text_mt: whether secular, Vedic, or spiritual, / goes to the dreadful Raurava hell, terrible to behold.

sanskrit_iast:
aṇumātrātmakaṃ dehaṃ ṣoḍaśārdhamiti smṛtam .
ādadīta yato jñānaṃ taṃ pūrvamabhivādayet . . 46
meaning:
अणुमात्रात्मकं देहं षोडशार्धमिति स्मृतम् .
आददीत यतो ज्ञानं तं पूर्वमभिवादयेत् . . 46
text_mt: A body consisting merely of subtle parts is traditionally remembered as eightfold. / He from whom one receives knowledge, him one should salute with reverence first.

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitrīsāramātro'pi varo vipraḥ suyantritaḥ .
nāyantritastrivedo'pi sarvāśī sarvavikrayī . . 47
meaning:
सावित्रीसारमात्रोऽपि वरो विप्रः सुयन्त्रितः .
नायन्त्रितस्त्रिवेदोऽपि सर्वाशी सर्वविक्रयी . . 47
text_mt: A brāhmaṇa who merely masters the Sāvitrī, if well-restrained, is superior; / not one who knows the three Vedas but is unrestrained, eating everything and selling everything.

sanskrit_iast:
śayyāsanedhyācarite śreyasā na samāviśet .
śayyāsanasthaścaivenaṃ pratyutthāyābhivādayet . . 48
meaning:
शय्यासनेध्याचरिते श्रेयसा न समाविशेत् .
शय्यासनस्थश्चैवेनं प्रत्युत्थायाभिवादयेत् . . 48
text_mt: One should not occupy a bed or seat that is used by a superior; / and seated upon a bed or seat, one should rise to greet him with reverence.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvaṃ prāṇā hyutkrāmanti yūnaḥ sthavira āgate .
pratyutthānābhivādābhyāṃ punastānpratipadyate . . 49
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वं प्राणा ह्युत्क्रामन्ति यूनः स्थविर आगते .
प्रत्युत्थानाभिवादाभ्यां पुनस्तान्प्रतिपद्यते . . 49
text_mt: For the vital breaths of a young man ascend upwards when an elder arrives; / by rising up and saluting with reverence, he recovers them again.

sanskrit_iast:
abhivādanaśīlasya nityaṃ vṛddhopasevinaḥ .
catvāri samyagvardhante āyuḥ prajñā yaśo balam . . 1.4.50
meaning:
अभिवादनशीलस्य नित्यं वृद्धोपसेविनः .
चत्वारि सम्यग्वर्धन्ते आयुः प्रज्ञा यशो बलम् . . 1.4.50
text_mt: For one who is accustomed to respectful salutation and who continually attends upon elders, / four things increase properly: life span, wisdom, fame, and strength.

sanskrit_iast:
abhivādaparo vipro jyāyāṃsamabhivādayet .
asau nāmāhamasmīti svanāma parikīrtayet . . 51
meaning:
अभिवादपरो विप्रो ज्यायांसमभिवादयेत् .
असौ नामाहमस्मीति स्वनाम परिकीर्तयेत् . . 51
text_mt: A brāhmaṇa devoted to respectful salutation should salute an elder; / he should announce his own name, saying, 'I am such-and-such by name.'

sanskrit_iast:
nāmadheyasya ye kecidabhivādaṃ na jānate .
tānprājño'hamiti brūyātstriyaḥ sarvāstathaiva ca . . 52
meaning:
नामधेयस्य ये केचिदभिवादं न जानते .
तान्प्राज्ञोऽहमिति ब्रूयात्स्त्रियः सर्वास्तथैव च . . 52
text_mt: To those who do not understand the salutation by name, / a wise man should say, 'It is I', and likewise to all women.

sanskrit_iast:
bhoḥ śabdaṃ kīrtayedante svasya nāmnobhivādane .
nāmnaḥ svarūpabhāvo hi bho bhāva ṛṣibhiḥ smṛtaḥ . . 53
meaning:
भोः शब्दं कीर्तयेदन्ते स्वस्य नाम्नोभिवादने .
नाम्नः स्वरूपभावो हि भो भाव ऋषिभिः स्मृतः . . 53
text_mt: He should pronounce the word 'bhoḥ' at the end of his own name in salutation; / for the inherent nature of a name is remembered by the sages as the state of 'bhoḥ'.

sanskrit_iast:
āyuṣmānbhava saumyeti vācyo vipro'bhivādane .
akāraścāsya nāmno'nte vācyaḥ pūrvākṣaraḥ plutaḥ . . 54
meaning:
आयुष्मान्भव सौम्येति वाच्यो विप्रोऽभिवादने .
अकारश्चास्य नाम्नोऽन्ते वाच्यः पूर्वाक्षरः प्लुतः . . 54
text_mt: A brāhmaṇa should be addressed in return of a salutation with: 'May you be long-lived, gentle one'; / and at the end of his name, the vowel 'a' should be spoken with the preceding syllable prolated.

sanskrit_iast:
yo na vettyabhivādasya vipraḥ pratyabhivādanam .
nābhivādyaḥ sa viduṣā yathā śūdrastathaiva saḥ . . 55
meaning:
यो न वेत्त्यभिवादस्य विप्रः प्रत्यभिवादनम् .
नाभिवाद्यः स विदुषा यथा शूद्रस्तथैव सः . . 55
text_mt: A brāhmaṇa who does not know how to return a salutation / should not be saluted by a learned man; he is just like a śūdra.

sanskrit_iast:
abhivāde kṛte yastu na karotyabhivādanam .
āśīrvā kuruśārdūla sa yāti narakaṃ dhruvam . . 56
meaning:
अभिवादे कृते यस्तु न करोत्यभिवादनम् .
आशीर्वा कुरुशार्दूल स याति नरकं ध्रुवम् . . 56
text_mt: He who, when a salutation has been made, does not return a salutation / or a blessing, O tiger of the Kurus, goes surely to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
abhīti bhagavānviṣṇuārvādayāmīti śaṅkaraḥ .
dvāveva pūjitau tena yaḥ karotyabhivādanam . . 57
meaning:
अभीति भगवान्विष्णुआर्वादयामीति शङ्करः .
द्वावेव पूजितौ तेन यः करोत्यभिवादनम् . . 57
text_mt: 'Abhi' is the blessed Viṣṇu, and 'I salute' [vādāyami] is Śaṅkara; / both of them are worshipped by him who performs a salutation.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaṃ kuśalaṃ pṛcchetkṣatrabandhumanāmayam .
vaiśyaṃ kṣemaṃ samāgamya śūdramārogyameva tu . . 58
meaning:
ब्राह्मणं कुशलं पृच्छेत्क्षत्रबन्धुमनामयम् .
वैश्यं क्षेमं समागम्य शूद्रमारोग्यमेव तु . . 58
text_mt: One should ask a brāhmaṇa about his well-being, an associate of the kṣatriya class about freedom from illness, / a vaiśya, upon meeting, about prosperity, and a śūdra about good health.

sanskrit_iast:
na vācyo dīkṣito nāmnā yavīyānapi yo bhavet .
bho bhavatpūrvakatvena iti svāyambhuvo'bravīt . 59
meaning:
न वाच्यो दीक्षितो नाम्ना यवीयानपि यो भवेत् .
भो भवत्पूर्वकत्वेन इति स्वायम्भुवोऽब्रवीत् . 59
text_mt: An initiated person, even if younger, should not be addressed by name, / but rather preceded by "bho" or "bhavat"—so spoke the Self-born Manu.

sanskrit_iast:
parapatnī tu yā rājannasambaddhā tu yonitaḥ .
vaktavyā bhavatītyevaṃ subhage bhaganīti ca . . 1.4.60
meaning:
परपत्नी तु या राजन्नसम्बद्धा तु योनितः .
वक्तव्या भवतीत्येवं सुभगे भगनीति च . . 1.4.60
text_mt: Another’s wife, O king, who is not related by blood, / should be addressed as "bhavatī", "fortunate one", or "sister".

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛvyānmātulānrājañchvaśurānṛtvijo gurūn .
asāvahamiti brūyātpratyutthāya jaghanyajaḥ . . 61
meaning:
पितृव्यान्मातुलान्राजञ्छ्वशुरानृत्विजो गुरून् .
असावहमिति ब्रूयात्प्रत्युत्थाय जघन्यजः . . 61
text_mt: To paternal uncles, maternal uncles, O king, fathers-in-law, priests, and elders, / a younger person should rise and say, "I am so-and-so".

sanskrit_iast:
mātṛṣvasā mātulānī śvaśrūratha pitṛṣvasā .
sampūjyā gurupatnī ca samāstā gurubhāryayā . . 62
meaning:
मातृष्वसा मातुलानी श्वश्रूरथ पितृष्वसा .
सम्पूज्या गुरुपत्नी च समास्ता गुरुभार्यया . . 62
text_mt: A maternal aunt, a maternal uncle's wife, a mother-in-law, and a paternal aunt / are to be revered like a guru's wife; they are equal to a guru's wife.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhasya bhrāturyā bhāryā savarṇāhanyahanyapi .
2pūjayanprayato vipro yāti viṣṇusado nṛpa . . 63
meaning:
ज्येष्ठस्य भ्रातुर्या भार्या सवर्णाहन्यहन्यपि .
2पूजयन्प्रयतो विप्रो याति विष्णुसदो नृप . . 63
text_mt: The wife of an elder brother, if of the same class, honoured day after day / with restrained devotion by a brāhmaṇa, leads him to the abode of Viṣṇu, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
pravāsādetya sampūjyā jñātisambandhiyoṣitaḥ .
pituryā bhaginī rājanmātuścāpi viśāmpate . . 64
meaning:
प्रवासादेत्य सम्पूज्या ज्ञातिसम्बन्धियोषितः .
पितुर्या भगिनी राजन्मातुश्चापि विशाम्पते . . 64
text_mt: Returning from abroad, one should revere the women of his kin and affines, / and the sister of his father, O king, and also of his mother, O lord of the people.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmano bhaginī yā ca jyeṣṭhā kurukulodvaha .
sadā svamātṛvaddhṛttimātiṣṭhedbhāratottama . . 65
meaning:
आत्मनो भगिनी या च ज्येष्ठा कुरुकुलोद्वह .
सदा स्वमातृवद्धृत्तिमातिष्ठेद्भारतोत्तम . . 65
text_mt: And one's own elder sister, O bearer of the Kuru lineage, / one should always treat like one's own mother, O best of Bharatas.

sanskrit_iast:
garīyasī tatastābhyo mātā jñeyā narādhipa .
putramitrabhāgineyā draṣṭavyā hyātmanā samāḥ . . 66
meaning:
गरीयसी ततस्ताभ्यो माता ज्ञेया नराधिप .
पुत्रमित्रभागिनेया द्रष्टव्या ह्यात्मना समाः . . 66
text_mt: A mother is to be known as greater than these, O lord of men; / but a son, a friend, and a sister’s son should indeed be regarded as equal to oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
daśābdākhyaṃ paurasakhyaṃ pañcābdākhyaṃ kalābhṛtām .
abdapūrvaṃ śrotriyāṇāṃ svalpenāpi svayoniṣu . . 67
meaning:
दशाब्दाख्यं पौरसख्यं पञ्चाब्दाख्यं कलाभृताम् .
अब्दपूर्वं श्रोत्रियाणां स्वल्पेनापि स्वयोनिषु . . 67
text_mt: Friendship among citizens is established by ten years' [difference], among artisans by five years', / among scholars of the Veda by a single year, and among one’s own kin by even a little.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaṃ daśavarṣaṃ ca śatavarṣaṃ ca bhūmipam .
pitāputrau vijānīyādbrāhmaṇastu tayoḥ pitā . . 68
meaning:
ब्राह्मणं दशवर्षं च शतवर्षं च भूमिपम् .
पितापुत्रौ विजानीयाद्ब्राह्मणस्तु तयोः पिता . . 68
text_mt: A ten-year-old brāhmaṇa and a hundred-year-old king / should be understood as father and son; and between the two, the brāhmaṇa is the father.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ kṣatriyapitā vaiśyasyāpi pitāmahaḥ .
prapitāmahaśca śūdrasya prokto vipro manīṣibhiḥ . . 69
meaning:
इत्येवं क्षत्रियपिता वैश्यस्यापि पितामहः .
प्रपितामहश्च शूद्रस्य प्रोक्तो विप्रो मनीषिभिः . . 69
text_mt: Thus the brāhmaṇa is declared by the wise to be the father of the kṣatriya, / the grandfather of the vaiśya, and the great-grandfather of the śūdra.

sanskrit_iast:
vittaṃ bandhurvayaḥ karma vidyā bhavati pañcamī .
etāni mānyasthānāni garīyo yadyaduttaram . . 1.4.70
meaning:
वित्तं बन्धुर्वयः कर्म विद्या भवति पञ्चमी .
एतानि मान्यस्थानानि गरीयो यद्यदुत्तरम् . . 1.4.70
text_mt: Wealth, kin, age, ritual action, and fifth is knowledge: / these are the grounds of respect; each subsequent one is more weighty [than the preceding].

sanskrit_iast:
pañcānāṃ triṣu vargeṣu bhūyāṃsi guṇavanti ca .
yasya syuḥ so'tra mānārhaḥ śūdro'pi daśamīṃ gataḥ . . 71
meaning:
पञ्चानां त्रिषु वर्गेषु भूयांसि गुणवन्ति च .
यस्य स्युः सोऽत्र मानार्हः शूद्रोऽपि दशमीं गतः . . 71
text_mt: He in whom the majority and the most excellent of these five are found within the three classes / is worthy of respect here, even a śūdra who has reached his tenth decade.

sanskrit_iast:
cakriṇo daśamīsthasya rogiṇo bhāriṇaḥ 1 striyāḥ .
snātakasya tu rājñaśca panthā deyo varasya ca . . 72
meaning:
चक्रिणो दशमीस्थस्य रोगिणो भारिणः 1 स्त्रियाः .
स्नातकस्य तु राज्ञश्च पन्था देयो वरस्य च . . 72
text_mt: Way should be given to one in a chariot, to one in his tenth decade, to the sick, to one carrying a burden, to a woman, / to a snātaka, to a king, and to a bridegroom.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣāṃ samāgame tāta pūjyau snātakapārthivau .
ābhyāṃ samāgame rājansnātako nṛpamānabhāk . . 73
meaning:
एषां समागमे तात पूज्यौ स्नातकपार्थिवौ .
आभ्यां समागमे राजन्स्नातको नृपमानभाक् . . 73
text_mt: When these meet, my dear, the snātaka and the king are to be honoured; / and when these two meet, O king, the snātaka receives honour from the king.

sanskrit_iast:
adhyāpayedyastu śiṣyaṃ kṛtvopanayanaṃ dvijaḥ .
sarahasyaṃ sakalpaṃ ca vedaṃ bharatasattama . .
tamācāryaṃ mahābāho pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ . . 74
meaning:
अध्यापयेद्यस्तु शिष्यं कृत्वोपनयनं द्विजः .
सरहस्यं सकल्पं च वेदं भरतसत्तम . .
तमाचार्यं महाबाहो प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः . . 74
text_mt: The twice-born who, having performed the student's initiation, teaches him / the Veda along with its esoteric meaning and its ritual manuals, O best of Bharatas, / him the wise call an ācārya, O mighty-armed one.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadeśaṃ tu vedasya vedāṅgānyapi vā punaḥ .
yo'dhyāpayati vṛttyarthamupādhyāyaḥ sa ucyate . . 75
meaning:
एकदेशं तु वेदस्य वेदाङ्गान्यपि वा पुनः .
योऽध्यापयति वृत्त्यर्थमुपाध्यायः स उच्यते . . 75
text_mt: One who, however, teaches for his livelihood a single portion of the Veda, / or again the auxiliary sciences of the Veda, is called an upādhyāya.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣekādīni kāryāṇi yaḥ karoti nṛpottama .
adhyāpayati cānyena sa vipro gururucyate . . 76
meaning:
निषेकादीनि कार्याणि यः करोति नृपोत्तम .
अध्यापयति चान्येन स विप्रो गुरुरुच्यते . . 76
text_mt: He who performs the rites beginning with conception, O best of kings, / and has him taught by another, that brāhmaṇa is called a guru.

sanskrit_iast:
agnyādheyaṃ pākayajñānagniṣṭomādikānmakhān .
yaḥ karoti vṛto yasya sa tasyartvigihocyate . . 77
meaning:
अग्न्याधेयं पाकयज्ञानग्निष्टोमादिकान्मखान् .
यः करोति वृतो यस्य स तस्यर्त्विगिहोच्यते . . 77
text_mt: He who, being chosen by someone, performs for him the establishment of the fires, / the cooked-food sacrifices, and the sacrifices beginning with the Agniṣṭoma, is called his ṛtvij here.

sanskrit_iast:
ya āvṛṇotyavitathaṃ brahmaṇā śravaṇāvubhau .
sa mātā sa pitā jñeyastaṃ na druhyetkathañcana 1 . . 78
meaning:
य आवृणोत्यवितथं ब्रह्मणा श्रवणावुभौ .
स माता स पिता ज्ञेयस्तं न द्रुह्येत्कथञ्चन 1 . . 78
text_mt: He who truthfully fills both ears with the Veda / should be known as mother and father; one must never injure him in any way.

sanskrit_iast:
upādhyāyāndaśācāryaṃ ācāryāṇāṃ śataṃ pitā .
sahasreṇa piturmātā gauraveṇātiricyate . . 79
meaning:
उपाध्यायान्दशाचार्यं आचार्याणां शतं पिता .
सहस्रेण पितुर्माता गौरवेणातिरिच्यते . . 79
text_mt: An ācārya surpasses ten upādhyāyas, a father surpasses a hundred ācāryas, / and a mother surpasses a thousand fathers in venerability.

sanskrit_iast:
utpādakabrahmadātrorgarīyānbrahmadaḥ pitā .
brahmajanma hi viprasya pretya ceha ca śāśvatam . . 1.4.80
meaning:
उत्पादकब्रह्मदात्रोर्गरीयान्ब्रह्मदः पिता .
ब्रह्मजन्म हि विप्रस्य प्रेत्य चेह च शाश्वतम् . . 1.4.80
text_mt: Between the physical progenitor and the giver of the Veda, the father who gives the Veda is greater; / for the Vedic birth of a brāhmaṇa is eternal, both in the hereafter and here.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmānmātā pitā cainaṃ yadutpādayato mithaḥ .
sambhūtiṃ tasya tāṃ vidyādyadyonāvabhijāyate . . 81
meaning:
कामान्माता पिता चैनं यदुत्पादयतो मिथः .
सम्भूतिं तस्य तां विद्याद्यद्योनावभिजायते . . 81
text_mt: That birth which a mother and father bring about for him mutually out of desire, / that should be known as his birth when he is born in the womb.

sanskrit_iast:
ācāryastasya tāṃ jātiṃ vidhidvedapāragaḥ .
utpādayati sāvitryā sā satyā sā'jarāmarā . . 82
meaning:
आचार्यस्तस्य तां जातिं विधिद्वेदपारगः .
उत्पादयति सावित्र्या सा सत्या साऽजरामरा . . 82
text_mt: That birth which the ācārya, fully versed in the Veda, brings about for him / in accordance with the rules through the Sāvitrī, that is real, ageless, and immortal.

sanskrit_iast:
upādhyāyamāditaḥ kṛtvā ye pūjyāḥ kathitāstava .
mahāgururmahābāho sarveṣāmadhikaḥ smṛtaḥ . . 83
meaning:
उपाध्यायमादितः कृत्वा ये पूज्याः कथितास्तव .
महागुरुर्महाबाहो सर्वेषामधिकः स्मृतः . . 83
text_mt: Of those who have been described to you as worthy of worship, beginning with the upādhyāya, / the mahāguru, O mighty-armed one, is traditionally considered superior to all.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraśatasaṃkhyo'sāvācāryāṇāmidaṃ matam .
caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ sa mahāgururucyate . . 84
meaning:
सहस्रशतसंख्योऽसावाचार्याणामिदं मतम् .
चतुर्णामपि वर्णानां स महागुरुरुच्यते . . 84
text_mt: He counts as a hundred thousand ācāryas—this is the view; / for all four classes, he is called the mahāguru.

sanskrit_iast:
śatānīka uvāca
ya ete bhavatā proktā upādhyāyamukhā dvijāḥ .
viditā eva me sarve na mahāgurureva hi . . 85
meaning:
शतानीक उवाच
य एते भवता प्रोक्ता उपाध्यायमुखा द्विजाः .
विदिता एव मे सर्वे न महागुरुरेव हि . . 85
text_mt:
Śatānīka said:
All these twice-born men described by you, headed by the upādhyāya, / are well known to me, but not the mahāguru.

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
jayopajīvī yo vipraḥ sa mahāgururucyate .
aṣṭādaśapurāṇāni rāmasya caritaṃ tathā . . 86
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
जयोपजीवी यो विप्रः स महागुरुरुच्यते .
अष्टादशपुराणानि रामस्य चरितं तथा . . 86
text_mt:
Sumantu said:
The brāhmaṇa who makes his living from the Jaya is called the mahāguru: / the eighteen Purāṇas, as well as the deeds of Rāma,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇudharmādayo dharmāḥ śivadharmāśca bhārata .
kārṣṇaṃ vedaṃ pañcamaṃ tu yanmahābhārataṃ smṛtam . . 87
meaning:
विष्णुधर्मादयो धर्माः शिवधर्माश्च भारत .
कार्ष्णं वेदं पञ्चमं तु यन्महाभारतं स्मृतम् . . 87
text_mt: duties beginning with the Viṣṇudharma, and the Śivadharmas, O descendant of Bharata, / and the fifth Veda composed by Kṛṣṇa [Dvaipāyana], which is remembered as the Mahābhārata,

sanskrit_iast:
śrautā 1 dharmāśca rājendra nāradoktā mahīpate .
jayeti nāma eteṣāṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ . . 88
meaning:
श्रौता 1 धर्माश्च राजेन्द्र नारदोक्ता महीपते .
जयेति नाम एतेषां प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः . . 88
text_mt: and the revealed duties spoken by Nārada, O lord of the earth; / the wise declare that the name of these is "Jaya".

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ viprakadambasya dhārakaḥ2 pravaraḥ smṛtaḥ .
yastvetāni samastāni purāṇānīha vindati . . 89
meaning:
एवं विप्रकदम्बस्य धारकः2 प्रवरः स्मृतः .
यस्त्वेतानि समस्तानि पुराणानीह विन्दति . . 89
text_mt: Thus the bearer [of these texts] is held to be the foremost among the assembly of brāhmaṇas; / he who masters all these Purāṇas here,

sanskrit_iast:
bhārataṃ ca mahābāho sa sarvajño mato nṛṇām .
tasmātsa pūjyo rājendra varṇairviprādibhiḥ sadā . . 1.4.90
meaning:
भारतं च महाबाहो स सर्वज्ञो मतो नृणाम् .
तस्मात्स पूज्यो राजेन्द्र वर्णैर्विप्रादिभिः सदा . . 1.4.90
text_mt: and the Mahābhārata, O mighty-armed one, is considered omniscient among men. / Therefore, O king of kings, he is ever to be honoured by the classes, beginning with the brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ tvayā na śrutaṃ vākyaṃ yadāha bhagavānvibhuḥ .
alpaṃ vā bahu vā yasya śrutasyopakaroti yaḥ . .
tamapīha guruṃ vidyācchrutopakriyayā tayā3 . . 91
meaning:
किं त्वया न श्रुतं वाक्यं यदाह भगवान्विभुः .
अल्पं वा बहु वा यस्य श्रुतस्योपकरोति यः . .
तमपीह गुरुं विद्याच्छ्रुतोपक्रियया तया3 . . 91
text_mt: Have you not heard the statement spoken by the glorious all-pervading Lord: / "He who assists someone with learning, whether little or much, / should also be recognized as a guru here, on account of that service of sacred learning"?

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmasya janmanaḥ kartā svadharmasya ca śāsitā .
bālo'pi vipro vṛddhasya pitā bhavati dharmataḥ 4 . . 92
meaning:
ब्राह्मस्य जन्मनः कर्ता स्वधर्मस्य च शासिता .
बालोऽपि विप्रो वृद्धस्य पिता भवति धर्मतः 4 . . 92
text_mt: He who brings about the Vedic birth and instructs in one's own duty, / even if a boy, is according to dharma the father of an elder.

sanskrit_iast:
adhyāpayāmāsa pitṝñchiśurāṅgirasaḥ kaviḥ .
putrakā iti hovāca jñānena parigṛhya tām . . 93
meaning:
अध्यापयामास पितॄञ्छिशुराङ्गिरसः कविः .
पुत्रका इति होवाच ज्ञानेन परिगृह्य ताम् . . 93
text_mt: The young son of Aṅgiras, a poet, taught his ancestors; / taking hold of them with knowledge, he said: "Little sons!"

sanskrit_iast:
te tamarthamapṛcchanta devānāgatamanyavaḥ .
devāścaitānsametyocurnyāyyaṃ vai śiśuruktavān . . 94
meaning:
ते तमर्थमपृच्छन्त देवानागतमन्यवः .
देवाश्चैतान्समेत्योचुर्न्याय्यं वै शिशुरुक्तवान् . . 94
text_mt: Filled with indignation, they asked the gods about this matter; / and the gods assembled and said to them: "Truly, the boy spoke rightly.

sanskrit_iast:
ajño bhavati vai bālaḥ pitā bhavati mantradaḥ .
ajñaṃ hi bālamityāhuḥ pitetyeva tu mantradam . . 95
meaning:
अज्ञो भवति वै बालः पिता भवति मन्त्रदः .
अज्ञं हि बालमित्याहुः पितेत्येव तु मन्त्रदम् . . 95
text_mt: One without knowledge is indeed a child; the giver of sacred mantras is the father. / For they call an ignorant man a child, but the giver of mantras a father."

sanskrit_iast:
pitāmaheti jayadamityūcuste divaukasaḥ .
jayo mantrāstathā vedā dehamekaṃ tridhā kṛtam . . 96
meaning:
पितामहेति जयदमित्यूचुस्ते दिवौकसः .
जयो मन्त्रास्तथा वेदा देहमेकं त्रिधा कृतम् . . 96
text_mt: "And the giver of the Jaya is a grandfather," those dwellers in heaven declared. / The Jaya, the mantras, and the Vedas are one single body divided into three.

sanskrit_iast:
nahāyanairna palitairna mitreṇa na bandhubhiḥ .
ṛṣayaścakrire dharmaṃ yo'nūcānaḥ sa no mahān . . 97
meaning:
नहायनैर्न पलितैर्न मित्रेण न बन्धुभिः .
ऋषयश्चक्रिरे धर्मं योऽनूचानः स नो महान् . . 97
text_mt: Not by years, nor by grey hair, nor by friends, nor by kin / did the sages establish dharma; he who has studied the Veda is great among us.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca viśāṃpate .
jyeṣṭhaṃ vandanti rājendra sandehaṃ śṛṇu vai yathā . . 98
meaning:
ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च विशांपते .
ज्येष्ठं वन्दन्ति राजेन्द्र सन्देहं शृणु वै यथा . . 98
text_mt: Of brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, and of śūdras, O lord of the people, / they venerate the eldest, O king of kings; listen indeed to how there is doubt [regarding this].

sanskrit_iast:
jñānato vīryato rājandhanato janmatastathā .
śīlatastu pradhānā ye te pradhānā matā mama . . 99
meaning:
ज्ञानतो वीर्यतो राजन्धनतो जन्मतस्तथा .
शीलतस्तु प्रधाना ये ते प्रधाना मता मम . . 99
text_mt: Those who are pre-eminent by knowledge, by valour, O king, by wealth, by birth, / and by virtuous conduct—they are considered foremost by me.

sanskrit_iast:
na tena sthaviro bhavati yenāsya palitaṃ śiraḥ .
yo vai yuvāpyadhīyānastaṃ devāḥ sthaviraṃ viduḥ . . 1.4.100
meaning:
न तेन स्थविरो भवति येनास्य पलितं शिरः .
यो वै युवाप्यधीयानस्तं देवाः स्थविरं विदुः . . 1.4.100
text_mt: One does not become an elder because his head is grey; / he who, though young, is learned, the gods know him to be an elder.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā kāṣṭhamayo hastī yathā carmamayo mṛgaḥ .
yaśca vipro'nadhīyānastrayaste nāma 1 bibhrati . . 101
meaning:
यथा काष्ठमयो हस्ती यथा चर्ममयो मृगः .
यश्च विप्रोऽनधीयानस्त्रयस्ते नाम 1 बिभ्रति . . 101
text_mt: Just as a wooden elephant, just as a leather deer, / and just as a brāhmaṇa who does not study—these three bear only the name.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā yoṣā'phalā strīṣu yathā gaurgavi cāphalā .
yathā cājñe'phalaṃ dānaṃ yathā vipro'nṛco'phalaḥ . . 102
meaning:
यथा योषाऽफला स्त्रीषु यथा गौर्गवि चाफला .
यथा चाज्ञेऽफलं दानं यथा विप्रोऽनृचोऽफलः . . 102
text_mt: Just as a woman who is barren among women, just as a cow who is barren among cattle, / and just as a gift to an ignorant man is fruitless, so a brāhmaṇa without the Ṛgveda is fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśvadevena ye hīnā ātithyena vivarjitāḥ .
sarve tu vṛṣalā jñeyāḥ prāptavedā api dvijāḥ . . 103
meaning:
वैश्वदेवेन ये हीना आतिथ्येन विवर्जिताः .
सर्वे तु वृषला ज्ञेयाः प्राप्तवेदा अपि द्विजाः . . 103
text_mt: Those who are destitute of the rite to all the gods and devoid of hospitality / are all to be known as outcasts, even if they be twice-born who have acquired the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
nānṛgbrāhmaṇo bhavati na vaṇiṅna kuśīlavaḥ .
na śūdraḥ preṣaṇaṃ kurvannasteno na cikitsakaḥ . . 104
meaning:
नानृग्ब्राह्मणो भवति न वणिङ्न कुशीलवः .
न शूद्रः प्रेषणं कुर्वन्नस्तेनो न चिकित्सकः . . 104
text_mt: One without the Ṛgveda does not become a brāhmaṇa, nor a merchant, nor an actor; / a servant performing errands is not a śūdra, nor is a thief a physician.

sanskrit_iast:
avratā hyanadhīyānā yatra bhaikṣacarā dvijāḥ .
taṃ grāmaṃ daṇḍayedrājā corabhaktaprado hi saḥ . . 105
meaning:
अव्रता ह्यनधीयाना यत्र भैक्षचरा द्विजाः .
तं ग्रामं दण्डयेद्राजा चोरभक्तप्रदो हि सः . . 105
text_mt: Where twice-born men wander for alms without vows and without studying, / the king should punish that village, for it provides food to thieves.

sanskrit_iast:
santuṣṭo yatra vai vipraḥ sāgnikaḥ kurunandana .
yāti sāphalyatāṃ vedairdevairevaṃ hi bhāṣitam . . 106
meaning:
सन्तुष्टो यत्र वै विप्रः साग्निकः कुरुनन्दन .
याति साफल्यतां वेदैर्देवैरेवं हि भाषितम् . . 106
text_mt: Where a brāhmaṇa who maintains the sacred fire is contented, O scion of the Kurus, / he attains fulfillment through the Vedas; thus indeed the gods have spoken.

sanskrit_iast:
vedairuktaṃ yathā vīra surajyeṣṭhamupetya vai .
vepante brāhmaṇā bhūmāvabhyasyanti hyanagnikāḥ . .
kliśyante te kimarthaṃ hi mūḍhā vai phalakāmyayā . . 107
meaning:
वेदैरुक्तं यथा वीर सुरज्येष्ठमुपेत्य वै .
वेपन्ते ब्राह्मणा भूमावभ्यस्यन्ति ह्यनग्निकाः . .
क्लिश्यन्ते ते किमर्थं हि मूढा वै फलकाम्यया . . 107
text_mt: As was said by the Vedas, O hero, having approached the eldest of gods: / 'Brāhmaṇas tremble on earth, practicing [the Vedas] without sacred fires; / why do those fools suffer, yearning for fruits?'

sanskrit_iast:
anuṣṭhānavihīnānāmasmānabhyasatāṃ bhuvi .
kleśo hi kevalaṃ deva nāsmadabhyasane phalam . . 108
meaning:
अनुष्ठानविहीनानामस्मानभ्यसतां भुवि .
क्लेशो हि केवलं देव नास्मदभ्यसने फलम् . . 108
text_mt: 'For those devoid of practice who repeat us on earth, / it is sheer distress, O lord; there is no fruit in repeating us.'

sanskrit_iast:
anuṣṭhānaṃ paraṃ devamasmatsvabhyasanātsadā .
ityevaṃ rājaśārdūla vedā ūcurhi vedhasam . .
tasmācca vedābhyasanādanuṣṭhānaṃ paraṃ matam . . 109
meaning:
अनुष्ठानं परं देवमस्मत्स्वभ्यसनात्सदा .
इत्येवं राजशार्दूल वेदा ऊचुर्हि वेधसम् . .
तस्माच्च वेदाभ्यसनादनुष्ठानं परं मतम् . . 109
text_mt: 'Practice is superior, O lord, always over the mere repetition of us.' / In this way, O tiger among kings, the Vedas spoke to the Creator; / therefore, practice is considered superior to the repetition of the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāro vā trayo vāpi yadbrūyurvedapāragāḥ .
sa dharma iti vijñeyo netareṣāṃ sahasraśaḥ . . 1.4.110
meaning:
चत्वारो वा त्रयो वापि यद्ब्रूयुर्वेदपारगाः .
स धर्म इति विज्ञेयो नेतरेषां सहस्रशः . . 1.4.110
text_mt: Whatever four, or even three, who have mastered the Vedas declare, / that should be known as dharma, not what is proclaimed by thousands of others.

sanskrit_iast:
yadvadanti tamomūḍhā mūrkhā dharmamajānataḥ 1 .
tatpāpaṃ śatadhā bhūtvā vaktṝnevānugacchati . . 111
meaning:
यद्वदन्ति तमोमूढा मूर्खा धर्ममजानतः 1 .
तत्पापं शतधा भूत्वा वक्तॄनेवानुगच्छति . . 111
text_mt: What fools deluded by darkness declare, ignorant of dharma, / that sin, multiplying a hundredfold, pursues only the speakers.

sanskrit_iast:
śaucahīne vratabhraṣṭe vipre vedavivarjite .
dīyamānaṃ rudatyannaṃ ki mayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam . . 112
meaning:
शौचहीने व्रतभ्रष्टे विप्रे वेदविवर्जिते .
दीयमानं रुदत्यन्नं कि मया दुष्कृतं कृतम् . . 112
text_mt: When food is given to a brāhmaṇa lacking purity, fallen from vows, and devoid of the Vedas, / it weeps, [saying,] 'What evil deed have I done?'

sanskrit_iast:
japopajīvine dattaṃ yadātmānaṃ prapaśyati .
nṛtyati sma tadā rājankarāvuddhṛtya bhārata . . 113
meaning:
जपोपजीविने दत्तं यदात्मानं प्रपश्यति .
नृत्यति स्म तदा राजन्करावुद्धृत्य भारत . . 113
text_mt: When it sees itself given to one living by silent recitation, / then, O king, raising its hands, it dances, O Bhārata.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyātapobhyāṃ sampanne brāhmaṇe gṛhamāgate .
krīḍantyauṣadhayaḥ sarvā yāsyāmaḥ paramāṃ gatim . . 114
meaning:
विद्यातपोभ्यां सम्पन्ने ब्राह्मणे गृहमागते .
क्रीडन्त्यौषधयः सर्वा यास्यामः परमां गतिम् . . 114
text_mt: When a brāhmaṇa endowed with knowledge and austerity enters a house, / all medicinal plants rejoice, [thinking,] 'We shall go to the highest state.'

sanskrit_iast:
1avratānāmamantrāṇāmajapānāṃ ca bhārata .
pratigraho na dātavyo na śilā tārayecchilām . . 115
meaning:
1अव्रतानाममन्त्राणामजपानां च भारत .
प्रतिग्रहो न दातव्यो न शिला तारयेच्छिलाम् . . 115
text_mt: To those without vows, without mantras, and without silent recitation, O Bhārata, / gifts should not be given; a stone cannot carry a stone across [the water].

sanskrit_iast:
śrotriyāyaiva deyāni havyakavyāni nityaśaḥ .
aśrotriyāya dattāni na pitṝnnāpi 2 devatāḥ . . 116
meaning:
श्रोत्रियायैव देयानि हव्यकव्यानि नित्यशः .
अश्रोत्रियाय दत्तानि न पितॄन्नापि 2 देवताः . . 116
text_mt: Offerings to the gods and ancestors are always to be given only to one learned in scripture; / what is given to one not learned in scripture reaches neither ancestors nor deities.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya caiva gṛhe mūrkho dūre cāpi bahuśrutaḥ .
bahuśrutāya dātavyaṃ nāsti mūrkhavyatikramaḥ . . 117
meaning:
यस्य चैव गृहे मूर्खो दूरे चापि बहुश्रुतः .
बहुश्रुताय दातव्यं नास्ति मूर्खव्यतिक्रमः . . 117
text_mt: If a fool is in one's house and a learned man is far away, / it should be given to the learned man; passing over a fool is no transgression.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇātikramo nāsti mūrkhe japavivarjite .
jvalantamagnimutsṛjya na hi bhasmani hūyate . . 118
meaning:
ब्राह्मणातिक्रमो नास्ति मूर्खे जपविवर्जिते .
ज्वलन्तमग्निमुत्सृज्य न हि भस्मनि हूयते . . 118
text_mt: There is no transgression of a brāhmaṇa in the case of a fool devoid of silent recitation; / indeed, leaving a blazing fire, one does not offer oblation into ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
na caitadeva manyante .pitaro devatāstathā .
saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ vāpi brāhmaṇaṃ daivataṃ param . . 119
meaning:
न चैतदेव मन्यन्ते .पितरो देवतास्तथा .
सगुणं निर्गुणं वापि ब्राह्मणं दैवतं परम् . . 119
text_mt: Nor do the ancestors and the deities think thus; / whether virtuous or devoid of virtues, a brāhmaṇa is the supreme deity.

sanskrit_iast:
nātikramedgṛhāsīnaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ viprakarmaṇi 3 .
atikramanmahābāho rauravaṃ yāti bhārata . . 1.4.120
meaning:
नातिक्रमेद्गृहासीनं ब्राह्मणं विप्रकर्मणि 3 .
अतिक्रमन्महाबाहो रौरवं याति भारत . . 1.4.120
text_mt: In rites for brāhmaṇas, one should not pass over a brāhmaṇa seated in the house; / passing over him, O mighty-armed Bhārata, one goes to Raurava.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatrīmātrasāro'pi brāhmaṇaḥ pūjyatāṃ gataḥ .
gṛhāsanno viśeṣeṇa na bhavetpatitastu saḥ . . 121
meaning:
गायत्रीमात्रसारोऽपि ब्राह्मणः पूज्यतां गतः .
गृहासन्नो विशेषेण न भवेत्पतितस्तु सः . . 121
text_mt: Even one who has only the Gāyatrī as his essence is a brāhmaṇa who has attained venerability, / especially if he is nearby in the house, provided he is not fallen.

sanskrit_iast:
dhānyaśūnyo yathā grāmo yathā kūpaśca nirjalaḥ .
brāhmaṇaścānadhīyānastrayaste nāmadhārakāḥ . . 122
meaning:
धान्यशून्यो यथा ग्रामो यथा कूपश्च निर्जलः .
ब्राह्मणश्चानधीयानस्त्रयस्ते नामधारकाः . . 122
text_mt: Just like a village devoid of grain and a well without water, / so is an unlearned brāhmaṇa: these three merely bear the name.

sanskrit_iast:
yastvekapaṅktyāṃ viṣamaṃ dadāti snehādbhayādvā yadi vārthahetoḥ .
vedeṣu dṛṣṭamṛṣibhiśca gītaṃ tāṃ brahmahatyāṃ munayo vadanti . . 123
meaning:
यस्त्वेकपङ्क्त्यां विषमं ददाति स्नेहाद्भयाद्वा यदि वार्थहेतोः .
वेदेषु दृष्टमृषिभिश्च गीतं तां ब्रह्महत्यां मुनयो वदन्ति . . 123
text_mt: He who serves unequally in a single row out of affection, fear, or for the sake of wealth— / this is seen in the Vedas and sung by the sages; the wise call that the murder of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ahiṃsayaiva bhūtānāṃ kāryaṃ śreyo'nuśāsanam .
vākcaiva madhurā ślakṣṇā prayojyā dharmamīpsatā . . 124
meaning:
अहिंसयैव भूतानां कार्यं श्रेयोऽनुशासनम् .
वाक्चैव मधुरा श्लक्ष्णा प्रयोज्या धर्ममीप्सता . . 124
text_mt: Instruction for the welfare of living beings should be performed only through non-violence; / and speech that is sweet and gentle should be employed by one desiring dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya vāṅmanasī śuddhe satyagupte ca bhārata .
sa vai sarvamavāpnoti vedāntopagataṃ phalam . . 125
meaning:
यस्य वाङ्मनसी शुद्धे सत्यगुप्ते च भारत .
स वै सर्वमवाप्नोति वेदान्तोपगतं फलम् . . 125
text_mt: He whose speech and mind are pure and well guarded by truth, O Bhārata, / attains the entire fruit that is attained through the Vedānta.

sanskrit_iast:
nāruntudaḥ syādārto'pi na paradrohakarmadhīḥ .
yayāsyo dvijate loko na tāṃ vācamudīrayet . . 126
meaning:
नारुन्तुदः स्यादार्तोऽपि न परद्रोहकर्मधीः .
ययास्यो द्विजते लोको न तां वाचमुदीरयेत् . . 126
text_mt: Even when afflicted, one should not wound the vital spots of others, nor have a mind bent on injuring others; / one should not utter that speech by which people are distressed.

sanskrit_iast:
yatkaroti śubhaṃ vācā 1 procyamānā manīṣibhiḥ .
śrūyatāṃ kuruśārdūla sadā cāpi tathocyatām . . 127
meaning:
यत्करोति शुभं वाचा 1 प्रोच्यमाना मनीषिभिः .
श्रूयतां कुरुशार्दूल सदा चापि तथोच्यताम् . . 127
text_mt: The good that is accomplished by speech when uttered by the wise, / let that be heard, O tiger of the Kurus, and let it always be spoken likewise.

sanskrit_iast:
na tathā śaśī na salilaṃ na candanaraso na śītalacchāyā .
prahlādayati ca puruṣaṃ yathā madhurabhāṣiṇī vāṇī . . 128
meaning:
न तथा शशी न सलिलं न चन्दनरसो न शीतलच्छाया .
प्रह्लादयति च पुरुषं यथा मधुरभाषिणी वाणी . . 128
text_mt: Neither the moon, nor water, nor sandalwood paste, nor cool shade / delights a man as much as sweet-sounding speech.

sanskrit_iast:
arhaṇādbrāhmaṇo nityamudvijeta viṣādiva .
amṛtasyeva cākāṃkṣedapamānasya sarvadā . . 129
meaning:
अर्हणाद्ब्राह्मणो नित्यमुद्विजेत विषादिव .
अमृतस्येव चाकांक्षेदपमानस्य सर्वदा . . 129
text_mt: A brāhmaṇa should constantly recoil from honour as from poison, / and always yearn for insult as for nectar.

sanskrit_iast:
sukhaṃ hyavamataḥ śete sukhaṃ ca pratibudhyate .
sukhaṃ carati lokesminnavamantā vinaśyati . . 1.4.130
meaning:
सुखं ह्यवमतः शेते सुखं च प्रतिबुध्यते .
सुखं चरति लोकेस्मिन्नवमन्ता विनश्यति . . 1.4.130
text_mt: For despised he sleeps in peace, in peace he awakens, / and in peace he walks in this world; the despiser perishes.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā rājansaṃskṛtātmā dvijaḥ śanaiḥ .
gurau vasansecinuyādbrahmādhigamidaṃ tapaḥ . . 131
meaning:
अनेन विधिना राजन्संस्कृतात्मा द्विजः शनैः .
गुरौ वसन्सेचिनुयाद्ब्रह्माधिगमिदं तपः . . 131
text_mt: By this rule, O king, a twice-born man whose self is purified gradually, / dwelling with a guru, should accumulate this austerity leading to the knowledge of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
tapoviśeṣairvividhairvrataiśca vividhoditaiḥ .
vedaḥ kṛtsnodhigantavyaḥ sarahasyo dvijanmanā . . 132
meaning:
तपोविशेषैर्विविधैर्व्रतैश्च विविधोदितैः .
वेदः कृत्स्नोधिगन्तव्यः सरहस्यो द्विजन्मना . . 132
text_mt: Through various special austerities and various prescribed vows, / the entire Veda along with its esoteric teachings is to be mastered by the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
vedamevābhyasennityaṃ tapastapyaṃ dvijottamaḥ .
vedābhyāso hi viprasya tapaḥ paramihocyate . . 133
meaning:
वेदमेवाभ्यसेन्नित्यं तपस्तप्यं द्विजोत्तमः .
वेदाभ्यासो हि विप्रस्य तपः परमिहोच्यते . . 133
text_mt: The best of the twice-born should constantly practice the Veda, performing austerity; / for practice of the Veda is declared to be the supreme austerity of a brāhmaṇa in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
āhaiva sa nakhāgrebhyaḥ paramaṃ tapyate tapaḥ .
yaḥ supto'pi dvijo'dhīte svādhyāyaṃ śaktito'nvaham . . 134
meaning:
आहैव स नखाग्रेभ्यः परमं तप्यते तपः .
यः सुप्तोऽपि द्विजोऽधीते स्वाध्यायं शक्तितोऽन्वहम् . . 134
text_mt: He performs supreme austerity indeed to the tips of his nails, / that twice-born man who, even when lying down, recites the sacred study daily according to his ability.

sanskrit_iast:
yo'nadhītya dvijo vedamanyatra kurute śramam .
sa jīvanneva śūdratvamāśu gacchati sānvayaḥ . . 135
meaning:
योऽनधीत्य द्विजो वेदमन्यत्र कुरुते श्रमम् .
स जीवन्नेव शूद्रत्वमाशु गच्छति सान्वयः . . 135
text_mt: The twice-born man who, without studying the Veda, exerts himself elsewhere, / swiftly sinks to the condition of a śūdra even while living, along with his family.

sanskrit_iast:
na yasya vedo na japo na vidyāśca viśāmpate .
sa śūdra eva mantavya ityāha bhagavānvibhuḥ . . 136
meaning:
न यस्य वेदो न जपो न विद्याश्च विशाम्पते .
स शूद्र एव मन्तव्य इत्याह भगवान्विभुः . . 136
text_mt: He who has neither the Veda, nor silent recitation, nor knowledge, O lord of the people, / is to be regarded merely as a śūdra; thus spoke the Lord, the all-pervading.

sanskrit_iast:
māturagre ca jananaṃ dvitīyo mauñjibandhanam .
tṛtīyo yajñadīkṣāyāṃ dvijasya vidhirīritaḥ . . 137
meaning:
मातुरग्रे च जननं द्वितीयो मौञ्जिबन्धनम् .
तृतीयो यज्ञदीक्षायां द्विजस्य विधिरीरितः . . 137
text_mt: The first birth is from the mother, the second is the tying of the muñja grass girdle; / the third is at the sacrificial consecration; thus the rule is declared for a twice-born man.

sanskrit_iast: tatra yadbrahma janmāsya mauñjībandhanacihnitam . . 138
meaning: तत्र यद्ब्रह्म जन्मास्य मौञ्जीबन्धनचिह्नितम् . . 138
text_mt: In that regard, that Vedic birth of his marked by the tying of the muñja girdle,

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāsya mātā sāvitrī pitā tvācārya ucyate .
vedapradānāttvācāryaṃ pitaraṃ manurabravīt . . 139
meaning:
तत्रास्य माता सावित्री पिता त्वाचार्य उच्यते .
वेदप्रदानात्त्वाचार्यं पितरं मनुरब्रवीत् . . 139
text_mt: therein his mother is the Sāvitrī, while the teacher is called his father; / because of imparting the Veda, Manu spoke of the teacher as the father.

sanskrit_iast:
na hyasya vidyate karma kiñcidāmauñjibandhanāt .
nābhivyāhārayedbrahama svadhāninayanādṛte 1 . . 1.4.140
meaning:
न ह्यस्य विद्यते कर्म किञ्चिदामौञ्जिबन्धनात् .
नाभिव्याहारयेद्ब्रहम स्वधानिनयनादृते 1 . . 1.4.140
text_mt: Indeed, no rite exists for him until the tying of the muñja girdle; / he should not pronounce the sacred word, except for the offering of ancestral libations.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdreṇa tu samaṃ tāvadyāvadvede na jāyate .
kṛtopanayanasyāsya vratādeśanamiṣyate . .
brahmaṇo grahaṇaṃ caiva krameṇa vidhipūrvakam . . 141
meaning:
शूद्रेण तु समं तावद्यावद्वेदे न जायते .
कृतोपनयनस्यास्य व्रतादेशनमिष्यते . .
ब्रह्मणो ग्रहणं चैव क्रमेण विधिपूर्वकम् . . 141
text_mt: He is equal to a śūdra so long as he is not born in the Veda; / once his initiation has been performed, the direction of vows is prescribed for him, / and the gradual acquisition of the sacred knowledge according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
yatsūtraṃ cāpi yaccarma yā yā cāsya ca mekhalā .
vasanaṃ cāpi yo daṇḍastadvai tasya vrateṣvapi . . 142
meaning:
यत्सूत्रं चापि यच्चर्म या या चास्य च मेखला .
वसनं चापि यो दण्डस्तद्वै तस्य व्रतेष्वपि . . 142
text_mt: The sacred thread, the animal skin, whatever girdle he has, / the garment, and the staff—these remain his during the vows as well.

sanskrit_iast:
sevetemāṃstu niyamānbrahmacārī gurau vasan .
sanniyamyendriyagrāmaṃ tapovṛddhyarthamātmanaḥ . . 143
meaning:
सेवेतेमांस्तु नियमान्ब्रह्मचारी गुरौ वसन् .
सन्नियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं तपोवृद्ध्यर्थमात्मनः . . 143
text_mt: A student of the Veda, dwelling with his guru, should observe these restraints, / completely controlling the collection of senses for the increase of his own austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛndārakarṣipitṝṇāṃ kuryāttarpaṇameva hi .
narāṇāṃ ca mahābāho nityaṃ snātvā prayatnataḥ . . 144
meaning:
वृन्दारकर्षिपितॄणां कुर्यात्तर्पणमेव हि .
नराणां च महाबाहो नित्यं स्नात्वा प्रयत्नतः . . 144
text_mt: He should indeed perform the water offering to the gods, the sages, and the ancestors, / and to mortals, O mighty-armed one, having bathed daily with exertion.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpaṃ toyaṃ phalaṃ cāpi samidādhānameva 3 ca .
nānāvidhāni kāṣṭhāni mṛttikāṃ ca tathā kuśān . . 145
meaning:
पुष्पं तोयं फलं चापि समिदाधानमेव 3 च .
नानाविधानि काष्ठानि मृत्तिकां च तथा कुशान् . . 145
text_mt: [He should bring] flowers, water, fruits, and make the laying of kindling sticks, / [gathering] various kinds of firewood, clay, and kuśa grass.

sanskrit_iast:
varjayenmadhu māṃsaṃ ca gandhamālyarathānstriyaḥ .
śuklāni caiva sarvāṇi prāṇināṃ 1 caiva hiṃsanam . . 146
meaning:
वर्जयेन्मधु मांसं च गन्धमाल्यरथान्स्त्रियः .
शुक्लानि चैव सर्वाणि प्राणिनां 1 चैव हिंसनम् . . 146
text_mt: He should avoid honey, meat, perfume, garlands, chariots, women, / all fermented substances, and violence toward living beings,

sanskrit_iast:
abhyaṅgamañjanaṃ cākṣṇorupānacchatradhāraṇam .
saṃkalpaṃ kāmajaṃ krodhaṃ lobhaṃ gītaṃ ca vādanam . . 147
meaning:
अभ्यङ्गमञ्जनं चाक्ष्णोरुपानच्छत्रधारणम् .
संकल्पं कामजं क्रोधं लोभं गीतं च वादनम् . . 147
text_mt: body unguent, eye collyrium, wearing shoes and carrying an umbrella, / lustful desire, anger, greed, singing, and instrumental music.

sanskrit_iast:
nartanaṃ ca tathā dyūtaṃ janavādaṃ tathānṛtam .
parivādaṃ cāpi vibho dūrataḥ parivarjayet . . 148
meaning:
नर्तनं च तथा द्यूतं जनवादं तथानृतम् .
परिवादं चापि विभो दूरतः परिवर्जयेत् . . 148
text_mt:
Dancing, gambling, gossip, falsehood,
and defamation, O mighty one, he must avoid from afar.

sanskrit_iast:
strīṇāṃ ca prekṣaṇālambo rapavītaṃ2 parasya ca .
puṃścalībhistathā saṅgaṃ na kuryātkurunandana . . 149
meaning:
स्त्रीणां च प्रेक्षणालम्बो रपवीतं2 परस्य च .
पुंश्चलीभिस्तथा सङ्गं न कुर्यात्कुरुनन्दन . . 149
text_mt:
Looking at women and embracing them, and [wearing] another's sacred thread,
and associating with unchaste women he must not do, O descendant of Kuru.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaḥ śayīta sarvatra na retaḥ skandayetkvacit .
kāmāddhi skandayanreto hinasti vratameva tu . . 1.4.150
meaning:
एकः शयीत सर्वत्र न रेतः स्कन्दयेत्क्वचित् .
कामाद्धि स्कन्दयन्रेतो हिनस्ति व्रतमेव तु . . 1.4.150
text_mt:
He should sleep alone everywhere, and never emit semen;
for by emitting semen out of lust, he destroys his very vow.

sanskrit_iast:
suptaḥ kṣaranbrahmacārī dvijaḥ śukramakāmataḥ .
snātvārkamarcayitvā tu punarmāmityṛcaṃ japet . . 151
meaning:
सुप्तः क्षरन्ब्रह्मचारी द्विजः शुक्रमकामतः .
स्नात्वार्कमर्चयित्वा तु पुनर्मामित्यृचं जपेत् . . 151
text_mt:
A twice-born brahmacārin who discharges semen while asleep without desire,
having bathed and worshipped the sun, should murmur the verse, "May [the seed] return to me."

sanskrit_iast:
manorapi tathā cātra śrūyate paramaṃ vacaḥ .
udakumbhaṃ sumanaso gośakṛnmṛttikāṃ kuśān . .
āharedyāvadarthānhi bhaikṣaṃ cāpi hi nityaśaḥ . . 152
meaning:
मनोरपि तथा चात्र श्रूयते परमं वचः .
उदकुम्भं सुमनसो गोशकृन्मृत्तिकां कुशान् . .
आहरेद्यावदर्थान्हि भैक्षं चापि हि नित्यशः . . 152
text_mt:
Moreover, on this matter the supreme word of Manu is heard:
a water-pot, flowers, cow dung, earth, and kuśa grass
he should bring as needed, and also alms perpetually.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛheṣu yeṣāṃ kartavyaṃ tāñchṛṇuṣva nṛpottama .
svakarmasu ratā ye vai tathā vedeṣu ye ratāḥ . .
yajñeṣu cāpi rājendra ye ca śraddhāsamāśritāḥ . . 153
meaning:
गृहेषु येषां कर्तव्यं ताञ्छृणुष्व नृपोत्तम .
स्वकर्मसु रता ये वै तथा वेदेषु ये रताः . .
यज्ञेषु चापि राजेन्द्र ये च श्रद्धासमाश्रिताः . . 153
text_mt:
Hear, O best of kings, in whose houses this is to be done:
those who are devoted to their duties, those who are devoted to the Vedas,
and to sacrifices, O ruler of kings, and those who are full of faith.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacāryā haredbhaikṣaṃ gṛhebhyaḥ prayato'nvaham .
guroḥ kule na bhikṣet svajñātikulabandhuṣu . . 154
meaning:
ब्रह्मचार्या हरेद्भैक्षं गृहेभ्यः प्रयतोऽन्वहम् .
गुरोः कुले न भिक्षेत् स्वज्ञातिकुलबन्धुषु . . 154
text_mt:
A brahmacārin, disciplined, should fetch alms daily from [their] houses;
he must not beg in the family of his teacher, nor among his own kinsmen, family, or relatives.

sanskrit_iast:
alābhe tvanyagotrāṇāṃ pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ vivarjayet .
sarvaṃ cāpi caredgrāmaṃ pūrvoktānāmasambhave . .
antyavarjaṃ mahābāho ityāha bhagavānvibhuḥ . . 155
meaning:
अलाभे त्वन्यगोत्राणां पूर्वं पूर्वं विवर्जयेत् .
सर्वं चापि चरेद्ग्रामं पूर्वोक्तानामसम्भवे . .
अन्त्यवर्जं महाबाहो इत्याह भगवान्विभुः . . 155

sanskrit_iast:
vācaṃ niyamya prayatastvagniṃ śastraṃ ca varjayet .
cāturvarṇyaṃ caredbhaikṣamalābhe kurunandana . . 156
meaning:
वाचं नियम्य प्रयतस्त्वग्निं शस्त्रं च वर्जयेत् .
चातुर्वर्ण्यं चरेद्भैक्षमलाभे कुरुनन्दन . . 156
text_mt:
Restraining his speech, disciplined, he should avoid fire and weapons;
if [the aforesaid are] not available, O descendant of Kuru, he may beg alms from the four varnas.

sanskrit_iast:
ārādāhṛtya samidhaḥ. sannidadhyād gṛhopari .
sāyaṃprātastu juhuyāttābhiragnimatandritaḥ . . 157
meaning:
आरादाहृत्य समिधः. सन्निदध्याद् गृहोपरि .
सायंप्रातस्तु जुहुयात्ताभिरग्निमतन्द्रितः . . 157
text_mt:
Having fetched firewood from near at hand, he should deposit it above the dwelling;
evening and morning, alert, he should offer oblation with them into the fire.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaikṣācaraṇamakṛtvā na tamagniṃ samidhya vai .
anāturaḥ saptarātramavakīrṇivrataṃ caret . . 158
meaning:
भैक्षाचरणमकृत्वा न तमग्निं समिध्य वै .
अनातुरः सप्तरात्रमवकीर्णिव्रतं चरेत् . . 158
text_mt:
If without being sick he fails to beg alms and kindle that fire
for seven nights, he must observe the vow of the avakīrṇin.

sanskrit_iast:
vartanaṃ cāsya bhaikṣeṇa pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ .
tasmādbhaikṣeṇa vai nityaṃ naikānnādī bhavedyatī . . 159
meaning:
वर्तनं चास्य भैक्षेण प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः .
तस्माद्भैक्षेण वै नित्यं नैकान्नादी भवेद्यती . . 159
text_mt:
Wise men declare his livelihood to be by alms;
therefore, a renouncer should always live on alms and never eat from a single house.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaikṣeṇa vratino vṛttirupavāsasamā smṛtā .
daivatye vratavadrājanpitrye karmaṇyatharṣivat . .
kāmamabhyarthito'śnīyādvratamasya na lupyate . . 1.4.160
meaning:
भैक्षेण व्रतिनो वृत्तिरुपवाससमा स्मृता .
दैवत्ये व्रतवद्राजन्पित्र्ये कर्मण्यथर्षिवत् . .
काममभ्यर्थितोऽश्नीयाद्व्रतमस्य न लुप्यते . . 1.4.160

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇasya mahābāho karma yatsamudāhṛtam .
rājanyavaiśyayornaitatpaṇḍitaiḥ kurunandana . . 161
meaning:
ब्राह्मणस्य महाबाहो कर्म यत्समुदाहृतम् .
राजन्यवैश्ययोर्नैतत्पण्डितैः कुरुनन्दन . . 161
text_mt:
This duty that has been declared for a brāhmaṇa, O mighty-armed one,
is not declared by the learned for a kṣatriya or a vaiśya, O descendant of Kuru.

sanskrit_iast:
codito'codito 1 vāpi guruṇā nityameva hi .
kuryādadhyayane yogamācāryasya hiteṣu ca . . 162
meaning:
चोदितोऽचोदितो 1 वापि गुरुणा नित्यमेव हि .
कुर्यादध्ययने योगमाचार्यस्य हितेषु च . . 162
text_mt:
Prompted or unprompted by the teacher, always indeed
he should make effort in study and in matters beneficial to his preceptor.

sanskrit_iast:
buddhīndriyāṇi manasā śarīraṃ vācameva hi .
niyamya prāñjalistiṣṭhedvīkṣamāṇo gurormukham . . 163
meaning:
बुद्धीन्द्रियाणि मनसा शरीरं वाचमेव हि .
नियम्य प्राञ्जलिस्तिष्ठेद्वीक्षमाणो गुरोर्मुखम् . . 163
text_mt:
Restraining his organs of cognition with his mind, and his body and speech as well,
he should stand with hands folded in reverence, looking at the teacher's face.

sanskrit_iast:
nityamuddhṛtapāṇiḥ syātsādhvācārastu saṃyataḥ .
āsyatāmiti coktaḥ sannāsītābhimukhaṃ guroḥ . . 164
meaning:
नित्यमुद्धृतपाणिः स्यात्साध्वाचारस्तु संयतः .
आस्यतामिति चोक्तः सन्नासीताभिमुखं गुरोः . . 164
text_mt:
He should always keep his hands raised, conduct himself well, and be self-controlled;
and when told, "Be seated," he should sit facing the teacher.

sanskrit_iast:
vastraveṣaistathānnaistu hīnaḥ syādgurusannidhau .
uttiṣṭhetprathamaṃ cāsya jaghanyaṃ cāpi saṃviśet . . 165
meaning:
वस्त्रवेषैस्तथान्नैस्तु हीनः स्याद्गुरुसन्निधौ .
उत्तिष्ठेत्प्रथमं चास्य जघन्यं चापि संविशेत् . . 165
text_mt:
In clothes, attire, and food, he should be simpler in the teacher's presence;
he should rise before him, and lie down to sleep after him.

sanskrit_iast:
pratiśravaṇasambhāṣe talpastho na samācaret .
na cāsīno na bhuñjāno na tiṣṭhanna parāṅmukhaḥ . . 166
meaning:
प्रतिश्रवणसम्भाषे तल्पस्थो न समाचरेत् .
न चासीनो न भुञ्जानो न तिष्ठन्न पराङ्मुखः . . 166
text_mt:
He should not answer or converse while lying on a couch,
nor while seated, nor while eating, nor while standing, nor facing away.

sanskrit_iast:
āsīnasya sthitaḥ kuryādabhigacchaṃśca tiṣṭhataḥ .
pratyudgantā tu vrajataḥ paścāddhāvaṃśca dhāvataḥ . . 167
meaning:
आसीनस्य स्थितः कुर्यादभिगच्छंश्च तिष्ठतः .
प्रत्युद्गन्ता तु व्रजतः पश्चाद्धावंश्च धावतः . . 167
text_mt:
[He should answer] standing when [the teacher] is seated; approaching when he is standing;
going to meet him when he walks; and running behind him when he runs;

sanskrit_iast:
parāṅmukhasyābhimukho dūrasthasyaitya cāntikam .
namaskṛtya śayānasya nideśe tiṣṭhetsarvadā . . 168
meaning:
पराङ्मुखस्याभिमुखो दूरस्थस्यैत्य चान्तिकम् .
नमस्कृत्य शयानस्य निदेशे तिष्ठेत्सर्वदा . . 168
text_mt:
facing him when he is turned away; coming near when he is at a distance;
having bowed when he is lying down; he should always remain at his command.

sanskrit_iast:
nīcaṃ śayyāsanaṃ cāsya sarvadā gurusannidhau .
gurośca cakṣurviṣaye na yatheṣṭāsano bhavet . . 169
meaning:
नीचं शय्यासनं चास्य सर्वदा गुरुसन्निधौ .
गुरोश्च चक्षुर्विषये न यथेष्टासनो भवेत् . . 169
text_mt:
His bed and seat should always be lower in the teacher's presence;
and within the sight of the teacher, he should not sit as he pleases.

sanskrit_iast:
nāmoccāraṇamevāsya parokṣamapi suvrata .
na cainamanukurvīta gatibhāṣaṇaceṣṭitaiḥ . . 1.4.170
meaning:
नामोच्चारणमेवास्य परोक्षमपि सुव्रत .
न चैनमनुकुर्वीत गतिभाषणचेष्टितैः . . 1.4.170
text_mt:
[He should avoid] even uttering his name behind his back, O man of good vows,
nor should he mimic him with his gait, speech, or gestures.

sanskrit_iast:
parīvādastathā nindā guroryatra pravartate .
karṇau tatra pidhātavyo gantavyaṃ vā tato'nyataḥ . . 171
meaning:
परीवादस्तथा निन्दा गुरोर्यत्र प्रवर्तते .
कर्णौ तत्र पिधातव्यो गन्तव्यं वा ततोऽन्यतः . . 171
text_mt:
Where censure or slander of the teacher takes place,
both ears must be closed there, or one must go elsewhere from that spot.

sanskrit_iast:
parīvādādrāsabhaḥ syātsārameyastu nindakaḥ .
paribhoktā kṛmirbhavati kīṭo bhavati matsarī . . 172
meaning:
परीवादाद्रासभः स्यात्सारमेयस्तु निन्दकः .
परिभोक्ता कृमिर्भवति कीटो भवति मत्सरी . . 172
text_mt:
From censure one becomes a donkey; a slanderer becomes a dog;
he who consumes [the teacher's wealth] becomes a worm; an envious person becomes an insect.

sanskrit_iast:
dūrastho nārcayedenaṃ na kruddho nāntike striyāḥ .
yānāsanagato rājannavaruhyābhivādayet . . 173
meaning:
दूरस्थो नार्चयेदेनं न क्रुद्धो नान्तिके स्त्रियाः .
यानासनगतो राजन्नवरुह्याभिवादयेत् . . 173
text_mt:
He should not revere him while standing at a distance, nor while angry, nor near a woman;
if mounted on a vehicle or a seat, O king, he should dismount and salute him.

sanskrit_iast:
pratikūle samāne tu nāsīta guruṇā saha .
aśṛṇvaṃti gurau rājanna kiñcidapi kīrtayet . . 174
meaning:
प्रतिकूले समाने तु नासीत गुरुणा सह .
अशृण्वंति गुरौ राजन्न किञ्चिदपि कीर्तयेत् . . 174
text_mt:
When the wind is contrary or level, he should not sit with the teacher;
while the teacher does not hear, O king, he should mention nothing at all.

sanskrit_iast:
gośvoṣṭrayānaprāsādaprastareṣu kaṭeṣu ca .
āsīta guruṇā sārdhaṃ śilāphalaka nauṣu ca .. 175
meaning:
गोश्वोष्ट्रयानप्रासादप्रस्तरेषु कटेषु च .
आसीत गुरुणा सार्धं शिलाफलक नौषु च .. 175
text_mt:
In carts drawn by cattle, horses, or camels, in palaces, on rock slabs, and on mats,
he may sit together with the teacher, and also on stone slabs, planks, and boats.

sanskrit_iast:
gurorgurau sannihite guruvadvṛttimācaret .
guruputreṣu cāryeṣu guroścaiva svabandhuṣu .. 176
meaning:
गुरोर्गुरौ सन्निहिते गुरुवद्वृत्तिमाचरेत् .
गुरुपुत्रेषु चार्येषु गुरोश्चैव स्वबन्धुषु .. 176
text_mt:
When the teacher's teacher is present, he should behave as toward his teacher;
likewise toward the teacher's sons, venerable elders, and the teacher's own kinsmen.

sanskrit_iast:
bālaḥ samānajanmā vā viśiṣṭo yajñakarmaṇi .
adhyāpayangurusuto guruvanmānamarhati .. 177
meaning:
बालः समानजन्मा वा विशिष्टो यज्ञकर्मणि .
अध्यापयन्गुरुसुतो गुरुवन्मानमर्हति .. 177
text_mt:
A child, or one of the same age, or one distinguished in sacrificial rites—
if he is teaching, the teacher's son deserves honour just like the teacher.

sanskrit_iast:
utsādanamathāṅgānāṃ snāpanocchiṣṭabhojane .
pādayornejana rājanguruputreṣu varjayet .. 178
meaning:
उत्सादनमथाङ्गानां स्नापनोच्छिष्टभोजने .
पादयोर्नेजन राजन्गुरुपुत्रेषु वर्जयेत् .. 178
text_mt:
Rubbing of the limbs, bathing, eating his leftovers,
and washing his feet, O king, he must avoid in the case of the teacher's sons.

sanskrit_iast:
guruvatpratipūjyāstu savarṇā guruyoṣitaḥ .
asavarṇāstu sampūjyāḥ pratyutthānābhivādanaiḥ .. 179
meaning:
गुरुवत्प्रतिपूज्यास्तु सवर्णा गुरुयोषितः .
असवर्णास्तु सम्पूज्याः प्रत्युत्थानाभिवादनैः .. 179
text_mt:
The wives of the teacher of the same class are to be honoured like the teacher;
but those of a different class are to be honoured by rising up and saluting.

sanskrit_iast:
abhyañjanaṃ sa snapanaṃ gātrotsādanameva ca .
gurupatnyā na kāryāṇi keśānāṃ ca prasādhanam .. 1.4.180
meaning:
अभ्यञ्जनं स स्नपनं गात्रोत्सादनमेव च .
गुरुपत्न्या न कार्याणि केशानां च प्रसाधनम् .. 1.4.180
text_mt:
Anointing, bathing, massaging of the limbs,
and arranging the hair are not to be done for the teacher's wife.

sanskrit_iast:
gurupatnīṃ tu yuvatīṃ nābhivādeta pādayoḥ .
pūrṇaviṃśativarṣeṇa guṇadoṣau vijānatā .. 181
meaning:
गुरुपत्नीं तु युवतीं नाभिवादेत पादयोः .
पूर्णविंशतिवर्षेण गुणदोषौ विजानता .. 181
text_mt:
A young wife of the teacher should not be saluted by the feet
by one who has reached twenty years of age and knows virtues and faults.

sanskrit_iast:
svabhāva eva nārīṇāṃ narāṇāmiha dūṣaṇam .
atorthānna pramādyanti pratipādya vipaścitaḥ .. 182
meaning:
स्वभाव एव नारीणां नराणामिह दूषणम् .
अतोर्थान्न प्रमाद्यन्ति प्रतिपाद्य विपश्चितः .. 182
text_mt:
It is the very nature of women to corrupt men in this world;
for this reason, the wise do not become careless [in their company].

sanskrit_iast:
avidvāṃsamalaṃ loke vidvāṃsamapi vā punaḥ .
pramadā hyutpathaṃ netuṃ kāmakrodhavaśānugam .. 183
meaning:
अविद्वांसमलं लोके विद्वांसमपि वा पुनः .
प्रमदा ह्युत्पथं नेतुं कामक्रोधवशानुगम् .. 183
text_mt:
A woman is capable of leading astray in this world the ignorant
or even the learned man who comes under the sway of lust and anger.

sanskrit_iast:
mātrā svasrā duhitrā vā na viviktāsano bhavet .
balavānindriyagrāmo vidvāṃsamapi karṣati .. 184
meaning:
मात्रा स्वस्रा दुहित्रा वा न विविक्तासनो भवेत् .
बलवानिन्द्रियग्रामो विद्वांसमपि कर्षति .. 184
text_mt:
One should not sit in a secluded place with one's mother, sister, or daughter;
the powerful host of the senses drags along even a learned man.

sanskrit_iast:
rājendra gurupatnīnāṃ yuvatīnāṃ yuvā bhuvi .
vidhivadvandanaṃ kuryādasāvahamiti bruvan .. 185
meaning:
राजेन्द्र गुरुपत्नीनां युवतीनां युवा भुवि .
विधिवद्वन्दनं कुर्यादसावहमिति ब्रुवन् .. 185
text_mt:
O ruler of kings, a young man on the earth should salute young wives of the teacher
in accordance with the rule, declaring, "I am so-and-so."

sanskrit_iast:
vipro'sya pādagrahaṇamanvahaṃ cābhivādanam .
gurudāreṣu kurvīta satāṃ dharmamanusmaran .. 186
meaning:
विप्रोऽस्य पादग्रहणमन्वहं चाभिवादनम् .
गुरुदारेषु कुर्वीत सतां धर्ममनुस्मरन् .. 186
text_mt:
A brāhmaṇa should clasp their feet and make daily salutation
toward the teacher's wives, remembering the duty of the righteous.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā khanankhanitreṇa jalamāpnoti mānavaḥ .
tathā gurugatāṃ vidyāṃ śuśrūṣuradhigacchati .. 187
meaning:
यथा खनन्खनित्रेण जलमाप्नोति मानवः .
तथा गुरुगतां विद्यां शुश्रूषुरधिगच्छति .. 187
text_mt:
Just as a man digging with a spade reaches water,
even so a diligent student acquires the knowledge residing in the teacher.

sanskrit_iast:
muṇḍo vā jaṭilo vā syādatha vā syācchikhī jaṭī .
nainaṃ grāme'bhinimlocedarko nābhyudiyātkvacit .. 188
meaning:
मुण्डो वा जटिलो वा स्यादथ वा स्याच्छिखी जटी .
नैनं ग्रामेऽभिनिम्लोचेदर्को नाभ्युदियात्क्वचित् .. 188
text_mt:
Whether shaven-headed, wearing matted locks, or having a crest with matted locks,
never in the village should the sun set or rise upon him [while asleep].

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ cedabhyudiyātsūryaḥ śayānaṃ kāmakārataḥ .
nimlocedvāpyabhijñānājjapannupavaseddinam .. 189
meaning:
तं चेदभ्युदियात्सूर्यः शयानं कामकारतः .
निम्लोचेद्वाप्यभिज्ञानाज्जपन्नुपवसेद्दिनम् .. 189
text_mt:
If the sun rises upon him lying down voluntarily,
or sets [upon him], knowing this, he should fast for a day while murmuring [prayers].

sanskrit_iast:
sūryeṇa hyabhinirmuktaḥ śayānobhyuditaśca yaḥ .
prāyaścittamakurvāṇo yuktaḥ syānmahatainasā .. 1.4.190
meaning:
सूर्येण ह्यभिनिर्मुक्तः शयानोभ्युदितश्च यः .
प्रायश्चित्तमकुर्वाणो युक्तः स्यान्महतैनसा .. 1.4.190
text_mt:
For he upon whom the sun sets or rises while he is lying down,
without performing expiation, would be associated with great sin.

sanskrit_iast:
upaspṛśya mahārāja ubhe sandhye samāhitaḥ .
śucau deśe japañjapyamupāsīta yathāvidhi .. 191
meaning:
उपस्पृश्य महाराज उभे सन्ध्ये समाहितः .
शुचौ देशे जपञ्जप्यमुपासीत यथाविधि .. 191
text_mt:
Having sipped water, O great king, collected in mind at both twilights,
in a clean spot, murmuring what is to be murmured, he should attend [to the twilights] according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi strī yadyavarajaḥ śreyaḥ kiñcitsamācaret .
tatsarvamācaredyukto yatra vā ramate manaḥ .. 192
meaning:
यदि स्त्री यद्यवरजः श्रेयः किञ्चित्समाचरेत् .
तत्सर्वमाचरेद्युक्तो यत्र वा रमते मनः .. 192
text_mt: Whether a woman or a younger brother should perform any good action, / one should, being disciplined, perform all of it, or whatever pleases one’s mind.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmārthāvucyate śreyaḥ kāmārthau dharmameva ca .
artha eveha vā śreyastrivarga iti saṃsthitiḥ .. 193
meaning:
धर्मार्थावुच्यते श्रेयः कामार्थौ धर्ममेव च .
अर्थ एवेह वा श्रेयस्त्रिवर्ग इति संस्थितिः .. 193
text_mt: Some say the highest good is dharma and wealth, others pleasure and wealth, and others dharma alone; / or wealth alone is the highest good here: the settled conclusion is that it consists of the triad.

sanskrit_iast:
pitā mātā tathā bhrātā ācāryāḥ kurunandana .
nārtenāpyavamantavyā brāhmaṇena viśeṣataḥ .. 194
meaning:
पिता माता तथा भ्राता आचार्याः कुरुनन्दन .
नार्तेनाप्यवमन्तव्या ब्राह्मणेन विशेषतः .. 194
text_mt: Father, mother, brother, and preceptor, O scion of the Kurus, / must not be despised even by one afflicted, especially by a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ācāryo brahmaṇo mūrtiḥ pitā mūrtiḥ prajāpateḥ .
mātāpyathāditermūrtirbhrātā syānmūrtirātmanaḥ .. 195
meaning:
आचार्यो ब्रह्मणो मूर्तिः पिता मूर्तिः प्रजापतेः .
माताप्यथादितेर्मूर्तिर्भ्राता स्यान्मूर्तिरात्मनः .. 195
text_mt: The preceptor is the embodiment of Brahmā; the father is the embodiment of Prajāpati; / the mother is the embodiment of Aditi; and the brother is the embodiment of oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
yanmātā pitarau kleśaṃ sahete sambhave nṛṇām .
na tasya niṣkṛtiḥ śakyā kartuṃ varṣaśatairapi . . 196
meaning:
यन्माता पितरौ क्लेशं सहेते सम्भवे नृणाम् .
न तस्य निष्कृतिः शक्या कर्तुं वर्षशतैरपि . . 196
text_mt: The hardship that mother and father endure at the birth of human beings— / its recompense cannot be made even in hundreds of years.

sanskrit_iast:
tayornityaṃ priyaṃ kuryādācāryasya ca bhārata .
teṣu hi triṣu tuṣṭeṣu tapaḥ sarvaṃ samāpyate . . 197
meaning:
तयोर्नित्यं प्रियं कुर्यादाचार्यस्य च भारत .
तेषु हि त्रिषु तुष्टेषु तपः सर्वं समाप्यते . . 197
text_mt: One should always do what is pleasing to both of them and to the preceptor, O Bhārata; / for when these three are satisfied, all austerity is accomplished.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ śuśrūṣā paramaṃ tapa ucyate .
na tairanabhyanujñāto dharmamanyaṃ samācaret . . 198
meaning:
तेषां त्रयाणां शुश्रूषा परमं तप उच्यते .
न तैरनभ्यनुज्ञातो धर्ममन्यं समाचरेत् . . 198
text_mt: Service to these three is called the highest austerity; / without being permitted by them, one should not practice any other duty.

sanskrit_iast:
ta eva hi trayo lokāsta eva traya āśramāḥ 1 .
ta eva ca trayo vedāsta evoktāstrayo'gnayaḥ . . 199
meaning:
त एव हि त्रयो लोकास्त एव त्रय आश्रमाः 1 .
त एव च त्रयो वेदास्त एवोक्तास्त्रयोऽग्नयः . . 199
text_mt: For they indeed are the three worlds; they indeed are the three stages of life; / they indeed are the three Vedas; and they indeed are called the three sacred fires.

sanskrit_iast:
mātā vai gārhapatyāgniḥ pitā vai dakṣiṇaḥ smṛtaḥ .
gururāhavanīyaśca sāgnitretā garīyasī . . 1.4.200
meaning:
माता वै गार्हपत्याग्निः पिता वै दक्षिणः स्मृतः .
गुरुराहवनीयश्च साग्नित्रेता गरीयसी . . 1.4.200
text_mt: The mother is traditionally regarded as the Gārhapatya fire, the father as the Dakṣiṇa fire, / and the guru as the Āhavanīya fire; this triad of fires is the most venerable.

sanskrit_iast:
triṣu tuṣṭeṣu caiteṣu trīṃllokāñjayate gṛhī .
dīpyamānaḥ svavapuṣā devavaddivi modate . . 201
meaning:
त्रिषु तुष्टेषु चैतेषु त्रींल्लोकाञ्जयते गृही .
दीप्यमानः स्ववपुषा देववद्दिवि मोदते . . 201
text_mt: When these three are pleased, the householder conquers the three worlds; / shining with his own body, he rejoices in heaven like a god.

sanskrit_iast:
imaṃ lokaṃ pitṛbhaktyā mātṛbhaktyā tu madhyamam .
guruśuśrūṣayā caiva gacchecchakrasalokatām . . 202
meaning:
इमं लोकं पितृभक्त्या मातृभक्त्या तु मध्यमम् .
गुरुशुश्रूषया चैव गच्छेच्छक्रसलोकताम् . . 202
text_mt: Through devotion to his father he gains this world, through devotion to his mother the intermediate [world], / and through service to his guru he reaches the world of Śakra.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve tenādṛtā dharmā yasyaite traya ādṛtāḥ .
anādṛtāstu yenaite sarvāstasyāphalāḥ ..203
meaning:
सर्वे तेनादृता धर्मा यस्यैते त्रय आदृताः .
अनादृतास्तु येनैते सर्वास्तस्याफलाः ..203
text_mt: All duties are honoured by him by whom these three are honoured; / but for him by whom these are disregarded, all [duties] are fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvattrayaste jīveyustāvannānyatsamācaret.
teṣveva nityaṃ śuśrūṣāṃ kuryātpriyahite rataḥ . . 204
meaning:
यावत्त्रयस्ते जीवेयुस्तावन्नान्यत्समाचरेत्.
तेष्वेव नित्यं शुश्रूषां कुर्यात्प्रियहिते रतः . . 204
text_mt: As long as those three live, so long he should not perform any other [duty]; / devoted to their pleasure and welfare, he should continually serve them alone.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāmanuparodhena pārthakyaṃ 2 yadyadācaret .
tattannivedayettebhyo manovacanakarmabhiḥ . . 205
meaning:
तेषामनुपरोधेन पार्थक्यं 2 यद्यदाचरेत् .
तत्तन्निवेदयेत्तेभ्यो मनोवचनकर्मभिः . . 205
text_mt: Whatever he performs separately without obstruction to them, / he should announce all that to them in mind, speech, and action.

sanskrit_iast:
triṣveteṣviti kṛtyaṃ hi puruṣasya samāpyate .
eṣa dharmaḥ paraḥ sākṣādupadharmo'nya ucyate . . 206
meaning:
त्रिष्वेतेष्विति कृत्यं हि पुरुषस्य समाप्यते .
एष धर्मः परः साक्षादुपधर्मोऽन्य उच्यते . . 206
text_mt: For in these three the duty of a man is fully accomplished; / this is the supreme dharma visible directly; anything else is called a minor duty.

sanskrit_iast:
śraddhadhānaḥ śubhāṃ vidyāmādadītāvarādapi .
antyādapi paraṃ dharmaṃ strīratnaṃ duṣkulādapi . . 207
meaning:
श्रद्धधानः शुभां विद्यामाददीतावरादपि .
अन्त्यादपि परं धर्मं स्त्रीरत्नं दुष्कुलादपि . . 207
text_mt: Endowed with faith, one should acquire auspicious knowledge even from a low-born person, / the supreme dharma even from an outcaste, and a gem of a woman even from an ignoble family.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣādapyamṛtaṃ grāhyaṃ bālādapi subhāṣitam .
amitrādapi sadvṛttamamedhyādapi kāñcanam . . 208
meaning:
विषादप्यमृतं ग्राह्यं बालादपि सुभाषितम् .
अमित्रादपि सद्वृत्तममेध्यादपि काञ्चनम् . . 208
text_mt: Nectar should be taken even from poison, wise counsel even from a child, / good conduct even from an enemy, and gold even from filth.

sanskrit_iast:
striyo ratnaṃ nayo vidyā dharmaḥ śaucaṃ subhāṣitam .
vividhāni ca śilpāni samādeyāni sarvaśaḥ . . 209
meaning:
स्त्रियो रत्नं नयो विद्या धर्मः शौचं सुभाषितम् .
विविधानि च शिल्पानि समादेयानि सर्वशः . . 209
text_mt: Women, jewels, policy, learning, dharma, purity, wise counsel, / and various crafts are to be gathered from everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
abrāhmaṇādadhyayanamāpatkāle vidhīyate .
anuvrajyā ca śuśrūṣā yāvadadhyayanaṃ guroḥ . . 1.4.210
meaning:
अब्राह्मणादध्ययनमापत्काले विधीयते .
अनुव्रज्या च शुश्रूषा यावदध्ययनं गुरोः . . 1.4.210
text_mt: Study from a non-brāhmaṇa is prescribed in times of distress, / along with following behind and serving the teacher as long as the study lasts.

sanskrit_iast:
nābrāhmaṇe gurau śiṣyo vāsamātyantikaṃ vaset .
brāhmaṇe cānanūcāne kāñkṣangatimanuttamām . . 211
meaning:
नाब्राह्मणे गुरौ शिष्यो वासमात्यन्तिकं वसेत् .
ब्राह्मणे चाननूचाने काञ्क्षन्गतिमनुत्तमाम् . . 211
text_mt: A pupil desiring the highest destiny should not reside permanently / with a non-brāhmaṇa teacher, nor with a brāhmaṇa who is not learned in the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi tvātyantiko vāso rocate ca guroḥ kule .
yuktaḥ paricaredenamāśarīravimokṣaṇāt . . 212
meaning:
यदि त्वात्यन्तिको वासो रोचते च गुरोः कुले .
युक्तः परिचरेदेनमाशरीरविमोक्षणात् . . 212
text_mt: If, however, permanent residence in the preceptor’s family pleases him, / he should diligently attend on him until the release of his body.

sanskrit_iast:
ā samāpteḥ śarīrasya yastu śuśrūṣate gurum .
sa gacchatyañjasā vipro brāhmaṇaḥ sadya śāśvatam . . 213
meaning:
आ समाप्तेः शरीरस्य यस्तु शुश्रूषते गुरुम् .
स गच्छत्यञ्जसा विप्रो ब्राह्मणः सद्य शाश्वतम् . . 213
text_mt: A brāhmaṇa who serves his preceptor until the end of his body / goes directly to the eternal abode of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
na pūrvaṃ gurave kiñcidupakurvīta dharmavit .
snānāya guruṇājñastaḥ śaktyā gurvarthamāharet . . 214
meaning:
न पूर्वं गुरवे किञ्चिदुपकुर्वीत धर्मवित् .
स्नानाय गुरुणाज्ञस्तः शक्त्या गुर्वर्थमाहरेत् . . 214
text_mt: He who knows dharma should not offer anything to the preceptor beforehand; / instructed by the preceptor for his [concluding] bath, he should bring what is for the preceptor according to his ability.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetraṃ hiraṇyaṃ gāmaśvaṃ chatropānahameva ca .
dhānyaṃ vāsāṃsi śākaṃ vā gurave prītamāharet . . 215
meaning:
क्षेत्रं हिरण्यं गामश्वं छत्रोपानहमेव च .
धान्यं वासांसि शाकं वा गुरवे प्रीतमाहरेत् . . 215
text_mt: A field, gold, a cow, a horse, an umbrella, shoes, / grain, garments, or vegetables—he should bring what is pleasing to the preceptor.

sanskrit_iast:
svargate gāṃ parityajya gurau bharatasattama .
guṇānvite gurusute gurudāre'tha vā nṛpa . .
sapiṇḍe vā guroścāpi guruvadvṛttimācaret . . 216
meaning:
स्वर्गते गां परित्यज्य गुरौ भरतसत्तम .
गुणान्विते गुरुसुते गुरुदारेऽथ वा नृप . .
सपिण्डे वा गुरोश्चापि गुरुवद्वृत्तिमाचरेत् . . 216
text_mt: When the preceptor has gone to heaven, having abandoned the earth, O best of the Bharatas, / one should behave as towards the preceptor towards the preceptor's son endowed with virtues, or towards the preceptor's wife, O king, / or towards a sapiṇḍa of the preceptor.

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣvavidyamāneṣu sthānāsanavihāravān .
prayuñjāno'gniśuśrūṣāṃ sādhayeddehamātsanaḥ . .
vīrasya kurvañchuśrūṣāṃ yāti vīrasalokatām . . 217
meaning:
एतेष्वविद्यमानेषु स्थानासनविहारवान् .
प्रयुञ्जानोऽग्निशुश्रूषां साधयेद्देहमात्सनः . .
वीरस्य कुर्वञ्छुश्रूषां याति वीरसलोकताम् . . 217
text_mt: In the absence of these, being mindful of standing, sitting, and moving about, / employing himself in the service of the sacred fire, he should discipline his body; / doing service to the heroic [fire], he goes to the world of the hero.

sanskrit_iast:
caratyevaṃ hi yo vipro brahmacaryamaviplutaḥ .
sa gatvā brahmasadanaṃ brahmaṇā saha modate . . 218
meaning:
चरत्येवं हि यो विप्रो ब्रह्मचर्यमविप्लुतः .
स गत्वा ब्रह्मसदनं ब्रह्मणा सह मोदते . . 218
text_mt: For a brāhmaṇa who thus practices unbroken celibacy / goes to the abode of Brahmā and rejoices with Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣa kathito dharmaḥ prathamaṃ brahmacāriṇaḥ .
gṛhasthasyāpi rājendra śṛṇu dharmamaśeṣataḥ . . 219
meaning:
इत्येष कथितो धर्मः प्रथमं ब्रह्मचारिणः .
गृहस्थस्यापि राजेन्द्र शृणु धर्ममशेषतः . . 219
text_mt: Thus has the duty of the student of the Veda first been declared; / listen now, O best of kings, to the duty of the householder in its entirety.

sanskrit_iast:
kāle prāpya vrataṃ vipra ṛtuyogena bhārata .
prapālayanvrataṃ yāti brahmasālokyatāṃ vibho . . 1.4.220
meaning:
काले प्राप्य व्रतं विप्र ऋतुयोगेन भारत .
प्रपालयन्व्रतं याति ब्रह्मसालोक्यतां विभो . . 1.4.220
text_mt: Having undertaken the vow at the proper time in conjunction with the season, O brāhmaṇa, O Bhārata, / [and] maintaining the vow, he attains co-residence with Brahmā, O lord.

sanskrit_iast:
sadopanayanaṃ śastaṃ vasante brāhmaṇasya tu .
kṣatriyasya tato grīṣme praśastaṃ manurabravīt . . 221
meaning:
सदोपनयनं शस्तं वसन्ते ब्राह्मणस्य तु .
क्षत्रियस्य ततो ग्रीष्मे प्रशस्तं मनुरब्रवीत् . . 221
text_mt: The upanayana of a brāhmaṇa is always commended in the spring; / Manu stated that for a kṣatriya it is commended thereafter in the summer.

sanskrit_iast:
prāpte śaradi vaiśyasya sadopanayanaṃ param .
ityeṣa trividhaḥ kālaḥ kathito vratayojane . . 222
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe śatārddhasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ brāhme parvaṇi
upanayanavidhivarṇanaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ . 4 .
strīṇāṃ śubhāśubhalakṣaṇavarṇanam
meaning:
प्राप्ते शरदि वैश्यस्य सदोपनयनं परम् .
इत्येष त्रिविधः कालः कथितो व्रतयोजने . . 222
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे शतार्द्धसाहस्र्यां संहितायां ब्राह्मे पर्वणि
उपनयनविधिवर्णनं नाम चतुर्थोऽध्यायः . 4 .
स्त्रीणां शुभाशुभलक्षणवर्णनम्
text_mt:
When autumn arrives, the upanayana of a vaiśya is always supreme; / thus is the threefold time declared for undertaking the vow.
Thus ends the fourth chapter, named 'Description of the Rules for the Upanayana,' in the Brāhmaparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of fifty thousand verses.
Description of the auspicious and inauspicious bodily marks of women

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
ṣaṭtriṃśadābdikaṃ caryaṃ gurau traivedikaṃ vratam .
tadardhikaṃ pādikaṃ vā grahaṇāntikameva ca . . 1
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
षट्त्रिंशदाब्दिकं चर्यं गुरौ त्रैवेदिकं व्रतम् .
तदर्धिकं पादिकं वा ग्रहणान्तिकमेव च . . 1
text_mt: Sumantu said: / The vow of the three Vedas is to be observed with the preceptor for thirty-six years, / or for half of that, or for a quarter of that, or until [the text] is mastered.
title: Strīlakṣaṇavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
vedānadhītya vedau vā vedaṃ vāpi nṛpottama .
aviplutabrahmacaryo gṛhasthāśramamāvaset . . 2
meaning:
वेदानधीत्य वेदौ वा वेदं वापि नृपोत्तम .
अविप्लुतब्रह्मचर्यो गृहस्थाश्रममावसेत् . . 2
text_mt: Having studied the Vedas, or two Vedas, or even one Veda, O best of kings, / with his celibacy unbroken, he should enter the householder stage of life.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ pratītaṃ svadharmeṇa brahmadāyaharaṃ pituḥ .
sragviṇaṃ talpa 1 āsīnamarhayetprathamaṃ gavā . . 3
meaning:
तं प्रतीतं स्वधर्मेण ब्रह्मदायहरं पितुः .
स्रग्विणं तल्प 1 आसीनमर्हयेत्प्रथमं गवा . . 3
text_mt: Renowned for his own dharma, taking the inheritance of the Veda from his father, / wearing a garland, seated on a couch, he should first be honoured with a cow.

sanskrit_iast:
guruṇā samanujñātaḥ samāvṛttau yathāvidhi .
udvaheta dvijo bhāryāṃ savarṇāṃ lakṣaṇānvitām . . 4
meaning:
गुरुणा समनुज्ञातः समावृत्तौ यथाविधि .
उद्वहेत द्विजो भार्यां सवर्णां लक्षणान्विताम् . . 4
text_mt: Permitted by his preceptor at his formal return home in accordance with the rule, / the twice-born should marry a wife of equal caste endowed with auspicious bodily marks.

sanskrit_iast:
śatānīka uvāca
lakṣaṇaṃ dvijaśārdūla strīṇāṃ vada mahāmune .
kīdṛglakṣaṇasaṃyuktā 1 kanyā syātsukhadā nṛpa . . 5
meaning:
शतानीक उवाच
लक्षणं द्विजशार्दूल स्त्रीणां वद महामुने .
कीदृग्लक्षणसंयुक्ता 1 कन्या स्यात्सुखदा नृप . . 5
text_mt: Śatānīka said: / Speak of the bodily marks of women, O tiger among the twice-born, O great sage; / endowed with what kind of bodily marks would a maiden bring happiness, O king?

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
yaduktaṃ brāhmaṇā pūrvaṃ strīlakṣaṇamanuttamam .
śreyase sarvalokānāṃ śubhāśubhaphalapradam . . 6
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
यदुक्तं ब्राह्मणा पूर्वं स्त्रीलक्षणमनुत्तमम् .
श्रेयसे सर्वलोकानां शुभाशुभफलप्रदम् . . 6
text_mt: Sumantu said: / That supreme [teaching on] bodily marks of women, which was spoken of old by Brahmā / for the welfare of all worlds, bestowing auspicious and inauspicious fruits—

sanskrit_iast:
tatte vacmi mahābāho śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa .
śrutena yena jānīṣe kanyāṃ śobhanalakṣaṇām . . 7
meaning:
तत्ते वच्मि महाबाहो शृणुष्वैकमना नृप .
श्रुतेन येन जानीषे कन्यां शोभनलक्षणाम् . . 7
text_mt: That I shall declare to you, O mighty-armed one; listen with single-minded attention, O king, / by hearing which you will recognise a maiden with auspicious bodily marks.

sanskrit_iast:
sukhāsīnaṃ suraśreṣṭhamabhigamya maharṣayaḥ .
papracchurlakṣaṇaṃ strīṇāṃ yatpṛṣṭo'haṃ tvayādhunā . . 8
meaning:
सुखासीनं सुरश्रेष्ठमभिगम्य महर्षयः .
पप्रच्छुर्लक्षणं स्त्रीणां यत्पृष्टोऽहं त्वयाधुना . . 8
text_mt: Approaching the foremost of the gods as he sat at ease, the great sages / questioned him about the bodily marks of women, which I have now been asked by you.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya śirasā devamidaṃ vacanamabruvan .
bhagavanbrūhi naḥ sarvaṃ strīṇāṃ lakṣaṇamuttamam . . 9
meaning:
प्रणम्य शिरसा देवमिदं वचनमब्रुवन् .
भगवन्ब्रूहि नः सर्वं स्त्रीणां लक्षणमुत्तमम् . . 9
text_mt: Bowing to the god with their heads, they spoke these words: / 'O Lord, tell us all the supreme bodily marks of women,

sanskrit_iast:
śreyase sarvalokānāṃ śubhāśubhaphalapradam .
praśastāmapraśāstāṃ ca jānīmo yena kanyakām . . 1.5.10
meaning:
श्रेयसे सर्वलोकानां शुभाशुभफलप्रदम् .
प्रशस्तामप्रशास्तां च जानीमो येन कन्यकाम् . . 1.5.10
text_mt: For the welfare of all worlds, bestowing auspicious and inauspicious fruits, / so that we may recognise a praised or unpraised maiden.'

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā viriñco vākyamabravīt .
śṛṇudhvaṃ dvijaśārdūlā vacmi yuṣmāsvaśeṣataḥ . . 11
meaning:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा विरिञ्चो वाक्यमब्रवीत् .
शृणुध्वं द्विजशार्दूला वच्मि युष्मास्वशेषतः . . 11
text_mt: Hearing those words of theirs, Viriñca spoke these words: / 'Listen, O tigers among the twice-born; I shall tell you in full.

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhitatalau samyagratāmbhojasamaprabhau .
īdṛśau caraṇau dhanyau yoṣitāṃ bhogavardhanau . . 12
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठिततलौ सम्यग्रताम्भोजसमप्रभौ .
ईदृशौ चरणौ धन्यौ योषितां भोगवर्धनौ . . 12
text_mt: With soles firmly planted, fully possessing the lustre of a red lotus— / such feet of women are fortunate and promote pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
karālairatinirmāsai rūkṣairardhaśirānvitaiḥ .
dāridryaṃ durbhagatvaṃ ca prāpnuvanti na saṃśayaḥ . . 13
meaning:
करालैरतिनिर्मासै रूक्षैरर्धशिरान्वितैः .
दारिद्र्यं दुर्भगत्वं च प्राप्नुवन्ति न संशयः . . 13
text_mt: By [feet that are] dreadful, fleshless, rough, and showing veins, / they incur poverty and misfortune; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgulyaḥ saṃhatā vṛttāḥ snig(?)dhāḥ sūkṣmanakhāstathā .
kurvantyatyantamaiśvaryaṃ rājabhāvaṃ ca yoṣitaḥ . . 14
meaning:
अङ्गुल्यः संहता वृत्ताः स्निग्(?)धाः सूक्ष्मनखास्तथा .
कुर्वन्त्यत्यन्तमैश्वर्यं राजभावं च योषितः . . 14
text_mt: Toes that are closely set, rounded, glossy, and have fine nails / bring women supreme sovereignty and royal status.

sanskrit_iast:
hrasvāḥ sujīvitaṃ hrasvā viralā vittahānaye .
dāridryaṃ mūlamagnāsu preṣyaṃ ca pṛthulāsu ca . . 15
meaning:
ह्रस्वाः सुजीवितं ह्रस्वा विरला वित्तहानये .
दारिद्र्यं मूलमग्नासु प्रेष्यं च पृथुलासु च . . 15
text_mt: [When they are] short, [they bring] a good life; short and sparse, they bring loss of wealth; / when sunken at the base, poverty; and when thick, servitude.

sanskrit_iast:
parasparasamārūḍhaistanubhirvṛttaparvabhiḥ .
bahūnapi patīnhatvā dāsī bhavati vai dvijāḥ . . 16
meaning:
परस्परसमारूढैस्तनुभिर्वृत्तपर्वभिः .
बहूनपि पतीन्हत्वा दासी भवति वै द्विजाः . . 16
text_mt: By toes overlapping one another, thin, and with rounded joints, / she slays even many husbands and becomes a slave-girl, O twice-born ones.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅguṣṭhonnataparvāṇastuṅgāgrāḥ komalānvitāḥ .
ratnakāñcanalābhāya viparītā vipattaye . . 17
meaning:
अङ्गुष्ठोन्नतपर्वाणस्तुङ्गाग्राः कोमलान्विताः .
रत्नकाञ्चनलाभाय विपरीता विपत्तये . . 17
text_mt: Thumbs with raised joints, high tips, and endowed with softness / bring the acquisition of gems and gold; opposite ones bring ruin.

sanskrit_iast:
subhagatvaṃ nakhaiḥ snigdhairātāmraiśca dhanād yatā .
putrāḥ syurunnatairebhiḥ susūkṣmaiścāpi rājatā . . 18
meaning:
सुभगत्वं नखैः स्निग्धैराताम्रैश्च धनाद् यता .
पुत्राः स्युरुन्नतैरेभिः सुसूक्ष्मैश्चापि राजता . . 18
text_mt: Good fortune comes from nails that are glossy and coppery, and wealth; / sons come from elevated ones, and sovereignty from very fine ones.

sanskrit_iast:
pāṇḍuraiḥ sphuṭitai rūkṣairnīlairdhūmraistathā kharaiḥ 1 .
niḥsvatā bhavati strīṇāṃ pītaiścābhakṣyabhakṣaṇam . . 19
meaning:
पाण्डुरैः स्फुटितै रूक्षैर्नीलैर्धूम्रैस्तथा खरैः 1 .
निःस्वता भवति स्त्रीणां पीतैश्चाभक्ष्यभक्षणम् . . 19
text_mt: By pale, split, rough, blue, smoky, and harsh [nails], / women incur destitution; and by yellow ones, eating uneatables.

sanskrit_iast:
gulphāḥ snigdhāśca vṛttāśca samārūḍhaśirāstathā .
yadi syurnūpurāndadhyurbāndhavādyaiḥ samāpnuyuḥ . . 1.5.20
meaning:
गुल्फाः स्निग्धाश्च वृत्ताश्च समारूढशिरास्तथा .
यदि स्युर्नूपुरान्दध्युर्बान्धवाद्यैः समाप्नुयुः . . 1.5.20
text_mt: If the ankles are glossy, rounded, and have their veins concealed, / they wear anklets and attain prosperity through relatives and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
aśirā śarakāṇḍābhāḥ suvṛttālpatanūruhāḥ .
jaṅghā kurvanti saubhāgyaṃ yānaṃ ca gajavājibhiḥ . . 21
meaning:
अशिरा शरकाण्डाभाः सुवृत्ताल्पतनूरुहाः .
जङ्घा कुर्वन्ति सौभाग्यं यानं च गजवाजिभिः . . 21
text_mt: Veinless, resembling reed-shafts, well-rounded, and with little hair, / shanks bring good fortune and travel by elephants and horses.

sanskrit_iast:
kliśyate romajaṅghā strī bhramatyuddhatapiṇḍikā .
kākajaṅghā patiṃ hanti vācāṭā kapilā ca yāḥ . . 22
meaning:
क्लिश्यते रोमजङ्घा स्त्री भ्रमत्युद्धतपिण्डिका .
काकजङ्घा पतिं हन्ति वाचाटा कपिला च याः . . 22
text_mt: A woman with hairy shanks suffers; one with protruding calves wanders; / a crow-shanked woman slays her husband, as does one who is talkative and tawny.

sanskrit_iast:
jānubhiścaiva mārjārasiṃhajānvanukāribhiḥ .
śriyamāpya subhāgyatvaṃ prāpnuvanti sutāṃstathā . . 23
meaning:
जानुभिश्चैव मार्जारसिंहजान्वनुकारिभिः .
श्रियमाप्य सुभाग्यत्वं प्राप्नुवन्ति सुतांस्तथा . . 23
text_mt: By knees that resemble the knees of a cat or a lion, / women attain splendour, good fortune, and sons.

sanskrit_iast:
ghaṭābhairadhvagā nāryo nirmāṃsaiḥ kulaṭā striyaḥ .
śirālairapi hiṃsrāḥ syurviśliṣṭairdhanavarjitāḥ . . 24
meaning:
घटाभैरध्वगा नार्यो निर्मांसैः कुलटा स्त्रियः .
शिरालैरपि हिंस्राः स्युर्विश्लिष्टैर्धनवर्जिताः . . 24
text_mt: By [knees] resembling water-jars, women become wanderers; by fleshless ones, unchaste wives; / by veined ones, violent; and by disjointed ones, devoid of wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
atyantakuṭilai rūkṣaiḥ sphuṭitāgrairguḍaprabhaiḥ .
anekajaistathā romaiḥ keśaiścāpi tathāvidhaiḥ . . 25
meaning:
अत्यन्तकुटिलै रूक्षैः स्फुटिताग्रैर्गुडप्रभैः .

text_mt: She whose joints are hidden, whose elbows are hairless, / and whose arms are graceful, rounded, and tender, is praised.

sanskrit_iast:
unnatāvanatau caiva nātisthūlau na romaśau .
sukhadau tu sadā strīṇāṃ saubhāgyārogyavardhanau . . 62
meaning:
उन्नतावनतौ चैव नातिस्थूलौ न रोमशौ .
सुखदौ तु सदा स्त्रीणां सौभाग्यारोग्यवर्धनौ . . 62
text_mt: Raised and rounded, neither overly thick nor hairy, / they always bestow happiness on women, increasing good fortune and health.

sanskrit_iast:
sthūle skandhe vahedbhāraṃ romaśe vyādhitā bhavet .
vakraskandhe bhavedvandhyā kulaṭā connatānane . . 63
meaning:
स्थूले स्कन्धे वहेद्भारं रोमशे व्याधिता भवेत् .
वक्रस्कन्धे भवेद्वन्ध्या कुलटा चोन्नतानने . . 63
text_mt: With thick shoulders she will carry burdens; with hairy ones she will be diseased; / with crooked shoulders she will be barren; and with an uplifted face, she is unchaste.

sanskrit_iast:
spaṣṭaṃ rekhātrayaṃ yasyā grīvāyāṃ caturaṅgulam .
maṇikāñcanamuktāḍhyaṃ sā dadhāti vibhūṣaṇam . . 64
meaning:
स्पष्टं रेखात्रयं यस्या ग्रीवायां चतुरङ्गुलम् .
मणिकाञ्चनमुक्ताढ्यं सा दधाति विभूषणम् . . 64
text_mt: She on whose four-finger-wide neck three clear lines appear, / wears ornaments rich in gems, gold, and pearls.

sanskrit_iast:
adhanā strī kṛśagrīvā dīrghagrīvā ca .bandhakī .
hasvagrīvā mṛtāpatyā sthūlagrīvā ca duḥkhitā . . 65
meaning:
अधना स्त्री कृशग्रीवा दीर्घग्रीवा च .बन्धकी .
हस्वग्रीवा मृतापत्या स्थूलग्रीवा च दुःखिता . . 65
text_mt: A woman with a thin neck is impoverished; with a long neck, an unchaste woman; / with a short neck, her offspring die; and with a thick neck, she is sorrowful.

sanskrit_iast:
anunnatā samāṃsā ca samā yasyāḥ kṛkāṭikā .
sudīrghamāyustvasyāstu ciraṃ bhartā ca jīvati . . 66
meaning:
अनुन्नता समांसा च समा यस्याः कृकाटिका .
सुदीर्घमायुस्त्वस्यास्तु चिरं भर्ता च जीवति . . 66
text_mt: She whose nape is not prominent, is fleshy, and even, / has a very long life, and her husband lives long.

sanskrit_iast:
nirmāṃsā bahumāṃsā ca śirālā romaśā tathā .
kuṭilā vikaṭā caiva vistīrṇā na ca śasyate . . 67
meaning:
निर्मांसा बहुमांसा च शिराला रोमशा तथा .
कुटिला विकटा चैव विस्तीर्णा न च शस्यते . . 67
text_mt: A nape that is fleshless, overly fleshy, veiny, hairy, / crooked, deformed, and wide is not commended.

sanskrit_iast:
na sthūlo na kṛśo'tyarthaṃ na vakro na ca romaśaḥ .
hanurevaṃvidhaḥ śreyāṃstato'nyo na praśasyate . . 68
meaning:
न स्थूलो न कृशोऽत्यर्थं न वक्रो न च रोमशः .
हनुरेवंविधः श्रेयांस्ततोऽन्यो न प्रशस्यते . . 68
text_mt: Neither thick nor excessively thin, neither crooked nor hairy— / a chin of this kind is superior; any other is not praised.

sanskrit_iast:
caturasramukhī dhūrtā maṇḍalāsyā śivā 1 bhavet .
aprajā vājivakrā strī mahāvakrā ca durbhagā . . 69
meaning:
चतुरस्रमुखी धूर्ता मण्डलास्या शिवा 1 भवेत् .
अप्रजा वाजिवक्रा स्त्री महावक्रा च दुर्भगा . . 69
