text_mt: Brahmā said: / When her husband has gone abroad, women's ornament should be merely what is auspicious, / and the diligent execution of the work begun by him;
title: Sapatnīkartavyavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast: śayyāmupārjanamarthānāṃ vyayānāṃ parihāpaṇam . . 2
meaning: शय्यामुपार्जनमर्थानां व्ययानां परिहापणम् . . 2
text_mt: [keeping to her] bed, the acquisition of wealth, and the curtailment of expenses;

sanskrit_iast:
vratopavāsatātparyaṃ tadvārtāparimārgaṇam .
daivajñekṣaṇikapraśno devānāmupayācanam . . 3
meaning:
व्रतोपवासतात्पर्यं तद्वार्तापरिमार्गणम् .
दैवज्ञेक्षणिकप्रश्नो देवानामुपयाचनम् . . 3
text_mt: devotion to vows and fasts, inquiring after news of him, / questioning astrologers and diviners, and making vows to the gods;

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ tasyāgamāśaṃsā kṣemārthaṃ devapūjanam .
na cātyujjvalaveṣatvaṃ na sadā tailadhāraṇam . .4
meaning:
नित्यं तस्यागमाशंसा क्षेमार्थं देवपूजनम् .
न चात्युज्ज्वलवेषत्वं न सदा तैलधारणम् . .4
text_mt: constantly longing for his return, worship of the gods for his welfare, / no excessively bright garments, and not always wearing oil [in her hair].

sanskrit_iast:
jñātiveśma na gantavyaṃ sakāmagamanena 1 ca .
gurūṇāmājñayā yāvadbharturāptajanaiḥ saha . . 5
meaning:
ज्ञातिवेश्म न गन्तव्यं सकामगमनेन 1 च .
गुरूणामाज्ञया यावद्भर्तुराप्तजनैः सह . . 5
text_mt: She should not go to the house of her kinsmen at her own pleasure, / but only by the permission of her elders, together with trustworthy people of her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpi na ciraṃ tiṣṭhetsnānādīnvāpi nācaret .
yāvadarthaṃ kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā tataḥ śīghraṃ samācaret . . 6
meaning:
तत्रापि न चिरं तिष्ठेत्स्नानादीन्वापि नाचरेत् .
यावदर्थं क्षणं स्थित्वा ततः शीघ्रं समाचरेत् . . 6
text_mt: Even there she should not stay long, nor perform bathing and the like; / having stayed for a moment as needed, she should then leave quickly.

sanskrit_iast:
āgate prakṛtisthaiva kṛtvā tātkālikaṃ vidhim .
muktapravāsane pathye snāte bhuktavati priye . . 7
meaning:
आगते प्रकृतिस्थैव कृत्वा तात्कालिकं विधिम् .
मुक्तप्रवासने पथ्ये स्नाते भुक्तवति प्रिये . . 7
text_mt: When he has returned, she should remain in her natural state, perform the rites for that time, / and when the beloved has laid aside his travel garments, bathed, and eaten wholesome food,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānaṃ samalaṅkṛtya saviśeṣaṃ mudānvitā .
devapūjopahārādīndadyātprāgupapāditān . . 8
meaning:
आत्मानं समलङ्कृत्य सविशेषं मुदान्विता .
देवपूजोपहारादीन्दद्यात्प्रागुपपादितान् . . 8
text_mt: having adorned herself exceptionally, filled with joy, / she should present the offerings for the worship of the gods and other things prepared beforehand.

sanskrit_iast:
kaniṣṭhāmātṛvajjyeṣṭhāṃ tadapatyāni cātmavat .
paśyettatparivargaṃ tu nityaṃ svaparivargavat . . 9
meaning:
कनिष्ठामातृवज्ज्येष्ठां तदपत्यानि चात्मवत् .
पश्येत्तत्परिवर्गं तु नित्यं स्वपरिवर्गवत् . . 9
text_mt: She should view the elder [co-wife] like a mother, the younger and her children like herself, / and his retinue always like her own retinue.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpuronāsane tiṣṭhetpatiṃ nāmaṃtrayeta ca .
tadabhiprāyataḥ kuryātpravṛttiṃ sarvakarmasu . . 1.14.10
meaning:
तत्पुरोनासने तिष्ठेत्पतिं नामंत्रयेत च .
तदभिप्रायतः कुर्यात्प्रवृत्तिं सर्वकर्मसु . . 1.14.10
text_mt: She should not sit on a seat before him, nor address her husband by name; / she should engage in all deeds according to his intention.

sanskrit_iast:
na saṃsṛjeta taddviṣṭaiḥ sakhyaṃ kurvīta tatpriyaiḥ .
janamāptatamaṃ tasya sadābhartuśca mānayet . . 11
meaning:
न संसृजेत तद्द्विष्टैः सख्यं कुर्वीत तत्प्रियैः .
जनमाप्ततमं तस्य सदाभर्तुश्च मानयेत् . . 11
text_mt: She should not associate with those he dislikes; she should make friends with those he loves; / and she should always honour the person who is most trusted by her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
paitṛkātsamupānītaṃ vasusaugaṃdhikādikam .
tasmai nivedyātmatayā tadā tadupayojayet . . 12
meaning:
पैतृकात्समुपानीतं वसुसौगंधिकादिकम् .
तस्मै निवेद्यात्मतया तदा तदुपयोजयेत् . . 12
text_mt: Wealth, perfumes, and the like brought from her father's family / she should use only after offering them to him as his own.

sanskrit_iast:
sopi tatprītaye kiṃcidādadyādalpamūlyakam .
saṃgopya mātṛvatstheyaṃ tattathaivopayojayet . . 13
meaning:
सोपि तत्प्रीतये किंचिदादद्यादल्पमूल्यकम् .
संगोप्य मातृवत्स्थेयं तत्तथैवोपयोजयेत् . . 13
text_mt: He too may accept something of small value to please her; / keeping it secret like a mother, she should use it just as it is.

sanskrit_iast:
tatprītyarthaṃ gṛhītaṃ yadvailakṣyādinivṛttaye .
saviśeṣaṃ prasaṃgena tasyaitatpratipādayet 1 . . 14
meaning:
तत्प्रीत्यर्थं गृहीतं यद्वैलक्ष्यादिनिवृत्तये .
सविशेषं प्रसंगेन तस्यैतत्प्रतिपादयेत् 1 . . 14
text_mt: Whatever is accepted to please her, in order to dispel embarrassment and the like, / she should present to him especially when the occasion arises.

sanskrit_iast:
strīṇāṃ yadetatsāpatnyaṃ paraṃ mātsaryakāraṇam .
tasmāttatparihartavyaṃ paramodāracaryayā2 . . 15
meaning:
स्त्रीणां यदेतत्सापत्न्यं परं मात्सर्यकारणम् .
तस्मात्तत्परिहर्तव्यं परमोदारचर्यया2 . . 15
text_mt: This rivalry of co-wives is the supreme cause of jealousy for women; / therefore, it should be avoided by supremely noble conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā kalpitanepathyā bhartuḥ paryāyavāsare .
hriyamādayamāneva3 patiṃ gacchedvisarjitā . . 16
meaning:
तथा कल्पितनेपथ्या भर्तुः पर्यायवासरे .
ह्रियमादयमानेव3 पतिं गच्छेद्विसर्जिता . . 16
text_mt: Likewise, adorned with attire arranged on her husband's allotted night, / she should go to her husband when dismissed [by the senior wife], acting as if struck by modesty.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā rahasi bhartāraṃ tatkālocitasaṃbhramaiḥ .
tadbhāvānugataistaistaiḥ saviśeṣamupācaret . . 17
meaning:
गत्वा रहसि भर्तारं तत्कालोचितसंभ्रमैः .
तद्भावानुगतैस्तैस्तैः सविशेषमुपाचरेत् . . 17
text_mt: Having approached her husband in secret, she should attend upon him with special care, / through various agitations suitable to the occasion and conforming to his moods.

sanskrit_iast:
pratibudhya tataḥ kāle saviśeṣaṃ trapānvitā .
jyeṣṭhāya vasatiṃ gacchedviśeṣeṇa tathā punaḥ . . 18
meaning:
प्रतिबुध्य ततः काले सविशेषं त्रपान्विता .
ज्येष्ठाय वसतिं गच्छेद्विशेषेण तथा पुनः . . 18
text_mt: Having awakened in the morning at the proper time, exceptionally filled with shame, / she should again go specifically to the dwelling of the senior wife.

sanskrit_iast:
aprātikūlyaṃ jyeṣṭhāyā hitamanyatra yoṣitaḥ .
tataḥ śanaistvavacchidya patiṃ svavaśamānayet . . 19
meaning:
अप्रातिकूल्यं ज्येष्ठाया हितमन्यत्र योषितः .
ततः शनैस्त्ववच्छिद्य पतिं स्ववशमानयेत् . . 19
text_mt: Benevolence toward the senior wife, and never antagonism, is beneficial elsewhere for a woman; / then, having detached her husband gradually, she should bring him under her own sway.

sanskrit_iast:
bahiṣpākādiyogena catuḥṣaṣṭyā rahogatam .
jyeṣṭhāmatiśayāneva bhartāramuparañjayet . . 1.14.20
meaning:
बहिष्पाकादियोगेन चतुःषष्ट्या रहोगतम् .
ज्येष्ठामतिशयानेव भर्तारमुपरञ्जयेत् . . 1.14.20
text_mt: Through cooking outside and the like, and through the sixty-four arts when alone, / outdoing the senior wife, she should delight her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
prāgalbhyaṃ rahasi strīṇāṃ lajjādhikyaṃ tato'nyadā .
cittajñānānuvṛttiśca patyau saṃsevanaṃ param . . 21
meaning:
प्रागल्भ्यं रहसि स्त्रीणां लज्जाधिक्यं ततोऽन्यदा .
चित्तज्ञानानुवृत्तिश्च पत्यौ संसेवनं परम् . . 21
text_mt: Boldness in secret for women, but greater bashfulness at other times, / and following the knowledge of his mind—this is supreme service to the husband.

sanskrit_iast:
evamārādhya bhartāraṃ gṛhamākramya ca kramāt .
gauravaṃ pratipattiṃ vā jyeṣṭhādiṣu na hāpayet . . 22
meaning:
एवमाराध्य भर्तारं गृहमाक्रम्य च क्रमात् .
गौरवं प्रतिपत्तिं वा ज्येष्ठादिषु न हापयेत् . . 22
text_mt: Having thus gratified her husband and gradually taken over the household, / she should not diminish reverence or honor toward the senior wife and others.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhavyāpāradāneṣu patiṃ guḍhaṃ tadhā vadet .
adhikuryādanicchantī jyeṣṭhaivenāṃ yathā balāt . . 23
meaning:
गृहव्यापारदानेषु पतिं गुढं तधा वदेत् .
अधिकुर्यादनिच्छन्ती ज्येष्ठैवेनां यथा बलात् . . 23
text_mt: In assigning household duties, she should speak secretly to her husband in such a way / that the senior wife herself, even if unwilling, would place her in authority as if by force.

sanskrit_iast:
sāpi vijñāya bhartāraṃ kaniṣṭhākṛṣṭamānasam .
viśrāmaṃ prārthayedenāmadhikuryātsutāmiva . . 24
meaning:
सापि विज्ञाय भर्तारं कनिष्ठाकृष्टमानसम् .
विश्रामं प्रार्थयेदेनामधिकुर्यात्सुतामिव . . 24
text_mt: She too, realizing that her husband's mind is attracted to the junior wife, / should ask her for rest and place her in charge like a daughter.

sanskrit_iast:
matvā bharturabhipretaṃ rakṣantī nijagauravam .
kṛtaṃ bhartranukūlaṃ syāttadiṣṭāyānumodayet . . 25
meaning:
मत्वा भर्तुरभिप्रेतं रक्षन्ती निजगौरवम् .
कृतं भर्त्रनुकूलं स्यात्तदिष्टायानुमोदयेत् . . 25
text_mt: Knowing her husband's intention and protecting her own dignity, / whatever is done should be pleasing to her husband, and she should approve what he desires.

sanskrit_iast:
sthānino yadabhipretaṃ bhṛtyaiḥ kiṃ kriyate'nyathā .
kliśyate tatra mūḍhātmā paratantro vṛthā janaḥ . . 26
meaning:
स्थानिनो यदभिप्रेतं भृत्यैः किं क्रियतेऽन्यथा .
क्लिश्यते तत्र मूढात्मा परतन्त्रो वृथा जनः . . 26
text_mt: What can servants do contrary to what is intended by the master? / In that matter, the foolish, dependent person suffers in vain.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsarvāsvavasthāsu manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ .
hitaṃ svāmyanukūlatvaṃ nārīṇāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ . . 27
meaning:
तस्मात्सर्वास्ववस्थासु मनोवाक्कायकर्मभिः .
हितं स्वाम्यनुकूलत्वं नारीणां तु विशेषतः . . 27
text_mt: Therefore, in all circumstances, by acts of mind, speech, and body, / conformity to one's master is beneficial, especially for women.

sanskrit_iast:
sāpi jyeṣṭhāpatiṃ caiva gṛhatantraṃ ca sarvadā .
samāvarjya 1 guṇairdhīrā prāgavasthāṃ na vismaret . . 28
meaning:
सापि ज्येष्ठापतिं चैव गृहतन्त्रं च सर्वदा .
समावर्ज्य 1 गुणैर्धीरा प्रागवस्थां न विस्मरेत् . . 28
text_mt: She too, the steadfast woman, having won over the senior wife, her husband, and the household order at all times / by her virtues, should not forget her former condition.

sanskrit_iast:
na saubhāgyamadaṃ kuryānna cauddhatyādivikriyām .
nitarāmānatiṃ gacchetsadānāryabhayādiva . . 29
meaning:
न सौभाग्यमदं कुर्यान्न चौद्धत्यादिविक्रियाम् .
नितरामानतिं गच्छेत्सदानार्यभयादिव . . 29
text_mt: She should not exhibit pride in good fortune, nor aberration such as arrogance; / she should thoroughly maintain humility, as if always in fear of an ignoble act.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā yogyatayā patyau saubhāgyamabhivardhate .
spardhayecya kulastrīṇāṃ praśrayopādhikaṃ tathā . . 1.14.30
meaning:
यथा योग्यतया पत्यौ सौभाग्यमभिवर्धते .
स्पर्धयेच्य कुलस्त्रीणां प्रश्रयोपाधिकं तथा . . 1.14.30
text_mt: Just as good fortune with her husband increases through fitness, / so emulation among highborn women has modesty as its condition.

sanskrit_iast:
evamārādhya bhartāraṃ tatkāryeṣvapramādinī .
pūjyānāṃ pūjane nityaṃ bhṛtyānāṃ bharaṇeṣu ca . . 31
meaning:
एवमाराध्य भर्तारं तत्कार्येष्वप्रमादिनी .
पूज्यानां पूजने नित्यं भृत्यानां भरणेषु च . . 31
text_mt: Having thus gratified her husband, being vigilant in his affairs, / always in honoring those worthy of honor and in maintaining servants,

sanskrit_iast:
guṇānāmarjane nityaṃ śīlavatparirakṣaṇe .
pretya ceha ca nirdvandvaṃ sukhamāpnotyanuttamam . . 32
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe śatārddhasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ brāhme parvaṇi strīdharmeṣu
sapatnīkartavyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ . 14 .
strīdharmavarṇanam
meaning:
गुणानामर्जने नित्यं शीलवत्परिरक्षणे .
प्रेत्य चेह च निर्द्वन्द्वं सुखमाप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् . . 32
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे शतार्द्धसाहस्र्यां संहितायां ब्राह्मे पर्वणि स्त्रीधर्मेषु
सपत्नीकर्तव्यवर्णनं नाम चतुर्दशोऽध्यायः . 14 .
स्त्रीधर्मवर्णनम्
text_mt:
in constantly acquiring virtues, and in guarding [herself] like a virtuous woman, / she attains unsurpassed, unconflicted happiness here and in the hereafter.
Thus ends the fourteenth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Duties of Co-wives', in the duties of women, in the Brāhmaparvan of the venerable Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa containing fifty thousand verses.
Description of the Duties of Women

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
durbhagā ca punarnityamupavāsāditatparā .
bāhyeṣu patikṛtyeṣu syādviśeṣābhiyoginī . . 1
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
दुर्भगा च पुनर्नित्यमुपवासादितत्परा .
बाह्येषु पतिकृत्येषु स्याद्विशेषाभियोगिनी . . 1
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Moreover, an unfortunate woman, constantly intent upon fasts and the like, / should be especially engaged in external tasks for her husband.
title: Strīdharmavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
na praśaṃsāṃ sapatnīṣu niṃdāṃ cāpi tathātmani .
asūyāṃ bharturīrṣyāṃ vā praṇayaṃ vāpi darśayet . . 2
meaning:
न प्रशंसां सपत्नीषु निंदां चापि तथात्मनि .
असूयां भर्तुरीर्ष्यां वा प्रणयं वापि दर्शयेत् . . 2
text_mt: She should not display praise among co-wives, nor censure of herself; / nor should she display malice, jealousy toward her husband, or affection.

sanskrit_iast:
madvidhā yā hi bahvetattaccāttyaṃtikamaśnute .
yadasyā yuṣmato yāyādbhāryāśabdābhidheyatām . . 3
meaning:
मद्विधा या हि बह्वेतत्तच्चात्त्यंतिकमश्नुते .
यदस्या युष्मतो यायाद्भार्याशब्दाभिधेयताम् . . 3
text_mt: Indeed, someone like me attains this abundance, and that exceedingly, / because she may attain the designation of 'wife' to one as long-lived as you.

sanskrit_iast:
na ca nirbhūṣaṇā tiṣṭhenna cāpyuddhatabhūṣaṇā .
nānyadā gaṃdhamālyādi grāhyaṃ patyupacārataḥ . . 4
meaning:
न च निर्भूषणा तिष्ठेन्न चाप्युद्धतभूषणा .
नान्यदा गंधमाल्यादि ग्राह्यं पत्युपचारतः . . 4
text_mt: She should neither remain without ornaments, nor should she wear haughty ornaments; / at other times perfumes, garlands, and the like should not be taken, except when serving her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
tannyūnaṃ sarvaśo grāhyaṃ vallabhāyā viśeṣataḥ .
bhūṣaṇaṃ gandhamālyaṃ tu tāvatkālamalakṣitam . . 5
meaning:
तन्न्यूनं सर्वशो ग्राह्यं वल्लभाया विशेषतः .
भूषणं गन्धमाल्यं तु तावत्कालमलक्षितम् . . 5
text_mt: She should take altogether less than the favorite wife in particular; / an ornament, perfume, or garland, however, should remain unperceived for that duration of time.

sanskrit_iast:
sambādhānāṃ pradeśānāṃ nityaṃ svedādimārjanam .
dantanāsādipaṅkānāṃ vigandhasya ca śodhanam . . 6
meaning:
सम्बाधानां प्रदेशानां नित्यं स्वेदादिमार्जनम् .
दन्तनासादिपङ्कानां विगन्धस्य च शोधनम् . . 6
text_mt: Daily wiping of sweat and the like from the private parts, / and cleansing of grime from teeth, nose, and the like, and of bad odors [should be done].

sanskrit_iast:
nimittaṃ bharturetāsāṃ yatkiṃcidabhilakṣayet .
nānena vā tayoryatnaṃ vidadhyādaṅgamārjane . . 7
meaning:
निमित्तं भर्तुरेतासां यत्किंचिदभिलक्षयेत् .
नानेन वा तयोर्यत्नं विदध्यादङ्गमार्जने . . 7
text_mt: Whatever sign of these the husband might notice, / by no means should she make an effort to cleanse her body in their presence.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāsāṃ ca sapatnīnāṃ sarvatrānugatā bhavet .
vaitasīṃ vṛttimāsthāya vallabhāyā viśeṣataḥ . . 8
meaning:
सर्वासां च सपत्नीनां सर्वत्रानुगता भवेत् .
वैतसीं वृत्तिमास्थाय वल्लभाया विशेषतः . . 8
text_mt: And toward all co-wives she should be compliant in every way, / adopting the conduct of a reed, especially toward the favorite wife.

sanskrit_iast:
anyasyā yadanuṣṭheyaṃ yanna sīdetsamarpitam .
bhartuścāviditaṃ yatnāttatkuryādavirodhi cet . . 9
meaning:
अन्यस्या यदनुष्ठेयं यन्न सीदेत्समर्पितम् .
भर्तुश्चाविदितं यत्नात्तत्कुर्यादविरोधि चेत् . . 9
text_mt: Whatever is to be performed for another that would not suffer if entrusted, / she should perform with effort without her husband's knowledge, if it causes no conflict.

sanskrit_iast:
kośavastrānnatāmbūlagandhāpānauṣadhādikam .
tatsarvamaniyuktānāṃ doṣavatvādvirudhyate . . 1.15.10
meaning:
कोशवस्त्रान्नताम्बूलगन्धापानौषधादिकम् .
तत्सर्वमनियुक्तानां दोषवत्वाद्विरुध्यते . . 1.15.10
text_mt: Treasury, clothes, food, betel, perfumes, drinks, medicines, and the like— / all that is objectionable for those not authorized, because it involves fault.

sanskrit_iast:
yattu muktamanuṣṭheyaṃ gahasammārjanādikam .
strīṇāmanadhikāre'pi prāyastadvidhirucyate . . 11
meaning:
यत्तु मुक्तमनुष्ठेयं गहसम्मार्जनादिकम् .
स्त्रीणामनधिकारेऽपि प्रायस्तद्विधिरुच्यते . . 11
text_mt: However, that which is left to be performed, such as sweeping the house, / is generally prescribed as a duty for women even when they have no formal authority.

sanskrit_iast:
abhyaṅgodvartanaṃ snānaṃ bhojanaṃ maṇḍanāni ca .
kuryādbharturapatyānāṃ dhātrīkarmāṇi sādaram . . 12
meaning:
अभ्यङ्गोद्वर्तनं स्नानं भोजनं मण्डनानि च .
कुर्याद्भर्तुरपत्यानां धात्रीकर्माणि सादरम् . . 12
text_mt: Inunction, rubbing with fragrant paste, bathing, food, and ornamentation— / she should respectfully perform the duties of a nurse for the husband's children.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmavattānyapatyāni sādhayatyanuyogataḥ .
svenāpyamīṣāṃ vittena vidadhyānmaṇḍanādikam . . 13
meaning:
आत्मवत्तान्यपत्यानि साधयत्यनुयोगतः .
स्वेनाप्यमीषां वित्तेन विदध्यान्मण्डनादिकम् . . 13
text_mt: She manages the children like her own through attentive care; / she should provide ornaments and the like for them even with her own wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
bhogaḥ svayamapatyairvā strīvittasya patirvidhā .
pūrve vayasyabhinandya paścime copayojanam . . 14
meaning:
भोगः स्वयमपत्यैर्वा स्त्रीवित्तस्य पतिर्विधा .
पूर्वे वयस्यभिनन्द्य पश्चिमे चोपयोजनम् . . 14
text_mt: The enjoyment of a woman's wealth is by herself, by the children, or by the husband; / its utilization is to be welcomed in the earlier age and in the later.

sanskrit_iast:
ubhayogastu vā mā vā karmajaḥ pṛthageva saḥ .
sadvṛtte tvadhikāṃ khyātiṃ kurvīta kriyayā punaḥ . . 15
meaning:
उभयोगस्तु वा मा वा कर्मजः पृथगेव सः .
सद्वृत्ते त्वधिकां ख्यातिं कुर्वीत क्रियया पुनः . . 15
text_mt: Whether there is use of both or not, it arises from past action and is distinct; / in good conduct, however, she should make higher renown again through her deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
na kāpi durbhagā nāma subhagā nāma jātitaḥ .
vyavahārādbhavatyeṣa nirdeśo ripumitravat . . 16
meaning:
न कापि दुर्भगा नाम सुभगा नाम जातितः .
व्यवहाराद्भवत्येष निर्देशो रिपुमित्रवत् . . 16
text_mt: No woman is called unfortunate or fortunate merely by birth; / this designation arises from behavior, like 'enemy' or 'friend'.

sanskrit_iast:
bhartṛcittāparijñānādananuṣṭhānato'pi vā.
vṛttairlokaviruddhaiśca yānti durbhagatāṃ striyaḥ . . 17
meaning:
भर्तृचित्तापरिज्ञानादननुष्ठानतोऽपि वा.
वृत्तैर्लोकविरुद्धैश्च यान्ति दुर्भगतां स्त्रियः . . 17
text_mt: From failure to understand their husband's mind, or from non-performance [of duties], / and through conduct contrary to the world, women arrive at the state of being unloved.

sanskrit_iast:
prānukūlyānmanovṛttaiḥ paro'pi priyatāṃ vrajet .
prātikūlyānnijopyāśu priyaḥ pradveṣatāmiyāt . . 18
meaning:
प्रानुकूल्यान्मनोवृत्तैः परोऽपि प्रियतां व्रजेत् .
प्रातिकूल्यान्निजोप्याशु प्रियः प्रद्वेषतामियात् . . 18
text_mt: Through compliance of mental disposition, even a stranger may become beloved; / through contrariness, even one's own dear person quickly attains enmity.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsarvāsvavasthāsu manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ .
priyaṃ samācarennityaṃ taccitānuvidhāyinī . . 19
meaning:
तस्मात्सर्वास्ववस्थासु मनोवाक्कायकर्मभिः .
प्रियं समाचरेन्नित्यं तच्चितानुविधायिनी . . 19
text_mt: Therefore, in all circumstances, by acts of mind, speech, and body, / she should constantly act pleasantly, conforming to his mind.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmanyāṃ kāmayettāsāṃ taṃ tayā saṃprayojayet .
kupitāṃ ca priyāṃ kāñcidyatnādasmai prasādayet . . 1.15.20
meaning:
यामन्यां कामयेत्तासां तं तया संप्रयोजयेत् .
कुपितां च प्रियां काञ्चिद्यत्नादस्मै प्रसादयेत् . . 1.15.20
text_mt: Whichever other [co-wife] among them he desires, she should unite him with her; / and if a certain beloved wife is angry, she should diligently conciliate her for him.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpādaparicaryāyāṃ gotrasaṃvāhane 1 tathā .
pīḍane śirasaścaiva paraṃ kauśalamabhyaset . . 21
meaning:
तत्पादपरिचर्यायां गोत्रसंवाहने 1 तथा .
पीडने शिरसश्चैव परं कौशलमभ्यसेत् . . 21
text_mt: In attending to his feet, in massaging his limbs, / and in pressing his head, she should cultivate the utmost skill.

sanskrit_iast:
pīḍanaṃ mṛdu madhyaṃ ca gātrāvasthāviśeṣataḥ .
mukhagātrādibhirliṅgaiḥ prayojyaṃ tatsukhāvaham . . 22
meaning:
पीडनं मृदु मध्यं च गात्रावस्थाविशेषतः .
मुखगात्रादिभिर्लिङ्गैः प्रयोज्यं तत्सुखावहम् . . 22
text_mt: Pressing may be soft or moderate, according to the specific condition of his limbs; / it should be applied so as to bring comfort, judging by indications from the face, limbs, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
bāhūrukaṭipṛṣṭheṣu skaṃdhe śirasi pādayoḥ .
gāḍhamardanamicchanti prāyonyatrāpi madhyamam . . 23
meaning:
बाहूरुकटिपृष्ठेषु स्कंधे शिरसि पादयोः .
गाढमर्दनमिच्छन्ति प्रायोन्यत्रापि मध्यमम् . . 23
text_mt: On the arms, thighs, hips, back, shoulders, head, and feet, / they desire firm rubbing; generally elsewhere, moderate.

sanskrit_iast:
nirmāṃseṣu pradeśeṣu nābhimūleṣu marmasu .
hṛdgaṇḍakakapolādāvicchanti mṛdumardanam . . 24
meaning:
निर्मांसेषु प्रदेशेषु नाभिमूलेषु मर्मसु .
हृद्गण्डककपोलादाविच्छन्ति मृदुमर्दनम् . . 24
text_mt: On fleshless parts, at the base of the navel, on vital points, / on the chest, temple, and cheek, they desire soft rubbing.

sanskrit_iast:
gāḍhaṃ jāgradavasthāyāmardhasuptasya madhyamam .
kiñcitsaparighātaṃ ca mṛdusuptasya neti vā . . 25
meaning:
गाढं जाग्रदवस्थायामर्धसुप्तस्य मध्यमम् .
किञ्चित्सपरिघातं च मृदुसुप्तस्य नेति वा . . 25
text_mt: Firm [pressure] during the waking state, moderate for one half-asleep / with gentle patting, and soft for one asleep—or not at all.

sanskrit_iast:
viruddhaṃ sarvagātreṣu2 lomavastu viśeṣataḥ .
utkaṇḍūyatyu soddharṣaṃ snehākteṣu ca marda nam . . 26
meaning:
विरुद्धं सर्वगात्रेषु2 लोमवस्तु विशेषतः .
उत्कण्डूयत्यु सोद्धर्षं स्नेहाक्तेषु च मर्द नम् . . 26
text_mt: It is improper on all limbs, especially on hairy areas, / to scratch violently with friction, and to rub upon parts smeared with oil.

sanskrit_iast:
sparśādromāñcajananaṃ sanakhacchuritaṃ śanaiḥ .
pulakollekhanopetaṃ śiraḥkaṃḍūśca pārśvayoḥ . . 27
meaning:
स्पर्शाद्रोमाञ्चजननं सनखच्छुरितं शनैः .
पुलकोल्लेखनोपेतं शिरःकंडूश्च पार्श्वयोः . . 27
text_mt: Causing horripilation by touch, gently tracing with nails, / accompanying the bristling of hair, and scratching the head on both sides [should be done].

sanskrit_iast:
teṣu teṣu ca gātreṣu tatprayojyaṃ tathātathā .
nidrāgamāya tatkāle rāgasaṃdhukṣaṇāya ca . . 28
meaning:
तेषु तेषु च गात्रेषु तत्प्रयोज्यं तथातथा .
निद्रागमाय तत्काले रागसंधुक्षणाय च . . 28
text_mt: And on those various limbs, it should be applied in that manner, / to bring on sleep at that time and to kindle passion.

sanskrit_iast:
tiṣṭhataścopaviṣṭasya 1 jāgrataḥ svapato'pi vā .
saṃvāhanaṃ praśaṃsaṃti yadatyarthaṃ sukhāvaham . . 29
meaning:
तिष्ठतश्चोपविष्टस्य 1 जाग्रतः स्वपतोऽपि वा .
संवाहनं प्रशंसंति यदत्यर्थं सुखावहम् . . 29
text_mt: Whether he is standing, seated, awake, or even asleep, / they praise massage because it brings extraordinary pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
naiṣpandyaṃ pulakodbhedo gātrāṇāmakṣimīlanam .
tatpradeśārpaṇaṃ kiñcidbodhedvikṛtidarśanam . . 1.15.30
meaning:
नैष्पन्द्यं पुलकोद्भेदो गात्राणामक्षिमीलनम् .
तत्प्रदेशार्पणं किञ्चिद्बोधेद्विकृतिदर्शनम् . . 1.15.30
text_mt: Motionlessness, the bristling of body hair, the closing of the eyes, / presenting that part [of the body], perceiving some slight alteration [of mood]—

sanskrit_iast:
ūrū mūlādideśe ca tatpāṇipratipīḍanam .
lakṣayennipuṇā2 yatra tatraivādhikamācaret . . 31
meaning:
ऊरू मूलादिदेशे च तत्पाणिप्रतिपीडनम् .
लक्षयेन्निपुणा2 यत्र तत्रैवाधिकमाचरेत् . . 31
text_mt: on the thighs and the region of the groin, pressing with his hand: / wherever the clever woman notices this, there she should do more.

sanskrit_iast:
evameva yathoddiṣṭaṃ strīvṛttaṃ yānutiṣṭhati .
patimārādhya sampūrṇa trivargaṃ sādhigacchati3 . . 32
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe śatārddhasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ brāhme parvaṇi strīdharmavarṇanaṃ
nāma paṃcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ . 15 .
pratipatkalpavarṇanam
meaning:
एवमेव यथोद्दिष्टं स्त्रीवृत्तं यानुतिष्ठति .
पतिमाराध्य सम्पूर्ण त्रिवर्गं साधिगच्छति3 . . 32
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे शतार्द्धसाहस्र्यां संहितायां ब्राह्मे पर्वणि स्त्रीधर्मवर्णनं
नाम पंचदशोऽध्यायः . 15 .
प्रतिपत्कल्पवर्णनम्
text_mt:
She who carries out women's conduct in this manner as instructed, / worshipping her husband, attains the complete trivarga.
Thus ends the fifteenth chapter, named “The Description of the Duties of Women,” in the Brāhmaparvan of the venerable Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa, in the recension of fifty thousand verses.
Description of the Rite of the First Lunar Day

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
ityuktvā bhagavānbrahmā strīlakṣaṇamaśeṣataḥ .
sadvṛttaṃ ca tathā strīṇāṃ jagāma sa nijālayam . . 1
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
इत्युक्त्वा भगवान्ब्रह्मा स्त्रीलक्षणमशेषतः .
सद्वृत्तं च तथा स्त्रीणां जगाम स निजालयम् . . 1
text_mt: Sumantu said: / Having thus fully explained the bodily characteristics of women / and the virtuous conduct of women, the Lord Brahmā departed for his own abode.
title: Pratipatkalpavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayaśca tathā jagmuḥ svāni dhiṣṇyānyaśeṣataḥ .
strīlakṣaṇaṃ tathā vṛttaṃ śrutvā kṛtsnaṃ mahīpate . . 2
meaning:
ऋषयश्च तथा जग्मुः स्वानि धिष्ण्यान्यशेषतः .
स्त्रीलक्षणं तथा वृत्तं श्रुत्वा कृत्स्नं महीपते . . 2
text_mt: And likewise the sages, having heard in full the characteristics of women / and their conduct, went to their respective seats, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ lakṣaṇasampannāṃ bhāryāṃ prāpya mahīpate .
kartavyaṃ yadgṛhasthena tadidānīṃ nibodha me . . 3
meaning:
इत्थं लक्षणसम्पन्नां भार्यां प्राप्य महीपते .
कर्तव्यं यद्गृहस्थेन तदिदानीं निबोध मे . . 3
text_mt: Having obtained a wife endowed with such characteristics, O king, / learn now from me what the householder must do.

sanskrit_iast:
baivāhikāgnau kurvīta gṛhyaṃ karma yathāvidhi .
pañcayajñavidhānaṃ tu paktiṃ kuryātsadā gṛhī . .4
meaning:
बैवाहिकाग्नौ कुर्वीत गृह्यं कर्म यथाविधि .
पञ्चयज्ञविधानं तु पक्तिं कुर्यात्सदा गृही . .4
text_mt: In the nuptial fire he should perform the domestic ritual according to rule, / and the householder should constantly cook according to the rule of the five sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
pañca sūnā gṛhasthasya tena svargaṃ na gacchati .
kaṇḍanī peṣaṇī cullī udakumbhīḥ pramārjanī . . 5
meaning:
पञ्च सूना गृहस्थस्य तेन स्वर्गं न गच्छति .
कण्डनी पेषणी चुल्ली उदकुम्भीः प्रमार्जनी . . 5
text_mt: The householder has five slaughterhouses, by which he does not go to heaven: / the pestle, the grindstone, the hearth, the water pot, and the broom.

sanskrit_iast:
āsāṃ krameṇa sarvāsāṃ viśuddhyarthaṃ manīṣibhiḥ .
pañcoddiṣṭā mahāyajñāḥ pratyahaṃ gṛhamedhinām . . 6
meaning:
आसां क्रमेण सर्वासां विशुद्ध्यर्थं मनीषिभिः .
पञ्चोद्दिष्टा महायज्ञाः प्रत्यहं गृहमेधिनाम् . . 6
text_mt: For the gradual purification of all of these, wise men / have prescribed five great sacrifices daily for householders:

sanskrit_iast:
adhyāpanaṃ brahmayajñaḥ pitṛyajñaśca tarpaṇam .
homo daivo balirbhaumastathānyo'tithipūjanam . .7
meaning:
अध्यापनं ब्रह्मयज्ञः पितृयज्ञश्च तर्पणम् .
होमो दैवो बलिर्भौमस्तथान्योऽतिथिपूजनम् . .7
text_mt: teaching is the sacrifice to Brahman, libation is the sacrifice to the ancestors, / oblation into the fire is to the gods, an offering cast on the ground is to the beings, and the other is honouring guests.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcaitānyo mahāyajñānna hāpayati śaktitaḥ .
sa gṛhe'pi vasannityaṃ sūnodorṣairna lipyate . . 8
meaning:
पञ्चैतान्यो महायज्ञान्न हापयति शक्तितः .
स गृहेऽपि वसन्नित्यं सूनोदोर्षैर्न लिप्यते . . 8
text_mt: He who does not neglect these five great sacrifices according to his capacity / is not tainted by the faults of the slaughterhouses, even though constantly dwelling in a house.

sanskrit_iast:
devatātithibhṛtyānāṃ pitṝṇāmātmanaśca yaḥ .
na nirvapati pañcānāmucchvasanna ca jīvati . . 9
meaning:
देवतातिथिभृत्यानां पितॄणामात्मनश्च यः .
न निर्वपति पञ्चानामुच्छ्वसन्न च जीवति . . 9
text_mt: He who does not offer [portions] to these five— / to the deities, guests, servants, ancestors, and himself—breathes, but does not live.

sanskrit_iast:
śatānīka uvāca
yasya nāsti gṛhe tvagniḥ sa mṛto nātra saṃśayaḥ .
na sa pūjayituṃ śakto devādīnbrāhmaṇottamaḥ . . 1.16.10
meaning:
शतानीक उवाच
यस्य नास्ति गृहे त्वग्निः स मृतो नात्र संशयः .
न स पूजयितुं शक्तो देवादीन्ब्राह्मणोत्तमः . . 1.16.10
text_mt: Śatānīka said: / He in whose house there is no fire is dead, there is no doubt of this; / he is not capable of worshipping the gods and other beings, O best of brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
niragnikasya viprasya kathaṃ devādayo dvija. .
prītāḥ syuḥ śāntaye tasya paraṃ kautūhalaṃ mama . . 11
meaning:
निरग्निकस्य विप्रस्य कथं देवादयो द्विज. .
प्रीताः स्युः शान्तये तस्य परं कौतूहलं मम . . 11
text_mt: How can the gods and other beings be pleased with a brahmin without a fire / for his welfare, O twice-born? Great is my curiosity.

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
sādhu pṛṣṭo'smi rājendra śrūyatāṃ paramaṃ vacaḥ.
anagnayastu ye viprāsteṣāṃ śreyo'bhidhīyate . . 12
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
साधु पृष्टोऽस्मि राजेन्द्र श्रूयतां परमं वचः.
अनग्नयस्तु ये विप्रास्तेषां श्रेयोऽभिधीयते . . 12
text_mt: Sumantu said: / I am well questioned, O king of kings; listen to the supreme teaching. / The welfare of those brahmins who are without fires is explained [here].

sanskrit_iast:
vratopavāsaniyamairnānādānaistathā 1 nṛpa .
devādayo bhavantyeva prītāsteṣāṃ na saṃśayaḥ . . 13
meaning:
व्रतोपवासनियमैर्नानादानैस्तथा 1 नृप .
देवादयो भवन्त्येव प्रीतास्तेषां न संशयः . . 13
text_mt: By observances, fasts, and restraints, and likewise by various gifts, O king, / the gods and other beings indeed become pleased with them, of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣādupavāsena tithau kila mahīpate .
prītā devādayasteṣāṃ bhavanti kurunandana . . 14
meaning:
विशेषादुपवासेन तिथौ किल महीपते .
प्रीता देवादयस्तेषां भवन्ति कुरुनन्दन . . 14
text_mt: Especially through fasting on a lunar day, O king, / the gods and other beings become pleased with them, O delight of the Kurus.

sanskrit_iast:
śatānīka uvāca
bhagavaṃstvaṃ tithīnbrūhi tithīnāṃ ca vidhiṃ hi me .
prāśanaṃ gṛhyadharmāṃśca upavāsavidhīnapi . . 15
meaning:
शतानीक उवाच
भगवंस्त्वं तिथीन्ब्रूहि तिथीनां च विधिं हि मे .
प्राशनं गृह्यधर्मांश्च उपवासविधीनपि . . 15
text_mt: Śatānīka said: / O venerable one, tell me the lunar days and the rule for the lunar days, / the consumption of foods, domestic duties, and also the rules of fasting,

sanskrit_iast:
mucyema yena pāpaughāttvatprasāddvijottama .
saṃsārāccāpi viprendra śreyase jagatastathā . . 16
meaning:
मुच्येम येन पापौघात्त्वत्प्रसाद्द्विजोत्तम .
संसाराच्चापि विप्रेन्द्र श्रेयसे जगतस्तथा . . 16
text_mt: by which we may be freed from the flood of sins through your grace, O best of the twice-born, / and from transmigration, O chief of brahmins, and also for the welfare of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
śṛṇu kaurava karmāṇi tithiguhyāśritāni tu .
śrutāni ghnanti pāpāni upoṣitaphalāni ca . . 17
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
शृणु कौरव कर्माणि तिथिगुह्याश्रितानि तु .
श्रुतानि घ्नन्ति पापानि उपोषितफलानि च . . 17
text_mt: Sumantu said: / Listen, O Kaurava, to the actions dependent on the secrets of the lunar days, / which, when heard, destroy sins, as well as the fruits of fasting.

sanskrit_iast:
pratipadi kṣīraprāśanaṃ dvitīyāyāṃ lavaṇavarjanam .
tṛtīyāyāṃ tilānnaṃ prāśnīyāccaturthyāṃ kṣīrāśanaśca pañcamyām . .
phalāśanaḥ sadā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śākāśanaḥ saptamyāṃ bilvāhāroṣṭamyāṃ tu . . 18
meaning:
प्रतिपदि क्षीरप्राशनं द्वितीयायां लवणवर्जनम् .
तृतीयायां तिलान्नं प्राश्नीयाच्चतुर्थ्यां क्षीराशनश्च पञ्चम्याम् . .
फलाशनः सदा षष्ठ्यां शाकाशनः सप्तम्यां बिल्वाहारोष्टम्यां तु . . 18
text_mt: On the first lunar day, consumption of milk; on the second, abstention from salt; / on the third, one should consume sesamum-rice; on the fourth and fifth, eating milk; / on the sixth, always eating fruit; on the seventh, eating vegetables; on the eighth, an intake of bilva fruit;

sanskrit_iast:
piṣṭāśano navamyāmanagnipākāhāro daśamyāmekādaśyāṃ ghṛtāhāro dvādaśyāṃ pāyasāhāraḥ .
trayodaśyāṃ gomūtrāhāraścaturdaśyāṃ yavānnāhāraḥ . . 19
meaning:
पिष्टाशनो नवम्यामनग्निपाकाहारो दशम्यामेकादश्यां घृताहारो द्वादश्यां पायसाहारः .
त्रयोदश्यां गोमूत्राहारश्चतुर्दश्यां यवान्नाहारः . . 19
text_mt: on the ninth, eating flour; on the tenth, eating food uncooked by fire; on the eleventh, eating ghee; on the twelfth, eating milk rice; / on the thirteenth, consuming cow urine; on the fourteenth, eating barley food;

sanskrit_iast:
kuśodakaprāśanaḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ haviṣyāhāro'māvāsyāyām .
eṣa prāśanavidhistithīnāmeva cānena vidhinā pakṣamekaṃ yo vartayati . . 1.16.20
meaning:
कुशोदकप्राशनः पौर्णमास्यां हविष्याहारोऽमावास्यायाम् .
एष प्राशनविधिस्तिथीनामेव चानेन विधिना पक्षमेकं यो वर्तयति . . 1.16.20
text_mt: on the full moon, drinking kuśa water; on the new moon, eating sacrificial food. / This is the rule of consumption for the lunar days, and he who spends a single fortnight according to this rule

sanskrit_iast:
so'śvamedhaphalaṃ daśaguṇaphalamavāpnoti .
svarge manvantarāṇi yāvatprativasati . . 21
meaning:
सोऽश्वमेधफलं दशगुणफलमवाप्नोति .
स्वर्गे मन्वन्तराणि यावत्प्रतिवसति . . 21
text_mt: attains tenfold the fruit of an horse sacrifice; / he dwells in heaven for manvantaras,

sanskrit_iast:
upagīyamānopsarogandharvairmāsatrayacatuṣṭayam .
sośvamedharājasūyānāṃ śataguṇamavāpnoti . . 22
meaning:
उपगीयमानोप्सरोगन्धर्वैर्मासत्रयचतुष्टयम् .
सोश्वमेधराजसूयानां शतगुणमवाप्नोति . . 22
text_mt: celebrated in song by apsarases and gandharvas. [If he maintains this] for three or four months, / he attains a hundred times the fruit of the horse sacrifice and the royal consecration.

sanskrit_iast:
svarge upagīyamānopsarogandharvaiścaturyugānāṃ daśaśatīryāvatprativasati .
tathāṣṭamāsapāraṇe rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ sahasraguṇaphalamavāpnoti . . 23
meaning:
स्वर्गे उपगीयमानोप्सरोगन्धर्वैश्चतुर्युगानां दशशतीर्यावत्प्रतिवसति .
तथाष्टमासपारणे राजसूयाश्वमेधाभ्यां सहस्रगुणफलमवाप्नोति . . 23
text_mt: Celebrated in song in heaven by apsarases and gandharvas, he dwells there for a thousand four-age cycles; / and by breaking his fast after eight months, he attains a thousand times the fruit of the royal consecration and the horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
svarge caturdaśa manvatarāṇi yāvatprativasati .
upagīyamānopsarogandharvairya evaṃ niyamamāsthāya varṣamekaṃ vartayati . . 24
meaning:
स्वर्गे चतुर्दश मन्वतराणि यावत्प्रतिवसति .
उपगीयमानोप्सरोगन्धर्वैर्य एवं नियममास्थाय वर्षमेकं वर्तयति . . 24
text_mt: He dwells in heaven for fourteen manvantaras, / celebrated in song by apsarases and gandharvas. He who, undertaking such a restraint, spends one year

sanskrit_iast: sa saviturloke kālaṃ manvantaraṃ prativasati . . 25
meaning: स सवितुर्लोके कालं मन्वन्तरं प्रतिवसति . . 25
text_mt: dwells in the world of the sun for the period of a manvantara.

sanskrit_iast: ya evaṃ niyamānrājannāśvayujanavamyāṃ māghamāsasya saptamyāṃ vaiśākhatṛtīyāyāṃ kārtikapaurṇamāsyāṃ tithivratāni gṛdṛṇāti brahmacārī gṛhastho vanastho nārī naro vā śūdraḥ prayatamānasaḥ dīrghāyuṣyaṃ savituḥ sālokyaṃ vrajati..26
meaning: य एवं नियमान्राजन्नाश्वयुजनवम्यां माघमासस्य सप्तम्यां वैशाखतृतीयायां कार्तिकपौर्णमास्यां तिथिव्रतानि गृदृणाति ब्रह्मचारी गृहस्थो वनस्थो नारी नरो वा शूद्रः प्रयतमानसः दीर्घायुष्यं सवितुः सालोक्यं व्रजति..26
text_mt: Whoever, with subdued mind, undertakes these observances of the lunar days in this way, O king—on the ninth of Āśvayuja, the seventh of the month of Māgha, the third of Vaiśākha, and the full moon of Kārttika—whether a student of the Veda, a householder, a forest-dweller, a woman, a man, or a śūdra, attains long life and reaches the world of the sun.

sanskrit_iast: yaiścāpi purā rājannanena vidhinā etāsu tithiṣvanyajanmāntare upavāsavidhiḥ kṛtaḥ dānāni dattāni vividhaprakārāṇi brāhmaṇānāṃ tapasvijaneṣu vā . . 27
meaning: यैश्चापि पुरा राजन्ननेन विधिना एतासु तिथिष्वन्यजन्मान्तरे उपवासविधिः कृतः दानानि दत्तानि विविधप्रकाराणि ब्राह्मणानां तपस्विजनेषु वा . . 27
text_mt: And by those by whom in former times, O king, according to this rule, the rite of fasting was performed on these lunar days in another birth, and various kinds of gifts were given to brahmins or among ascetics,

sanskrit_iast: trirātropavāsināṃ tīrthayātrātapogurumātāpitṛśuśrūśāniratānāṃ teṣāṃ svargādibhogavāsanādihāgatānāṃ phalaniṣpatticihnāni manuṣyaloke pratyakṣata eva dṛśyante . . 28
meaning: त्रिरात्रोपवासिनां तीर्थयात्रातपोगुरुमातापितृशुश्रूशानिरतानां तेषां स्वर्गादिभोगवासनादिहागतानां फलनिष्पत्तिचिह्नानि मनुष्यलोके प्रत्यक्षत एव दृश्यन्ते . . 28
text_mt: or who fasted for three nights, being devoted to pilgrimages to sacred places, austerities, and service to their guru, mother, and father—for them, having arrived here after enjoying heaven and other realms, the marks of the accomplishment of fruits are visibly seen in the human world:

sanskrit_iast: hastyaśvayānayugyadhanaratnakanakahiraṇyakaṭakakeyūragraiveyakakaṭisūtrakarṇālaṅkāramukuṭavaravastravaranārī-varavilepanasurūpaguṇadīrghāyuṣo vigatādhivyādhayo dānopavāsaratānāṃ phalānyetāni nṛtyagīta-vāditramaṅgalapāṭhakaśabdairihādyāpi puṇyakṛto bodhyamānā dṛśyanta iti . . 29
meaning: हस्त्यश्वयानयुग्यधनरत्नकनकहिरण्यकटककेयूरग्रैवेयककटिसूत्रकर्णालङ्कारमुकुटवरवस्त्रवरनारी-वरविलेपनसुरूपगुणदीर्घायुषो विगताधिव्याधयो दानोपवासरतानां फलान्येतानि नृत्यगीत-वादित्रमङ्गलपाठकशब्दैरिहाद्यापि पुण्यकृतो बोध्यमाना दृश्यन्त इति . . 29
text_mt: elephants, horses, vehicles, draft animals, wealth, gems, gold, silver, bracelets, armlets, necklaces, waistbands, ear ornaments, diadems, excellent garments, excellent women, excellent unguents, handsome forms, virtues, long life, and freedom from mental distress and physical disease. These are the fruits of those devoted to gifts and fasts; even today those who have performed merit are seen here being awakened by the sounds of dances, songs, musical instruments, and auspicious panegyrists.

sanskrit_iast: tathākṛtopavāsā api hi dṛśyante . . 1.16.30
meaning: तथाकृतोपवासा अपि हि दृश्यन्ते . . 1.16.30
text_mt: Similarly, those who have observed fasts are indeed seen.

sanskrit_iast: tathā adattadānā akṛtapuṇyāśca pratyakṣata eva dṛśyante . . 31
meaning: तथा अदत्तदाना अकृतपुण्याश्च प्रत्यक्षत एव दृश्यन्ते . . 31
text_mt: Likewise, those who have given no gifts and performed no meritorious deeds are visibly seen:

sanskrit_iast: tadyathā kāṇakuṣṭhibadhirajaḍamūkavyaṅgā rogadāridryopasargavyādhihatāyuṣaśca dṛśyaṃte'dyāpi mānavāḥ . . 32
meaning: तद्यथा काणकुष्ठिबधिरजडमूकव्यङ्गा रोगदारिद्र्योपसर्गव्याधिहतायुषश्च दृश्यंतेऽद्यापि मानवाः . . 32
text_mt: namely, one-eyed, leprous, deaf, dull, mute, and deformed persons, struck down by disease, poverty, misfortune, illness, and a shortened lifespan—such men are seen even today.

sanskrit_iast:
śatānīka uvāca
dvijendra tithayaḥ proktāḥ samāsena tvayā budha .
vistareṇaiva me bhūyaḥ prabrūhi dvijasattama . . 33
meaning:
शतानीक उवाच
द्विजेन्द्र तिथयः प्रोक्ताः समासेन त्वया बुध .
विस्तरेणैव मे भूयः प्रब्रूहि द्विजसत्तम . . 33
text_mt: Śatānīka said: / O chief of the twice-born, the lunar days have been declared by you in brief, O wise one. / Tell me [them] once more in detail, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
rahasyaṃ yattithīnāṃ tu devānāṃ ca viceṣṭitam .
yānīṣṭāni ca devānāṃ bhojyāni niyamāstathā . . 34
meaning:
रहस्यं यत्तिथीनां तु देवानां च विचेष्टितम् .
यानीष्टानि च देवानां भोज्यानि नियमास्तथा . . 34
text_mt: The secret regarding the lunar days and the deeds of the gods, / and what foods are dear to the gods, as well as the restrictions,

sanskrit_iast:
tāni me vada dharmajña yena pūto bhavenvaham .
nirdvandvo hi yathā vipra labhe yāgaphalāni tu . . 35
meaning:
तानि मे वद धर्मज्ञ येन पूतो भवेन्वहम् .
निर्द्वन्द्वो हि यथा विप्र लभे यागफलानि तु . . 35
text_mt: tell me those, O knower of dharma, so that I may become purified; / [and tell me] how, free from dualities, O brahmin, I may obtain the fruits of sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
rahasyaṃ yattithīnāṃ ca bhojanaṃ phalameva tu .
yāvacca yena niyamo viśeṣātstrījanasya ca . . 36
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
रहस्यं यत्तिथीनां च भोजनं फलमेव तु .
यावच्च येन नियमो विशेषात्स्त्रीजनस्य च . . 36
text_mt:
Sumantu said:
The secret regarding the lunar days, the food, and the fruit, / and the extent of the restriction by which [one acts], especially for womenfolk—

sanskrit_iast:
etatte sarvamākhyāmo rahasyaṃ tannibodha me .
yanmayā noktapūrvaṃ hi kasyacitsupriyasya hi . . 37
meaning:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यामो रहस्यं तन्निबोध मे .
यन्मया नोक्तपूर्वं हि कस्यचित्सुप्रियस्य हि . . 37
text_mt: all that I shall declare to you; learn that secret from me, / which has never before been spoken by me even to anyone very dear.

sanskrit_iast:
tatte'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi yasya devasya yā tithiḥ .
devatānāṃ rahasyāni vratāni niyamāstathā . . 38
meaning:
तत्तेऽहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि यस्य देवस्य या तिथिः .
देवतानां रहस्यानि व्रतानि नियमास्तथा . . 38
text_mt: I shall explain to you which lunar day belongs to which god, / the secrets of the deities, the votive observances, and the restrictions.

sanskrit_iast:
tāñchṛṇuṣva mahābāho gadato mama nārada .
sṛṣṭiṃ pūrvaṃ vadiṣyāmi saṃkṣepeṇa tithiṃ prati . . 39
meaning:
ताञ्छृणुष्व महाबाहो गदतो मम नारद .
सृष्टिं पूर्वं वदिष्यामि संक्षेपेण तिथिं प्रति . . 39
text_mt: Hear them from me as I speak, O mighty-armed Nārada; / first I shall describe creation in brief with respect to the lunar day.

sanskrit_iast:
tamobhūtamidaṃ tvāsīdalabhyamavitarkitam .
jagadbrahmā samāgatyāsṛjadātmānamātmanā . . 1.16.40
meaning:
तमोभूतमिदं त्वासीदलभ्यमवितर्कितम् .
जगद्ब्रह्मा समागत्यासृजदात्मानमात्मना . . 1.16.40
text_mt: This [universe] was enveloped in darkness, ungraspable, and unthinkable; / Brahmā, having assembled the world, created himself by himself.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbhūtātmaiva ātmāsāvaṇḍamadhyādviniḥsṛtaḥ .
ātmanaivātmano hyaṇḍaṃ sṛṣṭvā sa vibhurāditaḥ . . 41
meaning:
संभूतात्मैव आत्मासावण्डमध्याद्विनिःसृतः .
आत्मनैवात्मनो ह्यण्डं सृष्ट्वा स विभुरादितः . . 41
text_mt: Self-originated, that self came forth from the midst of the egg; / having created the egg of his own self by himself, that all-pervading lord at the beginning,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā nārāyaṇākhyo'sau sṛṣṭiṃ kartuṃ samudyataḥ .
tābhyāṃ soṇḍakapālābhyāṃ divaṃ bhūmiṃ ca nirmame . . 42
meaning:
ब्रह्मा नारायणाख्योऽसौ सृष्टिं कर्तुं समुद्यतः .
ताभ्यां सोण्डकपालाभ्यां दिवं भूमिं च निर्ममे . . 42
text_mt: Brahmā named Nārāyaṇa, set about to fashion the creation; / out of the two halves of that egg he formed heaven and earth,

sanskrit_iast:
diśaścaivopadiśaścaiva devādīndānavāṃstathā .
tithiṃ pūrvāmimāṃ rājaṃścakārātha vibhuḥ svayam . . 43
meaning:
दिशश्चैवोपदिशश्चैव देवादीन्दानवांस्तथा .
तिथिं पूर्वामिमां राजंश्चकाराथ विभुः स्वयम् . . 43
text_mt: as well as the cardinal directions, intermediate directions, gods, and Dānavas; / then, O king, the all-pervading lord himself instituted this first lunar day.

sanskrit_iast:
tithīnāṃ pravarā yasmādbrahmaṇā samudāhṛtā .
pratipāditā pare pūrve pratipattena tūcyate . . 44
meaning:
तिथीनां प्रवरा यस्माद्ब्रह्मणा समुदाहृता .
प्रतिपादिता परे पूर्वे प्रतिपत्तेन तूच्यते . . 44
text_mt: Because it was declared by Brahmā as the foremost of lunar days, / and was established before all others, it is therefore called pratipat.

sanskrit_iast:
asmātpadāttu tithayo yasmāttvanyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ .
asyānte kathayiṣyāmi upavāsavidhiṃ param . . 45
meaning:
अस्मात्पदात्तु तिथयो यस्मात्त्वन्याः प्रकीर्तिताः .
अस्यान्ते कथयिष्यामि उपवासविधिं परम् . . 45
text_mt: Because the other lunar days are proclaimed from this foundation, / at its end I shall declare the supreme rule of fasting.

sanskrit_iast:
kārttikyāṃ māghasaptamyāṃ vaiśākhasya yugādiṣu .
niyamopavāsaṃ prathamaṃ grāhayeta vidhānavit 1 . . 46
meaning:
कार्त्तिक्यां माघसप्तम्यां वैशाखस्य युगादिषु .
नियमोपवासं प्रथमं ग्राहयेत विधानवित् 1 . . 46
text_mt: On the full moon of Kārttika, on the seventh of Māgha, and at the beginnings of the yugas in Vaiśākha, / one who knows the ritual should first undertake the fast with restrictions.

sanskrit_iast:
yāṃ tithiṃ niyamaṃ kartuṃ bhaktyā samanugacchati .
tasyāṃ tithau vidhānaṃ yattannibodha janādhipa . . 47
meaning:
यां तिथिं नियमं कर्तुं भक्त्या समनुगच्छति .
तस्यां तिथौ विधानं यत्तन्निबोध जनाधिप . . 47
text_mt: On whichever lunar day one faithfully undertakes the observance, / learn from me the ritual on that lunar day, O ruler of men.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā tu pratipadyāṃ vai gṛhṇīyānniyamaṃ nṛpa .
caturdaśyāṃ kṛtāhāraḥ saṃkalpaṃ parikalpayet . . 48
meaning:
यदा तु प्रतिपद्यां वै गृह्णीयान्नियमं नृप .
चतुर्दश्यां कृताहारः संकल्पं परिकल्पयेत् . . 48
text_mt: When one takes up the observance on the pratipat, O king, / having eaten on the fourteenth, one should make the solemn resolve.

sanskrit_iast:
amāvāsyāṃ na bhuñjīta trikālaṃ snānamācaret .
pavitro hi japennityaṃ gāyatrīṃ śirasā saha . . 49
meaning:
अमावास्यां न भुञ्जीत त्रिकालं स्नानमाचरेत् .
पवित्रो हि जपेन्नित्यं गायत्रीं शिरसा सह . . 49
text_mt: On the new moon day one must not eat; one should bathe at the three sandhyās; / purified, one should constantly recite the Gāyatrī together with its head.

sanskrit_iast:
arcayitvā prabhāte tu gandhamālyairdvijottamān .
śaktyā kṣīraṃ pradadyāttu brahmā me prīyatāṃ prabhuḥ . . 1.16.50
meaning:
अर्चयित्वा प्रभाते तु गन्धमाल्यैर्द्विजोत्तमान् .
शक्त्या क्षीरं प्रदद्यात्तु ब्रह्मा मे प्रीयतां प्रभुः . . 1.16.50
text_mt: Having worshipped the best of brahmins at dawn with perfumes and garlands, / one should give milk according to one's means, [saying,] 'May Lord Brahmā be pleased with me.'

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhuñjīta gokṣīramanena vidhinā nṛpa .
eṣa eva vidhirdṛṣṭaḥ sarvāsu tithiṣu nṛpa . . 51
meaning:
ततो भुञ्जीत गोक्षीरमनेन विधिना नृप .
एष एव विधिर्दृष्टः सर्वासु तिथिषु नृप . . 51
text_mt: Then one should consume cow's milk according to this rule, O king; / this very procedure is seen for all the lunar days, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsaragate kāle vratametatsamāpyate .
vratāṃte yatphalaṃ tasya tannibodha narādhipa . . 52
meaning:
संवत्सरगते काले व्रतमेतत्समाप्यते .
व्रतांते यत्फलं तस्य तन्निबोध नराधिप . . 52
text_mt: When a year's time has passed, this votive observance is completed; / learn the fruit obtained at the conclusion of the votive observance, O ruler of men.

sanskrit_iast:
vimuktapāpaḥ śuddhātmā divyadehasya dehinaḥ .
brahmā dadāti saṃtuṣṭo vimānamatitejasam . .
avyāhatagatiṃ divyaṃ kinnarāpsarasairyutam . . 53
meaning:
विमुक्तपापः शुद्धात्मा दिव्यदेहस्य देहिनः .
ब्रह्मा ददाति संतुष्टो विमानमतितेजसम् . .
अव्याहतगतिं दिव्यं किन्नराप्सरसैर्युतम् . . 53
text_mt: Free from sin, pure in soul, for that embodied soul endowed with a divine body, / Brahmā, well-pleased, grants a celestial chariot of supreme splendour, / whose movement is unhindered, divine, accompanied by kinnaras and apsarases.

sanskrit_iast:
ramitvā suciraṃ tatra daivataiḥ saha devavat .
iha cāgatya vipratvaṃ daśa janmānyasau labhet . . 54
meaning:
रमित्वा सुचिरं तत्र दैवतैः सह देववत् .
इह चागत्य विप्रत्वं दश जन्मान्यसौ लभेत् . . 54
text_mt: Having rejoiced there for a very long time with the gods like a god, / and having returned here, he attains brahminhood for ten births.

sanskrit_iast:
vedavedāṃgavidyaśca dīrghāyuścaiva suprabhaḥ .
bhogī dhanapatirdātā jāyate'sau kṛte yuge . . 55
meaning:
वेदवेदांगविद्यश्च दीर्घायुश्चैव सुप्रभः .
भोगी धनपतिर्दाता जायतेऽसौ कृते युगे . . 55
text_mt: Learned in the Vedas and the Vedāṅgas, long-lived, and of great splendour, / an enjoyer of pleasures, a lord of wealth, and a donor, he is born in the Kṛta Yuga.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāmitrastu rājendra brāhmaṇatvajigīṣayā .
tapaścacāra vipulaṃ santāpāya divaukasām . .
brāhmaṇatvaṃ na lebhe'sau lebhe vighnānanekaśaḥ . . 56
meaning:
विश्वामित्रस्तु राजेन्द्र ब्राह्मणत्वजिगीषया .
तपश्चचार विपुलं सन्तापाय दिवौकसाम् . .
ब्राह्मणत्वं न लेभेऽसौ लेभे विघ्नाननेकशः . . 56
text_mt: Viśvāmitra, O king of kings, desiring to attain brahminhood, / performed severe austerity to the torment of the denizens of heaven; / [yet] he did not obtain brahminhood, but obtained numerous obstacles.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu niyamātteṣāṃ tithīnāṃ pravarā tithiḥ .
upoṣitā bahuvidhā jñātvā brahmapriyāṃ tithim . . 57
meaning:
ततस्तु नियमात्तेषां तिथीनां प्रवरा तिथिः .
उपोषिता बहुविधा ज्ञात्वा ब्रह्मप्रियां तिथिम् . . 57
text_mt: Then, through the discipline of these lunar days, the foremost lunar day, / dear to Brahmā, was fasted on in diverse ways once it was understood.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dadau brahmā viśvāmitrāya dhīmate .
ihaiva tena dehena brāhmaṇatvaṃ sudurlabham . . 58
meaning:
ततो ददौ ब्रह्मा विश्वामित्राय धीमते .
इहैव तेन देहेन ब्राह्मणत्वं सुदुर्लभम् . . 58
text_mt: Then Brahmā granted to the wise Viśvāmitra, / in this very body and in this world, that brahminhood so very difficult to attain.

sanskrit_iast:
tithīnāṃ pravarā hyeṣā tithīnāmuttamā tithiḥ .
kṣatriyo vaiśyaśūdrau vā brāhmaṇatvamavāpnuyuḥ . . 59
meaning:
तिथीनां प्रवरा ह्येषा तिथीनामुत्तमा तिथिः .
क्षत्रियो वैश्यशूद्रौ वा ब्राह्मणत्वमवाप्नुयुः . . 59
text_mt: This is indeed the foremost of lunar days, the best of lunar days; / through it a kṣatriya, a vaiśya, or a śūdra may attain brahminhood.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tithiriyaṃ rājankāmadā kañjajapriyā .
sarahasyā mayā proktā yā noktā yasya kasyacit . . 1.16.60
meaning:
एवं तिथिरियं राजन्कामदा कञ्जजप्रिया .
सरहस्या मया प्रोक्ता या नोक्ता यस्य कस्यचित् . . 1.16.60
text_mt: Thus this lunar day, granter of desires and dear to the lotus-born, / has been declared by me together with its secret, which has never been told to just anyone.

sanskrit_iast:
haihayaistālajaṅghaiśca turuṣkairyavanaiḥ śakaiḥ .
upoṣitā ihātraiva brāhmaṇatvamabhīpsubhiḥ 1 . . 61
meaning:
हैहयैस्तालजङ्घैश्च तुरुष्कैर्यवनैः शकैः .
उपोषिता इहात्रैव ब्राह्मणत्वमभीप्सुभिः 1 . . 61
text_mt: It was fasted on right here by the Haihayas, Tālajaṅghas, / Turuṣkas, Yavanas, and Śakas, desiring to attain brahminhood.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣā paramā puṇyā śivā pāpaharā tathā .
paṭhitopāsitā rājañchraddhayā ca śrutā 1 tathā . . 62
meaning:
इत्येषा परमा पुण्या शिवा पापहरा तथा .
पठितोपासिता राजञ्छ्रद्धया च श्रुता 1 तथा . . 62
text_mt: Thus, this [lunar day] is supremely auspicious, benign, and sin-destroying; / recited, venerated, O king, and heard with faith,

sanskrit_iast:
māhātmyaṃ cāpi yopyasyāḥ śṛṇuyānmānavo nṛpa .
ṛddhiṃ vṛddhiṃ tathā kīrtiṃ śivaṃ cāpya divaṃ vrajet . . 63
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe śatārddhasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ brāhme parvaṇi pratipatkalpavarṇanaṃ
nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ . 16 .
meaning:
माहात्म्यं चापि योप्यस्याः शृणुयान्मानवो नृप .
ऋद्धिं वृद्धिं तथा कीर्तिं शिवं चाप्य दिवं व्रजेत् . . 63
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे शतार्द्धसाहस्र्यां संहितायां ब्राह्मे पर्वणि प्रतिपत्कल्पवर्णनं
नाम षोडशोऽध्यायः . 16 .
text_mt:
and whatever man hears its greatness, O king, / attains prosperity, growth, fame, and auspiciousness, and goes to heaven.
Thus ends the sixteenth chapter, named 'Description of the Pratipatkalpa', in the Brāhmaparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of fifty thousand verses.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śatānīka uvāca .. ..
brūhi me vista rādbrahmanpratipatkṛtyamādarāt ..
brahmapūjāvidhānaṃ ca pūjane yacca vai phalam..1..
meaning:
.. शतानीक उवाच .. ..
ब्रूहि मे विस्त राद्ब्रह्मन्प्रतिपत्कृत्यमादरात् ..
ब्रह्मपूजाविधानं च पूजने यच्च वै फलम्..1..
text_mt:
Śatānīka said:
Tell me in detail, O brahmin, with care, about the duty on the pratipat, / the ritual of worship of Brahmā, and the fruit [gained] in that worship.
title: Brahmaṇo'rcanavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
.. sumaṃturuvāca .. ..
śṛṇuṣvaikamanā rājankathayāmyeṣa śāṃtidam ..
pūrvamekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṃgame .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. सुमंतुरुवाच .. ..
शृणुष्वैकमना राजन्कथयाम्येष शांतिदम् ..
पूर्वमेकार्णवे घोरे नष्टे स्थावरजंगमे .. 2 ..
text_mt:
Sumantu said:
Listen with single-minded attention, O king; I shall relate that which brings peace. / Formerly, when the immovable and movable had perished in the terrible single ocean,

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃbhūrabhavaddevaḥ surajyeṣṭhaścaturmukhaḥ ..
sasarja lokāndevāṃśca bhūtāni vividhāni ca ..3..
meaning:
स्वयंभूरभवद्देवः सुरज्येष्ठश्चतुर्मुखः ..
ससर्ज लोकान्देवांश्च भूतानि विविधानि च ..3..
text_mt: the Self-born god, eldest of the gods, the four-faced one, appeared; / he created the worlds, the gods, and diverse beings

sanskrit_iast:
kāyena manasā vācā jaṃgamasthāvarāṇi ca ..
pitā yaḥ sarvadevānāṃ bhūtānāṃ ca pitāmahaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
कायेन मनसा वाचा जंगमस्थावराणि च ..
पिता यः सर्वदेवानां भूतानां च पितामहः .. 4 ..
text_mt: by body, mind, and speech, both movable and immovable— / he who is the father of all gods and the grandfather of beings.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādeṣa sadā pūjyo yato lokaguruḥ paraḥ ..
sṛjatyeṣa jagatkṛtsnaṃ pāti saṃharate tathā ..5..
meaning:
तस्मादेष सदा पूज्यो यतो लोकगुरुः परः ..
सृजत्येष जगत्कृत्स्नं पाति संहरते तथा ..5..
text_mt: Therefore he is ever to be worshipped, because he is the supreme teacher of the world; / he creates the entire universe, protects it, and destroys it.

sanskrit_iast:
rudro'sya manaso jāto viṣṇurjāto'sya vakṣasaḥ ..
mukhebhyaścaturo vedā vedāṃgāni ca kṛtsnaśaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
रुद्रोऽस्य मनसो जातो विष्णुर्जातोऽस्य वक्षसः ..
मुखेभ्यश्चतुरो वेदा वेदांगानि च कृत्स्नशः .. 6 ..
text_mt: Rudra was born from his mind, Viṣṇu was born from his chest, / and from his mouths the four Vedas and the Vedāṅgas in their entirety.

sanskrit_iast:
devāpsarasagaṃdharvāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ ..
pūjayaṃti sadā vīra viriṃciṃ suranāyakam ..7..
meaning:
देवाप्सरसगंधर्वाः सयक्षोरगराक्षसाः ..
पूजयंति सदा वीर विरिंचिं सुरनायकम् ..7..
text_mt: Gods, apsarases, and gandharvas, along with yakṣas, uragas, and rākṣasas, / ever worship Viriñci, the leader of the gods, O hero.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvo brahmamayo lokaḥ sarvaṃ brahmaṇi saṃsthitam..
tasmātsamarcayedbrahmanya icchecchreya ātmanaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
सर्वो ब्रह्ममयो लोकः सर्वं ब्रह्मणि संस्थितम्..
तस्मात्समर्चयेद्ब्रह्मन्य इच्छेच्छ्रेय आत्मनः .. 8 ..
text_mt: The entire world consists of Brahmā; everything is established in Brahmā; / therefore one who desires his own welfare should thoroughly worship Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
yo na pūjayate bhaktyā surajyeṣṭhaṃ sureśvaram ..
na sa nākasya rājyasya na ca mokṣasya bhājanam .. 9 ..
meaning:
यो न पूजयते भक्त्या सुरज्येष्ठं सुरेश्वरम् ..
न स नाकस्य राज्यस्य न च मोक्षस्य भाजनम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Whoever does not worship the eldest of gods, the lord of gods, with devotion, / is not fit for heaven, for sovereignty, nor for liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu pūjayate bhaktyā viriṃciṃ bhuvaneśvaram ..
sa nākarājyamokṣeṣu kṣipraṃ bhavati bhājanam .. 1.17.10 ..
meaning:
यस्तु पूजयते भक्त्या विरिंचिं भुवनेश्वरम् ..
स नाकराज्यमोक्षेषु क्षिप्रं भवति भाजनम् .. 1.17.10 ..
text_mt: But whoever worships Viriñci, the lord of the worlds, with devotion, / swiftly becomes fit for heaven, sovereignty, and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsaumyamanā bhūtvā yāvajjīvaṃ pratijñayā ..
arcayitvā sadā devamāpannopi naro nṛpa .. 11 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्सौम्यमना भूत्वा यावज्जीवं प्रतिज्ञया ..
अर्चयित्वा सदा देवमापन्नोपि नरो नृप .. 11 ..
text_mt: Therefore, having become gentle-minded, with a lifelong vow, / ever worshipping the god even when fallen into misfortune, O man, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ dehaparityāgo varaṃ narakasambhavaḥ ..
na tvevāpūjya bhuṃjaṃti devaṃ vai padmasaṃbhavam .. 12 ..
meaning:
वरं देहपरित्यागो वरं नरकसम्भवः ..
न त्वेवापूज्य भुंजंति देवं वै पद्मसंभवम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: better is abandoning the body, better is birth in hell, / than that people eat without having worshipped the lotus-born god.

sanskrit_iast:
sadā pūjayate yastu vīra bhaktyā pitāmaham ..
manuṣyacarmaṇā naddhaḥ sa vedhā nātra saṃśayaḥ..13..
meaning:
सदा पूजयते यस्तु वीर भक्त्या पितामहम् ..
मनुष्यचर्मणा नद्धः स वेधा नात्र संशयः..13..
text_mt: The man who always worships the Grandfather with devotion, O hero, / is Brahmā himself covered in human skin; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
na hi vedho'rcanātkiṃcitpuṇyamabhyadhikaṃ bhavet ..
iti vijñāya yatnena pūjanī yaḥ sadā vidhiḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
न हि वेधोऽर्चनात्किंचित्पुण्यमभ्यधिकं भवेत् ..
इति विज्ञाय यत्नेन पूजनी यः सदा विधिः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Indeed, no religious merit can be greater than worship of Brahmā; / knowing this, Brahmā should always be worshipped with effort.

sanskrit_iast:
yo brahmāṇaṃ dveṣṭi mohātsarvadevanamaskṛtam ..
naro narakagāmī syāttasya saṃbhāṣaṇādapi .. 15 ..
meaning:
यो ब्रह्माणं द्वेष्टि मोहात्सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम् ..
नरो नरकगामी स्यात्तस्य संभाषणादपि .. 15 ..
text_mt: A man who hates Brahmā, who is bowed to by all the gods, out of delusion, / goes to hell even from merely speaking with him.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇorcāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya sarvayatnairvidhānataḥ ..
yatpuṇyaṃ phalamāpnoti tadekāgramanāḥ śṛṇu .. 16 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मणोर्चां प्रतिष्ठाप्य सर्वयत्नैर्विधानतः ..
यत्पुण्यं फलमाप्नोति तदेकाग्रमनाः शृणु .. 16 ..
text_mt: Having consecrated an image of Brahmā with every effort according to the ritual rules, / hear with single-minded attention the meritorious fruit he attains:

sanskrit_iast:
sarvayajñatapodānatīrthavedeṣu yatphalam ..
tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ labhedvedhaḥ pratiṣṭhayā .. 17 ..
meaning:
सर्वयज्ञतपोदानतीर्थवेदेषु यत्फलम् ..
तत्फलं कोटिगुणितं लभेद्वेधः प्रतिष्ठया .. 17 ..
text_mt: Whatever fruit is found in all sacrifices, austerities, gifts, holy places, and Vedas, / he gains that fruit multiplied a crore of times by establishing Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
kañjajaṃ sthāpayedyastu kṛtvā śālāṃ manoramām ..
sarvāṃgamodita puṇyaṃ koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ labhet .. 18 ..
meaning:
कञ्जजं स्थापयेद्यस्तु कृत्वा शालां मनोरमाम् ..
सर्वांगमोदित पुण्यं कोटिकोटिगुणं लभेत् .. 18 ..
text_mt: He who sets up the Lotus-Born [Brahmā] after constructing a delightful hall / obtains merit that brings joy to all limbs, multiplied a crore of crores.

sanskrit_iast:
mātṛjānpitṛjāṃścaiva yāṃ caivodvahate striyam ..
kulaikaviṃśamuttārya brahmaloke mahīyate .. 19 ..
meaning:
मातृजान्पितृजांश्चैव यां चैवोद्वहते स्त्रियम् ..
कुलैकविंशमुत्तार्य ब्रह्मलोके महीयते .. 19 ..
text_mt: Saving the relatives on his mother’s side, on his father’s side, and the wife he marries— / twenty-one generations in all—he is glorified in the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktvā tu vipulānbhogānpralaye samupasthite ..
jñānayogaṃ samāsādya sa tatraiva vimucyate .. 1.17.20 ..
meaning:
भुक्त्वा तु विपुलान्भोगान्प्रलये समुपस्थिते ..
ज्ञानयोगं समासाद्य स तत्रैव विमुच्यते .. 1.17.20 ..
text_mt: Having enjoyed extensive pleasures, when the cosmic dissolution arrives, / attaining the yoga of knowledge, he is liberated right there.

sanskrit_iast:
atha vā rājyamākāṃkṣejjāyate saṃbhavāṃtare ..
saptadvīpasamudrāyāḥ kṣiteradhipatirbhavet .. 21 ..
meaning:
अथ वा राज्यमाकांक्षेज्जायते संभवांतरे ..
सप्तद्वीपसमुद्रायाः क्षितेरधिपतिर्भवेत् .. 21 ..
text_mt: Or if he should desire kingship, being born in another rebirth, / he becomes the ruler of the earth containing the seven continents and oceans.

sanskrit_iast:
trisaṃdhyaṃ yo japedbrahma kṛtvāṣṭadala paṃkajam ..
paurṇamāsyāṃ pratipadi tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 22 ..
meaning:
त्रिसंध्यं यो जपेद्ब्रह्म कृत्वाष्टदल पंकजम् ..
पौर्णमास्यां प्रतिपदि तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु .. 22 ..
text_mt: Hear the meritorious fruit of him who, having made an eight-petalled lotus, / mutters the prayer to Brahmā at the three junctures of the day on the full moon and the first day [of the fortnight]:

sanskrit_iast:
anenaiva sa dehena brahmā saṃtiṣṭhate kṣitau ..
pāpahā sarvamartyānāṃ darśanātsparśanādapi .. .. 23 ..
meaning:
अनेनैव स देहेन ब्रह्मा संतिष्ठते क्षितौ ..
पापहा सर्वमर्त्यानां दर्शनात्स्पर्शनादपि .. .. 23 ..
text_mt: In this very body he abides as Brahmā on the earth, / destroying the sins of all mortals by sight and even by touch.

sanskrit_iast:
uddhṛtya divi saṃsthāpya kulānāmekaviṃśatim ..
taiḥ kulaiḥ sahito nityaṃ modate gogato nṛpa .. 24 ..
meaning:
उद्धृत्य दिवि संस्थाप्य कुलानामेकविंशतिम् ..
तैः कुलैः सहितो नित्यं मोदते गोगतो नृप .. 24 ..
text_mt: Having delivered twenty-one generations and established them in heaven, / together with those generations he continually rejoices, having reached the realm of rays, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
apyekavāraṃ yo bhaktyā pūjayetpadma saṃbhavam ..
padmasthaṃ mūrtimaṃtaṃ vā brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati ..25..
meaning:
अप्येकवारं यो भक्त्या पूजयेत्पद्म संभवम् ..
पद्मस्थं मूर्तिमंतं वा ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति ..25..
text_mt: Even if one worships the Lotus-Born [Brahmā] with devotion once, / seated on a lotus or in an embodied form, he goes to the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyakṣayātkṣitiṃ prāpya bhavetkṣitipatirmahān ..
vedavedāṃgatattvajño brāhmaṇaścāpi jāyate.. .. 26 ..
meaning:
पुण्यक्षयात्क्षितिं प्राप्य भवेत्क्षितिपतिर्महान् ..
वेदवेदांगतत्त्वज्ञो ब्राह्मणश्चापि जायते.. .. 26 ..
text_mt: Upon the exhaustion of that merit, reaching the earth, he becomes a great king; / or he is born as a brāhmaṇa who knows the reality of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas.

sanskrit_iast:
na tattapobhiratyugrairna ca sarvairmahāmakhaiḥ ..
gacchedbrahmapuraṃ divyaṃ mukttvā bhaktiparātmakān ..27..
meaning:
न तत्तपोभिरत्युग्रैर्न च सर्वैर्महामखैः ..
गच्छेद्ब्रह्मपुरं दिव्यं मुक्त्त्वा भक्तिपरात्मकान् ..27..
text_mt: One cannot go to the divine city of Brahmā through extremely fierce austerities / nor through all great sacrifices, except for those whose souls are devoted to bhakti.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛddārveṣṭakaśailairvā yaḥ kuryādbrahmaṇo gṛham ..
triḥsaptakulasaṃyukto brahmaloke mahīyate .. 28 ..
meaning:
मृद्दार्वेष्टकशैलैर्वा यः कुर्याद्ब्रह्मणो गृहम् ..
त्रिःसप्तकुलसंयुक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते .. 28 ..
text_mt: He who builds a house for Brahmā out of clay, wood, bricks, or stones, / endowed with thrice-seven generations, is glorified in the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛnmayātkoṭiguṇitaṃ phalaṃ dārviṣṭakāmaye ..
iṣṭakādviguṇa puṇyaṃ kṛte śailamaye gṛhe .. 29 ..
meaning:
मृन्मयात्कोटिगुणितं फलं दार्विष्टकामये ..
इष्टकाद्विगुण पुण्यं कृते शैलमये गृहे .. 29 ..
text_mt: A crore times more fruit is attained from one made of wood and brick than from a clay one; / double the merit of brick is gained when a house made of stone is built.

sanskrit_iast:
krīḍamānopi yaḥ kuryācchālāṃ vai brahmaṇo nṛpa ..
brahmaloke sa labhate vimānaṃ sarvakāmikam .. 1.17.30 ..
meaning:
क्रीडमानोपि यः कुर्याच्छालां वै ब्रह्मणो नृप ..
ब्रह्मलोके स लभते विमानं सर्वकामिकम् .. 1.17.30 ..
text_mt: Even in play, O king, he who builds a hall for Brahmā / obtains a celestial chariot yielding all desires in the world of Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpamālāparikṣiptaṃ kiṃkiṇījālabhūṣitam ..
dolāvikṣepasaṃpannaṃ ghaṃṭācāmarabhūṣitam .. 31 ..
meaning:
पुष्पमालापरिक्षिप्तं किंकिणीजालभूषितम् ..
दोलाविक्षेपसंपन्नं घंटाचामरभूषितम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: encircled with garlands of flowers, adorned with a lattice of tinkling bells, / provided with swaying swings, decorated with bells and chowries,

sanskrit_iast:
muktādāmavitānena śobhitaṃ sūryasuprabham ..
apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ sarvakāmasukhapradam .. 32 ..
meaning:
मुक्तादामवितानेन शोभितं सूर्यसुप्रभम् ..
अप्सरोगणसंकीर्णं सर्वकामसुखप्रदम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: beautified with canopies of pearl strands, possessing the brilliant radiance of the sun, / crowded with hosts of apsarases, granting every desire and pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
tatroṣitvā mahābhogī krīḍamānaḥ sadā suraiḥ ..
punarāgatya lokesminrājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
तत्रोषित्वा महाभोगी क्रीडमानः सदा सुरैः ..
पुनरागत्य लोकेस्मिन्राजा भवति धार्मिकः .. 33 ..
text_mt: Dwelling there as one enjoying great pleasures, always sporting with the gods, / having returned to this world, he becomes a righteous king.

sanskrit_iast:
paśyanpariharañjantūnmṛdupūrvaṃ mahīpate ..
śanaiḥ saṃmārjanaṃ kurvaṃścāndrāyaṇaphalaṃ vrajet .. 34 ..
meaning:
पश्यन्परिहरञ्जन्तून्मृदुपूर्वं महीपते ..
शनैः संमार्जनं कुर्वंश्चान्द्रायणफलं व्रजेत् .. 34 ..
text_mt: Watching and sparing living creatures, gently, O lord of the earth, / slowly sweeping, he attains the fruit of a cāndrāyaṇa penance.

sanskrit_iast:
vastrapūtena toyena yaḥ kuryādupalepanam ..
paśyanpariharañjatūṃścāṃdrāyaṇaphalaṃ labhet .. 35 ..
meaning:
वस्त्रपूतेन तोयेन यः कुर्यादुपलेपनम् ..
पश्यन्परिहरञ्जतूंश्चांद्रायणफलं लभेत् .. 35 ..
text_mt: He who smears [the floor] with water purified by cloth, / watching and avoiding living creatures, attains the fruit of a cāndrāyaṇa penance.

sanskrit_iast:
nairaṃtaryeṇa yaḥ kuryātpakṣaṃ saṃmārjanārcanam ..
yugakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ brahmaloke mahīyate .. 36 ..
meaning:
नैरंतर्येण यः कुर्यात्पक्षं संमार्जनार्चनम् ..
युगकोटिशतं साग्रं ब्रह्मलोके महीयते .. 36 ..
text_mt: He who continuously performs sweeping and worship for a fortnight / is glorified in the world of Brahmā for more than a hundred crores of yugas.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃte sa caturvedaḥ surūpaḥ priyadarśanaḥ ..
āḍhyaḥ sarvaguṇopeto rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
तस्यांते स चतुर्वेदः सुरूपः प्रियदर्शनः ..
आढ्यः सर्वगुणोपेतो राजा भवति धार्मिकः .. 37 ..
text_mt: At the end of that, he becomes a righteous king, knowing the four Vedas, / handsome, pleasant to behold, rich, and endowed with all virtues.

sanskrit_iast:
kapaṭenāpi yaḥ kuryādbrahmaśālāṃ sumānada ..
saṃmārjanādi vai karma so'pi prāpnoti tatphalam .. 38 ..
meaning:
कपटेनापि यः कुर्याद्ब्रह्मशालां सुमानद ..
संमार्जनादि वै कर्म सोऽपि प्राप्नोति तत्फलम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: Even deceitfully, O giver of great honour, he who performs the work of sweeping and so on / in the hall of Brahmā, even he obtains that fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvaddhamaṃti saṃsāre duḥkhaśokabhayaplutāḥ ..
na bhavaṃti suraśreṣṭhe yāvadraktā mahīpate .. 39 ..
meaning:
तावद्धमंति संसारे दुःखशोकभयप्लुताः ..
न भवंति सुरश्रेष्ठे यावद्रक्ता महीपते .. 39 ..
text_mt: They wander in saṃsāra overcome with pain, grief, and fear / only as long as they are not devoted to the best of gods, O lord of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
samāsaktaṃ yathā cittaṃ jantorviṣayagocare ..
yadyevaṃ brahmaṇi nyastaṃ ko na mucyeta bandhanāt .. 1.17.40 ..
meaning:
समासक्तं यथा चित्तं जन्तोर्विषयगोचरे ..
यद्येवं ब्रह्मणि न्यस्तं को न मुच्येत बन्धनात् .. 1.17.40 ..
text_mt: Just as a creature's mind is attached to sense objects, / if it were directed in that way toward Brahmā, who would not be released from bondage?

sanskrit_iast:
khaṇḍasphuṭitasaṃskāraṃ śālāyāṃ yaḥ karoti vai ..
arāmāvasathādyeṣu labhate mauktikaṃ phalam .. 41 ..
meaning:
खण्डस्फुटितसंस्कारं शालायां यः करोति वै ..
अरामावसथाद्येषु लभते मौक्तिकं फलम् .. 41 ..
text_mt: He who performs repairs of broken and cracked parts in the hall, / in groves, rest-houses, and the like, obtains the fruit of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsti brahmasamo devo nāsti brahmasamo guruḥ ..
nāsti brahmasamaṃ jñānaṃ nāsti vedhaḥsamaṃ tapaḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
नास्ति ब्रह्मसमो देवो नास्ति ब्रह्मसमो गुरुः ..
नास्ति ब्रह्मसमं ज्ञानं नास्ति वेधःसमं तपः .. 42 ..
text_mt: There is no god equal to Brahmā; there is no guru equal to Brahmā; / there is no knowledge equal to Brahmā; there is no austerity equal to Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
pratipadyādisarveṣu divaseṣūtsaveṣu ca ..
parvakāleṣu puṇye paurṇamāsyāṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
प्रतिपद्यादिसर्वेषु दिवसेषूत्सवेषु च ..
पर्वकालेषु पुण्ये पौर्णमास्यां विशेषतः .. 43 ..
text_mt: On all days starting with the first lunar day, on festivals, / and on sacred juncture days, especially on the full moon,

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkhabheryādinirghoṣairmahadbhigeṃyasaṃyutaiḥ ..
kuryānnīrājanaṃ deve surajyeṣṭhe caturmukhe .. 44 ..
meaning:
शंखभेर्यादिनिर्घोषैर्महद्भिगेंयसंयुतैः ..
कुर्यान्नीराजनं देवे सुरज्येष्ठे चतुर्मुखे .. 44 ..
text_mt: with great sounds of conches, kettledrums, and other instruments accompanied by singing, / one should perform the waving of lamps before the god, the eldest of the gods, the four-faced one.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvatparvāṇi vidhinā kuryā nnīrājanaṃ nṛpa ..
tāvadyugasahasrāṇi brahmaloke mahīyate .. 45 ..
meaning:
यावत्पर्वाणि विधिना कुर्या न्नीराजनं नृप ..
तावद्युगसहस्राणि ब्रह्मलोके महीयते .. 45 ..
text_mt: For as many juncture days as one performs the waving of lamps according to the ritual rules, O king, / for that many thousands of yugas he is glorified in the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
snānakāle trisaṃdhyaṃ tu yaḥ kuryānnṛtyavādanam ..
gītaṃ vā mukhavādyaṃ vā tasya puṇya phalaṃ śṛṇu .. 46 ..
meaning:
स्नानकाले त्रिसंध्यं तु यः कुर्यान्नृत्यवादनम् ..
गीतं वा मुखवाद्यं वा तस्य पुण्य फलं शृणु .. 46 ..
text_mt: Hear the meritorious fruit of him who performs dance and instrumental music / or singing or mouth-music at the bath time at the three junctures of the day:

sanskrit_iast:
yāvantyahāni kurute geyanṛtyādivādanam ..
tāvadyugasahasrāṇi brahmaloke mahīyate .. 47 ..
meaning:
यावन्त्यहानि कुरुते गेयनृत्यादिवादनम् ..
तावद्युगसहस्राणि ब्रह्मलोके महीयते .. 47 ..
text_mt: For as many days as he performs singing, dance, and instrumental music, / for that many thousands of yugas he is glorified in the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
kapilāpañcagavyena kuśavāriyutena ca ..
snāpayenmaṃtrapūtena brāhmaṃ snānaṃ hi tatsmṛtam .. 48 ..
meaning:
कपिलापञ्चगव्येन कुशवारियुतेन च ..
स्नापयेन्मंत्रपूतेन ब्राह्मं स्नानं हि तत्स्मृतम् .. 48 ..
text_mt: One should bathe [him] with the five bovine products of a brown cow along with kuśa grass and water, / purified by mantras; that is recalled as the bath of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
kapilāpaṃcagavyena dadhikṣīraghṛtena ca ..
snānaṃ śataguṇaṃ jñeyamitareṣāṃ narādhipa .. 49 ..
meaning:
कपिलापंचगव्येन दधिक्षीरघृतेन च ..
स्नानं शतगुणं ज्ञेयमितरेषां नराधिप .. 49 ..
text_mt: The bath with the five bovine products of a brown cow, with curd, milk, and clarified butter, / should be known to be a hundred times superior to those of others, O ruler of men.

sanskrit_iast:
devāgnikāryamuddiśya kapilāmāharetsadā ..
brahmakṣatraviśaścaiva na śūdrastu kadācana .. 1.17.50 ..
meaning:
देवाग्निकार्यमुद्दिश्य कपिलामाहरेत्सदा ..
ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशश्चैव न शूद्रस्तु कदाचन .. 1.17.50 ..
text_mt: One should always acquire a brown cow for the purpose of the rites of the gods and fire; / brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, and vaiśyas may do so, but a śūdra never.

sanskrit_iast:
kāpilaṃ yaḥ pibecchūdro devakāryārthanirmitam ..
sa pacyeta mahāghore suciraṃ narakārṇave .. 51 ..
meaning:
कापिलं यः पिबेच्छूद्रो देवकार्यार्थनिर्मितम् ..
स पच्येत महाघोरे सुचिरं नरकार्णवे .. 51 ..
text_mt: A śūdra who drinks [the milk] of a brown cow designated for the purpose of the rites of the gods / will boil for a very long time in a terrifying ocean of hell.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣakoṭisahasraistu yatpāpaṃ samupārjitam ..
surajyeṣṭhaghṛtābhyaṃgāddahetsarvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
वर्षकोटिसहस्रैस्तु यत्पापं समुपार्जितम् ..
सुरज्येष्ठघृताभ्यंगाद्दहेत्सर्वं न संशयः .. 52 ..
text_mt: Whatever sin has been accumulated over thousands of crores of years, / from anointing the eldest of the gods with clarified butter, he burns it all, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpakoṭisahasraistu yatpāpaṃ samupārjitam ..
pitāmahaghṛtasnānaṃ dahatyagniriveṃdhanam.53..
meaning:
कल्पकोटिसहस्रैस्तु यत्पापं समुपार्जितम् ..
पितामहघृतस्नानं दहत्यग्निरिवेंधनम्.53..
text_mt: Whatever sin has been accumulated over thousands of crores of kalpas, / bathing the Grandfather with clarified butter burns it as fire burns fuel.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtasnānaṃ pratipadi sakṛtkṛtvā tu kāṃjajam ..
kulaikaviṃśamuttārya viṣṇuloke mahī yate ..54..
meaning:
घृतस्नानं प्रतिपदि सकृत्कृत्वा तु कांजजम् ..
कुलैकविंशमुत्तार्य विष्णुलोके मही यते ..54..
text_mt: Having once performed the bath with clarified butter for the Lotus-Born [Brahmā] on the first lunar day, / having delivered twenty-one generations, he is glorified in the world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
ayutaṃ yo gavāṃ dadyādbhaktyā vai vedapārage ..
vastrahemādiyuktānāṃ kṣīrasnānena yatphalam ..55..
meaning:
अयुतं यो गवां दद्याद्भक्त्या वै वेदपारगे ..
वस्त्रहेमादियुक्तानां क्षीरस्नानेन यत्फलम् ..55..
text_mt: The fruit that one obtains who gives ten thousand cows with devotion to a master of the Vedas, / endowed with garments, gold, and the like, is gained by a bath with milk.

sanskrit_iast:
sakṛdājyena payasā snapayettu yaḥ ..
gāṃgeyena sa yānena yāti brahmasalokatām .. 56 ..
meaning:
सकृदाज्येन पयसा स्नपयेत्तु यः ..
गांगेयेन स यानेन याति ब्रह्मसलोकताम् .. 56 ..
text_mt: He who bathes [him] once with clarified butter and with milk / goes in a golden vehicle to dwelling in the same world as Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
snāpya dadhnā sakṛdvīra kañjajaṃ viṣṇumāpnuyāt ..
madhunā snapayitvā tu vīraloke mahīyate .. 57 ..
meaning:
स्नाप्य दध्ना सकृद्वीर कञ्जजं विष्णुमाप्नुयात् ..
मधुना स्नपयित्वा तु वीरलोके महीयते .. 57 ..
text_mt: Having bathed the Lotus-Born [Brahmā] once with curd, O hero, one attains Viṣṇu; / and having bathed [him] with honey, he is glorified in the world of heroes.

sanskrit_iast:
snānamikṣuraseneha yo viriṃceḥ samācaret ..
sa yāti lokaṃ savitastu tejasā bhāsayannabhaḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
स्नानमिक्षुरसेनेह यो विरिंचेः समाचरेत् ..
स याति लोकं सवितस्तु तेजसा भासयन्नभः .. 58 ..
text_mt: He who performs here the bathing of Viriñci with sugarcane juice / goes to the realm of Savitṛ, illuminating the firmament with his splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhodakena yo bhaktyā snāpayetpadmasaṃbhavam ..
utsṛjya pāpakalilaṃ sa yātyeva salokatām .. 59 ..
meaning:
शुद्धोदकेन यो भक्त्या स्नापयेत्पद्मसंभवम् ..
उत्सृज्य पापकलिलं स यात्येव सलोकताम् .. 59 ..
text_mt: He who bathes the Lotus-born with pure water through devotion, / casting off the stain of sin, he indeed attains companionship with him in his realm.

sanskrit_iast:
vastrapūtena toyena snapayedyaḥ sakṛdvibhum ..
sa sarvakālaṃ tṛptātmā lokavaśyatvamā pnuyāt .. 1.17.60 ..
meaning:
वस्त्रपूतेन तोयेन स्नपयेद्यः सकृद्विभुम् ..
स सर्वकालं तृप्तात्मा लोकवश्यत्वमा प्नुयात् .. 1.17.60 ..
text_mt: He who bathes the all-pervading Lord even once with water purified by cloth, / having his soul ever satisfied, attains mastery over the world.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvauṣadhībhiryo bhaktyā snapayetpadmasaṃbhavam ..
kāṃcanena vimānena brahmaloke mahīyate .. 61 ..
meaning:
सर्वौषधीभिर्यो भक्त्या स्नपयेत्पद्मसंभवम् ..
कांचनेन विमानेन ब्रह्मलोके महीयते .. 61 ..
text_mt: He who bathes the Lotus-born through devotion with all medicinal herbs / is honoured in the realm of Brahmā by means of a golden celestial chariot.

sanskrit_iast:
gandhacandanatoyena snāpayedyoṃbujodbhavam ..
rudralokamavāpnoti tejasā hemasannibhaḥ .. 62 ..
meaning:
गन्धचन्दनतोयेन स्नापयेद्योंबुजोद्भवम् ..
रुद्रलोकमवाप्नोति तेजसा हेमसन्निभः .. 62 ..
text_mt: He who bathes the Lotus-born with water [scented with] perfume and sandalwood / attains the realm of Rudra, resembling gold in splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
pāṭalotpalapadmāni karavīrāṇi sarvadā ..
snānakāle prayojyāni sthirāṇi surabhīṇi ca .. 63 ..
meaning:
पाटलोत्पलपद्मानि करवीराणि सर्वदा ..
स्नानकाले प्रयोज्यानि स्थिराणि सुरभीणि च .. 63 ..
text_mt: Pāṭala blossoms, blue water-lilies, lotuses, and oleanders, / enduring and fragrant, should always be employed at the time of bathing.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣāmekatamaṃ snānaṃ bhaktyā kṛtvā tu vedhasi ..
vidhūya pāpakalilaṃ vidhiloke mahīyate .. 64 ..
meaning:
एषामेकतमं स्नानं भक्त्या कृत्वा तु वेधसि ..
विधूय पापकलिलं विधिलोके महीयते .. 64 ..
text_mt: Having performed even one of these baths for the Creator with devotion, / shaking off the stain of sin, one is honoured in the realm of the Creator.

sanskrit_iast:
karpūrāgarutoyena snapayedyastu kañjajam ..
sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā brahmaloke mahīyate .. 65 ..
meaning:
कर्पूरागरुतोयेन स्नपयेद्यस्तु कञ्जजम् ..
सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा ब्रह्मलोके महीयते .. 65 ..
text_mt: He who bathes the Lotus-born with water [scented with] camphor and agallochum, / his soul purified of all sins, is honoured in the realm of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatrīśatajaptena vimalenāṃbhasā vibhum ..
snapayitvā sakṛdbhaktyā brahmalokamavā pnuyāt .. 66 ..
meaning:
गायत्रीशतजप्तेन विमलेनांभसा विभुम् ..
स्नपयित्वा सकृद्भक्त्या ब्रह्मलोकमवा प्नुयात् .. 66 ..
text_mt: Having bathed the all-pervading Lord once through devotion with pure water / over which the Gāyatrī has been recited a hundred times, one attains the realm of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
vibhuṃ śītāṃbunā snāpya dhāroṣṇapayasā tataḥ ..
tataḥ paścād ghṛtasnānaṃ kṛtvā pāpairvimucyate .. 67 ..
meaning:
विभुं शीतांबुना स्नाप्य धारोष्णपयसा ततः ..
ततः पश्चाद् घृतस्नानं कृत्वा पापैर्विमुच्यते .. 67 ..
text_mt: Having bathed the all-pervading Lord with cold water, then with warm milk fresh from the udder, / and after that having performed a bath with clarified butter, one is freed from sins.

sanskrit_iast:
etatsnānatrayaṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā tu bhaktitaḥ ..
aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 68 ..
meaning:
एतत्स्नानत्रयं कृत्वा पूजयित्वा तु भक्तितः ..
अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः .. 68 ..
text_mt: Having performed this threefold bath and worshipped him with devotion, / a man obtains the fruit of a thousand horse sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtkuṃbhaistāmrajaiḥ kuṃbhaiḥ snānaṃ śataguṇaṃ bhavet ..
raupye lakṣottaraṃ proktaṃ haimaiḥ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet .. 69 ..
meaning:
मृत्कुंभैस्ताम्रजैः कुंभैः स्नानं शतगुणं भवेत् ..
रौप्ये लक्षोत्तरं प्रोक्तं हैमैः कोटिगुणं भवेत् .. 69 ..
text_mt: With pots made of copper rather than earthen pots, the bath yields a hundredfold [fruit]; / in a silver [pot] it is declared to be a hundred thousand times more, and with golden ones it becomes ten million times as much.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇo darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ darśanātsparśanaṃ param ..
sparśanādarcanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ghṛtasnātamataḥ param .. 1.17.70 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मणो दर्शनं पुण्यं दर्शनात्स्पर्शनं परम् ..
स्पर्शनादर्चनं श्रेष्ठं घृतस्नातमतः परम् .. 1.17.70 ..
text_mt: The sight of Brahmā is meritorious; touch is superior to sight; / worship is better than touch; superior even to that is [the sight of] him bathed in clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ ghṛtasnānena dehinām ..
kṣiṇute padmajo yasmāttasmātsnānaṃ samācaret .. 71 ..
meaning:
वाचिकं मानसं पापं घृतस्नानेन देहिनाम् ..
क्षिणुते पद्मजो यस्मात्तस्मात्स्नानं समाचरेत् .. 71 ..
text_mt: Since the Lotus-born destroys the vocal and mental sin / of embodied beings through the bath of clarified butter, therefore one should perform that bath.

sanskrit_iast:
snapayitvārcayedbhaktyā yathā tacchṛṇu bhārata ..
śucivastradharaḥ snātaḥ kṛtanyāsaśca bhārata .. 72 ..
meaning:
स्नपयित्वार्चयेद्भक्त्या यथा तच्छृणु भारत ..
शुचिवस्त्रधरः स्नातः कृतन्यासश्च भारत .. 72 ..
text_mt: Having bathed him, how one should worship him with devotion—hear that, O descendant of Bharata: / wearing clean garments, having bathed, and having performed the placement of mantras, O descendant of Bharata,

sanskrit_iast:
caturhastaṃ likhetpadmaṃ caturbhāgavibhāgitam ..
madhye tasya likheccakraṃ dalairdvādaśabhiścitam .. 73 ..
meaning:
चतुर्हस्तं लिखेत्पद्मं चतुर्भागविभागितम् ..
मध्ये तस्य लिखेच्चक्रं दलैर्द्वादशभिश्चितम् .. 73 ..
text_mt: one should draw a four-cubit lotus divided into four parts; / in its centre one should draw a wheel adorned with twelve petals.

sanskrit_iast:
sarojāni tato nyasya akṣarāṇi samantataḥ ..
akṣaraṃ vihitaṃ cānyatpatrabhāge prakīrtitam .. 74 ..
meaning:
सरोजानि ततो न्यस्य अक्षराणि समन्ततः ..
अक्षरं विहितं चान्यत्पत्रभागे प्रकीर्तितम् .. 74 ..
text_mt: Then, having placed lotuses, [one deposits] syllables all around; / and another syllable is prescribed and taught on the petal-portion.

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvarṇakasaṃyogāllikheccaivānupūrvaśaḥ ..
kṛṣṇotkaṭaṃ tu madhyaṃ syātpītaraktaṃ tathā param .. 75 ..
meaning:
नानावर्णकसंयोगाल्लिखेच्चैवानुपूर्वशः ..
कृष्णोत्कटं तु मध्यं स्यात्पीतरक्तं तथा परम् .. 75 ..
text_mt: One should draw it successively with a combination of various colours: / the centre should be predominantly black, and the outer part yellow and red.

sanskrit_iast:
sitaṃ śuddhaṃ tu karttavyaṃ madhyabhāge tu vartulam ..
prabhākuṇḍalakairbāhyairveṣṭayeccakranāyakam ..76..
meaning:
सितं शुद्धं तु कर्त्तव्यं मध्यभागे तु वर्तुलम् ..
प्रभाकुण्डलकैर्बाह्यैर्वेष्टयेच्चक्रनायकम् ..76..
text_mt: In the central part a pure white circle should be made; / one should surround the lord of wheels with outer circles of radiance.

sanskrit_iast:
evamālikhya yatnena mūlamantraṃ tato nyaset ..
mūrdhnaḥ pādatalaṃ yāvatpraṇavaṃ vinyasedbudhaḥ .. 77 ..
meaning:
एवमालिख्य यत्नेन मूलमन्त्रं ततो न्यसेत् ..
मूर्ध्नः पादतलं यावत्प्रणवं विन्यसेद्बुधः .. 77 ..
