text_mt: Having drawn it thus with care, the wise man should then place the root mantra; / he should deposit the Praṇava from the crown of the head down to the soles of the feet.

sanskrit_iast:
nādarūpaṃ nyasettāvadyāvacchabdasya śūnyatā ..
tatkāraṃ vinyasenmūrdhni sakāraṃ mukhamaṇḍale .. 78 ..
meaning:
नादरूपं न्यसेत्तावद्यावच्छब्दस्य शून्यता ..
तत्कारं विन्यसेन्मूर्ध्नि सकारं मुखमण्डले .. 78 ..
text_mt: He should deposit it in the form of sound until the silence of the sound [is reached]. / He should place the syllable 'tat' on the crown of the head, and the syllable 'sa' on the circle of the face,

sanskrit_iast:
vikāraṃ kaṇṭhadeśe tu tukāraṃ sarvasaṃdhiṣu ..
vakāraṃ hṛdi madhye tu rekāraṃ pārśvayordvayoḥ .. 79 ..
meaning:
विकारं कण्ठदेशे तु तुकारं सर्वसंधिषु ..
वकारं हृदि मध्ये तु रेकारं पार्श्वयोर्द्वयोः .. 79 ..
text_mt: the syllable 'vi' in the throat region, and the syllable 'tu' in all the joints; / the syllable 'va' in the middle of the heart, and the syllable 're' on the two flanks;

sanskrit_iast:
ṇakāraṃ dakṣiṇe kukṣau yakāraṃ vāmasaṃjñake ..
bhakāraṃ kaṭinābhisthaṃ rgokāraṃ jānuparvasu .. 1.17.80 ..
meaning:
णकारं दक्षिणे कुक्षौ यकारं वामसंज्ञके ..
भकारं कटिनाभिस्थं र्गोकारं जानुपर्वसु .. 1.17.80 ..
text_mt: the syllable 'ṇa' in the right side of the belly, and the syllable 'ya' in that known as the left; / the syllable 'bha' situated at the waist and navel, and the syllable 'rgo' in the joints of the knees;

sanskrit_iast:
dekāraṃ jaṃghayornyasya vakāraṃ pādapadmayoḥ ..
syakāramaṃguṣṭhayornyasya dhīkāraṃ corasi nyaset .. 81 ..
meaning:
देकारं जंघयोर्न्यस्य वकारं पादपद्मयोः ..
स्यकारमंगुष्ठयोर्न्यस्य धीकारं चोरसि न्यसेत् .. 81 ..
text_mt: having placed the syllable 'de' on the two shanks, and the syllable 'va' on the two lotus-feet; / having placed the syllable 'sya' on the two thumbs, he should place the syllable 'dhī' on the chest;

sanskrit_iast:
makāraṃ jānudeśe tu hikāraṃ guhyamāśritam ..
dhikāraṃ hṛdaye nyasya yokāraṃ cauṣṭhayo rnyaset .. 82 ..
meaning:
मकारं जानुदेशे तु हिकारं गुह्यमाश्रितम् ..
धिकारं हृदये न्यस्य योकारं चौष्ठयो र्न्यसेत् .. 82 ..
text_mt: the syllable 'ma' in the region of the knees, and the syllable 'hi' resting on the private parts; / having placed the syllable 'dhi' on the heart, he should place the syllable 'yo' on the lips;

sanskrit_iast:
nakāraṃ nāsikāgre tu prakāraṃ netramāśritam ..
cokāraṃ tu bhuvormadhye dakāraṃ prāṇamāśritam .. 83 ..
meaning:
नकारं नासिकाग्रे तु प्रकारं नेत्रमाश्रितम् ..
चोकारं तु भुवोर्मध्ये दकारं प्राणमाश्रितम् .. 83 ..
text_mt: the syllable 'na' on the tip of the nose, and the syllable 'pra' resting on the eyes; / the syllable 'co' between the eyebrows, and the syllable 'da' resting on the breath;

sanskrit_iast:
yākāraṃ vinyasenmūrdhni takāraṃ keśamāśritam ..
nyāsaṃ kṛtvātmano dehe deve kuryāttathā nṛpa ..
sarvopacārasaṃpannaṃ kṛtvā samyaṅ nirīkṣayet .. 84 ..
meaning:
याकारं विन्यसेन्मूर्ध्नि तकारं केशमाश्रितम् ..
न्यासं कृत्वात्मनो देहे देवे कुर्यात्तथा नृप ..
सर्वोपचारसंपन्नं कृत्वा सम्यङ् निरीक्षयेत् .. 84 ..
text_mt: he should place the syllable 'yā' on the crown of the head, and the syllable 'ta' resting on the hair. / Having performed the placement of mantras on his own body, he should likewise do so on the god, O king; / having rendered it complete with all rites of attendance, he should inspect it properly.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṃkumāgurukarpūra candanena vimiśritam ..
gandhatoyamupaskṛtya gāyatryā praṇavena ca ..
prokṣayetsarvadravyāṇi paścādarcanamācaret .. 85 ..
meaning:
कुंकुमागुरुकर्पूर चन्दनेन विमिश्रितम् ..
गन्धतोयमुपस्कृत्य गायत्र्या प्रणवेन च ..
प्रोक्षयेत्सर्वद्रव्याणि पश्चादर्चनमाचरेत् .. 85 ..
text_mt: Having prepared scented water mixed with saffron, agallochum, camphor, / and sandalwood, with the Gāyatrī and the Praṇava / he should sprinkle all the substances, and afterwards perform the worship.

sanskrit_iast:
cakragranthiṣu sarvāsu praṇavaṃ viniveśayet ..
bhūyaḥ plutaṃ samuccārya praṇavaṃ sarvatomukham .. 86 ..
meaning:
चक्रग्रन्थिषु सर्वासु प्रणवं विनिवेशयेत् ..
भूयः प्लुतं समुच्चार्य प्रणवं सर्वतोमुखम् .. 86 ..
text_mt: He should deposit the Praṇava at all the junctures of the wheel; / having again uttered the protractedly accented Praṇava facing in all directions,

sanskrit_iast:
vinyasetpadmamadhye tu pīṭhaniṣpattihetave ..
āsane pṛthivī jñeyā sarvasattvadharā matā .. 87 ..
meaning:
विन्यसेत्पद्ममध्ये तु पीठनिष्पत्तिहेतवे ..
आसने पृथिवी ज्ञेया सर्वसत्त्वधरा मता .. 87 ..
text_mt: he should deposit it in the centre of the lotus to establish the seat. / The earth is to be understood in the seat, considered as supporting all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
hrasvoṃkāre matā sā tu dīrghoṃkāre tu devarāṭ ..
plutastu vyāpayedbhāvaṃ mokṣadaṃ cāmṛtātmakam .. 88 ..
meaning:
ह्रस्वोंकारे मता सा तु दीर्घोंकारे तु देवराट् ..
प्लुतस्तु व्यापयेद्भावं मोक्षदं चामृतात्मकम् .. 88 ..
text_mt: She is considered to be in the short Oṃkāra, while the king of gods is in the long Oṃkāra; / and the protractedly accented [Oṃkāra] pervades the state that grants liberation and consists of nectar.

sanskrit_iast:
yatnastho na nivarteta yogī prāṇaparāyaṇaḥ ..
āvāhanaṃ tataḥ kuryādakṣareṇa pareṇa tu .. 89 ..
meaning:
यत्नस्थो न निवर्तेत योगी प्राणपरायणः ..
आवाहनं ततः कुर्यादक्षरेण परेण तु .. 89 ..
text_mt: Standing steadfast in exertion, the yogin devoted to the vital breaths should not turn back. / Then he should perform the invocation with the supreme syllable.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhya tejorūpaṃ tu nyasenmantravarāṃstataḥ ..
tato vibhāvayeddevaṃ padmasthaṃ caturānanam..1.17.90..
meaning:
आवाह्य तेजोरूपं तु न्यसेन्मन्त्रवरांस्ततः ..
ततो विभावयेद्देवं पद्मस्थं चतुराननम्..1.17.90..
text_mt: Having invoked him in the form of splendour, he should then deposit the excellent mantras; / then he should meditate upon the four-faced god seated upon the lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
sraṣṭāraṃ sarvajagatāṃ viṣṇurudravidhānagam..
saṃbhāvya gandhapuṣpādi saṃbhārānkramātsarvānprakalpayet..
gāyatrīmuccaranmantraṃ sarvakarmāṇi kārayet..92..
meaning:
स्रष्टारं सर्वजगतां विष्णुरुद्रविधानगम्..
संभाव्य गन्धपुष्पादि संभारान्क्रमात्सर्वान्प्रकल्पयेत्..
गायत्रीमुच्चरन्मन्त्रं सर्वकर्माणि कारयेत्..92..
text_mt: the creator of all worlds, who attends to the ordainment of Viṣṇu and Rudra. / Having meditated on him, he should arrange all the requisites in order, such as scents and flowers; / uttering the Gāyatrī mantra, he should cause all the rites to be performed.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ tathā dīpaṃ naivedyaṃ sumanoharam..
khaṃḍalaḍḍukaśrīveṣṭakāsārāśokavartikāḥ..93..
meaning:
पुष्पं धूपं तथा दीपं नैवेद्यं सुमनोहरम्..
खंडलड्डुकश्रीवेष्टकासाराशोकवर्तिकाः..93..
text_mt: Flowers, incense, likewise a lamp, and very delightful food offerings: / sugar candy, laḍḍus, śrīveṣṭa pastries, kāsāra, aśokavartikās,

sanskrit_iast:
svastikollopikādugdhatilāveṣṭatilāḍhikāḥ..
phalāni caiva pakvāni lagnakhaṇḍaguḍāni ca..94..
meaning:
स्वस्तिकोल्लोपिकादुग्धतिलावेष्टतिलाढिकाः..
फलानि चैव पक्वानि लग्नखण्डगुडानि च..94..
text_mt: svastika pastries, ullopikās, milk, tilāveṣṭas, pastries rich in sesame, / and ripe fruits, along with lumps of crystallized sugar and jaggery.

sanskrit_iast:
anyāṃśca vividhāndadyātpūpāni vividhāni ca..
evamādīni sarvāṇi dāpayecachaktito nṛpa..95..
meaning:
अन्यांश्च विविधान्दद्यात्पूपानि विविधानि च..
एवमादीनि सर्वाणि दापयेचछक्तितो नृप..95..
text_mt: He should present other various cakes and different kinds of delicacies; / O king, he should cause all these and more to be offered according to his means.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlamantreṇa devasya tato dehaṃ vibhāvayet ..
pūjayeccāpi vidhinā yena taṃ te bravīmyaham .. 96 ..
meaning:
मूलमन्त्रेण देवस्य ततो देहं विभावयेत् ..
पूजयेच्चापि विधिना येन तं ते ब्रवीम्यहम् .. 96 ..
text_mt: Then with the root mantra he should meditate upon the body of the god, / and he should also worship him according to rule; I shall declare that to you.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā dehasaṃśodhanāya vai ..
āvāhayettatonantaṃ dhārayantaṃ vacaḥ sadā .. 97 ..
meaning:
प्राणायामत्रयं कृत्वा देहसंशोधनाय वै ..
आवाहयेत्ततोनन्तं धारयन्तं वचः सदा .. 97 ..
text_mt: Having performed three breath controls for the purification of the body, / he should then invoke Ananta, who ever maintains the word;

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvānantaṃ tato rudraṃ padmakiṃjalkamadhyagam ..
dhyāyedviṣṇuṃ tato devaṃ nyasetpadmodarodbhavam .. 98 ..
meaning:
ध्यात्वानन्तं ततो रुद्रं पद्मकिंजल्कमध्यगम् ..
ध्यायेद्विष्णुं ततो देवं न्यसेत्पद्मोदरोद्भवम् .. 98 ..
text_mt: having meditated on Ananta, then on Rudra situated in the middle of the filaments of the lotus, / he should then meditate on the god Viṣṇu, and should place the one born from the interior of the lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tridevatārūḍhaṃ padmamadhyeṃbujodbhavam ..
pūjayenmūlamantreṇa padmodarabhavaṃ nṛpa .. 99 ..
meaning:
एवं त्रिदेवतारूढं पद्ममध्येंबुजोद्भवम् ..
पूजयेन्मूलमन्त्रेण पद्मोदरभवं नृप .. 99 ..
text_mt: Thus, upon the Lotus-born mounted upon the three deities in the middle of the lotus, / born from the interior of the lotus, he should bestow worship with the root mantra, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛgvedaṃ tu yajurvedaṃ sāmavedaṃ ca pūjayet ..
jñānavairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ dharmaṃ saṃpūjayedbudhaḥ .. 1.17.100 ..
meaning:
ऋग्वेदं तु यजुर्वेदं सामवेदं च पूजयेत् ..
ज्ञानवैराग्यमैश्वर्यं धर्मं संपूजयेद्बुधः .. 1.17.100 ..
text_mt: The wise man should worship the Ṛgveda, the Yajurveda, and the Sāmaveda; / he should thoroughly worship wisdom, dispassion, sovereignty, and righteousness,

sanskrit_iast:
īśānādikramādrājanvidiśāsu samaṃtataḥ ..
śikṣā kalpo vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ chanda eva ca .. 101 ..
meaning:
ईशानादिक्रमाद्राजन्विदिशासु समंततः ..
शिक्षा कल्पो व्याकरणं निरुक्तं छन्द एव च .. 101 ..
text_mt: in the intermediate directions all around in order beginning with the north-east, O king: / phonetics, ritual procedure, grammar, etymology, and metrics.

sanskrit_iast:
jyotiṣaṃ ca mahābāho upavedāśca kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
itihāsapurāṇāni yathāyogyaṃ yathākramam .. 102 ..
meaning:
ज्योतिषं च महाबाहो उपवेदाश्च कृत्स्नशः ..
इतिहासपुराणानि यथायोग्यं यथाक्रमम् .. 102 ..
text_mt: And astronomy, O mighty-armed one, and all the Upavedas in their entirety, / the Itihāsas and the Purāṇas, properly and in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
śikṣā kalpo vyākaraṇaṃ devasya purataḥ sadā ..
kalpādayastataścānye diśāsu vidiśāsu ca..103..
meaning:
शिक्षा कल्पो व्याकरणं देवस्य पुरतः सदा ..
कल्पादयस्ततश्चान्ये दिशासु विदिशासु च..103..
text_mt: Phonetics, ritual, and grammar should always be placed in front of the god; / then ritual and the others, in the cardinal directions and intermediate directions.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāvyāhṛtayaḥ sarvāḥ praṇavena samanvitāḥ..
pūrvādikramayogena pūjayedvidhinā nṛpa.. 104..
meaning:
महाव्याहृतयः सर्वाः प्रणवेन समन्विताः..
पूर्वादिक्रमयोगेन पूजयेद्विधिना नृप.. 104..
text_mt: All the great vyāhṛtis joined with the praṇava / one should worship according to the rite in order starting from the east, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktayo brahmaṇastvetā lokarūpā vyavasthitāḥ..
pūjanīyāḥ prayatnena maṃtrarūpāḥ sthitāḥ svayam..105..
meaning:
शक्तयो ब्रह्मणस्त्वेता लोकरूपा व्यवस्थिताः..
पूजनीयाः प्रयत्नेन मंत्ररूपाः स्थिताः स्वयम्..105..
text_mt: These are indeed the powers of Brahmā, established in the form of the worlds; / they should be worshipped with diligence, standing by themselves in the form of mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
arakāṃtarasaṃsthāṃśca ṣaṭ samudrānsamarcayet ..
nakṣatrāṇi grahāścaiva rāśayaśca viśeṣataḥ . .
pūjyāḥ sarve yathānyāyaṃ surāgreṣu vyavasthitāḥ . . 106 ..
meaning:
अरकांतरसंस्थांश्च षट् समुद्रान्समर्चयेत् ..
नक्षत्राणि ग्रहाश्चैव राशयश्च विशेषतः . .
पूज्याः सर्वे यथान्यायं सुराग्रेषु व्यवस्थिताः . . 106 ..
text_mt: And one should worship the six oceans situated in the spaces between the spokes, / especially the constellations, the planets, and the zodiac signs. / All should be worshipped properly, positioned in front of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
nāgāśca garuḍaścaiva pūjanīyastathāgrataḥ ..
devatā ṛṣayaścaiva sahitāḥ kulaparvatāḥ ..
tattejonilayāḥ sarve pūjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ .. 107 ..
meaning:
नागाश्च गरुडश्चैव पूजनीयस्तथाग्रतः ..
देवता ऋषयश्चैव सहिताः कुलपर्वताः ..
तत्तेजोनिलयाः सर्वे पूजनीयाः प्रयत्नतः .. 107 ..
text_mt: And the serpents and Garuḍa must likewise be worshipped in front; / the deities, the sages together with the principal mountain ranges— / all abiding in his brilliance—must be worshipped with diligence.

sanskrit_iast:
ācamya vidhivatpūrvaṃ maṃtrapūtena vāriṇā ..
hṛdayādīnnyasedaṃgānhṛdayādiṣu kṛtsnaśaḥ . . 108 . .
meaning:
आचम्य विधिवत्पूर्वं मंत्रपूतेन वारिणा ..
हृदयादीन्न्यसेदंगान्हृदयादिषु कृत्स्नशः . . 108 . .
text_mt: Having first sipped water according to rule with mantra-purified water, / one should completely install the limbs, such as the heart, on the heart and other [parts of the body].

sanskrit_iast:
śikhā netraṃ tathā carma astraṃ ca bharatarṣabha . .
maheṃdrādidiśaścaitāḥ pūjayedvidhivannṛpa . . 109 . .
meaning:
शिखा नेत्रं तथा चर्म अस्त्रं च भरतर्षभ . .
महेंद्रादिदिशश्चैताः पूजयेद्विधिवन्नृप . . 109 . .
text_mt: The tuft, the eye, and likewise the armor and weapon, O bull of the Bharatas; / and one should worship these directions of Mahendra and the rest according to rule, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdayaṃ purataḥ pūjyaṃ śiro devasya pṛṣṭhataḥ ..
pūrvaṃ saṃpūjayeddevaṃ mūlamaṃtreṇa kṛtsnaśaḥ . . 1.17.110 ..
meaning:
हृदयं पुरतः पूज्यं शिरो देवस्य पृष्ठतः ..
पूर्वं संपूजयेद्देवं मूलमंत्रेण कृत्स्नशः . . 1.17.110 ..
text_mt: The heart should be worshipped in front, the head at the back of the god; / one should first worship the god completely with the root mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
visarjayeddarśayitvā mudrāṃ tu bharatarṣabha . .
aṃkuśaṃ naraśārdūla hyāhvāne kaṃjamādiśet .. 111 . .
meaning:
विसर्जयेद्दर्शयित्वा मुद्रां तु भरतर्षभ . .
अंकुशं नरशार्दूल ह्याह्वाने कंजमादिशेत् .. 111 . .
text_mt: Having displayed the mudrā, O bull of the Bharatas, he should perform the dismissal; / O tiger among men, he should indicate the goad and the lotus at the invocation.

sanskrit_iast:
yastvevaṃ pūjayeddevaṃ pratipannityameva ca . .
upoṣya paṃcadaśyāṃ tu sa yāti paramaṃ padam .. 112 ..
meaning:
यस्त्वेवं पूजयेद्देवं प्रतिपन्नित्यमेव च . .
उपोष्य पंचदश्यां तु स याति परमं पदम् .. 112 ..
text_mt: Whoever thus worships the god constantly on the pratipad, / having fasted on the fifteenth [day], he goes to the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sumaṃtu ruvāca . . . .
āpo hiṣṭheti maṃtro'yaṃ hṛdayaṃ parikīrtitam . .
ṛtaṃ satyaṃ śikhā proktā udutyaṃ netramādiśet . . 113 ..
meaning:
.. सुमंतु रुवाच . . . .
आपो हिष्ठेति मंत्रोऽयं हृदयं परिकीर्तितम् . .
ऋतं सत्यं शिखा प्रोक्ता उदुत्यं नेत्रमादिशेत् . . 113 ..
text_mt: Sumantu said: / The mantra 'āpo hi ṣṭha' is proclaimed as the heart; / 'ṛtaṃ satyam' is taught as the tuft; 'ud utyam' one should assign as the eye.

sanskrit_iast:
citraṃ devānāṃ mastamiti sarvalokeṣu viśrutam . .
varmaṇā te cchādayāmi kavacaṃ samudāhṛtam . . 114 . .
meaning:
चित्रं देवानां मस्तमिति सर्वलोकेषु विश्रुतम् . .
वर्मणा ते च्छादयामि कवचं समुदाहृतम् . . 114 . .
text_mt: 'citraṃ devānām' is renowned in all the worlds as the head; / 'varmaṇā te chādayāmi' is declared to be the armor.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūrbhuvaḥ svariti tathā śirase parikīrtitam ..
gāyatrīmūlataṃtrastu sādhakaḥ sarvakarmaṇām . . 11 5. .
meaning:
भूर्भुवः स्वरिति तथा शिरसे परिकीर्तितम् ..
गायत्रीमूलतंत्रस्तु साधकः सर्वकर्मणाम् . . 11 5. .
text_mt: Likewise, 'bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ' is proclaimed for the head; / the root manual is the Gāyatrī, accomplishing all rituals.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatryā pūjayeddevamoṃkāreṇābhimaṃtritam. .
praṇavenāparānsarvānṛgvedādīnprapūjayet . . 116 . .
meaning:
गायत्र्या पूजयेद्देवमोंकारेणाभिमंत्रितम्. .
प्रणवेनापरान्सर्वानृग्वेदादीन्प्रपूजयेत् . . 116 . .
text_mt: One should worship the god with the Gāyatrī consecrated by the sound oṃ; / one should worship all the others, the Ṛgveda and the rest, with the praṇava.

sanskrit_iast:
āhvāne pūjane vīra visarge brahmaṇastathā . .
gāyatrī paramo maṃtro vedamātā vibhāvinī . 117 ..
meaning:
आह्वाने पूजने वीर विसर्गे ब्रह्मणस्तथा . .
गायत्री परमो मंत्रो वेदमाता विभाविनी . 117 ..
text_mt: In the invocation, in the worship, and likewise in the dismissal of Brahmā, O hero, / the Gāyatrī is the supreme mantra, the radiant mother of the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatryakṣaratattvaistu pūjayedyastu devatām . .
sa gacchedbrahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ durlabhaṃ yaddurā sadam . . 118 . . ..
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe śatārddhasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ brāhme parvaṇi pratipatkalpe brahmaṇo'rcanavidhivarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ . . 17 . .
pratipatkalpasamāptivarṇanam
meaning:
गायत्र्यक्षरतत्त्वैस्तु पूजयेद्यस्तु देवताम् . .
स गच्छेद्ब्रह्मणः स्थानं दुर्लभं यद्दुरा सदम् . . 118 . . ..
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे शतार्द्धसाहस्र्यां संहितायां ब्राह्मे पर्वणि प्रतिपत्कल्पे ब्रह्मणोऽर्चनविधिवर्णनं नाम सप्तदशोऽध्यायः . . 17 . .
प्रतिपत्कल्पसमाप्तिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Whoever worships the deity with the syllable-principles of the Gāyatrī, / he goes to the realm of Brahmā, which is difficult to attain and hard to reach.
Thus ends the seventeenth chapter, titled 'Description of the Ritual for Worshipping Brahmā in the Pratipatkalpa', in the Brāhmaparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa consisting of fifty thousand verses.
Description of the Completion of the Pratipatkalpa

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
paurṇamāsyupavāsaṃ tu kṛtvā bhaktyā narādhipa .
anena vidhinā yastu viriñciṃ pūjayennaraḥ . . 1
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
पौर्णमास्युपवासं तु कृत्वा भक्त्या नराधिप .
अनेन विधिना यस्तु विरिञ्चिं पूजयेन्नरः . . 1
text_mt: Sumantu said: / Having fasted on the full moon day with devotion, O lord of men, / the man who worships Viriñci according to this rite,
title: adhyāyaḥ 018

sanskrit_iast:
pratipadyāṃ mahābāho sa gacchedbrahmaṇaḥ padam .
ṛgbhirviśeṣato 1 devī viriñcervāstudevatāḥ . . 2
meaning:
प्रतिपद्यां महाबाहो स गच्छेद्ब्रह्मणः पदम् .
ऋग्भिर्विशेषतो 1 देवी विरिञ्चेर्वास्तुदेवताः . . 2
text_mt: on the pratipad, O mighty-armed one, goes to the abode of Brahmā; / especially [worshipping] with verses from the Ṛgveda the goddess and the household deities of Viriñci.

sanskrit_iast:
kārttike māsi devasya rathayātrā prakīrtitā .
yāṃ kṛtvā mānavo bhaktyā yāti brahmasalokatām . . 3
meaning:
कार्त्तिके मासि देवस्य रथयात्रा प्रकीर्तिता .
यां कृत्वा मानवो भक्त्या याति ब्रह्मसलोकताम् . . 3
text_mt: In the month of Kārttika, the chariot procession of the god is proclaimed, / having performed which with devotion, a mortal attains dwelling in the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtike māsi rājendra paurṇamāsyāṃ caturmukham .
mārgeṇa carmaṇā sārdhaṃ sāvitryā ca parantapa . . 4
meaning:
कार्तिके मासि राजेन्द्र पौर्णमास्यां चतुर्मुखम् .
मार्गेण चर्मणा सार्धं सावित्र्या च परन्तप . . 4
text_mt: In the month of Kārtika on the full moon day, O king of kings, scorcher of foes, / [taking] the four-faced [god] along with the path, the shield, and Sāvitrī,

sanskrit_iast:
bhrāmayennagaraṃ sarvaṃ nānāvādyaiḥ samanvitam .
sthāpayed bhrāmayitvā tu salokaṃ nagaraṃ nṛpa . . 5
meaning:
भ्रामयेन्नगरं सर्वं नानावाद्यैः समन्वितम् .
स्थापयेद् भ्रामयित्वा तु सलोकं नगरं नृप . . 5
text_mt: one should take [him] around the entire city, accompanied by diverse musical instruments; / having taken [him] around the city along with its people, one should reinstall [him], O king.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayityāgre śāṃḍileyaṃ prapūjya ca .
āropayedrathe devaṃ puṇyavāditranisvanaiḥ . . 6
meaning:
ब्राह्मणं भोजयित्याग्रे शांडिलेयं प्रपूज्य च .
आरोपयेद्रथे देवं पुण्यवादित्रनिस्वनैः . . 6
text_mt: Having first fed a brāhmaṇa and worshipped Śāṇḍileya, / one should place the god on the chariot amidst auspicious instrumental sounds.

sanskrit_iast:
rathāgre śāṃḍilīputraṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ .
brāhmaṇānvācayitvā ca kṛtvā puṇyāhamaṃgalam . . 7
meaning:
रथाग्रे शांडिलीपुत्रं पूजयित्वा विधानतः .
ब्राह्मणान्वाचयित्वा च कृत्वा पुण्याहमंगलम् . . 7
text_mt: Having worshipped the son of Śāṇḍilī in front of the chariot according to the rite, / having caused brāhmaṇas to recite, and having performed the auspicious declaration of a holy day,

sanskrit_iast:
devamāropayitvā tu rathe kuryātprajāgaram .
nānāvidhaiḥ prekṣaṇakairbrahmaghoṣaiśca puṣkalaiḥ . . 8 rathopari ṭippaṇī
kṛtvā prajāgaraṃ hyevaṃ prabhāte brāhmaṇaṃ nṛpa .
bhojayitvā yathāśaktyā bhakṣyabhojyairanekaśaḥ . . 9
meaning:
देवमारोपयित्वा तु रथे कुर्यात्प्रजागरम् .
नानाविधैः प्रेक्षणकैर्ब्रह्मघोषैश्च पुष्कलैः . . 8 रथोपरि टिप्पणी
कृत्वा प्रजागरं ह्येवं प्रभाते ब्राह्मणं नृप .
भोजयित्वा यथाशक्त्या भक्ष्यभोज्यैरनेकशः . . 9
text_mt: having placed the god on the chariot, one should keep a night vigil / with various spectacles and copious chants of the Veda. / Having thus kept a night vigil, in the morning, O king, / having fed a brāhmaṇa to the best of one's ability with numerous pastries and foods,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā janaṃ2 vīra vajreṇa vidhivannṛpa .
bījena ca mahābāho payasā pāyasena ca . . 1.18.10
meaning:
पूजयित्वा जनं2 वीर वज्रेण विधिवन्नृप .
बीजेन च महाबाहो पयसा पायसेन च . . 1.18.10
text_mt: having worshipped the people, O hero, with a thunderbolt according to rule, O king, / and with seed, O mighty-armed one, with milk and rice boiled in milk,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānvācayitvā ca cchāṃdena vidhinā nṛpa .
kṛtvā puṇyāhaśabdaṃ ca rathaṃ ca bhrāmayetpure . . 11
meaning:
ब्राह्मणान्वाचयित्वा च च्छांदेन विधिना नृप .
कृत्वा पुण्याहशब्दं च रथं च भ्रामयेत्पुरे . . 11
text_mt: and having caused brāhmaṇas to recite according to Vedic rule, O king, / and having made the utterance of an auspicious day, one should take the chariot around the city.

sanskrit_iast:
caturvedavidairviprairbhrāmayedbrahmaṇo ratham .
bahvṛcātharvaṇoccāraiśchandogādhvaryubhistathā . . 12
meaning:
चतुर्वेदविदैर्विप्रैर्भ्रामयेद्ब्रह्मणो रथम् .
बह्वृचाथर्वणोच्चारैश्छन्दोगाध्वर्युभिस्तथा . . 12
text_mt: One should have the chariot of Brahmā driven by brāhmaṇas learned in the four Vedas, / with the recitations of Ṛgvedins and Atharvavedins, and by Sāmavedins and Yajurvedins.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrāmayeddevadevasya surajyeṣṭhasya taṃ ratham .
pradakṣiṇaṃ puraṃ sarvaṃ mārgeṇa susamena tu . . 13
meaning:
भ्रामयेद्देवदेवस्य सुरज्येष्ठस्य तं रथम् .
प्रदक्षिणं पुरं सर्वं मार्गेण सुसमेन तु . . 13
text_mt: One should drive that chariot of the god of gods, the eldest of the deities, / clockwise around the entire city along an even road.

sanskrit_iast:
na voḍhavyo ratho vīra śūdreṇa śubhamicchatā .
nāruheta rathaṃ prājño muktvaikaṃ bhojakaṃ nṛpa . . 14
meaning:
न वोढव्यो रथो वीर शूद्रेण शुभमिच्छता .
नारुहेत रथं प्राज्ञो मुक्त्वैकं भोजकं नृप . . 14
text_mt: The chariot should not be drawn by a śūdra desiring well-being, O hero; / a wise man should not mount the chariot, O king, except for a single Bhojaka.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇo dakṣiṇe pārśve sāvitrīṃ sthāpayennṛpa .
bhojako vāmapārśve tu purataḥ kañjajaṃ nyaset . . 15
meaning:
ब्रह्मणो दक्षिणे पार्श्वे सावित्रीं स्थापयेन्नृप .
भोजको वामपार्श्वे तु पुरतः कञ्जजं न्यसेत् . . 15
text_mt: On the right side of Brahmā one should place Sāvitrī, O king; / the Bhojaka on the left side, and in front one should place the lotus-born [god].

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tūryaninādaistu śaṃkhaśabdaiśca puṣkalaiḥ .
bhrāmayitvā rathaṃ rājanpuraṃ sarvaṃ pradakṣiṇam . .
svasthāne sthāpayedbhūyaḥ kṛtvā nīrājanaṃ budhaḥ . . 16
meaning:
एवं तूर्यनिनादैस्तु शंखशब्दैश्च पुष्कलैः .
भ्रामयित्वा रथं राजन्पुरं सर्वं प्रदक्षिणम् . .
स्वस्थाने स्थापयेद्भूयः कृत्वा नीराजनं बुधः . . 16
text_mt: Having thus taken the chariot clockwise around the whole city, O king, / with blaring trumpets and copious conch-sounds, / the wise man should reinstall [it] in its own place after performing the wave-offering.

sanskrit_iast:
ya evaṃ kurute yātrāṃ bhaktyā yaścāpi paśyati .
rathaṃ cākarṣate yastu sa gacchedbrahmaṇaḥ padam . . 17
meaning:
य एवं कुरुते यात्रां भक्त्या यश्चापि पश्यति .
रथं चाकर्षते यस्तु स गच्छेद्ब्रह्मणः पदम् . . 17
text_mt: He who thus conducts the procession, or who views it with devotion, / and he who pulls the chariot, goes to the abode of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtike māsyamāvāsyāṃ yastu dīpapradīpanam .
śālāyāṃ brahmaṇaḥ kuryātsa gacchedbrahmaṇaḥ padam . . 18
meaning:
कार्तिके मास्यमावास्यां यस्तु दीपप्रदीपनम् .
शालायां ब्रह्मणः कुर्यात्स गच्छेद्ब्रह्मणः पदम् . . 18
text_mt: In the month of Kārtika on the new moon day, whoever kindles lamps / in the hall of Brahmā, goes to the abode of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
pratipadi brāhmaṇāṃścāpi guḍamiśraiḥ pradīpakaiḥ .
vāsobhirahataiścāpi sa gacchedbrahmaṇaḥ padam . . 19
meaning:
प्रतिपदि ब्राह्मणांश्चापि गुडमिश्रैः प्रदीपकैः .
वासोभिरहतैश्चापि स गच्छेद्ब्रह्मणः पदम् . . 19
text_mt: On the pratipad, [whoever honors] brāhmaṇas with lamps mixed with jaggery / and with unwashed garments, he goes to the abode of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃdhaipuṣpairnavairvastrairātmānaṃ 1 pūjayecca yaḥ .
tasyāṃ pratipadāyāṃ tu sa gacchedbrahmaṇaḥ padam . . 1.18.20
meaning:
गंधैपुष्पैर्नवैर्वस्त्रैरात्मानं 1 पूजयेच्च यः .
तस्यां प्रतिपदायां तु स गच्छेद्ब्रह्मणः पदम् . . 1.18.20
text_mt: And he who honors himself with perfumes, flowers, and new garments / on that pratipad, goes to the abode of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpuṇyā tithiriyaṃ balirājyapravartinī .
brahmaṇaḥ supriyā nityaṃ bāleyā parikīrtitā . . 21
meaning:
महापुण्या तिथिरियं बलिराज्यप्रवर्तिनी .
ब्रह्मणः सुप्रिया नित्यं बालेया परिकीर्तिता . . 21
text_mt: This lunar day is highly auspicious, inaugurating the reign of Bali; / always dear to Brahmā, it is renowned as Bāleyā.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānpūjayitvāsyāmātmānaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ .
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ . . 22
meaning:
ब्राह्मणान्पूजयित्वास्यामात्मानं च विशेषतः .
स याति परमं स्थानं विष्णोरमिततेजसः . . 22
text_mt: Having worshipped brāhmaṇas on this [day] and especially oneself, / one goes to the supreme abode of Viṣṇu of immeasurable splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
caitre māsi mahābāho puṇyā pratipadā parā .
tasyāṃ yaḥ śvapacaṃ spṛṣṭvā snānaṃ kuryānnarottama . 23
meaning:
चैत्रे मासि महाबाहो पुण्या प्रतिपदा परा .
तस्यां यः श्वपचं स्पृष्ट्वा स्नानं कुर्यान्नरोत्तम . 23
text_mt: In the month of Caitra, O mighty-armed one, the pratipad is supreme and auspicious; / on that day, whoever bathes after touching an outcaste, O best of men,

sanskrit_iast:
na tasya duritaṃ kiñcinnādhayo vyādhayo nṛpa .
bhavanti kuruśārdūla tasmātsnānaṃ pravartayet . . 24
meaning:
न तस्य दुरितं किञ्चिन्नाधयो व्याधयो नृप .
भवन्ति कुरुशार्दूल तस्मात्स्नानं प्रवर्तयेत् . . 24
text_mt: to him no sin, nor mental agonies or bodily diseases occur, O king, / O tiger of the Kurus; therefore, one should perform that bath.

sanskrit_iast:
divyaṃ nīrājanaṃ taddhi sarvarogavināśanam .
gomahiṣyādi yatkiṃcittatsarvaṃ bhūṣayennṛpa . . 25
meaning:
दिव्यं नीराजनं तद्धि सर्वरोगविनाशनम् .
गोमहिष्यादि यत्किंचित्तत्सर्वं भूषयेन्नृप . . 25
text_mt:
For that is a divine waving of lights that destroys all diseases.
O king, one should adorn whatever [cattle there are], such as cows and buffaloes.

sanskrit_iast:
tailaśastrādibhirvastrastoraṇādhastato nayet .
brāhmaṇānāṃ tathā bhojyaṃ kuryātkurukulodvaha . . 26
meaning:
तैलशस्त्रादिभिर्वस्त्रस्तोरणाधस्ततो नयेत् .
ब्राह्मणानां तथा भोज्यं कुर्यात्कुरुकुलोद्वह . . 26
text_mt:
Then, with oil, weapons, garments, and other things, one should lead them beneath an archway.
Likewise, O upholder of the Kuru lineage, one should provide food for brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
tisro hyetāḥ parāḥ proktāstithayaḥ kurunandana .
kārttikeśvayuje māsi caitre māse ca bhārata . . 27
meaning:
तिस्रो ह्येताः पराः प्रोक्तास्तिथयः कुरुनन्दन .
कार्त्तिकेश्वयुजे मासि चैत्रे मासे च भारत . . 27
text_mt:
For these three lunar days are proclaimed as supreme, O joy of the Kurus,
in the months of Kārttika, Āśvayuja, and Caitra, O Bhārata.

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ dānaṃ śataguṇaṃ kārttike yā tithirnṛpa .
balirājyāptisukhadā pāṃśulāśubhanāśinī . . 28
śaryātyākhyāne puṣpadvitīyā varṇanam
meaning:
स्नानं दानं शतगुणं कार्त्तिके या तिथिर्नृप .
बलिराज्याप्तिसुखदा पांशुलाशुभनाशिनी . . 28
शर्यात्याख्याने पुष्पद्वितीया वर्णनम्

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
dvitīyāyāṃ tu rājendra aśvinau somapītinau .
cyavanena kṛtau yajñe miṣato maghavasya1 ca . . 1
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
द्वितीयायां तु राजेन्द्र अश्विनौ सोमपीतिनौ .
च्यवनेन कृतौ यज्ञे मिषतो मघवस्य1 च . . 1
text_mt:
Sumantu said:
On the second lunar day, O king of kings, the two Aśvins were made drinkers of soma
by Cyavana at the sacrifice, before the very eyes of Maghavan.
title: Puṣpadvitīyāvarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
śatānīka uvāca
kathamindrasya miṣataḥ kṛtau tau somapītinau .
cyavanena hi devānāṃ paśyatāṃ tadvadasva me . . 2
meaning:
शतानीक उवाच
कथमिन्द्रस्य मिषतः कृतौ तौ सोमपीतिनौ .
च्यवनेन हि देवानां पश्यतां तद्वदस्व मे . . 2
text_mt:
Śatānīka said:
How were the two made drinkers of soma before the very eyes of Indra
by Cyavana while the gods were looking on? Tell me that.

sanskrit_iast:
aho mahattapastasya cyavanasya mahātmanaḥ .
yadindrasya balādeva devatvaṃ prāpitāvubhau . . 3
meaning:
अहो महत्तपस्तस्य च्यवनस्य महात्मनः .
यदिन्द्रस्य बलादेव देवत्वं प्रापितावुभौ . . 3
text_mt:
Ah, great was the ascetic power of that noble-minded Cyavana,
since by force against Indra both were raised to godhood!

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
purātanayuge sandhau paścime'tha narādhipa .
cyavano yogamāsthāya gaṃgākūle'vasacciram . . 4
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
पुरातनयुगे सन्धौ पश्चिमेऽथ नराधिप .
च्यवनो योगमास्थाय गंगाकूलेऽवसच्चिरम् . . 4
text_mt:
Sumantu said:
In an ancient age, at the twilight of the last [quarter], O ruler of men,
Cyavana, engaging in yoga, dwelt on the bank of the Gaṅgā for a long time.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra śaryātirāyātaḥ snātumantaḥ1 puraiḥ saha .
snātvābhyarcya2 pitṝndevāngamanāyopacakrame . . 5
meaning:
तत्र शर्यातिरायातः स्नातुमन्तः1 पुरैः सह .
स्नात्वाभ्यर्च्य2 पितॄन्देवान्गमनायोपचक्रमे . . 5
text_mt:
Śaryāti arrived there to bathe along with his inner apartments.
Having bathed and worshipped the ancestors and the gods, he prepared to depart.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra mūḍhaṃ janapadamapaśyatpathi ceṣṭanam .
viṇmūtrotsargasaṃruddhaṃ jyotirākṣiptaniṣkriyam . .
bhramantaṃ tatratatraiva samīkṣya sa balaṃ nṛpaḥ . . 6
meaning:
तत्र मूढं जनपदमपश्यत्पथि चेष्टनम् .
विण्मूत्रोत्सर्गसंरुद्धं ज्योतिराक्षिप्तनिष्क्रियम् . .
भ्रमन्तं तत्रतत्रैव समीक्ष्य स बलं नृपः . . 6
text_mt:
There he saw his people bewildered, writhing upon the road,
blocked from discharging feces and urine, their light cast down, stripped of movement.
Seeing his army wandering about right there, the king,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca3 durmanā rājā amātyānsvānpurogamān .
cyavanasyāśramo'yaṃ hi nāparāddhaṃ tu kenacit . . 7
meaning:
उवाच3 दुर्मना राजा अमात्यान्स्वान्पुरोगमान् .
च्यवनस्याश्रमोऽयं हि नापराद्धं तु केनचित् . . 7
text_mt:
the king, dejected in mind, said to his ministers who preceded him:
'This is indeed the hermitage of Cyavana; has no offense been committed by anyone?'

sanskrit_iast:
na covāca yadā kaścittasya rājñastu pṛcchataḥ .
tadā sutā sukanyāsya provāca pitaraṃ vacaḥ . . 8
meaning:
न चोवाच यदा कश्चित्तस्य राज्ञस्तु पृच्छतः .
तदा सुता सुकन्यास्य प्रोवाच पितरं वचः . . 8
text_mt:
And when no one spoke as that king questioned them,
then his daughter Sukanyā spoke these words to her father:

sanskrit_iast:
mayā dṛṣṭaṃ tu yattāta sakhibhiḥ saha kautukam .
tatte vacmi nibodha tvaṃ śṛṇu tāta mahādbhutam . . 9
meaning:
मया दृष्टं तु यत्तात सखिभिः सह कौतुकम् .
तत्ते वच्मि निबोध त्वं शृणु तात महाद्भुतम् . . 9
text_mt:
'What was seen as a curiosity by me and my companions, O father,
that I will tell you; listen, understand, O father, a great wonder!

sanskrit_iast:
śiñjitārāvabahulāḥ kāñcīnūpuramekhalāḥ .
gāyantyo vilapantyaśca kīḍantyaścātra kānane . . 1.19.10
meaning:
शिञ्जितारावबहुलाः काञ्चीनूपुरमेखलाः .
गायन्त्यो विलपन्त्यश्च कीडन्त्यश्चात्र कानने . . 1.19.10
text_mt:
[We were] resounding with jingling sounds from girdles, anklets, and waistbands,
singing, crying out, and playing in this forest.

sanskrit_iast:
kokiladhvanimaśrauṣaṃ vyaktāvyaktākṣaraṃ kṛśam .
sukanye hyehihyehīti valmīkādvacamudgiran . . 11
meaning:
कोकिलध्वनिमश्रौषं व्यक्ताव्यक्ताक्षरं कृशम् .
सुकन्ये ह्येहिह्येहीति वल्मीकाद्वचमुद्गिरन् . . 11
text_mt:
I heard a sound like a cuckoo, faint, with distinct and indistinct syllables,
uttering the words: "Sukanyā, come, come!" from an anthill.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra gatvādbhutaṃ tāta paśyāmaḥ kila pāvakau .
dīpāvivācalaśikhau bhūyaḥ kanyā uvāca ha . . 12
meaning:
तत्र गत्वाद्भुतं तात पश्यामः किल पावकौ .
दीपाविवाचलशिखौ भूयः कन्या उवाच ह . . 12
text_mt:
Having gone there, O father, we truly saw a wonder: two fires,
like lamps with motionless flames.' Again the maiden spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
mayā ca kautukāttāta kimetadityabuddhitaḥ .
sūditau darbhasūcyagraistattejaḥ samupāramat . . 13
meaning:
मया च कौतुकात्तात किमेतदित्यबुद्धितः .
सूदितौ दर्भसूच्यग्रैस्तत्तेजः समुपारमत् . . 13
text_mt:
'And out of curiosity, O father, not understanding what it was,
they were pierced with the points of darbha needles, and that luster ceased.'

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā nṛpatistrastastūrṇaṃ tadvanamāgamat .
yatrāste bhārgavaḥ kaṣṭaṃ valmīkāntargato muniḥ . . 14
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा नृपतिस्त्रस्तस्तूर्णं तद्वनमागमत् .
यत्रास्ते भार्गवः कष्टं वल्मीकान्तर्गतो मुनिः . . 14
text_mt:
Hearing that, the terrified king quickly went to that forest
where the sage, the descendant of Bhṛgu, sat in distress inside the anthill.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā sa tatra provāca praṇipatya dvijottamam .
aparāddhaṃ mayā 1 deva tatkṣamasva namo'stu te . . 15
meaning:
गत्वा स तत्र प्रोवाच प्रणिपत्य द्विजोत्तमम् .
अपराद्धं मया 1 देव तत्क्षमस्व नमोऽस्तु ते . . 15
text_mt:
Going there and bowing down to that best of the twice-born, he said:
'An offense has been committed by me, O lord; forgive it, reverence to you!'

sanskrit_iast:
sa taṃ provāca nṛpatiṃ mayā jñātaṃ narādhipa .
sukanyāṃ me prayacchasva niveśārthī2 hyahaṃ nṛpa . .
anukramansukanyāṃ tu dattvā rājansukhī bhava . . 16
meaning:
स तं प्रोवाच नृपतिं मया ज्ञातं नराधिप .
सुकन्यां मे प्रयच्छस्व निवेशार्थी2 ह्यहं नृप . .
अनुक्रमन्सुकन्यां तु दत्त्वा राजन्सुखी भव . . 16
text_mt:
He said to that king: 'It has been understood by me, O ruler of men.
Give me Sukanyā, for I desire marriage, O king.
In accordance with duty, having given Sukanyā, O king, be happy.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktaḥ pradadau rājā sukanyāmavicārayan .
tataḥ svapuramāgamya avasatsuciraṃ sukhī . . 17
meaning:
इत्युक्तः प्रददौ राजा सुकन्यामविचारयन् .
ततः स्वपुरमागम्य अवसत्सुचिरं सुखी . . 17
text_mt:
Thus addressed, the king gave Sukanyā without deliberating.
Then, having returned to his own city, he lived happy for a very long time.

sanskrit_iast:
sukanyāpi patiṃ labdhvā suprītārādhayattadā .
rājyaśriyaṃ parityajya valkalājinadhāriṇī . . 18
meaning:
सुकन्यापि पतिं लब्ध्वा सुप्रीताराधयत्तदा .
राज्यश्रियं परित्यज्य वल्कलाजिनधारिणी . . 18
text_mt:
Sukanyā too, having obtained a husband, served him with great joy then,
abandoning royal splendour and wearing bark and animal skins.

sanskrit_iast:
gate bahutithe kāle vasante samupasthite .
tapodyotitasarvāṅgīṃ rūpodāryaguṇānvitām . .
snātāṃ svabhāryāṃ cyavana uvāca madhurākṣaram . . 19
meaning:
गते बहुतिथे काले वसन्ते समुपस्थिते .
तपोद्योतितसर्वाङ्गीं रूपोदार्यगुणान्विताम् . .
स्नातां स्वभार्यां च्यवन उवाच मधुराक्षरम् . . 19
text_mt:
When a long time had passed and spring had arrived,
Cyavana spoke sweet words to his own wife who had bathed,
her limbs illuminated by asceticism, endowed with beauty, dignity, and virtues:

sanskrit_iast:
ehyehi bhadre bhadraṃ te śayanīyaṃ samāśraya .
apatyaṃ janayasyādya kuladvayavivardhanam . . 1.19.20
meaning:
एह्येहि भद्रे भद्रं ते शयनीयं समाश्रय .
अपत्यं जनयस्याद्य कुलद्वयविवर्धनम् . . 1.19.20
text_mt:
'Come, come, auspicious one, may good betide you; take to the bed.
Bear an offspring today to increase both families.'

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktā tu sā kanyā prāñjaliḥ patimabravīt .
3nārhasyadya sukalyāṇa saṅgamaṃ sthaṇḍile'same . . 21
meaning:
एवमुक्ता तु सा कन्या प्राञ्जलिः पतिमब्रवीत् .
3नार्हस्यद्य सुकल्याण सङ्गमं स्थण्डिलेऽसमे . . 21
text_mt:
Addressed thus, the maiden, with folded hands, said to her husband:
'You ought not, O most blessed one, to have union today on an uneven patch of ground.

sanskrit_iast:
mama priyaṃ kuruṣvādya tato māmāhvayasva ca .
pitṛgehe yathātiṣṭhaṃ śayanīye susaṃskṛte . . 22
meaning:
मम प्रियं कुरुष्वाद्य ततो मामाह्वयस्व च .
पितृगेहे यथातिष्ठं शयनीये सुसंस्कृते . . 22
text_mt:
Do what pleases me today, and then summon me,
just as I remained in my father’s house on a well-prepared bed,

sanskrit_iast:
bahugairikavarṇādyaiḥ śvetapītāruṇākule .
vastrālaṅkāragandhādyaistathā tvamapi tatkuru . . 23
meaning:
बहुगैरिकवर्णाद्यैः श्वेतपीतारुणाकुले .
वस्त्रालङ्कारगन्धाद्यैस्तथा त्वमपि तत्कुरु . . 23
text_mt:
filled with white, yellow, and red colors from abundant red ochre and the like,
and with garments, ornaments, perfumes, and other things—do you also make it so!

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānaṃ vayasopetaṃ rūpavantaṃ suvarcasam .
vastrālaṅkāragandhāḍhyaṃ paśyeyaṃ yena sādaram . . 24
meaning:
आत्मानं वयसोपेतं रूपवन्तं सुवर्चसम् .
वस्त्रालङ्कारगन्धाढ्यं पश्येयं येन सादरम् . . 24
text_mt:
May I see you endowed with youth, handsome, radiant,
rich in garments, ornaments, and perfumes, so that [I may look upon you] with affection.'

sanskrit_iast:
sukanyāyā vacaḥ śrutvā cyavanaḥ prāha durmanāḥ .
na me'sti vittaṃ kalyāṇi pituste'sti yathā vane . . 25
meaning:
सुकन्याया वचः श्रुत्वा च्यवनः प्राह दुर्मनाः .
न मेऽस्ति वित्तं कल्याणि पितुस्तेऽस्ति यथा वने . . 25
text_mt:
Hearing Sukanyā’s words, Cyavana, troubled in mind, said:
'I have no wealth, auspicious one, such as your father has in the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kathaṃ bhūṣayāmyadya surūpaśca kathaṃ vada .
provāca sā patiṃ bhūyaḥ prahasantī kṛtāñjaliḥ . .
vittaṃ dadāvailavilo rūpaṃ vairocano'dadat . . 26
meaning:
स कथं भूषयाम्यद्य सुरूपश्च कथं वद .
प्रोवाच सा पतिं भूयः प्रहसन्ती कृताञ्जलिः . .
वित्तं ददावैलविलो रूपं वैरोचनोऽददत् . . 26
text_mt:
How then can I adorn myself today, and how can I become handsome? Tell me.'
Laughing, with hands joined in reverent greeting, she spoke again to her husband:
'The son of Ilavilā gave wealth; the son of Virocana gave beauty.'

sanskrit_iast:
cyavanaḥ prāha bhāryāṃ tāṃ na kariṣye tapovyayam .
evamuktvā tapaścograṃ tatāpa suciraṃ tadā . . 27
meaning:
च्यवनः प्राह भार्यां तां न करिष्ये तपोव्ययम् .
एवमुक्त्वा तपश्चोग्रं तताप सुचिरं तदा . . 27
text_mt:
Cyavana said to his wife: 'I will not waste my asceticism.'
Having spoken thus, he then performed fierce asceticism for a very long time.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tatrāgatau vīrāvaśvinau kālaparyayāt .
dṛṣṭavantau sukanyāṃ tau dīptyā vai devatāmiva . . 28
meaning:
अथ तत्रागतौ वीरावश्विनौ कालपर्ययात् .
दृष्टवन्तौ सुकन्यां तौ दीप्त्या वै देवतामिव . . 28
text_mt:
Then in the course of time, the two heroic Aśvins arrived there.
They saw Sukanyā, like a deity in splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
upagamyocatustāṃ tau kā tvaṃ sundari rūpiṇī .
kimarthamiha ekā tvaṃ tiṣṭhase kastavāśrayaḥ . . 29
meaning:
उपगम्योचतुस्तां तौ का त्वं सुन्दरि रूपिणी .
किमर्थमिह एका त्वं तिष्ठसे कस्तवाश्रयः . . 29
text_mt:
Approaching her, the two said: 'Who are you, beautiful, shapely woman?
For what reason do you stand here alone? Who is your protector?'

sanskrit_iast:
sā tāvuvāca tanvaṅgī śaryātiduhitā hyaham .
bhartā ca cyavano mahyaṃ kau ca vāṃ me tathocyatām . . 1.19.30
meaning:
सा तावुवाच तन्वङ्गी शर्यातिदुहिता ह्यहम् .
भर्ता च च्यवनो मह्यं कौ च वां मे तथोच्यताम् . . 1.19.30
text_mt:
The slender-limbed woman said to them: 'I am indeed the daughter of Śaryāti,
and Cyavana is my husband. And who are you two? Let that be told to me.'

sanskrit_iast:
ūcatuścāśvinau devāvāvāṃ viddhi nṛpātmaje .
kiṃ kariṣyasi tena tvaṃ jīrṇena ca kṛśena ca . .
āvayorvṛṇu bhartāramekameva yamicchasi . . 31
meaning:
ऊचतुश्चाश्विनौ देवावावां विद्धि नृपात्मजे .
किं करिष्यसि तेन त्वं जीर्णेन च कृशेन च . .
आवयोर्वृणु भर्तारमेकमेव यमिच्छसि . . 31
text_mt:
The two divine Aśvins said: 'Know us, O king’s daughter.
What will you do with him, who is aged and emaciated?
Choose one of us two as your husband, whichever you desire.'

sanskrit_iast:
sā tvabravīcca mā maivaṃ vaktumarhau divaukasau .
bhartāramanuraktāṅgī yathā svāhā vibhāvasoḥ . . 32
meaning:
सा त्वब्रवीच्च मा मैवं वक्तुमर्हौ दिवौकसौ .
भर्तारमनुरक्ताङ्गी यथा स्वाहा विभावसोः . . 32
text_mt:
She, however, said: 'You two dwellers in heaven ought not to speak thus.
I am devoted in body to my husband, just as Svāhā is to Fire.'

sanskrit_iast:
aśvināvūcatuḥ
āyātu ca viśatvadya cyavano vaiṣṇavījalam .
tato nau madhyagaṃ hyekaṃ vṛṇīṣvānyaṃ yamicchati . . 33
tāvabrūtāṃ sukanyāṃ tu gatvā pṛccha svakaṃ patim .
taṃ ca pṛṣṭvā punaścātrāgaccha nau sannidhau punaḥ . . 34.
āvāmatraiva tiṣṭhāvo yāvadāgamanaṃ tava .
sā gatvā prāha bhartāramaśvināvevasūcatuḥ 1 . . 35
meaning:
अश्विनावूचतुः
आयातु च विशत्वद्य च्यवनो वैष्णवीजलम् .
ततो नौ मध्यगं ह्येकं वृणीष्वान्यं यमिच्छति . . 33
तावब्रूतां सुकन्यां तु गत्वा पृच्छ स्वकं पतिम् .
तं च पृष्ट्वा पुनश्चात्रागच्छ नौ सन्निधौ पुनः . . 34.
आवामत्रैव तिष्ठावो यावदागमनं तव .
सा गत्वा प्राह भर्तारमश्विनावेवसूचतुः 1 . . 35
text_mt:
The two Aśvins said:
'Let Cyavana come and enter the Vaiṣṇavī waters today.
Then choose one between us, or another, whichever [he] wishes.'
The two said to Sukanyā: 'Go and ask your own husband.
Having asked him, come here once more into our presence.
We two shall remain right here until your return.'
She, having gone, told her husband just what the two Aśvins had said:

sanskrit_iast:
rūpavantaṃ ca bhartāraṃ kariṣyāvo yamicchasi .
atha madhyagataṃ hyekaṃ bhartṛtvena variṣyasi . . 36
meaning:
रूपवन्तं च भर्तारं करिष्यावो यमिच्छसि .
अथ मध्यगतं ह्येकं भर्तृत्वेन वरिष्यसि . . 36
text_mt:
'"We two shall make your husband handsome, as you desire.
Then you will choose one of us standing between as your husband."'

sanskrit_iast:
evamastviti tāṃ prāha bhāryāṃ cyavanastvaran .
sā taṃ gṛhya jagāmāśu yatra tau bhiṣajāvubhau . . 37
meaning:
एवमस्त्विति तां प्राह भार्यां च्यवनस्त्वरन् .
सा तं गृह्य जगामाशु यत्र तौ भिषजावुभौ . . 37
text_mt:
'So be it,' Cyavana said in haste to that wife.
Taking him, she went swiftly to where both physicians were.

sanskrit_iast:
sā tāvuvāca cyavano yathoktaṃ bhavatorvacaḥ .
kurutaṃ hyaśvinau kṣipraṃ sukanyā cepsitaṃ2 vṛṇot . . 38
meaning:
सा तावुवाच च्यवनो यथोक्तं भवतोर्वचः .
कुरुतं ह्यश्विनौ क्षिप्रं सुकन्या चेप्सितं2 वृणोत् . . 38
text_mt: She said to the two of them: 'Cyavana has accepted the word of you two, as spoken. / Do it quickly, O Aśvins, and let Sukanyā choose the desired one.'

sanskrit_iast:
tau taṃ saṅgṛhya gaṅgāyāṃ praviṣṭau muninā saha .
muhūrtāttu samuttiṣṭhanrūpataśca śriyā vṛtāḥ . . 39
meaning:
तौ तं सङ्गृह्य गङ्गायां प्रविष्टौ मुनिना सह .
मुहूर्तात्तु समुत्तिष्ठन्रूपतश्च श्रिया वृताः . . 39
text_mt: Taking him, the two plunged into the Gaṅgā together with the sage; / after an instant, they emerged, endowed with beauty and radiant splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
śobhante sma mahābāhau kamudbhidya tapoyutāḥ .
kalpādau kalaśe yadvatkañjākṣa vyoma vedhasaḥ . .
udakādutthitāstasmātsarve te samarūpakāḥ ..1.19.40
meaning:
शोभन्ते स्म महाबाहौ कमुद्भिद्य तपोयुताः .
कल्पादौ कलशे यद्वत्कञ्जाक्ष व्योम वेधसः . .
उदकादुत्थितास्तस्मात्सर्वे ते समरूपकाः ..1.19.40
text_mt: Those ascetic ones shone, O mighty-armed one, breaking out of the water, / just as at the beginning of the kalpa the lotus-eyed Brahma's sky [burst forth] from the jar. / Rising up from that water, they were all of identical form.

sanskrit_iast:
sukanyā tu tato dṛṣṭvā bharttāraṃ devarūpiṇam .
harṣeṇa mahatāviṣṭā na ca taṃ veda bhārata ..41
meaning:
सुकन्या तु ततो दृष्ट्वा भर्त्तारं देवरूपिणम् .
हर्षेण महताविष्टा न च तं वेद भारत ..41
text_mt: Then Sukanyā, seeing her husband possessing the form of a god, / was filled with immense joy, but could not distinguish him, O descendant of Bharata.

sanskrit_iast:
samakāyāḥ samavayaḥ samarūpāḥ samaśriyaḥ .
vastrālaṅkārasadṛśāndṛṣṭvā cintāṃ gatā ciram ..42
meaning:
समकायाः समवयः समरूपाः समश्रियः .
वस्त्रालङ्कारसदृशान्दृष्ट्वा चिन्तां गता चिरम् ..42
text_mt: With identical bodies, identical age, identical form, identical glory, / and identical garments and ornaments—seeing them, she fell into prolonged contemplation.

sanskrit_iast:
sā cintayitvā suciraṃ vaidyadevāvuvāca ha .
bībhatso'pi mayā bhartā parityakto na karhicit ..43
meaning:
सा चिन्तयित्वा सुचिरं वैद्यदेवावुवाच ह .
बीभत्सोऽपि मया भर्ता परित्यक्तो न कर्हिचित् ..43
text_mt: Having reflected for a long time, she said to the two divine physicians: / 'Though repulsive, my husband was never abandoned by me.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavadbhirātmasaṃdṛśaṃ kathaṃ1 tyaktvā vṛṇe param .
tasmāttameva bhartāraṃ prayacchadhvaṃ divaukasaḥ ..44
meaning:
भवद्भिरात्मसंदृशं कथं1 त्यक्त्वा वृणे परम् .
तस्मात्तमेव भर्तारं प्रयच्छध्वं दिवौकसः ..44
text_mt: Leaving aside the one like yourselves, how could I choose another? / Therefore, grant that very husband to me, O gods!'

sanskrit_iast:
tayā sabahumānaṃ tau prāñjalyā prārthitau tadā .
devacihnāni svānyeva dhārayantau supūjitau ..45
meaning:
तया सबहुमानं तौ प्राञ्जल्या प्रार्थितौ तदा .
देवचिह्नानि स्वान्येव धारयन्तौ सुपूजितौ ..45
text_mt: She besought the two with great reverence, her hands joined in supplication. / Then, properly worshipped, they displayed their divine signs.

sanskrit_iast:
sukanyā nipuṇaṃ tau tu sunirīkṣya ca vihvalā .
na rajo na nimeṣo vai na spṛśete dharāṃ pade ..46
meaning:
सुकन्या निपुणं तौ तु सुनिरीक्ष्य च विह्वला .
न रजो न निमेषो वै न स्पृशेते धरां पदे ..46
text_mt: Sukanyā scrutinized them carefully; being agitated, [she saw that] / their feet had no dust, no blinking of the eyes, and did not touch the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
ayaṃ ca sarajā mlāno bhūmimāśritya tiṣṭhati .
nimeṣaṃ caiva tasyaivaṃ jñātvā vai cyavano vṛtaḥ ..47
meaning:
अयं च सरजा म्लानो भूमिमाश्रित्य तिष्ठति .
निमेषं चैव तस्यैवं ज्ञात्वा वै च्यवनो वृतः ..47
text_mt: 'This one has dust, looks weary, and stands touching the ground, / and he blinks'—knowing this thus, she chose Cyavana.

sanskrit_iast:
cyavane vṛte sukanyayā puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ha .
devadundubhayaścaiva prāvādyanta anekaśaḥ ..48
meaning:
च्यवने वृते सुकन्यया पुष्पवृष्टिः पपात ह .
देवदुन्दुभयश्चैव प्रावाद्यन्त अनेकशः ..48
text_mt: When Cyavana was chosen by Sukanyā, a shower of flowers fell, / and celestial drums sounded in great numbers.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu cyavanastuṣṭo divyarūpadharastadā .
uvāca tau tu suprīta aśvinau kiṃ karomi vām ..49
meaning:
ततस्तु च्यवनस्तुष्टो दिव्यरूपधरस्तदा .
उवाच तौ तु सुप्रीत अश्विनौ किं करोमि वाम् ..49
text_mt: Then Cyavana, delighted and bearing a celestial form, / highly pleased, spoke to the two Aśvins: 'What shall I do for you?

sanskrit_iast:
bhāryā dattā kṛtaṃ rūpaṃ devānāmapi durlabham .
upakāraṃ variṣṭhaṃ yo na karotyupakāriṇaḥ ..1.19.50
meaning:
भार्या दत्ता कृतं रूपं देवानामपि दुर्लभम् .
उपकारं वरिष्ठं यो न करोत्युपकारिणः ..1.19.50
text_mt: A wife has been granted, and a form hard even for the gods to attain has been bestowed. / Whoever does not render the highest service to a benefactor

sanskrit_iast:
ekaviṃśatsa gacchecca narakāṇi krameṇa vai .
tasmādahaṃ variṣṭhaṃ vai kariṣye'hamamānuṣam . . 51
meaning:
एकविंशत्स गच्छेच्च नरकाणि क्रमेण वै .
तस्मादहं वरिष्ठं वै करिष्येऽहममानुषम् . . 51
text_mt: would go to twenty-one hells one after another. / Therefore, I shall perform an extraordinary, superhuman

sanskrit_iast:
upakāraṃ bhavadbhyāṃ tu prītaḥ kuryāṃ suniścitam .
yajñabhāgaphalaṃ dadyāṃ yaddeveṣvapi durlabham . . 52
meaning:
उपकारं भवद्भ्यां तु प्रीतः कुर्यां सुनिश्चितम् .
यज्ञभागफलं दद्यां यद्देवेष्वपि दुर्लभम् . . 52
text_mt: service for you both, being pleased, most assuredly: / I shall give you a share of the sacrifice and its fruit, which is rare even among the gods.'

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā tu deveśau visasarja mahāmuniḥ .
ājagāmāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ sahabhāryo mudānvitaḥ . . 53
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा तु देवेशौ विससर्ज महामुनिः .
आजगामाश्रमं पुण्यं सहभार्यो मुदान्वितः . . 53
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the great sage dismissed the two lords of gods, / and returned to his holy hermitage with his wife, full of joy.

sanskrit_iast:
atha śuśrāva śaryātiścyavanaṃ devarūpiṇam .
jagāma ca mahātejā draṣṭuṃ munivaraṃ vaśī . . 54
meaning:
अथ शुश्राव शर्यातिश्च्यवनं देवरूपिणम् .
जगाम च महातेजा द्रष्टुं मुनिवरं वशी . . 54
text_mt: Then Śaryāti heard that Cyavana possessed the form of a god, / and the self-controlled, glorious king went to see the best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇipatyādau pratipūjya yathārhataḥ .
sukanyāṃ tu tato dṛṣṭvā praṇipatyābhinandya ca . . 55
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा प्रणिपत्यादौ प्रतिपूज्य यथार्हतः .
सुकन्यां तु ततो दृष्ट्वा प्रणिपत्याभिनन्द्य च . . 55
text_mt: Seeing him, he first bowed down and honored him fittingly; / then seeing Sukanyā, he bowed to her and welcomed her.

sanskrit_iast:
sasvaje mūrdhni āghrāya tatotsaṅgaṃ 1 samānayat .
sā tasyāḥ sasvaje premṇā ānandāśrupariplutā . .
saṃsthāpya tāṃ mudā yukto nṛpatiḥ saha bhāryayā . . 56
meaning:
सस्वजे मूर्ध्नि आघ्राय ततोत्सङ्गं 1 समानयत् .
सा तस्याः सस्वजे प्रेम्णा आनन्दाश्रुपरिप्लुता . .
संस्थाप्य तां मुदा युक्तो नृपतिः सह भार्यया . . 56
text_mt: He smelled her crown and embraced her, then took her onto his lap. / She embraced him with affection, overflowing with tears of joy. / Having seated her, the delighted king, together with his wife,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyo'bravītsusaṃtuṣṭaṃ cyavanastaṃ narādhipam .
saṃbhāraṃ kuru yajñārthaṃ yājayiṣye narādhipa . . 57
meaning:
भूयोऽब्रवीत्सुसंतुष्टं च्यवनस्तं नराधिपम् .
संभारं कुरु यज्ञार्थं याजयिष्ये नराधिप . . 57
text_mt: said to him: Cyavana, very satisfied, spoke further to that king of men: / 'Make preparations for a sacrifice; I shall officiate as your priest, O king.'

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktaḥ sa nṛpatiḥ praṇipatya mahāmunim .
jagāma svapuraṃ hṛṣṭo yajñārthaṃ yatnamācarat . . 58
meaning:
एवमुक्तः स नृपतिः प्रणिपत्य महामुनिम् .
जगाम स्वपुरं हृष्टो यज्ञार्थं यत्नमाचरत् . . 58
text_mt: Thus addressed, the king bowed down to the great sage, / and went to his own city rejoiced, making efforts for the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
sapreṣyānpreṣayankṣipraṃ yajñārthe dravyamāharat .
maṃtripurohitācāryānānayāmāsa satvaram . . 59
meaning:
सप्रेष्यान्प्रेषयन्क्षिप्रं यज्ञार्थे द्रव्यमाहरत् .
मंत्रिपुरोहिताचार्यानानयामास सत्वरम् . . 59
text_mt: Sending messengers swiftly, he procured the materials for the sacrifice; / he promptly summoned ministers, family priests, and preceptors.

sanskrit_iast:
samānīteṣu sarveṣu teṣu dravyeṣu bhārata .
ājagāma viśuddhātmā cyavanaḥ saha bhāryayā . . 1.19.60
meaning:
समानीतेषु सर्वेषु तेषु द्रव्येषु भारत .
आजगाम विशुद्धात्मा च्यवनः सह भार्यया . . 1.19.60
text_mt: When all those materials had been assembled, O descendant of Bharata, / the pure-minded Cyavana arrived together with his wife.

sanskrit_iast:
sampūjitaśca śuśrāva mahāntaṃ tyāgamaujasam .
anyaiśca bahubhiḥ sārddhamatryaṅgirasabhārgavaiḥ . . 61
meaning:
सम्पूजितश्च शुश्राव महान्तं त्यागमौजसम् .
अन्यैश्च बहुभिः सार्द्धमत्र्यङ्गिरसभार्गवैः . . 61
text_mt: Revered, he heard of the great, splendid generosity [of the king], / along with many other [sages]—Atri, Aṅgiras, and Bhārgavas.

sanskrit_iast:
pravartite mahāyajñe yajamāne nṛpottame .
ṛtviktvakarmanirate hūyamāne hutāśane . .
āhūtāḥ svāgatāḥ sarve bhāgārthaṃ tridivālayāḥ . . 62
meaning:
प्रवर्तिते महायज्ञे यजमाने नृपोत्तमे .
ऋत्विक्त्वकर्मनिरते हूयमाने हुताशने . .
आहूताः स्वागताः सर्वे भागार्थं त्रिदिवालयाः . . 62
text_mt: When the great sacrifice commenced with the best of kings acting as the patron, / with [priests] engaged in the duties of officiating priests, and the sacrificial fire being fed with oblations, / all the dwellers of heaven were invoked and welcomed to receive their share.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñabhāge pravṛtte tu śāstroktena vidhānataḥ .
āgatāvaśvinau tatra āhūto cyavanena tu . . 63
meaning:
यज्ञभागे प्रवृत्ते तु शास्त्रोक्तेन विधानतः .
आगतावश्विनौ तत्र आहूतो च्यवनेन तु . . 63
text_mt: When the offering of the sacrificial share was underway according to the scriptural rules, / the two Aśvins arrived there, having been summoned by Cyavana.

sanskrit_iast:
āhvāne kriyamāṇe tu aśvibhyāṃ tu tadā nṛpa .
provācendro'tha cyavanaṃ naitau bhāgānvitau kuru . .
devānāṃ bhiṣajāvetau na bhāgārhau na daivatau . . 64
meaning:
आह्वाने क्रियमाणे तु अश्विभ्यां तु तदा नृप .
प्रोवाचेन्द्रोऽथ च्यवनं नैतौ भागान्वितौ कुरु . .
देवानां भिषजावेतौ न भागार्हौ न दैवतौ . . 64
text_mt: While the invocation was being made for the two Aśvins, O king, / Indra then said to Cyavana: 'Do not make these two recipients of a share! / These two are mere physicians of the gods, unworthy of a sacrificial share and not true deities.'

sanskrit_iast:
cyavanastviṃdramāhedaṃ devau hyetāvubhāvapi .
mamopakāriṇāvetau dadmi bhāgaṃ na saṃśayaḥ . . 65
meaning:
च्यवनस्त्विंद्रमाहेदं देवौ ह्येतावुभावपि .
ममोपकारिणावेतौ दद्मि भागं न संशयः . . 65
text_mt: Cyavana replied to Indra: 'These two are indeed gods. / They have been my benefactors; I shall give them a share without a doubt.'

sanskrit_iast:
tato hyuvāca sakrodhaḥ sa śakraścyavanaṃ ruṣā .
viprarṣe prahariṣyāmi yadi bhāgaṃ prayacchasi . . 66
meaning:
ततो ह्युवाच सक्रोधः स शक्रश्च्यवनं रुषा .
विप्रर्षे प्रहरिष्यामि यदि भागं प्रयच्छसि . . 66
text_mt: Then Śakra, enraged, spoke furiously to Cyavana: / 'O Brahmin sage, I shall strike you if you grant them a share!'

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktastu viprarṣirna covācāpi kiñcana .
bhāgau dadau ca so'śvibhyāṃ sruvamudyamya mantrataḥ . . 67
meaning:
एवमुक्तस्तु विप्रर्षिर्न चोवाचापि किञ्चन .
भागौ ददौ च सोऽश्विभ्यां स्रुवमुद्यम्य मन्त्रतः . . 67
text_mt: Though thus spoken to, the Brahmin sage said nothing in return; / he raised the sacrificial ladle with a mantra and offered the shares to the two Aśvins.

sanskrit_iast:
atha udyamya bhiduraṃ moktukāmo divaspatiḥ .
stambhitaścyavanenātha savajraḥ sa narādhipa . . 68
meaning:
अथ उद्यम्य भिदुरं मोक्तुकामो दिवस्पतिः .
स्तम्भितश्च्यवनेनाथ सवज्रः स नराधिप . . 68
text_mt: Then, having raised his thunderbolt, the lord of heaven wished to unleash it, / but with his thunderbolt he was paralyzed by Cyavana, O ruler of men.

sanskrit_iast:
sa stambhayitvātvindraṃ tu bhāgaṃ dattvāśvinorvaśī .
samāpayāmāsa tadā yajñakarma yathārthavat . . 69
meaning:
स स्तम्भयित्वात्विन्द्रं तु भागं दत्त्वाश्विनोर्वशी .
समापयामास तदा यज्ञकर्म यथार्थवत् . . 69
text_mt: Having paralyzed Indra and given the share to the two Aśvins, the self-controlled one / then completed the sacrificial rite according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
kañjajo'thājagāmāśu āha ca cyavanaṃ tadā .
uttaṃbhyatāmayaṃ lekho bhāgaścāstvaśvinoriha ..1.19.70
meaning:
कञ्जजोऽथाजगामाशु आह च च्यवनं तदा .
उत्तंभ्यतामयं लेखो भागश्चास्त्वश्विनोरिह ..1.19.70
text_mt: Then the lotus-born [Brahmā] arrived quickly and said to Cyavana: / 'Let this god be released from paralysis, and let the share here belong to the two Aśvins.'

sanskrit_iast:
tathendrastamuvācedaṃ cyavanaṃ prītamānasaḥ .
jānāmi śaktiṃ tapasaścyavaneha tavottamām ..7 1
khyāpanārthaṃ hi tapasastava etatkṛtaṃ mayā .
adyaprabhṛti bhāgo'stu devatvaṃ cāśvinostathā ..72
meaning:
तथेन्द्रस्तमुवाचेदं च्यवनं प्रीतमानसः .
जानामि शक्तिं तपसश्च्यवनेह तवोत्तमाम् ..7 1
ख्यापनार्थं हि तपसस्तव एतत्कृतं मया .
अद्यप्रभृति भागोऽस्तु देवत्वं चाश्विनोस्तथा ..72
text_mt: Then Indra, with a pleased mind, said this to Cyavana: / 'I know the superior power of your austerity here, O Cyavana! / This was done by me only to make known the power of your austerity. / From this day forth, let the sacrificial share and godhood belong to the two Aśvins.

sanskrit_iast:
yastvimāṃ tapasaḥ khyātiṃ tvadīyāṃ vai paṭhiṣyati .
śṛṇuyādvāpi śuddhātmā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ..73
meaning:
यस्त्विमां तपसः ख्यातिं त्वदीयां वै पठिष्यति .
शृणुयाद्वापि शुद्धात्मा तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु ..73
text_mt: Whoever, with a pure soul, recites or hears / this renown of your asceticism—hear the meritorious fruit thereof:

sanskrit_iast:
virocanasado gatvā gatvā puṣpasadastathā .
kāle'tha vāmadevasya muñjakeśasadastathā ..
yauvanayuktaḥ sa krīḍāstiṣṭhatīti na saṃśayaḥ ..74
meaning:
विरोचनसदो गत्वा गत्वा पुष्पसदस्तथा .
कालेऽथ वामदेवस्य मुञ्जकेशसदस्तथा ..
यौवनयुक्तः स क्रीडास्तिष्ठतीति न संशयः ..74
text_mt: Having gone to the abode of Virocana, and having gone to the flower-abode, / and in due time to the abode of Vāmadeva and Muñjakeśa, / he dwells sporting, endowed with youth, without a doubt.'

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā jagāmāśu devaḥ svabhavanaṃ vaśī .
cyavano'pi sabhāryo vai śayārtiścāśramaṃ gataḥ ..75
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा जगामाशु देवः स्वभवनं वशी .
च्यवनोऽपि सभार्यो वै शयार्तिश्चाश्रमं गतः ..75
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the self-controlled god went swiftly to his own abode; / Cyavana too, with his wife, and Śaryāti returned to the hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
athāpaśyadvimānābhaṃ bhavanaṃ devanirmitam .
śayyāsanavarairjuṣṭaṃ sarvakāmasamṛddhimat ..76
meaning:
अथापश्यद्विमानाभं भवनं देवनिर्मितम् .
शय्यासनवरैर्जुष्टं सर्वकामसमृद्धिमत् ..76
text_mt: Then he saw a mansion resembling a celestial chariot, crafted by the gods, / furnished with excellent couches and seats, abundant with every desired object,

sanskrit_iast:
1udyānavāpibhirjuṣṭaṃ devendreṇa samāhṛtam .
2gokhaṇḍasannibhaṃ reje gṛhaṃ tadbhuvi durlabham ..77
meaning:
1उद्यानवापिभिर्जुष्टं देवेन्द्रेण समाहृतम् .
2गोखण्डसन्निभं रेजे गृहं तद्भुवि दुर्लभम् ..77
text_mt: provided with gardens and reservoirs, provided by the lord of the gods; / that house, shining like a paradise, was rare upon the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
subhūṣaṇāni divyāni ratnavanti mahānti ca .
arajānsi ca vastrāṇi divyaprāvaraṇāni ca . .78
meaning:
सुभूषणानि दिव्यानि रत्नवन्ति महान्ति च .
अरजान्सि च वस्त्राणि दिव्यप्रावरणानि च . .78
text_mt: Splendid divine ornaments, large and studded with jewels, / dust-free garments, and celestial coverings [were there].

sanskrit_iast:
tatsarvamakhilaṃ saha patnyā mahāmuniḥ .
mudaṃ paramikāṃ lebhe śakraṃ ca praśaśaṃsa ha ..79
meaning:
तत्सर्वमखिलं सह पत्न्या महामुनिः .
मुदं परमिकां लेभे शक्रं च प्रशशंस ह ..79
text_mt: Beholding all that in its entirety together with his wife, the great sage / attained supreme joy and praised Śakra.

sanskrit_iast:
evamiṣṭā tithiriyaṃ dvitīyā aśvinornṛpa .
devatvaṃ yajñabhāgaṃ ca samprāptāviha bhārata ..1.19.80
meaning:
एवमिष्टा तिथिरियं द्वितीया अश्विनोर्नृप .
देवत्वं यज्ञभागं च सम्प्राप्ताविह भारत ..1.19.80
text_mt: Thus this second lunar day is beloved of the Aśvins, O king; / here they attained godhood and their sacrificial share, O descendant of Bharata.

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣyā vidhinā yena taṃ śṛṇuṣva narādhipa .
rūpaṃ surūpaṃ yo vāñcheddvitīyāyāṃ narādhipa . . 81
meaning:
उपोष्या विधिना येन तं शृणुष्व नराधिप .
रूपं सुरूपं यो वाञ्छेद्द्वितीयायां नराधिप . . 81
text_mt: Hear, O ruler of men, the rule by which it should be kept as a fast / by anyone who desires handsome beauty on the second lunar day, O ruler of men.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtike śuklapakṣasya dvitīyāyāṃ narādhipa .
puṣpāhāro varṣamekaṃ bhavetsa niyatātmavān . . 82
meaning:
कार्तिके शुक्लपक्षस्य द्वितीयायां नराधिप .
पुष्पाहारो वर्षमेकं भवेत्स नियतात्मवान् . . 82
text_mt: On the second lunar day of the bright fortnight in Kārtika, O ruler of men, / self-controlled, one should eat only flowers for one year.

sanskrit_iast:
kālaprāptāni yāni syurhaviṣyaṃ kusumāni tu .
bhuñjīyāttāni dattvā tu brāhmaṇebhyo narādhipa . . 83
meaning:
कालप्राप्तानि यानि स्युर्हविष्यं कुसुमानि तु .
भुञ्जीयात्तानि दत्त्वा तु ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नराधिप . . 83
text_mt: Whatever blossoms of the season may be fit for sacrificial food, / one should eat them after giving them to the brāhmaṇas, O ruler of men.

sanskrit_iast:
sauvarṇaraupyapuṣpāṇi atha vā jalajāni 1 ca .
vratānte tasya santuṣṭau devau tribhuvane'śvinau . . 84
meaning:
सौवर्णरौप्यपुष्पाणि अथ वा जलजानि 1 च .
व्रतान्ते तस्य सन्तुष्टौ देवौ त्रिभुवनेऽश्विनौ . . 84
text_mt: At the conclusion of the votive observance, offering gold, silver, / or water-born flowers, the two Aśvins, gods in the three worlds, are pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
dadatuḥ kāmagaṃ divyaṃ vimānamatitejasam .
suciraṃ divi nārībhirloke'sau ramate'śvinoḥ . . 85
meaning:
ददतुः कामगं दिव्यं विमानमतितेजसम् .
सुचिरं दिवि नारीभिर्लोकेऽसौ रमतेऽश्विनोः . . 85
text_mt: They grant him a divine celestial chariot that moves at will and shines with supreme splendour. / For a very long time in heaven, he rejoices with women in the world of the Aśvins.

sanskrit_iast:
iha cāgatya kalpānte jāto vipraḥ puraskṛtaḥ .
vedavedāṃgaviduṣaḥ saptajanmāntarāṇyasau . . 86
meaning:
इह चागत्य कल्पान्ते जातो विप्रः पुरस्कृतः .
वेदवेदांगविदुषः सप्तजन्मान्तराण्यसौ . . 86
text_mt: And coming here at the end of the kalpa, he is born as an honoured brāhmaṇa, / learned in the Vedas and the Vedāṅgas for seven consecutive births.

sanskrit_iast:
jāto jāto bhavedvidvānbrāhmaṇo'sau kṛte yuge .
dātā yajñapatirvāgmī ādhivyādhivivarjitaḥ . . 87
meaning:
जातो जातो भवेद्विद्वान्ब्राह्मणोऽसौ कृते युगे .
दाता यज्ञपतिर्वाग्मी आधिव्याधिविवर्जितः . . 87
text_mt: Born repeatedly in the Kṛta Yuga, he becomes a learned brāhmaṇa, / generous, master of sacrifices, eloquent, and free from mental agony and physical disease.

sanskrit_iast:
putrapautraiḥ parivṛtaḥ saha pantyā'vasacciram .
madhyadeśe sunagare 2 dharmiṣṭho rājyabhāgbhavet . . 88
meaning:
पुत्रपौत्रैः परिवृतः सह पन्त्याऽवसच्चिरम् .
मध्यदेशे सुनगरे 2 धर्मिष्ठो राज्यभाग्भवेत् . . 88
text_mt: Surrounded by sons and grandsons, he dwells long with his wife. / In an excellent city of Madhyadeśa, righteous, he obtains a kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣā kathitā tubhyaṃ dvitīyā puṣpasaṃjñitā .
phalasaṃjñā tathānyā syātsute vai muñjakeśini . . 89
meaning:
इत्येषा कथिता तुभ्यं द्वितीया पुष्पसंज्ञिता .
फलसंज्ञा तथान्या स्यात्सुते वै मुञ्जकेशिनि . . 89
text_mt: Thus has the second lunar day named Puṣpā been related to you; / likewise, another known as Phalā exists, O son, for Muñjakeśin.

sanskrit_iast:
suṣṭhu puṇyā pāpaharā viṣṭaraśravasaḥ priyā .
aśūnyaśayanā loke prakhyātā kurunandana . . 1.19.90
meaning:
सुष्ठु पुण्या पापहरा विष्टरश्रवसः प्रिया .
अशून्यशयना लोके प्रख्याता कुरुनन्दन . . 1.19.90
text_mt: Exceedingly auspicious, destroying sin, dear to Viṣṇu, / it is renowned in the world as Aśūnyaśayanā, O delight of the Kurus.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmupoṣya naro rājañchraddhābhaktipuraskṛtaḥ .
ṛddhiṃ vṛddhiṃ śriyaṃ vātha bhāryayā saha modate . . 91
aśūnyaśayanā nāmnyāḥ dvitīyātithermahattvam
meaning:
तामुपोष्य नरो राजञ्छ्रद्धाभक्तिपुरस्कृतः .
ऋद्धिं वृद्धिं श्रियं वाथ भार्यया सह मोदते . . 91
अशून्यशयना नाम्न्याः द्वितीयातिथेर्महत्त्वम्
text_mt:
Fasting on it, O king, endued with faith and devotion, / a man rejoices with his wife in prosperity, growth, and fortune.
The greatness of the second lunar day named Aśūnyaśayanā.

sanskrit_iast:
śatānīka uvāca
brūhi me dvijaśārdūla dvitīyāṃ phalasaṃjñitām .
yāmupoṣya naro yoṣidviyogaṃ neha gacchati . . 1
meaning:
शतानीक उवाच
ब्रूहि मे द्विजशार्दूल द्वितीयां फलसंज्ञिताम् .
यामुपोष्य नरो योषिद्वियोगं नेह गच्छति . . 1
text_mt: Śatānīka said: / Tell me, O tiger among the twice-born, of the second lunar day named Phalā, / by fasting on which a man here does not suffer separation from a woman;
title: adhyāyaḥ 020

sanskrit_iast:
patnyā naro muniśreṣṭha bhāryā ca patinā 1 saha .
tāmahaṃ śrotumicchāmi vidhavā strī na jāyate . .
upoṣitena yenārya patnyā ca sahito naraḥ . . 2
meaning:
पत्न्या नरो मुनिश्रेष्ठ भार्या च पतिना 1 सह .
तामहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि विधवा स्त्री न जायते . .
उपोषितेन येनार्य पत्न्या च सहितो नरः . . 2
text_mt: A man from his wife, O best of sages, and a wife from her husband. / I desire to hear about that by which a woman does not become a widow, / [and] by fasting on which, O noble one, a man remains united with his wife.

sanskrit_iast:
tanme brūhi dvijaśreṣṭha śreyo'rthaṃ narayoṣitām .
yena me kautukaṃ brahmañchrutvāpūrvaṃ prasarpati . . 3
meaning:
तन्मे ब्रूहि द्विजश्रेष्ठ श्रेयोऽर्थं नरयोषिताम् .
येन मे कौतुकं ब्रह्मञ्छ्रुत्वापूर्वं प्रसर्पति . . 3
text_mt: Tell that to me, O best of the twice-born, for the welfare of men and women, / whereby, having heard it anew, O brāhmaṇa, my curiosity is aroused.

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
aśūnyaśayanāṃ nāma dvitīyāṃ śṛṇu bhārata .
yāmupoṣya na vaidhavyaṃ strī prayāti narādhipa . .
patnīviyuktaśca naro na kadācitprajāyate . .4
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
अशून्यशयनां नाम द्वितीयां शृणु भारत .
यामुपोष्य न वैधव्यं स्त्री प्रयाति नराधिप . .
पत्नीवियुक्तश्च नरो न कदाचित्प्रजायते . .4
text_mt: Sumantu said: / Hear of the second lunar day named Aśūnyaśayanā, O Bhārata, / by fasting on which, O ruler of men, a woman does not suffer widowhood, / and a man is never born separated from his wife.

sanskrit_iast:
śete jagatpatiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śriyā sārdhaṃ yadā nṛpa .
aśūnyaśayanā nāma tadā grāhyā hi sā tithiḥ . . 5
meaning:
शेते जगत्पतिः कृष्णः श्रिया सार्धं यदा नृप .
अशून्यशयना नाम तदा ग्राह्या हि सा तिथिः . . 5
text_mt: When Kṛṣṇa, the lord of the universe, lies down together with Śrī, O king, / then indeed that lunar day should be observed, known as Aśūnyaśayanā.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇapakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ śrāvaṇe māsi bhārata .
idamuccārayetsnātaḥ praṇamya jagataḥ patim . .
śrīvatsadhāriṇaṃ devaṃ bhaktyābhyarcya śriyā saha . . 6
meaning:
कृष्णपक्षे द्वितीयायां श्रावणे मासि भारत .
इदमुच्चारयेत्स्नातः प्रणम्य जगतः पतिम् . .
श्रीवत्सधारिणं देवं भक्त्याभ्यर्च्य श्रिया सह . . 6
text_mt: On the second lunar day of the dark fortnight in the month of Śrāvaṇa, O Bhārata, / having bathed, bowing down to the lord of the universe, / having devoutly worshipped with Śrī the god who bears the Śrīvatsa, one should recite this:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīvatsadhāriñchrīkānta śrīvatsa śrīpate'vyaya .
gārhasthyaṃ mā praṇāśaṃ me yātu dharmārthakāmadam . . 7
meaning:
श्रीवत्सधारिञ्छ्रीकान्त श्रीवत्स श्रीपतेऽव्यय .
गार्हस्थ्यं मा प्रणाशं मे यातु धर्मार्थकामदम् . . 7
text_mt: 'O bearer of the Śrīvatsa, O beloved of Śrī, O Śrīvatsa, O Lord of Śrī, O imperishable one! / May my householder's life, which grants duty, wealth, and desire, never perish.

sanskrit_iast: gāvaśca mā praṇaśyantu mā praṇaśyantu me janāḥ . . 8
meaning: गावश्च मा प्रणश्यन्तु मा प्रणश्यन्तु मे जनाः . . 8
text_mt: May my cattle not perish, and may my people not perish.

sanskrit_iast:
jāmayo mā praṇaśyantu matto dāmpatyabhedataḥ .
lakṣmyā viyujye'haṃ deva na kadācidyathā bhavān . . 9
meaning:
जामयो मा प्रणश्यन्तु मत्तो दाम्पत्यभेदतः .
लक्ष्म्या वियुज्येऽहं देव न कदाचिद्यथा भवान् . . 9
text_mt: May my female kin not perish from me through division of husband and wife. / O God, just as you are never separated from Lakṣmī,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā kalatrasambandho deva mā me viyujyatām .
lakṣmyā na śūnyaṃ varada yathā te śayanaṃ sadā . . 1.20.10
meaning:
तथा कलत्रसम्बन्धो देव मा मे वियुज्यताम् .
लक्ष्म्या न शून्यं वरद यथा ते शयनं सदा . . 1.20.10
text_mt: O God, so let not my union with my wife be broken. / Just as your couch is never empty of Lakṣmī, O granter of boons,

sanskrit_iast:
śayyā mamāpyaśūnyāstu tathā tu madhusūdana .
evaṃ pramādya pūjāṃ ca kṛtvā lakṣmyāstathā hareḥ . . 11
meaning:
शय्या ममाप्यशून्यास्तु तथा तु मधुसूदन .
एवं प्रमाद्य पूजां च कृत्वा लक्ष्म्यास्तथा हरेः . . 11
text_mt: so also let my bed not be empty, O Madhusūdana!' / Having thus bowed down and worshipped Lakṣmī and Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
phalāni dadyācchāyāyāmabhīṣṭāni jagatpatim .
naktaṃ 1 praṇamyāyatane havirbhuñjīta vāgyataḥ . . 12
meaning:
फलानि दद्याच्छायायामभीष्टानि जगत्पतिम् .
नक्तं 1 प्रणम्यायतने हविर्भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः . . 12
text_mt: one should present desirable fruits on the bed to the lord of the universe. / At night, having bowed down at the shrine, restrained in speech, one should eat sacrificial food.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇāya dvitīye'hni śaktyā dadyācca dakṣiṇām . . 13
meaning: ब्राह्मणाय द्वितीयेऽह्नि शक्त्या दद्याच्च दक्षिणाम् . . 13
text_mt: And on the second day, one should give a priestly fee to a brāhmaṇa according to one's means.

sanskrit_iast:
śatānīka uvāca
kāni tāni abhīṣṭāni keśavasya phalāni tu .
yojyāni śayane vipra devadevasya kathyatām . . 14
meaning:
शतानीक उवाच
कानि तानि अभीष्टानि केशवस्य फलानि तु .
योज्यानि शयने विप्र देवदेवस्य कथ्यताम् . . 14
text_mt: Śatānīka said: / What are those desirable fruits of Keśava / to be offered on the bed of the god of gods? Let it be told, O brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ ca dānaṃ dvitīye'hni dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇasya tu .
bhaktairnarairdvijaśreṣṭha devadevasya śaktitaḥ . . 15
meaning:
किं च दानं द्वितीयेऽह्नि दातव्यं ब्राह्मणस्य तु .
भक्तैर्नरैर्द्विजश्रेष्ठ देवदेवस्य शक्तितः . . 15
text_mt: And what gift is to be given to a brāhmaṇa on the second day / by devoted men according to their means, O best of the twice-born, for the god of gods?

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
yāni tatra mahābāho kāle santi phalāni tu.
madhurāṇi sutīvrāṇi na cāpi kaṭukāni tu . . 16
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
यानि तत्र महाबाहो काले सन्ति फलानि तु.
मधुराणि सुतीव्राणि न चापि कटुकानि तु . . 16
text_mt: Sumantu said: / Whatever fruits exist in that season, O mighty-armed one, / that are sweet, and neither very sharp nor pungent,

sanskrit_iast:
dātavyāni nṛpaśreṣṭha svaśaktyā śayane nṛpa .
madhurāṇi pradattāni naro vallabhatāṃ yajet . . 17
meaning:
दातव्यानि नृपश्रेष्ठ स्वशक्त्या शयने नृप .
मधुराणि प्रदत्तानि नरो वल्लभतां यजेत् . . 17
text_mt: are to be offered on the bed according to one's ability, O king. / If sweet ones are presented, a man attains belovedness;

sanskrit_iast:
yoṣicca kuruśārdūla bharturvallabhatāmiyāt .
tasmātkaṭukatīvrāṇi strīliṅgāni vivarjayet . . 18
meaning:
योषिच्च कुरुशार्दूल भर्तुर्वल्लभतामियात् .
तस्मात्कटुकतीव्राणि स्त्रीलिङ्गानि विवर्जयेत् . . 18
text_mt: and a woman, O tiger of the Kurus, attains the love of her husband. / Therefore, one should avoid pungent, sharp fruits of feminine gender.

sanskrit_iast:
kharjūramātuliṅgāni śvetena śirasā saha .
phalāni śayane rājanyajñabhāgaharasya tu . . 19
meaning:
खर्जूरमातुलिङ्गानि श्वेतेन शिरसा सह .
फलानि शयने राजन्यज्ञभागहरस्य तु . . 19
text_mt: Dates and citrons with white tips— / such fruits on the bed, O king, of the recipient of the sacrificial share,

sanskrit_iast:
deyāni kuruśārdūla svaśaktyā muñjakeśine .
etānyeva tu viprasya gāṅgeyasahitāni tu . . 1.20.20
meaning:
देयानि कुरुशार्दूल स्वशक्त्या मुञ्जकेशिने .
एतान्येव तु विप्रस्य गाङ्गेयसहितानि तु . . 1.20.20
text_mt: are to be offered to Muñjakeśin according to one's means, O tiger of the Kurus. / These very same, along with gold,

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye'hni pradeyāni bhaktyā śaktyā ca bhārata .
vāsodānaṃ tathā dhānyaphaladānasamanvitam . .
gāṅgeyasya viśeṣeṇa dhānyadānaṃ pracakṣate . . 21
meaning:
द्वितीयेऽह्नि प्रदेयानि भक्त्या शक्त्या च भारत .
वासोदानं तथा धान्यफलदानसमन्वितम् . .
गाङ्गेयस्य विशेषेण धान्यदानं प्रचक्षते . . 21
text_mt: should be presented to a brāhmaṇa on the second day with devotion and according to one's means, O Bhārata, / together with a gift of cloth, grain, and fruit. / They especially praise the gift of grain along with gold.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ karoti yaḥ samyaṅnaro māsacatuṣṭayam .
tato janmatrayaṃ vīra gṛhabhaṅgo na jāyate . . 22
meaning:
एवं करोति यः सम्यङ्नरो मासचतुष्टयम् .
ततो जन्मत्रयं वीर गृहभङ्गो न जायते . . 22
text_mt: Whatever man performs this properly for four months, / for three births after that, O hero, no ruin of his home occurs.

sanskrit_iast:
aśūnyaśayanaścāsau dharmakāmārthasādhanaḥ .
bhavatyavyāhataiśvaryaḥ puruṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ . . 23
meaning:
अशून्यशयनश्चासौ धर्मकामार्थसाधनः .
भवत्यव्याहतैश्वर्यः पुरुषो नात्र संशयः . . 23
text_mt: His bed never empty, he achieves duty, desire, and wealth; / a man attains unhindered sovereignty—there is no doubt of this.

sanskrit_iast:
1nārī ca rājandharmajñā vratametadyathāvidhi .
yā karoti na sā śocyā bandhuvargasya jāyate . . 24
meaning:
1नारी च राजन्धर्मज्ञा व्रतमेतद्यथाविधि .
या करोति न सा शोच्या बन्धुवर्गस्य जायते . . 24
text_mt: And the woman who knows dharma, O king, and performs this votive observance according to rule, / does not become a cause of grief for her kin.

sanskrit_iast:
vaidhavyaṃ durbhagatvaṃ ca bhartṛtyāgaṃ ca sattama .
nāpnoti janma triyatametaccīrtvā2 mahāvratam . . 25
meaning:
वैधव्यं दुर्भगत्वं च भर्तृत्यागं च सत्तम .
नाप्नोति जन्म त्रियतमेतच्चीर्त्वा2 महाव्रतम् . . 25
text_mt: Widowhood, misfortune, and abandonment by her husband, O best of men, / she never meets for three hundred births, having performed this great votive observance.

sanskrit_iast:
adattvā kaṭukānīha phalāni kurunandana .
kharjūramātuliṅgāni bṛhatphalaśirāṃsi ca . . 26
meaning:
अदत्त्वा कटुकानीह फलानि कुरुनन्दन .
खर्जूरमातुलिङ्गानि बृहत्फलशिरांसि च . . 26
text_mt: Not giving pungent fruits here, O delight of the Kurus, / [but] dates, citrons, and large-topped fruits,

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā dvijebhyo rājendra madhurāṇi parāṇi ca .
tasmātsvaśaktyā yattena deyāni madhurāṇi ca . . 27
meaning:
दत्त्वा द्विजेभ्यो राजेन्द्र मधुराणि पराणि च .
तस्मात्स्वशक्त्या यत्तेन देयानि मधुराणि च . . 27
text_mt: having given other sweet ones to the twice-born, O lord of kings; / therefore, sweet ones should be given with effort according to one's means.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣā kathitā kṛṣṇadvitīyā tithiruttamā .
yāmupoṣya naro rājannṛddhiṃ vṛddhiṃ tathā vrajet . . 28
meaning:
इत्येषा कथिता कृष्णद्वितीया तिथिरुत्तमा .
यामुपोष्य नरो राजन्नृद्धिं वृद्धिं तथा व्रजेत् . . 28
text_mt: Thus has the excellent second lunar day of the dark fortnight been related, / by fasting on which a man attains prosperity and growth, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
śatānīka uvāca
bhavatā kathiteyaṃ vai dvitīyā tithiruttamā .
aśvibhyāṃ dvijaśārdūla kathamasyāṃ janārdanaḥ . . 29
meaning:
शतानीक उवाच
भवता कथितेयं वै द्वितीया तिथिरुत्तमा .
अश्विभ्यां द्विजशार्दूल कथमस्यां जनार्दनः . . 29
text_mt: Śatānīka said: / This excellent second lunar day was spoken of by you / as belonging to the two Aśvins, O tiger among the twice-born. How then is Janārdana

sanskrit_iast:
sampūjyaḥ phalasaṃjñāyāṃ kathitaḥ padmayā saha .
tadatra kautukaṃ mahyaṃ sumahajjāyate dvija . . 1.20.30
meaning:
सम्पूज्यः फलसंज्ञायां कथितः पद्मया सह .
तदत्र कौतुकं मह्यं सुमहज्जायते द्विज . . 1.20.30
text_mt: said to be worshipped on this [day] called Phalā along with Padmā? / Therefore, very great curiosity arises in me on this point, O twice-born one.

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
evametanna sandeho tathā vadasi bhārata .
aśvinorvai tithiriyaṃ kiṃ tu vākyaṃ nibodha me . . 31
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
एवमेतन्न सन्देहो तथा वदसि भारत .
अश्विनोर्वै तिथिरियं किं तु वाक्यं निबोध मे . . 31
text_mt: Sumantu said: / It is just so, there is no doubt, as you say, O Bhārata; / this lunar day indeed belongs to the Aśvins. But hear my words:

sanskrit_iast:
aśūnyaśayanā dattā 1viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ .
aśvibhyāṃ kuru śārdūla prītaye muñjakeśinaḥ . . 32
meaning:
अशून्यशयना दत्ता 1विष्णोरमिततेजसः .
अश्विभ्यां कुरु शार्दूल प्रीतये मुञ्जकेशिनः . . 32
text_mt: Aśūnyaśayanā was given to Viṣṇu of immeasurable splendour / by the two Aśvins, O tiger of the Kurus, for the pleasure of Muñjakeśin.

sanskrit_iast:
tāveva kuruśārdūla pūjyete'tra mahīpate .
nāsatyau bhagavānviṣṇurdattaśca śrīrvibhāvyate . . 33
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe śatārddhasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ brāhme parvaṇi
dvitīyākalpasamāptau viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ . 20 .
tṛtīyātithivratamāhātmyam
meaning:
तावेव कुरुशार्दूल पूज्येतेऽत्र महीपते .
नासत्यौ भगवान्विष्णुर्दत्तश्च श्रीर्विभाव्यते . . 33
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे शतार्द्धसाहस्र्यां संहितायां ब्राह्मे पर्वणि
द्वितीयाकल्पसमाप्तौ विंशोऽध्यायः . 20 .
तृतीयातिथिव्रतमाहात्म्यम्
text_mt:
Those two alone, O tiger among the Kurus, are worshipped here, O king: / the Nāsatyas, Lord Viṣṇu, Datta, and Śrī are contemplated.
Thus ends the twentieth chapter in the Brāhmaparvan, on the completion of the procedure for the second lunar day, in the Śatārdhasāhasrī Saṃhitā of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
The greatness of the votive observance of the third lunar day

sanskrit_iast:
sumantaruvāca
pativratā patiprāṇā patiśuśrūṣaṇe ratā .
evaṃvidhāpi yā proktā śuciḥ saṃśobhanā satī . . 1
meaning:
सुमन्तरुवाच
पतिव्रता पतिप्राणा पतिशुश्रूषणे रता .
एवंविधापि या प्रोक्ता शुचिः संशोभना सती . . 1
text_mt: Sumantu said: / A wife devoted to her husband, having her husband as her life-breath, delighting in attendance on her husband— / even being such, she who is proclaimed pure, radiant, and virtuous,
title: Tṛtīyākalpavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
sopavāsā tṛtīyāṃ tu lavaṇaṃ parivarjayet .
sā gṛhṇāti ca vai bhaktyā vratamāmaraṇāntikam . . 2
meaning:
सोपवासा तृतीयां तु लवणं परिवर्जयेत् .
सा गृह्णाति च वै भक्त्या व्रतमामरणान्तिकम् . . 2
text_mt: fasting on the third lunar day, should avoid salt. / And she undertakes with devotion this votive observance that lasts until death.

sanskrit_iast:
gaurī dadāti santuṣṭā rūpaṃ saubhāgyameva ca .
lāvaṇyaṃ lalitaṃ hṛdyaṃ ślāghyaṃ puṃsāṃ manoramam . . 3
meaning:
गौरी ददाति सन्तुष्टा रूपं सौभाग्यमेव च .
लावण्यं ललितं हृद्यं श्लाघ्यं पुंसां मनोरमम् . . 3
text_mt: Gaurī, being pleased, bestows beauty and good fortune, / charm that is delicate, endearing, praiseworthy, and delightful to men.

sanskrit_iast:
puṃso manoramā nārī bharttā nāryā manoramaḥ .
gaurīvratena bhavati rājam̐llavaṇavarjanāt . . 4
meaning:
पुंसो मनोरमा नारी भर्त्ता नार्या मनोरमः .
गौरीव्रतेन भवति राजम्̐ल्लवणवर्जनात् . . 4
text_mt: A woman becomes delightful to a man, and a husband delightful to a woman, / through the votive observance of Gaurī by abandoning salt, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ vrataṃ prati vibho dharmarājasya śṛṇvataḥ .
umayā ca purā proktaṃ yadvākyaṃ tannibodha me . . 5
meaning:
इदं व्रतं प्रति विभो धर्मराजस्य शृण्वतः .
उमया च पुरा प्रोक्तं यद्वाक्यं तन्निबोध मे . . 5
text_mt: Regarding this votive observance, O mighty one, hear from me the speech / that was spoken long ago by Umā to Dharmarāja as he listened:

sanskrit_iast:
mayā vratamidaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ saubhāgyakaraṇaṃ nṛṇām .
martye tu niyatā nārī vratametaccariṣyati . .
saha bhartrā sa modeta yathā bhartā haro mama . . 6
meaning:
मया व्रतमिदं सृष्टं सौभाग्यकरणं नृणाम् .
मर्त्ये तु नियता नारी व्रतमेतच्चरिष्यति . .
सह भर्त्रा स मोदेत यथा भर्ता हरो मम . . 6
text_mt: “This votive observance was created by me to bestow good fortune on human beings. / In the mortal realm, a restrained woman will perform this votive observance; / she will rejoice with her husband, just as my husband Hara [rejoices with me].

sanskrit_iast:
yā ca kanyā na bhartāraṃ vindate śobhanā satī .
sā tvidaṃ vratamuddiśya bhavedakṣārabhojanā . .
maccittā manmanāḥ kuryānmadbhaktā matparigrahā . . 7
meaning:
या च कन्या न भर्तारं विन्दते शोभना सती .
सा त्विदं व्रतमुद्दिश्य भवेदक्षारभोजना . .
मच्चित्ता मन्मनाः कुर्यान्मद्भक्ता मत्परिग्रहा . . 7
text_mt: And an unmarried girl, beautiful and virtuous, who does not obtain a husband, / should eat food free of salt with this votive observance as her goal. / With mind on me, with thought on me, devoted to me, and accepting me, she should perform it.

sanskrit_iast:
gaurīṃ saṃsthāpya sauvarṇīṃ gandhālaṅkārabhūṣitām .
vastrālaṅkārasaṃvītāṃ puṣpamaṇḍalamaṇḍitām . . 8
lavaṇaṃ guḍaṃ ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ devyai śaktyā nivedayet . 1
meaning:
गौरीं संस्थाप्य सौवर्णीं गन्धालङ्कारभूषिताम् .
वस्त्रालङ्कारसंवीतां पुष्पमण्डलमण्डिताम् . . 8
लवणं गुडं घृतं तैलं देव्यै शक्त्या निवेदयेत् . 1
text_mt:
Having installed a golden image of Gaurī, adorned with perfumes and ornaments, / clothed in garments and adornments, and decorated with a circle of flowers,
she should offer salt, jaggery, clarified butter, and oil to the goddess according to her ability,

sanskrit_iast: kaṭukhaṇḍaṃ jīrakaṃ ca patraśākaṃ ca bhārata . . 9
meaning: कटुखण्डं जीरकं च पत्रशाकं च भारत . . 9
text_mt: and pieces of pungent roots, cumin, and leafy vegetables, O Bhārata,

sanskrit_iast:
guḍaghṛṣṭāṃstathāpūpānkhaḍaveṣṭāṃstathā nṛpa .
brāhmaṇe vratasampanne pradadyātsubahuśrute . . 1.21.10
meaning:
गुडघृष्टांस्तथापूपान्खडवेष्टांस्तथा नृप .
ब्राह्मणे व्रतसम्पन्ने प्रदद्यात्सुबहुश्रुते . . 1.21.10
text_mt: as well as cakes smeared with jaggery and pastries fried in ghee, O king; / she should give them to a learned brāhmaṇa accomplished in votive observances.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklapakṣe sadā deyā yathā śaktyā hiraṇmayī .
dhanahīne tu bhaktyā2 ca madhuvṛkṣamayī nṛpa . . 11
meaning:
शुक्लपक्षे सदा देया यथा शक्त्या हिरण्मयी .
धनहीने तु भक्त्या2 च मधुवृक्षमयी नृप . . 11
text_mt: In the bright fortnight, a golden image should always be given according to one’s means, / but if devoid of wealth, O king, an image made of madhūka wood [may be given] with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
arcyā nityaṃ saṃnidhānāttatra gaurī na saṃśayaḥ .
akṣāralavaṇaṃ rātrau bhuṃkte caiva suvāgyatā . . 12
meaning:
