text_mt: Brahmins are not white like the rays of the moon; kṣatriyas are not of the colour of the kiṃśuka flower; / vaiśyas here are not like yellow orpiment; and śūdras are not the colour of charcoal.

sanskrit_iast:
pādapracāraistanuvarṇakeśaiḥ sukhena duḥkhena ca śoṇitena .
tvaṅmāṃsamedosthirasaiḥ1 samānāścatuṣprabhedā hi kathaṃ bhavanti ..42
meaning:
पादप्रचारैस्तनुवर्णकेशैः सुखेन दुःखेन च शोणितेन .
त्वङ्मांसमेदोस्थिरसैः1 समानाश्चतुष्प्रभेदा हि कथं भवन्ति ..42
text_mt: Being equal in the movements of their feet, in the colour of their bodies and hair, in joy and sorrow, in blood, / in skin, flesh, fat, bones, and semen, how can there be four divisions?

sanskrit_iast:
varṇapramāṇākṛtigarbhavāsavāgbuddhikarmendriyajīviteṣu .
balatrivargāmayabheṣajeṣu na vidyate jātikṛto viśeṣaḥ ..43
meaning:
वर्णप्रमाणाकृतिगर्भवासवाग्बुद्धिकर्मेन्द्रियजीवितेषु .
बलत्रिवर्गामयभेषजेषु न विद्यते जातिकृतो विशेषः ..43
text_mt: In complexion, stature, bodily form, stay in the womb, speech, intellect, organs of action, and life, / in strength, the three aims of life, disease, and medicine, no distinction created by birth is found.

sanskrit_iast:
sa eka evātra patiḥ prajānāṃ kathaṃ punarjātikṛtaḥ prabhedaḥ .
pramāṇadṛṣṭāntanayapravādaiḥ parīkṣyamāṇo vighaṭatvameti ..44
meaning:
स एक एवात्र पतिः प्रजानां कथं पुनर्जातिकृतः प्रभेदः .
प्रमाणदृष्टान्तनयप्रवादैः परीक्ष्यमाणो विघटत्वमेति ..44
text_mt: He alone is the single lord of creatures here; how then is there a division made by birth? / When examined through means of valid cognition, examples, and logical arguments, it dissolves.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāra ekasya pituḥ sutāśca teṣāṃ sutānāṃ khalu jātirekā .
evaṃ prajānāṃ hi pitaika evaṃ pitraikabhāvānna ca jātibhedaḥ ..45
meaning:
चत्वार एकस्य पितुः सुताश्च तेषां सुतानां खलु जातिरेका .
एवं प्रजानां हि पितैक एवं पित्रैकभावान्न च जातिभेदः ..45
text_mt: Four are the sons of one father, and those sons indeed have one and the same birth; / in this way, there is truly only one father of creatures; and because of the oneness of the father, there is no difference of birth.

sanskrit_iast:
phalānyathodumbaravṛkṣajāteryathāgramadhyāntabhavāni yāni .
varṇākṛtisparśarasaiḥ samāni tathaikato jātiratipracintyā ..46
meaning:
फलान्यथोदुम्बरवृक्षजातेर्यथाग्रमध्यान्तभवानि यानि .
वर्णाकृतिस्पर्शरसैः समानि तथैकतो जातिरतिप्रचिन्त्या ..46
text_mt: Just as the fruits born of the fig-tree species, whether grown at the tip, the middle, or the bottom, / are equal in colour, shape, touch, and taste, so birth from one source should be deeply considered.

sanskrit_iast:
ye kauśikāḥ kāśyapagautamāśca kauṃḍinyamāṇḍavyavaśiṣṭhagotrāḥ .
ātreyakautsāṅgirasaḥ sagargā maudgalyakātyāyanabhārgavāśca ..47
meaning:
ये कौशिकाः काश्यपगौतमाश्च कौंडिन्यमाण्डव्यवशिष्ठगोत्राः .
आत्रेयकौत्साङ्गिरसः सगर्गा मौद्गल्यकात्यायनभार्गवाश्च ..47
text_mt: Those who belong to the Kauśika, Kāśyapa, and Gautama lineages, and the Kauṇḍinya, Māṇḍavya, and Vasiṣṭha lineages, / the Ātreyas, Kautsas, and Āṅgirasas, along with the Gargas, Maudgalyas, Kātyāyanas, and Bhārgavas—

sanskrit_iast:
gotrāṇi nānāvidhajātayaśca bhrātṛsnuṣāmaithunaputrabhāvāḥ .
vaivāhikaṃ karma na varṇabhedaḥ sarvāṇi śilpāni bhavanti teṣām ..48
meaning:
गोत्राणि नानाविधजातयश्च भ्रातृस्नुषामैथुनपुत्रभावाः .
वैवाहिकं कर्म न वर्णभेदः सर्वाणि शिल्पानि भवन्ति तेषाम् ..48
text_mt: lineages, various castes, brotherly, daughter-in-law, marital, and filial relations, / marriage rites, and lack of distinction of class—all these crafts belong to them.

sanskrit_iast:
ye cānye2 paṇḍitāḥ prāhurdehabrāhmaṇatāṃ narāḥ .
teṣāṃ durdṛṣṭitimiramapanīyānukampya ca ..49
meaning:
ये चान्ये2 पण्डिताः प्राहुर्देहब्राह्मणतां नराः .
तेषां दुर्दृष्टितिमिरमपनीयानुकम्प्य च ..49
text_mt: And whatever other men, claiming to be learned, assert that brahminhood resides in the body, / having dispelled the darkness of their faulty vision and feeling compassion for them,

sanskrit_iast:
nyāyāñjanauṣadhairdivyaiḥ pariṇāmasukhāvahaiḥ .
upanītaḥ prayatnena sudṛṣṭiṃ saṃvidadmahe ..1.41.50
meaning:
न्यायाञ्जनौषधैर्दिव्यैः परिणामसुखावहैः .
उपनीतः प्रयत्नेन सुदृष्टिं संविदद्महे ..1.41.50
text_mt: by means of the divine medicine of the collyrium of logic, which brings happiness in its result, / we shall diligently lead them and impart correct vision.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtimattvācca nāśitvaṃ nāśitvāccheṣabhūtavat1 .
dehādhāraniviṣṭānāṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ na prakalpyate . .5 1
ekaikovayavasteṣāṃ na brāhmaṇyaṃ samaśnute .
na cānekasamūhe'pi sarvathātiprasaṅgataḥ . .52
meaning:
मृतिमत्त्वाच्च नाशित्वं नाशित्वाच्छेषभूतवत्1 .
देहाधारनिविष्टानां ब्राह्मण्यं न प्रकल्प्यते . .5 1
एकैकोवयवस्तेषां न ब्राह्मण्यं समश्नुते .
न चानेकसमूहेऽपि सर्वथातिप्रसङ्गतः . .52
text_mt: Because it possesses mortality, it has destructibility; and because of destructibility, like all other entities, / brahminhood cannot be assumed for those who reside in the substratum of a body. / Each single limb of theirs does not possess brahminhood, / nor does a collective assemblage of many, on pain of total absurdity in every way.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyudakavāyyagnipariṇāmaviśeṣataḥ .
dehataḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ brāhmaṇatvaprasaṅgataḥ . .53
meaning:
पृथिव्युदकवाय्यग्निपरिणामविशेषतः .
देहतः सर्वभूतानां ब्राह्मणत्वप्रसङ्गतः . .53
text_mt: From the transformation of earth, water, air, and fire into a body, / [if brahminhood were bodily], there would absurdly follow the brahminhood of all living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
dehasya brāhmaṇatvaṃ yairatattvajñaiḥ prakalpyate .
saṃskartṝṇāṃ śarīrasya teṣāṃ na brahmatā bhavet . .54
meaning:
देहस्य ब्राह्मणत्वं यैरतत्त्वज्ञैः प्रकल्प्यते .
संस्कर्तॄणां शरीरस्य तेषां न ब्रह्मता भवेत् . .54
text_mt: For those ignorant of reality who imagine that the body has the nature of a brāhmaṇa, / those who consecrate the body could not possess the state of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgyamāṇe prayatnena dehe tannopalabhyate .
tasmānna dehe brāhmaṇyaṃ nāpi dehātmakaṃ bhavet . .55
meaning:
मृग्यमाणे प्रयत्नेन देहे तन्नोपलभ्यते .
तस्मान्न देहे ब्राह्मण्यं नापि देहात्मकं भवेत् . .55
text_mt: When searched for with effort in the body, it is not found; / therefore, the state of a brāhmaṇa is not in the body, nor can it consist of the body.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāpasadacāṃḍālaśvādādīnāṃ3 prasajyate .
yadi dehasya vipratvaṃ bhavadbhirupagamyate . .56
meaning:
वर्णापसदचांडालश्वादादीनां3 प्रसज्यते .
यदि देहस्य विप्रत्वं भवद्भिरुपगम्यते . .56
text_mt: It would follow [also] for outcasts of mixed caste, caṇḍālas, dog-eaters, and the like, / if you accept that the body has the state of a vipra.

sanskrit_iast:
dehaśaktiguṇaiḥ kṣīṇaiḥ kāyabhasmādirūpavat .
tasmāddehātmakenaitadbrāhmaṇyaṃ nāpi karmajam . . 57
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe śatārdhasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ brāhme parvaṇi ṣaṣṭhīkalpe
brāhmaṇyavivekavarṇanaṃ nāmaikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .4 1 .
brāhmaṇasaṃskāravivekavarṇanam
meaning:
देहशक्तिगुणैः क्षीणैः कायभस्मादिरूपवत् .
तस्माद्देहात्मकेनैतद्ब्राह्मण्यं नापि कर्मजम् . . 57
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे शतार्धसाहस्र्यां संहितायां ब्राह्मे पर्वणि षष्ठीकल्पे
ब्राह्मण्यविवेकवर्णनं नामैकचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः .4 1 .
ब्राह्मणसंस्कारविवेकवर्णनम्
text_mt:
When the powers and qualities of the body decay, [it becomes] like the form of ashes and the rest of the body; / therefore, this state of a brāhmaṇa does not consist of the body, nor is it born of action.
Thus ends the forty-first chapter, named 'Description of Discernment of the Nature of a Brāhmaṇa', in the ritual of Ṣaṣṭhī, in the Brāhmaparvan, in the fifty-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa. 41.
Description of Discernment Concerning the Consecrations of a Brāhmaṇa

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
aparaiśca sadācārayogayuktairmanīṣibhiḥ .
yadakāri mahāsattvaiḥ subhāṣitamidaṃ śṛṇu . . 1
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
अपरैश्च सदाचारयोगयुक्तैर्मनीषिभिः .
यदकारि महासत्त्वैः सुभाषितमिदं शृणु . . 1
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Listen to this wise saying composed by other wise men, / great beings endowed with good conduct and yoga:
title: Brāhmaṇasaṃskāravivekavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
bahuvanaspatiśaṅkhapipīlikābhramaravāraṇajātimudāharan.
gatiṣu karmamito naṭavatsadā bhramati janturalabdhasudarśanaḥ . . 2
meaning:
बहुवनस्पतिशङ्खपिपीलिकाभ्रमरवारणजातिमुदाहरन्.
गतिषु कर्ममितो नटवत्सदा भ्रमति जन्तुरलब्धसुदर्शनः . . 2
text_mt: Passing through the species of various trees, conches, ants, bees, and elephants, / measured by his action across destinies, the creature, not having attained right vision, wanders constantly like an actor.

sanskrit_iast:
rūpaiśvaryajñānakulairvibhavairvarmito bhūtvā dharmapathaṃ cedvijahāsi .
na vakṣye vrajanbhuvanāni tvamaṭiṣyaṃstasmādabhibhasmībhūte mada ātmanaḥ . . 3
meaning:
रूपैश्वर्यज्ञानकुलैर्विभवैर्वर्मितो भूत्वा धर्मपथं चेद्विजहासि .
न वक्ष्ये व्रजन्भुवनानि त्वमटिष्यंस्तस्मादभिभस्मीभूते मद आत्मनः . . 3
text_mt: If, armoured with beauty, sovereignty, knowledge, lineages, and powers, you abandon the path of dharma, / I shall not speak; you will wander, roaming the worlds; therefore, let pride in oneself be turned to ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
jātikularūpavayovarṇānekaśrutamadāndhāḥ klībāḥ .
paratra ceha ca hitamapyarthaṃ na paśyanti . .4
meaning:
जातिकुलरूपवयोवर्णानेकश्रुतमदान्धाः क्लीबाः .
परत्र चेह च हितमप्यर्थं न पश्यन्ति . .4
text_mt: Blinded by the intoxication of birth, family, beauty, youth, caste, and diverse learning, impotent men / do not see their true welfare, whether here or in the hereafter.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā bhavaparivarte jātīnāṃ koṭiśatasahasreṣu .
hīnottamamadhyatvaṃ ko jātimadaṃ budhaḥ kuryāt . . 5
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा भवपरिवर्ते जातीनां कोटिशतसहस्रेषु .
हीनोत्तममध्यत्वं को जातिमदं बुधः कुर्यात् . . 5
text_mt: Knowing, in the turning of worldly existence through hundreds of thousands of crores of births, / the states of low, high, and middling, what wise man would harbor pride in birth?

sanskrit_iast:
naikāñjātiviśeṣānindriyanivṛttipūrvakānsarvān .
karmavaśādgacchatyatra kasyaikā śāśvatī jātiḥ . . 6
meaning:
नैकाञ्जातिविशेषानिन्द्रियनिवृत्तिपूर्वकान्सर्वान् .
कर्मवशाद्गच्छत्यत्र कस्यैका शाश्वती जातिः . . 6
text_mt: Under the power of karma, one goes through multiple distinct births, all preceded by the cessation of the sense organs; / whose birth here is single and eternal?

sanskrit_iast:
vidvatsadasi yo'pyāha saṃskārādbrāhmaṇo bhavan .
nyāyajñaiḥ1 sa nirākāryo vākyairnyāyānusāribhiḥ . . 7
meaning:
विद्वत्सदसि योऽप्याह संस्काराद्ब्राह्मणो भवन् .
न्यायज्ञैः1 स निराकार्यो वाक्यैर्न्यायानुसारिभिः . . 7
text_mt: Whoever declares in an assembly of scholars, 'One becomes a brāhmaṇa from consecration,' / he is to be refuted by those skilled in reasoning, with statements following logical method.

sanskrit_iast:
garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanaṃ tathā .
jātakarma nāmakarma tathānnaprāśanaṃ ca vai . . 8
meaning:
गर्भाधानं पुंसवनं सीमन्तोन्नयनं तथा .
जातकर्म नामकर्म तथान्नप्राशनं च वै . . 8
text_mt: The conception rite, the rite to cause male birth, the parting of the hair, / the birth rite, the naming ceremony, and indeed the first feeding of solid food,

sanskrit_iast:
cūḍopanayanaṃ cāsya vratādeśastathaiva ca .
samāvartanamapyanyatpāṇigrahaṇameva ca . . 9
meaning:
चूडोपनयनं चास्य व्रतादेशस्तथैव च .
समावर्तनमप्यन्यत्पाणिग्रहणमेव च . . 9
text_mt: his tonsure, the sacred thread investiture, the instruction in vows, / and another, the formal return from student life, and the taking of the bride's hand—

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamādisaṃskāravidhānairye'tisaṃskṛtāḥ .
ta eva brāhmaṇā yeṣāṃ nairantaryeṇa2 kāmanāḥ . . 1.42.10
meaning:
इत्येवमादिसंस्कारविधानैर्येऽतिसंस्कृताः .
त एव ब्राह्मणा येषां नैरन्तर्येण2 कामनाः . . 1.42.10
text_mt: those who are thoroughly consecrated by these and other rules of consecration / are alone called brāhmaṇas whose desires are uninterrupted.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmādvai brāhmaṇā jātā brāhmaṇaiḥ kṛtasaṃskṛtaiḥ .
nāyuḥ śaktirhi kāntyādiviśeṣo vidyate sphuṭaḥ . . 11
meaning:
यस्माद्वै ब्राह्मणा जाता ब्राह्मणैः कृतसंस्कृतैः .
नायुः शक्तिर्हि कान्त्यादिविशेषो विद्यते स्फुटः . . 11
text_mt: Since brāhmaṇas are indeed born of brāhmaṇas made consecrated, / yet no distinct difference in lifespan, power, luster, and so forth is evident,

sanskrit_iast:
tau vā brāhmaṇagātrotthau saṃskṛtāsaṃskṛtau narau .
iṣṭāniṣṭāptyanāptibhyāṃ na bhidyete parasparam . . 12
meaning:
तौ वा ब्राह्मणगात्रोत्थौ संस्कृतासंस्कृतौ नरौ .
इष्टानिष्टाप्त्यनाप्तिभ्यां न भिद्येते परस्परम् . . 12
text_mt: the two men born from the body of a brāhmaṇa, one consecrated and one unconsecrated, / do not differ from one another in the attainment or non-attainment of the desired and the undesired.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānādhyayanamīmāṃsā niyamendriyanigrahaiḥ .
vinā saṃskārayoge'pi puṃsaḥ śūdrānna bhinnatā . . 13
meaning:
ज्ञानाध्ययनमीमांसा नियमेन्द्रियनिग्रहैः .
विना संस्कारयोगेऽपि पुंसः शूद्रान्न भिन्नता . . 13
text_mt: Without knowledge, study, inquiry, rules, and restraint of the senses, / even when joined with consecrations, a man is not different from a śūdra.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃskāraḥ kriyamāṇaśca na śūdre ca pravartate .
saṃskṛtāṅgaśca1 pāpebhyo na paśyati nivartate . . 14
meaning:
संस्कारः क्रियमाणश्च न शूद्रे च प्रवर्तते .
संस्कृताङ्गश्च1 पापेभ्यो न पश्यति निवर्तते . . 14
text_mt: A consecration, even when performed, does not take effect upon a śūdra; / and one whose limbs are consecrated is not seen to turn away from sins.

sanskrit_iast:
vilāsinībhujaṃgādijanavanmadavihvalāḥ .
vyāmuhyanti sadācārādbrāhmaṇatvātpatanti3 ca . . 15
meaning:
विलासिनीभुजंगादिजनवन्मदविह्वलाः .
व्यामुह्यन्ति सदाचाराद्ब्राह्मणत्वात्पतन्ति3 च . . 15
text_mt: Distraught with passion, like men fond of wanton women, gallants, and the like, / they wander deluded from good conduct and fall from the state of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃskṛto'pi durācāro narakaṃ yāti mānavaḥ .
niḥsaṃskāraḥ sadācāro bhavedviprottamaḥ sadā . . 16
meaning:
संस्कृतोऽपि दुराचारो नरकं याति मानवः .
निःसंस्कारः सदाचारो भवेद्विप्रोत्तमः सदा . . 16
text_mt: Even if consecrated, a man of bad conduct goes to hell; / one devoid of consecrations who has good conduct becomes forever the best of vipras.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrapūtātmasaṃskārayukto'pi plavate na tu .
brāhmaṇyādavikalpaṃ sa paścādduścarito naraḥ . . 17
meaning:
मन्त्रपूतात्मसंस्कारयुक्तोऽपि प्लवते न तु .
ब्राह्मण्यादविकल्पं स पश्चाद्दुश्चरितो नरः . . 17
text_mt: Even if endowed with the consecration of the self purified by mantras, / a man of wicked conduct does not afterwards remain secure without doubt in the state of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmarthyātpatanaṃ tasmādbrāhmaṇyānmucyate dhruvam .
duranuṣṭhānasaktānāṃ puṃsāṃ puruṣapuṅgavaiḥ . . 18
meaning:
सामर्थ्यात्पतनं तस्माद्ब्राह्मण्यान्मुच्यते ध्रुवम् .
दुरनुष्ठानसक्तानां पुंसां पुरुषपुङ्गवैः . . 18
text_mt: Therefore, by the power [of truth], falling from the state of a brāhmaṇa is assuredly taught by the bulls among men / for persons addicted to bad practice.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ kvaciddṛṣṭamevaitatkiṃ vā spardhāvidatyayam .
tulyamutsahase kartumapyadṛṣṭaṃ tadā vada . . 19
meaning:
किं क्वचिद्दृष्टमेवैतत्किं वा स्पर्धाविदत्ययम् .
तुल्यमुत्सहसे कर्तुमप्यदृष्टं तदा वद . . 19
text_mt: Has this been seen anywhere, or is it an excess known through rivalry? / Tell me then, do you venture to treat the unseen as equal [to the seen]?

sanskrit_iast:
ācāramanuṣṭhinto vyāsādimunisattamāḥ .
garbhādhānādisaṃskārakalāparahitāḥ sphuṭam . . 1.42.20
meaning:
आचारमनुष्ठिन्तो व्यासादिमुनिसत्तमाः .
गर्भाधानादिसंस्कारकलापरहिताः स्फुटम् . . 1.42.20
text_mt: The best of sages, such as Vyāsa and others, practicing proper conduct, / were plainly devoid of the group of consecrations beginning with the conception rite,

sanskrit_iast:
viprottamāḥ śriyaṃ prāptāḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtāḥ .
bahavaḥ kathyamānā ye katicittānnibodhata . . 21
meaning:
विप्रोत्तमाः श्रियं प्राप्ताः सर्वलोकनमस्कृताः .
बहवः कथ्यमाना ये कतिचित्तान्निबोधत . . 21
text_mt: yet attained fortune as the best of vipras, revered by all the worlds. / Many are mentioned; learn of a few of them:

sanskrit_iast:
jāto vyāsastu kaivartyāḥ śvapākyāśca parāśaraḥ .
śukyāḥ śukaḥ kaṇādākhyastatholūkyāḥ suto'bhavat . . 22
meaning:
जातो व्यासस्तु कैवर्त्याः श्वपाक्याश्च पराशरः .
शुक्याः शुकः कणादाख्यस्तथोलूक्याः सुतोऽभवत् . . 22
text_mt: Vyāsa was born of a fisherwoman, and Parāśara of a woman of the dog-eating caste; / Śuka from a female parrot, and he who was named Kaṇāda was the son of a female owl;

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgījotharṣaśṛṅgopi vaśiṣṭho gaṇikātmajaḥ .
mandapālo4 muniśreṣṭho nāvikāpatyamucyate5 . . 23
meaning:
मृगीजोथर्षशृङ्गोपि वशिष्ठो गणिकात्मजः .
मन्दपालो4 मुनिश्रेष्ठो नाविकापत्यमुच्यते5 . . 23
text_mt: Rṣyaśṛṅga was born of a doe, and Vasiṣṭha was the son of a courtesan; / Mandapāla, the best of sages, is said to be the offspring of a boatwoman;

sanskrit_iast:
māṇḍavyo munirājastu maṇḍūkīgarbhasambhavaḥ .
bahavo'nye'pi vipratvaṃ prāptā ye pūrvavaddvijāḥ . . 24
meaning:
माण्डव्यो मुनिराजस्तु मण्डूकीगर्भसम्भवः .
बहवोऽन्येऽपि विप्रत्वं प्राप्ता ये पूर्ववद्द्विजाः . . 24
text_mt: Māṇḍavya, the king of sages, was born from the womb of a frog; / and many others, twice-born men, attained the state of a vipra as aforetold.

sanskrit_iast:
yaccaitaccārucaritairarcyamuccaritaṃ vacaḥ .
tadvicāryācarannuccairācāropacitadyutiḥ . . 25
meaning:
यच्चैतच्चारुचरितैरर्च्यमुच्चरितं वचः .
तद्विचार्याचरन्नुच्चैराचारोपचितद्युतिः . . 25
text_mt: And as for this worshipful word uttered by men of lovely conduct: / considering that, he acted high-mindedly, his splendor gathered from good conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
hariṇīgarbhasambhūta ṛṣyaśṛṅgo mahāmuniḥ .
tapasā brāhmaṇo jātaḥ saṃskārastena kāraṇam . . 26
meaning:
हरिणीगर्भसम्भूत ऋष्यशृङ्गो महामुनिः .
तपसा ब्राह्मणो जातः संस्कारस्तेन कारणम् . . 26
text_mt: The great sage Ṛṣyaśṛṅga, born from the womb of a doe, / became a brāhmaṇa through asceticism; therefore, [inner] consecration was the cause.

sanskrit_iast:
śvapākīgarbhasambhūtaḥ pitā vyāsasya pārthiva .
tapasā brāhmaṇo jātaḥ saṃskārastena kāraṇam . . 27
meaning:
श्वपाकीगर्भसम्भूतः पिता व्यासस्य पार्थिव .
तपसा ब्राह्मणो जातः संस्कारस्तेन कारणम् . . 27
text_mt: The father of Vyāsa, O king, born from the womb of a dog-eating woman, / became a brāhmaṇa through asceticism; therefore, [inner] consecration was the cause.

sanskrit_iast:
ulūkīgarbhasambhūtaḥ kaṇādākhyo mahāmuniḥ .
tapasā brāhmaṇo jātaḥ saṃskārastena kāraṇam . . 28
meaning:
उलूकीगर्भसम्भूतः कणादाख्यो महामुनिः .
तपसा ब्राह्मणो जातः संस्कारस्तेन कारणम् . . 28
text_mt: The great sage named Kaṇāda, born from the womb of a female owl, / became a brāhmaṇa through asceticism; therefore, [inner] consecration was the cause.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇikāgarbhasambhūto vaśiṣṭhaśca mahāmuniḥ .
tapasā brāhmaṇo jātaḥ saṃskārastena kāraṇam . . 29
meaning:
गणिकागर्भसम्भूतो वशिष्ठश्च महामुनिः .
तपसा ब्राह्मणो जातः संस्कारस्तेन कारणम् . . 29
text_mt: And the great sage Vasiṣṭha, born from the womb of a courtesan, / became a brāhmaṇa through asceticism; therefore, [inner] consecration was the cause.

sanskrit_iast:
nāvikāgarbhasambhūto mandapālo mahāmuniḥ .
tapasā brāhmaṇo jātaḥ saṃskārastena kāraṇam . . 1.42.30
meaning:
नाविकागर्भसम्भूतो मन्दपालो महामुनिः .
तपसा ब्राह्मणो जातः संस्कारस्तेन कारणम् . . 1.42.30
text_mt: The great sage Mandapāla, born from the womb of a boatwoman, / became a brāhmaṇa through asceticism; therefore, [inner] consecration was the cause.

sanskrit_iast:
vedatantrajasaṃskārakalāpanipuṇairapi .
vidyātapodhanabalādutkṛṣṭaṃ labhyate phalam . 31
meaning:
वेदतन्त्रजसंस्कारकलापनिपुणैरपि .
विद्यातपोधनबलादुत्कृष्टं लभ्यते फलम् . 31
text_mt: Even among those skilled in the whole group of consecrations born of the Vedas and Tantras, / the highest fruit is obtained through the power of learning and ascetic wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
labdhasaṃskāradehāśca mahāpātakino narāḥ .
yasmānnivartate brahma tasmātsāṅketikaṃ viduḥ . . 32
meaning:
लब्धसंस्कारदेहाश्च महापातकिनो नराः .
यस्मान्निवर्तते ब्रह्म तस्मात्साङ्केतिकं विदुः . . 32
text_mt: And because brāhmaṇahood departs from men who have attained consecration of the body when they commit great sins, / therefore they know it to be conventional.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe śatārdhasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ brāhme parvaṇi
ṣaṣṭhīkalpe brāhmaṇasaṃskāravivekavarṇanaṃ nāma dvācatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ . 42 .
varṇavyavasthāvarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे शतार्धसाहस्र्यां संहितायां ब्राह्मे पर्वणि
षष्ठीकल्पे ब्राह्मणसंस्कारविवेकवर्णनं नाम द्वाचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः . 42 .
वर्णव्यवस्थावर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the forty-second chapter, named 'Description of Discernment Concerning the Consecrations of a Brāhmaṇa', in the ritual of Ṣaṣṭhī, in the Brāhmaparvan, in the fifty-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa. 42.
Description of the System of Castes

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
kiṃ cānyadaparaṃ yūyaṃ vedamantravido janāḥ .
praṣṭavyāḥ kasya saṃskāre viśeṣamupagacchata . . 1
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
किं चान्यदपरं यूयं वेदमन्त्रविदो जनाः .
प्रष्टव्याः कस्य संस्कारे विशेषमुपगच्छत . . 1
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Furthermore, you people who know the Vedic mantras should be asked another question: / to what do you attribute distinction in consecration?
title: Varṇavyavasthāvarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ dehasyota yenāsau nisargamalinaḥ sthitaḥ .
śukraśoṇitasambhūtaḥ śamalodbhavakīṭavat . . 2
meaning:
किं देहस्योत येनासौ निसर्गमलिनः स्थितः .
शुक्रशोणितसम्भूतः शमलोद्भवकीटवत् . . 2
text_mt: Is it of the body? Or is it because this body remains naturally impure, / born of semen and blood, like a worm born of filth?

sanskrit_iast:
niṣekādiśmaśānāntairvividhairvidhivistaraiḥ .
dehino'tiśayaṃ kecidupagacchanti mānavāḥ . . 3
meaning:
निषेकादिश्मशानान्तैर्विविधैर्विधिविस्तरैः .
देहिनोऽतिशयं केचिदुपगच्छन्ति मानवाः . . 3
text_mt: By various detailed rituals, beginning with the insemination rite and ending at the cremation ground, / some men attribute superiority to the embodied soul.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ gūḍhamanaḥ kāyavāgviduṣṭaiḥ suceṣṭitaiḥ .
asaṃyatamanuṣyāṇāṃ pakṣo'yaṃ dūṣyate mayā . . 4
meaning:
तेषां गूढमनः कायवाग्विदुष्टैः सुचेष्टितैः .
असंयतमनुष्याणां पक्षोऽयं दूष्यते मया . . 4
text_mt: This position of undisciplined humans, whose conduct seems good while their minds, bodies, / and speech are secretly defiled, is refuted by me.

sanskrit_iast:
vaidikākhilasaṃskārasārabhūtā dvijātayaḥ .
sarvakāryakarānsarvānvṛṣalānatiśerate . . 5
meaning:
वैदिकाखिलसंस्कारसारभूता द्विजातयः .
सर्वकार्यकरान्सर्वान्वृषलानतिशेरते . . 5
text_mt: Twice-born men, who are the essence of all Vedic consecrations, / surpass all śūdras who perform all tasks.

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍakarmā vikarmastho brahmahā gurutalpagaḥ .
steno goghnaḥ surāpāṇaḥ parastrīramaṇapriyaḥ . . 6
meaning:
चण्डकर्मा विकर्मस्थो ब्रह्महा गुरुतल्पगः .
स्तेनो गोघ्नः सुरापाणः परस्त्रीरमणप्रियः . . 6
text_mt: One of fierce deeds, engaged in wrongful acts, a killer of a brāhmaṇa, one who violates the teacher's bed, / a thief, a cow-killer, a drinker of liquor, fond of sporting with other men's wives—

sanskrit_iast:
mithyāvādī madonmatto nāstiko vedanindakaḥ .
grāmayājakanirgranthau bahudoṣo durāsadaḥ . . 7
meaning:
मिथ्यावादी मदोन्मत्तो नास्तिको वेदनिन्दकः .
ग्रामयाजकनिर्ग्रन्थौ बहुदोषो दुरासदः . . 7
text_mt: a liar, intoxicated with pride, an atheist, a reviler of the Vedas, / a village priest, a mendicant ascetic, full of faults, difficult to approach,

sanskrit_iast:
ni1ṣiddhācārasaṃsevī coraścāṭo madoddhataḥ .
dhūrto naṭaḥ śaṭhaḥ pāpī sarvāśī sarvavikrayī . . 8
meaning:
नि1षिद्धाचारसंसेवी चोरश्चाटो मदोद्धतः .
धूर्तो नटः शठः पापी सर्वाशी सर्वविक्रयी . . 8
text_mt: one who indulges in forbidden conduct, a thief, a sycophant, arrogant with pride, / a rogue, an actor, a cheat, a sinner, an eater of everything, a seller of everything—

sanskrit_iast:
vāṅmanaḥ kāyajairduṣṭairhatā ye brāhmaṇādhamāḥ .
te na śuddhiṃ vrajantīha api yajñaśatairapi2 . . 9
meaning:
वाङ्मनः कायजैर्दुष्टैर्हता ये ब्राह्मणाधमाः .
ते न शुद्धिं व्रजन्तीह अपि यज्ञशतैरपि2 . . 9
text_mt: those lowest of brāhmaṇas who are ruined by vices arising from speech, mind, and body, / they do not attain purity in this world, even through hundreds of sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrāṇāṃ yānyaniṣṭāni sampadyante svabhāvataḥ .
viprāṇāmapi tānyeva nirvighnāni bhavanti na . . 1.43.10
meaning:
शूद्राणां यान्यनिष्टानि सम्पद्यन्ते स्वभावतः .
विप्राणामपि तान्येव निर्विघ्नानि भवन्ति न . . 1.43.10
text_mt: Those misfortunes that naturally befall śūdras / also befall vipras; they do not escape obstacles.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānmantrognihotraṃ vā vedyāṃ paśuvadho'pi vā .
hetavo na hi vipratve śūdraiḥ śakyā kriyā yathā . . 11
meaning:
तस्मान्मन्त्रोग्निहोत्रं वा वेद्यां पशुवधोऽपि वा .
हेतवो न हि विप्रत्वे शूद्रैः शक्या क्रिया यथा . . 11
text_mt: Therefore, neither a mantra, nor the agnihotra, nor the slaughter of a beast upon the altar / are causes for brāhmaṇahood, since such an act can be performed by śūdras.

sanskrit_iast:
ye cāpi karmabandhena baddhāḥ sīdanti jantavaḥ .
saṃsārānalasantāpaviklavīkṛtamānasāḥ . . 12
meaning:
ये चापि कर्मबन्धेन बद्धाः सीदन्ति जन्तवः .
संसारानलसन्तापविक्लवीकृतमानसाः . . 12
text_mt: And whatever living beings, bound by the fetters of action, suffer misery, / their minds unsettled by the torment of the fire of saṃsāra,

sanskrit_iast:
te janmamaraṇāṭavyāṃ sukhāmṛtapipāsavaḥ .
kṛpaṇasyāśraye'ṭanto labhante naiva nirvṛtim . . 13
meaning:
ते जन्ममरणाटव्यां सुखामृतपिपासवः .
कृपणस्याश्रयेऽटन्तो लभन्ते नैव निर्वृतिम् . . 13
text_mt: wandering in the wilderness of birth and death, thirsting for the nectar of happiness, / seeking refuge in a wretched person, they never attain peace.

sanskrit_iast:
caturvarṇā narā ye tu tattadvīrye narādhamāḥ .
teṣāṃ sarvātmanā sarvairdharmaiḥ sāṅkaryamīkṣyate .. 14
meaning:
चतुर्वर्णा नरा ये तु तत्तद्वीर्ये नराधमाः .
तेषां सर्वात्मना सर्वैर्धर्मैः साङ्कर्यमीक्ष्यते .. 14
text_mt: Moreover, among the men of the four varṇas, those lowest of men born of various seeds, / among them, total intermixture is seen in every respect through all customs.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdraviprādayo yonau na bhidyante parasparam .
sarvadharmasamānatvātsaṃskārādi nirarthakam .. 15
meaning:
शूद्रविप्रादयो योनौ न भिद्यन्ते परस्परम् .
सर्वधर्मसमानत्वात्संस्कारादि निरर्थकम् .. 15
text_mt: Śūdras, vipras, and the rest do not differ from one another in their origin; / because of the equality of all dharmas, consecrations and the like are meaningless.

sanskrit_iast:
tadanuṣṭhānavaidharmyaviyogamaraṇādibhiḥ .
asevyasevanairanyaiḥ śūdraviprādayaḥ samāḥ .. 16
meaning:
तदनुष्ठानवैधर्म्यवियोगमरणादिभिः .
असेव्यसेवनैरन्यैः शूद्रविप्रादयः समाः .. 16
text_mt: Through differences in performing rites, separation, death, and so forth, / and through other associations with what should not be associated with, śūdras, vipras, and the rest are equal.

sanskrit_iast:
buddhyā śaktyā svabhāvena dharmairjātyā1dibhiḥ śriyā .
kartavyaiḥ puṇyapāpābhyāṃ śanaiḥ2 sarvaśarīragaiḥ .. 17
meaning:
बुद्ध्या शक्त्या स्वभावेन धर्मैर्जात्या1दिभिः श्रिया .
कर्तव्यैः पुण्यपापाभ्यां शनैः2 सर्वशरीरगैः .. 17
text_mt: In intellect, capacity, innate nature, customs, caste, and so forth, in fortune, / in duties, merit and demerit gradually pervading all bodies,

sanskrit_iast:
bandhanai rodhanairnānāyātanopāyapīḍanaiḥ .
daṇḍairadaṇḍakaraṇairviṣādaparivedanaiḥ .. 18
meaning:
बन्धनै रोधनैर्नानायातनोपायपीडनैः .
दण्डैरदण्डकरणैर्विषादपरिवेदनैः .. 18
text_mt: in bindings, imprisonments, torments through various means of torture, / in punishments, unpunished deeds, despondency, and laments,

sanskrit_iast:
sāttvikaḥ pratidharmādyai rājasaiścitraveṣṭitaiḥ .
tāmasaistāpamohādyairdūyamānāḥ punaḥ1 punaḥ .. 19
meaning:
सात्त्विकः प्रतिधर्माद्यै राजसैश्चित्रवेष्टितैः .
तामसैस्तापमोहाद्यैर्दूयमानाः पुनः1 पुनः .. 19

śleśmamārutapittādyairmahābībhatsadarśanaiḥ .
kvacidvṛttinivṛttibhyāmamṛtānṛtahitāhitaiḥ ..1.43.20
meaning:
श्लेश्ममारुतपित्ताद्यैर्महाबीभत्सदर्शनैः .
क्वचिद्वृत्तिनिवृत्तिभ्याममृतानृतहिताहितैः ..1.43.20

alaṅkāropayogena manmathādyairviceṣṭitaiḥ .

ātmasnehaparadveṣasvīkṛtadravarakṣaṇaiḥ ..22

अलङ्कारोपयोगेन मन्मथाद्यैर्विचेष्टितैः .

अधिसिद्धिगतिं याति नानाविधमनोरथैः .

sanskrit_iast:
atikṣībatvasaṃkṣobhakṣutakṣāmakṣamāmayaiḥ .
yātanopāyapaiśunyaśūnyatvopaśamaistathā ..23

अतिक्षीबत्वसंक्षोभक्षुतक्षामक्षमामयैः .
यातनोपायपैशुन्यशून्यत्वोपशमैस्तथा ..23

apraśastairanuṣṭhānaiḥ samīpasthāpadaḥ samāḥ .
hiṃsakāḥ prāṇinaḥ pāpavitathālāpabhāṣiṇaḥ ..24

अप्रशस्तैरनुष्ठानैः समीपस्थापदः समाः .
हिंसकाः प्राणिनः पापवितथालापभाषिणः ..24

sanskrit_iast:
sādhūnāṃbhāṣakāḥ stenā nirdayāḥ pāradārikāḥ .
nīcakarmasamācārāḥ sarvabhakṣāḥ piśācavat ..25
meaning:
साधूनांभाषकाः स्तेना निर्दयाः पारदारिकाः .
नीचकर्मसमाचाराः सर्वभक्षाः पिशाचवत् ..25

duṣkulīnā durācārā nṛpāṇāmupajīvinaḥ .
viprakāryā vikarmasthā dhanino duṣṭacetasaḥ ..26
meaning:
दुष्कुलीना दुराचारा नृपाणामुपजीविनः .
विप्रकार्या विकर्मस्था धनिनो दुष्टचेतसः ..26
text_mt: of low birth, ill-behaved, subsisting upon kings, / conducting rites for vipras, addicted to illicit acts, wealthy, evil-minded,

sanskrit_iast:
lubdhakā hariṇānhatvā vāsaṃ kṛtvā yathā vane .
tathā khādanti piśunā bahavaśca3 kriyāvaśāt ..27
meaning:
लुब्धका हरिणान्हत्वा वासं कृत्वा यथा वने .
तथा खादन्ति पिशुना बहवश्च3 क्रियावशात् ..27

sanskrit_iast:
vedavādamadhīyānāḥ1 prāṇighātābhiśaṃsinaḥ .
puṣṇanti kapaṭairarthānvedavikrayiṇo'dhamāḥ . . 28
meaning:
वेदवादमधीयानाः1 प्राणिघाताभिशंसिनः .
पुष्णन्ति कपटैरर्थान्वेदविक्रयिणोऽधमाः . . 28
text_mt: Reciting the words of the Veda, but approving the slaughter of living beings, / those vile men who sell the Veda deceptively amass wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
māyino matsaragrastā lubdhā mugdhā madoddhatāḥ .
cāṭāḥ kārpaṭikāḥ kūrāḥ kadaryāḥ kalahapriyāḥ . . 29
meaning:
मायिनो मत्सरग्रस्ता लुब्धा मुग्धा मदोद्धताः .
चाटाः कार्पटिकाः कूराः कदर्याः कलहप्रियाः . . 29
text_mt: Deceitful, seized by envy, greedy, foolish, arrogant with pride, / flatterers, wanderers, cruel, miserly, fond of quarrels,

sanskrit_iast:
vācāṭaduṣṭakulaṭā aṭanto bhāṭakaiḥ saha .
bhaṇḍamānyā bhaṭāṭopaiḥ saṃkruddhāḥ suviluṇṭhakāḥ . . 1.43.30
meaning:
वाचाटदुष्टकुलटा अटन्तो भाटकैः सह .
भण्डमान्या भटाटोपैः संक्रुद्धाः सुविलुण्ठकाः . . 1.43.30
text_mt: talkative and wicked unchaste women, roaming about with hirelings, / respected by rogues, puffed up with soldierly pride, enraged, thorough plunderers,

sanskrit_iast:
paryaṭā bhāṭakā jīvāḥ kaṇṭhakaślokabhāṣiṇaḥ .
vikrīṇate hyavikreyamabhakṣyadravyabhakṣiṇaḥ . . 31
meaning:
पर्यटा भाटका जीवाः कण्ठकश्लोकभाषिणः .
विक्रीणते ह्यविक्रेयमभक्ष्यद्रव्यभक्षिणः . . 31
text_mt: wandering vagabonds, hirelings, reciting verses from memory, / they sell what should not be sold, eaters of uneatable substances.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrakarmānutiṣṭhanto nistapāste narādhamāḥ .
sevādhyāpanavāṇijyakṛṣyādyārambhalambhitāḥ . .
gṛhṇantaḥ sampado bāhayāddravyadhānyadhanādikāḥ . . 32
meaning:
शूद्रकर्मानुतिष्ठन्तो निस्तपास्ते नराधमाः .
सेवाध्यापनवाणिज्यकृष्याद्यारम्भलम्भिताः . .
गृह्णन्तः सम्पदो बाहयाद्द्रव्यधान्यधनादिकाः . . 32
text_mt: Performing the work of a śūdra, those lowest of men, devoid of austerities, / engaged in occupations such as service, teaching, commerce, and agriculture, / seizing wealth from outside—possessions, grain, riches, and the like—

sanskrit_iast:
krodhādābhyantarāndoṣāṃstathā duṣṭamanorathān .
atyajanto viśiṣṭānāṃ śreṣṭhāste kacamardinaḥ . . 33
meaning:
क्रोधादाभ्यन्तरान्दोषांस्तथा दुष्टमनोरथान् .
अत्यजन्तो विशिष्टानां श्रेष्ठास्ते कचमर्दिनः . . 33
text_mt: not casting off internal faults such as anger, as well as wicked desires, / they, foremost of the distinguished, are hair-pullers.

sanskrit_iast:
nopadeyāni vastrāṇi nityamādadate dvijāḥ .
hāpayanti na heyāni kathaṃ te guravaḥ kṣitau . . 34
meaning:
नोपदेयानि वस्त्राणि नित्यमाददते द्विजाः .
हापयन्ति न हेयानि कथं ते गुरवः क्षितौ . . 34
text_mt: Dvijas constantly take garments that should not be accepted, / and do not abandon what is to be abandoned; how are they preceptors on earth?

sanskrit_iast:
dantikā diṇḍikā bhaṇḍāścaṇḍāścaṇḍālaceṣṭitā .
vaitaṇḍakāste nighnanti yathā siṃho mṛgānpaśūn . . 35
meaning:
दन्तिका दिण्डिका भण्डाश्चण्डाश्चण्डालचेष्टिता .
वैतण्डकास्ते निघ्नन्ति यथा सिंहो मृगान्पशून् . . 35
text_mt: Arrogant, drum-beaters, scoundrels, fierce, acting like caṇḍālas, / those wranglers destroy [men] as a lion destroys wild beasts and cattle.

sanskrit_iast:
nirgranthaṃ munimālokya manyamānāḥ samunnatam .
paribhūyāvatiṣṭhante dhiktānriktānsavairiṇaḥ . . 36
meaning:
निर्ग्रन्थं मुनिमालोक्य मन्यमानाः समुन्नतम् .
परिभूयावतिष्ठन्ते धिक्तान्रिक्तान्सवैरिणः . . 36
text_mt: Beholding an unattached sage and considering him very exalted, / they stand reviling him; fie upon those empty, hostile men!

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsaṃsārikāḥ sattvāścittakleśakalaṅkitāḥ .
dauḥśīlyadaurmanasyādyaistulyajātīyabandhanāt . . 37

तस्मात्संसारिकाः सत्त्वाश्चित्तक्लेशकलङ्किताः .
दौःशील्यदौर्मनस्याद्यैस्तुल्यजातीयबन्धनात् . . 37
text_mt: Therefore, worldly beings are stained by the afflictions of the mind / on account of the common bond of the species through bad character, despair, and so forth.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrāṃ prarocate vipro rāgiṇīṃ maithunaṃ prati .

शूद्रां प्ररोचते विप्रो रागिणीं मैथुनं प्रति .

sanskrit_iast:
kāmakāmāturābhyastu rocante śūdramānavāḥ .

meaning:
कामकामातुराभ्यस्तु रोचन्ते शूद्रमानवाः .
मैथुनं प्रति ब्राह्मण्ये तेऽपि तासां सुखावहाः ..39
text_mt: And to brāhmaṇa women afflicted with longing and desire, śūdra men / are pleasing for sexual union; they too bring pleasure to them.

sanskrit_iast:
ye tu jātyādibhirbhinnā gavāśvoṣṭmataṅgajāḥ .
te vijātiṣu no garbhaṃ kurvate'pi sukhārthinaḥ ..1.43.40
meaning:
ये तु जात्यादिभिर्भिन्ना गवाश्वोष्ट्मतङ्गजाः .
ते विजातिषु नो गर्भं कुर्वतेऽपि सुखार्थिनः ..1.43.40
text_mt: Whereas cattle, horses, camels, and elephants, which are distinct by genus and the like, / do not produce offspring among different species, even when seeking pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
anaḍvāneva goreva kāmaṃ puṣṇāti saṅgame .
ghoṭakāśca ratiṃ samyakkurvate vaḍavāsu ca ..41

अनड्वानेव गोरेव कामं पुष्णाति सङ्गमे .
घोटकाश्च रतिं सम्यक्कुर्वते वडवासु च ..41
text_mt: Only a bull fulfills the desire of a cow in mating, / and stallions take their pleasure properly with mares.

sanskrit_iast:
patiṃ karabhamevāpya karabhī ramate mudā .
gajameva patiṃ labdhvā sukhaṃ tiṣṭhati hastinī ..42
meaning:
पतिं करभमेवाप्य करभी रमते मुदा .
गजमेव पतिं लब्ध्वा सुखं तिष्ठति हस्तिनी ..42
text_mt: Having obtained a male camel as mate, a female camel rejoices with delight; / having gained an elephant as mate, a female elephant abides in pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
tiryagjātiḥ striyā sākaṃ kurvāṇā'pi hi maithunam .
na tasyāḥ kurute garbhaṃ naro nāpi sukhāsikām ..43

तिर्यग्जातिः स्त्रिया साकं कुर्वाणाऽपि हि मैथुनम् .

text_mt: An animal, even if engaging in sexual union with a human woman, / does not produce offspring in her, nor does a human man with an animal [produce] ease of pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
tiraścā saha kurvāṇā maithunaṃ manujāṅganā .
nādhatte tatkṛtaṃ garbhaṃ na yuktaṃ maithunaṃ tayoḥ ..44
meaning:
तिरश्चा सह कुर्वाणा मैथुनं मनुजाङ्गना .
नाधत्ते तत्कृतं गर्भं न युक्तं मैथुनं तयोः ..44
text_mt: A human woman, engaging in sexual union with an animal, / does not conceive an offspring engendered by it; sexual union is not fitting for the two.

sanskrit_iast:
naivaṃ kaścidvibhāgosti maithune strīmanuṣyayoḥ .
yena saṃkṣīyate bhedaḥ prasphuṭaṃ dvijaśūdrayoḥ ..45
meaning:
नैवं कश्चिद्विभागोस्ति मैथुने स्त्रीमनुष्ययोः .
येन संक्षीयते भेदः प्रस्फुटं द्विजशूद्रयोः ..45
text_mt: There is no such division in the sexual union of a woman and a man, / by which the distinction between a dvija and a śūdra is plainly dissolved.

sanskrit_iast:
vedapāṭhacchalenāyaṃ na kriyābhiḥ prapadyate .
bahubhirjaḍasaṅghātairaviśiṣṭe pade'hani ..46
meaning:
वेदपाठच्छलेनायं न क्रियाभिः प्रपद्यते .
बहुभिर्जडसङ्घातैरविशिष्टे पदेऽहनि ..46
text_mt: On the pretext of reciting the Veda, this [distinction] is not established by rituals / in a day that is indistinct by means of many collections of dull matter.

sanskrit_iast:
dehe dehini cāmuṣminnaśucāvanavasthite .
rāgadveṣādibhirdoṣairadhikaṃ paripīḍite ..47
meaning:
देहे देहिनि चामुष्मिन्नशुचावनवस्थिते .
रागद्वेषादिभिर्दोषैरधिकं परिपीडिते ..47
text_mt: In this body and the embodied soul, impure and unstable, / intensely tormented by faults such as passion and hatred,

sanskrit_iast:
kulālacakravadbhrāntamānase viṣayārṇave .
ghoraduḥkhabhayākrānte samāje'nīśvarātmani ..48
meaning:
कुलालचक्रवद्भ्रान्तमानसे विषयार्णवे .
घोरदुःखभयाक्रान्ते समाजेऽनीश्वरात्मनि ..48
text_mt: in the ocean of sensory objects where the mind spins like a potter's wheel, / in society overcome by dreadful sorrow and fear, devoid of a master,

sanskrit_iast:
janmamṛtyujarāśokāniṣṭayogāgnipīḍite .
hīnasattvaśarīrādau na viśeṣo vibhāvyate ..49
meaning:
जन्ममृत्युजराशोकानिष्टयोगाग्निपीडिते .
हीनसत्त्वशरीरादौ न विशेषो विभाव्यते ..49
text_mt: tormented by the fire of birth, death, old age, grief, and union with the undesirable, / no distinction is perceived in the bodies and natures of base beings.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānmanuṣyabhedo'yaṃ saṅketabalanirmitaḥ .
brāhmaṇyaṃ brāhmaṇāsaṅgādbrāhmaṇī copasevate ..1.43.50
meaning:
तस्मान्मनुष्यभेदोऽयं सङ्केतबलनिर्मितः .
ब्राह्मण्यं ब्राह्मणासङ्गाद्ब्राह्मणी चोपसेवते ..1.43.50
text_mt: Therefore, this division of human beings is created merely by the power of convention. / A brāhmaṇa woman cultivates brāhmaṇahood from association with a brāhmaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
patiṃ tyaktvā mukhasvādalālasairmadalālasaiḥ .
āsevyate viṭaṃ gatvā bandhakī ceṭakairapi . . 51
meaning:
पतिं त्यक्त्वा मुखस्वादलालसैर्मदलालसैः .
आसेव्यते विटं गत्वा बन्धकी चेटकैरपि . . 51
text_mt: yet, abandoning her husband, driven by cravings for sensory pleasure and longing for intoxication, / an unchaste woman, going to a paramour, is enjoyed even by servants.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇyātpracyavante'nye mahāpātakasevitāḥ .
vyalīkakalpanaivaiṣā tasmājjātyādikalpanā . . 52
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe śatārddhasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ brāhme parvaṇi ṣaṣṭhīkalpe
varṇavyavasthāvarṇanaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ . 43 .
varṇavibhāgavivekavarṇanam
meaning:
ब्राह्मण्यात्प्रच्यवन्तेऽन्ये महापातकसेविताः .
व्यलीककल्पनैवैषा तस्माज्जात्यादिकल्पना . . 52
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे शतार्द्धसाहस्र्यां संहितायां ब्राह्मे पर्वणि षष्ठीकल्पे
वर्णव्यवस्थावर्णनं नाम त्रिचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः . 43 .
वर्णविभागविवेकवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Others fall from brāhmaṇahood when they commit major sins; / therefore, this conceptualization of caste and the like is merely a false fabrication.
Thus ends the forty-third chapter, entitled "Description of the Settlement of the Classes," in the Brāhmaparvan, in the Ṣaṣṭhīkalpa of the Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa consisting of fifty thousand verses.
Description of the Discernment of Class Divisions

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
heyopādeyatattvajñāstyaktānyāyapathāgamāḥ .
jitendriyamanovācaḥ sadācāraparāyaṇāḥ . . 1
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
हेयोपादेयतत्त्वज्ञास्त्यक्तान्यायपथागमाः .
जितेन्द्रियमनोवाचः सदाचारपरायणाः . . 1
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Knowing the truth of what is to be avoided and what is to be pursued, having abandoned the paths of injustice, / with senses, mind, and speech subdued, devoted to good conduct,
title: Varṇavibhāgavivekavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
niyamācāravṛttasthā hitānveṣaṇatatparāḥ .
saṃsārarakṣaṇopāyakriyāyuktamanorathāḥ . . 2
meaning:
नियमाचारवृत्तस्था हितान्वेषणतत्पराः .
संसाररक्षणोपायक्रियायुक्तमनोरथाः . . 2
text_mt: abiding in restraint and proper practice, intent upon seeking the good, / their aspirations joined with actions that serve to protect the world,

sanskrit_iast:
samyagdarśanasampannāḥ samādhisthā hatakrudhaḥ .
svādhyāyabhaktahṛdayāstyaktasaṅgā vimatsarāḥ . . 3
meaning:
सम्यग्दर्शनसम्पन्नाः समाधिस्था हतक्रुधः .
स्वाध्यायभक्तहृदयास्त्यक्तसङ्गा विमत्सराः . . 3
text_mt: endowed with right vision, established in meditative absorption, their wrath destroyed, / their hearts devoted to Vedic study, free from attachments, devoid of envy,

sanskrit_iast:
viśokā vimadāḥ śāntā sarvaprāṇihitaiṣiṇaḥ .
sukhaduḥkhasamālokā viviktasthānavāsinaḥ . . 4
meaning:
विशोका विमदाः शान्ता सर्वप्राणिहितैषिणः .
सुखदुःखसमालोका विविक्तस्थानवासिनः . . 4
text_mt: free from sorrow, free from pride, peaceful, wishing the welfare of all living beings, / viewing pleasure and pain alike, dwelling in secluded places,

sanskrit_iast:
vratopayuktasarvāṅgā dhārmikāḥ pāpabhīravaḥ .
nirmamā nirahaṅkārā dānaśūrā dayāparāḥ . . 5
meaning:
व्रतोपयुक्तसर्वाङ्गा धार्मिकाः पापभीरवः .
निर्ममा निरहङ्कारा दानशूरा दयापराः . . 5
text_mt: their entire bodies engaged in observances, righteous, fearful of sin, / free from possessiveness, devoid of egotism, heroic in giving, devoted to compassion,

sanskrit_iast:
satyabrahmavidaḥ śāntā sarvaśāstreṣu niṣṭhitāḥ .
sarvalokahitopāyapravṛttena svayaṃbhuvā . . 6
meaning:
सत्यब्रह्मविदः शान्ता सर्वशास्त्रेषु निष्ठिताः .
सर्वलोकहितोपायप्रवृत्तेन स्वयंभुवा . . 6
text_mt: knowers of true Brahman, tranquil, well-versed in all scriptures— / their limits were thus established by the Self-born One who acts for the benefit of all the world,

sanskrit_iast:
vāgīśvareṇa devena nābheyena bhavacchidā .
brahmaṇā kṛtamaryādāsta evaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ . . 7
meaning:
वागीश्वरेण देवेन नाभेयेन भवच्छिदा .
ब्रह्मणा कृतमर्यादास्त एवं ब्राह्मणाः स्मृताः . . 7
text_mt: the Lord of Speech, the deity born from the navel, the cutter of worldly existence, / by Brahmā; and they are thus remembered as brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
mahātapodhanairāryaiḥ sarvasattvābhayapradaiḥ .
sarvalokahitārthāya nipuṇaṃ supratiṣṭhitam . . 8
meaning:
महातपोधनैरार्यैः सर्वसत्त्वाभयप्रदैः .
सर्वलोकहितार्थाय निपुणं सुप्रतिष्ठितम् . . 8
text_mt: Firmly established with expertise by the noble ones of great ascetic wealth, / bestowers of fearlessness on all beings, for the sake of the welfare of all the world.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛhattvādbhagavānbrahmā nābheyastasya ye janāḥ .
bhaktyāsaktāḥ prapannāśca brāhmaṇāste prakīrtitāḥ . . 9
meaning:
वृहत्त्वाद्भगवान्ब्रह्मा नाभेयस्तस्य ये जनाः .
भक्त्यासक्ताः प्रपन्नाश्च ब्राह्मणास्ते प्रकीर्तिताः . . 9
text_mt: Because of his vastness, the lord is Brahmā, born from the navel; those people who are / attached to him with devotion and have taken refuge in him, they are proclaimed brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatriyāstu kṣatatrāṇādvaiśyā vārtāpraveśanāt .
ye tu śruterdrutiṃ prāptāḥ śūdrāsteneha kīrtitāḥ . . 1.44.10
meaning:
क्षत्रियास्तु क्षतत्राणाद्वैश्या वार्ताप्रवेशनात् .
ये तु श्रुतेर्द्रुतिं प्राप्ताः शूद्रास्तेनेह कीर्तिताः . . 1.44.10
text_mt: The kṣatriyas, however, [are so called] from protecting against injury, the vaiśyas from engaging in commerce; / but those who have fled from the Veda are proclaimed here as śūdras.

sanskrit_iast:
ye cācāraratāḥ prāhurbrāhmaṇyaṃ brahmavādinaḥ .
te tu phalaṃ praśaṃsanti yatsadā manasepsitam . . 11
meaning:
ये चाचाररताः प्राहुर्ब्राह्मण्यं ब्रह्मवादिनः .
ते तु फलं प्रशंसन्ति यत्सदा मनसेप्सितम् . . 11
text_mt: And those teachers of Brahman who declare that brāhmaṇa status consists of good conduct / praise the fruit that is ever desired in the mind:

sanskrit_iast:
kṣamā damo dayā dānaṃ satyaṃ śaucaṃ dhṛtirghṛṇā .
mārdavārjavasantoṣānahaṅkāratapaḥśamāḥ. . . 12
meaning:
क्षमा दमो दया दानं सत्यं शौचं धृतिर्घृणा .
मार्दवार्जवसन्तोषानहङ्कारतपःशमाः. . . 12
text_mt: Forbearance, self-restraint, compassion, charity, truthfulness, purity, steadfastness, kindness, / gentleness, uprightness, contentment, freedom from egotism, austerity, tranquility,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmo jñānamapaiśunyaṃ brahmacaryamamūḍhatā .
dhyānamāstikyamadveṣo vairāgyaṃ ca śamātmatā . . 13
meaning:
धर्मो ज्ञानमपैशुन्यं ब्रह्मचर्यममूढता .
ध्यानमास्तिक्यमद्वेषो वैराग्यं च शमात्मता . . 13
text_mt: righteousness, knowledge, absence of slander, celibacy, absence of delusion, / meditation, faith, absence of malice, detachment, and an essence of peace,

sanskrit_iast:
pāpabhīrutvamasteyamamātsaryamatṛṣṇatā .
naiḥsaṅgyaṃ guruśuśrūṣā manovākkāya saṃyamaḥ . . 14
meaning:
पापभीरुत्वमस्तेयममात्सर्यमतृष्णता .
नैःसङ्ग्यं गुरुशुश्रूषा मनोवाक्काय संयमः . . 14
text_mt: fear of sin, non-stealing, absence of jealousy, freedom from craving, / solitude, service to the guru, and restraint of mind, speech, and body.

sanskrit_iast:
ya evambhūtamācāramanutiṣṭhanti mānavāḥ .
brāhmaṇyaṃ puṣkalaṃ teṣāṃ nityameva pravardhate . . 15
meaning:
य एवम्भूतमाचारमनुतिष्ठन्ति मानवाः .
ब्राह्मण्यं पुष्कलं तेषां नित्यमेव प्रवर्धते . . 15
text_mt: Whatever human beings observe conduct such as this, / their abundant brāhmaṇa status ever increases.

sanskrit_iast:
te svamatāsvādalabdhavarṇācārā mahaujasaḥ .
sarvaśāstrāvirodhena pavitrīkṛtamānasāḥ . . 16
meaning:
ते स्वमतास्वादलब्धवर्णाचारा महौजसः .
सर्वशास्त्राविरोधेन पवित्रीकृतमानसाः . . 16
text_mt: Having obtained the conduct of their class through the relish of their own conviction, possessed of great vigour, / their minds purified in accordance with all scriptures,

sanskrit_iast:
sajjanābhimatāḥ prājñāḥ purāṇāgamapaṇḍitāḥ .
gītagītāgamācārāḥ smṛtikārāḥ paṭhanti ca . . 17
meaning:
सज्जनाभिमताः प्राज्ञाः पुराणागमपण्डिताः .
गीतगीतागमाचाराः स्मृतिकाराः पठन्ति च . . 17
text_mt: esteemed by the virtuous, wise, learned in the Purāṇas and Āgamas, / their conduct set forth in hymns and the traditions, the authors of Smṛti recite [this]:

sanskrit_iast:
manvantareṣu sarveṣu caturyugavibhāgaśaḥ .
varṇāśramācārakṛtaṃ karma siddhyatyanuttamam . . 18
meaning:
मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु चतुर्युगविभागशः .
वर्णाश्रमाचारकृतं कर्म सिद्ध्यत्यनुत्तमम् . . 18
text_mt: In all the manvantaras, according to the division of the four yugas, / action performed according to the conduct of the classes and stages of life achieves supreme perfection.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsiddhāyāṃ tu vārtāyāṃ tatasteṣāṃ svayaṃ prabhuḥ .
maryādāṃ sthāpayāmāsa yathārabdhaṃ parasparam . . 19
meaning:
संसिद्धायां तु वार्तायां ततस्तेषां स्वयं प्रभुः .
मर्यादां स्थापयामास यथारब्धं परस्परम् . . 19
text_mt: When agriculture and livelihood were firmly established, the Lord himself / then laid down limits among them according to their respective beginnings.

sanskrit_iast:
ye vai parigṛhītārasteṣāṃ sattvabalādhikāḥ .
itareṣāṃ kṣatatrāṇānsthāpayāmāsa kṣatriyān . . 1.44.20
meaning:
ये वै परिगृहीतारस्तेषां सत्त्वबलाधिकाः .
इतरेषां क्षतत्राणान्स्थापयामास क्षत्रियान् . . 1.44.20
text_mt: Those among them who took control, superior in strength and courage, / he established as kṣatriyas, protectors from injury for the others.

sanskrit_iast:
upatiṣṭhanti ye tānvai yācanto narmadāḥ sadā .
satyabrahma sadābhūtaṃ vadanto brāhmaṇāstu te . . 21
meaning:
उपतिष्ठन्ति ये तान्वै याचन्तो नर्मदाः सदा .
सत्यब्रह्म सदाभूतं वदन्तो ब्राह्मणास्तु ते . . 21
text_mt: Those who attend upon them, asking, ever pleasing, / speaking the true, eternal Brahman, they are the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
ye cānyepyabalāsteṣāṃ vaiśyakarmaṇi saṃsthitāḥ .
kīlāni nāśayanti sma pṛthivyāṃ prāgatandritāḥ . .
vaiśyāneva tu tānāha kīnāśānvṛttimāśritān . . 22
meaning:
ये चान्येप्यबलास्तेषां वैश्यकर्मणि संस्थिताः .
कीलानि नाशयन्ति स्म पृथिव्यां प्रागतन्द्रिताः . .
वैश्यानेव तु तानाह कीनाशान्वृत्तिमाश्रितान् . . 22
text_mt: And those others who were weak, engaged in the duties of a vaiśya, / who formerly without indolence uprooted boundary-stakes on the earth— / he called those cultivators who took up that livelihood vaiśyas.

sanskrit_iast:
śocantaśva dravantaśca paricaryāsu ye narāḥ .
nistejaso'lpavīryāśca śūdrāṃstānabravīttu saḥ . . 23
meaning:
शोचन्तश्व द्रवन्तश्च परिचर्यासु ये नराः .
निस्तेजसोऽल्पवीर्याश्च शूद्रांस्तानब्रवीत्तु सः . . 23
text_mt: And those men who grieved and fled, [engaged only] in services, / lacking lustre and of little vigour, he spoke of them as śūdras.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca parasparam .
karmāṇi pravibhaktāni syabhāvaprabhavairguṇaiḥ . . 24
meaning:
ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परस्परम् .
कर्माणि प्रविभक्तानि स्यभावप्रभवैर्गुणैः . . 24
text_mt: Among brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, and śūdras, / duties have been distributed according to the qualities born of their own nature.

sanskrit_iast:
śamastapo damaḥ śaucaṃ kṣāṃtirārjavameva ca .
jñānaṃ vijñānamāstikyaṃ brahmakarma svabhāvajam . . 25
meaning:
शमस्तपो दमः शौचं क्षांतिरार्जवमेव च .
ज्ञानं विज्ञानमास्तिक्यं ब्रह्मकर्म स्वभावजम् . . 25
text_mt: Tranquility, austerity, self-restraint, purity, forbearance, uprightness, / knowledge, experiential wisdom, and faith constitute the duty of a brāhmaṇa, born of their own nature.

sanskrit_iast:
śauryaṃ tejo dhṛtirdākṣyaṃ yuddhe cāpyapalāyanam .
dānamīśvarabhāvaśca kṣātraṃ karma svabhāvajam . . 26
meaning:
शौर्यं तेजो धृतिर्दाक्ष्यं युद्धे चाप्यपलायनम् .
दानमीश्वरभावश्च क्षात्रं कर्म स्वभावजम् . . 26
text_mt: Heroism, splendour, steadfastness, skill, not fleeing in battle, / generosity, and lordliness constitute the duty of a kṣatriya, born of their own nature.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣigorakṣavāṇijyaṃ vaiśyakarma svabhāvajam .
paricaryātmakaṃ karma śūdrasyāpi svabhāvajam . . 27
meaning:
कृषिगोरक्षवाणिज्यं वैश्यकर्म स्वभावजम् .
परिचर्यात्मकं कर्म शूद्रस्यापि स्वभावजम् . . 27
text_mt: Agriculture, cattle-tending, and trade constitute the duty of a vaiśya, born of their own nature; / and service constitutes the duty of a śūdra, born of their own nature.

sanskrit_iast:
yogastapo dayā dānaṃ satyaṃ dharmaśrutirghṛṇā .
jñānaṃ vijñānamāstikyametadbrāhmaṇalakṣaṇam . . 28
meaning:
योगस्तपो दया दानं सत्यं धर्मश्रुतिर्घृणा .
ज्ञानं विज्ञानमास्तिक्यमेतद्ब्राह्मणलक्षणम् . . 28
text_mt: Yoga, austerity, compassion, charity, truthfulness, hearing of sacred law, kindness, / knowledge, experiential wisdom, and faith—this is the mark of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śikhā jñānamayī yasya pavitraṃ ca tapomayam .
brāhmaṇyaṃ puṣkalaṃ tasya manuḥ svāyambhuvo'bravīt . . 29
meaning:
शिखा ज्ञानमयी यस्य पवित्रं च तपोमयम् .
ब्राह्मण्यं पुष्कलं तस्य मनुः स्वायम्भुवोऽब्रवीत् . . 29
text_mt: He whose topknot consists of knowledge and whose sacred thread consists of austerity, / his brāhmaṇa status is complete; so declared Manu, the son of Svayambhū.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra vā tatra vā varṇe uttamādhamamadhyamāḥ .
nivṛttaḥ pāpakarmebhyo brāhmaṇaḥ sa vidhīyate . . 1.44.30
meaning:
यत्र वा तत्र वा वर्णे उत्तमाधममध्यमाः .
निवृत्तः पापकर्मेभ्यो ब्राह्मणः स विधीयते . . 1.44.30
text_mt: In whatever class one may be—highest, lowest, or middle— / one who has turned away from sinful deeds is designated a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdro'pi śīlasampanno brāhmaṇādadhiko bhavet .
brāhmaṇo vigatācāraḥ śūdrāddhīnataro bhavet . . 31
meaning:
शूद्रोऽपि शीलसम्पन्नो ब्राह्मणादधिको भवेत् .
ब्राह्मणो विगताचारः शूद्राद्धीनतरो भवेत् . . 31
text_mt: Even a śūdra endowed with virtuous conduct is superior to a brāhmaṇa, / while a brāhmaṇa devoid of good conduct is inferior to a śūdra.

sanskrit_iast:
na surāṃ sandhayedyastu āpaṇeṣu gṛheṣu ca .
na vikrīṇāti ca tathā sacchūdro hi sa ucyate . . 32
meaning:
न सुरां सन्धयेद्यस्तु आपणेषु गृहेषु च .
न विक्रीणाति च तथा सच्छूद्रो हि स उच्यते . . 32
text_mt: One who does not brew liquor in shops or in homes, / and likewise does not sell it, is indeed called a virtuous śūdra.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyekā sphuṭameva jātiraparā kṛtyātparaṃ bhedinī .
yadvā vyāhṛtirekatāmadhigatā yaccānyadharmaṃ yayau . .
ekaikākhilabhāvabhedanidhanotpattisthitivyāpinī .
kiṃ nāsau pratipattigocarapathaṃ yāyādvibhaktyā nṛṇām . . 33
meaning:
यद्येका स्फुटमेव जातिरपरा कृत्यात्परं भेदिनी .
यद्वा व्याहृतिरेकतामधिगता यच्चान्यधर्मं ययौ . .
एकैकाखिलभावभेदनिधनोत्पत्तिस्थितिव्यापिनी .
किं नासौ प्रतिपत्तिगोचरपथं यायाद्विभक्त्या नृणाम् . . 33
text_mt: If one caste is clearly distinct from another by action alone, / or if an utterance attains oneness and passes into another nature, / pervading the destruction, origination, and continuity of every distinct entity, / why should this not fall within the range of discernment through the divisions of men?

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrī bhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe śatārddhasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ brāhme parvaṇi ṣaṣṭhīkalpe
varṇavibhāgavivekavarṇanaṃ nāma catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ . 44 .
kārtikeyavarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्री भविष्ये महापुराणे शतार्द्धसाहस्र्यां संहितायां ब्राह्मे पर्वणि षष्ठीकल्पे
वर्णविभागविवेकवर्णनं नाम चतुश्चत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः . 44 .
कार्तिकेयवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the forty-fourth chapter, entitled "Description of the Discernment of Class Divisions," in the Brāhmaparvan, in the Ṣaṣṭhīkalpa of the Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa consisting of fifty thousand verses.
Description of Kārtikeya

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
idaṃ śruṇu mayākhyātaṃ tarkapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ .
yuṣmākaṃ saṃśaye jāte kṛte vai jātikarmaṇoḥ . . 1
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इदं श्रुणु मयाख्यातं तर्कपूर्वमिदं वचः .
युष्माकं संशये जाते कृते वै जातिकर्मणोः . . 1
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Listen to this speech declared by me, preceded by reasoned inquiry, / when doubt arose among you concerning caste and action.
title: Kārtikeyavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
punarvacmi nibodhadhvaṃ samāsānna tu vistarāt .
saṃsiddhiṃ yānti manujā jātikarmasamuccayāt . . 2
meaning:
पुनर्वच्मि निबोधध्वं समासान्न तु विस्तरात् .
संसिद्धिं यान्ति मनुजा जातिकर्मसमुच्चयात् . . 2
text_mt: I tell you again, understand it in brief and not in detail: / Men attain perfection from the combination of caste and action.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhiṃ gacchedyathā kāryaṃ daivakarmasamuccayāt .
evaṃ saṃsiddhimāyāti puruṣo jātikarmaṇoḥ . . 3
meaning:
सिद्धिं गच्छेद्यथा कार्यं दैवकर्मसमुच्चयात् .
एवं संसिद्धिमायाति पुरुषो जातिकर्मणोः . . 3
text_mt: Just as an undertaking attains success through the combination of destiny and effort, / even so a person attains perfection from caste and action.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktavānpūrvaṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ bodhane purā .
yogīśvaro mahātejāḥ samāsānna tu vistarāt . . 4
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्तवान्पूर्वं शिष्याणां बोधने पुरा .
योगीश्वरो महातेजाः समासान्न तु विस्तरात् . . 4
text_mt: Having spoken thus in ancient times to instruct his disciples, / the Lord of Yogins of great lustre spoke in brief and not in detail.

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
iti pṛṣṭaḥ purā brahmā ṛṣīnprovāca bhārata .
savitarkamidaṃ vākyaṃ viprarṣe jātikarmaṇoḥ . . 5
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
इति पृष्टः पुरा ब्रह्मा ऋषीन्प्रोवाच भारत .
सवितर्कमिदं वाक्यं विप्रर्षे जातिकर्मणोः . . 5
text_mt: Sumantu said: / Thus questioned in ancient times, Brahmā addressed the sages, O Bhārata, / with these words accompanied by reasoning regarding caste and action, O brāhmaṇa sage.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttvayā mahābāho na kāryo vismayo nṛpa .
kārtikeyaṃ prati sadā devānāṃ durvidā gatiḥ . . 6
meaning:
तस्मात्त्वया महाबाहो न कार्यो विस्मयो नृप .
कार्तिकेयं प्रति सदा देवानां दुर्विदा गतिः . . 6
text_mt: Therefore, O mighty-armed king, you should not wonder; / the course of the gods concerning Kārtikeya is always difficult to comprehend.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe śatārdhasāhahasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ brāhme parvaṇi ṣaṣṭhīkalpe
kārtikeyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ . 45 .
brahmaparvavarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे शतार्धसाहहस्र्यां संहितायां ब्राह्मे पर्वणि षष्ठीकल्पे
कार्तिकेयवर्णनं नाम पञ्चचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः . 45 .
ब्रह्मपर्ववर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the forty-fifth chapter, entitled "Description of Kārtikeya," in the Brāhmaparvan, in the Ṣaṣṭhīkalpa of the Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa consisting of fifty thousand verses.
Description of the Brāhmaparvan

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
yeyaṃ bhādrapade māsi ṣaṣṭhī ca bharatarṣabha .
supuṇyeyaṃ pāpaharā śivā śāntā guhapriyā . . 1
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
येयं भाद्रपदे मासि षष्ठी च भरतर्षभ .
सुपुण्येयं पापहरा शिवा शान्ता गुहप्रिया . . 1
text_mt:
Sumantu said:
This sixth lunar day in the month of Bhādrapada, O bull of the Bharatas, / is very meritorious, sin-destroying, auspicious, peaceful, and dear to Guha.
title: Kārttikeyamāhātmayavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
snānadānādikaṃ sarvaṃ yasyāmakṣayyamucyate .
ye'syāṃ paśyanti gāṅgeyaṃ dakṣiṇāpathamāśritam . . 2
meaning:
स्नानदानादिकं सर्वं यस्यामक्षय्यमुच्यते .
येऽस्यां पश्यन्ति गाङ्गेयं दक्षिणापथमाश्रितम् . . 2
text_mt: All rites such as bathing and giving [gifts] performed on it are said to be imperishable. / Those who see Gāṅgeya residing in the southern region on this [tithi],

sanskrit_iast:
brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpairmucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ .
tasmādasyāṃ sadā paśyetkārttikeyaṃ nṛpottama . . 3
meaning:
ब्रह्महत्यादिभिः पापैर्मुच्यन्ते नात्र संशयः .
तस्मादस्यां सदा पश्येत्कार्त्तिकेयं नृपोत्तम . . 3
text_mt: are freed from sins such as slaying a brahmin, without doubt. / Therefore on this [tithi], O best of kings, one should always look upon Kārttikeya.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayanti guhaṃ ye'syāṃ narā bhaktisamanvitāḥ .
prāpyeha te sukhānkāmāngacchantīndrasalokatām . . 4
meaning:
पूजयन्ति गुहं येऽस्यां नरा भक्तिसमन्विताः .
प्राप्येह ते सुखान्कामान्गच्छन्तीन्द्रसलोकताम् . . 4
text_mt: Men endowed with devotion who worship Guha on this [day], / having attained pleasant desires here, go to the world of Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu kārayate veśma sudṛḍhaṃ supratiṣṭhitam .
dārvaṃ śailamayaṃ cāpi bhaktayā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ . .
gāṅgeyaṃ yānamāruhya gacchedgāṅgeyasadma vai . . 5
meaning:
यस्तु कारयते वेश्म सुदृढं सुप्रतिष्ठितम् .
दार्वं शैलमयं चापि भक्तया श्रद्धासमन्वितः . .
गाङ्गेयं यानमारुह्य गच्छेद्गाङ्गेयसद्म वै . . 5
text_mt: He who causes a very firm, well-consecrated shrine to be built, / made of wood or even of stone, filled with faith and devotion, / having mounted Gāṅgeya's vehicle, indeed goes to Gāṅgeya's abode.

sanskrit_iast:
sammārjanādi yaḥ karma kuryādguhagṛhe naraḥ .
dhvajasyāropaṇaṃ rājansa gacchedrudrasadma vai . . 6
meaning:
सम्मार्जनादि यः कर्म कुर्याद्गुहगृहे नरः .
ध्वजस्यारोपणं राजन्स गच्छेद्रुद्रसद्म वै . . 6
text_mt: A man who performs tasks such as sweeping in Guha's temple, / [or] the raising of a banner, O king, he indeed goes to Rudra's abode.

sanskrit_iast:
candanāgarukarpūrairyaśca pūjayate guham .
gajāśvarathayānāḍhyaṃ saināpatyamavāpnute . . 7
meaning:
चन्दनागरुकर्पूरैर्यश्च पूजयते गुहम् .
गजाश्वरथयानाढ्यं सैनापत्यमवाप्नुते . . 7
text_mt: And he who worships Guha with sandalwood, agallochum, and camphor, / attains commander-in-chiefship abounding in vehicles of elephants, horses, and chariots.

sanskrit_iast:
rājñāṃ pūjyaḥ sadā proktaḥ kārtikeyo mahīpate .
kārttikeyamṛte nānyaṃ rājñāṃ pūjyaṃ pracakṣate . . 8
meaning:
राज्ञां पूज्यः सदा प्रोक्तः कार्तिकेयो महीपते .
कार्त्तिकेयमृते नान्यं राज्ञां पूज्यं प्रचक्षते . . 8
text_mt: Kārtikeya is said to be always worshipful for kings, O lord of the earth; / other than Kārttikeya, none is declared worshipful for kings.

sanskrit_iast:
saṅgrāmaṃ gacchamāno yaḥ pūjayetkṛttikāsutam .
sa śatruṃ jayate vīra yathendro dānavānraṇe . . 9
meaning:
सङ्ग्रामं गच्छमानो यः पूजयेत्कृत्तिकासुतम् .
स शत्रुं जयते वीर यथेन्द्रो दानवान्रणे . . 9
text_mt: He who, going into battle, worships the son of Kṛttikā, / he conquers the enemy, O hero, just as Indra [conquered] the Dānavas in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjayecchaṅkārātmajam .
pūjamānastu taṃ bhaktyā campakairvividhairnṛpa . .
mucyate sarvapāpebhyastadā gacchecchivālayam . . 1.46.10
meaning:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन पूजयेच्छङ्कारात्मजम् .
पूजमानस्तु तं भक्त्या चम्पकैर्विविधैर्नृप . .
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यस्तदा गच्छेच्छिवालयम् . . 1.46.10
text_mt: Therefore, by every effort, one should worship the son of Śaṅkara. / Worshipping him with devotion with various campaka flowers, O king, / one is freed from all sins, and then goes to Śiva's abode.

sanskrit_iast:
tailaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ na bhuñjīta na divā kurunandana .
yastu ṣaṣṭhyāṃ naro naktaṃ kuryāddhi bharatarṣabha . .
sarvapāpaiḥ sa nirmukto gāṅgeyasya sado vrajet . . 11
meaning:
तैलं षष्ठ्यां न भुञ्जीत न दिवा कुरुनन्दन .
यस्तु षष्ठ्यां नरो नक्तं कुर्याद्धि भरतर्षभ . .
सर्वपापैः स निर्मुक्तो गाङ्गेयस्य सदो व्रजेत् . . 11
text_mt: On the sixth lunar day one should not consume oil, nor [eat] by day, O joy of the Kurus. / The man who observes the nocturnal meal on the sixth lunar day, O bull of the Bharatas, / liberated from all sins, goes to the abode of Gāṅgeya.

sanskrit_iast:
trikṛtvo dakṣiṇāmāśāṃ gatvā yaḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ .
pūjayeddevadeveśaṃ sa gacchecchāntimandiram . . 12
meaning:
त्रिकृत्वो दक्षिणामाशां गत्वा यः श्रद्धयान्वितः .
पूजयेद्देवदेवेशं स गच्छेच्छान्तिमन्दिरम् . . 12
text_mt: He who, endowed with faith, having gone three times to the southern quarter, / worships the lord of the gods of gods, he goes to the mansion of peace.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe śatārddhasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīkalpe kārttikeyamāhātmayavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ . 46 . .
śākasaptamīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे शतार्द्धसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठीकल्पे कार्त्तिकेयमाहात्मयवर्णनं नाम षट्चत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः . 46 . .
शाकसप्तमीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the forty-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Greatness of Kārttikeya', in the Ṣaṣṭhīkalpa of the Brāhmaparvan, in the Saṃhitā of Fifty Thousand Verses of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa. 46.
Description of the Śākasaptamī Vrata

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
saptamyāṃ sopavāsastu naktāhāro'pi vā bhavet .
saptamyāṃ devadevena labdhaṃ svaṃ rūpamādarāt . . 1
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
सप्तम्यां सोपवासस्तु नक्ताहारोऽपि वा भवेत् .
सप्तम्यां देवदेवेन लब्धं स्वं रूपमादरात् . . 1
text_mt:
Sumantu said:
On the seventh lunar day one should fast or take only a nocturnal meal. / On the seventh lunar day the god of the gods reverently obtained his own form.
title: adhyāyaḥ 047

sanskrit_iast:
aṇḍena saha jāto vai aṇḍastho buddhimāptavān .
aṇḍasthasyaiva dakṣeṇa bhāryāṃ dattvā svakāṃ sutām .. 2
meaning:
अण्डेन सह जातो वै अण्डस्थो बुद्धिमाप्तवान् .
अण्डस्थस्यैव दक्षेण भार्यां दत्त्वा स्वकां सुताम् .. 2
text_mt: Born along with an egg, abiding in the egg, he attained intellect. / Dakṣa gave his own daughter as wife to him while he was still abiding in the egg,

sanskrit_iast:
nāmnā rūpeti rūpeṇa nānyā nārī tathā 1 bhavet .
aṇḍastha eva suciraṃ sthito mārtaṇḍa ityataḥ . . 3
meaning:
नाम्ना रूपेति रूपेण नान्या नारी तथा 1 भवेत् .
अण्डस्थ एव सुचिरं स्थितो मार्तण्ड इत्यतः . . 3
text_mt: named Rūpā, by whose beauty there could be no other such woman. / He remained in the egg for a very long time, hence he is [called] Mārtaṇḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣājñayā viśvakarmā vapurasya prakāśayan .
prakāśatastato nāma tasya jātaṃ narādhipa . .
aṇḍasthasyaiva sañjāto yamunā yama eva ca . .4
meaning:
दक्षाज्ञया विश्वकर्मा वपुरस्य प्रकाशयन् .
प्रकाशतस्ततो नाम तस्य जातं नराधिप . .
अण्डस्थस्यैव सञ्जातो यमुना यम एव च . .4
text_mt: By Dakṣa's command, Viśvakarman revealed his body. / Because of the radiance, his name then arose [as Vivasvat], O ruler of men. / While he was still within the egg, Yamunā and Yama were born.

sanskrit_iast:
dākṣāyaṇī tasya bhāryā vairāgyāttanumadhyamā .
cintayāmāsa sā devī duḥkhānnirvedamāgatā . . 5
meaning:
दाक्षायणी तस्य भार्या वैराग्यात्तनुमध्यमा .
चिन्तयामास सा देवी दुःखान्निर्वेदमागता . . 5
text_mt: His wife, the daughter of Dakṣa, slender-waisted, out of dispassion, / having arrived at despondency through sorrow, that goddess reflected:

sanskrit_iast:
aho tejomayaṃ rūpaṃ kāntaṃ kāntasya kāntimat .
na cāsya kiñcitpaśyāmi aṅgaṃ tejovimohitam . . 6
meaning:
अहो तेजोमयं रूपं कान्तं कान्तस्य कान्तिमत् .
न चास्य किञ्चित्पश्यामि अङ्गं तेजोविमोहितम् . . 6
text_mt: "Ah, the form of my beloved is made of fiery brilliance, lovely, and luminous; / yet I cannot behold any limb of his, bewildered by his brilliance.

sanskrit_iast:
śubhaṃ kanakatulyaṃ me rūpaṃ kāntaṃ sukāntimat .
sāmprataṃ śyāmatāṃ yātaṃ dagdhametasya tejasā . . 7
meaning:
शुभं कनकतुल्यं मे रूपं कान्तं सुकान्तिमत् .
साम्प्रतं श्यामतां यातं दग्धमेतस्य तेजसा . . 7
text_mt: My auspicious form, resembling gold, lovely, very radiant, / has now become dark, burnt by his fiery brilliance.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttapsye tapaścāhaṃ gatvā vai uttarānkurūn .
svāṃ chāyāmatra nikṣipya bhayācchāpasya rūpiṇī . . 8
meaning:
तस्मात्तप्स्ये तपश्चाहं गत्वा वै उत्तरान्कुरून् .
स्वां छायामत्र निक्षिप्य भयाच्छापस्य रूपिणी . . 8
text_mt: Therefore, having gone to the Northern Kurus, I shall perform asceticism, / having deposited my own shapely shadow here out of fear of a curse."

sanskrit_iast:
nikṣipyovāca tāṃ bālāṃ mā cāsmai vai vadiṣyasi .
evaṃ sā niścayaṃ kṛtvā gatā vai uttarānkurūn . . 9
meaning:
निक्षिप्योवाच तां बालां मा चास्मै वै वदिष्यसि .
एवं सा निश्चयं कृत्वा गता वै उत्तरान्कुरून् . . 9
text_mt: Having placed her, she said to that girl: "You must not tell him!" / Having made this resolution, she went to the Northern Kurus.

sanskrit_iast:
svarūpaṃ tatra nikṣipya vaḍavārūpadhāriṇī .
cacāra sā mṛgaiḥ sārdhaṃ bahūnvarṣagaṇānnṛpa . . 1.47.10
meaning:
स्वरूपं तत्र निक्षिप्य वडवारूपधारिणी .
चचार सा मृगैः सार्धं बहून्वर्षगणान्नृप . . 1.47.10
text_mt: Having deposited her own form there, assuming the form of a mare, / she roamed with the wild beasts for many series of years, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
asāvapi ca mārtaṇḍaśchāyāṃ bhāryāmamanyat .
śaniṃ ca tapatīṃ caiva dve apatye ca jajñivān . . 11
meaning:
असावपि च मार्तण्डश्छायां भार्याममन्यत् .
शनिं च तपतीं चैव द्वे अपत्ये च जज्ञिवान् . . 11
text_mt: That Mārtaṇḍa, too, regarded Chāyā as his wife, / and he begot two offspring: Śani and Tapatī.

sanskrit_iast:
atha cchāyātmāpatyāni snehena paripālayet .
nātisnehena cāpaśyadyamunāṃ yamameva ca . . 12
meaning:
अथ च्छायात्मापत्यानि स्नेहेन परिपालयेत् .
नातिस्नेहेन चापश्यद्यमुनां यममेव च . . 12
text_mt: Then Chāyā nurtured her own children with affection, / but she did not look upon Yamunā and Yama with much affection.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tābhyāṃ vivādo'bhūdādityaduhitrordvayoḥ .
te ubhe vivadantyau tu parasparamasammatam . .
yamunā tapatī cobhe nimnage sambabhūvatuḥ . . 13
meaning:
अथ ताभ्यां विवादोऽभूदादित्यदुहित्रोर्द्वयोः .
ते उभे विवदन्त्यौ तु परस्परमसम्मतम् . .
यमुना तपती चोभे निम्नगे सम्बभूवतुः . . 13
text_mt: Then a dispute arose between those two, the two daughters of Āditya; / those two, arguing with one another in disagreement, / Yamunā and Tapatī, both became rivers.

sanskrit_iast:
yamo'pi yamunābhrātā chāyayā tāḍito bhṛśam .
pādamudyamya tasyā vai tasthau sammukha eva saḥ . . 14
meaning:
यमोऽपि यमुनाभ्राता छायया ताडितो भृशम् .
पादमुद्यम्य तस्या वै तस्थौ सम्मुख एव सः . . 14
text_mt: Yama too, the brother of Yamunā, was severely beaten by Chāyā; / raising his foot against her, he stood directly facing her.

sanskrit_iast:
chāyā śaśāpa taṃ roṣādyasmātpādodyato mama.
tasmātte karma bībhatsaṃ prāṇināṃ prāṇahiṃsanam . . 15
meaning:
छाया शशाप तं रोषाद्यस्मात्पादोद्यतो मम.
तस्मात्ते कर्म बीभत्सं प्राणिनां प्राणहिंसनम् . . 15
text_mt: Chāyā cursed him in anger: "Since your foot was raised against me, / therefore your occupation shall be gruesome: the destruction of the breath of living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyati ciraṃ mūḍha ācandrārkaṃ na saṃśayaḥ .
pādaṃ ca yadi bhūmau tvamimaṃ saṃsthāpayiṣyasi . . 16
meaning:
भविष्यति चिरं मूढ आचन्द्रार्कं न संशयः .
पादं च यदि भूमौ त्वमिमं संस्थापयिष्यसि . . 16
text_mt: It shall be so for a long time, fool, as long as the moon and sun endure, without doubt! / And if you set this foot upon the earth,

sanskrit_iast: kṛmayo bhakṣayiṣyanti macchāpakaluṣīkṛtam . . 17
meaning: कृमयो भक्षयिष्यन्ति मच्छापकलुषीकृतम् . . 17
text_mt: worms will devour it, polluted by my curse!"

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ vivadamānānāṃ mārtaṇḍo'bhyāgamattataḥ .
yamo'pyāha mahātmānaṃ mārtaṇḍaṃ lokapāvanam . . 18
meaning:
तेषां विवदमानानां मार्तण्डोऽभ्यागमत्ततः .
यमोऽप्याह महात्मानं मार्तण्डं लोकपावनम् . . 18
text_mt: While they were quarrelling, Mārtaṇḍa then arrived. / Yama spoke to the great-souled Mārtaṇḍa, the purifier of the world:

sanskrit_iast:
tāta nityamiyaṃ cāpi krūrabhāvena paśyati .
na cāsyāḥ susamā dṛṣṭirasmāsvastīti lakṣyate . . 19
meaning:
तात नित्यमियं चापि क्रूरभावेन पश्यति .
न चास्याः सुसमा दृष्टिरस्मास्वस्तीति लक्ष्यते . . 19
text_mt: "Father, this woman always looks [at us] with a cruel disposition, / and no fair and equal regard is seen in her towards us."

sanskrit_iast:
provācātha sa tāṃ chāyāṃ mārtaṇḍo bhṛśakopanaḥ .
1same apatye kiṃ mūḍhe samatvaṃ nānupaśyasi . . 1.47.20
meaning:
प्रोवाचाथ स तां छायां मार्तण्डो भृशकोपनः .
1समे अपत्ये किं मूढे समत्वं नानुपश्यसि . . 1.47.20
text_mt: Then Mārtaṇḍa, extremely wrathful, spoke to that Chāyā: / "The offspring being equal, O fool, why do you not see them equally?"

sanskrit_iast:
yamaḥ provāca pitaraṃ neyaṃ mātā pitarmama .
mātuśchāyā tviyaṃ pāpā śapto'hamanayā pitaḥ . .
yamunā tapatī vṛttaṃ tatsarvaṃ vinyavedayat . . 21
meaning:
यमः प्रोवाच पितरं नेयं माता पितर्मम .
मातुश्छाया त्वियं पापा शप्तोऽहमनया पितः . .
यमुना तपती वृत्तं तत्सर्वं विन्यवेदयत् . . 21
text_mt: Yama said to his father: "O father, this is not my mother! / This wicked woman is my mother's shadow; I have been cursed by her, O father!" / He reported the entire matter concerning Yamunā and Tapatī.

sanskrit_iast:
atha provāca mārtaṇḍo mā te pādo mahītale .
māṃsaṃ rudhiramādāya kṛmayo yāntu bhūtalam . . 22
meaning:
अथ प्रोवाच मार्तण्डो मा ते पादो महीतले .
मांसं रुधिरमादाय कृमयो यान्तु भूतलम् . . 22
text_mt: Then Mārtaṇḍa said: "May your foot not [fall] on the earth's surface; / taking the flesh and blood, let worms go down to the surface of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
yamunāyāśca yattoyaṃ gaṅgātulyaṃ bhaviṣyati .
narmadāyāstapatyāśca samaṃ puṇyena vai dvija . . 23
meaning:
यमुनायाश्च यत्तोयं गङ्गातुल्यं भविष्यति .
नर्मदायास्तपत्याश्च समं पुण्येन वै द्विज . . 23
text_mt: And the water of Yamunā shall become equal to the Gaṅgā, / and [the water] of Tapatī [shall be] equal in merit to the Narmadā, O twice-born one.

sanskrit_iast:
vindhyasya dakṣiṇeneha tapatī pravahiṣyati .
tatsāyujyatayā sāgraṃ gaṅgā yāsyati śobhanā . . 24
meaning:
विन्ध्यस्य दक्षिणेनेह तपती प्रवहिष्यति .
तत्सायुज्यतया साग्रं गङ्गा यास्यति शोभना . . 24
text_mt: Tapatī will flow here to the south of the Vindhya; / the beautiful Gaṅgā will go ahead by virtue of union with her.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgāmāsādya yamunā gaṅgā saiva bhaviṣyati .
saurasaumye ubhe puṇye sarvapāpapraṇāśane . . 25
meaning:
गङ्गामासाद्य यमुना गङ्गा सैव भविष्यति .
सौरसौम्ये उभे पुण्ये सर्वपापप्रणाशने . . 25
text_mt: Having reached the Gaṅgā, Yamunā will become the Gaṅgā herself. / Both of them, born of the Sun and of Soma, are holy and destroy all sins;

sanskrit_iast:
1saurī ca vaiṣṇavī cobhe mahāpāpabhayāpahe .
tvaṃ putra lokapālatvaṃ brahmaṇo'jñāṃ sabhājayan . .
adyaprabhṛti cchāyeyaṃ svadehasthā bhaviṣyati . . 26
meaning:
1सौरी च वैष्णवी चोभे महापापभयापहे .
त्वं पुत्र लोकपालत्वं ब्रह्मणोऽज्ञां सभाजयन् . .
अद्यप्रभृति च्छायेयं स्वदेहस्था भविष्यति . . 26
text_mt: both, related to Sūrya and related to Viṣṇu, remove the fear of great sins. / You, O son, honouring the command of Brahmā, [shall attain] the status of a world protector. / From this day forward, this shadow shall abide in her own body."

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃsthāpya svāṃ bhāryāmapatyāni tathaiva ca .
ājagāma sakāśaṃ vai dakṣasyāha ca kāraṇam2 . .
dakṣo vijñāya tatsarvaṃ mārtaṇḍamidamāha vai . . 27
meaning:
एवं संस्थाप्य स्वां भार्यामपत्यानि तथैव च .
आजगाम सकाशं वै दक्षस्याह च कारणम्2 . .
दक्षो विज्ञाय तत्सर्वं मार्तण्डमिदमाह वै . . 27
text_mt: Having thus settled his wife and offspring likewise, / he went into the presence of Dakṣa and explained the cause. / Having understood all that, Dakṣa indeed said this to Mārtaṇḍa:

sanskrit_iast: rūpaṃ na paśyatī tubhyaṃ sā bhāryā uttarāngatā . . 28
meaning: रूपं न पश्यती तुभ्यं सा भार्या उत्तरान्गता . . 28
text_mt: "She, your wife, does not behold your form, and has gone to the north."

sanskrit_iast:
rūpaṃ te prakaṭiṣyāmi yadi śakṣyasi vedanām .
asau provāca śakṣye'haṃ prakāśī kuru me vapuḥ . . 29
meaning:
रूपं ते प्रकटिष्यामि यदि शक्ष्यसि वेदनाम् .
असौ प्रोवाच शक्ष्येऽहं प्रकाशी कुरु मे वपुः . . 29
text_mt:
"I shall make your form manifest if you can endure the pain."
He replied, "I can endure it; make my body luminous."

sanskrit_iast:
atha sasmāra takṣāṇaṃ smṛta evājagāma saḥ .
provāca dakṣastakṣāṇaṃ mārtaṇḍaṃ vai prakāśaya . . 1.47.30
meaning:
अथ सस्मार तक्षाणं स्मृत एवाजगाम सः .
प्रोवाच दक्षस्तक्षाणं मार्तण्डं वै प्रकाशय . . 1.47.30
text_mt:
Then [Dakṣa] remembered the carpenter, and as soon as he was remembered, he came.
Dakṣa said to the carpenter, "Make Mārtaṇḍa luminous."

sanskrit_iast:
takṣā provāca mārtaṇḍaṃ vedanā visahiṣyase .
visahiṣyetha provāca takṣāṇaṃ dakṣacoditaḥ . . 31
meaning:
तक्षा प्रोवाच मार्तण्डं वेदना विसहिष्यसे .
विसहिष्येथ प्रोवाच तक्षाणं दक्षचोदितः . . 31
text_mt:
The carpenter said to Mārtaṇḍa, "Will you endure the pain?"
Impelled by Dakṣa, he said to the carpenter, "You may expect [me] to endure it."

sanskrit_iast:
atha takṣā prakāśaṃ vai tasya rūpaṃ vibhāvasau .
mukhādārabhya pādāntaṃ tatakṣakaraṇaiḥ svakaiḥ . .
kiraṇaistudyamāneṣu tasyāṅgeṣu punaḥ punaḥ .
kṣaṇekṣaṇe mūrchayati mārtaṇḍo vedanāturaḥ . . 32
meaning:
अथ तक्षा प्रकाशं वै तस्य रूपं विभावसौ .
मुखादारभ्य पादान्तं ततक्षकरणैः स्वकैः . .
किरणैस्तुद्यमानेषु तस्याङ्गेषु पुनः पुनः .
क्षणेक्षणे मूर्छयति मार्तण्डो वेदनातुरः . . 32
text_mt:
Then the carpenter pared down his luminous form, Vibhāvasu's, / starting from the head down to the feet with his chisels.
As his limbs were struck again and again with the rays,
Mārtaṇḍa, tormented by pain, fainted moment after moment.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya śāpabhayāttakṣā pādau gulphādiyāvataḥ .
cakārātho nirākārā aṅgulyo na prakāśayat . . 33
meaning:
तस्य शापभयात्तक्षा पादौ गुल्फादियावतः .
चकाराथो निराकारा अङ्गुल्यो न प्रकाशयत् . . 33
text_mt:
Out of fear of his curse, the carpenter fashioned his feet without shape,
as far as the ankles, and did not make the toes manifest.

sanskrit_iast:
paryāptaṃ takṣakarmedaṃ vedanā mama bādhate .
takṣā provāca mārtaṇḍaṃ vedanāṃ jahi gopate . . 34
meaning:
पर्याप्तं तक्षकर्मेदं वेदना मम बाधते .
तक्षा प्रोवाच मार्तण्डं वेदनां जहि गोपते . . 34
text_mt:
"Enough of this chiselling work! The pain torments me."
The carpenter said to Mārtaṇḍa, "Cast off the pain, O Lord of Rays.

sanskrit_iast:
karavīrasya puṣpāṇi raktacandanameva ca .
karādārabhya gātrāṇi vilimpe dehajāni te . . 35
meaning:
करवीरस्य पुष्पाणि रक्तचन्दनमेव च .
करादारभ्य गात्राणि विलिम्पे देहजानि ते . . 35
text_mt:
With oleander flowers and red sandalwood,
I shall anoint your limbs born of the body, beginning from the hand."

sanskrit_iast:
tattatkṛtaṃ tathā tena sa rujaṃ tyaktavānraviḥ .
ataścemāni ceṣṭāni mārtaṇḍasyeha bhūpate . . 36
meaning:
तत्तत्कृतं तथा तेन स रुजं त्यक्तवान्रविः .
अतश्चेमानि चेष्टानि मार्तण्डस्येह भूपते . . 36
text_mt:
Each of those was done accordingly by him, and the sun cast off the affliction.
And from this, O king, these have become dear to Mārtaṇḍa here:

sanskrit_iast:
karavīrasya puṣpāṇi tathā vai raktacandanam .
idamāha purā devo hyanūroragrato nṛpa . . 37
meaning:
करवीरस्य पुष्पाणि तथा वै रक्तचन्दनम् .
इदमाह पुरा देवो ह्यनूरोरग्रतो नृप . . 37
text_mt:
Flowers of the oleander and also red sandalwood.
Anciently, O king, the god spoke this before Anūru:

sanskrit_iast:
karavīrasya puṣpāṇi raktacandanameva hi .
itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ suparṇaguggulaṃ tathā . . 38
meaning:
करवीरस्य पुष्पाणि रक्तचन्दनमेव हि .
इतिहासपुराणाभ्यां सुपर्णगुग्गुलं तथा . . 38
text_mt:
"Oleander flowers, red sandalwood,
along with the Itihāsas and Purāṇas, and likewise eagle-guggulu—

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ prayacchati me bhaktyā sa me prāṇānprayacchati .
tasmānna deyamanyanme bhaktiyuktena jānatā . . 39
meaning:
यः प्रयच्छति मे भक्त्या स मे प्राणान्प्रयच्छति .
तस्मान्न देयमन्यन्मे भक्तियुक्तेन जानता . . 39
text_mt:
he who offers [these] to me with devotion offers me his very life-breaths.
Therefore, nothing else should be given to me by one who knows, endowed with devotion."

sanskrit_iast:
mārtaṇḍasyāṇḍajaṃ tejo gṛhītvā kila bhārata .
cakāra vajramajaraṃ 1 śatrulekhādināśanam . . 1.47.40
meaning:
मार्तण्डस्याण्डजं तेजो गृहीत्वा किल भारत .
चकार वज्रमजरं 1 शत्रुलेखादिनाशनम् . . 1.47.40
text_mt:
Taking the splendour born from Mārtaṇḍa’s egg, O Bhārata,
[Tvaṣṭṛ] fashioned the ageless vajra that destroys the lines of enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
mārtaṇḍaḥ parituṣṭo'bhūllabdhvā rūpaṃ gatavyathaḥ .
jagāma sa kurūnvegātsvabhāryādarśanotsukaḥ . . 41
meaning:
मार्तण्डः परितुष्टोऽभूल्लब्ध्वा रूपं गतव्यथः .
जगाम स कुरून्वेगात्स्वभार्यादर्शनोत्सुकः . . 41
text_mt:
Having obtained [his] form, Mārtaṇḍa became thoroughly pleased, freed from distress;
eager to see his wife, he went swiftly to the Kurus.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgamadhyagatāṃ dṛṣṭvā vaḍavārūpadhāriṇīm .
aśvarūpaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā svabhāryāmadhiruhya saḥ . .
avāsṛjatsvakaṃ tejo vegenāruhya so'śvavat . .4 2
parapuruṣāśaṅkayā sā sthitā devasya saṃmukhī .
tejo nāsāpuṭābhyāṃ tu yugapatsākṣipatpunaḥ . .4 3
tatra jātau devabhiṣajau nāsatyāvaśvināviti .
retaso'nte tu revanto virocanasuto mahān . . 44
meaning:
मृगमध्यगतां दृष्ट्वा वडवारूपधारिणीम् .
अश्वरूपं ततः कृत्वा स्वभार्यामधिरुह्य सः . .
अवासृजत्स्वकं तेजो वेगेनारुह्य सोऽश्ववत् . .4 2
परपुरुषाशङ्कया सा स्थिता देवस्य संमुखी .
तेजो नासापुटाभ्यां तु युगपत्साक्षिपत्पुनः . .4 3
तत्र जातौ देवभिषजौ नासत्यावश्विनाविति .
रेतसोऽन्ते तु रेवन्तो विरोचनसुतो महान् . . 44
text_mt:
Seeing her among the deer, bearing the form of a mare, / he then assumed the form of a horse, mounted his wife,
and mounting like a horse with speed, he discharged his seed.
Suspecting another male, she stood facing the god, / and cast the splendour back simultaneously from both her nostrils.
There were born the two divine physicians, the Nāsatyas, called the Aśvins; / and at the end of the semen arose great Revanta, the son of Virocana.

sanskrit_iast:
tapatī śaniśca sāvarṇiśchāyāpatyāni vai viduḥ .
yamunā yamaśca pūrvoktau saṃjñā 2 yāśca tathātmajau . . 45
meaning:
तपती शनिश्च सावर्णिश्छायापत्यानि वै विदुः .
यमुना यमश्च पूर्वोक्तौ संज्ञा 2 याश्च तथात्मजौ . . 45
text_mt:
Tapatī, Śani, and Sāvarṇi are known as the children of Chāyā;
and Yamunā and Yama, mentioned earlier, were the children of Saṃjñā.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāryā labdhā vapurdivyaṃ tathā putrāśca bhārata .
saptamyāṃ devadevasya sarvamevamidaṃ yataḥ . .
anena kāraṇeneṣṭā sadā devasya saptamī . . 46
meaning:
भार्या लब्धा वपुर्दिव्यं तथा पुत्राश्च भारत .
सप्तम्यां देवदेवस्य सर्वमेवमिदं यतः . .
अनेन कारणेनेष्टा सदा देवस्य सप्तमी . . 46
text_mt:
His wife was regained, along with a divine body and sons, O Bhārata.
Because all this happened for the god of gods on the saptamī, / for this reason the saptamī is always dear to the god.

sanskrit_iast:
saptamyāṃ sopavāsastu rātrau bhuñjīta yo naraḥ .
kṛtvopavāsaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu pañcamyāmekakālabhuk . . 47
meaning:
सप्तम्यां सोपवासस्तु रात्रौ भुञ्जीत यो नरः .
कृत्वोपवासं षष्ठ्यां तु पञ्चम्यामेककालभुक् . . 47
text_mt:
The man who, fasting on the saptamī, eats at night,
having observed a fast on the ṣaṣṭhī and eaten once on the pañcamī,

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā susaṃskṛtaṃ śākaṃ bhakṣyabhojyaiḥ samanvitam .
devāya brāhmaṇebhyaśca rātrau bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ . . 48
meaning:
दत्त्वा सुसंस्कृतं शाकं भक्ष्यभोज्यैः समन्वितम् .
देवाय ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च रात्रौ भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः . . 48
text_mt:
and having offered well-prepared greens accompanied by food to be chewed and eaten
to the god and to the brāhmaṇas, should eat at night, restrained in speech.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvajjīvaṃ naraḥ kaścidvratametaccarediti .
tasya śrīrvijayaścaiva trivargaścāpi vardhate . . 49
meaning:
यावज्जीवं नरः कश्चिद्व्रतमेतच्चरेदिति .
तस्य श्रीर्विजयश्चैव त्रिवर्गश्चापि वर्धते . . 49
text_mt:
If any man should perform this votive observance for as long as he lives,
his fortune, victory, and the three aims of life increase.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtaśca svargamāyāti 1 vimānavaramāsthitaḥ .
sūryaloke sa ramate manvantaragaṇānbahūn . .
iha cāgatya kālānte nṛpaḥ śānti samanvitaḥ . . 1.47.50
meaning:
मृतश्च स्वर्गमायाति 1 विमानवरमास्थितः .
सूर्यलोके स रमते मन्वन्तरगणान्बहून् . .
इह चागत्य कालान्ते नृपः शान्ति समन्वितः . . 1.47.50
text_mt:
And when dead, mounted on an excellent celestial chariot, he goes to heaven; / he rejoices in the world of the sun for many groups of manvantaras,
and returning here at the end of time, endowed with peace, [he becomes] a king.

sanskrit_iast:
putrapautraiḥ parivṛto dātā syānnṛpatiściram .
bhunakti hi dharāṃ rājanvigrahaiścājitaḥ parai . . 51
meaning:
पुत्रपौत्रैः परिवृतो दाता स्यान्नृपतिश्चिरम् .
भुनक्ति हि धरां राजन्विग्रहैश्चाजितः परै . . 51
text_mt:
Surrounded by sons and grandsons, he becomes a generous monarch for a long time;
he enjoys the earth, O king, undefeated in battles by enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
ye narā rājaśārdūla śākāhāreṇa saptamīm .
upoṣya labdhaṃ tattīrthaṃ pitryaṃ vai rājasaṃjñikam . . 52
meaning:
ये नरा राजशार्दूल शाकाहारेण सप्तमीम् .
उपोष्य लब्धं तत्तीर्थं पित्र्यं वै राजसंज्ञिकम् . . 52
text_mt:
