षष्टिर्वर्षसहस्राणां सहस्राणि स मोदते .
लोके सुमनसां वीर प्रत्येकं मधुसूदन . . 15
text_mt: For sixty thousands of thousands of years he rejoices / in the world of the gods, O hero, in each [individual one], O Madhusūdana.

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhāpya raverarcāṃ supraśaste niveśane .
puruṣaḥ kṛtakṛtyo'sti na doṣaphalamaśnute . . 16
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठाप्य रवेरर्चां सुप्रशस्ते निवेशने .
पुरुषः कृतकृत्योऽस्ति न दोषफलमश्नुते . . 16
text_mt: Having installed an image of the Sun in a very auspicious dwelling, / a man has fulfilled his purpose; he does not experience the fruit of sin.

sanskrit_iast:
ye bhaviṣyanti ye'tītā ākalpaṃ puruṣāḥ kule .
tāṃstārayati saṃsthāpya devasya pratimāṃ raveḥ . . 17
meaning:
ये भविष्यन्ति येऽतीता आकल्पं पुरुषाः कुले .
तांस्तारयति संस्थाप्य देवस्य प्रतिमां रवेः . . 17
text_mt: Those men in his lineage who will be and those who have passed away, until the end of the kalpa— / he delivers them having established an image of the god Ravi.

sanskrit_iast:
anuśiṣṭāḥ kila purā yamena yamakiṅkarāḥ .
pāśadaṇḍakarāḥ kṛṣṇa prajāsaṃyamanodyatāḥ . . 18
meaning:
अनुशिष्टाः किल पुरा यमेन यमकिङ्कराः .
पाशदण्डकराः कृष्ण प्रजासंयमनोद्यताः . . 18
text_mt: Indeed, long ago, the servants of Yama, holding nooses and rods in their hands, / engaged in restraining creatures, were instructed by Yama, O Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
yama uvāca
viharantu yathānyāyaṃ niyogo me'nupālyatām .
nājñābhaṅgaṃ kariṣyanti bhavatāṃ jantavaḥ kvacit . . 19
meaning:
यम उवाच
विहरन्तु यथान्यायं नियोगो मेऽनुपाल्यताम् .
नाज्ञाभङ्गं करिष्यन्ति भवतां जन्तवः क्वचित् . . 19
text_mt: Yama said: / Range about according to proper rule; let my command be observed! / Nowhere will creatures transgress your order.

sanskrit_iast:
kevalaṃ ye jaganmūlaṃ vivasvantamupāśritāḥ .
bhavadbhiḥ parihartavyāsteṣāṃ naiveha saṃsthitiḥ . . 1.113.20
meaning:
केवलं ये जगन्मूलं विवस्वन्तमुपाश्रिताः .
भवद्भिः परिहर्तव्यास्तेषां नैवेह संस्थितिः . . 1.113.20
text_mt: Only those who have taken refuge in Vivasvant, the root of the universe, / must be avoided by you; their dwelling is not here at all.

sanskrit_iast:
ye tu vaivasvatā loke taccittāstatparāyaṇāḥ .
pūjayanti sadā bhānuṃ te ca tyājyā sudūrataḥ . . 21
meaning:
ये तु वैवस्वता लोके तच्चित्तास्तत्परायणाः .
पूजयन्ति सदा भानुं ते च त्याज्या सुदूरतः . . 21
text_mt: Those people in the world who, their minds on him and devoted to him, / always worship the Sun, they too are to be shunned from afar.

sanskrit_iast:
tiṣṭhaṃśca prasvapangacchannuttiṣṭhanskhalite kṣute .
saṅkīrtayati devaṃ yaḥ sa nastyājyaḥ sudūrataḥ . . 22
meaning:
तिष्ठंश्च प्रस्वपन्गच्छन्नुत्तिष्ठन्स्खलिते क्षुते .
सङ्कीर्तयति देवं यः स नस्त्याज्यः सुदूरतः . . 22
text_mt: Standing, sleeping, walking, rising, stumbling, or sneezing, / he who glorifies the god must be avoided by us from afar.

sanskrit_iast:
nityanaimittikairdevaṃ ye yajanti tu bhāskaram .
na cālokyā bhavadbhiste yaddhyānaṃ haṃti vo gatim . . 23
meaning:
नित्यनैमित्तिकैर्देवं ये यजन्ति तु भास्करम् .
न चालोक्या भवद्भिस्ते यद्ध्यानं हंति वो गतिम् . . 23
text_mt: Those who sacrifice to the god Bhāskara with daily and occasional [rites], / you must not even look at them, for meditation on him destroys your power of movement.

sanskrit_iast:
ye puṣpadhūpavāso'bhirbhūṣaṇaiścāpi vallabhaiḥ .
arcayanti na te grāhyā matpituste parigrahāḥ . . 24
meaning:
ये पुष्पधूपवासोऽभिर्भूषणैश्चापि वल्लभैः .
अर्चयन्ति न ते ग्राह्या मत्पितुस्ते परिग्रहाः . . 24
text_mt: Those who worship with flowers, incenses, garments, and favourite ornaments, / they must not be seized; they are the retinue of my father.

sanskrit_iast:
upalepanakartāraḥ kartāro mārjanasya ye .
arkālaye parityājyaṃ teṣāṃ tripuruṣaṃ kulam . . 25
meaning:
उपलेपनकर्तारः कर्तारो मार्जनस्य ये .
अर्कालये परित्याज्यं तेषां त्रिपुरुषं कुलम् . . 25
text_mt: Those who perform smearing [and] those who perform sweeping / in the temple of Arka—their lineage for three generations must be left alone.

sanskrit_iast:
ye vāyatanaṃ bhānoḥ kāritaṃ tatkulodbhavaḥ .
pumānna nāvalokyo vai bhavadbhirduṣṭacakṣuṣā . . 26
meaning:
ये वायतनं भानोः कारितं तत्कुलोद्भवः .
पुमान्न नावलोक्यो वै भवद्भिर्दुष्टचक्षुषा . . 26
text_mt: Or a man born in that family by whom a shrine of the Sun was caused to be built / must not indeed be looked at by you with an evil eye.

sanskrit_iast:
yenārcā bhagavadbhaktyā matpituḥ kāritā śubhā .
narāṇāṃ tatkulaṃ vīrāḥ sadā tyājyaṃ sudūrataḥ . . 27
meaning:
येनार्चा भगवद्भक्त्या मत्पितुः कारिता शुभा .
नराणां तत्कुलं वीराः सदा त्याज्यं सुदूरतः . . 27
text_mt: He by whom an auspicious image of my father was caused to be made with devotion to the Lord— / O heroes, the lineage of those men must always be shunned from afar.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavatāṃ bhramatāṃ yatra bhānusaṃśrayamudrayā .
na cājñābhaṅgakṛtkaścidbhaviṣyati naraḥ kvacit . . 28
meaning:
भवतां भ्रमतां यत्र भानुसंश्रयमुद्रया .
न चाज्ञाभङ्गकृत्कश्चिद्भविष्यति नरः क्वचित् . . 28
text_mt: Wherever you roam, marked by refuge in the Sun, / no man will ever violate your command.

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktāḥ kiṅkarāstena yamena sumahātmanā .
anāśritya vacaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ satrājitamatho gatāḥ . . 29
meaning:
इत्युक्ताः किङ्करास्तेन यमेन सुमहात्मना .
अनाश्रित्य वचः कृष्णः सत्राजितमथो गताः . . 29
text_mt: Having been spoken to thus by that high-souled Yama, / the servants, disregarding [his] word, then went to Satrājit, O Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya te tejasā sarve bhānorbhaktasya suvrata .
mohitāḥ patitā bhūmau yathā ca vihagā nagāt . . 1.113.30
meaning:
तस्य ते तेजसा सर्वे भानोर्भक्तस्य सुव्रत .
मोहिताः पतिता भूमौ यथा च विहगा नगात् . . 1.113.30
text_mt: By the splendour of that devotee of the Sun, O observer of good vows, / all of them were bewildered and fell to the ground like birds from a tree.

sanskrit_iast:
etāṃ mahāphalāṃ yorcāṃ bhānoḥ kārayate naraḥ .
tavākhyānaṃ mahābāho gṛhaṃ kārayituśca yat . . 31
meaning:
एतां महाफलां योर्चां भानोः कारयते नरः .
तवाख्यानं महाबाहो गृहं कारयितुश्च यत् . . 31
text_mt: That image of the Sun of great fruit which a man causes to be made, / and that of one who causes a house to be built, has been told to you, O mighty-armed one.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñā narāṇāṃ pāpaughanāśakāḥ sarvakāmadāḥ .
tathaiveṣṭo jagadbhānuḥ sarvayajñamayo raviḥ . . 32
ādityasnāpanayogavarṇanam
meaning:
यज्ञा नराणां पापौघनाशकाः सर्वकामदाः .
तथैवेष्टो जगद्भानुः सर्वयज्ञमयो रविः . . 32
आदित्यस्नापनयोगवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Sacrifices are destroyers of the flood of men's sins and grant all desires; / likewise the Sun of the universe is worshipped, Ravi who consists of all sacrifices.
Description of the practice of bathing Āditya.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
sthāpitāṃ pratimāṃ bhānoḥ samyaksampūjya mānavaḥ .
yaṃ yaṃ prārthayate kāmaṃ taṃ taṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam . . 1
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
स्थापितां प्रतिमां भानोः सम्यक्सम्पूज्य मानवः .
यं यं प्रार्थयते कामं तं तं प्राप्नोत्यसंशयम् . . 1
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having properly worshipped the installed image of the Sun, / whatever desire a mortal prays for, he attains that without doubt.
title: Ādityasnāpanayogavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ snāpayati devasya ghṛtena pratimāṃ raveḥ .
prastheprasthe dvijāgryāṇāṃ sa dadāti gavāṃ śatam . . 2
meaning:
यः स्नापयति देवस्य घृतेन प्रतिमां रवेः .
प्रस्थेप्रस्थे द्विजाग्र्याणां स ददाति गवां शतम् . . 2
text_mt: He who bathes the image of the god Ravi with ghee, / with every prastha [of it] gives a hundred cows to the foremost of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
gavāṃ śatasya viprebhyo yadvattasya bhavetphalam .
ghṛtaprasthena tadbhānorbhavetsnātakayoginām . . 3
meaning:
गवां शतस्य विप्रेभ्यो यद्वत्तस्य भवेत्फलम् .
घृतप्रस्थेन तद्भानोर्भवेत्स्नातकयोगिनाम् . . 3
text_mt: Whatever fruit there would be of [giving] a hundred cows to brahmins, / that [fruit] comes from a prastha of ghee for the Sun for initiated yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūridyumnena samprāptā saptadvīpā vasundharā .
ghaṭodakena mārtaṇḍapratimā snāpitā kila . .4
meaning:
भूरिद्युम्नेन सम्प्राप्ता सप्तद्वीपा वसुन्धरा .
घटोदकेन मार्तण्डप्रतिमा स्नापिता किल . .4
text_mt: The earth with its seven continents was attained by Bhūridyumna, / since, indeed, an image of Mārtaṇḍa was bathed by him with a pot of water.

sanskrit_iast:
pratimāmasitāṣṭamyāṃ ghṛtena jagatīpateḥ .
snāpayitvā samastebhyaḥ pāpebhyaḥ kṛṣṇa mucyate . . 5
meaning:
प्रतिमामसिताष्टम्यां घृतेन जगतीपतेः .
स्नापयित्वा समस्तेभ्यः पापेभ्यः कृष्ण मुच्यते . . 5
text_mt: Having bathed the image of the Lord of the Earth with ghee on the dark aṣṭamī, / one is freed from all sins, O Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
saptamyāmatha ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vā gavyena haviṣā raveḥ .
snapanaṃ tu bhavecchreṣṭhaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam . . 6
meaning:
सप्तम्यामथ षष्ठ्यां वा गव्येन हविषा रवेः .
स्नपनं तु भवेच्छ्रेष्ठं महापातकनाशनम् . . 6
text_mt:
Bathing the Sun on the seventh or the sixth [lunar day] with oblation made from cow's [milk]
is indeed the best [rite], destroying grave sins.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānato'jñānato vāpi yatpāpaṃ kurute naraḥ .
tatkṣālayati sandhyāyāṃ ghṛtena snapanaṃ raveḥ . . 7
meaning:
ज्ञानतोऽज्ञानतो वापि यत्पापं कुरुते नरः .
तत्क्षालयति सन्ध्यायां घृतेन स्नपनं रवेः . . 7
text_mt:
Whatever sin a man commits, whether knowingly or unknowingly,
bathing the Sun with clarified butter at twilight washes it away.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvayajñamayo bhānurhavyānāṃ paramaṃ ghṛtam .
tayoraśeṣapāpānāṃ kṣālakaḥ saṅgamo bhavet . . 8
meaning:
सर्वयज्ञमयो भानुर्हव्यानां परमं घृतम् .
तयोरशेषपापानां क्षालकः सङ्गमो भवेत् . . 8
text_mt:
The Sun consists of all sacrifices, and clarified butter is the highest of offerings;
the union of the two washes away all sins without remainder.

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣu kṣīravahā nadyo hradāḥ pāyasakardamāḥ .
modate teṣu lokeṣu kṣīrasnānakaro raveḥ . . 9
meaning:
येषु क्षीरवहा नद्यो ह्रदाः पायसकर्दमाः .
मोदते तेषु लोकेषु क्षीरस्नानकरो रवेः . . 9
text_mt:
In worlds where rivers flow with milk and pools have rice-pudding for their mud,
he who bathes the Sun with milk rejoices.

sanskrit_iast:
āhlādaṃ nirvṛtisthānamārogyaṃ cārurūpatām .
saptajanmānyavāpnoti kṣīravānaparo raveḥ . . 1.114.10
meaning:
आह्लादं निर्वृतिस्थानमारोग्यं चारुरूपताम् .
सप्तजन्मान्यवाप्नोति क्षीरवानपरो रवेः . . 1.114.10
text_mt:
Delight, an abode of bliss, health, and handsome form—
for seven births another who offers milk to the Sun attains [these].

sanskrit_iast:
dadhyādīnāṃ vikārāṇāṃ kṣīrataḥ sambhavo yathā .
yathā ca vimalaṃ kṣīraṃ yathā nirvṛtikārakam . .
tathā ca nirmalaṃ jñānaṃ bhavatyapi na saṃśayaḥ . . 11
meaning:
दध्यादीनां विकाराणां क्षीरतः सम्भवो यथा .
यथा च विमलं क्षीरं यथा निर्वृतिकारकम् . .
तथा च निर्मलं ज्ञानं भवत्यपि न संशयः . . 11
text_mt:
Just as products like curd and the rest originate from milk,
and just as milk is pure and brings about bliss,
so also pure knowledge arises [from it]; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
grahānukūlatāṃ puṣṭiṃ priyatyamakhile jane .
karoti bhagavānbhānuḥ kṣīrasnapanatoṣitaḥ . . 12
meaning:
ग्रहानुकूलतां पुष्टिं प्रियत्यमखिले जने .
करोति भगवान्भानुः क्षीरस्नपनतोषितः . . 12
text_mt:
Favour of the planets, nourishment, and affection among all people—
these the blessed Sun bestows, gratified by being bathed in milk.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasya snigdhatāmeti dṛṣṭamātre prasīdati .
ghṛtakṣīreṇa deveśa snāpite timirāpahe . . 13
meaning:
सर्वस्य स्निग्धतामेति दृष्टमात्रे प्रसीदति .
घृतक्षीरेण देवेश स्नापिते तिमिरापहे . . 13
text_mt:
One obtains the affection of all, and at mere sight [the world] is pleased,
when the Lord of gods, the dispeller of darkness, has been bathed with clarified butter and milk, O lord of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe ādityasnāpanayogavarṇanaṃ
nāma caturdaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ . 114 .
sūryapūjāvidhivarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे आदित्यस्नापनयोगवर्णनं
नाम चतुर्दशाधिकशततमोऽध्यायः . 114 .
सूर्यपूजाविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the one hundred and fourteenth chapter, titled 'Description of the Rite of Bathing the Sun,' in the Seventh-Day Ritual of the Brāhmaparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Rules for Worshipping the Sun

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
praśaṃsanti mahātmānaḥ saṃvādaṃ bhāskarāśrayam .
gautamyā saha kauśalyā sumanāyāṃ surālaye . . 1
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
प्रशंसन्ति महात्मानः संवादं भास्कराश्रयम् .
गौतम्या सह कौशल्या सुमनायां सुरालये . . 1
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Great-souled ones praise the dialogue concerning the Sun
between Gautamī and Kauśalyā, who had a cheerful mind in the abode of the gods.
title: Sūryapūjāvidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
svarge'tiśobhanāṃ dṛṣṭvā kauśalyāṃ patinā saha .
brāhmaṇī gautamī nāma paryapṛcchata vismitā . . 2
meaning:
स्वर्गेऽतिशोभनां दृष्ट्वा कौशल्यां पतिना सह .
ब्राह्मणी गौतमी नाम पर्यपृच्छत विस्मिता . . 2
text_mt:
Seeing Kauśalyā exceedingly radiant in heaven together with her husband,
a brāhmaṇa woman named Gautamī, filled with wonder, questioned [her]:

sanskrit_iast:
gautamyuvāca
śataśaḥ santi kauśalye devāḥ svarganivāsinaḥ .
devapatnyastathaivaitāḥ siddhāḥ siddhāṅganāstathā . . 3
meaning:
गौतम्युवाच
शतशः सन्ति कौशल्ये देवाः स्वर्गनिवासिनः .
देवपत्न्यस्तथैवैताः सिद्धाः सिद्धाङ्गनास्तथा . . 3
text_mt:
Gautamī said:
O Kauśalyā, there are hundreds of gods dwelling in heaven,
and likewise these wives of the gods, the siddhas and the wives of siddhas.

sanskrit_iast:
na teṣāmīdṛśo gandho na kāntirna surūpatā .
na vāsasī śobhane ye yathā te patinā saha . . 4
meaning:
न तेषामीदृशो गन्धो न कान्तिर्न सुरूपता .
न वाससी शोभने ये यथा ते पतिना सह . . 4
text_mt:
They do not possess such fragrance, such radiance, or such beauty of form,
nor are their garments as splendid as yours together with your husband.

sanskrit_iast:
naivābharaṇajātāni teṣāṃ bhrājanti vai tathā .
yathā tava yathā patyurna ca svarganivāsinām . . 5
meaning:
नैवाभरणजातानि तेषां भ्राजन्ति वै तथा .
यथा तव यथा पत्युर्न च स्वर्गनिवासिनाम् . . 5
text_mt:
Their various ornaments do not shine in such a way
as yours and your husband's do, nor [do those] of [other] dwellers in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
susnātacailataścaiva yuvayoratiricyate .
lekhādyānāmapīśānāṃ kṣayātiśayavarjitaḥ . . 6
meaning:
सुस्नातचैलतश्चैव युवयोरतिरिच्यते .
लेखाद्यानामपीशानां क्षयातिशयवर्जितः . . 6
text_mt:
Because of your well-cleansed garments, [the radiance] of you two surpasses
even that of the lords such as the gods, being devoid of wane or surfeit.

sanskrit_iast:
tapaḥprabhāvo dānaṃ vā homo vā karmasaṃjñitaḥ .
yuvayoryatsamācakṣva tatsarvaṃ varavarṇini . .
yena me vikrame buddhirmanujā yena saṅgatāḥ . . 7
meaning:
तपःप्रभावो दानं वा होमो वा कर्मसंज्ञितः .
युवयोर्यत्समाचक्ष्व तत्सर्वं वरवर्णिनि . .
येन मे विक्रमे बुद्धिर्मनुजा येन सङ्गताः . . 7
text_mt:
Was it the power of asceticism, or gift-giving, or an oblation known as ritual action?
O fair-complexioned woman, explain to me all that you two [did],
by which my mind may resolve on bold effort, [and] through which mortals meet [such fortune].

sanskrit_iast:
kauśalyovāca
yajño yajñeśvaro bhānurāvābhyāṃ jātu toṣitaḥ .
svargaprāptiriyaṃ tasya karmaṇaḥ phalamuttamam . . 8
meaning:
कौशल्योवाच
यज्ञो यज्ञेश्वरो भानुरावाभ्यां जातु तोषितः .
स्वर्गप्राप्तिरियं तस्य कर्मणः फलमुत्तमम् . . 8

sanskrit_iast:
surūpatā tataḥ prītiḥ paśyatāṃ cāruveṣitā .
yatpṛcchasi mahābhāge tadapyeṣāṃ vadāmi te . . 9
meaning:
सुरूपता ततः प्रीतिः पश्यतां चारुवेषिता .
यत्पृच्छसि महाभागे तदप्येषां वदामि ते . . 9
text_mt:
Beauty of form, then affection from onlookers, and lovely attire—
since you ask, O highly fortunate lady, I shall explain the [cause] of these to you.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthodakaistathā gandhaiḥ snāpito yaddivākaraḥ .
tena kāntiriyaṃ nityaṃ devāṃstribhuvaneśvarān . . 1.115.10
meaning:
तीर्थोदकैस्तथा गन्धैः स्नापितो यद्दिवाकरः .
तेन कान्तिरियं नित्यं देवांस्त्रिभुवनेश्वरान् . . 1.115.10
text_mt:
Because the Maker of Day was bathed with waters of sacred fords and with perfumes,
therefore [we have] this constant lustre, [surpassing] the gods who are lords of the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
manaḥprasādaḥ saumyatvaṃ śarīre ye ca nirvṛtāḥ .
yatpriyatvaṃ ca sarvaṃ syāttadghṛtasnapanātphalam . . 11
meaning:
मनःप्रसादः सौम्यत्वं शरीरे ये च निर्वृताः .
यत्प्रियत्वं च सर्वं स्यात्तद्घृतस्नपनात्फलम् . . 11
text_mt:
Serenity of mind, gentleness, and that bliss which is in the body,
and all that affection [we receive]—that is the fruit of bathing [him] with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
yānyabhīṣṭāni vāsāṃsi yaccābhīṣṭavibhūṣaṇam .
ratnāni yānyabhīṣṭāni yatpriyaṃ cānulepanam . . 12
meaning:
यान्यभीष्टानि वासांसि यच्चाभीष्टविभूषणम् .
रत्नानि यान्यभीष्टानि यत्प्रियं चानुलेपनम् . . 12
text_mt:
Whatever garments were desired, whatever ornament was desired,
whatever jewels were desired, and whatever ointment was beloved,

sanskrit_iast:
ye dhṛtā yāni mālyāni dayitānyabhavansadā .
mama bhartustadaivāsya tadā rājyaṃ praśāsataḥ . . 13
meaning:
ये धृता यानि माल्यानि दयितान्यभवन्सदा .
मम भर्तुस्तदैवास्य तदा राज्यं प्रशासतः . . 13
text_mt:
whatever garlands were worn and were always dear
to my husband at that time, when he was ruling the kingdom,

sanskrit_iast:
tāni sarvāṇi sarvajña sarvapātari bhānuni .
dattāni taṃ samuttho'yaṃ gandhadhūpātmako guṇaḥ . . 14
meaning:
तानि सर्वाणि सर्वज्ञ सर्वपातरि भानुनि .
दत्तानि तं समुत्थोऽयं गन्धधूपात्मको गुणः . . 14
text_mt:
all those were given to the Sun, who is all-knowing and the protector of all;
this quality of fragrance and incense has arisen from that.

sanskrit_iast:
āhārā dayitā ye ca pavitrāśca niveditāḥ .
trilokakartuḥ savitustṛptistadguṇasambhavā . . 15
meaning:
आहारा दयिता ये च पवित्राश्च निवेदिताः .
त्रिलोककर्तुः सवितुस्तृप्तिस्तद्गुणसम्भवा . . 15
text_mt:
And whatever foods were dear and pure were offered
to Savitṛ, the maker of the three worlds; [our] contentment arose from those qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
svargakāmena me bhartrā mayā ca śubhadarśane .
kṛtametatkṛtenābhūdāvayorbhavasaṃkṣayaḥ . . 16
meaning:
स्वर्गकामेन मे भर्त्रा मया च शुभदर्शने .
कृतमेतत्कृतेनाभूदावयोर्भवसंक्षयः . . 16
text_mt:
This was performed by my husband desiring heaven, and by me, O lady of auspicious appearance;
by what was done, the destruction of [further] worldly existence came to us both.

sanskrit_iast:
ye tvakāmā narāḥ samyaktatkurvanti ca śobhane .
teṣāṃ dadāti viśveśo bhagavānmuktimīśvaraḥ . . 17
meaning:
ये त्वकामा नराः सम्यक्तत्कुर्वन्ति च शोभने .
तेषां ददाति विश्वेशो भगवान्मुक्तिमीश्वरः . . 17
text_mt:
Moreover, those men who perform it properly without desires, O fair one,
to them the Lord, the blessed ruler of the universe, grants liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
evamabhyarcya mārtaṇḍamarkaṃ deveśvaraṃ gurum .
prāpto'smyabhimatānkāmānkṛṣṇāhaṃ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ . . 18
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एवमभ्यर्च्य मार्तण्डमर्कं देवेश्वरं गुरुम् .
प्राप्तोऽस्म्यभिमतान्कामान्कृष्णाहं शाश्वतीः समाः . . 18
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Having thus worshipped Mārtaṇḍa, Arka, the lord of gods, the guru,
I attained my desired wishes, O Kṛṣṇa, for eternal years.

sanskrit_iast:
candanāgurukarpūrakuṅkumośīrapadmakaiḥ .
anulipto narairbhaktyā dadāti1 sāgarodbhavām . . 19
meaning:
चन्दनागुरुकर्पूरकुङ्कुमोशीरपद्मकैः .
अनुलिप्तो नरैर्भक्त्या ददाति1 सागरोद्भवाम् . . 19
text_mt:
When anointed with devotion by men using sandalwood, agarwood, camphor, saffron, uśīra, and padmaka,
he grants [Lakṣmī], who arose from the ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
kāleyakaṃ turuṣkaṃ ca raktacandanameva ca .
yānyātmani sadeṣṭāni tāni śasyānyapākuru . . 1.115.20
meaning:
कालेयकं तुरुष्कं च रक्तचन्दनमेव च .
यान्यात्मनि सदेष्टानि तानि शस्यान्यपाकुरु . . 1.115.20
text_mt:
Yellow sandalwood, Turkish incense, and red sandalwood—
whatever is always dear to oneself, do not withhold those commendable [substances].

sanskrit_iast:
gandhāścāpi śubhā ye ca dhūpā ye vijayodayāḥ .
divākarasya dharmajña nivedyāssarvadācyuta . . 21
meaning:
गन्धाश्चापि शुभा ये च धूपा ये विजयोदयाः .
दिवाकरस्य धर्मज्ञ निवेद्यास्सर्वदाच्युत . . 21
text_mt:
Auspicious perfumes as well, and incenses that bring about victory,
should always be offered to the Maker of Day, O Knower of Dharma, O Acyuta.

sanskrit_iast:
na dadyātsallakīkṣāraṃ no mukhena ca saṃhṛtam .
dadyādarkāya dharmajña dhūpamārādhanodyataḥ . . 22
meaning:
न दद्यात्सल्लकीक्षारं नो मुखेन च संहृतम् .
दद्यादर्काय धर्मज्ञ धूपमाराधनोद्यतः . . 22
text_mt:
One should not offer the exudation of the sallakī tree, nor [incense] blown upon by the mouth;
intent on worship, O Knower of Dharma, one should offer incense to Arka.

sanskrit_iast:
mālatī mallikā caiva yūthikā cātimuktikaḥ .
pāṭalāḥ karavīraśca japā sevantireva ca . . 23
meaning:
मालती मल्लिका चैव यूथिका चातिमुक्तिकः .
पाटलाः करवीरश्च जपा सेवन्तिरेव च . . 23
text_mt:
Mālatī and mallikā, yūthikā and atimuktaka,
pāṭalā flowers, karavīra, japā, and sevantī;

sanskrit_iast:
kuṅkumastagaraścaiva karṇikāraḥ sakeśaraḥ .
campakaḥ ketaka kundo bāṇabarbaramālikā . . 24
meaning:
कुङ्कुमस्तगरश्चैव कर्णिकारः सकेशरः .
चम्पकः केतक कुन्दो बाणबर्बरमालिका . . 24
text_mt:
Saffron, tagara, and karṇikāra along with its filaments,
campaka, ketaka, kunda, bāṇa, and barbaramālikā;

sanskrit_iast:
aśokastilako lodhrastathā caivāṭarūṣakaḥ .
śatapatrāṇi dhanyāni bakāhvānī viśeṣataḥ . . 25
meaning:
अशोकस्तिलको लोध्रस्तथा चैवाटरूषकः .
शतपत्राणि धन्यानि बकाह्वानी विशेषतः . . 25
text_mt:
Aśoka, tilaka, lodhra, and likewise aṭarūṣaka,
praise-worthy lotuses, and especially [the flowers] named baka;

sanskrit_iast:
agastiṃ kiṃśukaṃ tadvatpūjārthaṃ bhāskarasya tu .
amī puṣpaprakārāstu śastā bhāskarapūjane . . 26
meaning:
अगस्तिं किंशुकं तद्वत्पूजार्थं भास्करस्य तु .
अमी पुष्पप्रकारास्तु शस्ता भास्करपूजने . . 26
text_mt:
Agasti and likewise kiṃśuka for the worship of the Sun—
these varieties of flowers are commendable in the worship of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
bilvapatraṃ śamīpatraṃ patraṃ vā bhṛṅgarasya ca .
tamālapatraṃ ca hare sadaiva bhagavatpriyam . . 27
meaning:
बिल्वपत्रं शमीपत्रं पत्रं वा भृङ्गरस्य च .
तमालपत्रं च हरे सदैव भगवत्प्रियम् . . 27
text_mt:
A bilva leaf, a śamī leaf, or a leaf of bhṛṅgarāja,
and a tamāla leaf, O Hari, are always dear to the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tulasī kālatulasī tathā raktaṃ ca candanam .
ketakī patrapuṣpaṃ tu sadyastuṣṭikaraṃ raveḥ . . 28
meaning:
तुलसी कालतुलसी तथा रक्तं च चन्दनम् .
केतकी पत्रपुष्पं तु सद्यस्तुष्टिकरं रवेः . . 28
text_mt:
Tulasī, black tulasī, and likewise red sandalwood,
and the leaf-like flower of the ketakī instantly grant satisfaction to the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
padmotpalasamutthāni raktaṃ nīlotpalaṃ tathā .
sitotpalaṃ tu bhānostu dayitāni sadācyuta . . 29
meaning:
पद्मोत्पलसमुत्थानि रक्तं नीलोत्पलं तथा .
सितोत्पलं तु भानोस्तु दयितानि सदाच्युत . . 29
text_mt:
Those originating from padma and utpala, as well as the red, blue,
and white water-lily, are always dear to the Sun, O Acyuta.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇalokanmattakaṃ kāntaṃ tathaiva girimallikā .
na karṇikārikāpuṣpaṃ bhāskarāya nivedayet . . 1.115.30
meaning:
कृष्णलोकन्मत्तकं कान्तं तथैव गिरिमल्लिका .
न कर्णिकारिकापुष्पं भास्कराय निवेदयेत् . . 1.115.30
text_mt:
The kṛṣṇaloka, the unmattaka, the kānta, and likewise the girimallikā,
and the karṇikārikā flower one should not offer to the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṭajaṃ śālmalīpuṣpaṃ tathānyadgandhavarjitam .
niveditaṃ bhayaṃ rogaṃ niḥsvatāṃ ca prayacchati . . 31
meaning:
कुटजं शाल्मलीपुष्पं तथान्यद्गन्धवर्जितम् .
निवेदितं भयं रोगं निःस्वतां च प्रयच्छति . . 31
text_mt:
The kuṭaja, the flower of the śālmalī, and whatever else is devoid of fragrance,
when offered, brings fear, disease, and poverty.

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣāṃ na pratiṣedho'sti gandhavarṇānvitāni ca .
tāni puṣpāṇi deyāni mānave lokabhānave . . 32
meaning:
येषां न प्रतिषेधोऽस्ति गन्धवर्णान्वितानि च .
तानि पुष्पाणि देयानि मानवे लोकभानवे . . 32
text_mt:
Those flowers which are not prohibited and are endowed with fragrance and colour
should be offered by man to the Sun of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
sugandhaiśca murāmāṃsīkarpūrāgarucandanaiḥ .
tathānyaiśca śubhairdravyairarcayedvanamālinam . . 33
meaning:
सुगन्धैश्च मुरामांसीकर्पूरागरुचन्दनैः .
तथान्यैश्च शुभैर्द्रव्यैरर्चयेद्वनमालिनम् . . 33
text_mt:
And with sweet perfumes—murā, māṃsī, camphor, agarwood, and sandalwood—
and with other auspicious substances, one should worship the garlanded one.

sanskrit_iast:
dukūlapaṭṭakauśeyavārkṣakārpāsakādibhiḥ .
vāsobhiḥ pūjayedbhānuṃ yāni cātmapriyāṇi tu . . 34
meaning:
दुकूलपट्टकौशेयवार्क्षकार्पासकादिभिः .
वासोभिः पूजयेद्भानुं यानि चात्मप्रियाणि तु . . 34
text_mt:
With garments of dukūla, silk, tussar silk, bark-cloth, cotton, and the like,
and with those which are dear to oneself, one should worship the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣyāṇi yānyabhīṣṭāni bhojyānyabhimatāni ca .
phalaṃ ca vallabhaṃ yatsyāttatte deyaṃ divākare . . 35
meaning:
भक्ष्याणि यान्यभीष्टानि भोज्यान्यभिमतानि च .
फलं च वल्लभं यत्स्यात्तत्ते देयं दिवाकरे . . 35
text_mt:
Whatever chewable foods are desired and whatever eatables are approved,
and whatever fruit is favoured—that should be given by you to the Maker of Day.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇamaṇimuktāni rajataṃ ca tathācyuta .
dakṣiṇā vividhā ceha yaccānyadapi vallabham . . 36
meaning:
सुवर्णमणिमुक्तानि रजतं च तथाच्युत .
दक्षिणा विविधा चेह यच्चान्यदपि वल्लभम् . . 36
text_mt: Gold, gems, pearls, and silver as well, O Acyuta, / and diverse priestly gifts here, and whatever else is precious,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānaṃ bhāskaraṃ matvā yajñaṃ tasmai nivedayet .
tattadavyaktarūpāya bhāskarāya nivedayet . . 37
meaning:
आत्मानं भास्करं मत्वा यज्ञं तस्मै निवेदयेत् .
तत्तदव्यक्तरूपाय भास्कराय निवेदयेत् . . 37
text_mt: he should offer as a sacrifice to him, regarding himself as the Sun; / he should offer all that to the Sun whose form is unmanifest.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe ādityamāhātmye sūryapūjāvidhivarṇanaṃ
nāma pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ . 115 .
ravipūjāvidhivarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे आदित्यमाहात्म्ये सूर्यपूजाविधिवर्णनं
नाम पञ्चदशाधिकशततमोऽध्यायः . 115 .
रविपूजाविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the one hundred and fifteenth chapter, named 'Description of the Procedure for Sun Worship', in the discourse on the Greatness of Āditya, in the Seventh-Day Rite of the Brāhmaparvan in the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Procedure for Sun Worship

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
kṛṣṇa rājā mahānāsīdyayātikulasambhavaḥ .
satrājiditi vikhyātaścakravartī mahābalaḥ . . 1
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
कृष्ण राजा महानासीद्ययातिकुलसम्भवः .
सत्राजिदिति विख्यातश्चक्रवर्ती महाबलः . . 1
text_mt: Brahmā said: / O Kṛṣṇa, there was a great king born in the lineage of Yayāti, / renowned as Satrājit, an emperor of great might.
title: Ravipūjāvidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
prabhāvaistejasā kāntyā kṣāntyā balasamanvitaḥ .
dhairyagambhīryasampanno vadānyo yaśasānvitaḥ . . 2
meaning:
प्रभावैस्तेजसा कान्त्या क्षान्त्या बलसमन्वितः .
धैर्यगम्भीर्यसम्पन्नो वदान्यो यशसान्वितः . . 2
text_mt: Endowed with power, splendour, beauty, forbearance, and strength, / full of steadfastness and depth, generous, endowed with renown,

sanskrit_iast:
buddhyā vikramadakṣaśca sampanno brāhmaṇāyataḥ .
kṛtī kavistathā śūraḥ ṣaṭpadākhyairna nirjitaḥ . . 3
meaning:
बुद्ध्या विक्रमदक्षश्च सम्पन्नो ब्राह्मणायतः .
कृती कविस्तथा शूरः षट्पदाख्यैर्न निर्जितः . . 3
text_mt: skilled in valour through his intellect, accomplished, dedicated to brahmins, / skilled, wise, and brave, undefeated by the six enemies,

sanskrit_iast:
sadā pañcasu raktaśca vasumadbhirna nirjitaḥ .
rudratā vasubhirjātaiḥ sattvaśraddhāsamanvitaḥ . . 4
meaning:
सदा पञ्चसु रक्तश्च वसुमद्भिर्न निर्जितः .
रुद्रता वसुभिर्जातैः सत्त्वश्रद्धासमन्वितः . . 4
text_mt: ever devoted to the five, not overcome by those who possess wealth, / formidable as Rudra with the Vasus who arose, endowed with goodness and faith,

sanskrit_iast:
ambujasyāṇḍajasyeva ātreyasya tathācyuta .
ambujāyāstathā kṛṣṇa vāryapātraṃ sa vai vibho . . 5
meaning:
अम्बुजस्याण्डजस्येव आत्रेयस्य तथाच्युत .
अम्बुजायास्तथा कृष्ण वार्यपात्रं स वै विभो . . 5
text_mt: just like the lotus-born [Brahmā], the egg-born [Garuḍa], or the descendant of Atri [the Moon], O Acyuta, / and like the lotus-born [Lakṣmī], O Kṛṣṇa, he was indeed an ocean of virtues, O lord.

sanskrit_iast:
gāṅgeyena bale tulyaḥ paulastyārcāśramo yathā .
gāṅgeyasya tathā kṛṣṇa dhiṣaṇasya hareryathā . . 6
meaning:
गाङ्गेयेन बले तुल्यः पौलस्त्यार्चाश्रमो यथा .
गाङ्गेयस्य तथा कृष्ण धिषणस्य हरेर्यथा . . 6
text_mt: In strength he was equal to the son of Gaṅgā [Bhīṣma]; like the ascetic striving in worship of Pulastya's descendant [Rāvaṇa], / so was he to the son of Gaṅgā, O Kṛṣṇa, and like Bṛhaspati to Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmyaśca dvijabhaktastu tathā vālmīkivatsadā .
vyāsasya devaśārdūla jāmadagnyasya vā vibhoḥ . . 7
meaning:
काम्यश्च द्विजभक्तस्तु तथा वाल्मीकिवत्सदा .
व्यासस्य देवशार्दूल जामदग्न्यस्य वा विभोः . . 7
text_mt: Desirable and devoted to twice-born [brahmins], ever like Vālmīki, / like Vyāsa, O tiger among gods, or like the mighty son of Jamadagni [Paraśurāma],

sanskrit_iast:
eṣāṃ naikairguṇairyuktaḥ sa rājā kṣmātale vibho .
śaśāsa sa mahābāhuḥ saptadvīpāṃ vasundharām . . 8
meaning:
एषां नैकैर्गुणैर्युक्तः स राजा क्ष्मातले विभो .
शशास स महाबाहुः सप्तद्वीपां वसुन्धराम् . . 8
text_mt: endowed with the many virtues of these [illustrious figures], O lord, that mighty-armed king / ruled upon the surface of the earth over the land of seven continents,

sanskrit_iast:
yasmingāthāṃ pragāyanti ye purāṇavido janāḥ .
satrājite mahābāhau kṛṣṇa dhātrīṃ samāśrite . . 9
meaning:
यस्मिन्गाथां प्रगायन्ति ये पुराणविदो जनाः .
सत्राजिते महाबाहौ कृष्ण धात्रीं समाश्रिते . . 9
text_mt: about whom people knowing the Purāṇas sing a song / when the mighty-armed Satrājit, O Kṛṣṇa, held sway over the earth:

sanskrit_iast:
yāvatsūrya udeti sma yāvacca pratitiṣṭhati .
satrājitaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ kṣetramityamidhīyate . . 1.116.10
meaning:
यावत्सूर्य उदेति स्म यावच्च प्रतितिष्ठति .
सत्राजितं तु तत्सर्वं क्षेत्रमित्यमिधीयते . . 1.116.10
text_mt: 'As far as the sun rises and as far as it sets, / all of that is declared to be the domain of Satrājit.'

sanskrit_iast:
sa sarvaratnasaṃyuktāṃ saptadvīpavatīṃ mahīm .
śaśāsa dharmeṇa purā cakravartī mahābalaḥ . . 11
meaning:
स सर्वरत्नसंयुक्तां सप्तद्वीपवतीं महीम् .
शशास धर्मेण पुरा चक्रवर्ती महाबलः . . 11
text_mt: Endowed with all jewels, that emperor of great strength / formerly ruled according to dharma over the earth with its seven continents.

sanskrit_iast:
nānyāyakṛnna cāśakto vadānyo balavattaraḥ .
tasyābhūtpuruṣā rājñaḥ samyagdharmānuśāsinaḥ . . 12
meaning:
नान्यायकृन्न चाशक्तो वदान्यो बलवत्तरः .
तस्याभूत्पुरुषा राज्ञः सम्यग्धर्मानुशासिनः . . 12
text_mt: He did no injustice, nor was he weak; he was generous and exceedingly strong. / That king had officers who properly enforced righteous conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāraḥ sacivāstasya rājñaḥ satrājitasya tu .
babhūvurapratihatāḥ sadā vāti balasya vai . . 13
meaning:
चत्वारः सचिवास्तस्य राज्ञः सत्राजितस्य तु .
बभूवुरप्रतिहताः सदा वाति बलस्य वै . . 13
text_mt: There were four ministers of that king Satrājit, / who were unhindered and ever directed his military force.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya bhaktiratīvāsīnnisargādeva bhūpateḥ .
divākare jagadbhānau raktacandanamālini . . 14
meaning:
तस्य भक्तिरतीवासीन्निसर्गादेव भूपतेः .
दिवाकरे जगद्भानौ रक्तचन्दनमालिनि . . 14
text_mt: That lord of the earth had exceedingly great devotion, by his very nature, / to the Sun, the light of the universe, adorned with garlands of red sandalwood.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyordhvamahimānaṃ ca vilokya pṛthivīpateḥ .
na kevalaṃ janasyāpi hyabhavattasya vismayaḥ . . 15
meaning:
तस्योर्ध्वमहिमानं च विलोक्य पृथिवीपतेः .
न केवलं जनस्यापि ह्यभवत्तस्य विस्मयः . . 15
text_mt: Beholding his supreme majesty, the lord of the earth / felt astonishment, and not he alone, but his people as well.

sanskrit_iast:
sañcintayāmāsa nṛpaḥ samṛddhyā vismitastathā .
kathaṃ syāt sampadeṣā me punarapyanyajanmani . . 16
meaning:
सञ्चिन्तयामास नृपः समृद्ध्या विस्मितस्तथा .
कथं स्यात् सम्पदेषा मे पुनरप्यन्यजन्मनि . . 16
text_mt: Astonished by his prosperity, the king reflected: / 'How might this fortune be mine once again in another birth?'

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sa bahuśo rājā tadā kṛṣṇa mahāyaśāḥ .
cintayannapi tanmūlaṃ nāsadanniścayānvitaḥ . . 17
meaning:
एवं स बहुशो राजा तदा कृष्ण महायशाः .
चिन्तयन्नपि तन्मूलं नासदन्निश्चयान्वितः . . 17
text_mt: In this way, O Kṛṣṇa, that highly renowned king then, / although thinking many times of its root cause, could not arrive at any certainty.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā na niścayaṃ rājā sa yayau bhārgavīpriyaḥ .
tadā papraccha dharmajñānsa viprānsamupāgatān . . 18
meaning:
यदा न निश्चयं राजा स ययौ भार्गवीप्रियः .
तदा पप्रच्छ धर्मज्ञान्स विप्रान्समुपागतान् . . 18
text_mt: When the king, beloved of Bhārgavī, could reach no conclusion, / he then questioned the brahmins who had arrived, who were knowers of dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāśca sasukhānvīra viviktāntaḥ purasthitaḥ .
praṇipatya mahābāhurgrahītuṃ śāsanakriyāḥ . . 19
meaning:
सर्वाश्च ससुखान्वीर विविक्तान्तः पुरस्थितः .
प्रणिपत्य महाबाहुर्ग्रहीतुं शासनक्रियाः . . 19
text_mt: Seated in the secluded inner quarters, the mighty-armed hero, / having bowed down to them all who were at ease, [spoke] to receive their instructions:

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāsānugrahā buddhirbhavatāṃ mayi sattamāḥ .
tadahaṃ praṣṭumicchāmi kiñcittadvaktumarhatha . . 1.116.20
meaning:
विश्वासानुग्रहा बुद्धिर्भवतां मयि सत्तमाः .
तदहं प्रष्टुमिच्छामि किञ्चित्तद्वक्तुमर्हथ . . 1.116.20
text_mt: 'Your disposition toward me, O best of men, is one of trust and grace. / Therefore I wish to ask something; you ought to tell it to me.

sanskrit_iast:
sadvidyākhilavijñānasamyagdhautāntarātmabhiḥ .
bhavadbhiryadyanugrāhyaḥ syāmahaṃ vedavittamāḥ . . 21
meaning:
सद्विद्याखिलविज्ञानसम्यग्धौतान्तरात्मभिः .
भवद्भिर्यद्यनुग्राह्यः स्यामहं वेदवित्तमाः . . 21
text_mt: If I am to be favoured by you whose inner selves are fully purified / by true knowledge and all discerning wisdom, O best among the knowers of the Veda,

sanskrit_iast:
tadyathāvanmayā pṛṣṭā bhavanto matprasādinaḥ .
vaktumarhatha vidvāṃsaḥ sarvasyaivopakāriṇaḥ . . 22
meaning:
तद्यथावन्मया पृष्टा भवन्तो मत्प्रसादिनः .
वक्तुमर्हथ विद्वांसः सर्वस्यैवोपकारिणः . . 22
text_mt: then, when properly questioned by me, you who are gracious toward me, / who are learned and benefactors of all, ought to speak.'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
yaste manasi sandehastaṃ pṛcchādya mahīpate .
vadiṣyāmo yathānyāyaṃ yatte1 manasi varttate . . 23
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
यस्ते मनसि सन्देहस्तं पृच्छाद्य महीपते .
वदिष्यामो यथान्यायं यत्ते1 मनसि वर्त्तते . . 23
text_mt: [The brahmins] said: / 'Ask today, O lord of the earth, whatever doubt is in your mind; / we shall tell you according to propriety whatever dwells in your heart.

sanskrit_iast:
vayaṃ hi nṛpaśārdūla bhavatā pāritoṣitāḥ .
samyakprajāṃ pālayitrā dadatā bhojanaṃ sadā . . 24
meaning:
वयं हि नृपशार्दूल भवता पारितोषिताः .
सम्यक्प्रजां पालयित्रा ददता भोजनं सदा . . 24
text_mt: For we, O tiger among kings, have been pleased by you, / who properly protect the subjects and constantly give food.

sanskrit_iast:
santuṣṭo brāhmaṇo'śnīyācchiṃdyādvā dharmasaṃśayam .
hitaṃ copadiśedvartma ahitādvā nivartayet . . 25
meaning:
सन्तुष्टो ब्राह्मणोऽश्नीयाच्छिंद्याद्वा धर्मसंशयम् .
हितं चोपदिशेद्वर्त्म अहिताद्वा निवर्तयेत् . . 25
text_mt: A satisfied brahmin should eat, or he should resolve a doubt regarding dharma; / he should teach a beneficial path or turn [one] away from what is harmful.'

sanskrit_iast:
vivakṣumatha bhūpālaṃ bhāryā tasyaiva dhīmataḥ .
praṇipātena cāhedaṃ vinayātpraṇayānvitam . . 26
meaning:
विवक्षुमथ भूपालं भार्या तस्यैव धीमतः .
प्रणिपातेन चाहेदं विनयात्प्रणयान्वितम् . . 26
text_mt: As the ruler of the earth was then about to speak, the wise king's wife, / with a bow and out of modesty filled with affection, said this:

sanskrit_iast:
na strīṇāmavanīpāla vaktumīdṛgiheṣyate .
tathāpi bhūpate vakṣye sampadīdṛksudurlabhā . . 27
meaning:
न स्त्रीणामवनीपाल वक्तुमीदृगिहेष्यते .
तथापि भूपते वक्ष्ये सम्पदीदृक्सुदुर्लभा . . 27
text_mt: 'It is not considered fitting for women to speak like this here, O protector of the earth; / nevertheless, O king, I shall speak, for such fortune is extremely difficult to obtain.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyo'pi saṃśayānpraṣṭumalamīśo bhavānṛṣīn .
nanvahaṃ puraṣavyāghra sadāntaḥ puracāriṇī . . 28
meaning:
भूयोऽपि संशयान्प्रष्टुमलमीशो भवानृषीन् .
नन्वहं पुरषव्याघ्र सदान्तः पुरचारिणी . . 28
text_mt: You, my lord, are well able to ask the sages about your doubts again. / But I, O tiger among men, ever move only within the inner quarters.

sanskrit_iast:
tatprasādaṃ yadi bhavānkaroti mama pārthiva .
tanmadīyamṛṣīnpraṣṭuṃ sandehaṃ pārthivārhasi . . 29
meaning:
तत्प्रसादं यदि भवान्करोति मम पार्थिव .
तन्मदीयमृषीन्प्रष्टुं सन्देहं पार्थिवार्हसि . . 29
text_mt: Therefore, if you would show me favour, O king, / you ought to ask the sages this doubt of mine, O ruler of the earth.'

sanskrit_iast:
satrājita uvāca
brūhi subhrūrmataṃ yatte praṣṭavyā yanmayā dvijāḥ .
bhūyo'hamātmasandehaṃ prakṣyāmyetaddvijottamān . . 1.116.30
meaning:
सत्राजित उवाच
ब्रूहि सुभ्रूर्मतं यत्ते प्रष्टव्या यन्मया द्विजाः .
भूयोऽहमात्मसन्देहं प्रक्ष्याम्येतद्द्विजोत्तमान् . . 1.116.30
text_mt: Satrājit said: / 'Speak, O fair-browed one, what you think the twice-born should be asked by me; / afterwards I shall ask these best of the twice-born my own doubt.'

sanskrit_iast:
vimalavatyuvāca
śrūyante pṛthivīpāla nṛpā ye tu cirantanāḥ .
yeṣāṃ ca sampadbhūpāla yathā te'dya kilābhavat . . 31
meaning:
विमलवत्युवाच
श्रूयन्ते पृथिवीपाल नृपा ये तु चिरन्तनाः .
येषां च सम्पद्भूपाल यथा तेऽद्य किलाभवत् . . 31
text_mt: Vimalavatī said: / 'O protector of the earth, we hear of kings of old / who possessed such fortune, O king, as is yours today.

sanskrit_iast:
tadīdṛksampado dhāma tavāśeṣaṃ kṣitīśvara .
yena karmavipākena tadvadantu maharṣayaḥ . . 32
meaning:
तदीदृक्सम्पदो धाम तवाशेषं क्षितीश्वर .
येन कर्मविपाकेन तद्वदन्तु महर्षयः . . 32
text_mt: By the fruition of what deed did all of this abode of such fortune / become yours, O lord of the earth? Let the great sages tell that.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ ca bhavato bhāryā sarvasīmantinīvarā .
atīva karmaṇā yena tadvijñāne kutūhalam . . 33
meaning:
अहं च भवतो भार्या सर्वसीमन्तिनीवरा .
अतीव कर्मणा येन तद्विज्ञाने कुतूहलम् . . 33
text_mt: And by what extraordinary deed did I become your wife, / the best of all women with parted hair? I have a curiosity to know that.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā sampatsamṛddhatvamanyeṣvapi hi vidyate .
nirastātiśayatvena nūnaṃ nālpena karmaṇā . . 34
meaning:
तथा सम्पत्समृद्धत्वमन्येष्वपि हि विद्यते .
निरस्तातिशयत्वेन नूनं नाल्पेन कर्मणा . . 34
text_mt: Likewise, abundance of fortune is found in others too, / but this unsurpassed nature [of yours] is surely not due to a trivial deed.

sanskrit_iast:
tadanyajanmacaritaṃ naranātha nijaṃ bhavān .
munīnpṛccha tvayā cāhaṃ yanmayā ca purā kṛtam . . 35
meaning:
तदन्यजन्मचरितं नरनाथ निजं भवान् .
मुनीन्पृच्छ त्वया चाहं यन्मया च पुरा कृतम् . . 35
text_mt: Therefore, O lord of men, ask the sages about your own deeds in another birth, / and what was done previously by you and by me.'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
sa tathoktastayā rājā patnyā vismitamānasaḥ .
munīnāṃ purato māyāṃ praśaṃsanvākyamabravīt . . 36
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
स तथोक्तस्तया राजा पत्न्या विस्मितमानसः .
मुनीनां पुरतो मायां प्रशंसन्वाक्यमब्रवीत् . . 36
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having been addressed in this way by his wife, the king, with wonder in his heart, / praising her cleverness before the sages, spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
sādhu devi mataṃ yanme tvayā yadidamīritam .
satyaṃ munivacaḥ puṃsāṃ syāddha vai gṛhiṇī tathā . . 37
meaning:
साधु देवि मतं यन्मे त्वया यदिदमीरितम् .
सत्यं मुनिवचः पुंसां स्याद्ध वै गृहिणी तथा . . 37
text_mt: 'Noble is your thought, O queen, which has been spoken by you! / True is the sages' word that a housewife is indeed [a partner in dharma] for men.

sanskrit_iast:
so'hametanmahābhāge pṛcchāmyetānmahāmunīn .
teṣāmaviditaṃ kiñcittriṣu lokeṣu na vidyate . . 38
meaning:
सोऽहमेतन्महाभागे पृच्छाम्येतान्महामुनीन् .
तेषामविदितं किञ्चित्त्रिषु लोकेषु न विद्यते . . 38
text_mt: Therefore, O highly fortunate one, I shall ask these great sages; / there is nothing in the three worlds that is unknown to them.'

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā priyāṃ rājā praṇipatya ca tānṛṣīn .
yathāvadetadakhilaṃ papraccha dharaṇīdharaḥ . . 39
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा प्रियां राजा प्रणिपत्य च तानृषीन् .
यथावदेतदखिलं पप्रच्छ धरणीधरः . . 39
text_mt: Having spoken thus to his beloved, and having bowed down to those sages, / the sustainer of the earth asked all this in accordance with proper rule.

sanskrit_iast:
rājovāca
bhagavanto mamāśeṣaṃ prasādāvṛtacetasaḥ .
kathayantu yathāvṛttaṃ yanmayā sukṛtaṃ kṛtam . .1.116.4 0
ko'hamāsaṃ purā viprāḥ kiṃsvitkarma mayā kṛtam .
kiṃ vānayā tu cārvaṃgyā mama patnyā kṛtaṃ dvijāḥ . .4 1
yenāvayoriyaṃ lakṣmīrmartyaloke sudurlabhā .
catvāraścāpratihatā amātyā mama gacchataḥ . .4 2
aśeṣā bhūbhṛto vaśyā dhanasyānto na vidyate .
balaṃ caivāpratihataṃ śarīrārogyameva ca . .4 3
pratibhāti ca me kāntyā bhāryāyāmakhilaṃ jagat .
mamāpi vapuṣastejo na kaścitsahate dvijāḥ .44
meaning:
राजोवाच
भगवन्तो ममाशेषं प्रसादावृतचेतसः .
कथयन्तु यथावृत्तं यन्मया सुकृतं कृतम् . .1.116.4 0
कोऽहमासं पुरा विप्राः किंस्वित्कर्म मया कृतम् .
किं वानया तु चार्वंग्या मम पत्न्या कृतं द्विजाः . .4 1
येनावयोरियं लक्ष्मीर्मर्त्यलोके सुदुर्लभा .
चत्वारश्चाप्रतिहता अमात्या मम गच्छतः . .4 2
अशेषा भूभृतो वश्या धनस्यान्तो न विद्यते .
बलं चैवाप्रतिहतं शरीरारोग्यमेव च . .4 3
प्रतिभाति च मे कान्त्या भार्यायामखिलं जगत् .
ममापि वपुषस्तेजो न कश्चित्सहते द्विजाः .44
text_mt:
The king said:
May your reverences, with minds enveloped in grace,
relate to me fully as it happened the virtuous deed that was done by me.
Who was I in the past, O brāhmaṇas? What action indeed was performed by me,
or what was done by this slender-limbed wife of mine, O twice-born ones,
by which this fortune, so very difficult to attain in the mortal world, belongs to the two of us,
and four ministers, unopposed, attend me as I proceed,
all kings are submissive, there is no end to wealth,
and my strength is irresistible, as is the health of my body?
And the entire world seems radiant to me in my wife by her beauty,
and no one can endure the lustre of my body as well, O twice-born ones.

sanskrit_iast:
so'hamicchāmi tajjñātuṃ tathaiveyamaninditā .
nijānuṣṭhānamakhilaṃ yasyāśeṣamidaṃ phalam . .45
meaning:
सोऽहमिच्छामि तज्ज्ञातुं तथैवेयमनिन्दिता .
निजानुष्ठानमखिलं यस्याशेषमिदं फलम् . .45
text_mt:
Therefore I wish to know that, and likewise this blameless woman [wishes to know],
the entirety of her own practice, of which all this is the fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
iti pṛṣṭā narendreṇa samastāste tapodhanāḥ .
parāvasumathocuste kathyatāmasya bhūbhṛtaḥ . . 46
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इति पृष्टा नरेन्द्रेण समस्तास्ते तपोधनाः .
परावसुमथोचुस्ते कथ्यतामस्य भूभृतः . . 46
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Having been thus questioned by the king, all those ascetics
then said to Parāvasu: “Let it be told to this king.”

sanskrit_iast:
coditaḥ so'pi dharmajñairmahāśūrā mahāmatiḥ .
yogamāsthāya suciraṃ yathāvadyatamānasaḥ . . 47
meaning:
चोदितः सोऽपि धर्मज्ञैर्महाशूरा महामतिः .
योगमास्थाय सुचिरं यथावद्यतमानसः . . 47
text_mt:
Urged by those who knew dharma, he too, a great hero and of great intellect,
having entered into yoga for a very long time, with his mind suitably restrained,

sanskrit_iast:
jñātavānnṛpatestasya pūrvadehaviceṣṭitam .
sa tamāha munirbhūpaṃ vijñānecchaṃ mahāmatim . . 48
meaning:
ज्ञातवान्नृपतेस्तस्य पूर्वदेहविचेष्टितम् .
स तमाह मुनिर्भूपं विज्ञानेच्छं महामतिम् . . 48
text_mt:
perceived the conduct of that king in his previous body.
That sage spoke to the king, of great intellect, who desired knowledge,

sanskrit_iast:
satrājitaṃ mahātmānaṃ jitaśatruṃ manasvinam .
sapatnīkaṃ mahābuddhiṃ brāhmaṇānsatyavādinaḥ . . 49
meaning:
सत्राजितं महात्मानं जितशत्रुं मनस्विनम् .
सपत्नीकं महाबुद्धिं ब्राह्मणान्सत्यवादिनः . . 49
text_mt:
to the high-souled Satrājit, who had conquered his enemies, who was wise,
accompanied by his wife, exceedingly intelligent, [and surrounded by] truthful brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
parāvasuruvāca
śṛṇu bhūpāla sakalaṃ yasyedaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam .
tava rājyādikaṃ subhrūryeyaṃ cāsīnmahīpate . . 1.116.50
meaning:
परावसुरुवाच
शृणु भूपाल सकलं यस्येदं कर्मणः फलम् .
तव राज्यादिकं सुभ्रूर्येयं चासीन्महीपते . . 1.116.50
text_mt:
Parāvasu said:
Listen, O protector of the earth, to everything of which action this is the fruit—
your sovereignty and the rest, and this fair-browed woman who was [yours], O king.

sanskrit_iast:
tvamāsīḥ śūdrajātīyaḥ parahiṃsāparāyaṇaḥ .
kuṣṭhārto daṇḍapāruṣye niḥsnehaḥ sarvajantuṣu . . 51
meaning:
त्वमासीः शूद्रजातीयः परहिंसापरायणः .
कुष्ठार्तो दण्डपारुष्ये निःस्नेहः सर्वजन्तुषु . . 51
text_mt:
You were of the Śūdra caste, devoted to harming others,
afflicted with leprosy, given to harsh punishment, devoid of affection for all creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
dvayaṃ ca bhavato bhāryā pūrvamapyāyatekṣaṇā .
nityaṃ babhūva tvaccittā bhavacchuśrūṣaṇe ratā . . 52
meaning:
द्वयं च भवतो भार्या पूर्वमप्यायतेक्षणा .
नित्यं बभूव त्वच्चित्ता भवच्छुश्रूषणे रता . . 52
text_mt:
And the wife of your honour, even previously, was this long-eyed one;
constantly she was devoted to you in mind, delighting in serving your honour,

sanskrit_iast:
pativratā mahābhāgā bhartsyamānāpi niṣṭhuram .
tvadvākyeṣu ca sarveṣu vīra karmasu codyatā . 53
meaning:
पतिव्रता महाभागा भर्त्स्यमानापि निष्ठुरम् .
त्वद्वाक्येषु च सर्वेषु वीर कर्मसु चोद्यता . 53
text_mt:
a devoted wife of great fortune, even though harshly berated,
and ever zealous, O hero, in all your words and deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
naiśvaryādasahāyasya tyajyamānasya bandhubhiḥ .
kṣayaṃ jagāma yortho'bhūtsañcitaḥ prapitāmahaiḥ . . 54
meaning:
नैश्वर्यादसहायस्य त्यज्यमानस्य बन्धुभिः .
क्षयं जगाम योर्थोऽभूत्सञ्चितः प्रपितामहैः . . 54
text_mt:
Because of lack of wealth for you who were without support and abandoned by your relatives,
whatever wealth had been accumulated by your great-grandfathers went to ruin.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminkṣīṇe kṛṣiparastvamāsīḥ pṛthivīpate .
sāpi karmavipākena kṛṣirviphalatāṃ gatā . . 55
meaning:
तस्मिन्क्षीणे कृषिपरस्त्वमासीः पृथिवीपते .
सापि कर्मविपाकेन कृषिर्विफलतां गता . . 55
text_mt:
When that was depleted, you became devoted to agriculture, O lord of the earth.
That agriculture too came to fruitlessness through the ripening of [past] deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
tato niḥsvaṃ parikṣīṇaṃ pareṣāṃ bhṛtyatāṃ gatam .
tatyāja sādhvī neyaṃ tvāṃ tyajyamānāpi pārthiva . . 56
meaning:
ततो निःस्वं परिक्षीणं परेषां भृत्यतां गतम् .
तत्याज साध्वी नेयं त्वां त्यज्यमानापि पार्थिव . . 56
text_mt:
Then, when you were destitute, utterly ruined, and reduced to servitude to others,
this virtuous woman did not abandon you, O king, even though she was being abandoned [by all].

sanskrit_iast:
anayā tu samaṃ sādhvyā bhānorāvasathe tvayā .
kṛtaṃ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ vṛttyā bhaktyā sammārjanādikam . . 57
meaning:
अनया तु समं साध्व्या भानोरावसथे त्वया .
कृतं शुश्रूषणं वृत्त्या भक्त्या सम्मार्जनादिकम् . . 57
text_mt:
Together with this virtuous woman, in the abode of the sun,
service was performed by you by way of livelihood [and] through devotion, such as sweeping and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
niḥsnehaḥ sarvakāmebhyastanmayastvaṃ tadarpaṇaḥ .
ahanyahani visrambhāttasminnāvasathe raveḥ . . 58
meaning:
निःस्नेहः सर्वकामेभ्यस्तन्मयस्त्वं तदर्पणः .
अहन्यहनि विस्रम्भात्तस्मिन्नावसथे रवेः . . 58
text_mt:
Free from attachment to all desires, absorbed in Him, dedicated to Him,
day after day, with trust in that abode of the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
kānyakubjapure vīra mahāśuśrūṣitaṃ tvayā .
divākarālaye nityaṃ kṛtaṃ tanmārjanaṃ tvayā . . 59
meaning:
कान्यकुब्जपुरे वीर महाशुश्रूषितं त्वया .
दिवाकरालये नित्यं कृतं तन्मार्जनं त्वया . . 59
text_mt:
in the city of Kānyakubja, O hero, great service was rendered by you;
in the temple of the sun, sweeping was constantly done by you.

sanskrit_iast:
tathaivābhyukṣaṇaṃ bhūpa nityaṃ caivānulepanam .
patnyānayā nṛpa tathā yuṣmaccittānuvṛttayā . . 1.116.60
meaning:
तथैवाभ्युक्षणं भूप नित्यं चैवानुलेपनम् .
पत्न्यानया नृप तथा युष्मच्चित्तानुवृत्तया . . 1.116.60
text_mt:
Likewise sprinkling, O king, and constant smearing [with cow dung],
was thus done by this wife, O king, who followed your mind.

sanskrit_iast:
kāritaṃ śravaṇaṃ puṇyamitihāsapurāṇayoḥ .
dattvāṅgulīyakaṃ rājanpitṛdattaṃ tu vācake . . 61
meaning:
कारितं श्रवणं पुण्यमितिहासपुराणयोः .
दत्त्वाङ्गुलीयकं राजन्पितृदत्तं तु वाचके . . 61
text_mt:
The meritorious hearing of the itihāsas and purāṇas was arranged,
after giving to the reciter a ring given by your father, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
ahanyahani yatkarma yuvayornṛpakurvatoḥ .
tatraiva tanmayatvena pāpahānirajāyata . . 62
meaning:
अहन्यहनि यत्कर्म युवयोर्नृपकुर्वतोः .
तत्रैव तन्मयत्वेन पापहानिरजायत . . 62
text_mt:
Day after day, as the two of you performed that work, O king,
there itself, through being absorbed in that, the destruction of your sin took place.

sanskrit_iast:
bhānoḥ kāryaṃ mayā kāryaṃ paraṃ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ tathā .
nāprabhātaṃ prabhātaṃ vā cinteyamabhavanniśi . . 63
meaning:
भानोः कार्यं मया कार्यं परं शुश्रूषणं तथा .
नाप्रभातं प्रभातं वा चिन्तेयमभवन्निशि . . 63
text_mt:
“The business of the sun must be done by me, and supreme service likewise”;
neither before dawn nor after dawn did this reflection leave you at night.

sanskrit_iast:
evamāyatanaṃ ramyamityevaṃ ca sukhāvaham .
sūryavaccaivametatsyādityāsītte manastadā . . 64
meaning:
एवमायतनं रम्यमित्येवं च सुखावहम् .
सूर्यवच्चैवमेतत्स्यादित्यासीत्ते मनस्तदा . . 64
text_mt:
“May the temple thus be charming, and thus bring happiness,
and may it be like the sun!”—such was your mind at that time.

sanskrit_iast:
yogināṃ sukhadaṃ karma tathaiva sukhamityapi .
bhavaccittamabhūttatra yogakarmaṇyaharniśam . . 65
meaning:
योगिनां सुखदं कर्म तथैव सुखमित्यपि .
भवच्चित्तमभूत्तत्र योगकर्मण्यहर्निशम् . . 65
text_mt:
“Action that gives joy to yogins is likewise bliss”—
such was your mind there, day and night in the practice of yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tanmanasastatra kṛtodyogasya pārthiva .
bhūtānumāninaḥ samyagyathoktādhikakāriṇaḥ . . 66
meaning:
एवं तन्मनसस्तत्र कृतोद्योगस्य पार्थिव .
भूतानुमानिनः सम्यग्यथोक्ताधिककारिणः . . 66
text_mt:
Thus, with your mind fixed upon it, exerting yourself there, O king,
respectful toward living beings, performing properly more than what was prescribed,

sanskrit_iast:
smarato gopatiṃ nityaṃ cittenāpi dṛḍhātmanaḥ .
niḥśeṣamupaśāṃtaṃ te pāpaṃ sūryaniṣevaṇāt . . 67
meaning:
स्मरतो गोपतिं नित्यं चित्तेनापि दृढात्मनः .
निःशेषमुपशांतं ते पापं सूर्यनिषेवणात् . . 67
text_mt:
constantly remembering the lord of rays with a mind that was resolute in spirit,
your sin was completely appeased through attendance upon the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'dhikaṃ purastasmādagārasyānulepanam .
saṃmārjanaṃ ca bahuśaḥ sapatnīkena yatkṛtam . . 68
meaning:
ततोऽधिकं पुरस्तस्मादगारस्यानुलेपनम् .
संमार्जनं च बहुशः सपत्नीकेन यत्कृतम् . . 68
text_mt:
Even more than before, the smearing of that house
and repeated sweeping was done [by you] together with your wife.

sanskrit_iast:
kevalaṃ dharmamāśritya tyaktvā vṛttimaśeṣataḥ .
anayā śravaṇaṃ puṇyaṃ kāritaṃ vācakātsadā . 69
meaning:
केवलं धर्ममाश्रित्य त्यक्त्वा वृत्तिमशेषतः .
अनया श्रवणं पुण्यं कारितं वाचकात्सदा . 69
text_mt:
Relying purely on dharma, having abandoned all other livelihood,
the meritorious hearing from the reciter was constantly arranged by her.

sanskrit_iast:
nānādhātuvikāraistu gomayena mṛdā tathā .
upalepanaṃ kṛtaṃ bhaktyā tvayā pūrvaṃ surālaye . . 1.116.70
meaning:
नानाधातुविकारैस्तु गोमयेन मृदा तथा .
उपलेपनं कृतं भक्त्या त्वया पूर्वं सुरालये . . 1.116.70
text_mt:
With preparations of various minerals, and with cow dung and clay,
smearing was previously done with devotion by you in the temple of the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
athājagāma vai tatra kuvalāśvo mahīpatiḥ .
mahāsainyaparīvāraḥ prabhūtagajavāhanaḥ . . 71
meaning:
अथाजगाम वै तत्र कुवलाश्वो महीपतिः .
महासैन्यपरीवारः प्रभूतगजवाहनः . . 71
text_mt:
Then indeed King Kuvalāśva came there,
accompanied by a vast army and having abundant elephant-mounts.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasampadupetaṃ taṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam .
vṛtaṃ bhāryāsahasreṇa dṛṣṭvā saṃkrandanodbalam . .
spṛhā kṛtā tvayā tatra cārumaulini pārthive . . 72
meaning:
सर्वसम्पदुपेतं तं सर्वाभरणभूषितम् .
वृतं भार्यासहस्रेण दृष्ट्वा संक्रन्दनोद्बलम् . .
स्पृहा कृता त्वया तत्र चारुमौलिनि पार्थिवे . . 72
text_mt:
Seeing him endowed with all prosperity, adorned with all ornaments,
surrounded by a thousand wives, possessed of the might of Indra,
a longing was formed by you for that king with his beautiful diadem.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmapradaṃ karma kriyate bhāskārāśritam .
tenaitadakhilaṃ rājyamaśeṣaṃ cāptavānmahīm . . 73
meaning:
सर्वकामप्रदं कर्म क्रियते भास्काराश्रितम् .
तेनैतदखिलं राज्यमशेषं चाप्तवान्महीम् . . 73
text_mt:
Action that bestows all desires, directed to the sun, is performed;
by that you obtained this entire kingdom and the whole earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tejaścaivādhikaṃ yatte tathaiva śṛṇu pārthiva .
yogaprabhāvato labdhaṃ kathayāmyakhilaṃ tava . . 74
meaning:
तेजश्चैवाधिकं यत्ते तथैव शृणु पार्थिव .
योगप्रभावतो लब्धं कथयाम्यखिलं तव . . 74
text_mt:
And hear likewise, O king, about the extraordinary lustre that is yours,
obtained by the power of yoga; I shall tell you all of it.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraivāvasathe dīpaḥ praśāntaḥ snehasaṃkṣayāt .
nijabhojanatailena punaḥ prajvalitastvayā . . 75
meaning:
तत्रैवावसथे दीपः प्रशान्तः स्नेहसंक्षयात् .
निजभोजनतैलेन पुनः प्रज्वलितस्त्वया . . 75
text_mt:
In that very abode, a lamp had gone out from the exhaustion of oil;
it was lit again by you with the oil of your own food.

sanskrit_iast:
anyā cottarīyeṇa vīra vartyopabṛṃhitaḥ .
tava patnyā svayaṃ jvālya kāntirasyāstato'dhikā . . 76
meaning:
अन्या चोत्तरीयेण वीर वर्त्योपबृंहितः .
तव पत्न्या स्वयं ज्वाल्य कान्तिरस्यास्ततोऽधिका . . 76
text_mt:
And augmented with another wick from her upper garment, O hero,
it was lit by your wife herself; hence her beauty is superior to that.

sanskrit_iast:
tavāpyakhilabhūpālamanaḥ kṣobhakaraṃ punaḥ .
tejo narendra etasmātkimutārādhya bhāskaram . . 77
meaning:
तवाप्यखिलभूपालमनः क्षोभकरं पुनः .
तेजो नरेन्द्र एतस्मात्किमुताराध्य भास्करम् . . 77
text_mt:
Your lustre also, O lord of men, which agitates the minds of all kings,
is from this—how much more so from having worshiped the sun!

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ narendraḥ śūdratvādbhānukarmaparāyaṇaḥ .
tanmayatvena samprāpto mahimānamanuttamam . . 78
meaning:
एवं नरेन्द्रः शूद्रत्वाद्भानुकर्मपरायणः .
तन्मयत्वेन सम्प्राप्तो महिमानमनुत्तमम् . . 78
text_mt:
Thus, from being a Śūdra, the king became devoted to the work of the sun;
through being absorbed in Him, he attained unsurpassed greatness.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ punaryo naro bhaktyā nityaṃ śuśrūṣaṇāvṛtaḥ .
karoti satataṃ pūjāṃ niṣkāmo nānyamānasaḥ . . 79
meaning:
किं पुनर्यो नरो भक्त्या नित्यं शुश्रूषणावृतः .
करोति सततं पूजां निष्कामो नान्यमानसः . . 79
text_mt:
How much more then does that man, who with devotion, constantly filled with service,
perpetually performs worship, desireless and with no other thought in mind!

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāmṛddhimimāṃ labdhvā sarvalokamaheśvaraḥ .
pūjayitvārkamīśeśaṃ tamārādhya na sīdati . . 1.116.80
meaning:
सर्वामृद्धिमिमां लब्ध्वा सर्वलोकमहेश्वरः .
पूजयित्वार्कमीशेशं तमाराध्य न सीदति . . 1.116.80
text_mt:
Having obtained all this prosperity, a great lord over all people,
having worshiped the sun, the lord of lords, and having venerated Him, he does not suffer.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpai dhūpaistathā vānyairdīpairvastrānulepanaiḥ .
ārādhayārkaṃ tadveśma sadā sammārjanādinā . . 81
meaning:
पुष्पै धूपैस्तथा वान्यैर्दीपैर्वस्त्रानुलेपनैः .
आराधयार्कं तद्वेश्म सदा सम्मार्जनादिना . . 81
text_mt:
With flowers, with incenses, or with other lamps, garments, and unguents,
worship the sun, and His temple always with sweeping and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ kiñcidyadyanyattu durlabham .
taddatvā ca jagaddhātre bhāskarāya na sīdati . . 82
meaning:
यद्यदिष्टतमं किञ्चिद्यद्यन्यत्तु दुर्लभम् .
तद्दत्वा च जगद्धात्रे भास्कराय न सीदति . . 82
text_mt:
Whatever is most beloved, or whatever else is difficult to obtain,
by giving that to the sun, the sustainer of the world, one does not suffer.

sanskrit_iast:
sugandhāgurukarpūracandanāgurukuṃkumaiḥ .
vāsobhirvividhairdhūpaiḥ puṣpaiḥ srakcāmaradhvajaiḥ . . 83
meaning:
सुगन्धागुरुकर्पूरचन्दनागुरुकुंकुमैः .
वासोभिर्विविधैर्धूपैः पुष्पैः स्रक्चामरध्वजैः . . 83
text_mt:
With fragrant agallochum, camphor, sandalwood, aloe, and saffron,
with various garments and incenses, with flowers, garlands, chowries, and banners,

sanskrit_iast:
anyopahārairvividhaiḥ kṛtakṣīrābhiṣecanaiḥ .
gītavāditranṛtyādyaistoṣayasvārkamādarāt . . 84
meaning:
अन्योपहारैर्विविधैः कृतक्षीराभिषेचनैः .
गीतवादित्रनृत्याद्यैस्तोषयस्वार्कमादरात् . . 84
text_mt:
with other various offerings, with performed milk-ablutions,
and with songs, musical instruments, and dances, gratify the sun with reverence.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyarātriṣu mārtaṇḍaṃ nṛtyagītairathojjvalam .
bhūpa jāgaraṇairbhaktyā homaḥ kāryaḥ sadā śuciḥ . . 85
meaning:
पुण्यरात्रिषु मार्तण्डं नृत्यगीतैरथोज्ज्वलम् .
भूप जागरणैर्भक्त्या होमः कार्यः सदा शुचिः . . 85
text_mt: On holy nights, O king, [worship] Mārtaṇḍa, made radiant with dancing and singing / and with vigils, by devotion; a pure oblation must always be performed,

sanskrit_iast:
itihāsapurāṇānāṃ śravaṇena .viśeṣataḥ .
tathā vedasvanaiḥ puṇyairṛksāmayajubhirnṛpa . . 86
meaning:
इतिहासपुराणानां श्रवणेन .विशेषतः .
तथा वेदस्वनैः पुण्यैरृक्सामयजुभिर्नृप . . 86
text_mt: especially through the hearing of histories and Purāṇas, / and likewise, O king, with the holy Vedic chants of the Ṛg, Sāman, and Yajus.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ santoṣyate bhaktyā bhagavānbhavabhaṅgakṛt .
bhūyo vaivasvato bhūtvā bhavahṛdbhāskaro naraiḥ .. 87
meaning:
एवं सन्तोष्यते भक्त्या भगवान्भवभङ्गकृत् .
भूयो वैवस्वतो भूत्वा भवहृद्भास्करो नरैः .. 87
text_mt: Thus the blessed destroyer of worldly existence is pleased through devotion / by human beings, and the sun, dispelling worldly existence, becomes their protector.

sanskrit_iast:
toṣito bhagavānbhānurdadātyabhimataṃ phalam .
daivakarmasamarthānāṃ prāṇināṃ smṛtisambhavaiḥ . . 88
meaning:
तोषितो भगवान्भानुर्ददात्यभिमतं फलम् .
दैवकर्मसमर्थानां प्राणिनां स्मृतिसम्भवैः . . 88
text_mt: When pleased, the blessed Sun grants their desired fruit / through [deeds] born of memory, to living beings capable of divine rites.

sanskrit_iast:
toṣito bhagavānkāmānprayacchati divākaraḥ .
naiṣa vṛttairna ratnaughaiḥ puṣpairdhūpānulepanaiḥ . .
sadbhāvenaiva mārtaṇḍastoṣamāyāti saṃsmṛtaḥ . . 89
meaning:
तोषितो भगवान्कामान्प्रयच्छति दिवाकरः .
नैष वृत्तैर्न रत्नौघैः पुष्पैर्धूपानुलेपनैः . .
सद्भावेनैव मार्तण्डस्तोषमायाति संस्मृतः . . 89
text_mt: When pleased, the blessed maker of day bestows their desires. / Not by conduct, nor by heaps of jewels, nor by flowers, incense, or unguents, / but solely through sincere faith does Mārtaṇḍa attain delight when remembered.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayaikāgramanaskena gṛhasammārjanādikam .
kṛtvālpamīdṛśaṃ prāptaṃ rājyamanyena durlabham . . 1.116.90
meaning:
त्वयैकाग्रमनस्केन गृहसम्मार्जनादिकम् .
कृत्वाल्पमीदृशं प्राप्तं राज्यमन्येन दुर्लभम् . . 1.116.90
text_mt: By sweeping the house and doing other small services with a focused mind, / such a kingdom, unattainable by another, was attained by you.

sanskrit_iast:
anayā śravaṇaṃ puṇyaṃ kārayitvā gṛhe raveḥ .
īdṛkprāptā sampadiyaṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā tu vācake . . 91
meaning:
अनया श्रवणं पुण्यं कारयित्वा गृहे रवेः .
ईदृक्प्राप्ता सम्पदियं पूजां कृत्वा तु वाचके . . 91
text_mt: By her, having arranged holy recitation in the house of the Sun / and having worshipped the reciter, this sort of fortune was obtained.

sanskrit_iast:
prāptopakaraṇairyastamekāgramatiraṇḍajam .
santoṣayati nendro'pi bhavatā vai samaḥ kvacit . . 92
meaning:
प्राप्तोपकरणैर्यस्तमेकाग्रमतिरण्डजम् .
सन्तोषयति नेन्द्रोऽपि भवता वै समः क्वचित् . . 92
text_mt: Whoever, with a single-pointed mind, satisfies that egg-born god with the requisites at hand— / truly not even Indra is anywhere equal to you.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttvamanayā devyā sahātyantavinītayā .
bhāskarārādhane yatnaṃ kuru dharmabhṛtāṃ vara . . 93
meaning:
तस्मात्त्वमनया देव्या सहात्यन्तविनीतया .
भास्कराराधने यत्नं कुरु धर्मभृतां वर . . 93
text_mt: Therefore, together with this exceedingly modest queen, / make an effort in the worship of the Sun, O best of the upholders of righteousness!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
etanmunervaco vīra niśamya sa narādhipaḥ .
bhāryāsahāyaḥ sa tadā saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ . . 94
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एतन्मुनेर्वचो वीर निशम्य स नराधिपः .
भार्यासहायः स तदा संप्रहृष्टतनूरुहः . . 94
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Having heard these words of the sage, O hero, that ruler of men, / together with his wife, had the hair of his body stand on end with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtakāryamivātmānaṃ manyamānastadābhavat .
uvāca praṇato bhūtvā rājā satrājito'cyuta . . 95
meaning:
कृतकार्यमिवात्मानं मन्यमानस्तदाभवत् .
उवाच प्रणतो भूत्वा राजा सत्राजितोऽच्युत . . 95
text_mt: Thinking of himself as one who had accomplished his goal, / King Satrājita bowed down and spoke, O infallible one.

sanskrit_iast:
satrājita uvāca
yathāmaratvaṃ samprāpya yathā vāyurbalaṃ param .
paraṃ nirvāṇamāpnoti tathāhaṃ vacasā tava . . 96
meaning:
सत्राजित उवाच
यथामरत्वं सम्प्राप्य यथा वायुर्बलं परम् .
परं निर्वाणमाप्नोति तथाहं वचसा तव . . 96
text_mt:
Satrājita said:
Just as one attains immortality, or just as the wind attains supreme strength / and reaches the highest liberation, so have I by your words.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtakṛtyaḥ sukhāsīno nirvṛtiṃ paramāṃ gataḥ .
ajñānatamasācchanne yatpradīpastvayā dhṛtaḥ . . 97
meaning:
कृतकृत्यः सुखासीनो निर्वृतिं परमां गतः .
अज्ञानतमसाच्छन्ने यत्प्रदीपस्त्वया धृतः . . 97
text_mt: I am fulfilled, seated happily, having reached supreme peace, / because you held up a lamp where there was darkness of ignorance.

sanskrit_iast:
ahameṣā ca tanvaṅgī vibhūtibhraṃśabhīrukaḥ .
dravyamāpāditaṃ brahmannihādya vacasā tava . . 98
meaning:
अहमेषा च तन्वङ्गी विभूतिभ्रंशभीरुकः .
द्रव्यमापादितं ब्रह्मन्निहाद्य वचसा तव . . 98
text_mt: I, fearful of losing prosperity, and this slender-bodied [queen]— / wealth has been provided to us here today, O holy one, by your words.

sanskrit_iast:
sampadaḥ kathitaṃ bījamāvayorbhavatā mune .
tvadvaktrādudyatā vāco vijñātā hi dvijottama . . 99
meaning:
सम्पदः कथितं बीजमावयोर्भवता मुने .
त्वद्वक्त्रादुद्यता वाचो विज्ञाता हि द्विजोत्तम . . 99
text_mt: The root of fortune for both of us has been spoken by you, O sage; / the words spoken from your mouth have indeed been understood, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
na ratnairna ca vittaughairna ca puṣpānulepanaiḥ .
ārādhyaśca jagannātho bhāvaśūnyairdivākaraḥ . . 1.116.100
meaning:
न रत्नैर्न च वित्तौघैर्न च पुष्पानुलेपनैः .
आराध्यश्च जगन्नाथो भावशून्यैर्दिवाकरः . . 1.116.100
text_mt: Not with jewels, nor with heaps of riches, nor with flowers and unguents / is the Sun, the lord of the universe, to be worshipped by those devoid of faith.

sanskrit_iast:
bāhyārthanirapekṣaiśca manasaiva manogatiḥ .
niḥsvairārādhyate devo bhānuḥ sarveśvareśvaraḥ . . 101
meaning:
बाह्यार्थनिरपेक्षैश्च मनसैव मनोगतिः .
निःस्वैराराध्यते देवो भानुः सर्वेश्वरेश्वरः . . 101
text_mt: Indifferent to external objects, the refuge of thought is worshipped solely with the mind / by the destitute—the god Sun, ruler over all rulers.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvametanmayā jñātaṃ yattvamāttha mahāmune .
yacca pṛcchāmi tanme tvaṃ prasādasumukho vada . . 102
meaning:
सर्वमेतन्मया ज्ञातं यत्त्वमात्थ महामुने .
यच्च पृच्छामि तन्मे त्वं प्रसादसुमुखो वद . . 102
text_mt: All this spoken by you, O great sage, has been understood by me. / And what I ask, speak that to me with a face gracious with favor:

sanskrit_iast:
kathamārādhito devo naraiḥ strībhiśca bhāskaraḥ .
toṣamāyāti viprendra tadvadasva mahāmune . . 103
meaning:
कथमाराधितो देवो नरैः स्त्रीभिश्च भास्करः .
तोषमायाति विप्रेन्द्र तद्वदस्व महामुने . . 103
text_mt: How, when worshipped by men and by women, does the god Sun / attain satisfaction, O foremost of Brahmins? Tell that, O great sage!

sanskrit_iast:
rahasyāni ca devasya prītaye yā tithiḥ sadā .
cānyaśeṣāṇi me brūhi arkārādhanakāṃkṣiṇaḥ . . 104
meaning:
रहस्यानि च देवस्य प्रीतये या तिथिः सदा .
चान्यशेषाणि मे ब्रूहि अर्काराधनकांक्षिणः . . 104
text_mt: Tell me, who desire to worship the Sun, the secrets and the lunar day that is always / pleasing to the god, and all the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
parāvasuruvāca
śṛṇu bhūpāla yairbhānurgṛheṣyārādhyate janaiḥ .
nārībhiścātighore'sminpatitābhirbhavārṇave . . 105
meaning:
परावसुरुवाच
शृणु भूपाल यैर्भानुर्गृहेष्याराध्यते जनैः .
नारीभिश्चातिघोरेऽस्मिन्पतिताभिर्भवार्णवे . . 105
text_mt:
Parāvasu said:
Listen, O king, to how the Sun is worshipped in homes by people / and by women fallen into this most dreadful ocean of worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
samabhyarcya jagannāthaṃ devamakaṃ samādhinā .
ekamaśnāti yo bhaktaṃ dvitīyaṃ brāhmaṇārpaṇam . . 106
meaning:
समभ्यर्च्य जगन्नाथं देवमकं समाधिना .
एकमश्नाति यो भक्तं द्वितीयं ब्राह्मणार्पणम् . . 106
text_mt: Having worshipped the Sun, the lord of the universe, with mental concentration, / whoever eats one meal and offers a second to a Brahmin,

sanskrit_iast:
karoti bhāskaraprītyai kārttikaṃ māsamātmanā .
pūrve vayasi yatnena jānatā'jānatāpi vā . . 107
meaning:
करोति भास्करप्रीत्यै कार्त्तिकं मासमात्मना .
पूर्वे वयसि यत्नेन जानताऽजानतापि वा . . 107
text_mt: and personally performs [this] for the month of Kārttika for the pleasure of the Sun, / whatever sin was committed with effort in early life, knowingly or unknowingly,

sanskrit_iast:
pāpamācaritaṃ tasmādbhidyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .
anenaiva vidhānena māsi mārgaśire punaḥ . . 108
meaning:
पापमाचरितं तस्माद्भिद्यते नात्र संशयः .
अनेनैव विधानेन मासि मार्गशिरे पुनः . . 108
text_mt: is torn away from him; there is no doubt in this. / Again, by this very same method in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
samabhyarcya marakataṃ viprebhyo yaḥ prayacchati .
bhagavatprīṇanārthāya phalaṃ tasya śṛṇuṣva me . . 109
meaning:
समभ्यर्च्य मरकतं विप्रेभ्यो यः प्रयच्छति .
भगवत्प्रीणनार्थाय फलं तस्य शृणुष्व मे . . 109
text_mt: having worshipped, whoever gives emerald to the Brahmins / for the sake of pleasing the Blessed One—hear from me the fruit of that!

sanskrit_iast:
madhye vayasi yatpāpaṃ yoṣitā puruṣeṇa vā .
kṛtamasmācca tenekto vimokṣaḥ paramātmanā . . 1.116.110
meaning:
मध्ये वयसि यत्पापं योषिता पुरुषेण वा .
कृतमस्माच्च तेनेक्तो विमोक्षः परमात्मना . . 1.116.110
text_mt: Whatever sin was committed in middle age by a woman or a man, / release from it is proclaimed by the Supreme Self.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā caivekabhaktaṃ tu yastu viprāya yacchati .
divākaraṃ samabhyarcya pauṣe māsi mahīpate . . 111
meaning:
तथा चैवेकभक्तं तु यस्तु विप्राय यच्छति .
दिवाकरं समभ्यर्च्य पौषे मासि महीपते . . 111
text_mt: And likewise, whoever gives a single meal to a Brahmin / after worshipping the Sun in the month of Pauṣa, O ruler of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
tattacca prīṇayatyarkaṃ vārdhikenaiva yatkṛtam .
sa tasmānmucyate rājanpumānyoṣidathāpi vā . . 112
meaning:
तत्तच्च प्रीणयत्यर्कं वार्धिकेनैव यत्कृतम् .
स तस्मान्मुच्यते राजन्पुमान्योषिदथापि वा . . 112
text_mt: pleases the Sun in each case; whatever was committed in old age, / from that he is freed, O king, whether a man or a woman.

sanskrit_iast:
trimāsikaṃ vratamidaṃ yaḥ karoti nareśvara .
sa bhānuprīṇanātpāpairlaghubhiḥ parimucyate . . 113
meaning:
त्रिमासिकं व्रतमिदं यः करोति नरेश्वर .
स भानुप्रीणनात्पापैर्लघुभिः परिमुच्यते . . 113
text_mt: Whoever performs this three-month observance, O lord of men, / is thoroughly freed from minor sins through pleasing the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye vatsare rājanmucyate copapātakaiḥ .
tadvattṛtīye'pi kṛtaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam . . 114
meaning:
द्वितीये वत्सरे राजन्मुच्यते चोपपातकैः .
तद्वत्तृतीयेऽपि कृतं महापातकनाशनम् . . 114
text_mt: In the second year, O king, one is freed from secondary sins; / likewise, performed in the third [year], it destroys major sins.

sanskrit_iast:
vratametannaraiḥ strībhistribhirmāsairanuṣṭhitam .
tribhiḥ saṃvatsaraiścaiva pradadāti phalaṃ nṛṇām . . 115
meaning:
व्रतमेतन्नरैः स्त्रीभिस्त्रिभिर्मासैरनुष्ठितम् .
त्रिभिः संवत्सरैश्चैव प्रददाति फलं नृणाम् . . 115
text_mt: This observance, undertaken for three months by men and women, / and likewise for three years, bestows fruit upon humans.

sanskrit_iast:
tribhirmāsairanuṣṭhānāttrividhātpātakānnṛpa .
trīṇi nāmāni devasya mocayanti ca vārṣikaiḥ . . 116
meaning:
त्रिभिर्मासैरनुष्ठानात्त्रिविधात्पातकान्नृप .
त्रीणि नामानि देवस्य मोचयन्ति च वार्षिकैः . . 116
text_mt: By practice for three months, O king, from the three kinds of sins, / and three names of the god bring release through annual [observances].

sanskrit_iast:
yatastato vratamidaṃ vividhaṃ samudāhṛtam .
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ bhāskarārādhane param . . 117
meaning:
यतस्ततो व्रतमिदं विविधं समुदाहृतम् .
सर्वपापप्रशमनं भास्कराराधने परम् . . 117
text_mt: Therefore, this manifold observance has been described; / it is the best [means] in the worship of the Sun for pacifying all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
satrājita uvāca
katamāya 'tu viprāya dātavyaṃ bhaktito mune .
dvitīye dvijaśārdūla kathayasvākhilaṃ mama . . 118
meaning:
सत्राजित उवाच
कतमाय ऽतु विप्राय दातव्यं भक्तितो मुने .
द्वितीये द्विजशार्दूल कथयस्वाखिलं मम . . 118
text_mt:
Satrājita said:
To what kind of Brahmin should a gift be given with devotion, O sage? / On the second, O tiger among the twice-born, tell me everything!

sanskrit_iast:
parāvasuruvāca
deye purāṇaviduṣe vastre viprottamāya ca .
śrūyatāṃ cāpi vacanaṃ yaduktaṃ bhāskareṇa ca . .
aruṇāya mahābāho pṛcchate yatpurā nṛpa . . 119
meaning:
परावसुरुवाच
देये पुराणविदुषे वस्त्रे विप्रोत्तमाय च .
श्रूयतां चापि वचनं यदुक्तं भास्करेण च . .
अरुणाय महाबाहो पृच्छते यत्पुरा नृप . . 119
text_mt:
Parāvasu said:
Two garments are to be given to an excellent Brahmin who knows the Purāṇas. / And hear also the word that was spoken by the Sun / to Aruṇa, O mighty-armed king, when he asked formerly.

sanskrit_iast:
udayācalamārūḍhaṃ bhāskaraṃ timirāpaham .
praṇamya śirasā nūnamidaṃ vacanamabravīt . . 1.116.120
meaning:
उदयाचलमारूढं भास्करं तिमिरापहम् .
प्रणम्य शिरसा नूनमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् . . 1.116.120
text_mt: Having bowed with his head to the Sun who had mounted the mountain of sunrise, the dispeller of darkness, / he certainly spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
kāni priyāṇi te deva pūjane santi sarvadā .
puṣpādīnāṃ samastānāmārādhanavidhau sadā . .
uparāgādivastrādau brāhmaṇānāṃ tathā rave . . 121
meaning:
कानि प्रियाणि ते देव पूजने सन्ति सर्वदा .
पुष्पादीनां समस्तानामाराधनविधौ सदा . .
उपरागादिवस्त्रादौ ब्राह्मणानां तथा रवे . . 121
text_mt: "Which of all the flowers and other things are always pleasing to you, O god, in worship, / always in the rule of worship? / And on eclipses and the like, regarding clothing and Brahmins, O Sun?"

sanskrit_iast:
bhāskara uvāca
puṣpāṇāṃ karavīrāṇi tathā raktaṃ ca candanam .
guggulañcāpi dhūpānāṃ naivedye modakāḥ priyāḥ . . 122
meaning:
भास्कर उवाच
पुष्पाणां करवीराणि तथा रक्तं च चन्दनम् .
गुग्गुलञ्चापि धूपानां नैवेद्ये मोदकाः प्रियाः . . 122
text_mt:
The Sun said:
"Among flowers, oleanders and red sandalwood, / and bdellium among incenses, and modakas as food offering are pleasing [to me].

sanskrit_iast:
pūjākaro bhojakastu ghṛtadīpastathā priyaḥ .
dānaṃ priyaṃ khagaśreṣṭha vācakāya pradīyate . . 123
meaning:
पूजाकरो भोजकस्तु घृतदीपस्तथा प्रियः .
दानं प्रियं खगश्रेष्ठ वाचकाय प्रदीयते . . 123
text_mt: A Bhojaka priest who performs worship and a ghee lamp are dear, / and dear is the gift, O best of birds, that is given to a reciter.

sanskrit_iast:
māmuddiśya ca yaddānaṃ dīyate mānavairbhuvi .
vācakāya1 tu dātavyaṃ tanmama prītaye khaga . . 124
meaning:
मामुद्दिश्य च यद्दानं दीयते मानवैर्भुवि .
वाचकाय1 तु दातव्यं तन्मम प्रीतये खग . . 124
text_mt: Whatever gift is given by humans on earth with me in mind / should be given to a reciter, O bird, for my pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
itihāsapurāṇāmyāmabhijño yastu vācakaḥ .
brāhmaṇo vai khagaśreṣṭha sampūjyaḥ prītaye mama . . 125
meaning:
इतिहासपुराणाम्यामभिज्ञो यस्तु वाचकः .
ब्राह्मणो वै खगश्रेष्ठ सम्पूज्यः प्रीतये मम . . 125
text_mt: A reciter who is learned in the histories and Purāṇas, / a Brahmin indeed, O best of birds, is to be worshipped for my pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjite'sminsadā vipre pūjitohaṃ na saṃśayaḥ .
bhavāmi khagaśārdūla yatastviṣṭaḥ sa me sadā . . 126
meaning:
पूजितेऽस्मिन्सदा विप्रे पूजितोहं न संशयः .
भवामि खगशार्दूल यतस्त्विष्टः स मे सदा . . 126
text_mt: When this Brahmin is always worshipped, I am worshipped; there is no doubt, / O tiger among birds, because he is always dear to me.

sanskrit_iast:
vedavīṇāmṛdaṅgaiśca nātigandhavilepanaiḥ .
tathā me jāyate prītiryathā śrutvā khagottama . . 127
meaning:
वेदवीणामृदङ्गैश्च नातिगन्धविलेपनैः .
तथा मे जायते प्रीतिर्यथा श्रुत्वा खगोत्तम . . 127
text_mt: Not by Vedic chanting, lutes, and drums, nor by intense fragrant ointments / does such joy arise in me, O best of birds, as upon hearing

sanskrit_iast:
itihāsapurāṇāni vācyamānāni vācakaiḥ .
ataḥ priyo vācako me pūjākartā ca bhojakaḥ . . 128
upalepanasnāpanamāhātmyavarṇanam
meaning:
इतिहासपुराणानि वाच्यमानानि वाचकैः .
अतः प्रियो वाचको मे पूजाकर्ता च भोजकः . . 128
उपलेपनस्नापनमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
text_mt:
histories and Purāṇas being recited by reciters; / therefore, dear to me is the reciter and the Bhojaka who performs the worship."
Description of the Greatness of Anointing and Bathing [the Deity]

sanskrit_iast:
aruṇa uvāca
kimarthaṃ bhojakastubhyaṃ priyo deveśa kathyatām .
nānye viprādayo varṇā devatāyataneṣu vai . . 1
meaning:
अरुण उवाच
किमर्थं भोजकस्तुभ्यं प्रियो देवेश कथ्यताम् .
नान्ये विप्रादयो वर्णा देवतायतनेषु वै . . 1
text_mt:
Aruṇa said:
Why is the Bhojaka dear to you, Lord of gods? Tell me.
Why not the other classes, such as brāhmaṇas, in the temples of the deity?
title: Upalepanasnāpanamāhātmyavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
kaścāyaṃ bhojako deva kasya putraḥ kimātmakaḥ .
varṇataścāsya me brūhi karma cāsya samantataḥ . . 2
meaning:
कश्चायं भोजको देव कस्य पुत्रः किमात्मकः .
वर्णतश्चास्य मे ब्रूहि कर्म चास्य समन्ततः . . 2
text_mt: And who is this Bhojaka, O Lord? Whose son is he? What is his nature? / Tell me also of his class, and of his duty in every respect.

sanskrit_iast:
āditya uvāca
sādhu pṛṣṭo'smi bhadraṃ te vainateya mahāmate .
śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ sarvaṃ gadato mama khecara . . 3
meaning:
आदित्य उवाच
साधु पृष्टोऽस्मि भद्रं ते वैनतेय महामते .
शृणुष्वैकमनाः सर्वं गदतो मम खेचर . . 3
text_mt:
Āditya said:
You have asked well, may it be well with you, wise son of Vinatā. / Listen with single-minded devotion to all that I speak, O sky-wanderer.

sanskrit_iast:
viprādayastu ye tvanye varṇāḥ kaśyapanandana .
te pūjayanti māṃ nityaṃ bhaktiśraddhāsamanvitāḥ . .4
meaning:
विप्रादयस्तु ये त्वन्ये वर्णाः कश्यपनन्दन .
ते पूजयन्ति मां नित्यं भक्तिश्रद्धासमन्विताः . .4
text_mt: The other classes, such as brāhmaṇas, son of Kaśyapa, / always worship me endowed with devotion and faith.

sanskrit_iast:
devālayeṣu ye viprāḥ prītyā māṃ pūjayanti hi .
anyāśca devatāvṛttyā te syurdevalakāḥ khaga . .
etasmātkāraṇānmahyaṃ bhojako dayitaḥ sadā . . 5
meaning:
देवालयेषु ये विप्राः प्रीत्या मां पूजयन्ति हि .
अन्याश्च देवतावृत्त्या ते स्युर्देवलकाः खग . .
एतस्मात्कारणान्मह्यं भोजको दयितः सदा . . 5
text_mt: Those brāhmaṇas who worship me with love in temples, / and [worship] other deities by way of livelihood, become temple-priests (devalakas), O bird. / For this reason, the Bhojaka is always dear to me.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇato brāhmaṇaścāyaṃ svānuṣṭhānaparo yadi .
anuṣṭhānavihīno hi narakaṃ yātyasaṃśayam . . 6
meaning:
वर्णतो ब्राह्मणश्चायं स्वानुष्ठानपरो यदि .
अनुष्ठानविहीनो हि नरकं यात्यसंशयम् . . 6
text_mt: In terms of class he is a brāhmaṇa, if he is devoted to his proper observances. / For, devoid of proper observance, he goes to hell without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
na tyājyaṃ bhojakaistasmātsvakaṃ karma kadācana .
mayāsau nirmitaḥ pūrvaṃ tejasā svena vai khaga . . 7
meaning:
न त्याज्यं भोजकैस्तस्मात्स्वकं कर्म कदाचन .
मयासौ निर्मितः पूर्वं तेजसा स्वेन वै खग . . 7
text_mt: Therefore, his own duty must never be abandoned by a Bhojaka. / He was created by me of old through my own brilliance, O bird.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjārthamātmano nūnaṃ karma cāsya prakīrtitam .
priyavratasuto rājā śākadvīpe mahāmatiḥ . . 8
meaning:
पूजार्थमात्मनो नूनं कर्म चास्य प्रकीर्तितम् .
प्रियव्रतसुतो राजा शाकद्वीपे महामतिः . . 8
text_mt: Truly his duty has been proclaimed for the sake of my worship. / There was a wise king, the son of Priyavrata, in Śākadvīpa.

sanskrit_iast:
tena me kāritaṃ divyaṃ vimānapratimaṃ gṛham .
tasmindvīpe tadātmīye divyaṃ śilāmayaṃ mahat . . 9
meaning:
तेन मे कारितं दिव्यं विमानप्रतिमं गृहम् .
तस्मिन्द्वीपे तदात्मीये दिव्यं शिलामयं महत् . . 9
text_mt: By him was caused to be built for me a celestial abode resembling a celestial chariot, / a great celestial [temple] made of stone, in that continent of his.

sanskrit_iast:
sa madarcāṃ kārayitvā kāñcanīṃ lakṣaṇānvitām .
pratiṣṭhāpanāya vai tasyāścintayāmāsa suvrataḥ . . 1.117.10
meaning:
स मदर्चां कारयित्वा काञ्चनीं लक्षणान्विताम् .
प्रतिष्ठापनाय वै तस्याश्चिन्तयामास सुव्रतः . . 1.117.10
text_mt: Having had an image of me made of gold, endowed with auspicious marks, / that man of good vows considered how to consecrate it:

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtamāyatanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ teneyaṃ pratimā kṛtā .
ko vai pratiṣṭhāpayitā devamarkaṃ śubhālaye . . 11
meaning:
कृतमायतनं श्रेष्ठं तेनेयं प्रतिमा कृता .
को वै प्रतिष्ठापयिता देवमर्कं शुभालये . . 11
text_mt: 'An excellent temple has been made; by him this image has been made. / Who indeed will consecrate the god, the Sun, in the auspicious temple?'

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sañcintayitvā tu jagāma śaraṇaṃ mama .
bhaktiṃ tasya ca sañcintya khagāhaṃ pārthivasya tu . . 12
meaning:
एवं सञ्चिन्तयित्वा तु जगाम शरणं मम .
भक्तिं तस्य च सञ्चिन्त्य खगाहं पार्थिवस्य तु . . 12
text_mt: Having reflected thus, he took refuge in me. / And considering the devotion of that king, O bird,

sanskrit_iast:
gato'haṃ darśanaṃ tasya uktañcāpi mayā khaga .
kiṃ cintayasi rājendra kutaściṃtā samāgatā . . 13
meaning:
गतोऽहं दर्शनं तस्य उक्तञ्चापि मया खग .
किं चिन्तयसि राजेन्द्र कुतश्चिंता समागता . . 13
text_mt: I appeared before him, and I spoke, O bird: / 'What are you pondering, King of kings? Whence has this anxiety arisen?

sanskrit_iast:
brūhi yatte hṛdi prauḍhaṃ cintākāraṇamāgatam .
saṃpādayiṣye tatsarvaṃ vimanā bhava mā nṛpa . . 14
meaning:
ब्रूहि यत्ते हृदि प्रौढं चिन्ताकारणमागतम् .
संपादयिष्ये तत्सर्वं विमना भव मा नृप . . 14
text_mt: Speak what is deeply rooted in your heart, the cause of worry that has come. / I shall accomplish all of it; do not be despondent, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
atyarthaṃ duṣkaramapi kariṣye nātra saṃśayaḥ .
ityuktaḥ sa mayā rājā idaṃ vacanamabravīt . . 15
meaning:
अत्यर्थं दुष्करमपि करिष्ये नात्र संशयः .
इत्युक्तः स मया राजा इदं वचनमब्रवीत् . . 15
text_mt: Even if it is exceedingly difficult, I shall do it; there is no doubt of this.' / Addressed thus by me, the king spoke this word:

sanskrit_iast:
dvīpe'smindevadevasya kṛtamāyatanaṃ tava .
mayā bhaktyā jagannātha tatheyaṃ pratimā kṛtā . . 16
meaning:
द्वीपेऽस्मिन्देवदेवस्य कृतमायतनं तव .
मया भक्त्या जगन्नाथ तथेयं प्रतिमा कृता . . 16
text_mt: 'A temple for you, the God of gods, has been made in this continent / by me with devotion, Lord of the world, and likewise this image has been made.

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayedyastu tava devālaye khaga .
yatra santi trayo varṇā dvīpesminkṣatriyādayaḥ . . 17
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठां कारयेद्यस्तु तव देवालये खग .
यत्र सन्ति त्रयो वर्णा द्वीपेस्मिन्क्षत्रियादयः . . 17
text_mt: As for one who might perform the consecration in your temple, O bird— / where three classes exist in this continent, the kṣatriyas and the rest,

sanskrit_iast:
te mayoktā na kurvanti pratiṣṭhāṃ tava kṛtsnaśaḥ .
na cāpyarcāṃ jagannātha brāhmaṇaścātra vidyate . . 18
meaning:
ते मयोक्ता न कुर्वन्ति प्रतिष्ठां तव कृत्स्नशः .
न चाप्यर्चां जगन्नाथ ब्राह्मणश्चात्र विद्यते . . 18
text_mt: they, though addressed by me, do not perform your consecration in its entirety, / nor worship [it], Lord of the world; and no brāhmaṇa is found here.

sanskrit_iast:
teneyamāgatā cintā hṛdi śalyaṃ tayārpitam .
tato mayokto rājā'sau vainateya vacaḥ śubham . . 19
meaning:
तेनेयमागता चिन्ता हृदि शल्यं तयार्पितम् .
ततो मयोक्तो राजाऽसौ वैनतेय वचः शुभम् . . 19
