guhyairnānāvidhaiḥ stotrairvedavedāṅgapāragaiḥ . . 7
meaning:
ततस्तुष्टाव तं ब्रह्मा सर्वदेवगणैः सह .
गुह्यैर्नानाविधैः स्तोत्रैर्वेदवेदाङ्गपारगैः . . 7
text_mt:
Then Brahmā praised him together with all the hosts of gods
with various secret hymns composed by masters of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas:

sanskrit_iast:
svasti te'stu jagannātha dharmavarṣahimākara .
śāṃtiste sarvalokānāṃ devadeva divākara . . 8
meaning:
स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु जगन्नाथ धर्मवर्षहिमाकर .
शांतिस्ते सर्वलोकानां देवदेव दिवाकर . . 8
text_mt:
"Hail to you, O Lord of the Universe, creator of heat, rain, and cold!
May there be peace from you to all the worlds, O god of gods, O sun!

sanskrit_iast:
tato rudraśca viṣṇvādyāḥ stuvaṃtastaṃ divākaram .
tejaste vardhatāṃ deva likhyate'pi divaspate . . 9
meaning:
ततो रुद्रश्च विष्ण्वाद्याः स्तुवंतस्तं दिवाकरम् .
तेजस्ते वर्धतां देव लिख्यतेऽपि दिवस्पते . . 9
text_mt:
Then Rudra, Viṣṇu, and others, praising that sun, [said]:
'May your splendour increase, O god, even as it is trimmed, O lord of the day!'

sanskrit_iast:
indraścāgatya taṃ devaṃ likhyamānamathāstuvat .
jaya deva jayasveti tattvado'si jagatpate .. 1.121.10
meaning:
इन्द्रश्चागत्य तं देवं लिख्यमानमथास्तुवत् .
जय देव जयस्वेति तत्त्वदोऽसि जगत्पते .. 1.121.10
text_mt:
And Indra, having arrived, then praised that god as he was being trimmed:
'Conquer, O god, conquer! You are the bestower of truth, O lord of the universe!'

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayastu tataḥ sapta viśvāmitrapurogamāḥ .
tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotraiḥ svastisvastītivādinaḥ .. 11
meaning:
ऋषयस्तु ततः सप्त विश्वामित्रपुरोगमाः .
तुष्टुवुर्विविधैः स्तोत्रैः स्वस्तिस्वस्तीतिवादिनः .. 11
text_mt:
Then the seven sages, led by Viśvāmitra,
praised him with various hymns, proclaiming, 'Hail! Hail!'

sanskrit_iast:
vedoktābhirathāśīrbhirvālakhilyāśca tuṣṭuvuḥ .
tvaṃ nātha mokṣiṇāṃ mokṣo dhyeyastvaṃ dhyānināmapi .. 12
meaning:
वेदोक्ताभिरथाशीर्भिर्वालखिल्याश्च तुष्टुवुः .
त्वं नाथ मोक्षिणां मोक्षो ध्येयस्त्वं ध्यानिनामपि .. 12
text_mt:
And the Vālakhilyas praised him with blessings spoken in the Vedas:
'You, O protector, are the liberation of the seekers of liberation; you are the object of meditation even for meditators.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ gatiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam .
prajābhyaścaiva deveśa śaṃ no'stu jagataḥ pate .. 13
meaning:
त्वं गतिः सर्वभूतानां त्वयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् .
प्रजाभ्यश्चैव देवेश शं नोऽस्तु जगतः पते .. 13
text_mt:
You are the resort of all beings; in you everything is established.
And for the subjects, O lord of the gods, may there be welfare to us, O lord of the universe!

sanskrit_iast:
tvatto bhavati vai nityaṃ jagatsaṃlīyate tvayi .
tvamekastvaṃ dvidhā caiva tridhā ca tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ .. 14
meaning:
त्वत्तो भवति वै नित्यं जगत्संलीयते त्वयि .
त्वमेकस्त्वं द्विधा चैव त्रिधा च त्वं न संशयः .. 14
text_mt:
From you indeed the universe constantly arises; into you it dissolves.
You are one, and you are two, and you are threefold; there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayaikena jagatsṛṣṭaṃ tvayaikena prabodhitam .
tato vidyādharagaṇā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ .. 15
meaning:
त्वयैकेन जगत्सृष्टं त्वयैकेन प्रबोधितम् .
ततो विद्याधरगणा यक्षराक्षसपन्नगाः .. 15
text_mt:
By you alone the universe was created; by you alone it is awakened.'
Then the hosts of vidyādharas, yakṣas, rākṣasas, and serpents,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ sarve śirobhiḥ praṇatā ravim .
ūcurevaṃvidhā vāco manaḥ śrotrasukhapradāḥ .. 16
meaning:
कृताञ्जलिपुटाः सर्वे शिरोभिः प्रणता रविम् .
ऊचुरेवंविधा वाचो मनः श्रोत्रसुखप्रदाः .. 16
text_mt:
all with folded hands, bowing their heads to the sun,
spoke such words as gave delight to the mind and ears:

sanskrit_iast:
sahyaṃ bhavatu te tejo bhūtānāṃ bhūtabhāvana .
hāhā hūhūstataścaiva tumbururnāradastathā .. 17
meaning:
सह्यं भवतु ते तेजो भूतानां भूतभावन .
हाहा हूहूस्ततश्चैव तुम्बुरुर्नारदस्तथा .. 17
text_mt:
"'May your splendour become bearable to beings, O creator of beings!'
Then Hāhā, Hūhū, Tumburu, and Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
upagātuṃ samārabdhā gāmuccaiḥ kuśalā ravim .
ṣaḍjamadhyamagāṃdhāragrāmatrayaviśāradāḥ .. 18
meaning:
उपगातुं समारब्धा गामुच्चैः कुशला रविम् .
षड्जमध्यमगांधारग्रामत्रयविशारदाः .. 18
text_mt:
skilled in singing aloud, began to sing to the sun,
experts in the three scales: ṣaḍja, madhyama, and gāndhāra,

sanskrit_iast:
mūrcchanābhistataścaiva tathā dhaivatapañcamaiḥ .
nānānubhāvamandraiśca ardhamandraistathaiva ca .. 19
meaning:
मूर्च्छनाभिस्ततश्चैव तथा धैवतपञ्चमैः .
नानानुभावमन्द्रैश्च अर्धमन्द्रैस्तथैव च .. 19
text_mt:
with melodic variations, and with the notes dhaivata and pañcama,
with various expressive deep tones and also half-deep tones,

sanskrit_iast:
trisādhanaiḥ prakāraistu vādyatālasamanvitaiḥ .
viśvācī ca ghṛtācī ca urvaśī ca tilottamā ..20
meaning:
त्रिसाधनैः प्रकारैस्तु वाद्यतालसमन्वितैः .
विश्वाची च घृताची च उर्वशी च तिलोत्तमा ..20
text_mt:
with methods using three registers, accompanied by instruments and rhythm.
And Viśvācī, Ghṛtācī, Urvaśī, and Tilottamā,

sanskrit_iast:
menakā sahajanyā ca rambhā cāpsarasāṃ varā .
hāvabhāvavilāsaiśca kurvatyo'bhinayānbahūn ..2 1
tato'tīva kalaṃ geyaṃ madhuraṃ ca pravartate .
sarveṣāṃ devasaṃghānāṃ manaḥ śrotrasukhapradam ..22
meaning:
मेनका सहजन्या च रम्भा चाप्सरसां वरा .
हावभावविलासैश्च कुर्वत्योऽभिनयान्बहून् ..2 1
ततोऽतीव कलं गेयं मधुरं च प्रवर्तते .
सर्वेषां देवसंघानां मनः श्रोत्रसुखप्रदम् ..22
text_mt:
Menakā, Sahajanyā, and Rambhā, the best of the apsarases,
performing many dramatic representations with gestures, moods, and charms— / then an exceedingly melodious and sweet singing began, / bringing pleasure to the minds and ears of all the assemblies of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
pravādyaṃ tu tatastatra vīṇāvaṃśādi suvrata .
paṇavāḥ puṣkarāścaiva mṛdaṅgāḥ paṭahāstathā . . 23
meaning:
प्रवाद्यं तु ततस्तत्र वीणावंशादि सुव्रत .
पणवाः पुष्कराश्चैव मृदङ्गाः पटहास्तथा . . 23
text_mt:
Then there were played instruments such as the vīṇā, flutes, and the like, O one of good vows,
paṇava drums, puṣkara drums, mṛdaṅga drums, and paṭaha drums,

sanskrit_iast:
devadundubhayaḥ śaṃkhāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ .
gāyadbhiścaiva gandharvairnṛtyadbhiścāpsarogaṇaiḥ . . 24
meaning:
देवदुन्दुभयः शंखाः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः .
गायद्भिश्चैव गन्धर्वैर्नृत्यद्भिश्चाप्सरोगणैः . . 24
text_mt:
divine war drums, and conches by the hundreds and thousands,
with the gandharvas singing and the hosts of apsarases dancing.

sanskrit_iast:
tūryavāditraghoṣaiśca sarvaṃ kolāhalīkṛtam .
tataḥ kṛtaiḥ karapuṭaiḥ padyakuḍmalasannibhaiḥ . . 25
meaning:
तूर्यवादित्रघोषैश्च सर्वं कोलाहलीकृतम् .
ततः कृतैः करपुटैः पद्यकुड्मलसन्निभैः . . 25
text_mt:
Everything was filled with clamour by the sounds of musical instruments.
Then, with hands folded together resembling lotus buds,

sanskrit_iast:
lalāṭopari vinyastaiḥ praṇemuḥ sarvadevatāḥ .
tataḥ kolāhale tasminsarvadevasamāgame . . 26
meaning:
ललाटोपरि विन्यस्तैः प्रणेमुः सर्वदेवताः .
ततः कोलाहले तस्मिन्सर्वदेवसमागमे . . 26
text_mt:
placed upon their foreheads, all the deities bowed down.
Then, in that clamour at the gathering of all the gods,

sanskrit_iast: tejasaḥ śātanaṃ cakre viśvakarmā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ . . 27
meaning: तेजसः शातनं चक्रे विश्वकर्मा शनैः शनैः . . 27
text_mt: Viśvakarman performed the trimming of the splendour little by little.

sanskrit_iast:
iti himajalagharmakālahetorharakamalāsanaviṣṇusaṃstutasya .
tadupari likhanaṃ niśamya bhānorvrajati divākaralokamāyuṣonte . . 28
meaning:
इति हिमजलघर्मकालहेतोर्हरकमलासनविष्णुसंस्तुतस्य .
तदुपरि लिखनं निशम्य भानोर्व्रजति दिवाकरलोकमायुषोन्ते . . 28
text_mt: Thus, having heard of that trimming upon the sun—the cause of the seasons of cold, rain, and heat, praised by Hara, the lotus-seated Brahmā, and Viṣṇu—one goes to the world of the sun at the end of life.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe viśvakarmakṛtasūryatejaḥ śātanaṃ
nāmaikaviṃśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ . 121 .
ādityastavavarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे विश्वकर्मकृतसूर्यतेजः शातनं
नामैकविंशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः . 121 .
आदित्यस्तववर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus, in the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa, in the Brāhmaparvan, in the Saptamīkalpa, the hundred and twenty-first chapter, named "The Trimming of the Sun's Splendour Done by Viśvakarman."
Description of the Praise of Āditya.

sanskrit_iast:
śatānīka uvāca
tasminkāle samārūḍho likhyamāno divaspatiḥ .
brahmādibhiḥ stuto devairyathā vai tadvadasva me . . 1
meaning:
शतानीक उवाच
तस्मिन्काले समारूढो लिख्यमानो दिवस्पतिः .
ब्रह्मादिभिः स्तुतो देवैर्यथा वै तद्वदस्व मे . . 1
text_mt:
Śatānīka said:
At that time, how was the lord of the day, mounted [on the lathe] and being trimmed,
praised by the gods led by Brahmā? Truly tell me that.
title: Ādityastavaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
śṛṇuṣvaikamanā rājanyathā devo divaspatiḥ .
brahmādibhiḥ stuto devairṛṣibhiśca purā'nagha . . 2
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
शृणुष्वैकमना राजन्यथा देवो दिवस्पतिः .
ब्रह्मादिभिः स्तुतो देवैरृषिभिश्च पुराऽनघ . . 2
text_mt:
Sumantu said:
Listen with one-pointed mind, O king, to how the god, the lord of heaven,
was praised of old by Brahmā and the other gods and by the sages, O sinless one.

sanskrit_iast:
prayatnataḥ praṇatahitānukampine svarūpato lokavibhāvine namaḥ .
divaspate kamalakulāvabodhine namastamaḥ paṭasapaṭāvapāyine . . 3
meaning:
प्रयत्नतः प्रणतहितानुकम्पिने स्वरूपतो लोकविभाविने नमः .
दिवस्पते कमलकुलावबोधिने नमस्तमः पटसपटावपायिने . . 3
text_mt:
Obeisance to the one who by exertion has compassion for the welfare of those bowed down, who by his very nature manifests the worlds,
O lord of heaven, who awakens the lotus-clusters; obeisance to the dispeller of the veil of darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
pāvanātiśayapuṇyakarmaṇe naikakāmavibhavapradāyine .
bhāsurāmalamayūkhamāline sarvalokahitakāriṇe namaḥ . . 4
meaning:
पावनातिशयपुण्यकर्मणे नैककामविभवप्रदायिने .
भासुरामलमयूखमालिने सर्वलोकहितकारिणे नमः . . 4
text_mt:
To the one whose deeds are exceptionally purifying and meritorious, who bestows the abundance of various desires,
who wears a garland of radiant and spotless rays, who works the welfare of all worlds, obeisance!

sanskrit_iast:
ajāya lokatrayabhāvanāya bhūtātmane gopataye priyāya .
namo mahākāruṇikottamāya sūryāya lokatrayabhāvanāya . . 5
meaning:
अजाय लोकत्रयभावनाय भूतात्मने गोपतये प्रियाय .
नमो महाकारुणिकोत्तमाय सूर्याय लोकत्रयभावनाय . . 5
text_mt:
To the unborn, the creator of the three worlds, the soul of living beings, the lord of rays, the beloved,
obeisance to Sūrya, the supreme among the greatly compassionate, the creator of the three worlds!

sanskrit_iast:
vivasvate jñānakṛtāntarātmane jagatpratiṣṭhāya jagaddhitaiṣiṇe .
svayambhuve lokasamastacakṣuṣe surottamāyāmitatejase namaḥ . . 6
meaning:
विवस्वते ज्ञानकृतान्तरात्मने जगत्प्रतिष्ठाय जगद्धितैषिणे .
स्वयम्भुवे लोकसमस्तचक्षुषे सुरोत्तमायामिततेजसे नमः . . 6
text_mt:
To Vivasvat, whose inner self is made of knowledge, the support of the universe, who desires the welfare of the universe,
the self-born, the eye of the entire world, the highest of the gods, of boundless splendour, obeisance!

sanskrit_iast:
nijodayāya suragaṇamaulimaṇe jagatā tvaṃ mahitastvamurumayūkhasahasratapāḥ .
jagati vibho vatamasatuda vanatimirāsavapāvana madādbhavati vilohitavigrahatātimiravināśinamugraṃ sutarāṃ tribhuvanabhāprakaraiḥ . . 7
meaning:
निजोदयाय सुरगणमौलिमणे जगता त्वं महितस्त्वमुरुमयूखसहस्रतपाः .
जगति विभो वतमसतुद वनतिमिरासवपावन मदाद्भवति विलोहितविग्रहतातिमिरविनाशिनमुग्रं सुतरां त्रिभुवनभाप्रकरैः . . 7
text_mt:
O crest-jewel of the hosts of gods, arising by yourself, you are honoured by the world, burning with thousands of broad rays!
In the world, O omnipresent one, destroying darkness […] purifying the darkness of the forests, from intoxication your body becomes deep red, destroying darkness, fierce, exceedingly so with masses of radiance in the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast: rathāmāruhya1 samāmayaṃ bhramasi sadā jagato hitadaḥ . . 8
meaning: रथामारुह्य1 समामयं भ्रमसि सदा जगतो हितदः . . 8
text_mt: Mounting [your] chariot, you roam about, always free from affliction, granting what is beneficial to the world.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ saṃstuto devo bhāskaro vedhasā purā .
daivataiśca mahābāho śivaviṣṇvādibhirnṛpa . . 9
meaning:
इत्येवं संस्तुतो देवो भास्करो वेधसा पुरा .
दैवतैश्च महाबाहो शिवविष्ण्वादिभिर्नृप . . 9
text_mt:
In this way the god Bhāskara was praised in ancient times by the Creator,
and by the gods, O mighty-armed king, beginning with Śiva and Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe ādityastavo
nāma dvāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ . 122 .
parilekhavarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे आदित्यस्तवो
नाम द्वाविंशत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः . 122 .
परिलेखवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-second chapter, named 'Praise of Āditya', in the Saptamīkalpa of the Brāhmaparvan in the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Drawing

sanskrit_iast:
śatānīka uvāca
bhūyo'pi kathayasvemāṃ kathāṃ sūryasamāśritām .
na tṛptimadhigacchāmi śṛṇvannetāṃ kathāṃ mune . . 1
meaning:
शतानीक उवाच
भूयोऽपि कथयस्वेमां कथां सूर्यसमाश्रिताम् .
न तृप्तिमधिगच्छामि शृण्वन्नेतां कथां मुने . . 1
title: Parilekhavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvācaṃ
bhāskarasya kathāṃ puṇyāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm .
vakṣyāmi kathitāṃ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇā lokakartṛṇā1 . . 2
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाचं
भास्करस्य कथां पुण्यां सर्वपापप्रणाशिनीम् .
वक्ष्यामि कथितां पूर्वं ब्रह्मणा लोककर्तृणा1 . . 2
text_mt:
Sumantu said:
I shall speak of the holy tale of Bhāskara, which destroys all sins,
as it was told of old by Brahmā, the creator of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayaḥ paripṛcchanti brahmaloke pitāmaham .
tāpitāḥ sūryakiraṇaistejasā sampramohitāḥ . . 3
meaning:
ऋषयः परिपृच्छन्ति ब्रह्मलोके पितामहम् .
तापिताः सूर्यकिरणैस्तेजसा सम्प्रमोहिताः . . 3
text_mt:
In Brahmā’s world, the sages questioned the Grandfather,
tormented as they were by the sun's rays and thoroughly bewildered by his splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
ko'yaṃ dīpto mahātejā havīrāśisamaprabhaḥ .
etadveditumicchāmaḥ prabhāvo'sya kutaḥ prabho . . 4
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
कोऽयं दीप्तो महातेजा हवीराशिसमप्रभः .
एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामः प्रभावोऽस्य कुतः प्रभो . . 4
text_mt:
The sages said:
Who is this blazing one of great splendour, whose radiance equals a heap of sacrificial offerings?
We wish to know this, O lord: from where is his majesty?

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tamobhūteṣu lokeṣu naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame .
pravṛtte guṇahetutve pūrvaṃ buddhirajāyata . . 5
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
तमोभूतेषु लोकेषु नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे .
प्रवृत्ते गुणहेतुत्वे पूर्वं बुद्धिरजायत . . 5
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
When the worlds had become darkness, when moving and stationary things were destroyed,
and when the causality of the guṇas commenced, first intellect arose.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃkārastato jāto mahābhūtapravartakaḥ .
vāyvagnirāpaḥ khaṃ bhūmistatastvaṇḍamajāyata . . 6
meaning:
अहंकारस्ततो जातो महाभूतप्रवर्तकः .
वाय्वग्निरापः खं भूमिस्ततस्त्वण्डमजायत . . 6
text_mt:
From that arose egoity, the impeller of the gross elements;
then wind, fire, water, space, and earth, and then from that the egg was born.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminnaṇḍa ime lokāḥ sapta vai saṃpratiṣṭhitāḥ .
pṛthvī ca saptabhirdvīpaiḥ samudraiścāpi saptabhiḥ . . 7
meaning:
तस्मिन्नण्ड इमे लोकाः सप्त वै संप्रतिष्ठिताः .
पृथ्वी च सप्तभिर्द्वीपैः समुद्रैश्चापि सप्तभिः . . 7
text_mt:
Within that egg these seven worlds are established,
as well as the earth with its seven continents and its seven oceans.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraivāvasthito hyāsamahaṃ viṣṇurmaheśvaraḥ .
pramūḍhāstamasā sarve pradhyātā īśvaraṃ param . . 8
meaning:
तत्रैवावस्थितो ह्यासमहं विष्णुर्महेश्वरः .
प्रमूढास्तमसा सर्वे प्रध्याता ईश्वरं परम् . . 8
text_mt:
Stationed right there were I, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara;
bewildered by darkness, all [of us] meditated upon the supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhidya mahātejaḥ prādurbhūtaṃ tamonudam .
dhyānayogena cāsmābhirvijñātaṃ savitustathā . . 9
meaning:
ततो भिद्य महातेजः प्रादुर्भूतं तमोनुदम् .
ध्यानयोगेन चास्माभिर्विज्ञातं सवितुस्तथा . . 9
text_mt:
Then, having burst forth, a great splendour appeared, dispelling the darkness,
and through the yoga of meditation it was recognised by us as Savitṛ.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā ca paramātmānaṃ sarva eva pṛthakpṛthak .
divyābhiḥ stutibhirdevaṃ saṃstotumupacakramuḥ . . 1.123.10
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा च परमात्मानं सर्व एव पृथक्पृथक् .
दिव्याभिः स्तुतिभिर्देवं संस्तोतुमुपचक्रमुः . . 1.123.10
text_mt:
And having recognised the supreme Self, all [of us] individually
undertook to praise the god with celestial hymns:

sanskrit_iast:
ādidevo'si devānāmīśvarāṇāṃ tvamīśvaraḥ .
ādikartāsi bhūtānāṃ devadeva sanātana . . 11
meaning:
आदिदेवोऽसि देवानामीश्वराणां त्वमीश्वरः .
आदिकर्तासि भूतानां देवदेव सनातन . . 11
text_mt:
You are the primal god of the gods, you are the lord of lords;
you are the primal creator of beings, O god of gods, eternal one!

sanskrit_iast:
jīvanaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ devagandharvarakṣasām .
munikinnarasiddhānāṃ tathaivoragapakṣiṇām . . 12
meaning:
जीवनं सर्वसत्त्वानां देवगन्धर्वरक्षसाम् .
मुनिकिन्नरसिद्धानां तथैवोरगपक्षिणाम् . . 12
text_mt:
You are the life of all beings—of gods, gandharvas, and rākṣasas,
of sages, kinnaras, and siddhas, and likewise of serpents and birds.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ brahmā tvaṃ mahādevastvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ prajāpatiḥ .
vāyurindraśca somaśca vivasvānvaruṇastathā . . 13
meaning:
त्वं ब्रह्मा त्वं महादेवस्त्वं विष्णुस्त्वं प्रजापतिः .
वायुरिन्द्रश्च सोमश्च विवस्वान्वरुणस्तथा . . 13
text_mt:
You are Brahmā, you are Mahādeva, you are Viṣṇu, you are Prajāpati,
Vāyu, Indra, Soma, Vivasvat, and Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ kālaḥ sṛṣṭikartā ca hartā trātā prabhustathā .
saritaḥ sāgarāḥ śailā vidyudindradhanūṃṣi ca . .
pralayaḥ prabhavaścaiva vyaktāvyaktaḥ sanātanaḥ . . 14
meaning:
त्वं कालः सृष्टिकर्ता च हर्ता त्राता प्रभुस्तथा .
सरितः सागराः शैला विद्युदिन्द्रधनूंषि च . .
प्रलयः प्रभवश्चैव व्यक्ताव्यक्तः सनातनः . . 14

sanskrit_iast:
īśvarātparato vidyā vidyāyāḥ parataḥ śivaḥ .
śivātparataro devastvameva parameśvara . . 15
meaning:
ईश्वरात्परतो विद्या विद्यायाः परतः शिवः .
शिवात्परतरो देवस्त्वमेव परमेश्वर . . 15
text_mt:
Higher than the lord is wisdom; higher than wisdom is Śiva;
higher than Śiva is the god: you alone are the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvataḥ pāṇipādastvaṃ sarvato'kṣiśiromukhaḥ .
sahasrāṃśustvaṃ tu deva sahasrakiraṇastathā . . 16
meaning:
सर्वतः पाणिपादस्त्वं सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखः .
सहस्रांशुस्त्वं तु देव सहस्रकिरणस्तथा . . 16
text_mt:
Your hands and feet are everywhere; your eyes, heads, and faces are everywhere;
you are the thousand-rayed one, O god, possessing a thousand beams.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūrādibhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca maharjanastapastathā .
pradīptaṃ dīptimannityaṃ sarvalokaprakāśakam. .
durnirīkṣyaṃ surendrāṇāṃ yadrūpaṃ tasya te namaḥ .. 17
meaning:
भूरादिभूर्भुवः स्वश्च महर्जनस्तपस्तथा .
प्रदीप्तं दीप्तिमन्नित्यं सर्वलोकप्रकाशकम्. .
दुर्निरीक्ष्यं सुरेन्द्राणां यद्रूपं तस्य ते नमः .. 17
text_mt:
Beginning with Bhūr—Bhūr, Bhuvas, and Svar, as well as Mahar, Janas, and Tapas—
blazing, luminous, eternal, illuminating all the worlds,
hard to look upon even for the lords of the gods: obeisance to that form of yours!

sanskrit_iast:
surasiddhagaṇairjuṣṭaṃ bhṛgvatripulahādibhiḥ .
śubhaṃ paramamavyagraṃ yadrūpaṃ tasya te namaḥ .. 18
meaning:
सुरसिद्धगणैर्जुष्टं भृग्वत्रिपुलहादिभिः .
शुभं परममव्यग्रं यद्रूपं तस्य ते नमः .. 18
text_mt:
Frequented by hosts of gods and siddhas, by Bhṛgu, Atri, Pulaha, and others,
auspicious, supreme, undisturbed: obeisance to that form of yours!

sanskrit_iast:
pañcātītasthitaṃ tadvai daśaikādaśa eva ca .
ardhamāsamatikramya sthitaṃ tatsūryamaṇḍale ..
tasmai rūpāya te deva praṇatāḥ sarvadevatāḥ .. 19
meaning:
पञ्चातीतस्थितं तद्वै दशैकादश एव च .
अर्धमासमतिक्रम्य स्थितं तत्सूर्यमण्डले ..
तस्मै रूपाय ते देव प्रणताः सर्वदेवताः .. 19
text_mt:
Standing beyond the five, indeed, and the ten and the eleven,
standing in the solar orb beyond the half-month—
to that form of yours, O god, all the deities bow down.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvakṛdviśvabhūtaṃ ca viśvānarasurārcitam .
viśvasthitamaciṃtyaṃ ca yadrūpaṃ tasya te namaḥ ..1.123.20
meaning:
विश्वकृद्विश्वभूतं च विश्वानरसुरार्चितम् .
विश्वस्थितमचिंत्यं च यद्रूपं तस्य ते नमः ..1.123.20
text_mt:
Creating everything, being everything, worshipped by the gods and men of the universe,
residing in everything, and unthinkable: obeisance to that form of yours!

sanskrit_iast:
paraṃ yajñāt paraṃ devātparaṃ lokātparaṃ divaḥ .
duratikrameti yaḥ khyātastasmādapi paraṃ parāt ..
paramātmeti vikhyātaṃ yadrūpaṃ tasya te namaḥ ..2 1
avijñeyamacityaṃ ca adhyātmagatamavyayam .
anādinidhanaṃ devaṃ yadrūpaṃ tasya te namaḥ ..22
meaning:
परं यज्ञात् परं देवात्परं लोकात्परं दिवः .
दुरतिक्रमेति यः ख्यातस्तस्मादपि परं परात् ..
परमात्मेति विख्यातं यद्रूपं तस्य ते नमः ..2 1
अविज्ञेयमचित्यं च अध्यात्मगतमव्ययम् .
अनादिनिधनं देवं यद्रूपं तस्य ते नमः ..22
text_mt:
Higher than sacrifice, higher than the gods, higher than the world, higher than heaven,
higher even than that supreme which is called insurmountable,
renowned as the supreme Self: obeisance to that form of yours!
Unknowable, unthinkable, situated in the inner self, imperishable,
the god without beginning or end: obeisance to that form of yours!

sanskrit_iast:
namonamaḥ kāraṇakāraṇāya namonamaḥ pāpavināśanāya .
namonamo vaṃditavaṃdanāya namonamo rogavināśanāya ..2 3
namonamaḥ sarvavarapradāya namonamaḥ sarvabalapradāya .
namonamo jñānanidhe sadaiva namonamaḥ pañcadaśātmakāya ..24
meaning:
नमोनमः कारणकारणाय नमोनमः पापविनाशनाय .
नमोनमो वंदितवंदनाय नमोनमो रोगविनाशनाय ..2 3
नमोनमः सर्ववरप्रदाय नमोनमः सर्वबलप्रदाय .
नमोनमो ज्ञाननिधे सदैव नमोनमः पञ्चदशात्मकाय ..24
text_mt:
Obeisance, obeisance to the cause of causes! Obeisance, obeisance to the destroyer of sins!
Obeisance, obeisance to the worship of the worshipped! Obeisance, obeisance to the destroyer of diseases!
Obeisance, obeisance to the bestower of all boons! Obeisance, obeisance to the bestower of all strength!
Obeisance, obeisance, always, to the treasure of knowledge! Obeisance, obeisance to the one whose essence is fifteenfold!

sanskrit_iast:
stutaḥ sa bhagavānevaṃ tejasāṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ .
uvāca vācaṃ kalyāṇīṃ ko varo vaḥ pradīyatām ..25
meaning:
स्तुतः स भगवानेवं तेजसां रूपमास्थितः .
उवाच वाचं कल्याणीं को वरो वः प्रदीयताम् ..25
text_mt:
Praised in this way, the Lord, assuming a form of splendours,
spoke an auspicious speech: 'What boon shall be given to you?'

sanskrit_iast:
tavātitejasā rūpaṃ na kaścitsahate vibho .
sahanīyaṃ bhavatvetaddhitāya jagataḥ prabho ..26
meaning:
तवातितेजसा रूपं न कश्चित्सहते विभो .
सहनीयं भवत्वेतद्धिताय जगतः प्रभो ..26

sanskrit_iast:
evamastviti gāmuktvā bhagavānsarvakṛtsvayam .
lokānāṃ kāryasiddhyarthaṃ gharmavarṣāhimapradaḥ . . 27
meaning:
एवमस्त्विति गामुक्त्वा भगवान्सर्वकृत्स्वयम् .
लोकानां कार्यसिद्ध्यर्थं घर्मवर्षाहिमप्रदः . . 27
text_mt:
Saying 'Let it be so' to the earth, the Lord, the maker of all, himself
grants heat, rain, and cold for the accomplishment of the purposes of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ sāṃkhyāśca yogāśca ye cānye mokṣakāṃkṣiṇaḥ .
dhyāyanti dhyānino nityaṃ hadayasthaṃ divākaram . . 28
meaning:
अतः सांख्याश्च योगाश्च ये चान्ये मोक्षकांक्षिणः .
ध्यायन्ति ध्यानिनो नित्यं हदयस्थं दिवाकरम् . . 28
text_mt:
Therefore, the Sāṃkhyas, the Yogins, and whatever others long for liberation—
those meditators constantly meditate upon the sun residing in the heart.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalakṣaṇahīno'pi yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ .
sarvaṃ tarati vai pāpaṃ devakarmasamāśritaḥ . . 29
meaning:
सर्वलक्षणहीनोऽपि युक्तो वा सर्वपातकैः .
सर्वं तरति वै पापं देवकर्मसमाश्रितः . . 29
text_mt:
Even if devoid of all auspicious marks, or joined with all sins,
one crosses over all sin if dedicated to the rituals of the god.

sanskrit_iast:
agnihotraṃ ca vedāśca yajñāśca bahudakṣiṇāḥ .
bhānorbhaktyā namaskārakalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm . . 1.123.30
meaning:
अग्निहोत्रं च वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च बहुदक्षिणाः .
भानोर्भक्त्या नमस्कारकलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् . . 1.123.30
text_mt:
The agnihotra, the Vedas, and sacrifices with lavish priestly gifts
are not worth a sixteenth part of a bow made with devotion to the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam .
pavitraṃ ca pavitrāṇāṃ taṃ prapadye divākaram . . 31
meaning:
तीर्थानां परमं तीर्थं मङ्गलानां च मङ्गलम् .
पवित्रं च पवित्राणां तं प्रपद्ये दिवाकरम् . . 31
text_mt:
The highest sacred ford among sacred fords, the most auspicious among auspicious things,
and the purifier of purifiers—to that sun I take refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādyaiḥ saṃstutaṃ devairye prapadyanti 1 bhāskaram .
nirmuktāḥ kilbiṣaiḥ sarvaiste yānti ravimandiram . . 32
meaning:
ब्रह्माद्यैः संस्तुतं देवैर्ये प्रपद्यन्ति 1 भास्करम् .
निर्मुक्ताः किल्बिषैः सर्वैस्ते यान्ति रविमन्दिरम् . . 32
text_mt:
Those who take refuge in Bhāskara, who was praised by the gods headed by Brahmā,
freed from all sins, go to the abode of Ravi.

sanskrit_iast:
upacaryādibhiḥ sādhyo yathā vede divaspatiḥ .
lokānāmiha sarveṣāṃ tathā devo divākaraḥ . . 33
meaning:
उपचर्यादिभिः साध्यो यथा वेदे दिवस्पतिः .
लोकानामिह सर्वेषां तथा देवो दिवाकरः . . 33
text_mt: Just as the lord of the sky in the Veda is propitiated through services and the like, / so too is the sun-god [propitiated] by all the worlds here.

sanskrit_iast:
śatānīka uvāca
śarīralekhanaṃ sūrye kathaṃ vai pratipāditam .
devaiḥ saṛṣibhirvāpi tanmamācakṣva suvrata . . 34
meaning:
शतानीक उवाच
शरीरलेखनं सूर्ये कथं वै प्रतिपादितम् .
देवैः सऋषिभिर्वापि तन्ममाचक्ष्व सुव्रत . . 34
text_mt:
Śatānīka said:
How indeed was the paring of the body of the sun / performed by the gods or by the ṛṣis? Tell me that, O observer of excellent vows!

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
brahmaloke sukhāsīnaṃ brahmāṇaṃ te surāsurāḥ .
ṛṣayaḥ samupāgamya idamūcuḥ samāhitāḥ . . 35
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
ब्रह्मलोके सुखासीनं ब्रह्माणं ते सुरासुराः .
ऋषयः समुपागम्य इदमूचुः समाहिताः . . 35
text_mt:
Sumantu said:
Those gods and asuras, / and the ṛṣis, approaching Brahmā seated comfortably in the world of Brahmā, with focused minds spoke thus:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavandevatāputro ya eṣa divi rājate .
tenāndhakāro nikṛttaḥ so'yaṃ jājvalitīti hi . . 36
meaning:
भगवन्देवतापुत्रो य एष दिवि राजते .
तेनान्धकारो निकृत्तः सोऽयं जाज्वलितीति हि . . 36
text_mt: "O Lord, this son of a deity who shines in the sky— / by him darkness was destroyed, yet he blazes intensely indeed.

sanskrit_iast:
asya tejobhirakhilaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam .
nāśamāyāti deveśa yathā kliṣṭaṃ nadītaṭam . . 37
meaning:
अस्य तेजोभिरखिलं जगत्स्थावरजंगमम् .
नाशमायाति देवेश यथा क्लिष्टं नदीतटम् . . 37
text_mt: By his rays of light the entire world of moving and unmoving beings / goes to ruin, O lord of gods, like a riverbank worn away [by flood].

sanskrit_iast:
vayaṃ ca pīḍitā sarve tejasā tasya mohitāḥ .
padmaścāyaṃ yathā mlāno yoyaṃ yonistava prabho . . 38
meaning:
वयं च पीडिता सर्वे तेजसा तस्य मोहिताः .
पद्मश्चायं यथा म्लानो योयं योनिस्तव प्रभो . . 38
text_mt: And we are all afflicted, overwhelmed by his radiance, / just as this lotus has withered, which is your womb [of birth], O Lord!

sanskrit_iast:
divi bhuvyantarikṣe ca śarma nopalabhāmahe .
tathā kuru surajyeṣṭha yathā tejaḥ praśāmyati . . 39
meaning:
दिवि भुव्यन्तरिक्षे च शर्म नोपलभामहे .
तथा कुरु सुरज्येष्ठ यथा तेजः प्रशाम्यति . . 39
text_mt: In heaven, on earth, and in the atmosphere we find no comfort. / Act, O eldest of the gods, in such a way that his brilliance is calmed!"

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktaḥ sa bhagavānpadmayoniḥ prajāpatiḥ .
uvāca bhagavānbrahmā devānviṣṇupurogamān1 . . 1.123.40
meaning:
एवमुक्तः स भगवान्पद्मयोनिः प्रजापतिः .
उवाच भगवान्ब्रह्मा देवान्विष्णुपुरोगमान्1 . . 1.123.40
text_mt: Being thus addressed, the blessed Prajāpati, born of the lotus, / the blessed Brahmā, spoke to the gods headed by Viṣṇu:

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevena sahitā indreṇa ca mahātmanā .
tameva śaraṇaṃ devaṃ gacchāmaḥ sahitā vayam . . 41
meaning:
महादेवेन सहिता इन्द्रेण च महात्मना .
तमेव शरणं देवं गच्छामः सहिता वयम् . . 41
text_mt: "Together with Mahādeva and the noble Indra, / let us go all together to that very god for refuge."

sanskrit_iast:
tataste sahitāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇvādayaḥ surāḥ .
gatvā te śaraṇaṃ sarve bhāskaraṃ lokabhāskaram . . 42
meaning:
ततस्ते सहिताः सर्वे ब्रह्मविष्ण्वादयः सुराः .
गत्वा ते शरणं सर्वे भास्करं लोकभास्करम् . . 42
text_mt: Then all those gods, headed by Brahmā and Viṣṇu, / all went for refuge to the sun, the illuminator of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
stotuṃ pracakramuḥ sarve bhaktinamrā samantataḥ .
keśādidevatāḥ sarvā bhaktibhāvasamanvitāḥ . . 43
meaning:
स्तोतुं प्रचक्रमुः सर्वे भक्तिनम्रा समन्ततः .
केशादिदेवताः सर्वा भक्तिभावसमन्विताः . . 43
text_mt: Bowed down with devotion on all sides, they all began to praise [him]— / all the deities from Keśa onwards, endowed with the spirit of devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaviṣṇvīśā ūcuḥ
namonamaḥ suravara tigmatejase namonamaḥ suravara saṃstutāya vai .
jaḍāndhamūkānbadhirānsakuṣṭhānsaśvitriṇoṃ'dhānvividhavraṇāvṛtān . .
karoṣi tāneva punarnavāntsadā ato mahākāruṇikāya te namaḥ . . 44
meaning:
ब्रह्मविष्ण्वीशा ऊचुः
नमोनमः सुरवर तिग्मतेजसे नमोनमः सुरवर संस्तुताय वै .
जडान्धमूकान्बधिरान्सकुष्ठान्सश्वित्रिणोंऽधान्विविधव्रणावृतान् . .
करोषि तानेव पुनर्नवान्त्सदा अतो महाकारुणिकाय ते नमः . . 44
text_mt:
Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva said:
"Salutations, salutations to the best of gods of fierce radiance! Salutations, salutations to the best of gods who is praised! / Those who are inert, blind, mute, deaf, afflicted with leprosy, white-leprous, blind, and covered with various sores— / you make them fresh and new again continually. Therefore, salutations to you, who are exceedingly compassionate!

sanskrit_iast:
yadaudaraṃ jyotiratitvaranmahadyadalpatejo yadapīha cakṣuṣām .
yadatra yajñeṣvapanītamāhitaṃ tavaiva tadūpamanekataḥ sthitam . . 45
meaning:
यदौदरं ज्योतिरतित्वरन्महद्यदल्पतेजो यदपीह चक्षुषाम् .
यदत्र यज्ञेष्वपनीतमाहितं तवैव तदूपमनेकतः स्थितम् . . 45
text_mt: Whatever light is in the belly, moving with great speed, whatever slight light is here in the eyes, / and whatever is removed and established in sacrifices—that is your very form, abiding manifoldly.

sanskrit_iast:
suradviṣaḥ sāgaratoyavāsinaḥ pracaṇḍapāśāsiparaśvadhāyudhāḥ .
samucchritāste bhuvi pāpacetasaḥ prayāṃti nāśaṃ tava deva darśanāt . . 46
meaning:
सुरद्विषः सागरतोयवासिनः प्रचण्डपाशासिपरश्वधायुधाः .
समुच्छ्रितास्ते भुवि पापचेतसः प्रयांति नाशं तव देव दर्शनात् . . 46
text_mt: The enemies of the gods dwelling in the ocean waters, armed with terrible nooses, swords, and battle-axes, / haughty on earth and evil-minded, go to destruction at the sight of you, O God!

sanskrit_iast:
yato bhavāṃstīrthaphalaṃ samastaṃ yajñeṣu nityaṃ bhagavānavasthitaḥ .
namo bhavannatra vicāraṇāsti sadā samaḥ śāṃtikaro narāṇām . .
yaccāpi loke tapa ucyate budhaistatte mahāteja uśaṃti paṇḍitāḥ . .47
meaning:
यतो भवांस्तीर्थफलं समस्तं यज्ञेषु नित्यं भगवानवस्थितः .
नमो भवन्नत्र विचारणास्ति सदा समः शांतिकरो नराणाम् . .
यच्चापि लोके तप उच्यते बुधैस्तत्ते महातेज उशंति पण्डिताः . .47
text_mt: Because you are the fruit of all sacred fords and, as the Lord, are ever present in sacrifices; / salutations to you, Lord—there is no doubt here—ever impartial, conferring peace upon men; / and whatever is spoken of as austerity in the world by the wise, the learned proclaim that to be your great splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
stutaḥ sa bhagavānevaṃ prajāpatimukhaiḥ suraiḥ .
avadhānaṃ tataścakre śravaṇābhyāṃ mahīpate . .48
meaning:
स्तुतः स भगवानेवं प्रजापतिमुखैः सुरैः .
अवधानं ततश्चक्रे श्रवणाभ्यां महीपते . .48
text_mt: Praised thus by the gods headed by Prajāpati, / the Lord then turned his attention with his ears, O king of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
stuvanti te tato bhūyaḥ śivaviṣṇupurogamāḥ .
kṛtvā māṃ purataḥ sarve bhaktinamrāḥ samantataḥ . .49
meaning:
स्तुवन्ति ते ततो भूयः शिवविष्णुपुरोगमाः .
कृत्वा मां पुरतः सर्वे भक्तिनम्राः समन्ततः . .49
text_mt: Then, led by Śiva and Viṣṇu, placing me in front, / they all, bowed down in devotion on every side, praised him further:

sanskrit_iast:
1namonamastribhuvanabhūtidāyine kratukriyāsatphalasampradāyine .
namonamaḥ pratidinakarmasākṣiṇe sahasrasaṃdīdhitaye namonamaḥ . . 1.123.50
meaning:
1नमोनमस्त्रिभुवनभूतिदायिने क्रतुक्रियासत्फलसम्प्रदायिने .
नमोनमः प्रतिदिनकर्मसाक्षिणे सहस्रसंदीधितये नमोनमः . . 1.123.50
text_mt: "Salutations, salutations to the bestower of prosperity upon the three worlds, to the granter of the true fruit of sacrificial rites! / Salutations, salutations to the witness of daily deeds, to the one with thousands of combined rays, salutations, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
prasaktasaptāśvayuje kṣayāya dhruvaikaraśmigrathine namonamaḥ .
savālakhilyāpsarakinnaroragaiḥ saṃsiddhagandharvapiśācamānuṣaiḥ . .
sayakṣarakṣogaṇaguhyakottamaiḥ stutaḥ sadā deva namonamaste . . 51
meaning:
प्रसक्तसप्ताश्वयुजे क्षयाय ध्रुवैकरश्मिग्रथिने नमोनमः .
सवालखिल्याप्सरकिन्नरोरगैः संसिद्धगन्धर्वपिशाचमानुषैः . .
सयक्षरक्षोगणगुह्यकोत्तमैः स्तुतः सदा देव नमोनमस्ते . . 51
text_mt: Salutations, salutations to the one joined to seven attached horses, to destruction, to the one who strings the firm solitary ray! / By the Vālakhilyas, apsarases, kinnaras, and uragas, by perfected beings, gandharvas, piśācas, and humans, / by yakṣas, rākṣasa-hordes, and the highest guhyakas you are ever praised, O God! Salutations, salutations to you!

sanskrit_iast:
yato rasānsaṃkṣipase śarīriṇāṃ gabhastibhirhimajalagharmanisravaiḥ .
jagacca saṃśoṣayase sadaiva atosi loke jagato viśoṣaṇam . . 52
meaning:
यतो रसान्संक्षिपसे शरीरिणां गभस्तिभिर्हिमजलघर्मनिस्रवैः .
जगच्च संशोषयसे सदैव अतोसि लोके जगतो विशोषणम् . . 52
text_mt: Since you draw up the fluids of embodied beings through rays that discharge cold water and heat, / and ever wither the world, you are therefore the witherer of the world in this universe."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
jñātvā teṣāmabhiprāyamuvāca bhagavānvacaḥ .
labdhvānujñāṃ tataḥ sarve surāḥ saṃhṛṣṭacetasaḥ . . 53
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ज्ञात्वा तेषामभिप्रायमुवाच भगवान्वचः .
लब्ध्वानुज्ञां ततः सर्वे सुराः संहृष्टचेतसः . . 53
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Knowing their intention, the Lord spoke [these] words. / Then all the gods, having received permission, delighted in mind,

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṣṭāraṃ pūjayāmāsurmanovākkāyakarmabhiḥ .
viśvakarmā tavādeśātkarotu tava saumyatām . . 54
meaning:
त्वष्टारं पूजयामासुर्मनोवाक्कायकर्मभिः .
विश्वकर्मा तवादेशात्करोतु तव सौम्यताम् . . 54
text_mt: honoured Tvaṣṭṛ with actions of mind, speech, and body: / "May Viśvakarman, by your command, bring about your gentle form."

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu tejaso rāśiṃ sarvakarmavidhānavit .
bhramimāropayāmāsa viśvakarmā vibhāvasum . . 55
meaning:
ततस्तु तेजसो राशिं सर्वकर्मविधानवित् .
भ्रमिमारोपयामास विश्वकर्मा विभावसुम् . . 55
text_mt: Then Viśvakarman, skilled in the rule of all actions, / mounted that heap of radiance, the sun, upon a lathe.

sanskrit_iast:
amṛtenābhiṣiktasya tadā sūryasya vai vibhoḥ .
tejasaḥ śātanaṃ cakre viśvakarmā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ . . 56
meaning:
अमृतेनाभिषिक्तस्य तदा सूर्यस्य वै विभोः .
तेजसः शातनं चक्रे विश्वकर्मा शनैः शनैः . . 56
text_mt: Of the all-pervading sun, who was then sprinkled with nectar, / Viśvakarman performed the paring away of the brilliance little by little.

sanskrit_iast:
ājānulikhitaścāsau samurāsurapūjitaḥ .
nābhyanandattato deva ullekhanamataḥ param . . 57
meaning:
आजानुलिखितश्चासौ समुरासुरपूजितः .
नाभ्यनन्दत्ततो देव उल्लेखनमतः परम् . . 57
text_mt: And when he was pared down to the knees, worshipped by gods and asuras, / the God thereafter did not approve any further scraping.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabhṛti devasya caraṇau nityasaṃvṛtau .
tāpayanglāpayaṃścaiva yuktatejo'bhavattadā . . 58
meaning:
ततः प्रभृति देवस्य चरणौ नित्यसंवृतौ .
तापयन्ग्लापयंश्चैव युक्ततेजोऽभवत्तदा . . 58
text_mt: From that time forth, the two feet of the God are ever covered. / Warming and consuming, his brilliance then became measured.

sanskrit_iast:
yaccāsya śātitaṃ tejastena cakraṃ vinirmitam .
yena viṣṇurjaghānogrānsadā vai daityadānavān . . 59
meaning:
यच्चास्य शातितं तेजस्तेन चक्रं विनिर्मितम् .
येन विष्णुर्जघानोग्रान्सदा वै दैत्यदानवान् . . 59
text_mt: And the brilliance of his that was pared away—from that the discus was fashioned, / with which Viṣṇu constantly slew the fierce daityas and dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
śūlaśaktigadāvajraśarāsanaparaśvadhān .
devatānāṃ dadau kṛtvā viśvakarmā mahāmatiḥ . . 1.123.60
meaning:
शूलशक्तिगदावज्रशरासनपरश्वधान् .
देवतानां ददौ कृत्वा विश्वकर्मा महामतिः . . 1.123.60
text_mt: Making the trident, the spear, the mace, the thunderbolt, the bow, and the battle-axe, / the wise Viśvakarman gave [them] to the deities.

sanskrit_iast:
tridevanirmitaṃ stotraṃ sandhyayorubhayorjapan .
kulaṃ punāti puruṣo vyādhibhirna ca pīḍyate . . 61
meaning:
त्रिदेवनिर्मितं स्तोत्रं सन्ध्ययोरुभयोर्जपन् .
कुलं पुनाति पुरुषो व्याधिभिर्न च पीड्यते . . 61
text_mt: Muttering at both twilight junctures this hymn composed by the three gods, / a man purifies his lineage and is not afflicted by diseases.

sanskrit_iast:
prajāvānsiddhakarmā ca jīvetsāgraṃ śaracchatam .
putravāndhanavāṃścaiva sarvatra cāparājitaḥ . .
hitvā puraṃ bhūtamayaṃ gacchetsṛryamayaṃ puram . . 62
meaning:
प्रजावान्सिद्धकर्मा च जीवेत्साग्रं शरच्छतम् .
पुत्रवान्धनवांश्चैव सर्वत्र चापराजितः . .
हित्वा पुरं भूतमयं गच्छेत्सृर्यमयं पुरम् . . 62
text_mt: Blessed with offspring, successful in his deeds, he will live for a full hundred autumns; / endowed with sons and wealth, and undefeated everywhere, / leaving behind the physical city, he goes to the city of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyo'pi tuṣṭuvurdevāstathā devarṣayo ravim .
vāgbhiritthamaśeṣasya trailokyasya samāgatāḥ . . 63
meaning:
भूयोऽपि तुष्टुवुर्देवास्तथा देवर्षयो रविम् .
वाग्भिरित्थमशेषस्य त्रैलोक्यस्य समागताः . . 63
text_mt: Again, the gods and divine seers assembled from the entire three worlds / praised the sun with words in this manner.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
namaste1 ravirūpāya somarūpāya te namaḥ .
namo yajuḥ svarūpāyātharvāyāṅgirase2 namaḥ . . 64
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
नमस्ते1 रविरूपाय सोमरूपाय ते नमः .
नमो यजुः स्वरूपायाथर्वायाङ्गिरसे2 नमः . . 64
text_mt:
The gods said:
"Salutations to you whose form is the sun! Salutations to you whose form is the moon! / Salutations to you whose nature is the Yajus! Salutations to Atharva and Aṅgiras!

sanskrit_iast:
jñānaikadhāmabhūtāya3 nirdhūtatamase namaḥ .
śuddhajyotiḥsvarūpāya nistattvāyāmalātmane . . 65
meaning:
ज्ञानैकधामभूताय3 निर्धूततमसे नमः .
शुद्धज्योतिःस्वरूपाय निस्तत्त्वायामलात्मने . . 65
text_mt: Salutations to the one who is the sole abode of knowledge, whose darkness is shaken off! / Salutations to the pure soul devoid of material elements, whose nature is pure light!

sanskrit_iast:
namo'khilajagadvyāptisvarūpāyātmamūrtaye ..
sarvakāraṇabhūtāya niṣṭhāyai jñānacetasām..66..
meaning:
नमोऽखिलजगद्व्याप्तिस्वरूपायात्ममूर्तये ..
सर्वकारणभूताय निष्ठायै ज्ञानचेतसाम्..66..
text_mt: Salutations to the embodiment of the self, whose nature is the pervading of the entire world! / To the one who is the cause of all, the ultimate foundation for minds endowed with knowledge!

sanskrit_iast:
namo'stu jñeyarūpāya prakāśe lakṣarūpiṇe ..
bhāskarāya namastubhyaṃ tathā śabdakṛte namaḥ .. 67 ..
meaning:
नमोऽस्तु ज्ञेयरूपाय प्रकाशे लक्षरूपिणे ..
भास्कराय नमस्तुभ्यं तथा शब्दकृते नमः .. 67 ..
text_mt: Salutations be to the one whose form is that which is to be known, whose form is the target in illumination! / Salutations to you, the sun; and salutations to the maker of sound!

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsārahetave caiva saṃdhyājyotsnākṛte namaḥ ..
tvaṃ sarvametadbhagavāñjagadvai bhramati tvayā .. 68 ..
meaning:
संसारहेतवे चैव संध्याज्योत्स्नाकृते नमः ..
त्वं सर्वमेतद्भगवाञ्जगद्वै भ्रमति त्वया .. 68 ..
text_mt: Salutations to the cause of worldly existence and the creator of twilight and moonlight! / You are all this, O Lord; indeed, the world revolves through you.

sanskrit_iast:
bhramatvāviddhamakhilaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ sacarācaram ..
tvadaṃśubhiridaṃ sarvaṃ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ jāyate śuci .. 69 ..
meaning:
भ्रमत्वाविद्धमखिलं ब्रह्माण्डं सचराचरम् ..
त्वदंशुभिरिदं सर्वं संसृष्टं जायते शुचि .. 69 ..
text_mt: Pervaded by you, the entire cosmic egg revolves with its moving and unmoving beings. / Created by your rays, all this becomes pure.

sanskrit_iast:
kriyate tvatkarasparśājjalādīnāṃ pavitratā ..
homadānādiko dharmo nopakārāya jāyate .. 1.123.70 ..
meaning:
क्रियते त्वत्करस्पर्शाज्जलादीनां पवित्रता ..
होमदानादिको धर्मो नोपकाराय जायते .. 1.123.70 ..
text_mt: By the touch of your rays, purity of water and the like is effected. / Religious duty, such as fire offering and gift-giving, does not become beneficial

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadyāvanna saṃyogī jagatyatra bhavāñchuciḥ ..
prātarhomaṃ praśastaṃ hi udite tvayi jāyate .. 71 ..
meaning:
तावद्यावन्न संयोगी जगत्यत्र भवाञ्छुचिः ..
प्रातर्होमं प्रशस्तं हि उदिते त्वयि जायते .. 71 ..
text_mt: so long as you, who are pure, are not connected with this world. / For the morning fire offering becomes praiseworthy once you have risen.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛco'tha sakalā hyetā yajūṃṣi tvaṃ jagatpate ..
sakalāni ca sāmāni tapatyevaṃ jagatsadā .. 72 ..
meaning:
ऋचोऽथ सकला ह्येता यजूंषि त्वं जगत्पते ..
सकलानि च सामानि तपत्येवं जगत्सदा .. 72 ..
text_mt: Indeed, you are all these Ṛg verses, you are the Yajus verses, O Lord of the universe, / and all the Sāman verses; thus [your light] ever warms the world."

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṅmayastvaṃ jagannātha tvameva ca yajurmayaḥ ..
tathā sāmamayaścaiva tato nātha trayīmayaḥ .. 73 ..
meaning:
ऋङ्मयस्त्वं जगन्नाथ त्वमेव च यजुर्मयः ..
तथा साममयश्चैव ततो नाथ त्रयीमयः .. 73 ..
text_mt:
You consist of the Ṛg[veda], O Lord of the world, and you consist of the Yajur[veda];
likewise you consist of the Sāma[veda], and therefore, O Lord, you consist of the three Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva brahmaṇo rūpaṃ paraṃ cāparameva ca ..
mūrto'mūrtastathā sūkṣmaḥ sdhūlarūpatayā sthitaḥ .. 74 ..
meaning:
त्वमेव ब्रह्मणो रूपं परं चापरमेव च ..
मूर्तोऽमूर्तस्तथा सूक्ष्मः स्धूलरूपतया स्थितः .. 74 ..
text_mt:
You alone are the form of Brahman, both the higher and the lower;
embodied and unembodied, subtle, standing as gross form.

sanskrit_iast:
nimeṣakāṣṭhādimayaḥ kālarūpaḥ kṣayātmakaḥ ..
prasīda svecchayā rūpaṃ svatejomayamādiśa .. 75 ..
meaning:
निमेषकाष्ठादिमयः कालरूपः क्षयात्मकः ..
प्रसीद स्वेच्छया रूपं स्वतेजोमयमादिश .. 75 ..
text_mt:
You consist of nimeṣas, kāṣṭhās, and other [divisions of time]; you are the form of time whose nature is destruction.
Be gracious! By your own will, manifest your form consisting of your own splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ saṃstūyamānastu devairdevarṣibhistathā ..
mumoca svaṃ tadā tejastejasāṃ rāśiravyayaḥ..76..
meaning:
इत्थं संस्तूयमानस्तु देवैर्देवर्षिभिस्तथा ..
मुमोच स्वं तदा तेजस्तेजसां राशिरव्ययः..76..
text_mt:
Thus praised by the gods and divine seers,
the imperishable heap of splendour then shed his radiance.

sanskrit_iast:
yattasya ṛṅmayaṃ tejo bhavitā tena medinī ..
yajurmayenāpi divaṃ svayaṃ sāmamayo raviḥ..77..
meaning:
यत्तस्य ऋङ्मयं तेजो भविता तेन मेदिनी ..
यजुर्मयेनापि दिवं स्वयं साममयो रविः..77..
text_mt:
The earth came to be from that radiance of his which consists of the Ṛg[veda];
the heavens from that which consists of the Yajur[veda], while the Sun himself consists of the Sāma[veda].

sanskrit_iast:
śātitāstejaso bhāgā ye ca syurdaśa paṃca ca..
tasyaiva tena śarvasya kṛtaṃ śūlaṃ mahātmanā.. 78..
meaning:
शातितास्तेजसो भागा ये च स्युर्दश पंच च..
तस्यैव तेन शर्वस्य कृतं शूलं महात्मना.. 78..
text_mt:
Fifteen parts of his splendour were pared away;
from that very [splendour] the trident of high-souled Śarva was fashioned,

sanskrit_iast:
cakraṃ viṣṇorvasūnāṃ ca śaṃkarasya ca dāruṇam..
ṣaṇmukhasya tathā śaktiḥ śibikā dhanadasya ca..79..
meaning:
चक्रं विष्णोर्वसूनां च शंकरस्य च दारुणम्..
षण्मुखस्य तथा शक्तिः शिबिका धनदस्य च..79..
text_mt:
and the terrible discus of Viṣṇu, [weapons] of the Vasus and of Śaṅkara,
the spear of the six-faced one, and the palanquin of the Bestower of Wealth;

sanskrit_iast:
anyeṣāṃ cāsurārīṇāṃ śastrāṇyugrāṇi yāni vai..
yakṣavidyādharāṇāṃ ca tāni cakre sa viśvakṛt..1.123.80..
meaning:
अन्येषां चासुरारीणां शस्त्राण्युग्राणि यानि वै..
यक्षविद्याधराणां च तानि चक्रे स विश्वकृत्..1.123.80..
text_mt:
and the fierce weapons of other foes of the Asuras,
of Yakṣas and Vidyādharas, the All-maker fashioned.

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca ṣoḍaśaṃ bhāgaṃ bibharti bhagavānraviḥ..
tattejasaḥ paṃcadaśa śātitā viśvakarmaṇā.. 81..
meaning:
ततश्च षोडशं भागं बिभर्ति भगवान्रविः..
तत्तेजसः पंचदश शातिता विश्वकर्मणा.. 81..
text_mt:
And thereafter the Lord Sun bears the sixteenth part;
fifteen [parts] of his splendour were pared away by Viśvakarman.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ surūpadṛgbhānuruttarānagamatkurūn..
dadarśa tatra saṃjñāṃ ca vaḍavārūpadhāriṇīm..82..
meaning:
ततः सुरूपदृग्भानुरुत्तरानगमत्कुरून्..
ददर्श तत्र संज्ञां च वडवारूपधारिणीम्..82..
text_mt:
Then, having a handsome appearance, the Sun went to the Northern Kurus;
there he saw Saṃjñā, who had assumed the form of a mare.

sanskrit_iast:
ityetannikhilaṃ bhānoḥ kathitaṃ munisattamāḥ..
śṛṇuyādyo naro bhaktyā aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet..83..
meaning:
इत्येतन्निखिलं भानोः कथितं मुनिसत्तमाः..
शृणुयाद्यो नरो भक्त्या अश्वमेधफलं लभेत्..83..
text_mt:
All this of the Sun has thus been told, O best of sages;
the man who hears it with devotion obtains the fruit of an horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca..
vakṣyāmyahaṃ te punareva diṃḍe sūryasya sarvapravarapradhānam..
vyomnaḥ paraṃ tiṣṭhati yastu magnaḥ sa mucyate rudra ihāpi diṃḍī..1..
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच..
वक्ष्याम्यहं ते पुनरेव दिंडे सूर्यस्य सर्वप्रवरप्रधानम्..
व्योम्नः परं तिष्ठति यस्तु मग्नः स मुच्यते रुद्र इहापि दिंडी..1..
title: Pravaravarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
sthitvā purā brahmaśiraḥ kilāsau pragṛhya tattasya śiraḥkapālam..
tato hyasāvāśramamuttamaṃ śivo bahūdakaiḥ puṣpaphalaiḥ samṛddham .. 2 ..
meaning:
स्थित्वा पुरा ब्रह्मशिरः किलासौ प्रगृह्य तत्तस्य शिरःकपालम्..
ततो ह्यसावाश्रममुत्तमं शिवो बहूदकैः पुष्पफलैः समृद्धम् .. 2 ..
text_mt:
Formerly, having severed Brahmā's head and seized the skull of that head of his,
Śiva then [went] to an excellent hermitage rich in copious waters, flowers, and fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
nagno yadā dāruvane munīnāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca taṃ bhaikṣyacaraṃ sureśam ..
yoṣitsutāḥ saṃkṣubhitāstu sarve jagmurharaṃ taṃ munayaḥ sutuṣṭāḥ .. ..
sa hanyamāno munimukhyasaṃghairgṛhītaloṣṭairṛṣidaṃḍakāṣṭhaiḥ ..
vihāya diṃḍiḥ sa tu tānsurarṣīṃstato raverlokamathājagāma .. 4 ..
meaning:
नग्नो यदा दारुवने मुनीनां दृष्ट्वा च तं भैक्ष्यचरं सुरेशम् ..
योषित्सुताः संक्षुभितास्तु सर्वे जग्मुर्हरं तं मुनयः सुतुष्टाः .. ..
स हन्यमानो मुनिमुख्यसंघैर्गृहीतलोष्टैरृषिदंडकाष्ठैः ..
विहाय दिंडिः स तु तान्सुरर्षींस्ततो रवेर्लोकमथाजगाम .. 4 ..
text_mt:
When, naked, in the pine forest of the sages, seeing him wandering for alms, that lord of gods—
the women and children were agitated, but the sages, highly pleased, approached Hara.
Being struck by the hosts of foremost sages with clods of earth they had seized and with sages' wooden staffs,
he, Diṇḍi, left those divine seers and went from there to the realm of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
āgacchamānaṃ pramathāstamūcurdeveśa nityaṃ bhramase kimartham ..
sa prāha tānpāpavimocanārthamaṭāmi tīrthāni surālayāṃśca .. 5 ..
meaning:
आगच्छमानं प्रमथास्तमूचुर्देवेश नित्यं भ्रमसे किमर्थम् ..
स प्राह तान्पापविमोचनार्थमटामि तीर्थानि सुरालयांश्च .. 5 ..
text_mt:
As he approached, the Pramathas said to him, 'O lord of gods, why do you wander constantly?'
He said to them, 'To free myself from sin, I roam holy places and abodes of the gods.'

sanskrit_iast:
te bhūya ūcuḥ pramathāstamevamatraiva tiṣṭhasva raveḥ purastāt ..
śuddhiṃ tavaiṣa prakariṣyatīti śuddhastato yāsyasi rudralokam .. 6 ..
meaning:
ते भूय ऊचुः प्रमथास्तमेवमत्रैव तिष्ठस्व रवेः पुरस्तात् ..
शुद्धिं तवैष प्रकरिष्यतीति शुद्धस्ततो यास्यसि रुद्रलोकम् .. 6 ..
text_mt:
Those Pramathas said to him again, 'Stand right here before the Sun!
He will bring about your purification; purified thereby, you will go to the realm of Rudra.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktaḥ pramathaistu rudrastatraiva tasthau ravitoṣaṇāya ..
nagno jaṭī muṣṭikapālapāṇī rūpeṇa caivāpratimastriloke .. 7 ..
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्तः प्रमथैस्तु रुद्रस्तत्रैव तस्थौ रवितोषणाय ..
नग्नो जटी मुष्टिकपालपाणी रूपेण चैवाप्रतिमस्त्रिलोके .. 7 ..
text_mt:
Having been spoken to thus by the Pramathas, Rudra stayed right there to propitiate the Sun,
naked, with matted hair, a fist-sized skull in hand, matchless in form throughout the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
uktaḥ sa tuṣṭena tataḥ savitrā prītosmi devāgamanāttavāham ..
maddarśanādeva bhavānviśuddho diṃḍīti nāmnā bhavitāsi loke .. 8 ..
meaning:
उक्तः स तुष्टेन ततः सवित्रा प्रीतोस्मि देवागमनात्तवाहम् ..
मद्दर्शनादेव भवान्विशुद्धो दिंडीति नाम्ना भवितासि लोके .. 8 ..
text_mt:
He was then addressed by the pleased Savitṛ: 'I am delighted by your coming, O god.
Merely by the sight of me you are purified; you shall be known in the world by the name Diṇḍin.'

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭādaśaite pramathāstu bhānoścaturdaśānye tu rave rathasthāḥ ..
he devate dvau ca ṛṣipradhānau gaṃdharvasarpāvapi tāvadeva .. 9 ..
meaning:
अष्टादशैते प्रमथास्तु भानोश्चतुर्दशान्ये तु रवे रथस्थाः ..
हे देवते द्वौ च ऋषिप्रधानौ गंधर्वसर्पावपि तावदेव .. 9 ..
text_mt:
These eighteen Pramathas of the Sun and fourteen others reside on the Sun's chariot;
two deities, two chief sages, and as many Gandharvas and serpents;

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣau ca siddhau ca niśācarau cādityātmajāvapsarasāṃ pradhānau ..
vasaṃti te hyastamuṣaśca sūrye teṣāma śītiścaturottarā sā .. 1.124.10 ..
meaning:
यक्षौ च सिद्धौ च निशाचरौ चादित्यात्मजावप्सरसां प्रधानौ ..
वसंति ते ह्यस्तमुषश्च सूर्ये तेषाम शीतिश्चतुरोत्तरा सा .. 1.124.10 ..
text_mt:
two Yakṣas, two Siddhas, two night-roamers, two sons of Āditya, and two chief Apsarases;
they dwell from sunset to dawn in the Sun; their number is eighty-four.

sanskrit_iast: ityādidevapravarāstu sarve dhātvarthaśabdaiśca bhavaṃti siddhāḥ .. 11 ..
meaning: इत्यादिदेवप्रवरास्तु सर्वे धात्वर्थशब्दैश्च भवंति सिद्धाः .. 11 ..
text_mt: All these foremost attendants of the primal god are established according to the verbal roots of their names.

sanskrit_iast:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
vistarādbrūhi me brahmanpravarāndhātuśabdajān ..
yataśca kautukaṃ brahmannasmākamiha jāyate .. 12 ..
meaning:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
विस्तराद्ब्रूहि मे ब्रह्मन्प्रवरान्धातुशब्दजान् ..
यतश्च कौतुकं ब्रह्मन्नस्माकमिह जायते .. 12 ..
text_mt:
The sages said:
Tell me in detail, O Brahman, about these foremost attendants born from the roots of words,
for curiosity has arisen in us here, O Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca .. ..
bhūyastava pravakṣyāmi daṃḍanāyakapiṃgalau ..
rājñasrauṣādayaścānye digdevā diṃḍinā saha .. 13 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
भूयस्तव प्रवक्ष्यामि दंडनायकपिंगलौ ..
राज्ञस्रौषादयश्चान्ये दिग्देवा दिंडिना सह .. 13 ..
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
I will tell you again of Daṇḍanāyaka and Piṅgala,
of Rājña, Srauṣa, and others, the deities of the directions, together with Diṇḍin.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā saha samāgamya purā devairvicāritam ..
eṣa kāruṇikaḥ sūryo yudhyate dānavaiḥ saha .. 14 ..
meaning:
मया सह समागम्य पुरा देवैर्विचारितम् ..
एष कारुणिकः सूर्यो युध्यते दानवैः सह .. 14 ..
text_mt:
Formerly, having met with me, the gods reflected:
'This compassionate Sun fights with the Dānavas;

sanskrit_iast:
te tu labdhavarā bhūtvā amātyādyā hyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ ..
ādityaṃ manyamānāste tapaṃtaṃ haṃtumudyatāḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
ते तु लब्धवरा भूत्वा अमात्याद्या ह्यभीक्ष्णशः ..
आदित्यं मन्यमानास्ते तपंतं हंतुमुद्यताः .. 15 ..
text_mt:
and they, having obtained boons, acting repeatedly as ministers and such,
regarding Āditya as merely heating, are intent on killing him.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātteṣāṃ vighātārthaṃ pravarāśca bhavāmahe ..
asmābhiḥ pratiruddhāste na drakṣyaṃti divākaram .. 16 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्तेषां विघातार्थं प्रवराश्च भवामहे ..
अस्माभिः प्रतिरुद्धास्ते न द्रक्ष्यंति दिवाकरम् .. 16 ..
text_mt:
Therefore, for their repulse, we shall become foremost attendants;
blocked by us, they will not see the Sun.'

sanskrit_iast:
saṃmaṃtryaivaṃ tataḥ skaṃdo vāmapārśve raveḥ sthitaḥ ..
daṃḍanāyakasaṃjñastu sarvalokasya sa prabhuḥ .. .. 17 ..
meaning:
संमंत्र्यैवं ततः स्कंदो वामपार्श्वे रवेः स्थितः ..
दंडनायकसंज्ञस्तु सर्वलोकस्य स प्रभुः .. .. 17 ..
text_mt:
Having consulted thus, Skanda then stood on the left side of the Sun,
known as Daṇḍanāyaka, the lord of all the world.

sanskrit_iast:
uktaśca sa tadārkeṇa tvaṃ prajādaṃḍanāyakaḥ ..
daṃḍanītikaro yasmāttasmāttvaṃ daṃḍanāyakaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
उक्तश्च स तदार्केण त्वं प्रजादंडनायकः ..
दंडनीतिकरो यस्मात्तस्मात्त्वं दंडनायकः .. 18 ..
text_mt:
And he was then told by the Sun: 'You are the leader of punishment for creatures;
because you apply the policy of punishment, you are therefore Daṇḍanāyaka.'

sanskrit_iast:
likhate yaḥ prajānāṃ ca sukṛtaṃ yacca duṣkṛtam ..
agnirdakṣiṇapārśve tu piṃgalatvātsa piṃgalaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
लिखते यः प्रजानां च सुकृतं यच्च दुष्कृतम् ..
अग्निर्दक्षिणपार्श्वे तु पिंगलत्वात्स पिंगलः .. 19 ..
text_mt:
He who records the good deeds and evil deeds of creatures
is Agni on the right side; and because he is reddish-brown, he is Piṅgala.

sanskrit_iast:
āśvinau cāpi sūryasya pārśvayorubhayoḥ sthitau ..
aśvarūpātsamupannau tena tāvaśvinau surau .. 1.124.20 ..
meaning:
आश्विनौ चापि सूर्यस्य पार्श्वयोरुभयोः स्थितौ ..
अश्वरूपात्समुपन्नौ तेन तावश्विनौ सुरौ .. 1.124.20 ..
text_mt:
And the two Aśvins stand on both flanks of the Sun;
they arose from the form of a horse, therefore they are the two gods, the Aśvins.

sanskrit_iast:
dvārapālau smṛtau tasya rājñaḥ śreṣṭhau mahābalau ..
kārttikeyaḥ smṛto rājñaḥ śreṣṭhaścāpi haraḥ smṛtaḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
द्वारपालौ स्मृतौ तस्य राज्ञः श्रेष्ठौ महाबलौ ..
कार्त्तिकेयः स्मृतो राज्ञः श्रेष्ठश्चापि हरः स्मृतः .. 21 ..
text_mt:
His two doorkeepers are known as the kings, the best, possessed of great strength;
Kārttikeya is known as the king, and Hara is also known as the best.

sanskrit_iast:
rājṛdīptau smṛto dhāturnakārastasya pratyayaḥ ..
surasenāpatitvena sa yasmāddīpyate sadā ..
tasmātsa kārtikeyastu nāmnā rājña iti smṛtaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
राजृदीप्तौ स्मृतो धातुर्नकारस्तस्य प्रत्ययः ..
सुरसेनापतित्वेन स यस्माद्दीप्यते सदा ..
तस्मात्स कार्तिकेयस्तु नाम्ना राज्ञ इति स्मृतः .. 22 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sru gatau ca smṛto dhāturyasya sa pratyayaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
gacchatīti rahastasmātparyāyātsrauṣa ucyate .. 23 ..
meaning:
स्रु गतौ च स्मृतो धातुर्यस्य स प्रत्ययः स्मृतः ..
गच्छतीति रहस्तस्मात्पर्यायात्स्रौष उच्यते .. 23 ..
text_mt:
The verbal root *sru* is handed down in the sense of going, and *sa* is considered its suffix;
he moves secretly, and therefore by this synonym he is called Srauṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
prathamaṃ yadbhaveddvāraṃ dharmārthābhyāṃ samāśritam ..
tatraitau saṃsthitau devau lokapūjyau dvijottamāḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
प्रथमं यद्भवेद्द्वारं धर्मार्थाभ्यां समाश्रितम् ..
तत्रैतौ संस्थितौ देवौ लोकपूज्यौ द्विजोत्तमाः .. 24 ..
text_mt:
At the first gate, which is associated with righteousness and prosperity,
these two deities, revered by the worlds, stand, O best of twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyāyāṃ tu kakṣāyāmapradhṛṣṭau vyavasthitau ..
pakṣipretādhipau nāmnā smṛtau kalmāṣapakṣiṇau .. 25 ..
meaning:
द्वितीयायां तु कक्षायामप्रधृष्टौ व्यवस्थितौ ..
पक्षिप्रेताधिपौ नाम्ना स्मृतौ कल्माषपक्षिणौ .. 25 ..
text_mt:
In the second court stand two invincible ones,
the lords of birds and pretas, known by name as Kalmāṣa and Pakṣin.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇasya śabalatvācca yamaḥ kalmāṣa ucyate ..
pakṣāvasyeti yaḥ pakṣī garuḍaḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
वर्णस्य शबलत्वाच्च यमः कल्माष उच्यते ..
पक्षावस्येति यः पक्षी गरुडः परिकीर्तितः .. 26 ..
text_mt:
Because his colour is mottled, Yama is called Kalmāṣa;
he who has wings is Pakṣin, who is proclaimed to be Garuḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
sthito dakṣiṇata tasya daṃḍahastasamanvitaḥ ..
uttareṇa sthito'rkasya kuberaśca vināyakaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
स्थितो दक्षिणत तस्य दंडहस्तसमन्वितः ..
उत्तरेण स्थितोऽर्कस्य कुबेरश्च विनायकः .. 27 ..
text_mt:
Standing to his right with a staff in hand [is Yama];
to the north of the Sun stand Kubera and Vināyaka.

sanskrit_iast:
kubero dhanado jñeyo hastirūpo vināyakaḥ ..
kutsayā kupyatā śaptaṃ kuśarīramajāyata ..
kuberaḥ kuśarīratvātsa nāmnā dhanadaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
कुबेरो धनदो ज्ञेयो हस्तिरूपो विनायकः ..
कुत्सया कुप्यता शप्तं कुशरीरमजायत ..
कुबेरः कुशरीरत्वात्स नाम्ना धनदः स्मृतः .. 28 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nāyakaḥ sarvasattvānāṃ tena nāyaka ucyate ..
vividhaṃ nayate yasmātsa tu tasmādvināyakaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
नायकः सर्वसत्त्वानां तेन नायक उच्यते ..
विविधं नयते यस्मात्स तु तस्माद्विनायकः .. 29 ..
text_mt: He is the leader of all living beings; therefore, he is called Nāyaka. / And because he leads in various ways, he is Vināyaka.

sanskrit_iast:
raivataścaiva diṃḍiśca tau raveḥ pūrvataḥ sthitau ..
tato diṃḍiḥ smṛto rudro revatastanayo raveḥ .. 1.124.30 ..
meaning:
रैवतश्चैव दिंडिश्च तौ रवेः पूर्वतः स्थितौ ..
ततो दिंडिः स्मृतो रुद्रो रेवतस्तनयो रवेः .. 1.124.30 ..
text_mt: And Raivata and Ḍiṇḍi stand to the east of the Sun. / From this, Ḍiṇḍi is understood as Rudra, and Revata as the Sun’s son.

sanskrit_iast:
plutaṃ gacchatyasau yasmātsarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ ..
revṛplavagatau dhātū revatastena sa smṛtaḥ ..31..
meaning:
प्लुतं गच्छत्यसौ यस्मात्सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः ..
रेवृप्लवगतौ धातू रेवतस्तेन स स्मृतः ..31..
text_mt: Because he, bowed to by all the worlds, moves with leaps— / the roots rev and plu signify 'to jump'—he is therefore remembered as Revata.

sanskrit_iast:
ḍīṅgatāvasya vai dhātordiṃḍiśabdo nipātyate ..
ḍayate'sau sadā diṃḍī tena diṃḍī prakīrtitaḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
डीङ्गतावस्य वै धातोर्दिंडिशब्दो निपात्यते ..
डयतेऽसौ सदा दिंडी तेन दिंडी प्रकीर्तितः .. 32 ..
text_mt: Indeed, from the verbal root ḍīṅ, meaning 'to fly', the word ḍiṇḍi is derived as an irregular form. / He constantly flies, hence he is proclaimed as Ḍiṇḍī.

sanskrit_iast:
ityete pravarāḥ proktā dhātvarthā naigamaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
eṣāṃ saṃkṣepato bhūyaḥ saṃkhyāṃ vo nigadāmi vai .. 33 ..
meaning:
इत्येते प्रवराः प्रोक्ता धात्वर्था नैगमैः शुभैः ..
एषां संक्षेपतो भूयः संख्यां वो निगदामि वै .. 33 ..
text_mt: Thus these foremost root-meanings have been declared by auspicious Vedic sages. / Again, I shall now relate their number to you in brief.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvinau tau tato jñeyau daṃḍanāyakapiṃgalau ..
tau sūryadvārapau jñeyau rājñasrauṣau tataḥ smṛtau .. 34 ..
meaning:
अश्विनौ तौ ततो ज्ञेयौ दंडनायकपिंगलौ ..
तौ सूर्यद्वारपौ ज्ञेयौ राज्ञस्रौषौ ततः स्मृतौ .. 34 ..
text_mt: Next are to be known the two Aśvins, Daṇḍanāyaka and Piṅgala; / they are to be known as the Sun’s doorkeepers, and then are remembered as Rājñī and Srauṣā.

sanskrit_iast:
revataścaiva diṃḍiśca ityete pravarā mayā ..
aṣṭādaśa samā khyātāḥ saṃkṣepātsaṃkhyayā mayā .. 35 ..
meaning:
रेवतश्चैव दिंडिश्च इत्येते प्रवरा मया ..
अष्टादश समा ख्याताः संक्षेपात्संख्यया मया .. 35 ..
text_mt: And Revata and Ḍiṇḍi: thus these eighteen foremost ones / have been declared by me in equal measure, counted in summary.

sanskrit_iast:
ityebhirnāmabhistvanye dānavānāṃ jighāṃsayā ..
parivārya sthitāḥ sūryaṃ nānāpraharaṇāyudhāḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
इत्येभिर्नामभिस्त्वन्ये दानवानां जिघांसया ..
परिवार्य स्थिताः सूर्यं नानाप्रहरणायुधाः .. 36 ..
text_mt: Others, bearing various striking weapons, / stand surrounding the Sun under these names with the desire to slay the Dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
sarūpāścānyarūpāśca virūpāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ ..
parivārya sthitāḥ sūryaṃ garuḍaśca mahābalaḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
सरूपाश्चान्यरूपाश्च विरूपाः कामरूपिणः ..
परिवार्य स्थिताः सूर्यं गरुडश्च महाबलः .. 37 ..
text_mt: Bearing similar forms, other forms, deformed, or changing shape at will, / and the mighty Garuḍa—they stand surrounding the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
dhāturdiviti vai prokto krīḍāyāṃ sa tu ucyate ..
krīḍaṃte divi vai yasmāttasmātte daivatāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
धातुर्दिविति वै प्रोक्तो क्रीडायां स तु उच्यते ..
क्रीडंते दिवि वै यस्मात्तस्मात्ते दैवताः स्मृताः .. 38 ..
text_mt: The verbal root div is indeed stated; it is said to mean 'to play'. / Because they play in heaven, they are therefore remembered as deities.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni yānyuktānīha vai mayā ..
nānārūpaiḥ sthitānyeva ravestāni sama ntataḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि यान्युक्तानीह वै मया ..
नानारूपैः स्थितान्येव रवेस्तानि सम न्ततः .. 39 ..
text_mt: The Ṛg, Yajus, and Sāma verses that have been spoken here by me / stand in varied forms all around the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sumaṃturuvāca .. ..
ityevamuktavānbrahmā ṛṣīṇāṃ pṛcchatāṃ purā ..
te śrutvārādhya deveśaṃ saṃsiddhā divi saṃsthitāḥ .. 1.124.40 ..
meaning:
.. सुमंतुरुवाच .. ..
इत्येवमुक्तवान्ब्रह्मा ऋषीणां पृच्छतां पुरा ..
ते श्रुत्वाराध्य देवेशं संसिद्धा दिवि संस्थिताः .. 1.124.40 ..
text_mt: Sumantu said: / Thus Brahmā spoke long ago to the inquiring sages. / Having heard this and worshipped the lord of the gods, they attained perfection and took their place in heaven.

sanskrit_iast: iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe brahmarṣisaṃvāde pravaravarṇanaṃ nāma caturviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 124 .. .. cha .. ..
meaning: इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे ब्रह्मर्षिसंवादे प्रवरवर्णनं नाम चतुर्विंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 124 .. .. छ .. ..
text_mt: Thus ends the one hundred twenty-fourth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Foremost Retinue', in the dialogue between Brahmā and the sages, in the Saptamīkalpa of the Brāhmaparvan in the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śatānīka uvāca .. ..
yadetaddṛśyate vyoma sūryasya purato dvija ..
taducyate kimātmā ca kathaṃbhūtaśca kathyatām .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. शतानीक उवाच .. ..
यदेतद्दृश्यते व्योम सूर्यस्य पुरतो द्विज ..
तदुच्यते किमात्मा च कथंभूतश्च कथ्यताम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śatānīka said: / O twice-born one, this sky which is seen before the Sun— / of what nature is that which is spoken of, and of what kind is it? Please tell.
title: Bhuvanakośavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
.. sumaṃturuvāca .. ..
haṃta vyoma pravakṣyāmi sūryapraharaṇaṃ śubham ..
yadātmakaṃ hi yatproktaṃ yathā vasaṃti devatāḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. सुमंतुरुवाच .. ..
हंत व्योम प्रवक्ष्यामि सूर्यप्रहरणं शुभम् ..
यदात्मकं हि यत्प्रोक्तं यथा वसंति देवताः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Sumantu said: / Indeed, I shall describe the auspicious sky-weapon of the Sun, / of what essence it is declared to be, and how the deities reside there.

sanskrit_iast:
purastācca catuḥśṛṃgaṃ tadvyomāyatanaṃ raveḥ ..
vyomaśabdaṃ catuḥśṛṃgaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ ca yat .. 3 ..
meaning:
पुरस्ताच्च चतुःशृंगं तद्व्योमायतनं रवेः ..
व्योमशब्दं चतुःशृंगं सर्वदेवमयं च यत् .. 3 ..
text_mt: And in the front is that four-pinnacled sky-abode of the Sun, / which is termed 'the sky', has four peaks, and consists of all the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
gairikārṇavasaṃbhūtaṃ yadaṃtargarbhamāśritam ..
tatrotpannamidaṃ vyoma kalervyoma mahī smṛtā .. 4 ..
meaning:
गैरिकार्णवसंभूतं यदंतर्गर्भमाश्रितम् ..
तत्रोत्पन्नमिदं व्योम कलेर्व्योम मही स्मृता .. 4 ..
text_mt: Arisen from the red-ochre ocean, resting in its inner womb, / there this sky was generated; the earth is remembered as the sky of the Kali age.

sanskrit_iast:
varuṇasya yathā pāśo huṅkāro vedhaso yathā ..
viṣṇoścāpi yathā cakraṃ triśūlaṃ tryaṃbakasya ca ..5..
meaning:
वरुणस्य यथा पाशो हुङ्कारो वेधसो यथा ..
विष्णोश्चापि यथा चक्रं त्रिशूलं त्र्यंबकस्य च ..5..
text_mt: As is the noose of Varuṇa, as is the huṅkāra of the Creator, / as is the discus of Viṣṇu, and the trident of Tryambaka,

sanskrit_iast:
indrasya ca yathā vajraṃ tathā vyoma raveḥ smṛtam ..
tasminvyomni trayastriṃśatkrīḍanto yajñiyāḥ surāḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
इन्द्रस्य च यथा वज्रं तथा व्योम रवेः स्मृतम् ..
तस्मिन्व्योम्नि त्रयस्त्रिंशत्क्रीडन्तो यज्ञियाः सुराः .. 6 ..
text_mt: and as is the thunderbolt of Indra, so the sky is remembered as the Sun's weapon. / In that sky, thirty-three sacrificial gods disport themselves:

sanskrit_iast:
haraśca varṣaśuddhaśca tryaṃbakaścāparājitaḥ ..
vṛṣākapiśca śaṃbhuśca kapardī raivatastathā ..
īśvaro bhuvanaścaite rudrā ekādaśa smṛtāḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
हरश्च वर्षशुद्धश्च त्र्यंबकश्चापराजितः ..
वृषाकपिश्च शंभुश्च कपर्दी रैवतस्तथा ..
ईश्वरो भुवनश्चैते रुद्रा एकादश स्मृताः .. 7 ..
text_mt: Hara, Varṣaśuddha, Tryambaka, Aparājita, / Vṛṣākapi, Śambhu, Kapardin, Raivata, / Īśvara, and Bhuvana—these are remembered as the eleven Rudras.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityānāṃ ca nāmāni viṣṇoścakrasya dīyatām ..
aryamā ca tathā mitro bhago'tha varuṇastathā .. 8 ..
meaning:
आदित्यानां च नामानि विष्णोश्चक्रस्य दीयताम् ..
अर्यमा च तथा मित्रो भगोऽथ वरुणस्तथा .. 8 ..
text_mt: And let the names of the Ādityas, belonging to the discus of Viṣṇu, be proclaimed: / Aryaman, Mitra, Bhaga, and Varuṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
vivasvāntsavitā caiva pūṣā tvaṣṭā tathaiva ca ..
aṃśo bhagaścātitejā ādityā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
विवस्वान्त्सविता चैव पूषा त्वष्टा तथैव च ..
अंशो भगश्चातितेजा आदित्या द्वादश स्मृताः .. 9 ..
text_mt: Vivasvat, Savitṛ, Pūṣan, Tvaṣṭṛ, / Aṃśa, and the exceedingly splendid Bhaga—these are remembered as the twelve Ādityas.

sanskrit_iast:
dhruvo dharaśca somaśca āpaścaivā'nilo'nalaḥ .
pratyūṣaśca prabhātaśca vasavo'ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ . . 1.125.10
meaning:
ध्रुवो धरश्च सोमश्च आपश्चैवाऽनिलोऽनलः .
प्रत्यूषश्च प्रभातश्च वसवोऽष्टौ प्रकीर्तिताः . . 1.125.10
text_mt: Dhruva, Dhara, Soma, Āpa, Anila, Anala, / Pratyūṣa, and Prabhāta are proclaimed as the eight Vasus.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsatyaścaiva dasraśca smṛtau dvāvaśvināvubhau .
viśvedevānpravakṣyāmi nāmatastānnibodhata . . 11
meaning:
नासत्यश्चैव दस्रश्च स्मृतौ द्वावश्विनावुभौ .
विश्वेदेवान्प्रवक्ष्यामि नामतस्तान्निबोधत . . 11
text_mt: Nāsatya and Dasra are remembered as the two Aśvins. / I shall declare the Viśvedevas; learn them by name:

sanskrit_iast:
kraturdakṣo vasuḥ satyaḥ kālakāmau dhṛtiḥ kuruḥ .
śaṅkumātro vāmanaśca viśvedevā daśa smṛtāḥ . . 12
meaning:
क्रतुर्दक्षो वसुः सत्यः कालकामौ धृतिः कुरुः .
शङ्कुमात्रो वामनश्च विश्वेदेवा दश स्मृताः . . 12
text_mt: Kratu, Dakṣa, Vasu, Satya, Kāla, Kāma, Dhṛti, Kuru, / Śaṅkumātra, and Vāmana are remembered as the ten Viśvedevas.

sanskrit_iast:
vartamānā ime devā bhaviṣyānantare śṛṇu .
yamaśca tuṣitāścaiva1 vasavo2 vaśavartinaḥ . . 13
meaning:
वर्तमाना इमे देवा भविष्यानन्तरे शृणु .
यमश्च तुषिताश्चैव1 वसवो2 वशवर्तिनः . . 13
text_mt: These are the present gods; hear now about those in future intervals: / the Yamas, Tuṣitas, and Vasus under their control,

sanskrit_iast:
satyāśca bhūtarajasaḥ sādhyāśca tadanantarā .
ṣaṭsu manvantareṣvevaṃ devā dvādaśadvādaśa3 . .
pārāvatāstathā cānye te hyāsaṃstuṣitaiḥ saha . . 14
meaning:
सत्याश्च भूतरजसः साध्याश्च तदनन्तरा .
षट्सु मन्वन्तरेष्वेवं देवा द्वादशद्वादश3 . .
पारावतास्तथा चान्ये ते ह्यासंस्तुषितैः सह . . 14
text_mt: the Satyas, the Bhūtarajases, and next to them the Sādhyas; / thus in six Manu intervals there are twelve gods in each, / and others, the Pārāvatas, who were together with the Tuṣitas.

sanskrit_iast:
sādhyāndevānpravakṣyāmi nāmatastānnibodha me .
mano'numantā prāṇaśca naro nārāyaṇastathā . . 15
meaning:
साध्यान्देवान्प्रवक्ष्यामि नामतस्तान्निबोध मे .
मनोऽनुमन्ता प्राणश्च नरो नारायणस्तथा . . 15
text_mt: I shall declare the Sādhya gods; learn them from me by name: / Manas, Anumantṛ, Prāṇa, Nara, Nārāyaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛttilambo manuścaiva samo4 dharmaśca vīryavān .
vittasvāmī prabhuścaiva sādhyā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ . . 16
meaning:
वृत्तिलम्बो मनुश्चैव समो4 धर्मश्च वीर्यवान् .
वित्तस्वामी प्रभुश्चैव साध्या द्वादश कीर्तिताः . . 16
text_mt: Vṛttilamba, Manu, Sama, and the valiant Dharma, / Vittasvāmin, and Prabhu are proclaimed as the twelve Sādhyas.

sanskrit_iast:
ete yajñabhujo devāḥ sarvalokeṣu pūjitāḥ .
ādityāmeva te dhīra kaśyapasyātmajāḥ smṛtāḥ . . 17
meaning:
एते यज्ञभुजो देवाः सर्वलोकेषु पूजिताः .
आदित्यामेव ते धीर कश्यपस्यात्मजाः स्मृताः . . 17
text_mt: These sacrifice-enjoying gods are worshipped in all the worlds. / In the solar line, O wise one, they are remembered as the sons of Kaśyapa.

sanskrit_iast:
viśve ca vasavaḥ sādhyā vijñeyā dharmasūnavaḥ .
evaṃ dharmasutaḥ somastṛtīyo vasuriṣyate . . 18
meaning:
विश्वे च वसवः साध्या विज्ञेया धर्मसूनवः .
एवं धर्मसुतः सोमस्तृतीयो वसुरिष्यते . . 18
text_mt: The Viśvedevas, Vasus, and Sādhyas are to be known as sons of Dharma. / Thus Soma, the third Vasu, is considered the son of Dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmo'pi brahmaṇaḥ putraḥ purāṇe niścayaṃ gataḥ .
atha cendrānvasūṃścaiva nāmabhiśca nibodha me . . 19
meaning:
धर्मोऽपि ब्रह्मणः पुत्रः पुराणे निश्चयं गतः .
अथ चेन्द्रान्वसूंश्चैव नामभिश्च निबोध मे . . 19
text_mt: Dharma is also established in the Purāṇa as the son of Brahmā. / Now learn from me the Indras and Vasus by their names.

sanskrit_iast:
svāyambhuvo manuḥ pūrvaḥ tataḥ svārociṣaḥ smṛtaḥ .
uttamastāmasaścaiva raivataścākṣuṣastathā . . 1.125.20
meaning:
स्वायम्भुवो मनुः पूर्वः ततः स्वारोचिषः स्मृतः .
उत्तमस्तामसश्चैव रैवतश्चाक्षुषस्तथा . . 1.125.20
text_mt: First was Svāyambhuva Manu, then Svārociṣa is remembered, / Uttama, Tāmasa, Raivata, and Cākṣuṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
ityete ṣaḍatikrāntāḥ saptamaḥ sāmprato manuḥ .
vaivasvateti vijñeyo bhaviṣyāḥ sapta cāpare . . 21
meaning:
इत्येते षडतिक्रान्ताः सप्तमः साम्प्रतो मनुः .
वैवस्वतेति विज्ञेयो भविष्याः सप्त चापरे . . 21
text_mt: These six have passed away; the seventh is the present Manu, / who is to be known as Vaivasvata; and seven others are future.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣāmādyorkasāvarṇirbrahmasāvarṇireva ca .
tasmācca bhavasāvarṇirdharmasāvarṇirityuta . . 22
meaning:
एषामाद्योर्कसावर्णिर्ब्रह्मसावर्णिरेव च .
तस्माच्च भवसावर्णिर्धर्मसावर्णिरित्युत . . 22
text_mt: The first of these is Arkasāvarṇi, then Brahmasāvarṇi, / and after that Bhavasāvarṇi, and Dharmasāvarṇi,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamo dakṣasāvarṇiḥ sāvarṇiḥ5 pañca kīrtitāḥ .
raucyo bhauvyaśca dvāvanyāvityete manavaḥ smṛtāḥ . . 23
meaning:
पञ्चमो दक्षसावर्णिः सावर्णिः5 पञ्च कीर्तिताः .
रौच्यो भौव्यश्च द्वावन्यावित्येते मनवः स्मृताः . . 23
text_mt: and the fifth is Dakṣasāvarṇi—these five Sāvarṇis are proclaimed; / Raucya and Bhauvya are the two others: thus these Manus are remembered.

sanskrit_iast:
indrastu viṣṇubhugjñeyo vidyutistadanantaram .
vibhuḥ prabhuścaiva śikhī tathaiva ca manojavaḥ . . 24
meaning:
इन्द्रस्तु विष्णुभुग्ज्ञेयो विद्युतिस्तदनन्तरम् .
विभुः प्रभुश्चैव शिखी तथैव च मनोजवः . . 24
text_mt: Indra is to be known as Viṣṇubhuj, and after that Vidyuti, / Vibhu, Prabhu, Śikhin, and Manojava,

sanskrit_iast:
ojasvī sāmpratisvindro balirbhāvyastataḥ param .
adbhutastridivaścaiva daśamastvindra ucyate . . 25
meaning:
ओजस्वी साम्प्रतिस्विन्द्रो बलिर्भाव्यस्ततः परम् .
अद्भुतस्त्रिदिवश्चैव दशमस्त्विन्द्र उच्यते . . 25
text_mt: and Ojasvin is the present Indra; Bali is to be the next after him; / then Adbhuta, and Tridiva is said to be the tenth Indra,

sanskrit_iast:
susāttvikaśca1 kīrtiśca śatadhāmā2 divaspatiḥ .
iti bhūtā bhaviṣyāśca indrā jñeyāścaturdaśa . . 26
meaning:
सुसात्त्विकश्च1 कीर्तिश्च शतधामा2 दिवस्पतिः .
इति भूता भविष्याश्च इन्द्रा ज्ञेयाश्चतुर्दश . . 26
text_mt: Susāttvika, Kīrti, Śatadhāman, and Divaspati. / Thus fourteen past and future Indras are to be known.

sanskrit_iast:
kaśyapo'trirvaśiṣṭhaśca bharadvājaśca gautamaḥ .
viśvāmitro jamadagniḥ saptaite ṛṣayaḥ smṛtāḥ . . 27
meaning:
कश्यपोऽत्रिर्वशिष्ठश्च भरद्वाजश्च गौतमः .
विश्वामित्रो जमदग्निः सप्तैते ऋषयः स्मृताः . . 27
text_mt: Kaśyapa, Atri, Vasiṣṭha, Bharadvāja, Gautama, / Viśvāmitra, and Jamadagni—these are remembered as the seven sages.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi maruto'gniparigrahān .
pravahothāvahaścaiva udvahaḥ saṃvahastathā . . 28
meaning:
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि मरुतोऽग्निपरिग्रहान् .
प्रवहोथावहश्चैव उद्वहः संवहस्तथा . . 28
text_mt: Henceforth I shall declare the Maruts, who are attendants of fire: / Pravaha, then Āvaha, Udvaha, Saṃvaha,

sanskrit_iast:
vivaho nivahaścaiva parivāhastathaiva ca .
antarikṣacarā3 hyete pṛthaṅmārgavisāriṇaḥ . . 29
meaning:
विवहो निवहश्चैव परिवाहस्तथैव च .
अन्तरिक्षचरा3 ह्येते पृथङ्मार्गविसारिणः . . 29
text_mt: Vivaha, Nivaha, and likewise Parivāha; / for these roam in the atmosphere, spreading along separate paths.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryo'gniśca śucirnāmnā vaidyutaḥ pāvakaḥ smṛtaḥ .
nirmanthaḥ pavamāno'gnistrayaḥ proktā imegnayaḥ . . 1.125.30
meaning:
सूर्योऽग्निश्च शुचिर्नाम्ना वैद्युतः पावकः स्मृतः .
निर्मन्थः पवमानोऽग्निस्त्रयः प्रोक्ता इमेग्नयः . . 1.125.30
text_mt:
The solar fire is named Śuci, the lightning [fire] is known as Pāvaka,
and the fire produced by friction is Pavamāna; these three fires are declared.

sanskrit_iast:
agnīnāṃ putrapautrāstu catvāriṃśattathaiva tu .
marutāmapi sarveṣāṃ vijñeyāḥ saptasaptakāḥ . . 31
meaning:
अग्नीनां पुत्रपौत्रास्तु चत्वारिंशत्तथैव तु .
मरुतामपि सर्वेषां विज्ञेयाः सप्तसप्तकाः . . 31
text_mt:
The sons and grandsons of the fires are forty;
and all the Maruts should be known as seven groups of seven.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtuḥ saṃvatsaro'hyagnirṛtavastasya jajñire .
ṛtuputrāśca vai pañca iti sargaḥ sanātanaḥ . . 32
meaning:
ऋतुः संवत्सरोऽह्यग्निरृतवस्तस्य जज्ञिरे .
ऋतुपुत्राश्च वै पञ्च इति सर्गः सनातनः . . 32
text_mt:
The season is the year, fire indeed; the seasons were born from it.
And the sons of the seasons are five; such is the eternal creation.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsarastu prathamo dvitīyaḥ parivatsaraḥ .
idvatsarastṛtīyastu caturthastvanuvatsaraḥ . . 33
meaning:
संवत्सरस्तु प्रथमो द्वितीयः परिवत्सरः .
इद्वत्सरस्तृतीयस्तु चतुर्थस्त्वनुवत्सरः . . 33
text_mt:
The first is Saṃvatsara, the second Parivatsara,
the third is Idvatsara, and the fourth is Anuvatsara.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamo vatsarasteṣāmityevaṃ pañca te smṛtāḥ .
teṣu saṃvatsaro hyagniḥ sūryastu parivatsaraḥ . . 34
meaning:
पञ्चमो वत्सरस्तेषामित्येवं पञ्च ते स्मृताः .
तेषु संवत्सरो ह्यग्निः सूर्यस्तु परिवत्सरः . . 34
text_mt:
The fifth of them is Vatsara; thus these five are remembered.
Among them, Saṃvatsara is fire, and Parivatsara is the Sun;

sanskrit_iast:
soma idvatsarasteṣāṃ vāyuścaivānuvatsaraḥ .
rudrastu vatsaro jñeyaḥ pañcaitā ' yugadevatāḥ . . 35
meaning:
सोम इद्वत्सरस्तेषां वायुश्चैवानुवत्सरः .
रुद्रस्तु वत्सरो ज्ञेयः पञ्चैता ' युगदेवताः . . 35
text_mt:
Soma is their Idvatsara, and Vāyu is Anuvatsara;
Rudra should be known as Vatsara: these are the five deities of the [five-year] cycle.

sanskrit_iast:
ārtavā pitaro jñeyā ye jātāḥ ṛtusūnavaḥ .
pitāmahāstu vijñeyāḥ pañcābdā brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ . . 36
meaning:
आर्तवा पितरो ज्ञेया ये जाताः ऋतुसूनवः .
पितामहास्तु विज्ञेयाः पञ्चाब्दा ब्रह्मणः सुताः . . 36
text_mt:
The sons of the seasons who were born are to be known as the Ārtava ancestors;
and the five years, sons of Brahmā, are to be known as the grandfathers.

sanskrit_iast:
saumyā barhiṣadaścaiva agniṣvāttāśca ye trayaḥ .
ete vai pitarasteṣāṃ ye jīvatpitṛkā narāḥ . . 37
meaning:
सौम्या बर्हिषदश्चैव अग्निष्वात्ताश्च ये त्रयः .
एते वै पितरस्तेषां ये जीवत्पितृका नराः . . 37
text_mt:
The Saumyas, the Barhiṣads, and the Agniṣvāttas are the three [groups];
these indeed are the ancestors for those men whose fathers are still living.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityaścaiva somaśca lohitāṅgo budhastathā .
bṛhaspatiśca śukraśca tathā helisutaśca yaḥ . . 38
meaning:
आदित्यश्चैव सोमश्च लोहिताङ्गो बुधस्तथा .
बृहस्पतिश्च शुक्रश्च तथा हेलिसुतश्च यः . . 38
text_mt:
Āditya, Soma, Lohitāṅga, and Budha,
Bṛhaspati, Śukra, and he who is the son of Heli [the Sun],

sanskrit_iast:
uparāgaḥ śikhī cobhau navaite nu grahāḥ smṛtāḥ .
trailokyasya tvime nityaṃ bhāvābhāvanivedakāḥ . . 39
meaning:
उपरागः शिखी चोभौ नवैते नु ग्रहाः स्मृताः .
त्रैलोक्यस्य त्विमे नित्यं भावाभावनिवेदकाः . . 39
text_mt:
along with both Uparāga [Rāhu] and Śikhin [Ketu]—these nine are remembered as the planets;
these perpetually announce the fortune and misfortune of the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityaścaiva somaśca dvāvetau maṇḍalagrahau .
rāhuśchāyāgrahasteṣāṃ śeṣāstārā grahāḥ smṛtāḥ . .1.125.4 0
nakṣatrādhipatiḥ somo graharājo divākaraḥ .
paṭhyate cāgnirāditya udakaścandramāḥ smṛtaḥ . . 41
meaning:
आदित्यश्चैव सोमश्च द्वावेतौ मण्डलग्रहौ .
राहुश्छायाग्रहस्तेषां शेषास्तारा ग्रहाः स्मृताः . .1.125.4 0
नक्षत्राधिपतिः सोमो ग्रहराजो दिवाकरः .
पठ्यते चाग्निरादित्य उदकश्चन्द्रमाः स्मृतः . . 41

sanskrit_iast:
ādityaḥ paṭhyate brahmā viṣṇusteṣāṃ tu candramāḥ .
maheśvarastu vijñeyastṛtīyastārakagrahaḥ . . 42
meaning:
आदित्यः पठ्यते ब्रह्मा विष्णुस्तेषां तु चन्द्रमाः .
महेश्वरस्तु विज्ञेयस्तृतीयस्तारकग्रहः . . 42
text_mt:
Āditya is recited as Brahmā, and the Moon among them as Viṣṇu;
and Maheśvara is to be known as the third, the star-planets.

sanskrit_iast:
kaśyapasya sutaḥ sūryaḥ somo dharmasutaḥ smṛtaḥ .
devāsuragurū dvau tu nāmatastau1 mahāgrahau . . 43
meaning:
कश्यपस्य सुतः सूर्यः सोमो धर्मसुतः स्मृतः .
देवासुरगुरू द्वौ तु नामतस्तौ1 महाग्रहौ . . 43
text_mt:
Sūrya is the son of Kaśyapa, Soma is recorded as the son of Dharma;
the two teachers of gods and demons are celebrated by name as great planets.

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpatisutāvetāvubhau śukrabṛhaspatī .
budhaḥ somātmajaḥ śrīmāñchanī ravisutaḥ smṛtaḥ . . 44
meaning:
प्रजापतिसुतावेतावुभौ शुक्रबृहस्पती .
बुधः सोमात्मजः श्रीमाञ्छनी रविसुतः स्मृतः . . 44
text_mt:
Both of these, Śukra and Bṛhaspati, are sons of Prajāpati;
splendid Budha is the son of Soma, and Śani is recorded as the son of Ravi.

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhikāyāḥ suto rāhuḥ ketustu brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ .
sarveṣāṃ ca grahāṇāṃ hi adhastāccarate raviḥ . . 45
meaning:
सिंहिकायाः सुतो राहुः केतुस्तु ब्रह्मणः सुतः .
सर्वेषां च ग्रहाणां हि अधस्ताच्चरते रविः . . 45
text_mt:
Rāhu is the son of Siṃhikā, while Ketu is the son of Brahmā;
and Ravi travels beneath all the planets.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dūraṃ smṛtaṃ tāvadvidhornakṣatramaṇḍalam .
nakṣatrebhyaḥ kujabudhau śvetāhvastadanantaram . . 46
meaning:
ततो दूरं स्मृतं तावद्विधोर्नक्षत्रमण्डलम् .
नक्षत्रेभ्यः कुजबुधौ श्वेताह्वस्तदनन्तरम् . . 46
text_mt:
Above that is recorded the sphere of the Moon's asterisms at such a distance;
above the asterisms are Mars and Mercury, and next is he named Śveta [Venus].

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānmāheśvaraścorddhvaṃ dhiṣaṇastadanantaram .
kṛṣṇaścordhvaṃ tatastasmādatha citraśikhaṇḍijaḥ . . 47
meaning:
तस्मान्माहेश्वरश्चोर्द्ध्वं धिषणस्तदनन्तरम् .
कृष्णश्चोर्ध्वं ततस्तस्मादथ चित्रशिखण्डिजः . . 47
text_mt:
Above that is Māheśvara [Jupiter], and next is Dhiṣaṇa;
then above that is Kṛṣṇa [Saturn], and after that the offspring of the Citraśikhaṇḍins [the Seven Sages].

sanskrit_iast:
eṣāmeva kramaḥ proktāścāsaktaṃ tridivaṃ dhruve .
ādityanilayo rāhuḥ kadācitsomamārgagaḥ . . 48
meaning:
एषामेव क्रमः प्रोक्ताश्चासक्तं त्रिदिवं ध्रुवे .
आदित्यनिलयो राहुः कदाचित्सोममार्गगः . . 48
text_mt:
This order of them has been declared, and heaven is fixed to Dhruva;
Rāhu has his abode in the Sun, and sometimes he travels in the path of the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryamaṇḍalasaṃsthastu1 śikhī sarpati sarvadā .
navayojanasāhasro vistāro bhārgavasya2 tu . . 49
meaning:
सूर्यमण्डलसंस्थस्तु1 शिखी सर्पति सर्वदा .
नवयोजनसाहस्रो विस्तारो भार्गवस्य2 तु . . 49
text_mt:
Resting within the Sun's disk, Śikhin creeps continuously;
the diameter of Bhārgava is nine thousand yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
dviguṇaḥ sūryavistārādvistāraḥ śaninaḥ smṛtaḥ .
triguṇaṃ3 maṃḍalaṃ jñeyaṃ nākṣatraṃ vistarādvidhoḥ . . 1.125.50
meaning:
द्विगुणः सूर्यविस्ताराद्विस्तारः शनिनः स्मृतः .
त्रिगुणं3 मंडलं ज्ञेयं नाक्षत्रं विस्तराद्विधोः . . 1.125.50
text_mt:
The diameter of Saturn is recorded as twice the diameter of the Sun;
the asterism sphere should be known as three times the diameter of the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatramaṇḍalāttatra pādahīno bṛhaspatiḥ .
bṛhaspateḥ pādahīnaḥ śukroṅgāraka eva hi . . 51
meaning:
नक्षत्रमण्डलात्तत्र पादहीनो बृहस्पतिः .
बृहस्पतेः पादहीनः शुक्रोङ्गारक एव हि . . 51
text_mt:
Bṛhaspati is one quarter less than the sphere of asterisms;
Śukra is one quarter less than Bṛhaspati, and so is Aṅgāraka [Mars].

sanskrit_iast:
vistāro maṇḍalānāṃ tu pādahīnastayorbudhaḥ .
budhatulyāni ṛkṣāṇi sarvaṛkṣāṇi yāni tu . . 52
meaning:
विस्तारो मण्डलानां तु पादहीनस्तयोर्बुधः .
बुधतुल्यानि ऋक्षाणि सर्वऋक्षाणि यानि तु . . 52
text_mt:
Budha is one quarter less in diameter than the disks of those two;
all the lunar asterisms are equal in size to Budha.

sanskrit_iast:
yojanānyardhamātrāṇi tebhyo hrasvaṃ na vidyate .
rāhuḥ sūryapramāṇaśca kadācitsomasannibhaḥ . . 53
meaning:
योजनान्यर्धमात्राणि तेभ्यो ह्रस्वं न विद्यते .
राहुः सूर्यप्रमाणश्च कदाचित्सोमसन्निभः . . 53
text_mt:
They measure merely half a yojana; none is found smaller than them;
Rāhu is equal in measure to the Sun, and sometimes he resembles the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatragrahamānastu1 ketustvaniyataḥ smṛtaḥ .
avijñātagatiścaiva cañcalatvannarādhipa . . 54
meaning:
नक्षत्रग्रहमानस्तु1 केतुस्त्वनियतः स्मृतः .
