अविज्ञातगतिश्चैव चञ्चलत्वन्नराधिप . . 54
text_mt:
The size of Ketu as a star-planet is remembered as irregular,
and his course is unknown because of his restlessness, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
tathālakṣitarūpastu bahurūpadharo hi saḥ .
bhūrlokaḥ pṛthivī proktā antarikṣaṃ bhuvaḥ smṛtam . . 55
meaning:
तथालक्षितरूपस्तु बहुरूपधरो हि सः .
भूर्लोकः पृथिवी प्रोक्ता अन्तरिक्षं भुवः स्मृतम् . . 55
text_mt:
Indeed, his form is imperceptible, for he assumes many forms.
Bhūrloka is said to be the earth, and the intermediate region is remembered as Bhuvas.

sanskrit_iast:
svarlokastridivaṃ jñeyaṃ śeṣādūrdhvaṃ yathākramam .
bhūpatistu sadā tvagnistenāsau bhūpatiḥ smṛtaḥ . . 56
meaning:
स्वर्लोकस्त्रिदिवं ज्ञेयं शेषादूर्ध्वं यथाक्रमम् .
भूपतिस्तु सदा त्वग्निस्तेनासौ भूपतिः स्मृतः . . 56
text_mt:
Svarloka is to be known as heaven, and above the rest in regular order;
fire is always the lord of the earth, therefore he is remembered as Bhūpati.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyurnabhaspatistena tathā sūryo divaspatiḥ .
gandharvāpsarasaścaiva guhyakāḥ siddharākṣasāḥ . .57
meaning:
वायुर्नभस्पतिस्तेन तथा सूर्यो दिवस्पतिः .
गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव गुह्यकाः सिद्धराक्षसाः . .57
text_mt:
By that [rule] Vāyu is lord of the atmosphere, and likewise the Sun is lord of heaven.
Gandharvas, apsarases, guhyakas, siddhas, and rākṣasas

sanskrit_iast:
bhūrlokavāsinaḥ sarve antarikṣacarāñchṛṇu .
marutaḥ saptamaskaṃdhe rudrāstatraiva cāśvinau . .58
meaning:
भूर्लोकवासिनः सर्वे अन्तरिक्षचराञ्छृणु .
मरुतः सप्तमस्कंधे रुद्रास्तत्रैव चाश्विनौ . .58
text_mt:
are all inhabitants of Bhūrloka; now hear of those who move in the intermediate region:
the Maruts in the seventh wind-level, and there too the Rudras and the two Aśvins,

sanskrit_iast:
ādityā vasavaḥ sarve tathaiva ca gavāṃ gaṇāḥ .
caturthe tu maharloke vasante kalpavāsinaḥ . .5 9
prajānāṃ patibhiḥ sarveḥ sahitāḥ kurunandana .
janaloke pañcame ca vasante bhūmidāḥ sadā . . 1.125.60
meaning:
आदित्या वसवः सर्वे तथैव च गवां गणाः .
चतुर्थे तु महर्लोके वसन्ते कल्पवासिनः . .5 9
प्रजानां पतिभिः सर्वेः सहिताः कुरुनन्दन .
जनलोके पञ्चमे च वसन्ते भूमिदाः सदा . . 1.125.60
text_mt:
all the Ādityas and the Vasus, and likewise the herds of cattle.
In the fourth realm, Maharloka, dwell the inhabitants of the kalpa,
together with all the lords of creatures, O scion of the Kurus;
and in Janaloka, the fifth, givers of land dwell perpetually,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtuḥ sanatkumārādyā vairājabhra tathāśrayāḥ .
satyastu saptame loke hyapunarmārgagāminām . . 61
meaning:
ऋतुः सनत्कुमाराद्या वैराजभ्र तथाश्रयाः .
सत्यस्तु सप्तमे लोके ह्यपुनर्मार्गगामिनाम् . . 61
text_mt:
along with the season, Sanatkumāra and the others who take refuge in the luminous sphere of Vairāja;
and the realm of Satya is the seventh world for those who go on the path of non-return.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmalokaḥ samākhyāto hyapratīghātalakṣaṇaḥ .
itihāsavido yatra krīḍante kurunandana . . 62
meaning:
ब्रह्मलोकः समाख्यातो ह्यप्रतीघातलक्षणः .
इतिहासविदो यत्र क्रीडन्ते कुरुनन्दन . . 62
text_mt:
It is proclaimed as Brahmaloka, characterised by unobstructedness,
where knowers of traditional history disport themselves, O scion of the Kurus,

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇvanti ca purāṇāni ye sadā bhīmanaṃdana .
mahītalātsahasrāṇāṃ śatādūrdhvaṃ divākaraḥ . . 63
meaning:
शृण्वन्ति च पुराणानि ये सदा भीमनंदन .
महीतलात्सहस्राणां शतादूर्ध्वं दिवाकरः . . 63
text_mt:
and those who continually listen to the Purāṇas, O son of Bhīma.
The Sun is a hundred thousand [yojanas] above the surface of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
śatayojanakoṭyastu1 bhūmerūrdhvaṃ dhruvaḥ sthitaḥ .
tato viṃśatilakṣastu trailokyotsedha ucyate . . 64
meaning:
शतयोजनकोट्यस्तु1 भूमेरूर्ध्वं ध्रुवः स्थितः .
ततो विंशतिलक्षस्तु त्रैलोक्योत्सेध उच्यते . . 64
text_mt:
Dhruva is situated a hundred crore yojanas above the earth;
the height of the three worlds is said to be twenty hundred thousand beyond that.

sanskrit_iast:
dviguṇaistu sahasraistu yojanānāṃ śateṣu ca .
lokāṃtaramatho caivaṃ dhruvādūrdhvaṃ vidhīyate . . 65
meaning:
द्विगुणैस्तु सहस्रैस्तु योजनानां शतेषु च .
लोकांतरमथो चैवं ध्रुवादूर्ध्वं विधीयते . . 65
text_mt:
By twice that number of thousands and hundreds of yojanas,
another world above Dhruva is thus ordained.

sanskrit_iast:
devadānavagandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ .
bhūtā vidyādharāścaiva aṣṭau te devayonayaḥ . . 66
meaning:
देवदानवगन्धर्वा यक्षराक्षसपन्नगाः .
भूता विद्याधराश्चैव अष्टौ ते देवयोनयः . . 66
text_mt:
Gods, dānavas, gandharvas, yakṣas, rākṣasas, and serpents,
ghosts, and vidyādharas—these are the eight classes of divine beings.

sanskrit_iast:
yasminvyomni tvime lokāḥ sapta vai sampratiṣṭhitāḥ .
marutaḥ pitaro hyete tasminnevāgnayo grahāḥ . . 67
meaning:
यस्मिन्व्योम्नि त्विमे लोकाः सप्त वै सम्प्रतिष्ठिताः .
मरुतः पितरो ह्येते तस्मिन्नेवाग्नयो ग्रहाः . . 67
text_mt:
In that very space where these seven worlds are established,
the Maruts, the ancestors, the fires, and the planets reside.

sanskrit_iast:
yāstvapyetāḥ samākhyātā mayāṣṭau devayonayaḥ .
mūrtāścāmūrtayaścaiva sarvāstā vyomni saṃsthitāḥ . . 6 8
evaṃvidhamidaṃ vyoma sarvavyomamayaṃ smṛtam .
sarvadevamayaṃ caiva sarvagrahamayaṃ tathā . . 69
meaning:
यास्त्वप्येताः समाख्याता मयाष्टौ देवयोनयः .
मूर्ताश्चामूर्तयश्चैव सर्वास्ता व्योम्नि संस्थिताः . . 6 8
एवंविधमिदं व्योम सर्वव्योममयं स्मृतम् .
सर्वदेवमयं चैव सर्वग्रहमयं तथा . . 69
text_mt:
And these eight classes of divine beings that have been spoken of by me,
both corporeal and incorporeal, are all situated in space.
Such is this space, remembered as consisting of all space,
consisting of all deities, and consisting of all planets.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādyo hyarcayedvyoma tena sarve'rcitāḥ surāḥ .
tasmātsarvaprayatnena śubhārthī vyoma cārcayet . . 1.125.70
meaning:
तस्माद्यो ह्यर्चयेद्व्योम तेन सर्वेऽर्चिताः सुराः .
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन शुभार्थी व्योम चार्चयेत् . . 1.125.70
text_mt:
Therefore, whoever worships space has worshipped all the gods;
therefore, one who desires what is auspicious should worship space with every effort.

sanskrit_iast:
yastvarcate sadā vyoma bhaktyā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ .
vṛṣadhvajasado rājansa gacchennātra saṃśayaḥ . . 71
vyomamāhātmyavarṇanam
meaning:
यस्त्वर्चते सदा व्योम भक्त्या श्रद्धासमन्वितः .
वृषध्वजसदो राजन्स गच्छेन्नात्र संशयः . . 71
व्योममाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
text_mt:
He who always worships space with devotion, endowed with faith,
goes to the realm of the Bull-bannered [Śiva], O king; of this there is no doubt.
Description of the Praise of Space

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
ākāśaṃ khaṃ diśo vyoma antarikṣaṃ nabho'mbaram .
puṣkaraṃ gaganaṃ merurvipulaṃ ca bilaṃ tathā . . 1
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
आकाशं खं दिशो व्योम अन्तरिक्षं नभोऽम्बरम् .
पुष्करं गगनं मेरुर्विपुलं च बिलं तथा . . 1
text_mt:
Sumantu said:
Ākāśa, kha, diś, vyoman, antarikṣa, nabhas, ambara,
puṣkara, gagana, meru, vipula, bila,
title: Vyomamāhātmyavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
āpochidraṃ tathā śūnyaṃ tamo vai rodasī tathā .
nāmānyetāni te vyomnaḥ kīrtitāni mahīpate . . 2
meaning:
आपोछिद्रं तथा शून्यं तमो वै रोदसी तथा .
नामान्येतानि ते व्योम्नः कीर्तितानि महीपते . . 2
text_mt:
āpas, chidra, śūnya, tamas, and rodasī:
these names of space have been declared to you, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
lavaṇakṣīradadhyamlaghṛtamadhvikṣavastathā .
svādūdakaśca saptaite samudrāḥ parikīrtitāḥ . . 3
meaning:
लवणक्षीरदध्यम्लघृतमध्विक्षवस्तथा .
स्वादूदकश्च सप्तैते समुद्राः परिकीर्तिताः . . 3
text_mt: Salt water, milk, curd, sour gruel, clarified butter, wine, and sugarcane juice, / and fresh water: these seven oceans are proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
himavānhemakūṭaśca niṣadho nīla eva ca .
śvetaśca śṛṅgavāṃścaiva ṣaḍete varṣaparvatāḥ . .4
meaning:
हिमवान्हेमकूटश्च निषधो नील एव च .
श्वेतश्च शृङ्गवांश्चैव षडेते वर्षपर्वताः . .4
text_mt: Himavān, Hemakūṭa, Niṣadha, Nīla, / Śveta, and Śṛṅgavān: these six are the boundary mountains of the continents.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyasaṃsthastathaiteṣāṃ mahārājataparvataḥ .
māhendrī cāpyathāgneyī yāmyā ca nairṛtī tathā . . 5
meaning:
मध्यसंस्थस्तथैतेषां महाराजतपर्वतः .
माहेन्द्री चाप्यथाग्नेयी याम्या च नैरृती तथा . . 5
text_mt: And situated in their center is the great golden mountain [Meru]. / Then the cities of Indra, Agni, Yama, and Nirṛti,

sanskrit_iast:
vāruṇī cātha vāyavyā saumyaiśānī tathaiva ca .
etāḥ puryastu devānāṃ tathopari samāśritāḥ . . 6
meaning:
वारुणी चाथ वायव्या सौम्यैशानी तथैव च .
एताः पुर्यस्तु देवानां तथोपरि समाश्रिताः . . 6
text_mt: of Varuṇa, Vāyu, Soma, and Īśāna— / these cities of the gods are situated above it.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyāṃ tu sthito vīra lokālokastu parvataḥ .
tataścaṇḍakapālaṃ tu tasmāttatparatastu yaḥ . . 7
meaning:
पृथिव्यां तु स्थितो वीर लोकालोकस्तु पर्वतः .
ततश्चण्डकपालं तु तस्मात्तत्परतस्तु यः . . 7
text_mt: O hero, the mountain Lokāloka stands on the earth. / Beyond that is the shell of the cosmic egg, and beyond that what follows:

sanskrit_iast:
tato'gnirvāyurākāśaṃ tato bhūtādirucyate .
tato mahānahaṅkāraḥ prakṛtiḥ puruṣastataḥ . . 8
meaning:
ततोऽग्निर्वायुराकाशं ततो भूतादिरुच्यते .
ततो महानहङ्कारः प्रकृतिः पुरुषस्ततः . . 8
text_mt: then fire, wind, space; then the origin of the elements is declared; / then the great principle [Mahat], egoism, primal nature [Prakṛti], and then the spirit [Puruṣa].

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣādīśvaro śreya īśvareṇāvrṛtaṃ jagat .
īśvaro bhagavanbhānustenedaṃ pūritaṃ jagat . . 9
meaning:
पुरुषादीश्वरो श्रेय ईश्वरेणाव्रृतं जगत् .
ईश्वरो भगवन्भानुस्तेनेदं पूरितं जगत् . . 9
text_mt: Beyond the spirit, Īśvara is to be known; by Īśvara the universe is pervaded. / Īśvara is the blessed Sun; by him this universe is filled,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrāṃśurmahātejāścaturbāhurmahābalaḥ .
ūrdhvamapyatha lokāstu prāṅmayā ye prakīrtitāḥ . . 1.126.10
meaning:
सहस्रांशुर्महातेजाश्चतुर्बाहुर्महाबलः .
ऊर्ध्वमप्यथ लोकास्तु प्राङ्मया ये प्रकीर्तिताः . . 1.126.10
text_mt: the thousand-rayed, immensely radiant, four-armed, of great might. / And the upper worlds which were proclaimed by me before,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyastānsampravakṣyāmi aṇḍāvaraṇakārakān .
bhūrlokastubhuvarlokastṛtīyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ . . 11
meaning:
भूयस्तान्सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि अण्डावरणकारकान् .
भूर्लोकस्तुभुवर्लोकस्तृतीयः परिकीर्तितः . . 11
text_mt: I shall declare them again, which form the coverings of the egg: / Bhūrloka, Bhuvarloka, and the third is declared [Svarloka],

sanskrit_iast:
maharjanastapaḥ satyaḥ saptalokāḥ prakīrtitāḥ .
1tatastavaṃḍakapālaṃ tu tasmācca parastapaḥ . . 12
meaning:
महर्जनस्तपः सत्यः सप्तलोकाः प्रकीर्तिताः .
1ततस्तवंडकपालं तु तस्माच्च परस्तपः . . 12
text_mt: Maharloka, Janaloka, Tapoloka, and Satyaloka—seven worlds are declared. / Beyond them is the shell of the cosmic egg, and beyond that is the supreme [enveloping principle]:

sanskrit_iast:
tato'gnirvāyurākāśaṃ tato bhūtādirucyate .
tato mahānpradhānaśca prakṛtipuruṣastataḥ . . 13
meaning:
ततोऽग्निर्वायुराकाशं ततो भूतादिरुच्यते .
ततो महान्प्रधानश्च प्रकृतिपुरुषस्ततः . . 13
text_mt: then fire, wind, space; then the origin of the elements is declared; / then the great principle and Pradhāna, and then Prakṛti and Puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣādīśvaro jñeya īśvareṇāvṛtaṃ jagat .
bhūmeradhastātsaptaiva lokānabhimatāñchṛṇu . . 14
meaning:
पुरुषादीश्वरो ज्ञेय ईश्वरेणावृतं जगत् .
भूमेरधस्तात्सप्तैव लोकानभिमताञ्छृणु . . 14
text_mt: Beyond the spirit, Īśvara is to be known; by Īśvara the universe is pervaded. / Hear now of the seven chosen worlds beneath the earth:

sanskrit_iast:
talaṃ sutalapātāle talātalaṃ tathātalam .
vitalaṃ ca kuruśreṣṭha saptamaṃ ca rasātalam . . 15
meaning:
तलं सुतलपाताले तलातलं तथातलम् .
वितलं च कुरुश्रेष्ठ सप्तमं च रसातलम् . . 15
text_mt: Tala, Sutala, Pātāla, Talātala, Atala, / Vitala, O best of the Kurus, and the seventh, Rasātala.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'gnirvāyurākāśaṃ tato bhūtādirucyate .
tato mahānpradhānaśca prakṛtiḥ puruṣastataḥ . . 16
meaning:
ततोऽग्निर्वायुराकाशं ततो भूतादिरुच्यते .
ततो महान्प्रधानश्च प्रकृतिः पुरुषस्ततः . . 16
text_mt: Then fire, wind, space; then the origin of the elements is declared; / then the great principle and Pradhāna, Prakṛti, and then Puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣādīśvaro jñeya īśvareṇāvṛtaṃ jagat .
evaṃ meroḥ pramāṇaṃ tu sarvametatprakīrtitam . . 17
meaning:
पुरुषादीश्वरो ज्ञेय ईश्वरेणावृतं जगत् .
एवं मेरोः प्रमाणं तु सर्वमेतत्प्रकीर्तितम् . . 17
text_mt: Beyond Puruṣa, Īśvara is to be known; by Īśvara the universe is pervaded. / Thus all this measurement of Meru has been proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
caturasraścatuḥ śṛṃgaḥ sa meruḥ kāñcanaḥ śubhaḥ .
pṛthivyāṃ saṃsthito madhye siddhagandharvasevitaḥ . . 18
meaning:
चतुरस्रश्चतुः शृंगः स मेरुः काञ्चनः शुभः .
पृथिव्यां संस्थितो मध्ये सिद्धगन्धर्वसेवितः . . 18
text_mt: Square, four-peaked is that auspicious golden Meru, / standing in the center of the earth, frequented by Siddhas and Gandharvas,

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhiḥ kāñcanaiḥ śṛṃgairdivyairdivamivollikhan .
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi caturāśītirucchritaḥ . . 19
meaning:
चतुर्भिः काञ्चनैः शृंगैर्दिव्यैर्दिवमिवोल्लिखन् .
योजनानां सहस्राणि चतुराशीतिरुच्छ्रितः . . 19
text_mt: with four divine golden peaks as if scraping the sky, / eighty-four thousand yojanas in height,

sanskrit_iast:
praviṣṭaḥ ṣoḍaśādhastādaṣṭaviṃśativistṛtaḥ .
vistārastriguṇaścāsya pariṇāhastataḥ smṛtaḥ . . 1.126.20
meaning:
प्रविष्टः षोडशाधस्तादष्टविंशतिविस्तृतः .
विस्तारस्त्रिगुणश्चास्य परिणाहस्ततः स्मृतः . . 1.126.20
text_mt: penetrating sixteen [thousand] beneath, twenty-eight wide; / and its circumference is traditionally known to be three times its breadth.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya saumanasaṃ nāma śṛṃgamekaṃ tu kāñcanam .
dvitīyaṃ padmarāgābhaṃ jyotiṣkaṃ nāma nāmataḥ . . 21
meaning:
तस्य सौमनसं नाम शृंगमेकं तु काञ्चनम् .
द्वितीयं पद्मरागाभं ज्योतिष्कं नाम नामतः . . 21
text_mt: One golden peak of it is called Saumanasa; / the second, ruby-colored, is called Jyotiṣka by name;

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyaṃ nāmataścitraṃ sarvadevamayaṃ śubham .
caturthaṃ rājataṃ śuklaṃ candraujaskamiti smṛtam . . 22
meaning:
तृतीयं नामतश्चित्रं सर्वदेवमयं शुभम् .
चतुर्थं राजतं शुक्लं चन्द्रौजस्कमिति स्मृतम् . . 22
text_mt: the third is named Citra, composed of all the gods, auspicious; / the fourth is of silver, white, remembered as Candraujaska.

sanskrit_iast:
yattu saumanasaṃ nāma śṛṃgaṃ gāṅgeyamucyate .
tadeva codayo nāmnā yatrodyandṛśyate raviḥ . . 23
meaning:
यत्तु सौमनसं नाम शृंगं गाङ्गेयमुच्यते .
तदेव चोदयो नाम्ना यत्रोद्यन्दृश्यते रविः . . 23
text_mt: That golden peak which is called Saumanasa / is also named Udaya, where the rising sun is seen.

sanskrit_iast:
uttareṇa parikramya jambūdvīpaṃ divākaraḥ .
dṛśyo bhavati bhūtānāṃ śikharaṃ ca samāsthitaḥ . . 24
meaning:
उत्तरेण परिक्रम्य जम्बूद्वीपं दिवाकरः .
दृश्यो भवति भूतानां शिखरं च समास्थितः . . 24
text_mt: Circumambulating Jambūdvīpa by the north, the sun, / standing on the peak, becomes visible to living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
kāñcanasya ca śailasya tejasārkasya cāhṛte .
ubhe sandhye prakāśete ātāmre pūrvapaścime . . 25
meaning:
काञ्चनस्य च शैलस्य तेजसार्कस्य चाहृते .
उभे सन्ध्ये प्रकाशेते आताम्रे पूर्वपश्चिमे . . 25
text_mt: Brought forth by the splendor of the golden mountain and the sun, / the two twilights, morning and evening, shine reddish.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṃge saumanase sūrya uttiṣṭhatyuttarāyaṇe .
jyotiṣe dakṣiṇe cāpi viṣuve madhyatastayoḥ . . 26
meaning:
शृंगे सौमनसे सूर्य उत्तिष्ठत्युत्तरायणे .
ज्योतिषे दक्षिणे चापि विषुवे मध्यतस्तयोः . . 26
text_mt: The sun rises on Mount Saumanasa during the northern solstice, / on Jyotiṣa during the southern, and between the two at the equinox.

sanskrit_iast:
īśendrodriśca aiśānyāṃ tatrāgniḥ pūrvadakṣiṇe .
nairṛte'pi tato jñeyo vāyavye marutastathā . . 27
meaning:
ईशेन्द्रोद्रिश्च ऐशान्यां तत्राग्निः पूर्वदक्षिणे .
नैरृतेऽपि ततो ज्ञेयो वायव्ये मरुतस्तथा . . 27
text_mt: Īśāna and Indra's peak is in the northeast; there Agni is in the southeast; / then [Nirṛti] is to be known in the southwest, and in the northwest the Maruts.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye tu kaṃjajaḥ sākṣādgrahā jyotīṃṣi caiva hi .
ādityastena rūpeṇa tasminvyomni pratiṣṭhitaḥ . . 28
meaning:
मध्ये तु कंजजः साक्षाद्ग्रहा ज्योतींषि चैव हि .
आदित्यस्तेन रूपेण तस्मिन्व्योम्नि प्रतिष्ठितः . . 28
text_mt: In the center is the lotus-born [Brahmā] himself, and the planets and luminaries; / in that form, the sun is established in that sky.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ devamayaṃ vyoma tathā lokamayaṃ smṛtam .
pūrvakoṇasthite śṛṃge sthitaḥ śukro mahīpate . . 29
meaning:
इदं देवमयं व्योम तथा लोकमयं स्मृतम् .
पूर्वकोणस्थिते शृंगे स्थितः शुक्रो महीपते . . 29
text_mt: This sky is remembered as composed of the gods and composed of the worlds. / Standing on the peak in the eastern corner, O king, is Śukra;

sanskrit_iast:
helijaścāpare jñeyo dhananāthastathāpare .
somaścāpi caturthe tu sthitaḥ śṛṃge janādhipa . . 1.126.30
meaning:
हेलिजश्चापरे ज्ञेयो धननाथस्तथापरे .
सोमश्चापि चतुर्थे तु स्थितः शृंगे जनाधिप . . 1.126.30
text_mt: the son of Sūrya [Śani] is to be known on the other, and on another the lord of wealth [Kubera]; / and Soma stands on the fourth peak, O ruler of people.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye keśāsthito rājanhuṅkāraśca pinākinaḥ .
śṛṃge pūrvottare rājansthito devo vidhukṣaye1 . . 31
meaning:
मध्ये केशास्थितो राजन्हुङ्कारश्च पिनाकिनः .
शृंगे पूर्वोत्तरे राजन्स्थितो देवो विधुक्षये1 . . 31
text_mt: In the center stand the hairs and the roaring sound of the wielder of Pināka [Śiva]. / On the northeast peak, O king, stands the god at the waning of the moon [Śiva].

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sthito mahādevo gopatirlokapūjitaḥ .
pūrvāgneyīsthite śṛṃge sthito vai śāṇḍilaḥ sutaḥ . . 32
meaning:
ततः स्थितो महादेवो गोपतिर्लोकपूजितः .
पूर्वाग्नेयीस्थिते शृंगे स्थितो वै शाण्डिलः सुतः . . 32
text_mt: Next stands Mahādeva, the lord of cattle, revered by the worlds. / On the peak situated in the southeast stands indeed the son of Śāṇḍila [Agni].

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sthito mahātejāḥ kīnāśo helinandanaḥ .
sthito vai nairṛte śṛṃge virūpākṣo mahābalaḥ . . 33
meaning:
ततः स्थितो महातेजाः कीनाशो हेलिनन्दनः .
स्थितो वै नैरृते शृंगे विरूपाक्षो महाबलः . . 33
text_mt: Next stands the immensely radiant Yama, the son of the sun; / on the southwest peak stands the mighty Virūpākṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādanantaro devaḥ sthito vai yādasāṃ patiḥ .
tataḥ sthito mahātejā vīra mitro mahābalaḥ . . 34
meaning:
तस्मादनन्तरो देवः स्थितो वै यादसां पतिः .
ततः स्थितो महातेजा वीर मित्रो महाबलः . . 34
text_mt: Adjacent to him stands the divine lord of aquatic creatures [Varuṇa]; / next stands the immensely radiant hero Mitra, of great power,

sanskrit_iast:
vāyavyaṃ śṛṃgamāśritya sarvadevanamaskṛtam .
tataḥ sthito daśabalo naramāruhya bhārata . . 35
meaning:
वायव्यं शृंगमाश्रित्य सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम् .
ततः स्थितो दशबलो नरमारुह्य भारत . . 35
text_mt: resorting to the northwestern peak, bowed to by all the gods. / Next stands the ten-powered [Kubera], mounted on a man, O Bhārata.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā madhye sthito devo hyanantaścādha eva hi .
upendraśaṅkarau devau brahmaṇo'nte samāsthitau . . 36
meaning:
ब्रह्मा मध्ये स्थितो देवो ह्यनन्तश्चाध एव हि .
उपेन्द्रशङ्करौ देवौ ब्रह्मणोऽन्ते समास्थितौ . . 36
text_mt: In the middle stands the divine Brahmā, and Ananta indeed down below; / the gods Upendra and Śaṅkara stand near Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa merustathā vyoma eṣa dharmaśca paṭhyate .
sarvadevamayaścāyaṃ merurvyoma iti smṛtaḥ . . 37
meaning:
एष मेरुस्तथा व्योम एष धर्मश्च पठ्यते .
सर्वदेवमयश्चायं मेरुर्व्योम इति स्मृतः . . 37
text_mt: This is Meru, and thus the sky; this is recited as Dharma. / Composed of all the gods, this Meru is remembered as the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā vedamayaścāpi paṭhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .
śṛṃgāṇi vedāścatvāraḥ pūrvaśṛṃgādayo viduḥ . . 38
meaning:
तथा वेदमयश्चापि पठ्यते नात्र संशयः .
शृंगाणि वेदाश्चत्वारः पूर्वशृंगादयो विदुः . . 38
text_mt: It is also recited as composed of the Vedas; there is no doubt in this. / The wise know the peaks, beginning with the eastern peak, to be the four Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe vyomamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ
nāma ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ . 126 .
sūryaprasādavarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे व्योममाहात्म्यवर्णनं
नाम षड्विंशत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः . 126 .
सूर्यप्रसादवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the one hundred twenty-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Greatness of the Sky' in the Seventh Rite of the Brāhmaparvan in the glorious and great Bhaviṣyapurāṇa.
Description of the Sun's Grace

sanskrit_iast:
śatānīka uvāca
kathamārādhitaḥ sūryaḥ sāmbenāmitatejasā .
vimuktastu kathaṃ rogairbrūhi māṃ dvijasattama . . 1
meaning:
शतानीक उवाच
कथमाराधितः सूर्यः साम्बेनामिततेजसा .
विमुक्तस्तु कथं रोगैर्ब्रूहि मां द्विजसत्तम . . 1
text_mt: Śatānīka said: / How was the sun worshipped by Sāmba of boundless splendor, / and how was he freed from disease? Tell me, O best of the twice-born.
title: Sūryaprasādavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
sādhu pṛṣṭo'smi rājendra śṛṇu sāmbakathāṃ purā .
vistārādvacmi te sarvāṃ kathāṃ pāpavimocinīm . . 2
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
साधु पृष्टोऽस्मि राजेन्द्र शृणु साम्बकथां पुरा .
विस्ताराद्वच्मि ते सर्वां कथां पापविमोचिनीम् . . 2
text_mt: Sumantu said: / I am well asked, O ruler of kings! Hear the story of Sāmba in ancient times. / I shall tell you in full the whole story that delivers one from sins.

sanskrit_iast:
purā saṃśrutya māhātmyaṃ bhāskarasya sa nāradāt .
vinayādupasaṅgamya vacaḥ pitaramabravīt . . 3
meaning:
पुरा संश्रुत्य माहात्म्यं भास्करस्य स नारदात् .
विनयादुपसङ्गम्य वचः पितरमब्रवीत् . . 3
text_mt: Formerly, having heard the greatness of the Sun from Nārada, / approaching his father with humility, he spoke [these] words:

sanskrit_iast:
kaśmalenābhibhūto'smi malena vyādhinācyuta .
vaidyairoṣadhibhiścāpi na śāntirmama vidyate . . 4
meaning:
कश्मलेनाभिभूतोऽस्मि मलेन व्याधिनाच्युत .
वैद्यैरोषधिभिश्चापि न शान्तिर्मम विद्यते . . 4
text_mt: I am overcome by misery, by foul disease, O Acyuta; / and no relief is found for me through physicians or medicines.

sanskrit_iast:
vanaṃ gacchāmi bhagavannanujñāṃ dātumarhasi .
śivena puṇḍarīkākṣa dhyāya māṃ puruṣottama . . 5
meaning:
वनं गच्छामि भगवन्ननुज्ञां दातुमर्हसि .
शिवेन पुण्डरीकाक्ष ध्याय मां पुरुषोत्तम . . 5
text_mt: I go to the forest, O Blessed One; you should grant permission. / With auspiciousness, O lotus-eyed one, think of me, O supreme among men.

sanskrit_iast:
anujñātaḥ sa kṛṣṇena sindhoruttarakūlataḥ .
gatvā santārayāmāsa candrabhāgāṃ mahānadīm . . 6
meaning:
अनुज्ञातः स कृष्णेन सिन्धोरुत्तरकूलतः .
गत्वा सन्तारयामास चन्द्रभागां महानदीम् . . 6
text_mt: Permitted by Kṛṣṇa, having gone from the northern bank of the Sindhu, / he crossed the great river Candrabhāgā.

sanskrit_iast:
tato mitravanaṃ gatvā tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam .
upavāsaparaḥ sāmbaḥ śuṣko dhamanisantataḥ . . 7
meaning:
ततो मित्रवनं गत्वा तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् .
उपवासपरः साम्बः शुष्को धमनिसन्ततः . . 7
text_mt: Then having gone to Mitravana, the sacred place celebrated in the three worlds, / devoted to fasting, emaciated, his veins standing out,

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhanārthaṃ sūryasya guhyaṃ stotraṃ1 jajāpa ha .
vedaiścaturbhiḥ samitaṃ purāṇāśrayabṛṃhitam . . 8
meaning:
आराधनार्थं सूर्यस्य गुह्यं स्तोत्रं1 जजाप ह .
वेदैश्चतुर्भिः समितं पुराणाश्रयबृंहितम् . . 8
text_mt: for the purpose of worshipping the sun, Sāmba chanted a secret hymn / equal to the four Vedas and augmented by the foundation of the Purāṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
yadetanmaṇḍalaṃ śuklaṃ divyaṃ hyajaramavyayam .
yuktaṃ manojavairaśvairhārītairbrahmavādibhiḥ2 . . 9
meaning:
यदेतन्मण्डलं शुक्लं दिव्यं ह्यजरमव्ययम् .
युक्तं मनोजवैरश्वैर्हारीतैर्ब्रह्मवादिभिः2 . . 9
text_mt: This white, divine orb, unaging and imperishable, / yoked with horses swift as thought, green and proclaiming the Veda,

sanskrit_iast:
ādireṣa1 hi bhūtānāmāditya iti saṃjñitaḥ .
trailokyacakṣurevātra paramātmā prajāpatiḥ . . 1.127.10
meaning:
आदिरेष1 हि भूतानामादित्य इति संज्ञितः .
त्रैलोक्यचक्षुरेवात्र परमात्मा प्रजापतिः . . 1.127.10
text_mt: he is indeed the beginning of beings, named Āditya; / he is the eye of the three worlds here, the Supreme Self, Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa vai maṇḍale hyasminpuruṣo dīpyate mahān .
eṣa viṣṇuracintyātmā brahmā caiṣa pitāmahaḥ . . 11
meaning:
एष वै मण्डले ह्यस्मिन्पुरुषो दीप्यते महान् .
एष विष्णुरचिन्त्यात्मा ब्रह्मा चैष पितामहः . . 11
text_mt: The great Person who shines within this orb, / he is Viṣṇu of inconceivable nature, and he is Brahmā the Grandfather;

sanskrit_iast:
rudro mahendro varuṇa ākāśaṃ pṛthivī jalam .
vāyuḥ śaśāṅkaḥ parjanyo dhanādhyakṣo vibhāvasuḥ . . 12
meaning:
रुद्रो महेन्द्रो वरुण आकाशं पृथिवी जलम् .
वायुः शशाङ्कः पर्जन्यो धनाध्यक्षो विभावसुः . . 12
text_mt: he is Rudra, Mahendra, Varuṇa, space, earth, water, / wind, the moon, the rain cloud, the lord of wealth, and fire.

sanskrit_iast:
yaṣa eṣa maṇḍale hyasmin puruṣo dīpyate mahān .
ekaḥ sākṣānmahādevo vṛtramaṇḍanibhaḥ sadā . . 13
meaning:
यष एष मण्डले ह्यस्मिन् पुरुषो दीप्यते महान् .
एकः साक्षान्महादेवो वृत्रमण्डनिभः सदा . . 13
text_mt: The great Person who shines within this orb, / he alone is Mahādeva in visible form, always resembling the orb of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
kālo hyeṣa mahābāhurnibodhotpattilakṣaṇaḥ .
ya eṣa maṇḍale hyasmiṃstejobhiḥ pūrayanmahīm . . 14
meaning:
कालो ह्येष महाबाहुर्निबोधोत्पत्तिलक्षणः .
य एष मण्डले ह्यस्मिंस्तेजोभिः पूरयन्महीम् . . 14
text_mt: Know him, O mighty-armed one, to be Time, whose characteristic is origin, / he who, within this orb, fills the earth with his splendours,

sanskrit_iast:
bhrāmyate hyavyavacchinno vātairyo'mṛtalakṣaṇaḥ .
nātaḥ parataraṃ kiñcittejasā vidyate kvacit . . 15
meaning:
भ्राम्यते ह्यव्यवच्छिन्नो वातैर्योऽमृतलक्षणः .
नातः परतरं किञ्चित्तेजसा विद्यते क्वचित् . . 15
text_mt: who revolves uninterruptedly by the winds, whose nature is immortality; / nothing higher than him in splendour is found anywhere.

sanskrit_iast: puṣṇāti sarvabhūtāni eṣa eva sudhāmṛtaiḥ . antasthānmlecchajātīyāṃstiryagyonigatānapi . . 16
meaning: पुष्णाति सर्वभूतानि एष एव सुधामृतैः . अन्तस्थान्म्लेच्छजातीयांस्तिर्यग्योनिगतानपि . . 16
text_mt: He alone nourishes all beings with nectars of ambrosia, / even those residing within, outcast tribes, and those born among animals.

sanskrit_iast:
kāruṇyātsarvabhūtāni pāsi tvaṃ ca vibhāvaso .
śvitrakuṣṭhyaṃdhabadhirānpaṃgūṃścāpi tathā vibho . . 17
meaning:
कारुण्यात्सर्वभूतानि पासि त्वं च विभावसो .
श्वित्रकुष्ठ्यंधबधिरान्पंगूंश्चापि तथा विभो . . 17
text_mt: Out of compassion you protect all beings, O Sun; / and also those with leucoderma, lepers, the blind, the deaf, and the lame, O all-pervading lord.

sanskrit_iast:
prapannavatsalo deva kurute nīrujo bhavān .
cakramaṇḍalamagrāṃśca nirdhanālpāyuṣastathā . . 18
meaning:
प्रपन्नवत्सलो देव कुरुते नीरुजो भवान् .
चक्रमण्डलमग्रांश्च निर्धनाल्पायुषस्तथा . . 18
text_mt: Affectionate to the surrendered, O God, you make them free of disease, / as well as the foremost among the circle of provinces, the destitute, and those of short lifespan.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyakṣadarśī tvaṃ deva samuddharasi līlayā .
kā me śaktiḥ stavaiḥ stotumārto'haṃ rogapīḍitaḥ . . 19
meaning:
प्रत्यक्षदर्शी त्वं देव समुद्धरसि लीलया .
का मे शक्तिः स्तवैः स्तोतुमार्तोऽहं रोगपीडितः . . 19
text_mt: Seeing directly, O God, you deliver [them] with ease. / What power have I to praise with hymns, afflicted as I am and tormented by disease?

sanskrit_iast:
stūyase tvaṃ sadā devairbrahmaviṣṇuśivādibhiḥ .
mahendrasiddhagandharvairapsarobhiḥ saguhyakaiḥ . . 1.127.20
meaning:
स्तूयसे त्वं सदा देवैर्ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादिभिः .
महेन्द्रसिद्धगन्धर्वैरप्सरोभिः सगुह्यकैः . . 1.127.20
text_mt: You are ever praised by the gods, headed by Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva, / by Mahendra, the Siddhas, the Gandharvas, along with the Apsarases and Guhyakas.

sanskrit_iast:
stutibhiḥ kiṃ pavitrairvā tava deva samīritaiḥ .
yasya te ṛgyajuḥ sāmnāṃ tritaya maṇḍalasthitam . . 21
meaning:
स्तुतिभिः किं पवित्रैर्वा तव देव समीरितैः .
यस्य ते ऋग्यजुः साम्नां त्रितय मण्डलस्थितम् . . 21
text_mt: What need have you, O God, of purifying praises spoken, / you in whose orb abides the triad of the Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma Vedas?

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānināṃ tvaṃ paraṃ dhyānaṃ mokṣadvāraṃ ca mokṣiṇām .
anantatejasākṣobhyo hyaciṃtyāvyaktaniṣkalaḥ . . 22
meaning:
ध्यानिनां त्वं परं ध्यानं मोक्षद्वारं च मोक्षिणाम् .
अनन्ततेजसाक्षोभ्यो ह्यचिंत्याव्यक्तनिष्कलः . . 22
text_mt: For meditators you are the supreme meditation, and for seekers of liberation the door to liberation; / unshakeable by infinite splendour, inconceivable, unmanifest, without parts.

sanskrit_iast:
yadayaṃ vyāhataḥ kiñcitstotre'smiñjagataḥ patiḥ .
ārtiṃ bhaktiṃ ca vijñāya tatsarvaṃ jñātumarhasi . . 23
meaning:
यदयं व्याहतः किञ्चित्स्तोत्रेऽस्मिञ्जगतः पतिः .
आर्तिं भक्तिं च विज्ञाय तत्सर्वं ज्ञातुमर्हसि . . 23
text_mt: If anything has been recited [amiss] in this hymn to the Lord of the world, / you ought to acknowledge it all, knowing my distress and devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
tamuvāca tataḥ sūryaḥ prītyā jāmbavatīsutam .
prīto'smi tapasā vatse brūhi tanmāṃ yadicchasi . . 24
meaning:
तमुवाच ततः सूर्यः प्रीत्या जाम्बवतीसुतम् .
प्रीतोऽस्मि तपसा वत्से ब्रूहि तन्मां यदिच्छसि . . 24
text_mt: Then the Sun with affection spoke to the son of Jāmbavatī: / "I am pleased with your asceticism, dear child; tell me what you desire of me."

sanskrit_iast:
sāmba uvāca
yadi prasanno bhagavāneṣa eva varo mama .
bhaktirbhavatu me'tyarthaṃ tvayi deva sanātana . . 25
meaning:
साम्ब उवाच
यदि प्रसन्नो भगवानेष एव वरो मम .
भक्तिर्भवतु मेऽत्यर्थं त्वयि देव सनातन . . 25
text_mt: Sāmba said: / "If the Blessed Lord is pleased, this indeed is my boon: / let me have intense devotion to you, O eternal God."

sanskrit_iast:
śrīsūrya uvāca
bhūyastuṣṭo'smi bhadraṃ te varaṃ varaya suvrata .
sa dvitīyaṃ varaṃ vavre tadaiva varadaṃ vibhum . . 26
meaning:
श्रीसूर्य उवाच
भूयस्तुष्टोऽस्मि भद्रं ते वरं वरय सुव्रत .
स द्वितीयं वरं वव्रे तदैव वरदं विभुम् . . 26
text_mt: The holy Sun said: / "I am greatly pleased; blessings upon you! Choose a boon, O you of noble vows." / He then chose a second boon from the all-pervading lord who grants boons:

sanskrit_iast:
malaḥ śarīrasaṃstho me tvatprasādātpraṇaśyatu .
yena me śuddhamakhilaṃ vapurbhavatu gopate . . 27
meaning:
मलः शरीरसंस्थो मे त्वत्प्रसादात्प्रणश्यतु .
येन मे शुद्धमखिलं वपुर्भवतु गोपते . . 27
text_mt: Let the impurity abiding in my body perish by your grace, / so that my entire form may become pure, O lord of rays.

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
sa tathāstviti tenokto bhāskareṇa mahātmanā .
tāṃ mumoca rujaṃ sāmbo dehāttvacamivoragaḥ . . 28
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
स तथास्त्विति तेनोक्तो भास्करेण महात्मना .
तां मुमोच रुजं साम्बो देहात्त्वचमिवोरगः . . 28
text_mt: Sumantu said: / Told by him, the great-souled Bhāskara, "So be it," / Sāmba shed that affliction from his body like a snake its skin.

sanskrit_iast:
tato rūpeṇa divyena rūpavānabhavatpunaḥ .
praṇamya śirasā devaṃ purato'vasthito'bhavat . . 29
meaning:
ततो रूपेण दिव्येन रूपवानभवत्पुनः .
प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं पुरतोऽवस्थितोऽभवत् . . 29
text_mt: Then, endowed with a divine form, he became handsome once again. / Bowing with his head to the god, he stood before him.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīsūrya uvāca
bhūyaśca śṛṇu me sāmbaṃ tuṣṭo'haṃ yadbravīmi te .
adya prabhṛti tvannāmnā mama sthānāni suvrata . .
kṣitau ye sthāpayiṣyanti teṣāṃ lokāḥ sanātanāḥ . . 1.127.30
meaning:
श्रीसूर्य उवाच
भूयश्च शृणु मे साम्बं तुष्टोऽहं यद्ब्रवीमि ते .
अद्य प्रभृति त्वन्नाम्ना मम स्थानानि सुव्रत . .
क्षितौ ये स्थापयिष्यन्ति तेषां लोकाः सनातनाः . . 1.127.30
text_mt: The holy Sun said: / "Listen further, O Sāmba, to what I, being pleased, say to you: / From this day forward, O you of noble vows, those who establish my sanctuaries / in your name upon the earth, theirs are eternal worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpayasvaiva māmasmiṃścandrabhāgātaṭe śubhe .
tava nāmnā ca sāmbedaṃ parāṃ khyātiṃ gamiṣyati . . 31
meaning:
स्थापयस्वैव मामस्मिंश्चन्द्रभागातटे शुभे .
तव नाम्ना च साम्बेदं परां ख्यातिं गमिष्यति . . 31
text_mt: Establish me right here on this auspicious bank of the Candrabhāgā; / and under your name, O Sāmba, this [place] will attain supreme fame.

sanskrit_iast:
kīrtistavākṣayā loke khyātiṃ yāsyati suvrata .
bhūyaśca te pradāsyāmi pratyahaṃ svapnadarśanam . . 32
meaning:
कीर्तिस्तवाक्षया लोके ख्यातिं यास्यति सुव्रत .
भूयश्च ते प्रदास्यामि प्रत्यहं स्वप्नदर्शनम् . . 32
text_mt: Your imperishable renown will attain celebrity in the world, O you of noble vows; / and moreover, I will grant you daily vision [of me] in dreams."

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
evaṃ dattvā varaṃ tasmai vṛṣṇisiṃhāya cāparam .
pratyakṣadarśanaṃ dattvā tatraivāntaradhāddhariḥ . . 33
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
एवं दत्त्वा वरं तस्मै वृष्णिसिंहाय चापरम् .
प्रत्यक्षदर्शनं दत्त्वा तत्रैवान्तरधाद्धरिः . . 33
text_mt: Sumantu said: / Having thus granted this boon and another to that lion of the Vṛṣṇis, / and having granted a direct vision [of himself], Hari vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
ya idaṃ paṭhate stotraṃ trikālaṃ bhaktimānnaraḥ .
trisaptaśatamāvartya homaṃ vā saptarātrakam . . 34
meaning:
य इदं पठते स्तोत्रं त्रिकालं भक्तिमान्नरः .
त्रिसप्तशतमावर्त्य होमं वा सप्तरात्रकम् . . 34
text_mt: The devoted man who recites this hymn at the three junctures of the day, / having repeated it twenty-one times, or [performs] a burnt offering for seven nights,

sanskrit_iast:
rājyakāmo labhedrājyaṃ dhanakāmo labhedadhanam .
rogārto mucyate rogādyathā sāmbastathaiva saḥ . . 35
meaning:
राज्यकामो लभेद्राज्यं धनकामो लभेदधनम् .
रोगार्तो मुच्यते रोगाद्यथा साम्बस्तथैव सः . . 35
text_mt: desiring a kingdom, would obtain a kingdom; desiring wealth, would obtain wealth; / afflicted by disease, he is released from disease just as Sāmba was.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryalokaṃ vrajeccāpi bhaktyā pūjya divākaram .
ramate ca tathā tasmindevaiśca parivāritaḥ . . 36
meaning:
सूर्यलोकं व्रजेच्चापि भक्त्या पूज्य दिवाकरम् .
रमते च तथा तस्मिन्देवैश्च परिवारितः . . 36
text_mt: Having worshipped the Sun with devotion, he also goes to the world of the Sun, / and delights there, surrounded by the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sāmbopākhyāne sūryaprasādavarṇanaṃ
nāma saptaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ . 127 .
sāmbastavavarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे साम्बोपाख्याने सूर्यप्रसादवर्णनं
नाम सप्तविंशत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः . 127 .
साम्बस्तववर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-seventh chapter, named "Description of the Grace of the Sun" in the Sāmba narrative of the Saptamīkalpa, in the Brāhmaparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Hymn of Sāmba

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
astāvīcca tata sāmbaḥ kṛśo dhamanisantataḥ .
rājannāmasahasreṇa sahasrāṃśuṃ divākaram . . 1
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
अस्तावीच्च तत साम्बः कृशो धमनिसन्ततः .
राजन्नामसहस्रेण सहस्रांशुं दिवाकरम् . . 1
text_mt: Sumantu said: / Then, emaciated and with his veins protruding, Sāmba praised / the thousand-rayed Sun, the day-maker, with a thousand names, O King.
title: adhyāyaḥ 128

sanskrit_iast:
khidyamānaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā sūryaḥ kṛṣṇātmajaṃ tadā .
svapne'smai darśanaṃ dattvā punarvacanamabravīt . . 2
meaning:
खिद्यमानं ततो दृष्ट्वा सूर्यः कृष्णात्मजं तदा .
स्वप्नेऽस्मै दर्शनं दत्त्वा पुनर्वचनमब्रवीत् . . 2
text_mt: Then, seeing Kṛṣṇa's son in distress, the Sun / granted him a vision in a dream and spoke these words again:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīsūrya uvāca
sāmba sāmba mahāvāho śṛṇu jāmbavatīsuta .
alaṃ nāmasahasreṇa paṭha cemaṃ śubhaṃ stavam . . 3
meaning:
श्रीसूर्य उवाच
साम्ब साम्ब महावाहो शृणु जाम्बवतीसुत .
अलं नामसहस्रेण पठ चेमं शुभं स्तवम् . . 3
text_mt: The holy Sun said: / "Sāmba, Sāmba, O mighty-armed son of Jāmbavatī, listen: / enough with the thousand names; recite this auspicious hymn.

sanskrit_iast:
yāni guhyāni nāmāni pavitrāṇi śubhāni ca .
tāni te kīrtiyiṣyāmi prayatnādavadhāraya . 4
meaning:
यानि गुह्यानि नामानि पवित्राणि शुभानि च .
तानि ते कीर्तियिष्यामि प्रयत्नादवधारय . 4
text_mt: Those names which are secret, purifying, and auspicious, / I will proclaim to you; bear them in mind with care:

sanskrit_iast:
vaikartano vivasvāṃśca mārtaṇḍo bhāskaro raviḥ .
lokaprakāśakaḥ śrīmāṃllokacakṣurgraheśvaraḥ . 5
meaning:
वैकर्तनो विवस्वांश्च मार्तण्डो भास्करो रविः .
लोकप्रकाशकः श्रीमांल्लोकचक्षुर्ग्रहेश्वरः . 5
text_mt: Vaikartana, Vivasvat, Mārtaṇḍa, Bhāskara, Ravi, / illuminator of the worlds, the glorious, eye of the world, lord of the planets,

sanskrit_iast:
lokasākṣī trilokeśaḥ kartā hartā tamisrahā .
tapanastāpanaścaiva śuciḥ saptāśvavāhanaḥ . 6
meaning:
लोकसाक्षी त्रिलोकेशः कर्ता हर्ता तमिस्रहा .
तपनस्तापनश्चैव शुचिः सप्ताश्ववाहनः . 6
text_mt: witness of the world, lord of the three worlds, the creator, the destroyer, dispeller of darkness, / the burner, the scorcher, pure, borne by seven horses,

sanskrit_iast:
gabhastihasto brahmā ca sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ .
ekarviśatirityeṣa stava iṣṭassadā mama . . 7
meaning:
गभस्तिहस्तो ब्रह्मा च सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः .
एकर्विशतिरित्येष स्तव इष्टस्सदा मम . . 7
text_mt: having rays for hands, Brahmā, and worshipped by all the gods. / This hymn of twenty-one [names] is always beloved to me.

sanskrit_iast:
śarīrārogyadaścaiva dhanavṛddhiyaśaskaraḥ .
stavarāja iti khyātastriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ . 8
meaning:
शरीरारोग्यदश्चैव धनवृद्धियशस्करः .
स्तवराज इति ख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः . 8
text_mt: It grants bodily health, increases wealth, and brings renown; / renowned as the 'King of Hymns', it is famous in the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
ya etena mahābāho dve sandhye'stamanodaye .
stauti māṃ praṇato bhūtvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 9
meaning:
य एतेन महाबाहो द्वे सन्ध्येऽस्तमनोदये .
स्तौति मां प्रणतो भूत्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 9
text_mt: Whoever, O mighty-armed one, bows down and praises me with this [hymn] at the two twilights, sunset and sunrise, / is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
mānasaṃ vācikaṃ vāpi kāyikaṃ yacca duṣkṛtam .
ekajāpyena tatsarvaṃ praṇaśyati mamāgrataḥ . 1.128.10
meaning:
मानसं वाचिकं वापि कायिकं यच्च दुष्कृतम् .
एकजाप्येन तत्सर्वं प्रणश्यति ममाग्रतः . 1.128.10
text_mt: Whatever wrong action was committed mentally, verbally, or physically, / all that perishes before me by a single recitation.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa japyaśca homaśca sandhyopāsanameva ca .
balimantro'rghyamantro'tha dhūpamantrastathaiva ca . .11
meaning:
एष जप्यश्च होमश्च सन्ध्योपासनमेव च .
बलिमन्त्रोऽर्घ्यमन्त्रोऽथ धूपमन्त्रस्तथैव च . .11
text_mt: This is a recitation, a burnt offering, and the twilight prayer itself, / as well as the mantra for offerings, the mantra for water oblation, and the mantra for incense.

sanskrit_iast:
annapradāne snāne ca praṇipāte pradakṣiṇe .
pūjito'yaṃ mahāmantraḥ sarvapāpaharaḥ śubhaḥ . . 12
meaning:
अन्नप्रदाने स्नाने च प्रणिपाते प्रदक्षिणे .
पूजितोऽयं महामन्त्रः सर्वपापहरः शुभः . . 12
text_mt: In giving food, in bathing, in bowing down, and in circumambulation, / this great mantra, honoured, removes all sins and is auspicious."

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā sa bhagavānbhāskaro jagatāṃ patiḥ .
āmantrya kṛṣṇatanayaṃ tatraivāntarhito'bhavat . . 13
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान्भास्करो जगतां पतिः .
आमन्त्र्य कृष्णतनयं तत्रैवान्तर्हितोऽभवत् . . 13
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the Blessed Lord Bhāskara, Lord of the worlds, / bid farewell to Kṛṣṇa's son and disappeared right there.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmbo'pi stavarājena stutvā saptāśvavāhanam .
prītātmā nīrujaḥ śrīmāṃstasmādrogādvimuktavān . . 14
meaning:
साम्बोऽपि स्तवराजेन स्तुत्वा सप्ताश्ववाहनम् .
प्रीतात्मा नीरुजः श्रीमांस्तस्माद्रोगाद्विमुक्तवान् . . 14
text_mt: Sāmba too, having praised the one borne by seven horses with the 'King of Hymns', / gladdened at heart, free from illness, and glorious, was completely cured of that disease.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sāmbastavavarṇanaṃ
nāmāṣṭāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ . 128 .
sāmbakṛtādityamūrtisthāpanavarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे साम्बस्तववर्णनं
नामाष्टाविंशत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः . 128 .
साम्बकृतादित्यमूर्तिस्थापनवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-eighth chapter, entitled "Description of the Praise by Sāmba", in the Saptamīkalpa of the Brāhmaparvan in the venerable and great Bhaviṣyapurāṇa. 128.
Description of the Installation of the Image of Āditya by Sāmba

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
atha labdhavaraḥ sāmbo varaṃ prāpya purātanam .
manyamānastadāścaryaṃ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā . . 1
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
अथ लब्धवरः साम्बो वरं प्राप्य पुरातनम् .
मन्यमानस्तदाश्चर्यं प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना . . 1
text_mt: Sumantu said: / Then Sāmba, having obtained his boon, receiving the ancient boon, / thinking it a wonder, with an inner self overjoyed,
title: Sāmbakṛtādityamūrtisthāpanam

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvābhyāsena tenaiva sārdhamanyaistapasvibhiḥ .
snāpanārthaṃ nātidūraṃ candrabhāgāṃ nadīṃ yayau . . 2
meaning:
पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव सार्धमन्यैस्तपस्विभिः .
स्नापनार्थं नातिदूरं चन्द्रभागां नदीं ययौ . . 2
text_mt: along with other ascetics, by that same previous habit, / went to the Candrabhāgā river, not very far away, to bathe.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvātmamaṇḍalākāraṃ śraddadhāno dinedine .
sasnau sañcintayāmāsa kiṃ rūpaṃ sthāpayāmyaham . . 3
meaning:
कृत्वात्ममण्डलाकारं श्रद्दधानो दिनेदिने .
सस्नौ सञ्चिन्तयामास किं रूपं स्थापयाम्यहम् . . 3
text_mt: Having made the form of a solar disc, full of faith day after day, / he bathed and reflected: "What form shall I install?"

sanskrit_iast:
sa snātaḥ sahasaivātha praṇamya1 tu prabhāvatīm .
uhyamānāṃ jalaughena pratimāṃ sammukhīṃ raveḥ . . 4
meaning:
स स्नातः सहसैवाथ प्रणम्य1 तु प्रभावतीम् .
उह्यमानां जलौघेन प्रतिमां सम्मुखीं रवेः . . 4
text_mt: Having bathed, bowing at once to the radiant [deity], / [he saw] an image facing the Sun, carried along by the stream of water.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā tasya vīrasya samutpannamidaṃ yathā .
devena yattadājñaptaṃ tadidaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ . . 5
meaning:
तां दृष्ट्वा तस्य वीरस्य समुत्पन्नमिदं यथा .
देवेन यत्तदाज्ञप्तं तदिदं नात्र संशयः . . 5
text_mt: Seeing it, this [thought] arose in that hero: / "What was commanded by the god, this is that, of this there is no doubt."

sanskrit_iast:
sa tāmuttārya salilādānīya ca mahīpate .
tasminmitravanoddeśe sthāpayāmāsa tāṃ tadā . . 6
meaning:
स तामुत्तार्य सलिलादानीय च महीपते .
तस्मिन्मित्रवनोद्देशे स्थापयामास तां तदा . . 6
text_mt: Pulling it out from the water and bringing it, O lord of the earth, / he then installed it in that region of Mitravana.

sanskrit_iast:
nidhāya pratimām̐lloke sāmbastasya mahātmanaḥ .
mitraṃ mitravane ramye sthāpayitvā vidhānataḥ . . 7
meaning:
निधाय प्रतिमाम्̐ल्लोके साम्बस्तस्य महात्मनः .
मित्रं मित्रवने रम्ये स्थापयित्वा विधानतः . . 7
text_mt: Having set up the image in the world, Sāmba, / having installed Mitra of that great soul properly in pleasant Mitravana,

sanskrit_iast:
tatastāmeva papraccha praṇamya pratimāṃ raveḥ .
keneyaṃ nirmitā nātha bhavato hyākṛtiḥ śubhā . . 8
meaning:
ततस्तामेव पप्रच्छ प्रणम्य प्रतिमां रवेः .
केनेयं निर्मिता नाथ भवतो ह्याकृतिः शुभा . . 8
text_mt: bowing down, then asked that very image of the Sun: / "By whom, O Lord, was this auspicious form of yours fashioned?"

sanskrit_iast:
pratimā tamuvācātha śṛṇu sāmba bruve svayam .
nirmitā yena cāpyeṣā madīyā puruṣākṛtiḥ . . 9
meaning:
प्रतिमा तमुवाचाथ शृणु साम्ब ब्रुवे स्वयम् .
निर्मिता येन चाप्येषा मदीया पुरुषाकृतिः . . 9
text_mt: The image then said to him: "Listen, Sāmba, I shall tell you myself / by whom this human form of mine was fashioned.

sanskrit_iast:
mamātitejasāviṣṭaṃ rūpamāsītpurātanam .
asahyaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tato'smyabhyarcitaḥ suraiḥ . .
sahyaṃ bhavatu te rūpaṃ sarvaprāṇabhṛtāmiti . . 1.129.10
meaning:
ममातितेजसाविष्टं रूपमासीत्पुरातनम् .
असह्यं सर्वभूतानां ततोऽस्म्यभ्यर्चितः सुरैः . .
सह्यं भवतु ते रूपं सर्वप्राणभृतामिति . . 1.129.10
text_mt: My ancient form was permeated with excessive brilliance, / unbearable to all beings; therefore I was entreated by the gods: / 'Let your form become bearable to all living beings.'

sanskrit_iast:
tato mayā samādiṣṭo viśvakarmā mahātapāḥ .
tejasāṃ śātanaṃ kurvanrūpaṃ nirvartayasva me . . 11
meaning:
ततो मया समादिष्टो विश्वकर्मा महातपाः .
तेजसां शातनं कुर्वन्रूपं निर्वर्तयस्व मे . . 11
text_mt: Then Viśvakarman of great austerity was commanded by me: / 'Paring away the brilliance, fashion my form.'

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu matsamādeśāttenaiva nipuṇaṃ tadā .
śākadvīpe bhramiṃ kṛtvā rūpaṃ nirvartitaṃ mama . . 12
meaning:
ततस्तु मत्समादेशात्तेनैव निपुणं तदा .
शाकद्वीपे भ्रमिं कृत्वा रूपं निर्वर्तितं मम . . 12
text_mt: Then, by my command, my form was skillfully fashioned / by him at that time, placing me upon the lathe in Śākadvīpa.

sanskrit_iast:
prītyā teṣāṃ prapañco'yaṃ sa mayā kāritaḥ punaḥ .
teneyaṃ kalpavṛkṣāttu nirmitā viśvakarmaṇā . . 13
meaning:
प्रीत्या तेषां प्रपञ्चोऽयं स मया कारितः पुनः .
तेनेयं कल्पवृक्षात्तु निर्मिता विश्वकर्मणा . . 13
text_mt: Out of affection for them, this expansion was caused by me again; / by him, Viśvakarman, this was fashioned from the wish-granting tree.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā himavataḥ pṛṣṭhe purā siddhaniṣevite .
tvadarthaṃ candrabhāgāyāṃ tatastenāvatāritā . . 14
meaning:
कृत्वा हिमवतः पृष्ठे पुरा सिद्धनिषेविते .
त्वदर्थं चन्द्रभागायां ततस्तेनावतारिता . . 14
text_mt: Having fashioned it formerly on the ridge of the Himavat frequented by Siddhas, / it was then brought down into the Candrabhāgā by him for your sake.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavatastāraṇārthaṃ hi tataḥ sthānamidaṃ śubham .
ruciraṃ sarvadā sāmba sānnidhyaṃ me'tra yāsyati . . 15
meaning:
भवतस्तारणार्थं हि ततः स्थानमिदं शुभम् .
रुचिरं सर्वदा साम्ब सान्निध्यं मेऽत्र यास्यति . . 15
text_mt: Indeed, for your deliverance, this place is auspicious; / pleasing, O Sāmba, my presence here will remain always.

sanskrit_iast:
sānnidhyaṃ mama pūrvāhṇe sutīre drakṣyate janaiḥ .
kālapriye ca madhyāhne'parāhṇe cātra nityaśaḥ . . 16
meaning:
सान्निध्यं मम पूर्वाह्णे सुतीरे द्रक्ष्यते जनैः .
कालप्रिये च मध्याह्नेऽपराह्णे चात्र नित्यशः . . 16
text_mt: My presence will be seen by people in the forenoon at Sutīra, / at midday at Kālapriya, and in the afternoon always here.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvāhṇe pūjayed brahmā madhyāhne cakradhṛtsvayam .
śaṅkaraścāparāhṇe tu māṃ pūjayati sarvadā . . 17
meaning:
पूर्वाह्णे पूजयेद् ब्रह्मा मध्याह्ने चक्रधृत्स्वयम् .
शङ्करश्चापराह्णे तु मां पूजयति सर्वदा . . 17
text_mt: In the forenoon Brahmā worships me; at midday the Wielder of the Discus himself; / and in the afternoon Śaṅkara always worships me."

sanskrit_iast:
ityukto'sau bhagavatā bhāskareṇa sa yādavaḥ .
harṣamāpa mahābāho bhāskaro'ntardadhe tataḥ . . 18
meaning:
इत्युक्तोऽसौ भगवता भास्करेण स यादवः .
हर्षमाप महाबाहो भास्करोऽन्तर्दधे ततः . . 18
text_mt: Having been spoken to thus by the blessed Sun, that Yādava / attained joy, O mighty-armed one; then the Sun disappeared.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sāmbopākhyāne
sāmbakṛtādityamūrtisthāpanaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ . . 129 .
prasādalakṣaṇavarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे साम्बोपाख्याने
साम्बकृतादित्यमूर्तिस्थापनं नामैकोनत्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः . . 129 .
प्रसादलक्षणवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-ninth chapter, entitled "Installation of the Image of Āditya by Sāmba", in the narrative of Sāmba, in the Saptamīkalpa of the Brāhmaparvan in the venerable and great Bhaviṣyapurāṇa. 129.
Description of the Characteristics of a Temple

sanskrit_iast:
śatānīka uvāca
kathaṃ sāmbena viprendra pratiṣṭhā kāritā raveḥ .
kasya vā vacanāttena prāsādaḥ kārito raveḥ . . 1
meaning:
शतानीक उवाच
कथं साम्बेन विप्रेन्द्र प्रतिष्ठा कारिता रवेः .
कस्य वा वचनात्तेन प्रासादः कारितो रवेः . . 1
text_mt: Śatānīka said: / How, O best of brahmins, was the installation of the Sun performed by Sāmba, / or by whose word was the temple of the Sun constructed by him?
title: Prāsādalakṣaṇavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
atra te vacmi rājendra yathā sāmbena dhīmatā .
pratiṣṭhā kāritā bhānoḥ prasādaśca mahīpate . . 2
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
अत्र ते वच्मि राजेन्द्र यथा साम्बेन धीमता .
प्रतिष्ठा कारिता भानोः प्रसादश्च महीपते . . 2
text_mt: Sumantu said: / Here I tell you, O king of kings, how by the wise Sāmba / the installation of the Sun and the temple were made, O lord of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
sulabdhvā pratimāṃ bhānościntayāmāsa nāradam .
sa cāpi cintitaścāgādyatra jāmbavatīsutaḥ . . 3
meaning:
सुलब्ध्वा प्रतिमां भानोश्चिन्तयामास नारदम् .
स चापि चिन्तितश्चागाद्यत्र जाम्बवतीसुतः . . 3
text_mt: Having obtained the image of the Sun, he thought of Nārada, / and he, thought of, came to where the son of Jāmbavatī was.

sanskrit_iast:
tamāgatamabhiprekṣya nāradaṃ munisattamam .
sampūjya vidhivatsāṃbo nāradaṃ vākyamabravīt . .4
meaning:
तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य नारदं मुनिसत्तमम् .
सम्पूज्य विधिवत्सांबो नारदं वाक्यमब्रवीत् . .4
text_mt: Seeing that best of sages, Nārada, arrived, / having duly honoured him, Sāmba spoke these words to Nārada:

sanskrit_iast:
prāsādaṃ kārayedyastu bhāskarasya naro dvija .
kiṃ phalaṃ tasya devarṣe pratiṣṭhāṃ yaśca kārayet . . 5
meaning:
प्रासादं कारयेद्यस्तु भास्करस्य नरो द्विज .
किं फलं तस्य देवर्षे प्रतिष्ठां यश्च कारयेत् . . 5
text_mt: “Whatever man causes a temple of the Sun to be built, O brahmin, / what is his reward, O divine sage, and of him who performs the installation?”

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
prāsādaṃ śobhane deśe yastu kārayate raveḥ .
sa yāti naraśārdūla sūryalokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ . . 6
meaning:
नारद उवाच
प्रासादं शोभने देशे यस्तु कारयते रवेः .
स याति नरशार्दूल सूर्यलोकं न संशयः . . 6
text_mt: Nārada said: / “The one who has a temple of the Sun built in an auspicious place, / he goes to the realm of the Sun, O tiger among men; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmba uvāca
kathaṃ kuryādāyatanaṃ kasmindeśe dvijottama .
kīdṛkchastaṃ cāyatanaṃ devadevasya1 vai dvija . . 7
meaning:
साम्ब उवाच
कथं कुर्यादायतनं कस्मिन्देशे द्विजोत्तम .
कीदृक्छस्तं चायतनं देवदेवस्य1 वै द्विज . . 7
text_mt: Sāmba said: / How should one make the temple, in what region, O best of brahmins? / And what kind of temple is praised for the god of gods, O brahmin?

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
yatra prabhūtaṃ salilamāgame ca vināśane .
devatāyatanaṃ kuryādyaśodharmavivṛddhaye . . 8
meaning:
नारद उवाच
यत्र प्रभूतं सलिलमागमे च विनाशने .
देवतायतनं कुर्याद्यशोधर्मविवृद्धये . . 8
text_mt: Nārada said: / Where there is abundant water, at its source and at its outlet, / one should build a temple of the god for the increase of fame and dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭāpūrtena labhate lokāṃstāṃśca1 vibhūṣitān .
devānāmālayaṃ kāryaṃ dvayaṃ yatra ca dṛśyate . . 9
meaning:
इष्टापूर्तेन लभते लोकांस्तांश्च1 विभूषितान् .
देवानामालयं कार्यं द्वयं यत्र च दृश्यते . . 9
text_mt: Through sacrificial and charitable works one obtains those adorned worlds; / the abode of the gods should be made where both are seen.

sanskrit_iast:
salilādyaṃ ca ārāmaḥ kṛteṣvāyataneṣu ca .
sthāneṣveteṣu sānnidhyamupagacchanti devatāḥ . . 1.130.10
meaning:
सलिलाद्यं च आरामः कृतेष्वायतनेषु च .
स्थानेष्वेतेषु सान्निध्यमुपगच्छन्ति देवताः . . 1.130.10
text_mt: Where there is water and so forth, and a pleasure grove, in constructed temples, / in these places the deities take up their presence:

sanskrit_iast:
saraḥsu nalinīcchannanirastaraviraśmiṣu .
haṃsasaṃkṣiptakahlāravīthīvimalavāriṣu . . 11
meaning:
सरःसु नलिनीच्छन्ननिरस्तरविरश्मिषु .
हंससंक्षिप्तकह्लारवीथीविमलवारिषु . . 11
text_mt: at lakes covered with lotuses which dispel the rays of the sun, / whose clear waters have rows of night-lotuses tossed by geese;

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsakāraṇḍavakrauñcacakravākavirāviṣu .
paryantavimalacchāyāviśrāntajanacāriṣu . . 14
meaning:
हंसकारण्डवक्रौञ्चचक्रवाकविराविषु .
पर्यन्तविमलच्छायाविश्रान्तजनचारिषु . . 14
text_mt: resounding with geese, kāraṇḍavas, krauñcas, and cakravākas, / frequented by resting people in the clear shade along their borders;

sanskrit_iast:
krauñcakāñcīsulāpāśca kalahaṃsakalasvanāḥ .
nadyastoyāṃśukā yatra śapharīkṛtamekhalāḥ . . 13
meaning:
क्रौञ्चकाञ्चीसुलापाश्च कलहंसकलस्वनाः .
नद्यस्तोयांशुका यत्र शफरीकृतमेखलाः . . 13
text_mt: where rivers, whose robes are water and whose girdles are small carp, / have the pleasant cries of krauñcas as their waistbands and the sweet sounds of kalahaṃsas;

sanskrit_iast:
phulladrumottamāvāsāḥ saṅgamaśroṇimaṇḍalāḥ .
pulinādyunnatoraskā rasahāsāśca nimnagāḥ . . 14
meaning:
फुल्लद्रुमोत्तमावासाः सङ्गमश्रोणिमण्डलाः .
पुलिनाद्युन्नतोरस्का रसहासाश्च निम्नगाः . . 14
text_mt: rivers that have excellent blooming trees as abodes, confluences as hips, / sandbanks as raised breasts, and the murmuring sound of water as laughter;

sanskrit_iast:
vanopāntanadīśailasaṃskaropāntabhūmiṣu .
ramante devatā nityaṃ pureṣūdyānavatsu ca . . 15
meaning:
वनोपान्तनदीशैलसंस्करोपान्तभूमिषु .
रमन्ते देवता नित्यं पुरेषूद्यानवत्सु च . . 15
text_mt: on grounds bordering forests, rivers, and mountains, and near confluences, / and in cities with gardens, the deities always take delight.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmayo brāhmaṇādīnāṃ yāḥ proktā vāstukarmaṇi .
tā evaṃ teṣāṃ śasyante devatāyataneṣvapi . . 16
meaning:
भूमयो ब्राह्मणादीनां याः प्रोक्ता वास्तुकर्मणि .
ता एवं तेषां शस्यन्ते देवतायतनेष्वपि . . 16
text_mt: The sites which are prescribed in architectural practice for brahmins and others, / those very ones are recommended for them in the temples of the gods as well.

sanskrit_iast:
catuḥṣaṣṭipadaṃ kuryāddevatāyatanaṃ sadā .
dvāraṃ ca madhyamaṃ tasminsamadiksampraśasyate . 17
meaning:
चतुःषष्टिपदं कुर्याद्देवतायतनं सदा .
द्वारं च मध्यमं तस्मिन्समदिक्सम्प्रशस्यते . 17
text_mt: One should always make the temple of the god with sixty-four squares, / and the central door on it, facing the cardinal directions, is commended.

sanskrit_iast:
yo vistāro bhavettasya dviguṇā tatsamunnatiḥ .
ucchrāyastu tṛtīyo'tha tena tulyā kaṭirbhavet . . 18
meaning:
यो विस्तारो भवेत्तस्य द्विगुणा तत्समुन्नतिः .
उच्छ्रायस्तु तृतीयोऽथ तेन तुल्या कटिर्भवेत् . . 18
text_mt: Whatever is its width, its height should be double that; / one third is the elevation, and the waist should be equal to that.

sanskrit_iast:
vistārārdho bhavedgarbho bhinnayonyāḥ samantataḥ .
garbhapādonavistīrṇaṃ dvāraṃ dviguṇamucchritam . . 19
meaning:
विस्तारार्धो भवेद्गर्भो भिन्नयोन्याः समन्ततः .
गर्भपादोनविस्तीर्णं द्वारं द्विगुणमुच्छ्रितम् . . 19
text_mt: The sanctum should be half the width, with walls all around; / the door should be reduced by a fourth of the sanctum in width, and twice as high.

sanskrit_iast:
ucchrayātpādavistīrṇā śākhā tadvadudumbarī .
vistārātpādapratimādbāhulyaṃ śeṣayoḥ smṛtam . . 1.130.20
meaning:
उच्छ्रयात्पादविस्तीर्णा शाखा तद्वदुदुम्बरी .
विस्तारात्पादप्रतिमाद्बाहुल्यं शेषयोः स्मृतम् . . 1.130.20
text_mt: The jamb should be one fourth of the height in width, and likewise the threshold; / the thickness of the remaining two is taught to be one fourth of the width.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpaṃ saptanavabhiḥ śākhābhistatpraśasyate .
atha śākhācaturbhāge pratihārau niveśayet . . 21
meaning:
नृपं सप्तनवभिः शाखाभिस्तत्प्रशस्यते .
अथ शाखाचतुर्भागे प्रतिहारौ निवेशयेत् . . 21
text_mt: O king, it is praised as having seven or nine door-jambs; / then on the fourth part of the doorpost one should place the two door-keepers.

sanskrit_iast:
śailamaṅgalyavihagaḥ śrīvṛkṣaḥ svastikairghaṭaiḥ .
mānāṣṭamena1 bhāgena pratimā syātsapiṇḍikā . . 22
meaning:
शैलमङ्गल्यविहगः श्रीवृक्षः स्वस्तिकैर्घटैः .
मानाष्टमेन1 भागेन प्रतिमा स्यात्सपिण्डिका . . 22
text_mt: With rocks, auspicious birds, the śrīvṛkṣa tree, svastikas, and pitchers; / the image with its pedestal should be one eighth part of the measurement.

sanskrit_iast:
dvibhāgā pratimā tatra tṛtīyo bhāgapiṇḍikā .
pūrve merurmahābāho kailāsaśca tathāpare . . 23
meaning:
द्विभागा प्रतिमा तत्र तृतीयो भागपिण्डिका .
पूर्वे मेरुर्महाबाहो कैलासश्च तथापरे . . 23
text_mt: There, the image comprises two parts, and the third part is the pedestal. / In the east is Meru, O mighty-armed one, and Kailāsa and others in the west;

sanskrit_iast:
bhavanti cāpare vīra vimānacchadanaṃ tathā .
samudrapadmagaruḍanandivarddhanakuñjarāḥ . . 24
meaning:
भवन्ति चापरे वीर विमानच्छदनं तथा .
समुद्रपद्मगरुडनन्दिवर्द्धनकुञ्जराः . . 24
text_mt: and others, O hero, are roofed like celestial chariots: / Samudra, Padma, Garuḍa, Nandivardhana, and Kuñjara.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛharājo vṛṣo haṃsaḥ sarvatobhadrako ghaṭaḥ .
siṃho vṛṣaścatuṣkoṇaḥ ṣoḍaśāṣṭāśrayastathā . . 25
meaning:
गृहराजो वृषो हंसः सर्वतोभद्रको घटः .
सिंहो वृषश्चतुष्कोणः षोडशाष्टाश्रयस्तथा . . 25
text_mt:
Gṛharāja, Vṛṣa, Haṃsa, Sarvatobhadraka, Ghaṭa,
Siṃha, Vṛṣa, Catuṣkoṇa, as well as Ṣoḍaśāśraya and Aṣṭāśraya.

sanskrit_iast:
ityete viṃśatiḥ proktāḥ prāsādā yadunandana .
yathoktānukrameṇaiva lakṣaṇāni vadāmi te . . 26
meaning:
इत्येते विंशतिः प्रोक्ताः प्रासादा यदुनन्दन .
यथोक्तानुक्रमेणैव लक्षणानि वदामि ते . . 26
text_mt:
These are declared to be the twenty temples, O delight of the Yadus.
I shall tell you their characteristics in the very order stated.

sanskrit_iast: navatriṃśaducchritamerurdvādaśabhaumo vividhakuharaśca . dvārairyutaścatubhirdvātriṃśaddhastavistīrṇaḥ . . 27
meaning: नवत्रिंशदुच्छ्रितमेरुर्द्वादशभौमो विविधकुहरश्च . द्वारैर्युतश्चतुभिर्द्वात्रिंशद्धस्तविस्तीर्णः . . 27
text_mt:
Meru is thirty-nine [cubits] high, has twelve storeys, various chambers,
is endowed with four doors, and is thirty-two cubits wide.

sanskrit_iast:
triṃśaddhastāyāmo daśabhaumaḥ sapta mandaraḥ .
śikharayutaḥ kailāso'pi śikharavānaṣṭāviṃśoṣṭabhaumaśca . . 28
meaning:
त्रिंशद्धस्तायामो दशभौमः सप्त मन्दरः .
शिखरयुतः कैलासोऽपि शिखरवानष्टाविंशोष्टभौमश्च . . 28
text_mt:
Mandara has an extent of thirty cubits, ten storeys, and seven peaks;
Kailāsa too has peaks, [a height of] twenty-eight, and eight storeys.

sanskrit_iast:
jālagavākṣairyukto vimānasaṃjñastrisaptakāyāmaḥ .
nandana iti vai bhaumo dvātriṃśatṣoḍaśāṅgayutaḥ . . 29
meaning:
जालगवाक्षैर्युक्तो विमानसंज्ञस्त्रिसप्तकायामः .
नन्दन इति वै भौमो द्वात्रिंशत्षोडशाङ्गयुतः . . 29
text_mt:
The one named Vimāna is provided with latticed windows and has an extent of twenty-one;
Nandana is of thirty-two storeys and is endowed with sixteen angas.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛttaḥ samudganāmā padmākṛtirayaṃ cāṣṭau .
śṛṅgeṇaikena bhavedekena ca bhūmikā tasya . . 1.130.30
meaning:
वृत्तः समुद्गनामा पद्माकृतिरयं चाष्टौ .
शृङ्गेणैकेन भवेदेकेन च भूमिका तस्य . . 1.130.30
text_mt:
The one named Samudga is round; this Padmākṛti has eight [sides];
it should have a single peak and a single storey.

sanskrit_iast:
garuḍākṛtiśca garuḍo nandī vai ṣaṣṭivistīrṇaḥ .
kāyaśca saptabhaumo vibhūṣitoṃ'gaiśca saptaviṃśatibhiḥ . . 31
meaning:
गरुडाकृतिश्च गरुडो नन्दी वै षष्टिविस्तीर्णः .
कायश्च सप्तभौमो विभूषितोंऽगैश्च सप्तविंशतिभिः . . 31
text_mt:
Garuḍa has the shape of Garuḍa; Nandī is sixty wide,
its body has seven storeys, and is adorned with twenty-seven angas.

sanskrit_iast:
kuñjara iti gajapṛṣṭhaḥ ṣoḍaśāhastocchrito madhye .
gṛharājaḥ ṣoḍaśakastricakraśālā bhavedvalabhī . . 32
meaning:
कुञ्जर इति गजपृष्ठः षोडशाहस्तोच्छ्रितो मध्ये .
गृहराजः षोडशकस्त्रिचक्रशाला भवेद्वलभी . . 32
text_mt:
Kuñjara has an elephant's back and is sixteen cubits high in the middle;
Gṛharāja has sixteen, and its roof should be a hall with three barrel vaults.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣa evaṃ mṛmiśṛṅgo dvāvaśahastaḥ samunnato vṛttaḥ .
haṃso haṃsākāro ghaṭo'ṣṭasahasrakalaśarūpaḥ . . 33
meaning:
वृष एवं मृमिशृङ्गो द्वावशहस्तः समुन्नतो वृत्तः .
हंसो हंसाकारो घटोऽष्टसहस्रकलशरूपः . . 33
text_mt:
So Vṛṣa has [...] peaks, is twelve cubits tall, and is round;
Haṃsa has the shape of a swan; Ghaṭa has the form of a pot of eight thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
dvārairyutaścaturbhirbahuśikharo bhavati sarvatobhadraḥ .
bahuruciracandraśālaḥ ṣaptaviṃśadbhāgabhūmiśca . . 34
meaning:
द्वारैर्युतश्चतुर्भिर्बहुशिखरो भवति सर्वतोभद्रः .
बहुरुचिरचन्द्रशालः षप्तविंशद्भागभूमिश्च . . 34
text_mt:
Endowed with four doors and having many peaks is Sarvatobhadra;
it has many splendid dormer windows and its base has twenty-seven divisions.

sanskrit_iast: siṃhaḥ siṃhākāro1 dvādaśakoṇo'ṣṭahastaśca . . 35
meaning: सिंहः सिंहाकारो1 द्वादशकोणोऽष्टहस्तश्च . . 35
text_mt: Siṃha has the shape of a lion, twelve corners, and is eight cubits [wide].

sanskrit_iast:
sahasratritayaṃ caiva kathitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā .
prāhuḥ sthāpayataścātra matamekaṃ vipaścitaḥ . . 36
meaning:
सहस्रत्रितयं चैव कथितं विश्वकर्मणा .
प्राहुः स्थापयतश्चात्र मतमेकं विपश्चितः . . 36
text_mt:
And three thousand [types] were declared by Viśvakarman;
concerning its installation here, the wise proclaim a single opinion.

sanskrit_iast: kapotapālinīyuktamato gacchati tulyatām . . 37
meaning: कपोतपालिनीयुक्तमतो गच्छति तुल्यताम् . . 37
text_mt: Provided with a cornice, it thus attains equality.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmba uvāca
ya ete kathitā vipra prāsādā viṃśatistvayā .
teṣāṃ sūryasya kaḥ kāryaḥ prāsādo bhāskarasya tu . . 3 8
sthānāni yāni coktāni prāsādasya dvijottama .
teṣāṃ tvayoktaṃ hi puraṃ vyayavadbhirnarairyutam . . 3 9
tasminpradeśe vai kāryaṃ bhānormandiramuttamam .
diśāṃ bhāge ca katame brūhi śeṣaṃ dvijottama . . 1.130.40
meaning:
साम्ब उवाच
य एते कथिता विप्र प्रासादा विंशतिस्त्वया .
तेषां सूर्यस्य कः कार्यः प्रासादो भास्करस्य तु . . 3 8
स्थानानि यानि चोक्तानि प्रासादस्य द्विजोत्तम .
तेषां त्वयोक्तं हि पुरं व्ययवद्भिर्नरैर्युतम् . . 3 9
तस्मिन्प्रदेशे वै कार्यं भानोर्मन्दिरमुत्तमम् .
दिशां भागे च कतमे ब्रूहि शेषं द्विजोत्तम . . 1.130.40
text_mt:
Sāmba said:
Among these twenty temples that have been described by you, O brāhmaṇa,
which temple should be made for Sūrya, the sun?
And as for the sites of the temple that were mentioned, O best of the twice-born,
a city endowed with men of expense was indeed spoken of by you.
In which region of it should the excellent temple of the sun be made,
and in which directional quarter? Tell me the rest, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
puramadhyaṃ samāśritya kuryādāyatanaṃ raveḥ .
diśāṃ bhāge'tha vā pūrve pūrvadvārasamīpataḥ . . 41
meaning:
नारद उवाच
पुरमध्यं समाश्रित्य कुर्यादायतनं रवेः .
दिशां भागेऽथ वा पूर्वे पूर्वद्वारसमीपतः . . 41
text_mt:
Nārada said:
Taking resort in the centre of the town one should make the temple of the sun,
or in the eastern directional quarter, near the eastern gate.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmiṃ parīkṣya pūrvaṃ tu kuryādāyatanaṃ tataḥ ' .
iṣṭagandharasopetā nimnā2 bhūmiḥ praśasyate . 42
meaning:
भूमिं परीक्ष्य पूर्वं तु कुर्यादायतनं ततः ' .
इष्टगन्धरसोपेता निम्ना2 भूमिः प्रशस्यते . 42
text_mt:
First having tested the ground, one should then make the temple.
Ground that has a pleasant smell and taste, and is sloping, is praised.

sanskrit_iast:
śarkarātuṣakeśāsthikṣārāṅgāravivarjitā .
meghadundubhinirghoṣā sarvabījaprarohiṇī . . 43
meaning:
शर्करातुषकेशास्थिक्षाराङ्गारविवर्जिता .
मेघदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषा सर्वबीजप्ररोहिणी . . 43
text_mt:
Free from gravel, chaff, hair, bones, salt, and charcoal,
resounding like clouds and war drums, and causing all seeds to sprout;

sanskrit_iast:
śuklā raktā tathā pītā kṛṣṇā ca kathitā kṣitiḥ .
dvijarājanyavaṃśyānāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca yathākramam . . 44
meaning:
शुक्ला रक्ता तथा पीता कृष्णा च कथिता क्षितिः .
द्विजराजन्यवंश्यानां शूद्राणां च यथाक्रमम् . . 44
text_mt:
the ground is proclaimed to be white, red, yellow, and black
for twice-born, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, and śūdras, respectively.

sanskrit_iast:
parīkṣitāyāṃ tasyāṃ tu madhye tasyāḥ pramāṇataḥ .
upalipya caturhastaṃ caturasraṃ ca samantataḥ . . 45
meaning:
परीक्षितायां तस्यां तु मध्ये तस्याः प्रमाणतः .
उपलिप्य चतुर्हस्तं चतुरस्रं च समन्ततः . . 45
text_mt:
When it has been examined, then in its centre, according to measure,
having smeared [a square of] four cubits that is four-sided all around,

sanskrit_iast:
hastamātramadhaḥ kṛtvā madhye tasyā daśāṅgulam .
gartamutkīrya tenaiva pāṃsunā pratipūrayet . . 46
meaning:
हस्तमात्रमधः कृत्वा मध्ये तस्या दशाङ्गुलम् .
गर्तमुत्कीर्य तेनैव पांसुना प्रतिपूरयेत् . . 46
text_mt:
having dug down a cubit, and in its centre a pit of ten inches,
one should refill it with that very earth.

sanskrit_iast:
same samaguṇā jñeyā hīne hīnaguṇā bhavet .
vardhamāne tu vai pāṃsau bhavedvṛddhikarī kṣitiḥ . . 47
meaning:
समे समगुणा ज्ञेया हीने हीनगुणा भवेत् .
वर्धमाने तु वै पांसौ भवेद्वृद्धिकरी क्षितिः . . 47
text_mt:
If it is level, it is known to have equal qualities; if diminished, it has inferior qualities;
but if the earth overflows, the ground will bring prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ sammukhamarkasya kadācitpaścimāmukham .
sthāpanīyaṃ gṛhaṃ samyakprāṅmukhasthānakalpanāt . . 48
meaning:
नित्यं सम्मुखमर्कस्य कदाचित्पश्चिमामुखम् .
स्थापनीयं गृहं सम्यक्प्राङ्मुखस्थानकल्पनात् . . 48
text_mt:
The house should always be installed directly facing the sun, sometimes facing west,
due to the arrangement of an east-facing site.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavanāddakṣiṇe pārśve raveḥ snānagṛhaṃ bhavet .
agnihotra gṛhaṃ kāryaṃ raveruttarataḥ śubham . .
udaṅmukhaṃ bhavecchambhormātṝṇāṃ gṛhameva ca . . 49
meaning:
भवनाद्दक्षिणे पार्श्वे रवेः स्नानगृहं भवेत् .
अग्निहोत्र गृहं कार्यं रवेरुत्तरतः शुभम् . .
उदङ्मुखं भवेच्छम्भोर्मातॄणां गृहमेव च . . 49

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā paścimataḥ sthāpyo viṣṇuruttaratastathā .
nimbastu dakṣiṇe pārśve vāme rājñī prakīrtitā . . 1.130.50
meaning:
ब्रह्मा पश्चिमतः स्थाप्यो विष्णुरुत्तरतस्तथा .
निम्बस्तु दक्षिणे पार्श्वे वामे राज्ञी प्रकीर्तिता . . 1.130.50
text_mt:
Brahmā should be placed to the west, and Viṣṇu likewise to the north;
Nimba is on the right side, and Rājñī is proclaimed on the left.

sanskrit_iast:
piṃgalo pakṣiṇe7 bhānorvāmato daṇḍanāyakaḥ .
śrīmahāśvetayoḥ sthānaṃ puratastvaṃśumālinaḥ . . 51
meaning:
पिंगलो पक्षिणे7 भानोर्वामतो दण्डनायकः .
श्रीमहाश्वेतयोः स्थानं पुरतस्त्वंशुमालिनः . . 51
text_mt:
Piṅgala is on the right of the sun, and the Daṇḍanāyaka on the left;
the place of Śrī and Mahāśvetā is in front of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥsthāpyāśvinoḥ sthānaṃ pūrvadevagṛhādvahiḥ .
dvitīyāyāṃ tu kakṣāyāṃ rājñāsrauṣau vyavasthitau . . 52
meaning:
ततःस्थाप्याश्विनोः स्थानं पूर्वदेवगृहाद्वहिः .
द्वितीयायां तु कक्षायां राज्ञास्रौषौ व्यवस्थितौ . . 52
text_mt:
Then the place of the two Aśvins should be established outside the first shrine;
and in the second enclosure Rājñī and Srauṣa are stationed.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyāyāṃ tu kakṣāyāṃ sthitau kalmāṣapakṣiṇau .
jaṇḍakāmacarau1 sthāpyau dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritau . . 53
meaning:
तृतीयायां तु कक्षायां स्थितौ कल्माषपक्षिणौ .
जण्डकामचरौ1 स्थाप्यौ दक्षिणां दिशमाश्रितौ . . 53
text_mt:
In the third enclosure are stationed the two Kalmāṣapakṣins;
Jaṇḍa and Kāmacara should be placed, having taken resort in the southern direction.

sanskrit_iast:
udīcyāṃ sthāpanīyastu kubero lokapūjitaḥ .
uttareṇa tatastasya revataḥ savināyakaḥ . . 54
meaning:
उदीच्यां स्थापनीयस्तु कुबेरो लोकपूजितः .
उत्तरेण ततस्तस्य रेवतः सविनायकः . . 54
text_mt:
In the north, Kubera, worshipped by the world, should be placed;
then to his north, Revanta along with Vināyaka.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra vā vidyate sthānaṃ dikṣu sarvā guhādayaḥ .
dve maṇḍale'rghyadānārthaṃ kārye savyāpasavyataḥ . . 55
meaning:
यत्र वा विद्यते स्थानं दिक्षु सर्वा गुहादयः .
द्वे मण्डलेऽर्घ्यदानार्थं कार्ये सव्यापसव्यतः . . 55
text_mt:
Or wherever there is space in all directions, Guha and the others [should be placed].
Two circles should be made for the offering of arghya, on the left and right.

sanskrit_iast:
dadyādudayavelāyāmarghaṃ sūryāya dakṣiṇe .
uttare maṇḍale dadyādarghyamastamane raveḥ . . 56
meaning:
दद्यादुदयवेलायामर्घं सूर्याय दक्षिणे .
उत्तरे मण्डले दद्यादर्घ्यमस्तमने रवेः . . 56
text_mt:
One should give the arghya to Sūrya at the hour of sunrise in the southern [circle];
in the northern circle one should give the arghya at the setting of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
cakrākṛtāṃ tathānyasmindevasya pratimāṃ raveḥ .
sthāpayedvidhivadvīra caturbhiḥ kalaśaiḥ śubhaiḥ . . 57
meaning:
चक्राकृतां तथान्यस्मिन्देवस्य प्रतिमां रवेः .
स्थापयेद्विधिवद्वीर चतुर्भिः कलशैः शुभैः . . 57
text_mt:
In another [circle], in the shape of a wheel, one should install the image
of the divine sun according to rule, O hero, with four auspicious water pots,

sanskrit_iast:
nānātūryaninādaiśca śaṅkhaśabdaiśca puṣkalaiḥ .
tṛtīye maṇḍale hyeva pūjanīyo divākaraḥ . . 58
meaning:
नानातूर्यनिनादैश्च शङ्खशब्दैश्च पुष्कलैः .
तृतीये मण्डले ह्येव पूजनीयो दिवाकरः . . 58
text_mt:
to the sounds of various instruments and plentiful sounds of conches;
for the sun is to be worshipped in the third circle.

sanskrit_iast:
caturasraṃ catuḥśṛṅgaṃ vyoma devagṛhāgrataḥ .
pratimāyāstu sūtreṇa kāryaṃ madhye'sya maṇḍalam . . 59
meaning:
चतुरस्रं चतुःशृङ्गं व्योम देवगृहाग्रतः .
प्रतिमायास्तु सूत्रेण कार्यं मध्येऽस्य मण्डलम् . . 59
text_mt:
A four-sided canopy with four pinnacles [should be] in front of the shrine;
and with a cord from the image a circle should be made in its centre.

sanskrit_iast:
diṇḍī sthāpyaḥ purastasmādādityābhimukhaḥ sthitaḥ .
yadetatkathitaṃ vyoma sarvadevamayaṃ mayā . . 1.130.60
meaning:
दिण्डी स्थाप्यः पुरस्तस्मादादित्याभिमुखः स्थितः .
यदेतत्कथितं व्योम सर्वदेवमयं मया . . 1.130.60
text_mt:
Diṇḍī should be placed in front of it, standing facing the sun.
As for this canopy that I have declared to consist of all deities,

sanskrit_iast:
madhyāhne tasya dātavyamarghyamatra yadūttama .
atha vā maṇḍalaṃ cānyattṛtīyaṃ cakrasammitama5 . . 61
meaning:
मध्याह्ने तस्य दातव्यमर्घ्यमत्र यदूत्तम .
अथ वा मण्डलं चान्यत्तृतीयं चक्रसम्मितम5 . . 61
text_mt:
at midday the arghya should be given to him there, O best of the Yadus.
Or else another third circle measuring a wheel [should be made];

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpayitvā tu deveśaṃ dātavyo'rghaḥ supaṇḍitaiḥ .
devasya purataḥ kāryaṃ vyomasthānaṃ samīpataḥ . .
pustakavācanasthānamatha vā yatra rocate . . 62
meaning:
स्थापयित्वा तु देवेशं दातव्योऽर्घः सुपण्डितैः .
देवस्य पुरतः कार्यं व्योमस्थानं समीपतः . .
पुस्तकवाचनस्थानमथ वा यत्र रोचते . . 62
text_mt:
having installed the lord of gods, the arghya should be given by the very learned.
In front of the deity, close by, the place for the canopy should be made,
or wherever one pleases, a place for reading the scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa sthānavidhiḥ prokto devatānāṃ yathākramam .
gṛharājño'tha rudrastu dvāvetau bhāskarapriyau . . 63
meaning:
एष स्थानविधिः प्रोक्तो देवतानां यथाक्रमम् .
गृहराज्ञोऽथ रुद्रस्तु द्वावेतौ भास्करप्रियौ . . 63
text_mt:
This rule of placement of the deities has been declared in due order.
Now, Gṛharāja and Rudra, these two are dear to the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sāmbopākhyāne
prāsādalakṣaṇavarṇanaṃ nāma triṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ . 130 .
dāruparīkṣāvarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे साम्बोपाख्याने
प्रासादलक्षणवर्णनं नाम त्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः . 130 .
दारुपरीक्षावर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus, in the holy Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa, in the Brāhmaparvan, in the Saptamīkalpa, in the narrative of Sāmba,
the one hundred and thirtieth chapter, entitled "Description of the Characteristics of Temples."
Description of the Examination of Wood

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
atha te sampravakṣyāmi pratimāvidhivistaram .
sarveṣāmeva devānāmādityasya viśeṣataḥ . . 1
meaning:
नारद उवाच
अथ ते सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रतिमाविधिविस्तरम् .
सर्वेषामेव देवानामादित्यस्य विशेषतः . . 1
text_mt:
Nārada said:
Now I shall explain to you in detail the rules for making images
of all the deities, and especially of the sun.
title: Dāruparīkṣāvarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
arcā1 saptavidhā proktā bhaktānāṃ śubhavṛddhaye .
kāñcanī rājatī tāmrī pārthivī śailajā smṛtā . . 2
meaning:
अर्चा1 सप्तविधा प्रोक्ता भक्तानां शुभवृद्धये .
काञ्चनी राजती ताम्री पार्थिवी शैलजा स्मृता . . 2
text_mt:
The image is proclaimed to be of seven kinds, for the increase of the welfare of devotees:
golden, silver, copper, earthen, and made of stone;

sanskrit_iast:
vārkṣī cālekhyakā ceti mūtisthānāni sapta vai .
vārkṣīvidhānaṃ te vīra varṇayiṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ . . 3
meaning:
वार्क्षी चालेख्यका चेति मूतिस्थानानि सप्त वै .
वार्क्षीविधानं ते वीर वर्णयिष्याम्यशेषतः . . 3
text_mt:
and made of wood, and painted—these are indeed the seven sites of forms.
I shall describe to you in full, O hero, the rule regarding wooden [images].

sanskrit_iast:
kartranukūle divase saṃvatsaraviśodhite .
śubhairnimittaiḥ śakunaiḥ prasthānaiśca vanaṃ viśet . . 4
meaning:
कर्त्रनुकूले दिवसे संवत्सरविशोधिते .
शुभैर्निमित्तैः शकुनैः प्रस्थानैश्च वनं विशेत् . . 4
text_mt:
On a day favourable to the maker, verified in the year,
with auspicious portents, omens, and journeys, one should enter the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīriṇo varjitāḥ sarve durbalāste svabhāvataḥ .
catuṣpatheṣu na grāhyā ye ca putrakavṛkṣakāḥ2 . . 5
meaning:
क्षीरिणो वर्जिताः सर्वे दुर्बलास्ते स्वभावतः .
चतुष्पथेषु न ग्राह्या ये च पुत्रकवृक्षकाः2 . . 5
text_mt: All milky trees are excluded, for they are weak by nature; / nor should those at crossroads be taken, or saplings.

sanskrit_iast:
devatāyatanasthā ye tathā valmīkasambhavā .
utkīrṇā devatā yeṣu caityavṛkṣāśca ye smṛtāḥ . . 6
meaning:
देवतायतनस्था ये तथा वल्मीकसम्भवा .
उत्कीर्णा देवता येषु चैत्यवृक्षाश्च ये स्मृताः . . 6
text_mt: Those standing in temples of deities, likewise those grown on ant-hills, / those on which deities are carved, and those recorded as caitya trees;

sanskrit_iast:
śmaśānabhūmijā ye ca pakṣiṇāṃ nilayāśca ye .
sakoṭarāśca ye vṛkṣāḥ śuṣkāgrā ye ca pādapāḥ . . 7
meaning:
श्मशानभूमिजा ये च पक्षिणां निलयाश्च ये .
सकोटराश्च ये वृक्षाः शुष्काग्रा ये च पादपाः . . 7
text_mt: those growing in cremation grounds, and those that are dwellings for birds, / hollow trees, and trees with withered tops;

sanskrit_iast:
śastreṇa nihatā ye ca kuñjarāśāstathā kṛtāḥ .
sāmādyāḥ sarujo'dhaśca vyādhinaśca tathaiva ca . . 8
meaning:
शस्त्रेण निहता ये च कुञ्जराशास्तथा कृताः .
सामाद्याः सरुजोऽधश्च व्याधिनश्च तथैव च . . 8
text_mt: those struck by weapons, and likewise those broken by elephants, / those [diseased] from base upwards, diseased below, and likewise those afflicted with disease;

sanskrit_iast:
akāle puṣpitā ye ca kāle te ca vivarjitāḥ .
śīrṇaparṇāśca taravo rakṣodhvāṃkṣaniṣevitāḥ . .
ekaśākhātiśākhāśca triśākhāśca tathādhamāḥ . . 9
meaning:
अकाले पुष्पिता ये च काले ते च विवर्जिताः .
शीर्णपर्णाश्च तरवो रक्षोध्वांक्षनिषेविताः . .
एकशाखातिशाखाश्च त्रिशाखाश्च तथाधमाः . . 9
text_mt: those flowering out of season, and those destitute [of blossoms] in season, / trees with withered leaves, frequented by demons and crows, / single-branched, overly branched, or three-branched—these are vile.

sanskrit_iast:
madhūko devadāruśca vṛkṣarājaśca candanaḥ .
bilvaścāmrātakaścaiva khadirothāñjanastathā . . 1.131.10
meaning:
मधूको देवदारुश्च वृक्षराजश्च चन्दनः .
बिल्वश्चाम्रातकश्चैव खदिरोथाञ्जनस्तथा . . 1.131.10
text_mt: The madhūka, the devadāru, the sandalwood tree—the king of trees— / the bilva, the āmrātaka, the khadira, and then the añjana;

sanskrit_iast:
nimbaḥ śrīparṇavṛkṣaśca panasaḥ saralo'rjjunaḥ .
raktacandanaparyantāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ syuḥ pratimādrumāḥ . . 11
meaning:
निम्बः श्रीपर्णवृक्षश्च पनसः सरलोऽर्ज्जुनः .
रक्तचन्दनपर्यन्ताः श्रेष्ठाः स्युः प्रतिमाद्रुमाः . . 11
text_mt: the nimba, the śrīparṇī tree, the jackfruit, the sarala, the arjuna, / up to red sandalwood—these are the best trees for images.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇānāmānupūrvyeṇa dvau dvau vṛkṣau prakīrtitau .
nimbādyāḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ vṛkṣā sādhāraṇāḥ smṛtāḥ . . 12
meaning:
वर्णानामानुपूर्व्येण द्वौ द्वौ वृक्षौ प्रकीर्तितौ .
निम्बाद्याः सर्ववर्णानां वृक्षा साधारणाः स्मृताः . . 12
text_mt: Two trees are prescribed in regular order for each of the castes; / trees beginning with nimba are recorded as common to all castes.

sanskrit_iast:
kathyamānānviśeṣeṇa śṛṇu vīra tathāparān .
suradāruḥ śamī caiva madhūkaścandanastathā . .
ete vai taravastāta brāhmaṇānāṃ śubhāḥ smṛtāḥ . . 13
meaning:
कथ्यमानान्विशेषेण शृणु वीर तथापरान् .
सुरदारुः शमी चैव मधूकश्चन्दनस्तथा . .
एते वै तरवस्तात ब्राह्मणानां शुभाः स्मृताः . . 13
text_mt: Listen, hero, to others being spoken of specifically: / the devadāru, the śamī, the madhūka, and sandalwood— / these trees, my dear, are recorded as auspicious for brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatrasya ca tathāriṣṭaḥ khadirastindukastathā .
aśvatthaśca tathā sāmba drumaḥ karakataḥ śubhaḥ . . 14
meaning:
क्षत्रस्य च तथारिष्टः खदिरस्तिन्दुकस्तथा .
अश्वत्थश्च तथा साम्ब द्रुमः करकतः शुभः . . 14
text_mt: For the kṣatriya, the ariṣṭa, the khadira, and the tinduka; / and the aśvattha likewise, O Sāmba, is an auspicious tree […].

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśyānāṃ tadvadeva syuḥ khadiraścandanastathā .
puṇyāśca taravaścaite śubhadāstu tathaiva ca . . 15
meaning:
वैश्यानां तद्वदेव स्युः खदिरश्चन्दनस्तथा .
पुण्याश्च तरवश्चैते शुभदास्तु तथैव च . . 15
text_mt: For vaiśyas, in the same manner, the khadira and sandalwood / are sacred trees, and likewise bestow good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
kesaraḥ sarjakaścāmraḥ śālavṛkṣastathetaraḥ .
ete vai taravaḥ puṇyāḥ śūdrāṇāṃ śubhadāyakāḥ . . 16
meaning:
केसरः सर्जकश्चाम्रः शालवृक्षस्तथेतरः .
एते वै तरवः पुण्याः शूद्राणां शुभदायकाः . . 16
text_mt: The kesara, the sarja, the mango, the śāla tree, and others: / these sacred trees bestow good fortune on śūdras.

sanskrit_iast:
liṅgaṃ ca pratimāṃ caivamavasthāpya yathāvidhi .
vṛkṣaṃ cābhimataṃ gatvā pūjayedbalipuṣpakaiḥ . . 17
meaning:
लिङ्गं च प्रतिमां चैवमवस्थाप्य यथाविधि .
वृक्षं चाभिमतं गत्वा पूजयेद्बलिपुष्पकैः . . 17
text_mt: Having thus determined [the material for] the liṅga and the image according to rule, / one should approach the desired tree and worship it with offerings and flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
śucau deśe vivikte ca keśāṃgāravivarjite .
prāgudaksūcake deśe lokakaṣṭavivarjite . . 18
meaning:
शुचौ देशे विविक्ते च केशांगारविवर्जिते .
प्रागुदक्सूचके देशे लोककष्टविवर्जिते . . 18
text_mt: in a pure and secluded place, free of hair and charcoal, / in an area sloping towards the east and north, free from hardship to people,

sanskrit_iast:
vistīrṇaskandhaviṭapaḥ ṣatravānṛjuvṛddhigaḥ .
ātaṅkahīno vivaśaḥ sattvakparṇaḥ śubhastathā . 19
meaning:
विस्तीर्णस्कन्धविटपः षत्रवानृजुवृद्धिगः .
आतङ्कहीनो विवशः सत्त्वक्पर्णः शुभस्तथा . 19
text_mt: having broad trunk and boughs, crowned with foliage, growing straight, / free of disease, independent, endowed with excellent bark and leaves, and auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
svenaiva patitā ye ca hastibhiḥ pātitāstathā .
śuklāśca vahnidagdhāśca pakṣibhiścāpi varjitāḥ . . 1.131.20
meaning:
स्वेनैव पतिता ये च हस्तिभिः पातितास्तथा .
शुक्लाश्च वह्निदग्धाश्च पक्षिभिश्चापि वर्जिताः . . 1.131.20
text_mt: Those that have fallen of their own accord, and those felled by elephants, / white ones, those burned by fire, and those abandoned by birds—

sanskrit_iast:
taravo varjanīyāśca grahītavyāḥ śubhā drumāḥ .
snigdharūpāḥ saparṇāśra sapuṣpāḥ saphalāstathā . . 21
meaning:
तरवो वर्जनीयाश्च ग्रहीतव्याः शुभा द्रुमाः .
स्निग्धरूपाः सपर्णाश्र सपुष्पाः सफलास्तथा . . 21
text_mt: such trees are to be avoided, while auspicious trees are to be taken: / glossy in appearance, with leaves, flowers, and fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ tu grahaṇaṃ cāṣṭamāseṣu kārttikādiṣu .
bhūtvā śubhadine caiva sopavāso'dhivāsayet . . 22
meaning:
तेषां तु ग्रहणं चाष्टमासेषु कार्त्तिकादिषु .
भूत्वा शुभदिने चैव सोपवासोऽधिवासयेत् . . 22
text_mt: The harvesting of them should be in the eight months beginning with Kārttika; / having fasted on an auspicious day, one should perform the preparatory rite.

sanskrit_iast:
samantādupalipyātha tasyādhastādvasundharām .
gāyatryā paripūtena paritaḥ prokṣya vāriṇā . . 23
meaning:
समन्तादुपलिप्याथ तस्याधस्ताद्वसुन्धराम् .
गायत्र्या परिपूतेन परितः प्रोक्ष्य वारिणा . . 23
text_mt: Then, having smeared the earth beneath it all around, / and having sprinkled water purified by the Gāyatrī all around;

sanskrit_iast:
śukle ca paridhūte ca paridhāya ca1 vāsasī .
pūjayedgandhamālyaiśca sadhūpabalikarmabhiḥ . . 24
meaning:
शुक्ले च परिधूते च परिधाय च1 वाससी .
पूजयेद्गन्धमाल्यैश्च सधूपबलिकर्मभिः . . 24
text_mt: having put on two white and clean garments, / one should worship it with fragrant pastes and garlands, accompanied by incense and offering-rites.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kuśaiḥ paristīrṇe hutvāgnau tasya cāntike .
devadārusamidbhiśca mantreṇānena tattvavit . . 25
meaning:
ततः कुशैः परिस्तीर्णे हुत्वाग्नौ तस्य चान्तिके .
देवदारुसमिद्भिश्च मन्त्रेणानेन तत्त्ववित् . . 25
text_mt: Then, having offered into fire scattered around with kuśa grass near it, / with kindling of devadāru, the knower of truth, with this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ suvariti tato vṛkṣaṃ ca pūjayet .
oṃ prajāpataye satyasadāya nityaṃ śreṣṭhantarātmantsacarācarātman . .
sānnidhyamasminkuru deva vṛkṣe sūryāvṛtaṃ maṇḍalamāviśeśca namaḥ . . 26
meaning:
ओं भूर्भुवः सुवरिति ततो वृक्षं च पूजयेत् .
