meaning:
वसेत्तां रजनीं तत्र स्तूयमानश्चतुदिशम् .
ब्राह्मणैर्बन्दिभिश्चापि गीतज्ञैश्चारणैस्तथा . . 42
text_mt: he should dwell there for that night, being praised on all four sides / by brahmins, bards, and bards skilled in song.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ tatra sūryabhaktisamanvitaiḥ .
prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāṃ bodhayedṛgvidhānataḥ . . 43
meaning:
कुर्याज्जागरणं तत्र सूर्यभक्तिसमन्वितैः .
प्रभातायां तु शर्वर्यां बोधयेदृग्विधानतः . . 43
text_mt: He should keep vigil there together with those devoted to the sun; / and when the night has turned to dawn, he should awaken him according to the Ṛgvedic ritual rule.

sanskrit_iast:
haviṣyaṃ bhoktukāmāṃstu brāhmaṇānbhojakāṃstathā .
dakṣiṇābhiśca sampūjya taiḥ kṛtasvastivācanaḥ . .44
meaning:
हविष्यं भोक्तुकामांस्तु ब्राह्मणान्भोजकांस्तथा .
दक्षिणाभिश्च सम्पूज्य तैः कृतस्वस्तिवाचनः . .44
text_mt: Having honoured the brahmins and Bhojakas who wish to eat sacrificial food / with priestly gifts, and having had blessings pronounced by them,

sanskrit_iast:
tato garbhagṛhasthāya madhye kṛtvā tu piṇḍikām .
vidhivattatra sauvarṇaṃ nyasetsaptahayaṃ ratham . .45
meaning:
ततो गर्भगृहस्थाय मध्ये कृत्वा तु पिण्डिकाम् .
विधिवत्तत्र सौवर्णं न्यसेत्सप्तहयं रथम् . .45
text_mt: then, having made a pedestal in the middle for [the god] standing in the inner sanctum, / he should duly place there a golden chariot with seven horses.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabījauṣadhaiścaiva tatra dhṛtvā vidhānavit .
dattvārghyaṃ sthāpayettatra yajamānaḥ sahāyavān . . 46 śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣairjaladhārāsahākṣataiḥ .
kṛtyā puṇyāhaśabdaṃ tu ālayasya pradakṣiṇām . .47
meaning:
सर्वबीजौषधैश्चैव तत्र धृत्वा विधानवित् .
दत्त्वार्घ्यं स्थापयेत्तत्र यजमानः सहायवान् . . 46 शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषैर्जलधारासहाक्षतैः .
कृत्या पुण्याहशब्दं तु आलयस्य प्रदक्षिणाम् . .47
text_mt: The ritual expert, holding [an offering] there with all seeds and herbs, / having given water offering, the patron of the sacrifice accompanied by assistants should install [the god] there / amidst the sounds of conches and war drums, accompanied by streams of water and unbroken grains, / having uttered auspicious day blessings and made circumambulation of the temple.

sanskrit_iast:
śubhalagne dine ṛkṣe pūrvāhṇe bhānave kṣaṇe .
muhūrte ca śubhe bhānoḥ pratimāṃ sthāpayedbudhaḥ . .48
meaning:
शुभलग्ने दिने ऋक्षे पूर्वाह्णे भानवे क्षणे .
मुहूर्ते च शुभे भानोः प्रतिमां स्थापयेद्बुधः . .48
text_mt: Under an auspicious ascendant, day, and lunar mansion, in the forenoon, at a moment sacred to the sun, / and at an auspicious hour, the wise man should install the image of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
nādhomukhīṃ nordhvamukhīṃ na pārśvāvanatāṃ tathā .
samāmabhimukhīṃ cemāṃ pratimāṃ tu niveśayet . .49
meaning:
नाधोमुखीं नोर्ध्वमुखीं न पार्श्वावनतां तथा .
समामभिमुखीं चेमां प्रतिमां तु निवेशयेत् . .49
text_mt: Neither facing downwards, nor facing upwards, nor tilted to the side; / he should set up this image level and facing forward.

sanskrit_iast:
patnyau cāsya tataḥ samyakpārśvayorviniveśayet .
nikṣubhā dakṣiṇe pārśve rave rājñī tu vāmataḥ . . 1.136.50
meaning:
पत्न्यौ चास्य ततः सम्यक्पार्श्वयोर्विनिवेशयेत् .
निक्षुभा दक्षिणे पार्श्वे रवे राज्ञी तु वामतः . . 1.136.50
text_mt: Then he should properly install his two wives at his sides: / Nikṣubhā on the right side of the sun, and Rājñī on the left.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastadupahārārthaṃ sambhāraṃ prāktamāhṛtaiḥ .
modakāyūṣikāpūpaśaṣkulībhūtaśīrṣakaiḥ . . 51
meaning:
ततस्तदुपहारार्थं सम्भारं प्राक्तमाहृतैः .
मोदकायूषिकापूपशष्कुलीभूतशीर्षकैः . . 51
text_mt: Then, for his offering, with the provisions previously brought— / modakas, soups, cakes, twisted pastries, and round confections,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛśaraiḥ pāyasonmiśraiḥ sarvadikṣu kṣipedbalim .
indrāya devapataye baline vajrapāṇaye . .5 2
śatayajñādhipataye tasmai indrāya te namaḥ .
trātāramindramantreṇa indrasyāvāhanaṃ bhavet . . 53
meaning:
कृशरैः पायसोन्मिश्रैः सर्वदिक्षु क्षिपेद्बलिम् .
इन्द्राय देवपतये बलिने वज्रपाणये . .5 2
शतयज्ञाधिपतये तस्मै इन्द्राय ते नमः .
त्रातारमिन्द्रमन्त्रेण इन्द्रस्यावाहनं भवेत् . . 53
text_mt: and spiced rice mixed with milk rice—he should cast the offering in all directions: / 'To Indra, lord of the gods, the mighty one who holds the thunderbolt in hand, / the lord of a hundred sacrifices—to that Indra, homage to you!' / The invocation of Indra should be with the mantra 'trātāram indram...'

sanskrit_iast:
agnaye raktanetrāya jvālāmālārcitāya vai .
śaktihastāya tīvrāya tathā caivājavāhine . .
āgreyyāmagrimantreṇa vahnerāvāhanaṃ smṛtam . . 54
meaning:
अग्नये रक्तनेत्राय ज्वालामालार्चिताय वै .
शक्तिहस्ताय तीव्राय तथा चैवाजवाहिने . .
आग्रेय्यामग्रिमन्त्रेण वह्नेरावाहनं स्मृतम् . . 54
text_mt: To Agni, who has red eyes, who is worshiped with garlands of flames, / who has a spear in hand, the fierce one, and whose mount is a ram— / in the south-east, the invocation of fire is recorded with the fire mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍahastāya kṛṣṇāya mahiṣottamavāhine .
sūryaputrāya devāya dharmarājāya vai namaḥ . . 55
meaning:
दण्डहस्ताय कृष्णाय महिषोत्तमवाहिने .
सूर्यपुत्राय देवाय धर्मराजाय वै नमः . . 55
text_mt: To the one who holds a staff in hand, the dark one, whose mount is the excellent buffalo, / to the god who is the son of the sun, to the King of Dharma, homage!

sanskrit_iast:
yamāya tviti mantreṇa mudrāstasyaiva kīrtitāḥ .
nairṛte khaḍgahastāya nīlalohitakāya ca . . 56
meaning:
यमाय त्विति मन्त्रेण मुद्रास्तस्यैव कीर्तिताः .
नैरृते खड्गहस्ताय नीललोहितकाय च . . 56
text_mt: With the mantra 'yamāya tvā...', his mudrās are proclaimed. / In the south-west, to the one who holds a sword in hand, blue and red,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabāhyādhipataye virūpākhyāya vai namaḥ .
āyaṃ gauriti mantreṇa nairṛtyāṃ tu prakalpayet ..57
meaning:
सर्वबाह्याधिपतये विरूपाख्याय वै नमः .
आयं गौरिति मन्त्रेण नैरृत्यां तु प्रकल्पयेत् ..57
text_mt: to the lord of all the outer [beings], who is named Virūpa, homage! / With the mantra 'āyaṃ gauḥ...', he should perform [the invocation] in the south-west.

sanskrit_iast:
vāruṇyāṃ pāśahastāya varuṇāyeti kalpayet .
mantreṇāvāhanaṃ vidyātpañcanadyaḥ sarasvatīm ..58
meaning:
वारुण्यां पाशहस्ताय वरुणायेति कल्पयेत् .
मन्त्रेणावाहनं विद्यात्पञ्चनद्यः सरस्वतीम् ..58
text_mt: In the west, he should invoke Varuṇa, who holds a noose in hand, with 'To Varuṇa...' / He should know the invocation to be with the mantra 'pañca nadyaḥ sarasvatīm...'

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇātmakāya dhūpāya avyaṅgāyānilāya ca .
dhvajahastāya bhīmāya namo gandhavahāya ca ..59
meaning:
प्राणात्मकाय धूपाय अव्यङ्गायानिलाय च .
ध्वजहस्ताय भीमाय नमो गन्धवहाय च ..59
text_mt: To the one whose self is breath, to the incense, to the wind that is whole, / to the terrible one who holds a banner in hand, homage to the bearer of fragrance!

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāpyāvāhanaṃ vidyādyaddevādevaheḍanam .
gadāhastāya somāya śuṣmiṇe nṛgatāya ca ..1.136.6 0
gadāpaṭṭiśahastāya somarājāya vai namaḥ .
īśāvāsyaṃ ca guhyā vai somamantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..6 1
caturmukhāya devāya padmāsanagatāya ca .
kṛṣṇājinaniṣaṇṇāya namo lambodarāya ca ..62
meaning:
तस्याप्यावाहनं विद्याद्यद्देवादेवहेडनम् .
गदाहस्ताय सोमाय शुष्मिणे नृगताय च ..1.136.6 0
गदापट्टिशहस्ताय सोमराजाय वै नमः .
ईशावास्यं च गुह्या वै सोममन्त्रः प्रकीर्तितः ..6 1
चतुर्मुखाय देवाय पद्मासनगताय च .
कृष्णाजिननिषण्णाय नमो लम्बोदराय च ..62
text_mt: His invocation too should be known with 'yad devā devaheḍanam...'; / to Soma, who holds a mace in hand, the strong one, who has gone among men, / to the one who holds a mace and a spear in hand, to King Soma, homage! / The Īśāvāsya [and] secret [text] is proclaimed as the Soma mantra. / To the four-faced god, seated on a lotus throne, / seated upon a black antelope skin, and to the pot-bellied one, homage!

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇādhipataye deva nīlakaṇṭhāya śūline .
virūpākṣāya rudrāya trailokyādhipate namaḥ ..
abhi tvā śūra no mantra īśānāya prakalpayet ..6 3
sarvanāgādhirājāya śvetavarṇāya bhogine .
sahasraphaṇine nityamanantāya namonamaḥ ..64
meaning:
गणाधिपतये देव नीलकण्ठाय शूलिने .
विरूपाक्षाय रुद्राय त्रैलोक्याधिपते नमः ..
अभि त्वा शूर नो मन्त्र ईशानाय प्रकल्पयेत् ..6 3
सर्वनागाधिराजाय श्वेतवर्णाय भोगिने .
सहस्रफणिने नित्यमनन्ताय नमोनमः ..64
text_mt: To the lord of the hosts, O god, to the blue-throated, trident-bearing, / odd-eyed Rudra, to the sovereign of the three worlds, homage! / With the mantra 'abhi tvā śūra no...', he should perform [the invocation] for Īśāna. / To the sovereign king of all serpents, white-coloured, possessing coils, / with a thousand hoods, homage, homage forever to Ananta!

sanskrit_iast:
namo'stu sarpebhya iti mantraścaiva prakīrtitaḥ .
pañcarātrādibhirnyāso hyaṃganyāsaḥ prayujyate ..65
meaning:
नमोऽस्तु सर्पेभ्य इति मन्त्रश्चैव प्रकीर्तितः .
पञ्चरात्रादिभिर्न्यासो ह्यंगन्यासः प्रयुज्यते ..65
text_mt: And the mantra 'namo'stu sarpebhyaḥ...' is proclaimed. / Ritual placement with the Pañcarātra [mantras] and so forth, and placement on the limbs, is performed.

sanskrit_iast:
tathopakṣīrapānaiśca stutistotraiśca bhāskaram .
viprebhyo bhojakebhyaśca tato dadyācca dakṣiṇām ..66
meaning:
तथोपक्षीरपानैश्च स्तुतिस्तोत्रैश्च भास्करम् .
विप्रेभ्यो भोजकेभ्यश्च ततो दद्याच्च दक्षिणाम् ..66
text_mt: Likewise, [worshipping] the sun with milk drinks and with praises and hymns, / he should then give priestly gifts to the brahmins and Bhojakas.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryakratuṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ naiva kuryādadakṣiṇam .
sthāpyate'nena vidhinā tadbhaktaiḥ pratimā ca yā ..67
meaning:
सूर्यक्रतुं महापुण्यं नैव कुर्याददक्षिणम् .
स्थाप्यतेऽनेन विधिना तद्भक्तैः प्रतिमा च या ..67
text_mt: One should never perform the greatly meritorious sacrifice to the sun without priestly gifts. / And whatever image is installed according to this rule by his devotees,

sanskrit_iast:
sā tu vṛddhikarā nityaṃ sānnidhyācca sadā bhavet .
saptajanmasu teṣāṃ tu na rogāḥ sambhavanti hi ..68
meaning:
सा तु वृद्धिकरा नित्यं सान्निध्याच्च सदा भवेत् .
सप्तजन्मसु तेषां तु न रोगाः सम्भवन्ति हि ..68
text_mt: it brings prosperity constantly and ever ensures [his] presence; / indeed, no diseases arise for them throughout seven births.

sanskrit_iast:
upāsate trirātraṃ ye bhānoryātrābhivāsane .
gandhamālyopahāraistu te yānti bhuvanaṃ raveḥ ..69
meaning:
उपासते त्रिरात्रं ये भानोर्यात्राभिवासने .
गन्धमाल्योपहारैस्तु ते यान्ति भुवनं रवेः ..69
text_mt: Those who worship for three nights at the preliminary consecration of the procession of the sun / with offerings of scents and garlands go to the realm of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmīyaṃ parakīyaṃ vā pratimāsthāpanaṃ raveḥ .
yaḥ paśyati pumānbhaktyā sa svarlokamavāpnuyāt . . 1.136.70
meaning:
आत्मीयं परकीयं वा प्रतिमास्थापनं रवेः .
यः पश्यति पुमान्भक्त्या स स्वर्लोकमवाप्नुयात् . . 1.136.70
text_mt: A man who looks with devotion upon the installation of an image of the sun, / whether his own or another's, attains the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ vājapeyaśatasya ca .
phalaṃ prāpnoti puruṣaḥ pratiṣṭhāpya divākaram . . 71
meaning:
दशानामश्वमेधानां वाजपेयशतस्य च .
फलं प्राप्नोति पुरुषः प्रतिष्ठाप्य दिवाकरम् . . 71
text_mt: A man obtains the fruit of ten horse-sacrifices and a hundred vājapeya sacrifices / by establishing the Maker of Day.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvatkīrtiḥ puṇyakṛtā bhānoḥ sthāne niveśite .
tāvatsa tu yaduśreṣṭha sūryaloke mahīyate . . 72
meaning:
यावत्कीर्तिः पुण्यकृता भानोः स्थाने निवेशिते .
तावत्स तु यदुश्रेष्ठ सूर्यलोके महीयते . . 72
text_mt: As long as the fame made by his merit remains in the place established for the Sun, / so long, O best of the Yadus, is he exalted in the world of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpane cāsya vai mantraḥ prokto lokeṣu pūjitaḥ .
dhruvā dyauśca dhruvā pṛthvī dhruvaṃ viśvamidaṃ jagat . .
śreyase yajamānasya tathā tvaṃ dhruvatāṃ vraja . . 73
meaning:
स्थापने चास्य वै मन्त्रः प्रोक्तो लोकेषु पूजितः .
ध्रुवा द्यौश्च ध्रुवा पृथ्वी ध्रुवं विश्वमिदं जगत् . .
श्रेयसे यजमानस्य तथा त्वं ध्रुवतां व्रज . . 73
text_mt: And the mantra proclaimed for his installation is revered in the worlds: / 'Firm is heaven and firm is the earth, firm is this whole universe; / likewise, attain firmness for the welfare of the patron of the sacrifice.'

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpayitvā raviṃ bhaktyā vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā .
māse māse ṛtuphalaṃ labhante nātra saṃśayaḥ . . 74
meaning:
स्थापयित्वा रविं भक्त्या विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा .
मासे मासे ऋतुफलं लभन्ते नात्र संशयः . . 74
text_mt: Having installed the Sun with devotion through rites observed by the rules, / month after month they obtain the fruit of the seasons; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāhenāpi yadbhānoḥ pūjayā prāpyate phalam .
na tu kratuśatairvīra prāpyate mānavairbhuvi . . 75
meaning:
एकाहेनापि यद्भानोः पूजया प्राप्यते फलम् .
न तु क्रतुशतैर्वीर प्राप्यते मानवैर्भुवि . . 75
text_mt: The fruit that is obtained through worship of the Sun even for a single day / is not attained on earth by mortals through hundreds of sacrificial rites, O hero.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvāpi sumahatpāpaṃ yaḥ paścātsevate ravim .
sa yāti sūryalokaṃ tu naro vigatakalmaṣaḥ . . 76
meaning:
कृत्वापि सुमहत्पापं यः पश्चात्सेवते रविम् .
स याति सूर्यलोकं तु नरो विगतकल्मषः . . 76
text_mt: Even having committed a very great sin, a man who afterwards serves the Sun / goes to the world of the Sun, freed from stain.

sanskrit_iast:
na bhavediṣṭakānāṃ ca dravaṇaṃ bhūmisaṃmiti .
svarge mahīyate tāvatkārako devaveśmanaḥ . . 77
meaning:
न भवेदिष्टकानां च द्रवणं भूमिसंमिति .
स्वर्गे महीयते तावत्कारको देववेश्मनः . . 77
text_mt: As long as the melting away of the bricks to the measure of the earth does not take place, / so long is the maker of the house of the god exalted in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
khaṇḍasphuṭitasaṃskāraṃ kṛtvā yatphalamāpyate .
na tu kratusahasraistu prāpyate phalamuttamam . . 78
meaning:
खण्डस्फुटितसंस्कारं कृत्वा यत्फलमाप्यते .
न तु क्रतुसहस्रैस्तु प्राप्यते फलमुत्तमम् . . 78
text_mt: The fruit that is obtained by restoring broken and cracked [parts] / is not obtained, that supreme fruit, through thousands of sacrificial rites.

sanskrit_iast:
sikatāyāmapi gṛhaṃ yastu kuryādvibhāvasoḥ .
gopateḥ sa priyasadaḥ pragacchedgopatervaram . . 79
meaning:
सिकतायामपि गृहं यस्तु कुर्याद्विभावसोः .
गोपतेः स प्रियसदः प्रगच्छेद्गोपतेर्वरम् . . 79
text_mt: He who constructs a house for the Sun even out of sand / becomes a dear resident of the Lord of Rays, and goes to the supreme abode of the Lord of Rays.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ suravarasya tasya bhānorbhūtānāṃ sthitinilayaprasūtihetoḥ .
śrībhāgī bhavati naro niketakārī kalpānāṃ vasati śataṃ sa sūryaloke . . 1.136.80
pratiṣṭhāpanavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
इत्येवं सुरवरस्य तस्य भानोर्भूतानां स्थितिनिलयप्रसूतिहेतोः .
श्रीभागी भवति नरो निकेतकारी कल्पानां वसति शतं स सूर्यलोके . . 1.136.80
प्रतिष्ठापनविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
In this manner, the man who builds a dwelling for that excellent god, the Sun, the cause of the preservation, dissolution, and origin of all beings, / becomes a possessor of fortune and dwells for a hundred kalpas in the world of the Sun.
Description of the Rite of Installation

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
yaḥ prāsādaṃ racayati pumāndevatānāṃ prayatnāttatra prītyā sapadi kurute sthāpanāṃ bhānubhaktaḥ .
divyānbhogām̐llabhati ca sadā kāmataścāprameyāṃstānbhuktvāsau punarapi bhaveccakravartī pṛthivyām . . 1
meaning:
नारद उवाच
यः प्रासादं रचयति पुमान्देवतानां प्रयत्नात्तत्र प्रीत्या सपदि कुरुते स्थापनां भानुभक्तः .
दिव्यान्भोगाम्̐ल्लभति च सदा कामतश्चाप्रमेयांस्तान्भुक्त्वासौ पुनरपि भवेच्चक्रवर्ती पृथिव्याम् . . 1
text_mt: Nārada said: / The man who with effort builds a temple for the deities, and, as a devotee of the Sun, immediately performs installation there with love, / obtains divine and immeasurable enjoyments always according to his wish, and having enjoyed them, he becomes once more an emperor on earth.
title: Pratiṣṭhāpanavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
ye mānavāstridaśamūrtiniketanāni kurvanti sādhujanadṛṣṭimanoharāṇi .
teṣāṃ mṛte'pyaparamārthamaye śarīre loke paribhramati kīrtimayaṃ śarīram . . 2
meaning:
ये मानवास्त्रिदशमूर्तिनिकेतनानि कुर्वन्ति साधुजनदृष्टिमनोहराणि .
तेषां मृतेऽप्यपरमार्थमये शरीरे लोके परिभ्रमति कीर्तिमयं शरीरम् . . 2
text_mt: Those mortals who build dwellings for the forms of the gods, pleasing to the eyes of virtuous people, / even when their physical body made of untruth has died, their body composed of renown wanders in the world.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitamidaṃ devapūjyasya savituḥ sthāpanamivādhānam .
sādhāraṇaṃ vidhānaṃ śṛṇu devānāṃ pratiṣṭhāpane vīra . . 3
meaning:
इति ते कथितमिदं देवपूज्यस्य सवितुः स्थापनमिवाधानम् .
साधारणं विधानं शृणु देवानां प्रतिष्ठापने वीर . . 3
text_mt: Thus have I told you this installation, like the setting up [of the sacred fires], of Savitṛ, who is worthy of worship by the gods. / Listen, O hero, to the general rule for the installation of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
snāto bhukto vastrālaṅkṛtakusumairgandhaiḥ pratimāyā āstīrṇāyāṃ śayyāyāṃ sthāpanaṃ kuryāt .
suptāyāṃ tu sa nṛtyagītairjāgaraṇaiḥ samyagevādhivāsya daivajñena pratidiṣṭakāle saṃsthāpanaṃ kuryāt .
abhyarcya kusumagandhānulepanaiḥ śaṅkhatūryanirghoṣaiḥ prādakṣiṇyena nayedāyatanasya prayatnena kṛtvā baliṃ pratimāmabhyarcya brāhmaṇāṃśca sādhūndattvā hiraṇyakalaśaṃ vidhinā nikṣipetpiṃṇḍikāmadhye suśvabhre sthāpakadaivajñadvijānsamyagviśeṣato'bhyarcyākalpāntaṃ bhogī bhavatīha paratra sukhī . .4
meaning:
स्नातो भुक्तो वस्त्रालङ्कृतकुसुमैर्गन्धैः प्रतिमाया आस्तीर्णायां शय्यायां स्थापनं कुर्यात् .
सुप्तायां तु स नृत्यगीतैर्जागरणैः सम्यगेवाधिवास्य दैवज्ञेन प्रतिदिष्टकाले संस्थापनं कुर्यात् .
अभ्यर्च्य कुसुमगन्धानुलेपनैः शङ्खतूर्यनिर्घोषैः प्रादक्षिण्येन नयेदायतनस्य प्रयत्नेन कृत्वा बलिं प्रतिमामभ्यर्च्य ब्राह्मणांश्च साधून्दत्त्वा हिरण्यकलशं विधिना निक्षिपेत्पिंण्डिकामध्ये सुश्वभ्रे स्थापकदैवज्ञद्विजान्सम्यग्विशेषतोऽभ्यर्च्याकल्पान्तं भोगी भवतीह परत्र सुखी . .4
text_mt: Having bathed and eaten, one should make the installation of the image on a spread couch, with garments, ornaments, flowers, and fragrant unguents. / When it has been laid to rest, having properly performed the preliminary consecration through dances, songs, and vigils, one should perform the installation at the time indicated by the astrologer. / Having worshipped it with flowers, fragrances, and unguents, amidst the sounds of conches and musical instruments, one should carefully carry it clockwise around the temple. Having made an offering, having worshipped the image and the virtuous brāhmaṇas, and having given a golden vessel, one should properly deposit it into the cavity in the middle of the pedestal. Having properly and especially worshipped the installing priest, the astrologer, and the twice-born, he becomes an enjoyer of pleasures until the end of a kalpa and remains happy in the other world.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇorbhāgavatā matāśca savituḥ śambhoḥ sabhasmadvijā mātṝṇāmapi mātṛmaṇḍalavido viprā vidurbrāhmaṇāḥ .
sarve yasya vimuktaśuklavasanā buddhasya raktāmbarā ye yaṃ devamupāśritāḥ suvidhinā taistasya kāryā kriyā . . 5
meaning:
विष्णोर्भागवता मताश्च सवितुः शम्भोः सभस्मद्विजा मातॄणामपि मातृमण्डलविदो विप्रा विदुर्ब्राह्मणाः .
सर्वे यस्य विमुक्तशुक्लवसना बुद्धस्य रक्ताम्बरा ये यं देवमुपाश्रिताः सुविधिना तैस्तस्य कार्या क्रिया . . 5
text_mt: The Bhāgavatas are recognized for Viṣṇu, and for the Sun and Śambhu the twice-born smeared with ashes; for the Mothers, the learned brāhmaṇas who know the circle of the Mothers; / all [priests] of his are without white garments, [and] of the Buddha they wear red cloth. Those who are devoted to whichever god should perform his rite according to proper rule.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmānyamidaṃ devānāmadhivāsanaṃ bhavati mayā kathitam .
kriyamāṇamidaṃ dṛṣṭvā devānāṃ pratiṣṭhāpanam . .
naro bhaktyā iha kāmānavāpya svargabhājanaṃ bhavati . . 6
meaning:
सामान्यमिदं देवानामधिवासनं भवति मया कथितम् .
क्रियमाणमिदं दृष्ट्वा देवानां प्रतिष्ठापनम् . .
नरो भक्त्या इह कामानवाप्य स्वर्गभाजनं भवति . . 6
text_mt: This general preliminary consecration of the gods has been related by me. / Having seen this installation of the gods being performed, / a man with devotion attains his desires here and becomes an inheritor of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ te kathitaṃ rājanpratiṣṭhāpanamāditaḥ .
yatkṛtvā savituḥ snānaṃ naro yāti manogatim . . 7
meaning:
इदं ते कथितं राजन्प्रतिष्ठापनमादितः .
यत्कृत्वा सवितुः स्नानं नरो याति मनोगतिम् . . 7
text_mt: This installation has been told to you from the beginning, O king, / performing which [along with] the bath of Savitṛ, a man attains the realm of his desire.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ kuryānnaro bhaktyā savituḥ sthāpanaṃ budhaḥ .
kārayetpurato bhaktayā savituḥ sthāpanaṃ budhaḥ . . 8
meaning:
इत्थं कुर्यान्नरो भक्त्या सवितुः स्थापनं बुधः .
कारयेत्पुरतो भक्तया सवितुः स्थापनं बुधः . . 8
text_mt: Thus should a wise man perform the installation of Savitṛ with devotion; / a wise man should cause the installation of Savitṛ to be done in front with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
itihāsapurāṇasya śravaṇaṃ pāpanāśanam .
tābhyāṃ hi śravaṇādvīra sānnidhyaṃ yāti bhāskaraḥ . . 9
meaning:
इतिहासपुराणस्य श्रवणं पापनाशनम् .
ताभ्यां हि श्रवणाद्वीर सान्निध्यं याति भास्करः . . 9
text_mt: Listening to the Itihāsas and Purāṇas destroys sins. / Truly, through listening to both of them, O hero, the Sun comes near.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛte tvāyatane tasminye cānye cāpi devatāḥ .
tasmātkāryaṃ budhairnityaṃ dharmaśravaṇamāditaḥ . . 1.137.10
meaning:
कृते त्वायतने तस्मिन्ये चान्ये चापि देवताः .
तस्मात्कार्यं बुधैर्नित्यं धर्मश्रवणमादितः . . 1.137.10
text_mt: When that temple is made, and for whatever other deities there are, / therefore, listening to dharma from the beginning should always be performed by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
vācakaṃ pūjayitvā tu brāhmaṇānupapūjya ca .
kārayedvācanaṃ vīra pustakasyāgrato raveḥ . . 11
meaning:
वाचकं पूजयित्वा तु ब्राह्मणानुपपूज्य च .
कारयेद्वाचनं वीर पुस्तकस्याग्रतो रवेः . . 11
text_mt: Having worshipped the reciter and having worshipped the brāhmaṇas, / one should cause the recitation of the book to be made in front of the Sun, O hero.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasvaṃ sthāpake dadyādyatkiñjidgṛhamāgatam .
godānamathavā dadyāttasya cittaṃ prasādayet . . 12
meaning:
सर्वस्वं स्थापके दद्याद्यत्किञ्जिद्गृहमागतम् .
गोदानमथवा दद्यात्तस्य चित्तं प्रसादयेत् . . 12
text_mt: One should give to the installing priest all property, whatever has come into the house, / or one should give the gift of a cow and satisfy his heart.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣa kathito vīra pratiṣṭhākalpa āditaḥ .
kṛtvā dṛṣṭvā ca śrutvā ca yaṃ naro'rkamavāpnuyāt . . 13
meaning:
इत्येष कथितो वीर प्रतिष्ठाकल्प आदितः .
कृत्वा दृष्ट्वा च श्रुत्वा च यं नरोऽर्कमवाप्नुयात् . . 13
text_mt: Thus has this ritual of installation been told from the beginning, O hero, / by performing, seeing, and hearing which a man attains the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sāmbopākhyāne
pratiṣṭhāpanavidhivarṇanam nāma saptatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ . 137 .
dhvajāropaṇavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे साम्बोपाख्याने
प्रतिष्ठापनविधिवर्णनम् नाम सप्तत्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः . 137 .
ध्वजारोपणविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-seventh chapter, named 'Description of the Rite of Installation', in the Sāmba narrative, in the seventh kalpa, in the Brāhmaparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Rite of Raising the Banner

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi dhvajāropaṇamuttamam .
yaduktaṃ brahmaṇā pūrvamṛṣabhādhipate puraḥ . . 1
meaning:
नारद उवाच
हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि ध्वजारोपणमुत्तमम् .
यदुक्तं ब्रह्मणा पूर्वमृषभाधिपते पुरः . . 1
text_mt: Nārada said: / Well, I shall tell you the excellent raising of the banner, / which was spoken of formerly by Brahmā before the lord of bulls.
title: adhyāyaḥ 138

sanskrit_iast:
purā devāsure yuddhe yāni devairjayepsubhiḥ .
kṛtānyupari cihnāni vāhanāni dhvajāni tu . . 2
meaning:
पुरा देवासुरे युद्धे यानि देवैर्जयेप्सुभिः .
कृतान्युपरि चिह्नानि वाहनानि ध्वजानि तु . . 2
text_mt: Formerly, in the war between the gods and the asuras, the signs, vehicles, and banners / were placed above by the gods desirous of victory.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmacihnadhvajaṃ keturiti paryāyanāmabhiḥ .
kīrtitaḥ sa ca tasyeha pramāṇaṃ gadataḥ śṛṇu . . 3
meaning:
लक्ष्मचिह्नध्वजं केतुरिति पर्यायनामभिः .
कीर्तितः स च तस्येह प्रमाणं गदतः शृणु . . 3
text_mt: It is praised under the synonymous names of lakṣman, cihna, dhvaja, and ketu; / and hear its measure as I speak of it here.

sanskrit_iast:
dhvajo vaṃśasya kartavyastvaviddha ṛjuravraṇaḥ .
prāsādavyāsa tulyasya dhvajavaṃśapramāṇataḥ . . 4
meaning:
ध्वजो वंशस्य कर्तव्यस्त्वविद्ध ऋजुरव्रणः .
प्रासादव्यास तुल्यस्य ध्वजवंशप्रमाणतः . . 4
text_mt: The banner should be made of bamboo, unperforated, straight, and unblemished; / according to the measure of the bamboo for the banner, it should be equal to the width of the temple.

sanskrit_iast:
devāgārasya ye proktā mañjarīkalaśādayaḥ .
atha vā tatpramāṇastu dhvajadaṇḍaḥ prakīrtitaḥ . . 5
meaning:
देवागारस्य ये प्रोक्ता मञ्जरीकलशादयः .
अथ वा तत्प्रमाणस्तु ध्वजदण्डः प्रकीर्तितः . . 5
text_mt: Those that are taught for the house of the god, such as the spire and the water-pot— / or else the staff of the banner is said to be of that measure.

sanskrit_iast:
antargṛhasya yā vedī sūtrataḥ parikalpitā .
tasyā vyāso bhavedvaṃśaḥ prasādasya yadūttama . . 6
meaning:
अन्तर्गृहस्य या वेदी सूत्रतः परिकल्पिता .
तस्या व्यासो भवेद्वंशः प्रसादस्य यदूत्तम . . 6
text_mt: The altar of the inner sanctum which is marked out by measuring string, / its width should be [the length of] the bamboo [staff] of the temple, O best of the Yadus.

sanskrit_iast:
atha vā mūlasūtreṇa yo vyāso'ntargṛhasya tu .
prāsādavyāsa iti te proktaśceha na saṃśayaḥ . . 7
meaning:
अथ वा मूलसूत्रेण यो व्यासोऽन्तर्गृहस्य तु .
प्रासादव्यास इति ते प्रोक्तश्चेह न संशयः . . 7
text_mt: Or whatever width of the inner sanctum is [determined] by the primary cord, / that is declared to you as the width of the temple here, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
keturbhavedvaro vaṃśo na nimno na ṛjustathā .
patraṃ dhvaje yugaṃ caiva nalikāpuruṣastathā . . 8
meaning:
केतुर्भवेद्वरो वंशो न निम्नो न ऋजुस्तथा .
पत्रं ध्वजे युगं चैव नलिकापुरुषस्तथा . . 8
text_mt: The ketu should be an excellent bamboo, neither bent downwards nor [crooked, but] straight; / as well as the flag, the yoke, and the tube-man upon the banner.

sanskrit_iast:
caturhastā bhavantyete praśastāḥ kṛṣṇanandana .
aṣṭahastapramāṇastu viṃśārdhasya1 pramāṇataḥ . . 9
meaning:
चतुर्हस्ता भवन्त्येते प्रशस्ताः कृष्णनन्दन .
अष्टहस्तप्रमाणस्तु विंशार्धस्य1 प्रमाणतः . . 9
text_mt: These measuring four cubits are praised, O son of Kṛṣṇa; / but one measuring eight cubits corresponds to the measure of ten [cubits].

sanskrit_iast:
sāmānyo dhvajadaṇḍastu sarvasādhāraṇo mataḥ .
daṇḍapāṇidhvajo yastu smṛtaḥ ṣoḍaśahastavān . . 1.138.10
meaning:
सामान्यो ध्वजदण्डस्तु सर्वसाधारणो मतः .
दण्डपाणिध्वजो यस्तु स्मृतः षोडशहस्तवान् . . 1.138.10
text_mt: The common flagstaff is considered applicable to all; / but the staff of Daṇḍapāṇi's banner is remembered as having sixteen cubits.

sanskrit_iast:
viṃśaddhastātparo daṇḍo na kāryaḥ sarvathā raveḥ .
yugmahastastu kartavyo dhvajadaṇḍo manīṣibhiḥ . . 11
meaning:
विंशद्धस्तात्परो दण्डो न कार्यः सर्वथा रवेः .
युग्महस्तस्तु कर्तव्यो ध्वजदण्डो मनीषिभिः . . 11
text_mt: A staff greater than twenty cubits should never be made for the Sun; / and the banner-staff must be made with an even number of cubits by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
caturaṅgulavistīrṇaḥ suvṛtto dvyaṅgulopari .
nātisūkṣmo na ca sthūlo na kāryo nataparvakaḥ . . 12
meaning:
चतुरङ्गुलविस्तीर्णः सुवृत्तो द्व्यङ्गुलोपरि .
नातिसूक्ष्मो न च स्थूलो न कार्यो नतपर्वकः . . 12
text_mt: It should be four digits wide, well rounded, [tapering to] two digits at the top; / neither too slender nor thick, and it should not be made with bent joints.

sanskrit_iast:
samaparvātu kartavyaḥ sudṛḍhaḥ sūkṣma eva hi .
vakraḥ putravināśāya savraṇo'rthavināśanaḥ . . 13
meaning:
समपर्वातु कर्तव्यः सुदृढः सूक्ष्म एव हि .
वक्रः पुत्रविनाशाय सव्रणोऽर्थविनाशनः . . 13
text_mt: It should indeed be made with even joints, very firm, and slender. / A crooked one causes the ruin of sons, and one with blemishes ruins wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
rogado yugmahastastu bhinno duḥkhamanantakam .
karoti hāni dharmasya hīno yastu pramāṇataḥ . . 14
meaning:
रोगदो युग्महस्तस्तु भिन्नो दुःखमनन्तकम् .
करोति हानि धर्मस्य हीनो यस्तु प्रमाणतः . . 14
text_mt: [An odd-measured staff] brings disease, an even-cubited one [is sound], but a broken one causes endless sorrow. / One that is deficient in measure causes the loss of religious merit.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣamyamasamaparvā dadyātkṛcchramadhonnataḥ .
jayo jayanto jaitreyaḥ4 śatruhantā jayāvahaḥ . . 15
meaning:
वैषम्यमसमपर्वा दद्यात्कृच्छ्रमधोन्नतः .
जयो जयन्तो जैत्रेयः4 शत्रुहन्ता जयावहः . . 15
text_mt: One with uneven joints brings misfortune; one raised at the bottom gives hardship. / Jaya, Jayanta, Jaitreya, Śatruhantṛ, Jayāvaha,

sanskrit_iast:
nandopanandanau caivendropendrau gaditau tathā .
daśaite kīrtitā bhedā dhvajasyānandasammitāḥ . . 16
meaning:
नन्दोपनन्दनौ चैवेन्द्रोपेन्द्रौ गदितौ तथा .
दशैते कीर्तिता भेदा ध्वजस्यानन्दसम्मिताः . . 16
text_mt: Nanda and Upananda, and likewise Indra and Upendra are declared; / these ten varieties of banner are proclaimed, equivalent in joy.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijahastastu jayo daṇḍo jayanto dviguṇo mataḥ .
dvādaśahastastu jaitreyaḥ śatruhantā kalānvitaḥ . . 17
meaning:
द्विजहस्तस्तु जयो दण्डो जयन्तो द्विगुणो मतः .
द्वादशहस्तस्तु जैत्रेयः शत्रुहन्ता कलान्वितः . . 17
text_mt: The Jaya staff is two cubits, Jayanta is considered twice that; / Jaitreya is twelve cubits, and Śatruhantṛ is endowed with sixteen.

sanskrit_iast:
jayāvahastu viṃśārdho nanda ādityasannibhaḥ .
caturdaśopanandastu indraḥ ṣoḍaśa ucyate . . 18
meaning:
जयावहस्तु विंशार्धो नन्द आदित्यसन्निभः .
चतुर्दशोपनन्दस्तु इन्द्रः षोडश उच्यते . . 18
text_mt: Jayāvaha is ten cubits, Nanda is twelve; / Upananda is fourteen, and Indra is said to be sixteen.

sanskrit_iast:
upendro'ṣṭādaśaḥ5 proktastathendro viṃśatiḥ smṛtaḥ .
bhinno vakro'sādhitaśca na kāryo daṇḍa eva hi . . 19
meaning:
उपेन्द्रोऽष्टादशः5 प्रोक्तस्तथेन्द्रो विंशतिः स्मृतः .
भिन्नो वक्रोऽसाधितश्च न कार्यो दण्ड एव हि . . 19
text_mt: Upendra is declared to be eighteen, and Indra is remembered as twenty. / A broken, crooked, and unworked staff must never be made at all.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlamantreṇa kartavyo vyāsato'ntargṛhasya tu .
dhvajadaṇḍo mahābāho atha vā vāstumānataḥ . . 1.138.20
meaning:
मूलमन्त्रेण कर्तव्यो व्यासतोऽन्तर्गृहस्य तु .
ध्वजदण्डो महाबाहो अथ वा वास्तुमानतः . . 1.138.20
text_mt: The banner-staff, O mighty-armed one, should be made with the root-mantra / according to the width of the inner sanctuary, or according to the measurement of the site,

sanskrit_iast:
mañjarīmānato vāpi tadardhenāthavā vibho .
patākā vai śubhā kāryā dhvajavaṃśāvalambinī . . 21
meaning:
मञ्जरीमानतो वापि तदर्धेनाथवा विभो .
पताका वै शुभा कार्या ध्वजवंशावलम्बिनी . . 21
text_mt: or according to the measurement of the spire, or by half of that, O lord. / An auspicious flag should indeed be made, hanging from the banner-bamboo,

sanskrit_iast:
devāgārasya śikharāttribhāgaparimārjanī .
sā proktā daśadhā vīra mānatomānatastathā . . 22
meaning:
देवागारस्य शिखरात्त्रिभागपरिमार्जनी .
सा प्रोक्ता दशधा वीर मानतोमानतस्तथा . . 22
text_mt: sweeping one-third of the roof of the shrine of the deity. / It is declared to be of ten kinds, O hero, both according to standard measure and non-standard measure:

sanskrit_iast:
aṅkuraḥ pallavaścaiva skandhaḥ śākhā tathaiva ca .
patākā kadalī vīra keturlakṣma jayastathā . . 23
meaning:
अङ्कुरः पल्लवश्चैव स्कन्धः शाखा तथैव च .
पताका कदली वीर केतुर्लक्ष्म जयस्तथा . . 23
text_mt: Aṅkura, Pallava, Skandha, and Śākhā, / Patākā, Kadalī, O hero, Ketu, Lakṣman, and Jaya,

sanskrit_iast:
dhvajaśca daśamaḥ proktaḥ sarvadevamayovyayaḥ .
aṅkuro dvayaṃgulaḥ proktaḥ pallavaścaturaṅgulaḥ . . 24
meaning:
ध्वजश्च दशमः प्रोक्तः सर्वदेवमयोव्ययः .
अङ्कुरो द्वयंगुलः प्रोक्तः पल्लवश्चतुरङ्गुलः . . 24
text_mt: and Dhvaja is proclaimed the tenth, imperishable, consisting of all deities. / An Aṅkura is declared to be two digits; a Pallava is four digits;

sanskrit_iast:
skandhaḥ ṣaḍaṅgulaḥ proktaḥ śākhā cāṣṭāṅgulo matā .
ekādaśapatākā tu kadalī ca caturdaśa . . 25
meaning:
स्कन्धः षडङ्गुलः प्रोक्तः शाखा चाष्टाङ्गुलो मता .
एकादशपताका तु कदली च चतुर्दश . . 25
text_mt: a Skandha is declared to be six digits; a Śākhā is regarded as eight digits; / an eleven-[digit] one is a Patākā, and a Kadalī is fourteen;

sanskrit_iast:
ketustu ṣoḍaśaḥ prokto lakṣmāṣṭādaśamucyate .
jayā viṃśati vai proktā etāvattvaṅgulāni tu . . 26
meaning:
केतुस्तु षोडशः प्रोक्तो लक्ष्माष्टादशमुच्यते .
जया विंशति वै प्रोक्ता एतावत्त्वङ्गुलानि तु . . 26
text_mt: a Ketu is declared to be sixteen; a Lakṣman is said to be eighteen; / a Jayā is declared to be twenty—these are the digits.

sanskrit_iast:
devāgārasya kumbhasya prasannā sā pramārjanī .
aṅkureti patākā sā vijñeyā yadunandana . . 27
meaning:
देवागारस्य कुम्भस्य प्रसन्ना सा प्रमार्जनी .
अङ्कुरेति पताका सा विज्ञेया यदुनन्दन . . 27
text_mt: When it sweeps brightly the pot of the god's shrine, / that flag should be known as Aṅkura, O son of Yadu.

sanskrit_iast:
pallaveti dvitīyasya mārjanī parikīrtitā .
tribhāgamārjanīskandhaḥ śākhā vai pañcamasya tu . . 28
meaning:
पल्लवेति द्वितीयस्य मार्जनी परिकीर्तिता .
त्रिभागमार्जनीस्कन्धः शाखा वै पञ्चमस्य तु . . 28
text_mt: For the second, the sweeping flag is proclaimed as Pallava; / Skandha sweeps one-third; Śākhā is for the fifth;

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhasyoktā patākā tu kadalī saptamasya tu .
aṣṭamasya tathā keturlakṣma ca navamasya tu . . 29
meaning:
षष्ठस्योक्ता पताका तु कदली सप्तमस्य तु .
अष्टमस्य तथा केतुर्लक्ष्म च नवमस्य तु . . 29
text_mt: Patākā is spoken of for the sixth, Kadalī for the seventh; / likewise Ketu for the eighth, and Lakṣman for the ninth.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu daśamaḥ prokto jayanto yadunandana .
vṛṣasthānāvamārgī tu dhvajastu parikīrtitaḥ . . 1.138.30
meaning:
ततस्तु दशमः प्रोक्तो जयन्तो यदुनन्दन .
वृषस्थानावमार्गी तु ध्वजस्तु परिकीर्तितः . . 1.138.30
text_mt: Then the tenth is declared to be Jayanta, O son of Yadu; / but the banner [Dhvaja] is celebrated as sweeping down to the place of the bull.

sanskrit_iast:
gajo meṣo'tha mahiṣaḥ kabandhastu vṛṣastathā .
hariṇo'tha naraścaiva naraśca narasattama . . 31
meaning:
गजो मेषोऽथ महिषः कबन्धस्तु वृषस्तथा .
हरिणोऽथ नरश्चैव नरश्च नरसत्तम . . 31
text_mt: The elephant, the ram, then the buffalo, the headless trunk, and the bull, / the deer, and the man, and the man, O best of men—

sanskrit_iast:
sthānānyetāni bhūyo'tha1 prayuktasya dhvajasya tu .
diśabhāge tu pūrvāttu krameṇa parikalpayet . . 32
meaning:
स्थानान्येतानि भूयोऽथ1 प्रयुक्तस्य ध्वजस्य तु .
दिशभागे तु पूर्वात्तु क्रमेण परिकल्पयेत् . . 32
text_mt: these are the places of the banner properly employed; / one should arrange them in succession beginning from the eastern direction.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ daśavidhā proktā patākā tattvadarśibhiḥ .
kartavyā sā yathāpūrvaṃ tacchṛṇu tvaṃ narādhipa . . 33
meaning:
एवं दशविधा प्रोक्ता पताका तत्त्वदर्शिभिः .
कर्तव्या सा यथापूर्वं तच्छृणु त्वं नराधिप . . 33
text_mt: Thus the flag has been declared to be of ten kinds by the seers of truth; / hear, O ruler of men, how it is to be made as of old:

sanskrit_iast:
śuklavastramayī citrā saghaṇṭā sumanoharā .
nānācāmarasampannā kiṅkiṇījālamaṇḍitā . . 34
meaning:
शुक्लवस्त्रमयी चित्रा सघण्टा सुमनोहरा .
नानाचामरसम्पन्ना किङ्किणीजालमण्डिता . . 34
text_mt: Made of white cloth, variegated, equipped with bells, very charming, / provided with various chowries, and adorned with a lattice of tiny bells.

sanskrit_iast:
dhvajāgre caiva kartavyo devatāliṅgasūcakaḥ .
kāñcano vātha raupyo vā maṇiratnamayo'pi vā . . 35
meaning:
ध्वजाग्रे चैव कर्तव्यो देवतालिङ्गसूचकः .
काञ्चनो वाथ रौप्यो वा मणिरत्नमयोऽपि वा . . 35
text_mt: At the top of the banner one should make an indicator of the emblem of the deity, / either of gold, or of silver, or made of precious gems;

sanskrit_iast:
raṅgakairlikhyate vāpi tadvāhanasamākṛtiḥ .
dhvajadaṇḍo'tra vinyastaḥ kartavyo yadunandana . . 36
meaning:
रङ्गकैर्लिख्यते वापि तद्वाहनसमाकृतिः .
ध्वजदण्डोऽत्र विन्यस्तः कर्तव्यो यदुनन्दन . . 36
text_mt: or the likeness of its mount is painted with colours. / The banner-staff placed there should be made, O son of Yadu.

sanskrit_iast:
garutmātmāṃstu dhvajo viṣṇorīśvarasya dhvajo vṛṣaḥ .
brahmaṇaḥ paṅkajaṃ kāryaṃ raverdharmaḥ smṛto dhvajaḥ . . 37
meaning:
गरुत्मात्मांस्तु ध्वजो विष्णोरीश्वरस्य ध्वजो वृषः .
ब्रह्मणः पङ्कजं कार्यं रवेर्धर्मः स्मृतो ध्वजः . . 37
text_mt: Garutmān is the banner of Viṣṇu; the bull is the banner of the Lord; / the lotus is to be made for Brahmā; Dharma is remembered as the banner of the Sun;

sanskrit_iast:
haṃso1 jalādhipasyoktaḥ somasya tu naro dhvajaḥ .
baladevasya kālastu kāmasya makaradhvajaḥ . . 38
meaning:
हंसो1 जलाधिपस्योक्तः सोमस्य तु नरो ध्वजः .
बलदेवस्य कालस्तु कामस्य मकरध्वजः . . 38
text_mt: the goose is declared for the lord of waters; a man is the banner of Soma; / the black [serpent / palm] for Baladeva; and Kāma has the makara banner;

sanskrit_iast:
siṃho dhvajastu durgāyāḥ kīrtito yadunandana .
godhā cāpi umādevyā raivatasya hayaḥ smṛtaḥ . . 39
meaning:
सिंहो ध्वजस्तु दुर्गायाः कीर्तितो यदुनन्दन .
गोधा चापि उमादेव्या रैवतस्य हयः स्मृतः . . 39
text_mt: the lion is proclaimed as the banner of Durgā, O son of Yadu; / the monitor lizard of the goddess Umā; the horse is remembered for Raivata;

sanskrit_iast:
kacchapo varuṇasyokto vātasya hariṇo mataḥ .
pāvakasya tathā meṣa ākhurgaṇapatermataḥ . . 1.138.40
meaning:
कच्छपो वरुणस्योक्तो वातस्य हरिणो मतः .
पावकस्य तथा मेष आखुर्गणपतेर्मतः . . 1.138.40
text_mt: the tortoise is declared for Varuṇa; the deer is regarded for the Wind; / likewise the ram for Fire; the rat is regarded for the lord of the Gaṇas;

sanskrit_iast:
brahmarṣīṇāṃ kuśaḥ prokta ityeṣā dhvaja kalpanā .
yasya yadvāhanaṃ proktaṃ tattasya dhvaja ucyate . . 41
meaning:
ब्रह्मर्षीणां कुशः प्रोक्त इत्येषा ध्वज कल्पना .
यस्य यद्वाहनं प्रोक्तं तत्तस्य ध्वज उच्यते . . 41
text_mt: kuśa grass is declared for the Brahmin-seers—such is the design of banners. / Whatever is declared as the mount of each, that is called his banner.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇordhvaje tu sauvarṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ .
patākā cāpi pītā syādgaruḍasya samīpagā . . 42
meaning:
विष्णोर्ध्वजे तु सौवर्णं दण्डं कुर्याद्विचक्षणः .
पताका चापि पीता स्याद्गरुडस्य समीपगा . . 42
text_mt: On the banner of Viṣṇu, the wise man should make a golden staff, / and the flag should be yellow, situated near Garuḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvarasya dhvaje daṇḍo rājato yadunandanaḥ .
patākā cāpi śuklā syādvṛṣabhasya samīpagā . . 43
meaning:
ईश्वरस्य ध्वजे दण्डो राजतो यदुनन्दनः .
पताका चापि शुक्ला स्याद्वृषभस्य समीपगा . . 43
text_mt: On the banner of the Lord, the staff is of silver, O son of Yadu, / and the flag should be white, situated near the bull.

sanskrit_iast:
pitāmahadhvaje daṇḍaḥ smṛtastāmramayo budhaiḥ .
padmavarṇā patākā syātpaṅkajasya samīpagā . . 44
meaning:
पितामहध्वजे दण्डः स्मृतस्ताम्रमयो बुधैः .
पद्मवर्णा पताका स्यात्पङ्कजस्य समीपगा . . 44
text_mt: On the banner of the Grandfather, the staff is remembered by the wise to be made of copper; / the flag should be lotus-coloured, situated near the lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityasya ca sauvarṇo dhvaje daṇḍaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .
pañcavarṇā patākā syāddharmasyādhogatā nṛpa . . 45
meaning:
आदित्यस्य च सौवर्णो ध्वजे दण्डः प्रकीर्तितः .
पञ्चवर्णा पताका स्याद्धर्मस्याधोगता नृप . . 45
text_mt: And for the Sun, the staff on the banner is proclaimed to be of gold; / the flag should be of five colours, placed below Dharma, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
kiṅkiṇījālasampannā nānabudbudasannibhā .
puṣpamālopasampannā nānāvādibhirāvṛtā . . 46
meaning:
किङ्किणीजालसम्पन्ना नानबुद्बुदसन्निभा .
पुष्पमालोपसम्पन्ना नानावादिभिरावृता . . 46
text_mt: endowed with a network of tiny bells, resembling various bubbles, / furnished with garlands of flowers, and surrounded by various musical instruments.

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍa indradhvajasyoktaḥ kāñcano yadunandana .
patākā bahuvarṇā syātkuñjarasya samīpagā . . 47
meaning:
दण्ड इन्द्रध्वजस्योक्तः काञ्चनो यदुनन्दन .
पताका बहुवर्णा स्यात्कुञ्जरस्य समीपगा . . 47
text_mt: The staff of Indra's banner is said to be golden, O son of Yadu; / the flag should be multi-coloured, situated near the elephant.

sanskrit_iast:
āyasaścāpi daṇḍokto yamacihnaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ .
patākā varṇataḥ kṛṣṇā mahiṣasya samīpagā . . 48
meaning:
आयसश्चापि दण्डोक्तो यमचिह्नं विचक्षणैः .
पताका वर्णतः कृष्णा महिषस्य समीपगा . . 48
text_mt: And an iron staff is declared by the wise as the emblem of Yama; / the flag is black in colour, situated near the buffalo.

sanskrit_iast:
jalādhipadhvajo daṇḍo rājataḥ parikīrtitaḥ .
patākā sarvataḥ śvetā vicitrā sā ca kathyate . . 49
meaning:
जलाधिपध्वजो दण्डो राजतः परिकीर्तितः .
पताका सर्वतः श्वेता विचित्रा सा च कथ्यते . . 49
text_mt: The staff of the banner of the lord of waters is proclaimed to be silver; / its flag is said to be white all over and variegated.

sanskrit_iast:
dhvaje cāpi kuberasya daṇḍo maṇimayaḥ smṛtaḥ .
patākā cāpi raktā syānnarapādasamīpagā . . 1.138.50
meaning:
ध्वजे चापि कुबेरस्य दण्डो मणिमयः स्मृतः .
पताका चापि रक्ता स्यान्नरपादसमीपगा . . 1.138.50
text_mt: And on the banner of Kubera, the staff is remembered as made of jewels; / the flag should be red, situated near the feet of the man.

sanskrit_iast:
baladevadhvaje daṇḍo rājato yadunandana .
patākā varṇataḥ śuklā tālasyādhogatā smṛtā . . 51
meaning:
बलदेवध्वजे दण्डो राजतो यदुनन्दन .
पताका वर्णतः शुक्ला तालस्याधोगता स्मृता . . 51
text_mt: On the banner of Baladeva, the staff is of silver, O son of Yadu; / the flag is white in colour, remembered as placed below the palm tree.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmadhvaje trilohaḥ syāddaṇḍo yadukulodvaha .
patākā rohiṇī tatra makarasya samīpagā . . 52
meaning:
कामध्वजे त्रिलोहः स्याद्दण्डो यदुकुलोद्वह .
पताका रोहिणी तत्र मकरस्य समीपगा . . 52
text_mt: On Kāma's banner, the staff should be of three metals, O scion of the Yadu race; / the red flag there is situated near the makara.

sanskrit_iast:
māyūraṃ kārttikeyasya cihnaṃ lokeṣu gīyate .
trilohadaṇḍamārūḍhaṃ bahuratnavibhūṣitam . . 53
meaning:
मायूरं कार्त्तिकेयस्य चिह्नं लोकेषु गीयते .
त्रिलोहदण्डमारूढं बहुरत्नविभूषितम् . . 53
text_mt: The peacock emblem of Kārttikeya is sung in the worlds, / mounted on a staff of three metals, adorned with many jewels.

sanskrit_iast:
bahuvarṇakacitrā tu patākā kathitā budhaiḥ .
hastidantabhavaṃ daṇḍaṃ kuryādgaṇapaternṛpa . . 54
meaning:
बहुवर्णकचित्रा तु पताका कथिता बुधैः .
हस्तिदन्तभवं दण्डं कुर्याद्गणपतेर्नृप . . 54
text_mt: And the flag is described by the wise as variegated with many colours. / O king, one should make the staff of the lord of the Gaṇas from elephant ivory,

sanskrit_iast:
tāmradaṇḍaṃ samāruḍhaṃ saṃśuddhaṃ sampratiṣṭhitam .
śuklā patākā kartavyā supramāṇā mahīpate . . 55
meaning:
ताम्रदण्डं समारुढं संशुद्धं सम्प्रतिष्ठितम् .
शुक्ला पताका कर्तव्या सुप्रमाणा महीपते . . 55
text_mt: or mounted on a copper staff, thoroughly purified and consecrated. / A white flag should be made, well-proportioned, O protector of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
mātṝṇāṃ cāpi kartavyo naikarūpo dhvajo budhaiḥ .
patākābhiranekābhibarhuratnābhiranvitaḥ . . 56
meaning:
मातॄणां चापि कर्तव्यो नैकरूपो ध्वजो बुधैः .
पताकाभिरनेकाभिबर्हुरत्नाभिरन्वितः . . 56
text_mt: And for the Mothers, a multi-formed banner should be made by the wise, / accompanied by many flags and many jewels.

sanskrit_iast:
revatasyāpi kartavyo dhvajo vājī narādhipa .
raktā patākā tatrāpi kartavyā yadunandana . . 57
meaning:
रेवतस्यापि कर्तव्यो ध्वजो वाजी नराधिप .
रक्ता पताका तत्रापि कर्तव्या यदुनन्दन . . 57
text_mt: And for Revata, O king, a horse should be made [as] the banner; / a red flag also must be made there, O delight of the Yadus.

sanskrit_iast:
cāmuṇḍāmandire kāryaḥ śiromālākulo dhvajaḥ .
nīlā patākā kartavyā daṇḍo lohamayastathā . . 58
meaning:
चामुण्डामन्दिरे कार्यः शिरोमालाकुलो ध्वजः .
नीला पताका कर्तव्या दण्डो लोहमयस्तथा . . 58
text_mt: In the temple of Cāmuṇḍā, a banner crowned with a garland of heads should be made; / a blue flag must be made, and the pole made of iron.

sanskrit_iast:
rītīmayaśca mātṝṇāṃ revatasya ca kārayet .
gauryā dhvajastāmramayaḥ patākā gopasannibhā . . 59
meaning:
रीतीमयश्च मातॄणां रेवतस्य च कारयेत् .
गौर्या ध्वजस्ताम्रमयः पताका गोपसन्निभा . . 59
text_mt: And [a pole] made of brass should be made for the Mothers and for Revata. / For Gaurī, the banner is made of copper, [and] the flag resembles a cowherd.

sanskrit_iast:
svarṇadaṇḍastu vīrasya dhvajo meṣasamanvitaḥ .
patākā bahuratnāḍhye1 kartavyā yadunandana . . 1.138.60
meaning:
स्वर्णदण्डस्तु वीरस्य ध्वजो मेषसमन्वितः .
पताका बहुरत्नाढ्ये1 कर्तव्या यदुनन्दन . . 1.138.60
text_mt: A golden staff is for the Hero, with a ram on the banner; / a flag rich in many jewels must be made, O delight of the Yadus.

sanskrit_iast:
aśmasāramayo daṇḍo dhvajo vātasya ucyate .
patākā kṛṣṇavarṇā tu hariṇasya samīpagā . . 61
meaning:
अश्मसारमयो दण्डो ध्वजो वातस्य उच्यते .
पताका कृष्णवर्णा तु हरिणस्य समीपगा . . 61
text_mt: A pole made of iron is declared for the banner of the Wind, / while the flag is black in colour, positioned near a deer.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavatyā dhvajo daṇḍaḥ sarvaratnamayaḥ smṛtaḥ .
patākā tu trivarṇā syātsiṃhasyādhogatā nṛpa . . 62
meaning:
भगवत्या ध्वजो दण्डः सर्वरत्नमयः स्मृतः .
पताका तु त्रिवर्णा स्यात्सिंहस्याधोगता नृप . . 62
text_mt: The banner-pole of the Goddess is declared to be made of all jewels; / the flag should be three-coloured, placed beneath a lion, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃvidhamimaṃ kṛtvā dhvajaṃ lakṣaṇalakṣitam .
adhivāsya tato rājaṃstata āropayedbudhaḥ . . 63
meaning:
एवंविधमिमं कृत्वा ध्वजं लक्षणलक्षितम् .
अधिवास्य ततो राजंस्तत आरोपयेद्बुधः . . 63
text_mt: Having made such a banner marked with these characteristics, / and having performed its consecration, O king, the wise man should then raise it.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sarvauṣadhībhiśca snāpayitvā prayatnataḥ .
samālabhya ca badhnīyānmadhye pratisarānnṛpa . . 64
meaning:
ततः सर्वौषधीभिश्च स्नापयित्वा प्रयत्नतः .
समालभ्य च बध्नीयान्मध्ये प्रतिसरान्नृप . . 64
text_mt: Then, having carefully bathed it with all medicinal herbs, / and anointed it, O king, he should tie protective amulets in the middle.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpayitvā śubhāṃ vediṃ kalaśairupaśobhitām .
tasyāṃ vedyāṃ samāropya tāṃ rātrimadhivāsayet . . 65
meaning:
कल्पयित्वा शुभां वेदिं कलशैरुपशोभिताम् .
तस्यां वेद्यां समारोप्य तां रात्रिमधिवासयेत् . . 65
text_mt: Having prepared an auspicious altar adorned with water jars, / [and] having placed it upon that altar, he should let it dwell [there] for that night.

sanskrit_iast:
nānākusumacitrāṃ ca srajaṃ tasyānulambayet .
samabhyarcya prayatnena dhūpamasya nivedayet . . 66
meaning:
नानाकुसुमचित्रां च स्रजं तस्यानुलम्बयेत् .
समभ्यर्च्य प्रयत्नेन धूपमस्य निवेदयेत् . . 66
text_mt: He should hang upon it a garland variegated with diverse flowers; / having worshipped it diligently, he should offer incense to it.

sanskrit_iast:
balikarma tataḥ kṛtvā kṛśarāpūpakādibhiḥ .
palālapūpikābhiśca dadhipāyasasūpakaiḥ2 . . 67
meaning:
बलिकर्म ततः कृत्वा कृशरापूपकादिभिः .
पलालपूपिकाभिश्च दधिपायससूपकैः2 . . 67
text_mt: Then, having performed the rite of offering with kṛśarā, cakes, and other foods, / and with straw-cakes, curds, milk-rice, and broths,

sanskrit_iast:
uddiśya lokapālebhyo baliṃ dadyācca vāyasaiḥ .
brāhmaṇānsvasti vācyātha kṛtvā puṇyāhamaṅgalam . . 68
meaning:
उद्दिश्य लोकपालेभ्यो बलिं दद्याच्च वायसैः .
ब्राह्मणान्स्वस्ति वाच्याथ कृत्वा पुण्याहमङ्गलम् . . 68
text_mt: he should present an offering designated for the world protectors by means of crows. / Then, having made the brāhmaṇas chant benedictions and having performed the auspicious ceremony for a holy day,

sanskrit_iast:
vāditrakṛtanirghoṣaṃ jalaṃ saṃskārasaṃyutam .
nānābudbudasapannaṃ veṣṭitaṃ navavāsasā . . 69
meaning:
वादित्रकृतनिर्घोषं जलं संस्कारसंयुतम् .
नानाबुद्बुदसपन्नं वेष्टितं नववाससा . . 69
text_mt: with consecrated water resounding with musical instruments, / filled with various bubbles, wrapped with a new garment,

sanskrit_iast:
śubhe lagne dine ṛkṣe dhvajaṃ cāropayedbudhaḥ .
vinyasya svarṇakalaśaṃ śvabhrarājaṃ dhvajasya tu . . 1.138.70
meaning:
शुभे लग्ने दिने ऋक्षे ध्वजं चारोपयेद्बुधः .
विन्यस्य स्वर्णकलशं श्वभ्रराजं ध्वजस्य तु . . 1.138.70
text_mt: under an auspicious ascendant, day, and lunar mansion, the wise man should raise the banner, / having placed a golden jar, the king of pits, for the banner.

sanskrit_iast:
evamāropayedyastu dhvajaṃ devālayopari .
sa śriyā vardhate nityaṃ prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim . . 71
meaning:
एवमारोपयेद्यस्तु ध्वजं देवालयोपरि .
स श्रिया वर्धते नित्यं प्राप्नोति परमां गतिम् . . 71
text_mt: He who raises the banner in this manner upon a temple / ever thrives in prosperity and attains the highest state.

sanskrit_iast:
asurā vāsamicchanti dhvajahīne surālaye .
tasmāddevālayaṃ prājño dhvajahīnaṃ na kārayet . . 72
meaning:
असुरा वासमिच्छन्ति ध्वजहीने सुरालये .
तस्माद्देवालयं प्राज्ञो ध्वजहीनं न कारयेत् . . 72
text_mt: Demons desire to dwell in a temple that is devoid of a banner; / therefore, a wise man must not make a temple devoid of a banner.

sanskrit_iast:
mantraśca sthāpane prokto vidhānajñairdhvajasya tu .
ehyehi bhagavandeva devavāhana vai khaga . . 73
meaning:
मन्त्रश्च स्थापने प्रोक्तो विधानज्ञैर्ध्वजस्य तु .
एह्येहि भगवन्देव देववाहन वै खग . . 73
text_mt: And the mantra for the erection of the banner has been declared by those who know the ritual: / 'Come, come, O Lord, O god, vehicle of the god, O bird!

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkaraḥ śrīnivāsaśca jaya jaitropaśobhita .
vyomarūpa mahārūpa dharmātmaṃstvaṃ ca vai gateḥ . . 74
meaning:
श्रीकरः श्रीनिवासश्च जय जैत्रोपशोभित .
व्योमरूप महारूप धर्मात्मंस्त्वं च वै गतेः . . 74
text_mt: Giver of fortune, abode of Śrī, conqueror, adorned with victory! / Sky-formed, of great form, O righteous one, and thou indeed of motion!

sanskrit_iast:
sānnidhyaṃ kuru daṇḍe'sminsākṣī ca dhruvatāṃ vraja .
kuru vṛddhiṃ sadā kartuḥ prāsādasyārkavallabha . . 75
meaning:
सान्निध्यं कुरु दण्डेऽस्मिन्साक्षी च ध्रुवतां व्रज .
कुरु वृद्धिं सदा कर्तुः प्रासादस्यार्कवल्लभ . . 75
text_mt: Make thy presence in this pole, and as a witness become steadfast; / always grant increase to the builder of the temple, O beloved of the Sun!'

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ ehyehi bhagavannīśvaravinirmita uparicaravāyumārgānusāriñchrīnivāsa ripudhvaṃsa
yakṣanilaya sarvadevapriyaṃ kuru sānnidhyaṃ śānti svastyayanaṃ ca mebhayaṃ sarvavighnā vyapasarantu . . 76
meaning:
ओं एह्येहि भगवन्नीश्वरविनिर्मित उपरिचरवायुमार्गानुसारिञ्छ्रीनिवास रिपुध्वंस
यक्षनिलय सर्वदेवप्रियं कुरु सान्निध्यं शान्ति स्वस्त्ययनं च मेभयं सर्वविघ्ना व्यपसरन्तु . . 76
text_mt: 'Om, come, come, O Lord fashioned by Īśvara, moving in the upper air along the path of the wind, abode of Śrī, destroyer of enemies, / dwelling of yakṣas, dear to all the gods, make thy presence! Grant peace, benediction, and freedom from fear to me; let all obstacles depart!'

sanskrit_iast:
mantreṇānena rājendra śvabhre daṇḍe niveśayet .
patākāṃ pūrvamantreṇa sthityā pūrvamukho nṛpa . . 77
meaning:
मन्त्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र श्वभ्रे दण्डे निवेशयेत् .
पताकां पूर्वमन्त्रेण स्थित्या पूर्वमुखो नृप . . 77
text_mt: With this mantra, O ruler of kings, he should insert the pole into the pit; / facing east, O king, he should place the flag with the previous mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣipedūrdhvamathākāśaṃ prāsādaśikharādvibhoḥ .
yajamānastataḥ paśyetpatākāṃ yadunandana . . 78
meaning:
क्षिपेदूर्ध्वमथाकाशं प्रासादशिखराद्विभोः .
यजमानस्ततः पश्येत्पताकां यदुनन्दन . . 78
text_mt: He should cast [it] upward into the sky from the spire of the temple of the Lord. / Then the patron of the sacrifice should look upon the flag, O delight of the Yadus.

sanskrit_iast:
prāsādapurato vāpi patākāṃ pātayedyadi .
indralokaṃ tadā kartā viśedvai yadunandana . . 79
meaning:
प्रासादपुरतो वापि पताकां पातयेद्यदि .
इन्द्रलोकं तदा कर्ता विशेद्वै यदुनन्दन . . 79
text_mt: If he should drop the flag in front of the temple, / then the builder would enter the world of Indra, O delight of the Yadus.

sanskrit_iast:
āgneyyāmagnilokaṃ tu yāmyāṃ yamasado bhajet .
naiṛtyāṃ naiṛtaṃ lokaṃ vāruṇyaḥ vāruṇaṃ vrajet . . 1.138.80
meaning:
आग्नेय्यामग्निलोकं तु याम्यां यमसदो भजेत् .
नैऋत्यां नैऋतं लोकं वारुण्यः वारुणं व्रजेत् . . 1.138.80
text_mt: In the southeast, he would enjoy the world of Agni; in the south, the abode of Yama; / in the southwest, the world of the Nairṛtas; in the west, he would go to the world of Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya devasya yadveśma kṛtaṃ yadukulodvaha .
tasya lokamavāpnoti vṛṣasthānagato yadi . . 81
meaning:
यस्य देवस्य यद्वेश्म कृतं यदुकुलोद्वह .
तस्य लोकमवाप्नोति वृषस्थानगतो यदि . . 81
text_mt: Whatever temple has been made for whichever deity, O uplifter of the Yadu race, / he attains that deity's world, if it goes to the place of the bull.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyavye vāyumāpnoti saumyāyāṃ somamāpnuyāt .
aiśānyāmīśamāpnoti kartā vai devaveśmanaḥ . . 82
meaning:
वायव्ये वायुमाप्नोति सौम्यायां सोममाप्नुयात् .
ऐशान्यामीशमाप्नोति कर्ता वै देववेश्मनः . . 82
text_mt: In the northwest, he attains Vāyu; in the north, he would attain Soma; / in the northeast, he attains Īśa—the builder of the temple of the god.

sanskrit_iast:
ya evaṃ kārayedbhaktyā dhvajasyāropaṇaṃ raveḥ .
sa hi bhuktvā parānbhogānsūryaloke mahīyate . . 83
meaning:
य एवं कारयेद्भक्त्या ध्वजस्यारोपणं रवेः .
स हि भुक्त्वा परान्भोगान्सूर्यलोके महीयते . . 83
text_mt: He who thus causes the raising of the Sun's banner to be performed with devotion, / having enjoyed supreme pleasures, is honoured in the world of the Sun,

sanskrit_iast:
tejasāmbujasaṃkāśaḥ kāntyā cāmbujasannibhaḥ .
dvijātitulyaḥ prabhayā vikrameṇa ca gopateḥ . . 84
meaning:
तेजसाम्बुजसंकाशः कान्त्या चाम्बुजसन्निभः .
द्विजातितुल्यः प्रभया विक्रमेण च गोपतेः . . 84
text_mt: resembling a lotus in splendour, and like a lotus in beauty, / equal to the twice-born in radiance, and [equal] to the lord of the rays in prowess.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sāmbopākhyāne
dhvajāropaṇavidhivarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ . 138 .
bhojakānayanavarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे साम्बोपाख्याने
ध्वजारोपणविधिवर्णनं नामाष्टत्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः . 138 .
भोजकानयनवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-eighth chapter, named 'Description of the Rite of Raising the Banner', in the Sāmbopākhyāna in the Saptamīkalpa of the Brāhmaparvan in the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of Bringing the Bhojakas

sanskrit_iast:
sāmba uvāca
tvatprasādānmayā prāptaṃ rūpametatpurātanam .
pratyakṣadarśanaṃ cāpi bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ . . 1
meaning:
साम्ब उवाच
त्वत्प्रसादान्मया प्राप्तं रूपमेतत्पुरातनम् .
प्रत्यक्षदर्शनं चापि भास्करस्य महात्मनः . . 1
text_mt: Sāmba said: / By your grace I have regained this ancient form of mine, / and also direct sight of the great-souled Sun.
title: Bhojakānayanam

sanskrit_iast:
sarvametattu samprāpya punaścintākulaṃ manaḥ .
devasya paricaryāyāḥ pālanaṃ kaḥ kariṣyati . . 2
meaning:
सर्वमेतत्तु सम्प्राप्य पुनश्चिन्ताकुलं मनः .
देवस्य परिचर्यायाः पालनं कः करिष्यति . . 2
text_mt: Having obtained all this, my mind is troubled with concern once more: / Who will maintain the service of the Lord?

sanskrit_iast:
guṇayuktaṃ dvijaṃ kiñcitsamarthaṃ paripālane .
mamaivānugrahādbrahmandvijaṃ vyākhyātumarhasi . . 3
meaning:
गुणयुक्तं द्विजं किञ्चित्समर्थं परिपालने .
ममैवानुग्रहाद्ब्रह्मन्द्विजं व्याख्यातुमर्हसि . . 3
text_mt: Explain to me, O brāhmaṇa, out of favour toward me, / some twice-born endowed with virtue, capable of that maintenance.

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktastu sāmbena nāradaḥ pratyuvāca tam .
na dvijāḥ parigṛhṇanti devasya svīkṛtaṃ dhanam . . 4
meaning:
एवमुक्तस्तु साम्बेन नारदः प्रत्युवाच तम् .
न द्विजाः परिगृह्णन्ति देवस्य स्वीकृतं धनम् . . 4
text_mt: Thus addressed by Sāmba, Nārada replied to him: / 'Twice-born men do not accept wealth appropriated for the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyate hi dhanaṃ hyatra guṇaścāyaṃ pratigrahaḥ .
devacaryāgatairdravyaiḥ kriyā brāhmī na vidyate . . 5
meaning:
विद्यते हि धनं ह्यत्र गुणश्चायं प्रतिग्रहः .
देवचर्यागतैर्द्रव्यैः क्रिया ब्राह्मी न विद्यते . . 5
text_mt: For here wealth exists, and this acceptance of gifts has merit; / [yet] by means of materials belonging to temple-worship, no rite of a brāhmaṇa is [valid].

sanskrit_iast:
avajñayā ca kurvanti ye kriyāṃ lobhamohitāḥ .
apāṅkteyā bhavantīha te vai devalakā dvijāḥ . . 6
meaning:
अवज्ञया च कुर्वन्ति ये क्रियां लोभमोहिताः .
अपाङ्क्तेया भवन्तीह ते वै देवलका द्विजाः . . 6
text_mt: And those who, deluded by greed, perform the rite with disrespect, / they become unfit to dine in the assembly, those temple-priest brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
devasvaṃ brāhmaṇatvaṃ ca yo lobhādupajīvati .
sa pāpātmā naro loke gṛdhrocchiṣṭena jīvati . .
tato na brāhmaṇaḥ kaściddevacaryāṃ kariṣyati . . 7
meaning:
देवस्वं ब्राह्मणत्वं च यो लोभादुपजीवति .
स पापात्मा नरो लोके गृध्रोच्छिष्टेन जीवति . .
ततो न ब्राह्मणः कश्चिद्देवचर्यां करिष्यति . . 7
text_mt: That man who, through greed, makes a living from the deity's property and brāhmaṇa status, / is an evildoer in the world who lives on the leavings of vultures. / Therefore, no brāhmaṇa will perform the temple-service.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhijñaṃ jñānavantaṃ ca paricaryākṣamaṃ tathā .
deva eva tamākhyātuṃ tasmāttaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja . . 8
meaning:
विधिज्ञं ज्ञानवन्तं च परिचर्याक्षमं तथा .
देव एव तमाख्यातुं तस्मात्तं शरणं व्रज . . 8
text_mt: The god alone is able to declare one who knows the rituals, / possesses knowledge, and is capable of the service; therefore, seek refuge with him.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā yaduśārdūla ugrasenapurohitam .
gatvā1 gauramukhaṃ pṛccha sa te kāmaṃ vidhāsyati . . 9
meaning:
अथवा यदुशार्दूल उग्रसेनपुरोहितम् .
गत्वा1 गौरमुखं पृच्छ स ते कामं विधास्यति . . 9
text_mt: Or else, O tiger of the Yadus, having gone to Ugrasena's domestic priest, Gauramukha, / ask [him]; he will accomplish your desire.'

sanskrit_iast:
nāradenaivamuktastu sāmbo jāmbavatīsutaḥ .
sukhāsīnaṃ gṛhe vīra ugrasenapurohitam . . 1.139.10
meaning:
नारदेनैवमुक्तस्तु साम्बो जाम्बवतीसुतः .
सुखासीनं गृहे वीर उग्रसेनपुरोहितम् . . 1.139.10
text_mt: Thus addressed by Nārada, Sāmba, the son of Jāmbavatī, the hero, / [approached] Ugrasena's domestic priest seated comfortably in his house.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtapūrvāhṇikaṃ vīra vipraṃ gauramukhaṃ nṛpa .
vinayenopasaṅgamya sāmbo vākyamathābravīt . . 11
meaning:
कृतपूर्वाह्णिकं वीर विप्रं गौरमुखं नृप .
विनयेनोपसङ्गम्य साम्बो वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् . . 11
text_mt: Having approached with humility the brāhmaṇa Gauramukha, / who had completed his morning rituals, Sāmba then spoke these words, O king:

sanskrit_iast:
mayā bhānoḥ prasādena kāritaṃ vipulaṃ gṛham .
sapatnīkaṃ sasainyaṃ ca pṛthivyāṃ sāravatsthitam . . 12
meaning:
मया भानोः प्रसादेन कारितं विपुलं गृहम् .
सपत्नीकं ससैन्यं च पृथिव्यां सारवत्स्थितम् . . 12
text_mt: 'By the grace of the Sun, I have had a spacious house built, / established on the earth as the best [of structures], along with his consort and with his host.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ tasminmayā dattaṃ kṛtaṃ mūrteśca maṇḍalam .
tasmādiṣṭvā viśiṣṭebhyo deyaṃ dānaṃ manogatam . . 13
meaning:
सर्वं तस्मिन्मया दत्तं कृतं मूर्तेश्च मण्डलम् .
तस्मादिष्ट्वा विशिष्टेभ्यो देयं दानं मनोगतम् . . 13
text_mt: Everything has been given by me therein, and an altar for the image has been made; / therefore, having sacrificed, a gift pleasing to the heart is to be given to distinguished men.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsarvaṃ mama samprītyā gṛhāṇa tvaṃ mahāmune .
sāmbavākyamidaṃ śrutvā pratyuvāca mahāmuniḥ . . 14
meaning:
तत्सर्वं मम सम्प्रीत्या गृहाण त्वं महामुने .
साम्बवाक्यमिदं श्रुत्वा प्रत्युवाच महामुनिः . . 14
text_mt: Accept all that, O great sage, for my pleasure!' / Having heard these words of Sāmba, the great sage replied:

sanskrit_iast:
gauramukha uvāca
bravīmyahamaśeṣeṇa yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ .
ahaṃ vipro bhavānrājā sa ca devaparigrahaḥ . .
aparasparamevaṃ tu grahaṇaṃ me virudhyate . . 15
meaning:
गौरमुख उवाच
ब्रवीम्यहमशेषेण यथावदनुपूर्वशः .
अहं विप्रो भवान्राजा स च देवपरिग्रहः . .
अपरस्परमेवं तु ग्रहणं मे विरुध्यते . . 15
text_mt:
Gauramukha said:
I shall explain completely, in due order as it is.
I am a brahmin, you are a king, and that [temple property] is dedicated to the deity.
Thus, taking [it] reciprocally is forbidden for me.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmavidyāpraṇītāni svakarmāṇi dvijātayaḥ .
kurvāṇā na prahīyante anyathā bhinnavṛttayaḥ . . 16
meaning:
ब्रह्मविद्याप्रणीतानि स्वकर्माणि द्विजातयः .
कुर्वाणा न प्रहीयन्ते अन्यथा भिन्नवृत्तयः . . 16
text_mt: Twice-born men performing their own duties / prescribed by the knowledge of Brahman do not decline; otherwise they lose their proper conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣāntiradhyāpanaṃ2 jāpaḥ satyaṃ ca yadunandana .
etāni viprakarmāṇi na devārthaparigrahaḥ3 . . 17
meaning:
क्षान्तिरध्यापनं2 जापः सत्यं च यदुनन्दन .
एतानि विप्रकर्माणि न देवार्थपरिग्रहः3 . . 17
text_mt: Patience, teaching, recitation, and truthfulness, O delight of the Yadus, / these are the duties of a brahmin, not taking things meant for a deity.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi devārthadānaṃ1 syāttato devalakā dvijāḥ .
devadravyābhilāṣaśca brāhmaṇyaṃ tu vimuñcati . . 18
meaning:
यदि देवार्थदानं1 स्यात्ततो देवलका द्विजाः .
देवद्रव्याभिलाषश्च ब्राह्मण्यं तु विमुञ्चति . . 18
text_mt: If there should be a gift meant for a deity, then the twice-born become devalakas; / and longing for a deity's property forfeits brahminhood.

sanskrit_iast:
devadvāre ca yaddānaṃ brāhmaṇāya prayacchati .
dvāvetau pāpakartārāvātmadoṣeṇa mānavau . . 19
meaning:
देवद्वारे च यद्दानं ब्राह्मणाय प्रयच्छति .
द्वावेतौ पापकर्तारावात्मदोषेण मानवौ . . 19
text_mt: And whatever gift one gives to a brahmin at the door of a temple, / both of these men become committers of sin through their own fault.

sanskrit_iast:
devārthadānaṃ2 vārṣṇeya yadgṛhītvā ca yo dvijaḥ .
śrāddhe vā yadi vā satre tajjuhoti dadāti vā . .
bhinna vṛtto dvijaḥ pāpo rākṣasaḥ so'bhijāyate . . 1.139.20
meaning:
देवार्थदानं2 वार्ष्णेय यद्गृहीत्वा च यो द्विजः .
श्राद्धे वा यदि वा सत्रे तज्जुहोति ददाति वा . .
भिन्न वृत्तो द्विजः पापो राक्षसः सोऽभिजायते . . 1.139.20
text_mt: Whatever twice-born man, having accepted a gift meant for a deity, O descendant of Vṛṣṇi, / offers it in a sacrifice or gives it in a śrāddha or sacrificial session, / that sinful twice-born man, corrupted in conduct, is reborn as a rākṣasa.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijo devalako yatra paṅktyāṃ bhuṅkte mahīpate .
annānyupaspṛśennīcā sā paṅktiḥ pāpamācaret . . 21
meaning:
द्विजो देवलको यत्र पङ्क्त्यां भुङ्क्ते महीपते .
अन्नान्युपस्पृशेन्नीचा सा पङ्क्तिः पापमाचरेत् . . 21
text_mt: In whatever row a devalaka twice-born man eats, O lord of the earth, / [and] touches the foods, that low row commits sin.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijo devalako yasya saṃskāraṃ samprayacchati .
so'dhomukhānpitṝnsarvānākramya vinipātayet . . 22
meaning:
द्विजो देवलको यस्य संस्कारं सम्प्रयच्छति .
सोऽधोमुखान्पितॄन्सर्वानाक्रम्य विनिपातयेत् . . 22
text_mt: The devalaka twice-born man who administers a rite of passage / tramples all his ancestors and causes them to fall headlong into hell.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānaṃ pātayedyastu sonyānuddharate katham
uddhariṣyati cātmānamityeṣā kalpanādhamā . . 23
meaning:
आत्मानं पातयेद्यस्तु सोन्यानुद्धरते कथम्
उद्धरिष्यति चात्मानमित्येषा कल्पनाधमा . . 23
text_mt: How can one who brings himself to ruin deliver others? / That he will deliver himself is a wretched fancy.

sanskrit_iast:
yo haṭhācca bhayāccaiva kurute raviveśmanaḥ .
vṛttiṃ vidhatte vipratvātpatitassa tu jāyate . . 24
meaning:
यो हठाच्च भयाच्चैव कुरुते रविवेश्मनः .
वृत्तिं विधत्ते विप्रत्वात्पतितस्स तु जायते . . 24
text_mt: He who, out of force or fear, creates / [his] livelihood from the temple of the Sun, falls from brahminhood.

sanskrit_iast:
sapratigrahamantreṇa dvijo'śnāti parigraham .
devapratigrahārtheṣu vedavākyaṃ na vidyate . . 25
meaning:
सप्रतिग्रहमन्त्रेण द्विजोऽश्नाति परिग्रहम् .
देवप्रतिग्रहार्थेषु वेदवाक्यं न विद्यते . . 25
text_mt: A twice-born man enjoys a gift by means of the mantra for acceptance; / there is no Vedic statement for the acceptance of gifts meant for deities.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādrājā na devārthaṃ vipre dadyātkathañcana .
brahmasūtramahaṃ chittvā gamiṣyāmīti gamyatām . . 26
meaning:
तस्माद्राजा न देवार्थं विप्रे दद्यात्कथञ्चन .
ब्रह्मसूत्रमहं छित्त्वा गमिष्यामीति गम्यताम् . . 26
text_mt: Therefore, a king should never give property meant for a deity to a brahmin. / Having broken my sacred thread, I shall depart; let [everyone] go.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmba uvāca
agrāhyaṃ ceddvijātibhyaḥ kasmai deyamidaṃ mayā .
śrutaṃ vā dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ vā tanme vyākhyātumarhasi . . 27
meaning:
साम्ब उवाच
अग्राह्यं चेद्द्विजातिभ्यः कस्मै देयमिदं मया .
श्रुतं वा दृष्टपूर्वं वा तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि . . 27
text_mt:
Sāmba said:
If it is not to be accepted by twice-born men, to whom should this be given by me? / Whether heard or seen before, you ought to explain that to me.

sanskrit_iast:
gauramukha uvāca
magāya samprayaccha tvaṃ purametacchubhaṃ vibho .
tasyādhikāro devānne devatānāṃ ca pūjane . . 28
meaning:
गौरमुख उवाच
मगाय सम्प्रयच्छ त्वं पुरमेतच्छुभं विभो .
तस्याधिकारो देवान्ने देवतानां च पूजने . . 28
text_mt:
Gauramukha said:
Give this auspicious city to a Maga, O lord; / his entitlement is to the food of the deity and to the worship of the deities.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmba uvāca
ko'yaṃ mageti te proktāḥ kva vāsau vasate vibho .
kasya putro dvijaśreṣṭha kimācāraḥ kimākṛtiḥ . . 29
meaning:
साम्ब उवाच
कोऽयं मगेति ते प्रोक्ताः क्व वासौ वसते विभो .
कस्य पुत्रो द्विजश्रेष्ठ किमाचारः किमाकृतिः . . 29
text_mt:
Sāmba said:
Who is this who is called by you a Maga, and where does he dwell, O lord? / Whose son is he, O best of the twice-born, and what is his conduct and appearance?

sanskrit_iast:
gauramukha uvāca
yo'yaṃ mageti vai prokto mago divyo dvijottamaḥ .
nikṣubhāyāṃ 1 suto vīra ādityātmaja ucyate . . 1.139.30
meaning:
गौरमुख उवाच
योऽयं मगेति वै प्रोक्तो मगो दिव्यो द्विजोत्तमः .
निक्षुभायां 1 सुतो वीर आदित्यात्मज उच्यते . . 1.139.30
text_mt:
Gauramukha said:
This Maga who is spoken of is divine, the best among the twice-born; / born of Nikṣubhā, O hero, he is said to be the son of Āditya.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmba uvāca
kathaṃ sa nikṣubhāputraḥ kathaṃ vīrasutastathā .
kathaṃ cādityatanayo mago'sāvucyatena'gha . . 31
meaning:
साम्ब उवाच
कथं स निक्षुभापुत्रः कथं वीरसुतस्तथा .
कथं चादित्यतनयो मगोऽसावुच्यतेनऽघ . . 31
text_mt:
Sāmba said:
How is he the son of Nikṣubhā, and how is he the son of a hero? / And how is this Maga called the offspring of Āditya, O sinless one?

sanskrit_iast:
gauramukha uvāca
mānuṣatvaṃ gatā devī nikṣubhā kila yādava .
gatā śāpamavāpyeha bhāskarāllokapūjitā . . 32
meaning:
गौरमुख उवाच
मानुषत्वं गता देवी निक्षुभा किल यादव .
गता शापमवाप्येह भास्कराल्लोकपूजिता . . 32
text_mt:
Gauramukha said:
The goddess Nikṣubhā, worshipped by all the world, attained human state, O Yādava; / she came here having received a curse from Bhāskara.

sanskrit_iast:
gotraṃ mihiramityāhustasmai brāhmaṇyamuttamam .
sujihvā nāma dharmātmā ṛṣiputraḥ purānagha . . 33
meaning:
गोत्रं मिहिरमित्याहुस्तस्मै ब्राह्मण्यमुत्तमम् .
सुजिह्वा नाम धर्मात्मा ऋषिपुत्रः पुरानघ . . 33
text_mt: They declare his lineage to be Mihira, [and] to him belongs the highest brahminhood. / In ancient times, O sinless one, there was a righteous son of a sage named Sujihva.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyātmajā samutpannā nikṣubhā sā varāṅganā .
rūpeṇāpratimā loke hāralīlā matā tu sā . . 34
meaning:
तस्यात्मजा समुत्पन्ना निक्षुभा सा वराङ्गना .
रूपेणाप्रतिमा लोके हारलीला मता तु सा . . 34
text_mt: To him was born a daughter, Nikṣubhā, an excellent woman, / peerless in the world for her beauty, regarded as a necklace's grace.

sanskrit_iast: piturniyogātsā kanyā viharejjātavedasi . . 35
meaning: पितुर्नियोगात्सा कन्या विहरेज्जातवेदसि . . 35
text_mt: By her father's command, that maiden was to sport near the sacrificial fire.

sanskrit_iast:
viharantī yathānyāyaṃ samiddhe pāvake tathā .
atha tāṃ devadeveśo hyaṃśumālī dadarśa ha . . 36
meaning:
विहरन्ती यथान्यायं समिद्धे पावके तथा .
अथ तां देवदेवेशो ह्यंशुमाली ददर्श ह . . 36
text_mt: While she was thus sporting properly near the kindled fire, / the lord of the gods, the sun with garlanded rays, saw her.

sanskrit_iast:
rūpayauvanasampannāṃ tataḥ kāmavaśaṃ gataḥ .
cintayāmāsa deveśaḥ kathaṃ tāṃ vai bhajāmyaham . . 37
meaning:
रूपयौवनसम्पन्नां ततः कामवशं गतः .
चिन्तयामास देवेशः कथं तां वै भजाम्यहम् . . 37
text_mt: Endowed with beauty and youth, he fell under the power of desire; / then the lord of gods considered: 'How may I enjoy her?

sanskrit_iast:
anayāvahṛto yo'yaṃ pāvako devapūjitaḥ .
vanamāviśya tanvaṅgīṃ bhajeyaṃ lokapūjitām . . 38
meaning:
अनयावहृतो योऽयं पावको देवपूजितः .
वनमाविश्य तन्वङ्गीं भजेयं लोकपूजिताम् . . 38
text_mt: Entering this sacrificial fire worshipped by the gods, which was brought by her, / I shall enter the forest and enjoy that slender-limbed woman worshipped by the world.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti sañcintya deveśaḥ sahasrāṃśurdivaspati .
viveśa pāvakaṃ vīra tatputraścābhavattadā . . 39
meaning:
इति सञ्चिन्त्य देवेशः सहस्रांशुर्दिवस्पति .
विवेश पावकं वीर तत्पुत्रश्चाभवत्तदा . . 39
text_mt: Having reflected thus, the lord of gods, the thousand-rayed lord of the sky, / entered the fire, O hero, and then became her son.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vilāsalāvaṇyarūpayauvanaśālinī .
samiddhaṃ laṅghayitvāgniṃ jagāmāyatalocanā . . 1.139.40
meaning:
ततो विलासलावण्यरूपयौवनशालिनी .
समिद्धं लङ्घयित्वाग्निं जगामायतलोचना . . 1.139.40
text_mt: Then, radiant with charm, loveliness, beauty, and youth, / that wide-eyed maiden stepped over the kindled fire and went away.

sanskrit_iast:
kruddhaḥ svarūpamāsthāya dṛṣṭvā kanyāṃ sa pīḍitaḥ .
karaṃ kareṇa saṅgṛhya tatastāṃ havyavāhanaḥ . . 41
meaning:
क्रुद्धः स्वरूपमास्थाय दृष्ट्वा कन्यां स पीडितः .
करं करेण सङ्गृह्य ततस्तां हव्यवाहनः . . 41
text_mt: Angered, taking his own form upon seeing the maiden, the fire-god, distressed, / then seized her hand with his hand,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca yaduśārdūla nodito bhāskareṇa tu .
vedoktaṃ vidhimutsṛjya yathāhaṃ laṃghitastvayā . .4 2
tasmānmattaḥ samutpanno na ca putro bhaviṣyati .
jaraśabda iti khyāto vaṃśakīrtivivardhanaḥ . . 43
meaning:
उवाच यदुशार्दूल नोदितो भास्करेण तु .
वेदोक्तं विधिमुत्सृज्य यथाहं लंघितस्त्वया . .4 2
तस्मान्मत्तः समुत्पन्नो न च पुत्रो भविष्यति .
जरशब्द इति ख्यातो वंशकीर्तिविवर्धनः . . 43
text_mt: and, O tiger of the Yadus, said, prompted by Bhāskara: / 'Because, abandoning the rule taught in the Veda, I was stepped over by you, / therefore, though born from me, he will not be a [mere] son; / he will be renowned by the name Jara, furthering the glory of his lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
agnijātyā magāḥ proktāḥ somajātyā dvijātayaḥ .
bhojakādityajātyā hi divyāste parikīrtitāḥ . .44
meaning:
अग्निजात्या मगाः प्रोक्ताः सोमजात्या द्विजातयः .
भोजकादित्यजात्या हि दिव्यास्ते परिकीर्तिताः . .44
text_mt: Magas are said to belong to the caste of fire, twice-born men to the caste of soma; / Bhojakas indeed belong to the caste of the sun; they are celebrated as divine.'

sanskrit_iast:
tāmevamuktvā bhagavānādityo'ntaratastadā .
athotpannāṃ prajāṃ jñātvā dhyānayogena vai ṛṣiḥ . . 45
meaning:
तामेवमुक्त्वा भगवानादित्योऽन्तरतस्तदा .
अथोत्पन्नां प्रजां ज्ञात्वा ध्यानयोगेन वै ऋषिः . . 45
text_mt: Having thus addressed her, the lord Āditya then vanished. / Then the sage, knowing through the yoga of meditation that an offspring had been conceived,

sanskrit_iast:
patitaḥ syānmahātejā ṛgjihvaḥ sumahāmatiḥ .
śāpamudyamya tejasvī ṛgjihvo vākyamabravīt . . 46
meaning:
पतितः स्यान्महातेजा ऋग्जिह्वः सुमहामतिः .
शापमुद्यम्य तेजस्वी ऋग्जिह्वो वाक्यमब्रवीत् . . 46
text_mt: the great-spirited, highly intelligent Ṛgjihva became fallen [from composure]. / Raising a curse, the resplendent Ṛgjihva spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
ātmāparādhātkāminyā yathā garbho nalāvṛtaḥ .
sambhūtaste mahābhāge apūjyo'yaṃ bhaviṣyati . . 47
meaning:
आत्मापराधात्कामिन्या यथा गर्भो नलावृतः .
सम्भूतस्ते महाभागे अपूज्योऽयं भविष्यति . . 47
text_mt: ‘Since, through the fault of a lustful woman, a womb covered with fire / was formed by you, O fortunate one, this [child] shall be unvenerable.’

sanskrit_iast:
putraśokābhisantaptā bālā paryākulekṣaṇā .
cintayāmāsa duḥkhārtā tamekaṃ jvalanākṛtim . . 48
meaning:
पुत्रशोकाभिसन्तप्ता बाला पर्याकुलेक्षणा .
चिन्तयामास दुःखार्ता तमेकं ज्वलनाकृतिम् . . 48
text_mt: Afflicted by grief for her son, the young woman with bewildered eyes / and tormented by sorrow meditated on that singular one whose form is flame:

sanskrit_iast:
tato devavariṣṭhasya mama yonisamudbhavaḥ .
ayaṃ datto mahāśāpaḥ pūjyatāṃ kartumarhasi . .4 9
bhavetpūjyo hi me putro deveśvara tathā kuru .
evaṃ ciṃtayamānastu bhagavānaryamā kila . . 1.139.50
meaning:
ततो देववरिष्ठस्य मम योनिसमुद्भवः .
अयं दत्तो महाशापः पूज्यतां कर्तुमर्हसि . .4 9
भवेत्पूज्यो हि मे पुत्रो देवेश्वर तथा कुरु .
एवं चिंतयमानस्तु भगवानर्यमा किल . . 1.139.50
text_mt: ‘Then, this great curse was laid upon the offspring born of my womb from the best of gods; / you ought to make him worthy of worship. / Let my son be worthy of worship, O lord of gods; act accordingly.’ / While she was thus thinking, the lord Aryaman indeed,

sanskrit_iast:
āgneyaṃ rūpamāśritya cedaṃ vacanamabravīt .
snigdho gambhīranirghoṣaḥ śānto jvaravivarjitaḥ . . 51
meaning:
आग्नेयं रूपमाश्रित्य चेदं वचनमब्रवीत् .
स्निग्धो गम्भीरनिर्घोषः शान्तो ज्वरविवर्जितः . . 51
text_mt: assuming a form of fire, spoke these words, / gentle, with a deep sound, calm, and free from agitation:

sanskrit_iast:
ṛgjihraḥ sumahātejā dharmaṃ carati suvrata .
tenotsṛṣṭaṃ mahāśāpaṃ nānyathā kartumutsahe . . 52
meaning:
ऋग्जिह्रः सुमहातेजा धर्मं चरति सुव्रत .
तेनोत्सृष्टं महाशापं नान्यथा कर्तुमुत्सहे . . 52
text_mt: ‘The very splendid Ṛgjihva practices dharma, faithful to his vows; / I cannot undo the great curse cast by him.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ tu kāryagarīyastvādātmano yogyamuttamam .
tava putraṃ vidhāsyāmi cāpūjyaṃ vedapāragam . . 53
meaning:
किं तु कार्यगरीयस्त्वादात्मनो योग्यमुत्तमम् .
तव पुत्रं विधास्यामि चापूज्यं वेदपारगम् . . 53
text_mt: However, due to the gravity of the task, I will make your son, / who is worthy and most excellent for me, unvenerable [to others], but a master of the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
vaṃśaśca sumahāṃstasya nivasiṣyati bhūtale .
mamāṅgāni mahātmāno vāśiṣṭhā brahmavādinaḥ . . 54
meaning:
वंशश्च सुमहांस्तस्य निवसिष्यति भूतले .
ममाङ्गानि महात्मानो वाशिष्ठा ब्रह्मवादिनः . . 54
text_mt: And a very great lineage of his will dwell upon the surface of the earth; / they will be my limbs, high-souled, descendants of Vasiṣṭha, proclaimers of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
madgāyanā madyajanā madbhaktā matparāyaṇāḥ .
mama śuśrūṣakāścaiva mama ca vratacāriṇaḥ . . 55
meaning:
मद्गायना मद्यजना मद्भक्ता मत्परायणाः .
मम शुश्रूषकाश्चैव मम च व्रतचारिणः . . 55
text_mt: Singing of me, sacrificing to me, devoted to me, intent upon me, / attendants upon me, and observers of my vows,

sanskrit_iast:
tvāṃ ca māṃ ca yathānyāyaṃ vedaṃ tattvārthadarśinaḥ .
pūjayiṣyanti niratāḥ sadā madbhāvabhāvitāḥ . . 56
meaning:
त्वां च मां च यथान्यायं वेदं तत्त्वार्थदर्शिनः .
पूजयिष्यन्ति निरताः सदा मद्भावभाविताः . . 56
text_mt: discerning the true meaning of the Veda, constantly imbued with my nature, / devoted, they will properly worship you and me.

sanskrit_iast:
matkarmaṇāṃ madaṅgānāṃ madbhāvaviniveśanāt .
virajā matprasādena māmevaiṣyantyasaṃśayam . . 57
meaning:
मत्कर्मणां मदङ्गानां मद्भावविनिवेशनात् .
विरजा मत्प्रसादेन मामेवैष्यन्त्यसंशयम् . . 57
text_mt: From the performance of my rites, from [serving] my limbs, and from the entry into my being, / cleansed of passion by my grace, they will without doubt attain me alone.

sanskrit_iast:
jaṭāśmaśrudharā nityaṃ sadā mayi parāyaṇāḥ .
pañcakālavidhānajñā vīrakālasya yajvinaḥ . . 58
meaning:
जटाश्मश्रुधरा नित्यं सदा मयि परायणाः .
पञ्चकालविधानज्ञा वीरकालस्य यज्विनः . . 58
text_mt: Constantly wearing matted hair and beards, always devoted to me, / knowing the rules of the five periods of the day, sacrificers of the heroic time,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇekadakṣiṇe pāṇau varma vāmena dhārayan .
patidānena vadanaṃ pracchādya niyataḥ śuciḥ . . 59
meaning:
पूर्णेकदक्षिणे पाणौ वर्म वामेन धारयन् .
पतिदानेन वदनं प्रच्छाद्य नियतः शुचिः . . 59
text_mt: holding the full vessel in the right hand and armour in the left, / covering the face with the mouth-veil, self-restrained and pure.’

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇaṃ hi mahatāṃ kṛtvā tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ .
ayamāccāprasādācca vyākulendriyacetasā . . 1.139.60
meaning:
प्राणं हि महतां कृत्वा ततो भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः .
अयमाच्चाप्रसादाच्च व्याकुलेन्द्रियचेतसा . . 1.139.60
text_mt: Having made an offering of life-breath for the great, he should then eat with restrained speech, / with senses and mind troubled by lack of restraint and displeasure.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhihīnaṃ maṃtrahīna ye vai yakṣyanti māmataḥ .
te'pi svargāccyutāḥ klāntā ramante sūryasannidhau . . 61
meaning:
विधिहीनं मंत्रहीन ये वै यक्ष्यन्ति मामतः .
तेऽपि स्वर्गाच्च्युताः क्लान्ता रमन्ते सूर्यसन्निधौ . . 61
text_mt: Those who sacrifice to me henceforth devoid of rule and devoid of mantras, / even they, fallen from heaven and weary, find delight in the presence of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃvidhāstava sutā bhaviṣyanti mahītale .
magavaṃśe mahātmāno vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ . . 62
meaning:
एवंविधास्तव सुता भविष्यन्ति महीतले .
मगवंशे महात्मानो वेदवेदाङ्गपारगाः . . 62
text_mt: Such shall be your sons upon the surface of the earth: / high-souled men in the lineage of the Magas, masters who have crossed to the further shore of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas.

sanskrit_iast:
evamāśvāsya tāṃ devīṃ bhāskaro vāritaskaraḥ .
antadardhe mahātejāḥ sā ca harṣamavāpa ha . . 63
meaning:
एवमाश्वास्य तां देवीं भास्करो वारितस्करः .
अन्तदर्धे महातेजाः सा च हर्षमवाप ह . . 63
text_mt: Having thus comforted that goddess, the radiant Sun, dispeller of darkness, / disappeared, and she attained great joy.

sanskrit_iast:
evamete samutpannā bhojakāḥ kṛṣṇanandana .
viṣṇubhāste tathādityā utpannā lokapūjitāḥ . . 64
meaning:
एवमेते समुत्पन्ना भोजकाः कृष्णनन्दन .
विष्णुभास्ते तथादित्या उत्पन्ना लोकपूजिताः . . 64
text_mt: In this way were these Bhojakas born, O delight of Kṛṣṇa; / possessing the splendour of Viṣṇu and of Āditya, they were born honoured by the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāmetatpuraṃ dehi paryāptāste pratigrahe .
tvadīyasyāsya me vīra tathā bhāskarapūjane . . 65
meaning:
तेषामेतत्पुरं देहि पर्याप्तास्ते प्रतिग्रहे .
त्वदीयस्यास्य मे वीर तथा भास्करपूजने . . 65
text_mt: Grant this city to them; they are worthy to receive [gifts] / of what is yours, O hero, as well as to perform the worship of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya gauramukhasyedaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā sa yādavaḥ .
sāmbo jāmbavatīputraḥ praṇamya śirasoktavān . . 66
meaning:
तस्य गौरमुखस्येदं वाक्यं श्रुत्वा स यादवः .
साम्बो जाम्बवतीपुत्रः प्रणम्य शिरसोक्तवान् . . 66
text_mt: Having heard these words of Gauramukha, that Yādava, / Sāmba, the son of Jāmbavatī, bowed with his head and said:

sanskrit_iast:
kva vasante mahātmāna ete bhāskaraputrakāḥ .
bhojakā dvijaśārdūla yena tānānayāmyaham . . 67
meaning:
क्व वसन्ते महात्मान एते भास्करपुत्रकाः .
भोजका द्विजशार्दूल येन तानानयाम्यहम् . . 67
text_mt: "Where do these high-souled sons of the Sun, / the Bhojakas, dwell, O tiger among the twice-born, so that I may bring them?"

sanskrit_iast:
gauramukha uvāca
nāhaṃ jāne mahābāho vasante yatra vai magāḥ .
jānīte tānravirvīra tasmāttaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja . . 68
meaning:
गौरमुख उवाच
नाहं जाने महाबाहो वसन्ते यत्र वै मगाः .
जानीते तान्रविर्वीर तस्मात्तं शरणं व्रज . . 68
text_mt: Gauramukha said: / "I do not know, O mighty-armed one, where the Magas dwell. / The Sun knows them, O hero; therefore, go to him for refuge."

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇenaivamuktastu praṇamya śirasā ravim .
jagāda bhāskaraṃ sāmbaḥ kaste pūjāṃ kariṣyati . . 6 9-
vijñaptastveva sāmbena pratimā tamuvāca ha .
na yogyāḥ paricaryāyāṃ jambūdvīpe mamānagha . . 1.139.70
meaning:
ब्राह्मणेनैवमुक्तस्तु प्रणम्य शिरसा रविम् .
जगाद भास्करं साम्बः कस्ते पूजां करिष्यति . . 6 9-
विज्ञप्तस्त्वेव साम्बेन प्रतिमा तमुवाच ह .
न योग्याः परिचर्यायां जम्बूद्वीपे ममानघ . . 1.139.70
