text_mt: Thus addressed by the brāhmaṇa, Sāmba bowed his head to the Sun / and spoke to the Sun: "Who will perform your worship?" / Being thus petitioned by Sāmba, the image spoke to him: / "The people in Jambūdvīpa are not fit for my attendance, O sinless one.

sanskrit_iast:
mama pūjākaraṃ gatvā śākadvīpādihānaya .
lavaṇodātpare pāre kṣīrodena samāvṛtaḥ . . 71
meaning:
मम पूजाकरं गत्वा शाकद्वीपादिहानय .
लवणोदात्परे पारे क्षीरोदेन समावृतः . . 71
text_mt: Go and bring here from Śākadvīpa one who can perform my worship. / Beyond the Salt Ocean's further shore, it is encircled by the Milk Ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
jambūdvīpātparo yasmācchākadvīpa iti smṛtaḥ .
tatra puṇyā janapadāścaturvarṇasamanvitāḥ . . 72
meaning:
जम्बूद्वीपात्परो यस्माच्छाकद्वीप इति स्मृतः .
तत्र पुण्या जनपदाश्चतुर्वर्णसमन्विताः . . 72
text_mt: Because it lies beyond Jambūdvīpa, it is known as Śākadvīpa. / There lie sacred realms, endowed with the four classes:

sanskrit_iast:
magāśca magagāścaiva gānagā1 mandagāstathā .
magā brāhmaṇabhūyiṣṭhā magagāḥ kṣatriyāḥ smṛtāḥ . . 73
meaning:
मगाश्च मगगाश्चैव गानगा1 मन्दगास्तथा .
मगा ब्राह्मणभूयिष्ठा मगगाः क्षत्रियाः स्मृताः . . 73
text_mt: the Magas, the Magagas, the Gānagas, and the Mandagas. / The Magas are mostly brāhmaṇas; the Magagas are considered kṣatriyas;

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśyāstu gānagā jñeyāḥ śūdrāsteṣāṃ tu mandagāḥ .
na teṣāṃ saṅkaraḥ kaściddharmāśrayakṛte kvacit . . 74
meaning:
वैश्यास्तु गानगा ज्ञेयाः शूद्रास्तेषां तु मन्दगाः .
न तेषां सङ्करः कश्चिद्धर्माश्रयकृते क्वचित् . . 74
text_mt: the Gānagas are to be known as vaiśyas, and the Mandagas among them as śūdras. / Among them there is never any intermixture concerning the observance of dharma,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmasyāsya vicāro vā hyekataḥ sukhinaḥ prajāḥ .
tejasaste madīyasya nirmitā viśvakarmaṇā . . . . 75
meaning:
धर्मस्यास्य विचारो वा ह्येकतः सुखिनः प्रजाः .
तेजसस्ते मदीयस्य निर्मिता विश्वकर्मणा . . . . 75
text_mt: nor any dispute over this dharma; the subjects are singularly happy. / They were fashioned by Viśvakarman from my own splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
tebhyo vedāstu catvāraḥ sarahasyā mayoditāḥ .
vedoktairvividhaiḥ stotraiḥ parairguhyairmayā kṛtaiḥ . . 76
meaning:
तेभ्यो वेदास्तु चत्वारः सरहस्या मयोदिताः .
वेदोक्तैर्विविधैः स्तोत्रैः परैर्गुह्यैर्मया कृतैः . . 76
text_mt: To them the four Vedas were spoken by me along with their secret teachings, / with diverse hymns proclaimed in the Vedas, supreme and secret, composed by me.

sanskrit_iast:
te ca dhyāyanti māmeva yajante māṃ ca nityaśaḥ .
manmānasā madyajanā madbhaktā matparāyaṇāḥ . . 77
meaning:
ते च ध्यायन्ति मामेव यजन्ते मां च नित्यशः .
मन्मानसा मद्यजना मद्भक्ता मत्परायणाः . . 77
text_mt: And they meditate on me alone, and they sacrifice to me constantly, / their minds fixed on me, sacrificing to me, devoted to me, intent upon me,

sanskrit_iast:
mama śuśrūṣakāścaiva mama ca vratacāriṇaḥ .
avyaṅgadhāriṇaścaiva vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā . . 78
meaning:
मम शुश्रूषकाश्चैव मम च व्रतचारिणः .
अव्यङ्गधारिणश्चैव विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा . . 78
text_mt: attending upon me, performing vows dedicated to me, / and wearing the avyaṅga according to rites ordained by rule.

sanskrit_iast:
kurvanti te sadā bhadrāṃ mama pūjāṃ mamānugāḥ .
tathā devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca saha cāraṇaiḥ . .
viharante ramante ca dṛśyamānāśca taiḥ saha . . 79
meaning:
कुर्वन्ति ते सदा भद्रां मम पूजां ममानुगाः .
तथा देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च सह चारणैः . .
विहरन्ते रमन्ते च दृश्यमानाश्च तैः सह . . 79
text_mt: They, my followers, always perform my auspicious worship. / Likewise the gods with the gandharvas, and the siddhas along with the cāraṇas, / sport and take delight, visibly present with them.

sanskrit_iast:
jambūdvīpe tvahaṃ viṣṇurvedavedāṅgapūjitaḥ .
śakro'haṃ śālmalīdvīpe krauñcadvīpe hyahaṃ bhagaḥ1 . . 1.139.80
meaning:
जम्बूद्वीपे त्वहं विष्णुर्वेदवेदाङ्गपूजितः .
शक्रोऽहं शाल्मलीद्वीपे क्रौञ्चद्वीपे ह्यहं भगः1 . . 1.139.80
text_mt: In Jambūdvīpa I am Viṣṇu, worshipped by the Vedas and Vedāṅgas; / I am Śakra in Śālmalīdvīpa; in Krauñcadvīpa I am Bhaga;

sanskrit_iast:
plakṣadvīpe tvahaṃ bhānuḥ śākadvīpe divākaraḥ .
puṣkare ca smṛto brahmā tataścāhaṃ maheśvaraḥ . . 81
meaning:
प्लक्षद्वीपे त्वहं भानुः शाकद्वीपे दिवाकरः .
पुष्करे च स्मृतो ब्रह्मा ततश्चाहं महेश्वरः . . 81
text_mt: in Plakṣadvīpa I am Bhānu; in Śākadvīpa, Divākara; / and in Puṣkara I am called Brahmā; and further, I am Maheśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
tānmagānmama pūjārthaṃ śākadvīpādihānaya .
āruhya garuḍaṃ sāmba śīghraṃ gatvāvicārayan . . 82
meaning:
तान्मगान्मम पूजार्थं शाकद्वीपादिहानय .
आरुह्य गरुडं साम्ब शीघ्रं गत्वाविचारयन् . . 82
text_mt: Bring those Magas here from Śākadvīpa for my worship. / Mounting Garuḍa, Sāmba, go quickly without hesitation."

sanskrit_iast:
tatheti gṛhya tāmājñāṃ raverjāmbavatīsutaḥ .
punardvāravatīṃ gatvā kāntyātīva samanvitaḥ . . 83
meaning:
तथेति गृह्य तामाज्ञां रवेर्जाम्बवतीसुतः .
पुनर्द्वारवतीं गत्वा कान्त्यातीव समन्वितः . . 83
text_mt: Saying "So be it," Jāmbavatī's son received that command of the Sun, / and went again to Dvāravatī, filled with exceeding splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
ākhyātavānpituḥ sarvaṃ svakīyaṃ devadarśanam .
tasmācca garuḍaṃ labdhvā yayau sāmbo'dhiruhya tam . . 84
meaning:
आख्यातवान्पितुः सर्वं स्वकीयं देवदर्शनम् .
तस्माच्च गरुडं लब्ध्वा ययौ साम्बोऽधिरुह्य तम् . . 84
text_mt: He told his father everything regarding his vision of the god. / Having obtained Garuḍa from him, Sāmba mounted him and departed.

sanskrit_iast:
śākadvīpamanuprāpya samprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ .
tatrāpaśyadyathoddiṣṭānsāmbastejasvino magān . . 85
meaning:
शाकद्वीपमनुप्राप्य सम्प्रहृष्टतनूरुहः .
तत्रापश्यद्यथोद्दिष्टान्साम्बस्तेजस्विनो मगान् . . 85
text_mt: Having reached Śākadvīpa with his hair thrilling with joy, / Sāmba saw there the splendid Magas, just as described,

sanskrit_iast:
vivasvantaṃ pūjayanto dhūpadīpādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ .
so'bhivādya ca tānpūrvaṃ kṛtvāpyeṣāṃ pradakṣiṇām . . 86
meaning:
विवस्वन्तं पूजयन्तो धूपदीपादिभिः शुभैः .
सोऽभिवाद्य च तान्पूर्वं कृत्वाप्येषां प्रदक्षिणाम् . . 86
text_mt: worshipping Vivasvat with auspicious incense, lamps, and the like. / Having first greeted them and circumambulated them,

sanskrit_iast:
pṛṣṭvā cānāmayaṃ teṣāṃ praśaṃsāsāmapūrvakam .
yūyaṃ hi puṇyakarmāṇo draṣṭavyārthe śubhārthinaḥ . .
ratā ye'rkasya pūjāyāṃ yeṣāṃ caiva varapradaḥ . . 87
meaning:
पृष्ट्वा चानामयं तेषां प्रशंसासामपूर्वकम् .
यूयं हि पुण्यकर्माणो द्रष्टव्यार्थे शुभार्थिनः . .
रता येऽर्कस्य पूजायां येषां चैव वरप्रदः . . 87
text_mt: and inquired after their health with praise and gentle words, [he said:] / "You indeed are of meritorious deeds, desiring auspiciousness in what is to be seen, / devoted to the worship of the Sun, and to whom he grants boons.

sanskrit_iast:
tanayaṃ vitta māṃ viṣṇoḥ sāmbaṃ nāmnā ca viśrutam .
candrabhāgātaṭe cāpi mayā sūryo niveśitaḥ . . 88
meaning:
तनयं वित्त मां विष्णोः साम्बं नाम्ना च विश्रुतम् .
चन्द्रभागातटे चापि मया सूर्यो निवेशितः . . 88
text_mt: Know me to be the son of Viṣṇu, renowned by the name Sāmba. / On the bank of the Candrabhāgā, the Sun has been installed by me.

sanskrit_iast:
tenāhaṃ preṣitaścātra uttiṣṭhadhvaṃ vrajāmahe .
te tamūcustataḥ sāmbamevametanna saṃśayaḥ . . 89
meaning:
तेनाहं प्रेषितश्चात्र उत्तिष्ठध्वं व्रजामहे .
ते तमूचुस्ततः साम्बमेवमेतन्न संशयः . . 89
text_mt: I have been sent here by him; arise, let us go." / Then they said to Sāmba: "So it is, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
asmākamapi devena vyākhyātāṃ pūrvameva hi .
aṣṭādaśa kulānīha magānāṃ vedavādinām . .
yāsyanti ye tvayā sārdhaṃ yathā devena bhāṣitam . . 1.139.90
meaning:
अस्माकमपि देवेन व्याख्यातां पूर्वमेव हि .
अष्टादश कुलानीह मगानां वेदवादिनाम् . .
यास्यन्ति ये त्वया सार्धं यथा देवेन भाषितम् . . 1.139.90
text_mt: It was indeed explained to us beforehand by the god: / 'Here eighteen families of the Magas who recite the Veda / shall depart along with you, just as spoken by the god.'"

sanskrit_iast:
tatastāni daśāṣṭau ca kulānīha samantataḥ .
āropya garuḍe sāmbastvaritaḥ punarabhyagāt . . 91
meaning:
ततस्तानि दशाष्टौ च कुलानीह समन्ततः .
आरोप्य गरुडे साम्बस्त्वरितः पुनरभ्यगात् . . 91
text_mt: Then, having placed those eighteen families from all around / onto Garuḍa, Sāmba swiftly returned.

sanskrit_iast:
so'lpenaiva tu kālena prāpto mitravanaṃ tataḥ .
kṛtvājñāṃ tu raveḥ sāmbaḥ kṛtsnaṃ tvevaṃ nyavedayat . . 92
meaning:
सोऽल्पेनैव तु कालेन प्राप्तो मित्रवनं ततः .
कृत्वाज्ञां तु रवेः साम्बः कृत्स्नं त्वेवं न्यवेदयत् . . 92
text_mt: In a very short time he reached Mitravana; / having carried out the command of the Sun, Sāmba reported everything thus.

sanskrit_iast:
raviḥ śobhanamityuktvā prasannaḥ sāmbamabravīt .
mama pūjākarā hyete prajānāṃ śāntikārakāḥ . . 93
meaning:
रविः शोभनमित्युक्त्वा प्रसन्नः साम्बमब्रवीत् .
मम पूजाकरा ह्येते प्रजानां शान्तिकारकाः . . 93
text_mt: Saying "Excellent," the Sun, pleased, said to Sāmba: / "These indeed are the performers of my worship, the bringers of peace to the people.

sanskrit_iast:
mama pūjāṃ kariṣyanti vidhānoktāṃ yadūttama .
tatkṛte na punaścintā tava kācidbhaviṣyati . . 94
meaning:
मम पूजां करिष्यन्ति विधानोक्तां यदूत्तम .
तत्कृते न पुनश्चिन्ता तव काचिद्भविष्यति . . 94
text_mt: They will perform my worship as enjoined by rule, O best of the Yadus. / Because of that, you will have no further anxiety whatsoever."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sāmbopākhyāne bhojakānayanaṃ
nāmaikonacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ . 139 .
bhojakotpattivarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे साम्बोपाख्याने भोजकानयनं
नामैकोनचत्वारिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः . 139 .
भोजकोत्पत्तिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-ninth chapter, entitled "The Bringing of the Bhojakas," in the Story of Sāmba, in the Seventh Kalpa of the Brāhmaparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Origin of the Bhojakas

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
evaṃ sa ānayitvā tu magānsāmbo mahīpate .
sa mahātmā purā sāmbaścandrabhāgāsarittaṭe . . 1
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
एवं स आनयित्वा तु मगान्साम्बो महीपते .
स महात्मा पुरा साम्बश्चन्द्रभागासरित्तटे . . 1
text_mt: Sumantu said: / Thus, having brought the Magas, O lord of the earth, / that high-souled Sāmba in ancient times, on the bank of the Candrabhāgā river,
title: Bhojakotpattivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
puraṃ niveśayāmāsa sthāpayitvā divākaram .
kṛtvā dhanasamṛddhaṃ tu bhojakānāṃ samarpayat . . 2
meaning:
पुरं निवेशयामास स्थापयित्वा दिवाकरम् .
कृत्वा धनसमृद्धं तु भोजकानां समर्पयत् . . 2
text_mt: established a city after installing the Sun; / having made it rich in wealth, he handed it over to the Bhojakas.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpuraṃ savituḥ puṇyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam .
sāṃbena kāritaṃ yasmāttasmātsāmbapuraṃ smṛtam . . 3
meaning:
तत्पुरं सवितुः पुण्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् .
सांबेन कारितं यस्मात्तस्मात्साम्बपुरं स्मृतम् . . 3
text_mt: That holy city of the Sun is renowned in the three worlds; / because it was caused to be built by Sāmba, it is known as Sāmbapura.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminpratiṣṭhito devaḥ puramadhye divākaraḥ .
satkṛtya sthāpitāḥ sarve ātmanāmāṅkite pure . . 4
meaning:
तस्मिन्प्रतिष्ठितो देवः पुरमध्ये दिवाकरः .
सत्कृत्य स्थापिताः सर्वे आत्मनामाङ्किते पुरे . . 4
text_mt: In it, the divine Sun was consecrated in the middle of the city; / all were established with honour in the city marked with his own name.

sanskrit_iast:
magānāṃ tu sadācāro dṛṣṭācārakulocitaḥ .
devaśuśrūṣaṇaṃ gītaṃ vedaproktena karmaṇā . . 5
meaning:
मगानां तु सदाचारो दृष्टाचारकुलोचितः .
देवशुश्रूषणं गीतं वेदप्रोक्तेन कर्मणा . . 5
text_mt: The conduct of the Magas was righteous, suited to their traditional lineage, / and their attendance on the god was sung according to the rites proclaimed in the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtakṛtyastadā sāmbo varaṃ labdhvā punaryuvā .
ādidevaṃ surajyeṣṭhamādityaṃ praṇipatya saḥ . . 6
meaning:
कृतकृत्यस्तदा साम्बो वरं लब्ध्वा पुनर्युवा .
आदिदेवं सुरज्येष्ठमादित्यं प्रणिपत्य सः . . 6
text_mt: Having accomplished his purpose and obtained a boon, Sāmba, youth restored, / bowed down to Āditya, the primordial god, the eldest of the deities.

sanskrit_iast:
anantaraṃ magānsarvānpraṇipatyābhivādya ca .
prasthito nirmalaḥ sāmbaḥ purīṃ dvāravatīṃ tadā . . 7
meaning:
अनन्तरं मगान्सर्वान्प्रणिपत्याभिवाद्य च .
प्रस्थितो निर्मलः साम्बः पुरीं द्वारवतीं तदा . . 7
text_mt: Next, having bowed down and greeted all the Magas, / the stainless Sāmba then departed for the city of Dvāravatī.

sanskrit_iast:
magānāṃ kāraṇārthena prārthitā bhojavaṃśajāḥ .
vasudevasya pautreṇa gotrajena mahātmanā . . 8
meaning:
मगानां कारणार्थेन प्रार्थिता भोजवंशजाः .
वसुदेवस्य पौत्रेण गोत्रजेन महात्मना . . 8
text_mt: For the sake of the Magas, the daughters of the Bhoja lineage were asked for / by the noble grandson of Vasudeva, born in his own clan.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyādānaṃ kṛtaṃ teṣāṃ magānāṃ bhojakottamaiḥ .
sarvāstāḥ sahitāḥ kanyāḥ pravālamaṇibhūṣitāḥ . . 9
meaning:
कन्यादानं कृतं तेषां मगानां भोजकोत्तमैः .
सर्वास्ताः सहिताः कन्याः प्रवालमणिभूषिताः . . 9
text_mt: The giving of the maidens to those Magas was performed by the best of the Bhojakas; / all those maidens were assembled together, adorned with coral gems.

sanskrit_iast:
arcayitvā tu tāḥ sarvāḥ preṣitāḥ saviturgṛham .
punargatvā tu sāṃbena pṛṣṭo devo divākaraḥ . . 1.140.10
meaning:
अर्चयित्वा तु ताः सर्वाः प्रेषिताः सवितुर्गृहम् .
पुनर्गत्वा तु सांबेन पृष्टो देवो दिवाकरः . . 1.140.10
text_mt: Having honoured all of them, they were sent to the house of Savitṛ. / Having gone again, Sāmba questioned the sun-god:

sanskrit_iast:
magānāṃ jñānamākhyāhi1 vedānavyaṅgameva ca .
sāmbasya vacanaṃ śrutvā bhāskaro vākyamabravīt . . 11
meaning:
मगानां ज्ञानमाख्याहि1 वेदानव्यङ्गमेव च .
साम्बस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा भास्करो वाक्यमब्रवीत् . . 11
text_mt: "Declare the knowledge of the Magas, and their Vedas, and the avyaṅga." / Hearing Sāmba's words, the sun-god spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
pṛccha tvaṃ nāradaṃ gatvā sa te sarvaṃ vadiṣyati .
evamukto'tha vai sāmbo gatavānnāradaṃ prati . . 12
meaning:
पृच्छ त्वं नारदं गत्वा स ते सर्वं वदिष्यति .
एवमुक्तोऽथ वै साम्बो गतवान्नारदं प्रति . . 12
text_mt: "Go and ask Nārada; he will tell you everything." / Being spoken to thus, Sāmba went to Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā kṛtsnamidaṃ sarvaṃ tasmai tena niveditam .
sa cāpyāha tataḥ sāmbaṃ na jāne jñānamuttamam . . 13
meaning:
गत्वा कृत्स्नमिदं सर्वं तस्मै तेन निवेदितम् .
स चाप्याह ततः साम्बं न जाने ज्ञानमुत्तमम् . . 13
text_mt: Having gone, he reported all this in full to him. / And he too then said to Sāmba: "I do not know that highest knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
bhojakānāṃ yaduśreṣṭha jñānaṃ vyāso mahāmuniḥ .
taṃ gatvā paripṛccha tvaṃ praṇamya śirasā munim . . 14
meaning:
भोजकानां यदुश्रेष्ठ ज्ञानं व्यासो महामुनिः .
तं गत्वा परिपृच्छ त्वं प्रणम्य शिरसा मुनिम् . . 14
text_mt: The knowledge of the Bhojakas, O best of the Yadus, the great sage Vyāsa [knows]. / Having gone to him, bow your head to the sage and ask.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇānurodhātte sarvaṃ sa vakṣyati na saṃśayaḥ .
nāradenaivamuktastu sāmbo jāmbavatīsutaḥ . . 15
meaning:
कृष्णानुरोधात्ते सर्वं स वक्ष्यति न संशयः .
नारदेनैवमुक्तस्तु साम्बो जाम्बवतीसुतः . . 15
text_mt: Out of regard for Kṛṣṇa, he will tell you everything, without doubt." / Being thus addressed by Nārada, Sāmba, the son of Jāmbavatī,

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsāśramaṃ sa gatvā tu praṇamya śirasā munim .
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt . . 16
meaning:
व्यासाश्रमं स गत्वा तु प्रणम्य शिरसा मुनिम् .
कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा इदं वचनमब्रवीत् . . 16
text_mt: went to Vyāsa's hermitage, bowed his head to the sage, / folded his hands, and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
śākadvīpaṃ mayā gatvā ānītā magapuṅgavāḥ .
bālā yauvanasampannāḥ sanniviṣṭā magottamāḥ . . 17
meaning:
शाकद्वीपं मया गत्वा आनीता मगपुङ्गवाः .
बाला यौवनसम्पन्नाः सन्निविष्टा मगोत्तमाः . . 17
text_mt: "Having gone to Śākadvīpa, the foremost of the Magas were brought by me: / the best Magas, young, endowed with youth, were settled.

sanskrit_iast:
satkṛtya pūjayitvā tu puraṃ teṣāṃ samarpitam .
samprāpya tu puraṃ te vai jyeṣṭhamadhyakanīyasaḥ . . 18
meaning:
सत्कृत्य पूजयित्वा तु पुरं तेषां समर्पितम् .
सम्प्राप्य तु पुरं ते वै ज्येष्ठमध्यकनीयसः . . 18
text_mt: Having respected and honoured them, a city was bestowed upon them. / Having arrived at the city, they—the eldest, middle, and youngest—

sanskrit_iast:
bhojavaṃśasamutpannāḥ kanyakāḥ samalaṅkṛtāḥ .
varayitvā kṛtaṃ teṣāṃ viprapraṇayanaṃ śubham . . 19
meaning:
भोजवंशसमुत्पन्नाः कन्यकाः समलङ्कृताः .
वरयित्वा कृतं तेषां विप्रप्रणयनं शुभम् . . 19
text_mt: chose the adorned maidens born in the Bhoja lineage, / and their auspicious marriage was performed.

sanskrit_iast:
aho sabhāgyāḥ ślāghyāśca kṛtapuṇyāśca te sadā .
pūjāyāṃ ye ratā bhānoryeṣāṃ caiva varapradaḥ . . 1.140.20
meaning:
अहो सभाग्याः श्लाघ्याश्च कृतपुण्याश्च ते सदा .
पूजायां ये रता भानोर्येषां चैव वरप्रदः . . 1.140.20
text_mt: "Ah, fortunate, praiseworthy, and ever full of merit are they / who are devoted to the worship of the Sun and to whom he grants boons.

sanskrit_iast:
paryāptaṃ sarvameteṣāmiha cāmuṣmikaṃ phalam .
anitye sati mānuṣye devapūjāratā hi ye . . 21
meaning:
पर्याप्तं सर्वमेतेषामिह चामुष्मिकं फलम् .
अनित्ये सति मानुष्ये देवपूजारता हि ये . . 21
text_mt: Sufficient for them is every fruit in this world and the next, / for they are devoted to the worship of god while human life is impermanent.

sanskrit_iast:
kintu cintayataḥ sūryaṃ cintayitvā tu bhojakān .
jñānaṃ prati tathā caiṣāṃ hadaye saṃśayo mama . . 22
meaning:
किन्तु चिन्तयतः सूर्यं चिन्तयित्वा तु भोजकान् .
ज्ञानं प्रति तथा चैषां हदये संशयो मम . . 22
text_mt: Yet as I contemplate the Sun, and having thought about the Bhojakas, / doubt remains in my heart regarding their knowledge:

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ pūjākarā hyete ke magāḥ ke ca bhojakāḥ .
jñānaṃ kiṃ paramaṃ teṣāṃ jñeyasteṣāṃ ka eva tu . . 23
meaning:
कथं पूजाकरा ह्येते के मगाः के च भोजकाः .
ज्ञानं किं परमं तेषां ज्ञेयस्तेषां क एव तु . . 23
text_mt: How are they worshippers? Who are the Magas and who are the Bhojakas? / What is their supreme knowledge, and what alone is to be known by them?

sanskrit_iast:
divyeti te kathaṃ proktāḥ kimarthaṃ kūrcadhāraṇam .
sauravrataṃ kimarthaṃ tu vācakāste kathaṃ smṛtāḥ . . 24
meaning:
दिव्येति ते कथं प्रोक्ताः किमर्थं कूर्चधारणम् .
सौरव्रतं किमर्थं तु वाचकास्ते कथं स्मृताः . . 24
text_mt: How are they called divine? For what reason do they wear the kūrca? / For what reason is the solar observance, and how are they considered reciters?

sanskrit_iast:
kimarthaṃ tejasā vedāngāyantaścaiva te katham .
athāhikañcukasyāṅgaṃ kiṃ pramāṇaṃ ca kasya vai . . 25
meaning:
किमर्थं तेजसा वेदान्गायन्तश्चैव ते कथम् .
अथाहिकञ्चुकस्याङ्गं किं प्रमाणं च कस्य वै . . 25
text_mt: Why do they [recite] the Vedas with splendour, and how do they sing? / Now, what is the limb and the measure of the serpent-girdle, and to whom belongs what?

sanskrit_iast:
kasya vai kā samākhyātā yadutpannaṃ kathaṃ smṛtam .
kathaṃ devāṃśca gāyanti yajñaṃ kurvanti te katham . . 26
meaning:
कस्य वै का समाख्याता यदुत्पन्नं कथं स्मृतम् .
कथं देवांश्च गायन्ति यज्ञं कुर्वन्ति ते कथम् . . 26
text_mt: What designation is given to whom, and how is what is born remembered? / How do they sing to the gods, and how do they perform sacrifice?

sanskrit_iast:
agnihotraṃ ca kiṃ teṣāṃ pañca dolāśca kāḥ smṛtāḥ .
etatsarvaṃ samākhyāhi bhojakānāṃ viceṣṭitam . . 27
meaning:
अग्निहोत्रं च किं तेषां पञ्च दोलाश्च काः स्मृताः .
एतत्सर्वं समाख्याहि भोजकानां विचेष्टितम् . . 27
text_mt: And what is their agnihotra, and what are the five swings known to be? / Explain all this conduct of the Bhojakas to me."

sanskrit_iast:
sāmbasya vacanaṃ śrutvā kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ .
kālīsuto mahātejā uvāca paramaṃ vacaḥ . . 28
meaning:
साम्बस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनिः .
कालीसुतो महातेजा उवाच परमं वचः . . 28
text_mt: Hearing Sāmba's words, the sage Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana, / the highly splendid son of Kālī, spoke supreme words:

sanskrit_iast:
sādhusādhu yaduśreṣṭha sādhu pṛṣṭo'smi suvrata .
durjñeyaceṣṭitaṃ kiñcidbhojakānāṃ na saṃśayaḥ . . 29
meaning:
साधुसाधु यदुश्रेष्ठ साधु पृष्टोऽस्मि सुव्रत .
दुर्ज्ञेयचेष्टितं किञ्चिद्भोजकानां न संशयः . . 29
text_mt: "Well done, well done, O best of the Yadus! You have asked well, O observer of vows! / Difficult to know is anything of the practice of the Bhojakas, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāskarasya prasādena mamāpi smṛtimāgatam .
yathākhyātaṃ vaśiṣṭhena tathā te vacmi kṛtsnaśaḥ . . 1.140.30
meaning:
भास्करस्य प्रसादेन ममापि स्मृतिमागतम् .
यथाख्यातं वशिष्ठेन तथा ते वच्मि कृत्स्नशः . . 1.140.30
text_mt: By the grace of the sun-god, it has also come into my memory. / Just as was declared by Vasiṣṭha, so I shall tell you in full.

sanskrit_iast:
magānāṃ caritaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ kṛṣṇanandana .
jñānavedina evaite karmayogaṃ samāśritāḥ . . 31
meaning:
मगानां चरितं श्रेष्ठं शृणु त्वं कृष्णनन्दन .
ज्ञानवेदिन एवैते कर्मयोगं समाश्रिताः . . 31
text_mt: Hear the excellent conduct of the Magas, O son of Kṛṣṇa! / They alone know knowledge and are established in karmayoga.

sanskrit_iast:
śrūyante ṛṣayaḥ sarve maunena niyamasthitāḥ .
bhuñjate cāpi maunena sarve vai paramarṣayaḥ . . 32
meaning:
श्रूयन्ते ऋषयः सर्वे मौनेन नियमस्थिताः .
भुञ्जते चापि मौनेन सर्वे वै परमर्षयः . . 32
text_mt: All the ṛṣis are heard to be established in restraint through silence; / all the supreme ṛṣis also eat in silence.

sanskrit_iast:
municaryākṛtaste'pi śākadvīpanivāsinaḥ .
tasmānmaunena bhoktavyamaguṇatvamanicchatā . . 33
meaning:
मुनिचर्याकृतस्तेऽपि शाकद्वीपनिवासिनः .
तस्मान्मौनेन भोक्तव्यमगुणत्वमनिच्छता . . 33
text_mt: Those dwellers in Śākadvīpa also adopted the conduct of sages; / therefore one wishing to avoid demerit must eat in silence.

sanskrit_iast:
vacaḥ sūryasamākhyātaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca varaṃ tathā .
arcāyāṃ te ca te nityamarcayantaśca te smṛtāḥ . . 34
meaning:
वचः सूर्यसमाख्यातं कारणं च वरं तथा .
अर्चायां ते च ते नित्यमर्चयन्तश्च ते स्मृताः . . 34
text_mt: The word declared by the Sun is the cause and the supreme boon; / they are engaged in worship, and they are recorded as constantly worshipping.

sanskrit_iast:
bhojakanyāsujātatvādbhojakāstena te smṛtāḥ .
brāhmaṇānāṃ yathā prokto vedāścatvāra eva tu . . 35
meaning:
भोजकन्यासुजातत्वाद्भोजकास्तेन ते स्मृताः .
ब्राह्मणानां यथा प्रोक्तो वेदाश्चत्वार एव तु . . 35
text_mt: Because they were born from the daughters of the Bhojas, they are therefore known as Bhojakas. / Just as four Vedas are proclaimed for Brāhmaṇas—

sanskrit_iast:
ṛgvedo'tha yajurvedaḥ sāmavedastvatharvaṇaḥ .
brahmaṇoktāstathā vedā magānāmapi suvrata . . 36
meaning:
ऋग्वेदोऽथ यजुर्वेदः सामवेदस्त्वथर्वणः .
ब्रह्मणोक्तास्तथा वेदा मगानामपि सुव्रत . . 36
text_mt: the Ṛgveda, the Yajurveda, the Sāmaveda, and the Ātharvaṇa— / so also the Vedas were spoken by Brahmā for the Magas, O observer of vows.

sanskrit_iast:
ta eva viparītāstu teṣāṃ vedāḥ prakīrtitāḥ .
vedo viśvamadaścaiva vidvadvahnirasastathā . . 37
meaning:
त एव विपरीतास्तु तेषां वेदाः प्रकीर्तिताः .
वेदो विश्वमदश्चैव विद्वद्वह्निरसस्तथा . . 37
text_mt: Those very Vedas of theirs are celebrated in inverse order: / the Veda, the Viśvamada, the Vidvat, and the Vahnirasa.

sanskrit_iast:
vedā hyete magānāṃ tu purovāca prajāpatiḥ .
magā vedamadhīyante vedāṅgāstena te smṛtāḥ . . 38
meaning:
वेदा ह्येते मगानां तु पुरोवाच प्रजापतिः .
मगा वेदमधीयन्ते वेदाङ्गास्तेन ते स्मृताः . . 38
text_mt: Prajāpati formerly spoke these Vedas for the Magas. / The Magas study the Veda; therefore they are remembered as limbs of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣo na hi mahābhāgaḥ sarvasattvasukhāvahaḥ .
sasūryarathamāsādya rathibhiḥ saha varṣati . . 39
meaning:
शेषो न हि महाभागः सर्वसत्त्वसुखावहः .
ससूर्यरथमासाद्य रथिभिः सह वर्षति . . 39
text_mt: For Śeṣa is indeed highly fortunate, bringing happiness to all beings; / having reached the chariot of the Sun, he rains down along with the charioteers.

sanskrit_iast:
yastasya tu punarmokaṃ sa raverhi mahānakaḥ .
vanditavyo magānāṃ tu astramantreṇa nityaśaḥ . .1.140.4 0
yathā srajo dvijānāṃ tu pūjākāle pramīyate .
sarvasaṃskārayajñeṣu yathā darbhā dvijātiṣu . .4 1
pavitrāḥ kīrtitāsteṣāṃ tathā dharmo magasya tu .
ebhirjayanti bhūyiṣṭhaṃ tasmindvīpe magādhipāḥ . .42
meaning:
यस्तस्य तु पुनर्मोकं स रवेर्हि महानकः .
वन्दितव्यो मगानां तु अस्त्रमन्त्रेण नित्यशः . .1.140.4 0
यथा स्रजो द्विजानां तु पूजाकाले प्रमीयते .
सर्वसंस्कारयज्ञेषु यथा दर्भा द्विजातिषु . .4 1
पवित्राः कीर्तितास्तेषां तथा धर्मो मगस्य तु .
एभिर्जयन्ति भूयिष्ठं तस्मिन्द्वीपे मगाधिपाः . .42
text_mt: The slough of that [serpent] is the great girdle of the Sun; / it is to be saluted by the Magas always with the weapon-mantra. / Just as garlands are ordained for the twice-born at the time of worship, / and just as darbha-grasses [are ordained] for the twice-born in all rites of passage and sacrifices, / they are proclaimed pure, and such is the duty of the Maga. / By these the rulers of the Magas prevail mostly on that continent.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyāvantaḥ kulaśreṣṭhāḥ śaucācārasamanvitāḥ .
yajñāvasaktā1 bhaktāśca japanto mantramāditaḥ . .4 3
priyāstu yaduśārdūla bhojakā yadunandana .
astramiva vai mantro vedasya paripaṭhyate . .44
meaning:
विद्यावन्तः कुलश्रेष्ठाः शौचाचारसमन्विताः .
यज्ञावसक्ता1 भक्ताश्च जपन्तो मन्त्रमादितः . .4 3
प्रियास्तु यदुशार्दूल भोजका यदुनन्दन .
अस्त्रमिव वै मन्त्रो वेदस्य परिपठ्यते . .44
text_mt: Learned, highest of lineage, endowed with purity and right conduct, / attached to sacrifice and devoted, muttering the mantra from the beginning, / dear [to the Sun], O tiger among the Yadus, are the Bhojakas, O descendant of Yadu! / The mantra is recited just like the weapon of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu sāvitrī parikalpyate .
asmākaṃ tu yaduśreṣṭha mahāvyāhṛtipūrtikā . .45
meaning:
सर्वेषां ब्राह्मणानां तु सावित्री परिकल्प्यते .
अस्माकं तु यदुश्रेष्ठ महाव्याहृतिपूर्तिका . .45
text_mt: For all Brāhmaṇas, the Sāvitrī is prescribed; / but for us, O best of the Yadus, it is that which completes the great vyāhṛtis.

sanskrit_iast:
amohakenātha vimānabhuñjī maunena caivāpi yathā hi yuktam .
na cāpi kiñcitsmṛtikaṃ spṛśecca taccāpi nātraiva ca saṃspṛśeddhi . . 47
meaning:
अमोहकेनाथ विमानभुञ्जी मौनेन चैवापि यथा हि युक्तम् .
न चापि किञ्चित्स्मृतिकं स्पृशेच्च तच्चापि नात्रैव च संस्पृशेद्धि . . 47
text_mt: Then, free from delusion, one should eat in silence, properly restrained, on a clean seat; / and one must not touch anything polluted, nor should anything touch it here.

sanskrit_iast:
śvasantyanicchaṃstu parikṣipettu svābhīṣṭasūryaṃ tu nametsadaiva .
yathā yajñaṃ hi mantreṇa vedaproktena karmaṇā . .47
meaning:
श्वसन्त्यनिच्छंस्तु परिक्षिपेत्तु स्वाभीष्टसूर्यं तु नमेत्सदैव .
यथा यज्ञं हि मन्त्रेण वेदप्रोक्तेन कर्मणा . .47
text_mt: If one inhales unintentionally, one should cast [the food] away; one should ever bow to one's cherished Sun. / Just as a sacrifice is performed with a mantra by an action taught in the Veda,

sanskrit_iast:
tattvamanyanmagānāntu vidhimantrapuraskṛtam .
haviḥ sampadyate yasmāttena te yajvinaḥ smṛtāḥ . .48
meaning:
तत्त्वमन्यन्मगानान्तु विधिमन्त्रपुरस्कृतम् .
हविः सम्पद्यते यस्मात्तेन ते यज्विनः स्मृताः . .48
text_mt: so is the other truth of the Magas, preceded by rules and mantras. / Since the oblation is accomplished [by them], they are therefore considered sacrificers.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāgnihotraṃ prathitaṃ dvijānāṃ tathādhvahotraṃ vihitaṃ magānām .
acchaṃ ca nāmeti tadadhvarasya munervaco nātra vicāraṇāsti . .49
meaning:
यथाग्निहोत्रं प्रथितं द्विजानां तथाध्वहोत्रं विहितं मगानाम् .
अच्छं च नामेति तदध्वरस्य मुनेर्वचो नात्र विचारणास्ति . .49
text_mt: Just as the agnihotra is renowned for the twice-born, so the adhvahotra is ordained for the Magas; / and the name of that sacrifice is Accha—such is the sage's statement, there is no deliberation here.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcadhūpāḥ pradātavyāḥ siddhirasyeha sarvadā .
daṇḍanāyakavele dve trisandhyaṃ bhāskarasya tu . . 1.140.50
bhojakajātivarṇanam
meaning:
पञ्चधूपाः प्रदातव्याः सिद्धिरस्येह सर्वदा .
दण्डनायकवेले द्वे त्रिसन्ध्यं भास्करस्य तु . . 1.140.50
भोजकजातिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Five incenses should be offered; success is his here at all times. / There are two times for the leader of the army at the three junctures of the day for the Sun.
Description of the Bhojaka Caste

sanskrit_iast:
sāmba uvāca
bhojakānāṃ yattvayoktamavyaṅgo dehaśodhakaḥ .
vratabandhastvasau proktasteṣāṃ jātiśca kā smṛtā . . 1
meaning:
साम्ब उवाच
भोजकानां यत्त्वयोक्तमव्यङ्गो देहशोधकः .
व्रतबन्धस्त्वसौ प्रोक्तस्तेषां जातिश्च का स्मृता . . 1
text_mt:
Sāmba said:
What was spoken by you regarding the avyaṅga, which purifies the body of the Bhojakas—
that is called the binding of the vow; and what is recorded as their caste?
title: Bhojakajātivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
te pṛṣṭā bhavatā sarve bhojakānāṃ kumārakāḥ .
kimākhyātaṃ tatastaistu tadevācakṣva kṛtsnaśaḥ . . 2
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
ते पृष्टा भवता सर्वे भोजकानां कुमारकाः .
किमाख्यातं ततस्तैस्तु तदेवाचक्ष्व कृत्स्नशः . . 2

sanskrit_iast:
sāmba uvāca
sanniveṣā mayā proktā bhojakānāṃ samantataḥ .
mamaiva brūta tattvaṃ tadvarṇaḥ ko'tra kathaṃ sthitaḥ . . 3
meaning:
साम्ब उवाच
सन्निवेषा मया प्रोक्ता भोजकानां समन्ततः .
ममैव ब्रूत तत्त्वं तद्वर्णः कोऽत्र कथं स्थितः . . 3
text_mt:
Sāmba said:
The settlements of the Bhojakas were spoken of all around by me:
"Tell me the truth of it: what caste is here, and how is it established?"

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu bhagavānprāha vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ .
ye tvayoktā śrutāḥ sāmba bhojakānāṃ kumārakāḥ . . 4
meaning:
ततस्तु भगवान्प्राह वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः .
ये त्वयोक्ता श्रुताः साम्ब भोजकानां कुमारकाः . . 4
text_mt:
Then the blessed one, skilled in speech, spoke these words:
Those who were mentioned by you, O Sāmba, the boys of the Bhojakas, have been heard of.

sanskrit_iast:
mamaivaite magā jñeyā aṣṭau śūdrā madaṅgajāḥ .
etadbuddhvā tu vacanaṃ praṇamya śirasā ravim . . 5
meaning:
ममैवैते मगा ज्ञेया अष्टौ शूद्रा मदङ्गजाः .
एतद्बुद्ध्वा तु वचनं प्रणम्य शिरसा रविम् . . 5
text_mt:
These should be known as my own Magas; the eight Śūdras were born from my body.
Having understood these words, bowing with his head to the Sun,

sanskrit_iast:
dattā bhojakulotpannā daśabhyo daśakanyakāḥ .
tatastu mandakebhyo'pi dattāścāṣṭau hi kanyakāḥ . . 6
meaning:
दत्ता भोजकुलोत्पन्ना दशभ्यो दशकन्यकाः .
ततस्तु मन्दकेभ्योऽपि दत्ताश्चाष्टौ हि कन्यकाः . . 6
text_mt:
ten maidens born of the Bhoja lineage were given to the ten,
and then eight maidens were indeed given to the Mandakas.

sanskrit_iast:
tato niveśitaṃ teṣāṃ mayā sāmba puraṃ smara .
dāsakanyāstu yāścāṣṭau bhojakanyāśca yā daśa . . 7
meaning:
ततो निवेशितं तेषां मया साम्ब पुरं स्मर .
दासकन्यास्तु याश्चाष्टौ भोजकन्याश्च या दश . . 7
text_mt:
Then a city was established for them by me, O Sāmba, remember.
The maidens who were the eight slave girls, and those who were the ten Bhoja maidens—

sanskrit_iast:
etāsteṣāṃ kumārāṇāṃ jñeyāstā daśa cāṣṭa ca .
tatra te bhojakanyāsu dvijairutpāditāḥ sutāḥ . . 8
meaning:
एतास्तेषां कुमाराणां ज्ञेयास्ता दश चाष्ट च .
तत्र ते भोजकन्यासु द्विजैरुत्पादिताः सुताः . . 8
text_mt:
these should be known as belonging to those boys, eighteen in all.
There, the sons begotten upon the Bhoja maidens by the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
bhojakāstāngaṇānprāhurbrāhmaṇāndivyasaṃjñitān .
dāsakanyāsu ye jātā mandagairantyasaṃjñitaiḥ . . 9
meaning:
भोजकास्तान्गणान्प्राहुर्ब्राह्मणान्दिव्यसंज्ञितान् .
दासकन्यासु ये जाता मन्दगैरन्त्यसंज्ञितैः . . 9
text_mt:
the Bhojakas spoke of as their groups, as Brāhmaṇas designated divine;
those born of the slave maidens through the Mandagas, designated low-born,

sanskrit_iast:
madaṅgā nāma te jñeyāḥ savituḥ paricārakāḥ .
te ca viprapure tasminputradāraśubhairvṛtāḥ . . 1.141.10
meaning:
मदङ्गा नाम ते ज्ञेयाः सवितुः परिचारकाः .
ते च विप्रपुरे तस्मिन्पुत्रदारशुभैर्वृताः . . 1.141.10
text_mt:
they are known by the name Madaṅgas, attendants of the Sun.
And they, in that city of Brāhmaṇas, surrounded by fine sons and wives,

sanskrit_iast:
svadharmairyaṣṭumārabdhaiḥ śākadvīpe'rcito raviḥ .
nānāvidhairvaidikaistu mantrairmunivarottamāḥ . . 11
meaning:
स्वधर्मैर्यष्टुमारब्धैः शाकद्वीपेऽर्चितो रविः .
नानाविधैर्वैदिकैस्तु मन्त्रैर्मुनिवरोत्तमाः . . 11
text_mt:
having begun to sacrifice according to their own duties, worshipped the Sun in Śākadvīpa
with diverse Vedic mantras, O best of excellent sages.

sanskrit_iast:
avyaṅgadhāriṇo martyāḥ pūjayante divaspatim .
dṛṣṭvā vyaṅgaṃ tu vai teṣāṃ kautūhalasamanvitaḥ . . 12
meaning:
अव्यङ्गधारिणो मर्त्याः पूजयन्ते दिवस्पतिम् .
दृष्ट्वा व्यङ्गं तु वै तेषां कौतूहलसमन्वितः . . 12
text_mt:
The mortals wearing the avyaṅga worship the lord of day.
Having seen their vyaṅga, filled with curiosity,

sanskrit_iast:
sāmbaḥ prāha namaskṛtya bhūyaḥ satyavatīsutam .
kathaṃ varo'yamavyaṅgaḥ kathito munisattama . . 13
meaning:
साम्बः प्राह नमस्कृत्य भूयः सत्यवतीसुतम् .
कथं वरोऽयमव्यङ्गः कथितो मुनिसत्तम . . 13
text_mt:
Sāmba, having bowed again to the son of Satyavatī, said:
How is this excellent avyaṅga spoken of, O best of sages?

sanskrit_iast:
kuta eṣa samutpannaḥ kasmācca sa śuciḥ smṛtaḥ .
bandhanīyaḥ kadā cāyaṃ kimarthaṃ caiva dhāryate . .
kiṃ pramāṇaṃ ca bhagavanvyaṅgaścāyaṃ kimucyate . . 14
meaning:
कुत एष समुत्पन्नः कस्माच्च स शुचिः स्मृतः .
बन्धनीयः कदा चायं किमर्थं चैव धार्यते . .
किं प्रमाणं च भगवन्व्यङ्गश्चायं किमुच्यते . . 14
text_mt:
From where did it arise, and why is it considered pure?
When is it to be tied, and for what purpose is it worn?
And what is its measure, O blessed one, and why is it called vyaṅga?

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ vyāso jāmbavatyāḥ sutasya ca . . 15
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
श्रुत्वैवं वचनं व्यासो जाम्बवत्याः सुतस्य च . . 15
text_mt:
Sumantu said:
Hearing such words of the son of Jāmbavatī, Vyāsa,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca kuruśārdūla sāmbaṃ kālīsutaḥ sa tu . .
vyāsa uvāca
etacca me yathoktastvaṃ jātireṣāṃ na saṃśayaḥ . . 16
meaning:
उवाच कुरुशार्दूल साम्बं कालीसुतः स तु . .
व्यास उवाच
एतच्च मे यथोक्तस्त्वं जातिरेषां न संशयः . . 16
text_mt:
the son of Kālī, spoke to Sāmba, O tiger of the Kurus.
Vyāsa said:
And this caste of theirs is as told to you by me, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
avyaṅgasyāpi te vacmi lakṣaṇaṃ gadataḥ śṛṇu . . 17
vyaḍgotpattināmavarṇanam
meaning:
अव्यङ्गस्यापि ते वच्मि लक्षणं गदतः शृणु . . 17
व्यड्गोत्पत्तिनामवर्णनम्
text_mt:
I shall tell you also the characteristics of the avyaṅga as I speak; listen.
Description of the origin and name of the vyaṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
devatā ṛṣayo nāgā gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ .
yakṣarakṣāṃsi vai bhānau nivasanti ṛtukramāt . . 1
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
देवता ऋषयो नागा गन्धर्वाप्सरसां गणाः .
यक्षरक्षांसि वै भानौ निवसन्ति ऋतुक्रमात् . . 1
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Deities, sages, serpents, hosts of gandharvas and apsarases,
yakṣas, and rākṣasas dwell in the sun in the sequence of the seasons.
title: adhyāyaḥ 142

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tu vāsukirhyabdamudyatsūryarathaṃ javāt .
svasthānamājagāmāśu namaskṛtya divākaram . . 2
meaning:
तत्र तु वासुकिर्ह्यब्दमुद्यत्सूर्यरथं जवात् .
स्वस्थानमाजगामाशु नमस्कृत्य दिवाकरम् . . 2
text_mt:
There, indeed, Vāsuki, [riding] for a year with speed upon the rising sun's chariot,
quickly went to his own abode after bowing to the day-maker.

sanskrit_iast:
avyaṅgameva sūryāya prītyarthaṃ vai samarpayat .
gāṅgeyabhūṣitaṃ divyaṃ nātiraktasitaṃ śubham . . 3
meaning:
अव्यङ्गमेव सूर्याय प्रीत्यर्थं वै समर्पयत् .
गाङ्गेयभूषितं दिव्यं नातिरक्तसितं शुभम् . . 3
text_mt:
He offered the avyaṅga itself to the Sun for the sake of his affection,
auspicious, adorned with gold, divine, neither overly red nor white.

sanskrit_iast:
babandha taṃ ca tatprītyai madhyabhāge tamātmanaḥ .
nāgarājāṅgasambhūto dhṛto yasmācca bhānunā . . 4
meaning:
बबन्ध तं च तत्प्रीत्यै मध्यभागे तमात्मनः .
नागराजाङ्गसम्भूतो धृतो यस्माच्च भानुना . . 4
text_mt:
And he tied it around his middle portion for the sake of affection for him.
Because it arose from the body of the king of serpents, and was worn by the Sun,

sanskrit_iast:
tattasmāddhāryate sūryaprītyai tadbhaktimicchatā .
vidhānena ca tattvena śucirbhavati bhojakaḥ . . 5
meaning:
तत्तस्माद्धार्यते सूर्यप्रीत्यै तद्भक्तिमिच्छता .
विधानेन च तत्त्वेन शुचिर्भवति भोजकः . . 5
text_mt:
therefore it is worn for the Sun's pleasure by one desiring devotion to him;
and by proper injunction and in truth, the Bhojaka becomes pure.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ ca dhāraṇāttasya bhavetprīto divākaraḥ .
na dhārayanti ye tvevaṃ bhojakāḥ pūjakāḥ raveḥ . . 6
meaning:
नित्यं च धारणात्तस्य भवेत्प्रीतो दिवाकरः .
न धारयन्ति ये त्वेवं भोजकाः पूजकाः रवेः . . 6
text_mt:
And from wearing it daily, the day-maker will be pleased.
Those Bhojakas, worshippers of the Sun, who do not wear it in this manner,

sanskrit_iast:
saurahīnā na te yājyā ucchiṣṭā nātra saṃśayaḥ .
smṛtyācāre te hi bhagnā raviṃ nārhanti pūjitum . . 7
meaning:
सौरहीना न ते याज्या उच्छिष्टा नात्र संशयः .
स्मृत्याचारे ते हि भग्ना रविं नार्हन्ति पूजितुम् . . 7
text_mt:
bereft of Saura rites, are not to be sacrificed for; they are impure, of this there is no doubt.
For they are fallen from the traditional code of conduct; they do not deserve to worship the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayanto raviṃ te hi narakaṃ yānti rauravam .
na vai hasenna uttiṣṭhedyāvadarcā labhanti te . . 8
meaning:
पूजयन्तो रविं ते हि नरकं यान्ति रौरवम् .
न वै हसेन्न उत्तिष्ठेद्यावदर्चा लभन्ति ते . . 8
text_mt:
Worshipping the Sun, they go to the Raurava hell.
One should not laugh nor stand up as long as they perform the worship.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ jñātvā na sandeho hyavyaṅgena vinā raviḥ .
nāgarājasya saṃspṛṣṭo hyārasustena saṃsmṛtaḥ . . 9
meaning:
इत्थं ज्ञात्वा न सन्देहो ह्यव्यङ्गेन विना रविः .
नागराजस्य संस्पृष्टो ह्यारसुस्तेन संस्मृतः . . 9
text_mt:
Knowing thus, there is no doubt that the Sun is without the avyaṅga [to them];
for it touched the king of serpents, and is remembered by that [reason] as ārasu.

sanskrit_iast:
ekavarṇaḥ sa kartavyaḥ kāryasiddhikarastathā .
pramāṇenāṅgulānāṃ tu śatāddhi śatamuttaram . . 1.142.10
meaning:
एकवर्णः स कर्तव्यः कार्यसिद्धिकरस्तथा .
प्रमाणेनाङ्गुलानां तु शताद्धि शतमुत्तरम् . . 1.142.10
text_mt:
It should be made of a single color, conferring success in one's undertakings.
In measure of angulas, it is one hundred over a hundred;

sanskrit_iast:
utkṛṣṭo'yaṃ pramāṇena madhyamo viṃśaduttaraḥ .
śatamaṣṭottaraṃ hrasvo na tu hrasvatarastataḥ . . 11
meaning:
उत्कृष्टोऽयं प्रमाणेन मध्यमो विंशदुत्तरः .
शतमष्टोत्तरं ह्रस्वो न तु ह्रस्वतरस्ततः . . 11
text_mt:
this is superior in measure; the middling is twenty above [a hundred];
the short is eight above a hundred; but it should not be shorter than that.

sanskrit_iast:
tadākṛtiḥ kṛtaścaiṣa nirmito viśvakarmaṇā .
madhyame bhojakānāṃ tu paraḥ śata udāhṛtaḥ . . 12
meaning:
तदाकृतिः कृतश्चैष निर्मितो विश्वकर्मणा .
मध्यमे भोजकानां तु परः शत उदाहृतः . . 12
text_mt:
And it was made into that form, fashioned by Viśvakarman.
Among the middling of the Bhojakas, one exceeding a hundred is mentioned.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃskṛto'pi vinā tena śucirnaiva bhavatyuta .
tenāsya dhāraṇādvīra śucireva tadā bhavet . . 13
meaning:
संस्कृतोऽपि विना तेन शुचिर्नैव भवत्युत .
तेनास्य धारणाद्वीर शुचिरेव तदा भवेत् . . 13
text_mt:
Even if consecrated, without it one does not become pure at all.
Therefore, by wearing it, O hero, one then becomes truly pure.

sanskrit_iast:
havirhomādikāḥ sarvā bhavantyasya kriyāḥ śubhāḥ .
avyaṅgaḥ patitāṅgaśca avyaṅgo'tha mahīpate . . 14
meaning:
हविर्होमादिकाः सर्वा भवन्त्यस्य क्रियाः शुभाः .
अव्यङ्गः पतिताङ्गश्च अव्यङ्गोऽथ महीपते . . 14
text_mt:
All his auspicious rites, beginning with oblation and fire-sacrifice, become fruitful.
It is avyaṅga, and also patitāṅga; it is avyaṅga, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa sāraśca sā ramyā vai jñeyā jayanāmabhiḥ .
aheraṅgātsamutpanno hyavyaṅgastu tataḥ smṛtaḥ . . 15
meaning:
एष सारश्च सा रम्या वै ज्ञेया जयनामभिः .
अहेरङ्गात्समुत्पन्नो ह्यव्यङ्गस्तु ततः स्मृतः . . 15
text_mt:
This is the essence, and it is delightful, to be known by victorious names.
Because it arose from the body of the snake (aheh aṅgāt), it is therefore remembered as avyaṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmādasmādaheraṅgamavyaṅgastena cocyate .
arheti pūjāyāṃ dhātoḥ pratyayo ṇvultataḥ smṛtaḥ . . 16
meaning:
यस्मादस्मादहेरङ्गमव्यङ्गस्तेन चोच्यते .
अर्हेति पूजायां धातोः प्रत्ययो ण्वुल्ततः स्मृतः . . 16
text_mt:
Because of this—from the body of the snake—it is therefore called avyaṅga.
From the verbal root arh in the sense of worship, the affix ṇvul is remembered from that;

sanskrit_iast:
pūjitaśca pavitraśca yasmāttenārhakaḥ smṛtaḥ .
sārasārtaḥ smṛtaṃ rūpaṃ pradhānaṃ sāra ucyate . . 17
meaning:
पूजितश्च पवित्रश्च यस्मात्तेनार्हकः स्मृतः .
सारसार्तः स्मृतं रूपं प्रधानं सार उच्यते . . 17
text_mt:
and because it is worshipped and purifying, therefore it is called arhaka.
Its form is remembered as saturated with essence; the principal is called sāra.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṇa bhaktau smṛtau dhātustasmātsārasanaḥ smṛtaḥ .
yasmādarcitamevaṃ tu suvarṇamaṇimauktikaiḥ . . 18
meaning:
षण भक्तौ स्मृतौ धातुस्तस्मात्सारसनः स्मृतः .
यस्मादर्चितमेवं तु सुवर्णमणिमौक्तिकैः . . 18
text_mt:
The verbal root ṣaṇa is remembered in the sense of devotion; therefore it is remembered as sārasana.
Because it is worshipped in this manner with gold, gems, and pearls,

sanskrit_iast:
sa jñeyaḥ patitāṅgastu nityayajñairupāhṛtaḥ .
ityete kathitā vīra avyaṅgā vyaṅgabhojakāḥ . . 19
meaning:
स ज्ञेयः पतिताङ्गस्तु नित्ययज्ञैरुपाहृतः .
इत्येते कथिता वीर अव्यङ्गा व्यङ्गभोजकाः . . 19
text_mt:
it should be known as patitāṅga, offered through daily sacrifices.
Thus these avyaṅgas have been described to you, O hero, as the Bhojakas of the vyaṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛddhivṛddhikaro nityaṃ kāyaśuddhikarastathā .
sarvavedamayaścāyaṃ sarvadevamayastathā . . 1.142.20
meaning:
ऋद्धिवृद्धिकरो नित्यं कायशुद्धिकरस्तथा .
सर्ववेदमयश्चायं सर्वदेवमयस्तथा . . 1.142.20
text_mt:
It constantly grants prosperity and increase, and it purifies the body.
And it consists of all the Vedas, and it consists of all the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhūtamayaḥ sāmba sarvalokamayastathā .
madhye'sya saṃsthito brahmā mūle viṣṇurmahāmate . . 21
meaning:
सर्वभूतमयः साम्ब सर्वलोकमयस्तथा .
मध्येऽस्य संस्थितो ब्रह्मा मूले विष्णुर्महामते . . 21
text_mt:
it consists of all beings, O Sāmba, and it consists of all the worlds.
In its middle stands Brahmā; at its base is Viṣṇu, O wise one;

sanskrit_iast:
śaśāṅkamaulirantye tu saṃsthito yadunaṃdana .
ṛgvedo'sya sthito mūle yajurvedo'sya madhyagaḥ . . 22
meaning:
शशाङ्कमौलिरन्त्ये तु संस्थितो यदुनंदन .
ऋग्वेदोऽस्य स्थितो मूले यजुर्वेदोऽस्य मध्यगः . . 22
text_mt:
and Śiva, who bears the moon on his crest, stands at the end, O joy of the Yadus.
The Ṛgveda is situated at its base; the Yajurveda is in its middle;

sanskrit_iast:
agre sthitaḥ sāmavedo granthirāṅgirasonagha .
pṛthvī mūlamāśritya sthitā ca yadusattama . . 23
meaning:
अग्रे स्थितः सामवेदो ग्रन्थिराङ्गिरसोनघ .
पृथ्वी मूलमाश्रित्य स्थिता च यदुसत्तम . . 23
text_mt:
at its tip stands the Sāmaveda; its knot is Āṅgirasa, O sinless one.
The earth stands resting upon its base, O best of the Yadus;

sanskrit_iast:
mūlāśanāstvapaḥ sāmba madhye devo vibhāvasuḥ .
tāsāmanantaraṃ vāta ākāśo'gre samāsthitaḥ . . 24
meaning:
मूलाशनास्त्वपः साम्ब मध्ये देवो विभावसुः .
तासामनन्तरं वात आकाशोऽग्रे समास्थितः . . 24
text_mt:
the waters eat from its base, O Sāmba; in the middle is god Fire;
immediately after them is wind; space is situated at the tip.

sanskrit_iast:
mūle sthitastu bhūrloko bhuvarlokastu madhyagaḥ .
svarlokaścāgramāśritya sthito vyaṅgasya yāvatā . . 25
meaning:
मूले स्थितस्तु भूर्लोको भुवर्लोकस्तु मध्यगः .
स्वर्लोकश्चाग्रमाश्रित्य स्थितो व्यङ्गस्य यावता . . 25
text_mt:
Bhūrloka is situated at the base, and Bhuvarloka is in the middle;
and Svarloka stands resting upon the tip, as far as the vyaṅga extends.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ devamayaḥ sāṃba evaṃ lokamayastathā .
dhāraṇīyo mahānbhaktyā pūjakaḥ prītaye raveḥ . . 26
meaning:
एवं देवमयः सांब एवं लोकमयस्तथा .
धारणीयो महान्भक्त्या पूजकः प्रीतये रवेः . . 26
text_mt:
Thus it consists of the gods, O Sāmba; thus it consists of the worlds.
The worshipper should wear this great [girdle] with devotion for the pleasure of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayanti raviṃ ye vai vinānena yadūttama .
pūjāphalaṃ na teṣāṃ syānnarakaṃ ca vrajanti hi . . 27
meaning:
पूजयन्ति रविं ये वै विनानेन यदूत्तम .
पूजाफलं न तेषां स्यान्नरकं च व्रजन्ति हि . . 27
text_mt: Those who worship the sun without this, O best of the Yadus, / have no fruit of their worship and indeed go to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā teṣāṃ bhavennityamavyaṅgo bhojakaḥ sadā .
anyakāle yaduśreṣṭha ityetatkathitaṃ tava . . 28
meaning:
तथा तेषां भवेन्नित्यमव्यङ्गो भोजकः सदा .
अन्यकाले यदुश्रेष्ठ इत्येतत्कथितं तव . . 28
text_mt: Thus their bhojaka should always constantly wear the avyaṅga. / At any other time, O best of the Yadus, thus has this been told to you,

sanskrit_iast:
bandhane kāraṇaṃ vīra bhūṣaṇāni ca suvrata . . 29
dhūpādivividhavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
बन्धने कारणं वीर भूषणानि च सुव्रत . . 29
धूपादिविविधविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
the reason for its tying, O hero, and its ornaments, O you of good vows.
Description of the various rites of incense and other offerings

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
śrutvaivameva sāmbena vyāsātsatyavatīsutāt .
avyaṅgasya ca utpattiṃ punarāgānmahāmatiḥ . . 1
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
श्रुत्वैवमेव साम्बेन व्यासात्सत्यवतीसुतात् .
अव्यङ्गस्य च उत्पत्तिं पुनरागान्महामतिः . . 1
text_mt: Sumantu said: / Having heard just this from Vyāsa, the son of Satyavatī, / about the origin of the avyaṅga, the high-minded Sāmba returned again.
title: Dhūpādivividhavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast: athāgatya mahātejāḥ sāmbo gatvāśramaṃ punaḥ . . 2
meaning: अथागत्य महातेजाः साम्बो गत्वाश्रमं पुनः . . 2
text_mt: Then having arrived, the exceedingly radiant Sāmba, having gone once more to the hermitage

sanskrit_iast:
nāradasya mahābāhornāradaṃ vākyamabravīt .
kathamutkṣipya vai dhūpaṃ bhojakaiḥ saviturmune . . 3
meaning:
नारदस्य महाबाहोर्नारदं वाक्यमब्रवीत् .
कथमुत्क्षिप्य वै धूपं भोजकैः सवितुर्मुने . . 3
text_mt: of the mighty-armed Nārada, spoke these words to Nārada: / "O sage, how is incense raised by the bhojakas for the Sun,

sanskrit_iast:
snānamācamanaṃ caivamarghyadānaṃ mahātmane .
sāmbasya vacanaṃ śrutvā nārado munisattamaḥ . . 4
meaning:
स्नानमाचमनं चैवमर्घ्यदानं महात्मने .
साम्बस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा नारदो मुनिसत्तमः . . 4
text_mt: as well as the bath, the sipping of water, and the offering of water to the great-souled one?" / Having heard Sāmba's words, Nārada, the best of sages,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca kuruśārdūla sāmbaṃ jāmbavatīsutam .
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi raverdhūpavidhikramam . . 5
meaning:
उवाच कुरुशार्दूल साम्बं जाम्बवतीसुतम् .
हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि रवेर्धूपविधिक्रमम् . . 5
text_mt: spoke, O tiger among the Kurus, to Sāmba, the son of Jāmbavatī: / "Behold, I shall tell you the sequence of the rite of incense for the Sun,

sanskrit_iast:
snānamācamanaṃ caiva svarṇadānaṃ tathaiva ca .
ācāntastristataḥ snātvā vāsasī nirmale śubhe . . 6
meaning:
स्नानमाचमनं चैव स्वर्णदानं तथैव च .
आचान्तस्त्रिस्ततः स्नात्वा वाससी निर्मले शुभे . . 6
text_mt: as well as the bath, the sipping of water, and likewise the gift of gold. / Having sipped water three times, then having bathed, putting on two spotless, auspicious,

sanskrit_iast:
anārdre saṃvasītaiva pavitre paridhāya ca .
udaṅmukhaḥ prāṅmukho vāpyācāmecca prayatnataḥ . . 7
meaning:
अनार्द्रे संवसीतैव पवित्रे परिधाय च .
उदङ्मुखः प्राङ्मुखो वाप्याचामेच्च प्रयत्नतः . . 7
text_mt: and dry garments, and wearing a sacred thread, / facing north or facing east, one should sip water with care.

sanskrit_iast:
jale jalastho nācāmejjalāduttīrya yatnataḥ .
apsu sūryastathāgniśca mātā devī sarasvatī . . 8
meaning:
जले जलस्थो नाचामेज्जलादुत्तीर्य यत्नतः .
अप्सु सूर्यस्तथाग्निश्च माता देवी सरस्वती . . 8
text_mt: Standing in water, one should not sip water in the water; having carefully emerged from the water [one should sip]. / For in the waters are the Sun as well as Fire, and Mother Goddess Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāduttīrya cācāmennācāmettu jalāśaye .
upaviśya śucau deśe prayataḥ prāgudaṅmukhaḥ . . 9
meaning:
तस्मादुत्तीर्य चाचामेन्नाचामेत्तु जलाशये .
उपविश्य शुचौ देशे प्रयतः प्रागुदङ्मुखः . . 9
text_mt: Therefore, having stepped out, one should sip water, and not sip water in a reservoir. / Having sat down in a pure place, restrained, facing east or north,

sanskrit_iast:
pādau prakṣālya hastau ca antarjānustathācamet .
prasannāstriḥ pibettvāpaḥ prayataḥ susamāhitaḥ . . 1.143.10
meaning:
पादौ प्रक्षाल्य हस्तौ च अन्तर्जानुस्तथाचमेत् .
प्रसन्नास्त्रिः पिबेत्त्वापः प्रयतः सुसमाहितः . . 1.143.10
text_mt: having washed both feet and both hands, placing [the hands] between the knees, he should sip water. / Attentive and well-composed, he should drink clear water three times.

sanskrit_iast:
sammārjanaṃ tu dviḥ kuryāttribhirabhyukṣaṇaṃ punaḥ .
mūrdhānaṃ khāni cātmānamupaspṛśyānu pūrvaśaḥ . . 11
meaning:
सम्मार्जनं तु द्विः कुर्यात्त्रिभिरभ्युक्षणं पुनः .
मूर्धानं खानि चात्मानमुपस्पृश्यानु पूर्वशः . . 11
text_mt: He should wipe twice, and again sprinkle with three [drops], / and sequentially touch the head, the bodily apertures, and oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
ācānto'rkaṃ namaskṛtya śauceṣu śucitāmiyāt .
kriyāṃ yaḥ kurute mohādanācamyeha nāstikaḥ . . 12
meaning:
आचान्तोऽर्कं नमस्कृत्य शौचेषु शुचितामियात् .
क्रियां यः कुरुते मोहादनाचम्येह नास्तिकः . . 12
text_mt: Having sipped water and bowed to the Sun, he attains purity among purifications. / An unbeliever here who through delusion performs a rite without sipping water—

sanskrit_iast:
bhavantīha kriyāḥ sarvā vṛthā tasya na saṃśayaḥ .
śucikāmā hi vai devā vedairevamudāhṛtāḥ . . 13
meaning:
भवन्तीह क्रियाः सर्वा वृथा तस्य न संशयः .
शुचिकामा हि वै देवा वेदैरेवमुदाहृताः . . 13
text_mt: all his rites here become useless, there is no doubt. / For the gods desire purity; thus it has been declared by the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
inopāsākṛtaścaiva sarve devāḥ prayatnataḥ .
śaucameva praśaṃsanti śaucāṅgairhi vidhīyate . . 14
meaning:
इनोपासाकृतश्चैव सर्वे देवाः प्रयत्नतः .
शौचमेव प्रशंसन्ति शौचाङ्गैर्हि विधीयते . . 14
text_mt: And made by the worship of the Sun, all the gods zealously / praise purity alone; for it is prescribed through the constituent parts of purity.

sanskrit_iast:
ācānto maunamāsthāya devāgāraṃ tato vrajet .
śvāsarodhanimittaṃ tu prāṇamācchādya vāsasā . . 15
meaning:
आचान्तो मौनमास्थाय देवागारं ततो व्रजेत् .
श्वासरोधनिमित्तं तु प्राणमाच्छाद्य वाससा . . 15
text_mt: Having sipped water and observed silence, he should then go to the temple of the deity, / covering his breath with a cloth for the purpose of checking his breathing,

sanskrit_iast:
śiraḥ prāvṛtya yatnena keśodakanivṛttaye .
tataḥ pūjāṃ raveḥ kuryātpuṣpairnānāvidhaiḥ śubhaiḥ . . 16
meaning:
शिरः प्रावृत्य यत्नेन केशोदकनिवृत्तये .
ततः पूजां रवेः कुर्यात्पुष्पैर्नानाविधैः शुभैः . . 16
text_mt: and carefully wrapping his head to prevent hair or water [from falling]. / Then he should perform the worship of the Sun with diverse auspicious flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatrīṃ saśiraskāṃ ca yajamānaḥ prayatnataḥ .
dhūpaṃ tato'gnaye dadyātprathamaṃ guggulāhutam . . 17
meaning:
गायत्रीं सशिरस्कां च यजमानः प्रयत्नतः .
धूपं ततोऽग्नये दद्यात्प्रथमं गुग्गुलाहुतम् . . 17
text_mt: the sacrificer carefully [reciting] the Gāyatrī with its head. / Then he should first offer into the fire incense consisting of an oblation of guggulu.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpāñjaliṃ tato gṛhya tacchikhāyāṃ prayatnataḥ .
ravermūrdhani taṃ dadyāddevamantramudāharan . . 18
meaning:
पुष्पाञ्जलिं ततो गृह्य तच्छिखायां प्रयत्नतः .
रवेर्मूर्धनि तं दद्याद्देवमन्त्रमुदाहरन् . . 18
text_mt: Then, having carefully taken a handful of flowers at its flame, / he should place it on the head of the Sun, pronouncing the deity's mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ vratena yadvratino varjayanti devā manuṣyāḥ pitaraśca sarve .
tasyādityaṃ prasaraṃ ca manāmahe yastejasā prathamaṃ nāvibhāti . . 19
meaning:
ओं व्रतेन यद्व्रतिनो वर्जयन्ति देवा मनुष्याः पितरश्च सर्वे .
तस्यादित्यं प्रसरं च मनामहे यस्तेजसा प्रथमं नाविभाति . . 19
text_mt: "Oṃ, that vow which the observant, the gods, men, and all the ancestors avoid / through the vow—we reflect upon his sun and its course, which first shines forth with splendour."

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpavelāḥ smṛtāḥ pañca dhūpeṣveva tu pañcasu .
havanādyāḥ kriyāḥ pañca rakṣiṣye'haṃ tathā punaḥ . 1.143.20
meaning:
धूपवेलाः स्मृताः पञ्च धूपेष्वेव तु पञ्चसु .
हवनाद्याः क्रियाः पञ्च रक्षिष्येऽहं तथा पुनः . 1.143.20
text_mt: Five times for incense are prescribed for the five [types of] incense. / The five rites beginning with the offering into the fire I shall likewise protect again.

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍanāyakavelā tu pratyūṣe ṛkṣadarśanāt .
nājñāvelā pradoṣastu tattvakāryaṃ vijānatā . . 21
meaning:
दण्डनायकवेला तु प्रत्यूषे ऋक्षदर्शनात् .
नाज्ञावेला प्रदोषस्तु तत्त्वकार्यं विजानता . . 21
text_mt: The time of the Daṇḍanāyaka is at dawn upon seeing the stars. / The dusk is the time of the King; the duty of reality should be understood by one who knows.

sanskrit_iast:
trikālaṃ tu raveḥ pūjā kartavyā sūryadarśanāt .
ardhoditastu pūrvāhṇe tato'rddhastu ravirvibhuḥ . . 22
meaning:
त्रिकालं तु रवेः पूजा कर्तव्या सूर्यदर्शनात् .
अर्धोदितस्तु पूर्वाह्णे ततोऽर्द्धस्तु रविर्विभुः . . 22
text_mt: Worship of the Sun is to be performed at the three junctures of the day from the sight of the Sun. / In the morning, when half-risen, then the lord Sun is half;

sanskrit_iast:
helayeti ca pūrvāhṇe madhyāhne jvalanāya ca .
tathaiva maṇḍale deyaṃ nīcāhne jvalanāya ca . . 23
meaning:
हेलयेति च पूर्वाह्णे मध्याह्ने ज्वलनाय च .
तथैव मण्डले देयं नीचाह्ने ज्वलनाय च . . 23
text_mt: with 'Helā' in the morning, and at midday for the blazing one; / likewise, it should be offered into the solar orb and to the blazing one in the afternoon.

sanskrit_iast:
candanodakamiśrāṇi gandhodakayutāni ca .
padmāni karavīrāṇi tathā raktotpalāni ca . . 24
meaning:
चन्दनोदकमिश्राणि गन्धोदकयुतानि च .
पद्मानि करवीराणि तथा रक्तोत्पलानि च . . 24
text_mt: Mixed with sandalwood water and united with fragrant water, / lotuses, oleanders, and red water-lilies,

sanskrit_iast:
kusumodakamiśrāṇi kuruṃṭakusumaṃ tathā .
gandhādīni ca divyāni kṛtvā vai tāmrabhājane ..25
meaning:
कुसुमोदकमिश्राणि कुरुंटकुसुमं तथा .
गन्धादीनि च दिव्यानि कृत्वा वै ताम्रभाजने ..25
text_mt: mixed with flower-scented water, and kuruṇṭa flowers, / having placed these divine perfumes and items in a copper vessel,

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpaṃ dattvāgnaye vīra prayatnādguggulāhutim .
arghyapātraṃ tadā gṛhya kuryādāvāhanaṃ raveḥ ..26
meaning:
धूपं दत्त्वाग्नये वीर प्रयत्नाद्गुग्गुलाहुतिम् .
अर्घ्यपात्रं तदा गृह्य कुर्यादावाहनं रवेः ..26
text_mt: and having carefully given incense to the fire with an oblation of guggulu, O hero, / taking then the arghya vessel, he should perform the invocation of the Sun:

sanskrit_iast:
ehi sūrya sahasrāṃśo tejorāśe jagatpate .
anukampya māṃ deva gṛhāṇārghyaṃ divākara ..27
meaning:
एहि सूर्य सहस्रांशो तेजोराशे जगत्पते .
अनुकम्प्य मां देव गृहाणार्घ्यं दिवाकर ..27
text_mt: "Come, O Sun of a thousand rays, mass of splendour, Lord of the Universe! / Taking compassion on me, O God, accept this arghya, O Maker of Day!"

sanskrit_iast:
anenāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā jānubhyāmavanīṃ gataḥ .
ravernivedayedarghyamādityahṛdaye gataḥ ..28
meaning:
अनेनावाहनं कृत्वा जानुभ्यामवनीं गतः .
रवेर्निवेदयेदर्घ्यमादित्यहृदये गतः ..28
text_mt: Having made the invocation with this, having fallen to the ground on both knees, / absorbed in the Ādityahṛdaya, he should offer the arghya to the Sun:

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ namo bhagavate1 ādityāya viśvāya kheśāya brahmaṇelokakartṛṇe.
īśānāya purāṇāya sahasrākṣāya te namaḥ ..29
meaning:
ओं नमो भगवते1 आदित्याय विश्वाय खेशाय ब्रह्मणेलोककर्तृणे.
ईशानाय पुराणाय सहस्राक्षाय ते नमः ..29
text_mt: "Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One, Āditya, the Universal, the sky-dwelling Brahman, the creator of the worlds, / to Īśāna, the Ancient One, the thousand-eyed one, homage to you;

sanskrit_iast:
somāya ṛgyajuratharvāya.
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥoṃmahaḥ oṃjanaḥ oṃtapaḥ oṃ satyaṃ brahmaṇe muṇḍe madhye purataḥ .. ādityāya namaḥ ..1.143.3 0
nārada uvāca
sāvitryāśca pare tantre trailokyatrāṇakāriṇe .
paritaḥ parigṛhyātha dhūpabhājanamutkṣipet ..3 1
nivedayettato dhūpaṃ vācametāmudīrayet .
tvameka eva rudrāṇāṃ vasūnāṃ ca purātanaḥ ..32
meaning:
सोमाय ऋग्यजुरथर्वाय.
ओं भूर्भुवःस्वःओंमहः ओंजनः ओंतपः ओं सत्यं ब्रह्मणे मुण्डे मध्ये पुरतः .. आदित्याय नमः ..1.143.3 0
नारद उवाच
सावित्र्याश्च परे तन्त्रे त्रैलोक्यत्राणकारिणे .
परितः परिगृह्याथ धूपभाजनमुत्क्षिपेत् ..3 1
निवेदयेत्ततो धूपं वाचमेतामुदीरयेत् .
त्वमेक एव रुद्राणां वसूनां च पुरातनः ..32
text_mt: to Soma, the Ṛg, Yajus, and Atharva [Vedas]; / oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ, oṃ mahaḥ, oṃ janaḥ, oṃ tapaḥ, oṃ satyam, to the Brahman, on the head, in the middle, in front... homage to Āditya." / Nārada said: / And in the supreme system of Sāvitrī, for the protector of the three worlds, / holding it all around, he should then raise the incense vessel. / He should then present the incense and utter these words: / "You alone are ancient among the Rudras and the Vasus;

sanskrit_iast:

pūrvāhṇe ca tvayā tena madhyāhne cāpareṇa tu ..3 3

viṣṇostatparamaṃ padaṃ sadā paśyaṃti sūrayaḥ ..34
meaning:

पूर्वाह्णे च त्वया तेन मध्याह्ने चापरेण तु ..3 3

sanskrit_iast:

नमो वरुणाय शम्भवे ..35
text_mt: In the evening, he should present the arghya to the Maker of Day with the mantra: / 'Oṃ, homage to Varuṇa, to Śambhu.'

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ ākṛṣṇena rajasā vartamāno niveśayannamṛtaṃ martyaṃ ca .
hiraṇyayena savitā rathenādevo yāti bhuvanāni paśyan..36
meaning:
ओं आकृष्णेन रजसा वर्तमानो निवेशयन्नमृतं मर्त्यं च .
हिरण्ययेन सविता रथेनादेवो याति भुवनानि पश्यन्..36
text_mt: "Oṃ, circling through the dark space, laying to rest the immortal and the mortal, / the god Savitṛ comes on his golden chariot, beholding the worlds."

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā dattvā dhūpaṃ sūryāya bhojakaḥ .
utkṣipeccaiva dhūpena viśedgarbhagṛhaṃ tataḥ . . 37
meaning:
अनेन विधिना दत्त्वा धूपं सूर्याय भोजकः .
उत्क्षिपेच्चैव धूपेन विशेद्गर्भगृहं ततः . . 37

sanskrit_iast:

mantreṇa mihirāyeti nikṣubhāyeti nityaśaḥ . . 38

मन्त्रेण मिहिरायेति निक्षुभायेति नित्यशः . . 38

दण्डनायकसंज्ञाय पिङ्गलाय च वै नमः . . 39
text_mt: then 'Homage to Rājñī' and then 'Homage to Nikṣubhā', / and indeed 'Homage to the one named Daṇḍanāyaka and to Piṅgala',

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:

ततः प्रदक्षिणं कुर्वन्दिग्देवेभ्यो निवेदयेत् . . 1.143.40
text_mt: likewise to Rājña, to Srauṣa, likewise to the lord Garuḍa. / Then, circumambulating, he should present it to the deities of the directions.

sanskrit_iast:
diṇḍine tu tato dadyāddhemantāya yadūttama .

oṃ brahmaṇe muṇḍapataye ādityāya puruṣeśvarāya sūryāya namonamaḥ . . 42
meaning:
दिण्डिने तु ततो दद्याद्धेमन्ताय यदूत्तम .

text_mt: Then one should give to Diṇḍin, and to Hemanta, O best of the Yadus; / and one should give to Maheśvara, and likewise to Vyoman, O Yādava. / (Obeisance to the Viśvedevas. Obeisance to the Rudras.) / Oṃ, obeisance, obeisance to Brahmā, to Muṇḍapati, to Āditya, to Puruṣeśvara, to Sūrya.

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: praising [him] with the hymns concealed for the Sun, and having thus acknowledged them, then: / 'You have been worshipped by me according to my capacity and with devotion, O Vibhāvasu; / tell me, O Lord, of the accomplishment of my aims in this world and the next.'

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: Whoever, having bathed at the three junctures of the day, thus worships the sun with bowed head / according to the prescribed rule, obtains the fruit of an aśvamedha sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: And he who constantly performs the elaborate incense offering as prescribed, / has sons, remains free from disease, and upon death is dissolved into the sun.

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: When performed with effort according to the prescribed rule, / all undertakings succeed and become fruitful.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yadā na syātpatrāṇi samupāharet .

पत्रं न स्यात्ततो धूपं धूपो न स्यात्ततो जलम् . . 51
text_mt: When excellent flowers are not available, one should bring leaves; / if leaves are not available, then incense; if incense is not available, then water.

अशक्तः प्रणिपातस्य मनसा पूजयेद्रविम् . . 52
text_mt: And when nothing at all is available, one should worship by prostration; / if unable to prostrate, one should worship the sun mentally.

द्रव्याणां सम्भवे चैव सर्वमेवोपहारयेत् . . 53

मन्त्रैः कर्मयुतो यस्तु मित्रे धूपं निवेदयेत् .
उच्चारणाच्च वै तेषां धूपप्रीतो भवेद्रविः . . 54

meaning:

तस्माद्युक्तं सदा कार्यं पूज्यते च दिवाकरः . . 56
text_mt: By means of the lotus-stalk, O king of kings, a man goes to the Sun; / therefore that which is proper should always be done, and the Sun is worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
te'śvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya sūryalokaṃ vrajanti hi .

meaning:
तेऽश्वमेधफलं प्राप्य सूर्यलोकं व्रजन्ति हि .
धूपेन पूज्यमानं तु नराः पश्यन्ति यादव . . 57
text_mt: Having obtained the fruit of an aśvamedha sacrifice, they indeed go to the world of the sun; / men who behold him being worshipped with incense, O Yādava,

sanskrit_iast:
yānti te paramaṃ sthānaṃ yanna paśyanti sūrayaḥ .
kriyamāṇaṃ tathārkaṃ ca bhaktyā paśyanti ye narāḥ . .
sarvānkāmāniha prāpya te yānti paramaṃ padam . . 58
meaning:
यान्ति ते परमं स्थानं यन्न पश्यन्ति सूरयः .
क्रियमाणं तथार्कं च भक्त्या पश्यन्ति ये नराः . .
सर्वान्कामानिह प्राप्य ते यान्ति परमं पदम् . . 58

athājagāma bhagavānvyāso dvāravatīṃ purīm .

sanskrit_iast:
tamāgatamṛṣiṃ dṛṣṭvā vāsudevo viśāṃpate .

meaning:

अभ्युत्थाय महातेजाः पूजयामास भारत . . 2

sanskrit_iast:
svayamevāsanaṃ dattvā pādyamarghyaṃ tathaiva ca .

पप्रच्छ प्रयतो भूत्वा व्यासं सत्यवतीसुतम् . . 3
text_mt: Having himself offered a seat, water for the feet, and the respectful offering of arghya, / he became attentive and questioned Vyāsa, the son of Satyavatī:

śākadvīpamito gatvā jñānino mokṣagāminaḥ . . 4
meaning:

text_mt: 'These Bhojaka brāhmaṇas who were brought by my son, / having gone from here to Śākadvīpa—wise men bound for liberation—

sanskrit_iast:
tāndṛṣṭvā rūpato vipra praveśātkarmatastathā.
kautūhalaṃ samutpannaṃ harṣaśca paramo mama . . 5
meaning:
तान्दृष्ट्वा रूपतो विप्र प्रवेशात्कर्मतस्तथा.
कौतूहलं समुत्पन्नं हर्षश्च परमो मम . . 5
text_mt: having seen them by their appearance, O brāhmaṇa, by their conduct, and by their rites, / curiosity arose in me, as well as supreme joy.

sanskrit_iast:
kathamete kṣaṇamapi tiṣṭhante pṛthivītale .
yeṣāṃ raviḥ sadā pūjyasteṣāṃ muktiḥ sadā vaset . . 6
meaning:
कथमेते क्षणमपि तिष्ठन्ते पृथिवीतले .
येषां रविः सदा पूज्यस्तेषां मुक्तिः सदा वसेत् . . 6

sanskrit_iast:

इदं मे मनसो ब्रह्मन्सदा सम्प्रतिभाति वै . . 7
text_mt: Indeed, without attaining the state of a Bhojaka, no one attains liberation; / this, O holy one, ever appears true to my mind.'

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
evameva yathāttha tvaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādhara .

meaning:

एवमेव यथात्थ त्वं शङ्खचक्रगदाधर .
धन्या एते महात्मानो भोजका नात्र संशयः . . 8
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / 'It is just as you have said, O bearer of the conch, discus, and mace. / Blessed are these great-souled Bhojakas; of this there is no doubt,

sanskrit_iast:
ye pūjayanti satataṃ bhānumantaṃ divākaram .

meaning:
ये पूजयन्ति सततं भानुमन्तं दिवाकरम् .
ज्ञानिनः कर्मनिष्ठाश्च सदा मोक्षगतिं गताः . . 9
text_mt: who constantly worship the radiant Sun; / wise, steadfast in action, they have always attained the path of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
yajante satataṃ bhānuṃ balipuṣpaphalaistathā .
annenauṣadhibhiścaiva ājyahomaiśca kṛtsnaśaḥ . . 1.144.10
meaning:
यजन्ते सततं भानुं बलिपुष्पफलैस्तथा .
अन्नेनौषधिभिश्चैव आज्यहोमैश्च कृत्स्नशः . . 1.144.10
text_mt: They worship the Sun continually with offerings, flowers, and fruits, / with food, medicinal herbs, and oblation of clarified butter in their entirety.

sanskrit_iast:
homaṃ ca śāśvataṃ kṛtvā paraṃ homaṃ tataḥ śritāḥ .
parahomasya karaṇātpūtātmāno hyakalmaṣāḥ . . 11
meaning:
होमं च शाश्वतं कृत्वा परं होमं ततः श्रिताः .
परहोमस्य करणात्पूतात्मानो ह्यकल्मषाः . . 11
text_mt: And having performed the perpetual homa, they then take resort in the supreme homa; / through performing the supreme homa, their souls purified and free from defilement,

sanskrit_iast:
viśanti paramāṃ divyāṃ bhāskarīṃ taijasīṃ kalām .
karmaṇaḥ sādhane caikā tatra cāgnau pratiṣṭhitā . . 12
meaning:
विशन्ति परमां दिव्यां भास्करीं तैजसीं कलाम् .
कर्मणः साधने चैका तत्र चाग्नौ प्रतिष्ठिता . . 12
text_mt: they enter the supreme, divine, fiery portion belonging to the Sun. / And for the accomplishment of ritual action, one [portion] is established there in the fire;

sanskrit_iast:
vāyumārgasthitā vyomni dvitīyāntaḥ prakāśikā .
tataḥ paraṃ tṛtīyā tu tatsmṛtaṃ sūryamaṇḍale . . 13
meaning:
वायुमार्गस्थिता व्योम्नि द्वितीयान्तः प्रकाशिका .
ततः परं तृतीया तु तत्स्मृतं सूर्यमण्डले . . 13
text_mt: the second, standing in the path of the wind in the sky, illuminates within; / and beyond that is the third, which is known [to abide] in the orb of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍalaṃ tacca saviturdivyaṃ hyajaramavyayam .
tasyā'sau puruṣo madhye yo'sau sadasadātmakaḥ . . 14
meaning:
मण्डलं तच्च सवितुर्दिव्यं ह्यजरमव्ययम् .
तस्याऽसौ पुरुषो मध्ये योऽसौ सदसदात्मकः . . 14
text_mt: And that orb of the sun is divine, ageless, and imperishable; / in the middle of it is that Person whose self consists of the real and the unreal.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣarākṣarastu vijñeyo mahāsūryastathaiva ca .
niṣkalaḥ sakalaścāpi dvau ca tasya prakalpitau . . 15
meaning:
क्षराक्षरस्तु विज्ञेयो महासूर्यस्तथैव च .
निष्कलः सकलश्चापि द्वौ च तस्य प्रकल्पितौ . . 15
text_mt: He is to be known as both perishable and imperishable, and likewise as the Great Sun; / he is both without parts and with parts—two [forms] of his are conceived.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣaraḥ sakalaścaiva sarvabhūtavyavasthitaḥ .
satattvaḥ sakalaḥ proktastattvahīnastu niṣkalaḥ . . 16
meaning:
अक्षरः सकलश्चैव सर्वभूतव्यवस्थितः .
सतत्त्वः सकलः प्रोक्तस्तत्त्वहीनस्तु निष्कलः . . 16
text_mt: He is imperishable and with parts, residing in all beings; / having tattvas, he is called "with parts"; but devoid of tattvas, he is "without parts".

sanskrit_iast:
tṛṇagulmalatāvṛkṣavṛkasiṃhadvijādhipān .
surasiddhamanuṣyāṃśca sthalajāñjalajānharet . . 17
meaning:
तृणगुल्मलतावृक्षवृकसिंहद्विजाधिपान् .
सुरसिद्धमनुष्यांश्च स्थलजाञ्जलजान्हरेत् . . 17
text_mt: Grasses, shrubs, creepers, trees, wolves, lions, lords of birds, / gods, siddhas, humans, land-dwellers, and water-dwellers—he takes them [all].

sanskrit_iast:
vyavasthitaḥ sa sarvatra sarveṣāmantarātmani .
yadā kalpātmakaścaiva dvitīyāṃ tanumāśritaḥ . . 18
meaning:
व्यवस्थितः स सर्वत्र सर्वेषामन्तरात्मनि .
यदा कल्पात्मकश्चैव द्वितीयां तनुमाश्रितः . . 18
text_mt: He is stationed everywhere in the inner self of all beings; / when he is composed of eons, he assumes a second body.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkalastu sadā jñeyaḥ saṃsthitastaijasīṃ kalām .
himaṃ gharmaṃ ca varṣaṃ ca trailokye kurute sadā . . 19
meaning:
निष्कलस्तु सदा ज्ञेयः संस्थितस्तैजसीं कलाम् .
हिमं घर्मं च वर्षं च त्रैलोक्ये कुरुते सदा . . 19
text_mt: He is always to be known as without parts, abiding in the fiery portion; / he always produces cold, heat, and rain in the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyā yā tanustasya akṣaraṃ tatparaṃ padam .
devayānaṃ tu panthānaṃ karmayogena saṃsthitā . 1.144.20
meaning:
द्वितीया या तनुस्तस्य अक्षरं तत्परं पदम् .
देवयानं तु पन्थानं कर्मयोगेन संस्थिता . 1.144.20
text_mt: That second body of his is the imperishable, supreme state; / established on the path of the gods by the yoga of action,

sanskrit_iast:
ādityasiddhāntaritāḥ sāṅkhyayogavidaśca ye .
te'bhigacchanti tatsthānaṃ sa mokṣaḥ parikīrtitaḥ . . 21
meaning:
आदित्यसिद्धान्तरिताः साङ्ख्ययोगविदश्च ये .
तेऽभिगच्छन्ति तत्स्थानं स मोक्षः परिकीर्तितः . . 21
text_mt: those devoted to the solar doctrine, and those who know Sāṅkhya and Yoga, / reach that abode; that is proclaimed as liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
nirdvandvo nirgamaścaiva tatra gatvā na śocati .
vedeṣu brahma vadanti dhyāyante tattvavedinaḥ . . 22
meaning:
निर्द्वन्द्वो निर्गमश्चैव तत्र गत्वा न शोचति .
वेदेषु ब्रह्म वदन्ति ध्यायन्ते तत्त्ववेदिनः . . 22
text_mt: Free from the pairs of opposites and departed [from saṃsāra], having gone there one does not grieve. / In the Vedas they speak of it as Brahman; those who know the truth meditate upon it.

sanskrit_iast:
akāraṃ tattvataścāpi dhyāyante puruṣottama .
tryakṣaraṃ ca tamoṃkāraṃ sārdhamātrātraye sthitam . . 23
meaning:
अकारं तत्त्वतश्चापि ध्यायन्ते पुरुषोत्तम .
त्र्यक्षरं च तमोंकारं सार्धमात्रात्रये स्थितम् . . 23
text_mt: And in reality, O supreme among men, they meditate on the letter "A", / and on that three-lettered Oṃkāra abiding in three and a half measures.

sanskrit_iast:
vadanti cārdhamātrasthaṃ makāraṃ vyañjanātmakam.
dhyāyanti ye makārīyaṃ jñānaṃ te hi sadātmakam . . 24
meaning:
वदन्ति चार्धमात्रस्थं मकारं व्यञ्जनात्मकम्.
ध्यायन्ति ये मकारीयं ज्ञानं ते हि सदात्मकम् . . 24
text_mt: And they declare the consonant "M" to reside in the half-measure; / those who meditate on the knowledge pertaining to "M" [meditate] indeed on that which consists of eternal being.'

sanskrit_iast:
makāro bhagavāndevo bhāskaraḥ parikīrtitaḥ .
makāradhyānayogācca magā hyete prakīrtitāḥ . . 25
meaning:
मकारो भगवान्देवो भास्करः परिकीर्तितः .
मकारध्यानयोगाच्च मगा ह्येते प्रकीर्तिताः . . 25
text_mt: The letter Ma is proclaimed to be the blessed god Bhāskara, / and through the practice of meditation upon the letter Ma, these are indeed proclaimed as Magas.

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpamālyairyutaścāpi upahāraistathaiva ca .
bhojayanti sahasrāṃśuṃ tena te bhojakāḥ smṛtāḥ . . 26
bhojakajñānavarṇanam
meaning:
धूपमाल्यैर्युतश्चापि उपहारैस्तथैव च .
भोजयन्ति सहस्रांशुं तेन ते भोजकाः स्मृताः . . 26
भोजकज्ञानवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Equipped with incense and garlands, and likewise with offerings, / they feed the thousand-rayed Sun; for that reason, they are traditionally known as Bhojakas.
Description of the Knowledge of the Bhojakas

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudeva uvāca
jñānopalabdhiṃ viprendra bhojakānāṃ mahāmune .
brūhi tattvaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha kautukaṃ paramaṃ mama . . 1
meaning:
वासुदेव उवाच
ज्ञानोपलब्धिं विप्रेन्द्र भोजकानां महामुने .
ब्रूहि तत्त्वं द्विजश्रेष्ठ कौतुकं परमं मम . . 1
text_mt: Vāsudeva said: / O foremost of sages, leader of the brahmins, declare to me the true reality of the attainment of knowledge / of the Bhojakas, O best of the twice-born; great is my curiosity.
title: Bhojakajñānavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
imāṃ jñānopalabdhiṃ tu nibodha gadato mama .
asthisthūlaṃ snāyuyutaṃ māṃsaśoṇitalepanam . .
carmāvanaddhaṃ durgaṃdhipūrṇaṃ mūtrapurīṣayoḥ . . 2
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
इमां ज्ञानोपलब्धिं तु निबोध गदतो मम .
अस्थिस्थूलं स्नायुयुतं मांसशोणितलेपनम् . .
चर्मावनद्धं दुर्गंधिपूर्णं मूत्रपुरीषयोः . . 2
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Listen as I proclaim this attainment of knowledge: / Thick with bones, joined with sinews, smeared with flesh and blood, / bound with skin, foul-smelling, and filled with urine and feces,

sanskrit_iast:
jarāśokasamāviṣṭaṃ rogāyatanamāturam .
rajasvalamanityaṃ ca bhūtāvāsamimaṃ tyajet . . 3
meaning:
जराशोकसमाविष्टं रोगायतनमातुरम् .
रजस्वलमनित्यं च भूतावासमिमं त्यजेत् . . 3
text_mt: overcome with old age and grief, an afflicted abode of disease, / impure and impermanent—one should abandon this dwelling of the elements.

sanskrit_iast:
kapālaṃ vṛkṣamūlāni kucailamasahāyatā .
samatā sarvabhūteṣu evaṃ muktasya lakṣaṇam . . 4
meaning:
कपालं वृक्षमूलानि कुचैलमसहायता .
समता सर्वभूतेषु एवं मुक्तस्य लक्षणम् . . 4
text_mt: A skull-bowl, the roots of trees, ragged garments, solitude, / and equanimity toward all beings: such is the mark of a liberated one.

sanskrit_iast:
tile tailaṃ gavi kṣīraṃ kāṣṭhe pāvakasantatiḥ .
upāyaṃ cintayedasya dhiyā dhīraḥ samāhitaḥ . . 5
meaning:
तिले तैलं गवि क्षीरं काष्ठे पावकसन्ततिः .
उपायं चिन्तयेदस्य धिया धीरः समाहितः . . 5
text_mt: Oil in sesame, milk in a cow, the continuity of fire in wood— / the steadfast, concentrated man should contemplate the means to [attain] this with his intellect.

sanskrit_iast:
pramāthi ca prayatnena manaḥ saṃyamya cañcalam .
buddhīndriyāṇi saṃyamya śakunāniva pañjare . . 6
meaning:
प्रमाथि च प्रयत्नेन मनः संयम्य चञ्चलम् .
बुद्धीन्द्रियाणि संयम्य शकुनानिव पञ्जरे . . 6
text_mt: Restraining with effort the turbulent, fickle mind, / and holding in check the cognitive senses like birds in a cage,

sanskrit_iast:
indriyairniyatairdehī dhārābhiriva tṛpyate .
satatamamṛtasyaiva janārdana mahāmate . . 7
meaning:
इन्द्रियैर्नियतैर्देही धाराभिरिव तृप्यते .
सततममृतस्यैव जनार्दन महामते . . 7
text_mt: the embodied soul, with senses restrained, is continuously satisfied / as if by streams of nectar, O great-minded Janārdana.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāyāmairdaheddoṣāndhāraṇābhiśca1 kilbiṣam .
pratyāhāreṇa saṃsargāndhyānenānīśvarānguṇān . . 8
meaning:
प्राणायामैर्दहेद्दोषान्धारणाभिश्च1 किल्बिषम् .
प्रत्याहारेण संसर्गान्ध्यानेनानीश्वरान्गुणान् . . 8
text_mt: Through breath-controls one should burn away faults, and through concentrations, sin; / through sensory withdrawal, attachments; and through meditation, the qualities alien to the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyamānasya dahyante cānte doṣā yathāgninā .
tathendriyakṛtā doṣā dahyante prāṇanigrahāt . . 9
meaning:
ध्यायमानस्य दह्यन्ते चान्ते दोषा यथाग्निना .
तथेन्द्रियकृता दोषा दह्यन्ते प्राणनिग्रहात् . . 9
text_mt: Just as impurities in what is being smelted are burned away at last by fire, / so the faults caused by the senses are burned away through control of the breath.

sanskrit_iast:
cittaṃ cittena saṃśodhya bhāvaṃ bhāvena śodhayet .
manastu manasā śodhyaṃ buddhiṃ buddhyā tu śodhayet . . 1.145.10
meaning:
चित्तं चित्तेन संशोध्य भावं भावेन शोधयेत् .
मनस्तु मनसा शोध्यं बुद्धिं बुद्ध्या तु शोधयेत् . . 1.145.10
text_mt: One should purify the mind with the mind, and purify disposition with disposition; / the thought-organ must be purified by the thought-organ, and the intellect purified by the intellect.

sanskrit_iast:
cittasyātiprasādena bhāti karma śubhāśubham .
śubhāśubhavinirmukto nirdvandvo niṣparigrahaḥ . .
nirmamo nirahaṅkārastato yāti parāṃ gatim . . 11
meaning:
चित्तस्यातिप्रसादेन भाति कर्म शुभाशुभम् .
शुभाशुभविनिर्मुक्तो निर्द्वन्द्वो निष्परिग्रहः . .
निर्ममो निरहङ्कारस्ततो याति परां गतिम् . . 11
text_mt: Through the supreme serenity of the mind, good and bad action shine forth [clearly]; / freed from good and bad, beyond the dualities, free of possessions, / devoid of mineness and free of egoism, one then goes to the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
parvāhṇe lohitaṃ rūpaṃ prathamamṛṅmamayaṃ smṛtam .
yajurmayaṃ dvitīyaṃ tu śvetaṃ mādhyāhnikaṃ smṛtam . . 12
meaning:
पर्वाह्णे लोहितं रूपं प्रथममृङ्ममयं स्मृतम् .
यजुर्मयं द्वितीयं तु श्वेतं माध्याह्निकं स्मृतम् . . 12
text_mt: In the morning, the first form is remembered as red and made of the Ṛgveda; / the second, made of the Yajurveda, is remembered as white, belonging to midday.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sāyāhne sāmno rūpaṃ tu tatkṛtam .
prathamaṃ rājasaṃ deva dvitīyaṃ sāttvikaṃ smṛtam . 13
meaning:
कृष्णं तृतीयं सायाह्ने साम्नो रूपं तु तत्कृतम् .
प्रथमं राजसं देव द्वितीयं सात्त्विकं स्मृतम् . 13
text_mt: The third, in the evening, is black, made of the Sāmaveda. / The first is remembered as passionate, O god, and the second as pure;

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyaṃ tāmasaṃ rūpaṃ traiguṇyaṃ tasya kalpitam .
trayāṇāṃ vyatirekeṇa caturthaṃ sūryamaṇḍalam . . 14
meaning:
तृतीयं तामसं रूपं त्रैगुण्यं तस्य कल्पितम् .
त्रयाणां व्यतिरेकेण चतुर्थं सूर्यमण्डलम् . . 14
text_mt: the third is the dark form: thus is his threefold nature conceived. / Distinct from these three is the fourth, the solar disc,

sanskrit_iast:
jyotiḥ prakāśakaṃ sūkṣmaṃ proktaṃ devanirañjanam .
caturthaṃ tu vedavidaḥ sūryasiddhāntavedinaḥ . . 15
meaning:
ज्योतिः प्रकाशकं सूक्ष्मं प्रोक्तं देवनिरञ्जनम् .
चतुर्थं तु वेदविदः सूर्यसिद्धान्तवेदिनः . . 15
text_mt: a subtle, illuminating light, proclaimed to be the immaculate god. / Knowers of the Vedas and knowers of the Sūryasiddhānta [know] the fourth.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃkārapraṇavairyuktā dhyānanirbhūtakalmaṣāḥ .
sthitāḥ padmāsane vīrā nābhisaṃnyastapāṇayaḥ . . 16
meaning:
ओंकारप्रणवैर्युक्ता ध्याननिर्भूतकल्मषाः .
स्थिताः पद्मासने वीरा नाभिसंन्यस्तपाणयः . . 16
text_mt: Endowed with the syllable Om, the praṇava, with their impurities wiped away by meditation, / the heroes, seated in the lotus posture, place their hands upon the navel.

sanskrit_iast:
suṣumnānāḍikāmārgaṃ kumbharecakapūrakaiḥ .
tribhiḥ saṃśodhya tānpañca maruto dehamadhyagān .. 17
meaning:
सुषुम्नानाडिकामार्गं कुम्भरेचकपूरकैः .
त्रिभिः संशोध्य तान्पञ्च मरुतो देहमध्यगान् .. 17
text_mt: Purifying the pathway of the suṣumnā channel by the three— / retention, expulsion, and inhalation—along with those five winds moving in the middle of the body,

sanskrit_iast:
padāṅguṣṭhānvitaḥ svinnamūrdhvamutkṣepayetkramāt .
nābhideśe tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā devamagnimanāmayam .. 18
meaning:
पदाङ्गुष्ठान्वितः स्विन्नमूर्ध्वमुत्क्षेपयेत्क्रमात् .
नाभिदेशे तु तं दृष्ट्वा देवमग्निमनामयम् .. 18
text_mt: connected through the big toes, one should gradually cast the heated [breath] upward. / Having seen in the region of the navel that god, the flawless fire,

sanskrit_iast:
somaṃ ca hadaye dṛṣṭvā mūrdhni vāgniśikhāṃ tataḥ .
vātaraśmibhirāsādya taṃ bhittvā maṇḍalaṃ param .. 19
meaning:
सोमं च हदये दृष्ट्वा मूर्ध्नि वाग्निशिखां ततः .
वातरश्मिभिरासाद्य तं भित्त्वा मण्डलं परम् .. 19
text_mt: and having seen Soma in the heart, and then the flame of fire in the crown of the head, / having approached with the rays of wind and pierced that supreme disc,

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ paraṃ tu yo gacchedyogasthaḥ sūryamaṇḍalam .
yatra gatvā na śocanti tatsauraṃ paramaṃ padam ..1.145.2 0
devārcanaṃ mahābāho kīrtitaḥ keśisūdana .
prathamaṃ hadayaṃ sthānaṃ dvitīyaṃ cāgnimāśritam ..2 1
tṛtīyaṃ nābhisaṃsthaṃ ca caturthaṃ sūryamaṇḍalam ..22
meaning:
ततः परं तु यो गच्छेद्योगस्थः सूर्यमण्डलम् .
यत्र गत्वा न शोचन्ति तत्सौरं परमं पदम् ..1.145.2 0
देवार्चनं महाबाहो कीर्तितः केशिसूदन .
प्रथमं हदयं स्थानं द्वितीयं चाग्निमाश्रितम् ..2 1
तृतीयं नाभिसंस्थं च चतुर्थं सूर्यमण्डलम् ..22
text_mt: one who, established in yoga, would then go beyond to the solar disc— / having gone where they grieve no more, that is the supreme solar abode. / Worship of the god, O mighty-armed one, has been proclaimed, O slayer of Keśin: / the first place is the heart, the second resides in fire, / the third is located in the navel, and the fourth is the solar disc.

sanskrit_iast:
sthānaṃ paraṃ vai paramātmasaṃsthaṃ bhānoḥ sureśasya vadanti tajjñāḥ .
jñeyaḥ sa mokṣaśca nṛṇāṃ sa eva saṃsāravicchittikaraṃ padaṃ tataḥ ..23
meaning:
स्थानं परं वै परमात्मसंस्थं भानोः सुरेशस्य वदन्ति तज्ज्ञाः .
ज्ञेयः स मोक्षश्च नृणां स एव संसारविच्छित्तिकरं पदं ततः ..23
text_mt: Those who know that reality declare the supreme station of the Sun, the lord of the gods, to abide in the Supreme Self; / that is to be known as liberation for men, and that very station cuts off worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
idamamṛtasamaṃ parasya vedyaṃ kiraṇasahasramṛto hitaṃ janānām .
ṛṣicaritamavetya tattvasāraṃ vyapagatamohadhiyaḥ prayānti mokṣam ..24
meaning:
इदममृतसमं परस्य वेद्यं किरणसहस्रमृतो हितं जनानाम् .
ऋषिचरितमवेत्य तत्त्वसारं व्यपगतमोहधियः प्रयान्ति मोक्षम् ..24
text_mt: This truth of the supreme [deity], equal to nectar, is to be known; the thousand-rayed Sun is beneficial for people. / Understanding this conduct of the sages as the essence of reality, those whose minds are freed from delusion attain liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ magānāṃ caritaṃ mayā te prakhyāpitaṃ yānavareṇa yuktam .
jñātvātvimaṃ mokṣavido vadanti siddhāśca tatsthānamavāpnuvanti ..25
meaning:
इदं मगानां चरितं मया ते प्रख्यापितं यानवरेण युक्तम् .
ज्ञात्वात्विमं मोक्षविदो वदन्ति सिद्धाश्च तत्स्थानमवाप्नुवन्ति ..25
text_mt: This conduct of the Magas has been proclaimed by me to you, endowed with the foremost vehicle. / Having known this, the knowers of liberation speak [of it], and the perfected ones attain that state.

sanskrit_iast:
yanmayoktamidaṃ jñānaṃ deyaṃ śraddhāvatāṃ nṛṇām .
nāstikānāmabuddhīnāṃ na deyaṃ bhūtimicchatā ..26
meaning:
यन्मयोक्तमिदं ज्ञानं देयं श्रद्धावतां नृणाम् .
नास्तिकानामबुद्धीनां न देयं भूतिमिच्छता ..26
text_mt: This knowledge declared by me should be given to faithful men; / one who desires prosperity should not give it to atheists or the unintelligent.

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
ityuktvā bhagavānvyāso bhojakajñānamuttamam .
nārāyaṇaṃ mahābāho jagāmāyatanaṃ hareḥ ..27
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
