सर्वपापैर्विमुच्यन्ते सप्तजन्मकृतैरपि . . 18
text_mt: Whether at one time, two times, or three times, and always, / those who remember Ravi with devotion, even once, O Bhārata, / are liberated from all sins, even those committed in seven births.

sanskrit_iast:
stuvanti ye sadā bhānuṃ na te prakṛtimānuṣāḥ .
svargalokātparibhraṣṭāste jñeyā bhāskarā bhuvi . . 19
meaning:
स्तुवन्ति ये सदा भानुं न ते प्रकृतिमानुषाः .
स्वर्गलोकात्परिभ्रष्टास्ते ज्ञेया भास्करा भुवि . . 19
text_mt: Those who constantly praise the Sun are not ordinary men; / having fallen from the heavenly world, they are to be known as suns upon the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
nānarkaḥ smarate'rkaṃ vai nānarko'rkaṃ samarcayet .
nānarkaḥ kīrtayedarkaṃ nānarko'rkamavāpnuyāt . . 1.151.20
meaning:
नानर्कः स्मरतेऽर्कं वै नानर्कोऽर्कं समर्चयेत् .
नानर्कः कीर्तयेदर्कं नानर्कोऽर्कमवाप्नुयात् . . 1.151.20
text_mt: One who is not Arka does not remember Arka; one who is not Arka does not worship Arka; / one who is not Arka does not praise Arka; one who is not Arka does not attain Arka.

sanskrit_iast:
sauradharmasya sāro'yaṃ sūryabhaktiḥ suniścalā .
ṣoḍaśāṅgā ca sā proktā raviṇeha divaukasām . . 21
meaning:
सौरधर्मस्य सारोऽयं सूर्यभक्तिः सुनिश्चला .
षोडशाङ्गा च सा प्रोक्ता रविणेह दिवौकसाम् . . 21
text_mt: This is the essence of the Saura duty: unwavering devotion to Sūrya; / and that sixteen-limbed [devotion] was proclaimed here by Ravi to the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
prātaḥ snānaṃ japo homastathā devārcanaṃ nṛpa .
dvijānāṃ pūjanaṃ bhaktyā pūjā gośvatthayostathā . . 22
meaning:
प्रातः स्नानं जपो होमस्तथा देवार्चनं नृप .
द्विजानां पूजनं भक्त्या पूजा गोश्वत्थयोस्तथा . . 22
text_mt: Morning bath, recitation of mantras, fire oblation, and worship of the deity, O king; / worship of twice-borns with devotion, and worship of the cow and the aśvattha tree;

sanskrit_iast:
itihāsapurāṇebhyo bhaktiśraddhāpuraskṛtam .
śravaṇaṃ rājaśārdūla vedābhyāsastathaiva ca . . 23
meaning:
इतिहासपुराणेभ्यो भक्तिश्रद्धापुरस्कृतम् .
श्रवणं राजशार्दूल वेदाभ्यासस्तथैव च . . 23
text_mt: listening to the Itihāsas and Purāṇas accompanied by devotion and faith, / O tiger among kings, and practice of the Veda as well;

sanskrit_iast:
madbhaktyā janavātsalyaṃ pūjāyāṃ cānumodanam .
svayamabhyarcayedbhaktyā mamāgre vācakaṃ param . . 24
meaning:
मद्भक्त्या जनवात्सल्यं पूजायां चानुमोदनम् .
स्वयमभ्यर्चयेद्भक्त्या ममाग्रे वाचकं परम् . . 24
text_mt: affection toward people on account of devotion to me, and rejoicing in worship; / one should oneself worship with devotion the supreme reciter before me;

sanskrit_iast:
pustakasya sadā śreṣṭha mamātīva priyaṃ surāḥ .
matkathāśravaṇaṃ nityaṃ svaranetrāṅgavikriyā . . 25
meaning:
पुस्तकस्य सदा श्रेष्ठ ममातीव प्रियं सुराः .
मत्कथाश्रवणं नित्यं स्वरनेत्राङ्गविक्रिया . . 25
text_mt: [worship] of the book, O best one, is always exceedingly dear to me, O gods; / constant listening to my stories; emotional alteration of voice, eyes, and limbs;

sanskrit_iast:
mamānusmaraṇaṃ nityaṃ bhaktyā śraddhāpuraskṛtam .
ṣoḍaśāḍgā bhaktiriyaṃ yasminmlecche'pi vartate . .
viprendraḥ sa muniḥ śrīmānsajātyaḥ sa ca paṇḍitaḥ . . 26
meaning:
ममानुस्मरणं नित्यं भक्त्या श्रद्धापुरस्कृतम् .
षोडशाड्गा भक्तिरियं यस्मिन्म्लेच्छेऽपि वर्तते . .
विप्रेन्द्रः स मुनिः श्रीमान्सजात्यः स च पण्डितः . . 26
text_mt: and constant remembrance of me accompanied by devotion and faith. / Even if this sixteen-limbed devotion exists in a mleccha, / he is a chief of twice-borns, he is a sage, he is prosperous, he is an equal in caste, and he is a learned man.

sanskrit_iast:
na me pṛthakcaturvedā madbhaktaḥ śvapaco'pi yaḥ .
tasmai deyaṃ tato grāhyaṃ sa ca pūjyo yathā hyaham . . 27
meaning:
न मे पृथक्चतुर्वेदा मद्भक्तः श्वपचोऽपि यः .
तस्मै देयं ततो ग्राह्यं स च पूज्यो यथा ह्यहम् . . 27
text_mt: To me, those who know the four Vedas are not different from one who is my devotee, even if he is a dog-cooker; / to him should be given, from him should be accepted, and he is to be worshipped just like me.

sanskrit_iast:
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati .
tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati . . 28
meaning:
पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति .
तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति . . 28
text_mt: Whoever offers me with devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or water— / I am not lost to him, and he is not lost to me.

sanskrit_iast:
yo māṃ sarvagataṃ paśyetsarvaṃ ca mayi saṃsthitam .
tasyāhamāsthito nityaṃ sa ca nityaṃ mayi sthitaḥ . . 29
meaning:
यो मां सर्वगतं पश्येत्सर्वं च मयि संस्थितम् .
तस्याहमास्थितो नित्यं स च नित्यं मयि स्थितः . . 29
text_mt: He who sees me present in all things, and all things situated in me— / I am ever abiding for him, and he is ever abiding in me.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭādaśārdhakakṣāyāḥ paraṃ cāṣṭabhirudbhavaiḥ .
rodhayitvā mahābāho tathā jñānatareṇa tu . . 1.151.30
meaning:
अष्टादशार्धकक्षायाः परं चाष्टभिरुद्भवैः .
रोधयित्वा महाबाहो तथा ज्ञानतरेण तु . . 1.151.30
text_mt: Beyond the ninth enclosure, having blocked [the mind] / with the eight manifestations, O mighty-armed one, and by supreme knowledge,

sanskrit_iast:
durgapālaṃ vijityāśu bhāskarārdhaṃ tu durjayam .
jitvā ca purarājānāṃ mahātejamanaupamam . . 31
meaning:
दुर्गपालं विजित्याशु भास्करार्धं तु दुर्जयम् .
जित्वा च पुरराजानां महातेजमनौपमम् . . 31
text_mt: having quickly conquered the fortress guardian, and having conquered the invincible half of Bhāskara, / and the king of the city, of great splendour and incomparable,

sanskrit_iast:
manasācalayā bhaktyā yo māṃ dhyāyati mānavaḥ .
ahaṃ tameva ciṃtāmi ātmavatsatataṃ naram . . 32
meaning:
मनसाचलया भक्त्या यो मां ध्यायति मानवः .
अहं तमेव चिंतामि आत्मवत्सततं नरम् . . 32
text_mt: the man who meditates on me with an unwavering mind and devotion— / on that very man do I always reflect, as on myself.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sauradharmavarṇanaṃ
nāmaikapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ . 151 .
sūradharmeṣu praśnavarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे सौरधर्मवर्णनं
नामैकपञ्चाशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः . 151 .
सूरधर्मेषु प्रश्नवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the hundred and fifty-first chapter, titled "Description of the Saura Dharma," in the Saptamīkalpa of the Brāhmaparvan in the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa. 151.
Description of the Inquiries Concerning the Duties to the Sun

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
sūre ca durlabhā bhaktirdurlabhaṃ surapūjanam .
sūrāya durlabhaṃ dānaṃ sūrahomaśca durlabhaḥ . . 1
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
सूरे च दुर्लभा भक्तिर्दुर्लभं सुरपूजनम् .
सूराय दुर्लभं दानं सूरहोमश्च दुर्लभः . . 1
text_mt: Sumantu said: / "Devotion to the Sun is rare, worship of the gods is rare; / giving to the Sun is rare, and offering oblations to the Sun is rare.
title: Praśnavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
sudurlabhaṃ raverjñānaṃ tadabhyāso'pi durlabha .
sudurlabhataraṃ jñeyaṃ khaṣolkajñānamuttamam . . 2
meaning:
सुदुर्लभं रवेर्ज्ञानं तदभ्यासोऽपि दुर्लभ .
सुदुर्लभतरं ज्ञेयं खषोल्कज्ञानमुत्तमम् . . 2
text_mt: Exceedingly difficult to attain is knowledge of the Sun, and its practice too is hard to attain; / even more difficult to attain, it should be known, is the supreme knowledge of Khaṣolka.

sanskrit_iast:
sudurlabhataraṃ jñānaṃ sadā vai bhāskarasya tu .
pradakṣiṇāṃ cakraturvai pādau bhaktyā'rkamandire . . 3
meaning:
सुदुर्लभतरं ज्ञानं सदा वै भास्करस्य तु .
प्रदक्षिणां चक्रतुर्वै पादौ भक्त्याऽर्कमन्दिरे . . 3
text_mt: Ever indeed is knowledge of the Sun exceedingly difficult to attain. / Blessed are the two feet that have performed circumambulation with devotion in the temple of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tau karau ślāghyatāṃ prāptau yau pūjāṃ cakratū raveḥ .
saivaikā rasanā dhanyā stotraṃ yā kurute raveḥ . . 4
meaning:
तौ करौ श्लाघ्यतां प्राप्तौ यौ पूजां चक्रतू रवेः .
सैवैका रसना धन्या स्तोत्रं या कुरुते रवेः . . 4
text_mt: Those two hands have attained praiseworthiness that have performed the worship of the Sun; / that tongue alone is blessed which utters praise of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmanaḥ puṇyatāṃ prāptaṃ yaddhitvā viṣayaṃ nṛpa .
niścalā ca raverlīlā nirbhīkā krodhavarjitā . . 5
meaning:
तन्मनः पुण्यतां प्राप्तं यद्धित्वा विषयं नृप .
निश्चला च रवेर्लीला निर्भीका क्रोधवर्जिता . . 5
text_mt: That mind has attained merit, O king, which, abandoning worldly objects, / [remains] motionless, fearless, and free from anger in the sport of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
śatānīka uvāca
sūryārcanavidhiṃ kurvañchrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ .
tvatprasādāddvijaśreṣṭha kautūhalamatīva me . . 6
meaning:
शतानीक उवाच
सूर्यार्चनविधिं कुर्वञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः .
त्वत्प्रसादाद्द्विजश्रेष्ठ कौतूहलमतीव मे . . 6
text_mt:
Śatānīka said:
Performing the rite of worshipping the Sun, I desire to hear [it] as it truly is. / Through your favour, O best of twice-born, my curiosity is very great:

sanskrit_iast:
yatpuṇyaṃ sthāpite sūrye kṛte sūryālaye ca yat .
sammārjane ca yatpuṇyaṃ yatpuṇyamupalepane. . 7
meaning:
यत्पुण्यं स्थापिते सूर्ये कृते सूर्यालये च यत् .
सम्मार्जने च यत्पुण्यं यत्पुण्यमुपलेपने. . 7
text_mt: the merit gained when the Sun is installed, and when an abode for the Sun is built; / the merit gained in sweeping, and the merit gained in smearing [it with cow-dung];

sanskrit_iast:
sthāne kṛte ca yatpuṇyaṃ tathā nīrājane kṛte .
nīlauṣadhipravāpena nṛtyamaṅgalavāditaiḥ . . 8
meaning:
स्थाने कृते च यत्पुण्यं तथा नीराजने कृते .
नीलौषधिप्रवापेन नृत्यमङ्गलवादितैः . . 8
text_mt: the merit gained when the pedestal is made, and likewise when the lustration with lamps is performed / with the scattering of blue medicinal herbs, accompanied by dances and auspicious instruments;

sanskrit_iast:
arghyadānena yatpuṇyaṃ toyasnānena yadbhavet .
pañcāmṛtamayasnāne dadhisnāne ca yatphalam . . 9
meaning:
अर्घ्यदानेन यत्पुण्यं तोयस्नानेन यद्भवेत् .
पञ्चामृतमयस्नाने दधिस्नाने च यत्फलम् . . 9
text_mt: the merit gained by giving water for the arghya, and what comes from bathing [the icon] with water; / the fruit gained from bathing with the five nectars, and from bathing with curds;

sanskrit_iast:
cakrābhyaṅge ca yatproktaṃ vajrasnāne ca yatphalam .
madhusnāne payaḥsnāne snāna ikṣurasasya tu . . 1.152.10
meaning:
चक्राभ्यङ्गे च यत्प्रोक्तं वज्रस्नाने च यत्फलम् .
मधुस्नाने पयःस्नाने स्नान इक्षुरसस्य तु . . 1.152.10
text_mt: and what is declared regarding anointing the discus, and the fruit from bathing [the icon] with vajra; / in bathing with honey, in bathing with milk, and in bathing with sugarcane juice;

sanskrit_iast:
udvartanaṃ śucisthāne kuśapuṣpodakena tu .
suvarṇaratnatoyaiśca gandhacandanavāribhiḥ . . 11
meaning:
उद्वर्तनं शुचिस्थाने कुशपुष्पोदकेन तु .
सुवर्णरत्नतोयैश्च गन्धचन्दनवारिभिः . . 11
text_mt: the rubbing down in a pure place with water of kuśa grass and flowers, / with waters containing gold and jewels, and with fragrant sandalwood water;

sanskrit_iast:
karpūrāgurutoyena svacchato yena yatphalam .
vilepanaiśca gandhāḍhyairvilepanaphalaṃ labhet . . 12
meaning:
कर्पूरागुरुतोयेन स्वच्छतो येन यत्फलम् .
विलेपनैश्च गन्धाढ्यैर्विलेपनफलं लभेत् . . 12
text_mt: and the fruit that one attains from water containing camphor and agallochum, with pure water, / and with ointments rich in fragrances—the fruit of applying ointments;

sanskrit_iast:
tālapatrapradāne tu pradāne cāmarasya tu .
raktapuṣpārcane yacca dāmabhiḥ pūjanena ca . . 13
meaning:
तालपत्रप्रदाने तु प्रदाने चामरस्य तु .
रक्तपुष्पार्चने यच्च दामभिः पूजनेन च . . 13
text_mt: and upon offering a palm leaf, upon offering a chowrie, / upon worshipping with red flowers, and upon worshipping with garlands;

sanskrit_iast:
sumānāṃ maṇḍape yacca puṣpamālāvalambanāt .
pūjābhaktiviśeṣaiśca gṛhamālāvalambane . . 14
meaning:
सुमानां मण्डपे यच्च पुष्पमालावलम्बनात् .
पूजाभक्तिविशेषैश्च गृहमालावलम्बने . . 14
text_mt: and what [is gained] from suspending garlands of flowers in the pavilion for the gods, / and through special acts of devotion and worship, from suspending garlands on the shrine;

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpadānaviśeṣeṇa dhūpadīpaiśca yatphalam .
vastrālaṅkāradāne tu puṇyaśravaṇakīrtane . . 15
meaning:
पुष्पदानविशेषेण धूपदीपैश्च यत्फलम् .
वस्त्रालङ्कारदाने तु पुण्यश्रवणकीर्तने . . 15
text_mt: and the fruit gained through the special gift of flowers, through incense and lamps; / upon giving clothing and ornaments, and in listening to and reciting meritorious deeds;

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaśravasya dāne tu avyaṅgasya ca gopate .
magānāṃ matprasādena abhivādanapūjane . . 16
meaning:
ब्रह्मश्रवस्य दाने तु अव्यङ्गस्य च गोपते .
मगानां मत्प्रसादेन अभिवादनपूजने . . 16
text_mt: and upon giving sacred Vedic hearing and the avyaṅga, O lord of rays, / and in saluting and worshipping the Magas through your favour;

sanskrit_iast:
vyomapūjāphalaṃ yacca aruṇasya ca pūjanam .
tathānyadapi yatproktamajñānādbrāhmaṇottama . . 17
meaning:
व्योमपूजाफलं यच्च अरुणस्य च पूजनम् .
तथान्यदपि यत्प्रोक्तमज्ञानाद्ब्राह्मणोत्तम . . 17
text_mt: and what is the fruit of worshipping space, and the worship of Aruṇa; / and likewise whatever else has been spoken of out of ignorance, O best of Brahmins—

sanskrit_iast: tatsarvaṃ brūhi me brahmanbhaktānāmanukampayā . . 18
meaning: तत्सर्वं ब्रूहि मे ब्रह्मन्भक्तानामनुकम्पया . . 18
text_mt: tell me all that, O Brahmin, out of compassion for the devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi sūradharmeṣu praśnavarṇanaṃ nāma
dvipañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ . 152 .
sūryatejovarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सूरधर्मेषु प्रश्नवर्णनं नाम
द्विपञ्चाशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः . 152 .
सूर्यतेजोवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the hundred and fifty-second chapter, entitled 'Description of the Inquiry regarding the Duties towards the Sun', in the Brāhmaparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Splendour of the Sun

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
sumatiśca raverbhaktaḥ pāṇḍaveya mahāmate .
ataste nikhilaṃ vacmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa . . 1
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
सुमतिश्च रवेर्भक्तः पाण्डवेय महामते .
अतस्ते निखिलं वच्मि शृणुष्वैकमना नृप . . 1
text_mt:
Sumantu said:
Wise and a devotee of the Sun are you, O wise descendant of Pāṇḍu! / Therefore I shall tell you everything; listen with one-pointed mind, O king.
title: Sūryatejovarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
kalpādau sṛjato vīra brahmaṇo vividhāḥ prajāḥ .
ahaṃkāro mahānāsīnnāsti loke maduttamaḥ . . 2
meaning:
कल्पादौ सृजतो वीर ब्रह्मणो विविधाः प्रजाः .
अहंकारो महानासीन्नास्ति लोके मदुत्तमः . . 2
text_mt: At the beginning of the kalpa, O hero, as Brahmā was creating diverse creatures, / a great egotism arose [in him]: 'There is no one in the world superior to me!'

sanskrit_iast:
tathā pālayato vīra keśavasya dharāpate .
tathā saṃharato jajñe'haṅkārastryambakasya ca . . 3
meaning:
तथा पालयतो वीर केशवस्य धरापते .
तथा संहरतो जज्ञेऽहङ्कारस्त्र्यम्बकस्य च . . 3
text_mt: Likewise, O hero, lord of the earth, as Keśava was preserving [the world], / and likewise as Tryambaka was destroying [it], egotism was born [in them].

sanskrit_iast:
ciṃtayantotha te devāḥ keśavaśca narādhipa .
mithaste spardhayā yuktāḥ parasparavirodhinaḥ . . 4
meaning:
चिंतयन्तोथ ते देवाः केशवश्च नराधिप .
मिथस्ते स्पर्धया युक्ताः परस्परविरोधिनः . . 4
text_mt: Then those gods and Keśava, reflecting, O ruler of men, / were filled with rivalry towards one another, opposing each other.

sanskrit_iast:
vivādastu mahānāsītkañjāmbunagaukasām .
parasparaṃ mahābāho manasāśritya kevalam . . 5
meaning:
विवादस्तु महानासीत्कञ्जाम्बुनगौकसाम् .
परस्परं महाबाहो मनसाश्रित्य केवलम् . . 5
text_mt: Indeed, a great dispute arose among those dwellers in the lotus, the waters, and the mountains, / simply by relying on their minds against one another, O mighty-armed one.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ kartā vikartā'haṃ pālako'haṃ jagatprabhuḥ .
ityāha bhagavānbrahmā kṛṣṇabhīmau samarcitau . . 6
meaning:
अहं कर्ता विकर्ताऽहं पालकोऽहं जगत्प्रभुः .
इत्याह भगवान्ब्रह्मा कृष्णभीमौ समर्चितौ . . 6
text_mt: 'I am the creator, I am the transformer, I am the protector, the lord of the universe!' / Thus spoke the blessed Brahmā to Kṛṣṇa and Bhīma, who were worshipped together.

sanskrit_iast:
tathaitya śaṃkaraḥ kruddhaḥ kaḥ śakto madṛte bhuvi .
saṃhartuṃ jagadetaddhi sraṣṭuṃ pālayituṃ tathā . .7
meaning:
तथैत्य शंकरः क्रुद्धः कः शक्तो मदृते भुवि .
संहर्तुं जगदेतद्धि स्रष्टुं पालयितुं तथा . .7
text_mt: Then Śaṅkara, arriving enraged, [said:] 'Who on earth other than me is capable / of destroying this universe, or of creating and preserving it?'

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇo'pyevameva manāk krodhasamanvitaḥ .
na vā śakto jagatsraṣṭuṃ saṃhartuṃ rakṣituṃ tathā . . 8
meaning:
नारायणोऽप्येवमेव मनाक् क्रोधसमन्वितः .
न वा शक्तो जगत्स्रष्टुं संहर्तुं रक्षितुं तथा . . 8
text_mt: Nārāyaṇa also, possessed of slight anger, [spoke] in the very same way: / 'Is anyone else able to create, destroy, or protect the universe?'

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ teṣāṃ pravadatāṃ kruddhānāṃ ca parasparam .
samāviśattadā'jñānaṃ tamo mohātmakaṃ vibho . . 9
meaning:
एवं तेषां प्रवदतां क्रुद्धानां च परस्परम् .
समाविशत्तदाऽज्ञानं तमो मोहात्मकं विभो . . 9
text_mt: As they were speaking thus and enraged at one another, / then, O lord, ignorance—darkness consisting of delusion—entered [them].

sanskrit_iast:
tena krāntadhiyaḥ sarve na paśyanti parasparam .
atyarthaṃ mohamāpannā na jānantīha kiñcana . . 1.153.10
meaning:
तेन क्रान्तधियः सर्वे न पश्यन्ति परस्परम् .
अत्यर्थं मोहमापन्ना न जानन्तीह किञ्चन . . 1.153.10
text_mt: Their minds overcome by it, they could not see one another; / having fallen into extreme delusion, they knew nothing here.

sanskrit_iast:
apaśyanto mithaste tu niṣaṇṇāḥ kṣmātale vibho .
āramanti hi ye cānye te divākaramāsthitāḥ . . 11
meaning:
अपश्यन्तो मिथस्ते तु निषण्णाः क्ष्मातले विभो .
आरमन्ति हि ये चान्ये ते दिवाकरमास्थिताः . . 11
text_mt: Unable to see one another, they sank down upon the surface of the earth, O lord; / and whatever other [beings] took delight, they took refuge in the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tamasā mohitāḥ sarve nidrāvatkrāntacetasaḥ .
manāgjñānena cākrāntāḥ kiṃ kuryāmeti mohitāḥ . . 12
meaning:
तमसा मोहिताः सर्वे निद्रावत्क्रान्तचेतसः .
मनाग्ज्ञानेन चाक्रान्ताः किं कुर्यामेति मोहिताः . . 12
text_mt: All were deluded by darkness, their minds overcome as if by sleep; / overwhelmed with just a glimmer of consciousness, bewildered, [wondering:] 'What should we do?'

sanskrit_iast:
atha bhūtādhipo devo gośrutābharaṇojjvalaḥ .
candrārdhakṛtaśobhastu śītalāṃśuviśodhitaḥ . . 13
meaning:
अथ भूताधिपो देवो गोश्रुताभरणोज्ज्वलः .
चन्द्रार्धकृतशोभस्तु शीतलांशुविशोधितः . . 13
text_mt: Then the god who is the lord of spirits, brilliant with an ornament [bright as] a cow's ear, / adorned with a crescent moon, purified by its cool rays,

sanskrit_iast:
ārtimetya parāṃ vīra mohitastamasā vibho .
apaśyannabravīddevaṃ mādhavaṃ bhūdharaṃ harim . . 14
meaning:
आर्तिमेत्य परां वीर मोहितस्तमसा विभो .
अपश्यन्नब्रवीद्देवं माधवं भूधरं हरिम् . . 14
text_mt: having fallen into supreme distress, O hero, deluded by darkness, O lord, / unable to see, spoke to the god Hari, Mādhava, the upholder of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
mahādeva uvāca
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābāho kva gatastvaṃ mahāmate .
brahmā ca kva gato vīra nāhaṃ paśyāmi vāṃ kvacit . . 15
meaning:
महादेव उवाच
कृष्ण कृष्ण महाबाहो क्व गतस्त्वं महामते .
ब्रह्मा च क्व गतो वीर नाहं पश्यामि वां क्वचित् . . 15
text_mt:
Mahādeva said:
O Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, O mighty-armed one, where have you gone, O wise one? / And where has Brahmā gone, O hero? I do not see you two anywhere!

sanskrit_iast:
mohena mahatāhaṃ vai tamasā ca vimohitaḥ .
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kva cāhamadhunā sthitaḥ . . 16
meaning:
मोहेन महताहं वै तमसा च विमोहितः .
किं करोमि क्व गच्छामि क्व चाहमधुना स्थितः . . 16
text_mt: I am indeed utterly bewildered by great delusion and darkness. / What shall I do? Where shall I go? And where am I standing now?

sanskrit_iast:
kṣmādharaṃ pṛthivīṃ vṛkṣān devagandharvadānavān .
vipulaṃ sāgaraṃ sindhūnnahi paśyāmi kiñcana . . 17
meaning:
क्ष्माधरं पृथिवीं वृक्षान् देवगन्धर्वदानवान् .
विपुलं सागरं सिन्धून्नहि पश्यामि किञ्चन . . 17
text_mt: The mountains, the earth, the trees, the gods, Gandharvas, and Dānavas, / the vast ocean, and the rivers—I see nothing at all!

sanskrit_iast:
kenopāyena paśyeyaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam .
brūhi me devaśārdūla vrīḍā me'tīva jāyate . . 18
meaning:
केनोपायेन पश्येयं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् .
ब्रूहि मे देवशार्दूल व्रीडा मेऽतीव जायते . . 18
text_mt: By what means might I behold the world of stationary and moving beings? / Tell me, O tiger among gods; shame rises within me exceedingly!

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkarasya vacaḥ śrutvā harirvacanamabravīt .
śokagadgadayā vācā tamasā mohito nṛpa . . 19
meaning:
शङ्करस्य वचः श्रुत्वा हरिर्वचनमब्रवीत् .
शोकगद्गदया वाचा तमसा मोहितो नृप . . 19
text_mt: Hearing the words of Śaṅkara, Hari spoke [these] words / with a voice faltering with grief, bewildered by darkness, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuruvāca
bhīma bhīma na jāne'haṃ kva bhavānvartate'dhunā .
mamāpi mohitaṃ cetastamasātīva śaṅkara . . 1.153.20
meaning:
विष्णुरुवाच
भीम भीम न जानेऽहं क्व भवान्वर्ततेऽधुना .
ममापि मोहितं चेतस्तमसातीव शङ्कर . . 1.153.20
text_mt:
Viṣṇu said:
O Bhīma, Bhīma, I do not know where you are now! / My mind too, O Śaṅkara, is utterly bewildered by darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
kva gacchāmi kva tiṣṭhāmi kathaṃ tatsvasthatāṃ vrajet .
tamasā pūritaṃ sarvaṃ jagaddhi parameśvara . . 21
meaning:
क्व गच्छामि क्व तिष्ठामि कथं तत्स्वस्थतां व्रजेत् .
तमसा पूरितं सर्वं जगद्धि परमेश्वर . . 21
text_mt: Where shall I go? Where shall I stand? How might [the mind] regain its composure? / For the entire world, O supreme lord, is filled with darkness!

sanskrit_iast:
yadyasau dṛśyate devaḥ surajyeṣṭho'mbujodbhavaḥ .
pṛcchāvastaṃ mahātmānaṃ yadi te rocate hara . . 22
meaning:
यद्यसौ दृश्यते देवः सुरज्येष्ठोऽम्बुजोद्भवः .
पृच्छावस्तं महात्मानं यदि ते रोचते हर . . 22
text_mt: If that god, the eldest of the gods, born from the lotus, can be seen, / let us ask that great-souled one, if it pleases you, O Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
hitvā darpamahaṅkāraṃ samamāsthāya kevalam .
padmānanaṃ padmayoniṃ padmapatranibhekṣaṇam . . 23
meaning:
हित्वा दर्पमहङ्कारं सममास्थाय केवलम् .
पद्माननं पद्मयोनिं पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणम् . . 23
text_mt: Casting aside pride and egotism, and adopting only equanimity, / [let us ask] him whose face is like a lotus, whose origin is the lotus, whose eyes resemble the petals of a lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ gadato vākyaṃ viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ .
śrutvovāca vibhurbrahmā gaṅgādharamahīdharau . . 24
meaning:
इत्येवं गदतो वाक्यं विष्णोरमिततेजसः .
श्रुत्वोवाच विभुर्ब्रह्मा गङ्गाधरमहीधरौ . . 24
text_mt: Hearing Viṣṇu of boundless splendour speak words in this manner, / the all-pervading Brahmā spoke to the bearer of the Gaṅgā and the upholder of the earth:

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābāho bhīma bhīma mahāmate .
kva bhavantau brūta kiṃ ca kiṃ yuvāmūcathurmithaḥ . . 25
meaning:
कृष्ण कृष्ण महाबाहो भीम भीम महामते .
क्व भवन्तौ ब्रूत किं च किं युवामूचथुर्मिथः . . 25
text_mt: 'O Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, O mighty-armed one! O Bhīma, Bhīma, O wise one! / Where are you two? Speak! What have you two been saying to one another?

sanskrit_iast:
mamātīva manobuddhī tamasā vaśamāgate .
na śṛṇomi na paśyāmi nidrāmohavaśaṃ gataḥ . . 26
meaning:
ममातीव मनोबुद्धी तमसा वशमागते .
न शृणोमि न पश्यामि निद्रामोहवशं गतः . . 26
text_mt: My mind and intellect have completely come under the sway of darkness; / I hear nothing, I see nothing, fallen under the power of sleep and delusion.

sanskrit_iast:
aho bata jagatsarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam .
tamasā vyāṣṭataṃ devau na jāne kva gataṃ mahaḥ . . 27
meaning:
अहो बत जगत्सर्वं सदेवासुरमानुषम् .
तमसा व्याष्टतं देवौ न जाने क्व गतं महः . . 27
text_mt: Alas, the entire universe, with its gods, Asuras, and human beings, / is pervaded by darkness, O two gods! I do not know where the light has gone!'

sanskrit_iast:
atha teṣāṃ pravadatāṃ brahmādīnāṃ divaukasām .
darpakrodhabhayārtānāṃ tamasākrāntacetasām . . 28
meaning:
अथ तेषां प्रवदतां ब्रह्मादीनां दिवौकसाम् .
दर्पक्रोधभयार्तानां तमसाक्रान्तचेतसाम् . . 28
text_mt: Then, as those dwellers of heaven headed by Brahmā were speaking, / afflicted by pride, anger, and fear, their minds overwhelmed by darkness—

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ darpāpahārāya prabodhārthaṃ ca gopateḥ .
tejorūpaṃ samudbhūtamaṣṭaśṛṅgamanaupamam . . 29
meaning:
तेषां दर्पापहाराय प्रबोधार्थं च गोपतेः .
तेजोरूपं समुद्भूतमष्टशृङ्गमनौपमम् . . 29
text_mt:
To take away their pride and to enlighten the lord of cattle,
an incomparable form of splendor arose, possessing eight peaks.

sanskrit_iast:
alakṣyaṃ pāpatamasā mahadvyoma narādhipa .
jvālāmālāvṛtaṃ vīra bahurūpaṃ ca bhāsate . . 1.153.30
meaning:
अलक्ष्यं पापतमसा महद्व्योम नराधिप .
ज्वालामालावृतं वीर बहुरूपं च भासते . . 1.153.30
text_mt:
The vast sky, unperceived because of the evil darkness, O king,
encompassed by garlands of flames, multiform, shone forth, O hero.

sanskrit_iast:
śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ gatamūrdhvaṃ bhramattathā .
gomadhyato mahārāja karṇikevāmbujasya tu . . 31
meaning:
शतयोजनविस्तीर्णं गतमूर्ध्वं भ्रमत्तथा .
गोमध्यतो महाराज कर्णिकेवाम्बुजस्य तु . . 31
text_mt:
Extending for a hundred yojanas, rising upward and whirling,
out from the midst of the rays, O great king, like the pericarp of a lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
prakāśaṃ tejasā tasya jagatsarvamidaṃ nṛpa .
pureṣvantaryathā vīra ambujasyārcibhiḥ sadā . . 32
meaning:
प्रकाशं तेजसा तस्य जगत्सर्वमिदं नृप .
पुरेष्वन्तर्यथा वीर अम्बुजस्यार्चिभिः सदा . . 32
text_mt:
All this world was illumined by its splendor, O king,
just as within lotus cities [it is illumined] continually by rays, O hero.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā parasparaṃ sarve huṅkārādivikāriṇaḥ .
tejasā mohitāstasya jagatsarvamidaṃ nṛpa . . 33
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा परस्परं सर्वे हुङ्कारादिविकारिणः .
तेजसा मोहितास्तस्य जगत्सर्वमिदं नृप . . 33
text_mt:
Seeing one another, they were all overcome with roars and other agitations,
bewildered by its splendor, along with this entire world, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
tejasā mohitaṃ tasya mahadvyoma narādhipa .
tato vismayamāsīnaḥ dṛṣṭagopatayo nṛpa . . 34
meaning:
तेजसा मोहितं तस्य महद्व्योम नराधिप .
ततो विस्मयमासीनः दृष्टगोपतयो नृप . . 34
text_mt:
The vast sky was bewildered by its splendor, O lord of men.
Then, seated in astonishment, seeing the lords of rays, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
paśyamānā maho vyomni mitho vacanamabruvan .
aho tejaḥ samuddhūtamasmākaṃ śreyase nṛpa . . 35
meaning:
पश्यमाना महो व्योम्नि मिथो वचनमब्रुवन् .
अहो तेजः समुद्धूतमस्माकं श्रेयसे नृप . . 35
text_mt:
looking at the splendor in the sky, they spoke words to one another:
"Aha! A splendor has arisen for our welfare, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
prakāśāya ca lokānāṃ sarve paśyāma kiṃ nvidam .
jñānāyordhvaṃ gato brahmā cādhastāttripurāntaka. . . 36
meaning:
प्रकाशाय च लोकानां सर्वे पश्याम किं न्विदम् .
ज्ञानायोर्ध्वं गतो ब्रह्मा चाधस्तात्त्रिपुरान्तक. . . 36
text_mt:
and for the illumination of the worlds! Let us all see: what indeed is this?"
To ascertain it, Brahmā went upward, and the destroyer of Tripura [went] downward.

sanskrit_iast:
tiryagjagāma deveśaścakrāmbujagadādharaḥ .
alabdhvā tasya te sarve pramāṇaṃ gairikādhipāḥ . . 37
meaning:
तिर्यग्जगाम देवेशश्चक्राम्बुजगदाधरः .
अलब्ध्वा तस्य ते सर्वे प्रमाणं गैरिकाधिपाः . . 37
text_mt:
The lord of gods, bearer of the discus, lotus, and mace, went transversely.
Not finding its measure, all those lords of mountains,

sanskrit_iast:
vismayotphullanayanā samāgamya parasparam .
sarve kañjādikā devā idaṃ vacanamabruvan . . 38
meaning:
विस्मयोत्फुल्लनयना समागम्य परस्परम् .
सर्वे कञ्जादिका देवा इदं वचनमब्रुवन् . . 38
text_mt:
with eyes wide open in wonder, coming together,
all the gods, beginning with the lotus-born [Brahmā], spoke this word:

sanskrit_iast:
ko'yaṃ kimātmakaścāyaṃ kimidaṃ tejasāṃ nidhiḥ .
aho'sya darśanātsarve sañjātā jñānino vayam . . 39
meaning:
कोऽयं किमात्मकश्चायं किमिदं तेजसां निधिः .
अहोऽस्य दर्शनात्सर्वे सञ्जाता ज्ञानिनो वयम् . . 39
text_mt:
"Who is this? Of what nature is he? What is this treasury of splendors?
Ah, by the sight of him we all have become possessors of knowledge!

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsarve praṇamyainaṃ stuvīmo'dbhutadarśanam .
kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ sarve cāstuvaṃstridivaukasaḥ . . 1.153.40
meaning:
तस्मात्सर्वे प्रणम्यैनं स्तुवीमोऽद्भुतदर्शनम् .
कृताञ्जलिपुटाः सर्वे चास्तुवंस्त्रिदिवौकसः . . 1.153.40
text_mt:
Therefore, having bowed to him, let us all praise this wondrous sight!"
With palms joined in reverence, all the dwellers of heaven praised [him].

sanskrit_iast:
stuvatāmapyathaiteṣāṃ sahasrakiraṇo raviḥ .
ātmānaṃ darśayāmāsa kṛpayā parayā vṛtaḥ . . 41
meaning:
स्तुवतामप्यथैतेषां सहस्रकिरणो रविः .
आत्मानं दर्शयामास कृपया परया वृतः . . 41
text_mt:
And while they were praising him, the thousand-rayed sun,
filled with supreme compassion, revealed himself.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā bhaktiṃ mahābāho brahmādīnāṃ mahopamām .
atha te vyomni deveśaṃ dadṛśuḥ parameśvaram . . 42
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा भक्तिं महाबाहो ब्रह्मादीनां महोपमाम् .
अथ ते व्योम्नि देवेशं ददृशुः परमेश्वरम् . . 42
text_mt:
Recognizing the devotion of Brahmā and the others, O mighty-armed one, to be great,
they then beheld the lord of gods, the supreme lord, in the sky:

sanskrit_iast:
khaṣolkalokanātheśaṃ sahasrakiraṇojjvalam .
kṛttikābhirasaṃspṛṣṭaṃ yadvā tatkārtikāsthitam . . 43
meaning:
खषोल्कलोकनाथेशं सहस्रकिरणोज्ज्वलम् .
कृत्तिकाभिरसंस्पृष्टं यद्वा तत्कार्तिकास्थितम् . . 43
text_mt:
Khaṣolka, the lord and ruler of the worlds, radiant with a thousand rays,
untouched by the Kṛttikās, or abiding in Kārtika,

sanskrit_iast:
durjayaṃ kṛttikānāṃ tu tathaikena vivarjitam .
tathā hastavihīnaṃ ca saptarṣirahitaṃ tathā . . 44
meaning:
दुर्जयं कृत्तिकानां तु तथैकेन विवर्जितम् .
तथा हस्तविहीनं च सप्तर्षिरहितं तथा . . 44
text_mt:
invincible to the Kṛttikās, yet devoid of one;
likewise devoid of Hasta, and devoid of the seven sages,

sanskrit_iast:
varṣābdarahitaṃ devaṃ saptasvaravivarjitam .
sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ caiva sadaikākārarūpiṇam . .45
meaning:
वर्षाब्दरहितं देवं सप्तस्वरविवर्जितम् .
सकलं निष्कलं चैव सदैकाकाररूपिणम् . .45
text_mt:
the god devoid of rain and clouds, devoid of the seven musical notes,
with parts and without parts, having an eternally uniform form.

sanskrit_iast:
taddṛṣṭvānekaśirasamanekacaraṇaṃ tathā .
anekodarabāhvaṃsamanekābharaṇānvitam . .4 6
anekānanamakṣībaṃ sahasrākṣamanaupamam .
anekavarṇarūpaṃ ca anekamukuṭojjvalam . .47
meaning:
तद्दृष्ट्वानेकशिरसमनेकचरणं तथा .
अनेकोदरबाह्वंसमनेकाभरणान्वितम् . .4 6
अनेकाननमक्षीबं सहस्राक्षमनौपमम् .
अनेकवर्णरूपं च अनेकमुकुटोज्ज्वलम् . .47
text_mt:
Having seen that [form] with many heads and many feet,
with many bellies, arms, and shoulders, endowed with many ornaments, / with many faces, not intoxicated, thousand-eyed, incomparable,
of many colors and forms, radiant with many diadems,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvaivaṃ devadevasya rūpaṃ bhānormahātmanaḥ .
vismayotphullanayanāstuṣṭavuste divākaram . . 48
meaning:
दृष्ट्वैवं देवदेवस्य रूपं भानोर्महात्मनः .
विस्मयोत्फुल्लनयनास्तुष्टवुस्ते दिवाकरम् . . 48
text_mt:
having thus seen the form of the god of gods, the great-souled sun,
their eyes wide open in wonder, they praised the maker of day.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā brahmā stotuṃ pracakrame .
praṇamya śirasā bhānumidaṃ vacanamabravīt . . 49
meaning:
कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा ब्रह्मा स्तोतुं प्रचक्रमे .
प्रणम्य शिरसा भानुमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् . . 49
text_mt:
Joining his palms in reverence, Brahmā began to praise him;
bowing his head to the sun, he spoke this word:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
namaste devadeveśa sahasrakiraṇojjvala .
lokadīpa namaste'stu namaste koṇavallabha . . 1.153.50
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
नमस्ते देवदेवेश सहस्रकिरणोज्ज्वल .
लोकदीप नमस्तेऽस्तु नमस्ते कोणवल्लभ . . 1.153.50
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
"Obeisance to you, O lord of the gods of gods, radiant with a thousand rays!
O lamp of the world, obeisance be to you! Obeisance to you, O beloved of Koṇa!

sanskrit_iast:
bhāskarāya namo nityaṃ khaṣolkāya namonamaḥ .
viṣṇave kālacakrāya somāyāmitatejase . . 51
meaning:
भास्कराय नमो नित्यं खषोल्काय नमोनमः .
विष्णवे कालचक्राय सोमायामिततेजसे . . 51
text_mt:
Obeisance perpetually to Bhāskara! Obeisance, obeisance to Khaṣolka,
to Viṣṇu, to the wheel of time, to Soma of boundless splendor!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste pañcakālāya indrāya vasuretase .
khagāya lokanāthāya ekacakrarathāya ca . . 52
meaning:
नमस्ते पञ्चकालाय इन्द्राय वसुरेतसे .
खगाय लोकनाथाय एकचक्ररथाय च . . 52
text_mt:
Obeisance to you, the five periods of time, to Indra, whose seed is Vasu,
to the sky-traveler, the lord of the world, and whose chariot has a single wheel!

sanskrit_iast:
jagaddhitāya devāya śivāyāmitatejase .
tamoghnāya surūpāya tejasāṃ nidhaye namaḥ . . 53
meaning:
जगद्धिताय देवाय शिवायामिततेजसे .
तमोघ्नाय सुरूपाय तेजसां निधये नमः . . 53
text_mt:
To the god who works the welfare of the world, to Śiva of boundless splendor,
to the destroyer of darkness, the handsome one, obeisance to the treasury of splendors!

sanskrit_iast:
arthāya kāmarūpāya dharmāyāmitatejase .
mokṣāya mokṣarūpāya sūryāya ca namonamaḥ . . 54
meaning:
अर्थाय कामरूपाय धर्मायामिततेजसे .
मोक्षाय मोक्षरूपाय सूर्याय च नमोनमः . . 54
text_mt:
To wealth, to the one whose form is desire, to dharma of boundless splendor,
to liberation, to the embodiment of liberation, and to Sūrya, obeisance, obeisance!

sanskrit_iast:
krodhalobhavihīnāya lokānāṃ sthitihetave .
śubhāya śubharūpāya śubhadāya śubhātmane . . 55
meaning:
क्रोधलोभविहीनाय लोकानां स्थितिहेतवे .
शुभाय शुभरूपाय शुभदाय शुभात्मने . . 55
text_mt:
To the one free from anger and greed, the cause of the stability of the worlds,
to the auspicious, the auspicious-formed, the giver of auspiciousness, the auspicious self!

sanskrit_iast:
śāntāya śāntarūpāya śāntaye'smāsu vai namaḥ .
namaste brahmarūpāya brāhmaṇāya namonamaḥ . . 56
meaning:
शान्ताय शान्तरूपाय शान्तयेऽस्मासु वै नमः .
नमस्ते ब्रह्मरूपाय ब्राह्मणाय नमोनमः . . 56
text_mt:
To the peaceful, the peaceful-formed, to the peace within us, indeed, obeisance!
Obeisance to you whose form is Brahman, obeisance, obeisance to the Brāhmaṇa!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmadevāya brahmarūpāya brahmaṇe paramātmane .
brahmaṇe ca prasādaṃ vai kuru deva jagatpate . . 57
meaning:
ब्रह्मदेवाय ब्रह्मरूपाय ब्रह्मणे परमात्मने .
ब्रह्मणे च प्रसादं वै कुरु देव जगत्पते . . 57
text_mt:
To the god of Brahmā, whose form is Brahman, to Brahman, the supreme self;
and grant grace to Brahmā, O god, O lord of the universe!"

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ stutvā raviṃ brahmā śraddhayā parayā vibho .
tūṣṇīmāsīnmahābhāga prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā . . 58
meaning:
एवं स्तुत्वा रविं ब्रह्मा श्रद्धया परया विभो .
तूष्णीमासीन्महाभाग प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना . . 58
text_mt:
Having thus praised the sun with supreme faith, O all-pervading one,
Brahmā remained silent, O fortunate one, with an inner self exceedingly delighted.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇo'nantaraṃ rudraḥ stotraṃ cakre vibhāvasoḥ .
tripurārirmahātejāḥ praṇamya śirasā ravim ..59
meaning:
ब्रह्मणोऽनन्तरं रुद्रः स्तोत्रं चक्रे विभावसोः .
त्रिपुरारिर्महातेजाः प्रणम्य शिरसा रविम् ..59
text_mt:
After Brahmā, Rudra composed a hymn of praise to the luminous one;
the foe of Tripura, of great splendor, bowed his head to the sun:

sanskrit_iast:
mahādeva uvāca
jaya bhāva jayājeya jaya haṃsa divākara .
jaya śambho mahābāho khaga gocara bhūdhara ..1.153.60
meaning:
महादेव उवाच
जय भाव जयाजेय जय हंस दिवाकर .
जय शम्भो महाबाहो खग गोचर भूधर ..1.153.60
text_mt:
Mahādeva said:
"Victory, O source of existence! Victory, O unconquerable one! Victory, O swan, O day-maker!
Victory, O Śambhu, O mighty-armed one, sky-traveler, sphere of the rays, supporter of the earth!

sanskrit_iast:
jaya lokapradīpena jaya bhāno jagatpate .
jaya kāla jayānanta saṃvatsara śubhānana ..6 1
jaya devāditeḥ putra kaśyapānandavardhana .
tamoghna jaya sapteśa jaya saptāśvavāhana ..62
meaning:
जय लोकप्रदीपेन जय भानो जगत्पते .
जय काल जयानन्त संवत्सर शुभानन ..6 1
जय देवादितेः पुत्र कश्यपानन्दवर्धन .
तमोघ्न जय सप्तेश जय सप्ताश्ववाहन ..62
text_mt:
Victory through the lamp of the world! Victory, O sun, O lord of the universe!
Victory, O time! Victory, O endless one, year, auspicious-faced one! / Victory, O son of divine Aditi, increaser of the joy of Kaśyapa!
O destroyer of darkness, victory, O lord of the seven! Victory, O you whose mount is seven horses!

sanskrit_iast:
maheśa jaya kāntīśa jaya kāleśa śaṅkara .
arthakāmeśa dharmeśa jaya mokṣeśa śarmada ..63
meaning:
महेश जय कान्तीश जय कालेश शङ्कर .
अर्थकामेश धर्मेश जय मोक्षेश शर्मद ..63
text_mt:
O great lord, victory, O lord of splendor! Victory, O lord of time, O Śaṅkara!
O lord of wealth and desire, lord of dharma! Victory, O lord of liberation, bestower of happiness!

sanskrit_iast:
jaya vedāṅgarūpāya graharūpāya vai namaḥ .
satyāya satyarūpāya surūpāya śubhāya ca ..64
meaning:
जय वेदाङ्गरूपाय ग्रहरूपाय वै नमः .
सत्याय सत्यरूपाय सुरूपाय शुभाय च ..64
text_mt:
Victory to the embodiment of the Vedāṅgas! Obeisance indeed to the embodiment of the planets,
to truth, to the embodiment of truth, to the handsome and the auspicious one!

sanskrit_iast:
krodhalobhavināśāya kāmanāśāya vai jaya .
kalmāṣapakṣirūpāya yatirūpāya śambhave ..65
meaning:
क्रोधलोभविनाशाय कामनाशाय वै जय .
कल्माषपक्षिरूपाय यतिरूपाय शम्भवे ..65
text_mt:
Victory indeed to the destroyer of anger and greed, to the destroyer of desire,
to the one in the form of the spotted bird, the one in the form of an ascetic, to Śambhu!

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāya viśvarūpāya viśvakarmāya vai jaya .
jayoṅkāra vaṣaṭkāra svāhākāra svadhāmaya ..66
meaning:
विश्वाय विश्वरूपाय विश्वकर्माय वै जय .
जयोङ्कार वषट्कार स्वाहाकार स्वधामय ..66
text_mt:
Victory indeed to the all, to the embodiment of the all, to Viśvakarman!
Victory, O Oṃkāra, Vaṣaṭkāra, Svāhākāra, you whose essence is Svadhā!

sanskrit_iast:
jayāśvamedharūpāya cāgnirūpāryamāya ca .
saṃsārārṇavapītāya mokṣadvārapradāya ca ..67
meaning:
जयाश्वमेधरूपाय चाग्निरूपार्यमाय च .
संसारार्णवपीताय मोक्षद्वारप्रदाय च ..67
text_mt:
Victory to the embodiment of the horse-sacrifice, and to Aryaman whose form is fire,
to the one who has drunk the ocean of worldly existence, and to the bestower of the door of liberation!

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsārārṇavamagnasya mama deva jagatpate .
hastāvalambano deva bhava tvaṃ gopate'dbhuta ..68
meaning:
संसारार्णवमग्नस्य मम देव जगत्पते .
हस्तावलम्बनो देव भव त्वं गोपतेऽद्भुत ..68
text_mt:
For me, sunken in the ocean of worldly existence, O god, O lord of the universe,
become a support of the hand, O god, O wondrous lord of rays!

sanskrit_iast:
īśo'pyevamahīnāṅgaṃ stutvā bhānuṃ prayatnataḥ .
virarāma mahārāja praṇamya śirasā ravim ..69
meaning:
ईशोऽप्येवमहीनाङ्गं स्तुत्वा भानुं प्रयत्नतः .
विरराम महाराज प्रणम्य शिरसा रविम् ..69
text_mt:
Having thus assiduously praised the sun who has flawless limbs,
Īśa too ceased, O great king, having bowed his head to the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
atha viṣṇurmahātejāḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭo ravim .
uvāca rājaśārdūla bhaktyā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..1.153.70
meaning:
अथ विष्णुर्महातेजाः कृताञ्जलिपुटो रविम् .
उवाच राजशार्दूल भक्त्या श्रद्धासमन्वितः ..1.153.70
text_mt:
Then Viṣṇu of great splendor, with joined palms, spoke to the sun,
O tiger among kings, endowed with devotion and faith:

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuruvāca
namāmi devadeveśaṃ bhūtabhāvanamavyayam .
divākaraṃ raviṃ bhānuṃ mārtaṇḍaṃ bhāskaraṃ bhagam ..71
meaning:
विष्णुरुवाच
नमामि देवदेवेशं भूतभावनमव्ययम् .
दिवाकरं रविं भानुं मार्तण्डं भास्करं भगम् ..71
text_mt:
Viṣṇu said:
"I bow to the lord of the gods of gods, the source of beings, the imperishable,
the day-maker, Ravi, Bhānu, Mārtaṇḍa, Bhāskara, Bhaga,

sanskrit_iast:
indraṃ viṣṇuṃ hariṃ haṃsamarkaṃ lokaguruṃ vibhum .
trinetraṃ tryakṣaraṃ tryaṅgaṃ trimūrtiṃ trigatiṃ śubham . .72
meaning:
इन्द्रं विष्णुं हरिं हंसमर्कं लोकगुरुं विभुम् .
त्रिनेत्रं त्र्यक्षरं त्र्यङ्गं त्रिमूर्तिं त्रिगतिं शुभम् . .72
text_mt:
Indra, Viṣṇu, Hari, the swan, Arka, the teacher of the world, the all-pervading one,
three-eyed, three-syllabled, three-limbed, three-formed, of threefold course, the auspicious one.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṇmukhāya namo nityaṃ trinetrāya namonamaḥ .
caturviṃśatipādāya namo dvādaśapāṇaye . 73 .
meaning:
षण्मुखाय नमो नित्यं त्रिनेत्राय नमोनमः .
चतुर्विंशतिपादाय नमो द्वादशपाणये . 73 .
text_mt:
Obeisance perpetually to the six-faced one! Obeisance, obeisance to the three-eyed one!
Obeisance to the one with twenty-four feet! Obeisance to the twelve-handed one!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste bhūtapataye lokānāṃ pataye namaḥ .
devānāṃ pataye nityaṃ varṇānāṃ pataye namaḥ . .74
meaning:
नमस्ते भूतपतये लोकानां पतये नमः .
देवानां पतये नित्यं वर्णानां पतये नमः . .74
text_mt:
Obeisance to you, the lord of beings! Obeisance to the lord of the worlds!
Obeisance perpetually to the lord of the gods! Obeisance to the lord of the social classes!

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ brahmā tvaṃ jagannātho rudrastvaṃ ca prajāpatiḥ .
tvaṃ somastvaṃ tathādityastvamoṃkāraka eva hi . . 75
meaning:
त्वं ब्रह्मा त्वं जगन्नाथो रुद्रस्त्वं च प्रजापतिः .
त्वं सोमस्त्वं तथादित्यस्त्वमोंकारक एव हि . . 75
text_mt:
You are Brahmā, you are the lord of the universe, and you are Rudra, Prajāpati;
you are Soma, and likewise you are Āditya; you are indeed Oṃkāra itself."

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatirbudhastvaṃ hi tvaṃ śukrastvaṃ vibhāvasuḥ .
yamastvaṃ varuṇastvaṃ hi namaste kaśyapātmaja . . 76
meaning:
बृहस्पतिर्बुधस्त्वं हि त्वं शुक्रस्त्वं विभावसुः .
यमस्त्वं वरुणस्त्वं हि नमस्ते कश्यपात्मज . . 76
text_mt: You indeed are Bṛhaspati, you are Budha, you are Śukra, you are Vibhāvasu; / you are Yama, you are Varuṇa; homage to you, O son of Kaśyapa!

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā tatamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam .
tvatta eva samutpannaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam . . 77
meaning:
त्वया ततमिदं सर्वं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् .
त्वत्त एव समुत्पन्नं सदेवासुरमानुषम् . . 77
text_mt: By you is all this universe pervaded, both moving and unmoving; / from you alone has it arisen, together with gods, asuras, and mortals.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā cāhaṃ ca rudraśca samutpannā jagatpate .
kalpādau tu purā deva sthitaye jagato'nagha . . 78
meaning:
ब्रह्मा चाहं च रुद्रश्च समुत्पन्ना जगत्पते .
कल्पादौ तु पुरा देव स्थितये जगतोऽनघ . . 78
text_mt: Brahmā, myself, and Rudra have also arisen, O Lord of the universe, / at the beginning of the kalpa long ago, O sinless god, for the preservation of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
namaste vedarūpāya ahorūpāya vai namaḥ .
namaste jñānarūpāya yajñāya ca namonamaḥ . .79
meaning:
नमस्ते वेदरूपाय अहोरूपाय वै नमः .
नमस्ते ज्ञानरूपाय यज्ञाय च नमोनमः . .79
text_mt: Homage to you whose form is the Veda, homage indeed to you whose form is the day; / homage to you whose form is knowledge, and homage, homage to sacrifice!

sanskrit_iast:
prasīdāsmāsu deveśa bhūteśa kiraṇojjvala .
saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ prasādaṃ kuru gopate . .1.153.80
meaning:
प्रसीदास्मासु देवेश भूतेश किरणोज्ज्वल .
संसारार्णवमग्नानां प्रसादं कुरु गोपते . .1.153.80
text_mt: Be gracious to us, O Lord of gods, Lord of beings, radiant with rays; / grant your grace, O Lord of rays, to those immersed in the ocean of saṃsāra!

sanskrit_iast:
vedāntāya namo nityaṃ namo yajñakalāya ca . .
sumanturuvāca
stutvaivaṃ bhāskaraṃ bhaktyā viṣṇurbharatasattama .
pradadhyau nṛpaśārdūla raviṃ tadgatamānasaḥ . 81
meaning:
वेदान्ताय नमो नित्यं नमो यज्ञकलाय च . .
सुमन्तुरुवाच
स्तुत्वैवं भास्करं भक्त्या विष्णुर्भरतसत्तम .
प्रदध्यौ नृपशार्दूल रविं तद्गतमानसः . 81
text_mt: Homage continually to the culmination of the Vedas, and homage to the portion of sacrifice! / Sumantu said: / Having thus praised the sun with devotion, O best of Bharatas, / Viṣṇu meditated upon the sun, O tiger among kings, with mind fixed on him.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ te naraśārdūla devā brahmādayo'nagha .
stuvanti taṃ mahātmānaṃ sahasrakiraṇaṃ ravim . . 82
meaning:
एवं ते नरशार्दूल देवा ब्रह्मादयोऽनघ .
स्तुवन्ति तं महात्मानं सहस्रकिरणं रविम् . . 82
text_mt: In this manner, O tiger among men, those gods led by Brahmā, O sinless one, / praised that great-souled, thousand-rayed sun.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ stuvatāṃ teṣāṃ raviṃ bhaktyā mahātmanām .
atha tuṣṭo ravisteṣāṃ brahmadīnāṃ jagatpatiḥ . 83
meaning:
इत्येवं स्तुवतां तेषां रविं भक्त्या महात्मनाम् .
अथ तुष्टो रविस्तेषां ब्रह्मदीनां जगत्पतिः . 83
text_mt: As those great-souled ones thus praised the sun with devotion, / the sun, the Lord of the universe, was pleased with them, led by Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
vijñāya bhaktiṃ paramāṃ śraddhāṃ ca paramāṃ vibhuḥ .
uvāca sa mahātejāḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā .84
meaning:
विज्ञाय भक्तिं परमां श्रद्धां च परमां विभुः .
उवाच स महातेजाः प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना .84
text_mt: Recognising their supreme devotion and supreme faith, the all-pervading, / immensely resplendent lord spoke with a rejoicing inner soul.

sanskrit_iast:
graheśo vyoma cārūḍhastejasā prajvalandiśaḥ .
brahmāṇaṃ viṣṇumīśānamāmantryaitānviśāṃpate . .85
meaning:
ग्रहेशो व्योम चारूढस्तेजसा प्रज्वलन्दिशः .
ब्रह्माणं विष्णुमीशानमामन्त्र्यैतान्विशांपते . .85
text_mt: The Lord of the planets, mounted in the sky, setting all directions ablaze with splendour, / addressed Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Īśāna, O ruler of people,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tānpraṇatāntsarvāñchirobhiravaniṃ gatān .
tuṣṭo'smi te surajyeṣṭha caturmukha jagatpate . .
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te manasā tvaṃ yadicchasi ..86
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तान्प्रणतान्त्सर्वाञ्छिरोभिरवनिं गतान् .
तुष्टोऽस्मि ते सुरज्येष्ठ चतुर्मुख जगत्पते . .
वरं वरय भद्रं ते मनसा त्वं यदिच्छसि ..86
text_mt: Seeing them all bowed down, touching the earth with their heads: / “I am pleased with you, O eldest of the gods, four-faced Lord of the universe; / choose a boon—may it be well with you—whatever you desire in your mind.”

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā tu vacanaṃ bhānorbrahmā lokagururnṛpa .
jagāma śirasā bhūmāvuvāca sa kṛtāñjaliḥ ..87
meaning:
कृत्वा तु वचनं भानोर्ब्रह्मा लोकगुरुर्नृप .
जगाम शिरसा भूमावुवाच स कृताञ्जलिः ..87
text_mt: Accepting the words of the sun, O king, Brahmā, the guru of the worlds, / went to the ground with his head and, folding his hands, said:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
kṛtakṛtyo'smi deveśa pūtaścāsmi khagādhipa .
dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi gato'smi paramāṃ gatim . .88
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
कृतकृत्योऽस्मि देवेश पूतश्चास्मि खगाधिप .
धन्योऽस्म्यनुगृहीतोऽस्मि गतोऽस्मि परमां गतिम् . .88
text_mt: Brahmā said: / “My purpose is fulfilled, O Lord of gods; I am purified, O Lord of the sky-goers; / I am blessed, I am favoured, I have attained the supreme goal,

sanskrit_iast: sahasrakiraṇairyanme bhavāndarśanamāgataḥ ..89
meaning: सहस्रकिरणैर्यन्मे भवान्दर्शनमागतः ..89
text_mt: in that you, with your thousand rays, have come into my sight.

sanskrit_iast:
apaśyataśca deveśa mūḍhamāsīnmano mama .
bhagavansamprasīda tvaṃ mamopari vibhāvaso . .1.153.9 0
prayaccha tvaṃ balaṃ bhaktimātmano mama gopate .
gatvā śirobhiravanimaṣṭāṅgaiḥ patitasya ca . .
bhaktyā vijñaptimākarṇya prasādaṃ kuru gopate . . 91
meaning:
अपश्यतश्च देवेश मूढमासीन्मनो मम .
भगवन्सम्प्रसीद त्वं ममोपरि विभावसो . .1.153.9 0
प्रयच्छ त्वं बलं भक्तिमात्मनो मम गोपते .
गत्वा शिरोभिरवनिमष्टाङ्गैः पतितस्य च . .
भक्त्या विज्ञप्तिमाकर्ण्य प्रसादं कुरु गोपते . . 91
text_mt: Not seeing you, O Lord of gods, my mind was bewildered. / O Lord, be fully gracious unto me, O Vibhāvasu! / Grant strength, and devotion to yourself, unto me, O Lord of rays! / To one who has touched the earth with his head and fallen with eight limbs, / hearing my petition made with devotion, grant your grace, O Lord of rays!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā pūṣā devo jagatpatiḥ .
tathetyāha mahārāja virāṭa praśrayānvitam . . 92
meaning:
ब्रह्मणो वचनं श्रुत्वा पूषा देवो जगत्पतिः .
तथेत्याह महाराज विराट प्रश्रयान्वितम् . . 92
text_mt: Hearing the words of Brahmā, the divine Pūṣan, Lord of the universe, / said ‘So be it,’ O great king, with majestic reverence.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇe ca varaṃ dattvā rājandevo divākaraḥ .
uvāca tryambakaṃ devaṃ śaśāṅkakṛtaśekharam . . 93
meaning:
ब्रह्मणे च वरं दत्त्वा राजन्देवो दिवाकरः .
उवाच त्र्यम्बकं देवं शशाङ्ककृतशेखरम् . . 93
text_mt: Having granted the boon to Brahmā, O king, the divine maker of day / spoke to the god Tryambaka, whose crest is adorned by the crescent moon:

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ varaya bhūteśa bhūbhṛjjādayitānagha .
yamicchasi mahādeva dade'haṃ tadaśeṣataḥ . . 94
meaning:
वरं वरय भूतेश भूभृज्जादयितानघ .
यमिच्छसि महादेव ददेऽहं तदशेषतः . . 94
text_mt: “Choose a boon, O Lord of beings, beloved of the mountain’s daughter, O sinless one! / Whatever you desire, O Mahādeva, I grant entirely.”

sanskrit_iast:
bhāskarasya vacaḥ śrutvā īśvarastripurāntaka .
gatvā tu śirasā bhūmau praṇamyovāca bhāskaram . . 95
meaning:
भास्करस्य वचः श्रुत्वा ईश्वरस्त्रिपुरान्तक .
गत्वा तु शिरसा भूमौ प्रणम्योवाच भास्करम् . . 95
text_mt: Hearing the words of the sun, Īśvara, the destroyer of Tripura, / touched the ground with his head, bowed, and addressed the sun:

sanskrit_iast:
mahādeva uvāca
puṇyo'haṃ puṇyakarmāhaṃ nāsti dhanyataro mama .
gato'haṃ paramāṃ siddhiṃ gataśca paramāṃ gatim . . 96
meaning:
महादेव उवाच
पुण्योऽहं पुण्यकर्माहं नास्ति धन्यतरो मम .
गतोऽहं परमां सिद्धिं गतश्च परमां गतिम् . . 96
text_mt: Mahādeva said: / “I am meritorious, I have performed holy deeds; no one is more blessed than I; / I have reached supreme perfection, and I have attained the supreme goal.

sanskrit_iast:
nāprāpyamasti deveśa nāsādhyaṃ mama kiṃcana .
yasya me bhagavāndevaḥ prasādapravaṇaḥ sthitaḥ . . 97
meaning:
नाप्राप्यमस्ति देवेश नासाध्यं मम किंचन .
यस्य मे भगवान्देवः प्रसादप्रवणः स्थितः . . 97
text_mt: Nothing is unattainable for me, O Lord of gods, nothing is impossible for me, / for whom the divine Lord stands inclined to grant grace.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā tatamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam .
tvatta eva samutpannaṃ layaṃ ca tvayi yāsyati . . 98
meaning:
त्वया ततमिदं सर्वं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् .
त्वत्त एव समुत्पन्नं लयं च त्वयि यास्यति . . 98
text_mt: By you is all this universe pervaded, both moving and unmoving; / from you alone has it arisen, and into you it shall dissolve.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi tuṣṭo mama vibho anugrāhyo'smi te yadi .
acalāṃ dehi me bhaktimātmanaścaraṇaṃ naya . . 99
meaning:
यदि तुष्टो मम विभो अनुग्राह्योऽस्मि ते यदि .
अचलां देहि मे भक्तिमात्मनश्चरणं नय . . 99
text_mt: If you are pleased with me, O all-pervading lord, if I am worthy of your favour, / grant me unswerving devotion and lead me to your feet.”

sanskrit_iast:
vyomakeśavacaḥ śrutvā pūṣā devo divākaraḥ .
tathetyāha haraṃ vīra tato harimuvāca . . 1.153.100
meaning:
व्योमकेशवचः श्रुत्वा पूषा देवो दिवाकरः .
तथेत्याह हरं वीर ततो हरिमुवाच . . 1.153.100
text_mt: Hearing the words of Vyomakeśa, the divine Pūṣan, the maker of day, / said ‘So be it’ to Hara, O hero, and then addressed Hari:

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa mahābāho varaṃ varaya godhara .
parituṣṭo'smi te deva yamicchasi mahābala . . 101
meaning:
नारायण महाबाहो वरं वरय गोधर .
परितुष्टोऽस्मि ते देव यमिच्छसि महाबल . . 101
text_mt: “O Nārāyaṇa of mighty arms, O supporter of the earth, choose a boon! / I am exceedingly pleased with you, O god; choose whatever you desire, O one of mighty strength!”

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā tu bhāskaravacaḥ kīlālajanako hariḥ .
uvāca parayā bhaktyā natvā ca śirasā ravim . . 102
meaning:
श्रुत्वा तु भास्करवचः कीलालजनको हरिः .
उवाच परया भक्त्या नत्वा च शिरसा रविम् . . 102
text_mt: Hearing the words of the sun, Hari, the progenitor of the waters, / spoke with supreme devotion, bowing with his head to the sun:

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca
jaya deva jagannātha jaya deva guro rave .
prasīda mama deveśa bhaktiṃ yacchātmano rave . . 103
meaning:
नारायण उवाच
जय देव जगन्नाथ जय देव गुरो रवे .
प्रसीद मम देवेश भक्तिं यच्छात्मनो रवे . . 103
text_mt: Nārāyaṇa said: / “Hail, O divine Lord of the universe! Hail, O divine guru, O Sun! / Be gracious to me, O Lord of gods; grant me devotion to yourself, O Sun,

sanskrit_iast:
yenāhaṃ sarvadevānāmuttamaḥ syāṃ jagatpate .
ajeyaśca tathā deva daityadānavarakṣasām . . 104
meaning:
येनाहं सर्वदेवानामुत्तमः स्यां जगत्पते .
अजेयश्च तथा देव दैत्यदानवरक्षसाम् . . 104
text_mt: so that I may become foremost among all gods, O Lord of the universe, / and also invincible, O god, to daityas, dānavas, and rākṣasas.

sanskrit_iast:
tvadbhaktyā bṛṃhitabalastejasā mahatānvitaḥ .
tato mayā mahatkarma kartavyaṃ tava śāsanāt . . 105
meaning:
त्वद्भक्त्या बृंहितबलस्तेजसा महतान्वितः .
ततो मया महत्कर्म कर्तव्यं तव शासनात् . . 105
text_mt: Strengthened in might through devotion to you, endowed with great splendour, / I must then perform a great task by your command:

sanskrit_iast:
prajānāṃ pālanaṃ deva devānāṃ ca grahādhipa .
varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ ca varṇadharmasya vā vibho . . 106
meaning:
प्रजानां पालनं देव देवानां च ग्रहाधिप .
वर्णानामाश्रमाणां च वर्णधर्मस्य वा विभो . . 106
text_mt: the protection of creatures, O god, and of the gods, O Lord of planets, / and of the varnas and āśramas, and of the varna duties, O all-pervading lord.

sanskrit_iast:
duṣṭadaityavināśāya lokānāṃ pālanāya ca .
sṛṣṭo'haṃ bhavatā pūrvaṃ kalpādau ca kṛto'nagha . . 107
meaning:
दुष्टदैत्यविनाशाय लोकानां पालनाय च .
सृष्टोऽहं भवता पूर्वं कल्पादौ च कृतोऽनघ . . 107
text_mt: For the destruction of wicked daityas and for the protection of the worlds, / I was created by you long ago and ordained at the beginning of the kalpa, O sinless one.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya ruṣṭo bhavānsyādvai kathañcitpuruṣasya tu .
vyādhirduḥkhaṃ manorogaṃ dāridryaṃ santatikṣayaḥ . . 108
meaning:
यस्य रुष्टो भवान्स्याद्वै कथञ्चित्पुरुषस्य तु .
व्याधिर्दुःखं मनोरोगं दारिद्र्यं सन्ततिक्षयः . . 108
text_mt: For whatever person you might become angry with in any way, / disease, sorrow, mental affliction, poverty, and loss of offspring—

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaitāni bhavantīha ādhayo vividhāstathā .
tasmāttvaṃ ca tato deva saṃstavyaḥ satataṃ budhaiḥ . . 109
meaning:
तस्यैतानि भवन्तीह आधयो विविधास्तथा .
तस्मात्त्वं च ततो देव संस्तव्यः सततं बुधैः . . 109
text_mt: these come upon him here, as well as various anxieties; / therefore, O god, you should be constantly praised by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tvāṃ gopate deva bhaktyā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ .
ahamarcitumicchāmi tasmānmayi kṛpāṃ kuru . . 1.153.110
meaning:
एवं त्वां गोपते देव भक्त्या श्रद्धासमन्वितः .
अहमर्चितुमिच्छामि तस्मान्मयि कृपां कुरु . . 1.153.110
text_mt: Thus, O Lord of rays, O god, endowed with faith and devotion, / I desire to worship you; therefore, show compassion to me.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sauradharme sūryatejovarṇanaṃ
nāma tripañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ . 153 .
trayī-upākhyānavarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे सौरधर्मे सूर्यतेजोवर्णनं
नाम त्रिपञ्चाशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः . 153 .
त्रयी-उपाख्यानवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the hundred and fifty-third chapter, entitled ‘The Description of the Splendour of Sūrya,’ in the Saura-dharma of the Saptamīkalpa, in the Brāhmaparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa. 153.
Description of the Narrative of the Three Vedas

sanskrit_iast:
sumanturuvāca
śrutvā tu vacanaṃ bhānurviṣṇoramitatejasaḥ .
uvāca kuruśārdūla ādityaḥ kṛpayānvitaḥ . . 1
meaning:
सुमन्तुरुवाच
श्रुत्वा तु वचनं भानुर्विष्णोरमिततेजसः .
उवाच कुरुशार्दूल आदित्यः कृपयान्वितः . . 1
text_mt: Sumantu said: / Hearing the words of Viṣṇu of boundless splendour, / the Sun, Āditya, filled with compassion, spoke, O tiger among Kurus:
title: adhyāyaḥ 154

sanskrit_iast:
āditya uvāca
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābāho śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ .
yadarthaṃ prārthitaḥ kṛṣṇa tatsarvaṃ te bhaviṣyati . . 2
meaning:
आदित्य उवाच
कृष्ण कृष्ण महाबाहो शृणु मे परमं वचः .
यदर्थं प्रार्थितः कृष्ण तत्सर्वं ते भविष्यति . . 2
text_mt: Āditya said: / “O Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa of mighty arms, hear my supreme word: / for whatever purpose you have petitioned, O Kṛṣṇa, all that will come to pass for you.

sanskrit_iast:
devadānavayakṣāṇāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām .
ajeyastvaṃ mahābāho bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ . . 3
meaning:
देवदानवयक्षाणां गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् .
अजेयस्त्वं महाबाहो भविष्यसि न संशयः . . 3
text_mt: To gods, dānavas, and yakṣas, to gandharvas, serpents, and rākṣasas, / you shall be invincible, O mighty-armed one, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
jagatpālayituṃ sarvaṃ samarthaśca bhaviṣyasi .
acalā tava bhaktiśca bhaviṣyati mamopari . .4
meaning:
जगत्पालयितुं सर्वं समर्थश्च भविष्यसि .
अचला तव भक्तिश्च भविष्यति ममोपरि . .4
text_mt: And you shall be capable of protecting the entire universe, / and your devotion towards me shall remain unswerving.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāpi satataṃ śakto jagatsraṣṭuṃ bhaviṣyati .
saṃhartuṃ śaṅkaraścāpi matprasādādbhaviṣyati . .5
meaning:
ब्रह्मापि सततं शक्तो जगत्स्रष्टुं भविष्यति .
संहर्तुं शङ्करश्चापि मत्प्रसादाद्भविष्यति . .5
text_mt: Brahmā also shall always be capable of creating the universe, / and Śaṅkara shall be capable of destroying it, through my grace.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavanto matprasādena jñānināmuttamaṃ padam .
gamiṣyanti na sandeho matpūjāprasādataḥ . .6
meaning:
भवन्तो मत्प्रसादेन ज्ञानिनामुत्तमं पदम् .
गमिष्यन्ति न सन्देहो मत्पूजाप्रसादतः . .6
text_mt: You all, through my grace, shall attain the highest station of the wise, / there is no doubt, through the grace of worshipping me.”

sanskrit_iast:
ravervacanamākarṇya gośrutābharaṇo vibho .
uvāca gopatirgogo gopatiṃ govṛṣadhvajaḥ . .7
meaning:
रवेर्वचनमाकर्ण्य गोश्रुताभरणो विभो .
उवाच गोपतिर्गोगो गोपतिं गोवृषध्वजः . .7
text_mt: Having heard the word of the sun, O all-pervading lord, he who is adorned with cattle and sacred tradition, / the lord of speech, the bull, the master of rays whose banner bears a bull, spoke to the Lord of rays.

sanskrit_iast:
tvāmārādhya bhaviṣyāmo vayaṃ sarve surottamāḥ .
kathamārādhayāmo hi bhavantaṃ śraddhayānvitāḥ . .
śreyase satataṃ deva brūhi nastattvamātmanaḥ . .8
meaning:
त्वामाराध्य भविष्यामो वयं सर्वे सुरोत्तमाः .
कथमाराधयामो हि भवन्तं श्रद्धयान्विताः . .
श्रेयसे सततं देव ब्रूहि नस्तत्त्वमात्मनः . .8
text_mt: By worshipping you, we shall all become the foremost among the gods. / How then, endowed with faith, are we to worship you? / Always tell us your own true nature, O god, for our highest good.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavato hi na paśyāmo mūrtiṃ paramapūjitām .
paśyāmaḥ kevalaṃ tejo hyabdhestoyamivojjhitam . . 9
meaning:
भवतो हि न पश्यामो मूर्तिं परमपूजिताम् .
पश्यामः केवलं तेजो ह्यब्धेस्तोयमिवोज्झितम् . . 9
text_mt: For we do not see your supremely worshipped form; / we see only splendour, like water cast forth from the ocean,

sanskrit_iast:
jvālāmālākulaṃ sarvamanekākṛti cādbhutam .
na cākāravihīnaṃ tu cetaso lambanaṃ bhavet . . 1.154.10
meaning:
ज्वालामालाकुलं सर्वमनेकाकृति चाद्भुतम् .
न चाकारविहीनं तु चेतसो लम्बनं भवेत् . . 1.154.10
text_mt: filled with a multitude of flames, having manifold shapes, and wondrous. / Yet that which is devoid of form cannot be a support for the mind.

sanskrit_iast:
ālambanādṛte deva na cittaramaṇaṃ kvacit .
cetaso'ramaṇe bhaktirna puṃsāṃ jāyate kvacit . . 11
meaning:
आलम्बनादृते देव न चित्तरमणं क्वचित् .
चेतसोऽरमणे भक्तिर्न पुंसां जायते क्वचित् . . 11
text_mt: Without a support, O god, the mind finds delight nowhere; / when the mind does not take delight, devotion never arises in men.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktiṃ vinā pūjayituṃ na śakyante divaukasaḥ .
tvatpūjane hi prāpyante deva dharmādayo naraiḥ . . 12
meaning:
भक्तिं विना पूजयितुं न शक्यन्ते दिवौकसः .
त्वत्पूजने हि प्राप्यन्ते देव धर्मादयो नरैः . . 12
text_mt: Without devotion, the gods cannot be worshipped; / indeed, in worshipping you, men attain righteousness and the other aims of life, O god.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāddarśaya tāṃ mūrtimātmano yā parā matā .
yena tvāṃ pūjayitvā tu vayaṃ siddhā bhavāmahe . . 13
meaning:
तस्माद्दर्शय तां मूर्तिमात्मनो या परा मता .
येन त्वां पूजयित्वा तु वयं सिद्धा भवामहे . . 13
text_mt: Therefore, show us that form of yours which is considered supreme, / by worshipping which we may attain perfection.

sanskrit_iast:
sūrya uvāca
sādhu sādhu mahādeva sādhu pṛṣṭo'smi suvrata .
śṛṇu caikamanāḥ kṛtsnaṃ gadato mama mānada . . 14
meaning:
सूर्य उवाच
साधु साधु महादेव साधु पृष्टोऽस्मि सुव्रत .
शृणु चैकमनाः कृत्स्नं गदतो मम मानद . . 14
text_mt:
Sūrya said:
Well said, well said, Mahādeva! Well have I been questioned, O you of noble vows! / Listen with single-minded attention to all that I declare, O bestower of honour.

sanskrit_iast:
caturmūrtirahaṃ deva jagadvyāpya vyavasthitaḥ .
śreyase sarvalokānāmādimadhyāntakṛtsadā . . 15
meaning:
चतुर्मूर्तिरहं देव जगद्व्याप्य व्यवस्थितः .
श्रेयसे सर्वलोकानामादिमध्यान्तकृत्सदा . . 15
text_mt: Having four forms, O god, I abide pervading the universe, / continually bringing about the beginning, middle, and end, for the highest good of all the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
ekā me rājasī mūrtirbrahmeti parikīrtitā .
sṛṣṭiṃ karoti sā nityaṃ kalpādau jagatāṃ vibho . . 16
meaning:
एका मे राजसी मूर्तिर्ब्रह्मेति परिकीर्तिता .
सृष्टिं करोति सा नित्यं कल्पादौ जगतां विभो . . 16
text_mt: One form of mine is endowed with rajas, proclaimed to be Brahmā; / it eternally performs the creation of the worlds at the beginning of a kalpa, O all-pervading one.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyā sāttvikī proktā yā parā parikīrtitā .
jagatsā pālayennityaṃ duṣṭadaityavināśinī . . 17
meaning:
द्वितीया सात्त्विकी प्रोक्ता या परा परिकीर्तिता .
जगत्सा पालयेन्नित्यं दुष्टदैत्यविनाशिनी . . 17
text_mt: The second is declared to be endowed with sattva, proclaimed as the supreme; / it perpetually protects the universe, destroying wicked daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyā tāmasī jñeyā īśeti ṣarikīrtitā .
trailokyaṃ saṃharetsā tu kalpānte śūlapāṇinī . . 18
meaning:
तृतीया तामसी ज्ञेया ईशेति षरिकीर्तिता .
त्रैलोक्यं संहरेत्सा तु कल्पान्ते शूलपाणिनी . . 18
text_mt: The third is to be known as endowed with tamas, proclaimed as Īśā; / holding a trident in hand, it dissolves the three worlds at the end of a kalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthī tu guṇairhīnā satyādibhiranuttamā .
sā cāśakyā kvaciddraṣṭuṃ sthitā sā cābhavatsadā . . 19
meaning:
चतुर्थी तु गुणैर्हीना सत्यादिभिरनुत्तमा .
सा चाशक्या क्वचिद्द्रष्टुं स्थिता सा चाभवत्सदा . . 19
text_mt: The fourth, however, is devoid of qualities such as truth, [yet] unsurpassable; / it is impossible to see anywhere, and it abides ever-existing.

sanskrit_iast:
tayā tatamidaṃ sarvaṃ yaccodgīthaṃ tu me gatiḥ .
niṣkalā sakalā sā tu surūpā rūpavarjitā . . 1.154.20
meaning:
तया ततमिदं सर्वं यच्चोद्गीथं तु मे गतिः .
निष्कला सकला सा तु सुरूपा रूपवर्जिता . . 1.154.20
text_mt: By it all this is pervaded; and that which is the udgītha is my goal. / It is partless and possessed of parts, beautifully formed and formless.

sanskrit_iast:
antargatā ca lokānāṃ na ca karmaphalaṃ gatā .
tiṣṭhamānāpyaliptā sā padmapatramivāmbhasā . . 21
meaning:
अन्तर्गता च लोकानां न च कर्मफलं गता .
तिष्ठमानाप्यलिप्ता सा पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा . . 21
text_mt: It has entered within the worlds, yet is not subject to the fruit of action; / remaining there, it is unstained, like a lotus leaf by water.

sanskrit_iast:
anaṣṭā ca sadā ṣaḍbhiḥ saptātītya vyavasthitā .
catustanā ca sā ṣaḍbhyasturīyākhyā supūjitā . . 22
meaning:
अनष्टा च सदा षड्भिः सप्तातीत्य व्यवस्थिता .
चतुस्तना च सा षड्भ्यस्तुरीयाख्या सुपूजिता . . 22
text_mt: It is never destroyed by the six, standing beyond the seven; / having four breasts, beyond the six, it is called the Fourth and is supremely worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
na sā spraṣṭuṃ tvayā śakyā hariṇā brahmaṇā na ca .
māmanārādhya bhūteśa vyomarūpaṃ kadācana . . 23
meaning:
न सा स्प्रष्टुं त्वया शक्या हरिणा ब्रह्मणा न च .
मामनाराध्य भूतेश व्योमरूपं कदाचन . . 23
text_mt: It cannot be touched by you, nor by Hari, nor by Brahmā, / without having worshipped me as the form of the sky at any time, O lord of beings.

sanskrit_iast:
yadetadbhavatāṃ deva prabodhārthamupasthitam .
ahaṃkāravimūḍhānāṃ tamasā ca trilocana . . 24
meaning:
यदेतद्भवतां देव प्रबोधार्थमुपस्थितम् .
अहंकारविमूढानां तमसा च त्रिलोचन . . 24
text_mt: This which has appeared for your awakening, O god, / [when you were] deluded by ego and by darkness, O three-eyed one,

sanskrit_iast:
prakāśāya ca lokānāṃ jvālāmālāsamākulam .
karṇikeva sthitaṃ deva bhūpadmasyākhilasya ca . . 25
meaning:
प्रकाशाय च लोकानां ज्वालामालासमाकुलम् .
कर्णिकेव स्थितं देव भूपद्मस्याखिलस्य च . . 25
text_mt: and for the illumination of the worlds, filled with a garland of flames, / stands like the pericarp of the entire earth-lotus, O god.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya saṃdarśanādeva yūyaṃ sarve prabodhitāḥ .
prakāśamabhavadvāpi jagatsarvamathārcibhiḥ . . 26
meaning:
यस्य संदर्शनादेव यूयं सर्वे प्रबोधिताः .
प्रकाशमभवद्वापि जगत्सर्वमथार्चिभिः . . 26
text_mt: At the very sight of which all of you were awakened, / and the whole universe became illuminated by its rays.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādārādhayasvainamaspṛṣṭaṃ gamanopamam .
manmūrtiṃ yena tāṃ divyāṃ drakṣyasi tvaṃ trilocana . . 27
meaning:
तस्मादाराधयस्वैनमस्पृष्टं गमनोपमम् .
मन्मूर्तिं येन तां दिव्यां द्रक्ष्यसि त्वं त्रिलोचन . . 27
text_mt: Therefore, worship this untouched [light], comparable to motion, / by which, O three-eyed one, you will behold that divine form of mine.

sanskrit_iast:
yattvādyamīśvaraṃ jajñe tadvyoma parikīrtitam .
kalpānte hyatra vai vyomni līyante sarvadevatāḥ . . 28
meaning:
यत्त्वाद्यमीश्वरं जज्ञे तद्व्योम परिकीर्तितम् .
कल्पान्ते ह्यत्र वै व्योम्नि लीयन्ते सर्वदेवताः . . 28
text_mt: The supreme lord who was born in the beginning is proclaimed as that sky; / indeed, at the end of a kalpa, all deities dissolve here in the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇe līyate brahmā vāme tasya janārdanaḥ .
tvaṃ sadā kacadeśe tu līyase tripurāntaka . . 29
meaning:
दक्षिणे लीयते ब्रह्मा वामे तस्य जनार्दनः .
त्वं सदा कचदेशे तु लीयसे त्रिपुरान्तक . . 29
text_mt: Brahmā dissolves in its right side, Janārdana in its left; / you, O destroyer of Tripura, always dissolve in the region of its hair.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatrī līyate tasya hṛdaye lokamātaraḥ .
līyante mūrddhni vai vedaḥ saṣaḍaṅgapadakramaḥ . . 1.154.30
meaning:
गायत्री लीयते तस्य हृदये लोकमातरः .
लीयन्ते मूर्द्ध्नि वै वेदः सषडङ्गपदक्रमः . . 1.154.30
text_mt: Gāyatrī, the mother of the worlds, dissolves in its heart; / the Veda, together with the six auxiliary limbs, the pada, and krama [recitations], dissolves in its head.

sanskrit_iast:
jaṭhare līyate sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam .
punarutpadyate hyasmādbrahmādyaṃ sacarācaram . . 31
meaning:
जठरे लीयते सर्वं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् .
पुनरुत्पद्यते ह्यस्माद्ब्रह्माद्यं सचराचरम् . . 31
text_mt: The entire universe, stationary and moving, dissolves in its belly; / and from it is born again [the universe] beginning with Brahmā, together with all that moves and is still.

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśaṃ vyoma ityāhuḥ pṛthivī nikṣubhā matā .
bhūtaśreyoha'mākāśo nikṣubhā dayitā mama . . 32
meaning:
आकाशं व्योम इत्याहुः पृथिवी निक्षुभा मता .
भूतश्रेयोहऽमाकाशो निक्षुभा दयिता मम . . 32
text_mt: They call space the sky; the earth is regarded as Nikṣubhā. / I am the welfare of beings, the sky; Nikṣubhā is my beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā nikṣubhayā sarvaṃ jagadvyāptaṃ trilocana .
tasmādārādhaya vyoma tvaṃ brahmā keśavastathā . . 33
meaning:
मया निक्षुभया सर्वं जगद्व्याप्तं त्रिलोचन .
तस्मादाराधय व्योम त्वं ब्रह्मा केशवस्तथा . . 33
text_mt: By me and Nikṣubhā the entire universe is pervaded, O three-eyed one. / Therefore, you, Brahmā, and Keśava should worship the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
tanme rūpaṃ mahadvyoma pūjayitvā trilocana .
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ hi girau tvaṃ gandhamādane . .
tato yāsyasi saṃsiddhiṃ ṣaḍaṅgāṃ paramāṃ śubhām . . 34
meaning:
तन्मे रूपं महद्व्योम पूजयित्वा त्रिलोचन .
दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं हि गिरौ त्वं गन्धमादने . .
ततो यास्यसि संसिद्धिं षडङ्गां परमां शुभाम् . . 34
text_mt: Having worshipped that great form of mine, the sky, O three-eyed one, / for a thousand divine years on Mount Gandhamādana, / you will then attain supreme, auspicious perfection endowed with six limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
kalāpagrāmamāśritya śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ .
ārādhayatu māṃ bhaktyā vyomarūpaṃ janārdanaḥ . . 35
meaning:
कलापग्राममाश्रित्य शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः .
आराधयतु मां भक्त्या व्योमरूपं जनार्दनः . . 35
text_mt: Taking resort in the village of Kalāpa, let Janārdana, / bearer of the conch, discus, and mace, worship me with devotion in the form of the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
antarikṣagataṃ tīrthaṃ puṣkaraṃ lokapāvanam .
tatra gatvā viriñco me vyomarūpaṃ sadārcatu . . 36
meaning:
अन्तरिक्षगतं तीर्थं पुष्करं लोकपावनम् .
तत्र गत्वा विरिञ्चो मे व्योमरूपं सदार्चतु . . 36
text_mt: There is Puṣkara, the pilgrimage place situated in the intermediate space, which purifies the world; / having gone there, let Viriñca always worship me in the form of the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ māṃ satataṃ yūyaṃ samārādhya jagatpatim .
samānāṃ ca sudivyānāṃ sahasratrayamādarāt . . 37
meaning:
एवं मां सततं यूयं समाराध्य जगत्पतिम् .
समानां च सुदिव्यानां सहस्रत्रयमादरात् . . 37
text_mt: Thus continually worshipping me, the lord of the universe, / for three thousand fully divine years with reverence,

sanskrit_iast:
tato drakṣyatha me mūrtiṃ paramāṃ yāṃ vidurbudhāḥ .
kadambagolakākārāṃ raśmimālākulāṃ parām . . 38
meaning:
ततो द्रक्ष्यथ मे मूर्तिं परमां यां विदुर्बुधाः .
कदम्बगोलकाकारां रश्मिमालाकुलां पराम् . . 38
text_mt: you will then behold my supreme form, which the wise know, / having the shape of a kadamba sphere, filled with a garland of rays, supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
atha nārāyaṇo devaḥ praṇamya śirasā ravim .
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt . . 39
meaning:
अथ नारायणो देवः प्रणम्य शिरसा रविम् .
कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा इदं वचनमब्रवीत् . . 39
text_mt: Then the god Nārāyaṇa, bowing his head to the sun / and making the gesture of hollowed hands, spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuruvāca
yadi te paramaṃ rūpaṃ mataṃ vyoma hyanaupamam .
tamārādhya vayaṃ sarve yāsyāmaḥ siddhimuttamām . .1.154.4 0
kīdṛgvyoma tvahaṃ brahmā haraśca tripurāntakaḥ .
ārādhayāmahe deva bhaktyā śreyo'rthamātmanaḥ . .4 1
yena siddhiṃ gamiṣyāmastamārādhya divākaram .
tasmānno lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi vyomnaḥ paramapūjita . .42
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sauradharme trayyupākhyāne
catuḥpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ . 1 54.
sauradharmanirūpaṇam
meaning:
विष्णुरुवाच
यदि ते परमं रूपं मतं व्योम ह्यनौपमम् .
तमाराध्य वयं सर्वे यास्यामः सिद्धिमुत्तमाम् . .1.154.4 0
कीदृग्व्योम त्वहं ब्रह्मा हरश्च त्रिपुरान्तकः .
आराधयामहे देव भक्त्या श्रेयोऽर्थमात्मनः . .4 1
येन सिद्धिं गमिष्यामस्तमाराध्य दिवाकरम् .
तस्मान्नो लक्षणं ब्रूहि व्योम्नः परमपूजित . .42
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे सौरधर्मे त्रय्युपाख्याने
चतुःपञ्चाशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः . 1 54.
सौरधर्मनिरूपणम्
text_mt:
Viṣṇu said:
If your supreme form is considered to be the incomparable sky, / by worshipping it we shall all attain the highest perfection. / What kind of sky do I, Brahmā, and Hara the destroyer of Tripura / worship with devotion for the sake of our own highest good, O god, / by worshipping which we shall attain perfection, worshipping the sun? / Therefore tell us the characteristic of the sky, O supremely worshipped one.
Thus ends the one hundred and fifty-fourth chapter, on the narrative of the Trayī in the Solar Dharma of the Saptamīkalpa, in the Brāhmaparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Determination of the Solar Dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
āditya uvāca
sādhusādhu suraśreṣṭha sādhu pṛṣṭo'smi bhūdhara .
śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ kṛṣṇa gadato nikhilaṃ mama . . 1
meaning:
आदित्य उवाच
साधुसाधु सुरश्रेष्ठ साधु पृष्टोऽस्मि भूधर .
शृणुष्वैकमनाः कृष्ण गदतो निखिलं मम . . 1
text_mt:
Āditya said:
Well said, well said, foremost of the gods! Well have I been asked, O bearer of the earth! / Listen with single-minded attention, O Kṛṣṇa, as I declare everything.
title: Sauradharmanirupaṇam

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhaya tvayaṃ devo mama rūpamanaupamam .
catuṣkoṇaṃ paraṃ vyoma adbhutaṃ gairikojjvalam . . 2
meaning:
आराधय त्वयं देवो मम रूपमनौपमम् .
चतुष्कोणं परं व्योम अद्भुतं गैरिकोज्ज्वलम् . . 2
text_mt: Let this god worship my incomparable form: / the supreme sky with four corners, wondrous and bright as red ochre.

sanskrit_iast:
tvāmārādhya ca cakrāṃkaṃ śaṃkaro vṛttamādarāt ..
śabdādau satataṃ brahma sagarādau trilocanaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
त्वामाराध्य च चक्रांकं शंकरो वृत्तमादरात् ..
शब्दादौ सततं ब्रह्म सगरादौ त्रिलोचनः .. 3 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped you marked with the discus, Śaṅkara [shall worship] the circular [form] with reverence, / Brahmā continually in sound and the rest, and the three-eyed one in Sagara and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyāhne tvaṃ sadā deva bhaktyā māmarcayasva vai ..
yatheṣṭamṛbhavaḥ sarve bhaktyā māṃ pūjayaṃtu vai .. 4 ..
meaning:
मध्याह्ने त्वं सदा देव भक्त्या मामर्चयस्व वै ..
यथेष्टमृभवः सर्वे भक्त्या मां पूजयंतु वै .. 4 ..
text_mt: At midday, O god, do worship me always with devotion; / let all the Ṛbhus worship me with devotion as they desire.

sanskrit_iast:
tato brahmādayo devāḥ śrutvā vākyaṃ vibhāvasoḥ ..
praṇamya śirasā sarvaṃ idaṃ vacanamabruvan .. 5 ..
meaning:
ततो ब्रह्मादयो देवाः श्रुत्वा वाक्यं विभावसोः ..
प्रणम्य शिरसा सर्वं इदं वचनमब्रुवन् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Then the gods headed by Brahmā, having heard the words of the sun, / bowed their heads to everything and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyā deva vayaṃ sarve kṛtakṛtyāstathaiva ca ..
asmābhirbhagavānpṛṣṭa stejasā prajvalaṃti ca .. 6 ..
meaning:
धन्या देव वयं सर्वे कृतकृत्यास्तथैव च ..
अस्माभिर्भगवान्पृष्ट स्तेजसा प्रज्वलंति च .. 6 ..
text_mt: Blessed are we all, O god, and we have accomplished our purpose; / the Blessed One has been questioned by us, and they blaze with splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbhūtā jñāninaḥ sarve bhavato darśanādvayam ..
tamomohāttathā taṃdrā sarvamekapade gatam .. 7 ..
meaning:
संभूता ज्ञानिनः सर्वे भवतो दर्शनाद्वयम् ..
तमोमोहात्तथा तंद्रा सर्वमेकपदे गतम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: All of us have become possessors of knowledge from seeing you; / darkness, delusion, and lethargy have vanished all at once.

sanskrit_iast:
vayaṃ tvanmūrtayaḥ sarve tejasā tava saṃvṛtāḥ ..
utpattisthitināśāya lokānāṃ tava śāsanāt .. 8 ..
meaning:
वयं त्वन्मूर्तयः सर्वे तेजसा तव संवृताः ..
उत्पत्तिस्थितिनाशाय लोकानां तव शासनात् .. 8 ..
text_mt: We are all your forms, enveloped by your splendour, / for the creation, preservation, and destruction of the worlds, by your command.

sanskrit_iast:
sthitāḥ sarve surajyeṣṭha lokapālāśca kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
adhunā sādha yāmeha vyomnaḥ pūjāṃ vrajāmahe .. 9 ..
meaning:
स्थिताः सर्वे सुरज्येष्ठ लोकपालाश्च कृत्स्नशः ..
अधुना साध यामेह व्योम्नः पूजां व्रजामहे .. 9 ..
text_mt: All the world protectors and all the eldest gods are positioned in their entirety. / Now we shall set forth; let us go to worship the firmament.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā bhāskaro vāritaskaraḥ ..
uvāca brahmaviṣṇvīśānsāmapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ .. 1.155.10 .. ..
meaning:
इत्थं तेषां वचः श्रुत्वा भास्करो वारितस्करः ..
उवाच ब्रह्मविष्ण्वीशान्सामपूर्वमिदं वचः .. 1.155.10 .. ..
text_mt: Having heard their words, the sun, who steals the waters, / spoke these soothing words to Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva:

sanskrit_iast:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
evametanna saṃdeho yadā vadatha suvratāḥ..
yūyaṃ manmūrtayaḥ sarve yuṣmākamahameva hi..11..
meaning:
.. आदित्य उवाच .. ..
एवमेतन्न संदेहो यदा वदथ सुव्रताः..
यूयं मन्मूर्तयः सर्वे युष्माकमहमेव हि..11..
text_mt: Āditya said: / It is just so, without doubt, as you speak, O men of good vows: / you are all my forms, and I alone indeed am you.

sanskrit_iast:
yadetaddarśanaṃ devāḥ pramāṇa ca yaduttamam..
jvālāmālākulaṃ śubhraṃ śāṃḍileyamivojjhitam .. 12 ..
meaning:
यदेतद्दर्शनं देवाः प्रमाण च यदुत्तमम्..
ज्वालामालाकुलं शुभ्रं शांडिलेयमिवोज्झितम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: That which is this vision, O gods, and which is the supreme authority, / filled with garlands of flames, radiant, as if abandoned by Śāṇḍilī,

sanskrit_iast:
yuṣmākaṃ devaśārdūlāstannibodhata kāraṇam..
ahaṃkāravimūḍhānāṃ mithaḥ kalahināṃ tathā .. .. 13 ..
meaning:
युष्माकं देवशार्दूलास्तन्निबोधत कारणम्..
अहंकारविमूढानां मिथः कलहिनां तथा .. .. 13 ..
text_mt: learn the reason for it, O tigers among gods: / for you who were deluded by egotism and quarrelling with one another,

sanskrit_iast:
prabodhārthaṃ hi yuṣmākaṃ tamaso nāśanāya ca ..
pravartanāya sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ ca pradarśitam ..14..
meaning:
प्रबोधार्थं हि युष्माकं तमसो नाशनाय च ..
प्रवर्तनाय सर्वेषां कर्मणां च प्रदर्शितम् ..14..
text_mt: it was shown to awaken you, to destroy darkness, / and to set all activities into motion.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādevaṃ viditvā tu nāhaṃkāraḥ kadācana ..
kartavyo bhūtimicchadbhiḥ satataṃ devasattamāḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
तस्मादेवं विदित्वा तु नाहंकारः कदाचन ..
कर्तव्यो भूतिमिच्छद्भिः सततं देवसत्तमाः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Therefore, knowing this, egotism should never / be indulged in by those who desire prosperity, O best of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
mānaṃ darpamahaṃkāraṃ pūrvaṃ tyaktvā sudūrataḥ ..
ārādhayata māṃ bhaktyā satataṃ śraddhayānvitāḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
मानं दर्पमहंकारं पूर्वं त्यक्त्वा सुदूरतः ..
आराधयत मां भक्त्या सततं श्रद्धयान्विताः .. 16 ..
text_mt: Having first cast far away conceit, pride, and egotism, / worship me constantly with devotion and endowed with faith.

sanskrit_iast:
tato drakṣyatha me rūpaṃ sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ ca yat ..
yasya saṃdarśanādeva sarve siddhimavāpsyatha .. 17..
meaning:
ततो द्रक्ष्यथ मे रूपं सकलं निष्कलं च यत् ..
यस्य संदर्शनादेव सर्वे सिद्धिमवाप्स्यथ .. 17..
text_mt: Then you will see my form, which is both with parts and without parts, / by the mere sight of which all of you will attain perfection.

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā mahārāja sahasrakiraṇo vibhuḥ ..
jagāmādarśanaṃ teṣāṃ paśyatāmeva bhārata .. 18 ..
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा महाराज सहस्रकिरणो विभुः ..
जगामादर्शनं तेषां पश्यतामेव भारत .. 18 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, O great king, the thousand-rayed lord / vanished from their sight even as they watched, O Bhārata.

sanskrit_iast:
atha te vismitāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇupinākinaḥ ..
tejasā tasya devasya bhāskarasya mahaujasaḥ ..19..
meaning:
अथ ते विस्मिताः सर्वे ब्रह्मविष्णुपिनाकिनः ..
तेजसा तस्य देवस्य भास्करस्य महौजसः ..19..
text_mt: Then all of them—Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Pinākin—were filled with wonder / by the splendour of that god Bhāskara of great power.

sanskrit_iast:
parasparamathocuste vismayena tadā nṛpa ..
aho mahātmā'yaṃ devo'ditiputro divaspatiḥ .. 1.155.20 ..
meaning:
परस्परमथोचुस्ते विस्मयेन तदा नृप ..
अहो महात्माऽयं देवोऽदितिपुत्रो दिवस्पतिः .. 1.155.20 ..
text_mt: Then they said to one another in astonishment, O king: / “Ah, great-souled is this god, the son of Aditi, lord of heaven,

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhadbhānurmahātejā lokadīpo vibhāvasuḥ ..
yena sarve vayaṃ trātā nighnatā vipulaṃ tamaḥ ..21..
meaning:
बृहद्भानुर्महातेजा लोकदीपो विभावसुः ..
येन सर्वे वयं त्राता निघ्नता विपुलं तमः ..21..
text_mt: greatly shining, of vast splendour, the lamp of the world, Vibhāvasu, / by whom we all have been rescued, he having destroyed the vast darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhayāmastaṃ sarve gatvā sthānāni kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
yena sarve vayaṃ tasya prasādātsiddhimāpnumaḥ ..22 ..
meaning:
आराधयामस्तं सर्वे गत्वा स्थानानि कृत्स्नशः ..
येन सर्वे वयं तस्य प्रसादात्सिद्धिमाप्नुमः ..22 ..
text_mt: Let us all worship him, going to our several abodes, / so that by his grace we all may attain perfection.”

sanskrit_iast:
tadvyoma pūjayitvā tu parayā śraddhayā vibhoḥ ..
āmaṃtrya te mithaḥ sarve gatāḥ pūjārthamādarāt .. 23 ..
meaning:
तद्व्योम पूजयित्वा तु परया श्रद्धया विभोः ..
आमंत्र्य ते मिथः सर्वे गताः पूजार्थमादरात् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped that firmament of the lord with supreme faith, / and taking leave of one another, they all went out of reverence for the sake of worship.

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma puṣkaraṃ brahmā śālagrāmaṃ janārdanaḥ ..
vṛṣabhadhvajo gato vīra parvataṃ gaṃdhamādanam ..24..
meaning:
जगाम पुष्करं ब्रह्मा शालग्रामं जनार्दनः ..
वृषभध्वजो गतो वीर पर्वतं गंधमादनम् ..24..
text_mt: Brahmā went to Puṣkara, Janārdana to Śālagrāma, / and the bull-bannered god went, O hero, to the Gandhamādana mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktvā mānamahaṃkāraṃ kurvaṃtastapa uttamam ..
ārādhayaṃti taṃ devaṃ bhāskaraṃ vāritaskaram..25..
meaning:
त्यक्त्वा मानमहंकारं कुर्वंतस्तप उत्तमम् ..
आराधयंति तं देवं भास्करं वारितस्करम्..25..
text_mt: Abandoning conceit and egotism, performing supreme asceticism, / they worshipped that god Bhāskara, the stealer of waters.

sanskrit_iast:
vyomni kṛtvā catuṣkoṇaṃ brahmā nityamapūjayat ..
cakrāṃkitaṃ harirnityaṃ samyagvyomaṃ tvapūjayat .. 26 ..
meaning:
व्योम्नि कृत्वा चतुष्कोणं ब्रह्मा नित्यमपूजयत् ..
चक्रांकितं हरिर्नित्यं सम्यग्व्योमं त्वपूजयत् .. 26 ..
text_mt: Brahmā worshipped constantly, making a four-cornered shape in the firmament; / Hari properly worshipped every day the firmament marked with a discus;

sanskrit_iast:
haro'pi satataṃ vīra tejasā vahnisannibham ..
apūjayatsadā vṛttaṃ vyomaṃ bhaktyā samanvitaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
हरोऽपि सततं वीर तेजसा वह्निसन्निभम् ..
अपूजयत्सदा वृत्तं व्योमं भक्त्या समन्वितः .. 27 ..
