संयावं कृशरं पूपं पायसं यावकं तथा ..
दध्योदनरसालान्नमोदकान्गुडपूपकान् .. 31 ..
text_mt: along with saṃyāva, kṛśara, cakes, pāyasa, and barley meal, / curd rice, spiced rice, modakas, and jaggery cakes—

sanskrit_iast:
yāvaṃtastaṇḍulāstasminnaivedye parisaṃkhyayā ..
tāvadvarṣa sahasrāṇi sūraloke mahīyate .. 32..
meaning:
यावंतस्तण्डुलास्तस्मिन्नैवेद्ये परिसंख्यया ..
तावद्वर्ष सहस्राणि सूरलोके महीयते .. 32..
text_mt: as many grains of rice as are counted in that food offering, / for that many thousands of years he is exalted in the realm of Sūra.

sanskrit_iast:
guḍakhaṃḍakṛtānāṃ ca bhakṣyāṇāṃ vinivedane ..
ghṛtena plāvitānāṃ ca phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ labhet .. 33 ..
meaning:
गुडखंडकृतानां च भक्ष्याणां विनिवेदने ..
घृतेन प्लावितानां च फलं शतगुणं लभेत् .. 33 ..
text_mt: And in the offering of edible delicacies made of molasses and candied sugar, / saturated with clarified butter, one obtains a hundredfold fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
rasāla khādyakādyānāṃ bhakṣyāṇāṃ phalamiṣyate ..
tadardhaṃ salilasyāpi vāsitasya nivedayet .. 34 ..
meaning:
रसाल खाद्यकाद्यानां भक्ष्याणां फलमिष्यते ..
तदर्धं सलिलस्यापि वासितस्य निवेदयेत् .. 34 ..
text_mt: Such is the fruit desired for edible treats, spiced dishes, and other food; / one should offer fragrant water of half that quantity.

sanskrit_iast:
yathākālopalabdhāni bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca ..
nivedyārkāya paramaṃ sthānaṃ prāpnoti pūjanāt .. 35 ..
meaning:
यथाकालोपलब्धानि भक्ष्याणि विविधानि च ..
निवेद्यार्काय परमं स्थानं प्राप्नोति पूजनात् .. 35 ..
text_mt: Having offered various kinds of edible foods obtained according to the season / to Arka, one attains the supreme abode through that worship.

sanskrit_iast:
prajvālya ghṛtadīpaṃ tu bhāskarasyālaye śubham ..
āgneyaṃ yānamāruhya gacchetsaumanasaṃ puram.. 36 ..
meaning:
प्रज्वाल्य घृतदीपं तु भास्करस्यालये शुभम् ..
आग्नेयं यानमारुह्य गच्छेत्सौमनसं पुरम्.. 36 ..
text_mt: Having lit an auspicious lamp with clarified butter in the temple of Bhāskara, / he mounts a chariot of fire and goes to the city of Saumanasa.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ kuryātkārtike māsi śobhanāṃ dīpamālikām..
saptamyāmatha ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vāmāvāsyāyāmathāpi vā .. 37 ..
meaning:
यः कुर्यात्कार्तिके मासि शोभनां दीपमालिकाम्..
सप्तम्यामथ षष्ठ्यां वामावास्यायामथापि वा .. 37 ..
text_mt: One who arranges a beautiful row of lamps in the month of Kārtika, / whether on the seventh, or on the sixth, or even on the new moon day,

sanskrit_iast:
bhāskarāyutasaṃkāśastejasā bhāsayandiśaḥ ..
divyābharaṇasaṃpannaḥ kulamuddhṛtya sarvaśaḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
भास्करायुतसंकाशस्तेजसा भासयन्दिशः ..
दिव्याभरणसंपन्नः कुलमुद्धृत्य सर्वशः .. 38 ..
text_mt: resembling ten thousand suns, illuminating the directions with brilliance, / adorned with divine ornaments, having delivered his lineage entirely,

sanskrit_iast:
yāvatpradīpasaṃkhyānaṃ ghṛtenāpūrya bodhitam..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate .. 39 ..
meaning:
यावत्प्रदीपसंख्यानं घृतेनापूर्य बोधितम्..
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि सूर्यलोके महीयते .. 39 ..
text_mt: as many as the number of lamps lit and filled with clarified butter, / for that many thousands of years he is exalted in the realm of Sūrya.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpavṛkṣamathodbodhya parvasvāyataneṣu vai ..
pūrvasmāddviguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 1.164.40 ..
meaning:
दीपवृक्षमथोद्बोध्य पर्वस्वायतनेषु वै ..
पूर्वस्माद्द्विगुणं पुण्यं लभते नात्र संशयः .. 1.164.40 ..
text_mt: Moreover, having lit a lamp-tree in temples on festival days, / he obtains twice the merit mentioned before, there is no doubt of this.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpavṛkṣaṃ samudbodhya bhāskarāyataneṣu bhoḥ ..
sarvalohamayaṃ vīra raviloke mahīyate .. 41 ..
meaning:
दीपवृक्षं समुद्बोध्य भास्करायतनेषु भोः ..
सर्वलोहमयं वीर रविलोके महीयते .. 41 ..
text_mt: Having illuminated a lamp-tree made entirely of metal in the temples of Bhāskara, / O hero, he is exalted in the realm of Ravi.

sanskrit_iast:
śirasā dhārayeddīpaṃ bhāskarasyāgrato niśi ..
lalāṭe caiva hastābhyāṃ samudyuktastatho rasi .. 42 ..
meaning:
शिरसा धारयेद्दीपं भास्करस्याग्रतो निशि ..
ललाटे चैव हस्ताभ्यां समुद्युक्तस्तथो रसि .. 42 ..
text_mt: One should bear a lamp on one's head before Bhāskara at night, / and on the forehead, and intently with both hands, as well as upon the chest.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāskarāyutasaṃkāśo vimānairarkasannibhaiḥ ..
kalpāyutaśataṃ caiva sūryaloke mahīyate .. 43 ..
meaning:
भास्करायुतसंकाशो विमानैरर्कसन्निभैः ..
कल्पायुतशतं चैव सूर्यलोके महीयते .. 43 ..
text_mt: resplendent like ten thousand suns, in celestial chariots resembling the sun, / he is honoured in the world of the sun for a hundred tens of thousands of kalpas.

sanskrit_iast:
annadātā tu yo vīra vīraloke mahī yate ..
bhāskarasyāgrato dattvā darpaṇaṃ nirmalaṃ śubham .. 44 ..
meaning:
अन्नदाता तु यो वीर वीरलोके मही यते ..
भास्करस्याग्रतो दत्त्वा दर्पणं निर्मलं शुभम् .. 44 ..
text_mt: And he who gives food, O hero, is honoured in the world of heroes. / Having presented a clean, auspicious mirror before the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
paryaṃke śobhitaṃ kṛtvā śvetamālyaiḥ sacandanaiḥ ..
vṛkārkanirmalaḥ śrīmāndivyābharaṇa rūpadhṛk ..
kalpāyutasahasrāṇi sūraloke mahīyate .. 45 ..
meaning:
पर्यंके शोभितं कृत्वा श्वेतमाल्यैः सचन्दनैः ..
वृकार्कनिर्मलः श्रीमान्दिव्याभरण रूपधृक् ..
कल्पायुतसहस्राणि सूरलोके महीयते .. 45 ..
text_mt: having adorned it on a couch with white garlands and sandalwood, / pure like the morning sun, glorious, wearing divine ornaments and forms, / he is honoured in the world of the sun for thousands of tens of thousands of kalpas.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ bhaktyā śraddadhāno ravernaraḥ ..
aśvamedhasahasrasya sukhena labhate phalam.. .. 46 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं भक्त्या श्रद्दधानो रवेर्नरः ..
अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य सुखेन लभते फलम्.. .. 46 ..
text_mt: A faithful person who circumambulates the sun with devotion / easily obtains the fruit of a thousand horse sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ yastu namaskāraṃ prayojayet ..
rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ sakalaṃ vindate phalam .. 47 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं यस्तु नमस्कारं प्रयोजयेत् ..
राजसूयाश्वमेधाभ्यां सकलं विन्दते फलम् .. 47 ..
text_mt: One who performs circumambulation and offers bow / obtains the complete fruit of both the Rājasūya and horse sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
namaskāraḥ smṛto yajñaḥ sarvayajño ttamottamaḥ ..
namaskṛtvā sahasrāṃśumaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 48 ..
meaning:
नमस्कारः स्मृतो यज्ञः सर्वयज्ञो त्तमोत्तमः ..
नमस्कृत्वा सहस्रांशुमश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .. 48 ..
text_mt: A bow is considered a sacrifice, the best among all sacrifices; / having bowed to the thousand-rayed one, one obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya daṃḍavadbhūmau namaskāreṇa yo'rcayet ..
sa yāṃ gatimavāpnoti na tāṃ kratu śatairapi .. 49 ..
meaning:
प्रणम्य दंडवद्भूमौ नमस्कारेण योऽर्चयेत् ..
स यां गतिमवाप्नोति न तां क्रतु शतैरपि .. 49 ..
text_mt: Prostrating like a stick upon the ground, he who worships with a bow / reaches a destination that cannot be attained even with hundreds of sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvayajñopavāsepu sarvatīrtheṣu yatphalam ..
abhijñāpyopahāreṇa pūjayā phalamaśnute .. 1.164.50 ..
meaning:
सर्वयज्ञोपवासेपु सर्वतीर्थेषु यत्फलम् ..
अभिज्ञाप्योपहारेण पूजया फलमश्नुते .. 1.164.50 ..
text_mt: Whatever fruit is attained in all sacrifices, fasts, and all holy sites, / he enjoys that fruit through worship, having honoured [the sun] with an offering.

sanskrit_iast:
śvetaṃ mahādhvajaṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā cāpaṃ ca raṃgakam ..
kiṃkiṇījālanirghoṣaṃ mayūracchatrabhūṣitam ..
yastvaryamṇe naro dadyācchraddhayā parayānvitaḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
श्वेतं महाध्वजं कृत्वा कृत्वा चापं च रंगकम् ..
किंकिणीजालनिर्घोषं मयूरच्छत्रभूषितम् ..
यस्त्वर्यम्णे नरो दद्याच्छ्रद्धया परयान्वितः .. 51 ..
text_mt: Having made a white, great banner and an arch with colours, / resounding with a network of jingling bells, adorned with a peacock-feather parasol, / whichever man offers it to Aryaman filled with supreme faith,

sanskrit_iast:
sa śatena vimānānāṃ sarvadeva namaskṛtaḥ ..
manvantaraśataṃ deva modate divi devavat .. 52 ..
meaning:
स शतेन विमानानां सर्वदेव नमस्कृतः ..
मन्वन्तरशतं देव मोदते दिवि देववत् .. 52 ..
text_mt: he, bowed to by all the gods, with a hundred celestial chariots, / rejoices in heaven like a god for a hundred manvantaras, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
dhvajamālākulaṃ kuryādyaḥ prāṃteṣu bhagālayam..
mahādhvajāṣṭakaṃ cāpi digvidikṣu nivedayet .. 53 ..
meaning:
ध्वजमालाकुलं कुर्याद्यः प्रांतेषु भगालयम्..
महाध्वजाष्टकं चापि दिग्विदिक्षु निवेदयेत् .. 53 ..
text_mt: He who fills the perimeter of Bhaga’s temple with rows of banners / and dedicates eight great banners in the cardinal and intermediate directions,

sanskrit_iast:
sa vimānasahasreṇa dhvajamālākulena tu ..
kalpāyutaśataṃ divyaṃ modete divi sūravat .. 54 ..
meaning:
स विमानसहस्रेण ध्वजमालाकुलेन तु ..
कल्पायुतशतं दिव्यं मोदेते दिवि सूरवत् .. 54 ..
text_mt: he, with a thousand celestial chariots crowded with rows of banners, / rejoices in heaven like the sun for a divine hundred tens of thousands of kalpas.

sanskrit_iast:
śatacandrāṃśuvimalaṃ muktādāmopaśobhitam ..
maṇidaṃḍamayaṃ chatraṃ dadyādvā kāṃcanādikam .. 55 ..
meaning:
शतचन्द्रांशुविमलं मुक्तादामोपशोभितम् ..
मणिदंडमयं छत्रं दद्याद्वा कांचनादिकम् .. 55 ..
text_mt: He who offers a parasol pure as the rays of a hundred moons, adorned with strings of pearls, / with a handle made of jewels, or made of gold and other materials,

sanskrit_iast:
sa dhāryamāṇacchatreṇa hemadaṃḍopaśobhinā ..
modate sūryaloke tu vimānavaramā sthitaḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
स धार्यमाणच्छत्रेण हेमदंडोपशोभिना ..
मोदते सूर्यलोके तु विमानवरमा स्थितः .. 56 ..
text_mt: he, with a parasol being held over him, resplendent with a gold shaft, / rejoices in the world of the sun, seated upon a supreme celestial chariot.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastasmāccyuto lokānnisargādbhuvamāgataḥ ..
bhuṅkte samudraparyaṃtāmekacchatrāṃ vasundharām .. 57 ..
meaning:
ततस्तस्माच्च्युतो लोकान्निसर्गाद्भुवमागतः ..
भुङ्क्ते समुद्रपर्यंतामेकच्छत्रां वसुन्धराम् .. 57 ..
text_mt: Then, falling from that world and arriving on earth in the course of time, / he enjoys the earth bounded by the oceans under a single royal parasol.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ śṛṃkhalāsamāyuktāṃ mahāghaṇṭāṃ mahāsvanām ..
kāṃsyalohamayīṃ vāpi nibadhnīyādbhagālaye .. 58 ..
meaning:
यः शृंखलासमायुक्तां महाघण्टां महास्वनाम् ..
कांस्यलोहमयीं वापि निबध्नीयाद्भगालये .. 58 ..
text_mt: He who fastens in the temple of Bhaga a great bell of loud sound, / fitted with chains, made of bell-metal or iron,

sanskrit_iast:
śobhanaḥ syānnaraḥ śrīmānbhagasyātīva vallabhaḥ ..
sūryatulyabalo bhūtvā sūryaloke mahīyate .. 59 ..
meaning:
शोभनः स्यान्नरः श्रीमान्भगस्यातीव वल्लभः ..
सूर्यतुल्यबलो भूत्वा सूर्यलोके महीयते .. 59 ..
text_mt: that man will be splendid, glorious, and exceedingly dear to Bhaga; / having attained strength equal to the sun, he is honoured in the world of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
bherīmṛdaṃgapaṭahajharjharīmardalādikam ..
daśakāṃsyādivāditraṃ yo bhagāya nivedayet .. 1.164.60 ..
meaning:
भेरीमृदंगपटहझर्झरीमर्दलादिकम् ..
दशकांस्यादिवादित्रं यो भगाय निवेदयेत् .. 1.164.60 ..
text_mt: He who presents to Bhaga kettledrums, mṛdaṅgas, paṭahas, jharjharīs, mardalas, / and other instruments such as ten kinds of brass cymbals,

sanskrit_iast:
sa vimānairmahābhāgervaṃśavīṇāyutasvanaiḥ ..
yugāntakaśataṃ divyaṃ bhagaloke mahīyate .. 61 ..
meaning:
स विमानैर्महाभागेर्वंशवीणायुतस्वनैः ..
युगान्तकशतं दिव्यं भगलोके महीयते .. 61 ..
text_mt: he, accompanied by splendid celestial chariots resounding with tens of thousands of flutes and vīṇās, / is honoured in the world of Bhaga for a divine hundred cosmic ages.

sanskrit_iast:
susaṃgītakadānena savādyena viśeṣataḥ ..
yatheṣṭaṃ bhāskare loke modate kālamakṣayam .. 62 ..
meaning:
सुसंगीतकदानेन सवाद्येन विशेषतः ..
यथेष्टं भास्करे लोके मोदते कालमक्षयम् .. 62 ..
text_mt: By donating exquisite music, especially with instruments, / he rejoices according to his desire in the world of the sun for inexhaustible time.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāmahāsvanaṃ dattvā śaṃkhayugmaṃ bhagālaye ..
yugakoṭiśataṃ divyaṃ bhagaloke mahīyate .. 63 ..
meaning:
महामहास्वनं दत्त्वा शंखयुग्मं भगालये ..
युगकोटिशतं दिव्यं भगलोके महीयते .. 63 ..
text_mt: Having offered a pair of conches of very great sound in the temple of Bhaga, / he is honoured in the world of Bhaga for a divine hundred crores of cosmic ages.

sanskrit_iast:
vimānaṃ bahuvarṇābhaṃ madhye paṃkajabhūṣitam ..
vicitramekavarṇaṃ vāsanavastropakalpitam .. 64 ..
meaning:
विमानं बहुवर्णाभं मध्ये पंकजभूषितम् ..
विचित्रमेकवर्णं वासनवस्त्रोपकल्पितम् .. 64 ..
text_mt: A canopy of many colours, adorned in the middle with a lotus, / variegated or of a single colour, fashioned from fine cloths,

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃkiṇījālasaṃpannaṃ varṇakaiścopaśobhitam ..
puṣpamālāprabhaṃ vāpi ghaṃṭācāmarabhūṣitam .. 65 ..
meaning:
किंकिणीजालसंपन्नं वर्णकैश्चोपशोभितम् ..
पुष्पमालाप्रभं वापि घंटाचामरभूषितम् .. 65 ..
text_mt: furnished with a network of jingling bells, embellished with colours, / or radiant like a flower garland, adorned with bells and chowries—

sanskrit_iast:
bhagasyopari yo dadyātsarvaratnopaśobhitam ..
dukūlapaṭṭadevāṃgairvastrairvā varṇakānvitaiḥ .. 66 ..
meaning:
भगस्योपरि यो दद्यात्सर्वरत्नोपशोभितम् ..
दुकूलपट्टदेवांगैर्वस्त्रैर्वा वर्णकान्वितैः .. 66 ..
text_mt: he who offers it above Bhaga, adorned with all jewels, / made of dukūla, silk, fine devāṅga fabrics, or cloths endowed with colours,

sanskrit_iast:
paṭṭādivastrataṃtūnāṃ parisaṃkhyā tu yā bhavet ..
tāvadyugasahasrāṇi sūraloke mahīyate .. 67 ..
meaning:
पट्टादिवस्त्रतंतूनां परिसंख्या तु या भवेत् ..
तावद्युगसहस्राणि सूरलोके महीयते .. 67 ..
text_mt: for as many threads as there are in those silk and other cloths, / for that many thousands of cosmic ages he is honoured in the world of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagāhutyā jagatsarvaṃ sṛṣṭidvāreṇa dhāryate ..
agnivartmā vacasyukto hyagnirasyātmajaḥ sadā .. 68 ..
meaning:
भगाहुत्या जगत्सर्वं सृष्टिद्वारेण धार्यते ..
अग्निवर्त्मा वचस्युक्तो ह्यग्निरस्यात्मजः सदा .. 68 ..
text_mt: By the offering to Bhaga the entire world is sustained through the path of creation; / he whose path is fire is declared in Vedic text, and fire is always his son.

sanskrit_iast:
yastvagnikāryaṃ(ya?) vidhivatkuryānnityaṃ bhagālaye ..
bhagamuddiśya rājeṃdra sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 69 ..
meaning:
यस्त्वग्निकार्यं(य?) विधिवत्कुर्यान्नित्यं भगालये ..
भगमुद्दिश्य राजेंद्र स याति परमां गतिम् .. 69 ..
text_mt: He who duly performs the daily fire-rite in the temple of Bhaga / dedicated to Bhaga, O king of kings, goes to the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvānnaṃ yāvakopetaṃ yastu nityavidhiṃ haret ..
puṣpadhūpajalopetaṃ kālekāle viśeṣataḥ .. 1.164.70 ..
meaning:
सर्वान्नं यावकोपेतं यस्तु नित्यविधिं हरेत् ..
पुष्पधूपजलोपेतं कालेकाले विशेषतः .. 1.164.70 ..
text_mt: He who brings all kinds of food along with barley gruel as a daily rite, / accompanied by flowers, incense, and water, especially at the proper times,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāśvetādimātṝṇāṃ trikalpānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ ..
yaḥ kṛtvā sakṛdapyevaṃ sarvadikṣu baliṃ haret ..
sa naraśca sahasrāṇi śāṃḍileyapure vaset .. 71 ..
meaning:
महाश्वेतादिमातॄणां त्रिकल्पानां च सर्वशः ..
यः कृत्वा सकृदप्येवं सर्वदिक्षु बलिं हरेत् ..
स नरश्च सहस्राणि शांडिलेयपुरे वसेत् .. 71 ..
text_mt: having done so even once and presented an offering in all directions / to the mothers headed by Mahāśvetā and to the three Kalpas entirely, / that man shall dwell for thousands [of years] in the realm of Śāṇḍileya.

sanskrit_iast:
saurasaṃdhyābaliṃ kṛtvā dināṃte satataṃ raveḥ ..
varṣāyutaśataṃ sāgraṃ bhagaloke mahīyate .. 72 ..
meaning:
सौरसंध्याबलिं कृत्वा दिनांते सततं रवेः ..
वर्षायुतशतं साग्रं भगलोके महीयते .. 72 ..
text_mt: Having constantly made the solar twilight offering to the sun at the end of the day, / he is honoured in the world of Bhaga for a full hundred tens of thousands of years.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhyodanapayobhiryaḥ pūritaṃ pātramāvṛtam ..
puṣpadhūpārcitaṃ caiva vitānopari śobhitam .. 73 ..
meaning:
दध्योदनपयोभिर्यः पूरितं पात्रमावृतम् ..
पुष्पधूपार्चितं चैव वितानोपरि शोभितम् .. 73 ..
text_mt: He who covers a vessel filled with curd, boiled rice, and milk, / worshipped with flowers and incense, adorned above with a canopy,

sanskrit_iast:
śirasā dhārayetpātraṃ śanairgacchetpradakṣiṇam ..
ravyāyatanaparyaṃte śaṃkhavīṇādinisvanaiḥ .. 74 ..
meaning:
शिरसा धारयेत्पात्रं शनैर्गच्छेत्प्रदक्षिणम् ..
रव्यायतनपर्यंते शंखवीणादिनिस्वनैः .. 74 ..
text_mt: should carry the vessel on his head and slowly circumambulate / the perimeter of the sun’s temple to the sounds of conches, vīṇās, and other instruments,

sanskrit_iast:
darpaṇairdhūpamālābhirgeyanṛtyādiśobhitam ..
bhānorhi smṛtiśīlaśca tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 75 ..
meaning:
दर्पणैर्धूपमालाभिर्गेयनृत्यादिशोभितम् ..
भानोर्हि स्मृतिशीलश्च तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु .. 75 ..
text_mt: adorned with mirrors, rows of incense, singing, dancing, and the like, / constantly remembering the sun—hear the meritorious fruit of that!

sanskrit_iast:
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ tathā ..
tapastaptaṃ mahattena bhavedevaṃ na saṃśayaḥ .. 76 ..
meaning:
दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु दिव्यं वर्षशतं तथा ..
तपस्तप्तं महत्तेन भवेदेवं न संशयः .. 76 ..
text_mt: He has performed great austerity for a divine thousand years / and a divine hundred years; thus it will be without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagabhaktiprasannātmā yadyapi syātsa pāpakṛt ..
bhagaloke vasennityaṃ bhagānucaratāṃ gataḥ .. 77 ..
meaning:
भगभक्तिप्रसन्नात्मा यद्यपि स्यात्स पापकृत् ..
भगलोके वसेन्नित्यं भगानुचरतां गतः .. 77 ..
text_mt: His mind serene through devotion to Bhaga, even if he were an evildoer, / he would dwell eternally in Bhaga's world, having become an attendant of Bhaga.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃ tu ṣaṣṭhīṃ naktena yaśca kṛṣṇāṃ ca saptamīm ..
iha bhogānavāpnoti paratra ca śubhāṃ gatim .. 78 ..
meaning:
कृष्णां तु षष्ठीं नक्तेन यश्च कृष्णां च सप्तमीम् ..
इह भोगानवाप्नोति परत्र च शुभां गतिम् .. 78 ..
text_mt: And he who observes the dark sixth and the dark seventh with a nocturnal meal / obtains pleasures in this world and an auspicious state in the next.

sanskrit_iast:
yobdamekaṃ tu kurvīta naktaṃ bhagadine naraḥ ..
brahmacārī jitakrodho bhagārcanaparo naraḥ ..
ayācitātparaṃ naktaṃ tasmannāktena vartayet .. 79..
meaning:
योब्दमेकं तु कुर्वीत नक्तं भगदिने नरः ..
ब्रह्मचारी जितक्रोधो भगार्चनपरो नरः ..
अयाचितात्परं नक्तं तस्मन्नाक्तेन वर्तयेत् .. 79..
text_mt: A man who observes a nocturnal meal for one year on the day of Bhaga, / chaste, his anger conquered, intent on the worship of Bhaga, / since a nocturnal meal is superior to eating unasked food, he should sustain himself with a nocturnal meal.

sanskrit_iast:
devaistu bhuktaṃ madhyāhne pūrvāhṇe ṛṣibhistathā ..
aparāhṇe tu pitṛbhiḥ saṃdhyāyāṃ guhyakādibhiḥ .. 1.164.80 ..
meaning:
देवैस्तु भुक्तं मध्याह्ने पूर्वाह्णे ऋषिभिस्तथा ..
अपराह्णे तु पितृभिः संध्यायां गुह्यकादिभिः .. 1.164.80 ..
text_mt: Eating is done by the gods at midday, and by the sages in the morning, / by the ancestors in the afternoon, and by the Guhyakas and others at twilight.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvā velā hyatikramya saurāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ param ..
bhuṃjāno naktakāle tu sūryabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ .. 81 ..
meaning:
सर्वा वेला ह्यतिक्रम्य सौराणां भोजनं परम् ..
भुंजानो नक्तकाले तु सूर्यभक्तिपरायणः .. 81 ..
text_mt: Surpassing all these times, the eating of the Sauras is supreme: / eating at the time of the nocturnal meal, devoted to the worship of the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
bhagalokamavāpnoti sumanāḥ sumanovrataḥ ..
bhuktvā saumanasām̐llokānrā jā bhavati bhūtale ..82..
meaning:
भगलोकमवाप्नोति सुमनाः सुमनोव्रतः ..
भुक्त्वा सौमनसाम्̐ल्लोकान्रा जा भवति भूतले ..82..
text_mt: cheerful and keeping the vow of cheerfulness, he reaches the world of Bhaga; / having enjoyed the pleasant worlds, he becomes a king upon earth.

sanskrit_iast:
haviṣyabhojanaṃ snānamāhārasya ca lāghavam ..
agnikāryamadhaḥśayyāṃ naktabhojī samācaret.. 83 ..
meaning:
हविष्यभोजनं स्नानमाहारस्य च लाघवम् ..
अग्निकार्यमधःशय्यां नक्तभोजी समाचरेत्.. 83 ..
text_mt: Eating havis-food, bathing, lightness of nourishment, / the fire-rite, and sleeping on the ground—one who eats a nocturnal meal should practice these.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhyāṃ prayatnena kṛtvā naktaṃ vidhānataḥ ..
naro mārgaśire māsi aṃśumāniti pūjayeta ..84..
meaning:
कृष्णषष्ठ्यां प्रयत्नेन कृत्वा नक्तं विधानतः ..
नरो मार्गशिरे मासि अंशुमानिति पूजयेत ..84..
text_mt: Having diligently observed the nocturnal meal on the dark sixth according to rule, / a man in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa should worship him saying: 'To the Radiant One.'

sanskrit_iast:
vidhivatprāśya gomūtramanāhāro niśi svapet..
atirātrasya yajñasya phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 85 ..
meaning:
विधिवत्प्राश्य गोमूत्रमनाहारो निशि स्वपेत्..
अतिरात्रस्य यज्ञस्य फलमाप्नोति मानवः .. 85 ..
text_mt: Having duly consumed cow urine, he should sleep at night without food; / that man obtains the fruit of the Atirātra sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣyepyevaṃ sahasrāṃśuṃ bhānumaṃtamuśaṃti ca ..
vājapeyaphalaṃ prāpya ghṛtaṃ prāśya labhennaraḥ .. 86 ..
meaning:
पुष्येप्येवं सहस्रांशुं भानुमंतमुशंति च ..
वाजपेयफलं प्राप्य घृतं प्राश्य लभेन्नरः .. 86 ..
text_mt: In Puṣya also, they declare [the worship of] the thousand-rayed Bhānu similarly; / having consumed clarified butter, a man obtains the fruit of the Vājapeya sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
māghe divākaraṃ nāma kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhyāṃ narottama ..
niśi pītvā tu gokṣīraṃ gomedhaphalamāpnuyāt .. 87 ..
meaning:
माघे दिवाकरं नाम कृष्णषष्ठ्यां नरोत्तम ..
निशि पीत्वा तु गोक्षीरं गोमेधफलमाप्नुयात् .. 87 ..
text_mt: In Māgha, [worshipping] the one named Divākara on the dark sixth, O best of men, / and drinking cow's milk at night, he would obtain the fruit of a Gomedha sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
mārtaṃḍaṃ phālgune māsi pūjayitvā gavāṃ payaḥ ..
pibettataḥ sūryaloke modate so'yutāyutam ..88..
meaning:
मार्तंडं फाल्गुने मासि पूजयित्वा गवां पयः ..
पिबेत्ततः सूर्यलोके मोदते सोऽयुतायुतम् ..88..
text_mt: Having worshipped Mārtaṇḍa in the month of Phālguna, he should drink / cow's milk; then he rejoices in the world of Sūrya for myriad upon myriad [of years].

sanskrit_iast:
caitre māsi vivasvaṃtaṃ pūjayitvā subhaktimān ..
haviṣyāśī sūryaloke'psarobhiḥ saha modate..89..
meaning:
चैत्रे मासि विवस्वंतं पूजयित्वा सुभक्तिमान् ..
हविष्याशी सूर्यलोकेऽप्सरोभिः सह मोदते..89..
text_mt: In the month of Caitra, having worshipped Vivasvat with sincere devotion, / eating sacrificial food, he rejoices in the world of Sūrya together with the apsarases.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśākhe caṇḍakiraṇaṃ pūjayecca payovrataḥ..
varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sāgraṃ modate sūryasaṃnidhau..1.164.90..
meaning:
वैशाखे चण्डकिरणं पूजयेच्च पयोव्रतः..
वर्षाणामयुतं साग्रं मोदते सूर्यसंनिधौ..1.164.90..
text_mt: In Vaiśākha, observing the milk-fast, one should worship the fierce-rayed [Sun]; / he rejoices in the presence of Sūrya for fully ten thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhe divaspatiṃ pūjya gavāṃ śṛṃgodakaṃ pibet..
gavāṃ koṭipradānasya nikhilaṃ phalamā pnuyāt ..91..
meaning:
ज्येष्ठे दिवस्पतिं पूज्य गवां शृंगोदकं पिबेत्..
गवां कोटिप्रदानस्य निखिलं फलमा प्नुयात् ..91..
text_mt: In Jyeṣṭha, having worshipped Divaspati, he should drink water [poured over] a cow's horn; / he obtains the entire fruit of donating ten million cows.

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhe tvarkanāmānamiṣṭvā prāśya ca gomayam ..
prayātyarkasalokaṃ tu varṣāṇāṃ ca śataṃśatam..92..
meaning:
आषाढे त्वर्कनामानमिष्ट्वा प्राश्य च गोमयम् ..
प्रयात्यर्कसलोकं तु वर्षाणां च शतंशतम्..92..
text_mt: In Āṣāḍha, having sacrificed to the one named Arka and consumed cow dung, / he goes to the world of Arka for hundreds of hundreds of years.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvaṇe'ryamanāmānaṃ pūjayitvā payaḥ pibet ..
varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sāgraṃ modate bhāskarālaye .. 93 ..
meaning:
श्रावणेऽर्यमनामानं पूजयित्वा पयः पिबेत् ..
वर्षाणामयुतं साग्रं मोदते भास्करालये .. 93 ..
text_mt: In Śrāvaṇa, having worshipped the one named Aryaman, he should drink milk; / he rejoices in the abode of Bhāskara for fully ten thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
māsi bhādrapade ṣaṣṭhyāṃ bhāskaraṃ nāma pūjayet ..
bhāskaraṃ paṃcagavyasya sarvamedhaphalaṃ labhet..94..
meaning:
मासि भाद्रपदे षष्ठ्यां भास्करं नाम पूजयेत् ..
भास्करं पंचगव्यस्य सर्वमेधफलं लभेत्..94..
text_mt: In the month of Bhādrapada, on the sixth, one should worship the one named Bhāskara; / [drinking] the five bovine products [for] Bhāskara, he obtains the fruit of a Sarvamedha sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
māsi cāśvayuje ṣaṣṭhyāṃ bhagākhyaṃ nāma pūjayet ..
palagomūtrabhukcaiva aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ..95..
meaning:
मासि चाश्वयुजे षष्ठ्यां भगाख्यं नाम पूजयेत् ..
पलगोमूत्रभुक्चैव अश्वमेधफलं लभेत् ..95..
text_mt: And in the month of Āśvayuja, on the sixth, one should worship the one named Bhaga; / consuming a pala of cow's urine, he obtains the fruit of an Aśvamedha sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
māse tu kārtike ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śakrākhyaṃ nāma pūjayet ..
dūrvāṃkuraṃ sakṛtprāśya rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet..96..
meaning:
मासे तु कार्तिके षष्ठ्यां शक्राख्यं नाम पूजयेत् ..
दूर्वांकुरं सकृत्प्राश्य राजसूयफलं लभेत्..96..
text_mt: In the month of Kārtika, on the sixth, one should worship the one named Śakra; / having tasted a sprout of dūrvā grass just once, he obtains the fruit of a Rājasūya sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣāṃte bhojayedviprānsūryabhaktiparāyaṇān..
pāyasaṃ madhusaṃyuktaṃ vajreṇa ca pariplutam..97..
meaning:
वर्षांते भोजयेद्विप्रान्सूर्यभक्तिपरायणान्..
पायसं मधुसंयुक्तं वज्रेण च परिप्लुतम्..97..
text_mt: At the end of the year, he should feed brāhmaṇas who are devoted to the worship of Sūrya / with rice pudding mixed with honey and drenched in clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktyā hiraṇyavāsāṃsi bhaktyā tebhyo nivedayet ..
nivedayecca sūryāya kṛṣṇāṃ gāṃ ca payasvinīm .. 98 ..
meaning:
शक्त्या हिरण्यवासांसि भक्त्या तेभ्यो निवेदयेत् ..
निवेदयेच्च सूर्याय कृष्णां गां च पयस्विनीम् .. 98 ..
text_mt: According to his capacity, he should present them with golden garments out of devotion; / and he should present to Sūrya a black, milk-yielding cow.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣamekaṃ ca deve vai nairaṃtaryeṇa yo nayet ..
kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhīvrataṃ bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ..99..
meaning:
वर्षमेकं च देवे वै नैरंतर्येण यो नयेत् ..
कृष्णषष्ठीव्रतं भक्त्या तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु ..99..
text_mt: Whoever passes a single year without interruption for the god, / observing the votive observance of the dark sixth with devotion, hear the meritorious fruit of that:

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvakāmasamanvitaḥ ..
modate sūryaloke tu sa naraḥ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ..1.164.100..
meaning:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः सर्वकामसमन्वितः ..
मोदते सूर्यलोके तु स नरः शाश्वतीः समाः..1.164.100..
text_mt: Liberated from all sins and endowed with all desires, / that man rejoices in the world of Sūrya for everlasting years.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyeṣvahaḥsu sarveṣu viṣuvadgrahaṇādiṣu ..
dānopavāsahomādyairakṣayaṃ khaga jāyate ..101..
meaning:
पुण्येष्वहःसु सर्वेषु विषुवद्ग्रहणादिषु ..
दानोपवासहोमाद्यैरक्षयं खग जायते ..101..
text_mt: On all auspicious days, at the equinoxes, eclipses, and so forth, / [the merit generated] by gifts, fasts, oblations, and other [rites] becomes imperishable, O bird.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sumaṃturuvāca .. ..
ityuktavānpurā bhānuraruṇāya viśāṃpate..
kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhīvrataṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpabhayāpaham .. 102 ..
meaning:
.. सुमंतुरुवाच .. ..
इत्युक्तवान्पुरा भानुररुणाय विशांपते..
कृष्णषष्ठीव्रतं पुण्यं सर्वपापभयापहम् .. 102 ..
text_mt: Sumantu said: / Thus the Sun formerly spoke to Aruṇa, O lord of the people, / [about] the meritorious votive observance of the dark sixth, which removes the fear of all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvedaṃ puruṣo bhaktyā bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ ..
prayāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ bhānoramitatejasaḥ ..103..
ubhayasaptamīvarṇanam
meaning:
कृत्वेदं पुरुषो भक्त्या भास्करस्य महात्मनः ..
प्रयाति परमं स्थानं भानोरमिततेजसः ..103..
उभयसप्तमीवर्णनम्
text_mt:
A man having performed this with devotion to the great-souled Bhāskara / goes to the supreme abode of Bhānu of boundless splendor.
Description of the Seventh Lunar Day in Both Fortnights

sanskrit_iast:
.. sumaṃturuvāca .. ..
ahaṃ te saṃpravakṣyāmi sūryasyavrattamuttamam..
dharmakāmārthamokṣāṇāṃ pratipādanamuttamam..1..
meaning:
.. सुमंतुरुवाच .. ..
अहं ते संप्रवक्ष्यामि सूर्यस्यव्रत्तमुत्तमम्..
धर्मकामार्थमोक्षाणां प्रतिपादनमुत्तमम्..1..
text_mt: Sumantu said: / I will fully declare to you the supreme votive observance of Sūrya, / the excellent teacher of righteousness, pleasure, wealth, and liberation.
title: Ubhayasaptamīvarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣamāse tu saṃprāpte yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam..
jiteṃdriyaḥ satyavādī śāligodhūmagorasaiḥ ..2..
meaning:
पौषमासे तु संप्राप्ते यः कुर्यान्नक्तभोजनम्..
जितेंद्रियः सत्यवादी शालिगोधूमगोरसैः ..2..
text_mt: When the month of Pauṣa has arrived, he who takes a nocturnal meal / with senses conquered and speaking the truth, [eating] śāli rice, wheat, and dairy foods,

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣayoḥ saptamīṃ yatnādupavāsena yāpayet ..
trisaṃdhyamarcayedbhānuṃ śāṃḍileyaṃ ca suvrata..3..
meaning:
पक्षयोः सप्तमीं यत्नादुपवासेन यापयेत् ..
त्रिसंध्यमर्चयेद्भानुं शांडिलेयं च सुव्रत..3..
text_mt: should diligently spend the seventh [lunar day] of both fortnights with fasting; / O performer of good vows, he should worship Bhānu and Śāṇḍileya at the three twilights;

sanskrit_iast:
adhaḥśāyī bhavennityaṃ sarvabhogaviva rjitaḥ ..
māsi pūrṇe tu saptamyāṃ ghṛtādibhirariṃdama .. 4 ..
meaning:
अधःशायी भवेन्नित्यं सर्वभोगविव र्जितः ..
मासि पूर्णे तु सप्तम्यां घृतादिभिररिंदम .. 4 ..
text_mt: he should always sleep on the ground, free from all sense-pleasures. / When the month is completed, on the seventh [lunar day], with clarified butter and other [substances], O subduer of foes,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā snānaṃ mahāpūjāṃ sūryadevasya bhāsta..
naivedyaṃ modakaprasthaṃ kṣīraṃ siddhaṃ nivedayet ..5..
meaning:
कृत्वा स्नानं महापूजां सूर्यदेवस्य भास्त..
नैवेद्यं मोदकप्रस्थं क्षीरं सिद्धं निवेदयेत् ..5..
text_mt: having performed the bath and the great worship of the sun-god, O radiant one, / he should offer as a food-offering a prastha of modakas and prepared milk-rice;

sanskrit_iast:
bhojayecca dvijānaṣṭau bhagārcā śubhalakṣaṇām ..
gāṃ ca dattvā mahārāja kapilāṃ bhāskarāya tu ..6..
meaning:
भोजयेच्च द्विजानष्टौ भगार्चा शुभलक्षणाम् ..
गां च दत्त्वा महाराज कपिलां भास्कराय तु ..6..
text_mt: and he should feed eight twice-born [men], [performing] the worship of Bhaga with auspicious marks, / and having given a brown cow to Bhāskara, O great king.

sanskrit_iast:
ya evaṃ kurute puṇyaṃ sūryasya vratamuttamam..
tasya puṇya phalaṃ vacmi sarvakāmasamanvitam..7..
meaning:
य एवं कुरुते पुण्यं सूर्यस्य व्रतमुत्तमम्..
तस्य पुण्य फलं वच्मि सर्वकामसमन्वितम्..7..
text_mt: Whoever thus performs the meritorious, supreme votive observance of Sūrya, / I declare his meritorious fruit, which is accompanied by all desires:

sanskrit_iast:
sūryakoṭipratīkāśairvimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ ..
apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇairmahāvibhavasaṃyutaiḥ ..8..
meaning:
सूर्यकोटिप्रतीकाशैर्विमानैः सार्वकामिकैः ..
अप्सरोगणसंकीर्णैर्महाविभवसंयुतैः ..8..
text_mt: in celestial chariots resembling ten million suns, fulfilling all desires, / crowded with hosts of apsarases, endowed with great splendor,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃgītanṛtyavādyādyairgaṃdharvagaṇaśobhitaiḥ ..
dodhūyamānaścamaraiḥ stūyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ ..9..
meaning:
संगीतनृत्यवाद्याद्यैर्गंधर्वगणशोभितैः ..
दोधूयमानश्चमरैः स्तूयमानः सुरासुरैः ..9..
text_mt: resplendent with hosts of gandharvas, with song, dance, instrumental music, and the like, / fanned by chowries, praised by gods and asuras,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrakiraṇābhāsaḥ sauraiḥ sūryasamanvitaiḥ ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatrāste raviraṃśumān..1.165.10..
meaning:
सहस्रकिरणाभासः सौरैः सूर्यसमन्वितैः ..
स याति परमं स्थानं यत्रास्ते रविरंशुमान्..1.165.10..
text_mt: shining like a thousand rays, accompanied by Saura [worshippers] and suns, / he goes to the supreme abode where the ray-bearing Sun resides.

sanskrit_iast:
romasaṃkhyā tu yā tasyāstatprasūtiḥ kuleṣu ca ..
tāvadyugasahasrāṇi sūraloke mahīyate ..11..
meaning:
रोमसंख्या तु या तस्यास्तत्प्रसूतिः कुलेषु च ..
तावद्युगसहस्राणि सूरलोके महीयते ..11..
text_mt: As many hairs as there are on her and on her progeny in his family, / for that many thousands of yugas he is honored in the world of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
triḥsaptakulajaiḥ sārdhaṃ bhogānbhuktvā yathepsitān ..
jñānayogaṃ samāsādya punareva pramucyate .. 12 ..
meaning:
त्रिःसप्तकुलजैः सार्धं भोगान्भुक्त्वा यथेप्सितान् ..
ज्ञानयोगं समासाद्य पुनरेव प्रमुच्यते .. 12 ..
text_mt: Having enjoyed desires as he wishes together with those born in thrice-seven families, / having attained the discipline of knowledge, he is liberated once again.

sanskrit_iast:
yogādduḥkhāṃtamāpnoti jñānayogaṃ pravartate ..
sauradharmādbhavejjñānaṃ sauradharmo bhagārcanāt.. .. 13 ..
meaning:
योगाद्दुःखांतमाप्नोति ज्ञानयोगं प्रवर्तते ..
सौरधर्माद्भवेज्ज्ञानं सौरधर्मो भगार्चनात्.. .. 13 ..
text_mt: From yoga he attains the end of suffering; the discipline of knowledge begins; / from Saura duty knowledge arises; Saura duty arises from the worship of Bhaga.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ te samākhyātaṃ bhavārṇavavyapohanam..
sauramokṣakramopāyaṃ sūrāśrayaniṣevaṇam .. 14 ..
meaning:
इत्येवं ते समाख्यातं भवार्णवव्यपोहनम्..
सौरमोक्षक्रमोपायं सूराश्रयनिषेवणम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: In this way has been proclaimed to you the removal of the ocean of existence, / the means for the sequence of Saura liberation, [which is] resort to the shelter of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
māghamāse tu saṃprāpte yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam ..
piṇyākaṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ bhuṃjānaḥ sa jitendriyaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
माघमासे तु संप्राप्ते यः कुर्यान्नक्तभोजनम् ..
पिण्याकं घृतसंयुक्तं भुंजानः स जितेन्द्रियः .. 15 ..
text_mt: When the month of Māgha has arrived, he who takes a nocturnal meal, / eating oilcake mixed with clarified butter, self-controlled,

sanskrit_iast:
sopavāsaśca saptamyāṃ bhavedubhayapakṣayoḥ ..
ghṛtābhiṣekamaṣṭamyāṃ kuryādbhānornarādhipa ..
gāṃ ca dayāddineśāya taruṇīṃ nīlasaṃnibhām.. 16 ..
meaning:
सोपवासश्च सप्तम्यां भवेदुभयपक्षयोः ..
घृताभिषेकमष्टम्यां कुर्याद्भानोर्नराधिप ..
गां च दयाद्दिनेशाय तरुणीं नीलसंनिभाम्.. 16 ..
text_mt: and fasts on the seventh of both fortnights; / he should perform an ablution with clarified butter for Bhānu on the eighth, O lord of men, / and give to the lord of the day a young cow resembling a dark-blue [cloud].

sanskrit_iast:
indranīlapratīkāśairvimānaiḥ śikhisaṃyutaiḥ ..
gatvādityapuraṃ ramyaṃ bhogānbhuṃkte yathepsitān .. 17 ..
meaning:
इन्द्रनीलप्रतीकाशैर्विमानैः शिखिसंयुतैः ..
गत्वादित्यपुरं रम्यं भोगान्भुंक्ते यथेप्सितान् .. 17 ..
text_mt: In celestial chariots resembling sapphires and endowed with peacocks, / having gone to the delightful city of Āditya, he enjoys pleasures as he desires.

sanskrit_iast:
rājeṃdra phālgune māsi yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam ..
śyāmākakṣīranīvārairjitakrodho jitendriyaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
राजेंद्र फाल्गुने मासि यः कुर्यान्नक्तभोजनम् ..
श्यामाकक्षीरनीवारैर्जितक्रोधो जितेन्द्रियः .. 18 ..
text_mt: O lord of kings, he who takes a nocturnal meal in the month of Phālguna / with śyāmāka grain, milk, and wild rice, having conquered anger and subdued the senses,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vāpyatha saptamyāmupavāsaparo naraḥ ..
aṣṭamyāṃ tu mahāsnānaṃ pañcagavyaghṛtādibhiḥ ..19..
meaning:
षष्ठ्यां वाप्यथ सप्तम्यामुपवासपरो नरः ..
अष्टम्यां तु महास्नानं पञ्चगव्यघृतादिभिः ..19..
text_mt: a man devoted to fasting on the sixth or on the seventh; / and on the eighth, a great bath with the five bovine products, clarified butter, and so forth,

sanskrit_iast:
valmīkajādimṛdbhiśca gomūtraśakṛdādibhiḥ..
tvagbhiśca kṣīravṛkṣāṇāṃ snāpayitvā pramārjayet ..1.165.20..
meaning:
वल्मीकजादिमृद्भिश्च गोमूत्रशकृदादिभिः..
त्वग्भिश्च क्षीरवृक्षाणां स्नापयित्वा प्रमार्जयेत् ..1.165.20..
text_mt: and with clays born of anthills and the like, cow's urine, cow dung, and the like, / and with the barks of milky trees, having bathed [the image], he should wipe it dry.

sanskrit_iast:
saurabheyīṃ tato dadyādraktābhāṃ raktamāline ..
padmarāgapratīkāśairvimānairhastisaṃyutaiḥ ..
gatvādityapuraṃ ramyaṃ modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
सौरभेयीं ततो दद्याद्रक्ताभां रक्तमालिने ..
पद्मरागप्रतीकाशैर्विमानैर्हस्तिसंयुतैः ..
गत्वादित्यपुरं रम्यं मोदते शाश्वतीः समाः .. 21 ..
text_mt: Then he should give to the red-garlanded [deity] a red-hued cow. / In celestial chariots resembling rubies and accompanied by elephants, / having gone to the delightful city of Āditya, he rejoices for everlasting years.

sanskrit_iast:
māsi caitre tu saṃprāpte yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam ..
śālyannaṃ pāyasairyuktaṃ bhuñjānaśca jitendriyaḥ ..
bhānave pāṭalāṃ dadyādvaiṣṇavīṃ taruṇīṃ nṛpa .. 22 ..
meaning:
मासि चैत्रे तु संप्राप्ते यः कुर्यान्नक्तभोजनम् ..
शाल्यन्नं पायसैर्युक्तं भुञ्जानश्च जितेन्द्रियः ..
भानवे पाटलां दद्याद्वैष्णवीं तरुणीं नृप .. 22 ..
text_mt: When the month of Caitra has arrived, he who takes a nocturnal meal, / eating śāli rice combined with milk-porridge, and self-controlled, / should give to Bhānu a young, pink cow dedicated to Viṣṇu, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣparāga prabhairyānairnānāhaṃsādiyāyibhiḥ ..
gacchetsūryapuraṃ ramyaṃ modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ ..23..
meaning:
पुष्पराग प्रभैर्यानैर्नानाहंसादियायिभिः ..
गच्छेत्सूर्यपुरं रम्यं मोदते शाश्वतीः समाः ..23..
text_mt: In vehicles having the radiance of topazes, drawn by various swans and other [birds], / he goes to the delightful city of Sūrya and rejoices for everlasting years.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśākhe vīramāse tu yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam ..
sūrye khaṃḍājya saṃmiśraṃ sakṛddadyānnivedanam .. 24 ..
meaning:
वैशाखे वीरमासे तु यः कुर्यान्नक्तभोजनम् ..
सूर्ये खंडाज्य संमिश्रं सकृद्दद्यान्निवेदनम् .. 24 ..
text_mt: In Vaiśākha, the heroic month, whoever observes the nocturnal meal, / should offer once to the Sun an offering mixed with candied sugar and clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
gāṃ ca dadyānmahārāja bhāskarāya śubhānana ..
sāmānyaṃ ca vidhiṃ kuryātprayukto yo mayā tava .. 25 ..
meaning:
गां च दद्यान्महाराज भास्कराय शुभानन ..
सामान्यं च विधिं कुर्यात्प्रयुक्तो यो मया तव .. 25 ..
text_mt: And he should give a cow to the Sun, O great king with auspicious face; / and he should perform the general ritual which was enjoined by me upon you.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśairyānairbarhiṇavāhanaiḥ ..
aṇimādiguṇairyuktaḥ sūryavadvicareddivi .. 26 ..
meaning:
शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशैर्यानैर्बर्हिणवाहनैः ..
अणिमादिगुणैर्युक्तः सूर्यवद्विचरेद्दिवि .. 26 ..
text_mt: In vehicles resembling pure crystal, with peacocks for their mounts, / endowed with qualities such as animan, he wanders in the sky like the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāpte śrāvaṇe māsi yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam ..
kṣīraṣaṣṭikabhaktena sarvasattvahite rataḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
संप्राप्ते श्रावणे मासि यः कुर्यान्नक्तभोजनम् ..
क्षीरषष्टिकभक्तेन सर्वसत्त्वहिते रतः .. 27 ..
text_mt: When the month of Śrāvaṇa arrives, whoever observes the nocturnal meal / with boiled sixty-day rice cooked in milk, devoted to the welfare of all beings,

sanskrit_iast:
pītavarṇāṃ ca gāṃ dadyādbhāskarāya mahātmane ..
sāmānyamakhilaṃ kuryādvidhānaṃ yatprakīrtitam ..28..
meaning:
पीतवर्णां च गां दद्याद्भास्कराय महात्मने ..
सामान्यमखिलं कुर्याद्विधानं यत्प्रकीर्तितम् ..28..
text_mt: and gives a yellow cow to the great-souled Sun, / should perform the entire general ritual that has been proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
sa vicitrairmahāyānairhaṃsasārasagāmibhiḥ ..
gatvādityapuraṃ śrīmānpūrvoktaṃ labhate phalam .. 29 ..
meaning:
स विचित्रैर्महायानैर्हंससारसगामिभिः ..
गत्वादित्यपुरं श्रीमान्पूर्वोक्तं लभते फलम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: He, magnificent, having gone to the city of Āditya in wondrous great vehicles / drawn by geese and sarus cranes, attains the aforementioned fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
vīra bhādrapade māsi yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam ..
hutaśeṣahaviṣyāśī vṛkṣamūlamupāśritaḥ .. 1.165.30 ..
meaning:
वीर भाद्रपदे मासि यः कुर्यान्नक्तभोजनम् ..
हुतशेषहविष्याशी वृक्षमूलमुपाश्रितः .. 1.165.30 ..
text_mt: O hero, whoever observes the nocturnal meal in the month of Bhādrapada, / eating sacrificial remnants of havis food, taking shelter at the base of a tree,

sanskrit_iast:
svapyādāyatane rātrau sarvabhūtānukampakaḥ ..
dadyādgāṃ rohiṇīṃ śreṣṭhāṃ bhāskarāya mahātmane .. 31 ..
meaning:
स्वप्यादायतने रात्रौ सर्वभूतानुकम्पकः ..
दद्याद्गां रोहिणीं श्रेष्ठां भास्कराय महात्मने .. 31 ..
text_mt: should sleep at night in a temple, showing compassion to all beings; / he should give an excellent red-brown cow to the great-souled Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
niśākarakaraprakhyairvajravaidūryasannibhaiḥ ..
cakravākasamāyuktairvimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
निशाकरकरप्रख्यैर्वज्रवैदूर्यसन्निभैः ..
चक्रवाकसमायुक्तैर्विमानैः सार्वकामिकैः .. 32 ..
text_mt: In celestial chariots resembling the rays of the moon, looking like diamond and beryl, / fitted with ruddy geese, granting all desires,

sanskrit_iast:
gatvādityapuraṃ ramyaṃ surāsurasuvanditam..
modate sa mahābhāgo yāvadā bhūtasaṃplavam .. 33 ..
meaning:
गत्वादित्यपुरं रम्यं सुरासुरसुवन्दितम्..
मोदते स महाभागो यावदा भूतसंप्लवम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: having gone to the delightful city of Āditya, praised by gods and asuras, / that highly fortunate one rejoices until the dissolution of all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmānāśvayuje māsi yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam ..
mitāśanaṃ prabhuñjāno jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
श्रीमानाश्वयुजे मासि यः कुर्यान्नक्तभोजनम् ..
मिताशनं प्रभुञ्जानो जितक्रोधो जितेन्द्रियः .. 34 ..
text_mt: In the month of Āśvayuja, the fortunate one who observes the nocturnal meal, / eating moderate food, having subdued anger and conquered his senses,

sanskrit_iast:
dadyādgāṃ padmavarṇābhāṃ ,bhānave'mitatejase ..
divyābharaṇasaṃpannāṃ taruṇīṃ ca payasvinīm ..35..
meaning:
दद्याद्गां पद्मवर्णाभां ,भानवेऽमिततेजसे ..
दिव्याभरणसंपन्नां तरुणीं च पयस्विनीम् ..35..
text_mt: should give a cow having the color of a lotus to the Sun of immeasurable brilliance, / adorned with divine ornaments, young and rich in milk.

sanskrit_iast:
svastimauktikasaṃkāśairiṃdranīlopaśobhitaiḥ ..
jīvo jīvakasaṃyuktavimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ ..
gacchedbhānusalokatvaṃ bhuñjānaḥ sa jitendriyaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
स्वस्तिमौक्तिकसंकाशैरिंद्रनीलोपशोभितैः ..
जीवो जीवकसंयुक्तविमानैः सार्वकामिकैः ..
गच्छेद्भानुसलोकत्वं भुञ्जानः स जितेन्द्रियः .. 36 ..
text_mt: In celestial chariots resembling pearls and Svastika symbols, adorned with sapphires, / having jīvañjīvaka birds, granting all desires, / he who has subdued his senses, enjoying himself, goes to the world of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
divākarāya gāṃ dadyājvalanārkasamaprabhām ..
pūrvoktaṃ ca vidhiṃ kuryātsūrya tulyo bhavennaraḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
दिवाकराय गां दद्याज्वलनार्कसमप्रभाम् ..
पूर्वोक्तं च विधिं कुर्यात्सूर्य तुल्यो भवेन्नरः .. 37 ..
text_mt: He should give to the maker of day a cow possessing radiance equal to fire and the sun, / and should perform the previously described rite; the man becomes equal to the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
kālānalaśikhaprakhyairmahāyānairnagopamaiḥ ..
mahāsiṃhakṛtāropaiḥ sūryavanmodate sukhī .. 38 ..
meaning:
कालानलशिखप्रख्यैर्महायानैर्नगोपमैः ..
महासिंहकृतारोपैः सूर्यवन्मोदते सुखी .. 38 ..
text_mt: In great vehicles resembling the flames of the fire of destruction, like mountains, / mounted with great lions, happy, he rejoices like the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam ..
yaccānnaṃ payasā yuktaṃ bhuñjānaḥ sa jitendriyaḥ ..39..
meaning:
मार्गशीर्षे शुभे मासि यः कुर्यान्नक्तभोजनम् ..
यच्चान्नं पयसा युक्तं भुञ्जानः स जितेन्द्रियः ..39..
text_mt: In the auspicious month of Mārgaśīrṣa, whoever observes the nocturnal meal, / eating food prepared with milk, with senses conquered,

sanskrit_iast:
prayacchedgāṃ tathā raktāṃ nānālaṃkārabhūṣitām ..
sūryāya kuruśārdūla vidhiṃ cāpi samācaret .. 1.165.40 ..
meaning:
प्रयच्छेद्गां तथा रक्तां नानालंकारभूषिताम् ..
सूर्याय कुरुशार्दूल विधिं चापि समाचरेत् .. 1.165.40 ..

text_mt: In vehicles resembling white lotuses, joined with chariots drawn by white horses, / having gone there to that lovely city, endowed with supreme radiance,

sanskrit_iast:
saptamyāmatha ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vā saṃkrāṃtau ca raverdine ..
haviṣā havirhomaṃ tu sopavāsaḥ samācaret .. 3 ..
meaning:

text_mt: Having made [an image of] Nikṣubhā out of bell-metal, or an auspicious golden one, / or of silver, one should bathe it with clarified butter and other substances for a year.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃdhamālyairalaṃkṛtya vastrayu gmaiśca śobhanaiḥ ..
bhakṣyabhojyairaśeṣaiśca vitānadhvajacāmaraiḥ .. 5 ..

भक्ष्यभोज्यैरशेषैश्च वितानध्वजचामरैः .. 5 ..
text_mt: Having adorned it with perfumes and garlands, and with pairs of beautiful garments, / with all kinds of edible and consumable foods, and with canopies, banners, and chowries,

sanskrit_iast:

kṛtvāyatanamadhye tu pratimāmupakalpayet .. 6 ..

dhvajaśaṃkhādivibhavairbhagasyāyatanaṃ nayet .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:

सर्वलक्षणसंपन्नं धनधान्यसमन्वितम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Having enjoyed pleasures in worlds beginning with the world of Sūrya, O ruler of men, / and arriving in due course in this world, she finds a husband of her liking, / endowed with all auspicious marks and accompanied by wealth and grain.

kṛṣṇapakṣe tu saptamyāṃ yā nārī tu dṛḍhavratā ..
.. 9 .. varṣāṃte sarvagaṃdhāḍhyaṃ nikṣubhārkaṃ nivedayet ..

sanskrit_iast: suvarṇamaṇimuktābhyāṃ bhojayitvā magāṃganām ..1.167.10..

निक्षुभार्कमिदं पुण्यं सा याति परमं पदम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: A woman who performs this vow that removes fear of sin, O king, / this meritorious Nikṣubhārka vow, goes to the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣamekaṃ mahābāho śraddhayā parayānvitaḥ ..
varṣāṃte vai bhojayedvīra dāṃpatyaṃ bhojakeṣu vai ..14..
meaning:
वर्षमेकं महाबाहो श्रद्धया परयान्वितः ..
वर्षांते वै भोजयेद्वीर दांपत्यं भोजकेषु वै ..14..
text_mt: Endowed with supreme faith for one year, O mighty-armed one, / at the end of the year, O hero, one should feed a married couple among the Bhojakas.

sanskrit_iast:
bhojayitvā tu dāṃpatyaṃ bhogakānāṃ mahābalaiḥ ..
pūjayedgaṃdhamālyaistu vāsobhiḥ kurunaṃdana .. 15 ..
meaning:
भोजयित्वा तु दांपत्यं भोगकानां महाबलैः ..
पूजयेद्गंधमाल्यैस्तु वासोभिः कुरुनंदन .. 15 ..
text_mt: Having fed the couple among the Bhojakas, O descendant of Kuru, / one should worship them with mighty [devotion] using perfumes, garlands, and garments.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā tāmramaye pātre vajrapūrṇairalaṃkṛtam ..
nikṣubhārkaṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ dattvā tābhyāṃ tu śaktitaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा ताम्रमये पात्रे वज्रपूर्णैरलंकृतम् ..
निक्षुभार्कं तु सौवर्णं दत्त्वा ताभ्यां तु शक्तितः .. 16 ..
text_mt: Having placed in a copper vessel [an image] adorned with diamonds, / and having given golden Nikṣubhā and Arka to the two of them according to one's capacity—

sanskrit_iast:
nikṣubhā bhojikā jñeyā bhojako'rkaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
tasmāttau pūjayetsaurīśvaravacchraddhayānvitaḥ .. 17 ..
kāmapradastrīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
निक्षुभा भोजिका ज्ञेया भोजकोऽर्कः प्रकीर्तितः ..
तस्मात्तौ पूजयेत्सौरीश्वरवच्छ्रद्धयान्वितः .. 17 ..
कामप्रदस्त्रीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Nikṣubhā should be known as the Bhojikā, and Arka is proclaimed as the Bhojaka; / therefore, endowed with faith, one should worship the two like the lord and lady of Sūrya.
Description of the women's votive observance fulfilling desires

sanskrit_iast:
.. sumaṃturuvāca .. ..
ekabhaktena yā nārī kārttikaṃ kṣapayennṛpa ..
kṣamāhiṃsādiniyamaiḥ saṃyatā brahmacāriṇī ..1..
meaning:
.. सुमंतुरुवाच .. ..
एकभक्तेन या नारी कार्त्तिकं क्षपयेन्नृप ..
क्षमाहिंसादिनियमैः संयता ब्रह्मचारिणी ..1..
text_mt: Sumantu said: / A woman who passes Kārttika on a single meal a day, O king, / practicing celibacy, restrained by the rules of forbearance, non-violence, and so forth,
title: adhyāyaḥ 168

sanskrit_iast:
guḍājyamiśraṃ śālyannaṃ bhāskarāya nivedayet ..
pakṣayorubhayostāta śradayā parayānvitā .. 2 ..
meaning:
गुडाज्यमिश्रं शाल्यन्नं भास्कराय निवेदयेत् ..
पक्षयोरुभयोस्तात श्रदया परयान्विता .. 2 ..
text_mt: should offer cooked śāli-rice mixed with jaggery and ghee to Bhāskara / in both fortnights, dear one, endowed with supreme faith.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpāṇāṃ karavīrāṇāṃ guggulaṃ sājyamādiśet ..
saptamyāṃ tāta ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vai upavāsaratirbhavet .. 3 ..
meaning:
पुष्पाणां करवीराणां गुग्गुलं साज्यमादिशेत् ..
सप्तम्यां तात षष्ठ्यां वै उपवासरतिर्भवेत् .. 3 ..
text_mt: She should assign oleander flowers and guggulu with ghee; / on the saptamī and on the ṣaṣṭhī, dear one, she should be devoted to fasting.

sanskrit_iast:
iṃdranīlapratīkāśairvimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ ..
varṣāyutaśataṃ sāgraṃ sūraloke mahīyate .. 4 ..
meaning:
इंद्रनीलप्रतीकाशैर्विमानैः सार्वकामिकैः ..
वर्षायुतशतं साग्रं सूरलोके महीयते .. 4 ..
text_mt: In celestial chariots fulfilling all desires, resembling sapphires, / she is honored in the world of Sūrya for a full hundred myriad years.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā ca sarvalokeṣu bhogamāsādya yatnataḥ ..
kramādāgatya loke'sminyatheṣṭaṃ viṃdate patim .. 5 ..
meaning:
तथा च सर्वलोकेषु भोगमासाद्य यत्नतः ..
क्रमादागत्य लोकेऽस्मिन्यथेष्टं विंदते पतिम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: And likewise, having carefully attained enjoyment in all worlds, / arriving in due course in this world, she finds a husband to her liking.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ sarvayajñeṣu vidhistulyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
ekabhaktopavāsasya phalaṃ ca sadṛśaṃ bhavet .. 6 ..
meaning:
इत्येवं सर्वयज्ञेषु विधिस्तुल्यः प्रकीर्तितः ..
एकभक्तोपवासस्य फलं च सदृशं भवेत् .. 6 ..
text_mt: In this way, the rule is proclaimed identical in all sacrifices, / and the fruit of eating one meal a day and fasting is similar.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣamā satyaṃ dayā dānaṃ śaucamiṃdriyanigrahaḥ ..
sūryapūjāgnihavanaṃ saṃtoṣaḥ steyavarjanam..7..
meaning:
क्षमा सत्यं दया दानं शौचमिंद्रियनिग्रहः ..
सूर्यपूजाग्निहवनं संतोषः स्तेयवर्जनम्..7..
text_mt: Forbearance, truth, compassion, charity, purity, restraint of the senses, / worship of Sūrya, offering in fire, contentment, and abstention from theft—

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavrateṣvayaṃ dharmaḥ sāmānyo daśadhā smṛtaḥ ..
niḥśeṣamahaṃ vakṣyāmi māsānmāsavrataṃ prati .. 8 ..
meaning:
सर्वव्रतेष्वयं धर्मः सामान्यो दशधा स्मृतः ..
निःशेषमहं वक्ष्यामि मासान्मासव्रतं प्रति .. 8 ..
text_mt: this tenfold duty is remembered as common to all votive observances. / I shall tell without remainder the month-by-month votive observance.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi vyomapṛṣṭhe vinirmitam ..
gaṃdhamālyairalaṃkṛtya śubhānanamanaupamam.. 9 ..
meaning:
मार्गशीर्षे शुभे मासि व्योमपृष्ठे विनिर्मितम् ..
गंधमाल्यैरलंकृत्य शुभाननमनौपमम्.. 9 ..
text_mt: In the auspicious month of Mārgaśīrṣa, having adorned [an image] fashioned on the surface of the sky, / with a lovely face and peerless, with perfumes and garlands,

sanskrit_iast:
tāmrapātrādikaiścaivāpyapsarogaṇasevitaiḥ ..
sumerau daśasāhasre sūryaloke mahīyate .. 1.168.10 ..
meaning:
ताम्रपात्रादिकैश्चैवाप्यप्सरोगणसेवितैः ..
सुमेरौ दशसाहस्रे सूर्यलोके महीयते .. 1.168.10 ..
text_mt: with copper vessels and the like, attended by hosts of apsarases, / she is honored in the world of Sūrya upon Sumeru for ten thousand [years].

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadevakadaṃbeṣu saṃprāpya vimalāṃ śriyam ..
kramādāgatya loke'sminrājānaṃ patimāpnuyāt ..
puṣpairamumalaṃkṛtya bhānave vinivedayet .. 11 ..
meaning:
सर्वदेवकदंबेषु संप्राप्य विमलां श्रियम् ..
क्रमादागत्य लोकेऽस्मिन्राजानं पतिमाप्नुयात् ..
पुष्पैरमुमलंकृत्य भानवे विनिवेदयेत् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Attaining spotless fortune among all the assemblies of the gods, / arriving in due course in this world, she would obtain a king as husband. / Having adorned this with flowers, one should present it to the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃdhamālyairalaṃkṛtya śubhānanamanaupa mam ..
tāmrapātrādikāṃsyaṃ vā kṛtvā tatra nivedayet .. 12 ..
meaning:
गंधमाल्यैरलंकृत्य शुभाननमनौप मम् ..
ताम्रपात्रादिकांस्यं वा कृत्वा तत्र निवेदयेत् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Having adorned with perfumes and garlands [an image] of lovely face and peerless, / having placed it in a copper or bell-metal vessel, she should present it there.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpuṣpakayānena divyagaṃdhapravāhinā ..
sumerau daśasāhasraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate ..13..
meaning:
महापुष्पकयानेन दिव्यगंधप्रवाहिना ..
सुमेरौ दशसाहस्रं सूर्यलोके महीयते ..13..
text_mt: In a great celestial flower-chariot wafting divine fragrance, / she is honored in the world of Sūrya upon Sumeru for ten thousand [years].

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktvā tu vipulānbhogānsarvalokeṣu bhārata ..
saṃprāpyaitaṃ kramāllokaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ vidate patim..14..
meaning:
भुक्त्वा तु विपुलान्भोगान्सर्वलोकेषु भारत ..
संप्राप्यैतं क्रमाल्लोकं यथेष्टं विदते पतिम्..14..
text_mt: Having enjoyed vast pleasures in all worlds, O descendant of Bharata, / arriving in due course in this world, she finds a husband to her liking.

sanskrit_iast:
māghe rathamaśvayujaṃ dīpamālyavibhūṣitam..
piṣṭasānusamā yuktaṃ kṛtvāyatanamānayet..15..
meaning:
माघे रथमश्वयुजं दीपमाल्यविभूषितम्..
पिष्टसानुसमा युक्तं कृत्वायतनमानयेत्..15..
text_mt: In Māgha, having made a chariot yoked with horses, adorned with lamps and garlands, / accompanied by a peak of flour, she should bring it to the temple.

sanskrit_iast:
mahārathopamairyānaiḥ śvetāśvavarasaṃyutaiḥ ..
varṣāyutaśataṃ sāgraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate..16..
meaning:
महारथोपमैर्यानैः श्वेताश्ववरसंयुतैः ..
वर्षायुतशतं साग्रं सूर्यलोके महीयते..16..
text_mt: In celestial chariots resembling great chariots, accompanied by excellent white horses, / she is honored in the world of Sūrya for a full hundred myriad years.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāmarāṇāṃ lokeṣu prāpya bhogānyathepsitān..
kramādāgatya loke'sminyatheṣṭaṃ patimāpnuyāt ..17..
meaning:
सर्वामराणां लोकेषु प्राप्य भोगान्यथेप्सितान्..
क्रमादागत्य लोकेऽस्मिन्यथेष्टं पतिमाप्नुयात् ..17..
text_mt: Having attained desired pleasures in the worlds of all the immortals, / arriving in due course in this world, she would obtain a husband to her liking.

sanskrit_iast:
pratimāṃ phālgune māsi kṛtvā piṣṭamayī raveḥ ..
gaṃdhamālyairalaṃkṛtya sthāpayedbhāskarā laye..18..
meaning:
प्रतिमां फाल्गुने मासि कृत्वा पिष्टमयी रवेः ..
गंधमाल्यैरलंकृत्य स्थापयेद्भास्करा लये..18..
text_mt: Having made an image of the Sun out of flour in the month of Phālguna, / and adorned it with perfumes and garlands, she should install it in the temple of Bhāskara.

sanskrit_iast:
yānairapratimairdivyairgītanādasamākulaiḥ..
sumerau daśasāhasraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate ..19..
meaning:
यानैरप्रतिमैर्दिव्यैर्गीतनादसमाकुलैः..
सुमेरौ दशसाहस्रं सूर्यलोके महीयते ..19..
text_mt: In peerless divine chariots filled with the sound of songs, / she is honored in the world of Sūrya upon Sumeru for ten thousand [years].

sanskrit_iast:
sarvābhimataloke'sminprāpya bhogānyathepsitān..
punaretya imaṃ lokaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ viṃdate patim ..1.168.20..
meaning:
सर्वाभिमतलोकेऽस्मिन्प्राप्य भोगान्यथेप्सितान्..
पुनरेत्य इमं लोकं यथेष्टं विंदते पतिम् ..1.168.20..
text_mt: Having attained desired pleasures in this world of all desired things, / returning again to this world, she finds a husband to her liking.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvāruṇaṃ tathā caitre gaṃdhamālyopaśobhitam ..
sthāpya pātre yathokte tu bhāskarāya nivedayet ..21..
meaning:
कृत्वारुणं तथा चैत्रे गंधमाल्योपशोभितम् ..
स्थाप्य पात्रे यथोक्ते तु भास्कराय निवेदयेत् ..21..
text_mt: Likewise having made Aruṇa in Caitra, beautified with perfumes and garlands, / and placing him in the vessel as prescribed, she should present him to Bhāskara.

sanskrit_iast:
śaradiṃdupratīkāśairvimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ ..
varṣāyutaśataṃ sāgraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate .. 22..
meaning:
शरदिंदुप्रतीकाशैर्विमानैः सार्वकामिकैः ..
वर्षायुतशतं साग्रं सूर्यलोके महीयते .. 22..
text_mt: In celestial chariots fulfilling all desires, resembling the autumn moon, / she is honored in the world of Sūrya for a full hundred myriad years.

sanskrit_iast:
karmakṣayādihāgatya putrapautrasamanvitam ..
abhīṣṭaṃ patimāsādya labhedbhogāntsudurlabhān .. 23 ..
meaning:
कर्मक्षयादिहागत्य पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितम् ..
अभीष्टं पतिमासाद्य लभेद्भोगान्त्सुदुर्लभान् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Arriving here upon the exhaustion of her karma, united with sons and grandsons, / having obtained a cherished husband, she would attain pleasures very difficult to attain.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃḍulāḍhakapiṣṭena kṛtvā vai meruparvatam ..
nikṣubhārkasamāyuktaṃ sarvadhātuvibhūṣitam .. 24
meaning:
तंडुलाढकपिष्टेन कृत्वा वै मेरुपर्वतम् ..
निक्षुभार्कसमायुक्तं सर्वधातुविभूषितम् .. 24
text_mt: Having fashioned Mount Meru with an āḍhaka measure of rice flour, / accompanied by Nikṣubhā and Arka, decorated with all minerals,

sanskrit_iast:
nānālaṃkārasaṃpannaṃ nānāmālyavibhūṣitam ..
sarvaratnasamāyuktaṃ sthāpayedbhāskarālaye .. 25 ..
meaning:
नानालंकारसंपन्नं नानामाल्यविभूषितम् ..
सर्वरत्नसमायुक्तं स्थापयेद्भास्करालये .. 25 ..
text_mt: endowed with various ornaments, decorated with various garlands, / accompanied by all jewels, she should install it in the abode of Bhāskara.

sanskrit_iast:
mahadvyomavrataṃ hyetadvaiśākhe yaḥ samācaret ..
nānāvidhaiśca yānaistu sūryaloke mahīyate .. 26 ..
meaning:
महद्व्योमव्रतं ह्येतद्वैशाखे यः समाचरेत् ..
नानाविधैश्च यानैस्तु सूर्यलोके महीयते .. 26 ..
text_mt: One who performs this great sky-vow in Vaiśākha, / is honored in the world of Sūrya with various vehicles.

sanskrit_iast:
saurādisarvalokeṣu bhuktvā bhogānaśeṣataḥ ..
kramādāgatya loke'sminrājānaṃ patimāpnuyāt .. 27 ..
meaning:
सौरादिसर्वलोकेषु भुक्त्वा भोगानशेषतः ..
क्रमादागत्य लोकेऽस्मिन्राजानं पतिमाप्नुयात् .. 27 ..
text_mt: Having enjoyed completely all pleasures in worlds beginning with the world of Sūrya, / arriving in due course in this world, she would obtain a king as husband.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyaṃ ca tathā padmamāṣāḍhe piṣṭamuttamam ..
sarvabījarasaiḥ pūrṇaṃ kṛtvā tu śubhralakṣaṇam ..
nānākeśaragaṃdhāḍhayaṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam .. 28 ..
meaning:
द्वितीयं च तथा पद्ममाषाढे पिष्टमुत्तमम् ..
सर्वबीजरसैः पूर्णं कृत्वा तु शुभ्रलक्षणम् ..
नानाकेशरगंधाढयं सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् .. 28 ..
text_mt:
And likewise in Āṣāḍha [she should make] a second, excellent lotus of flour,
filling it with the essences of all seeds, making it with auspicious marks,
abundant with varied saffron-scents, adorned with all jewels.

sanskrit_iast:
etairvā haimabhiryānaiḥ sarvabhogānvitairnṛpa ..
varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate ..29..
meaning:
एतैर्वा हैमभिर्यानैः सर्वभोगान्वितैर्नृप ..
वर्षकोटिशतं साग्रं सूर्यलोके महीयते ..29..
text_mt:
Or on these golden vehicles provided with all pleasures, O king,
she is glorified in the world of Sūrya for a full hundred crore of years.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktvā tu vipulānbhogānsarvalokeṣvanukramāt ..
prāptā tu sarvabhogāḍhayaṃ taruṇaṃ viṃdate patim .. 1.168.30 ..
meaning:
भुक्त्वा तु विपुलान्भोगान्सर्वलोकेष्वनुक्रमात् ..
प्राप्ता तु सर्वभोगाढयं तरुणं विंदते पतिम् .. 1.168.30 ..
text_mt:
Having enjoyed abundant pleasures in all worlds in succession,
and having arrived [here], she finds a youthful husband endowed with all enjoyments.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadhātusamākīrṇaṃ vicitradhvajaśobhitam ..
nivedayeta sūryāya śrāvaṇe tilaparvatam .. 31 ..
meaning:
सर्वधातुसमाकीर्णं विचित्रध्वजशोभितम् ..
निवेदयेत सूर्याय श्रावणे तिलपर्वतम् .. 31 ..
text_mt:
In Śrāvaṇa one should offer to Sūrya a mountain of sesame,
strewn with all minerals, adorned with variegated banners.

sanskrit_iast:
svacchaṃdagāmibhiryānairnānā varṇavibhūṣitaiḥ ..
varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate .. 32 ..
meaning:
स्वच्छंदगामिभिर्यानैर्नाना वर्णविभूषितैः ..
वर्षकोटिशतं साग्रं सूर्यलोके महीयते .. 32 ..
text_mt:
On vehicles moving at will, adorned with various colours,
she is glorified in the world of Sūrya for a full hundred crore of years.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāpya vividhānbhogānbahvāścaryasamanvitān ..
kramāllokamimaṃ prāpya rājānaṃ viṃdate patim .. 33 ..
meaning:
संप्राप्य विविधान्भोगान्बह्वाश्चर्यसमन्वितान् ..
क्रमाल्लोकमिमं प्राप्य राजानं विंदते पतिम् .. 33 ..
text_mt:
Having attained diverse pleasures filled with many wonders,
she arrives in this world in due course and finds a king as husband.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā bhādrapade māsi vyoma śālimayaṃ nṛpa ..
vitānadhvajacchatrāḍhyaṃ nānāmālāvibhūṣitam .. 34 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा भाद्रपदे मासि व्योम शालिमयं नृप ..
वितानध्वजच्छत्राढ्यं नानामालाविभूषितम् .. 34 ..
text_mt:
Having made a firmament of rice in the month of Bhādrapada, O king,
rich with canopies, banners, and royal parasols, adorned with various garlands,

sanskrit_iast:
taruṇārkakaraprakhyairmahā yānaiḥ suśobhanai ..
varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate .. 35 ..
meaning:
तरुणार्ककरप्रख्यैर्महा यानैः सुशोभनै ..
वर्षकोटिसहस्राणि सूर्यलोके महीयते .. 35 ..
text_mt:
she is glorified in the world of Sūrya for thousands of crores of years
on beautiful great vehicles resembling the rays of the morning sun.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāpya vividhānbhogāntsarvānnimiṣasaṃbhavān ..
kramādāgatya loke'sminrājānaṃ viṃdate patim .. 36 ..
meaning:
संप्राप्य विविधान्भोगान्त्सर्वान्निमिषसंभवान् ..
क्रमादागत्य लोकेऽस्मिन्राजानं विंदते पतिम् .. 36 ..
text_mt:
Having obtained various pleasures, all born in an instant,
she arrives in this world in due course and finds a king as husband.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā cāśvayuje māsi vipulaṃ dhānyaparvatam ..
suvarṇavastragaṃdhāḍhyaṃ bhāskarāya nivedayet .. 37 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा चाश्वयुजे मासि विपुलं धान्यपर्वतम् ..
सुवर्णवस्त्रगंधाढ्यं भास्कराय निवेदयेत् .. 37 ..
text_mt:
And having made in the month of Āśvayuja an extensive mountain of grain,
rich in gold, garments, and perfumes, she should offer it to Bhāskara.

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitraiśca mahāyānairvarabhogasamanvitaiḥ ..
varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate .. 38 ..
meaning:
सावित्रैश्च महायानैर्वरभोगसमन्वितैः ..
वर्षकोटिसहस्राणि सूर्यलोके महीयते .. 38 ..
text_mt:
On great solar vehicles endowed with choice pleasures,
she is glorified in the world of Sūrya for thousands of crores of years.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryalokādilokeṣu bhuktvā bhogānyathepsitān ..
asmim̐lloke cā saṃprāptā rājānaṃ viṃdate patim ..
candrāgnibhāskarāṇāṃ tu kāṃtitejaḥprabhānvitam .. 39 ..
meaning:
सूर्यलोकादिलोकेषु भुक्त्वा भोगान्यथेप्सितान् ..
अस्मिम्̐ल्लोके चा संप्राप्ता राजानं विंदते पतिम् ..
चन्द्राग्निभास्कराणां तु कांतितेजःप्रभान्वितम् .. 39 ..
text_mt:
Having enjoyed pleasures as desired in the world of Sūrya and other realms,
and having arrived in this world, she finds a king as husband,
endowed with the loveliness, splendor, and brilliance of the moon, fire, and sun.

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃyaṃ kāmaṃ samuddiśya naranārīnapuṃsakāḥ ..
pūjayaṃti raviṃ bhaktyā tatsarvaṃ prāpnuvaṃti hi .. 1.168.40 .. ..
sūryavratavarṇanam
meaning:
यंयं कामं समुद्दिश्य नरनारीनपुंसकाः ..
पूजयंति रविं भक्त्या तत्सर्वं प्राप्नुवंति हि .. 1.168.40 .. ..
सूर्यव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Whatever desire men, women, or eunuchs intend
when they worship Ravi with devotion, all that indeed they obtain.
Description of the Sūryavrata

sanskrit_iast:
.. sumaṃturuvāca .. ..
mṛnmayaṃ dārujaṃ śailaṃ pakveṣṭakamathāpi vā ..
kṛtvā maṭhaṃ gṛhaṃ vāpi yathā vibha vasaṃbhavāt .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सुमंतुरुवाच .. ..
मृन्मयं दारुजं शैलं पक्वेष्टकमथापि वा ..
कृत्वा मठं गृहं वापि यथा विभ वसंभवात् .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Sumantu said:
Having made a monastery or a house of clay, wood, stone,
or baked bricks, according to the extent of one's wealth,
title: Sūryavratavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
sarvopakaraṇopetaṃ sarvadhānyasamanvitam ..
sūryāyetthaṃ gṛhaṃ dadyātsarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 2 ..
meaning:
सर्वोपकरणोपेतं सर्वधान्यसमन्वितम् ..
सूर्यायेत्थं गृहं दद्यात्सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् .. 2 ..
text_mt:
equipped with all utensils, provided with all kinds of grain,
one who gives such a house to Sūrya obtains all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvaikabhaktaṃ hemaṃte māghamāsamataṃ dritaḥ ..
māsāṃtena rathaṃ kuryāccitravastropaśobhitam .. 3 ..
meaning:
कृत्वैकभक्तं हेमंते माघमासमतं द्रितः ..
मासांतेन रथं कुर्याच्चित्रवस्त्रोपशोभितम् .. 3 ..
text_mt:
Having eaten once a day in the cold season throughout the month of Māgha without indolence,
at the end of the month one should make a chariot adorned with variegated cloth,

sanskrit_iast:
śvetaiścaturbhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ turagaiḥ samalaṃkṛtam ..
śvetadhvajapatākābhiśchatracāmaradarpaṇaiḥ .. .. 4 ..
meaning:
श्वेतैश्चतुर्भिः संयुक्तं तुरगैः समलंकृतम् ..
श्वेतध्वजपताकाभिश्छत्रचामरदर्पणैः .. .. 4 ..
text_mt:
yoked to four white horses, richly decorated
with white flags, pennants, royal parasols, chowries, and mirrors.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃḍulāḍhakapiṣṭena kṛtvā bhānuṃ narādhipa ..
vinyasya taṃ rathopasthe saṃjñayā saha bhūpate .. 5 ..
meaning:
तंडुलाढकपिष्टेन कृत्वा भानुं नराधिप ..
विन्यस्य तं रथोपस्थे संज्ञया सह भूपते .. 5 ..
text_mt:
Having fashioned Bhānu with flour from an āḍhaka of rice, O ruler of men,
and having placed him upon the chariot-seat together with Saṃjñā, O lord of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ rātrau rājamārgeṇa śaṃkhabheryādinisvanaiḥ ..
bhramayitvā śanaiḥ paścātsūryāyatanamāviśet .. 6 ..
meaning:
तं रात्रौ राजमार्गेण शंखभेर्यादिनिस्वनैः ..
भ्रमयित्वा शनैः पश्चात्सूर्यायतनमाविशेत् .. 6 ..
text_mt:
having processed it at night along the royal highway to the sounds of conches, kettledrums, and other instruments,
one should then slowly enter the temple of Sūrya.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra jāgarapūjābhiḥ pradīpāvaliśobhitaiḥ ..
prekṣaṇīyaiḥ pradānaiśca kṣapayitvā śanaiḥ kṣapām ..7 ..
meaning:
तत्र जागरपूजाभिः प्रदीपावलिशोभितैः ..
प्रेक्षणीयैः प्रदानैश्च क्षपयित्वा शनैः क्षपाम् ..7 ..
text_mt:
Having spent the night slowly there with vigils and worships,
shining with rows of lamps, spectacles, and gifts,

sanskrit_iast:
prabhāte snapanaṃ kṛtvā madhukṣīraghṛtena ca ..
dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇebhyo'nnaṃ yathāśaktyā ca dakṣiṇām .. 8 ..
meaning:
प्रभाते स्नपनं कृत्वा मधुक्षीरघृतेन च ..
दीनांधकृपणेभ्योऽन्नं यथाशक्त्या च दक्षिणाम् .. 8 ..
text_mt:
having performed the bathing at dawn with honey, milk, and clarified butter,
[giving] food to the poor, the blind, and the destitute, and fees according to one's capacity,

sanskrit_iast:
rathaṃ saṃvāhanopetaṃ bhāskarāya nivedayet..
bhuktvā ca bāṃdhavaiḥ sārdhaṃ praṇamyārkagṛhaṃ vrajet ..9..
meaning:
रथं संवाहनोपेतं भास्कराय निवेदयेत्..
भुक्त्वा च बांधवैः सार्धं प्रणम्यार्कगृहं व्रजेत् ..9..
text_mt:
one should dedicate the chariot together with the draft animals to Bhāskara;
and having eaten together with kinsmen, bowing down, one should go to the house of Arka.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavratānāṃ pravaraṃ maṃtradharmānvitaḥ sadā ..
vrataṃ sūryavrataṃ nāmasarvakāmārthasiddhaye ..1.169.10..
meaning:
सर्वव्रतानां प्रवरं मंत्रधर्मान्वितः सदा ..
व्रतं सूर्यव्रतं नामसर्वकामार्थसिद्धये ..1.169.10..
text_mt:
The observance called Sūryavrata is always the best of all observances,
joined with mantras and righteousness, for the attainment of all desired goals.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavrateṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvayajñeṣu yatphalam ..
sarvaṃ sūryaratheneha tatpuṇyaṃ labhate nṛpa .. 11 ..
meaning:
सर्वव्रतेषु यत्पुण्यं सर्वयज्ञेषु यत्फलम् ..
सर्वं सूर्यरथेनेह तत्पुण्यं लभते नृप .. 11 ..
text_mt:
Whatever merit is in all observances, whatever fruit is in all sacrifices,
all that merit one obtains here by means of the chariot of Sūrya, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryāyutapratīkāśairvimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ ..
trisaptakulajaiḥ sārdhaṃ sūryaloke mahīyate .. 12 ..
meaning:
सूर्यायुतप्रतीकाशैर्विमानैः सार्वकामिकैः ..
त्रिसप्तकुलजैः सार्धं सूर्यलोके महीयते .. 12 ..
text_mt:
On celestial chariots fulfilling all desires, resembling ten thousand suns,
he is glorified in the world of Sūrya together with relatives of twenty-one generations.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktvā tu vipulānbhogānsarvalokeṣvanukramāt ..
kalpāyutaśataṃ sāgraṃ tato rājā bhavetkṣitau .. 13 ..
meaning:
भुक्त्वा तु विपुलान्भोगान्सर्वलोकेष्वनुक्रमात् ..
कल्पायुतशतं साग्रं ततो राजा भवेत्क्षितौ .. 13 ..
text_mt:
Having enjoyed abundant pleasures in all worlds in succession
for a full hundred myriad kalpas, he then becomes a king on earth.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcabalisamāyuktaṃ mṛdu ṣaḍvāstukalpitam ..
sarvopakaraṇopetaṃ sūryaṃ saṃjñāṃ prakalpayet .. 14 ..
meaning:
पंचबलिसमायुक्तं मृदु षड्वास्तुकल्पितम् ..
सर्वोपकरणोपेतं सूर्यं संज्ञां प्रकल्पयेत् .. 14 ..
text_mt:
Accompanied by five offerings, soft, arranged on six sites,
equipped with all utensils, one should fashion Sūrya and Saṃjñā.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃjñādevīsamāyuktaṃ paiṣṭāśāḍhyaṃ nivedayet..
saurajñānārthatattvajñamācāryamudayānvitam .. 15 ..
meaning:
संज्ञादेवीसमायुक्तं पैष्टाशाढ्यं निवेदयेत्..
सौरज्ञानार्थतत्त्वज्ञमाचार्यमुदयान्वितम् .. 15 ..
text_mt:
Accompanied by the goddess Saṃjñā, one should offer [a figure] rich with flour of Āṣāḍha [rice];
and to an ācārya who knows the true essence of the Saura knowledge, endowed with prosperity,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya gaṃdhapuṣpādyairvastrālaṃkāracāmaraiḥ ..
bhakṣya bhojyairaśeṣaiśca tataḥ śayyāṃ nivedayet .. 16 ..
meaning:
संपूज्य गंधपुष्पाद्यैर्वस्त्रालंकारचामरैः ..
भक्ष्य भोज्यैरशेषैश्च ततः शय्यां निवेदयेत् .. 16 ..
text_mt:
having worshipped [him] with perfumes, flowers, and the like, with garments, ornaments, and chowries,
and with all kinds of solid and soft foods, one should then present a bed.

sanskrit_iast:
tadūrṇātūlavastrāṇāṃ parisaṃkhyā tu yāvatī ..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate .. 17 ..
meaning:
तदूर्णातूलवस्त्राणां परिसंख्या तु यावती ..
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि सूर्यलोके महीयते .. 17 ..
text_mt:
As great as is the count of threads of its wool, cotton, and garments,
for that many thousands of years he is glorified in the world of Sūrya.

sanskrit_iast:
surādisarvalokeṣu bhuktvā bhogānaśeṣataḥ ..
kāmādāgatya loke'sminrājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
सुरादिसर्वलोकेषु भुक्त्वा भोगानशेषतः ..
कामादागत्य लोकेऽस्मिन्राजा भवति धार्मिकः .. 18 ..
text_mt:
Having enjoyed all pleasures in all the worlds of the gods and others,
returning to this world as he desires, he becomes a righteous king.

sanskrit_iast:
daśa gobhiḥ saha vṛṣaṃ tā vṛṣaikādaśāḥ smṛtāḥ ..
sūryāya vinivedyeha yatphalaṃ labhate śṛṇu .. 19 ..
meaning:
दश गोभिः सह वृषं ता वृषैकादशाः स्मृताः ..
सूर्याय विनिवेद्येह यत्फलं लभते शृणु .. 19 ..
text_mt:
Hear what fruit one obtains here upon dedicating to Sūrya
a bull together with ten cows—these are known as the eleven cattle headed by a bull.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśādityatulyātmā aṇimādiguṇairyutaḥ ..
sarvatra modate rājansūryasyānucaro bhavet .. 20 .. ..
godānavarṇanam
meaning:
द्वादशादित्यतुल्यात्मा अणिमादिगुणैर्युतः ..
सर्वत्र मोदते राजन्सूर्यस्यानुचरो भवेत् .. 20 .. ..
गोदानवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Equal in nature to the twelve Ādityas, endowed with virtues such as atomicity,
he rejoices everywhere, O king, and becomes an attendant of Sūrya.
Description of the Gift of Cows

sanskrit_iast:
.. sumanturuvāca .. ..
savṛṣaṃ gośataṃ dattvā bhāskarāya narādhipa ..
triḥsaptakulajaiḥ sārdhaṃ śṛṇu yatphalamāpnuyāt .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सुमन्तुरुवाच .. ..
सवृषं गोशतं दत्त्वा भास्कराय नराधिप ..
त्रिःसप्तकुलजैः सार्धं शृणु यत्फलमाप्नुयात् .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Sumantu said:
Having given a hundred cows together with a bull to Bhāskara, O ruler of men,
hear what fruit one obtains together with relatives of twenty-one generations:
title: Godānavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
varakoṭipratīkāśaiḥ sarvakāmasamanvitaiḥ ..
mahāyānairasaṃkhyeyairamarāsurapūjitaiḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
वरकोटिप्रतीकाशैः सर्वकामसमन्वितैः ..
महायानैरसंख्येयैरमरासुरपूजितैः .. 2 ..
text_mt:
Resembling crores of the finest beings, endowed with all desires,
upon countless great vehicles worshipped by gods and asuras,

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśādityasaṃkāśo divākara ivāparaḥ ..
gatvādityapuraṃ ramyaṃ krīḍate sūryamaṃḍape .. 3 ..
meaning:
द्वादशादित्यसंकाशो दिवाकर इवापरः ..
गत्वादित्यपुरं रम्यं क्रीडते सूर्यमंडपे .. 3 ..
text_mt:
resembling the twelve Ādityas, like another Divākara,
having gone to the delightful city of Āditya, he sports in the pavilion of Sūrya.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktvā tu vipulānbhogānpralaye sarvadehinām ..
mohakaṃcukamutsṛjya viśatyādityamaṃḍale .. 4 ..
meaning:
भुक्त्वा तु विपुलान्भोगान्प्रलये सर्वदेहिनाम् ..
मोहकंचुकमुत्सृज्य विशत्यादित्यमंडले .. 4 ..
text_mt:
Having enjoyed abundant pleasures, at the dissolution of all embodied beings,
casting off the bodice of delusion, he enters the solar orb.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajñaḥ sūraparamaḥ śuddhaḥ svātmanyavasthitaḥ ..
sarvagaḥ paripūrṇatvātsūryavaddīptimānbhavet .. 5..
meaning:
सर्वज्ञः सूरपरमः शुद्धः स्वात्मन्यवस्थितः ..
सर्वगः परिपूर्णत्वात्सूर्यवद्दीप्तिमान्भवेत् .. 5..
text_mt:
All-knowing, devoted to Sūra, pure, established in his own self,
all-pervading through his fullness, he becomes radiant like the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
yo dadyādubhayamukhīṃ saurabheyīṃ divākare ..
saptadvīpāṃ mahīṃ dattvā yatphalaṃ tadavāpnuyāt ..
pādadvayaṃ śiro'rdhaṃ ca saśailavanakānanā .. 6 ..
bhojakabhojanānuṣṭhānavarṇanam
meaning:
यो दद्यादुभयमुखीं सौरभेयीं दिवाकरे ..
सप्तद्वीपां महीं दत्त्वा यत्फलं तदवाप्नुयात् ..
पादद्वयं शिरोऽर्धं च सशैलवनकानना .. 6 ..
भोजकभोजनानुष्ठानवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Whoever gives to Divākara a cow with two heads [at calving],
what fruit [one obtains] by giving the earth with its seven continents,
with its mountains, woods, and forests, that he obtains [when only] two feet and half the head [are born].
Description of the rules of dining for Bhojakas

sanskrit_iast:
.. śatānīka uvāca .. ..
magānāṃ brūhi me dharmaṃ samāsavyāsayogataḥ ..
phalaṃ ca kiṃ bhavedbrahmanmagadharmaniṣevaṇāt .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. शतानीक उवाच .. ..
मगानां ब्रूहि मे धर्मं समासव्यासयोगतः ..
फलं च किं भवेद्ब्रह्मन्मगधर्मनिषेवणात् .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Śatānīka said:
Tell me, in brief and in detail, the duty of the Magas, / and what fruit there is, O brāhmaṇa, from observing the Maga duty.
title: Ṣṭhānavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
.. sumaṃturuvāca .. ..
ya eṣa dharmaḥ sūryeti tavākhyāto mayānagha ..
magadharmaḥ sa evoktaḥ sarvapāpabhayāpahaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. सुमंतुरुवाच .. ..
य एष धर्मः सूर्येति तवाख्यातो मयानघ ..
मगधर्मः स एवोक्तः सर्वपापभयापहः .. 2 ..
text_mt:
Sumaṃtu said:
This duty of Sūrya that I have declared to you, O sinless one, / is indeed called the Maga duty, which removes all sin and fear.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ magadharmaniṣevaṇam..
magadharmaśca saṃprokta eteṣāṃ bhavamuktaye ..3..
meaning:
सर्वेषामेव वर्णानां मगधर्मनिषेवणम्..
मगधर्मश्च संप्रोक्त एतेषां भवमुक्तये ..3..
text_mt: The observance of the Maga duty is for all castes, / and the Maga duty is proclaimed for their release from worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ strī śūdro vā magāśramī ..
yaḥ pūjayati mārtaṃḍaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 4 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः स्त्री शूद्रो वा मगाश्रमी ..
यः पूजयति मार्तंडं स याति परमां गतिम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Whether brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, women, śūdras, or those living in the stage of a Maga, / whoever worships the sun attains the highest state.

sanskrit_iast:
trisaṃdhyamarcayedbhānumagnikāryaṃ ca śaktitaḥ ..
kuryānmago mahābāho mukhamāvṛtya yatnataḥ ..5..
meaning:
त्रिसंध्यमर्चयेद्भानुमग्निकार्यं च शक्तितः ..
कुर्यान्मगो महाबाहो मुखमावृत्य यत्नतः ..5..
text_mt: He should worship the sun at the three twilights, and perform the fire-rite according to his ability; / a Maga, O mighty-armed one, should perform it carefully covering his mouth.

sanskrit_iast:
trisaṃdhyamekakālaṃ vā pūjayecchaddhayā ravim ..
asaṃpūjya raviṃ mohānna bhuṃjīta kadācana .. 6 ..
meaning:
त्रिसंध्यमेककालं वा पूजयेच्छद्धया रविम् ..
असंपूज्य रविं मोहान्न भुंजीत कदाचन .. 6 ..
text_mt: He should worship the sun with faith at the three twilights or once a day; / having not worshipped the sun, he must never eat out of delusion.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa dharmaḥ paro jñeyaḥ śeṣo bhavati mānavaḥ ..
apūjayitvā bhuṃjāno viṣṭhāṃ bhuṅkte ca vai magaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
एष धर्मः परो ज्ञेयः शेषो भवति मानवः ..
अपूजयित्वा भुंजानो विष्ठां भुङ्क्ते च वै मगः .. 7 ..
text_mt: This should be known as the supreme duty; the rest belongs to [common] man. / A Maga who eats without having worshipped indeed eats excrement.

sanskrit_iast:
devaṃ samāśritaiḥ pūjā kartavyeyaṃ tribhiḥ sadā ..
manasā pūjayedyogī puṣpaiścāraṇyasaṃbhavaiḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
देवं समाश्रितैः पूजा कर्तव्येयं त्रिभिः सदा ..
मनसा पूजयेद्योगी पुष्पैश्चारण्यसंभवैः .. 8 ..
text_mt: This worship must always be performed by those devoted to the god through three [means]: / a yogin should worship in his mind, and with wild flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
devārthapuṣpahiṃsāyāṃ na bhavettasya hiṃsakaḥ ..
yadyalpamapi cātmārthaṃ nihanyāddhiṃsakastadā .. 9 ..
meaning:
देवार्थपुष्पहिंसायां न भवेत्तस्य हिंसकः ..
यद्यल्पमपि चात्मार्थं निहन्याद्धिंसकस्तदा .. 9 ..
text_mt: In harming flowers for the sake of the god, one is not a slayer; / if he should destroy even a little for his own sake, he is then a slayer.

sanskrit_iast:
magaścāgniparo nityaṃ tadbhakto'tithipūjakaḥ ..
magī maithunavarjyaḥ syācchrīmāngṛhamagāśramī .. 1.171.10 ..
meaning:
मगश्चाग्निपरो नित्यं तद्भक्तोऽतिथिपूजकः ..
मगी मैथुनवर्ज्यः स्याच्छ्रीमान्गृहमगाश्रमी .. 1.171.10 ..
text_mt: A Maga is ever devoted to the fire, devoted to Him, and an honourer of guests; / a Maga, fortunate and living in the stage of a householder-Maga, should abstain from sexual intercourse [at forbidden times].

sanskrit_iast:
devāgnisvatithau bhaktaṃ pacate cātmakāraṇāt ..
ātmārthe yaḥ pacenmohātsa mago narakaṃ vrajet .. 11 ..
meaning:
देवाग्निस्वतिथौ भक्तं पचते चात्मकारणात् ..
आत्मार्थे यः पचेन्मोहात्स मगो नरकं व्रजेत् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Cooked food is for the god, the fire, and one's guest, not for one's own sake; / he who out of delusion cooks for himself, that Maga goes to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
devārthe pacanaṃ yeṣāṃ saṃtānārthaṃ tu maithunam ..
artho dānārthaṃ uddiṣṭo narakaṃ hi viparyayāt.. .. 12 ..
meaning:
देवार्थे पचनं येषां संतानार्थं तु मैथुनम् ..
अर्थो दानार्थं उद्दिष्टो नरकं हि विपर्ययात्.. .. 12 ..
text_mt: For those whose cooking is for the god, whose sexual intercourse is for offspring, / and whose wealth is designated for gifts—the reverse leads indeed to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
jīvatṛtīyabhāgepi na prakurvīta vārcanam ..
vittārjane tadardhena yato nityaṃ hi jīvitam .. 13 ..
meaning:
जीवतृतीयभागेपि न प्रकुर्वीत वार्चनम् ..
वित्तार्जने तदर्धेन यतो नित्यं हि जीवितम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: One should not perform worship with the third part of one's livelihood; / for life is sustained daily by acquiring wealth with half of it.

sanskrit_iast:
nyāyopārjitavittaḥ syādanyāyaṃ pari varjayet ..
anyāyārjitavittaistu kurvannarakamāpnuyāt .. 14 ..
meaning:
न्यायोपार्जितवित्तः स्यादन्यायं परि वर्जयेत् ..
अन्यायार्जितवित्तैस्तु कुर्वन्नरकमाप्नुयात् .. 14 ..
text_mt: One should have wealth acquired justly, and should entirely avoid injustice; / performing [rites] with wealth acquired unjustly, one attains hell.

sanskrit_iast:
vācorthe brahmacārī yaḥ sūryapūjāgnitatparaḥ ..
bhavejjiteṃdriyaḥ śāṃto naiṣṭhiko bhauti ko'pi vā .. 15 ..
meaning:
वाचोर्थे ब्रह्मचारी यः सूर्यपूजाग्नितत्परः ..
भवेज्जितेंद्रियः शांतो नैष्ठिको भौति कोऽपि वा .. 15 ..
text_mt: A student of the Veda who speaks for the truth, intent on the fire and the worship of Sūrya, / should have conquered his senses, be tranquil, whether a lifelong student or a temporary one.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvagaṃdhavinirmuktaḥ kaṃdamūlaphalāśanaḥ ..
mama vaikhānaso jñeyaḥ sūryapūjāgnitatparaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
सर्वगंधविनिर्मुक्तः कंदमूलफलाशनः ..
मम वैखानसो ज्ञेयः सूर्यपूजाग्नितत्परः .. 16 ..
text_mt: Free from all perfumes, eating roots, bulbs, and fruits, / intent on the fire and the worship of Sūrya, he should be known as my forest-dwelling anchorite.

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛttaḥ saṃgamebhyastu sūryadhyāna rataḥ sadā ..
jñeyaḥ saurayatīṃdrāya pūjāniṣṭho jiteṃdriyaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
निवृत्तः संगमेभ्यस्तु सूर्यध्यान रतः सदा ..
ज्ञेयः सौरयतींद्राय पूजानिष्ठो जितेंद्रियः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Turned away from company, ever delighting in meditation on Sūrya, / steadfast in worship, with senses conquered, he should be known as a supreme solar ascetic.

sanskrit_iast:
muṃḍopanayano vyaṃgī śuklavāsaḥ samanvitaḥ ..
jñeyaṃ tadarcanasthānametatkāryaṃ prayatnataḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
मुंडोपनयनो व्यंगी शुक्लवासः समन्वितः ..
ज्ञेयं तदर्चनस्थानमेतत्कार्यं प्रयत्नतः .. 18 ..
text_mt: Having a shaven head and the sacred thread, wearing an avyaṅga, clad in white garments— / that should be known as his place of worship; this must be performed with effort.

sanskrit_iast:
athāvyaṃgo mahārāja dhārayedyastu bhojakaḥ ..
agamyaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati .. 19 ..
meaning:
अथाव्यंगो महाराज धारयेद्यस्तु भोजकः ..
अगम्यं सर्वसत्त्वानां सूर्यलोकं स गच्छति .. 19 ..
text_mt: Now, O great king, whatever Bhojaka wears an avyaṅga / goes to the realm of Sūrya, which is inaccessible to all living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
dhvaṃsanaṃ sarvaduṣṭānāṃ sarvapāpa bhayāpaham ..
bhāvaśuddhena satatamarcanīyo divākaraḥ .. 1.171.20 ..
meaning:
ध्वंसनं सर्वदुष्टानां सर्वपाप भयापहम् ..
भावशुद्धेन सततमर्चनीयो दिवाकरः .. 1.171.20 ..
text_mt: The Sun, the destroyer of all wicked ones, the remover of all sin and fear, / must constantly be worshipped by one whose mind is pure.

sanskrit_iast:
