सर्वत्रलोचना देवी वर्णतः कर्बुरारुणा .. 9 ..
text_mt: Mounted upon the elephant Airāvata, thunderbolt in hand, of great strength, / the goddess with eyes everywhere, variegated and red in colour,

sanskrit_iast:
siddhagaṃdharvanamitā sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitā ..
iṃdrāṇī te sadā devī śāṃtimāśu karotu vai .. 1.177.10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
varāhaghoṇā vikaṭā varāhavaravāhinī ..
śyāmāvadātā yā devī śaṃkhacakragadādharā .. 11 ..

वराहघोणा विकटा वराहवरवाहिनी ..
श्यामावदाता या देवी शंखचक्रगदाधरा .. 11 ..
text_mt: Having the snout of a boar, formidable, riding upon an excellent boar, / the goddess dark and fair, bearing conch, discus, and mace,

text_mt: illuminating the twilights, ever worshipping the sun, / may the goddess Vārāhī, bestower of boons, indeed bring about peace for you.

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: Half-sheathed, emaciated at the waist, fleshless through the binding of tendons, / of dreadful mouth, terrifying, brandishing sword and bell, virtuous,

text_mt: wearing a garland of skulls, cruel, bearing an excellent skull-staff, / reddish, with tawny eyes, wrapped in an elephant-hide,

sanskrit_iast:
gośrutābharaṇā devī pretasthānanivāsinī ..
śivārūpeṇa ghoreṇa śivarūpabhayaṃkarī ..
cāmuṃḍā caṃḍarūpeṇa sadā śāṃtiṃ karotu te .. 15 ..

गोश्रुताभरणा देवी प्रेतस्थाननिवासिनी ..
शिवारूपेण घोरेण शिवरूपभयंकरी ..
चामुंडा चंडरूपेण सदा शांतिं करोतु ते .. 15 ..
text_mt: the goddess with renowned ornaments, dwelling in the abode of pretas, / having a terrible form with jackals, frightening in the form of Śiva, / in her fierce form, may Cāmuṇḍā ever bring about peace for you.

sanskrit_iast:
caṃḍamuṃḍakarā devī muṃḍadehagatā satī ..

चंडमुंडकरा देवी मुंडदेहगता सती ..
कपालमालिनी क्रूरा खट्वांगवरधारिणी .. 16 ..
text_mt: The goddess holding the heads of Caṇḍa and Muṇḍa, standing on headless bodies, virtuous, / wearing a garland of skulls, cruel, bearing an excellent skull-staff,

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:
आकाशमातरो देव्यस्तथान्या लोकमातरः ..

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: May all the great goddess Mothers, their hands occupied with their own weapons, / remaining pervasive throughout the universe, desiring offerings, of great fortune,

text_mt: ever bring about peace, engaged in the adoration of Āditya; / tranquil with peaceful minds, bestowing peace for the sake of your tranquility.

साक्षादागत्य रूपेण शांतेनामिततेजसा ..
शांतिं करोतु ते प्रीता आदित्या राधने रता .. 25 .. ..
text_mt: having arrived directly in her peaceful form of boundless splendour, / may she, delighted and engaged in the adoration of Āditya, bring about peace for you.

sanskrit_iast:

Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-seventh chapter, on the procedure of the fire sacrifice in the Daśamukha section, in the duties pertaining to the Sun in the Saptamīkalpa of the Brāhmaparvan in the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.

text_mt: Resembling sapphire, three-eyed, raising a blazing spear as his weapon, / wearing red garments, glorious, black-bodied, adorned with snakes,

धनुश्चक्रप्रहरणा खङ्गपट्टिशधारिणी .. 12 ..
text_mt: With a glossy dark complexion, the crusher of the great buffalo, / wielding a bow and a discus as weapons, carrying a sword and a paṭṭiśa,

sūryārcanaratā nityaṃ sūryabhāvānubhāvitāḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
पुनर्वसुस्तथा पुष्य आश्लेषा च तथाधिप ..
सूर्यार्चनरता नित्यं सूर्यभावानुभाविताः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Punarvasu as well, Puṣya, and likewise Āśleṣā, O lord, / constantly devoted to sun-worship, suffused with devotion to the sun, 2

sanskrit_iast:
arcayaṃti sadā devamādityaṃ surate sadā ..
nakṣatramātaro hyetāḥ prabhāmālāvibhūṣitāḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
अर्चयंति सदा देवमादित्यं सुरते सदा ..
नक्षत्रमातरो ह्येताः प्रभामालाविभूषिताः .. 3 ..
text_mt: Ever worship the god Āditya, constantly for the sake of the gods; / for these mother-stars are adorned with garlands of radiance. 3

sanskrit_iast:
maghā sarvaguṇopetā pūrvā caiva tu phālgunī ..
svātī viśākhā varadā dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritāḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
मघा सर्वगुणोपेता पूर्वा चैव तु फाल्गुनी ..
स्वाती विशाखा वरदा दक्षिणां दिशमाश्रिताः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Maghā endowed with all virtues, and Pūrvaphalgunī, / Svātī, and boon-bestowing Viśākhā, situated in the southern direction, 4

sanskrit_iast:
arcayaṃti sadā devamādityaṃ surapūjitam ..
tavāpi śāṃtikaṃ dyotaṃ kurvaṃtu gaganoditāḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
अर्चयंति सदा देवमादित्यं सुरपूजितम् ..
तवापि शांतिकं द्योतं कुर्वंतु गगनोदिताः .. 5 ..
text_mt: Ever worship the god Āditya, worshipped by the gods; / risen in the sky, may they bring about peaceful light for you as well. 5

sanskrit_iast:
anurādhā tathā jyeṣṭhā mūlaṃ sūryapuraḥsarā ..
pūrvāṣāḍhā mahāvīryā āṣāḍhā cottarā tathā .. 6 ..
meaning:
अनुराधा तथा ज्येष्ठा मूलं सूर्यपुरःसरा ..
पूर्वाषाढा महावीर्या आषाढा चोत्तरा तथा .. 6 ..
text_mt: Anurādhā, and Jyeṣṭhā, Mūla following the sun, / Pūrvāṣāḍhā of great valour, and likewise Uttarāṣāḍhā, 6

sanskrit_iast:
abhijinnāma nakṣatraṃ śravaṇaṃ ca bahuśrutam ..
etāḥ paścimato dīptā rājaṃte cānu mūrtayaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
अभिजिन्नाम नक्षत्रं श्रवणं च बहुश्रुतम् ..
एताः पश्चिमतो दीप्ता राजंते चानु मूर्तयः .. 7 ..
text_mt: The asterism named Abhijit, and Śravaṇa of wide renown— / these blazing forms shine forth in succession in the west. 7

sanskrit_iast:
bhāskaraṃ pūjayaṃtyetāḥ sarvakālaṃ subhāvitāḥ ..
śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te nityaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca maharddhikām ..8..
meaning:
भास्करं पूजयंत्येताः सर्वकालं सुभाविताः ..
शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते नित्यं विभूतिं च महर्द्धिकाम् ..8..
text_mt: Filled with noble devotion, they worship the sun at all times; / may they constantly bring you peace and prosperity of great abundance. 8

sanskrit_iast: dhaniṣṭhā śatabhiṣā tu pūrvabhādrapadā tathā .. 9 ..
meaning: धनिष्ठा शतभिषा तु पूर्वभाद्रपदा तथा .. 9 ..
text_mt: Dhaniṣṭhā, Śatabhiṣaj, and Pūrvabhādrapadā, 9

sanskrit_iast:
uttarā bhādrarevatyau cāśvinī ca mahāmate ..
bharaṇī ca mahādevī nityamuttarataḥ sthitāḥ .. 1.179.10 ..
meaning:
उत्तरा भाद्ररेवत्यौ चाश्विनी च महामते ..
भरणी च महादेवी नित्यमुत्तरतः स्थिताः .. 1.179.10 ..
text_mt: Uttarabhādrapadā, Revatī, and Aśvinī, O noble-minded one, / and the great goddess Bharaṇī, ever situated in the north, 10

sanskrit_iast:
sūryārcanaratā nityamādityagatamā nasāḥ ..
śāṃtiṃ kurvatu te nityaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca maharddhikām .. 11 ..
meaning:
सूर्यार्चनरता नित्यमादित्यगतमा नसाः ..
शांतिं कुर्वतु ते नित्यं विभूतिं च महर्द्धिकाम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Constantly devoted to sun-worship, their minds focused on Āditya, / may they constantly bring you peace and prosperity of great abundance. 11

sanskrit_iast:
meṣo mṛgādhipaḥ siṃho dhanurdīptimatāṃ varaḥ ..
pūrveṇa bhāsayaṃtyete sūryayogaparāḥ śubhāḥ ..
śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te nityaṃ bhaktyā sūryapadāṃbuje .. 12 ..
meaning:
मेषो मृगाधिपः सिंहो धनुर्दीप्तिमतां वरः ..
पूर्वेण भासयंत्येते सूर्ययोगपराः शुभाः ..
शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते नित्यं भक्त्या सूर्यपदांबुजे .. 12 ..
text_mt: Aries, Leo the king of beasts, and Sagittarius the best of the radiant ones; / shining in the east, these auspicious signs are intent on union with the sun; / through devotion to the sun's lotus feet, may they constantly grant you peace. 12

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣaḥ kanyā ca paramā makaraścāpi buddhimān ..
ete dakṣiṇabhāge tu pūjayaṃti raviṃ sadā ..
bhaktyā paramayā nityaṃ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā ..13..
meaning:
वृषः कन्या च परमा मकरश्चापि बुद्धिमान् ..
एते दक्षिणभागे तु पूजयंति रविं सदा ..
भक्त्या परमया नित्यं शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा ..13..
text_mt: Taurus, the supreme Virgo, and wise Capricorn; / these in the southern quarter ever worship the sun; / with supreme devotion, may they ever bring peace to you. 13

sanskrit_iast:
mithunaṃ ca tulā kuṃbhaḥ paścime ca vyavasthitāḥ ..
japaṃtyete sadākālamādityaṃ grahanāya kam .. 14 ..
meaning:
मिथुनं च तुला कुंभः पश्चिमे च व्यवस्थिताः ..
जपंत्येते सदाकालमादित्यं ग्रहनाय कम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Gemini, Libra, and Aquarius, situated in the west; / they at all times chant [the praise of] Āditya, the lord of the planets. 14

sanskrit_iast:
śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te nityaṃ khakholkājñānatatparāḥ ..
satapodattapuṣpābhyāṃ ye smṛtā satataṃ budhaiḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते नित्यं खखोल्काज्ञानतत्पराः ..
सतपोदत्तपुष्पाभ्यां ये स्मृता सततं बुधैः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Intent upon the wisdom of Khakholka, may they constantly grant you peace; / they who are continuously remembered by the wise with austerity and offerings of flowers. 15

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayaḥ sapta vikhyātā dhruvāṃtāḥ praramojjvalāḥ ..
bhānuprasādātsaṃpannāḥ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā .. 16 ..
meaning:
ऋषयः सप्त विख्याता ध्रुवांताः प्ररमोज्ज्वलाः ..
भानुप्रसादात्संपन्नाः शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा .. 16 ..
text_mt: The renowned seven sages, ending with Dhruva, supremely radiant, / perfected through the grace of the sun—may they ever bring peace to you: 16

sanskrit_iast:
kaśyapo gālavo gārgyo viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ ..
munirdakṣo vaśiṣṭhaśca mārkaṇḍaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
कश्यपो गालवो गार्ग्यो विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः ..
मुनिर्दक्षो वशिष्ठश्च मार्कण्डः पुलहः क्रतुः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Kaśyapa, Gālava, Gārgya, the great sage Viśvāmitra, / the sage Dakṣa, Vasiṣṭha, Mārkaṇḍa, Pulaha, Kratu, 17

sanskrit_iast:
nārado bhṛgurātreyo bhāradvājaśca vai muniḥ ..
vālmīkiḥ kauśiko vātsyaḥ śākalyo'tha punarvasuḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
नारदो भृगुरात्रेयो भारद्वाजश्च वै मुनिः ..
वाल्मीकिः कौशिको वात्स्यः शाकल्योऽथ पुनर्वसुः .. 18 ..
text_mt: Nārada, Bhṛgu, Ātreya, and indeed the sage Bhāradvāja, / Vālmīki, Kauśika, Vātsya, Śākalya, and Punarvasu, 18

sanskrit_iast:
śālaṃkāyana ityete ṛṣayo'tha mahātapāḥ ..
sūryadhyānaikaparamāḥ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā.. 19 ..
meaning:
शालंकायन इत्येते ऋषयोऽथ महातपाः ..
सूर्यध्यानैकपरमाः शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा.. 19 ..
text_mt: Śālaṅkāyana—these sages of great austerities, / wholly devoted to meditation on the sun, may they ever grant peace to you. 19

sanskrit_iast:
munikanyā mahābhāgā ṛṣikanyāḥ kumārikāḥ ..
sūryārcanaratā nityaṃ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā .. 1.179.20 ..
meaning:
मुनिकन्या महाभागा ऋषिकन्याः कुमारिकाः ..
सूर्यार्चनरता नित्यं शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा .. 1.179.20 ..
text_mt: The fortunate daughters of the munis, the maiden daughters of the sages, / constantly devoted to sun-worship, may they ever grant peace to you. 20

sanskrit_iast:
siddhāḥ samṛddhatapaso ye cānye vai mahātapāḥ ..
vidyādharā mahātmāno garuḍaśca tvayā saha .. 21 ..
meaning:
सिद्धाः समृद्धतपसो ये चान्ये वै महातपाः ..
विद्याधरा महात्मानो गरुडश्च त्वया सह .. 21 ..
text_mt: The siddhas of abundant ascetic power, and whatever other [sages] of great austerities, / the noble vidyādharas, and Garuḍa along with you, 21

sanskrit_iast:
ādityaparamā hyete ādityārādhane ratāḥ ..
siddhiṃ te saṃprayacchaṃtu āśīrvādaparāyaṇāḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
आदित्यपरमा ह्येते आदित्याराधने रताः ..
सिद्धिं ते संप्रयच्छंतु आशीर्वादपरायणाः .. 22 ..
text_mt: Devoted to Āditya, intent upon worshipping Āditya, / intent on blessings, may they bestow accomplishment upon you. 22

sanskrit_iast:
namucirdaityarājedraḥ śaṃkukarṇo mahābalaḥ ..
mahānātho'tha vikhyāto daityaḥ paramavīryavān .. 23 ..
meaning:
नमुचिर्दैत्यराजेद्रः शंकुकर्णो महाबलः ..
महानाथोऽथ विख्यातो दैत्यः परमवीर्यवान् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Namuci, the lord among kings of daityas, Śaṅkukarṇa of great strength, / and the renowned Mahānātha, a daitya of supreme prowess, 23

sanskrit_iast:
grahādhipasya devasya nityaṃ pūjāparāyaṇāḥ ..
balaṃ vīryaṃ ca te ṛddhimārogyaṃ ca bruvaṃtu te ..24..
meaning:
ग्रहाधिपस्य देवस्य नित्यं पूजापरायणाः ..
बलं वीर्यं च ते ऋद्धिमारोग्यं च ब्रुवंतु ते ..24..
text_mt: Ever devoted to the worship of the god who is the lord of planets— / may they declare strength, prowess, prosperity, and health for you. 24

sanskrit_iast:
mahāḍhyo yo hayagrīvaḥ prahlādaḥ prabhayānvitaḥ ..
tānaikāgnimukho daityaḥ kālanemirmahābalaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
महाढ्यो यो हयग्रीवः प्रह्लादः प्रभयान्वितः ..
तानैकाग्निमुखो दैत्यः कालनेमिर्महाबलः .. 25 ..
text_mt: The very wealthy Hayagrīva, Prahlāda endowed with lustre, / the daitya Tānaikāgnimukha, and Kālanemi of great strength, 25

sanskrit_iast:
ete daityā mahātmānaḥ sūryabhāvena bhāvitāḥ ...
tuṣṭiṃ balaṃ tathā''rogyaṃ prayacchaṃtu surārayaḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
एते दैत्या महात्मानः सूर्यभावेन भाविताः ...
तुष्टिं बलं तथा'ऽरोग्यं प्रयच्छंतु सुरारयः .. 26 ..
text_mt: These noble daityas, suffused with devotion to the sun, / may these enemies of the gods grant contentment, strength, and health. 26

sanskrit_iast:
vairocano hiraṇyākṣasturvasuśca sulocanaḥ ..
mucakuṃdo mukuṃdaśca daityo raivatakastathā ..27..
meaning:
वैरोचनो हिरण्याक्षस्तुर्वसुश्च सुलोचनः ..
मुचकुंदो मुकुंदश्च दैत्यो रैवतकस्तथा ..27..
text_mt: Virocana's son [Bali], Hiraṇyākṣa, Turvasu, Sulocana, / Mucukunda, Mukunda, and the daitya Raivataka, 27

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvena parameṇemaṃ yajaṃte satataṃ ravim ..
satataṃ ca śubhātmānaḥ puṣṭiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā .. 28 ..
meaning:
भावेन परमेणेमं यजंते सततं रविम् ..
सततं च शुभात्मानः पुष्टिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा .. 28 ..
text_mt: Continuously worship this sun with supreme devotion; / may these auspicious-natured ones ever bring nourishment to you. 28

sanskrit_iast:
daityapatayo mahābhāgā daityānāṃ kanyakāḥ śubhāḥ ..
kumārā ye ca daityānāṃ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā .. 29 ..
meaning:
दैत्यपतयो महाभागा दैत्यानां कन्यकाः शुभाः ..
कुमारा ये च दैत्यानां शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा .. 29 ..
text_mt: The fortunate lords of the daityas, the auspicious daughters of the daityas, / and the young sons of the daityas, may they ever grant peace to you. 29

sanskrit_iast:
āraktena śarīraṇa raktāṃtāyatalocanāḥ ..
mahābhāgāḥ kṛtāṭopāḥ śaṃkhādyāḥ kṛtalakṣaṇāḥ .. 1.179.30 ..
meaning:
आरक्तेन शरीरण रक्तांतायतलोचनाः ..
महाभागाः कृताटोपाः शंखाद्याः कृतलक्षणाः .. 1.179.30 ..
text_mt: With reddish bodies, wide eyes with red corners, / glorious, displaying their hoods, Śaṅkha and the others, marked with auspicious signs; 30

sanskrit_iast:
anaṃto nāgarājeṃdra ādityārādhane rataḥ ..
mahāpāpaviṣaṃ hatvā śāṃtimāśu karotu te .. 31 ..
meaning:
अनंतो नागराजेंद्र आदित्याराधने रतः ..
महापापविषं हत्वा शांतिमाशु करोतु ते .. 31 ..
text_mt: Ananta, the foremost king among nāgas, devoted to the worship of Āditya, / having destroyed the poison of great sins, may he swiftly grant peace to you. 31

sanskrit_iast:
atipītena dehena visphuradbhogasaṃpadā ..
tejasā cātidīptena kṛtasvastikalāṃchanaḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
अतिपीतेन देहेन विस्फुरद्भोगसंपदा ..
तेजसा चातिदीप्तेन कृतस्वस्तिकलांछनः .. 32 ..
text_mt: With an intensely yellow body, displaying an abundance of glittering hoods, / and with exceedingly brilliant splendour, bearing the mark of the svastika, 32

sanskrit_iast:
nāgarāṭ takṣakaḥ śrīmānnāmakoṭyā samanvitaḥ ..
karotu te mahāśāṃtiṃ sarvadoṣaviṣāpahām .. 33 ..
meaning:
नागराट् तक्षकः श्रीमान्नामकोट्या समन्वितः ..
करोतु ते महाशांतिं सर्वदोषविषापहाम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: May the glorious Takṣaka, king of nāgas, accompanied by millions of names, / bring about great peace for you, removing all afflictions and poisons. 33

sanskrit_iast:
atikṛṣṇena varṇena sphuṭādhikaṭamastakaḥ ..
kaṃṭharekhātrayopeto ghoradaṃṣṭrāyudhodyataḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
अतिकृष्णेन वर्णेन स्फुटाधिकटमस्तकः ..
कंठरेखात्रयोपेतो घोरदंष्ट्रायुधोद्यतः .. 34 ..
text_mt: Intensely black in colour, with an expansive, prominent crest, / endowed with three lines on his neck, raising fierce fangs as weapons, 34

sanskrit_iast:
karkoṭako mahānāgo viṣadarpabalānvitaḥ ..
viṣaśastrāgnisaṃtāpaṃ hatvā śāṃtiṃ karotu te .. 35 ..
meaning:
कर्कोटको महानागो विषदर्पबलान्वितः ..
विषशस्त्राग्निसंतापं हत्वा शांतिं करोतु ते .. 35 ..
text_mt: May the great nāga Karkoṭaka, endowed with the strength and pride of poison, / having dispelled the torment of poison, weapons, and fire, grant peace to you. 35

sanskrit_iast:
padmavarṇaḥ padmakāntiḥ phullapadmāyatekṣaṇaḥ ..
khyātaḥ padmo mahānāgo nityaṃ bhāskarapūjakaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
पद्मवर्णः पद्मकान्तिः फुल्लपद्मायतेक्षणः ..
ख्यातः पद्मो महानागो नित्यं भास्करपूजकः .. 36 ..
text_mt: Lotus-coloured, having the lustre of a lotus, with eyes wide like blooming lotuses, / the famous great nāga Padma, who constantly worships the sun, 36

sanskrit_iast:
sa te śāṃti śubhaṃ śīghramacalaṃ saṃprayacchatu ..
śyāmena dehabhāreṇa śrīmatkamalalocanaḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
स ते शांति शुभं शीघ्रमचलं संप्रयच्छतु ..
श्यामेन देहभारेण श्रीमत्कमललोचनः .. 37 ..
text_mt: May he quickly grant you peace, auspiciousness, and stability, / [he who has] beautiful lotus eyes and a massive, dark-hued body,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣadarpabalonmatto grīvāyāṃ rekhayānvitaḥ ..
śaṃkhapālaśriyā dīptaḥ sūryapādābjapūjakaḥ .. 38...
mahāviṣaṃ garaśreṣṭhaṃ hatvā śāṃtiṃ karotu te ..
atigaureṇa dehena caṃdrārdhakṛtaśekharaḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
विषदर्पबलोन्मत्तो ग्रीवायां रेखयान्वितः ..
शंखपालश्रिया दीप्तः सूर्यपादाब्जपूजकः .. 38...
महाविषं गरश्रेष्ठं हत्वा शांतिं करोतु ते ..
अतिगौरेण देहेन चंद्रार्धकृतशेखरः .. 39 ..
text_mt: Who is intoxicated with the pride and power of his venom, marked with lines on his neck, / radiant with the splendour of Śaṅkhapāla, worshipping the lotus feet of the sun! / Having destroyed great venom and the deadliest poison, may he bring you peace, / [he who has] an exceedingly fair body, crested with the crescent moon,

sanskrit_iast:
dīpabhāge kṛtāṭopaśubhalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ ..
kuliko nāma nāgendro nityaṃ sūryaparāyaṇaḥ ..
apahṛtya viṣaṃ ghoraṃ karotu tava śāṃtikam .. 1.179.40 ..
meaning:
दीपभागे कृताटोपशुभलक्षणलक्षितः ..
कुलिको नाम नागेन्द्रो नित्यं सूर्यपरायणः ..
अपहृत्य विषं घोरं करोतु तव शांतिकम् .. 1.179.40 ..
text_mt: Puffed with pride in his luminous form, distinguished by auspicious marks, / the serpent king named Kulika, ever devoted to the sun! / Having taken away terrible poison, may he bring about peace for you.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃtarikṣe ca ye nāgā ye nāgāḥ svargasaṃsthitāḥ ..
girikaṃdaradurgeṣu ye nāgā bhuvi saṃsthitāḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
अंतरिक्षे च ये नागा ये नागाः स्वर्गसंस्थिताः ..
गिरिकंदरदुर्गेषु ये नागा भुवि संस्थिताः .. 41 ..
text_mt: And whatever serpents dwell in the intermediate space, whatever serpents reside in heaven, / whatever serpents dwell on earth in mountain caves and fastnesses,

sanskrit_iast:
pātāle ye sthitā nāgāḥ sarve yatra samāhitāḥ ..
sūryapādā rcanāsaktāḥ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā ..42..
meaning:
पाताले ये स्थिता नागाः सर्वे यत्र समाहिताः ..
सूर्यपादा र्चनासक्ताः शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा ..42..
text_mt: Whatever serpents dwell in the netherworld, all concentrated together, / intent on worshipping the sun's feet—may they ever bring you peace!

sanskrit_iast:
nāginyo nāgakanyāśca tathā nāgakumārakāḥ ..
sūryabhaktāḥ sumanasaḥ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā ..43..
meaning:
नागिन्यो नागकन्याश्च तथा नागकुमारकाः ..
सूर्यभक्ताः सुमनसः शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा ..43..
text_mt: May the female serpents, the serpent maidens, and likewise the serpent youths, / devoted to the sun and pure of mind, ever bring you peace!

sanskrit_iast:
ya idaṃ nāmasaṃsthānaṃ kīrtayecchṛṇuyāttathā ..
na taṃ sarpā vihiṃsati na viṣaṃ kramate sadā .. 44 ..
meaning:
य इदं नामसंस्थानं कीर्तयेच्छृणुयात्तथा ..
न तं सर्पा विहिंसति न विषं क्रमते सदा .. 44 ..
text_mt: Whoever recites or hears this catalogue of names, / serpents never harm him, nor does poison ever overtake him.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe saura dharmavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..179.. ..
śāntikavarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे सौर धर्मवर्णनं नामैकोनाशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..179.. ..
शान्तिकवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-ninth chapter, entitled "Description of the Solar Dharma," in the Saptamīkalpa of the Brāhmaparvan in the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Peace-Bestowing Rite

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃgā puṇyā mahādevī yamunā narmadā nadī ..
gautamī cāpi kāverī varuṇā devikā tathā ..1..
meaning:
गंगा पुण्या महादेवी यमुना नर्मदा नदी ..
गौतमी चापि कावेरी वरुणा देविका तथा ..1..
text_mt: The sacred, great goddess Gaṅgā, the river Yamunā and Narmadā, / Gautamī as well, Kāverī, Varuṇā, and likewise Devikā—
title: adhyāyaḥ 180

sanskrit_iast:
sarvagrahapatiṃ devaṃ lokeśaṃ lokanāyakam ..
pūjayaṃti sadā nadyaḥ sūryasadbhāvabhāvitāḥ ..
śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te nityaṃ sūryadhyānaikamānasāḥ ..2..
meaning:
सर्वग्रहपतिं देवं लोकेशं लोकनायकम् ..
पूजयंति सदा नद्यः सूर्यसद्भावभाविताः ..
शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते नित्यं सूर्यध्यानैकमानसाः ..2..
text_mt: These rivers, imbued with true devotion to the sun, ever worship / the lord of all planets, the deity, ruler of the worlds, leader of the worlds. / With minds solely intent on meditation upon the sun, may they constantly bring you peace!

sanskrit_iast:
niraṃjanā nāma nadī śoṇaścāpi mahānadaḥ ..
maṃdākinī ca paramā tathā sannihitā śubhā..3..
meaning:
निरंजना नाम नदी शोणश्चापि महानदः ..
मंदाकिनी च परमा तथा सन्निहिता शुभा..3..
text_mt: The river named Nirañjanā and the great river Śoṇa, / the supreme Mandākinī, and likewise the auspicious Sannihitā—

sanskrit_iast:
etāścānyāśca bahavo bhuvi divyaṃtarikṣake..
sūryārcanaratā nadyaḥ kurvaṃtu tava śāṃtikam ..4..
meaning:
एताश्चान्याश्च बहवो भुवि दिव्यंतरिक्षके..
सूर्यार्चनरता नद्यः कुर्वंतु तव शांतिकम् ..4..
text_mt: These and many other rivers on earth, in heaven, and in the intermediate space, / intent on worshipping the sun, may they bring about peace for you!

sanskrit_iast:
mahāvaiśravaṇo devo yakṣarājo maharṣikaḥ ..
yakṣakoṭiparīvāro yakṣasaṃkhyeyasaṃyutaḥ ..5..
meaning:
महावैश्रवणो देवो यक्षराजो महर्षिकः ..
यक्षकोटिपरीवारो यक्षसंख्येयसंयुतः ..5..
text_mt: The great god Vaiśravaṇa, king of the yakṣas, of great power, / surrounded by crores of yakṣas and accompanied by countless yakṣas,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāvibhavasaṃpannaḥ sūryapādārcane rataḥ ..
sūryadhyānaikaparamaḥ sūryabhāvena bhāvitaḥ..6..
meaning:
महाविभवसंपन्नः सूर्यपादार्चने रतः ..
सूर्यध्यानैकपरमः सूर्यभावेन भावितः..6..
text_mt: Endowed with immense power, devoted to worshipping the sun's feet, / wholly dedicated to single-minded meditation upon the sun, imbued with devotion to the sun—

sanskrit_iast:
śāṃtiṃ karotu te prītaḥ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇaḥ ..
māṇibhadro mahāyakṣo maṇiratnavibhūṣitaḥ ..7..
meaning:
शांतिं करोतु ते प्रीतः पद्मपत्रायतेक्षणः ..
माणिभद्रो महायक्षो मणिरत्नविभूषितः ..7..
text_mt: Pleasantly disposed, with eyes long as lotus petals, may he bring you peace! / The great yakṣa Māṇibhadra, adorned with jewels and gems,

sanskrit_iast:
manohareṇa hāreṇa kaṃṭhalagnena rājate ..
yakṣiṇīyakṣakanyābhiḥ parivāritavigrahaḥ ..
sūryārcanasamāsaktaḥ karotu tava śāṃtikam..8..
meaning:
मनोहरेण हारेण कंठलग्नेन राजते ..
यक्षिणीयक्षकन्याभिः परिवारितविग्रहः ..
सूर्यार्चनसमासक्तः करोतु तव शांतिकम्..8..
text_mt: Shines with a captivating necklace clasped about his throat, / his person surrounded by yakṣiṇīs and yakṣa maidens. / Wholly absorbed in worshipping the sun, may he bring about peace for you!

sanskrit_iast:
suciro nāma yakṣeṃdro maṇikuḍala bhūṣitaḥ ..
lalāṭe hemapaṭalaprabaddhena virājate .. 9 ..
meaning:
सुचिरो नाम यक्षेंद्रो मणिकुडल भूषितः ..
ललाटे हेमपटलप्रबद्धेन विराजते .. 9 ..
text_mt: The yakṣa lord named Sucira, adorned with jewelled earrings, / shines with a golden diadem bound upon his forehead.

sanskrit_iast:
bahuyakṣasamākīrṇo yakṣairnamitavigrahaḥ ..
sūryapūjāparo yuktaḥ karotu tava śāṃtikam .. 1.180.10...
meaning:
बहुयक्षसमाकीर्णो यक्षैर्नमितविग्रहः ..
सूर्यपूजापरो युक्तः करोतु तव शांतिकम् .. 1.180.10...
text_mt: Surrounded by many yakṣas, his body bowed to by yakṣas, / devoted to worshipping the sun and disciplined, may he bring about peace for you!

sanskrit_iast:
pāṃciko nāma yakṣeṃdraḥ kaṃṭhābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ..
kukkuṭena vicitreṇa bahuratnānvitena tu .. 11 ..
meaning:
पांचिको नाम यक्षेंद्रः कंठाभरणभूषितः ..
कुक्कुटेन विचित्रेण बहुरत्नान्वितेन तु .. 11 ..
text_mt: The yakṣa lord named Pāñcika, adorned with neck ornaments, / along with a wondrous rooster endowed with many jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣavṛndasamākīrṇo yakṣakoṭisamanvitaḥ ..
sūryārcanakaraḥ śrīmānkarotu tava śāṃtikam .. 12 ..
meaning:
यक्षवृन्दसमाकीर्णो यक्षकोटिसमन्वितः ..
सूर्यार्चनकरः श्रीमान्करोतु तव शांतिकम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Thronged with hosts of yakṣas, accompanied by crores of yakṣas, / who performs the worship of the sun, glorious, may he bring about peace for you!

sanskrit_iast:
dhṛtarāṣṭro mahātejā nānāyakṣādhipaḥ khaga ..
divyapaṭṭaḥ śuklacchatro maṇikāṃcanabhūṣitaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
धृतराष्ट्रो महातेजा नानायक्षाधिपः खग ..
दिव्यपट्टः शुक्लच्छत्रो मणिकांचनभूषितः .. 13 ..
text_mt: Dhṛtarāṣṭra, endowed with great splendour, lord of diverse yakṣas, O bird, / with a celestial silk band and a white royal parasol, adorned with gems and gold,

sanskrit_iast:
sūryabhaktaḥ sūryarataḥ sūryapūjāparāyaṇaḥ ..
sūryaprasādasaṃpannaḥ karotu tava śāṃtikam .. 14 ..
meaning:
सूर्यभक्तः सूर्यरतः सूर्यपूजापरायणः ..
सूर्यप्रसादसंपन्नः करोतु तव शांतिकम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Devoted to the sun, delighting in the sun, dedicated to the worship of the sun, / endowed with the sun's grace, may he bring about peace for you!

sanskrit_iast:
virūpākṣaśca yakṣeṃdraḥ śvetavāsā mahādyutiḥ ..
nānākāṃcanamālābhirupaśobhitakaṃdharaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
विरूपाक्षश्च यक्षेंद्रः श्वेतवासा महाद्युतिः ..
नानाकांचनमालाभिरुपशोभितकंधरः .. 15 ..
text_mt: And the yakṣa lord Virūpākṣa, clad in white, of great lustre, / his neck adorned with garlands of various kinds of gold,

sanskrit_iast:
sūryapūjāparo bhaktaḥ kaṃjākṣaḥ kaṃjasannibhaḥ ..
tejasādityasaṃkāśaḥ karotu tava śāṃtikam .. 16 ..
meaning:
सूर्यपूजापरो भक्तः कंजाक्षः कंजसन्निभः ..
तेजसादित्यसंकाशः करोतु तव शांतिकम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: Devoted to the worship of the sun, faithful, lotus-eyed, resembling a lotus, / equal in brilliance to the sun, may he bring about peace for you!

sanskrit_iast:
aṃtīrakṣagatā yakṣā ye yakṣāḥ svargagāminaḥ ..
nānārūpadharā yakṣāḥ sūryabhaktā dṛḍhavratāḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
अंतीरक्षगता यक्षा ये यक्षाः स्वर्गगामिनः ..
नानारूपधरा यक्षाः सूर्यभक्ता दृढव्रताः .. 17 ..
text_mt: The yakṣas stationed in the intermediate space, the yakṣas who go to heaven, / the yakṣas who assume diverse forms, devoted to the sun and firm in their vows,

sanskrit_iast:
tadbhaktāstadgamanasaḥ sūryapūjāsamutsukāḥ ..
śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te hṛṣṭāḥ śāṃtāḥ śāṃtiparāyaṇāḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
तद्भक्तास्तद्गमनसः सूर्यपूजासमुत्सुकाः ..
शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते हृष्टाः शांताः शांतिपरायणाः .. 18 ..
text_mt: Devoted to him, their minds fixed on him, eager to worship the sun, / delighted, tranquil, dedicated to peace, may they bring you peace!

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣiṇyo vividhākārāstathā yakṣakumārakāḥ ..
yakṣakanyā mahābhāgāḥ sūryārādhanatatparāḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
यक्षिण्यो विविधाकारास्तथा यक्षकुमारकाः ..
यक्षकन्या महाभागाः सूर्याराधनतत्पराः .. 19 ..
text_mt: May the yakṣiṇīs of diverse forms, and likewise the yakṣa youths, / the illustrious yakṣa maidens, intent on worshipping the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
śāṃtiṃ svastyayanaṃ kṣemaṃ balaṃ kalyāṇamuttamam ..
siddhiṃ cāśu prayacchaṃtu nityaṃ ca susamāhitāḥ .. 1.180.20 ..
meaning:
शांतिं स्वस्त्ययनं क्षेमं बलं कल्याणमुत्तमम् ..
सिद्धिं चाशु प्रयच्छंतु नित्यं च सुसमाहिताः .. 1.180.20 ..
text_mt: Quickly grant you peace, blessing, security, strength, supreme welfare, / and accomplishment, ever being well concentrated!

sanskrit_iast:
parvatāḥ sarvataḥ sarve vṛkṣāścaiva maharddhikāḥ ..
sūryabhaktāḥ sadā sarve śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā .. 21 ..
meaning:
पर्वताः सर्वतः सर्वे वृक्षाश्चैव महर्द्धिकाः ..
सूर्यभक्ताः सदा सर्वे शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा .. 21 ..
text_mt: May all the mountains everywhere, and all the trees of great power, / all being ever devoted to the sun, constantly bring you peace!

sanskrit_iast:
sāgarāḥ sarvataḥ sarve gṛhāraṇyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
sūryasyārādhanaparāḥ kurvaṃtu tava śāṃtikam .. 22 ..
meaning:
सागराः सर्वतः सर्वे गृहारण्यानि कृत्स्नशः ..
सूर्यस्याराधनपराः कुर्वंतु तव शांतिकम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: May all the oceans everywhere, the dwellings and the forests in their entirety, / intent upon worshipping the sun, bring about peace for you!

sanskrit_iast:
rākṣasāḥ sarvataḥ sarve ghorarūpā mahābalāḥ ..
sthalajā rākṣasā ye tu aṃtarikṣagatāśca ye ..23..
meaning:
राक्षसाः सर्वतः सर्वे घोररूपा महाबलाः ..
स्थलजा राक्षसा ये तु अंतरिक्षगताश्च ये ..23..
text_mt: May all the rākṣasas everywhere, of terrible forms and great strength— / those rākṣasas born of the earth and those who move through the intermediate space,

sanskrit_iast:
pātāle rākṣasā ye tu nityaṃ sūryārcane ratāḥ ..
śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sarve tejasā nityadīpitāḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
पाताले राक्षसा ये तु नित्यं सूर्यार्चने रताः ..
शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सर्वे तेजसा नित्यदीपिताः .. 24 ..
text_mt: And those rākṣasas in the netherworld, who are ever intent on worshipping the sun, / all ever illumined by splendour, bring you peace!

sanskrit_iast:
pretāḥ pretagaṇāḥ sarve ye pretāḥ sarvatomukhāḥ ..
atidīptāśca ye pretā ye pretā rudhirāśanāḥ ..25...
meaning:
प्रेताः प्रेतगणाः सर्वे ये प्रेताः सर्वतोमुखाः ..
अतिदीप्ताश्च ये प्रेता ये प्रेता रुधिराशनाः ..25...
text_mt: All the pretas and troops of pretas, those pretas whose faces look in all directions, / those pretas who are exceedingly blazing, and those pretas who feed on blood,

sanskrit_iast:
aṃtarikṣe ca ye pretāstathā ye svargavāsinaḥ ..
pātāle bhūtale vāpi ye pretāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
अंतरिक्षे च ये प्रेतास्तथा ये स्वर्गवासिनः ..
पाताले भूतले वापि ये प्रेताः कामरूपिणः .. 26 ..
text_mt: Those pretas in the intermediate space and likewise those dwelling in heaven, / or those pretas in the netherworld or on the earth's surface who change their form at will,

sanskrit_iast:
ekacakro ratho yasya yastu devo vṛṣadhvajaḥ ..
tejasā tasya devasya śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā ..27..
meaning:
एकचक्रो रथो यस्य यस्तु देवो वृषध्वजः ..
तेजसा तस्य देवस्य शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा ..27..
text_mt: Through the splendour of that deity whose chariot has a single wheel / and who bears the bull on his banner, may they ever bring you peace!

sanskrit_iast:
ye piśācā mahāvīryā vṛddhimaṃto mahābalāḥ ..
nānārūpadharāḥ sarve sarve ca guṇavattarāḥ ..28...
meaning:
ये पिशाचा महावीर्या वृद्धिमंतो महाबलाः ..
नानारूपधराः सर्वे सर्वे च गुणवत्तराः ..28...
text_mt: Those piśācas of great prowess, prosperous and mighty, / all assuming diverse forms, and all endowed with superior qualities,

sanskrit_iast:
aṃtarikṣe piśācā ye svarge ye ca mahābalāḥ ..
pātāle bhūtale ye ca bahurūpā manojavāḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
अंतरिक्षे पिशाचा ये स्वर्गे ये च महाबलाः ..
पाताले भूतले ये च बहुरूपा मनोजवाः .. 29 ..
text_mt: Those piśācas in the intermediate space, those of great might in heaven, / and those in the netherworld and on the earth's surface, manifold in form and swift as thought,

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāhaṃ sārathirvīra yasya tvaṃ turagaḥ sadā ..
tejasā tasya devasya śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te'ñjasā .. 1.180.30 ..
meaning:
यस्याहं सारथिर्वीर यस्य त्वं तुरगः सदा ..
तेजसा तस्य देवस्य शांतिं कुर्वंतु तेऽञ्जसा .. 1.180.30 ..
text_mt: Through the splendour of that deity whose charioteer I am, O hero, / and whose steed you ever are, may they swiftly bring you peace!

sanskrit_iast:
apasmāragrahāḥ sarve sarve cāpi jvaragrahāḥ ..
ye ca svargasthitāḥ sarve bhūmigā ye grahottamāḥ .. .. 31 ..
meaning:
अपस्मारग्रहाः सर्वे सर्वे चापि ज्वरग्रहाः ..
ये च स्वर्गस्थिताः सर्वे भूमिगा ये ग्रहोत्तमाः .. .. 31 ..
text_mt: All the seizure-demons of epilepsy and all the seizure-demons of fever, / all those residing in heaven and the foremost seizure-demons roaming on earth,

sanskrit_iast:
pātāle tu grahā ye ca ye grahāḥ sarvato gatāḥ ..
dakṣiṇe kiraṇe yasya sūryasya ca sthito hariḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
पाताले तु ग्रहा ये च ये ग्रहाः सर्वतो गताः ..
दक्षिणे किरणे यस्य सूर्यस्य च स्थितो हरिः .. 32 ..
text_mt: And those seizure-demons in the netherworld, those seizure-demons who go everywhere— / upon whose right ray, the sun's, Hari is stationed,

sanskrit_iast:
haro yasya sadā vāme lalāṭe kaṃjajaḥ sthitaḥ ..
tejasā tasya devasya śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā .. 33 ..
meaning:
हरो यस्य सदा वामे ललाटे कंजजः स्थितः ..
तेजसा तस्य देवस्य शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा .. 33 ..
text_mt: On whose left Hara ever stands, and upon whose forehead the lotus-born [Brahmā] is stationed— / through the splendour of that deity, may they ever bring you peace!

sanskrit_iast:
iti devādayaḥ sarve sūryayajñavidhāyinaḥ ..
kurvaṃtu jagataḥ śāṃtiṃ sūryabhakteṣu sarvadā .. 34 ..
meaning:
इति देवादयः सर्वे सूर्ययज्ञविधायिनः ..
कुर्वंतु जगतः शांतिं सूर्यभक्तेषु सर्वदा .. 34 ..
text_mt: Thus may all beings, beginning with the gods, who perform the sacrifice to the sun, / ever bring peace to the world among the devotees of the sun!

sanskrit_iast:
jayaḥ sūryāya devāya tamohaṃtre vivasvate ..
jayapradāya sūryāya bhāskarāya namostu te .. 35 ..
meaning:
जयः सूर्याय देवाय तमोहंत्रे विवस्वते ..
जयप्रदाय सूर्याय भास्कराय नमोस्तु ते .. 35 ..
text_mt: Victory to the sun, to the deity, to Vivasvat who destroys darkness! / To the sun who grants victory, to the illuminator, homage be to you!

sanskrit_iast:
grahottamāya devāya jayaḥ kalyāṇakāriṇe ..
jayaḥ padmavikāśāya budharūpāya te namaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
ग्रहोत्तमाय देवाय जयः कल्याणकारिणे ..
जयः पद्मविकाशाय बुधरूपाय ते नमः .. 36 ..
text_mt: Victory to the best of planets, the god who causes auspiciousness! / Victory to him who causes the lotus to blossom, who has the form of Budha; reverence to you!

sanskrit_iast:
jayaḥ dīptividhānāya jayaḥ śāṃtividhāyine ..
tamoghnāya jayāyaiva ajitāya namonamaḥ ..37..
meaning:
जयः दीप्तिविधानाय जयः शांतिविधायिने ..
तमोघ्नाय जयायैव अजिताय नमोनमः ..37..
text_mt: Victory to him who ordains radiance, victory to him who ordains peace! / Reverence, reverence to the dispeller of darkness, to Victory, to the Unvanquished!

sanskrit_iast:
jayārka jayadīptīśa sahasrakiraṇojjvala ..
jaya nirmitalokastvamajitāya namonamaḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
जयार्क जयदीप्तीश सहस्रकिरणोज्ज्वल ..
जय निर्मितलोकस्त्वमजिताय नमोनमः .. 38 ..
text_mt: Victory, O Sun! Victory, O Lord of Radiance, blazing with a thousand rays! / Victory, you by whom the world is fashioned; reverence, reverence to the Unvanquished!

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatrīdeharūpāya sāvitrīdayitāya ca ..
dharādharāya sūryāya mārtaṃḍāya namonamaḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
गायत्रीदेहरूपाय सावित्रीदयिताय च ..
धराधराय सूर्याय मार्तंडाय नमोनमः .. 39 ..
text_mt: To him whose body is the form of the Gāyatrī, and who is the beloved of Sāvitrī, / to the supporter of the earth, to the Sun, to Mārtaṇḍa, reverence, reverence!

sanskrit_iast:
sumaṃturuvāca ..
evaṃ hi kurvataḥ śāṃtimaruṇasya mahīpate ..
śreyase vainateyasya garuḍasya mahātmanaḥ .. 1.180.40 ..
meaning:
सुमंतुरुवाच ..
एवं हि कुर्वतः शांतिमरुणस्य महीपते ..
श्रेयसे वैनतेयस्य गरुडस्य महात्मनः .. 1.180.40 ..
text_mt: Sumantu said: / As Aruṇa was thus performing the pacification rite, O king, / for the welfare of the son of Vinatā, the noble Garuḍa, 1.180.40

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu suparṇaḥ patravānabhūt ..
tejasā budhasaṃkāśo valena hariṇā samaḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु सुपर्णः पत्रवानभूत् ..
तेजसा बुधसंकाशो वलेन हरिणा समः .. 41 ..
text_mt: at that very time Suparṇa became possessed of wings, / resembling Budha in brilliance and equal to Hari in strength.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūrṇāvayavo rājanyathāpūrvaṃ tathābhavat ..
prasādāddevadevasya bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
संपूर्णावयवो राजन्यथापूर्वं तथाभवत् ..
प्रसादाद्देवदेवस्य भास्करस्य महात्मनः .. 42 ..
text_mt: With all his limbs complete, O king, he became just as before, / through the grace of the god of gods, the noble Bhāskara.

sanskrit_iast:
evamanye'pi rājeṃdra mānavā ye ca rogiṇaḥ ..
asmitkṛte'gnikārye tu virujāste bhavaṃti hi ..
tasmādyatnena kartavyamagnikāryaṃ vidhānataḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
एवमन्येऽपि राजेंद्र मानवा ये च रोगिणः ..
अस्मित्कृतेऽग्निकार्ये तु विरुजास्ते भवंति हि ..
तस्माद्यत्नेन कर्तव्यमग्निकार्यं विधानतः .. 43 ..
text_mt: In this way other mortal men also, who are sick, O king of kings, / when this fire ritual is performed, indeed become free of disease; / therefore this fire ritual must be performed diligently according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
karaṇīyaṃ ca rājeṃdra mānavaiśca prarogibhiḥ ..
asminkṛte agnikāye virujāste bhavaṃti hi.. 44 ..
meaning:
करणीयं च राजेंद्र मानवैश्च प्ररोगिभिः ..
अस्मिन्कृते अग्निकाये विरुजास्ते भवंति हि.. 44 ..
text_mt: It should also be performed, O king of kings, by men who are deeply afflicted by disease; / when this fire rite is performed, they indeed become free of disease.

sanskrit_iast:
graho paghāte durbhikṣa utpāteṣu ca kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
avarṣamāṇe parjanye lakṣahomasamanvitaḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
ग्रहो पघाते दुर्भिक्ष उत्पातेषु च कृत्स्नशः ..
अवर्षमाणे पर्जन्ये लक्षहोमसमन्वितः .. 45 ..
text_mt: During affliction by evil planets, famine, and in all portents, / and when the rain god does not rain, accompanied by a hundred thousand oblations,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā prasūktaṃ tu dhyātvā vīraṃ prayatnataḥ ..
vāruṇaiśca tathā sūktairhomaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
पूजयित्वा प्रसूक्तं तु ध्यात्वा वीरं प्रयत्नतः ..
वारुणैश्च तथा सूक्तैर्होमं कुर्याद्विचक्षणः .. 46 ..
text_mt: having worshipped well with hymns, and having meditated diligently on the Hero, / the wise man should offer oblations with hymns to Varuṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
cetasā suprasannena sarpiṣā madhunā saha ..
tilairyavaiśca sahitaiḥ pāyasaṃ madhunā tathā .. 47 ..
meaning:
चेतसा सुप्रसन्नेन सर्पिषा मधुना सह ..
तिलैर्यवैश्च सहितैः पायसं मधुना तथा .. 47 ..
text_mt: with a serene mind, together with clarified butter and honey, / accompanied by sesame and barley, and milk-rice with honey as well.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ ca śāṃtikaṃ kuryādbaliṃ dayātprayatnataḥ ..
evaṃ kṛte śriyaṃ devā varṣaṃte kāmanā nṛṇām .. 48 ..
meaning:
इदं च शांतिकं कुर्याद्बलिं दयात्प्रयत्नतः ..
एवं कृते श्रियं देवा वर्षंते कामना नृणाम् .. 48 ..
text_mt: And he should perform this pacification rite and diligently make an offering; / when this is done, the gods shower the desired wealth of men.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ śāṃtikādhyāyaṃ yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādapi ..
vidhinā sarvalokastu dhyāyamāno divākaram.. 49 ..
meaning:
इत्येवं शांतिकाध्यायं यः पठेच्छृणुयादपि ..
विधिना सर्वलोकस्तु ध्यायमानो दिवाकरम्.. 49 ..
text_mt: Whoever recites or even listens to this pacification chapter in this manner, / according to rule, the entire world meditating upon the maker of day,

sanskrit_iast:
sa vijitya raṇe śatruṃ mānaṃ ca paramaṃ labhet ..
akṣayaṃ modate kālamatiraskṛtaśāsanaḥ .. 1.180.50 ..
meaning:
स विजित्य रणे शत्रुं मानं च परमं लभेत् ..
अक्षयं मोदते कालमतिरस्कृतशासनः .. 1.180.50 ..
text_mt: he, having conquered his enemy in battle, obtains supreme honour; / he rejoices for imperishable time, his command never transgressed. 1.180.50

sanskrit_iast:
vyādhibhirnābhibhūyeta putrapautraiḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ..
bhavedādityasadṛśastejasā prabhayā tathā .. 51 ..
meaning:
व्याधिभिर्नाभिभूयेत पुत्रपौत्रैः प्रतिष्ठितः ..
भवेदादित्यसदृशस्तेजसा प्रभया तथा .. 51 ..
text_mt: He would not be overcome by diseases, established with sons and grandsons; / he would become like the sun in brilliance and in radiance.

sanskrit_iast:
yānuddiśya paṭhedvīra vācako mānavo bhuvi..
na pīḍyate ca tai rogairvātapittakaphātmakaiḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
यानुद्दिश्य पठेद्वीर वाचको मानवो भुवि..
न पीड्यते च तै रोगैर्वातपित्तकफात्मकैः .. 52 ..
text_mt: Intending whomsoever the human reciter recites it on earth, O hero, / that person is not tormented by diseases arising from wind, bile, and phlegm.

sanskrit_iast:
nākāle maraṇaṃ tasya na sarpaiścāpi daśyate ..
na viṣaṃ kramate dehe na jaḍāṃdhyaṃ na mūkatā .. 53 ..
meaning:
नाकाले मरणं तस्य न सर्पैश्चापि दश्यते ..
न विषं क्रमते देहे न जडांध्यं न मूकता .. 53 ..
text_mt: There is no untimely death for him, nor is he bitten by serpents; / poison does not take effect in his body, nor is there dullness, blindness, or muteness.

sanskrit_iast:
na cotpatti bhayaṃ tasya nābhicārakajaṃ bhavet ..
ye rogā ye mahotpātā ye'hayaśca mahāviṣāḥ ..
te sarve praśamaṃ yāṃti śravaṇādasya bhārata...54 ..
meaning:
न चोत्पत्ति भयं तस्य नाभिचारकजं भवेत् ..
ये रोगा ये महोत्पाता येऽहयश्च महाविषाः ..
ते सर्वे प्रशमं यांति श्रवणादस्य भारत...54 ..
text_mt: And he has no fear of misfortunes, nor any arising from sorcery; / whatever diseases, whatever great portents, and whatever serpents of terrible venom there are, / they all go to complete cessation from hearing this, O descendant of Bharata.

sanskrit_iast:
yatpuṇyaṃ sarva tīrthānāṃ gaṃgādīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
tatpuṇyaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ prāpnoti śravaṇādibhiḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
यत्पुण्यं सर्व तीर्थानां गंगादीनां विशेषतः ..
तत्पुण्यं कोटिगुणितं प्राप्नोति श्रवणादिभिः .. 55 ..
text_mt: Whatever religious merit belongs to all holy places, especially the Gaṅgā and others, / he attains that merit multiplied ten-millionfold by hearing and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
daśānāṃ rājasūyānāmanyeṣāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ..
jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
दशानां राजसूयानामन्येषां च विशेषतः ..
जीवेद्वर्षशतं साग्रं सर्वव्याधिविवर्जितः .. 56 ..
text_mt: And especially [the merit] of ten Rājasūya sacrifices; / he would live a full hundred years, freed from all diseases.

sanskrit_iast:
goghnaścaiva kṛtaghnaśca brahmahā gurutalpagaḥ ..
śaraṇāgatadīnārtamitraviśrabhaghātakaḥ .. 57 ...
meaning:
गोघ्नश्चैव कृतघ्नश्च ब्रह्महा गुरुतल्पगः ..
शरणागतदीनार्तमित्रविश्रभघातकः .. 57 ...
text_mt: A cow-killer, an ungrateful person, a slayer of a brāhmaṇa, one who violates the teacher's bed, / a slayer of one who has sought refuge, of the poor, the afflicted, or of one who has placed trust as a friend,

sanskrit_iast:
duṣṭaḥ pāpasamācāraḥ pitṛhā mātṛhā tathā ..
śravaṇādasya pāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
दुष्टः पापसमाचारः पितृहा मातृहा तथा ..
श्रवणादस्य पापेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः .. 58 ..
text_mt: a wicked person, one of sinful conduct, a patricide, or a matricide— / from hearing this, he is freed from sins; there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
itihāsamimaṃ puṇyamagnikāryamanuttamam ..
na dadyātkasyacidvīra mūrkhasya kaluṣātmanaḥ .. 59 ..
meaning:
इतिहासमिमं पुण्यमग्निकार्यमनुत्तमम् ..
न दद्यात्कस्यचिद्वीर मूर्खस्य कलुषात्मनः .. 59 ..
text_mt: This holy story and unequalled fire rite, / O hero, one should not give to any foolish, tainted person.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryabhakte sadā deyaṃ sūryeṇa kathitaṃ purā ..
aruṇasya mahābāho garuḍasyāruṇena ca .. 1.180.60 ..
meaning:
सूर्यभक्ते सदा देयं सूर्येण कथितं पुरा ..
अरुणस्य महाबाहो गरुडस्यारुणेन च .. 1.180.60 ..
text_mt: It should always be given to a devotee of the sun; it was told formerly by the sun / to Aruṇa, O mighty-armed one, and by Aruṇa to Garuḍa. 1.180.60

sanskrit_iast:
garuḍena purā proktaṃ bhojakānāṃ mahātmanām ..
sūryaśarmasukhādīnāṃ śākadvīpe mahīpate .. 61 ..
meaning:
गरुडेन पुरा प्रोक्तं भोजकानां महात्मनाम् ..
सूर्यशर्मसुखादीनां शाकद्वीपे महीपते .. 61 ..
text_mt: It was told formerly by Garuḍa to the noble Bhojakas, / Sūryaśarman, Sukha, and others, in Śākadvīpa, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
taiścāpi kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ munervyāsasya dhīmataḥ ..
tenāpi kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpabhayāpaham .. 62 .. ..
smṛtibhedavarṇanam
meaning:
तैश्चापि कथितं पुण्यं मुनेर्व्यासस्य धीमतः ..
तेनापि कथितं पुण्यं सर्वपापभयापहम् .. 62 .. ..
स्मृतिभेदवर्णनम्
text_mt:
And by them was this holy [rite] related to the wise sage Vyāsa; / by him too was it recounted, sacred and removing all sins and fears.
Description of the Divisions of Smṛti

sanskrit_iast:
.. śatānīka uvāca.. ..
paṃcaprakāraṃ dharmaṃ me vada smārtaṃ yathākramam ..
kautukaṃ pṛccha te brahmansamāsavyāsayogataḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. शतानीक उवाच.. ..
पंचप्रकारं धर्मं मे वद स्मार्तं यथाक्रमम् ..
कौतुकं पृच्छ ते ब्रह्मन्समासव्यासयोगतः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śatānīka said: / Speak to me in due order of the fivefold Smārta dharma; / out of curiosity I ask you, O brāhmaṇa, concisely and in detail.
title: Smṛtibhedavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
.. sumanturuvāca .. ..
paṃcadhā varṇitaṃ dharmaṃ śṛṇu rājansamāsataḥ ..
yathoktaṃ bhāskareṇeha aruṇasya mahātmanaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. सुमन्तुरुवाच .. ..
पंचधा वर्णितं धर्मं शृणु राजन्समासतः ..
यथोक्तं भास्करेणेह अरुणस्य महात्मनः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Sumantu said: / Hear briefly, O king, of dharma described as fivefold, / as it was told here by Bhāskara to the noble Aruṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrakiraṇaṃ bhānumudayasthaṃ divākaram ..
praṇamya śirasā devamuvāca garuḍāgrajaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
सहस्रकिरणं भानुमुदयस्थं दिवाकरम् ..
प्रणम्य शिरसा देवमुवाच गरुडाग्रजः .. 3 ..
text_mt: Having bowed his head to the thousand-rayed Bhānu, the maker of day at his rising, / the god, Garuḍa's elder brother spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavandevadeveśa sahasrakiraṇojjvala ..
smṛtidharmānyathātattvaṃ vaktumarhasi pṛcchataḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
भगवन्देवदेवेश सहस्रकिरणोज्ज्वल ..
स्मृतिधर्मान्यथातत्त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि पृच्छतः .. 4 ..
text_mt: O Lord, ruler of the gods of gods, blazing with a thousand rays! / You ought to declare the duties of smṛti as they truly are to me who ask.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pṛṣṭastu bhagavānaruṇena khagādhipaḥ ..
uvāca parayā prītyā pūjayitvā mahīpate .. 5 ..
meaning:
एवं पृष्टस्तु भगवानरुणेन खगाधिपः ..
उवाच परया प्रीत्या पूजयित्वा महीपते .. 5 ..
text_mt: Thus questioned by Aruṇa, the lord, king of birds, / having honoured him, spoke with supreme joy, O king:

sanskrit_iast:
.. .. bhāskara uvāca .. ..
smṛtidharmaṃ vedamūlaṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ garuḍāgraja ..
pūrvānubhūtaṃ yaddhyānamatha tatsmaraṇaṃ smṛtiḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
.. .. भास्कर उवाच .. ..
स्मृतिधर्मं वेदमूलं शृणु त्वं गरुडाग्रज ..
पूर्वानुभूतं यद्ध्यानमथ तत्स्मरणं स्मृतिः .. 6 ..
text_mt: Bhāskara said: / Hear, O elder brother of Garuḍa, the smṛti dharma rooted in the Veda; / that contemplation which has been previously experienced, the recollection of it is smṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaḥ kriyātmā nirdiṣṭaḥ śreyobhyudayalakṣaṇaḥ ..
sa ca pañcavidhaḥ prokto vedamūlaḥ sanātanaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
धर्मः क्रियात्मा निर्दिष्टः श्रेयोभ्युदयलक्षणः ..
स च पञ्चविधः प्रोक्तो वेदमूलः सनातनः .. 7 ..
text_mt: Dharma is defined as consisting of action, characterised by supreme good and prosperity; / and it is declared to be fivefold, rooted in the Veda, and eternal.

sanskrit_iast:
asya śabdasyānuṣṭhānātsvargo mokṣaśca jāyate ..
iha loke sukhaiśvaryamalaṃ yacca khagādhipa .. 8 ..
meaning:
अस्य शब्दस्यानुष्ठानात्स्वर्गो मोक्षश्च जायते ..
इह लोके सुखैश्वर्यमलं यच्च खगाधिप .. 8 ..
text_mt: From the practice of this teaching heaven and liberation arise, / as well as happiness, sovereignty, and sufficient prosperity in this world, O lord of birds.

sanskrit_iast:
.. anūruruvāca .. ..
kathaṃ paṃcavidho hyeṣa prokto dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ..
kasya bhedāstu te paṃca brūhi me devasattama .. 9 .. ..
meaning:
.. अनूरुरुवाच .. ..
कथं पंचविधो ह्येष प्रोक्तो धर्मः सनातनः ..
कस्य भेदास्तु ते पंच ब्रूहि मे देवसत्तम .. 9 .. ..
text_mt: Anūru said: / How is this eternal dharma declared to be fivefold? / What are those five divisions? Tell me, O best of gods!

sanskrit_iast:
.. bhāskara uvāca .. ..
vedadharmaḥ smṛtastveka āśramāṇāṃ sa tatparaḥ ..
varṇāśramastṛtīyastu guṇanaimittiko yathā .. 1.181.10 ..
meaning:
.. भास्कर उवाच .. ..
वेदधर्मः स्मृतस्त्वेक आश्रमाणां स तत्परः ..
वर्णाश्रमस्तृतीयस्तु गुणनैमित्तिको यथा .. 1.181.10 ..
text_mt: Bhāskara said: / One is remembered as the dharma of the Veda, and beyond that is that of the stages of life; / the third is of caste and stage of life, and likewise that which is incidental to a quality, 1.181.10

sanskrit_iast:
varṇatvamekamāśritya adhikāre pravartate ..
savarṇāśramadaṃḍastu bhikṣā daṃḍādiko yathā ..11..
meaning:
वर्णत्वमेकमाश्रित्य अधिकारे प्रवर्तते ..
सवर्णाश्रमदंडस्तु भिक्षा दंडादिको यथा ..11..
text_mt: taking recourse solely in caste, one acts within one's sphere of duty; / such as the staff of caste and stage of life, and begging, staff, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāśramāśramatvaṃ ca yodhikṛtya pravartate..
sa varṇāśramadharmastu daṃḍādyā mekhalā yathā ..12..
meaning:
वर्णाश्रमाश्रमत्वं च योधिकृत्य प्रवर्तते..
स वर्णाश्रमधर्मस्तु दंडाद्या मेखला यथा ..12..
text_mt: And that which proceeds taking its authority from caste, stage of life, and [specific] stage of life, / that is the duty of caste and stage of life, such as the staff and the girdle.

sanskrit_iast:
yo guṇena pravarteta sa guṇo dharma ucyate ..
yathā mūrdhābhiṣiktasya prajānāṃ pālanaṃ param ..13..
meaning:
यो गुणेन प्रवर्तेत स गुणो धर्म उच्यते ..
यथा मूर्धाभिषिक्तस्य प्रजानां पालनं परम् ..13..
text_mt: That which proceeds according to an inherent quality is called the dharma of quality; / such as the supreme protection of the subjects by an anointed king.

sanskrit_iast:
nimittamekamāśritya yo dharmaḥ saṃpravartate ..
naimittikaḥ sa vijñeyo jātidravyaguṇāśrayaḥ ..14..
meaning:
निमित्तमेकमाश्रित्य यो धर्मः संप्रवर्तते ..
नैमित्तिकः स विज्ञेयो जातिद्रव्यगुणाश्रयः ..14..
text_mt: That dharma which proceeds taking recourse to a particular occasion / is to be known as occasional, resting upon class, material, and quality.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa tu dvividhaḥ proktaḥ samāsādaviśeṣataḥ ..
naimittikaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ prāyaścittavidhiryathā .. 15 ..
meaning:
एष तु द्विविधः प्रोक्तः समासादविशेषतः ..
नैमित्तिकः स विज्ञेयः प्रायश्चित्तविधिर्यथा .. 15 ..
text_mt: This is declared to be of two kinds, concisely without differentiation: / it should be understood as occasional, like the rule for expiation.

sanskrit_iast:
sa caturdhā nirūpyastu svarūpaphalasādhanaiḥ ..
pramāṇatastu pratyekasamastaiśca yathākramam .. 16 ..
meaning:
स चतुर्धा निरूप्यस्तु स्वरूपफलसाधनैः ..
प्रमाणतस्तु प्रत्येकसमस्तैश्च यथाक्रमम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: It is to be examined in four ways through essential nature, result, and means, / and from authority, individually and collectively, in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutyā saha virodhe tu bādhyate viṣayaṃ vinā ..
vyavasthayā virodhena kāryo yatnaḥ parīkṣyate ..17..
meaning:
श्रुत्या सह विरोधे तु बाध्यते विषयं विना ..
व्यवस्थया विरोधेन कार्यो यत्नः परीक्ष्यते ..17..
text_mt: When in conflict with Śruti, it is set aside, unless in its own domain; / when there is conflict with an established rule, the effort to be undertaken is examined.

sanskrit_iast:
smṛtyā saha virodhena cārthaśāstrasya sādhanam ..
parasparavirodhe tu arthaśāstrasya sādhanam ..18..
meaning:
स्मृत्या सह विरोधेन चार्थशास्त्रस्य साधनम् ..
परस्परविरोधे तु अर्थशास्त्रस्य साधनम् ..18..
text_mt: When in conflict with Smṛti, the demonstration of the treatise on statecraft [is barred]; / and when there is mutual conflict, the demonstration of the treatise on statecraft [is also barred].

sanskrit_iast:
adṛṣṭārthe vikalpastu vyavasthāsaṃbhave sati ..
smṛtiśāstravikalpastu ākāṃkṣāpūraṇe sati .. 19 ..
meaning:
अदृष्टार्थे विकल्पस्तु व्यवस्थासंभवे सति ..
स्मृतिशास्त्रविकल्पस्तु आकांक्षापूरणे सति .. 19 ..
text_mt: Where an unseen purpose is concerned, an option [is admitted] when an established rule is possible; / but an option among Smṛti treatises [occurs] when a syntactic expectation is fulfilled.

sanskrit_iast:
vedamūle sthitaṃ tvetadanuṣṭhānaṃ kriyā satī ..
evaṃ śakyavidhānaṃ tu nyāyo hyevaṃ vyavasthitaḥ .. 1.181.20 ..
meaning:
वेदमूले स्थितं त्वेतदनुष्ठानं क्रिया सती ..
एवं शक्यविधानं तु न्यायो ह्येवं व्यवस्थितः .. 1.181.20 ..
text_mt: This performance, grounded in the Veda, is a true ritual act; / thus is the prescribed application possible, for this is how the reasoning is settled.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣedhavidhirūpaṃ tu dvidhā śāstraṃ khagādhipa ..
ekarūpaṃ vadaṃtyanye bahurūpamathā pare .. 21 ..
meaning:
निषेधविधिरूपं तु द्विधा शास्त्रं खगाधिप ..
एकरूपं वदंत्यन्ये बहुरूपमथा परे .. 21 ..
text_mt: The scripture is of two kinds, taking the form of prohibition and injunction, O lord of birds; / others say it is of one form, and yet others, of manifold forms.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcaprakārāḥ smṛtaya evaṃ śiṣyavyavasthitāḥ ..
tridhā caturdhā dvedhā vā ekadhā bahudhā khaga .. 22 ..
meaning:
पंचप्रकाराः स्मृतय एवं शिष्यव्यवस्थिताः ..
त्रिधा चतुर्धा द्वेधा वा एकधा बहुधा खग .. 22 ..
text_mt: The Smṛtis are established for pupils in five categories, / or in three, four, two, one, or manifold ways, O bird:

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭārthā tu smṛtiḥ kācidadṛṣṭārthā tathāparā ..
anuvādasmṛtistvanyā dṛṣṭādṛṣṭā tu paṃcamī ..
sarvā etā vedamūlāḥ smṛtā vai ṛṣibhiḥ svayam .. 23 .. ..
meaning:
दृष्टार्था तु स्मृतिः काचिददृष्टार्था तथापरा ..
अनुवादस्मृतिस्त्वन्या दृष्टादृष्टा तु पंचमी ..
सर्वा एता वेदमूलाः स्मृता वै ऋषिभिः स्वयम् .. 23 .. ..
text_mt: One Smṛti has a seen purpose, another has an unseen purpose, / another is a restating Smṛti, and the fifth has both seen and unseen purposes; / all these are remembered by the sages themselves as rooted in the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
.. aruṇa uvāca .. ..
yā etā bhavatā proktāḥ smṛtayaḥ parvagopane ..
etāsāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi samāsādeva sattama .. 24 ..
meaning:
.. अरुण उवाच .. ..
या एता भवता प्रोक्ताः स्मृतयः पर्वगोपने ..
एतासां लक्षणं ब्रूहि समासादेव सत्तम .. 24 ..
text_mt: Aruṇa said: / These Smṛtis that have been declared by you in protecting the divisions— / state their defining characteristics concisely, O best of beings.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭārthā kā matā deva adṛṣṭārthā ca kā bhavet ..
dṛṣṭādṛṣṭasvarūpā kā nyāyamūlā ca kā bhavet ..
anuvādasmṛtiḥ kā syādṛṣṭādṛṣṭā tu kā bhavet .. 25 ..
meaning:
दृष्टार्था का मता देव अदृष्टार्था च का भवेत् ..
दृष्टादृष्टस्वरूपा का न्यायमूला च का भवेत् ..
अनुवादस्मृतिः का स्यादृष्टादृष्टा तु का भवेत् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Which is considered to have a seen purpose, O lord, and which has an unseen purpose? / Which has the nature of both seen and unseen, and which is rooted in reasoning? / Which is a restating Smṛti, and which has both seen and unseen purposes?

sanskrit_iast:
evamukto mahātejā bhāskaro vāritaskaraḥ ..
uvāca taṃ khagaṃ vīraṃ praṇataṃ vinayānvitam .. 26 ..
meaning:
एवमुक्तो महातेजा भास्करो वारितस्करः ..
उवाच तं खगं वीरं प्रणतं विनयान्वितम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: Addressed thus, the resplendent Sun, who wards off thieves, / spoke to that heroic bird, who was bowed and endowed with modesty.

sanskrit_iast:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
ṣaḍguṇasya svarūpaṃ tu prayogā tkāryagauravāt ..
samayānāmupāyānāṃ yogo vyāsasamāsataḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
.. आदित्य उवाच .. ..
षड्गुणस्य स्वरूपं तु प्रयोगा त्कार्यगौरवात् ..
समयानामुपायानां योगो व्याससमासतः .. 27 ..
text_mt: Āditya said: / The nature of the sixfold foreign policy through practical application and importance of tasks, / the combination of agreements and expedients, in detail and in brief,

sanskrit_iast:
adhyakṣāṇāṃ ca nikṣepaḥ karaṇānāṃ nirūpaṇam ..
dṛṣṭārtheyaṃ smṛtiḥ proktā ṛṣibhirgaruḍāgraja .. 28 ..
meaning:
अध्यक्षाणां च निक्षेपः करणानां निरूपणम् ..
दृष्टार्थेयं स्मृतिः प्रोक्ता ऋषिभिर्गरुडाग्रज .. 28 ..
text_mt: the appointment of overseers, and the examination of administrative offices— / this Smṛti is declared by the sages to have a seen purpose, O elder brother of Garuḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyopāstistathā kāryā śuno māṃsaṃ na bhakṣayet ..
adṛṣṭārthā smṛtiḥ proktā manunā vinatātmaja .. 29 ..
meaning:
संध्योपास्तिस्तथा कार्या शुनो मांसं न भक्षयेत् ..
अदृष्टार्था स्मृतिः प्रोक्ता मनुना विनतात्मज .. 29 ..
text_mt: One must perform the twilight worship; one must not eat dog meat— / [such] Smṛti is declared by Manu to have an unseen purpose, O son of Vinatā.

sanskrit_iast:
pālāśaṃ dhārayeddaṃḍamubhayārthā vidurbudhāḥ ..
virodhe tu vikalpaḥ syādyāgo homastato yathā .. 1.181.30 ..
meaning:
पालाशं धारयेद्दंडमुभयार्था विदुर्बुधाः ..
विरोधे तु विकल्पः स्याद्यागो होमस्ततो यथा .. 1.181.30 ..
text_mt: One should carry a staff of palāśa wood: the wise understand this as having both purposes. / But when there is a conflict, an option arises, just as sacrifice and oblation [differ].

sanskrit_iast:
śrutau dṛṣṭaṃ yathā kāryaṃ smṛto tattādṛśaṃ yadi ..
uktānuvādinī sā tu pārivrājyaṃ tathā gṛhāt .. 31 ..
meaning:
श्रुतौ दृष्टं यथा कार्यं स्मृतो तत्तादृशं यदि ..
उक्तानुवादिनी सा तु पारिव्राज्यं तथा गृहात् .. 31 ..
text_mt: If what is seen in Śruti is similarly [enjoined] to be done in Smṛti, / that is an explanatory restatement, as is renunciation from home.

sanskrit_iast:
ukto dharmaśca saṃkṣepātparibhāṣā ca tadgatā ..
tatsādhanaṃ ca deśādi itthamityabravīdraviḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
उक्तो धर्मश्च संक्षेपात्परिभाषा च तद्गता ..
तत्साधनं च देशादि इत्थमित्यब्रवीद्रविः .. 32 ..
text_mt: Dharma has been declared in brief, along with its interpretive conventions, / and its means, region, and so on; thus spoke the Sun:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāvartaḥ paro deśa ṛṣiśastastvanaṃtaraḥ ..
madhyadeśastato'pyanya āryāvartastvanaṃtaraḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मावर्तः परो देश ऋषिशस्तस्त्वनंतरः ..
मध्यदेशस्ततोऽप्यन्य आर्यावर्तस्त्वनंतरः .. 33 ..
text_mt: Brahmāvarta is the supreme country, next is the land praised by the sages; / different from that is Madhyadeśa, and next to it is Āryāvarta.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇasārastu vicarenmṛgo yatra svabhāvataḥ ..
yajñiyaḥ sa tu deśaḥ syānmlecchadeśastataḥ paraḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
कृष्णसारस्तु विचरेन्मृगो यत्र स्वभावतः ..
यज्ञियः स तु देशः स्यान्म्लेच्छदेशस्ततः परः .. 34 ..
text_mt: Where the blackbuck roams by its own nature, / that is the land fit for sacrifice; beyond that lies the country of the mlecchas.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādīnāṃ ca devānāṃ brāhmaṇādestathaiva ca ..
bhūtagrāmasya kṛtsnasya trayaṃ kṛtsnasya khecara .. .. 35 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मादीनां च देवानां ब्राह्मणादेस्तथैव च ..
भूतग्रामस्य कृत्स्नस्य त्रयं कृत्स्नस्य खेचर .. .. 35 ..
text_mt: For Brahmā and the other gods, for the brāhmaṇas and others as well, / and for the whole collection of beings, the three [are valid] for the entirety, O sky-wanderer.

sanskrit_iast:
sādhanatvaṃ manuḥ prāha vedamūlaṃ sanātanam ..
prakāśayajñasaṃsiddhyai yadaśabdasya eva tu .. 36 ..
meaning:
साधनत्वं मनुः प्राह वेदमूलं सनातनम् ..
प्रकाशयज्ञसंसिद्ध्यै यदशब्दस्य एव तु .. 36 ..
text_mt: Manu declared its status as a means, eternal and rooted in the Veda, / for the accomplishment of the manifest sacrifice [...]

sanskrit_iast:
upalabhya yathātattvaṃ sa ca darśitavānṛṣiḥ ..
samyaksaṃsādhanaṃ dharmaḥ kartavyastvadhikāriṇā .. 37 ..
meaning:
उपलभ्य यथातत्त्वं स च दर्शितवानृषिः ..
सम्यक्संसाधनं धर्मः कर्तव्यस्त्वधिकारिणा .. 37 ..
text_mt: Having understood it in accordance with truth, that sage displayed it: / dharma is a complete accomplishment to be performed by one who is qualified,

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkāmena sadā vīra kāmyaṃ rūpānvitena ca ..
ācārayuktaḥ śraddhālurvedajño'dhyātmaciṃtakaḥ ..
karmaṇāṃ phalamāpnoti nyāyārjitadhanaśca yaḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
निष्कामेन सदा वीर काम्यं रूपान्वितेन च ..
आचारयुक्तः श्रद्धालुर्वेदज्ञोऽध्यात्मचिंतकः ..
कर्मणां फलमाप्नोति न्यायार्जितधनश्च यः .. 38 ..
text_mt: always without desire, O hero, and by one endowed with desire for the optional rites. / Endowed with proper conduct, faithful, knowing the Veda, contemplating the self, / and one whose wealth is earned righteously, obtains the fruit of rites.

sanskrit_iast:
.. aruṇa uvāca .. ..
brahmāvartādideśānāṃ samastānāṃ vibhāvaso ..
vibhāgaṃ brūhi deveṃdra saṃmānaya grahādhipa .. 39 ..
meaning:
.. अरुण उवाच .. ..
ब्रह्मावर्तादिदेशानां समस्तानां विभावसो ..
विभागं ब्रूहि देवेंद्र संमानय ग्रहाधिप .. 39 ..
text_mt: Aruṇa said: / State the divisions of all the regions beginning with Brahmāvarta, O Sun; / O lord of the gods, honour [my request], O lord of planets.

sanskrit_iast:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
sarasvatīdṛṣadvatyordevanadyoryadaṃtaram ..
taṃ devanirmitaṃ deśaṃ brahmāvartaṃ pracakṣate .. 1.181.40 ..
meaning:
.. आदित्य उवाच .. ..
सरस्वतीदृषद्वत्योर्देवनद्योर्यदंतरम् ..
तं देवनिर्मितं देशं ब्रह्मावर्तं प्रचक्षते .. 1.181.40 ..
text_mt: Āditya said: / That land situated between the two divine rivers, the Sarasvatī and the Dṛṣadvatī, / fashioned by the gods, is called Brahmāvarta.

sanskrit_iast:
himavadviṃdhyadharayoryadaṃtaramudāhṛtam ..
pratyageva prayāgācca madhyadeśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
āsamudrāttu vai pūrvādāsamudrāttu paścimāt .. 41 ..
meaning:
हिमवद्विंध्यधरयोर्यदंतरमुदाहृतम् ..
प्रत्यगेव प्रयागाच्च मध्यदेशः प्रकीर्तितः ..
आसमुद्रात्तु वै पूर्वादासमुद्रात्तु पश्चिमात् .. 41 ..
text_mt: That which is declared to lie between the Himavat and Vindhya mountains, / west of Prayāga, is celebrated as Madhyadeśa. / From the eastern ocean to the western ocean,

sanskrit_iast:
tayorevāṃtaraṃ giryorāryāvartaṃ vidurbudhāḥ .. āryāvarta
etānvijñāya saddeśāntsaṃśrayeta prayatnataḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
तयोरेवांतरं गिर्योरार्यावर्तं विदुर्बुधाः .. आर्यावर्त
एतान्विज्ञाय सद्देशान्त्संश्रयेत प्रयत्नतः .. 42 ..
text_mt: the region between those very two mountains the wise know as Āryāvarta. / Having known these noble regions, one should take resort in them with diligence.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrastu yasmiṃstasminvā nivasedvṛttikarśitaḥ ..
eṣā dharmasya vai jyotiḥ samāsātkathitā tava .. 43 .. ..
vivāhavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
शूद्रस्तु यस्मिंस्तस्मिन्वा निवसेद्वृत्तिकर्शितः ..
एषा धर्मस्य वै ज्योतिः समासात्कथिता तव .. 43 .. ..
विवाहविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
A śūdra, however, afflicted for a livelihood, may reside anywhere. / This illumination of dharma has been related to you in brief.
Description of the Rules of Marriage

sanskrit_iast:
.. .. āditya uvāca .. ..
uktaṃ dharmasya rūpaṃ tu sādhikāraṃ sanātanam ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dharmamāśramiṇāṃ khaga .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. .. आदित्य उवाच .. ..
उक्तं धर्मस्य रूपं तु साधिकारं सनातनम् ..
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि धर्ममाश्रमिणां खग .. 1 ..
text_mt: Āditya said: / The eternal nature of dharma, along with qualification, has been declared; / hereafter, I shall proclaim the dharma of the people of the orders of life, O bird.
title: Vivāhavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vanastho bhikṣureva ca ..
catvāra āśramāḥ proktā eka eva caturvidhaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मचारी गृहस्थश्च वनस्थो भिक्षुरेव च ..
चत्वार आश्रमाः प्रोक्ता एक एव चतुर्विधः .. 2 ..
text_mt: The student, the householder, the forest-dweller, and the mendicant: / four orders of life are declared; a single one is fourfold.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatro brahmacārī tu prājāpatyo dvitīyakaḥ ..
devavratastṛtīyastu naiṣṭhikastu caturthakaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
गायत्रो ब्रह्मचारी तु प्राजापत्यो द्वितीयकः ..
देवव्रतस्तृतीयस्तु नैष्ठिकस्तु चतुर्थकः .. 3 ..
text_mt: The Gāyatra student is the first, the Prājāpatya is the second, / the Devavrata is the third, and the perpetual student is the fourth.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāra āśramāḥ proktāḥ savedāḥ samadharmakāḥ ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃskāraṃ dharmasiddhaye .. 4 ..
meaning:
चत्वार आश्रमाः प्रोक्ताः सवेदाः समधर्मकाः ..
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि संस्कारं धर्मसिद्धये .. 4 ..
text_mt: Four orders of life are declared, possessing the Vedas and sharing equal duties. / Hereafter, I shall proclaim the life-cycle rites for the attainment of dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
garbhādhānamṛtau kāryaṃ hṛṣṭayostu samantrakam ..
kāryaṃ puṃsavanaṃ mātustṛtīye māsi saṃyutaiḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
गर्भाधानमृतौ कार्यं हृष्टयोस्तु समन्त्रकम् ..
कार्यं पुंसवनं मातुस्तृतीये मासि संयुतैः .. 5 ..
text_mt: The rite of conception is to be performed in the fertile period by a joyous couple, accompanied by mantras; / the rite for quickening a male child is to be performed for the mother in the third month with companions.

sanskrit_iast:
sīmantaḥ saptame garbhe ṣaṣṭhe vā saptame'pi vā ..
pātrasaṃskārakā iṣṭā garbhādhānādayastrayaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
सीमन्तः सप्तमे गर्भे षष्ठे वा सप्तमेऽपि वा ..
पात्रसंस्कारका इष्टा गर्भाधानादयस्त्रयः .. 6 ..
text_mt: The parting of the hair [is performed] in the seventh [month of] pregnancy, or in the sixth or seventh; / the three beginning with the rite of conception are prescribed as sanctifying the receptacle.

sanskrit_iast:
jātakarmādayaḥ sarve saṃskārāḥ puruṣasya tu ..
jātasya prāśanaṃ yatra svarṇā dīnāṃ samantrakam .. 7 ..
meaning:
जातकर्मादयः सर्वे संस्काराः पुरुषस्य तु ..
जातस्य प्राशनं यत्र स्वर्णा दीनां समन्त्रकम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: All the rites beginning with the birth-rite, however, belong to the male person; / the newborn is fed [honey and ghee] with gold and other [utensils], accompanied by mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
jātakarmeti tatproktaṃ guhyaṃ nāma tadaiva tu ..
prakāśo nāma kartavyaṃ dine tvekādaśerthavat .. 8 ..
meaning:
जातकर्मेति तत्प्रोक्तं गुह्यं नाम तदैव तु ..
प्रकाशो नाम कर्तव्यं दिने त्वेकादशेर्थवत् .. 8 ..
text_mt: That is declared to be the birth-rite; the secret name is [given] at that very time, / but the public, meaningful name should be given on the eleventh day.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaśāstrādisaṃyuktaṃ ṣaṣṭhe'nnaprāśanaṃ khaga ..
prathame'bde tṛtīye vā cūḍākarma vidhīyate .. 9 ..
meaning:
धर्मशास्त्रादिसंयुक्तं षष्ठेऽन्नप्राशनं खग ..
प्रथमेऽब्दे तृतीये वा चूडाकर्म विधीयते .. 9 ..
text_mt: The first feeding of solid food, accompanied by Dharmaśāstra [observances], is in the sixth month, O bird; / the tonsure rite is prescribed in the first or third year.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭame daśame vāpi brāhmaṇasyopanāyanam ..
puruṣasya tathā cānyajātīyānāṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 1.182.10 ..
meaning:
अष्टमे दशमे वापि ब्राह्मणस्योपनायनम् ..
पुरुषस्य तथा चान्यजातीयानां विशेषतः .. 1.182.10 ..
text_mt: The sacred thread investiture of a brāhmaṇa is performed in the eighth or tenth [year], / and for a man of the other castes specifically.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśe dvādaśe vā kārya kṣatriyavaiśyayoḥ ..
vedasaṃskārakaṃ vacmi manyante tvaupanāyanam .. 11 ..
meaning:
एकादशे द्वादशे वा कार्य क्षत्रियवैश्ययोः ..
वेदसंस्कारकं वच्मि मन्यन्ते त्वौपनायनम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: In the eleventh or twelfth [year], it should be performed for a kṣatriya and a vaiśya [respectively]. / I shall explain that which purifies through the Veda, but they consider it the investiture [with the sacred thread].

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣasya tathā cānya ubhayośca bravīmyaham ..
sāvitraṃ vaidikaṃ caiva mahānāmnīmahāvratam .. 12 ..
meaning:
पुरुषस्य तथा चान्य उभयोश्च ब्रवीम्यहम् ..
सावित्रं वैदिकं चैव महानाम्नीमहाव्रतम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Likewise, I shall explain the other [observances] for a man, and for both: / the Sāvitra, the Vedic [vow], the Mahānāmnī, and the Mahāvrata,

sanskrit_iast:
tathaupaniṣadaṃ cābdaṃ godānaṃ ca suvarṇakam ..
vratāni grahaṇārthāni vedasyeti manormatam .. 13 ..
meaning:
तथौपनिषदं चाब्दं गोदानं च सुवर्णकम् ..
व्रतानि ग्रहणार्थानि वेदस्येति मनोर्मतम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: and the Aupaniṣada for a year, the Godāna, and the Suvarṇaka. / These vows are for the acquisition of the Veda: such is the opinion of Manu.

sanskrit_iast:
vedaikadeśapāṭhasya uktaṃ gṛhye prapañcakam ..
uktā gurostu śuśrūṣā dṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthasādhanam .. 14 ..
meaning:
वेदैकदेशपाठस्य उक्तं गृह्ये प्रपञ्चकम् ..
उक्ता गुरोस्तु शुश्रूषा दृष्टादृष्टार्थसाधनम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: The detailed procedure for the recitation of a single portion of the Veda is declared in the Gṛhya [sūtra]. / Service to the guru is declared to be the means of accomplishing both seen and unseen aims.

sanskrit_iast:
ubhayorvā tathā cānyā yathānyāyaṃ yathāśrutam ..
gurorapyeva taṃ vidyāttaddhyānaṃ trividhaṃ smṛtam .. 15 ..
meaning:
उभयोर्वा तथा चान्या यथान्यायं यथाश्रुतम् ..
गुरोरप्येव तं विद्यात्तद्ध्यानं त्रिविधं स्मृतम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: Or of both, and likewise other [duties], according to rule and according to revelation. / One should know this regarding the guru as well; meditation upon him is taught to be threefold.

sanskrit_iast:
toṣaḥ parasparasyeti etāvāndharmasaṃgrahaḥ ..
kṛtsno vedo'dhigaṃtavyaḥ svadharmamanutiṣṭhatā .. 16 ..
meaning:
तोषः परस्परस्येति एतावान्धर्मसंग्रहः ..
कृत्स्नो वेदोऽधिगंतव्यः स्वधर्ममनुतिष्ठता .. 16 ..
text_mt: Pleasing one another—this is the summary of dharma. / The entire Veda is to be studied by one who follows his own dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā vedaṃ brahmacārī graṃthārthānyānyathāvidhi ..
naiṣṭhikaśca vidhānaṃ tu yāvatklībaṃ vidhīyate ..
vidyānte'bhīṣṭadānaṃ ca anujñāto gṛhī bhavet .. 17 ..
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा वेदं ब्रह्मचारी ग्रंथार्थान्यान्यथाविधि ..
नैष्ठिकश्च विधानं तु यावत्क्लीबं विधीयते ..
विद्यान्तेऽभीष्टदानं च अनुज्ञातो गृही भवेत् .. 17 ..
text_mt: Having learned the Veda, the student, [understanding] the texts and meanings according to rule— / and for a perpetual student the rule is enjoined as long as [he is not] impotent— / having given what is desired at the end of study, with permission he may become a householder.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkāsanaṃ gurugṛhādgṛhasthasya yathābhavet ..
naiṣṭhikaśca tathā snānaṃ kuryātsamyagyathāvidhi .. 18 ..
meaning:
निष्कासनं गुरुगृहाद्गृहस्थस्य यथाभवेत् ..
नैष्ठिकश्च तथा स्नानं कुर्यात्सम्यग्यथाविधि .. 18 ..
text_mt: When departure from the teacher’s house takes place for the householder, / and likewise for the perpetual [student], he should properly take the bath according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
udvahedvai tato bhāryāṃ savarṇāṃ lakṣaṇānvitām ..
aviplutabrahmacaryaścādhikārī khagottama .. 19 ..
meaning:
उद्वहेद्वै ततो भार्यां सवर्णां लक्षणान्विताम् ..
अविप्लुतब्रह्मचर्यश्चाधिकारी खगोत्तम .. 19 ..
text_mt: Then, O best of birds, having preserved his chastity unbroken, being entitled [to marry], / he should marry a wife of the same caste endowed with auspicious marks.

sanskrit_iast:
svatantramanye cecchanti hyadhikāraṃ dvijottamāḥ ..
saptamīṃ pañcamīṃ caiva kanyakāṃ pitṛmātṛtaḥ .. 1.182.20 ..
meaning:
स्वतन्त्रमन्ये चेच्छन्ति ह्यधिकारं द्विजोत्तमाः ..
सप्तमीं पञ्चमीं चैव कन्यकां पितृमातृतः .. 1.182.20 ..
text_mt: Others among the best of the twice-born desire independent eligibility. / [A maiden] removed seven degrees on the father’s side and five degrees on the mother’s side,

sanskrit_iast:
udvaheta dvijo bhāryāmasamānārṣagotrajām ..
saṃkhyāvidhivivāheṣu gotrārthaṃ vidhivarjitam .. 21 ...
meaning:
उद्वहेत द्विजो भार्यामसमानार्षगोत्रजाम् ..
संख्याविधिविवाहेषु गोत्रार्थं विधिवर्जितम् .. 21 ...
text_mt: a twice-born man should marry as his wife, not born of the same ancestral lineage or gotra. / In marriages according to the enumerated rules, [one born of the same gotra] is devoid of legality with respect to gotra.

sanskrit_iast:
vikalpenaiva mantavyamṛṣīṇāṃ vividhā śrutiḥ ..
aṣṭau vivāhā varṇānāṃ saṃskārākhyā iti śrutiḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
विकल्पेनैव मन्तव्यमृषीणां विविधा श्रुतिः ..
अष्टौ विवाहा वर्णानां संस्काराख्या इति श्रुतिः .. 22 ..
text_mt: It should be understood as an option; there are diverse revelations of the sages. / The eight marriages of the castes are called sacraments: such is the revelation.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu doṣavatīṃ kanyāmanākhyāya praya cchati ..
tasya kuryānnṛpo daṃḍaṃ svayaṃ ṣaṇṇavatiṃ paṇān ..23..
meaning:
यस्तु दोषवतीं कन्यामनाख्याय प्रय च्छति ..
तस्य कुर्यान्नृपो दंडं स्वयं षण्णवतिं पणान् ..23..
text_mt: If someone gives away a maiden having a defect without declaring it, / the king himself should impose a fine of ninety-six paṇas upon him.

sanskrit_iast:
piturgṛhe tu yā kanyā rajaḥ paśyatyasaṃskṛtā ..
pataṃti pitarastasya kanyā ca vṛṣalī bhavet .. 24 ..
meaning:
पितुर्गृहे तु या कन्या रजः पश्यत्यसंस्कृता ..
पतंति पितरस्तस्य कन्या च वृषली भवेत् .. 24 ..
text_mt: When an unmarried maiden sees menstruation in her father’s house, / his ancestors fall, and that maiden becomes a vṛṣalī.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu tāṃ varayetkanyāṃ brāhmaṇo jñānadurbalaḥ ..
aśrāddheyamapāṅkteyaṃ taṃ vidyādvṛṣalīpatim .. 25 ..
meaning:
यस्तु तां वरयेत्कन्यां ब्राह्मणो ज्ञानदुर्बलः ..
अश्राद्धेयमपाङ्क्तेयं तं विद्याद्वृषलीपतिम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: If a brāhmaṇa deficient in wisdom should choose that maiden, / one should know him as the husband of a vṛṣalī, unfit for funeral offerings and unfit to sit in company.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadoṣānhi vikhyāpya striyā vā puruṣasya vā ..
ubhayorapi vikhyāpya tataḥ saṃbandhamācaret .. 26 ..
meaning:
सर्वदोषान्हि विख्याप्य स्त्रिया वा पुरुषस्य वा ..
उभयोरपि विख्याप्य ततः संबन्धमाचरेत् .. 26 ..
text_mt: Having openly declared all defects, whether of the woman or of the man, / having announced [them] of both, he should then contract the alliance.

sanskrit_iast:
gaurī kanyā pradhānā vai madhyamā kanyakā smṛtā ..
rohiṇī tatsamā jñeyā adhamā tu rajasvalā .. 27 ..
meaning:
गौरी कन्या प्रधाना वै मध्यमा कन्यका स्मृता ..
रोहिणी तत्समा ज्ञेया अधमा तु रजस्वला .. 27 ..
text_mt: A gaurī is regarded as the best maiden, an [ordinary] maiden is middling, / a rohiṇī is to be known as equal to her, but a menstruating girl is the lowest.

sanskrit_iast:
.. anūruruvāca .. ..
gaurī tu kā matā kanyā rohiṇī ca jagatpate ..
rajasvalā nagnikā ca devakanyā ca kā bhavet .. 28 ..
meaning:
.. अनूरुरुवाच .. ..
गौरी तु का मता कन्या रोहिणी च जगत्पते ..
रजस्वला नग्निका च देवकन्या च का भवेत् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Anūru said: / Which maiden is considered a gaurī, and which a rohiṇī, O Lord of the world? / And what would be a rajasvalā, a nagnikā, and a devakanyā?

sanskrit_iast:
.. bhāskara uvāca .. ..
asaṃprāptarajā gaurī prāpte rajasi rohiṇī ..
avyañjanayutā kanyā kucahīnā ca nagnikā .. 29 ..
meaning:
.. भास्कर उवाच .. ..
असंप्राप्तरजा गौरी प्राप्ते रजसि रोहिणी ..
अव्यञ्जनयुता कन्या कुचहीना च नग्निका .. 29 ..
text_mt: Bhāskara said: / A gaurī is one who has not yet attained menstruation; upon attaining menstruation, she is a rohiṇī. / A maiden without signs [of puberty] and devoid of breasts is a nagnikā.

sanskrit_iast:
saptavarṣā bhavedgaurī daśavarṣā tu nagnikā ..
dvādaśe tu bhavetkanyā ata ūrdhvaṃ rajasvalā .. 1.182.30 ..
meaning:
सप्तवर्षा भवेद्गौरी दशवर्षा तु नग्निका ..
द्वादशे तु भवेत्कन्या अत ऊर्ध्वं रजस्वला .. 1.182.30 ..
text_mt: At seven years she is a gaurī; at ten years she is a nagnikā; / at twelve she is a [mature] maiden; beyond that, she is a rajasvalā.

sanskrit_iast:
vyañjanena samopetāṃ somo bhuṅkte hi kanyakām .. tu. - ṛgveda 10.85.40
payodhareṣu gaṃdharvā rajasyagniḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
व्यञ्जनेन समोपेतां सोमो भुङ्क्ते हि कन्यकाम् .. तु. - ऋग्वेद 10.85.40
पयोधरेषु गंधर्वा रजस्यग्निः प्रकीर्तितः .. 31 ..
text_mt: Soma indeed enjoys a maiden who is endowed with signs [of puberty]; / the Gandharvas [enjoy her] when breasts appear; Agni is said [to enjoy her] at menstruation.

sanskrit_iast:
hinasti vyañjanaiḥ putrānkulaṃ hanyātpayodharaiḥ ..
gatimiṣṭāṃ tathā lokānhanyāttu rajasā pituḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
हिनस्ति व्यञ्जनैः पुत्रान्कुलं हन्यात्पयोधरैः ..
गतिमिष्टां तथा लोकान्हन्यात्तु रजसा पितुः .. 32 ..
text_mt: Through the signs [of puberty] she destroys sons; through breasts she would destroy the family; / and through menstruation she would destroy the desired goal and the worlds of her father.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādavyañjanopetāmarajaskapayodharām ..
nānyopabhuktāṃ somādyairdadyādduhitaraṃ pitā .. 33 ..
meaning:
तस्मादव्यञ्जनोपेतामरजस्कपयोधराम् ..
नान्योपभुक्तां सोमाद्यैर्दद्याद्दुहितरं पिता .. 33 ..
text_mt: Therefore, a father should give his daughter who is without signs [of puberty], without menstruation, and without breasts, / not enjoyed by others such as Soma.

sanskrit_iast:
annaṃ tasya na bhoktavyaṃ vṛthā pāko hi sa smṛtaḥ ..
vṛthā pākasya bhuktvānnaṃ prāyaścittaṃ samācaret ..34..
meaning:
अन्नं तस्य न भोक्तव्यं वृथा पाको हि स स्मृतः ..
वृथा पाकस्य भुक्त्वान्नं प्रायश्चित्तं समाचरेत् ..34..
text_mt: His food must not be eaten, for that is regarded as wasted cooking. / Having eaten the food of wasted cooking, one should perform an expiation.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāyāmaṃ trirabhyasya ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśuddhyati ..
vivāhayedekagotrāṃ samānapravarāṃ khaga ..
kṛtvā tasyāṃ samutsargamatikṛcchro viśodhanam .. 35 ..
meaning:
प्राणायामं त्रिरभ्यस्य घृतं प्राश्य विशुद्ध्यति ..
विवाहयेदेकगोत्रां समानप्रवरां खग ..
कृत्वा तस्यां समुत्सर्गमतिकृच्छ्रो विशोधनम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: Having practiced breath control three times and consumed ghee, he becomes purified. / If one marries a woman of the same gotra or having the same pravara, O bird, / having abandoned her, the atikṛcchra penance is the purification.

sanskrit_iast:
udvāhayetsagotrāṃ ca tanayāṃ mātulasya ca ..
ṛṣibhiścaiva tulyo yo dvijaścāṃdrāyaṇaṃ caret .. 36 ..
meaning:
उद्वाहयेत्सगोत्रां च तनयां मातुलस्य च ..
ऋषिभिश्चैव तुल्यो यो द्विजश्चांद्रायणं चरेत् .. 36 ..
text_mt: If one should marry a woman of the same gotra, or the daughter of a maternal uncle, / even a twice-born man who is equal to the sages must perform the cāndrāyaṇa penance.

sanskrit_iast:
asapiṇḍā tu yā māturasagotrā ca yā pituḥ ..
sā praśastā dvijātīnāṃ dārakarmaṇi maithune .. 37 .. ..
meaning:
असपिण्डा तु या मातुरसगोत्रा च या पितुः ..
सा प्रशस्ता द्विजातीनां दारकर्मणि मैथुने .. 37 .. ..
text_mt: She who is not a sapiṇḍa of the mother and not of the same gotra as the father / is praised for the twice-born for the rites of marriage and for intercourse.

sanskrit_iast:
.. aruṇa uvāca .. ..
dārakarma kimuktaṃ vai yaduktaṃ bhavatā idam ..
sā praśastā dvijātīnāṃ dārakarmaṇi maithune .. 38 ..
meaning:
.. अरुण उवाच .. ..
दारकर्म किमुक्तं वै यदुक्तं भवता इदम् ..
सा प्रशस्ता द्विजातीनां दारकर्मणि मैथुने .. 38 ..
text_mt: Aruṇa said: / What is called the rite of marriage, which was stated by you here: / 'She is praised for the twice-born for the rites of marriage and for intercourse'?

sanskrit_iast:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
agnihotrādi yatkarma vaidikaṃ vinatātmaja ..
taduktaṃ dārakarmeti dvābhyāṃ yogāttu maithune ..39..
meaning:
.. आदित्य उवाच .. ..
अग्निहोत्रादि यत्कर्म वैदिकं विनतात्मज ..
तदुक्तं दारकर्मेति द्वाभ्यां योगात्तु मैथुने ..39..
text_mt: Āditya said: / That Vedic rite such as the agnihotra, O son of Vinatā, / that is called the rite of marriage, while intercourse arises from the union of the two.

sanskrit_iast:
nodvahetkapilāṃ kanyāṃ nādhikāṃgīṃ na rogiṇīm ..
nālomikāṃ nātilomāṃ na cākūṭāṃ na piṅgalām ..1.182.40..
meaning:
नोद्वहेत्कपिलां कन्यां नाधिकांगीं न रोगिणीम् ..
नालोमिकां नातिलोमां न चाकूटां न पिङ्गलाम् ..1.182.40..
text_mt: He should not marry a girl with yellowish-brown hair, nor one with extra limbs, nor a sickly girl, / nor one who is hairless, nor one with excessive hair, nor one who is talkative, nor one who is tawny,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛkṣavṛkṣanadīnāmnīṃ nānyaparvatanāmikām ..
na yakṣāhipreṣyanāmnīṃ cātibhīṣaṇanāmikām..41..
meaning:
ऋक्षवृक्षनदीनाम्नीं नान्यपर्वतनामिकाम् ..
न यक्षाहिप्रेष्यनाम्नीं चातिभीषणनामिकाम्..41..
text_mt: nor one named after a constellation, a tree, or a river, nor one having the name of a low mountain, / nor one named after a yakṣa, a serpent, or a servant, nor one with a terrifying name.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāstu na bhavedbhrātā na vijñāyeta vai pitā ..
nopagaccheddhi tāṃ prājñaḥ putrikādharmaśaṃkayā ..42..
meaning:
यस्यास्तु न भवेद्भ्राता न विज्ञायेत वै पिता ..
नोपगच्छेद्धि तां प्राज्ञः पुत्रिकाधर्मशंकया ..42..
text_mt: A wise man should not approach [in marriage] one who has no brother, / or whose father is not known, for fear of the law of an appointed daughter.

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsasvarāmekavarṇāṃ madhupiṃgalalocanām ..
tādṛśīṃ varayetkanyāṃ gṛhārthī khagasattama .. 43 ..
meaning:
हंसस्वरामेकवर्णां मधुपिंगललोचनाम् ..
तादृशीं वरयेत्कन्यां गृहार्थी खगसत्तम .. 43 ..
text_mt: Having a voice like a swan, of uniform complexion, with eyes reddish-brown like honey— / such a maiden should one who desires a household choose, O best of birds.

sanskrit_iast:
dārāgnihotrasaṃyogaṃ kurute yo'graje sthite ..
parivettā sa vijñeyaḥ parivittistu pūrvajaḥ ..44 ..
meaning:
दाराग्निहोत्रसंयोगं कुरुते योऽग्रजे स्थिते ..
परिवेत्ता स विज्ञेयः परिवित्तिस्तु पूर्वजः ..44 ..
text_mt: He who contracts marriage and the agnihotra fire while his elder brother remains [unmarried] / is to be known as a parivettā, and the elder brother is the parivitti.

sanskrit_iast:
parivittiḥ parivettā ca yayā sa parividyate ..
sarve te narakaṃ yāṃti dātṛyājakapaṃcamāḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
परिवित्तिः परिवेत्ता च यया स परिविद्यते ..
सर्वे ते नरकं यांति दातृयाजकपंचमाः .. 45 ..
text_mt: The parivitti, the parivettā, and she through whom he commits the parivedana— / all of them go to hell, with the giver and the officiating priest as the fourth and fifth.

sanskrit_iast:
klībe deśāṃtarasthe vā patite vrajite tathā ..
yogaśāstrābhiyukte ca na doṣaḥ parivedane ..46..
meaning:
क्लीबे देशांतरस्थे वा पतिते व्रजिते तथा ..
योगशास्त्राभियुक्ते च न दोषः परिवेदने ..46..
text_mt: When [the elder brother] is impotent, living in another land, an outcaste, an ascetic, / or devoted to the teachings of Yoga, there is no fault in parivedana.

sanskrit_iast:
khaṃjavāmanakubjeṣu gadgadeṣu jaḍeṣu ca ..
jātyaṃdhe badhire mūke na doṣaḥ parivedane .. 47 ..
meaning:
खंजवामनकुब्जेषु गद्गदेषु जडेषु च ..
जात्यंधे बधिरे मूके न दोषः परिवेदने .. 47 ..
text_mt: In the case of those who are lame, dwarfs, hunchbacked, stutterers, imbeciles, / blind from birth, deaf, or mute, there is no fault in parivedana.

sanskrit_iast:
na śrāddhaṃ tu kaniṣṭhasya vikulāya ca kanyakā ..
varaśca kulaśīlābhyāṃ na śuddhyeta kadācana ..
na maṃtrāḥ kāraṇaṃ tatra na ca kanyā vṛtā bhavet .. 48 ..
meaning:
न श्राद्धं तु कनिष्ठस्य विकुलाय च कन्यका ..
वरश्च कुलशीलाभ्यां न शुद्ध्येत कदाचन ..
न मंत्राः कारणं तत्र न च कन्या वृता भवेत् .. 48 ..
text_mt: There is no funeral offering for a younger brother, nor [should a maiden be given] to one of base family; / and if a suitor is never purified in family and conduct, / the mantras are of no effect there, nor is the maiden chosen.
