sanskrit_iast:
udvāhitā tu yākanyā na ca prāptā tu maithunam ..
punarabhyeti bhartāraṃ yathā kanyā tathaiva sā .. 49 ..
meaning:
उद्वाहिता तु याकन्या न च प्राप्ता तु मैथुनम् ..
पुनरभ्येति भर्तारं यथा कन्या तथैव सा .. 49 ..
text_mt: A maiden who has been married but has not attained sexual union, / she may go again to a husband; she is just as a [virgin] maiden.

sanskrit_iast:
samākṣipya matāṃ kanyāṃ pitā tvakṣatayonikām ..
kulaśīlavate dadyānna syāddoṣaḥ khagādhipa .. 1.182.50 ..
meaning:
समाक्षिप्य मतां कन्यां पिता त्वक्षतयोनिकाम् ..
कुलशीलवते दद्यान्न स्याद्दोषः खगाधिप .. 1.182.50 ..
text_mt: Taking back an approved maiden whose virginity is intact, / the father may give her to one of good family and conduct; there would be no fault, O lord of birds.

sanskrit_iast:
.. anūruruvāca .. ..
ete'ṣṭau prabhavāḥ proktā vivāhā ye jagatpate ..
lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi caiteṣāṃ samāsāttimirāpaha .. 51 ..
meaning:
.. अनूरुरुवाच .. ..
एतेऽष्टौ प्रभवाः प्रोक्ता विवाहा ये जगत्पते ..
लक्षणं ब्रूहि चैतेषां समासात्तिमिरापह .. 51 ..
text_mt: Anūru said: / These eight forms of marriage that have been declared, O Lord of the world— / tell their characteristics in brief, O dispeller of darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
śubhāṃ lakṣaṇasaṃpannāṃ kulaśīlaguṇānvitām ..
alaṃkṛtyārhate dānaṃ vivāho brāhma ucyate .. 52 ..
meaning:
.. आदित्य उवाच .. ..
शुभां लक्षणसंपन्नां कुलशीलगुणान्विताम् ..
अलंकृत्यार्हते दानं विवाहो ब्राह्म उच्यते .. 52 ..
text_mt:
Āditya said:
The gift of an auspicious [girl] endowed with good marks, possessing noble family, conduct, and virtues, / having adorned her, to a worthy recipient is called the Brāhma marriage.

sanskrit_iast:
saha dharmakriyāhetordānaṃ samayabaṃdhanāt ..
alaṃkṛtyaiva kanyāyāḥ prājāpatyaḥ sa ucyate .. 53 ..
meaning:
सह धर्मक्रियाहेतोर्दानं समयबंधनात् ..
अलंकृत्यैव कन्यायाः प्राजापत्यः स उच्यते .. 53 ..
text_mt: The gift of a maiden, having adorned her, for the purpose of jointly performing religious rites / with a mutual agreement, that is called Prājāpatya.

sanskrit_iast:
pradānaṃ yatra kanyāyāḥ sahagomithunena tu ..
savarṇāyāḥ sagotrāyāstamārṣamṛṣayo viduḥ.. 54 ..
meaning:
प्रदानं यत्र कन्यायाः सहगोमिथुनेन तु ..
सवर्णायाः सगोत्रायास्तमार्षमृषयो विदुः.. 54 ..
text_mt: Where the giving of a maiden of the same caste and the same gotra takes place / together with a pair of cattle, the sages know that as Ārṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃtarvedyāṃ samānīya kanyāṃ kanakamaṃḍitām ..
ṛtvije caiva yaddānaṃ vivāho daivasaṃjñakaḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
अंतर्वेद्यां समानीय कन्यां कनकमंडिताम् ..
ऋत्विजे चैव यद्दानं विवाहो दैवसंज्ञकः .. 55 ..
text_mt: Having brought the maiden adorned with gold into the sacrificial altar-enclosure, / the giving [of her] to an officiating priest is the marriage known as Daiva.

sanskrit_iast:
ete vivāhāścatvāro dharmakāmārthadāyakāḥ ..
aśulkā brahmaṇā proktāstārayaṃti kuladvayam .. 56 ..
meaning:
एते विवाहाश्चत्वारो धर्मकामार्थदायकाः ..
अशुल्का ब्रह्मणा प्रोक्तास्तारयंति कुलद्वयम् .. 56 ..
text_mt: These four marriages bestow dharma, desire, and wealth; / declared by Brahmā to be free of bride-price, they deliver both families.

sanskrit_iast:
caturṣveteṣu dattāyāmutpanno yaḥ sutaḥ striyām ..
dātuḥ pratigrahītuśca punātyāsaptamānpitṝn .. 57 ..
meaning:
चतुर्ष्वेतेषु दत्तायामुत्पन्नो यः सुतः स्त्रियाम् ..
दातुः प्रतिग्रहीतुश्च पुनात्यासप्तमान्पितॄन् .. 57 ..
text_mt: A son born of a woman given in these four [types of marriage] / purifies the ancestors up to the seventh generation of both the giver and the receiver.

sanskrit_iast:
vivikte svayamanyo'nyaṃ strīpuṃsoryaḥ samāgamaḥ ..
prītihetuḥ sa gāṃdharvo vivāhaḥ paṃcamo mataḥ ..58..
meaning:
विविक्ते स्वयमन्योऽन्यं स्त्रीपुंसोर्यः समागमः ..
प्रीतिहेतुः स गांधर्वो विवाहः पंचमो मतः ..58..
text_mt: The union of a man and a woman in secret of their own accord, / having affection as its cause, is considered the fifth marriage, the Gāndharva.

sanskrit_iast:
hatvā cchittvā ca bhittvā ca krośaṃtīṃ rudatīṃ gṛhāt..
prasahya kanyāharaṇaṃ rākṣasodvāha ucyate..59..
meaning:
हत्वा च्छित्त्वा च भित्त्वा च क्रोशंतीं रुदतीं गृहात्..
प्रसह्य कन्याहरणं राक्षसोद्वाह उच्यते..59..
text_mt: Having slain, severed, and breached, forcibly carrying off a maiden / who is screaming and weeping from her home, is called the Rākṣasa marriage.

sanskrit_iast:
śulkaṃ pradāya kanyāyā haraṇaṃ vyasanādapi..
prasāda heturuktoyamāsuraḥ saptamastathā .. 1.182.60 ..
meaning:
शुल्कं प्रदाय कन्याया हरणं व्यसनादपि..
प्रसाद हेतुरुक्तोयमासुरः सप्तमस्तथा .. 1.182.60 ..
text_mt: Carrying off a maiden after paying a bride-price, even out of distress, / said to have pleasure as its cause—this is likewise the seventh, the Āsura.

sanskrit_iast:
suptāṃ mattāṃ pramattāṃ vā raho yatropagacchati ..
sa pāpiṣṭho vivāhānāṃ paiśācaścāṣṭamodhamaḥ .. 61 ..
meaning:
सुप्तां मत्तां प्रमत्तां वा रहो यत्रोपगच्छति ..
स पापिष्ठो विवाहानां पैशाचश्चाष्टमोधमः .. 61 ..
text_mt: When one approaches [her] in secret while she is asleep, intoxicated, or heedless, / that most wicked and lowest of marriages is the Paiśāca, the eighth.

sanskrit_iast:
etānsaśulkānsāmānyānvivāhāṃścaturo viduḥ ..
kevalaṃ kṣatriyasyaiva vīryaṃ chittvā hi rākṣasaḥ .. 62 ..
meaning:
एतान्सशुल्कान्सामान्यान्विवाहांश्चतुरो विदुः ..
केवलं क्षत्रियस्यैव वीर्यं छित्त्वा हि राक्षसः .. 62 ..
text_mt: They know these four marriages, which involve bride-price, to be common; / only for a kṣatriya is the Rākṣasa [appropriate], having overcome valour.

sanskrit_iast:
prāpte pūrvavivāhe tu vidhirvaivāhikaḥ śivaḥ ..
kartavyastu tribhirvarṇaiḥ samayenāgnisākṣikaḥ .. 63 ..
meaning:
प्राप्ते पूर्वविवाहे तु विधिर्वैवाहिकः शिवः ..
कर्तव्यस्तु त्रिभिर्वर्णैः समयेनाग्निसाक्षिकः .. 63 ..
text_mt: When the previous [four] marriages are undertaken, the auspicious marital rite, / however, should be performed by the three classes with an agreement witnessed by fire.

sanskrit_iast:
doṣavatyāḥ pradāne tu dātuḥ ṣaṇṇavatirdamaḥ ..
syāttu śulkapradāne ca kanyāyāścāpavarjane ..64..
meaning:
दोषवत्याः प्रदाने तु दातुः षण्णवतिर्दमः ..
स्यात्तु शुल्कप्रदाने च कन्यायाश्चापवर्जने ..64..
text_mt: In the case of giving a blemished girl, the fine of the giver shall be ninety-six; / and so it shall be in the case of giving a bride-price and in the abandonment of a maiden.

sanskrit_iast:
mokṣopavartanaṃ dveṣaḥ strīdhanasya nivartanam ..
ākāṃkṣā tīrthasaṃrodhastyāgahetuśca vakṣyate .. 65 ..
meaning:
मोक्षोपवर्तनं द्वेषः स्त्रीधनस्य निवर्तनम् ..
आकांक्षा तीर्थसंरोधस्त्यागहेतुश्च वक्ष्यते .. 65 ..
text_mt: Dissolution, departure, hatred, withholding of woman's property, / expectation, obstructing her fertile season, and the cause of abandonment shall be spoken of.

sanskrit_iast:
parasparasya saṃbaṃdhānmokṣaḥ strīpuṃsayoḥ smṛtaḥ ..
na syādanyataraḥ prīto roṣātsāṃpratikādapi .. 66 ..
meaning:
परस्परस्य संबंधान्मोक्षः स्त्रीपुंसयोः स्मृतः ..
न स्यादन्यतरः प्रीतो रोषात्सांप्रतिकादपि .. 66 ..
text_mt: Dissolution of the union between a man and a woman is recorded [in law]: / neither would be pleased, even out of momentary anger.

sanskrit_iast:
bādhate cetpatirbhāryāṃ sa tu dveṣa iti smṛtaḥ ..
vṛttirābharaṇaṃ śulkaṃ lābhaśca strīdhanaṃ bhavet..67..
meaning:
बाधते चेत्पतिर्भार्यां स तु द्वेष इति स्मृतः ..
वृत्तिराभरणं शुल्कं लाभश्च स्त्रीधनं भवेत्..67..
text_mt: If a husband oppresses his wife, that is recorded as hatred. / Livelihood, ornaments, bride-price, and acquisitions constitute woman's property.

sanskrit_iast:
bhoktṛstu svayamevedaṃ pratijñāhananaṃ bhavet ..
vṛthā mokṣeṇa bhogena striyai dadyātsavṛddhikam ..68..
meaning:
भोक्तृस्तु स्वयमेवेदं प्रतिज्ञाहननं भवेत् ..
वृथा मोक्षेण भोगेन स्त्रियै दद्यात्सवृद्धिकम् ..68..
text_mt: For the user [of it] himself, this becomes a breach of promise; / through futile dissolution [or] enjoyment, he must restore [it] to the woman with interest.

sanskrit_iast:
āpattisamaye jāte strīdhanaṃ bhoktumarhati ..
ākāṃkṣetāṣṭavarṣāṇi bhartāpi prasavaṃ striyāḥ .. 69 ..
meaning:
आपत्तिसमये जाते स्त्रीधनं भोक्तुमर्हति ..
आकांक्षेताष्टवर्षाणि भर्तापि प्रसवं स्त्रियाः .. 69 ..
text_mt: When a time of distress has arisen, he is entitled to enjoy the woman's property. / A husband, moreover, should wait eight years for offspring from a woman.

sanskrit_iast:
jāyante yadi no putrāstasyāṃ yatne mahatyapi ..
tato viṃdeta putrārthī dharmataḥ kulajāṃ striyam.. 1.182.70 ..
meaning:
जायन्ते यदि नो पुत्रास्तस्यां यत्ने महत्यपि ..
ततो विंदेत पुत्रार्थी धर्मतः कुलजां स्त्रियम्.. 1.182.70 ..
text_mt: If sons are not born to her even upon great exertion, / then, desiring a son, he may lawfully take a well-born woman.

sanskrit_iast:
putralābhātparaṃ loke nāsti hi prasavārthinaḥ ..
etāṃ śulkasya tāṃ bhuktvā anyāṃ labdhuṃ yadīcchati ..
samastāstoṣayitvārthaiḥ sūryoḍhāṃ paramāṃ varet..71..
meaning:
पुत्रलाभात्परं लोके नास्ति हि प्रसवार्थिनः ..
एतां शुल्कस्य तां भुक्त्वा अन्यां लब्धुं यदीच्छति ..
समस्तास्तोषयित्वार्थैः सूर्योढां परमां वरेत्..71..
text_mt: For there is nothing higher in the world than obtaining a son for one desiring offspring. / Having enjoyed this woman of bride-price, if he wishes to obtain another, / he, having satisfied all with wealth, may marry a superior woman wed in the presence of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
ekā śūdrasya vaiśyasya dve tisraḥ kṣatriyasya tu..
catasro brāhmaṇasya syurbhāryā rājño yatheṣṭataḥ .. 72 ..
meaning:
एका शूद्रस्य वैश्यस्य द्वे तिस्रः क्षत्रियस्य तु..
चतस्रो ब्राह्मणस्य स्युर्भार्या राज्ञो यथेष्टतः .. 72 ..
text_mt: A śūdra may have one wife, a vaiśya two, a kṣatriya three, / a brāhmaṇa four, and a king as many as he pleases.

sanskrit_iast:
atīrthagamanātpuṃsastīrthe saṃgāhanātstriyāḥ ..
ubhayordharmalopaḥ syātsveṣveva tu viśeṣataḥ .. 73 ..
meaning:
अतीर्थगमनात्पुंसस्तीर्थे संगाहनात्स्त्रियाः ..
उभयोर्धर्मलोपः स्यात्स्वेष्वेव तु विशेषतः .. 73 ..
text_mt: From a man's approaching [her] outside her fertile season, or a woman's bathing [with him] in her fertile season [improperly], / there occurs an omission of duty for both, particularly in their own [caste rules].

sanskrit_iast:
yaugapadye tu tīrthānāṃ vivāhakramaśo vrajet ..
tatsāmyaṃ jīvaputrā vā grahaṇakramaśopi vā..74..
meaning:
यौगपद्ये तु तीर्थानां विवाहक्रमशो व्रजेत् ..
तत्साम्यं जीवपुत्रा वा ग्रहणक्रमशोपि वा..74..
text_mt: When the fertile seasons coincide, he should go according to the order of marriage; / or equally with them, or to one whose sons are living, or according to the order of taking [them].

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmādibhirvivāhaistu saṃskṛtau tau khagādhipa ..
aṣṭau vivāhā varṇānāṃ vainateya uśaṃti vai .. 75..
meaning:
ब्राह्मादिभिर्विवाहैस्तु संस्कृतौ तौ खगाधिप ..
अष्टौ विवाहा वर्णानां वैनतेय उशंति वै .. 75..
text_mt: Those two are consecrated by the marriages beginning with Brāhma, O lord of birds; / the eight marriages are indeed praised for the classes, O son of Vinatā.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmo daivastathārṣaśca prājāpatyaḥ khagā dhipa ..
gāṃdharvaścāsuro rakṣaḥ paiśācastvaṣṭamo'dhamaḥ .. 76 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मो दैवस्तथार्षश्च प्राजापत्यः खगा धिप ..
गांधर्वश्चासुरो रक्षः पैशाचस्त्वष्टमोऽधमः .. 76 ..
text_mt: Brāhma, Daiva, and likewise Ārṣa, Prājāpatya, O lord of birds, / Gāndharva, Āsura, Rākṣasa, and the eighth, the lowest, Paiśāca.

sanskrit_iast:
praśastāḥ kṣatriyādīnāṃ viprādīnāṃ tu mānataḥ ..
pratigrahādayo baddhā vivāhā brāhmaṇasya tu ..77..
meaning:
प्रशस्ताः क्षत्रियादीनां विप्रादीनां तु मानतः ..
प्रतिग्रहादयो बद्धा विवाहा ब्राह्मणस्य तु ..77..
text_mt: They are recommended for the kṣatriyas and others, but for the brāhmaṇas and others according to authority; / marriages involving acceptance [of gifts] and so forth are bound to the brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatriyasyāpi deyā tu pratigrahavivarjitā ..
pravṛttiṃ kecidicchaṃti dānamityapare striyāḥ ..
pāvanaṃ puruṣāṇāṃ tu vivāhaṃ paricakṣate ..78..
śrāddhavidhikathāvarṇanam
meaning:
क्षत्रियस्यापि देया तु प्रतिग्रहविवर्जिता ..
प्रवृत्तिं केचिदिच्छंति दानमित्यपरे स्त्रियाः ..
पावनं पुरुषाणां तु विवाहं परिचक्षते ..78..
श्राद्धविधिकथावर्णनम्
text_mt:
To a kṣatriya, however, [a bride] is to be given without acceptance of gifts; / some desire woman's initiative, others a gift; / but marriage is declared to be purifying for men.
Description of the narration of the rules of śrāddha.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāskara uvāca..
kuryātpaṃcamahāyajñānadhikāro dvijasya saḥ..
bhūtapitramarabrahmamanuṣyāṇāṃ yathāvidhi..1..
meaning:
भास्कर उवाच..
कुर्यात्पंचमहायज्ञानधिकारो द्विजस्य सः..
भूतपित्रमरब्रह्ममनुष्याणां यथाविधि..1..
text_mt:
Bhāskara said:
A twice-born should perform the five great sacrifices, for that is his entitlement: / those to the spirits, the ancestors, the gods, the Veda, and men, according to rule.
title: Śrāddhavidhikathanam

sanskrit_iast:
sadā sadāna kṛtyānāṃ phalārthamapare sthitāḥ..
nityānitya miti prāhuranuṣaṃgātphalaṃ pare ..2..
meaning:
सदा सदान कृत्यानां फलार्थमपरे स्थिताः..
नित्यानित्य मिति प्राहुरनुषंगात्फलं परे ..2..
text_mt: Others abide always in the fruit of the rites of giving; / some declare [them] to be regular and occasional, and others [say] the fruit comes through secondary connection.

sanskrit_iast:
atitheḥ paritoṣāya paricaryā vidhīyate ..
adṛṣṭaniyamādṛṣṭamārogyāntaṃ ca varjanam ..3..
meaning:
अतिथेः परितोषाय परिचर्या विधीयते ..
अदृष्टनियमादृष्टमारोग्यान्तं च वर्जनम् ..3..
text_mt: Service is prescribed for the satisfaction of a guest; / the unseen [fruit comes] from the restriction of the unseen, and abstention [lasts] until recovery of health.

sanskrit_iast:
tisroṣṭakāstu kartavyā madhyāvartī caturthikā..
śākapāyasapūpaistu māṃsena tu caturthikā..4..
meaning:
तिस्रोष्टकास्तु कर्तव्या मध्यावर्ती चतुर्थिका..
शाकपायसपूपैस्तु मांसेन तु चतुर्थिका..4..
text_mt: Three aṣṭakās should be performed, and the fourth occurs in the middle: / with vegetables, milk-rice, and cakes, but the fourth with meat.

sanskrit_iast:
pratipadi kriyate yattu catuṣpārvaṇamucyate ..
svagṛhyoktavidhānena tattu pakṣādi kīrtyate..5..
meaning:
प्रतिपदि क्रियते यत्तु चतुष्पार्वणमुच्यते ..
स्वगृह्योक्तविधानेन तत्तु पक्षादि कीर्त्यते..5..
text_mt: That which is performed on the first day of the fortnight is called the four-pārvaṇa; / performed according to the rite spoken in one's own Gṛhyasūtra, it is declared to begin the fortnight.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ sapiṃḍanam..
pārvaṇaṃ ceti vijñeyaṃ goṣṭhaśuddhyarthamuttamam..
karmāṃgaṃ navamaṃ proktaṃ vaidikaṃ daśamaṃ smṛtam ..6.. ..
meaning:
नित्यं नैमित्तिकं काम्यं वृद्धिश्राद्धं सपिंडनम्..
पार्वणं चेति विज्ञेयं गोष्ठशुद्ध्यर्थमुत्तमम्..
कर्मांगं नवमं प्रोक्तं वैदिकं दशमं स्मृतम् ..6.. ..
text_mt: The regular, the occasional, the optional, the vṛddhiśrāddha, the sapiṇḍana, / and the pārvaṇa is to be understood, an excellent [śrāddha] for the purification of a cow-pen; / the ninth is said to be an auxiliary to rites, and the tenth is recorded as Vedic.

sanskrit_iast:
.. anūruruvāca .. ..
yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ śrāddhaṃ dvādaśadhā vibho ..
tasya sarvasya mā brūhi lakṣaṇaṃ vai pṛthakpṛthak .. 7 ..
meaning:
.. अनूरुरुवाच .. ..
यदेतद्भवता प्रोक्तं श्राद्धं द्वादशधा विभो ..
तस्य सर्वस्य मा ब्रूहि लक्षणं वै पृथक्पृथक् .. 7 ..
text_mt:
Anūru said:
This śrāddha which has been spoken of by You as twelvefold, O Lord, / tell me each of their characteristics separately.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ kimucyate śrāddhaṃ kiṃ vā naimittikaṃ bhavet ..
kāmyādi devadeveśa eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vada .. 8 ..
meaning:
नित्यं किमुच्यते श्राद्धं किं वा नैमित्तिकं भवेत् ..
काम्यादि देवदेवेश एतेषां लक्षणं वद .. 8 ..
text_mt: What is called the regular śrāddha? Or what would be the occasional? / Tell the characteristics of these, the optional and so forth, O Lord of the gods of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
ahanyahani yacchrāddhaṃ tannityaṃ khaga kīrtitam ..
vaiśvadevavihīnaṃ tu aśaktāvudakena tu .. 9 ..
meaning:
.. आदित्य उवाच .. ..
अहन्यहनि यच्छ्राद्धं तन्नित्यं खग कीर्तितम् ..
वैश्वदेवविहीनं तु अशक्तावुदकेन तु .. 9 ..
text_mt:
Āditya said:
The śrāddha which [is performed] day after day is declared to be regular, O bird; / but it is devoid of the rite to all-gods, or with water in case of inability.

sanskrit_iast:
ekoddiṣṭaṃ tu yacchrāddhaṃ tannaimittikamucyate ..
tatsadaiva prakartavyamayugmānbhojayeddvijān .. 1.183.10 ..
meaning:
एकोद्दिष्टं तु यच्छ्राद्धं तन्नैमित्तिकमुच्यते ..
तत्सदैव प्रकर्तव्यमयुग्मान्भोजयेद्द्विजान् .. 1.183.10 ..
text_mt: The śrāddha dedicated to a single [ancestor] is called occasional; / that should always be performed; one should feed an odd number of twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmayuktaṃ hi tatkāmyamabhipretārthasiddhaye ..
pārvaṇena vidhānena tadapyuktaṃ khagādhipa .. 11 ..
meaning:
कामयुक्तं हि तत्काम्यमभिप्रेतार्थसिद्धये ..
पार्वणेन विधानेन तदप्युक्तं खगाधिप .. 11 ..
text_mt: That which is accompanied by a desire is optional, for the attainment of a desired goal; / that also, O lord of birds, has been stated to be by the procedure of a pārvaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛddhau yatkriyate śrāddhaṃ vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ taducyate ..
sarvaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kāryaṃ pūrvāhṇe tūpavītinā ..12..
meaning:
वृद्धौ यत्क्रियते श्राद्धं वृद्धिश्राद्धं तदुच्यते ..
सर्वं प्रदक्षिणं कार्यं पूर्वाह्णे तूपवीतिना ..12..
text_mt: The śrāddha which is performed on [an occasion of] prosperity is called the vṛddhiśrāddha; / everything should be done clockwise in the forenoon by one wearing the sacred thread over the left shoulder.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃdhodakatilairyuktaṃ kuryātpātracatuṣṭayam..
arghārthaṃ pitṛpātreṣu pretapātraṃ pramocayet ..13..
meaning:
गंधोदकतिलैर्युक्तं कुर्यात्पात्रचतुष्टयम्..
अर्घार्थं पितृपात्रेषु प्रेतपात्रं प्रमोचयेत् ..13..
text_mt: One should prepare four vessels supplied with fragrant water and sesamum; / for the sake of the water-offering, one should pour the vessel for the deceased spirit into the vessels for the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
ye samānā iti dvābhyāmetajjñeyaṃ sapiṃḍanam ..
nityena tulyaṃ śeṣaṃ syādekoddiṣṭaṃ striyā api..14..
meaning:
ये समाना इति द्वाभ्यामेतज्ज्ञेयं सपिंडनम् ..
नित्येन तुल्यं शेषं स्यादेकोद्दिष्टं स्त्रिया अपि..14..
text_mt: This rite of sapiṇḍana is known to be performed with the two mantras beginning “ye samānāḥ”. / The remainder is equal to the daily [rite], and an ekoddiṣṭa is also [performed] for a woman.

sanskrit_iast:
darśe vai kriyate yattu tatpārvaṇamudāhṛtam ..
parvaṇi kriyate yacca tatpārvaṇamiti sthitiḥ ..
gobhyaśca kriyate śrāddhaṃ tadgoṣṭhaśrāddhamucyate .. 15 ..
meaning:
दर्शे वै क्रियते यत्तु तत्पार्वणमुदाहृतम् ..
पर्वणि क्रियते यच्च तत्पार्वणमिति स्थितिः ..
गोभ्यश्च क्रियते श्राद्धं तद्गोष्ठश्राद्धमुच्यते .. 15 ..
text_mt: That which is performed on the new moon day is proclaimed as pārvaṇa; / and that which is performed on a conjunction day is pārvaṇa—such is the rule. / And the śrāddha performed for cows is called goṣṭha-śrāddha.

sanskrit_iast:
bahūnāṃ viduṣāṃ saṃpatsukhārthaṃ pitṛtṛptaye ..
kriyate śuddhaye yadvai brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam ..
śudyarthamiti tatproktaṃ vainateya manīṣibhiḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
बहूनां विदुषां संपत्सुखार्थं पितृतृप्तये ..
क्रियते शुद्धये यद्वै ब्राह्मणानां च भोजनम् ..
शुद्यर्थमिति तत्प्रोक्तं वैनतेय मनीषिभिः .. 16 ..
text_mt: The feeding of brāhmaṇas performed for the sake of prosperity and happiness / of many wise men, for the satisfaction of the ancestors, and for purification, / has been declared by the wise, O son of Vinatā, to be for purification.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣekakāle some ca sīmatonnayane tathā ..
jñeyaṃ puṃsavanaṃ śrāddhaṃ tacca karmāṃgameva ca .. .. 17 ..
meaning:
निषेककाले सोमे च सीमतोन्नयने तथा ..
ज्ञेयं पुंसवनं श्राद्धं तच्च कर्मांगमेव च .. .. 17 ..
text_mt: At the time of insemination, at the soma ritual, and likewise at the parting of the hair, / a puṃsavana-śrāddha is to be known, and that is indeed an auxiliary of the rite.

sanskrit_iast:
kriyate devamuddiśya saptamyādiṣu yatnataḥ ..
gaccheddeśāṃtare yastu śrāddhaṃ kuryāttu sarpiṣā ..
tadyatnārthamiti proktaṃ pradiśecca na saṃśayaḥ ..18..
meaning:
क्रियते देवमुद्दिश्य सप्तम्यादिषु यत्नतः ..
गच्छेद्देशांतरे यस्तु श्राद्धं कुर्यात्तु सर्पिषा ..
तद्यत्नार्थमिति प्रोक्तं प्रदिशेच्च न संशयः ..18..
text_mt: That which is performed with effort intending a deity, on the seventh day and so forth, / or when one goes to another country and performs a śrāddha with clarified butter, / is declared to be for special effort; one should assign it, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
śarīropacaye śrāddhamaśvavṛddhyarthameva ca ..
puṣṭyarthametadvijñeyamaupacārikamucyate .. 19 ..
meaning:
शरीरोपचये श्राद्धमश्ववृद्ध्यर्थमेव च ..
पुष्ट्यर्थमेतद्विज्ञेयमौपचारिकमुच्यते .. 19 ..
text_mt: A śrāddha [performed] for bodily development and for the increase of horses / is to be understood as being for nourishment; it is called aupacārika.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmeva śrāddhānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sāṃvatsaraṃ matam ..
kiyate yatkhagaśreṣṭha mṛtehani budhaiḥ saha .. 1.183.20 ..
meaning:
सर्वेषामेव श्राद्धानां श्रेष्ठं सांवत्सरं मतम् ..
कियते यत्खगश्रेष्ठ मृतेहनि बुधैः सह .. 1.183.20 ..
text_mt: Of all śrāddhas indeed, the annual one is considered the best, / which is performed on the day of death together with the wise, O best of birds.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛte'hani punaryastu na kuryācchrāddhamādarāt ..
mātuśca khagaśārdūla vatsarāṃte mṛte'hani .. 21 ..
meaning:
मृतेऽहनि पुनर्यस्तु न कुर्याच्छ्राद्धमादरात् ..
मातुश्च खगशार्दूल वत्सरांते मृतेऽहनि .. 21 ..
text_mt: He who, on the other hand, does not respectfully perform the śrāddha on the day of death / of his mother, O tiger among birds, at the end of the year on the day of death—

sanskrit_iast:
nāhaṃ tasya khagaśreṣṭha pūjāṃ gṛhṇāmi no hariḥ ..
na brahmā na ca vai rudro na cānye devatāgaṇāḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
नाहं तस्य खगश्रेष्ठ पूजां गृह्णामि नो हरिः ..
न ब्रह्मा न च वै रुद्रो न चान्ये देवतागणाः .. 22 ..
text_mt: I do not accept his worship, O best of birds, nor does Hari, / nor Brahmā, nor Rudra, nor the other hosts of deities.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādyatnena kartavyaṃ varṣevarṣe mṛte'hani ..
nareṇa khagaśārdūla bhojakena viśeṣataḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
तस्माद्यत्नेन कर्तव्यं वर्षेवर्षे मृतेऽहनि ..
नरेण खगशार्दूल भोजकेन विशेषतः .. 23 ..
text_mt: Therefore it must be performed with effort year after year on the day of death / by a man, O tiger among birds, especially by a Bhojaka.

sanskrit_iast:
bhojako yastu vai śrāddhaṃ na karoti khagādhipa ..
mātāpitṛbhyāṃ satataṃ varṣevarṣe mṛte'hani ...27.
meaning:
भोजको यस्तु वै श्राद्धं न करोति खगाधिप ..
मातापितृभ्यां सततं वर्षेवर्षे मृतेऽहनि ...27.
text_mt: The Bhojaka who indeed does not perform the śrāddha, O king of birds, / for his mother and father constantly year after year on the day of death,

sanskrit_iast:
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ tāmisraṃ nāma nāmataḥ ..
tato bhavati duṣṭātmā nagare sūkaraḥ khaga .. 25 ..
meaning:
स याति नरकं घोरं तामिस्रं नाम नामतः ..
ततो भवति दुष्टात्मा नगरे सूकरः खग .. 25 ..
text_mt: goes to the terrible hell named Tāmisra. / Then that wicked-minded one becomes a hog in a city, O bird.

sanskrit_iast:
anūruruvāca .. ..
na jānāti dinaṃ yastu na māsaṃ vibudhādhipa ..
mṛtau yatra mahāprājña pitarau sa kathaṃ naraḥ ..
śrāddhaṃ karotu vai tābhyāṃ vidhivadvatsarātmakam .. 26 ..
meaning:
अनूरुरुवाच .. ..
न जानाति दिनं यस्तु न मासं विबुधाधिप ..
मृतौ यत्र महाप्राज्ञ पितरौ स कथं नरः ..
श्राद्धं करोतु वै ताभ्यां विधिवद्वत्सरात्मकम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: Anūru said: / A man who knows neither the day nor the month, O lord of deities, / on which his two parents died, O greatly wise one, how may that man / perform the annual śrāddha for them according to the rules?

sanskrit_iast:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
na jānāti naro yastu mṛtānāṃ vinatātmaja ..
māsaṃ dinaṃ mṛtānāṃ tu pitṝṇāṃ khagasattama .. 27 ..
meaning:
.. आदित्य उवाच .. ..
न जानाति नरो यस्तु मृतानां विनतात्मज ..
मासं दिनं मृतानां तु पितॄणां खगसत्तम .. 27 ..
text_mt: Āditya said: / The man who does not know, O son of Vinatā, / the month or day of the departed ancestors, O best among birds—

sanskrit_iast:
yathā kuryātkhagaśreṣṭha śṛṇu kṛtsnaṃ samāsataḥ ..
mṛtāhaṃ yo na jānāti mānavo vinatātmaja .. 28 ..
meaning:
यथा कुर्यात्खगश्रेष्ठ शृणु कृत्स्नं समासतः ..
मृताहं यो न जानाति मानवो विनतात्मज .. 28 ..
text_mt: hear in full, in brief, how he should act, O best of birds. / The mortal who does not know the day of death, O son of Vinatā,

sanskrit_iast:
tena kāryamamāyāṃ ca śrāddhaṃ sāṃvatsaraṃ khaga ..
māse mārgaśire vīra māghe vā vidhivatkhaga .. .. 29 ..
meaning:
तेन कार्यममायां च श्राद्धं सांवत्सरं खग ..
मासे मार्गशिरे वीर माघे वा विधिवत्खग .. .. 29 ..
text_mt: by him the annual śrāddha must be performed on the new moon day, O bird, / in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, O hero, or in Māgha, according to the rule, O bird.

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣato bhojanena yo māṃ pūjyate sadā ..
prītaye mama vai tena saṃpūjyāḥ pitaraḥ sadā .. 1.183.30 ..
meaning:
विशेषतो भोजनेन यो मां पूज्यते सदा ..
प्रीतये मम वै तेन संपूज्याः पितरः सदा .. 1.183.30 ..
text_mt: He who always worships me, especially through the feeding [of priests], / by him the ancestors must always be venerated for my gratification.

sanskrit_iast:
mameṣṭāḥ pitaro nityaṃ gāvo viprāśca suvrata ..
tasmācca te sadā pūjyā madbhaktena viśeṣataḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
ममेष्टाः पितरो नित्यं गावो विप्राश्च सुव्रत ..
तस्माच्च ते सदा पूज्या मद्भक्तेन विशेषतः .. 31 ..
text_mt: Dear to me are always the ancestors, cows, and brāhmaṇas, O one of good vows; / therefore, they should always be worshipped especially by my devotee.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sauradharme śrāddhavidhikathanaṃ nāma tryaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..183.. ..
brāhmaṇadharmavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे सौरधर्मे श्राद्धविधिकथनं नाम त्र्यशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..183.. ..
ब्राह्मणधर्मविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-third chapter, named 'Description of the Rules for Śrāddha', in the Solar Dharma within the Saptamīkalpa of the Brāhmaparvan, in the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Rules of Conduct for Brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
prakhyāte pratyayenaiva praśnapūrvaṃ pratigrahaḥ ..
yajane'dhyāpane vāde ṣaḍvidho vedavikrayaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
प्रख्याते प्रत्ययेनैव प्रश्नपूर्वं प्रतिग्रहः ..
यजनेऽध्यापने वादे षड्विधो वेदविक्रयः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Selling the Veda is sixfold: upon public fame, through trust alone, preceded by an enquiry, / in performing a sacrifice, in teaching, and in disputation.
title: Brāhmaṇadharmavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
veda vikrayanirdiṣṭaṃ striyā cāvarjitaṃ dhanam ..
na deyaṃ pitṛdevebhyo yacca klībātkhagādhipa .. 2 ..
meaning:
वेद विक्रयनिर्दिष्टं स्त्रिया चावर्जितं धनम् ..
न देयं पितृदेवेभ्यो यच्च क्लीबात्खगाधिप .. 2 ..
text_mt: Wealth designated by selling the Veda, and wealth acquired through a woman, / or that which comes from a eunuch, should not be given to the ancestors or gods, O king of birds.

sanskrit_iast:
anuyogena yo dadyādbrāhmaṇāya pratigraham ..
sa pūrvaṃ narakaṃ yāti brāhmaṇāstadanaṃtaram .. 3 ..
meaning:
अनुयोगेन यो दद्याद्ब्राह्मणाय प्रतिग्रहम् ..
स पूर्वं नरकं याति ब्राह्मणास्तदनंतरम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: He who gives a gift to a brāhmaṇa following an inquiry, / goes to hell first, and after him the brāhmaṇa [goes as well].

sanskrit_iast:
vedākṣarāṇi yāvaṃti niyujyanterthakāraṇāt ..
tāvatyo bhrūṇahatyā vai vedavikrayamāpnuyāt .. 4 ..
meaning:
वेदाक्षराणि यावंति नियुज्यन्तेर्थकारणात् ..
तावत्यो भ्रूणहत्या वै वेदविक्रयमाप्नुयात् .. 4 ..
text_mt: For as many syllables of the Veda as are employed for the sake of money, / so many foeticides indeed does one incur by the sale of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśvadevena yo hīna ādityasya ca karmaṇaḥ ..
sarve te vṛṣalā jñeyāḥ prāptavedāśca brāhmaṇāḥ ..5..
meaning:
वैश्वदेवेन यो हीन आदित्यस्य च कर्मणः ..
सर्वे ते वृषला ज्ञेयाः प्राप्तवेदाश्च ब्राह्मणाः ..5..
text_mt: Those brāhmaṇas who are destitute of the vaiśvadeva and of the rite of Āditya, / even though they have acquired the Veda, are all to be known as outcasts.

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣāmadhyayanaṃ nāsti ye ca kecidanagnayaḥ..
kulaṃ vā'śrotriyaṃ yeṣāṃ sarve te śūdradharmiṇaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
येषामध्ययनं नास्ति ये च केचिदनग्नयः..
कुलं वाऽश्रोत्रियं येषां सर्वे ते शूद्रधर्मिणः .. 6 ..
text_mt: Those who have no Vedic study, and those who keep no sacred fire, / or those whose family is unlearned in the Veda, all share the condition of a śūdra.

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtvā vaiśvadevaṃ tu yo bhuṅkte so'budhaḥ khaga ..
vṛthā tenānnapākena yamayoniṃ vrajettu saḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
अकृत्वा वैश्वदेवं तु यो भुङ्क्ते सोऽबुधः खग ..
वृथा तेनान्नपाकेन यमयोनिं व्रजेत्तु सः .. 7 ..
text_mt: He who eats without having performed the vaiśvadeva is a fool, O bird; / on account of that vain cooking of food, he goes to the womb of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
priyo vā yadi vā dveṣyo mūrkhaḥ paṃḍita eva ca ..
vaiśvadeve tu saṃprāpte so'tithiḥ svargasaṃkramaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
प्रियो वा यदि वा द्वेष्यो मूर्खः पंडित एव च ..
वैश्वदेवे तु संप्राप्ते सोऽतिथिः स्वर्गसंक्रमः .. 8 ..
text_mt: Whether dear or hostile, a fool or a learned man, / who arrives when the vaiśvadeva is underway—such a guest is a bridge to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
naikagrāmīṇamatithiṃ viprasāṃgatikaṃ tathā ..
aciṃtyobhyāgato yasmāttasmādatithirucyate .. 9 ..
meaning:
नैकग्रामीणमतिथिं विप्रसांगतिकं तथा ..
अचिंत्योभ्यागतो यस्मात्तस्मादतिथिरुच्यते .. 9 ..
text_mt: One should not consider as a guest a co-villager or a brāhmaṇa traveling companion. / Because he arrives unthought of, for that reason he is called a guest.

sanskrit_iast:
aciṃtyaḥ sa tu vai nāmnā vaiśvadeva upāgataḥ ..
atithiṃ taṃ vijānīyānna punaḥ pūrvamāgataḥ .. 1.184.10 ..
meaning:
अचिंत्यः स तु वै नाम्ना वैश्वदेव उपागतः ..
अतिथिं तं विजानीयान्न पुनः पूर्वमागतः .. 1.184.10 ..
text_mt: He who arrives unthought of by name at the vaiśvadeva / should be recognized as a guest, and not one who has arrived beforehand.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvacca prāpnuyādannaṃ kṛtāśīḥ snātako dvijaḥ ..
tasyānnasya caturbhāgaṃ haṃtakāraṃ viduḥ khaga..11..
meaning:
यावच्च प्राप्नुयादन्नं कृताशीः स्नातको द्विजः ..
तस्यान्नस्य चतुर्भागं हंतकारं विदुः खग..11..
text_mt: As much food as a bath-graduate twice-born who has pronounced blessings would receive, / one-fourth of that food they know as the hantakāra, O bird.

sanskrit_iast:
grāsamātrā bhavedbhikṣā catuṣkālaṃ caturguṇam ..
puṣkalāni ca catvāri haṃtakāro vidhīyate .. 12 ..
meaning:
ग्रासमात्रा भवेद्भिक्षा चतुष्कालं चतुर्गुणम् ..
पुष्कलानि च चत्वारि हंतकारो विधीयते .. 12 ..
text_mt: Alms should be merely a mouthful; [the grāsa is] fourfold, four times that amount; / and four puṣkalas are prescribed as the hantakāra.

sanskrit_iast:
ārūḍho naiṣṭhikaṃ dharmaṃ yastu pracyavate punaḥ ..
cāṃdrāyaṇaṃ carenmāsamiti viddhi khagādhipa .. 13 ..
meaning:
आरूढो नैष्ठिकं धर्मं यस्तु प्रच्यवते पुनः ..
चांद्रायणं चरेन्मासमिति विद्धि खगाधिप .. 13 ..
text_mt: He who, having undertaken the lifelong observance of celibacy, lapses again, / should perform the cāndrāyaṇa for a month; know this, O king of birds.

sanskrit_iast:
ārūḍhapatitāpatyā brāhmaṇo vṛṣalena ca ..
dvāvetau viddhi cāṃḍālau veditrādyaśca jāyate .. 14 ..
meaning:
आरूढपतितापत्या ब्राह्मणो वृषलेन च ..
द्वावेतौ विद्धि चांडालौ वेदित्राद्यश्च जायते .. 14 ..
text_mt: The offspring of one who has fallen after taking vows, and a brāhmaṇa [begotten] by an outcast— / know both of these as cāṇḍālas, and [likewise] one who is born from a [woman who had a previous] husband.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇī kulaṭā nityaṃ svakaṃ tyaktvā patiṃ khaga ..
anyasya viśate gehe brāhmaṇasya khagādhipa..15..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणी कुलटा नित्यं स्वकं त्यक्त्वा पतिं खग ..
अन्यस्य विशते गेहे ब्राह्मणस्य खगाधिप..15..
text_mt: A brāhmaṇa woman who is unchaste constantly, having abandoned her own husband, O bird, / enters the house of another brāhmaṇa, O king of birds;

sanskrit_iast:
utpadyate tu yastasyā brāhmaṇena mahāmate ..
sa cāṃḍālo mahānprokto mahācāṃḍāla ityuta..16..
meaning:
उत्पद्यते तु यस्तस्या ब्राह्मणेन महामते ..
स चांडालो महान्प्रोक्तो महाचांडाल इत्युत..16..
text_mt: he who is born of her by that brāhmaṇa, O highly intelligent one, / is proclaimed a great cāṇḍāla, indeed called a mahācāṇḍāla.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu pravrajito bhūtvā punaḥ sevati maithunam..
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate krimiḥ ..
paṃcagavyena śuddhiḥ syādityāha mama dehakṛt..17..
meaning:
यस्तु प्रव्रजितो भूत्वा पुनः सेवति मैथुनम्..
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि विष्ठायां जायते क्रिमिः ..
पंचगव्येन शुद्धिः स्यादित्याह मम देहकृत्..17..
text_mt: He who, having become a renouncer, engages again in sexual union, / is born as a worm in faeces for sixty thousand years. / Purification occurs by the five products of the cow, so said my creator.

sanskrit_iast:
abhojyaṃ brāhmaṇasyānnaṃ vṛṣalena nimaṃtritam ..
tathaiva vṛṣalasyānnaṃ brāhmaṇena nimaṃtritam ..18..
meaning:
अभोज्यं ब्राह्मणस्यान्नं वृषलेन निमंत्रितम् ..
तथैव वृषलस्यान्नं ब्राह्मणेन निमंत्रितम् ..18..
text_mt: Food of a brāhmaṇa invited by an outcast must not be eaten, / and likewise the food of an outcast invited by a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānnaṃ dadacchūdraḥ śūdrānnaṃ brāhmaṇo dadat ..
ubhāvetāvabhojyānnau bhuktvā cāṃdrāyaṇaṃ caret ..19..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणान्नं ददच्छूद्रः शूद्रान्नं ब्राह्मणो ददत् ..
उभावेतावभोज्यान्नौ भुक्त्वा चांद्रायणं चरेत् ..19..
text_mt: A śūdra who gives food of a brāhmaṇa, and a brāhmaṇa who gives food of a śūdra— / both of these are persons whose food is inedible; having eaten it, one should perform the cāndrāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
upanikṣepadharmeṇa śūdrānnaṃ ca paceddvijaḥ ..
abhojyaṃ tadbhavedannaṃ sa ca vipraḥ purohitaḥ ..1.184.20..
meaning:
उपनिक्षेपधर्मेण शूद्रान्नं च पचेद्द्विजः ..
अभोज्यं तद्भवेदन्नं स च विप्रः पुरोहितः ..1.184.20..
text_mt: And if a twice-born should cook the food of a śūdra under the arrangement of a trust, / that food would become inedible, and that brāhmaṇa becomes [merely] a domestic priest.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrānnaṃ śūdrasaṃparkaṃ śūdreṇa saha vāsanam ..
śūdrājjñānāgamaḥ kaścijvalaṃtamapi pātayet ..21..
meaning:
शूद्रान्नं शूद्रसंपर्कं शूद्रेण सह वासनम् ..
शूद्राज्ज्ञानागमः कश्चिज्वलंतमपि पातयेत् ..21..
text_mt: Food from a śūdra, contact with a śūdra, residing together with a śūdra, / and any acquisition of knowledge from a śūdra will cause even a blazing [sage] to fall.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrānnopahatā viprā vihvalā ratilālasāḥ ..
kupitāḥ kiṃ kariṣyaṃti nirviṣā iva pannagāḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
शूद्रान्नोपहता विप्रा विह्वला रतिलालसाः ..
कुपिताः किं करिष्यंति निर्विषा इव पन्नगाः .. 22 ..
text_mt: Brāhmaṇas ruined by the food of a śūdra, agitated and longing for sexual pleasure— / what will they do when angered, like serpents deprived of poison?

sanskrit_iast:
hastadattāstu ye snehāllavaṇavyaṃjanādayaḥ ..
dātāraṃ nādhitiṣṭhaṃti bhoktā bhuṃkte tu kilbiṣam .. 23 ..
meaning:
हस्तदत्तास्तु ये स्नेहाल्लवणव्यंजनादयः ..
दातारं नाधितिष्ठंति भोक्ता भुंक्ते तु किल्बिषम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Salt, condiments, and the like that are given by hand out of affection / do not benefit the giver, and the eater eats sin.

sanskrit_iast:
āyasena tu pātreṇa yadannamupadīyate ..
bhoktā viṣṭhāśanaṃ bhuṃkte dātā tu narakaṃ vrajet .. 24 ..
meaning:
आयसेन तु पात्रेण यदन्नमुपदीयते ..
भोक्ता विष्ठाशनं भुंक्ते दाता तु नरकं व्रजेत् .. 24 ..
text_mt: Food that is served from an iron vessel: / the eater eats an eating of excrement, and the giver goes to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃgulyā daṃtakāṣṭhaṃ yatpratyakṣalavaṇaṃ ca yat ..
mṛttikābhakṣaṇaṃ caiva tulyaṃ gomāṃsabhakṣaṇaiḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
अंगुल्या दंतकाष्ठं यत्प्रत्यक्षलवणं च यत् ..
मृत्तिकाभक्षणं चैव तुल्यं गोमांसभक्षणैः .. 25 ..
text_mt: Cleaning the teeth with a finger, raw salt directly [eaten], / and eating earth are equal to eating beef.

sanskrit_iast:
mukhe paryuṣite nityaṃ bhavatyaprayato dvijaḥ ..
tasmācchuṣkamathārdraṃ vā bhakṣayeddaṃtadhāvanam .. 26 ..
meaning:
मुखे पर्युषिते नित्यं भवत्यप्रयतो द्विजः ..
तस्माच्छुष्कमथार्द्रं वा भक्षयेद्दंतधावनम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: When his mouth has spent the night stale, a twice-born is always impure; / therefore, dry or moist, he should chew a tooth-cleaning stick.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpālaṃkāravastrāṇi gaṃdha mālyānulepanam..
upavāse na duṣyaṃti daṃtadhāvanamaṃjanam ..27..
meaning:
पुष्पालंकारवस्त्राणि गंध माल्यानुलेपनम्..
उपवासे न दुष्यंति दंतधावनमंजनम् ..27..
text_mt: Flowers, ornaments, garments, perfumes, garlands, unguents, / the tooth-cleaning stick, and collyrium do not corrupt a fast.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhāṃte vasate mūrkho dūre cāsya guṇānvitaḥ ..
guṇanvite ca dātavyaṃ nāsti mūrkhavya tikramaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
गृहांते वसते मूर्खो दूरे चास्य गुणान्वितः ..
गुणन्विते च दातव्यं नास्ति मूर्खव्य तिक्रमः .. 28 ..
text_mt: If a fool lives close to one's house, and a virtuous man far from it, / one should give to the virtuous man; there is no wrong in bypassing the fool.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇātikramo nāsti vipre vedavivarjite ..
jvalaṃtamagnimutsṛjya na hi bhasmani hūyate .. 29 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणातिक्रमो नास्ति विप्रे वेदविवर्जिते ..
ज्वलंतमग्निमुत्सृज्य न हि भस्मनि हूयते .. 29 ..
text_mt: There is no offense in passing over a brāhmaṇa when the priest is devoid of the Vedas; / having abandoned a blazing fire, one does not make offerings in ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
sannikṛṣṭamadhīyānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ yo vyatikramet..
bhojanenaiva dānena dahatyāsaptamaṃ kulam .. 1.184.30 ..
meaning:
सन्निकृष्टमधीयानं ब्राह्मणं यो व्यतिक्रमेत्..
भोजनेनैव दानेन दहत्यासप्तमं कुलम् .. 1.184.30 ..
text_mt: He who bypasses a learned brāhmaṇa living nearby / with food or gifts burns his family up to the seventh generation.

sanskrit_iast:
.. anūruruvāca .. ..
evameva jagannātha devadeva jagatpate ..
kiṃ tu yatte purā deva śrutaṃ vākyaṃ mahātmanaḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
.. अनूरुरुवाच .. ..
एवमेव जगन्नाथ देवदेव जगत्पते ..
किं तु यत्ते पुरा देव श्रुतं वाक्यं महात्मनः .. 31 ..
text_mt: Anūru said: / So it is indeed, Lord of the world, God of gods, Master of the universe. / But the word of the great-souled one which was heard by you formerly, O god,

sanskrit_iast:
gadato nāradasyaiva śṛṇu tvaṃ vibudhādhipa ..
gadato me suraśreṣṭha dharmyamarthaṃ sukhāvaham .. 32 ..
meaning:
गदतो नारदस्यैव शृणु त्वं विबुधाधिप ..
गदतो मे सुरश्रेष्ठ धर्म्यमर्थं सुखावहम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: spoken by Nārada himself, hear, O ruler of the gods, / as I declare it, O best of the gods, [a word] righteous, purposeful, and bringing happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
satyaniṣṭhaṃ dvijaṃ yastu śuklajātiṃ priyaṃvadam ..
mūrkhaṃ pākhaṃḍinaṃ vāpi vṛttihīnamathāpi vā .. 33 ..
meaning:
सत्यनिष्ठं द्विजं यस्तु शुक्लजातिं प्रियंवदम् ..
मूर्खं पाखंडिनं वापि वृत्तिहीनमथापि वा .. 33 ..
text_mt: A man who bypasses a twice-born fixed in truth, of pure birth, who speaks kindly, / or [even] one who is a fool, a hypocrite, or without a livelihood,

sanskrit_iast:
atikramya naro ghoraṃ narakaṃ pātayetkhaga..
sapta parānsapta pūrvānpuruṣānātmanā saha .. 34 ..
meaning:
अतिक्रम्य नरो घोरं नरकं पातयेत्खग..
सप्त परान्सप्त पूर्वान्पुरुषानात्मना सह .. 34 ..
text_mt: plunges, O bird, into a terrible hell, / together with himself, seven succeeding and seven preceding men [of his lineage].

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānnātikramedrājā brāhmaṇaṃ prātiveśikam ..
saṃbandhatastathāsannaṃ dauhitraṃ vidyate tathā .. 35 ..
meaning:
तस्मान्नातिक्रमेद्राजा ब्राह्मणं प्रातिवेशिकम् ..
संबन्धतस्तथासन्नं दौहित्रं विद्यते तथा .. 35 ..
text_mt: Therefore a king should not pass over a neighboring brāhmaṇa; / likewise a daughter's son who is near by kinship is acknowledged,

sanskrit_iast:
bhāgineyaṃ viśeṣeṇa tathā baṃdhuṃ grahādhipa ..
nātikramennarastvetānsumūrkhānapi gopate ..
atikramya mahadraudraṃ rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet .. 36 ..
meaning:
भागिनेयं विशेषेण तथा बंधुं ग्रहाधिप ..
नातिक्रमेन्नरस्त्वेतान्सुमूर्खानपि गोपते ..
अतिक्रम्य महद्रौद्रं रौरवं नरकं व्रजेत् .. 36 ..
text_mt: and especially a sister's son, and likewise a kinsman, O lord of planets. / A man should not pass over these, even if they are utter fools, O protector of cows; / by passing them over, he goes to the dread, terrible Raurava hell.

sanskrit_iast:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
evametanna saṃdeho yathā vadasi khecara ..
mamāpyavagataṃ vīra brāhmaṇaṃ na parīkṣayet .. 37 ..
meaning:
.. आदित्य उवाच .. ..
एवमेतन्न संदेहो यथा वदसि खेचर ..
ममाप्यवगतं वीर ब्राह्मणं न परीक्षयेत् .. 37 ..
text_mt: The Sun said: / It is so; there is no doubt, just as you say, O sky-goer. / It is also understood by me, O hero, that one should not test a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadevamayaṃ vipraṃ sarvalokamayaṃ tathā ..
tasmātsaṃpūjayedenaṃ na guṇāṃstasya ciṃtayet .. 38 ..
meaning:
सर्वदेवमयं विप्रं सर्वलोकमयं तथा ..
तस्मात्संपूजयेदेनं न गुणांस्तस्य चिंतयेत् .. 38 ..
text_mt: A priest embodies all the gods and embodies all the worlds; / therefore one should honor him and not consider his qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
kevalaṃ ciṃtayejjātiṃ na guṇānvinatātmaja ..
tasmādāmaṃtrayetpūrvamāsannaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ budhaḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
केवलं चिंतयेज्जातिं न गुणान्विनतात्मज ..
तस्मादामंत्रयेत्पूर्वमासन्नं ब्राह्मणं बुधः .. 39 ..
text_mt: One should consider only his birth, not his qualities, O son of Vinatā; / therefore a wise man should first invite a nearby brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
yastvāsannamatikramya brāhmaṇaṃ patitādṛte ..
dūrasthānpūjayenmūḍho guṇāḍhyānnarakaṃ vrajet .. 1.184.40 ..
meaning:
यस्त्वासन्नमतिक्रम्य ब्राह्मणं पतितादृते ..
दूरस्थान्पूजयेन्मूढो गुणाढ्यान्नरकं व्रजेत् .. 1.184.40 ..
text_mt: He who, having bypassed a nearby brāhmaṇa—except for an outcaste—, / foolishly honors those living far away who are rich in qualities goes to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
devakarmavināśena brahmasvaharaṇena ca ..
devadravyaṃ dvijānnaṃ ca brahmasvaṃ brāhmaṇārjitam ..
viyonyāṃ kṣipate yastu viyonimadhigacchati .. 41 ..
meaning:
देवकर्मविनाशेन ब्रह्मस्वहरणेन च ..
देवद्रव्यं द्विजान्नं च ब्रह्मस्वं ब्राह्मणार्जितम् ..
वियोन्यां क्षिपते यस्तु वियोनिमधिगच्छति .. 41 ..
text_mt: By destroying the rites for the gods and by seizing a brāhmaṇa's property— / divine property, food meant for a twice-born, and a brāhmaṇa's property acquired by a brāhmaṇa— / he who casts it into a non-human womb enters a non-human womb.

sanskrit_iast:
mā dadasveti yo brūyādgavāgnibrāhmaṇeṣu vai ..
tiryagyoniśataṃ gatvā cāṃḍā leṣvabhijāyate .. 42 ..
meaning:
मा ददस्वेति यो ब्रूयाद्गवाग्निब्राह्मणेषु वै ..
तिर्यग्योनिशतं गत्वा चांडा लेष्वभिजायते .. 42 ..
text_mt: He who says, 'Do not give!' when cows, fire, and brāhmaṇas [are concerned], / having gone through a hundred animal wombs, is born among Caṇḍālas.

sanskrit_iast:
yattu vācā pratijñātaṃ karmaṇā nopapāditam ..
tadṛṇaṃ dharmasaṃyuktamiha loke paratra ca .. 43 ..
meaning:
यत्तु वाचा प्रतिज्ञातं कर्मणा नोपपादितम् ..
तदृणं धर्मसंयुक्तमिह लोके परत्र च .. 43 ..
text_mt: What is promised by word of mouth but not fulfilled by deed / is a debt coupled with righteousness in this world and the next.

sanskrit_iast:
vedavidyāvratasnāte śrotriye gṛhamāgate ..
krīḍaṃtyoṣadhayaḥ sarvā yāsyāmaḥ paramāṃ gatim .. 44 ..
meaning:
वेदविद्याव्रतस्नाते श्रोत्रिये गृहमागते ..
क्रीडंत्योषधयः सर्वा यास्यामः परमां गतिम् .. 44 ..
text_mt: When a learned priest who has completed the vow of Vedic study arrives at the house, / all the medicinal herbs rejoice, [saying,] 'We shall attain the highest state!'

sanskrit_iast:
madhu māṃsaṃ surāṃ somaṃ lākṣādyaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā ..
vikrīyānyatamaṃ teṣāṃ dvijaścāṃdrāyaṇaṃ caret .. 45 ..
meaning:
मधु मांसं सुरां सोमं लाक्षाद्यं लवणं तथा ..
विक्रीयान्यतमं तेषां द्विजश्चांद्रायणं चरेत् .. 45 ..
text_mt: Having sold honey, meat, spirituous liquor, soma, lac and the like, or salt— / any one of these—a twice-born should perform the Cāndrāyaṇa penance.

sanskrit_iast:
guḍaṃ tilaṃ tathā nīlaṃ keśāngodhūmakānyavān ..
vikrīya brāhmaṇo gāṃ ca kṛcchraṃ sāṃtapanaṃ caret .. 46 ..
meaning:
गुडं तिलं तथा नीलं केशान्गोधूमकान्यवान् ..
विक्रीय ब्राह्मणो गां च कृच्छ्रं सांतपनं चरेत् .. 46 ..
text_mt: Having sold molasses, sesame seeds, indigo, hair, wheat, barley, / or a cow, a brāhmaṇa should perform the painful Sāṃtapana penance.

sanskrit_iast:
auṣṭramāvikadugdhaṃ ca annaṃ mṛtakasūtake ..
caurasyānnaṃ mṛtaśrāddhe bhuktvā cāṃdrāyaṇaṃ caret .. 47 ..
meaning:
औष्ट्रमाविकदुग्धं च अन्नं मृतकसूतके ..
चौरस्यान्नं मृतश्राद्धे भुक्त्वा चांद्रायणं चरेत् .. 47 ..
text_mt: Having drunk the milk of a camel or sheep, or eaten food during impurity from death or childbirth, / or the food of a thief, or at a funeral offering for the dead, one should perform the Cāndrāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
gavāṃ śṛṃgodake snāto mahānadyāśca saṃgame ..
samudradarśanādvāpi śunā daṣṭaḥ śucirbhavet .. 48 ..
meaning:
गवां शृंगोदके स्नातो महानद्याश्च संगमे ..
समुद्रदर्शनाद्वापि शुना दष्टः शुचिर्भवेत् .. 48 ..
text_mt: One bitten by a dog becomes pure by bathing in water from the horns of cows, / at the confluence of great rivers, or by the sight of the ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
vedavidyāvratasnātaḥ śunā daṣṭo dvijaḥ khaga ..
hiraṇyodakamiśraṃ tu ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśuddhyati .. 49 ..
meaning:
वेदविद्याव्रतस्नातः शुना दष्टो द्विजः खग ..
हिरण्योदकमिश्रं तु घृतं प्राश्य विशुद्ध्यति .. 49 ..
text_mt: A twice-born who has bathed upon completing his Vedic study and vow, if bitten by a dog, O bird, / becomes completely pure upon consuming clarified butter mixed with water containing gold.

sanskrit_iast:
tiṣṭhanvāpyatha vā gacchañchunā daṣṭo dvijaḥ khaga ..
vajraṃ prāśya śuciḥ syādvai yathāha bhagavānmanuḥ .. 1.184.50 ..
meaning:
तिष्ठन्वाप्यथ वा गच्छञ्छुना दष्टो द्विजः खग ..
वज्रं प्राश्य शुचिः स्याद्वै यथाह भगवान्मनुः .. 1.184.50 ..
text_mt: Standing or walking, a twice-born who is bitten by a dog, O bird, / becomes pure by consuming vajra, as the blessed Manu has said.

sanskrit_iast:
vratinaścāpi daṣṭasya trirātraṃ kṣapaṇaṃ smṛtam ..
saghṛtaṃ ca tato bhuktvā vrataśeṣaṃ samācaret .. 51 ..
meaning:
व्रतिनश्चापि दष्टस्य त्रिरात्रं क्षपणं स्मृतम् ..
सघृतं च ततो भुक्त्वा व्रतशेषं समाचरेत् .. 51 ..
text_mt: For one observing a vow who has been bitten, fasting for three nights is prescribed; / and then, having eaten with clarified butter, he should perform the rest of his vow.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇī tu śunā daṣṭā some dṛṣṭaṃ samācaret ..
yadā na dṛśyate somaḥ prāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ bhavet .. 52 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणी तु शुना दष्टा सोमे दृष्टं समाचरेत् ..
यदा न दृश्यते सोमः प्रायश्चित्तं कथं भवेत् .. 52 ..
text_mt: A brāhmaṇa woman bitten by a dog should perform [the expiation] when Soma is seen. / When Soma is not seen, how can the expiation take place?

sanskrit_iast:
yāṃ diśaṃ vrajate somastāṃ diśaṃ cāvalokayet ..
somamārgeṇa sā pūrvā pañcapūtena śudhyati .. 53. ..
meaning:
यां दिशं व्रजते सोमस्तां दिशं चावलोकयेत् ..
सोममार्गेण सा पूर्वा पञ्चपूतेन शुध्यति .. 53. ..
text_mt: She should look in that direction in which Soma goes; / by way of Soma's path, she becomes purified first by the five purifying items.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇasya brahmadvāre pūya śoṇitasaṃbhave ..
krimibhirdaśyate yaśca niṣkṛtiṃ tasya vacmi te .. 54 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणस्य ब्रह्मद्वारे पूय शोणितसंभवे ..
क्रिमिभिर्दश्यते यश्च निष्कृतिं तस्य वच्मि ते .. 54 ..
text_mt: When in the case of a brāhmaṇa pus and blood appear at the Brahmarandhra / and he is bitten by worms, I will tell you his expiation.

sanskrit_iast:
gavāṃ tatra purīṣeṇa trikālaṃ snānamācaret ..
dadhi kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ pītvā kṛmidaṣṭo viśudhyati .. 55 ..
meaning:
गवां तत्र पुरीषेण त्रिकालं स्नानमाचरेत् ..
दधि क्षीरं घृतं पीत्वा कृमिदष्टो विशुध्यति .. 55 ..
text_mt: He should take a bath with cow dung at the three junctures of the day; / having drunk curd, milk, and clarified butter, one bitten by worms is purified.

sanskrit_iast:
atha nābhyāḥ pradaṣṭasya āpādādvinatātmaja ..
etadvinirdiśetprājñaḥ prāyaścittaṃ khagādhipa .. 56 ..
meaning:
अथ नाभ्याः प्रदष्टस्य आपादाद्विनतात्मज ..
एतद्विनिर्दिशेत्प्राज्ञः प्रायश्चित्तं खगाधिप .. 56 ..
text_mt: Now, for one bitten below the navel down to the feet, O son of Vinatā, / a wise man should prescribe this expiation, O lord of birds.

sanskrit_iast:
nābhikaṇṭhāṃtare vīra yadā cotpadyate kṛmiḥ ..
ṣaḍrātraṃ tu tadā proktaṃ prāyaścittaṃ manīṣibhiḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
नाभिकण्ठांतरे वीर यदा चोत्पद्यते कृमिः ..
षड्रात्रं तु तदा प्रोक्तं प्रायश्चित्तं मनीषिभिः .. 57 ..
text_mt: When worms appear between the navel and the throat, O hero, / an expiation of six nights is then prescribed by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā daśaṃti śirasi kṛmayo vinatātmaja ..
kṛcchraṃ tadā caretprājñaḥ śuddhaye kaśyapātmaja .. 58 ..
meaning:
यदा दशंति शिरसि कृमयो विनतात्मज ..
कृच्छ्रं तदा चरेत्प्राज्ञः शुद्धये कश्यपात्मज .. 58 ..
text_mt: When worms bite upon the head, O son of Vinatā, / a wise man should then perform the Kṛcchra penance for purification, O son of Kaśyapa.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtānnaṃ madhu māṃsaṃ ca yastu bhuñjīta brāhmaṇaḥ ..
sa trīṇyahānyupavasedekāhaṃ codake vaset .. 59 .. ..
mātṛśrāddhavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
मृतान्नं मधु मांसं च यस्तु भुञ्जीत ब्राह्मणः ..
स त्रीण्यहान्युपवसेदेकाहं चोदके वसेत् .. 59 .. ..
मातृश्राद्धविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
A brāhmaṇa who eats food of a dead person, honey, or meat / should fast for three days and live in water for one day.
Description of the Rules for the Rite to the Mothers

sanskrit_iast:
.. .. āditya uvāca .. ..
rātrau śrāddhaṃ na kurvīta rākṣasī kīrtitā hi sā ..
sandhyayorubhayorvīra sūrye caiva tirohite ..1..
meaning:
.. .. आदित्य उवाच .. ..
रात्रौ श्राद्धं न कुर्वीत राक्षसी कीर्तिता हि सा ..
सन्ध्ययोरुभयोर्वीर सूर्ये चैव तिरोहिते ..1..
text_mt: The Sun said: / One should not perform a śrāddha at night, for it is declared to be demonic, / nor at both twilights, O hero, when the sun has disappeared.
title: Mātṛśrāddhavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtvā mātṛyajñaṃ tu yaḥ śrāddhaṃ pariveṣayet ..
tātasya krodhasaṃyuktāṃ hiṃsāmicchaṃti dāruṇām ..2..
meaning:
अकृत्वा मातृयज्ञं तु यः श्राद्धं परिवेषयेत् ..
तातस्य क्रोधसंयुक्तां हिंसामिच्छंति दारुणाम् ..2..
text_mt: He who serves a śrāddha without first performing the sacrifice to the Mothers: / filled with anger, they desire dreadful harm for the father.

sanskrit_iast:
.. anūruruvāca .. ..
mātṛśrāddhaṃ kathaṃ kāryaṃ kāśca tā mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ..
nāṃdīmukhāśca pitaraḥ kathaṃ pūjāmavāpnuyuḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
.. अनूरुरुवाच .. ..
मातृश्राद्धं कथं कार्यं काश्च ता मातरः स्मृताः..
नांदीमुखाश्च पितरः कथं पूजामवाप्नुयुः .. 3 ..
text_mt: Anūru said: / How is the śrāddha to the Mothers to be performed, and who are remembered as those Mothers? / And how do the ancestors whose faces are gladdened receive worship?

sanskrit_iast:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
hanta te sampravakṣyāmi mātṛśrāddhavidhiṃ khaga ..
śṛṇu tvaṃ khagaśārdūla gadato mama kṛtsnaśaḥ ..4..
meaning:
.. आदित्य उवाच .. ..
हन्त ते सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि मातृश्राद्धविधिं खग ..
शृणु त्वं खगशार्दूल गदतो मम कृत्स्नशः ..4..

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvāhṇe bhojayedviprānaṣṭau sarvānpradakṣiṇān ..
tathānyaṃ navamaṃ vipraṃ caturaśca khagādhipa .. 5 ..
meaning:
पूर्वाह्णे भोजयेद्विप्रानष्टौ सर्वान्प्रदक्षिणान् ..
तथान्यं नवमं विप्रं चतुरश्च खगाधिप .. 5 ..
text_mt:
In the forenoon, one should feed eight brāhmaṇas, all in clockwise order,
and likewise another, ninth brāhmaṇa, and four [others], O lord of birds.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛjūnvai kṛtapāndattvā satyena vidhivatkhaga ..
kṛtvā yavaistilārthaṃ tu dadhimiśraṃ krameṇa ca ..6..
meaning:
ऋजून्वै कृतपान्दत्त्वा सत्येन विधिवत्खग ..
कृत्वा यवैस्तिलार्थं तु दधिमिश्रं क्रमेण च ..6..
text_mt:
Giving [them seats of kuśa grass] straight, properly formed, with truth and according to rule, O bird,
and using barley instead of sesamum, mixed with curd, in due order,

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapuṣpādikaṃ sarvaṃ kuryādviprapradakṣiṇam ..
brāhmaṇebhyastato dadyānmadhuraṃ bhojanaṃ khaga .. 7 ..
meaning:
गन्धपुष्पादिकं सर्वं कुर्याद्विप्रप्रदक्षिणम् ..
ब्राह्मणेभ्यस्ततो दद्यान्मधुरं भोजनं खग .. 7 ..
text_mt:
one should perform all [offerings of] perfume, flowers, and the like in a clockwise direction around the brāhmaṇas;
then, O bird, one should give sweet food to the brāhmaṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
guḍamiśraṃ khagaśreṣṭha savastramodanaṃ param ..
rasānāṃ modakāṃścaiva na ca tānkaṭukāṃstathā .. 8 ..
meaning:
गुडमिश्रं खगश्रेष्ठ सवस्त्रमोदनं परम् ..
रसानां मोदकांश्चैव न च तान्कटुकांस्तथा .. 8 ..
text_mt:
mixed with jaggery, O best of birds, along with clothes, boiled rice of supreme quality,
and modakas of various flavours, but never pungent ones.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ bhukteṣu vipreṣu dadyātpiṃḍā nsamāhitaḥ ..
dadhyakṣatavimiśrāṃstu badaraiśca khagādhipa .. 9 ..
meaning:
एवं भुक्तेषु विप्रेषु दद्यात्पिंडा न्समाहितः ..
दध्यक्षतविमिश्रांस्तु बदरैश्च खगाधिप .. 9 ..
text_mt:
When the brāhmaṇas have thus eaten, one should attentively offer the piṇḍas,
mixed with curd and unhusked barley grains, and with badara berries, O lord of birds.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā tu maṃḍapaṃ vīra caturasraṃ pradakṣiṇam ..
pūrvāgrāṃśca kuśāndattvā puṣpāṇāṃ prakaraṃ tathā .. 1.185.10 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा तु मंडपं वीर चतुरस्रं प्रदक्षिणम् ..
पूर्वाग्रांश्च कुशान्दत्त्वा पुष्पाणां प्रकरं तथा .. 1.185.10 ..
text_mt:
Having prepared a four-sided pavilion, O hero, circumambulating clockwise,
and having strewn kuśa grass pointing east, and likewise a scatter of flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
savyena pāṇinā vīra vidhivatkhagasattama ..
mātre pramātre tanmātre nirvapetpūrvatomukhaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
सव्येन पाणिना वीर विधिवत्खगसत्तम ..
मात्रे प्रमात्रे तन्मात्रे निर्वपेत्पूर्वतोमुखः .. 11 ..
text_mt:
with the right hand, O hero, according to rule, O best of birds,
facing east, one should offer [piṇḍas] to the mother, maternal grandmother, and maternal great-grandmother.

sanskrit_iast:
piturmātre tu tanmātre nirvapedvidhiva tkhaga ..
vṛddhāyai prapitāmahyai tathānyaṃ nirvapedbudhaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
पितुर्मात्रे तु तन्मात्रे निर्वपेद्विधिव त्खग ..
वृद्धायै प्रपितामह्यै तथान्यं निर्वपेद्बुधः .. 12 ..
text_mt:
According to rule, one should offer [piṇḍas] to the father's mother and to her mother, O bird;
and the wise man should offer another to the ancient paternal great-grandmother.

sanskrit_iast:
evamuddiśya vai mātṝḥ ṣaṭ piṃḍānnirvapetkhaga ..
aṣṭāśayeddvijānvīra mātṛśrāddhe khagā dhipa ..
navamaṃ sarvadaivatyaṃ bhojayedvidhivatkhaga .. 13 ..
meaning:
एवमुद्दिश्य वै मातॄः षट् पिंडान्निर्वपेत्खग ..
अष्टाशयेद्द्विजान्वीर मातृश्राद्धे खगा धिप ..
नवमं सर्वदैवत्यं भोजयेद्विधिवत्खग .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nāṃdīmukhāṃstānuddiśya pitṝnpaṃca dvijottamān ..
bhojayedvidhicchrāddhe vṛddhiśrāddhe pradakṣiṇam .. 14 ..
meaning:
नांदीमुखांस्तानुद्दिश्य पितॄन्पंच द्विजोत्तमान् ..
भोजयेद्विधिच्छ्राद्धे वृद्धिश्राद्धे प्रदक्षिणम् .. 14 ..
text_mt:
Intending them for the Nāndīmukha ancestors, one should feed five excellent twice-born men
clockwise in the prescribed śrāddha, the vṛddhi-śrāddha.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ śrāddhadvayaṃ kuyādvṛddhau kaśyapanaṃdana ..
tathānyamapi te vacmi paraṃ śrāddhavidhiṃ tava .. 15 ..
meaning:
इत्थं श्राद्धद्वयं कुयाद्वृद्धौ कश्यपनंदन ..
तथान्यमपि ते वच्मि परं श्राद्धविधिं तव .. 15 ..
text_mt:
In this way one should perform the two śrāddhas at a prosperity-rite, O son of Kaśyapa;
and I shall tell you another supreme rule for the śrāddha.

sanskrit_iast:
athaivaṃ bhojayecchrāddhe tatpūrvaṃ tu pravartayet..
anyathā tatra luṃpaṃti sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ ..16..
meaning:
अथैवं भोजयेच्छ्राद्धे तत्पूर्वं तु प्रवर्तयेत्..
अन्यथा तत्र लुंपंति सदेवासुरमानुषाः ..16..
text_mt:
Then, one should thus feed them at a śrāddha, but should set it forth prior to that;
otherwise, gods, asuras, and humans disrupt it there.

sanskrit_iast:
agnyabhāve tu viprasya pāṇāvevopapādayet..
yo hyagniḥ sa dvijo vīnda maṃtradarśibhirucyate.. .. 17 ..
meaning:
अग्न्यभावे तु विप्रस्य पाणावेवोपपादयेत्..
यो ह्यग्निः स द्विजो वीन्द मंत्रदर्शिभिरुच्यते.. .. 17 ..
text_mt:
In the absence of a sacrificial fire, one should place [the offering] right in the hand of a brāhmaṇa;
for that twice-born man is indeed the fire, O eagle, as is stated by seers of mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrva pātre yadannaṃ ca yaccānnamupakalpitam ..
tenaiva saha bhoktavyaṃ pṛthagbhāvo na vidyate ..18..
meaning:
पूर्व पात्रे यदन्नं च यच्चान्नमुपकल्पितम् ..
तेनैव सह भोक्तव्यं पृथग्भावो न विद्यते ..18..
text_mt:
Whatever food was in the first vessel, and whatever food has been prepared,
should be eaten together with it; no separateness is recognised.

sanskrit_iast:
dvau daive'tharvaṇau viprau prāṅmukhāvupaveśayet..
pitrye trīnudagāsyāṃśca vṛddhau cādhvaryusaṃgamān .. 19 ..
meaning:
द्वौ दैवेऽथर्वणौ विप्रौ प्राङ्मुखावुपवेशयेत्..
पित्र्ये त्रीनुदगास्यांश्च वृद्धौ चाध्वर्युसंगमान् .. 19 ..
text_mt:
One should seat two brāhmaṇas facing east for the gods, skilled in the Atharvaveda,
three facing north for the ancestors, and in the vṛddhi-śrāddha those who know the Adhvaryu [rites].

sanskrit_iast:
trīṇi śrāddhe pavitrāṇi dauhitraḥ kutupāstilāḥ ..
trīṇi cātra praśaṃsaṃti śaucamakrodhamatvaram .. 1.185.20 ..
meaning:
त्रीणि श्राद्धे पवित्राणि दौहित्रः कुतुपास्तिलाः ..
त्रीणि चात्र प्रशंसंति शौचमक्रोधमत्वरम् .. 1.185.20 ..
text_mt:
Three things are purifying at a śrāddha: a daughter's son, a kutapa blanket, and sesamum seeds;
and three things they praise here: purity, freedom from anger, and lack of haste.

sanskrit_iast:
dauhitraṃ khaṃḍamityuktaṃ lalāṭāya prajāpate ..
tatra śṛṃgasya yatpātraṃ taddauhitramiti smṛtam .. 21 ..
meaning:
दौहित्रं खंडमित्युक्तं ललाटाय प्रजापते ..
तत्र शृंगस्य यत्पात्रं तद्दौहित्रमिति स्मृतम् .. 21 ..
text_mt:
A rhinoceros horn is called 'dauhitra' for Prajāpati's forehead;
a vessel made of that horn is known as 'dauhitra'.

sanskrit_iast:
savyādaṃsātparibhraṣṭaṃ nābhideśe vyavasthitam ..
ekavastraṃ tu taṃ vidyāddaive pitrye ca varjayet .. 22 ..
meaning:
सव्यादंसात्परिभ्रष्टं नाभिदेशे व्यवस्थितम् ..
एकवस्त्रं तु तं विद्याद्दैवे पित्र्ये च वर्जयेत् .. 22 ..
text_mt:
If it has slipped from the left shoulder and rests at the region of the navel,
one should know him to have a single garment, and one should avoid [him] in rites for the gods and ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ tathā ..
nottarīyaṃ vinā kāryaṃ kṛtaṃ syānniṣphalaṃ yataḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
पितृदेवमनुष्याणां पूजनं भोजनं तथा ..
नोत्तरीयं विना कार्यं कृतं स्यान्निष्फलं यतः .. 23 ..
text_mt:
Worship of the ancestors, gods, and men, as well as feeding [them],
should not be done without an upper garment, since what is done [without it] would be fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
paridhānakṛte skaṃdhe gṛhastho yo'rcayetpitṝn ..
na sa tatphalamāpnoti yathā yogapaṭāvṛtaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
परिधानकृते स्कंधे गृहस्थो योऽर्चयेत्पितॄन् ..
न स तत्फलमाप्नोति यथा योगपटावृतः .. 24 ..
text_mt:
A householder who, with his lower cloth thrown over his shoulder, worships the ancestors,
does not attain that fruit, just as one wrapped in an ascetic's yoga-cloth [does not].

sanskrit_iast:
vanasthānāṃ khagaśreṣṭha yatīnāṃ ca mahāmate ..
siddhaye karmaṇāṃ vīra yogapaṭṭakamucyate .. 25 ..
meaning:
वनस्थानां खगश्रेष्ठ यतीनां च महामते ..
सिद्धये कर्मणां वीर योगपट्टकमुच्यते .. 25 ..
text_mt:
For forest-dwellers, O best of birds, and for ascetics, O broad-minded one,
the yoga-cloth is prescribed for the success of their rites, O hero.

sanskrit_iast:
hastau prakṣālya gaṃḍūṣaṃ yaḥ pibedavicakṣaṇaḥ ..
sa tu daivaṃ ca pitryaṃ ca ātmānaṃ copaghā tayet .. 26 ..
meaning:
हस्तौ प्रक्षाल्य गंडूषं यः पिबेदविचक्षणः ..
स तु दैवं च पित्र्यं च आत्मानं चोपघा तयेत् .. 26 ..
text_mt:
The unwise man who, having washed his hands, drinks a mouthful of water [for rinsing],
destroys the rite for the gods, that for the ancestors, and himself.

sanskrit_iast:
bhojaneṣveva tiṣṭhaṃti svasti kurvaṃti ye dvijāḥ ..
āsuraṃ tadbhavecchrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ nopatiṣṭhate .. 27 ..
meaning:
भोजनेष्वेव तिष्ठंति स्वस्ति कुर्वंति ये द्विजाः ..
आसुरं तद्भवेच्छ्राद्धं पितॄणां नोपतिष्ठते .. 27 ..
text_mt:
If twice-born men utter 'svasti' while still eating,
that śrāddha becomes demonic and does not reach the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
dātāro nobhivardhaṃtā vedāḥ saṃta tireva ca..
śraddhā ca no mā vyagamadbahudeyaṃ ca no'stviti ..28.. ..
śuddhiprakaraṇavarṇanam
meaning:
दातारो नोभिवर्धंता वेदाः संत तिरेव च..
श्रद्धा च नो मा व्यगमद्बहुदेयं च नोऽस्त्विति ..28.. ..
शुद्धिप्रकरणवर्णनम्
text_mt:
[They should say:] 'May our donors prosper, and our Vedas, and our progeny!
May faith not depart from us, and may we have much to give!'
Description of the section on purification

sanskrit_iast:
bhāskara uvāca .. ..
śrāvaṇyāṃ tu baliḥ kāryaḥ sarpāṇāṃ maṃtrapūrvakaḥ ..
śayanārohaṇe caiva kārye sukhamabhīpsatā .. 1 ..
meaning:
भास्कर उवाच .. ..
श्रावण्यां तु बलिः कार्यः सर्पाणां मंत्रपूर्वकः ..
शयनारोहणे चैव कार्ये सुखमभीप्सता .. 1 ..
title: Śuddhiprakaraṇavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
kāryaḥ pratyavarohastu mārgaśīrṣyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ ..
phalaṃ vinā tvanuṣṭhānaṃ nityānāmiṣyate sphuṭam .. 2 ..
meaning:
कार्यः प्रत्यवरोहस्तु मार्गशीर्ष्यां न संशयः ..
फलं विना त्वनुष्ठानं नित्यानामिष्यते स्फुटम् .. 2 ..
text_mt:
The descent [from the high bed] must without doubt be performed on the full-moon day of Mārgaśīrṣa;
the performance of regular duties is clearly accepted as being without a [specific] reward.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmyānāṃ saphalārthaṃ tu doṣaprāptyarthameva ca ..
naimittikānāṃ karaṇaṃ trividhaṃ karmaṇāṃ phalam .. 3 ..
meaning:
काम्यानां सफलार्थं तु दोषप्राप्त्यर्थमेव च ..
नैमित्तिकानां करणं त्रिविधं कर्मणां फलम् .. 3 ..
text_mt:
The performance of optional rites is for a reward, and that of occasional rites is to avoid demerit;
thus threefold is the fruit of actions.

sanskrit_iast:
phalaṃ kecidupāttasya duritasya pracakṣate ..
anutpattiṃ tathā cānye pratyetyābhyupamaṃtrya ca .. 4 ..
meaning:
फलं केचिदुपात्तस्य दुरितस्य प्रचक्षते ..
अनुत्पत्तिं तथा चान्ये प्रत्येत्याभ्युपमंत्र्य च .. 4 ..
text_mt:
Some describe the fruit as the [removal] of accumulated sin,
and others, having understood and declared it, as its non-arising.

sanskrit_iast:
nityakriyaṃ tathā cānye anuṣaṃgātphalaṃ śrutiḥ ..
agnyādheyaṃ tathā darśaṃ paurṇamāsaṃ dvitīyakam..5..
meaning:
नित्यक्रियं तथा चान्ये अनुषंगात्फलं श्रुतिः ..
अग्न्याधेयं तथा दर्शं पौर्णमासं द्वितीयकम्..5..
text_mt:
Others say the regular rite produces a result as a secondary consequence; sacred tradition says:
establishing the sacrificial fires, the new-moon sacrifice, and the full-moon sacrifice as the second;

sanskrit_iast:
cāturmāsyamagnihotraṃ paśubaṃdho nirūḍhakāḥ ..
sautrāmaṇī saṃsthāḥ syurhaviṣaḥ śrutinoditāḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
चातुर्मास्यमग्निहोत्रं पशुबंधो निरूढकाः ..
सौत्रामणी संस्थाः स्युर्हविषः श्रुतिनोदिताः .. 6 ..
text_mt:
the Cāturmāsya, the Agnihotra, the animal sacrifice, the Nirūḍhapaśubandha,
and the Sautrāmaṇī—these are the forms of oblations prescribed by the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
agniṣṭomo'tyagniṣṭoma ukthyaḥ saṃṣoḍaśī tathā ..
vājapeyātirātraśca āpyoryāmaḥ śrutau śrutaḥ ..7..
meaning:
अग्निष्टोमोऽत्यग्निष्टोम उक्थ्यः संषोडशी तथा ..
वाजपेयातिरात्रश्च आप्योर्यामः श्रुतौ श्रुतः ..7..
text_mt:
The Agniṣṭoma, Atyagniṣṭoma, Ukthya, Ṣoḍaśin,
Vājapeya, Atirātra, and Āptoryāma are recorded in the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
dayā syātsarvabhūteṣu anasūyātha maṃgalam ..
kṣāṃtirdayā tvanāyāsaḥ śaucamaspṛhatā vratam .. 8 ..
meaning:
दया स्यात्सर्वभूतेषु अनसूयाथ मंगलम् ..
क्षांतिर्दया त्वनायासः शौचमस्पृहता व्रतम् .. 8 ..
text_mt:
There should be compassion toward all beings, absence of envy, auspiciousness,
forbearance, kindness, lack of strain, purity, absence of greed, and vows.

sanskrit_iast:
samyaguktāstu saṃskārā brahmaprāptinimittakāḥ ..
anaṃtaraṃ pravakṣyāmi viprāṇāṃ vṛttayaḥ śubhāḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
सम्यगुक्तास्तु संस्कारा ब्रह्मप्राप्तिनिमित्तकाः ..
अनंतरं प्रवक्ष्यामि विप्राणां वृत्तयः शुभाः .. 9 ..
text_mt:
These purificatory rites aimed at attaining Brahman have been duly spoken of;
next I shall declare the auspicious livelihoods of brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtāmṛte ca viprāṇāmṛtaṃ pramṛtameva ca ..
pratigrahavaṇijyādi śreyasī nottarottarā .. 1.186.10 ..
meaning:
ऋतामृते च विप्राणामृतं प्रमृतमेव च ..
प्रतिग्रहवणिज्यादि श्रेयसी नोत्तरोत्तरा .. 1.186.10 ..
text_mt:
For brāhmaṇas there are Ṛta and Amṛta, as well as Mṛta and Pramṛta;
acceptance of gifts, trade, and the like—each later one is not superior [to the former].

sanskrit_iast:
ājīvikāvṛttayastu ityādyāḥ saṃpravartitāḥ ..
tāsāṃ kayāpi jīvettu anutiṣṭhedyathāvidhi .. 11 ..
meaning:
आजीविकावृत्तयस्तु इत्याद्याः संप्रवर्तिताः ..
तासां कयापि जीवेत्तु अनुतिष्ठेद्यथाविधि .. 11 ..
text_mt:
Such occupations have been set forth for livelihood;
living by any one of them, one should perform [rites] according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ śuciḥ sugaṃdhaśca snānaśīlaḥ priyaṃvadaḥ ..
pūjyaśca pūjayeddevānkāryāṇi svayamācaret .. 12 ..
meaning:
नित्यं शुचिः सुगंधश्च स्नानशीलः प्रियंवदः ..
पूज्यश्च पूजयेद्देवान्कार्याणि स्वयमाचरेत् .. 12 ..
text_mt:
Constantly clean, fragrant, accustomed to bathing, speaking kindly,
and worthy of honour, one should worship the gods and conduct affairs oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
nekṣetārkaṃ na nagnāṃ strīṃ na ca saṃspṛṣṭa maithunam ..
nāpsu mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā nāśucī rātritārakāḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
नेक्षेतार्कं न नग्नां स्त्रीं न च संस्पृष्ट मैथुनम् ..
नाप्सु मूत्रं पुरीषं वा नाशुची रात्रितारकाः .. 13 ..
text_mt:
One should not look at the [rising/setting] sun, nor at a naked woman, nor at copulation taking place,
nor pass urine or faeces in water, nor gaze while impure at the stars of the night.

sanskrit_iast:
śāstroktā yaṃtraṇā yā tu nānuktāni vratāni ca ..
svargārthaṃ sādhayettaiśca śaktimānmanasā tathā ..14..
meaning:
शास्त्रोक्ता यंत्रणा या तु नानुक्तानि व्रतानि च ..
स्वर्गार्थं साधयेत्तैश्च शक्तिमान्मनसा तथा ..14..
text_mt:
With whatever restraint is taught in scripture, and with vows not prohibited,
one who is capable should achieve heaven through them, and likewise in mind.

sanskrit_iast:
nityāni kecidicchaṃti kāmyāni ca tathāpare ..
kāmyāpravṛttau saṃge ca prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate ..15..
meaning:
नित्यानि केचिदिच्छंति काम्यानि च तथापरे ..
काम्याप्रवृत्तौ संगे च प्रायश्चित्तं विधीयते ..15..
text_mt:
Some desire regular rites, and others desire optional rites;
if an optional rite is not begun, or if there is attachment [to the fruit], an expiation is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
vratāni manasā tviṣṭasaṃkalpa iti mānasaḥ ..
aṃtarānuphalaṃ yattadṛṣivādāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ..16..
meaning:
व्रतानि मनसा त्विष्टसंकल्प इति मानसः ..
अंतरानुफलं यत्तदृषिवादाः प्रकीर्तिताः ..16..
text_mt:
Vows are mental when their desired resolve is made in the mind;
that which brings an intermediate fruit is proclaimed in the sayings of the ṛṣis.

sanskrit_iast:
anadhyāyaṃ svayaṃ samyagvarjayetphalasādhanam ..
ātmā śuddhastathā deśo hyasuhāraḥ prajāpadaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
अनध्यायं स्वयं सम्यग्वर्जयेत्फलसाधनम् ..
आत्मा शुद्धस्तथा देशो ह्यसुहारः प्रजापदः .. 17 ..
text_mt:
One should oneself properly avoid a time unsuitable for Vedic study, which accomplishes the result.
The self should be pure, and likewise the place; life-taking brings calamity to progeny.

sanskrit_iast:
aśubhāni nimittāni utpāto vikṛtaṃ tathā ..
parvāṇi manaso'śuddhiranadhyāya iti smṛtaḥ ..18..
meaning:
अशुभानि निमित्तानि उत्पातो विकृतं तथा ..
पर्वाणि मनसोऽशुद्धिरनध्याय इति स्मृतः ..18..
text_mt:
Inauspicious omens, portents, unnatural events,
the transitional days of the lunar month, and impurity of mind are considered times unsuitable for study.

sanskrit_iast:
anadhyāyāśca dṛṣṭārthā adṛṣṭārthāstathāpare ..
vedādhyayanameveti tridhā maddhyānadarśanam ..19..
meaning:
अनध्यायाश्च दृष्टार्था अदृष्टार्थास्तथापरे ..
वेदाध्ययनमेवेति त्रिधा मद्ध्यानदर्शनम् ..19..
text_mt:
Some times unsuitable for study have visible purposes, while others have invisible purposes.
In this way, study of the Veda is viewed as threefold by my doctrine.

sanskrit_iast:
abhakṣyaṃ sarvavarṇānāṃ śāvāśaucaṃ khagādhipa ..
dravyaśuddhistathaiva syādanyathā tvasamaṃjasam ..1.186.20..
meaning:
अभक्ष्यं सर्ववर्णानां शावाशौचं खगाधिप ..
द्रव्यशुद्धिस्तथैव स्यादन्यथा त्वसमंजसम् ..1.186.20..
text_mt:
Inedible food is forbidden to all social classes, as is impurity from death, O king of birds;
purification of articles must be observed likewise, for otherwise there is impropriety.

sanskrit_iast:
jātiduṣṭaṃ kriyāduṣṭaṃ kāladuṣṭaṃ vibhūṣitam..
saṃsargāśrayaduṣṭaṃ ca sahṛllekhaṃ svabhāvataḥ ..21..
meaning:
जातिदुष्टं क्रियादुष्टं कालदुष्टं विभूषितम्..
संसर्गाश्रयदुष्टं च सहृल्लेखं स्वभावतः ..21..
text_mt:
Food ruined by its species, ruined by preparation, ruined by time, though garnished,
ruined by contact, ruined by its container, and causing nausea by its very nature;

sanskrit_iast:
laśunaṃ gṛṃjanaṃ caiva palāṃḍuṃ kavakāni ca ..
vārtākaṃ nālikeraṃ tu mūlakaṃ jātiduṣṭakam..22..
meaning:
लशुनं गृंजनं चैव पलांडुं कवकानि च ..
वार्ताकं नालिकेरं तु मूलकं जातिदुष्टकम्..22..
text_mt:
Garlic, carrots, onions, and mushrooms,
eggplant, coconut, and radish are ruined by their species.

sanskrit_iast:
no bhuñjīta kriyāduṣṭaṃ duṣṭaṃ ca patitaiḥ pṛthak..
kāladuṣṭaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ hānidaṃ cirasaṃsthitam ..23..
meaning:
नो भुञ्जीत क्रियादुष्टं दुष्टं च पतितैः पृथक्..
कालदुष्टं तु विज्ञेयं हानिदं चिरसंस्थितम् ..23..
text_mt:
One should not eat what is ruined by preparation, nor what has been separately spoiled by outcasts;
and food ruined by time should be known as harmful if it has stood for a long period.

sanskrit_iast: dadhibhakṣyavikārāśca madhuvarjyāstadiṣyate ..24..
meaning: दधिभक्ष्यविकाराश्च मधुवर्ज्यास्तदिष्यते ..24..
text_mt: Preparations made from curd and flour, excluding honey, are approved in such a case.

sanskrit_iast:
surālaśunasaṃspṛṣṭaṃ peyūṣādisamanvitam ..
saṃsargaduṣṭametaddhi śunocchiṣṭaṃ khageśvara..25..
meaning:
सुरालशुनसंस्पृष्टं पेयूषादिसमन्वितम् ..
संसर्गदुष्टमेतद्धि शुनोच्छिष्टं खगेश्वर..25..
text_mt:
Food touched by liquor or garlic, or mixed with biestings and the like,
is ruined by contact, as is food left over by a dog, O lord of birds.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrasaktaṃ khaṃḍasaktaṃ jñeyamāśrayadūṣitam..
vicikitsā tu hṛdaye bhakṣye yasmintsujāyate..26..
meaning:
शूद्रसक्तं खंडसक्तं ज्ञेयमाश्रयदूषितम्..
विचिकित्सा तु हृदये भक्ष्ये यस्मिन्त्सुजायते..26..
text_mt:
Food adhering to a Śūdra or to a fragment is known as spoiled by its container.
When doubt arises in the heart regarding an edible item,

sanskrit_iast:
sahṛllekhaṃ tu tajjñeyaṃ purīṣaṃ tu svabhāvataḥ ..
rasaduṣṭe vikāro'pi rasasyeti pradarśitaḥ..27..
meaning:
सहृल्लेखं तु तज्ज्ञेयं पुरीषं तु स्वभावतः ..
रसदुष्टे विकारोऽपि रसस्येति प्रदर्शितः..27..
text_mt:
that is to be known as causing nausea, while feces is impure by its very nature.
When the flavor is spoiled, the modification of the taste is likewise shown.

sanskrit_iast:
pāyasaṃ kṣīrapākādi tasminneva dine tathā..
yathāśāstraṃ khagaśreṣṭha bhakṣyābhakṣye nirūpayet..28..
meaning:
पायसं क्षीरपाकादि तस्मिन्नेव दिने तथा..
यथाशास्त्रं खगश्रेष्ठ भक्ष्याभक्ष्ये निरूपयेत्..28..
text_mt:
Rice cooked in milk, milk-dishes, and the like must be consumed on that very day.
According to the treatise, O best of birds, one should determine what is edible and inedible.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇātyaye prokṣitaṃ ca śrāddhe ca dvijakāmyayā ..
pitṝndevāṃścārpayitvā bhuṃjanmāṃsaṃ na doṣabhāk..29..
meaning:
प्राणात्यये प्रोक्षितं च श्राद्धे च द्विजकाम्यया ..
पितॄन्देवांश्चार्पयित्वा भुंजन्मांसं न दोषभाक्..29..
text_mt:
When life is in danger, when it is consecrated with water, or in an ancestral rite at the wish of a twice-born,
one incurs no sin by eating meat after having offered it to the ancestors and the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
pretāśuddhiḥ sapiṃḍānāṃ tasminneva mṛte sati..
daśāhaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ vā pakṣaṃ māsaṃ tvaśuddhatā .. 1.186.30 ..
meaning:
प्रेताशुद्धिः सपिंडानां तस्मिन्नेव मृते सति..
दशाहं द्वादशाहं वा पक्षं मासं त्वशुद्धता .. 1.186.30 ..
text_mt:
Impurity due to a deceased person applies to sapinda-kinsmen upon their death;
the impurity lasts for ten days, twelve days, a fortnight, or a month.

sanskrit_iast:
daśāhāditrike bhāge varṇaśo na bhavaṃti hi ..
daśāhena tu bhojyāḥ syuḥ sūtakāśaucayostathā .. 31..
meaning:
दशाहादित्रिके भागे वर्णशो न भवंति हि ..
दशाहेन तु भोज्याः स्युः सूतकाशौचयोस्तथा .. 31..
text_mt:
In the triad of periods beginning with ten days, it does not apply strictly by class;
for ten days they may eat food together during impurity caused by birth or death.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvaṃ daśāhādekāhaśravaṇe sati jāyate ..
saṃvatsare vyatīte tu snānādeva viśudhyati .. 32 ..
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वं दशाहादेकाहश्रवणे सति जायते ..
संवत्सरे व्यतीते तु स्नानादेव विशुध्यति .. 32 ..
text_mt:
After ten days have passed, an impurity of one day occurs upon hearing of it;
when a full year has elapsed, however, one becomes pure merely by bathing.

sanskrit_iast:
samānodakatā proktā janmanāmnoraparyaye ..
sapiṃḍāḥ saptapuruṣāḥ śrutāvetannidarśanam .. 33 ..
meaning:
समानोदकता प्रोक्ता जन्मनाम्नोरपर्यये ..
सपिंडाः सप्तपुरुषाः श्रुतावेतन्निदर्शनम् .. 33 ..
text_mt:
The relationship of samānodaka is declared as long as birth and name are remembered;
sapiṇḍas extend to seven generations, as is exemplified in Vedic tradition.

sanskrit_iast:
ā daṃtajanmanaḥ sadya ācūḍānnaiṣṭhikī smṛtā ..
trirātramāvratādeśātsapiṃḍeṣu mṛteṣu ca .. 34 ..
meaning:
आ दंतजन्मनः सद्य आचूडान्नैष्ठिकी स्मृता ..
त्रिरात्रमाव्रतादेशात्सपिंडेषु मृतेषु च .. 34 ..
text_mt:
Until the eruption of teeth, purity is immediate; until tonsure, it is observed as fixed;
for three nights after tonsure until investiture, when sapiṇḍas die.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāmapi tadekaṃ syādvayovasthāpyapekṣyate ..
samānodakāttrirātreṇa śudhyedvai mṛtyujanmanoḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
तेषामपि तदेकं स्याद्वयोवस्थाप्यपेक्ष्यते ..
समानोदकात्त्रिरात्रेण शुध्येद्वै मृत्युजन्मनोः .. 35 ..
text_mt:
For them too, it may be for one day, and the stage of age is also taken into account.
Through a samānodaka, one is purified in three nights in matters of death and birth.

sanskrit_iast:
garbhasrāve trirātreṇa udakyā śudhyate tathā ..
anaṃtajanma maraṇe taccheṣeṇa viśudhyati .. 36 ..
meaning:
गर्भस्रावे त्रिरात्रेण उदक्या शुध्यते तथा ..
अनंतजन्म मरणे तच्छेषेण विशुध्यति .. 36 ..
text_mt:
In case of miscarriage, a menstruating woman is purified in three nights;
upon death following another birth, she is purified by the remainder of that period.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijānāṃ tvevameva syātpitrarthaṃ mātureva vā ..
agnihotrārthaṃ vijñeyaṃ sadyaḥ śaucamiti sthitiḥ ..37..
meaning:
द्विजानां त्वेवमेव स्यात्पित्रर्थं मातुरेव वा ..
अग्निहोत्रार्थं विज्ञेयं सद्यः शौचमिति स्थितिः ..37..
text_mt:
For twice-born men it is just so, on account of the father or indeed the mother;
for the purpose of the Agnihotra fire, immediate purity is known to be the rule.

sanskrit_iast:
asapiṃḍe tu nirhārāttrirātramapi mānavaḥ ..
tasyaivānugatau jñeyaṃ sadyaḥ śaucaṃ khagādhipa .. 38 ..
meaning:
असपिंडे तु निर्हारात्त्रिरात्रमपि मानवः ..
तस्यैवानुगतौ ज्ञेयं सद्यः शौचं खगाधिप .. 38 ..
text_mt:
In the case of a non-sapiṇḍa, a person becomes impure for three nights from carrying the corpse;
if merely following it, immediate purity is known, O lord of birds.

sanskrit_iast:
śudhyeddvijo daśāhena janmahānau dviyoniṣu ..
ṣaṅbhistribhirahai kena kṣatraviṭśūdrayoniṣu .. 39 ..
meaning:
शुध्येद्द्विजो दशाहेन जन्महानौ द्वियोनिषु ..
षङ्भिस्त्रिभिरहै केन क्षत्रविट्शूद्रयोनिषु .. 39 ..
text_mt:
A twice-born man is purified in ten days upon birth or death in families of twice-born origin;
in six, three, or one day among descendants of Kṣatriyas, Vaiśyas, and Śūdras.

sanskrit_iast:
uktaśaucaṃ yathānyāyaṃ śārīraṃ tattvadarśibhiḥ ..
dravyaśuddhividhānaṃ tu yathāvadabhidhīyate .. 1.186.40 ..
meaning:
उक्तशौचं यथान्यायं शारीरं तत्त्वदर्शिभिः ..
द्रव्यशुद्धिविधानं तु यथावदभिधीयते .. 1.186.40 ..
text_mt:
Bodily purity has been properly declared by the seers of truth;
now the procedure for the purification of articles is stated as it truly is.

sanskrit_iast:
taijasī mārtikī vīra vāriśuddhiḥ smṛtā tathā ..
nirlepakṣālanenaiva sparśe tu prokṣaṇena vai .. 41 ..
meaning:
तैजसी मार्तिकी वीर वारिशुद्धिः स्मृता तथा ..
निर्लेपक्षालनेनैव स्पर्शे तु प्रोक्षणेन वै .. 41 ..
text_mt:
Purification by fire, by earth, and likewise by water is remembered, O hero:
by wiping off stains and washing, or merely by sprinkling with water upon contact.

sanskrit_iast:
aśuddhaṃ naiva kiṃciddhi dravyamastīti khecara ..
vacanācchuddhyaśuddhī tu dravyāṇāmiha khecara .. 42 ..
meaning:
अशुद्धं नैव किंचिद्धि द्रव्यमस्तीति खेचर ..
वचनाच्छुद्ध्यशुद्धी तु द्रव्याणामिह खेचर .. 42 ..
text_mt:
Indeed, no substance is inherently impure, O sky-wanderer;
purity and impurity of objects in this world exist entirely through scriptural injunction, O sky-wanderer.

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ śaucaṃ ca kartavyaṃ dravyaśaucādanaṃtaram ..
prātaḥsnānaṃ tu nityaṃ syādgrahaṇe kāmyameva ca .. 43 ..
meaning:
स्नानं शौचं च कर्तव्यं द्रव्यशौचादनंतरम् ..
प्रातःस्नानं तु नित्यं स्याद्ग्रहणे काम्यमेव च .. 43 ..
text_mt:
Bathing and purification should be performed immediately after the purification of articles;
the morning bath is obligatory, while that during an eclipse is optional.

sanskrit_iast:
naimittikaṃ kṣurāśaucaṃ tena pāpādviśudhyati ..
uktaṃ tu śaucaṃ vijñeyaṃ doṣakṣayakaraṃ khaga .. 44 ..
meaning:
नैमित्तिकं क्षुराशौचं तेन पापाद्विशुध्यति ..
उक्तं तु शौचं विज्ञेयं दोषक्षयकरं खग .. 44 ..
text_mt:
Occasional is the impurity from shaving, through which one is cleansed of sin;
the declared purification, O bird, should be understood as destroying flaws.

sanskrit_iast:
karmāṃgaṃ ceti vijñeyaṃ ṣaṭprakārā samāsataḥ ..
evamācamanaṃ vidyādviśiṣṭaṃ tu dvijanmanām ..45..
meaning:
कर्मांगं चेति विज्ञेयं षट्प्रकारा समासतः ..
एवमाचमनं विद्याद्विशिष्टं तु द्विजन्मनाम् ..45..
text_mt:
It should be understood as an auxiliary of rites, sixfold in brief;
thus one should know sipping water as especially prescribed for twice-born men.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā mṛtānāṃ tadvatsyādanyeṣāṃ tu yathāsukham ..
kanyānivṛttiṃ putraistu yathānyāyaṃ samācaret.. 46 ..
meaning:
तदा मृतानां तद्वत्स्यादन्येषां तु यथासुखम् ..
कन्यानिवृत्तिं पुत्रैस्तु यथान्यायं समाचरेत्.. 46 ..
text_mt:
Then it applies likewise to those who have died; for others, however, it is according to convenience.
The marriage of daughters should be properly performed by the sons.

sanskrit_iast: kalāśilpānisarvāṇi gṛhrīyātparituṣṭaye .. 47 ..
meaning: कलाशिल्पानिसर्वाणि गृह्रीयात्परितुष्टये .. 47 ..
text_mt: One should acquire all arts and crafts for personal satisfaction.

sanskrit_iast:
śuśrūṣeta patiṃ bhāryā paritoṣaṃ yathā vrajet ..
gurūṇāṃ paritoṣaśca dharmaḥ strīṇāṃ sanātanaḥ..48..
meaning:
शुश्रूषेत पतिं भार्या परितोषं यथा व्रजेत् ..
गुरूणां परितोषश्च धर्मः स्त्रीणां सनातनः..48..
text_mt:
A wife should serve her husband so that he attains contentment;
and pleasing the elders is the eternal duty of women.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛddhā'putrā yadi mṛtā tadabhāve nṛpasya tu ..
mṛtāpatyāpyagarbhā ca vṛddhāpatyā pativratā .. 49 ..
meaning:
वृद्धाऽपुत्रा यदि मृता तदभावे नृपस्य तु ..
मृतापत्याप्यगर्भा च वृद्धापत्या पतिव्रता .. 49 ..
text_mt:
If an old woman dies without sons, then in the absence of [heirs], her property goes to the king;
whether her children have died, or she is barren, or her children are grown, a faithful wife

sanskrit_iast:
kuryādanirvṛtaṃ bharturgate sannihitepi vā ..
etāṃ dharma samāṃ niṣṭhāṃ bhartṛlokamavāpnuyāt ..1.186.50..
meaning:
कुर्यादनिर्वृतं भर्तुर्गते सन्निहितेपि वा ..
एतां धर्म समां निष्ठां भर्तृलोकमवाप्नुयात् ..1.186.50..
text_mt:
should perform her husband’s unfinished duty, whether he has departed or is present;
observing this steadfast devotion equal to righteousness, she attains her husband's world.

sanskrit_iast:
strī dharmacāriṇī sādhvī mṛtā dāhyā tathāgnibhiḥ ..
viparītādadāhyā tu punardārakriyā tathā ..51..
meaning:
स्त्री धर्मचारिणी साध्वी मृता दाह्या तथाग्निभिः ..
विपरीताददाह्या तु पुनर्दारक्रिया तथा ..51..
text_mt:
A virtuous wife who lives righteously should, upon death, be cremated with fires;
if she is the opposite, she is not to be cremated, and the rite of taking another wife [may be performed].

sanskrit_iast:
strīṇāṃ niyogo vihito maraṇādbrahmacārakam ..
prāptavyaśca yathādharmo dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalapradaḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
स्त्रीणां नियोगो विहितो मरणाद्ब्रह्मचारकम् ..
प्राप्तव्यश्च यथाधर्मो दृष्टादृष्टफलप्रदः .. 52 ..
text_mt:
For women, appointment is ordained, or celibacy following the husband’s death;
and righteous duty, yielding visible and invisible results, is to be pursued.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāddharmaṃ sadā kuryātkurvatī svargamāpnuyāt .. 53 ..
sauradharme dhenumāhātmyavarṇanam
meaning:
तस्माद्धर्मं सदा कुर्यात्कुर्वती स्वर्गमाप्नुयात् .. 53 ..
सौरधर्मे धेनुमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Therefore, she should always practice virtue; practicing it, she attains heaven.
In the Solar Ordinances: Description of the Greatness of the Cow.

sanskrit_iast:
.. anūruruvāca .. ..
kāni puṇyāni kṛtveha svargaṃ gacchaṃti mānavāḥ ..
manuṣyaloke saṃbhūtāḥ svarloke gāminaḥ param ..1..
meaning:
.. अनूरुरुवाच .. ..
कानि पुण्यानि कृत्वेह स्वर्गं गच्छंति मानवाः ..
