मनुष्यलोके संभूताः स्वर्लोके गामिनः परम् ..1..
text_mt:
Anūru said:
By performing what merits here do men go to heaven?
Born in the world of mortals, how do they proceed to the supreme celestial realm?
title: Dhenumāhātmyavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
karmayajñastapoyajñaḥ svādhyāyo dhyānanirmitaḥ ..
jñānayajñaśca paṃcaite mahāyajñāḥ prakīrtitāḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
कर्मयज्ञस्तपोयज्ञः स्वाध्यायो ध्याननिर्मितः ..
ज्ञानयज्ञश्च पंचैते महायज्ञाः प्रकीर्तिताः .. 2 ..
text_mt:
The sacrifice of action, the sacrifice of penance, private recitation, that made of meditation,
and the sacrifice of knowledge: these five are proclaimed as great sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣāmeva yajñānāmuttamaḥ katamaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
etadyajñaphalānāṃ ca kiṃ phalaṃ kā gatirbhavet ..3..
meaning:
एतेषामेव यज्ञानामुत्तमः कतमः स्मृतः ..
एतद्यज्ञफलानां च किं फलं का गतिर्भवेत् ..3..
text_mt:
Among these very sacrifices, which one is considered the best?
And what is the fruit of the fruits of these sacrifices, and what will be the destination?

sanskrit_iast:
dharmādharmaprabhedāśca kiyantaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
tatsādhanāni katidhā gatayaśca yathā vada ..4..
meaning:
धर्माधर्मप्रभेदाश्च कियन्तः परिकीर्तिताः ..
तत्साधनानि कतिधा गतयश्च यथा वद ..4..
text_mt:
How many divisions of righteousness and unrighteousness are proclaimed?
In how many ways are their means accomplished, and what are the destinations? Tell me.

sanskrit_iast:
khaga nārakiṇāṃ puṃsāmāgatānāṃ punaḥ kṣitau ..
kāni cihnāni jāyante muktaśeṣeṇa karmaṇā .. 5 ..
meaning:
खग नारकिणां पुंसामागतानां पुनः क्षितौ ..
कानि चिह्नानि जायन्ते मुक्तशेषेण कर्मणा .. 5 ..
text_mt:
O bird, for men who were in hell and have returned once more to earth,
what signs appear as a remnant of their discharged karma?

sanskrit_iast:
mahābhavārṇavādghorāddharmādharmābhisaṃkulāt ..
garbhādiduḥkhaphenāḍhyānmucyaṃte dehinaḥ katham .. .. 6 ..
meaning:
महाभवार्णवाद्घोराद्धर्माधर्माभिसंकुलात् ..
गर्भादिदुःखफेनाढ्यान्मुच्यंते देहिनः कथम् .. .. 6 ..
text_mt:
From the dreadful, great ocean of mundane existence, thronged with virtue and vice,
rich with the foam of the suffering of the womb and so forth, how are embodied beings released?

sanskrit_iast:
ityukto bhagavānbhānuḥ sarvapraśnārthamādarāt .. 7 ..
pratyuvāca mahātejāḥ samāsavyāsayogataḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तो भगवान्भानुः सर्वप्रश्नार्थमादरात् .. 7 ..
प्रत्युवाच महातेजाः समासव्यासयोगतः .. 7 ..
text_mt:
Having been thus addressed, the blessed Sun, for the sake of all these questions, with care
replied, possessed of great splendour, by means of summary and expansion.

sanskrit_iast:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
svargāpavargaphaladaṃ narakārṇavatāraṇam ..
dharmaṃ pāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ śṛṇu śūra prabhāṣataḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
.. आदित्य उवाच .. ..
स्वर्गापवर्गफलदं नरकार्णवतारणम् ..
धर्मं पापहरं पुण्यं शृणु शूर प्रभाषतः .. 8 ..
text_mt:
Āditya said:
Listen, O hero, as I speak of righteous duty, which bestows the fruits of heaven and final liberation, / carries [one] across the ocean of hell, removes sin, and is meritorious.

sanskrit_iast:
śraddhāpūrvaḥ sadā dharmaḥ śraddhāmadhyāṃtasaṃsthitaḥ ..
śraddhāniṣṭhapratiṣṭhaśca dharmaḥ śraddhā prakīrtitā .. 9 ..
meaning:
श्रद्धापूर्वः सदा धर्मः श्रद्धामध्यांतसंस्थितः ..
श्रद्धानिष्ठप्रतिष्ठश्च धर्मः श्रद्धा प्रकीर्तिता .. 9 ..
text_mt: Righteous duty always begins with faith, is established with faith in its middle and end, / and has its foundation in the steadfastness of faith; righteous duty is proclaimed to be faith itself.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutimaṃtrarasāḥ sūkṣmāḥ pradhānapuruṣeśvaraḥ ..
śraddhāmātreṇa gṛhyaṃte na pareṇa ca cakṣuṣā .. 1.187.10 ..
meaning:
श्रुतिमंत्ररसाः सूक्ष्माः प्रधानपुरुषेश्वरः ..
श्रद्धामात्रेण गृह्यंते न परेण च चक्षुषा .. 1.187.10 ..
text_mt: The subtle essences of the Vedic mantras, nature, the cosmic person, and the supreme Lord— / these are grasped through faith alone, and not by any other eye.

sanskrit_iast:
kāyakleśairna bahubhirna caivārthasya rāśibhiḥ ..
dharmaḥ saṃprāpyate sūkṣmaḥ śraddhāhīnaiḥ surairapi .. 11 ..
meaning:
कायक्लेशैर्न बहुभिर्न चैवार्थस्य राशिभिः ..
धर्मः संप्राप्यते सूक्ष्मः श्रद्धाहीनैः सुरैरपि .. 11 ..
text_mt: Neither by many bodily afflictions nor by heaps of wealth / is subtle righteous duty attained, even by the gods, if they are devoid of faith.

sanskrit_iast:
śraddhā dharmaḥ paraḥ sūkṣmaḥ śraddhā yajñāhutaṃ tapaḥ..
śraddhā mokṣaśca svargaśca śraddhā sarvamidaṃ jagat .. 12 ..
meaning:
श्रद्धा धर्मः परः सूक्ष्मः श्रद्धा यज्ञाहुतं तपः..
श्रद्धा मोक्षश्च स्वर्गश्च श्रद्धा सर्वमिदं जगत् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Faith is the supreme, subtle righteous duty; faith is the sacrifice, the oblation, and asceticism; / faith is both liberation and heaven; faith is this entire world.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasvaṃ jīvitaṃ vāpi dadyādaśraddhayā ca yaḥ ..
nāpnuyātsa phalaṃ kiṃcittasmācchraddhāparo bhavet ...13 ..
meaning:
सर्वस्वं जीवितं वापि दद्यादश्रद्धया च यः ..
नाप्नुयात्स फलं किंचित्तस्माच्छ्रद्धापरो भवेत् ...13 ..
text_mt: Even if one were to give one’s all, or even one’s very life, without faith, / one would not obtain any fruit; therefore, one should be dedicated to faith.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ śraddhāmayāḥ sarve mama dharmāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ..
pūjyastu śraddhayā puṃsā dhyeyaḥ pūjyaśca śraddhayā .. 14 ..
meaning:
एवं श्रद्धामयाः सर्वे मम धर्माः प्रकीर्तिताः ..
पूज्यस्तु श्रद्धया पुंसा ध्येयः पूज्यश्च श्रद्धया .. 14 ..
text_mt: Thus all my righteous duties are proclaimed to consist of faith. / He should be worshipped with faith by a man; he is to be meditated upon and worshipped with faith.

sanskrit_iast:
adhikārasya prāptyarthaṃ mahāsāravimuktidam ..
ajñāduktaṃ sasaṃdigdhaṃ vākyametanmamādbhutam .. 15 ..
meaning:
अधिकारस्य प्राप्त्यर्थं महासारविमुक्तिदम् ..
अज्ञादुक्तं ससंदिग्धं वाक्यमेतन्ममाद्भुतम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: In order to attain qualification, granting supreme substance and liberation, / this wonderful word of mine was spoken by the unknowing one, full of doubt:

sanskrit_iast:
nānāsiddhikaraṃ divyaṃ lokacittānuraṃjanam ..
suniścitārthagaṃbhīraṃ vākyaṃ mama manoramam .. 16 ..
meaning:
नानासिद्धिकरं दिव्यं लोकचित्तानुरंजनम् ..
सुनिश्चितार्थगंभीरं वाक्यं मम मनोरमम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: Delighting the hearts of the world, divine, yielding various supernatural powers, / profound with well-ascertained meaning, is my delightful word.

sanskrit_iast:
manmānasasamudro hi dvipadoyaṃ vidurbudhāḥ ..
sa khaṣolketi vikhyātaḥ saśivaṃ maṃḍalaṃ khaga .. 17 ..
meaning:
मन्मानससमुद्रो हि द्विपदोयं विदुर्बुधाः ..
स खषोल्केति विख्यातः सशिवं मंडलं खग .. 17 ..
text_mt: For the wise know that this two-footed being is the ocean of my mind; / he is renowned as Khaṣolka, O bird, an orb accompanied by Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
devatrayaguṇātītaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvavitprabhuḥ ..
omityekākṣare maṃtre sthitaḥ sa paramo mama ..18..
meaning:
देवत्रयगुणातीतः सर्वज्ञः सर्ववित्प्रभुः ..
ओमित्येकाक्षरे मंत्रे स्थितः स परमो मम ..18..
text_mt: Transcending the qualities of the triad of deities, all-knowing, all-understanding, the Lord, / abiding in the single-syllable mantra 'Oṃ'—he is my supreme [form].

sanskrit_iast:
yathānādipravṛttoyaṃ ghoraḥ saṃsārasāgaraḥ ..
khaṣolkopi tathānādiḥ saṃsārārṇavaśodhanaḥ ..19..
meaning:
यथानादिप्रवृत्तोयं घोरः संसारसागरः ..
खषोल्कोपि तथानादिः संसारार्णवशोधनः ..19..
text_mt: Just as this terrible ocean of transmigratory existence has proceeded from beginningless time, / so too is Khaṣolka beginningless, the purifier of the ocean of transmigratory existence.

sanskrit_iast:
vyādhīnāṃ bheṣajaṃ yadvatpra tipakṣasvabhāvataḥ ..
mokṣiṇāṃ muktihetuśca siddhaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ .. 1.187.20 ..
meaning:
व्याधीनां भेषजं यद्वत्प्र तिपक्षस्वभावतः ..
मोक्षिणां मुक्तिहेतुश्च सिद्धः सर्वार्थसाधकः .. 1.187.20 ..
text_mt: Just as medicine cures diseases by its counteracting nature, / he is the cause of liberation for seekers of release, accomplished, the fulfiller of all aims.

sanskrit_iast:
mamābhidhānamantroyamabhidheyaḥ sadā smṛtaḥ ..
abhidhānābhidheyohaṃ mantrasiddho'smi khecara .. 21 ..
meaning:
ममाभिधानमन्त्रोयमभिधेयः सदा स्मृतः ..
अभिधानाभिधेयोहं मन्त्रसिद्धोऽस्मि खेचर .. 21 ..
text_mt: This is my name-mantra; he is traditionally remembered as that which is to be designated. / I am both designation and designated; I am accomplished through mantra, O sky-wanderer.

sanskrit_iast:
vedo manogame cātra ṣaḍakṣaramaṃtrasthitaḥ ..
yadvā mukto'kṣaraikena loke pañcākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
वेदो मनोगमे चात्र षडक्षरमंत्रस्थितः ..
यद्वा मुक्तोऽक्षरैकेन लोके पञ्चाक्षरः स्मृतः .. 22 ..
text_mt: And here the Veda, accessible to the mind, resides in the six-syllable mantra; / or, when released of one syllable, it is remembered in the world as having five syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ tasya bahubhirmantraiḥ śāstrairvā bahuvistaraiḥ ..
yasyoṃ namaḥ khaṣolketi mantro'yaṃ hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
किं तस्य बहुभिर्मन्त्रैः शास्त्रैर्वा बहुविस्तरैः ..
यस्यों नमः खषोल्केति मन्त्रोऽयं हृदि संस्थितः .. 23 ..
text_mt: What need has he of many mantras, or of scriptures of vast extent, / in whose heart resides this mantra: 'Oṃ, homage to Khaṣolka'?

sanskrit_iast:
tenādhītaṃ śrutaṃ tena tena sarvamanuṣṭhitam ..
yenoṃ namaḥ khaṣolketi mama vākyaṃ ṣaḍakṣaram .. 24 ..
meaning:
तेनाधीतं श्रुतं तेन तेन सर्वमनुष्ठितम् ..
येनों नमः खषोल्केति मम वाक्यं षडक्षरम् .. 24 ..
text_mt: By him it is studied, by him heard, by him all has been performed, / by whom this six-syllable word of mine [is held]: 'Oṃ, homage to Khaṣolka.'

sanskrit_iast:
vidhivākyamidaṃ sarvaṃ nārthavādaṃ vaco mama ..
etatte vakṣyate'śeṣaṃ mama vākyārthamuttamam ..
pṛcchasvemaṃ praṇamyāśu vainateya mahāmate .. 25 ..
meaning:
विधिवाक्यमिदं सर्वं नार्थवादं वचो मम ..
एतत्ते वक्ष्यतेऽशेषं मम वाक्यार्थमुत्तमम् ..
पृच्छस्वेमं प्रणम्याशु वैनतेय महामते .. 25 ..
text_mt: All this is an injunction-statement; my speech is not [mere] commendatory discourse. / This excellent meaning of my words will be told to you in its entirety. / Bowing down quickly, ask him, O wise Vainateya.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sumanturuvāca .. ..
śrutvā tu vacanaṃ bhānorvainateyo mahābalaḥ ..
saptāśvatilakaṃ bhaktyā praṇamyovāca bhārata .. 26 ..
meaning:
.. सुमन्तुरुवाच .. ..
श्रुत्वा तु वचनं भानोर्वैनतेयो महाबलः ..
सप्ताश्वतिलकं भक्त्या प्रणम्योवाच भारत .. 26 ..
text_mt:
Sumantu said:
Having heard the words of the sun, the mighty Vainateya, / bowing with devotion to Saptāśvatilaka, spoke, O descendant of Bharata.

sanskrit_iast:
.. anūruruvāca .. ..
brūhi māṃ devaśārdūla yatpṛcchāmi mahāmate ..
kīdṛgvākyamidaṃ bhānorvākyārthaṃ brūhi ca prabho .. 27.. ..
meaning:
.. अनूरुरुवाच .. ..
ब्रूहि मां देवशार्दूल यत्पृच्छामि महामते ..
कीदृग्वाक्यमिदं भानोर्वाक्यार्थं ब्रूहि च प्रभो .. 27.. ..
text_mt:
Anūru said:
Speak to me, O tiger among gods, what I ask, O high-minded one; / tell me, O Lord, what kind of word this of the sun is, and the meaning of his words.

sanskrit_iast:
.. saptāśvatilaka uvāca .. ..
vimuktāśeṣadoṣeṇa sarvajñena bhagena yat ..
praṇītamamalaṃ vākyaṃ tatpramāṇaṃ na saṃśayaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
.. सप्ताश्वतिलक उवाच .. ..
विमुक्ताशेषदोषेण सर्वज्ञेन भगेन यत् ..
प्रणीतममलं वाक्यं तत्प्रमाणं न संशयः .. 28 ..
text_mt:
Saptāśvatilaka said:
That flawless word which has been composed by the all-knowing Bhaga, / free from all defects, is authoritative without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmānmārtaṃḍa nāmāsau kathyate ca manīṣibhiḥ ..
yathārthaṃ puṇyamāpnoti patatyaśraddhayā tvadhaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
यस्मान्मार्तंड नामासौ कथ्यते च मनीषिभिः ..
यथार्थं पुण्यमाप्नोति पतत्यश्रद्धया त्वधः .. 29 ..
text_mt: Because he is called Mārtaṇḍa by the wise, / one obtains merit according to reality, but through lack of faith one falls down.

sanskrit_iast:
sauravākyapravaktāraṃ sūravatpūjayedgurum ..
saṃsārārṇava nirmagnaṃ yaḥ samuddharate janam .. 1.187.30 ..
meaning:
सौरवाक्यप्रवक्तारं सूरवत्पूजयेद्गुरुम् ..
संसारार्णव निर्मग्नं यः समुद्धरते जनम् .. 1.187.30 ..
text_mt: One should worship the guru who proclaims the Saura teaching as if he were the sun, / who rescues a person submerged in the ocean of transmigratory existence.

sanskrit_iast:
sauradharmāmbuhastena kastena sadṛśo guruḥ ..
ajñānavahnisaṃtaptaṃ nirvāpayati yaḥ śanaiḥ ..
jñānāmṛtena vai bhaktā kastaṃ na pratipūjayet .. 31 ..
meaning:
सौरधर्माम्बुहस्तेन कस्तेन सदृशो गुरुः ..
अज्ञानवह्निसंतप्तं निर्वापयति यः शनैः ..
ज्ञानामृतेन वै भक्ता कस्तं न प्रतिपूजयेत् .. 31 ..
text_mt: With the hand that holds the water of Saura duty, what guru is equal to him / who gradually extinguishes one scorched by the fire of ignorance? / Who would not worship him devotedly with the nectar of knowledge?

sanskrit_iast:
naiva rājyena mahatā na caivārthasya rāśibhiḥ ..
prāptamajñānaśamanaṃ paraloke sukhāvaham .. 32 ..
meaning:
नैव राज्येन महता न चैवार्थस्य राशिभिः ..
प्राप्तमज्ञानशमनं परलोके सुखावहम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: Neither by great kingship nor by heaps of wealth / is the quelling of ignorance attained, bringing happiness in the other world.

sanskrit_iast:
svargāpavarga siddhyarthaṃ bhāṣitaṃ yattu śobhanam ..
vākyaṃ te devadevena tadvijñeyaṃ subhāṣitam .. 33 ..
meaning:
स्वर्गापवर्ग सिद्ध्यर्थं भाषितं यत्तु शोभनम् ..
वाक्यं ते देवदेवेन तद्विज्ञेयं सुभाषितम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: That splendid word which was spoken to you by the god of gods / for the attainment of heaven and final liberation should be known as well-spoken.

sanskrit_iast:
rāgadveṣākṣamākrodhakāmatṛṣṇānusāriṇām ..
vākyaṃ niraya hetutvāttaddurbhāṣitamucyate .. 34 ..
meaning:
रागद्वेषाक्षमाक्रोधकामतृष्णानुसारिणाम् ..
वाक्यं निरय हेतुत्वात्तद्दुर्भाषितमुच्यते .. 34 ..
text_mt: Because it is the cause of hell, the speech of those who follow / passion, hatred, intolerance, anger, lust, and thirst is called ill-spoken.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃskṛtenāpi kiṃ tena mṛdulālāpasaṃginā ..
avidyārāmavākyena saṃsārakleśahetunā .. 35 ..
meaning:
संस्कृतेनापि किं तेन मृदुलालापसंगिना ..
अविद्यारामवाक्येन संसारक्लेशहेतुना .. 35 ..
text_mt: What is the use of that speech, though refined, attached to soft prattle, / which is the playground of ignorance and the cause of the afflictions of worldly existence?

sanskrit_iast:
yacchrutvā jāyate puṇyaṃ rāgādīnāṃ ca saṃkṣayaḥ ..
virūpamapi tadvākyaṃ vijñeyamatiśobhanam .. 36 ..
meaning:
यच्छ्रुत्वा जायते पुण्यं रागादीनां च संक्षयः ..
विरूपमपि तद्वाक्यं विज्ञेयमतिशोभनम् .. 36 ..
text_mt: That word, hearing which merit is born and passion and the rest are destroyed, / even if unpleasing, should be known as exceedingly splendid.

sanskrit_iast:
smṛtayo bhārataṃ vedāḥ śāstrāṇi sumahāṃti ca ..
svāyuṣaḥ kṣapaṇāyaiva dhamo'rthasamagranthitaḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
स्मृतयो भारतं वेदाः शास्त्राणि सुमहांति च ..
स्वायुषः क्षपणायैव धमोऽर्थसमग्रन्थितः .. 37 ..
text_mt: The traditional codes of law, the Mahābhārata, the Vedas, and very great treatises— / composed of righteousness and wealth—are merely for the wearing away of one’s lifespan.

sanskrit_iast:
putradārādisaṃsāre narāṇāṃ mūḍhacetasām ..
saṃsāraviduṣāṃ śāstramanādi mukhanirgatam .. 38..
meaning:
पुत्रदारादिसंसारे नराणां मूढचेतसाम् ..
संसारविदुषां शास्त्रमनादि मुखनिर्गतम् .. 38..
text_mt: In worldly existence consisting of sons, wives, and the rest, for men of deluded minds, / the treatise emerged from the beginningless mouth of those who know worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ śreṣṭhamidaṃ jñeyaṃ sarvaṃ tvaṃ jñātumicchasi ..
api varṣasahasrāyuḥ śāstrāntaṃ nādhigacchati .. 39 ..
meaning:
इदं श्रेष्ठमिदं ज्ञेयं सर्वं त्वं ज्ञातुमिच्छसि ..
अपि वर्षसहस्रायुः शास्त्रान्तं नाधिगच्छति .. 39 ..
text_mt: 'This is the best, this is to be known'—you wish to know everything; / even with a lifespan of a thousand years, one does not reach the end of the scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
vijñāyākṣaratanmātraṃ jīvitaṃ cātivaṃcanam ..
vihāya sarvaśāstrāṇi paralokaṃ samācaret .. 1.187.40 ..
meaning:
विज्ञायाक्षरतन्मात्रं जीवितं चातिवंचनम् ..
विहाय सर्वशास्त्राणि परलोकं समाचरेत् .. 1.187.40 ..
text_mt: Having understood that the syllable alone [is real] and that life is utter deception, / one should abandon all scriptures and attend to the other world.

sanskrit_iast:
paṇḍitenāpi kiṃ tena samarthena ca dehinām ..
yaḥ puṇyabhāramudvoḍhumaśaktaḥ pāralaukikam .. 41 ..
meaning:
पण्डितेनापि किं तेन समर्थेन च देहिनाम् ..
यः पुण्यभारमुद्वोढुमशक्तः पारलौकिकम् .. 41 ..
text_mt: What is the use of that scholar, or of that capable person among embodied beings, / who is unable to bear the burden of merit pertaining to the next world?

sanskrit_iast:
paṇḍito'pi sa mūrkhaḥ syācchaktiyukto'pyaśaktikaḥ ..
yaḥ saurajñānamāhātmyamuccārayitumakṣamaḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
पण्डितोऽपि स मूर्खः स्याच्छक्तियुक्तोऽप्यशक्तिकः ..
यः सौरज्ञानमाहात्म्यमुच्चारयितुमक्षमः .. 42 ..
text_mt: Even if learned, he would be a fool; even if endowed with power, he is powerless, / who is unable to recite the majesty of Saura knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsa paṃḍitaḥ śaktaḥ sa tapasvī jitendriyaḥ ..
yaḥ saurajñānasadbhāvamālocayitumudyataḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्स पंडितः शक्तः स तपस्वी जितेन्द्रियः ..
यः सौरज्ञानसद्भावमालोचयितुमुद्यतः .. 43 ..
text_mt: Therefore, he is learned, he is capable, he is an ascetic who has subdued his senses, / who is intent upon reflecting on the reality of Saura knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ pradadyānnṛpaḥ kṛtsnāṃ kṣmāṃ dhanaṃ kāṃcanaṃ tathā ..
sarvamanyāyataḥ pṛchenna tasyopadiśedguruḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
यः प्रदद्यान्नृपः कृत्स्नां क्ष्मां धनं कांचनं तथा ..
सर्वमन्यायतः पृछेन्न तस्योपदिशेद्गुरुः .. 44 ..
text_mt: If a king were to give the entire earth, wealth, and likewise gold, / but should ask everything unjustly, the guru should not instruct him.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ śṛṇoti raverdharmaṃ nyāyataḥ sa ca vakti ca ..
tato gacchati susthānaṃ narakaṃ tadviparyaye .. 45 ..
meaning:
यः शृणोति रवेर्धर्मं न्यायतः स च वक्ति च ..
ततो गच्छति सुस्थानं नरकं तद्विपर्यये .. 45 ..
text_mt: He who listens to the duty of Ravi according to proper method and speaks it, / goes from there to a good state; in the reverse case, to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
dattagodohasaṃbhūtaḥ ṣaḍakṣaravidhānataḥ ..
raviḥ saṃpūjitaḥ śīghraṃ narāṇāṃ tulyatā bhṛśam .. 46 ..
meaning:
दत्तगोदोहसंभूतः षडक्षरविधानतः ..
रविः संपूजितः शीघ्रं नराणां तुल्यता भृशम् .. 46 ..
text_mt: When Ravi is worshipped with what is produced from the milk of cows given according to the six-syllable rite, / equality with him is swiftly and greatly [attained] by men.

sanskrit_iast:
surāsurairmathyamānātkṣīrodātsāgarātpurā ..
pañca gāvaḥ samutpannāḥ sarvalo kasya mātaraḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
सुरासुरैर्मथ्यमानात्क्षीरोदात्सागरात्पुरा ..
पञ्च गावः समुत्पन्नाः सर्वलो कस्य मातरः .. 47 ..
text_mt: Anciently, as the ocean of milk was being churned by the gods and asuras, / five cows were born, the mothers of all the world:

sanskrit_iast:
naṃdā subhadrā surabhī sumanā śobhanāvatī ..
gāvaḥ sūryasamā bhāsā utpannāḥ kṛtimāgatāḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
नंदा सुभद्रा सुरभी सुमना शोभनावती ..
गावः सूर्यसमा भासा उत्पन्नाः कृतिमागताः .. 48 ..
text_mt: Nandā, Subhadrā, Surabhī, Sumanā, and Śobhanāvatī— / cows equal to the sun in brilliance, were born and came into being.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalokopakārārthaṃ devānāṃ tarpaṇāya ca ..
māmāśritya sthitā gāvaḥ snānārthaṃ bhāskarasya tu .. 49 ..
meaning:
सर्वलोकोपकारार्थं देवानां तर्पणाय च ..
मामाश्रित्य स्थिता गावः स्नानार्थं भास्करस्य तु .. 49 ..
text_mt: For the benefit of all worlds and for the gratification of the gods, / and for the bath of Bhāskara, these cows dwell having taken refuge in me.

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāmaṃgāni puṇyāni ṣaḍrasāḥ khagasattama ..
khagādiṣu ca sarveṣu sthirāṇītyupadhāraya .. 1.187.50 ..
meaning:
तासामंगानि पुण्यानि षड्रसाः खगसत्तम ..
खगादिषु च सर्वेषु स्थिराणीत्युपधारय .. 1.187.50 ..
text_mt:
Know, O best of birds, that their limbs are holy,
and the six tastes are firmly established in all birds and other creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
gomayaṃ rocanaṃ mūtraṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ gavām ..
ṣaḍaṃgāni pavitrāṇi sarvasiddhikarāṇi ca .. 51 ..
meaning:
गोमयं रोचनं मूत्रं क्षीरं दधि घृतं गवाम् ..
षडंगानि पवित्राणि सर्वसिद्धिकराणि च .. 51 ..
text_mt:
Cow dung, yellow orpiment, urine, milk, curd, and ghee:
these six limbs of cows are purifying and grant all perfections.

sanskrit_iast:
gomayādutthitaḥ śrīmānbilvavṛkṣo'rkavallabhaḥ ..
tatrāste padmahastā śrīrvṛkṣastena ca sa smṛtaḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
गोमयादुत्थितः श्रीमान्बिल्ववृक्षोऽर्कवल्लभः ..
तत्रास्ते पद्महस्ता श्रीर्वृक्षस्तेन च स स्मृतः .. 52 ..
text_mt:
From cow dung arose the glorious bilva tree, beloved of the sun;
there sits Śrī with lotus in hand, and therefore it is remembered as that tree.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃkānyutpalapadmāni punarjātāni gomayāt ..
gorocanaṃ ca maṃgalya pavitraṃ sarvakāmadam .. 53 ..
meaning:
पंकान्युत्पलपद्मानि पुनर्जातानि गोमयात् ..
गोरोचनं च मंगल्य पवित्रं सर्वकामदम् .. 53 ..
text_mt:
From cow dung also arose lotuses and blue lotuses from the mud;
and cow-gall is auspicious, purifying, and grants all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
gomūtrādguggulurjātaḥ sugaṃdhiḥ priyadarśanaḥ ..
āhāraḥ sarvadevānāṃ bhāskarasya viśeṣataḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
गोमूत्राद्गुग्गुलुर्जातः सुगंधिः प्रियदर्शनः ..
आहारः सर्वदेवानां भास्करस्य विशेषतः .. 54 ..
text_mt:
From cow urine arose bdellium, fragrant and pleasing to look upon;
it is food for all the gods, especially for the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
yadbījaṃ jagataḥ kiṃcittajjñeyaṃ kṣīrasaṃbhavam ..
dadhnaḥ sarvāṇi jātāni māṃgalyānyarthasiddhaye .. 55 ..
meaning:
यद्बीजं जगतः किंचित्तज्ज्ञेयं क्षीरसंभवम् ..
दध्नः सर्वाणि जातानि मांगल्यान्यर्थसिद्धये .. 55 ..
text_mt:
Whatever seed there is of the world, know that to have arisen from milk;
from curd all auspicious things have arisen for the attainment of goals.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtādamṛtamutpannamamarāṇāmatipriyam ..
tasmāddhṛtena payasā dadhnā yaḥ snāpayedravim .. 56 ..
meaning:
घृतादमृतमुत्पन्नममराणामतिप्रियम् ..
तस्माद्धृतेन पयसा दध्ना यः स्नापयेद्रविम् .. 56 ..
text_mt:
From ghee arose the nectar most dear to the immortals;
therefore, whoever bathes the Sun with ghee, milk, and curd,

sanskrit_iast:
tadaṃte coṣṇatoyena kaṣāyaiśca nirūpayet ..
snāpya śītāṃbunā paścādbhānuṃ rocanayālabhet .. 57 ..
meaning:
तदंते चोष्णतोयेन कषायैश्च निरूपयेत् ..
स्नाप्य शीतांबुना पश्चाद्भानुं रोचनयालभेत् .. 57 ..
text_mt:
and then concludes it with warm water and examines him with decoctions,
having bathed [him] afterwards with cold water, should smear the Sun with yellow orpiment.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedbilvapatraiśca padmairnīlotpalaistathā ..
arghyaṃ dadyāttataḥ paścātsavajraṃ guggulaṃ khaga .. 58 ..
meaning:
पूजयेद्बिल्वपत्रैश्च पद्मैर्नीलोत्पलैस्तथा ..
अर्घ्यं दद्यात्ततः पश्चात्सवज्रं गुग्गुलं खग .. 58 ..
text_mt:
He should worship with bilva leaves, lotuses, and blue lotuses;
then afterwards, O bird, he should offer water of respect, and bdellium with diamonds.

sanskrit_iast:
pāyasaṃ dadhibhaktaṃ ca vajraṃ ca madhunā saha ..
nivedayecca sadbhaktyā bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca .. 59 ..
meaning:
पायसं दधिभक्तं च वज्रं च मधुना सह ..
निवेदयेच्च सद्भक्त्या भक्ष्याणि विविधानि च .. 59 ..
text_mt:
Milk-rice, curd-rice, and vajra along with honey,
he should present with true devotion, along with various foods.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ paścātpraṇipatya kṣamāpayet ..
anena vidhinā bhānuṃ ṣaḍaṃgena divaspatim .. 1.187.60 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं पश्चात्प्रणिपत्य क्षमापयेत् ..
अनेन विधिना भानुं षडंगेन दिवस्पतिम् .. 1.187.60 ..
text_mt:
Having made circumambulation, bowed down, he should beg for forgiveness.
By this sixfold rite to the Sun, the lord of the day,

sanskrit_iast:
iha loke pare caiva sarvānkāmānsa gacchati ..
ṣaḍaṃgavidhinā taṃ cāpūjyaivaṃ sumanā ravim .. 61 ..
meaning:
इह लोके परे चैव सर्वान्कामान्स गच्छति ..
षडंगविधिना तं चापूज्यैवं सुमना रविम् .. 61 ..
text_mt:
he attains all desires in this world and in the next.
Having thus worshipped the Sun with cheerful mind by the sixfold rite,

sanskrit_iast:
svargaṃ nayetsadhīmāṃstu kulānāmekaviṃśatim ..
svarge sthāpya svayaṃ gacchejjyautiṣaṃ nāma tatpadam .. 62 ..
meaning:
स्वर्गं नयेत्सधीमांस्तु कुलानामेकविंशतिम् ..
स्वर्गे स्थाप्य स्वयं गच्छेज्ज्यौतिषं नाम तत्पदम् .. 62 ..
text_mt:
the wise man would lead twenty-one generations to heaven;
having established them in heaven, he himself would go to that abode called Jyotiṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśena bhojakā vīra devakārye niyojitāḥ ..
prayāṃti svāminā sārdhaṃ śrīmadbhānuṃ paraṃ mahaḥ .. 63 ..
meaning:
अंशेन भोजका वीर देवकार्ये नियोजिताः ..
प्रयांति स्वामिना सार्धं श्रीमद्भानुं परं महः .. 63 ..
text_mt:
O hero, the Bhojakas employed in the work of the god
go together with their master by a portion to the glorious Sun, the supreme radiance.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktvā bhogāṃstu vipulānbhojako bhogasaṃmitaḥ ..
kālātpunarihāyātaḥ pṛthivyāmekarāḍbhavet .. 64 ..
meaning:
भुक्त्वा भोगांस्तु विपुलान्भोजको भोगसंमितः ..
कालात्पुनरिहायातः पृथिव्यामेकराड्भवेत् .. 64 ..
text_mt:
Having enjoyed extensive pleasures, the Bhojaka, filled with enjoyment,
having returned here in time, would become sole sovereign over the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yadgataṃ bhāskarārcane ..
saurā gāvaśca gacchaṃti sūryalokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
पुष्पं पत्रं फलं तोयं यद्गतं भास्करार्चने ..
सौरा गावश्च गच्छंति सूर्यलोकं न संशयः .. 65 ..
text_mt:
Whatever flower, leaf, fruit, or water has gone into the worship of the Sun,
the Solar devotees and cows go to the world of the Sun without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ pibedbhojane dhenoradattā bhānave payaḥ ..
sa gacchennarakaṃ ghoramakurvaṃstarpaṇaṃ raveḥ .. 66 ..
meaning:
यः पिबेद्भोजने धेनोरदत्ता भानवे पयः ..
स गच्छेन्नरकं घोरमकुर्वंस्तर्पणं रवेः .. 66 ..
text_mt:
Whoever drinks the milk of a cow at a meal without offering it to the Sun,
he would go to a dreadful hell, not having made a libation to the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
ekakālaṃ pibetkṣīraṃ dhenūnāṃ bhāskarasya tu ..
anena snāpayeddevaṃ kṣīreṇa khagasattama .. 67 ..
meaning:
एककालं पिबेत्क्षीरं धेनूनां भास्करस्य तु ..
अनेन स्नापयेद्देवं क्षीरेण खगसत्तम .. 67 ..
text_mt:
One should drink the milk of the Sun's cows at a single time;
with this milk, O best of birds, he should bathe the god.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyūṣe yadbhavetkṣīraṃ dhenūnāṃ bhāskarasya tu ..
snāpayettena vai bhānuṃ kṛtsnena garuḍāgraja .. 68 ..
meaning:
प्रत्यूषे यद्भवेत्क्षीरं धेनूनां भास्करस्य तु ..
स्नापयेत्तेन वै भानुं कृत्स्नेन गरुडाग्रज .. 68 ..
text_mt:
Whatever milk of the cows belongs to the Sun at dawn,
with all of it, O elder brother of Garuḍa, he should bathe the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu loko bhajetsarva na devāya nivedayet ..
yāvanto romakūpāśca gavāṃ dehe khagādhipa ..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi narake pacyate khaga .. 69 ..
meaning:
यस्तु लोको भजेत्सर्व न देवाय निवेदयेत् ..
यावन्तो रोमकूपाश्च गवां देहे खगाधिप ..
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि नरके पच्यते खग .. 69 ..
text_mt:
Whoever among people would enjoy everything and not offer it to the god,
as many pores of hair as there are in the body of cows, O lord of birds,
for so many thousands of years he is cooked in hell, O bird.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjitaṃ pūjyamānaṃ vā yaḥ kaścicchṛṇuyādravim ..
śrutvānumodate yastu sa yajñaphalamaśnute .. 1.187.70 ..
meaning:
पूजितं पूज्यमानं वा यः कश्चिच्छृणुयाद्रविम् ..
श्रुत्वानुमोदते यस्तु स यज्ञफलमश्नुते .. 1.187.70 ..
text_mt:
Whoever hears of the Sun worshipped or being worshipped,
and having heard rejoices, attains the fruit of sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāskaraṃ pṛjitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ..
harṣātpraṇamya vai bhānuṃ tasya loke mahīyate .. 71 ..
meaning:
भास्करं पृजितं दृष्ट्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ..
हर्षात्प्रणम्य वै भानुं तस्य लोके महीयते .. 71 ..
text_mt:
Having seen the Sun worshipped, he is freed from all sins;
having bowed down to the Sun in joy, he is magnified in his world.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjyamānaṃ raviṃ bhaktyā yaḥ paśyenmānavaḥ khaga ..
so'pi yajñaphalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥ .. 72 ..
meaning:
पूज्यमानं रविं भक्त्या यः पश्येन्मानवः खग ..
सोऽपि यज्ञफलं कृत्स्नं प्राप्नुयान्नात्र संशयः .. 72 ..
text_mt:
Whoever sees the Sun being worshipped with devotion, O bird,
he too would obtain the entire fruit of sacrifice; there is no doubt here.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvānumodate yastu pūjyamānaṃ divākaram ..
tatsarvaṃ phalamāpnoti prasādādbhāskarasya tu .. 73 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वानुमोदते यस्तु पूज्यमानं दिवाकरम् ..
तत्सर्वं फलमाप्नोति प्रसादाद्भास्करस्य तु .. 73 ..
text_mt:
And whoever, having heard of the Sun being worshipped, rejoices,
attains all that fruit through the grace of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
ekajanmānugaṃ dānaṃ bhaktyā yacca niveditam ..
japayajñādviyuktebhyaḥ sahasrabhavikaṃ smṛtam ..
ābhūtasaṃplava sthāyi pradānaṃ japajīvinām .. 74 ..
meaning:
एकजन्मानुगं दानं भक्त्या यच्च निवेदितम् ..
जपयज्ञाद्वियुक्तेभ्यः सहस्रभविकं स्मृतम् ..
आभूतसंप्लव स्थायि प्रदानं जपजीविनाम् .. 74 ..

sanskrit_iast:
atyalpamapi yaddattaṃ vācakāya khagādhipa ..
tanmahāpralayaṃ yāvaddāturbhogāya kalpate .. 75 ..
meaning:
अत्यल्पमपि यद्दत्तं वाचकाय खगाधिप ..
तन्महाप्रलयं यावद्दातुर्भोगाय कल्पते .. 75 ..
text_mt:
Even the tiniest bit that is given to a reciter, O lord of birds,
serves for the donor's enjoyment until the great dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
na dānamalpaṃ bahudhā kiṃcidasti vijānatām ..
deśakālavidhiśraddhāpātrayuktaṃ tadakṣayam .. 76 ..
meaning:
न दानमल्पं बहुधा किंचिदस्ति विजानताम् ..
देशकालविधिश्रद्धापात्रयुक्तं तदक्षयम् .. 76 ..
text_mt:
For the wise, no gift is ever considered small;
endowed with place, time, rule, faith, and a worthy recipient, it is inexhaustible.

sanskrit_iast:
pātre deśe ca kāle ca vidhinā śraddhayā ca yat ..
dattaṃ hutaṃ kṛtaṃ caiva tadanaṃtaphalaṃ bhavet .. 77 ..
meaning:
पात्रे देशे च काले च विधिना श्रद्धया च यत् ..
दत्तं हुतं कृतं चैव तदनंतफलं भवेत् .. 77 ..
text_mt:
Whatever is given, offered in fire, and performed with a worthy recipient, in place and time,
according to rule and with faith, that becomes of endless fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
tilārdhamapi yadvīra dīyate śraddhayā dvija ..
satpātre vidhivadbhaktyā tadbhavetsarvakāmikam .. 78 ..
meaning:
तिलार्धमपि यद्वीर दीयते श्रद्धया द्विज ..
सत्पात्रे विधिवद्भक्त्या तद्भवेत्सर्वकामिकम् .. 78 ..
text_mt:
Even half a sesame seed, O hero, O twice-born, that is given with faith
to a worthy recipient according to rule and with devotion, becomes the granter of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
yatsnātaṃ jñānasalilaiḥ śīlabhasmapramārjitam .. snāna
tatpātraṃ sarvapātrebhya uttamaṃ parikīrtitam .. 79 ..
meaning:
यत्स्नातं ज्ञानसलिलैः शीलभस्मप्रमार्जितम् .. स्नान
तत्पात्रं सर्वपात्रेभ्य उत्तमं परिकीर्तितम् .. 79 ..
text_mt:
He who is bathed in the waters of knowledge, cleansed with the ashes of good conduct,
that recipient is proclaimed the highest of all recipients.

sanskrit_iast:
japo damo yamaḥ puṃsāṃ trātā saṃsāgsāgarāt ..
ajñānāṃ pāpanetrāṇāṃ tatpātraṃ paramaṃ smṛtam .. 1.187.80 ..
meaning:
जपो दमो यमः पुंसां त्राता संसाग्सागरात् ..
अज्ञानां पापनेत्राणां तत्पात्रं परमं स्मृतम् .. 1.187.80 ..
text_mt:
Muttering, self-restraint, and control are the saviour of men from the ocean of worldly existence;
for the ignorant whose eyes are sinful, that recipient is remembered as supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānaplavena copetaṃ śāstraṃ pāpamahārṇavāt ..
ajñānsaṃtārayennūnaṃ kiṃ śilā tārayecchilām .. 81 ..
meaning:
ज्ञानप्लवेन चोपेतं शास्त्रं पापमहार्णवात् ..
अज्ञान्संतारयेन्नूनं किं शिला तारयेच्छिलाम् .. 81 ..
text_mt:
Endowed with the boat of knowledge, scripture can surely carry the ignorant across
from the great ocean of sin; can a stone cause a stone to cross?

sanskrit_iast:
dvijānāṃ vedaviduṣāṃ kaṭisaṃbhogi yatphalam ..
haṃtakārapradānena tatphalaṃ japajīvine .. 82 ..
meaning:
द्विजानां वेदविदुषां कटिसंभोगि यत्फलम् ..
हंतकारप्रदानेन तत्फलं जपजीविने .. 82 ..
text_mt:
Whatever fruit is attained by embracing the waists of twice-born scholars of the Veda,
that same fruit belongs to one who lives by muttering, through the giving of food.

sanskrit_iast:
jīvo yasyaitya gṛhe ca bhuṅkte satkṛtisatkṛtaḥ ..
kulamuttārayettasya narakārṇavasaṃsthitam .. 83 ..
meaning:
जीवो यस्यैत्य गृहे च भुङ्क्ते सत्कृतिसत्कृतः ..
कुलमुत्तारयेत्तस्य नरकार्णवसंस्थितम् .. 83 ..
text_mt:
He in whose house a living soul comes and eats, honoured with hospitality,
would deliver his family residing in the ocean of hell.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñāgnihomatīrtheṣu yatphalaṃ parikīrtitam ..
japināmannadānena tatsamagraṃ phala labhet .. 84 ..
meaning:
यज्ञाग्निहोमतीर्थेषु यत्फलं परिकीर्तितम् ..
जपिनामन्नदानेन तत्समग्रं फल लभेत् .. 84 ..
text_mt:
Whatever fruit is proclaimed in sacrifices, fire-oblations, and sacred bathing places,
he would obtain that entire fruit through the gift of food to those who mutter [prayers].

sanskrit_iast:
bhojine śāṃtacittāya paridhyānaratāya ca ..
śraddhayānnaṃ sakṛddattvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 85 ..
meaning:
भोजिने शांतचित्ताय परिध्यानरताय च ..
श्रद्धयान्नं सकृद्दत्त्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 85 ..
text_mt:
Having once given food with faith to a diner whose mind is calm
and who is devoted to deep meditation, he is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
japakāñchāṃtisaṃyuktānādityārpitacetasaḥ ..
bhojayitvā sakṛdbhaktyā sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 86 ..
meaning:
जपकाञ्छांतिसंयुक्तानादित्यार्पितचेतसः ..
भोजयित्वा सकृद्भक्त्या सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् .. 86 ..
text_mt:
Having once fed with devotion those who mutter [prayers], endowed with tranquility,
whose minds are offered to the Sun, one would obtain all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyamāno raveḥ sūktaṃ bhojayetsatataṃ ca yaḥ ..
tataḥ sākṣādanenaiva tadbhuktamaśana bhavet .. 87 ..
meaning:
ध्यायमानो रवेः सूक्तं भोजयेत्सततं च यः ..
ततः साक्षादनेनैव तद्भुक्तमशन भवेत् .. 87 ..
text_mt:
And whoever continuously feeds [them] while meditating on the hymn to the Sun,
by that directly, that food becomes eaten by him.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝnudiśya yaḥ śrāddhe bhojayedbhojakaṃ naraḥ ..
sa sthānaṃ samavāpnoti bhānavīyamasaṃśayaḥ .. 88 ..
bhojakasatkāravarṇanam
meaning:
पितॄनुदिश्य यः श्राद्धे भोजयेद्भोजकं नरः ..
स स्थानं समवाप्नोति भानवीयमसंशयः .. 88 ..
भोजकसत्कारवर्णनम्
text_mt:
The man who feeds a Bhojaka in an ancestral rite with reference to the ancestors,
he attains the abode belonging to the Sun without doubt.
Description of the Hospitality to a Bhojaka

sanskrit_iast:
.. saptāśva uvāca .. ..
sūryāya sarvapākānnaṃ nivedyāgnau ca homayet ..
hutvāgnau prakṣipedvīra baliṃ dikṣu samaṃtataḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सप्ताश्व उवाच .. ..
सूर्याय सर्वपाकान्नं निवेद्याग्नौ च होमयेत् ..
हुत्वाग्नौ प्रक्षिपेद्वीर बलिं दिक्षु समंततः .. 1 ..
title: adhyāyaḥ 188

sanskrit_iast:
sūryāgniguruviprāṇāṃ sarvapākānnamanvaham ..
yo'nivedyātmanā bhuṃkte sa bhuṃkte kilbiṣaṃ naraḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
सूर्याग्निगुरुविप्राणां सर्वपाकान्नमन्वहम् ..
योऽनिवेद्यात्मना भुंक्ते स भुंक्ते किल्बिषं नरः .. 2 ..
text_mt:
The man who himself eats every day all cooked food without offering it
to the Sun, fire, the guru, and the brāhmaṇas, eats sin.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣipālye ca vāṇijye krodhasatyakṣayādibhiḥ ..
puṃsāṃ pāpāni vardhaṃte sūnādoṣaiśca paṃcabhiḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
कृषिपाल्ये च वाणिज्ये क्रोधसत्यक्षयादिभिः ..
पुंसां पापानि वर्धंते सूनादोषैश्च पंचभिः .. 3 ..
text_mt: In agriculture, animal husbandry, and trade, through anger, loss of truthfulness, and the like, / and through the five domestic slaughtering-faults, men's sins increase.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṃḍanī peṣaṇī cullī udakuṃbhaḥ pramārjanī ..
paṃca sūnā gṛhasthasya tena svargaṃ na gacchati .. 4 ..
meaning:
कंडनी पेषणी चुल्ली उदकुंभः प्रमार्जनी ..
पंच सूना गृहस्थस्य तेन स्वर्गं न गच्छति .. 4 ..
text_mt: The mortar, the grindstone, the hearth, the water jar, and the broom: / these are the five slaughterhouses of the householder; on account of them he does not go to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryāgnigurupūjābhiḥ pāpairetairna lipyate ..
anyaiśca pātakaighoraistasmātsaṃpūjayetsadā .. 5 ..
meaning:
सूर्याग्निगुरुपूजाभिः पापैरेतैर्न लिप्यते ..
अन्यैश्च पातकैघोरैस्तस्मात्संपूजयेत्सदा .. 5 ..
text_mt: By worshiping the sun, fire, and the guru, he is not stained by these sins / or by other terrible offenses; therefore, one should always worship them.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryāgnigurunaivedyaṃ yāvatsyādannasaṃkhyayā ..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi dātā sūryapure vaset .. 6 ..
meaning:
सूर्याग्निगुरुनैवेद्यं यावत्स्यादन्नसंख्यया ..
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि दाता सूर्यपुरे वसेत् .. 6 ..
text_mt: As many food-portions as there may be in the food offering to the sun, fire, and the guru, / for that many thousands of years the giver shall dwell in the city of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtapūpayutaiḥ siktaiḥ puṇyaṃ daśaguṇottaram ..
avadaṃśaguṇairyuktaṃ puṇyaṃ śataguṇaṃ khaga .. 7 ..
meaning:
घृतपूपयुतैः सिक्तैः पुण्यं दशगुणोत्तरम् ..
अवदंशगुणैर्युक्तं पुण्यं शतगुणं खग .. 7 ..
text_mt: With [cakes] accompanied by and steeped in clarified butter, the merit is tenfold greater; / endowed with condiments, O bird, the merit is a hundredfold.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭikaudananaivedyaṃ sahasraguṇitaṃ phalam ..
sugaṃdhaśālinaivedyaṃ vijñeyamayutottaram.. 8 ..
meaning:
षष्टिकौदननैवेद्यं सहस्रगुणितं फलम् ..
सुगंधशालिनैवेद्यं विज्ञेयमयुतोत्तरम्.. 8 ..
text_mt: An offering of boiled ṣaṣṭika rice has a thousandfold fruit; / an offering of fragrant winter rice should be known to be ten thousandfold greater.

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣyānnapānadānāni tatphalāni tathātathā ..
yadvā tadvā sadā deyaṃ sūryāgnigurusādhuṣu ..
bhakṣyaṃ nivedya pūrvoktamakṣayaṃ labhate phalam .. 9 ..
meaning:
भक्ष्यान्नपानदानानि तत्फलानि तथातथा ..
यद्वा तद्वा सदा देयं सूर्याग्निगुरुसाधुषु ..
भक्ष्यं निवेद्य पूर्वोक्तमक्षयं लभते फलम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Gifts of solid food, boiled food, and drinks bring corresponding fruits. / Whatever it may be, it should always be given to the sun, fire, the guru, and the virtuous; / having offered the previously mentioned food, one obtains imperishable fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktiṃ deva deve divākare ..
sa pitṝnsarvapāpebhyaḥ samuddhṛtya divaṃ nayet .. 1.188.10 ..
meaning:
एवं यः कुरुते भक्तिं देव देवे दिवाकरे ..
स पितॄन्सर्वपापेभ्यः समुद्धृत्य दिवं नयेत् .. 1.188.10 ..
text_mt: He who thus renders devotion to the sun, god of gods, / having rescued his ancestors from all sins, leads them to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃgāsnānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ darśanātprāpnuyādraveḥ ..
sarvatīrthābhiṣekaṃ ca praṇāmādviṃdate khaga .. 11 ..
meaning:
गंगास्नानमिदं पुण्यं दर्शनात्प्राप्नुयाद्रवेः ..
सर्वतीर्थाभिषेकं च प्रणामाद्विंदते खग .. 11 ..
text_mt: This merit of bathing in the Gaṅgā one obtains from the sight of the sun; / and one attains the ablution of all sacred fords from a reverent bow, O bird.

sanskrit_iast:
mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ praṇamya śirasā ravim ..
śuśrūṣeta ca saṃdhyāyāṃ sūryaloke mahīyate .. 12..
meaning:
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यः प्रणम्य शिरसा रविम् ..
शुश्रूषेत च संध्यायां सूर्यलोके महीयते .. 12..
text_mt: Having bowed to the sun with his head, he is freed from all sins; / and if he attends upon [the sun] at twilight, he is exalted in the realm of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
yugapatpūjitāstena brahmaviṣṇu maheśvarāḥ ..
pitaraḥ sarvadevāśca bhaveyuḥ pūjitā ravau .. 13 ..
meaning:
युगपत्पूजितास्तेन ब्रह्मविष्णु महेश्वराः ..
पितरः सर्वदेवाश्च भवेयुः पूजिता रवौ .. 13 ..
text_mt: By him Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara are worshiped simultaneously; / the ancestors and all the gods become worshiped when the sun is worshiped.

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣyaṃti pitarastasya sukṛṣṭeneva karṣukāḥ ..
yaḥ śrāddhe bhojayedbhaktyā brāhmaṇaṃ japajīvinam .. 14 ..
meaning:
तुष्यंति पितरस्तस्य सुकृष्टेनेव कर्षुकाः ..
यः श्राद्धे भोजयेद्भक्त्या ब्राह्मणं जपजीविनम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: His ancestors rejoice just as farmers do over well-plowed land, / if in a śrāddha he devotedly feeds a brāhmaṇa who subsists on mantra-recitation.

sanskrit_iast:
api naḥ sa kule kaṃciduddharetkiṃ khageśvara ..
yaḥ saṃpūjya raviṃ śrāddhe bhojayejjapajīvinam .. 15 ..
meaning:
अपि नः स कुले कंचिदुद्धरेत्किं खगेश्वर ..
यः संपूज्य रविं श्राद्धे भोजयेज्जपजीविनम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: [The ancestors say:] “Could anyone in our family deliver us, O king of birds, / who, having worshiped the sun, feeds in the śrāddha one who subsists on mantra-recitation?”

sanskrit_iast:
tṛpyaṃti pitarastasya gāyaṃti ca pitāmahāḥ ..
adya naḥ sa kule prājño vācakaṃ bhojayiṣyati .. 16 ..
meaning:
तृप्यंति पितरस्तस्य गायंति च पितामहाः ..
अद्य नः स कुले प्राज्ञो वाचकं भोजयिष्यति .. 16 ..
text_mt: His fathers are satisfied and his grandfathers sing: / “Today in our family a wise man will feed the reader [of scriptures]!”

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇavidamāyāṃtaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva saha saṃsthitāḥ ..
krīḍaṃtyoṣadhayaḥ sarvā yāsyāmaḥ svargamakṣayam .. 17 ..
meaning:
पुराणविदमायांतं दृष्ट्वैव सह संस्थिताः ..
क्रीडंत्योषधयः सर्वा यास्यामः स्वर्गमक्षयम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: Upon seeing one versed in the Purāṇas arrive, all the medicinal plants, / standing together, rejoice: “We shall go to imperishable heaven!”

sanskrit_iast:
anugrahāya lokānāṃ śraddhāyāśca parīkṣaṇe ..
caraṃtyatithirūpeṇa pitaro devatāstathā .. .. 18 ..
meaning:
अनुग्रहाय लोकानां श्रद्धायाश्च परीक्षणे ..
चरंत्यतिथिरूपेण पितरो देवतास्तथा .. .. 18 ..
text_mt: To bestow grace upon people and to test their faith, / the ancestors and likewise the deities wander about in the form of guests.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādatithimāyāṃtamagre gacchetkṛtāṃjaliḥ ..
svāgatāsanapādyārghyasnānānnaśayanādibhiḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
तस्मादतिथिमायांतमग्रे गच्छेत्कृतांजलिः ..
स्वागतासनपाद्यार्घ्यस्नानान्नशयनादिभिः .. 19 ..
text_mt: Therefore, one should go out to meet an arriving guest with folded hands, / with welcome, a seat, water for the feet, guest-water, a bath, food, a bed, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
rūpānvitaṃ virūpaṃ vā malinaṃ malināṃbaram ..
velāyāmatithiṃ prāptaṃ paṃḍito na vicārayet .. 1.188.20 ..
meaning:
रूपान्वितं विरूपं वा मलिनं मलिनांबरम् ..
वेलायामतिथिं प्राप्तं पंडितो न विचारयेत् .. 1.188.20 ..
text_mt: Whether handsome or deformed, dirty or dressed in soiled clothes, / when a guest arrives at mealtime, a wise person should not evaluate [him].

sanskrit_iast:
bhojakānāṃ śarīreṣu nityaṃ sannihito raviḥ ..
ye bhojakāstyajaṃtyanye sarvapāpeṣvavasthitāḥ ..
adhomukhorddhvapādāste pataṃti narakāgniṣu .. 21 ..
meaning:
भोजकानां शरीरेषु नित्यं सन्निहितो रविः ..
ये भोजकास्त्यजंत्यन्ये सर्वपापेष्ववस्थिताः ..
अधोमुखोर्द्ध्वपादास्ते पतंति नरकाग्निषु .. 21 ..
text_mt: The sun is always present in the bodies of the Bhojakas. / Those others who abandon the Bhojakas, abiding in all sins, / fall head down and feet up into the fires of hell.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛmibhirbhinnavadanāstapyamānāśca vahninā ..
pīḍyaṃte cāyudhai rghoṃrairyāvadiṃdrāścaturdaśa .. 22 ..
meaning:
कृमिभिर्भिन्नवदनास्तप्यमानाश्च वह्निना ..
पीड्यंते चायुधै र्घोंरैर्यावदिंद्राश्चतुर्दश .. 22 ..
text_mt: Their faces torn open by worms and burning with fire, / they are tormented with terrible weapons as long as the fourteen Indras endure.

sanskrit_iast:
ye cāpavādaṃ śṛṇvaṃti vimūḍhā brāhmaṇeṣu vai ..
te viśeṣeṇa pacyaṃte narakeṣu madicchayā .. 23 ..
meaning:
ये चापवादं शृण्वंति विमूढा ब्राह्मणेषु वै ..
ते विशेषेण पच्यंते नरकेषु मदिच्छया .. 23 ..
text_mt: And those foolish people who listen to slander against brāhmaṇas / are especially cooked in the hells by my will.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmeva pātrāṇāṃ satpātraṃ jāpakaḥ paraḥ ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjayetsusamāhitaḥ .. 24 .. ..
sauradharmeṣu saptāśvasaṃvādaḥ
meaning:
सर्वेषामेव पात्राणां सत्पात्रं जापकः परः ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन पूजयेत्सुसमाहितः .. 24 .. ..
सौरधर्मेषु सप्ताश्वसंवादः
text_mt:
Among all recipients, the reciter [of mantras] is the supreme worthy recipient; / therefore, with all effort, well-concentrated, one should worship him.
Dialogue of Saptāśva on the Solar Ordinances.

sanskrit_iast:
.. saptāśvatilaka uvāca .. ..
āmapātrarasā yadvannaśyaṃte naśyabhājane ..
japopekṣe tathā dānaṃ saha pātreṇa naśyati ..
sadbījamūṣare yadvatsamuptaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet ..1..
meaning:
.. सप्ताश्वतिलक उवाच .. ..
आमपात्ररसा यद्वन्नश्यंते नश्यभाजने ..
जपोपेक्षे तथा दानं सह पात्रेण नश्यति ..
सद्बीजमूषरे यद्वत्समुप्तं निष्फलं भवेत् ..1..
text_mt: The ornament of Saptāśva said: / Just as the liquids in an unbaked vessel are ruined in a perishable container, / so a gift given to one who neglects mantra-recitation perishes along with the recipient; / just as good seed sown in barren soil becomes fruitless,
title: Saptāśvānūrusaṃvādaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmanīva hutaṃ havyaṃ yathā hotuśca niṣphalam ..
japena rahite vipre tathā dānaṃ nirarthakam ..2..
meaning:
भस्मनीव हुतं हव्यं यथा होतुश्च निष्फलम् ..
जपेन रहिते विप्रे तथा दानं निरर्थकम् ..2..
text_mt: and just as an oblation poured into ashes is fruitless for the sacrificer, / so a gift to a vipra who is devoid of mantra-recitation is useless.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā ṣaṇḍho'phalaḥ strīṣu yathā gaurgavi cāphalā ..
brāhmaṇasya tathā janma japahīnasya niṣphalam ..3..
meaning:
यथा षण्ढोऽफलः स्त्रीषु यथा गौर्गवि चाफला ..
ब्राह्मणस्य तथा जन्म जपहीनस्य निष्फलम् ..3..
text_mt: Just as a eunuch is fruitless with women, and just as a cow is fruitless with a cow, / so the birth of a brāhmaṇa devoid of mantra-recitation is fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
lohoḍupena pratarannimajjatyudake yathā ..
dātā dātā grahītā ca patatyaṃdhe tamasyatha..4..
meaning:
लोहोडुपेन प्रतरन्निमज्जत्युदके यथा ..
दाता दाता ग्रहीता च पतत्यंधे तमस्यथ..4..
text_mt: Just as one crossing over in an iron boat sinks into the water, / so the giver and the receiver fall into blind darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
kāruṇyātsarvabhūteṣu śraddhayā yatpradīyate ..
dānaṃ tadvai khaga jñeyaṃ sārvakāmikamuttamam .. 5 ..
meaning:
कारुण्यात्सर्वभूतेषु श्रद्धया यत्प्रदीयते ..
दानं तद्वै खग ज्ञेयं सार्वकामिकमुत्तमम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Whatever is given with faith out of compassion for all beings, / that gift, O bird, should be known as fulfilling all desires and supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca bālavṛddhātureṣu ca ..
yaddīyate khagaśreṣṭha tasyānantaphalaṃ bhavet .. 6 ..
meaning:
दीनांधकृपणानां च बालवृद्धातुरेषु च ..
यद्दीयते खगश्रेष्ठ तस्यानन्तफलं भवेत् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Whatever is given to the poor, the blind, and the miserable, and among children, the aged, and the afflicted, / O best of birds, bears infinite fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
na hi svārthaṃ samuddiśya pratigṛhṇaṃti sādhavaḥ ..
dāturevopakārāya jagṛhuḥ śravaṇādayaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
न हि स्वार्थं समुद्दिश्य प्रतिगृह्णंति साधवः ..
दातुरेवोपकाराय जगृहुः श्रवणादयः .. 7 ..
text_mt: Virtuous men do not accept gifts for their own sake; / Śravaṇa and others accepted [them] solely for the benefit of the giver.

sanskrit_iast:
dāturevopakārāya vadatyarthī dadasva me ..
yasmāddātā prayātyūrdhvamadhastiṣṭhetpratigrahī .. 8 ..
meaning:
दातुरेवोपकाराय वदत्यर्थी ददस्व मे ..
यस्माद्दाता प्रयात्यूर्ध्वमधस्तिष्ठेत्प्रतिग्रही .. 8 ..
text_mt: It is solely for the benefit of the giver that the petitioner says: “Give to me!” / For the giver goes upward, while the recipient stays below.

sanskrit_iast:
dehīti suvadannarthī dhanaṃ bodhayatīva saḥ ..
yanmayā kṛtamarthitvaṃ prage'dānaphalaṃ hi tat .. 9 ..
meaning:
देहीति सुवदन्नर्थी धनं बोधयतीव सः ..
यन्मया कृतमर्थित्वं प्रगेऽदानफलं हि तत् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Saying politely, “Give!” the petitioner, as it were, instructs [the giver about] wealth: / “The fact that I have become a beggar is indeed the fruit of not giving in a past life.”

sanskrit_iast:
bodhayaṃti na yācante dehīti kṛpaṇā janāḥ ..
avastheyamadānasya yadyācāmo gṛhegṛhe .. 1.189.10 ..
meaning:
बोधयंति न याचन्ते देहीति कृपणा जनाः ..
अवस्थेयमदानस्य यद्याचामो गृहेगृहे .. 1.189.10 ..
text_mt: Wretched people teach, they do not beg, [when saying,] “Give!”: / “This is the state caused by nongiving, that we beg from house to house.”

sanskrit_iast:
āyātyarthī gṛhaṃ yastu kastaṃ na pratipūjayet ..
koyamarthī na pūjyaḥ syādyācamāno dinedine .. 11 ..
meaning:
आयात्यर्थी गृहं यस्तु कस्तं न प्रतिपूजयेत् ..
कोयमर्थी न पूज्यः स्याद्याचमानो दिनेदिने .. 11 ..
text_mt: When a petitioner comes to one's house, who would not honor him? / Who is this petitioner who should not be worshiped, begging day after day?

sanskrit_iast:
yadbalādapyanicchaṃtaṃ yojayaṃti narāśrayān ..
ahanyahani yācaṃte dātuste darśayaṃti hi .. .. 12 ..
meaning:
यद्बलादप्यनिच्छंतं योजयंति नराश्रयान् ..
अहन्यहनि याचंते दातुस्ते दर्शयंति हि .. .. 12 ..
text_mt: Because they forcibly attach human beings [to merit], even when unwilling, / and beg day after day, they are indeed showing [the path] to the giver.

sanskrit_iast:
ekastiṣṭhati cādhastādanyaścopari tiṣṭhati ..
dātṛyācakayorbhedaḥ karābhyāmeva sūcitaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
एकस्तिष्ठति चाधस्तादन्यश्चोपरि तिष्ठति ..
दातृयाचकयोर्भेदः कराभ्यामेव सूचितः .. 13 ..
text_mt: One hand stays below, and the other stays above; / the distinction between the giver and the beggar is indicated by the hands alone.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ prāptāyārthine dānaṃ tyaktvā pātra mudīkṣate ..
sarvakarmasu yuktatvānna dātā pāramārthikaḥ ..14..
meaning:
यः प्राप्तायार्थिने दानं त्यक्त्वा पात्र मुदीक्षते ..
सर्वकर्मसु युक्तत्वान्न दाता पारमार्थिकः ..14..
text_mt: He who withholds a gift from an arrived petitioner and looks for a [more worthy] recipient, / because he is engaged in all [kinds of calculated] deeds, is not a true giver.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyarthino narā na syurdānadharmaḥ kathaṃ bhavet..
tadarthiṣu bhaveddānaṃ svāgataṃ svāgataṃ priyam.. .. 15 ..
meaning:
यद्यर्थिनो नरा न स्युर्दानधर्मः कथं भवेत्..
तदर्थिषु भवेद्दानं स्वागतं स्वागतं प्रियम्.. .. 15 ..
text_mt: If there were no human beggars, how could the virtue of generosity exist? / Therefore, a gift to petitioners should be accompanied by a warm welcome and dear words.

sanskrit_iast:
pādodakamanuvrajyātsvargasopānasaptakam ..
ciṃtāciṃtānurūpeṇa kadā kasya vinaṣyati .. 16 ..
meaning:
पादोदकमनुव्रज्यात्स्वर्गसोपानसप्तकम् ..
चिंताचिंतानुरूपेण कदा कस्य विनष्यति .. 16 ..
text_mt: Water for the feet and accompanying [the guest] are a seven-rung ladder to heaven. / According to one's anxious or careless thought, when does [merit] perish for anyone?

sanskrit_iast:
grāsādardhamapi grāsaṃ yuktaṃ dātuṃ sadārthinām ..
dānaṃ priyavinirmuktaṃ naṣṭamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
ग्रासादर्धमपि ग्रासं युक्तं दातुं सदार्थिनाम् ..
दानं प्रियविनिर्मुक्तं नष्टमाहुर्मनीषिणः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Even half a mouthful from one's food is fit to be given always to petitioners; / wise men say that a gift devoid of affection is lost.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsatkṛtya dātavyamanaṃtaphalamicchatā ..
pretyākhyānamapi śreyaḥ priyānunayapeśa lam ..18..
meaning:
तस्मात्सत्कृत्य दातव्यमनंतफलमिच्छता ..
प्रेत्याख्यानमपि श्रेयः प्रियानुनयपेश लम् ..18..
text_mt: Therefore, one desiring infinite fruit should give with hospitality; / even a refusal that is pleasing with kind persuasion is better [than a harsh gift].

sanskrit_iast:
na taddānamasatkārapāruṣyamalinīkṛtam ..
varaṃ na dattamarthibhyaḥ saṃkruddhenāṃtarātmanā..19..
meaning:
न तद्दानमसत्कारपारुष्यमलिनीकृतम् ..
वरं न दत्तमर्थिभ्यः संक्रुद्धेनांतरात्मना..19..
text_mt: That which is soiled by disrespect and harshness is not a gift; / it is better that nothing be given to petitioners by an inwardly enraged mind.

sanskrit_iast:
na taddhanaṃ na ca prītirna dharmaḥ priyavarjitaḥ ..
dānapradānaniyamayajñadhyānaṃ hutaṃ tapaḥ ..
yatnenāpi kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ krodho'sya niṣphalaṃ khaga .. 1.189.20 ..
meaning:
न तद्धनं न च प्रीतिर्न धर्मः प्रियवर्जितः ..
दानप्रदाननियमयज्ञध्यानं हुतं तपः ..
यत्नेनापि कृतं सर्वं क्रोधोऽस्य निष्फलं खग .. 1.189.20 ..
text_mt: That is not wealth, nor is there love, nor dharma when bereft of kindness. / Gift-giving, vows, sacrifices, meditation, offerings into the fire, and asceticism— / all of it, even if performed with effort, O bird, anger renders fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ śraddhayārcitaṃ dadyātprati gṛhṇāti cārcitam ..
tāvubhau gacchataḥ svargaṃ naraka tadviparyayāt .. 21 ..
meaning:
यः श्रद्धयार्चितं दद्यात्प्रति गृह्णाति चार्चितम् ..
तावुभौ गच्छतः स्वर्गं नरक तद्विपर्ययात् .. 21 ..
text_mt: Whoever gives what is offered with faith, and whoever receives what is offered, / both of them go to heaven; from the opposite, to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
audāryaṃ svāgataṃ maitrī hyanukaṃpā ca matsaraḥ ..
paṃcabhistu gurau dānaṃ dāturdāne mahāphalam..22..
meaning:
औदार्यं स्वागतं मैत्री ह्यनुकंपा च मत्सरः ..
पंचभिस्तु गुरौ दानं दातुर्दाने महाफलम्..22..
text_mt: Generosity, welcoming words, friendliness, compassion, and absence of malice— / through these five, a gift given to an elder brings great fruit to the giver.

sanskrit_iast:
vārāṇasī kurukṣetraṃ prayāgaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca ..
gātaṭaṃ samudraśca naimiṣāraṇyameva ca .. 23 ..
meaning:
वाराणसी कुरुक्षेत्रं प्रयागं पुष्कराणि च ..
गातटं समुद्रश्च नैमिषारण्यमेव च .. 23 ..
text_mt: Vārāṇasī, Kurukṣetra, Prayāga, and the Puṣkaras, / the bank of the Gaṅgā, the ocean, and the Naimiṣa forest,

sanskrit_iast:
mūlasthānaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ puṃḍīrasvāmikaṃ tathā ..
kālapriyaṃ khagaśreṣṭha kṣīrikāvāsa eva ca .. 24 ..
meaning:
मूलस्थानं महापुण्यं पुंडीरस्वामिकं तथा ..
कालप्रियं खगश्रेष्ठ क्षीरिकावास एव च .. 24 ..
text_mt: the exceedingly sacred Mūlasthāna, likewise Puṇḍīrasvāmin, / Kālapriya, O best of birds, and Kṣīrikāvāsa:

sanskrit_iast:
ityete kīrtitā deśāḥ surasiddhaniṣevitāḥ ..
sarve sūryāśramāḥ puṇyāḥ sarvā nadyaḥ saparvatāḥ ..
gosiddhamuni vāsāśca deśāḥ puṇyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
इत्येते कीर्तिता देशाः सुरसिद्धनिषेविताः ..
सर्वे सूर्याश्रमाः पुण्याः सर्वा नद्यः सपर्वताः ..
गोसिद्धमुनि वासाश्च देशाः पुण्याः प्रकीर्तिताः .. 25 ..
text_mt: These regions are proclaimed as frequented by gods and siddhas. / All hermitage-abodes of the Sun are holy; all rivers along with mountains, / and regions that are the dwellings of cows, siddhas, and sages, are proclaimed holy.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryāyatanasaṃsthānāṃ yadyadalpaṃ tu dīyate ..
tadanaṃtaphalaṃ jñeyaṃ vacaḥ kṣetrānubhāvataḥ.. 36 ..
meaning:
सूर्यायतनसंस्थानां यद्यदल्पं तु दीयते ..
तदनंतफलं ज्ञेयं वचः क्षेत्रानुभावतः.. 36 ..
text_mt: Whatever little is given to those residing at an abode of the Sun, / that should be known to bear endless fruit by virtue of the sacred site.

sanskrit_iast:
grahaṇaṃ caṃdrasūryābhyāmuttarāyaṇamuttamam ..
viṣuvaṃ savyatīpātaṃ ṣaḍaśītimukhaṃ tathā .. 27 ..
meaning:
ग्रहणं चंद्रसूर्याभ्यामुत्तरायणमुत्तमम् ..
विषुवं सव्यतीपातं षडशीतिमुखं तथा .. 27 ..
text_mt: An eclipse of the moon or the sun, the excellent northern course of the sun, / the equinox, along with a vyatīpāta, and the ṣaḍaśītimukha,

sanskrit_iast:
dinacchidrāṇi saṃkrāṃtiḥ puṇyaṃ viṣupadaṃ khaga ..
iti kālaḥ samā khyātaḥ puṃsāṃ puṇyavivardhanaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
दिनच्छिद्राणि संक्रांतिः पुण्यं विषुपदं खग ..
इति कालः समा ख्यातः पुंसां पुण्यविवर्धनः .. 28 ..
text_mt: the dinacchidras, the solar transit, and the holy viṣupada, O bird— / thus is time declared, increasing the merit of men.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktibhāvaḥ parā prītirdharmo dharmaikabhāvanaḥ ..
pratipattiriti jñeyaṃ śraddhāparyāyapaṃcakam ..29..
meaning:
भक्तिभावः परा प्रीतिर्धर्मो धर्मैकभावनः ..
प्रतिपत्तिरिति ज्ञेयं श्रद्धापर्यायपंचकम् ..29..
text_mt: Devotional disposition, supreme affection, dharma, reflection on dharma alone, / [and] reverent reception—these are to be known as the five synonyms of faith.

sanskrit_iast:
śraddhayā vidhivatpātre pratipāditamuttamam ..
tasmācchraddhāṃ samāsthāya deyamakṣayamicchatā .. 1.189.30 ..
meaning:
श्रद्धया विधिवत्पात्रे प्रतिपादितमुत्तमम् ..
तस्माच्छ्रद्धां समास्थाय देयमक्षयमिच्छता .. 1.189.30 ..
text_mt: Given with faith according to rule to a worthy recipient, [a gift] is supreme. / Therefore, relying upon faith, one who desires what is imperishable should give.

sanskrit_iast:
yaddānaṃ śraddhayā pātre vidhivatpratipāditam ..
tadanaṃtaphalaṃ jñeya mapi vā bhāramātrakam .. 31 ..
meaning:
यद्दानं श्रद्धया पात्रे विधिवत्प्रतिपादितम् ..
तदनंतफलं ज्ञेय मपि वा भारमात्रकम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: Whatever gift is bestowed with faith upon a worthy recipient according to rule, / that should be known to yield endless fruit, even if it is only a weight of a bhāra.

sanskrit_iast:
ārteṣu dīneṣu guṇānviteṣu yaḥ śraddhayā svalpamapi pradadyāt ..
sa sarvakāmānsamupaiti lokāñcchraddhaiva dānaṃ pravadaṃti tajjñāḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
आर्तेषु दीनेषु गुणान्वितेषु यः श्रद्धया स्वल्पमपि प्रदद्यात् ..
स सर्वकामान्समुपैति लोकाञ्च्छ्रद्धैव दानं प्रवदंति तज्ज्ञाः .. 32 ..
text_mt: Whoever with faith gives even a very little to the afflicted, the wretched, and the virtuous, / he attains worlds where all desires are fulfilled; those who know the truth declare that faith itself is the gift.

sanskrit_iast:
śraddhā dānaṃ paraṃ jñeyaṃ śraddhā eva tapaḥ param ..
śraddhāṃ yajñamuśantīha śraddhā paramupoṣitam .. 33 ..
meaning:
श्रद्धा दानं परं ज्ञेयं श्रद्धा एव तपः परम् ..
श्रद्धां यज्ञमुशन्तीह श्रद्धा परमुपोषितम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: Faith is to be known as the supreme gift; faith alone is supreme asceticism; / here they declare faith to be sacrifice; faith is the supreme fast.

sanskrit_iast:
athāhiṃsā kṣamā satyaṃ hrīḥ śraddheṃdriyasaṃyamaḥ ..
dānamiṣṭaṃ tapo dhyānaṃ daśakaṃ dharmasādhanam .. 34 ..
meaning:
अथाहिंसा क्षमा सत्यं ह्रीः श्रद्धेंद्रियसंयमः ..
दानमिष्टं तपो ध्यानं दशकं धर्मसाधनम् .. 34 ..
text_mt: Now, non-violence, patience, truth, modesty, faith, restraint of the senses, / gift-giving, worship, asceticism, and meditation: this is the tenfold means of dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
haṃtavyastaiḥ samastairvā sūryadharmairanuṣṭhitaiḥ ..
sūryaukasāṃ ca saṃprāptergatirekā prakīrtitā .. 35 ..
meaning:
हंतव्यस्तैः समस्तैर्वा सूर्यधर्मैरनुष्ठितैः ..
सूर्यौकसां च संप्राप्तेर्गतिरेका प्रकीर्तिता .. 35 ..
text_mt: By all these practices of the dharma of the Sun when performed, [evil] is destroyed; / and for attaining the abode of the Sun, one single path is proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā bhūḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ śāṃtiratiśayaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
kuryātpuṇyaṃ mahattasmānmama lokepsayā sudhī .. 36 ..
meaning:
यथा भूः सर्वभूतानां शांतिरतिशयः स्मृतः ..
कुर्यात्पुण्यं महत्तस्मान्मम लोकेप्सया सुधी .. 36 ..
text_mt: Just as the earth is recalled as the utmost resting place of all beings, / so should the wise man perform great merit out of a desire for my world.

sanskrit_iast:
parastrīdravyasaṃkalpaṃ yaḥ sāpekṣaṃ karoti ca ..
gurumārtamaśaktaṃ vā videśe prasthitaṃ tathā ..
aribhiḥ paribhūtaṃ ca saṃtyajeccaiva pāpakṛt .. 37 ..
meaning:
परस्त्रीद्रव्यसंकल्पं यः सापेक्षं करोति च ..
गुरुमार्तमशक्तं वा विदेशे प्रस्थितं तथा ..
अरिभिः परिभूतं च संत्यजेच्चैव पापकृत् .. 37 ..
text_mt: He who looks covetously upon another’s wife and property, / or who, performing evil, abandons a guru who is afflicted or helpless, / or set out in a foreign land, or humiliated by enemies,

sanskrit_iast:
tadbhāryāmitraputreṣu yaścāvajñāṃ karoti ca ..
ityetatpātakaṃ jñeyaṃ guruniṃdāsamaṃ bhavet .. 38 ..
meaning:
तद्भार्यामित्रपुत्रेषु यश्चावज्ञां करोति च ..
इत्येतत्पातकं ज्ञेयं गुरुनिंदासमं भवेत् .. 38 ..
text_mt: and who shows disrespect toward his wife, friend, or sons— / this is to be known as a sin equal to reviling one’s guru.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaghnaśca surāpaśca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ ..
mahāpātakinastvete tatsaṃyogī ca pañcamaḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मघ्नश्च सुरापश्च स्तेयी च गुरुतल्पगः ..
महापातकिनस्त्वेते तत्संयोगी च पञ्चमः .. 39 ..
text_mt: The killer of a brāhmaṇa, the drinker of liquor, the thief, and he who violates the bed of his guru— / these are the perpetrators of great sins, and he who associates with them is the fifth.

sanskrit_iast:
krodhāddveṣādbhayāllobhādbrāhmaṇasya vadeta yaḥ ..
prāṇāṃtikaṃ mahādoṣaṃ brahmahā sa udāhṛtaḥ .. 1.189.40 ..
meaning:
क्रोधाद्द्वेषाद्भयाल्लोभाद्ब्राह्मणस्य वदेत यः ..
प्राणांतिकं महादोषं ब्रह्महा स उदाहृतः .. 1.189.40 ..
text_mt: He who out of anger, hatred, fear, or greed speaks against a brāhmaṇa / a grave accusation bringing death, he is declared a killer of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaṃ ca samāhūya yācamānamakiṃcanam ..
yannāstīti ca yo brūyātsa cāṇḍālaṃ udāhṛtaḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणं च समाहूय याचमानमकिंचनम् ..
यन्नास्तीति च यो ब्रूयात्स चाण्डालं उदाहृतः .. 41 ..
text_mt: And he who, having summoned a destitute brāhmaṇa who is begging, / says, 'There is nothing,' is declared an outcaste.

sanskrit_iast:
devadvijagavāṃ bhūmiṃ pūrvadattāṃ hareta yaḥ ..
pranaṣṭāmapi kāle tu tamāhurbrahmaghātakam .. 42 ..
meaning:
देवद्विजगवां भूमिं पूर्वदत्तां हरेत यः ..
प्रनष्टामपि काले तु तमाहुर्ब्रह्मघातकम् .. 42 ..
text_mt: He who takes away land previously given to gods, brāhmaṇas, or cows, / even if it has fallen into ruin over time, him they call a slayer of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
adhītya yo raverjñānaṃ parityajati maṃdadhīḥ ..
surāpena samaṃ jñeyaṃ tasya pāpaṃ ca suvrata .. 43 ..
meaning:
अधीत्य यो रवेर्ज्ञानं परित्यजति मंदधीः ..
सुरापेन समं ज्ञेयं तस्य पापं च सुव्रत .. 43 ..
text_mt: The dull-witted person who, having learned the knowledge of the Sun, abandons it— / his sin, O you of good vows, is to be known as equal to that of a drinker of liquor.

sanskrit_iast:
agnihotraparityāgaḥ paṃcayajñiyakarmaṇām ..
mātāpitṛparityāgaḥ kūṭasākṣyaṃ suhṛdvadhaḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
अग्निहोत्रपरित्यागः पंचयज्ञियकर्मणाम् ..
मातापितृपरित्यागः कूटसाक्ष्यं सुहृद्वधः .. 44 ..
text_mt: Abandonment of the agnihotra and of the rites of the five sacrifices, / abandonment of mother and father, false testimony, murder of a friend,

sanskrit_iast:
apriyaṃ sūryabhaktānāmabhakṣyasya ca bhakṣaṇam ..
evaṃ niraparādhānāṃ prāṇināṃ ca pramāraṇam .. 45 ..
meaning:
अप्रियं सूर्यभक्तानामभक्ष्यस्य च भक्षणम् ..
एवं निरपराधानां प्राणिनां च प्रमारणम् .. 45 ..
text_mt: displeasure toward devotees of the Sun, eating what is inedible, / and likewise the slaughter of innocent living beings—

sanskrit_iast:
sarvādhipatyameteṣāṃ nāsti devapurottame ..
ātmalokādhipatyaṃ tu yacchetsarvajatpatiḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
सर्वाधिपत्यमेतेषां नास्ति देवपुरोत्तमे ..
आत्मलोकाधिपत्यं तु यच्छेत्सर्वजत्पतिः .. 46 ..
text_mt: for these people there is no sovereignty over all in the supreme city of the gods; / rather, the Lord of all creatures grants them sovereignty only in their own world.

sanskrit_iast:
kecidatraiva mucyante jñānayogaparā narāḥ ..
āvartaṃte punaścānye saṃsāre bhogatatparāḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
केचिदत्रैव मुच्यन्ते ज्ञानयोगपरा नराः ..
आवर्तंते पुनश्चान्ये संसारे भोगतत्पराः .. 47 ..
text_mt: Some men, devoted to the yoga of knowledge, are liberated right here; / while others, devoted to worldly pleasures, turn back again into the cycle of existence.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādvimokṣamanvicchanbhogāsaktiṃ vivarjayet ..
viraktaḥ śāṃtacittātmā sauralokamavāpnuyāt .. 48 ..
meaning:
तस्माद्विमोक्षमन्विच्छन्भोगासक्तिं विवर्जयेत् ..
विरक्तः शांतचित्तात्मा सौरलोकमवाप्नुयात् .. 48 ..
text_mt: Therefore, one seeking liberation should abandon attachment to worldly pleasures; / detached, with a tranquil mind and self, he would attain the world of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
yaccāpyasaktahṛdayā japantīmaṃ prasaṃgataḥ ..
teṣāmapi vadatyekaḥ svānubhāvānurūpataḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
यच्चाप्यसक्तहृदया जपन्तीमं प्रसंगतः ..
तेषामपि वदत्येकः स्वानुभावानुरूपतः .. 49 ..
text_mt: And as for those who, with unattached hearts, chant this [hymn] on occasion, / the One declares for them as well according to their own spiritual power:

sanskrit_iast:
tannārcayanti ye bhānuṃ sakṛducchiṣṭadehinaḥ ..
teṣāṃ piśācaloke tu bhogānbhānuḥ prayacchati .. 1.189.50 ..
meaning:
तन्नार्चयन्ति ये भानुं सकृदुच्छिष्टदेहिनः ..
तेषां पिशाचलोके तु भोगान्भानुः प्रयच्छति .. 1.189.50 ..
text_mt: Those with impure bodies who do not worship the Sun even once— / to them the Sun gives worldly pleasures in the world of the piśācas.

sanskrit_iast:
dvirjapaṃti ca ye bhānuṃ krūrāḥ saṃkruddhalocanāḥ ..
rakṣoloke ravisteṣāṃ mahābhāgyaṃ prayacchati .. 51 ..
meaning:
द्विर्जपंति च ये भानुं क्रूराः संक्रुद्धलोचनाः ..
रक्षोलोके रविस्तेषां महाभाग्यं प्रयच्छति .. 51 ..
text_mt: Those who, being cruel and with enraged eyes, chant to the Sun twice— / to them the Sun grants great fortune in the world of the rakṣasas.

sanskrit_iast:
trirarcayanti ye bhānuṃ madyamāṃsaratā narāḥ ..
ṛṣiloke ravisteṣāṃ bhogāndivyānprayacchati .. 52 ..
meaning:
त्रिरर्चयन्ति ये भानुं मद्यमांसरता नराः ..
ऋषिलोके रविस्तेषां भोगान्दिव्यान्प्रयच्छति .. 52 ..
text_mt: Those men who, indulging in wine and meat, worship the Sun thrice— / to them the Sun grants divine pleasures in the world of the sages.

sanskrit_iast:
ye nṛtyagītaṃ kurvaṃti triścaturdhā yadṛcchayā ..
sūryasyāgre tu te yāṃti gaṃdharvabhavanaṃ khaga .. 53 ..
meaning:
ये नृत्यगीतं कुर्वंति त्रिश्चतुर्धा यदृच्छया ..
सूर्यस्याग्रे तु ते यांति गंधर्वभवनं खग .. 53 ..
text_mt: Those who spontaneously perform dance and song three or four times / before the Sun, O bird, go to the abode of the gandharvas.

sanskrit_iast:
lokāḥ khyātiṃ samuddiśya pūjayaṃti ca gopatim ..
teṣāṃ śakrālaye bhānuḥ kāmāntsarvānprayacchati .. 54 ..
meaning:
लोकाः ख्यातिं समुद्दिश्य पूजयंति च गोपतिम् ..
तेषां शक्रालये भानुः कामान्त्सर्वान्प्रयच्छति .. 54 ..
text_mt: People who worship the Lord of rays with an eye to fame— / to them the Sun grants all desires in the abode of Śakra.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmāsaktena cittena yaḥ ṣaḍarcayate ravim ..
prājāpatye ravistasya loke bhogānprayacchati .. 55 ..
meaning:
कामासक्तेन चित्तेन यः षडर्चयते रविम् ..
प्राजापत्ये रविस्तस्य लोके भोगान्प्रयच्छति .. 55 ..
text_mt: He who worships the Sun six times with a mind clinging to desire— / to him the Sun grants worldly pleasures in the world of Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast:
navakṛtvorcayedyastu citrabhānuṃ khagādhipa ..
sa yāti viṣṇusālokyaṃ viṣṇunā saha modate .. 56..
meaning:
नवकृत्वोर्चयेद्यस्तु चित्रभानुं खगाधिप ..
स याति विष्णुसालोक्यं विष्णुना सह मोदते .. 56..
text_mt: Whoever worships the Sun of variegated rays nine times, O king of birds, / goes to the same world as Viṣṇu and rejoices with Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādapi paraṃ sthānaṃ yadbhūtānāṃ manoharam ..
aprameyaguṇaidivyairvimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
तस्मादपि परं स्थानं यद्भूतानां मनोहरम् ..
अप्रमेयगुणैदिव्यैर्विमानैः सार्वकामिकैः .. 57 ..
text_mt: Higher even than that is the place delightful to living beings, / [endowed] with divine celestial chariots of immeasurable qualities, granting all desires,

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃkhyairvastubhirvyāptaṃ gairikai raktacitrakaiḥ ..
nānāgṛhasamākīrṇaiḥ sūryakoṭisamaprabham .. 58 ..
meaning:
असंख्यैर्वस्तुभिर्व्याप्तं गैरिकै रक्तचित्रकैः ..
नानागृहसमाकीर्णैः सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभम् .. 58 ..
text_mt: filled with countless objects, with red-coloured minerals, / crowded with various mansions, equal in splendour to ten million suns.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsthānaṃ te pragacchaṃti arcayanti ca ye dvijān ..
tatra loke khagaśreṣṭha vasaṃti viharaṃti ca ..
tasmādapi paraṃ sthānaṃ jyotiṣkaṃ sauramucyate .. 59 ..
meaning:
तत्स्थानं ते प्रगच्छंति अर्चयन्ति च ये द्विजान् ..
तत्र लोके खगश्रेष्ठ वसंति विहरंति च ..
तस्मादपि परं स्थानं ज्योतिष्कं सौरमुच्यते .. 59 ..
text_mt: To that place go those who worship brāhmaṇas; / in that world, O best of birds, they reside and sport; / higher even than that is declared the luminous realm of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sūryānubhāvena nikṛṣṭenāpi karmaṇā ..
naraiḥ sthānānyavāpyante śraddhābhāvānurūpataḥ .. ..1.189.60..
sauradharmeṣu sūryānūrusaṃvādavarṇanam
meaning:
एवं सूर्यानुभावेन निकृष्टेनापि कर्मणा ..
नरैः स्थानान्यवाप्यन्ते श्रद्धाभावानुरूपतः .. ..1.189.60..
सौरधर्मेषु सूर्यानूरुसंवादवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus, by the power of the Sun, even through lowly action, / places are attained by men according to the nature of their faith.
Description of the dialogue between Sūrya and Anūru concerning solar duties.

sanskrit_iast:
.. .. saptāśvatilaka uvāca .. ..
tārārūpavimānānāmimāḥ saṃti ca koṭayaḥ ..
yaḥ kuryāttu namaskāraṃ tasyaiva ca phalaṃ bhavet .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. .. सप्ताश्वतिलक उवाच .. ..
तारारूपविमानानामिमाः संति च कोटयः ..
यः कुर्यात्तु नमस्कारं तस्यैव च फलं भवेत् .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Saptāśvatilaka said:
There are crores of these celestial chariots having the form of stars.
Whoever pays homage [to them] obtains that very reward.
title: adhyāyaḥ 190

sanskrit_iast:
ityetā gatayaḥ proktā mahatyaḥ sauradharmiṇām ..
tasmātsauraḥ sadā dharmaḥ kartavyaḥ sukhamicchatā .. 2 ..
meaning:
इत्येता गतयः प्रोक्ता महत्यः सौरधर्मिणाम् ..
तस्मात्सौरः सदा धर्मः कर्तव्यः सुखमिच्छता .. 2 ..
text_mt:
In this way, these exalted destinies of those who follow solar duties have been declared.
Therefore, one who desires happiness should always practice the solar duty.

sanskrit_iast:
idānīṃ pāpanicayāḥ sthūlā narakahetavaḥ ..
te samāsena kathyante manovākkāyasādhanaiḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
इदानीं पापनिचयाः स्थूला नरकहेतवः ..
ते समासेन कथ्यन्ते मनोवाक्कायसाधनैः .. 3 ..
text_mt:
Now, the major accumulations of sin that cause hell,
committed by means of mind, speech, and body, are recounted in brief.

sanskrit_iast:
gavāṃ mārge vane cāgneḥ pure grāme samarpaṇam ..
ityetānīha pāpāni surāpānasamāni ca .. 4 ..
meaning:
गवां मार्गे वने चाग्नेः पुरे ग्रामे समर्पणम् ..
इत्येतानीह पापानि सुरापानसमानि च .. 4 ..
text_mt:
Setting fire to the path of cows, to a forest,
to a city, or to a village—
such sins as these in this world are considered equal to drinking liquor.

sanskrit_iast:
vane sarvasya haraṇaṃ narastrīgajavājinām ..
gobhūsamīpajātānāmoṣadhīnāṃ ca khecara .. 5 ..
meaning:
वने सर्वस्य हरणं नरस्त्रीगजवाजिनाम् ..
गोभूसमीपजातानामोषधीनां च खेचर .. 5 ..
text_mt:
Stealing everything in the forest, [stealing] men, women, elephants, and horses,
and medicinal plants that grow near cows or land, O bird,

sanskrit_iast:
candanāgurukarpūrakastūrīpaṭṭavāsasām ..
hastanyāsāpa haraṇaṃ rukmasteyasamaṃ smṛtam .. 6 ..
meaning:
चन्दनागुरुकर्पूरकस्तूरीपट्टवाससाम् ..
हस्तन्यासाप हरणं रुक्मस्तेयसमं स्मृतम् .. 6 ..
text_mt:
and the misappropriation of sandalwood, agarwood, camphor,
musk, and silk garments entrusted to one's hands is traditionally regarded as equal to stealing gold.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyānāṃ varayogyānāmākarṣaṇamasaṃgataḥ ..
putramitrakalatreṣu gamanaṃ bhaginīṣu ca .. 7 ..
meaning:
कन्यानां वरयोग्यानामाकर्षणमसंगतः ..
पुत्रमित्रकलत्रेषु गमनं भगिनीषु च .. 7 ..
text_mt:
Abducting maidens fit for a husband without due connection,
having intercourse with the wives of sons or friends, and with sisters,

sanskrit_iast:
kumārīsāhasaṃ ghoramaṃtyajastrīniṣevaṇam ..
savarṇāyāśca gamanaṃ gurutalpasamaṃ smṛtam .. 8 ..
meaning:
कुमारीसाहसं घोरमंत्यजस्त्रीनिषेवणम् ..
सवर्णायाश्च गमनं गुरुतल्पसमं स्मृतम् .. 8 ..
text_mt:
terrible violence against an unmarried girl, resorting to an outcaste woman,
and intercourse with a woman of one's own caste is regarded as equal to defiling the guru's bed.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpātakatulyāni pāpānyuktāni yāni tu ..
tāni pātakasaṃjñāni brūmahe copapātakam .. 9 ..
meaning:
महापातकतुल्यानि पापान्युक्तानि यानि तु ..
तानि पातकसंज्ञानि ब्रूमहे चोपपातकम् .. 9 ..
text_mt:
Now, those sins that have been stated as equal to the major sins
are designated as pātaka; and we also declare the secondary sins.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijāyārthaṃ pariśrutya na prayacchati yo dvija ..
sadbhāryāṇāṃ ca saṃtyāgaḥ sādhubandhutapasvinām .. 1.190.10 ..
meaning:
द्विजायार्थं परिश्रुत्य न प्रयच्छति यो द्विज ..
सद्भार्याणां च संत्यागः साधुबन्धुतपस्विनाम् .. 1.190.10 ..
text_mt:
A twice-born man who, having promised wealth to a twice-born man, does not give it;
the abandonment of good wives, of virtuous people, relatives, and ascetics;

sanskrit_iast:
gobhū hiraṇyavastrāṇāmapahāraḥ prayatnataḥ ..
īśvarārpitabuddhīnāṃ pīḍanaṃ sumahatkṛtam .. 11 ..
meaning:
गोभू हिरण्यवस्त्राणामपहारः प्रयत्नतः ..
ईश्वरार्पितबुद्धीनां पीडनं सुमहत्कृतम् .. 11 ..
text_mt:
the deliberate theft of cows, land, gold, and clothes;
inflicting great torment upon those whose intellects are dedicated to the Lord;

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ pīḍāmāśramasthāna ācaredalpikāmapi ..
tadbhūtyuparibhūtasya paśudhānyadhanasya ca .. 12 ..
meaning:
यः पीडामाश्रमस्थान आचरेदल्पिकामपि ..
तद्भूत्युपरिभूतस्य पशुधान्यधनस्य च .. 12 ..
text_mt:
he who commits even the slightest torment against a hermitage-dweller,
or against the cattle, grain, and wealth that constitute his prosperity;

sanskrit_iast:
kūpadhānyapaśusteyamayājyānāṃ ca yājanam ..
yajñārāmataḍāgānāṃ dārāpatyasya vikrayaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
कूपधान्यपशुस्तेयमयाज्यानां च याजनम् ..
यज्ञारामतडागानां दारापत्यस्य विक्रयः .. 13 ..
text_mt:
the theft of a well, grain, or cattle, officiating at sacrifices for those unfit to be sacrificed for,
the sale of sacrifices, pleasure gardens, ponds, wives, and children;

sanskrit_iast:
tīrtha yātropavāsānāṃ vrate ca japakarmaṇi ..
strīdhanānyupakarṣaṃti ye janāḥ pāpakarmaṇā .. 14 ..
meaning:
तीर्थ यात्रोपवासानां व्रते च जपकर्मणि ..
स्त्रीधनान्युपकर्षंति ये जनाः पापकर्मणा .. 14 ..
text_mt:
those people who, by wicked deeds, carry off women's property
during pilgrimages to sacred fords, fasts, votive observances, and rites of recitation;

sanskrit_iast:
arakṣaṇaṃ ca nārīṇāṃ madyapastrīniṣevaṇam ..
ṛṣīṇāmapradānaṃ ca dhānyavṛddhyupasevanam .. 15 ..
meaning:
अरक्षणं च नारीणां मद्यपस्त्रीनिषेवणम् ..
ऋषीणामप्रदानं च धान्यवृद्ध्युपसेवनम् .. 15 ..
text_mt:
neglecting to protect women, having intercourse with a woman who drinks liquor,
not making offerings to sages, and practicing usury on grain;

sanskrit_iast:
devāgnisādhusādhvīnāṃ nindā gobrāhmaṇasya ca ..
pratyakṣaṃ vā parokṣaṃ vā rājamāṇḍalikānapi .. 16 ..
meaning:
देवाग्निसाधुसाध्वीनां निन्दा गोब्राह्मणस्य च ..
प्रत्यक्षं वा परोक्षं वा राजमाण्डलिकानपि .. 16 ..
text_mt:
reviling gods, fire, virtuous men, chaste women,
cows, and brahmins, whether openly or behind their backs, as well as feudatory kings;

sanskrit_iast:
utsannapitṛdevāśca svakarmatyāginaśca ye ..
duḥśīlā nāstikāḥ pāpāḥ sadasacchūnyavādinaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
उत्सन्नपितृदेवाश्च स्वकर्मत्यागिनश्च ये ..
दुःशीला नास्तिकाः पापाः सदसच्छून्यवादिनः .. 17 ..
text_mt:
those by whom ancestors and gods are neglected, those who abandon their own duties,
the ill-behaved, atheists, sinners, and nihilists who argue about existence and non-existence;

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kāme pravṛtte tu viyonau paśuyoniṣu ..
rajasvalāsvayonau tu maithunaṃ yaḥ samācaret .. 18 ..
meaning:
एवं कामे प्रवृत्ते तु वियोनौ पशुयोनिषु ..
रजस्वलास्वयोनौ तु मैथुनं यः समाचरेत् .. 18 ..
text_mt:
likewise, when lust is aroused, he who engages in copulation
in an unnatural womb, among animals, with menstruating women, or in a non-generative orifice;

sanskrit_iast:
strīputramitrasaṃprīte rārāmocchedakāśca ye ..
janasyāpriyavaktāro janābhiprāyabhedinaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
स्त्रीपुत्रमित्रसंप्रीते रारामोच्छेदकाश्च ये ..
जनस्याप्रियवक्तारो जनाभिप्रायभेदिनः .. 19 ..
text_mt:
those who destroy pleasure gardens dear to wives, sons, and friends,
those who speak unpleasant words to people, and those who thwart people's intentions;

sanskrit_iast:
bhettā taḍāgavaprāṇāṃ saṃkramāṇāṃ rasasya ca ..
ekapaṃktisthitānāṃ ca paṃktibhedaṃ karoti yaḥ ..1.190.20..
meaning:
भेत्ता तडागवप्राणां संक्रमाणां रसस्य च ..
एकपंक्तिस्थितानां च पंक्तिभेदं करोति यः ..1.190.20..
text_mt:
he who breaches the embankments of ponds, bridges, or channels of liquid,
and he who creates a division in a line among those seated in a single row—

sanskrit_iast:
ityetaistu narāḥ pāpairupapātakinaḥ smṛtāḥ ..21..
saptāśvatilakāruṇasaṃvādam
meaning:
इत्येतैस्तु नराः पापैरुपपातकिनः स्मृताः ..21..
सप्ताश्वतिलकारुणसंवादम्
text_mt:
by these sins, men are traditionally considered to be guilty of secondary sins.
The dialogue between Saptāśvatilaka and Aruṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
.. saptāśvatilaka uvāca .. ..
ye gobrāhmaṇasasyānāṃ sādhūnāṃ tu tapasvinām ..
dūṣakāścaiva vartaṃte narā narakagāminaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सप्ताश्वतिलक उवाच .. ..
ये गोब्राह्मणसस्यानां साधूनां तु तपस्विनाम् ..
दूषकाश्चैव वर्तंते नरा नरकगामिनः .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Saptāśvatilaka said:
Those men who persist in abusing cows,
brahmins, crops, virtuous people, and ascetics go to hell.
title: adhyāyaḥ 191

sanskrit_iast:
pariśrameṇa tapyante ye'pare tasya sūcakāḥ ..
paradāraratānāṃ ca kanyāyā dūṣakāśca ye .. 2 ..
meaning:
परिश्रमेण तप्यन्ते येऽपरे तस्य सूचकाः ..
परदाररतानां च कन्याया दूषकाश्च ये .. 2 ..
text_mt:
Others who are distressed by another's toil, those who inform upon him,
those who delight in other men's wives, and those who deflower maidens;

sanskrit_iast:
goṣṭhāgnijalaramyāsu tarucchāyānageṣu ca ..
tyajaṃti ye purīṣāṇi ārāmā yataneṣu ca .. 3 ..
meaning:
गोष्ठाग्निजलरम्यासु तरुच्छायानगेषु च ..
त्यजंति ये पुरीषाणि आरामा यतनेषु च .. 3 ..
text_mt:
those who discharge excrement in cowpens, near fire, in pleasant waters,
in the shade of trees, on hills, in gardens, or in temples;

sanskrit_iast:
madyapānaratā nityaṃ gītavādyaratā narāḥ ..
kāmakrodhamadāviṣṭā raṃdhrānveṣaṇatatparāḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
मद्यपानरता नित्यं गीतवाद्यरता नराः ..
कामक्रोधमदाविष्टा रंध्रान्वेषणतत्पराः .. 4 ..
text_mt:
men who are constantly addicted to drinking liquor, devoted to singing and instrumental music,
possessed by lust, anger, and arrogance, intent upon seeking out [others'] vulnerabilities;

sanskrit_iast:
pākhaṇḍamatasaṃyuktā vṛthā saṃlāpa kautukāḥ ..
ye mārgānuparudhaṃti parasīmāṃ haraṃti ca .. 5 ..
meaning:
पाखण्डमतसंयुक्ता वृथा संलाप कौतुकाः ..
ये मार्गानुपरुधंति परसीमां हरंति च .. 5 ..
text_mt:
those endowed with heretical doctrines, eager for idle chatter,
those who obstruct pathways, and those who seize another's boundary;

sanskrit_iast:
kūṭaśāsanakartāraḥ kūṭakarmakṛto narāḥ ..
dhanuṣaḥ śilpiśastrāṇāṃ yaḥ kartā yaśca vikrayī .. 6 ..
meaning:
कूटशासनकर्तारः कूटकर्मकृतो नराः ..
धनुषः शिल्पिशस्त्राणां यः कर्ता यश्च विक्रयी .. 6 ..
text_mt:
men who forge royal edicts, who engage in deceitful practices,
and he who makes or sells bows, artisans' tools, or weapons;

sanskrit_iast:
nirdayotīvabhṛtyeṣu paśūnāṃ damakaśca yaḥ ..
mithyā pravadato vācamākarṇayati yaḥ śanaiḥ ..
svāmimitragurudrohī māyāvī capalaḥ śaṭhaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
निर्दयोतीवभृत्येषु पशूनां दमकश्च यः ..
मिथ्या प्रवदतो वाचमाकर्णयति यः शनैः ..
स्वामिमित्रगुरुद्रोही मायावी चपलः शठः .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ye bhāryāputramitrāṇi bālavṛddhakuśāturān ..
bhṛtyānatithibandhūṃśca tyajaṃti ca bubhukṣitān .. 8 ..
meaning:
ये भार्यापुत्रमित्राणि बालवृद्धकुशातुरान् ..
भृत्यानतिथिबन्धूंश्च त्यजंति च बुभुक्षितान् .. 8 ..
text_mt:
those who abandon their wives, sons, friends, children, the elderly,
the afflicted, servants, guests, and relatives while they are hungry;

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ svayaṃ pakvamaśnāti viprāyānnaṃ na yacchati ..
vṛthā pākaḥ sa vijñeyo brahmavādiṣu garhitaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
यः स्वयं पक्वमश्नाति विप्रायान्नं न यच्छति ..
वृथा पाकः स विज्ञेयो ब्रह्मवादिषु गर्हितः .. 9 ..
text_mt:
he who eats food cooked for himself and does not give food to a brahmin,
is to be known as one who cooks in vain, censured among the knowers of the Veda;

sanskrit_iast:
niyamaṃ svayamādāya ye tyajaṃtyajiteṃdriyāḥ ..
pravrajyāvasitā ye ca rahasyānāṃ tu bhedakāḥ .. 1.191.10 ..
meaning:
नियमं स्वयमादाय ये त्यजंत्यजितेंद्रियाः ..
प्रव्रज्यावसिता ये च रहस्यानां तु भेदकाः .. 1.191.10 ..
text_mt:
those who, lacking control over their senses, take a religious vow upon themselves and then abandon it,
those who lapse from ascetic wandering, and those who disclose secrets;

sanskrit_iast:
ye tāḍayaṃti gāṃ mūḍhāstrāsayaṃti muhurmuhuḥ ..
durbalaṃ na ca puṣṇaṃti pranaṣṭānnānviṣaṃti ca .. 11 ..
meaning:
ये ताडयंति गां मूढास्त्रासयंति मुहुर्मुहुः ..
दुर्बलं न च पुष्णंति प्रनष्टान्नान्विषंति च .. 11 ..
text_mt:
the fools who beat a cow and frighten it repeatedly,
who do not nourish a weak [cow], and who do not search for lost ones;

sanskrit_iast:
pīḍayaṃtyatibhāreṇa akṣayaṃ vāhayaṃti ca ..
vṛṣāṇāṃ vṛṣaṇānanye pāpiṣṭhā gālayaṃti hi ..
vāhayaṃti ca gāṃ vaṃdhyāṃ te pāpiṣṭhā narādhamāḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
पीडयंत्यतिभारेण अक्षयं वाहयंति च ..
वृषाणां वृषणानन्ये पापिष्ठा गालयंति हि ..
वाहयंति च गां वंध्यां ते पापिष्ठा नराधमाः .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
anarthavikalaṃ hīnaṃ bālavṛddhakṛśānugam ..
nānukaṃpaṃti ye mūḍhāste yāṃti narakaṃ narāḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
अनर्थविकलं हीनं बालवृद्धकृशानुगम् ..
नानुकंपंति ये मूढास्ते यांति नरकं नराः .. 13 ..
text_mt:
those foolish men who have no compassion for one who is destitute, distressed, destitute of resources,
or accompanied by children, the aged, or the emaciated—they go to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
ajāvikā māhiṣikāḥ savitrīvṛṣalīpatiḥ ..
kṣatraviṭśūdravṛddhāśca svadharmavihatāḥ sadā .. 14 ..
meaning:
अजाविका माहिषिकाः सवित्रीवृषलीपतिः ..
क्षत्रविट्शूद्रवृद्धाश्च स्वधर्मविहताः सदा .. 14 ..
text_mt:
Those who keep goats, sheep, or buffaloes, the husband of an outcaste woman who has borne children,
and the elders of kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, and śūdras who have perpetually ruined their own duties;

sanskrit_iast:
śilpinaḥ kārukā veśyāḥ kṣemakāranṛpadhvajāḥ ..
nartakyo jyotiṣi hatāḥ sarve narakagāminaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
शिल्पिनः कारुका वेश्याः क्षेमकारनृपध्वजाः ..
नर्तक्यो ज्योतिषि हताः सर्वे नरकगामिनः .. 15 ..
text_mt:
artisans, craftsmen, prostitutes, those who harm the welfare [of others] or bear the insignia of kings,
female dancers, and those ruined by astrology—all of these go to hell.
