text_mt: Tell me truly the reason why Brahmā and the others, headed by Rudra, [bow to him]. / Who is this Bhāskara, O Brahmin? Whence was he born, and who is he said to be?

sanskrit_iast:
kīrtayasva yathānyāyaṃ kautukaṃ hi paraṃ mama ..
kuśalo hi bhavāṃlloke tasmāttvaṃ vaktumarhasi .. 12 ..
meaning:
कीर्तयस्व यथान्यायं कौतुकं हि परं मम ..
कुशलो हि भवांल्लोके तस्मात्त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि .. 12 ..
text_mt: Proclaim it properly, for my curiosity is immense. / Indeed, you are skilled in the world; therefore, you ought to speak.

sanskrit_iast:
.. vyāsa uvāca .. ..
aho tava mahatkaṣṭaṃ pramūḍhosi na saṃśayaḥ ..
stuvaṃtaśca tamarcābhiḥ siddhā brahmādayaḥ surāḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
.. व्यास उवाच .. ..
अहो तव महत्कष्टं प्रमूढोसि न संशयः ..
स्तुवंतश्च तमर्चाभिः सिद्धा ब्रह्मादयः सुराः .. 13 ..
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Ah, great is your plight! You are bewildered, no doubt. / The Siddhas and the gods, Brahmā and the others, praise him with acts of worship.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmeva devānāmādirāditya ucyate ..
sa haṃti timiraṃ sarvaṃ digvidikṣu vyavasthitam .. 14 ..
meaning:
सर्वेषामेव देवानामादिरादित्य उच्यते ..
स हंति तिमिरं सर्वं दिग्विदिक्षु व्यवस्थितम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Āditya is called the first of all the gods. / He destroys all the darkness situated in the cardinal and intermediate directions.

sanskrit_iast:
sa dharmaḥ sarvadharmāṇāṃ sa ca pūjyatamo mataḥ ..
brahmādayastamarcaṃti sa cādistridivaukasām .. 15 ..
meaning:
स धर्मः सर्वधर्माणां स च पूज्यतमो मतः ..
ब्रह्मादयस्तमर्चंति स चादिस्त्रिदिवौकसाम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: He is the righteousness of all righteous duties, and he is considered the most worthy of worship. / Brahmā and the others worship him, and he is the beginning of the dwellers of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
aditiḥ kaśyapasatī ādityastena cocyate ..
ādikartātha vā yasmā ttasmādāditya ucyate .. 16 ..
meaning:
अदितिः कश्यपसती आदित्यस्तेन चोच्यते ..
आदिकर्ताथ वा यस्मा त्तस्मादादित्य उच्यते .. 16 ..
text_mt: Aditi was the virtuous wife of Kaśyapa, and therefore he is called Āditya; / or because he is the primeval creator (ādikartṛ), therefore is he called Āditya.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādetajjagatsarvamādityātsaṃpravartate ..
sadevāsuragaṃdharvaṃ sayakṣoragarākṣasam .. 17 ..
meaning:
तस्मादेतज्जगत्सर्वमादित्यात्संप्रवर्तते ..
सदेवासुरगंधर्वं सयक्षोरगराक्षसम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: Therefore, this entire universe proceeds from Āditya, / together with gods, asuras, and gandharvas, together with yakṣas, uragas, and rākṣasas.

sanskrit_iast:
rudropeṃdrau tatheṃdraśca brahmā dakṣotha kaśyapaḥ ..
ādityadevatāḥ sarve tathānye devadānavāḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
रुद्रोपेंद्रौ तथेंद्रश्च ब्रह्मा दक्षोथ कश्यपः ..
आदित्यदेवताः सर्वे तथान्ये देवदानवाः .. 18 ..
text_mt: Rudra, Upendra, as well as Indra, Brahmā, Dakṣa, and then Kaśyapa— / all have Āditya as their deity, as do the other gods and dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
mukhādbhūto viriṃcistu rudro vakṣasthalāttataḥ ..
upeṃdro dakṣiṇāddhastāddhātā vāmakarāttathā .. 19 ..
meaning:
मुखाद्भूतो विरिंचिस्तु रुद्रो वक्षस्थलात्ततः ..
उपेंद्रो दक्षिणाद्धस्ताद्धाता वामकरात्तथा .. 19 ..
text_mt: Viriñci arose from his mouth, and then Rudra from the region of his chest; / Upendra from his right hand, and Dhātṛ likewise from his left hand;

sanskrit_iast:
vāmapādatalāddakṣo dakṣiṇātkaśyapastathā ..
ityutpannāstathā cānye devāsuranarāḥ khagāḥ ..
tenāsau deva ādityaḥ sarvadeveṣu pūjitaḥ ..20..
meaning:
वामपादतलाद्दक्षो दक्षिणात्कश्यपस्तथा ..
इत्युत्पन्नास्तथा चान्ये देवासुरनराः खगाः ..
तेनासौ देव आदित्यः सर्वदेवेषु पूजितः ..20..
text_mt: Dakṣa from the sole of his left foot, and Kaśyapa from the right. / Thus were they born, and so too other gods, asuras, humans, and birds. / By that [creator], this god Āditya is worshipped among all gods.

sanskrit_iast:
.. bhīṣma uvāca .. ..
yadītthaṃ gīyate vīra digvidikṣu sa bhāskaraḥ ..
yadi tasya prabhāvoyaṃ pārāśarya jagatpateḥ ..21..
meaning:
.. भीष्म उवाच .. ..
यदीत्थं गीयते वीर दिग्विदिक्षु स भास्करः ..
यदि तस्य प्रभावोयं पाराशर्य जगत्पतेः ..21..
text_mt: Bhīṣma said: / If that Bhāskara is praised in this way in the cardinal and intermediate directions, O hero, / if this is the majesty of that lord of the universe, O son of Parāśara,

sanskrit_iast:
sa kimarthaṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ tu rākṣasaiḥ paribhūyate ..
dvijaiḥ saṃrakṣyate bhūyaścakravadbhramate punaḥ ..
rāhuṇā gṛhyate'grāhyastatkimarthaṃ dvijottama ..22..
meaning:
स किमर्थं त्रिसंध्यं तु राक्षसैः परिभूयते ..
द्विजैः संरक्ष्यते भूयश्चक्रवद्भ्रमते पुनः ..
राहुणा गृह्यतेऽग्राह्यस्तत्किमर्थं द्विजोत्तम ..22..
text_mt: why then is he overcome by rākṣasas at the three junctures of the day, / protected repeatedly by twice-borns, and turns again like a wheel, / and is seized by Rāhu, though unseizable? Why is that, O best of the twice-born?

sanskrit_iast:
..vyāsa uvāca .. ..
piśācoragarakṣāṃsi ḍākinīdānavāṃstathā ..
dakṣiṇāgnirdahetkrodhāttamākrāmati bhāskaraḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
..व्यास उवाच .. ..
पिशाचोरगरक्षांसि डाकिनीदानवांस्तथा ..
दक्षिणाग्निर्दहेत्क्रोधात्तमाक्रामति भास्करः .. 23 ..
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Piśācas, uragas, and rakṣases, as well as ḍākinīs and dānavas, / the southern fire burns in anger, and Bhāskara traverses them.

sanskrit_iast:
trisaṃdhyaṃ tu trayo devāḥ sānnidhyaṃ ravimaṃḍale ..
muhūrtasya prabhāvoyamasādhye dṛṣṭake tathā .. 24 ..
meaning:
त्रिसंध्यं तु त्रयो देवाः सान्निध्यं रविमंडले ..
मुहूर्तस्य प्रभावोयमसाध्ये दृष्टके तथा .. 24 ..
text_mt: At the three junctures of the day, the three gods are present in the disc of the sun. / This is the power of a muhūrta, and likewise when [a misfortune] seen is incurable.

sanskrit_iast:
tamekamevamuddiśya loke dharmaḥ pravartate ..
namaskṛte stute tasminsarve devā namaskṛtāḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
तमेकमेवमुद्दिश्य लोके धर्मः प्रवर्तते ..
नमस्कृते स्तुते तस्मिन्सर्वे देवा नमस्कृताः .. 25 ..
text_mt: Intending him alone, righteousness operates in the world. / When he is saluted and praised, all the gods are saluted.

sanskrit_iast:
trisandhyaṃ vasudhādevairbhāskarastriḥ praṇamyate ..
rāhurādityabiṃbasya sthitodhastānna saṃśayaḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
त्रिसन्ध्यं वसुधादेवैर्भास्करस्त्रिः प्रणम्यते ..
राहुरादित्यबिंबस्य स्थितोधस्तान्न संशयः .. 26 ..
text_mt: At the three junctures of the day, Bhāskara is bowed to thrice by the gods on earth. / Rāhu is situated below the disc of Āditya, without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
amṛtārthī vimānastho yāvatsaṃsravate'mṛtam ..
vimānāṃtaritaṃ biṃbamādiśedgrahaṇaṃ tataḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
अमृतार्थी विमानस्थो यावत्संस्रवतेऽमृतम् ..
विमानांतरितं बिंबमादिशेद्ग्रहणं ततः .. 27 ..
text_mt: Desiring nectar, he stands in a celestial chariot so long as the nectar flows down; / since the disc is obscured by the celestial chariot, an eclipse is then announced.

sanskrit_iast:
na kaściddharṣituṃ śakta ādityo dahate dhruvam ..
divārātrimuhūrtānāṃ jñānāyākramate raviḥ..28..
meaning:
न कश्चिद्धर्षितुं शक्त आदित्यो दहते ध्रुवम् ..
दिवारात्रिमुहूर्तानां ज्ञानायाक्रमते रविः..28..
text_mt: No one is able to overpower him; Āditya burns steadily. / Ravi traverses for the knowledge of days, nights, and muhūrtas.

sanskrit_iast:
nādityena vinā rātrirna dinaṃ na ca tarpaṇam ..
nādharmmo nātha vā dharmmastena dṛṣṭaṃ carācaram .. 29 ..
meaning:
नादित्येन विना रात्रिर्न दिनं न च तर्पणम् ..
नाधर्म्मो नाथ वा धर्म्मस्तेन दृष्टं चराचरम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: Without Āditya there is no night, no day, and no water-offering; / neither is there unrighteousness nor righteousness; by him the moving and unmoving is seen.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityaḥ pāti vai sarvamādityaḥ sṛjate sadā ..
etatsarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭaṃ bhavatā mama .. 30 .. ..
bhīṣmavyāsasaṃvādavarṇanam
meaning:
आदित्यः पाति वै सर्वमादित्यः सृजते सदा ..
एतत्सर्वं समाख्यातं यत्पृष्टं भवता मम .. 30 .. ..
भीष्मव्याससंवादवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Āditya indeed protects everything, Āditya creates perpetually. / All this has been fully recounted, which was asked of me by you.
Description of the Dialogue Between Bhīṣma and Vyāsa

sanskrit_iast:
.. bhīṣma uvāca .. ..
sa ādityo bhavedyena acirāttu varapradaḥ ..
tadahaṃśrotumicchāmi vipra māṃ brūhi tattvataḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. भीष्म उवाच .. ..
स आदित्यो भवेद्येन अचिरात्तु वरप्रदः ..
तदहंश्रोतुमिच्छामि विप्र मां ब्रूहि तत्त्वतः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Bhīṣma said: / Tell me truly, O Brahmin, for I wish to hear: / how does that Āditya quickly become a granter of boons?
title: adhyāyaḥ 199

sanskrit_iast:
.. vyāsa uvāca .. ..
pūjayā japahomena dhyānadhāraṇayā saha ..
sakalaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā taddīkṣā samayaṃ tathā .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. व्यास उवाच .. ..
पूजया जपहोमेन ध्यानधारणया सह ..
सकलं मण्डलं कृत्वा तद्दीक्षा समयं तथा .. 2 ..
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Through worship, recitation, and oblation, along with meditation and concentration, / having made the complete maṇḍala, and likewise having obtained its initiation

sanskrit_iast:
labdhvā rādhayate yastu bhaktyā tadgatamānasaḥ ..
tasya bhānurbhavedvīra acirāttu varapradaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
लब्ध्वा राधयते यस्तु भक्त्या तद्गतमानसः ..
तस्य भानुर्भवेद्वीर अचिरात्तु वरप्रदः .. 3 ..
text_mt: and vows, he who worships [him] with devotion, his mind fixed upon him— / for him, O hero, the Sun quickly becomes a granter of boons.

sanskrit_iast:
balasiddhiṃ mahadvīryaṃ pratāpaṃ ca svakāyanam ..
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca rūpaṃ saubhāgyasaṃpadam .. 4 ..
meaning:
बलसिद्धिं महद्वीर्यं प्रतापं च स्वकायनम् ..
धनं धान्यं सुवर्णं च रूपं सौभाग्यसंपदम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Attainment of strength, great valour, majesty, and a fine body of one's own, / wealth, grain, gold, beauty, and the wealth of good fortune,

sanskrit_iast:
ārogyamāyuḥ kīrtiṃ ca yaśaḥ putrāṃśca mānada ..
dadate nātra saṃdeho yasya tuṣṭo divākaraḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
आरोग्यमायुः कीर्तिं च यशः पुत्रांश्च मानद ..
ददते नात्र संदेहो यस्य तुष्टो दिवाकरः .. 5 ..
text_mt: health, lifespan, fame, renown, and sons, O giver of honour— / he grants these, there is no doubt, to one with whom the Day-maker is pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmamarthaṃ tathā kāmaṃ vidyāṃ mokṣaśriyaṃ tathā ..
dadate bhāskarastuṣṭo narāṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
धर्ममर्थं तथा कामं विद्यां मोक्षश्रियं तथा ..
ददते भास्करस्तुष्टो नराणां नात्र संशयः .. 6 ..
text_mt: Righteousness, wealth, desire, knowledge, and the splendour of liberation— / when pleased, Bhāskara grants these to men, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
saureṇa vidhinā tāta pūjayitvā divākaram ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti tathādityālayaṃ nṛpa .. 7 ..
meaning:
सौरेण विधिना तात पूजयित्वा दिवाकरम् ..
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति तथादित्यालयं नृप .. 7 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped the Day-maker according to the Saura rule, my dear, / a king obtains all desires, and likewise the abode of Āditya.

sanskrit_iast:
.. bhīṣma uvāca .. ..
saurasnānavidhiṃ brūhi sarahasyaṃ mahāmate ..
yena snāto'malo yāti naraḥ pūja yituṃ ravim .. 8 ..
meaning:
.. भीष्म उवाच .. ..
सौरस्नानविधिं ब्रूहि सरहस्यं महामते ..
येन स्नातोऽमलो याति नरः पूज यितुं रविम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Bhīṣma said: / Tell me, O highly intelligent one, the rule of Saura bathing together with its secret, / bathed by which, stainless, a man goes to worship Ravi.

sanskrit_iast:
.. vyāsa uvāca .. ..
haṃta te saṃpravakṣyāmi snānaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ..
śucau manorame sthāne saṃgṛhyāstreṇa mṛttikām ..9 ..
meaning:
.. व्यास उवाच .. ..
हंत ते संप्रवक्ष्यामि स्नानं पापप्रणाशनम् ..
शुचौ मनोरमे स्थाने संगृह्यास्त्रेण मृत्तिकाम् ..9 ..
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Well then, I shall tell you of the bath that destroys sins: / having gathered clay with the Astra [mantra] in a pure and pleasant place,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhisaṃgho hakārastu ṭarephophasamanvite ..
anenāstreṇa saṃgṛhya tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret .. 10..
meaning:
संधिसंघो हकारस्तु टरेफोफसमन्विते ..
अनेनास्त्रेण संगृह्य ततः स्नानं समाचरेत् .. 10..
text_mt: the juncture-conjunction, the syllable ha, combined with ṭa, the letter ra, and pha— / having taken it with this Astra [mantra], one should then perform the bath.

sanskrit_iast:
malasnānaṃ tataḥ paścāccheṣārdhena tu kārayet ..
bhāgatrayaṃ tu sārdhaṃ tu tṛṇapāṣāṇavarjitam .. 11 ..
meaning:
मलस्नानं ततः पश्चाच्छेषार्धेन तु कारयेत् ..
भागत्रयं तु सार्धं तु तृणपाषाणवर्जितम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Then, after that, one should cause the dirt-cleansing bath with the remaining half. / [Divide the clay into] three parts, free of grass and stones;

sanskrit_iast:
ekamastreṇa cālabhya tathānyaṃ bhāskareṇa tu ..
aṃgaṃ caiva tṛtīyena abhimaṃtrya sakṛtsakṛt .. 12 ..
meaning:
एकमस्त्रेण चालभ्य तथान्यं भास्करेण तु ..
अंगं चैव तृतीयेन अभिमंत्र्य सकृत्सकृत् .. 12 ..
text_mt: having smeared one [part] with the Astra [mantra], and another with the Bhāskara [mantra], / and [smearing] the body with the third, having consecrated [each] once;

sanskrit_iast:
japtvāstreṇa kṣipeddikṣu nirvighnaṃ tu jalaṃ bhavet ..
sūryatīrthe dvitīyena abhimaṃtrya sakṛtsakṛt .. 13 ..
meaning:
जप्त्वास्त्रेण क्षिपेद्दिक्षु निर्विघ्नं तु जलं भवेत् ..
सूर्यतीर्थे द्वितीयेन अभिमंत्र्य सकृत्सकृत् .. 13 ..
text_mt: having recited [the mantra], one should throw [water] in the directions with the Astra [mantra], and the water will become free from obstacles. / Having consecrated [the water] at the sacred bathing place of Sūrya with the second [mantra] once,

sanskrit_iast:
gu(mu)ṇḍayitvā tataḥ snāyāditi tīrtheṣu mānavaḥ ..
tūryaśaṃkhaninādena dhyātvā devaṃ divākaram .. 14 ..
meaning:
गु(मु)ण्डयित्वा ततः स्नायादिति तीर्थेषु मानवः ..
तूर्यशंखनिनादेन ध्यात्वा देवं दिवाकरम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: and having shaved his head, a man should then bathe in such sacred waters, / meditating on the god Divākara to the sound of trumpets and conches.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā rājopacāreṇa punarācamya yatnataḥ ..
snānaṃ kṛtvā tato bhīṣma maṃtrarājena saṃyutam .. 15 ..
meaning:
स्नात्वा राजोपचारेण पुनराचम्य यत्नतः ..
स्नानं कृत्वा ततो भीष्म मंत्रराजेन संयुतम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: Having bathed with royal offerings, and having sipped water again with care, / having then performed the bath, O Bhīṣma, accompanied by the king of mantras—

sanskrit_iast:
harephau biṃduyuktaśca tathānyo dīrghayā saha ..
mātrayā rephasaṃyukto hakāro biṃdunā saha .. 16 ..
meaning:
हरेफौ बिंदुयुक्तश्च तथान्यो दीर्घया सह ..
मात्रया रेफसंयुक्तो हकारो बिंदुना सह .. 16 ..
text_mt: ha and ra combined with a bindu, and another [ha] with a long / vowel, combined with ra, the letter ha with a bindu,

sanskrit_iast:
sakāraḥ savisargastu maṃtrarājo'yamucyate ..
tatastu tarpayenmaṃtrānsarvāṃstāṃstu karāgrajaiḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
सकारः सविसर्गस्तु मंत्रराजोऽयमुच्यते ..
ततस्तु तर्पयेन्मंत्रान्सर्वांस्तांस्तु कराग्रजैः .. 17 ..
text_mt: and the letter sa with a visarga—this is called the king of mantras. / Then one should gratify all those mantras with the tips of the fingers:

sanskrit_iast:
parvaṇāmūrdhvato devāḥ savyena munayastathā ..
pitaraścāpasavyena tadbījena pratarpayet.. .. 18 ..
meaning:
पर्वणामूर्ध्वतो देवाः सव्येन मुनयस्तथा ..
पितरश्चापसव्येन तद्बीजेन प्रतर्पयेत्.. .. 18 ..
text_mt: the gods above the finger-joints with the right hand, and the sages likewise; / and one should gratify the ancestors with the inverted hand using that seed-syllable.

sanskrit_iast:
yadgītaṃ pravaraṃ loke akṣarāṇāṃ manīṣibhiḥ ..
tadbiṃdusahitaṃ proktaṃ hṛdbījaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
यद्गीतं प्रवरं लोके अक्षराणां मनीषिभिः ..
तद्बिंदुसहितं प्रोक्तं हृद्बीजं नात्र संशयः .. 19 ..
text_mt: That which is praised by wise men as the foremost among syllables in the world, / that, accompanied by a bindu, is declared to be the heart seed-syllable, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā vāmakare hastāddhyātvā prājño vidhānavit ..
evaṃ snātvā vidhānena saṃdhyāṃ vandedvidhānataḥ .. 20 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा वामकरे हस्ताद्ध्यात्वा प्राज्ञो विधानवित् ..
एवं स्नात्वा विधानेन संध्यां वन्देद्विधानतः .. 20 ..
text_mt: Having placed [it] on the left hand from the hand, meditating, the wise man who knows the procedure, / having thus bathed according to rule, should worship the twilight juncture according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vidvānkṣipetpaścādbhāskarāyodakāṃjalim ..
japecca tryakṣaraṃ maṃtraṃ ṣaṇmukhaṃ vā yadicchayā .. 21 ..
meaning:
ततो विद्वान्क्षिपेत्पश्चाद्भास्करायोदकांजलिम् ..
जपेच्च त्र्यक्षरं मंत्रं षण्मुखं वा यदिच्छया .. 21 ..
text_mt: Then the wise man should offer cupped hands of water to the sun, / and should mutter at will the three-syllable mantra or the six-faced [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
maṃtrarājeti yaḥ pūrvaṃ tavākhyāto mayā nṛpa ..
paścāttīrthe tu maṃtrāṃstu saṃhṛtya hṛdayaṃ nyaset .. 22 ..
meaning:
मंत्रराजेति यः पूर्वं तवाख्यातो मया नृप ..
पश्चात्तीर्थे तु मंत्रांस्तु संहृत्य हृदयं न्यसेत् .. 22 ..
text_mt: O king, that mantra which was previously declared to you by me as the king of mantras— / withdrawing those mantras at the sacred water, he should then deposit them in the heart.

sanskrit_iast:
maṃtrairātmānamekatra kṛtvā hyarghyaṃ pradāpayet ..
raktacandanagaṃdhaistu śucisnāto mahītale .. 23 ..
meaning:
मंत्रैरात्मानमेकत्र कृत्वा ह्यर्घ्यं प्रदापयेत् ..
रक्तचन्दनगंधैस्तु शुचिस्नातो महीतले .. 23 ..
text_mt: Having united oneself by means of mantras, he should indeed offer the guest-gift; / having bathed purely on the earth with the fragrances of red sandalwood,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā maṇḍalakaṃ vittamekacitto vyavasthitaḥ ..
gṛhītvā karavīrāṇi saṃsthāpya tāmrabhājane .. 24 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा मण्डलकं वित्तमेकचित्तो व्यवस्थितः ..
गृहीत्वा करवीराणि संस्थाप्य ताम्रभाजने .. 24 ..
text_mt: having drawn a mandala, with focused mind and concentrated awareness, / taking oleander blossoms and placing them in a copper vessel,

sanskrit_iast:
tilataṃḍulasayuktaṃ kuśagandhodakena tu ..
raktacandanadhūpena yuktamarghyaṃ prasādhya tat .. 25 ..
meaning:
तिलतंडुलसयुक्तं कुशगन्धोदकेन तु ..
रक्तचन्दनधूपेन युक्तमर्घ्यं प्रसाध्य तत् .. 25 ..
text_mt: joined with sesame seeds and unhusked rice grains, with water of kuśa grass and scent, / combined with red sandalwood and incense, having prepared that guest-gift,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā śirasi tatpātraṃ jānubhyāmavaniṃ gataḥ ..
pūrvamaṃtreṇa saṃyuktamarghyaṃ dadyāttu bhānave ..26..
meaning:
कृत्वा शिरसि तत्पात्रं जानुभ्यामवनिं गतः ..
पूर्वमंत्रेण संयुक्तमर्घ्यं दद्यात्तु भानवे ..26..
text_mt: placing that vessel upon his head, having gone to the earth on both knees, / he should offer the guest-gift to the sun, accompanied by the previous mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
mucyate sarvapāpaistu yo hyevaṃ vinivedayet ..
yadyugādisahasreṇa vyatīpātaśatena ca .. 27 ..
meaning:
मुच्यते सर्वपापैस्तु यो ह्येवं विनिवेदयेत् ..
यद्युगादिसहस्रेण व्यतीपातशतेन च .. 27 ..
text_mt: He who presents [it] in this way is freed from all sins. / Whatever [fruit is attained] by a thousand beginnings of yugas and a hundred vyatīpātas,

sanskrit_iast:
ayanānāṃ sahasreṇa candrasya grahaṇe tathā ..
gavāṃ śatasahasreṇa yatphalaṃ jyeṣṭhapuṣkare ..
datte kurukulaśreṣṭha tadarghyeṇa phalaṃ labhet ..28..
meaning:
अयनानां सहस्रेण चन्द्रस्य ग्रहणे तथा ..
गवां शतसहस्रेण यत्फलं ज्येष्ठपुष्करे ..
दत्ते कुरुकुलश्रेष्ठ तदर्घ्येण फलं लभेत् ..28..
text_mt: by a thousand solstices, and at an eclipse of the moon, / [or] by the gift of a hundred thousand cows at Jyeṣṭhapuṣkara, O best of the Kuru lineage—that fruit he obtains through that guest-gift.

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣāmantravihīno'pi bhaktyā saṃvatsareṇa tu ..
phalamarghyeṇa vai vīra labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
दीक्षामन्त्रविहीनोऽपि भक्त्या संवत्सरेण तु ..
फलमर्घ्येण वै वीर लभते नात्र संशयः .. 29 ..
text_mt: Even one devoid of initiation and mantras, through devotion over one year, / obtains the fruit through the guest-gift, O hero; there is no doubt here.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ punardīkṣito vidvānvidhinārghyaṃ nivedayet ..
nāsāvutpadyate bhūmau sa layaṃ yāti bhāskare.. 30 ..
meaning:
यः पुनर्दीक्षितो विद्वान्विधिनार्घ्यं निवेदयेत् ..
नासावुत्पद्यते भूमौ स लयं याति भास्करे.. 30 ..
text_mt: Moreover, the wise man who is initiated and presents the guest-gift according to the rule, / is not reborn on earth; he attains dissolution in the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
iha janmani saubhāgyamāyurāgegyasaṃpadām ..
acirādbhavate vīra sa bhāryāsukhabhājanam..31..
meaning:
इह जन्मनि सौभाग्यमायुरागेग्यसंपदाम् ..
अचिराद्भवते वीर स भार्यासुखभाजनम्..31..
text_mt: In this birth he attains good fortune, long life, health, and prosperity; / before long, O hero, he becomes a vessel for the happiness of a wife.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa snānavidhiḥ prokto mayā saṃkṣepatastava ..
hitāya mānaveṃdrāṇāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ ..32.. ..
sauradharmavarṇanam
meaning:
एष स्नानविधिः प्रोक्तो मया संक्षेपतस्तव ..
हिताय मानवेंद्राणां सर्वपापप्रणाशनः ..32.. ..
सौरधर्मवर्णनम्
text_mt:
This rule of bathing has been declared in brief to you by me, / for the welfare of the lords of men, destroying all sins.
Description of the Saura duties

sanskrit_iast:
.. bhīṣma uvāca .. ..
kathitaste snānavidhirbrahmanvai pāpahārakaḥ ..
samyagbrahmarcanavidhiṃ pūjayiṣyāmi yena vai .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. भीष्म उवाच .. ..
कथितस्ते स्नानविधिर्ब्रह्मन्वै पापहारकः ..
सम्यग्ब्रह्मर्चनविधिं पूजयिष्यामि येन वै .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Bhīṣma said:
The rule of bathing has been told by you, O brāhmaṇa, which takes away sin; / [tell me] the proper rule of worshipping Brahmā, by which I may indeed worship him.
title: adhyāyaḥ 200

sanskrit_iast:
.. vyāsa uvāca .. ..
haṃta te saṃpravakṣyāmi vidhimādityapūjane ..
vivikte vijaya sthāne suprasanne suśobhane .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. व्यास उवाच .. ..
हंत ते संप्रवक्ष्यामि विधिमादित्यपूजने ..
विविक्ते विजय स्थाने सुप्रसन्ने सुशोभने .. 2 ..
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Come, I shall declare to you the rule regarding the worship of Āditya, / in a secluded place, an auspicious spot, very pleasant and beautiful.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedbhāskaraṃ mantrī saralīkṛtavigrahaḥ ..
bhadrāsanasamārūḍhaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ sādhakottamaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
पूजयेद्भास्करं मन्त्री सरलीकृतविग्रहः ..
भद्रासनसमारूढः प्राङ्मुखः साधकोत्तमः .. 3 ..
text_mt: The practitioner of mantras should worship the sun, having straightened his body; / seated upon an auspicious seat, facing east, being the best of practitioners,

sanskrit_iast:
astrabījena maṃtreṇa naraḥ svāṃgāni vinyaset ..
aṃguṣṭhamāditaḥ kṛtvā kaniṣṭhāntaṃ suvinyaset ..4..
meaning:
अस्त्रबीजेन मंत्रेण नरः स्वांगानि विन्यसेत् ..
अंगुष्ठमादितः कृत्वा कनिष्ठान्तं सुविन्यसेत् ..4..
text_mt: a man should deposit his limbs with the mantra of the weapon-seed; / starting from the thumb, he should properly deposit up to the little finger.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdayādīnphaḍantāṃstānvinyasetkramataḥ sadā ..
netrapāṇitale vīra nyasya arghyādi maṃtravit .. 5 ..
meaning:
हृदयादीन्फडन्तांस्तान्विन्यसेत्क्रमतः सदा ..
नेत्रपाणितले वीर न्यस्य अर्घ्यादि मंत्रवित् .. 5 ..
text_mt: He should always deposit in order those beginning with the heart and ending with phaṭ; / having deposited on the eye and the palm of the hand, O hero, he who knows mantras [should offer] the guest-gift and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
yavarge yacaturthaṃ tu karṇabiṃdusamanvitam ..
netrabījamiti proktaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ..6..
meaning:
यवर्गे यचतुर्थं तु कर्णबिंदुसमन्वितम् ..
नेत्रबीजमिति प्रोक्तं ज्योतीरूपं न संशयः ..6..
text_mt: That which is fourth in the ya-group, joined with the ear and the drop, / is declared to be the eye-seed, having the form of light, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
paścāttu tryakṣaraṃ sūryaṃ kavacaṃ vinyasedbudhaḥ ..
kathitaṃ tanmayā vīra maṃtrarājeti pṛcchataḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
पश्चात्तु त्र्यक्षरं सूर्यं कवचं विन्यसेद्बुधः ..
कथितं तन्मया वीर मंत्रराजेति पृच्छतः .. 7 ..
text_mt: Thereafter, the wise man should deposit the three-syllable solar armour; / that was declared by me, O hero, to you who asked about the king of mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kuryātprathamaṃ bījamudgiran ..
śeṣakrameṇa hutvāyaṃ viraje bhīṣmaśaktitaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
प्राणायामं ततः कुर्यात्प्रथमं बीजमुद्गिरन् ..
शेषक्रमेण हुत्वायं विरजे भीष्मशक्तितः .. 8 ..
text_mt: Then he should perform breath control, uttering the first seed; / having offered this in the remaining order into the stainless one, O Bhīṣma, according to his ability,

sanskrit_iast:
tribhireva tato ghorairātmaśuddhiḥ kṛtā bhavet ..
iti saṃśodhya cātmānaṃ sūryaṃ sarvāṃtikaṃ nyaset .. 9 ..
meaning:
त्रिभिरेव ततो घोरैरात्मशुद्धिः कृता भवेत् ..
इति संशोध्य चात्मानं सूर्यं सर्वांतिकं न्यसेत् .. 9 ..
text_mt: then purification of oneself will be accomplished by three dread [utterances] alone. / Having thus purified oneself, he should deposit the sun on all sides.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdaye hṛdayaṃ nyasya śiraḥ śirasi vinyaset ..
ekaviṃśatimātṛkāyā akṣaraṃ yatprakīrtitam .. 10 ..
meaning:
हृदये हृदयं न्यस्य शिरः शिरसि विन्यसेत् ..
एकविंशतिमातृकाया अक्षरं यत्प्रकीर्तितम् .. 10 ..
text_mt: Depositing the heart on the heart, he should deposit the head on the head; / that which is proclaimed as the syllable of the twenty-first mother,

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdbījamiti vikhyātaṃ brahmasthānamanaupamam..
śirasārkasya pūjā tu lokerkaḥ pratikathyate .. 11 ..
meaning:
हृद्बीजमिति विख्यातं ब्रह्मस्थानमनौपमम्..
शिरसार्कस्य पूजा तु लोकेर्कः प्रतिकथ्यते .. 11 ..
text_mt: is celebrated as the heart-seed, the incomparable place of Brahman; / the worship of the sun on the head is described in the world as the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
śikhāyāṃ tu śikhāṃ nyasyeccharīre kavacaṃ nyaset ..
netrayorvinyasennetraṃ karayorastrameva ca .. 12 ..
meaning:
शिखायां तु शिखां न्यस्येच्छरीरे कवचं न्यसेत् ..
नेत्रयोर्विन्यसेन्नेत्रं करयोरस्त्रमेव च .. 12 ..
text_mt: He should deposit the crest on the crest, and he should deposit the armour on the body; / he should deposit the eye on both eyes, and the weapon on both hands.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāvyāhṛtayo rājaṃstathārajvālinī śikhā ..
hakāraśca rakāraśca kukāro biṃdunā saha ..13 ..
meaning:
महाव्याहृतयो राजंस्तथारज्वालिनी शिखा ..
हकारश्च रकारश्च कुकारो बिंदुना सह ..13 ..
text_mt: The great utterances, O king, and also the blazing crest; / the syllable ha, the syllable ra, and the syllable ku together with the drop—

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣāṃ samayāścaiva kavacaṃ parikathyate ..
netrayorvinyasennetraṃ karayora strameva ca .. 14 ..
meaning:
एतेषां समयाश्चैव कवचं परिकथ्यते ..
नेत्रयोर्विन्यसेन्नेत्रं करयोर स्त्रमेव च .. 14 ..
text_mt: the convention of these is indeed declared to be the armour; / he should deposit the eye on both eyes, and the weapon on both hands.

sanskrit_iast:
evamaṃgāni vinyasya nāsau kenāpi bāddhyate ..
śatravo mitratāṃ yāṃti alābhe lābhamāpnuyāt ..15..
meaning:
एवमंगानि विन्यस्य नासौ केनापि बाद्ध्यते ..
शत्रवो मित्रतां यांति अलाभे लाभमाप्नुयात् ..15..
text_mt: Having deposited his limbs in this manner, he is not afflicted by anyone; / his enemies become friends, and in absence of gain he obtains gain.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānaṃ bhāskaraṃ jñātvā yathoktaṃ tattvadarśibhiḥ ..
tatastu pūjayedbhānuṃ sthaṃḍile vidhivatpunaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
आत्मानं भास्करं ज्ञात्वा यथोक्तं तत्त्वदर्शिभिः ..
ततस्तु पूजयेद्भानुं स्थंडिले विधिवत्पुनः .. 16 ..
text_mt: Knowing oneself to be the sun, as spoken by the seers of truth, / he should then worship the sun on a bare mound according to rule once more.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā tu dakṣiṇe pārśve divyapuṣpakaraṃḍakam ..
kṛtvā suśobhite vāme tāmrapūrṇena vāriṇā .. 17 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा तु दक्षिणे पार्श्वे दिव्यपुष्पकरंडकम् ..
कृत्वा सुशोभिते वामे ताम्रपूर्णेन वारिणा .. 17 ..
text_mt: Placing a basket of divine flowers on the right side, / and placing [a vessel] filled with water in copper on the beautiful left side,

sanskrit_iast:
astreṇa kṣālitāṃ pūrṇāṃ śeṣaṃ maṃtrairjalaistathā ..
abhimaṃtrya tataḥ sthāpya kavacenāvaguṃṭhitām .. 18 ..
meaning:
अस्त्रेण क्षालितां पूर्णां शेषं मंत्रैर्जलैस्तथा ..
अभिमंत्र्य ततः स्थाप्य कवचेनावगुंठिताम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: washed with the weapon[-mantra], filled, and consecrating the rest with mantras and waters, / and then placing it, veiled with the armour[-mantra],

sanskrit_iast:
sthaṃḍile caiva dravyāṇi pūjārthaṃ kalpitāni tu ..
sarvāṇi prokṣayedvidvānarghyapātraṃ jalena tu ..
tato maṃtraṃ japetpaścādekacittena maṃtravit ..19..
meaning:
स्थंडिले चैव द्रव्याणि पूजार्थं कल्पितानि तु ..
सर्वाणि प्रोक्षयेद्विद्वानर्घ्यपात्रं जलेन तु ..
ततो मंत्रं जपेत्पश्चादेकचित्तेन मंत्रवित् ..19..
text_mt: and the substances prepared on the mound for the sake of worship— / the wise man should sprinkle all of them with water from the guest-gift vessel; / then afterwards, he who knows mantras should mutter the mantra with one-pointed mind.

sanskrit_iast:
.. bhīṣma uvāca .. ..
purāṇasahitairmaṃtrairyo vidhiḥ kathito budhaiḥ ..20..
meaning:
.. भीष्म उवाच .. ..
पुराणसहितैर्मंत्रैर्यो विधिः कथितो बुधैः ..20..
text_mt:
Bhīṣma said:
The rule that is declared by the wise along with the mantras of the Purāṇas—

sanskrit_iast:
sa mayā viditaḥ kṛtsnaḥ kathito naikaśo dvijaiḥ ..
vedoktairvividhairmaṃtrairyathā saṃpūjyate raviḥ ..21 ..
meaning:
स मया विदितः कृत्स्नः कथितो नैकशो द्विजैः ..
वेदोक्तैर्विविधैर्मंत्रैर्यथा संपूज्यते रविः ..21 ..
text_mt: that is completely known to me, told repeatedly by the twice-born. / How the sun is worshipped with various mantras spoken in the Vedas,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā me brūhi sakalaṃ vaidikaṃ vidhisattamam .. 22 ..
sūryamaṇḍaladevatārcanavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
तथा मे ब्रूहि सकलं वैदिकं विधिसत्तमम् .. 22 ..
सूर्यमण्डलदेवतार्चनविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
tell me all of that, the supreme Vedic rule.
Description of the rule of worship of the deities of the solar disc

sanskrit_iast:
.. vyāsa uvāca ..
atha tvāṃ kathayiṣyehaṃ saṃvādaṃ dharmavarddhanam ..
surajyeṣṭhasya devasya keśavasya ca bhārata .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. व्यास उवाच ..
अथ त्वां कथयिष्येहं संवादं धर्मवर्द्धनम् ..
सुरज्येष्ठस्य देवस्य केशवस्य च भारत .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Now I shall tell you the dialogue that increases righteousness, / between the eldest of the gods and Keśava, O descendant of Bharata.
title: Sūryamaṇḍaladevatārcanavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
manovatyāṃ surajyeṣṭhaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ caturmukham..
praṇamya śirasā viṣṇuridaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 2 ..
meaning:
मनोवत्यां सुरज्येष्ठं सुखासीनं चतुर्मुखम्..
प्रणम्य शिरसा विष्णुरिदं वचनमब्रवीत् .. 2 ..
text_mt: Bowing his head to the four-faced eldest of the gods who was seated comfortably in Manovatī, / Viṣṇu spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
.. viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
bhagavandevadeveśa surajyeṣṭha caturmukha ..
ārādhanavidhiṃ brūhi bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
.. विष्णुरुवाच .. ..
भगवन्देवदेवेश सुरज्येष्ठ चतुर्मुख ..
आराधनविधिं ब्रूहि भास्करस्य महात्मनः .. 3 ..
text_mt:
Viṣṇu said:
O blessed one, ruler of the gods of gods, eldest of the gods, four-faced one, / tell me the rule of propitiation of the noble sun.

sanskrit_iast:
kathamārādhayedbhānuṃ maṃḍalasthaṃ divaspatim ..
brūhi me'tra gaṇaṃ devaṃ yenāhaṃ pūjaye vibhum .. 4 ..
meaning:
कथमाराधयेद्भानुं मंडलस्थं दिवस्पतिम् ..
ब्रूहि मेऽत्र गणं देवं येनाहं पूजये विभुम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: How should one propitiate the sun, the lord of day residing in his orb? / Tell me here the retinue, O god, by which I may worship the omnipresent lord.

sanskrit_iast:
sādhusādhu mahābāho sādhu pṛṣṭo' smi bhūdhara ..
śṛṇu caikamanā deva bhāskarārādhane vidhim ..5..
meaning:
साधुसाधु महाबाहो साधु पृष्टो' स्मि भूधर ..
शृणु चैकमना देव भास्कराराधने विधिम् ..5..
text_mt:
[Brahmā said:]
Well done, well done, O mighty-armed one! Well asked am I, O supporter of the earth! / Listen with one-pointed mind, O god, to the rule for propitiating the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
khaṣolkaṃ nirmalaṃ devaṃ pūjayitvā vibhāvasum ..
pūrve madhye tathāgneyyāṃ virūpākṣe prabhaṃ jane .. 6 ..
meaning:
खषोल्कं निर्मलं देवं पूजयित्वा विभावसुम् ..
पूर्वे मध्ये तथाग्नेय्यां विरूपाक्षे प्रभं जने .. 6 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped the spotless god Khaṣolka, who is the sun, / in the east, in the centre, likewise in the south-east, in Virūpākṣa, and in Prabhañjana,

sanskrit_iast:
krameṇa yāvadīśānīṃ hṛdi bījena vinyaset ..
khaṣolkāsanametattu vinyastaṃ mānavottamaiḥ .. 7..
meaning:
क्रमेण यावदीशानीं हृदि बीजेन विन्यसेत् ..
खषोल्कासनमेतत्तु विन्यस्तं मानवोत्तमैः .. 7..
text_mt: in order up to the north-east, he should deposit [them] in the heart with the seed; / this seat of Khaṣolka is deposited by the best of men.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastasyopariṣṭāttu hṛdayena tu kaṃcu kam ..
saptāvaraṇasaṃyuktamaṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam .. 8 ..
meaning:
ततस्तस्योपरिष्टात्तु हृदयेन तु कंचु कम् ..
सप्तावरणसंयुक्तमष्टपत्रं सकर्णिकम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Then, above it, with the heart-[mantra], [he should visualize] the lotus / endowed with seven coverings, eight petals, and a pericarp,

sanskrit_iast:
kesarālaṃbadevatvaṃ paṃcavarṇaṃ mahādbhutam ..
parīkṣābhūmividhivacchāstroktavidhinā kṛtam .. 9 ..
meaning:
केसरालंबदेवत्वं पंचवर्णं महाद्भुतम् ..
परीक्षाभूमिविधिवच्छास्त्रोक्तविधिना कृतम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: possessing divinity resting on the filaments, five-colored, very wonderful, / constructed according to the rite for testing ground, by the method enjoined in scripture.

sanskrit_iast:
dīptādi pūrvādārabhya yāvadīśānagocaram ..
nyasecchaktyaṣṭakaṃ maṃtrī madhyataḥ sarvatomukhīm .. 1.201.10 ..
meaning:
दीप्तादि पूर्वादारभ्य यावदीशानगोचरम् ..
न्यसेच्छक्त्यष्टकं मंत्री मध्यतः सर्वतोमुखीम् .. 1.201.10 ..
text_mt: Beginning from the east and proceeding to the northeast quarter, / the mantra-reciter should deposit the group of eight powers, [and] in the center Sarvatomukhī:

sanskrit_iast:
dīptā sūkṣmā jayā bhadrā vibhūtirvimalā tathā ..
amoghā vidyutā caiva navamī sarvatomukhī .. 11 ..
meaning:
दीप्ता सूक्ष्मा जया भद्रा विभूतिर्विमला तथा ..
अमोघा विद्युता चैव नवमी सर्वतोमुखी .. 11 ..
text_mt: Dīptā, Sūkṣmā, Jayā, Bhadrā, Vibhūti, as well as Vimalā, / Amoghā, and Vidyutā, and the ninth is Sarvatomukhī.

sanskrit_iast:
tata āvāhayedbhānuṃ sthāpayetkarṇikopari..
upasthānaṃ tu vai kṛtvā maṃtreṇānena suvrata .. 12 ..
meaning:
तत आवाहयेद्भानुं स्थापयेत्कर्णिकोपरि..
उपस्थानं तु वै कृत्वा मंत्रेणानेन सुव्रत .. 12 ..
text_mt: Then he should invoke the Sun and install him upon the pericarp; / and having performed homage with this mantra, O observer of good vows:

sanskrit_iast:
udutyaṃ jātavedasamiti maṃtraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
agniṃ dūtena maṃtreṇa anena viśvasuvrata ..13..
meaning:
उदुत्यं जातवेदसमिति मंत्रः प्रकीर्तितः ..
अग्निं दूतेन मंत्रेण अनेन विश्वसुव्रत ..13..
text_mt: "ud u tyaṃ jātavedasam" is proclaimed as the mantra. / With the mantra "agniṃ dūtam", O observer of vows for the world,

sanskrit_iast:
ākṛṣṇena rajasā maṃtreṇānena cārcayet ..
haṃsaḥśuciṣaditi ca maṃtreṇārkaṃ prapūjayet .. 14 ..
meaning:
आकृष्णेन रजसा मंत्रेणानेन चार्चयेत् ..
हंसःशुचिषदिति च मंत्रेणार्कं प्रपूजयेत् .. 14 ..
text_mt: and with this mantra, "ākṛṣṇena rajasā", he should worship [him]; / and with the mantra "haṃsaḥ śuciṣat" he should worship the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
apaptetārakaṃ devīdīptānena prapūjayet ..
adṛśramasyaketavaḥ sūkṣmāṃ devīṃ samarcayet .. 15..
meaning:
अपप्तेतारकं देवीदीप्तानेन प्रपूजयेत् ..
अदृश्रमस्यकेतवः सूक्ष्मां देवीं समर्चयेत् .. 15..
text_mt: With "apaptat tārakaḥ" he should worship the goddess Dīptā; / with "adṛśram asya ketavaḥ" he should worship the goddess Sūkṣmā;

sanskrit_iast:
taraṇirviśvadarśeti anena satataṃ jayam ..
pratyaṅdevānāṃ viśeti bhadrāṃ devīṃ samarcayet .. 16 ..
meaning:
तरणिर्विश्वदर्शेति अनेन सततं जयम् ..
प्रत्यङ्देवानां विशेति भद्रां देवीं समर्चयेत् .. 16 ..
text_mt: with "taraṇir viśvadarśataḥ" [he should worship] Jayā perpetually; / with "pratyaṅ devānāṃ viśaḥ" he should worship the goddess Bhadrā;

sanskrit_iast:
vibhūtimarcayennityaṃ yenāpāvakacakṣasā ..
vidyāmeṣīti maṃtreṇa hyanena vimalāṃ sadā .. 17 ..
meaning:
विभूतिमर्चयेन्नित्यं येनापावकचक्षसा ..
विद्यामेषीति मंत्रेण ह्यनेन विमलां सदा .. 17 ..
text_mt: with "yena pāvaka cakṣasā" he should perpetually worship Vibhūti; / and with this mantra, "vidyām eṣi", always [worship] Vimalā;

sanskrit_iast:
amoghāṃ pūjayennityaṃ maṃtreṇānena suvrata..
navamīṃ pūjayeddevīṃ satataṃ sarvatomukhīm .. 18 ..
meaning:
अमोघां पूजयेन्नित्यं मंत्रेणानेन सुव्रत..
नवमीं पूजयेद्देवीं सततं सर्वतोमुखीम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: he should perpetually worship Amoghā with this mantra, O observer of good vows; / [and] he should always worship the ninth goddess, Sarvatomukhī.

sanskrit_iast:
maṃtreṇānena kṛṣṇasya udvayaṃtamitīha ca ..
udyannadyamitrahomaṃ prathamamakṣaraṃ vrajet.. 19 ..
meaning:
मंत्रेणानेन कृष्णस्य उद्वयंतमितीह च ..
उद्यन्नद्यमित्रहोमं प्रथममक्षरं व्रजेत्.. 19 ..
text_mt: With this mantra of Kṛṣṇa, "ud vayaṃ tamasas pari"; / [and] "udyann adya mitramahaḥ", he should proceed to the first syllable.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyaṃ pūjayetkṛṣṇaṃ śukleṣu harimāhave ..
udagādayamādityo anenāpi tṛtīyakam .. 1.201.20 ..
meaning:
द्वितीयं पूजयेत्कृष्णं शुक्लेषु हरिमाहवे ..
उदगादयमादित्यो अनेनापि तृतीयकम् .. 1.201.20 ..
text_mt: He should worship the second, the dark Hari among the white, in the battle; / with "ud agād ayam ādityaḥ" [he should worship] the third also;

sanskrit_iast:
tatsaviturvareṇyeti caturthaṃ parikīrtitam ..
mahitomahitoyeti paṃcarcaṃ parikīrtayet .. 21 ..
meaning:
तत्सवितुर्वरेण्येति चतुर्थं परिकीर्तितम् ..
महितोमहितोयेति पंचर्चं परिकीर्तयेत् .. 21 ..
text_mt: "tat savitur vareṇyam" is proclaimed as the fourth; / he should recite the five-verse hymn, "mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca naḥ";

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatā ṣaṣṭhaṃ bījaṃ prakīrtitam ..
savitā paścātātpurastātsaptamaṃ devasattama .. 22 ..
meaning:
हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्तता षष्ठं बीजं प्रकीर्तितम् ..
सविता पश्चातात्पुरस्तात्सप्तमं देवसत्तम .. 22 ..
text_mt: "hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre" is proclaimed as the sixth seed-[mantra]; / "savitā paścāt savitā purastāt" is the seventh, O best of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ bījāni vinyasya ādityaṃ sthāpayeddvijaḥ ..
ādityaṃ sthāpayeddhyāne sarveṣāṃ pūjayedbudhaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
एवं बीजानि विन्यस्य आदित्यं स्थापयेद्द्विजः ..
आदित्यं स्थापयेद्ध्याने सर्वेषां पूजयेद्बुधः .. 23 ..
text_mt: Having thus deposited the seed-mantras, the twice-born should install Āditya; / the wise man should establish Āditya in meditation and worship [him] before all;

sanskrit_iast:
bāhyato devaśārdūla indrādīnāṃ samaṃtataḥ..
raktavarṇaṃ mahātejaṃ sitapadmopari sthitam..24..
meaning:
बाह्यतो देवशार्दूल इन्द्रादीनां समंततः..
रक्तवर्णं महातेजं सितपद्मोपरि स्थितम्..24..
text_mt: on the outside, O tiger among gods, [the deities] headed by Indra all around: / red-colored, of great splendor, seated upon a white lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam..
dvibhujaṃ caikacakraṃ ca saumyaṃ padmadhanuṣkaram..25..
meaning:
सर्वलक्षणसंयुक्तं सर्वाभरणभूषितम्..
द्विभुजं चैकचक्रं च सौम्यं पद्मधनुष्करम्..25..
text_mt: endowed with all auspicious marks, adorned with all ornaments, / two-armed and one-wheeled, gentle, with lotus and bow in hand,

sanskrit_iast:
vartulaṃ tena biṃbena madhyasthamatitejasam..
ādityasya tvidaṃ rūpaṃ sarvalokeṣu pūjitam..26..
meaning:
वर्तुलं तेन बिंबेन मध्यस्थमतितेजसम्..
आदित्यस्य त्विदं रूपं सर्वलोकेषु पूजितम्..26..
text_mt: standing in the middle with that circular orb, exceeding in radiance. / This form of Āditya is worshipped in all the worlds;

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvā saṃpūjayennityaṃ sthaṃḍilaṃ maṃḍalāśritam..27.. ..
ādityapūjāvidhivarṇanam
meaning:
ध्यात्वा संपूजयेन्नित्यं स्थंडिलं मंडलाश्रितम्..27.. ..
आदित्यपूजाविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
having meditated [on him], he should constantly worship him on the altar resting on the diagram.
Description of the Rite of Worshipping Āditya

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
maṇḍalasthaṃ suraśreṣṭha vidhinā yena bhāskaram ..
pūjayenmānavo bhaktyā sa vidhiḥ kathyatāṃ mama .. 1 ..
meaning:
विष्णुरुवाच .. ..
मण्डलस्थं सुरश्रेष्ठ विधिना येन भास्करम् ..
पूजयेन्मानवो भक्त्या स विधिः कथ्यतां मम .. 1 ..
text_mt: Viṣṇu said: / O best of gods, tell me that rite by which rite / a mortal may worship Bhāskara situated in the maṇḍala with devotion.
title: Ādityapūjāvidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedvidhinā yena bhāskaraṃ padmasaṃbhavam ..
mūrtisthaṃ sarvagaṃ devaṃ pūjitaṃ sasurāsuraiḥ ..2..
meaning:
पूजयेद्विधिना येन भास्करं पद्मसंभवम् ..
मूर्तिस्थं सर्वगं देवं पूजितं ससुरासुरैः ..2..
text_mt: By which rite should one worship Bhāskara, who arose from a lotus, / the omnipresent god dwelling in an image, worshipped by gods and asuras together?

sanskrit_iast:
.. brahmovāca ..
sādhu kṛṣṇa mahābāho sādhu pṛṣṭo'smi suvrata ..
śṛṇu caikamanāḥ pūrvaṃ mūrtisthaṃ yena pūjayet .. 3 ..
meaning:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच ..
साधु कृष्ण महाबाहो साधु पृष्टोऽस्मि सुव्रत ..
शृणु चैकमनाः पूर्वं मूर्तिस्थं येन पूजयेत् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Well said, O long-armed Kṛṣṇa, well asked of me, O observer of good vows! / Listen with single-pointed mind how one should previously worship [him] dwelling in an image.

sanskrit_iast:
iṣe tveti ca mantreṇa uttamāṃgaṃ sadārcayet ..
agnimīḻeti mantreṇa pūjayeddakṣiṇe kare ..4..
meaning:
इषे त्वेति च मन्त्रेण उत्तमांगं सदार्चयेत् ..
अग्निमीḻएति मन्त्रेण पूजयेद्दक्षिणे करे ..4..
text_mt: With the mantra "iṣe tvorje tvā" he should constantly worship the head; / with the mantra "agnim īḷe purohitam" he should worship the right hand;

sanskrit_iast:
agna āyāhi mantreṇa pādau devasya pūjayet ..
ājighreti ca maṃtreṇa pūjayetpuṣpamālayā ..5..
meaning:
अग्न आयाहि मन्त्रेण पादौ देवस्य पूजयेत् ..
आजिघ्रेति च मंत्रेण पूजयेत्पुष्पमालया ..5..
text_mt: with the mantra "agna ā yāhi vītaye" he should worship the two feet of the god; / with the mantra "ājighra kalaśam" he should worship with a garland of flowers;

sanskrit_iast:
yogayogati maṃtreṇa muktapuṣpāṃjaliṃ kṣipet ..
samudraṃ gaccha yatproktamanena snāpayedravim .. 6 ..
meaning:
योगयोगति मंत्रेण मुक्तपुष्पांजलिं क्षिपेत् ..
समुद्रं गच्छ यत्प्रोक्तमनेन स्नापयेद्रविम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: with the mantra "yoge yoge" he should throw an open handful of flowers; / with that which is proclaimed as "samudraṃ gaccha svāhā", he should bathe the Sun;

sanskrit_iast:
imaṃ me gaṃgeti yatproktamanenāpi ca bhūdhara ..
samudrajyeti mantreṇa kaṣāyaiḥ parirūpayet.. 7 ..
meaning:
इमं मे गंगेति यत्प्रोक्तमनेनापि च भूधर ..
समुद्रज्येति मन्त्रेण कषायैः परिरूपयेत्.. 7 ..
text_mt: and also with that which is proclaimed as "imaṃ me gaṅge", O supporter of the earth; / with the mantra "samudrajyeṣṭhāḥ" he should wash [him] with astringent decoctions.

sanskrit_iast:
snāpayetpayasā kṛṣṇa āpyāyasveti mantrataḥ ..
dadhikrāvṇeti vai dadhnā snāpayeddadhivadravim .. 8 ..
meaning:
स्नापयेत्पयसा कृष्ण आप्यायस्वेति मन्त्रतः ..
दधिक्राव्णेति वै दध्ना स्नापयेद्दधिवद्रविम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: He should bathe [him] with milk, O Kṛṣṇa, by the mantra "āpyāyasva"; / with curd, by "dadhikrāvṇo", he should bathe the Sun like curd.

sanskrit_iast:
tejo'si śukramiti ca ghṛtena snapanaṃ param..
yā auṣadhīti maṃtreṇa snānamoṣadhibhiḥ smṛtam .. 9 ..
meaning:
तेजोऽसि शुक्रमिति च घृतेन स्नपनं परम्..
या औषधीति मंत्रेण स्नानमोषधिभिः स्मृतम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: And with "tejo 'si śukram" the bathing with clarified butter is the highest; / with the mantra "yā oṣadhīḥ" the bath with herbs is taught.

sanskrit_iast:
udvartayettato dvipadābhiḥ surādhipa ..
mānastoketi mantreṇa yugapatsnānamācaret..10..
meaning:
उद्वर्तयेत्ततो द्विपदाभिः सुराधिप ..
मानस्तोकेति मन्त्रेण युगपत्स्नानमाचरेत्..10..
text_mt: Then he should rub [him] with the two-footed verses, O lord of gods; / with the mantra "mā nas toke" he should perform the simultaneous bath.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇorarāṭamantreṇa snāpayedgandhavāriṇā..
sauvarṇena tu maṃtreṇa arghyaṃ pādyaṃ nivedayet..11..
meaning:
विष्णोरराटमन्त्रेण स्नापयेद्गन्धवारिणा..
सौवर्णेन तु मंत्रेण अर्घ्यं पाद्यं निवेदयेत्..11..
text_mt: With the mantra "viṣṇor arāṭam asi" he should bathe him with fragrant water; / with the golden mantra he should offer the guest-offering and the water for washing the feet.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame maṃtreṇārghyaṃ pradāpayet..
vedo'sīti hi maṃtreṇa upavītaṃ pradāpayet..12..
meaning:
इदं विष्णुर्विचक्रमे मंत्रेणार्घ्यं प्रदापयेत्..
वेदोऽसीति हि मंत्रेण उपवीतं प्रदापयेत्..12..
text_mt: With the mantra "idaṃ viṣṇur vi cakrame" he should present the guest-offering; / with the mantra "vedo 'si" indeed he should present the sacred thread.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspateti mantreṇa dadyādvastrāṇi bhānave..
yena śriyaṃ prakurvāṇāṃ puṣpamālāṃ prayojayet..13..
meaning:
बृहस्पतेति मन्त्रेण दद्याद्वस्त्राणि भानवे..
येन श्रियं प्रकुर्वाणां पुष्पमालां प्रयोजयेत्..13..
text_mt: With the mantra "bṛhaspate" he should give garments to the Sun; / with "yena śriyam" he should apply a blooming garland of flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
dhūrasīti ca mantreṇa dhūpaṃ dadyātsaguggulam..
samiddhoṃ'janamaṃtreṇa aṃjanaṃ tu prayacchati..14..
meaning:
धूरसीति च मन्त्रेण धूपं दद्यात्सगुग्गुलम्..
समिद्धोंऽजनमंत्रेण अंजनं तु प्रयच्छति..14..
text_mt: With the mantra "dhūr asi" he should give incense accompanied with bdellium; / with the mantra "samiddho añjan" he presents collyrium.

sanskrit_iast:
yuñjānīti ca maṃtreṇa bhānuṃ rocanayārcayet ..
āraktakaṃ ca vai kuryāddīrghāyuṣṭvāya vai budhaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
युञ्जानीति च मंत्रेण भानुं रोचनयार्चयेत् ..
आरक्तकं च वै कुर्याद्दीर्घायुष्ट्वाय वै बुधः .. 15 ..
text_mt: With the mantra "yuñjānāḥ" he should worship the Sun with yellow orpiment; / and the wise man should apply red paste for longevity.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣo raviṃ sarasi pūjayet ..
saṃbhāvayeti maṃtreṇa padmanetre parāmṛśet .. 16 ..
meaning:
सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषो रविं सरसि पूजयेत् ..
संभावयेति मंत्रेण पद्मनेत्रे परामृशेत् .. 16 ..
text_mt: With "sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ" he should worship the Sun in the pool; / with the mantra "saṃbhāvaya" he should touch his two lotus eyes;

sanskrit_iast:
viśvataścakṣurityevaṃ bhānordehaṃ samālabhet ..
śrīśca te lakṣmīśceti maṃtreṇānena pūjayet .. 17 ..
bhāskarārādhanavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
विश्वतश्चक्षुरित्येवं भानोर्देहं समालभेत् ..
श्रीश्च ते लक्ष्मीश्चेति मंत्रेणानेन पूजयेत् .. 17 ..
भास्कराराधनविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
with "viśvataścakṣuḥ" he should anoint the body of the Sun; / and with this mantra, "śrīś ca te lakṣmīś ca", he should worship him.
Description of the Rite of Adoration of Bhāskara

sanskrit_iast:
.. viṣṇuruvāca ..
vyomapūjāvidhiṃ brūhi samāsāccaturānana ..
aṣṭaśṛṃgaṃ kathaṃ vyoma pūjayedbhāskarasya tu .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. विष्णुरुवाच ..
व्योमपूजाविधिं ब्रूहि समासाच्चतुरानन ..
अष्टशृंगं कथं व्योम पूजयेद्भास्करस्य तु .. 1 ..
text_mt: Viṣṇu said: / Tell succinctly the rite of worshipping the vault, O four-faced one; / how should one worship the eight-peaked vault of Bhāskara?
title: Bhāskarārādhanavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
vyomapūjāvidhiṃ kṛṣṇa nibodha gadato mama ..
aṣṭaśṛṃgaṃ yathā vyoma pūjayaṃti manīṣiṇaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
व्योमपूजाविधिं कृष्ण निबोध गदतो मम ..
अष्टशृंगं यथा व्योम पूजयंति मनीषिणः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Learn from me speaking, O Kṛṣṇa, the rite of worshipping the vault, / how wise men worship the eight-peaked vault.

sanskrit_iast:
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ kṛtvā cāśmamayaṃ tathā ..
aṣṭaśṛṃgaṃ mahābāho anena vidhinārcayet .. 3 ..
meaning:
सौवर्णं राजतं ताम्रं कृत्वा चाश्ममयं तथा ..
अष्टशृंगं महाबाहो अनेन विधिनार्चयेत् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Having made [it] of gold, of silver, of copper, and likewise of stone, / the eight-peaked [altar], O long-armed one, one should worship by this rite.

sanskrit_iast:
prathamaṃ pūjayedbhānuṃ madhye maṃtreṇa suvrata ..
mahiṣā vo mahāyeti nānāpuṣpakadaṃbakaiḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
प्रथमं पूजयेद्भानुं मध्ये मंत्रेण सुव्रत ..
महिषा वो महायेति नानापुष्पकदंबकैः .. 4 ..
text_mt: First he should worship the Sun in the center with the mantra, O observer of good vows, / "mahiṣo vo mahāyate", with various clusters of flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
trātāramiṃdraṃ maṃtreṇa sarvaśṛṃgaṃ sadārcayet ..
udīratāmavara ityatha vānena pūjayet .. 5 ..
meaning:
त्रातारमिंद्रं मंत्रेण सर्वशृंगं सदार्चयेत् ..
उदीरतामवर इत्यथ वानेन पूजयेत् .. 5 ..
text_mt: With the mantra "trātāram indram" he should constantly worship all the peaks; / or alternatively, with "ud īratām avare", he should worship with this.

sanskrit_iast:
āyaṃ gauriti mantreṇa nairṛ(kṛ)taṃ śṛṃgamarcayet ..
rakṣohaṇaṃ vājinaṃ vā pūjayedasurāṃtakam .. 6 ..
meaning:
आयं गौरिति मन्त्रेण नैरृ(कृ)तं शृंगमर्चयेत् ..
रक्षोहणं वाजिनं वा पूजयेदसुरांतकम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: With the mantra “āyaṃ gauḥ,” one should worship the southwestern peak; / or one should worship the slayer of demons with “rakṣohaṇaṃ vājinaṃ.”

sanskrit_iast:
indrasomāṃtapataye hyatha vānena pūjayet ..
abhitvā śūra no numa aiśānaṃ śṛṃgamarcayet .. 7 ..
meaning:
इन्द्रसोमांतपतये ह्यथ वानेन पूजयेत् ..
अभित्वा शूर नो नुम ऐशानं शृंगमर्चयेत् .. 7 ..
text_mt: Or else with “indrasomāntapataye” one should worship him; / with “abhi tvā śūra nonumaḥ,” one should worship the northeastern peak.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ bhānuṃ ca paritaḥ pūjayaṃti sadācyuta ..
yenedaṃ bhūtamiti vai atha vānena pūjayeta .. 8 ..
meaning:
एवं भानुं च परितः पूजयंति सदाच्युत ..
येनेदं भूतमिति वै अथ वानेन पूजयेत .. 8 ..
text_mt: Thus they always worship the sun all around, O Acyuta; / or else one should worship him with “yenedaṃ bhūtam.”

sanskrit_iast:
namo'stu sarvapāpebhyo vyomapīṭhaṃ sadārcayet ..
te narāḥ satataṃ kāmānprāpnuvaṃti na saṃśayaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
नमोऽस्तु सर्वपापेभ्यो व्योमपीठं सदार्चयेत् ..
ते नराः सततं कामान्प्राप्नुवंति न संशयः .. 9 ..
text_mt: Saying “Obeisance unto all evils,” one should always worship the pedestal of space; / those men constantly attain their desires, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
tvameko rudrāṇāṃ vasūnāṃ pūrvāhṇe tena pūjayet ..
tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ haṃsaḥ śuciṣaditi vai aparāhne sadārcayet .. 10 ..
meaning:
त्वमेको रुद्राणां वसूनां पूर्वाह्णे तेन पूजयेत् ..
तद्विष्णोः परमं पदं हंसः शुचिषदिति वै अपराह्ने सदार्चयेत् .. 10 ..
text_mt: In the morning one should worship with “tvameko rudrāṇāṃ vasūnām”; / with “tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ” and “haṃsaḥ śuciṣat,” one should always worship in the afternoon.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ bhānuṃ grahaiḥ sārdhaṃ pūjayaṃti sadaspate ..
te sarvānvividhānkāmānprāpnuvaṃti na saṃśayaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
एवं भानुं ग्रहैः सार्धं पूजयंति सदस्पते ..
ते सर्वान्विविधान्कामान्प्राप्नुवंति न संशयः .. 11 ..
text_mt: Thus they worship the sun together with the planets, O lord of the assembly; / they obtain all their various desires, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
vimale vāsasī dattvā gurave sapavitrake ..
upānahau tathā kṛṣṇa sauvarṇamaṃgulīyakam .. 12 ..
meaning:
विमले वाससी दत्त्वा गुरवे सपवित्रके ..
उपानहौ तथा कृष्ण सौवर्णमंगुलीयकम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Having given two spotless garments along with purifying darbha rings to the preceptor, / as well as sandals, O Kṛṣṇa, and a golden ring,

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapuṣpāṇi citrāṇi bhakṣyabhojyānyanekaśaḥ ..
anena vidhinā yastu sopavāsorcayedravim ..
bahuputro bahudhanaḥ sa naro bhavyavānbhavet ..13..
meaning:
गन्धपुष्पाणि चित्राणि भक्ष्यभोज्यान्यनेकशः ..
अनेन विधिना यस्तु सोपवासोर्चयेद्रविम् ..
बहुपुत्रो बहुधनः स नरो भव्यवान्भवेत् ..13..
text_mt: and various perfumes and flowers, and numerous snacks and solid foods, / that man who, fasting, worships the sun according to this rule / shall have many sons, much wealth, and become prosperous.

sanskrit_iast:
uttare cāyane yastu sopavāsorcayedravim ..
sośvamedhaphalaṃ viṃdyādbahuputraśca jāyate .. 14 ..
meaning:
उत्तरे चायने यस्तु सोपवासोर्चयेद्रविम् ..
सोश्वमेधफलं विंद्याद्बहुपुत्रश्च जायते .. 14 ..
text_mt: And he who, fasting, worships the sun at the northern solstice / obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice and is born with many sons.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvopavāsaṃ viṣuve yastu pūjayate ravim ..
bahuputro bahudhano kīrtimāṃścāpi jāyate .. 15 ..
meaning:
कृत्वोपवासं विषुवे यस्तु पूजयते रविम् ..
बहुपुत्रो बहुधनो कीर्तिमांश्चापि जायते .. 15 ..
text_mt: He who, having fasted at the equinox, worships the sun / is born with many sons, much wealth, and illustrious.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvopavāsaṃ grahaṇe vidhivaccaṃdrasūryayoḥ ..
pūjayedbhāskaraṃ bhaktyā brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati .. 16 ..
meaning:
कृत्वोपवासं ग्रहणे विधिवच्चंद्रसूर्ययोः ..
पूजयेद्भास्करं भक्त्या ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति .. 16 ..
text_mt: Having fasted at an eclipse of the moon or sun according to rule, / he who worships the sun with devotion goes to the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathito viṣṇo bhāskarārādhane vidhiḥ ..
yaṃ śrutvā puruṣo bhaktyā mama loke mahīyate .. 17 ..
meaning:
इति ते कथितो विष्णो भास्कराराधने विधिः ..
यं श्रुत्वा पुरुषो भक्त्या मम लोके महीयते .. 17 ..
text_mt: Thus has the rule for worshipping the sun been told to you, O Viṣṇu; / having heard it with devotion, a person is glorified in my world.

sanskrit_iast:
punaretya mahīṃ kṛṣṇa rājā bhavati bhūtale ..
bahu putro bahudhanaḥ samareṣvaparājitaḥ .. 18 ..
vyomārcanavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
पुनरेत्य महीं कृष्ण राजा भवति भूतले ..
बहु पुत्रो बहुधनः समरेष्वपराजितः .. 18 ..
व्योमार्चनविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Returning to earth, O Kṛṣṇa, he becomes a king upon the terrestrial plane, / with many sons, much wealth, and undefeated in battles.
Description of the Rite of Worshipping the Sky

sanskrit_iast:
.. sumanturuvāca .. ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi vidhiṃ paramapūjitam ..
ratnavyomapratiṣṭhāyāṃ yathā bhānuṃ prapūjayet .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सुमन्तुरुवाच .. ..
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि विधिं परमपूजितम् ..
रत्नव्योमप्रतिष्ठायां यथा भानुं प्रपूजयेत् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sumantu said: / Henceforth I shall declare the supreme, revered rite / by which one should worship the sun upon the consecration of a jewel-sky.
title: Vyomārcanavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
arcayitvā tu prakṛtiṃ gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatairvibho ..
sahodakenāṃjalinā sahapuṣpākṣatena vā .. 2 ..
meaning:
अर्चयित्वा तु प्रकृतिं गंधपुष्पाक्षतैर्विभो ..
सहोदकेनांजलिना सहपुष्पाक्षतेन वा .. 2 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped the pedestal with perfumes, flowers, and unbroken grains, O lord, / with folded hands holding water, or holding flowers and unbroken grains,

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhayenmahādevaṃ khaṣolkaṃ bhāskaraṃ vibhum ..
mantreṇa kuruśārdūla pratyakṣakiraṇāya vai .. 3 ..
meaning:
आवाहयेन्महादेवं खषोल्कं भास्करं विभुम् ..
मन्त्रेण कुरुशार्दूल प्रत्यक्षकिरणाय वै .. 3 ..
text_mt: one should invoke the great god, Khaṣolka, the all-pervading sun, / with the mantra, O tiger of the Kurus, for him whose rays are manifest:

sanskrit_iast: oṃ khaṣolkamāvāhayāmi oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaroṃ ādityārādhane mantraḥ .. 4 ..
meaning: ओं खषोल्कमावाहयामि ओं भूर्भुवः स्वरों आदित्याराधने मन्त्रः .. 4 ..
text_mt: “Oṃ, I invoke Khaṣolka; oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ oṃ.” This is the mantra in the worship of Āditya.

sanskrit_iast:
abhimantrya bhuve mātraṃ sāvitryā ca ṛcā vibho ..
āpo hiṣṭheti yā proktā vṛthā sūryasya sarvadā .. 5 ..
meaning:
अभिमन्त्र्य भुवे मात्रं सावित्र्या च ऋचा विभो ..
आपो हिष्ठेति या प्रोक्ता वृथा सूर्यस्य सर्वदा .. 5 ..
text_mt: Having consecrated the earth-measure with the Sāvitrī verse, O lord, / that which is proclaimed as “āpo hi ṣṭhā,” always [offered] to the sun in vain,

sanskrit_iast:
yathānyāyaṃ tu saṃkṣālya pūrayeccānyato yataḥ ..
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatetyanayā kṣālayedbudhaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
यथान्यायं तु संक्षाल्य पूरयेच्चान्यतो यतः ..
हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्ततेत्यनया क्षालयेद्बुधः .. 6 ..
text_mt: having washed it properly, one should fill it from another [vessel]; / the wise one should wash it with “hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartata.”

sanskrit_iast:
savitā paścātātsavitā hyanayā pūrayedbudhaḥ ..
ityevaṃ pūrayitvā tu vāri puṣpākṣatairbudhaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
सविता पश्चातात्सविता ह्यनया पूरयेद्बुधः ..
इत्येवं पूरयित्वा तु वारि पुष्पाक्षतैर्बुधः .. 7 ..
text_mt: The wise one should fill it with “savitā paścātāt savitā”; / having thus filled it with water, flowers, and unbroken grains, the wise one,

sanskrit_iast:
pātramaudumbaraṃ gṛhya kṛtsnaṃ sūryasya darśayet ..
udutyaṃ jātavedasamanayā vyomni nikṣipet .. 8 ..
meaning:
पात्रमौदुम्बरं गृह्य कृत्स्नं सूर्यस्य दर्शयेत् ..
उदुत्यं जातवेदसमनया व्योम्नि निक्षिपेत् .. 8 ..
text_mt: taking an udumbara vessel, should show it entirely to the sun; / he should cast it into the air with “ud u tyaṃ jātavedasam.”

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsaḥ śuciṣaditi pādyaṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ ..
nirvāpayecca payasā khaṣolkaṃ snāpayettataḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
हंसः शुचिषदिति पाद्यं दद्याद्विचक्षणः ..
निर्वापयेच्च पयसा खषोल्कं स्नापयेत्ततः .. 9 ..
text_mt: With “haṃsaḥ śuciṣat” the discerning one should give foot-water; / and he should quench him with milk, and then bathe Khaṣolka.

sanskrit_iast:
agnistu saptabhirvīra kīrtitāstāśca kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
āpo hiṣṭheti ca kramāttisṛbhiḥ kurunaṃdana .. 10 ..
meaning:
अग्निस्तु सप्तभिर्वीर कीर्तितास्ताश्च कृत्स्नशः ..
आपो हिष्ठेति च क्रमात्तिसृभिः कुरुनंदन .. 10 ..
text_mt: The [verses to] Agni are recited as seven, O hero, all of them in full; / and with the three beginning with “āpo hi ṣṭhā” in order, O joy of the Kurus,

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyavarṇeti kramāccaturbhiśca narādhipa ..
abhimaṃtryodakamṛgbhistisṛbhi rnikṣipennṛpa .. 11 ..
meaning:
हिरण्यवर्णेति क्रमाच्चतुर्भिश्च नराधिप ..
अभिमंत्र्योदकमृग्भिस्तिसृभि र्निक्षिपेन्नृप .. 11 ..
text_mt: and in order with the four beginning with “hiraṇyavarṇāḥ,” O lord of men; / having consecrated the water with these three verses, O king, he should pour it out.

sanskrit_iast:
bhānoḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā kṛṇuṣvapāja ityapi ..
tya(itya)mūṣu vājinaṃ giraḥ prathamā parikīrtitā .. 12 ..
meaning:
भानोः प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा कृणुष्वपाज इत्यपि ..
त्य(इत्य)मूषु वाजिनं गिरः प्रथमा परिकीर्तिता .. 12 ..
text_mt: Having circumambulated the sun with “kṛṇuṣva pājaḥ,” / the first hymn of praise is proclaimed as “tam ū ṣu vājinaṃ giraḥ.”

sanskrit_iast:
patimiṃdrastavācāma dvitīyā parikīrtitā ..
patimiṃdrastu śuddho na āgahi tṛtīyā parikīrtitā .. 13 ..
meaning:
पतिमिंद्रस्तवाचाम द्वितीया परिकीर्तिता ..
पतिमिंद्रस्तु शुद्धो न आगहि तृतीया परिकीर्तिता .. 13 ..
text_mt: The second is proclaimed as “patim indraḥ stavācāma”; / the third is proclaimed as “patim indras tu śuddho na āgahi.”

sanskrit_iast:
sidhye vṛtrāṇi jighne śagaṃdhairbhānuṃ prapūjayet..
asya vāmasyetyanayā akṣataiḥ pūjayedravim .. 14 ..
meaning:
सिध्ये वृत्राणि जिघ्ने शगंधैर्भानुं प्रपूजयेत्..
अस्य वामस्येत्यनया अक्षतैः पूजयेद्रविम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: With “sidhye vṛtrāṇi jighne śa-,” one should worship the sun with perfumes; / with “asya vāmasya,” one should worship the sun with unbroken grains.

sanskrit_iast:
sapta yuṃjaṃti rathamanayā pūjayedravim ..
puṣpairbharataśārdūla satataṃ tamanāśanam .. 15 ..
meaning:
सप्त युंजंति रथमनया पूजयेद्रविम् ..
पुष्पैर्भरतशार्दूल सततं तमनाशनम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: With “sapta yuñjanti ratham,” one should worship the sun; / constantly worship that destroyer of darkness with flowers, O tiger of the Bharatas.

sanskrit_iast:
ko dadarśa prathama manayā dhūpamādiśet ..
pākaḥ pṛcchāmyanayā caṃdanaṃ pratipādayet .. 16 ..
meaning:
को ददर्श प्रथम मनया धूपमादिशेत् ..
पाकः पृच्छाम्यनया चंदनं प्रतिपादयेत् .. 16 ..
text_mt: With “ko dadarśa prathamam,” one should offer incense; / with “pākaḥ pṛcchāmi,” one should offer sandalwood paste.

sanskrit_iast:
uddīpyasyetyanayā dīpaṃ dadyādvibhāvasoḥ ..
arcitvā kuṃkumaṃ caiva śīrṣaṃ kṣīraṃ tu maṃḍalam .. 17..
meaning:
उद्दीप्यस्येत्यनया दीपं दद्याद्विभावसोः ..
अर्चित्वा कुंकुमं चैव शीर्षं क्षीरं तु मंडलम् .. 17..
text_mt: With “uddīpyasva,” one should give a lamp to the sun; / having offered saffron, and [anointing] the head and the orb with milk,

sanskrit_iast:
yuktā mātāsītyanayā naivedyaṃ pratipādayet ..
gaurīrmimāyeti dadyāttathā śukle ca vāsasī .. 18 ..
meaning:
युक्ता मातासीत्यनया नैवेद्यं प्रतिपादयेत् ..
गौरीर्मिमायेति दद्यात्तथा शुक्ले च वाससी .. 18 ..
text_mt: with “yuktā mātāsīt,” one should present the food-offering; / with “gaurīr mimāya,” one should give two white garments.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ samudretyanayā upavītaṃ nivedayet ..
iti saṃpūjya deveśaṃ tataḥ kuryātparāṃ stutim .. 19 ..
meaning:
तस्याः समुद्रेत्यनया उपवीतं निवेदयेत् ..
इति संपूज्य देवेशं ततः कुर्यात्परां स्तुतिम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: With “tasyāḥ samudrāḥ,” one should present the sacred thread; / having thus worshipped the lord of gods, one should then make the supreme praise

sanskrit_iast:
ṛgbhirvai paṃcabhistāta śṛṇu caikamanādṛtaḥ ..
ukṣāṇaṃ pṛśniriti ca prathamā parikīrtitā .. 20 ..
meaning:
ऋग्भिर्वै पंचभिस्तात शृणु चैकमनादृतः ..
उक्षाणं पृश्निरिति च प्रथमा परिकीर्तिता .. 20 ..
text_mt: with five verses, dear one; hear them, attentive and with single mind: / the first is proclaimed as “ukṣāṇaṃ pṛśniḥ”;

sanskrit_iast:
catvāri vāgiti bhaveddvitīyā parikīrtitā ..
iṃdraṃ mitraṃ tṛtīyā tu varādhikye prakīrtitā .. 21 ..
meaning:
चत्वारि वागिति भवेद्द्वितीया परिकीर्तिता ..
इंद्रं मित्रं तृतीया तु वराधिक्ये प्रकीर्तिता .. 21 ..
text_mt: the second is proclaimed to be “catvāri vāk”; / the third, renowned for supreme excellence, is “indraṃ mitraṃ”;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇaṃ niyānaṃ hi tathā caturthī parikīrtitā ..
yo ratnavāhītyanayā kirīṭaṃ yojayedravau .. 22 ..
meaning:
कृष्णं नियानं हि तथा चतुर्थी परिकीर्तिता ..
यो रत्नवाहीत्यनया किरीटं योजयेद्रवौ .. 22 ..
text_mt: and the fourth is proclaimed as “kṛṣṇaṃ niyānam”; / with “yo ratnavāhī,” one should affix a diadem to the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
gatehanāmityanayā avyaṃgaṃ bhāskaraṃ nyaset ..
iyamadadādrabhasamṛṇacyutamiti ṛgāditaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
गतेहनामित्यनया अव्यंगं भास्करं न्यसेत् ..
इयमददाद्रभसमृणच्युतमिति ऋगादितः .. 23 ..
text_mt: With “gatehanām,” one should place the avyaṅga girdle on the sun; / from the verse beginning “iyam adadād rabhasam ṛṇacyutam,”

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā pūjāṃ tataścargbhiraṣṭābhiriti cācyuta ..
devasya śaktayo'ṣṭau ca pūjayedvidhivatkramāt .. 24 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा पूजां ततश्चर्ग्भिरष्टाभिरिति चाच्युत ..
देवस्य शक्तयोऽष्टौ च पूजयेद्विधिवत्क्रमात् .. 24 ..
text_mt: having then performed worship with eight verses, O Acyuta, / one should worship the eight energies of the god in proper sequence according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣa te mayākhyātaḥ pratimāpūjane vidhiḥ ..
yaḥ purokto mahābāho brahmaṇā viṣṇave tathā ..25..
meaning:
इत्येष ते मयाख्यातः प्रतिमापूजने विधिः ..
यः पुरोक्तो महाबाहो ब्रह्मणा विष्णवे तथा ..25..
text_mt: This rule for worshipping the image has been declared to you by me, / which was spoken of old by Brahmā to Viṣṇu, O mighty-armed one.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā yastu satataṃ pūjayedravim ..
sa prāpnotyakhilānkāmāniha loke paratra ca ..26..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु सततं पूजयेद्रविम् ..
स प्राप्नोत्यखिलान्कामानिह लोके परत्र च ..26..
text_mt: He who constantly worships the sun according to this rule / obtains all desires in this world and in the next.

sanskrit_iast:
putrārthī labhate putrāndhanārthī labhate dhanam ..
kanyārthī labhate kanyāṃ vedārthī vedavidbhavet ..27..
meaning:
पुत्रार्थी लभते पुत्रान्धनार्थी लभते धनम् ..
कन्यार्थी लभते कन्यां वेदार्थी वेदविद्भवेत् ..27..
text_mt: One who desires sons obtains sons; one who desires wealth obtains wealth; / one who desires a maiden obtains a maiden; one who desires the Veda becomes a knower of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkāmaḥ pūjayedyastu sa mokṣaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ ..
anena vidhinā pūjya gataḥ siddhiṃ sa vaiṣṇavaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
निष्कामः पूजयेद्यस्तु स मोक्षं प्राप्नुयान्नरः ..
अनेन विधिना पूज्य गतः सिद्धिं स वैष्णवः .. 28 ..
text_mt: A man who worships without desire attains liberation; / having worshipped according to this rule, that Vaiṣṇava reaches perfection.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādayastathā devaṃ pūjayitvā vibhāvasum ..
anena vidhinā pūjya saṃtaḥ siddhiṃ parāṃ gatāḥ .. 29 .. ..
mahādevārcanavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
ब्रह्मादयस्तथा देवं पूजयित्वा विभावसुम् ..
अनेन विधिना पूज्य संतः सिद्धिं परां गताः .. 29 .. ..
महादेवार्चनविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Brahmā and the other gods, having thus worshipped the sun / according to this rule, being virtuous, attained the supreme perfection.
Description of the Rite of Worship by Mahādeva

sanskrit_iast:
.. vyāsa uvāca .. ..
punarnibodha me bhīṣma gadataḥ paramaṃ vidhim ..
yena pūjayate nityaṃ mahādevaṃ divā karam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. व्यास उवाच .. ..
पुनर्निबोध मे भीष्म गदतः परमं विधिम् ..
येन पूजयते नित्यं महादेवं दिवा करम् .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Listen again, O Bhīṣma, as I proclaim the supreme rite / by which Mahādeva continually worships the sun, maker of the day:
title: Rcanavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
prabhūtaṃ nirmalaṃ teja ārādhya paramaṃ sukham ..
pūrvamaṃtastathāgneyyāṃ nairṛtyāṃ pavanālaye .. 2 ..
meaning:
प्रभूतं निर्मलं तेज आराध्य परमं सुखम् ..
पूर्वमंतस्तथाग्नेय्यां नैरृत्यां पवनालये .. 2 ..
text_mt: having worshipped the abundant, spotless splendor, the supreme bliss, / first in the east, then inside in the south-east, in the south-west, in the abode of the wind,

sanskrit_iast:
krameṇa yāvadīśānaṃ hṛdi bījaṃ ca vinyaset ..
bhāskarāsanametattu nyastavyaṃ tattvadarśibhiḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
क्रमेण यावदीशानं हृदि बीजं च विन्यसेत् ..
भास्करासनमेतत्तु न्यस्तव्यं तत्त्वदर्शिभिः .. 3 ..
text_mt: in order up to the north-east, one should also place the seed-syllable in the heart. / This seat of the Sun must be placed by those who perceive reality.

sanskrit_iast:
upariṣṭāttatastasya hṛdayena tu paṃkajam ..
aṣṭapatraṃ keśarālaṃ paṃcavarṇasakeśaram .. 4 ..
meaning:
उपरिष्टात्ततस्तस्य हृदयेन तु पंकजम् ..
अष्टपत्रं केशरालं पंचवर्णसकेशरम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Then, above it, [one should place] a lotus with the heart-[mantra]— / eight-petaled, rich in filaments, five-colored, with stamens.

sanskrit_iast:
dīptādi pūrvamārabhya āmahādevagocaram ..
śaktyaṣṭakaṃ nyasenmaṃtrairāditaḥ sarvatomukhīm .. 5 ..
meaning:
दीप्तादि पूर्वमारभ्य आमहादेवगोचरम् ..
शक्त्यष्टकं न्यसेन्मंत्रैरादितः सर्वतोमुखीम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Beginning from the east with Dīptā, extending into the realm of Mahādeva, / one should place the eight śaktis with mantras, beginning with Sarvatomukhī.

sanskrit_iast:
abījaiḥ kesarāgreṣu krameṇaiva ca pūjayet ..
tatastvāvāhayedbhānuṃ sthāpayetkarṇikopari .. 6 ..
meaning:
अबीजैः केसराग्रेषु क्रमेणैव च पूजयेत् ..
ततस्त्वावाहयेद्भानुं स्थापयेत्कर्णिकोपरि .. 6 ..
text_mt: One should worship [them] in succession at the tips of the filaments with the seed-syllables. / Then one should invoke the Sun and install him upon the pericarp.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyopahṛtya taṃ cānyaṃ veditavyaṃ khapuṣkaram ..
tenaivāvāhanaṃ cārcya sthāpanaṃ cārdhameva ca .. 7 ..
meaning:
तस्योपहृत्य तं चान्यं वेदितव्यं खपुष्करम् ..
तेनैवावाहनं चार्च्य स्थापनं चार्धमेव च .. 7 ..
text_mt: Having offered to him that other [offering], the sky-lotus should be known; / with that very [mantra] one performs the invocation, worship, installation, and arghya,

sanskrit_iast:
pādyamācamanaṃ sthānaṃ vastragaṃdhādibhūṣaṇam ..
vidhinā vīrapuṣpāṇi naivedyaṃ dhūpameva ca .. 8 ..
meaning:
पाद्यमाचमनं स्थानं वस्त्रगंधादिभूषणम् ..
विधिना वीरपुष्पाणि नैवेद्यं धूपमेव च .. 8 ..
text_mt: water for the feet, sipping water, placing, garments, scents and other ornaments, / vīra flowers according to rule, food offerings, and incense.

sanskrit_iast:
kartavyaṃ śraddhayā bhaktyā evaṃ tuṣyati bhāskaraḥ ..
mahāpātakino'pyāśu labhaṃte ciṃtitaṃ phalam .. 9 ..
meaning:
कर्तव्यं श्रद्धया भक्त्या एवं तुष्यति भास्करः ..
महापातकिनोऽप्याशु लभंते चिंतितं फलम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: It should be performed with faith and devotion; thus the Sun is pleased. / Even great sinners quickly attain their desired fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityaṃ pūjayitvā tu paścādaṃgāni pūjayet ..
dīptāyāṃ hṛdayaṃ nyasya bhavānyā śiraso nyaset .. 10 ..
meaning:
आदित्यं पूजयित्वा तु पश्चादंगानि पूजयेत् ..
दीप्तायां हृदयं न्यस्य भवान्या शिरसो न्यसेत् .. 10 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped the Sun, one should afterward worship the limbs: / placing the heart in Dīptā, one should place the head with Bhavānī.

sanskrit_iast:
digvidikṣu nyasedastramiṃdrādi diśottarāṃtikam ..
karṇikāyāṃ nyasennetraṃ svabījena tu vārcayeta .. 11 ..
meaning:
दिग्विदिक्षु न्यसेदस्त्रमिंद्रादि दिशोत्तरांतिकम् ..
कर्णिकायां न्यसेन्नेत्रं स्वबीजेन तु वार्चयेत .. 11 ..
text_mt: One should place the weapon in the cardinal and intermediate directions, ending at the north with Indra and the other directions. / One should place the eye in the pericarp, or worship it with its own seed-syllable.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpairgaṃdhaiśca dhūpaiśca hṛdayāni krameṇa tu ..
pūjayitvā tu vidhivadgarbhaṃ paścāttu maṃtravit .. 12 ..
meaning:
पुष्पैर्गंधैश्च धूपैश्च हृदयानि क्रमेण तु ..
पूजयित्वा तु विधिवद्गर्भं पश्चात्तु मंत्रवित् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Having duly worshipped the hearts in sequence / with flowers, scents, and incenses, the knower of mantras should then [worship] the interior.

sanskrit_iast:
bāhyataḥ pūrvato maṃdaṃ dakṣiṇena budhaṃ tathā ..
viṣāṇaṃ paścime pūjya uttareṇa tu bhārgavam .. 13 ..
meaning:
बाह्यतः पूर्वतो मंदं दक्षिणेन बुधं तथा ..
विषाणं पश्चिमे पूज्य उत्तरेण तु भार्गवम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: On the outside, in the east Saturn, and in the south Mercury, / having worshipped Viṣāṇa in the west, and Venus in the north,

sanskrit_iast:
āgneyyāṃ ca kujaṃ pūjya nairṛtyāṃ bhānudehajam ..
vāyavyāṃ pūjayetkṛṣṇamaiśānyāṃ vikacaṃ nṛpa .. 14 ..
meaning:
आग्नेय्यां च कुजं पूज्य नैरृत्यां भानुदेहजम् ..
वायव्यां पूजयेत्कृष्णमैशान्यां विकचं नृप .. 14 ..
text_mt: having worshipped Mars in the south-east and the Sun's son in the south-west, / in the north-west one should worship Kṛṣṇa, and in the north-east Vikaca, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
indrādilokapālāṃśca tato'ṣṭau pūjayedbudhaḥ ..
sugaṃdhairvividhaiḥ puṣpairdhūpaiścaiva manoramaiḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
इन्द्रादिलोकपालांश्च ततोऽष्टौ पूजयेद्बुधः ..
सुगंधैर्विविधैः पुष्पैर्धूपैश्चैव मनोरमैः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Then the wise man should worship the eight world protectors beginning with Indra / with various fragrant flowers and pleasing incenses.

sanskrit_iast:
krameṇa pūjayedbhānuṃ lokapālairgrahaiḥ saha ..
maṃtraiḥ kurukulaśreṣṭha ya icchecchreya ātmanaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
क्रमेण पूजयेद्भानुं लोकपालैर्ग्रहैः सह ..
मंत्रैः कुरुकुलश्रेष्ठ य इच्छेच्छ्रेय आत्मनः .. 16 ..
text_mt: Whoever desires his own welfare, O best of the Kuru lineage, / should worship the Sun in succession together with the world protectors, planets, and mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā yatra devaḥ saṃpūjyate raviḥ ..
na caurāgnibhayaṃ tatra na cāpi narakādbhayam .. 17 ..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना यत्र देवः संपूज्यते रविः ..
न चौराग्निभयं तत्र न चापि नरकाद्भयम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: Where the divine Sun is worshipped by this rite, / there is no fear of thieves or fire, nor any fear of hell.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣopalaviṣādibhyo bhayaṃ tatra na vidyate ..
sukhamārogyamānaṃdaṃ subhikṣamacalāṃ śriyam .. 18 ..
meaning:
वर्षोपलविषादिभ्यो भयं तत्र न विद्यते ..
सुखमारोग्यमानंदं सुभिक्षमचलां श्रियम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: No fear exists there from hailstorms, poison, and the like; / [there is] comfort, health, joy, abundance of food, and immovable prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
tejobiṃbāṃtamadhyastha ādityaḥ paramārthataḥ ..
yaṣṭavyaḥ sādhakairnityaṃ na ratho na ca vājinaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
तेजोबिंबांतमध्यस्थ आदित्यः परमार्थतः ..
यष्टव्यः साधकैर्नित्यं न रथो न च वाजिनः .. 19 ..
text_mt: In ultimate truth, the Sun, abiding within the center of the orb of splendor, / is to be worshipped continually by practitioners—not the chariot and not the horses.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣa vidhirākhyāto mayā bhīṣma tavākhilaḥ ..
yena pūjayate nityaṃ mahādevo divākaram .. 20 ..
meaning:
इत्येष विधिराख्यातो मया भीष्म तवाखिलः ..
येन पूजयते नित्यं महादेवो दिवाकरम् .. 20 ..
text_mt: Thus this entire rite has been declared by me to you, O Bhīṣma, / by which Mahādeva continually worships the sun, maker of the day.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ pūjya vivasvantaṃ hṛdbījena visarjayet ..
ya evaṃ pūjayedbhānuṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 21 .. ..
sūryapūjāmāhātmyavarṇanam
meaning:
इत्थं पूज्य विवस्वन्तं हृद्बीजेन विसर्जयेत् ..
य एवं पूजयेद्भानुं स याति परमां गतिम् .. 21 .. ..
सूर्यपूजामाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Having thus worshipped Vivasvat, one should dismiss him with the heart's seed-syllable. / He who worships the Sun in this way attains the supreme state.
Description of the Greatness of Sun Worship

sanskrit_iast:
.. bhīṣma uvāca .. ..
maṃtroddhāraṃ paraṃ brūhi mudrāśaktisamanvitam ..
rūpavarṇa samaṃ caiva paurāṇikamanuttamam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. भीष्म उवाच .. ..
मंत्रोद्धारं परं ब्रूहि मुद्राशक्तिसमन्वितम् ..
रूपवर्ण समं चैव पौराणिकमनुत्तमम् .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Bhīṣma said:
Tell me the supreme extraction of mantras, accompanied by mudrās and śaktis, / matching form and color, the unexcelled Purāṇic [lore].
title: Sūryapūjāmāhātmyavarṇanm

sanskrit_iast:
.. vyāsa uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu bhīṣma mahābāho yathā vakṣyāmi tenagha ..
paurāṇikānāṃ maṃtrāṇāmuddhāraṃ vaidikādṛte ..2..
meaning:
.. व्यास उवाच .. ..
शृणु भीष्म महाबाहो यथा वक्ष्यामि तेनघ ..
पौराणिकानां मंत्राणामुद्धारं वैदिकादृते ..2..
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Listen, O mighty-armed Bhīṣma, as I shall speak to you, O sinless one, / concerning the extraction of Purāṇic mantras, apart from the Vedic [ones].

sanskrit_iast:
varṇarephasamāyuktaṃ vidrumenaiva bhūṣitam ..
aṃtasthānāṃ hi aṃtyaṃ vai brahmadaivatyamucyate ..3..
meaning:
वर्णरेफसमायुक्तं विद्रुमेनैव भूषितम् ..
अंतस्थानां हि अंत्यं वै ब्रह्मदैवत्यमुच्यते ..3..
text_mt: Joined with the letter r and adorned with coral, / the last of the semivowels is said to have Brahmā as its deity.

sanskrit_iast:
biṃdurephasamāyuktaṃ dīrghayā mātrayā tathā ..
dīkṣākṣaraṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ dvitīyaṃ viṣṇudaivatam ..4..
meaning:
बिंदुरेफसमायुक्तं दीर्घया मात्रया तथा ..
दीक्षाक्षरं समुद्दिष्टं द्वितीयं विष्णुदैवतम् ..4..
text_mt: Endowed with the bindu and the letter r, and likewise with a long vowel-measure, / the syllable of initiation is declared; the second has Viṣṇu as its deity.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyaṃ tu tathā proktaṃ savisargaṃ janādhipa ..
sa tṛtīyo budhaiḥ prokto rudradaivata eva hi ..5..
meaning:
तृतीयं तु तथा प्रोक्तं सविसर्गं जनाधिप ..
स तृतीयो बुधैः प्रोक्तो रुद्रदैवत एव हि ..5..
text_mt: The third is likewise proclaimed, O ruler of men, as having a visarga; / that third is indeed declared by the wise to have Rudra as its deity.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāskaroyaṃ mahānsākṣānmaṃtramūrtistrirakṣaraḥ..
durlabhaḥ paramo guhyastridevo devapūjitaḥ ..6..
meaning:
भास्करोयं महान्साक्षान्मंत्रमूर्तिस्त्रिरक्षरः..
दुर्लभः परमो गुह्यस्त्रिदेवो देवपूजितः ..6..
text_mt: This is the great Sun, directly the embodiment of the mantra, possessing three syllables, / difficult to attain, supremely secret, the threefold deity, worshipped by the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
yastvidaṃ japate bhaktyā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ..
tataśca mudrāṃ vakṣyāmi sānnidhya kāraṇaṃ param ..7..
meaning:
यस्त्विदं जपते भक्त्या स याति परमां गतिम् ..
ततश्च मुद्रां वक्ष्यामि सान्निध्य कारणं परम् ..7..
text_mt: He who recites this with devotion goes to the supreme state. / And next I will speak of the mudrā, the supreme cause of [divine] presence.

sanskrit_iast:
padmākārau karau kṛtvā madhye śliṣṭe tu madhyame..
aṃguliṃ kṣārayettasminvimudreti ca socyate ..8..
meaning:
पद्माकारौ करौ कृत्वा मध्ये श्लिष्टे तु मध्यमे..
अंगुलिं क्षारयेत्तस्मिन्विमुद्रेति च सोच्यते ..8..
text_mt: Having made the hands in the shape of a lotus, with the middle fingers joined in the middle, / one should extend the finger upon it; this is called the Vimudrā.

sanskrit_iast:
anayā baddhayā rājanbhāskarasya priyo bhavet ..
mahābhayeṣu sarveṣu mātṛvatparirakṣati .. 9 ..
meaning:
अनया बद्धया राजन्भास्करस्य प्रियो भवेत् ..
महाभयेषु सर्वेषु मातृवत्परिरक्षति .. 9 ..
text_mt: When this [mudrā] is bound, O king, one becomes dear to the Sun; / in all great perils, he protects [one] like a mother.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdayaṃ tasya vijñeyaṃ yadakṣaravaraṃ smṛtam ..
vidrumopari saṃchannaṃ hṛdgataṃ tadgataṃ sadā .. 10 ..
meaning:
हृदयं तस्य विज्ञेयं यदक्षरवरं स्मृतम् ..
विद्रुमोपरि संछन्नं हृद्गतं तद्गतं सदा .. 10 ..
text_mt: His heart is to be known as that which is remembered as the excellent syllable / covered over the coral, residing in the heart, ever directed to it.

sanskrit_iast:
śirasyarkamiti proktaṃ devadevasya bhārata ..
mahāvyāhṛtayastisrastathārajvālinī śikhā .. 11 ..
meaning:
शिरस्यर्कमिति प्रोक्तं देवदेवस्य भारत ..
महाव्याहृतयस्तिस्रस्तथारज्वालिनी शिखा .. 11 ..
text_mt: "Arka" is proclaimed for the head of the god of gods, O descendant of Bharata; / the three great vyāhṛtis, and likewise the lock of hair is Arciṣmatī.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭākṣarā tu vidyeyamādityasya mahātmanaḥ ..
yaḥ smaretsādhakastvenaṃ nāsau kenāpi bādhyate .. 12 ..
meaning:
अष्टाक्षरा तु विद्येयमादित्यस्य महात्मनः ..
यः स्मरेत्साधकस्त्वेनं नासौ केनापि बाध्यते .. 12 ..
text_mt: This is the eight-syllabled spell of the great-souled Sun. / The practitioner who remembers it is not afflicted by anything.

sanskrit_iast:
akāreṇa samāyuktaṃ biṃdurephasamanvitam ..
hakāramagnidaivatyaṃ kavacaṃ bhāskarapriyam.. 13 ..
meaning:
अकारेण समायुक्तं बिंदुरेफसमन्वितम् ..
हकारमग्निदैवत्यं कवचं भास्करप्रियम्.. 13 ..
text_mt: Joined with the letter a, endowed with bindu and the letter r, / the letter ha has Agni as its deity; [it is] the armor dear to the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
ekākṣaramidaṃ proktamabhedyaṃ yaḥ smaredidam ..
duṣṭānāṃ caiva vighnānāṃ nāśanaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
एकाक्षरमिदं प्रोक्तमभेद्यं यः स्मरेदिदम् ..
दुष्टानां चैव विघ्नानां नाशनं नात्र संशयः .. 14 ..
text_mt: This is declared to be of one syllable, impenetrable; he who remembers this— / it destroys wicked obstacles, there is no doubt of this.

sanskrit_iast:
savisargo repha iti astramekākṣaraṃ smṛtam ..
nāśayedduṣṭakarmāṇi sādhakasya na saṃśayaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
सविसर्गो रेफ इति अस्त्रमेकाक्षरं स्मृतम् ..
नाशयेद्दुष्टकर्माणि साधकस्य न संशयः .. 15 ..
text_mt: The letter r with a visarga is remembered as the one-syllabled weapon; / it destroys the wicked deeds of the practitioner, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃmukhau tau karau kṛtvā śliṣṭau tu grathitāṃgulī ..
kaniṣṭhenāmike yojye tarjanyau madhyame tathā .. .. 16 ..
meaning:
संमुखौ तौ करौ कृत्वा श्लिष्टौ तु ग्रथितांगुली ..
कनिष्ठेनामिके योज्ये तर्जन्यौ मध्यमे तथा .. .. 16 ..
text_mt: Having brought the two hands face to face, joined with fingers interlaced, / the little fingers and ring fingers should be joined, and likewise the forefingers and middle fingers.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛcchiraḥ saśikhā carmā mudreyaṃ vyomasaṃjñitā ..
muṣṭivakrocchritaṃ kuryātsavyahastasya tarjanīm ..17..
meaning:
हृच्छिरः सशिखा चर्मा मुद्रेयं व्योमसंज्ञिता ..
मुष्टिवक्रोच्छ्रितं कुर्यात्सव्यहस्तस्य तर्जनीम् ..17..
text_mt: Pertaining to heart, head, tuft, and armor, this mudrā is called Vyoma. / One should make a fist and raise the forefinger of the right hand curved:

sanskrit_iast:
mālaśabdakṛtādistu mudrā hyastrasya kīrtitā ..
trāsanī nāma vikhyātā sarvaviprabhayaṃkarī .. 18 ..
meaning:
मालशब्दकृतादिस्तु मुद्रा ह्यस्त्रस्य कीर्तिता ..
त्रासनी नाम विख्याता सर्वविप्रभयंकरी .. 18 ..
text_mt: beginning with the sound of a garland, it is celebrated as the mudrā of the weapon, / renowned by the name Trāsanī, inspiring terror in all adversaries.

sanskrit_iast:
karṇabiṃdusamāyuktaṃ yaṃ caturthaṃ mahāmate ..
bhāskarasya tvidaṃ netramagridaivatamucyate ... .. 19 ..
meaning:
कर्णबिंदुसमायुक्तं यं चतुर्थं महामते ..
भास्करस्य त्विदं नेत्रमग्रिदैवतमुच्यते ... .. 19 ..
text_mt: The fourth [semivowel] endowed with the ear-vowel and bindu, O highly intelligent one, / is said to be this eye of the Sun, having Agni as its deity.

sanskrit_iast:
smaraḥ syātsādhakeṃdrāṇāṃ duraṃto nāśane dhruvam ..
madhyamā tarjanī caiva savyahastasya cocchritam.. 20 ..
meaning:
स्मरः स्यात्साधकेंद्राणां दुरंतो नाशने ध्रुवम् ..
मध्यमा तर्जनी चैव सव्यहस्तस्य चोच्छ्रितम्.. 20 ..
text_mt: Smara would certainly bring endless destruction to the best of practitioners. / The middle and index fingers of the right hand are raised,

sanskrit_iast:
kaniṣṭhānāmike kuṃcya aṃguṣṭhena tataḥ kramet ..
netrābhyāṃ sparśayedenāṃ netramudrā prakīrtitā .. 21 ..
meaning:
कनिष्ठानामिके कुंच्य अंगुष्ठेन ततः क्रमेत् ..
नेत्राभ्यां स्पर्शयेदेनां नेत्रमुद्रा प्रकीर्तिता .. 21 ..
text_mt: and bending the little and ring fingers, one should then touch with the thumb / and touch the eyes with it; this is proclaimed as the eye-mudrā.

sanskrit_iast:
govṛṣā nāma vikhyātā darśayeddivyagocaram ..
rāṃ dīptāriṃ tataḥ sūkṣmārīṃ jayā bhīṣma ucyate .. 22 ..
meaning:
गोवृषा नाम विख्याता दर्शयेद्दिव्यगोचरम् ..
रां दीप्तारिं ततः सूक्ष्मारीं जया भीष्म उच्यते .. 22 ..
text_mt: Renowned by the name Govṛṣā, it reveals the divine sphere. / "Rāṃ" is Dīptā, "rīṃ" then is Sūkṣmā, "jayā" is spoken of, O Bhīṣma,

sanskrit_iast:
ubhāhvārūṃ vibhūtiśca vimalā reṃ prakīrtitā ..
aghahā ca mahābāho vidyutā rauṃ prakīrtitā .. 23 ..
meaning:
उभाह्वारूं विभूतिश्च विमला रें प्रकीर्तिता ..
अघहा च महाबाहो विद्युता रौं प्रकीर्तिता .. 23 ..
text_mt: "rūṃ" is called both [Bhadrakarī] and Vibhūti, "reṃ" is proclaimed as Vimalā, / and "raiṃ" is Aghahā, O mighty-armed one; "rauṃ" is proclaimed as Vidyutā,

sanskrit_iast:
govṛṣā nāma raṃ sarvaṃ vīrabhadrakarī tathā ..
ityetā bījarūpāstu kathitāścaiva śaktayaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
गोवृषा नाम रं सर्वं वीरभद्रकरी तथा ..
इत्येता बीजरूपास्तु कथिताश्चैव शक्तयः .. 24 ..
text_mt: "raṃ" is Govṛṣā, all [these], and likewise Vīrabhadrakarī. / Thus these śaktis have been proclaimed in the form of seed-syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
