sthāpyāśca svottare pārśve ityetā devaśaktayaḥ ..17..
meaning:
स्थाप्य बुद्धिमती नित्यं श्रीकामैर्वा विवस्वतः ..
ऋद्धिश्चैव विसृष्टिश्च पौर्णमासी विभावरी..
स्थाप्याश्च स्वोत्तरे पार्श्वे इत्येता देवशक्तयः ..17..
text_mt: Buddhimatī must always be installed by those desiring prosperity from Vivasvant. / Ṛddhi, Visṛṣṭi, Paurṇamāsī, and Vibhāvarī / are to be installed on his left side: these are the powers of the god.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpaścānnamalaṃkāro vāsaḥ puṣpāṇi mantrataḥ ..
deyāni devadevāya sānugāya samūrtaye ..18..
meaning:
दीपश्चान्नमलंकारो वासः पुष्पाणि मन्त्रतः ..
देयानि देवदेवाय सानुगाय समूर्तये ..18..
text_mt: A lamp, food, ornament, garment, and flowers / should be offered with mantras to the god of gods, who has attendants and form.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhinānena satataṃ sadā yorcayati bhāskaram ..
saṃprāpya paramānkāmāṃstato bhānusado vrajet .. 19 ..
meaning:
विधिनानेन सततं सदा योर्चयति भास्करम् ..
संप्राप्य परमान्कामांस्ततो भानुसदो व्रजेत् .. 19 ..
text_mt: Whoever continually worships the sun in this manner / obtains supreme desires and goes to the abode of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā yastu bhojayedbhāskaraṃ nṛpa ..
tvaṃ niṃba kaṭukātmāsi ādityanilayastathā ..
sarvarogaharaḥ śānto bhava me prāśanaṃ sadā .. 1.216.20 ..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु भोजयेद्भास्करं नृप ..
त्वं निंब कटुकात्मासि आदित्यनिलयस्तथा ..
सर्वरोगहरः शान्तो भव मे प्राशनं सदा .. 1.216.20 ..
text_mt: Whoever feeds the sun by this rule, O king: / 'You are neem, bitter in nature, and the dwelling of the sun; / banishing all diseases, peaceful, be my food always.'

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ prāśya japedbhūmau devasya purato nṛpa ..
brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā tu śaktyā dattvā tu dakṣiṇām.. 21 ..
meaning:
इत्थं प्राश्य जपेद्भूमौ देवस्य पुरतो नृप ..
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयित्वा तु शक्त्या दत्त्वा तु दक्षिणाम्.. 21 ..
text_mt: Having thus eaten, he should recite prayers on the ground before the god, O king, / after feeding brāhmaṇas and giving a sacrificial fee according to his means.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ paścānmadhuraṃ kṣāravarjitam ..
ityeṣā varṣaparyantaṃ kartavyā caiva saptamī .. 22 ..
meaning:
भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः पश्चान्मधुरं क्षारवर्जितम् ..
इत्येषा वर्षपर्यन्तं कर्तव्या चैव सप्तमी .. 22 ..
text_mt: Restraining his speech, he should then eat sweet food, free from saline; / in this way, this saptamī is to be observed for a whole year.

sanskrit_iast:
kurvāṇaḥ saptamīmetāṃ sarvarogaiḥ pramucyate ..
sarvaroga vinirmuktaḥ sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati .. 23 ..
meaning:
कुर्वाणः सप्तमीमेतां सर्वरोगैः प्रमुच्यते ..
सर्वरोग विनिर्मुक्तः सूर्यलोकं स गच्छति .. 23 ..
text_mt: Performing this saptamī, one is freed from all diseases; / delivered from all diseases, he goes to the world of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sumanturuvāca .. ..
atha bhādrapade māsi site pakṣe mahīpate ..
kṛtvopavāsaṃ saptamyāṃ vidhivatpūjayedravim .. 24 ..
meaning:
.. सुमन्तुरुवाच .. ..
अथ भाद्रपदे मासि सिते पक्षे महीपते ..
कृत्वोपवासं सप्तम्यां विधिवत्पूजयेद्रविम् .. 24 ..
text_mt: Sumantu said: / Now in the month of Bhādrapada, in the bright fortnight, O lord of the earth, / having fasted on the seventh day, one should worship the sun according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
māheśvareṇa vidhinā pūjayedatra bhāskaram ..
aṣṭamyāṃ tu punaḥ snātaḥ pūjayitvā divākaram .. 25 ..
meaning:
माहेश्वरेण विधिना पूजयेदत्र भास्करम् ..
अष्टम्यां तु पुनः स्नातः पूजयित्वा दिवाकरम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: One should worship the sun here with the Māheśvara rite; / having bathed again on the eighth day and worshipped the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
dadyātphalāni viprebhyo mārtaṇḍaḥ prīyatāmiti ..
kharjūraṃ nālikeraṃ ca mātuliṅgaphalāni ca .. 26 ..
meaning:
दद्यात्फलानि विप्रेभ्यो मार्तण्डः प्रीयतामिति ..
खर्जूरं नालिकेरं च मातुलिङ्गफलानि च .. 26 ..
text_mt: he should give fruits to the brāhmaṇas, saying, 'May Mārtaṇḍa be pleased': / dates, coconuts, and citron fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
devasya purato dattvā tathā cāmraphalāni ca ..
iti te kathitaṃ rājansaptamīphalamāditaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
देवस्य पुरतो दत्त्वा तथा चाम्रफलानि च ..
इति ते कथितं राजन्सप्तमीफलमादितः .. 27 ..
text_mt: Having placed [them] before the god, and likewise mango fruits— / thus has the fruit of the saptamī been told to you from the beginning, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
mahātapo mahāśreṣṭhaṃ bhāskarasya viśāmpate ..
yacchrutvā mānavo rājanmucyate brahmahatyayā .. 28 ..
meaning:
महातपो महाश्रेष्ठं भास्करस्य विशाम्पते ..
यच्छ्रुत्वा मानवो राजन्मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया .. 28 ..
text_mt: It is the great, supreme austerity of the sun, O ruler of the people, / hearing which a man is freed from the killing of a brāhmaṇa, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
tathedaṃ paramaṃ parva kathitaṃ brahmasaṃjñitam ..
yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyante mānavā nṛpa .. 29 ..
meaning:
तथेदं परमं पर्व कथितं ब्रह्मसंज्ञितम् ..
यच्छ्रुत्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यन्ते मानवा नृप .. 29 ..
text_mt: Likewise, this supreme section called Brahma has been proclaimed, / hearing which men are freed from all sins, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvamedhasahasrasya vājapeyaśatasya ca ..
sarvatīrthābhigamane vedābhyāse ca yatphalam ..
yatphalaṃ pṛthivīdāne tatsarvaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ .. 1.216.30 ..
meaning:
अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य वाजपेयशतस्य च ..
सर्वतीर्थाभिगमने वेदाभ्यासे च यत्फलम् ..
यत्फलं पृथिवीदाने तत्सर्वं प्राप्नुयान्नरः .. 1.216.30 ..
text_mt: The fruit of a thousand horse sacrifices, of a hundred vājapeyas, / of going to all sacred fords, and of the study of the Vedas; / whatever fruit lies in gifting the earth—a man obtains all of that.

sanskrit_iast:
rājasūyasahasrasya vājapeyaśatasya ca ..
sahasraśatadānasya phalaṃ viṃdati mānavaḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
राजसूयसहस्रस्य वाजपेयशतस्य च ..
सहस्रशतदानस्य फलं विंदति मानवः .. 31 ..
text_mt: The fruit of a thousand rājasūyas, of a hundred vājapeyas, / and of a hundred thousand gifts, a mortal attains.

sanskrit_iast:
lekhatvaṃ brāhmaṇo gacchetkṣatriyo vipratāṃ vrajet ..
vaiśyo'pi kṣatratāṃ yāti śūdro vaiśyatvameva ca .. 32 ..
meaning:
लेखत्वं ब्राह्मणो गच्छेत्क्षत्रियो विप्रतां व्रजेत् ..
वैश्योऽपि क्षत्रतां याति शूद्रो वैश्यत्वमेव च .. 32 ..
text_mt: A brāhmaṇa would attain the status of a god, a kṣatriya would become a brāhmaṇa, / a vaiśya also attains kṣatriya status, and a śūdra attains vaiśya status.

sanskrit_iast:
sūtamāgadha bandyādyā ye cānye saṃkarodbhavāḥ ..
te'pi yāṃtyuttamaṃ sthānaṃ purāṇaśravaṇādvibho .. 33 ..
meaning:
सूतमागध बन्द्याद्या ये चान्ये संकरोद्भवाः ..
तेऽपि यांत्युत्तमं स्थानं पुराणश्रवणाद्विभो .. 33 ..
text_mt: Sūtas, Māgadhas, bards, and others who are of mixed birth / also go to the supreme state from hearing the Purāṇa, O lord.

sanskrit_iast:
itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ na tvanyatpāvanaṃ nṛṇām ..
yeṣāṃ śravaṇamātreṇa mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
इतिहासपुराणाभ्यां न त्वन्यत्पावनं नृणाम् ..
येषां श्रवणमात्रेण मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः .. 34 ..
text_mt: There is nothing more purifying for men than the Itihāsa and Purāṇa, / merely by hearing which one is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhinā rājaśārdūla śṛṇvatāṃ yatphalaṃ kila ..
yathoktaṃ nātra saṃdehaḥ paṭhatāṃ ca viśāṃpate .. 35 .. ..
meaning:
विधिना राजशार्दूल शृण्वतां यत्फलं किल ..
यथोक्तं नात्र संदेहः पठतां च विशांपते .. 35 .. ..
text_mt: Whatever fruit is told for those listening according to rule, O tiger among kings, / is as stated, without doubt, and for those reading it, O ruler of the people.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śatānīka uvāca .. ..
bhagavankena vidhinā śrotavyaṃ bhārataṃ naraiḥ ..
caritaṃ rāmabhadrasya purāṇāni viśeṣataḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
.. शतानीक उवाच .. ..
भगवन्केन विधिना श्रोतव्यं भारतं नरैः ..
चरितं रामभद्रस्य पुराणानि विशेषतः .. 36 ..
text_mt: Śatānīka said: / Blessed one, by what rule should the Bhārata be heard by men, / the deeds of Rāmabhadra, and especially the Purāṇas?

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ tu vaiṣṇavā dharmāḥ śivadharmā aśeṣataḥ ..
saurāṇāṃ cāpi viprendra ucyatāṃ śravaṇe vidhiḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
कथं तु वैष्णवा धर्माः शिवधर्मा अशेषतः ..
सौराणां चापि विप्रेन्द्र उच्यतां श्रवणे विधिः .. 37 ..
text_mt: How are the Vaiṣṇava teachings, the Śaiva teachings in their entirety, / and those of the Sauras [to be heard], O foremost of brāhmaṇas? Let the rule for hearing be told.

sanskrit_iast:
vācanīyaṃ kathaṃ cāpi vācako dvijasattama ..
lakṣaṇaṃ cāsya me brūhi vācakasya mahātmanaḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
वाचनीयं कथं चापि वाचको द्विजसत्तम ..
लक्षणं चास्य मे ब्रूहि वाचकस्य महात्मनः .. 38 ..
text_mt: And how is it to be recited? What kind is the reciter, O best of the twice-born? / Tell me the characteristics of this noble reciter.

sanskrit_iast:
svarūpaṃ cāsya me brūhi khaṣolkasya mahātmanaḥ ..
phalaṃ ca pūjite kiṃ syādvācake vidhivaddvija .. .. 39 ..
meaning:
स्वरूपं चास्य मे ब्रूहि खषोल्कस्य महात्मनः ..
फलं च पूजिते किं स्याद्वाचके विधिवद्द्विज .. .. 39 ..
text_mt: Tell me the true form of this noble Khaṣolka, / and what fruit would come when the reciter is worshipped according to rule, O twice-born?

sanskrit_iast:
pāraṇepāraṇe pūjyo vācakaḥ śrāvakaiḥ katham ..
samāpte bhagavankiṃkiṃ deyaṃ parvaṇi vācake .. 1.216.40 ..
meaning:
पारणेपारणे पूज्यो वाचकः श्रावकैः कथम् ..
समाप्ते भगवन्किंकिं देयं पर्वणि वाचके .. 1.216.40 ..
text_mt: At each completion of a fast, how should the reciter be honoured by the listeners? / When it is concluded, blessed one, what should be given to the reciter at the occasion?

sanskrit_iast:
na ca kiṃ kāryasiddhaṃ yatsiddhaṃ parvaṇi parvaṇi ..
.. sumanturuvāca .. ..
samyakpṛṣṭo'smi rājendra itihāsapurāṇayoḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
न च किं कार्यसिद्धं यत्सिद्धं पर्वणि पर्वणि ..
.. सुमन्तुरुवाच .. ..
सम्यक्पृष्टोऽस्मि राजेन्द्र इतिहासपुराणयोः .. 41 ..
text_mt: And what task is accomplished that is perfected at each occasion? / Sumantu said: / I have been questioned well, O ruler of kings, on the Itihāsa and Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śravaṇe tu mahābāho śrūyatāṃ yanmayā purā ..
pṛṣṭo vocanmahātejā viriṃco bhagavānguruḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
श्रवणे तु महाबाहो श्रूयतां यन्मया पुरा ..
पृष्टो वोचन्महातेजा विरिंचो भगवान्गुरुः .. 42 ..
text_mt: Regarding hearing them, O mighty-armed one, hear what formerly, / when asked by me, the blessed teacher, brilliant Viriñci, spoke.

sanskrit_iast:
haṃta te kathayāmyeṣa purāṇaśravaṇe vidhim ..
itihāsapurāṇāni śrutvā bhaktyā viśeṣataḥ ..
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo brahmahatyādibhirvibho .. 43 ..
meaning:
हंत ते कथयाम्येष पुराणश्रवणे विधिम् ..
इतिहासपुराणानि श्रुत्वा भक्त्या विशेषतः ..
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो ब्रह्महत्यादिभिर्विभो .. 43 ..
text_mt:
Lo, I shall tell you the rule for hearing the Purāṇas.
Having heard the Itihāsas and Purāṇas, especially with devotion, / one is freed from all sins such as killing a brāhmaṇa, O mighty lord.

sanskrit_iast:
sāyaṃ prātastathā rātrau śucirbhūtvā śṛṇoti yaḥ ..
tasya viṣṇustathā brahmā tuṣyate śaṃkarastathā .. 44 ..
meaning:
सायं प्रातस्तथा रात्रौ शुचिर्भूत्वा शृणोति यः ..
तस्य विष्णुस्तथा ब्रह्मा तुष्यते शंकरस्तथा .. 44 ..
text_mt: He who, having become pure, listens in the evening, in the morning, and at night, / Viṣṇu, Brahmā, and Śaṅkara are pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyūṣe bhagavānbrahmā dināṃte tuṣyate hariḥ ..
mahādevastathā rātrau śṛṇvatāṃ tuṣyate vibhuḥ ..
pāraṇāni daśāheṣu eke kurvaṃti tāni bhoḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
प्रत्यूषे भगवान्ब्रह्मा दिनांते तुष्यते हरिः ..
महादेवस्तथा रात्रौ शृण्वतां तुष्यते विभुः ..
पारणानि दशाहेषु एके कुर्वंति तानि भोः .. 45 ..
text_mt:
At dawn the lord Brahmā is pleased, at day's end Hari is pleased; / likewise at night the all-pervading Mahādeva is pleased with those who listen.
Some perform concluding feasts on the tenth days, O lord;

sanskrit_iast:
bhavedvai rājaśārdūla śṛṇu teṣāṃ ca yatphalam ..
vidhānaṃ vācakasyeha śṛṇvatāṃ ca viśāṃpate..46..
meaning:
भवेद्वै राजशार्दूल शृणु तेषां च यत्फलम् ..
विधानं वाचकस्येह शृण्वतां च विशांपते..46..
text_mt: it may be so indeed, O tiger among kings; listen to their fruit, / and to the rule here for the reciter and for the listeners, O ruler of subjects.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhavāsā gṛhādetya sthānaṃ yatsamayānvitam ..
pradakṣiṇaṃ tato gatvā yastasmindeva eva hi .. 47 ..
meaning:
शुद्धवासा गृहादेत्य स्थानं यत्समयान्वितम् ..
प्रदक्षिणं ततो गत्वा यस्तस्मिन्देव एव हि .. 47 ..
text_mt: Having come from home wearing clean clothes to the place that is properly arranged, / and having then circumambulated whichever deity is present there,

sanskrit_iast:
nātyuccaṃ nātinīcaṃ ca hyāsanaṃ bhajate tataḥ ..
āsanaṃ tasya vai rājanbodhakasya sadā bhavet .. 48 ..
meaning:
नात्युच्चं नातिनीचं च ह्यासनं भजते ततः ..
आसनं तस्य वै राजन्बोधकस्य सदा भवेत् .. 48 ..
text_mt:
he then takes a seat that is neither too high nor too low.
That seat indeed, O king, should always belong to the instructor.

sanskrit_iast:
vandanīyaṃ prapūjya ca śrotṛbhiḥ kurunandana ..
vyāsapīṭhaṃ tu tatproktaṃ gurorāsanamādiśet .. 49 ..
meaning:
वन्दनीयं प्रपूज्य च श्रोतृभिः कुरुनन्दन ..
व्यासपीठं तु तत्प्रोक्तं गुरोरासनमादिशेत् .. 49 ..
text_mt:
It should be revered and worshipped by the listeners, O scion of the Kurus.
It is declared to be the seat of Vyāsa; one should designate it as the seat of the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
na stheyaṃ śrāvakaistasmādvācakasyāsane nṛpa ..
rājāsane yathā bhṛtyairyathā putraiḥ piturnṛpa .. 1.216.50 ..
meaning:
न स्थेयं श्रावकैस्तस्माद्वाचकस्यासने नृप ..
राजासने यथा भृत्यैर्यथा पुत्रैः पितुर्नृप .. 1.216.50 ..
text_mt: Therefore the listeners must not remain on the seat of the reciter, O king, / just as servants do not remain on a king's seat, or sons on their father's, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
yathā śiśurgurorvīra sa teṣāṃ hi gururmataḥ ..
devārcāmagrataḥ kṛtvā brāhmaṇārcāṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
यथा शिशुर्गुरोर्वीर स तेषां हि गुरुर्मतः ..
देवार्चामग्रतः कृत्वा ब्राह्मणार्चां विशेषतः .. 51 ..
text_mt:
just as a child [does not remain on the seat] of his guru, O hero, for he is regarded as their guru.
Having first performed the worship of the gods, especially the worship of brāhmaṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
upa viśya tataḥ paścācchrāvakaḥ śṛṇuyānnṛpa ..
samastānāgatānkṛtvā tataḥ pustakamādadet .. 52 ..
meaning:
उप विश्य ततः पश्चाच्छ्रावकः शृणुयान्नृप ..
समस्तानागतान्कृत्वा ततः पुस्तकमाददेत् .. 52 ..
text_mt:
and having seated himself thereafter, the listener should listen, O king.
Having ensured that all have arrived, he should then take up the manuscript.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya śirasā tasya pustakasya viśāṃpate ..
graṃthiṃ ca śithilāṃ kuryādvācakaḥ kurunandana ..
punarbadhnīta tatsūtraṃ tanmuktvā vācayetkvacit .. 53 ..
meaning:
प्रणम्य शिरसा तस्य पुस्तकस्य विशांपते ..
ग्रंथिं च शिथिलां कुर्याद्वाचकः कुरुनन्दन ..
पुनर्बध्नीत तत्सूत्रं तन्मुक्त्वा वाचयेत्क्वचित् .. 53 ..
text_mt:
Having bowed with his head to that manuscript, O ruler of subjects, / the reciter should loosen its knot, O scion of the Kurus.
He should bind that cord again, or having released it, he may recite anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
trividhaṃ pustakaṃ vidyātsūtraṃ vāsukirucyate ..
patrāṇi bhagavānbrahmā akṣarāṇi janārdanaḥ ..54..
meaning:
त्रिविधं पुस्तकं विद्यात्सूत्रं वासुकिरुच्यते ..
पत्राणि भगवान्ब्रह्मा अक्षराणि जनार्दनः ..54..
text_mt: One should know that the manuscript has a threefold nature: the cord is said to be Vāsuki, / the leaves are the lord Brahmā, and the syllables are Janārdana.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkaraśca tathā sūtraṃ paṃktayaḥ sarvadevatāḥ ..
pāvakaśca tathā sūtre madhye bhānuḥ samāśritaḥ ..55..
meaning:
शंकरश्च तथा सूत्रं पंक्तयः सर्वदेवताः ..
पावकश्च तथा सूत्रे मध्ये भानुः समाश्रितः ..55..
text_mt:
And Śaṅkara is the cord; the lines are all the deities;
Agni is in the cord, and the Sun resides in the middle.

sanskrit_iast:
agre sthitā grahāḥ sarve diśo vāpi tathā vibho ..
smṛto meruḥ sadā śaṃkuśchidramākāśamucyate ..56..
meaning:
अग्रे स्थिता ग्रहाः सर्वे दिशो वापि तथा विभो ..
स्मृतो मेरुः सदा शंकुश्छिद्रमाकाशमुच्यते ..56..
text_mt:
All the planets stand in front, or likewise the directions, O mighty lord.
The pin is always traditionally remembered as Meru; the hole is said to be space.

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃtradvayaṃ kāṣṭhamayamadhordhvaṃ yadudāhṛtam ..
dyāvāpṛthivyośca śaṃkhastathā caṃdra udāhṛtaḥ ..57..
meaning:
यंत्रद्वयं काष्ठमयमधोर्ध्वं यदुदाहृतम् ..
द्यावापृथिव्योश्च शंखस्तथा चंद्र उदाहृतः ..57..
text_mt: The pair of wooden boards, which are spoken of as lower and upper, / are Heaven and Earth; the conch is said to be the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ devamayaṃ hyetatpustakaṃ devapūjitam ..
namasyaṃ pūjanīyañca gṛhe sthāpyaṃ vibhūtaye.. 58 ..
meaning:
इत्थं देवमयं ह्येतत्पुस्तकं देवपूजितम् ..
नमस्यं पूजनीयञ्च गृहे स्थाप्यं विभूतये.. 58 ..
text_mt:
Thus this manuscript is composed of the gods and worshipped by the gods.
It is to be saluted, worshipped, and kept in the house for prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
yo'sya sūtraṃ bṛhatkṛtvā prayacchati narottamaḥ ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo divākaraḥ..59..
meaning:
योऽस्य सूत्रं बृहत्कृत्वा प्रयच्छति नरोत्तमः ..
स याति परमं स्थानं यत्र देवो दिवाकरः..59..
text_mt: That best of men who, having made its cord large, offers it, / goes to the supreme realm where the god Sun resides.

sanskrit_iast:
nirūpya pātraṃ rājendra karābhyāṃ gṛhya vācakaḥ ..
praṇamya śirasā sarvānbrahmādīnvyāsameva ca ..
vālmīkiṃ ca tathā rājanvidhiṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ ravim..1.216.60..
meaning:
निरूप्य पात्रं राजेन्द्र कराभ्यां गृह्य वाचकः ..
प्रणम्य शिरसा सर्वान्ब्रह्मादीन्व्यासमेव च ..
वाल्मीकिं च तथा राजन्विधिं विष्णुं शिवं रविम्..1.216.60..
text_mt: Having inspected the page, O best of kings, and taking it with both hands, / the reciter, bowing with his head to all, beginning with Brahmā, and to Vyāsa,

sanskrit_iast:
namaskāramathaiṣāṃ tu paṭhitvā kurunaṃdana..
tatosau vyāharedviprānvācakaḥ śradayānvitaḥ61.. .
alaṃbitamatastabdhamadbhutaṃ vīramūrjitam ..
asaṃsaktākṣarapadaṃ rasabhāvasamanvitam .. 62 ..
meaning:
नमस्कारमथैषां तु पठित्वा कुरुनंदन..
ततोसौ व्याहरेद्विप्रान्वाचकः श्रदयान्वितः61.. .
अलंबितमतस्तब्धमद्भुतं वीरमूर्जितम् ..
असंसक्ताक्षरपदं रसभावसमन्वितम् .. 62 ..
text_mt: and likewise, O king, to Vālmīki, to the Creator, to Viṣṇu, to Śiva, and to the Sun, / and having recited their homage, O scion of the Kurus, / that reciter, endowed with faith, should then address the brāhmaṇas: / unhurried, not stiff, wondrous, heroic, energetic, / with words and syllables distinct, endowed with aesthetic flavors and emotional states,

sanskrit_iast:
saptasvarasamāyuktaṃ kālekāle viśāṃpate ..
pradarśayanrasāntsarvānvācako vyāharennṛpa .. 63 ..
meaning:
सप्तस्वरसमायुक्तं कालेकाले विशांपते ..
प्रदर्शयन्रसान्त्सर्वान्वाचको व्याहरेन्नृप .. 63 ..
text_mt: endowed with the seven musical notes, at the proper times, O ruler of subjects; / displaying all aesthetic flavors, the reciter should speak, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
īdṛśādvācakādviprācchrutvā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
itihāsapurāṇāni rāmasya caritaṃ tathā.. 64..
meaning:
ईदृशाद्वाचकाद्विप्राच्छ्रुत्वा श्रद्धासमन्वितः ..
इतिहासपुराणानि रामस्य चरितं तथा.. 64..
text_mt: Having heard from such a brāhmaṇa reciter, endowed with faith, / the Itihāsas and Purāṇas, as well as the deeds of Rāma,

sanskrit_iast:
niyamasthaḥ śuciḥ śrotā śṛṇuyātphalamaśnute ..
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdraścāpi viśeṣataḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
नियमस्थः शुचिः श्रोता शृणुयात्फलमश्नुते ..
ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यः शूद्रश्चापि विशेषतः .. 65 ..
text_mt:
the listener, established in rules and pure, who listens enjoys the fruit:
a brāhmaṇa, a kṣatriya, a vaiśya, and especially a śūdra.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvamedhamavāpnoti sarvānkāmānavāpnute ..
rogaiśca mucyate sarvairmahatpuṇyaṃ ca viṃdati ..
gacchedvāpi paraṃ sthānaṃ devasyādbhutamuttamam ..66..
meaning:
अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुते ..
रोगैश्च मुच्यते सर्वैर्महत्पुण्यं च विंदति ..
गच्छेद्वापि परं स्थानं देवस्याद्भुतमुत्तमम् ..66..
text_mt: He attains the horse sacrifice, he attains all desires, / he is freed from all diseases, and he obtains great religious merit; / or he may go to the supreme, wonderful, excellent realm of the god.

sanskrit_iast:
snātairgṛhaṃ samāgamya śrotṛbhirvācakasya tu ..
praṇamya śirasā vipraṃ vācakaṃ śraddhayā nṛpa..67..
meaning:
स्नातैर्गृहं समागम्य श्रोतृभिर्वाचकस्य तु ..
प्रणम्य शिरसा विप्रं वाचकं श्रद्धया नृप..67..
text_mt: Having bathed and assembled at the house of the reciter, / the listeners, bowing with the head to the brāhmaṇa reciter with faith, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
āsanaṃ ca samāśritya sthātavyaṃ vācakasya tu..
saṃmukhaṃ rājaśārdūla vāgyataiḥ susamāhitaiḥ..68..
meaning:
आसनं च समाश्रित्य स्थातव्यं वाचकस्य तु..
संमुखं राजशार्दूल वाग्यतैः सुसमाहितैः..68..
text_mt: and taking a seat facing the reciter, / they should remain, O tiger among kings, restrained in speech and thoroughly composed.

sanskrit_iast:
vācakena namaskāre kṛte vyāsasya bhūpate..
na vaktavyaṃ mahābāho śrāvakaiḥ saṃśayādṛte ..69..
meaning:
वाचकेन नमस्कारे कृते व्यासस्य भूपते..
न वक्तव्यं महाबाहो श्रावकैः संशयादृते ..69..
text_mt: When the reciter has made his salutation to Vyāsa, O lord of the earth, / nothing should be spoken by the listeners, O mighty-armed one, except for a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃśaye sati praṣṭavyo vācakaḥ saṃprasādya tu ..
yataśca sa gurusteṣāṃ dharmato baṃdhurucyate..1.216.70..
meaning:
संशये सति प्रष्टव्यो वाचकः संप्रसाद्य तु ..
यतश्च स गुरुस्तेषां धर्मतो बंधुरुच्यते..1.216.70..
text_mt: When there is a doubt, the reciter is to be questioned after propitiating him, / for he is their guru and is called their kin according to dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
vācakenāpi vaktavyaṃ yatsyātteṣāṃ nibodhanam ..
anugrahāya sarveṣāmaśeṣā guravo nṛpa .. 71 ..
meaning:
वाचकेनापि वक्तव्यं यत्स्यात्तेषां निबोधनम् ..
अनुग्रहाय सर्वेषामशेषा गुरवो नृप .. 71 ..
text_mt:
And the reciter should speak that which will bring about their comprehension;
for gurus, without exception, are for the grace of all, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
namaskārādayaḥ śrāvyā śivamastviti vodyate ..
vāgyatairnṛpaśārdla varṇaiḥ sarvairmahīpate..72..
meaning:
नमस्कारादयः श्राव्या शिवमस्त्विति वोद्यते ..
वाग्यतैर्नृपशार्द्ल वर्णैः सर्वैर्महीपते..72..
text_mt: Salutations and the like are to be made heard, saying 'May there be auspiciousness,' / with restrained speech, by all the social classes, O tiger among kings, O lord of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrāṇāṃ purato vaiśyā vaiśyānāṃ kṣatriṇastathā ..
madhyasthito'tha sarveṣāṃ vācako vyāharennṛpa ..
ye ca saṃkarajā rājannarāste śūdrapṛṣṭhataḥ .. 73 ..
meaning:
शूद्राणां पुरतो वैश्या वैश्यानां क्षत्रिणस्तथा ..
मध्यस्थितोऽथ सर्वेषां वाचको व्याहरेन्नृप ..
ये च संकरजा राजन्नरास्ते शूद्रपृष्ठतः .. 73 ..

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaṃ vācakaṃ vidyānnānyavarṇajamādaret ..
śrutvānyavarṇajādvācaṃ vācakānnarakaṃ vrajet .. 74 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणं वाचकं विद्यान्नान्यवर्णजमादरेत् ..
श्रुत्वान्यवर्णजाद्वाचं वाचकान्नरकं व्रजेत् .. 74 ..
text_mt:
One should know the reciter to be a brāhmaṇa; one should not respect one born of another class.
Having heard the speech from a reciter born of another class, one would go to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ hi śṛṇvatāṃ teṣāṃ varṇānāmanupūrvaśaḥ ..
māsimāsi bhavedrājanpāraṇaṃ kurunandana .. 75 ..
meaning:
इत्थं हि शृण्वतां तेषां वर्णानामनुपूर्वशः ..
मासिमासि भवेद्राजन्पारणं कुरुनन्दन .. 75 ..
text_mt: For those classes who thus listen in due order, / month after month there should be a concluding feast, O king, O scion of the Kurus.

sanskrit_iast:
śreyo'rthamātmano rājanpūjayedvācakaṃ budhaḥ ..
māsi pūrṇe dvija śreṣṭhe dātavyaṃ svarṇamāṣakam .. 76 ..
meaning:
श्रेयोऽर्थमात्मनो राजन्पूजयेद्वाचकं बुधः ..
मासि पूर्णे द्विज श्रेष्ठे दातव्यं स्वर्णमाषकम् .. 76 ..
text_mt:
For the sake of his own welfare, O king, a wise man should worship the reciter.
When the month is completed, a gold māṣaka should be given to the best of the twice-born:

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇena mahābāho dve deye kṣatriyasya tu ..
vācakāya dvijaśreṣṭha vaiśyenāpi trayaṃ tathā .. 77 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणेन महाबाहो द्वे देये क्षत्रियस्य तु ..
वाचकाय द्विजश्रेष्ठ वैश्येनापि त्रयं तथा .. 77 ..
text_mt: by a brāhmaṇa, O mighty-armed one; but two are to be given by a kṣatriya / to the reciter, O best of the twice-born; and likewise three by a vaiśya,

sanskrit_iast:
śūdreṇaiva ca catvāro dātavyāḥ svarṇamāṣakāḥ ..
māsimāsi dvijaśreṣṭha śraddhayā vācakāya tu .. 78 ..
meaning:
शूद्रेणैव च चत्वारो दातव्याः स्वर्णमाषकाः ..
मासिमासि द्विजश्रेष्ठ श्रद्धया वाचकाय तु .. 78 ..
text_mt: and four gold māṣakas are to be given by a śūdra / month after month, O best of the twice-born, with faith to the reciter.

sanskrit_iast:
prathame pāraṇe rājanvācakaṃ pūjya śaktitaḥ ..
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ viṃdati mānavaḥ .. 79 ..
meaning:
प्रथमे पारणे राजन्वाचकं पूज्य शक्तितः ..
अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य फलं विंदति मानवः .. 79 ..
text_mt: At the first concluding feast, O king, having worshipped the reciter according to one's ability, / a man obtains the fruit of the Agniṣṭoma sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtikādīnsamārabhya yāvatkārttikamacyuta ..
agniṣṭomaṃ gosavaṃ ca jyotiṣṭomaṃ tathā nṛpa .. 1.216.80 ..
meaning:
कार्तिकादीन्समारभ्य यावत्कार्त्तिकमच्युत ..
अग्निष्टोमं गोसवं च ज्योतिष्टोमं तथा नृप .. 1.216.80 ..
text_mt: Beginning from Kārttika and so forth up to Kārttika, O infallible one, / [the fruit of] the Agniṣṭoma, the Gosava, and likewise the Jyotiṣṭoma, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
sautrāmaṇiṃ vājapeyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca tathā vibho ..
māheśvaraṃ tathā brāhmaṃ puṃḍarīkaṃ yajeta yaḥ .. 81 ..
meaning:
सौत्रामणिं वाजपेयं वैष्णवं च तथा विभो ..
माहेश्वरं तथा ब्राह्मं पुंडरीकं यजेत यः .. 81 ..
text_mt: the Sautrāmaṇī, the Vājapeya, and likewise the Vaiṣṇava, O mighty lord, / the Māheśvara, and likewise the Brāhma, and the Puṇḍarīka, which one might sacrifice,

sanskrit_iast:
ādityayajñasya tathā rājasūyāśvamedhayoḥ ..
phalaṃ prāpnoti rājeṃdra māsairdvādaśabhiḥ kramāt ..
itthaṃ yajñaphalaṃ prāpya yāti lokāṃstathottamān .. 82 ..
meaning:
आदित्ययज्ञस्य तथा राजसूयाश्वमेधयोः ..
फलं प्राप्नोति राजेंद्र मासैर्द्वादशभिः क्रमात् ..
इत्थं यज्ञफलं प्राप्य याति लोकांस्तथोत्तमान् .. 82 ..
text_mt:
as well as of the solar sacrifice, and of the Rājasūya and the horse sacrifice, / he obtains the fruit, O best of kings, through the twelve months in succession.
Having thus obtained the fruit of the sacrifices, he goes to the highest worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
vajravedikasaṃpannaṃ maṇiratnavibhūṣitam ..
vimānamāsthito rājanmodate śakramaṃdire .. 83 ..
meaning:
वज्रवेदिकसंपन्नं मणिरत्नविभूषितम् ..
विमानमास्थितो राजन्मोदते शक्रमंदिरे .. 83 ..
text_mt: Mounted upon a celestial chariot furnished with diamond altars / and adorned with gems and jewels, O king, he rejoices in the abode of Śakra.

sanskrit_iast:
tataścaṃdrasya bhavane vāruṇe bhavane tataḥ ..
śociṣkeśagṛhe gatvā gaccheccailavile gṛhe .. 84 ..
meaning:
ततश्चंद्रस्य भवने वारुणे भवने ततः ..
शोचिष्केशगृहे गत्वा गच्छेच्चैलविले गृहे .. 84 ..
text_mt: Then, having gone to the abode of Candra, then to the abode of Varuṇa, / to the house of Śociṣkeśa, he should go to the house of the son of Ilavilā.

sanskrit_iast:
dhiṣaṇasya gṛhaṃ gatvā tataścitraśikhaṃḍinaḥ ..
vṛddhaśravasamāsādya gacchetkaṃjajamaṃdire ..
evameva nṛpaśreṣṭha nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 85 ..
meaning:
धिषणस्य गृहं गत्वा ततश्चित्रशिखंडिनः ..
वृद्धश्रवसमासाद्य गच्छेत्कंजजमंदिरे ..
एवमेव नृपश्रेष्ठ नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 85 ..
text_mt: Having gone to the house of Dhiṣaṇa, then to that of Citraśikhaṇḍin, / reaching Vṛddhaśravas, he should go to the abode of the Lotus-Born. / Thus indeed, best of kings, no hesitation should be made in this matter.

sanskrit_iast:
phalametatsamuddiṣṭaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ satataṃ nṛṇām ..
etatphalaṃ vatsareṇa śṛṇvato vidhito nṛpa .. 86 ..
meaning:
फलमेतत्समुद्दिष्टं शृण्वतां सततं नृणाम् ..
एतत्फलं वत्सरेण शृण्वतो विधितो नृप .. 86 ..
text_mt: This fruit is declared for men who listen constantly; / this is the fruit for one who listens according to rule for a year, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
etāni parimāṇāni vatsareṇa bhavaṃti vai ..
śṛṇvatāṃ nṛpaśārdūla dadatāṃ vācakāya vai .. 87 ..
meaning:
एतानि परिमाणानि वत्सरेण भवंति वै ..
शृण्वतां नृपशार्दूल ददतां वाचकाय वै .. 87 ..
text_mt: These measures indeed come to pass in a year, / tiger among kings, for those who listen and give to the reciter.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaṃ ca dve tathā trīṇi catvāri ca viśāṃpate ..
deyāni vācakāyeha māsimāsi narādhipa .. 88 ..
meaning:
एकं च द्वे तथा त्रीणि चत्वारि च विशांपते ..
देयानि वाचकायेह मासिमासि नराधिप .. 88 ..
text_mt: One, two, three, and four, O lord of the people, / are to be given here to the reciter month by month, O ruler of men,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇādyairnṛpa śreṣṭha sarvavarṇavibhāgaśaḥ ..
samāpte parvaṇi tathā vācakaṃ pūjayetpunaḥ ..89..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाद्यैर्नृप श्रेष्ठ सर्ववर्णविभागशः ..
समाप्ते पर्वणि तथा वाचकं पूजयेत्पुनः ..89..
text_mt: by brāhmaṇas and the other castes according to their division, best of kings; / likewise, when the festival is completed, one should worship the reciter again.

sanskrit_iast:
vācakaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ caiva sarvakāmaiḥ prapūjayet ..
gandhamālyādibhirdivyairvā sobhirvividhairapi .. 1.216.90 ..
meaning:
वाचकं ब्राह्मणं चैव सर्वकामैः प्रपूजयेत् ..
गन्धमाल्यादिभिर्दिव्यैर्वा सोभिर्विविधैरपि .. 1.216.90 ..
text_mt: One should worship the reciter, a brāhmaṇa, with all desired offerings, / with heavenly scents, garlands, and the like, and also with various garments.

sanskrit_iast:
vācakāya pradattvā tu tato viprānprapūjayet ..
hiraṇyaṃ rajataṃ rukmaṃ gāśca kāṃsyopadohanāḥ ..91..
meaning:
वाचकाय प्रदत्त्वा तु ततो विप्रान्प्रपूजयेत् ..
हिरण्यं रजतं रुक्मं गाश्च कांस्योपदोहनाः ..91..
text_mt: Having given first to the reciter, one should then worship the brāhmaṇas / with gold, silver, gold coins, and cows that have bronze milking pails.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā ca vācakāyeha śrutasya prāpyate phalam ..
yathā sadakṣiṇaṃ cānnaṃ śrāddhakāle prakīrtitam ..
tathā śrutaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha sadakṣiṇamudāhṛtam .. 92 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वा च वाचकायेह श्रुतस्य प्राप्यते फलम् ..
यथा सदक्षिणं चान्नं श्राद्धकाले प्रकीर्तितम् ..
तथा श्रुतं नृपश्रेष्ठ सदक्षिणमुदाहृतम् .. 92 ..
text_mt: And having given to the reciter here, the fruit of what was heard is obtained; / just as food given at the time of a śrāddha is proclaimed to be accompanied by a sacrificial fee, / even so what is heard, best of kings, is declared to be accompanied by a sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast:
vācakaṃ pūjayedyasmā tpaścāllekhakapūjanam ..
samāpte parvaṇi vibho viśeṣeṇaiva cārcayet .. 93 ..
meaning:
वाचकं पूजयेद्यस्मा त्पश्चाल्लेखकपूजनम् ..
समाप्ते पर्वणि विभो विशेषेणैव चार्चयेत् .. 93 ..
text_mt: Since one should worship the reciter, after that comes the worship of the scribe; / when the festival is completed, O lord, one should worship him especially.

sanskrit_iast:
vācakaḥ pūjito yena pūjitāstena devatāḥ ..
vācake parituṣṭe ca mama prītiranuttamā ..94..
meaning:
वाचकः पूजितो येन पूजितास्तेन देवताः ..
वाचके परितुष्टे च मम प्रीतिरनुत्तमा ..94..
text_mt: By him by whom the reciter is worshipped, the deities are worshipped; / and when the reciter is fully pleased, my delight is unsurpassed.

sanskrit_iast:
iti vedhāḥ sadā prāha devānāṃ purataḥ purā ..
tasmiṃstuṣṭe jagatsarvaṃ tuṣṭaṃ bhavati nityaśaḥ....
tasmātprapūjayedvipra vācakaṃ nṛpa sattama ..
na tulyaṃ vācakeneha pātradānasya vidyate..96..
meaning:
इति वेधाः सदा प्राह देवानां पुरतः पुरा ..
तस्मिंस्तुष्टे जगत्सर्वं तुष्टं भवति नित्यशः....
तस्मात्प्रपूजयेद्विप्र वाचकं नृप सत्तम ..
न तुल्यं वाचकेनेह पात्रदानस्य विद्यते..96..
text_mt: Thus the Creator always spoke before the gods of old: / 'When he is pleased, the entire world is constantly pleased; / therefore one should worship the brāhmaṇa reciter, best of kings; / there is no recipient of gifts equal to the reciter in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
tiṣṭhaṃti yasya śāstrāṇi jihvāgre pṛthivīpate..
dṛṣṭaśca gocarastāta kastena sadṛśo dvijaḥ..97..
meaning:
तिष्ठंति यस्य शास्त्राणि जिह्वाग्रे पृथिवीपते..
दृष्टश्च गोचरस्तात कस्तेन सदृशो द्विजः..97..
text_mt: On the tip of whose tongue the scriptures reside, O lord of the earth, / and who has seen what lies within their scope, dear one, what twice-born man is equal to him?

sanskrit_iast:
na tulyaṃ vidyate tena bhuvi pātraṃ nareṣu vai ..
tasmādannaṃ sadā pūrvaṃ tasmai deyaṃ vidurbudhāḥ ..
śrāddhe yasya dvijo bhuṃkte vācakaḥ śradayānvitaḥ ..
bhavaṃti pitarastasya tṛptā varṣaśataṃ nṛpa ..98..
meaning:
न तुल्यं विद्यते तेन भुवि पात्रं नरेषु वै ..
तस्मादन्नं सदा पूर्वं तस्मै देयं विदुर्बुधाः ..
श्राद्धे यस्य द्विजो भुंक्ते वाचकः श्रदयान्वितः ..
भवंति पितरस्तस्य तृप्ता वर्षशतं नृप ..98..
text_mt: No recipient among men on earth is found equal to him; / therefore the wise know that food should always be given to him first. / At whose śrāddha the twice-born reciter eats endowed with faith, / his ancestors remain satisfied for a hundred years, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
yatheha sarvadevānāṃ bhāskaraḥ pravaraḥ smṛtaḥ ..
vispaṣṭamadbhutaṃ śāṃtaṃ spaṣṭākṣarapadaṃ tathā ..
kalasvarasamāyuktaṃ rasabhāvasamanvitam .. 99 ..
meaning:
यथेह सर्वदेवानां भास्करः प्रवरः स्मृतः ..
विस्पष्टमद्भुतं शांतं स्पष्टाक्षरपदं तथा ..
कलस्वरसमायुक्तं रसभावसमन्वितम् .. 99 ..
text_mt: Just as the Sun is recalled as the foremost of all the gods here, / [so is he who recites] distinctly, wondrously, calmly, with clear syllables and words, / endowed with a sweet tone, accompanied by aesthetic flavor and emotion,

sanskrit_iast:
budhyamānaḥ sadātyarthaṃ graṃthāthaṃ kṛtsnaśo nṛpa ..
brāhmaṇādiṣu varṇeṣu graṃthārthaṃ vācayennṛpa .. 1.216.100 ..
meaning:
बुध्यमानः सदात्यर्थं ग्रंथाथं कृत्स्नशो नृप ..
ब्राह्मणादिषु वर्णेषु ग्रंथार्थं वाचयेन्नृप .. 1.216.100 ..
text_mt: always understanding the meaning of the text exceedingly well in its entirety, O king; / he should recite the meaning of the text among the castes beginning with the brāhmaṇas, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
ya evaṃ vācayedrājanya vipro vyāsa ucyate ..
ato'nyathā kathayitā jñeyo'sau vaktṛnāmakaḥ .. 101 ..
meaning:
य एवं वाचयेद्राजन्य विप्रो व्यास उच्यते ..
अतोऽन्यथा कथयिता ज्ञेयोऽसौ वक्तृनामकः .. 101 ..
text_mt: The brāhmaṇa who recites in this manner, O king, is called a Vyāsa; / one who relates otherwise should be known merely by the name of speaker.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃbhūto vasedyasminvācako vyāsasannibhaḥ ..
deśe'tha pattane rājansa deśaḥ pravaraḥ smṛtaḥ .. 102 ..
meaning:
इत्थंभूतो वसेद्यस्मिन्वाचको व्याससन्निभः ..
देशेऽथ पत्तने राजन्स देशः प्रवरः स्मृतः .. 102 ..
text_mt: In whichever country or city such a reciter, like unto Vyāsa, should dwell, / O king, that country is recalled as foremost.

sanskrit_iast:
te dhanyāste mahātmānaste kṛtārthā na saṃśayaḥ ..
vasaṃti yatnato yasminsa deśaḥ pravaraḥ smṛtaḥ .. 103 ..
meaning:
ते धन्यास्ते महात्मानस्ते कृतार्था न संशयः ..
वसंति यत्नतो यस्मिन्स देशः प्रवरः स्मृतः .. 103 ..
text_mt: They are fortunate, they are great-souled, they have achieved their purpose—there is no doubt— / who dwell with effort where he lives; that country is recalled as foremost.

sanskrit_iast:
na śobhate puraṃ vīra vyāsahīnaṃ kadācana ..
yathārkahīnaṃ hi dinaṃ caṃdrahīnā yathā niśā .. 104 ..
meaning:
न शोभते पुरं वीर व्यासहीनं कदाचन ..
यथार्कहीनं हि दिनं चंद्रहीना यथा निशा .. 104 ..
text_mt: A city without a Vyāsa never shines, O hero, / just as a day without the sun, or a night without the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
na rājate saro yadvatpadminī rahitaṃ nṛpa ..
tathā vyāsavihīnaṃ tu rājate na puraṃ kvacit .. 105 ..
meaning:
न राजते सरो यद्वत्पद्मिनी रहितं नृप ..
तथा व्यासविहीनं तु राजते न पुरं क्वचित् .. 105 ..
text_mt: Just as a lake does not look splendid without a lotus plant, O king, / even so a city devoid of a Vyāsa never looks splendid anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya vācakaṃ bhaktyā yatphalaṃ prāpyate naraiḥ ..
na tatkratusahasreṇa prāpyate kurunaṃdana .. 1 0 6 ..
meaning:
प्रणम्य वाचकं भक्त्या यत्फलं प्राप्यते नरैः ..
न तत्क्रतुसहस्रेण प्राप्यते कुरुनंदन .. 1 0 6 ..
text_mt: The fruit that is obtained by men having bowed with devotion to the reciter / cannot be obtained by a thousand sacrifices, O delight of the Kurus.

sanskrit_iast:
yathaikato grahāḥ sarve ekatastu divākaraḥ ..
tathaikato dvijāḥ sarve ekatastu sa vācakaḥ .. 107 ..
meaning:
यथैकतो ग्रहाः सर्वे एकतस्तु दिवाकरः ..
तथैकतो द्विजाः सर्वे एकतस्तु स वाचकः .. 107 ..
text_mt: Just as on one side are all the planets and on the other is the Sun, / so on one side are all twice-born men and on the other is the reciter.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā vedasamo nāsti āgamo bhuvi kaścana ..
tathā vyāsasamo nāsti brāhmaṇo bhuvi kaścana .. 108 ..
meaning:
यथा वेदसमो नास्ति आगमो भुवि कश्चन ..
तथा व्याससमो नास्ति ब्राह्मणो भुवि कश्चन .. 108 ..
text_mt: Just as there is no traditional scripture on earth equal to the Veda, / so there is no brāhmaṇa on earth equal to a Vyāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
kurukṣetrasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na dvitīyaṃ pracakṣate ..
na nadī gaṃgayā tulyā na devo bhāskarādvaraḥ ..109..
meaning:
कुरुक्षेत्रसमं तीर्थं न द्वितीयं प्रचक्षते ..
न नदी गंगया तुल्या न देवो भास्कराद्वरः ..109..
text_mt: They declare that there is no second sacred place equal to Kurukṣetra; / there is no river equal to the Gaṅgā, and no god superior to the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
nāśvamedhasamaṃ puṇyaṃ na pāpaṃ brahmahatyayā ..
putrajanmasukhaistulyaṃ na sukhaṃ vidyate yathā ..1.216.11 0..
meaning:
नाश्वमेधसमं पुण्यं न पापं ब्रह्महत्यया ..
पुत्रजन्मसुखैस्तुल्यं न सुखं विद्यते यथा ..1.216.11 0..
text_mt: There is no merit equal to the horse sacrifice, no sin equal to the killing of a brāhmaṇa, / and just as there is no pleasure equal to the pleasures from the birth of a son,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā vyāsasamo vipro na kvacitprāpyate nṛpa ..
daive karmaṇi pitrye ca pāvanaḥ paramo nṛṇām .. 111 ..
meaning:
तथा व्याससमो विप्रो न क्वचित्प्राप्यते नृप ..
दैवे कर्मणि पित्र्ये च पावनः परमो नृणाम् .. 111 ..
text_mt: even so a brāhmaṇa equal to a Vyāsa is found nowhere, O king; / in rites for the gods and in rites for the ancestors, he is the supreme purifier of men.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsti vyāsasamaḥ śreṣṭha itīyaṃ vaidikī śrutiḥ ..
atha viprasahasrāṇāṃ vipro'yaṃ śreṣṭha īritaḥ ..
upaviṣṭo yadā bhuṃkte vyāso vai vipramaṇḍale ..112..
meaning:
नास्ति व्याससमः श्रेष्ठ इतीयं वैदिकी श्रुतिः ..
अथ विप्रसहस्राणां विप्रोऽयं श्रेष्ठ ईरितः ..
उपविष्टो यदा भुंक्ते व्यासो वै विप्रमण्डले ..112..
text_mt: 'There is none equal to a Vyāsa, he is the best'—such is this Vedic revelation. / Now among thousands of brāhmaṇas, this brāhmaṇa is declared the foremost; / when a Vyāsa sits and eats in a gathering of brāhmaṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhe tāta pavitrāṇi kathitāni purā mama..
brahmaṇā rājaśārdūla śṛṇu tāni yathāvidhi ..113..
meaning:
श्राद्धे तात पवित्राणि कथितानि पुरा मम..
ब्रह्मणा राजशार्दूल शृणु तानि यथाविधि ..113..
text_mt: the purifying items at a śrāddha were told to me of old, dear one, / by Brahmā, O tiger among kings; hear them according to rule:

sanskrit_iast:
madhu pāyasaṃ kālaśākastilāśca kutapastathā ..
rājataṃ cāpi pātreṣu brāhmaṇeṣvatha vācakaḥ ..114..
meaning:
मधु पायसं कालशाकस्तिलाश्च कुतपस्तथा ..
राजतं चापि पात्रेषु ब्राह्मणेष्वथ वाचकः ..114..
text_mt: honey, rice pudding, black mustard greens, sesame seeds, and the kutapa hour, / and silver among vessels, and the reciter among brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
daive karmaṇi pitrye ca sa jñeyaḥ paṃktipāvanaḥ ..
vācakaśca yatiścaiva tathā yaśca ṣaḍaṃgavit .. 115 ..
meaning:
दैवे कर्मणि पित्र्ये च स ज्ञेयः पंक्तिपावनः ..
वाचकश्च यतिश्चैव तथा यश्च षडंगवित् .. 115 ..
text_mt: In rites for the gods and in rites for the ancestors, he should be known as one who purifies the row; / the reciter, the ascetic, and he who knows the six auxiliaries of the Veda—

sanskrit_iast:
ete sarve nṛpaśreṣṭha vijñeyāḥ paṃktipāvanāḥ ..
nāmanī vācakasyaite śṛṅgavārthamathaitayoḥ .. 116 ..
meaning:
एते सर्वे नृपश्रेष्ठ विज्ञेयाः पंक्तिपावनाः ..
नामनी वाचकस्यैते शृङ्गवार्थमथैतयोः .. 116 ..
text_mt: all these, best of kings, are to be known as purifiers of the row. / These are the two names of the reciter; now hear the meaning of both:

sanskrit_iast:
itihāsapurāṇāni jayeti viditāni vai ..
upajīvati yasmādvai vācayāno dvijo nṛpa ..
jayopajīvī tenāsau gataḥ khyātiṃ tu vācakaḥ .. 117 ..
meaning:
इतिहासपुराणानि जयेति विदितानि वै ..
उपजीवति यस्माद्वै वाचयानो द्विजो नृप ..
जयोपजीवी तेनासौ गतः ख्यातिं तु वाचकः .. 117 ..
text_mt: the histories and purāṇas are indeed known as 'Jaya'; / since the twice-born man makes his living by reciting them, O king, / that reciter has therefore attained renown as 'living by Jaya'.

sanskrit_iast:
vispaṣṭamadbhutaṃ śāṃtaṃ spaṣṭākṣaramidaṃ tathā ..
kalasvarasamāyuktaṃ rasabhāvasamanvitam..118..
meaning:
विस्पष्टमद्भुतं शांतं स्पष्टाक्षरमिदं तथा ..
कलस्वरसमायुक्तं रसभावसमन्वितम्..118..
text_mt: Distinctly, wondrously, calmly, with this text having clear syllables, / endowed with a sweet tone, accompanied by aesthetic flavor and emotion,

sanskrit_iast:
yudhyamānotha vātyarthaṃ graṃthārthaṃ kṛtsnaśo nṛpa ..
brāhmaṇādiṣu varṇeṣu graṃthārthaṃ cārpayettathā .. 119 ..
meaning:
युध्यमानोथ वात्यर्थं ग्रंथार्थं कृत्स्नशो नृप ..
ब्राह्मणादिषु वर्णेषु ग्रंथार्थं चार्पयेत्तथा .. 119 ..
text_mt: or grasping exceedingly well the meaning of the text in its entirety, O king, / he should also impart the meaning of the text among the castes beginning with the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
ya evaṃ vācayedrājanya vipro vyāsa ucyate ..
ato'nyathā vācayitā na gacchedvyāsatāṃ kvacit .. 1.216.120 ..
meaning:
य एवं वाचयेद्राजन्य विप्रो व्यास उच्यते ..
अतोऽन्यथा वाचयिता न गच्छेद्व्यासतां क्वचित् .. 1.216.120 ..
text_mt: The brāhmaṇa who recites in this manner, O king, is called a Vyāsa; / one who recites otherwise would never attain the status of a Vyāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
trividhaṃ vācakaṃ vidyātsadā guṇavibhedataḥ ..
śrāvakaṃ ca mahābāho trividhaṃ guṇabhedataḥ .. 121 ..
meaning:
त्रिविधं वाचकं विद्यात्सदा गुणविभेदतः ..
श्रावकं च महाबाहो त्रिविधं गुणभेदतः .. 121 ..
text_mt: One should know the reciter to be of three kinds, according to the distinction of the guṇas; / and the hearer, O mighty-armed one, is of three kinds according to the distinction of the guṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
dvāvetau kathyamānau tu nibodha gadato mama ..
abhidrutaṃ tathāspaṣṭaṃ vistaraṃ svaravarjitam ..122..
meaning:
द्वावेतौ कथ्यमानौ तु निबोध गदतो मम ..
अभिद्रुतं तथास्पष्टं विस्तरं स्वरवर्जितम् ..122..
text_mt: As these two are being described, understand from me as I speak: / hurried, indistinct, diffuse, devoid of tone,

sanskrit_iast:
padacchedavihīnaṃ ca tathā bhāvavivarjitam ..
abudhyamāno graṃthārthamabhīṣṭotsāhavarjitaḥ .. 123 ..
meaning:
पदच्छेदविहीनं च तथा भावविवर्जितम् ..
अबुध्यमानो ग्रंथार्थमभीष्टोत्साहवर्जितः .. 123 ..
text_mt: lacking word separation, devoid of feeling, / not understanding the meaning of the text, devoid of desirable enthusiasm—

sanskrit_iast:
īdṛśaṃ vācayedyastu vācakaḥ kṣmādhipeśvara ..
krodhano'priyavādī ca ajñānādgraṃthadūṣakaḥ .. 124 ..
meaning:
ईदृशं वाचयेद्यस्तु वाचकः क्ष्माधिपेश्वर ..
क्रोधनोऽप्रियवादी च अज्ञानाद्ग्रंथदूषकः .. 124 ..
text_mt: a reciter who recites in such a way, O lord of rulers of the earth, / wrathful, speaking unkind words, and corrupting the text through ignorance,

sanskrit_iast:
budhyate na ca kaṣṭācca sa jñeyo vācakādhamaḥ ..
vispaṣṭamadbhutaṃ śāṃtaṃ rasabhāvasamanvitam.. 125 ..
meaning:
बुध्यते न च कष्टाच्च स ज्ञेयो वाचकाधमः ..
विस्पष्टमद्भुतं शांतं रसभावसमन्वितम्.. 125 ..
text_mt: and does not understand it even with difficulty, he should be known as the lowest of reciters. / Distinctly, wonderfully, calmly, endowed with aesthetic flavor and emotion,

sanskrit_iast:
abudhyamāno graṃthārthaṃ vācayedyastu vācakaḥ ..
sa jñeyo rājaso rājannidānīṃ sāttvikaṃ śṛṇu .. 126 ..
meaning:
अबुध्यमानो ग्रंथार्थं वाचयेद्यस्तु वाचकः ..
स ज्ञेयो राजसो राजन्निदानीं सात्त्विकं शृणु .. 126 ..
text_mt: yet not understanding the meaning of the text—the reciter who recites thus / should be known as passionate, O king. Now hear about the virtuous one:

sanskrit_iast:
vispaṣṭamadbhutaṃ śāṃtaṃ spaṣṭākṣarapadaṃ tathā ..
kalasvarasamāyuktaṃ rasabhāvasamanvitam ..127 ..
meaning:
विस्पष्टमद्भुतं शांतं स्पष्टाक्षरपदं तथा ..
कलस्वरसमायुक्तं रसभावसमन्वितम् ..127 ..
text_mt: Distinctly, wonderfully, calmly, with syllables and words clearly articulated, / accompanied by a melodious tone, endowed with aesthetic flavor and emotion,

sanskrit_iast:
attyarthaṃ budhyamānastu graṃthārthaṃ kṛtsnaśo nṛpa ..
brāhmaṇādiṣu varṇeṣu ācāryo vidhivannṛpa .. 128 ..
meaning:
अत्त्यर्थं बुध्यमानस्तु ग्रंथार्थं कृत्स्नशो नृप ..
ब्राह्मणादिषु वर्णेषु आचार्यो विधिवन्नृप .. 128 ..
text_mt: deeply understanding the meaning of the text in its entirety, O king, / an ācārya according to rule among the social classes beginning with the brahmins, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
ya evaṃ vācayedrājansa jñeyaḥ sāttviko budhaiḥ ..
śraddhā bhaktivihīno yo lobhiṣṭhaḥ kaṭuko yathā .. 129 ..
meaning:
य एवं वाचयेद्राजन्स ज्ञेयः सात्त्विको बुधैः ..
श्रद्धा भक्तिविहीनो यो लोभिष्ठः कटुको यथा .. 129 ..
text_mt: he who recites in this manner, O king, should be known by the wise as virtuous. / He who is devoid of faith and devotion, excessively greedy, harsh,

sanskrit_iast:
hetuvādaparo rājaṃstathāsūyāsamanvitaḥ ..
nityāṃ naimittikāṃ kāmyāmādadaddakṣiṇāṃ nṛpa .. .. 1.216.130 ..
meaning:
हेतुवादपरो राजंस्तथासूयासमन्वितः ..
नित्यां नैमित्तिकां काम्यामाददद्दक्षिणां नृप .. .. 1.216.130 ..
text_mt: intent on contentious debate, O king, and full of malice, / taking regular, occasional, and desire-prompted sacrificial gifts, O king—

sanskrit_iast:
vācako yo mahābāho śṛṇuyādyastu mānavaḥ ..
sa jñeyastāmaso rājañchrāvako mānavo'pi saḥ .. 131 ..
meaning:
वाचको यो महाबाहो शृणुयाद्यस्तु मानवः ..
स ज्ञेयस्तामसो राजञ्छ्रावको मानवोऽपि सः .. 131 ..
text_mt: such a reciter, O mighty-armed one, and the man who listens to him, / should be known as dark, O king; and that human listener too [is dark].

sanskrit_iast:
na tasya purato vīra vācaye tprājña eva hi ..
prasaṃgācchṛṇuyādyastu śraddhābhaktivivarjitaḥ .. 132..
meaning:
न तस्य पुरतो वीर वाचये त्प्राज्ञ एव हि ..
प्रसंगाच्छृणुयाद्यस्तु श्रद्धाभक्तिविवर्जितः .. 132..
text_mt: A wise man should never recite before him, O hero. / But he who listens merely out of circumstance, devoid of faith and devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
rājankautukapātraṃ tu sa jñeyo rājaso bhavet ..
saṃtyajya sarvakāryāṇi bhaktyā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ .. 133 ..
meaning:
राजन्कौतुकपात्रं तु स ज्ञेयो राजसो भवेत् ..
संत्यज्य सर्वकार्याणि भक्त्या श्रद्धासमन्वितः .. 133 ..
text_mt: an object of curiosity, O king, he should be known as passionate. / Setting aside all tasks, with devotion and endowed with faith,

sanskrit_iast:
satataṃ pūjayedyastu vācakaṃ śraddhayā mudā ..
nitye naimittike kāmye gurūnvai devatāstathā .. 134 ..
meaning:
सततं पूजयेद्यस्तु वाचकं श्रद्धया मुदा ..
नित्ये नैमित्तिके काम्ये गुरून्वै देवतास्तथा .. 134 ..
text_mt: he who constantly honors the reciter with faith and joy / in regular, occasional, and desire-prompted [rites], as he would the gurus and deities,

sanskrit_iast:
ya evaṃ śṛṇuyādvīra sa jñeyaḥ sāttviko budhaiḥ ..
vyāsaḥ pūjyaḥ śrāvakāṇāṃ yathā vyāsavaco nṛpa.. 135 ..
meaning:
य एवं शृणुयाद्वीर स ज्ञेयः सात्त्विको बुधैः ..
व्यासः पूज्यः श्रावकाणां यथा व्यासवचो नृप.. 135 ..
text_mt: he who listens in this way, O hero, is known by the wise as virtuous. / A Vyāsa is to be honored by listeners just as the word of Vyāsa [is], O king.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātpūjyatamo nānyaḥ śrāvakāṇāṃ nṛpottama ..
yataḥ sa vai gurusteṣāṃ jñānadātā sadā nṛpa ..136..
meaning:
तस्मात्पूज्यतमो नान्यः श्रावकाणां नृपोत्तम ..
यतः स वै गुरुस्तेषां ज्ञानदाता सदा नृप ..136..
text_mt: Therefore none is more worthy of worship for listeners than he, O best of kings, / since he is their guru, always the giver of knowledge, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
caturṇāmiha varṇānāṃ nānyo bandhuḥ pracakṣyate ..
vyāsādṛte nṛpaśreṣṭha itīyaṃ vaidikī śrutiḥ ..137..
meaning:
चतुर्णामिह वर्णानां नान्यो बन्धुः प्रचक्ष्यते ..
व्यासादृते नृपश्रेष्ठ इतीयं वैदिकी श्रुतिः ..137..
text_mt: No other kin in this world is proclaimed for the four classes / besides a Vyāsa, O best of kings; such is this Vedic revelation.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjayedvācakaṃ sadā ..
sa guruḥ sa pitā mātā sa baṃdhuḥ sa suhṛttathā .. 138 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन पूजयेद्वाचकं सदा ..
स गुरुः स पिता माता स बंधुः स सुहृत्तथा .. 138 ..
text_mt: Therefore, with every effort one should constantly honor the reciter; / he is the guru, he is the father, mother, he is the kinsman, and he is the friend.

sanskrit_iast:
vācako nṛpaśārdūla viprādīnāmaśeṣataḥ ..
itthaṃ vyāso gururjñeyaḥ pūjyo mānyo dvijātibhiḥ .. 139 ..
meaning:
वाचको नृपशार्दूल विप्रादीनामशेषतः ..
इत्थं व्यासो गुरुर्ज्ञेयः पूज्यो मान्यो द्विजातिभिः .. 139 ..
text_mt: The reciter, O tiger among kings, [is all these] to all the brahmins and others without remainder. / Thus a Vyāsa should be recognized as a guru, to be worshipped and respected by the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇvaṃti ye narā rājansa teṣāṃ gururucyate ..
pūjārthaṃ tasya samayaḥ śrāvakāṇāmudāhṛtaḥ .. . 1.216.140 ..
meaning:
शृण्वंति ये नरा राजन्स तेषां गुरुरुच्यते ..
पूजार्थं तस्य समयः श्रावकाणामुदाहृतः .. . 1.216.140 ..
text_mt: The men who listen, O king, of them he is called the guru. / The proper time has been declared for listeners to perform his worship:

sanskrit_iast:
ye śṛṇvaṃti nṛpaśreṣṭha māsi māsi dadaṃti te ..
svarṇamāṣakamekasmai vācakāya pṛthakpṛthak ..141..
meaning:
ये शृण्वंति नृपश्रेष्ठ मासि मासि ददंति ते ..
स्वर्णमाषकमेकस्मै वाचकाय पृथक्पृथक् ..141..
text_mt: Those who listen, O best of kings, give month by month / one gold māṣaka individually to each reciter.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāṃ cāmāvāsyāyāmatha vā ravisaṃkrame ..
sā nityā dakṣiṇā tasyāṃ yā ca śreyo'rthamātmanaḥ..142..
meaning:
द्वादश्यां चामावास्यायामथ वा रविसंक्रमे ..
सा नित्या दक्षिणा तस्यां या च श्रेयोऽर्थमात्मनः..142..
text_mt: On the twelfth lunar day, on the new moon day, or at a solar transit, / that is the regular priestly gift, and that which is for his own welfare.

sanskrit_iast:
ayane viṣuve caiva caṃdrasūryagrahe tathā ..
prāpte vāparapakṣe ca dānaṃ tasyai svaśaktitaḥ .. 143 ..
meaning:
अयने विषुवे चैव चंद्रसूर्यग्रहे तथा ..
प्राप्ते वापरपक्षे च दानं तस्यै स्वशक्तितः .. 143 ..
text_mt: At a solstice, at an equinox, at an eclipse of the moon or sun, / or when the dark fortnight arrives, a gift [should be given] to him according to one's means.

sanskrit_iast:
deyaṃ syācchrāvakaistāta taṃ muktvā nānyato nṛpa ..
prathamaṃ tasya dātavyaṃ śreyo'rthaṃ śrāvakaiḥ sadā ..144..
meaning:
देयं स्याच्छ्रावकैस्तात तं मुक्त्वा नान्यतो नृप ..
प्रथमं तस्य दातव्यं श्रेयोऽर्थं श्रावकैः सदा ..144..
text_mt: It should be given by the listeners, dear one, to him and to no one else, O king. / First it should be given to him always by the listeners for the sake of welfare.

sanskrit_iast:
adattvā tasya yenyasmai saṃprayacchaṃti śrāvakāḥ ..
avamānaḥ kṛtastaistu vācakasya bhavennṛpa .. 145 ..
meaning:
अदत्त्वा तस्य येन्यस्मै संप्रयच्छंति श्रावकाः ..
अवमानः कृतस्तैस्तु वाचकस्य भवेन्नृप .. 145 ..
text_mt: Not giving to him, the listeners who give to another— / an insult is thereby committed by them against the reciter, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvāvamānamatha taiḥ prāpyate yatphalaṃ nṛpa ..
brāhmaṇādyaiḥ samastaiśca tacchṛṇuṣva varānana ..146..
meaning:
कृत्वावमानमथ तैः प्राप्यते यत्फलं नृप ..
ब्राह्मणाद्यैः समस्तैश्च तच्छृणुष्व वरानन ..146..
text_mt: Having committed an insult, the fruit that is obtained by them, O king, / by all of them beginning with the brahmins, hear that, O fair-faced one:

sanskrit_iast:
śūdratvaṃ brāhmaṇo yāti kṣatriyo yāti kākatām ..
jāyate ca tathā vaiśyaḥ śūdraścāṇḍālatāṃ vrajet ..147..
meaning:
शूद्रत्वं ब्राह्मणो याति क्षत्रियो याति काकताम् ..
जायते च तथा वैश्यः शूद्रश्चाण्डालतां व्रजेत् ..147..
text_mt: A brahmin falls into the state of a śūdra, a kṣatriya becomes a crow, / a vaiśya is born [likewise as an animal], and a śūdra becomes an outcaste.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātpūjyo nṛpaśreṣṭha prathamaṃ vācako budhaiḥ ..
āpatkāle ca vṛddhau ca yataścāsau guruḥ smṛtaḥ .. 148 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्पूज्यो नृपश्रेष्ठ प्रथमं वाचको बुधैः ..
आपत्काले च वृद्धौ च यतश्चासौ गुरुः स्मृतः .. 148 ..
text_mt: Therefore, O best of kings, the reciter is to be honored first by the wise / in times of distress and in prosperity, because he is considered a guru.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśākhyāmayane vīra tṛtīyāyāṃ ca suvrata ..
kārttikyāmatha mārgyāṃ ca saṃpūjyaḥ prathamaṃ bhavet .. 149 ..
meaning:
वैशाख्यामयने वीर तृतीयायां च सुव्रत ..
कार्त्तिक्यामथ मार्ग्यां च संपूज्यः प्रथमं भवेत् .. 149 ..
text_mt: On the full moon day of Vaiśākha, at a solstice, O hero, and on the third lunar day, O you of good vows, / on the full moon day of Kārttika and on that of Mārgaśīrṣa, he should be honored first.

sanskrit_iast:
parvasvanyeṣu ca vibho saṃpūjyo dharmataḥ smṛtaḥ ..
hiraṇyaṃ ca suvarṇaṃ ca dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ tathaiva ca .. 1.216.150 ..
meaning:
पर्वस्वन्येषु च विभो संपूज्यो धर्मतः स्मृतः ..
हिरण्यं च सुवर्णं च धनं धान्यं तथैव च .. 1.216.150 ..
text_mt: And on other sacred days, O lord, he is traditionally honored according to duty. / Unrefined gold, purified gold, wealth, and likewise grain,

sanskrit_iast:
annaṃ cāpi tathā pakvaṃ māṃsaṃ ca kurunaṃdana ..
dātavyaṃ prathamaṃ tasmai śrāvakairnṛpasattama .. 151 ..
meaning:
अन्नं चापि तथा पक्वं मांसं च कुरुनंदन ..
दातव्यं प्रथमं तस्मै श्रावकैर्नृपसत्तम .. 151 ..
text_mt: as well as cooked food and meat, O joy of the Kurus, / should first be given to him by the listeners, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
vācakastu yathā nityaṃ sukhamāste narādhipa ..
na pīḍyate yathā dvaṃdvaistathā kāryaṃ varānana .. 152 ..
meaning:
वाचकस्तु यथा नित्यं सुखमास्ते नराधिप ..
न पीड्यते यथा द्वंद्वैस्तथा कार्यं वरानन .. 152 ..
text_mt: In such a way that the reciter always lives comfortably, O lord of men, / and is not afflicted by the pairs of opposites, so it should be done, O fair-faced one.

sanskrit_iast:
hemaṃte lomaśā deyāśchatraṃ prāvṛṣi sattama ..
upānahau kālayogye kāle caivānulomaśaḥ ..153..
meaning:
हेमंते लोमशा देयाश्छत्रं प्रावृषि सत्तम ..
उपानहौ कालयोग्ये काले चैवानुलोमशः ..153..
text_mt: Woollen blankets should be given in the cold season, an umbrella in the rainy season, O best one, / and shoes suitable for the season, in due order with the seasons.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ dvaṃdvavinirmuktaḥ sa yeṣāṃ vācako nṛpa ..
te dhanyāḥ śrāvakā loke te gatāḥ paramaṃ padam .. 154 ..
meaning:
इत्थं द्वंद्वविनिर्मुक्तः स येषां वाचको नृप ..
ते धन्याः श्रावका लोके ते गताः परमं पदम् .. 154 ..
text_mt: In this way, those whose reciter is freed from the pairs of opposites, O king, / those listeners are blessed in the world, they attain the highest state.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanā tu kathaṃ vīra sukhamicchedvicakṣaṇaḥ ..
viṣamasthe gurau rājanyataśca sa guruḥ smṛtaḥ .. 155 ..
meaning:
आत्मना तु कथं वीर सुखमिच्छेद्विचक्षणः ..
विषमस्थे गुरौ राजन्यतश्च स गुरुः स्मृतः .. 155 ..
text_mt: How could a discerning man desire happiness for himself, O hero, / when the guru is in distress, O king? For he is recognized as the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
vācakaśrāvakāṇāṃ ca tasmāddvaṃdvaṃ vighātayet ..
yatnaḥ kāryaḥ śrāvakaiśca vācakasya janādhipa .. 156 ..
meaning:
वाचकश्रावकाणां च तस्माद्द्वंद्वं विघातयेत् ..
यत्नः कार्यः श्रावकैश्च वाचकस्य जनाधिप .. 156 ..
text_mt: Therefore, [distress from] the pairs of opposites of reciters and listeners should be eliminated; / effort should be made by the listeners on behalf of the reciter, O ruler of people.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ pūjyaḥ sadā vyāsaḥ śreyo'rthaṃ prathamaṃ nṛpa ..
bhartā pūjyo yathā strīṇāṃ sarvāsāṃ vai mahī pate .. 157 ..
meaning:
इत्थं पूज्यः सदा व्यासः श्रेयोऽर्थं प्रथमं नृप ..
भर्ता पूज्यो यथा स्त्रीणां सर्वासां वै मही पते .. 157 ..
text_mt: Thus a Vyāsa is always to be honored first for the sake of welfare, O king. / Just as a husband is to be honored by all women, O lord of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvakāṇāṃ tathā rājanvācakaḥ pūjya ucyate ..
upādhyāyastu śiṣyāṇāṃ yathā bhāgavato hariḥ .. 158 ..
meaning:
श्रावकाणां तथा राजन्वाचकः पूज्य उच्यते ..
उपाध्यायस्तु शिष्याणां यथा भागवतो हरिः .. 158 ..
text_mt: so the reciter is said to be worthy of honor by listeners, O king. / Just as an instructor is to students, just as Hari is to the Bhāgavatas,

sanskrit_iast:
saurāṇāṃ ca yathā bhānuḥ śaivānāṃ śaṃkaro yathā ..
vācakastu tathā pūjyaḥ śrāvakāṇāṃ narādhipa .. 159 ..
meaning:
सौराणां च यथा भानुः शैवानां शंकरो यथा ..
वाचकस्तु तथा पूज्यः श्रावकाणां नराधिप .. 159 ..
text_mt: just as the sun is to the Sauras, just as Śaṅkara is to the Śaivas, / even so is the reciter to be honored by the listeners, O ruler of men.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāṃ dadatā nityaṃ śrotavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā ..
pūrvoktamāṣakaṃ tasmai vācakāya janādhipa .. 1.216.160 ..
meaning:
दक्षिणां ददता नित्यं श्रोतव्यं भूतिमिच्छता ..
पूर्वोक्तमाषकं तस्मै वाचकाय जनाधिप .. 1.216.160 ..
text_mt: Constantly giving the priestly gift, one desiring prosperity must listen, / [giving] the aforesaid māṣaka to that reciter, O ruler of people.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā dātuṃ na śaknoti māṣakaṃ kāṃcanasya tu ..
rajatasya tadā deyaṃ māṣakaṃ śreyase nṛpa .. 161 ..
meaning:
यदा दातुं न शक्नोति माषकं कांचनस्य तु ..
रजतस्य तदा देयं माषकं श्रेयसे नृप .. 161 ..
text_mt: When one is unable to give a māṣaka of gold, / then a māṣaka of silver should be given for spiritual welfare, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
tadabhāve hiraṇyaṃ ca vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ..
mṛttikāpi hi dātavyā prāpnoti satphalaṃ śubham .. 162 ..
meaning:
तदभावे हिरण्यं च वित्तशाठ्यविवर्जितः ..
मृत्तिकापि हि दातव्या प्राप्नोति सत्फलं शुभम् .. 162 ..
text_mt: In its absence, [whatever] gold [one has], free from deceit regarding wealth; / even earth indeed should be given; one obtains a good, auspicious fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣā dakṣiṇā nityā māsimāsi bhavennṛpa ..
naimittikā bhavedrājangrahaṇādiṣu parvasu .. 163 ..
meaning:
इत्येषा दक्षिणा नित्या मासिमासि भवेन्नृप ..
नैमित्तिका भवेद्राजन्ग्रहणादिषु पर्वसु .. 163 ..
text_mt: Such is the regular priestly gift, to be given month by month, O king; / and the occasional one occurs, O king, at sacred occasions such as eclipses.

sanskrit_iast:
amale vāsasī rājangaṃdhamālyavibhūṣaṇe ..
samāpte parvaṇi vibho dātavye bhūtimicchatā .. .. 164 ..
meaning:
अमले वाससी राजन्गंधमाल्यविभूषणे ..
समाप्ते पर्वणि विभो दातव्ये भूतिमिच्छता .. .. 164 ..
text_mt: Two spotless garments, O king, perfumes, garlands, and ornaments, / when the festival day concludes, O lord, should be given by one desiring prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā sarvasamāptiṃ tu pūjayecchrāvako dhuvam ..
ātmānamapi vikrīya ya icchetsaphalaṃ śrutam .. 165 ..
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा सर्वसमाप्तिं तु पूजयेच्छ्रावको धुवम् ..
आत्मानमपि विक्रीय य इच्छेत्सफलं श्रुतम् .. 165 ..
text_mt: Recognizing the complete conclusion of everything, a listener must surely worship [him], / even selling himself, if he desires the recitation heard to bear fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
naimittikāṃ ca nityāṃ ca dakṣi ṇāmapradāya ca ..
śṛṇoti ca sadā yastu tasya tanniṣphalaṃ śrutam .. 166 ..
meaning:
नैमित्तिकां च नित्यां च दक्षि णामप्रदाय च ..
शृणोति च सदा यस्तु तस्य तन्निष्फलं श्रुतम् .. 166 ..
text_mt: Without offering both the occasional and regular priestly gift, / he who always listens—to him that recitation heard is fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā ca dakṣiṇāhīnādyajñānna phalamaśnute ..
tathā śrutaṃ ca rājeṃdra dakṣi ṇārahitaṃ smṛtam .. 167 ..
meaning:
यथा च दक्षिणाहीनाद्यज्ञान्न फलमश्नुते ..
तथा श्रुतं च राजेंद्र दक्षि णारहितं स्मृतम् .. 167 ..
text_mt: And just as one does not enjoy the fruit from a sacrifice devoid of priestly gifts, / even so that which is heard without a priestly gift is traditionally regarded, O king of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
caturguṇā bhavedrājanyā nityā dakṣiṇā vibho ..
samāpte parvaṇi vibho ityāha bhagavāñchivaḥ .. 168 ..
meaning:
चतुर्गुणा भवेद्राजन्या नित्या दक्षिणा विभो ..
समाप्ते पर्वणि विभो इत्याह भगवाञ्छिवः .. 168 ..
text_mt: O king, the daily honorarium becomes fourfold, O mighty one, / when the festival is concluded, O mighty one; thus spoke the blessed Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣa kathito rājanpurāṇaśravaṇe vidhiḥ ..
yataśca vidhihīnaṃ tu na karmaphalamudyate .. 169 ..
meaning:
इत्येष कथितो राजन्पुराणश्रवणे विधिः ..
यतश्च विधिहीनं तु न कर्मफलमुद्यते .. 169 ..
text_mt: Thus has the rule for listening to a Purāṇa been told, O king, / since an action devoid of rule is not said to yield any fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ pitṛdevābhipūjanam ..
vidhipūrvaṃ smṛtaṃ jñeyaṃ yatheha kurunadana..1.216.170 ..
meaning:
स्नानं दानं जपो होमः पितृदेवाभिपूजनम् ..
विधिपूर्वं स्मृतं ज्ञेयं यथेह कुरुनदन..1.216.170 ..
text_mt: Bathing, gifting, recitation of mantras, oblation into fire, and the worship of ancestors and deities / should be known as traditionally performed according to rule, just as here, O joy of the Kurus.

sanskrit_iast:
phaladaṃ nṛpaśārdūla purāṇaśravaṇaṃ tathā ..
yathāyaṃ kathitaṃ tubhyaṃ vidhinā śravaṇaṃ mayā ..171..
meaning:
फलदं नृपशार्दूल पुराणश्रवणं तथा ..
यथायं कथितं तुभ्यं विधिना श्रवणं मया ..171..
text_mt: So too, listening to a Purāṇa bears fruit, O tiger among kings, / just as this listening was told to you by me according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
yathoktaṃ tu yathā jīvaṃ yathoktaṃ brahmavādinā ..
sa brāhmaṇo mahārāja sarvalokeṣu pūjitaḥ .. 172 ..
meaning:
यथोक्तं तु यथा जीवं यथोक्तं ब्रह्मवादिना ..
स ब्राह्मणो महाराज सर्वलोकेषु पूजितः .. 172 ..
text_mt: As stated [in the scriptures], according to one's livelihood, and as spoken by a knower of the Veda, / that Brahmin, O great king, is worshipped in all worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāśrutaṃ mahābāho tathedaṃ kathitaṃ tava ..
bhāskarasya tu māhātmyaṃ māhātmyaṃ vācakasya tu .. 173 ..
meaning:
यथाश्रुतं महाबाहो तथेदं कथितं तव ..
भास्करस्य तु माहात्म्यं माहात्म्यं वाचकस्य तु .. 173 ..
text_mt: Just as it was heard, O mighty-armed one, so has this been told to you: / the majesty of the Sun, and the majesty of the reciter;

sanskrit_iast:
tathā ca saptamīkalpaḥ sarvapāpabhayāpahaḥ ..
anena vidhinā yastu pūjayetsatataṃ naraḥ .. 174 ..
meaning:
तथा च सप्तमीकल्पः सर्वपापभयापहः ..
अनेन विधिना यस्तु पूजयेत्सततं नरः .. 174 ..
text_mt: and likewise the ritual manual for the seventh lunar day, which removes all sins and fears. / A person who constantly worships according to this rule,

sanskrit_iast:
bhagalokaṃ samāsādya triṣu lokeṣu gīyate ..
tato'rkalokamāsādya gaccheccitraśikhaṃḍinaḥ .. 175 ..

भगलोकं समासाद्य त्रिषु लोकेषु गीयते ..
ततोऽर्कलोकमासाद्य गच्छेच्चित्रशिखंडिनः .. 175 ..

tasmādapi mahābāho gacchellokaṃ divākaram..
arkaloke tato yātastato golokamaśnute .. 176 ..

तस्मादपि महाबाहो गच्छेल्लोकं दिवाकरम्..
अर्कलोके ततो यातस्ततो गोलोकमश्नुते .. 176 ..
text_mt: from there too, O mighty-armed one, he would go to the realm of the Sun. / Having gone from the realm of the Sun, he then attains the realm of cows;

daśānāṃ rājasūyānāmagniṣṭomaśatasya ca .. 177 ..

sanskrit_iast: 1 1 śatānīko vyāsaṃ cāturvarṇyadharmaṃ cāturvarṇyabhavaṇayogyadharmādyākhyānañca śrotuṃ papraccha sa ca tvāṃ sumantuḥ śrāvayiṣyatītyavocat . tataḥ śatānīkena pṛṣṭena sumantunā purāṇānāṃ pāpahāritvamupapādya viśeṣato bhaviṣyapurāṇapraśaṃsā paraṃparayā purāṇapravartanaṃ tadīyapadyasaṃkhyāvaṇarnañca ślo0 106
meaning: 1 1 शतानीको व्यासं चातुर्वर्ण्यधर्मं चातुर्वर्ण्यभवणयोग्यधर्माद्याख्यानञ्च श्रोतुं पप्रच्छ स च त्वां सुमन्तुः श्रावयिष्यतीत्यवोचत् . ततः शतानीकेन पृष्टेन सुमन्तुना पुराणानां पापहारित्वमुपपाद्य विशेषतो भविष्यपुराणप्रशंसा परंपरया पुराणप्रवर्तनं तदीयपद्यसंख्यावणर्नञ्च श्लो0 106
text_mt: 1 1 Śatānīka asked Vyāsa to hear the duty of the four classes and the narrative of duties suitable for the dwelling of the four classes, and he said, “Sumantu will recite it to you.” Then, upon being asked by Śatānīka, Sumantu established that the Purāṇas remove sins, especially praised the Bhaviṣyapurāṇa, and described the transmission of the Purāṇa through tradition and the number of its verses. Verses: 106.

meaning: 19 29 द्वितीयाकल्पे पुष्पद्वितीयामाहात्म्यवर्णने शर्यातिकर्तृकच्यवनोद्देश्यकसुकन्यानिवेद- नोत्तरकुमारकर्तृकच्यवनसम्बन्धियुवत्वप्राप्त्युत्तरं दस्रयोश्च्यवनकल्पितयज्ञ- भागभुक्त्वेन कुद्धशक्रस्य तद्धननाय वज्रोद्यमनं तेनसंजातकोपच्यवनकर्तृकेन्द्र- भुजस्तंभवर्णनम् . पश्चाच्छक्रस्तुतिप्रसन्नच्यवनकर्तृकप्रसादेन शक्रस्य भुजस्तंभ. नाभाववर्णनञ्च श्लो. 91
text_mt: 19 29 In the description of the majesty of the Flower-Second in the ritual manual for the second lunar day, the presentation of Sukanyā intended for Cyavana performed by Śaryāti; thereafter, Cyavana's attainment of youth performed by the Kumāras; thereafter, Indra's raising of his thunderbolt to slay Cyavana out of anger due to the two Dasras enjoying the sacrificial portion devised by Cyavana, and the description of the paralysis of Indra's arm performed by Cyavana who became enraged thereby; and subsequently, the description of the cessation of the paralysis of Śakra's arm through the favour of Cyavana who was pleased by Śakra's praise. Verses: 91.

Verses: 51.

text_mt: 23 33 In the description of the ritual manual for the fourth lunar day, the description of the son of Bhīma having authority over obstacles; the description of the rule for his worship, and the description of the worship of his enclosure. Verses: 31.

sanskrit_iast: 117 103 bhojakotpattibhojakamāhātmyavarṇanam, mūryapratimollepanasnāpanamāhātmyavarṇanam ślo. 82
meaning: 117 103 भोजकोत्पत्तिभोजकमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, मूर्यप्रतिमोल्लेपनस्नापनमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् श्लो. 82
text_mt: 117 103 Description of the origin and greatness of Bhojakas, [and] description of the greatness of anointing and bathing the image of Sūrya; 82 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 118 105 ādityāyatane dīpadānamāhātmyavarṇanam ślo. 54
meaning: 118 105 आदित्यायतने दीपदानमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् श्लो. 54
text_mt: 118 105 Description of the greatness of giving lamps in the temple of Āditya; 54 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 119 106 dīpadānamāhātmyavarṇanam ślo. 26
meaning: 119 106 दीपदानमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् श्लो. 26
text_mt: 119 106 Description of the greatness of giving lamps; 26 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 120 106 viṣādyupadravarogavināśārthaṃ sūryapūjāmāhātmyavarṇanam ślo. 67
meaning: 120 106 विषाद्युपद्रवरोगविनाशार्थं सूर्यपूजामाहात्म्यवर्णनम् श्लो. 67
text_mt: 120 106 Description of the greatness of the worship of Sūrya for the destruction of afflictions and diseases such as poison; 67 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 121 108 viśvakarmakṛtasūryaśarīratejaḥśātanavṛttāntavarṇanam ślo, 28
meaning: 121 108 विश्वकर्मकृतसूर्यशरीरतेजःशातनवृत्तान्तवर्णनम् श्लो, 28
text_mt: 121 108 Description of the event of the paring of the splendour of Sūrya's body by Viśvakarman; 28 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 122 108 brahmādidevakṛtasūryastutivarṇanam ślo. 9
meaning: 122 108 ब्रह्मादिदेवकृतसूर्यस्तुतिवर्णनम् श्लो. 9
text_mt: 122 108 Description of the praise of Sūrya made by the gods headed by Brahmā; 9 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 123 109 sūryamāhātmyavarṇane sūyatejaśātanāvasare brahmaviṣṇvīśakṛtasūryastutivarṇanam ślo. 8
meaning: 123 109 सूर्यमाहात्म्यवर्णने सूयतेजशातनावसरे ब्रह्मविष्ण्वीशकृतसूर्यस्तुतिवर्णनम् श्लो. 8
text_mt: 123 109 In the description of the greatness of Sūrya, the praise of Sūrya made by Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva on the occasion of the paring of Sūrya's splendour; 8 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 124 110 sūryānucarapravaraṇanāmaniruktivarṇanam ślo. 40
meaning: 124 110 सूर्यानुचरप्रवरणनामनिरुक्तिवर्णनम् श्लो. 40
text_mt: 124 110 Description of the etymological derivations of the names of Sūrya's foremost attendants; 40 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 125 111 vyomamāhātmyavarṇane bhuvanakośavarṇanam ślo. 71
meaning: 125 111 व्योममाहात्म्यवर्णने भुवनकोशवर्णनम् श्लो. 71
text_mt: 125 111 In the description of the greatness of the sky, the description of the cosmical system; 71 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 126 113 vyomamāhātmye bhuvanakośavarṇane lokalokapālalokavarṇanam ślo. 38
meaning: 126 113 व्योममाहात्म्ये भुवनकोशवर्णने लोकलोकपाललोकवर्णनम् श्लो. 38
text_mt: 126 113 In the greatness of the sky, within the description of the cosmical system, the description of the realms of the world protectors; 38 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 127 114 vistareṇa sāṃbopākhyānavarṇanārambhaḥ, piturājñayā sāṃbena sūryasya stutikaraṇam sāṃbopari mūryaprasādavarṇanam ślo. 36
meaning: 127 114 विस्तरेण सांबोपाख्यानवर्णनारम्भः, पितुराज्ञया सांबेन सूर्यस्य स्तुतिकरणम् सांबोपरि मूर्यप्रसादवर्णनम् श्लो. 36
text_mt: 127 114 The beginning of the detailed account of Sāmba: the praising of Sūrya by Sāmba at his father's command, [and] the description of Sūrya's grace toward Sāmba; 36 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 128 114 sāṃbena sūryastavakaraṇam, sūryeṇa sāṃbāya varapradānam ślo. 14
meaning: 128 114 सांबेन सूर्यस्तवकरणम्, सूर्येण सांबाय वरप्रदानम् श्लो. 14
text_mt: 128 114 The praising of Sūrya by Sāmba, [and] the granting of a boon to Sāmba by Sūrya; 14 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 129 115 sāṃbāya sūryapratimālābhaḥ pratimayā svasthāpanasthānakathanam ślo. 18
meaning: 129 115 सांबाय सूर्यप्रतिमालाभः प्रतिमया स्वस्थापनस्थानकथनम् श्लो. 18
text_mt: 129 115 Sāmba's obtaining of the image of Sūrya, [and] the image stating its own place of installation; 18 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 130 115 sāṃbena caṃdrabhāgāsarittīre sūryapratimāsthāpanam, nāradena sāṃbāya sūryaprāsādani- rmāṇavidhikathanam ślo, 63
meaning: 130 115 सांबेन चंद्रभागासरित्तीरे सूर्यप्रतिमास्थापनम्, नारदेन सांबाय सूर्यप्रासादनि- र्माणविधिकथनम् श्लो, 63
text_mt: 130 115 The installation of the image of Sūrya on the bank of the Candrabhāgā river by Sāmba, [and] the teaching of the ritual rules for constructing a temple to Sūrya by Nārada to Sāmba; 63 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 131 116 sūryapratimānirmāṇavidhau dāruparīkṣāvidhivarṇanam ślo. 43
meaning: 131 116 सूर्यप्रतिमानिर्माणविधौ दारुपरीक्षाविधिवर्णनम् श्लो. 43
text_mt: 131 116 In the ritual procedure for making an image of Sūrya, the description of the procedure for inspecting wood; 43 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 132 117 sarvadevapratimālakṣaṇavarṇanam ślo. 32
meaning: 132 117 सर्वदेवप्रतिमालक्षणवर्णनम् श्लो. 32
text_mt: 132 117 Description of the characteristics of the images of all the gods; 32 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 133 118 pratimāpratiṣṭhāvidhau viśvarūpavarṇanam ślo. 23
meaning: 133 118 प्रतिमाप्रतिष्ठाविधौ विश्वरूपवर्णनम् श्लो. 23
text_mt: 133 118 In the procedure for the consecration of images, the description of the universal form; 23 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 134 119 pratiṣṭhākarmopayuktakālādivarṇanam, pratiṣṭhāmaṇḍalavarṇanaṃ ca. ślo. 27
meaning: 134 119 प्रतिष्ठाकर्मोपयुक्तकालादिवर्णनम्, प्रतिष्ठामण्डलवर्णनं च. श्लो. 27
text_mt: 134 119 Description of the proper time and other elements for the rite of consecration, and the description of the consecration mandala; 27 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 135 119 sūryapratimāsnānakarmavidhivarṇanam, snānakarmopayuktabhojakādidvijavarṇanam, varjya- dvijavarṇanaṃ ca ślo. 67
meaning: 135 119 सूर्यप्रतिमास्नानकर्मविधिवर्णनम्, स्नानकर्मोपयुक्तभोजकादिद्विजवर्णनम्, वर्ज्य- द्विजवर्णनं च श्लो. 67
text_mt: 135 119 Description of the procedure for the rite of bathing the image of Sūrya, description of the twice-born such as Bhojakas qualified for the bathing rite, and description of the twice-born to be avoided; 67 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 136 120 sūryapratimādhivāsanaprakāravarṇanam ślo, 80
meaning: 136 120 सूर्यप्रतिमाधिवासनप्रकारवर्णनम् श्लो, 80
text_mt: 136 120 Description of the method of preliminary consecration of an image of Sūrya; 80 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 137 122 sarvadevaprāsādapratiṣṭhāprakāravarṇanam ślo. 13
meaning: 137 122 सर्वदेवप्रासादप्रतिष्ठाप्रकारवर्णनम् श्लो. 13
text_mt: 137 122 Description of the method of consecration of temples of all the gods; 13 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 138 123 dhvajāropaṇādiprakāravarṇanam ślo. 84
meaning: 138 123 ध्वजारोपणादिप्रकारवर्णनम् श्लो. 84
text_mt: 138 123 Description of the method of raising the banner and related rites; 84 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 139 124 devaparicaryāpālanārthaṃ gauramukhaṃ purohitaṃ prati sāṃbāgamanam, gauramukhena sāṃbāya sūryaparicaryāpālanasamartha magabhojakabrāhmaṇotpattisthitivṛttāṃtakathanam sāṃbena śākadvīpānmitravane magabhojakānayanam, sūryasya sāṃbopari suprasādavarṇanam ślo, 94
meaning: 139 124 देवपरिचर्यापालनार्थं गौरमुखं पुरोहितं प्रति सांबागमनम्, गौरमुखेन सांबाय सूर्यपरिचर्यापालनसमर्थ मगभोजकब्राह्मणोत्पत्तिस्थितिवृत्तांतकथनम् सांबेन शाकद्वीपान्मित्रवने मगभोजकानयनम्, सूर्यस्य सांबोपरि सुप्रसादवर्णनम् श्लो, 94
text_mt: 139 124 Sāmba's coming to the family priest Gauramukha to maintain the service of the deity; Gauramukha's narration to Sāmba of the account of the origin and status of the Maga-Bhojaka brahmins who are competent to maintain the service of Sūrya; Sāmba's bringing of the Maga-Bhojakas from Śākadvīpa to Mitravana; [and] description of Sūrya's supreme grace toward Sāmba; 94 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 140 126 sāṃbena caṃdrabhāgāsarittīre sāṃbapuraniveśanam, bhojakebhyo yādavakanyādānam, kṛṣṇadvaipāyanena sāṃba prati magabhājekabrāhmaṇacaritrakathanam ślo. 50
meaning: 140 126 सांबेन चंद्रभागासरित्तीरे सांबपुरनिवेशनम्, भोजकेभ्यो यादवकन्यादानम्, कृष्णद्वैपायनेन सांब प्रति मगभाजेकब्राह्मणचरित्रकथनम् श्लो. 50
text_mt: 140 126 Sāmba's founding of Sāmbapura on the bank of the Candrabhāgā river; the giving of Yādava maidens to the Bhojakas; [and] Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana's narration of the deeds of the Maga-Bhojaka brahmins to Sāmba; 50 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 141 127 bhojakajātivarṇanam ślo, 17
meaning: 141 127 भोजकजातिवर्णनम् श्लो, 17
text_mt: 141 127 Description of the Bhojaka caste; 17 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 142 128 avyaṃgotpattivarṇanam ślo, 29
meaning: 142 128 अव्यंगोत्पत्तिवर्णनम् श्लो, 29
text_mt: 142 128 Description of the origin of the avyaṅga; 29 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 143 128 nāradoktasūryadhūpādivividhavidhivarṇanam ślo. 58
meaning: 143 128 नारदोक्तसूर्यधूपादिविविधविधिवर्णनम् श्लो. 58
text_mt: 143 128 Description of the various ritual procedures spoken by Nārada regarding incense and other offerings to Sūrya; 58 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 144 129 vyāsasya dvārakāgamanottaraṃ śrīkṛṣṇapṛcchāyāṃ vyāsena bhojakotpattivṛttāntavarṇa- nam ślo, 26
meaning: 144 129 व्यासस्य द्वारकागमनोत्तरं श्रीकृष्णपृच्छायां व्यासेन भोजकोत्पत्तिवृत्तान्तवर्ण- नम् श्लो, 26
text_mt: 144 129 Upon Vyāsa's arrival in Dvārakā, Vyāsa's narration of the account of the Bhojakas' origin in response to Śrī Kṛṣṇa's inquiry; 26 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 145 130 bhojakajñānopalabdhivṛttāntavarṇanam ślo, 28
meaning: 145 130 भोजकज्ञानोपलब्धिवृत्तान्तवर्णनम् श्लो, 28
text_mt: 145 130 Description of the account of the attainment of knowledge by the Bhojakas; 28 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 146 131 bhojyābhojyānnabhojakavṛttāntavarṇanam ślo. 28
meaning: 146 131 भोज्याभोज्यान्नभोजकवृत्तान्तवर्णनम् श्लो. 28
text_mt: 146 131 Description of the account of the Bhojakas and food fit and unfit to be eaten; 28 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 147 131 sūryapriyāpriyabhojakalakṣaṇavarṇanam ślo. 38
meaning: 147 131 सूर्यप्रियाप्रियभोजकलक्षणवर्णनम् श्लो. 38
text_mt: 147 131 Description of the characteristics of the Bhojakas dear and not dear to Sūrya; 38 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 148 132 śrīkṛṣṇasya sudarśanakālacakraprāptivṛttāntavarṇanam ślo. 30
meaning: 148 132 श्रीकृष्णस्य सुदर्शनकालचक्रप्राप्तिवृत्तान्तवर्णनम् श्लो. 30
text_mt: 148 132 Description of the account of Śrī Kṛṣṇa's attainment of the Sudarśana and the wheel of time; 30 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 149 133 sūryacakrasūryadīkṣāvidhivarṇanam ślo, 61
meaning: 149 133 सूर्यचक्रसूर्यदीक्षाविधिवर्णनम् श्लो, 61
text_mt: 149 133 Description of the ritual procedure for the solar diagram and initiation into the cult of Sūrya; 61 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 150 134 sthaṇḍile sūryārcanaprakāravarṇanam ślo. 24
meaning: 150 134 स्थण्डिले सूर्यार्चनप्रकारवर्णनम् श्लो. 24
text_mt: 150 134 Description of the manner of worshipping Sūrya on a bare sacrificial ground; 24 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 151 135 sauradharmaprastāvavarṇanam ślo, 32
meaning: 151 135 सौरधर्मप्रस्ताववर्णनम् श्लो, 32
text_mt: 151 135 Description of the introductory exposition of solar duty; 32 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 152 135 sūryārcanavijijñāsāyāmanekapraśnavarṇanam ślo, 17
meaning: 152 135 सूर्यार्चनविजिज्ञासायामनेकप्रश्नवर्णनम् श्लो, 17
text_mt: 152 135 Description of various inquiries in the desire to understand Sūrya's worship; 17 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 153 136 sūryatejovarṇane brahmaviṣṇvīśaiḥ sūryastutikaraṇam, sūryaprasādavarṇanam ślo, 110 154 138 sūryeṇa brahmaviṣṇvīśebhyaḥ svamūrtitrayīvarṇanam ślo. 42
meaning: 153 136 सूर्यतेजोवर्णने ब्रह्मविष्ण्वीशैः सूर्यस्तुतिकरणम्, सूर्यप्रसादवर्णनम् श्लो, 110 154 138 सूर्येण ब्रह्मविष्ण्वीशेभ्यः स्वमूर्तित्रयीवर्णनम् श्लो. 42
text_mt: 153 136 In the description of Sūrya's splendour, the uttering of praise to Sūrya by Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva, and the description of Sūrya's favour; 110 verses. 154 138 Description of Sūrya's threefold form revealed by him to Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva; 42 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 155 138 ādityena brahmaṇe svārādhanamāhātmyaṃ varṇayitvā, varaṃ ca pradāya gaṃdhamādane śaṃkarāya darśanaṃ dattvā varadānam ślo, 68
meaning: 155 138 आदित्येन ब्रह्मणे स्वाराधनमाहात्म्यं वर्णयित्वा, वरं च प्रदाय गंधमादने शंकराय दर्शनं दत्त्वा वरदानम् श्लो, 68
text_mt: 155 138 Having described to Brahmā the greatness of his own propitiation and granted a boon, Āditya's granting of a vision and bestowing of a boon to Śaṅkara on Gandhamādana; 68 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 156 140 śālagrāmasthalaṃ prati gatvā tapasyate viṣṇave sūryeṇa varapradānam ślo. 30
meaning: 156 140 शालग्रामस्थलं प्रति गत्वा तपस्यते विष्णवे सूर्येण वरप्रदानम् श्लो. 30
text_mt: 156 140 Having gone to the sacred place of Śālagrāma, Sūrya's granting of a boon to Viṣṇu who was performing asceticism; 30 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 157 140 sūryāvatārakathāprastāvavarṇanam ślo, 52
meaning: 157 140 सूर्यावतारकथाप्रस्ताववर्णनम् श्लो, 52
text_mt: 157 140 Description of the introductory narrative of Sūrya's incarnations; 52 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 158 142 sūryotpattivṛttāntavarṇanam ślo, 47
meaning: 158 142 सूर्योत्पत्तिवृत्तान्तवर्णनम् श्लो, 47
text_mt: 158 142 Description of the account of Sūrya's origin; 47 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 159 142 nānāvidhasūryāvatārakathāvarṇanam ślo, 25
meaning: 159 142 नानाविधसूर्यावतारकथावर्णनम् श्लो, 25
text_mt: 159 142 Description of the narratives of the various forms of Sūrya's incarnations; 25 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 160 143 brahmādīnāṃ sūryarūpadarśanavarṇanam ślo, 52
meaning: 160 143 ब्रह्मादीनां सूर्यरूपदर्शनवर्णनम् श्लो, 52
text_mt: 160 143 Description of the vision of Sūrya's form by Brahmā and the others; 52 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 161 144 sūryapūjāphalapraśnavarṇanam ślo. 9
meaning: 161 144 सूर्यपूजाफलप्रश्नवर्णनम् श्लो. 9
text_mt: 161 144 Description of the questioning concerning the fruits of Sūrya's worship; 9 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 162 144 vividhaprakāraiḥ sūryapūjāphalavarṇanam ślo. 55
meaning: 162 144 विविधप्रकारैः सूर्यपूजाफलवर्णनम् श्लो. 55
text_mt: 162 144 Description of the fruits of Sūrya's worship through diverse methods; 55 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 163 145 bhāskarārādhane vividhapuṣpapūjāphalamāhātmyakathanam ślo, 87
meaning: 163 145 भास्कराराधने विविधपुष्पपूजाफलमाहात्म्यकथनम् श्लो, 87
text_mt: 163 145 Recital of the greatness and fruits of worship with diverse flowers in the propitiation of Bhāskara; 87 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 164 147 sūryapūjāmāhātmyavarṇanapuraḥsaraṃ sūryaṣaṣṭhīvratamāhātmyavarṇanam ślo. 103
meaning: 164 147 सूर्यपूजामाहात्म्यवर्णनपुरःसरं सूर्यषष्ठीव्रतमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् श्लो. 103
text_mt: 164 147 Description of the greatness of the Sūrya-ṣaṣṭhī votive observance, preceded by a description of the greatness of Sūrya's worship; 103 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 165 149 sarvamāseṣūbhayapakṣasaptamīvratamāhātmyavarṇanam ślo. 45
meaning: 165 149 सर्वमासेषूभयपक्षसप्तमीव्रतमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् श्लो. 45
text_mt: 165 149 Description of the greatness of the saptamī votive observance of both fortnights in all months; 45 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 166 150 nikṣubhārkavratamāhātmyavarṇanam ślo. 18
meaning: 166 150 निक्षुभार्कव्रतमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् श्लो. 18
text_mt: 166 150 Description of the greatness of the Nikṣubhārka votive observance; 18 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 167 150 nikṣubhārkavratamāhātmyavarṇanam ślo. 17
meaning: 167 150 निक्षुभार्कव्रतमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् श्लो. 17

sanskrit_iast: pātālavarṇanam
meaning: पातालवर्णनम्
text_mt: Description of the Underworld.
title: adhyāyaḥ 01

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ..
oṃ namaḥ kamaladalanayanābhirāmāya ..
śrīrāmacaṃdrāya ..
svacchaṃ caṃdrāvadātaṃ kavikaramakarakṣobhasaṃjātaphenaṃ bakṣodbhūtiprasūktairvrataniyamaparaiḥ sevitaṃ vipramukhyaiḥ ..
oṃkārālaṃkṛtena tribhuvanaguruṇā brahmaṇā dṛṣṭapūtaṃ saṃbhogābhogagamyaṃ janakaluṣaharaṃ pauṣkaraṃ vaḥ punātu .. 1 .1
meaning:
.. श्रीगणेशाय नमः ..
ओं नमः कमलदलनयनाभिरामाय ..
श्रीरामचंद्राय ..
स्वच्छं चंद्रावदातं कविकरमकरक्षोभसंजातफेनं बक्षोद्भूतिप्रसूक्तैर्व्रतनियमपरैः सेवितं विप्रमुख्यैः ..
