.. sūta uvāca .. ..
pratimālakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye yathāśāstramataṃ dvijāḥ ..
pratimāṃ lakṣaṇairhīnāṃ gṛhītāṃ naiva pūjayet .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
प्रतिमालक्षणं वक्ष्ये यथाशास्त्रमतं द्विजाः ..
प्रतिमां लक्षणैर्हीनां गृहीतां नैव पूजयेत् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / I shall declare the characteristics of an image according to the view of the treatises, O twice-born; / one must not worship an image accepted [if it is] devoid of the [proper] characteristics.
title: adhyāyaḥ 12

sanskrit_iast:
śailajā dārujā tāmrī mṛdbhavā sarvakāmadā ..
ekahastā dvihastā vā sārdhahastā tathāpi vā .. 2 ..
meaning:
शैलजा दारुजा ताम्री मृद्भवा सर्वकामदा ..
एकहस्ता द्विहस्ता वा सार्धहस्ता तथापि वा .. 2 ..
text_mt: Born of stone, born of wood, made of copper, or produced from clay, it grants all desires; / whether one cubit, two cubits, or even one and a half cubits,

sanskrit_iast:
prāsādamānamathavā athavā sarvalakṣaṇam ..
aṣṭāṃgulotsedhakaṃ ca na gehe'rcayetkṛtī .. 3 ..
meaning:
प्रासादमानमथवा अथवा सर्वलक्षणम् ..
अष्टांगुलोत्सेधकं च न गेहेऽर्चयेत्कृती .. 3 ..
text_mt: or the measure of the temple, or endowed with all the characteristics; / a wise man should not worship in the house one having an elevation of eight digits.

sanskrit_iast:
devāgārasya yaddvāraṃ tasmādaṣṭāṃgulena tu ..
tribhāgapiṃḍikā kāryā dvau bhāgau pratimā bhavet .. 4 ..
meaning:
देवागारस्य यद्द्वारं तस्मादष्टांगुलेन तु ..
त्रिभागपिंडिका कार्या द्वौ भागौ प्रतिमा भवेत् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Relative to the door of the shrine of the deity, by eight digits from that, / the pedestal should be made of one third, [and] the image should be two parts.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃgulaṃ vai bhavedvṛddhiraśītiścaturuttarā..
vistāramānataḥ kāryaṃ vadanaṃ dvādaśāṃgulam .. 5 ..
meaning:
अंगुलं वै भवेद्वृद्धिरशीतिश्चतुरुत्तरा..
विस्तारमानतः कार्यं वदनं द्वादशांगुलम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: The increase should indeed be one digit, up to eighty-four; / according to the measure of width, the face should be made twelve digits.

sanskrit_iast:
mukhatribhāge cibukaṃ lalāṭaṃ nāsikāṃ tathā ..
karṇau nāsikayā grīvātulyau vā niyatau tu yau .. 6 ..
meaning:
मुखत्रिभागे चिबुकं ललाटं नासिकां तथा ..
कर्णौ नासिकया ग्रीवातुल्यौ वा नियतौ तु यौ .. 6 ..
text_mt: In the three parts of the face are the chin, forehead, and likewise the nose; / the two ears are equal to the nose, or the neck, which are fixed.

sanskrit_iast:
nayane dvyaṃgule syātāṃ tribhāgā tārakā bhavet ..
tṛtīyatārakābhāge śubhadṛṣṭiṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
नयने द्व्यंगुले स्यातां त्रिभागा तारका भवेत् ..
तृतीयतारकाभागे शुभदृष्टिं विचक्षणः .. 7 ..
text_mt: The two eyes should be two digits; the pupil should be a third part; / in the third part of the pupil, the expert [places] the auspicious gaze.

sanskrit_iast:
lalāṭamastakagrīvaṃ kuryāttatsamameva tu ..
pariṇāhastu śiraso bhaveddvātriṃśadaṃgulaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
ललाटमस्तकग्रीवं कुर्यात्तत्सममेव तु ..
परिणाहस्तु शिरसो भवेद्द्वात्रिंशदंगुलः .. 8 ..
text_mt: One should make the forehead, head, and neck indeed equal to that; / and the circumference of the head should be thirty-two digits.

sanskrit_iast:
tulyau nāsikayā grīvā mukhena hṛdayāṃtaram ..
atha vistārapaṃktistu tato'rdhaṃ tu kaṭiḥ sadā .. 9 ..
meaning:
तुल्यौ नासिकया ग्रीवा मुखेन हृदयांतरम् ..
अथ विस्तारपंक्तिस्तु ततोऽर्धं तु कटिः सदा .. 9 ..
text_mt: Equal to the nose is the neck; the chest interval is equal to the face; / now, the width of the row [of shoulders] is [fixed], and the waist is always half of that.

sanskrit_iast:
bāhū ca bāhutulyau ca ūrū jaṃghe ca jāghanam ..
gulphāvasthnastu pādaḥ syāddhāṭitaścaturaṃgulaḥ ..
ṣaḍaṃgulastu vistārastulyāṃguṣṭhoṃ'gulatrayam .. 2.1.12.10 ..
meaning:
बाहू च बाहुतुल्यौ च ऊरू जंघे च जाघनम् ..
गुल्फावस्थ्नस्तु पादः स्याद्धाटितश्चतुरंगुलः ..
षडंगुलस्तु विस्तारस्तुल्यांगुष्ठोंऽगुलत्रयम् .. 2.1.12.10 ..
text_mt: The two arms are equal to [each other's] arms, the two thighs, two shanks, and the hips; / the foot from the ankle bone should be laid out as four digits, / but its width is six digits, with the big toe equal at three digits.

sanskrit_iast:
pradeśinī ca tattulyā hīnā śeṣānnakhānakham ..
caturdaśāṃgulaḥ pādasyāyāmaḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
प्रदेशिनी च तत्तुल्या हीना शेषान्नखानखम् ..
चतुर्दशांगुलः पादस्यायामः परिकीर्तितः .. 11 ..
text_mt: And the foretoe is equal to that; the remaining ones diminish nail by nail; / the length of the foot is proclaimed to be fourteen digits.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktā sā pūjyā pratimā śubhā ..
adharoṣṭhastathaivorubhrūlalāṭamanīṣikam .. 12 ..
meaning:
एवं लक्षणसंयुक्ता सा पूज्या प्रतिमा शुभा ..
अधरोष्ठस्तथैवोरुभ्रूललाटमनीषिकम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Endowed with such characteristics, that auspicious image is to be worshipped: / the lower lip, and likewise the thigh, eyebrow, forehead, [made according to] intellect.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃḍaṃ ca niyataṃ mūrtau kuryādaṃgasamunnateḥ ..
viśālanayanastāmrapado vāyatalocanaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
गंडं च नियतं मूर्तौ कुर्यादंगसमुन्नतेः ..
विशालनयनस्ताम्रपदो वायतलोचनः .. 13 ..
text_mt: And on the icon, the wise man should unfailingly make the cheek proportionate to the elevation of the body, / [having] wide eyes, red-tinted feet, or long eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
savitānala patrasya cāruvidyādharastathā ..
vatsaprokto'timukuṭaḥ kaṭakāṃgadahāravān .. 14 ..
meaning:
सवितानल पत्रस्य चारुविद्याधरस्तथा ..
वत्सप्रोक्तोऽतिमुकुटः कटकांगदहारवान् .. 14 ..
text_mt: [An image of] Savitṛ, having the radiance of fire, with handsome Vidyādharas, / declared by the sage Vatsa, with a towering diadem, wearing bracelets, armlets, and necklaces,

sanskrit_iast:
abhyaṃgapadabandhādi sāmānyenopaśobhi ca ..
suprabhāmaṃḍalā cāru vicitramaṇikuṇḍalā .. 15 ..
meaning:
अभ्यंगपदबन्धादि सामान्येनोपशोभि च ..
सुप्रभामंडला चारु विचित्रमणिकुण्डला .. 15 ..
text_mt: and generally adorned with anointings, foot-bindings, and the like, / possessing a splendid halo, wearing charming earrings of diverse gems,

sanskrit_iast:
karābhyāṃ kāṃcanīṃ mālāṃ prodvahaṃtīṃ śiroruhān..
evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃpannāṃ kārayedvihitapradām .. 16 ..
meaning:
कराभ्यां कांचनीं मालां प्रोद्वहंतीं शिरोरुहान्..
एवं लक्षणसंपन्नां कारयेद्विहितप्रदाम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: raising a golden garland with both hands [above] the hair on the head — / one should make [her], endowed with such characteristics, granting what is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
susnigdhāṃ varadāṃ saumyāṃ dvitīyāśramiṇāmimām ..
navatālo bhavedviṣṇurvāsudevastritālakaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
सुस्निग्धां वरदां सौम्यां द्वितीयाश्रमिणामिमाम् ..
नवतालो भवेद्विष्णुर्वासुदेवस्त्रितालकः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Very glossy, bestowing boons, gentle, this [image is] for householders. / Viṣṇu should be nine tālas, [and] Vāsudeva three tālas.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛsiṃhaḥ pañcatālaḥ syāddhayagrīvastu paṃcamaḥ ..
nārāyaṇaścāṣṭatālo maheśaḥ pañcatālakaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
नृसिंहः पञ्चतालः स्याद्धयग्रीवस्तु पंचमः ..
नारायणश्चाष्टतालो महेशः पञ्चतालकः .. 18 ..
text_mt: Nṛsiṃha should be five tālas, and Hayagrīva fifth; / Nārāyaṇa eight tālas, and Maheśa five tālas.

sanskrit_iast:
navatālā bhaveddurgā lakṣmīścaiva tritālikā ..
vāṇīṃ tritālikāṃ vidyātsavitā saptatālakaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
नवताला भवेद्दुर्गा लक्ष्मीश्चैव त्रितालिका ..
वाणीं त्रितालिकां विद्यात्सविता सप्ततालकः .. 19 ..
text_mt: Durgā should be nine tālas, and Lakṣmī indeed three tālas; / one should know Vāṇī to be three tālas, [and] Savitṛ seven tālas.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇe vāsudevasya kare cakraṃ pratiṣṭhitam ..
śaṃkho bhavecca tadadho vāmārdhe tasya vai gadā .. 2.1.12.20 ..
meaning:
दक्षिणे वासुदेवस्य करे चक्रं प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
शंखो भवेच्च तदधो वामार्धे तस्य वै गदा .. 2.1.12.20 ..
text_mt: The discus is established in Vāsudeva's right hand; / the conch should be below it, and indeed the club in his left half.

sanskrit_iast:
tadadhaśca bhavetpadmaṃ śrīvatsenopaśobhitam ..
savye'rdhe tārakāsyaṃ ca trinetramubhayātmakam .. 21 ..
meaning:
तदधश्च भवेत्पद्मं श्रीवत्सेनोपशोभितम् ..
सव्येऽर्धे तारकास्यं च त्रिनेत्रमुभयात्मकम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: Below that should be the lotus, adorned with the Śrīvatsa; / and in the left half, having the pupil in the face, three-eyed, partaking of both natures.

sanskrit_iast:
pārśve nalinasiṃhau dvau subhadrāṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset ..
rukmiṇī vāmabhāge ca tadadhastāddivīṃdrakam .. 22 ..
meaning:
पार्श्वे नलिनसिंहौ द्वौ सुभद्रां दक्षिणे न्यसेत् ..
रुक्मिणी वामभागे च तदधस्ताद्दिवींद्रकम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: At the flanks are two: a lotus and a lion; one should place Subhadrā on the right, / Rukmiṇī on the left side, and beneath that the lord of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtāṃjalipuṭasthaśca nāradaḥ kapilastathā ..
dharmādharmāvubhau pārśve kartavyau sragviṇāṃ varau .. 23 ..
meaning:
कृतांजलिपुटस्थश्च नारदः कपिलस्तथा ..
धर्माधर्मावुभौ पार्श्वे कर्तव्यौ स्रग्विणां वरौ .. 23 ..
text_mt: Nārada and Kapila stand with cupped hands folded; / both Dharma and Adharma should be made on either side, foremost among those wearing garlands.

sanskrit_iast:
yadugraṃ vāsudevasya tathā nārāyaṇasya ca ..
vaiparītyaṃ vijānīyānmādhavānāṃ tathaiva ca .. 24 ..
meaning:
यदुग्रं वासुदेवस्य तथा नारायणस्य च ..
वैपरीत्यं विजानीयान्माधवानां तथैव च .. 24 ..
text_mt: Whatever is terrible of Vāsudeva, and likewise of Nārāyaṇa, / one should know to be inverted; and likewise of the forms of Mādhava.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthe girau taḍāge ca samīpe sthāpayetsudhīḥ ..
nagaragrāmamadhye vā brāhmaṇānāṃ ca saṃsadi .. 25 ..
meaning:
तीर्थे गिरौ तडागे च समीपे स्थापयेत्सुधीः ..
नगरग्राममध्ये वा ब्राह्मणानां च संसदि .. 25 ..
text_mt: At a holy bathing place, on a mountain, or near a pond, the wise person should install [it], / or in the middle of a city or village, or in an assembly of brāhmaṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
avimukte viśeṣaṇa siddhakṣetre daśārṇake ..
trīṇyuttarasahasrāṇi paṃcapaṃcottarāṇi ṣaṭ .. 26 ..
meaning:
अविमुक्ते विशेषण सिद्धक्षेत्रे दशार्णके ..
त्रीण्युत्तरसहस्राणि पंचपंचोत्तराणि षट् .. 26 ..
text_mt: especially in Avimukta, in a Siddhakṣetra, or in Daśārṇaka. / Three thousand and five [generations], and six times five [generations] after that,

sanskrit_iast:
kulāni pūrvaṃ vipreṃdrāḥ samuddharati nānyathā ..
kalau dārumayaḥ kāryo hyaśakto mṛnmayotha vā .. 27 ..
meaning:
कुलानि पूर्वं विप्रेंद्राः समुद्धरति नान्यथा ..
कलौ दारुमयः कार्यो ह्यशक्तो मृन्मयोथ वा .. 27 ..
text_mt: ancestral families he delivers, O foremost brāhmaṇas; it cannot be otherwise. / In the Kali age it should be made of wood, or if unable, of clay.

sanskrit_iast:
caṃdanāgurubhiḥ kuryādbilvaśrīparṇikasya ca ..
padmakāṣṭhamayaścaiva vāmamasya tathaiva hi .. 28 .. ..
kuṇḍanirmāṇavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
चंदनागुरुभिः कुर्याद्बिल्वश्रीपर्णिकस्य च ..
पद्मकाष्ठमयश्चैव वाममस्य तथैव हि .. 28 .. ..
कुण्डनिर्माणविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
One should make it with sandalwood, agallochum, and also bilva and śrīparṇī wood, / or made of padmakāṣṭha wood, and likewise on its left.
Description of the Rules for Constructing Sacrificial Pits

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kuṃḍānāmatha nirṇayam ..
tasyoddhāraṃ ca saṃskāraṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ dvijasattamāḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि कुंडानामथ निर्णयम् ..
तस्योद्धारं च संस्कारं शृणुध्वं द्विजसत्तमाः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Hereafter I shall declare the determination of the sacrificial pits; / hear its layout and consecration, O best of the twice-born.
title: adhyāyaḥ 13

sanskrit_iast:
caturasraṃ ca vṛttaṃ ca pādārdhaṃ cārdhacaṃdrakam ..
yonyākāraṃ caṃdrakaṃ ca aṣṭārdhamatha paṃcamam .. 2 ..
meaning:
चतुरस्रं च वृत्तं च पादार्धं चार्धचंद्रकम् ..
योन्याकारं चंद्रकं च अष्टार्धमथ पंचमम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: Square, circular, half-circular, crescent-shaped, / vulva-shaped, moon-shaped, and fifth is half of eight [quadrangular],

sanskrit_iast:
saptārdhaṃ ca navārdhaṃ ca kuṃḍaṃ daśakamīritam ..
bhūmiṃ saṃśodhya vidhivattuṣakeśādivarjitām .. 3 ..
meaning:
सप्तार्धं च नवार्धं च कुंडं दशकमीरितम् ..
भूमिं संशोध्य विधिवत्तुषकेशादिवर्जिताम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: half of seven, and half of nine — a tenfold set of sacrificial pits has been declared. / Having properly purified the ground, freed from chaff, hair, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
bhrāmayeccordhvatastasyā bhasmāṃgārāṇi yatnataḥ ..
aṃkurārpaṇakaṃ kuryātsaptāhādeva buddhimān .. 4 ..
meaning:
भ्रामयेच्चोर्ध्वतस्तस्या भस्मांगाराणि यत्नतः ..
अंकुरार्पणकं कुर्यात्सप्ताहादेव बुद्धिमान् .. 4 ..
text_mt: one should carefully sweep ashes and cinders away from its top; / the wise man should perform the sowing of sprouts seven days prior.

sanskrit_iast:
sthānaṃ vimarditaṃ kuryātkhanitvā secayejjalaiḥ ..
puṣṭihastocchrāyamitaṃ prakuryātparisūtrayet.. 5 ..
meaning:
स्थानं विमर्दितं कुर्यात्खनित्वा सेचयेज्जलैः ..
पुष्टिहस्तोच्छ्रायमितं प्रकुर्यात्परिसूत्रयेत्.. 5 ..
text_mt: He should level the site, dig it out, and sprinkle it with water; / he should make it measuring the height of a cubit with clenched fist, and mark it out with cord.

sanskrit_iast:
arkāṃgulamitaṃ sūtraṃ caturasraṃ prakalpayet ..
aṣṭādaśāṃgake kṣetre nyasedekaṃ bahistataḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
अर्कांगुलमितं सूत्रं चतुरस्रं प्रकल्पयेत् ..
अष्टादशांगके क्षेत्रे न्यसेदेकं बहिस्ततः .. 6 ..
text_mt: He should prepare a square with a cord measuring twelve digits; / on an eighteen-digit field, he should then set one [part] outside.

sanskrit_iast:
māpayettena mānena trivṛttaṃ kuṃḍamujjvalam ..
pūrvavadvibhajetkṣetraṃ bhāgaikaṃ purato nyaset .. 7 ..
meaning:
मापयेत्तेन मानेन त्रिवृत्तं कुंडमुज्ज्वलम् ..
पूर्ववद्विभजेत्क्षेत्रं भागैकं पुरतो न्यसेत् .. 7 ..
text_mt: By that measure he should measure the bright, tri-circular sacrificial pit; / he should divide the field as before, and place one share in front.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛttāni kālikādīni bahistrīṇi vivarjayet ..
padmakuṃḍamidaṃ proktaṃ vilocanamanoharam .. 8 ..
meaning:
वृत्तानि कालिकादीनि बहिस्त्रीणि विवर्जयेत् ..
पद्मकुंडमिदं प्रोक्तं विलोचनमनोहरम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: He should discard three outer circles, the kālikā and the others; / this is declared to be the lotus sacrificial pit, charming to the eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
daśadhā bhedayetkṣetre urdhvādhordhvāṃguladvayam ..
saṃparipātayetsūtraṃ pāṭayettatpramāṇataḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
दशधा भेदयेत्क्षेत्रे उर्ध्वाधोर्ध्वांगुलद्वयम् ..
संपरिपातयेत्सूत्रं पाटयेत्तत्प्रमाणतः .. 9 ..
text_mt: He should divide the field into ten parts, two digits above and below; / he should cast down the cord, and divide it according to that measure.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcadhā bhedite kṣetre kāmaṃ vā vibhajetsudhīḥ ..
nyasetpurastādevāṃgaṃ koṇārdhārdhapramāṇataḥ .. 2.1.13.10 ..
meaning:
पंचधा भेदिते क्षेत्रे कामं वा विभजेत्सुधीः ..
न्यसेत्पुरस्तादेवांगं कोणार्धार्धप्रमाणतः .. 2.1.13.10 ..
text_mt: When the field is divided into five parts, or as desired, the wise man should divide it; / he should set the part in front, measuring one-fourth of a corner.

sanskrit_iast:
yonisthānaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya aśvatthasya dalākṛtiḥ ..
sūtradvayaṃ tato dadyātkuṃḍaṃ parimitaṃ bhavet .. 11 ..
meaning:
योनिस्थानं प्रतिष्ठाप्य अश्वत्थस्य दलाकृतिः ..
सूत्रद्वयं ततो दद्यात्कुंडं परिमितं भवेत् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Having established the place of the vulva, having the shape of a leaf of the sacred fig tree, / he should then apply two cords; the sacrificial pit will be delimited.

sanskrit_iast:
caturasraṃ samuddhṛtya sūtraṃ saṃkalpayogataḥ ..
diśaṃ prati yathānyāyaṃ pātayecca dvijottamāḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
चतुरस्रं समुद्धृत्य सूत्रं संकल्पयोगतः ..
दिशं प्रति यथान्यायं पातयेच्च द्विजोत्तमाः .. 12 ..
text_mt: Having raised the square according to the rule of the cord, / O best of the twice-born, he should cast [the cords] toward each direction in the proper manner.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṃgāṭakaṃ yugmapuṭaṃ ṣaḍasraṃ kuṃḍatrayaṃ budhāḥ ..
jalāśayārāmakūpe nitye gṛhamaye yathā .. 13 ..
meaning:
शृंगाटकं युग्मपुटं षडस्रं कुंडत्रयं बुधाः ..
जलाशयारामकूपे नित्ये गृहमये यथा .. 13 ..
text_mt: The wise know the three sacrificial pits: triangular, paired-shell, and hexagonal, / for reservoirs, gardens, wells, and likewise in daily domestic rites.

sanskrit_iast:
catusraṃ bhavetkuṃḍaṃ dvijasaṃskārakarmaṇi ..
devapratiṣṭhāyāge ca gṛhavāstau caturthakam .. 14 ..
meaning:
चतुस्रं भवेत्कुंडं द्विजसंस्कारकर्मणि ..
देवप्रतिष्ठायागे च गृहवास्तौ चतुर्थकम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: The sacrificial pit should be square in rites of passage for the twice-born, / in sacrifice for consecrating deities, and fourthly in house-foundation rites.

sanskrit_iast:
vasuṃdharāyogabhede prapaṃce vartamādiśet ..
some'ṣṭau paṃkajaṃ proktaṃ naramedhāśvamedhayoḥ .. .. 15 ..
meaning:
वसुंधरायोगभेदे प्रपंचे वर्तमादिशेत् ..
सोमेऽष्टौ पंकजं प्रोक्तं नरमेधाश्वमेधयोः .. .. 15 ..
text_mt: In the variety of combinations for the earth, one should indicate the circular in diversity; / in Soma rites, eight [sides] are prescribed; the lotus is declared in human sacrifice and horse sacrifice,

sanskrit_iast:
aṃkurārpaṇayāge ca vaiṣṇave yāgakarmaṇi ..
śivadevyośca janmādāvaṣṭamyāṃ cārdhacaṃdrakam .. 16 ..
meaning:
अंकुरार्पणयागे च वैष्णवे यागकर्मणि ..
शिवदेव्योश्च जन्मादावष्टम्यां चार्धचंद्रकम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: and in the rite of sowing sprouts, in Vaiṣṇava sacrificial rites, / at the appearance of Śiva and the goddess, and the crescent-shaped on the aṣṭamī.

sanskrit_iast:
mārjārapauṣṭike vairaṃ ramye ca śāṃtike tathā ..
śāṃtipratiṣṭhāyāge tu śāktānāṃ kāmyakarmaṇi .. 17 ..
meaning:
मार्जारपौष्टिके वैरं रम्ये च शांतिके तथा ..
शांतिप्रतिष्ठायागे तु शाक्तानां काम्यकर्मणि .. 17 ..
text_mt: In rites for prosperity against enemies, in conflicts, in delightful and pacifying rites, / and in pacification and installation sacrifices, in wish-granting rites of Śāktas,

sanskrit_iast:
puraścaraṇakāmyeṣu jvarādīnāṃ vimokṣaṇe ..
evaṃvidheṣu kāryeṣu yonikuṃḍaṃ praśasyate .. .. 18 ..
meaning:
पुरश्चरणकाम्येषु ज्वरादीनां विमोक्षणे ..
एवंविधेषु कार्येषु योनिकुंडं प्रशस्यते .. .. 18 ..
text_mt: in preliminary recitations for desires, in the alleviation of fevers and the like — / in such undertakings, the vulva-shaped sacrificial pit is praised.

sanskrit_iast:
devatātīrthayātrādau mahāyuddhapraveśane ..
saure śāṃte pauṣṭike ca ṣaṭpuraṃ kuṃḍamuttamam.. 19..
meaning:
देवतातीर्थयात्रादौ महायुद्धप्रवेशने ..
सौरे शांते पौष्टिके च षट्पुरं कुंडमुत्तमम्.. 19..
text_mt: In pilgrimages to deities and holy places, in entering into great warfare, / in Solar rites, pacifying rites, and rites of prosperity, the six-sided sacrificial pit is best.

sanskrit_iast:
māraṇoccāṭane caiva tathā rogopaśāṃtaye ..
vaiṣṇavānāṃ koṭihome nṛpāṇāmatiśocane .. 2.1.13.20 ..
meaning:
मारणोच्चाटने चैव तथा रोगोपशांतये ..
वैष्णवानां कोटिहोमे नृपाणामतिशोचने .. 2.1.13.20 ..
text_mt: In lethal sorcery and eradication, and likewise for the alleviation of diseases, / in the ten-million homa of Vaiṣṇavas, in great sorrow of kings,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāsramabjakuṃḍaṃ ca saptāsraṃ nidhisādhane ..
rājñā sādhye ca paṃcāsraṃ kanyāprāptau trirasrakam ..21..
meaning:
अष्टास्रमब्जकुंडं च सप्तास्रं निधिसाधने ..
राज्ञा साध्ये च पंचास्रं कन्याप्राप्तौ त्रिरस्रकम् ..21..
text_mt: the eight-sided and lotus sacrificial pit [is used], and the seven-sided in accomplishing treasures; / the five-sided in that which is to be achieved by a king, and the three-sided in obtaining a bride.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvannimnaṃ bhavedeva vistārastāvadeva tu ..
kuṃḍānurūpataḥ kāryā mekhalā sarvato budhaiḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
यावन्निम्नं भवेदेव विस्तारस्तावदेव तु ..
कुंडानुरूपतः कार्या मेखला सर्वतो बुधैः .. 22 ..
text_mt: As deep as it may be, just so much should be its width; / according to the sacrificial pit, a stepped girdle should be made on all sides by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
ayutādiṣu homeṣu mekhalāṃ yojayetsudhīḥ ..
nimna pramāṇe cātrāpi mūle sārdhāṃgulaṃ tyajet .. 23 ..
meaning:
अयुतादिषु होमेषु मेखलां योजयेत्सुधीः ..
निम्न प्रमाणे चात्रापि मूले सार्धांगुलं त्यजेत् .. 23 ..
text_mt: In homas of ten thousand offerings and the like, the wise man should construct the stepped girdle; / and in measuring the depth here, he should leave one and a half digits at the base.

sanskrit_iast:
koṇavedarasairmānaṃ yathāyogyamanukramāt ..
muṣṭihaste samutsedho sārdhāṃgulapariṣkṛtaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
कोणवेदरसैर्मानं यथायोग्यमनुक्रमात् ..
मुष्टिहस्ते समुत्सेधो सार्धांगुलपरिष्कृतः .. 24 ..
text_mt: The measure of corners is four and six respectively, in proper order; / in a cubit with clenched fist, the height is refined to one and a half digits.

sanskrit_iast:
aratnimātre kuṃḍe tu triścaikāṃgulataḥ kramāt ..
ekahastamite kuṃḍe vedāgninayanāṃgulāḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
अरत्निमात्रे कुंडे तु त्रिश्चैकांगुलतः क्रमात् ..
एकहस्तमिते कुंडे वेदाग्निनयनांगुलाः .. 25 ..
text_mt: In a sacrificial pit measuring a cubit from elbow to clenched fist, [it is] three and one digit in order; / in a sacrificial pit measuring one cubit, [it is] four, three, and two digits.

sanskrit_iast:
saptamekhalakaṃ yuktaṃ lakṣahome na śasyate ..
paṃcamekhalakaṃ vātha lakṣakoṭyāṃ ca yojayet .. 26 ..
meaning:
सप्तमेखलकं युक्तं लक्षहोमे न शस्यते ..
पंचमेखलकं वाथ लक्षकोट्यां च योजयेत् .. 26 ..
text_mt: A sevenfold stepped girdle is fitted; it is not recommended in a lakṣa-homa; / or one should use a fivefold stepped girdle in a lakṣa or koṭi [homa].

sanskrit_iast:
ekāṃgulādimānena nemiṃ saṃvardhayetsudhīḥ ..
caturhastamite kuṃḍe tāvadeva guṇāṃgulāḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
एकांगुलादिमानेन नेमिं संवर्धयेत्सुधीः ..
चतुर्हस्तमिते कुंडे तावदेव गुणांगुलाः .. 27 ..
text_mt: With a measure beginning from one digit, the wise man should increase the rim; / in a sacrificial pit measuring four cubits, it is just as many [times] three digits.

sanskrit_iast:
vasuhaste bhānupaṃktiryugmahīne'pi tāḥ kramāt ..
sarvāḥ samā grahamakhe mekhalāśca sahasrake .. 28 ..
meaning:
वसुहस्ते भानुपंक्तिर्युग्महीनेऽपि ताः क्रमात् ..
सर्वाः समा ग्रहमखे मेखलाश्च सहस्रके .. 28 ..
text_mt: In a [sacrificial pit of] eight cubits, [the number of girdles] is a series of twelve, or in one diminished by a pair [they are] in due order; / all the girdles are equal in a planetary sacrifice and in a thousand-[offering rite].

sanskrit_iast:
pārśvato yojayettatra mekhalāstā yathākramam .. .
sārdhāṃgulādimānena nemiṃ saṃvardhayetsudhīḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
पार्श्वतो योजयेत्तत्र मेखलास्ता यथाक्रमम् .. .
सार्धांगुलादिमानेन नेमिं संवर्धयेत्सुधीः .. 29 ..
text_mt: There one should fashion those girdles along the sides in due order. / A wise man should enlarge the rim by a measure beginning with one and a half aṅgulas.

sanskrit_iast:
ekamekhalayāgena yojayecchaktibhāvataḥ ..
homādhikye bahuphalamanyūnaṃ nādhikaṃ bhavet ..2.1.13.30..
meaning:
एकमेखलयागेन योजयेच्छक्तिभावतः ..
होमाधिक्ये बहुफलमन्यूनं नाधिकं भवेत् ..2.1.13.30..
text_mt: With the sacrifice of a single girdle one should fashion it according to one's capacity. / When the oblation is greater, there is great fruit; it should not be deficient nor excessive.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṃḍasya rūpaṃ jānīyātparamaṃ prakṛtervapuḥ ..
tato home śataguṇaṃ sthaṃḍile svalpakaṃ phalam .. 31..
meaning:
कुंडस्य रूपं जानीयात्परमं प्रकृतेर्वपुः ..
ततो होमे शतगुणं स्थंडिले स्वल्पकं फलम् .. 31..
text_mt: One should know the form of the sacrificial pit to be the supreme body of Prakṛti. / Therefore, an oblation in it yields a hundredfold fruit, while on an altar-ground the fruit is very little.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭacaturdhā guṇāyāmavistāronnatiśālinī ..
ekāṃgulaṃ tu yonyagraṃ kuryādīṣadadhomukham .. 32 ..
meaning:
षटचतुर्धा गुणायामविस्तारोन्नतिशालिनी ..
एकांगुलं तु योन्यग्रं कुर्यादीषदधोमुखम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: Possessing length, breadth, and height of six, four, or three [aṅgulas], / one should make the tip of the yoni one aṅgula [in measure], turned slightly downward.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikāṃgulato yoniṃ kuṃḍaśūnyeṣu vardhayet ..
samamadhye mekhalāyāḥ saparyā yā sulakṣaṇā .. 33 ..
meaning:
एकैकांगुलतो योनिं कुंडशून्येषु वर्धयेत् ..
सममध्ये मेखलायाः सपर्या या सुलक्षणा .. 33 ..
text_mt: One should enlarge the yoni by one aṅgula for each unit in the voids of the sacrificial pit. / Exactly in the middle of the girdle is the worship that possesses auspicious marks.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpayetkuṃḍakoṇeṣu yoniṃ tāṃ dvijasattamāḥ ..
kuṃḍānāṃ kalpayennābhiṃ sphuṭamaṃbujasannibhām .. 34 ..
meaning:
स्थापयेत्कुंडकोणेषु योनिं तां द्विजसत्तमाः ..
कुंडानां कल्पयेन्नाभिं स्फुटमंबुजसन्निभाम् .. 34 ..
text_mt: O best of the twice-born, one should place that yoni at the corners of the sacrificial pit. / One should fashion the navel of the sacrificial pits clearly resembling a lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
tattu kuṃḍānurūpaṃ vā suvyaktaṃ sumanoharam ..
yonikuṃḍe yonimabjaṃ kuṃḍe nābhiṃ ca varjayet .. 35 ..
meaning:
तत्तु कुंडानुरूपं वा सुव्यक्तं सुमनोहरम् ..
योनिकुंडे योनिमब्जं कुंडे नाभिं च वर्जयेत् .. 35 ..
text_mt: or conforming to the sacrificial pit, very distinct and highly pleasing. / In a yoni-shaped sacrificial pit one should omit the yoni, and in a lotus-shaped pit one should omit the navel.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvaddvayapramāṇena ardhāṃgulakramādbahiḥ ..
nābhiṃ pravardhayedekaṃ kuṃḍānāṃ rūpato yathā .. 36 ..
meaning:
यावद्द्वयप्रमाणेन अर्धांगुलक्रमाद्बहिः ..
नाभिं प्रवर्धयेदेकं कुंडानां रूपतो यथा .. 36 ..
text_mt: Up to a measure of two [aṅgulas], outside, by stages of half an aṅgula, / one should enlarge the single navel according to the shape of the sacrificial pits.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tatra bhavetkuṃḍaṃ biṃbaśūnyaṃ na homayet ..
śivaśaktisamāyogātkāma utpadyate yataḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
तत्र तत्र भवेत्कुंडं बिंबशून्यं न होमयेत् ..
शिवशक्तिसमायोगात्काम उत्पद्यते यतः .. 37 ..
text_mt: There, whatever sacrificial pit there may be, one must not offer oblations without an icon, / because desire arises from the union of Śiva and Śakti.

sanskrit_iast:
avaṭopi umādevī biṃbaḥ khyātaḥ sadāśivaḥ ..
na kuryādekayā hīnaṃ maraṇaṃ ca samuddiśet ..38..
meaning:
अवटोपि उमादेवी बिंबः ख्यातः सदाशिवः ..
न कुर्यादेकया हीनं मरणं च समुद्दिशेत् ..38..
text_mt: The cavity is the goddess Umā, and the icon is celebrated as Sadāśiva. / One should not make it lacking either one; [otherwise] one should predict death.

sanskrit_iast:
trayodaśāṃgulaṃ hitvā vahnihastamathāpi vā ..
mahātīrthe siddhakṣetre yatra śaṃbhugṛhe kule .. 39 ..
meaning:
त्रयोदशांगुलं हित्वा वह्निहस्तमथापि वा ..
महातीर्थे सिद्धक्षेत्रे यत्र शंभुगृहे कुले .. 39 ..
text_mt: Leaving aside thirteen aṅgulas, or else three cubits, / at a great sacred bathing place, in a field of perfection, or where there is a shrine of Śambhu or an ancestral seat,

sanskrit_iast:
tasya dakṣiṇadigbhāge agrato maṃḍalaṃ likhet ..
tatra pūjā prakartavyā pūrvamānena cāśrayet ..2.1.13.40..
meaning:
तस्य दक्षिणदिग्भागे अग्रतो मंडलं लिखेत् ..
तत्र पूजा प्रकर्तव्या पूर्वमानेन चाश्रयेत् ..2.1.13.40..
text_mt: on its southern side, in front, one should draw a mandala. / Worship should be performed there, and one should undertake it according to the aforementioned measure,

sanskrit_iast:
arkahastāṃtare kuryācchatordhvāṃte śatena vā .. 41 ..
yajñamānavidhānavarṇanam
meaning:
अर्कहस्तांतरे कुर्याच्छतोर्ध्वांते शतेन वा .. 41 ..
यज्ञमानविधानवर्णनम्
text_mt:
at an interval of twelve cubits, or at the end of a hundred [cubits] or more, or with a hundred.
Description of the Rules for the Measures of Sacrifices

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
yasya yajñasya yanmānaṃ tattu tenaiva yojayet ..
amānena hato yajñastasmānmānaṃ na hāpayet .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
यस्य यज्ञस्य यन्मानं तत्तु तेनैव योजयेत् ..
अमानेन हतो यज्ञस्तस्मान्मानं न हापयेत् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Whatever is the measure of a sacrifice, one should indeed furnish it with that very [measure]. / A sacrifice is ruined by lack of measure; therefore, one should not diminish the measure.
title: adhyāyaḥ 14

sanskrit_iast:
śatārdhaṃ prathamaṃ mānaṃ śatasāhasrameva ca ..
ayutaṃ ca tathā lakṣaṃ koṭihomamataḥ param ..2..
meaning:
शतार्धं प्रथमं मानं शतसाहस्रमेव च ..
अयुतं च तथा लक्षं कोटिहोममतः परम् ..2..
text_mt: Half a hundred is the first measure, and also a hundred thousand; / and ten thousand, and likewise a hundred thousand; beyond this is the ten-million oblation.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paraṃ tu vibhave rājā vānyo ddhijottamāḥ ..
na sa siddhimavāpnoti ayāgaphalabhāgbhavet ..3..
meaning:
अतः परं तु विभवे राजा वान्यो द्धिजोत्तमाः ..
न स सिद्धिमवाप्नोति अयागफलभाग्भवेत् ..3..
text_mt: Beyond this, however, even if having wealth, whether a king or another, O best of the twice-born, / he does not attain success; he would become a partaker in the fruit of non-sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
vipākaṃ karmaṇāṃ sarvaṃ naraḥ prāpnoti sarvadā ..
śubhāśubhaṃ tato nityaṃ prāpnoti manujaḥ kila .. 4 ..
meaning:
विपाकं कर्मणां सर्वं नरः प्राप्नोति सर्वदा ..
शुभाशुभं ततो नित्यं प्राप्नोति मनुजः किल .. 4 ..
text_mt: A man always reaps all the ripening of his deeds. / Therefore, indeed, a mortal continually experiences what is auspicious and inauspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
yuktāścāpi grahāstatra nityaṃ śāṃtikapauṣṭike ..
tasmātprayatnato bhaktyā nityaṃ pūjā yathāvidhi .. 5 ..
meaning:
युक्ताश्चापि ग्रहास्तत्र नित्यं शांतिकपौष्टिके ..
तस्मात्प्रयत्नतो भक्त्या नित्यं पूजा यथाविधि .. 5 ..
text_mt: And the planets are always involved there in rites of pacification and prosperity. / Therefore, with diligence and devotion, worship [should be done] daily according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
adbhute ca tathā śāṃtiṃ kuryādbhaktisamanvitaḥ ..
tasmādgrahābhijanitaṃ śubhāśubhaphalaṃ khalu .. .. 6 ..
meaning:
अद्भुते च तथा शांतिं कुर्याद्भक्तिसमन्वितः ..
तस्माद्ग्रहाभिजनितं शुभाशुभफलं खलु .. .. 6 ..
text_mt: And in the event of a portent, endowed with devotion, one should perform a rite of pacification; / for indeed the auspicious and inauspicious fruit is generated by the planets.

sanskrit_iast:
adbhuteṣu ca sarveṣu ayutaṃ kārayennaraḥ ..
homaṃ yathābhirucitaṃ pauṣṭike kāmyakarmaṇi .. 7 ..
meaning:
अद्भुतेषु च सर्वेषु अयुतं कारयेन्नरः ..
होमं यथाभिरुचितं पौष्टिके काम्यकर्मणि .. 7 ..
text_mt: In the case of all portents, a man should cause a ten-thousand [oblation] to be performed. / In a rite for prosperity or a desired object, an oblation may be according to one's liking.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣahomaṃ koṭihomaṃ rājā kuryādyathāvidhi ..
anyaḥ śatādikaṃ kuryādayutaṃ vibhave sati .. 8 ..
meaning:
लक्षहोमं कोटिहोमं राजा कुर्याद्यथाविधि ..
अन्यः शतादिकं कुर्यादयुतं विभवे सति .. 8 ..
text_mt: A king should perform a hundred-thousand oblation or a ten-million oblation according to rule; / another may perform an oblation of a hundred and so forth, or ten thousand, if wealth is present.

sanskrit_iast:
grahāṇāṃ lakṣahomastu koṭihomastathā kalau ..
nidhihomaṃ cābhicāraṃ tanna kuryādgṛhāśramī .. 9 ..
meaning:
ग्रहाणां लक्षहोमस्तु कोटिहोमस्तथा कलौ ..
निधिहोमं चाभिचारं तन्न कुर्याद्गृहाश्रमी .. 9 ..
text_mt: In the Kali age, there is a hundred-thousand oblation and a ten-million oblation for the planets; / but a householder should not perform a treasure-oblation or malevolent magic.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra yatra japaḥ kāryo homo vā yatra kutracit ..
mānaṃ naiva ca kartavyaṃ mānādau cāṣṭakaṃ nyaset .. 2.1.14.10 ..
meaning:
यत्र यत्र जपः कार्यो होमो वा यत्र कुत्रचित् ..
मानं नैव च कर्तव्यं मानादौ चाष्टकं न्यसेत् .. 2.1.14.10 ..
text_mt: Wherever recitation is to be performed or an oblation anywhere at all, / an improper measure should not be made, and at the beginning of the measure one should place an octad.

sanskrit_iast:
yugmasādhyaṃ na kartavyaṃ yugmato bhayamādiśet ..
lakṣe saptatālasaṃkhyā koṭihome ca viṃśatiḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
युग्मसाध्यं न कर्तव्यं युग्मतो भयमादिशेत् ..
लक्षे सप्ततालसंख्या कोटिहोमे च विंशतिः .. 11 ..
text_mt: That which is accomplished by an even number should not be done; from an even number one should predict danger. / In a hundred-thousand [oblation] the count of days is seventy, and in a ten-million oblation it is twenty [months],

sanskrit_iast:
ekatriṃśaddinairvāpi na kuryādvyatyayaṃ kvacit ..
āraṃbhastrisahasraḥ syāddvitīye'ṣṭasahasrakaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
एकत्रिंशद्दिनैर्वापि न कुर्याद्व्यत्ययं क्वचित् ..
आरंभस्त्रिसहस्रः स्याद्द्वितीयेऽष्टसहस्रकः .. 12 ..
text_mt: or in thirty-one days; one should nowhere cause an inversion. / The commencement should be three thousand, on the second day eight thousand,

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīye tu sahasraṃ syādgrahasādhyaḥ smṛto vidhiḥ ..
pañcāhe ca samāraṃbhe sahasraṃ juhuyādbudhaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
तृतीये तु सहस्रं स्याद्ग्रहसाध्यः स्मृतो विधिः ..
पञ्चाहे च समारंभे सहस्रं जुहुयाद्बुधः .. 13 ..
text_mt: and on the third day it should be one thousand; [this] rule is handed down as accomplished by the planets. / And in an undertaking of five days, the wise man should offer one thousand [on the first day],

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye'hni dvisāhasraṃ tṛtīye tu sahasrakam ..
guṇasāhasrakaṃ turye pañcāhe śeṣamīritam .. 14 ..
meaning:
द्वितीयेऽह्नि द्विसाहस्रं तृतीये तु सहस्रकम् ..
गुणसाहस्रकं तुर्ये पञ्चाहे शेषमीरितम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: on the second day two thousand, and on the third day one thousand, / on the fourth three thousand, and in five days the remainder is declared.

sanskrit_iast:
navāhe kalpayellakṣamekaikāṃgaṃ dine dine ..
paṃcame ca tathā ṣaṣṭhe kule bhāgadvayādhikam .. 15 ..
meaning:
नवाहे कल्पयेल्लक्षमेकैकांगं दिने दिने ..
पंचमे च तथा षष्ठे कुले भागद्वयाधिकम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: In a nine-day rite, one should arrange a hundred thousand, limb by limb, day by day; / and on the fifth and sixth [days], in the group, it is increased by two parts.

sanskrit_iast:
koṭihome ca tithyaṃge śatabhāgena kalpayet ..
na nyūnaṃ nādhikaṃ kāryametanmānamudāhṛtam .. 16 ..
meaning:
कोटिहोमे च तिथ्यंगे शतभागेन कल्पयेत् ..
न न्यूनं नाधिकं कार्यमेतन्मानमुदाहृतम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: And in a ten-million oblation, with the lunar day as a division, one should arrange it with a hundredth part. / It should not be made deficient nor excessive; this measure has been declared.

sanskrit_iast:
nityamekaṃ dine dadyātpṛthaṅnityaṃ na cācaret ..
sa samāje japennityaṃ pañcatāreṇa sviṣṭakṛt .. 17 ..
meaning:
नित्यमेकं दिने दद्यात्पृथङ्नित्यं न चाचरेत् ..
स समाजे जपेन्नित्यं पञ्चतारेण स्विष्टकृत् .. 17 ..
text_mt: One should offer one daily oblation every day and not perform it separately. / In the assembly, he should continually recite with five tāras, performing the sviṣṭakṛt.

sanskrit_iast:
ayute lakṣahome ca koṭihome ca sarvadā ..
prathame divase kuryāddevatānāṃ ca sthāpanam .. 18 ..
meaning:
अयुते लक्षहोमे च कोटिहोमे च सर्वदा ..
प्रथमे दिवसे कुर्याद्देवतानां च स्थापनम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: In a ten-thousand oblation, a hundred-thousand oblation, and always in a ten-million oblation, / on the first day one should perform the installation of the deities.

sanskrit_iast:
mahotsave dvitīye tu balidānaṃ tathaiva ca ..
tryahasādhye trirātre ca pūrṇaṃ kṛtvā visarjayet .. 19 ..
meaning:
महोत्सवे द्वितीये तु बलिदानं तथैव च ..
त्र्यहसाध्ये त्रिरात्रे च पूर्णं कृत्वा विसर्जयेत् .. 19 ..
text_mt: On the second [day] of the great festival, [there is] the animal sacrifice likewise. / In a rite to be accomplished in three days or three nights, having completed it, one should dismiss [the deities].

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāhe tu tṛtīye'hni balidānaṃ praśasyate ..
saptāhe cāṣṭadivase navāhe paṃcame'hani .. 2.1.14.20 ..
meaning:
पञ्चाहे तु तृतीयेऽह्नि बलिदानं प्रशस्यते ..
सप्ताहे चाष्टदिवसे नवाहे पंचमेऽहनि .. 2.1.14.20 ..
text_mt: In a five-day rite, the animal sacrifice is praised on the third day; / in a seven-day rite, on the eighth day; in a nine-day rite, on the fifth day;

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāhe dvādaśāhe tu dvātriṃśatṣoḍaśe'hani ..
ito'nyathā na kurvīta nātra yajñaphalaṃ labhet .. 21 ..
kuṇḍasaṃskāravarṇanam
meaning:
पञ्चाहे द्वादशाहे तु द्वात्रिंशत्षोडशेऽहनि ..
इतोऽन्यथा न कुर्वीत नात्र यज्ञफलं लभेत् .. 21 ..
कुण्डसंस्कारवर्णनम्
text_mt:
in a [fifteen]-day rite, on the twelfth day; and in a thirty-two [day rite], on the sixteenth day. / One must not act otherwise than this; [otherwise] one would not obtain the fruit of the sacrifice here.
Description of the Consecration of the Sacrificial Pit

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
kuṇḍānāmatha saṃskāre vakṣye śāstramataṃ yathā ..
asaṃskṛte cārthahānistasmātsaṃskṛtya homayet .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
कुण्डानामथ संस्कारे वक्ष्ये शास्त्रमतं यथा ..
असंस्कृते चार्थहानिस्तस्मात्संस्कृत्य होमयेत् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Now I shall speak of the consecration of sacrificial pits according to the opinion of the scriptures. / In an unconsecrated [pit] there is loss of wealth; therefore, having consecrated it, one should offer oblations.
title: adhyāyaḥ 15

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭādaśa syuḥ saṃskārāḥ kuṇḍānāṃ tatra darśitāḥ..
tāreṇāvekṣayetsthānaṃ kuśatoyaiḥ prasecayet ..2..
meaning:
अष्टादश स्युः संस्काराः कुण्डानां तत्र दर्शिताः..
तारेणावेक्षयेत्स्थानं कुशतोयैः प्रसेचयेत् ..2..
text_mt: Eighteen consecrations of sacrificial pits are shown there. / One should inspect the place with the tāra and sprinkle it with water containing kuśa grass.

sanskrit_iast:
trisūtrīkaraṇaṃ paścādvṛttasūtraṃ nipātayet..
vāreṇa kīlakaṃ dadyānnārasiṃhena kuḍmalam ..3..
meaning:
त्रिसूत्रीकरणं पश्चाद्वृत्तसूत्रं निपातयेत्..
वारेण कीलकं दद्यान्नारसिंहेन कुड्मलम् ..3..
text_mt: Then the making of three cords; one should cast the circular cord. / One should drive in a peg with the vāra [mantra], and a calyx with the Nārasiṃha [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
jihvāṃ prakalpayetpaścāttasmādagniṃ samāharet ..
na ca mlecchagṛhādagniṃ na śūdranilayātkvacit .. 4 ..
meaning:
जिह्वां प्रकल्पयेत्पश्चात्तस्मादग्निं समाहरेत् ..
न च म्लेच्छगृहादग्निं न शूद्रनिलयात्क्वचित् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Then one should fashion the tongue; from that one should bring the fire. / Fire should never be fetched from the house of a mleccha, nor from the dwelling of a śūdra,

sanskrit_iast:
nadīparvataśālābhyaḥ strīhastātparivarjayet ..
saṃskṛtya parigṛhṇīyāttridhā kṛtvā samuddharet .. 5 ..
meaning:
नदीपर्वतशालाभ्यः स्त्रीहस्तात्परिवर्जयेत् ..
संस्कृत्य परिगृह्णीयात्त्रिधा कृत्वा समुद्धरेत् .. 5 ..
text_mt: nor from rivers, mountains, or public halls; one should avoid [taking fire] from the hand of a woman. / Having consecrated it, one should accept it, and dividing it threefold, take it up.

sanskrit_iast:
tamagniṃ pratigṛhṇīyādātmano'bhimukhaṃ yathā ..
vahnibījena matimāñchivabījena prokṣayet .. 6 ..
meaning:
तमग्निं प्रतिगृह्णीयादात्मनोऽभिमुखं यथा ..
वह्निबीजेन मतिमाञ्छिवबीजेन प्रोक्षयेत् .. 6 ..
text_mt: One should receive that fire facing oneself. / The intelligent one should sprinkle it with the fire-bīja and the Śiva-bīja.

sanskrit_iast:
vāgīśvarīmṛtusnātāṃ vāgīśvarasamāgatām ..
dhyātvā samīraṇaṃ dadyātkāmamutpadyate tataḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
वागीश्वरीमृतुस्नातां वागीश्वरसमागताम् ..
ध्यात्वा समीरणं दद्यात्काममुत्पद्यते ततः .. 7 ..
text_mt: Having meditated upon Vāgīśvarī, bathed after her menstrual period, united with Vāgīśvara, / one should fanningly provide wind; desire arises therefrom.

sanskrit_iast:
kālabījena caiśānyāṃ yonāvagniṃ vinikṣipet ..
paścāddevasya devyāśca dadyādācamanīyakam .. 8 ..
meaning:
कालबीजेन चैशान्यां योनावग्निं विनिक्षिपेत् ..
पश्चाद्देवस्य देव्याश्च दद्यादाचमनीयकम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: With the kāla-bīja one should cast the fire into the yoni in the north-east. / Afterwards, one should offer sipping-water to the god and the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛpiṅgala dahadaha paṃcayugmamudīrya ca ..
sarvajñājñāpaya svāhā mantroyaṃ vahnipūjane .. 9 ..
meaning:
पितृपिङ्गल दहदह पंचयुग्ममुदीर्य च ..
सर्वज्ञाज्ञापय स्वाहा मन्त्रोयं वह्निपूजने .. 9 ..
text_mt: Having uttered "pitṛpiṅgala daha daha" twice, [and then] / "sarvajñājñāpaya svāhā"—this is the mantra in the worship of Agni.

sanskrit_iast:
vahnibarhiṣi saṃyuktāḥ sādiyāṃtāḥ sabiṃdavaḥ ..
vahnimantrāḥ samuddiṣṭā dvijānāṃ maṃtra īritaḥ .. 2.1.15.10 ..
meaning:
वह्निबर्हिषि संयुक्ताः सादियांताः सबिंदवः ..
वह्निमन्त्राः समुद्दिष्टा द्विजानां मंत्र ईरितः .. 2.1.15.10 ..
text_mt: Combined with vahnibarhis, beginning with "sa" and ending with "ya", accompanied by the bindu— / the mantras of Agni are declared; the mantra for the twice-born has been stated.

sanskrit_iast:
jihvāstāstrividhāḥ proktā yajñadattena sattamāḥ ..
hiraṇyāmājyahomeṣu homayetsaṃyatātmakaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
जिह्वास्तास्त्रिविधाः प्रोक्ता यज्ञदत्तेन सत्तमाः ..
हिरण्यामाज्यहोमेषु होमयेत्संयतात्मकः .. 11 ..
text_mt: Those tongues were declared to be of three kinds by Yajñadatta, O best of men. / In oblations of clarified butter, one who has restrained his mind should make offerings into Hiraṇyā.

sanskrit_iast:
trimadhvaktairyatra homaṃ karṇikāyāṃ ca homayet ..
kanakāsyāttu kṛṣṇāsyāddhirṇyā śubhratā tathā .. 12 ..
meaning:
त्रिमध्वक्तैर्यत्र होमं कर्णिकायां च होमयेत् ..
कनकास्यात्तु कृष्णास्याद्धिर्ण्या शुभ्रता तथा .. 12 ..
text_mt: Where the oblation is made with substances smeared with the three sweets, he should offer it upon the pericarp. / From the golden face, the black face, Hiraṇyā, and likewise Śubhrā,

sanskrit_iast:
bahurūpātirūpā ca sāttvikā yogakarmasu ..
viśvamūrtiṃ sphuliṃginyau dhūmravarṇā manojavā ..13..
meaning:
बहुरूपातिरूपा च सात्त्विका योगकर्मसु ..
विश्वमूर्तिं स्फुलिंगिन्यौ धूम्रवर्णा मनोजवा ..13..
text_mt: Bahurūpā, and Atirūpā—[these are] sattvic in rites of yoga. / Viśvamūrti, the two Sphuliṅginīs, Dhūmravarṇā, Manojavā,

sanskrit_iast:
lohitāsyātkarālāsyātkālībhāsasya ityapi..
etāḥ sapta niyuṃjīta vijñeyāḥ krūrakarmasu ..14..
meaning:
लोहितास्यात्करालास्यात्कालीभासस्य इत्यपि..
एताः सप्त नियुंजीत विज्ञेयाः क्रूरकर्मसु ..14..
text_mt: Lohitāsyā, Karālāsyā, and Kālībhāsā— / these seven should be employed, known to be for cruel rites.

sanskrit_iast:
samidbhedeṣu yā jihvāstāstu tenaiva yojayet ..
hiraṇyāmājyahome homayetsaṃyatātmakaḥ ..15..
meaning:
समिद्भेदेषु या जिह्वास्तास्तु तेनैव योजयेत् ..
हिरण्यामाज्यहोमे होमयेत्संयतात्मकः ..15..
text_mt: Whichever tongues are assigned among the various kinds of kindling sticks, he should employ them with that very [material]. / In oblations of clarified butter, one who has restrained his mind should make offerings into Hiraṇyā.

sanskrit_iast:
trimadhvaktairyathā homaṃ karṇikāyāṃ ca homayet ..
śuddhakṣīreṇa raktāyāṃ naityikeṣu prabhā smṛtā .. 16 ..
meaning:
त्रिमध्वक्तैर्यथा होमं कर्णिकायां च होमयेत् ..
शुद्धक्षीरेण रक्तायां नैत्यिकेषु प्रभा स्मृता .. 16 ..
text_mt: Just as an oblation smeared with the three sweets is offered on the pericarp, / [so an oblation] with pure milk is offered in Raktā; Prabhā is remembered in obligatory rites.

sanskrit_iast:
bahurūpā puṣpahome kṛṣṇā cānnena pāyasaiḥ ..
ikṣuhome padmarāgā suvarṇā padmahomake 317..
meaning:
बहुरूपा पुष्पहोमे कृष्णा चान्नेन पायसैः ..
इक्षुहोमे पद्मरागा सुवर्णा पद्महोमके 317..
text_mt: Bahurūpā is used in flower oblations, Kṛṣṇā with cooked grain and milk-rice, / Padmarāgā in sugarcane oblations, and Suvarṇā in lotus oblations.

sanskrit_iast:
lohitā padmahome ca śvetā vai bilvapatrake ..
dhūminī tilahome ca kāṣṭhahome karālikā .. 18 ..
meaning:
लोहिता पद्महोमे च श्वेता वै बिल्वपत्रके ..
धूमिनी तिलहोमे च काष्ठहोमे करालिका .. 18 ..
text_mt: Lohitā in lotus oblations, Śvetā indeed with bilva leaves, / Dhūminī in sesamum oblations, and Karālikā in wood oblations.

sanskrit_iast:
lohitāsyā pitṛhome tato jñeyā manojavā ..
vaiśvānaraṃ sthitaṃ home samiddhomeṣu sattamāḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
लोहितास्या पितृहोमे ततो ज्ञेया मनोजवा ..
वैश्वानरं स्थितं होमे समिद्धोमेषु सत्तमाः .. 19 ..
text_mt: Lohitāsyā in ancestral oblations; then Manojavā is to be known. / Vaiśvānara is standing in oblations of kindling sticks, O best of men;

sanskrit_iast:
samānamājyahome ca niṣaṇṇaṃ śeṣavastuṣu ..
āsyāttu juhuyādvahnau pipartti sarvakarmasu .. 2.1.15.20 ..
meaning:
समानमाज्यहोमे च निषण्णं शेषवस्तुषु ..
आस्यात्तु जुहुयाद्वह्नौ पिपर्त्ति सर्वकर्मसु .. 2.1.15.20 ..
text_mt: level in oblations of clarified butter, and seated in the remaining substances. / He who offers into the mouth of the fire attains fulfillment in all rites.

sanskrit_iast:
karṇahome tu vai vyādhirnetre taddvayamīritam ..
nāsikāyāṃ manaḥpīḍā mastake'dhvā na saṃśayaḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
कर्णहोमे तु वै व्याधिर्नेत्रे तद्द्वयमीरितम् ..
नासिकायां मनःपीडा मस्तकेऽध्वा न संशयः .. 21 ..
text_mt: In an oblation into the ear, disease [results]; in the eye, both of those are said to occur; / in the nose, mental distress; in the head, a journey, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
putraṃ vipatkaraṃ caiva tasmāttatra na homayet ..
sādhāraṇamatho vakṣye vahnerjihvāśca kīrtitāḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
पुत्रं विपत्करं चैव तस्मात्तत्र न होमयेत् ..
साधारणमथो वक्ष्ये वह्नेर्जिह्वाश्च कीर्तिताः .. 22 ..
text_mt: And it brings calamity to one's son; therefore, one should not offer there. / Now I shall proclaim the common [rule], and the tongues of fire are praised:

sanskrit_iast:
pravakṣyāmi vidhiṃ kṛtsnaṃ yadviśeṣaṃ punaḥ śṛṇu ..
ghṛtāhutau hiraṇyākhyā gaganā pāṇihomataḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
प्रवक्ष्यामि विधिं कृत्स्नं यद्विशेषं पुनः शृणु ..
घृताहुतौ हिरण्याख्या गगना पाणिहोमतः .. 23 ..
text_mt: I will state the entire procedure; listen further to the specific rule. / In an offering of clarified butter, [the tongue] named Hiraṇyā [is used]; Gaganā from oblations with the hand;

sanskrit_iast:
vakrā khyātā mahāhome kṛṣṇābhā sā kratau matā ..
suprabhā modakavidhau bahurūpātirūpikāḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
वक्रा ख्याता महाहोमे कृष्णाभा सा क्रतौ मता ..
सुप्रभा मोदकविधौ बहुरूपातिरूपिकाः .. 24 ..
text_mt: Vakrā is renowned in the great oblation; she who shines black is considered [appropriate] in the sacrifice; / Suprabhā in the rite of sweetmeats; Bahurūpā and Atirūpā

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpapatravidhau home vahnerjihvāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ..
na vā saṃkalpayetkuṇḍe śūdrākāra vibhedataḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
पुष्पपत्रविधौ होमे वह्नेर्जिह्वाः प्रकीर्तिताः ..
न वा संकल्पयेत्कुण्डे शूद्राकार विभेदतः .. 25 ..
text_mt: in the oblation rite of flowers and leaves—[thus] the tongues of fire are proclaimed. / Or one should not arrange [them] in the sacrificial pit according to the different forms of Śūdras.

sanskrit_iast:
indrakoṣṭhaṃ mastakaṃ syādīśāgneye ca mastake ..
tatkāṣṭhapārśve dve netre dvau karau ca padakramāt .. 26 ..
meaning:
इन्द्रकोष्ठं मस्तकं स्यादीशाग्नेये च मस्तके ..
तत्काष्ठपार्श्वे द्वे नेत्रे द्वौ करौ च पदक्रमात् .. 26 ..
text_mt: The square of Indra should be the head, and in the northeast and southeast [there are parts of] the head; / on the flanks of that wood are the two eyes, and the two hands according to the position of the feet.

sanskrit_iast:
aviśiṣṭaṃ bhavetpucchaṃ madhye codarasambhavam ..
udare homayetpuṣṭimannaṃ pāyasakaṃ ca yat .. 27 ..
meaning:
अविशिष्टं भवेत्पुच्छं मध्ये चोदरसम्भवम् ..
उदरे होमयेत्पुष्टिमन्नं पायसकं च यत् .. 27 ..
text_mt: The remainder will be the tail, and in the middle what arises as the belly. / In the belly he should offer for nourishment whatever cooked food and milk-rice there is.

sanskrit_iast:
hutvā vrīhigaṇaṃ tatra karṇe puṣpāhutiṃ hunet ..
vāmakarṇe vāmanetre hunedabjādikaṃ budhaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
हुत्वा व्रीहिगणं तत्र कर्णे पुष्पाहुतिं हुनेत् ..
वामकर्णे वामनेत्रे हुनेदब्जादिकं बुधः .. 28 ..
text_mt: Having offered a collection of rice there, he should offer a flower oblation into the ear. / The wise man should offer lotuses and the like into the left ear and left eye,

sanskrit_iast:
śravaṇe caiva netre ca dakṣiṇe cekṣukhaṃḍakam ..
vāmapāde vāmakare abhicāreṣu śasyate .. 29 ..
meaning:
श्रवणे चैव नेत्रे च दक्षिणे चेक्षुखंडकम् ..
वामपादे वामकरे अभिचारेषु शस्यते .. 29 ..
text_mt: and pieces of sugarcane into the right ear and right eye. / [Offering] into the left foot and left hand is commended in sorcery rites.

sanskrit_iast:
māraṇe puṣpadeśe tu na cānyaṃ homayetkvacit ..
vipatkaraṃ vijānīyāddhvaniḥ sarvavināśakṛt .. 2.1.15.30 ..
meaning:
मारणे पुष्पदेशे तु न चान्यं होमयेत्क्वचित् ..
विपत्करं विजानीयाद्ध्वनिः सर्वविनाशकृत् .. 2.1.15.30 ..
text_mt: In rites of killing, [one should offer] into the place of the flowers, and never offer anything else anywhere. / One should know that [an error] brings calamity, and a [crackling] noise causes total destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
candanāgarukarpūrapāṭalāyūthikānibhaḥ ..
pāvakasya suto gaṃdhaḥ samaṃtātsumahodayaḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
चन्दनागरुकर्पूरपाटलायूथिकानिभः ..
पावकस्य सुतो गंधः समंतात्सुमहोदयः .. 31 ..
text_mt: Resembling sandalwood, aloe, camphor, pāṭalā, and yūthikā flowers, / the fragrant smell generated by the fire brings great prosperity on all sides.

sanskrit_iast:
pradakṣiṇastyaktakalpā chatrākā śithilā śikhā ..
śubhadā yajamānasya rājyasyāpi viśeṣataḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
प्रदक्षिणस्त्यक्तकल्पा छत्राका शिथिला शिखा ..
शुभदा यजमानस्य राज्यस्यापि विशेषतः .. 32 ..
text_mt: A flame that turns clockwise, has cast off [irregular] appearance, is shaped like a royal parasol, and is relaxed / bestows good fortune upon the sacrificer, and especially upon the kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
chinnavṛttāḥ śikhāḥ kuryānmṛtyurdhanaparikṣayaḥ ..
nirvāpyaṃ maraṇaṃ vidyānmahādhūmākule'pi ca .. 33 ..
meaning:
छिन्नवृत्ताः शिखाः कुर्यान्मृत्युर्धनपरिक्षयः ..
निर्वाप्यं मरणं विद्यान्महाधूमाकुलेऽपि च .. 33 ..
text_mt: Flames with broken circles cause death and the destruction of wealth. / If [the fire] is extinguished, or when it is choked with dense smoke, one should recognise death.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃvidheṣu doṣeṣu prāyaścittaṃ samācaret ..
aṣṭāviṃśāhutīstyaktvā brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
एवंविधेषु दोषेषु प्रायश्चित्तं समाचरेत् ..
अष्टाविंशाहुतीस्त्यक्त्वा ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेत्ततः .. 34 ..
text_mt: When such faults occur, he should perform an expiation: / having offered twenty-eight oblations, he should then feed brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlenājyena juhuyājjuhuyātpañcaviṃśatim ..
mahāsnānaṃ prakartavyaṃ trikālaṃ haripūjanam .. .. 35 ..
yajñāntapūjāvidhivarṇanam
meaning:
मूलेनाज्येन जुहुयाज्जुहुयात्पञ्चविंशतिम् ..
महास्नानं प्रकर्तव्यं त्रिकालं हरिपूजनम् .. .. 35 ..
यज्ञान्तपूजाविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
With clarified butter he should offer twenty-five [oblations] using the root mantra. / A great ablution should be performed, and the worship of Hari at the three junctures of the day.
Description of the procedure for worship at the conclusion of a sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūt uvāca .. ..
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ caiva yāgādau ca samāptake ..
homāvasāne prajapedupacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत् उवाच .. ..
नित्यं नैमित्तिकं चैव यागादौ च समाप्तके ..
होमावसाने प्रजपेदुपचारांश्च षोडश .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / In obligatory and occasional rites, and at the beginning and end of a sacrifice, / at the conclusion of the fire oblation he should recite [the mantras] and [present] the sixteen upacāras.
title: adhyāyaḥ 16

sanskrit_iast:
dadyātsamīraṇaṃ paścātpīṭhapūjāṃ samācarat ..
gṛhītvā raktapuṣpaṃ ca dhyāyedvahniṃ yathāvidhi .. 2 ..
meaning:
दद्यात्समीरणं पश्चात्पीठपूजां समाचरत् ..
गृहीत्वा रक्तपुष्पं च ध्यायेद्वह्निं यथाविधि .. 2 ..
text_mt: He should subsequently offer wind and perform the worship of the seat. / Taking a red flower, he should meditate on Agni according to rule:

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭaṃ śaktisvastikābhītimuccairdīrghairdorbhirdhārayantaṃ varāṃtam ..
hemākalpaṃ padmasaṃsthaṃ trinetraṃ dhyāyedvahniṃ baddhamauliṃ jaṭābhiḥ .. .. 3 ..
meaning:
इष्टं शक्तिस्वस्तिकाभीतिमुच्चैर्दीर्घैर्दोर्भिर्धारयन्तं वरांतम् ..
हेमाकल्पं पद्मसंस्थं त्रिनेत्रं ध्यायेद्वह्निं बद्धमौलिं जटाभिः .. .. 3 ..
text_mt: Holding aloft in his long arms the wish-granting [gesture], the spear, the svastika, the gesture of fearlessness, and the boon-granting [gesture], / adorned with gold ornaments, seated on a lotus, three-eyed, he should meditate on Agni with his crown bound with matted hair.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvādidvāradeśeṣu kāmadevaṃ śatakratum ..
varāhaṃ ṣaṇmukhaṃ caiva gaṃdhādyaiḥ sādhu pūjayet .. 4 ..
meaning:
पूर्वादिद्वारदेशेषु कामदेवं शतक्रतुम् ..
वराहं षण्मुखं चैव गंधाद्यैः साधु पूजयेत् .. 4 ..
text_mt: In the door locations beginning with the east, he should properly worship Kāmadeva, Indra, / Varāha, and Ṣaṇmukha with perfumes and other [offerings].

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhya sthāpayetpaścādaṣṭau mudrāḥ pradarśayet ..
dattvāsanaṃ svāgataṃ ca dadyātpādyādikatrayam .. 5 ..
meaning:
आवाह्य स्थापयेत्पश्चादष्टौ मुद्राः प्रदर्शयेत् ..
दत्त्वासनं स्वागतं च दद्यात्पाद्यादिकत्रयम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Having invoked and installed him, he should then display the eight mudrās. / Offering a seat and a welcome, he should present the triad beginning with water for the feet.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ pūrvādipātreṣu yāvatā ca hutāśanam ..
suvarṇavarṇamamalaṃ samiddhaṃ sarvatomukham .. 6 ..
meaning:
अतः पूर्वादिपात्रेषु यावता च हुताशनम् ..
सुवर्णवर्णममलं समिद्धं सर्वतोमुखम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Then, in the vessels beginning with the east, as far as Hutāśana [extends]— / golden-coloured, spotless, blazing, facing every direction,

sanskrit_iast:
mahodaraṃ mahājihvamākāśatvena pūjayet ..
tārakādīnsamāpte ca gandhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
महोदरं महाजिह्वमाकाशत्वेन पूजयेत् ..
तारकादीन्समाप्ते च गन्धैः पुष्पैः पृथग्विधैः .. 7 ..
text_mt: having a vast belly and a great tongue—he should worship him as space; / and at the conclusion [he should worship] the stars and the rest with perfumes and various kinds of flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva jihvāstrividhā dhyāyenmaṃtrapuraḥsarāḥ ..
vakṣyamāṇena maṃtreṇa upacārairanaṃtaram .. 8 ..
meaning:
तत्रैव जिह्वास्त्रिविधा ध्यायेन्मंत्रपुरःसराः ..
वक्ष्यमाणेन मंत्रेण उपचारैरनंतरम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Right there he should meditate on the three kinds of tongues, preceded by mantras, / with the mantra that will be stated, and immediately after with the upacāras:

sanskrit_iast:
tvamādiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ saṃsārārṇavatārakaḥ ..
paramajyotīrūpastvamāsanaṃ saphalī kuru .. 9 ..
meaning:
त्वमादिः सर्वभूतानां संसारार्णवतारकः ..
परमज्योतीरूपस्त्वमासनं सफली कुरु .. 9 ..
text_mt: "You are the beginning of all beings, the one who brings [them] across the ocean of worldly existence; / you have the form of supreme light; make [this] seat fruitful!"

sanskrit_iast:
dadyādāsanametena puṣpagucchatrayeṇa tu ..
puṭāṃjaliṃ tato baddhvā pṛcchetkuśalapūrvakam .. 2.1.16.10 ..
meaning:
दद्यादासनमेतेन पुष्पगुच्छत्रयेण तु ..
पुटांजलिं ततो बद्ध्वा पृच्छेत्कुशलपूर्वकम् .. 2.1.16.10 ..
text_mt: With this he should offer a seat consisting of three clusters of flowers. / Then, folding his hands in an añjali gesture, he should ask [after his welfare] with words of greeting:

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśvānara namaste'stu namaste havyavāhana ..
svāgataṃ tu suraśreṣṭha śāṃtiṃ kuru namo'stu te .. 11 ..
meaning:
वैश्वानर नमस्तेऽस्तु नमस्ते हव्यवाहन ..
स्वागतं तु सुरश्रेष्ठ शांतिं कुरु नमोऽस्तु ते .. 11 ..
text_mt: "O Vaiśvānara, homage to you! Homage to you, bearer of oblations! / Welcome, O best of gods! Bring peace, homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste bhagavandeva āponārāyaṇātmaka ..
sarvalokahitārthāya pādyaṃ ca pratigṛhyatām.. 12 ..
meaning:
नमस्ते भगवन्देव आपोनारायणात्मक ..
सर्वलोकहितार्थाय पाद्यं च प्रतिगृह्यताम्.. 12 ..
text_mt: Homage to you, O divine Lord, whose essence is Nārāyaṇa abiding in the waters! / For the welfare of all the worlds, please accept water for the feet.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇaparaṃ dhāma jyotīrūpa sanātana ..
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ viśvarūpa namo'stu te .. 13 ..
meaning:
नारायणपरं धाम ज्योतीरूप सनातन ..
गृहाणार्घ्यं मया दत्तं विश्वरूप नमोऽस्तु ते .. 13 ..
text_mt: O supreme abode of Nārāyaṇa, having the form of light, eternal one! / Accept the arghya offered by me, O universal form, homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
jagadādityarūpeṇa prakāśayati yaḥ sadā ..
tasmai prakāśarū pāya namaste jātavedase .. 14 ..
meaning:
जगदादित्यरूपेण प्रकाशयति यः सदा ..
तस्मै प्रकाशरू पाय नमस्ते जातवेदसे .. 14 ..
text_mt: He who always illuminates the universe in the form of the sun— / to that Jātavedas, whose form is light, homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
dhanaṃjaya namaste'stu sarvapāpapraṇāśana ..
snānīyaṃ te mayā dattaṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhaye .. 15 ..
meaning:
धनंजय नमस्तेऽस्तु सर्वपापप्रणाशन ..
स्नानीयं ते मया दत्तं सर्वकामार्थसिद्धये .. 15 ..
text_mt: O Dhanañjaya, homage to you, destroyer of all sins! / Bathing water is offered to you by me for the attainment of all desired aims.

sanskrit_iast:
hutāśana mahābāho devadeva sanātana ..
śaraṇaṃ te prayacchāmi dehi me paramaṃ padam .. 16 ..
meaning:
हुताशन महाबाहो देवदेव सनातन ..
शरणं ते प्रयच्छामि देहि मे परमं पदम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: O Hutāśana, mighty-armed one, god of gods, eternal one! / I offer you refuge; grant me the supreme abode!"

sanskrit_iast:
jyotiṣāṃ jyotīrūpastvamanādinidhanācyuta ..
mayā dattamalaṃkāramalaṃkuru namostu te .. 17 ..
meaning:
ज्योतिषां ज्योतीरूपस्त्वमनादिनिधनाच्युत ..
मया दत्तमलंकारमलंकुरु नमोस्तु ते .. 17 ..
text_mt: You are the embodiment of the light of lights, without beginning or end, O Acyuta; / adorn yourself with the ornament given by me. Homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
devīdevā mudaṃ yāṃti yasya samyaksamāgamāt ..
sarvadoṣopaśāṃtyartha gandho'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām .. 18 ..
meaning:
देवीदेवा मुदं यांति यस्य सम्यक्समागमात् ..
सर्वदोषोपशांत्यर्थ गन्धोऽयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: At whose proper approach the goddesses and gods find delight— / for the pacification of all afflictions, let this fragrance be accepted.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ hi brahmā ca jyotiṣāṃ gatirīśvara ..
gṛhāṇa puṣpaṃ deveśa sānulepaṃ jagadbhavet .. 19 ..
meaning:
त्वं विष्णुस्त्वं हि ब्रह्मा च ज्योतिषां गतिरीश्वर ..
गृहाण पुष्पं देवेश सानुलेपं जगद्भवेत् .. 19 ..
text_mt: You are Viṣṇu, you indeed are Brahmā, the destination of luminaries, the Sovereign; / accept the flower, O Lord of gods, along with ointment, that the world may prosper.

sanskrit_iast:
devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca sukhamekaṃ sanātanam ..
dhūpo'yaṃ devadeveśa gṛhyatāṃ me dhanaṃjaya .. 2.1.16.20 ..
meaning:
देवतानां पितॄणां च सुखमेकं सनातनम् ..
धूपोऽयं देवदेवेश गृह्यतां मे धनंजय .. 2.1.16.20 ..
text_mt: The single eternal happiness of the gods and the ancestors— / let this incense, O Lord of the gods of gods, O Dhanaṃjaya, be received from me.

sanskrit_iast:
tvamekaḥ sarvabhūteṣu sthāvareṣu careṣu ca ..
paramātmā parākāraḥ pradīpaḥ pratigṛhyatām .. 21 ..
meaning:
त्वमेकः सर्वभूतेषु स्थावरेषु चरेषु च ..
परमात्मा पराकारः प्रदीपः प्रतिगृह्यताम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: You alone [dwell] in all beings, in the stationary and the moving; / you are the Supreme Self, of supreme form. Let the lamp be accepted.

sanskrit_iast:
namo'stu yajñapataye prabhave jātavedase ..
sarvalokahitārthāya naivedyaṃ pratigṛhyatām .. 22 ..
meaning:
नमोऽस्तु यज्ञपतये प्रभवे जातवेदसे ..
सर्वलोकहितार्थाय नैवेद्यं प्रतिगृह्यताम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: Homage to the Lord of sacrifice, the powerful Jātavedas; / for the benefit of all worlds, let the food-offering be accepted.

sanskrit_iast:
hutāśana namastubhyaṃ namaste rukmavāhana ..
lokanātha namaste'stu namaste jātavedase .. 23 ..
meaning:
हुताशन नमस्तुभ्यं नमस्ते रुक्मवाहन ..
लोकनाथ नमस्तेऽस्तु नमस्ते जातवेदसे .. 23 ..
text_mt: O consumer of oblations, homage to you; homage to you who ride on gold; / O protector of the world, homage be to you; homage to Jātavedas.

sanskrit_iast:
ityanena tu mantreṇa dadyāddivye'pyadhītakam ..
sarvasvaṃ yajñasūtraṃ ca paramānnaṃ samākṣikam ..24..
agnivarṇanam
meaning:
इत्यनेन तु मन्त्रेण दद्याद्दिव्येऽप्यधीतकम् ..
सर्वस्वं यज्ञसूत्रं च परमान्नं समाक्षिकम् ..24..
अग्निवर्णनम्
text_mt:
With this mantra he should give what was studied [by him], on a celestial day too, / all his possessions, the sacrificial cord, and the finest milk-rice mixed with honey.
Description of the Fires

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
yajñabhedaṃ tribhedaṃ ca vakṣye śāstramataṃ yathā ..
yathāvedānusāreṇa yathāgrahaṇa yojanam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
यज्ञभेदं त्रिभेदं च वक्ष्ये शास्त्रमतं यथा ..
यथावेदानुसारेण यथाग्रहण योजनम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / I shall state the division of sacrifices, threefold according to the opinion of the scriptures, / according to the Veda, and as applied in reception.
title: adhyāyaḥ 17

sanskrit_iast:
śatārdhe vahniruddiṣṭaḥ śatārdhe kāśyapaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
ghṛtapradīpake viṣṇustilayāge vanaspatiḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
शतार्धे वह्निरुद्दिष्टः शतार्धे काश्यपः स्मृतः ..
घृतप्रदीपके विष्णुस्तिलयागे वनस्पतिः .. 2 ..
text_mt: [In a rite of] fifty [oblations], Vahni is prescribed; [in another of] fifty, Kāśyapa is remembered; / in a ghee lamp, it is Viṣṇu; in a sesame sacrifice, it is Vanaspati.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasre brāhmaṇo nāma ayute harirucyate ..
lakṣahome tu vahniḥ syātkoṭihome hutāśanaḥ ..3..
meaning:
सहस्रे ब्राह्मणो नाम अयुते हरिरुच्यते ..
लक्षहोमे तु वह्निः स्यात्कोटिहोमे हुताशनः ..3..
text_mt: In a thousand, it is called Brāhmaṇa; in ten thousand, it is named Hari; / in a sacrifice of one hundred thousand offerings, it is Vahni; in a sacrifice of ten million, Hutāśana.

sanskrit_iast:
varuṇaḥ śāṃtike jñeyo māraṇe hyaruṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
nityahome'nalo nāma prāyaścitte hutāśanaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
वरुणः शांतिके ज्ञेयो मारणे ह्यरुणः स्मृतः ..
नित्यहोमेऽनलो नाम प्रायश्चित्ते हुताशनः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Varuṇa is to be known in rites of pacification, and Aruṇa is remembered in rites of destruction; / in the daily fire-offering his name is Anala, and in expiation, Hutāśana.

sanskrit_iast:
lohitaścānnayajñe yo grahāṇāṃ pratyanukramāt ..
devapratiṣṭhāyāge tu lohitaḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
लोहितश्चान्नयज्ञे यो ग्रहाणां प्रत्यनुक्रमात् ..
देवप्रतिष्ठायागे तु लोहितः परिकीर्तितः .. 5 ..
text_mt: And Lohita is in the grain sacrifice, respectively for the planets; / in the sacrifice for the consecration of deities, Lohita is proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpatirvāstuyāge maṃḍape cāpi padmake ..
prapāyāṃ caiva nāgākhyo mahādāne havirbhujaḥ ..6..
meaning:
प्रजापतिर्वास्तुयागे मंडपे चापि पद्मके ..
प्रपायां चैव नागाख्यो महादाने हविर्भुजः ..6..
text_mt: Prajāpati is in the Vāstu sacrifice, and also in the pavilion shaped like a lotus; / in a water station he is called Nāga; in a great gift, [the fire is called] Havirbhuj.

sanskrit_iast:
godāne ca bhavedrudraḥ kanyādāne tu go'jakaḥ ..
tulāpuruṣadāne ca dhātāgniḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
गोदाने च भवेद्रुद्रः कन्यादाने तु गोऽजकः ..
तुलापुरुषदाने च धाताग्निः परिकीर्तितः .. 7 ..
text_mt: In the gift of a cow, it is Rudra; but in giving away a maiden, it is Go'jaka; / and in the gift of a man's weight, the fire is proclaimed as Dhātṛ.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣotsarge bhavetsūryo'vasānāṃte raviḥ smṛtaḥ ..
pāvako vaiśvadeve ca dīkṣāpakṣe janārdanaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
वृषोत्सर्गे भवेत्सूर्योऽवसानांते रविः स्मृतः ..
पावको वैश्वदेवे च दीक्षापक्षे जनार्दनः .. 8 ..
text_mt: In the release of a bull, it is Sūrya; at the conclusion of one's end, it is remembered as Ravi; / Pāvaka is in the Vaiśvadeva rite; and on the occasion of initiation, it is Janārdana.

sanskrit_iast:
trāsane ca bhavetkālaḥ kravyādaḥ śaradāhane ..
parṇadāhe yamo nāma hyasthidāhe śikhaṃḍikaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
त्रासने च भवेत्कालः क्रव्यादः शरदाहने ..
पर्णदाहे यमो नाम ह्यस्थिदाहे शिखंडिकः .. 9 ..
text_mt: In causing terror, it is Kāla; Kravyāda is in the burning of a dead body; / in the cremation of an effigy of leaves, his name is Yama; and in the burning of bones, Śikhaṇḍin.

sanskrit_iast:
garbhādhāne ca marutaḥ sīmaṃte piṃgalaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
puṃsave tviṃdra ākhyātaḥ praśasto yāgakarmaṇi .. 2.1.17.10 ..
meaning:
गर्भाधाने च मरुतः सीमंते पिंगलः स्मृतः ..
पुंसवे त्विंद्र आख्यातः प्रशस्तो यागकर्मणि .. 2.1.17.10 ..
text_mt: In conception, it is Marut; in hair-parting, Piṅgala is remembered; / in the rite for generating a male, it is declared to be Indra, auspicious in sacrificial rites.

sanskrit_iast:
nāmasaṃsthāpane caivamupanyaste ca pārthivaḥ ..
niṣkrame hāṭakaścaiva prāśane ca śucistathā .. 11 ..
meaning:
नामसंस्थापने चैवमुपन्यस्ते च पार्थिवः ..
निष्क्रमे हाटकश्चैव प्राशने च शुचिस्तथा .. 11 ..
text_mt: And thus in the name-giving and in depositing [the infant], it is Pārthiva; / at first outing, it is Hāṭaka; and at first feeding, likewise Śuci.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍānanaśca cūḍāyāṃ vratādeśe samudbhavaḥ ..
vītihotraścopanaye samāvarte dhanaṃjayaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
षडाननश्च चूडायां व्रतादेशे समुद्भवः ..
वीतिहोत्रश्चोपनये समावर्ते धनंजयः .. 12 ..
text_mt: And Ṣaḍānana is at the tonsure; Samudbhava is at the initiation of a vow; / Vītihotra is at the sacred thread investiture; and at the return home, Dhanaṃjaya.

sanskrit_iast:
udare jaṭharāgniśca samudre vaḍavānalaḥ ..
śikhāyāṃ ca vibhurjñeyaḥ svarasyāgniḥ sarīsṛpaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
उदरे जठराग्निश्च समुद्रे वडवानलः ..
शिखायां च विभुर्ज्ञेयः स्वरस्याग्निः सरीसृपः .. 13 ..
text_mt: In the belly, it is the digestive fire, and in the ocean, the submarine fire; / on the crest, Vibhu is to be known, and Sarīsṛpa is the fire of voice.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvāgnirmaṃtharo nāma rathāgnirjātavedasaḥ ..
gajāgnirmaṃdaraścaiva sūryāgnirviṃdhyasaṃjñakaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
अश्वाग्निर्मंथरो नाम रथाग्निर्जातवेदसः ..
गजाग्निर्मंदरश्चैव सूर्याग्निर्विंध्यसंज्ञकः .. 14 ..
text_mt: The fire of horses is named Manthara; the fire of chariots is Jātavedas; / the fire of elephants is Mandara; and the fire of the sun is named Vindhya.

sanskrit_iast:
toyāgnirvaruṇonāma brāhmaṇāgnirhavirbhujaḥ ..
parvatāgniḥ kratubhujo dāvāgniḥ sūrya ucyate .. 15 ..
meaning:
तोयाग्निर्वरुणोनाम ब्राह्मणाग्निर्हविर्भुजः ..
पर्वताग्निः क्रतुभुजो दावाग्निः सूर्य उच्यते .. 15 ..
text_mt: The fire of water is named Varuṇa; the fire of Brahmins is Havirbhuj; / the fire of mountains is Kratubhuj; the forest fire is called Sūrya.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpāgniḥ pāvako nāma gṛhyāgnirdharaṇīpatiḥ ..
ghṛtāgniśca nalo vāyuḥ sūtikāgniśca rākṣasaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
दीपाग्निः पावको नाम गृह्याग्निर्धरणीपतिः ..
घृताग्निश्च नलो वायुः सूतिकाग्निश्च राक्षसः .. 16 ..
text_mt: The fire of lamps is named Pāvaka; the domestic fire is Dharaṇīpati; / the fire of ghee is Nala and Vāyu; and the fire of the lying-in chamber is Rākṣasa.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe madhyamaparvaṇi prathamabhāge'gnināmavarṇanaṃnāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 17 ...cha...
homadravyakathanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे मध्यमपर्वणि प्रथमभागेऽग्निनामवर्णनंनाम सप्तदशोऽध्यायः .. 17 ...छ...
होमद्रव्यकथनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the seventeenth chapter, named 'Description of the Names of Fire', in the first part of the Madhyamaparvan in the glorious Mahāpurāṇa, the Bhaviṣya.
Declaration of the Sacrificial Materials

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
athāto homadravyāṇāṃ pramāṇamabhidhīyate ..
pramāṇe cāpramāṇe ca niṣphalaṃ bhavati dhuvam ..1..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अथातो होमद्रव्याणां प्रमाणमभिधीयते ..
प्रमाणे चाप्रमाणे च निष्फलं भवति धुवम् ..1..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Now the measure of the sacrificial materials is stated; / whether in measure or beyond measure, [done wrongly] it surely becomes fruitless.
title: adhyāyaḥ 18

sanskrit_iast:
karṣamātraṃ ghṛtaṃ home śuktimātraṃ payaḥ smṛtam ..
tatsamaṃ pañcagavyaṃ ca dadhi dugdhaṃ tathā madhu .. 2 ..
meaning:
कर्षमात्रं घृतं होमे शुक्तिमात्रं पयः स्मृतम् ..
तत्समं पञ्चगव्यं च दधि दुग्धं तथा मधु .. 2 ..
text_mt: Ghee in a fire-offering is remembered as a karṣa; milk as a śukti; / equal to that is the five products of the cow, curd, milk, and honey.

sanskrit_iast:
muṣṭimānena pṛthukā lājāḥ syurmuṣṭisaṃmitāḥ ..
śarkarā muṣṭimātrā ca śarkarātolakaṃ viduḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
मुष्टिमानेन पृथुका लाजाः स्युर्मुष्टिसंमिताः ..
शर्करा मुष्टिमात्रा च शर्करातोलकं विदुः .. 3 ..
text_mt: Flattened rice is by measure of a fistful; parched grain should be measured by fistfuls; / sugar is a fistful in measure, and they know sugar as a tolaka.

sanskrit_iast:
tritolakaṃ guḍaṃ vidyādikṣuparvavi dhirbhavet ..
ekaikaṃ patrapuṣpāṇi śālūkasya trimuṣṭikam ..4..
meaning:
त्रितोलकं गुडं विद्यादिक्षुपर्ववि धिर्भवेत् ..
एकैकं पत्रपुष्पाणि शालूकस्य त्रिमुष्टिकम् ..4..
text_mt: One should know jaggery as three tolakas; sugar cane follows the rule of internodes; / leaves and flowers one by one; of lotus root, three fistfuls.

sanskrit_iast:
ekalagne na juhuyānna pṛthagjuhuyātkvacit ..
savṛṃtakaṃ japāpuṣpaṃ keśaraṃ tatsavṛṃtakam .. .. 5 ..
meaning:
एकलग्ने न जुहुयान्न पृथग्जुहुयात्क्वचित् ..
सवृंतकं जपापुष्पं केशरं तत्सवृंतकम् .. .. 5 ..
text_mt: One must not offer things joined as one, nor should one ever offer separately [what is whole]; / a hibiscus flower should have its stalk, and saffron its filaments with their base.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikaśaśca padmānāṃ jalajānāṃ tathaiva ca ..
jīvaṃtyāḥ phalamānena piṣṭakānāṃ prasaṃkhyayā .. 6 ..
meaning:
एकैकशश्च पद्मानां जलजानां तथैव च ..
जीवंत्याः फलमानेन पिष्टकानां प्रसंख्यया .. 6 ..
text_mt: And lotuses one by one, and water-born flowers likewise; / by the measure of a fruit of jīvantī, [and] cakes by number.

sanskrit_iast:
vasaṃtakaṃ dhātrimāne modakasya pramāṇataḥ ..
ekaikaśaḥ phalānāṃ ca mātuliṃgatrikheḍakam ..7..
meaning:
वसंतकं धात्रिमाने मोदकस्य प्रमाणतः ..
एकैकशः फलानां च मातुलिंगत्रिखेडकम् ..7..
text_mt: A vāsantaka by the measure of a myrobalan; modaka by its measure; / fruits one by one, and a citron in three pieces.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭadhā nālikerasya panasaṃ daśadhā bhavet..
padmabījapramāṇena kūṣmāṃḍaṃ cāṣṭadhā bhavet ..8..
meaning:
अष्टधा नालिकेरस्य पनसं दशधा भवेत्..
पद्मबीजप्रमाणेन कूष्मांडं चाष्टधा भवेत् ..8..
text_mt: A coconut is [divided] in eight parts, a jackfruit should be in ten parts; / ash gourd should be in eight parts, measured to the size of a lotus seed.

sanskrit_iast:
urvārukaṃ cāṣṭadhā ca guḍūcī caturaṃgulam ..
pūgamānaṃ ca māṃsasya saguḍaṃ tatra dṛśyate ..9..
meaning:
उर्वारुकं चाष्टधा च गुडूची चतुरंगुलम् ..
पूगमानं च मांसस्य सगुडं तत्र दृश्यते ..9..
text_mt: A cucumber is in eight parts, and guḍūcī is four fingers [long]; / meat is seen to be of the size of an areca nut, together with jaggery there.

sanskrit_iast:
anyatra badarīmānaṃ tiṃdukaṃ ca tridhā kṛtam ..
kāṣṭhaṃ prādeśamātraṃ syāddūrvā yāśca tripatrakam .. 2.1.18.10 ..
meaning:
अन्यत्र बदरीमानं तिंदुकं च त्रिधा कृतम् ..
काष्ठं प्रादेशमात्रं स्याद्दूर्वा याश्च त्रिपत्रकम् .. 2.1.18.10 ..
text_mt: Elsewhere it is the size of a jujube; a tinduka is divided into three; / fire-wood should be the span of a hand, and dūrvā grass three-leaved.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūrjapatraṃ ca gṛhṇīyācchamīṃ prādeśamātrikām ..
vrīhayo muṣṭimātrāḥ syuḥ śuktimānena sarṣapāḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
भूर्जपत्रं च गृह्णीयाच्छमीं प्रादेशमात्रिकाम् ..
व्रीहयो मुष्टिमात्राः स्युः शुक्तिमानेन सर्षपाः .. 11 ..
text_mt: And one should take birch-bark and śamī measuring the span of a hand; / rice grains should be a fistful, mustard seeds by the measure of a śukti.

sanskrit_iast:
maricāḥ syurvimā nena mṛṇālaṃ cātha mūlakam ..
saptakhaṃḍaṃ ca vārtākaṃ tripuṣṭaṃ ca tridhoditam ..12..
meaning:
मरिचाः स्युर्विमा नेन मृणालं चाथ मूलकम् ..
सप्तखंडं च वार्ताकं त्रिपुष्टं च त्रिधोदितम् ..12..
text_mt: Peppercorns should be [offered] by counting, and lotus-fibres, and radish; / an eggplant is divided into seven pieces, and tripuṣṭa is taught as threefold.

sanskrit_iast:
caṃdanāgurukarpūrakastūrīkuṃkumāni ca ..
tittiḍībījamānena samuddi ṣṭāni deśikaiḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
चंदनागुरुकर्पूरकस्तूरीकुंकुमानि च ..
तित्तिडीबीजमानेन समुद्दि ष्टानि देशिकैः .. 13 ..
text_mt: Sandalwood, agarwood, camphor, musk, and saffron— / these are prescribed by the teachers as being measured by the seed of a tamarind.

sanskrit_iast:
samidāplavane tryaṃgatilānāmapi madhyataḥ..
daśakaṃ plāvanenaiva sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ vinā .. 14 ..
meaning:
समिदाप्लवने त्र्यंगतिलानामपि मध्यतः..
दशकं प्लावनेनैव सहस्राणां शतं विना .. 14 ..
text_mt: In the dipping of sacrificial fuel, by the three fingers, and in the middle of sesame seeds; / by dipping a group of ten, without a hundred of thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vrīhiplāvane ca kāṣṭhavadi kṣudaṃḍakam ..
prokṣaṇaṃ mṛdupuṣpāṇāṃ latādīnāṃ tathaiva ca .. 15 ..
meaning:
एवं व्रीहिप्लावने च काष्ठवदि क्षुदंडकम् ..
प्रोक्षणं मृदुपुष्पाणां लतादीनां तथैव च .. 15 ..
text_mt: So too in the dipping of rice, [and] a stalk of sugar cane like firewood; / sprinkling is for soft flowers and creepers and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
pāyasānne tathānne ca modake piṣṭake'pi ca ..
śālyāsaktena juhuyādvyatyaye vyatyayaṃ phalam .. 16 ..
meaning:
पायसान्ने तथान्ने च मोदके पिष्टकेऽपि च ..
शाल्यासक्तेन जुहुयाद्व्यत्यये व्यत्ययं फलम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: With milk-rice, ordinary food, modaka, and cake as well, / one should offer mixed with śāli rice; in inversion, the fruit is inverted.

sanskrit_iast:
bilvapatrasya plavanaṃ daṃḍaṃ hitvā ca plāvayet ..
vṛṃtasaṃplāvanādeva phalaṃ harati rākṣasaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
बिल्वपत्रस्य प्लवनं दंडं हित्वा च प्लावयेत् ..
वृंतसंप्लावनादेव फलं हरति राक्षसः .. 17 ..
text_mt: In the dipping of a bilva leaf, having discarded the stem, one should dip it; / from dipping the stalk itself, a rākṣasa steals the fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
bilvapatrasya pūrvārdhaprāptamātreṇa yoja yet ..
patratrayaṃ tathā home chinnebhinne'tidūṣaṇam .. 18 ..
meaning:
बिल्वपत्रस्य पूर्वार्धप्राप्तमात्रेण योज येत् ..
पत्रत्रयं तथा होमे छिन्नेभिन्नेऽतिदूषणम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: As soon as the front half of the bilva leaf is obtained, one should employ it; / likewise three leaves in a fire-offering; if severed or broken, it is a great defect.

sanskrit_iast:
na dvitriplavanaṃ kuryātkṛtvā yāti rasātalam ..
tasmācca putraśiṣyādyairbrāhmaṇaistattvakovidaiḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
न द्वित्रिप्लवनं कुर्यात्कृत्वा याति रसातलम् ..
तस्माच्च पुत्रशिष्याद्यैर्ब्राह्मणैस्तत्त्वकोविदैः .. 19 ..
text_mt:
One must not perform two or three dippings; having done so, one goes to the netherworld.
Therefore, by sons, pupils, and others, by Brahmins skilled in the true principles,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvāśābhimukho bhūtvā pāvayecca yathākramāt ..
na nyūnaṃ nādhikaṃ kuryācchāṃtipakṣa udaṅmukhaḥ .. 2.1.18.20 ..
meaning:
पूर्वाशाभिमुखो भूत्वा पावयेच्च यथाक्रमात् ..
न न्यूनं नाधिकं कुर्याच्छांतिपक्ष उदङ्मुखः .. 2.1.18.20 ..
text_mt:
facing toward the east, one should purify [the leaves] in proper order.
One should not make it less or more; in the rite of pacification, [one should face] northward.

sanskrit_iast:
pāyasānyanyadeveṣu yatnena pariva rjayet ..
na cāgnau dāpayedyatnādetebhyaḥ pratipādayet ..21..
meaning:
पायसान्यन्यदेवेषु यत्नेन परिव र्जयेत् ..
न चाग्नौ दापयेद्यत्नादेतेभ्यः प्रतिपादयेत् ..21..
text_mt:
One should diligently avoid milk-rice offerings in [the worship of] other deities.
And one must not offer it into the fire with effort; one should distribute it to these [deities].

sanskrit_iast:
kaniṣṭhāṃgulimāsādya prakuryātparvabhūṣaṇam ..
guṇadorakamānena tāvaddhomagatirbudhāḥ ..22..
meaning:
कनिष्ठांगुलिमासाद्य प्रकुर्यात्पर्वभूषणम् ..
गुणदोरकमानेन तावद्धोमगतिर्बुधाः ..22..
text_mt:
Reaching up to the little finger, one should make the joint-ornament.
According to the measure of the sacred thread, so far is the motion of the oblation, O wise ones,

sanskrit_iast:
aṃgulairdvitricaturaiḥ patrahomākṛtikramāt .. 23 ..
sruvadarvīnirṇayavarṇanam
meaning:
अंगुलैर्द्वित्रिचतुरैः पत्रहोमाकृतिक्रमात् .. 23 ..
स्रुवदर्वीनिर्णयवर्णनम्
text_mt:
measuring two, three, or four finger-breadths, according to the order of the leaf-oblation form.
Description of the determination of the ladle and spoon

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
śrīparṇī śiṃśapā kṣīrī bilvaḥ khadira eva ca ..
sruve praśastāstaravaḥ siddhidā yāgakarmaṇi .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
श्रीपर्णी शिंशपा क्षीरी बिल्वः खदिर एव च ..
स्रुवे प्रशस्तास्तरवः सिद्धिदा यागकर्मणि .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Śrīparṇī, śiṃśapā, milky-sap trees, bilva, and khadira—
these trees are praised for the sruva-ladle, granting success in sacrificial rites.
title: Sruvadarvīnirṇayaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ praśastāstu dhātrīkhadirakeśarāḥ ..
saṃskāre śaśibhinnau ca dhātrī dhātrā vinirmitā .. 2 ..
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठायां प्रशस्तास्तु धात्रीखदिरकेशराः ..
संस्कारे शशिभिन्नौ च धात्री धात्रा विनिर्मिता .. 2 ..
text_mt:
In consecration rites, dhātrī, khadira, and keśara are praised;
in purification rites, two trees split by the moon, [and] dhātrī fashioned by the Creator.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāśe yaḥ sruvaḥ proktaḥ saṃskāre yajñasādhane ..
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ tu kathitāsta danye śāstravedibhiḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
संप्राशे यः स्रुवः प्रोक्तः संस्कारे यज्ञसाधने ..
प्रतिष्ठायां तु कथितास्त दन्ये शास्त्रवेदिभिः .. 3 ..
text_mt:
The sruva-ladle that is prescribed for feeding, for purification, and for accomplishing sacrifice,
and others in consecration rites, have been stated by those who know the scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
sruvaṃ srucamatho vakṣye yadadhīnaśca jāyate ..
yajñe na sarvakaṃ dhāryamakṣareṇa ca vyatyayaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
स्रुवं स्रुचमथो वक्ष्ये यदधीनश्च जायते ..
यज्ञे न सर्वकं धार्यमक्षरेण च व्यत्ययः .. 4 ..
text_mt:
Now I shall describe the sruva-ladle and sruc-spoon, subject to which [the sacrifice] comes to be.
In sacrifice, not everything is to be held, nor is there an inversion by a single syllable.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyādau ca sruvaṃ vakṣye yacca mānaṃ yadāspadam ..
kāṣṭhaṃ gṛhītvā bilvasya riktāditithivarjite .. 5 ..
meaning:
तस्यादौ च स्रुवं वक्ष्ये यच्च मानं यदास्पदम् ..
काष्ठं गृहीत्वा बिल्वस्य रिक्तादितिथिवर्जिते .. 5 ..
text_mt:
First I shall describe its sruva-ladle, its measure, and its foundation.
Taking the wood of a bilva tree on a lunar day excluding empty lunar days and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
samupoṣya ca racayedāmiṣāṇi na ca smaret ..
varjayedgrāmyadharmaṃ ca nirmāṇe sruksruvasya vai .. 6 ..
meaning:
समुपोष्य च रचयेदामिषाणि न च स्मरेत् ..
वर्जयेद्ग्राम्यधर्मं च निर्माणे स्रुक्स्रुवस्य वै .. 6 ..
text_mt:
and having fasted, one should fashion it, and not even think of meat;
and one should avoid sexual intercourse during the making of the sruc and sruva.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṣṭhaṃ gṛhītvā vibhajedbhāgāṃstriṃśattathā punaḥ ..
viṃśatyaṃgulamānaṃ tu kuṃḍavedisamodaram.. 7..
meaning:
काष्ठं गृहीत्वा विभजेद्भागांस्त्रिंशत्तथा पुनः ..
विंशत्यंगुलमानं तु कुंडवेदिसमोदरम्.. 7..
text_mt:
Taking the piece of wood, one should divide it again into thirty parts.
Its measure is twenty finger-breadths, its belly equal to the sacrificial pit and altar.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṭāhākāranimnaṃ ca sruvaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ..
dhātrīphalasamākāraṃ svadhānimnaṃ suśobhanam .. 8 ..
meaning:
कटाहाकारनिम्नं च स्रुवं कुर्याद्विचक्षणः ..
धात्रीफलसमाकारं स्वधानिम्नं सुशोभनम् .. 8 ..
text_mt:
The wise person should make the sruva-ladle hollow like a cauldron,
resembling the shape of an āmalakī fruit, hollowed for the svadhā-offering, very beautiful.

sanskrit_iast:
vedīṃ śūrpākṛtiṃ kuryātkuṃḍāni parikalpayet ..
haṃsavattriguṇā vāpi hastenā'numukhaṃ likhet .. 9 ..
meaning:
वेदीं शूर्पाकृतिं कुर्यात्कुंडानि परिकल्पयेत् ..
हंसवत्त्रिगुणा वापि हस्तेनाऽनुमुखं लिखेत् .. 9 ..
text_mt:
One should make the altar winnowing-basket-shaped, and fashion the sacrificial pits;
or three times as long, like a swan, one should draw it facing forward with the hand.

sanskrit_iast:
sruvaṃ caturviṃśatibhirbhāgaiśca racayeddhruvam ..
dvitriṃśaṃ syātkuṃḍamānamadaive tasya kīrtitam .. 2.1.19.10 ..
meaning:
स्रुवं चतुर्विंशतिभिर्भागैश्च रचयेद्ध्रुवम् ..
द्वित्रिंशं स्यात्कुंडमानमदैवे तस्य कीर्तितम् .. 2.1.19.10 ..
text_mt:
One must certainly fashion the sruva-ladle with twenty-four parts.
The measure of the sacrificial pit should be thirty-two; it is stated for non-divine rites.

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhiraṃgairānāhaṃ karṣādyagraṃ tataḥ sruvam ..
aṃgadvayena vilikhetpaṃke mṛgamadākṛtim ..11..
meaning:
चतुर्भिरंगैरानाहं कर्षाद्यग्रं ततः स्रुवम् ..
अंगद्वयेन विलिखेत्पंके मृगमदाकृतिम् ..11..
text_mt:
Its circumference is four angulas, its tip a karṣa and so forth; then the sruva-ladle
one should delineate with two angulas, having the form of musk in mud.

sanskrit_iast:
daṃḍamūlāśraye daṃḍī bhavetkaṃkaṇabhūṣitaḥ ..
sauvarṇasya ca tāmrasya kāryā darvī pramāṇataḥ ..12..
meaning:
दंडमूलाश्रये दंडी भवेत्कंकणभूषितः ..
सौवर्णस्य च ताम्रस्य कार्या दर्वी प्रमाणतः ..12..
text_mt:
Resting at the base of the staff, the staff should be adorned with a ring.
A spoon of gold or of copper should be made according to the correct measure.

sanskrit_iast:
śraivarṇikodbhavaṃ yacca iṃduvṛkṣasamudbhavam..
kṣīravṛkṣasamudbhūtaṃ dvādaśāṃgulasaṃmitam..13..
meaning:
श्रैवर्णिकोद्भवं यच्च इंदुवृक्षसमुद्भवम्..
क्षीरवृक्षसमुद्भूतं द्वादशांगुलसंमितम्..13..
text_mt:
That which is born of the śraivarṇika tree, born of the indu tree,
and born of a tree with milky sap, measuring twelve finger-breadths—

sanskrit_iast:
dvayaṃgulaṃ maṃḍalaṃ tasya darvī sā yajñasādhane..
catvāriṃśattolikābhiriti tāmramayasya ca..14..
meaning:
द्वयंगुलं मंडलं तस्य दर्वी सा यज्ञसाधने..
चत्वारिंशत्तोलिकाभिरिति ताम्रमयस्य च..14..
text_mt:
its bowl is two finger-breadths; that spoon is used in performing the sacrifice.
Or of copper, weighing forty tolās.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcāṃgulaṃ maṃḍalaṃ ca aṣṭahastaṃ ca daṃḍakam..
annādipāyasavidhau darvī yajñasya sādhane..15..
meaning:
पंचांगुलं मंडलं च अष्टहस्तं च दंडकम्..
अन्नादिपायसविधौ दर्वी यज्ञस्य साधने..15..
text_mt:
Its bowl is five finger-breadths, and its handle is eight cubits;
