in rites offering food, milk-rice, and the like, this spoon is used in performing the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
daśatolakamānena sā ca darvī udāhṛtā ..
ājyasaṃśodhanārthaṃ tu sā tu tāmramayasya ca .. 16 ..
meaning:
दशतोलकमानेन सा च दर्वी उदाहृता ..
आज्यसंशोधनार्थं तु सा तु ताम्रमयस्य च .. 16 ..
text_mt:
That spoon is declared to have the measure of ten tolās;
for purifying the clarified butter, it should be made of copper.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśāṃgulamānena sarvābhāve ca paippalīm ..
ājya sthālīṃ ghṛtamayīṃ mṛnmayīṃ ca samāśrayet .. 17 ..
meaning:
षोडशांगुलमानेन सर्वाभावे च पैप्पलीम् ..
आज्य स्थालीं घृतमयीं मृन्मयीं च समाश्रयेत् .. 17 ..
text_mt:
Measuring sixteen finger-breadths, or of pīpal wood in the absence of all [metals];
one should use an earthenware pot for clarified butter, holding ghee.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tāmramayī kāryā na ca tāṃ tatra yojayet .. 18 ..
pūrṇavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
अथ ताम्रमयी कार्या न च तां तत्र योजयेत् .. 18 ..
पूर्णविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Then one of copper should be made; but one must not use it there.
Description of the full-offering rite

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
atha pūrṇavidhiṃ vakṣye yathā caṃdrārthavedinām ..
yasya samyaganuṣṭhānātsaṃpūrṇaṃ syāditi sthitiḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अथ पूर्णविधिं वक्ष्ये यथा चंद्रार्थवेदिनाम् ..
यस्य सम्यगनुष्ठानात्संपूर्णं स्यादिति स्थितिः .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Now I shall describe the full-offering rite according to those who know the meaning of the moon,
by the proper performance of which everything becomes complete; such is the rule.
title: adhyāyaḥ 20

sanskrit_iast:
homapūrtau mokṣakalpaḥ pūjāṃte'rghyaṃ vidhīyate ..
atha tasyāmapūrṇāyāṃ hataśrīryajñabhraṃśatā .. 2..
meaning:
होमपूर्तौ मोक्षकल्पः पूजांतेऽर्घ्यं विधीयते ..
अथ तस्यामपूर्णायां हतश्रीर्यज्ञभ्रंशता .. 2..
text_mt:
At the completion of the fire-oblation, liberation is the procedure; at the end of worship, the water offering is prescribed.
Now, when that [offering] is incomplete, prosperity is destroyed and the sacrifice fails.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena sruvādho vinyaseccarum..
pūrṇaṃ dattvā savitre'rghyaṃ brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥ..3..
meaning:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन स्रुवाधो विन्यसेच्चरुम्..
पूर्णं दत्त्वा सवित्रेऽर्घ्यं ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेत्ततः..3..
text_mt:
Therefore, with every effort one should place the caru-offering below the sruva-ladle;
having given the full water offering to Savitṛ, one should then feed the Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhaṃ praviśya ca tataḥ kulapūjāṃ samācaret..
saptate dehi me pūrṇāṃ punātviti ṛcā kramāt..4..
meaning:
गृहं प्रविश्य च ततः कुलपूजां समाचरेत्..
सप्तते देहि मे पूर्णां पुनात्विति ऋचा क्रमात्..4..
text_mt:
Then, having entered the house, one should perform the worship of the family deity,
with the verses 'Saptate', 'Dehi me', 'Pūrṇā', and 'Punātu' in order.

sanskrit_iast:
niyojayetpratiṣṭhāyāṃ nityanaimittike śṛṇu..
punātviti ṛcā pūrṇā prathamā parikīrtitā .. 5 ..
meaning:
नियोजयेत्प्रतिष्ठायां नित्यनैमित्तिके शृणु..
पुनात्विति ऋचा पूर्णा प्रथमा परिकीर्तिता .. 5 ..
text_mt:
One should employ them in consecration rites; listen concerning the daily and occasional rites:
The first full-offering is proclaimed with the verse 'Punātu'.

sanskrit_iast:
saptateti dvitīyā syāddehimeti tṛtīyikā ..
pūrṇā darvī caturthī syātkulevasthāpya deśikaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
सप्ततेति द्वितीया स्याद्देहिमेति तृतीयिका ..
पूर्णा दर्वी चतुर्थी स्यात्कुलेवस्थाप्य देशिकः .. 6 ..
text_mt:
The second should be with 'Saptate', the third with 'Dehi me',
and the fourth should be 'Pūrṇā darvī'; having established them in the family, the preceptor,

sanskrit_iast:
utthāya dadyātpūrṇāṃ tu nopaviśya kadācana ..
kanakāyāṃ ca jihvāyāṃ raktāyāṃ grahayāgake .. 7 ..
meaning:
उत्थाय दद्यात्पूर्णां तु नोपविश्य कदाचन ..
कनकायां च जिह्वायां रक्तायां ग्रहयागके .. 7 ..
text_mt:
having stood up, should give the full-offering, never while seated,
upon the golden tongue and upon the red tongue in the sacrifice to the planets.

sanskrit_iast:
grahahome śatāṃte ca pūrṇā ekā vidhīyate ..
sahasrāṃte yugaṃ dadyādayutāṃte yugadvayam .. 8 ..
meaning:
ग्रहहोमे शतांते च पूर्णा एका विधीयते ..
सहस्रांते युगं दद्यादयुतांते युगद्वयम् .. 8 ..
text_mt:
In the planetary oblation, at the end of a hundred [oblations], one full-offering is prescribed;
at the end of a thousand, one should give a pair; at the end of ten thousand, two pairs.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrāṃte dadedekaṃ puṣpahome ca sattamāḥ ..
pūrṇā tvekasahasraṃ tu dadyādyajñaphalepsayā .. 9 ..
meaning:
सहस्रांते ददेदेकं पुष्पहोमे च सत्तमाः ..
पूर्णा त्वेकसहस्रं तु दद्याद्यज्ञफलेप्सया .. 9 ..
text_mt:
At the end of a thousand, one should give one in an oblation of flowers, O best of men;
or one seeking the fruit of sacrifice should give one thousand full-offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdupuṣpākṛtau tvekā kevale cekṣuhomake ..
śataṃ dve ca śate caiva garbhādhānānnaprāśane .. 2.1.20.10 ..
meaning:
मृदुपुष्पाकृतौ त्वेका केवले चेक्षुहोमके ..
शतं द्वे च शते चैव गर्भाधानान्नप्राशने .. 2.1.20.10 ..
text_mt:
In the form of soft flowers, there is one; and in an oblation of sugarcane alone [there is one];
one hundred, and indeed two hundred, in the conception rite and first feeding of solid food,

sanskrit_iast:
sīmaṃtonnayane caiva prāyaścittākṛtīṣu ca ..
vaiśvadeve ca nitye ca pūrṇā tvekā vidhīyate .. 11 ..
meaning:
सीमंतोन्नयने चैव प्रायश्चित्ताकृतीषु च ..
वैश्वदेवे च नित्ये च पूर्णा त्वेका विधीयते .. 11 ..
text_mt:
and in the parting of the hair, and in penance rites,
and in the daily Vaiśvadeva rite, one full-offering is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ srucau samau kṛtvā uparyupari vinyaset ..
yathā na vyayate kṛtvā na kalpayati yāvatā .. 12 ..
meaning:
एवं स्रुचौ समौ कृत्वा उपर्युपरि विन्यसेत् ..
यथा न व्ययते कृत्वा न कल्पयति यावता .. 12 ..
text_mt:
Thus, having made the two ladles equal, one should place one above the other,
acting so that it does not spill, as long as one does not arrange it.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣichaṃdādikaṃ śrutvā pratimaṃtrasya sattamāḥ ..
anyathālpālpakaphalaṃ tasmātsaṃnyasya homayet ..13..
meaning:
ऋषिछंदादिकं श्रुत्वा प्रतिमंत्रस्य सत्तमाः ..
अन्यथाल्पाल्पकफलं तस्मात्संन्यस्य होमयेत् ..13..
text_mt:
Having heard the seer, meter, and so forth of each mantra, O best of men—
otherwise the fruit is very slight—therefore, having renounced, one should offer oblation.

sanskrit_iast:
saptateti brāhmaṇasya ṛṣiḥ kauṃḍinya īritaḥ ..
jagatī ca bhavecchaṃdo devatāgniḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. .. 14 ..
meaning:
सप्ततेति ब्राह्मणस्य ऋषिः कौंडिन्य ईरितः ..
जगती च भवेच्छंदो देवताग्निः प्रकीर्तितः .. .. 14 ..
text_mt:
For the Brahmin, the seer of the mantra 'Saptate' is declared to be Kauṇḍinya,
the meter should be Jagatī, and the deity is proclaimed as Agni.

sanskrit_iast:
dehi meti ca maṃtrasya prajāpatirṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ ..
anuṣṭup ca bhavecchaṃdo devatāsya prajāpatiḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
देहि मेति च मंत्रस्य प्रजापतिरृषिः स्मृतः ..
अनुष्टुप् च भवेच्छंदो देवतास्य प्रजापतिः .. 15 ..
text_mt:
Prajāpati is remembered as the seer of the mantra 'Dehi me',
its meter should be Anuṣṭubh, and its deity is Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇā darvīti mantrasya śatakraturṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ ..
chaṃdonuṣṭupsamākhyātaṃ vahniścaivātra devatā .. 16 ..
meaning:
पूर्णा दर्वीति मन्त्रस्य शतक्रतुरृषिः स्मृतः ..
छंदोनुष्टुप्समाख्यातं वह्निश्चैवात्र देवता .. 16 ..
text_mt:
Śatakratu is remembered as the seer of the mantra 'Pūrṇā darvī',
the meter is named Anuṣṭubh, and fire is the deity here.

sanskrit_iast:
punātviti ca mantrasya ṛṣiḥ syātpavanaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
chaṃdo'pi jagatī khyātaṃ devatāgniśca kīrtitaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
पुनात्विति च मन्त्रस्य ऋषिः स्यात्पवनः स्मृतः ..
छंदोऽपि जगती ख्यातं देवताग्निश्च कीर्तितः .. 17 ..
text_mt:
Pavana is remembered as the seer of the mantra 'Punātu',
the meter is known as Jagatī, and the deity is proclaimed as Agni.

sanskrit_iast:
turyapūrṇā yajñamadhye nakule dvijasattamāḥ ..
na cāśiṣaṃ yajñamadhye abhiṣekaṃ ca tarpaṇam .. 18 ..
meaning:
तुर्यपूर्णा यज्ञमध्ये नकुले द्विजसत्तमाः ..
न चाशिषं यज्ञमध्ये अभिषेकं च तर्पणम् .. 18 ..
text_mt:
The fourth full-offering is in the midst of sacrifice, not in the family, O best of Brahmins;
and no blessing in the midst of sacrifice, nor consecration sprinkling and libation.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtvikchaṃdaḥ spṛśansamyagdakṣiṇāṃgamathāpi vā ..
yajamānaḥ sapatnīko mahotsavapuraḥsaram .. 19 ..
meaning:
ऋत्विक्छंदः स्पृशन्सम्यग्दक्षिणांगमथापि वा ..
यजमानः सपत्नीको महोत्सवपुरःसरम् .. 19 ..
text_mt:
The officiating priest, touching the meter properly or touching the right limb,
the sacrificer together with his wife, preceded by a great festival,

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāmitro'yutaṃ tatra homaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ..
lavalī badarī śastaṃ picumaṃdakacchatrakam .. 2.1.20.20 ..
meaning:
विश्वामित्रोऽयुतं तत्र होमं कुर्याद्विचक्षणः ..
लवली बदरी शस्तं पिचुमंदकच्छत्रकम् .. 2.1.20.20 ..
text_mt:
the wise Viśvāmitra should perform ten thousand oblations there;
lavalī, badarī, picumanda, and mushrooms are recommended.

sanskrit_iast:
nāgaraṃgaṃ dhātakīṃ ca pūrṇāyāṃ ca vivarjayet ..
japyahānirasaṃkhyāte homabhraṃśaśca jāyate .. 21 ..
meaning:
नागरंगं धातकीं च पूर्णायां च विवर्जयेत् ..
जप्यहानिरसंख्याते होमभ्रंशश्च जायते .. 21 ..
text_mt: One should avoid orange and dhātakī in the final offering. / When [the oblations] are uncounted, recitation is lost and the oblation fails.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātprāgeva satilāngaṇitvā sthāpayetpṛthak ..
yugapadgaṇayedvātha na cāṃgena kadācana ..22..
meaning:
तस्मात्प्रागेव सतिलान्गणित्वा स्थापयेत्पृथक् ..
युगपद्गणयेद्वाथ न चांगेन कदाचन ..22..
text_mt: Therefore, one should first count [the offerings] together with sesame seeds and set them aside. / Or one may count simultaneously, but never on a limb [of the body].

sanskrit_iast:
dhātakyāśca phalaiḥ saṃkhyā kartavyā phalamicchatā ..
badaryāśca lavalyāśca phalaiḥ sarvārthasiddhaye .. 23 ..
meaning:
धातक्याश्च फलैः संख्या कर्तव्या फलमिच्छता ..
बदर्याश्च लवल्याश्च फलैः सर्वार्थसिद्धये .. 23 ..
text_mt: One who desires results should make the count with fruits of the dhātakī, / and with fruits of the jujube and the lavalī for the attainment of all ends.

sanskrit_iast:
nāgaraṃgaphalaireva dhātakyā bakulaiḥ phalaiḥ ..
yajñahānikaraṃ yasmāttasmāttatparivarjayet .. 24 ..
meaning:
नागरंगफलैरेव धातक्या बकुलैः फलैः ..
यज्ञहानिकरं यस्मात्तस्मात्तत्परिवर्जयेत् .. 24 ..
text_mt: With the fruits of the orange, dhātakī, and bakula, / because they cause the destruction of the sacrifice, one should therefore avoid them.

sanskrit_iast:
karpūracaṃdanaiḥ kuryāddholikāṃ yajñasiddhaye ..
gaṃgāmṛttikayā yuktaḥ śunikāmatha vā dvijāḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
कर्पूरचंदनैः कुर्याद्धोलिकां यज्ञसिद्धये ..
गंगामृत्तिकया युक्तः शुनिकामथ वा द्विजाः .. 25 ..
text_mt: For the success of the sacrifice, one should make a swing with camphor and sandalwood, / or combined with clay from the Gaṅgā, or a small dog, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
raktaguṃjāphalaiḥ saṃkhyāṃ puṣṭikāmeṣu yojayet ..
vātārdhe ca śate caiva sahasre ca tathaiva hi .. 26 ..
meaning:
रक्तगुंजाफलैः संख्यां पुष्टिकामेषु योजयेत् ..
वातार्धे च शते चैव सहस्रे च तथैव हि .. 26 ..
text_mt: One desiring prosperity should employ red guñjā berries for the count, / for half a vāta, a hundred, and likewise a thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
hotā syādayutenāpi ekāhe vedasaṃkhyayā ..
ṛṇasādhye bhaveddhotā traya eva dvijottamāḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
होता स्यादयुतेनापि एकाहे वेदसंख्यया ..
ऋणसाध्ये भवेद्धोता त्रय एव द्विजोत्तमाः .. 27 ..
text_mt: There may be one hotṛ priest even for ten thousand [oblations] performed in a single day, or four [hotṛs]. / For a rite to discharge debt, the hotṛs should be only three, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣahome tu hotāraḥ ṣaḍeva parikīrtitāḥ ..
koṭihome tu viprāḥ syuḥ praśastāḥ paṃktisaṃkhyayā .. 28 ..
meaning:
लक्षहोमे तु होतारः षडेव परिकीर्तिताः ..
कोटिहोमे तु विप्राः स्युः प्रशस्ताः पंक्तिसंख्यया .. 28 ..
text_mt: In a lakṣahoma, however, only six hotṛs are prescribed. / In a koṭihoma, twice-born men numbering ten are praised.

sanskrit_iast:
nava paṃca daśadaśakaṃ paṃcaviṃśamathāpi vā ..
kāmakrodha vihīnāḥ syurṛtvijaḥ śāṃtacetasaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
नव पंच दशदशकं पंचविंशमथापि वा ..
कामक्रोध विहीनाः स्युरृत्विजः शांतचेतसः .. 29 ..
text_mt: Or nine, five, ten tens, or even twenty-five. / The officiating priests should be free from desire and anger, with tranquil minds.

sanskrit_iast:
navagrahamakhe viprāścatvāro vedavedinaḥ ..
athavā ṛtvijau śāṃtau dvāveva parikīrtitau ..2.1.20.30..
meaning:
नवग्रहमखे विप्राश्चत्वारो वेदवेदिनः ..
अथवा ऋत्विजौ शांतौ द्वावेव परिकीर्तितौ ..2.1.20.30..
text_mt: In a sacrifice to the nine planets, there should be four Brahmins knowing the Vedas; / or only two peaceful officiating priests are prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
kāryāvayutahome tu na prasajyeta vistare ..
tadvatsadaśadhā cāṣṭau navahome tu ṛtvijaḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
कार्यावयुतहोमे तु न प्रसज्येत विस्तरे ..
तद्वत्सदशधा चाष्टौ नवहोमे तु ऋत्विजः .. 31 ..
text_mt: In an ayutahoma, they should perform it without indulging in excessive elaboration. / Likewise, eight officiating priests multiplied by ten in a ninefold sacrifice;

sanskrit_iast:
kartavyāḥ śaktitastadvaccatvāro'pi vimatsarāḥ ..
tameva pūjayedbrahmā dvau vā trīnvā yathāvidhi .. 32 ..
meaning:
कर्तव्याः शक्तितस्तद्वच्चत्वारोऽपि विमत्सराः ..
तमेव पूजयेद्ब्रह्मा द्वौ वा त्रीन्वा यथाविधि .. 32 ..
text_mt: or, according to capacity, four free from malice should be engaged. / The Brahman priest should worship that very one, or two or three according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
ekamapyarcayedbrahmā sahasre tvekabrāhmaṇam ..
dakṣiṇābhiḥ prayatnena nirvahedalpavittavān .. 33 ..
meaning:
एकमप्यर्चयेद्ब्रह्मा सहस्रे त्वेकब्राह्मणम् ..
दक्षिणाभिः प्रयत्नेन निर्वहेदल्पवित्तवान् .. 33 ..
text_mt: In a thousand [oblations], the Brahman priest should worship even a single Brahmin. / A man of small means should carry it out with effort by paying sacrificial fees.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣahomastu kartavyo yadā vittaṃ bhavettadā ..
yataḥ sarvamavāpnoti kuryātkāmavidhānataḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
लक्षहोमस्तु कर्तव्यो यदा वित्तं भवेत्तदा ..
यतः सर्वमवाप्नोति कुर्यात्कामविधानतः .. 34 ..
text_mt: A lakṣahoma, however, should be performed when wealth is available, / because he attains everything; he should perform it according to the rule of desire.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjyate śivaloke ca vasvādityamarudgaṇaiḥ ..
yāvatkalpaśatānyaṣṭāvaṃte mokṣamavāpnuyāt .. 35 ..
meaning:
पूज्यते शिवलोके च वस्वादित्यमरुद्गणैः ..
यावत्कल्पशतान्यष्टावंते मोक्षमवाप्नुयात् .. 35 ..
text_mt: He is worshipped in the world of Śiva by the Vasus, Ādityas, and the hosts of Maruts / for eight hundred kalpas, and in the end he attains liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
akāmo yastvimaṃ kuryāllakṣahomaṃ yathāvidhi ..
śatakāmamavāpnoti padaṃ cānaṃtyamaśnute .. 36 ..
meaning:
अकामो यस्त्विमं कुर्याल्लक्षहोमं यथाविधि ..
शतकाममवाप्नोति पदं चानंत्यमश्नुते .. 36 ..
text_mt: Whoever, free from selfish desire, performs this lakṣahoma according to rule, / obtains a hundred desires and reaches an imperishable state.

sanskrit_iast:
putrārthī labhate putraṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam ..
bhāryāthīṃ labhate bhāryāṃ kumārī ca śubhaṃ patim .. 37 ..
meaning:
पुत्रार्थी लभते पुत्रं धनार्थी लभते धनम् ..
भार्याथीं लभते भार्यां कुमारी च शुभं पतिम् .. 37 ..
text_mt: One desiring a son obtains a son; one desiring wealth obtains wealth; / one desiring a wife obtains a wife, and an unmarried maiden [obtains] an auspicious husband.

sanskrit_iast:
bhraṣṭarājyastathā rājyaṃ śrīkāmaḥ śriyamāpnuyāt ..
yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ sarvaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam .. 38 ..
meaning:
भ्रष्टराज्यस्तथा राज्यं श्रीकामः श्रियमाप्नुयात् ..
यं यं कामयते कामं सर्वं प्राप्नोति पुष्कलम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: One fallen from kingship obtains his kingdom, and one desiring prosperity obtains prosperity. / Whatever desire he desires, he attains it all in abundance.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkāmaḥ kurute yastu paraṃ brahmādhigacchati ..
tasmācchataguṇaḥ proktaḥ koṭihomaḥ svayaṃbhuvā .. 39 ..
meaning:
निष्कामः कुरुते यस्तु परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति ..
तस्माच्छतगुणः प्रोक्तः कोटिहोमः स्वयंभुवा .. 39 ..
text_mt: Whoever performs it without desire reaches the highest Brahman. / Therefore, the koṭihoma was declared by the Self-born to be a hundred times superior.

sanskrit_iast:
ācārya eva hotā syādbrāhmaṇānāmasaṃbhave ..
na yojayedekameva cāyute homakarmaṇi .. 2.1.20.40 ..
meaning:
आचार्य एव होता स्याद्ब्राह्मणानामसंभवे ..
न योजयेदेकमेव चायुते होमकर्मणि .. 2.1.20.40 ..
text_mt: The ācārya himself may be the hotṛ in the absence of Brahmins. / One should not employ only one in the offering rite of ten thousand [oblations].

sanskrit_iast:
darbhāsane'to na kuśe tṛṇe pattre tvace'pi ca ..
pāṣāṇe mṛttikāyāṃ ca na ca vastrāsane kvacit .. 41 ..
meaning:
दर्भासनेऽतो न कुशे तृणे पत्त्रे त्वचेऽपि च ..
पाषाणे मृत्तिकायां च न च वस्त्रासने क्वचित् .. 41 ..
text_mt: Therefore, not on a seat of darbha, nor of kuśa, grass, leaves, or bark; / nor on stone or earth, nor ever on a cloth seat.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra dārumayaṃ kuryādāgamaṃ bhajate dvijaḥ ..
dānaṃ dadyācca homāṃte pūrṇādau ca yathā bhavet .. 42 ..
meaning:
तत्र दारुमयं कुर्यादागमं भजते द्विजः ..
दानं दद्याच्च होमांते पूर्णादौ च यथा भवेत् .. 42 ..
text_mt: There, the twice-born should make a wooden seat, adhering to traditional teaching. / And he should give gifts at the end of the oblation and at the full offering, as appropriate.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijasaṃskārakāryeṣu pūrṇādau cāpi dakṣiṇā ..
maṃtropāsanakāryeṣu somayāgāśvamedhake .. 43 .. ..
maṇḍalavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
द्विजसंस्कारकार्येषु पूर्णादौ चापि दक्षिणा ..
मंत्रोपासनकार्येषु सोमयागाश्वमेधके .. 43 .. ..
मण्डलविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
In the rites of the sacraments of the twice-born, and at the full offering, a sacrificial fee [is given]; / in the practices of mantra-worship, and in the Soma sacrifice and the horse sacrifice.
Description of the Rules for Mandalas

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
athāto maṃḍalaṃ vakṣye purāṇeṣu yathoditam ..
yadadhīnā bhavetsiddhistasmātkuryātsamāhitaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अथातो मंडलं वक्ष्ये पुराणेषु यथोदितम् ..
यदधीना भवेत्सिद्धिस्तस्मात्कुर्यात्समाहितः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Now I shall explain the mandala as spoken in the Purāṇas, / upon which success depends; therefore, one should make it with concentration.
title: adhyāyaḥ 21

sanskrit_iast:
devāḥ padmāsanasthāśca bhaviṣyaṃti vasaṃti ca ..
vinābjaṃ nārcayeddevīmarcite yakṣiṇī haret .. 2 ..
meaning:
देवाः पद्मासनस्थाश्च भविष्यंति वसंति च ..
विनाब्जं नार्चयेद्देवीमर्चिते यक्षिणी हरेत् .. 2 ..
text_mt: The gods will be seated and dwell on lotus seats. / Without a lotus, one must not worship the goddess; if worshipped [otherwise], a yakṣiṇī snatches it away.

sanskrit_iast:
ato maṃḍalavicchedaṃ yasmāddaśaguṇaṃ bhavet ..
rajaḥsādhye śataguṇaṃ kevale dviguṇaṃ phalam .. 3..
meaning:
अतो मंडलविच्छेदं यस्माद्दशगुणं भवेत् ..
रजःसाध्ये शतगुणं केवले द्विगुणं फलम् .. 3..
text_mt: Hence, drawing a mandala yields tenfold [merit]; / executed with coloured powder, a hundredfold; simply drawn, twofold the fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
triśataṃ vaṃdane sādhye sahasraṃ ca rajo'ṣṭakam ..
rajobhiḥ ṣoḍaśairbiṃbaṃ śataṃśatamanaṃtakam .. 4 ..
meaning:
त्रिशतं वंदने साध्ये सहस्रं च रजोऽष्टकम् ..
रजोभिः षोडशैर्बिंबं शतंशतमनंतकम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: In paying homage it yields three hundredfold, and with eight powders, a thousandfold. / A design made with sixteen powders yields a hundred upon a hundred, endless [merit].

sanskrit_iast:
yantre maṇau śālagrāme pratimāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
mahālaye mahāyonau raktaliṃge ca sādhikam .. 5 ..
meaning:
यन्त्रे मणौ शालग्रामे प्रतिमायां विशेषतः ..
महालये महायोनौ रक्तलिंगे च साधिकम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Especially on a yantra, a gem, a Śālagrāma stone, an image, / a Mahālaya, a Mahāyoni, and on a red liṅga, it is superior.

sanskrit_iast:
rajoyuktaṃ likhedyastu pūjākārye vibhūtaye ..
karaṇādiphalaṃ yasmāttasmāttatparivarjayet ..6..
meaning:
रजोयुक्तं लिखेद्यस्तु पूजाकार्ये विभूतये ..
करणादिफलं यस्मात्तस्मात्तत्परिवर्जयेत् ..6..
text_mt: Whoever draws it with powders for prosperity in a worship ritual— / since [otherwise] the fruit of the action is lost, he should therefore avoid that.

sanskrit_iast:
caturasraṃ navaṃ vyūhaṃ krauṃcaprāṇaṃ catu rvidham ..
kāmabījaṃ vajranābhaṃ vighnarājaṃ gajāhvayam .. 7 ..
meaning:
चतुरस्रं नवं व्यूहं क्रौंचप्राणं चतु र्विधम् ..
कामबीजं वज्रनाभं विघ्नराजं गजाह्वयम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: The fourfold Caturasra, Navavyūha, and Krauñcaprāṇa, / the Kāmabīja, Vajranābha, Vighnarāja, and Gajasaṃjña,

sanskrit_iast:
pārijātaṃ caṃdrabiṃbaṃ sūryakāṃtaṃ ca śekharam ..
śatapatraṃ sahasrāraṃ navanābhaṃ ca muṣṭikam .. .. 8 ..
meaning:
पारिजातं चंद्रबिंबं सूर्यकांतं च शेखरम् ..
शतपत्रं सहस्रारं नवनाभं च मुष्टिकम् .. .. 8 ..
text_mt: the Pārijāta, Candrabimba, Sūryakānta, and Śekhara, / the Śatapatra, Sahasrāra, Navanābha, and Muṣṭika,

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcābjaṃ caiva mainākaṃ kāmarājaṃ ca puṣkaram ..
aṣṭāsraṃ caiva śrībiṃbaṃ ṣaḍasraṃ tryasrameva tu ..9..
meaning:
पंचाब्जं चैव मैनाकं कामराजं च पुष्करम् ..
अष्टास्रं चैव श्रीबिंबं षडस्रं त्र्यस्रमेव तु ..9..
text_mt: the Pañcābja, Maināka, Kāmarāja, and Puṣkara, / the octagonal, the Śrībimba, the hexagonal, and the triangular.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāriṃśattathā paṃcasvādhikaṃ parisaṃkhyayā ..
caturasraṃ navavyūḍhaṃ vaiṣṇave yāgakarmaṇi .. 2.1.21.10 ..
meaning:
चत्वारिंशत्तथा पंचस्वाधिकं परिसंख्यया ..
चतुरस्रं नवव्यूढं वैष्णवे यागकर्मणि .. 2.1.21.10 ..
text_mt: In counting, they are forty-five in total. / In a sacrifice to Viṣṇu, the Caturasra and the Navavyūḍha [are prescribed].

sanskrit_iast:
praśastaṃ cāpi gomedhe krauṃcaṃ ghrāṇaṃ caturvidham ..
subhadraṃ cāśvamedhe ca naramedhe narāsanam .. 11 ..
meaning:
प्रशस्तं चापि गोमेधे क्रौंचं घ्राणं चतुर्विधम् ..
सुभद्रं चाश्वमेधे च नरमेधे नरासनम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: In a cattle sacrifice, Krauñcaprāṇa of four types is recommended; / Subhadra in a horse sacrifice, and Narāsana in a human sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatra sarvatobhadraṃ caturasraṃ subhadrakam ..
kāmarājaṃ tathā tryasramaṣṭāsraṃ ca ṣaḍasrakam ..12..
meaning:
सर्वत्र सर्वतोभद्रं चतुरस्रं सुभद्रकम् ..
कामराजं तथा त्र्यस्रमष्टास्रं च षडस्रकम् ..12..
text_mt: Everywhere the Sarvatobhadra, Caturasra, and Subhadra [are suitable], / and likewise Kāmarāja, the triangular, the octagonal, and the hexagonal.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktānāṃ kāmapakṣe ca paṃcasiṃhāsanaṃ mahat ..
dhyānācale merupṛṣṭhaṃ maṇimuktācaleṣvapi .. 13 ..
meaning:
शक्तानां कामपक्षे च पंचसिंहासनं महत् ..
ध्यानाचले मेरुपृष्ठं मणिमुक्ताचलेष्वपि .. 13 ..
text_mt: For capable persons on the side of desire, the great Pañcasiṃhāsana [is prescribed]. / On Dhyānācala, Merupṛṣṭha, and also on the mountains of jewels and pearls,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraṃ śatapatraṃ ca annadāne tilācale ..
harivallabhaṃ rājasūye somayāgeṣu śasyate .. 14 ..
meaning:
सहस्रं शतपत्रं च अन्नदाने तिलाचले ..
हरिवल्लभं राजसूये सोमयागेषु शस्यते .. 14 ..
text_mt: the Sahasra and Śatapatra [are used] in gifts of food and the mountain of sesame seeds; / Harivallabha is praised in the Rājasūya and in Soma sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ subhadraṃ ca sarvatobhadrameva ca ..
jalāśayapratiṣṭhāyāṃ vighnarājaṃ praśasyate .. 15 ..
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठायां सुभद्रं च सर्वतोभद्रमेव च ..
जलाशयप्रतिष्ठायां विघ्नराजं प्रशस्यते .. 15 ..
text_mt: In consecration rites, Subhadra and Sarvatobhadra [are praised], / and in the consecration of a water reservoir, Vighnarāja is recommended.

sanskrit_iast:
ghaṭaprasthāpane caiva gajāhvaṃ turagāsanam ..
śatapatraṃ lakṣahome ayute caturasrakam .. 16 ..
meaning:
घटप्रस्थापने चैव गजाह्वं तुरगासनम् ..
शतपत्रं लक्षहोमे अयुते चतुरस्रकम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: In the installation of the pitcher, the Gajasaṃjña and Turagāsana [are prescribed]; / the Śatapatra in a lakṣahoma, and the Caturasra in an ayuta.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya yajñasya yadbiṃbaṃ tattu tenaiva yojayet ..
ito'nyathā bhaveddoṣo viparīteṣvadhogatiḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
यस्य यज्ञस्य यद्बिंबं तत्तु तेनैव योजयेत् ..
इतोऽन्यथा भवेद्दोषो विपरीतेष्वधोगतिः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Whatever design belongs to whatever sacrifice, one should employ that very one. / Any deviation from this is a defect; in contrary practice, there is a downfall.

sanskrit_iast:
dvihastā caturasrā ca vedikā parikīrtitā ..
caturaṃgulocchrāyamitā ṣaḍaṃgulā hyathāpi vā ..18..
meaning:
द्विहस्ता चतुरस्रा च वेदिका परिकीर्तिता ..
चतुरंगुलोच्छ्रायमिता षडंगुला ह्यथापि वा ..18..
text_mt: A square altar is prescribed, measuring two cubits, / four finger-breadths in height, or else six finger-breadths.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍaṃgulā navavyūhe vardhayedyajñakovidaḥ ..
ekāṃgulasamutsedhaḥ kartavyassusamāhitaiḥ.. ... 19 ..
meaning:
षडंगुला नवव्यूहे वर्धयेद्यज्ञकोविदः ..
एकांगुलसमुत्सेधः कर्तव्यस्सुसमाहितैः.. ... 19 ..
text_mt: In the Navavyūha, an expert in sacrifice should increase it by six finger-breadths. / Those who are well-concentrated should make the elevation one finger-breadth.

sanskrit_iast:
krauṃcaprāṇe turyahastaṃ muṣṭihastaṃ samucchritam ..
madhyadvaye hīnakaraṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ tryaṃgulādhikam .. 2.1.21.20 ..
meaning:
क्रौंचप्राणे तुर्यहस्तं मुष्टिहस्तं समुच्छ्रितम् ..
मध्यद्वये हीनकरं कनिष्ठं त्र्यंगुलाधिकम् .. 2.1.21.20 ..
text_mt: In the Krauñcaprāṇa, it is raised by a quarter of a cubit or a fist-cubit; / in the two middles, it is diminished by a cubit; the lowest is increased by three finger-breadths.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryāddvitrikramāddhīnamucchrāye dvijasattamāḥ ..
pārijātaṃ caṃdrabiṃbaṃ sūryakāṃtaṃ ca śekharam .. 21 ..
meaning:
कुर्याद्द्वित्रिक्रमाद्धीनमुच्छ्राये द्विजसत्तमाः ..
पारिजातं चंद्रबिंबं सूर्यकांतं च शेखरम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: O best of the twice-born, one should make it diminished in height by degrees of two or three: / [the altars called] the Pārijāta, the lunar disc (Candrabimba), the Sūryakānta, and the Śekhara.

sanskrit_iast:
grahāṇāṃ pauṣṭike pakṣe bāhyagrāmādisādhane ..
niyojayettatratatra vedikācakrakatrayam .. 22 ..
meaning:
ग्रहाणां पौष्टिके पक्षे बाह्यग्रामादिसाधने ..
नियोजयेत्तत्रतत्र वेदिकाचक्रकत्रयम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: In the rite for the planets producing nourishment, and in rites of accomplishment outside villages and the like, / one should arrange three circular platforms there in each place.

sanskrit_iast:
prathame muṣṭihastaḥ syātsaṃpūrṇe śeṣamānakaiḥ ..
navalābhe ca paṃcābjaṃ karatrayamudāhṛtam .. 23 ..
meaning:
प्रथमे मुष्टिहस्तः स्यात्संपूर्णे शेषमानकैः ..
नवलाभे च पंचाब्जं करत्रयमुदाहृतम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: In the first there should be a fist-cubit; in the complete one, with the remaining measurements; / and in the acquisition of nine [parts], five lotuses and three cubits are proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣā caiva variṣṭhā ca lavalī bhitti vedikā ..
vijñeyā dvijaśārdūlā yathākāmyeṣu yojayet .. 24 ..
meaning:
शेषा चैव वरिष्ठा च लवली भित्ति वेदिका ..
विज्ञेया द्विजशार्दूला यथाकाम्येषु योजयेत् .. 24 ..
text_mt: The Śeṣā, the Variṣṭhā, and the Lavali-wall platform / are to be understood, O tigers among the twice-born, and one should employ them in elective rites as desired.

sanskrit_iast:
ayathāvyatyaye doṣastasmādyatnena sādhayet ..
daśahaste cāṣṭahaste aṣṭahaste ca ṣoḍaśam ..25..
meaning:
अयथाव्यत्यये दोषस्तस्माद्यत्नेन साधयेत् ..
दशहस्ते चाष्टहस्ते अष्टहस्ते च षोडशम् ..25..
text_mt: There is a flaw if done otherwise or inverted; therefore one should accomplish it with care. / In ten cubits and in eight cubits, and in an eight-cubit [area] sixteen [parts],

sanskrit_iast:
muṣṭibāhuñca prādeśaṃ vardhayetṣoḍaśāṃśake ..
hastotsedhaṃ ca kartavyaṃ hīne hīnaṃ ca hrāsayet .. 26 ..
meaning:
मुष्टिबाहुञ्च प्रादेशं वर्धयेत्षोडशांशके ..
हस्तोत्सेधं च कर्तव्यं हीने हीनं च ह्रासयेत् .. 26 ..
text_mt: One should increase by a fist, a forearm, and a span at the sixteenth part. / The height is to be made one cubit; and when decreased, one should reduce it lower.

sanskrit_iast:
darpaṇākārakaṃ kuryādyāgake śāṃti karmaṇi ..
hīnaṃ kuryātprayatnena vaprākāraṃ paristave .. 27 ..
meaning:
दर्पणाकारकं कुर्याद्यागके शांति कर्मणि ..
हीनं कुर्यात्प्रयत्नेन वप्राकारं परिस्तवे .. 27 ..
text_mt: One should make it mirror-shaped in a sacrifice performed for pacification; / one should carefully make it diminished, resembling an earthen mound, in hymns of praise.

sanskrit_iast:
niśāraṇairgomayaiśca vedikāṃ ca pralepayet ..
svarṇaratnamayaistoyairabhiṣicya kuśodakaiḥ .. .. 28 ..
meaning:
निशारणैर्गोमयैश्च वेदिकां च प्रलेपयेत् ..
स्वर्णरत्नमयैस्तोयैरभिषिच्य कुशोदकैः .. .. 28 ..
text_mt: And one should plaster the platform with night-gathered cow dung, / having sprinkled it with waters containing gold and jewels, and with kuśa-water.

sanskrit_iast:
hīnavīryagavānāṃ ca purīṣaṃ dhenukaṃ tathā ..
kapilāyāśca yatnena kuṃḍamaṃḍalalepane .. 29 ..
meaning:
हीनवीर्यगवानां च पुरीषं धेनुकं तथा ..
कपिलायाश्च यत्नेन कुंडमंडललेपने .. 29 ..
text_mt: One must carefully avoid the dung of cows of diminished vigour, of milk-calves, / and of a brown cow, in plastering the sacrificial pit and the maṇḍala

sanskrit_iast:
varjayetsarvayāgeṣu sthaṃḍileṣu prayatnataḥ ..
vinā sūtraiḥ kīlake na maṃḍale naiva sūtrayet .. 2.1.21.30 ..
meaning:
वर्जयेत्सर्वयागेषु स्थंडिलेषु प्रयत्नतः ..
विना सूत्रैः कीलके न मंडले नैव सूत्रयेत् .. 2.1.21.30 ..
text_mt: In all sacrifices on sacrificial grounds, with effort. / Without lines and pegs, one must not draw the lines upon the maṇḍala.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātprayatnataḥ kāryaṃ yatsūtraṃ yacca kīlakam ..
arkahastamitaṃ sūtraṃ mṛdu lākṣāmayaṃ tathā .. 31 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्प्रयत्नतः कार्यं यत्सूत्रं यच्च कीलकम् ..
अर्कहस्तमितं सूत्रं मृदु लाक्षामयं तथा .. 31 ..
text_mt: Therefore, with care, what is cord and what is peg must be prepared: / a cord twelve cubits long, soft, and treated with red lac;

sanskrit_iast:
pītakāryasrajaṃ caiva kīlakaṃ svarṇanirmitam ..
raupyatāmramayaṃ kuryādvaiṣṇave yāgakarmaṇi .. 32 ..
meaning:
पीतकार्यस्रजं चैव कीलकं स्वर्णनिर्मितम् ..
रौप्यताम्रमयं कुर्याद्वैष्णवे यागकर्मणि .. 32 ..
text_mt: A garland made of yellow flowers, and a peg fashioned of gold; / or one may make it of silver or copper in a sacrificial rite for Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇanāyake supraśastaṃ śaiṣepāmārgameva ca ..
grahapakṣe tatheśasya kacchapasya dvijottamāḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
गणनायके सुप्रशस्तं शैषेपामार्गमेव च ..
ग्रहपक्षे तथेशस्य कच्छपस्य द्विजोत्तमाः .. 33 ..
text_mt: In [a rite for] the Lord of Gaṇas, and in [a rite for] Śaṣa, [wood of] the apāmārga is praised as best; / likewise, O best of the twice-born, in the planetary side, [and in rites] of Īśa and of Kacchapa.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśe cārkahaste ca tatra nemiyutaṃ bhavet .. 34 ..
viṣayānukramaṇikā
atha dvitīyaṃ madhyamaparva .. 2 ..
meaning:
षोडशे चार्कहस्ते च तत्र नेमियुतं भवेत् .. 34 ..
विषयानुक्रमणिका
अथ द्वितीयं मध्यमपर्व .. 2 ..
text_mt:
And in the sixteen- and twelve-cubit [altars], there it should be provided with a rim.

meaning:
1 191 मंगलाचरणम्, भविष्यपुराणप्रशंसा, धर्मस्वरूपवर्णनम् श्लो. 39

3 192 स्वर्गपातालाद्यूर्ध्वाधोलोकवर्णनम् श्लो. 26
4 192 भूर्लोकविस्तारविनिर्णयपुरःसरं ज्योतिश्चक्रवर्णनम् श्लो. 43
5 193 त्रैवर्णिकप्रशंसायां शह्मणलक्षणब्राह्मणकर्तव्यवर्णनम् श्लो, 92
6 195 ब्राह्मणमाहात्म्यगुरुगुणवर्णनम् श्लो. 26
7 196 पुराणेतिहासार्चनश्रवणमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् श्लो, 25
8 198 पुराणेतिहासविभागपूर्वकाङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् श्लो. 46
9 199 अंतर्वेदिबहिर्वेदिप्रमाणादिवर्णनपूर्वकं पूर्तकर्मनिरूपणम् श्लो. 90

12 203 प्रतिदेवताप्रतिमालक्षणवर्णनम् श्लो, 28
13 203 कर्मविशेषपरत्वेन विविधविधिकुण्डनिर्णयवर्णनम् श्लो, 41

15 205 कुण्डसंस्कारे शास्त्रमतवर्णनम्, अष्टादशकुण्डसंस्कारवर्णनं च श्लो. 35

20 207 पूर्णाहुतिहोमनिर्णयवर्णनम्, कर्मपरत्वेन ब्राह्मणसंख्यावर्णनम्, यथाविधिकृतयाग- फलवर्णनम् श्लो. 43

text_mt:
1 [p.] 191: Auspicious invocation, praise of the Bhaviṣyapurāṇa, description of the nature of dharma: 39 verses.
2 [p.] 191: Description of the origin and extent of the cosmic Puruṣa and the universe: 27 verses.
3 [p.] 192: Description of the upper and lower worlds such as heaven and the netherworlds: 26 verses.
4 [p.] 192: Description of the circle of luminaries preceded by the determination of the extent of the terrestrial world: 43 verses.
5 [p.] 193: In the praise of the three upper classes, description of the marks of a brāhmaṇa and the duties of a brāhmaṇa: 92 verses.
6 [p.] 195: Description of the greatness of a brāhmaṇa and the virtues of a guru: 26 verses.
7 [p.] 196: Description of the greatness of worship and hearing of the Purāṇas and Itihāsas: 25 verses.
8 [p.] 198: Description of the greatness of the ancillary texts following the divisions of the Purāṇas and Itihāsas: 46 verses.
9 [p.] 199: Exposition of charitable public works preceded by the description of the measures of the inner altar and outer altar: 90 verses.
10: Description of the rules for planting various trees for orchard-making: 90 verses.
11 [p.] 203: Description of special rules for the consecration of wells, stepwells, and ponds: 10 verses.
12 [p.] 203: Description of the characteristics of the images of each deity: 28 verses.
13 [p.] 203: Description of the determination of diverse kinds of sacrificial pits according to particular rites: 41 verses.
14 [p.] 204: Description of the measures and numbers of oblations and homas according to particular sacrifices: 21 verses.
15 [p.] 205: Description of the authoritative opinion on the consecration of the sacrificial pit, and description of the eighteen consecrations of the sacrificial pit: 35 verses.
16 [p.] 205: Description of the sixteen modes of service at the conclusion of regular and occasional homas: 24 verses.
17 [p.] 206: Description of the names of fire in specific rites preceded by the description of the three types of sacrifice: 16 verses.
18 [p.] 206: Description of the measures of substances intended for the homa: 23 verses.
19 [p.] 207: Description of the determination for constructing sruva and darvī ladles and vessels: 18 verses.
20 [p.] 207: Description of the determination of the full-offering homa, description of the number of brāhmaṇas according to the rite, and description of the fruits of sacrifices performed according to rule: 43 verses.
21 [p.] 208: Description of the construction of various kinds of maṇḍalas according to deity and according to rite: 34 verses.
(Thus ends the first part.)

sanskrit_iast: maṇḍaladevaracanāvarṇanam
meaning: मण्डलदेवरचनावर्णनम्
text_mt: Description of the arrangement of deities on the maṇḍala

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
athoddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi caturasrādikasya ca ..
arkāṃgulamitaṃ kṣetraṃ caturasraṃ prakalpayet..1..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अथोद्धारं प्रवक्ष्यामि चतुरस्रादिकस्य च ..
अर्कांगुलमितं क्षेत्रं चतुरस्रं प्रकल्पयेत्..1..
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Now I shall declare the extraction of the square and other shapes: / one should fashion a square area measuring twelve finger-breadths.
title: adhyāyaḥ 01

sanskrit_iast:
guṇāṃgulaṃ pratidiśaṃ vardhayetsuvicakṣaṇaḥ ..
caturasraṃ samaṃ kuyādiṣṭeraṣṭādaśāṃgulam .. 2 ..
meaning:
गुणांगुलं प्रतिदिशं वर्धयेत्सुविचक्षणः ..
चतुरस्रं समं कुयादिष्टेरष्टादशांगुलम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: A prudent person should increase it by three finger-breadths in each direction; / he should make an equal square of eighteen finger-breadths according to the bricks.

sanskrit_iast:
dvihaste caiva sūtrāgre tryaṃgulāni samaṃtataḥ ..
caturasrīkṛte paścāddvihastamapi jāyate .. 3 ..
meaning:
द्विहस्ते चैव सूत्राग्रे त्र्यंगुलानि समंततः ..
चतुरस्रीकृते पश्चाद्द्विहस्तमपि जायते .. 3 ..
text_mt: And on a two-cubit [field], three finger-breadths all around from the tip of the cord; / when made into a square, it then becomes two cubits as well.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ poḍaśahastāṃtaṃ vardhayetkramataḥ svayam ..
haste vinirṇayaṃ viprā racayenmaṃḍala sudhīḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
एवं पोडशहस्तांतं वर्धयेत्क्रमतः स्वयम् ..
हस्ते विनिर्णयं विप्रा रचयेन्मंडल सुधीः .. 4 ..
text_mt: In this way one should oneself increase it up to sixteen cubits in order. / O brāhmaṇas, having made the determination in cubits, an intelligent person should draw the maṇḍala.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśāṃgulakalpābhyāṃ madhuhaste ca maṃḍale ..
dvihaste hastamātraṃ syāddvihastaṃ tu catuṣkare .. 5 ..
meaning:
द्वादशांगुलकल्पाभ्यां मधुहस्ते च मंडले ..
द्विहस्ते हस्तमात्रं स्याद्द्विहस्तं तु चतुष्करे .. 5 ..
text_mt: With units of twelve finger-breadths in a maṇḍala of one cubit, / there would be just one cubit on a two-cubit [maṇḍala], and two cubits on a four-cubit one.

sanskrit_iast:
padmamānaṃ caturddhā tu vṛttaṃ kuryātsamaṃtataḥ ..
prathame karṇikā kāryyā keśarāṇi dvitīyake .. 6 ..
meaning:
पद्ममानं चतुर्द्धा तु वृत्तं कुर्यात्समंततः ..
प्रथमे कर्णिका कार्य्या केशराणि द्वितीयके .. 6 ..
text_mt: One should make the circular lotus-dimension all around in four parts: / in the first the pericarp is to be made, and the filaments in the second;

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīye dalasaṃdhīṃśca dalāgrāṇi caturthake ..
karṇikāṃ pītavarṇena śuddhena paṃkajaṃ likhet ..7..
meaning:
तृतीये दलसंधींश्च दलाग्राणि चतुर्थके ..
कर्णिकां पीतवर्णेन शुद्धेन पंकजं लिखेत् ..7..
text_mt: In the third the petal-joints, and in the fourth the petal-tips. / One should draw the lotus pericarp with a pure yellow colour.

sanskrit_iast:
keśarāstrividhāḥ proktā mūlamadhyāgradeśataḥ ..
mūle śuklāruṇā madhye pītāścāgre pratiṣṭhitāḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
केशरास्त्रिविधाः प्रोक्ता मूलमध्याग्रदेशतः ..
मूले शुक्लारुणा मध्ये पीताश्चाग्रे प्रतिष्ठिताः .. 8 ..
text_mt: The filaments are declared to be threefold: from base, middle, and tip: / white at the base, reddish in the middle, and established as yellow at the tip.

sanskrit_iast:
pātrasaṃdhirbhavecchyāmaḥ koṇe raktena raṃjayet ..
devāstrāṇi likhedbāhye puramadhye ca koṇake .. 9 ..
meaning:
पात्रसंधिर्भवेच्छ्यामः कोणे रक्तेन रंजयेत् ..
देवास्त्राणि लिखेद्बाह्ये पुरमध्ये च कोणके .. 9 ..
text_mt: The joint of the receptacle should be dark; one should colour it red at the corner. / One should draw the divine weapons on the outside, and in the centre and corners of the city,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāṃgulapramāṇaṃ yadyathāvarṇaṃ vināditaḥ ..
śaṃbhurgaurī tathā brahmā rāmakṛṣṇetyanukramāt .. 2.2.1.10 ..
meaning:
अष्टांगुलप्रमाणं यद्यथावर्णं विनादितः ..
शंभुर्गौरी तथा ब्रह्मा रामकृष्णेत्यनुक्रमात् .. 2.2.1.10 ..
text_mt: Measuring eight finger-breadths, according to their colour, without sound, / in proper sequence: Śambhu, Gaurī, then Brahmā, Rāma, and Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sīmarekhāṃgulocchrāyaṃ tattadardhena yojayet ..
śivaviṣṇvormahāyāge śaṃbhumārabhya dāpayet .. 11 ..
meaning:
सीमरेखांगुलोच्छ्रायं तत्तदर्धेन योजयेत् ..
शिवविष्ण्वोर्महायागे शंभुमारभ्य दापयेत् .. 11 ..
text_mt: One should provide boundary-lines of a finger's height, with half of that [width]. / In a great sacrifice of Śiva and Viṣṇu, one should assign [places] beginning with Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ ca rāmāṃtaṃ kṛṣṇāṃtaṃ ca jalāśaye ..
durgāyāge ca śrīpakṣe brahmādīnparikalpayet .. 12 ..
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठायां च रामांतं कृष्णांतं च जलाशये ..
दुर्गायागे च श्रीपक्षे ब्रह्मादीन्परिकल्पयेत् .. 12 ..
text_mt: In a consecration, ending with Rāma; and in [a rite for] a water reservoir, ending with Kṛṣṇa. / In a sacrifice to Durgā, and in rites of fortune, one should assign Brahmā and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
grahayāge ca pītādīnkuryācca na tadanyathā ..
navavyūhamatho vakṣye purāṇamatasammatam .. 13 ..
meaning:
ग्रहयागे च पीतादीन्कुर्याच्च न तदन्यथा ..
नवव्यूहमथो वक्ष्ये पुराणमतसम्मतम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: And in a planetary sacrifice, one should make them yellow and the rest, and not otherwise. / Now I shall declare the ninefold array (navavyūha) approved by the opinion of the Purāṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ ca pūrvavatkāryaṃ paṃkajaṃ sulikhetsudhīḥ ..
tāvatsaṃkhyāharaṇayorveṣṭayetprakramādapi .. 14 ..
meaning:
सर्वं च पूर्ववत्कार्यं पंकजं सुलिखेत्सुधीः ..
तावत्संख्याहरणयोर्वेष्टयेत्प्रक्रमादपि .. 14 ..
text_mt: Everything should be done as before; an intelligent man should draw the lotus well; / he should surround them also successively in both removals of that number,

sanskrit_iast:
śuklāruṇaistathā pītaiḥ pītāruṇasitairapi ..
pītāruṇasitairevaṃ svabhāve pratibhāgake .. 15 ..
meaning:
शुक्लारुणैस्तथा पीतैः पीतारुणसितैरपि ..
पीतारुणसितैरेवं स्वभावे प्रतिभागके .. 15 ..
text_mt: With white and red, as well as yellow; and with yellow, red, and white; / and thus with yellow, red, and white, according to nature in each division.

sanskrit_iast:
kalāyaṃtraṃ tadaṃte ca guhyapatrā grakeṇa tu ..
ṣoḍaśairviṃśamāne tu saliṅgaṃ cāṣṭapatrake ..16..
meaning:
कलायंत्रं तदंते च गुह्यपत्रा ग्रकेण तु ..
षोडशैर्विंशमाने तु सलिङ्गं चाष्टपत्रके ..16..
text_mt:
And at its end [one should draw] the Kalāyantra with the tip of a secret petal,
with sixteen [divisions] in twenty measures, with a liṅga, and with eight petals.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ maṃḍalamaṃtrāṇāṃ varjayetparamārthataḥ ..
tadvanmūleṣu koṇeṣu keśarāṇi prakalpayet..17..
meaning:
एवं मंडलमंत्राणां वर्जयेत्परमार्थतः ..
तद्वन्मूलेषु कोणेषु केशराणि प्रकल्पयेत्..17..
text_mt:
In this way, one must thoroughly avoid [mistakes in] the mantras of the maṇḍala.
Likewise, one should arrange filaments at the bases and the corners,

sanskrit_iast:
daśadaṃḍasamākāraṃ trivarṇaṃ pratiraṃjitam ..
araṃ dadyāddaśāgre tu sarvāṃgulapramāṇataḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
दशदंडसमाकारं त्रिवर्णं प्रतिरंजितम् ..
अरं दद्याद्दशाग्रे तु सर्वांगुलप्रमाणतः .. 18 ..
text_mt:
having the form of ten rods, coloured in three hues.
One should place a spoke at the tip of the ten, measuring all angulas,

sanskrit_iast:
pītenāraṃ ca sarvatra tanmadhye śoṇatuṃḍakam ..
navavyūhamidaṃ proktaṃ dharmakāmārthadāyakam .. 19 ..
meaning:
पीतेनारं च सर्वत्र तन्मध्ये शोणतुंडकम् ..
नवव्यूहमिदं प्रोक्तं धर्मकामार्थदायकम् .. 19 ..
text_mt:
and the spoke everywhere [coloured] with yellow, and in its centre a red beak.
This is proclaimed as the ninefold array, which bestows dharma, kāma, and artha.

sanskrit_iast:
na śūdro maṃḍalaṃ kuryānna kuryādbrāhmaṇabruvaḥ ..
kuryācca saṃgame tīrthe devatāyataneṣu ca .. 2.2.1.20 ..
meaning:
न शूद्रो मंडलं कुर्यान्न कुर्याद्ब्राह्मणब्रुवः ..
कुर्याच्च संगमे तीर्थे देवतायतनेषु च .. 2.2.1.20 ..
text_mt:
A Śūdra should not make the maṇḍala, nor should a nominal Brahmin.
One should make it at a confluence [of rivers], at a sacred bathing-place, and in shrines of deities.

sanskrit_iast:
likhitvā nārcayedya stu agnikāryavihīnakaḥ ..
aviddho jāyate so'pi yato janmanijanmani .. 21 .. ..
krauñcamānavarṇanam
meaning:
लिखित्वा नार्चयेद्य स्तु अग्निकार्यविहीनकः ..
अविद्धो जायते सोऽपि यतो जन्मनिजन्मनि .. 21 .. ..
क्रौञ्चमानवर्णनम्
text_mt:
He who draws it but does not worship, being devoid of the fire-rite,
is born unimpaired […] from birth to birth.
Description of the Krauñca-measure

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca ..
krauñcamānaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvedārthavādinām ..
saṃmataṃ sarvataṃtreṣu gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच ..
क्रौञ्चमानं प्रवक्ष्यामि यथावेदार्थवादिनाम् ..
संमतं सर्वतंत्रेषु गोपनीयं प्रयत्नतः .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Sūta said:
I shall explain the Krauñca-measure according to the teachers of the Vedic meaning,
approved in all tantras, which must be kept secret with great care.
title: adhyāyaḥ 02

sanskrit_iast:
ātmano'ratnimānena dviguṇaṃ parikalpayet ..
madhye vṛddhyā tu tatsūtraṃ bhrāmayetkīlakopari .. 2 ..
meaning:
आत्मनोऽरत्निमानेन द्विगुणं परिकल्पयेत् ..
मध्ये वृद्ध्या तु तत्सूत्रं भ्रामयेत्कीलकोपरि .. 2 ..
text_mt:
One should measure twice the length of one's own cubit;
increasing it in the middle, one should rotate that cord over a peg.

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣṭayaṃ nyasedvṛttaṃ madhyamādhamabhāvataḥ..
karṇikā prathame vṛtte dvitīye tvatha keśaram .. 3 ..
meaning:
चतुष्टयं न्यसेद्वृत्तं मध्यमाधमभावतः..
कर्णिका प्रथमे वृत्ते द्वितीये त्वथ केशरम् .. 3 ..
text_mt:
One should lay down four circles according to high, middle, and low status:
the pericarp in the first circle, and filaments in the second;

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīye padmapatrāṇi caturthe ṣoḍaśacchadāḥ ..
śobhopaśobhe kuryācca caturasre same śubhe .. 4 ..
meaning:
तृतीये पद्मपत्राणि चतुर्थे षोडशच्छदाः ..
शोभोपशोभे कुर्याच्च चतुरस्रे समे शुभे .. 4 ..
text_mt:
lotus petals in the third, and sixteen petals in the fourth.
One should also make the main decoration and sub-decoration on an even, auspicious square.

sanskrit_iast:
taddakṣiṇāgraṃ sulikhetpārśvayoḥ pakṣakadvayam ..
tatra padmayugaṃ kuryānmadhye cāṃgulamaṃtaram..5..
meaning:
तद्दक्षिणाग्रं सुलिखेत्पार्श्वयोः पक्षकद्वयम् ..
तत्र पद्मयुगं कुर्यान्मध्ये चांगुलमंतरम्..5..
text_mt:
One should properly draw its southern point, and two wings on both flanks;
there one should make a pair of lotuses, with a space of an angula between them.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklaṃ pītaṃ tathā raktaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ lohitasannibham ..
saṃkhyātaṃ tāmraparṇaṃ ca śyāmalaṃ cāṣṭakaṃ rajaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
शुक्लं पीतं तथा रक्तं कृष्णं लोहितसन्निभम् ..
संख्यातं ताम्रपर्णं च श्यामलं चाष्टकं रजः .. 6 ..
text_mt:
White, yellow, and red, black, that resembling blood,
the calculated copper-coloured one, and dark-blue: these are the eight powders.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklaṃ taṃḍulacūrṇotthaṃ pītaṃ tu niśayā smṛtam ..
raktaṃ tu niśayā yogācchaṃkhacūrṇādibhāvitam .. 7 ..
meaning:
शुक्लं तंडुलचूर्णोत्थं पीतं तु निशया स्मृतम् ..
रक्तं तु निशया योगाच्छंखचूर्णादिभावितम् .. 7 ..
text_mt:
White is produced from rice-powder, and yellow is traditionally taught [as made] from turmeric;
red is from the mixture of turmeric processed with conch-shell powder and the like;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇaṃ pulakādidagdhaṃ raktaṃ pītāsyayogataḥ ..
kuṃkumābhaṃ pāṃḍuraṃ ca raktaśvetairvinirmitam .. 8 ..
meaning:
कृष्णं पुलकादिदग्धं रक्तं पीतास्ययोगतः ..
कुंकुमाभं पांडुरं च रक्तश्वेतैर्विनिर्मितम् .. 8 ..
text_mt:
black is burnt from unhusked grain and the like; red is from the mixture of yellow and [lime];
the saffron-coloured and pale [powders] are prepared from red and white;

sanskrit_iast:
tāmravarṇaṃ kusuṃbhena śyāmalaṃ bilvapatrajam ..
yavagodhūmacūrṇādiyogena tu rajaḥ smṛtam .. 9 ..
meaning:
ताम्रवर्णं कुसुंभेन श्यामलं बिल्वपत्रजम् ..
यवगोधूमचूर्णादियोगेन तु रजः स्मृतम् .. 9 ..
text_mt:
copper-coloured is from safflower; dark-blue is produced from bilva leaves;
and powder is taught as [made] from the mixture of barley- and wheat-flour and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvarekhāsu vibhajecchuklaṃ madhye tu pītakam ..
karṇikāyāṃ keśareṣu śubhrameva nipātayet .. 2.2.2.10 ..
meaning:
सर्वरेखासु विभजेच्छुक्लं मध्ये तु पीतकम् ..
कर्णिकायां केशरेषु शुभ्रमेव निपातयेत् .. 2.2.2.10 ..
text_mt:
One should divide white on all the lines, but yellow in the middle;
on the pericarp and the filaments one should drop only white.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvādikramayogena śuklādīni prayoja yet ..
patrasaṃdhau tu vibhajedrajaḥ sekāṃtarakramāt ..11..
meaning:
पूर्वादिक्रमयोगेन शुक्लादीनि प्रयोज येत् ..
पत्रसंधौ तु विभजेद्रजः सेकांतरक्रमात् ..11..
text_mt:
In regular order beginning with the east, one should apply the white and the rest;
at the junction of petals, one should distribute powder in succession through alternating sprinklings.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ ṣoḍaśapatreṣu pūrvādikramato bhavet ..
śuklaṃ pītaṃ tathā tāmraṃ tataḥ saṃkhyātameva ca ..12..
meaning:
ततः षोडशपत्रेषु पूर्वादिक्रमतो भवेत् ..
शुक्लं पीतं तथा ताम्रं ततः संख्यातमेव च ..12..
text_mt:
Then, on the sixteen petals, in order starting from the east, there should be:
white, yellow, and copper-coloured, and then the calculated one;

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmalaṃ kuṃkumābhaṃ ca raktaṃ śuklaṃ ca kṛṣṇakam ..
pītaṃ tāmraṃ ca saṃkhyātaṃ śyāmaṃ kuṃkumaraktakam .. 13..
meaning:
श्यामलं कुंकुमाभं च रक्तं शुक्लं च कृष्णकम् ..
पीतं ताम्रं च संख्यातं श्यामं कुंकुमरक्तकम् .. 13..
text_mt:
dark-blue, saffron-coloured, red, white, and black;
yellow, copper-coloured, calculated, dark-blue, saffron-coloured, and red.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dadyāddvijaḥ pūrve īśānāṃtaṃ vibhāvayet ..
krauṃcamūrghni bhavedraktaṃ caturaṃgulamānataḥ..14..
meaning:
एवं दद्याद्द्विजः पूर्वे ईशानांतं विभावयेत् ..
क्रौंचमूर्घ्नि भवेद्रक्तं चतुरंगुलमानतः..14..
text_mt:
Thus the twice-born should apply [them] in the east, conceiving them up to the northeast.
On the head of the Krauñca, there should be red measuring four angulas;

sanskrit_iast:
tuṃḍabhāge bhavetpītaṃ grīvāyāṃ śuklameva ca ..
pucche viṃśatipatrāṇi ādau paṃca rajaḥkramāt ..15..
meaning:
तुंडभागे भवेत्पीतं ग्रीवायां शुक्लमेव च ..
पुच्छे विंशतिपत्राणि आदौ पंच रजःक्रमात् ..15..
text_mt:
in the region of the beak there should be yellow, and on the neck white;
on the tail there are twenty feathers, five at first in the sequence of powders.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍaṃguleṣvaṃḍabhāge pītena parikalpayet ..
grīvāyāṃ śuklarajasā bhāvitāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..16..
meaning:
षडंगुलेष्वंडभागे पीतेन परिकल्पयेत् ..
ग्रीवायां शुक्लरजसा भावितायां विशेषतः ..16..
text_mt:
Over six angulas in the region of the egg, one should fashion [it] with yellow;
especially on the neck, when it is prepared with white powder,

sanskrit_iast:
tatra pītādikaṃ lekhyaṃ pūrvoktaṃ ca yathā bhavet ..
śuklādikaṃ pradadyānu pātreṣvekaikaśaḥ pṛthak .. 17 ..
meaning:
तत्र पीतादिकं लेख्यं पूर्वोक्तं च यथा भवेत् ..
शुक्लादिकं प्रदद्यानु पात्रेष्वेकैकशः पृथक् .. 17 ..
text_mt:
yellow and the others are to be drawn there as previously stated.
One should apply white and the others separately, one by one, on the vessels.

sanskrit_iast:
caturaṃgulake pāde jānorūrdhve tu pītakam ..
adhastāttu bhavedraktaṃ tadeva caturaṃgulam ..18..
meaning:
चतुरंगुलके पादे जानोरूर्ध्वे तु पीतकम् ..
अधस्तात्तु भवेद्रक्तं तदेव चतुरंगुलम् ..18..
text_mt:
On the four-angula foot, above the knee there should be yellow;
below it should be red, measuring the same four angulas.

sanskrit_iast:
dvyaṃgulena bhavecchyāmamaṃgulīṣvapi vinyaset ..
evaṃ pakṣadvayenāpi likhecchuklaṃ vibhāvayet .. 19 ..
meaning:
द्व्यंगुलेन भवेच्छ्याममंगुलीष्वपि विन्यसेत् ..
एवं पक्षद्वयेनापि लिखेच्छुक्लं विभावयेत् .. 19 ..
text_mt:
It should be dark-blue by two angulas, and one should also place it on the toes;
thus with both wings, one should draw and visualize white.

sanskrit_iast:
pade śuddhaṃ cāṃgulīṣu raktaṃ śyāmena bhāvayet ..
pūrvapaścimadigbhāge śuklaṃ syādvāradeśataḥ ..2.2.2.20..
meaning:
पदे शुद्धं चांगुलीषु रक्तं श्यामेन भावयेत् ..
पूर्वपश्चिमदिग्भागे शुक्लं स्याद्वारदेशतः ..2.2.2.20..
text_mt:
Pure [white] on the foot, and on the toes one should visualize red with dark-blue;
in the eastern and western quarters it should be white, from the region of the entrance,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇottarataścaiva raktavarṇaṃ vinirdiśet ..
mahākrauṃcamidaṃ jñeyaṃ madhyakraucamidaṃ śṛṇu .. 21 ..
meaning:
दक्षिणोत्तरतश्चैव रक्तवर्णं विनिर्दिशेत् ..
महाक्रौंचमिदं ज्ञेयं मध्यक्रौचमिदं शृणु .. 21 ..
text_mt:
and on the south and north one should prescribe the colour red.
This is known as the Great Krauñca; now hear this Middling Krauñca,

sanskrit_iast:
kaniṣṭhaṃ sarvayajñeṣu vidyānāṃ saptamuttamam ..
athāparaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvataṃtramataṃ kramāt .. 22 ..
meaning:
कनिष्ठं सर्वयज्ञेषु विद्यानां सप्तमुत्तमम् ..
अथापरं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वतंत्रमतं क्रमात् .. 22 ..
text_mt:
and the Smallest in all sacrifices, the best of the seven lores.
Now I shall declare another in regular sequence, according to the doctrine of all tantras:

sanskrit_iast:
raktapītaṃ raktapītaiḥ kuryātpucchacatuṣṭayam ..
pūrvādikramayoge tu patrāṃte dharaṇītale .. ..23..
meaning:
रक्तपीतं रक्तपीतैः कुर्यात्पुच्छचतुष्टयम् ..
पूर्वादिक्रमयोगे तु पत्रांते धरणीतले .. ..23..
text_mt:
With red-and-yellow powders one should make four tails;
in regular order starting from the east, at the edge of the petals on the ground,

sanskrit_iast:
sulikhenmūlasaṃlagnaṃ bahiṣkoṇacatuṣṭayam ..
kaniṣṭhe'ṣṭakulaṃ kuryātpucchaṃ kuryāccaturvidham ..24..
meaning:
सुलिखेन्मूलसंलग्नं बहिष्कोणचतुष्टयम् ..
कनिष्ठेऽष्टकुलं कुर्यात्पुच्छं कुर्याच्चतुर्विधम् ..24..
text_mt:
one should properly draw four outer corners joined to the base.
In the smallest [maṇḍala], one should make eight families, and make the tail of four kinds.

sanskrit_iast:
trivṛttaṃ veṣṭayetpaścātsitaraktāsitaiḥ kramāt ..
dṛṣṭaṃ janmaśatodbhūtaṃ pāpaṃ nāśayate dhuvam ..25..
meaning:
त्रिवृत्तं वेष्टयेत्पश्चात्सितरक्तासितैः क्रमात् ..
दृष्टं जन्मशतोद्भूतं पापं नाशयते धुवम् ..25..
text_mt:
One should surround it behind with three circles of white, red, and black in succession;
seen, it surely destroys sin born of a hundred lifetimes.

sanskrit_iast:
pītaṃ vā vilikhedviprā naśyaṃti sakalāpadaḥ..
ataścakraṃ bahiścakraṃ kṣetre ca pratidarśanam ..26..
meaning:
पीतं वा विलिखेद्विप्रा नश्यंति सकलापदः..
अतश्चक्रं बहिश्चक्रं क्षेत्रे च प्रतिदर्शनम् ..26..
text_mt:
Or, O Brahmins, if one draws it yellow, all misfortunes are destroyed.
Therefore, the wheel and the outer wheel, and its sight in the field,

sanskrit_iast:
tasya kalpaśatodbhūtaṃ pāpaṃ nāśayate dhuvam ..
mayūraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ caiva siṃhaṃ krauṃcaṃ ca vai kapim ..27..
meaning:
तस्य कल्पशतोद्भूतं पापं नाशयते धुवम् ..
मयूरं वृषभं चैव सिंहं क्रौंचं च वै कपिम् ..27..
text_mt:
surely destroys the sin born of a hundred aeons for him.
A peacock, a bull, a lion, a curlew, and indeed a monkey:

sanskrit_iast:
pramādādvā gṛhe kṣetre vṛkṣāgre cāpi bho dvijāḥ ..
utthāya vaṃdanaṃ kuryādbrahmahatyāśataṃ dahet .. 28 ..
meaning:
प्रमादाद्वा गृहे क्षेत्रे वृक्षाग्रे चापि भो द्विजाः ..
उत्थाय वंदनं कुर्याद्ब्रह्महत्याशतं दहेत् .. 28 ..
text_mt:
O Brahmins, whether by chance in the house, the field, or at the top of a tree,
rising and bowing [to them], one burns away a hundred slayings of a Brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
poṣaṇātkīrtimāpnoti darśanātpāpavicyutiḥ ..
darśanādvardhate lakṣmīrāyurvṛddhiśca jāyate .. 29 ..
meaning:
पोषणात्कीर्तिमाप्नोति दर्शनात्पापविच्युतिः ..
दर्शनाद्वर्धते लक्ष्मीरायुर्वृद्धिश्च जायते .. 29 ..
text_mt:
From feeding [them] one attains fame; from seeing [them] comes liberation from sin;
from seeing [them] fortune increases, and lengthening of life comes to be.

sanskrit_iast:
mayūro brahmaṇo mūrtirvṛṣabhaśca sadāśivaḥ.. .
siṃhe ca saṃbhaveddurgā vaiṣṇavo vidhirucyate ..2.2.2.30..
meaning:
मयूरो ब्रह्मणो मूर्तिर्वृषभश्च सदाशिवः.. .
सिंहे च संभवेद्दुर्गा वैष्णवो विधिरुच्यते ..2.2.2.30..
text_mt:
The peacock is the form of Brahmā, and the bull is Sadāśiva;
in the lion Durgā resides, and the Vaiṣṇava rite is proclaimed [there].

sanskrit_iast:
krauṃco nārāyaṇo devo vyāghrastripurasuṃdarī ..
kālikā kṛṣṇavyāghraśca lakṣmīścitrakapotakaḥ ..31..
meaning:
क्रौंचो नारायणो देवो व्याघ्रस्त्रिपुरसुंदरी ..
कालिका कृष्णव्याघ्रश्च लक्ष्मीश्चित्रकपोतकः ..31..
text_mt:
The curlew is the god Nārāyaṇa; the tigress is Tripurasundarī;
Kālikā is the black tigress; and Lakṣmī is the spotted dove.

sanskrit_iast:
snātaḥ paśyati pratyahni grahadoṣo na jāyate ..
tasmātprayatnato bhūtvā dhārayetpoṣayedgṛhe .. 32 ..
meaning:
स्नातः पश्यति प्रत्यह्नि ग्रहदोषो न जायते ..
तस्मात्प्रयत्नतो भूत्वा धारयेत्पोषयेद्गृहे .. 32 ..
text_mt:
Having bathed, he who sees them daily suffers no planetary affliction;
therefore, becoming attentive, one should keep and nurture [them] in the house.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi maṃḍale maṃḍaleṣvapi ..
rajodravyapramāṇaṃ ca yathoktaṃ yatnavarjanam .. 33 ..
meaning:
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि मंडले मंडलेष्वपि ..
रजोद्रव्यप्रमाणं च यथोक्तं यत्नवर्जनम् .. 33 ..
text_mt:
Hereafter I shall explain, in each and every maṇḍala,
the measure of powder substances and the careful avoidance as prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃḍulotthaṃ yavotthaṃ vā varjyaṃ makararopaṇam ..
yadbālyaśrāvaṇe jātaṃ hiṃgulaṃ gaṃdhakaṃ tathā ..34..
meaning:
तंडुलोत्थं यवोत्थं वा वर्ज्यं मकररोपणम् ..
यद्बाल्यश्रावणे जातं हिंगुलं गंधकं तथा ..34..
text_mt:
Derived from rice or derived from barley, the drawing of a sea-monster is to be avoided;
that which is produced in early Śrāvaṇa, cinnabar, and sulphur,

sanskrit_iast:
haritālaṃ subhadraṃ ca sadā vighnaṃ vivarjayet ..
haimaṃtikodbhavaṃ yacca sitapāṣāṇameva ca ..35..
meaning:
हरितालं सुभद्रं च सदा विघ्नं विवर्जयेत् ..
हैमंतिकोद्भवं यच्च सितपाषाणमेव च ..35..
text_mt:
orpiment, and subhadra: one should always avoid [these, which cause] obstacles;
and that which arises in winter, and white stone,

sanskrit_iast:
kāṃcanyāśca prabhedaṃ yacchastaṃ śuklaguṇaṃ dvijāḥ ..
śephālivṛttaṃ niśayā atasīkusumāni ca ..36..
meaning:
कांचन्याश्च प्रभेदं यच्छस्तं शुक्लगुणं द्विजाः ..
शेफालिवृत्तं निशया अतसीकुसुमानि च ..36..
text_mt:
and the variety of gold—these are praised for their white quality, O Brahmins.
Round night-jasmine with turmeric, and linseed flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃśukasya ca puṣpāṇi śastaṃ pītaṃ guṇaṃ bhavet ..
nāgajaṃ gairikaṃ caiva kusuṃbha kusumāni ca ..37..
meaning:
किंशुकस्य च पुष्पाणि शस्तं पीतं गुणं भवेत् ..
नागजं गैरिकं चैव कुसुंभ कुसुमानि च ..37..
text_mt:
and flowers of the palāśa: [these] are praised for their yellow quality;
red lead, red chalk, and safflower blossoms [for red].

sanskrit_iast:
kuśītaṃ guḍakaṃ caiva maṃjiṣṭhāṃ paṃcaraṃgakam ..
vijayāpatrakaṃ caiva bilvapatraṃ tathaiva ca..38..
meaning:
कुशीतं गुडकं चैव मंजिष्ठां पंचरंगकम् ..
विजयापत्रकं चैव बिल्वपत्रं तथैव च..38..
text_mt:
[White] water-lily, guḍaka, and madder as a fivefold coloring;
vijayā leaves and likewise bilva leaves,

sanskrit_iast:
punarnavāyāḥ patraṃ ca keśarasya bakasya ca..
kṛṣṇapāṣāṇakaṃ caiva kṛṣṇābhraṃ samayūthakam..39..
meaning:
पुनर्नवायाः पत्रं च केशरस्य बकस्य च..
कृष्णपाषाणकं चैव कृष्णाभ्रं समयूथकम्..39..
text_mt:
and the leaf of punarnavā, and of saffron, and of baka;
black stone and black mica along with myrobalan,

sanskrit_iast:
nāgapāṣāṇakaṃ caiva punnāgaṃ dagdhapaṃcakam ..
śaṃkhacūrṇaṃ lohaviṣṭhāṃ nāgaviṣṭhāṃ ca varjayet..2.2.2.40..
meaning:
नागपाषाणकं चैव पुन्नागं दग्धपंचकम् ..
शंखचूर्णं लोहविष्ठां नागविष्ठां च वर्जयेत्..2.2.2.40..
text_mt:
nāgapāṣāṇa, punnāga, and the five burnt substances;
one should avoid conch powder, iron slag, and lead slag.

sanskrit_iast:
karpūraṃ kuṃkumaṃ caiva rocanārocanāṃ śrayet ..
yavaśālīyakairbhinnaṃ śuklaṃ ca kārayetsudhīḥ ..41..
meaning:
कर्पूरं कुंकुमं चैव रोचनारोचनां श्रयेत् ..
यवशालीयकैर्भिन्नं शुक्लं च कारयेत्सुधीः ..41..
text_mt:
One should use camphor, saffron, and rocanā;
a wise person should make white from barley and winter rice.

sanskrit_iast:
lākṣāṃ ca yadi gṛhṇīyāttadbharjitvā pradāpayet ..
ākāśaṃ pṛthivīṃ caiva bhaumaṃ rāmaṃ tathā śanī ..42..
meaning:
लाक्षां च यदि गृह्णीयात्तद्भर्जित्वा प्रदापयेत् ..
आकाशं पृथिवीं चैव भौमं रामं तथा शनी ..42..
text_mt:
And if one takes red lac, one should apply it after roasting it;
space, earth, Mars, Rāma, and Saturn.

sanskrit_iast:
dharaṇīṃ sadanasthāne pañcadhā vibhajedbahiḥ ..
padmamullikhya prathamaṃ karṇikāṃ tadanantaram ..43..
meaning:
धरणीं सदनस्थाने पञ्चधा विभजेद्बहिः ..
पद्ममुल्लिख्य प्रथमं कर्णिकां तदनन्तरम् ..43..
text_mt:
One should divide the ground outside the house area into five parts;
having first drawn a lotus, then the pericarp,

sanskrit_iast:
tarjanyamadhyā pūrvotthaṃ vibhajedvā samāhitaḥ ..
tarjanyaṃguṣṭhayogairvā tṛṇamārabhya yadbhavet .. 44 ..
meaning:
तर्जन्यमध्या पूर्वोत्थं विभजेद्वा समाहितः ..
तर्जन्यंगुष्ठयोगैर्वा तृणमारभ्य यद्भवेत् .. 44 ..
text_mt:
composed, one should divide what arises from the east with forefinger and middle finger;
or with the junction of the forefinger and thumb, starting from the grass, whatever it may be.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛṇamārabhya sāmānye śakto vā madhyamāditaḥ ..
rākṣasādipratiṣṭhāyāṃ grahapakṣe'gnimāditaḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
तृणमारभ्य सामान्ये शक्तो वा मध्यमादितः ..
राक्षसादिप्रतिष्ठायां ग्रहपक्षेऽग्निमादितः .. 45 ..
text_mt:
Starting from the grass in ordinary rites, or if able, from the middle finger first;
in the consecration of demons and so forth, from Fire in the context of the planets.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃgulyagre ca vibhajetsarvakāmārthasiddhaye ..
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ grahamakhe kāmyeṣu parivarjayet .. 46 ..
meaning:
अंगुल्यग्रे च विभजेत्सर्वकामार्थसिद्धये ..
प्रतिष्ठायां ग्रहमखे काम्येषु परिवर्जयेत् .. 46 ..
text_mt:
And one should divide it at the fingertip for the attainment of all desires and aims;
in a consecration, in a planetary sacrifice, and in rites for specific desires, one should avoid [certain faults].

sanskrit_iast:
subhadraṃ maṇḍalaṃ vakṣye śubhadaṃ śubhamādiśet ..
ataḥ subhadramuddiṣṭaṃ svargamokṣapradāyakam .. 47 ..
meaning:
सुभद्रं मण्डलं वक्ष्ये शुभदं शुभमादिशेत् ..
अतः सुभद्रमुद्दिष्टं स्वर्गमोक्षप्रदायकम् .. 47 ..
text_mt:
I shall describe the subhadra maṇḍala, which bestows good fortune; one should declare it auspicious;
hence subhadra is declared as bestowing heaven and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
sārdhahastena mānena kuryānmaṃṇḍalamuttamam ..
caturviśāṃgulaiḥ pūrṇaṃ sarvatra hastamādiśet .. 48 ..
meaning:
सार्धहस्तेन मानेन कुर्यान्मंण्डलमुत्तमम् ..
चतुर्विशांगुलैः पूर्णं सर्वत्र हस्तमादिशेत् .. 48 ..
text_mt:
One should make the excellent maṇḍala with a measurement of one and a half cubits;
one should declare a cubit everywhere as full with twenty-four finger-breadths.

sanskrit_iast:
karturmadhyasahasrasya madhyamā madhyaparvaṇi ..
madhyamā dīrghamānena mānāṃgulamiti smṛtam .. 49 ..
meaning:
कर्तुर्मध्यसहस्रस्य मध्यमा मध्यपर्वणि ..
मध्यमा दीर्घमानेन मानांगुलमिति स्मृतम् .. 49 ..
text_mt:
At the middle joint of the middle finger of an average patron,
the standard finger-breadth is traditionally known by the length of the middle finger.

sanskrit_iast:
rekhādvayāṃtaraṃ yacca mūlarekhāṃ na cāśrayet ..
vaddhāṃguṣṭhanakhadvaṃdvaṃ mānāṃgulamathāpi vā ..2.2.2.50..
meaning:
रेखाद्वयांतरं यच्च मूलरेखां न चाश्रयेत् ..
वद्धांगुष्ठनखद्वंद्वं मानांगुलमथापि वा ..2.2.2.50..
text_mt:
And the space between two lines—one should not rely on the baseline—
or the standard finger-breadth is the pair of nails of joined thumbs.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye nibadhya śaṃkuṃ ca muṣṭibāhupramāṇataḥ ..
trivṛttaṃ kārayenmadhye jyeṣṭhottarakanīyasam .. 51 ..
meaning:
मध्ये निबध्य शंकुं च मुष्टिबाहुप्रमाणतः ..
त्रिवृत्तं कारयेन्मध्ये ज्येष्ठोत्तरकनीयसम् .. 51 ..
text_mt:
Having fixed a peg in the middle according to the measure of the arm with a clenched fist,
one should make three circles in the middle, largest, middle, and smallest.

sanskrit_iast:
prakalpya karṇikādīni madhye cāṣṭadalaṃ likhet ..
bahiścārkadalaṃ kuryādvarṇānāṃ kramakeṇa tu ..52..
meaning:
प्रकल्प्य कर्णिकादीनि मध्ये चाष्टदलं लिखेत् ..
बहिश्चार्कदलं कुर्याद्वर्णानां क्रमकेण तु ..52..
text_mt:
Having formed the pericarp and other parts, one should draw an eight-petalled [lotus] in the center;
and outside one should make twelve petals according to the order of the colors.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcamaṃ śvetavarṇena bahiḥ kuryāttriveṣṭanam ..
sitapītāruṇaṃ kuryātpaścādvedāṃgulāṃtare .. 53 ..
meaning:
पंचमं श्वेतवर्णेन बहिः कुर्यात्त्रिवेष्टनम् ..
सितपीतारुणं कुर्यात्पश्चाद्वेदांगुलांतरे .. 53 ..
text_mt:
One should make the fifth a triple enclosure outside with white color;
one should make it white, yellow, and red, then at an interval of four finger-breadths,

sanskrit_iast:
veṣṭayecchuklavarṇena madhye kalpalatāṃ likhet ..
subhadraṃ maṇḍalātpūrvaṃ sarvatobhadrakaṃ śṛṇu .. .. 54 ..
meaning:
वेष्टयेच्छुक्लवर्णेन मध्ये कल्पलतां लिखेत् ..
सुभद्रं मण्डलात्पूर्वं सर्वतोभद्रकं शृणु .. .. 54 ..
text_mt:
one should enclose it with white color and draw a wish-fulfilling creeper in the middle.
This was the subhadra maṇḍala; now hear first of the sarvatobhadra:

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāryeṣu yajñeṣu sarvakalyāṇamāpnuyāt ..
maṃḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ sarvayajñeṣu puṣṭidam .. 55 ..
meaning:
सर्वकार्येषु यज्ञेषु सर्वकल्याणमाप्नुयात् ..
मंडलं सर्वतोभद्रं सर्वयज्ञेषु पुष्टिदम् .. 55 ..
text_mt:
in all undertakings and in all sacrifices, one attains all welfare;
the sarvatobhadra maṇḍala provides nourishment in all sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
sādhakānāṃ hitārthāya īśvareṇaiva bhāṣitam ..
caturviṃśatyaṃgulena hastaḥ prathamato bhavet .. 56 ..
meaning:
साधकानां हितार्थाय ईश्वरेणैव भाषितम् ..
चतुर्विंशत्यंगुलेन हस्तः प्रथमतो भवेत् .. 56 ..
text_mt:
It was spoken by the Lord himself for the welfare of practitioners;
a cubit should first be twenty-four finger-breadths.

sanskrit_iast:
koṇe sūtradvayaṃ dadyānmadhye sūtradvayaṃ punaḥ ..
tato matsyānviracayetkarṇe sūtrāṇi sādhakaḥ ..57..
meaning:
कोणे सूत्रद्वयं दद्यान्मध्ये सूत्रद्वयं पुनः ..
ततो मत्स्यान्विरचयेत्कर्णे सूत्राणि साधकः ..57..
text_mt:
One should lay two cords at the corner, and again two cords in the middle;
then the practitioner should make fish marks on the cords at the diagonal.

sanskrit_iast:
catuḥ sūtraṃ pātayecca pūrvāparavibhāgataḥ ..
punardadyāccatuḥsūtraṃ karṇasūtraṃ punardadet .. 58 ..
meaning:
चतुः सूत्रं पातयेच्च पूर्वापरविभागतः ..
पुनर्दद्याच्चतुःसूत्रं कर्णसूत्रं पुनर्ददेत् .. 58 ..
text_mt:
And one should cast four cords according to the division into east and west;
one should lay four cords again, and then lay diagonal cords again,

sanskrit_iast:
śatadvayapadaṃ yāvatṣaṭpaṃcāśādhikaṃ tathā ..
pātayecca tathā sūtramevaṃ saptadaśaṃ bhavet .. 59 ..
meaning:
शतद्वयपदं यावत्षट्पंचाशाधिकं तथा ..
पातयेच्च तथा सूत्रमेवं सप्तदशं भवेत् .. 59 ..
text_mt:
up to two hundred and fifty-six squares;
and one should cast the cords thus; there will be seventeen [lines].

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvapaṃktyā padayugaṃ cādye padacatuṣṭayam ..
dvārapārśve bhavedyāvaddaṃtapaṃktyā padatrayam .. 2.2.2.60 ..
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वपंक्त्या पदयुगं चाद्ये पदचतुष्टयम् ..
द्वारपार्श्वे भवेद्यावद्दंतपंक्त्या पदत्रयम् .. 2.2.2.60 ..
text_mt:
A pair of squares in the upper row and four squares at the beginning,
up to the side of the entrance there should be three squares in the tooth-row.

sanskrit_iast:
rekhāṃ sarvatra śuklena racayedyajñiyottamaḥ ..
paṅkajaṃ śuklavarṇena vaiṣṇavo yāgakarmaṇi .. 61 ..
meaning:
रेखां सर्वत्र शुक्लेन रचयेद्यज्ञियोत्तमः ..
पङ्कजं शुक्लवर्णेन वैष्णवो यागकर्मणि .. 61 ..
text_mt:
The best of sacrificial performers should draw the line everywhere with white;
a Vaiṣṇava should draw the lotus with white color in a sacrificial rite.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktiyoge bhavedraktaṃ śaive pītaṃ vinirdiśet ..
pratiṣṭhāsu ca sarvāsu śuklameva praśasyate .. 62 ..
meaning:
शक्तियोगे भवेद्रक्तं शैवे पीतं विनिर्दिशेत् ..
प्रतिष्ठासु च सर्वासु शुक्लमेव प्रशस्यते .. 62 ..
text_mt:
In a Śākta rite it should be red, and in a Śaiva rite one should designate it yellow;
and in all consecrations, white alone is praised.

sanskrit_iast:
pītena karṇikā kāryā caturbhāgena mānataḥ ..
śubhaṃ cakorāvasthāne tāpayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 63 ..
meaning:
पीतेन कर्णिका कार्या चतुर्भागेन मानतः ..
शुभं चकोरावस्थाने तापयित्वा विचक्षणः .. 63 ..
text_mt:
The pericarp should be made yellow, measuring a fourth part;
having heated the auspicious [substances] at the position of the cakora bird, the expert,

sanskrit_iast:
karṇikāmūlamārabhya rekhāḥ ṣoḍaśa kalpayet ..
rekhāmūle bhavecchuklaṃ madhye raktaṃ nipātayet .. 64 ..
meaning:
कर्णिकामूलमारभ्य रेखाः षोडश कल्पयेत् ..
रेखामूले भवेच्छुक्लं मध्ये रक्तं निपातयेत् .. 64 ..
text_mt:
starting from the base of the pericarp, should fashion sixteen lines;
at the base of the line it should be white, in the middle one should lay down red,

sanskrit_iast:
agre pītaṃ bhavedevaṃ kṛtvā paṃkajaveṣṭanam ..
śubhravarṇena taddadyātpītavarṇena sarvataḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
अग्रे पीतं भवेदेवं कृत्वा पंकजवेष्टनम् ..
शुभ्रवर्णेन तद्दद्यात्पीतवर्णेन सर्वतः .. 65 ..
text_mt:
and at the tip it should be yellow: having thus made the enclosure of the lotus,
one should provide it with white color and with yellow color all around.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye raktaṃ bhavettacca evaṃ ṣoḍaśakalpayet ..
koṇeṣu raktaṃ dadyācca padmaṃ kṣetreṣu nirdiśet .. 66 ..
meaning:
मध्ये रक्तं भवेत्तच्च एवं षोडशकल्पयेत् ..
कोणेषु रक्तं दद्याच्च पद्मं क्षेत्रेषु निर्दिशेत् .. 66 ..
text_mt:
And in the middle it should be red; thus one should fashion sixteen [petals];
and one should place red in the corners, and assign a lotus in the fields.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklena pīṭhagātrāṇi pīṭhakoṇe padatraye ..
pītavarṇena racayeddvidhā paṃktidvaye tathā .. 67 ..
meaning:
शुक्लेन पीठगात्राणि पीठकोणे पदत्रये ..
पीतवर्णेन रचयेद्द्विधा पंक्तिद्वये तथा .. 67 ..
text_mt:
With white the limbs of the pedestal, and in the three squares at the corner of the pedestal,
one should fashion it with yellow color in two ways, likewise in two rows.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhena racayetpādau punaḥ pītādivarṇakaiḥ..
citraṃ suśobhanaṃ kāryaṃ tatra kalpalatāṃ nyaset .. ..68..
meaning:
शुद्धेन रचयेत्पादौ पुनः पीतादिवर्णकैः..
चित्रं सुशोभनं कार्यं तत्र कल्पलतां न्यसेत् .. ..68..
text_mt:
One should fashion the feet with pure [white], and again with yellow and other colors;
one should make it multi-colored and very beautiful, and place a wish-fulfilling creeper there.

sanskrit_iast:
mānaṃ kalpalatāyāstu dvyaṅgulaṃ parikīrtitam ..
dvedve śastaṃ ca bhramaṇaṃ śaṃkhāvartakramāttrayam ..69..
meaning:
मानं कल्पलतायास्तु द्व्यङ्गुलं परिकीर्तितम् ..
द्वेद्वे शस्तं च भ्रमणं शंखावर्तक्रमात्त्रयम् ..69..
text_mt:
The measure of the wish-fulfilling creeper is declared to be two finger-breadths;
two and two windings are praised, and three in the order of a conch-spiral.

sanskrit_iast:
graṃthaugraṃthau puṣpaphale nānāvarṇena bhāvayet ..
nānāpaśugaṇairyuktaṃ nānāpakṣigaṇairyutam .. 2.2.2.70 ..
meaning:
ग्रंथौग्रंथौ पुष्पफले नानावर्णेन भावयेत् ..
नानापशुगणैर्युक्तं नानापक्षिगणैर्युतम् .. 2.2.2.70 ..
text_mt:
At every knot one should visualize flowers and fruits with various colors;
endowed with various hosts of beasts, endowed with various flocks of birds.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇave gāruḍaṃ śastaṃ śaive kīśavṛṣaṃ likhet ..
śākte vyāghraṃ tathaiśe ca śarabhaṃ harimālikhet ..71..
meaning:
वैष्णवे गारुडं शस्तं शैवे कीशवृषं लिखेत् ..
शाक्ते व्याघ्रं तथैशे च शरभं हरिमालिखेत् ..71..
text_mt:
In a Vaiṣṇava [rite] Garuḍa is praised; in a Śaiva rite one should draw a monkey and a bull;
in a Śākta rite a tiger, and in an Aiśa rite one should draw a śarabha and a lion.

sanskrit_iast:
śobhāṃ pītena racayedupaśobhāṃ ca pītakaiḥ ..
koṇeṣu kṛṣṇavarṇena bahiḥ syādveṣṭanatrayam .. 72 ..
meaning:
शोभां पीतेन रचयेदुपशोभां च पीतकैः ..
कोणेषु कृष्णवर्णेन बहिः स्याद्वेष्टनत्रयम् .. 72 ..
text_mt:
One should make the border with yellow, and the secondary border with yellow tones;
with black color in the corners; outside there should be three enclosures.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklapītāruṇaiḥ kāryaṃ maṇḍalaṃ syānmanoramam ..
sarvatobhadramaparaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam .. 73 ..
meaning:
शुक्लपीतारुणैः कार्यं मण्डलं स्यान्मनोरमम् ..
सर्वतोभद्रमपरं सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकम् .. 73 ..
text_mt:
With white, yellow, and red the maṇḍala should be made delightful;
[now] another sarvatobhadra, granting all accomplishments,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajñānamayaṃ śuddhaṃ dharmakāmārthadāyakam ..
caturasraṃ samaṃ kṛtvā digbhyo dvādaśadhā dvijāḥ .. 74 ..
meaning:
सर्वज्ञानमयं शुद्धं धर्मकामार्थदायकम् ..
चतुरस्रं समं कृत्वा दिग्भ्यो द्वादशधा द्विजाः .. 74 ..
text_mt:
consisting of all knowledge, pure, bestowing virtue, desire, and wealth:
having made a square equal from the cardinal points into twelve parts, O twice-born ones,

sanskrit_iast:
pātayettatra sūtrāṇi koṣṭhānāṃ dṛśyate śatam ..
catuścatvāriṃśadādyaṃ paścātṣaṭtriṃśadaṃbujam .. 75 ..
meaning:
पातयेत्तत्र सूत्राणि कोष्ठानां दृश्यते शतम् ..
चतुश्चत्वारिंशदाद्यं पश्चात्षट्त्रिंशदंबुजम् .. 75 ..
text_mt:
one should cast cords there: one hundred squares are seen;
first forty-four, and then a thirty-six-square lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
koṣṭhaṃ prakalpayetpīṭhaṃ paṃktyā caivātra vīthikām ..
dvāraśobhe yathāpūrvamupaśobhaṃ ca dṛśyate .. 76 ..
meaning:
कोष्ठं प्रकल्पयेत्पीठं पंक्त्या चैवात्र वीथिकाम् ..
द्वारशोभे यथापूर्वमुपशोभं च दृश्यते .. 76 ..
text_mt:
One should designate a square for the pedestal, and an aisle here along the row;
as before, the door-borders and secondary border are seen.

sanskrit_iast:
avaśiṣṭaiḥ padaiḥ kuryātsadbhistaṃtrāṇi mantravit ..
vidadhyātpūrvavaccheṣamevaṃ vā maṇḍalaṃ bhavet .. 77..
meaning:
अवशिष्टैः पदैः कुर्यात्सद्भिस्तंत्राणि मन्त्रवित् ..
विदध्यात्पूर्ववच्छेषमेवं वा मण्डलं भवेत् .. 77..
text_mt:
The knower of mantras should perform the rituals with the remaining noble squares;
one should arrange the rest as before; thus or so the maṇḍala should be.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvoktamaṇḍale vidvandharaṇīsadanaṃ bahiḥ ..
madhye kalpalatā kāryā bahiṣkoṇeṣu sattamāḥ .. 78 ..
meaning:
पूर्वोक्तमण्डले विद्वन्धरणीसदनं बहिः ..
मध्ये कल्पलता कार्या बहिष्कोणेषु सत्तमाः .. 78 ..
text_mt:
In the previously described maṇḍala, O wise ones, the earth-chamber is outside;
a wish-fulfilling creeper should be made in the middle, and at the outer corners, O best of men,

sanskrit_iast:
gulālītūryavarṇena mahāmatta iti smṛtaḥ ..
śobhopaśobhe śobhāgrāṃ kuryādvai maṇḍalaṃ bhavet .. 79 ..
meaning:
गुलालीतूर्यवर्णेन महामत्त इति स्मृतः ..
शोभोपशोभे शोभाग्रां कुर्याद्वै मण्डलं भवेत् .. 79 ..
text_mt:
with the color of gulālī and tūrya, it is called mahāmatta;
one should make the border and secondary border, having the tip of the border; indeed the maṇḍala is formed.

sanskrit_iast:
etaddhi sarvatobhadraṃ rāśiyuktamataḥ param ..
śatapatraṃ vajranābhaṃ biṃbanābhaṃ sahasrakam .. 2.2.2.80 ..
meaning:
एतद्धि सर्वतोभद्रं राशियुक्तमतः परम् ..
शतपत्रं वज्रनाभं बिंबनाभं सहस्रकम् .. 2.2.2.80 ..
text_mt:
This indeed is the sarvatobhadra; thereafter the one endowed with zodiacal signs:
the hundred-petalled, the vajranābha, the bimbanābha, the thousand-petalled,

sanskrit_iast:
gajāhvaṃ ca gajākāraṃ madhye tu samalaṅkṛtam ..
catuścandre candrabimbaścandrakāṃtamudāhṛtam .. 81 ..
meaning:
गजाह्वं च गजाकारं मध्ये तु समलङ्कृतम् ..
चतुश्चन्द्रे चन्द्रबिम्बश्चन्द्रकांतमुदाहृतम् .. 81 ..
text_mt:
and the one named gaja, shaped like an elephant, adorned in the middle;
and in the four-moon [maṇḍala], the lunar orb is declared as candrakānta.

sanskrit_iast:
bahirdvādaśabhiḥ sūryaiḥ sūryākrāṃtaṃ prakīrtitam ..
śekharī tripuṭaṃ caiva śatapatraṃ ca prakramāt .. 82 ..
meaning:
बहिर्द्वादशभिः सूर्यैः सूर्याक्रांतं प्रकीर्तितम् ..
शेखरी त्रिपुटं चैव शतपत्रं च प्रक्रमात् .. 82 ..
text_mt: [The maṇḍala] bounded on the outside by twelve suns is declared as Sūryākrānta. / Śekharī, Tripuṭa, and Śatapatra in succession,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrameva viprendrāḥ padmānte yasya svastikam ..
svastikaṃ tadbhavedviprāḥ puṣkaraṃ vajrasaṃmatam .. 83 ..
meaning:
सहस्रमेव विप्रेन्द्राः पद्मान्ते यस्य स्वस्तिकम् ..
स्वस्तिकं तद्भवेद्विप्राः पुष्करं वज्रसंमतम् .. 83 ..
text_mt: and Sahasra, O foremost of Brahmins; at the end of whose lotus there is a svastika, / that becomes Svastika, O Brahmins; Puṣkara is agreed to be [like] a vajra;

sanskrit_iast:
cintāmaṇiṃ kuṃkumāṃśaṃ khātaṃ ca harivallabham ..
pañcasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca pañcasiṃhāsanaṃ viduḥ .. 84 ..
meaning:
चिन्तामणिं कुंकुमांशं खातं च हरिवल्लभम् ..
पञ्चसिंहासनस्थं च पञ्चसिंहासनं विदुः .. 84 ..
text_mt: Cintāmaṇi, Kuṅkumāṃśa, Khāta, and Harivallabha; / and that which rests upon five lion-thrones is known as Pañcasiṃhāsana;

sanskrit_iast:
tadvadvṛṣāsanaṃ jñeyaṃ śikhirūpaṃ śikhidhvajam ..
nārasiṃhaṃ padmagarbhaṃ kapotāsyaṃ tathā bhavet .. 85 ..
meaning:
तद्वद्वृषासनं ज्ञेयं शिखिरूपं शिखिध्वजम् ..
नारसिंहं पद्मगर्भं कपोतास्यं तथा भवेत् .. 85 ..
text_mt: likewise Vṛṣāsana should be known, Śikhirūpa, Śikhidhvaja, / Nārasiṃha, Padmagarbha, and Kapotāsya likewise;

sanskrit_iast:
gāruḍaṃ merugarbhaṃ ca nīlakaṇṭhaṃ narākṛtim ..
śatakratugajārūḍhaṃ śrībiṃbanavasūtrakam .. 86 ..
meaning:
गारुडं मेरुगर्भं च नीलकण्ठं नराकृतिम् ..
शतक्रतुगजारूढं श्रीबिंबनवसूत्रकम् .. 86 ..
text_mt: Gāruḍa, Merugarbha, Nīlakaṇṭha, Narākṛti, / Śatakratugajārūḍha, Śrībimbanavasūtraka,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāsramaṣṭakoṇādyaṃ bahiḥ padmavanaṃ kṛtam ..
kāmadvayena puṭitaṃ sahasraṃ padmaveṣṭitam .. 87 ..
meaning:
अष्टास्रमष्टकोणाद्यं बहिः पद्मवनं कृतम् ..
कामद्वयेन पुटितं सहस्रं पद्मवेष्टितम् .. 87 ..
text_mt: eight-sided, beginning with eight angles, having a lotus grove made outside; / encased by two kāmas, a thousand [petals] enclosed by lotuses;

sanskrit_iast:
tryasragarbhaṃ paṅkajaṃ ca tryasraṃ tatparikīrtitam ..
aṣṭa patrāṇi vai meruṃ sumeruṃ tadviparyaye .. 88 ..
meaning:
त्र्यस्रगर्भं पङ्कजं च त्र्यस्रं तत्परिकीर्तितम् ..
अष्ट पत्राणि वै मेरुं सुमेरुं तद्विपर्यये .. 88 ..
text_mt: having a triangular interior and a lotus, that is proclaimed as Tryasra. / Eight petals [make] Meru; the reverse of that is Sumeru;

sanskrit_iast:
mahāmahāmerupṛṣṭhaṃ śatatrayacchadairvṛtam ..
chidravyaktiṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā mānena bho dvijāḥ .. 89 ..
vasu 8 dig 10 viṃśakaiścaiva 20 catvāriṃśat 40 śatārdhakam 50 ..
meaning:
महामहामेरुपृष्ठं शतत्रयच्छदैर्वृतम् ..
छिद्रव्यक्तिं प्रवक्ष्यामि यथा मानेन भो द्विजाः .. 89 ..
वसु 8 दिग् 10 विंशकैश्चैव 20 चत्वारिंशत् 40 शतार्धकम् 50 ..
text_mt:
Mahāmahāmerupṛṣṭha is surrounded by three hundred petals. / I shall declare the manifestation of the spaces according to measure, O Brahmins:
Eight (8), ten (10), twenty (20), forty (40), half a hundred (50),

sanskrit_iast: daṃḍiśravaṇasaṃpanna 60 mākāśaṃ vasusaṃmitam .. 2.2.2.90 ..
meaning: दंडिश्रवणसंपन्न 60 माकाशं वसुसंमितम् .. 2.2.2.90 ..
text_mt: endowed with a stick and ears: sixty (60), the sky, measured by the Vasus (8),

sanskrit_iast:
śataviṃśādhikaṃ caiva 120 dalāni tadanantaram ..
śuklaraktaṃ cāṣṭavaṇairbiṃboṣṭhaṃ paripūrayet .. 91 ..
meaning:
शतविंशाधिकं चैव 120 दलानि तदनन्तरम् ..
शुक्लरक्तं चाष्टवणैर्बिंबोष्ठं परिपूरयेत् .. 91 ..
text_mt: and one hundred increased by twenty (120) petals thereafter. / With white, red, and eight colours one should fill the bimba rim;

sanskrit_iast:
śuklena paṅkajaṃ tatra paścātkuryāttriveṣṭanam ..
śatapatramatho vakṣye bimbarājeti kathyate .. 92 ..
meaning:
शुक्लेन पङ्कजं तत्र पश्चात्कुर्यात्त्रिवेष्टनम् ..
शतपत्रमथो वक्ष्ये बिम्बराजेति कथ्यते .. 92 ..
text_mt: there [one draws] a lotus in white, and afterwards makes a triple enclosure. / Now I shall declare the hundred-petalled [maṇḍala], called Bimbarāja:

sanskrit_iast:
sthaṃḍile kuśahaste ca pūrvavadveṣṭayetkramāt ..
vasu 8 pañcakalā 16 pañcaviṃśakaṃ 25 tannapatrakāt .. 93 ..
meaning:
स्थंडिले कुशहस्ते च पूर्ववद्वेष्टयेत्क्रमात् ..
वसु 8 पञ्चकला 16 पञ्चविंशकं 25 तन्नपत्रकात् .. 93 ..
text_mt: on the altar, with kuśa grass in hand, one should encircle [it] in order as before; / eight (8), five and a digit (16), twenty-five (25), from those nine petals,

sanskrit_iast:
catvāriṃśattataḥ paścā 40 daṣṭottaraśataṃ 108 bhavet ..
śuklaṃ śoṇaṃ tathā pītaṃ śyāmaśuklairanaṃtaram .. 94 ..
meaning:
चत्वारिंशत्ततः पश्चा 40 दष्टोत्तरशतं 108 भवेत् ..
शुक्लं शोणं तथा पीतं श्यामशुक्लैरनंतरम् .. 94 ..
text_mt: after that forty (40), [and then] there should be one hundred and eight (108); / with white, crimson, likewise yellow, and thereafter dark-blue and white;

sanskrit_iast:
vilome dalasandhīni śākte śaive tu ṣaṭpuram ..
veṣṭayetpaṃcavarṇena śuklādīni samaṃtataḥ .. 95 ..
meaning:
विलोमे दलसन्धीनि शाक्ते शैवे तु षट्पुरम् ..
वेष्टयेत्पंचवर्णेन शुक्लादीनि समंततः .. 95 ..
text_mt: in reverse order [one fills] the joints of the petals; in Śākta and Śaiva [rites] a six-city [design]. / One should encircle [it] on all sides with five colours, white and the rest;

sanskrit_iast:
raktapītaiḥ samāstīrya koṇāñchuklena pūrayet ..
sthaṃḍile tārahastena aṣṭahastaṃ prakalpayet .. 96 ..
meaning:
रक्तपीतैः समास्तीर्य कोणाञ्छुक्लेन पूरयेत् ..
स्थंडिले तारहस्तेन अष्टहस्तं प्रकल्पयेत् .. 96 ..
text_mt: having spread [them] with red and yellow, one should fill the corners with white. / On the altar, with an elevated cubit, one should prepare an eight-cubit [design],

sanskrit_iast:
maṃḍalaṃ biṃbarājasya aṣṭottaradalairvṛtam ..
vasupañcaśaktiviṃśaccatvāriṃśacchatārddhakam .. 97 ..
meaning:
मंडलं बिंबराजस्य अष्टोत्तरदलैर्वृतम् ..
वसुपञ्चशक्तिविंशच्चत्वारिंशच्छतार्द्धकम् .. 97 ..
text_mt: the maṇḍala of Bimbarāja, surrounded by a hundred and eight petals: / eight, five, śakti (six), twenty, forty, half a hundred,

sanskrit_iast:
tryṛtupatraṃ suvṛttaṃ syādvṛttayuktaṃ sabilvakam ..
catvāriṃśaddvayaṃ caiva gaganena samāvṛtam .. 98 ..
meaning:
त्र्यृतुपत्रं सुवृत्तं स्याद्वृत्तयुक्तं सबिल्वकम् ..
चत्वारिंशद्द्वयं चैव गगनेन समावृतम् .. 98 ..
text_mt: thirty-six petals, very circular, endowed with circles, along with bilva [leaves]; / twice forty (80), enclosed by the sky,

sanskrit_iast:
śataṃ viṃśādhikaśataṃ dviśataṃ viṃśamuttamam ..
veṣṭanāṃse ca triśataṃ prakramādatha vardhayet .. 99 ..
meaning:
शतं विंशाधिकशतं द्विशतं विंशमुत्तमम् ..
वेष्टनांसे च त्रिशतं प्रक्रमादथ वर्धयेत् .. 99 ..
text_mt: one hundred, one hundred and twenty, an excellent two hundred and twenty; / and at the shoulder of the enclosure three hundred, increasing in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
lavalyābhamatho vakṣye sārddhahastapramāṇataḥ ..
navaviṃśaṃ kalpayettu catuḥsūtrāṇi pātayet .. 2.2.2.100 ..
meaning:
लवल्याभमथो वक्ष्ये सार्द्धहस्तप्रमाणतः ..
नवविंशं कल्पयेत्तु चतुःसूत्राणि पातयेत् .. 2.2.2.100 ..
text_mt: Now I shall declare the Lavalyābha, having the measure of one and a half cubits; / one should fashion twenty-nine, and cast down four threads,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇottarataścaiva tadvadeva vijānīhi ..
