pītena retapuḥṭitā madhye śuklaṃ vibhāvyate .. 101 ..
meaning:
दक्षिणोत्तरतश्चैव तद्वदेव विजानीहि ..
पीतेन रेतपुःटिता मध्ये शुक्लं विभाव्यते .. 101 ..
text_mt: and likewise in the south and north; know it thus. / Enclosed with yellow lines, white is perceived in the middle;

sanskrit_iast:
grahapakṣennapītena madhye raktaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ..
sarvā rekhāśca śuklena pauṣṭike pītamādiśet .. 102 ..
meaning:
ग्रहपक्षेन्नपीतेन मध्ये रक्तं प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
सर्वा रेखाश्च शुक्लेन पौष्टिके पीतमादिशेत् .. 102 ..
text_mt: in the planetary wing, yellow; in the middle, red is established. / All lines are [drawn] in white; in a rite of nourishment one should prescribe yellow;

sanskrit_iast:
saśāṃtike na yoktavyaṃ kāme raktaṃ vinirdiśet ..
madhye tu paṅkajaṃ raktaṃ yugme somasya paṅkajam .. 103 ..
meaning:
सशांतिके न योक्तव्यं कामे रक्तं विनिर्दिशेत् ..
मध्ये तु पङ्कजं रक्तं युग्मे सोमस्य पङ्कजम् .. 103 ..
text_mt: it must not be used in an appeasement rite; in a desire-rite one should prescribe red. / In the middle [is] a red lotus; in the pair, the lotus of Soma;

sanskrit_iast:
śuklavarṇena tatkuryātpītavarṇamudasya ca ..
aiśānyāṃ cottare bhāge guroḥ pītaṃ tu paṅkajam .. 104 ..
meaning:
शुक्लवर्णेन तत्कुर्यात्पीतवर्णमुदस्य च ..
ऐशान्यां चोत्तरे भागे गुरोः पीतं तु पङ्कजम् .. 104 ..
text_mt: one should make that with a white colour, throwing off the yellow colour. / In the north-eastern part, the lotus of Guru is yellow;

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvasyāṃ diśi śukrasya paṅkajaṃ śubhravarṇakam ..
vāruṇe tu śanaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ nairṛtyāṃ dhūmravarṇakam .. 105 ..
meaning:
पूर्वस्यां दिशि शुक्रस्य पङ्कजं शुभ्रवर्णकम् ..
वारुणे तु शनैः कृष्णं नैरृत्यां धूम्रवर्णकम् .. 105 ..
text_mt: in the eastern direction the lotus of Śukra is of a bright white colour; / in the western [direction] the black [lotus] of Śani; in the south-western [direction] a smoke-coloured one

sanskrit_iast:
rāhoḥ prakalpayettacca ketorapi niyojayet ..
vāyavyāṃ diśi saṃyojya paṅkajaṃ vilikhettataḥ .. .. 106 ..
meaning:
राहोः प्रकल्पयेत्तच्च केतोरपि नियोजयेत् ..
वायव्यां दिशि संयोज्य पङ्कजं विलिखेत्ततः .. .. 106 ..
text_mt: one should prepare for Rāhu, and one should assign [it] to Ketu also; / having joined it in the north-western direction, one should then draw the lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
vilome dalasandhīni pūrayatsuvicakṣaṇaḥ ..
bahiḥ pañcarajaiḥ kāryaṃ yuvadurgavibhūṣitam .. 107 ..
meaning:
विलोमे दलसन्धीनि पूरयत्सुविचक्षणः ..
बहिः पञ्चरजैः कार्यं युवदुर्गविभूषितम् .. 107 ..
text_mt: The wise man should fill the intersections of the petals in reverse order. / Outside, it is to be made with five powders, adorned with a young fortress;

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvapaścimadigbhāge śuklaṃ syāddvāradeśataḥ ..
dakṣiṇottaradigbhāge raktameva praśasyate .. 108 ..
meaning:
पूर्वपश्चिमदिग्भागे शुक्लं स्याद्द्वारदेशतः ..
दक्षिणोत्तरदिग्भागे रक्तमेव प्रशस्यते .. 108 ..
text_mt: in the eastern and western quarters it should be white, by the door area; / in the southern and northern quarters red alone is commended.

sanskrit_iast:
tristhāne samamadhye ca dvādaśāṃgulaprakramāt ..
dvihastādāvaṃgulena varddhayettadvibhāgataḥ .. .. 109 ..
meaning:
त्रिस्थाने सममध्ये च द्वादशांगुलप्रक्रमात् ..
द्विहस्तादावंगुलेन वर्द्धयेत्तद्विभागतः .. .. 109 ..
text_mt: In three places, evenly in the middle, by the method of twelve angulas; / starting from two cubits, one should increase [it] by angula according to that division.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcābjamaṇḍalaṃ jñeyaṃ catuḥsvastikabhūṣitam .. 2.2.2.110 ..
mūlyakathanavarṇanam
meaning:
पञ्चाब्जमण्डलं ज्ञेयं चतुःस्वस्तिकभूषितम् .. 2.2.2.110 ..
मूल्यकथनवर्णनम्
text_mt:
This is known as the Pañcābja-maṇḍala, adorned with four svastikas.
Description of the Declaration of Values

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
na kuryāddakṣiṇāhīnaṃ mānahīnaṃ na kārayet ..
amānena hato yajñastasmānmānaṃ praśasyate .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
न कुर्याद्दक्षिणाहीनं मानहीनं न कारयेत् ..
अमानेन हतो यज्ञस्तस्मान्मानं प्रशस्यते .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / One should not perform [a rite] devoid of sacrificial fee, nor make it lacking in proper measure; / a sacrifice is ruined by lack of measure, therefore proper measure is praised.
title: adhyāyaḥ 03

sanskrit_iast:
yasya yajñasya yanmānaṃ tattu tenaiva yojayet ..
amānena kṛte sarve vrajeyurnarakaṃ punaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
यस्य यज्ञस्य यन्मानं तत्तु तेनैव योजयेत् ..
अमानेन कृते सर्वे व्रजेयुर्नरकं पुनः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Whatever is the measure of a given sacrifice, one should furnish it only with that; / if it is performed without proper measure, all [involved] will go to hell again.

sanskrit_iast:
ācāryahotṛbrahmāṇo vidhijñaḥ sahakartṛkaḥ ..
yasya yajñe pāpakaśca jātihīnaḥ praveśayet .. 3 ..
meaning:
आचार्यहोतृब्रह्माणो विधिज्ञः सहकर्तृकः ..
यस्य यज्ञे पापकश्च जातिहीनः प्रवेशयेत् .. 3 ..
text_mt: The preceptor, the hotṛ, and the brahmā [priests] should know the rules, along with the patron. / In whose sacrifice a sinful and low-caste person enters,

sanskrit_iast:
aśītibhirvarāṭaiśca paṇa ityabhidhīyate ..
taistu ṣoḍaśabhirjñeyaṃ purāṇaṃ saptabhistu taiḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
अशीतिभिर्वराटैश्च पण इत्यभिधीयते ..
तैस्तु षोडशभिर्ज्ञेयं पुराणं सप्तभिस्तु तैः .. 4 ..
text_mt: By eighty cowries a paṇa is named; / by sixteen of those a purāṇa is known; by seven of those,

sanskrit_iast:
rājataiścāṣṭabhiḥ svarṇaṃ yajñādau dakṣiṇā smṛtā ..
mahārāme dvisauvarṇaṃ kūpe svarṇārdhameva ca .. 5 ..
meaning:
राजतैश्चाष्टभिः स्वर्णं यज्ञादौ दक्षिणा स्मृता ..
महारामे द्विसौवर्णं कूपे स्वर्णार्धमेव च .. 5 ..
text_mt: and by eight of silver, a suvarṇa; [this] is remembered as the sacrificial fee in a sacrifice and other [rites]. / In a great grove [consecration] two gold coins; and at a well half a gold coin;

sanskrit_iast:
tulasyāmalakīyāge suvarṇaikaṃ pracakṣate ..
yakṛlloke ca sauvarṇaṃ lakṣe svarṇaṃ catuṣṭayam .. 6 ..
meaning:
तुलस्यामलकीयागे सुवर्णैकं प्रचक्षते ..
यकृल्लोके च सौवर्णं लक्षे स्वर्णं चतुष्टयम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: at a sacrifice to Tulasī and Āmalakī they declare one gold coin; / among common people a gold coin, and at a lakṣa [recitation/homa] four gold coins;

sanskrit_iast:
navame koṭihome ca devatānāṃ ca sthāpane ..
prāsādasya samutsarge aṣṭādaśa suvarṇakāḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
नवमे कोटिहोमे च देवतानां च स्थापने ..
प्रासादस्य समुत्सर्गे अष्टादश सुवर्णकाः .. 7 ..
text_mt: in the ninth [rite], at a koṭi-homa, and at the installation of deities, / and at the dedication of a temple: eighteen gold coins;

sanskrit_iast:
taḍāge puṣkariṇyāṃ ca ardhārdhaṃ pari kīrtitam ..
mahādāne ca dīkṣāyāṃ vṛṣotsarge ca sattamāḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
तडागे पुष्करिण्यां च अर्धार्धं परि कीर्तितम् ..
महादाने च दीक्षायां वृषोत्सर्गे च सत्तमाः .. 8 ..
text_mt: at a pond and at a lotus-pool, half of half is proclaimed; / in a great gift, at initiation, and at the release of a bull, O best of men;

sanskrit_iast:
jīvataśca vṛṣotsarge gayāśrāddhe tathaiva ca ..
avittasādhyamānena yajñaṃ kuryātkalauyuge .. 9 ..
meaning:
जीवतश्च वृषोत्सर्गे गयाश्राद्धे तथैव च ..
अवित्तसाध्यमानेन यज्ञं कुर्यात्कलौयुगे .. 9 ..
text_mt: and at the release of a bull during lifetime, likewise at the Gayā-śrāddha: / in the Kali age one should perform sacrifice by the measure attainable without [great] wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
daṃpatyośca vṛṣotsarge mānamekamudāhṛtam ..
bahubhiḥ kiyamāṇopi yāga eko mahottamaiḥ .. 2.2.3.10 ..
meaning:
दंपत्योश्च वृषोत्सर्गे मानमेकमुदाहृतम् ..
बहुभिः कियमाणोपि याग एको महोत्तमैः .. 2.2.3.10 ..
text_mt: And for a married couple releasing a bull, a single measure is declared; / even if performed by many, a sacrifice is one, O most eminent ones.

sanskrit_iast:
rājñaḥ karagrahe caiva dīkṣāyāṃ dāna karmaṇi ..
aśītirattikaṃ svarṇaṃ śravaṇe bhāratasya ca .. 11 ..
meaning:
राज्ञः करग्रहे चैव दीक्षायां दान कर्मणि ..
अशीतिरत्तिकं स्वर्णं श्रवणे भारतस्य च .. 11 ..
text_mt: At a king's marriage, at initiation, and in an act of giving, / and at the hearing of the Mahābhārata, [the fee is] gold of eighty rattis;

sanskrit_iast:
grahayāge pratiṣṭhāyāṃ suvarṇaśatarattikaḥ ..
lakṣahome cāyute ca koṭyāmeva vidhīyate .. .. 12 ..
meaning:
ग्रहयागे प्रतिष्ठायां सुवर्णशतरत्तिकः ..
लक्षहोमे चायुते च कोट्यामेव विधीयते .. .. 12 ..
text_mt: in a planetary sacrifice and in a consecration, a gold coin of a hundred rattis; / in a hundred-thousand oblation, in a ten-thousand oblation, and in a ten-million [oblation] it is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
devānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca dānaṃ yasya prakalpitam ..
tasyaiva deyaṃ taddānaṃ sāṃgopāṃgaṃ sadakṣiṇam .. 13 ..
meaning:
देवानां ब्राह्मणानां च दानं यस्य प्रकल्पितम् ..
तस्यैव देयं तद्दानं सांगोपांगं सदक्षिणम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: A gift that is intended for gods and Brahmins / must be given to that very one, complete with all its limbs and secondary parts, along with a sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast:
nānāsya kiñciddātavyaṃ saṃgabhaṃgo bhavedyataḥ ..
gṛhī tu kṛtvā yaddānaṃ tadā tasya ṛṇī bhavet .. 14 ..
meaning:
नानास्य किञ्चिद्दातव्यं संगभंगो भवेद्यतः ..
गृही तु कृत्वा यद्दानं तदा तस्य ऋणी भवेत् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Nothing of this should be withheld, because [otherwise] a rupture of the rite occurs; / but a householder who makes a gift, [if not giving the fee], becomes his debtor.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñeṣu home yaddravyaṃ kāṣṭhamājyādikaṃ ca yat ..
tannāyakasya pūjāyāṃ dravyamāhurvinirmitam .. 15 ..
meaning:
यज्ञेषु होमे यद्द्रव्यं काष्ठमाज्यादिकं च यत् ..
तन्नायकस्य पूजायां द्रव्यमाहुर्विनिर्मितम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: Whatever substance—wood, clarified butter, and so forth—is [used] in sacrificial oblations, / they say that substance was produced for the worship of its presiding deity.

sanskrit_iast:
anādidevatārcāyāṃ pūjāsnānādikarmaṇi ..
yasyārhaṇādikaṃ dravyaṃ tasya devasya tadbhavet .. 16 ..
meaning:
अनादिदेवतार्चायां पूजास्नानादिकर्मणि ..
यस्यार्हणादिकं द्रव्यं तस्य देवस्य तद्भवेत् .. 16 ..
text_mt: In the worship of beginningless deities, in rites such as worship and bathing, / the substance intended for honouring and the like belongs to that deity.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyakṣaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādyajñadānavratādike ..
adakṣiṇaṃ naiva kāryaṃ prakuryādbhūridakṣiṇam .. 17 ..
meaning:
प्रत्यक्षं दक्षिणां दद्याद्यज्ञदानव्रतादिके ..
अदक्षिणं नैव कार्यं प्रकुर्याद्भूरिदक्षिणम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: One should give a sacrificial fee directly in rites such as sacrifices, gifts, and votive observances; / [a rite] should never be performed without a sacrificial fee; one should provide an abundant sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast:
ato dattaṃ purā dattaṃ dātavyaṃ caiva saṃprati ..
parasvodārabuddhīnāṃ sā sā hi dakṣiṇā bhavet .. 18 ..
meaning:
अतो दत्तं पुरा दत्तं दातव्यं चैव संप्रति ..
परस्वोदारबुद्धीनां सा सा हि दक्षिणा भवेत् .. 18 ..
text_mt: Therefore, what was given formerly, and what is to be given now— / for those of generous mind regarding others' property, that indeed becomes the sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast:
dattāni vidhivatpuṃsāṃ devadānāni yāni hi ..
dāsīdāsagavādīni manasā yāni karhi cit .. 19 ..
meaning:
दत्तानि विधिवत्पुंसां देवदानानि यानि हि ..
दासीदासगवादीनि मनसा यानि कर्हि चित् .. 19 ..
text_mt: The divine gifts given according to rule by men, / such as female and male slaves, cattle, and the like, which were ever [intended] in the mind—

sanskrit_iast:
dātavyānyapi tānyeva kārayetparivarttanam ..
ekasyānekadānaṃ ca dadetkaścitpṛthakpṛthak .. 2.2.3.20 ..
meaning:
दातव्यान्यपि तान्येव कारयेत्परिवर्त्तनम् ..
एकस्यानेकदानं च ददेत्कश्चित्पृथक्पृथक् .. 2.2.3.20 ..
text_mt: even those must be given, [or] one should cause an exchange; / and one may give multiple gifts for one [obligation], severally.

sanskrit_iast:
varaṇaṃ ca kadā kuryāttantre kuryācca dakṣiṇām ..
ratnasya dakṣiṇā deyā kāṃcanaṃ samudāhṛtam .. 21 ..
meaning:
वरणं च कदा कुर्यात्तन्त्रे कुर्याच्च दक्षिणाम् ..
रत्नस्य दक्षिणा देया कांचनं समुदाहृतम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: And when should one make the formal appointment? One should give the sacrificial fee in the ritual procedure: / for a gem, gold is declared to be the sacrificial fee to be given;

sanskrit_iast:
kāṃcanasya bhavedraupyaṃ raupye kāṃcanamudviśet ..
bhūmerbhūmirdakṣiṇā syādvastrasya vastradakṣiṇā .. 22 ..
meaning:
कांचनस्य भवेद्रौप्यं रौप्ये कांचनमुद्विशेत् ..
भूमेर्भूमिर्दक्षिणा स्याद्वस्त्रस्य वस्त्रदक्षिणा .. 22 ..
text_mt: for gold, there should be silver; for silver, one should designate gold; / for land, the sacrificial fee should be land; for cloth, the sacrificial fee is cloth;

sanskrit_iast:
pānīyasya tu pānīyaṃ vrīhīṇāṃ vrīhidakṣiṇā ..
gajasya dakṣiṇā chāgo hyaśvasya meṣa īritaḥ .. ..23..
meaning:
पानीयस्य तु पानीयं व्रीहीणां व्रीहिदक्षिणा ..
गजस्य दक्षिणा छागो ह्यश्वस्य मेष ईरितः .. ..23..
text_mt: for water, indeed, water; for rice, the sacrificial fee is rice; / for an elephant, the sacrificial fee is a goat; for a horse, a ram is declared;

sanskrit_iast:
paśūnāṃ ca catuṣpādā devasya devadakṣiṇā ..
yajño mānasya ṣaḍbhāgo dviguṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
पशूनां च चतुष्पादा देवस्य देवदक्षिणा ..
यज्ञो मानस्य षड्भागो द्विगुणः परिकीर्तितः .. 24 ..
text_mt: and for animals, four-footed [beasts]; for a god, a divine sacrificial fee; / the sacrifice is proclaimed to be a sixth part of the standard, doubled.

sanskrit_iast:
ācāryasyaiva bhāgaikaṃ yajamānaḥ pradāsyati ..
pāpakaistu kalatrāṇāṃ bhāgaikaṃ tadanaṃtaram .. 25 ..
meaning:
आचार्यस्यैव भागैकं यजमानः प्रदास्यति ..
पापकैस्तु कलत्राणां भागैकं तदनंतरम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: The patron of the sacrifice shall give one share to the preceptor alone; / thereafter, along with sinful ones, one share to the wives;

sanskrit_iast:
pātrāṇāmṛtvigādīnāṃ bhāgatrayamudāhṛtam ..
sarvasattvasya bhāgaikaṃ svalpaṃ cecchiṣṭagauravāt ..26.ḥ
ācāryādyaṃśataḥ kaścitkṣīṇavittaṃ samāharet ..
amūlyaṃ vargamūlyaṃ yadbhavedvai dakṣiṇottamā .. 27 ..
meaning:
पात्राणामृत्विगादीनां भागत्रयमुदाहृतम् ..
सर्वसत्त्वस्य भागैकं स्वल्पं चेच्छिष्टगौरवात् ..26.ः
आचार्याद्यंशतः कश्चित्क्षीणवित्तं समाहरेत् ..
अमूल्यं वर्गमूल्यं यद्भवेद्वै दक्षिणोत्तमा .. 27 ..
text_mt: three shares are declared for worthy recipients such as the officiating priests; / one share is for all living beings, or small out of respect for what remains. / From the portion of the preceptor and others, one may make up for deficient wealth; / that which is priceless or the value of the class indeed becomes the highest sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast:
mānāśaktau tu yajñānāṃ yaddeyaṃ yajñasiddhaye ..
devatā pustakaṃ ratnaṃ gāvo dhānyaṃ tilāstathā ..28..
meaning:
मानाशक्तौ तु यज्ञानां यद्देयं यज्ञसिद्धये ..
देवता पुस्तकं रत्नं गावो धान्यं तिलास्तथा ..28..
text_mt: When unable to meet the standard of sacrifices, what should be given for the success of the sacrifice: / a deity, a book, a jewel, cattle, grain, and sesame seeds,

sanskrit_iast:
nameruphalapuṣpāṇi deyānyetāni sarvataḥ ..
catuścakrāṃkito yastu sāṃdro vṛtto janārdanaḥ ..29..
meaning:
नमेरुफलपुष्पाणि देयान्येतानि सर्वतः ..
चतुश्चक्रांकितो यस्तु सांद्रो वृत्तो जनार्दनः ..29..
text_mt: nameru fruits and flowers—these are to be given everywhere; / that which is marked with four discs, solid, and round is Janārdana;

sanskrit_iast:
devatāpratimādyaṃ ca śironābhistathaiva ca ..
śvetaliṃgaṃ ratnaliṃgamindranīlādikaṃ ca yat ..2.2.3.30..
meaning:
देवताप्रतिमाद्यं च शिरोनाभिस्तथैव च ..
श्वेतलिंगं रत्नलिंगमिन्द्रनीलादिकं च यत् ..2.2.3.30..
text_mt: an image of a deity and so forth, as well as the head and navel, / a white liṅga, a jeweled liṅga, and what is sapphire and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāvartaśaṃkhaṃ ca harivaṃśastathā khilaḥ ..
kapilo nīlavṛṣabhaḥ somadhānyaṃ tathaiva ca .. 31 ..
meaning:
दक्षिणावर्तशंखं च हरिवंशस्तथा खिलः ..
कपिलो नीलवृषभः सोमधान्यं तथैव च .. 31 ..
text_mt: a right-spiraling conch, and the entire Harivaṃśa, / a tawny [cow], a blue bull, and likewise somadhānya grain:

sanskrit_iast:
amūlyānyāhuretāni dattvānantaphalāni ca ..
svarṇapādo bhavenmūlyaṃ śālagrāmasya dakṣiṇā .. 32 ..
meaning:
अमूल्यान्याहुरेतानि दत्त्वानन्तफलानि च ..
स्वर्णपादो भवेन्मूल्यं शालग्रामस्य दक्षिणा .. 32 ..
text_mt: these they call priceless, yielding endless fruit when given; / a quarter-share of gold should be the value, the sacrificial fee for a śālagrāma stone;

sanskrit_iast:
kṣudraliṃge svarṇamūlyaṃ pādārdhaṃ śrīdharepi ca ..
anantonantamityuktaṃ pādārdhaṃ bāṇaliṅgake .. 33 ..
meaning:
क्षुद्रलिंगे स्वर्णमूल्यं पादार्धं श्रीधरेपि च ..
अनन्तोनन्तमित्युक्तं पादार्धं बाणलिङ्गके .. 33 ..
text_mt: for a small liṅga, the value is gold, and half a quarter-share for a śrīdhara; / ananta is said to be endless; half a quarter-share for a bāṇaliṅga;

sanskrit_iast:
yathā pustakamātreṇa svarṇa pādārdhamiṣyate ..
jyotiṣerdhaṃ suvarṇasya rajatārdhaṃ vṛṣe tathā .. 34 ..
meaning:
यथा पुस्तकमात्रेण स्वर्ण पादार्धमिष्यते ..
ज्योतिषेर्धं सुवर्णस्य रजतार्धं वृषे तथा .. 34 ..
text_mt: for a book alone, half a quarter-share of gold is desired; / for Jyotiṣa, half a suvarṇa, and likewise half a silver [piece] for a bull;

sanskrit_iast:
harivaṃśe ślokaśate svarṇamekaṃ prakīrtitam ..
dharmaśāstrasya sāhasre rajatatrayamīritam.. 35 ..
meaning:
हरिवंशे श्लोकशते स्वर्णमेकं प्रकीर्तितम् ..
धर्मशास्त्रस्य साहस्रे रजतत्रयमीरितम्.. 35 ..
text_mt: for a hundred verses of the Harivaṃśa, one gold [coin] is proclaimed; / for a thousand [verses] of the Dharmaśāstra, three silver [coins] are declared;

sanskrit_iast:
kapilāyāṃ suvarṇārdhaṃ dhenumātre purāṇakam ..
prāyaścittavidhau jñeyaṃ dhenumātraṃ purāṇakam .. 36 ..
meaning:
कपिलायां सुवर्णार्धं धेनुमात्रे पुराणकम् ..
प्रायश्चित्तविधौ ज्ञेयं धेनुमात्रं पुराणकम् .. 36 ..
text_mt: for a tawny cow, half a suvarṇa; for an ordinary cow, a purāṇa; / in the rule of expiation, an ordinary cow is known to be a purāṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇatritayaṃ cānye vīryahīne dvayaṃ bhavet ..
kṛṣṇe vṛṣe ṣaṭpurāṇaṃ śvete navapurāṇakam ..37..
meaning:
पुराणत्रितयं चान्ये वीर्यहीने द्वयं भवेत् ..
कृष्णे वृषे षट्पुराणं श्वेते नवपुराणकम् ..37..
text_mt: and three purāṇas for another, [or] there should be two for one lacking vigor; / for a black bull, six purāṇas; for a white, nine purāṇas;

sanskrit_iast:
dvātriṃśacca purāṇaṃ syādvṛṣe nīle tathaiva ca ..
nameroḥ praticakre ca dvādaśa svarṇarattikāḥ .. .. 38 ..
meaning:
द्वात्रिंशच्च पुराणं स्याद्वृषे नीले तथैव च ..
नमेरोः प्रतिचक्रे च द्वादश स्वर्णरत्तिकाः .. .. 38 ..
text_mt: and there should be thirty-two purāṇas for a blue bull; / and for each disc of a nameru, twelve golden rattikās;

sanskrit_iast:
mūlyaṃ śrīphalamātre'pi purāṇatritayaṃ bhavet ..
paṅktyāpi turyakaṃ vivātkalau paṇavyavasthayā .. 39 ..
meaning:
मूल्यं श्रीफलमात्रेऽपि पुराणत्रितयं भवेत् ..
पङ्क्त्यापि तुर्यकं विवात्कलौ पणव्यवस्थया .. 39 ..
text_mt: for an ordinary śrīphala, the value should be three purāṇas; / even by a row, one fourth [...], according to the regulation of paṇas in the Kali age;

sanskrit_iast:
dhātrīphalasya pratyekaṃ bhavedrajatamā ṣakam ..
etānyāhuḥ praśastāni mūlayoge paraṃ viduḥ .. 2.2.3.40 .. ..
mūlyadānavarṇanam
meaning:
धात्रीफलस्य प्रत्येकं भवेद्रजतमा षकम् ..
एतान्याहुः प्रशस्तानि मूलयोगे परं विदुः .. 2.2.3.40 .. ..
मूल्यदानवर्णनम्
text_mt:
for an emblic myrobalan fruit, each should be a silver māṣaka; / these they call praiseworthy; they know the supreme in the employment of roots.
Description of the Gift of Values

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
pūrṇapātramatho vakṣye yajñe sādhāraṇe'pi ca ..
kāmahome bhavenmuṣṭirmuṣṭayoṣṭau tu kuñcikā .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
पूर्णपात्रमथो वक्ष्ये यज्ञे साधारणेऽपि च ..
कामहोमे भवेन्मुष्टिर्मुष्टयोष्टौ तु कुञ्चिका .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Now I shall declare the full vessel, even in an ordinary sacrifice: / in an optional oblation, there should be a handful, and eight handfuls are a kuñcikā;
title: adhyāyaḥ 04

sanskrit_iast:
ekaika kuñcimānena kuryātpātrāṇi vai sadā ..
pātrāṇi ca pṛthakkṛtvā sthāpayeddvāradeśataḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
एकैक कुञ्चिमानेन कुर्यात्पात्राणि वै सदा ..
पात्राणि च पृथक्कृत्वा स्थापयेद्द्वारदेशतः .. 2 ..
text_mt: one should always make vessels with the measure of each single kuñci; / having made the vessels separate, one should place them at the doorway.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhānāṃ khaḍgadhārāṇāṃ pratyekasya dinakramāt ..
tatraiva dadyā nnānyatra na kuryādvyatyayaṃ kvacit .. 3 ..
meaning:
सिद्धानां खड्गधाराणां प्रत्येकस्य दिनक्रमात् ..
तत्रैव दद्या न्नान्यत्र न कुर्याद्व्यत्ययं क्वचित् .. 3 ..
text_mt: For perfected ones bearing swords, for each in daily order, / one should give right there, not elsewhere; one should never make a transposition anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇḍānāṃ kuḍmalānāṃ ca vedanaṃ yādṛśaṃ śṛṇu ..
caturasrapadasyāpi raupyārdhaṃ ca kalau yuge .. 4 ..
meaning:
कुण्डानां कुड्मलानां च वेदनं यादृशं शृणु ..
चतुरस्रपदस्यापि रौप्यार्धं च कलौ युगे .. 4 ..
text_mt: Hear what the wage is for sacrificial pits and buds: / even for a square space, half a silver [coin] in the Kali age;

sanskrit_iast:
dve raupye sarvatobhadre krauñcaghrāṇe caturthakam..
mahāsiṃhāsane pañca daśapātre tadardhakam .. 5 ..
meaning:
द्वे रौप्ये सर्वतोभद्रे क्रौञ्चघ्राणे चतुर्थकम्..
महासिंहासने पञ्च दशपात्रे तदर्धकम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: two silver [coins] for a sarvatobhadra; a fourth for a krauñca's beak; / five for a great throne; half of that for a ten-vessel;

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrāre merupṛṣṭhe turyaraupyavṛṣādhikam ..
vṛṣe gale ca vṛṣabhaṃ śeṣe raupyasahasrakam .. 6 ..
meaning:
सहस्रारे मेरुपृष्ठे तुर्यरौप्यवृषाधिकम् ..
वृषे गले च वृषभं शेषे रौप्यसहस्रकम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: for a thousand-spoked one on the back of Meru, a fourth silver [coin] plus a bull; / on a bull and on a neck, a bull; on the remainder, a thousand silver [coins];

sanskrit_iast:
caturasrasya nirmāṇe svarṇapādaḥ kalau yuge ..
mahākuṇḍe tu dviguṇaṃ vṛtte raupyaṃ nivedayet .. 7 ..
meaning:
चतुरस्रस्य निर्माणे स्वर्णपादः कलौ युगे ..
महाकुण्डे तु द्विगुणं वृत्ते रौप्यं निवेदयेत् .. 7 ..
text_mt: in the construction of a square one, a quarter of gold in the Kali age; / in a great sacrificial pit, double that; in a round one, one should present silver;

sanskrit_iast:
padmakuṇḍe tu vṛṣabhamardha candre tu raupyakam ..
yonikuṇḍe dadeddhenumaṣṭārdhasvarṇamāṣakam .. 8 ..
meaning:
पद्मकुण्डे तु वृषभमर्ध चन्द्रे तु रौप्यकम् ..
योनिकुण्डे ददेद्धेनुमष्टार्धस्वर्णमाषकम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: in a lotus sacrificial pit, a bull; in a crescent-shaped one, a silver [coin]; / in a vulva-shaped sacrificial pit, one should give a cow, [or] four golden māṣakas;

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍasre tu tadardhaṃ syādyāge māṣadvayaṃ bhavet ..
śaive codyāpane caiva pratyahnā svarṇamāṣakam .. 9 ..
meaning:
षडस्रे तु तदर्धं स्याद्यागे माषद्वयं भवेत् ..
शैवे चोद्यापने चैव प्रत्यह्ना स्वर्णमाषकम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: in a hexagonal one, it should be half of that; in a sacrifice, it should be two māṣakas; / in a Śaiva concluding rite, a golden māṣaka per day;

sanskrit_iast:
dāraṇe hastamātraṃ syātsvarṇakṛṣṇakalaṃ bhavet ..
iṣṭikākaraṇe caiva pratyahnā syātpaṇadvayam .. 2.2.4.10 ..
meaning:
दारणे हस्तमात्रं स्यात्स्वर्णकृष्णकलं भवेत् ..
इष्टिकाकरणे चैव प्रत्यह्ना स्यात्पणद्वयम् .. 2.2.4.10 ..
text_mt: in splitting, for one cubit it should be a gold kṛṣṇakala; / and in the making of bricks, it should be two paṇas per day;

sanskrit_iast:
khaṇḍe daśavarāṭaṃ syādbṛ hanmāne tu kākiṇī ..
taḍāge puṣkariṇyāṃ ca khanane prathamāṃgake .. 11 ..
meaning:
खण्डे दशवराटं स्याद्बृ हन्माने तु काकिणी ..
तडागे पुष्करिण्यां च खनने प्रथमांगके .. 11 ..
text_mt: in a piece, it should be ten cowries; in a large measure, a kākiṇī; / in a tank and in a lotus-pool, in digging the first section,

sanskrit_iast:
saptahastamite kuṇḍe niṣṭhe ābaddhamātrakam ..
purāṇasya ca ekāṃśaṃ vetanaṃ parikīrtitam .. 12 ..
meaning:
सप्तहस्तमिते कुण्डे निष्ठे आबद्धमात्रकम् ..
पुराणस्य च एकांशं वेतनं परिकीर्तितम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: in a sacrificial pit measuring seven cubits, when completed and enclosed, / one part of a purāṇa is declared to be the wage;

sanskrit_iast:
vardhayetpaṇamātreṇa nimne patre ca prakramāt ..
bṛhatkūpasya nirmāṇe pratyahaṃ ca paṇadvayam .. 13 ..
meaning:
वर्धयेत्पणमात्रेण निम्ने पत्रे च प्रक्रमात् ..
बृहत्कूपस्य निर्माणे प्रत्यहं च पणद्वयम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: one should increase [it] by merely a paṇa in the lower part and in order; / in the construction of a large well, two paṇas each day;

sanskrit_iast:
śaile jñeyaṃ kāñcanasya rattikā gṛhakarmaṇi..
koṣṭhe jñeyaṃ sārddhapaṇaṃ raṃgādiracite paṇam..14..
meaning:
शैले ज्ञेयं काञ्चनस्य रत्तिका गृहकर्मणि..
कोष्ठे ज्ञेयं सार्द्धपणं रंगादिरचिते पणम्..14..
text_mt: in stone, a rattikā of gold should be known; in house construction, / in a storehouse, a paṇa and a half should be known; in one decorated with colors and the like, a paṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkṣāṇāṃ ropaṇe dadyātpratyahnā sārdhamāṣakam ..
setubaṃdhe ca paṃkile ca paṇadvayaṃ ca kākiṇī .. 15 ..
meaning:
वृक्षाणां रोपणे दद्यात्प्रत्यह्ना सार्धमाषकम् ..
सेतुबंधे च पंकिले च पणद्वयं च काकिणी .. 15 ..
text_mt: in the planting of trees, one should give a māṣaka and a half each day; / in dam-building and in muddy ground, two paṇas and a kākiṇī;

sanskrit_iast:
paṇepaṇe tu tāmrasya dadyātpaṇacatuṣṭayam ..
ghaṭane kāṃsyasīsānāṃ paṇatrayamudāhṛtam .. 16 ..
meaning:
पणेपणे तु ताम्रस्य दद्यात्पणचतुष्टयम् ..
घटने कांस्यसीसानां पणत्रयमुदाहृतम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: for every paṇa of copper, one should give four paṇas; / in the fashioning of bronze and lead, three paṇas are declared;

sanskrit_iast:
atha vā dinasaṃkhyānaṃ paṇaikaṃ ca sakākiṇi ..
suvarṇasya paṇaike tu purāṇaṃ ratnakuṭṭime .. 17 ..
meaning:
अथ वा दिनसंख्यानं पणैकं च सकाकिणि ..
सुवर्णस्य पणैके तु पुराणं रत्नकुट्टिमे .. 17 ..
text_mt: or the daily calculation is one paṇa with a kākiṇī; / for one paṇa of gold, a purāṇa; on a pavement of jewels.

sanskrit_iast:
rajate tu tadardhaṃ syātsphaṭikasya ca dāraṇe ..
dinasaṃkhyāpaṇadvaṃdvaṃ ratnānāmatha kuḍmalam.. 18 ..
meaning:
रजते तु तदर्धं स्यात्स्फटिकस्य च दारणे ..
दिनसंख्यापणद्वंद्वं रत्नानामथ कुड्मलम्.. 18 ..
text_mt: For silver it should be half of that, and for cutting crystal / the count of days is two paṇas, and likewise for buds of gems.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇivedhe maṇau jñeyaṃ kākiṇī parikīrtitā ..
caturvarāṭamadhikaṃ sphāṭike maṇivedhane .. 19 ..
meaning:
मणिवेधे मणौ ज्ञेयं काकिणी परिकीर्तिता ..
चतुर्वराटमधिकं स्फाटिके मणिवेधने .. 19 ..
text_mt: For perforating a jewel, one should know that a kākiṇī is prescribed for each jewel; / four cowries more for perforating a crystal bead.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṃsyatālasya nirmāṇe dhamane tu paṇatrayam ..
lākṣānirmāṇake kārye tadardhamapi kīrtitam..2.2.4.20..
meaning:
कांस्यतालस्य निर्माणे धमने तु पणत्रयम् ..
लाक्षानिर्माणके कार्ये तदर्धमपि कीर्तितम्..2.2.4.20..
text_mt: In fashioning a bell-metal cymbal, three paṇas are prescribed for melting; / in the work of making lac, half of that is stated.

sanskrit_iast:
gavāṃ ca dohane caiva varāṭe turyavetanam..
vetane vastranirmāṇe patre hastapaṇatrayam ..21..
meaning:
गवां च दोहने चैव वराटे तुर्यवेतनम्..
वेतने वस्त्रनिर्माणे पत्रे हस्तपणत्रयम् ..21..
text_mt: And for milking cows, the wage is a quarter of a cowrie; / as a wage for making cloth, three paṇas per cubit on the piece.

sanskrit_iast:
avivastrasya nirmāṇe syaṃdanaṃ daśakākiṇī ..
pidhānavastranirmāṇe tripaṇaṃ parikīrtitam .. 22 ..
meaning:
अविवस्त्रस्य निर्माणे स्यंदनं दशकाकिणी ..
पिधानवस्त्रनिर्माणे त्रिपणं परिकीर्तितम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: In making woolen cloth, the rolling is ten kākiṇīs; / in making covering-cloth, three paṇas are proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
daśa kākiṇī ūrdhvādhastadvyaye paṇyavetanam ..
vaṃśājīvasya pratyahnā paṇasyārdhe sakākiṇi .. 23 ..
meaning:
दश काकिणी ऊर्ध्वाधस्तद्व्यये पण्यवेतनम् ..
वंशाजीवस्य प्रत्यह्ना पणस्यार्धे सकाकिणि .. 23 ..
text_mt: Above and below ten kākiṇīs, upon those expenses is the merchant's fee; / for a bamboo-worker, daily, half a paṇa with a kākiṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
lohakārasya ca tathā nāpitasya ca vetanam ..
śirasā tasya vapane vijñeyā daśa kākiṇī .. 24 ..
meaning:
लोहकारस्य च तथा नापितस्य च वेतनम् ..
शिरसा तस्य वपने विज्ञेया दश काकिणी .. 24 ..
text_mt: And likewise is the wage of a blacksmith and a barber: / for shaving the head, ten kākiṇīs should be known.

sanskrit_iast:
saśmaśrunakhamāne tu pradadyātkākiṇīdvayam ..
nārīṇāmatha saṃskāre nakhacitrādirañjane .. 25 ..
meaning:
सश्मश्रुनखमाने तु प्रदद्यात्काकिणीद्वयम् ..
नारीणामथ संस्कारे नखचित्रादिरञ्जने .. 25 ..
text_mt: For trimming beard and nails, one should give two kākiṇīs; / and in adorning women, painting their nails and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
sakākiṇi paṇaṃ tacca savitre ca payodhare ..
paṇānāṃ turyakaṃ dadyātsīmaṃtasyālake tathā .. 26 ..
meaning:
सकाकिणि पणं तच्च सवित्रे च पयोधरे ..
पणानां तुर्यकं दद्यात्सीमंतस्यालके तथा .. 26 ..
text_mt: one paṇa along with a kākiṇī; and on the breast with the sun, / one should give a quarter of a paṇa, and likewise on the part of the hair and the lock.

sanskrit_iast:
padacitre tu sārddhaṃ syādgrīvāṇāṃ guhyadhāraṇe ..
dhānyānāṃ ropaṇe caiva dinaike paṇa vetanam .. 27 ..
meaning:
पदचित्रे तु सार्द्धं स्याद्ग्रीवाणां गुह्यधारणे ..
धान्यानां रोपणे चैव दिनैके पण वेतनम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: For painting the feet, it should be one and a half; for decorating the necks and hidden parts; / and for planting grains, the wage is one paṇa for a single day.

sanskrit_iast:
lavaṇe tu tathā deyā guvākānāṃ ca ropaṇe ..
daṇḍapatrasya saṃskāre maricānāṃ tathaiva ca .. 28 ..
meaning:
लवणे तु तथा देया गुवाकानां च रोपणे ..
दण्डपत्रस्य संस्कारे मरिचानां तथैव च .. 28 ..
text_mt: Likewise it should be given for harvesting and for planting betel-nut trees; / in dressing the stem and leaf, and likewise of black pepper,

sanskrit_iast:
paṇadvayaṃ varāṭānāmadhikaṃ daśameva tu ..
halehale paṇaikaṃ syātkākiṇyadhikameva ca .. 29 ..
meaning:
पणद्वयं वराटानामधिकं दशमेव तु ..
हलेहले पणैकं स्यात्काकिण्यधिकमेव च .. 29 ..
text_mt: two paṇas, with an addition of ten cowries; / for each plow, it should be one paṇa and an additional kākiṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
paṇatrayaṃ cakrapaṇe mahiṣāṇāṃ paṇādhikam ..
narāṇāṃ vāhane caiva paṇaikaṃ daśa kākiṇī .. 2.2.4.30 ..
meaning:
पणत्रयं चक्रपणे महिषाणां पणाधिकम् ..
नराणां वाहने चैव पणैकं दश काकिणी .. 2.2.4.30 ..
text_mt: Three paṇas for a wheel-toll; for buffaloes, one paṇa more; / and for carrying men, one paṇa and ten kākiṇīs.

sanskrit_iast:
dāsīnāṃ gardabhānāṃ ca adhikaṃ kākiṇīdvayāt ..
kṣālane cāpi vastrasya tailakṣāravivarjite .. 31 ..
meaning:
दासीनां गर्दभानां च अधिकं काकिणीद्वयात् ..
क्षालने चापि वस्त्रस्य तैलक्षारविवर्जिते .. 31 ..
text_mt: For female servants and donkeys, two kākiṇīs more; / and for washing cloth free of oil and alkaline salt,

sanskrit_iast:
vastre pratipaṇaṃ dadyāddīrghe prasthe'pi vardhayet ..
sadyaḥ prakṣālane'pyardhaṃ dinādāvadhikaṃ bhaved .. 32 ..
meaning:
वस्त्रे प्रतिपणं दद्याद्दीर्घे प्रस्थेऽपि वर्धयेत् ..
सद्यः प्रक्षालनेऽप्यर्धं दिनादावधिकं भवेद् .. 32 ..
text_mt: one should give a paṇa per cloth; for one that is long and wide, one should increase [it]; / even for immediate washing, it should be half more at the beginning of the day.

sanskrit_iast:
śvetavastre bhavennyūnaṃ pade sūkṣme ca varddhayet ..
mṛttikānāṃ samuddhāraṃ kuddāle cekṣupīḍane .. 33 ..
meaning:
श्वेतवस्त्रे भवेन्न्यूनं पदे सूक्ष्मे च वर्द्धयेत् ..
मृत्तिकानां समुद्धारं कुद्दाले चेक्षुपीडने .. 33 ..
text_mt: For white cloth it should be less; for fine foot-cloth one should increase [it]; / for digging up earth with a spade, and for pressing sugarcane,

sanskrit_iast:
vetanaṃ puṣpasaṃskāre sahasraṃ daśakākiṇī ..
kākiṇī sraṅnibaddhe ca dviguṇaṃ kaṇṭhamālikā .. 34 ..
meaning:
वेतनं पुष्पसंस्कारे सहस्रं दशकाकिणी ..
काकिणी स्रङ्निबद्धे च द्विगुणं कण्ठमालिका .. 34 ..
text_mt: the wage for preparing flowers is ten kākiṇīs per thousand; / a kākiṇī for a tied garland, and double for a neck-garland.

sanskrit_iast:
abaddhe dvyaṃgulaṃ yāvanmuṇḍamālā prakīrtitā ..
hastatraye kaṇṭhamālā ānābhi kamalāvadhi .. 35 ..
meaning:
अबद्धे द्व्यंगुलं यावन्मुण्डमाला प्रकीर्तिता ..
हस्तत्रये कण्ठमाला आनाभि कमलावधि .. 35 ..
text_mt: Untied, up to two finger-breadths, it is termed a head-garland; / a neck-garland measures three cubits, down to the navel, up to the lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
kākiṇīkatrayaṃ caiva nirmāṇe dvijasattamāḥ ..
mālatyāśca tulasyāśca jātiyūthyośca sattamāḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
काकिणीकत्रयं चैव निर्माणे द्विजसत्तमाः ..
मालत्याश्च तुलस्याश्च जातियूथ्योश्च सत्तमाः .. 36 ..
text_mt: Three kākiṇīs for the fashioning, O best of the twice-born, / of jasmine and tulasī, and of Spanish jasmine and yellow jasmine, O excellent ones.

sanskrit_iast:
tadardhārdhaṃ mārutena damane bakulasya ca ..
vetanaṃ dīpataile ca ājyasya parivardhayet .. 37 ..
meaning:
तदर्धार्धं मारुतेन दमने बकुलस्य च ..
वेतनं दीपतैले च आज्यस्य परिवर्धयेत् .. 37 ..
text_mt: Half of that half for marjoram, and for bakula; / the wage is for lamp-oil; for ghee one should increase it.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmeyāme raupyamāṣaṃ snehe caiva tu kākiṇī ..
sārdhāṃgulapramāṇena vastravartiṃ vidurbudhāḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
यामेयामे रौप्यमाषं स्नेहे चैव तु काकिणी ..
सार्धांगुलप्रमाणेन वस्त्रवर्तिं विदुर्बुधाः .. 38 ..
text_mt: Watch by watch, a silver māṣa, and a kākiṇī for oil; / the wise know a cloth wick to measure one and a half finger-breadths.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍaṃgulena dairghyaṃ ca na nyūnaṃ nādhikaṃ bhavet ..
pañcaviṃśatibhiḥ saṃkhyā taṃtubhirdvijasattamāḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
षडंगुलेन दैर्घ्यं च न न्यूनं नाधिकं भवेत् ..
पञ्चविंशतिभिः संख्या तंतुभिर्द्विजसत्तमाः .. 39 ..
text_mt: And the length should be six finger-breadths, neither less nor more; / its count should be twenty-five threads, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāṅgulena mānena kartavyaḥ susamāhitaḥ ..
hastocchrāye pradadyāttu muṣṭihaste tu madhyamam .. 2.2.4.40 ..
meaning:
पञ्चाङ्गुलेन मानेन कर्तव्यः सुसमाहितः ..
हस्तोच्छ्राये प्रदद्यात्तु मुष्टिहस्ते तु मध्यमम् .. 2.2.4.40 ..
text_mt: It should be carefully made with a measure of five finger-breadths; / one should give one measuring a cubit in height; one measuring a fist and a cubit is middling.

sanskrit_iast:
trihaste caturhaste vā uttamaṃ mānamīritam ..
svarṇadhāre hato rājā rajate sarvakāmadaḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
त्रिहस्ते चतुर्हस्ते वा उत्तमं मानमीरितम् ..
स्वर्णधारे हतो राजा रजते सर्वकामदः .. 41 ..
text_mt: Three cubits or four cubits is stated to be the superior measure; / on a gold stand, the king is slain; on silver, it grants all desires;

sanskrit_iast:
tāmre cāyuḥkṣayakaramāyase durgatipradaḥ ..
śastasya karamardasya praśastottara ucyate .. 42 ..
meaning:
ताम्रे चायुःक्षयकरमायसे दुर्गतिप्रदः ..
शस्तस्य करमर्दस्य प्रशस्तोत्तर उच्यते .. 42 ..
text_mt: on copper, it causes loss of lifespan; on iron, it brings misfortune; / of the sword and of the carissa carandas, the northern is said to be praiseworthy.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpādhāraṃ kāṃsyamayaṃ tathārītimayasya ca ..
abhāve mṛnmayasyaiva mṛnmaye mānavarjitam .. 43 ..
meaning:
दीपाधारं कांस्यमयं तथारीतिमयस्य च ..
अभावे मृन्मयस्यैव मृन्मये मानवर्जितम् .. 43 ..
text_mt: The lampstand should be made of bell-metal, and likewise of brass; / in their absence, of clay; for clay, it is devoid of [rigid] measure.

sanskrit_iast:
daśāṅgadhūpake mūlyaṃ viṃśake tu paṇatrayam ..
dvādaśakāṃgule'pyardhavartiṃ dhūpāya vartayet .. 44 ..
meaning:
दशाङ्गधूपके मूल्यं विंशके तु पणत्रयम् ..
द्वादशकांगुलेऽप्यर्धवर्तिं धूपाय वर्तयेत् .. 44 ..
text_mt: The cost for ten-ingredient incense, and for twenty, is three paṇas; / one should also prepare a half-wick of twelve finger-breadths for incense.

sanskrit_iast:
haste paṃcapramāṇaṃ ca vastraiḥ kuryācca vartikām ..
pañcaviṃśatibhirvā yaḥ sa mahāvartirucyate ..45.. ..
kalaśanirṇayavarṇanam
meaning:
हस्ते पंचप्रमाणं च वस्त्रैः कुर्याच्च वर्तिकाम् ..
पञ्चविंशतिभिर्वा यः स महावर्तिरुच्यते ..45.. ..
कलशनिर्णयवर्णनम्
text_mt:
And with cloths one should make a wick measuring five in a cubit; / or that which is made with twenty-five is called a great wick.
Description of the determination of the water pot

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kalaśānāṃ vinirṇayam ..
yasyārpite ca māṃgalye yātrāsiddhiśca jāyate ..1..
meaning:
सूत उवाच ..
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि कलशानां विनिर्णयम् ..
यस्यार्पिते च मांगल्ये यात्रासिद्धिश्च जायते ..1..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Hereafter I shall explain the determination of the water pots, / by whose auspicious presentation the success of the journey is accomplished.
title: adhyāyaḥ 05

sanskrit_iast:
saptāṅgaṃ kalaśe jñeyaṃ pañcāṅgamatha vā punaḥ ..
vārimātreṇa saṃpūrṇe na sā siddhiḥ prajāyate ..2..
meaning:
सप्ताङ्गं कलशे ज्ञेयं पञ्चाङ्गमथ वा पुनः ..
वारिमात्रेण संपूर्णे न सा सिद्धिः प्रजायते ..2..
text_mt: The water pot should be known as having seven limbs or five limbs; / when filled with water alone, that success does not come to pass.

sanskrit_iast:
atha vākṣatapuṣpeṣu devamāvāhya pūjayet ..
na cānyatra yajeddevānviphalaṃ parikīrtitam..3..
meaning:
अथ वाक्षतपुष्पेषु देवमावाह्य पूजयेत् ..
न चान्यत्र यजेद्देवान्विफलं परिकीर्तितम्..3..
text_mt: Or having invoked the deity into unbroken rice and flowers, one should worship [him]; / one should not worship the gods elsewhere; it is proclaimed to be fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
vaṭasyāśvatthavṛkṣasya dhātakībilvakasya ca ..
pañcapallavamuddiṣṭaṃ vinyasetkalaśopari .. 4 ..
meaning:
वटस्याश्वत्थवृक्षस्य धातकीबिल्वकस्य च ..
पञ्चपल्लवमुद्दिष्टं विन्यसेत्कलशोपरि .. 4 ..
text_mt: Of the banyan tree, the sacred fig tree, the dhātakī, and the bilva tree: / five sprouts are prescribed to be placed upon the water pot.

sanskrit_iast:
sauvarṇā rājatā vāpi tāmrādyā mṛnmayāstathā ..
kalaśāḥ kramaśaḥ proktā yathāvittānusārataḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
सौवर्णा राजता वापि ताम्राद्या मृन्मयास्तथा ..
कलशाः क्रमशः प्रोक्ता यथावित्तानुसारतः .. 5 ..
text_mt: Golden, silver, copper, and likewise clay: / water pots are proclaimed in sequence according to one's wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
abhedyāḥ suṣamāḥ plakṣāḥ sarve ādyāḥ supūritāḥ ..
niśchidrā ṛjavaścaiva secanānyekakarṣakaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
अभेद्याः सुषमाः प्लक्षाः सर्वे आद्याः सुपूरिताः ..
निश्छिद्रा ऋजवश्चैव सेचनान्येककर्षकः .. 6 ..
text_mt: Unbroken, well-proportioned, smooth, all the prime ones well-filled, / without holes and straight, sprinkled with a single karṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
eka triṃśāṅgulaṃ kuryātkālāhe dviguṇaṃ śatam ..
mukhaṃ cāṣṭāṃgulaṃ tasya dvyaṃgule ca varārthite ..7..
meaning:
एक त्रिंशाङ्गुलं कुर्यात्कालाहे द्विगुणं शतम् ..
मुखं चाष्टांगुलं तस्य द्व्यंगुले च वरार्थिते ..7..
text_mt: One should make it thirty-one finger-breadths; in a large vessel, twice a hundred; / its mouth should be eight finger-breadths, and two finger-breadths when prayed for boons.

sanskrit_iast:
taijasaiḥ kārayenmānaṃ mṛnmaye mānamucyate ..
kalaśodakanirmāṇe amānaṃ naiva yojayet .. 8 ..
meaning:
तैजसैः कारयेन्मानं मृन्मये मानमुच्यते ..
कलशोदकनिर्माणे अमानं नैव योजयेत् .. 8 ..
text_mt: One should have the measure made with metallic [vessels]; the measure is stated for clay; / in preparing water pot water, one should never employ an improper measure.

sanskrit_iast:
kalaśasthāpanaṃ vakṣye yatra sannihitāḥ surāḥ ..
vyutkrameṇa pravinyāse yātudhāno haretkila .. 9 ..
meaning:
कलशस्थापनं वक्ष्ये यत्र सन्निहिताः सुराः ..
व्युत्क्रमेण प्रविन्यासे यातुधानो हरेत्किल .. 9 ..
text_mt: I shall declare the installation of the water pot, wherein the gods are present; / if it is arranged in reverse order, a demon indeed carries [the merit] away.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñe sādhāraṇaṃ vakṣye yadvidhānaṃ yathāmatam ..
svastikopari vinyāse saṃpūrṇasyārdhamānake .. 2.2.5.10 ..
meaning:
यज्ञे साधारणं वक्ष्ये यद्विधानं यथामतम् ..
स्वस्तिकोपरि विन्यासे संपूर्णस्यार्धमानके .. 2.2.5.10 ..
text_mt: I shall declare what is common to the sacrifice, which rule is according to tradition: / placed upon a svastika, half the measure of the full one.

sanskrit_iast:
caturasrottaraṃ bhittvā cordhvādhomānataḥ samam ..
turyasūtrāṇi matimānpañca pūrvāyatanāni ca .. 11 ..
meaning:
चतुरस्रोत्तरं भित्त्वा चोर्ध्वाधोमानतः समम् ..
तुर्यसूत्राणि मतिमान्पञ्च पूर्वायतनानि च .. 11 ..
text_mt: Having divided the square area equally from top to bottom according to measure, / the wise man [draws] four cords and five extending eastward.

sanskrit_iast:
mārjayetsvastikākāraṃ turyamātraṃ yathā bhavet ..
svastikaṃ jāyate tatra kalaśānāṃ tathāsanam .. 12 ..
meaning:
मार्जयेत्स्वस्तिकाकारं तुर्यमात्रं यथा भवेत् ..
स्वस्तिकं जायते तत्र कलशानां तथासनम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: One should wipe it into the form of a svastika so that it is fourfold in measure; / a svastika is produced there, and likewise a seat for the water pots.

sanskrit_iast:
syonā pṛthivīti maṃtreṇa kuryādbhūbhiparigraham ..
madhyamānānikābhyāṃ ca nyasyetpātālasaṃmukham ..
ṛṣirnārāyaṇo'sya syādgāyatrī devatā raviḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
स्योना पृथिवीति मंत्रेण कुर्याद्भूभिपरिग्रहम् ..
मध्यमानानिकाभ्यां च न्यस्येत्पातालसंमुखम् ..
ऋषिर्नारायणोऽस्य स्याद्गायत्री देवता रविः .. 13 ..
text_mt: With the mantra 'Syonā pṛthivī', he should perform the taking possession of the earth; / and with the middle and ring fingers he should place it facing Pātāla; / its seer is Nārāyaṇa, its meter is Gāyatrī, and the deity is Ravi.

sanskrit_iast:
viniyogaḥ sthāpane ca tathā bhūmiparigrahaḥ ..
dhānyamasīti mantreṇa dhānyasūktaṃ paristavet .. 14 ..
meaning:
विनियोगः स्थापने च तथा भूमिपरिग्रहः ..
धान्यमसीति मन्त्रेण धान्यसूक्तं परिस्तवेत् .. 14 ..
text_mt: The application is in the installation, and likewise in taking possession of the earth; / with the mantra 'Dhānyam asi', he should praise with the Dhānyasūkta.

sanskrit_iast:
asya mantrasya ca ṛṣirgautamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ..
anuṣṭupca bhavecchando devatāsya guruḥ smṛtaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
अस्य मन्त्रस्य च ऋषिर्गौतमः परिकीर्तितः ..
अनुष्टुप्च भवेच्छन्दो देवतास्य गुरुः स्मृतः .. 15 ..
text_mt: The seer of this mantra is proclaimed to be Gautama; / the meter is Anuṣṭubh, and its deity is remembered as Guru.

sanskrit_iast:
ājighraṃ kalaśaṃ mahyāṃ sthāpayetkalaśaṃ tataḥ ..
kaniṣṭhāṃguṣṭhakaṃ tyaktvā kumbhāgre udare'pi ca .. 16 ..
meaning:
आजिघ्रं कलशं मह्यां स्थापयेत्कलशं ततः ..
कनिष्ठांगुष्ठकं त्यक्त्वा कुम्भाग्रे उदरेऽपि च .. 16 ..
text_mt: With [the mantra] beginning with “Ājighra”, he should establish the jar upon the earth, and then establish the jar / having released the little finger and the thumb, at the top and the belly of the jar.

sanskrit_iast:
vinyāsaścaiva kartavyastryaṃgule brahmamudrayā ..
ājighrasya ca mantrasya ṛṣirbharga udāhṛtaḥ ..
paṃktiśchandaśca uddiṣṭo devatā viṣṇuravyayaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
विन्यासश्चैव कर्तव्यस्त्र्यंगुले ब्रह्ममुद्रया ..
आजिघ्रस्य च मन्त्रस्य ऋषिर्भर्ग उदाहृतः ..
पंक्तिश्छन्दश्च उद्दिष्टो देवता विष्णुरव्ययः .. 17 ..
text_mt: The ritual placement should be performed across three finger-breadths with the Brahma mudrā. / Of the mantra beginning with “Ājighra”, the seer is proclaimed to be Bharga, / the metre is declared to be Paṅkti, and the deity is the imperishable Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
kalaśasthāpane caiva somayāge ca yojayet ..
paṃcanadyetimantreṇa kṣipedgaṅgājalaṃ tataḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
कलशस्थापने चैव सोमयागे च योजयेत् ..
पंचनद्येतिमन्त्रेण क्षिपेद्गङ्गाजलं ततः .. 18 ..
text_mt: One should employ [this mantra] in establishing the jar and in the Soma sacrifice. / Then, with the mantra beginning with “Pañcanadī”, he should pour the water of the Gaṅgā.

sanskrit_iast:
devatā paramā triṣṭubdevatā somabhāvitaḥ ..
viniyogaḥ pallave ca vinyasetparikīrtitaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
देवता परमा त्रिष्टुब्देवता सोमभावितः ..
विनियोगः पल्लवे च विन्यसेत्परिकीर्तितः .. 19 ..
text_mt: The highest deity [is proclaimed], the metre is Triṣṭubh, and the deity is connected with Soma. / The application is declared: he should place it upon the sprout.

sanskrit_iast:
yāḥ phalinīti maṃtreṇa pradadyātsaphalākṣatam ..
yāḥ phalinīti maṃtrasya ṛṣiḥ kamalasaṃjñakaḥ ..
triṣṭupchando gaṇapatirdevatā parikīrtitā .. 2.2.5.20 ..
meaning:
याः फलिनीति मंत्रेण प्रदद्यात्सफलाक्षतम् ..
याः फलिनीति मंत्रस्य ऋषिः कमलसंज्ञकः ..
त्रिष्टुप्छन्दो गणपतिर्देवता परिकीर्तिता .. 2.2.5.20 ..
text_mt: With the mantra beginning with “Yāḥ phalinīḥ”, he should offer unbroken grains along with fruit. / Of the mantra beginning with “Yāḥ phalinīḥ”, the seer is known as Kamala, / the metre is Triṣṭubh, and the deity is proclaimed to be Gaṇapati.

sanskrit_iast:
badaraṃ nāgaraṃ caiva dhātrī ca picumardakam ..
jīvaṃtī pīvaraṃ caiva phalānyetāni varjayet .. 21 ..
meaning:
बदरं नागरं चैव धात्री च पिचुमर्दकम् ..
जीवंती पीवरं चैव फलान्येतानि वर्जयेत् .. 21 ..
text_mt: Jujube, ginger, āmlakī, and neem, / jīvantī, and pīvara—one should avoid these fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyagarbheti ṛcā pañcaratnāni nikṣipet ..
ṛṣirhiraṇyagarbhosya chandastriṣṭubudāhṛtam ..
savitā devatā cāsya ratnanyāseti yoja yet ..22..
meaning:
हिरण्यगर्भेति ऋचा पञ्चरत्नानि निक्षिपेत् ..
ऋषिर्हिरण्यगर्भोस्य छन्दस्त्रिष्टुबुदाहृतम् ..
सविता देवता चास्य रत्नन्यासेति योज येत् ..22..
text_mt: With the verse beginning with “Hiraṇyagarbha”, he should throw in the five jewels. / Its seer is Hiraṇyagarbha, its metre is declared to be Triṣṭubh, / its deity is Savitṛ, and one should employ it in the placement of the jewels.

sanskrit_iast:
amṛtīkaraṇaṃ kuryāddaivaśulbanameva ca ..
varuṇasya tveti ṛṣirvaruṇāṃtare yojayet ..23..
meaning:
अमृतीकरणं कुर्याद्दैवशुल्बनमेव च ..
वरुणस्य त्वेति ऋषिर्वरुणांतरे योजयेत् ..23..
text_mt: He should perform the immortalisation and the divine measuring-cord ritual. / With the verse beginning with “Varuṇasya tvā”, the seer should apply it within Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīśca te iti mantreṇa dadyātpuṣpaṃ sacandanam ..
gandhadvāreti maṃtreṇa dadyādgandhaṃ viloḍitam .. 24 ..
meaning:
श्रीश्च ते इति मन्त्रेण दद्यात्पुष्पं सचन्दनम् ..
गन्धद्वारेति मंत्रेण दद्याद्गन्धं विलोडितम् .. 24 ..
text_mt: With the mantra beginning with “Śrīś ca te”, he should offer a flower smeared with sandalwood paste. / With the mantra beginning with “Gandhadvārā”, he should offer blended perfume.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṇḍāditi ca mantreṇa dadyāddūrvākṣataṃ punaḥ ..
vrīhayaśceti mantreṇa pañca vrīhīṃśca nikṣipet ..25..
meaning:
काण्डादिति च मन्त्रेण दद्याद्दूर्वाक्षतं पुनः ..
व्रीहयश्चेति मन्त्रेण पञ्च व्रीहींश्च निक्षिपेत् ..25..
text_mt: And with the mantra beginning with “Kāṇḍāt”, he should again offer dūrvā grass and unbroken grains. / With the mantra beginning with “Vrīhayaḥ”, he should throw in the five grains:

sanskrit_iast:
tilāśca māṣā mudgāśca śyāmākāḥ śālayaḥ smṛtāḥ ..
pañca dhānyagaṇaḥ proktaḥ sarvāriṣṭaniṣūdanaḥ .. 26 ..
māsavarṇanam
meaning:
तिलाश्च माषा मुद्गाश्च श्यामाकाः शालयः स्मृताः ..
पञ्च धान्यगणः प्रोक्तः सर्वारिष्टनिषूदनः .. 26 ..
मासवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Sesame, black gram, mung bean, śyāmāka, and rice are declared. / This group of five grains is proclaimed to destroy all calamities.
Description of the Months

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
atha māsāśrayaṃ karma kartuṃ māsanirūpaṇam ..
kriyate tadvidhaṃ saṃkhye bhavenmāsa ścaturvidhaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अथ मासाश्रयं कर्म कर्तुं मासनिरूपणम् ..
क्रियते तद्विधं संख्ये भवेन्मास श्चतुर्विधः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Now, in order to perform rites dependent on months, the determination of months is undertaken; / in the enumeration of those types, a month is of four kinds:
title: adhyāyaḥ 06

sanskrit_iast:
cāndraḥ sauraḥ sāvanaśca nākṣatraśca tathāparaḥ ..
śuklapratipadaṃ prāpya yāvaddarśa ca aindavaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
चान्द्रः सौरः सावनश्च नाक्षत्रश्च तथापरः ..
शुक्लप्रतिपदं प्राप्य यावद्दर्श च ऐन्दवः .. 2 ..
text_mt: lunar, solar, civil, and the other is sidereal. / Beginning from the bright pratipad up to the new moon is the lunar [month].

sanskrit_iast:
ekarāśau raviryāvatsa māsaḥ saura ucyate ..
triṃśatā divasairmāsaḥ sāvanaḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
एकराशौ रविर्यावत्स मासः सौर उच्यते ..
त्रिंशता दिवसैर्मासः सावनः परिकीर्तितः .. 3 ..
text_mt: As long as the sun remains in a single zodiacal sign, that month is called solar. / A month measured by thirty days is proclaimed to be civil.

sanskrit_iast:
nākṣatramāso'śvinyādirevatyanto hi viśrutaḥ..
udayādudayaṃ yastu sāvano divaso raveḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
नाक्षत्रमासोऽश्विन्यादिरेवत्यन्तो हि विश्रुतः..
उदयादुदयं यस्तु सावनो दिवसो रवेः .. 4 ..
text_mt: The sidereal month is famed as beginning with Aśvinī and ending with Revatī. / But that which is from sunrise to sunrise is a civil day of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃtreṇaikatitherbhāgakālo divasa aindavaḥ ..
rāśestriṃśadbhāgakālaḥ kālastvekasya bhāsvataḥ ..5..
meaning:
तंत्रेणैकतिथेर्भागकालो दिवस ऐन्दवः ..
राशेस्त्रिंशद्भागकालः कालस्त्वेकस्य भास्वतः ..5..
text_mt: According to the system, the time of the division of a single lunar day is a lunar day. / The time of a thirtieth division of a zodiacal sign is the time of a single sun.

sanskrit_iast:
ahorātraṃ tu tannaivaṃ saure'pi bhāgamānataḥ..
ahorātraṃ sādhanasya mukhyavṛttvaiva labhyate .. 6 ..
meaning:
अहोरात्रं तु तन्नैवं सौरेऽपि भागमानतः..
अहोरात्रं साधनस्य मुख्यवृत्त्वैव लभ्यते .. 6 ..
text_mt: A day-and-night is not like that, even in the solar [system], according to the measure of the division; / a day-and-night of practice is obtained only by the primary sense.

sanskrit_iast:
saure cāndre tūpagaṇau triṃśadbhāge tvadarśanāt ..
sāvanā divasā grāhyā ṛṣīṇāṃ samaye gṛhe .. 7 ..
meaning:
सौरे चान्द्रे तूपगणौ त्रिंशद्भागे त्वदर्शनात् ..
सावना दिवसा ग्राह्या ऋषीणां समये गृहे .. 7 ..
text_mt: In the solar and lunar [systems], because of the lack of observation in the thirtieth division, / civil days are to be taken according to the tradition of the sages in the house,

sanskrit_iast:
atibhāgavyavasthāyāṃ prāyaścittakriyāsu ca..
mantropāsanakārye ca annasya prāśane śiśoḥ..8..
meaning:
अतिभागव्यवस्थायां प्रायश्चित्तक्रियासु च..
मन्त्रोपासनकार्ये च अन्नस्य प्राशने शिशोः..8..
text_mt: in the arrangement of fractional shares, in expiatory rites, / in rites of worshipping mantras, and in the first feeding of an infant,

sanskrit_iast:
karasya grahaṇe rājño vyavahāreṣu māḥsu ca..
yajñeṣu dinasaṃ khyāyāṃ grāhyo māsastu sāvanaḥ ..9..
meaning:
करस्य ग्रहणे राज्ञो व्यवहारेषु माःसु च..
यज्ञेषु दिनसं ख्यायां ग्राह्यो मासस्तु सावनः ..9..
text_mt: in the king's collection of tax, in legal transactions, in lunar months, / and in the enumeration of days in sacrifices, the civil month is to be taken.

sanskrit_iast:
sauramāso vivāhādau yadādyaiḥ supragṛhyate ..
yajñeṣvapi vrate vāpi vihite snānakarmaṇi ..2.2.6.10..
meaning:
सौरमासो विवाहादौ यदाद्यैः सुप्रगृह्यते ..
यज्ञेष्वपि व्रते वापि विहिते स्नानकर्मणि ..2.2.6.10..
text_mt: The solar month is appropriately accepted in marriages and the like by the ancient sages, / and also in sacrifices, in a votive observance, and in the prescribed rite of bathing.

sanskrit_iast:
cāndrastu pārvaṇe grāhyo vārṣikeṣvaṣṭakāsu ca ..
śrāddheṣu tithikāryeṣu tithyukteṣu vrateṣu ca ..11..
meaning:
चान्द्रस्तु पार्वणे ग्राह्यो वार्षिकेष्वष्टकासु च ..
श्राद्धेषु तिथिकार्येषु तिथ्युक्तेषु व्रतेषु च ..11..
text_mt: The lunar [month] is to be taken for the new- and full-moon rites, annual [rites], the aṣṭakās, / ancestral rites, rites tied to lunar days, and votive observances prescribed for lunar days.

sanskrit_iast:
nākṣatraḥ somapādīnāmāryabhāgavicāraṇe ..
karagrahavidhau rājñāṃ nāyaṃ sarvajanākṛtiḥ .. 12..
meaning:
नाक्षत्रः सोमपादीनामार्यभागविचारणे ..
करग्रहविधौ राज्ञां नायं सर्वजनाकृतिः .. 12..
text_mt: The sidereal [month] is used in examining the shares of the worthy for Soma-drinkers and others; / in the kings' method of collecting tax, this does not apply to all people.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvaccaitrādimāsoktaṃ tithyuktaṃ karma dṛśyate ..
tattu cāndreṇa kartavyaṃ sā hi caitrādinocyate ..13..
meaning:
तद्वच्चैत्रादिमासोक्तं तिथ्युक्तं कर्म दृश्यते ..
तत्तु चान्द्रेण कर्तव्यं सा हि चैत्रादिनोच्यते ..13..
text_mt: Likewise, a rite declared for the months beginning with Caitra and connected with a lunar day is observed; / that must be performed by the lunar [reckoning], for that [sequence] is named from Caitra and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
rājoktau sāvanaḥ prokte tithisaṃbhāgakarmaṇi..
tatra sauro bhavedvācyaḥ sauraśabdapravartanāt ..14..
meaning:
राजोक्तौ सावनः प्रोक्ते तिथिसंभागकर्मणि..
तत्र सौरो भवेद्वाच्यः सौरशब्दप्रवर्तनात् ..14..
text_mt: In a king's declaration, the civil [month] is taught; in rites concerning the division of lunar days, / there the solar should be expressed, because of the application of the term 'solar'.

sanskrit_iast:
citrānakṣatrayogena caitrī sā pūrṇimā smṛtā..
tayopalakṣito māsaścaitra ityabhidhīyate .. 15 ..
meaning:
चित्रानक्षत्रयोगेन चैत्री सा पूर्णिमा स्मृता..
तयोपलक्षितो मासश्चैत्र इत्यभिधीयते .. 15 ..
text_mt: Due to conjunction with the Citrā asterism, that full moon is recorded as Caitrī; / characterised by that [full moon], the month is named Caitra.

sanskrit_iast:
sa ca tithyātmako māsaścāndraḥ śravaṇabhāskaraḥ ..
cāndraścaitryaṃtiko māso mukhyaścaitrādisaṃjñakaḥ .. 16..
meaning:
स च तिथ्यात्मको मासश्चान्द्रः श्रवणभास्करः ..
चान्द्रश्चैत्र्यंतिको मासो मुख्यश्चैत्रादिसंज्ञकः .. 16..
text_mt: That month consisting of lunar days is lunar, with the sun in Śravaṇa; / the lunar month ending with Caitrī is the primary one designated as Caitra and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
gauṇo'pyasau yugādyāderanurodhena vardhanāt ..
mukhyaḥ śuklādidarśāṃto māso lākṣaṇiko mataḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
गौणोऽप्यसौ युगाद्यादेरनुरोधेन वर्धनात् ..
मुख्यः शुक्लादिदर्शांतो मासो लाक्षणिको मतः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Even this secondary one increases in accordance with the beginning of the yuga and so on; / the primary month, ending with the new moon from the bright fortnight onward, is considered standard.

sanskrit_iast:
caitrādyāścāndramāsā ye dvādaśāpi tu yogataḥ ..
paurṇamāsīyutābhistu na carkṣatvaṃ na rebhire .. 18 ..
meaning:
चैत्राद्याश्चान्द्रमासा ये द्वादशापि तु योगतः ..
पौर्णमासीयुताभिस्तु न चर्क्षत्वं न रेभिरे .. 18 ..
text_mt: Those twelve lunar months beginning with Caitra, arising from conjunction / with [the lunar asterisms] joined with the full moon, did not fail to possess the asterism.

sanskrit_iast:
viśākhayādyeṣu yā vā tathā bhādrapadena vā ..
yatra na pūrṇimāyogo māsaḥ sa syādvināśakaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
विशाखयाद्येषु या वा तथा भाद्रपदेन वा ..
यत्र न पूर्णिमायोगो मासः स स्याद्विनाशकः .. 19 ..
text_mt: That [full moon] which is in the [months] beginning with Viśākhā, or with Bhādrapada, / wherein there is no conjunction with the full moon, that month would become destructive.

sanskrit_iast:
yo'sau yadyapi caitrādau naiṣṭhiko'pi pralabhyate ..
yathā saure'pi yāto'sau yogo'yamatidurghaṭaḥ .. 2.2.6.20 ..
meaning:
योऽसौ यद्यपि चैत्रादौ नैष्ठिकोऽपि प्रलभ्यते ..
यथा सौरेऽपि यातोऽसौ योगोऽयमतिदुर्घटः .. 2.2.6.20 ..
text_mt: Even if that which is constant is obtained in Caitra and the rest, / as it passes even into the solar, this conjunction is extremely difficult to achieve.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā ca māsasāmānye yogenāyaṃ bhavetkvacit ..
yadi varṣasahasrānte tadakṣeṇaiva pūrṇimā .. 21 ..
meaning:
तथा च माससामान्ये योगेनायं भवेत्क्वचित् ..
यदि वर्षसहस्रान्ते तदक्षेणैव पूर्णिमा .. 21 ..
text_mt: And so, in a general month, this [conjunction] might occur somewhere; / if at the end of a thousand years, a full moon with that very axle

sanskrit_iast:
saṃyuktā labhyate yatra bhavedrājyavināśanam ..
sūryācandramasau nityaṃ kurvāte tithibhojanam .. 22 ..
meaning:
संयुक्ता लभ्यते यत्र भवेद्राज्यविनाशनम् ..
सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ नित्यं कुर्वाते तिथिभोजनम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: is found conjoined, where that happens, destruction of the kingdom would occur. / The sun and the moon constantly consume the lunar days.

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍadvaye bhuktaśeṣe na bhuñjīta kadācana ..
atikramyāparāṃ bhoktuṃ tithiṃ yatra ubhāvapi ..23..
meaning:
दण्डद्वये भुक्तशेषे न भुञ्जीत कदाचन ..
अतिक्रम्यापरां भोक्तुं तिथिं यत्र उभावपि ..23..
text_mt: When two daṇḍas remain of what was eaten, one should never eat. / Where both [luminaries], passing beyond, consume another lunar day,

sanskrit_iast:
yatra viṃśattithistasmātsañcitaikā bhavediti ..
triṃśatā cāndramāsau tu candreṇaiko hi varddhate .. 24..
meaning:
यत्र विंशत्तिथिस्तस्मात्सञ्चितैका भवेदिति ..
त्रिंशता चान्द्रमासौ तु चन्द्रेणैको हि वर्द्धते .. 24..
text_mt: where the twentieth lunar day is, from that one [day] becomes accumulated. / In thirty lunar months, one indeed increases by the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
sa cādhiko yato māsastataḥ syādadhimāsakaḥ ..
samarātriṃ divaṃ kṛtvā vaivasvatapurīgatim .. 25 ..
meaning:
स चाधिको यतो मासस्ततः स्यादधिमासकः ..
समरात्रिं दिवं कृत्वा वैवस्वतपुरीगतिम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: And since that month is additional, it becomes an intercalary month. / Having made day and night equal, [the sun] going to the city of Vaivasvata,

sanskrit_iast:
gaśe rāśyaṃtare sūryo yāvadgacchati bhānumān ..
gacchanvardhayati pūrvaṃ tithayastāstu saṃcitāḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
गशे राश्यंतरे सूर्यो यावद्गच्छति भानुमान् ..
गच्छन्वर्धयति पूर्वं तिथयस्तास्तु संचिताः .. 26 ..
text_mt: as long as the luminous sun moves to another zodiacal sign, / in moving, it increases the previous [days]; those lunar days are accumulated.

sanskrit_iast:
vardhate tithayo yāvattulāṃ yāti divā karaḥ ..
tulādirāśiṣaṭke tu na varddhate kadācana .. 27 ..
meaning:
वर्धते तिथयो यावत्तुलां याति दिवा करः ..
तुलादिराशिषट्के तु न वर्द्धते कदाचन .. 27 ..
text_mt: The lunar days increase until the sun goes to Libra; / in the six zodiacal signs beginning with Libra, they never increase,

sanskrit_iast:
svabhāvātsamagatyā tu yataḥ saṃkramate raviḥ ..
saṃcayamānātvekaikā pratimāsaṃ vivarddhate ..
niśāsvapi tu saure tā ekasmiṃstisra ityapi .. 28 ..
meaning:
स्वभावात्समगत्या तु यतः संक्रमते रविः ..
संचयमानात्वेकैका प्रतिमासं विवर्द्धते ..
निशास्वपि तु सौरे ता एकस्मिंस्तिस्र इत्यपि .. 28 ..
text_mt: because by nature the sun transits with equal motion. / By accumulated measure, one [fraction] increases each month; / even in the nights of a solar [month], those are three in one.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūrṇatriṃśattithibhirmāsyekasminyadā bhavet ..
sa cāndro malino māsaḥ koṇapādyaiḥ samīhitaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
संपूर्णत्रिंशत्तिथिभिर्मास्येकस्मिन्यदा भवेत् ..
स चान्द्रो मलिनो मासः कोणपाद्यैः समीहितः .. 29 ..
text_mt: When in one month there are thirty complete lunar days, / that lunar month is an impure month, sought by Koṇapa and others.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktocchiṣṭā tu tanmāsādasaṃspṛṣṭadivākaraḥ ..
yadā saṃkramate laṃghya tadā jñeyo malimlucaḥ .. 2.2.6.30 ..
meaning:
भुक्तोच्छिष्टा तु तन्मासादसंस्पृष्टदिवाकरः ..
यदा संक्रमते लंघ्य तदा ज्ञेयो मलिम्लुचः .. 2.2.6.30 ..
text_mt: When the sun, untouched by that month, transits by leaping over the remnant that was consumed, / then it should be known as an intercalary month.

sanskrit_iast:
sārdhavarṣadvaye pūrṇe patatyevaṃ niśākaraḥ ..
parityaktāśca yāvaṃtyo vyutkramiṇyaśca yāḥ punaḥ ..
tithayaste niyoktavyā naro na syātsa pūraṇaḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
सार्धवर्षद्वये पूर्णे पतत्येवं निशाकरः ..
परित्यक्ताश्च यावंत्यो व्युत्क्रमिण्यश्च याः पुनः ..
तिथयस्ते नियोक्तव्या नरो न स्यात्स पूरणः .. 31 ..
text_mt: When two and a half years are complete, the moon falls thus [into intercalation]. / Whatever lunar days are omitted and also those that are irregular, / they should be appointed; a man should not be that replenisher.

sanskrit_iast:
nairṛtyāṃtaṃ hitārthāya jalaketurnigacchati ..
nirmamaṃ malinaṃ māsaṃ pretānāṃ ca hitāya ca ..32..
meaning:
नैरृत्यांतं हितार्थाय जलकेतुर्निगच्छति ..
निर्ममं मलिनं मासं प्रेतानां च हिताय च ..32..
text_mt: For the sake of welfare toward the southwest, Jalaketu goes forth, / indifferent to the unclean month, and for the benefit of the pretas.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ pretakriyāḥ sarvāḥ kāryā malimluce'pi ca..
yatkartavyaṃ na kartavyaṃ malamāse dvijottamāḥ ..33..
meaning:
अतः प्रेतक्रियाः सर्वाः कार्या मलिम्लुचेऽपि च..
यत्कर्तव्यं न कर्तव्यं मलमासे द्विजोत्तमाः ..33..
text_mt: Therefore all preta-rites are to be performed even in an intercalary month. / What is to be done and what is not to be done in an intercalated month, O best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
tadidānīṃ pravakṣyāmi kathitaṃ ca prasaṃgataḥ ..
yacchrāddhaṃ pretasaṃbaṃdhi sarpiḍīkaraṇāvadhi ..
malamāse'pi tatkāryaṃ viśi naṣṭi sapiṃḍanam .. 34 ..
meaning:
तदिदानीं प्रवक्ष्यामि कथितं च प्रसंगतः ..
यच्छ्राद्धं प्रेतसंबंधि सर्पिडीकरणावधि ..
मलमासेऽपि तत्कार्यं विशि नष्टि सपिंडनम् .. 34 ..
text_mt: that I will now declare, as it has been mentioned in this context: / The śrāddha related to the preta up to the sapiṇḍīkaraṇa rite / must be performed even in an intercalary month; it preserves the sapiṇḍana.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā tu dvādaśo māso daivānmalimluco bhavet.
tatraiva yatnātkartavyā kriyā pretasya vārṣikī .. 35 ..
meaning:
यदा तु द्वादशो मासो दैवान्मलिम्लुचो भवेत्.
तत्रैव यत्नात्कर्तव्या क्रिया प्रेतस्य वार्षिकी .. 35 ..
text_mt: When, however, the twelfth month happens by fate to be an intercalary month, / right there the annual rite for the preta must be performed with diligence.

sanskrit_iast:
māsāṃtare tu patite tasminneva malimluce ..
tadā trayodaśe māsi kartavyaṃ tatsapiṃḍanam.. 36 ..
meaning:
मासांतरे तु पतिते तस्मिन्नेव मलिम्लुचे ..
तदा त्रयोदशे मासि कर्तव्यं तत्सपिंडनम्.. 36 ..
text_mt: When, however, that intercalary month falls within the intervening months, / then that sapiṇḍana must be performed in the thirteenth month.

sanskrit_iast:
varjyaṃ māsikayā śrāddhamekaṃ tasmiṃstrayodaśe ..
triṃśatā ghaṭikaiḥ śrāddhaṃ vardhate'dyāpi saṃmitam .. 37 ..
meaning:
वर्ज्यं मासिकया श्राद्धमेकं तस्मिंस्त्रयोदशे ..
त्रिंशता घटिकैः श्राद्धं वर्धतेऽद्यापि संमितम् .. 37 ..
text_mt: One monthly śrāddha is to be avoided in that thirteenth [month]; / up to today, a śrāddha increases measured by thirty ghaṭikās.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryātpatyābdikaṃ karma prayatnena malimluce ..
naimittikaṃ ca kurvīta nādhikārastayorbhavet .. 38 ..
meaning:
कुर्यात्पत्याब्दिकं कर्म प्रयत्नेन मलिम्लुचे ..
नैमित्तिकं च कुर्वीत नाधिकारस्तयोर्भवेत् .. 38 ..
text_mt: One should diligently perform the annual rite of the husband in an intercalary month, / and one may perform occasional rites; there is no additional entitlement for both.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthasnānamalabhyaṃ tattadādyaṃ devadarśanam ..
upavāsādikaṃ karma sīmantonnayanaṃ tathā .. 39 ..
meaning:
तीर्थस्नानमलभ्यं तत्तदाद्यं देवदर्शनम् ..
उपवासादिकं कर्म सीमन्तोन्नयनं तथा .. 39 ..
text_mt: Bathing at holy places that is hard to attain, the first darśana of a deity, / rites such as fasting, and likewise the parting of the hair rite,

sanskrit_iast:
ārtavarjaṃ puṃsavanaṃ putrādimukhadarśanam ..
malamāsepi kurvīta śukre cāstamupāgate ..2.2.6.40..
meaning:
आर्तवर्जं पुंसवनं पुत्रादिमुखदर्शनम् ..
मलमासेपि कुर्वीत शुक्रे चास्तमुपागते ..2.2.6.40..
text_mt: the puṃsavana rite, except during menses, looking upon the face of one's son and so forth— / one should perform these even in an intercalary month, and when Venus has set.

sanskrit_iast:
malamāsepi kurvīta nṛpāṇāmabhiṣecanam..
vratāraṃbhaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca cūḍākarma ca mekhalām..41..
meaning:
मलमासेपि कुर्वीत नृपाणामभिषेचनम्..
व्रतारंभं प्रतिष्ठां च चूडाकर्म च मेखलाम्..41..
text_mt: [Nor] in an intercalary month should one perform the consecration of kings, / the commencement of a votive observance, installation, tonsure, and the investiture of the girdle,

sanskrit_iast:
maṃtropāsāṃ rahasyaṃ ca mahādānaṃ sumaṅgalam ..
vivāhaṃ ca gṛhāraṃbhaṃ praveśaṃ navaveśmanaḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
मंत्रोपासां रहस्यं च महादानं सुमङ्गलम् ..
विवाहं च गृहारंभं प्रवेशं नववेश्मनः .. 42 ..
text_mt: worship with mantras, secret [rites], highly auspicious great donations, / marriage, beginning a house, entering a new house,

sanskrit_iast:
upagrahaṃ gavādīnāmāśramāṃtarasaṃkramam ..
dīrghamātrāsu nejyaṃ vai tīrthayātrāvasecanam.. 43 ..
meaning:
उपग्रहं गवादीनामाश्रमांतरसंक्रमम् ..
दीर्घमात्रासु नेज्यं वै तीर्थयात्रावसेचनम्.. 43 ..
text_mt: purchasing cattle and the like, transitioning to another stage of life; / sacrifice is certainly not [to be done] on long journeys, nor pilgrimage, nor sprinkling rites.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣavṛddhivṛṣotsargakanyā dvirnayanādi ca ..
yajñaṃ ca kāmikaṃ vidvānmalamāse vivarjayet ..44..
meaning:
वर्षवृद्धिवृषोत्सर्गकन्या द्विर्नयनादि च ..
यज्ञं च कामिकं विद्वान्मलमासे विवर्जयेत् ..44..
text_mt: Birthdays, release of a bull, taking away a maiden for the second time, and so forth, / and optional sacrifices—a wise person should avoid them in an intercalary month.

sanskrit_iast:
evamastaṃ gate śukre vṛddhabālye ca saṃtyajet..
pādāstaṃ ca mahāstaṃ ca dvividhaṃ cāstamasya tu .. 45 ..
meaning:
एवमस्तं गते शुक्रे वृद्धबाल्ये च संत्यजेत्..
पादास्तं च महास्तं च द्विविधं चास्तमस्य तु .. 45 ..
text_mt: Likewise, when Venus has set, and in its old age and infancy, one should renounce [such acts]. / Its setting is twofold: pādāsta and mahāsta.

sanskrit_iast:
dvisaptatirdinānyasya mahāstaṃ pūrvato bhavet ..
pṛthivyāmeva pādāstaṃ bhaveddvādaśa vatsarān .. 46 ..
meaning:
द्विसप्ततिर्दिनान्यस्य महास्तं पूर्वतो भवेत् ..
पृथिव्यामेव पादास्तं भवेद्द्वादश वत्सरान् .. 46 ..
text_mt: Its mahāsta in the east lasts seventy-two days; / on earth indeed, the pādāsta lasts twelve years.

sanskrit_iast:
ūnapañcāśadadhikaṃ divasānāṃ śatadvayam ..
pratīcyāmuditaḥ kāvyo dṛśyo bhavati sarvadā .. 47 ..
meaning:
ऊनपञ्चाशदधिकं दिवसानां शतद्वयम् ..
प्रतीच्यामुदितः काव्यो दृश्यो भवति सर्वदा .. 47 ..
text_mt: Two hundred and forty-nine days, / when risen in the west, Venus is always visible.

sanskrit_iast:
ekarkṣe guruṇā yukto yāvattiṣṭhati bhārgavaḥ ..
malamāsavatkarmāṇi prāhustyājyāni sarvaśaḥ ..48..
meaning:
एकर्क्षे गुरुणा युक्तो यावत्तिष्ठति भार्गवः ..
मलमासवत्कर्माणि प्राहुस्त्याज्यानि सर्वशः ..48..
text_mt: As long as Venus remains conjoined with Jupiter in a single asterism, / they say all rites are to be completely abandoned, just as in an intercalary month.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛkṣabhede tvekarāśau saṃparke yadi vānayoḥ ..
guro rāhorapi tathā tyajedvidvānna saṃśayaḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
ऋक्षभेदे त्वेकराशौ संपर्के यदि वानयोः ..
गुरो राहोरपि तथा त्यजेद्विद्वान्न संशयः .. 49 ..
text_mt: If there is a contact between these two even in different asterisms but within a single zodiacal sign, / or likewise between Jupiter and Rāhu, the wise man should undoubtedly avoid [rites].

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhe rāśau sthite sūrye jīve cāstamupāgate ..
heyāni yāni karmāṇi niṣiddhāni malimluce .. 2.2.6.50 ..
meaning:
सिंहे राशौ स्थिते सूर्ये जीवे चास्तमुपागते ..
हेयानि यानि कर्माणि निषिद्धानि मलिम्लुचे .. 2.2.6.50 ..
text_mt: When the sun is in the sign of Leo and Jupiter has set, / those rites that are forbidden in an intercalary month should be abandoned.

sanskrit_iast:
mithunasthe yadā bhānau malamāsaḥ patatyasau ..
dvirāṣāḍha iti khyāto gauṇe śabdavivartanāt .. 51 ..
meaning:
मिथुनस्थे यदा भानौ मलमासः पतत्यसौ ..
द्विराषाढ इति ख्यातो गौणे शब्दविवर्तनात् .. 51 ..
text_mt: When that intercalary month falls while the sun is in Gemini, / it is known as Double Āṣāḍha, through a secondary transference of the word.

sanskrit_iast:
phalaṃ cātra mṛtasyaurdhvadehikaṃ karma kurvatā ..
āṣāḍhakīrtanaṃ kāryamevaṃ varṣāṃtare'pi ca .. 52 ..
meaning:
फलं चात्र मृतस्यौर्ध्वदेहिकं कर्म कुर्वता ..
आषाढकीर्तनं कार्यमेवं वर्षांतरेऽपि च .. 52 ..
text_mt: And here, for the person performing the post-mortem rite for the deceased, the fruit [accrues]; / the mention of Āṣāḍha is to be made, and likewise in another year.

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhadvayasaṃyuktapūrṇamāsīdvayaṃ tathā ..
yugmakarkaṭayo rāśyo dvirāṣāḍhastadā bhavet .. 53 ..
meaning:
आषाढद्वयसंयुक्तपूर्णमासीद्वयं तथा ..
युग्मकर्कटयो राश्यो द्विराषाढस्तदा भवेत् .. 53 ..
text_mt: Endowed with two Āṣāḍhas, and likewise with two full-moon days / across the two signs of Gemini and Cancer, it then becomes Double Āṣāḍha.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavedgauṇo dvirāṣāḍho rāśistatraiva saṃyute ..
pūrvatrike tu patite tadeva bhagavānhariḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
भवेद्गौणो द्विराषाढो राशिस्तत्रैव संयुते ..
पूर्वत्रिके तु पतिते तदेव भगवान्हरिः .. 54 ..
text_mt: Double Āṣāḍha becomes secondary when the zodiacal sign is conjoined right there; / when it falls in the first triad, then Lord Hari

sanskrit_iast:
karkaṭe śayanaṃ kuryādāgamiṣyaṃ paratrake ..
karkiṇyarke suptaharau śakrapūjāśvine bhavet .. 55 ..
meaning:
कर्कटे शयनं कुर्यादागमिष्यं परत्रके ..
कर्किण्यर्के सुप्तहरौ शक्रपूजाश्विने भवेत् .. 55 ..
text_mt: should take His rest in Cancer, intending to come in the later triad. / When the sun is in Cancer and Hari is sleeping, the worship of Indra takes place in Āśvina;

sanskrit_iast:
durgotthānaṃ tulāyāṃ tu viṣṇurnidrāṃ jahātyasau .. 56 ..
tithividhānavarṇanam
meaning:
दुर्गोत्थानं तुलायां तु विष्णुर्निद्रां जहात्यसौ .. 56 ..
तिथिविधानवर्णनम्
text_mt:
the awakening of Durgā takes place in Libra, [when] Viṣṇu abandons His sleep.
Description of the rules regarding lunar days

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
daivaṃ vā paitṛkaṃ karma kālamāśritya vartate ..
kāle tānyeva karmāṇi phalaṃ yacchaṃti kurvatām .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
दैवं वा पैतृकं कर्म कालमाश्रित्य वर्तते ..
काले तान्येव कर्माणि फलं यच्छंति कुर्वताम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / A rite for the gods or for the ancestors depends upon time; / in proper time, those very rites bestow fruit upon those who perform them.
title: adhyāyaḥ 07

sanskrit_iast:
muhurbālye karmaphalaṃ trikāle'pi na vidyate ..
vyayo vā mukhyabhāvena phaladaḥ karmaśālinām .. 2 ..
meaning:
मुहुर्बाल्ये कर्मफलं त्रिकालेऽपि न विद्यते ..
व्ययो वा मुख्यभावेन फलदः कर्मशालिनाम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: A karmic fruit repeatedly in its nascent stage does not exist even in the three divisions of time; / or expenditure primarily bears fruit for those who possess rites.

sanskrit_iast:
kālastu guṇabhāvena sarvakālāśritā kriyā ..
na kālena vinā kiñcittriṣu lokeṣu jāyate .. 3 ..
meaning:
कालस्तु गुणभावेन सर्वकालाश्रिता क्रिया ..
न कालेन विना किञ्चित्त्रिषु लोकेषु जायते .. 3 ..
text_mt: Time, however, serves as a subordinate factor, while action depends upon all time; / nothing in the three worlds comes to be without time.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ kālaṃ pravakṣyāmi nimittaṃ karmaṇāmiha .
kāle hyamūrtirbhagavāneka eva tu yadyapi ..
tathāpyupādhibhedena bhidyate kālabhedibhiḥ ..4..
meaning:
अतः कालं प्रवक्ष्यामि निमित्तं कर्मणामिह .
काले ह्यमूर्तिर्भगवानेक एव तु यद्यपि ..
तथाप्युपाधिभेदेन भिद्यते कालभेदिभिः ..4..
text_mt: Therefore I will explain time here, the cause of rites. / For though the Lord is bodiless and only one in time, / He is nevertheless differentiated by the dividers of time through differences in limiting conditions.

sanskrit_iast:
tithinakṣatravārādau rātriyogādayopi ye ..
te'pi kālāḥ pakṣamāsarāśivarṣāṃtare'pi ca ..
sādhanāni bhavantyete svātantryeṇa na kasyacit ..5..
meaning:
तिथिनक्षत्रवारादौ रात्रियोगादयोपि ये ..
तेऽपि कालाः पक्षमासराशिवर्षांतरेऽपि च ..
साधनानि भवन्त्येते स्वातन्त्र्येण न कस्यचित् ..5..
text_mt: Whatever [divisions exist] at the beginning of lunar days, asterisms, weekdays, and the combinations of night, / those times also within fortnights, months, signs, and years / become means [of rites], never through the autonomy of anyone.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmasya vāpyadharmasya mukhyo vyāpāra eva saḥ ..
tithyādikālabhāveṣu niṣiddhaṃ nihitaṃ hi tat .. 6 ..
meaning:
धर्मस्य वाप्यधर्मस्य मुख्यो व्यापार एव सः ..
तिथ्यादिकालभावेषु निषिद्धं निहितं हि तत् .. 6 ..
text_mt: That very activity is the principal element of virtue or of non-virtue; / for that which is forbidden is laid down according to the temporal conditions such as the lunar day.

sanskrit_iast:
pālayansvargamāpnoti hitvā prāpnotyadhogatim ..
sādhayaṃtyapi karmāṇi parasparamavekṣyate .. .. 7 ..
meaning:
पालयन्स्वर्गमाप्नोति हित्वा प्राप्नोत्यधोगतिम् ..
साधयंत्यपि कर्माणि परस्परमवेक्ष्यते .. .. 7 ..
text_mt: Observing it, one attains heaven; abandoning it, one attains a low state. / While rites accomplish [their ends], they are mutually observed;

sanskrit_iast:
kālabhāgo niḥsahāyo ye'pi syuḥ karmasādhanāḥ ..
tithau pūrvāhṇavyāpinyāṃ kurvīta karma vaidikam .. 8 ..
meaning:
कालभागो निःसहायो येऽपि स्युः कर्मसाधनाः ..
तिथौ पूर्वाह्णव्यापिन्यां कुर्वीत कर्म वैदिकम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: a portion of time is without assistance, whatever means of rites there may be. / On a lunar day pervading the morning, one should perform a Vedic rite.

sanskrit_iast:
ekoddiṣṭaṃ tu madhyāhnavyāpinyāṃ hi samācaret..
parāhṇavyāpinīṃ prāpya tithiṃ kuryāttu pārvaṇam .. 9 ..
meaning:
एकोद्दिष्टं तु मध्याह्नव्यापिन्यां हि समाचरेत्..
पराह्णव्यापिनीं प्राप्य तिथिं कुर्यात्तु पार्वणम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: One should perform an ekoddiṣṭa rite on [a lunar day] pervading midday; / having reached a lunar day pervading the afternoon, one should perform a pārvaṇa rite.

sanskrit_iast:
na tu pūrvāhṇamadhyāhnaparāhṇeṣu yathocitam ..
apradhāne tu kurvīta karma daivādikaṃ ca yat..2.2.7.10..
meaning:
न तु पूर्वाह्णमध्याह्नपराह्णेषु यथोचितम् ..
अप्रधाने तु कुर्वीत कर्म दैवादिकं च यत्..2.2.7.10..
text_mt: Not [irregularly], but in the forenoon, midday, and afternoon, as is fitting; / on an insignificant [lunar day], however, whatever divine or other rite there is should be performed.

sanskrit_iast:
eko hi kālaḥ prātastu vṛddhiśrāddhādisādhane ..
nāpekṣate sāhāyyaṃ tattithyādiviṣuvādiṣu ..11..
meaning:
एको हि कालः प्रातस्तु वृद्धिश्राद्धादिसाधने ..
नापेक्षते साहाय्यं तत्तिथ्यादिविषुवादिषु ..11..
text_mt: Indeed, morning is the sole time for accomplishing the vṛddhiśrāddha and the like; / that does not require assistance during equinoxes and the like, beginning with lunar days.

sanskrit_iast:
devebhyo brahmaṇā dattaḥ pūrvāhṇastithibhiḥ saha ..
pitṛbhyo hyaparāhṇastu pārvaṇaṃ tu paraṃ vinā .. 12 ..
meaning:
देवेभ्यो ब्रह्मणा दत्तः पूर्वाह्णस्तिथिभिः सह ..
पितृभ्यो ह्यपराह्णस्तु पार्वणं तु परं विना .. 12 ..
text_mt: The forenoon was given by Brahmā to the gods along with the lunar days; / the afternoon to the ancestors, without any other pārvaṇa [time].

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvāhṇamātrasaṃprāptau tato devānprapūjayet ..
pūrvāhṇasparśamātre'pi tithikhaṇḍena cārpayet ..13..
meaning:
पूर्वाह्णमात्रसंप्राप्तौ ततो देवान्प्रपूजयेत् ..
पूर्वाह्णस्पर्शमात्रेऽपि तिथिखण्डेन चार्पयेत् ..13..
text_mt: Upon reaching merely the forenoon, one should thereupon worship the gods; / even by mere contact with the forenoon, one should offer with a fraction of a lunar day.

sanskrit_iast:
kharvā darpā tathā hiṃsrā tithiśca trividhā bhavet ..
kharvādi laṃghayettulyā darpā bhavati varddhitā ..14..
meaning:
खर्वा दर्पा तथा हिंस्रा तिथिश्च त्रिविधा भवेत् ..
खर्वादि लंघयेत्तुल्या दर्पा भवति वर्द्धिता ..14..
text_mt: A lunar day is threefold: kharvā, darpā, and hiṃsrā; / kharvā is equal when transcending, darpā is increased,

sanskrit_iast:
hiṃsrā tu kṣayajā jñeyā kālabhedena gṛhyate ..
kharvā darpā pare grāhyā hiṃsrā grāhyā tu pūrvataḥ .. 16..
meaning:
हिंस्रा तु क्षयजा ज्ञेया कालभेदेन गृह्यते ..
खर्वा दर्पा परे ग्राह्या हिंस्रा ग्राह्या तु पूर्वतः .. 16..
text_mt: while hiṃsrā is to be known as born of diminution; it is taken according to division of time. / Kharvā and darpā should be taken on the subsequent [day], but hiṃsrā should be taken on the preceding [day].

sanskrit_iast:
śuklapakṣe parā grāhyā kṛṣṇe pūrvā praśasyate ..
snānadānavrate caiva viṣayogo nidarśitaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
शुक्लपक्षे परा ग्राह्या कृष्णे पूर्वा प्रशस्यते ..
स्नानदानव्रते चैव विषयोगो निदर्शितः .. 17 ..
text_mt: In the bright fortnight, the subsequent is to be taken; in the dark [fortnight], the preceding is praised. / In bathing, giving, and votive observance, the conjunction with poison is pointed out.

sanskrit_iast:
tithau codeti savitā kālamātraṃ ca vā yadi ..
anyāpi saiva vijñeyā tithistasminnaharniśam .. 16 ..
meaning:
तिथौ चोदेति सविता कालमात्रं च वा यदि ..
अन्यापि सैव विज्ञेया तिथिस्तस्मिन्नहर्निशम् .. 16 ..
text_mt:
And if the sun rises on a lunar day even for the briefest measure of time,
that very lunar day is to be known as extending for that entire day and night, even if another occurs.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāvāste ravirbhāti ghaṭikā daśa vāpi vā..
sā tithistadahorātraṃ vyapadeśyā na cetarā..19..
meaning:
यथावास्ते रविर्भाति घटिका दश वापि वा..
सा तिथिस्तदहोरात्रं व्यपदेश्या न चेतरा..19..
text_mt:
Or as the sun shines at sunset, or for even ten ghaṭikās,
that lunar day is to be designated as lasting that day and night, and no other.

sanskrit_iast:
śukle vā yadi vā kṛṣṇe kharvā darpā tithiśca yā ..
yayāstaṃ savitā yāti pitṛkārye ca sā tithiḥ .. 2.2.7.20 ..
meaning:
शुक्ले वा यदि वा कृष्णे खर्वा दर्पा तिथिश्च या ..
ययास्तं सविता याति पितृकार्ये च सा तिथिः .. 2.2.7.20 ..
text_mt:
Whether in the bright or in the dark [fortnight], whatever lunar day is a kharvā or darpā,
and by which the sun sets, that is the lunar day for ancestral rites.

sanskrit_iast:
dinadvaye'pi kutape astagāṃ tithimāśrayet ..
śrāddhakālādikaṃ yatra tatra śrāddhaṃ vidhīyate ..
vrate ca vṛddhigāminyāṃ yatrodayo raverbhavet ..21..
meaning:
दिनद्वयेऽपि कुतपे अस्तगां तिथिमाश्रयेत् ..
श्राद्धकालादिकं यत्र तत्र श्राद्धं विधीयते ..
व्रते च वृद्धिगामिन्यां यत्रोदयो रवेर्भवेत् ..21..

sanskrit_iast:
amāvāsyapārvaṇe ca sā tithiḥ pitṛpūjane ..
amāvasyāmṛtasyaiva pārvaṇaṃ yatra kutracit ..22..
meaning:
अमावास्यपार्वणे च सा तिथिः पितृपूजने ..
अमावस्यामृतस्यैव पार्वणं यत्र कुत्रचित् ..22..
text_mt:
And in the pārvaṇa rite on a new moon, that lunar day is for worshipping the ancestors;
for one who died on the new moon day, the pārvaṇa rite is performed wherever [it falls].

sanskrit_iast:
astagāmitithiryatra sā tithiḥ pitṛmaṃdiram..
ekoddiṣṭaṃ carettatra nodaye ca kadācana..23..
meaning:
अस्तगामितिथिर्यत्र सा तिथिः पितृमंदिरम्..
एकोद्दिष्टं चरेत्तत्र नोदये च कदाचन..23..
text_mt:
Where the lunar day extends to sunset, that lunar day belongs to the realm of the ancestors;
one should perform the single-ancestor rite then, and never at sunrise.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklapakṣe ca kṛṣṇe ca yo yogaḥ parapūrvayoḥ..
pūrvedyurvā paredyurvā trisaṃdhyavyāpinī tithiḥ..
sā pūjyā ca svakṛtyeṣu pakṣayorubhayorapi ..24..
meaning:
शुक्लपक्षे च कृष्णे च यो योगः परपूर्वयोः..
पूर्वेद्युर्वा परेद्युर्वा त्रिसंध्यव्यापिनी तिथिः..
सा पूज्या च स्वकृत्येषु पक्षयोरुभयोरपि ..24..
text_mt:
Both in the bright fortnight and in the dark fortnight, whatever junction occurs between the subsequent and preceding [lunar days],
a lunar day that encompasses the three twilight periods, whether on the previous day or on the following day,
is to be honoured in its respective rites in both fortnights.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjyā hi vyastaṃ saṃtyajya pūrvaṃ caikādaśīyugam ..
dvitīyā vahninā yuktā caturthī paṃcamīyutā .. .. 25 ..
meaning:
पूज्या हि व्यस्तं संत्यज्य पूर्वं चैकादशीयुगम् ..
द्वितीया वह्निना युक्ता चतुर्थी पंचमीयुता .. .. 25 ..
text_mt:
Indeed, having abandoned the reversed conjunction, the pair of the preceding and the ekādaśī should be honoured,
and the dvitīyā joined with the third, the caturthī joined with the fifth;

sanskrit_iast:
etā upoṣyāstithayaḥ puṇyāḥ syurdharmavedibhiḥ ..
etadvyastāstu puṇyāni ghnaṃti pūrvakṛtānyapi .. 26 ..
meaning:
एता उपोष्यास्तिथयः पुण्याः स्युर्धर्मवेदिभिः ..
एतद्व्यस्तास्तु पुण्यानि घ्नंति पूर्वकृतान्यपि .. 26 ..
text_mt:
these lunar days should be fasted on as auspicious by those who know the dharma;
when reversed from this, however, they destroy even merit accumulated previously.

sanskrit_iast:
bāṇena viddhā yā ṣaṣṭhī munividdhā tathāṣṭamī ..
daśamyekādaśīviddhā trayodaśyā caturdaśī .. 27 ..
meaning:
बाणेन विद्धा या षष्ठी मुनिविद्धा तथाष्टमी ..
दशम्येकादशीविद्धा त्रयोदश्या चतुर्दशी .. 27 ..
text_mt:
The ṣaṣṭhī overlapped by the fifth, likewise the aṣṭamī overlapped by the seventh,
the daśamī overlapped by the ekādaśī, the caturdaśī by the trayodaśī,

sanskrit_iast:
amāvāsyā bhūtaviddhā nopoṣyā munināpi ca ..
haṃti putrakalatrāṇi dhanāni samupoṣitā .. 28 ..
meaning:
अमावास्या भूतविद्धा नोपोष्या मुनिनापि च ..
हंति पुत्रकलत्राणि धनानि समुपोषिता .. 28 ..
text_mt:
and the new moon day overlapped by the fourteenth should not be fasted upon even by an ascetic;
when fasted upon, it destroys sons, wives, and wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
viddhā ye nābhinindyāḥ syuryuktāstenābhinanditāḥ ..
vyastasya saṃbhave yugmaṃ viddhā bhavati sarvaśaḥ ..29..
meaning:
विद्धा ये नाभिनिन्द्याः स्युर्युक्तास्तेनाभिनन्दिताः ..
व्यस्तस्य संभवे युग्मं विद्धा भवति सर्वशः ..29..
text_mt:
Those that are overlapped would not be censured [if proper], and those joined with them are praised;
if a reversed order occurs, the pair becomes overlapped in every way.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmastāṃ tu tithiṃ prāpya yugmānyapūjyatāmiyuḥ ..
yugmāni ca divāyoge grāhyāṇi vyastaniṃdanam .. 2.2.7.30 ..
meaning:
तामस्तां तु तिथिं प्राप्य युग्मान्यपूज्यतामियुः ..
युग्मानि च दिवायोगे ग्राह्याणि व्यस्तनिंदनम् .. 2.2.7.30 ..
text_mt:
Reaching that setting lunar day, pairs would become unworthy of worship;
and pairs are to be accepted in conjunction with daytime; censure applies to the reversed [order].

sanskrit_iast:
naktādivratayoge tu divāsaṃvarddhamarkarān ..
