rātriyogaścaturthyostu viśiṣya parigṛhyate .. 31 ..
meaning:
नक्तादिव्रतयोगे तु दिवासंवर्द्धमर्करान् ..
रात्रियोगश्चतुर्थ्योस्तु विशिष्य परिगृह्यते .. 31 ..
text_mt:
In the conjunction of a votive observance such as a nocturnal meal, the sun's rays increase during the day;
and the night-conjunction of the two caturthīs is especially accepted.

sanskrit_iast:
rātriyogaṃ vināpi syādekādaśyādikaṃ vratam ..
naktaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ caiva vināyoge'pi śasyate .. 32 ..
meaning:
रात्रियोगं विनापि स्यादेकादश्यादिकं व्रतम् ..
नक्तं जागरणं चैव विनायोगेऽपि शस्यते .. 32 ..
text_mt:
Even without night-conjunction, a votive observance such as ekādaśī may occur;
a nocturnal meal and a vigil are praised even without such conjunction.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyupavāsaṃ tu dvādaśīyogataścaret ..
divāyoge tu saṃpūrṇāṃ tyajedubhayapūrvataḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
एकादश्युपवासं तु द्वादशीयोगतश्चरेत् ..
दिवायोगे तु संपूर्णां त्यजेदुभयपूर्वतः .. 33 ..
text_mt:
One should observe the fast of ekādaśī in conjunction with dvādaśī;
if it is complete in daytime conjunction, one should abandon it before both.

sanskrit_iast:
rātriyoge tu saṃpūrṇā sopāsyaikādaśī sadā ..
saptamī śukla pakṣe'pi pūjyā ṣaṣṭhyā samanvitā .. 34 ..
meaning:
रात्रियोगे तु संपूर्णा सोपास्यैकादशी सदा ..
सप्तमी शुक्ल पक्षेऽपि पूज्या षष्ठ्या समन्विता .. 34 ..
text_mt:
When it is complete in conjunction with night, that ekādaśī is always to be observed;
in the bright fortnight too, saptamī joined with ṣaṣṭhī is to be honoured.

sanskrit_iast:
niśi tu syādyadā ṣaṣṭhī saptamī navamī divā ..
upoṣya kevalāṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ toṣayedbhāskaraṃ naraḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
निशि तु स्याद्यदा षष्ठी सप्तमी नवमी दिवा ..
उपोष्य केवलां षष्ठीं तोषयेद्भास्करं नरः .. 35 ..
text_mt:
When the ṣaṣṭhī falls at night, and the saptamī and navamī during the day,
a person should fast on the isolated ṣaṣṭhī and propitiate the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ trayodaśīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ vidhiprāptāṃ vinā dvijāḥ ..
upoṣya pārvatīnāthaṃ toṣayedyaśca kevalam ..36 ..
meaning:
एवं त्रयोदशीं कृष्णां विधिप्राप्तां विना द्विजाः ..
उपोष्य पार्वतीनाथं तोषयेद्यश्च केवलम् ..36 ..
text_mt:
Likewise, O twice-born, without the prescribed dark trayodaśī,
fasting on it alone, one propitiates the lord of Pārvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
divā trayodaśīyuktā kṛṣṇopoṣyā caturdaśī ..
pareṇāpi caturdaśyā na tu kuryādamātithau ..37..
meaning:
दिवा त्रयोदशीयुक्ता कृष्णोपोष्या चतुर्दशी ..
परेणापि चतुर्दश्या न तु कुर्यादमातिथौ ..37..
text_mt:
The dark caturdaśī joined with trayodaśī during the day is to be fasted upon;
and one should not perform it on the new moon day with a subsequent caturdaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
trisaṃdhyavyāpinī prāpya yadi kuryādupauṣaṇam ..
pāraṇaṃ tu sinīvālyāṃ caturdaśyāmupoṣayet..38..
meaning:
त्रिसंध्यव्यापिनी प्राप्य यदि कुर्यादुपौषणम् ..
पारणं तु सिनीवाल्यां चतुर्दश्यामुपोषयेत्..38..
text_mt:
If one undertakes a fast having reached [a lunar day] encompassing the three twilight periods,
one should break the fast on the sinīvālī, fasting on the caturdaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaśīmatikramya sinīvālyāṃ tu pāraṇāt..
vratāni tasya naśyaṃti prākṛtāni caturdaśīm ..39..
meaning:
चतुर्दशीमतिक्रम्य सिनीवाल्यां तु पारणात्..
व्रतानि तस्य नश्यंति प्राकृतानि चतुर्दशीम् ..39..
text_mt:
Because of breaking the fast on the sinīvālī after transgressing the caturdaśī,
his ordinary votive observances of the caturdaśī perish.

sanskrit_iast:
saptamī lalitā bhādre śaktotthānaṃ ca vāruṇī ..
pūjyāścaitāḥ parāḥ kuryāttrisaṃdhyavyāpinīṣvapi ..2.2.7.40..
meaning:
सप्तमी ललिता भाद्रे शक्तोत्थानं च वारुणी ..
पूज्याश्चैताः पराः कुर्यात्त्रिसंध्यव्यापिनीष्वपि ..2.2.7.40..
text_mt:
The Lalitā-saptamī in the month of Bhādra, the raising of Indra's banner, and the Vāruṇī:
these subsequent ones should be honoured, even when [the previous] encompasses the three twilight periods.

sanskrit_iast:
trisaṃdhyāvyāpinī pūrve parato varddhate yadi ..
saṛkṣā ṛkṣayoge tu ṛkṣābhāve parā yutā..41..
meaning:
त्रिसंध्याव्यापिनी पूर्वे परतो वर्द्धते यदि ..
सऋक्षा ऋक्षयोगे तु ऋक्षाभावे परा युता..41..
text_mt:
If [a lunar day] encompassing the three twilight periods occurs previously and increases further,
it is observed with the asterism when joined with the asterism, or the subsequent one is joined when the asterism is absent.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛkṣābhāve parā grāhyā trisaṃdhyavyāpinīṣvapi ..
śrāvaṇe cādyapāde tu praśastā śakrapūjane ..42..
meaning:
ऋक्षाभावे परा ग्राह्या त्रिसंध्यव्यापिनीष्वपि ..
श्रावणे चाद्यपादे तु प्रशस्ता शक्रपूजने ..42..
text_mt:
In the absence of the asterism, the subsequent one is to be accepted, even among those encompassing the three twilight periods;
and in the first quarter of Śrāvaṇa, it is praised in the worship of Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
abhāve cottarāṣāḍhā dhaniṣṭhā ca viśiṣyate ..
daṇḍārdhaṃ daṇḍamekaṃ vā tadardhaṃ palameva vā ..43..
meaning:
अभावे चोत्तराषाढा धनिष्ठा च विशिष्यते ..
दण्डार्धं दण्डमेकं वा तदर्धं पलमेव वा ..43..
text_mt:
In its absence, Uttarāṣāḍhā and Dhaniṣṭhā are distinguished;
for half a daṇḍa, or one daṇḍa, or half of that, or even a pala,

sanskrit_iast:
udaye saṃyutā grāhyā sā tithiścottamā bhavet ..
trisaṃdhyavyāpinīṃ hitvā pūjyā śuklāṣṭamī parā ..44..
meaning:
उदये संयुता ग्राह्या सा तिथिश्चोत्तमा भवेत् ..
त्रिसंध्यव्यापिनीं हित्वा पूज्या शुक्लाष्टमी परा ..44..
text_mt:
joined at sunrise, that lunar day is to be taken and becomes excellent;
setting aside one encompassing the three twilight periods, the subsequent bright aṣṭamī is to be honoured.

sanskrit_iast:
ravicakravatā grāhyā rathe tithyāderapi ca ..
trisaṃdhyavyāpinī yā tu palamekaṃ pare dine ..45..
meaning:
रविचक्रवता ग्राह्या रथे तिथ्यादेरपि च ..
त्रिसंध्यव्यापिनी या तु पलमेकं परे दिने ..45..
text_mt:
It is to be observed on a chariot with the disc of the sun on the lunar day and the like;
that which encompasses the three twilight periods, even for one pala on the following day,

sanskrit_iast:
apare'pi ca sarvatra halānāṃ vāhanaṃ tyajet..
śuklaikādaśyamāvāsyāsaṃkrāntyāṃ śrāddhavāsare ..46..
meaning:
अपरेऽपि च सर्वत्र हलानां वाहनं त्यजेत्..
शुक्लैकादश्यमावास्यासंक्रान्त्यां श्राद्धवासरे ..46..
text_mt:
and everywhere on the other day, one should avoid driving ploughs;
on the bright ekādaśī, the new moon, a solstice, and on the day of a śrāddha,

sanskrit_iast: narāśvagogajādīnāṃ vāhanātpātakī bhavet ..47..
meaning: नराश्वगोगजादीनां वाहनात्पातकी भवेत् ..47..
text_mt: from driving men, horses, cattle, elephants, and the like, one becomes a sinner.

sanskrit_iast:
karturgomahiṣādīnāṃ gardabhoṣṭrakharasya ca ..
na vāhayeddāsa dāsī vāhanenāsti dūṣaṇam .. 48 ..
meaning:
कर्तुर्गोमहिषादीनां गर्दभोष्ट्रखरस्य च ..
न वाहयेद्दास दासी वाहनेनास्ति दूषणम् .. 48 ..
text_mt:
For the agent, [regarding] cattle, buffaloes, and the like, donkeys, camels, and asses,
he should not cause them to be driven; there is no blame in being driven by a male or female slave.

sanskrit_iast:
bahukālikayajñe ca yajñaśrāddhe tathaiva ca ..
grāmāṃtare na doṣaḥ syāddivi nadyaṃtare'pi ca .. 49 ..
meaning:
बहुकालिकयज्ञे च यज्ञश्राद्धे तथैव च ..
ग्रामांतरे न दोषः स्याद्दिवि नद्यंतरेऽपि च .. 49 ..
text_mt:
In a prolonged sacrifice, and likewise in a sacrificial śrāddha,
there is no fault in another village, in the sky, or across a river.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaśrāddhe'pyambughaṭe yacchrāddhaṃ māsikaṃ bhavet ..
tatra gomahiṣādīnāṃ vāhane nāsti dūṣaṇam .. 2.2.7.50 ..
meaning:
नित्यश्राद्धेऽप्यम्बुघटे यच्छ्राद्धं मासिकं भवेत् ..
तत्र गोमहिषादीनां वाहने नास्ति दूषणम् .. 2.2.7.50 ..
text_mt:
In a daily śrāddha, and also in the water-jar rite which is a monthly śrāddha,
there is no fault in driving cattle, buffaloes, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryādaṃbughaṭaśrāddhaṃ na kālaniyamaṃ kvacit ..
na cānnaniyamaṃ kuryādaśmapātraṃ ca varjayet .. 51 ..
meaning:
कुर्यादंबुघटश्राद्धं न कालनियमं क्वचित् ..
न चान्ननियमं कुर्यादश्मपात्रं च वर्जयेत् .. 51 ..
text_mt:
One should perform the water-jar śrāddha with no fixed rule of time anywhere;
one should not observe a restriction of food, and one should avoid a stone vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
taijasairnirmitaṃ kumbhamatha vā vṛkṣapatrajam ..
na yojayenmṛnmayaṃ ca śūdrāṇāṃ mṛnmaye vidhiḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
तैजसैर्निर्मितं कुम्भमथ वा वृक्षपत्रजम् ..
न योजयेन्मृन्मयं च शूद्राणां मृन्मये विधिः .. 52 ..
text_mt:
A jar made of metal or produced from tree leaves [is used];
one must not employ an earthen one; an earthen one is the rule for Śūdras.

sanskrit_iast:
nivedayecca māsāṃte mṛnmayaṃ vṛkṣamūlake ..
āsphālayetpareṇaiva na vastraṃ tu kathañcana ..
parvaśrāddhe daivalakaṃ tathā raṇḍāśramaṃ tyajet .. 53 ..
meaning:
निवेदयेच्च मासांते मृन्मयं वृक्षमूलके ..
आस्फालयेत्परेणैव न वस्त्रं तु कथञ्चन ..
पर्वश्राद्धे दैवलकं तथा रण्डाश्रमं त्यजेत् .. 53 ..

sanskrit_iast:
mātāpitṛparityāgī tailahavyādivikrayī ..
catvāriṃśadutsavānāṃ sāṣṭānāṃ ca caredyadi .. 54 ..
meaning:
मातापितृपरित्यागी तैलहव्यादिविक्रयी ..
चत्वारिंशदुत्सवानां साष्टानां च चरेद्यदि .. 54 ..
text_mt:
One who abandons mother and father, one who sells oil, sacrificial oblations, and the like,
if he celebrates forty-eight festivals,

sanskrit_iast:
striyā vimucyate kaścitsa tu raṇḍāśramī mataḥ ..
aṣṭacatvāriṃśadabdaṃ vayo yāvanna pūryate .. 55 ..
meaning:
स्त्रिया विमुच्यते कश्चित्स तु रण्डाश्रमी मतः ..
अष्टचत्वारिंशदब्दं वयो यावन्न पूर्यते .. 55 ..
text_mt:
or if someone is deserted by his wife, he is considered a widower,
as long as he has not reached the age of forty-eight years.

sanskrit_iast: putrabhāryāviyuktasya nāsti yajñādhikāritā .. 56 ..
meaning: पुत्रभार्यावियुक्तस्य नास्ति यज्ञाधिकारिता .. 56 ..
text_mt: For one devoid of son and wife, there is no eligibility for Vedic sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
yāṃ tithiṃ samanuprāpya samudeti divākaraḥ ..
snānādhyayanadāneṣu sā tithiḥ sakalā smṛtā .. 57 ..
meaning:
यां तिथिं समनुप्राप्य समुदेति दिवाकरः ..
स्नानाध्ययनदानेषु सा तिथिः सकला स्मृता .. 57 ..
text_mt:
The lunar day upon reaching which the sun rises,
is remembered as complete for bathing, Vedic study, and giving.

sanskrit_iast:
yayāstaṃ savitā yāti kṛṣṇapakṣe tu sā tithiḥ ..
pitṝṇāṃ sakalā jñeyā snānadānādikarmasu .. .. 58 ..
meaning:
ययास्तं सविता याति कृष्णपक्षे तु सा तिथिः ..
पितॄणां सकला ज्ञेया स्नानदानादिकर्मसु .. .. 58 ..
text_mt:
The lunar day in the dark fortnight, however, with which the sun sets,
is known as complete for the ancestors in rites of bathing, giving, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
saptamī śuklapakṣe yā yāvadicchecca khaṇḍitā ..
ādyabhāge raveḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ parādau yāṣṭamīyutā ..
yadyakhaṇḍā bhavetsaiva tadā jñeyā bhavātmikā .. 59 ..
meaning:
सप्तमी शुक्लपक्षे या यावदिच्छेच्च खण्डिता ..
आद्यभागे रवेः षष्ठ्यां परादौ याष्टमीयुता ..
यद्यखण्डा भवेत्सैव तदा ज्ञेया भवात्मिका .. 59 ..
text_mt:
Whatever saptamī in the bright fortnight is interrupted, for as long as one desires,
joined with ṣaṣṭhī in the sun's first part, and with aṣṭamī at the beginning of the next,
if it should be uninterrupted, then it is known as dedicated to Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
māghamāsena sāpyevaṃ pūrveṇa ravitoṣiṇī ..
manvaṃtarā pareṇaiva snānapānādikarmasu .. 2.2.7.60 ..
uttamatithinirṇayavarṇanam
meaning:
माघमासेन साप्येवं पूर्वेण रवितोषिणी ..
मन्वंतरा परेणैव स्नानपानादिकर्मसु .. 2.2.7.60 ..
उत्तमतिथिनिर्णयवर्णनम्

sanskrit_iast:
..sūta uvāca .. ..
tithīnāṃ pravarā yasmādbrahmaṇā samudāhṛtā ..
pratipāditā pare pūrve pratipādya navodyate .. 1 ..
meaning:
..सूत उवाच .. ..
तिथीनां प्रवरा यस्माद्ब्रह्मणा समुदाहृता ..
प्रतिपादिता परे पूर्वे प्रतिपाद्य नवोद्यते .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Because the best among lunar days was proclaimed by Brahmā, / declared after the preceding one, the first lunar day is celebrated anew.
title: adhyāyaḥ 08

sanskrit_iast:
kārtikāśvayujoścaitre māghe cāpi viśeṣataḥ ..
snānaṃ dānaṃ daśaguṇaṃ śivaviṣṇvośca pūjanam .. 2 ..
meaning:
कार्तिकाश्वयुजोश्चैत्रे माघे चापि विशेषतः ..
स्नानं दानं दशगुणं शिवविष्ण्वोश्च पूजनम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: In Kārtika and Āśvayuja, and especially in Caitra and Māgha, / bathing, giving gifts, and worship of Śiva and Viṣṇu are tenfold [in fruit].

sanskrit_iast:
agnimiṣṭvā ca kṛtvā ca pratipadyāmiti smṛtam ..
haviṣā sarvadhānyāni prāpnuyādīpsitaṃ dhanam .. 3 ..
meaning:
अग्निमिष्ट्वा च कृत्वा च प्रतिपद्यामिति स्मृतम् ..
हविषा सर्वधान्यानि प्राप्नुयादीप्सितं धनम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Having sacrificed to fire and performed it, this is remembered on the first lunar day: / by means of sacrificial offering, one obtains all kinds of grain and desired wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatau dvitīyāyāṃ śuklāyāṃ vidhipūjanam ..
kṛtvā naktaṃ samaśnīyāllabhate bhūtimīpsitām ..4..
meaning:
बृहस्पतौ द्वितीयायां शुक्लायां विधिपूजनम् ..
कृत्वा नक्तं समश्नीयाल्लभते भूतिमीप्सिताम् ..4..
text_mt: When the second lunar day of the bright fortnight falls on a Thursday, having performed worship according to rule, / one should take a nocturnal meal; one obtains desired prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
mithune karkaṭe caiva govipradamanāṃtaram ..
dvitīyā yā tu vipreṃdāstāmupoṣya hariṃ yajet ..
yāmupoṣya na vaidhavyaṃ prayāti strī na saṃśayaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
मिथुने कर्कटे चैव गोविप्रदमनांतरम् ..
द्वितीया या तु विप्रेंदास्तामुपोष्य हरिं यजेत् ..
यामुपोष्य न वैधव्यं प्रयाति स्त्री न संशयः .. 5 ..
text_mt: In Gemini and Cancer, after subduing cows and Brahmins, / having fasted on that second lunar day, O best of Brahmins, one should worship Hari; / having fasted on which, a woman does not incur widowhood, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
amūlyaśayanaṃ māsaṃ daṃpatī pratipūjayet ..
vāsobhirgandhapuṣpaiśca nānābhakṣyaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
अमूल्यशयनं मासं दंपती प्रतिपूजयेत् ..
वासोभिर्गन्धपुष्पैश्च नानाभक्ष्यैः पृथग्विधैः .. 6 ..
text_mt: One should honour a married couple for a month with priceless bedding, / with garments, fragrant flowers, and various kinds of assorted eatables.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśākhe śuklapakṣe tu tṛtīyāyāṃ tathaiva ca ..
gaṃgātoye naraḥ snātvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ..7..
meaning:
वैशाखे शुक्लपक्षे तु तृतीयायां तथैव च ..
गंगातोये नरः स्नात्वा मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः ..7..
text_mt: In Vaiśākha, in the bright fortnight, and likewise on the third lunar day, / a man having bathed in Gaṅgā water is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
svātiyuktatṛtīyāyāṃ vaiśākhe tu viśeṣataḥ ..
māghe tu rohiṇīyuktā vṛṣe cāśvayuje tathā .. 8 ..
meaning:
स्वातियुक्ततृतीयायां वैशाखे तु विशेषतः ..
माघे तु रोहिणीयुक्ता वृषे चाश्वयुजे तथा .. 8 ..
text_mt: On the third lunar day conjoined with Svāti, especially in Vaiśākha, / but in Māgha conjoined with Rohiṇī, and likewise in Taurus and in Āśvayuja,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ yaddīyate kiñcittadakṣayamudāhṛtam ..
viśeṣato haviṣyānnaṃ modakādisamāyutam ..9..
meaning:
तस्यां यद्दीयते किञ्चित्तदक्षयमुदाहृतम् ..
विशेषतो हविष्यान्नं मोदकादिसमायुतम् ..9..
text_mt: whatever is given on that day is declared imperishable, / especially food suitable for sacrifice accompanied by modakas and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
toyadānaṃ viśeṣeṇa praśaṃsaṃti manīṣiṇaḥ ..
guḍakarpūrasaṃyuktaṃ brahmaloke mahīyate .. 2.2.8.10 ..
meaning:
तोयदानं विशेषेण प्रशंसंति मनीषिणः ..
गुडकर्पूरसंयुक्तं ब्रह्मलोके महीयते .. 2.2.8.10 ..
text_mt: The wise especially praise the gift of water; / [when given] accompanied by jaggery and camphor, one is magnified in the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā tṛtīyā yadi labhyate ..
tasyāṃ snānopavāsādyamakṣayaṃ parikīrtitam ..11..
meaning:
बुधश्रवणसंयुक्ता तृतीया यदि लभ्यते ..
तस्यां स्नानोपवासाद्यमक्षयं परिकीर्तितम् ..11..
text_mt: If a third lunar day is obtained conjoined with Mercury and Śravaṇa, / bathing, fasting, and the like performed upon it are proclaimed imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthībharaṇīyoge bhaveccaradinaṃ yadā ..
tadābhyarcya yamaṃ devaṃ mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
चतुर्थीभरणीयोगे भवेच्चरदिनं यदा ..
तदाभ्यर्च्य यमं देवं मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः .. 12 ..
text_mt: When there is a conjunction of the fourth lunar day with Bharaṇī on a Tuesday, / then, having worshipped the god Yama, one is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
śivā śāṃtā sukhā caiva caturthī trividhā smṛtā ..
sāpi bhādrapade śuklā śivaloke supūjitā .. 13 ..
meaning:
शिवा शांता सुखा चैव चतुर्थी त्रिविधा स्मृता ..
सापि भाद्रपदे शुक्ला शिवलोके सुपूजिता .. 13 ..
text_mt: Śivā, Śāntā, and Sukhā: the fourth lunar day is known to be of three kinds; / that one too in the bright fortnight of Bhādrapada is well-honoured in the world of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
kārttike tu bhavecchāyā tathā māghe tu kīrtyate ..
tasyāṃ snānaṃ tapo dānamupavāso japastathā ..
bhavetsahasraguṇitaṃ śrāddhaṃ bhavati cākṣayam .. 14 ..
meaning:
कार्त्तिके तु भवेच्छाया तथा माघे तु कीर्त्यते ..
तस्यां स्नानं तपो दानमुपवासो जपस्तथा ..
भवेत्सहस्रगुणितं श्राद्धं भवति चाक्षयम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: In Kārttika it becomes Chāyā, and likewise it is proclaimed in Māgha; / bathing, austerity, gift-giving, fasting, and recitation of mantras upon it / becomes multiplied a thousandfold, and an ancestral rite becomes imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśe kārayetpūjāṃ modakādibhirādarāt ..
caturthyāṃ vighnanāśāya sarvakāmaprasiddhaye .. 15 ..
meaning:
गणेशे कारयेत्पूजां मोदकादिभिरादरात् ..
चतुर्थ्यां विघ्ननाशाय सर्वकामप्रसिद्धये .. 15 ..
text_mt: One should respectfully arrange worship to Gaṇeśa with modakas and the like / on the fourth lunar day for the destruction of obstacles and the attainment of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvaṇe māsi pañcamyāṃ śuklapakṣe viśeṣataḥ ..
snāpayennavanāgāṃśca gaṃdhatoyaiḥ sugaṃdhibhiḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
श्रावणे मासि पञ्चम्यां शुक्लपक्षे विशेषतः ..
स्नापयेन्नवनागांश्च गंधतोयैः सुगंधिभिः .. 16 ..
text_mt: In the month of Śrāvaṇa, especially on the fifth lunar day of the bright fortnight, / one should bathe the nine serpents with fragrant, perfumed water.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ kule prayacchaṃti abhayaṃ prāṇarakṣaṇam .. 17 ..
meaning: तेषां कुले प्रयच्छंति अभयं प्राणरक्षणम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: They bestow fearlessness and preservation of life upon their family.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyobhayalekhe ca gomayena viśeṣataḥ ..
pūjayeddadhidugdhādyaiḥ siṃdūrairapi bhaktitaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
द्वादश्योभयलेखे च गोमयेन विशेषतः ..
पूजयेद्दधिदुग्धाद्यैः सिंदूरैरपि भक्तितः .. 18 ..
text_mt: And on the twelfth, in both drawings [made] especially with cow dung, / one should worship with curds, milk, and the like, and also with vermilion, with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
supte janārdane kṛṣṇapañcamyāṃ bhavanāṃgaṇe ..
pūjayenmanasādevīṃ vāmāṃ snuhīti saṃśrayām .. 19 ..
meaning:
सुप्ते जनार्दने कृष्णपञ्चम्यां भवनांगणे ..
पूजयेन्मनसादेवीं वामां स्नुहीति संश्रयाम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: When Janārdana is asleep, on the fifth lunar day of the dark fortnight, in the courtyard of the house / one should worship the left-sided goddess Manasā, resorting to the snuhī plant.

sanskrit_iast:
picumaṃdasya patrāṇi sthāpayedbhavanodare ..
pūjayitvā naro devīṃ na sarpabhayamāpnu yāt .. 2.2.8.20 ..
meaning:
पिचुमंदस्य पत्राणि स्थापयेद्भवनोदरे ..
पूजयित्वा नरो देवीं न सर्पभयमाप्नु यात् .. 2.2.8.20 ..
text_mt: One should place leaves of the neem tree inside the house; / having worshipped the goddess, a man will not incur fear of snakes.

sanskrit_iast:
yeyaṃ bhādrapade ṣaṣṭhī ṣaṣṭhī ca dvijasattama ..
snānadānādikaṃ tasyāṃ sarvamakṣayamucyate .. 21 ..
meaning:
येयं भाद्रपदे षष्ठी षष्ठी च द्विजसत्तम ..
स्नानदानादिकं तस्यां सर्वमक्षयमुच्यते .. 21 ..
text_mt: This sixth lunar day which falls in Bhādrapada, O best of the twice-born— / bathing, gift-giving, and the like on that sixth lunar day are all said to be imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ phalāśano viprā viśeṣānmāghakārtike ..
iha cāmutra mukhyāṃ ca labhate khyātimuttamām .. 22 ..
meaning:
षष्ठ्यां फलाशनो विप्रा विशेषान्माघकार्तिके ..
इह चामुत्र मुख्यां च लभते ख्यातिमुत्तमाम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: Eating fruit on the sixth lunar day, O Brahmins, especially in Māgha and Kārtika, / one obtains prominent, supreme renown both in this world and in the next.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhe pakṣe ca saptamyāṃ yadā saṃkramate raviḥ ....
mahājayā tadā syādvai saptamī bhāskarapriyā .. 23 ..
meaning:
शुद्धे पक्षे च सप्तम्यां यदा संक्रमते रविः ....
महाजया तदा स्याद्वै सप्तमी भास्करप्रिया .. 23 ..
text_mt: When the sun enters [a sign] on the seventh lunar day in the pure fortnight, / then indeed it is Mahājayā, the seventh lunar day dear to the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
aparājitā tu bhādrasya mahāpātakanāśinī ..
lalitā kevalā jñeyā putrapautra vivarddhinī .. 24 ..
meaning:
अपराजिता तु भाद्रस्य महापातकनाशिनी ..
ललिता केवला ज्ञेया पुत्रपौत्र विवर्द्धिनी .. 24 ..
text_mt: Aparājitā of Bhādra destroys great sins; / Lalitā alone is to be known as increasing sons and grandsons.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklā vā yadi vā kṛṣṇā ṣaṣṭhī vā saptamī tu vā ..
ravivāreṇa saṃyuktā tithiḥ puṇyatamā smṛtā .. 25 ..
meaning:
शुक्ला वा यदि वा कृष्णा षष्ठी वा सप्तमी तु वा ..
रविवारेण संयुक्ता तिथिः पुण्यतमा स्मृता .. 25 ..
text_mt: Whether bright or dark, whether the sixth or the seventh lunar day, / conjoined with a Sunday, the lunar day is remembered as most sacred.

sanskrit_iast:
āśvinasya sitāṣṭamyāmaṣṭādaśabhujāṃ yajet ..
kārttike śuklapakṣe vā mahāvibhavavistaraiḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
आश्विनस्य सिताष्टम्यामष्टादशभुजां यजेत् ..
कार्त्तिके शुक्लपक्षे वा महाविभवविस्तरैः .. 26 ..
text_mt: On the bright aṣṭamī of Āśvina, or in the bright fortnight of Kārttika, / one should worship the eighteen-armed [goddess] with great displays of wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe māsi śuklāṣṭamyāṃ ca caṃḍikām ..
prātaḥ snātvārcayedbhaktyā rātrau saṃsnāpayeddvijāḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
आषाढे श्रावणे मासि शुक्लाष्टम्यां च चंडिकाम् ..
प्रातः स्नात्वार्चयेद्भक्त्या रात्रौ संस्नापयेद्द्विजाः .. 27 ..
text_mt: And on the bright aṣṭamī in the months of Āṣāḍha and Śrāvaṇa, having bathed in the morning, / one should worship Caṇḍikā with devotion, O twice-born, and bathe her at night.

sanskrit_iast:
caitramāsi sitāṣṭamyāmaśokakusumairdvijāḥ ..
arcayenmṛnmayīṃ devīmaśokārthaṃ ca sarvadā .. 28 ..
meaning:
चैत्रमासि सिताष्टम्यामशोककुसुमैर्द्विजाः ..
अर्चयेन्मृन्मयीं देवीमशोकार्थं च सर्वदा .. 28 ..
text_mt: In the month of Caitra, on the bright aṣṭamī, with aśoka blossoms, O twice-born, / one should worship the clay goddess always for the sake of freedom from sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
satyaṣṭamamuhūrte vā rohiṇīsahitāṣṭamī ..
śrāvaṇe māsi siṃhārke kvacitsāpi ca śasyate .. 29 ..
meaning:
सत्यष्टममुहूर्ते वा रोहिणीसहिताष्टमी ..
श्रावणे मासि सिंहार्के क्वचित्सापि च शस्यते .. 29 ..
text_mt: Or when the eighth muhūrta is present, an aṣṭamī conjoined with Rohiṇī / in the month of Śrāvaṇa when the sun is in Leo is also occasionally praised.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśīnāṃ koṭīnāṃ vrataiśca labhate phalam..
ato daśaguṇaṃ proktaṃ kṛtvaitatphalamāpnuyāta .. 2.2.8.30 ..
meaning:
एकादशीनां कोटीनां व्रतैश्च लभते फलम्..
अतो दशगुणं प्रोक्तं कृत्वैतत्फलमाप्नुयात .. 2.2.8.30 ..
text_mt: The fruit one obtains through the votive observances of crores of ekādaśīs, / tenfold that is declared: having performed this, one obtains that fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
aśakto'nyakriyāṃ kartumupavāsaṃ tu kevalam ..
kṛtvā vimucyate pāpātsaptakṛtyakṛtāṃ varaḥ ..31..
meaning:
अशक्तोऽन्यक्रियां कर्तुमुपवासं तु केवलम् ..
कृत्वा विमुच्यते पापात्सप्तकृत्यकृतां वरः ..31..
text_mt: If unable to perform other rites, having observed a mere fast, / the best of performers of the seven rites is freed from sin.

sanskrit_iast:
na kālaniyamastatra na vāraniyamaḥ kvacit ..
nāpi nakṣatradoṣo'sti vāradoṣo na gaṇyate .. 32 ..
meaning:
न कालनियमस्तत्र न वारनियमः क्वचित् ..
नापि नक्षत्रदोषोऽस्ति वारदोषो न गण्यते .. 32 ..
text_mt: There is no restriction of time in that regard, nor any restriction of day anywhere; / there is neither fault of asterism, nor is fault of weekday counted.

sanskrit_iast:
trikālaṃ pūjayeddevaṃ divā rātrau viśeṣataḥ ..
ardharātre viśeṣeṇa puṣpairnānāvidhairapi ..33..
meaning:
त्रिकालं पूजयेद्देवं दिवा रात्रौ विशेषतः ..
अर्धरात्रे विशेषेण पुष्पैर्नानाविधैरपि ..33..
text_mt: One should worship the god at the three junctures of the day, by day and especially at night, / particularly at midnight, with flowers of various kinds.

sanskrit_iast:
divā titheralābhe tu na kuryādvidhivadvratam ..
rātrisparśe yadi paraṃ rajanyāmapi cāṣṭamī ..34..
meaning:
दिवा तिथेरलाभे तु न कुर्याद्विधिवद्व्रतम् ..
रात्रिस्पर्शे यदि परं रजन्यामपि चाष्टमी ..34..
text_mt: If the lunar day is not obtained by day, one should not perform the votive observance according to rule; / only if there is contact at night, even if the aṣṭamī falls in the night.

sanskrit_iast:
saptamī sārdhayāmaṃ ca rohiṇī vā na saṃspṛśet..
vratī saṃkalpayettatra na ca rātrau kadācana..35..
meaning:
सप्तमी सार्धयामं च रोहिणी वा न संस्पृशेत्..
व्रती संकल्पयेत्तत्र न च रात्रौ कदाचन..35..
text_mt: If the seventh lunar day or Rohiṇī touches half a watch, / the observer of the votive observance should formulate the intention there, and never at night.

sanskrit_iast:
prāgāraṃbhaṃ prakurvīta adhimātrādhike vratī ..
viśvanāthādidevānāṃ darśanaṃ prāgvivarjayet..36..
meaning:
प्रागारंभं प्रकुर्वीत अधिमात्राधिके व्रती ..
विश्वनाथादिदेवानां दर्शनं प्राग्विवर्जयेत्..36..
text_mt: The observer of the votive observance should make the commencement earlier when it exceeds the measure; / one should beforehand avoid the sight of gods such as Viśvanātha.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra tatropavāsī syādyāmāṣṭakavrataṃ caret..
yāmārdhaṃ tatparaṃ yāme pāraṇaṃ vicaredvratī..37..
meaning:
यत्र तत्रोपवासी स्याद्यामाष्टकव्रतं चरेत्..
यामार्धं तत्परं यामे पारणं विचरेद्व्रती..37..
text_mt: Wherever he may be, he should be fasting and observe the votive observance of eight watches; / for half a watch, and in the watch after that, the observer of the votive observance should perform the breaking of the fast.

sanskrit_iast: tatpare cā'nnajanyaṃ vā na kuryātpāraṇaṃ gṛhī .. 38 ..
meaning: तत्परे चाऽन्नजन्यं वा न कुर्यात्पारणं गृही .. 38 ..
text_mt: And after that, a householder should not perform the breaking of the fast with grain-born food.

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatrayoge grahaṇe pūjayetparameśvaram ..
japahomādikaṃ kuryādgṛhī nopavasetkvacit .. 39 ..
meaning:
नक्षत्रयोगे ग्रहणे पूजयेत्परमेश्वरम् ..
जपहोमादिकं कुर्याद्गृही नोपवसेत्क्वचित् .. 39 ..
text_mt: During a conjunction of asterisms or an eclipse, one should worship the Supreme Lord; / a householder should perform mantra recitation, fire offerings, and the like, and never fast.

sanskrit_iast:
divāṣṭamyāṃ muhūrte vā prājāpatyena saṃyutam ..
tathāpi ca divākṛtyaṃ samāpya ca vrataṃ caret .. 2.2.8.40 ..
meaning:
दिवाष्टम्यां मुहूर्ते वा प्राजापत्येन संयुतम् ..
तथापि च दिवाकृत्यं समाप्य च व्रतं चरेत् .. 2.2.8.40 ..
text_mt: By day on an aṣṭamī, or during a muhūrta conjoined with Prajāpati's asterism, / nevertheless, having finished the day's duties, one should perform the votive observance.

sanskrit_iast:
muhūrtāṃte ca māsāṃte aṣṭamyāmapi rohiṇī ..
upavāse ca yo doṣaḥ pūjāhomaḥ praśasyate .. 41 ..
meaning:
मुहूर्तांते च मासांते अष्टम्यामपि रोहिणी ..
उपवासे च यो दोषः पूजाहोमः प्रशस्यते .. 41 ..
text_mt: And at the end of a muhūrta, at the end of a month, and on an aṣṭamī [conjoined with] Rohiṇī, / whatever fault there is in fasting, worship and fire offering are praised.

sanskrit_iast:
navamyāṃ ca sadā pūjyāḥ pratimāse'yutaṃ dvijāḥ ..
gṛhṇīyānniyamaṃ caiva yathā karma phalapradam .. .. 42 ..
meaning:
नवम्यां च सदा पूज्याः प्रतिमासेऽयुतं द्विजाः ..
गृह्णीयान्नियमं चैव यथा कर्म फलप्रदम् .. .. 42 ..
text_mt: And on the navamī in every month, ten thousand twice-born are always to be honoured; / and one should undertake the rule according to which action yields fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtikasya tu māsasya daśamī śuklapakṣikā ..
tasyāṃ yuktāśanā viprā brahmalokamavāpnuyuḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
कार्तिकस्य तु मासस्य दशमी शुक्लपक्षिका ..
तस्यां युक्ताशना विप्रा ब्रह्मलोकमवाप्नुयुः .. 43 ..
text_mt: On the tenth lunar day of the bright fortnight of the month of Kārtika, / eating moderately on it, Brahmins attain the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
daśamī jyeṣṭhamāsasya sā ceddaśaharā smṛtā ..
āśvinasya mahāpuṇyā kārtike vijayā smṛtā .. 44 ..
meaning:
दशमी ज्येष्ठमासस्य सा चेद्दशहरा स्मृता ..
आश्विनस्य महापुण्या कार्तिके विजया स्मृता .. 44 ..
text_mt: If that tenth lunar day of the month of Jyeṣṭha is celebrated, it is called Daśaharā; / that of Āśvina is most sacred, and in Kārtika it is called Vijayā.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśī vrataparā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī ..
sarvapāpavinirmuktā yathā kurvaṃti mānavāḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
एकादशी व्रतपरा सर्वपापप्रणाशिनी ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्ता यथा कुर्वंति मानवाः .. 45 ..
text_mt: The eleventh lunar day is dedicated to votive observances, destroying all sins; / liberated from all sins, as men perform it.

sanskrit_iast:
daśamyāmekabhaktastu saṃyataḥ syājjitendriyaḥ ..
ekādaśyāmupoṣyātha dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇaṃ caret ..46..
meaning:
दशम्यामेकभक्तस्तु संयतः स्याज्जितेन्द्रियः ..
एकादश्यामुपोष्याथ द्वादश्यां पारणं चरेत् ..46..
text_mt: On the daśamī, however, one should eat a single meal, restrained and with subdued senses. / Then, having fasted on the ekādaśī, one should break the fast on the dvādaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśa dvādaśīrhanti tasmāttathācaredbudhaḥ ..
pūrvedyurekādaśī pūrṇā parehani ca vardhate .. 47 ..
meaning:
द्वादश द्वादशीर्हन्ति तस्मात्तथाचरेद्बुधः ..
पूर्वेद्युरेकादशी पूर्णा परेहनि च वर्धते .. 47 ..
text_mt: It destroys twelve dvādaśīs; therefore a wise man should act accordingly. / When ekādaśī is complete on the previous day and extends into the following day,

sanskrit_iast:
na vardhate dvādaśī tu tadā tvevaṃ vyavasthitiḥ ..
vanavāsī parāṃ kuryātpūrvāṃ kuryādgṛhāśramī ..48..
meaning:
न वर्धते द्वादशी तु तदा त्वेवं व्यवस्थितिः ..
वनवासी परां कुर्यात्पूर्वां कुर्याद्गृहाश्रमी ..48..
text_mt: and dvādaśī does not extend, then this is the rule: / a forest-dweller should observe the second, and a householder should observe the first.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvevaikādaśī tyājyā vardhate cettithidvayam ..
ekādaśī dvādaśī tu tadopoṣyā parā tithiḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
पूर्वेवैकादशी त्याज्या वर्धते चेत्तिथिद्वयम् ..
एकादशी द्वादशी तु तदोपोष्या परा तिथिः .. 49 ..
text_mt: Only the first ekādaśī is to be abandoned if both lunar days extend; / when ekādaśī and dvādaśī [both extend], then the second lunar day is to be fasted upon.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā tu pāraṇā yogyā dvādaśī nopatiṣṭhate ..
tadā pūrvaiva saṃgrāhyā tyājyā vṛddhā pare'hani .. 2.2.8.50 ..
meaning:
यदा तु पारणा योग्या द्वादशी नोपतिष्ठते ..
तदा पूर्वैव संग्राह्या त्याज्या वृद्धा परेऽहनि .. 2.2.8.50 ..
text_mt: When, however, a dvādaśī suitable for breaking the fast does not present itself, / then only the first is to be taken, and the extended one on the following day is to be abandoned.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśī kalāyuktā sakalā dvādaśī yadi ..
tatra kratusamaṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam .. 51 ..
meaning:
एकादशी कलायुक्ता सकला द्वादशी यदि ..
तत्र क्रतुसमं पुण्यं त्रयोदश्यां तु पारणम् .. 51 ..
text_mt: If ekādaśī has a single fraction and dvādaśī is complete, / there the merit is equal to a Vedic sacrifice, but the breaking of the fast is on the trayodaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca pare'hani na labhyate ..
nopoṣyā sā mahādoṣā putrapautradhanakṣayāt .. 52 ..
meaning:
एकादशी द्वादशी च परेऽहनि न लभ्यते ..
नोपोष्या सा महादोषा पुत्रपौत्रधनक्षयात् .. 52 ..
text_mt: If ekādaśī and dvādaśī are not found on the following day, / that [day] is not to be fasted upon; it is a great fault, because of the destruction of sons, grandsons, and wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśī daśāviddhā dvādaśyāṃ liptikā yadā ..
dvādaśī pāraṇāyogyā vardhate cāpare'hani ..
tadā dinadvaye tyājyā pāraṇaṃ ca niyogataḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
एकादशी दशाविद्धा द्वादश्यां लिप्तिका यदा ..
द्वादशी पारणायोग्या वर्धते चापरेऽहनि ..
तदा दिनद्वये त्याज्या पारणं च नियोगतः .. 53 ..
text_mt: When ekādaśī is overlapped by daśamī and extends by a minute fraction into dvādaśī, / and dvādaśī, suitable for breaking the fast, extends into the following day, / then it should be abandoned on both days, and the breaking of the fast [is to be observed] as prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśīgrahaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvādaśī luptapāraṇā ..
caṇḍātithau vrataṃ caiva haṃti puṇyaṃ purā kṛtam .. 54 ..
meaning:
षोडशीग्रहणं दृष्ट्वा द्वादशी लुप्तपारणा ..
चण्डातिथौ व्रतं चैव हंति पुण्यं पुरा कृतम् .. 54 ..
text_mt: Seeing an eclipse on the full-moon day when the breaking of the fast on dvādaśī is lost, / a votive observance on an inauspicious lunar day destroys merit previously acquired.

sanskrit_iast:
trayodaśyāṃ yadvihitaṃ pāraṇaṃ na tu puṇyadam ..
gṛhāśramī na kuryādvā daśamīdvādaśīkṣayāt .. 55 ..
meaning:
त्रयोदश्यां यद्विहितं पारणं न तु पुण्यदम् ..
गृहाश्रमी न कुर्याद्वा दशमीद्वादशीक्षयात् .. 55 ..
text_mt: Breaking the fast which is prescribed on the trayodaśī does not bestow merit. / Or a householder should not perform it, on account of the loss of daśamī and dvādaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi rudrā daśamitrā pare'hniravisaṃkramaḥ ..
tathāpi saṃparityajya dvādaśyāṃ samupāvaset .. 56 ..
meaning:
यदि रुद्रा दशमित्रा परेऽह्निरविसंक्रमः ..
तथापि संपरित्यज्य द्वादश्यां समुपावसेत् .. 56 ..
text_mt: If the eleventh lunar day is joined with daśamī and the sun's transit occurs on the following day, / even then, having abandoned it, one should fast on the dvādaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
vajrālokanamātraṃ tu daśamī saṃviśedyadi ..
ekādaśī na bhoktavyā parā hyekādaśī tadā .. 57 ..
meaning:
वज्रालोकनमात्रं तु दशमी संविशेद्यदि ..
एकादशी न भोक्तव्या परा ह्येकादशी तदा .. 57 ..
text_mt: If daśamī enters by even the sight of a lightning flash, / then the ekādaśī must not be eaten upon; the following day is indeed the ekādaśī.

sanskrit_iast: tadā ceddaśamīviddhā samupoṣyā na dūṣaṇam.. 58 ..
meaning: तदा चेद्दशमीविद्धा समुपोष्या न दूषणम्.. 58 ..
text_mt: If it is overlapped by daśamī then, fasting upon it carries no fault.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāmupavāsaṃ tu yaḥ karoti narottamaḥ ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra viṣṇuranāmayaḥ .. 59 ..
meaning:
द्वादश्यामुपवासं तु यः करोति नरोत्तमः ..
स याति परमं स्थानं यत्र विष्णुरनामयः .. 59 ..
text_mt: The best of men who observes a fast on dvādaśī / goes to the supreme abode where the unblemished Viṣṇu resides.

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣya daśamīmitrāṃ mohādekādaśīṃ naraḥ ..
nirayaṃ yāti sa pretya dharmasaṃtatisaṃkṣayāt .. 2.2.8.60 ..
meaning:
उपोष्य दशमीमित्रां मोहादेकादशीं नरः ..
निरयं याति स प्रेत्य धर्मसंततिसंक्षयात् .. 2.2.8.60 ..
text_mt: A man who, out of delusion, fasts on an ekādaśī joined with daśamī / goes to hell after death, because of the destruction of his lineage and righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
ravivāre śukravāre saṃkrāntyāṃ tu dinakṣaye ..
upavāsaṃ prakurvīta pāraṇaṃ tu vivarjayet .. 61 ..
meaning:
रविवारे शुक्रवारे संक्रान्त्यां तु दिनक्षये ..
उपवासं प्रकुर्वीत पारणं तु विवर्जयेत् .. 61 ..
text_mt: On a Sunday, on a Friday, at a solar transit, and on a day of loss, / one should observe a fast, but avoid breaking the fast.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklāṃ vā yadi vā kṛṣṇāṃ pūrvasaṃkalpitāmapi ..
ekādaśīṃ sadā kuryānna vai kṛṣṇettarāṃ kvacit ..62..
meaning:
शुक्लां वा यदि वा कृष्णां पूर्वसंकल्पितामपि ..
एकादशीं सदा कुर्यान्न वै कृष्णेत्तरां क्वचित् ..62..
text_mt: Whether bright or dark, even if previously resolved upon, / one should always observe the ekādaśī, and never omit the dark one.

sanskrit_iast:
naktena vartayetkṛṣṇāmiti śāstraviniścayaḥ ..
māse caikādaśī yatra labhyate śuklapakṣake ..
tatra kuryātkṛṣṇapakṣe parā tithirna gṛhyate ..63..
meaning:
नक्तेन वर्तयेत्कृष्णामिति शास्त्रविनिश्चयः ..
मासे चैकादशी यत्र लभ्यते शुक्लपक्षके ..
तत्र कुर्यात्कृष्णपक्षे परा तिथिर्न गृह्यते ..63..
text_mt: One should observe the dark [ekādaśī] with a nocturnal meal; such is the determination of the scripture. / In the month where ekādaśī falls in the bright fortnight, / there one should observe it; in the dark fortnight, the following lunar day is not taken.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvaṇī dvādaśī śuklā cāṃdrabhadre yadā harau ..
tatropoṣya hṛṣīkeśaṃ pūjayedvidhivannaraḥ .. 64 ..
meaning:
श्रावणी द्वादशी शुक्ला चांद्रभद्रे यदा हरौ ..
तत्रोपोष्य हृषीकेशं पूजयेद्विधिवन्नरः .. 64 ..
text_mt: When the bright dvādaśī of Śrāvaṇa falls in the asterism of Śravaṇa while Hari [is asleep], / having fasted then, a man should worship Hṛṣīkeśa according to the rules.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvaṇe cāśvine caiva labhyate dvādaśīdine ..
śravaṇena samāyuktā mahatī sā prakīrtitā .. 65 ..
meaning:
श्रावणे चाश्विने चैव लभ्यते द्वादशीदिने ..
श्रवणेन समायुक्ता महती सा प्रकीर्तिता .. 65 ..
text_mt: When on the dvādaśī day in Śrāvaṇa and in Āśvina / it is conjoined with Śravaṇa, it is proclaimed as the Great [dvādaśī].

sanskrit_iast:
puṣyeṇa drādaśīyuktā phālgune vijayā smṛtā ..
kārtike cetparityājyā māghe tu nārakī bhavet ..66..
meaning:
पुष्येण द्रादशीयुक्ता फाल्गुने विजया स्मृता ..
कार्तिके चेत्परित्याज्या माघे तु नारकी भवेत् ..66..
text_mt: Conjoined with Puṣya, dvādaśī in Phālguna is known as Vijayā; / in Kārtika it should be abandoned, but in Māgha it leads to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
yā bhādre vijayā proktā śravaṇena samāyutā..
viśeṣaḥ kathyate tatra yathāvadvratamācaret ..67..
meaning:
या भाद्रे विजया प्रोक्ता श्रवणेन समायुता..
विशेषः कथ्यते तत्र यथावद्व्रतमाचरेत् ..67..
text_mt: The Vijayā that is proclaimed in Bhādrapada, conjoined with Śravaṇa— / its special rule is declared, how one should observe the votive observance according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyāmuttarato dvādaśī ca divānvitā ..
niśipūrṇā dvādaśī ca śravaṇenāpi saṃyutā ..68..
meaning:
एकादश्यामुत्तरतो द्वादशी च दिवान्विता ..
निशिपूर्णा द्वादशी च श्रवणेनापि संयुता ..68..
text_mt: On the day following ekādaśī, when dvādaśī continues through the day, / and is complete at night, and conjoined with Śravaṇa,

sanskrit_iast: saphalā dvādaśī jñeyā upoṣyaiṣā mahāphalā .. 69 ..
meaning: सफला द्वादशी ज्ञेया उपोष्यैषा महाफला .. 69 ..
text_mt: it should be known as the fruitful dvādaśī; fasted upon, this bears great fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāṃ viṣṇuviddhāyāṃ vāsudevaṃ prapūjayet ..
kṛṣṇāyāṃ tu vrataṃ kuryādbahuduḥkhaṃ samācareta .. 2.2.8.70 ..
meaning:
द्वादश्यां विष्णुविद्धायां वासुदेवं प्रपूजयेत् ..
कृष्णायां तु व्रतं कुर्याद्बहुदुःखं समाचरेत .. 2.2.8.70 ..
text_mt: On a dvādaśī overlapped by Viṣṇu, one should worship Vāsudeva. / But if one undertakes the votive observance on the dark [dvādaśī], one incurs much sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśī kāmaviddhā cenmanyate nāpyupoṣaṇam ..
hanyātpurākṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāmupoṣaṇam ..71..
meaning:
द्वादशी कामविद्धा चेन्मन्यते नाप्युपोषणम् ..
हन्यात्पुराकृतं पुण्यं त्रयोदश्यामुपोषणम् ..71..
text_mt: If dvādaśī is overlapped by trayodaśī, fasting is not commended; / fasting on trayodaśī destroys merit previously acquired.

sanskrit_iast:
prahareprahare snānaṃ śarvaryāṃ ca vidhīyate ..
pūjanaṃ cāgnikāryaṃ ca ṣaṭsu kāryaṃ vratī caret ..72..
meaning:
प्रहरेप्रहरे स्नानं शर्वर्यां च विधीयते ..
पूजनं चाग्निकार्यं च षट्सु कार्यं व्रती चरेत् ..72..
text_mt: Bathing is prescribed watch by watch during the night; / worship and fire-ritual should be performed by the observer of the vow across the six [watches].

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśīṃ dvādaśīṃ ca prāpnoti śravaṇe yadi ..
ekādaśyāmupoṣyātha dvādaśyāmapyupāvaset..73..
meaning:
एकादशीं द्वादशीं च प्राप्नोति श्रवणे यदि ..
एकादश्यामुपोष्याथ द्वादश्यामप्युपावसेत्..73..
text_mt: If Śravaṇa coincides with ekādaśī and dvādaśī, / having fasted on ekādaśī, one should also fast on dvādaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
pāraṇaṃ tu trayodaśyāṃ dvādaśī cenna labhyate ..
āmiṣānnaṃ na bhuñjīta haviṣyānnena pāraṇam ..74..
meaning:
पारणं तु त्रयोदश्यां द्वादशी चेन्न लभ्यते ..
आमिषान्नं न भुञ्जीत हविष्यान्नेन पारणम् ..74..
text_mt: Breaking the fast is on trayodaśī if dvādaśī is not obtained. / One must not eat meat; breaking the fast is done with sacrificial food.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā tu pāraṇāyogyā labhyate dvādaśī tadā ..
tasyāṃ nātikramo yuktastadabhāve trayodaśī..75..
meaning:
यदा तु पारणायोग्या लभ्यते द्वादशी तदा ..
तस्यां नातिक्रमो युक्तस्तदभावे त्रयोदशी..75..
text_mt: When, however, a dvādaśī suitable for breaking the fast is obtained, / then transgressing it is not proper; in its absence, [the fast is broken on] trayodaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca śravaṇarkṣeṇa saṃyutā ..
viṣṇuśṛṃkhalako nāma budhavāre viśiṣyate ..76..
meaning:
एकादशी द्वादशी च श्रवणर्क्षेण संयुता ..
विष्णुशृंखलको नाम बुधवारे विशिष्यते ..76..
text_mt: When ekādaśī and dvādaśī are conjoined with the asterism of Śravaṇa / on a Wednesday, it is called Viṣṇuśṛṅkhalaka and is especially distinguished.

sanskrit_iast:
daśamyāṃ saṃyato bhūtvā prātarekādaśīdine ..
kṛtvā tu saṅgame snānaṃ prahareprahare dvijāḥ ..77..
meaning:
दशम्यां संयतो भूत्वा प्रातरेकादशीदिने ..
कृत्वा तु सङ्गमे स्नानं प्रहरेप्रहरे द्विजाः ..77..
text_mt: Having become restrained on daśamī, in the morning of the ekādaśī day, / having bathed at a confluence watch by watch, O twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā kṛtvā vijayāyāṃ vratottamam ..
sarvapāpaṃ kṣayaṃ nītvā viṣṇuloke vasennaraḥ .. 78 ..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना कृत्वा विजयायां व्रतोत्तमम् ..
सर्वपापं क्षयं नीत्वा विष्णुलोके वसेन्नरः .. 78 ..
text_mt: having performed this best of votive observances on Vijayā according to this rule, / having destroyed all sins, a man dwells in the world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
caturyugānāṃ divyānāṃ yāvatsyādviṣṇurūpadhṛka ..
tāvadeva hi sarvatra sārvabhaumo bhavennaraḥ .. 79 ..
meaning:
चतुर्युगानां दिव्यानां यावत्स्याद्विष्णुरूपधृक ..
तावदेव हि सर्वत्र सार्वभौमो भवेन्नरः .. 79 ..
text_mt: For as many divine four-age cycles as he bears the form of Viṣṇu, / for that long indeed a man becomes a universal sovereign everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
tretāyāṃ daśajanmāni madhyadeśeṣu bho dvijāḥ ..
tataśca bhārate varṣe vedavedāṃtasāravit ..
putrapautradhanairyukto lakṣado nṛpasannibhaḥ .. 2.2.8.80 ..
meaning:
त्रेतायां दशजन्मानि मध्यदेशेषु भो द्विजाः ..
ततश्च भारते वर्षे वेदवेदांतसारवित् ..
पुत्रपौत्रधनैर्युक्तो लक्षदो नृपसन्निभः .. 2.2.8.80 ..
text_mt: For ten births in Tretāyuga in the central lands, O twice-born, / and thereafter in the land of Bhārata, knowing the essence of the Vedas and Vedānta, / endowed with sons, grandsons, and wealth, a donor of hundreds of thousands, equal to a king,

sanskrit_iast:
jāyate daśa janmāni tretāyāṃ brāhmaṇottamaḥ ..
sapatnīkaśca dīrghāyurdharmakarmasu pūjitaḥ .. 81 ..
meaning:
जायते दश जन्मानि त्रेतायां ब्राह्मणोत्तमः ..
सपत्नीकश्च दीर्घायुर्धर्मकर्मसु पूजितः .. 81 ..
text_mt: he is born for ten births as an excellent Brahmin in Tretāyuga, / with a wife, long-lived, and honoured in religious acts.

sanskrit_iast:
bhādre māsi site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ pṛthivīpatim ..
śatrumutthāpayetprāhṇe śubhalagne śubhakṣaṇe .. 82 ..
meaning:
भाद्रे मासि सिते पक्षे द्वादश्यां पृथिवीपतिम् ..
शत्रुमुत्थापयेत्प्राह्णे शुभलग्ने शुभक्षणे .. 82 ..
text_mt: In the month of Bhādrapada, in the bright fortnight, on the dvādaśī, / the lord of the earth should raise [the banner of] the enemy in the forenoon, in an auspicious lagna and an auspicious moment.

sanskrit_iast:
śalyaśālmalikasyāpi saptaparṇīyakasya ca ..
eṣāmanyatamaṃ vṛkṣaṃ caṃpakasyārjunasya vā .. 83 ..
meaning:
शल्यशाल्मलिकस्यापि सप्तपर्णीयकस्य च ..
एषामन्यतमं वृक्षं चंपकस्यार्जुनस्य वा .. 83 ..
text_mt: From the śalya, the śālmali, and the saptaparṇa, / or from one of these trees: the campaka or the arjuna,

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhatkadaṃbavṛkṣasya dvicatvāriṃśadaṃgulaiḥ ..
dvātriṃśadaṃgulairvāpi mānadvayamathāpi vā ..
trivyāyāmaṃ ca prathamaṃ dvāviṃśahastameva vā .. 84 ..
meaning:
बृहत्कदंबवृक्षस्य द्विचत्वारिंशदंगुलैः ..
द्वात्रिंशदंगुलैर्वापि मानद्वयमथापि वा ..
त्रिव्यायामं च प्रथमं द्वाविंशहस्तमेव वा .. 84 ..
text_mt: or from a large kadamba tree, [a pole] of forty-two aṅgulas, / or of thirty-two aṅgulas, or indeed of two measures; / the first is three spans, or twenty-two cubits.

sanskrit_iast:
hastaḥ ṣoḍaśavārasya gṛhasthasya viśiṣyate ..
hastatrayeṇa viprasya dvādaśa kṣatriyasya tu .. 85 ..
meaning:
हस्तः षोडशवारस्य गृहस्थस्य विशिष्यते ..
हस्तत्रयेण विप्रस्य द्वादश क्षत्रियस्य तु .. 85 ..
text_mt: A cubit is recommended for a householder of sixteen turns; / of three cubits for a Brahmin, and twelve for a Kṣatriya;

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭahastaṃ tu vaiśyasya śūdrasya pañcahastakam ..
abhrataḥ śvetacchatraṃ syātpatākā ca purepure .. 86 ..
meaning:
अष्टहस्तं तु वैश्यस्य शूद्रस्य पञ्चहस्तकम् ..
अभ्रतः श्वेतच्छत्रं स्यात्पताका च पुरेपुरे .. 86 ..
text_mt: of eight cubits for a Vaiśya, and of five cubits for a Śūdra. / In front there should be a white royal parasol, and a banner in city after city.

sanskrit_iast:
ghanasārasamāyuktāṃ karpūramaṃḍanānvitām ..
raktavastraparicchannāṃ puṣpamālyairalaṃkṛtām .. 87 ..
meaning:
घनसारसमायुक्तां कर्पूरमंडनान्विताम् ..
रक्तवस्त्रपरिच्छन्नां पुष्पमाल्यैरलंकृताम् .. 87 ..
text_mt: Infused with camphor, accompanied by camphor ornaments, / covered with red cloth, and adorned with flower garlands,

sanskrit_iast:
mañcasthāṃ kārayetpūjāṃ bhaktyā ca sudṛḍho naraḥ ..
saptarātraṃ caretpūjāmaindramantreṇa mantravit .. 88 ..
meaning:
मञ्चस्थां कारयेत्पूजां भक्त्या च सुदृढो नरः ..
सप्तरात्रं चरेत्पूजामैन्द्रमन्त्रेण मन्त्रवित् .. 88 ..
text_mt: a man of very firm resolve should cause worship to be performed on a platform with devotion. / The knower of mantras should perform the worship for seven nights with the mantra of Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
kākādīnna spṛśejjātu vairapakṣe viśeṣataḥ ..
patākāyā nipāte tu rāṣṭrahāniṃ samādiśet .. 89 ..
meaning:
काकादीन्न स्पृशेज्जातु वैरपक्षे विशेषतः ..
पताकाया निपाते तु राष्ट्रहानिं समादिशेत् .. 89 ..
text_mt: Crows and the like should never touch it, especially from an enemy's quarter; / but upon the fall of the banner, one should foretell ruin to the realm.

sanskrit_iast:
patāke nissṛte bhagne mahiṣāṇāṃ vināśanam ..
sthūṇāpāte ca bhagne vā cāśvahāniṃ samādiśet .. 2.2.8.90 ..
meaning:
पताके निस्सृते भग्ने महिषाणां विनाशनम् ..
स्थूणापाते च भग्ने वा चाश्वहानिं समादिशेत् .. 2.2.8.90 ..
text_mt: If the two flags slip out or break, destruction of buffaloes [is indicated]; / and if the post falls or breaks, one should predict loss of horses.

sanskrit_iast:
taskaraśca kule tasya prāyaścittaṃ samācaret ..
tadviṣṇoriti maṃtreṇa śatapadmasamanvitam .. 91 ..
meaning:
तस्करश्च कुले तस्य प्रायश्चित्तं समाचरेत् ..
तद्विष्णोरिति मंत्रेण शतपद्मसमन्वितम् .. 91 ..
text_mt: And if there is a thief in his family, he should perform an expiation / with the mantra 'tad viṣṇoḥ', together with a hundred lotuses.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇumuddiśya juhuyādayutaṃ pippalasya ca ..
grahāṇāṃ ca tribhāgena cāyutaṃ juhuyādbudhaḥ .. 92 ..
meaning:
विष्णुमुद्दिश्य जुहुयादयुतं पिप्पलस्य च ..
ग्रहाणां च त्रिभागेन चायुतं जुहुयाद्बुधः .. 92 ..
text_mt: Intending it for Viṣṇu, he should offer ten thousand [oblations] of pippala wood; / and the wise man should offer ten thousand oblations for the planets with a third part.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityasyādbhutamidaṃ dvijapāte tu bho dvijāḥ ..
kapotapāte śukrasya kākādau bhaumamādiśet .. 93 ..
meaning:
आदित्यस्याद्भुतमिदं द्विजपाते तु भो द्विजाः ..
कपोतपाते शुक्रस्य काकादौ भौममादिशेत् .. 93 ..
text_mt: O twice-born, when a bird falls, this is a portent of the Sun; / when a pigeon falls, of Venus; in the case of a crow and the like, one should declare it to be of Mars;

sanskrit_iast:
bhūkaṃpe jāyate viṣṭaṃ guroradbhutamādiśet ..
kīṭaviddhe kṛte viprāścandrasyādbhutamādiśet .. 94 ..
meaning:
भूकंपे जायते विष्टं गुरोरद्भुतमादिशेत् ..
कीटविद्धे कृते विप्राश्चन्द्रस्याद्भुतमादिशेत् .. 94 ..
text_mt: when an earthquake occurs, excrement appears: one should declare it a portent of Jupiter; / when it is bored through by insects, O twice-born, one should declare it a portent of the Moon;

sanskrit_iast: patāke nissṛte bhagne rāhoradbhutamādiśet.. 95 ..
meaning: पताके निस्सृते भग्ने राहोरद्भुतमादिशेत्.. 95 ..
text_mt: if the two flags slip out or break, one should declare it a portent of Rāhu.

sanskrit_iast:
śivā ruvaṃti cāndrasya vānaro vā spṛśetkvacit ..
ketoradbhutamuddiṣṭaṃ bhūmikaṃpe tu te dvijāḥ .. 96 ..
meaning:
शिवा रुवंति चान्द्रस्य वानरो वा स्पृशेत्क्वचित् ..
केतोरद्भुतमुद्दिष्टं भूमिकंपे तु ते द्विजाः .. 96 ..
text_mt: If jackals howl, it belongs to the Moon, or if a monkey touches it anywhere; / but when the earth quakes, that is taught as a portent of Ketu, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
trayodaśīṃ sitāṃ prāpya puṣpairnānāvidhairapi ..
kāmadevaṃ samabhyarcedgandhādyaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ .. 97 ..
meaning:
त्रयोदशीं सितां प्राप्य पुष्पैर्नानाविधैरपि ..
कामदेवं समभ्यर्चेद्गन्धाद्यैः सुमनोहरैः .. 97 ..
text_mt: Having reached the bright thirteenth, with various kinds of flowers / and with highly charming perfumes and the like, he should worship Kāmadeva.

sanskrit_iast:
caitre māsi sitāṣṭamyāṃ śanau śatabhiṣā yadi ..
gaṃgāyā yadi labhyeta sūryagrahaśataiḥ samā .. 98 ..
meaning:
चैत्रे मासि सिताष्टम्यां शनौ शतभिषा यदि ..
गंगाया यदि लभ्येत सूर्यग्रहशतैः समा .. 98 ..
text_mt: If in the month of Caitra on the bright eighth, on a Saturday, there is Śatabhiṣaj, / and if it is obtained at the Gaṅgā, it is equal to hundreds of solar eclipses.

sanskrit_iast:
seyaṃ mahāvāruṇīti khyātā kṛṣṇatrayodaśī ..
asyāṃ snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca śrāddhaṃ vākṣayamucyate .. 99 ..
meaning:
सेयं महावारुणीति ख्याता कृष्णत्रयोदशी ..
अस्यां स्नानं च दानं च श्राद्धं वाक्षयमुच्यते .. 99 ..
text_mt: This same dark thirteenth is renowned as the Mahāvāruṇī; / bathing, gifting, or a śrāddha on this [day] is said to be inexhaustible.

sanskrit_iast:
madhumāse site pakṣe dambhabhañjī caturdaśī ..
tasyāṃ madanamūle ca akṣaraṃ kāmamarcayet .. 2.2.8.100 ..
meaning:
मधुमासे सिते पक्षे दम्भभञ्जी चतुर्दशी ..
तस्यां मदनमूले च अक्षरं काममर्चयेत् .. 2.2.8.100 ..
text_mt: In the month of Madhu, in the bright fortnight, is the Dambhabhañjī fourteenth; / on it, at the root of a madana tree, he should worship the imperishable Kāma.

sanskrit_iast:
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ madanasya prabhāvataḥ ..
jugupsitavacobhistu samyaktuṣṭo manobhavaḥ .. 101 ..
meaning:
स याति परमं स्थानं मदनस्य प्रभावतः ..
जुगुप्सितवचोभिस्तु सम्यक्तुष्टो मनोभवः .. 101 ..
text_mt: He goes to the supreme station through the power of Madana; / for Manobhava is thoroughly pleased with coarse words.

sanskrit_iast:
anantasya vrataṃ vakṣye sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ..
anantaṃ sukhamāpnoti yaḥ kuryādbhaktimānnaraḥ .. 102 ..
meaning:
अनन्तस्य व्रतं वक्ष्ये सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ..
अनन्तं सुखमाप्नोति यः कुर्याद्भक्तिमान्नरः .. 102 ..
text_mt: I shall explain the votive observance of Ananta, which destroys all sins; / a devoted man who performs it attains endless happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāṃ pūjite śakre dhvajake vāstuyaṣṭiṣu ..
tataḥ śuklacaturdaśyāmanantaṃ pūjayeddharim .. 103 ..
meaning:
द्वादश्यां पूजिते शक्रे ध्वजके वास्तुयष्टिषु ..
ततः शुक्लचतुर्दश्यामनन्तं पूजयेद्धरिम् .. 103 ..
text_mt: When Śakra has been worshipped on the twelfth on the banners [and] house-pillars, / he should then worship Hari as Ananta on the bright fourteenth.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā darbhamayānantaṃ vāridhānyānvitaṃ tathā ..
pūjayeccandanairgandhairnaivedyairvividhairapi .. 104 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा दर्भमयानन्तं वारिधान्यान्वितं तथा ..
पूजयेच्चन्दनैर्गन्धैर्नैवेद्यैर्विविधैरपि .. 104 ..
text_mt: Having made an Ananta out of darbha grass, accompanied by water and grain, / he should worship him with sandalwood, perfumes, and various offerings of food,

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaśa phalairmūlairjalajaiḥ kusumairapi ..
yavagodhūmaśālīnāṃ cūrṇairnaikatamasya ca .. 105 ..
meaning:
चतुर्दश फलैर्मूलैर्जलजैः कुसुमैरपि ..
यवगोधूमशालीनां चूर्णैर्नैकतमस्य च .. 105 ..
text_mt: with fourteen fruits, roots, and water-born flowers, / and with the flour of one of barley, wheat, or rice,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā pūpāhvayaṃ tasmai dadyādekaṃ śrutekṣitam ..
svayamekaṃ tu bhuñjīta dadyātsatrasya dorakam .. 106 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा पूपाह्वयं तस्मै दद्यादेकं श्रुतेक्षितम् ..
स्वयमेकं तु भुञ्जीत दद्यात्सत्रस्य दोरकम् .. 106 ..
text_mt: having made what is called a cake, he should offer one to him after it has been inspected by a learned man; / he should eat one himself, and should give the thread of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaśagranthiyutaṃ kuṃkumena vilepitam ..
caturdaśasūtramayaṃ sūtraṃ kārpāsameva ca .. 107 ..
meaning:
चतुर्दशग्रन्थियुतं कुंकुमेन विलेपितम् ..
चतुर्दशसूत्रमयं सूत्रं कार्पासमेव च .. 107 ..
text_mt: It has fourteen knots, is smeared with saffron, / and is a thread made of fourteen cotton strands.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ preta caturdaśyāṃ bhojayitvā tapodhanān ..
dānaṃ dattvā dvijebhyaśca yamalokaṃ na gacchati .. 108 ..
meaning:
अतः प्रेत चतुर्दश्यां भोजयित्वा तपोधनान् ..
दानं दत्त्वा द्विजेभ्यश्च यमलोकं न गच्छति .. 108 ..
text_mt: Therefore, having fed ascetics on the fourteenth of the ghosts / and given gifts to the twice-born, he does not go to the world of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pretakathāṃ śrutvā śākairnaktaṃ samācaret ..
caturdaśaṃ dvādaśaṃ vā saptamaṃ vāpi pañcamam .. 109 ..
meaning:
ततः प्रेतकथां श्रुत्वा शाकैर्नक्तं समाचरेत् ..
चतुर्दशं द्वादशं वा सप्तमं वापि पञ्चमम् .. 109 ..
text_mt: Then, having listened to the tale of the ghosts, he should take a nocturnal meal of herbs / on the fourteenth, or the twelfth, or the seventh, or even the fifth.

sanskrit_iast: mānamātrādikaṃ kṛtvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 2.2.8.110 ..
meaning: मानमात्रादिकं कृत्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 2.2.8.110 ..
text_mt: Having performed the [gift of the] measure of grain and so forth, he is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
māghe māsi vaṭāpāyaḥ kasya pāpaṃ punīmahe ..
snātvā tatra caturdaśyāṃ samaye tārakāmaye .. 111 ..
meaning:
माघे मासि वटापायः कस्य पापं पुनीमहे ..
स्नात्वा तत्र चतुर्दश्यां समये तारकामये .. 111 ..
text_mt: In the month of Māgha, at the falling away of the banyan, whose sin do we purify? / Having bathed there on the fourteenth, at the time marked by stars,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbhavetphālgune māsi yā ca kṛṣṇā caturdaśī ..
śivarātririti khyātā sā jagatsarvakāmadā .. 112 ..
meaning:
संभवेत्फाल्गुने मासि या च कृष्णा चतुर्दशी ..
शिवरात्रिरिति ख्याता सा जगत्सर्वकामदा .. 112 ..
text_mt: that which occurs in the month of Phālguna as the dark fourteenth / is renowned as Śivarātri; it grants all desires to the world.

sanskrit_iast:
divā tasyā alābhe tu rātriyoge vrataṃ caret ..
caturdaśī amāviddhā tadvrataṃ parivarjayet .. 113 ..
meaning:
दिवा तस्या अलाभे तु रात्रियोगे व्रतं चरेत् ..
चतुर्दशी अमाविद्धा तद्व्रतं परिवर्जयेत् .. 113 ..
text_mt: If it is not obtained during the day, he should perform the votive observance during its night-conjunction; / if the fourteenth is touched by the new moon, he should avoid that votive observance.

sanskrit_iast:
tithiyoge ca śarvaryāṃ saṃpūrṇe vratamācaret ..
kāmaviddhā sā ca pūjyā rātriyoge caredvratī .. 114 ..
meaning:
तिथियोगे च शर्वर्यां संपूर्णे व्रतमाचरेत् ..
कामविद्धा सा च पूज्या रात्रियोगे चरेद्व्रती .. 114 ..
text_mt: And when the conjunction of the lunar day is complete in the night, he should perform the votive observance; / that which is touched by the thirteenth is also to be worshipped; the observer of the vow should perform it during the night-conjunction.

sanskrit_iast:
prahareprahare snānaṃ svayaṃ snātvā śivasya ca ..
kārayedvidhivadbhaktyā homaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi .. 115 ..
meaning:
प्रहरेप्रहरे स्नानं स्वयं स्नात्वा शिवस्य च ..
कारयेद्विधिवद्भक्त्या होमं कुर्याद्यथाविधि .. 115 ..
text_mt: Bathing himself watch by watch, he should also / cause Śiva's [bath] to be performed according to rule with devotion, and should perform the oblation according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
atha vakṣyāmi caitrādimāse tu pūrṇimā yathā ..
citrānakṣatrasaṃyukto gurupūrṇo vidhuryadi ..
mahācaitrīti sā jñeyā pūrṇimākṣayapuṇyadā .. 116 ..
meaning:
अथ वक्ष्यामि चैत्रादिमासे तु पूर्णिमा यथा ..
चित्रानक्षत्रसंयुक्तो गुरुपूर्णो विधुर्यदि ..
महाचैत्रीति सा ज्ञेया पूर्णिमाक्षयपुण्यदा .. 116 ..
text_mt: Now I shall explain how the full moon falls in the months beginning with Caitra: / If the full moon is joined with the lunar mansion Citrā and with Jupiter, / it is to be known as Mahācaitrī, a full moon granting inexhaustible merit.

sanskrit_iast:
viśākhādiṣu bhedeṣu pūrṇacandro guruścaret ..
mahāvaiśākhikādyāstu pūrṇimā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ .. 117 ..
meaning:
विशाखादिषु भेदेषु पूर्णचन्द्रो गुरुश्चरेत् ..
महावैशाखिकाद्यास्तु पूर्णिमा द्वादश स्मृताः .. 117 ..
text_mt: When the full moon and Jupiter move into the different [mansions] beginning with Viśākhā, / twelve full-moon days are traditionally remembered, beginning with Mahāvaiśākhī.

sanskrit_iast:
mahājyaiṣṭhī viśeṣo'yaṃ prājāpatye yathā raviḥ ..
gurupūrṇacandro jyeṣṭhāyāṃ mahājyaiṣṭhīti sā smṛtā .. 118 ..
meaning:
महाज्यैष्ठी विशेषोऽयं प्राजापत्ये यथा रविः ..
गुरुपूर्णचन्द्रो ज्येष्ठायां महाज्यैष्ठीति सा स्मृता .. 118 ..
text_mt: This special Mahājyaiṣṭhī is when the Sun is in Rohiṇī; / when Jupiter and the full moon are in Jyeṣṭhā, that is traditionally remembered as Mahājyaiṣṭhī.

sanskrit_iast:
vināpi guruṇā candraḥ kṛttikā pūrṇimā tathā ..
tathā mahākārttikī sā tithiḥ puṇyatamā bhavet .. 119 ..
meaning:
विनापि गुरुणा चन्द्रः कृत्तिका पूर्णिमा तथा ..
तथा महाकार्त्तिकी सा तिथिः पुण्यतमा भवेत् .. 119 ..
text_mt: Even without Jupiter, when the Moon is with Kṛttikā on the full moon, / then that lunar day becomes Mahākārtikī, most meritorious.

sanskrit_iast:
rohiṇyāṃ tu sthitaścandraḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ tu kārttike ..
mahākārttikī tathāpi syātsvargaloke'pi durlabhā .. 2.2.8.120 ..
meaning:
रोहिण्यां तु स्थितश्चन्द्रः पौर्णमास्यां तु कार्त्तिके ..
महाकार्त्तिकी तथापि स्यात्स्वर्गलोकेऽपि दुर्लभा .. 2.2.8.120 ..
text_mt: When the Moon stands in Rohiṇī on the full moon in Kārttika, / it is still Mahākārtikī, difficult to obtain even in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
citrā vā yadi vā pūrṇā yadā syātpūrṇimātithiḥ ..
mahācaitrī tathāpi syādaśvamedhaphalapradā .. 121 ..
meaning:
चित्रा वा यदि वा पूर्णा यदा स्यात्पूर्णिमातिथिः ..
महाचैत्री तथापि स्यादश्वमेधफलप्रदा .. 121 ..
text_mt: Whether it is Citrā or the full moon when the full-moon lunar day occurs, / it is still Mahācaitrī, granting the fruit of a horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
raviṇā kṛttikāyogādravivāre ca pūrṇimā ..
mahācaitrī tathāpi syāddattasyākṣayakārikā .. 122 ..
meaning:
रविणा कृत्तिकायोगाद्रविवारे च पूर्णिमा ..
महाचैत्री तथापि स्याद्दत्तस्याक्षयकारिका .. 122 ..
text_mt: From the conjunction of Kṛttikā with the Sun, and on a Sunday, when it is the full moon, / it is still Mahācaitrī, making what is given inexhaustible.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ gurau guroryoge mahācaitrī prakīrtitā ..
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca japo niyama eva ca .. 123 ..
meaning:
एवं गुरौ गुरोर्योगे महाचैत्री प्रकीर्तिता ..
तत्र स्नानं च दानं च जपो नियम एव च .. 123 ..
text_mt: Thus, in Jupiter or in conjunction with Jupiter, Mahācaitrī is proclaimed; / bathing, gifting, recitation, and religious restraint there—

sanskrit_iast:
sarvamakṣayatāṃ yāti phalaṃ caivāśvamedhikam ..
pitarastarpitā yāṃti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamakṣayam .. 124 ..
meaning:
सर्वमक्षयतां याति फलं चैवाश्वमेधिकम् ..
पितरस्तर्पिता यांति वैष्णवं लोकमक्षयम् .. 124 ..
text_mt: all attain imperishability, as well as the reward of a horse sacrifice; / the ancestors, when propitiated, go to the imperishable realm of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
bharaṇyāṃ kārttike māsi yadi syātpūrṇimā tithiḥ ..
gaṃgādvāre tu mahatī vaiśākhī puṇyadā smṛtā .. 125 ..
meaning:
भरण्यां कार्त्तिके मासि यदि स्यात्पूर्णिमा तिथिः ..
गंगाद्वारे तु महती वैशाखी पुण्यदा स्मृता .. 125 ..
text_mt: If the full-moon lunar day should fall in Bharaṇī in the month of Kārttika, / then at Gaṅgādvāra the great Vaiśākhī is remembered as merit-giving.

sanskrit_iast:
śālagrāme mahācaitrī kṛtapuṇyā mahātithiḥ ..
gaṃgādvāre tu mahatī vaiśākhī puṇyadā smṛtā .. 126 ..
meaning:
शालग्रामे महाचैत्री कृतपुण्या महातिथिः ..
गंगाद्वारे तु महती वैशाखी पुण्यदा स्मृता .. 126 ..
text_mt: At Śālagrāma, the great lunar day Mahācaitrī has its merit made; / at Gaṅgādvāra the great Vaiśākhī is remembered as merit-giving.

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣottame mahājyaiṣṭhī mahāṣāḍhī tu śṛṃkhale ..
mahāśrāvaṇī kedāre mahāpuṇyatamā matā .. 127 ..
meaning:
पुरुषोत्तमे महाज्यैष्ठी महाषाढी तु शृंखले ..
महाश्रावणी केदारे महापुण्यतमा मता .. 127 ..
text_mt: At Puruṣottama is Mahājyaiṣṭhī, but Mahāṣāḍhī is at Śṛṅkhala; / Mahāśrāvaṇī is considered most holy at Kedāra;

sanskrit_iast:
mahābhādrī badaryāṃ ca kujo'pi syānnarastathā ..
mahākārttikī puṣkare ca kānyakubje tathottaraṃ .. 128 ..
meaning:
महाभाद्री बदर्यां च कुजोऽपि स्यान्नरस्तथा ..
महाकार्त्तिकी पुष्करे च कान्यकुब्जे तथोत्तरं .. 128 ..
text_mt: and Mahābhādrī is at Badarī, and Mars also becomes a man [there]; / Mahākārtikī is at Puṣkara, and further at Kānyakubja;

sanskrit_iast:
mahatī mārgaśīrṣe syādayodhyāyāṃ tathottare ..
mahāpauṣī puṇyatamā mahāmāghī prayāgataḥ .. .. 129 ..
meaning:
महती मार्गशीर्षे स्यादयोध्यायां तथोत्तरे ..
महापौषी पुण्यतमा महामाघी प्रयागतः .. .. 129 ..
text_mt: the great one in Mārgaśīrṣa is at Ayodhyā, and further north; / most meritorious is Mahāpauṣī, and Mahāmāghī is at Prayāga;

sanskrit_iast: mahāphālgunī naimiṣe ca nirdiṣṭāḥ syurmahāphalāḥ .. 2.2.8.130 ..
meaning: महाफाल्गुनी नैमिषे च निर्दिष्टाः स्युर्महाफलाः .. 2.2.8.130 ..
text_mt: and Mahāphālgunī is at Naimiṣa: these are declared to yield great fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
atra sma vihitaṃ karma śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham ..
sarvamakṣayatāṃ yāti varddhate cādhikaṃ phalam .. 131 ..
meaning:
अत्र स्म विहितं कर्म शुभं वा यदि वाशुभम् ..
सर्वमक्षयतां याति वर्द्धते चाधिकं फलम् .. 131 ..
text_mt: Whatever rite is performed here, whether auspicious or inauspicious, / all of it attains imperishability, and its fruit increases abundantly.

sanskrit_iast:
āśvine paurṇamāsī tu kaumudīti prakīrtitā ..
asyāṃ candrodaye lakṣmīṃ pūjayedvidhivannaraḥ .. 132 ..
meaning:
आश्विने पौर्णमासी तु कौमुदीति प्रकीर्तिता ..
अस्यां चन्द्रोदये लक्ष्मीं पूजयेद्विधिवन्नरः .. 132 ..
text_mt: The full-moon [day] in Āśvina is proclaimed as Kaumudī; / on it, at moonrise, a man should worship Lakṣmī according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
nirvatayenna yaḥ śrāddhaṃ prabhāte paitṛkaṃ dvijaḥ ..
indukṣaye māsimāsi prāyaścittīyate tu saḥ .. 133 ..
meaning:
निर्वतयेन्न यः श्राद्धं प्रभाते पैतृकं द्विजः ..
इन्दुक्षये मासिमासि प्रायश्चित्तीयते तु सः .. 133 ..
text_mt: A twice-born man who does not perform the ancestral śrāddha in the morning / at the waning of the moon month after month requires expiation.

sanskrit_iast:
candrāśvine tu kṛṣṇāyāṃ pañcadaśyāṃ yathāvidhi ..
kṛtvā snānādikaṃ karma sopavāso dinaṃ nayet ..134..
meaning:
चन्द्राश्विने तु कृष्णायां पञ्चदश्यां यथाविधि ..
कृत्वा स्नानादिकं कर्म सोपवासो दिनं नयेत् ..134..
text_mt: On the dark fifteenth [day] of the lunar Āśvina, having performed / the rites of bathing and so forth according to rule, he should spend the day fasting.

sanskrit_iast:
pradoṣasamaye lakṣmīṃ pūjayitvā yathāvidhi ..
dīpavṛkṣānyathā vṛkṣām̐llakṣmīprītyai samutsṛjet .. .. 135 ..
meaning:
प्रदोषसमये लक्ष्मीं पूजयित्वा यथाविधि ..
दीपवृक्षान्यथा वृक्षाम्̐ल्लक्ष्मीप्रीत्यै समुत्सृजेत् .. .. 135 ..
text_mt:
Having worshipped Lakṣmī according to rule at dusk,
he should set out lamp-trees like [real] trees for the pleasure of Lakṣmī.

sanskrit_iast:
nadītīre girau goṣṭhe śmaśāne vṛkṣamūlataḥ ..
catuṣpathe nijāgāre catvare tānnidhāpayet .. 136 ..
meaning:
नदीतीरे गिरौ गोष्ठे श्मशाने वृक्षमूलतः ..
चतुष्पथे निजागारे चत्वरे तान्निधापयेत् .. 136 ..
text_mt:
On the bank of a river, on a mountain, in a cowpen, in a cremation ground, at the foot of a tree,
at a crossroad, in one's own dwelling, and in a courtyard, he should have them placed.

sanskrit_iast:
dvirbhojanamamāvāsyāṃ na kartavyaṃ kadācana ..
śarvaryāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa māghaphālgunayornaraiḥ ..137.. ..
pravaravicāravarṇanam
meaning:
द्विर्भोजनममावास्यां न कर्तव्यं कदाचन ..
शर्वर्यां च विशेषेण माघफाल्गुनयोर्नरैः ..137.. ..
प्रवरविचारवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Eating twice should never be done on the new-moon day,
especially at night, by men in [the months of] Māgha and Phālguna.
Description of the examination of pravaras

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
vakṣye pravarasaṃtānaṃ yathākramamiti dvijāḥ ..
yadvinā vyatyayo yasmāttasmācchāstrānusārataḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
वक्ष्ये प्रवरसंतानं यथाक्रममिति द्विजाः ..
यद्विना व्यत्ययो यस्मात्तस्माच्छास्त्रानुसारतः .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Sūta said:
I shall declare the lineages of pravaras in proper order, O twice-born!
Because without which confusion [arises], therefore [I declare them] in accordance with the treatises.
title: adhyāyaḥ 09

sanskrit_iast:
pravaratrayaṃ kāśyapasya kāśyapāśāvanairdhruvam ..
pañcāśvagautamasyādya gautamaścoya eva ca .. 2 ..
meaning:
प्रवरत्रयं काश्यपस्य काश्यपाशावनैर्ध्रुवम् ..
पञ्चाश्वगौतमस्याद्य गौतमश्चोय एव च .. 2 ..
text_mt:
For Kāśyapa, the group of three pravaras is surely Kāśyapa, Āśāva, and Naidhruva.
For Gautama, the first is Pañcāśva, then Gautama and Coya.

sanskrit_iast:
cyavano jāmadagnyaśca āplavāyanameva ca ..
mokunyāṃgirasabhāsyājjāmadagnyāplavāyanam .. 3 ..
meaning:
च्यवनो जामदग्न्यश्च आप्लवायनमेव च ..
मोकुन्यांगिरसभास्याज्जामदग्न्याप्लवायनम् .. 3 ..
text_mt:
Cyavana, Jāmadagnya, and Āplavāyana;
from the Āṅgirasa lineage of Mokunī, Jāmadagnya and Āplavāyana.

sanskrit_iast:
śāṃḍilyāsitadaivalāḥ pravaratrayameva ca ..
parāśarasya ca tathā svayaṃ śāṃbavaśiṣṭhakam .. 4 ..
meaning:
शांडिल्यासितदैवलाः प्रवरत्रयमेव च ..
पराशरस्य च तथा स्वयं शांबवशिष्ठकम् .. 4 ..
text_mt:
Śāṇḍilya, Asita, and Devala are the triad of pravaras;
and likewise for Parāśara, [the triad] itself is Śāmba, Vasiṣṭha,

sanskrit_iast:
ātreyamācāryaṇasyābālapravarameva hi ..
vātsyavāsyāyanau caiva urukaṃṭaka eva ca .. 5 ..
meaning:
आत्रेयमाचार्यणस्याबालप्रवरमेव हि ..
वात्स्यवास्यायनौ चैव उरुकंटक एव च .. 5 ..
text_mt:
and Ātreya. For Ācāryaṇa, [there is] indeed the juvenile pravara;
and Vātsya, Vātsyāyana, and Urukaṇṭaka,

sanskrit_iast:
arthakṣīramitrāvaruṇaṃ pañcamaṃ parikīrtitam..
autathyasya trayaṃ vidyādvālmīko'varameva hi .. 6 ..
meaning:
अर्थक्षीरमित्रावरुणं पञ्चमं परिकीर्तितम्..
औतथ्यस्य त्रयं विद्याद्वाल्मीकोऽवरमेव हि .. 6 ..
text_mt:
and Arthakṣīra-Mitrāvaruṇa is proclaimed as the fifth.
One should know three for Autathya; Vālmīka is the junior.

sanskrit_iast:
autathyasya ca vāśiṣṭhamaindre cakraṃ ca krauñcāyanaṃ tathā ..
autathyeti samākhyātaṃ māhiṣyaṃ cyavanaṃ tathā .. 7 ..
meaning:
औतथ्यस्य च वाशिष्ठमैन्द्रे चक्रं च क्रौञ्चायनं तथा ..
औतथ्येति समाख्यातं माहिष्यं च्यवनं तथा .. 7 ..
text_mt:
And for Autathya, Vāsiṣṭha, Cakra in the Aindra [line], and Krauñcāyana;
likewise declared as Autathya are Māhiṣya and Cyavana.

sanskrit_iast:
urukaṃṭatrayaṃ vidyātkauśikasya trayaṃ tathā ..
yadgālo devarāṭ khyātaḥ kuśikādyāśca bho dvijāḥ ..8..
meaning:
उरुकंटत्रयं विद्यात्कौशिकस्य त्रयं तथा ..
यद्गालो देवराट् ख्यातः कुशिकाद्याश्च भो द्विजाः ..8..
text_mt:
One should know the triad for Urukaṇṭa, and likewise three for Kauśika:
Yadgāla, Devarāṭ, and Kuśika and others are renowned, O twice-born!

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāmitro devarāṭca svayaṃ caiva trayaṃ matam ..
ghṛtakauśikasya kuśikā viśvāmitrāghamarṣaṇam .. 9
meaning:
विश्वामित्रो देवराट्च स्वयं चैव त्रयं मतम् ..
घृतकौशिकस्य कुशिका विश्वामित्राघमर्षणम् .. 9
text_mt:
Viśvāmitra, Devarāṭ, and oneself are considered the three.
For Ghṛtakauśika, Kuśika, Viśvāmitra, and Aghamarṣaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍakauśikasya ca tathā devarāṭ devarātakam..
viśvāmitre tu vikhyātaḥ sumantoreva eva hi .. 2.2.9.10 ..
meaning:
चण्डकौशिकस्य च तथा देवराट् देवरातकम्..
विश्वामित्रे तु विख्यातः सुमन्तोरेव एव हि .. 2.2.9.10 ..
text_mt:
And likewise for Caṇḍakauśika, Devarāṭ, and Devarātaka;
and among Viśvāmitras, celebrated indeed is that of Sumantu.

sanskrit_iast:
taruṃkaśākaṭāyanaḥ svayameva pravaratrayam ..
bhramadvayaṃ jaimineśca svayaṃ vāśiṣṭhameva ca .. 11 ..
meaning:
तरुंकशाकटायनः स्वयमेव प्रवरत्रयम् ..
भ्रमद्वयं जैमिनेश्च स्वयं वाशिष्ठमेव च .. 11 ..
text_mt:
Taruṃka, Śākaṭāyana, and oneself are the three pravaras.
For Jaimini, the pair of Bhramas, oneself, and Vāsiṣṭha.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkhamāṃgirasacyavanaṃ śaṃkhabhasya trayaṃ matam..
vātsyasya cyavano nāma āplavāyanakastathā .. 12 ..
meaning:
शंखमांगिरसच्यवनं शंखभस्य त्रयं मतम्..
वात्स्यस्य च्यवनो नाम आप्लवायनकस्तथा .. 12 ..
text_mt:
Śaṅkha, Āṅgirasa, and Cyavana are considered the three for Śaṅkhabha.
For Vātsya, [the pravaras] are named Cyavana and Āplavāyanaka.

sanskrit_iast:
sāvarṇasya tu sāvarṇyacyavanajāmadagnibhārgavam ..
āplavāyaneti pāṭhīne eka eva tu sattamāḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
सावर्णस्य तु सावर्ण्यच्यवनजामदग्निभार्गवम् ..
आप्लवायनेति पाठीने एक एव तु सत्तमाः .. 13 ..
text_mt:
For Sāvarṇa, however, Sāvarṇya, Cyavana, Jāmadagni, and Bhārgava;
while in the Āplavāyana reading, there is only one, O best of men!

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇājinasya kṛṣṇājinaṃ viśvāmitrasya jaiminam ..
kātyāyanasya kātyāyanagārgyāyaṇatrayaṃ tathā .. 14 ..
meaning:
कृष्णाजिनस्य कृष्णाजिनं विश्वामित्रस्य जैमिनम् ..
कात्यायनस्य कात्यायनगार्ग्यायणत्रयं तथा .. 14 ..
text_mt:
For Kṛṣṇājina, Kṛṣṇājina; for Viśvāmitra, Jaimini;
for Kātyāyana, the triad of Kātyāyana and Gārgyāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vātsyāyaneti vikhyātaṃ kuśikasya ca paṃcamam ..
amuṃ ca viśvāmitraṃ ca jāmadagnyāplavāyanam .. 15 ..
meaning:
वात्स्यायनेति विख्यातं कुशिकस्य च पंचमम् ..
अमुं च विश्वामित्रं च जामदग्न्याप्लवायनम् .. 15 ..
text_mt:
Declared as Vātsyāyana, and the fifth for Kuśika;
this and Viśvāmitra, and Jāmadagnya and Āplavāyana.

sanskrit_iast:
gārgyasya gārgyasāmuṃca tathāṃgirasa eva ca ..
bārhaspatyabharadvāja iti paṃca prakīrtitam .. 16 ..
meaning:
गार्ग्यस्य गार्ग्यसामुंच तथांगिरस एव च ..
बार्हस्पत्यभरद्वाज इति पंच प्रकीर्तितम् .. 16 ..
text_mt:
For Gārgya, Gārgya, Sāmu, and likewise Āṅgirasa,
Bārhaspatya, and Bharadvāja: thus five are proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
vaśiṣṭhasya ca vāsiṣṭhaṃ ca tathāṃgirasa eva ca ..
mitrāvaruṇasaṃyuktaṃ tāvattasya prakīrtitam.. 17 ..
meaning:
वशिष्ठस्य च वासिष्ठं च तथांगिरस एव च ..
मित्रावरुणसंयुक्तं तावत्तस्य प्रकीर्तितम्.. 17 ..
text_mt:
And for Vasiṣṭha, Vāsiṣṭha, and likewise Āṅgirasa;
joined with Mitrāvaruṇa: so many are proclaimed for him.

sanskrit_iast:
jāhvakarṇabhavakarṇau pravarau parikīrtitau ..
upamanyurupamanyostathendraḥ saha eva ca .. 18 ..
meaning:
जाह्वकर्णभवकर्णौ प्रवरौ परिकीर्तितौ ..
उपमन्युरुपमन्योस्तथेन्द्रः सह एव च .. 18 ..
text_mt:
Jāhvakarṇa and Bhavakarṇa are proclaimed as the two pravaras.
For Upamanyu, Upamanyu, then Indra, together with [Pramatha].

sanskrit_iast:
taduttameti tritayaṃ mitrāvaruṇasya ca trayam ..
ātreyagautamāṃgirasapravaratrayameva hi .. 19 ..
meaning:
तदुत्तमेति त्रितयं मित्रावरुणस्य च त्रयम् ..
आत्रेयगौतमांगिरसप्रवरत्रयमेव हि .. 19 ..
text_mt:
Taduttama is the triad; and three for Mitrāvaruṇa:
indeed the triad of pravaras Ātreya, Gautama, and Āṅgirasa.

sanskrit_iast:
kamaṃḍalotpalamitrāmitrāvaruṇa eva ca ..
kamaṃḍaluśceti tritayaṃ pravaratrayameva ca .. 2.2.9.20 ..
meaning:
कमंडलोत्पलमित्रामित्रावरुण एव च ..
कमंडलुश्चेति त्रितयं प्रवरत्रयमेव च .. 2.2.9.20 ..
text_mt:
Kamaṇḍala, Utpalamitra, and Mitrāvaruṇa;
and Kamaṇḍalu: thus is the triad, indeed the three pravaras.

sanskrit_iast:
cyavanasya tathā jñeyamūrvacyavanāplavāyanam ..
atha sa kasyāṃgirasabārhaspatya eva trayam .. 21 ..
meaning:
च्यवनस्य तथा ज्ञेयमूर्वच्यवनाप्लवायनम् ..
अथ स कस्यांगिरसबार्हस्पत्य एव त्रयम् .. 21 ..
text_mt:
For Cyavana, Ūrva, Cyavana, and Āplavāyana should be known.
Then for Sa[śunaka?], Āṅgirasa and Bārhaspatya are the three.

sanskrit_iast:
āgastyasya agastiśca māhaśca cyavaneti ca ..
viśvāmitre devarāta autathyeti tathaiva ca .. 22..
meaning:
आगस्त्यस्य अगस्तिश्च माहश्च च्यवनेति च ..
विश्वामित्रे देवरात औतथ्येति तथैव च .. 22..
text_mt:
For Āgastya, Agasti, Māha, and Cyavana;
for Viśvāmitra, Devarāta, and likewise Autathya.

sanskrit_iast:
ye noktā ye 'pyavijñātāste proktāḥ kāśyapājjagat .. 23 ..
vāstuyāgavarṇanam
meaning:
ये नोक्ता ये ऽप्यविज्ञातास्ते प्रोक्ताः काश्यपाज्जगत् .. 23 ..
वास्तुयागवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Those that have not been stated and those that are unknown, the world declares them [sprung] from Kāśyapa.
Description of the sacrifice to the Vāstu

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
vāstuyāgamatho vakṣye balimaṇḍalapūrvakam ..
aṃkurārpaṇakaṃ kṛtvā madhye kuryācca maṃḍalam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
वास्तुयागमथो वक्ष्ये बलिमण्डलपूर्वकम् ..
अंकुरार्पणकं कृत्वा मध्ये कुर्याच्च मंडलम् .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Now I shall declare the sacrifice to the Vāstu, preceded by a bali-circle:
having performed the sprout-offering, one should make a mandala in the centre.
title: adhyāyaḥ 10

sanskrit_iast:
trihastā piṃḍikā kāryā caturasrā udakplavā ..
prādeśamātra utsedho darpaṇāṃtarnibho bhavet .. 2 ..
meaning:
त्रिहस्ता पिंडिका कार्या चतुरस्रा उदक्प्लवा ..
प्रादेशमात्र उत्सेधो दर्पणांतर्निभो भवेत् .. 2 ..
text_mt:
A platform three cubits [wide] should be made, square and sloping to the north;
its height should be a span, resembling the surface of a mirror.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye saṃmārjayedvidvānpādānnava yathākramāt..
koṇe catuṣpadaṃ jñeyaṃ dikṣu tripadakaṃ kramāt .. 3 ..
meaning:
मध्ये संमार्जयेद्विद्वान्पादान्नव यथाक्रमात्..
कोणे चतुष्पदं ज्ञेयं दिक्षु त्रिपदकं क्रमात् .. 3 ..
text_mt:
In the middle, the wise man should clean nine squares in succession;
at the corner, four squares should be known, and in the cardinal directions three squares in order.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcakaṃ yugmapādena caturdikṣu tataḥ param ..
koṇe catuṣpadaṃ sthāpyaṃ catuṣkoṇe vibhāvayet .. 4 ..
meaning:
पञ्चकं युग्मपादेन चतुर्दिक्षु ततः परम् ..
कोणे चतुष्पदं स्थाप्यं चतुष्कोणे विभावयेत् .. 4 ..
text_mt:
Thereafter, a group of five with a pair of squares in the four directions;
four squares are to be placed at the corner; he should meditate upon them at the four corners.

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣkoṇaṃ bahiḥ kuryātkoṇe cāpi catuṣṭayam ..
dvātriṃśacca bhavedbāhye cātaścāpi trayodaśa .. 5 ..
meaning:
चतुष्कोणं बहिः कुर्यात्कोणे चापि चतुष्टयम् ..
द्वात्रिंशच्च भवेद्बाह्ये चातश्चापि त्रयोदश .. 5 ..
text_mt:
Outside he should make a square, and four also at the corner;
there should be thirty-two on the outside, and thirteen here [within].

sanskrit_iast:
catvāriṃśatpañcayutā militvā vāstudevatāḥ ..
śikhī caivātha parjanyo jayaṃtaḥ kuliśāyudhaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
चत्वारिंशत्पञ्चयुता मिलित्वा वास्तुदेवताः ..
शिखी चैवाथ पर्जन्यो जयंतः कुलिशायुधः .. 6 ..
text_mt:
Together, the deities of the Vāstu are forty-five:
Śikhin, and then Parjanya, Jayanta, the thunderbolt-armed [Indra],

sanskrit_iast:
sūryaḥ satyo vṛṣaścaiva ākāśaṃ vāyureva ca ..
pūṣā ca vitathaścaiva guhānyaśca yamastathā ..7..
meaning:
सूर्यः सत्यो वृषश्चैव आकाशं वायुरेव च ..
पूषा च वितथश्चैव गुहान्यश्च यमस्तथा ..7..
text_mt:
Sūrya, Satya, and Vṛṣa, Ākāśa, and Vāyu,
Pūṣan, Vitatha, Guhānya, and Yama,

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvo mṛgarājastu mṛgāḥ pitṛgaṇāstathā ..
dauvāriko'tha sugrīvaḥ puṣpadanto jalādhipaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
गन्धर्वो मृगराजस्तु मृगाः पितृगणास्तथा ..
दौवारिकोऽथ सुग्रीवः पुष्पदन्तो जलाधिपः .. 8 ..
text_mt:
Gandharva, the king of beasts, the deer, and the classes of ancestors,
Dauvārika, then Sugrīva, Puṣpadanta, the lord of waters [Varuṇa],

sanskrit_iast:
asuraḥ paśupāśau ca rogo hi mokṣa eva ca ..
bhallāṭaḥ somasarpau ca aditiśca ditistathā .. 9 ..
meaning:
असुरः पशुपाशौ च रोगो हि मोक्ष एव च ..
भल्लाटः सोमसर्पौ च अदितिश्च दितिस्तथा .. 9 ..
text_mt:
Asura, Paśu and Pāśa, Roga, and Mokṣa,
Bhallāṭa, Soma and Sarpa, Aditi, and Diti.

sanskrit_iast:
bahirdvādaśa ityetānīśānādīnyathākramam ..
īśānādicatuṣkoṇaṃ saṃsthitānpūjayedbudhaḥ .. 2.2.10.10 ..
meaning:
बहिर्द्वादश इत्येतानीशानादीन्यथाक्रमम् ..
ईशानादिचतुष्कोणं संस्थितान्पूजयेद्बुधः .. 2.2.10.10 ..
text_mt:
These twelve on the outside, beginning with Īśāna, in proper order—
the wise man should worship them stationed in the four corners beginning with Īśāna.

sanskrit_iast:
āpaścaivātha sāvitro jayo rudrastathaiva ca ..
aryamā savitā caiva vivasvānvibudhādhipaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
आपश्चैवाथ सावित्रो जयो रुद्रस्तथैव च ..
अर्यमा सविता चैव विवस्वान्विबुधाधिपः .. 11 ..
text_mt:
And Āpas, then Sāvitra, Jaya, and Rudra,
Aryaman, Savitṛ, Vivasvat, and the lord of the gods [Indra],

sanskrit_iast:
mitro'tha rājayakṣmā ca saptamaḥ pṛthivīdharaḥ ..
aṣṭamastvāpavatsastu paridhau brahmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
मित्रोऽथ राजयक्ष्मा च सप्तमः पृथिवीधरः ..
अष्टमस्त्वापवत्सस्तु परिधौ ब्रह्मणः स्मृतः .. 12 ..
text_mt:
Mitra, then Rājayakṣman, and seventh Pṛthivīdhara;
and eighth Āpavatsa is remembered on the perimeter of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvādiṣu tathā pūjyā gandhapuṣpaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ ..
paṃcacatvāriṃśadetaccarakyā ca caturthakam .. 13 ..
meaning:
पूर्वादिषु तथा पूज्या गन्धपुष्पैः पृथग्विधैः ..
पंचचत्वारिंशदेतच्चरक्या च चतुर्थकम् .. 13 ..
text_mt:
They are to be worshipped in the east and other [directions] with perfumes and various flowers.
These are forty-five, and with Carakī [they form] the fourth group.

sanskrit_iast:
militvā ūnapañcāśaduttamā vāstudevatāḥ ..
nānyatra yojayedviprāḥ prāsāde ca viśeṣataḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
मिलित्वा ऊनपञ्चाशदुत्तमा वास्तुदेवताः ..
नान्यत्र योजयेद्विप्राः प्रासादे च विशेषतः .. 14 ..
text_mt:
Together, the superior deities of the Vāstu are forty-nine;
one must not employ them elsewhere, O Brahmins, but especially in a temple.

sanskrit_iast:
bahiḥ koṇe carakyādi carakaṃ ca vidārikām ..
pūtanāṃ ca tataḥ paścādvāyavye pāparākṣasīm .. 15 ..
meaning:
बहिः कोणे चरक्यादि चरकं च विदारिकाम् ..
पूतनां च ततः पश्चाद्वायव्ये पापराक्षसीम् .. 15 ..
text_mt:
At the outer corners, [he should place] Carakī and others: Caraka and Vidārikā,
and Pūtanā, and then afterwards the sin-demoness in the northwest.

sanskrit_iast:
svaiḥsvairmaṃtraiśca gaṃdhādyaiḥ pūjayetkusumādinā ..
yathoktena baliṃ dadyātpāyasānnena vā punaḥ.. 16 ..
meaning:
स्वैःस्वैर्मंत्रैश्च गंधाद्यैः पूजयेत्कुसुमादिना ..
यथोक्तेन बलिं दद्यात्पायसान्नेन वा पुनः.. 16 ..
text_mt:
He should worship them with their own mantras, perfumes, flowers, and the like;
he should present a bali according to what has been taught, or with milk-rice.

sanskrit_iast:
rekhāḥ sarvatra śuklena padmaṃ raktena bhāvayet ..
rañjayedeva varṇena bahiṣpañcarajena tu .. 17 ..
meaning:
रेखाः सर्वत्र शुक्लेन पद्मं रक्तेन भावयेत् ..
रञ्जयेदेव वर्णेन बहिष्पञ्चरजेन तु .. 17 ..
text_mt:
The lines should be white everywhere; he should visualize the lotus as red;
and he should color the outside with five-colored powder.

sanskrit_iast:
devavarṇānatho vakṣye yathāvadanuvarṇitāḥ ..
rakto gaurastathā śoṇaḥ sitaraktaḥ sitastathā .. 18 ..
meaning:
देववर्णानथो वक्ष्ये यथावदनुवर्णिताः ..
रक्तो गौरस्तथा शोणः सितरक्तः सितस्तथा .. 18 ..
text_mt:
Next, I shall explain the deities' colours as properly described:
red, fair, crimson, white-and-red, and white;

sanskrit_iast:
pītaḥ śuklaśca dharmaśca pūṣā raktaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
śyāmaḥ śukraśca kṛṣṇaśca pītaḥ śuklo yathākramam .. 19 ..
meaning:
पीतः शुक्लश्च धर्मश्च पूषा रक्तः प्रकीर्तितः ..
श्यामः शुक्रश्च कृष्णश्च पीतः शुक्लो यथाक्रमम् .. 19 ..
text_mt:
yellow, white; Dharma is red, and Pūṣan is declared red;
dark, bright, black, yellow, and white in sequence;

sanskrit_iast:
pīto bhṛṃgaḥ punaḥ śuklaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śuklastathaiva ca ..
raktaḥ śuklaśca śoṇaśca kṛṣṇaraktastathaiva ca .. 2.2.10.20 ..
meaning:
पीतो भृंगः पुनः शुक्लः कृष्णः शुक्लस्तथैव च ..
रक्तः शुक्लश्च शोणश्च कृष्णरक्तस्तथैव च .. 2.2.10.20 ..
text_mt:
yellow, Bhṛṅga is white, black, white as well,
red, white, crimson, and black-and-red as well;

sanskrit_iast:
dhūmrapīto raktapītaḥ śuklaḥ kṛṣṇaśca śyāmakaḥ ..
raktavarṇena dvātriṃśaddaśa varṇāḥ prakīrtitāḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
धूम्रपीतो रक्तपीतः शुक्लः कृष्णश्च श्यामकः ..
रक्तवर्णेन द्वात्रिंशद्दश वर्णाः प्रकीर्तिताः .. 21 ..
text_mt:
smoky-yellow, red-yellow, white, black, and dark;
with red, thirty-two [and] ten colours are declared;

sanskrit_iast:
śuklaśoṇaṃ punaḥ śvetaṃ siṃdūrābhaṃ prakīrtitam ..
pāṃḍurakuṃkumābhaṃ ca raktaṃ jñeyaṃ ca pītakam .. 22 ..
meaning:
शुक्लशोणं पुनः श्वेतं सिंदूराभं प्रकीर्तितम् ..
पांडुरकुंकुमाभं च रक्तं ज्ञेयं च पीतकम् .. 22 ..
text_mt:
white-and-crimson, then white, declared vermilion-hued,
pale, saffron-coloured, red, and known as yellow;

sanskrit_iast:
śuklapītaṃ ca śvetaṃ ca gauraṃ cetyaṣṭavarṇakam ..
pītaṃ raktaṃ ca śyāmaṃ ca gauraṃ ceti catuṣṭayam.. 23 ..
meaning:
शुक्लपीतं च श्वेतं च गौरं चेत्यष्टवर्णकम् ..
पीतं रक्तं च श्यामं च गौरं चेति चतुष्टयम्.. 23 ..
text_mt:
white-and-yellow, white, and fair: an eightfold set of colours;
yellow, red, dark, and fair: a group of four;

sanskrit_iast:
dharaṇīmadanaṃ vādye śaṃbhuvarṇādiprakramāt ..
śuklena rañjayeddvārānpuradvāraṃ ca madhyame .. 24 ..
meaning:
धरणीमदनं वाद्ये शंभुवर्णादिप्रक्रमात् ..
शुक्लेन रञ्जयेद्द्वारान्पुरद्वारं च मध्यमे .. 24 ..
text_mt:
Dharaṇī and Madana on the instruments, beginning in sequence with Śambhu's colours;
he should colour the gates white, and the city gate in the middle;

sanskrit_iast:
madhyeṃte ūnapañcāśatsarvaṃ ca vāstukarmaṇi ..
catvāriṃśaddvārayutaṃ gṛhadevakule'pi ca .. 25 ..
meaning:
मध्येंते ऊनपञ्चाशत्सर्वं च वास्तुकर्मणि ..
चत्वारिंशद्द्वारयुतं गृहदेवकुलेऽपि च .. 25 ..
