text_mt:
in the centre, at the edge, forty-nine in all in the rite of the site;
endowed with forty gates, both in a house and in a temple;

sanskrit_iast:
mahākūpe tathā śveto anyatrāpi praśasyate ..
sulipte ca śucau deśe sārdhahastapramāṇataḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
महाकूपे तथा श्वेतो अन्यत्रापि प्रशस्यते ..
सुलिप्ते च शुचौ देशे सार्धहस्तप्रमाणतः .. 26 ..
text_mt:
and white is praised at a great well, as well as elsewhere;
on a well-smeared and pure ground, measuring one and a half cubits;

sanskrit_iast:
daśa pūrvāyatā rekhā daśa caivottarāyatāḥ ..
ekādaśīpadaṃ kuryādrekhābhiḥ padakena tu .. 27 ..
meaning:
दश पूर्वायता रेखा दश चैवोत्तरायताः ..
एकादशीपदं कुर्याद्रेखाभिः पदकेन तु .. 27 ..
text_mt:
ten lines extending eastwards, and ten lines extending northwards;
he should make the eleventh square with the lines, forming a grid of squares;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavāstuvibhāgena vijñeyā navakā nava ..
padasthānpūjayeddevāṃstriṃśatpañcādaśadeva tu ..28..
meaning:
सर्ववास्तुविभागेन विज्ञेया नवका नव ..
पदस्थान्पूजयेद्देवांस्त्रिंशत्पञ्चादशदेव तु ..28..
text_mt:
by the division of the entire site, nine nines are to be known;
he should worship the deities situated in the squares, thirty [plus] five and ten;

sanskrit_iast:
dvātriṃśadbāhyataḥ pūjyāḥ pūjyāgāre trayodaśa ..
madhye nava pade brahmā tasyāpyaṣṭau samīpagāḥ ..29..
meaning:
द्वात्रिंशद्बाह्यतः पूज्याः पूज्यागारे त्रयोदश ..
मध्ये नव पदे ब्रह्मा तस्याप्यष्टौ समीपगाः ..29..
text_mt:
thirty-two are to be worshipped on the outside, thirteen within the house of worship;
in the middle, in nine squares, is Brahmā, and eight attend close to him;

sanskrit_iast:
caturdikṣu ṣaṭpadaṃ tu tripadaṃ tu catuṣpadam ..
padaikaṃ tu catuṣkoṇe eṣa vāstuvinirṇayaḥ ..
carakyādi tato hitvā catvāriṃśacca paṃcakam.. .. 2.2.10.30 ..
meaning:
चतुर्दिक्षु षट्पदं तु त्रिपदं तु चतुष्पदम् ..
पदैकं तु चतुष्कोणे एष वास्तुविनिर्णयः ..
चरक्यादि ततो हित्वा चत्वारिंशच्च पंचकम्.. .. 2.2.10.30 ..

sanskrit_iast:
aparaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vakṣye yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ ..
navarekhāprayogeṇa navakoṣṭhānprakalpayet .. 31 ..
meaning:
अपरं मण्डलं वक्ष्ये यथावदनुपूर्वशः ..
नवरेखाप्रयोगेण नवकोष्ठान्प्रकल्पयेत् .. 31 ..
text_mt:
I shall explain another maṇḍala, properly and in due order;
by applying nine lines, he should fashion nine compartments;

sanskrit_iast:
dvicatuṣkoṣṭhakairdikṣu yajetāryamaṇaṃ tataḥ ..
vivasvaṃtaṃ tato mittraṃ mahīdharamataḥ param .. 32 ..
meaning:
द्विचतुष्कोष्ठकैर्दिक्षु यजेतार्यमणं ततः ..
विवस्वंतं ततो मित्त्रं महीधरमतः परम् .. 32 ..
text_mt:
with two fourfold compartments in the quarters, he should then worship Aryaman;
then Vivasvat, then Mitra, and after him Mahīdhara;

sanskrit_iast:
koṇeṣu koṣṭhadvaṃdveṣu bāhyādiparikīrtitam ..
sāvitraṃ savitāraṃ ca śakramindraṃ jayaṃ punaḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
कोणेषु कोष्ठद्वंद्वेषु बाह्यादिपरिकीर्तितम् ..
सावित्रं सवितारं च शक्रमिन्द्रं जयं पुनः .. 33 ..
text_mt:
in the corners, in pairs of compartments, stated from the outside inwards:
Sāvitra and Savitṛ, Śakra and Indra, and then Jaya;

sanskrit_iast:
rudraṃ rudrajayaṃ caiva vāyuṃ jṛṃbhakameva ca ..
pilipicchaṃ ca medhāvī vidārī pūtanā tathā .. 34 ..
meaning:
रुद्रं रुद्रजयं चैव वायुं जृंभकमेव च ..
पिलिपिच्छं च मेधावी विदारी पूतना तथा .. 34 ..
text_mt:
Rudra, Rudrajaya, Vāyu, and Jṛmbhaka;
Pilipiccha, Medhāvin, Vidārī, and Pūtanā;

sanskrit_iast:
kramādīśānaparyaṃtāṃ jayaṃtaḥ śakrabhāskarau ..
satyovṛṣāṃtarikṣau ca diśi prācyāmavasthitāḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
क्रमादीशानपर्यंतां जयंतः शक्रभास्करौ ..
सत्योवृषांतरिक्षौ च दिशि प्राच्यामवस्थिताः .. 35 ..
text_mt:
in sequence up to the northeast: Jayanta, Śakra, and the Sun;
Satya, Vṛṣa, and Antarikṣa are positioned in the eastern quarter;

sanskrit_iast:
agniḥ pūṣā ca vitadho yamaśca gṛharakṣakaḥ ..
gaṃdharvo bhṛṃgarājaśca mṛgo dakṣiṇamāśritāḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
अग्निः पूषा च वितधो यमश्च गृहरक्षकः ..
गंधर्वो भृंगराजश्च मृगो दक्षिणमाश्रिताः .. 36 ..
text_mt:
Agni, Pūṣan, Vitatha, and Yama the house-guardian;
Gandharva, Bhṛṅgarāja, and Mṛga dwell in the south;

sanskrit_iast:
nirṛtirdauvārikaśca sugrīvavaruṇau tataḥ ..
puṣpadaṃtasvarau śoṣarogau pratyagdiśi sthitāḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
निरृतिर्दौवारिकश्च सुग्रीववरुणौ ततः ..
पुष्पदंतस्वरौ शोषरोगौ प्रत्यग्दिशि स्थिताः .. 37 ..
text_mt:
Nirṛti and Dauvārika, then Sugrīva and Varuṇa;
Puṣpadanta, Svara, Śoṣa, and Roga are situated in the western quarter;

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇavāyuśca nāgaśca somo bhallāṭa eva ca ..
mudgalākhyo dityaditī kuberasya diśi sthitāḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
प्राणवायुश्च नागश्च सोमो भल्लाट एव च ..
मुद्गलाख्यो दित्यदिती कुबेरस्य दिशि स्थिताः .. 38 ..
text_mt:
Prāṇavāyu, Nāga, Soma, Bhallāṭa,
Mudgala, Diti, and Aditi are situated in Kubera's quarter;

sanskrit_iast:
militvā ca tripañcāśattebhyaḥ pūrve baliṃ haret ..
piṇyākaiḥ paramānnairvā pūrvoktairvā yathā kramāt.. 39 ..
meaning:
मिलित्वा च त्रिपञ्चाशत्तेभ्यः पूर्वे बलिं हरेत् ..
पिण्याकैः परमान्नैर्वा पूर्वोक्तैर्वा यथा क्रमात्.. 39 ..
text_mt:
gathering together fifty-three, he should first offer them oblations,
with oil-cake, with choice porridge, or as previously stated in due sequence;

sanskrit_iast:
raktamaryamaṇaṃ dhyāyeccaturbhirbahubhirvṛtam ..
śvetāśvavāhanaṃ divyaṃ kirīṭaiḥ svairvibhūṣitam .. 2.2.10.40 ..
meaning:
रक्तमर्यमणं ध्यायेच्चतुर्भिर्बहुभिर्वृतम् ..
श्वेताश्ववाहनं दिव्यं किरीटैः स्वैर्विभूषितम् .. 2.2.10.40 ..
text_mt:
he should meditate upon Aryaman as red, attended by four arms,
having white horses for his mount, divine, adorned with his own crowns;

sanskrit_iast: ākṛṣṇeneti mantrasya svarṇa ṛṣijagatīchandaḥ savitraryamaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 41 ..
meaning: आकृष्णेनेति मन्त्रस्य स्वर्ण ऋषिजगतीछन्दः सवित्रर्यमप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 41 ..
text_mt: of the mantra beginning with *ākṛṣṇena*, Svarṇa is the seer, Jagatī the metre, and the application is to please Savitṛ and Aryaman;

sanskrit_iast:
vivasvaṃtaṃ pītavarṇaṃ pītāmbaradharaṃ śubham ..
meṣasthaṃ ca mahākāyaṃ devagandharvasevitam ..42..
meaning:
विवस्वंतं पीतवर्णं पीताम्बरधरं शुभम् ..
मेषस्थं च महाकायं देवगन्धर्वसेवितम् ..42..
text_mt:
Vivasvat is yellow-coloured, wearing yellow garments, auspicious,
mounted upon a ram, huge-bodied, served by gods and gandharvas;

sanskrit_iast: etātaviṣaṃtīti maṃtrasya kardama ṛṣiḥ paṃktiśchandaḥ kamalādevatāvivasvatprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 43 ..
meaning: एतातविषंतीति मंत्रस्य कर्दम ऋषिः पंक्तिश्छन्दः कमलादेवताविवस्वत्प्रीतये विनियोगः .. 43 ..
text_mt: of the mantra beginning with *etātaviṣantī*, Kardama is the seer, Paṅkti the metre, Kamalā the deity, and the application is to please Vivasvat;

sanskrit_iast:
mitraṃ dhyāyecchuklavarṇaṃ śvetahaṃsoparisthi tam ..
trinetraṃ tribhujaṃ caiva śvetāṃbaradharaṃ śubham .. 44 ..
meaning:
मित्रं ध्यायेच्छुक्लवर्णं श्वेतहंसोपरिस्थि तम् ..
त्रिनेत्रं त्रिभुजं चैव श्वेतांबरधरं शुभम् .. 44 ..
text_mt:
he should meditate upon Mitra as white-coloured, standing upon a white swan,
three-eyed, three-armed, auspicious, dressed in white garments;

sanskrit_iast: kayānaścīti maṃtrasya jayaṃta ṛṣirgāyatrī chandaḥ śaṅkaro devatā mitraprītaye viniyogaḥ .. ..45..
meaning: कयानश्चीति मंत्रस्य जयंत ऋषिर्गायत्री छन्दः शङ्करो देवता मित्रप्रीतये विनियोगः .. ..45..
text_mt: of the mantra beginning with *kayānaścī*, Jayanta is the seer, Gāyatrī the metre, Śaṅkara the deity, and the application is to please Mitra;

sanskrit_iast:
prītaṃ mahīdharaṃ dhyāyedvṛṣabhopari saṃsthim..
tribhujaṃ padmahastaṃ ca vyālayajñopavītinam ..46..
meaning:
प्रीतं महीधरं ध्यायेद्वृषभोपरि संस्थिम्..
त्रिभुजं पद्महस्तं च व्यालयज्ञोपवीतिनम् ..46..
text_mt:
he should meditate upon pleased Mahīdhara standing upon a bull,
three-armed, holding a lotus, wearing a snake as his sacred thread;

sanskrit_iast: tryambakamiti maṃtrasya gargaṛṣistriṣṭup chando haro devatā mahīdharaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 47 ..
meaning: त्र्यम्बकमिति मंत्रस्य गर्गऋषिस्त्रिष्टुप् छन्दो हरो देवता महीधरप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 47 ..
text_mt: of the mantra beginning with *tryambakam*, Garga is the seer, Triṣṭubh the metre, Hara the deity, and the application is to please Mahīdhara;

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitrīṃ śvetavarṇāṃ ca sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutām ..
dvibhujāṃ pītavastrāṃ ca śvetasiṃhāsane sthitām .. 48 ..
meaning:
सावित्रीं श्वेतवर्णां च सर्वलक्षणसंयुताम् ..
द्विभुजां पीतवस्त्रां च श्वेतसिंहासने स्थिताम् .. 48 ..
text_mt:
Sāvitrī is white-coloured, endowed with all auspicious marks,
two-armed, clad in yellow garments, seated upon a white throne;

sanskrit_iast: raktāmbaradharāṃ raktāṃ raktamālopaśobhitām .. 49 ..
meaning: रक्ताम्बरधरां रक्तां रक्तमालोपशोभिताम् .. 49 ..
text_mt: wearing red garments, red-complexioned, adorned with a garland of red flowers;

sanskrit_iast: tadvarṣaṃ iti maṃtrasya gautama ṛṣirvirāṭ chandaḥ sūryo devatā savitṛprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 2.2.10.50 ..
meaning: तद्वर्षं इति मंत्रस्य गौतम ऋषिर्विराट् छन्दः सूर्यो देवता सवितृप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 2.2.10.50 ..
text_mt: of the mantra beginning with *tadvarṣaṃ*, Gautama is the seer, Virāṭ the metre, Sūrya the deity, and the application is to please Savitṛ;

sanskrit_iast:
śakraṃ dhyāyetpītavarṇaṃ śuklakairāvatasthitam ..
sarvadevaiḥ stūyamānaṃ dvibhujaṃ pītavāsasam ..51..
meaning:
शक्रं ध्यायेत्पीतवर्णं शुक्लकैरावतस्थितम् ..
सर्वदेवैः स्तूयमानं द्विभुजं पीतवाससम् ..51..
text_mt:
he should meditate upon Śakra as yellow-coloured, standing upon white Airāvata,
praised by all the deities, two-armed, clad in yellow clothes;

sanskrit_iast: trātāramiti maṃtrasya bhārgava ṛṣistriṣṭup chando narasiṃho devatā indrajayaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 52 ..
meaning: त्रातारमिति मंत्रस्य भार्गव ऋषिस्त्रिष्टुप् छन्दो नरसिंहो देवता इन्द्रजयप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 52 ..
text_mt: of the mantra beginning with *trātāram*, Bhārgava is the seer, Triṣṭubh the metre, Narasiṃha the deity, and the application is to please Indra and Jaya;

sanskrit_iast:
rudraṃ dhyāyecchvetavarṇaṃ vṛṣabhārūḍhavigraham ..
nāgayajñopavītaṃ ca sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam .. 53 ..
meaning:
रुद्रं ध्यायेच्छ्वेतवर्णं वृषभारूढविग्रहम् ..
नागयज्ञोपवीतं च सर्वलक्षणसंयुतम् .. 53 ..
text_mt:
he should meditate upon Rudra as white-coloured, his body mounted on a bull,
with a snake for his sacred thread, endowed with all auspicious marks;

sanskrit_iast: namaste rudreti maṃtrasya gāyatrī chaṃdastryaṃbako devatā rudraprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 54 ..
meaning: नमस्ते रुद्रेति मंत्रस्य गायत्री छंदस्त्र्यंबको देवता रुद्रप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 54 ..
text_mt: of the mantra beginning with *namaste rudra*, Gāyatrī is the metre, Tryambaka the deity, and the application is to please Rudra;

sanskrit_iast:
raktaṃ rudraṃ jayaṃ dhyāyedraktapadmopari sthitam ..
raktaśyāmāṃbaradharaṃ dvibhujaṃ raktavāsasam .. 55 ..
meaning:
रक्तं रुद्रं जयं ध्यायेद्रक्तपद्मोपरि स्थितम् ..
रक्तश्यामांबरधरं द्विभुजं रक्तवाससम् .. 55 ..
text_mt:
he should meditate upon red Rudrajaya standing upon a red lotus,
wearing garments of red and dark, two-armed, clad in red clothes;

sanskrit_iast: tryaṃbakamiti mantrasya gāyatrīcchando maheśo devatā rudrajayaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 56 ..
meaning: त्र्यंबकमिति मन्त्रस्य गायत्रीच्छन्दो महेशो देवता रुद्रजयप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 56 ..
text_mt: of the mantra beginning with *tryambakam*, Gāyatrī is the metre, Maheśa the deity, and the application is to please Rudrajaya;

sanskrit_iast:
api śvetaṃ tato dhyāyedvarābhayakaraṃ param ..
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ śvetapadmopari sthitam .. 57 ..
meaning:
अपि श्वेतं ततो ध्यायेद्वराभयकरं परम् ..
सर्वलक्षणसंपन्नं श्वेतपद्मोपरि स्थितम् .. 57 ..
text_mt:
then he should also meditate upon Ap as white, supreme, granting boons and fearlessness,
endowed with all auspicious marks, standing upon a white lotus;

sanskrit_iast:
īśāna iti maṃtrasya marīcirṛṣiḥ paṃkticchando vāyurdevatā apāṃ prītaye viniyogaḥ..
āpavatsaṃ pītavarṇaṃ meṣārūḍhaṃ caturbhujam ..58..
meaning:
ईशान इति मंत्रस्य मरीचिरृषिः पंक्तिच्छन्दो वायुर्देवता अपां प्रीतये विनियोगः..
आपवत्सं पीतवर्णं मेषारूढं चतुर्भुजम् ..58..
text_mt:
of the mantra beginning with *īśāna*, Marīci is the seer, Paṅkti the metre, Vāyu the deity, and the application is to please Apas;
Āpavatsa is yellow-coloured, mounted upon a ram, four-armed;

sanskrit_iast: padmaśaṃkhadharaṃ vāme varābhayakaraṃ param .. 59..
meaning: पद्मशंखधरं वामे वराभयकरं परम् .. 59..
text_mt: holding a lotus and a conch, supreme, his left hand bestowing boons and fearlessness;

sanskrit_iast: varuṇasyottaṃbhanamasīti mantrasya narottama ṛṣirvirāṭ chando varuṇo devatā āvayaḥ prītaye viniyogaḥ ..2.2.10.60..
meaning: वरुणस्योत्तंभनमसीति मन्त्रस्य नरोत्तम ऋषिर्विराट् छन्दो वरुणो देवता आवयः प्रीतये विनियोगः ..2.2.10.60..
text_mt: of the mantra beginning with *varuṇasyottambhanam asi*, Narottama is the seer, Virāṭ the metre, Vāruṇa the deity, and the application is to please Āvaya;

sanskrit_iast:
koṇasūtrasyobhayataḥ śvetakoṣṭhadvaye punaḥ..
śarvaṃ dhyāyedraktavarṇaṃ vṛṣabhopari saṃsthitam ..61....
meaning:
कोणसूत्रस्योभयतः श्वेतकोष्ठद्वये पुनः..
शर्वं ध्यायेद्रक्तवर्णं वृषभोपरि संस्थितम् ..61....
text_mt:
furthermore, on both sides of the diagonal line, in two white compartments,
he should meditate upon Śarva as red-coloured, mounted upon a bull;

sanskrit_iast: dvibhujaṃ ca trinetraṃ ca jaṭābhāropaśobhitam ..62..
meaning: द्विभुजं च त्रिनेत्रं च जटाभारोपशोभितम् ..62..
text_mt: two-armed, three-eyed, and adorned with a mass of matted hair.

sanskrit_iast: mālā svāheti maṃtrasya bhārgava ṛṣirgāyatrīchando mahādevo devatā śarvaprītaye viniyogaḥ...63.
meaning: माला स्वाहेति मंत्रस्य भार्गव ऋषिर्गायत्रीछन्दो महादेवो देवता शर्वप्रीतये विनियोगः...63.
text_mt: Of the mantra 'mālā svāhā', the seer is Bhārgava, the metre is Gāyatrī, the deity is Mahādeva, and the application is for the propitiation of Śarva.

sanskrit_iast:
guhaṃ dhyāyetpītavarṇaṃ pītapadmāsanasthitama ..
nānābharaṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ kuṇḍalādyairalaṅkṛtam .. 64 ..
meaning:
गुहं ध्यायेत्पीतवर्णं पीतपद्मासनस्थितम ..
नानाभरणशोभाढ्यं कुण्डलाद्यैरलङ्कृतम् .. 64 ..
text_mt: One should meditate upon Guha as yellow-coloured, seated on a yellow lotus seat, / rich in the splendour of various ornaments, adorned with earrings and the like.

sanskrit_iast: sa bodha iti mantrasya agastirṛṣirgāyatrī chando haro devatā guhaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 65 ..
meaning: स बोध इति मन्त्रस्य अगस्तिरृषिर्गायत्री छन्दो हरो देवता गुहप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 65 ..
text_mt: Of the mantra 'sa bodha', the seer is Agasti, the metre is Gāyatrī, the deity is Hara, and the application is for the propitiation of Guha.

sanskrit_iast:
aryamṇaṃ dvibhujaṃ raktaṃ raktamālyopaśobhitam..
raktapadmāsanasthaṃ ca devagandharvasevitam .. 66 ..
meaning:
अर्यम्णं द्विभुजं रक्तं रक्तमाल्योपशोभितम्..
रक्तपद्मासनस्थं च देवगन्धर्वसेवितम् .. 66 ..
text_mt: Aryaman is two-armed, red, adorned with red garlands, / seated upon a red lotus seat, and served by gods and gandharvas.

sanskrit_iast: vāto vāreti maṃtrasya kāśyapa ṛṣiranuṣṭupchando vāyurdevatā aryamaprītaye viniyogaḥ..67..
meaning: वातो वारेति मंत्रस्य काश्यप ऋषिरनुष्टुप्छन्दो वायुर्देवता अर्यमप्रीतये विनियोगः..67..
text_mt: Of the mantra 'vāto vā', the seer is Kāśyapa, the metre is Anuṣṭubh, the deity is Vāyu, and the application is for the propitiation of Aryaman.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyecca jambhakaṃ śvetaṃ dvibhujaṃ kuṭilānanam ..
karālavadanaṃ ghoraṃ varāhopari saṃsthitam .. 68 ..
meaning:
ध्यायेच्च जम्भकं श्वेतं द्विभुजं कुटिलाननम् ..
करालवदनं घोरं वराहोपरि संस्थितम् .. 68 ..
text_mt: And one should meditate upon Jambhaka as white, two-armed, with a crooked face, / terrible-faced, fearsome, and mounted upon a boar.

sanskrit_iast: kuvidogavaya iti mantrasya viśvāmitra ṛṣirjagatī chandaḥ somo devatā jaṃbhakaprītaye viniyogaḥ ..69..
meaning: कुविदोगवय इति मन्त्रस्य विश्वामित्र ऋषिर्जगती छन्दः सोमो देवता जंभकप्रीतये विनियोगः ..69..
text_mt: Of the mantra 'kuvidogavaya', the seer is Viśvāmitra, the metre is Jagatī, the deity is Soma, and the application is for the propitiation of Jambhaka.

sanskrit_iast:
pilapicchaṃ raktavarṇaṃ raktamālyairalaṅkṛtam ..
raktapadmāsanasthaṃ ca raktābharaṇaśobhitam .. 2.2.10.70 ..
meaning:
पिलपिच्छं रक्तवर्णं रक्तमाल्यैरलङ्कृतम् ..
रक्तपद्मासनस्थं च रक्ताभरणशोभितम् .. 2.2.10.70 ..
text_mt: Pilapiccha is red-coloured, adorned with red garlands, / seated on a red lotus seat, and beautified with red ornaments.

sanskrit_iast: devasya heti mantrasya paṃktiśchaṃdaḥ śacī devatā pilapicchaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 71 ..
meaning: देवस्य हेति मन्त्रस्य पंक्तिश्छंदः शची देवता पिलपिच्छप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 71 ..
text_mt: Of the mantra 'devasya ha', the metre is Paṅkti, the deity is Śacī, and the application is for the propitiation of Pilapiccha.

sanskrit_iast:
pītāṃ ca carakīṃ dhyāyedraktamālyairalaṃkṛtām ..
sucāruvadanāṃ bhavyāṃ guñjāhāropaśobhitām .. 72 ..
meaning:
पीतां च चरकीं ध्यायेद्रक्तमाल्यैरलंकृताम् ..
सुचारुवदनां भव्यां गुञ्जाहारोपशोभिताम् .. 72 ..
text_mt: One should meditate upon Carakī as yellow, adorned with red garlands, / very lovely-faced, auspicious, and graced with a necklace of guñjā [berries].

sanskrit_iast: tadvarṣaṃ iti mantrasya jaṭila ṛṣirbṛhatī chando bhavo devatā carakīprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 73 ..
meaning: तद्वर्षं इति मन्त्रस्य जटिल ऋषिर्बृहती छन्दो भवो देवता चरकीप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 73 ..
text_mt: Of the mantra 'tadvarṣam', the seer is Jaṭila, the metre is Bṛhatī, the deity is Bhava, and the application is for the propitiation of Carakī.

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmāṃ vidārikāṃ dhyāyettrinetrāṃ ca caturbhujām..
nānāgaṇayutāṃ devīṃ paṅkajadvayadhāriṇīm .. 74..
meaning:
श्यामां विदारिकां ध्यायेत्त्रिनेत्रां च चतुर्भुजाम्..
नानागणयुतां देवीं पङ्कजद्वयधारिणीम् .. 74..
text_mt: One should meditate upon Vidārikā as dark, three-eyed and four-armed, / a goddess accompanied by various hosts, holding two lotuses.

sanskrit_iast: śrīśca te iti mantrasya varuṇa ṛṣirnṛsiṃho devatā vidārikāprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 75 ..
meaning: श्रीश्च ते इति मन्त्रस्य वरुण ऋषिर्नृसिंहो देवता विदारिकाप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 75 ..
text_mt: Of the mantra 'śrīśca te', the seer is Varuṇa, the deity is Nṛsiṃha, and the application is for the propitiation of Vidārikā.

sanskrit_iast:
raktāṃ ca pūtanāṃ dhyāyetpaṅkajasthāṃ suśobhanām ..
sarvābharaṇasaṃpannāṃ sarvālaṃkāraśobhitām .. 76 ..
meaning:
रक्तां च पूतनां ध्यायेत्पङ्कजस्थां सुशोभनाम् ..
सर्वाभरणसंपन्नां सर्वालंकारशोभिताम् .. 76 ..
text_mt: One should meditate upon Pūtanā as red, seated on a lotus, very splendid, / endowed with all ornaments, and beautified with all decorations.

sanskrit_iast: mayi gṛhṇāmīti maṃtrasya vivasvānṛṣirnārāyaṇo devatā pūtanāprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 77 ..
meaning: मयि गृह्णामीति मंत्रस्य विवस्वानृषिर्नारायणो देवता पूतनाप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 77 ..
text_mt: Of the mantra 'mayi gṛhṇāmi', the seer is Vivasvan, the deity is Nārāyaṇa, and the application is for the propitiation of Pūtanā.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvādidikṣu sarvāsu sārdhādyaṃtapadeṣu ca ..
īśānaṃ jaṭilaṃ śvetaṃ śūlahastaṃ mahābhujam ..78..
meaning:
पूर्वादिदिक्षु सर्वासु सार्धाद्यंतपदेषु च ..
ईशानं जटिलं श्वेतं शूलहस्तं महाभुजम् ..78..
text_mt: In all the directions, beginning with the east, and in the outer boundary squares: / Īśāna is matted-haired, white, spear in hand, mighty-armed,

sanskrit_iast: trinetraṃ vṛṣabhārūḍhaṃ nāgahāro paśobhitam .. 79 ..
meaning: त्रिनेत्रं वृषभारूढं नागहारो पशोभितम् .. 79 ..
text_mt: three-eyed, mounted upon a bull, and adorned with a snake-necklace.

sanskrit_iast: āyuḥśīrṣāṇa iti maṃtrasya vāmadeva ṛṣirbṛhatī chando dharaṇīdharo devatā īśānaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 2.2.10.80 ..
meaning: आयुःशीर्षाण इति मंत्रस्य वामदेव ऋषिर्बृहती छन्दो धरणीधरो देवता ईशानप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 2.2.10.80 ..
text_mt: Of the mantra 'āyuḥśīrṣāṇa', the seer is Vāmadeva, the metre is Bṛhatī, the deity is Dharaṇīdhara, and the application is for the propitiation of Īśāna.

sanskrit_iast:
raktaṃ dhyāyecca parjanyaṃ dvibhujaṃ pītavāsasam ..
dakṣiṇe paraśuṃ dhyāyedoṃkāraṃ ca tathāpare .. 81..
meaning:
रक्तं ध्यायेच्च पर्जन्यं द्विभुजं पीतवाससम् ..
दक्षिणे परशुं ध्यायेदोंकारं च तथापरे .. 81..
text_mt: And one should meditate upon Parjanya as red, two-armed, clad in yellow garments; / one should meditate upon an axe in the right hand, and likewise an oṃkāra in the other.

sanskrit_iast: kayānaśceti mantrasya dharma ṛṣirbṛhatī chando bhavo devatā parjanya prītaye viniyogaḥ ..82..
meaning: कयानश्चेति मन्त्रस्य धर्म ऋषिर्बृहती छन्दो भवो देवता पर्जन्य प्रीतये विनियोगः ..82..
text_mt: Of the mantra 'kayā naḥ', the seer is Dharma, the metre is Bṛhatī, the deity is Bhava, and the application is for the propitiation of Parjanya.

sanskrit_iast:
jayantaṃ śvetaṃ śvetavṛṣabhārūḍhaṃ dhyātvā..
mānastoketi mantrasya śaktyṛṣistriṣṭupchandaḥ śaṅkaro devatā jayaṃtaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 83 ..
meaning:
जयन्तं श्वेतं श्वेतवृषभारूढं ध्यात्वा..
मानस्तोकेति मन्त्रस्य शक्त्यृषिस्त्रिष्टुप्छन्दः शङ्करो देवता जयंतप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 83 ..
text_mt: Having meditated upon Jayanta as white and mounted upon a white bull: / of the mantra 'mā nastoka', the seer is Śakti, the metre is Triṣṭubh, the deity is Śaṅkara, and the application is for the propitiation of Jayanta.

sanskrit_iast: śuklaṃ pītaṃ dvibhujamairāvatasthaṃ vajradharaṃ dhyātvā mūlabījena sthāpayet .. 84 ..
meaning: शुक्लं पीतं द्विभुजमैरावतस्थं वज्रधरं ध्यात्वा मूलबीजेन स्थापयेत् .. 84 ..
text_mt: Having meditated upon [Indra] as white-yellow, two-armed, seated upon Airāvata, holding a thunderbolt, one should install him with the root seed-syllable.

sanskrit_iast: bhāskaraṃ raktadvibhujaṃ raktāśvasthaṃ dhyātvā māyābījena pūjayet ..85..
meaning: भास्करं रक्तद्विभुजं रक्ताश्वस्थं ध्यात्वा मायाबीजेन पूजयेत् ..85..
text_mt: Having meditated upon Bhāskara as red, two-armed, and seated on a red horse, one should worship him with the māyā seed-syllable.

sanskrit_iast:
satyaṃ ca dvibhujaṃ śvetaṃ trinetraṃ pītavāsasaṃ mandakuṃdabījena pūjayet..
vṛṣaṃ pītaṃ vṛṣabhārūḍhamākāśabījena pūjayet ..86..
meaning:
सत्यं च द्विभुजं श्वेतं त्रिनेत्रं पीतवाससं मन्दकुंदबीजेन पूजयेत्..
वृषं पीतं वृषभारूढमाकाशबीजेन पूजयेत् ..86..
text_mt: And one should worship Satya, two-armed, white, three-eyed, clad in yellow garments, with the mandakunda seed-syllable; / one should worship Vṛṣa, yellow and mounted upon a bull, with the space seed-syllable.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛkṣaṃ nīlaṃ caturbhujaṃ mahiṣārūḍham ..
ācchīma iti mantrasya hotā yakṣa ṛṣistriṣṭupchandaḥ śaṃkaro devatā ṛkṣaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 87 ..
meaning:
ऋक्षं नीलं चतुर्भुजं महिषारूढम् ..
आच्छीम इति मन्त्रस्य होता यक्ष ऋषिस्त्रिष्टुप्छन्दः शंकरो देवता ऋक्षप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 87 ..
text_mt: Ṛkṣa is dark blue, four-armed, and mounted upon a buffalo. / Of the mantra 'ācchīma', the seer is the Hotṛ Yakṣa, the metre is Triṣṭubh, the deity is Śaṅkara, and the application is for the propitiation of Ṛkṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
agnimārabhya pūjayet ..
agniṃ raktaṃ saptajihvaṃ raktavāsasaṃ piṅgākṣaṃ dhyātvā ..
agnidūtamiti maṃtrasya bharadvāja ṛṣistriṣṭucchandaḥ śaṃkaro devatā agniprītaye vini yogaḥ .. 88 ..
meaning:
अग्निमारभ्य पूजयेत् ..
अग्निं रक्तं सप्तजिह्वं रक्तवाससं पिङ्गाक्षं ध्यात्वा ..
अग्निदूतमिति मंत्रस्य भरद्वाज ऋषिस्त्रिष्टुच्छन्दः शंकरो देवता अग्निप्रीतये विनि योगः .. 88 ..
text_mt: Beginning with Agni, one should worship: / having meditated upon Agni as red, seven-tongued, clad in red garments, with tawny eyes; / of the mantra 'agnidūtam', the seer is Bharadvāja, the metre is Triṣṭubh, the deity is Śaṅkara, and the application is for the propitiation of Agni.

sanskrit_iast: vitathaṃ raktamajavāhanaṃ dvibhujaṃ dhyātvā gāyatryā pūjayet .. 89 ..
meaning: वितथं रक्तमजवाहनं द्विभुजं ध्यात्वा गायत्र्या पूजयेत् .. 89 ..
text_mt: Having meditated upon Vitatha as red, with a goat as his mount, and two-armed, one should worship him with the Gāyatrī.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatryā viśvāmitra ṛṣirgāyatrīchandaḥ savitā devatā vitathaprītaye viniyogaḥ ..2.2.10.90..
meaning: गायत्र्या विश्वामित्र ऋषिर्गायत्रीछन्दः सविता देवता वितथप्रीतये विनियोगः ..2.2.10.90..
text_mt: Of the Gāyatrī, the seer is Viśvāmitra, the metre is Gāyatrī, the deity is Savitṛ, and the application is for the propitiation of Vitatha.

sanskrit_iast:
yamaṃ kṛṣṇamahiṣārūḍhaṃ daṇḍahastaṃ dhyāyet ..
acchiya iti mantrasya triṣṭupchando bhavānī devatā yamaprītaye viniyogaḥ ..91..
meaning:
यमं कृष्णमहिषारूढं दण्डहस्तं ध्यायेत् ..
अच्छिय इति मन्त्रस्य त्रिष्टुप्छन्दो भवानी देवता यमप्रीतये विनियोगः ..91..
text_mt: One should meditate upon Yama as mounted upon a black buffalo, with a staff in hand. / Of the mantra 'acchiya', the metre is Triṣṭubh, the deity is Bhavānī, and the application is for the propitiation of Yama.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhe kṣetraṃ raktamūrdhvakeśaṃ mahābhujaṃ raktavāsasaṃ dhyātvā vahnibījena pūjayet ..92..
meaning: गृहे क्षेत्रं रक्तमूर्ध्वकेशं महाभुजं रक्तवाससं ध्यात्वा वह्निबीजेन पूजयेत् ..92..
text_mt: In the house [compartment], having meditated upon Kṣetra as red, with upright hair, mighty-armed, and clad in red garments, one should worship him with the fire seed-syllable.

sanskrit_iast: gandharvaṃ śvetaṃ dvibhujaṃ padmāsanasthaṃ dhyātvā yamabījena pūjayet ..93..
meaning: गन्धर्वं श्वेतं द्विभुजं पद्मासनस्थं ध्यात्वा यमबीजेन पूजयेत् ..93..
text_mt: Having meditated upon Gandharva as white, two-armed, and seated upon a lotus seat, one should worship him with the Yama seed-syllable.

sanskrit_iast: bhṛṅgarājaṃ raktasiṃhāsanārūḍhaṃ divyayajñopavītinaṃ dhyāyet .. 94 ..
meaning: भृङ्गराजं रक्तसिंहासनारूढं दिव्ययज्ञोपवीतिनं ध्यायेत् .. 94 ..
text_mt: One should meditate upon Bhṛṅgarāja as seated upon a red throne, wearing a divine sacred thread.

sanskrit_iast: hotā yasketi mantrasya bhārgava ṛṣirgāyatrīchando yaśo devatā bhṛṃgarājaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 95 ..
meaning: होता यस्केति मन्त्रस्य भार्गव ऋषिर्गायत्रीछन्दो यशो देवता भृंगराजप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 95 ..
text_mt: Of the mantra 'hotā yaska', the seer is Bhārgava, the metre is Gāyatrī, the deity is Yaśas, and the application is for the propitiation of Bhṛṅgarāja.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgaṃ pītaṃ mṛgārūḍhaṃ pītavāsasaṃ dhyātvā ..
kadācaneti mantrasya vāmadevaṛṣirbṛhatī chando vāmadevo devatā mṛgaprītaye viniyogaḥ ..96..
meaning:
मृगं पीतं मृगारूढं पीतवाससं ध्यात्वा ..
कदाचनेति मन्त्रस्य वामदेवऋषिर्बृहती छन्दो वामदेवो देवता मृगप्रीतये विनियोगः ..96..
text_mt: Having meditated upon Mṛga as yellow, mounted upon a deer, clad in yellow garments; / of the mantra 'kadācana', the seer is Vāmadeva, the metre is Bṛhatī, the deity is Vāmadeva, and the application is for the propitiation of Mṛga.

sanskrit_iast:
nairṛtārddhapadeṣu ca ..
nirṛtiṃ pītaṃ śvetaṃ padmāsanasthaṃ dhyātvā ..
kaidācaneti mantrasya paṃktiśchandaḥ savitā devatā nirṛtiprītaye viniyogaḥ ..97..
meaning:
नैरृतार्द्धपदेषु च ..
निरृतिं पीतं श्वेतं पद्मासनस्थं ध्यात्वा ..
कैदाचनेति मन्त्रस्य पंक्तिश्छन्दः सविता देवता निरृतिप्रीतये विनियोगः ..97..
text_mt: And in the half-squares of the southwest: / having meditated upon Nirṛti as yellow-white and seated on a lotus seat; / of the mantra 'kaidācana', the metre is Paṅkti, the deity is Savitṛ, and the application is for the propitiation of Nirṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
nairṛtārddhapadeṣu ca dauvārikaṃ śvetaśarabhārūḍhaṃ trinetraṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaṃ dhyātvā ..
hotasveti mantrasya narasiṃhaṛṣirbṛhatī chando gaṇeśo devatā dauvārikaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 98 ..
meaning:
नैरृतार्द्धपदेषु च दौवारिकं श्वेतशरभारूढं त्रिनेत्रं सर्वाभरणभूषितं ध्यात्वा ..
होतस्वेति मन्त्रस्य नरसिंहऋषिर्बृहती छन्दो गणेशो देवता दौवारिकप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 98 ..
text_mt: And in the half-squares of the southwest, having meditated upon Dauvārika as mounted upon a white śarabha, three-eyed, and adorned with all ornaments; / of the mantra 'hotasva', the seer is Narasiṃha, the metre is Bṛhatī, the deity is Gaṇeśa, and the application is for the propitiation of Dauvārika.

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmaṃ sugrīvaṃ kṛṣṇameṣārūḍhaṃ pītavāsasaṃ dhyātvā ..
svādityeti mantrasya triṣṭupchando vāmano devatā sugrīvaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 99 ..
meaning:
श्यामं सुग्रीवं कृष्णमेषारूढं पीतवाससं ध्यात्वा ..
स्वादित्येति मन्त्रस्य त्रिष्टुप्छन्दो वामनो देवता सुग्रीवप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 99 ..
text_mt: Having meditated upon Sugrīva as dark, mounted upon a black ram, clad in yellow garments; / of the mantra 'svāditya', the metre is Triṣṭubh, the deity is Vāmana, and the application is for the propitiation of Sugrīva.

sanskrit_iast: sumitriyā na iti mantrasya kandarpaṛṣiḥ paṅktiśchandaḥ sūryo devatā varuṇaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 2.2.10.100 ..
meaning: सुमित्रिया न इति मन्त्रस्य कन्दर्पऋषिः पङ्क्तिश्छन्दः सूर्यो देवता वरुणप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 2.2.10.100 ..
text_mt: Of the mantra 'sumitriyā naḥ', the seer is Kandarpa, the metre is Paṅkti, the deity is Sūrya, and the application is for the propitiation of Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpadaṃtaṃ pītaṃ meṣārūḍhaṃ pītavāsasaṃ dhyātvā ..
yā oṣadhīriti mantrasya manmatha ṛṣirjagatī chando vāyurdevatā puṣpadaṃtaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 101 ..
meaning:
पुष्पदंतं पीतं मेषारूढं पीतवाससं ध्यात्वा ..
या ओषधीरिति मन्त्रस्य मन्मथ ऋषिर्जगती छन्दो वायुर्देवता पुष्पदंतप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 101 ..
text_mt: Having meditated upon Puṣpadanta as yellow, mounted upon a ram, clad in yellow garments; / of the mantra 'yā oṣadhīḥ', the seer is Manmatha, the metre is Jagatī, the deity is Vāyu, and the application is for the propitiation of Puṣpadanta.

sanskrit_iast:
asuraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇamālyairalaṃkṛtaṃ kṛtvā ..
ākṛṣṇeti mantrasya hiraṇyavarṇa ṛṣirjagatī chandaḥ savitā devatā asuraprītaye viniyogaḥ .. .. 102 ..
meaning:
असुरं कृष्णं कृष्णमाल्यैरलंकृतं कृत्वा ..
आकृष्णेति मन्त्रस्य हिरण्यवर्ण ऋषिर्जगती छन्दः सविता देवता असुरप्रीतये विनियोगः .. .. 102 ..
text_mt: Having rendered Asura black, adorned with black garlands; / of the mantra 'ākṛṣṇa', the seer is Hiraṇyavarṇa, the metre is Jagatī, the deity is Savitṛ, and the application is for the propitiation of Asura.

sanskrit_iast:
asuraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nāgahārānvitaṃ padmāsanasthaṃ dhyātvā ..
ābrahmanniti maṃtrasya nalina ṛṣistriṣṭupchando bhavānī devatā somaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 103 ..
meaning:
असुरं कृष्णं नागहारान्वितं पद्मासनस्थं ध्यात्वा ..
आब्रह्मन्निति मंत्रस्य नलिन ऋषिस्त्रिष्टुप्छन्दो भवानी देवता सोमप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 103 ..
text_mt: Having meditated upon Asura as black, endowed with a necklace of serpents, seated on a lotus seat; / of the mantra 'ā brahman', the seer is Nalina, the metre is Triṣṭubh, the deity is Bhavānī, and the application is for the propitiation of Soma.

sanskrit_iast:
rogaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nīlendīvaradharaṃ śvetavṛṣabhārūḍhaṃ dhyātvā ..
namaste rudra iti mantrasya nārada ṛṣiḥ paṃktiśchandaḥ śrīrdevatā rogaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 104 ..
meaning:
रोगं कृष्णं नीलेन्दीवरधरं श्वेतवृषभारूढं ध्यात्वा ..
नमस्ते रुद्र इति मन्त्रस्य नारद ऋषिः पंक्तिश्छन्दः श्रीर्देवता रोगप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 104 ..
text_mt: Having meditated upon Roga as dark, holding a blue water-lily, and mounted on a white bull: / Of the mantra 'namas te rudra', the seer is Nārada, the meter is paṅkti, the deity is Śrī, and the ritual application is for the satisfaction of Roga.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyukoṇādārabhya pūjayet ..
vāyuṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ dhvajahastaṃ mṛgārūḍhaṃ dhyātvā ..
devā iti mantrasya bṛhatī chando yamo devatā nāgaprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 105 ..
meaning:
वायुकोणादारभ्य पूजयेत् ..
वायुं धूम्रवर्णं ध्वजहस्तं मृगारूढं ध्यात्वा ..
देवा इति मन्त्रस्य बृहती छन्दो यमो देवता नागप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 105 ..
text_mt: One should worship beginning from the northwest corner. / Having meditated upon Vāyu as smoke-coloured, holding a banner in his hand, and mounted on a deer: / Of the mantra 'devāḥ', the meter is bṛhatī, the deity is Yama, and the ritual application is for the satisfaction of the Nāga.

sanskrit_iast: śvetaṃ somaṃ śvetavarṇāsanasthaṃ dhyātvā bhadrabījena pūjayet .. .. 106 ..
meaning: श्वेतं सोमं श्वेतवर्णासनस्थं ध्यात्वा भद्रबीजेन पूजयेत् .. .. 106 ..
text_mt: Having meditated upon white Soma seated on a white seat, one should worship him with the seed-syllable of Bhadra.

sanskrit_iast:
raktaṃ bhallāṭaṃ pītavāsasaṃ dhyātvā vahnibījena pūjayet ..
pītavāsasamajavāhanaṃ hārakeyūrānvitaṃ vāyubījena maṃdarādyaiḥ pūjayet .. .. 107 ..
meaning:
रक्तं भल्लाटं पीतवाससं ध्यात्वा वह्निबीजेन पूजयेत् ..
पीतवाससमजवाहनं हारकेयूरान्वितं वायुबीजेन मंदराद्यैः पूजयेत् .. .. 107 ..
text_mt: Having meditated upon red Bhallāṭa dressed in yellow garments, one should worship him with the seed-syllable of fire. / Dressed in yellow garments, riding a goat, endowed with necklaces and armlets, one should worship him with the seed-syllable of wind using mandāra and other [flowers].

sanskrit_iast:
raktāṃ ditiṃ nāgahārānvitāṃ raktapadmāsanasthāṃ dhyātvā ..
mānārthaṃ iti mantrasyeti pūjayet .. 108 ..
meaning:
रक्तां दितिं नागहारान्वितां रक्तपद्मासनस्थां ध्यात्वा ..
मानार्थं इति मन्त्रस्येति पूजयेत् .. 108 ..
text_mt: Having meditated upon red Diti endowed with a serpent-necklace and seated on a red lotus seat: / One should worship with the mantra 'mānārtham'.

sanskrit_iast: māno tvā iti maṃtrasya bhārgava ṛṣiḥ paṃktiśchandaḥ pṛthivī devatā ditiprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 109 ..
meaning: मानो त्वा इति मंत्रस्य भार्गव ऋषिः पंक्तिश्छन्दः पृथिवी देवता दितिप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 109 ..
text_mt: Of the mantra 'mā no tvā', the seer is Bhārgava, the meter is paṅkti, the deity is Pṛthivī, and the ritual application is for the satisfaction of Diti.

sanskrit_iast:
aditiṃ pītavarṇāṃ siṃhārūḍhāṃ pītāṃbaradharāṃ dhyātvā ..
hiraṇyavarṇa iti maṃtrasya janārdana ṛṣirbṛhatī chandaḥ somo devatā aditiprītaye viniyogaḥ .. 2.2.10.110 ..
meaning:
अदितिं पीतवर्णां सिंहारूढां पीतांबरधरां ध्यात्वा ..
हिरण्यवर्ण इति मंत्रस्य जनार्दन ऋषिर्बृहती छन्दः सोमो देवता अदितिप्रीतये विनियोगः .. 2.2.10.110 ..
text_mt: Having meditated upon Aditi as yellow-coloured, mounted on a lion, and wearing yellow garments: / Of the mantra 'hiraṇyavarṇa', the seer is Janārdana, the meter is bṛhatī, the deity is Soma, and the ritual application is for the satisfaction of Aditi.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yathā vidhāyātha homaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi ..
homāṃte dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātkāñcanaṃ hemasaṃyutam .. 111 ..
meaning:
एवं यथा विधायाथ होमं कुर्याद्यथाविधि ..
होमांते दक्षिणां दद्यात्काञ्चनं हेमसंयुतम् .. 111 ..
text_mt: Having thus performed [the rites] according to rule, one should then perform the fire-sacrifice according to rule. / At the conclusion of the fire-sacrifice, one should give a sacrificial fee of gold combined with gold.

sanskrit_iast:
taḍāgayāgapakṣe tu suvarṇaṃ cārdhameva vā .. 112 .. ..
pūjākramavarṇanam
meaning:
तडागयागपक्षे तु सुवर्णं चार्धमेव वा .. 112 .. ..
पूजाक्रमवर्णनम्
text_mt:
In the case of a sacrifice for a reservoir, however, [one should give] a gold coin or even half of it.
Description of the Order of Worship

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
atha pūjākramaṃ vakṣye purāṇasmṛticoditam ..
uttare paścime vātha pūrve cāpi samācaret .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अथ पूजाक्रमं वक्ष्ये पुराणस्मृतिचोदितम् ..
उत्तरे पश्चिमे वाथ पूर्वे चापि समाचरेत् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Now I shall declare the order of worship prescribed by Purāṇas and Smṛtis. / One should perform it in the north, or in the west, or also in the east.
title: adhyāyaḥ 11

sanskrit_iast:
nadītīre nemiprāṃte daśadvādaśasaṃkhyayā ..
maṃḍalaṃ racayedviprāścarukadvayasaṃyutam .. 2 ..
meaning:
नदीतीरे नेमिप्रांते दशद्वादशसंख्यया ..
मंडलं रचयेद्विप्राश्चरुकद्वयसंयुतम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: On a riverbank or at the edge of an enclosure, O brahmins, / one should construct a mandala of ten or twelve [cubits] in measure, accompanied by two offering-vessels.

sanskrit_iast:
tribhāgaṃ vibhajetkṣetraṃ madhyabhāgadvayena tu ..
trihastavedikāṃ kuryāttālotsedhāmudakplavām .. 3 ..
meaning:
त्रिभागं विभजेत्क्षेत्रं मध्यभागद्वयेन तु ..
त्रिहस्तवेदिकां कुर्यात्तालोत्सेधामुदक्प्लवाम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: One should divide the ground into three parts; with the two central parts / one should make an altar of three cubits, one span in height and sloping to the north.

sanskrit_iast:
uttarāśe dakṣiṇe cāratnihastāṃtare'pi ca ..
trimekhalāṃ hastamātrāṃ guṇavedīsamanvitām.. 4 ..
meaning:
उत्तराशे दक्षिणे चारत्निहस्तांतरेऽपि च ..
त्रिमेखलां हस्तमात्रां गुणवेदीसमन्विताम्.. 4 ..
text_mt: In the northern part and in the south, at an interval of a cubit or a cubit from the elbow, / with three tiers, measuring one cubit, furnished with three altars,

sanskrit_iast:
mūle sārdhaṃ ca śuklāṃ ca mekhalāṃ tu tathaiva ca ..
caturaṃgulikāṃ vediṃ madhyonnatāṃ prakalpayet .. 5 ..
meaning:
मूले सार्धं च शुक्लां च मेखलां तु तथैव च ..
चतुरंगुलिकां वेदिं मध्योन्नतां प्रकल्पयेत् .. 5 ..
text_mt: and with one and a half [cubits] at the base, white, and with a tier likewise; / one should fashion an altar of four fingers, raised in the middle.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭsaptāṃgulikāṃ yoniṃ paścime mekhalopari ..
vinyasennābhisaṃyuktamevaṃ kuṇḍaṃ prakalpayet .. 6 ..
meaning:
षट्सप्तांगुलिकां योनिं पश्चिमे मेखलोपरि ..
विन्यसेन्नाभिसंयुक्तमेवं कुण्डं प्रकल्पयेत् .. 6 ..
text_mt: On the west, upon the tier, one should place a vulva-shaped lip / of six or seven fingers, furnished with a navel; thus one should fashion the sacrificial pit.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhaṃ vṛddhyātmakaṃ kuryātsaṃkalpaṃ mānasaṃ caret ..
śrāddhārthaṃ naiva saṃkalpettathā vai devadarśane .. 7 ..
meaning:
श्राद्धं वृद्ध्यात्मकं कुर्यात्संकल्पं मानसं चरेत् ..
श्राद्धार्थं नैव संकल्पेत्तथा वै देवदर्शने .. 7 ..
text_mt: One should perform a prosperity-śrāddha and make a mental resolve. / One must not make a resolve for the sake of an [ordinary] śrāddha, nor likewise when beholding a deity,

sanskrit_iast:
gayāśrāddhārthakaṃ cāṣṭatīrthaśrāddhārthameva ca ..
aiśānyāṃ kalaśe devaṃ pūjayedgaṇanāyakam .. 8 ..
meaning:
गयाश्राद्धार्थकं चाष्टतीर्थश्राद्धार्थमेव च ..
ऐशान्यां कलशे देवं पूजयेद्गणनायकम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: nor for a Gayā-śrāddha or for a śrāddha at the eight sacred places. / In the northeast, one should worship the divine Gaṇanāyaka in a water-pot.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye kuṇḍe mahāṃścaiva viṣṇudevaṃ digīśvarān..
brahmāṇaṃ cāgnikuṇḍe tu svaiḥ svairmantraiḥ prapūjayet .. 9 ..
meaning:
मध्ये कुण्डे महांश्चैव विष्णुदेवं दिगीश्वरान्..
ब्रह्माणं चाग्निकुण्डे तु स्वैः स्वैर्मन्त्रैः प्रपूजयेत् .. 9 ..
text_mt: In the central pit, [one should worship] the Great [Lord], Lord Viṣṇu, and the guardians of the directions; / and in the fire-pit, one should worship Brahmā with their respective mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāyāmaṃ vidhāyātha bhūtaśuddhiṃ samācaret ..
dhyāyedvāṭavīśapuruṣaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam .. 2.2.11.10 ..
meaning:
प्राणायामं विधायाथ भूतशुद्धिं समाचरेत् ..
ध्यायेद्वाटवीशपुरुषं सर्वलक्षणसंयुतम् .. 2.2.11.10 ..
text_mt: Then, having performed breath-control, one should execute the purification of the elements. / One should meditate on the Lord Person of the Site, endowed with all auspicious marks,

sanskrit_iast:
śvetaṃ caturbhujaṃ śāṃtaṃ kuṇḍalādyairalaṃkṛtam ..
pustakaṃ cākṣamālāṃ ca varābhayakaraṃ param .. 11 ..
meaning:
श्वेतं चतुर्भुजं शांतं कुण्डलाद्यैरलंकृतम् ..
पुस्तकं चाक्षमालां च वराभयकरं परम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: white, four-armed, tranquil, adorned with earrings and other ornaments, / [holding] a book and a rosary, supreme, granting boons and protection with his hands,

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛvaiśvānaropetaṃ kuṭilabhrūpaśobhitam ..
karālavadanaṃ caiva ājānukaralaṃbitam .. 12 ..
meaning:
पितृवैश्वानरोपेतं कुटिलभ्रूपशोभितम् ..
करालवदनं चैव आजानुकरलंबितम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: accompanied by the Ancestors and Vaiśvānara, graced with curved eyebrows, / with a dreadful visage, and his hands hanging down to his knees.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrdhanyagniṃ samāviśya mukhe vāyuḥ samāhitaḥ ..
pṛthvīdharoryamā caiva tathāṣṭavaneṣṭitau .. 13 ..
meaning:
मूर्धन्यग्निं समाविश्य मुखे वायुः समाहितः ..
पृथ्वीधरोर्यमा चैव तथाष्टवनेष्टितौ .. 13 ..
text_mt: Having entered with Fire in the head, Wind is concentrated in the mouth; / Pṛthvīdhara and Aryaman are both established in the eight woods.

sanskrit_iast:
vakṣasthale 'parāṃ saṃdhyāṃ yajeccaiva yathāvidhi ..
netrayorditiparjanyau śrotre ditījyaputrakau .. 14 ..
meaning:
वक्षस्थले ऽपरां संध्यां यजेच्चैव यथाविधि ..
नेत्रयोर्दितिपर्जन्यौ श्रोत्रे दितीज्यपुत्रकौ .. 14 ..
text_mt: Upon the chest one should worship the evening twilight according to rule; / in the eyes are Diti and Parjanya, and in the ears are Diti and the son of Ījya.

sanskrit_iast:
sarpendrāvāsanasthau ca vāme dakṣaṃ vibhāvayet ..
satyasomāgnayastatra rāhoḥ paṃca ca paṃca ca .. 15 ..
meaning:
सर्पेन्द्रावासनस्थौ च वामे दक्षं विभावयेत् ..
सत्यसोमाग्नयस्तत्र राहोः पंच च पंच च .. 15 ..
text_mt: The two serpent-kings are on his seat, and one should contemplate Dakṣa on the left; / Satya, Soma, and the fires are there, and five and five of Rāhu.

sanskrit_iast:
rudraśca rājayakṣmā ca vāmahaste vyavasthitau ..
pārśve tu dakṣiṇe tadvadvirathaśca maharkṣakaḥ.. 16 ..
meaning:
रुद्रश्च राजयक्ष्मा च वामहस्ते व्यवस्थितौ ..
पार्श्वे तु दक्षिणे तद्वद्विरथश्च महर्क्षकः.. 16 ..
text_mt: Rudra and Rājayakṣman are situated in the left hand; / on the right side likewise are Viratha and Maharkṣaka.

sanskrit_iast:
ubhau jñeyau tathā jānvorubhau gandharvapuṣpakau ..
jaṃghayorbhṛṃgasugrīvau sphicordauvāriko gaṇaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
उभौ ज्ञेयौ तथा जान्वोरुभौ गन्धर्वपुष्पकौ ..
जंघयोर्भृंगसुग्रीवौ स्फिचोर्दौवारिको गणः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Both Gandharva and Puṣpaka are to be known on both knees; / Bhṛṅga and Sugrīva are on the shanks, and the Dauvārika troop is on the buttocks.

sanskrit_iast:
jayaśakrau tathā meḍhre padayoḥ pitarastathā ..
evaṃ dhyātvā nyasetpuṣpaṃ some naivaṃ viciṃtayet .. 18 ..
meaning:
जयशक्रौ तथा मेढ्रे पदयोः पितरस्तथा ..
एवं ध्यात्वा न्यसेत्पुष्पं सोमे नैवं विचिंतयेत् .. 18 ..
text_mt: Jaya and Śakra are on the penis, and the Ancestors are on the feet. / Having meditated thus, one should deposit a flower; on Soma one should not contemplate thus.

sanskrit_iast:
mandaraṃ dīrghayuktena ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret..
tāvadvīryaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā praṇavaṃ brahmaṇeti ca .. 19 ..
meaning:
मन्दरं दीर्घयुक्तेन षडङ्गानि समाचरेत्..
तावद्वीर्यं ततः कृत्वा प्रणवं ब्रह्मणेति च .. 19 ..
text_mt: One should perform the six bodily limbs using Mandara with a long [vowel]. / Then, having generated that power, with the praṇava and 'brahmaṇe',

sanskrit_iast:
vāstvīśāya vidmaheti tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayāt ..
anena snapanaṃ kuryātpūjādravyāṇi prokṣayet .. 2.2.11.20 ..
meaning:
वास्त्वीशाय विद्महेति तन्नो विष्णुः प्रचोदयात् ..
अनेन स्नपनं कुर्यात्पूजाद्रव्याणि प्रोक्षयेत् .. 2.2.11.20 ..
text_mt: [saying:] 'We contemplate the Lord of the Site; may that Viṣṇu inspire us'— / with this one should perform the bathing and sprinkle the articles of worship.

sanskrit_iast:
āsanaṃ pūjayetpūrvaṃ dharmeṇāpi svaśaktitaḥ ..
ādau tu bhāskaraṃ sūryaṃ śacīnāthaṃ gaṇādhipam .. 21 ..
meaning:
आसनं पूजयेत्पूर्वं धर्मेणापि स्वशक्तितः ..
आदौ तु भास्करं सूर्यं शचीनाथं गणाधिपम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: First one should worship the seat with righteousness according to one's ability: / at first, Bhāskara, Sūrya, the lord of Śacī, and the lord of the Gaṇas;

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāraśaktiṃ pṛthivīṃ pūjayettatra paṅkajam ..
baṃdīśāsanamityuktaṃ pūjayedāsanaṃ tataḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
आधारशक्तिं पृथिवीं पूजयेत्तत्र पङ्कजम् ..
बंदीशासनमित्युक्तं पूजयेदासनं ततः .. 22 ..
text_mt: one should worship the support-power, the Earth, and the lotus there. / This is declared as the seat of Bandīśa; then one should worship the seat.

sanskrit_iast:
sitacandanayuktena śvetapuṣpaṃ pragṛhya ca ..
harerdhyānaṃ tataḥ kuryātsthāpayenmadhyamaṇḍale ..23..
meaning:
सितचन्दनयुक्तेन श्वेतपुष्पं प्रगृह्य च ..
हरेर्ध्यानं ततः कुर्यात्स्थापयेन्मध्यमण्डले ..23..
text_mt: Taking a white flower anointed with white sandalwood, / one should then perform meditation on Hari and establish him in the central mandala.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhya cāsanaṃ dadyāttataḥ pādyādikatrayam ..
madhuparkaṃ tato dadyādvāstoṣpatimatheśvaram .. 24 ..
meaning:
आवाह्य चासनं दद्यात्ततः पाद्यादिकत्रयम् ..
मधुपर्कं ततो दद्याद्वास्तोष्पतिमथेश्वरम् .. 24 ..
text_mt: Having invoked him, one should offer the seat, and then the triad beginning with water for the feet; / then one should offer the honey-mixture, and then to Vāstoṣpati, the sovereign Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
asya mantrasya ca ṛṣiśchando gāyatramīritam ..
devatā ca bhavedbrahmā yojayedaśvamedhakam .. 25 ..
meaning:
अस्य मन्त्रस्य च ऋषिश्छन्दो गायत्रमीरितम् ..
देवता च भवेद्ब्रह्मा योजयेदश्वमेधकम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Of this mantra, the seer and meter are declared to be Gāyatra; / and the deity is Brahmā; one should employ it in the horse-sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
maṃdaraṃ vijayaṃ somaṃ mahādevaṃ ca mādhavam ..
rudraṃ haraṃ jayaṃ bhaṃ ca pūrvādidalamūlake .. 26 ..
meaning:
मंदरं विजयं सोमं महादेवं च माधवम् ..
रुद्रं हरं जयं भं च पूर्वादिदलमूलके .. 26 ..
text_mt: Mandara, Vijaya, Soma, Mahādeva, and Mādhava, / Rudra, Hara, Jaya, and Bha, at the base of the petals beginning with the east;

sanskrit_iast:
jayā ca vijayā caiva satyā māyā śivāṃbikā ..
hāsinī kāminī caitā dalamūleṣu bhāvayet .. 27 .
meaning:
जया च विजया चैव सत्या माया शिवांबिका ..
हासिनी कामिनी चैता दलमूलेषु भावयेत् .. 27 .
text_mt: and Jayā, Vijayā, Satyā, Māyā, Śivā, Ambikā, / Hāsinī, and Kāminī—one should contemplate these at the bases of the petals.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpāñjalitrayaṃ dadyādvāstoṣpataya ityapi ..
arghyamaṃtreṇa gaṃdhādyaiḥ pūjayedbhūtimicchatā ..28..
meaning:
पुष्पाञ्जलित्रयं दद्याद्वास्तोष्पतय इत्यपि ..
अर्घ्यमंत्रेण गंधाद्यैः पूजयेद्भूतिमिच्छता ..28..
text_mt: One who desires prosperity should offer three double handfuls of flowers [with the mantra] 'to Vāstoṣpati', / and worship with perfumes and the like using the guest-offering mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
vāstoṣpate bhava mate iti dhyātvā ṛtaṃ ceti maṃtreṇa pūjayet ..
ṛṣirnārāyaṇaśchando gāyatrī parikīrtitam .. 29 ..
meaning:
वास्तोष्पते भव मते इति ध्यात्वा ऋतं चेति मंत्रेण पूजयेत् ..
ऋषिर्नारायणश्छन्दो गायत्री परिकीर्तितम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: Having meditated with 'vāstoṣpate bhava mate', one should worship with the mantra 'ṛtaṃ ca'. / The seer is Nārāyaṇa, and the meter is proclaimed as gāyatrī.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryaśca devatā khyātaḥ prīṇitaḥ kuliśāyudhaḥ ..
sūryaṃ raktāsanārūḍhaṃ dvibhujaṃ raktavāsasam .. 2.2.11.30 ..
meaning:
सूर्यश्च देवता ख्यातः प्रीणितः कुलिशायुधः ..
सूर्यं रक्तासनारूढं द्विभुजं रक्तवाससम् .. 2.2.11.30 ..
text_mt: And Sūrya is renowned as the deity, gratified, holding the thunderbolt-weapon. / [Meditating on] Sūrya mounted on a red seat, two-armed, dressed in red garments,

sanskrit_iast:
raktapadmadvayadharaṃ kuṃḍalādyaiḥ suśobhitam..
evaṃ dhyātvā tu matimānhaṃsaṃ samaṃtramīśvaram..31..
meaning:
रक्तपद्मद्वयधरं कुंडलाद्यैः सुशोभितम्..
एवं ध्यात्वा तु मतिमान्हंसं समंत्रमीश्वरम्..31..
text_mt: holding two red lotuses, beautifully adorned with earrings and other ornaments: / having meditated thus, the wise person [worships] the Lord Haṃsa with mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsasya iti maṃtrasya ṛṣirautathya īritaḥ ..
paṃktiśchandaḥ svayaṃ devo viniyogastu prītaye ..32..
meaning:
हंसस्य इति मंत्रस्य ऋषिरौतथ्य ईरितः ..
पंक्तिश्छन्दः स्वयं देवो विनियोगस्तु प्रीतये ..32..
text_mt: Of the mantra 'haṃsasya', the seer is declared to be Autathya; / the meter is paṅkti, the god is himself [the deity], and the application is for [his] satisfaction.

sanskrit_iast:
nīlotpaladvayadharaṃ satyaṃ mṛtyūparisthitam..
svacchaśvetāṃbaradharaṃ varadaṃ bhaktavatsalam ..33..
meaning:
नीलोत्पलद्वयधरं सत्यं मृत्यूपरिस्थितम्..
स्वच्छश्वेतांबरधरं वरदं भक्तवत्सलम् ..33..
text_mt: Holding two blue lotuses, truth-natured, standing upon Death, / wearing spotless white garments, granting boons, affectionate to his devotees,

sanskrit_iast:
svaṃ madātvamiti mantreṇa śvetacandanapuṣpakaiḥ ..
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ ..34..
meaning:
स्वं मदात्वमिति मन्त्रेण श्वेतचन्दनपुष्पकैः ..
पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या वस्त्रालंकारभूषणैः ..34..
text_mt: with the mantra beginning *svaṃ madātvaṃ*, with white sandalwood and flowers, / one should worship [him] with supreme devotion, with garments, ornaments, and decorations.

sanskrit_iast:
uddharṣaṇa iti maṃtreṇa kṛṣṇapuṣpairathārcayet ..
satyavrata ṛṣiścāsya triṣṭupchando'sya devatā ..
savitā caiva vijñeyaḥ prītaye ca vṛṣasya ca ..35..
meaning:
उद्धर्षण इति मंत्रेण कृष्णपुष्पैरथार्चयेत् ..
सत्यव्रत ऋषिश्चास्य त्रिष्टुप्छन्दोऽस्य देवता ..
सविता चैव विज्ञेयः प्रीतये च वृषस्य च ..35..
text_mt: Then, with the mantra beginning *uddharṣaṇaḥ*, one should worship with black flowers; / its seer is Satyavrata, its metre is triṣṭubh, and its deity / is known as Savitṛ, for the pleasure of Vṛṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
śulkavarṇaṃ tathākāśamṛṣṭisaṃghaiśca saṃstutam ..
ghaṭasthaṃ dvibhujaṃ dhyāyedgadāpadmavidhāriṇam ..36..
meaning:
शुल्कवर्णं तथाकाशमृष्टिसंघैश्च संस्तुतम् ..
घटस्थं द्विभुजं ध्यायेद्गदापद्मविधारिणम् ..36..
text_mt: White in colour, [namely] Ākāśa, praised by hosts of sages, / seated on a pot, two-armed, holding a mace and a lotus, one should meditate on him.

sanskrit_iast:
śanno devīti paṭhanādgandhapuṣpādibhiryajet ..
ṛṣiḥ syātkardamo viprāśchando jāgatikā tathā ..
devatā ca bhaveccāgnirākāśaprītaye nyaset ..37..
meaning:
शन्नो देवीति पठनाद्गन्धपुष्पादिभिर्यजेत् ..
ऋषिः स्यात्कर्दमो विप्राश्छन्दो जागतिका तथा ..
देवता च भवेच्चाग्निराकाशप्रीतये न्यसेत् ..37..
text_mt: By reciting *śan no devī*, one should worship [him] with fragrant perfumes, flowers, and the like; / the seer is Kardama, O brāhmaṇas, the metre is jagatī, / and the deity is Agni; one should assign it for the pleasure of Ākāśa.

sanskrit_iast:
dhvajahastamahābāhuṃ marudbhiścopasevitam..
dvibhujaṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ ca vāyuṃ dhyātvā prapūjayet..38..
meaning:
ध्वजहस्तमहाबाहुं मरुद्भिश्चोपसेवितम्..
द्विभुजं धूम्रवर्णं च वायुं ध्यात्वा प्रपूजयेत्..38..
text_mt: Holding a banner in hand, mighty-armed, attended by the Maruts, / two-armed and smoke-coloured: having thus meditated on Vāyu, one should worship [him].

sanskrit_iast:
rājāna iti mantreṇa pūjayetsitataṃḍulaiḥ..
ṛṣirnārāyaṇacchando gāyatrī devatā dvijāḥ..39..
meaning:
राजान इति मन्त्रेण पूजयेत्सिततंडुलैः..
ऋषिर्नारायणच्छन्दो गायत्री देवता द्विजाः..39..
text_mt: One should worship [him] with white unbroken rice grains using the mantra beginning *rājānaḥ*; / the seer is Nārāyaṇa, the metre is gāyatrī, [and] the deity, O twice-born ones,

sanskrit_iast:
devatā ca bhavedvāyuḥ prītaye tasya yojayet ..
pūṣāraktaśca dvibhujo raktapadmāsanasthitaḥ ..2.2.11.40..
meaning:
देवता च भवेद्वायुः प्रीतये तस्य योजयेत् ..
पूषारक्तश्च द्विभुजो रक्तपद्मासनस्थितः ..2.2.11.40..
text_mt: is Vāyu; one should employ it for his pleasure. / And Pūṣan is red, two-armed, seated on a red lotus throne.

sanskrit_iast:
rājāna iti ca ṛcā pūjayedgandhacandanaiḥ..
gobhilosya ṛṣiḥ paṅktiśchando'tha jagatī smṛtam ..
devatā ca bhavedvāyuḥ prītaye viniyojayet ..41..
meaning:
राजान इति च ऋचा पूजयेद्गन्धचन्दनैः..
गोभिलोस्य ऋषिः पङ्क्तिश्छन्दोऽथ जगती स्मृतम् ..
देवता च भवेद्वायुः प्रीतये विनियोजयेत् ..41..
text_mt: And with the verse beginning *rājānaḥ*, one should worship [him] with perfumes and sandalwood; / its seer is Gobhila, the metre is recorded as paṅkti and jagatī, / and the deity is Vāyu; one should employ it for [his] pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
vitathaṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ ca caturbhirbāhubhirvṛtam..
mṛgākṣapāśakhaṭvāṅga śūlaṃ ca dadhataṃ karaiḥ ..
meṣārūḍhaṃ viśālākṣaṃ rājāno mahyamīrayan .. 42 ..
meaning:
वितथं श्यामवर्णं च चतुर्भिर्बाहुभिर्वृतम्..
मृगाक्षपाशखट्वाङ्ग शूलं च दधतं करैः ..
मेषारूढं विशालाक्षं राजानो मह्यमीरयन् .. 42 ..
text_mt: Vitatha, dark-coloured, endowed with four arms, / holding a deer's eye, a noose, a khaṭvāṅga, and a trident in his hands, / mounted on a ram, large-eyed: they recite *rājāno mahyam* [for him].

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhakṣataṃ tathā śuklaṃ caturbhirgardabhairvṛtam ..
śūlaṃ daṃḍaṃ ca khaḍvāṃgaṃ dadhataṃ vṛṣavāhanam .. 43 ..
meaning:
गृहक्षतं तथा शुक्लं चतुर्भिर्गर्दभैर्वृतम् ..
शूलं दंडं च खड्वांगं दधतं वृषवाहनम् .. 43 ..
text_mt: Likewise Gṛhakṣata, white, surrounded by four donkeys, / holding a trident, a staff, and a khaṭvāṅga, having a bull as his vehicle,

sanskrit_iast:
pītavastradharaṃ devaṃ jaṭāmukuṭasaṃyutam ..
āśuḥ śiśāna iti mantreṇa pūjayedgandhacandanaiḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
पीतवस्त्रधरं देवं जटामुकुटसंयुतम् ..
आशुः शिशान इति मन्त्रेण पूजयेद्गन्धचन्दनैः .. 44 ..
text_mt: the god wearing yellow garments, adorned with a crown of matted hair, / one should worship with perfumes and sandalwood using the mantra beginning *āśuḥ śiśānaḥ*.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpadaṃta ṛṣistriṣṭupchandaśca parikīrtitam ..
īśvarasya devatāyā prītaye viniyojayet .. 45 ..
meaning:
पुष्पदंत ऋषिस्त्रिष्टुप्छन्दश्च परिकीर्तितम् ..
ईश्वरस्य देवताया प्रीतये विनियोजयेत् .. 45 ..
text_mt: Puṣpadanta is the seer, and the metre is proclaimed as triṣṭubh; / one should employ it for the pleasure of the deity Īśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
yamaṃ dhyāyetkṛṣṇavarṇaṃ mahiṣasthaṃ dvibāhukam ..
daṇḍapāśadharaṃ caiva keyūrādyairvibhūṣitam.. 46 ..
meaning:
यमं ध्यायेत्कृष्णवर्णं महिषस्थं द्विबाहुकम् ..
दण्डपाशधरं चैव केयूराद्यैर्विभूषितम्.. 46 ..
text_mt: One should meditate on Yama, dark-coloured, seated on a buffalo, two-armed, / holding a staff and a noose, and adorned with armlets and other ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
īśāneti ca mantreṇa pūjayetkusumādinā ..
vāmadeva ṛṣiḥ paṃktiśchandaḥ kālosya devatā .. 47 ..
meaning:
ईशानेति च मन्त्रेण पूजयेत्कुसुमादिना ..
वामदेव ऋषिः पंक्तिश्छन्दः कालोस्य देवता .. 47 ..
text_mt: And with the mantra beginning *īśāna*, one should worship [him] with flowers and other offerings; / Vāmadeva is the seer, the metre is paṅkti, and Kāla is his deity.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍānanaṃ ca gandharvaṃ pītaṃ dhyāyeccaturbhujam ..
pītāṃbaradharaṃ caiva nānābharaṇabhūṣitam .. 48 ..
meaning:
षडाननं च गन्धर्वं पीतं ध्यायेच्चतुर्भुजम् ..
पीतांबरधरं चैव नानाभरणभूषितम् .. 48 ..
text_mt: And one should meditate on Gandharva as six-faced, yellow, four-armed, / wearing yellow garments, and adorned with various ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
yaddeva iti mantreṇa pūjayetkusumādinā ..
hārītosya ṛṣiḥ prokto jagatīchanda īritam ..
hiraṇyagarbho devatāsya prītaye viniyojayet .. 49 ..
meaning:
यद्देव इति मन्त्रेण पूजयेत्कुसुमादिना ..
हारीतोस्य ऋषिः प्रोक्तो जगतीछन्द ईरितम् ..
हिरण्यगर्भो देवतास्य प्रीतये विनियोजयेत् .. 49 ..
text_mt: One should worship [him] with flowers and the like using the mantra beginning *yad deva*; / Hārīta is declared to be his seer, the metre is proclaimed as jagatī, / and Hiraṇyagarbha is his deity; one should employ it for his pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛṅgarājaṃ jaṭārūḍhaṃ svacchaṃ pītāṃbaraṃ śubham ..
cakṣuḥ pīteti mantreṇa pūjayedgandhacaṃdanaiḥ .. 2.2.11.50 ..
meaning:
भृङ्गराजं जटारूढं स्वच्छं पीतांबरं शुभम् ..
चक्षुः पीतेति मन्त्रेण पूजयेद्गन्धचंदनैः .. 2.2.11.50 ..
text_mt: Bhṛṅgarāja, wearing matted hair, pure, dressed in auspicious yellow garments, / one should worship with perfumes and sandalwood using the mantra beginning *cakṣuḥ pītā*.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiścāgastirākhyātastriṣṭupchandaḥ prakīrtitam ..
viśvedevā devatā ca bhṛṅgarājasya prītaye .. 51 ..
meaning:
ऋषिश्चागस्तिराख्यातस्त्रिष्टुप्छन्दः प्रकीर्तितम् ..
विश्वेदेवा देवता च भृङ्गराजस्य प्रीतये .. 51 ..
text_mt: Agasti is proclaimed as the seer, the metre is stated as triṣṭubh, / and the Viśvedevas are the deity, for the pleasure of Bhṛṅgarāja.

sanskrit_iast:
pītaṃ mṛgaṃ mṛgārūḍhaṃ jaṭāmukuṭamaṃḍitam ..
paro devā iti maṃtreṇa pūjayedbalipāyasaiḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
पीतं मृगं मृगारूढं जटामुकुटमंडितम् ..
परो देवा इति मंत्रेण पूजयेद्बलिपायसैः .. 52 ..
text_mt: Mṛga is yellow, mounted on a deer, adorned with a crown of matted hair; / one should worship [him] with offerings and milk-rice using the mantra beginning *paro devāḥ*.

sanskrit_iast:
kapilaśca ṛṣiḥ prokto gāyatrī chanda īritam ..
varuṇo devatā cāsya prītaye viniyojayet .. 53 ..
meaning:
कपिलश्च ऋषिः प्रोक्तो गायत्री छन्द ईरितम् ..
वरुणो देवता चास्य प्रीतये विनियोजयेत् .. 53 ..
text_mt: And Kapila is declared to be the seer, the metre is proclaimed as gāyatrī, / and Varuṇa is his deity; one should employ it for his pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyetpitṛgaṇaṃ śukraṃ caturbhirbāhubhirvṛtam ..
pitṛbhya iti mantreṇa pūjayetkusumādinā .. 54 ..
meaning:
ध्यायेत्पितृगणं शुक्रं चतुर्भिर्बाहुभिर्वृतम् ..
पितृभ्य इति मन्त्रेण पूजयेत्कुसुमादिना .. 54 ..
text_mt: One should meditate on the host of ancestors as bright, endowed with four arms; / one should worship [them] with flowers and the like using the mantra beginning *pitṛbhyaḥ*.

sanskrit_iast:
śunaḥśepa ṛṣiścāsya triṣṭupchandaśca devatā ..
viśvedevāḥ samākhyātāḥ pitṛmedhena pūjayet .. 55 ..
meaning:
शुनःशेप ऋषिश्चास्य त्रिष्टुप्छन्दश्च देवता ..
विश्वेदेवाः समाख्याताः पितृमेधेन पूजयेत् .. 55 ..
text_mt: Śunaḥśepa is its seer, the metre is triṣṭubh, and the deity / is declared to be the Viśvedevas; one should worship [them] with an ancestral offering.

sanskrit_iast:
dauvārikaṃ cāṣṭabhujaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ vicintayet ..
raktavastrapiṃgalākṣaṃ kṛṣṇavyāghropari sthitam .. 56 ..
meaning:
दौवारिकं चाष्टभुजं कृष्णवर्णं विचिन्तयेत् ..
रक्तवस्त्रपिंगलाक्षं कृष्णव्याघ्रोपरि स्थितम् .. 56 ..
text_mt: And one should contemplate Dauvārika as eight-armed, dark-coloured, / wearing red garments, with reddish-brown eyes, standing upon a black tiger.

sanskrit_iast: yo naḥ piteti mantreṇa pūjayedbhaktitatparaḥ .. 57 ..
meaning: यो नः पितेति मन्त्रेण पूजयेद्भक्तितत्परः .. 57 ..
text_mt: Intent on devotion, one should worship [him] with the mantra beginning *yo naḥ pitā*.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśvānara ṛṣiścāsya gāyatrī chanda īritam ..
devatā ca bhavecchaktirviniyogaśca pūjane .. 58 ..
meaning:
वैश्वानर ऋषिश्चास्य गायत्री छन्द ईरितम् ..
देवता च भवेच्छक्तिर्विनियोगश्च पूजने .. 58 ..
text_mt: And Vaiśvānara is its seer, the metre is proclaimed as gāyatrī, / the deity is Śakti, and the ritual application is in worship.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkhābhaṃ caiva sugrīvaṃ dvibhujaṃ cakradhāriṇam ..
haṃsārūḍhaṃ mahākāyaṃ balivijñānakāraṇam .. 59 ..
meaning:
शंखाभं चैव सुग्रीवं द्विभुजं चक्रधारिणम् ..
हंसारूढं महाकायं बलिविज्ञानकारणम् .. 59 ..
text_mt: And Sugrīva is radiant like a conch, two-armed, holding a discus, / mounted on a swan, large-bodied, the cause of knowing the offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkhapadmadharaṃ caiva mahiṣasthaṃ vicintayet..
sa iṣu hasteti maṃtreṇa pūjayedraktabhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 2.2.11.60 ..
meaning:
शंखपद्मधरं चैव महिषस्थं विचिन्तयेत्..
स इषु हस्तेति मंत्रेण पूजयेद्रक्तभूषणैः .. 2.2.11.60 ..
text_mt: Holding a conch and a lotus, one should contemplate [him] seated on a buffalo; / one should worship [him] with red ornaments using the mantra beginning *sa iṣuhastaḥ*.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiḥ śaṃkhastathācchandaḥ paṅktiḥ somo'tha devatā ..
śvetaṃ jalādhipaṃ dhyāyedgandharvādyaiśca veṣṭitam .. 61 ..
meaning:
ऋषिः शंखस्तथाच्छन्दः पङ्क्तिः सोमोऽथ देवता ..
श्वेतं जलाधिपं ध्यायेद्गन्धर्वाद्यैश्च वेष्टितम् .. 61 ..
text_mt: The seer is Śaṅkha, the metre is paṅkti, and Soma is the deity; / one should meditate on the Lord of Waters as white, surrounded by Gandharvas and others.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣyāsanagataṃ dhyāyecchvetagandhena carcayet ..
bṛhaspate paridīyā iti maṃtreṇa bhaktitaḥ .. 62 ..
meaning:
ऋष्यासनगतं ध्यायेच्छ्वेतगन्धेन चर्चयेत् ..
बृहस्पते परिदीया इति मंत्रेण भक्तितः .. 62 ..
text_mt: One should meditate on him seated on the seat of the sages and worship him with white perfume / with devotion, using the mantra beginning *bṛhaspate paridīyāḥ*.

sanskrit_iast:
tryaṃbako'sya ṛṣistriṣṭupchando devo jalādhipaḥ ..
dhyāyecca asuraṃ raktaṃ karālaṃ naravāhanam .. 63 ..
meaning:
त्र्यंबकोऽस्य ऋषिस्त्रिष्टुप्छन्दो देवो जलाधिपः ..
ध्यायेच्च असुरं रक्तं करालं नरवाहनम् .. 63 ..
text_mt: Tryambaka is his seer, the metre is triṣṭubh, and the god is the Lord of Waters. / And one should meditate on Asura as red, terrible, having a human being as his vehicle,

sanskrit_iast:
daśabhirbāhubhiryuktaṃ kṛṣṇavastrānulepanam ..
śanno devīti maṃtreṇa kṛṣṇapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet.. 64 ..
meaning:
दशभिर्बाहुभिर्युक्तं कृष्णवस्त्रानुलेपनम् ..
शन्नो देवीति मंत्रेण कृष्णपुष्पैः प्रपूजयेत्.. 64 ..
text_mt: endowed with ten arms, with black garments and ointment; / one should worship [him] with black flowers using the mantra beginning *śan no devī*.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣirvaiśvānaraśchando virāḍityabhidhīyate..
vaiśvānarottaro devaḥ prītaye tasya yojayet .. 65..
meaning:
ऋषिर्वैश्वानरश्छन्दो विराडित्यभिधीयते..
वैश्वानरोत्तरो देवः प्रीतये तस्य योजयेत् .. 65..
text_mt: The seer is Vaiśvānara, and the metre is named virāj; / the god is Vaiśvānarottara; one should employ it for his pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣaṃ ṣaḍānanaṃ dhyāyetkṛṣṇaṃ ca madhupiṃgalam ..
meṣasthaṃ kuṇḍalopetaṃ nāgayajñopavītinam ..
udvarṣa iti mantreṇa pūjayedbhūtimicchatā .. 66..
meaning:
शेषं षडाननं ध्यायेत्कृष्णं च मधुपिंगलम् ..
मेषस्थं कुण्डलोपेतं नागयज्ञोपवीतिनम् ..
उद्वर्ष इति मन्त्रेण पूजयेद्भूतिमिच्छता .. 66..
text_mt: One should meditate on Śeṣa as six-faced, dark, honey-brown, / mounted on a ram, wearing earrings, wearing a serpent as a sacred thread; / he who desires prosperity should worship [him] with the mantra beginning *ud varṣa*.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpaṃ raktaṃ trinetraṃ ca raktaṃ prānte vicintayet ..
raktaśmaśrudharaṃ caiva varahastaṃ vicintayet .. 67..
meaning:
पापं रक्तं त्रिनेत्रं च रक्तं प्रान्ते विचिन्तयेत् ..
रक्तश्मश्रुधरं चैव वरहस्तं विचिन्तयेत् .. 67..
text_mt: One should contemplate Pāpa as red and three-eyed, red at the perimeter, / bearing a red beard, with a hand granting boons.

sanskrit_iast:
siddho vīreti mantreṇa kṛṣṇapuṣpairathārcayet..
yamaṃ ca kṛkarākṣaṃ ca ākuñcanmūrdhaje dvijāḥ..68..
meaning:
सिद्धो वीरेति मन्त्रेण कृष्णपुष्पैरथार्चयेत्..
यमं च कृकराक्षं च आकुञ्चन्मूर्धजे द्विजाः..68..
text_mt: With the mantra beginning *siddho vīraḥ*, one should worship with black flowers / Yama, with eyes like a kṛkara bird and curled hair, O twice-born ones.

sanskrit_iast:
kapilo'sya ṛṣiśchando'nuṣṭup caiva prakīrtitam ..
devatā ca yaśaḥ khyātaṃ prītaye viniyojayet .. 69 ..
meaning:
कपिलोऽस्य ऋषिश्छन्दोऽनुष्टुप् चैव प्रकीर्तितम् ..
देवता च यशः ख्यातं प्रीतये विनियोजयेत् .. 69 ..
text_mt: Kapila is his seer, and the metre is proclaimed as anuṣṭubh; / the deity is celebrated as Yaśas; one should employ it for [his] pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
yamaṃ ca kṛkarākṣaṃ ca kṣamākuñcitamūrdhajam .. ..
kharasthaṃ dvibhujaṃ dhyāyedimaṃ mantramudīrayet .. 2.2.11.70 ..
meaning:
यमं च कृकराक्षं च क्षमाकुञ्चितमूर्धजम् .. ..
खरस्थं द्विभुजं ध्यायेदिमं मन्त्रमुदीरयेत् .. 2.2.11.70 ..
text_mt: Yama, with eyes like a kṛkara bird, with hair gently curled, / mounted on a donkey, two-armed, one should meditate upon [him and] recite this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
vāsukiḥ syādṛṣiścāsya paṃktiśchandaśca devatā ..
hiraṇyagarbha ityuktaḥ prītaye'sya niyojayet .. 71 ..
meaning:
वासुकिः स्यादृषिश्चास्य पंक्तिश्छन्दश्च देवता ..
हिरण्यगर्भ इत्युक्तः प्रीतयेऽस्य नियोजयेत् .. 71 ..
text_mt: Vāsuki is his seer, the metre is paṅkti, and the deity / is declared to be Hiraṇyagarbha; one should employ it for his pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
ardhapītaṃ ca dvibhujaṃ raktākṣaṃ dhūmrameva vā ..
devatābhiśca saṃpannaṃ vāto vāretireva ca .. 72 ..
meaning:
अर्धपीतं च द्विभुजं रक्ताक्षं धूम्रमेव वा ..
देवताभिश्च संपन्नं वातो वारेतिरेव च .. 72 ..
text_mt: Half-yellow and two-armed, red-eyed or smoke-coloured, / endowed with divine qualities, and [addressed by the mantra] *vāto vā*.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣirvāyuśca gāyatrī chando vāyuśca devatā .. 73 ..
meaning: ऋषिर्वायुश्च गायत्री छन्दो वायुश्च देवता .. 73 ..
text_mt: The seer is Vāyu, the metre is gāyatrī, and the deity is Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
mugdharaktaṃ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ tathā ..
pītavastraṃ pannagasthaṃ hārakeyūramaṃḍitam .. 74 ..
meaning:
मुग्धरक्तं शंखचक्रगदापद्मधरं तथा ..
पीतवस्त्रं पन्नगस्थं हारकेयूरमंडितम् .. 74 ..
text_mt: Charming and red, holding a conch, discus, mace, and lotus, / wearing yellow garments, seated on a serpent, adorned with necklaces and armlets.

sanskrit_iast:
avasṛṣṭā parāpata iti mantreṇa pūjayet ..
agniścāsya ṛṣiḥ proktacchandaḥ somaśca devatā .. 75 ..
meaning:
अवसृष्टा परापत इति मन्त्रेण पूजयेत् ..
अग्निश्चास्य ऋषिः प्रोक्तच्छन्दः सोमश्च देवता .. 75 ..
text_mt:
One should worship [him] with the mantra, “avasṛṣṭā parāpata”;
Agni is declared to be its sage, [the meter] a meter, and Soma the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
pītaṃ bhallāṭakaṃ dhyāyetpadmasthaṃ raktabhūṣaṇam ..
dvibhujaṃ padmahastaṃ ca devamevaṃ vicintayet ..
yanmāturiti mantreṇa pūjayetsitataṃḍulaiḥ .. 76 ..
meaning:
पीतं भल्लाटकं ध्यायेत्पद्मस्थं रक्तभूषणम् ..
द्विभुजं पद्महस्तं च देवमेवं विचिन्तयेत् ..
यन्मातुरिति मन्त्रेण पूजयेत्सिततंडुलैः .. 76 ..

sanskrit_iast:
jambhako'sya ṛṣiśchando gāyatrī samudāhṛtā ..
devatā ca bhavetkumbhaḥ prītaye viniyogataḥ .. .. 77 ..
meaning:
जम्भकोऽस्य ऋषिश्छन्दो गायत्री समुदाहृता ..
देवता च भवेत्कुम्भः प्रीतये विनियोगतः .. .. 77 ..
text_mt:
Jambhaka is its sage, the meter is declared to be Gāyatrī,
and Kumbha is the deity, for [his] pleasure through application.

sanskrit_iast:
somaṃ dhyāyecchyāmarūpaṃ padmāsanagataṃ param ..
nānābharaṇasampannaṃ kirīṭavaradhāriṇam ..
marmāṇiteti mantreṇa gandhādyairapi pūjayet .. 78 ..
meaning:
सोमं ध्यायेच्छ्यामरूपं पद्मासनगतं परम् ..
नानाभरणसम्पन्नं किरीटवरधारिणम् ..
मर्माणितेति मन्त्रेण गन्धाद्यैरपि पूजयेत् .. 78 ..
text_mt:
One should meditate upon the supreme Soma, of dark form, seated on a lotus posture,
endowed with various ornaments, wearing an excellent diadem.
One should also worship [him] with perfumes and other offerings using the mantra, “marmāṇi te”.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiḥ svārtho vedaśchando jagatītyabhidhīyate ..
devatā ca bhavetsomaḥ prīyate viniyojayet .. 79 ..
meaning:
ऋषिः स्वार्थो वेदश्छन्दो जगतीत्यभिधीयते ..
देवता च भवेत्सोमः प्रीयते विनियोजयेत् .. 79 ..
text_mt:
The sage is Svārtha, the meter is said to be Veda-Jagatī,
and Soma is the deity; one should apply [it] so that he is pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
darpaṃ dhyāyetkṛṣṇavarṇaṃ kṛṣṇāṃbaradharaṃ tathā ..
nāgayajñopavītiṃ ca śikhistaṃbhaṃ dvijottamāḥ .. 2.2.11.80 ..
meaning:
दर्पं ध्यायेत्कृष्णवर्णं कृष्णांबरधरं तथा ..
नागयज्ञोपवीतिं च शिखिस्तंभं द्विजोत्तमाः .. 2.2.11.80 ..
text_mt:
One should meditate upon Darpa, of black colour, wearing black garments,
having a serpent as his sacred thread, and [resembling] a post of fire, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast: paścadīśeti mantreṇa gandhādyaiḥ paripūjayet .. 81 ..
meaning: पश्चदीशेति मन्त्रेण गन्धाद्यैः परिपूजयेत् .. 81 ..
text_mt: One should worship [him] with perfumes and other offerings using the mantra, “paścadīśa”.

sanskrit_iast:
mantraścāsya ṛṣiścāsya pañcāyata namīritam ..
paṃktiśchandastathā proktaṃ devaḥ pañcānanaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 82 ..
meaning:
मन्त्रश्चास्य ऋषिश्चास्य पञ्चायत नमीरितम् ..
पंक्तिश्छन्दस्तथा प्रोक्तं देवः पञ्चाननः स्मृतः .. 82 ..
text_mt:
The mantra and its sage: “pañcāyatanama” is declared [as the sage];
Paṅkti is stated as the meter, and the five-faced god [Śiva] is remembered [as the deity].

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmavarṇāṃ ditiṃ dhyāyeddvibhujāṃ pītavigrahām ..
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannāṃ sarvālaṃkāraśobhitām .. 83 ..
meaning:
श्यामवर्णां दितिं ध्यायेद्द्विभुजां पीतविग्रहाम् ..
सर्वलक्षणसंपन्नां सर्वालंकारशोभिताम् .. 83 ..
text_mt:
One should meditate upon Diti, of dark colour, two-armed, with a yellow body,
endowed with all auspicious marks, adorned with all ornaments.

sanskrit_iast: suparṇo'sīti mantreṇa pūjayetpītacandanaiḥ .. 84 ..
meaning: सुपर्णोऽसीति मन्त्रेण पूजयेत्पीतचन्दनैः .. 84 ..
text_mt: One should worship [her] with yellow sandalwood using the mantra, “suparṇo 'si”.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣirnārāyaṇaśchando jagatī parikīrtyate ..
bhaveddevo bhārgavaśca iṣṭārthe paripūjayet .. 85 ..
meaning:
ऋषिर्नारायणश्छन्दो जगती परिकीर्त्यते ..
भवेद्देवो भार्गवश्च इष्टार्थे परिपूजयेत् .. 85 ..
text_mt:
Nārāyaṇa is proclaimed as the sage, Jagatī as the meter;
the god would be Bhārgava; one should worship for the desired objective.

sanskrit_iast:
raktābhāmaditiṃ dhyāyetsarvālaṃkārabhūṣitām ..
śukrāṃbhāritimantreṇa gandhādyairabhipūjayet .. 86 ..
meaning:
रक्ताभामदितिं ध्यायेत्सर्वालंकारभूषिताम् ..
शुक्रांभारितिमन्त्रेण गन्धाद्यैरभिपूजयेत् .. 86 ..
text_mt:
One should meditate upon Aditi, of red lustre, adorned with all ornaments;
one should worship [her] with perfumes and other offerings using the mantra, “śukrāṃbhāra”.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmadeva ṛṣiścāsya gandhādyairabhipūjayet .
devaḥ śukraḥ samākhyātaḥ stutau ca viniyojayet . . 87
meaning:
वामदेव ऋषिश्चास्य गन्धाद्यैरभिपूजयेत् .
देवः शुक्रः समाख्यातः स्तुतौ च विनियोजयेत् . . 87
text_mt:
Vāmadeva is its sage; one should worship with perfumes and other offerings;
Śukra is declared as the deity, and one should employ [it] in praise.

sanskrit_iast:
īśānādikoṇagatānpūjayetsusamāhitaḥ .
āpaṃ dhyāyecchuklavarṇaṃ kuṇḍalādyairvibhūṣitam . . 88
meaning:
ईशानादिकोणगतान्पूजयेत्सुसमाहितः .
आपं ध्यायेच्छुक्लवर्णं कुण्डलाद्यैर्विभूषितम् . . 88
text_mt:
Well-composed, one should worship those stationed in the north-east and other corners.
One should meditate upon Āpa, white in colour, adorned with earrings and other ornaments.

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ viṣṇuriti mantreṇa trigandhena samarcayet . . 89
meaning: इदं विष्णुरिति मन्त्रेण त्रिगन्धेन समर्चयेत् . . 89
text_mt: One should worship [him] with triple-perfume using the mantra, “idaṃ viṣṇuḥ”.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣiḥ syātkardamaśchando virāḍityabhidhīyate . . 2.2.11.90
meaning: ऋषिः स्यात्कर्दमश्छन्दो विराडित्यभिधीयते . . 2.2.11.90
text_mt: Kardama would be the sage; the meter is designated as Virāj.

sanskrit_iast:
devaḥ somaḥ samākhyātaḥ prītaye viniyojayet..
saritaṃ dvibhujaṃ raktaṃ raktaśvetāṃbarānvitam..91..
meaning:
देवः सोमः समाख्यातः प्रीतये विनियोजयेत्..
सरितं द्विभुजं रक्तं रक्तश्वेतांबरान्वितम्..91..
text_mt:
Soma is declared as the deity; one should employ [it] for [his] pleasure.
[One should meditate upon] Sarit: two-armed, red, endowed with red and white garments.

sanskrit_iast: payasā śukla iti mantreṇa pūjayetkamalādinā .. 92 ..
meaning: पयसा शुक्ल इति मन्त्रेण पूजयेत्कमलादिना .. 92 ..
text_mt: One should worship with lotuses and other [flowers] using the mantra, “payasā śukla”.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa ṛṣiścāsya paṃktiśchandaḥ prakīrtyate ..
nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ devaḥ prītaye viniyojayet .. 93 ..
meaning:
नारायण ऋषिश्चास्य पंक्तिश्छन्दः प्रकीर्त्यते ..
नारायणः स्वयं देवः प्रीतये विनियोजयेत् .. 93 ..
text_mt:
Nārāyaṇa is its sage, Paṅkti is proclaimed as the meter;
Nārāyaṇa himself is the deity; one should employ [it] for [his] pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
jayaṃ dhyāyetpītavarṇaṃ dvibhujaṃ varahastakam ..
devaṃ kirīṭasampannaṃ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitam .. 94 ..
meaning:
जयं ध्यायेत्पीतवर्णं द्विभुजं वरहस्तकम् ..
देवं किरीटसम्पन्नं सर्वालंकारभूषितम् .. 94 ..
text_mt:
One should meditate upon Jaya, yellow in colour, two-armed, his hand [raised] in boon-bestowal,
the god endowed with a diadem, adorned with all ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā pariśruta iti mantreṇānena pūjayet ..
ṛṣirnārāyaṇaśchandaḥ paṃktiḥ somo'tha devatā ..95..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा परिश्रुत इति मन्त्रेणानेन पूजयेत् ..
ऋषिर्नारायणश्छन्दः पंक्तिः सोमोऽथ देवता ..95..
text_mt:
One should worship with this mantra, “dṛṣṭvā pariśrutaḥ”;
Nārāyaṇa is the sage, Paṅkti the meter, and Soma the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
rudraṃ dhyāyedraktavarṇaṃ śītāṃśukṛtaśekharam..
dvibhujaṃ śūlahastaṃ ca ḍamaruṃ ca parābhavet ..96..
meaning:
रुद्रं ध्यायेद्रक्तवर्णं शीतांशुकृतशेखरम्..
द्विभुजं शूलहस्तं च डमरुं च पराभवेत् ..96..
text_mt:
One should meditate upon Rudra, red in colour, with the moon made into a crest-jewel,
two-armed, with a trident in hand, and the other [hand] should hold a ḍamaru drum.

sanskrit_iast:
divo mūrdhanniti mantreṇa ṛṣayaḥ samudāhṛtāḥ..
ṛṣiḥ syātkāśyapaśchando virāḍityabhidhīyate ..97..
meaning:
दिवो मूर्धन्निति मन्त्रेण ऋषयः समुदाहृताः..
ऋषिः स्यात्काश्यपश्छन्दो विराडित्यभिधीयते ..97..
text_mt:
The sages are declared with the mantra, “divo mūrdhan”;
Kāśyapa would be the sage, and the meter is designated as Virāj.

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ devo viniyogaḥ stutau ca viniyojayet ..
dvibhujaṃ raktapadmasya paṃkajadvayadhāriṇam .. 98 ..
meaning:
स्वयं देवो विनियोगः स्तुतौ च विनियोजयेत् ..
द्विभुजं रक्तपद्मस्य पंकजद्वयधारिणम् .. 98 ..
text_mt:
The god is himself [the deity]; the application is: one should employ [it] in praise.
[One should meditate upon him as] two-armed, having a red lotus, holding two lotuses.

sanskrit_iast:
asya kirīṭa iti mantreṇa raktasrakcandanādibhiḥ ..
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā ṛṣirnīla udāhṛtaḥ ..
triṣṭupchando devatā syāddhradopi parikīrtitaḥ .. 99 ..
meaning:
अस्य किरीट इति मन्त्रेण रक्तस्रक्चन्दनादिभिः ..
पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या ऋषिर्नील उदाहृतः ..
त्रिष्टुप्छन्दो देवता स्याद्ध्रदोपि परिकीर्तितः .. 99 ..

sanskrit_iast:
savitāraṃ tathā dhyāyetpadmasthaṃ dvibhujaprabhum..
nānābharaṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ saptāśvarathamaṃḍitam .. 2.2.11.100 ..
meaning:
सवितारं तथा ध्यायेत्पद्मस्थं द्विभुजप्रभुम्..
नानाभरणशोभाढ्यं सप्ताश्वरथमंडितम् .. 2.2.11.100 ..
text_mt:
Likewise, one should meditate upon the lord Savitṛ, stationed on a lotus, two-armed,
abounding in the beauty of various ornaments, gracing a chariot with seven horses.

sanskrit_iast:
yaddevā iti mantreṇa gandhādyaiḥ paripūjayet ..
ṛṣirautathya ākhyātaḥ prītaye viniyojayet .. 101 ..
meaning:
यद्देवा इति मन्त्रेण गन्धाद्यैः परिपूजयेत् ..
ऋषिरौतथ्य आख्यातः प्रीतये विनियोजयेत् .. 101 ..
text_mt:
One should worship with perfumes and other offerings using the mantra, “yaddevāḥ”;
Autathya is declared as the sage; one should employ [it] for [his] pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyedraktaṃ vivasvantaṃ dvibhujaṃ padmavigraham..
avidyā iti mantreṇa pūjayedgandhacandanaiḥ .. 102 ..
meaning:
ध्यायेद्रक्तं विवस्वन्तं द्विभुजं पद्मविग्रहम्..
अविद्या इति मन्त्रेण पूजयेद्गन्धचन्दनैः .. 102 ..
text_mt:
One should meditate upon the red Vivasvat, two-armed, having the form of a lotus;
one should worship with perfumes and sandalwood using the mantra, “avidyā”.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣirgandhaḥ samākhyātastriṣṭupchandaśca īritam ..
devatā ca bhavetsomaḥ stutau ca viniyojayet .. 103 ..
meaning:
ऋषिर्गन्धः समाख्यातस्त्रिष्टुप्छन्दश्च ईरितम् ..
देवता च भवेत्सोमः स्तुतौ च विनियोजयेत् .. 103 ..
text_mt:
Gandha is declared as the sage, and Triṣṭubh is stated as the meter;
Soma would be the deity, and one should employ [it] in praise.

sanskrit_iast:
vibudhādhipaṃ tato dhyāyetpītaṃ vṛṣabhavāhanam ..
caturbhujaṃ yaṣṭihastamakṣamālaikahastakam ..
trinetraṃ raktavastraṃ ca mukuṭādyairalaṃkṛtam .. 104 ..
meaning:
विबुधाधिपं ततो ध्यायेत्पीतं वृषभवाहनम् ..
चतुर्भुजं यष्टिहस्तमक्षमालैकहस्तकम् ..
त्रिनेत्रं रक्तवस्त्रं च मुकुटाद्यैरलंकृतम् .. 104 ..
text_mt:
Then one should meditate upon Vibudhādhipa: yellow, mounted upon a bull,
four-armed, with a staff in hand, with a rosary in one hand,
three-eyed, [wearing] red garments, and adorned with diadems and other ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣirhārīta ityukto jagatīcchanda īritam ..
devatā ca bhavecchaktiḥ prītaye viniyojayet .. 105 ..
meaning:
ऋषिर्हारीत इत्युक्तो जगतीच्छन्द ईरितम् ..
देवता च भवेच्छक्तिः प्रीतये विनियोजयेत् .. 105 ..
text_mt:
Hārīta is said to be the sage, Jagatī is stated as the meter;
Śakti would be the deity; one should employ [it] for [her] pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
mitraṃ dhyāyecchuklavarṇaṃ varābhayakaraṃ param ..
meṣasthaṃ ca trinetraṃ ca kirīṭavaramaṃḍitam .. 106 ..
meaning:
मित्रं ध्यायेच्छुक्लवर्णं वराभयकरं परम् ..
मेषस्थं च त्रिनेत्रं च किरीटवरमंडितम् .. 106 ..
text_mt:
One should meditate upon Mitra, white in colour, supreme, his hands granting boons and fearlessness,
mounted upon a ram, three-eyed, and adorned with an excellent diadem.

sanskrit_iast: dhanākarastviti mantreṇa pūjayeddadhipāyasaiḥ..1 07..
meaning: धनाकरस्त्विति मन्त्रेण पूजयेद्दधिपायसैः..1 07..
text_mt: One should worship with curds and milk-rice using the mantra, “dhanākarastu”.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣirautathya ityukto jagatī chanda īritam ..
devatā ca bhavedyakṣmā prītaye viniyojayet ..108..
meaning:
ऋषिरौतथ्य इत्युक्तो जगती छन्द ईरितम् ..
देवता च भवेद्यक्ष्मा प्रीतये विनियोजयेत् ..108..
text_mt:
Autathya is said to be the sage, Jagatī is stated as the meter;
Yakṣman would be the deity; one should employ [it] for [his] pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
pītāsyaṃ rājayakṣyāṇaṃ karālaṃ ca viciṃtayet..
yaśo rūpamiti mantreṇa gandhādyaiḥ paripūjayet .. 109 ..
meaning:
पीतास्यं राजयक्ष्याणं करालं च विचिंतयेत्..
यशो रूपमिति मन्त्रेण गन्धाद्यैः परिपूजयेत् .. 109 ..
text_mt:
One should visualize Rājayakṣman with a yellow face, and dreadful;
one should worship with perfumes and other offerings using the mantra, “yaśo rūpam”.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhyaṅṅātharvaṇa ṛṣirgāyatrī chanda īritam ..
yakṣmā ca devatā caiva stutau ca viniyoja yet ..2.2.11.1 1 0..
meaning:
दध्यङ्ङाथर्वण ऋषिर्गायत्री छन्द ईरितम् ..
यक्ष्मा च देवता चैव स्तुतौ च विनियोज येत् ..2.2.11.1 1 0..
text_mt:
Dadhyañc Ātharvaṇa is the sage, Gāyatrī is stated as the meter;
and Yakṣman is the deity; one should employ [it] in praise.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklāṃbaradharaṃ dhyāyeddvibhujaṃ śikhivāhanam ..
yamaṃ vineti maṃtreṇa pūjayedbhaktitatparaḥ ..111..
meaning:
शुक्लांबरधरं ध्यायेद्द्विभुजं शिखिवाहनम् ..
यमं विनेति मंत्रेण पूजयेद्भक्तितत्परः ..111..
text_mt:
One should meditate upon [him] wearing white garments, two-armed, mounted upon a peacock;
intent on devotion, one should worship using the mantra, “yamaṃ vinā”.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiḥ syānnāradaḥ proktaśchandonuṣṭupprakīrtitam ..
vivasvāndevatā caiva kratau ca viniyojayet ..112..
meaning:
ऋषिः स्यान्नारदः प्रोक्तश्छन्दोनुष्टुप्प्रकीर्तितम् ..
विवस्वान्देवता चैव क्रतौ च विनियोजयेत् ..112..
text_mt:
Nārada would be declared as the sage, the meter is proclaimed as Anuṣṭubh,
and Vivasvat is the deity; one should employ [it] in the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dhyātvā vivasvaṃtaṃ mahākāyaṃ mahodaram ..
abhinnarūpamaṃtreṇa gandhādyaiḥ paripūja yet .. 113 ..
meaning:
एवं ध्यात्वा विवस्वंतं महाकायं महोदरम् ..
अभिन्नरूपमंत्रेण गन्धाद्यैः परिपूज येत् .. 113 ..
text_mt:
Having thus meditated upon Vivasvat, having a great body and a large belly,
one should worship with perfumes and other offerings using the mantra, “abhinnarūpa”.

sanskrit_iast: kāśyaposya ṛṣiśchandastriṣṭubdevaḥ śacīpatiḥ .. 114 ..
meaning: काश्यपोस्य ऋषिश्छन्दस्त्रिष्टुब्देवः शचीपतिः .. 114 ..
text_mt: Kāśyapa is its sage, the meter is Triṣṭubh, and the god is Śacīpati.

sanskrit_iast:
bahirīśānakoṇeṣu devādīnparipūjayet ..
kūṣmāṇḍairvaraṇāpuṣpaiḥ śaurakairvā samarcayet .. 115 ..
meaning:
बहिरीशानकोणेषु देवादीन्परिपूजयेत् ..
कूष्माण्डैर्वरणापुष्पैः शौरकैर्वा समर्चयेत् .. 115 ..
text_mt:
Outside, in the north-eastern corners, one should worship the gods and other beings;
one should worship them with ash gourds, with flowers of the varaṇa, or with śauraka flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
pītāṃ karālikāṃ dhyāyeccarakīṃ varavarṇinīm ..
svabjasthāṃ dvibhujāṃ caiva guñjāhāropaśobhitām .. 116 ..
meaning:
पीतां करालिकां ध्यायेच्चरकीं वरवर्णिनीम् ..
स्वब्जस्थां द्विभुजां चैव गुञ्जाहारोपशोभिताम् .. 116 ..
text_mt:
One should meditate upon the yellow Karālikā, Carakī, of excellent complexion,
stationed on her own lotus, two-armed, and adorned with a necklace of guñjā berries.

sanskrit_iast:
pītinyarūpamantreṇa pūjayedbhūtimicchukaḥ ..
baladeva ṛṣiścāsya chando gaurī ca devatā .. 117 ..
meaning:
पीतिन्यरूपमन्त्रेण पूजयेद्भूतिमिच्छुकः ..
बलदेव ऋषिश्चास्य छन्दो गौरी च देवता .. 117 ..
text_mt:
Desiring prosperity, one should worship with the mantra, “pītinyarūpa”;
Baladeva is its sage, the meter […], and Gaurī is the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyedvidārikāṃ raktāṃ navayauvanasaṃyutām ..
pavitreṇa punīhīti maṃtreṇānena pūjayet .. 118 ..
meaning:
ध्यायेद्विदारिकां रक्तां नवयौवनसंयुताम् ..
पवित्रेण पुनीहीति मंत्रेणानेन पूजयेत् .. 118 ..
text_mt:
One should meditate upon Vidārikā, red, endowed with fresh youth;
one should worship with this mantra, “pavitreṇa punīhi”.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣirgargaḥ samākhyātastriṣṭupchandosya devatā ..
rudro'pi ca samākhyātaḥ stutau ca viniyojayet .. 119 ..
meaning:
ऋषिर्गर्गः समाख्यातस्त्रिष्टुप्छन्दोस्य देवता ..
रुद्रोऽपि च समाख्यातः स्तुतौ च विनियोजयेत् .. 119 ..
text_mt:
Garga is declared as the sage, Triṣṭubh as the meter;
Rudra is also declared as its deity; one should employ [it] in praise.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpādirākṣasīṃ dhyāyetsaurabheyoparisthitām ..
kayā na iti maṃtreṇa pūjayedgandhacandanaiḥ .. 2.2.11.120 ..
meaning:
पापादिराक्षसीं ध्यायेत्सौरभेयोपरिस्थिताम् ..
कया न इति मंत्रेण पूजयेद्गन्धचन्दनैः .. 2.2.11.120 ..
text_mt:
One should meditate upon the rākṣasī Pāpā and others, standing upon a bull;
one should worship with perfumes and sandalwood using the mantra, “kayā naḥ”.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiḥ suvarṇa ākhyātaḥ paṅktiśchandaḥ prakīrtitam ..
devatā ca mahādeva iṣṭārthe viniyojayet .. 121 ..
meaning:
ऋषिः सुवर्ण आख्यातः पङ्क्तिश्छन्दः प्रकीर्तितम् ..
देवता च महादेव इष्टार्थे विनियोजयेत् .. 121 ..
text_mt: The sage is declared to be Suvarṇa, the metre is proclaimed to be paṅkti, / and the deity is Mahādeva; one should employ it for one's desired goal.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇḍavedyā aṃtare ca sthāpavedvidhivadbudhaḥ ..
parvatāgramṛdaṃ caiva gajadaṃtamṛdaṃ tathā .. 122 ..
meaning:
कुण्डवेद्या अंतरे च स्थापवेद्विधिवद्बुधः ..
पर्वताग्रमृदं चैव गजदंतमृदं तथा .. 122 ..
