text_mt: And inside the altar of the sacrificial pit, the wise man should set down according to rule: / soil from a mountain peak, and likewise soil from an elephant's tusk,

sanskrit_iast:
valmīke saṃgame caiva rājadvāracatuṣpathāt ..
kuśamūlamṛdaṃ caiva yajñiyasya vanaspateḥ .. 123 ..
meaning:
वल्मीके संगमे चैव राजद्वारचतुष्पथात् ..
कुशमूलमृदं चैव यज्ञियस्य वनस्पतेः .. 123 ..
text_mt: from an anthill, from a river confluence, from a royal gate, from a crossroad, / and soil from the root of kuśa grass and from a tree suitable for sacrifice;

sanskrit_iast:
indravallī tathākrāṃta amṛtī trapuṣasya ca ..
mālatī caṃpakaṃ caiva tathā urvārukasya ca .. 124 ..
meaning:
इन्द्रवल्ली तथाक्रांत अमृती त्रपुषस्य च ..
मालती चंपकं चैव तथा उर्वारुकस्य च .. 124 ..
text_mt: indravallī, and likewise ākrāntā, amṛtī, of cucumber, / mālatī, campaka, and likewise of melon;

sanskrit_iast:
pāribhadrasya patraiśca paritaḥ pariveṣṭanam ..
pañcatuṃgasya parito mukhe kuryātphaṇānvitam .. 125 ..
meaning:
पारिभद्रस्य पत्रैश्च परितः परिवेष्टनम् ..
पञ्चतुंगस्य परितो मुखे कुर्यात्फणान्वितम् .. 125 ..
text_mt: and an enclosing all around with leaves of the pāribhadra tree; / all around the pañcatuṅga, at the mouth, he should make [a vessel] provided with hoods;

sanskrit_iast:
śrīphalaṃ bījapūraṃ ca nālikeraṃ ca dāḍimam ..
dhātrīṃ jaṃbuphalaṃ caiva anyayā doṣamādiśet ..126..
meaning:
श्रीफलं बीजपूरं च नालिकेरं च दाडिमम् ..
धात्रीं जंबुफलं चैव अन्यया दोषमादिशेत् ..126..
text_mt: bilva fruit, citron, coconut, pomegranate, / āmalakī, and rose-apple fruit; through another [choice], he would indicate a defect;

sanskrit_iast:
pañcaraktaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca nikṣipedvaruṇaṃ yajet ..
pañcopacārairvidhivadgandhapuṣpādibhiryajet..127..
meaning:
पञ्चरक्तं सुवर्णं च निक्षिपेद्वरुणं यजेत् ..
पञ्चोपचारैर्विधिवद्गन्धपुष्पादिभिर्यजेत्..127..
text_mt: and he should cast in five red [gems] and gold, and worship Varuṇa; / he should worship according to rule with the five articles of worship, with perfume, flowers, and the rest.

sanskrit_iast: udvartana iti mantreṇa varuṇaṃ ca punaryajet ..128..
meaning: उद्वर्तन इति मन्त्रेण वरुणं च पुनर्यजेत् ..128..
text_mt: And with the mantra 'Udvartana...', he should worship Varuṇa again.

sanskrit_iast:
asya maṃtrasya ca ṛṣirviṣṇuśchanda udāhṛtam ..
gāyatrī devatā pāśī prītaye viniyojayet .. 129 ..
meaning:
अस्य मंत्रस्य च ऋषिर्विष्णुश्छन्द उदाहृतम् ..
गायत्री देवता पाशी प्रीतये विनियोजयेत् .. 129 ..
text_mt: And of this mantra, the sage is Viṣṇu, the metre is declared to be / gāyatrī, the deity is the noose-bearer [Varuṇa]; one should employ it for his pleasure.

sanskrit_iast: pañcagaṃdhānvinikṣipya hastaṃ dattvā paṭhettataḥ .. 2.2.11.130 ..
meaning: पञ्चगंधान्विनिक्षिप्य हस्तं दत्त्वा पठेत्ततः .. 2.2.11.130 ..
text_mt: Having thrown in the five perfumes, placing his hand upon it, he should then recite:

sanskrit_iast:
sarve samudrāḥ saritaḥ sarāṃsi ca mahāhradāḥ...
āyāṃtu sarvapāpaghnāḥ sarvalokasukhāvahāḥ .. 131 ..
meaning:
सर्वे समुद्राः सरितः सरांसि च महाह्रदाः...
आयांतु सर्वपापघ्नाः सर्वलोकसुखावहाः .. 131 ..
text_mt: 'May all the oceans, rivers, lakes, and great pools, / destroyers of all sins, bringers of happiness to all worlds, arrive!

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāstīrthāni jaladāḥ nadāḥ ..
āyāṃtu yajamānasya duritakṣayakārakāḥ .. 132 ..
meaning:
गंगाद्याः सरितः सर्वास्तीर्थानि जलदाः नदाः ..
आयांतु यजमानस्य दुरितक्षयकारकाः .. 132 ..
text_mt: May the Gaṅgā and all other rivers, sacred bathing places, clouds, and streams, / bringing about the destruction of the sacrificer's sins, arrive!'

sanskrit_iast:
aghorājyaṣṭakakṛtā vāstoṣpataya ityapi ..
śataṃ vā cāṣṭasaṃyuktaṃ sahasraṃ vā viśeṣataḥ .. 133 ..
meaning:
अघोराज्यष्टककृता वास्तोष्पतय इत्यपि ..
शतं वा चाष्टसंयुक्तं सहस्रं वा विशेषतः .. 133 ..
text_mt: Made with the Aghora eight-ghee [oblations], and also [with the mantra] 'Vāstoṣpate...': / one hundred and eight, or especially one thousand,

sanskrit_iast:
śatārdhaṃ vā hunedviprastilairvā taṃḍulaiḥ saha ..
pālāśairvā pippalairvaudumbarairvā samācaret..134..
meaning:
शतार्धं वा हुनेद्विप्रस्तिलैर्वा तंडुलैः सह ..
पालाशैर्वा पिप्पलैर्वौदुम्बरैर्वा समाचरेत्..134..
text_mt: or the twice-born should offer half a hundred oblations, with sesame or with rice grains, / or he should perform it with palāśa, pippala, or udumbara [twigs],

sanskrit_iast:
payodadhyādibhirvāpi madhvājyairvā viśiṣyate..
anyeṣāṃ ca vratenaiva ekaikāmatha vāhutim..135..
meaning:
पयोदध्यादिभिर्वापि मध्वाज्यैर्वा विशिष्यते..
अन्येषां च व्रतेनैव एकैकामथ वाहुतिम्..135..
text_mt: or with milk, curd, and the rest, or it is distinguished with honey and ghee; / and by the vow of others, he should offer one oblation each,

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭāviṃśatibhiścānyairaṣṭāṣṭau paṃcapaṃca vā .. 136 ..
meaning: अष्टाविंशतिभिश्चान्यैरष्टाष्टौ पंचपंच वा .. 136 ..
text_mt: or twenty-eight by others, or eight each, or five each.

sanskrit_iast:
carakyādīṃścāsanaiśca piṣṭakairvaṭakena vā ..
raktapuṣpeṇa patreṇa trimadhvaktena yatnataḥ .. 137 ..
meaning:
चरक्यादींश्चासनैश्च पिष्टकैर्वटकेन वा ..
रक्तपुष्पेण पत्रेण त्रिमध्वक्तेन यत्नतः .. 137 ..
text_mt: And to Carakī and the rest, with seats, cakes, or fried dumplings, / with red flowers, leaves, carefully smeared with the three sweets—

sanskrit_iast:
vāstoṣpate dṛḍhaṃ japtvā yajedvāstupatiṃ yadā ..
paṃcopacārairvidhivatsāṃgopāṃgairanaṃtaram ..138..
meaning:
वास्तोष्पते दृढं जप्त्वा यजेद्वास्तुपतिं यदा ..
पंचोपचारैर्विधिवत्सांगोपांगैरनंतरम् ..138..
text_mt: when, having firmly recited 'Vāstoṣpate...', he should worship Vāstupati / according to rule with the five articles of worship, along with the limbs and sub-limbs, thereafter

sanskrit_iast:
balimāsādayetpaścāddadyādekaikaśaḥ kramāt..
brāhmaṇaiścaiva dadyācca sadā ājyaṃ samākṣikam .. 139 ..
meaning:
बलिमासादयेत्पश्चाद्दद्यादेकैकशः क्रमात्..
ब्राह्मणैश्चैव दद्याच्च सदा आज्यं समाक्षिकम् .. 139 ..
text_mt: he should then present the offering, and give it one by one in order; / and with the brāhmaṇas he should always give ghee with honey.

sanskrit_iast:
śālyannaṃ śikhine dadyāttathā nīlotpalāni ca ..
odanaṃ sotpalaṃ dadyātparjanyāya vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 2.2.11.140 ..
meaning:
शाल्यन्नं शिखिने दद्यात्तथा नीलोत्पलानि च ..
ओदनं सोत्पलं दद्यात्पर्जन्याय विचक्षणः .. 2.2.11.140 ..
text_mt: He should give winter-rice food to Śikhin, and likewise blue water lilies; / the discerning man should give boiled rice with water lilies to Parjanya;

sanskrit_iast:
jayāya piṣṭakaṃ kāryamindrāya ghṛtamodakaḥ ..
sūryāya piṣṭakānnaṃ ca satyāya yavapūlikām ..141..
meaning:
जयाय पिष्टकं कार्यमिन्द्राय घृतमोदकः ..
सूर्याय पिष्टकान्नं च सत्याय यवपूलिकाम् ..141..
text_mt: a cake is to be made for Jaya, a ghee-sweetmeat for Indra, / cake-food for Sūrya, and a barley cake for Satya;

sanskrit_iast:
bhramāya matsyamāṃsānnaṃ śaṣkulīmatha piṣṭakam ..
vāyavye ca tathā saktūnpūṣṇe cāpūpameva hi .. 142 ..
meaning:
भ्रमाय मत्स्यमांसान्नं शष्कुलीमथ पिष्टकम् ..
वायव्ये च तथा सक्तून्पूष्णे चापूपमेव हि .. 142 ..
text_mt: food with fish and meat for Bhrama, and then a fried pastry and cake; / and likewise roasted barley meal for Vāyavya, and a baked sweet cake for Pūṣan;

sanskrit_iast:
vitathāya kalāyānnaṃ gṛharkṣāya samākṣikam ..
pūṣṇetha kṛśarānnaṃ ca śālyannaṃ ca nivedayet .. 143 ..
meaning:
वितथाय कलायान्नं गृहर्क्षाय समाक्षिकम् ..
पूष्णेथ कृशरान्नं च शाल्यन्नं च निवेदयेत् .. 143 ..
text_mt: food with peas for Vitatha, [food] with honey for Gṛharkṣa; / he should then present rice with pulse for Pūṣan, and winter-rice food;

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvāya kastūrikānnaṃ kṛśaraṃ bhṛṃgarājake ..
mṛgāya yāvakānnaṃ ca pitṛbhyo mudgapāyasam ..144..
meaning:
गन्धर्वाय कस्तूरिकान्नं कृशरं भृंगराजके ..
मृगाय यावकान्नं च पितृभ्यो मुद्गपायसम् ..144..
text_mt: musk-flavoured food for Gandharva, rice with pulse for Bhṛṅgarājaka, / barley food for Mṛga, and kidney-bean rice pudding for the ancestors;

sanskrit_iast:
dauvārikāya kṛśarānanaḍuṃhe ca pūpakam ..
pāyasaṃ puṣpadaṃtāya varuṇāya ca piṣṭakam .. 145 ..
meaning:
दौवारिकाय कृशराननडुंहे च पूपकम् ..
पायसं पुष्पदंताय वरुणाय च पिष्टकम् .. 145 ..
text_mt: rice with pulse for Dauvārika, and a cake for Anaḍuha; / rice pudding for Puṣpadanta, and a cake for Varuṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
asurāya modakāṃścaiva dadyādāpikṣaye surām..
ghṛtodanaṃ ca somāya kaṇānnaṃ yakṣmaṇe dadet .. 146 ..
meaning:
असुराय मोदकांश्चैव दद्यादापिक्षये सुराम्..
घृतोदनं च सोमाय कणान्नं यक्ष्मणे ददेत् .. 146 ..
text_mt: and sweetmeats for Asura, and he should give liquor for Āpikṣaya; / boiled rice with ghee for Soma, and grain-tip food he should give to Yakṣman;

sanskrit_iast:
rogāya ghṛtalaḍḍūkaṃ sapāyasaguḍaudanam ..
akṣāya vividhānnaṃ ca bhallāṭāya tathaiva ca .. 147 ..
meaning:
रोगाय घृतलड्डूकं सपायसगुडौदनम् ..
अक्षाय विविधान्नं च भल्लाटाय तथैव च .. 147 ..
text_mt: a ghee-laḍḍu for Roga, along with rice pudding and jaggery-rice; / and various foods for Akṣa, and likewise for Bhallāṭa;

sanskrit_iast:
somāya madhuśālyannaṃ nāgāya guḍapiṣṭakam ..
adityai cāpi godhūmaṃ ghṛtapakvaṃ nivedayet .. 148 ..
meaning:
सोमाय मधुशाल्यन्नं नागाय गुडपिष्टकम् ..
अदित्यै चापि गोधूमं घृतपक्वं निवेदयेत् .. 148 ..
text_mt: honey and winter-rice food for Soma, a jaggery cake for Nāga; / and he should present wheat cooked in ghee to Aditi;

sanskrit_iast:
dityai dadyāttathā kṣīraṃ sitaśarkarayā saha ..
kṣīrānnaṃ caiva pūṣṇe ca āpavatsāya vai dadhi .. .. 149 ..
meaning:
दित्यै दद्यात्तथा क्षीरं सितशर्करया सह ..
क्षीरान्नं चैव पूष्णे च आपवत्साय वै दधि .. .. 149 ..
text_mt: and to Diti he should give milk together with white sugar; / milk-rice to Pūṣan, and curd indeed to Āpavatsa;

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitryai laḍḍukānnaṃ ca savitre ca guḍaudanam ..
jayāya ghṛtamannaṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ ca vivasvate .. 2.2.11.150 ..
meaning:
सावित्र्यै लड्डुकान्नं च सवित्रे च गुडौदनम् ..
जयाय घृतमन्नं च मिष्टान्नं च विवस्वते .. 2.2.11.150 ..
text_mt: a laḍḍu-dish for Sāvitrī, and jaggery-rice for Savitṛ; / food with ghee for Jaya, and sweet food for Vivasvat;

sanskrit_iast:
virūpāya ca taddadyāddharidrānnaṃ tathaiva ca ..
ghṛtaudanaṃ ca citrāya rudrāya ghṛtapāyasam .. 151 ..
meaning:
विरूपाय च तद्दद्याद्धरिद्रान्नं तथैव च ..
घृतौदनं च चित्राय रुद्राय घृतपायसम् .. 151 ..
text_mt: and he should give that to Virūpa, and turmeric-food likewise; / boiled rice with ghee to Citra, and ghee-rice pudding to Rudra;

sanskrit_iast:
māṃsaudanaṃ yakṣmaṇe ca kṛśaraṃ varuṇāya ca ..
aryamṇe śarkarāpūpaṃ bahirdadyāccatuṣṭayam .. .. 152 ..
meaning:
मांसौदनं यक्ष्मणे च कृशरं वरुणाय च ..
अर्यम्णे शर्करापूपं बहिर्दद्याच्चतुष्टयम् .. .. 152 ..
text_mt: boiled rice with meat to Yakṣman, and rice with pulse to Varuṇa; / a sugar cake to Aryaman; on the outside he should give four:

sanskrit_iast:
citraudanaṃ samāṃsaṃ ca matsyānnaṃ guḍapiṣṭakam ..
pratidevopari kṣīraṃ ghṛtakṣīrasamanvitam ..
tīrthatoyasamāyuktaṃ sugandhena samanvitam..153..
meaning:
चित्रौदनं समांसं च मत्स्यान्नं गुडपिष्टकम् ..
प्रतिदेवोपरि क्षीरं घृतक्षीरसमन्वितम् ..
तीर्थतोयसमायुक्तं सुगन्धेन समन्वितम्..153..
text_mt: variegated boiled rice with meat, fish food, and jaggery cake; / over each deity, milk, endowed with ghee and milk, / combined with sacred water, and endowed with sweet fragrance.

sanskrit_iast:
patākā devavarṇena dadyādbrahmādiṣu kramāt ..
maṃtraṃ japetsvasāmarthyātsvasāmarthyātstutiṃ paṭhet .. 154 ..
meaning:
पताका देववर्णेन दद्याद्ब्रह्मादिषु क्रमात् ..
मंत्रं जपेत्स्वसामर्थ्यात्स्वसामर्थ्यात्स्तुतिं पठेत् .. 154 ..
text_mt: He should give a flag according to the colour of the deity, to Brahmā and the others in order; / he should recite the mantra according to his ability, and recite the praise according to his ability.

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣastavasya sūrya ṛṣirjagatī chandaḥ ..
savitā devatā somapāke stutau viniyogaḥ .. 155 ..
meaning:
पुरुषस्तवस्य सूर्य ऋषिर्जगती छन्दः ..
सविता देवता सोमपाके स्तुतौ विनियोगः .. 155 ..
text_mt: Of the praise of Puruṣa, Sūrya is the sage, jagatī is the metre, / Savitṛ is the deity; the employment is in praise during the cooking of soma.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śaṃkara uvāca .. ..
viṣṇurjiṣṇurvibhuryajño yajñiyo yajñapālakaḥ ..
nārāyaṇo naro haṃso viṣvakseno hutāśanaḥ .. 156 ..
meaning:
.. शंकर उवाच .. ..
विष्णुर्जिष्णुर्विभुर्यज्ञो यज्ञियो यज्ञपालकः ..
नारायणो नरो हंसो विष्वक्सेनो हुताशनः .. 156 ..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / Viṣṇu, victorious, all-pervading, sacrifice, worthy of sacrifice, protector of sacrifice, / Nārāyaṇa, Nara, Haṃsa, Viṣvaksena, fire-eater [Agni],

sanskrit_iast:
yajñeśaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sūryaḥ surārcitaḥ ..
ādidevo jagatkartā maṇḍaleśo mahīdharaḥ .. 157 ..
meaning:
यज्ञेशः पुण्डरीकाक्षः कृष्णः सूर्यः सुरार्चितः ..
आदिदेवो जगत्कर्ता मण्डलेशो महीधरः .. 157 ..
text_mt: Lord of sacrifice, lotus-eyed, Kṛṣṇa, Sūrya, worshipped by the gods, / primal deity, creator of the world, lord of the circle, bearer of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
padmanābho hṛṣīkeśo dātā dāmodaro hariḥ ..
trivikramastrilokeśo brahmaṇaḥ prītivarddhanaḥ .. 158 ..
meaning:
पद्मनाभो हृषीकेशो दाता दामोदरो हरिः ..
त्रिविक्रमस्त्रिलोकेशो ब्रह्मणः प्रीतिवर्द्धनः .. 158 ..
text_mt: lotus-naveled, Hṛṣīkeśa, giver, Dāmodara, Hari, / Trivikrama, lord of the three worlds, increaser of Brahmā's delight,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktapriyo'cyutaḥ satyaḥ satyavākyo dhruvaḥ śuciḥ ..
saṃnyāsī śāstratattvajñastripaṃcāśadguṇātmakaḥ .. 159 ..
meaning:
भक्तप्रियोऽच्युतः सत्यः सत्यवाक्यो ध्रुवः शुचिः ..
संन्यासी शास्त्रतत्त्वज्ञस्त्रिपंचाशद्गुणात्मकः .. 159 ..
text_mt: fond of devotees, Acyuta, Satya, true of speech, Dhruva, pure, / renunciant, knower of the truth of scriptures, consisting of fifty-three qualities,

sanskrit_iast:
vidārī vinayaḥ śāṃtastapasvī vaidyutaprabhaḥ ..
yajñastvaṃ hi vaṣaṭkārastvamoṃkārastvamagnayaḥ .. 2.2.11.160 ..
meaning:
विदारी विनयः शांतस्तपस्वी वैद्युतप्रभः ..
यज्ञस्त्वं हि वषट्कारस्त्वमोंकारस्त्वमग्नयः .. 2.2.11.160 ..
text_mt: destroyer, modesty, peaceful, ascetic, possessing the splendour of lightning; / for you are the sacrifice, the vaṣaṭ-call, you are the oṃkāra, you are the sacred fires;

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ svadhā tvaṃ hi svāhā tvaṃ sudhā ca puruṣottamaḥ ..
namo devādidevāya viṣṇave śāsvatāya ca ..
anaṃtāyāprameyāya namaste garuḍadhvaja .. 161 ..
meaning:
त्वं स्वधा त्वं हि स्वाहा त्वं सुधा च पुरुषोत्तमः ..
नमो देवादिदेवाय विष्णवे शास्वताय च ..
अनंतायाप्रमेयाय नमस्ते गरुडध्वज .. 161 ..
text_mt: you are svadhā, you are svāhā, and you are nectar, the supreme spirit [Puruṣottama]; / salutations to the god of gods, to Viṣṇu, and to the eternal one; / to the infinite, the immeasurable; salutations to you whose banner is Garuḍa!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmastavamimaṃ proktaṃ mahādevena bhāṣitam ..
prayatnādyaḥ paṭhennityamamṛtatvaṃ sa gacchati .. 162 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मस्तवमिमं प्रोक्तं महादेवेन भाषितम् ..
प्रयत्नाद्यः पठेन्नित्यममृतत्वं स गच्छति .. 162 ..
text_mt: Whoever carefully and constantly recites this praise of Brahman, / spoken by Mahādeva, he attains immortality.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyaṃti ye nityamanaṃtamacyutaṃ hṛtpadmamadhye svayamāvyavasthitam ..
upāsakānāṃ prabhumekamīśvaraṃ te yāṃti siddhiṃ paramāṃ tu vaiṣṇavīm .. 163 ..
arghyadānavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
ध्यायंति ये नित्यमनंतमच्युतं हृत्पद्ममध्ये स्वयमाव्यवस्थितम् ..
उपासकानां प्रभुमेकमीश्वरं ते यांति सिद्धिं परमां तु वैष्णवीम् .. 163 ..
अर्घ्यदानविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Those who constantly meditate on the infinite, unfalling one, standing manifest within the heart's lotus, / the single master and sovereign of worshippers, they attain supreme Vaiṣṇava perfection.
Description of the procedure for offering arghya

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tato bheryādighoṣeṇa yajamāna udaṅmukhaḥ ..
kanakatoyena gandhena mudgalāgreṇa lepayet .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
ततो भेर्यादिघोषेण यजमान उदङ्मुखः ..
कनकतोयेन गन्धेन मुद्गलाग्रेण लेपयेत् .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Then, amidst the sounding of kettle-drums and other instruments, the sacrificer, facing north, / should smear [the ground] with golden water and perfume, using the tip of a club.
title: adhyāyaḥ 12

sanskrit_iast:
aiśānyāṃ madhyabhāge vā yajedvā susamāhitaḥ ..
vartulākārayedyasmānmana icchati saṃjapan .. 2 ..
meaning:
ऐशान्यां मध्यभागे वा यजेद्वा सुसमाहितः ..
वर्तुलाकारयेद्यस्मान्मन इच्छति संजपन् .. 2 ..
text_mt: In the northeast or in the middle part, being well-composed, he should sacrifice, / or he should make it circular, murmuring [prayers] as his mind desires.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiḥ kaṃṭhotha gāyatrī chanda ityabhidhīyate ..
devatā pṛthivī caiva stutau ca viniyojayet ..3..
meaning:
ऋषिः कंठोथ गायत्री छन्द इत्यभिधीयते ..
देवता पृथिवी चैव स्तुतौ च विनियोजयेत् ..3..
text_mt: Kaṇṭha is the seer, Gāyatrī is declared the metre, / and the deity is Earth; he should employ them in the praise.

sanskrit_iast:
vivare pūjayetkarma brahmāṇaṃ ca dharādharam ..
pṛthivīṃ gandhapuṣpādyairnaivedyairvividhairapi .. 4 ..
meaning:
विवरे पूजयेत्कर्म ब्रह्माणं च धराधरम् ..
पृथिवीं गन्धपुष्पाद्यैर्नैवेद्यैर्विविधैरपि .. 4 ..
text_mt: In the cavity he should worship the Kurma, Brahmā, and the bearer of the earth, / and [he should worship] the Earth with fragrant flowers and the like, as well as with various food offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
agrato'ṣṭadalaṃ lekhyaṃ sthāpayetkalaśaṃ tataḥ..
mukhe vidhāya kanakaṃ rājatena vinirmitam .. 5 ..
meaning:
अग्रतोऽष्टदलं लेख्यं स्थापयेत्कलशं ततः..
मुखे विधाय कनकं राजतेन विनिर्मितम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: In front, an eight-petalled [lotus] should be drawn, and then he should place a jar, / having placed over its mouth gold, [or one] made of silver,

sanskrit_iast:
śuktiśaṃkhasamaṃ vāpi viśvāmitrasamudbhavam ..
pūjayettīrthatoyena gandhapuṣpākṣatādinā ..6..
meaning:
शुक्तिशंखसमं वापि विश्वामित्रसमुद्भवम् ..
पूजयेत्तीर्थतोयेन गन्धपुष्पाक्षतादिना ..6..
text_mt: or equal to an oyster-shell or conch, or one derived from a mother-of-pearl. / He should worship it with water from holy fords, perfumes, flowers, unbroken grains, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇukrāṃtā vacākuṣṭhacandanena viloḍitam ..
kṣīraṃ ca mātuliṃgaṃ ca sāvitraṃ ca sadūrvayā .. 7 ..
meaning:
विष्णुक्रांता वचाकुष्ठचन्दनेन विलोडितम् ..
क्षीरं च मातुलिंगं च सावित्रं च सदूर्वया .. 7 ..
text_mt: Stirred with viṣṇukrāntā, vacā, kuṣṭha, and sandalwood, / and milk, and citron, and an offering to Savitṛ together with dūrvā grass,

sanskrit_iast:
dadhyakṣataṃ madhuyutamevamarghyaṃ ca sādhayet ..
sitacandanavastrādyaiḥ śālyaiśca vividhairapi .. 8 ..
meaning:
दध्यक्षतं मधुयुतमेवमर्घ्यं च साधयेत् ..
सितचन्दनवस्त्राद्यैः शाल्यैश्च विविधैरपि .. 8 ..
text_mt: with curd, unbroken grains, and honey, he should thus prepare the respectful offering / with white sandalwood, cloth and the like, and also with various kinds of winter rice.

sanskrit_iast:
avraṇaṃ kalaśaṃ kṛtvā pañcavarṇasamanvitam ..
āvāhayettoyanidhiṃ maṃtreṇānena bhaktitaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
अव्रणं कलशं कृत्वा पञ्चवर्णसमन्वितम् ..
आवाहयेत्तोयनिधिं मंत्रेणानेन भक्तितः .. 9 ..
text_mt: Having made an unblemished jar endowed with five colours, / he should invoke the ocean with this mantra out of devotion:

sanskrit_iast:
āyāhi bhagavandeva toyamūrte jaleśvara ..
hṛdvarṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ paritoṣāya te namaḥ .. 2.2.12.10 ..
meaning:
आयाहि भगवन्देव तोयमूर्ते जलेश्वर ..
हृद्वर्णार्घ्यं मया दत्तं परितोषाय ते नमः .. 2.2.12.10 ..
text_mt: "Come, O blessed God, whose form is water, Lord of the waters! / The respectful offering according to the heart's desire has been given by me for your satisfaction. Homage to you!"

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhebhyaścaiva somāya tvaṣṭre caiva ca śūline ..
imaṃ me varuṇetyādi pratyekaṃ syādgatitrayam .. 11 ..
meaning:
गृहेभ्यश्चैव सोमाय त्वष्ट्रे चैव च शूलिने ..
इमं मे वरुणेत्यादि प्रत्येकं स्याद्गतित्रयम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: And to the houses, to Soma, to Tvaṣṭṛ, and to the trident-bearer, / with "May this of mine, O Varuṇa" and so forth, there should be three courses for each.

sanskrit_iast:
tatorghyadānaṃ vidhivatkṣīreṇa haviṣā madhu ..
yajamānaḥ sapatnīkaḥ kuṃbhaṃ kukṣau nidhāya ca..12..
meaning:
ततोर्घ्यदानं विधिवत्क्षीरेण हविषा मधु ..
यजमानः सपत्नीकः कुंभं कुक्षौ निधाय च..12..
text_mt: Then, having placed the jar at his side, the sacrificer together with his wife / [should make] the presentation of the respectful offering according to rule, with milk, clarified butter, and honey.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyagarbheti maṃtrasya bharadvājaṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ ..
chandaśca jagatī khyātaṃ devatā ca jalādhipaḥ..13..
meaning:
हिरण्यगर्भेति मंत्रस्य भरद्वाजऋषिः स्मृतः ..
छन्दश्च जगती ख्यातं देवता च जलाधिपः..13..
text_mt: Of the mantra "Hiraṇyagarbha", Bharadvāja is recorded as the seer, / the metre is known as Jagatī, and the deity is the Lord of Waters.

sanskrit_iast:
varuṇasyottaṃbhaneti maṃtrasya jalakuṃbhaṃ nivedayet ..
asya maṃtrasya ca ṛṣirnāradaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ..
virāṭchandaśca īśāno devatā samudāhṛtā ..14..
meaning:
वरुणस्योत्तंभनेति मंत्रस्य जलकुंभं निवेदयेत् ..
अस्य मंत्रस्य च ऋषिर्नारदः परिकीर्तितः ..
विराट्छन्दश्च ईशानो देवता समुदाहृता ..14..
text_mt: With the mantra "Varuṇasyottambhanam", he should offer the water jar. / Nārada is proclaimed as the seer of this mantra, / Virāj is the metre, and Īśāna is declared the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
mocayenmīnayugmaṃ ca meṣayugmaṃ tathaiva ca ..
saṃbhave pakṣiyugmaṃ ca āḍīṃ vā cakravākakam ..15..
meaning:
मोचयेन्मीनयुग्मं च मेषयुग्मं तथैव च ..
संभवे पक्षियुग्मं च आडीं वा चक्रवाककम् ..15..
text_mt: He should release a pair of fish, and likewise a pair of rams, / and if possible, a pair of birds, either an āḍī-duck or a ruddy goose.

sanskrit_iast:
mocayennāgayugmaṃ ca āyuvṛddheśca hetave ..
dikṣu jīvaṃtikāṃ dadyādrākṣasebhyo baliṃ haret .. 16 ..
meaning:
मोचयेन्नागयुग्मं च आयुवृद्धेश्च हेतवे ..
दिक्षु जीवंतिकां दद्याद्राक्षसेभ्यो बलिं हरेत् .. 16 ..
text_mt: And he should release a pair of serpents for the sake of lengthening his life. / He should offer a jīvantikā plant in the directions, and take an offering for the rākṣasas,

sanskrit_iast:
nirmitaṃ māṣabhaktena raktapuṣpairalaṃkṛtam ..
kṣātrako lakṣmaṇaścaiva maṇibhadro gaṇeśvaraḥ ..
sabiṃdukena haṃtena dikṣu madhye yathā kramāt .. 17 ..
meaning:
निर्मितं माषभक्तेन रक्तपुष्पैरलंकृतम् ..
क्षात्रको लक्ष्मणश्चैव मणिभद्रो गणेश्वरः ..
सबिंदुकेन हंतेन दिक्षु मध्ये यथा क्रमात् .. 17 ..
text_mt: prepared from black-gram cakes and adorned with red flowers. / Kṣātraka, Lakṣmaṇa, and Maṇibhadra, Lord of Ganas, / ending in the nasal dot and [the word] "hant", in the directions and in the centre, respectively.

sanskrit_iast:
ye bhavā bhāvino bhūtā ye ca teṣu mayāsinaḥ ..
āharaṃ tu baliṃ tuṣṭyā prayacchaṃtu śubhaṃ mama .. 18 ..
meaning:
ये भवा भाविनो भूता ये च तेषु मयासिनः ..
आहरं तु बलिं तुष्ट्या प्रयच्छंतु शुभं मम .. 18 ..
text_mt: "Whichever beings have been, are to be, and exist, and those who feed upon them, / may they receive the offering with satisfaction and grant me auspiciousness!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā ca baliṃ dadyānnamaskuryādanaṃtaram ..
dadyātpayasvinīṃ gāṃ ca ācāryāya viśeṣataḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा च बलिं दद्यान्नमस्कुर्यादनंतरम् ..
दद्यात्पयस्विनीं गां च आचार्याय विशेषतः .. 19 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, he should give the offering and bow immediately afterwards. / And he should give a milch cow, especially to the preceptor.

sanskrit_iast:
anyeṣāṃ hi hiraṇyaṃ ca gāṃ ca dadyāddvijanmane ..
vyāhṛtidvitayaṃ caiva tato vāruṇapaṃcakam .. 2.2.12.20 ..
meaning:
अन्येषां हि हिरण्यं च गां च दद्याद्द्विजन्मने ..
व्याहृतिद्वितयं चैव ततो वारुणपंचकम् .. 2.2.12.20 ..
text_mt: He should give gold and a cow to other twice-born ones; / and then the pair of vyāhṛtis, followed by the five Varuṇa [verses].

sanskrit_iast:
prājāpatyaṃ sviṣṭakṛcca juhuyāttadanaṃtaram ..
ghṛtaiḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ nāsti tathā rasavisārakaiḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
प्राजापत्यं स्विष्टकृच्च जुहुयात्तदनंतरम् ..
घृतैः स्विष्टकृतं नास्ति तथा रसविसारकैः .. 21 ..
text_mt: Immediately after that, he should offer the prājāpatya and the sviṣṭakṛt oblation. / There is no sviṣṭakṛt made with clarified butter, nor with fluid essences.

sanskrit_iast:
padmotpalairmātuliṃgaiḥ panasairmātuluṃgakaiḥ ..
madhūkairviśvapuṣpaiśca tathāmrātakakāśakaiḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
पद्मोत्पलैर्मातुलिंगैः पनसैर्मातुलुंगकैः ..
मधूकैर्विश्वपुष्पैश्च तथाम्रातककाशकैः .. 22 ..
text_mt: With lotuses, blue water-lilies, citrons, jackfruits, matuluṅgas, / madhūka blossoms, viśvapuṣpas, and hog-plums and kāśa grass,

sanskrit_iast:
abhiṣekaṃ tataḥ kuryātsuvāstviti ca vai japan ..
dadyātpūrṇāṃ ca vidhivatsūryāyārghyaṃ nivedayet .. 23 ..
meaning:
अभिषेकं ततः कुर्यात्सुवास्त्विति च वै जपन् ..
दद्यात्पूर्णां च विधिवत्सूर्यायार्घ्यं निवेदयेत् .. 23 ..
text_mt: he should then perform consecration while murmuring "May it be of good site". / He should offer the full oblation according to rule and present a respectful offering to Sūrya.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcadoṣaṃ puraskṛtya brāhmaṇānumatena ca ..
gṛhaṃ praviśya ca tato brāhmaṇānatha bhojayet .. 24 ..
meaning:
पञ्चदोषं पुरस्कृत्य ब्राह्मणानुमतेन च ..
गृहं प्रविश्य च ततो ब्राह्मणानथ भोजयेत् .. 24 ..
text_mt: Having redressed the fivefold fault, and with the permission of the brāhmaṇas, / he should then enter the house and feed the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇe caiva dadyādvittānusārataḥ ..
jñātibhiḥ saha bhuñjīta dadhikṣīrāmiṣaṃ vinā .. 25 ..
meaning:
दीनांधकृपणे चैव दद्याद्वित्तानुसारतः ..
ज्ञातिभिः सह भुञ्जीत दधिक्षीरामिषं विना .. 25 ..
text_mt: And he should give according to his means to the poor, the blind, and the destitute. / He should eat together with his kin, without curd, milk, and meat.

sanskrit_iast:
na kṣīraṃ ca kaṣāyaṃ ca bharjitaṃ śākameva ca ..
na kāṇḍaṃ ca na puṣpaṃ ca karīraṃ ca kadācana .. 26 ..
meaning:
न क्षीरं च कषायं च भर्जितं शाकमेव च ..
न काण्डं च न पुष्पं च करीरं च कदाचन .. 26 ..
text_mt: [One should] not [consume] milk, or astringent [food], or roasted greens, / nor stems, nor flowers, nor ever karīra sprouts.

sanskrit_iast:
śālyannaṃ mūlakaṃ caiva panasāmraphalāni ca ..
mastaṃ madhughṛtaguḍaṃ mātuliṃgaṃ sasaiṃdhavam .. 27 ..
meaning:
शाल्यन्नं मूलकं चैव पनसाम्रफलानि च ..
मस्तं मधुघृतगुडं मातुलिंगं ससैंधवम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: Rice made of winter grain, radishes, jackfruit and mangoes, / whey, honey, clarified butter, jaggery, citron with rock salt,

sanskrit_iast:
badaraṃ dhātakiphalaṃ kunda puṣpaṃ tathā tilam ..
etatpraśastaṃ jānīyānmarīcāni viśeṣataḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
बदरं धातकिफलं कुन्द पुष्पं तथा तिलम् ..
एतत्प्रशस्तं जानीयान्मरीचानि विशेषतः .. 28 ..
text_mt: jujube, dhātakī fruit, kunda flowers, and sesamum— / he should know these to be praised, especially black pepper.

sanskrit_iast:
trirātramatha saptāhaṃ parityajya khale tataḥ ..
pañcāṃgakaṃ tataḥ kuryātsthāpa yenneti yugmakam .. 29 ..
meaning:
त्रिरात्रमथ सप्ताहं परित्यज्य खले ततः ..
पञ्चांगकं ततः कुर्यात्स्थाप येन्नेति युग्मकम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: Then, having avoided the threshing floor for three nights or seven days, / he should then perform the five-limbed [rite] and should set down the pair of "neti".

sanskrit_iast:
prathamā cārkahastena dvitīyā daśahastikā ..
vitaste tu bhavecchataṃ dviguṇaṃ tadanaṃtaram .. 2.2.12.30 ..
meaning:
प्रथमा चार्कहस्तेन द्वितीया दशहस्तिका ..
वितस्ते तु भवेच्छतं द्विगुणं तदनंतरम् .. 2.2.12.30 ..
text_mt: The first is twelve cubits, the second is ten cubits; / but in spans there should be a hundred, and twice that thereafter,

sanskrit_iast:
śatārdhaṃ tataḥ paścātṣaṣṭihastamanaṃtaram .. 31 .. ..
agnihotravidhānavarṇanam
meaning:
शतार्धं ततः पश्चात्षष्टिहस्तमनंतरम् .. 31 .. ..
अग्निहोत्रविधानवर्णनम्
text_mt:
after that, half a hundred, and immediately after, sixty cubits.
Description of the rule for the agnihotra.

sanskrit_iast:
..sūta uvāca.. ..
svagṛhyāgnividhiṃ vakṣye yogabhedeṣu sattamāḥ ..
na paroktaṃ vidhānena bhayadaṃ kīrtidhvaṃsanam .. 1 ..
meaning:
..सूत उवाच.. ..
स्वगृह्याग्निविधिं वक्ष्ये योगभेदेषु सत्तमाः ..
न परोक्तं विधानेन भयदं कीर्तिध्वंसनम् .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Sūta said:
O best of men, I shall describe the rule for the fire of one's own domestic ritual according to the distinctions of yoga; / not that spoken by another according to [foreign] rule, which causes fear and destroys renown.
title: adhyāyaḥ 13

sanskrit_iast:
putrā eva ca kanyāśca janiṣyāścāpare sutāḥ ..
gṛhyā iti samākhyātā yajamānasya dāyadāḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
पुत्रा एव च कन्याश्च जनिष्याश्चापरे सुताः ..
गृह्या इति समाख्याता यजमानस्य दायदाः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Sons, daughters, and other children yet to be born— / these are called "domestic", the heirs of the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ saṃskārayāgeṣu śāntikarmakriyāsu ca ..
ācāryavihitaḥ kalpastasmāccakṣa iti smṛtaḥ .. .. 3 ..
meaning:
तेषां संस्कारयागेषु शान्तिकर्मक्रियासु च ..
आचार्यविहितः कल्पस्तस्माच्चक्ष इति स्मृतः .. .. 3 ..
text_mt: In their rites of passage, sacrifices, and rites of pacification, / the procedure is prescribed by the preceptor; therefore it is remembered as Dakṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
trikuśaṃ parigṛhṇāti tataśca kurute dṛḍham ..
ṛṣirdakṣaśca jagatī chando viṣṇuśca devatā ..4..
meaning:
त्रिकुशं परिगृह्णाति ततश्च कुरुते दृढम् ..
ऋषिर्दक्षश्च जगती छन्दो विष्णुश्च देवता ..4..
text_mt: He takes up three blades of kuśa grass and then makes them firm. / The seer is Dakṣa, the metre is Jagatī, and the deity is Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
kaśyapastṛpyatāmiti bhūrasīti ca śodhanam ..
ṛṣiḥ suvarṇa gāyatrī jagatī chanda iṣyate ..
devatā ca bhavetsūryaḥ pṛthivīśodhane nyaset .. 5 ..
meaning:
कश्यपस्तृप्यतामिति भूरसीति च शोधनम् ..
ऋषिः सुवर्ण गायत्री जगती छन्द इष्यते ..
देवता च भवेत्सूर्यः पृथिवीशोधने न्यसेत् .. 5 ..
text_mt: The purification is with "May Kaśyapa be satisfied" and "You are the earth". / Suvarṇa is the seer, Gāyatrī and Jagatī are the approved metres, / and Sūrya is the deity; one should apply them in the purification of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
aiśānyādikrameṇaiva prādakṣiṇyena yatnataḥ ..
yatpavitreti maṃtreṇa tarjanyaṃguṣṭhayorapi .. 6 ..
meaning:
ऐशान्यादिक्रमेणैव प्रादक्षिण्येन यत्नतः ..
यत्पवित्रेति मंत्रेण तर्जन्यंगुष्ठयोरपि .. 6 ..
text_mt: Beginning with the northeast, proceeding clockwise with care, / with the mantra "That which is a purifier", using the forefinger and thumb,

sanskrit_iast:
kuśagarbhatrayeṇāpi bhrāmayedvalayākṛti ..
parisamūhanamityuktaṃ snapanaṃ śṛṇu sattama .. 7 ..
meaning:
कुशगर्भत्रयेणापि भ्रामयेद्वलयाकृति ..
परिसमूहनमित्युक्तं स्नपनं शृणु सत्तम .. 7 ..
text_mt: and with three inner blades of kuśa, he should turn it in the shape of a circle. / This is called sweeping around. Listen to the ablution, O best of men.

sanskrit_iast:
īśānādeśca saṃskāraṃ kuryātparisamūhanam ..
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ caretyādinairṛtyādigrahaṃ makhe .. 8 ..
meaning:
ईशानादेश्च संस्कारं कुर्यात्परिसमूहनम् ..
प्रतिष्ठायां चरेत्यादिनैरृत्यादिग्रहं मखे .. 8 ..
text_mt: He should perform the consecration by sweeping around starting from the northeast. / In the establishment, one should proceed with "Car..." and so forth, seizing from the southwest and other [directions] in the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
parisamūhanamaindrasya parvato'sya ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ ..
paṃkticchandaḥ samuddiṣṭamindrāṇī cāsya devatā .. 9 ..
meaning:
परिसमूहनमैन्द्रस्य पर्वतोऽस्य ऋषिः स्मृतः ..
पंक्तिच्छन्दः समुद्दिष्टमिन्द्राणी चास्य देवता .. 9 ..
text_mt: Parvata is remembered as the seer of the sweeping around belonging to Indra; / the metre is declared to be Paṅkti, and Indrāṇī is its deity.

sanskrit_iast:
gomayaṃ ca trigaṃdhaṃ ca paṃcamūrtikayāpi ca ..
kaniṣṭhaṃ guhyakaṃ tyaktvā devatārthe na lepayet .. 2.2.13.10 ..
meaning:
गोमयं च त्रिगंधं च पंचमूर्तिकयापि च ..
कनिष्ठं गुह्यकं त्यक्त्वा देवतार्थे न लेपयेत् .. 2.2.13.10 ..
text_mt: Cow dung, three perfumes, and with five kinds of clay; / omitting the little finger and the thumb, he should not smear it for the sake of the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
mānastokeneti ṛcā viśvedevaśca pūjyatām ..
ṛṣiḥ syātkāśyapacchando viśvadevaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
मानस्तोकेनेति ऋचा विश्वेदेवश्च पूज्यताम् ..
ऋषिः स्यात्काश्यपच्छन्दो विश्वदेवः प्रकीर्तितः .. 11 ..
text_mt: And let the Viśvedevas be worshipped with the verse "Mā nastoke". / The seer is Kāśyapa, the metre is declared, and Viśvadeva is [the deity].

sanskrit_iast:
yojayellepayedvidvānghaṭamābaddhya sattamāḥ ..
madhyamātarjanībhyāṃ ca kuśamārabhya dakṣiṇam .. 12 ..
meaning:
योजयेल्लेपयेद्विद्वान्घटमाबद्ध्य सत्तमाः ..
मध्यमातर्जनीभ्यां च कुशमारभ्य दक्षिणम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: The wise man, having tied a pot, should apply and smear, O best of men, / with the middle and forefingers, beginning with the right kuśa grass.

sanskrit_iast:
caturastrīkṛte kṣetraṃ hastamānaṃ tathānanam ..
yajvabhiriti mantreṇa sūryaḥ prīṇāti sattamāḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
चतुरस्त्रीकृते क्षेत्रं हस्तमानं तथाननम् ..
यज्वभिरिति मन्त्रेण सूर्यः प्रीणाति सत्तमाः .. 13 ..
text_mt: When the field is made square, one cubit in measure and likewise its mouth, / Sūrya is pleased through the mantra beginning with "yajvabhiḥ", O best of men.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣe sārdhāṃgulaṃ tyaktvā paścimena parityajet ..
uttarāgrāṃ likhedrekhāmanyathā'maṃgalaṃ bhavet .. 14 ..
meaning:
दक्षे सार्धांगुलं त्यक्त्वा पश्चिमेन परित्यजेत् ..
उत्तराग्रां लिखेद्रेखामन्यथाऽमंगलं भवेत् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Leaving one and a half fingers on the right and leaving [the space] to the west, / he should draw a line with its tip to the north; otherwise, it would be inauspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
āpyāyasveti mantrasya dhanvatari ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ ..
triṣṭupchandaḥ samākhyātaṃ savitā cātra devatā .. 15 ..
meaning:
आप्यायस्वेति मन्त्रस्य धन्वतरि ऋषिः स्मृतः ..
त्रिष्टुप्छन्दः समाख्यातं सविता चात्र देवता .. 15 ..
text_mt: For the mantra "āpyāyasva", Dhanvantari is remembered as the ṛṣi; / the metre is declared to be Triṣṭubh, and Savitṛ is the deity here.

sanskrit_iast:
tallagnaṃ dakṣiṇe caikaṃ pūrvārddhadvādaśāṅgulam ..
anyāṃgulāṃtaraṃ caikaṃ tataḥ saptāṃgulaṃ bhavet .. 16 ..
meaning:
तल्लग्नं दक्षिणे चैकं पूर्वार्द्धद्वादशाङ्गुलम् ..
अन्यांगुलांतरं चैकं ततः सप्तांगुलं भवेत् .. 16 ..
text_mt: Adjoining that, on the right, [there should be] one [line] twelve fingers long in the eastern half; / another with an interval of a finger, and then [one] seven fingers long.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśamūlena svarṇena pratiṣṭhāyāṃ ca rājate ..
aṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ ca saṃjyotīti ca saṃjapan .. 17 ..
meaning:
कुशमूलेन स्वर्णेन प्रतिष्ठायां च राजते ..
अंगुष्ठानामिकाभ्यां च संज्योतीति च संजपन् .. 17 ..
text_mt: With the root of kuśa grass or with gold, and [made] of silver during a consecration, / using the thumb and the ring finger, while muttering "saṃ jyotiḥ",

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsmarenmitrā varuṇau ṛṣirautathyasaṃjñakaḥ ..
paṃktiśchandaḥ śivo devo rekhāmatha ca yojayet .. 18 ..
meaning:
संस्मरेन्मित्रा वरुणौ ऋषिरौतथ्यसंज्ञकः ..
पंक्तिश्छन्दः शिवो देवो रेखामथ च योजयेत् .. 18 ..
text_mt: he should remember Mitra and Varuṇa; the ṛṣi is named Autathya, / the metre is Paṅkti, the deity is Śiva; and then he should draw the line.

sanskrit_iast:
tenaivorddhvakarau kuryāddakṣavāme sakṛtsakṛt ..
bhāsvarāya kṣipedagnau tata ūrdhvaṃ raṇaṃ smṛtam .. 19 ..
meaning:
तेनैवोर्द्ध्वकरौ कुर्याद्दक्षवामे सकृत्सकृत् ..
भास्वराय क्षिपेदग्नौ तत ऊर्ध्वं रणं स्मृतम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: With that very [implement] he should raise his hands once to the right and once to the left; / he should cast [it] into the fire for Bhāsvara; after that, an offering is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
sadasaṃpadṛṣiḥ karṇo virāḍiti udāhṛtaḥ ..
chanda indro devatā ca pṛthivyā devatā bhavet .. 2.2.13.20 ..
meaning:
सदसंपदृषिः कर्णो विराडिति उदाहृतः ..
छन्द इन्द्रो देवता च पृथिव्या देवता भवेत् .. 2.2.13.20 ..
text_mt: For "sadasaspatiḥ", the ṛṣi is Karṇa, spoken of as Virāj; / Indra is the metre and the deity, and the Earth is the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśapuṣpodakenāpi devatīrthena sattamāḥ ..
paṃcagavyena matimānpañcaratnodakena ca ..
pañcapallavatoyena mahāyoge viśeṣataḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
कुशपुष्पोदकेनापि देवतीर्थेन सत्तमाः ..
पंचगव्येन मतिमान्पञ्चरत्नोदकेन च ..
पञ्चपल्लवतोयेन महायोगे विशेषतः .. 21 ..
text_mt: With water containing kuśa grass and flowers, with the tīrtha of the gods, O best of men, / with pañcagavya, with water containing the five gems, / and especially with water of the five sprouts in the great conjunction, the wise man [should sprinkle it].

sanskrit_iast:
athonasya ca mantrasya variṣṭhaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ..
chando'tha devī gāyatrī devatā gaṇanāyakaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
अथोनस्य च मन्त्रस्य वरिष्ठः परिकीर्तितः ..
छन्दोऽथ देवी गायत्री देवता गणनायकः .. 22 ..
text_mt: And for the mantra beginning with "atha unaḥ", Variṣṭha is proclaimed [as the ṛṣi]; / the metre is the divine Gāyatrī, and the deity is Gaṇanāyaka.

sanskrit_iast:
kīśādagniṃ samādāya me gṛhṇāmīti saṃpaṭhan ..
me gṛhṇāmīti maṃtrasya ṛṣirgautama īritaḥ ..
chandonuṣṭupsamākhyātaṃ vāmadevo'tha devatā .. 23 ..
meaning:
कीशादग्निं समादाय मे गृह्णामीति संपठन् ..
मे गृह्णामीति मंत्रस्य ऋषिर्गौतम ईरितः ..
छन्दोनुष्टुप्समाख्यातं वामदेवोऽथ देवता .. 23 ..
text_mt: Taking the fire from the kīśa, reciting "me gṛhṇāmi"— / for the mantra "me gṛhṇāmi", Gautama is declared as the ṛṣi, / the metre is declared as Anuṣṭubh, and Vāmadeva is the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
kravyādagniṃ parityajya kravyādamagnimīrayan ..
mantreṇānena matimāndakṣiṇasyāṃ vinikṣipet .. 24 ..
meaning:
क्रव्यादग्निं परित्यज्य क्रव्यादमग्निमीरयन् ..
मन्त्रेणानेन मतिमान्दक्षिणस्यां विनिक्षिपेत् .. 24 ..
text_mt: Discarding the corpse-devouring fire while uttering "kravyādam agnim", / the wise man should cast it away to the south with this mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
asya mantrasya hārīta ṛṣiḥ syācchanda iṣyate ..
devatā vāmadevo'pi dāhepi viniyojayet .. 25 ..
meaning:
अस्य मन्त्रस्य हारीत ऋषिः स्याच्छन्द इष्यते ..
देवता वामदेवोऽपि दाहेपि विनियोजयेत् .. 25 ..
text_mt: For this mantra, Hārīta is the ṛṣi, the metre is desired [as described], / and the deity is Vāmadeva; he should also employ it in cremation.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhanaṃ tataḥ kuryātsaṃsarakṣeti saṃjapan..
saṃsarakṣeti maṃtrasya ṛṣirnīla udāhṛtaḥ ..
virāṭ chando'tha vijñeyo devatā ca śatakratuḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
आवाहनं ततः कुर्यात्संसरक्षेति संजपन्..
संसरक्षेति मंत्रस्य ऋषिर्नील उदाहृतः ..
विराट् छन्दोऽथ विज्ञेयो देवता च शतक्रतुः .. 26 ..
text_mt: Then he should perform the invocation while muttering "saṃsarakṣa"; / for the mantra "saṃsarakṣa", Nīla is declared as the ṛṣi, / Virāj is to be known as the metre, and Śatakratu is the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśvānara iti ṛcā agnisthāpanamīritam..
maṃtramācāti prīṇāti ṛṣiḥ syātkāśyapaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
anuṣṭup ca bhavecchando devatā havyavāhanaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
वैश्वानर इति ऋचा अग्निस्थापनमीरितम्..
मंत्रमाचाति प्रीणाति ऋषिः स्यात्काश्यपः स्मृतः ..
अनुष्टुप् च भवेच्छन्दो देवता हव्यवाहनः .. 27 ..
text_mt: The installation of the fire is proclaimed with the verse "vaiśvānara"; / he pleases [the fire] by reciting the mantra; Kāśyapa is remembered as the ṛṣi, / Anuṣṭubh is the metre, and Havyavāhana is the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
badhnāsīti ca maṃtreṇa agniṃ kuryātpradakṣiṇam ..
ṛṣiḥ svayaṃbhūrākhyāto virāṭchanda udāhṛtam ..
devatā paramātmā ca namaskāreṇa yojayet .. .. 28 ..
meaning:
बध्नासीति च मंत्रेण अग्निं कुर्यात्प्रदक्षिणम् ..
ऋषिः स्वयंभूराख्यातो विराट्छन्द उदाहृतम् ..
देवता परमात्मा च नमस्कारेण योजयेत् .. .. 28 ..
text_mt: With the mantra "badhnāsi", he should circumambulate the fire; / the ṛṣi is declared as Svayambhū, Virāj is proclaimed as the metre, / and the deity is the Supreme Self; he should accompany it with a bow.

sanskrit_iast:
tatognidakṣiṇe bhāge prāgagrakuśakubjake ..
dvihaste bhavataścaiva hastapānāsane atha .. 29 ..
meaning:
ततोग्निदक्षिणे भागे प्रागग्रकुशकुब्जके ..
द्विहस्ते भवतश्चैव हस्तपानासने अथ .. 29 ..
text_mt: Then, on the southern side of the fire, upon kuśa grass curved with tips pointing east, / two cubits [in size] there should be, and then a seat placed by hand.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmannihopaveśyatāmiti brahmāṇaṃ viniveśayet ..
brahmayajñānṛcā dogdhrī dhenuriti tvṛcā ..2.2.13.30..
meaning:
ब्रह्मन्निहोपवेश्यतामिति ब्रह्माणं विनिवेशयेत् ..
ब्रह्मयज्ञानृचा दोग्ध्री धेनुरिति त्वृचा ..2.2.13.30..
text_mt: "O Brahmā, be seated here"—with this he should seat Brahmā; / with the verse "brahmayajñān" and with the verse "dogdhrī dhenuḥ",

sanskrit_iast:
dvābhyāmiti ca mantrābhyāmiti brahmapraveśanam..
śakro'sya trāyatāmeti śṛṇu ṛgbhyāmṛṣīdvijāḥ ..31..
meaning:
द्वाभ्यामिति च मन्त्राभ्यामिति ब्रह्मप्रवेशनम्..
शक्रोऽस्य त्रायतामेति शृणु ऋग्भ्यामृषीद्विजाः ..31..
text_mt: with these two mantras, the entry of Brahmā takes place; / "May Śakra protect him"—listen to the ṛṣis of the two verses, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpatirṛṣiśchandastriṣṭubdevo'tha śaṃkaraḥ ..
nāradaśca ṛṣiśchandastriṣṭubdevaḥ śacīpatiḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
प्रजापतिरृषिश्छन्दस्त्रिष्टुब्देवोऽथ शंकरः ..
नारदश्च ऋषिश्छन्दस्त्रिष्टुब्देवः शचीपतिः .. 32 ..
text_mt: Prajāpati is the ṛṣi, the metre is Triṣṭubh, and the deity is Śaṅkara; / and Nārada is the ṛṣi, the metre is Triṣṭubh, and the deity is the lord of Śacī.

sanskrit_iast:
agneruttarabhāge ca hastamānāṃtarepi ca ..
praṇītā sthāpanaṃ kuryāddina ehīti saṃjapan.. 33 ..
meaning:
अग्नेरुत्तरभागे च हस्तमानांतरेपि च ..
प्रणीता स्थापनं कुर्याद्दिन एहीति संजपन्.. 33 ..
text_mt: And on the northern side of the fire, at a distance of one cubit, / he should place the praṇītā vessel while muttering "dina ehi".

sanskrit_iast:
mantrasya ca ṛṣiśchando vāmadevaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
jagatī ca bhavecchando devatā ca śatakratuḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
मन्त्रस्य च ऋषिश्छन्दो वामदेवः प्रकीर्तितः ..
जगती च भवेच्छन्दो देवता च शतक्रतुः .. 34 ..
text_mt: The ṛṣi of the mantra is proclaimed to be Vāmadeva, / the metre is Jagatī, and the deity is Śatakratu.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīparṇīsahakārotthaṃ varuṇasya viśeṣataḥ ..
ṣaḍaṃgulena vistāraṃ viṃśatyaṃgulakena ca .. 35 ..
meaning:
श्रीपर्णीसहकारोत्थं वरुणस्य विशेषतः ..
षडंगुलेन विस्तारं विंशत्यंगुलकेन च .. 35 ..
text_mt: Made of śrīparṇī or sahakāra wood, especially for Varuṇa, / six fingers in breadth, and twenty fingers

sanskrit_iast:
dairghyeṇa ca catuḥkhyātakāṃgulaṃ ca pramāṇataḥ ..
dvyaṃgule carakākāyāmāsāsandevakarmaṇi .. 36 ..
meaning:
दैर्घ्येण च चतुःख्यातकांगुलं च प्रमाणतः ..
द्व्यंगुले चरकाकायामासासन्देवकर्मणि .. 36 ..
text_mt: in length, and four fingers in height by measure; / [or] two fingers [high], of round shape, seated in the divine rite.

sanskrit_iast:
abhicāre bhavetkāṃsyaṃ tāmraṃ syācchāṃtikarmaṇi ..
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ mṛnmayaṃ ca aṣṭāṃgulamathāpi vā .. 37 ..
meaning:
अभिचारे भवेत्कांस्यं ताम्रं स्याच्छांतिकर्मणि ..
प्रतिष्ठायां मृन्मयं च अष्टांगुलमथापि वा .. 37 ..
text_mt: In sorcery it should be of bell-metal; it should be copper in a pacificatory rite; / in a consecration, of clay, or eight fingers [wide],

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśāṃgulaprastāraṃ taijasaṃ mānavarjitam..
imaṃ me varuṇenarcā praṇītāmatha pūrayet .. 38 ..
meaning:
द्वादशांगुलप्रस्तारं तैजसं मानवर्जितम्..
इमं मे वरुणेनर्चा प्रणीतामथ पूरयेत् .. 38 ..
text_mt: with a width of twelve fingers, [or] metallic without measure; / he should then fill the praṇītā vessel with the verse "imaṃ me varuṇa".

sanskrit_iast:
sāgarā atha prīyaṃtāmitthamādhyānamācaret ..
sakṛdacchinnadarbheṇa digvidikṣu paristaret .. 39 ..
meaning:
सागरा अथ प्रीयंतामित्थमाध्यानमाचरेत् ..
सकृदच्छिन्नदर्भेण दिग्विदिक्षु परिस्तरेत् .. 39 ..
text_mt: "May the oceans be pleased"—thus he should meditate; / he should strew [the area] in the cardinal and intermediate directions with darbha grass cut once.

sanskrit_iast:
nairṛte dikṣu sītaḥ syādvaiśvadeve tathaiva ca ..
kayā naścitra ityṛcā nāgaḥ prīṇāti sattamāḥ .. 2.2.13.40 ..
meaning:
नैरृते दिक्षु सीतः स्याद्वैश्वदेवे तथैव च ..
कया नश्चित्र इत्यृचा नागः प्रीणाति सत्तमाः .. 2.2.13.40 ..
text_mt: In the south-western directions it should be white, and likewise in the Vaiśvadeva; / with the verse "kayā naś citraḥ", the serpent is pleased, O best of men.

sanskrit_iast:
asya maṃtrasya ca ṛṣirbharadvāja udāhṛtaḥ ..
chando'nuṣṭubdevatā ca īśānaḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
अस्य मंत्रस्य च ऋषिर्भरद्वाज उदाहृतः ..
छन्दोऽनुष्टुब्देवता च ईशानः परिकीर्तितः .. 41 ..
text_mt: For this mantra, Bharadvāja is declared as the ṛṣi, / the metre is Anuṣṭubh, and the deity is proclaimed to be Īśāna.

sanskrit_iast:
prayojanādikaṃ dravyaṃ tata āsādayetkramāt ..
dakṣiṇādi uttarāṃtaṃ dhuvāsa ityṛcāpi ca .. 42 ..
meaning:
प्रयोजनादिकं द्रव्यं तत आसादयेत्क्रमात् ..
दक्षिणादि उत्तरांतं धुवास इत्यृचापि च .. 42 ..
text_mt: Then he should set down the requisite substances in order, / from the south ending at the north, also with the verse "dhuvāsa".

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiḥ syānnāradaśchandonuṣṭupcaivātha devatā ..
śatakratuśca prīṇāti yojayedatha sādarāt .. 43 ..
meaning:
ऋषिः स्यान्नारदश्छन्दोनुष्टुप्चैवाथ देवता ..
शतक्रतुश्च प्रीणाति योजयेदथ सादरात् .. 43 ..
text_mt: The ṛṣi is Nārada, the metre is Anuṣṭubh, and the deity / Śatakratu is pleased; he should employ it with reverence.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṣṭhaṃ ca paścime kuryātprayacchanpaścimena tu ..
purato'nnaṃ pañcavrīhīstilāśca sahasarṣapān .. 44 ..
meaning:
काष्ठं च पश्चिमे कुर्यात्प्रयच्छन्पश्चिमेन तु ..
पुरतोऽन्नं पञ्चव्रीहीस्तिलाश्च सहसर्षपान् .. 44 ..
text_mt: He should place the firewood in the west, offering it from the west; / in front, food, the five grains, sesamum seeds together with mustard seeds,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇe caiva āpūpaṃ bhṛṃgarājaṃ tathaiva ca ..
phalapatre vāmabhāge piṣṭakaṃ dadhi dugdhakam .. 45 ..
meaning:
दक्षिणे चैव आपूपं भृंगराजं तथैव च ..
फलपत्रे वामभागे पिष्टकं दधि दुग्धकम् .. 45 ..
text_mt: and on the right cake and also bhṛṅgarāja; / on the left side, fruits and leaves, pastry, curd, and milk,

sanskrit_iast:
panasaṃ nārikelaṃ ca modakaṃ laḍḍukaṃ tathā ..
praṇītāṃ ca digvidikṣu sthāpayedavicārayan .. 46 ..
meaning:
पनसं नारिकेलं च मोदकं लड्डुकं तथा ..
प्रणीतां च दिग्विदिक्षु स्थापयेदविचारयन् .. 46 ..
text_mt: jackfruit, coconut, modaka sweets, and likewise laddu; / and without hesitation he should place the praṇītā vessel in the directions and intermediate directions.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇītāṃ na spṛśejjātu homakāle kathaṃcana ..
snānakuṃbhaṃ ca bho viprā yāvadyāgaḥ pravartate .. 47 ..
meaning:
प्रणीतां न स्पृशेज्जातु होमकाले कथंचन ..
स्नानकुंभं च भो विप्रा यावद्यागः प्रवर्तते .. 47 ..
text_mt: He must never touch the praṇītā vessel at the time of the homa under any circumstance, / nor the bathing pot, O brāhmaṇas, as long as the sacrifice proceeds.

sanskrit_iast:
uccīrakaṃ mātuliṃgaṃ dūrvāṃ dhātrīphalāni ca ..
tulasīmālatījātī jalajāni viśeṣataḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
उच्चीरकं मातुलिंगं दूर्वां धात्रीफलानि च ..
तुलसीमालतीजाती जलजानि विशेषतः .. 48 ..
text_mt: Uccīraka, mātuliṅga, dūrvā grass, dhātrī fruits, / tulasī, mālatī, jasmine, and especially aquatic flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
aiśānyāṃ sthāpayetsarvaṃ yacca vai kaṃkatīmayam ..
nairṛtyeti viśeṣoyaṃ yacca vaikaṃkatī śamī .. 49 ..
meaning:
ऐशान्यां स्थापयेत्सर्वं यच्च वै कंकतीमयम् ..
नैरृत्येति विशेषोयं यच्च वैकंकती शमी .. 49 ..
text_mt: he should place everything in the north-east, and whatever is made of kaṅkatī wood; / in the south-west—this is the distinction—whatever is of vikaṅkata and śamī wood.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāyogena tatsarvaṃ grāhyaṃ tatpatrameva ca ..
kṣīrapāke tu kṣīrāṃte carusthālīmathānayet .. 2.2.13.50 ..
meaning:
यथायोगेन तत्सर्वं ग्राह्यं तत्पत्रमेव च ..
क्षीरपाके तु क्षीरांते चरुस्थालीमथानयेत् .. 2.2.13.50 ..
text_mt: All that should be taken appropriately, and its leaves as well; / when cooking with milk, after the milk [is boiled], he should then bring the pot for the caru.

sanskrit_iast:
pavivacchedanakuśaiśchiṃdyātprādeśikaṃ punaḥ ..
chittvā pavitraṃ prokṣaṇyāṃ sthāpayedbalabhidāmrakam .. 51 ..
meaning:
पविवच्छेदनकुशैश्छिंद्यात्प्रादेशिकं पुनः ..
छित्त्वा पवित्रं प्रोक्षण्यां स्थापयेद्बलभिदाम्रकम् .. 51 ..
text_mt: With kuśa grass for cutting the purifier, he should cut [a blade] of a span's length; / having cut the purifier, he should place the Balabhid mango leaf in the sprinkling vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇo rarāṭamaṃtreṇa chedayedagrabhāgataḥ ..
pāyasena kāṭhinena pramathnīyātkadācana .. 52 ..
meaning:
विष्णो रराटमंत्रेण छेदयेदग्रभागतः ..
पायसेन काठिनेन प्रमथ्नीयात्कदाचन .. 52 ..
text_mt: With the mantra "viṣṇo rarāṭam", he should cut it from the tip; / he should never stir it with firm milk-rice,

sanskrit_iast:
na rasena na kārṣṇena na dṛḍhena kadācana ..
tāmreṇa bhasmanā cātha śuktiśaṃkhena vāgyataḥ ..53..
meaning:
न रसेन न कार्ष्णेन न दृढेन कदाचन ..
ताम्रेण भस्मना चाथ शुक्तिशंखेन वाग्यतः ..53..
text_mt: nor with juice, nor with iron, nor ever with something harsh; / [he should clean it] with copper, ash, and with a pearl oyster shell or conch, restrained in speech.

sanskrit_iast:
chedayetpiñjulīṃ cāpi pavitramatha deśikaḥ..
viṣṇo rarāṭamaṃtrasya hārītaśca ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
छेदयेत्पिञ्जुलीं चापि पवित्रमथ देशिकः..
विष्णो रराटमंत्रस्य हारीतश्च ऋषिः स्मृतः .. 54 ..
text_mt:
The spiritual teacher should also cut the bunch of grass and the purifying strainer.
The seer of the mantra 'viṣṇo rarāṭam' is remembered as Hārīta;

sanskrit_iast:
paṃktiśchaṃdo bhaveddevaḥ saṃskāre viniyojayet ..
praṇītābhājanaṃ gṛhya prokṣaṇīṃ pūrayettribhiḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
पंक्तिश्छंदो भवेद्देवः संस्कारे विनियोजयेत् ..
प्रणीताभाजनं गृह्य प्रोक्षणीं पूरयेत्त्रिभिः .. 55 ..
text_mt:
the meter is paṅkti, and he should employ it in the consecration of the deity.
Taking the praṇītā vessel, he should fill the prokṣaṇī vessel in three [pours].

sanskrit_iast:
kāyatīrthena tatkuryāddevatīrthena cetyapi ..
vāmahastatale paścātsthāpayetprokṣaṇīyakam .. 56 ..
meaning:
कायतीर्थेन तत्कुर्याद्देवतीर्थेन चेत्यपि ..
वामहस्ततले पश्चात्स्थापयेत्प्रोक्षणीयकम् .. 56 ..
text_mt:
He should do that through the tīrtha of Ka (Prajāpati) or through the tīrtha of the gods.
Afterwards, he should place the prokṣaṇī vessel upon the palm of his left hand.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyamāmadhyamāṃguṣṭha apāmārgeṇa maṃtribhiḥ ..
uttānaṃ tatpavitraṃ ca pavitraṃ teti saṃjapan .. 57 ..
meaning:
मध्यमामध्यमांगुष्ठ अपामार्गेण मंत्रिभिः ..
उत्तानं तत्पवित्रं च पवित्रं तेति संजपन् .. 57 ..
text_mt:
With the middle fingers and thumbs [holding] with Apāmārga, the mantras
recited while keeping that purifying strainer upward, murmuring 'pavitraṃ te':

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiḥ syādgautamaśchando dharmarājo'tha devatā ..
atha sthāpitadravyāṇi prokṣayetsthāpayetkramāt .. 58 ..
meaning:
ऋषिः स्याद्गौतमश्छन्दो धर्मराजोऽथ देवता ..
अथ स्थापितद्रव्याणि प्रोक्षयेत्स्थापयेत्क्रमात् .. 58 ..
text_mt:
The seer is Gautama, the meter is [triṣṭubh], and the deity is Dharmarāja.
Then he should sprinkle the arranged materials and place them in due order:

sanskrit_iast:
sakṛddravye tribhiḥ kāṣṭhaistrivāraṃ maṃtrapuṣpakaiḥ ..
sthirasthāne tu saṃprāptapraṇītāyāśca dakṣiṇe .. 59 ..
meaning:
सकृद्द्रव्ये त्रिभिः काष्ठैस्त्रिवारं मंत्रपुष्पकैः ..
स्थिरस्थाने तु संप्राप्तप्रणीतायाश्च दक्षिणे .. 59 ..
text_mt:
once upon the articles, with three pieces of wood, [and] thrice with flowers accompanied by mantras.
In a stable place, to the south of the praṇītā vessel that has been positioned,

sanskrit_iast:
prādeśāṃtarataścaiva ājyasthālīmathārpayet ..
agrato maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā vahniṃ vipre tu sthāpayet .. 2.2.13.60 ..
meaning:
प्रादेशांतरतश्चैव आज्यस्थालीमथार्पयेत् ..
अग्रतो मण्डलं कृत्वा वह्निं विप्रे तु स्थापयेत् .. 2.2.13.60 ..
text_mt:
at a span's distance, he should place the ghee-pan.
Having made a diagram in front, he should establish the fire, O brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
dyūtaṃ niḥsārayettattu nirūpyāśu krameṇa tu ..
īśāneti ca maṃtreṇa adhiśrapaṇamīritam ..61..
meaning:
द्यूतं निःसारयेत्तत्तु निरूप्याशु क्रमेण तु ..
ईशानेति च मंत्रेण अधिश्रपणमीरितम् ..61..
text_mt:
Having inspected it swiftly in due order, he should remove the dust.
With the mantra 'īśāna...', placing [the vessel] on the fire is enjoined.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣirnārāyaṇaśchandaḥ paṃktirīśo'tha devatā..
paryagnikaraṇaṃ kuryādādarāddvayamapyatha .. 62 ..
meaning:
ऋषिर्नारायणश्छन्दः पंक्तिरीशोऽथ देवता..
पर्यग्निकरणं कुर्यादादराद्द्वयमप्यथ .. 62 ..
text_mt:
The seer is Nārāyaṇa, the meter is paṅkti, and the deity is Īśa.
He should then attentively carry out the encircling with fire for both [vessels].

sanskrit_iast:
avekṣya īśamārabhya dakṣiṇāvartakena tu ..
kulāyanīti maṃtreṇa ṛṣicchandādikaṃ smaran .. 63 ..
meaning:
अवेक्ष्य ईशमारभ्य दक्षिणावर्तकेन तु ..
कुलायनीति मंत्रेण ऋषिच्छन्दादिकं स्मरन् .. 63 ..
text_mt:
Having inspected [it] beginning from the northeast in a clockwise direction,
with the mantra 'kulāyani...', remembering the seer, meter, and so forth,

sanskrit_iast:
pariveṣyājyasthālīṃ ca triḥ sakṛdvā samāhitaḥ ..
pitarastṛpyatāmiti saṃskāre mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ .. 64 ..
meaning:
परिवेष्याज्यस्थालीं च त्रिः सकृद्वा समाहितः ..
पितरस्तृप्यतामिति संस्कारे मातरः स्मृताः .. 64 ..
text_mt:
focused in mind, he should surround the ghee-pan thrice or once.
Reciting 'pitaras tṛpyatām', the Mothers are remembered in the consecration.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiḥ syājjamadagniśca gāyatrī chanda īritam ..
devatā ca pinākī syādagniṣṭome ca yojayet .. 65 ..
meaning:
ऋषिः स्याज्जमदग्निश्च गायत्री छन्द ईरितम् ..
देवता च पिनाकी स्यादग्निष्टोमे च योजयेत् .. 65 ..
text_mt:
The seer is Jamadagni, the meter is stated to be gāyatrī,
and the deity is Pinākin; he should employ it in the Agniṣṭoma.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtasya ca tathā tvaṃ no brahmā vai tṛpyatāmiti ..
ṣaḍaṃgulaṃ sruvaṃ paścādgṛhītvāgnau pratapya ca .. 66 ..
meaning:
घृतस्य च तथा त्वं नो ब्रह्मा वै तृप्यतामिति ..
षडंगुलं स्रुवं पश्चाद्गृहीत्वाग्नौ प्रतप्य च .. 66 ..
text_mt:
And likewise of the clarified butter, 'tvaṃ no...' and 'brahmā vai tṛpyatām'.
Afterwards, having taken a six-finger sruva and heated it over the fire—

sanskrit_iast:
trirātraṃ tu mahāyoge sakṛdanyatra sattamāḥ ..
saṃmārjayetkuśenāpi mūlādagraṃ tu secayet .. 67 ..
meaning:
त्रिरात्रं तु महायोगे सकृदन्यत्र सत्तमाः ..
संमार्जयेत्कुशेनापि मूलादग्रं तु सेचयेत् .. 67 ..
text_mt:
for three nights in a great rite, but only once elsewhere, O best of men—
he should wipe it with kuśa grass and sprinkle it from the root to the tip.

sanskrit_iast:
agrānmūlaṃ punaḥ kuryātsaṃpūjya ca punaḥ punaḥ ..
tribhistribhiḥ praṇītode prokṣayettadanaṃtaram .. 68 ..
meaning:
अग्रान्मूलं पुनः कुर्यात्संपूज्य च पुनः पुनः ..
त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः प्रणीतोदे प्रोक्षयेत्तदनंतरम् .. 68 ..
text_mt:
He should do so again from the tip to the root, worshipping it again and again.
Immediately afterwards, he should sprinkle it thrice with water from the praṇītā.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuvaṃ punaḥ pratapyātha prokṣaṇyuttarato nyaset ..
ājyapātraṃ puraskṛtya pavitraṃ ca samāharet ..69..
meaning:
भुवं पुनः प्रतप्याथ प्रोक्षण्युत्तरतो न्यसेत् ..
आज्यपात्रं पुरस्कृत्य पवित्रं च समाहरेत् ..69..
text_mt:
Having heated the earth again, he should place [the sruva] north of the prokṣaṇī.
Bringing the ghee-vessel forward, he should take up the purifying strainer.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃguṣṭhe dve anāme tu gṛhṇīyāttatpavitrakam ..
aṣṭāṃgulaṃ madhyakṛtvo ghṛtaṃ triḥ pavanaṃ caret ..2.2.13.70..
meaning:
अंगुष्ठे द्वे अनामे तु गृह्णीयात्तत्पवित्रकम् ..
अष्टांगुलं मध्यकृत्वो घृतं त्रिः पवनं चरेत् ..2.2.13.70..
text_mt:
He should hold that purifying strainer between both thumbs and ring fingers.
Placing [it] eight fingers in the middle, he should perform the purification of the clarified butter thrice.

sanskrit_iast:
pātāle tristathākāśe avekṣyājyaṃ tatastribhiḥ ..
prokṣaṇyāṃ ca tathā kuryādadhaḥ saṃprokṣya deśikaḥ .. 71 ..
meaning:
पाताले त्रिस्तथाकाशे अवेक्ष्याज्यं ततस्त्रिभिः ..
प्रोक्षण्यां च तथा कुर्यादधः संप्रोक्ष्य देशिकः .. 71 ..
text_mt:
Having inspected the ghee thrice downward and thrice upward in the sky,
the spiritual teacher should do the same in the prokṣaṇī vessel, sprinkling underneath.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pāyasamādāya utthāya ca samantra kam ..
tūṣṇīṃ dadyāttathā cāgnau sanniveśena tattvataḥ .. 72 ..
meaning:
ततः पायसमादाय उत्थाय च समन्त्र कम् ..
तूष्णीं दद्यात्तथा चाग्नौ सन्निवेशेन तत्त्वतः .. 72 ..
text_mt:
Then, having taken the pāyasa and stood up with the mantra,
he should silently offer it into the fire with proper placement according to truth.

sanskrit_iast:
sapavitraṃ dakṣakare gṛhītvā prokṣaṇīyakam ..
aṣṭāṃgule mūlabhāge tajjalena īśāditaḥ .. 73..
meaning:
सपवित्रं दक्षकरे गृहीत्वा प्रोक्षणीयकम् ..
अष्टांगुले मूलभागे तज्जलेन ईशादितः .. 73..
text_mt:
Holding the prokṣaṇī vessel with the purifying strainer in his right hand,
with that water, for eight finger-breadths from the base, beginning from the northeast,

sanskrit_iast:
agniṃ paryukṣayetpaścāddakṣiṇāvartakena ca ..
pavitraṃ ca praṇītāyāṃ nidhāya prokṣaṇīyakam .. 74 ..
meaning:
अग्निं पर्युक्षयेत्पश्चाद्दक्षिणावर्तकेन च ..
पवित्रं च प्रणीतायां निधाय प्रोक्षणीयकम् .. 74 ..
text_mt:
he should then sprinkle around the fire in a clockwise direction.
Placing the purifying strainer and the prokṣaṇī in the praṇītā,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃyāvārthaṃ ca bho viprā agnivattatra deśikaḥ ..
dhyāyedagniṃ raktavarṇaṃ sruvahastaṃ tribāhukam .. 75 ..
meaning:
संयावार्थं च भो विप्रा अग्निवत्तत्र देशिकः ..
ध्यायेदग्निं रक्तवर्णं स्रुवहस्तं त्रिबाहुकम् .. 75 ..
text_mt:
for the sake of the flour-paste offering, O brāhmaṇas, the teacher there, becoming like fire,
should meditate upon fire as red in color, holding a sruva, having three arms,

sanskrit_iast:
kamaṃḍaluṃ pare haste tato dakṣakareṇa tu ..
sruvaṃ gṛhītvā juhuyāttūṣṇīmeva samāhitaḥ .. 76 ..
meaning:
कमंडलुं परे हस्ते ततो दक्षकरेण तु ..
स्रुवं गृहीत्वा जुहुयात्तूष्णीमेव समाहितः .. 76 ..
text_mt:
with a water-pot in his other hand. Then, with his right hand,
having taken the sruva, he should offer silently, fully concentrated.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃte ca devatoddeśaṃ prājāpatyaṃ samīrayan ..
praṇavāṃtena juhuyātsarvatra dvijasattamāḥ .. 77 ..
meaning:
अंते च देवतोद्देशं प्राजापत्यं समीरयन् ..
प्रणवांतेन जुहुयात्सर्वत्र द्विजसत्तमाः .. 77 ..
text_mt:
At the end, pronouncing the dedication to the deity sacred to Prajāpati,
he should offer ending with the praṇava everywhere, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyukoṇaṃ samārabhya vahnikoṇāntakena tu ..
acchinnena ghṛtenaiva indrāya tadanaṃtaram .. 78 ..
meaning:
वायुकोणं समारभ्य वह्निकोणान्तकेन तु ..
अच्छिन्नेन घृतेनैव इन्द्राय तदनंतरम् .. 78 ..
text_mt:
Beginning from the northwest corner and ending at the southeast corner,
with an unbroken stream of clarified butter, he should then offer to Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
agnīṣomātmakaṃ caiva juhuyādrākṣasāditaḥ ..
aiśānakoṇaparyaṃtaṃ tato naimittikaṃ caret .. 79 ..
meaning:
अग्नीषोमात्मकं चैव जुहुयाद्राक्षसादितः ..
ऐशानकोणपर्यंतं ततो नैमित्तिकं चरेत् .. 79 ..
text_mt:
And he should offer [the portion] sacred to Agni and Soma beginning from the southwest corner
up to the northeast corner; then he should perform the occasional rite.

sanskrit_iast:
paścātsviṣṭaṃ tato dadyāddadyācca matibhistathā ..
vāruṇaṃ pañcakaṃ caiva kṛtvā pūrṇāṃ tato labhet .. 2.2.13.80 ..
meaning:
पश्चात्स्विष्टं ततो दद्याद्दद्याच्च मतिभिस्तथा ..
वारुणं पञ्चकं चैव कृत्वा पूर्णां ततो लभेत् .. 2.2.13.80 ..
text_mt:
Afterwards he should offer the sviṣṭakṛt; and he should offer according to his understanding.
Having performed the set of five rites to Varuṇa, he obtains the full offering.

sanskrit_iast:
udvāha iti maṃtra sya atharvaṇa ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ ..
chaṃdo devī ca gāyatrī devataṃ cāpi vāruṇam .. 81 ..
meaning:
उद्वाह इति मंत्र स्य अथर्वण ऋषिः स्मृतः ..
छंदो देवी च गायत्री देवतं चापि वारुणम् .. 81 ..
text_mt:
The seer of the mantra 'udvāha...' is remembered as Atharvan;
the meter is divine gāyatrī, and the deity is Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛte yojayenmantrī stutau cāpi niyojayet ..
tvannogna iti maṃtrasya ṛṣirvāśiṣṭhasaṃjñakaḥ ..
chaṃdaśca bṛhatī khyātaṃ tadevāgniḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 82 ..
meaning:
प्रकृते योजयेन्मन्त्री स्तुतौ चापि नियोजयेत् ..
त्वन्नोग्न इति मंत्रस्य ऋषिर्वाशिष्ठसंज्ञकः ..
छंदश्च बृहती ख्यातं तदेवाग्निः प्रकीर्तितः .. 82 ..

sanskrit_iast:
iḍo gatamiti mantrasya ṛṣiḥ ko guhyasaṃjñakaḥ ..
chandaśca jagatī khyātaṃ devo viṣṇuḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 83 ..
meaning:
इडो गतमिति मन्त्रस्य ऋषिः को गुह्यसंज्ञकः ..
छन्दश्च जगती ख्यातं देवो विष्णुः प्रकीर्तितः .. 83 ..
text_mt:
The seer of the mantra 'iḍo gatam...' is the one named Guhya;
the meter is celebrated as jagatī, and the deity is proclaimed to be Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
udvartana iti maṃtrasya ṛṣiḥ ko nu prakīrtitaḥ ..
chando devī ca gāyatrī varuṇaścādhidevatā ..84..
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe madhyamaparvaṇi dvitīyabhāge trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 13 .. ..
makhavidhānavarṇanam
meaning:
उद्वर्तन इति मंत्रस्य ऋषिः को नु प्रकीर्तितः ..
छन्दो देवी च गायत्री वरुणश्चाधिदेवता ..84..
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे मध्यमपर्वणि द्वितीयभागे त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः .. 13 .. ..
मखविधानवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Who indeed is proclaimed as the seer of the mantra 'udvartana...'?
The meter is divine gāyatrī, and Varuṇa is the presiding deity.
Thus ends the thirteenth chapter in the second part of the Madhyamaparvan in the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the sacrificial procedure

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
makhe sarvatra brahmāṇamṛtvijaṃ varayedatha ..
kuśakaṇḍīṃ svagṛhyena kṛtvāgniṃ cārcayettataḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
मखे सर्वत्र ब्रह्माणमृत्विजं वरयेदथ ..
कुशकण्डीं स्वगृह्येन कृत्वाग्निं चार्चयेत्ततः .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Sūta said:
In every sacrifice, one should then choose the priest as Brahmā.
Having performed the kuśakaṇḍī according to one's own Gṛhyasūtra, one should then worship the fire.
title: adhyāyaḥ 14

sanskrit_iast:
āghārājyabhāgau tu mahāvyāhṛtayastrayaḥ ..
sarvaṃ prāyaścittasaṃjñakaṃ prājāpatyaṃ ca sviṣṭakṛt .. 2 ..
meaning:
आघाराज्यभागौ तु महाव्याहृतयस्त्रयः ..
सर्वं प्रायश्चित्तसंज्ञकं प्राजापत्यं च स्विष्टकृत् .. 2 ..
text_mt:
The two continuous ghee libations, the two butter portions, the three great mystical utterances,
the complete atonement rite, the offering to Prajāpati, and the sviṣṭakṛt offering:

sanskrit_iast:
etannityaṃ hi sarvatra home karmaṇi nirdiśet ..
prājāpatye ca indrāya etāvāghārasaṃjñakau .. 3 ..
meaning:
एतन्नित्यं हि सर्वत्र होमे कर्मणि निर्दिशेत् ..
प्राजापत्ये च इन्द्राय एतावाघारसंज्ञकौ .. 3 ..
text_mt:
One must assign this as regular in every homa rite:
the two to Prajāpati and to Indra are known as the two continuous ghee libations;

sanskrit_iast:
agnaye caiva somāya ājyabhāgau prakīrtitau..
bhūrbhuvaḥsvastrayaścaiva mahāvyāhṛtayaḥ smṛtāḥ ..4..
meaning:
अग्नये चैव सोमाय आज्यभागौ प्रकीर्तितौ..
भूर्भुवःस्वस्त्रयश्चैव महाव्याहृतयः स्मृताः ..4..
text_mt:
the two butter portions are proclaimed to be for Agni and for Soma;
and the three, bhūr, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ, are remembered as the great mystical utterances.

sanskrit_iast:
ayāścāgne iti tathā ye te śatamanuttamam ..
sarvaprāyaścittasaṃjñā ete vai pañca maṃtrakāḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
अयाश्चाग्ने इति तथा ये ते शतमनुत्तमम् ..
सर्वप्रायश्चित्तसंज्ञा एते वै पञ्च मंत्रकाः .. 5 ..
text_mt:
The mantras 'ayāścāgne...' and the supreme 'ye te śatam...':
these five mantras are indeed designated as the complete atonement.

sanskrit_iast:
prājāpatyāhutiścaikā sviṣṭakṛccāparā smṛtā ..
caturdaśaitāḥ kṛtayo hotavyā nityasaṃjñakāḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
प्राजापत्याहुतिश्चैका स्विष्टकृच्चापरा स्मृता ..
चतुर्दशैताः कृतयो होतव्या नित्यसंज्ञकाः .. 6 ..
text_mt:
One oblation is to Prajāpati, and another is remembered as sviṣṭakṛt.
These fourteen actions are to be offered as the regular rites.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā sakṛddevatoddeśaṃ homaṃ paścātsamācaret ..
somapā ye ca goyāge naramedhāśvamedhayoḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा सकृद्देवतोद्देशं होमं पश्चात्समाचरेत् ..
सोमपा ये च गोयागे नरमेधाश्वमेधयोः .. 7 ..
text_mt:
Having made the dedication of the deity once, he should subsequently perform the homa.
Those who drink Soma in a cattle sacrifice, in a human sacrifice, or in a horse sacrifice,

sanskrit_iast:
anyatra viparītena svāhāṃtena hunedbudhaḥ ..
naimittikaṃ vinā nityaṃ viphalaṃ yāti nānyathā .. .. 8 ..
meaning:
अन्यत्र विपरीतेन स्वाहांतेन हुनेद्बुधः ..
नैमित्तिकं विना नित्यं विफलं याति नान्यथा .. .. 8 ..
text_mt:
elsewhere, the wise man should offer in the reverse manner ending with 'svāhā'.
Without the occasional rite, the regular rite becomes fruitless, not otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ varjyaṃ śatārdhena vaiśvadeve tathaiva ca ..
tryahasādhyādiyāgeṣu yannideśaṃ śṛṇu dvijāḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
नित्यं वर्ज्यं शतार्धेन वैश्वदेवे तथैव च ..
त्र्यहसाध्यादियागेषु यन्निदेशं शृणु द्विजाः .. 9 ..
text_mt:
The regular rite is to be omitted in fifty oblations, and likewise in the Vaiśvadeva.
In sacrifices accomplished over three days and so forth, hear the instruction, O twice-born:

sanskrit_iast:
ekāhe vāghārārajyau kṛtvā naimittikīṃ kṛtīḥ ..
samā sviṣṭakṛtaṃ vidyādākṛtyādyāstataḥ param .. 2.2.14.10 ..
meaning:
एकाहे वाघारारज्यौ कृत्वा नैमित्तिकीं कृतीः ..
समा स्विष्टकृतं विद्यादाकृत्याद्यास्ततः परम् .. 2.2.14.10 ..
text_mt:
In a one-day rite, having performed the two continuous libations and two butter portions, [then] the occasional actions,
one should know the sviṣṭakṛt is equal, and beyond that, the ākṛti offerings and others.

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣatastryahādau tu aghārāvājyapūrvakam ..
paścānnaimittikaṃ kuryātsamāptidivase pyatha .. 11 ..
meaning:
विशेषतस्त्र्यहादौ तु अघारावाज्यपूर्वकम् ..
पश्चान्नैमित्तिकं कुर्यात्समाप्तिदिवसे प्यथ .. 11 ..
text_mt:
Especially in a three-day rite and the like, the two continuous libations preceded by the butter portions [are performed];
and on the day of completion, he should afterwards perform the occasional rite.

sanskrit_iast:
āghārārājyapūrveṇa tato naimittikaṃ caret ..
sviṣṭakṛdvyāhṛtiścaiva vāruṇādyāstathā hi ṣaṭ .. 12 ..
meaning:
आघाराराज्यपूर्वेण ततो नैमित्तिकं चरेत् ..
स्विष्टकृद्व्याहृतिश्चैव वारुणाद्यास्तथा हि षट् .. 12 ..
text_mt: After preceding with the two libations of clarified butter, he should then perform the occasional [rite], / as well as the Sviṣṭakṛt, the vyāhṛtis, and the six [offerings] beginning with Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijātiḥ patito yatra dvitrikaṃ ca catuścatuḥ ..
ekasmindivase kuryātsomayāge ca śaiśave .. 13 ..
meaning:
द्विजातिः पतितो यत्र द्वित्रिकं च चतुश्चतुः ..
एकस्मिन्दिवसे कुर्यात्सोमयागे च शैशवे .. 13 ..
text_mt: Where a twice-born has fallen, or two or three or four at a time, / he should perform [it] on one day, and in a Soma sacrifice, and in childhood.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijātīnāṃ vivāhe tu naityikaṃ prathamaṃ bhavet ..
ekasmindivase kuryādagnikāryaṃ pṛthakpṛthak .. 14 ..
meaning:
द्विजातीनां विवाहे तु नैत्यिकं प्रथमं भवेत् ..
एकस्मिन्दिवसे कुर्यादग्निकार्यं पृथक्पृथक् .. 14 ..
text_mt: At the marriage of twice-born [men], the daily [rite] comes first; / he should perform the fire-rites separately on a single day.

sanskrit_iast:
dadyādekaṃ ca nityaṃ ca pṛthaṅ nityaṃ na cācaret ..
dvijātiḥ patito yatra dvitrikaṃ ca catuścatuḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
दद्यादेकं च नित्यं च पृथङ् नित्यं न चाचरेत् ..
द्विजातिः पतितो यत्र द्वित्रिकं च चतुश्चतुः .. 15 ..
text_mt: He should perform one daily [rite] and should not perform [them] separately each day; / where a twice-born has fallen, or two, three, or four at a time,

sanskrit_iast:
ekasmindivase kuryāttatrāpi naittikaṃ tyajet ..
home brahmā stute viṣṇuḥ sruve caiva maheśvaraḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
एकस्मिन्दिवसे कुर्यात्तत्रापि नैत्तिकं त्यजेत् ..
होमे ब्रह्मा स्तुते विष्णुः स्रुवे चैव महेश्वरः .. 16 ..
text_mt: he should perform [it] on a single day, and even there he should omit the daily [rite]. / Brahmā is [present] in the fire-offering, Viṣṇu in praise, and Maheśvara in the sruva-ladle;

sanskrit_iast:
ajasyāniyame cendro'dhiśrayaṇaṃ vivasvataḥ ..
paryagnikaraṇe caiva udvāhe mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
अजस्यानियमे चेन्द्रोऽधिश्रयणं विवस्वतः ..
पर्यग्निकरणे चैव उद्वाहे मातरः स्मृताः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Indra is [present] in the unconstrained [movement] of the goat, the placing on the fire belongs to Vivasvat; / in the carrying of fire around [the offering], and at marriage, the Mothers are remembered [to be present];

sanskrit_iast:
candrādityau cotpavane vīkṣaṇe ca diśastathā ..
prokṣaṇyāṃ sthāpane durgā ime lakṣmī pratiṣṭhitā .. 18 ..
meaning:
चन्द्रादित्यौ चोत्पवने वीक्षणे च दिशस्तथा ..
प्रोक्षण्यां स्थापने दुर्गा इमे लक्ष्मी प्रतिष्ठिता .. 18 ..
text_mt: the Moon and the Sun are in the purifying of clarified butter, and likewise the directions in the inspecting; / Durgā is in the water for sprinkling and its setting down; in these, Lakṣmī is established.

sanskrit_iast:
homaṃ kuryāddvijaśreṣṭhā vidhiṃ kuryātsamāhitaḥ..
eteṣu devatāḥ proktā dvijātīnāṃ hitāya ca..19..
meaning:
होमं कुर्याद्द्विजश्रेष्ठा विधिं कुर्यात्समाहितः..
एतेषु देवताः प्रोक्ता द्विजातीनां हिताय च..19..
text_mt: The best of twice-born should make the fire-offering, collected in mind, he should perform the rite. / The deities have been proclaimed in these [rites] for the welfare of twice-born men.

sanskrit_iast:
yajetsupaśubaddheṣu saṃskāre caiva parvaṇi ..
devatāḥ sarvā jñātavyā etā yajñe samāhitaiḥ ..2.2.14.20..
meaning:
यजेत्सुपशुबद्धेषु संस्कारे चैव पर्वणि ..
देवताः सर्वा ज्ञातव्या एता यज्ञे समाहितैः ..2.2.14.20..
text_mt: He should sacrifice when animals are properly bound, and at a life-cycle rite, and on a parvan day; / all these deities must be known in the sacrifice by those who are collected in mind.

sanskrit_iast:
adhidaivena jānīyātkaravalyāṃ paṃcaphalaṃ yataḥ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena devatāmatha vinyaset ..21..
devadhyānavarṇanam
meaning:
अधिदैवेन जानीयात्करवल्यां पंचफलं यतः..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन देवतामथ विन्यसेत् ..21..
देवध्यानवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Since five fruits are obtained in the open palm through the presiding deity, / therefore he should install the deity with every effort.
Description of the Meditation on the Deities

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
atha vakṣyāmi saccaiṣāṃ devānāṃ dhyānamuttamam ..
asya yajñe parijñānājjihvā samyakphalapradā ..1..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अथ वक्ष्यामि सच्चैषां देवानां ध्यानमुत्तमम् ..
अस्य यज्ञे परिज्ञानाज्जिह्वा सम्यक्फलप्रदा ..1..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Now I shall tell the true and supreme meditation upon these gods; / through knowledge of this in a sacrifice, the tongue [of fire] properly grants fruit.
title: adhyāyaḥ 15

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyavarṇāṃ prathamāṃ vahnijihvāṃ mahādyutim ..
kanakāḍhyakarāṃ devīṃ hiraṇyākhyeṣṭasiddhaye .. 2 ..
meaning:
हिरण्यवर्णां प्रथमां वह्निजिह्वां महाद्युतिम् ..
कनकाढ्यकरां देवीं हिरण्याख्येष्टसिद्धये .. 2 ..
text_mt: For the attainment of one's desired [goals] by the name of Hiraṇyā, / [one should meditate on] the first tongue of fire, of golden hue, exceedingly splendid, a goddess whose hands abound with gold;

sanskrit_iast:
kanakāṃ dvibhujāṃ śuklāṃ hastābhyāṃ darbhasaṃyutām ..
kamaṃḍaluṃ ca bibhrāṇāṃ numaḥ sādhakasiddhidām .. 3 ..
meaning:
कनकां द्विभुजां शुक्लां हस्ताभ्यां दर्भसंयुताम् ..
कमंडलुं च बिभ्राणां नुमः साधकसिद्धिदाम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: we praise [the tongue] Kanakā, two-armed, white, having darbha-grass in both hands / and bearing a water-pot, who grants success to the practitioner;

sanskrit_iast:
udyadindunibhāṃ raktāṃ caturbhirbhujapa llavaiḥ ..
śaṃkhacakrābhayavarāndadhatīṃ praṇamāmyaham .. 4 ..
meaning:
उद्यदिन्दुनिभां रक्तां चतुर्भिर्भुजप ल्लवैः ..
शंखचक्राभयवरान्दधतीं प्रणमाम्यहम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: I bow to [the tongue] resembling the rising moon, red, bearing conch, / discus, boon, and fearlessness with her four branch-like arms;

sanskrit_iast:
bhinnāṃjanacayaprakhyāṃ svarṇakuṃbhaṃ tu vāmataḥ ..
dakṣiṇena varāraktāṃ dhārayaṃtīṃ namāmyaham .. 9 ..
meaning:
भिन्नांजनचयप्रख्यां स्वर्णकुंभं तु वामतः ..
दक्षिणेन वरारक्तां धारयंतीं नमाम्यहम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: I bow to [the tongue] resembling a heap of crushed collyrium, holding a golden jar on her left, / and with her right [hand] granting boons and red;

sanskrit_iast:
suprabhāmaṇḍalābhā ca karābhyāṃ tatkṛtāñjaliḥ ..
padmāsanasthā kauśeyavasanā me prasīdatu .. 6 ..
meaning:
सुप्रभामण्डलाभा च कराभ्यां तत्कृताञ्जलिः ..
पद्मासनस्था कौशेयवसना मे प्रसीदतु .. 6 ..
text_mt: and Suprabhā, radiant with a halo of light, her hands forming an añjali, / seated on a lotus throne and clothed in silk garments, may she be pleased with me;

sanskrit_iast:
japākusumasaṃkāśā bahurūpā sakhe mama ..
śubhadā syādbhujaiḥ śubhrā sahasraṃ dadhatī parān .. 7 ..
meaning:
जपाकुसुमसंकाशा बहुरूपा सखे मम ..
शुभदा स्याद्भुजैः शुभ्रा सहस्रं दधती परान् .. 7 ..
text_mt: resembling a hibiscus flower, multiform, O friend, / bearing a thousand supreme [weapons] with her arms, white, may she grant auspiciousness to me;

sanskrit_iast:
nīlotpalanibhe devi vahnivarṇaparābhave ..
japāpuṣpadhare nityaṃ satīrūpe prasīda me .. 8 ..
meaning:
नीलोत्पलनिभे देवि वह्निवर्णपराभवे ..
जपापुष्पधरे नित्यं सतीरूपे प्रसीद मे .. 8 ..
text_mt: O goddess resembling a blue lotus, outshining the colour of fire, / ever holding a hibiscus flower, having the form of Satī, be pleased with me.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlena vīkṣayetsthānaṃ maṃtreṇa khananaṃ matam ..
trisūtrīkaraṇaṃ kuryāccatuḥsūtraṃ nipātayet .. 9 .. ..
devadhyānavidhānavarṇanam
meaning:
मूलेन वीक्षयेत्स्थानं मंत्रेण खननं मतम् ..
त्रिसूत्रीकरणं कुर्याच्चतुःसूत्रं निपातयेत् .. 9 .. ..
देवध्यानविधानवर्णनम्
text_mt:
He should inspect the site with the root-mantra; the digging is considered [to be done] with a mantra; / he should perform the threefold cord-laying, [and] cast down the four cords.
Description of the Injunction for Meditation on the Deities

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
pratiṣṭhāyāḥ pūrvadine kuryāddevādhivāsanam ..
dhānyapratiṣṭhāṃ tasyaiva yūpaṃ cāpi yathāvidhi .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
प्रतिष्ठायाः पूर्वदिने कुर्याद्देवाधिवासनम् ..
धान्यप्रतिष्ठां तस्यैव यूपं चापि यथाविधि .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / On the day preceding the consecration, one should perform the preliminary sanctification of the deity, / the consecration of grains for it, and also the sacrificial post according to the rule.
title: adhyāyaḥ 16

sanskrit_iast:
rātrau mūlāgre ca ghaṭe sthāpayedgaṇanāyakam ..
saṃpūjya ca vidhānena digīśāṃśca tathā grahān .. 2 ..
meaning:
रात्रौ मूलाग्रे च घटे स्थापयेद्गणनायकम् ..
संपूज्य च विधानेन दिगीशांश्च तथा ग्रहान् .. 2 ..
text_mt: At night, he should install Gaṇanāyaka at the tip of the base and in a jar; / and having worshipped the lords of the directions and likewise the planets according to the rule,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇaṃ ca taḍāgeṣu varuṇaṃ śāntiyāgake ..
somaṃ ca maṃḍale sūryaṃ pāde viṣṇuṃ tathaiva ca .. 3 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्माणं च तडागेषु वरुणं शान्तियागके ..
सोमं च मंडले सूर्यं पादे विष्णुं तथैव च .. 3 ..
text_mt: and Brahmā at ponds, Varuṇa in a peaceful rite, / Soma in a maṇḍala, Sūrya at the foot, and likewise Viṣṇu;

sanskrit_iast:
śaive śaivaṃ tathā proktaṃ prapāyāmatha vāruṇam ..
ārāme caiva brahmāṇaṃ pādyādyairapi cārcayet .. 4 ..
meaning:
शैवे शैवं तथा प्रोक्तं प्रपायामथ वारुणम् ..
आरामे चैव ब्रह्माणं पाद्याद्यैरपि चार्चयेत् .. 4 ..
text_mt: in a Śaiva [temple], the Śaiva [deity] is thus stated, and Varuṇa at a water-shed; / and Brahmā in a grove; he should worship them with water for the feet and so forth.

sanskrit_iast:
drupadādīti mantreṇa snāpayetprathamaṃ budhaḥ ..
gāyatryā ca tataḥ paścādgandhadvāreti tailakam .. 5 ..
meaning:
द्रुपदादीति मन्त्रेण स्नापयेत्प्रथमं बुधः ..
गायत्र्या च ततः पश्चाद्गन्धद्वारेति तैलकम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: The wise man should first bathe [the image] with the mantra beginning with ‘Drupadā’; / and thereafter with the Gāyatrī, [and apply] oil with ‘Gandhadvārā’.

sanskrit_iast:
sunābheti ca maṃtreṇa dvābhyāmeva viśiṣyate ..
śrīśca te iti kusumaṃ phalinīti ca vai phalam .. 6 ..
meaning:
सुनाभेति च मंत्रेण द्वाभ्यामेव विशिष्यते ..
श्रीश्च ते इति कुसुमं फलिनीति च वै फलम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: With the mantra ‘Sunābhā’, [the rite] is distinguished with two [mantras]; / a flower with ‘Śrīś ca te’, and a fruit with ‘Phalinī’;

sanskrit_iast:
kāṃḍāditi ca maṃtreṇa dadyāddūrvāśataṃ tataḥ ..
siṃdoriveti siṃdūraṃ viśvāmiti ca mārjanam .. 7 ..
meaning:
कांडादिति च मंत्रेण दद्याद्दूर्वाशतं ततः ..
सिंदोरिवेति सिंदूरं विश्वामिति च मार्जनम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: then he should offer a hundred dūrvā-blades with the mantra beginning with ‘Kāṇḍāt’; / vermilion with ‘Sindhor iva’, and cleansing with ‘Viśvām’.

sanskrit_iast:
samicchetyañjanaṃ dadyādduḥsthaṃ surāsurā japan ..
candanaṃ yajvabhirjaptvā mānastoketi candanam .. 8 ..
meaning:
समिच्छेत्यञ्जनं दद्याद्दुःस्थं सुरासुरा जपन् ..
चन्दनं यज्वभिर्जप्त्वा मानस्तोकेति चन्दनम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: With ‘Samicchā’ he should apply collyrium, reciting [it when] gods and asuras are distressed; / sandalwood having been recited by the sacrificers, sandalwood with ‘Mā nastoke’.

sanskrit_iast:
yūpe caiva viśeṣoyamuttarāgraṃ pravinyaset ..
adyaiva tena maṃtreṇa sthāpayedatha vāriṇā .. 9 ..
meaning:
यूपे चैव विशेषोयमुत्तराग्रं प्रविन्यसेत् ..
अद्यैव तेन मंत्रेण स्थापयेदथ वारिणा .. 9 ..
text_mt: And on the sacrificial post, this is the particular [rule]: he should place the tip pointing north; / he should then install [it] with water, with that mantra, on that very day.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatryā prathamaṃ caiva āpo hiṣṭheti vai japan ..
śanno devīti drupadāṃ snāpayettadanantaram .. 2.2.16.10 ..
meaning:
गायत्र्या प्रथमं चैव आपो हिष्ठेति वै जपन् ..
शन्नो देवीति द्रुपदां स्नापयेत्तदनन्तरम् .. 2.2.16.10 ..
text_mt: First with the Gāyatrī and indeed reciting ‘Āpo hi ṣṭhā’, / [and] ‘Śaṁ no devī’, he should immediately bathe [it] with the Drupadā-verse.

sanskrit_iast:
abhimantryātha brahmeti trirātraṃ maṃtramīrayan ..
yogaṃ yogadṛḍhaṃ japtvā pavitraṃ vinyasettataḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
अभिमन्त्र्याथ ब्रह्मेति त्रिरात्रं मंत्रमीरयन् ..
योगं योगदृढं जप्त्वा पवित्रं विन्यसेत्ततः .. 11 ..
text_mt: Then having consecrated [it] with ‘Brahma’, uttering the mantra for three nights, / having recited ‘Yogaṁ yoga-dṛḍham’, he should then place the purifier.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ gandharveti mantreṇa tathā subhābha ityapi ..
dvābhyāṃ tailagaṃdhayutaṃ śrīsūktenāpi puṣpakam .. 12 ..
meaning:
त्वं गन्धर्वेति मन्त्रेण तथा सुभाभ इत्यपि ..
द्वाभ्यां तैलगंधयुतं श्रीसूक्तेनापि पुष्पकम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: With the mantra ‘Tvaṁ gandharva’, and likewise ‘Subhābhaḥ’, / with both, [he offers] oil mixed with perfume, and also a flower with the Śrīsūkta;

sanskrit_iast:
dhūrasīti ca tathā dhūpamāsrajyotirbhirdīpakam ..
anumīmahatāti dadyāddūrvākṣataṃ tataḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
धूरसीति च तथा धूपमास्रज्योतिर्भिर्दीपकम् ..
अनुमीमहताति दद्याद्दूर्वाक्षतं ततः .. 13 ..
text_mt: and likewise incense with ‘Dhūr asi’, a lamp with ‘Āsrajyotirbhiḥ’; / he should then offer unbroken grain mixed with dūrvā with ‘Anumīmahatā’.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāmīti ca nimnyaṃtakāṃḍāditi tathākṣatam ..
siṃdoriveti sindūraṃ samidheti tathāñjanam .. 14 ..
meaning:
विश्वामीति च निम्न्यंतकांडादिति तथाक्षतम् ..
सिंदोरिवेति सिन्दूरं समिधेति तथाञ्जनम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: And with ‘Viśvāmī’, down to the depths, likewise unbroken grain with ‘Kāṇḍāt’; / vermilion with ‘Sindhor iva’, and likewise collyrium with ‘Samidhā’.

sanskrit_iast:
pādo'syetyatha bhuktaṃ syādyāḥ phalinīti punaḥ phalam ..
rūpaṃ neti dahedrūpaṃ na sociti ca pūjanam .. 15 ..
meaning:
पादोऽस्येत्यथ भुक्तं स्याद्याः फलिनीति पुनः फलम् ..
रूपं नेति दहेद्रूपं न सोचिति च पूजनम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: With ‘Pādo ’sya’ there is food, again fruit with ‘Yāḥ phalinīḥ’; / with ‘Rūpaṁ na’ he should burn away the form, and worship with ‘Na sociḥ’.

sanskrit_iast:
yuvā suvāseti vastraṃ nāgagandheti candanam ..
tato yamagṛhādbāhye maṇḍapāṃtaramāśritaḥ ..16..
meaning:
युवा सुवासेति वस्त्रं नागगन्धेति चन्दनम् ..
ततो यमगृहाद्बाह्ये मण्डपांतरमाश्रितः ..16..
text_mt: Garments with ‘Yuvā suvāsāḥ’, and sandalwood with ‘Nāgagandhā’; / then, having gone outside the chamber of Yama into another pavilion,

sanskrit_iast:
sunātīti vaco dadyāttataścāvāhayetprabhum ..
tatrādhivāsanaṃ kuryādrakṣayecca surakṣibhiḥ ..17..
meaning:
सुनातीति वचो दद्यात्ततश्चावाहयेत्प्रभुम् ..
तत्राधिवासनं कुर्याद्रक्षयेच्च सुरक्षिभिः ..17..
text_mt: he should speak the words ‘Sunāti’ and then invoke the Lord; / there he should perform the preliminary sanctification and protect [it] with excellent protectors.

sanskrit_iast:
ācāryo yajamānaśca ṛtvigbhojanamācaret ..
akṣāralavaṇānyāsī dadhi viśvaṃ tilāṃstyajet ..18..
meaning:
आचार्यो यजमानश्च ऋत्विग्भोजनमाचरेत् ..
अक्षारलवणान्यासी दधि विश्वं तिलांस्त्यजेत् ..18..
text_mt: The preceptor, the patron of the sacrifice, and the officiating priest should take their meal; / eating foods without alkali or salt, he should avoid curd, all [spices], and sesamum seeds.

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāraṇaṃ cādhivāsaṃ vakṣye tatrānusārataḥ ..
sunāteti vaco dadyāttailaṃ caiva śive tribhiḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
आधारणं चाधिवासं वक्ष्ये तत्रानुसारतः ..
सुनातेति वचो दद्यात्तैलं चैव शिवे त्रिभिः .. 19 ..
text_mt: I shall state the holding and the preliminary sanctification according to that [tradition]: / he should speak the word ‘Sunātā’ and [offer] oil to Śiva with three [verses];

sanskrit_iast:
pañcabhirbrāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ gandharvā iti vismaran ..
dadyādgandhaṃ tailayutaṃ gandhadvāretyṛcā punaḥ .. 2.2.16.20 ..
meaning:
पञ्चभिर्ब्राह्मणैः सार्धं गन्धर्वा इति विस्मरन् ..
