दद्याद्गन्धं तैलयुतं गन्धद्वारेत्यृचा पुनः .. 2.2.16.20 ..
text_mt: together with five brāhmaṇas, reciting ‘Gandharvāḥ’, / he should again offer perfume mixed with oil with the verse ‘Gandhadvārā’.

sanskrit_iast:
yāḥ phalinīti ca phalaṃ pūgatānāmavarjanam ..
kauśikīruttamosīti dadyātkhaḍgaṃ sutīkṣṇakam .. 21 ..
meaning:
याः फलिनीति च फलं पूगतानामवर्जनम् ..
कौशिकीरुत्तमोसीति दद्यात्खड्गं सुतीक्ष्णकम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: And fruit with ‘Yāḥ phalinīḥ’, without omitting betel-nuts; / with ‘Kauśikīr uttamo ’si’ he should present a very sharp sword;

sanskrit_iast:
rūpena veti mantreṇa mudgaraṃ ca nivedayet ..
śrīśca te iti kusumaṃ viśvānīti ca saṃpaṭhan .. 22 ..
meaning:
रूपेन वेति मन्त्रेण मुद्गरं च निवेदयेत् ..
श्रीश्च ते इति कुसुमं विश्वानीति च संपठन् .. 22 ..
text_mt: and with the mantra ‘Rūpeṇa vā’ he should offer a club; / [and offer] a flower with ‘Śrīś ca te’, reciting ‘Viśvāni’.

sanskrit_iast:
nirmathanaṃ tataḥ kāryamiti sādhāraṇo vidhiḥ ..
tatodhivāsakalpe tu pradeśe tu samācaret .. 23 ..
meaning:
निर्मथनं ततः कार्यमिति साधारणो विधिः ..
ततोधिवासकल्पे तु प्रदेशे तु समाचरेत् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Then churning [of the fire] should be performed; this is the common rule. / Then, in the procedure of preliminary sanctification, he should perform [it] in that place.

sanskrit_iast:
vinādhivāsanaṃ viprāḥ pratiṣṭhānaṃ samācaret ..
na tatphalamavāpnoti vivāhe śaraṇaṃ diśet .. 24 ..
meaning:
विनाधिवासनं विप्राः प्रतिष्ठानं समाचरेत् ..
न तत्फलमवाप्नोति विवाहे शरणं दिशेत् .. 24 ..
text_mt: If one performs an installation without preliminary consecration, O Brahmins, / one does not attain its fruit, [just as] in marriage one should assign refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prayatnataḥ kāryaṃ pūrvāhne rātriyogataḥ ..
nitye naimittike kāmye kārayetkuṇḍamaṇḍapam .. 25 ..
meaning:
ततः प्रयत्नतः कार्यं पूर्वाह्ने रात्रियोगतः ..
नित्ये नैमित्तिके काम्ये कारयेत्कुण्डमण्डपम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Therefore it must be performed with effort in the morning in conjunction with the night. / In an obligatory, occasional, or optional rite, one should cause a sacrificial pit and pavilion to be constructed.

sanskrit_iast:
sthaṃḍile hasta mātreṇa vālukānirmite'pi ca ..
trayodaśāṃgule haste dvihaste cāpi varddhate .. 26 ..
meaning:
स्थंडिले हस्त मात्रेण वालुकानिर्मितेऽपि च ..
त्रयोदशांगुले हस्ते द्विहस्ते चापि वर्द्धते .. 26 ..
text_mt: On an altar of one cubit, even when made of sand, / it increases at thirteen angulas, at a cubit, and at two cubits.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikāṃgulako viprāḥ pīṭhe nāsti vicāraṇā ..
navapañcaka kuṇḍe ca lakṣādāvapi śaṃkayā .. 27 ..
meaning:
एकैकांगुलको विप्राः पीठे नास्ति विचारणा ..
नवपञ्चक कुण्डे च लक्षादावपि शंकया .. 27 ..
text_mt: It is one angula at a time on the pedestal, O Brahmins, of that there is no doubt, / and in a sacrificial pit of nine or five, even at a hundred thousand and so on, out of caution.

sanskrit_iast:
tato daśāṃgule pakṣe daśāṃgaṃ śṛṇuta dvijāḥ ..
kāṣṭhaṃ pattraṃ ca puṣpaṃ ca modakaṃ piṣṭakaṃ tathā .. 28 ..
meaning:
ततो दशांगुले पक्षे दशांगं शृणुत द्विजाः ..
काष्ठं पत्त्रं च पुष्पं च मोदकं पिष्टकं तथा .. 28 ..
text_mt: Then, in the ten-angula category, listen, O twice-born ones, to the ten components: / wood, a leaf, a flower, a sweetmeat, and likewise a pastry,

sanskrit_iast:
annaṃ ca paramānnaṃ ca hyavekṣyaṃ tilameva ca ..
etadvai gṛhapakṣe ca viṣṇupakṣe tilāditaḥ..29..
meaning:
अन्नं च परमान्नं च ह्यवेक्ष्यं तिलमेव च ..
एतद्वै गृहपक्षे च विष्णुपक्षे तिलादितः..29..
text_mt: cooked grain, sweet rice, clarifying butter, and sesamum. / This is indeed in the domestic category; in the category of Viṣṇu, [it begins] with sesamum and the rest;

sanskrit_iast:
śaive yavāditaḥ kāryā śākte puṣpādito bhavet ..
sūrye pakṣe piṣṭakādi gopāle kṛśarāditaḥ .. 2.2.16.30 ..
meaning:
शैवे यवादितः कार्या शाक्ते पुष्पादितो भवेत् ..
सूर्ये पक्षे पिष्टकादि गोपाले कृशरादितः .. 2.2.16.30 ..
text_mt: in the category of Śiva, it should be done beginning with barley; in that of Śakti, it should begin with flowers; / in the category of Sūrya, beginning with pastry; in that of Gopāla, beginning with spiced rice;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇe ca karavīrādi śrīphalāni ca traipure ..

devadhyānavarṇanam
meaning:

सारस्वते च श्रीवृक्षे मोक्षकामे निगद्यते .. 31 .. ..

and in that of Kṛṣṇa, oleander and the rest; and bilva fruits in that of Tripurā; / and in that of Sarasvatī, on the śrīvṛkṣa tree, it is prescribed for one desiring liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
aṣṭau hotāro dvārapālāthāṣṭau aṣṭau kāryā brāhmaṇā yājakāśca ..
sarve śuddhā lakṣitā lakṣaṇādyairekaḥ kāryo jāpakosminmahātmā .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अष्टौ होतारो द्वारपालाथाष्टौ अष्टौ कार्या ब्राह्मणा याजकाश्च ..

text_mt: Sūta said: / Eight hotṛ priests and eight door-keepers, and eight officiating Brahmins are to be employed. / All must be pure and endowed with auspicious marks and the like; in this [rite], one great-souled man should be appointed as a reciter.
title: adhyāyaḥ 17

sanskrit_iast:
divyairgaṃdhairgaṃdhamālyaiḥ suvarṇaistailaṃ kāryaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ pañcaviṃśāḥ ..
āvāpyaistu dviguṇairvai balīyo divyairvastrairarhaṇādakṣiṇābhiḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
दिव्यैर्गंधैर्गंधमाल्यैः सुवर्णैस्तैलं कार्यं ब्राह्मणाः पञ्चविंशाः ..
आवाप्यैस्तु द्विगुणैर्वै बलीयो दिव्यैर्वस्त्रैरर्हणादक्षिणाभिः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Twenty-five Brahmins should be anointed with oil, with divine scents, fragrant garlands, and gold, / or indeed doubly potent with additional [items], with divine garments, worship, and priestly fees.

sanskrit_iast:
nārhayitvā yathoktena kaścitpatraṃ niveśayet ..
anarhiteṣu vipreṣu na samyakphalamāpnuyāt .. 3 ..
meaning:
नार्हयित्वा यथोक्तेन कश्चित्पत्रं निवेशयेत् ..
अनर्हितेषु विप्रेषु न सम्यक्फलमाप्नुयात् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Without worshipping them according to what has been declared, no one should place a leaf. / When the Brahmins are not worshipped, one does not obtain the full fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhādiṣu sarveṣu samyagviprānathārhayet ..
kuśadvijaṃ tu sarvatra arghyaṃ viṣṭaramātrakam .. 4 ..
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठादिषु सर्वेषु सम्यग्विप्रानथार्हयेत् ..
कुशद्विजं तु सर्वत्र अर्घ्यं विष्टरमात्रकम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: In all rites such as installations, one should duly worship the Brahmins. / A kuśa-grass Brahmin [should receive] the water offering and a seat everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
pradadyādarhaṇaṃ samyakpaścātpātraṃ nivedayet ..
vinārhaṇaṃ kṛte tasminnarake paripacyate .. 5 ..
meaning:
प्रदद्यादर्हणं सम्यक्पश्चात्पात्रं निवेदयेत् ..
विनार्हणं कृते तस्मिन्नरके परिपच्यते .. 5 ..
text_mt: One should duly present the worship, and afterwards offer the vessel. / If it is done without worship, one is cooked in hell.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyekaṃ brāhmaṇā yajñe vedamantreṣu pāragāḥ ..
ācāryo yadi kāryeṣu varayeddaśa govrajān .. 6 ..
meaning:
प्रत्येकं ब्राह्मणा यज्ञे वेदमन्त्रेषु पारगाः ..
आचार्यो यदि कार्येषु वरयेद्दश गोव्रजान् .. 6 ..
text_mt: In the sacrifice, each of the Brahmins should be fully versed in Vedic mantras. / If the ācārya should select [them] in the rites, [let him choose] ten owners of herds of cattle.

sanskrit_iast:
viśiṣṭānāmabhāve'pi kuryātkuśamayāndvijān ..
kuśapratikṛtau cāpi svagotraṃ svaṃ dvijaṃ vinā .. 7 ..
meaning:
विशिष्टानामभावेऽपि कुर्यात्कुशमयान्द्विजान् ..
कुशप्रतिकृतौ चापि स्वगोत्रं स्वं द्विजं विना .. 7 ..
text_mt: Even in the absence of qualified [men], one should make twice-borns of kuśa grass. / But in an effigy of kuśa grass, without one's own lineage and one's own twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
na kuryāccaraṇoddeśaṃ tathā praharasaṃhatim ..
gotrādikīrtanāṃteṣu svanāmoddeśamīrayan .. 8 ..
meaning:
न कुर्याच्चरणोद्देशं तथा प्रहरसंहतिम् ..
गोत्रादिकीर्तनांतेषु स्वनामोद्देशमीरयन् .. 8 ..
text_mt: one should not make mention of the Vedic branch nor the aggregate of hours, / uttering the mention of one's own name at the end of the proclamation of the lineage and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
tulāpuruṣadāne ca tathā ca hāṭakācale ..
kanyādāne tathotsarge kīrtayetpravarādikam .. 9 ..
meaning:
तुलापुरुषदाने च तथा च हाटकाचले ..
कन्यादाने तथोत्सर्गे कीर्तयेत्प्रवरादिकम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: In the gift of the weight of a man, and likewise in that of a mountain of gold, / in the gift of a maiden, and likewise in a consecration, one should proclaim the ancestral lineage and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
na pātraṃ pratikṛtyarthaṃ na cālaṃ sodakaṃ tathā ..
mṛtabhāryyo hyabhāryaśca aputro mṛtaputrakaḥ .. 2.2.17.10 ..
meaning:
न पात्रं प्रतिकृत्यर्थं न चालं सोदकं तथा ..
मृतभार्य्यो ह्यभार्यश्च अपुत्रो मृतपुत्रकः .. 2.2.17.10 ..
text_mt: Neither an effigy nor an insufficient one with water is an [acceptable] recipient. / One whose wife has died, or one who is wifeless, or childless, or whose children have died,

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrasaṃskārakaścaiva kṛpaṇo gaṇayājakaḥ ..
prāyaścittagṛhītaśca rājayājakapaiśunau .. 11 ..
meaning:
शूद्रसंस्कारकश्चैव कृपणो गणयाजकः ..
प्रायश्चित्तगृहीतश्च राजयाजकपैशुनौ .. 11 ..
text_mt: one who performs sacraments for Śūdras, a miser, one who sacrifices for a multitude, / one who has undertaken an expiation, one who sacrifices for a king, a slanderer,

sanskrit_iast:
śūdragehanivāsī ca śūdrapreraka eva ca ..
svalpakaṇṭho vāmanaśca vṛṣalīpatireva ca .. 12 ..
meaning:
शूद्रगेहनिवासी च शूद्रप्रेरक एव च ..
स्वल्पकण्ठो वामनश्च वृषलीपतिरेव च .. 12 ..
text_mt: one who dwells in the house of a Śūdra, and one who acts at the instigation of a Śūdra, / one with a defective throat, a dwarf, and the husband of a Śūdra woman,

sanskrit_iast:
bandhudveṣī gurudveṣī bhāryādveṣī tathaiva ca ..
hīnāṃgaścaiva vṛddhāṃgo bhagnadaṃtaśca dāṃbhikaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
बन्धुद्वेषी गुरुद्वेषी भार्याद्वेषी तथैव च ..
हीनांगश्चैव वृद्धांगो भग्नदंतश्च दांभिकः .. 13 ..
text_mt: one who hates his relatives, one who hates his guru, and likewise one who hates his wife, / one with a missing limb, one with an excess limb, one with broken teeth, a hypocrite,

sanskrit_iast:
pratigrāhī ca kunakhaḥ pāradārika eva ca ..
śvitrī kuṣṭhī kulodbhūto nidrālurvyasanārthakaḥ ..14..
meaning:
प्रतिग्राही च कुनखः पारदारिक एव च ..
श्वित्री कुष्ठी कुलोद्भूतो निद्रालुर्व्यसनार्थकः ..14..
text_mt: one who accepts improper gifts, one with deformed nails, an adulterer, / one with vitiligo, a leper, [even if] well-born, a sluggard, one devoted to vices,

sanskrit_iast:
adīkṣitaḥ kadaryaśca caṃḍarogī galadvraṇaḥ ..
mahāvraṇī ca udarī yajñapātraṃ na kārayet .. 15 ..
meaning:
अदीक्षितः कदर्यश्च चंडरोगी गलद्व्रणः ..
महाव्रणी च उदरी यज्ञपात्रं न कारयेत् .. 15 ..
text_mt: one who is uninitiated, a miser, one with a fierce disease, one with an ulcer on the throat, / one with severe ulcers, and one with dropsy—one should not make [any of these] a recipient at a sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
varaṇāṃte tu pātrāṇāṃ pūjāmantrāñchṛṇu dvija ..
pratimantreṇa gandhādyairarcayenmantravittamaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
वरणांते तु पात्राणां पूजामन्त्राञ्छृणु द्विज ..
प्रतिमन्त्रेण गन्धाद्यैरर्चयेन्मन्त्रवित्तमः .. 16 ..
text_mt: At the conclusion of the selection of the recipients, listen, O twice-born, to the worship mantras. / The foremost knower of mantras should worship with scents and the rest, using each respective mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmamūrtistvamācāryaḥ saṃsārātpāhi māṃ vibho ..
tvatprasādādguro yajñaṃ prāptosmi yanmayepsitam ... .. 17 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्ममूर्तिस्त्वमाचार्यः संसारात्पाहि मां विभो ..
त्वत्प्रसादाद्गुरो यज्ञं प्राप्तोस्मि यन्मयेप्सितम् ... .. 17 ..
text_mt: ‘You, the ācārya, are the embodiment of Brahmā; protect me from saṃsāra, O Lord. / By your grace, O guru, I have obtained the sacrifice that was desired by me.

sanskrit_iast:
ciraṃ me śāśvatī kīrtiryāvallokāścarācarāḥ ..
prasīda tvaṃ maheśāna pratiṣṭhākarmasiddhaye .. 18 ..
meaning:
चिरं मे शाश्वती कीर्तिर्यावल्लोकाश्चराचराः ..
प्रसीद त्वं महेशान प्रतिष्ठाकर्मसिद्धये .. 18 ..
text_mt: May my eternal fame endure for a long time, as long as the worlds of mobile and immobile beings exist. / Be gracious, O Great Lord, for the success of the installation rite.

sanskrit_iast:
tvamādiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ saṃsārārṇava tārakaḥ ..
jñānāmṛtapradācāryo yajurveda namo'stu te .. 19 ..
meaning:
त्वमादिः सर्वभूतानां संसारार्णव तारकः ..
ज्ञानामृतप्रदाचार्यो यजुर्वेद नमोऽस्तु ते .. 19 ..
text_mt: You are the origin of all beings, the savior across the ocean of saṃsāra. / The ācārya who grants the nectar of knowledge, O Yajurveda, obeisance to you!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇaiva samudbhūta prakāśitadigantara ..
śuddhajāṃbūnadaprakhya yajurveda namo'stu te .. 2.2.17.20 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मणैव समुद्भूत प्रकाशितदिगन्तर ..
शुद्धजांबूनदप्रख्य यजुर्वेद नमोऽस्तु ते .. 2.2.17.20 ..
text_mt: Arisen from Brahmā himself, illuminator of the intermediate quarters, / resembling pure Jambūnada gold, O Yajurveda, obeisance to you!

sanskrit_iast:
prataptakanakābhāsa bhāsitadyutibhūtala ..
mantraprakhyānasaṃsthāna yajurveda namo'stu te .. 21 ..
meaning:
प्रतप्तकनकाभास भासितद्युतिभूतल ..
मन्त्रप्रख्यानसंस्थान यजुर्वेद नमोऽस्तु ते .. 21 ..
text_mt: Having the luster of molten gold, illuminating the earth with your radiance, / the abode for the manifestation of mantras, O Yajurveda, obeisance to you!

sanskrit_iast:
praphullakanakābhāsa bhāsvarāsurabhūṣita ..
prakīrṇamantrasaṃbhāravidhijña praṇato'smi te .. 22 ..
meaning:
प्रफुल्लकनकाभास भास्वरासुरभूषित ..
प्रकीर्णमन्त्रसंभारविधिज्ञ प्रणतोऽस्मि ते .. 22 ..
text_mt: Having the luster of blooming gold, adorned by radiant beings, / knower of the rules for the scattered collection of mantras, I am bowed to you.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍaṃgavedavedajña ṛtviṅgamokṣaprado bhava ..
praviśya maṇḍalaṃ viprā svasthāne sthāpayetkramāt .. 23 ..
meaning:
षडंगवेदवेदज्ञ ऋत्विङ्गमोक्षप्रदो भव ..
प्रविश्य मण्डलं विप्रा स्वस्थाने स्थापयेत्क्रमात् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Knower of the Veda with its six auxiliary limbs, being the sacrificial priest, be the granter of liberation.’ / Having entered the maṇḍala, O Brahmins, one should establish them in their respective places in order.

sanskrit_iast:
vedyāḥ paścimabhāge tu ācāryaṃ sthāpayedbudhaḥ ..
kuṇḍasyāgre tu brahmāṇaṃ maṇḍalasyaiva paścime .. 24 ..
meaning:
वेद्याः पश्चिमभागे तु आचार्यं स्थापयेद्बुधः ..
कुण्डस्याग्रे तु ब्रह्माणं मण्डलस्यैव पश्चिमे .. 24 ..
text_mt: The wise man should establish the ācārya on the western part of the altar, / and the Brahmā priest in front of the sacrificial pit, to the west of the maṇḍala.

sanskrit_iast:
hotāraṃ sthāpayettatra vidhijñamatha cottare ..
dvaudvau kṛtvā jñāpakau ca khaḍgadhārakameva ca ..25..
meaning:
होतारं स्थापयेत्तत्र विधिज्ञमथ चोत्तरे ..
द्वौद्वौ कृत्वा ज्ञापकौ च खड्गधारकमेव च ..25..
text_mt: There he should establish the hotṛ priest, who knows the rules, in the north, / and having appointed two announcers and a sword-bearer,

sanskrit_iast:
dvāridvāri prayatnena dvārapālānanukramāt ..
vakṣyamāṇena maṃtreṇa pratyekamatha sthāpayet ..26..
meaning:
द्वारिद्वारि प्रयत्नेन द्वारपालाननुक्रमात् ..
वक्ष्यमाणेन मंत्रेण प्रत्येकमथ स्थापयेत् ..26..
text_mt: at each door, with diligence, the door-keepers in sequence, / he should then establish each of them with the mantra to be spoken.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedgandhapuṣpādyairvāsaso yugalena tu ..
yajñe savitate yo'sau pūjyate puruṣaḥ sadā..27..
meaning:
पूजयेद्गन्धपुष्पाद्यैर्वाससो युगलेन तु ..
यज्ञे सवितते योऽसौ पूज्यते पुरुषः सदा..27..
text_mt: He should worship them with scents, flowers, and other offerings, and with a pair of garments: / ‘He who is that Person ever worshipped in the sacrifice, O Savitṛ,

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇasvarūpeṇa yajñaṃ me saphalaṃ kuru ..
yajñeṣu sākṣī sarveṣu yajurvedārthatattvavit .. 28 ..
meaning:
नारायणस्वरूपेण यज्ञं मे सफलं कुरु ..
यज्ञेषु साक्षी सर्वेषु यजुर्वेदार्थतत्त्ववित् .. 28 ..
text_mt: make my sacrifice fruitful in the form of Nārāyaṇa! / The witness in all sacrifices, the knower of the true meaning of the Yajurveda,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛgvedārthasya tattvajña indrarūpa namo'stu te ..
makhaśreṣṭheṣu sarveṣu yena maṃtrāḥ suvistṛtāḥ .. .. 39 ..
meaning:
ऋग्वेदार्थस्य तत्त्वज्ञ इन्द्ररूप नमोऽस्तु ते ..
मखश्रेष्ठेषु सर्वेषु येन मंत्राः सुविस्तृताः .. .. 39 ..
text_mt: knower of the reality of the meaning of the Ṛgveda, in the form of Indra, obeisance to you, / by whom mantras are widely expanded in all the best of sacrifices!

sanskrit_iast:
yajurvedārthatattvajña brahmarūpa namo'stu te ..
makhaśreṣṭheṣu sarveṣu eṣa eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ .. 2.2.17.30 ..
meaning:
यजुर्वेदार्थतत्त्वज्ञ ब्रह्मरूप नमोऽस्तु ते ..
मखश्रेष्ठेषु सर्वेषु एष एव विधिः स्मृतः .. 2.2.17.30 ..
text_mt: Knower of the reality of the meaning of the Yajurveda, in the form of Brahmā, obeisance to you!’ / In all the best of sacrifices, this very rule is remembered.

sanskrit_iast:
māṃgalyaṃ karmaṇāṃ nityaṃ sarvajñaṃ jñānarūpi ṇam ..
siddhaye mama yajñasya namāmi śivarūpiṇam .. 31 ..
meaning:
मांगल्यं कर्मणां नित्यं सर्वज्ञं ज्ञानरूपि णम् ..
सिद्धये मम यज्ञस्य नमामि शिवरूपिणम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: ‘The eternal auspiciousness of actions, the omniscient one whose form is knowledge, / for the success of my sacrifice, I bow to him whose form is Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
pālaya tvaṃ diśaḥ sarvā vidiśaśca tathā imam ..
dikpālarūpiṇaṃ vipraṃ yajñasiddhau namā myaham ..
na saṃkalpaṃ caredyāgaṃ vrataṃ devārcanaṃ tathā .. 32 ..
meaning:
पालय त्वं दिशः सर्वा विदिशश्च तथा इमम् ..
दिक्पालरूपिणं विप्रं यज्ञसिद्धौ नमा म्यहम् ..
न संकल्पं चरेद्यागं व्रतं देवार्चनं तथा .. 32 ..
text_mt: Do you protect all the directions and the intermediate directions, and likewise this [place]. / I bow to the Brahmin who has the form of the guardian of the directions, for the success of the sacrifice.’ / One should not perform a sacrifice, an observance, or the worship of deities without a solemn intention.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkalpamūlaḥ kāmo vai yajñāḥ saṃkalpasaṃbhavāḥ ..
saṃkalpena vinā viprā yatkiñcitkurute naraḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
संकल्पमूलः कामो वै यज्ञाः संकल्पसंभवाः ..
संकल्पेन विना विप्रा यत्किञ्चित्कुरुते नरः .. 33 ..
text_mt: Desire is rooted in solemn intention; sacrifices are born of solemn intention. / Whatever a man does without a solemn intention, O Brahmins,

sanskrit_iast:
phalaṃ cālpālpakaṃ tasya dharmasyārddhakṣayo bhavet ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena yāgaṃ saṃkalpayetsudhīḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
फलं चाल्पाल्पकं तस्य धर्मस्यार्द्धक्षयो भवेत् ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन यागं संकल्पयेत्सुधीः .. 34 ..
text_mt: its fruit is exceedingly small, and half of his merit is destroyed. / Therefore, with all effort, the wise man should undertake a sacrifice with a solemn intention.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmātparo naiva bhavenniṣkāmo'pi na śobhanaḥ ..
tasmātkāmamayaṃ dharmaṃ vinā mokṣaṃ na cācaret .. 35 ..
meaning:
कामात्परो नैव भवेन्निष्कामोऽपि न शोभनः ..
तस्मात्काममयं धर्मं विना मोक्षं न चाचरेत् .. 35 ..
text_mt: There can be nothing beyond desire, nor is desirelessness praise-worthy; / therefore, one should never perform desire-filled duty without [an eye to] liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkalpena vinā yastu dharmaṃ carati mānavaḥ ..
na tasya phalamāpnoti nityanaimittikasya ca .. 36 ..
meaning:
संकल्पेन विना यस्तु धर्मं चरति मानवः ..
न तस्य फलमाप्नोति नित्यनैमित्तिकस्य च .. 36 ..
text_mt: A man who performs duty without a solemn vow / does not attain the fruit of it, whether obligatory or occasional.

sanskrit_iast:
na kuryātsthāpane caiva kuryādvai maṃḍalāṃtare ..
gṛhītvauduṃbaraṃ pātraṃ vāripūrṇaṃ guṇānvitam .. 37 ..
meaning:
न कुर्यात्स्थापने चैव कुर्याद्वै मंडलांतरे ..
गृहीत्वौदुंबरं पात्रं वारिपूर्णं गुणान्वितम् .. 37 ..
text_mt: One should not do [it] at the consecration, but within the diagram, / taking a vessel of udumbara wood, filled with water and having good qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
jalāśayārāmakūpa saṃkalpe pūrvadiṅmukhaḥ ..
sādhāraṇe cottarāsyo grahayajñe tu saṃmukhaḥ ..38..
meaning:
जलाशयारामकूप संकल्पे पूर्वदिङ्मुखः ..
साधारणे चोत्तरास्यो ग्रहयज्ञे तु संमुखः ..38..
text_mt: At the solemn vow for a reservoir, a garden, or a well, he should face east; / at a general [vow], he should face north, but at a sacrifice to the planets, he should face them directly.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāvrate pratiṣṭhāyāṃ pātraṃ tāmraṃ hiraṇmayam ..
rājatāśmamayaṃ sāṃgaṃ yadyajñeṣu praśasyate .. 39 ..
meaning:
महाव्रते प्रतिष्ठायां पात्रं ताम्रं हिरण्मयम् ..
राजताश्ममयं सांगं यद्यज्ञेषु प्रशस्यते .. 39 ..
text_mt: In a great votive observance and in a consecration, a vessel of copper, gold, / silver, or stone, complete with its parts, is commended in sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñīyapātrapuṭakaṃ hastasthāne prakīrtitam ..
aiśyānyāṃ nikṣipettoyaṃ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ ca pūrvataḥ ..2.2.17.40..
meaning:
यज्ञीयपात्रपुटकं हस्तस्थाने प्रकीर्तितम् ..
ऐश्यान्यां निक्षिपेत्तोयं प्रतिष्ठायां च पूर्वतः ..2.2.17.40..
text_mt: A cup among the sacrificial vessels is declared to take the place of the hand. / He should pour the water in the north-east, and at a consecration, in the east.

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśe nikṣipedyāge vrate īśepi nityake ..
pitṛmedhe ca goyāge naramedhe ca dakṣiṇe ..41..
meaning:
आकाशे निक्षिपेद्यागे व्रते ईशेपि नित्यके ..
पितृमेधे च गोयागे नरमेधे च दक्षिणे ..41..
text_mt: In a sacrifice, he should pour it into the air, and in an obligatory votive observance, to the Lord; / and in an ancestral sacrifice, a cow-sacrifice, and a human sacrifice, in the south.

sanskrit_iast:
śuktikāṃsyādihastaiśca tāmraraupyādibhistathā..
saṃkalpo naiva kartavyo mṛnmaye ca kadācana .. 42 ..
meaning:
शुक्तिकांस्यादिहस्तैश्च ताम्ररौप्यादिभिस्तथा..
संकल्पो नैव कर्तव्यो मृन्मये च कदाचन .. 42 ..
text_mt: With bowls made of conch-shell, bronze, and the like, or likewise with copper, silver, and the rest, / a solemn vow should never be made, nor ever in an earthen one.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavaṃ pūrvamuccārya yajedyajñeśvaraṃ smaret ..
gaṅgā cādityacaṃdrau ca dyaurbhūmī rātrivāsarau ..43..
meaning:
प्रणवं पूर्वमुच्चार्य यजेद्यज्ञेश्वरं स्मरेत् ..
गङ्गा चादित्यचंद्रौ च द्यौर्भूमी रात्रिवासरौ ..43..
text_mt: Having first uttered the Praṇava, he should sacrifice and remember the Lord of Sacrifice: / 'Gaṅgā, the sun and moon, heaven and earth, night and day,

sanskrit_iast:
sūryaḥ somo yamaḥ kālo mahābhūtāni paṃca ca ..
ete śubhāśubhāsyeha karmaṇo nava sākṣiṇaḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
सूर्यः सोमो यमः कालो महाभूतानि पंच च ..
एते शुभाशुभास्येह कर्मणो नव साक्षिणः .. 44 ..
text_mt: the sun, the moon, Yama, Time, and the five great elements— / these are the nine witnesses here to a good or evil deed.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuccārya nyaseddharmaṃ dhyātvā puṣpāñjaliṃ sṛjet ..
amṛtaṃ kṛtyapātre ca oṃ tatsaditi nirdiśet .. 45 ..
meaning:
इत्युच्चार्य न्यसेद्धर्मं ध्यात्वा पुष्पाञ्जलिं सृजेत् ..
अमृतं कृत्यपात्रे च ओं तत्सदिति निर्दिशेत् .. 45 ..
text_mt: Having recited this, he should establish Dharma; having meditated, he should offer a handful of flowers. / He should consign the nectar into the vessel for the rite, saying, 'Oṃ tat sat.'

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaḥ śubhravapuḥ sitāṃbaradharaḥ kāryordhvadeśe vṛṣo hastābhyāmabhayaṃ varaṃ ca satataṃ rūpaṃ paraṃ yo dadhat ..
sarvaprāṇisukhāvahaḥ kṛtadhiyāṃ mokṣaikahetuḥ sadā soyaṃ pātu jagaṃti caiva satataṃ bhūyātsatāṃ bhūtaye .. 46 ..
meaning:
धर्मः शुभ्रवपुः सितांबरधरः कार्योर्ध्वदेशे वृषो हस्ताभ्यामभयं वरं च सततं रूपं परं यो दधत् ..
सर्वप्राणिसुखावहः कृतधियां मोक्षैकहेतुः सदा सोयं पातु जगंति चैव सततं भूयात्सतां भूतये .. 46 ..
text_mt: Dharma, whose body is white, who wears white garments, is to be fashioned above as a bull, / ever bearing in his two hands the gesture of fearlessness and a boon, and possessing a supreme form; / he brings happiness to all living beings and is always the sole cause of liberation for those of cultivated intellect— / may this very one protect the worlds and always be for the welfare of the virtuous!

sanskrit_iast:
yajñasaṃbaṃdhiviprāṃśca ekāhenaiva yojayet ..
havirdravyāṇi yāni syuraṣṭayāgāṃtarepi ca .. 47 ..
meaning:
यज्ञसंबंधिविप्रांश्च एकाहेनैव योजयेत् ..
हविर्द्रव्याणि यानि स्युरष्टयागांतरेपि च .. 47 ..
text_mt: And he should engage the Brahmins connected with the sacrifice in a single day; / and whatever oblational materials there may be, even within eight sacrifices,

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥpunarniyojyāni brāhmaṇā haviragnayaḥ .. 48 ..
yogasthāpanadevapratiṣṭhāpanavarṇanam
meaning:
पुनःपुनर्नियोज्यानि ब्राह्मणा हविरग्नयः .. 48 ..
योगस्थापनदेवप्रतिष्ठापनवर्णनम्
text_mt:
the Brahmins, the oblation, and the fires are to be employed again and again.
Description of the establishment of yoga and the consecration of deities.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
māghādimāseṣvapi ṣaṭsu kāryā yogapratiṣṭhā ṛṣibhiḥ praṇītā ..
devādisaṃsthāpanamā huratra yāvanna supto madhusūdanaśca .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
माघादिमासेष्वपि षट्सु कार्या योगप्रतिष्ठा ऋषिभिः प्रणीता ..
देवादिसंस्थापनमा हुरत्र यावन्न सुप्तो मधुसूदनश्च .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / The consecration of yoga has been prescribed by the sages to be performed during the six months beginning with Māgha. / The installation of deities and the like is said to take place here as long as Madhusūdana is not asleep.
title: adhyāyaḥ 18

sanskrit_iast:
vāre bhṛgordevagurorbudhasya somasya sarvāḥ śubhadā bhavaṃti ..
lagne śubhasthe śubhavīkṣite vā kāryā pratiṣṭhā ca jalāśayānām .. 2 ..
meaning:
वारे भृगोर्देवगुरोर्बुधस्य सोमस्य सर्वाः शुभदा भवंति ..
लग्ने शुभस्थे शुभवीक्षिते वा कार्या प्रतिष्ठा च जलाशयानाम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: On the days of Śukra, the priest of the gods, Budha, and Soma, all [consecrations] bestow auspiciousness. / The consecration of reservoirs should be performed when an auspicious [planet] occupies the ascendant or when it is aspected by an auspicious [planet].

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhā dvitīyā ca tathā tṛtīyā trayodaśī cāpi tathaiva viprāḥ ..
tathāpi saptamyapi paurṇamāsī daśamyasau cāpyatha paṃcamī ca .. 3 ..
meaning:
शुद्धा द्वितीया च तथा तृतीया त्रयोदशी चापि तथैव विप्राः ..
तथापि सप्तम्यपि पौर्णमासी दशम्यसौ चाप्यथ पंचमी च .. 3 ..
text_mt: The bright second, O Brahmins, and likewise the third, and the thirteenth; / likewise the seventh, the full moon, the tenth, and also the fifth—

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇapratiṣṭhā ca jalāśayāderetāḥ praśastāstithayo bhavaṃti ..
aprāpya caitāni śubhāni yāni kāryā pratiṣṭhā viṣuvadvaye ca .. 4 ..
meaning:
प्राणप्रतिष्ठा च जलाशयादेरेताः प्रशस्तास्तिथयो भवंति ..
अप्राप्य चैतानि शुभानि यानि कार्या प्रतिष्ठा विषुवद्वये च .. 4 ..
text_mt: these are the commended lunar days for the consecration of the life-breath in reservoirs and the like. / If these auspicious [times] cannot be obtained, the consecration should be performed at the two equinoxes,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍaśītilokāpyayanadvayena yugādike puṇyādine śubhe ca ..
kāryā taḍāgādijalāśayasya prācyāṃ pratiṣṭhā atha cottare vā .. 5 ..
meaning:
षडशीतिलोकाप्ययनद्वयेन युगादिके पुण्यादिने शुभे च ..
कार्या तडागादिजलाशयस्य प्राच्यां प्रतिष्ठा अथ चोत्तरे वा .. 5 ..
text_mt: at the two Ṣaḍaśītis, at the World-increase, at the start of a Yuga, or on an auspicious sacred day. / The consecration of a reservoir such as a pond should be performed in the east or in the north.

sanskrit_iast:
sucāru īṣatpravaṇe ca deśe suvartulaḥ ṣoḍaśahastamaṃḍapaḥ ..
dvāraiścaturbhiḥ prathitairupetaścaturmukhaścāpi bhavetsuretāḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
सुचारु ईषत्प्रवणे च देशे सुवर्तुलः षोडशहस्तमंडपः ..
द्वारैश्चतुर्भिः प्रथितैरुपेतश्चतुर्मुखश्चापि भवेत्सुरेताः .. 6 ..
text_mt: In a very pleasant, slightly sloping place, [there should be] a well-rounded pavilion of sixteen cubits, / endowed with four renowned gateways, and having four faces, well-seeded.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvādidvāreṣu catuṣṭayeṣu plakṣādibhistoraṇakaiḥ sureśaḥ ..
plakṣastathoduṃbarapippalau ca nyagrodhakaṃ cāpi yathākrameṇa ..7..
meaning:
पूर्वादिद्वारेषु चतुष्टयेषु प्लक्षादिभिस्तोरणकैः सुरेशः ..
प्लक्षस्तथोदुंबरपिप्पलौ च न्यग्रोधकं चापि यथाक्रमेण ..7..
text_mt: At the four gateways beginning with the east, O lord of the gods, [there are to be] arches made of plakṣa and other [trees]: / plakṣa, udumbara, pippala, and nyagrodha respectively in order.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhve ca hastānamitāni yāni vicitramālyāṃbarabhūṣitāni ..
bhūmau yathā prīti ca hastakāni bhavaṃti caitānyapi toraṇāni ..8..
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वे च हस्तानमितानि यानि विचित्रमाल्यांबरभूषितानि ..
भूमौ यथा प्रीति च हस्तकानि भवंति चैतान्यपि तोरणानि ..8..
text_mt: Measured in cubits upwards, decorated with colourful garlands and cloths, / these arches are also measured in cubits on the ground according to desire.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatra yāgepi hi maṃḍapasya kāryā dhvajā dikṣu vidikṣu śubhrāḥ..
dikpālavarṇābhapatākayuktā madhye ca vai nīlapatākayuktāḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
सर्वत्र यागेपि हि मंडपस्य कार्या ध्वजा दिक्षु विदिक्षु शुभ्राः..
दिक्पालवर्णाभपताकयुक्ता मध्ये च वै नीलपताकयुक्ताः .. 9 ..
text_mt: Everywhere in the sacrifice, bright banners should be placed in the cardinal and intermediate directions of the pavilion, / accompanied by flags having the colours and splendours of the guardians of the directions, and in the centre, accompanied by a blue flag.

sanskrit_iast:
dhvajāśca yasmindaśahastasammitāstasminpatākā api pañcahastāḥ ..
aratnimātrā yadi mūlabhāge paṃcāṃgu lāgre vinibaddhagūḍhāḥ .. 2.2.18.10 ..
meaning:
ध्वजाश्च यस्मिन्दशहस्तसम्मितास्तस्मिन्पताका अपि पञ्चहस्ताः ..
अरत्निमात्रा यदि मूलभागे पंचांगु लाग्रे विनिबद्धगूढाः .. 2.2.18.10 ..
text_mt: Where the flagstaffs are measured at ten cubits, the flags are five cubits; / they are of the measure of an aratni at the base and secretly fastened at the tip of five fingers.

sanskrit_iast:
dvāre ca tasmiṃśca nirūpitā vā raṃbhā supuṣpā sukhaśāḍvalāśca ..
vacābhivṛkṣottarapaṃcahastāḥ sapaṃcaśākhā api tora ṇāni ..11..
meaning:
द्वारे च तस्मिंश्च निरूपिता वा रंभा सुपुष्पा सुखशाड्वलाश्च ..
वचाभिवृक्षोत्तरपंचहस्ताः सपंचशाखा अपि तोर णानि ..11..
text_mt: At that gateway are set plantain trees with beautiful flowers and pleasant lawns, / or five-cubit vacā trees to the north, and arches with five branches.

sanskrit_iast:
muṃjodbhavairbarhisamudbhavairvā suraṃjitaścettritapadmapallavaiḥ ..
puṣṭadvaye sūtritaṃ veṣṭayecca tathekṣukāṇḍairatha yāgamaṇḍapam..12..
meaning:
मुंजोद्भवैर्बर्हिसमुद्भवैर्वा सुरंजितश्चेत्त्रितपद्मपल्लवैः ..
पुष्टद्वये सूत्रितं वेष्टयेच्च तथेक्षुकाण्डैरथ यागमण्डपम्..12..
text_mt: Coloured with muñja grass or sacrificial grass, or with three layers of lotus shoots, / bound with cords at the two sides, he should also enclose the sacrificial pavilion with sugarcane stalks.

sanskrit_iast:
vedistathā maṃḍapa madhyabhāge kāryā ca koṇesthituṣādihīnā..
hastocchritā reravavatī surekhapariṣkṛtā hastacatuṣṭayena .. 13 ..
meaning:
वेदिस्तथा मंडप मध्यभागे कार्या च कोणेस्थितुषादिहीना..
हस्तोच्छ्रिता रेरववती सुरेखपरिष्कृता हस्तचतुष्टयेन .. 13 ..
text_mt: An altar should likewise be made in the middle part of the pavilion, free of chaff and the like in the corners, / one cubit high, having gravel, adorned with beautiful lines, measuring four cubits.

sanskrit_iast:
vedyāṃ parityajya daśāṃgulāni aiśānyata strīṇi tathā parāṇi ..
kuṃḍāya dadyāccaturasramekamavasthitaṃ tryaṃgulamekhalojjvalam..14..
meaning:
वेद्यां परित्यज्य दशांगुलानि ऐशान्यत स्त्रीणि तथा पराणि ..
कुंडाय दद्याच्चतुरस्रमेकमवस्थितं त्र्यंगुलमेखलोज्ज्वलम्..14..
text_mt: Leaving ten digits on the altar, and three others from the north-east, / he should provide for the sacrificial pit one square [space] established with a gleaming girdle of three digits.

sanskrit_iast:
prāsāde ca taḍāge ca mahārāme tathaiva ca ..
maṃḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ prayatnenaiva kārayet ..15..
meaning:
प्रासादे च तडागे च महारामे तथैव च ..
मंडलं सर्वतोभद्रं प्रयत्नेनैव कारयेत् ..15..
text_mt: In a temple, at a pond, and likewise in a great grove, / he should carefully make a sarvatobhadra diagram.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṃḍaṃ cāpi prakurvīta yathābhyantaramekhalam ..
bahiryonigataṃ śvetaṃ niścitraṃ samasūtrakam ..16..
meaning:
कुंडं चापि प्रकुर्वीत यथाभ्यन्तरमेखलम् ..
बहिर्योनिगतं श्वेतं निश्चित्रं समसूत्रकम् ..16..
text_mt: And he should fashion the sacrificial pit so that its girdle is on the inside, / with its vulva-base on the outside, white, devoid of variegated patterns, and straightly aligned with the cord.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṃḍāni kuryānnava kuṃḍapakṣe vedyāstathoccairavidikṣu caiva.
sarvāṇi sarvatra ca mekhalāni ṣaḍasrapaṃcāsrasamekhalāni..17..
meaning:
कुंडानि कुर्यान्नव कुंडपक्षे वेद्यास्तथोच्चैरविदिक्षु चैव.
सर्वाणि सर्वत्र च मेखलानि षडस्रपंचास्रसमेखलानि..17..
text_mt: In the option of nine sacrificial pits, he should make the sacrificial pits high upon the altar in the cardinal and intermediate directions; / all of them with girdles everywhere—hexagonal, pentagonal, with equal girdles,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāsrajānyabjatrikoṇakāni tathārddhacandraṃ caturasrakaṃ ca..
kuṇḍasya pūrvottaradigvibhāge sthāpyo ghaṭaścandanacāruliptaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:

title: adhyāyaḥ 19

sanskrit_iast:
paṃca devānnamaskṛtya tathā yajñeśvaraṃ harim ..
saṃkalpaṃ ca tataḥ kṛtvā brāhmaṇānāmanujñayā .. 2 ..
meaning:
पंच देवान्नमस्कृत्य तथा यज्ञेश्वरं हरिम् ..
संकल्पं च ततः कृत्वा ब्राह्मणानामनुज्ञया .. 2 ..
text_mt: having bowed to the five deities and Hari, the Lord of Sacrifice, / and then having made his solemn vow with the permission of the Brahmins:

sanskrit_iast:
etasminpuṇyadeśe tu phalaṃ gotraśca vai yamaḥ ..
vedavyāsādipraṇītaṃ yathāśāstranidarśanam .. 3 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्पुण्यदेशे तु फलं गोत्रश्च वै यमः ..
वेदव्यासादिप्रणीतं यथाशास्त्रनिदर्शनम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: 'In this sacred place, the fruit, the lineage, and Yama— / as taught by Vedavyāsa and others, following the demonstration of the treatises,

sanskrit_iast:
yathāyathā svatantroktaṃ puṇyā raṇyābhidhāyakam ..
jalāśayapratiṣṭhāyāṃ kariṣye vidhivaddvijāḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
यथायथा स्वतन्त्रोक्तं पुण्या रण्याभिधायकम् ..
जलाशयप्रतिष्ठायां करिष्ये विधिवद्द्विजाः .. 4 ..
text_mt: just as declared in the respective texts describing sacred forests, / I shall perform [the rite] according to rule for the consecration of the reservoir, O twice-born.'

sanskrit_iast:
yathāyathā ca kalpoktaṃ yathākuṇḍaṃ vidhānataḥ ..
sādhivāsaṃ yathaivaikaḥ puṇyāraṇyavidhāyakaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
यथायथा च कल्पोक्तं यथाकुण्डं विधानतः ..
साधिवासं यथैवैकः पुण्यारण्यविधायकः .. 5 ..
text_mt: And just as declared in the ritual manual, according to the sacrificial pit in the prescribed manner, / together with the preliminary consecration, just as a single person performs the sacred grove ritual,

sanskrit_iast:
jalāśayapratiṣṭhāṃ ca kariṣye vidhivaddvijāḥ ..
saṃkalpamevaṃ kṛtvā tu vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ samācaret .. 6 ..
meaning:
जलाशयप्रतिष्ठां च करिष्ये विधिवद्द्विजाः ..
संकल्पमेवं कृत्वा तु वृद्धिश्राद्धं समाचरेत् .. 6 ..
text_mt: so 'I shall perform the consecration of the reservoir according to rule, O twice-born.' / Having thus made the formal resolve, he should perform the vṛddhiśrāddha.

sanskrit_iast: mātṛyāgaṃ puraskṛtya vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ samāpayet..7..
meaning: मातृयागं पुरस्कृत्य वृद्धिश्राद्धं समापयेत्..7..

sanskrit_iast:
bheryādighoṣeṇa sumaṃgalena padyaṃ likhedatra saṣoḍaśākṣaram ..
indrādidikpālavarāyudhāni samullikhedeva diśi sthitāni .. .. 8 ..
meaning:
भेर्यादिघोषेण सुमंगलेन पद्यं लिखेदत्र सषोडशाक्षरम् ..
इन्द्रादिदिक्पालवरायुधानि समुल्लिखेदेव दिशि स्थितानि .. .. 8 ..
text_mt: With the auspicious sound of kettle-drums and the like, he should draw here a sixteen-syllabled lotus-verse; / he should delineate the excellent weapons of the guardians of the directions, Indra and the rest, situated in each direction.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmeśānvarayetsarvānācāryaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ ..
svarṇakuṃḍalayugmena tathā tāmrādibhājanaiḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मेशान्वरयेत्सर्वानाचार्यं तु विशेषतः ..
स्वर्णकुंडलयुग्मेन तथा ताम्रादिभाजनैः .. 9 ..
text_mt: He should choose all the priests, [such as] the Brahman, and the officiating teacher in particular, / with a pair of gold earrings and likewise with vessels of copper and other metals.

sanskrit_iast:
nānāratnaiśca vastraiśca ācāryaṃ varayedbudhaḥ ..
hemālaṃkārayugmaiśca vāsobhirvividharaipi .. 2.2.19.10 ..
meaning:
नानारत्नैश्च वस्त्रैश्च आचार्यं वरयेद्बुधः ..
हेमालंकारयुग्मैश्च वासोभिर्विविधरैपि .. 2.2.19.10 ..
text_mt: With various jewels and garments the wise man should choose the officiating teacher, / and with pairs of gold ornaments and varied cloths.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāmānaṃ yathāśakti yathābhivṛṇuyādbudhaḥ ..
racitā yajamānena dhruvaṃ svastyastu te iti ..11..
meaning:
यथामानं यथाशक्ति यथाभिवृणुयाद्बुधः ..
रचिता यजमानेन ध्रुवं स्वस्त्यस्तु ते इति ..11..
text_mt: According to measure, according to capacity, just as the wise man should choose them, / arranged by the patron of the sacrifice, [he says,] 'May there truly be well-being for you.'

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sarvauṣadhībhiśca yajamānaḥ sapatnikaḥ ..
āpohiṣṭhetimantreṇa snāpayāmāsuraprajāḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
ततः सर्वौषधीभिश्च यजमानः सपत्निकः ..
आपोहिष्ठेतिमन्त्रेण स्नापयामासुरप्रजाः .. 12 ..
text_mt: Then with all the herbs, along with his wife, / with the mantra 'āpo hi ṣṭhā', they bathed the childless patron of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
yavagodhūmanīvāratilaśyāmākaśālayaḥ ..
priyaṃguvrīhayaścāṣṭau sarvauṣadhigaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
यवगोधूमनीवारतिलश्यामाकशालयः ..
प्रियंगुव्रीहयश्चाष्टौ सर्वौषधिगणः स्मृतः .. 13 ..
text_mt: Barley, wheat, wild rice, sesame, black millet, śāli rice, / priyaṅgu, and paddy rice: these eight are considered the collection of all herbs.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śuklāmbaradharaḥ śuklamālyānulepanaḥ ..
sarvauṣadhyudakasnātaḥ snāpito vedapuṅgavaiḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
ततः शुक्लाम्बरधरः शुक्लमाल्यानुलेपनः ..
सर्वौषध्युदकस्नातः स्नापितो वेदपुङ्गवैः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Then, clad in white garments, with white garlands and ointments, / bathed with the water of all the herbs, having been bathed by the pre-eminent knowers of the Vedas,

sanskrit_iast:

nānāmaṃgalaghoṣeṇa bherīpaṭahanisvanaiḥ .. 15 ..

ब्राह्मणैरभ्यनुज्ञातः पुरोहितपुरःसरः ..
नानामंगलघोषेण भेरीपटहनिस्वनैः .. 15 ..
text_mt: permitted by the brāhmaṇas, preceded by the family priest, / with diverse auspicious sounds and the roars of kettle-drums and paṭaha drums,

sanskrit_iast:
yajamānaḥ sapatnīkaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ ..
paścimaṃ dvāramāsādya praviśed yāgamaṇḍapam .. 16 ..
meaning:
यजमानः सपत्नीकः पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितः ..
पश्चिमं द्वारमासाद्य प्रविशेद् यागमण्डपम् .. 16 ..

sanskrit_iast:

चरके पूजयेद्विघ्नं गंगां च यमुनां तथा ..
पार्श्वयोश्चार्धतो लक्ष्मीं प्रतिहारमनुक्रमात् .. 17 ..
text_mt: At the threshold he should worship Vighna, and likewise Gaṅgā and Yamunā, / and on the two flanks, half-way, Lakṣmī and the door-keeper in succession.

sanskrit_iast:
vediṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya namaskuryādyathāvidhi ..
upaviśya tatastasminbrāhmaṇānumate sthitaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
वेदिं प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य नमस्कुर्याद्यथाविधि ..
उपविश्य ततस्तस्मिन्ब्राह्मणानुमते स्थितः .. 18 ..
text_mt: Having circumambulated the altar, he should pay homage according to rule; / then sitting down upon it, remaining with the brāhmaṇas' permission,

sanskrit_iast:

स्वस्ति वाच्यं ततः कृत्वा पंच देवान्प्रपूजयेत् ..

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedāsanaṃ paścātsvakīyaṃ puṣpacaṃdanaiḥ ..

vimalāsanāya ca namo namaḥ sārāsanāya ca ..

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:
ततो भूमितले वामहस्तं दत्त्वा पठेन्नरः ..
पृथ्वि त्वया धृता लोका देवि त्वं विष्णुना धृता .. 23 ..
text_mt: Then placing his left hand on the surface of the earth, the man should recite: / 'O Earth, the worlds are upheld by you; O Goddess, you are upheld by Viṣṇu;

त्वं च धारय मां नित्यं पवित्रमासनं कुरु ..
सूर्यायार्घ्यं ततो दत्त्वा गुरुं नत्वा कृताञ्जलिः .. 24 ..
text_mt: and do you uphold me constantly, and make my seat pure.' / Then having offered water for the arghya to the Sun, bowing to the guru with palms joined in reverence,

sanskrit_iast:
devaṃ hṛtpadmake nītvā prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ caret ..
tato'rcayedvighnarājamaiśānyāṃ ca ghaṭopari .. 25 ..
meaning:
देवं हृत्पद्मके नीत्वा प्राणायामत्रयं चरेत् ..
ततोऽर्चयेद्विघ्नराजमैशान्यां च घटोपरि .. 25 ..
text_mt: bringing the deity into the lotus of his heart, he should perform three breath-controls. / Then he should worship the King of Obstacles in the northeast, upon the water-pot,

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapuṣpaistathā vastrairnaivedyairvividhairapi ..
gaṇānāṃ tveti maṃtreṇa brahmāṇaṃ tadanaṃtaram .. 26 ..
meaning:
गन्धपुष्पैस्तथा वस्त्रैर्नैवेद्यैर्विविधैरपि ..
गणानां त्वेति मंत्रेण ब्रह्माणं तदनंतरम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: with fragrant perfumes, flowers, and likewise garments, and diverse food-offerings, / with the mantra 'gaṇānāṃ tvā'. Immediately thereafter, [he should worship] Brahmā

sanskrit_iast:

vāsudevaṃ tataḥ paścādbalibhirgandhacaṃdanaiḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
आब्रह्मन्निति ऋचा तद्विष्णोरिति संस्मरन् ..
वासुदेवं ततः पश्चाद्बलिभिर्गन्धचंदनैः .. 27 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tato devaśarīraṃ tu navamāsādya triṃśatam ..
vedyāśca paritaḥ sarvānsvesve sthāne yathākramam .. 28 ..
meaning:

वेद्याश्च परितः सर्वान्स्वेस्वे स्थाने यथाक्रमम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Then, having reached thirty-nine divine bodies / all around the altar, [he should worship them] in their respective places in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
tato rājādhirājena bhūtaśuddhiṃ samācaret ..
tato budbudamadhye tu śvetapadmāsanasthitam .. 29 ..
meaning:
ततो राजाधिराजेन भूतशुद्धिं समाचरेत् ..
ततो बुद्बुदमध्ये तु श्वेतपद्मासनस्थितम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: Then, [empowered] by the king of kings, he should perform the purification of the elements. / Then, situated on a white lotus-seat in the middle of a bubble,

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ śaṃkhakundendusaprabham..
kirīṭakuṇḍalayutaṃ sitaṃ paṃkajadhāriṇam .. 2.2.19.30 ..
meaning:
शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशं शंखकुन्देन्दुसप्रभम्..
किरीटकुण्डलयुतं सितं पंकजधारिणम् .. 2.2.19.30 ..
text_mt: resembling pure crystal, having the lustre of a conch, the kunda flower, and the moon, / adorned with a diadem and earrings, fair-complexioned, holding a lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
śuklamālyāṃbaraṃ śuklaṃ śuklagaṃdhānulepanam ..
ahituṇḍāsanasthaṃ ca pāśahastaṃ mahābalam .. 31 ..
meaning:
शुक्लमाल्यांबरं शुक्लं शुक्लगंधानुलेपनम् ..
अहितुण्डासनस्थं च पाशहस्तं महाबलम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: wearing white garlands and white garments, anointed with white fragrant paste, / seated on a serpent's hood, holding a noose in hand, possessed of great strength,

sanskrit_iast:
stūyamānaṃ suragaṇaiḥ siddhagaṃdharvasevitam ..
sucāruvadanaṃ devaṃ padmamālopaśobhitam .. 32 ..
meaning:
स्तूयमानं सुरगणैः सिद्धगंधर्वसेवितम् ..
सुचारुवदनं देवं पद्ममालोपशोभितम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: praised by the hosts of gods, attended by Siddhas and Gandharvas, / the god of very charming face, adorned with a garland of lotuses,

sanskrit_iast:
rājīvalocanaṃ nityaṃ nāgalokopaśobhitam ..
makaragrāhakūrmādyairnānājalacarairvṛtam .. 33 ..
meaning:
राजीवलोचनं नित्यं नागलोकोपशोभितम् ..
मकरग्राहकूर्माद्यैर्नानाजलचरैर्वृतम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: lotus-eyed, constantly adorned by the serpent world, / surrounded by makaras, crocodiles, turtles, and various aquatic creatures,

sanskrit_iast:
jalāśayagataṃ devaṃ ciṃtayejjalaśāyinam..
tato nyāsaṃ prakurvīta pacāṃgatvāvaśobhitam .. 34 ..
meaning:
जलाशयगतं देवं चिंतयेज्जलशायिनम्..
ततो न्यासं प्रकुर्वीत पचांगत्वावशोभितम् .. 34 ..
text_mt: he should meditate upon the god resting in the waters, residing in the water-reservoir. / Then he should perform the ritual installation of letters, adorned with five limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
arghyapātraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā tribhāgajalapūritam ..
aṣṭadhā mūlamaṃtraṃ ca japtvā tenodakena ca .. 35 ..
meaning:
अर्घ्यपात्रं ततः कृत्वा त्रिभागजलपूरितम् ..
अष्टधा मूलमंत्रं च जप्त्वा तेनोदकेन च .. 35 ..
text_mt: Then, having prepared the arghya vessel filled with water to three parts, / and having recited the root-mantra eight times, with that water

sanskrit_iast:
āsanaṃ yāgavastūni prokṣayettena vāriṇā ..
aruṇāya vidmahe tamoghnāya ca dhīmahi .. 36 ..
meaning:
आसनं यागवस्तूनि प्रोक्षयेत्तेन वारिणा ..
अरुणाय विद्महे तमोघ्नाय च धीमहि .. 36 ..
text_mt: he should sprinkle the seat and the sacrificial requisites with that water. / 'We know Aruṇa, and we meditate on the dispeller of darkness;

sanskrit_iast:
tanno aruṇaḥ pracodayāditi snānaṃ samācaret ..
tato gaṇeśamaiśānyāmāgneyyāṃ gurupādukām.. 37 ..
meaning:
तन्नो अरुणः प्रचोदयादिति स्नानं समाचरेत् ..
ततो गणेशमैशान्यामाग्नेय्यां गुरुपादुकाम्.. 37 ..
text_mt: may that Aruṇa impel us'—saying this, he should perform the bath. / Then Gaṇeśa in the northeast, the sandals of the guru in the southeast,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmādharmādikānsarvāntsattvādīnatha cārcayet ..
sūryasomajalādīnāṃ maṇḍalāni yathākramam ..38..
meaning:
धर्माधर्मादिकान्सर्वान्त्सत्त्वादीनथ चार्चयेत् ..
सूर्यसोमजलादीनां मण्डलानि यथाक्रमम् ..38..
text_mt: and then he should worship all [principles], beginning with righteousness and unrighteousness, and beginning with sattva, / and the circles of the sun, moon, water, and the others, in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye śaktiṃ ca kṣīrodamanaṃtaṃ pṛthivīṃ tathā ..
kūrmaṃ cādhāraśaktiṃ ca sumeruṃ mandaraṃ tathā .. 39 ..
meaning:
मध्ये शक्तिं च क्षीरोदमनंतं पृथिवीं तथा ..
कूर्मं चाधारशक्तिं च सुमेरुं मन्दरं तथा .. 39 ..
text_mt: In the centre, [he should worship] the Śakti, the Milk Ocean, Ananta, and likewise the Earth, / the Tortoise, the Foundation-Śakti, and likewise Mount Sumeru and Mandara.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcatattvaṃ samabhyarcya sāṃgopāgamanaṃtaram ..
tataḥ śvetaṃ ca kusumaṃ sākṣataṃ yogamāyayā .. 2.2.19.40 ..
meaning:
पञ्चतत्त्वं समभ्यर्च्य सांगोपागमनंतरम् ..
ततः श्वेतं च कुसुमं साक्षतं योगमायया .. 2.2.19.40 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped the five elements together with the primary and secondary limbs immediately after, / then taking a white flower along with unbroken grains by means of Yogamāyā,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā pūrvavaddeśe sthāpayetkalaśopari ..
āvāhanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā mantreṇānena maṃtravit .. 41 ..
meaning:
गृहीत्वा पूर्ववद्देशे स्थापयेत्कलशोपरि ..
आवाहनं ततः कृत्वा मन्त्रेणानेन मंत्रवित् .. 41 ..
text_mt: he should place it upon the water-pot in the place as before. / Then having performed the invocation with this mantra, the knower of mantras [should say]:

sanskrit_iast:
ehyehi bhagavanvaruṇa eṣa yajñaḥ pravartate ..
yajñabhāgaṃ gṛhāṇedaṃ tvāmevāvāhayāmyaham .. 42 ..
meaning:
एह्येहि भगवन्वरुण एष यज्ञः प्रवर्तते ..
यज्ञभागं गृहाणेदं त्वामेवावाहयाम्यहम् .. 42 ..
text_mt: 'Come, come, O Lord Varuṇa, this sacrifice is taking place! / Receive this sacrificial share; it is you alone whom I invoke!'

sanskrit_iast:
evamāvāhya lokeśamaṣṭau mudrāḥ pradarśayet ..
gāyatryā snāpayitvā tu dadyātpādyādikatrayam .. 43 ..
meaning:
एवमावाह्य लोकेशमष्टौ मुद्राः प्रदर्शयेत् ..
गायत्र्या स्नापयित्वा तु दद्यात्पाद्यादिकत्रयम् .. 43 ..
text_mt: Having thus invoked the Lord of the World, he should display the eight mudrās. / Having bathed him with the Gāyatrī, he should offer the triad beginning with foot-washing water.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpāñjaliṃ tato dattvā mūlamaṃtreṇa deśikaḥ ..
pūrvādipatramūleṣu dharmādīnpūjayedbudhaḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
पुष्पाञ्जलिं ततो दत्त्वा मूलमंत्रेण देशिकः ..
पूर्वादिपत्रमूलेषु धर्मादीन्पूजयेद्बुधः .. 44 ..
text_mt: Then having offered an añjali of flowers with the root-mantra, the spiritual teacher, / the wise man, should worship righteousness and the rest at the bases of the petals beginning in the east.

sanskrit_iast:
sattvādyāḥ pūjayettatra teṣāmeva varāṃganāḥ ..
jñānaṃ dharmaṃ ca somaṃ ca rajaḥ sattvaṃ tamastathā .. 45 ..
meaning:
सत्त्वाद्याः पूजयेत्तत्र तेषामेव वरांगनाः ..
ज्ञानं धर्मं च सोमं च रजः सत्त्वं तमस्तथा .. 45 ..
text_mt: There he should worship the principles beginning with sattva, and their excellent consorts: / knowledge, righteousness, the moon, and rajas, sattva, and tamas.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvādipatramadhye tu grahānaṣṭau prapūjayet ..
patrāgre lokapālānāmagnyā(gryā?)dīnāyudhāṃstathā .. 46 ..
meaning:
पूर्वादिपत्रमध्ये तु ग्रहानष्टौ प्रपूजयेत् ..
पत्राग्रे लोकपालानामग्न्या(ग्र्या?)दीनायुधांस्तथा .. 46 ..
text_mt: In the middle of the petals beginning in the east, he should worship the eight planets; / and at the tip of the petals, the weapons of the world protectors, fire and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
karṇikādakṣiṇe pūrvaṃ vāme cāpi śacīpatim ..
pūrvapatre tu brahmāṇaṃ pūjayetsitapaṅkajaiḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
कर्णिकादक्षिणे पूर्वं वामे चापि शचीपतिम् ..
पूर्वपत्रे तु ब्रह्माणं पूजयेत्सितपङ्कजैः .. 47 ..
text_mt: To the right of the pericarp first, and to the left, [he should worship] the lord of Śacī; / and on the eastern petal he should worship Brahmā with white lotuses.

sanskrit_iast:
nairṛtye varuṇa syātha madhye'naṃtaṃ prapūjayet ..
pīṭhamantreṣu pūrvādibrahmāṇaṃ ca śivaṃ tathā .. 48 ..
meaning:
नैरृत्ये वरुण स्याथ मध्येऽनंतं प्रपूजयेत् ..
पीठमन्त्रेषु पूर्वादिब्रह्माणं च शिवं तथा .. 48 ..
text_mt: In the southwest he should worship Varuṇa, and in the middle, Ananta; / with the seat-mantras, beginning in the east, [he should worship] Brahmā and Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuṃ cāpi gaṇeśaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ gaṃdhacandanaiḥ ..
japenmantraṃ sāṣṭaśataṃ sahasraṃ vijapedbudhaḥ ..49 ..
meaning:
विष्णुं चापि गणेशं च पृथिवीं गंधचन्दनैः ..
जपेन्मन्त्रं साष्टशतं सहस्रं विजपेद्बुधः ..49 ..
text_mt: and Viṣṇu, and Gaṇeśa, and the Earth, with fragrant sandal-pastes. / The wise man should recite the mantra one hundred and eight or a thousand times.

sanskrit_iast:
jānubhyāmavanīṃ gatvā vijayākhyastavaṃ paṭhet ..
īśānādipīṭhakoṇeṣu kamalāmaṃbikāṃ tathā .. 2.2.19.50 ..
meaning:
जानुभ्यामवनीं गत्वा विजयाख्यस्तवं पठेत् ..
ईशानादिपीठकोणेषु कमलामंबिकां तथा .. 2.2.19.50 ..
text_mt: Going down to the ground on both knees, he should recite the hymn called Vijayā. / In the corners of the seat beginning with the northeast, [he should worship] Kamalā and likewise Ambikā,

sanskrit_iast:
nairṛtyāṃ viśvakarmāṇaṃ vāyavye tu sarasvatīm ..
pūrvādidvāradeśe tu marutaṃ cāvahādikam .. 51 ..
meaning:
नैरृत्यां विश्वकर्माणं वायव्ये तु सरस्वतीम् ..
पूर्वादिद्वारदेशे तु मरुतं चावहादिकम् .. 51 ..
text_mt: Viśvakarman in the southwest, and Sarasvatī in the northwest. / At the gateway regions beginning with the east, [he should place] the Maruts such as Āvaha:

sanskrit_iast:
āvahaṃ pravahaṃ caiva tathaivodvahasaṃvahau ..
vinyasetpaścime dvāri nivahaṃ ca parīvaham .. 52 ..
meaning:
आवहं प्रवहं चैव तथैवोद्वहसंवहौ ..
विन्यसेत्पश्चिमे द्वारि निवहं च परीवहम् .. 52 ..
text_mt: Āvaha and Pravaha, and likewise Udvaha and Saṃvaha; / at the western gate he should place Nivaha and Parīvaha,

sanskrit_iast:
vinyaseduttaradvāri marutaṃ ca parābhavam ..
āgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu bahiṣpīṭhaṃ tato jayet .. 53 ..
meaning:
विन्यसेदुत्तरद्वारि मरुतं च पराभवम् ..
आग्नेयादिषु कोणेषु बहिष्पीठं ततो जयेत् .. 53 ..
text_mt: and at the northern gate he should place the Marut Parābhava. / Then, in the corners beginning with the southeast, he should master the outer seat:

sanskrit_iast:
piśācānrākṣasānbhūtānvetālāṃśca tathā kramāt ..
kṣobhakaḥ kāmarūpaśca saubhadro marutastathā .. 54 ..
meaning:
पिशाचान्राक्षसान्भूतान्वेतालांश्च तथा क्रमात् ..
क्षोभकः कामरूपश्च सौभद्रो मरुतस्तथा .. 54 ..
text_mt: the piśācas, rākṣasas, bhūtas, and vetālas, respectively in order. / Kṣobhaka, Kāmarūpa, Saubhadra, Maruta,

sanskrit_iast:
gomukho nandabhadraśca dvijihvo malinastathā ..
hastikarṇo viśālākhyaḥ saptarakṣogaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
गोमुखो नन्दभद्रश्च द्विजिह्वो मलिनस्तथा ..
हस्तिकर्णो विशालाख्यः सप्तरक्षोगणः स्मृतः .. 55 ..
text_mt: Gomukha, Nandabhadra, Dvijihva, Malina, / Hastikarṇa, and the one named Viśāla are recorded as the group of seven rākṣasas.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmido varadaścaiva jayaṃtaḥ kṣobhakastathā ..
vivasvaṃtaḥ sudaṃtaśca ete bhūtagaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
भूमिदो वरदश्चैव जयंतः क्षोभकस्तथा ..
विवस्वंतः सुदंतश्च एते भूतगणाः स्मृताः .. 56 ..
text_mt: Bhūmida, Varada, Jayanta, Kṣobhaka, / Vivasvant, and Sudanta are recorded as the hosts of bhūtas.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃgado nīlakarṇo'sau vasaṃto yāvakastathā ..
ghorarūpā mahākāyaḥ vetālāśca prakīrtitāḥ ..57..
meaning:
अंगदो नीलकर्णोऽसौ वसंतो यावकस्तथा ..
घोररूपा महाकायः वेतालाश्च प्रकीर्तिताः ..57..
text_mt: Aṅgada, Nīlakarṇa, Vasanta, and Yāvaka / are proclaimed as the vetālas of terrifying form and huge bodies.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatairbhaktaṃ sarve devā grahādayaḥ ..
dhyānavarṇānurūpeṇa pūjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
गंधपुष्पाक्षतैर्भक्तं सर्वे देवा ग्रहादयः ..
ध्यानवर्णानुरूपेण पूजनीयाः प्रयत्नतः .. 58 ..
text_mt: With scents, flowers, unhusked barley, and boiled rice, all the gods, planets, and so forth / should be zealously worshipped according to their visualization and colour.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyedādityamāraktaṃ raktapadmāsanasthitam ..
raktāṃbaradharaṃ raktaṃ raktamālyānulepanam .. 59 ..
meaning:
ध्यायेदादित्यमारक्तं रक्तपद्मासनस्थितम् ..
रक्तांबरधरं रक्तं रक्तमाल्यानुलेपनम् .. 59 ..
text_mt: He should visualize Āditya as reddish, seated upon a red lotus, / wearing red garments, red-complexioned, with red garlands and unguents,

sanskrit_iast:
yavavidrumasaṃkāśaṃ siṃdūrāruṇasaprabham..
ākṛṣṇeneti maṃtreṇa sthāpayetkalaśopari .. 2.2.19.60 ..
meaning:
यवविद्रुमसंकाशं सिंदूरारुणसप्रभम्..
आकृष्णेनेति मंत्रेण स्थापयेत्कलशोपरि .. 2.2.19.60 ..
text_mt: resembling barley and coral, shining with the red radiance of vermilion. / With the mantra beginning with 'ākṛṣṇena', he should place him upon the water-pot.

sanskrit_iast:
ihāgaccheti cāvāhya pādyārghyaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ ..
gaṃdhapuṣpādibhirbhaktyā pūjayettaṃ yathāvidhi .. .. 61 ..
meaning:
इहागच्छेति चावाह्य पाद्यार्घ्यैश्च पृथग्विधैः ..
गंधपुष्पादिभिर्भक्त्या पूजयेत्तं यथाविधि .. .. 61 ..
text_mt: Having invoked him with 'ihāgaccha', and with water for the feet, various kinds of respectful offerings, / scents, flowers, and the like, he should worship him with devotion according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
baliṃ ca lohitaṃ dadyātpāyasaṃ dadhikhaṃḍakam ..
ghṛtaliptaṃ ca śālyannaṃ patākāṃ raktavarṇikām .. 62 ..
meaning:
बलिं च लोहितं दद्यात्पायसं दधिखंडकम् ..
घृतलिप्तं च शाल्यन्नं पताकां रक्तवर्णिकाम् .. 62 ..
text_mt: He should offer a red animal sacrifice, milk-rice, curd mixed with sugar candy, / śāli rice smeared with ghee, and a red-coloured banner.

sanskrit_iast:
śvetāṃbaradharaṃ śvetaṃ śuklagaṃdhānu lepanam ..
dvibhujaṃ varadaṃ devaṃ gadāhastaṃ mahābalam .. 63 ..
meaning:
श्वेतांबरधरं श्वेतं शुक्लगंधानु लेपनम् ..
द्विभुजं वरदं देवं गदाहस्तं महाबलम् .. 63 ..
text_mt: [He should visualize Soma] wearing white garments, white, anointed with white-scented unguent, / two-armed, the boon-granting god, holding a mace in his hand, possessed of great strength,

sanskrit_iast:
nānābharaṇasaṃpannaṃ siddhagaṃdharvasevitam ..
śuklapadmāsanasthaṃ cāśvaṃ dadyācchvetabhūṣitam.. .. 64 ..
meaning:
नानाभरणसंपन्नं सिद्धगंधर्वसेवितम् ..
शुक्लपद्मासनस्थं चाश्वं दद्याच्छ्वेतभूषितम्.. .. 64 ..
text_mt: adorned with various ornaments, attended by siddhas and gandharvas, / seated upon a white lotus; and he should offer a horse adorned with white.

sanskrit_iast:
imaṃ devā iti maṃtreṇa sthāpayetpūrvadigdale ..
sitavastraiśca puṣpaiśca śuklamālyānulepanaiḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
इमं देवा इति मंत्रेण स्थापयेत्पूर्वदिग्दले ..
सितवस्त्रैश्च पुष्पैश्च शुक्लमाल्यानुलेपनैः .. 65 ..
text_mt: With the mantra beginning with 'imaṃ devāḥ', he should place him on the petal of the eastern direction, / [worshipping him] with white garments, flowers, white garlands, and unguents.

sanskrit_iast:
pāyasaiḥ śvetabalibhirdadhibhaktaṃ nivedayet..
dhūpaiḥ śvetapatākābhirnaivedyairvividhairapi .. 66 ..
meaning:
पायसैः श्वेतबलिभिर्दधिभक्तं निवेदयेत्..
धूपैः श्वेतपताकाभिर्नैवेद्यैर्विविधैरपि .. 66 ..
text_mt: He should present milk-rice, white offerings, curd-rice, / incenses, white banners, and also various kinds of food offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
raktamālyāṃbaraṃ devaṃ raktābharaṇabhūṣitam ..
sucārunayanaṃ raktaṃ raktapadmāsanasthitam .. 67 ..
meaning:
रक्तमाल्यांबरं देवं रक्ताभरणभूषितम् ..
सुचारुनयनं रक्तं रक्तपद्मासनस्थितम् .. 67 ..
text_mt: [He should visualize Maṅgala] as the god with red garlands and garments, adorned with red ornaments, / with very handsome eyes, red, seated upon a red lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
kirīṭakuṃḍaladharaṃ meṣakaṃṭhaṃ caturbhujam ..
varadaṃ yajñanāśaṃ ca śūlaśaktigadādharam .. 68 ..
meaning:
किरीटकुंडलधरं मेषकंठं चतुर्भुजम् ..
वरदं यज्ञनाशं च शूलशक्तिगदाधरम् .. 68 ..
text_mt: wearing a diadem and earrings, with the neck of a ram, four-armed, / granting boons, destroying sacrifices, and holding a trident, spear, and mace,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmapradaṃ devaṃ siddhagaṃdharvasevitam ..
ciṃtayetparayā bhaktyā maṃgalaṃ dharaṇīsutam .. 69 ..
meaning:
सर्वकामप्रदं देवं सिद्धगंधर्वसेवितम् ..
चिंतयेत्परया भक्त्या मंगलं धरणीसुतम् .. 69 ..
text_mt: the god who bestows all desires, attended by siddhas and gandharvas; / with supreme devotion he should meditate upon Maṅgala, the son of the Earth.

sanskrit_iast:
agnimīḻetimaṃtreṇa sthāpayedagnidigdale ..
pūjayedraktapuṣpaiśca raktamālyānulepanaiḥ .. 2.2.19.70 ..
meaning:
अग्निमीḻएतिमंत्रेण स्थापयेदग्निदिग्दले ..
पूजयेद्रक्तपुष्पैश्च रक्तमाल्यानुलेपनैः .. 2.2.19.70 ..
text_mt: With the mantra beginning with 'agnimīḻe', he should place him on the petal of the southeast direction. / He should worship him with red flowers, red garlands, and unguents,

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpai raktapatākābhirguḍabhaktanive danaiḥ ..
atasīpuṣpasaṃkāśaṃ karṇikārasamaprabham .. 71 ..
meaning:
धूपै रक्तपताकाभिर्गुडभक्तनिवे दनैः ..
अतसीपुष्पसंकाशं कर्णिकारसमप्रभम् .. 71 ..
text_mt: with incenses, red banners, and offerings of jaggery-rice. / [He should visualize Budha] resembling an atasī flower, with a radiance equal to a karṇikāra blossom,

sanskrit_iast:
rauhiṇeyaṃ mahākāyaṃ nīlanīrajalocanam ..
praśāṃtavadanaṃ devaṃ pītavastraṃ caturbhujam ..72..
meaning:
रौहिणेयं महाकायं नीलनीरजलोचनम् ..
प्रशांतवदनं देवं पीतवस्त्रं चतुर्भुजम् ..72..
text_mt: the son of Rohiṇī, having a huge body, with eyes like blue lotuses, / the god of tranquil countenance, wearing yellow garments, four-armed,

sanskrit_iast:
khaṅgacarmadharaṃ tadvadgadāparaśudhāriṇam ..
padmāsanagataṃ devaṃ pītapadmāsanasthitam .. 73..
meaning:
खङ्गचर्मधरं तद्वद्गदापरशुधारिणम् ..
पद्मासनगतं देवं पीतपद्मासनस्थितम् .. 73..
text_mt: holding a sword and a shield, and likewise bearing a mace and an axe, / the god seated in the lotus posture, seated upon a yellow lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
nānābharaṇasaṃpūrṇaṃ mṛgendravaravāhanam ..
udbudhyasveti maṃtreṇa yā myāṃ tu sthāpayedbudham .. 74 ..
meaning:
नानाभरणसंपूर्णं मृगेन्द्रवरवाहनम् ..
उद्बुध्यस्वेति मंत्रेण या म्यां तु स्थापयेद्बुधम् .. 74 ..
text_mt: fully adorned with various ornaments, having an excellent lion for his mount. / With the mantra beginning with 'udbudhyasva', he should place Budha in the southern direction.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedgandhapuṣpādyaiḥ pītagaṃdhānulepanaiḥ ..
vastraiḥ pītapatākābhirbalibhiḥ kṛśarānvitaiḥ .. 75 ..
meaning:
पूजयेद्गन्धपुष्पाद्यैः पीतगंधानुलेपनैः ..
वस्त्रैः पीतपताकाभिर्बलिभिः कृशरान्वितैः .. 75 ..
text_mt: He should worship him with scents, flowers, and the like, with yellow-scented unguents, / with garments, yellow banners, and offerings accompanied by kṛśara.

sanskrit_iast:
pītavarṇaṃ guruṃ dhyāyetpītapadmāsanasthitam ..
pītābharaṇasaṃpannaṃ pītavastraṃ caturbhujam ..76..
meaning:
पीतवर्णं गुरुं ध्यायेत्पीतपद्मासनस्थितम् ..
पीताभरणसंपन्नं पीतवस्त्रं चतुर्भुजम् ..76..
text_mt: He should visualize Guru as yellow-coloured, seated upon a yellow lotus, / equipped with yellow ornaments, wearing yellow garments, four-armed,

sanskrit_iast:
varadaṃ daṃḍahastaṃ ca sākṣasūtrakamaṃḍalum ..
pūjyamānaṃ sugaṃdharvaiḥ sendrairdevagaṇairapi ..77..
meaning:
वरदं दंडहस्तं च साक्षसूत्रकमंडलुम् ..
पूज्यमानं सुगंधर्वैः सेन्द्रैर्देवगणैरपि ..77..
text_mt: granting boons, holding a staff in hand, with a rosary and a water-pot, / being worshipped by noble gandharvas and even hosts of gods headed by Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspataya iti maṃtreṇa nairṛtyāṃ diśi saṃsthitam ..
pītacandanagaṃdhaiśca pītavastrādibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..78..
meaning:
बृहस्पतय इति मंत्रेण नैरृत्यां दिशि संस्थितम् ..
पीतचन्दनगंधैश्च पीतवस्त्रादिभूषणैः ..78..
text_mt: [Visualizing him] situated in the southwestern direction, with the mantra beginning with 'bṛhaspate', / with yellow sandalwood scents and ornaments such as yellow garments,

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpaiḥ pītapatākābhiḥ pītodakanivedanaiḥ..
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā puraṃdarapurohitam .. 79 ..
meaning:
धूपैः पीतपताकाभिः पीतोदकनिवेदनैः..
पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या पुरंदरपुरोहितम् .. 79 ..
text_mt: with incenses, yellow banners, and offerings of yellow water, / he should worship Purandara's priest with supreme devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyecchukraṃ bhṛgusutaṃ śvetapadmāsanasthitam ..
caturbhujaṃ mahākāyaṃ varadaṃ daṃḍadhāriṇam .. 2.2.19.80 ..
meaning:
ध्यायेच्छुक्रं भृगुसुतं श्वेतपद्मासनस्थितम् ..
चतुर्भुजं महाकायं वरदं दंडधारिणम् .. 2.2.19.80 ..
text_mt: He should visualize Śukra, the son of Bhṛgu, seated upon a white lotus, / four-armed, having a huge body, granting boons, carrying a staff,

sanskrit_iast:
mahābāhuṃ viśālākṣaṃ sākṣasūtrakamaṃḍalum ..
stūyamānaṃ muniśreṣṭhaiḥ sevitaṃ daityapuṅgavaiḥ .. 81 ..
meaning:
महाबाहुं विशालाक्षं साक्षसूत्रकमंडलुम् ..
स्तूयमानं मुनिश्रेष्ठैः सेवितं दैत्यपुङ्गवैः .. 81 ..
text_mt: having mighty arms, broad-eyed, with a rosary and a water-pot, / being praised by the foremost of sages, attended by the chiefs of the daityas,

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhāsanagataṃ devaṃ nīlendīvaralocanam ..
vilasatpuṇḍarīkasya mālābhirupaśobhitam .. 82 ..
meaning:
सिंहासनगतं देवं नीलेन्दीवरलोचनम् ..
विलसत्पुण्डरीकस्य मालाभिरुपशोभितम् .. 82 ..
text_mt: the god seated upon a throne, with eyes like blue water-lilies, / adorned with garlands of gleaming white lotuses,

sanskrit_iast:
nānādaityendraputrāṃśca pāṭhayantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ..
nānāśastrāstracaturaṃ nānāśāstraviśāradam .. 83 ..
meaning:
नानादैत्येन्द्रपुत्रांश्च पाठयन्तं मुहुर्मुहुः ..
नानाशस्त्रास्त्रचतुरं नानाशास्त्रविशारदम् .. 83 ..
text_mt: repeatedly instructing the various sons of the daitya kings, / skilled in various weapons and missiles, learned in various treatises.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dhyātvā bhṛguśreṣṭhaṃ japannannātparisrutam ..
manasā bhaktiyuktena sthāpayetpaścime dale .. 84 ..
meaning:
एवं ध्यात्वा भृगुश्रेष्ठं जपन्नन्नात्परिस्रुतम् ..
मनसा भक्तियुक्तेन स्थापयेत्पश्चिमे दले .. 84 ..
text_mt: Having thus visualized the foremost of the Bhṛgus, reciting the mantra beginning with 'annātparisrutaḥ', / he should place him with a mind endowed with devotion on the western petal.

sanskrit_iast:
sitacaṃdanavastraiśca dhūpamālyānulepanaiḥ ..
dhūpaiḥ śvetapatākābhiḥ saktubhiḥ kṣīrasaṃyutaiḥ .. 85 ..
meaning:
सितचंदनवस्त्रैश्च धूपमाल्यानुलेपनैः ..
धूपैः श्वेतपताकाभिः सक्तुभिः क्षीरसंयुतैः .. 85 ..
text_mt: With white sandalwood, garments, incense, garlands, and unguents, / with incenses, white banners, and roasted barley meal mixed with milk,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā puṃḍarīkākṣatairapi ..
dhyāyetsauriṃ caturbāhuṃ śūlahastaṃ varapradam .. 86..
meaning:
पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या पुंडरीकाक्षतैरपि ..
ध्यायेत्सौरिं चतुर्बाहुं शूलहस्तं वरप्रदम् .. 86..
text_mt: he should worship him with supreme devotion, and also with white lotuses and unhusked barley. / He should visualize Sauri as four-armed, holding a trident, bestowing boons,

sanskrit_iast:
indranīlanibhaṃ śyāmaṃ divya bāṇadhanurdharam..
indīvarāsanasthaṃ ca sarojavarasaprabham .. 87 ..
meaning:
इन्द्रनीलनिभं श्यामं दिव्य बाणधनुर्धरम्..
इन्दीवरासनस्थं च सरोजवरसप्रभम् .. 87 ..
text_mt: dark, resembling a sapphire, holding a divine bow and arrows, / seated upon a blue water-lily, with a brilliance equal to an excellent lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
nīlāṃbaradharaṃ nīlapadmamālopaśobhitam ..
ghorarūpaṃ mahākāyaṃ chāyāhṛdayanandanam.. 88 ..
meaning:
नीलांबरधरं नीलपद्ममालोपशोभितम् ..
घोररूपं महाकायं छायाहृदयनन्दनम्.. 88 ..
text_mt: wearing blue garments, adorned with a garland of blue lotuses, / of terrifying form, having a huge body, the delighter of the heart of Chāyā.

sanskrit_iast:
śannodevīti maṃtreṇa vāyavyāṃ diśi vinyaset ..
kṛṣṇacaṃdanavastraiśca kṛṣṇamālyānulepanaiḥ .. 89 ..
meaning:
शन्नोदेवीति मंत्रेण वायव्यां दिशि विन्यसेत् ..
कृष्णचंदनवस्त्रैश्च कृष्णमाल्यानुलेपनैः .. 89 ..
text_mt: With the mantra beginning with 'śaṃ no devīḥ', he should place him in the northwestern direction. / With black sandalwood, garments, black garlands, and unguents,

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpairnīlapatākābhirbalibhirmāṣamiśritaiḥ ..
dhūmravarṇaṃ sadā ketuṃ gadāhastaṃ varapradam .. 2.2.19.90 ..
meaning:
धूपैर्नीलपताकाभिर्बलिभिर्माषमिश्रितैः ..
धूम्रवर्णं सदा केतुं गदाहस्तं वरप्रदम् .. 2.2.19.90 ..
text_mt: with incenses, blue banners, and offerings mixed with black gram, / [he should worship Sauri. He should visualize] Ketu as ever smoke-coloured, with a mace in hand, bestowing boons,

sanskrit_iast:
dvibhujaṃ bhīmakāyaṃ ca dhūmrākṣaṃ dhūmravāsasam ..
ketuṃ kṛṇvanniti mantreṇa aiśā nyāṃ sthāpayeddiśi .. 91 ..
meaning:
द्विभुजं भीमकायं च धूम्राक्षं धूम्रवाससम् ..
केतुं कृण्वन्निति मन्त्रेण ऐशा न्यां स्थापयेद्दिशि .. 91 ..
text_mt: two-armed, with a dreadful body, smoke-coloured eyes, and smoke-coloured clothes. / With the mantra beginning with 'ketuṃ kṛṇvan', he should place him in the northeastern direction.

sanskrit_iast:
dhūmravarṇaiśca mālyaiśca dhūmragaṃdhānulepanaiḥ ..
dhūmradhūmrapatākābhirbalibhirmāṣamiśritaiḥ .. 92 ..
meaning:
धूम्रवर्णैश्च माल्यैश्च धूम्रगंधानुलेपनैः ..
धूम्रधूम्रपताकाभिर्बलिभिर्माषमिश्रितैः .. 92 ..
text_mt: With smoke-coloured garlands, smoke-coloured scents and unguents, / with greyish smoke-coloured banners, and offerings mixed with black gram,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā ketuṃ sarvārthasiddhidam ..
lokapālānahaṃ vakṣye sarvasiddhipradāyakān .. 93 ..
meaning:
पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या केतुं सर्वार्थसिद्धिदम् ..
लोकपालानहं वक्ष्ये सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकान् .. 93 ..
text_mt: he should worship Ketu, the granter of all desired ends, with supreme devotion. / I shall now declare the world protectors who bestow all accomplishments.

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣu pūjitamātreṣu nālabhyaṃ vidyate kvacit ..
devarājaṃ tato dhyāyetpuṣpabāṇacayaprabham ..
dvibhujaṃ pītasaṃkāśaṃ nīlendīvaralocanam .. 94 ..
meaning:
येषु पूजितमात्रेषु नालभ्यं विद्यते क्वचित् ..
देवराजं ततो ध्यायेत्पुष्पबाणचयप्रभम् ..
द्विभुजं पीतसंकाशं नीलेन्दीवरलोचनम् .. 94 ..
text_mt: As soon as these are worshipped, there is nothing anywhere that cannot be attained. / One should then meditate on the king of the gods, shining with a mass of flower-arrows, / two-armed, resembling yellow, with eyes like blue lotuses,

sanskrit_iast:
raktotpaladharaṃ tadvatpītavāsasamanvitam ..
cāmarāsaktahastaiśca kanyāratnaiśca śobhitam .. 95 ..
meaning:
रक्तोत्पलधरं तद्वत्पीतवाससमन्वितम् ..
चामरासक्तहस्तैश्च कन्यारत्नैश्च शोभितम् .. 95 ..
text_mt: holding a red lotus, likewise endowed with yellow garments, / and adorned with jewel-like maidens whose hands are engaged with chowries.

sanskrit_iast:
indrāṇīṃ ciṃtayedvāme utpaladvayadhāriṇīm ..
evaṃ saṃpūjayedbhaktyā surarājaṃ jagatprabhum ..
trātāramiti mantreṇa sthāpayetkarṇikottare .. 96 ..
meaning:
इन्द्राणीं चिंतयेद्वामे उत्पलद्वयधारिणीम् ..
एवं संपूजयेद्भक्त्या सुरराजं जगत्प्रभुम् ..
त्रातारमिति मन्त्रेण स्थापयेत्कर्णिकोत्तरे .. 96 ..
text_mt: One should contemplate Indrāṇī on his left, holding two lotuses. / In this way one should worship with devotion the king of the gods, the lord of the world; / one should install him to the north of the pericarp with the mantra 'trātāram'.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā dhṛpagaṃdhānulepanaiḥ ..
nānāvidhopahāraiśca patākābhirdhvajairapi .. 97 ..
meaning:
पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या धृपगंधानुलेपनैः ..
नानाविधोपहारैश्च पताकाभिर्ध्वजैरपि .. 97 ..
text_mt: One should worship him with supreme devotion, using incense, fragrant ointments, / various kinds of offerings, and also pennants and banners.

sanskrit_iast:
baliṃ kṣīrānvitaṃ dadyānmodakaṃ sitaśarkarām ..
uttaptasvarṇasaṃkāśaṃ vītihotraṃ caturbhujam .. 98 ..
meaning:
बलिं क्षीरान्वितं दद्यान्मोदकं सितशर्कराम् ..
उत्तप्तस्वर्णसंकाशं वीतिहोत्रं चतुर्भुजम् .. 98 ..
text_mt: One should offer a bali accompanied by milk, sweetmeats, and white sugar. / Resembling heated gold, four-armed Vītihotra (Agni),

sanskrit_iast:
ardhacandrasamasthaṃ ca ajavāhanamuttamam ..
jvālāvitānasaṃraktaṃ mūrdhni saptaśikhānvitam .. 99 ..
meaning:
अर्धचन्द्रसमस्थं च अजवाहनमुत्तमम् ..
ज्वालावितानसंरक्तं मूर्ध्नि सप्तशिखान्वितम् .. 99 ..
text_mt: seated as if on a half-moon, having an excellent ram as his mount, / reddened by an expanse of flames, endowed with seven crests on his head,

sanskrit_iast:
varadaṃ vibhayaṃ mālāṃ dakṣe sūtraṃ kamaṇḍalum ..
trinetraṃ raktanayanaṃ jaṭāmukuṭamaṃḍitam .. 2.2.19.100 ..
meaning:
वरदं विभयं मालां दक्षे सूत्रं कमण्डलुम् ..
त्रिनेत्रं रक्तनयनं जटामुकुटमंडितम् .. 2.2.19.100 ..
text_mt: granting boons, bestowing fearlessness, with a rosary, a cord, and a water-pot on the right, / three-eyed, with red eyes, adorned with a crown of matted locks,

sanskrit_iast:
nānābharaṇasaṃpannaṃ siddhagandharvasevitam ..
agnijihveti maṃtreṇa snāpayedagnidigdale .. 101 ..
meaning:
नानाभरणसंपन्नं सिद्धगन्धर्वसेवितम् ..
अग्निजिह्वेति मंत्रेण स्नापयेदग्निदिग्दले .. 101 ..
text_mt: endowed with various ornaments, attended by Siddhas and Gandharvas— / one should bathe and install him on the petal in the direction of Agni with the mantra 'agnijihva'.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedraktapuṣpaiśca raktamālyānulepanaiḥ ..
dhūpai raktapatākābhirbalibhiḥ pāyasairapi .. 102 ..
meaning:
पूजयेद्रक्तपुष्पैश्च रक्तमाल्यानुलेपनैः ..
धूपै रक्तपताकाभिर्बलिभिः पायसैरपि .. 102 ..
text_mt: One should worship him with red flowers, red garlands, and ointments, / with incenses, red pennants, and offerings along with rice-pudding.

sanskrit_iast:
nīlāñjanacayaprakhyaṃ nīlasiṃhāsanasthitam ..
mahāmahiṣamārūḍhaṃ daṃḍapāśadhara vibhum .. 103 ..
meaning:
नीलाञ्जनचयप्रख्यं नीलसिंहासनस्थितम् ..
महामहिषमारूढं दंडपाशधर विभुम् .. 103 ..
text_mt: Resembling a heap of blue collyrium, seated upon a blue throne, / mounted upon a great buffalo, bearing a staff and a noose, the lord,

sanskrit_iast:
karālavadanaṃ bhīmaṃ jvālā ghūrṇitalocanam ..
ghoradaṃṣṭrākarālaiśca kiṃkarāṇāṃ gaṇairvṛtam ..
mahiṣaṃ ciṃtayedvāme citraguptaṃ ca dakṣiṇe .. 104 ..
meaning:
करालवदनं भीमं ज्वाला घूर्णितलोचनम् ..
घोरदंष्ट्राकरालैश्च किंकराणां गणैर्वृतम् ..
महिषं चिंतयेद्वामे चित्रगुप्तं च दक्षिणे .. 104 ..
text_mt: having a dreadful face, terrible, with eyes rolling with flames, / surrounded by hosts of servants terrifying with fierce fangs— / one should meditate on Mahiṣa to his left and Citragupta to his right.

sanskrit_iast:
acchīyasa iti maṃtreṇa sthāpayedyamadigdale ..
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā dharmarājaṃ jagadgurum ..
rākṣasendraṃ mahākāyaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ dvibāhukam .. 105 ..
meaning:
अच्छीयस इति मंत्रेण स्थापयेद्यमदिग्दले ..
पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या धर्मराजं जगद्गुरुम् ..
राक्षसेन्द्रं महाकायं कृष्णवर्णं द्विबाहुकम् .. 105 ..
text_mt: One should install him on the petal in the direction of Yama with the mantra 'acchīyasa', / and worship with supreme devotion the King of Dharma, the guru of the world. / The lord of the Rākṣasas, of mighty body, dark-coloured, two-armed,

sanskrit_iast:
nānābharaṇasaṃpannaṃ khaṅgahastaṃ mahāba lam ..
varamuktāvimānasthaṃ ghorarūpaṃ jaleśvaram .. 106 ..
meaning:
नानाभरणसंपन्नं खङ्गहस्तं महाब लम् ..
वरमुक्ताविमानस्थं घोररूपं जलेश्वरम् .. 106 ..
text_mt: endowed with various ornaments, sword in hand, of great might, / stationed on an aerial chariot of choice pearls, of terrible form, the lord of waters (Nirṛti)—

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa ta iti maṃtreṇa nairṛtyāṃ sthāpayeddiśi ..
kṛṣṇacandanavastraiśca kṛṣṇamālyānulepanaiḥ .. 107 ..
meaning:
एष त इति मंत्रेण नैरृत्यां स्थापयेद्दिशि ..
कृष्णचन्दनवस्त्रैश्च कृष्णमाल्यानुलेपनैः .. 107 ..
text_mt: one should install him in the south-western direction with the mantra 'eṣa te', / with black sandalwood and garments, and with black garlands and unguents,

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpaiḥ kṛṣṇapatākābhirbalibhirmāṣamiśritaiḥ ..
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ śaṃkhakundendusaprabham .. 108 ..
meaning:
धूपैः कृष्णपताकाभिर्बलिभिर्माषमिश्रितैः ..
शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशं शंखकुन्देन्दुसप्रभम् .. 108 ..
text_mt: with incenses, black pennants, and offerings mixed with black gram. / Resembling pure crystal, possessing the radiance of a conch, kunda flower, and the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
dvibhujaṃ pāśahastaṃ ca sundarāṅgaṃ varapradam ..
varuṇasyeti maṃtreṇa sthāpayetpaścime dale .. 109 ..
meaning:
द्विभुजं पाशहस्तं च सुन्दराङ्गं वरप्रदम् ..
वरुणस्येति मंत्रेण स्थापयेत्पश्चिमे दले .. 109 ..
text_mt: two-armed, with a noose in his hand, having handsome limbs, bestowing boons— / one should install [Varuṇa] on the western petal with the mantra 'varuṇasya',

sanskrit_iast: sitacandanadhūpaiśca patākābhirdhvajairapi .. 2.2.19.110 ..
meaning: सितचन्दनधूपैश्च पताकाभिर्ध्वजैरपि .. 2.2.19.110 ..
text_mt: with white sandalwood and incenses, and also with pennants and banners.

sanskrit_iast:
samīraṇaṃ kuñjaravarṇasannibhaṃ mṛgādhirūḍhaṃ dvibhujaṃ dvinetram ..
dhvajāṃbaraṃ cāpi dadhānamekaṃ nīlāṃbaraṃ meghagaṇairvṛtaṃ ca .. 111 ..
meaning:
समीरणं कुञ्जरवर्णसन्निभं मृगाधिरूढं द्विभुजं द्विनेत्रम् ..
ध्वजांबरं चापि दधानमेकं नीलांबरं मेघगणैर्वृतं च .. 111 ..
text_mt: Samīraṇa (Vāyu), resembling the colour of an elephant, mounted on a deer, two-armed, two-eyed, / holding a banner and a garment, alone, clad in blue, and surrounded by hosts of clouds—

sanskrit_iast:
nīlacandanavastraiśca nīlamālyānulepanaiḥ ..
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā patākābhirdhvajairapi .. 112 ..
meaning:
नीलचन्दनवस्त्रैश्च नीलमाल्यानुलेपनैः ..
पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या पताकाभिर्ध्वजैरपि .. 112 ..
text_mt: with blue sandalwood and garments, and blue garlands and unguents, / one should worship him with supreme devotion, and also with pennants and banners,

sanskrit_iast: dhūpairnīlapatākābhirbalibhiḥ pāyasairapi .. 113 ..
meaning: धूपैर्नीलपताकाभिर्बलिभिः पायसैरपि .. 113 ..
text_mt: with incenses, blue pennants, and offerings along with rice-pudding.

sanskrit_iast:
