gadādharaṃ bhaktavarapradaṃ ca āvāhayeduttarapadmapatre .. 114 ..
meaning:
ध्यायेद्द्विनेत्रं द्विभुजं धनेशं पीतांबरं वै नरवाहनं च ..
गदाधरं भक्तवरप्रदं च आवाहयेदुत्तरपद्मपत्रे .. 114 ..
text_mt: One should meditate on two-eyed, two-armed Dhaneśa (Kubera), clad in yellow, with a human as his mount, / bearing a mace, bestowing boons on devotees, and invoke him on the northern lotus petal,

sanskrit_iast: gandhacaṃdanavastraiśca pītamālyānulepanaiḥ .. 115 ..
meaning: गन्धचंदनवस्त्रैश्च पीतमाल्यानुलेपनैः .. 115 ..
text_mt: with perfumes, sandalwood, garments, and yellow garlands and unguents,

sanskrit_iast: dhūpaiḥ pītapatākābhirbalibhiḥ pāyasairapi .. 116 ..
meaning: धूपैः पीतपताकाभिर्बलिभिः पायसैरपि .. 116 ..
text_mt: with incenses, yellow pennants, and offerings along with rice-pudding.

sanskrit_iast:
snigdhakarpūrasaṃkāśaṃ tuṣārakiraṇaprabham ..
triśūlatumburudharaṃ tathābhayavarapradam .. 117 ..
meaning:
स्निग्धकर्पूरसंकाशं तुषारकिरणप्रभम् ..
त्रिशूलतुम्बुरुधरं तथाभयवरप्रदम् .. 117 ..
text_mt: Resembling smooth camphor, possessing the radiance of the moon, / bearing a trident and a lute, and likewise granting fearlessness and boons,

sanskrit_iast:
uttaṃgavṛṣabhārūḍhaṃ trinetraṃ bhasmabhūṣitam ..
kapālamālinaṃ tadvatkhaṇḍeṃdukṛtaśekharam .. 118 ..
meaning:
उत्तंगवृषभारूढं त्रिनेत्रं भस्मभूषितम् ..
कपालमालिनं तद्वत्खण्डेंदुकृतशेखरम् .. 118 ..
text_mt: mounted upon a lofty bull, three-eyed, adorned with ashes, / wearing a garland of skulls, and likewise with a crescent moon as his crest—

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ dhyātvā maheśānaṃ sthāpayedīśadigdale .. 119 ..
meaning: एवं ध्यात्वा महेशानं स्थापयेदीशदिग्दले .. 119 ..
text_mt: having thus meditated upon Maheśāna, one should install him on the petal in the north-eastern direction.

sanskrit_iast: pūjayetparayā bhaktyā bhakṣyabhojyairanekaśaḥ .. .. 2.2.19.120 ..
meaning: पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या भक्ष्यभोज्यैरनेकशः .. .. 2.2.19.120 ..
text_mt: One should worship him with supreme devotion, with many kinds of edible and chewable foods,

sanskrit_iast:
sitadhvajapatākābhirbalibhiḥ pāyasādibhiḥ ..
tvamīśāna iti maṃtreṇa ṛṣiṃ chandaḥ samīrayan .. 121 ..
meaning:
सितध्वजपताकाभिर्बलिभिः पायसादिभिः ..
त्वमीशान इति मंत्रेण ऋषिं छन्दः समीरयन् .. 121 ..
text_mt: with white banners and pennants, and with offerings of rice-pudding and the like, / with the mantra 'tvamīśāna', reciting the seer and the metre.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇaṃ raktagaurāgaṃ śoṇa padmasamaprabham ..
rājīvalocanaṃ tadvatpadmagarbhasamaprabham .. 122 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्माणं रक्तगौरागं शोण पद्मसमप्रभम् ..
राजीवलोचनं तद्वत्पद्मगर्भसमप्रभम् .. 122 ..
text_mt: Brahmā, reddish-white in body, with the brilliance of a crimson lotus, / lotus-eyed, likewise having the lustre of the womb of a lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
padmāsanasthitaṃ tadvacchvetavastraṃ caturbhujam ..
caturmukhaṃ suraśreṣṭhaṃ meghagambhīranisvanam .. 123 ..
meaning:
पद्मासनस्थितं तद्वच्छ्वेतवस्त्रं चतुर्भुजम् ..
चतुर्मुखं सुरश्रेष्ठं मेघगम्भीरनिस्वनम् .. 123 ..
text_mt: seated upon a lotus seat, similarly clad in white garments, four-armed, / four-faced, the foremost of the gods, with a voice deep as a cloud,

sanskrit_iast:
rājahaṃsasamāyuktaṃ vimānavarasaṃsthitam ..
sruksruvau dakṣiṇe haste vāme daṃḍaṃ kamaṇḍalum ..124..
meaning:
राजहंससमायुक्तं विमानवरसंस्थितम् ..
स्रुक्स्रुवौ दक्षिणे हस्ते वामे दंडं कमण्डलुम् ..124..
text_mt: accompanied by a royal swan, seated in an excellent aerial chariot, / with the sruc and sruva ladles in his right hand, and a staff and water-pot in his left,

sanskrit_iast:
kurvāṇamiva lokāṃstrīnsiddhagandharvasevitam ..
ājyasthālīṃ tathaivāgre kuśāṃśca samidhaṃ tathā .. 125 ..
meaning:
कुर्वाणमिव लोकांस्त्रीन्सिद्धगन्धर्वसेवितम् ..
आज्यस्थालीं तथैवाग्रे कुशांश्च समिधं तथा .. 125 ..
text_mt: as if creating the three worlds, served by Siddhas and Gandharvas, / with a pot of clarified butter likewise in front, as well as kuśa grasses and sacrificial fuel,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmapārśve tu sāvitrīṃ dakṣiṇe tu sarasvatīm ..
ābrahmanniti maṃtreṇa sthāpayetpūrva digdale .. 126 ..
meaning:
वामपार्श्वे तु सावित्रीं दक्षिणे तु सरस्वतीम् ..
आब्रह्मन्निति मंत्रेण स्थापयेत्पूर्व दिग्दले .. 126 ..
text_mt: with Sāvitrī on his left side and Sarasvatī on his right— / one should install him on the eastern petal with the mantra 'ābrahman'.

sanskrit_iast:
nānābhakṣyopacāraiśca pūjayedgaṃdhacandanaiḥ ..
dhūpaiḥ śvetapatākābhirbalibhiścājyapāyasaiḥ .. 127 ..
meaning:
नानाभक्ष्योपचारैश्च पूजयेद्गंधचन्दनैः ..
धूपैः श्वेतपताकाभिर्बलिभिश्चाज्यपायसैः .. 127 ..
text_mt: One should worship him with various offerings of food, with fragrant ointments and sandalwood, / with incenses, white pennants, and offerings of clarified butter and rice-pudding.

sanskrit_iast:
anantaśuklavarṇābhaṃ pītavastraṃ caturbhujam ..
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇaṃ jagadīśvaram .. 128 ..
meaning:
अनन्तशुक्लवर्णाभं पीतवस्त्रं चतुर्भुजम् ..
शंखचक्रगदापद्मधारिणं जगदीश्वरम् .. 128 ..
text_mt: Infinite, with the radiance of a white colour, clad in yellow garments, four-armed, / bearing a conch, a discus, a mace, and a lotus, the lord of the universe,

sanskrit_iast:
ādhārabhūtaṃ jagatāṃ svarṇayajñopavītinam .
nānābharaṇasampannaṃ phaṇāśatasamanvitam.. .. 129 ..
meaning:
आधारभूतं जगतां स्वर्णयज्ञोपवीतिनम् .
नानाभरणसम्पन्नं फणाशतसमन्वितम्.. .. 129 ..
text_mt: the foundation of the worlds, possessing a golden sacred thread, / endowed with various ornaments, possessed of a hundred hoods—

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ namostviti maṃtreṇa sthāpayedvaruṇāṃtare ..
pūjayedbhakṣyabhojyaiśca dīpagandhānulepanaiḥ .. 2.2.19.130 ..
meaning:
ओं नमोस्त्विति मंत्रेण स्थापयेद्वरुणांतरे ..
पूजयेद्भक्ष्यभोज्यैश्च दीपगन्धानुलेपनैः .. 2.2.19.130 ..
text_mt: one should install [Ananta] in the western quarter with the mantra 'oṃ namo'stu', / and worship him with chewable and edible foods, and with lamps, fragrant unguents, and perfumes,

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpaiḥ śvetapatākābhirbalibhiścaiva nirmitaiḥ ..
tato maṇḍalapūrve tu brahmāṇaṃ pītavāsasam ...34...
meaning:
धूपैः श्वेतपताकाभिर्बलिभिश्चैव निर्मितैः ..
ततो मण्डलपूर्वे तु ब्रह्माणं पीतवाससम् ...34...
text_mt: with incenses, white pennants, and prepared offerings. / Then, in the east of the diagram, [one should meditate on] Brahmā clad in yellow garments,

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhujaṃ caturvaktraṃ sruvahastaṃ varapradam ..
bibhrataṃ ca śrutaṃ tadvattathā daṃḍakamaṇḍalū ..132..
meaning:
चतुर्भुजं चतुर्वक्त्रं स्रुवहस्तं वरप्रदम् ..
बिभ्रतं च श्रुतं तद्वत्तथा दंडकमण्डलू ..132..
text_mt: four-armed, four-faced, with a sacrificial ladle in his hand, granting boons, / holding the Veda likewise, and also a staff and a water-pot.

sanskrit_iast:
ābrahmanniti mantreṇa pūjayedgandhacandanaiḥ ..
dakṣiṇe tryaṃbakaṃ dhyāyecchūlakhaṭvāṃdhāriṇam .. 133 ..
meaning:
आब्रह्मन्निति मन्त्रेण पूजयेद्गन्धचन्दनैः ..
दक्षिणे त्र्यंबकं ध्यायेच्छूलखट्वांधारिणम् .. 133 ..
text_mt: One should worship him with perfumes and sandalwood using the mantra 'ābrahman'. / In the south, one should meditate on Tryambaka bearing a trident and a skull-staff,

sanskrit_iast:
varadaṃ ḍamarudharaṃ nāgayajñopavītinam ..
nibaddha jṛṭacandrārdhaṃ śuddhasphaṭikasannibham ... 134 ..
meaning:
वरदं डमरुधरं नागयज्ञोपवीतिनम् ..
निबद्ध जृटचन्द्रार्धं शुद्धस्फटिकसन्निभम् ... 134 ..
text_mt: granting boons, holding a ḍamaru, with a serpent for his sacred thread, / having the crescent moon bound in his matted locks, resembling pure crystal,

sanskrit_iast:
kapālamālinaṃ devaṃ bhujaṃgābharaṇānvitam..
trinetraṃ kundasaṃkāśaṃ bhūtapretagaṇairvṛtam.. 135 ..
meaning:
कपालमालिनं देवं भुजंगाभरणान्वितम्..
त्रिनेत्रं कुन्दसंकाशं भूतप्रेतगणैर्वृतम्.. 135 ..
text_mt: the god wearing a garland of skulls, endowed with serpent ornaments, / three-eyed, resembling a kunda flower, surrounded by hosts of bhūtas and pretas.

sanskrit_iast:
tryaṃbakaṃ ceti mantreṇa pūjayenmadhupāyasaiḥ ..
atasīpuṣpasaṃkāśaṃ hārakeyūrabhūṣitam .. 136 ..
meaning:
त्र्यंबकं चेति मन्त्रेण पूजयेन्मधुपायसैः ..
अतसीपुष्पसंकाशं हारकेयूरभूषितम् .. 136 ..
text_mt: One should worship him with the mantra 'tryambakam' with honey and rice-pudding. / [In the west, one should meditate on Viṣṇu] resembling the flax flower, adorned with necklaces and armlets,

sanskrit_iast:
nānābharaṇasaṃpannaṃ pītavastraṃ caturbhujam ..
dakṣiṇe ca gadāṃ cakraṃ vāme śaṃkhaṃ sapadmakam .. 137 ..
meaning:
नानाभरणसंपन्नं पीतवस्त्रं चतुर्भुजम् ..
दक्षिणे च गदां चक्रं वामे शंखं सपद्मकम् .. 137 ..
text_mt: endowed with various ornaments, clad in yellow garments, four-armed, / with a mace and a discus on the right, and a conch along with a lotus on the left.

sanskrit_iast:
śriyā dakṣiṇato vāme sarasvatyā samanvitam ..
tadviṣṇoriti maṃtreṇa sthāpayetpaścime tataḥ .. 138 ..
meaning:
श्रिया दक्षिणतो वामे सरस्वत्या समन्वितम् ..
तद्विष्णोरिति मंत्रेण स्थापयेत्पश्चिमे ततः .. 138 ..
text_mt: Accompanied by Śrī on his right side and Sarasvatī on his left, / he should then install [him] in the west with the mantra 'tad viṣṇoḥ'.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedgandhapuṣpādyaiḥ pāyasena ghṛtena ca ..
gaṇeśaṃ tu caturbāhuṃ vyālayajñopavītinam .. 139 ..
meaning:
पूजयेद्गन्धपुष्पाद्यैः पायसेन घृतेन च ..
गणेशं तु चतुर्बाहुं व्यालयज्ञोपवीतिनम् .. 139 ..
text_mt: He should worship with scents, flowers, and the like, with pāyasa and with ghee, / and [install] Gaṇeśa, who has four arms and wears a serpent as his sacred thread,

sanskrit_iast:
gajendravadanaṃ devaṃ śvetavastraṃ caturbhujam ..
paraśuṃ laguḍaṃ vāme dakṣiṇe daṃḍamutpalam .. 2.2.19.140 ..
meaning:
गजेन्द्रवदनं देवं श्वेतवस्त्रं चतुर्भुजम् ..
परशुं लगुडं वामे दक्षिणे दंडमुत्पलम् .. 2.2.19.140 ..
text_mt: the god who has the face of an elephant-king, wears white garments, has four arms, / holds an axe and a club in his left [hands], and a staff and a blue lotus in his right;

sanskrit_iast:
mūṣakasthaṃ mahākāyaṃ śaṅkhakundeṃdusaprabham ..
yuktaṃ buddhikubuddhibhyāmekadaṃtaṃ bhayāpaham .. 141 ..
meaning:
मूषकस्थं महाकायं शङ्खकुन्देंदुसप्रभम् ..
युक्तं बुद्धिकुबुद्धिभ्यामेकदंतं भयापहम् .. 141 ..
text_mt: seated upon a mouse, having a huge body, possessing the luster of a conch, a kunda flower, and the moon, / accompanied by Buddhi and Kubuddhi, single-tusked, dispelling fear,

sanskrit_iast:
nānābharaṇasaṃpannaṃ sarvāpattivināśanam ..
gaṇānāṃ tviti mantreṇa vinyaseduttare dhruvam .. 142 ..
meaning:
नानाभरणसंपन्नं सर्वापत्तिविनाशनम् ..
गणानां त्विति मन्त्रेण विन्यसेदुत्तरे ध्रुवम् .. 142 ..
text_mt: endowed with various ornaments, destroying all calamities; / he must certainly place [him] in the north with the mantra 'gaṇānāṃ tvā'.

sanskrit_iast:
uttaptajāṃbūnadahemasannibhāṃ lakṣmīṃ sarojāsanasaṃsthitāṃ śubhām..
vāme sarojaṃ dadhatīṃ tathaiva haste ca dakṣe dhṛtacāmarāṃ ca .. 143 ..
meaning:
उत्तप्तजांबूनदहेमसन्निभां लक्ष्मीं सरोजासनसंस्थितां शुभाम्..
वामे सरोजं दधतीं तथैव हस्ते च दक्षे धृतचामरां च .. 143 ..
text_mt: Lakṣmī, resembling molten Jāmbūnada gold, seated on a lotus throne, auspicious, / holding a lotus in her left [hand] and likewise holding a chowrie in her right hand,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīśca teti ca mantreṇa aiśānyāṃ maṃḍalādbahiḥ ..
sthāpayetpūjayedbhaktyā sitacandana paṅkajaiḥ .. 144 ..
meaning:
श्रीश्च तेति च मन्त्रेण ऐशान्यां मंडलाद्बहिः ..
स्थापयेत्पूजयेद्भक्त्या सितचन्दन पङ्कजैः .. 144 ..
text_mt: he should install in the northeast outside the maṇḍala with the mantra 'śrīś ca te' / and worship her with devotion using white sandalwood and lotuses.

sanskrit_iast: modakaṃ paramānnaṃ ca yavakṣīraṃ nivedayet .. 145 ..
meaning: मोदकं परमान्नं च यवक्षीरं निवेदयेत् .. 145 ..
text_mt: He should offer modakas, supreme food (paramānna), and barley porridge.

sanskrit_iast:
tato devīmaṃbikāṃ divyarūpāṃ brahmeṃdrādyaiḥ stūyamānāṃ trinetrām ..
siṃheśasthāṃ taptajāṃbūnadābhāṃ candrārddhenābaddhamauliṃ jaṭābhiḥ .. 146 ..
meaning:
ततो देवीमंबिकां दिव्यरूपां ब्रह्मेंद्राद्यैः स्तूयमानां त्रिनेत्राम् ..
सिंहेशस्थां तप्तजांबूनदाभां चन्द्रार्द्धेनाबद्धमौलिं जटाभिः .. 146 ..
text_mt: Then [he should meditate upon] goddess Ambikā, divine in form, praised by Brahmā, Indra, and others, three-eyed, / seated on the king of lions, radiant like molten Jāmbūnada gold, her crest bound by matted locks with a half-moon,

sanskrit_iast:
divyairvastrairbāhubhiḥ sāgralambairdivyairmālyairbhūṣaṇaiḥ svairupetām ..
brahmeṃdrādyairdurjayāṃ māhiṣāsyaṃ tīkṣṇairastrairdānavaṃ mardayaṃtīm .. 147 ..
meaning:
दिव्यैर्वस्त्रैर्बाहुभिः साग्रलम्बैर्दिव्यैर्माल्यैर्भूषणैः स्वैरुपेताम् ..
ब्रह्मेंद्राद्यैर्दुर्जयां माहिषास्यं तीक्ष्णैरस्त्रैर्दानवं मर्दयंतीम् .. 147 ..
text_mt: clad in divine garments, her arms hanging forward, adorned with divine garlands and her own ornaments, / invincible to Brahmā, Indra, and others, crushing the buffalo-faced demon with sharp weapons,

sanskrit_iast:
śūlaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ bāṇaśaktī ca tīkṣṇe khaḍgaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ bibhratīṃ dakṣiṇena ..
cāpaṃ pāśaṃ kheṭakaṃ cāṃkuśaṃ ca ghaṇṭāṃ vāme bibhratīṃ vai kuṭhāram .. 148 ..
meaning:
शूलं तीक्ष्णं बाणशक्ती च तीक्ष्णे खड्गं तीक्ष्णं बिभ्रतीं दक्षिणेन ..
चापं पाशं खेटकं चांकुशं च घण्टां वामे बिभ्रतीं वै कुठारम् .. 148 ..
text_mt: holding in her right [hands] a sharp trident, a sharp arrow and spear, and a sharp sword, / and holding in her left [hands] indeed a bow, a noose, a shield, a goad, a bell, and an axe,

sanskrit_iast:
śiraśchedādardhajātaṃ kabandhaṃ khaḍgaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ bibhratīṃ daityarājam ..
nāgaiḥ pāśairveṣṭayitvā samaṃ tācchūlenainaṃ nighnatīṃ dehamadhye .. 149 ..
meaning:
शिरश्छेदादर्धजातं कबन्धं खड्गं तीक्ष्णं बिभ्रतीं दैत्यराजम् ..
नागैः पाशैर्वेष्टयित्वा समं ताच्छूलेनैनं निघ्नतीं देहमध्ये .. 149 ..
text_mt: binding with serpent-nooses the king of the Daityas who has become half a headless trunk through the severing of his head and who holds a sharp sword, / and slaying him completely with her trident in the middle of his body,

sanskrit_iast:
sendrairdevaiḥ stūyamānāṃ suveṇīṃ gaṃdharvādyaiḥ siddhasaṃghaiśca sevyām ..
nānāvastrairbhūṣaṇairdīpyamānāṃ dhyāyeddevīmaṃbikāmujvalaṃtīm .. 2.2.19.150 ..
meaning:
सेन्द्रैर्देवैः स्तूयमानां सुवेणीं गंधर्वाद्यैः सिद्धसंघैश्च सेव्याम् ..
नानावस्त्रैर्भूषणैर्दीप्यमानां ध्यायेद्देवीमंबिकामुज्वलंतीम् .. 2.2.19.150 ..
text_mt: praised by the gods accompanied by Indra, having lovely braids, attended by Gandharvas and hosts of Siddhas, / blazing with diverse garments and ornaments—he should meditate on the shining goddess Ambikā.

sanskrit_iast:
vastrairmālyairyakṣadhūpairvitānairbhakṣyairbhojyairmodakaiḥ pāyasaiśca ..
māṃsaiḥ piṣṭaiśchāgalāḍhyairaśeṣaiḥ pūjyā devī caṃḍikā'bhīṣṭadā ca .. 151 ..
meaning:
वस्त्रैर्माल्यैर्यक्षधूपैर्वितानैर्भक्ष्यैर्भोज्यैर्मोदकैः पायसैश्च ..
मांसैः पिष्टैश्छागलाढ्यैरशेषैः पूज्या देवी चंडिकाऽभीष्टदा च .. 151 ..
text_mt: With garments, garlands, yakṣadhūpa incenses, canopies, foods to be chewed and eaten, modakas and pāyasas, / with meats and flour-cakes abundant with goat meat, in full, goddess Caṇḍikā is to be worshipped, granting desired boons.

sanskrit_iast: śyāmāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ dhyāyetpaṃkajadvayadhāriṇīm .. 152 ..
meaning: श्यामां च पृथिवीं ध्यायेत्पंकजद्वयधारिणीम् .. 152 ..
text_mt: And he should meditate upon dark Pṛthivī holding two lotuses,

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍūkasthāṃ dvibhujāṃ syonā pṛthivīti cārcayet ..
nairṛtyāṃ viśvakarmāṇaṃ dvibhujaṃ ṭaṃkadhāriṇam .. 193 ..
meaning:
मण्डूकस्थां द्विभुजां स्योना पृथिवीति चार्चयेत् ..
नैरृत्यां विश्वकर्माणं द्विभुजं टंकधारिणम् .. 193 ..
text_mt: seated on a frog, two-armed, and he should worship her with the [mantra] 'syonā pṛthivī'. / In the southwest, [he should install] Viśvakarman, two-armed and holding a chisel,

sanskrit_iast:
utpalaṃ dakṣiṇe haste padmasthaṃ pītavāsasam ..
evaṃ dhyātvā tato brahmanniti maṃtreṇa pūjayet .. 154 ..
meaning:
उत्पलं दक्षिणे हस्ते पद्मस्थं पीतवाससम् ..
एवं ध्यात्वा ततो ब्रह्मन्निति मंत्रेण पूजयेत् .. 154 ..
text_mt: holding a blue lotus in his right hand, seated on a lotus, wearing yellow garments. / Having meditated thus, he should then worship him with the mantra 'brahmann'.

sanskrit_iast:
svasthāṃ sarasvatīṃ dhyāyedvaradābhayadāyinīm ..
pītavastrāṃ sumukuṭāṃ devagandharvasevitām .. 155 ..
meaning:
स्वस्थां सरस्वतीं ध्यायेद्वरदाभयदायिनीम् ..
पीतवस्त्रां सुमुकुटां देवगन्धर्वसेविताम् .. 155 ..
text_mt: He should meditate on peaceful Sarasvatī granting boons and protection, / wearing yellow garments, having a fine crown, and attended by gods and Gandharvas.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmadhā iti mantreṇa pūjayetsitacaṃdanaiḥ ..
baliṃ śveta caruṃ dadyātkṛśaraṃ yāvakaṃ tathā .. 156 ..
meaning:
यामधा इति मन्त्रेण पूजयेत्सितचंदनैः ..
बलिं श्वेत चरुं दद्यात्कृशरं यावकं तथा .. 156 ..
text_mt: He should worship her with the mantra 'yām adhāḥ' using white sandalwood; / he should offer a white offering of caru, as well as kṛśara and barley porridge.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpayedvāmadigbhāge kuṃdapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet ..
pūrvādidvāradeśe tu pūjayecca marudgaṇaiḥ .. 157 ..
meaning:
स्थापयेद्वामदिग्भागे कुंदपुष्पैः प्रपूजयेत् ..
पूर्वादिद्वारदेशे तु पूजयेच्च मरुद्गणैः .. 157 ..
text_mt: He should install [her] in the western direction and worship her with kunda flowers. / At the door-region starting from the east, he should worship with the host of Maruts.

sanskrit_iast:
agnyādiṣu ca koṇeṣu bahirbhūtānsamācaret ..
piśācā rākṣasā bhūtā vetālakapijātayaḥ .. 158 ..
meaning:
अग्न्यादिषु च कोणेषु बहिर्भूतान्समाचरेत् ..
पिशाचा राक्षसा भूता वेतालकपिजातयः .. 158 ..
text_mt: And in the corners beginning with Agni's [southeast], he should assign the spirits who are outside: / piśācas, rākṣasas, ghosts, vetālas, and monkey-species,

sanskrit_iast:
nirṇāsāścaiva te sarve raudrā vikṛtarūpiṇaḥ ..
tato maṇḍala madhye tu vāruṇaṃ pūrvavartmanā .. 159 ..
meaning:
निर्णासाश्चैव ते सर्वे रौद्रा विकृतरूपिणः ..
ततो मण्डल मध्ये तु वारुणं पूर्ववर्त्मना .. 159 ..
text_mt: and all those noseless, fierce beings of deformed shapes. / Then, in the center of the maṇḍala, according to the former course, for Varuṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrayetkalaśe tatra suvarṇādivinirmitam ..
kūrmaṃ kūrmākṛtiṃ kuryācchuddhasvarṇena sattamāḥ .. 2.2.19.160 ..
meaning:
पूरयेत्कलशे तत्र सुवर्णादिविनिर्मितम् ..
कूर्मं कूर्माकृतिं कुर्याच्छुद्धस्वर्णेन सत्तमाः .. 2.2.19.160 ..
text_mt: he should fill the water-pot. In it, [he should place] what is made of gold and other metals: / O best of men, he should fashion a tortoise in tortoise-shape from pure gold,

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhatparva pramāṇena rājatasya ca durlabham ..
pādaṃ pādena mānena aṃgulaṃ parimaṇḍalam .. 161 ..
meaning:
बृहत्पर्व प्रमाणेन राजतस्य च दुर्लभम् ..
पादं पादेन मानेन अंगुलं परिमण्डलम् .. 161 ..
text_mt: of the measure of a large knuckle; and [one] of silver, which is hard to obtain, / measuring a quarter [of it] by a quarter, a finger-breadth in circumference.

sanskrit_iast:
prauṣṭhīmatsyaṃ tathā kuryātkulīraṃ tāmranirmitam ..
tenaikasya vinirmāṇaṃ dvyaṃgulāyāmavistṛtam .. 162 ..
meaning:
प्रौष्ठीमत्स्यं तथा कुर्यात्कुलीरं ताम्रनिर्मितम् ..
तेनैकस्य विनिर्माणं द्व्यंगुलायामविस्तृतम् .. 162 ..
text_mt: Likewise, he should fashion a prauṣṭhī fish, and a crab made of copper; / the fabrication of each one by him should be two finger-breadths in length and width.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā mānena maṇḍūkaṃ tāṃ bhūmiṃ munisattamāḥ ..
śiśumāraṃ ca vai samyaktolakadvayanirmitam .. 163 ..
meaning:
तथा मानेन मण्डूकं तां भूमिं मुनिसत्तमाः ..
शिशुमारं च वै सम्यक्तोलकद्वयनिर्मितम् .. 163 ..
text_mt: By the same measure, O best of sages, [he should fashion] a frog and that earth, / and properly a porpoise made of two tolas,

sanskrit_iast:
aṃgulatrayadīrghaṃ ca yathā tasyākṛtirbhavet ..
sitacandanavastraiśca pūjanīyāḥ samaṃtataḥ .. 164 ..
meaning:
अंगुलत्रयदीर्घं च यथा तस्याकृतिर्भवेत् ..
सितचन्दनवस्त्रैश्च पूजनीयाः समंततः .. 164 ..
text_mt: and three finger-breadths long, so that it has its proper shape. / They should be worshipped all around with white sandalwood and garments,

sanskrit_iast:
yāvakaiśca viśeṣeṇa bahumaṃtraviśāradān ..
bahvṛcau pūrvamatsyārthe dakṣiṇe tu yajurvidau .. 165 ..
meaning:
यावकैश्च विशेषेण बहुमंत्रविशारदान् ..
बह्वृचौ पूर्वमत्स्यार्थे दक्षिणे तु यजुर्विदौ .. 165 ..
text_mt: and especially with barley offerings. [He should summon] those versed in many mantras: / two Ṛgvedic priests for the eastern fish, and two Yajurvedic priests in the south,

sanskrit_iast:
sāsanau paścime cātha uttare'tharvaṇau smṛtau ..
jayadhvamiti tānbrūyāddhotṛkānpunareva hi .. 166 ..
meaning:
सासनौ पश्चिमे चाथ उत्तरेऽथर्वणौ स्मृतौ ..
जयध्वमिति तान्ब्रूयाद्धोतृकान्पुनरेव हि .. 166 ..
text_mt: two Sāmavedic priests in the west, and two Atharvavedic priests are prescribed for the north. / He should again say to those Hotṛ priests: 'Be victorious!'

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpayitvā pṛthaksūtre sarpaṃ ca mātaruddīpameva ca ..
pañcāṃgaṃ śivasūktaṃ ca yathā viṣṇorharasya ca .. 167 ..
meaning:
स्थापयित्वा पृथक्सूत्रे सर्पं च मातरुद्दीपमेव च ..
पञ्चांगं शिवसूक्तं च यथा विष्णोर्हरस्य च .. 167 ..
text_mt: Having placed on separate threads the serpent, the mother, and the lamp, / and the five-part Śivasūkta, as well as those of Viṣṇu and Hara,

sanskrit_iast:
jayāgrataḥ puruṣasūktamadbhyaḥ saṃbhūtameva ca ..
āśuḥ śiśānamārabhya vayaṃ moṣāṃgarudrake .. 168 ..
meaning:
जयाग्रतः पुरुषसूक्तमद्भ्यः संभूतमेव च ..
आशुः शिशानमारभ्य वयं मोषांगरुद्रके .. 168 ..
text_mt: the Puruṣasūkta before Jaya, the 'adbhyaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ', / beginning with 'āśuḥ śiśānaḥ', and in the minor Rudra 'vayaṃ mo ṣu',

sanskrit_iast:
yajjāgrataścāgneśca viṣṇorarāṭameva ca ..
samastādhyāyarudreṇa śatarudrākhyamīritam .. .. 169 ..
meaning:
यज्जाग्रतश्चाग्नेश्च विष्णोरराटमेव च ..
समस्ताध्यायरुद्रेण शतरुद्राख्यमीरितम् .. .. 169 ..
text_mt: 'yajjāgrataḥ', and of Agni, and 'viṣṇor arāṭam'— / with the complete chapter of Rudra, it is designated as the Śatarudra.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāṃgarudrasya puṣpadaṃta ṛṣirgāyatrī chando vedāhametadbījaṃ śrīścatripād ūrdhva ud ait puruṣaḥ pādo 'syehābhavat punaḥ . - te iti śaktirnamaste rudra iti nāyakaḥ paramarudro devatā parama stutau viniyogaḥ ..
saptāṃgarudrasya puṣpadaṃtaṛṣiḥ paṃktiśchaṃdaḥ ..
tryaṃbakamiti aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ ..
tripādūrdhvamiti tarjanībhyāṃ svāhā ..
vedāhamiti madhyamābhyāṃ vaṣaṭ ..
amīṣāṃ citramiti anāmikābhyāṃ hum ..
yavāgūṃ soma iti kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ ..
parito dhenumiti karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyām astrāya phaṭ iti ..
yajjāgrata iti hṛdayāya namaḥ ..
sahasraśīrṣeti śirase svāhā ..
adbhyaḥ saṃbhūta iti śikhāyai vaṣaṭ ..
āśuḥ śiśāna iti kavacābhyāṃ huṃ ..
namaste rudra iti netratrayāya vauṣaṭ ..
rūḍhaṃ brahmanniti astrāya phaṭ ..
caturdikṣu choṭikāṃdānam .. iti sarvāṃgeṣu ..)
home pravartamāne tu sūktānanyāṃśca vai japet ..
prajapedvāruṇaṃ sūktaṃ tathā ca pālasūktakam .. 2.2.19.170 ..
meaning:
पञ्चांगरुद्रस्य पुष्पदंत ऋषिर्गायत्री छन्दो वेदाहमेतद्बीजं श्रीश्चत्रिपाद् ऊर्ध्व उद् ऐत् पुरुषः पादो ऽस्येहाभवत् पुनः . - ते इति शक्तिर्नमस्ते रुद्र इति नायकः परमरुद्रो देवता परम स्तुतौ विनियोगः ..
सप्तांगरुद्रस्य पुष्पदंतऋषिः पंक्तिश्छंदः ..
त्र्यंबकमिति अंगुष्ठाभ्यां नमः ..
त्रिपादूर्ध्वमिति तर्जनीभ्यां स्वाहा ..
वेदाहमिति मध्यमाभ्यां वषट् ..
अमीषां चित्रमिति अनामिकाभ्यां हुम् ..
यवागूं सोम इति कनिष्ठिकाभ्यां वौषट् ..
परितो धेनुमिति करतलकरपृष्ठाभ्याम् अस्त्राय फट् इति ..
यज्जाग्रत इति हृदयाय नमः ..
सहस्रशीर्षेति शिरसे स्वाहा ..
अद्भ्यः संभूत इति शिखायै वषट् ..
आशुः शिशान इति कवचाभ्यां हुं ..
नमस्ते रुद्र इति नेत्रत्रयाय वौषट् ..
रूढं ब्रह्मन्निति अस्त्राय फट् ..
चतुर्दिक्षु छोटिकांदानम् .. इति सर्वांगेषु ..)
होमे प्रवर्तमाने तु सूक्तानन्यांश्च वै जपेत् ..
प्रजपेद्वारुणं सूक्तं तथा च पालसूक्तकम् .. 2.2.19.170 ..
text_mt: For the five-part Rudra, Puṣpadanta is the seer, Gāyatrī the meter, 'vedāham etaṃ' the seed, 'śrīś ca' ['tripād ūrdhva ud ait puruṣaḥ pādo 'syehābhavat punaḥ'] - 'te' the power, 'namas te rudra' the leader, Parama-Rudra the deity, and the application is in supreme praise. / For the seven-part Rudra, the seer is Puṣpadanta and the meter is Paṅkti. / 'tryambakaṃ'—homage to the thumbs. / 'tripād ūrdhvam'—svāhā to the forefingers. / 'vedāham'—vaṣaṭ to the middle fingers. / 'amīṣāṃ citram'—hum to the ring fingers. / 'yavāgūṃ soma'—vauṣaṭ to the little fingers. / 'parito dhenum'—phaṭ for the weapon to the palms and backs of the hands. / 'yajjāgrataḥ'—homage to the heart. / 'sahasraśīrṣā'—svāhā to the head. / 'adbhyaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ'—vaṣaṭ to the crest. / 'āśuḥ śiśānaḥ'—huṃ to the armors. / 'namas te rudra'—vauṣaṭ to the three eyes. / 'rūḍhaṃ brahmann'—phaṭ for the weapon. / Snapping of fingers in the four directions. Thus upon all limbs. / While the fire-oblation is taking place, he should indeed recite the other hymns: / he should recite the hymn to Varuṇa, and likewise the guardian hymn,

sanskrit_iast:
rātrisūktaṃ ca raudraṃ ca pāvamānaṃ samujjvalam ..
japecca pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ sarvatovarataṃ pṛthak .. 171 ..
meaning:
रात्रिसूक्तं च रौद्रं च पावमानं समुज्ज्वलम् ..
जपेच्च पौरुषं सूक्तं सर्वतोवरतं पृथक् .. 171 ..
text_mt: and the Rātrisūkta, and the Raudra, and the brilliant Pāvamāna; / and he should recite separately the Puruṣasūkta that faces all directions.

sanskrit_iast:
śāktaṃ raudraṃ ca saumyaṃ ca kūṣmāṇḍaṃ jātavedasam ..
saurasūktaṃ ca yajato dakṣiṇena yajurvidaḥ .. 172 ..
meaning:
शाक्तं रौद्रं च सौम्यं च कूष्माण्डं जातवेदसम् ..
सौरसूक्तं च यजतो दक्षिणेन यजुर्विदः .. 172 ..
text_mt: The Śākta hymn, the Raudra hymn, the Saumya hymn, the Kūṣmāṇḍa hymn, the Jātavedasa hymn, / and the Saura hymn, are chanted to the south by one knowing the Yajurveda who performs the sacrifice;

sanskrit_iast:
vairājaṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ sauvarṇaṃ rudrasaṃhitām ..
śaiśavaṃ pañcanirayaṃ gāyatryaṃ jyeṣṭhasāma ca .. 173 ..
meaning:
वैराजं पौरुषं सूक्तं सौवर्णं रुद्रसंहिताम् ..
शैशवं पञ्चनिरयं गायत्र्यं ज्येष्ठसाम च .. 173 ..
text_mt: the Vairāja hymn, the Pauruṣa hymn, the Sauvarṇa hymn, the Rudrasaṃhitā, / the Śaiśava, the Pañcaniraya, the Gāyatra, and the Jyeṣṭhasāman;

sanskrit_iast:
vāmadevyaṃ bṛhatsāma tathā caiva rathaṃtaram ..
govrataṃ ca vikarṇaṃ ca rakṣoghnaṃ pāvanaṃ smṛtam .. 174 ..
meaning:
वामदेव्यं बृहत्साम तथा चैव रथंतरम् ..
गोव्रतं च विकर्णं च रक्षोघ्नं पावनं स्मृतम् .. 174 ..
text_mt: the Vāmadevya, the Bṛhatsāman, and likewise the Rathaṃtara, / the Govrata, the Vikarṇa, the Rakṣoghna, considered purifying,

sanskrit_iast:
gāyaṃtaṃ brāhmaṇā ye ca pūrvādidvāradeśataḥ ..
annātparisruta iti pañcapūrvaṃ saurasūktakam .. 175 ..
meaning:
गायंतं ब्राह्मणा ये च पूर्वादिद्वारदेशतः ..
अन्नात्परिस्रुत इति पञ्चपूर्वं सौरसूक्तकम् .. 175 ..
text_mt: which the Brahmins sing starting from the eastern entrance and the other quarters. / The Saura hymn, preceded by five [verses], begins with *annāt parisrutaḥ*;

sanskrit_iast:
rudrādhyāyaṃ ca pañcāṃgaṃ raudra ityabhidhīyate ..
āpyāyasveti ca catuḥ saumyaṃ sūktaṃ pracakṣate .. 176 ..
meaning:
रुद्राध्यायं च पञ्चांगं रौद्र इत्यभिधीयते ..
आप्यायस्वेति च चतुः सौम्यं सूक्तं प्रचक्षते .. 176 ..
text_mt: the Rudrādhyāya with its five limbs is called the Raudra hymn; / that which begins with *āpyāyasva*, consisting of four [verses], they proclaim as the Saumya hymn;

sanskrit_iast:
īśāvetyādi svāṃgaṃ ca kauṣmāṃḍaṃ daśamaṃ smṛtam ..
agre bṛhanniti navasūktaṃ vai jātavedasam .. 177 ..
meaning:
ईशावेत्यादि स्वांगं च कौष्मांडं दशमं स्मृतम् ..
अग्रे बृहन्निति नवसूक्तं वै जातवेदसम् .. 177 ..
text_mt: that which begins with *īśāvāsyam* along with its own limbs, the tenth, is considered the Kauṣmāṇḍa; / the hymn of nine verses beginning with *agre bṛhat* is indeed the Jātavedasa;

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśaṃ tu vibhrāḍ vṛhatsauraṃ sūktaṃ prakīrtitam ..
saurasūktaṃ dhruvosīti iṣavo maṃgalaṃ smṛtam .. 178 ..
meaning:
षोडशं तु विभ्राड् वृहत्सौरं सूक्तं प्रकीर्तितम् ..
सौरसूक्तं ध्रुवोसीति इषवो मंगलं स्मृतम् .. 178 ..
text_mt: the sixteenth, beginning with *vibhrāḍ bṛhat*, is proclaimed as the Saura hymn; / the Saura hymn beginning with *dhruvo 'si* and *iṣavaḥ* is considered auspicious;

sanskrit_iast:
rātrisūktaṃ hi yajvāgne rakṣoghnaṃ śaivasūktakam ..
gaṇānāntveti pañca āpohiṣṭheti ca trayam .. 179 ..
meaning:
रात्रिसूक्तं हि यज्वाग्ने रक्षोघ्नं शैवसूक्तकम् ..
गणानान्त्वेति पञ्च आपोहिष्ठेति च त्रयम् .. 179 ..
text_mt: the Rātrisūkta is indeed for the sacrificer's fire, and the Rakṣoghna is a Śaiva hymn; / the five [verses] beginning with *gaṇānāṃ tvā*, and the three beginning with *āpo hi ṣṭhā*;

sanskrit_iast:
pavamānaṃ tu tadviddhi pāvamānaṃ tu ṣoḍaśa ..
samastaṃ devayāgeṣu tadrātrau tu tadūrdhvakam ..
tadarddhārddhaṃ ca ārāme kūpe tvekaṛcaṃ japet .. 2.2.19.180 ..
meaning:
पवमानं तु तद्विद्धि पावमानं तु षोडश ..
समस्तं देवयागेषु तद्रात्रौ तु तदूर्ध्वकम् ..
तदर्द्धार्द्धं च आरामे कूपे त्वेकऋचं जपेत् .. 2.2.19.180 ..
text_mt: know that to be the Pavamāna, while the Pāvamāna has sixteen [verses]. / In sacrifices to the gods, [it should be recited] in its entirety, but at night, what comes after that; / in a pleasure-grove, half of half of it, and at a well one should recite a single verse.

sanskrit_iast:
svagṛhyoktavidhānena pratikuṇḍeṣu homayet ..
saṃskuryādīkṣaṇādyaiśca saṃpūjya ca parasparam ..181..
meaning:
स्वगृह्योक्तविधानेन प्रतिकुण्डेषु होमयेत् ..
संस्कुर्यादीक्षणाद्यैश्च संपूज्य च परस्परम् ..181..
text_mt: One should offer oblation in each sacrificial pit according to the rule declared in one's own Gṛhyasūtra; / one should consecrate them with glance and other rites, and worship one another.

sanskrit_iast:
prajvālyāgniṃ ca vidhivaddhomaṃ kuryādanantaram ..
vāgīśvaraṃ samabhyarcya vāgīśvaryā samanvitam .. 182 ..
meaning:
प्रज्वाल्याग्निं च विधिवद्धोमं कुर्यादनन्तरम् ..
वागीश्वरं समभ्यर्च्य वागीश्वर्या समन्वितम् .. 182 ..
text_mt: And having kindled the fire according to rule, one should perform the oblation immediately afterwards, / having thoroughly worshipped Vāgīśvara united with Vāgīśvarī.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya devasya yo yāgaḥ pratiṣṭhā yasya kasyacit ..
prāgeva tasya juhuyātsahasraṃ ca śataṃ tathā .. 183 ..
meaning:
यस्य देवस्य यो यागः प्रतिष्ठा यस्य कस्यचित् ..
प्रागेव तस्य जुहुयात्सहस्रं च शतं तथा .. 183 ..
text_mt: Whatever sacrifice of whichever deity, or whatever consecration [is taking place], / first of all one should offer for that [deity] one thousand and one hundred [oblations]

sanskrit_iast:
tilājyaiḥ pāyasairvātha patrapuṣpākṣatena ca ..
grahebhyo vidhivatsarvaṃ tathendrāyeśvarāya ca .. 184 ..
meaning:
तिलाज्यैः पायसैर्वाथ पत्रपुष्पाक्षतेन च ..
ग्रहेभ्यो विधिवत्सर्वं तथेन्द्रायेश्वराय च .. 184 ..
text_mt: with sesamum, clarified butter, or milk-rice, or with leaves, flowers, and unbroken grain. / To the planets, everything according to rule, and likewise to Indra and to Īśvara,

sanskrit_iast:
marudbhyo lokapālebhyo vidhivadviśvakarmaṇe ..
ūrjena samidhā kuryādaṣṭāṣṭau svagṛheṣvapi ..185..
meaning:
मरुद्भ्यो लोकपालेभ्यो विधिवद्विश्वकर्मणे ..
ऊर्जेन समिधा कुर्यादष्टाष्टौ स्वगृहेष्वपि ..185..
text_mt: to the Maruts, to the world protectors, and according to rule to Viśvakarman; / with invigorating firewood one should make eight [oblations] to each, even in one's own homes.

sanskrit_iast:
indreśvaramārutānāṃ tilājyena ghṛtena vā ..
ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyātsvairmaṃtrairyathākramāt .. 186 ..
meaning:
इन्द्रेश्वरमारुतानां तिलाज्येन घृतेन वा ..
एकैकामाहुतिं दद्यात्स्वैर्मंत्रैर्यथाक्रमात् .. 186 ..
text_mt: To Indra, Īśvara, and the Maruts, with sesamum and clarified butter or with ghee, / one should give one oblation each with their respective mantras in due order,

sanskrit_iast:
digīśānāṃ ca pratyekamaṣṭāṣṭau ca viśeṣataḥ ..
viśvakarmanniti mantreṇa kṛtvā ājyāhutitrayam .. 187 ..
meaning:
दिगीशानां च प्रत्येकमष्टाष्टौ च विशेषतः ..
विश्वकर्मन्निति मन्त्रेण कृत्वा आज्याहुतित्रयम् .. 187 ..
text_mt: and especially eight each to the lords of the cardinal points; / having made three oblations of clarified butter with the mantra beginning with *viśvakarman*,

sanskrit_iast:
samittrayaṃ palāśasya athavāśvatthasaṃbhavam ..
ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyādājyena ca viśeṣataḥ .. 188 ..
meaning:
समित्त्रयं पलाशस्य अथवाश्वत्थसंभवम् ..
एकैकामाहुतिं दद्यादाज्येन च विशेषतः .. 188 ..
text_mt: and three pieces of kindling of palāśa or produced from aśvattha, / one should especially give one oblation each with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaṃ prajā patiṃ viṣṇuṃ durgāṃ ca kamalāmapi ..
sarasvatīṃ ca vidhivatpṛthivyā iti pāvakaiḥ .. 189 ..
meaning:
शिवं प्रजा पतिं विष्णुं दुर्गां च कमलामपि ..
सरस्वतीं च विधिवत्पृथिव्या इति पावकैः .. 189 ..
text_mt: To Śiva, Prajāpati, Viṣṇu, Durgā, and Kamalā, / and to Sarasvatī according to rule, with the fires [and the mantra] beginning with *pṛthivyāḥ*;

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtebhyo'pyāhutiṃ dadyādevaṃ māsadvayaṃ kramāt ..
anyeṣāṃ madhurāktena tilalājairyayākramam .. 2.2.19.190 ..
meaning:
भूतेभ्योऽप्याहुतिं दद्यादेवं मासद्वयं क्रमात् ..
अन्येषां मधुराक्तेन तिललाजैर्ययाक्रमम् .. 2.2.19.190 ..
text_mt: one should also give an oblation to the ghosts, in this manner over two months in sequence; / to the others [an oblation] smeared with sweet substances, with sesamum and parched grain in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuṃ caiva tu vāyavye durgāyāśca tathottare ..
kamalāyāśca īśāne īśānasya sabhūtakam.. 191 ..
meaning:
विष्णुं चैव तु वायव्ये दुर्गायाश्च तथोत्तरे ..
कमलायाश्च ईशाने ईशानस्य सभूतकम्.. 191 ..
text_mt: And to Viṣṇu in the north-west, and likewise to Durgā in the north, / and to Kamalā in the north-east, and to Īśāna together with the ghosts.

sanskrit_iast:
ekakuṇḍe tu ekasminhomaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi ..
pakṣe vai pañcakuṇḍe tu pūrvādīnāṃ krameṇa tu .. 192 ..
meaning:
एककुण्डे तु एकस्मिन्होमं कुर्याद्यथाविधि ..
पक्षे वै पञ्चकुण्डे तु पूर्वादीनां क्रमेण तु .. 192 ..
text_mt: In a single sacrificial pit one should perform the oblation according to rule; / or, in the option of five sacrificial pits, in the order of the east and other [directions]:

sanskrit_iast:
ekakuṃḍe grahānkṛtvā kṛtvā balabhidā saha ..
dakṣiṇe kramataścaiva lokeśaṃ ca tathaiva ca .. 193 ..
meaning:
एककुंडे ग्रहान्कृत्वा कृत्वा बलभिदा सह ..
दक्षिणे क्रमतश्चैव लोकेशं च तथैव च .. 193 ..
text_mt: having placed the planets along with Indra in one sacrificial pit, / and in the south in due order, likewise the lord of the world;

sanskrit_iast:
paścime yasya yāgasya durgāyāścottare diśi ..
īśāne bhūtayakṣmā ca juhuyāddeśikottamaḥ ..! .. 194 ..
meaning:
पश्चिमे यस्य यागस्य दुर्गायाश्चोत्तरे दिशि ..
ईशाने भूतयक्ष्मा च जुहुयाद्देशिकोत्तमः ..! .. 194 ..
text_mt: in the west, [the deity] of whichever sacrifice it is; and in the northern direction of Durgā; / in the north-east, the best of preceptors should offer to the ghosts and consumption.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇvādidevatānāṃ ca agrakuṃḍe vidhīyate ..
prathame divase kuryāddevatānāṃ ca sthāpanam ..
dvitīye pūjanaṃ kuryāddhomaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi .. .. 195 ..
meaning:
विष्ण्वादिदेवतानां च अग्रकुंडे विधीयते ..
प्रथमे दिवसे कुर्याद्देवतानां च स्थापनम् ..
द्वितीये पूजनं कुर्याद्धोमं कुर्याद्यथाविधि .. .. 195 ..
text_mt: And for Viṣṇu and the other deities, [the offering] is prescribed in the eastern sacrificial pit. / On the first day, one should perform the installation of the deities; / on the second day, one should perform the worship and perform the oblation according to rule;

sanskrit_iast:
balidānaṃ tṛtīye tu caturthīkaṃ caturthake ..
nīrājanaṃ pañcame tu pañcāhasādhyako vidhiḥ ..
tryahasādhye tṛtīye tu navāhe tvatha paṃcame ... . 196 ..
meaning:
बलिदानं तृतीये तु चतुर्थीकं चतुर्थके ..
नीराजनं पञ्चमे तु पञ्चाहसाध्यको विधिः ..
त्र्यहसाध्ये तृतीये तु नवाहे त्वथ पंचमे ... . 196 ..
text_mt: on the third, the animal sacrifice; and on the fourth, the fourth-day rite; / on the fifth, the lustration: this is the procedure accomplished in five days. / In [a rite] accomplished in three days, [it is done] on the third; and in [one of] nine days, on the fifth.

sanskrit_iast:
udaṅmukhaḥ prāṅmukho vāpyaiśānyādi krameṇa tu ..
prādakṣiṇyena yajñaṃ tu mantraiḥ parisamūhanam ..
mantrapūrvaṃ sāgnikānāṃ niragnestuṣṭikena tu .. 197 ..
meaning:
उदङ्मुखः प्राङ्मुखो वाप्यैशान्यादि क्रमेण तु ..
प्रादक्षिण्येन यज्ञं तु मन्त्रैः परिसमूहनम् ..
मन्त्रपूर्वं साग्निकानां निरग्नेस्तुष्टिकेन तु .. 197 ..
text_mt: Facing north or facing east, in the order beginning with the north-east, / [one performs] the sweeping together around the sacrifice clockwise with mantras; / with mantras for those with consecrated fires, but for one without consecrated fires, with the Tuṣṭika [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
trikuśena mahāyāge vivāhādau dvipatrakam ..
vaiśvadeve tvekapatramiti sādhāraṇo vidhiḥ .. 198 ..
meaning:
त्रिकुशेन महायागे विवाहादौ द्विपत्रकम् ..
वैश्वदेवे त्वेकपत्रमिति साधारणो विधिः .. 198 ..
text_mt: With three kuśa blades in a great sacrifice, with two leaves in a wedding and such, / but with a single leaf in the Vaiśvadeva: such is the general rule.

sanskrit_iast:
digvidikṣu paristīrya mahāyāgeṣu sarvadā ..
dikṣumātraṃ nityake ca viśvadeve tathaiva ca .. 199 ..
meaning:
दिग्विदिक्षु परिस्तीर्य महायागेषु सर्वदा ..
दिक्षुमात्रं नित्यके च विश्वदेवे तथैव च .. 199 ..
text_mt: Having strewn grass in the cardinal and intermediate directions in great sacrifices at all times, / but only in the cardinal directions in the daily rite, and likewise in the Viśvadeva;

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtvā karma nityaṃ ca vṛthā naimittikaṃ bhavet ..
tasmātphalādyairapi tatkṛtvā naimittikaṃ caret .. 2.2.19.200 ..
meaning:
अकृत्वा कर्म नित्यं च वृथा नैमित्तिकं भवेत् ..
तस्मात्फलाद्यैरपि तत्कृत्वा नैमित्तिकं चरेत् .. 2.2.19.200 ..
text_mt: without having performed the daily rite, the occasional rite becomes futile; / therefore, having performed it even with fruits and the like, one should undertake the occasional rite.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaścitte vaiśvadeve sāyaṃprātaḥ pratīṣu ca .. 201 ..
meaning: प्रायश्चित्ते वैश्वदेवे सायंप्रातः प्रतीषु च .. 201 ..
text_mt: In an expiation, in the Vaiśvadeva, and in the morning and evening [rites];

sanskrit_iast:
māraṇoccāṭahomeṣu tathā saṃkalpitākṛtī 1
pratyavāyakule kvāpi tatra nityākṛtiṃ vinā .. 202 ..
meaning:
मारणोच्चाटहोमेषु तथा संकल्पिताकृती 1
प्रत्यवायकुले क्वापि तत्र नित्याकृतिं विना .. 202 ..
text_mt: in oblations for killing and driving away, and likewise in voluntary rites, / anywhere in a series of adverse consequences, without the daily rite there,

sanskrit_iast:
śatārddhaṃ juhuyādyatra tatra nityaṃ vivarjayet ..
tūryahomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā tūṣṇīmeva jitendriyaḥ .. 203 ..
meaning:
शतार्द्धं जुहुयाद्यत्र तत्र नित्यं विवर्जयेत् ..
तूर्यहोमं ततः कृत्वा तूष्णीमेव जितेन्द्रियः .. 203 ..
text_mt: where one offers half a hundred, there one should omit the daily rite. / Then, having performed the silent oblation, entirely silently with senses subdued,

sanskrit_iast:
prajapedindramagniṃ ca somāya ca yathākramam ..
tatastu samidhāhomaṃ vyāhṛtistadanantaram .. 204 ..
meaning:
प्रजपेदिन्द्रमग्निं च सोमाय च यथाक्रमम् ..
ततस्तु समिधाहोमं व्याहृतिस्तदनन्तरम् .. 204 ..
text_mt: one should murmur mantras to Indra and Agni, and to Soma in due order; / then follows the oblation of kindling-sticks, and immediately thereafter the vyāhṛtis,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūrbhuvaḥ svāheti tathā tatra ityādipaṃcakam ..
ante sviṣṭakṛtaṃ dadyādvidhānaṃ tasya bhoḥ śṛṇu .. 205 ..
meaning:
भूर्भुवः स्वाहेति तथा तत्र इत्यादिपंचकम् ..
अन्ते स्विष्टकृतं दद्याद्विधानं तस्य भोः शृणु .. 205 ..
text_mt: *bhūrbhuvaḥ svāhā*, and likewise the five beginning with *tatra*; / at the end one should make the Sviṣṭakṛt offering. Hear its rule, O sir:

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtāhutiṃ sviṣṭakṛcca dvijasaṃskārakarmasu ..
ghṛtaiḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ dadyādyāgādau parivarjayet .. 206 ..
meaning:
घृताहुतिं स्विष्टकृच्च द्विजसंस्कारकर्मसु ..
घृतैः स्विष्टकृतं दद्याद्यागादौ परिवर्जयेत् .. 206 ..
text_mt: an oblation of clarified butter is the Sviṣṭakṛt in rites of passage for the twice-born; / one should give the Sviṣṭakṛt with clarified butter, but avoid it in sacrifices and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvauṣadhyudakasnānaṃ karidaṃtotthamuṣṇayā ..
rathyāvalmīkagoṣṭhasya tathāśvasya surasya ca .. 207 ..
meaning:
सर्वौषध्युदकस्नानं करिदंतोत्थमुष्णया ..
रथ्यावल्मीकगोष्ठस्य तथाश्वस्य सुरस्य च .. 207 ..
text_mt: The bath with water containing all medicinal herbs, with warm [water], springing from an elephant's tusk, / [soil] of a street, of an anthill, of a cowpen, and of a horse and a deity,

sanskrit_iast:
trigandhaṃ ca triśītaṃ ca kuśamūlasya mṛttikāḥ ..
nikṣipetsnānakumbheṣu ācāryādīṃstu sthāpayet .. 208 ..
meaning:
त्रिगन्धं च त्रिशीतं च कुशमूलस्य मृत्तिकाः ..
निक्षिपेत्स्नानकुम्भेषु आचार्यादींस्तु स्थापयेत् .. 208 ..
text_mt: and the three fragrances, the three cool substances, and earth from the root of kuśa grass, / one should cast into the bath jars; and one should install the preceptor and others.

sanskrit_iast:
yajamānaḥ puraḥ kṛtvā daṃtakāṣṭhapuraḥsaram ..
rātrau ca bhakṣyabhojyādyaiḥ paritoṣya yavākṣatam .. 209 .'
kṛtvā yathoktakālena pūjayettailadhārayā ..
tataḥ prabhāte vimale snānaṃ kuryādyathā vidhi .. 2.2.19.210 ..
meaning:
यजमानः पुरः कृत्वा दंतकाष्ठपुरःसरम् ..
रात्रौ च भक्ष्यभोज्याद्यैः परितोष्य यवाक्षतम् .. 209 .'
कृत्वा यथोक्तकालेन पूजयेत्तैलधारया ..
ततः प्रभाते विमले स्नानं कुर्याद्यथा विधि .. 2.2.19.210 ..
text_mt: The patron, placing them in front, preceded by [the use of] a tooth-stick, / and having gratified them at night with various foods and drinks, having offered barley and unbroken grain / at the prescribed time, should worship with a stream of oil. / Then at clear dawn, he should perform the bath according to rule:

sanskrit_iast:
snānamabdaivatairmantraiḥ sūktena puruṣeṇa tu ..
vāruṇena ca sūktena surāstvādi yathākramam .. 211 ..
meaning:
स्नानमब्दैवतैर्मन्त्रैः सूक्तेन पुरुषेण तु ..
वारुणेन च सूक्तेन सुरास्त्वादि यथाक्रमम् .. 211 ..
text_mt: the bath with mantras addressed to the waters, with the Puruṣa hymn, / with the Vāruṇa hymn, and [the verses] beginning with *surās tvā* in due order:

sanskrit_iast:
surāstvāmabhiṣiṃcaṃtu brahmanna viṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ..
vāsudevo jagannāthastathā saṃkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ .. 212 ..
meaning:
सुरास्त्वामभिषिंचंतु ब्रह्मन्न विष्णुमहेश्वराः ..
वासुदेवो जगन्नाथस्तथा संकर्षणः प्रभुः .. 212 ..
text_mt: "May the gods consecrate you, O Brahmin, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara; / Vāsudeva, the Lord of the World, and likewise the powerful Saṃkarṣaṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
ākhaṃḍalognirbhagavānyamo vai nirṛtistathā ..
varuṇaḥ pavanaścaiva dhanāyakṣastathā śivaḥ .. 213 ..
meaning:
आखंडलोग्निर्भगवान्यमो वै निरृतिस्तथा ..
वरुणः पवनश्चैव धनायक्षस्तथा शिवः .. 213 ..
text_mt: Indra, the divine Agni, Yama, and indeed Nirṛti; / Varuṇa, Pavana, Dhanada, and likewise Śiva;"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇā sahitaḥ śeṣo dikpālāḥ pātu te sadā ..
kīrtirlakṣmīrdhṛtirmedhā puṣṭiḥ śraddhā kriyā matiḥ .. 214 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मणा सहितः शेषो दिक्पालाः पातु ते सदा ..
कीर्तिर्लक्ष्मीर्धृतिर्मेधा पुष्टिः श्रद्धा क्रिया मतिः .. 214 ..
text_mt: May Śeṣa together with Brahmā and the guardians of the directions always protect you. / Kīrti, Lakṣmī, Dhṛti, Medhā, Puṣṭi, Śraddhā, Kriyā, Mati,

sanskrit_iast:
buddhirlajjā vapuḥ śāṃtistuṣṭiḥ kāṃtiśca mātaraḥ ..
etāstvāmabhiṣiṃcaṃtu devapantyaḥ samāhitāḥ .. 215 ..
meaning:
बुद्धिर्लज्जा वपुः शांतिस्तुष्टिः कांतिश्च मातरः ..
एतास्त्वामभिषिंचंतु देवपन्त्यः समाहिताः .. 215 ..
text_mt: Buddhi, Lajjā, Vapus, Śānti, Tuṣṭi, Kānti, and the Mothers— / may these wives of the gods, fully concentrated, consecrate you.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityaścandramā bhaumo budhajīvasitārkajāḥ..
grahāstvāmabhiṣiṃcaṃtu rāhuḥ ketuśca tarpitāḥ .. 216 ..
meaning:
आदित्यश्चन्द्रमा भौमो बुधजीवसितार्कजाः..
ग्रहास्त्वामभिषिंचंतु राहुः केतुश्च तर्पिताः .. 216 ..
text_mt: May the Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, and Saturn— / may these planets, along with Rāhu and Ketu, propitiated, consecrate you.

sanskrit_iast:
devadānavagaṃdharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ ..
ṛṣayo manavo devā devamātara eva ca .. 217 ..
meaning:
देवदानवगंधर्वा यक्षराक्षसपन्नगाः ..
ऋषयो मनवो देवा देवमातर एव च .. 217 ..
text_mt: May gods, dānavas, gandharvas, yakṣas, rākṣasas, and serpents, / the sages, Manus, gods, and also the mothers of the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
devapatnyo drumā nāgā daityāścāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ..
astrāṇi sarvaśastrāṇi rājāno vāhanāni ca .. 218 ..
meaning:
देवपत्न्यो द्रुमा नागा दैत्याश्चाप्सरसां गणाः ..
अस्त्राणि सर्वशस्त्राणि राजानो वाहनानि च .. 218 ..
text_mt: the wives of the gods, trees, nāgas, daityas, and the hosts of apsarases, / the magical weapons, all ordinary weapons, kings, and mounts,

sanskrit_iast:
auṣadhāni ca ratnāni kālasyāvayavāśca ye ..
saritaḥ sāgarāḥ śailāstīrthāni jaladā nadāḥ .. 219 ..
meaning:
औषधानि च रत्नानि कालस्यावयवाश्च ये ..
सरितः सागराः शैलास्तीर्थानि जलदा नदाः .. 219 ..
text_mt: the medicinal herbs, jewels, and the divisions of Time, / rivers, oceans, mountains, sacred fords, rain clouds, and streams—

sanskrit_iast:
ete tvāmabhiṣiṃcaṃtu sarvakāmārthasiddhaye ..
snānaṃ samāpya vidhivatsvagaṇenānu lepayet .. 2.2.19.220 ..
meaning:
एते त्वामभिषिंचंतु सर्वकामार्थसिद्धये ..
स्नानं समाप्य विधिवत्स्वगणेनानु लेपयेत् .. 2.2.19.220 ..
text_mt: may all these consecrate you for the attainment of all desired aims. / Having concluded the bath according to rule, one should anoint [him] along with his retinue.

sanskrit_iast:
gavāmaṣṭottaraśataṃ tadardhaṃ cātha viṃśatim ..
ācāryāyābhirūpāya pradadiyādabhipūjayan.. 221 ..
meaning:
गवामष्टोत्तरशतं तदर्धं चाथ विंशतिम् ..
आचार्यायाभिरूपाय प्रददियादभिपूजयन्.. 221 ..
text_mt: One should give one hundred and eight cows, or half that, or twenty, / honouring [him], to a learned and worthy preceptor.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabhāte vimale jale samṛvatārayet ..
śuddhāṃ ca kapilāṃ dogdhrīṃ ghaṭācāmaravarjitām .. 222 ..
meaning:
ततः प्रभाते विमले जले समृवतारयेत् ..
शुद्धां च कपिलां दोग्ध्रीं घटाचामरवर्जिताम् .. 222 ..
text_mt: Then, at clear dawn, he should cause [a cow] to be brought down into the water: / an unblemished, milch kapilā cow, free of bells and chowries.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmagāya tato dadyātsuvarṇadakṣiṇānvitām ..
yūpamādāya saṃsthāpya snāpayedvāruṇaṃ japan .. 223 ..
meaning:
सामगाय ततो दद्यात्सुवर्णदक्षिणान्विताम् ..
यूपमादाय संस्थाप्य स्नापयेद्वारुणं जपन् .. 223 ..
text_mt: Then he should give it, along with a sacrificial fee in gold, to a chanter of the Sāmaveda. / Taking a sacrificial post and erecting it, he should bathe [the image] while reciting the hymn to Varuṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
acchevatena mantreṇa gāyatryā tadanantaram ..
rocanābhistriratnena tathā kuṃbhodakena ca .. 224 ..
meaning:
अच्छेवतेन मन्त्रेण गायत्र्या तदनन्तरम् ..
रोचनाभिस्त्रिरत्नेन तथा कुंभोदकेन च .. 224 ..
text_mt: with the mantra beginning "Acchevatena", and immediately after with the Gāyatrī, / with yellow pigment, with the three jewels, and with jar-water;

sanskrit_iast:
parvatāgramṛdā toyanāgavalmīkajātayā ..
gajadaṃtamṛdā caiva kūlamūlatamṛdā tathāta ..225..
meaning:
पर्वताग्रमृदा तोयनागवल्मीकजातया ..
गजदंतमृदा चैव कूलमूलतमृदा तथात ..225..
text_mt: with clay from a mountain peak, with earth from water, from an elephant, and from an anthill, / with clay from an elephant's tusk, and also with clay from the base of a riverbank;

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpodakena śaṃkhena tathā ratnodakena ca ..
dadhyakṣatena dugdhena ghaṭena śatadhārayā .. 226 ..
meaning:
पुष्पोदकेन शंखेन तथा रत्नोदकेन च ..
दध्यक्षतेन दुग्धेन घटेन शतधारया .. 226 ..
text_mt: with flower-scented water, with a conch, and also with jewel-infused water, / with curds, unbroken rice, milk, and a jar with a hundred streams;

sanskrit_iast:
sugaṃdhena triśītena vilipya ca samāhitaḥ ..
dāpayetkāṃsyamūlaṃ ca dadyāllohamayaṃ ca vā .. 227 ..
meaning:
सुगंधेन त्रिशीतेन विलिप्य च समाहितः ..
दापयेत्कांस्यमूलं च दद्याल्लोहमयं च वा .. 227 ..
text_mt: and having anointed it with fragrant substances and three cooling agents, collected in mind, / he should present a base of bell-metal or give one made of iron.

sanskrit_iast:
mālyavastrairalaṃkṛtya pūjayedgandhacandanaiḥ ..
īśāvā iti maṃtreṇa dadyātpuṣpāñjalitrayam .. 228 ..
meaning:
माल्यवस्त्रैरलंकृत्य पूजयेद्गन्धचन्दनैः ..
ईशावा इति मंत्रेण दद्यात्पुष्पाञ्जलित्रयम् .. 228 ..
text_mt: Having adorned it with garlands and garments, he should worship it with fragrant sandal pastes. / With the mantra beginning "Īśāvā", he should offer three handfuls of flowers;

sanskrit_iast:
punastvāditi maṃtreṇa punaḥ puṣpaṃ samutsṛjet ..
prādeśamātravistāraṃ madhye vṛttaṃ ṣaḍaṃgulam .. 229 ..
meaning:
पुनस्त्वादिति मंत्रेण पुनः पुष्पं समुत्सृजेत् ..
प्रादेशमात्रविस्तारं मध्ये वृत्तं षडंगुलम् .. 229 ..
text_mt: with the mantra beginning "Punas tvā", he should again cast flowers. / It should measure a span in width, and have a circle of six finger-breadths in the middle.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṃsyacakrasya mānaṃ tu ūrdhvaṃ yaddvādaśāṃgulam ..
tadūrdhve vilikhecchūlaṃ caturaṃgulamānataḥ .. 2.2.19.230 ..
meaning:
कांस्यचक्रस्य मानं तु ऊर्ध्वं यद्द्वादशांगुलम् ..
तदूर्ध्वे विलिखेच्छूलं चतुरंगुलमानतः .. 2.2.19.230 ..
text_mt: Such is the measurement of the bell-metal disc, twelve finger-breadths high. / Above that, he should draw a trident measuring four finger-breadths.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃguṣṭhahīne lohasya tatra śūlaṃ na kārayet ..
tato maṃgalapūrve tu dvijātīnāṃ matena ca .. 231 ..
meaning:
अंगुष्ठहीने लोहस्य तत्र शूलं न कारयेत् ..
ततो मंगलपूर्वे तु द्विजातीनां मतेन च .. 231 ..
text_mt: If it is made of iron and lacks the thumb's width, one should not fashion a trident upon it. / Then, following auspicious rites and according to the opinion of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
samutsṛjecca prāsādaṃ taḍāgaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ..
caturdarbhaṃ gṛhītvā tu īśānābhimukhena tu ..
samutsṛjettataḥ paścādvākyametadurīyet .. 232 ..
meaning:
समुत्सृजेच्च प्रासादं तडागं च विशेषतः ..
चतुर्दर्भं गृहीत्वा तु ईशानाभिमुखेन तु ..
समुत्सृजेत्ततः पश्चाद्वाक्यमेतदुरीयेत् .. 232 ..
text_mt: one should dedicate a temple and especially a pond. / Taking four blades of darbha grass and facing northeast, / he should then make the dedication and utter these words:

sanskrit_iast: omityādiśrīkṛṣṇadvaipāyanābhidhāna vedavyāsapraṇīta bhaviṣyapurāṇokta phalapraptikāmaścatuṣkoṇādyavacchinnamatkāritapuṣkariṇījalametadūrjitaṃ gaṃdhapuṣpādyarcitaṃ varuṇadaivataṃ sarvasattvebhyaḥ snānāvagāhanārthamahamutsṛje .. 233 .. tato varuṇasūktena varuṇaṃ nāgasaṃyutam ..
meaning: ओमित्यादिश्रीकृष्णद्वैपायनाभिधान वेदव्यासप्रणीत भविष्यपुराणोक्त फलप्रप्तिकामश्चतुष्कोणाद्यवच्छिन्नमत्कारितपुष्करिणीजलमेतदूर्जितं गंधपुष्पाद्यर्चितं वरुणदैवतं सर्वसत्त्वेभ्यः स्नानावगाहनार्थमहमुत्सृजे .. 233 .. ततो वरुणसूक्तेन वरुणं नागसंयुतम् ..
text_mt: "Oṃ. Desiring to obtain the fruit spoken of in the Bhaviṣyapurāṇa composed by Veda-Vyāsa named Śrī Kṛṣṇa-Dvaipāyana, I dedicate this mighty water of the pond constructed by me, defined by four corners and the rest, worshipped with perfumes, flowers, and other offerings, having Varuṇa as its deity, for the sake of bathing and immersion for all living beings." / Then, with the hymn to Varuṇa, [an image of] Varuṇa accompanied by a nāga,

sanskrit_iast: makaraṃ kacchapaṃ caiva toyeṣu parinikṣipet ..234..
meaning: मकरं कच्छपं चैव तोयेषु परिनिक्षिपेत् ..234..
text_mt: and a makara and a tortoise, he should cast into the waters.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedvaruṇaṃ devamarghyaṃ dadyādviśeṣataḥ ..
tenodakena saṃsnāpya gajadaṃtotthamṛtsnayā .. 235 ..
meaning:
पूजयेद्वरुणं देवमर्घ्यं दद्याद्विशेषतः ..
तेनोदकेन संस्नाप्य गजदंतोत्थमृत्स्नया .. 235 ..
text_mt: He should worship the god Varuṇa and especially offer an arghya. / Having bathed him with that water and with clay raised by an elephant's tusk,

sanskrit_iast:
śvetāśvasurasaṃbhūtaṃ śrīśca teti ca saṃjapan ..
āpyāyasveti maṃtreṇa mṛdaṃ catuṣpathodbhavām .. .. 236 ..
meaning:
श्वेताश्वसुरसंभूतं श्रीश्च तेति च संजपन् ..
आप्यायस्वेति मंत्रेण मृदं चतुष्पथोद्भवाम् .. .. 236 ..
text_mt: arisen from a white horse and an ox, while reciting "Śrīś ca te", / and with clay taken from a crossroads with the mantra beginning "Āpyāyasva",

sanskrit_iast:
tadviṣṇoriti maṃtreṇa kuśamūlena sthāpayet ..
tīrthatoyena gaṃdhena tathā pañcāmṛtena ca .. 237 ..
meaning:
तद्विष्णोरिति मंत्रेण कुशमूलेन स्थापयेत् ..
तीर्थतोयेन गंधेन तथा पञ्चामृतेन च .. 237 ..
text_mt: with the mantra beginning "Tad viṣṇoḥ", he should establish [him] with the root of kuśa grass. / With holy ford water, perfume, and the five nectars,

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatryā snāpayeddevaṃ ratnatoyena sādhakaḥ ..
āpyāyasveti maṃtreṇa kṣīreṇa tadanaṃtaram .. 238 ..
meaning:
गायत्र्या स्नापयेद्देवं रत्नतोयेन साधकः ..
आप्यायस्वेति मंत्रेण क्षीरेण तदनंतरम् .. 238 ..
text_mt: and with jewel-infused water, the practitioner should bathe the god with the Gāyatrī; / then with milk, using the mantra beginning "Āpyāyasva";

sanskrit_iast:
dadhikrāvṇeti dadhnā ca madhuvāteti vai madhu ..
sarasvatyāṃteti jātīpuṣpatoyena snāpayet .. 239 ..
meaning:
दधिक्राव्णेति दध्ना च मधुवातेति वै मधु ..
सरस्वत्यांतेति जातीपुष्पतोयेन स्नापयेत् .. 239 ..
text_mt: with curds using "Dadhikrāvṇaḥ", and indeed with honey using "Madhu vātāḥ"; / with the mantra beginning "Sarasvatyāḥ", he should bathe him with water infused with jātī flowers.

( varuṇottamiti maṃtrasya nārāyaṇa ṛṣiḥ gāyatrī chaṃdo varuṇo devatā varuṇaprītaye viniyogaḥ ..

paścānnīrājanaṃ kuryātpañcaghoṣapuraḥsaram .. 2.2.19.240 ..
meaning:
( वरुणोत्तमिति मंत्रस्य नारायण ऋषिः गायत्री छंदो वरुणो देवता वरुणप्रीतये विनियोगः ..

पुष्पोदकस्नाने ..
