1. 208: Description of drawing the maṇḍala with regard to ritual action, 21 verses.
2. 209: Description of the methods of constructing various maṇḍalas such as Krauñcaghrāṇa and others, 110 verses.
3. 211: Description of the standard value of the sacrificial fee and the like according to particular rites, preceded by a description of the defect in performing a rite without a sacrificial fee, 40 verses.
4. 212: Description of the standard value of the sacrificial fee and the like according to particular materials and rites, preceded by a description of the measure of the full-vessel, 45 verses.
5. 212: Description of the method of making and establishing the water jar and other implements with regard to ritual action, 26 verses.
6. 213: Description of the determination of the characteristics and natures of the four kinds of months for their utility in rites based on months, 56 verses.
7. 214: Description of the division of time with regard to rites for gods and ancestors, and description of the determination of lunar days in particular rites, 60 verses.
8. 215: Description of the fruits of rites performed on particular lunar days beginning with the first day and ending with the new moon in particular months, 137 verses.
9. 218: Description of the lineages of gotras and pravaras, 23 verses.
10. 218: Description of the procedure for the Vāstu sacrifice preceded by the offering circle, 112 verses.
11–12. 221: Description of the mantras, meters, sages, and deities, preceded by the description of the meditation on each deity, in the sequence of worshipping the deities of the site, 164 verses.
13. 224: Description of the procedure for offering arghya to deities, 31 verses.
14. 224: Description of the fire-ritual procedure as taught in one's own Gṛhyasūtra, 84 verses.
15. 226: Description of the rule for Kuśakaṇḍikā and the sthālīpāka offering in the fire ritual, 21 verses.
16. 226: Description of the meditation on the tongues of fire, 9 verses.
17. 227: Description of the duties to be performed on the day preceding the consecration, 31 verses.
18. 227: Description of the appointment of brahmins employed in the sacrificial rite, 48 verses.
19. 228: Description of the consecration procedure, preceded by the determination of the proper time for consecration, 19 verses.
20. 229: Description of the manner of worshipping the deities in the consecration of a house-site, 297 verses.
21. 235: Description of the procedure for the consecration of a house-site according to the intermediate mode, 138 verses.
(Thus ends the second part.)

sanskrit_iast: upavanādipratiṣṭhāvarṇanam
meaning: उपवनादिप्रतिष्ठावर्णनम्
text_mt: Description of the Consecration of Groves and Gardens

sanskrit_iast:
.. .. sūta uvāca .. ..
ārāmādau viśeṣo yo vakṣyate'tra mayādhunā ..
maṃḍalaṃ kārayitvā tu caturasraṃ samaṃ śubham ..1..
meaning:
.. .. सूत उवाच .. ..
आरामादौ विशेषो यो वक्ष्यतेऽत्र मयाधुना ..
मंडलं कारयित्वा तु चतुरस्रं समं शुभम् ..1..
text_mt:
Sūta said:
The special rule regarding groves and the like will now be declared here by me.
Having constructed a maṇḍala that is four-cornered, even, and auspicious,
title: adhyāyaḥ 01

sanskrit_iast:
aiśānyāṃ kalaśe devaṃ tatra nāthaṃ prapūjayet ..
madhyame kalaśe pūjā grahāṇāṃ ca tataḥ param .. 2 ..
meaning:
ऐशान्यां कलशे देवं तत्र नाथं प्रपूजयेत् ..
मध्यमे कलशे पूजा ग्रहाणां च ततः परम् .. 2 ..
text_mt:
One should worship the lord, the god, in the water-jar in the north-east;
next is the worship of the planets in the central water-jar.

sanskrit_iast:
svadikṣu dvāradeśe tu paścimadvāradeśayoḥ ..
brahmāṇaṃ cāpyanantaṃ ca madhyato varuṇaṃ yajet ..3..
meaning:
स्वदिक्षु द्वारदेशे तु पश्चिमद्वारदेशयोः ..
ब्रह्माणं चाप्यनन्तं च मध्यतो वरुणं यजेत् ..3..
text_mt:
In their own quarters at the gateway, and at the two western doorposts,
one should worship Brahmā and Ananta, and in the middle, Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
varuṇaṃ codakumbhasthaṃ bhūtaśākhāsu śobhanam ..
tena cāvāhayāmi tvāṃ vibho svargāya vai bhava ..4..
meaning:
वरुणं चोदकुम्भस्थं भूतशाखासु शोभनम् ..
तेन चावाहयामि त्वां विभो स्वर्गाय वै भव ..4..
text_mt:
Varuṇa seated upon the water-pot, adorned among leafy branches:
'With this I invoke you, O Lord; may you lead indeed to heaven.'

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvagaṃ mandaraṃ sthāpya toraṇopari sattamāḥ ..
viṣvaksenaṃ samabhyarcya arcanaṃ svargasaṃyutam ..5..
meaning:
पूर्वगं मन्दरं स्थाप्य तोरणोपरि सत्तमाः ..
विष्वक्सेनं समभ्यर्च्य अर्चनं स्वर्गसंयुतम् ..5..
text_mt:
Having placed Mandara facing east above the archway, O best of men,
and having worshipped Viṣvaksena, [it becomes] a worship leading to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
karṇikāyāṃ vāsudevaṃ śuddhasphaṭikasannibham ..
caturbhujaṃ śaṅkhacakragadāpadmavibhūṣitam .. 6 ..
meaning:
कर्णिकायां वासुदेवं शुद्धस्फटिकसन्निभम् ..
चतुर्भुजं शङ्खचक्रगदापद्मविभूषितम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: In the pericarp [he should contemplate] Vāsudeva, resembling pure crystal, / four-armed, adorned with conch, discus, mace, and lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīvatsakaustubhoraskaṃ mukuṭādyairalaṃkṛtam ..
dakṣiṇe kamalā tasya vāme puṣṭivyavasthitiḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
श्रीवत्सकौस्तुभोरस्कं मुकुटाद्यैरलंकृतम् ..
दक्षिणे कमला तस्य वामे पुष्टिव्यवस्थितिः .. 7 ..
text_mt: his chest marked with the Śrīvatsa and Kaustubha, adorned with a diadem and other [ornaments]; / to his right is Kamalā, and to his left Puṣṭi is situated.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhakinnarayakṣādyaiḥ stūyamānaṃ surāsuraiḥ ..
saṃpūjya vidhivadbhaktyā viṣṇorarāṭa ityṛcā .. 8 ..
meaning:
सिद्धकिन्नरयक्षाद्यैः स्तूयमानं सुरासुरैः ..
संपूज्य विधिवद्भक्त्या विष्णोरराट इत्यृचा .. 8 ..
text_mt: Being praised by Siddhas, Kinnaras, yakṣas, and others, by gods and asuras, / having worshipped [him] duly with devotion using the verse 'viṣṇor arāṭam…',

sanskrit_iast:
dale saṃkarṣaṇādīṃśca vimalādyāśca nāyikāḥ ..
saṃpūjya dhūpadīpādyairupahārairanuttamaiḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
दले संकर्षणादींश्च विमलाद्याश्च नायिकाः ..
संपूज्य धूपदीपाद्यैरुपहारैरनुत्तमैः .. 9 ..
text_mt: and on the petals Saṃkarṣaṇa and the others, and Vimalā and the other presiding Śaktis, / having worshipped [them] with incense, lamps, and other unsurpassed presentations,

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtapradīpo devasya gugguluḥ saralastathā ..
dhūpo devabaliḥ kṣīraṃ paramānnaṃ ghṛtaplutam .. 2.3.1.10 ..
meaning:
घृतप्रदीपो देवस्य गुग्गुलुः सरलस्तथा ..
धूपो देवबलिः क्षीरं परमान्नं घृतप्लुतम् .. 2.3.1.10 ..
text_mt: the deity's lamp is of clarified butter; bdellium and pine resin are / the incense; the divine offering is milk, [and] rice-milk flooded with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyetsomaṃ karṇikāyāṃ dakṣiṇe padmasaṃsthitam ..
śuklābhaṃ dvibhujaṃ śāntaṃ keyūrādyupaśobhitam.. 11 ..
meaning:
ध्यायेत्सोमं कर्णिकायां दक्षिणे पद्मसंस्थितम् ..
शुक्लाभं द्विभुजं शान्तं केयूराद्युपशोभितम्.. 11 ..
text_mt: He should meditate on Soma seated on a lotus to the right of the pericarp, / white in splendour, two-armed, peaceful, adorned with armlets and other [ornaments],

sanskrit_iast:
praśasyaṃ devayakṣāṇāṃ varadābhayahastakam ..
imaṃ devā iti ṛcā upacāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
प्रशस्यं देवयक्षाणां वरदाभयहस्तकम् ..
इमं देवा इति ऋचा उपचारैः पृथग्विधैः .. 12 ..
text_mt: praised by gods and yakṣas, his hands showing the gesture of granting boons and fearlessness, / [worshipping him] with the verse 'imaṃ devāḥ…' and with diverse services.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayecca niśānāthaṃ ghṛtabhaktaṃ nivedayet ..
indraṃ jayantamākāśaṃ varuṇaṃ cāgnimeva ca .. 13 ..
meaning:
पूजयेच्च निशानाथं घृतभक्तं निवेदयेत् ..
इन्द्रं जयन्तमाकाशं वरुणं चाग्निमेव च .. 13 ..
text_mt: And he should worship the Lord of the Night, and offer cooked rice with clarified butter; / and Indra, Jayanta, Ākāśa, Varuṇa, and Agni,

sanskrit_iast:
īśānaṃ tatpuruṣaṃ caiva vāyuṃ pūrvādidikṣvapi ..
karṇikāyā vāmabhāge varadābhayahastakam ..14..
meaning:
ईशानं तत्पुरुषं चैव वायुं पूर्वादिदिक्ष्वपि ..
कर्णिकाया वामभागे वरदाभयहस्तकम् ..14..
text_mt: as well as Īśāna, Tatpuruṣa, and Vāyu in the directions beginning with the east; / and on the left side of the pericarp, with hands showing the gesture of granting boons and fearlessness,

sanskrit_iast:
dvibhujaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ ca mahādevaṃ prapūjayet ..
tryaṃbakeṇa ca maṃtreṇa dadyācca ghṛtapiṣṭakam .. 15 ..
meaning:
द्विभुजं शुक्लवर्णं च महादेवं प्रपूजयेत् ..
त्र्यंबकेण च मंत्रेण दद्याच्च घृतपिष्टकम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: two-armed and white-complexioned, he should worship Mahādeva / with the Tryambaka mantra, and should offer pastry made with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudevāya devāya juhuyādaṣṭa āhutīḥ ..
paramānnena saumyasya juhuyādaṣṭaviṃśatim .. 16 ..
meaning:
वासुदेवाय देवाय जुहुयादष्ट आहुतीः ..
परमान्नेन सौम्यस्य जुहुयादष्टविंशतिम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: He should offer eight oblations to the god Vāsudeva; / he should offer twenty-eight [oblations] of rice-milk to the gentle [Soma];

sanskrit_iast:
śivāya paramānnena juhuyādāhutidvayam ..
gaṇeśasya tathājyena dadedekāhutiṃ budhaḥ .. .. 17 ..
meaning:
शिवाय परमान्नेन जुहुयादाहुतिद्वयम् ..
गणेशस्य तथाज्येन ददेदेकाहुतिं बुधः .. .. 17 ..
text_mt: he should offer two oblations of rice-milk to Śiva; / likewise, the wise one should offer one oblation of clarified butter to Gaṇeśa;

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇo varuṇasyātha ekaikāmāhutiṃ tathā ..
grahāṇāṃ svoktasamidhā digīśānāṃ pṛthakpṛthak .. 18 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मणो वरुणस्याथ एकैकामाहुतिं तथा ..
ग्रहाणां स्वोक्तसमिधा दिगीशानां पृथक्पृथक् .. 18 ..
text_mt: then one oblation each to Brahmā and Varuṇa; / for the planets, with their prescribed kindling sticks; for the lords of the directions separately,

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyādājyena ca yathākram ..
karālī dhūmalī śvetā lohitā kanakaprabhā .. 19 ..
meaning:
एकैकामाहुतिं दद्यादाज्येन च यथाक्रम् ..
कराली धूमली श्वेता लोहिता कनकप्रभा .. 19 ..
text_mt: he should offer one oblation each with clarified butter in due order: / Karālī, Dhūmalī, Śvetā, Lohitā, Kanakaprabhā,

sanskrit_iast:
atiraktā padmarāgā vahnijihvā prakīrtitāḥ ..
tāsāṃ maṃtrāḥ krameṇaiva sādivāsāṃta bindavaḥ .. 2.3.1.20 ..
meaning:
अतिरक्ता पद्मरागा वह्निजिह्वा प्रकीर्तिताः ..
तासां मंत्राः क्रमेणैव सादिवासांत बिन्दवः .. 2.3.1.20 ..
text_mt: Atiraktā, and Padmarāgā are declared to be the tongues of Agni; / their mantras in due order end with the bindu, beginning with 'sa' and ending with 'va',

sanskrit_iast:
yakārasthāśca vijñeyā aṣṭasvaravibhūṣitāḥ ..
ghṛtamadhvājyasiktābhirhomayecca pṛthakpṛthak .. 21 ..
meaning:
यकारस्थाश्च विज्ञेया अष्टस्वरविभूषिताः ..
घृतमध्वाज्यसिक्ताभिर्होमयेच्च पृथक्पृथक् .. 21 ..
text_mt: and are to be understood as placed on the letter 'ya', adorned with the eight vowels; / he should offer separately with [oblations] sprinkled with clarified butter and honey.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyāddattvā caiva samāhitaḥ ..
agnīṣomaṃ tathendraṃ ca pṛthivīmantarikṣakam .. 22 ..
meaning:
एकैकामाहुतिं दद्याद्दत्त्वा चैव समाहितः ..
अग्नीषोमं तथेन्द्रं च पृथिवीमन्तरिक्षकम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: He should offer one oblation to each, and having offered [them], composed in mind, / [then] to Agni and Soma, and likewise to Indra, to the earth, and to the mid-air,

sanskrit_iast:
sthālīpākena juhuyānmadhukṣīrayavānvitam ..
ekaikāmāhutiṃ teṣāṃ samuddiśya pṛthakpṛthak .. 23 ..
meaning:
स्थालीपाकेन जुहुयान्मधुक्षीरयवान्वितम् ..
एकैकामाहुतिं तेषां समुद्दिश्य पृथक्पृथक् .. 23 ..
text_mt: he should offer with a pot-cooked oblation mixed with honey, milk, and barley, / one oblation to each of them separately, dedicated by name.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvakairgaṃdhapuṣpādyairarcitvā saparāvakam ..
japasva tvaṃ mahābhāga śraddhayā caiva vāgyataḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
यावकैर्गंधपुष्पाद्यैरर्चित्वा सपरावकम् ..
जपस्व त्वं महाभाग श्रद्धया चैव वाग्यतः .. 24 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped them with barley gruel, perfumes, flowers, and the like, along with the cup, / do you recite, O highly fortunate one, with faith and with speech restrained.

sanskrit_iast:
jāpako vidhinānena prajapettatra ruddhakam ..
maṅgalaṃ paramānnaṃ ca saurasūktaṃ tathā japet .. 25 ..
meaning:
जापको विधिनानेन प्रजपेत्तत्र रुद्धकम् ..
मङ्गलं परमान्नं च सौरसूक्तं तथा जपेत् .. 25 ..
text_mt: The reciter, according to this rule, should recite there the protective [verse]; / he should recite the auspicious [hymn], [offer] rice-milk, and likewise recite the Saura Sūkta.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃmṛjya vidhinā snāpayitvā yathāvidhi ..
yūpaṃ garbhe vinikṣipya tatra kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ..26..
meaning:
ततः संमृज्य विधिना स्नापयित्वा यथाविधि ..
यूपं गर्भे विनिक्षिप्य तत्र कुर्याद्विचक्षणः ..26..
text_mt: Then, having cleansed [it] according to rule and bathed [it] as prescribed, / casting the sacrificial post into the pit, the discerning man should do there [as follows]:

sanskrit_iast:
dhvajānāropya prāṃteṣu dadyātsomaṃ vanaspatim ..
ko'dāditi paṭhitvā ca vṛkṣāṇāṃ karṇavedhanam ..27..
meaning:
ध्वजानारोप्य प्रांतेषु दद्यात्सोमं वनस्पतिम् ..
कोऽदादिति पठित्वा च वृक्षाणां कर्णवेधनम् ..27..
text_mt: having raised banners at the borders, he should offer [worship to] Soma, the lord of the forest; / and having recited 'ko 'dāt…', the ear-piercing of the trees

sanskrit_iast:
sūcyā sutīkṣṇayā kāryaṃ dvipātre vāmadakṣiṇe ..
navagrahāṇāṃ tṛptyarthaṃ yāvakaṃ laḍḍukaṃ tathā .. 28 ..
meaning:
सूच्या सुतीक्ष्णया कार्यं द्विपात्रे वामदक्षिणे ..
नवग्रहाणां तृप्त्यर्थं यावकं लड्डुकं तथा .. 28 ..
text_mt: is to be performed with a very sharp needle in two vessels, on the left and the right; / for the satisfaction of the nine planets, barley gruel and sweetmeats,

sanskrit_iast:
piṣṭakaṃ ca pṛthagdadyātkumārībālakeṣu ca ..
niśāraṃjitasūtreṇa saṃveṣṭya ca sacūrṇakam .. 29..
meaning:
पिष्टकं च पृथग्दद्यात्कुमारीबालकेषु च ..
निशारंजितसूत्रेण संवेष्ट्य च सचूर्णकम् .. 29..
text_mt: and pastry he should give separately, and to maidens and young boys; / and having wrapped [the trees] with a thread dyed with turmeric and covered with powder,

sanskrit_iast:
pradadyāddohakaṃ caiva vṛkṣāṇāṃ vidhipūrvakam ..
prāśayeccaiva tānvṛkṣānimaṃ mantramudāharet .. 2.3.1.30 ..
meaning:
प्रदद्याद्दोहकं चैव वृक्षाणां विधिपूर्वकम् ..
प्राशयेच्चैव तान्वृक्षानिमं मन्त्रमुदाहरेत् .. 2.3.1.30 ..
text_mt: he should duly present a bucket to the trees; / and he should feed those trees, and utter this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkṣāgrātpatitasyāpi ārohātpatitasya ca..
maraṇe vāsthibhaṅge vā kartā pāpairna lipyate ..31..
meaning:
वृक्षाग्रात्पतितस्यापि आरोहात्पतितस्य च..
मरणे वास्थिभङ्गे वा कर्ता पापैर्न लिप्यते ..31..
text_mt: 'Whether someone falls from the top of the tree, or falls while climbing, / in the event of death or a broken bone, the agent is not smeared with sin.'

sanskrit_iast:
dhenuṃ suvarṇaṃ dhānyaṃ ca ācāryāya pradakṣiṇam..
dattvā ca ṛtvije dadyātsuvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tathā .. 32 ..
meaning:
धेनुं सुवर्णं धान्यं च आचार्याय प्रदक्षिणम्..
दत्त्वा च ऋत्विजे दद्यात्सुवर्णं रजतं तथा .. 32 ..
text_mt: Having given a cow, gold, and grain to the preceptor as a sacrificial fee, / and having circumambulated, he should give gold and silver to the officiating priest;

sanskrit_iast:
dhānyaṃ ca brahmaṇe dadyādghṛtabhojyaṃ saśarkaram ..
iṣṭāṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātsadasyāya tathaiva ca .. 33 ..
meaning:
धान्यं च ब्रह्मणे दद्याद्घृतभोज्यं सशर्करम् ..
इष्टां च दक्षिणां दद्यात्सदस्याय तथैव च .. 33 ..
text_mt: and he should give grain to the Brahmā priest, and food cooked with clarified butter and sugar; / and likewise he should give an agreeable fee to each member of the assembly.

sanskrit_iast:
adhikalaśaṃ samānīya snānaṃ kuryādvidhānataḥ ..
kṛtvā caivāniśaṃ kuryāddadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ tathā ..34..
meaning:
अधिकलशं समानीय स्नानं कुर्याद्विधानतः ..
कृत्वा चैवानिशं कुर्याद्दद्यात्पूर्णाहुतिं तथा ..34..
text_mt: Having brought the principal pitcher, he should perform the ablution according to the ordinance; / and having done so, he should proceed without interruption and offer the final oblation.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvauṣadhyudakaṃ prokṣya trivāraṃ kṣīradhārayā ..
saṃveṣṭya triścaturvāraṃ brahmaghoṣapuraḥsaram .. .. 35 ..
meaning:
सर्वौषध्युदकं प्रोक्ष्य त्रिवारं क्षीरधारया ..
संवेष्ट्य त्रिश्चतुर्वारं ब्रह्मघोषपुरःसरम् .. .. 35 ..
text_mt: Sprinkling all-herb water, three times with a stream of milk, / having wrapped [it] three or four times, preceded by the chanting of the Veda,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhaṃ vrajettato vipraiḥ kuryāccaiva gṛhārcanam ..
taṃtau viśeṣaṃ vakṣyāmi varā evedamityṛcā .. 36 ..
meaning:
गृहं व्रजेत्ततो विप्रैः कुर्याच्चैव गृहार्चनम् ..
तंतौ विशेषं वक्ष्यामि वरा एवेदमित्यृचा .. 36 ..
text_mt: he should then go home and perform the worship of the house with the brāhmaṇas; / I shall declare the special rule concerning the thread, with the verse 'varā evedam…'.

sanskrit_iast:
balaṃ kāmaṃ hayagrīvaṃ mādhavaṃ puruṣottamam..
vāsudevaṃ dhanādhyakṣaṃ tato nārāyaṇaṃ yajet..37..
meaning:
बलं कामं हयग्रीवं माधवं पुरुषोत्तमम्..
वासुदेवं धनाध्यक्षं ततो नारायणं यजेत्..37..
text_mt: He should worship Bala, Kāma, Hayagrīva, Mādhava, Puruṣottama, / Vāsudeva, the Lord of Wealth, and then Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhibhaktaṃ baliṃ dadyātpañcagavyasamudbhavam..
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhinā dakṣiṇe pṛthivīṃ yajet..38..
meaning:
दधिभक्तं बलिं दद्यात्पञ्चगव्यसमुद्भवम्..
एवं संपूज्य विधिना दक्षिणे पृथिवीं यजेत्..38..
text_mt: He should present an offering of curd-rice prepared with the five products of the cow; / having thus worshipped according to rule, he should worship the Earth on the right:

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhakāṃñcanavarṇābhāṃ varābhayakarāṃ śubhām ..
maṃḍūkasthāṃ ca dvibhujāṃ sarvālaṅkārasundarīm ..39..
meaning:
शुद्धकांञ्चनवर्णाभां वराभयकरां शुभाम् ..
मंडूकस्थां च द्विभुजां सर्वालङ्कारसुन्दरीम् ..39..
text_mt: shining with the colour of pure gold, auspicious, her hands showing boon-granting and fearlessness, / seated upon a frog, two-armed, beautiful with all ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
syonā pṛthivīti mantreṇa pūjayitvā yathāvidhi ..
pāyasaṃ madhusaṃyuktaṃ baliṃ dadyātsaśarkaram .. 2.3.1.40 ..
meaning:
स्योना पृथिवीति मन्त्रेण पूजयित्वा यथाविधि ..
पायसं मधुसंयुक्तं बलिं दद्यात्सशर्करम् .. 2.3.1.40 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped [her] duly with the mantra 'syonā pṛthivi…', / he should present an offering of rice-milk combined with honey and sugar.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmato viśvakarmāṇaṃ śuddhasphaṭikasaṃnibham ..
śūlaṭaṃkadharaṃ śāṃtaṃ saṃyajedupacārakaiḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
वामतो विश्वकर्माणं शुद्धस्फटिकसंनिभम् ..
शूलटंकधरं शांतं संयजेदुपचारकैः .. 41 ..
text_mt: On the left [he should worship] Viśvakarman, resembling pure crystal, / holding a trident and a chisel, peaceful, worshipping him with the articles of veneration,

sanskrit_iast:

dadyājjapecca kauṣmāṇḍaṃ sūktaṃ pauruṣameva ca ...45...
meaning:
विश्वन्निति ऋचा तं च बलिं च मधु पिष्टकम् ..
दद्याज्जपेच्च कौष्माण्डं सूक्तं पौरुषमेव च ...45...
text_mt: and [offering to] him with the verse 'viśvann…' an offering of honey and pastry, / he should give [it] and recite the Kauṣmāṇḍa sūkta and the Puruṣa Sūkta.

sanskrit_iast:
madhupāyasayuktena homānaṣṭau vidhāya ca..
ekaikaṃ homayetpaścā tpṛthivīhomakarmaṇi ..43..
meaning:
मधुपायसयुक्तेन होमानष्टौ विधाय च..
एकैकं होमयेत्पश्चा त्पृथिवीहोमकर्मणि ..43..
text_mt: And having performed eight oblations with [an oblation] mixed with honey and rice-milk, / he should then offer each one in the oblation-rite for the Earth.

sanskrit_iast:
samutsṛjya tataḥ setumimaṃ mantraṃ paṭhettataḥ ..
picchile patitānāṃ ca ucchritenāṃgasaṃgataḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
समुत्सृज्य ततः सेतुमिमं मन्त्रं पठेत्ततः ..
पिच्छिले पतितानां च उच्छ्रितेनांगसंगतः .. 44 ..
text_mt: Then, having dedicated the causeway, he should recite this mantra: / 'For those who have slipped on slippery ground, whose limbs are united with an elevated [crossing],

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhite dharmasetau dharmo me syānna pātakam ..
setorasya prabandhasya śraddhayā parayā tathā .. 45 ..
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठिते धर्मसेतौ धर्मो मे स्यान्न पातकम् ..
सेतोरस्य प्रबन्धस्य श्रद्धया परया तथा .. 45 ..
text_mt: when this bridge of dharma has been established, may righteousness accrue to me, not sin!' / And by the construction of this bridge, with supreme faith,

sanskrit_iast:
ye cātra prāṇinaḥ saṃti rakṣāṃ kurvati setavaḥ ..
vedāgamena yatpuṇyaṃ yathaiva hi samarpitam .. 46 ..
meaning:
ये चात्र प्राणिनः संति रक्षां कुर्वति सेतवः ..
वेदागमेन यत्पुण्यं यथैव हि समर्पितम् .. 46 ..
text_mt: whatever living creatures are here, bridges provide protection [to them]; / whatever merit is acquired through the Vedic tradition is thereby truly offered.

sanskrit_iast:
gartaṃ kṛtvā pañcaratnaṃ saṃsthāpyaṃ tadanantaram ..
saṃsthāpya ca tato yūpaṃ saṃpūjya ca yathāvidhi .. 47 ..
meaning:
गर्तं कृत्वा पञ्चरत्नं संस्थाप्यं तदनन्तरम् ..
संस्थाप्य च ततो यूपं संपूज्य च यथाविधि .. 47 ..
text_mt: Having dug a pit and placed the five gems in it immediately after, / and then having erected the sacrificial post and worshipped it according to rule,

ācāryāya tato dadyādiṣṭāṃ ca varadakṣiṇām ..
pūjayeddvijadāṃpatyaṃ lājābhiḥ paripūjitam .. 48 ..
meaning:
आचार्याय ततो दद्यादिष्टां च वरदक्षिणाम् ..
पूजयेद्द्विजदांपत्यं लाजाभिः परिपूजितम् .. 48 ..
text_mt: he should then give to the preceptor an agreeable and excellent sacrificial fee; / he should worship a brāhmaṇa couple that has been honoured with puffed grain;

sanskrit_iast:
poṭikāṃ ca tataḥ śayyāṃ dadyādiṣṭārthasiddhaye ..
setau vṛkṣa sthitā ye syū ropayetkadalīṃ śubhām .. 49 ..
meaning:
पोटिकां च ततः शय्यां दद्यादिष्टार्थसिद्धये ..
सेतौ वृक्ष स्थिता ये स्यू रोपयेत्कदलीं शुभाम् .. 49 ..
text_mt: and then he should give a bundle and a bed for the attainment of desired ends; / whatever trees stand upon the embankment, he should plant auspicious plantains

gopracāravaiśiṣṭyavarṇanam

on both sides of them in this manner, and separately in the grove.
Description of the Excellence of Pasture Land for Cattle

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
gopracāraṃ punarvakṣye viśeṣaṃ tatra me śṛṇu ..
yajedviṣṇuṃ sala kṣmīkamupacāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
गोप्रचारं पुनर्वक्ष्ये विशेषं तत्र मे शृणु ..
यजेद्विष्णुं सल क्ष्मीकमुपचारैः पृथग्विधैः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / I shall further declare the pasture land for cattle; listen to its specific rule from me. / One should worship Viṣṇu accompanied by Lakṣmī with various kinds of offerings,
title: adhyāyaḥ 02

sanskrit_iast:
upacāraiśca brahmāṇaṃ rudraṃ caiva karālikām ..
varāhaṃ somasūrye ca mahādevaṃ yathākramam .. 2 ..
meaning:
उपचारैश्च ब्रह्माणं रुद्रं चैव करालिकाम् ..
वराहं सोमसूर्ये च महादेवं यथाक्रमम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: and, with offerings, Brahmā, Rudra, Karālikā, / Varāha, Soma, Sūrya, and Mahādeva, in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
homaṃ caiva yathā viṣṇoḥ kamalāyāstrayaṃtrayam ..
ājyena kṣetrapālānāmanyeṣāṃ madhumiśritaiḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
होमं चैव यथा विष्णोः कमलायास्त्रयंत्रयम् ..
आज्येन क्षेत्रपालानामन्येषां मधुमिश्रितैः .. 3 ..
text_mt: And likewise a fire oblation of three [offerings] each for Viṣṇu and Kamalā, / with clarified butter for the protectors of the fields, and for the others mixed with honey.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyāllājādiṣu pṛthakpṛthak ..
samutsṛjya vidhānena yūpaṃ saṃsthāpya pūjayet .. 4 ..
meaning:
एकैकामाहुतिं दद्याल्लाजादिषु पृथक्पृथक् ..
समुत्सृज्य विधानेन यूपं संस्थाप्य पूजयेत् .. 4 ..
text_mt: One should offer oblations one by one among puffed grains and the like separately; / having consecrated according to rule and erected a sacrificial post, one should worship it.

sanskrit_iast:
trihastamāttraṃ racitaṃ kuryānnāgaphaṇānvitam ..
ropayedekahastena garbhe homaṃ prayojayet ..5..
meaning:
त्रिहस्तमात्त्रं रचितं कुर्यान्नागफणान्वितम् ..
रोपयेदेकहस्तेन गर्भे होमं प्रयोजयेत् ..5..
text_mt: One should make it measuring three cubits, provided with a serpent's hood; / one should plant it by one cubit, and perform the fire oblation into the pit.

sanskrit_iast:
lājāsaṃyuktavidhinā viśveṣāmiti sañjapan ..
nāgādhipataye tadvadacyutāya tṛtīyakam .. 6 ..
meaning:
लाजासंयुक्तविधिना विश्वेषामिति सञ्जपन् ..
नागाधिपतये तद्वदच्युताय तृतीयकम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: According to the rule accompanied by puffed grains, chanting "To all [gods]", / likewise to the lord of serpents, and a third to Acyuta,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaumāyeti caturthaṃ ca tato yūpaṃ nivedayet ..
mayi gṛbhṇāmīti sampūjya yūpaṃ ca rudradaivatama .. 7 ..
meaning:
भौमायेति चतुर्थं च ततो यूपं निवेदयेत् ..
मयि गृभ्णामीति सम्पूज्य यूपं च रुद्रदैवतम .. 7 ..
text_mt: and a fourth saying "To the son of the earth [Mars]"; then one should dedicate the sacrificial post. / Having worshipped with "I take within myself", the sacrificial post has Rudra as its deity.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya rudraṃ pañcāṃgaṃ dhānyaṃ vastraṃ ca dakṣiṇām ..
ācāryāya tathā hotre anyeṣāmiṣṭadakṣiṇām .. 8 ..
meaning:
संपूज्य रुद्रं पञ्चांगं धान्यं वस्त्रं च दक्षिणाम् ..
आचार्याय तथा होत्रे अन्येषामिष्टदक्षिणाम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped the five-limbed Rudra, [one should offer] grain, cloth, and a sacrificial fee / to the preceptor as well as the hotṛ-priest, and to the others a desired sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast:
gopracāre ca śaileyaṃ yūpaṃ hastadvayānvitam ..
pañcaśīrṣānvitaṃ kuryāddhastamātraṃ praropayet .. 9 ..
meaning:
गोप्रचारे च शैलेयं यूपं हस्तद्वयान्वितम् ..
पञ्चशीर्षान्वितं कुर्याद्धस्तमात्रं प्ररोपयेत् .. 9 ..
text_mt: And on the pasture land for cows, one should make a stone sacrificial post measuring two cubits / provided with five heads, [and] plant it to the extent of a single cubit.

sanskrit_iast:
yūpaṃ ca caitravṛkṣaṃ ca kuṇḍalīmaṭhapīṭhikām ..
saṃspṛśyācamya vai viprāḥ prāṇāyāmena śudhyati .. 2.3.2.10 ..
meaning:
यूपं च चैत्रवृक्षं च कुण्डलीमठपीठिकाम् ..
संस्पृश्याचम्य वै विप्राः प्राणायामेन शुध्यति .. 2.3.2.10 ..
text_mt: Having touched a sacrificial post, a sacred tree, a Kuṇḍalī monastery or shrine, / and having sipped water, O brāhmaṇas, one is purified by breath control.

sanskrit_iast:
caturhastapramāṇena śatakuṇḍena saṃmitam ..
tadardhaṃ ca kaniṣṭhena aṣṭakāṣṭādhikaṃ bhavet .. 11 ..
meaning:
चतुर्हस्तप्रमाणेन शतकुण्डेन संमितम् ..
तदर्धं च कनिष्ठेन अष्टकाष्टाधिकं भवेत् .. 11 ..
text_mt: It is measured by four cubits, conforming to one hundred pits; / half of that in the lowest measure would exceed eight by eight.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmau ratnaṃ ca saṃsthāpya imaṃ mantramudāharet ..
śivalokastathā gāvaḥ sarvadevasupūjitāḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
भूमौ रत्नं च संस्थाप्य इमं मन्त्रमुदाहरेत् ..
शिवलोकस्तथा गावः सर्वदेवसुपूजिताः .. 12 ..
text_mt: And having placed a jewel in the earth, one should pronounce this mantra: / "Cattle are the world of Śiva, worshipped by all gods.

sanskrit_iast:
gobhya eṣā mayā bhūmiḥ sampradattā śubhārthinā ..
evaṃ nivedayedyastu gopracāraṃ samāhitaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
गोभ्य एषा मया भूमिः सम्प्रदत्ता शुभार्थिना ..
एवं निवेदयेद्यस्तु गोप्रचारं समाहितः .. 13 ..
text_mt: This land is given by me to the cattle, desiring welfare." / Whoever, attentive, dedicates pasture land for cattle in this manner,

sanskrit_iast:
sa muktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇuloke mahīyate ..
yāvaṃti tṛṇagulmāni saṃti bhūmau śubhāni ca .. 14 ..
meaning:
स मुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यो विष्णुलोके महीयते ..
यावंति तृणगुल्मानि संति भूमौ शुभानि च .. 14 ..
text_mt: freed from all sins, is glorified in the realm of Viṣṇu. / As many auspicious grasses and shrubs as there are on the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ..
pūrve sīmāṃ nibadhnīyātkṛtvā vṛkṣasya ropaṇam .. 15 ..
meaning:
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते ..
पूर्वे सीमां निबध्नीयात्कृत्वा वृक्षस्य रोपणम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: for that many thousands of years he is glorified in the heavenly realm. / One should fix the boundary in the east by planting a tree;

sanskrit_iast:
setuṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇataḥ paścimeṃgāraropaṇam ..
uttare khānayetkūpaṃ tasya sīmāṃ na laṃghayeta..16..
meaning:
सेतुं कृत्वा दक्षिणतः पश्चिमेंगाररोपणम् ..
उत्तरे खानयेत्कूपं तस्य सीमां न लंघयेत..16..
text_mt: having made a dam in the south, [and] planting charcoal in the west, / one should dig a well in the north; one should not cross its boundary.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sahasradhārāṃ ca śasyena paripūritām ..
pradadyādvā tato viprāḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ..17..
meaning:
ततः सहस्रधारां च शस्येन परिपूरिताम् ..
प्रदद्याद्वा ततो विप्राः सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ..17..
text_mt: Then one should give a thousand-streamed vessel filled with grain; / or from that, O brāhmaṇas, one is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
nagaragrāmapūrve vā uttare paścimepi vā ..
na kuryādagnidigbhāge dakṣiṇāṃ vā tataḥ śubhām .. 18 ..
meaning:
नगरग्रामपूर्वे वा उत्तरे पश्चिमेपि वा ..
न कुर्यादग्निदिग्भागे दक्षिणां वा ततः शुभाम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: Either to the east of a city or village, or to the north or west; / one should not make the auspicious [land] in the southeastern direction or the south.

sanskrit_iast:
gopracāraṃ khanedyastu vāhayedvā kathaṃcana ..
kulāni pātayatyāśu brahmahatyāśca viṃdati .. 19 ..
meaning:
गोप्रचारं खनेद्यस्तु वाहयेद्वा कथंचन ..
कुलानि पातयत्याशु ब्रह्महत्याश्च विंदति .. 19 ..
text_mt: Whoever digs up or somehow plows a pasture for cattle / causes his families to fall quickly and incurs the killing of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
svargaṃ nayati gocarma samyagdattaṃ sadakṣiṇam ..
yāvattṛṇāni tadbhūmau saptasaṃkhyāni saṃkhyayā .. 2.3.2.20 ..
meaning:
स्वर्गं नयति गोचर्म सम्यग्दत्तं सदक्षिणम् ..
यावत्तृणानि तद्भूमौ सप्तसंख्यानि संख्यया .. 2.3.2.20 ..
text_mt: A gocarma [measure of land] properly given with a sacrificial fee leads to heaven. / As many grasses as there are on that land, numbering seven times in count,

sanskrit_iast: tāvatkālaṃ vasetsvarge viṣṇulokānna taccyutiḥ .. 21 ..
meaning: तावत्कालं वसेत्स्वर्गे विष्णुलोकान्न तच्च्युतिः .. 21 ..
text_mt: for so long a time he dwells in heaven; there is no falling away from the world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāyāgāvasāne ca yo na tarpayati dvijān ..
nirarthakaṃ tasya karma prayāsaphalamātrakam .. 22 ..
meaning:
महायागावसाने च यो न तर्पयति द्विजान् ..
निरर्थकं तस्य कर्म प्रयासफलमात्रकम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: And at the end of a great sacrifice, he who does not satisfy the twice-born / finds his rite fruitless, yielding only exertion.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣotsargā vasāne tu pradadyādyo mahīṃ dvijāḥ ..
na yāti viprāḥ pretatvaṃ tasmādviprādamatsarāḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
वृषोत्सर्गा वसाने तु प्रदद्याद्यो महीं द्विजाः ..
न याति विप्राः प्रेतत्वं तस्माद्विप्रादमत्सराः .. 23 ..
text_mt: At the conclusion of the bull's release, whoever gives land, O twice-born, / does not enter the state of a preta, O ungrudging brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra mānaṃ pṛthakcaiva śṛṇutātra samāgatāḥ ..
amānena dadedyastu narakaṃ yāti rauravama .. 24 ..
meaning:
तत्र मानं पृथक्चैव शृणुतात्र समागताः ..
अमानेन ददेद्यस्तु नरकं याति रौरवम .. 24 ..
text_mt: Listen to the distinct measure in this matter, you who have gathered here: / he who gives without measure goes to the Raurava hell.

sanskrit_iast:
gavāṃ śataṃ vṛṣaścaiko yatra tiṣṭhatyayaṃtritaḥ ..
tadgocarmeti vikhyātaṃ dattaṃ sarvāghanāśanam .. 25 ..
meaning:
गवां शतं वृषश्चैको यत्र तिष्ठत्ययंत्रितः ..
तद्गोचर्मेति विख्यातं दत्तं सर्वाघनाशनम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Where a hundred cows and one bull can stand unconstrained, / that is renowned as a gocarma; when given, it destroys all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
gopracārasya devasya brāhmaṇasya ca bho dvijāḥ ..
yāvatkālāvadhe sīmā atīte nāsti pātakam .. 26 ..
meaning:
गोप्रचारस्य देवस्य ब्राह्मणस्य च भो द्विजाः ..
यावत्कालावधे सीमा अतीते नास्ति पातकम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: Of pasture land for cattle, of a god, and of a brāhmaṇa, O twice-born, / the boundary lasts for a period of time; once passed, there is no sin.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍapaṃ pūjayetsūryaṃ vāsudevasamanvitam..
homastila guḍābhyāṃ ca aṣṭāvaṣṭau pṛthakpṛthak .. 27 ..
meaning:
मण्डपं पूजयेत्सूर्यं वासुदेवसमन्वितम्..
होमस्तिल गुडाभ्यां च अष्टावष्टौ पृथक्पृथक् .. 27 ..
text_mt: One should worship the sun accompanied by Vāsudeva in the pavilion; / the fire oblation is with sesame and jaggery, eight each separately.

sanskrit_iast:
dehi meti ca mantreṇa vinyasenmaṃḍapopari ..
yatnasiddhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā śulkaghaṭacatuṣṭayam.. 28 ..
meaning:
देहि मेति च मन्त्रेण विन्यसेन्मंडपोपरि ..
यत्नसिद्धं ततः कृत्वा शुल्कघटचतुष्टयम्.. 28 ..
text_mt: And with the mantra "Give unto me", one should place [them] on the pavilion; / then, having carefully prepared four tax-pots,

sanskrit_iast:
samutsṛjejjapetpaścātsauraṃ sūktaṃ ca vaiṣṇavam ..
vaṭapatre tu saṃlikhya citraṃ nirmāya vā punaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
समुत्सृजेज्जपेत्पश्चात्सौरं सूक्तं च वैष्णवम् ..
वटपत्रे तु संलिख्य चित्रं निर्माय वा पुनः .. 29 ..
text_mt: one should dedicate [it], and afterwards chant a solar hymn and a Vaiṣṇava [hymn]. / Having written on a banyan leaf, or having made an image,

sanskrit_iast:
dikpālānsaṃnyasetsvāsu svāsu dikṣu vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
baddhāñjaliḥ paṭhenmaṃtrāniṃdrādīnāṃ yathākramam .. 2.3.2.30 ..
meaning:
दिक्पालान्संन्यसेत्स्वासु स्वासु दिक्षु विचक्षणः ..
बद्धाञ्जलिः पठेन्मंत्रानिंद्रादीनां यथाक्रमम् .. 2.3.2.30 ..
text_mt: the wise man should place the guardians of the directions in their respective directions; / with folded hands he should recite the mantras of Indra and the others in order:

sanskrit_iast:
dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya ātmano vibhavāya ca ..
vajrahasto mahendra tvaṃ dharmatastrātumarhasi ..31..
meaning:
धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय आत्मनो विभवाय च ..
वज्रहस्तो महेन्द्र त्वं धर्मतस्त्रातुमर्हसि ..31..
text_mt: "For the establishment of righteousness and for my own prosperity, / O Mahendra, thunderbolt in hand, you ought to protect according to righteousness!

sanskrit_iast:
bho vahne meṣavāhastvaṃ catuḥśṛṃgavirājita ..
anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi .. 32 ..
meaning:
भो वह्ने मेषवाहस्त्वं चतुःशृंगविराजित ..
अनाथं मण्डपं त्वं हि धर्मतस्त्रातुमर्हसि .. 32 ..
text_mt: O Vahni, you whose vehicle is a ram, adorned with four horns! / Indeed, you ought to protect the masterless pavilion according to righteousness!

sanskrit_iast:
yama tvaṃ dakṣiṇāśeśa mahāmahiṣavāhana ..
anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi .. 33 ..
meaning:
यम त्वं दक्षिणाशेश महामहिषवाहन ..
अनाथं मण्डपं त्वं हि धर्मतस्त्रातुमर्हसि .. 33 ..
text_mt: O Yama, you lord of the southern quarter, whose vehicle is a great buffalo! / Indeed, you ought to protect the masterless pavilion according to righteousness!

sanskrit_iast:
mañcastho rākṣasendrastvaṃ khaḍgapāṇirmahābalaḥ ..
anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi .. 34 ..
meaning:
मञ्चस्थो राक्षसेन्द्रस्त्वं खड्गपाणिर्महाबलः ..
अनाथं मण्डपं त्वं हि धर्मतस्त्रातुमर्हसि .. 34 ..
text_mt: Mounted on a couch, you king of the rākṣasas, sword in hand, of great might! / Indeed, you ought to protect the masterless pavilion according to righteousness!

sanskrit_iast:
vārirāṭ dhvajahasto'si pavano mṛgavāhanaḥ ..
anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi .. 35 ..
meaning:
वारिराट् ध्वजहस्तोऽसि पवनो मृगवाहनः ..
अनाथं मण्डपं त्वं हि धर्मतस्त्रातुमर्हसि .. 35 ..
text_mt: You are the king of waters, banner in hand; Pavana, whose vehicle is a deer! / Indeed, you ought to protect the masterless pavilion according to righteousness!

sanskrit_iast:
dhanādhyakṣo gadāhastaḥ piṃgākṣo naravāhanaḥ ..
anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi .. 36 ..
meaning:
धनाध्यक्षो गदाहस्तः पिंगाक्षो नरवाहनः ..
अनाथं मण्डपं त्वं हि धर्मतस्त्रातुमर्हसि .. 36 ..
text_mt: The guardian of wealth, mace in hand, reddish-eyed, whose vehicle is a man! / Indeed, you ought to protect the masterless pavilion according to righteousness!

sanskrit_iast:
ādidevosi devānāṃ kartā hartā maheśvaraḥ ..
anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi .. 37 ..
meaning:
आदिदेवोसि देवानां कर्ता हर्ता महेश्वरः ..
अनाथं मण्डपं त्वं हि धर्मतस्त्रातुमर्हसि .. 37 ..
text_mt: You are the primal god of the gods, creator, destroyer, Maheśvara! / Indeed, you ought to protect the masterless pavilion according to righteousness!

sanskrit_iast:
anaṃto nāgarājo yo dharāmuddhṛtya tiṣṭhati ..
anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatasrātumarhasi .. 38 ..
meaning:
अनंतो नागराजो यो धरामुद्धृत्य तिष्ठति ..
अनाथं मण्डपं त्वं हि धर्मतस्रातुमर्हसि .. 38 ..
text_mt: Ananta, the serpent king, who stands upholding the earth! / Indeed, you ought to protect the masterless pavilion according to righteousness!"

sanskrit_iast:
caturṇāmeva varṇānāṃ sthityarthaṃ mṛgapakṣiṇām ..
prītaye vāsudevasya evaṃ maṇḍapamutsṛjet .. 39 ..
meaning:
चतुर्णामेव वर्णानां स्थित्यर्थं मृगपक्षिणाम् ..
प्रीतये वासुदेवस्य एवं मण्डपमुत्सृजेत् .. 39 ..
text_mt: For the sustenance of all four classes, for beasts and birds, / and for the pleasure of Vāsudeva, one should thus dedicate the pavilion.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagne stambhe tṛṇe jīrṇe punastṛṇapradāpane ..
sthāpane ca tathaivāsya pratiṣṭhā syādyathākṣayā .. 2.3.2.40 ..
meaning:
भग्ने स्तम्भे तृणे जीर्णे पुनस्तृणप्रदापने ..
स्थापने च तथैवास्य प्रतिष्ठा स्याद्यथाक्षया .. 2.3.2.40 ..
text_mt: "When a pillar is broken, when thatch is worn out, in giving thatch again / and likewise in erecting it, so may its consecration be imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
ghātāpāyādidoṣeṇa mriyaṃte yadi jantavaḥ ..
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ tu dharmo me syānna pātakam .. 41 ..
meaning:
घातापायादिदोषेण म्रियंते यदि जन्तवः ..
प्रतिष्ठायां कृतायां तु धर्मो मे स्यान्न पातकम् .. 41 ..
text_mt: If living beings die due to the fault of accidents and harms, / when the consecration has been performed, may there be righteousness for me and not sin.

sanskrit_iast:
mānuṣāḥ paśavo ye ca nivasantīha maṇḍape ..
svasti cāstu sadā teṣāṃ tvatprasādātkila prabho .. 42 ..
meaning:
मानुषाः पशवो ये च निवसन्तीह मण्डपे ..
स्वस्ति चास्तु सदा तेषां त्वत्प्रसादात्किल प्रभो .. 42 ..
text_mt: The humans and animals that dwell here in the pavilion, / may there always be well-being for them through your grace, O Lord!"

sanskrit_iast:
tatastriguṇasūtreṇa sutrāmāṇeti vai ṛcā ..
saptadhā veṣṭayitvā tu dakṣiṇāṃ saṃprakāśya ca .. 43 ..
meaning:
ततस्त्रिगुणसूत्रेण सुत्रामाणेति वै ऋचा ..
सप्तधा वेष्टयित्वा तु दक्षिणां संप्रकाश्य च .. 43 ..
text_mt: Then, having wrapped it sevenfold with a triple-stranded cord / with the verse beginning "Sutrāmāṇam", and having declared the sacrificial fee,

sanskrit_iast:
upānahau tathā chatramācāryāya nivedayet ..
maṇḍape bhojayedviprāṃsteṣāṃ dadyādyathepsitān .. .. 44 ..
meaning:
उपानहौ तथा छत्रमाचार्याय निवेदयेत् ..
मण्डपे भोजयेद्विप्रांस्तेषां दद्याद्यथेप्सितान् .. .. 44 ..
text_mt: He should present sandals and a royal parasol to the ācārya; / he should feed the brāhmaṇas in the pavilion and give them whatever they desire.

sanskrit_iast:
dīnebhyaśca pṛthagdadyādgṛhaṃ viprapuraḥsaram ..
praviśettūryaghoṣeṇa prakuryācca gṛhārcanam .. 45 ..
meaning:
दीनेभ्यश्च पृथग्दद्याद्गृहं विप्रपुरःसरम् ..
प्रविशेत्तूर्यघोषेण प्रकुर्याच्च गृहार्चनम् .. 45 ..
text_mt: And he should give separately to the poor; preceded by brāhmaṇas / he should enter the house to the sound of musical instruments, and perform the worship of the house.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ prapāyāṃ vijñeyo viśeṣo varuṇaṃ vrajet ..
vāsudevena sahitaṃ sāṃgopāṃgaṃ sadakṣiṇam .. 46 ..
meaning:
एवं प्रपायां विज्ञेयो विशेषो वरुणं व्रजेत् ..
वासुदेवेन सहितं सांगोपांगं सदक्षिणम् .. 46 ..
text_mt: Thus is known the specific rule for a water-booth; he should go to Varuṇa, / together with Vāsudeva, along with the limbs and secondary limbs, with a sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast:
sthālīpākavidhānena prakuryāddeśikottamaḥ ..
ācāryāya gṛhaṃ dadyātparicchedasamanvitam .. 47 ..
meaning:
स्थालीपाकविधानेन प्रकुर्याद्देशिकोत्तमः ..
आचार्याय गृहं दद्यात्परिच्छेदसमन्वितम् .. 47 ..
text_mt: The best of preceptors should perform [the rite] according to the procedure of the cooked-grain sacrifice (sthālīpāka); / he should present a house with all its boundaries to the ācārya.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtvije tāmrapātraṃ ca jalapūrṇaṃ ca dhānyakam ..
dikpālāndvāradeśe tu kūpayāge viśeṣataḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
ऋत्विजे ताम्रपात्रं च जलपूर्णं च धान्यकम् ..
दिक्पालान्द्वारदेशे तु कूपयागे विशेषतः .. 48 ..
text_mt: And a copper vessel filled with water and grain to the officiating priest (ṛtvij); / especially in the sacrifice of a well, [he should worship] the guardians of the directions at the doorway.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇaṃ nāgarājānaṃ dvārapālau ca paścime ..
yajenmantraiḥ pṛthagdevānmantrairebhiryathākramam .. 49 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्माणं नागराजानं द्वारपालौ च पश्चिमे ..
यजेन्मन्त्रैः पृथग्देवान्मन्त्रैरेभिर्यथाक्रमम् .. 49 ..
text_mt: Brahmā, the King of Serpents, and two gatekeepers in the west— / he should worship the deities individually with these mantras in proper order:

sanskrit_iast:
balidānaṃ vidhānena kṛtvā dadyādyathāvidhi ..
patākānāmatastattvaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathākramam .. 2.3.2.50 ..
meaning:
बलिदानं विधानेन कृत्वा दद्याद्यथाविधि ..
पताकानामतस्तत्त्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि यथाक्रमम् .. 2.3.2.50 ..
text_mt: Having made an offering according to the rule, he should present it properly. / Next I shall proclaim the true nature of the flags in due succession:

sanskrit_iast:
vajrī ca dhūmalī kṛṣṇā pītā caivātha vāruṇī ..
śīghrā gaurī umā caiva pītā śuklā prakīrtitā ..51..
meaning:
वज्री च धूमली कृष्णा पीता चैवाथ वारुणी ..
शीघ्रा गौरी उमा चैव पीता शुक्ला प्रकीर्तिता ..51..
text_mt: Vajrī (thunderbolt-bearer), Dhūmalī (smoky), Kṛṣṇā (black), Pītā (yellow), and Vāruṇī (western); / Śīghrā (swift), Gaurī (fair), and Umā; [they are] proclaimed as yellow and white.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṃbheṣu pūjayeddevānmaheśaṃ prathamaṃ budhaḥ ..
grahāṃśca madhyakalaśe brahmāṇaṃ ca tataḥ param .. 52 ..
meaning:
कुंभेषु पूजयेद्देवान्महेशं प्रथमं बुधः ..
ग्रहांश्च मध्यकलशे ब्रह्माणं च ततः परम् .. 52 ..
text_mt: The wise man should first worship Maheśa in the water jars, / then the planets in the central jar, and Brahmā next after that.

sanskrit_iast:
vedikāpūrvabhāge tu uttare kalaśe śivam ..
dakṣiṇe kalaśe viṣṇuṃ karṇikāyāṃ jaleśvaram .. 53 ..
meaning:
वेदिकापूर्वभागे तु उत्तरे कलशे शिवम् ..
दक्षिणे कलशे विष्णुं कर्णिकायां जलेश्वरम् .. 53 ..
text_mt: In the eastern part of the altar [he should worship], but Śiva in the northern jar, / Viṣṇu in the southern jar, and the Lord of the Waters (Varuṇa) in the pericarp.

sanskrit_iast:
kalaśe vidhivadbhaktyā upacāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ ..
saṃpūjya vaṭapatre ca nāgānsaṃlikhya nāgajaiḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
कलशे विधिवद्भक्त्या उपचारैः पृथग्विधैः ..
संपूज्य वटपत्रे च नागान्संलिख्य नागजैः .. 54 ..
text_mt: Having duly worshipped in the jar with devotion and diverse offerings, / and having drawn the nāgas upon a banyan leaf with elephant-born perfumes [or ivory]:

sanskrit_iast:
yo nāgāstānpravakṣyāmi anaṃto vāsukistathā ..
tathā karkoṭakaścaiva padmaśca kulikastathā ..
padmaścaiva mahāpadmo mantrairebhiḥ pṛthakpṛthak .. 55 ..
meaning:
यो नागास्तान्प्रवक्ष्यामि अनंतो वासुकिस्तथा ..
तथा कर्कोटकश्चैव पद्मश्च कुलिकस्तथा ..
पद्मश्चैव महापद्मो मन्त्रैरेभिः पृथक्पृथक् .. 55 ..
text_mt: I shall proclaim those nāgas: Ananta, Vāsuki, / likewise Karkoṭaka, Padma, and Kulika, / Padma and Mahāpadma, individually with these mantras:

sanskrit_iast:
puṃḍarīkadalābhāsa śubhakarṇāṃtalocana ..
phaṇāsahasrasaṃyukta śaṃkhābjakṛtalocana .. 56 ..
meaning:
पुंडरीकदलाभास शुभकर्णांतलोचन ..
फणासहस्रसंयुक्त शंखाब्जकृतलोचन .. 56 ..
text_mt: ‘O you who resemble a white lotus petal! O you whose auspicious eyes reach to your ears! / O you who have a thousand hoods, whose eyes are made like conches and lotuses!

sanskrit_iast:
anaṃta nāgarājendra ihāgaccha namo'stu te ..
sita kuṃdenduvarṇābha visphuradbhogamaṃḍala .. 57 ..
meaning:
अनंत नागराजेन्द्र इहागच्छ नमोऽस्तु ते ..
सित कुंदेन्दुवर्णाभ विस्फुरद्भोगमंडल .. 57 ..
text_mt: O Ananta, king of nāga-lords, come here, homage be to you! / O white one, gleaming with the hue of jasmine and the moon, with glistening circle of coils!

sanskrit_iast:
sarvanāgasya śūrasya kṛtasvastikalāṃchana ..
nāgendratakṣaka śrīmannihāgaccha namostu te .. 58 ..
meaning:
सर्वनागस्य शूरस्य कृतस्वस्तिकलांछन ..
नागेन्द्रतक्षक श्रीमन्निहागच्छ नमोस्तु ते .. 58 ..
text_mt: O heroic one among all nāgas, marked with the svastika emblem! / O glorious lord of nāgas Takṣaka, come here, homage be to you!

sanskrit_iast:
navīnajaladaśyāma śrīmankamalalocana ..
viṣadarpabalonmatta grīvāyāmekaśekhara .. 59 ..
meaning:
नवीनजलदश्याम श्रीमन्कमललोचन ..
विषदर्पबलोन्मत्त ग्रीवायामेकशेखर .. 59 ..
text_mt: O you who are dark like a fresh raincloud, O glorious one, lotus-eyed! / O you maddened by the power and pride of poison, having a single crest on the neck!

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkhapāla iti khyāta jalādhārapratīkṣaka ..
adhyakṣe nāgalokānāmihāgaccha namo'stu te .. 2.3.2.60 ..
meaning:
शंखपाल इति ख्यात जलाधारप्रतीक्षक ..
अध्यक्षे नागलोकानामिहागच्छ नमोऽस्तु ते .. 2.3.2.60 ..
text_mt: Celebrated as Śaṅkhapāla, overseer of the water reservoirs! / O ruler of the realms of the nāgas, come here, homage be to you!

sanskrit_iast:
atipīta suvarṇābha candrārdhāṃkitamastaka ..
dīptabhogakṛtāṭopa śubhalakṣaṇalakṣita .. 61 ..
meaning:
अतिपीत सुवर्णाभ चन्द्रार्धांकितमस्तक ..
दीप्तभोगकृताटोप शुभलक्षणलक्षित .. 61 ..
text_mt: O intensely yellow one, brilliant as gold, whose head is marked with the crescent moon! / You whose expansion of blazing hoods is made splendid, adorned with auspicious marks!

sanskrit_iast:
kulīra nāgarājeṃdra sarvasattvahite rata ..
tiṣṭheha yajñasiddhyarthaṃ kāmarūpa namostu te .. 62..
meaning:
कुलीर नागराजेंद्र सर्वसत्त्वहिते रत ..
तिष्ठेह यज्ञसिद्ध्यर्थं कामरूप नमोस्तु ते .. 62..
text_mt: O Kulīra, king of the lords of nāgas, devoted to the welfare of all beings! / Stand here for the accomplishment of the sacrifice, O shape-shifter, homage be to you!

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ suvarṇena varṇena padmapatrāyatekṣaṇaḥ ..
paṃcabiṃdukṛtābhogo grīvāyāmekaśekharaḥ ..
tasmai te padmanāgendra tīvrarūpa namo'stu te .. 63 ..
meaning:
यः सुवर्णेन वर्णेन पद्मपत्रायतेक्षणः ..
पंचबिंदुकृताभोगो ग्रीवायामेकशेखरः ..
तस्मै ते पद्मनागेन्द्र तीव्ररूप नमोऽस्तु ते .. 63 ..
text_mt: He who has the colour of gold, with eyes wide as lotus leaves, / whose expanse [of hoods] has five dots, with a single crest upon the neck: / to you, O lotus nāga-lord, of fierce form, homage be to you!

sanskrit_iast:
nāginyo nāgakanyāśca tathā nāgakumārakāḥ ..
sarve te prītamanasaḥ pūjāṃ gṛhṇaṃtu me sadā .. 64 ..
meaning:
नागिन्यो नागकन्याश्च तथा नागकुमारकाः ..
सर्वे ते प्रीतमनसः पूजां गृह्णंतु मे सदा .. 64 ..
text_mt: May the nāginīs and nāga maidens, as well as the young nāga princes, / all with joyful minds, ever accept my worship!’

sanskrit_iast:
svagṛhyoktena vidhinā kṛtvāgnisthāpanaṃ budhaḥ ..
ājyaṃ saṃskṛtya juhuyāddigīśānāṃ yathākramam .. 65 ..
meaning:
स्वगृह्योक्तेन विधिना कृत्वाग्निस्थापनं बुधः ..
आज्यं संस्कृत्य जुहुयाद्दिगीशानां यथाक्रमम् .. 65 ..
text_mt: Having established the fire according to the rule declared in his own Gṛhya text, / the wise man, purifying the clarified butter, should offer oblations to the rulers of the directions in order.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityādigrahāṃścaiva brahmāṇaṃ kṛṣṇameva ca ..
madhupiṣṭena ca śivaṃ varuṇaṃ juhuyāttataḥ .. 66 ..
meaning:
आदित्यादिग्रहांश्चैव ब्रह्माणं कृष्णमेव च ..
मधुपिष्टेन च शिवं वरुणं जुहुयात्ततः .. 66 ..
text_mt: And [he should sacrifice] to the planets beginning with Āditya (the Sun), to Brahmā, and to Kṛṣṇa; / then he should sacrifice to Śiva with flour mixed with honey, and to Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
prādeśamātraṃ saṃprokṣya yūpaṃ cāsya pramāṇakam ..
caturasraṃ śūlayuktaṃ gaṇānānīya pūjayet .. 67 ..
meaning:
प्रादेशमात्रं संप्रोक्ष्य यूपं चास्य प्रमाणकम् ..

text_mt: In the southwest he should worship Durgā, and Śatakratu on the two sides; / [he should worship] Vināyaka, Viṣṇu, Gaṅgā, and Pṛthivīṣaṣṭikā.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśenopacāreṇa pūjayecca viśeṣataḥ ..
maṃḍalasyottare bhāge nāgarūpamanaṃtakam .. 16 ..
meaning:
षोडशेनोपचारेण पूजयेच्च विशेषतः ..
मंडलस्योत्तरे भागे नागरूपमनंतकम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: He should worship them especially with sixteen articles of worship; / in the northern part of the maṇḍala [he should fashion] Ananta in the form of a serpent.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcakṛṣṇālakaiḥ kuryādbṛhatparvapramāṇakam ..
āropayeccākṣatādyaiḥ śvetacandanapuṣpakaiḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
पंचकृष्णालकैः कुर्याद्बृहत्पर्वप्रमाणकम् ..
आरोपयेच्चाक्षताद्यैः श्वेतचन्दनपुष्पकैः .. 17 ..
text_mt: He should make it with five black locks of hair, of the measure of a large knuckle; / he should install it with unbroken grains and other [substances], white sandalwood, and flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā agnikāryamathācaret ..
varuṇaṃ juhuyātpūrvaṃ madhunā pāyasena vā .. 18 ..
meaning:
पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या अग्निकार्यमथाचरेत् ..
वरुणं जुहुयात्पूर्वं मधुना पायसेन वा .. 18 ..
text_mt: He should worship with supreme devotion and then perform the fire-ritual; / he should first make oblations to Varuṇa with honey or milk-rice,

sanskrit_iast:
tilākṣatairvā ājyairvā trimadhvaktairathāpi vā ..
aṣṭottaraśataṃ kuryāddigīśānāṃ ghṛtena tu ..19..
meaning:
तिलाक्षतैर्वा आज्यैर्वा त्रिमध्वक्तैरथापि वा ..
अष्टोत्तरशतं कुर्याद्दिगीशानां घृतेन तु ..19..
text_mt: or with sesame and unbroken grains, or with clarified butter, or indeed with [substances] smeared with the three sweets; / he should offer one hundred and eight [oblations] to the guardians of the directions with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyātpuṣpaistilaghṛtena ca ..
nārāyaṇaṃ śivaṃ durgāṃ gaṇeśaṃ ca grahānniśi.. .. 2.3.4.20 ..
meaning:
एकैकामाहुतिं दद्यात्पुष्पैस्तिलघृतेन च ..
नारायणं शिवं दुर्गां गणेशं च ग्रहान्निशि.. .. 2.3.4.20 ..
text_mt: He should offer one oblation each with flowers, sesame, and clarified butter / to Nārāyaṇa, Śiva, Durgā, Gaṇeśa, and the planets at night.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāvaṣṭau ca juhuyādghṛtairekāhutirbhaveta ..
brahmāyudhvānamiti maṃtreṇa brahmāṇaṃ pāyasena tu ..21..
meaning:
अष्टावष्टौ च जुहुयाद्घृतैरेकाहुतिर्भवेत ..
ब्रह्मायुध्वानमिति मंत्रेण ब्रह्माणं पायसेन तु ..21..
text_mt: He should offer eight [oblations] to each; one oblation should be made with clarified butter; / and to Brahmā [an oblation should be made] with milk-rice using the mantra "Brahmā devānām".

sanskrit_iast:
ekāhutiṃ tato dadyādāpohiṣṭheti vā tribhiḥ ..
tato varuṇamuddiśya dadyādājyāhutitrayam .. 22 ..
meaning:
एकाहुतिं ततो दद्यादापोहिष्ठेति वा त्रिभिः ..
ततो वरुणमुद्दिश्य दद्यादाज्याहुतित्रयम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: Then he should offer a single oblation, or [oblations] with the three verses beginning with "Āpo hi ṣṭhā"; / then, addressing Varuṇa, he should offer three oblations of clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
imaṃ varuṇa iti vā tadvaromā ṛcā punaḥ ..
varuṇasyottaṃbhanamasīti yenāpāvaka eva ca .. 23 ..
meaning:
इमं वरुण इति वा तद्वरोमा ऋचा पुनः ..
वरुणस्योत्तंभनमसीति येनापावक एव च .. 23 ..
text_mt: With "Imaṃ me varuṇa" or again with the verse "Tat tvā yāmi", / [and with] "Varuṇasyottambhanam asi", and with "Yenā pāvaka",

sanskrit_iast:
vātasyayamiti punaḥ pañcavarṇaṃ yathākramāt ..
tato varuṇamuddiśya ghṛtena ca guḍaiḥ saha .. 24 ..
meaning:
वातस्ययमिति पुनः पञ्चवर्णं यथाक्रमात् ..
ततो वरुणमुद्दिश्य घृतेन च गुडैः सह .. 24 ..
text_mt: and again with "Vātasya yuktam", [he should offer] the five-colored [powders] in their proper order; / then, addressing Varuṇa, [he should offer oblations] with clarified butter along with jaggery.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sviṣṭakṛte dadyādbaliṃ dadyādanukramāt..
madhvājyapāyasaṃ dadyādvaruṇāya viśeṣataḥ ..25..
meaning:
ततः स्विष्टकृते दद्याद्बलिं दद्यादनुक्रमात्..
मध्वाज्यपायसं दद्याद्वरुणाय विशेषतः ..25..
text_mt: Then he should make an offering to Sviṣṭakṛt, and he should make an offering [to the others] in succession; / he should offer honey, clarified butter, and milk-rice especially to Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
yavakṣīraṃ digīśebhyo hyanyebhyaḥ pāyasena tu ..
nāgāya piṣṭakaṃ dadyāllājāhomāṣṭakaṃ punaḥ.. 26 ..
meaning:
यवक्षीरं दिगीशेभ्यो ह्यन्येभ्यः पायसेन तु ..
नागाय पिष्टकं दद्याल्लाजाहोमाष्टकं पुनः.. 26 ..
text_mt: [He should offer] barley and milk to the guardians of the directions, and milk-rice to the others; / to the serpent he should offer a cake, and then an eightfold fire-offering of parched grain.

sanskrit_iast:
anaṃtasyottare tīre padmapatraṃ paristaret ..
aṣṭāṣṭāpadamānena varuṇaṃ rājatena tu .. 27 ..
meaning:
अनंतस्योत्तरे तीरे पद्मपत्रं परिस्तरेत् ..
अष्टाष्टापदमानेन वरुणं राजतेन तु .. 27 ..
text_mt: On the northern bank of Ananta he should spread lotus leaves; / with the measure of sixty-four steps, [he should make an image of] Varuṇa out of silver.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryātpūrvadvayenāpi bāṇarattisuvarṇakaiḥ ..
kuryātpuṣkariṇīṃ tatra pūrvārdhe caturasrake .. 28 ..
meaning:
कुर्यात्पूर्वद्वयेनापि बाणरत्तिसुवर्णकैः ..
कुर्यात्पुष्करिणीं तत्र पूर्वार्धे चतुरस्रके .. 28 ..
text_mt: He should make it, as well as the former two, with five rattis of gold; / he should make a pond there, in the eastern half, in a square.

sanskrit_iast:
varuṇaṃ vinyasettatra tathā puṣkariṇīmapi ..
vidhivadvākyapūrveṇa utsṛjecca jaleśayam .. 29 ..
meaning:
वरुणं विन्यसेत्तत्र तथा पुष्करिणीमपि ..
विधिवद्वाक्यपूर्वेण उत्सृजेच्च जलेशयम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: He should place Varuṇa there, and likewise the pond; / according to the rule, preceded by the formula, he should dedicate the water-reservoir:

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ adyetyādi viṣṇurūpāya karuṇāya śrutiratyādyuktavedavyāsasapraṇītāgniṣṭomaphalaprāptaye puṣkariṇīpratiṣṭhākarmaṇi imāṃ puṣkariṇīṃ suvarṇarājatāṃ svagṛhyoditāṃ sālaṃkārāṃ supūjitāmamukagotraḥ amukadevaśarmā tubhyamahaṃ saṃpradade .. ityutsargavākyam .. oṃ adyetyādi brāhmaṇamukhyebhyaḥ mamāgniṣṭomādyanekaphalaprāptaye imaṃ jalāśayaṃ varuṇadaivataṃ supūjitaṃ caturmukhasahitaṃ catuḥsattvāvacchinnasnānapānādyupabhogāya amukasagotraḥ amukadevaśarmāhamutsṛje ..)
tato naukāṃ samādāya madhyātkiṃcittathottare ..
jalāśayasya madhyaṃ tu ṛtvigghomaṃ carettataḥ .. 2.3.4.30 ..
meaning:
ओं अद्येत्यादि विष्णुरूपाय करुणाय श्रुतिरत्याद्युक्तवेदव्याससप्रणीताग्निष्टोमफलप्राप्तये पुष्करिणीप्रतिष्ठाकर्मणि इमां पुष्करिणीं सुवर्णराजतां स्वगृह्योदितां सालंकारां सुपूजिताममुकगोत्रः अमुकदेवशर्मा तुभ्यमहं संप्रददे .. इत्युत्सर्गवाक्यम् .. ओं अद्येत्यादि ब्राह्मणमुख्येभ्यः ममाग्निष्टोमाद्यनेकफलप्राप्तये इमं जलाशयं वरुणदैवतं सुपूजितं चतुर्मुखसहितं चतुःसत्त्वावच्छिन्नस्नानपानाद्युपभोगाय अमुकसगोत्रः अमुकदेवशर्माहमुत्सृजे ..)
ततो नौकां समादाय मध्यात्किंचित्तथोत्तरे ..
जलाशयस्य मध्यं तु ऋत्विग्घोमं चरेत्ततः .. 2.3.4.30 ..
text_mt: "Oṃ, on this day, etc., for the compassionate one in the form of Viṣṇu, for the attainment of the fruit of the Agniṣṭoma declared by the Śruti and Smṛti composed by Vedavyāsa, in the rite of consecration of the pond, this pond, of gold and silver, stated in my own Gṛhya sutra, adorned with ornaments, well-worshipped, I, of such-and-such gotra, of such-and-such name, give unto you." — this is the formula of dedication. — "Oṃ, on this day, etc., to the foremost brāhmaṇas, for my attainment of manifold fruits beginning with the Agniṣṭoma, this water-reservoir, having Varuṇa as its deity, well-worshipped, accompanied by the Four-faced One, for the enjoyment of bathing, drinking, etc., delimited to the four classes of living beings, I, of such-and-such gotra, of such-and-such name, dedicate.") / Then, taking a boat, somewhat to the north of the middle, / into the center of the water-reservoir, the officiating priest should then perform the homa.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvāvasthāyinīṃ yaṣṭiṃ samāropya vidhānataḥ ..
tato varuṇa sūktena varuṇaṃ rājatodbhavam ..
puṣkariṇyāsamaṃ tena nāgayaṣṭyaṃtare kṣipet .. 31 ..
meaning:
पूर्वावस्थायिनीं यष्टिं समारोप्य विधानतः ..
ततो वरुण सूक्तेन वरुणं राजतोद्भवम् ..
पुष्करिण्यासमं तेन नागयष्ट्यंतरे क्षिपेत् .. 31 ..
text_mt: Having raised the previously erected post according to rule, / he should then, with the Varuṇa hymn, throw [the image of] Varuṇa made of silver / together with the pond into the space within the serpent-post.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraivānaṃtanāgaṃ ca maṃtrametadudīrayed..
puṃḍarīkadalābhāsa śubharaktāṃtalocana ..
phaṇāsahasrasaṃyukta supratiṣṭha namo'stu te .. 32 ..
meaning:
तत्रैवानंतनागं च मंत्रमेतदुदीरयेद्..
पुंडरीकदलाभास शुभरक्तांतलोचन ..
फणासहस्रसंयुक्त सुप्रतिष्ठ नमोऽस्तु ते .. 32 ..
text_mt: In that very place he should [install] the serpent Ananta, and utter this mantra: / "O you who have the luster of white lotus petals, with auspicious eyes that are red at the corners, / possessed of a thousand hoods, firmly established, salutation to you!"

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāṃ ca tato dadyāttataḥ pūrṇāṃ vidhāya ca ..
mocayenmakarāngrāhānmīnakūrmāñjalecarān .. 33 ..
meaning:
दक्षिणां च ततो दद्यात्ततः पूर्णां विधाय च ..
मोचयेन्मकरान्ग्राहान्मीनकूर्माञ्जलेचरान् .. 33 ..
text_mt: Then he should give the priestly fee, and then having performed the full oblation, / he should release aquatic creatures: makaras, alligators, fish, and tortoises,

sanskrit_iast:
padmotpalaṃ ca śaivālaṃ maṃtrameva prayatnataḥ ..
puṣkariṇyāṃ ca triḥ kuryātkhātaṃ sarvapradakṣiṇām .. 34 ..
meaning:
पद्मोत्पलं च शैवालं मंत्रमेव प्रयत्नतः ..
पुष्करिण्यां च त्रिः कुर्यात्खातं सर्वप्रदक्षिणाम् .. 34 ..
text_mt: and lotus, blue water-lily, and water-weeds, with the mantra recited diligently; / and around the pond he should perform a circumambulation of the excavation three times.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityādhyāyakaṃ japtvā kṣipellājakapardakān ..
pātayetkṣīradhārāṃ ca sahasreṇa śatena ca .. 35 ..
meaning:
आदित्याध्यायकं जप्त्वा क्षिपेल्लाजकपर्दकान् ..
पातयेत्क्षीरधारां च सहस्रेण शतेन च .. 35 ..
text_mt: Having recited the chapter dedicated to the Sun, he should throw parched grains and cowrie shells; / and he should pour a stream of milk by hundreds and thousands [of measures].

sanskrit_iast:
sūtreṇa veṣṭayetprājño raktena ca catuṣkramāt ..
pathi saṃtoṣayeddīnānsaṃtoṣya ca gṛhaṃ vrajet .. 36 .. ..
sarovarādipratiṣṭhāvidhānavarṇanam
meaning:
सूत्रेण वेष्टयेत्प्राज्ञो रक्तेन च चतुष्क्रमात् ..
पथि संतोषयेद्दीनान्संतोष्य च गृहं व्रजेत् .. 36 .. ..
सरोवरादिप्रतिष्ठाविधानवर्णनम्
text_mt:
The wise man should wrap it with red thread four times; / on the way he should satisfy the wretched, and having gladdened [them], he should go home.
Description of the Rules for the Consecration of Lakes and Other Water Bodies

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
nalinyāśca tathā vāpyā hradasya dvijasattamāḥ ..
vidhiṃ vakṣye sahāṅgena vidhānaṃ śṛṇuta dvijāḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
नलिन्याश्च तथा वाप्या ह्रदस्य द्विजसत्तमाः ..
विधिं वक्ष्ये सहाङ्गेन विधानं शृणुत द्विजाः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / O best of twice-born ones, of a lotus pond, a stepped well, and a lake, / I shall state the rule along with its auxiliary parts; hear the procedure, O twice-born ones!
title: adhyāyaḥ 05

sanskrit_iast:
svarṇapādena mānena pūrvedyuradhivāsa yet ...
āpohiṣṭheti mantreṇa tathā astraiḥ śatairapi .. 2 ..
meaning:
स्वर्णपादेन मानेन पूर्वेद्युरधिवास येत् ...
आपोहिष्ठेति मन्त्रेण तथा अस्त्रैः शतैरपि .. 2 ..
text_mt: On the previous day, one should perform the preliminary consecration using a measure of a quarter [pāda] of gold, / with the mantra "Āpo hi ṣṭhā..." and also with a hundred protective weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
svamaṇḍale śubhe sthāne viśetpūrvamukhena tu ..
gaṇeśaṃ varuṇaṃ caiva ghaṭe saṃpūjayecchivam .. 3 ..
meaning:
स्वमण्डले शुभे स्थाने विशेत्पूर्वमुखेन तु ..
गणेशं वरुणं चैव घटे संपूजयेच्छिवम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Entering an auspicious place within one's mandala facing eastward, / one should worship Gaṇeśa, Varuṇa, and Śiva in a water pot.

sanskrit_iast:
vāgīśaṃ ca tathā viṣṇuṃ sūrye kuṃbhe samarcayet ..
pāyasenāhutiṃ dadyādvaruṇāya ghṛtena ca .. 4 ..
meaning:
वागीशं च तथा विष्णुं सूर्ये कुंभे समर्चयेत् ..
पायसेनाहुतिं दद्याद्वरुणाय घृतेन च .. 4 ..
text_mt: One should worship Vāgīśa, Viṣṇu, and the Sun in the pot; / one should offer oblations of milk-rice and clarified butter to Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyādanyeṣāṃ ca sruveṇa ca ..
balidānaṃ pāyasena utsṛjettadanaṃtaram .. 5 ..
meaning:
एकैकामाहुतिं दद्यादन्येषां च स्रुवेण च ..
बलिदानं पायसेन उत्सृजेत्तदनंतरम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: One should offer a single oblation to each of the others with a sacrificial ladle, / and immediately thereafter release the offering made with milk-rice.

sanskrit_iast:
yūpaṃ niveśayetpaścāddadyāddhenuṃ ca dakṣiṇām ..
pūrṇaṃ dadyātsavitre'rghyaṃ dattvā tu svagṛhaṃ vrajet .. 6 ..
meaning:
यूपं निवेशयेत्पश्चाद्दद्याद्धेनुं च दक्षिणाम् ..
पूर्णं दद्यात्सवित्रेऽर्घ्यं दत्त्वा तु स्वगृहं व्रजेत् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Afterwards, one should erect a sacrificial post and give a cow as a priestly gift; / having offered the full oblation and arghya to Savitṛ, one should return to one's home.

sanskrit_iast:
ārāmasya vidhiṃ vakṣye pratiṣṭhāvidhivistaram ..
hīnārāmasya ca tathā eka vṛkṣasya ca dvijāḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
आरामस्य विधिं वक्ष्ये प्रतिष्ठाविधिविस्तरम् ..
हीनारामस्य च तथा एक वृक्षस्य च द्विजाः .. 7 ..
text_mt: I shall explain the rule for a grove, the detailed rite of its consecration, / and likewise, O twice-born, for a small grove and for a single tree.

sanskrit_iast:
araṇyamadhye pāścātye uttare vā viśeṣataḥ ..
maṃḍapaṃ vartulaṃ kuryādarghyahastapramāṇakam .. 8 ..
meaning:
अरण्यमध्ये पाश्चात्ये उत्तरे वा विशेषतः ..
मंडपं वर्तुलं कुर्यादर्घ्यहस्तप्रमाणकम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: In the middle of the woods, especially in the western or northern quarter, / one should construct a circular pavilion measuring half a cubit.

sanskrit_iast:
taddakṣiṇe bhavetkuṃḍaṃ caturasraṃ samaṃ śubham ..
caturmukhaṃ ca kartavyaṃ toraṇādyairalaṃkṛtam .. 9 ..
meaning:
तद्दक्षिणे भवेत्कुंडं चतुरस्रं समं शुभम् ..
चतुर्मुखं च कर्तव्यं तोरणाद्यैरलंकृतम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: To the south of it there should be an auspicious, square, level sacrificial pit; / it should be made four-faced and adorned with archways and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
maṃdarādikamāvāhya tataḥ saṃpūjayetkramāt ..
viṣvaksenaṃ ca tatraiva pūjayedgandhacandanaiḥ .. 2.3.5.10 ..
meaning:
मंदरादिकमावाह्य ततः संपूजयेत्क्रमात् ..
विष्वक्सेनं च तत्रैव पूजयेद्गन्धचन्दनैः .. 2.3.5.10 ..
text_mt: Having invoked Mount Mandara and the others, one should then worship them in order; / and right there one should worship Viṣvaksena with perfumes and sandalwood paste.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛguṃ karṇasamārūḍhaṃ sarvabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ..
viṣvaksenasya maṃtroyaṃ pūjāyāṃ caiva sarvataḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
भृगुं कर्णसमारूढं सर्वभूषणभूषितम् ..
विष्वक्सेनस्य मंत्रोयं पूजायां चैव सर्वतः .. 11 ..
text_mt: "To Bhṛgu, resting on the ear, adorned with all ornaments"— / this is the mantra of Viṣvaksena, applied everywhere in the worship.

sanskrit_iast:
dvārapālaṃ ca saṃpūrṇaṃ gauryādīnkalaśeṣu ca ..
svāsu dikṣu digīśānāṃ balipuṣpākṣatādi nā .. 12 ..
meaning:
द्वारपालं च संपूर्णं गौर्यादीन्कलशेषु च ..
स्वासु दिक्षु दिगीशानां बलिपुष्पाक्षतादि ना .. 12 ..
text_mt: One should fully worship the door-keepers, Gaurī and others in pots, / and the guardians of the directions in their respective quarters, with offerings, flowers, unhusked barley grains, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
nairṛtyavaruṇayormadhye anaṃtaṃ pratipūjayet ..
indreśānayośca madhye brahmāṇaṃ ca prakalpayet .. 13 ..
meaning:
नैरृत्यवरुणयोर्मध्ये अनंतं प्रतिपूजयेत् ..
इन्द्रेशानयोश्च मध्ये ब्रह्माणं च प्रकल्पयेत् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Between the quarters of Nirṛti and Varuṇa, one should worship Ananta; / and between Indra and Īśāna, one should install Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
vedipārśve tato gatvā vedimāvāhya pūjayet ..
āsanaṃ kalpayitvā tu sāmānyārghyaṃ vidhāya ca .. 14 ..
meaning:
वेदिपार्श्वे ततो गत्वा वेदिमावाह्य पूजयेत् ..
आसनं कल्पयित्वा तु सामान्यार्घ्यं विधाय च .. 14 ..
text_mt: Going then to the side of the altar, having invoked the altar, one should worship it; / and having prepared a seat and offered the general arghya,

sanskrit_iast:
aiśāne kalaśe vidyudbrahmāṇaṃ ca tathā grahān ..
svaiḥsvairmaṃtrairgaṃdhapuṣpairnaivedyaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
ऐशाने कलशे विद्युद्ब्रह्माणं च तथा ग्रहान् ..
स्वैःस्वैर्मंत्रैर्गंधपुष्पैर्नैवेद्यैश्च पृथग्विधैः .. 15 ..
text_mt: one should worship Vidyut-Brahmā in the north-eastern pot and likewise the planets, / each with their own mantras, perfumes, flowers, and various food offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
maḍaleśaṃ vāsudevaṃ sāsanaṃ ca bṛhaspatim ..
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā pāyasānnaṃ baliṃ haret .. 16 ..
meaning:
मडलेशं वासुदेवं सासनं च बृहस्पतिम् ..
पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या पायसान्नं बलिं हरेत् .. 16 ..
text_mt: One should worship the lord of the mandala, Vāsudeva, along with Bṛhaspati upon his seat, / with supreme devotion, and present an offering of milk-rice.

sanskrit_iast:
dvibhujaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca śaṃkha cakradharaṃ vibhum ..
padmāsanagataṃ dhyāyetpītavastraṃ suśobhanam .. 17 ..
meaning:
द्विभुजं वासुदेवं च शंख चक्रधरं विभुम् ..
पद्मासनगतं ध्यायेत्पीतवस्त्रं सुशोभनम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: One should meditate on the two-armed all-pervading Vāsudeva, holding a conch and a discus, / seated in the lotus posture, wearing yellow garments, exceedingly splendid,

sanskrit_iast:
nīlotpaladalābhāsaṃ haricaṃdanacarcitam ..
devarṣisiddhasahitaṃ kalatradvaya saṃyutam.. 18 ..
meaning:
नीलोत्पलदलाभासं हरिचंदनचर्चितम् ..
देवर्षिसिद्धसहितं कलत्रद्वय संयुतम्.. 18 ..
text_mt: shining like a petal of a blue lotus, smeared with yellow sandalwood paste, / accompanied by divine sages and Siddhas, and joined by his two wives.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvā āropayedevaṃ bālādīnatha nāyakān ..
vimalādyā nāyikāśca digīśāṃśca yathāvidhi .. 19 ..
meaning:
ध्यात्वा आरोपयेदेवं बालादीनथ नायकान् ..
विमलाद्या नायिकाश्च दिगीशांश्च यथाविधि .. 19 ..
text_mt: Having thus meditated, one should install the leaders beginning with Bāla, / the female leaders beginning with Vimalā, and the guardians of the directions according to the rule.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśoccaiḥ pṛthagrūpaiḥ pratipuṣpāṃjalikramāt..
paritaḥ pūjayedviṣṇuṃ śivaṃ durgāṃ sarasvatīm .. 2.3.5.20 ..
meaning:
षोडशोच्चैः पृथग्रूपैः प्रतिपुष्पांजलिक्रमात्..
परितः पूजयेद्विष्णुं शिवं दुर्गां सरस्वतीम् .. 2.3.5.20 ..
text_mt: With sixteen elevated, distinct forms, through successive handfuls of flowers, / one should worship Viṣṇu, Śiva, Durgā, and Sarasvatī all around.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ dhyāyetsomaṃ caturmukham ..
aśvārūḍhaṃ divya rūpaṃ padmākṣaṃ dhṛtapuṣpakam .. 21 ..
meaning:
शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशं ध्यायेत्सोमं चतुर्मुखम् ..
अश्वारूढं दिव्य रूपं पद्माक्षं धृतपुष्पकम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: One should meditate on Soma resembling pure crystal, four-faced, / mounted upon a horse, of divine form, with lotus eyes, holding a flower,

sanskrit_iast:
varadaṃ devagaṃdharvaiḥ sevitaṃ munibhiḥ stutam ..
śvetaṃ vanaspatiṃ dhyāyeddvibhujaṃ pītavāsasam .. 22 ..
meaning:
वरदं देवगंधर्वैः सेवितं मुनिभिः स्तुतम् ..
श्वेतं वनस्पतिं ध्यायेद्द्विभुजं पीतवाससम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: granting boons, served by gods and Gandharvas, praised by sages; / one should meditate on Vanaspati as white, two-armed, clad in yellow garments,

sanskrit_iast:
svarathasthaṃ mahābāhuṃ śaṃkhāṃkuśasakheṭakam ..
vidyāṃ ca vāmato dhyāyetsvamantreṇa ca sthāpayet .. 23 ..
meaning:
स्वरथस्थं महाबाहुं शंखांकुशसखेटकम् ..
विद्यां च वामतो ध्यायेत्स्वमन्त्रेण च स्थापयेत् .. 23 ..
text_mt: standing in his chariot, mighty-armed, holding a conch, an ankuśa, and a shield; / and one should meditate on Vidyā to his left and install her with her own mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
daśasvarānvitaṃ toyaṃ svabhāvaṃ tamasānvitam ..
maṃtro'yaṃ devadevasya pūjāyāṃ viniyojayet ..24..
meaning:
दशस्वरान्वितं तोयं स्वभावं तमसान्वितम् ..
मंत्रोऽयं देवदेवस्य पूजायां विनियोजयेत् ..24..
text_mt: "Endowed with ten vowels, water by nature, filled with darkness"— / one should employ this mantra in the worship of the God of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
nīlaṃ jayaṃ bhṛṃgiṇaṃ ca paritaśca yathākramāt ..
tataḥ kuśakaṃḍikāṃ kṛtvā sthālīpākaṃ vidhānataḥ.. .. 25 ..
meaning:
नीलं जयं भृंगिणं च परितश्च यथाक्रमात् ..
ततः कुशकंडिकां कृत्वा स्थालीपाकं विधानतः.. .. 25 ..
text_mt: One should worship Nīla, Jaya, and Bhṛṅgin in their respective order all around; / then, having performed the preparation of kuśa grass, one prepares the boiled sacrificial dish according to the rule.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭottaraśataṃ caiva somāya dvādaśāhutīḥ ..
vānaspatestathāṣṭau ca ājye'nyeṣāṃ vidhīyatām .. 26 ..
meaning:
अष्टोत्तरशतं चैव सोमाय द्वादशाहुतीः ..
वानस्पतेस्तथाष्टौ च आज्येऽन्येषां विधीयताम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: One hundred and eight oblations [are prescribed], and twelve oblations to Soma; / eight to Vanaspati, and oblations of clarified butter should be ordained for the others.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyātsaptajihvāmanaṃtaram ..
vāstoṣpataya iti maṃtreṇa sthālīpākadvayaṃ nayet .. 27 ..
meaning:
एकैकामाहुतिं दद्यात्सप्तजिह्वामनंतरम् ..
वास्तोष्पतय इति मंत्रेण स्थालीपाकद्वयं नयेत् .. 27 ..
text_mt: Immediately after, one should offer a single oblation to the seven-tongued fire; / with the mantra "O lords of the dwelling...", one should carry out two boiled sacrificial dishes.

sanskrit_iast:
vanaspatiṃ samuddiśya tatoyamīrayedṛcam ..
vṛkṣādīnsthāpayetpūrve gāyatryā prathamaṃ budhaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
वनस्पतिं समुद्दिश्य ततोयमीरयेदृचम् ..
वृक्षादीन्स्थापयेत्पूर्वे गायत्र्या प्रथमं बुधः .. 28 ..
text_mt: Directing it toward Vanaspati, the wise man should then utter this verse; / one should first install the trees and others in the east with the Gāyatrī.

sanskrit_iast:
abjairagraṃ kāṃsyavastraṃ ratnaṃ dikṣu yathākramam ..
brīhayaśceti maṃtreṇa tathā ca saritaśca me .. 29 ..
meaning:
अब्जैरग्रं कांस्यवस्त्रं रत्नं दिक्षु यथाक्रमम् ..
ब्रीहयश्चेति मंत्रेण तथा च सरितश्च मे .. 29 ..
text_mt: Lotus flowers at the tip, bronze, cloth, and gems in the directions in proper sequence, / with the mantra "Vrīhayaś ca..." and "Tathā ca saritaś ca me",

sanskrit_iast:
mitratrayaśceti tathā pūṣā ca ma ṛcā tathā ..
saṃsthāpya vrīhīnsaṃvāpya tatraiva vidhipūrvakam .. 2.3.5.30 ..
meaning:
मित्रत्रयश्चेति तथा पूषा च म ऋचा तथा ..
संस्थाप्य व्रीहीन्संवाप्य तत्रैव विधिपूर्वकम् .. 2.3.5.30 ..
text_mt: as well as "Mitratrayaḥ..." and with the verse "Pūṣā ca me..."; / having deposited and sown the rice grains right there according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣipedgaṅgājalaṃ toye sarvauṣadhyudakena ca ..
saṃsthāpya yajamānaṃ ca surāstvāmiti mantrakaiḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
क्षिपेद्गङ्गाजलं तोये सर्वौषध्युदकेन च ..
संस्थाप्य यजमानं च सुरास्त्वामिति मन्त्रकैः .. 31 ..
text_mt: one should pour Gaṅgā water into the water along with water of all herbs; / and having made the patron of the sacrifice stand with the mantras "Surās tvām...",

sanskrit_iast:
ācāryamātmane tatra saṃsthitaṃ dvijapuṃgavaiḥ ..
samāpya nityavidhinācāryāyātha ca dakṣiṇām .. 32 ..
meaning:
आचार्यमात्मने तत्र संस्थितं द्विजपुंगवैः ..
समाप्य नित्यविधिनाचार्यायाथ च दक्षिणाम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: together with the preeminent twice-born attending on the preceptor there, / having completed [the rite] with the daily procedure, then [giving] a priestly gift to the preceptor,

sanskrit_iast:
dhenuṃ ca lohapātraṃ ca dattvā iṣṭāṃ ca dakṣiṇām ..
brāhmaṇebhyo yathāśakti dadyātpūrṇāṃ gṛhaṃ vrajet .. 33 .. .. ..
kṣudrārāmapratiṣṭhāvarṇanam
meaning:
धेनुं च लोहपात्रं च दत्त्वा इष्टां च दक्षिणाम् ..
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो यथाशक्ति दद्यात्पूर्णां गृहं व्रजेत् .. 33 .. .. ..
क्षुद्रारामप्रतिष्ठावर्णनम्
text_mt:
having given a cow, an iron vessel, and a cherished priestly gift / to the Brahmins according to one's capacity, one should offer the final oblation and return home.
Description of the Consecration of a Small Grove

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
kṣudrārāmapratiṣṭhāṃ ca vakṣye ca dvijasattama ..
amaṃḍale śubhe sthāne dvihastama yasthaṃḍile .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
क्षुद्रारामप्रतिष्ठां च वक्ष्ये च द्विजसत्तम ..
अमंडले शुभे स्थाने द्विहस्तम यस्थंडिले .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / I shall describe the consecration of a small grove, O best of the twice-born. / In an auspicious spot without a mandala, on a bare ground measuring two cubits,
title: adhyāyaḥ 06

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpayetkalaśaṃ tatra somaṃ viṣṇuṃ samarcayet ..
ācāryamātraṃ varayenniśāsūtraiḥ praveṣṭayet .. 2 ..
meaning:
स्थापयेत्कलशं तत्र सोमं विष्णुं समर्चयेत् ..
आचार्यमात्रं वरयेन्निशासूत्रैः प्रवेष्टयेत् .. 2 ..
text_mt: one should install a water pot there and worship Soma and Viṣṇu. / One should select only a preceptor and wind threads around it at night.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkṣānmālyairalaṃkṛtya bhūṣayedbhūṣaṇādinā ..
dohadaṃ ca tato dadyātsthāpayecchitadhārayā .. 3 ..
meaning:
वृक्षान्माल्यैरलंकृत्य भूषयेद्भूषणादिना ..
दोहदं च ततो दद्यात्स्थापयेच्छितधारया .. 3 ..
text_mt: Having adorned the trees with garlands, one should embellish them with ornaments and the like; / one should then give plant-fertilising liquid and establish them with a cold stream [of water].

sanskrit_iast:
bhojayetpaṃcaviprāṃśca puratoṃ'te viśeṣataḥ ..
karṇavedhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā utsṛjedvāsyapūrvakam.. .. 4 ..
meaning:
भोजयेत्पंचविप्रांश्च पुरतोंऽते विशेषतः ..
कर्णवेधं ततः कृत्वा उत्सृजेद्वास्यपूर्वकम्.. .. 4 ..
text_mt: One should feed five Brahmins in front and especially at the end; / then, having performed the ear-piercing rite, one should release it after performing the preliminary blessing.

sanskrit_iast:
dadyādyūpaṃ madhyadeśe ropayetkadalīṃ tataḥ ..
raṃbhāṃ ca ropayeddikṣu sthālīpākavidhānataḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
दद्याद्यूपं मध्यदेशे रोपयेत्कदलीं ततः ..
रंभां च रोपयेद्दिक्षु स्थालीपाकविधानतः .. 5 ..
text_mt: One should place a sacrificial post in the middle, and then plant a plantain; / and one should plant a banana tree in the quarters, according to the rule of the boiled sacrificial dish.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāvaṣṭau ca juhuyādanyeṣāṃ ca ghṛtena tu ..
ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyātsviṣṭakṛttadanaṃtaram .. 6 ..
meaning:
अष्टावष्टौ च जुहुयादन्येषां च घृतेन तु ..
एकैकामाहुतिं दद्यात्स्विष्टकृत्तदनंतरम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: One should offer eight oblations each to the others with clarified butter; / immediately thereafter, one should offer a single oblation to Agni Sviṣṭakṛt.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāṃ ca tato dadyātpūrṇāṃ dadyādgṛhaṃ vrajet .. 7 ..
śreṣṭhavṛkṣapratiṣṭhāvidhānavarṇanam
meaning:
दक्षिणां च ततो दद्यात्पूर्णां दद्याद्गृहं व्रजेत् .. 7 ..
श्रेष्ठवृक्षप्रतिष्ठाविधानवर्णनम्
text_mt:
One should then give a priestly gift, offer the final oblation, and go home.
Description of the Procedure for the Consecration of an Excellent Tree

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ekādivaravṛkṣāṇāṃ vidhiṃ vakṣye dvijottamāḥ ..
vṛkṣasya paścime bhāge sthāpayetkalaśaṃ tataḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एकादिवरवृक्षाणां विधिं वक्ष्ये द्विजोत्तमाः ..
वृक्षस्य पश्चिमे भागे स्थापयेत्कलशं ततः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / I shall explain the rule for single and other excellent trees, O best of the twice-born. / On the western side of the tree, one should then install a water pot.
title: adhyāyaḥ 07

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkṣaṃ saṃsthāpayetpūrvaṃ sūtreṇa pariveṣṭayet ..
brahmāṇaṃ kalaśebhyaśca somaṃ viṣṇuṃ vanaspatim .. 2 ..
meaning:
वृक्षं संस्थापयेत्पूर्वं सूत्रेण परिवेष्टयेत् ..
ब्रह्माणं कलशेभ्यश्च सोमं विष्णुं वनस्पतिम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: One should first establish the tree and wrap it around with a thread; / [and invoke] Brahmā, Soma, Viṣṇu, and Vanaspati from the pots.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastilayavairhomānaṣṭāṣṭau vidhivaccaret ..
samutsṛjya tato yūpaṃ kadalyā saha dharmavit .. 3 ..
meaning:
ततस्तिलयवैर्होमानष्टाष्टौ विधिवच्चरेत् ..
समुत्सृज्य ततो यूपं कदल्या सह धर्मवित् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Then, one who knows dharma should perform eight fire offerings each with sesame and barley according to rule, / and then release the sacrificial post together with a plantain.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkṣamūle yajeddharmaṃ pṛthivīṃ ca viśaṃ tathā ..
digīśāṃśca tathā yakṣānnācāryaṃ toṣayettataḥ.. 4..
meaning:
वृक्षमूले यजेद्धर्मं पृथिवीं च विशं तथा ..
दिगीशांश्च तथा यक्षान्नाचार्यं तोषयेत्ततः.. 4..
text_mt: At the base of the tree he should sacrifice to Dharma, to the earth, to the people, / and to the guardians of the directions and the yakṣas; then he should gratify the preceptor.

sanskrit_iast:
dhenuṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāddohadaṃ vṛkṣapūjanam ..
kṛtvā samyagvidhānena savitre'rghyaṃ nivedayet .. 5 ..
aśvatthapratiṣṭhāvidhānavarṇanam
meaning:
धेनुं च दक्षिणां दद्याद्दोहदं वृक्षपूजनम् ..
कृत्वा सम्यग्विधानेन सवित्रेऽर्घ्यं निवेदयेत् .. 5 ..
अश्वत्थप्रतिष्ठाविधानवर्णनम्
text_mt:
He should give a cow as the sacrificial fee, perform the arboricultural rite and worship of the tree, / and having properly performed [everything] according to rule, he should present the water-offering to Savitṛ.
Description of the procedure for the consecration of the aśvattha tree

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
athāśvatthapratiṣṭhāyāṃ mūle bāhupramāṇakam ..
sthaṇḍilaṃ kārayettatra caṃdanenāṅkitaṃ yathā .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अथाश्वत्थप्रतिष्ठायां मूले बाहुप्रमाणकम् ..
स्थण्डिलं कारयेत्तत्र चंदनेनाङ्कितं यथा .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Now, in the consecration of an aśvattha tree, he should make an altar at its base / measuring an arm's length, marked there with sandalwood.
title: adhyāyaḥ 08

sanskrit_iast:
padmaṃ prakalpayettatra sāmānyārghyaṃ vidhāya ca ..
pūrvedyu rātrisamaye tadviṣṇoriti vai ṛcā .. 2 ..
meaning:
पद्मं प्रकल्पयेत्तत्र सामान्यार्घ्यं विधाय च ..
पूर्वेद्यु रात्रिसमये तद्विष्णोरिति वै ऋचा .. 2 ..
text_mt: He should fashion a lotus there, and having made the general water-offering / on the previous night with the verse beginning 'tad viṣṇoḥ',

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpayedvāriṇā pūrṇaṃ kayā neti ca gaṃdhakam ..
gaṃdhadvāreti tailena śrīśca teti ca caṃdanam .. 3 ..
meaning:
स्थापयेद्वारिणा पूर्णं कया नेति च गंधकम् ..
गंधद्वारेति तैलेन श्रीश्च तेति च चंदनम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: he should place [a jar] filled with water, and fragrant substances with 'kayā naḥ', / [anoint it] with oil with 'gandhadvārām', and with sandalwood paste with 'śrīś ca te'.

sanskrit_iast:
dadyāddūrvākṣataṃ kalye brāhmaṇatrayabhojanam ..
kārayetsitasūtraiśca veṣṭayeccaṃdanasya ca .. 4 ..
meaning:
दद्याद्दूर्वाक्षतं कल्ये ब्राह्मणत्रयभोजनम् ..
कारयेत्सितसूत्रैश्च वेष्टयेच्चंदनस्य च .. 4 ..
text_mt: At daybreak he should offer dūrvā grass and unbroken grain, feed three brahmins, / wrap [the tree] with white threads, and [anoint it] with sandalwood paste.

sanskrit_iast:
kumbhe vināyakaṃ pūjya brahmāṇaṃ ca pare ghaṭe ..
svadikṣu dikpatīṃścāpi vṛkṣamūle navagrahān .. 5 ..
meaning:
कुम्भे विनायकं पूज्य ब्रह्माणं च परे घटे ..
स्वदिक्षु दिक्पतींश्चापि वृक्षमूले नवग्रहान् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped Vināyaka in a pot and Brahmā in another jar, / and also the guardians of the directions in their respective quarters, and the nine planets at the base of the tree,

sanskrit_iast:
maṃḍale śivamabhyarcyaṃ pīṭhapūjā puraḥsaram ..
pūrve caṃḍaṃ pracaṃḍaṃ ca dakṣiṇe naṃdibhṛṃgiṇau ..6..
meaning:
मंडले शिवमभ्यर्च्यं पीठपूजा पुरःसरम् ..
पूर्वे चंडं प्रचंडं च दक्षिणे नंदिभृंगिणौ ..6..
text_mt: he should worship Śiva in the diagram, preceded by worship of the seat: / Caṇḍa and Pracaṇḍa in the east, Nandin and Bhṛṅgin in the south,

sanskrit_iast:
anaṃtaṃ paścime kāmamuttare gaṇanāyakam ..
kārtikeyaṃ madhyadeśa ādhāraśaktipūrvakam..7...
meaning:
अनंतं पश्चिमे काममुत्तरे गणनायकम् ..
कार्तिकेयं मध्यदेश आधारशक्तिपूर्वकम्..7...
text_mt: Ananta in the west, Kāma in the north, Gaṇanāyaka / and Kārtikeya in the middle, preceded by the power of the support (Ādhāraśakti),

sanskrit_iast:
anaṃtaṃ pṛthivīṃ caiva trivṛttaṃ ca trimaṃḍalam..
atha dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi śvetaṃ vṛṣabhameva ca .. 8..
meaning:
अनंतं पृथिवीं चैव त्रिवृत्तं च त्रिमंडलम्..
अथ ध्यानं प्रवक्ष्यामि श्वेतं वृषभमेव च .. 8..
text_mt: and Ananta, the earth, the triple fold, and the three circles. / Now I shall explain the visualisation: on a white bull,

sanskrit_iast:
dvibhujaṃ śūlahastaṃ ca sarvābharaṇasaṃyutam..
āropayetsvataṃtreṇa mūle viṣṇuṃ samarcayet..9..
meaning:
द्विभुजं शूलहस्तं च सर्वाभरणसंयुतम्..
आरोपयेत्स्वतंत्रेण मूले विष्णुं समर्चयेत्..9..
text_mt: two-armed, with a trident in hand, endowed with all ornaments. / He should set it up independently; at the base he should worship Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkaraṃ ca tathā madhye agre brahmāṇakaṃ yajet..
baliṃ ca piṣṭakānnaṃ ca dattvā ca śrapayeccarum..2.3.8.10..
meaning:
शंकरं च तथा मध्ये अग्रे ब्रह्माणकं यजेत्..
बलिं च पिष्टकान्नं च दत्त्वा च श्रपयेच्चरुम्..2.3.8.10..
text_mt: and Śaṅkara in the middle, and at the top he should sacrifice to Brahmā. / Having offered a bali and flour-cake food, he should boil the sacrificial porridge.

sanskrit_iast:
juhuyādrudramuddiśya rudrasaṃkhyāhutiṃ kramāt ..
anyeṣāṃ ca sruveṇaiva homaṃ dadyātprayatnataḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
जुहुयाद्रुद्रमुद्दिश्य रुद्रसंख्याहुतिं क्रमात् ..
अन्येषां च स्रुवेणैव होमं दद्यात्प्रयत्नतः .. 11 ..
text_mt: He should offer into the fire dedicated to Rudra oblations numbering eleven in sequence, / and with the ladle he should diligently make the oblation to the others.

sanskrit_iast:
ropayetkadalīvṛkṣamācāryaṃ paritoṣayet ..
kṛtvā pūrṇāṃ paṃcadhārāṃ kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇām .. 12 ..
meaning:
रोपयेत्कदलीवृक्षमाचार्यं परितोषयेत् ..
कृत्वा पूर्णां पंचधारां कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणाम् .. 12 ..
