sanskrit_iast:
tāḍīpūgādayo yatra yamau syātāṃ pramādataḥ ..
gehī tatra vinaśyeta sadāraḥ putrasaṃyutaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
ताडीपूगादयो यत्र यमौ स्यातां प्रमादतः ..
गेही तत्र विनश्येत सदारः पुत्रसंयुतः .. 29 ..
text_mt: Where palmyra, areca, or the like unnaturally bear twins, / the householder there will perish along with his wife and children.

sanskrit_iast:
baddhapuṣpe yadā puṣpaṃ phalaṃ vā yadi dṛśyate ..
akṣatādarśanāttatra somasyādbhutadarśanam ..
dadhi madhu ghṛtaṃ caiva juhuyādayutaṃ dvijāḥ ..2.3.20.30..
meaning:
बद्धपुष्पे यदा पुष्पं फलं वा यदि दृश्यते ..
अक्षतादर्शनात्तत्र सोमस्याद्भुतदर्शनम् ..
दधि मधु घृतं चैव जुहुयादयुतं द्विजाः ..2.3.20.30..
text_mt: When a blossom is seen on a flower-bud, or a fruit appears, / because of the disappearance of unhusked grain, that is a portentous sign of Soma. / O twice-born, one should offer ten thousand oblations of curds, honey, and ghee,

sanskrit_iast:
pālāśaṃ somamuddiśya somasya ca bhaveddine ..
imaṃdevā iti maṃtreṇa somāya śrapayeccarum ..31..
meaning:
पालाशं सोममुद्दिश्य सोमस्य च भवेद्दिने ..
इमंदेवा इति मंत्रेण सोमाय श्रपयेच्चरुम् ..31..
text_mt: using palāśa wood, intended for Soma, on the day of Soma, / and with the mantra ‘imaṃ devāḥ’ one should cook a caru offering for Soma.

sanskrit_iast:
utpataṃti gṛhe yasya yavā māṣāśca puṣkalāḥ ..
dadhikṣīrājyapākeṣu rudhiraṃ dṛśyate yadi ..32..
meaning:
उत्पतंति गृहे यस्य यवा माषाश्च पुष्कलाः ..
दधिक्षीराज्यपाकेषु रुधिरं दृश्यते यदि ..32..
text_mt: In whose house abundant barley and black gram fly up, / or if blood is seen in cooked curds, milk, and ghee;

sanskrit_iast:
akasmādgṛhadāhastu anagnijvalanaṃ yathā ..
meghahīnā bhavedvidyudvṛṣasyodgamanaṃ tathā ..33..
meaning:
अकस्माद्गृहदाहस्तु अनग्निज्वलनं यथा ..
मेघहीना भवेद्विद्युद्वृषस्योद्गमनं तथा ..33..
text_mt: or a sudden burning of the house, like a blaze without fire, / lightning occurring without clouds, or the leaping up of a bull;

sanskrit_iast:
vyādhilīnā vinaśyaṃti nikhilāḥ paśumānuṣāḥ ..
evaṃ sarvāṇi bhūtāni bhavaṃtyakārake dhruvam .. 34
meaning:
व्याधिलीना विनश्यंति निखिलाः पशुमानुषाः ..
एवं सर्वाणि भूतानि भवंत्यकारके ध्रुवम् .. 34
text_mt: all beasts and humans, overcome by disease, perish. / In this way all beings certainly suffer when Mars is malefic.

sanskrit_iast:
rājāmātyavināśāya gehe gehī vinaśyati ..
prāṇanāśāya viprāyāhutyā ca prabhavaṃti hi .. 35 ..
meaning:
राजामात्यविनाशाय गेहे गेही विनश्यति ..
प्राणनाशाय विप्रायाहुत्या च प्रभवंति हि .. 35 ..
text_mt: For the destruction of the king and his ministers, the master of the house perishes in his home; / indeed, through priestly oblations these portents bring destruction of life.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā vābhadramatyugraṃ juhuyādayutaṃ kramāt ..
dadhimadhughṛtairyuktaṃ khādirodumbare'pi ca .. 36 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा वाभद्रमत्युग्रं जुहुयादयुतं क्रमात् ..
दधिमधुघृतैर्युक्तं खादिरोदुम्बरेऽपि च .. 36 ..
text_mt: Or having seen such very fierce inauspiciousness, one should duly offer ten thousand oblations / mixed with curds, honey, and ghee, into [wood of] khadira and udumbara,

sanskrit_iast:
agnirmūddheṃti maṃtreṇa śrapitaṃ lohitaṃ carum ..
triviprānbhojayeddadyāddakṣiṇāṃ lohitaṃ tataḥ ..
svarṇamaṃgāramuddiśya tataḥ śāṃtiḥ prajāyate .. 37 ..
meaning:
अग्निर्मूद्धेंति मंत्रेण श्रपितं लोहितं चरुम् ..
त्रिविप्रान्भोजयेद्दद्याद्दक्षिणां लोहितं ततः ..
स्वर्णमंगारमुद्दिश्य ततः शांतिः प्रजायते .. 37 ..
text_mt: with a red caru offering cooked while reciting the mantra ‘agnirmūrdhā’. / One should feed three Brahmins, and then give a priestly gift of red cloth / and gold intended for Mars; then pacification arises.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpaṃ vā pātayedyatra phalaṃ vāpi tathaiva ca ..
dadhyannaṃ ca ghṛtairmiśraṃ raupyaṃ hiraṇyameva ca ..38..
meaning:
पुष्पं वा पातयेद्यत्र फलं वापि तथैव च ..
दध्यन्नं च घृतैर्मिश्रं रौप्यं हिरण्यमेव च ..38..
text_mt: Where a blossom or fruit drops down, / curd-rice mixed with ghee, silver, and gold,

sanskrit_iast:
hastyaśvamahiṣā gāvo dārāpatyadhanāni ca ..
tuṣṭenāṃgārakeṇaiva sarvametatpradīyatām..
āṃgārakeṇa maṃtreṇa khādiraṃ cākṣatairyutam.. .. 39 ..
meaning:
हस्त्यश्वमहिषा गावो दारापत्यधनानि च ..
तुष्टेनांगारकेणैव सर्वमेतत्प्रदीयताम्..
आंगारकेण मंत्रेण खादिरं चाक्षतैर्युतम्.. .. 39 ..
text_mt: elephants, horses, buffaloes, cows, wives, children, and riches— / all this should be given, with Mars being propitiated, / using the mantra for Mars, with khadira wood and unbroken grains;

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāṃ ca yathāśakti dadyādviprāya vā punaḥ ..
lohitaṃ ca baliṃ dadyāttataḥ saṃpadyate śubham ..2.3.20.40..
meaning:
दक्षिणां च यथाशक्ति दद्याद्विप्राय वा पुनः ..
लोहितं च बलिं दद्यात्ततः संपद्यते शुभम् ..2.3.20.40..
text_mt: and again one should give a priestly gift according to one's means to a Brahmin. / One should also offer a red offering; then auspiciousness is obtained.

sanskrit_iast:
dhāvaṃti cordhvapucchāśca gṛhe gāvaḥ svayaṃ yadi ..
ārohaṃti gṛhaṃ viprāḥ sārameyāśca sūkarāḥ.. 41 ..
meaning:
धावंति चोर्ध्वपुच्छाश्च गृहे गावः स्वयं यदि ..
आरोहंति गृहं विप्राः सारमेयाश्च सूकराः.. 41 ..
text_mt: If cows run of their own accord in the house with tails held high, / or, O Brahmins, dogs and pigs climb onto the house;

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhe yasya bhavaṃtyete tasya bhāryā vinaśyati ..
sarveṣāṃ vā bhavenmṛtyurvaṃdhyā gaurvā prajāyate ..42..
meaning:
गृहे यस्य भवंत्येते तस्य भार्या विनश्यति ..
सर्वेषां वा भवेन्मृत्युर्वंध्या गौर्वा प्रजायते ..42..
text_mt: in whose house these occur, his wife perishes, / or death befalls everyone, or the cow becomes barren;

sanskrit_iast:
mithyāvādena gehī ca rājñā vādaiśca tiṣṭhati ..
atha vā yadgṛhe gāvo nardayaṃti hasaṃti ca ..43..
meaning:
मिथ्यावादेन गेही च राज्ञा वादैश्च तिष्ठति ..
अथ वा यद्गृहे गावो नर्दयंति हसंति च ..43..
text_mt: and the householder faces false accusation and disputes with the king. / Or in whose house cows roar and laugh,

sanskrit_iast:
dharaṇīhananaṃ yatra dvayorāskadanaṃ tathā ..
nimittānyevamādīni gośvajātāni sattamāḥ ..44..
meaning:
धरणीहननं यत्र द्वयोरास्कदनं तथा ..
निमित्तान्येवमादीनि गोश्वजातानि सत्तमाः ..44..
text_mt: where there is pawing of the earth, or the leaping together of two, / and such portents arise among cows and horses, O best of men;

sanskrit_iast:
yasya gehe bhavaṃtyete nāśastasya bhaveddhruvam ..
maṇḍūkasarpakūṣmāṃḍāḥ prasuvaṃti yathā striyaḥ ..45..
meaning:
यस्य गेहे भवंत्येते नाशस्तस्य भवेद्ध्रुवम् ..
मण्डूकसर्पकूष्मांडाः प्रसुवंति यथा स्त्रियः ..45..
text_mt: in whose house these occur, his destruction is certain. / Just as women bringing forth frogs, snakes, and gourds—

sanskrit_iast:
akasmādyadi caitāni budhasyotpātalakṣaṇam ..
śāṃtiṃ tatra pravakṣyāmi yathā saṃpadyate sukham .. 46 ..
meaning:
अकस्माद्यदि चैतानि बुधस्योत्पातलक्षणम् ..
शांतिं तत्र प्रवक्ष्यामि यथा संपद्यते सुखम् .. 46 ..
text_mt: if these occur suddenly, it is a sign of a portent from Mercury. / I will explain the pacification there so that happiness may ensue:

sanskrit_iast:
dadhimadhughṛtāktaṃ ca apāmārgaṃ tathā punaḥ ..
ayutaṃ budhavāre ca juhuyācchraddhayā yutaḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
दधिमधुघृताक्तं च अपामार्गं तथा पुनः ..
अयुतं बुधवारे च जुहुयाच्छ्रद्धया युतः .. 47 ..
text_mt: Anointed with curds, honey, and ghee, with apāmārga wood again, / one should offer ten thousand oblations on a Wednesday with deep faith;

sanskrit_iast:
aṃbaketi ca maṃtreṇa budhāya śrapayeccarum ..
suvarṇaṃ budhamuddiśya gāṃ ca dadyātpayasvinīm .. 48 ..
meaning:
अंबकेति च मंत्रेण बुधाय श्रपयेच्चरुम् ..
सुवर्णं बुधमुद्दिश्य गां च दद्यात्पयस्विनीम् .. 48 ..
text_mt: with the mantra ‘amba’ one should cook a caru offering for Mercury. / One should give gold intended for Mercury and a milch cow.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇaṃ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ ca suphalaṃ cākṣataṃ tathā ..
gṛhe prāṃgaṇake yasya nipataṃti kadācana ..49..
meaning:
सुवर्णं पुष्पवृष्टिं च सुफलं चाक्षतं तथा ..
गृहे प्रांगणके यस्य निपतंति कदाचन ..49..
text_mt: Gold, a rain of flowers, fine fruits, and unbroken grains, / if these ever fall into anyone's house or courtyard,

sanskrit_iast:
alaṃkārayutāṃ vāpi sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām ..
gṛhamadhye tu yaḥ paśye tkṣīṇāmaṃtarhitāṃ striyam .. 2.3.20.50 ..
meaning:
अलंकारयुतां वापि सर्वाभरणभूषिताम् ..
गृहमध्ये तु यः पश्ये त्क्षीणामंतर्हितां स्त्रियम् .. 2.3.20.50 ..
text_mt: or if one should see in the middle of the house an adorned woman, / adorned with all ornaments, wasted and then disappearing,

sanskrit_iast:
akasmānmālatīpuṣpaṃ jātaṃ syāttasya vā gṛhe ..
somāya na ca saṃtuṣṭaḥ sarvametatpradṛśyate .. 51 ..
meaning:
अकस्मान्मालतीपुष्पं जातं स्यात्तस्य वा गृहे ..
सोमाय न च संतुष्टः सर्वमेतत्प्रदृश्यते .. 51 ..
text_mt: or if mālatī flowers suddenly appear in his house— / not being pleased with Soma, all of this is seen.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ tathā putra aiśvaryaṃ ca varastriyaḥ ..
sabhṛtyāśca mahiṣyaśca mariṣyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ ..52..
meaning:
धनं धान्यं तथा पुत्र ऐश्वर्यं च वरस्त्रियः ..
सभृत्याश्च महिष्यश्च मरिष्यंति न संशयः ..52..
text_mt: Wealth, grain, children, power, and noble women, / along with servants and buffaloes, will surely die; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīścateti ca mantreṇa apāmārgaṃ tathā budhaḥ ..
sahasraṃ budhavāre ca juhuyād ghṛtasaṃyutam .. 53 ..
meaning:
श्रीश्चतेति च मन्त्रेण अपामार्गं तथा बुधः ..
सहस्रं बुधवारे च जुहुयाद् घृतसंयुतम् .. 53 ..
text_mt: Reciting the mantra ‘śrīśca te’, the wise man should offer / a thousand oblations with apāmārga on a Wednesday, combined with ghee.

sanskrit_iast:
payasvinīṃ tathā gāṃ ca vāsoyugasamanvitam ..
dvijāya śraddhayā dadyāttataḥ saṃpadyate śubham.. 54 ..
meaning:
पयस्विनीं तथा गां च वासोयुगसमन्वितम् ..
द्विजाय श्रद्धया दद्यात्ततः संपद्यते शुभम्.. 54 ..
text_mt: And a milch cow, along with a pair of garments, / one should give to a Brahmin with faith; then auspiciousness is obtained.

sanskrit_iast:
raktasrāvo bhavedyatra tatra ṛtvikprasūyate ..
siṃhavyāghragavādīnāṃ dhanahānivipatkaraḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
रक्तस्रावो भवेद्यत्र तत्र ऋत्विक्प्रसूयते ..
सिंहव्याघ्रगवादीनां धनहानिविपत्करः .. 55 ..
text_mt: Where a flow of blood occurs, a sacrificial priest is born there; / among lions, tigers, cattle, and the like, it brings loss of wealth and misfortune.

sanskrit_iast:
eko vṛṣastrayo gāvaḥ saptāṣṭa nava daṃtinaḥ ..
saṃvatsareṇa tasyaikā prasūtirvihatā punaḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
एको वृषस्त्रयो गावः सप्ताष्ट नव दंतिनः ..
संवत्सरेण तस्यैका प्रसूतिर्विहता पुनः .. 56 ..
text_mt: One bull, three cows, seven, eight, or nine tusked beasts— / within a year a single birth among them is destroyed again.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥpunarvrataṃ cāśu akāle maithunaṃ tathā ..
gāvo yatra prasūyaṃte yamau doṣakarāvimau .. 57 ..
meaning:
पुनःपुनर्व्रतं चाशु अकाले मैथुनं तथा ..
गावो यत्र प्रसूयंते यमौ दोषकराविमौ .. 57 ..
text_mt: Repeated fasts immediately, copulation at improper times, / and where cows give birth to twins—these two produce harm.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuñjīkṛtāni dhānyāni vrīhayo yavataṃḍulāḥ ..
grāvimārjāramaṃḍūkāḥ sthūṇābhaṃge ca prāṅgaṇe .. 58 ..
meaning:
भुञ्जीकृतानि धान्यानि व्रीहयो यवतंडुलाः ..
ग्राविमार्जारमंडूकाः स्थूणाभंगे च प्राङ्गणे .. 58 ..
text_mt: Grains piled up together—paddy, barley, and rice grains— / stones, cats, frogs, and when a pillar breaks in the courtyard,

sanskrit_iast:
vikiraṃti nakhairbhūmiṃ prarohaṃti grahaṃ tathā ..
gṛhe yasya prajāyaṃte tasyā mṛtyurna saṃśayaḥ .. 59 ..
meaning:
विकिरंति नखैर्भूमिं प्ररोहंति ग्रहं तथा ..
गृहे यस्य प्रजायंते तस्या मृत्युर्न संशयः .. 59 ..
text_mt: if they scratch the ground with claws and shoot up in the house, / in whose house they occur, her death is certain; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṇmāsābhyantare yatra śmaśānaṃ yāsyati dhruvam ..
kalahaṃ jñātivairaṃ ca vyādhipīḍā bhaviṣyati .. 2.3.20.60 ..
meaning:
षण्मासाभ्यन्तरे यत्र श्मशानं यास्यति ध्रुवम् ..
कलहं ज्ञातिवैरं च व्याधिपीडा भविष्यति .. 2.3.20.60 ..
text_mt: Within six months he will certainly go to the cremation ground; / there will be discord, hostility among relatives, and affliction from diseases;

sanskrit_iast:
vipralāpo mitra nāśa iṣṭeṣvaniṣṭadarśanam..
bhāryāputravināśaśca bhavedeṣu viniścitam .. 61 ..
meaning:
विप्रलापो मित्र नाश इष्टेष्वनिष्टदर्शनम्..
भार्यापुत्रविनाशश्च भवेदेषु विनिश्चितम् .. 61 ..
text_mt: delirium, loss of friends, sight of misfortune among loved ones, / and destruction of wife and son will certainly occur amidst these.

sanskrit_iast:
kriyāvaṃtaṃ yadā kurvankurvīta gṛdhrabilvake ..
tadā rājñāṃ vibhramaśca tathā gṛhavināśanam .. 62 ..
meaning:
क्रियावंतं यदा कुर्वन्कुर्वीत गृध्रबिल्वके ..
तदा राज्ञां विभ्रमश्च तथा गृहविनाशनम् .. 62 ..
text_mt: When performing rituals with a vulture on a bilva tree, / then confusion of kings and destruction of the house will occur.

sanskrit_iast:
amātyavargāśca pure rājñāṃ rājyaparāṅmukhāḥ ..
bṛhaspatiṃ samuddiśya gāṃ ca dadyātpayasvinīm .. 63 ..
meaning:
अमात्यवर्गाश्च पुरे राज्ञां राज्यपराङ्मुखाः ..
बृहस्पतिं समुद्दिश्य गां च दद्यात्पयस्विनीम् .. 63 ..
text_mt:
and the body of ministers in the city turns against the kings' sovereignty,
one should dedicate [it] to Bṛhaspati and give a milch cow.

sanskrit_iast:
vārimaṃḍe ca kūpe ca vāpyāṃ ca madhukāṃjike ..
kṣīraṃ dadhighṛtaṃ caiva jātaṃ yadi bhaviṣyati .. 64 ..
meaning:
वारिमंडे च कूपे च वाप्यां च मधुकांजिके ..
क्षीरं दधिघृतं चैव जातं यदि भविष्यति .. 64 ..
text_mt:
If in rice-gruel, a well, a reservoir, honey, or sour gruel,
milk, curd, and ghee should come to be produced,

sanskrit_iast:
akasmāttatra vṛkṣaśca phalena saha saṃyutaḥ ..
gṛhamadhye prajāyeta tataḥ saṃpadyate śubham .. 65 ..
meaning:
अकस्मात्तत्र वृक्षश्च फलेन सह संयुतः ..
गृहमध्ये प्रजायेत ततः संपद्यते शुभम् .. 65 ..
text_mt:
or if suddenly a tree laden with fruit
should spring up inside the house, then good fortune will ensue.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatestu tuṣṭasya sarvametannidarśanam ..
gauraṃ bṛhaspateścaiva prakuryātprāyadakṣiṇām .. 66 ..
meaning:
बृहस्पतेस्तु तुष्टस्य सर्वमेतन्निदर्शनम् ..
गौरं बृहस्पतेश्चैव प्रकुर्यात्प्रायदक्षिणाम् .. 66 ..
text_mt:
All this is a sign of Bṛhaspati being pleased.
One should make a predominantly white [gift] as sacrificial fee for Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast:
aśubhaṃ hi śubhenaiva śāṃtiṃ homaṃ ca kārayet ..
tatraiva rākṣasaṃ yatra ghaṭakaṃ pariśoṣaṇam .. 67 ..
meaning:
अशुभं हि शुभेनैव शांतिं होमं च कारयेत् ..
तत्रैव राक्षसं यत्र घटकं परिशोषणम् .. 67 ..
text_mt:
One should avert inauspiciousness by auspiciousness alone, performing pacification and a fire offering
right where the pot, dried up by a rākṣasa, [is found].

sanskrit_iast:
kesarī śarkarā tailaṃ rājataṃ tāṃḍavaṃ sthitam ..
māṣabhaktaṃ tathā dhānyaṃ suvarṇaṃ rajatāni ca .. 68 ..
meaning:
केसरी शर्करा तैलं राजतं तांडवं स्थितम् ..
माषभक्तं तथा धान्यं सुवर्णं रजतानि च .. 68 ..
text_mt:
Saffron, sugar, oil, silver, dancing posture,
māṣa-rice, grain, gold, and silver pieces,

sanskrit_iast:
tāmraṃ kāṃsyaṃ tathā lohaṃ sīsakaṃ pittalaṃ tathā ..
sthāpitānīva dṛśyaṃte gṛhe caitāni yasya vai .. 69 ..
meaning:
ताम्रं कांस्यं तथा लोहं सीसकं पित्तलं तथा ..
स्थापितानीव दृश्यंते गृहे चैतानि यस्य वै .. 69 ..
text_mt:
copper, bell-metal, iron, lead, and brass—
in whose house these are seen as if placed [there],

sanskrit_iast:
dhananāśo bhavettasya svarga bhaṃgo hyathāpi vā ..
vyādhipīḍe tathā ghore rājopadravabaṃdhane ..
gajāśvapaśubhṛtyānāṃ vināśo jāyate dhruvam .. 2.3.20.70 ..
meaning:
धननाशो भवेत्तस्य स्वर्ग भंगो ह्यथापि वा ..
व्याधिपीडे तथा घोरे राजोपद्रवबंधने ..
गजाश्वपशुभृत्यानां विनाशो जायते ध्रुवम् .. 2.3.20.70 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yasyaitāni pradṛśyaṃte parvataḥ kanakāni ca ..
saṃpattasya prajāyeta niścalā sukhadā sadā .. 71 ..
meaning:
यस्यैतानि प्रदृश्यंते पर्वतः कनकानि च ..
संपत्तस्य प्रजायेत निश्चला सुखदा सदा .. 71 ..
text_mt:
For him to whom these, a mountain, and pieces of gold appear,
steadfast prosperity bringing constant joy will be born.

sanskrit_iast:
daṃtottareṣu daṃtāśca paṃktimākramya saṃsthitāḥ ..
te'pi doṣakarāḥ sarve śalā kākṛtinastathā ..
upadaṃtāśca sarve te na te doṣakarāḥ kvacit .. 72 ..
meaning:
दंतोत्तरेषु दंताश्च पंक्तिमाक्रम्य संस्थिताः ..
तेऽपि दोषकराः सर्वे शला काकृतिनस्तथा ..
उपदंताश्च सर्वे ते न ते दोषकराः क्वचित् .. 72 ..

sanskrit_iast:
bhāṃḍe kuṃbhe yadā caiva śrūyate ghanagarjitam ..
kaṃcukānāṃ gṛhe caiva prākāraḥ śrūyate yadi .. 73 ..
meaning:
भांडे कुंभे यदा चैव श्रूयते घनगर्जितम् ..
कंचुकानां गृहे चैव प्राकारः श्रूयते यदि .. 73 ..
text_mt:
When the roar of a dense cloud is heard in a vessel or jar,
or if the [shaking of a] rampart is heard in a house of mail-clad guards,

sanskrit_iast:
mūṣikānāṃ mukhe caiva jvalaṃtī yasya paśyati ..
gehī tatraiva naśyeta śukrasyādbhutadarśanam ..74..
meaning:
मूषिकानां मुखे चैव ज्वलंती यस्य पश्यति ..
गेही तत्रैव नश्येत शुक्रस्याद्भुतदर्शनम् ..74..
text_mt:
or in whose house a blazing [light] is seen in the mouth of mice,
the householder there will perish: this is a portent of Śukra.

sanskrit_iast:
śāṃtiṃ tatra pravakṣyāmi yayā saṃpadyate śubham ..
śamīpatraṃ nirmitaṃ ca yavairyuktaṃ gṛhiṇyapi ..
dadhimadhughṛtāktaṃ ca juhuyādbhārgave dine .. 75 ..
meaning:
शांतिं तत्र प्रवक्ष्यामि यया संपद्यते शुभम् ..
शमीपत्रं निर्मितं च यवैर्युक्तं गृहिण्यपि ..
दधिमधुघृताक्तं च जुहुयाद्भार्गवे दिने .. 75 ..
text_mt:
I shall declare the pacification rite for that, by which good fortune ensues:
the housewife should offer into the fire śamī-leaves prepared
and mixed with barley, smeared with curd, honey, and ghee, on a Friday.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklavāsoyugaṃ caiva gāṃ ca śuklāṃ payasvinīm ..
suvarṇaṃ śraddhayā caiva dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇām .. 76 ..
meaning:
शुक्लवासोयुगं चैव गां च शुक्लां पयस्विनीम् ..
सुवर्णं श्रद्धया चैव दद्याद्विप्राय दक्षिणाम् .. 76 ..
text_mt:
And one should faithfully give to a Brahmin, as a sacrificial fee,
a pair of white garments, a white milch cow, and gold.

sanskrit_iast:
devāgāre yadā bhūmirlohitā yasya dṛśyate ..
puṣpitā dṛśyate loke tatra viddhi mahadbhayam .. 77 ..
meaning:
देवागारे यदा भूमिर्लोहिता यस्य दृश्यते ..
पुष्पिता दृश्यते लोके तत्र विद्धि महद्भयम् .. 77 ..
text_mt:
When the earth in a temple is seen by someone to be red,
[or] is seen flowering in the world, know that there is great danger there.

sanskrit_iast:
rājā vā rājaputro vā rājyaṃ vāpi vinaśyati ..
maṃtriṇo maṃtriputrāśca mriyaṃte nātra saṃśayaḥ ..78..
meaning:
राजा वा राजपुत्रो वा राज्यं वापि विनश्यति ..
मंत्रिणो मंत्रिपुत्राश्च म्रियंते नात्र संशयः ..78..
text_mt:
The king or the king's son or the kingdom itself will perish;
the ministers and the ministers' sons will die—there is no doubt of this.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra vā dṛśyate loke gṛhe yasya supūjitāḥ ..
puṣpitāśca gṛhastaṃbhāḥ śarīraṃ ca ghaṭastathā .. 79 ..
meaning:
यत्र वा दृश्यते लोके गृहे यस्य सुपूजिताः ..
पुष्पिताश्च गृहस्तंभाः शरीरं च घटस्तथा .. 79 ..
text_mt:
Or where, well-honoured in someone's house, there are seen in the world
flowering house-pillars, or a body, or a pot,

sanskrit_iast:
hastyaśvamahiṣāścaiva ajā gāvastathaiva ca ..
nityaṃ svāmivadhārthāya puṣpitāṃ pravahaṃti ca .. 2.3.20.80 ..
meaning:
हस्त्यश्वमहिषाश्चैव अजा गावस्तथैव च ..
नित्यं स्वामिवधार्थाय पुष्पितां प्रवहंति च .. 2.3.20.80 ..
text_mt:
elephants, horses, buffaloes, goats, and cows likewise
always bear flowers [on themselves], it is for the death of their master.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhe haṃso gṛhe samyaṅmaṇḍūkā jalacāriṇaḥ ..
dvāre praviśya sarpaśca pratimāyāḥ prakalpanam .. 81 ..
meaning:
गृहे हंसो गृहे सम्यङ्मण्डूका जलचारिणः ..
द्वारे प्रविश्य सर्पश्च प्रतिमायाः प्रकल्पनम् .. 81 ..
text_mt:
A swan in the house, aquatic frogs right in the house,
a snake entering the door, or the fashioning of an image,

sanskrit_iast:
akasmāddhaṭaśabdopi yatra kutrāpi jāyate ..
sravaṃti pramadā yatra bhinnāste syurnavāṃgikāḥ .. 82 ..
meaning:
अकस्माद्धटशब्दोपि यत्र कुत्रापि जायते ..
स्रवंति प्रमदा यत्र भिन्नास्ते स्युर्नवांगिकाः .. 82 ..
text_mt:
or where the sound of a pot arises suddenly anywhere,
where women discharge [blood], their new limbs being broken,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhī tatra vinaśyeta saputrapaśubāṃdhavaḥ ..
dhanuḥkhaḍgadharā rātrau madhyāhne cāndrake tathā .. 83 ..
meaning:
गृही तत्र विनश्येत सपुत्रपशुबांधवः ..
धनुःखड्गधरा रात्रौ मध्याह्ने चान्द्रके तथा .. 83 ..
text_mt:
the householder will perish there along with his sons, cattle, and kin.
At night, or at midday, in the lunar orb, bearing a bow and sword,

sanskrit_iast:
udito dṛśyate vyomni jvalitaḥ pāvakastathā ..
manuṣyāṅganānāṃ maraṇaṃ tathā syādrāṣṭraviplavaḥ .. 84 ..
meaning:
उदितो दृश्यते व्योम्नि ज्वलितः पावकस्तथा ..
मनुष्याङ्गनानां मरणं तथा स्याद्राष्ट्रविप्लवः .. 84 ..
text_mt:
or a blazing fire is seen risen in the sky,
there will be the death of women, as well as upheaval in the realm.

sanskrit_iast:
rasasiddhāni vastūni surādyāścāpi vā punaḥ ..
hastino madayuktāśca aśvā dhīritahiṃsakāḥ ..
vinaśyaṃti sadā caite śaneradbhutadarśane .. 85 ..
meaning:
रससिद्धानि वस्तूनि सुराद्याश्चापि वा पुनः ..
हस्तिनो मदयुक्ताश्च अश्वा धीरितहिंसकाः ..
विनश्यंति सदा चैते शनेरद्भुतदर्शने .. 85 ..
text_mt:
Liquified alchemical substances, or again liquors and such,
elephants in rut, and horses that are reckless and violent,
always perish when there is a portent of Śani.

sanskrit_iast:
nagare vā tathā grāme jāyante tasya vairiṇaḥ ..
divā vā yadi vā rātrau śaneradbhutadarśanam .. 86 ..
meaning:
नगरे वा तथा ग्रामे जायन्ते तस्य वैरिणः ..
दिवा वा यदि वा रात्रौ शनेरद्भुतदर्शनम् .. 86 ..
text_mt:
Enemies will arise against him in the city or in the village;
by day or by night, it is a portent of Śani.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgavyāghrādirakṣāṃsi tathā gomahiṣā api ..
utpataṃti yadā caite śaneradbhutamādiśet .. 87 ..
meaning:
मृगव्याघ्रादिरक्षांसि तथा गोमहिषा अपि ..
उत्पतंति यदा चैते शनेरद्भुतमादिशेत् .. 87 ..
text_mt:
When deer, tigers, and other wild beasts, as well as cattle and buffaloes,
leap up [uncontrollably], one should designate it a portent of Śani.

sanskrit_iast:
nidhimaṃtraṃ pravakṣyāmi yena saṃpadyate śubham ..
juhuyādayutaṃ samyaksasyāṃśca samidhaṃ dvijāḥ .. 88 ..
meaning:
निधिमंत्रं प्रवक्ष्यामि येन संपद्यते शुभम् ..
जुहुयादयुतं सम्यक्सस्यांश्च समिधं द्विजाः .. 88 ..
text_mt:
I shall declare the treasure-mantra by which good fortune ensues:
O Brahmins, one should properly offer into the fire ten thousand grains and kindling sticks,

sanskrit_iast:
śanno devīti maṃtreṇa śubhārthaṃ śanivāsare ..
caruṃ ca śrapayettatra samuddiśya śanaiścaram .. 89 ..
meaning:
शन्नो देवीति मंत्रेण शुभार्थं शनिवासरे ..
चरुं च श्रपयेत्तत्र समुद्दिश्य शनैश्चरम् .. 89 ..
text_mt:
with the mantra 'śaṃ no devī' on a Saturday for the sake of auspiciousness;
and there one should cook a caru offering dedicated to Śanaiścara.

sanskrit_iast:
gāṃ ca nīlāṃ tato dadyājjīvadvatsāṃ payasvinīm ..
vāsoyugaṃ ca viprāya suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tathā .. 2.3.20.90 ..
meaning:
गां च नीलां ततो दद्याज्जीवद्वत्सां पयस्विनीम् ..
वासोयुगं च विप्राय सुवर्णं रजतं तथा .. 2.3.20.90 ..
text_mt:
Then one should give to a Brahmin a dark cow whose calf is living and giving milk,
a pair of garments, gold, and silver.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā tu śraddhayā samyagdakṣiṇāṃ śirasi sthitām ..
vidhiṃ homāvasāne tu tataḥ saṃpadyate śubham .. 91 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वा तु श्रद्धया सम्यग्दक्षिणां शिरसि स्थिताम् ..
विधिं होमावसाने तु ततः संपद्यते शुभम् .. 91 ..
text_mt:
Having duly and faithfully presented the sacrificial fee placed on the head,
[and concluded] the rite at the end of the fire offering, good fortune will ensue.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā dvāre godhikā ca śaṃkhinī praviśedgṛham ..
tadā'śubhaṃ vijānīyādrājapīḍā dhanakṣayaḥ ..
ayutaṃ juhuyātsamyaktataḥ saṃpadyate śubham .. 92 ..
meaning:
यदा द्वारे गोधिका च शंखिनी प्रविशेद्गृहम् ..
तदाऽशुभं विजानीयाद्राजपीडा धनक्षयः ..
अयुतं जुहुयात्सम्यक्ततः संपद्यते शुभम् .. 92 ..
text_mt:
When an iguana or a śaṅkhinī snake enters the house through the door,
then one should recognise it as inauspicious: torment from the king and loss of wealth.
One should duly offer ten thousand oblations; then good fortune ensues.

sanskrit_iast:
vinā garjitameghena śilāvṛṣṭiḥ prajāyate ..
raktamiśrā hi pāṃḍuśca patantī yatra dṛśyate .. 93 ..
meaning:
विना गर्जितमेघेन शिलावृष्टिः प्रजायते ..
रक्तमिश्रा हि पांडुश्च पतन्ती यत्र दृश्यते .. 93 ..
text_mt:
A shower of stones occurs without a thundering cloud;
where it is seen falling mixed with blood, or pale,

sanskrit_iast:
tatra saṃdṛśyate cābhraṃ vṛkṣā vātavivarjitāḥ ..
śakradhvajastathā cāpaṃ patanaṃ sumanasya ca .. 94 ..
meaning:
तत्र संदृश्यते चाभ्रं वृक्षा वातविवर्जिताः ..
शक्रध्वजस्तथा चापं पतनं सुमनस्य च .. 94 ..
text_mt:
and a cloud is seen there, trees devoid of wind [break],
Indra's banner and a bow fall, and the falling of a flower occurs,

sanskrit_iast:
divā śivā purā rauti ulūko vā niśācaraḥ ..
niśi nipatya kākutsthe pradeśe rauti vā vṛṣaḥ .. 95 ..
meaning:
दिवा शिवा पुरा रौति उलूको वा निशाचरः ..
निशि निपत्य काकुत्स्थे प्रदेशे रौति वा वृषः .. 95 ..
text_mt:
a jackal howls in the city by day, or an owl, the night-prowler [calls],
or an ox howls at night, having collapsed in the area, O descendant of Kakutstha,

sanskrit_iast:
adharmaprabalā deśā rājā dharmaparāṅmukhaḥ ..
anyonyaṃ ca jighāṃsaṃti gobrāhmaṇamathāpi vā .. 96 ..
meaning:
अधर्मप्रबला देशा राजा धर्मपराङ्मुखः ..
अन्योन्यं च जिघांसंति गोब्राह्मणमथापि वा .. 96 ..
text_mt:
countries will be dominated by unrighteousness, the king will be averse to virtue,
and [men] will seek to kill one another, or a cow or a Brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhe gṛhī vinaśyecca saputrapaśubāṃdhavaḥ ..
utsānaṃ dvāradeśe'sya maraṇaṃ rāṣṭravibhramaḥ .. 97 ..
meaning:
गृहे गृही विनश्येच्च सपुत्रपशुबांधवः ..
उत्सानं द्वारदेशेऽस्य मरणं राष्ट्रविभ्रमः .. 97 ..
text_mt:
In the house, the householder will perish along with his sons, cattle, and kin;
there will be distress at his doorway, death, and confusion in the realm.

sanskrit_iast:
rājyanāśo bhavedrājño maraṇaṃ vāhanasya ca ..
viparītāni deśāni kramataḥ saṃbhavaṃti hi .. 98 ..
meaning:
राज्यनाशो भवेद्राज्ञो मरणं वाहनस्य च ..
विपरीतानि देशानि क्रमतः संभवंति हि .. 98 ..
text_mt:
There will be the loss of the king's realm and the death of his mount;
calamities will indeed arise successively in the provinces.

sanskrit_iast:
rāhuṇā grastasūryo'pi niśi cātha yadā divā ..
tārakāgaṇavaccaiva rājñāṃ nidhanakārakaḥ .. 99 ..
meaning:
राहुणा ग्रस्तसूर्योऽपि निशि चाथ यदा दिवा ..
तारकागणवच्चैव राज्ञां निधनकारकः .. 99 ..
text_mt:
When the sun is eclipsed by Rāhu, whether at night or by day,
or resembles a cluster of stars, it brings destruction to kings.

sanskrit_iast:
sahāmātyā vinaśyaṃti svarge ye ca sudurjayāḥ ..
paracakreṇa pātyaṃte rājāno nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 2.3.20.100 ..
meaning:
सहामात्या विनश्यंति स्वर्गे ये च सुदुर्जयाः ..
परचक्रेण पात्यंते राजानो नात्र संशयः .. 2.3.20.100 ..
text_mt:
Kings perish together with their ministers, even those invincible in heaven;
they are cast down by a hostile army—of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
chāyādhvajaśca gagane dṛśyate cetkadācana ..
darśanādeva rājñastu vināśaḥ saharāṣṭrakaiḥ .. 101 ..
meaning:
छायाध्वजश्च गगने दृश्यते चेत्कदाचन ..
दर्शनादेव राज्ञस्तु विनाशः सहराष्ट्रकैः .. 101 ..
text_mt:
And if ever a shadow-banner is seen in the sky,
by its mere sighting comes the destruction of the king along with his subjects.

sanskrit_iast:
jvalito dṛśyate yatra pāvakaśca sakṛjjale ..
vajre śirasi gātre vā jīvitaṃ tasya durlabham .. 102 ..
meaning:
ज्वलितो दृश्यते यत्र पावकश्च सकृज्जले ..
वज्रे शिरसि गात्रे वा जीवितं तस्य दुर्लभम् .. 102 ..
text_mt:
Where a blazing fire is seen suddenly in water,
or a thunderbolt strikes the head or body, his life is hard to preserve.

sanskrit_iast:
dvāropāṃte tathā staṃbhe āgnirvā dhūma eva vā ..
puruṣasya tu tatraiva maraṇaṃ jāyate dhruvam .. 103 ..
meaning:
द्वारोपांते तथा स्तंभे आग्निर्वा धूम एव वा ..
पुरुषस्य तु तत्रैव मरणं जायते ध्रुवम् .. 103 ..
text_mt:
Near the door, or upon a pillar, fire or smoke appears;
the death of the man there will surely occur.

sanskrit_iast:
gagane'śanighātaśca śaktihastena vā punaḥ ..
abdasyābhyaṃtare tasya maraṇaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ..104..
meaning:
गगनेऽशनिघातश्च शक्तिहस्तेन वा पुनः ..
अब्दस्याभ्यंतरे तस्य मरणं नात्र संशयः ..104..
text_mt:
Or again a lightning strike in the sky, or by the hand of a spear-wielder;
within a year his death will occur—there is no doubt of this.

sanskrit_iast:
śikhāvalayamadhye tu sadhūmaḥ pāvakodgamaḥ ..
dṛśyate nagare madhye tatraivādbhutadarśanam .. 105 ..
meaning:
शिखावलयमध्ये तु सधूमः पावकोद्गमः ..
दृश्यते नगरे मध्ये तत्रैवाद्भुतदर्शनम् .. 105 ..
text_mt: If within the circle of the flame an outbreak of smoky fire is seen / in the middle of a city, that indeed is an portentous sight.

sanskrit_iast:
śavasya nīyamānasya utthānaṃ vā pramādataḥ ..
sthāpitasya ca liṃgasya anyatra gamanaṃ tathā .. 106 ..
meaning:
शवस्य नीयमानस्य उत्थानं वा प्रमादतः ..
स्थापितस्य च लिंगस्य अन्यत्र गमनं तथा .. 106 ..
text_mt: Or if a corpse being carried away should rise up through error, / and likewise if an installed linga should move elsewhere,

sanskrit_iast:
nirghātaścāpi bhūkaṃpo nivātolkāpradarśanam ..
akāle puṣpitā vṛkṣāḥ phalaṃ cākālasaṃbhavam .. .. 107 ..
meaning:
निर्घातश्चापि भूकंपो निवातोल्काप्रदर्शनम् ..
अकाले पुष्पिता वृक्षाः फलं चाकालसंभवम् .. .. 107 ..
text_mt: a thunderclap [from a cloudless sky], an earthquake, the sight of a meteor falling in windless weather, / trees blossoming out of season, and fruit appearing out of season,

sanskrit_iast:
animittāni sarvāṇi dūramāgatya nirbharam ..
animittasya nāśo yaḥ saiṃhikeyakṛtasya ca .. 108 ..
meaning:
अनिमित्तानि सर्वाणि दूरमागत्य निर्भरम् ..
अनिमित्तस्य नाशो यः सैंहिकेयकृतस्य च .. 108 ..
text_mt: all these are inauspicious portents having arrived from afar with full force. / For the destruction of the portent caused by the son of Siṃhikā,

sanskrit_iast:
narāṇāmāsanaṃ caiva gavāṃ vā mānuṣīgirā ..
pakṣamātrāṃtare tasya putrasya maraṇaṃ diśet .. 109 ..
meaning:
नराणामासनं चैव गवां वा मानुषीगिरा ..
पक्षमात्रांतरे तस्य पुत्रस्य मरणं दिशेत् .. 109 ..
text_mt: or if an assembly of men or cattle speaks with a human voice, / one should foretell the death of his son within half a month.

sanskrit_iast:
ayutaṃ juhuyāttatra rāhumuddiśya yatnataḥ ..
śāṃtimatra pravakṣyāmi yayā saṃpadyate śubham .. 2.3.20.110 ..
meaning:
अयुतं जुहुयात्तत्र राहुमुद्दिश्य यत्नतः ..
शांतिमत्र प्रवक्ष्यामि यया संपद्यते शुभम् .. 2.3.20.110 ..
text_mt: There one should carefully make ten thousand oblations dedicated to Rāhu. / I shall declare the appeasement rite here, by which good fortune is attained.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhimadhughṛtāktaṃ ca kuryāddūrvākṣataṃ tathā ..
kalāyu iti mantreṇa juhuyādravivāsare .. 111 ..
meaning:
दधिमधुघृताक्तं च कुर्याद्दूर्वाक्षतं तथा ..
कलायु इति मन्त्रेण जुहुयाद्रविवासरे .. 111 ..
text_mt: One should prepare dūrvā grass and unbroken grain smeared with curd, honey, and ghee; / with the mantra 'kalāyu...', one should offer oblations on a Sunday.

sanskrit_iast:
caruṃ ca śrapayettatra rāhumudiśya saṃśrayāt ..
homaṃ kuryāttato gāṃ ca kapilāṃ ca payasvinīm .. 112 ..
meaning:
चरुं च श्रपयेत्तत्र राहुमुदिश्य संश्रयात् ..
होमं कुर्यात्ततो गां च कपिलां च पयस्विनीम् .. 112 ..
text_mt: And there one should cook a caru offering dedicated to Rāhu as a refuge; / then one should perform the fire offering and give a tawny, milk-giving cow,

sanskrit_iast:
atasī tilaśaṃkhau vā vāsoyugamathāpi vā ..
śraddhayā rāhumuddiśya dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇām .. 113 ..
meaning:
अतसी तिलशंखौ वा वासोयुगमथापि वा ..
श्रद्धया राहुमुद्दिश्य दद्याद्विप्राय दक्षिणाम् .. 113 ..
text_mt: or flax, sesame, and a conch, or a pair of garments; / with faith, intending it for Rāhu, one should give a priestly gift to a Brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
duritasya vināśāya tasya saṃpadyate śubham ..
dadhimadhughṛtakṣīreṇa vāruṇena ca vāruṇe .. 114 ..
meaning:
दुरितस्य विनाशाय तस्य संपद्यते शुभम् ..
दधिमधुघृतक्षीरेण वारुणेन च वारुणे .. 114 ..
text_mt: For the destruction of misfortune, good fortune comes to him; / with curd, honey, ghee, and milk, [offering] to Varuṇa in the Varuṇa direction.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛśyate cādbhutaṃ teṣu viśiṣṭairdoṣadarśibhiḥ ..
gṛhī tatra vinaṣṭaśca bhavetsapaśubāṃdhavaḥ ..115..
meaning:
दृश्यते चाद्भुतं तेषु विशिष्टैर्दोषदर्शिभिः ..
गृही तत्र विनष्टश्च भवेत्सपशुबांधवः ..115..
text_mt: If a portent is seen among these by eminent observers of faults, / the householder there would be ruined along with his cattle and kin.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛśyaṃte tatra krauñcāśca jaṃbukā gṛdhravāyasāḥ ..
dāruṇaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ ghoraṃ nṛtyaṃti ca hasaṃti ca ..1 16..
meaning:
दृश्यंते तत्र क्रौञ्चाश्च जंबुका गृध्रवायसाः ..
दारुणं भीषणं घोरं नृत्यंति च हसंति च ..1 16..
text_mt: If curlews, jackals, vultures, and crows are seen there, / dancing and laughing in a terrible, frightening, and dreadful manner,

sanskrit_iast:
maithunāni ca sarveṣāṃ yasya vāse bhavedyadi ..
mṛtyustasya bhavedāśu īśvarasya ca śāsanāt .. 117 ..
meaning:
मैथुनानि च सर्वेषां यस्य वासे भवेद्यदि ..
मृत्युस्तस्य भवेदाशु ईश्वरस्य च शासनात् .. 117 ..
text_mt: and if matings of all kinds occur in his dwelling, / death would come to him swiftly by the ordinance of the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
dhūmaketuryadā vyomni jvalatpāvaka sannibhaḥ ..
sthānātsthānāṃtaraṃ yāti bhūmau vā patate bhṛśam ..
sabaṃdhurasyate rājā paracakraiḥ sa pīḍitaḥ .. 118 ..
meaning:
धूमकेतुर्यदा व्योम्नि ज्वलत्पावक सन्निभः ..
स्थानात्स्थानांतरं याति भूमौ वा पतते भृशम् ..
सबंधुरस्यते राजा परचक्रैः स पीडितः .. 118 ..
text_mt: When a comet resembling blazing fire moves from place to place in the sky, / or violently falls to the earth, / the king, afflicted by foreign armies, is destroyed along with his kinsmen.

sanskrit_iast:
durbhikṣaṃ maraṇaṃ caiva ciraṃ rāṣṭre bhaviṣyati ..
gāvo markaṭakuṃbhā va viśaṃte gṛhaveśmani .. 119 ..
meaning:
दुर्भिक्षं मरणं चैव चिरं राष्ट्रे भविष्यति ..
गावो मर्कटकुंभा व विशंते गृहवेश्मनि .. 119 ..
text_mt: Famine and death will endure for a long time in the realm. / If cows, monkeys, or water-jars enter into the dwelling of a house,

sanskrit_iast:
gāvaśca tasya naśyaṃti dārāpatyadhanāni ca ..
anyasya doṣo bhavati gṛhe yāṃti pramādataḥ .. 2.3.20.120 ..
meaning:
गावश्च तस्य नश्यंति दारापत्यधनानि च ..
अन्यस्य दोषो भवति गृहे यांति प्रमादतः .. 2.3.20.120 ..
text_mt: his cows perish, as well as his wife, offspring, and wealth. / It brings misfortune to another if they enter a house by mistake.

sanskrit_iast:
abdāṃtare bhavenmṛtyurvirajā hi bhaviṣyati ..
śāṃtimatra pravakṣyāmi yayā saṃpadyate śubham .. 121 ..
meaning:
अब्दांतरे भवेन्मृत्युर्विरजा हि भविष्यति ..
शांतिमत्र प्रवक्ष्यामि यया संपद्यते शुभम् .. 121 ..
text_mt: Death will occur within a year; indeed, he will become free of dust [i.e., dead]. / I shall declare the appeasement rite here, by which good fortune is attained.

sanskrit_iast:
saptāśvarathasaṃyuktaṃ hemacchatravibhūṣitam ..
viprāya maṃḍapaṃ dadyādbilvapatramathāpi vā .. 122 ..
meaning:
सप्ताश्वरथसंयुक्तं हेमच्छत्रविभूषितम् ..
विप्राय मंडपं दद्याद्बिल्वपत्रमथापि वा .. 122 ..
text_mt: One should give to a Brahmin a pavilion equipped with a seven-horse chariot / and adorned with a royal parasol of gold, or else a bilva leaf.

sanskrit_iast:
aiṃdreṇaiva tu mantreṇa homaḥ kāryo dvijātibhiḥ ..
akasmācchālatālākṣakhadirotpalaserakāḥ .. 123 ..
meaning:
ऐंद्रेणैव तु मन्त्रेण होमः कार्यो द्विजातिभिः ..
अकस्माच्छालतालाक्षखदिरोत्पलसेरकाः .. 123 ..
text_mt: The twice-born should perform the fire offering with the mantra addressed to Indra. / If suddenly sāla, palm, akṣa, khadira, blue lotus, or seraka plants

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhamadhye prajāyeta ketoradbhutadarśanam ..
haṃso vā droṇakāko vā mayūro vā gṛhopari .. 124 ..
meaning:
गृहमध्ये प्रजायेत केतोरद्भुतदर्शनम् ..
हंसो वा द्रोणकाको वा मयूरो वा गृहोपरि .. 124 ..
text_mt: If [these] should grow inside the house, it is an portentous sight of Ketu; / or if a swan, a raven, or a peacock is seen above the house,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhe tasya mahotpātaḥ ketoradbhutadarśanam ..
śāṃtimatra pravakṣyāmi yayā saṃpadyate śubham..125..
meaning:
गृहे तस्य महोत्पातः केतोरद्भुतदर्शनम् ..
शांतिमत्र प्रवक्ष्यामि यया संपद्यते शुभम्..125..
text_mt: a great calamity occurs in his house: it is an portentous sight of Ketu. / I shall declare the appeasement rite here, by which good fortune is attained.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhimadhughṛtāktaṃ ca juhuyādayutaṃ kuśam..
tryaṃbakaṃ ceti mantreṇa ketavebhivape ccarum .. 126 ..
meaning:
दधिमधुघृताक्तं च जुहुयादयुतं कुशम्..
त्र्यंबकं चेति मन्त्रेण केतवेभिवपे च्चरुम् .. 126 ..
text_mt: One should offer ten thousand kuśa blades smeared with curd, honey, and ghee; / and with the mantra 'Tryambaka...', one should scatter the caru offering for Ketu.

sanskrit_iast:
nīlāṃ dhenuṃ savatsāṃ ca bahukṣīrapradāṃ tathā ..
mṛttikāṃ hemavāsaśca nānālaṃkārameva ca .. 127 ..
meaning:
नीलां धेनुं सवत्सां च बहुक्षीरप्रदां तथा ..
मृत्तिकां हेमवासश्च नानालंकारमेव च .. 127 ..
text_mt: A dark cow together with her calf, providing abundant milk, / earth, gold, garments, and various ornaments [should be given].

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāṃ ca pravakṣyāmi yasya nāsti pratikriyā ..
devamuddiśya dānena homena caruṇā tathā .. 128 ..
meaning:
दक्षिणां च प्रवक्ष्यामि यस्य नास्ति प्रतिक्रिया ..
देवमुद्दिश्य दानेन होमेन चरुणा तथा .. 128 ..
text_mt: I shall declare the priestly gift where there is no other remedy: / by gifting, by fire offering, and likewise by caru dedicated to the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi cchāyāṃ yaḥ paśyedātmanaḥ svayam ..
svacchāyāṃ pādukasyaiva paśyetpañcaśirodvayam .. 129 ..
meaning:
दक्षिणस्यां दिशि च्छायां यः पश्येदात्मनः स्वयम् ..
स्वच्छायां पादुकस्यैव पश्येत्पञ्चशिरोद्वयम् .. 129 ..
text_mt: One who personally sees his own shadow in the southern quarter, / or sees the shadow of his shoe, or sees five or two heads,

sanskrit_iast:
evamevaiva yacchinnaṃ śinaṣṭi ca tato hitam ..
śīghraṃ nāśamavāpnoti saptāhānnātra saṃśayaḥ .. 2.3.20.130 ..
meaning:
एवमेवैव यच्छिन्नं शिनष्टि च ततो हितम् ..
शीघ्रं नाशमवाप्नोति सप्ताहान्नात्र संशयः .. 2.3.20.130 ..
text_mt: or sees it severed in that very manner, what good remains for him then? / He swiftly attains destruction within seven days; there is no doubt here.

sanskrit_iast:
uccāvacānpravakṣyāmi yathā śāstreṇa coditam ..
kākamārjāraśūkānāṃ kapotānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
maithunaṃ dṛśyate yatra tacca rāhormahādbhutam .. 131 ..
meaning:
उच्चावचान्प्रवक्ष्यामि यथा शास्त्रेण चोदितम् ..
काकमार्जारशूकानां कपोतानां विशेषतः ..
मैथुनं दृश्यते यत्र तच्च राहोर्महाद्भुतम् .. 131 ..
text_mt: I shall declare diverse portents, as enjoined by the scripture: / where copulation of crows, cats, porcupines, and especially pigeons / is seen, that is a great portent of Rāhu.

sanskrit_iast:
śanimuddiśya juhuyādayutaṃ śanivāsare ..
pūjayedarkapuṣpeṇa śatena juhuyāccarum .. 132 ..
meaning:
शनिमुद्दिश्य जुहुयादयुतं शनिवासरे ..
पूजयेदर्कपुष्पेण शतेन जुहुयाच्चरुम् .. 132 ..
text_mt: One should offer ten thousand oblations dedicated to Saturn on a Saturday; / one should worship with arka flowers, and offer a caru with a hundred [oblations].

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā tatraiva paśyeta śaneradbhutadarśanam ..
aṣṭāviṃśaṃ caruṃ kṛtvā tataḥ śāṃtirbhaveddhruvam 133 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा तत्रैव पश्येत शनेरद्भुतदर्शनम् ..
अष्टाविंशं चरुं कृत्वा ततः शांतिर्भवेद्ध्रुवम् 133 ..
text_mt: Having done this right there, one should examine the portentous sight of Saturn; / having prepared twenty-eight caru offerings, appeasement will certainly ensue.

sanskrit_iast:
bhujapadostathā cakṣuḥspaṃdane maraṇaṃ diśet ..
tattu somādbhutaṃ vidyādvāmadakṣiṇataḥ kramāt .. 134 ..
meaning:
भुजपदोस्तथा चक्षुःस्पंदने मरणं दिशेत् ..
तत्तु सोमाद्भुतं विद्याद्वामदक्षिणतः क्रमात् .. 134 ..
text_mt: If there is twitching in the arms, feet, or eyes, one should foretell death; / one should know that to be a lunar portent, on the left and right respectively.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇapakṣe bhavedvāme viparīte'dbhutaṃ diśet ..
aniṣṭasūcakaṃ yasmāttasmācchāṃtiṃ prakalpayet..135..
meaning:
कृष्णपक्षे भवेद्वामे विपरीतेऽद्भुतं दिशेत् ..
अनिष्टसूचकं यस्मात्तस्माच्छांतिं प्रकल्पयेत्..135..
text_mt: In the dark fortnight, it is [ominous] on the left; one should declare it an ominous portent if contrary. / Because it indicates misfortune, one should therefore perform an appeasement rite.

sanskrit_iast:
śatārddhaṃ ravimuddiśya śāntyarthe homamācaret ..
carupākavidhānena yavaistilasusarpiṣā .. 136 ..
meaning:
शतार्द्धं रविमुद्दिश्य शान्त्यर्थे होममाचरेत् ..
चरुपाकविधानेन यवैस्तिलसुसर्पिषा .. 136 ..
text_mt: One should perform a fire offering of fifty oblations dedicated to the Sun for appeasement, / following the procedure for cooking caru, with barley, sesame, and fine ghee.

sanskrit_iast:
pustake yajñasūtraṃ ca asatpātre carau tu vā ..
śakravastrapradagdhe ca sūryasyādbhutadarśanam .. 137 ..
meaning:
पुस्तके यज्ञसूत्रं च असत्पात्रे चरौ तु वा ..
शक्रवस्त्रप्रदग्धे च सूर्यस्याद्भुतदर्शनम् .. 137 ..
text_mt: If a sacred thread is on a book, or on an unworthy vessel, or on the caru, / or if Indra's cloth is burned, it is an portentous sight of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
hayamāraṃ trimadhvaktaṃ juhuyādiṣṭasiddhaye ..
devapustakaratnāni maṇikāṃcanameva ca .. 138 ..
meaning:
हयमारं त्रिमध्वक्तं जुहुयादिष्टसिद्धये ..
देवपुस्तकरत्नानि मणिकांचनमेव च .. 138 ..
text_mt: One should offer oleander smeared with the three sweets for the attainment of one's desires; / [if portents occur regarding] images of gods, books, jewels, gems, and gold,

sanskrit_iast:
lohitasyādbhutaṃ vidyātsahasraṃ ca viśodhanam ..
devāgāre tathā godhā śaṃkhinī praviśetkvacit .. 139 ..
meaning:
लोहितस्याद्भुतं विद्यात्सहस्रं च विशोधनम् ..
देवागारे तथा गोधा शंखिनी प्रविशेत्क्वचित् .. 139 ..
text_mt: one should know it as an portent of Mars, and a thousand [oblations] is the purification. / If an iguana or a conch-snail enters a temple of the gods anywhere,

sanskrit_iast:
droṇakāko bakaścaiva ulūkadvayameva ca ..
raktakaṃṭhaḥ kapotaśca vyāghra eṇaśca vā viśet .. 2.3.20.140 ..
meaning:
द्रोणकाको बकश्चैव उलूकद्वयमेव च ..
रक्तकंठः कपोतश्च व्याघ्र एणश्च वा विशेत् .. 2.3.20.140 ..
text_mt: or if a raven, a crane, or a pair of owls, / or a red-throated pigeon, a tiger, or a blackbuck enters,

sanskrit_iast:
yasya devagṛhaṃ paśyettasya tasyāyutaṃ hunet ..
na cātra gṛhavaikṛtyaṃ hasanaṃ yadi dṛśyate ..
saṃpattisūcakaṃ gehe maraṇaṃ duḥkhadarśanam .. 141 ..
meaning:
यस्य देवगृहं पश्येत्तस्य तस्यायुतं हुनेत् ..
न चात्र गृहवैकृत्यं हसनं यदि दृश्यते ..
संपत्तिसूचकं गेहे मरणं दुःखदर्शनम् .. 141 ..
text_mt: in whatever house of a deity one sees this, one should offer ten thousand oblations for it. / Nor is there any deformity in the house here; if laughing is seen,

sanskrit_iast:
kraṃdane hatarājyena gajāśvavāhane kvacit ..
sūryamuddiśya juhuyādayutaṃ sarvasiddhaye .. 142 ..
meaning:
क्रंदने हतराज्येन गजाश्ववाहने क्वचित् ..
सूर्यमुद्दिश्य जुहुयादयुतं सर्वसिद्धये .. 142 ..
text_mt: it indicates wealth in the house, [whereas] death and misery are seen / in weeping; if the kingdom is ruined, or anywhere on an elephant or horse mount, / one should offer ten thousand oblations dedicated to the Sun for complete success.

sanskrit_iast:
pramādātkaṃpane hāniḥ svede jāte vipadbhavet ..
kṣīrasrāve ca rudhire tatra rājye mahadbhayam .. 143 ..
meaning:
प्रमादात्कंपने हानिः स्वेदे जाते विपद्भवेत् ..
क्षीरस्रावे च रुधिरे तत्र राज्ये महद्भयम् .. 143 ..
text_mt: From trembling due to an accident there is loss; when sweating occurs, there is misfortune; / and if milk or blood flows, there is great terror in that kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
gocchāgau vātha gomāyurgṛhopari pranṛtyati ..
yadā rauti divā pherustadā nāśo bhaveddhruvam .. 144 ..
meaning:
गोच्छागौ वाथ गोमायुर्गृहोपरि प्रनृत्यति ..
यदा रौति दिवा फेरुस्तदा नाशो भवेद्ध्रुवम् .. 144 ..
text_mt: If a cow, a goat, or a jackal dances upon a house, / [or] when a jackal howls by day, then destruction will surely follow.

sanskrit_iast:
śvajaṃbukāvatha vyāghro yathāśakti ca dhāvati ..
īśāne mahiṣastadvattadā deśe ca viplavaḥ .. 145 ..
meaning:
श्वजंबुकावथ व्याघ्रो यथाशक्ति च धावति ..
ईशाने महिषस्तद्वत्तदा देशे च विप्लवः .. 145 ..
text_mt: If a dog and a jackal, or a tiger runs with all its might, / or likewise a buffalo in the northeast, then there will be upheaval in the land.

sanskrit_iast:
rāhoradbhutamudiśya sahasraṃ juhuyāccarum ..
vṛkṣādbhutaṃ yadā paśyettatra tasyāṃ parityajet ..
yadgṛheṣu hutaṃ yāti deśaviplavamādiśet .. .. 146 ..
meaning:
राहोरद्भुतमुदिश्य सहस्रं जुहुयाच्चरुम् ..
वृक्षाद्भुतं यदा पश्येत्तत्र तस्यां परित्यजेत् ..
यद्गृहेषु हुतं याति देशविप्लवमादिशेत् .. .. 146 ..
text_mt: Intending it for an portent of Rāhu, one should offer a thousand oblations of caru. / When one sees a portent involving trees, one should abandon it in that [direction]; / if what is offered goes into houses, one should predict upheaval in the land.

sanskrit_iast:
deśe vā nagare grāme āraṇyapaśubandhanam ..
sarpe vā viparītaṃ ca māṃsapiṃḍamathāpi vā ..
tadgṛhe maraṇaṃ caiva deśa viplavamādiśet .. 147 ..
meaning:
देशे वा नगरे ग्रामे आरण्यपशुबन्धनम् ..
सर्पे वा विपरीतं च मांसपिंडमथापि वा ..
तद्गृहे मरणं चैव देश विप्लवमादिशेत् .. 147 ..
text_mt: If in a country, city, or village a wild animal is bound, / or if a snake [gives birth to] an unnatural form or a lump of flesh, / death [occurs] in that house and one should foretell catastrophe for the realm.

sanskrit_iast:
divādbhute'yutaṃ rātrau dviguṇaṃ ca bhaveddhruvam ..
dviguṇaṃ cāpi saṃdhyāyāmardharātre caturguṇam .. 148 ..
meaning:
दिवाद्भुतेऽयुतं रात्रौ द्विगुणं च भवेद्ध्रुवम् ..
द्विगुणं चापि संध्यायामर्धरात्रे चतुर्गुणम् .. 148 ..
text_mt: In the case of a daytime portent, ten thousand [oblations should be offered], and at night it certainly must be doubled; / at twilight it is also doubled, and at midnight it is quadrupled.

sanskrit_iast:
akāle tatra maraṇamakāle gṛhiṇīmṛtiḥ ..
saurādbhutaṃ vijānīyādaśubhe vā viśodhanam .. 149 ..
meaning:
अकाले तत्र मरणमकाले गृहिणीमृतिः ..
सौराद्भुतं विजानीयादशुभे वा विशोधनम् .. 149 ..
text_mt: Untimely death [occurs] there, [and] untimely death of the housewife. / One should recognise it as a solar portent, or [perform] purification in the event of inauspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikasyāyutaṃ yatra kuryāttatraiva homayet ..
sāṃgopāṃgena sahita maṣṭāvaṣṭau hutaṃ ca vā .. 2.3.20.150 ..
meaning:
एकैकस्यायुतं यत्र कुर्यात्तत्रैव होमयेत् ..
सांगोपांगेन सहित मष्टावष्टौ हुतं च वा .. 2.3.20.150 ..
text_mt: Where one should offer ten thousand for each one, there one should make the oblation; / together with all the principal and subsidiary limbs, or an oblation of eight each.

sanskrit_iast:
adhipratyadhisahitaṃ gṛhapakṣe'pi sattamāḥ ..
tanmānena hutaṃ viprā kuryāttatraiva bhūṣaṇam .. 151 ..
meaning:
अधिप्रत्यधिसहितं गृहपक्षेऽपि सत्तमाः ..
तन्मानेन हुतं विप्रा कुर्यात्तत्रैव भूषणम् .. 151 ..
text_mt: Together with the presiding and secondary deities, and also on the side of the planets, O best of men; / according to that measure, O brāhmaṇas, one should make the oblation, and right there perform the adornment.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikasyāhutaṃ viprā aṣṭāvaṣṭau hutaṃ ca vā ..
adhipratyadhidevānāṃ yāścānyāścāṃgadevatāḥ .. 152 ..
meaning:
एकैकस्याहुतं विप्रा अष्टावष्टौ हुतं च वा ..
अधिप्रत्यधिदेवानां याश्चान्याश्चांगदेवताः .. 152 ..
text_mt: An oblation for each, O brāhmaṇas, or an oblation of eight each, / for the presiding and secondary deities, and whichever other subordinate deities there are.

sanskrit_iast:
mānāṃtaṃ ca dadetpūrṇāṃ dattvā pūrṇāṃ na homayet ..
vakṣye grahamakhe mānaṃ yena mānena sidhyati .. 153 ..
meaning:
मानांतं च ददेत्पूर्णां दत्त्वा पूर्णां न होमयेत् ..
वक्ष्ये ग्रहमखे मानं येन मानेन सिध्यति .. 153 ..
text_mt: At the end of the measure one should offer the full oblation; having offered the full oblation, one should not sacrifice further. / I shall explain the measure in the planetary sacrifice, by which measure it succeeds.

sanskrit_iast:
amānakaraṇe doṣastasmānmānaṃ na hāpayet ..
paṃkticatvāriṃśadādyaiścaturdhā vibhajennaraḥ .. 154..
meaning:
अमानकरणे दोषस्तस्मान्मानं न हापयेत् ..
पंक्तिचत्वारिंशदाद्यैश्चतुर्धा विभजेन्नरः .. 154..
text_mt: In omitting the measure there is a fault; therefore one should not diminish the measure. / A man should divide [the oblations] into four parts, beginning with rows of forty.

sanskrit_iast:
aniṣṭāya tato dadyāccaruhomaṃ vibhāgaśaḥ ..
adhipratyadhidevānāmaṣṭāvaṣṭa hyudāhṛtam ..155 ..
meaning:
अनिष्टाय ततो दद्याच्चरुहोमं विभागशः ..
अधिप्रत्यधिदेवानामष्टावष्ट ह्युदाहृतम् ..155 ..
text_mt: Then one should offer the oblation of boiled-rice offering portion by portion for the afflicted [planet]. / For the presiding and secondary deities, eight each is declared.

sanskrit_iast:
tryaṃbakādiṣu maṃtreṣu homatrayamudāhṛtam ..
dhanaṃjaye tathā dadyāccaruhomaṃ vibhāgataḥ .. 156 ..
meaning:
त्र्यंबकादिषु मंत्रेषु होमत्रयमुदाहृतम् ..
धनंजये तथा दद्याच्चरुहोमं विभागतः .. 156 ..
text_mt: Three oblations are declared for the mantras beginning with Tryambaka. / Likewise, one should offer the oblation of boiled-rice offering portion by portion to Dhanañjaya.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityāyāṣṭāvaṣṭāvadhikakalpayetsudhīḥ ..
śatahome tu sarvatra daśāṃgaṃ kalpayennaraḥ .. 157 ..
meaning:
आदित्यायाष्टावष्टावधिककल्पयेत्सुधीः ..
शतहोमे तु सर्वत्र दशांगं कल्पयेन्नरः .. 157 ..
text_mt: A wise man should assign an excess of eight each to the Sun. / But in a hundred-oblation sacrifice everywhere, a man should assign ten parts.

sanskrit_iast:
aniṣṭāya yugāṃgaṃ tu grahebhyo hyaṃganāya ca ..
adhipratyadhidevānāṃ tathaivāṃgaṃ prakalpayet .. 158 ..
meaning:
अनिष्टाय युगांगं तु ग्रहेभ्यो ह्यंगनाय च ..
अधिप्रत्यधिदेवानां तथैवांगं प्रकल्पयेत् .. 158 ..
text_mt: Four parts for the afflicted [planet], and parts for the planets and the chief [deity]; / likewise one should assign parts for the presiding and secondary deities.

sanskrit_iast:
dvau tu dadyāttryaṃbakāya tathā dhanaṃjayāya ca ..
tatra homo nāyakāya sarvatraiva vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 159 ..
meaning:
द्वौ तु दद्यात्त्र्यंबकाय तथा धनंजयाय च ..
तत्र होमो नायकाय सर्वत्रैव विचक्षणः .. 159 ..
text_mt: One should offer two to Tryambaka and likewise to Dhanañjaya. / In that rite, the discerning person always makes an oblation for the chief deity.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasre caiva viṃśāṃge aniṣṭāya daśāṃśakam ..
pañcāṃśena grahāṇāṃ ca pañcāṃśena yavānapi .. 2.3.20.160 ..
meaning:
सहस्रे चैव विंशांगे अनिष्टाय दशांशकम् ..
पञ्चांशेन ग्रहाणां च पञ्चांशेन यवानपि .. 2.3.20.160 ..
text_mt: And in a thousand [oblations], with twenty parts, one-tenth part is for the afflicted [planet], / five parts are for the planets, and five parts of barley grains.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāniṣṭe paṃcaśataṃ tasyārdhaṃ grahavāgyataḥ ..
ekatriṃśadbhavenmānam ( 31) anyeṣāṃ tu caturdaśa (14) ..161..
meaning:
तत्रानिष्टे पंचशतं तस्यार्धं ग्रहवाग्यतः ..
एकत्रिंशद्भवेन्मानम् ( 31) अन्येषां तु चतुर्दश (14) ..161..
text_mt: In that case, five hundred [oblations] are for the afflicted [planet]; restrained in speech, half of that is for the planets; / thirty-one is the measure, and for the others, fourteen.

sanskrit_iast:
grahādhikaṃ homayugaṃ tatra bhāge prakalpayet ..
adhātaye ca tithyaṃgaṃ pañcāṃgaṃ yasya cādbhutam .. 162 ..
meaning:
ग्रहाधिकं होमयुगं तत्र भागे प्रकल्पयेत् ..
अधातये च तिथ्यंगं पञ्चांगं यस्य चाद्भुतम् .. 162 ..
text_mt: In that division one should assign two oblations in excess of the planet; / and for [countering] non-destruction, fifteen parts, and five parts for the one whose portent it is.

sanskrit_iast:
grahebhyaścaiva paṃcāṃgaṃ tatra vāṃgaṃ parānapi ..
ekaikāṃge bhavenmānaṃ ṣaṭśataṃ ṣaṣṭireva ca .. 163 ..
meaning:
ग्रहेभ्यश्चैव पंचांगं तत्र वांगं परानपि ..
एकैकांगे भवेन्मानं षट्शतं षष्टिरेव च .. 163 ..
text_mt: And five parts for the planets, or parts for the others there. / In each single part the measure would be six hundred and sixty.

sanskrit_iast:
adhikaṃ ca bhavetṣaṣṭirdaśame bhāgaśeṣataḥ ..
aniṣṭāṃśe trisahasraṃ triśataṃ triṃśataṃ tathā .. 164 ..
meaning:
अधिकं च भवेत्षष्टिर्दशमे भागशेषतः ..
अनिष्टांशे त्रिसहस्रं त्रिशतं त्रिंशतं तथा .. 164 ..
text_mt: And there would be an excess of sixty from the remainder of the tenth division. / In the portion for the afflicted [planet], three thousand, three hundred and thirty.

sanskrit_iast:
catuḥśataṃ grahāṇāṃ ca tathā saptaśatādhikam ..
upagrahebhyo dadyācca paṃcāśītyadhikaṃ śatam .. 165 ..
meaning:
चतुःशतं ग्रहाणां च तथा सप्तशताधिकम् ..
उपग्रहेभ्यो दद्याच्च पंचाशीत्यधिकं शतम् .. 165 ..
text_mt: Four hundred for the planets, and also an excess of seven hundred. / One should give one hundred and eighty-five to the minor planets.

sanskrit_iast:
tithyaṃgabhāgaḥ śeṣeṇa grahe saptaśatādhikam ..
ekaikaṃ tu grahasyaivamādityāya yugaṃ bhavet .. 166 ..
meaning:
तिथ्यंगभागः शेषेण ग्रहे सप्तशताधिकम् ..
एकैकं तु ग्रहस्यैवमादित्याय युगं भवेत् .. 166 ..
text_mt: The portion of fifteen parts from the remainder is with an excess of seven hundred for the planet; / thus one for each planet, and there should be four for the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
grahāṃge yaḥ sthito bhāgo yugalaṃ bhāgaśeṣataḥ ..
tryaṃbakāya ca taddadyāttathā dhanaṃjayāya ca ..167..
meaning:
ग्रहांगे यः स्थितो भागो युगलं भागशेषतः ..
त्र्यंबकाय च तद्दद्यात्तथा धनंजयाय च ..167..
text_mt: The portion situated in the planetary division is a pair from the remainder of the portion; / one should give that to Tryambaka, and likewise to Dhanañjaya.

sanskrit_iast:
śāṃtike pauṣṭike kāmye yadīcchetsukhamātmanaḥ..
grahāṇāṃ cāyutaṃ homaṃ tryahasādhyena homayet .. 168 ..
meaning:
शांतिके पौष्टिके काम्ये यदीच्छेत्सुखमात्मनः..
ग्रहाणां चायुतं होमं त्र्यहसाध्येन होमयेत् .. 168 ..
text_mt: In pacification rites, prosperity rites, and desire-fulfilling rites, if one desires one's own happiness, / one should offer ten thousand oblations to the planets, accomplished in three days.

sanskrit_iast:
tryahasādhye vidhānaṃ yatpuraivodīritaṃ dvijāḥ ..
idānīṃ prakrameṇaiva yo bhāgaḥ sa nigadyate .. 169 ..
meaning:
त्र्यहसाध्ये विधानं यत्पुरैवोदीरितं द्विजाः ..
इदानीं प्रक्रमेणैव यो भागः स निगद्यते .. 169 ..
text_mt: The rule concerning what is accomplished in three days has already been stated, O twice-born ones; / now the division according to regular order is described.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvasmindivase'niṣṭe sahasraṃ triśatottaram ( 1300) ..
itareṣāṃ grahāṇāṃ ca pratyekaṃ tu śataṃ śatam( 100) .. 2.3.20.170 ..
meaning:
पूर्वस्मिन्दिवसेऽनिष्टे सहस्रं त्रिशतोत्तरम् ( 1300) ..
इतरेषां ग्रहाणां च प्रत्येकं तु शतं शतम्( 100) .. 2.3.20.170 ..
text_mt: On the first day, one thousand and three hundred [oblations] for the afflicted [planet], / and one hundred each for the other planets.

sanskrit_iast:
adhipratyadhidevānāṃ paṃcāśaddhoma ucyate ..
prathamehni pradadyācca militvā trisahasrakam( 3000) .. 171 ..
meaning:
अधिप्रत्यधिदेवानां पंचाशद्धोम उच्यते ..
प्रथमेह्नि प्रदद्याच्च मिलित्वा त्रिसहस्रकम्( 3000) .. 171 ..
text_mt: Fifty oblations are prescribed for the presiding and secondary deities. / On the first day, combined together, one should offer three thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyadivase'niṣṭe dvisahasramudāhṛtam ( 2000) ..
prati grahebhyastriśataṃ dadyādaṣṭa śatādhikam( 108) .. 172 ..
meaning:
द्वितीयदिवसेऽनिष्टे द्विसहस्रमुदाहृतम् ( 2000) ..
प्रति ग्रहेभ्यस्त्रिशतं दद्यादष्ट शताधिकम्( 108) .. 172 ..
text_mt: On the second day, two thousand [oblations] are prescribed for the afflicted [planet]. / For each of the planets one should offer one hundred and eight.

sanskrit_iast:
upagrahebhyo dadyācca ṣoḍaśabhyo yathākramam ..
ekāśītiṃ dadau yatnādaśītiṃ cāṃtyayordvayoḥ .. 173 ..
meaning:
उपग्रहेभ्यो दद्याच्च षोडशभ्यो यथाक्रमम् ..
एकाशीतिं ददौ यत्नादशीतिं चांत्ययोर्द्वयोः .. 173 ..
text_mt: And one should offer to the sixteen minor planets in proper order; / he carefully gave eighty-one, and eighty to the last two.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dvitīyadivase militvā ṣaṭsahasrakam ( 6000) ..
aniṣṭāya triśataṃ tu tṛtīyadivase matam..174..
meaning:
एवं द्वितीयदिवसे मिलित्वा षट्सहस्रकम् ( 6000) ..
अनिष्टाय त्रिशतं तु तृतीयदिवसे मतम्..174..
text_mt: Thus, combined together on the second day, six thousand [oblations]. / On the third day, three hundred are prescribed for the afflicted [planet].

sanskrit_iast:
tatpratyekaṃ grahāṇāṃ ca dvācatvāriṃśaducyate ..
adhipratyadhidevānāṃ pratyekaṃ paṃcatriṃśakam .. 175 ..
meaning:
तत्प्रत्येकं ग्रहाणां च द्वाचत्वारिंशदुच्यते ..
अधिप्रत्यधिदेवानां प्रत्येकं पंचत्रिंशकम् .. 175 ..
text_mt: For each of those planets, forty-two is declared; / for each of the presiding and secondary deities, thirty-five.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyadivase dadyānmilitvaikasahasrakam ( 1000) ..
ādityāya yugaṃ dadyādekaṃ tu tryaṃbakāya ca .. 176 ..
meaning:
तृतीयदिवसे दद्यान्मिलित्वैकसहस्रकम् ( 1000) ..
आदित्याय युगं दद्यादेकं तु त्र्यंबकाय च .. 176 ..
text_mt: On the third day, combined together, one should offer one thousand. / One should give four to the Sun, and one to Tryambaka.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanaṃjayāya homaikamekaṃ cāyutamucyate ..
tadardhakaṃ grahebhyaśca itarebhyastadardhakam .. 177 ..
meaning:
धनंजयाय होमैकमेकं चायुतमुच्यते ..
तदर्धकं ग्रहेभ्यश्च इतरेभ्यस्तदर्धकम् .. 177 ..
text_mt: One oblation is declared for Dhanañjaya, and one [share of] ten thousand [is prescribed]. / Half of that is for the planets, and half of that for the others.

sanskrit_iast:
grahāṇāṃ trisahasraṃ tu paṃcānāṃ ca sahasrakam ..
trisahasrabhāgaśeṣamādityāya sahasrakam .. 178 ..
meaning:
ग्रहाणां त्रिसहस्रं तु पंचानां च सहस्रकम् ..
त्रिसहस्रभागशेषमादित्याय सहस्रकम् .. 178 ..
text_mt: Three thousand for the planets, and one thousand for the five. / From the remainder of the three-thousand share, one thousand is for the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tryaṃbakāya tathā dadyāttathā dhanaṃjayāya ca ..
ṣaṭpādādhika ṣaṭaṣaṭkasahasraparisaṃkhyayā ..
navaślokaśatodbhūtaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ syādbhaviṣyakam .. 179 .. ..
..śrīveṅkaṭeśvarārpaṇamastu ..
viṣayānukramaṇikā
meaning:
त्र्यंबकाय तथा दद्यात्तथा धनंजयाय च ..
षट्पादाधिक षटषट्कसहस्रपरिसंख्यया ..
नवश्लोकशतोद्भूतं संपूर्णं स्याद्भविष्यकम् .. 179 .. ..
..श्रीवेङ्कटेश्वरार्पणमस्तु ..
विषयानुक्रमणिका
text_mt:
Likewise one should offer to Tryambaka, and likewise to Dhanañjaya. / By the count of six thousand six hundred and six, plus six quarter-verses, / born of nine hundred verses, the Bhaviṣya [Purāṇa's Madhyamaparvan] is complete.
May this be dedicated to glorious Veṅkaṭeśvara.

sanskrit_iast: kṛtayugabhūpākhyānam
meaning: कृतयुगभूपाख्यानम्
text_mt: The Narrative of the Kings of the Kṛta Age
title: Kṛtayugabhūpākhyānam

sanskrit_iast:
.. .. śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ .. ..
nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam ..
devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet ..1..
.. śaunaka uvāca .. ..
bhaviṣyākhye mahākalpe brahmāyuṣi parārddhake ..
prathame'bdehni tṛtīye prāpte vaivasvate'ntare .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. .. श्रीगणेशाय नमः .. ..
नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम् ..
देवीं सरस्वतीं व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत् ..1..
.. शौनक उवाच .. ..
भविष्याख्ये महाकल्पे ब्रह्मायुषि परार्द्धके ..
प्रथमेऽब्देह्नि तृतीये प्राप्ते वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Salutation to Śrī Gaṇeśa. / Having bowed down to Nārāyaṇa and to Nara, the best of humans, / and to the goddess Sarasvatī, and to Vyāsa, one should then utter [the word] ‘Victory’.
Śaunaka said: / In the great aeon named Bhaviṣya, in the second half of Brahmā’s lifespan, / during the first year, on the third day, when the Vaivasvata interval arrived,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāviṃśe satyayuge ke rājāno'bhavanmune ..
teṣāṃ rājyasya varṣāṇi tanme vada vicakṣaṇa .. 2 ..
meaning:
अष्टाविंशे सत्ययुगे के राजानोऽभवन्मुने ..
तेषां राज्यस्य वर्षाणि तन्मे वद विचक्षण .. 2 ..
text_mt: in the twenty-eighth Satya Age, which kings came to be, O sage? / Tell me that, O wise one, and the years of their rule.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
kalpākhye śvetavārāhe brahmābdasya dinatraye ..
prāpte saptamuhūrte ca manurvaivasva to'bhavata .. 3 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
कल्पाख्ये श्वेतवाराहे ब्रह्माब्दस्य दिनत्रये ..
प्राप्ते सप्तमुहूर्ते च मनुर्वैवस्व तोऽभवत .. 3 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / In the aeon called Śvetavārāha, on the third day of Brahmā’s year, / and when the seventh muhūrta arrived, Vaivasvata Manu came into being.

sanskrit_iast:
sa taptvā sarayūtīre tapo divyaṃ śataṃ samāḥ ..
tacchikkāto'bhavatputra ikṣvākuḥ sa mahīpatiḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
स तप्त्वा सरयूतीरे तपो दिव्यं शतं समाः ..
तच्छिक्कातोऽभवत्पुत्र इक्ष्वाकुः स महीपतिः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Having performed celestial austerity for a hundred years on the bank of the Sarayū, / from his sneeze was born a son, Ikṣvāku, who became ruler of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇo varadānena divyaṃ yānaṃ sa āptavān ..
nārāyaṇaṃ pūjayitvā harau rājyaṃ nivedya ca .. 5..
meaning:
ब्रह्मणो वरदानेन दिव्यं यानं स आप्तवान् ..
नारायणं पूजयित्वा हरौ राज्यं निवेद्य च .. 5..
text_mt: By a boon granted by Brahmā, he obtained a celestial conveyance. / Having worshipped Nārāyaṇa and offered his kingdom to Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭtriṃśacca sahasrāṇāmabdaṃ rājyaṃ tadā'karot ..
tasmājjāto vikukṣiśca śatahīnaṃ tadabdakam ..6..
meaning:
षट्त्रिंशच्च सहस्राणामब्दं राज्यं तदाऽकरोत् ..
तस्माज्जातो विकुक्षिश्च शतहीनं तदब्दकम् ..6..
text_mt: he then ruled for thirty-six thousand years. / From him Vikukṣi was born; having ruled for a period [of years]

sanskrit_iast:
rājyaṃ kṛtvā divaṃ yātastasmājjāto ripuṃjayaḥ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tatkakutsthasutaḥ smṛtaḥ..7..
meaning:
राज्यं कृत्वा दिवं यातस्तस्माज्जातो रिपुंजयः..
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं तत्ककुत्स्थसुतः स्मृतः..7..
text_mt: diminished by a hundred, he went to heaven. From him Ripuṃjaya was born; / he ruled diminished by a hundred; his son was known as Kakutstha.

sanskrit_iast:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tato'nenāṃsa ātmajaḥ ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmājjāto nṛpaḥ pṛthuḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं ततोऽनेनांस आत्मजः ..
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं तस्माज्जातो नृपः पृथुः .. 8 ..
text_mt: He ruled diminished by a hundred; then his son was Anenas. / He ruled diminished by a hundred; from him King Pṛthu was born.

sanskrit_iast:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ viṣvagaśvaśca tatsutaḥ ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmādārdro nṛpo'bhavat .. 9 ..
meaning:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं विष्वगश्वश्च तत्सुतः ..
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं तस्मादार्द्रो नृपोऽभवत् .. 9 ..
text_mt: He ruled diminished by a hundred; his son was Viṣvagaśva. / He ruled diminished by a hundred; from him came King Ārdra.

sanskrit_iast:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bhadrāśvastatsuto'bhavat ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ yuvanāśvastu tatsutaḥ .. 3.1.1.10 ..
meaning:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं भद्राश्वस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ..
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं युवनाश्वस्तु तत्सुतः .. 3.1.1.10 ..
text_mt: He ruled diminished by a hundred; his son was Bhadrāśva. / He ruled diminished by a hundred; his son was Yuvanāśva.

sanskrit_iast:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śravasthastatsuto'bhavat ..
satyapādaśca saṃjātaḥ prathamo bhārate'ntare .. 11 ..
meaning:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं श्रवस्थस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ..
सत्यपादश्च संजातः प्रथमो भारतेऽन्तरे .. 11 ..
text_mt: He ruled diminished by a hundred; his son was Śravastha. / Thus the first quarter of the Satya [Age] came to an end in the land of Bhārata.

sanskrit_iast:
udayādastaparyaṃtaṃ tairnṛpairbhūmimaṃḍalam ..
bhuktaṃ nītiparairdevaiḥ śravasthena tu bhūtale..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bṛhadaśvastato'bhavat .. 12 ..
meaning:
उदयादस्तपर्यंतं तैर्नृपैर्भूमिमंडलम् ..
भुक्तं नीतिपरैर्देवैः श्रवस्थेन तु भूतले..
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं बृहदश्वस्ततोऽभवत् .. 12 ..
text_mt: From sunrise to sunset, the orb of the earth was enjoyed by those kings / devoted to righteousness like gods. By Śravastha upon the earth, / a reign diminished by a hundred was held; from him came Bṛhadaśva.

sanskrit_iast:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmātkuvalayāśvakaḥ ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛta rājyaṃ dṛḍhāśvastatsuto'bhavat..13..
meaning:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं तस्मात्कुवलयाश्वकः ..
शतहीनं कृत राज्यं दृढाश्वस्तत्सुतोऽभवत्..13..
text_mt: He ruled diminished by a hundred; from him came Kuvalayāśva. / He ruled diminished by a hundred; his son was Dṛḍhāśva.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrahīnaṃ rājyaṃ tattasmātputro nikuṃbhakaḥ ..
sahasrahīnaṃ rājyaṃ tatsaṃkaṭāśvastu tatsutaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
सहस्रहीनं राज्यं तत्तस्मात्पुत्रो निकुंभकः ..
सहस्रहीनं राज्यं तत्संकटाश्वस्तु तत्सुतः .. 14 ..
text_mt: His reign was diminished by a thousand; from him was born his son Nikuṃbhaka. / His reign was diminished by a thousand; his son was Saṅkaṭāśva.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrahīnaṃ rājyaṃ tattasmājjātaḥ prasenajit ..
sahasrahīnaṃ rājyaṃ tadravaṇāśvastu tatsutaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
सहस्रहीनं राज्यं तत्तस्माज्जातः प्रसेनजित् ..
सहस्रहीनं राज्यं तद्रवणाश्वस्तु तत्सुतः .. 15 ..
text_mt: His reign was diminished by a thousand; from him was born Prasenajit. / His reign was diminished by a thousand; his son was Ravaṇāśva.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrahīnaṃ rājyaṃ tanmāṃdhātā tatsuto'bhavat ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ purukutsastu tatsutaḥ ..16..
meaning:
सहस्रहीनं राज्यं तन्मांधाता तत्सुतोऽभवत् ..
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं पुरुकुत्सस्तु तत्सुतः ..16..
text_mt: His reign was diminished by a thousand; his son was Māndhātṛ. / He ruled diminished by a hundred; his son was Purukutsa.

sanskrit_iast:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ triṃśadaśvastu tatsutaḥ ..
rathe yasya smṛtā vāhā vājinastriṃśato varāḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं त्रिंशदश्वस्तु तत्सुतः ..
रथे यस्य स्मृता वाहा वाजिनस्त्रिंशतो वराः .. 17 ..
text_mt: He ruled diminished by a hundred; his son was Triṃśadaśva, / to whose chariot were harnessed thirty excellent horses.

sanskrit_iast:
anaraṇyastato jāto hyaṣṭāviṃśatsahasrakam ..
rājyaṃ dvitīyacaraṇe smṛtaṃ satyayugasya vai .. 18 ..
meaning:
अनरण्यस्ततो जातो ह्यष्टाविंशत्सहस्रकम् ..
राज्यं द्वितीयचरणे स्मृतं सत्ययुगस्य वै .. 18 ..
text_mt: From him Anaraṇya was born; twenty-eight thousand [years] / is recorded as his reign in the second quarter of the Satya Age.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛṣadaśvastato jāto rājyaṃ ṣaṣṭhasahasrakam ..
tadabdaṃ bhūtale kṛtvā pitṛlokamupāyayau .. 19 ..
meaning:
पृषदश्वस्ततो जातो राज्यं षष्ठसहस्रकम् ..
तदब्दं भूतले कृत्वा पितृलोकमुपाययौ .. 19 ..
text_mt: From him Pṛṣadaśva was born; having ruled on earth / for sixty-six thousand years, he went to the world of the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
haryaśvastu tato jāto viṣṇubhaktakule nṛpaḥ ..
sahasrahīnaṃ rājyaṃ tattatsuto vasumānsmṛtaḥ .. 3.1.1.20 ..
meaning:
हर्यश्वस्तु ततो जातो विष्णुभक्तकुले नृपः ..
सहस्रहीनं राज्यं तत्तत्सुतो वसुमान्स्मृतः .. 3.1.1.20 ..
text_mt: From him King Haryaśva was born in a lineage devoted to Viṣṇu. / His reign was diminished by a thousand; his son was known as Vasumat.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrahīnaṃ rājyaṃ tattridhanvā tanayastataḥ ..
sahasrahīnaṃ rājyaṃ tattena rājñā ca satkṛtam .. 21 ..
meaning:
सहस्रहीनं राज्यं तत्त्रिधन्वा तनयस्ततः ..
सहस्रहीनं राज्यं तत्तेन राज्ञा च सत्कृतम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: His reign was diminished by a thousand; then his son was Tridhanvan. / His reign was diminished by a thousand, and was virtuously held by that king.

sanskrit_iast:
satyapādaḥ samāpto'yaṃ dvitīyo bhārate'ntare ..
tridhanvanaśca nṛpatestrapāraṇyastu vai sutaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
सत्यपादः समाप्तोऽयं द्वितीयो भारतेऽन्तरे ..
त्रिधन्वनश्च नृपतेस्त्रपारण्यस्तु वै सुतः .. 22 ..
text_mt: This second quarter of the Satya [Age] came to an end in the land of Bhārata. / The son of King Tridhanvan was Trapāraṇya.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrahīnaṃ rājyaṃ tatkṛtvā svargamupāyayau ..
tasmājjātastriśaṃkuśca rājyaṃ varṣasahasrakam .. 23 ..
meaning:
सहस्रहीनं राज्यं तत्कृत्वा स्वर्गमुपाययौ ..
तस्माज्जातस्त्रिशंकुश्च राज्यं वर्षसहस्रकम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Having ruled diminished by a thousand, he went to heaven. / From him Triśaṅku was born; his reign was a thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
chadmanā hīnatāṃ jāto hariścaṃdrastu tatsutaḥ ..
rājyaṃ viṃśatsahasraṃ ca rohito nāma tatsutaḥ ..24 ..
meaning:
छद्मना हीनतां जातो हरिश्चंद्रस्तु तत्सुतः ..
राज्यं विंशत्सहस्रं च रोहितो नाम तत्सुतः ..24 ..
text_mt: He fell into lowliness through deceit; his son was Hariścandra. / His reign was twenty thousand [years]; his son was named Rohita.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ hārītastanayo'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ caṃcubhūpaśca tatsutaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं हारीतस्तनयोऽभवत् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं चंचुभूपश्च तत्सुतः .. 25 ..
text_mt: He ruled equal to his father; his son was Hārīta. / He ruled equal to his father; his son was King Cañcu.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ hi rājyaṃ tadvijayo nāma tatsutaḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ hi rājyaṃ tadrurūkastanayastataḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं हि राज्यं तद्विजयो नाम तत्सुतः ..
पितुस्तुल्यं हि राज्यं तद्रुरूकस्तनयस्ततः .. 26 ..
text_mt: His reign was indeed equal to his father’s; his son was named Vijaya. / His reign was indeed equal to his father’s; from him his son was Ruruka.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sagarastanayo'bhavat ..
bhūpāśca bāhusenāntā vaiṣṇavāḥ parikīrtitāḥ..27..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सगरस्तनयोऽभवत् ..
भूपाश्च बाहुसेनान्ता वैष्णवाः परिकीर्तिताः..27..
text_mt: He ruled equal to his father; his son was Sagara. / The kings up to Bāhusena are proclaimed as Vaiṣṇavas.

sanskrit_iast:
rājyamānaṃ kṛtaṃ samyagbhūpairvaivasvatādibhiḥ ..
maṇisvarṇasamṛddhiśca bahvannaṃ bahudugdhakam .. 28 ..
meaning:
राज्यमानं कृतं सम्यग्भूपैर्वैवस्वतादिभिः ..
मणिस्वर्णसमृद्धिश्च बह्वन्नं बहुदुग्धकम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: The span of rule was well maintained by the kings beginning with Vaivasvata. / There was an abundance of jewels and gold, plenty of food and plenty of milk.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇo dharmastadā bhūmyāṃ mune satyayugasya vai ..
tṛtīyacaraṇe madhye sagaro nāma bhūpatiḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
पूर्णो धर्मस्तदा भूम्यां मुने सत्ययुगस्य वै ..
तृतीयचरणे मध्ये सगरो नाम भूपतिः .. 29 ..
text_mt: Righteousness was then complete on earth, O sage, during the Satya Age. / In the middle of its third quarter, there was a king named Sagara.

sanskrit_iast:
śivabhaktaḥ sadācārastatputrāḥ sāgarāḥ smṛtāḥ ..
triṃśatsahasravarṣaṃ tadrājyaṃ vai munibhiḥ smṛtam .. 3.1.1.30 ..
meaning:
शिवभक्तः सदाचारस्तत्पुत्राः सागराः स्मृताः ..
त्रिंशत्सहस्रवर्षं तद्राज्यं वै मुनिभिः स्मृतम् .. 3.1.1.30 ..
text_mt: He was devoted to Śiva and of noble conduct; his sons are known as the Sāgaras. / His reign is remembered by sages as thirty thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
naṣṭeṣu sāgareṣvevamasamañjasa ātmajaḥ ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamaṃśumāṃstatsuto'bhavat ..31..
meaning:
नष्टेषु सागरेष्वेवमसमञ्जस आत्मजः ..
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यमंशुमांस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ..31..
text_mt: When the sons of Sagara were thus destroyed, his son was Asamañjasa. / He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; his son was Aṃśumān.

sanskrit_iast:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ dilīpastatsuto'bhavat ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmājjāto bhagīrathaḥ ..32..
meaning:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं दिलीपस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ..
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं तस्माज्जातो भगीरथः ..32..
text_mt: He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; Dilīpa was his son. / He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; from him was born Bhagīratha.

sanskrit_iast:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śrutasenastato'bhavat ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ nābhāgastanayastataḥ ..33..
meaning:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं श्रुतसेनस्ततोऽभवत् ..
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं नाभागस्तनयस्ततः ..33..
text_mt: He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; Śrutasena came after him. / He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; his son Nābhāga came after him.

sanskrit_iast:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamambarīṣastato'bhavat ..
śaivāḥ ṣaṭśrutasenāntā nābhāgo vaiṣṇavo nṛpaḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यमम्बरीषस्ततोऽभवत् ..
शैवाः षट्श्रुतसेनान्ता नाभागो वैष्णवो नृपः .. 34 ..
text_mt: He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; Ambarīṣa came after him. / The six ending with Śrutasena were Śaivas; King Nābhāga was a Vaiṣṇava.

sanskrit_iast:
satyapādaḥ samāpto'yaṃ tṛtīyo bhārateṃtare ..
aṃvarīṣeṇa bhūpena śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 35 ..
meaning:
सत्यपादः समाप्तोऽयं तृतीयो भारतेंतरे ..
अंवरीषेण भूपेन शतहीनं कृतं पदम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: This third quarter of the Satya[yuga] was completed within Bhārata. / By King Ambarīṣa a status of a hundred [years] less was made.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthe caraṇe tasya cāṣṭādaśa sahasrakam ..
abdaṃ rājyaṃ śubhaṃ jñātaṃ karmabhūmyāṃ ca bhārate .. 36 ..
meaning:
चतुर्थे चरणे तस्य चाष्टादश सहस्रकम् ..
अब्दं राज्यं शुभं ज्ञातं कर्मभूम्यां च भारते .. 36 ..
text_mt: In its fourth quarter, an auspicious rule of eighteen thousand / years is known in Bhārata, the land of action.

sanskrit_iast:
ekonatriṃśadvarṣāṇi rājyaṃ tattriṃśatāni ca ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ siṃdhudvīpo'mbarīṣajaḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
एकोनत्रिंशद्वर्षाणि राज्यं तत्त्रिंशतानि च ..
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं सिंधुद्वीपोऽम्बरीषजः .. 37 ..
text_mt: Twenty-nine years and thirty hundred [years] was that reign. / He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; Sindhudvīpa was the son of Ambarīṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamayutāśvastato'bhavat ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamṛtuparṇastu tatsutaḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यमयुताश्वस्ततोऽभवत् ..
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यमृतुपर्णस्तु तत्सुतः .. 38 ..
text_mt: He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; Ayutāśva came after him. / He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; Ṛtuparṇa was his son.

sanskrit_iast:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sarvakāmo nṛpastataḥ ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ nṛpaḥ kalmāṣapādakaḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं सर्वकामो नृपस्ततः ..
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं नृपः कल्माषपादकः .. 39 ..
text_mt: He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; King Sarvakāma came after him. / He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; the king was Kalmāṣapāda.

sanskrit_iast:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sudāsastanayo'bhavat..
tasmādaśamakaścaiva madayantyā vaśiṣṭhajaḥ .. 3.1.1.40 ..
meaning:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं सुदासस्तनयोऽभवत्..
तस्मादशमकश्चैव मदयन्त्या वशिष्ठजः .. 3.1.1.40 ..
text_mt: He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; Sudāsa became his son. / From him [was born] Aśmaka, fathered by Vasiṣṭha upon Madayantī.

sanskrit_iast:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ harivarmā tato'bhavat ..
sapta bhūpāḥ sudāsāntā vaiṣṇavāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..41..
meaning:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं हरिवर्मा ततोऽभवत् ..
सप्त भूपाः सुदासान्ता वैष्णवाः परिकीर्तिताः ..41..
text_mt: He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; Harivarmā came after him. / The seven kings ending with Sudāsa are celebrated as Vaiṣṇavas.

sanskrit_iast:
guruśāpāttu saudāso rājyāṅgaṃ gurave'rpayat ..
gokarṇaliṃgabhaktaśca śaivaḥ samaya ucyate .. 42 ..
meaning:
गुरुशापात्तु सौदासो राज्याङ्गं गुरवेऽर्पयत् ..
गोकर्णलिंगभक्तश्च शैवः समय उच्यते .. 42 ..
text_mt: Through the curse of his guru, the son of Sudāsa offered the kingdom's sovereignty to the guru. / Devoted to the liṅga of Gokarṇa, he is called an adherent of the Śaiva doctrine.

sanskrit_iast:
harivarmā śamakajo vaiśyavatsādhupūjakaḥ ..
ūnatriṃśatsahasrāṇi tathā saptaśatāni vai .. 43 ..
meaning:
हरिवर्मा शमकजो वैश्यवत्साधुपूजकः ..
ऊनत्रिंशत्सहस्राणि तथा सप्तशतानि वै .. 43 ..
text_mt: Harivarmā, born of Aśmaka, worshipped virtuous men like a vaiśya. / For twenty-nine thousand and seven hundred [years],

sanskrit_iast:
harivarmā'karodrājyaṃ tasmāddaśaratho'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmāddillīvayassutaḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
हरिवर्माऽकरोद्राज्यं तस्माद्दशरथोऽभवत् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्माद्दिल्लीवयस्सुतः .. 44 ..
text_mt: Harivarmā ruled; from him came Daśaratha. / He ruled equally to his father; from him his son Dilīpa [came].

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bhṛpo viśvāsahastataḥ ..
rājyaṃ daśasahasraṃ tanniyajñaḥ prākṛto nṛpaḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं भृपो विश्वासहस्ततः ..
राज्यं दशसहस्रं तन्नियज्ञः प्राकृतो नृपः .. 45 ..
text_mt: He ruled equally to his father; then King Viśvasaha [came]. / That reign was ten thousand [years]; the king performed no sacrifice and was vulgar.

sanskrit_iast:
tadadharmapratāpena hyanāvṛṣṭistadā'bhavat ..
śatavarṣamanā vṛṣṭissarvarājyaṃ vyanāśayat .. 46 ..
meaning:
तदधर्मप्रतापेन ह्यनावृष्टिस्तदाऽभवत् ..
शतवर्षमना वृष्टिस्सर्वराज्यं व्यनाशयत् .. 46 ..
text_mt: Due to the power of his unrighteousness, a drought occurred then. / A drought of a hundred years destroyed the entire kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñaṃ kṛtvā vaśiṣṭhastu rājñīvacanatatparaḥ ..
yajñātkhaṭvāṃga utpannaḥ khaṭvāṃgaṃ śastramudvahan .. 47 ..
meaning:
यज्ञं कृत्वा वशिष्ठस्तु राज्ञीवचनतत्परः ..
यज्ञात्खट्वांग उत्पन्नः खट्वांगं शस्त्रमुद्वहन् .. 47 ..
text_mt: Having performed a sacrifice, Vasiṣṭha, devoted to the queen's word— / from the sacrifice Khaṭvāṅga was born, bearing the khaṭvāṅga weapon.

sanskrit_iast:
indrasāhāyyamagamadrājyaṃ triṃśatsahasrakam ..
kṛtvā .tatra varaṃ labdhvā devebhyo muktitāṃ gataḥ ... 48 ..
meaning:
इन्द्रसाहाय्यमगमद्राज्यं त्रिंशत्सहस्रकम् ..
कृत्वा .तत्र वरं लब्ध्वा देवेभ्यो मुक्तितां गतः ... 48 ..
text_mt: He went to the aid of Indra; having ruled for thirty thousand [years] / and having obtained a boon from the gods there, he attained liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
khaṭṭāṃgāddīrghabāhuśca rājyaṃ viṃśatsa hasrakam ..
tasmātsudarśano jāto devīpūjanatatparaḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
खट्टांगाद्दीर्घबाहुश्च राज्यं विंशत्स हस्रकम् ..
तस्मात्सुदर्शनो जातो देवीपूजनतत्परः .. 49 ..
text_mt: From Khaṭvāṅga [came] Dīrghabāhu; his reign was twenty thousand [years]. / From him was born Sudarśana, devoted to the worship of the Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavā dāśarathyaṃ tāstrayo vikhyātasadbalāḥ ..
khaṭvāṃgo dīrghabāhuśca vaiṣṇavau parikīrtitau .. 3.1.1.50 ..
meaning:
वैष्णवा दाशरथ्यं तास्त्रयो विख्यातसद्बलाः ..
खट्वांगो दीर्घबाहुश्च वैष्णवौ परिकीर्तितौ .. 3.1.1.50 ..
text_mt: Those three ending with the son of Daśaratha, renowned for true strength, were Vaiṣṇavas. / Khaṭvāṅga and Dīrghabāhu are celebrated as Vaiṣṇavas.

sanskrit_iast:
sudarśano mahāprājñaḥ kāśīrājasutāṃ nṛpaḥ ..
udūhya bhūpatīñjitvā devīsevāprasādataḥ.. ..
rājyaṃ bharatakhaṇḍāntamadadhaddharmato nṛpaḥ ..
varṣapañcasahasrāṇi rājyaṃ cakre sa bhūpatiḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
सुदर्शनो महाप्राज्ञः काशीराजसुतां नृपः ..
उदूह्य भूपतीञ्जित्वा देवीसेवाप्रसादतः.. ..
राज्यं भरतखण्डान्तमदधद्धर्मतो नृपः ..
वर्षपञ्चसहस्राणि राज्यं चक्रे स भूपतिः .. 52 ..
text_mt: King Sudarśana, endowed with great wisdom, married the daughter of the king of Kāśī; / having conquered the kings through the grace of worshipping the Goddess, / the king held the realm up to the borders of Bharatakhaṇḍa with righteousness. / That ruler ruled for five thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
svapnamadhye vacaḥ proktaṃ mahākālyā nṛpāya vai ..
vatsa tvaṃ priyayā sārddhaṃ vaśiṣṭhādibhiranvitaḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
स्वप्नमध्ये वचः प्रोक्तं महाकाल्या नृपाय वै ..
वत्स त्वं प्रियया सार्द्धं वशिष्ठादिभिरन्वितः .. 53 ..
text_mt: In a dream, a speech was indeed uttered to the king by Mahākālī: / 'O child, accompanied by your beloved and joined by Vasiṣṭha and others,

sanskrit_iast:
himālayaṃ giriṃ prāpya vāsaṃ kuru mahāmate ..
mahāvāyuprabhāvena kṣayo bharatakhaṃḍake .. 54 ..
meaning:
हिमालयं गिरिं प्राप्य वासं कुरु महामते ..
महावायुप्रभावेन क्षयो भरतखंडके .. 54 ..
text_mt: reach the Himālaya mountain and make your residence [there], O noble-minded one. / By the power of a mighty wind, destruction [shall come] in Bharatakhaṇḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
ratnākaraḥ paścimo'bdhistasya dvīpāḥ kṣayaṃ gatāḥ ..
mahodadhiḥ pūrvato'bdhistasya dvīpāḥ kṣayaṃ gatāḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
रत्नाकरः पश्चिमोऽब्धिस्तस्य द्वीपाः क्षयं गताः ..
महोदधिः पूर्वतोऽब्धिस्तस्य द्वीपाः क्षयं गताः .. 55 ..
text_mt: Ratnākara is the western ocean; its islands have gone to destruction. / Mahodadhi is the eastern ocean; its islands have gone to destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
vāḍavo'bdhirdakṣiṇe ca tasya dvīpāḥ kṣayaṃ gatāḥ ..
himābdhiruttare tasya sagaraiḥ khanito hi saḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
वाडवोऽब्धिर्दक्षिणे च तस्य द्वीपाः क्षयं गताः ..
हिमाब्धिरुत्तरे तस्य सगरैः खनितो हि सः .. 56 ..
text_mt: The Vāḍava ocean is in the south; its islands have gone to destruction. / The Himābdhi is in the north; indeed, it was dug by the sons of Sagara.

sanskrit_iast:
ye dvīpāstu suvikhyātāste'pi sarve layaṃ gatāḥ ..
bhārato varṣa evāsau vatsare saptame'hani .. 57 ..
meaning:
ये द्वीपास्तु सुविख्यातास्तेऽपि सर्वे लयं गताः ..
भारतो वर्ष एवासौ वत्सरे सप्तमेऽहनि .. 57 ..
text_mt: The islands that are renowned—they too have all gone to dissolution. / This very land of Bhārata, on the seventh day of the year,

sanskrit_iast:
sajīvaḥ pralayaṃ yāyāttasmāttvaṃ jīvito bhava ..
tatheti matvā sa nṛpaḥ parvataṃ vai himālayam .. 58 ..
meaning:
सजीवः प्रलयं यायात्तस्मात्त्वं जीवितो भव ..
तथेति मत्वा स नृपः पर्वतं वै हिमालयम् .. 58 ..
text_mt: along with living creatures, will go to dissolution; therefore, remain alive.' / Thinking, 'So be it,' that king went to the Himālaya mountain

sanskrit_iast:
prāptavānmukhyabhūpaiśca mukhyavaiśyairdvijaiḥ saha ..
pañcavarṣapramāṇena vāyustejaḥkramājjalam .. 59 ..
meaning:
प्राप्तवान्मुख्यभूपैश्च मुख्यवैश्यैर्द्विजैः सह ..
