न्यूहः स्मृतो विष्णुभक्तस्सोऽहं ध्यानपरायणः .. 46 ..
text_mt: Sīma, Śama, and Bhāva were his three sons. / Nyūha is remembered as a devotee of Viṣṇu, devoted to meditation on "I am He".

sanskrit_iast: ekadā bhagavānviṣṇustatsvapne tu samāgataḥ .. 47 ..
meaning: एकदा भगवान्विष्णुस्तत्स्वप्ने तु समागतः .. 47 ..
text_mt: Once, the Blessed Lord Viṣṇu appeared in his dream:

sanskrit_iast:
vatsa nyūha śṛṇuṣvedaṃ pralayaḥ saptame'hani ..
bhavitā tvaṃ janaissārdhaṃ nāvamāruhya satvaram .. 48 ..
meaning:
वत्स न्यूह शृणुष्वेदं प्रलयः सप्तमेऽहनि ..
भविता त्वं जनैस्सार्धं नावमारुह्य सत्वरम् .. 48 ..
text_mt: "Child Nyūha, hear this: on the seventh day the dissolution / will take place. Boarding a boat quickly together with your people,

sanskrit_iast:
jīvanaṃ kuru bhakteṣu sarvaśreṣṭho bhaviṣyasi ..
tatheti matvā sa munirnāvaṃ kṛtvā supuṣṭitām .. 49 ..
meaning:
जीवनं कुरु भक्तेषु सर्वश्रेष्ठो भविष्यसि ..
तथेति मत्वा स मुनिर्नावं कृत्वा सुपुष्टिताम् .. 49 ..
text_mt: preserve your life; you will become the foremost among devotees." / Saying "So be it", that sage made a very sturdy boat,

sanskrit_iast:
hastatriśatalambāṃ ca paṃcāśaddhastavistṛtām ..
triṃśaddhastocchritāṃ ramyāṃ sarvajīvasamanvitām .. 3.1.4.50 ..
meaning:
हस्तत्रिशतलम्बां च पंचाशद्धस्तविस्तृताम् ..
त्रिंशद्धस्तोच्छ्रितां रम्यां सर्वजीवसमन्विताम् .. 3.1.4.50 ..
text_mt: three hundred cubits in length, fifty cubits in breadth, / thirty cubits high, lovely, supplied with all living creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
āruhya svakulaissārddhaṃ viṣṇudhyānaparo'bhavat ..
sāṃvartako meghagaṇo maheṃdreṇa samanvitaḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
आरुह्य स्वकुलैस्सार्द्धं विष्णुध्यानपरोऽभवत् ..
सांवर्तको मेघगणो महेंद्रेण समन्वितः .. 51 ..
text_mt: Having boarded it with his family, he became absorbed in meditation on Viṣṇu. / Accompanied by Mahendra, the Sāṁvartaka clouds

sanskrit_iast:
catvāriṃśaddinānyeva mahāvṛṣṭimakārayat ..
sarvaṃ tu bhārataṃ varṣaṃ jalaiḥ plāvya tu siṃdhavaḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
चत्वारिंशद्दिनान्येव महावृष्टिमकारयत् ..
सर्वं तु भारतं वर्षं जलैः प्लाव्य तु सिंधवः .. 52 ..
text_mt: caused a great rain for forty days. / Flooding the whole land of Bhārata with waters, the oceans,

sanskrit_iast:
catvāro militāḥ sarve viśālāyāṃ na cāgatāḥ ..
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi munayo brahmavādinaḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
चत्वारो मिलिताः सर्वे विशालायां न चागताः ..
अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि मुनयो ब्रह्मवादिनः .. 53 ..
text_mt: all four united, but they did not reach Viśālā. / Eighty-eight thousand sages who expound the Veda,

sanskrit_iast:
nyūhaśca svakulaissārdhaṃ śeṣāssarve vināśitāḥ ..
tadā ca munayassarve viṣṇumāyāṃ pratuṣṭuvuḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
न्यूहश्च स्वकुलैस्सार्धं शेषास्सर्वे विनाशिताः ..
तदा च मुनयस्सर्वे विष्णुमायां प्रतुष्टुवुः .. 54 ..
text_mt: and Nyūha with his family [survived]; all the rest were destroyed. / And then all the sages praised the illusory power of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
.. munaya ūcuḥ .. ..
namo devyai mahākālyai devakyai ca namonamaḥ ..
mahālakṣmyai viṣṇumātre rādhā devyai namonamaḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
.. मुनय ऊचुः .. ..
नमो देव्यै महाकाल्यै देवक्यै च नमोनमः ..
महालक्ष्म्यै विष्णुमात्रे राधा देव्यै नमोनमः .. 55 ..
text_mt: The sages said: / Praise to the Goddess Mahākālī, and praise, praise to Devakī! / Praise to Mahālakṣmī, the mother of Viṣṇu; praise, praise to goddess Rādhā!

sanskrit_iast:
revatyai puṣpavatyai ca svarṇavatyai namonamaḥ ..
kāmākṣāyai ca māyāyai namo mātre namonamaḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
रेवत्यै पुष्पवत्यै च स्वर्णवत्यै नमोनमः ..
कामाक्षायै च मायायै नमो मात्रे नमोनमः .. 56 ..
text_mt: Homage, homage to Revatī, to Puṣpavatī, and to Svarṇavatī; / homage to Kāmākṣī and to Māyā, homage, homage to the Mother.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāvātaprabhāvena mahā megharaveṇa ca ..
jaladhārābhirugrābhirbhayaṃ jātaṃ hi dāruṇam ..57..
meaning:
महावातप्रभावेन महा मेघरवेण च ..
जलधाराभिरुग्राभिर्भयं जातं हि दारुणम् ..57..
text_mt: Through the power of a mighty wind and through the roar of great clouds, / [and] by the fierce streams of water, a dreadful terror indeed arose.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādbhayādbhairavi tvamasmānsaṃrakṣa kiṃkarān ..
tadā prasannā sā devī jalaṃ śāṃta tayā kṛtam .. 58 ..
meaning:
तस्माद्भयाद्भैरवि त्वमस्मान्संरक्ष किंकरान् ..
तदा प्रसन्ना सा देवी जलं शांत तया कृतम् .. 58 ..
text_mt: Protect us, your servants, O Bhairavī, from that terror! / Then that goddess was pleased; the water was pacified by her.

sanskrit_iast:
abdāṃtare mahī sarvā sthalī bhūtvā pradṛśyate ..
ārācca śiṣiṇā nāma himādrestaṭabhūmayaḥ .. 59 ..
meaning:
अब्दांतरे मही सर्वा स्थली भूत्वा प्रदृश्यते ..
आराच्च शिषिणा नाम हिमाद्रेस्तटभूमयः .. 59 ..
text_mt: Within a year, the whole earth appeared as dry land; / and nearby was named Śiṣiṇā, the shore-lands of the snowy mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
nyūhastatra sthito nāvamāruhya svakulaissaha ..
jalāṃte bhūmimāgatya tatra vāsaṃ karoti saḥ .. 3.1.4.60 ..
kaliyugabhūpākhyānavarṇanam
meaning:
न्यूहस्तत्र स्थितो नावमारुह्य स्वकुलैस्सह ..
जलांते भूमिमागत्य तत्र वासं करोति सः .. 3.1.4.60 ..
कलियुगभूपाख्यानवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Nyūha stayed there, having boarded the boat together with his family; / when the waters ended, having reached land, he dwelt there.
Description of the narrative of the kings of the Kali age

sanskrit_iast:
.. śaunaka uvāca .. ..
sāṃprataṃ vartate yo vai pralayāṃte munīśvara ..
divyadṛṣṭiprabhāvena jñātaṃ brūhi tataḥ param .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. शौनक उवाच .. ..
सांप्रतं वर्तते यो वै प्रलयांते मुनीश्वर ..
दिव्यदृष्टिप्रभावेन ज्ञातं ब्रूहि ततः परम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śaunaka said: / O lord of sages, tell [us] beyond that what has been known by the power of divine vision / concerning whoever exists at present after the dissolution.
title: adhyāyaḥ 05

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
nyūho nāma smṛto mleccho viṣṇumohaṃ tadākarot ..
tadā prasanno bhagavāṃstasya vaṃśaḥ pravarddhitaḥ ..2..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
न्यूहो नाम स्मृतो म्लेच्छो विष्णुमोहं तदाकरोत् ..
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवांस्तस्य वंशः प्रवर्द्धितः ..2..
text_mt: Sūta said: / The mleccha named Nyūha then performed devotion to Viṣṇu; / then the Blessed One was pleased, [and] his lineage increased.

sanskrit_iast:
mlecchabhāṣā kṛtā tena vedavākyaparāṅmukhā ..
kaleśca vṛddhaye brāhmīṃ bhāṣāṃ kṛtvā'paśabdagām ... 3 ..
meaning:
म्लेच्छभाषा कृता तेन वेदवाक्यपराङ्मुखा ..
कलेश्च वृद्धये ब्राह्मीं भाषां कृत्वाऽपशब्दगाम् ... 3 ..
text_mt: A mleccha language turned away from the words of the Veda was made by him; / and having turned the sacred language into corrupt speech for the growth of the Kali [age],

sanskrit_iast:
nyūhāya dattavāndevo buddhīśo buddhigaḥ svayam ..
vilomaṃ ca kṛtaṃ nāma nyūhena trisutasya vai .. 4 ..
meaning:
न्यूहाय दत्तवान्देवो बुद्धीशो बुद्धिगः स्वयम् ..
विलोमं च कृतं नाम न्यूहेन त्रिसुतस्य वै .. 4 ..
text_mt: the god himself, the lord of intellect who abides in intellect, gave it to Nyūha. / And reverse names were indeed made by Nyūha for his three sons:

sanskrit_iast:
simaśca hāmaśca tathā yākūto nāma viśrutaḥ ..
yākūtaḥ saptaputraśca jumro mājūja eva saḥ ..5..
meaning:
सिमश्च हामश्च तथा याकूतो नाम विश्रुतः ..
याकूतः सप्तपुत्रश्च जुम्रो माजूज एव सः ..5..
text_mt: Sima and Hāma, and the renowned one named Yākūta. / And Yākūta had seven sons: Jumra, and that very Mājūja,

sanskrit_iast:
mādī tathā ca yūnānastūvalomasakastathā ..
tīrāsaśca tathā teṣāṃ nāmabhirdeśa ucyate ..6..
meaning:
मादी तथा च यूनानस्तूवलोमसकस्तथा ..
तीरासश्च तथा तेषां नामभिर्देश उच्यते ..6..
text_mt: Mādī, and likewise Yūnāna, Tūvala, Masaka, / and likewise Tīrāsa; lands are named after their names.

sanskrit_iast:
jumrā daśa kanābjaśca riphataśca tajarrumaḥ ..
tannāmnā ca smṛtā deśā yūnādyā ye sutāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
जुम्रा दश कनाब्जश्च रिफतश्च तजर्रुमः ..
तन्नाम्ना च स्मृता देशा यूनाद्या ये सुताः स्मृताः .. 7 ..
text_mt: From Jumra were Kanābja, Riphata, and Tajarruma; / and lands are named after their names; those who are remembered as sons from Yūna onwards

sanskrit_iast:
ilīśastaralīśaśca kittīhūdānirucyate ..
caturbhirnāmabhirdeśāsteṣāṃ teṣāṃ pracakrire .. .. 8 ..
meaning:
इलीशस्तरलीशश्च कित्तीहूदानिरुच्यते ..
चतुर्भिर्नामभिर्देशास्तेषां तेषां प्रचक्रिरे .. .. 8 ..
text_mt: are called Ilīśa, Taralīśa, and Kittīhūdāni; / regions were designated for each of them after their four names.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyatanayāddhāmātsutāścatvāra eva te ..
kuśo miśraśca kūjaśca kanaāṃstatra nāmabhiḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
द्वितीयतनयाद्धामात्सुताश्चत्वार एव ते ..
कुशो मिश्रश्च कूजश्च कनआंस्तत्र नामभिः .. 9 ..
text_mt: From the second son, Hāma, there were four sons indeed: / Kuśa, Miśra, Kūja, and Kanaāṃ; by their names

sanskrit_iast:
deśāḥ prasiddhā mlecchānāṃ kuśātṣaṭtanayāḥ smṛtāḥ ..
sa vā caiva havīlaśca sarvatoragamastathā .. 3.1.5.10 ..
meaning:
देशाः प्रसिद्धा म्लेच्छानां कुशात्षट्तनयाः स्मृताः ..
स वा चैव हवीलश्च सर्वतोरगमस्तथा .. 3.1.5.10 ..
text_mt: renowned lands of the mlecchas [are known]. Six sons are remembered from Kuśa: / Savā, Havīla, and Sarvatoragama,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā savatikā nāma nimarūho mahābalaḥ ..
teṣāṃ putrāśca kalanaḥ siṃnāroraka ucyate .. 11 ..
meaning:
तथा सवतिका नाम निमरूहो महाबलः ..
तेषां पुत्राश्च कलनः सिंनारोरक उच्यते .. 11 ..
text_mt: and the one named Savatikā, and the mighty Nimarūha. / And their sons are called Kalana, Siṃnāra, and Uraka,

sanskrit_iast:
akkado vāvunaścaiva rasanādeśakāśca te ..
śrāvayitvā munīnsūto yoganidrāvaśaṃ gataḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
अक्कदो वावुनश्चैव रसनादेशकाश्च ते ..
श्रावयित्वा मुनीन्सूतो योगनिद्रावशं गतः .. 12 ..
text_mt: and Akkada, Vāvuna, and Rasanādeśaka. / Having recited [this] to the sages, the Sūta succumbed to the power of yogic sleep.

sanskrit_iast:
dvisahasre śatābdānte buddhvā punarathābravīta ..
simavaṃśaṃ pravakṣyāmi simo jyeṣṭhaḥ sa bhūpatiḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
द्विसहस्रे शताब्दान्ते बुद्ध्वा पुनरथाब्रवीत ..
सिमवंशं प्रवक्ष्यामि सिमो ज्येष्ठः स भूपतिः .. 13 ..
text_mt: Awakening at the end of two thousand and one hundred years, he then spoke again: / I shall describe the lineage of Sima. Sima was the eldest, a king.

sanskrit_iast:
rājyaṃ paṃcaśataṃ varṣaṃ tena mlecchena satkṛtam ..
arkansadastasya sutaścatustriṃśacca rājyakam .. 14 ..
meaning:
राज्यं पंचशतं वर्षं तेन म्लेच्छेन सत्कृतम् ..
अर्कन्सदस्तस्य सुतश्चतुस्त्रिंशच्च राज्यकम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: A reign of five hundred years was upheld by that mleccha; / Arkansada was his son, and [his] kingdom was thirty-four [years].

sanskrit_iast:
catuśśataṃ punarjñeyaṃ siṃhastattanayo'bhavat ..
rājyaṃ tasya smṛtaṃ tatra ṣaṣṭyuttara catuḥ śatam .. 15 ..
meaning:
चतुश्शतं पुनर्ज्ञेयं सिंहस्तत्तनयोऽभवत् ..
राज्यं तस्य स्मृतं तत्र षष्ट्युत्तर चतुः शतम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: Four hundred [years] more should be known; Siṃha became his son; / his reign there is remembered as four hundred and sixty [years].

sanskrit_iast:
ivratasya suto jñeyaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
phalajastasya tanayaścatvāriṃśaddvayaṃ śatam .. 16 ..
meaning:
इव्रतस्य सुतो ज्ञेयः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ..
फलजस्तस्य तनयश्चत्वारिंशद्द्वयं शतम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: The son of Ivrata should be known to have held the status equal to his father; / Phalaja was his son; two hundred and forty [years]

sanskrit_iast:
rājyaṃ kṛtaṃ tu tasmācca raū nāma sutaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
saptatriṃśacca dviśataṃ tasya rājyaṃ prakīrtitam .. 17 ..
meaning:
राज्यं कृतं तु तस्माच्च रऊ नाम सुतः स्मृतः ..
सप्तत्रिंशच्च द्विशतं तस्य राज्यं प्रकीर्तितम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: was the rule made [by him]; and from him a son named Raū is remembered; / two hundred and thirty-seven [years] is proclaimed as his reign.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmācca jūja utpannaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
nahūrastasya tanayo vayaḥ ṣaṣṭyuttaraṃ śatam ..
rājyaṃ cakāra nṛpatirbahuśatrūnvihiṃsayan .. 18 ..
meaning:
तस्माच्च जूज उत्पन्नः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ..
नहूरस्तस्य तनयो वयः षष्ट्युत्तरं शतम् ..
राज्यं चकार नृपतिर्बहुशत्रून्विहिंसयन् .. 18 ..
text_mt: And from him Jūja was born; he held the status equal to his father; / Nahūra was his son; his life was one hundred and sixty [years]; / destroying many enemies, the king ruled.

sanskrit_iast:
tāharastasya tanayaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
tasmātputro'virāmaśca nahūro hāranastrayaḥ .. 19..
meaning:
ताहरस्तस्य तनयः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ..
तस्मात्पुत्रोऽविरामश्च नहूरो हारनस्त्रयः .. 19..
text_mt: Tāhara was his son; he held the status equal to his father; / from him came three sons: Avirāma, Nahūra, and Hārana.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ teṣāṃ smṛtā vaṃśā nāmamātreṇa kīrtitāḥ ..
sarasvatyāśca śāpena mlecchabhāṣā mahādhamāḥ .. 3.1.5.20 ..
meaning:
एवं तेषां स्मृता वंशा नाममात्रेण कीर्तिताः ..
सरस्वत्याश्च शापेन म्लेच्छभाषा महाधमाः .. 3.1.5.20 ..
text_mt: Thus their lineages are remembered, proclaimed by mere name; / and by the curse of Sarasvatī, the most degraded mleccha languages [arose].

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ vṛddhiḥ kalau cāsītsaṃkṣepeṇa prakīrtitā ..
saṃskṛtasyaiva vāṇī tu bhārataṃ varṣamūhyatām .. 21 ..
meaning:
तेषां वृद्धिः कलौ चासीत्संक्षेपेण प्रकीर्तिता ..
संस्कृतस्यैव वाणी तु भारतं वर्षमूह्यताम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: Their growth occurred in the Kali age, proclaimed in brief; / let the speech of Sanskrit alone be considered as [belonging to] the realm of Bhārata.

sanskrit_iast:
anyakhaṃḍe gatā saiva mlecchā hyānaṃdino'bhavan ..
evaṃ te vipra kathitaṃ viṣṇubhaktadvijaissaha .. 22 .. ..
meaning:
अन्यखंडे गता सैव म्लेच्छा ह्यानंदिनोऽभवन् ..
एवं ते विप्र कथितं विष्णुभक्तद्विजैस्सह .. 22 .. ..
text_mt: When that same [speech] went to other lands, the mlecchas indeed became joyful; / thus has it been told to you, O brāhmaṇa, along with the twice-born devotees of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
.. vyāsa uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā munayassarve viśālāyāṃ nivāsinaḥ ..
naraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ saṃpūjya vinayānvitāḥ ..23..
meaning:
.. व्यास उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा मुनयस्सर्वे विशालायां निवासिनः ..
नरं नारायणं देवं संपूज्य विनयान्विताः ..23..
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Having heard that, all the sages dwelling in Viśālā, / having worshipped the god Nara-Nārāyaṇa with modesty,

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānaṃ cakrurmudā yuktā dviśataṃ parivatsarān ..
tatpaścādbodhitāssarve śaunakādyā munīśvarāḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
ध्यानं चक्रुर्मुदा युक्ता द्विशतं परिवत्सरान् ..
तत्पश्चाद्बोधितास्सर्वे शौनकाद्या मुनीश्वराः .. 24 ..
text_mt: meditated with joy for two hundred years. / Afterwards, all the great sages Śaunaka and the others, having awakened,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyātarpaṇadevārcāḥ kṛtvā dhyātvā janārddanam ..
lomaharṣaṇamāsīnaṃ papracchurvinayānvitāḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
संध्यातर्पणदेवार्चाः कृत्वा ध्यात्वा जनार्द्दनम् ..
लोमहर्षणमासीनं पप्रच्छुर्विनयान्विताः .. 25 ..
text_mt: having performed the twilight prayers, water-libations, and deity worship, and having meditated on Janārdana, / asked Lomaharṣaṇa who was seated, filled with humility:

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsaśiṣya mahābhāga ciraṃ jīva mahāmate ..
sāṃprataṃ vartate yo vai rājā tanme vada prabho .. 26 ..
meaning:
व्यासशिष्य महाभाग चिरं जीव महामते ..
सांप्रतं वर्तते यो वै राजा तन्मे वद प्रभो .. 26 ..
text_mt: O disciple of Vyāsa, highly fortunate, live long, O highly wise one! / Tell me, O lord, who indeed is the king who exists at present?

sanskrit_iast:
..sūta uvāca .. ..
trisahasrābdasaṃprāpte kalau bhārgavanaṃdana ..
āvante śaṃkhanāmā'sau sāṃprataṃ vartate nṛpaḥ ..27..
meaning:
..सूत उवाच .. ..
त्रिसहस्राब्दसंप्राप्ते कलौ भार्गवनंदन ..
आवन्ते शंखनामाऽसौ सांप्रतं वर्तते नृपः ..27..
text_mt: Sūta said: / When three thousand years have arrived in the Kali [age], O son of Bhṛgu, / that king named Śaṅkha exists at present in Avanti.

sanskrit_iast:
mlecchadeśe śakapatiratha rājyaṃ karoti vai ..
śṛṇu tatkāraṇaṃ sarve yathā yasya vivardhanam .. 28 ..
meaning:
म्लेच्छदेशे शकपतिरथ राज्यं करोति वै ..
शृणु तत्कारणं सर्वे यथा यस्य विवर्धनम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Now in the mleccha land the lord of the Śakas indeed rules; / all of you listen to the reason for that, how each experienced growth.

sanskrit_iast:
dvisahasre kalau prāpte mlecchavaṃśavivarddhitā ..
bhūmirmlecchamayī sarvā nānāpathavivarddhitā..29..
meaning:
द्विसहस्रे कलौ प्राप्ते म्लेच्छवंशविवर्द्धिता ..
भूमिर्म्लेच्छमयी सर्वा नानापथविवर्द्धिता..29..
text_mt: When two thousand [years] arrived in the Kali [age], the earth was multiplied by lineages of mlecchas; / it was all full of mlecchas, expanded with diverse doctrines,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāvartamṛte tatra sarasvatyāstaṭaṃ śubham ..
mlecchācāryaśca mūśākhyastanmataiḥ pūritaṃ jagat .. 3.1.5.30 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मावर्तमृते तत्र सरस्वत्यास्तटं शुभम् ..
म्लेच्छाचार्यश्च मूशाख्यस्तन्मतैः पूरितं जगत् .. 3.1.5.30 ..
text_mt: except Brahmāvarta, there on the auspicious bank of the Sarasvatī. / And there was a mleccha teacher named Mūśā; the world was filled with his teachings.

sanskrit_iast:
devārcanaṃ vedabhāṣā naṣṭā prāpte kalau yuge ..
tallakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu mune mlecchabhāṣāścaturvidhāḥ .. 31..
meaning:
देवार्चनं वेदभाषा नष्टा प्राप्ते कलौ युगे ..

बलभद्रस्तदा तुष्टो यज्ञभावेन भावितः ..
शिशुनागः क्रतोर्जातो बलभद्रांशसंभवः ..26..
text_mt: Balabhadra, pleased at that time, being gratified by the disposition of the sacrifice, / Śiśunāga was born from the sacrifice as an incarnation of a portion of Balabhadra.

sanskrit_iast:
śatavarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ kākavarmā suto'bhavat ..
tadrājyaṃ navativarṣaṃ kṣemadharmā tato'bhavat .. 27 ..
meaning:
शतवर्षं कृतं राज्यं काकवर्मा सुतोऽभवत् ..
तद्राज्यं नवतिवर्षं क्षेमधर्मा ततोऽभवत् .. 27 ..
text_mt: His rule was carried on for a hundred years; Kākavarmā was his son. / His reign was ninety years; after him came Kṣemadharmā.

sanskrit_iast:
aśītivarṣaṃ rājyaṃ tatkṣetraujāstatsuto'bhavat ..
daśahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ vedamiśrastato'bhavat .. 28 ..
meaning:
अशीतिवर्षं राज्यं तत्क्षेत्रौजास्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ..
दशहीनं कृतं राज्यं वेदमिश्रस्ततोऽभवत् .. 28 ..
text_mt: His reign was eighty years; Kṣetraujas was his son. / The rule was carried on for ten less; after him came Vedamiśra.

sanskrit_iast:
daśahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tato'jātaripussutaḥ ..
daśahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ darbhakastanayo'bhavat .. 29 ..
meaning:
दशहीनं कृतं राज्यं ततोऽजातरिपुस्सुतः ..
दशहीनं कृतं राज्यं दर्भकस्तनयोऽभवत् .. 29 ..
text_mt: The rule was carried on for ten less; then Ajātaripu was his son. / The rule was carried on for ten less; Darbhaka was his son.

sanskrit_iast:
daśahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamudayāśvastato'bhavat ..
daśahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ naṃdavardhana eva tat .. 3.1.6.30 ..
meaning:
दशहीनं कृतं राज्यमुदयाश्वस्ततोऽभवत् ..
दशहीनं कृतं राज्यं नंदवर्धन एव तत् .. 3.1.6.30 ..
text_mt: The rule was carried on for ten less; after him was Udayāśva. / The rule was carried on for ten less, and that was Nandavardhana.

sanskrit_iast:
daśahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmānnaṃdasuto'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śūdrīgarbhasamudbhavaḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
दशहीनं कृतं राज्यं तस्मान्नंदसुतोऽभवत् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं शूद्रीगर्भसमुद्भवः .. 31 ..
text_mt: The rule was carried on for ten less; from him was born Nanda, his son. / The rule was carried on equal to his father's; he was born from the womb of a Śūdra woman.

sanskrit_iast:
nandājjātaḥ pranandaśca daśavarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
tasmājātaḥ parānandaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 32 ..
meaning:
नन्दाज्जातः प्रनन्दश्च दशवर्षं कृतं पदम् ..
तस्माजातः परानन्दः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: From Nanda was born Prananda, and he held office for ten years; / from him was born Parānanda, and he held office equal to his father.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmājjātassamānaṃdo viṃśadvarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
tasmājātaḥ priyānaṃdaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 33 ..
meaning:
तस्माज्जातस्समानंदो विंशद्वर्षं कृतं पदम् ..
तस्माजातः प्रियानंदः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: From him was born Samānanda, who held office for twenty years; / from him was born Priyānanda, who held office equal to his father.

sanskrit_iast:
devānaṃdastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
yajñabhaṃgaḥ sutastasmātpiturarddhaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 34..
meaning:
देवानंदस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ..
यज्ञभंगः सुतस्तस्मात्पितुरर्द्धं कृतं पदम् .. 34..
text_mt: Devānanda was his son, who held office equal to his father; / Yajñabhaṅga was the son after him, who held office for half his father's time.

sanskrit_iast:
mauryānaṃdastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
mahānandastato jātaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 35 ..
meaning:
मौर्यानंदस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ..
महानन्दस्ततो जातः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: Mauryānanda was his son, who held office equal to his father; / Mahānanda was born after him, who held office equal to his father.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu kalinā saṃsmṛto hariḥ ..
kāśyapādudbhavo devo gautamo nāma viśrutaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु कलिना संस्मृतो हरिः ..
काश्यपादुद्भवो देवो गौतमो नाम विश्रुतः .. 36 ..
text_mt: At that very time, Hari was remembered by Kali; / a divine being was born from Kāśyapa, celebrated by the name Gautama.

sanskrit_iast:
bauddhadharmaṃ ca saṃskatya paṭṭaṇe prāptavānhariḥ ..
daśavarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmācchākyamuniḥ smṛtaḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
बौद्धधर्मं च संस्कत्य पट्टणे प्राप्तवान्हरिः ..
दशवर्षं कृतं राज्यं तस्माच्छाक्यमुनिः स्मृतः .. 37 ..
text_mt: And refining the Buddhist religion, Hari arrived in Paṭṭaṇa; / his rule was carried on for ten years; from him is remembered Śākyamuni.

sanskrit_iast:
viṃśadvarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmācchuddhodano'bhavat ..
triṃśadvarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śākya siṃhastato'bhavat .. 38 ..
meaning:
विंशद्वर्षं कृतं राज्यं तस्माच्छुद्धोदनोऽभवत् ..
त्रिंशद्वर्षं कृतं राज्यं शाक्य सिंहस्ततोऽभवत् .. 38 ..
text_mt: For twenty years he ruled, and from him arose Śuddhodana. / For thirty years he ruled, and from him then arose Śākyasiṃha.

sanskrit_iast:
śatādrau dvisahasre'bde vyatīte so'bhavannṛpaḥ ..
kaleḥ prathamacaraṇe vedamārgo vināśitaḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
शताद्रौ द्विसहस्रेऽब्दे व्यतीते सोऽभवन्नृपः ..
कलेः प्रथमचरणे वेदमार्गो विनाशितः .. 39 ..
text_mt: When two thousand one hundred years had passed, he became king. / In the first quarter of the Kali [age], the path of the Vedas was destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭivarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sarvabauddhā narāḥ smṛtāḥ..
nareṣu viṣṇurnṛpatiryathā rājā tathā prajāḥ..3.1.6.40..
meaning:
षष्टिवर्षं कृतं राज्यं सर्वबौद्धा नराः स्मृताः..
नरेषु विष्णुर्नृपतिर्यथा राजा तथा प्रजाः..3.1.6.40..
text_mt: For sixty years he ruled, and all men were considered Buddhists. / Among men, the king is Viṣṇu; as is the king, so are the subjects.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇorvīryānusāreṇa jagaddharmaḥ pravarttate ..
tasminharau ye śaraṇaṃ prāptā māyāpatau narāḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
विष्णोर्वीर्यानुसारेण जगद्धर्मः प्रवर्त्तते ..
तस्मिन्हरौ ये शरणं प्राप्ता मायापतौ नराः .. 41 ..
text_mt: In accordance with the power of Viṣṇu, universal order operates. / The men who have taken refuge in that Hari, the lord of Māyā,

sanskrit_iast:
api pāpasamācārā mokṣavaṃtaḥ prakīrtitāḥ ..
śakyasiṃhādbuddhasiṃhaḥ piturarthaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 42 ..
meaning:
अपि पापसमाचारा मोक्षवंतः प्रकीर्तिताः ..
शक्यसिंहाद्बुद्धसिंहः पितुरर्थं कृतं पदम् .. 42 ..
text_mt: even if of sinful conduct, are declared to attain liberation. / From Śākyasiṃha came Buddhasiṃha; he held the station for his father's duration.

sanskrit_iast:
caṃdraguptastasya sutaḥ paurasā dhipateḥ sutām ..
sulūvasya tathodvāhya yāvanībauddhatatparaḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
चंद्रगुप्तस्तस्य सुतः पौरसा धिपतेः सुताम् ..
सुलूवस्य तथोद्वाह्य यावनीबौद्धतत्परः .. 43 ..
text_mt: Candragupta was his son; having married the daughter of Sulūva, / the ruler of the Paurasas, he was devoted to the Yavana Buddhist [doctrine].

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭivarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ biṃdusārastato'bhavat ..
pitṛstulya kṛtaṃ rājyamaśokastanayo'bhavat ..44..
meaning:
षष्टिवर्षं कृतं राज्यं बिंदुसारस्ततोऽभवत् ..
पितृस्तुल्य कृतं राज्यमशोकस्तनयोऽभवत् ..44..
text_mt: For sixty years he ruled, and then arose Bindusāra. / He ruled equal [in years] to his father, and Aśoka became his son.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu kānyakubjo dvijottamaḥ ..
arbudaṃ śikharaṃ prāpya brahmahomamathākarot ..45..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु कान्यकुब्जो द्विजोत्तमः ..
अर्बुदं शिखरं प्राप्य ब्रह्महोममथाकरोत् ..45..
text_mt: At that very time, a foremost twice-born of Kānyakubja, / having reached the peak of Arbuda, then performed a brahma-fire sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
vedamaṃtraprabhāvācca jātāścatvāri kṣatriyāḥ ..
pramarassāmavedī ca capahāniryajurvidaḥ..46..
meaning:
वेदमंत्रप्रभावाच्च जाताश्चत्वारि क्षत्रियाः ..
प्रमरस्सामवेदी च चपहानिर्यजुर्विदः..46..
text_mt: And by the power of the Vedic mantras, four kṣatriyas were born: / Pramara, knower of the Sāmaveda, and Capahāni, knower of the Yajurveda;

sanskrit_iast:
trivedī ca tathā śuklotharvā sa parihārakaḥ ..
airāvatakule jātāngajānāruhya te pṛthak ..47..
meaning:
त्रिवेदी च तथा शुक्लोथर्वा स परिहारकः ..
ऐरावतकुले जातान्गजानारुह्य ते पृथक् ..47..
text_mt: and likewise Śukla, knower of the three Vedas, and Parihāra, follower of the Atharva[veda]. / Having separately mounted elephants born of the lineage of Airāvata,

sanskrit_iast:
aśokaṃ svavaśaṃ cakussarve bauddhā vināśitāḥ ..
caturlakṣāḥ smṛtā bauddhāḥ divyaśastraiḥ prahāritāḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
अशोकं स्ववशं चकुस्सर्वे बौद्धा विनाशिताः ..
चतुर्लक्षाः स्मृता बौद्धाः दिव्यशस्त्रैः प्रहारिताः .. 48 ..
text_mt: they brought Aśoka under their control, and all the Buddhists were destroyed. / Four hundred thousand Buddhists, it is remembered, were struck down with divine weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
avante pramaro bhūpaścaturyojanavistṛtām ..
ambāvatīṃ nāma purīmadhyāsya sukhito'bhavat .. 49 ..
meaning:
अवन्ते प्रमरो भूपश्चतुर्योजनविस्तृताम् ..
अम्बावतीं नाम पुरीमध्यास्य सुखितोऽभवत् .. 49 ..
text_mt: In Avanti, King Pramara, occupying the city named Ambāvatī, / four yojanas wide, became joyful.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
citrakūṭagirerdeśe parihāro mahīpatiḥ ..
kaliṃjarapuraṃ ramyamakrośāyatanaṃ smṛtam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
चित्रकूटगिरेर्देशे परिहारो महीपतिः ..
कलिंजरपुरं रम्यमक्रोशायतनं स्मृतम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / In the region of Mount Citrakūṭa, King Parihāra, / [occupying] the charming city of Kaliñjara, remembered as extending across a krośa,
title: Kaliyugasaṃbhūtaraviśaśivaṃśabhūpavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
adhyāsya bauddhahaṃtā sa sukhitobhavadūrjitaḥ ..
rājaputrākhyadeśe ca capahānirmahīpatiḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
अध्यास्य बौद्धहंता स सुखितोभवदूर्जितः ..
राजपुत्राख्यदेशे च चपहानिर्महीपतिः .. 2 ..
text_mt: occupying [it], that slayer of Buddhists became happy and mighty. / And in the region called Rājaputra, King Capahāni,

sanskrit_iast:
ajamerapuraṃ ramyaṃ vidhiśobhāsamanvitam ..
cāturvarṇyayutaṃ divyamadhyāsya sukhito'bhavat .. 3 ..
meaning:
अजमेरपुरं रम्यं विधिशोभासमन्वितम् ..
चातुर्वर्ण्ययुतं दिव्यमध्यास्य सुखितोऽभवत् .. 3 ..
text_mt: occupying the charming and splendid city of Ajamere, endowed with proper beauty / and inhabited by the four castes, became happy.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklo nāma mahīpālo gata ānarta'maṃḍale ..
dvārakāṃ nāma nagarīmadhyāsya sukhito'bhavat .. 4 .. .
meaning:
शुक्लो नाम महीपालो गत आनर्तऽमंडले ..
द्वारकां नाम नगरीमध्यास्य सुखितोऽभवत् .. 4 .. .
text_mt: The king named Śukla went to the territory of Ānarta; / occupying the city named Dvārakā, he became happy.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śaunaka uvāca ..
teṣāmagnyudbhavānāṃ ca ye bhūpā rājyasatkṛtāḥ ..
tānme brūhi mahābhāga sūto vākyamathābravīt .. 5 ..
meaning:
.. शौनक उवाच ..
तेषामग्न्युद्भवानां च ये भूपा राज्यसत्कृताः ..
तान्मे ब्रूहि महाभाग सूतो वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Śaunaka said: / Those kings who were born from the fire and honoured with kingship— / tell me of them, O fortunate one! Thereupon Sūta spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
gacchadhvaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ sarve yoganidrāvaśo hyaham ..
tacchutvā munayaḥ sarve viṣṇordhyānaṃ pracakrire .. 6 ..
meaning:
गच्छध्वं ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे योगनिद्रावशो ह्यहम् ..
तच्छुत्वा मुनयः सर्वे विष्णोर्ध्यानं प्रचक्रिरे .. 6 ..
text_mt: "Go, all you brāhmaṇas, for I am overcome by yogic sleep." / Hearing that, all the sages engaged in meditation on Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇe dve ca sahasrānte sūto vacanamabravīt ..
saptatriṃśaśate varṣe daśābde cādhike kalau .. 7 ..
meaning:
पूर्णे द्वे च सहस्रान्ते सूतो वचनमब्रवीत् ..
सप्तत्रिंशशते वर्षे दशाब्दे चाधिके कलौ .. 7 ..
text_mt: When two thousand [years] were fully completed, Sūta spoke these words: / "In the thirty-seventh century and ten years further into the Kali [age],

sanskrit_iast:
pramaro nāma bhūpālaḥ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ ca ṣaṭsamāḥ..
mahāmadastato jātaḥ piturardhaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..8..
meaning:
प्रमरो नाम भूपालः कृतं राज्यं च षट्समाः..
महामदस्ततो जातः पितुरर्धं कृतं पदम् ..8..
text_mt: the king named Pramara ruled for six years. / From him Mahāmada was born; he held the station for half [the time of] his father.

sanskrit_iast:
devāpistanayastasya pitu stulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
devadūtastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ smṛtaṃ padam .. 9 ..
meaning:
देवापिस्तनयस्तस्य पितु स्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ..
देवदूतस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं स्मृतं पदम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Devāpi was his son; he held the station equal to his father. / Devadūta was his son; his station is remembered as equal to his father's.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādgaṃdharvasenaśca paṃcāśadabdabhūpadam ..
kṛtvā ca svasutaṃ śaṃkhamabhiṣicya vanaṃ gataḥ .. 3.1.7.10 ..
meaning:
तस्माद्गंधर्वसेनश्च पंचाशदब्दभूपदम् ..
कृत्वा च स्वसुतं शंखमभिषिच्य वनं गतः .. 3.1.7.10 ..
text_mt: From him came Gandharvasena; having held the station of king for fifty years / and having anointed his own son Śaṅkha, he went to the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkhena tatpadaṃ prāptaṃ rājyaṃ triṃśatsamāḥ kṛtam ..
devāṃganā vīramatī śakreṇa preṣitā tadā .. 11 ..
meaning:
शंखेन तत्पदं प्राप्तं राज्यं त्रिंशत्समाः कृतम् ..
देवांगना वीरमती शक्रेण प्रेषिता तदा .. 11 ..
text_mt: That station was obtained by Śaṅkha, and he ruled for thirty years. / Then the celestial maiden Vīramatī was sent by Śakra;

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃdharvasenaṃ saṃprāpya putraratnamajījanat ..
sutasya janmakāle tu nabhasaḥ puṣpavṛṣṭayaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
गंधर्वसेनं संप्राप्य पुत्ररत्नमजीजनत् ..
सुतस्य जन्मकाले तु नभसः पुष्पवृष्टयः .. 12 ..
text_mt: having approached Gandharvasena, she gave birth to a jewel of a son. / At the time of the son's birth, showers of flowers fell from the sky,

sanskrit_iast:
peturduṃdubhayo nedurvāṃti vātāḥ sukhapradāḥ ..
śivadṛṣṭirdvijo nāma śiṣyaissārddhaṃ vanaṃ gataḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
पेतुर्दुंदुभयो नेदुर्वांति वाताः सुखप्रदाः ..
शिवदृष्टिर्द्विजो नाम शिष्यैस्सार्द्धं वनं गतः .. 13 ..
text_mt: war drums sounded, and delightful breezes blew. / A twice-born named Śivadṛṣṭi went to the forest together with his disciples;

sanskrit_iast:
viṃśadbhiḥ karmayogaṃ ca samārādhya śivo'bhavat ..
pūrṇe triṃśacchate varṣe kalau prāpte bhayaṃkare .. 14 ..
meaning:
विंशद्भिः कर्मयोगं च समाराध्य शिवोऽभवत् ..
पूर्णे त्रिंशच्छते वर्षे कलौ प्राप्ते भयंकरे .. 14 ..
text_mt: having fully practised the yoga of action for twenty [years], he became Śiva. / When thirty centuries were completed and the terrible Kali [age] arrived,
