.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
bhagavansarvatīrthānāṃ dānānāṃ kiṃ paraṃ smṛtam ..
yatkṛtvā ca kalau ghore parāṃ nirvṛtimāpnuyāt .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
भगवन्सर्वतीर्थानां दानानां किं परं स्मृतम् ..
यत्कृत्वा च कलौ घोरे परां निर्वृतिमाप्नुयात् .. 1 ..
text_mt: The sages said: / "O blessed one, what is remembered as the highest of all sacred fords and gifts, / by doing which in the terrible Kali [age] one may attain supreme beatitude?"
title: adhyāyaḥ 31

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
sāmanasya sutaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pāṇinirnāma viśrutaḥ ..
kaṇabhugvaraśiṣyaiśca śāstrajñaiḥ sa parājitaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
सामनस्य सुतः श्रेष्ठः पाणिनिर्नाम विश्रुतः ..
कणभुग्वरशिष्यैश्च शास्त्रज्ञैः स पराजितः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / "There was an excellent son of Sāmana, celebrated by the name of Pāṇini; / he was defeated by the excellent disciples of Kaṇabhuj who were knowledgeable in the śāstras.

sanskrit_iast:
lajjitaḥ pāṇinistatra gatastīrthāntaraṃ prati ..
snātvā sarvāṇi tīrthāni saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ ..3..
meaning:
लज्जितः पाणिनिस्तत्र गतस्तीर्थान्तरं प्रति ..
स्नात्वा सर्वाणि तीर्थानि संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः ..3..
text_mt: Ashamed, Pāṇini then went towards various sacred fords. / Having bathed at all the sacred fords and gratified the ancestors and the deities,

sanskrit_iast:
kedāramudakaṃ pītvā śivadhyānaparo'bhavat ..
parṇāśī saptadivasāñjalabhakṣastato'bhavat .. 4 ..
meaning:
केदारमुदकं पीत्वा शिवध्यानपरोऽभवत् ..
पर्णाशी सप्तदिवसाञ्जलभक्षस्ततोऽभवत् .. 4 ..
text_mt: and having drunk the water of Kedāra, he became intent on meditating upon Śiva. / For seven days he fed on leaves, and then he fed on water.

sanskrit_iast:
tato daśadinānte sa vāyubhakṣo daśāhani ..
aṣṭāviṃśaddine rudro varaṃ brūhi vaco'bravīt .. 5 ..
meaning:
ततो दशदिनान्ते स वायुभक्षो दशाहनि ..
अष्टाविंशद्दिने रुद्रो वरं ब्रूहि वचोऽब्रवीत् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Then, after ten days, he fed on air for ten days. / On the twenty-eighth day, Rudra spoke the word: 'Choose a boon!'

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvāmṛtamayaṃ vākyamastaudgadgadayā girā ..
sarveśaṃ sarvaliṃgeśaṃ girijāvallabhaṃ haram .. 6..
meaning:
श्रुत्वामृतमयं वाक्यमस्तौद्गद्गदया गिरा ..
सर्वेशं सर्वलिंगेशं गिरिजावल्लभं हरम् .. 6..
text_mt: Hearing that speech full of nectar, with a choked voice he praised / Hara, the lord of all, the lord of all liṅgas, the beloved of the mountain's daughter.

sanskrit_iast:
.. pāṇiniruvāca .. ..
namo rudrāya mahate sarveśāya hitaiṣiṇe ..
nandīsaṃsthāya devāya vidyābhayakarāya ca .. 7 ..
meaning:
.. पाणिनिरुवाच .. ..
नमो रुद्राय महते सर्वेशाय हितैषिणे ..
नन्दीसंस्थाय देवाय विद्याभयकराय च .. 7 ..
text_mt: Pāṇini said: / 'Homage to great Rudra, the lord of all, who wishes well, / to the god who resides on Nandin, who grants knowledge and freedom from fear;

sanskrit_iast:
pāpāntakāya bhargāya namonantāya vedhase ..
namo māyāhareśāya namaste lokaśaṃkara .. 8 ..
meaning:
पापान्तकाय भर्गाय नमोनन्ताय वेधसे ..
नमो मायाहरेशाय नमस्ते लोकशंकर .. 8 ..
text_mt: to Bharga, the destroyer of sins; homage to the infinite creator; / homage to the lord who removes delusion; homage to you, O benefactor of the world!

sanskrit_iast:
yadi prasanno deveśa vidyāmūlaprado bhava ..
paraṃ tīrthaṃ hi me dehi dvaimāturapitarnamaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश विद्यामूलप्रदो भव ..
परं तीर्थं हि मे देहि द्वैमातुरपितर्नमः .. 9 ..
text_mt: If you are pleased, O lord of the gods, grant the root of knowledge; / give me indeed the supreme sacred ford; homage to you, father of the two-mothered one!'

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ...
iti śrutvā mahādevaḥ sūtrāṇi pradadau mudā ..
sarvavarṇamayānyeva aiuṇādiśubhāni vai .. 3.2.31.10 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ...
इति श्रुत्वा महादेवः सूत्राणि प्रददौ मुदा ..
सर्ववर्णमयान्येव ऐउणादिशुभानि वै .. 3.2.31.10 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Hearing this, Mahādeva joyfully gave the sūtras / made of all phonemes, auspicious, beginning with 'a-i-uṇ'.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānahrade satyajale rāga dveṣamalāpahe ..
yaḥ prāpto mānase tīrthe sarvatīrthaphalaṃ bhajet ..11..
meaning:
ज्ञानह्रदे सत्यजले राग द्वेषमलापहे ..
यः प्राप्तो मानसे तीर्थे सर्वतीर्थफलं भजेत् ..11..
text_mt: "He who reaches the mental sacred ford, the lake of knowledge with water of truth / that removes the impurity of passion and hatred, attains the fruit of all sacred fords.

sanskrit_iast:
mānasaṃ hi mahattīrtha brahmadarśanakārakam ..
pāṇine te dadau vipra kṛtakṛtyo bhavānbhava .. 12 ..
meaning:
मानसं हि महत्तीर्थ ब्रह्मदर्शनकारकम् ..
पाणिने ते ददौ विप्र कृतकृत्यो भवान्भव .. 12 ..
text_mt: Indeed, the Mānasa is a great sacred ford that brings about the vision of Brahman. / O brāhmaṇa Pāṇini, I have given it to you; may you have fulfilled your purpose!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvāṃtardadhe rudraḥ pāṇiniḥ svagṛhaṃ yayau ..
sūtrapāṭhaṃ dhātupāṭhaṃ gaṇapāṭhaṃ tathaiva ca .. 13 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वांतर्दधे रुद्रः पाणिनिः स्वगृहं ययौ ..
सूत्रपाठं धातुपाठं गणपाठं तथैव च .. 13 ..
text_mt: Having said this, Rudra vanished; Pāṇini went to his own home. / Composing the Sūtrapāṭha, the Dhātupāṭha, and likewise the Gaṇapāṭha,

sanskrit_iast:
liṃgasūtraṃ tathā kṛtvā paraṃ nirvāṇamāpta vān ..
tasmāttvaṃ bhārgavaśreṣṭha mānasaṃ tīrthamācara .. 14 ..
meaning:
लिंगसूत्रं तथा कृत्वा परं निर्वाणमाप्त वान् ..
तस्मात्त्वं भार्गवश्रेष्ठ मानसं तीर्थमाचर .. 14 ..
text_mt: and likewise the Liṅgasūtra, he attained supreme nirvāṇa. / Therefore, O best of the Bhārgavas, practice the mental sacred ford,

sanskrit_iast:
yato yātā svayaṃ gaṃgā sarvatīrthamayī śivā ..
gaṃgātīrthātparaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhavi ṣyati .. 15 .. ..
meaning:
यतो याता स्वयं गंगा सर्वतीर्थमयी शिवा ..
गंगातीर्थात्परं तीर्थं न भूतं न भवि ष्यति .. 15 .. ..
text_mt: from which Gaṅgā herself, auspicious, embodying all sacred fords, issued. / There has been no sacred ford higher than the Gaṅgā ford, nor will there be.

sanskrit_iast: iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe pratisargaparvaṇi caturyugakhaṇḍāparaparyāye kaliyugīyetihāsasamuccaya ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 31 .. ..
meaning: इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे प्रतिसर्गपर्वणि चतुर्युगखण्डापरपर्याये कलियुगीयेतिहाससमुच्चय एकत्रिंशोऽध्यायः .. 31 .. ..
text_mt: Thus ends the thirty-first chapter in the Kali-era compendium of history, in the section on the four ages, in the Pratisargaparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
totādaryāṃ dvijaḥ kaścidbopadeva iti śrutaḥ ..
babhūva kṛṣṇabhaktaśca vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तोतादर्यां द्विजः कश्चिद्बोपदेव इति श्रुतः ..
बभूव कृष्णभक्तश्च वेदवेदांगपारगः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / At Totādri there was a certain twice-born known as Bopadeva; / he was a devotee of Kṛṣṇa and had mastered the Vedas and their auxiliary sciences.
title: adhyāyaḥ 32

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ gopagopīniṣevitam ..
manasā pūjayāmāsa devadevaṃ janārddanam .. 2 ..
meaning:
गत्वा वृन्दावनं रम्यं गोपगोपीनिषेवितम् ..
मनसा पूजयामास देवदेवं जनार्द्दनम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: Having gone to delightful Vṛndāvana, frequented by cowherds and cowherdesses, / he worshipped in his mind Janārdana, the god of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣānte ca hariḥ sākṣāddadau jñānamanuttamam ..
tena jñānena saṃprāptā hṛdi bhāgavatī kathā .. 3 ..
meaning:
वर्षान्ते च हरिः साक्षाद्ददौ ज्ञानमनुत्तमम् ..
तेन ज्ञानेन संप्राप्ता हृदि भागवती कथा .. 3 ..
text_mt: And at the end of a year, Hari in person bestowed upon him unexcelled knowledge; / by that knowledge, the narrative of the Bhāgavata was received in his heart.

sanskrit_iast:
śukena varṇitā yā vai viṣṇurātāya dhīmate ..
tāṃ kathāṃ varṇayāmāsa mokṣamūrtiṃ sanātanīm .. 4 ..
meaning:
शुकेन वर्णिता या वै विष्णुराताय धीमते ..
तां कथां वर्णयामास मोक्षमूर्तिं सनातनीम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: He described that very narrative, the eternal embodiment of liberation, / which was recounted by Śuka to the wise Viṣṇurāta.

sanskrit_iast:
kathānte bhagavānviṣṇuḥ prādurāsījjanārdanaḥ ..
uvāca snigdhayā vācā varaṃ brūhi mahāmate .. 5 ..
meaning:
कथान्ते भगवान्विष्णुः प्रादुरासीज्जनार्दनः ..
उवाच स्निग्धया वाचा वरं ब्रूहि महामते .. 5 ..
text_mt: At the conclusion of the narrative, the blessed Lord Viṣṇu Janārdana manifested; / he said in an affectionate voice: 'Choose a boon, O noble-minded one!'

sanskrit_iast:
.. bopadeva uvāca .. ..
namaste bhagavanviṣṇo lokānugrahakāraka ..
tvayā tatamidaṃ viśvaṃ devatiryaṅnarādikam .. 6 ..
meaning:
.. बोपदेव उवाच .. ..
नमस्ते भगवन्विष्णो लोकानुग्रहकारक ..
त्वया ततमिदं विश्वं देवतिर्यङ्नरादिकम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Bopadeva said: / 'Homage to you, blessed Viṣṇu, who grant grace to the worlds; / by you this universe—gods, animals, men, and the rest—is pervaded.

sanskrit_iast:
tvannāmnā narakārtāśca te kṛtārthāḥ kalau yuge ..
tvayā dattaṃ bhāgavataṃ śrīma dvyāsena nirmitam ..
māhātmyaṃ tasya me brūhi yadi datto varastvayā .. 7 ..
meaning:
त्वन्नाम्ना नरकार्ताश्च ते कृतार्थाः कलौ युगे ..
त्वया दत्तं भागवतं श्रीम द्व्यासेन निर्मितम् ..
माहात्म्यं तस्य मे ब्रूहि यदि दत्तो वरस्त्वया .. 7 ..
text_mt: By your name, those tormented in hell have achieved their purpose in the Kali age. / You gave the Bhāgavata composed by glorious Vyāsa; / tell me its greatness, if a boon is granted by you.'

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
ekadā bhagavānrudro bhavānyā saha śaṃkaraḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
एकदा भगवान्रुद्रो भवान्या सह शंकरः .. 8 ..
text_mt: The blessed Lord said: / Once the blessed Rudra, Śaṅkara, together with Bhavānī—

sanskrit_iast:
bauddharājye jagatprāpte daṃbhapākhaṇḍanirmite ..
dṛṣṭvā kāśyāṃ bhūmituṃgaṃ praṇanāma mudā yutaḥ ..
jaya saccidānanda vibho jagadānaṃ dakāraka .. 9 ..
meaning:
बौद्धराज्ये जगत्प्राप्ते दंभपाखण्डनिर्मिते ..
दृष्ट्वा काश्यां भूमितुंगं प्रणनाम मुदा युतः ..
जय सच्चिदानन्द विभो जगदानं दकारक .. 9 ..
text_mt: when the world had fallen into the Buddhist kingdom produced by deceit and heresy— / seeing an elevation of ground at Kāśī, bowed down full of joy: / 'Victory to the all-pervading Being-Consciousness-Bliss, who causes bliss to the world!'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā śivā prāha ko devo'sti tavottamaḥ ..
sa hovāca mahādevi yajñaḥ saptāhamatra vai .. 3.2.32.10 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा शिवा प्राह को देवोऽस्ति तवोत्तमः ..
स होवाच महादेवि यज्ञः सप्ताहमत्र वै .. 3.2.32.10 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, Śivā said: 'What god is superior to you?' / He said: 'O great goddess, a seven-day sacrificial rite [was held] here indeed.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādbhūmipavitratvamiha prāptaṃ varānane ..
sarvatīrthādhikatvaṃ ca svayaṃ brahma sanātanam .. 11 ..
meaning:
तस्माद्भूमिपवित्रत्वमिह प्राप्तं वरानने ..
सर्वतीर्थाधिकत्वं च स्वयं ब्रह्म सनातनम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Therefore the sanctity of the ground has been attained here, O fair-faced lady, / as well as superiority over all sacred fords; it is the eternal Brahman itself.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā śivā devī prāptāsīdguhyakālayam ..
rudreṇa sahitā tatra bhūmiśuddhimakārayat .. 12 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा शिवा देवी प्राप्तासीद्गुह्यकालयम् ..
रुद्रेण सहिता तत्र भूमिशुद्धिमकारयत् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, the goddess Śivā went to the abode of the Guhyakas; / together with Rudra, she performed the purification of the ground there.

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍīśaśca gaṇeśaśca naṃdino guha eva ca ..
rakṣārthe sthāpitāstatra devadevena bho dvija .. 13 ..
meaning:
चण्डीशश्च गणेशश्च नंदिनो गुह एव च ..
रक्षार्थे स्थापितास्तत्र देवदेवेन भो द्विज .. 13 ..
text_mt: Caṇḍīśa, Gaṇeśa, the Nandins, and Guha / were established there for protection by the god of gods, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu devi kathāṃ ramyāṃ mama mānasasaṃsthitām ..
ityuktvā dhyānamāsthāya saptāhena svavarṇayat .. 14 ..
meaning:
शृणु देवि कथां रम्यां मम मानससंस्थिताम् ..
इत्युक्त्वा ध्यानमास्थाय सप्ताहेन स्ववर्णयत् .. 14 ..
text_mt: 'Listen, O goddess, to the delightful narrative situated within my mind.' / Having said this and entered into meditation, he described it himself over seven days.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāhe netra unmīlya dṛṣṭvā nidrāgatāṃ śivām ..
bodhayāmāsa bhagavānkathāṃte lokaśaṃkaraḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
अष्टाहे नेत्र उन्मील्य दृष्ट्वा निद्रागतां शिवाम् ..
बोधयामास भगवान्कथांते लोकशंकरः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Opening his eyes on the eighth day and seeing that Śivā had fallen asleep, / the blessed Lord, the benefactor of the world, awakened her at the conclusion of the narrative.

sanskrit_iast:
kiyatī te śrutā gāthā śrutvāha jagadaṃbikā ..
sudhāmaṃthanaparyaṃtaṃ caritraṃ śivayeritam .. 16 ..
meaning:
कियती ते श्रुता गाथा श्रुत्वाह जगदंबिका ..
सुधामंथनपर्यंतं चरित्रं शिवयेरितम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: 'How much of the story did you hear?' Having heard [this], the mother of the universe said: / 'Up to the churning for the nectar of immortality was the deed heard by Śivā.'

sanskrit_iast:
koṭarasthaḥ śukaḥ śrutvā ciraṃjīvatvamāgataḥ ..
pārvatyā rakṣitosau vai śukaḥ paramasundaraḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
कोटरस्थः शुकः श्रुत्वा चिरंजीवत्वमागतः ..
पार्वत्या रक्षितोसौ वै शुकः परमसुन्दरः .. 17 ..
text_mt: A parrot dwelling in a hollow, having heard it, attained immortality; / protected indeed by Pārvatī, that parrot was exceedingly beautiful.

sanskrit_iast:
sthitvā śivasya sadane mama dhyānaparo'bhavat ..
mamājñayā śukaḥ sākṣāttvadīyahṛdayasthitaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
स्थित्वा शिवस्य सदने मम ध्यानपरोऽभवत् ..
ममाज्ञया शुकः साक्षात्त्वदीयहृदयस्थितः .. 18 ..
text_mt: Remaining in the abode of Śiva, he became intent on meditating upon me; / by my command, that very Śuka took his place in your heart.

sanskrit_iast:
tena prāptaṃ bhāgavataṃ māhātmyaṃ cāsya durlabham ..
tvaṃ vai gaṃdharvasenāya pitre vikramabhūpateḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
तेन प्राप्तं भागवतं माहात्म्यं चास्य दुर्लभम् ..
त्वं वै गंधर्वसेनाय पित्रे विक्रमभूपतेः .. 19 ..
text_mt: By him the Bhāgavata was attained, and its hard-to-obtain greatness. / You, having reached the bank of the Narmadā, must recite

sanskrit_iast:
narmadākūlamāsādya śrāvayasva kathāṃ śubhām ..
harimāhātmyadānaṃ hi sarvadānaparaṃ smṛtam .. 3.2.32.20 ..
meaning:
नर्मदाकूलमासाद्य श्रावयस्व कथां शुभाम् ..
हरिमाहात्म्यदानं हि सर्वदानपरं स्मृतम् .. 3.2.32.20 ..
text_mt: this auspicious narrative to Gandharvasena, the father of King Vikrama; / for the gift of Hari's greatness is remembered as superior to all gifts."

sanskrit_iast:
satpātrāya pradātavyaṃ viṣṇubhaktāya dhīmate ..
bubhukṣitānnadānaṃ ca taddānasya samaṃ na hi .. 21 ..
meaning:
सत्पात्राय प्रदातव्यं विष्णुभक्ताय धीमते ..
बुभुक्षितान्नदानं च तद्दानस्य समं न हि .. 21 ..
text_mt: It should be given to a worthy recipient, a wise devotee of Viṣṇu; / indeed, giving food to the hungry does not equal that gift.

sanskrit_iast: ityuktvāṃtardadhe devo bopadevaḥ prasannadhīḥ .. 22 ..
meaning: इत्युक्त्वांतर्दधे देवो बोपदेवः प्रसन्नधीः .. 22 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the divine Bopadeva, with a gratified mind, disappeared.

sanskrit_iast:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
vāgjaṃ karma smṛtaṃ sūta veda pāṭhaḥ sanātanaḥ ..
bahutvātsarvavedānāṃ śrotumicchāmahe vayam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
वाग्जं कर्म स्मृतं सूत वेद पाठः सनातनः ..
बहुत्वात्सर्ववेदानां श्रोतुमिच्छामहे वयम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: The sages said: / Action born of speech is declared, O Sūta, to be the eternal recitation of the Veda; / because of the vastness of all the Vedas, we wish to hear:
title: adhyāyaḥ 33

sanskrit_iast:
kena stotreṇa vedānāṃ pāṭhasya phalamāpnuyāt ..
pāpāni vilayaṃ yāṃti tanme vada vicakṣaṇa .. 2 ..
meaning:
केन स्तोत्रेण वेदानां पाठस्य फलमाप्नुयात् ..
पापानि विलयं यांति तन्मे वद विचक्षण .. 2 ..
text_mt: By which hymn does one obtain the fruit of reciting the Vedas, / [and] sins dissolve away? Tell me that, O wise one!

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
vikramādityarājye tu dvijaḥ kaścidabhūdbhuvi ..
vyādhakarmeti vikhyāto brāhmaṇyāṃ śūdrato'bhavat .. .. 3 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
विक्रमादित्यराज्ये तु द्विजः कश्चिदभूद्भुवि ..
व्याधकर्मेति विख्यातो ब्राह्मण्यां शूद्रतोऽभवत् .. .. 3 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / In the kingdom of Vikramāditya, there was a certain twice-born on earth; / renowned as Vyādhakarma, he was born of a Śūdra upon a brāhmaṇa woman.

sanskrit_iast:
tripāṭhino dvijasyaiva bhāryā nāmnā hi kāminī ..
maithunecchāvatī nityaṃ madāghūrṇitalocanā .. 4 ..
meaning:
त्रिपाठिनो द्विजस्यैव भार्या नाम्ना हि कामिनी ..
मैथुनेच्छावती नित्यं मदाघूर्णितलोचना .. 4 ..
text_mt: A twice-born named Tripāṭhī had a wife named Kāminī; / she was always desirous of sexual union, her eyes rolling with passion.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijassaptaśatīpāṭhe vṛttyarthī karhicidgataḥ ..
grāme devalake ramye vahuvaiśyaniṣevite .. 5 ..
meaning:
द्विजस्सप्तशतीपाठे वृत्त्यर्थी कर्हिचिद्गतः ..
ग्रामे देवलके रम्ये वहुवैश्यनिषेविते .. 5 ..
text_mt: Once, seeking a livelihood by reciting the Saptaśatī, the twice-born went / to the lovely village of Devalaka, inhabited by many vaiśyas.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra māso gataḥ kālo nāyayau sa svamaṃdiram ..
tadā tu kāminī duṣṭā rūpayauvanasaṃyutā .. 6 ..
meaning:
तत्र मासो गतः कालो नाययौ स स्वमंदिरम् ..
तदा तु कामिनी दुष्टा रूपयौवनसंयुता .. 6 ..
text_mt: A month’s time passed there, and he did not return to his own home; / then the wicked Kāminī, endowed with beauty and youth,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā niṣādaṃ sabalaṃ kāṣṭhabhāropajīvinam ..
tasmai dattvā pañca mudrā bubhuje kāmapīḍitā .. 7 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा निषादं सबलं काष्ठभारोपजीविनम् ..
तस्मै दत्त्वा पञ्च मुद्रा बुभुजे कामपीडिता .. 7 ..
text_mt: seeing a strong Niṣāda who made his living carrying loads of firewood, / gave him five coins and, afflicted by desire, enjoyed [him].

sanskrit_iast:
tadā garbhaṃ dadhau sā ca vyādhivīryeṇa saṃci tam ..
putro'bhūddaśamāsāṃte jātakarma pitākarot .. 8 ..
meaning:
तदा गर्भं दधौ सा च व्याधिवीर्येण संचि तम् ..
पुत्रोऽभूद्दशमासांते जातकर्म पिताकरोत् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Then she conceived a womb gathered from the seed of the hunter; / at the end of ten months a son was born, and the father performed the birth rites.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśābde gate kāle sa dhūrto vedavarjitaḥ ..
vyādhakarmakaro nityaṃ vyādhakarmā hyatobhavat.. .. 9 ..
meaning:
द्वादशाब्दे गते काले स धूर्तो वेदवर्जितः ..
व्याधकर्मकरो नित्यं व्याधकर्मा ह्यतोभवत्.. .. 9 ..
text_mt: When twelve years had passed, he became a rogue devoid of the Veda, / always doing the work of a hunter; hence he was called Vyādhakarmā.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkāsitau dvijenaiva mātṛputrau dvijādhamau ..
tripāṭhī brahmacaryaṃ tu kṛtavāndharmatatparaḥ .. 3.2.33.10 ..
meaning:
निष्कासितौ द्विजेनैव मातृपुत्रौ द्विजाधमौ ..
त्रिपाठी ब्रह्मचर्यं तु कृतवान्धर्मतत्परः .. 3.2.33.10 ..
text_mt: Mother and son, the lowest of the twice-born, were driven out by that very twice-born; / and Tripāṭhī, devoted to righteousness, practiced celibacy.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyahaṃ caṃḍikāpāṭhaṃ kṛtvā viṃdhyagirau vasan ..
jīvanmuktobhavacchīghraṃ jagadaṃbāprasādataḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
प्रत्यहं चंडिकापाठं कृत्वा विंध्यगिरौ वसन् ..
जीवन्मुक्तोभवच्छीघ्रं जगदंबाप्रसादतः .. 11 ..
text_mt: Reciting the hymn to Caṇḍikā every day while living on the Vindhya mountain, / he quickly became liberated while living by the grace of the Mother of the Universe.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣādasya gṛhe cobhau vane gatvoṣaturmudā ..
pratyahaṃ jārabhāvena bahudravyamupārjitam .. .. 12 ..
meaning:
निषादस्य गृहे चोभौ वने गत्वोषतुर्मुदा ..
प्रत्यहं जारभावेन बहुद्रव्यमुपार्जितम् .. .. 12 ..
text_mt: And both of them went to the forest to live gladly in the house of the Niṣāda; / every day, through adultery, much wealth was acquired.

sanskrit_iast:
vyādhakarmā tu cauryeṇa pitṛmātṛpriyaṃkaraḥ ..
ekadā daivayogena śivāmaṃdiramāyayau .. 13 ..
meaning:
व्याधकर्मा तु चौर्येण पितृमातृप्रियंकरः ..
एकदा दैवयोगेन शिवामंदिरमाययौ .. 13 ..
text_mt: Vyādhakarmā, pleasing his mother and [step]father by theft, / once by the turn of fate came to a temple of Śivā.

sanskrit_iast:
cauravṛttiparo dhūrtaḥ striyā bhūṣaṇamāharat ..
kaiścijjātaḥ sa nī? dhūrto bahumāyāviśāradaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
चौरवृत्तिपरो धूर्तः स्त्रिया भूषणमाहरत् ..
कैश्चिज्जातः स नी? धूर्तो बहुमायाविशारदः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Devoted to the profession of stealing, the rogue snatched the ornament of a woman; / he had become a rogue, skilled in many deceptions.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācitprāptavāṃstatra dvijavastrasamudgatam ..
śrutamādicaritraṃ hi tena śabdapriyeṇa vai .. 15 ..
meaning:
कदाचित्प्राप्तवांस्तत्र द्विजवस्त्रसमुद्गतम् ..
श्रुतमादिचरित्रं हि तेन शब्दप्रियेण वै .. 15 ..
text_mt: At some time he found there [a book] taken from a twice-born's garment; / fond of the words, he heard the First Episode [of the Devīmāhātmya].

sanskrit_iast:
pāṭhapuṇyaprabhāveṇa dharmabuddhistato'bhavat ..
dattvā cauryadhanaṃ sarvaṃ tasmai viprāya pāṭhine .. 16 ..
meaning:
पाठपुण्यप्रभावेण धर्मबुद्धिस्ततोऽभवत् ..
दत्त्वा चौर्यधनं सर्वं तस्मै विप्राय पाठिने .. 16 ..
text_mt: By the power of the merit of that recitation, an inclination toward righteousness arose in him; / giving all his stolen wealth to that twice-born reciter,

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyatvamagamattatrākṣaramaiśaṃ jajāpa ha ..
bījamaṃtraprabhāveṇa tadaṃgātpāpamulbaṇam .. 17 ..
meaning:
शिष्यत्वमगमत्तत्राक्षरमैशं जजाप ह ..
बीजमंत्रप्रभावेण तदंगात्पापमुल्बणम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: he became his disciple there and chanted the syllable of the Lord; / by the power of the seed-mantra, dreadful sin from his body

sanskrit_iast:
niḥsṛtaṃ kṛmirūpeṇa bahuvarṇena tāpitam ..
trivarṣānte ca niṣpāpo babhūva dvijasattamaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
निःसृतं कृमिरूपेण बहुवर्णेन तापितम् ..
त्रिवर्षान्ते च निष्पापो बभूव द्विजसत्तमः .. 16 ..
text_mt: came forth in the form of worms of many colours, burnt [away]; / and at the end of three years, that best of the twice-born became sinless.

sanskrit_iast:
paṭhitvākṣaramālāṃ ca jajāpādicaritrakam ..
dvādaśābdamite kāle kāśyāṃ gatvā sa tu dvijaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
पठित्वाक्षरमालां च जजापादिचरित्रकम् ..
द्वादशाब्दमिते काले काश्यां गत्वा स तु द्विजः .. 19 ..
text_mt: Having recited the garland of syllables, he chanted the First Episode; / when a period of twelve years had elapsed, that twice-born went to Kāśī,

sanskrit_iast:
annapūrṇāṃ mahādevīṃ tuṣṭāva parayā mudā ..
rocanādyaiśca saṃpūjyāṃ munidevaniṣevitām .. 3.2.33.20 ..
meaning:
अन्नपूर्णां महादेवीं तुष्टाव परया मुदा ..
रोचनाद्यैश्च संपूज्यां मुनिदेवनिषेविताम् .. 3.2.33.20 ..
text_mt: and with supreme joy praised Annapūrṇā, the Great Goddess, / who is to be worshipped with yellow pigment and the like, and served by sages and gods:

sanskrit_iast:
nityānaṃdakarī parābhayakarī sauṃdaryaratnākarī nirdhūtākhilapāpapāvanakarī kāśīpurādhīśvarī ..
nānālokakarī mahābhayaharī viśvaṃbharī sundarī vidyāṃ dehi kṛpāvalaṃbanakarī mātānnapūrṇeśvarī .. 21 ..
meaning:
नित्यानंदकरी पराभयकरी सौंदर्यरत्नाकरी निर्धूताखिलपापपावनकरी काशीपुराधीश्वरी ..
नानालोककरी महाभयहरी विश्वंभरी सुन्दरी विद्यां देहि कृपावलंबनकरी मातान्नपूर्णेश्वरी .. 21 ..
text_mt: “O giver of eternal bliss, giver of supreme fearlessness, mine of jewels of beauty, / washer of all sins, purifier, sovereign lady of the city of Kāśī! / O creator of various worlds, remover of great fear, all-supporting, beautiful one, / bestow knowledge, O Mother Annapūrṇeśvarī, you who grant the support of your grace!”

sanskrit_iast:
sa ityaṣṭottaraṃ japtvā dhyānastimitalocanaḥ ..
suṣvāpa tatra muditaḥ svapne prādurabhūcchivā .. 22 ..
meaning:
स इत्यष्टोत्तरं जप्त्वा ध्यानस्तिमितलोचनः ..
सुष्वाप तत्र मुदितः स्वप्ने प्रादुरभूच्छिवा .. 22 ..
text_mt: Having chanted thus one hundred and eight times, his eyes motionless in meditation, / he fell asleep there joyfully; in a dream Śivā appeared to him.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā tasmai hi ṛgvidyāṃ punaraṃtaradhīyata ..
utthāya sa dvijo dhīmām̐llabdhvā vidyāmanuttamām .. 23 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वा तस्मै हि ऋग्विद्यां पुनरंतरधीयत ..
उत्थाय स द्विजो धीमाम्̐ल्लब्ध्वा विद्यामनुत्तमाम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Having given him the knowledge of the Ṛgveda, she disappeared again; / rising up, that wise twice-born, having obtained unexcelled knowledge,

sanskrit_iast:
vikramādityabhūpasya yajñācāryo babhūva ha ..
yajñāṃte yogamāsthāya jagāma tu himālayam .. 24 ..
meaning:
विक्रमादित्यभूपस्य यज्ञाचार्यो बभूव ह ..
यज्ञांते योगमास्थाय जगाम तु हिमालयम् .. 24 ..
text_mt: became the master of the sacrifice for King Vikramāditya; / and at the conclusion of the sacrifice, resorting to yoga, he went to the Himālayas.

sanskrit_iast:
etatte varṇitaṃ vipra puṇyamādicaritrakam ..
brahmībhūya yathā vipro lebhe siddhimanuttamām .. 25 ..
meaning:
एतत्ते वर्णितं विप्र पुण्यमादिचरित्रकम् ..
ब्रह्मीभूय यथा विप्रो लेभे सिद्धिमनुत्तमाम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: This holy First Episode has been described to you, O brāhmaṇa, / how the twice-born, becoming identified with brahman, attained unexcelled perfection.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ujjayinyāṃ purā vipra rājanyaḥ sarvahiṃsakaḥ ..
babhūva madyamāṃsāśī bhīmavarmeti viśrutaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
उज्जयिन्यां पुरा विप्र राजन्यः सर्वहिंसकः ..
बभूव मद्यमांसाशी भीमवर्मेति विश्रुतः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Formerly in Ujjayinī, O brāhmaṇa, there was a kṣatriya who killed all beings, / an eater of wine and meat, known as Bhīmavarmā.
title: adhyāyaḥ 34

sanskrit_iast:
māṃsalobhena sa khalaḥ sūkarāngrāmakukkuṭān ..
hatvā cābhakṣayatpāpī veśyāsaṃgaparāyaṇaḥ .. .. 2 ..
meaning:
मांसलोभेन स खलः सूकरान्ग्रामकुक्कुटान् ..
हत्वा चाभक्षयत्पापी वेश्यासंगपरायणः .. .. 2 ..
text_mt: Greedy for meat, that villain killed pigs and village roosters / and ate them, a sinner devoted to the company of prostitutes.

sanskrit_iast:
naramāṃsaṃ sa kravyādastyaktvānyānbhakṣako'bhavat ..
evaṃ bahugate kāle bhīmavarmā mahādhamaḥ ..
visūcyagnivaśaṃ yāto mamāra ca yuvāpi saḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
नरमांसं स क्रव्यादस्त्यक्त्वान्यान्भक्षकोऽभवत् ..
एवं बहुगते काले भीमवर्मा महाधमः ..
विसूच्यग्निवशं यातो ममार च युवापि सः .. 3 ..
text_mt: Abandoning other [foods], that flesh-eater became a consumer of human meat; / in this way, when much time had passed, the utterly degraded Bhīmavarmā, / fallen under the power of the fire of cholera, died though still young.

sanskrit_iast:
kāritaścaṃḍikāpāṭhastena duṣṭena bhīruṇā ..
tasya puṇyaprabhāvena nāgato narakānprati .. 4 ..
meaning:
कारितश्चंडिकापाठस्तेन दुष्टेन भीरुणा ..
तस्य पुण्यप्रभावेन नागतो नरकान्प्रति .. 4 ..
text_mt: A recitation of Caṇḍikā had been caused to be performed by that wicked coward; / by the power of its merit, he did not go to the hells.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ kṣatratvamagamanmāgadhe sa mahīpatiḥ ..
mahānandīti vikhyāto rājanītiparāyaṇaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
पुनः क्षत्रत्वमगमन्मागधे स महीपतिः ..
महानन्दीति विख्यातो राजनीतिपरायणः .. 5 ..
text_mt: He attained kṣatriyahood again as a king in Magadha, / known as Mahānandī, devoted to royal policy.

sanskrit_iast:
jātismaro babhūvāsau vedadharmaparāyaṇaḥ ..
kātyāyanasya śiṣyo'bhūnmahāśāktasya dhīmataḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
जातिस्मरो बभूवासौ वेदधर्मपरायणः ..
कात्यायनस्य शिष्योऽभून्महाशाक्तस्य धीमतः .. 6 ..
text_mt: He became one who remembered his former lives, devoted to Vedic righteousness; / he became a disciple of the wise Kātyāyana, a great Śākta.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmai nṛpāya sa munirdattvā madhyacaritrakam ..
sabījaṃ punarāgatya vindhye śakti paro'bhavat .. 7 ..
meaning:
तस्मै नृपाय स मुनिर्दत्त्वा मध्यचरित्रकम् ..
सबीजं पुनरागत्य विन्ध्ये शक्ति परोऽभवत् .. 7 ..
text_mt: Having given that king the Middle Episode / along with its seed-mantra, that sage went back to the Vindhyas and was devoted to the Śakti.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpo'pi pratyahaṃ devīṃ mahālakṣmīṃ sanātanīm ..
rocanādyaiśca saṃpūjya japanmadhyacaritrakam .. 8 ..
meaning:
नृपोऽपि प्रत्यहं देवीं महालक्ष्मीं सनातनीम् ..
रोचनाद्यैश्च संपूज्य जपन्मध्यचरित्रकम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: The king too, worshipping daily the eternal goddess Mahālakṣmī / with yellow pigment and other offerings, chanted the Middle Episode.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyakṣetratvamagamanmahāmāyāprasādataḥ ..
śūdrabhāvaṃ parityajya kṣatrabhāvamupāgataḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
पुण्यक्षेत्रत्वमगमन्महामायाप्रसादतः ..
शूद्रभावं परित्यज्य क्षत्रभावमुपागतः .. 9 ..
text_mt: By the grace of Mahāmāyā he attained the status of a sacred field; / abandoning the nature of a Śūdra, he attained the nature of a kṣatriya.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśābdāṃtare prāptastadguruḥ śaktitatparaḥ ..
lakṣacaṇḍīṃ nṛpādeva kārayāmāsa dharmataḥ .. 3.2.34.10 ..
meaning:
द्वादशाब्दांतरे प्राप्तस्तद्गुरुः शक्तितत्परः ..
लक्षचण्डीं नृपादेव कारयामास धर्मतः .. 3.2.34.10 ..
text_mt: At the end of twelve years his guru, devoted to the Śakti, arrived, / and caused a Lakṣacaṇḍī [sacrifice] to be duly performed by the king.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prādurabhūddevī jagadaṃbā sanātanī ..
nṛpāya dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ mokṣaṃ hi cādadāt .. 11 ..
meaning:
तदा प्रादुरभूद्देवी जगदंबा सनातनी ..
नृपाय धर्ममर्थं च कामं मोक्षं हि चाददात् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Then the eternal goddess, the Mother of the Universe, manifested; / she gave to the king righteousness, wealth, pleasure, and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
mahānandī mahābhāgo bhuktvā bhogaṃ surepsitam ..
ante jagāma paramaṃ lokaṃ devanamaskṛtam .. 12 ..
meaning:
महानन्दी महाभागो भुक्त्वा भोगं सुरेप्सितम् ..
अन्ते जगाम परमं लोकं देवनमस्कृतम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: The highly fortunate Mahānandī, having enjoyed pleasures desired by the gods, / in the end went to the supreme realm worshipped by the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitā vipra yatproktaṃ yajuṣo gatiḥ ..
sā vai madhyacaritreṇa prāptā śūdranṛpeṇa vai .. 13 ..
meaning:
इति ते कथिता विप्र यत्प्रोक्तं यजुषो गतिः ..
सा वै मध्यचरित्रेण प्राप्ता शूद्रनृपेण वै .. 13 ..
text_mt: Thus it has been told to you, O brāhmaṇa: that destination of the Yajurveda which is spoken of / was attained indeed through the Middle Episode by that Śūdra-king.

sanskrit_iast: ityevaṃ varṇitaṃ vipra māhātmyaṃ munivarṇitam .. 14 ..
meaning: इत्येवं वर्णितं विप्र माहात्म्यं मुनिवर्णितम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: In this way, O brāhmaṇa, the greatness described by the sages has been related.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
citrakūṭe girau ramye nānādhātuvicitrite ..
tatrāvasanmahāprājña upādhyāyaḥ patañjaliḥ. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
चित्रकूटे गिरौ रम्ये नानाधातुविचित्रिते ..
तत्रावसन्महाप्राज्ञ उपाध्यायः पतञ्जलिः. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / On the delightful mountain of Citrakūṭa, variegated with various minerals, / there lived the highly intelligent teacher Patañjali. (1)
title: adhyāyaḥ 35

sanskrit_iast:
vedavedāṃgatattvajño gītāśāstraparāyaṇaḥ ..
viṣṇubhaktaḥ satyasandho bhāṣyaśāstra viśāradaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
वेदवेदांगतत्त्वज्ञो गीताशास्त्रपरायणः ..
विष्णुभक्तः सत्यसन्धो भाष्यशास्त्र विशारदः .. 2 ..
text_mt: He knew the essential truth of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, was devoted to the scripture of the Gītā, / was a devotee of Viṣṇu, faithful to his word, and skilled in the treatise of the commentary. (2)

sanskrit_iast:
kadācitsa tu śuddhātmā gatastīrthāṃtaraṃ prati ..
kāśyāṃ kātyāyanenaiva tasya vādo mahānabhūt .. 3 ..
meaning:
कदाचित्स तु शुद्धात्मा गतस्तीर्थांतरं प्रति ..
काश्यां कात्यायनेनैव तस्य वादो महानभूत् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Once that pure-souled one went on a pilgrimage to sacred places. / In Kāśī a great debate arose between him and Kātyāyana. (3)

sanskrit_iast:
varṣānte ca tadā vipro devībhaktena nirjitaḥ ..
lajjitaḥ sa tu dharmātmā saṃtuṣṭāva sarasvatīm .. 4 ..
meaning:
वर्षान्ते च तदा विप्रो देवीभक्तेन निर्जितः ..
लज्जितः स तु धर्मात्मा संतुष्टाव सरस्वतीम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: At the end of a year, the brāhmaṇa was then defeated by that devotee of the goddess. / Ashamed, that righteous-souled one praised Sarasvatī. (4)

sanskrit_iast:
.. patañjaliruvāca .. ..
namo devyai mahāmūrtyai sarvamūrtyai namo nama ..
śivāyai sarvamāṃgalyai viṣṇumāye ca te namaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
.. पतञ्जलिरुवाच .. ..
नमो देव्यै महामूर्त्यै सर्वमूर्त्यै नमो नम ..
शिवायै सर्वमांगल्यै विष्णुमाये च ते नमः .. 5 ..
text_mt: Patañjali said: / Obeisance to the goddess of great form, obeisance again and again to her who is all forms! / To Śivā, to her who brings all auspiciousness, and to you, Viṣṇumāyā, obeisance! (5)

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva śraddhā buddhistvaṃ medhā vidyā śivaṃkarī ..
śāṃtirvāṇī tvamevāsi nārāyaṇi namonamaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
त्वमेव श्रद्धा बुद्धिस्त्वं मेधा विद्या शिवंकरी ..
शांतिर्वाणी त्वमेवासि नारायणि नमोनमः .. 6 ..
text_mt: You alone are faith; you are intellect, wisdom, knowledge bringing well-being. / You alone are peace and speech; Nārāyaṇī, obeisance, obeisance to you! (6)

sanskrit_iast:
ityukte sati vipre tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī ..
viprottama caritraṃ me japa caikāgramānasaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्ते सति विप्रे तु वागुवाचाशरीरिणी ..
विप्रोत्तम चरित्रं मे जप चैकाग्रमानसः .. 7 ..
text_mt: When the brāhmaṇa had spoken thus, a bodiless voice spoke: / "Best of brāhmaṇas, recite my narrative with a one-pointed mind. (7)

sanskrit_iast:
taccaritraprabhāveṇa satyaṃ jñānamavāpsyasi ..
kātyāyanasya viprasya rājasaṃjñānamuddhatam ..
madbhaktyā tena saṃprāptaṃ parājaya patañjale ..8 ..
meaning:
तच्चरित्रप्रभावेण सत्यं ज्ञानमवाप्स्यसि ..
कात्यायनस्य विप्रस्य राजसंज्ञानमुद्धतम् ..
मद्भक्त्या तेन संप्राप्तं पराजय पतञ्जले ..8 ..
text_mt: By the power of that narrative you will attain true knowledge. / The knowledge of the brāhmaṇa Kātyāyana is haughty and passionate; / it was obtained by him through devotion to me. Defeat him, Patañjali!" (8)

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vaco devyā vindhyavāsini mandiram ..
gatvā tāṃ pūjayāmāsa tuṣṭāva stotrapāṭhataḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो देव्या विन्ध्यवासिनि मन्दिरम् ..
गत्वा तां पूजयामास तुष्टाव स्तोत्रपाठतः .. 9 ..
text_mt: Having heard this speech of the goddess, he went to the temple of Vindhyavāsinī, / worshipped her, and praised her by reciting a hymn. (9)

sanskrit_iast:
jñānaṃ prasādajaṃ vipraḥ prāpya viṣṇuparāyaṇam ..
kātyāyanaṃ parājitya parāṃ mudamavāpa ha .. 3.2.35.10 ..
meaning:
ज्ञानं प्रसादजं विप्रः प्राप्य विष्णुपरायणम् ..
कात्यायनं पराजित्य परां मुदमवाप ह .. 3.2.35.10 ..
text_mt: Having attained knowledge born of her grace, centered on Viṣṇu, / the brāhmaṇa defeated Kātyāyana and obtained supreme joy. (10)

sanskrit_iast:
ūrddhvapuṃḍraṃ ca tilakaṃ tulasīkaṇṭhamālikām ..
kṛṣṇamantraṃ ca śivadaṃ sthāpayitvā gṛhegṛhe .. 11 ..
meaning:
ऊर्द्ध्वपुंड्रं च तिलकं तुलसीकण्ठमालिकाम् ..
कृष्णमन्त्रं च शिवदं स्थापयित्वा गृहेगृहे .. 11 ..
text_mt: Having established the upward mark and forehead mark, the neck-garland of tulasī, / and the auspicious Kṛṣṇa-mantra in every house (11)

sanskrit_iast:
janejane tathā kṛtvā mahābhāṣya mudairayat ..
ciraṃjīvitvamagamadviṣṇumāyāprasādataḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
जनेजने तथा कृत्वा महाभाष्य मुदैरयत् ..
चिरंजीवित्वमगमद्विष्णुमायाप्रसादतः .. 12 ..
text_mt: and among all the people, he proclaimed the Mahābhāṣya. / Through the grace of Viṣṇumāyā he attained long life. (12)

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathito vipra jāpyānāmuttamo japaḥ ..
kimanyacchrotumicchaṃti śaunakādyā maharṣayaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
इति ते कथितो विप्र जाप्यानामुत्तमो जपः ..
किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छंति शौनकाद्या महर्षयः .. 13 ..
text_mt: Thus has been related to you, O brāhmaṇa, the best recitation among recitations. / What else do the great sages headed by Śaunaka wish to hear? (13)

sanskrit_iast: sarve bhadrāṇi paśyaṃtu mā kaścidduḥkhabhāgbhavet .. 14 ..
meaning: सर्वे भद्राणि पश्यंतु मा कश्चिद्दुःखभाग्भवेत् .. 14 ..
text_mt: May all see auspicious things; may no one experience sorrow! (14)

sanskrit_iast:
maṃgalaṃ bhagavānviṣṇurmaṃgalaṃ garuḍadhvajaḥ ..
maṃgalaṃ puṃḍarīkākṣo maṃgalā yatano hariḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
मंगलं भगवान्विष्णुर्मंगलं गरुडध्वजः ..
मंगलं पुंडरीकाक्षो मंगला यतनो हरिः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Auspicious is the Blessed Lord Viṣṇu; auspicious is the one whose banner is Garuḍa. / Auspicious is the lotus-eyed one; Hari is the abode of auspiciousness. (15)

sanskrit_iast:
śuciryo hi naro nityamitihāsasamuccayam ..
śṛṇuyāddharmakāmārthī sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 16 ..
samāpto'yaṃ dvitīyaḥ khaṃḍaḥ..

29 277 Release of the merchant Sādhu from prison through the power of the Satyanārāyaṇa vow performed by the merchant Sādhu's wife; Sādhu's deceitfulness following the inquiry made by Satyanārāyaṇa; Nārāyaṇa's cursing of Sādhu; Nārāyaṇa's granting of a boon to Sādhu when prayed to by him; the son-in-law's sinking into water due to a transgression of the vow by Sādhu's daughter; the son-in-law's rising from the water after eating the food offering of Satyanārāyaṇa; description of Sādhu's attaining a good destiny through the grace of Satyanārāyaṇa; verses: 70.
30 279 The brāhmaṇa Pitṛśarman's praise of the Blessed Goddess Śivā upon observing the onset of the Kali age; description of the account of the origin of the Caturvedin brāhmaṇas from Pitṛśarman; verses: 33.
31 279 Description of the account of the great sage Pāṇini; verses: 15.

32 280 totādarīsthabopadevavṛttāntavarṇanam ślo. 22
33 280 vyādhakarmabrāhmaṇavṛttāntavarṇanam tasyānnapūrṇāprasādavṛttāntavarṇanam. saptaśatīprathamacaritramāhātmyavarṇanam ślo. 25

sanskrit_iast: ( iti dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ .. 2 ..)
text_mt: (Thus ends the Second Section [2])
title: viṣayānukramaṇikā

sanskrit_iast:
.. ṛṣayaḥ ūcuḥ .. ..
bhagavanvikramākhyānakālo'yaṃ bhavatoditaḥ ..
śatadvādaśamaryādo dvāparasya samo bhuvi .. .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. ऋषयः ऊचुः .. ..
भगवन्विक्रमाख्यानकालोऽयं भवतोदितः ..
शतद्वादशमर्यादो द्वापरस्य समो भुवि .. .. 1 ..
text_mt:
The sages said:
O venerable one, you have described this period of the narrative of Vikrama,
which on earth has a span of twelve hundred [years], equal to the Dvāpara age.
title: adhyāyaḥ 01

sanskrit_iast:
asminkāle mahābhāga līlā bhagavatā kṛtā ..
tāmetāṃ kathayāsmānvai sarvajño'sti bhavānsadā .. 2 ..
meaning:
अस्मिन्काले महाभाग लीला भगवता कृता ..
तामेतां कथयास्मान्वै सर्वज्ञोऽस्ति भवान्सदा .. 2 ..
text_mt:
At this time, O fortunate one, pastimes were enacted by the Lord.
Relate that to us, for you are indeed always omniscient.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam ..
devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet .. 3 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम् ..
देवीं सरस्वतीं व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत् .. 3 ..
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Having bowed down to Nārāyaṇa and to Nara, the foremost of men,
as well as to the goddess Sarasvatī and to Vyāsa, one should then utter "Victory!"

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyākhye mahākalpe prāpte vaivasvatentare ..
aṣṭāviṃśaddvāparānte kurukṣetre raṇo'bhavat .. 4 ..
meaning:
भविष्याख्ये महाकल्पे प्राप्ते वैवस्वतेन्तरे ..
अष्टाविंशद्द्वापरान्ते कुरुक्षेत्रे रणोऽभवत् .. 4 ..
text_mt:
When the great cosmic age named Bhaviṣya had arrived in the Vaivasvata interval,
at the end of the twenty-eighth Dvāpara, the battle took place at Kurukṣetra.

sanskrit_iast:
pāṃḍavairnirjitāḥ sarve kauravāḥ yuddhadurmadāḥ ..
aṣṭādaśe ca divase pāṃḍavānāṃ jayo'bhavat .. 5 ..
meaning:
पांडवैर्निर्जिताः सर्वे कौरवाः युद्धदुर्मदाः ..
अष्टादशे च दिवसे पांडवानां जयोऽभवत् .. 5 ..
text_mt:
All the Kauravas, arrogant in battle, were vanquished by the Pāṇḍavas,
and on the eighteenth day, victory belonged to the Pāṇḍavas.

sanskrit_iast:
dinānte bhaga vānkṛṣṇo jñātvā kālasya durgatim ..
śivaṃ tuṣṭāva manasā yogarūpaṃ sanātanam .. 6 ..
meaning:
दिनान्ते भग वान्कृष्णो ज्ञात्वा कालस्य दुर्गतिम् ..
शिवं तुष्टाव मनसा योगरूपं सनातनम् .. 6 ..
text_mt:
At the close of the day, Lord Kṛṣṇa, knowing the calamity of the times,
praised in his mind the eternal Śiva whose form is yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
.. kṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
namaḥ śāṃtāya rudrāya bhūte śāya kapardine..
kālakartre jagadbhartre pāpahartre namonamaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
.. कृष्ण उवाच .. ..
नमः शांताय रुद्राय भूते शाय कपर्दिने..
कालकर्त्रे जगद्भर्त्रे पापहर्त्रे नमोनमः .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pāṃḍavānrakṣa bhagavanmadbhaktānbhūtabhīrukān ..
iti śrutvā stavaṃ rudro naṃdiyānoparisthitaḥ ..
rakṣārthaṃ śibirāṇāṃ ca prāptavāñchūlahastadhṛk .. 8 ..
meaning:
पांडवान्रक्ष भगवन्मद्भक्तान्भूतभीरुकान् ..
इति श्रुत्वा स्तवं रुद्रो नंदियानोपरिस्थितः ..
रक्षार्थं शिबिराणां च प्राप्तवाञ्छूलहस्तधृक् .. 8 ..
text_mt:
Protect the Pāṇḍavas, O Lord, who are devoted to me and timid towards spirits!
Having heard this praise, Rudra, mounted upon the vehicle Nandi,
holdin a trident in his hand, arrived for the protection of the encampments.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā nṛpājñayā kṛṣṇaḥ sa gato gajasāhvayam ..
pāṃḍavāḥ paṃca nirgatya sarasvatyā staṭe'vasan .. 9 ..
meaning:
तदा नृपाज्ञया कृष्णः स गतो गजसाह्वयम् ..
पांडवाः पंच निर्गत्य सरस्वत्या स्तटेऽवसन् .. 9 ..
text_mt:
Then, by the king’s command, Kṛṣṇa went to Gajasāhvaya,
and the five Pāṇḍavas departed and dwelt on the bank of the Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
niśīthe drauṇibhojau ca kṛpastatra samāyayuḥ ..
tuṣṭuvurmanasā rudraṃ tebhyo mārgaṃ śivodadāt .. 3.3.1.10 ..
meaning:
निशीथे द्रौणिभोजौ च कृपस्तत्र समाययुः ..
तुष्टुवुर्मनसा रुद्रं तेभ्यो मार्गं शिवोददात् .. 3.3.1.10 ..
text_mt:
At midnight, the son of Droṇa, the Bhoja, and Kṛpa arrived there;
they praised Rudra in their minds, and Śiva gave them way.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvatthāmā tu balavāñchivadattamasiṃ tadā ..
gṛhītvā sa jaghānāśu dhṛṣṭadyumnapuraḥsarān .. 11 ..
meaning:
अश्वत्थामा तु बलवाञ्छिवदत्तमसिं तदा ..
गृहीत्वा स जघानाशु धृष्टद्युम्नपुरःसरान् .. 11 ..
text_mt:
Then the mighty Aśvatthāman, having taken the sword given by Śiva,
swiftly slew those headed by Dhṛṣṭadyumna.

sanskrit_iast: hatvā yatheṣṭamagamaddrauṇistābhyāṃ samanvitaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning: हत्वा यथेष्टमगमद्द्रौणिस्ताभ्यां समन्वितः .. 12 ..
text_mt: Having killed as he wished, the son of Droṇa departed, accompanied by the two of them.

sanskrit_iast:
pārṣatasyaiva sūtaśca hataśeṣo bhayāturaḥ ..
pāṃḍavānvarṇayāmāsa yathā jāto janakṣayaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
पार्षतस्यैव सूतश्च हतशेषो भयातुरः ..
पांडवान्वर्णयामास यथा जातो जनक्षयः .. 13 ..
text_mt:
The charioteer of Pārṣata himself, surviving the slaughter, distressed with fear,
recounted to the Pāṇḍavas how the destruction of their men had occurred.

sanskrit_iast:
āgaskṛtaṃ śivaṃ jñātvā bhīmādyāḥ krodhamūrcchitāḥ ..
svāyudhaistā ḍayāmāsa devadevaṃ pinākinam .. 14 ..
meaning:
आगस्कृतं शिवं ज्ञात्वा भीमाद्याः क्रोधमूर्च्छिताः ..
स्वायुधैस्ता डयामास देवदेवं पिनाकिनम् .. 14 ..
text_mt:
Knowing that Śiva had committed the offence, Bhīma and the others, overcome with wrath,
struck the god of gods, the bearer of the Pināka, with their own weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
astraśastrāṇi teṣāṃ tu śivadehe samāviśan ..
dṛṣṭvā te vismitāḥ sarve prajaghnustalamuṣṭibhiḥ .. 15..
meaning:
अस्त्रशस्त्राणि तेषां तु शिवदेहे समाविशन् ..
दृष्ट्वा ते विस्मिताः सर्वे प्रजघ्नुस्तलमुष्टिभिः .. 15..
text_mt:
Their magical missiles and weapons, however, entered Śiva’s body.
Seeing this, all of them, astonished, struck him with their palms and fists.

sanskrit_iast:
tāñchaśāpa tadā rudro yūyaṃ kṛṣṇaprapūjakāḥ ..
ato'smābhī rakṣiṇīyā vadhayogyāśca vai bhuvi .. 16 ..
meaning:
ताञ्छशाप तदा रुद्रो यूयं कृष्णप्रपूजकाः ..
अतोऽस्माभी रक्षिणीया वधयोग्याश्च वै भुवि .. 16 ..
text_mt:
Then Rudra cursed them: "You are worshippers of Kṛṣṇa;
therefore you should be protected by me, and yet [now] you deserve to be slain on earth.

sanskrit_iast:
punarjanma kalau prāpya bhokṣyate cāparādhakam ..
ityuktvāntardadhe devaḥ pāṃḍavā duḥkhitāstadā .. 17 ..
meaning:
पुनर्जन्म कलौ प्राप्य भोक्ष्यते चापराधकम् ..
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे देवः पांडवा दुःखितास्तदा .. 17 ..
text_mt:
Having obtained rebirth in the Kali age, you shall suffer for your transgression."
Having spoken thus, the god disappeared; then the Pāṇḍavas were sorrowful.

sanskrit_iast:
hariṃ śaraṇamājagmuraparādhanivṛttaye ..
tadā kṛṣṇayutāḥ sarve pāṃḍavāḥ śastravarjitāḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
हरिं शरणमाजग्मुरपराधनिवृत्तये ..
तदा कृष्णयुताः सर्वे पांडवाः शस्त्रवर्जिताः .. 18 ..
text_mt:
They went to Hari for refuge to remove their transgression;
then all the Pāṇḍavas, together with Kṛṣṇa, devoid of weapons,

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭuvurmanasā rudraṃ tadā prādurabhūcchivaḥ ..
varaṃ varayata prāha kṛṣṇaḥ śrutvābravīdidam .. 19 ..
meaning:
तुष्टुवुर्मनसा रुद्रं तदा प्रादुरभूच्छिवः ..
वरं वरयत प्राह कृष्णः श्रुत्वाब्रवीदिदम् .. 19 ..
text_mt:
praised Rudra in their minds, and then Śiva manifested.
He said, "Choose a boon!"; hearing this, Kṛṣṇa said this:

sanskrit_iast:
śastrāṇyastrāṇi yānyeva tvadaṃge kṣapitāni vai..
pāṃḍavebhyaśca dehi tvaṃ śāpasyānugrahaṃ kuru .. 3.3.1.20 ..
meaning:
शस्त्राण्यस्त्राणि यान्येव त्वदंगे क्षपितानि वै..
पांडवेभ्यश्च देहि त्वं शापस्यानुग्रहं कुरु .. 3.3.1.20 ..
text_mt:
"Whatever weapons and missiles were spent upon your body,
give them back to the Pāṇḍavas, and show grace regarding your curse!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā śivaḥ prāha kṛṣṇadeva namo'stu te ..
aparādho na me svāminmohito'haṃ tavājñayā .. 21 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा शिवः प्राह कृष्णदेव नमोऽस्तु ते ..
अपराधो न मे स्वामिन्मोहितोऽहं तवाज्ञया .. 21 ..
text_mt:
Having heard this, Śiva said: "O divine Kṛṣṇa, homage be to you!
It is not my fault, O Lord; I was deluded by your command.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvaśena mayā svāmindattaḥ śāpo bhayaṃkaraḥ ..
nānyathā vacanaṃ me syādaṃśāvataraṇaṃ bhavet .. 22 ..
meaning:
तद्वशेन मया स्वामिन्दत्तः शापो भयंकरः ..
नान्यथा वचनं मे स्यादंशावतरणं भवेत् .. 22 ..
text_mt:
Under its sway, O Master, a dreadful curse was pronounced by me;
my word cannot be otherwise, [so] there shall be a descent of portions.

sanskrit_iast:
vatsarājasya putratvaṃ gamiṣyati yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ..
balakhāniriti khyātaḥ śirīṣākhyapurādhipaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
वत्सराजस्य पुत्रत्वं गमिष्यति युधिष्ठिरः ..
बलखानिरिति ख्यातः शिरीषाख्यपुराधिपः .. 23 ..
text_mt:
Yudhiṣṭhira shall attain sonship to Vatsarāja,
renowned as Balakhāni, the ruler of the city named Śirīṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
bhīmo durvacanādduṣṭo mlecchayonau bhaviṣyati ..
vīraṇo nāma vikhyātaḥ sa vai vanarasādhipaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
भीमो दुर्वचनाद्दुष्टो म्लेच्छयोनौ भविष्यति ..
वीरणो नाम विख्यातः स वै वनरसाधिपः .. 24 ..
text_mt:
Bhīma, corrupted because of harsh speech, will be born in a Mleccha womb,
renowned by the name Vīraṇa, ruler of Vanarasa.

sanskrit_iast:
arjunāṃśaśca madbhakto janiṣyati mahāmatiḥ ..
putraḥ parimalasyaiva brahmānanda iti smṛtaḥ..25..
meaning:
अर्जुनांशश्च मद्भक्तो जनिष्यति महामतिः ..
पुत्रः परिमलस्यैव ब्रह्मानन्द इति स्मृतः..25..
text_mt:
A portion of Arjuna, devoted to me and very wise, shall be born
as the son of Parimala, known as Brahmānanda.

sanskrit_iast:
kānyakubje hi nakulo bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ..
ratnabhānusuto sau vai lakṣmaṇo nāma viśrutaḥ..26..
meaning:
कान्यकुब्जे हि नकुलो भविष्यति महाबलः..
रत्नभानुसुतो सौ वै लक्ष्मणो नाम विश्रुतः..26..
text_mt:
Nakula of great strength will be in Kānyakubja,
the son of Ratnabhānu, renowned indeed by the name Lakṣmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sahadevastu valavāñjaniṣyati mahāmatiḥ..
bhīṣmasiṃha suto jāto devasiṃha iti smṛtaḥ ..27..
meaning:
सहदेवस्तु वलवाञ्जनिष्यति महामतिः..
भीष्मसिंह सुतो जातो देवसिंह इति स्मृतः ..27..
text_mt:
The mighty and highly intelligent Sahadeva will be born
as the son of Bhīṣmasiṃha, known as Devasiṃha.

sanskrit_iast:
dhṛtarāṣṭrāṃśa evāsau janiṣyatyajamerake ..
pṛthivīrāja iti sa dropadī tatsutā smṛtā ..28..
meaning:
धृतराष्ट्रांश एवासौ जनिष्यत्यजमेरके ..
पृथिवीराज इति स द्रोपदी तत्सुता स्मृता ..28..
text_mt:
A portion of Dhṛtarāṣṭra himself will be born in Ajameraka
as Pṛthivīrāja, and Draupadī is known as his daughter,

sanskrit_iast:
velā nāmnā ca vikhyātā tārakaḥ karṇa eva hi ..
raktabījastathā rudro bhaviṣyati mahītale ..29..
meaning:
वेला नाम्ना च विख्याता तारकः कर्ण एव हि ..
रक्तबीजस्तथा रुद्रो भविष्यति महीतले ..29..
text_mt:
renowned by the name Velā; Karṇa will indeed be Tāraka;
likewise, Raktabīja will be Rudra on the surface of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
kauravāśca bhaviṣyanti māyāyuddhaviśāradāḥ..
pāṃḍupakṣāśca te sarve dharmiṇo balaśālinaḥ ..3.3.1.30..
meaning:
कौरवाश्च भविष्यन्ति मायायुद्धविशारदाः..
पांडुपक्षाश्च ते सर्वे धर्मिणो बलशालिनः ..3.3.1.30..
text_mt:
The Kauravas will be skilled in illusionary warfare,
and all those on the side of Pāṇḍu will be righteous and strong."

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
iti śrutvā hariḥ prāha vihasya parameśvaram ..
mayā śaktyavatāreṇa rakṣaṇīyā hi pāṃḍavāḥ ..31..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
इति श्रुत्वा हरिः प्राह विहस्य परमेश्वरम् ..
मया शक्त्यवतारेण रक्षणीया हि पांडवाः ..31..
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Having heard this, Hari smiled and said to the Supreme Lord:
"Indeed, the Pāṇḍavas are to be protected by me through an incarnation of Śakti.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāvatī purī ramyā māyādevīvinirmitā ..
deśarājasutastatra mamāṃśo hi janiṣyate .. 32 ..
meaning:
महावती पुरी रम्या मायादेवीविनिर्मिता ..
देशराजसुतस्तत्र ममांशो हि जनिष्यते .. 32 ..
text_mt:
In the delightful city of Mahāvatī, constructed by the goddess Māyā,
a portion of me will be born as the son of Deśarāja;

sanskrit_iast:
devakījaṭhare janmodayasiṃha iti smṛtaḥ ..
āhlādo mama dhāmāṃśo janiṣyati gururmama .. 33 ..
meaning:
देवकीजठरे जन्मोदयसिंह इति स्मृतः ..
आह्लादो मम धामांशो जनिष्यति गुरुर्मम .. 33 ..
text_mt:
birth will be in the womb of Devakī, known as Udayasiṃha.
Āhlāda, a portion of my splendour, will be born as my elder brother.

sanskrit_iast:
hatvāgnivaṃśajānbhūpānsthāpayiṣyāmi vai kalim ..
iti śrutvā śivo devastatraivāṃtaradhīyata .. 34 ..
meaning:
हत्वाग्निवंशजान्भूपान्स्थापयिष्यामि वै कलिम् ..
इति श्रुत्वा शिवो देवस्तत्रैवांतरधीयत .. 34 ..
text_mt:
Having slain the kings born of the fire lineage, I shall establish the Kali age."
Having heard this, the divine Śiva vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
prātaḥ kāle ca saṃprāpte pāṃḍavāḥ putraśokinaḥ ..
pretakāryāṇi te kṛtvā bhīṣmāntikamupāyayuḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
प्रातः काले च संप्राप्ते पांडवाः पुत्रशोकिनः ..
प्रेतकार्याणि ते कृत्वा भीष्मान्तिकमुपाययुः .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Sūta said:
When morning arrived, the Pāṇḍavas, grieving for their sons,
performed the funeral rites and approached Bhīṣma.
title: adhyāyaḥ 02

sanskrit_iast:
rājadharmānmokṣadharmāndānadharmānvibhāgaśaḥ ..
śrutvāyajannaśvamedhaistribhiruttamakarmabhiḥ ..2..
meaning:
राजधर्मान्मोक्षधर्मान्दानधर्मान्विभागशः ..
श्रुत्वायजन्नश्वमेधैस्त्रिभिरुत्तमकर्मभिः ..2..
text_mt:
Having heard the duties of kings, the duties of liberation, and the duties of charity in their divisions,
they worshipped with three horse sacrifices, the foremost of rites.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭtriṃśadabdarājyaṃ hi kṛtvā svargapuraṃ yayuḥ ..
janiṣyante tadaṃśā vai kalidharma vivṛddhaye .. 3 ..
meaning:
षट्त्रिंशदब्दराज्यं हि कृत्वा स्वर्गपुरं ययुः ..
जनिष्यन्ते तदंशा वै कलिधर्म विवृद्धये .. 3 ..
text_mt:
Having ruled the kingdom for thirty-six years, they went to the city of heaven.
Portions of them will be born for the increase of the dharma of the Kali age.

sanskrit_iast:
.. vyāsa uvāca .. ..
ityuktvā sa muniḥ sarvānpunaḥ sūto vadiṣyati ..
gacchadhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve yoganidrāvaśo hyaham ..
cakratīrthe samādhistho dhyāye'haṃ triguṇātparam .. 4 ..
meaning:
.. व्यास उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्त्वा स मुनिः सर्वान्पुनः सूतो वदिष्यति ..
गच्छध्वं मुनयः सर्वे योगनिद्रावशो ह्यहम् ..
चक्रतीर्थे समाधिस्थो ध्यायेऽहं त्रिगुणात्परम् .. 4 ..
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Having said this to all, the sage Sūta will speak again:
"Go, all you sages; for I am under the sway of yogic sleep;
established in absorption at Cakra-tīrtha, I meditate on what is beyond the three guṇas."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu munayo naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ ..
yogasiddhiṃ samāsthāya gamiṣyaṃtyātmanontike .. 5 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु मुनयो नैमिषारण्यवासिनः ..
योगसिद्धिं समास्थाय गमिष्यंत्यात्मनोन्तिके .. 5 ..
text_mt:
Having heard this, the sages residing in the Naimiṣa forest,
resorting to yogic perfection, will go near to the Self.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśābdaśate kāle'tīte te śaunakādayaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning: द्वादशाब्दशते कालेऽतीते ते शौनकादयः .. 6 ..
text_mt: When a time of twelve hundred years has passed, those headed by Śaunaka,

sanskrit_iast:
utthāya devakhāte ca snānadhyānādikāḥ kriyāḥ ..
kṛtvā sūtāntikaṃ gatvā vadiṣyaṃti punarvacaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
उत्थाय देवखाते च स्नानध्यानादिकाः क्रियाः ..
कृत्वा सूतान्तिकं गत्वा वदिष्यंति पुनर्वचः .. 7 ..
text_mt:
having arisen and performed rites such as bathing and meditation at the Devakhāta,
will approach Sūta and speak their words again.

sanskrit_iast:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
vikramākhyānakālo'yaṃ dvāpare ca śivājñayā ..
vinītānbhagavanbhūmau tadā tānnṛpatīnvada .. 8 .. ..
meaning:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
विक्रमाख्यानकालोऽयं द्वापरे च शिवाज्ञया ..
विनीतान्भगवन्भूमौ तदा तान्नृपतीन्वद .. 8 .. ..
text_mt:
The sages said:
This is the time of the narrative of Vikrama; and, O venerable one, speak now
of those kings who, by the command of Śiva in the Dvāpara age, were humbled on earth.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
svargate vikramāditye rājāno bahudhā'bhavan ..
tathāṣṭādaśa rājyāni teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu .. 9 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
स्वर्गते विक्रमादित्ये राजानो बहुधाऽभवन् ..
तथाष्टादश राज्यानि तेषां नामानि मे शृणु .. 9 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / When Vikramāditya went to heaven, many kings arose; / likewise there were eighteen kingdoms—hear their names from me:

sanskrit_iast:
paścime siṃdhunadyaṃte setubandhe hi dakṣiṇe ..
uttare badarīsthāne pūrve ca kapilāntike ..3.3.2.1 0..
meaning:
पश्चिमे सिंधुनद्यंते सेतुबन्धे हि दक्षिणे ..
उत्तरे बदरीस्थाने पूर्वे च कपिलान्तिके ..3.3.2.1 0..
text_mt: In the west, up to the river Indus; at the Setubandha in the south; / in the north, at the shrine of Badarī; and in the east, near Kapilā,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭādaśaiva rāṣṭrāṇi teṣāṃ madhye babhūvire ..
iṃdraprasthaṃ ca pāṃcālaṃ kuru kṣetraṃ ca kāpilam .. 11 ..
meaning:
अष्टादशैव राष्ट्राणि तेषां मध्ये बभूविरे ..
इंद्रप्रस्थं च पांचालं कुरु क्षेत्रं च कापिलम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: precisely eighteen realms arose within those borders: / Indraprastha, Pañcāla, Kurukṣetra, and Kāpila,

sanskrit_iast:
antarvedī vrajathyaivājameraṃ marudhanva ca ..
gaurjjaraṃ ca mahārāṣṭraṃ drāviḍaṃ ca kaliṃgakam .. 12 ..
meaning:
अन्तर्वेदी व्रजथ्यैवाजमेरं मरुधन्व च ..
गौर्ज्जरं च महाराष्ट्रं द्राविडं च कलिंगकम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Antarvedī, Vraja, Ajmer, and Marudhanva, / Gurjara, Mahārāṣṭra, Drāviḍa, and Kaliṅga,

sanskrit_iast:
āvaṃtyaṃ coḍupaṃ vaṃgaṃ gauḍaṃ māgadhameva ca ..
kauśalyaṃ ca tathā jñeyaṃ teṣāṃ rājā pṛthakpṛk .. 13 ..
meaning:
आवंत्यं चोडुपं वंगं गौडं मागधमेव च ..
कौशल्यं च तथा ज्ञेयं तेषां राजा पृथक्पृक् .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nānābhāṣāḥ sthitāstatra bahudharmapravartakāḥ ..
evamabdaśataṃ jātaṃ tataste vai śakādayaḥ ..14..
meaning:
नानाभाषाः स्थितास्तत्र बहुधर्मप्रवर्तकाः ..
एवमब्दशतं जातं ततस्ते वै शकादयः ..14..
text_mt: Various languages were established there, promoting diverse religious ways. / A hundred years passed in this manner; then indeed the Śakas and other [barbarians],

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā dharmavināśaṃ ca bahuvṛṃdaiḥ samanvitāḥ ..
kecittīrtvā siṃdhunadīmāryyadeśaṃ samāgatāḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा धर्मविनाशं च बहुवृंदैः समन्विताः ..
केचित्तीर्त्वा सिंधुनदीमार्य्यदेशं समागताः .. 15 ..
text_mt: having heard of the destruction of dharma and gathering in numerous hosts, / crossed the river Indus and entered the land of the Āryas.

sanskrit_iast:
himaparvatamārgeṇa siṃdhumārgeṇa cāgaman ..
jitvāryyāllām̐ṭhayitvā tānsvadeśaṃ punarāyayuḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
हिमपर्वतमार्गेण सिंधुमार्गेण चागमन् ..
जित्वार्य्याल्लाम्̐ठयित्वा तान्स्वदेशं पुनराययुः .. 16 ..
text_mt: They came by way of the snow mountains and along the course of the Indus; / having conquered the Āryas and plundered them, they returned to their own land.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā yoṣitasteṣāṃ paraṃ harṣamupāyayuḥ ..
etasminnantare tatra śālivāhanabhūpatiḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
गृहीत्वा योषितस्तेषां परं हर्षमुपाययुः ..
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र शालिवाहनभूपतिः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Carrying off their women, they rejoiced exceedingly. / In the meantime, right there King Śālivāhana,

sanskrit_iast:
vikramādityapautraśca pitṛrājyaṃ gṛhītavān ..
jitvā śakāndurādharṣāṃścīnataittirideśajān .. 18 ..
meaning:
विक्रमादित्यपौत्रश्च पितृराज्यं गृहीतवान् ..
जित्वा शकान्दुराधर्षांश्चीनतैत्तिरिदेशजान् .. 18 ..
text_mt: the grandson of Vikramāditya, seized his ancestral kingdom. / Having defeated the invincible Śakas, those born in China and the Taittiri realm,

sanskrit_iast:
bāhlīkānkāmarūpāṃśca romajānkhurajā cchaṭhān ..
teṣāṃ kośāngṛhītvā ca daṃḍayogyānakārayat .. 19 ..
meaning:
बाह्लीकान्कामरूपांश्च रोमजान्खुरजा च्छठान् ..
तेषां कोशान्गृहीत्वा च दंडयोग्यानकारयत् .. 19 ..
text_mt: the Bāhlīkas, Kāmarūpas, and the treacherous folk born in Rome and Khura, / he seized their treasuries and made them liable to tribute.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpitā tena maryyādā mlecchāryāṇāṃ pṛthakpṛthak ..
siṃdhusthānamiti jñeyaṃ rāṣṭra māryyasya cottamam ..3.3.2.20..
meaning:
स्थापिता तेन मर्य्यादा म्लेच्छार्याणां पृथक्पृथक् ..
सिंधुस्थानमिति ज्ञेयं राष्ट्र मार्य्यस्य चोत्तमम् ..3.3.2.20..
text_mt: He established a boundary dividing the mlecchas and the Āryas: / the region known as Sindhusthāna was deemed the foremost land of the Ārya,

sanskrit_iast:
mlecchasthānaṃ paraṃ sindhoḥ kṛtaṃ tena mahātmanā ..
ekadā tu śakādhīśo himatuṃgaṃ samāyayau .. 21 ..
meaning:
म्लेच्छस्थानं परं सिन्धोः कृतं तेन महात्मना ..
एकदा तु शकाधीशो हिमतुंगं समाययौ .. 21 ..
text_mt: while the realm beyond the Indus was made by that great-souled one the abode of the mlecchas. / But on one occasion the lord of the Śakas came to the snowy peak.

sanskrit_iast:
hūṇadeśasya madhye vai giristhaṃ puruṣaṃ śubham ..
dadarśa balavānrājā gaurāṃgaṃ śvetavastrakam .. 22 ..
meaning:
हूणदेशस्य मध्ये वै गिरिस्थं पुरुषं शुभम् ..
ददर्श बलवान्राजा गौरांगं श्वेतवस्त्रकम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: In the midst of the Hūṇa country, the mighty king beheld / an auspicious person seated on a mountain, fair-complexioned and dressed in white garments.

sanskrit_iast:
ko bhavāniti taṃ prāha sa hovāca mudānvitaḥ ..
īśaputraṃ ca māṃ viddhi kumārīgarbhasaṃbhavam .. 23 ..
meaning:
को भवानिति तं प्राह स होवाच मुदान्वितः ..
ईशपुत्रं च मां विद्धि कुमारीगर्भसंभवम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: He said to him, 'Who are you?' and he, filled with joy, answered: / 'Know that I am the Son of God, born from the womb of a maiden,

sanskrit_iast:
mlecchadharmasya vaktāraṃ satyavrataparāyaṇam ..
iti śrutvā nṛpaḥ prāha dharmaḥ ko bhavato mataḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
म्लेच्छधर्मस्य वक्तारं सत्यव्रतपरायणम् ..
इति श्रुत्वा नृपः प्राह धर्मः को भवतो मतः .. 24 ..
text_mt: a teacher of the mleccha religion, devoted to the vow of truth.' / Having heard this, the king said: 'What religion is favoured by you?'

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvovāca mahārāja prāpte satyasya saṃkṣaye ..
nirmaryāde mlecchadeśe masīho'haṃ samāgataḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वोवाच महाराज प्राप्ते सत्यस्य संक्षये ..
निर्मर्यादे म्लेच्छदेशे मसीहोऽहं समागतः .. 25 ..
text_mt: Hearing [this], he said: 'O great king, when truth had fallen into ruin / in the lawless land of the mlecchas, I arrived as the Messiah.

sanskrit_iast:
īśāmasī ca dasyūnāṃ prādurbhūtā bhayaṃkarī ..
tāmahaṃ mlecchataḥ prāpya masīhatvamupāgataḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
ईशामसी च दस्यूनां प्रादुर्भूता भयंकरी ..
तामहं म्लेच्छतः प्राप्य मसीहत्वमुपागतः .. 26 ..
text_mt: A terrible [darkness of] Jesus-the-Messiah had appeared among the robbers; / receiving it from the mlecchas, I attained Messiahship.

sanskrit_iast:
mleccheṣu sthāpito dharmo mayā tacchṛṇu bhūpate ..
mānasaṃ nirmalaṃ kṛtvā malaṃ dehe śubhāśubham ..27.
meaning:
म्लेच्छेषु स्थापितो धर्मो मया तच्छृणु भूपते ..
मानसं निर्मलं कृत्वा मलं देहे शुभाशुभम् ..27.
text_mt: The religion established by me among the mlecchas—hear that, O protector of the earth: / having purified the mind and cleansed the body of auspicious and inauspicious impurities,

sanskrit_iast:
naigamaṃ japamāsthāya japeta nirmalaṃ param..
nyāyena satyavacasā manasaikyena mānavaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
नैगमं जपमास्थाय जपेत निर्मलं परम्..
न्यायेन सत्यवचसा मनसैक्येन मानवः .. 28 ..
text_mt: taking recourse in Vedic repetition of sacred texts, one should repeat the pure, supreme [name]. / A man, with justice, truthful speech, and singleness of mind,

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānena pūjayedīśaṃ sūryamaṃḍalasaṃsthitam .
acalo'yaṃ prabhuḥ sākṣāttathā sūryocalaḥ sadā .. 29 ..
meaning:
ध्यानेन पूजयेदीशं सूर्यमंडलसंस्थितम् .
अचलोऽयं प्रभुः साक्षात्तथा सूर्योचलः सदा .. 29 ..
text_mt: should worship through meditation the Lord abiding in the solar orb. / This Lord is truly immovable, and the sun is ever moving;

sanskrit_iast:
tattvānāṃ calabhūtānāṃ karṣaṇaḥ sa samaṃtataḥ ..
iti kṛtyena bhūpāla masīhā vilayaṃ gatā .. 3.3.2.30 ..
meaning:
तत्त्वानां चलभूतानां कर्षणः स समंततः ..
इति कृत्येन भूपाल मसीहा विलयं गता .. 3.3.2.30 ..
text_mt: He is the attractor on all sides of the elements that have become mobile. / By such practice, O protector of the earth, the Messiah-status dissolved [into the divine];

sanskrit_iast:
īśamūrtirhṛdi prāptā nityaśuddhā śivaṃkarī ..
īśāmasīha iti ca mama nāma pratiṣṭhitam .. 31 ..
meaning:
ईशमूर्तिर्हृदि प्राप्ता नित्यशुद्धा शिवंकरी ..
ईशामसीह इति च मम नाम प्रतिष्ठितम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: the form of God, eternally pure and auspicious, was attained within my heart, / and my name was established as Jesus the Messiah.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā sa bhūpālo natvā taṃ mlecchapūjakam..
sthāpayāmāsa ta tatra mlecchasthāne hi dāruṇe .. 32 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा स भूपालो नत्वा तं म्लेच्छपूजकम्..
स्थापयामास त तत्र म्लेच्छस्थाने हि दारुणे .. 32 ..
text_mt: Having heard this, the king bowed to that worshipful one among the mlecchas / and settled him right there in that harsh abode of the mlecchas.

sanskrit_iast:
svarājyaṃ prāptavānrājā hayamedhamacīkarat ..
rājyaṃ kṛtvā sa ṣaṣṭyabdaṃ svargalokamupāyayau..
svargate nṛpatau tasminyathā cāsīttathā śṛṇu .. 34 ..
meaning:
स्वराज्यं प्राप्तवान्राजा हयमेधमचीकरत् ..
राज्यं कृत्वा स षष्ट्यब्दं स्वर्गलोकमुपाययौ..
स्वर्गते नृपतौ तस्मिन्यथा चासीत्तथा शृणु .. 34 ..
text_mt: Having returned to his own kingdom, the king performed the horse sacrifice. / Having ruled for sixty years, he went to heaven. / Hear what took place when that king had departed to heaven:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīsūta uvāca.. ..
śālivāhanavaṃśe ca rājāno daśa cābhavan..
rājyaṃ paṃcaśatābdaṃ ca kṛtvā lokāntaraṃ yayuḥ.. 1..
meaning:
श्रीसूत उवाच.. ..
शालिवाहनवंशे च राजानो दश चाभवन्..
राज्यं पंचशताब्दं च कृत्वा लोकान्तरं ययुः.. 1..
text_mt: The venerable Sūta said: / In the lineage of Śālivāhana there were ten kings; / having ruled for five hundred years, they passed into the other world.
title: adhyāyaḥ 03

sanskrit_iast:
maryyādā kramato līnā jātā bhūmaṃḍale tadā..
bhūpatirdaśamo yo vai bhojarāja iti smṛtaḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā prakṣīṇamaryyādāṃ balī digvijayaṃ yayau .. 2 ..
meaning:
मर्य्यादा क्रमतो लीना जाता भूमंडले तदा..
भूपतिर्दशमो यो वै भोजराज इति स्मृतः ..
दृष्ट्वा प्रक्षीणमर्य्यादां बली दिग्विजयं ययौ .. 2 ..
text_mt: Gradually, the established order in the terrestrial orb vanished. / The tenth king is recalled as King Bhoja; / seeing the established order severely diminished, the mighty one set out on a world-conquest.

sanskrit_iast:
senayā daśasāhasryā kālidāsena saṃyutaḥ ..
tathānyairbrāhmaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ siṃdhupāramupāyayau .. 3 ..
meaning:
सेनया दशसाहस्र्या कालिदासेन संयुतः ..
तथान्यैर्ब्राह्मणैः सार्द्धं सिंधुपारमुपाययौ .. 3 ..
text_mt: Accompanied by an army of ten thousand and by Kālidāsa, / as well as along with other brahmins, he reached the further bank of the Indus.

sanskrit_iast:
jitvā gāṃdhārajānmlecchānkāśmīrānnāravāñchaṭhān ..
teṣāṃ prāpya mahākośaṃ daṃḍayogyānakārayat ..4..
meaning:
जित्वा गांधारजान्म्लेच्छान्काश्मीरान्नारवाञ्छठान् ..
तेषां प्राप्य महाकोशं दंडयोग्यानकारयत् ..4..
text_mt: Conquering the mlecchas of Gandhāra, the Kāśmīras, and the deceitful Nāravals, / he seized their vast treasuries and made them liable to tribute.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare mleccha ācāryyeṇa samanvitaḥ..
mahāmada iti khyātaḥ śiṣyaśākhāsamanvitaḥ..5..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे म्लेच्छ आचार्य्येण समन्वितः..
महामद इति ख्यातः शिष्यशाखासमन्वितः..5..
text_mt: In the meantime, a mleccha accompanied by his preceptor, / renowned as Mahāmada, [arrived] together with a branch of disciples.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpaścaiva mahādevaṃ marusthalanivāsinam..
gaṃgājalaiśca saṃsnāpya paṃcagavyasamanvitaiḥ..
caṃdanādibhirabhyarcya tuṣṭāva manasā haram..6..
meaning:
नृपश्चैव महादेवं मरुस्थलनिवासिनम्..
गंगाजलैश्च संस्नाप्य पंचगव्यसमन्वितैः..
चंदनादिभिरभ्यर्च्य तुष्टाव मनसा हरम्..6..
text_mt: The king bathed Mahādeva, the dweller in the desert, / with waters of the Gaṅgā combined with the five products of the cow, / worshipped him with sandalwood and other perfumes, and praised Hara in his heart.

sanskrit_iast:
bhojarāja uvāca..
namaste girijānātha marusthalanivāsine ..
tripurāsuranāśāya vahumāyāpravarttine .. 7 ..
meaning:
भोजराज उवाच..
नमस्ते गिरिजानाथ मरुस्थलनिवासिने ..
त्रिपुरासुरनाशाय वहुमायाप्रवर्त्तिने .. 7 ..
text_mt: King Bhoja said: / 'Salutations to you, O Lord of the Mountain's Daughter, dweller in the desert, / destroyer of the demon Tripura, instigator of manifold illusions!

sanskrit_iast:
mlecchairguptāya śuddhāya saccidānandarūpiṇe ..
tvaṃ māṃ hi kiṃkaraṃ viddhi śaraṇārthamupāgatam..8 ..
meaning:
म्लेच्छैर्गुप्ताय शुद्धाय सच्चिदानन्दरूपिणे ..
त्वं मां हि किंकरं विद्धि शरणार्थमुपागतम्..8 ..
text_mt: Concealed by the mlecchas, pure, whose nature is being, consciousness, and bliss— / know me indeed as your servant who has come for refuge.'

sanskrit_iast:
..sūta uvāca .. ..
iti śrutvā stavaṃ devaḥ śabdamāha nṛpāya tam ..
gaṃtavyaṃ bhojarājena mahākāleśvarasthale .. 9 ..
meaning:
..सूत उवाच .. ..
इति श्रुत्वा स्तवं देवः शब्दमाह नृपाय तम् ..
गंतव्यं भोजराजेन महाकालेश्वरस्थले .. 9 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having heard this hymn of praise, the god uttered these words to the king: / 'King Bhoja must proceed to the shrine of Mahākāleśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
mlecchaissudūṣitā bhūmirvāhīkā nāma viśrutā ..
āryyadharmo hi naivātra vāhīke deśadāruṇe .. 3.3.3.10 ..
meaning:
म्लेच्छैस्सुदूषिता भूमिर्वाहीका नाम विश्रुता ..
आर्य्यधर्मो हि नैवात्र वाहीके देशदारुणे .. 3.3.3.10 ..
text_mt: The land renowned as Vāhīka has been utterly defiled by the mlecchas; / indeed, the religion of the Āryas does not exist here in this dread Vāhīka land.

sanskrit_iast:
babhūvātra mahāmāyī yo'sau dagdho mayā purā..
tripuro balidaityena preṣitaḥ punarāgataḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
बभूवात्र महामायी योऽसौ दग्धो मया पुरा..
त्रिपुरो बलिदैत्येन प्रेषितः पुनरागतः .. 11 ..
text_mt: He who was a great illusionist and was burned by me in ancient times / has arisen here: Tripura, dispatched by the demon Bali, has returned again.

sanskrit_iast:
ayoniḥ sa varo mattaḥ prāptavāndaityavarddhanaḥ ..
mahāmada iti khyātaḥ paiśācakṛtitatparaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
अयोनिः स वरो मत्तः प्राप्तवान्दैत्यवर्द्धनः ..
महामद इति ख्यातः पैशाचकृतितत्परः .. 12 ..
text_mt: Having obtained from me a boon of non-womb birth, that enhancer of the demons, / renowned as Mahāmada, is intent on acts worthy of a piśāca.

sanskrit_iast:
nāgantavyaṃ tvayā bhūpa paiśāce deśadhūrtake ..
matprasādena bhūpāla tava śuddhiḥ prajāyate .. 13 ..
meaning:
नागन्तव्यं त्वया भूप पैशाचे देशधूर्तके ..
मत्प्रसादेन भूपाल तव शुद्धिः प्रजायते .. 13 ..
text_mt: You must not come, O king, into this roguish land of piśācas; / by my grace, O protector of the earth, your purification will be brought about.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā nṛpaścaiva svadeśānpunarāgamat..
mahāmadaśca taiḥ sārddhaṃ siṃdhutīramupāyayau .. 14 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा नृपश्चैव स्वदेशान्पुनरागमत्..
महामदश्च तैः सार्द्धं सिंधुतीरमुपाययौ .. 14 ..
text_mt: Having heard this, the king returned to his own lands; / and Mahāmada, along with his followers, arrived at the bank of the Indus.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca bhūpatiṃ premṇā māyāmadaviśāradaḥ ..
tava devo mahārāja mama dāsatvamāgataḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
उवाच भूपतिं प्रेम्णा मायामदविशारदः ..
तव देवो महाराज मम दासत्वमागतः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Skilled in the intoxication of illusion, he said with affection to the ruler of the earth: / 'O great king, your god has become my servant.

sanskrit_iast:
mamocchiṣṭhaṃ sabhuṃjīyādyathā tatpaśya bho nṛpa ..
iti śrutvā tathā dṛṣṭvā paraṃ vismayamāgataḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
ममोच्छिष्ठं सभुंजीयाद्यथा तत्पश्य भो नृप ..
इति श्रुत्वा तथा दृष्ट्वा परं विस्मयमागतः .. 16 ..
text_mt: See how he eats my leftovers, O king!' / Having heard this and seen it thus, [the king] fell into utmost astonishment;

sanskrit_iast: mlecchadharme matiścāsīttasya bhūpasya dāruṇe..17..
meaning: म्लेच्छधर्मे मतिश्चासीत्तस्य भूपस्य दारुणे..17..
text_mt: and the mind of that king was turned toward the terrible mleccha religion.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā kālidāsastu ruṣā prāha mahāmadam ..
māyā te nirmitā dhūrta nṛpamohanahetave .. 18 ..
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा कालिदासस्तु रुषा प्राह महामदम् ..
माया ते निर्मिता धूर्त नृपमोहनहेतवे .. 18 ..
text_mt:
Hearing that, Kālidāsa angrily addressed Mahāmada:
“An illusion has been created by you, rogue, in order to delude the king!

sanskrit_iast:
haniṣyāmi durācāraṃ vāhīkaṃ puruṣādhamam ...
ityuktvā sa dvijaḥ śrīmānnavārṇajapatatparaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
हनिष्यामि दुराचारं वाहीकं पुरुषाधमम् ...
इत्युक्त्वा स द्विजः श्रीमान्नवार्णजपतत्परः .. 19 ..
text_mt:
I shall kill that wicked, lowest of men from the Vāhīka [country]!”
Having spoken thus, that glorious twice-born devoted himself to the recitation of the nine-syllabled mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
japtvā daśasahasraṃ ca taddaśāṃśaṃ juhāva saḥ ..
bhasma bhūtvā sa māyāvī mlecchadevatvamāgataḥ..3.3.3.20...
meaning:
जप्त्वा दशसहस्रं च तद्दशांशं जुहाव सः ..
भस्म भूत्वा स मायावी म्लेच्छदेवत्वमागतः..3.3.3.20...
text_mt:
Reciting it ten thousand times, he offered a tenth of that in the fire.
Reduced to ashes, that illusionist attained the status of a god of the Mlecchas.

sanskrit_iast:
bhayabhītāstu tacchiṣyā deśaṃ vāhīkamāyayuḥ ..
gṛhītvā svagurorbhasma madahīnatvamāgatam .. 21 ..
meaning:
भयभीतास्तु तच्छिष्या देशं वाहीकमाययुः ..
गृहीत्वा स्वगुरोर्भस्म मदहीनत्वमागतम् .. 21 ..
text_mt:
Terrified, his disciples returned to the Vāhīka land,
taking the ashes of their guru who had been subdued.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpitaṃ taiśca bhūmadhye tatroṣurmadatatparāḥ ...
madahīnaṃ puraṃ jātaṃ teṣāṃ tīrthaṃ samaṃ smṛtam .. 22 ..
meaning:
स्थापितं तैश्च भूमध्ये तत्रोषुर्मदतत्पराः ...
मदहीनं पुरं जातं तेषां तीर्थं समं स्मृतम् .. 22 ..
text_mt:
It was placed by them in the ground, and there they dwelt, devoted to intoxication.
A city called Madahīna arose, considered by them an equal pilgrimage site.

sanskrit_iast:
rātrau sa devarūpaśca bahumāyāviśāradaḥ ..
paiśācaṃ dehamāsthāya bhojarājaṃ hi so'bravīt..23..
meaning:
रात्रौ स देवरूपश्च बहुमायाविशारदः ..
पैशाचं देहमास्थाय भोजराजं हि सोऽब्रवीत्..23..
text_mt:
At night, having assumed a divine form, skilled in many illusions,
and having taken on a ghostly body, he spoke to King Bhoja:

sanskrit_iast:
āryyadharmo hi te rājansarvadharmottamaḥ smṛtaḥ..
īśājñayā kariṣyāmi paiśācaṃ dharmadāruṇam .. 24 ..
meaning:
आर्य्यधर्मो हि ते राजन्सर्वधर्मोत्तमः स्मृतः..
ईशाज्ञया करिष्यामि पैशाचं धर्मदारुणम् .. 24 ..
text_mt:
“O King, the Āryan religion is considered the highest of all religions.
By the command of the Lord, I will establish a terrible ghostly religion.

sanskrit_iast:
liṃgacchedī śikhāhīnaḥ śmaśrudhārī sa dūṣakaḥ ..
uccālāpī sarvabhakṣī bhaviṣyati jano mama .. 25 ..
meaning:
लिंगच्छेदी शिखाहीनः श्मश्रुधारी स दूषकः ..
उच्चालापी सर्वभक्षी भविष्यति जनो मम .. 25 ..
text_mt:
My people shall cut the foreskin, lack a tuft of hair, bear a beard, and be polluters;
they will speak loudly and eat everything.

sanskrit_iast:
vinā kaulaṃ ca paśavasteṣāṃ bhakṣyā matā mama ..
musalenaiva saṃskāraḥ kuśairiva bhaviṣyati .. 26 ..
meaning:
विना कौलं च पशवस्तेषां भक्ष्या मता मम ..
मुसलेनैव संस्कारः कुशैरिव भविष्यति .. 26 ..
text_mt:
Except without a rite, animals will be considered edible by them;
their purification will be by a pestle, just as with kuśa grass.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānmusalavanto hi jātayo dharmadūṣakāḥ ..
iti paiśācadharmaśca bhaviṣyati mayā kṛtaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
तस्मान्मुसलवन्तो हि जातयो धर्मदूषकाः ..
इति पैशाचधर्मश्च भविष्यति मया कृतः .. 27 ..
text_mt:
Therefore, they will be the Musalavān peoples, defilers of righteousness.
Thus this ghostly religion will be established by me.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā prayayau devaḥ sa rājā gehamāyayau ..
trivarṇe sthāpitā vāṇī sāṃskṛtī svargadāyinī .. 28 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा प्रययौ देवः स राजा गेहमाययौ ..
त्रिवर्णे स्थापिता वाणी सांस्कृती स्वर्गदायिनी .. 28 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, the god departed, and the king returned home.
Among the three castes, the Sanskrit speech that yields heaven was established.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdreṣu prākṛtī bhāṣā sthāpitā tena dhīmatā ..
paṃcāśadabdakālaṃ tu rājyaṃ kṛtvā divaṃ gataḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
शूद्रेषु प्राकृती भाषा स्थापिता तेन धीमता ..
पंचाशदब्दकालं तु राज्यं कृत्वा दिवं गतः .. 29 ..
text_mt:
Among the Śūdras, the Prakrit speech was established by that wise king.
Having ruled the kingdom for fifty years, he went to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpitā tena maryyādā sarvadevopamāninī ..
āryyāvartaḥ puṇyabhūmirmadhyaṃ viṃdhyahimālayoḥ .. 3.3.3.30 ..
meaning:
स्थापिता तेन मर्य्यादा सर्वदेवोपमानिनी ..
आर्य्यावर्तः पुण्यभूमिर्मध्यं विंध्यहिमालयोः .. 3.3.3.30 ..
text_mt:
He established the proper order resembling that of all the gods:
Āryāvarta, the sacred land, is the region between the Vindhya and the Himālaya.

sanskrit_iast:
āryya varṇāḥ sthitāstatra viṃdhyānte varṇasaṃkarāḥ ..
narā musalavantaśca sthāpitāḥ siṃdhupārajāḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
आर्य्य वर्णाः स्थितास्तत्र विंध्यान्ते वर्णसंकराः ..
नरा मुसलवन्तश्च स्थापिताः सिंधुपारजाः .. 31 ..
text_mt:
The Āryan castes dwelt there, and mixed castes at the border of the Vindhyas;
and the Musalavān men were placed beyond the Indus River.

sanskrit_iast:
barbare tuṣadeśe ca dvīpe nānāvidhe tathā ..
īśāmasīhadharmmāśca surai rājñaiva saṃsthitāḥ .. 32 ..
śrīsūta uvāca.. ..
śālivāhanavaṃśe ca rājāno daśa cābhavan..
rājyaṃ paṃcaśatābdaṃ ca kṛtvā lokāntaraṃ yayuḥ.. 1..
maryyādā kramato līnā jātā bhūmaṃḍale tadā..
bhūpatirdaśamo yo vai bhojarāja iti smṛtaḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā prakṣīṇamaryyādāṃ balī digvijayaṃ yayau .. 2 ..
senayā daśasāhasryā kālidāsena saṃyutaḥ ..
tathānyairbrāhmaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ siṃdhupāramupāyayau .. 3 ..
jitvā gāṃdhārajānmlecchānkāśmīrānnāravāñchaṭhān ..
teṣāṃ prāpya mahākośaṃ daṃḍayogyānakārayat ..4..
etasminnantare mleccha ācāryyeṇa samanvitaḥ..
mahāmada iti khyātaḥ śiṣyaśākhāsamanvitaḥ..5..
nṛpaścaiva mahādevaṃ marusthalanivāsinam..
gaṃgājalaiśca saṃsnāpya paṃcagavyasamanvitaiḥ..
caṃdanādibhirabhyarcya tuṣṭāva manasā haram..6..
meaning:
बर्बरे तुषदेशे च द्वीपे नानाविधे तथा ..
ईशामसीहधर्म्माश्च सुरै राज्ञैव संस्थिताः .. 32 ..
श्रीसूत उवाच.. ..
शालिवाहनवंशे च राजानो दश चाभवन्..
राज्यं पंचशताब्दं च कृत्वा लोकान्तरं ययुः.. 1..
मर्य्यादा क्रमतो लीना जाता भूमंडले तदा..
भूपतिर्दशमो यो वै भोजराज इति स्मृतः ..
दृष्ट्वा प्रक्षीणमर्य्यादां बली दिग्विजयं ययौ .. 2 ..
सेनया दशसाहस्र्या कालिदासेन संयुतः ..
तथान्यैर्ब्राह्मणैः सार्द्धं सिंधुपारमुपाययौ .. 3 ..
जित्वा गांधारजान्म्लेच्छान्काश्मीरान्नारवाञ्छठान् ..
तेषां प्राप्य महाकोशं दंडयोग्यानकारयत् ..4..
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे म्लेच्छ आचार्य्येण समन्वितः..
महामद इति ख्यातः शिष्यशाखासमन्वितः..5..
नृपश्चैव महादेवं मरुस्थलनिवासिनम्..
गंगाजलैश्च संस्नाप्य पंचगव्यसमन्वितैः..
चंदनादिभिरभ्यर्च्य तुष्टाव मनसा हरम्..6..
text_mt:
In Barbara, the Tuṣa land, and various continents,
the religions of Īśāmasīha were maintained by the gods and by kings.
Śrī Sūta said:
In the lineage of Śālivāhana there were ten kings;
having ruled the kingdom for five hundred years, they departed to the other world.
The proper order gradually collapsed on the earth at that time.
The tenth king, remembered as King Bhoja,
seeing the decline of the proper order, set out strong on a world conquest.
Accompanied by an army of ten thousand and with Kālidāsa,
and together with other Brahmins, he reached the other bank of the Indus.
Having conquered the Mlecchas born in Gandhāra, the Kashmirians, and the deceitful Arabs,
and having seized their great treasury, he made them fit for punishment.
Meanwhile, accompanied by a teacher,
a Mleccha known as Mahāmada, together with a band of disciples, [appeared].
And the king bathed Mahādeva, who dwells in the desert,
with waters of the Gaṅgā mixed with the five products of the cow;
having worshipped Hara with sandalwood and other offerings, he praised him in his mind.

sanskrit_iast:
bhojarāja uvāca..
namaste girijānātha marusthalanivāsine ..
tripurāsuranāśāya vahumāyāpravarttine .. 7 ..
mlecchairguptāya śuddhāya saccidānandarūpiṇe ..
tvaṃ māṃ hi kiṃkaraṃ viddhi śaraṇārthamupāgatam..8 ..

text_mt:
King Bhoja said:
“Salutations to you, Lord of the Daughter of the Mountain, Dweller in the desert,
Destroyer of the demon Tripura, Initiator of many illusions!
Concealed by Mlecchas, pure, whose nature is being, consciousness, and bliss!
Know me as your servant, who has come for refuge.”
Sūta said:
Having heard this hymn of praise, the god uttered these words to the king:
“King Bhoja must go to the place of Mahākāleśvara.
This land, known as Vāhīka, has been utterly defiled by Mlecchas;
indeed, the Āryan religion does not exist in this terrible Vāhīka land.
Here arose that great illusionist whom I burned long ago;
Tripura, sent by the demon Bali, has come once again.
He of non-uterine birth, who increases the demons, received a boon from me;
known as Mahāmada, he is intent upon ghostly actions.
You must not go, O King, to that deceptive, ghostly land;
by my grace, O protector of the earth, your purification will take place.”

text_mt:
Having heard this, the king returned to his own country;
and Mahāmada, along with his followers, arrived at the bank of the Indus.
Skilled in illusion and arrogance, he spoke affectionately to the king:
“O Great King, your god has become my servant!
He shall eat my leftovers—see that, O King!”
Having heard that and having seen it thus, [the king] was filled with supreme astonishment.
And the mind of that king turned toward the dreadful religion of the Mlecchas.
Hearing that, Kālidāsa angrily addressed Mahāmada:
“An illusion has been created by you, rogue, in order to delude the king!
I shall kill that wicked, lowest of men from the Vāhīka [country]!”
Having spoken thus, that glorious twice-born devoted himself to the recitation of the nine-syllabled mantra.
Reciting it ten thousand times, he offered a tenth of that in the fire.
Reduced to ashes, that illusionist attained the status of a god of the Mlecchas.
Terrified, his disciples returned to the Vāhīka land,
taking the ashes of their guru who had been subdued.

text_mt:
It was placed by them in the ground, and there they dwelt, devoted to intoxication.
A city called Madahīna arose, considered by them an equal pilgrimage site.
At night, having assumed a divine form, skilled in many illusions,
and having taken on a ghostly body, he spoke to King Bhoja:
“O King, the Āryan religion is considered the highest of all religions.
By the command of the Lord, I will establish a terrible ghostly religion.
My people shall cut the foreskin, lack a tuft of hair, bear a beard, and be polluters;
they will speak loudly and eat everything.
Except without a rite, animals will be considered edible by them;
their purification will be by a pestle, just as with kuśa grass.
Therefore, they will be the Musalavān peoples, defilers of righteousness.
Thus this ghostly religion will be established by me.”
Having spoken thus, the god departed, and the king returned home.
Among the three castes, the Sanskrit speech that yields heaven was established.

The Prakrit language was established among the Śūdras by that wise king. / Having ruled for a period of fifty years, he went to heaven.
A boundary was established by him, respected by all the gods: / Āryāvarta is the holy land, lying between the Vindhyas and the Himalayas.
The noble classes were settled there, and mixed classes at the edge of the Vindhyas; / the people who possess clubs (Musalmāns) were settled beyond the Indus,
and likewise in Barbara, the Tuṣa country, and various islands. / The faiths of Īśā Masīha (Jesus Christ) were established there by the gods through the king.

Then an alliance was made by the two [brothers] together with Tālana; / the three heroes came to put Jayacandra to the test.
Sūta said: / When King Bhoja had gone to heaven, seven kings were born in his lineage; / short-lived and weak, they died within the space of three hundred years.
During their rule, the earth came to possess many kings. / King Vīrasiṃha is proclaimed as the seventh [among them].
In his lineage three kings died within the space of two hundred years; / King Gaṅgāsiṃha is proclaimed as the tenth.
That king ruled his kingdom righteously in the Kalpakṣetra. / In the Antarvedī region, in Kānyakubja, Jayacandra was king,
and in Indraprastha was Aṅgapāla, born of the Tomara lineage; / and there were many other kings who ruled villages and realms.
The expansion of the Agni lineage became exceedingly powerful: / reaching the abode of Kapila in the east, the edge of Vāhīka in the west,
