They were performers of the agnihotra, seekers of the welfare of cows and Brahmins; / they became equal to the Dvāpara age, proficient in religious duties.
A time equal to the age named Dvāpara turned everywhere: / in every house wealth was established, and righteousness in every person.
In every village a deity was established, and in every country a sacrifice; / the Mlecchas, performing the Aryan dharma, were turned in every direction.
Seeing this, the terrible Kali, along with his Mleccha woman, became fearful; / reaching the Blue Mountain (Nīlādri), the intelligent one sought refuge in Hari.
For a period of twelve years he was devoted to the yoga of meditation; / through meditation, having seen Kṛṣṇa, the eternal reality, consciousness, and bliss,
he praised Hari there with his mind, accompanied by Rādhā— / the ancient, ageless, eternal dweller of Vṛndāvana.

text_mt:
Kali said: / Accept my prostration with eight limbs, like a staff, O Lord and Master! / Protect me who have come for refuge to your feet, O treasure of mercy!
You are indeed the remover of all sins, Hari, the maker of all time; / you were white in the Satya age, and of red form in the Tretā.
In the Dvāpara you were of yellow form, and Kṛṣṇa in my destined time; / my sons are known as the Mlecchas, but they have taken to the Aryan dharma.
My four abodes, O Lord—gambling, liquor, gold, / and womanising—have been destroyed by the Kṣatriyas of the Fire lineage (Agrivaṃśa).
My body abandoned, my family abandoned, my kingdom abandoned, O Janārdana, / holding fast to your lotus feet, I have taken refuge in you.
Having heard this, the blessed Lord Kṛṣṇa laughed and said to him: / 'O Kali, for your protection I shall be born in Mahāvatī.
A portion of mine, descending upon the earth, will destroy the exceedingly powerful ones; / he will establish kings of the Mleccha lineage upon the face of the earth.'

text_mt:
Having spoken thus, the Lord visibly disappeared right there; / Kali, for his part, together with his Mleccha woman, attained supreme joy.
In the meantime, O Brahmin, hear what took place: / in the village of Vāksara, there was an Ābhīrī known by the name of Vratapā.
Indeed, she performed the excellent Navadurgā vrata for nine years; / pleased, Caṇḍikā said: 'Choose a boon, O beautiful lady!'
She said to her: 'If a boon is to be given to me by you, O Mother and Goddess, / let two boys equal to Rāma and Kṛṣṇa be born in my lineage.'
Having said, 'So be it,' that goddess vanished right there; / a king named Vasumān became infatuated with her beauty.
Having married her according to dharma, the king housed her in his own palace; / from the king, two sons were born of her: the elder was Deśarāja,
and the younger was Vatsarāja, equal to a hundred elephants in strength; / having conquered the lands of Magadha, the two possessed kingdoms.
A Mleccha remembered as Śatayatta was a heroic lord of the forest-region; / his son, born by Śiva’s command as a portion of Bhīmasena, was Vīraṇa.

His upward leap was indeed the height of a palmyra tree; / he was made famous by Śatayatta under the name Tālana.
With those two kings, there took place a battle that made the hair stand on end; / in battle, the extremely powerful Tālana was reduced to defeat.
Then friendship was formed between the two along with Tālana; / to test Jayacandra, the three heroes set out.

sanskrit_iast:
no cenmacchastrakaṭhinaiḥ kṣayaṃ yāsyaṃti sainikāḥ ..
iti jñātvā mahīrājo viṃśallakṣādhipo balī .. 31 ..
meaning:
नो चेन्मच्छस्त्रकठिनैः क्षयं यास्यंति सैनिकाः ..
इति ज्ञात्वा महीराजो विंशल्लक्षाधिपो बली .. 31 ..
text_mt: Otherwise, your soldiers shall perish by my hard weapons." / Knowing this, the mighty King Mahīrāja, lord of two million [men],

sanskrit_iast:
dūtaṃ vai preṣayāmāsa rājarājo madotkaṭaḥ ..
jayacaṃdra mahīpāla sāvadhānaṃ śṛṇuṣva tat .. 32 ..
meaning:
दूतं वै प्रेषयामास राजराजो मदोत्कटः ..
जयचंद्र महीपाल सावधानं शृणुष्व तत् .. 32 ..
text_mt: a king of kings arrogant with pride, sent a messenger: / "O King Jayacandra, listen carefully to this:

sanskrit_iast:
yadā nirākṛtā dhūrtā mayā te caṃdravaṃśinaḥ ..
tataḥ prabhṛti senāṅgaṃ viṃśallakṣaṃ samāhṛtam..33..
meaning:
यदा निराकृता धूर्ता मया ते चंद्रवंशिनः ..
ततः प्रभृति सेनाङ्गं विंशल्लक्षं समाहृतम्..33..
text_mt: From the time those knaves of the Lunar dynasty were expelled by me, / an army of two million has been assembled.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā ṣoḍaśalakṣaṃ ca yuddhasainyaṃ samāhṛtam ..
sarve vai bhārate bhūpā daṃḍayogyāśca me sadā ..34..
meaning:
त्वया षोडशलक्षं च युद्धसैन्यं समाहृतम् ..
सर्वे वै भारते भूपा दंडयोग्याश्च मे सदा ..34..
text_mt: You have gathered an army of sixteen hundred thousand for war. / All the kings in Bhārata are ever subject to punishment by me.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavānna daṃḍyo balavānkaraṃ me dātumarhati ..
no cenmatkaṭhinairbāṇaiḥ kṣayaṃ yāsyaṃti sainikāḥ ..35..
meaning:
भवान्न दंड्यो बलवान्करं मे दातुमर्हति ..
नो चेन्मत्कठिनैर्बाणैः क्षयं यास्यंति सैनिकाः ..35..
text_mt: You, who are powerful, are not to be punished, [yet] you ought to pay me tribute. / Otherwise, your soldiers shall perish by my hard arrows."

sanskrit_iast:
iti jñātvā tayorghoraṃ vairaṃ cāsīnmahītale ..
bhūmirājaśca valavāñjayacandrabhayārditaḥ ..36..
meaning:
इति ज्ञात्वा तयोर्घोरं वैरं चासीन्महीतले ..
भूमिराजश्च वलवाञ्जयचन्द्रभयार्दितः ..36..
text_mt: Realising this, terrible enmity arose between the two on earth. / And the mighty Bhūmirāja was distressed by fear of Jayacandra,

sanskrit_iast:
jayacaṃdraśca balavānpṛthivīrājabhīrukaḥ ..
jayacandraścāryadeśamarddharāṣṭramamakalpayat.. ..37..
meaning:
जयचंद्रश्च बलवान्पृथिवीराजभीरुकः ..
जयचन्द्रश्चार्यदेशमर्द्धराष्ट्रममकल्पयत्.. ..37..
text_mt: while the mighty Jayacandra was afraid of Pṛthivīrāja. / Jayacandra held half the realm of the land of the Āryas,

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivīrāja evāsau tathārddhaṃ rāṣṭramānayat ..
evaṃ jātaṃ tayorvairamagnivaṃśapraṇāśanam ..38..
meaning:
पृथिवीराज एवासौ तथार्द्धं राष्ट्रमानयत् ..
एवं जातं तयोर्वैरमग्निवंशप्रणाशनम् ..38..
text_mt: and Pṛthivīrāja brought the [other] half of the realm under his control. / In this way arose their enmity, which brought about the destruction of the Fire dynasty.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ekadā ratnabhānurhi mahīrājena pālitām ..
diśaṃ yāmyāṃ sa vai jitvā teṣāṃ kośānupāharat ..1..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एकदा रत्नभानुर्हि महीराजेन पालिताम् ..
दिशं याम्यां स वै जित्वा तेषां कोशानुपाहरत् ..1..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Once Ratnabhānu conquered the southern region / ruled by Mahīrāja and carried off their treasures.
title: adhyāyaḥ 06

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājastu tacchutvā paraṃ vismayamāgataḥ ..
ratnabhānośca tilako babhūva bahuvistaraḥ ..2..
meaning:
महीराजस्तु तच्छुत्वा परं विस्मयमागतः ..
रत्नभानोश्च तिलको बभूव बहुविस्तरः ..2..
text_mt: Hearing that, Mahīrāja was greatly astonished. / Ratnabhānu had an extensive coronation.

sanskrit_iast:
tilakā nāma vikhyātā yā tu vīravatī śubhā ..
śreṣṭhā dvādaśarājñīnāṃ jananī lakṣaṇasya vai .. 3 ..
meaning:
तिलका नाम विख्याता या तु वीरवती शुभा ..
श्रेष्ठा द्वादशराज्ञीनां जननी लक्षणस्य वै .. 3 ..
text_mt: His auspicious wife, heroic and renowned by the name Tilakā, / was the foremost of twelve queens, the mother of Lakṣaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
jayacaṃdrasya bhūpasya yoṣitaḥ ṣoḍaśābhavan ..
tāsāṃ na tanayo hyāsītpūrvakarmavipākataḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
जयचंद्रस्य भूपस्य योषितः षोडशाभवन् ..
तासां न तनयो ह्यासीत्पूर्वकर्मविपाकतः .. 4 ..
text_mt: King Jayacandra had sixteen wives; / through the ripening of past deeds, they had no son.

sanskrit_iast:
gauḍabhūpasya duhitā nāmnā divyavibhāvarī ..
jayacaṃdrasya mahiṣī taddāsī surabhānavī .. 5 ..
meaning:
गौडभूपस्य दुहिता नाम्ना दिव्यविभावरी ..
जयचंद्रस्य महिषी तद्दासी सुरभानवी .. 5 ..
text_mt: The daughter of the king of Gauḍa, named Divyavibhāvarī, / was Jayacandra's chief queen; her maidservant was Surabhānavī.

sanskrit_iast:
rūpayauvana saṃyuktā ratikeliviśāradā ..
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ sa nṛpaḥ kāmī bubhuje smarapīḍitaḥ ..6..
meaning:
रूपयौवन संयुक्ता रतिकेलिविशारदा ..
दृष्ट्वा तां स नृपः कामी बुभुजे स्मरपीडितः ..6..
text_mt: Endowed with beauty and youth, skilled in love-play, / the lustful king, seeing her, enjoyed her, afflicted by love.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ jātā sutā devī nāmnā saṃyoginī śubhā ..
dvādaśābdavayaḥ prāptā sā babhūva varāṃganā .. 7 ..
meaning:
तस्यां जाता सुता देवी नाम्ना संयोगिनी शुभा ..
द्वादशाब्दवयः प्राप्ता सा बभूव वरांगना .. 7 ..
text_mt: On her was born an auspicious daughter, a goddess named Saṃyoginī; / reaching twelve years of age, she became an exquisite woman.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ svayaṃvare rājāhvayadbhūpānmahāśubhān ..
bhūmirājastu balavāñchrutvā tadrūpamuttamam .. ..
vivāhārthe manaścāsīccaṃdrabhaṭṭamacodayat ..
maṃtripravara bho mitra caṃdrabhaṭṭa mama priya .. 9 ..
meaning:
तस्याः स्वयंवरे राजाह्वयद्भूपान्महाशुभान् ..
भूमिराजस्तु बलवाञ्छ्रुत्वा तद्रूपमुत्तमम् .. ..
विवाहार्थे मनश्चासीच्चंद्रभट्टमचोदयत् ..
मंत्रिप्रवर भो मित्र चंद्रभट्ट मम प्रिय .. 9 ..
text_mt: For her svayaṃvara, the king invited most auspicious monarchs. / But the mighty Bhūmirāja, hearing of her supreme beauty, / set his heart on marriage and sent Candra Bhaṭṭa: / "O best of ministers, O friend Candra Bhaṭṭa, dear to me,

sanskrit_iast:
kānyakubjapurīṃ prāpya manmūrtiṃ svarṇanirmitām.. ..
sthāpaya tvaṃ sabhāmadhye yadvṛttāṃtaṃ tu me vada .. 3.3.6.10 ..
meaning:
कान्यकुब्जपुरीं प्राप्य मन्मूर्तिं स्वर्णनिर्मिताम्.. ..
स्थापय त्वं सभामध्ये यद्वृत्तांतं तु मे वद .. 3.3.6.10 ..
text_mt: reach the city of Kānyakubja and set up an image of me made of gold / in the midst of the assembly, and tell me what occurs."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā caṃdrabhaṭṭo bhavānībhaktitatparaḥ ..
gatvā tatra bhṛguśreṣṭha yathā proktastathākarot .. 11 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा चंद्रभट्टो भवानीभक्तितत्परः ..
गत्वा तत्र भृगुश्रेष्ठ यथा प्रोक्तस्तथाकरोत् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, Candra Bhaṭṭa, devoted to Bhavānī, / went there, O best of the Bhṛgus, and did as he was told.

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃvare ca bhūpāśca nānādeśyāḥ samāgatāḥ ..
tyaktvā saṃyoginī tānvai nṛpamūrtivimohitā .. 12 ..
meaning:
स्वयंवरे च भूपाश्च नानादेश्याः समागताः ..
त्यक्त्वा संयोगिनी तान्वै नृपमूर्तिविमोहिता .. 12 ..
text_mt: And to the svayaṃvara kings arrived from diverse lands. / Rejecting them, Saṃyoginī was captivated by the statue of the king.

sanskrit_iast:
pitaraṃ prāha kāmākṣī yasya mūrtiriyaṃ nṛpa ..
bhaviṣyati sa me bhartā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
पितरं प्राह कामाक्षी यस्य मूर्तिरियं नृप ..
भविष्यति स मे भर्ता सर्वलक्षणलक्षितः .. 13 ..
text_mt: The lovely-eyed girl said to her father: "O king, he whose image this is / shall be my husband, marked with all auspicious signs."

sanskrit_iast:
jayacaṃdrastu tacchrutvā caṃdrabhadramuvāca tam ..
yadi te bhūpatiścaiva sarvasainyasamanvitaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
जयचंद्रस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा चंद्रभद्रमुवाच तम् ..
यदि ते भूपतिश्चैव सर्वसैन्यसमन्वितः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Hearing that, Jayacandra said to Candrabhadra: / "If your king, accompanied by his entire army,

sanskrit_iast:
sañjayedyoginīmetāṃ tarhi me'tipriyo bhavet ..
caṃdrabhaṭṭastu tacchrutvā tattu sarvamavarṇayat .. 15 ..
meaning:
सञ्जयेद्योगिनीमेतां तर्हि मेऽतिप्रियो भवेत् ..
चंद्रभट्टस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा तत्तु सर्वमवर्णयत् .. 15 ..
text_mt: can win this Yoginī, then he shall be very dear to me." / Hearing that, Candra Bhaṭṭa related all of it [to him].

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivīrāja evāsau śrutvā sainyamacodayat ..
ekalakṣā gajāstasya saptalakṣāsturaṃgamāḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
पृथिवीराज एवासौ श्रुत्वा सैन्यमचोदयत् ..
एकलक्षा गजास्तस्य सप्तलक्षास्तुरंगमाः .. 16 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, Pṛthivīrāja mobilised his army: / his elephants were one hundred thousand, his horses seven hundred thousand,

sanskrit_iast:
rathāḥ paṃcasahasrāśca dhanurbāṇaviśāradāḥ ..
lakṣāḥ padātayo jñeyā dvādaśaiva mahābalāḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
रथाः पंचसहस्राश्च धनुर्बाणविशारदाः ..
लक्षाः पदातयो ज्ञेया द्वादशैव महाबलाः .. 17 ..
text_mt: his chariots were five thousand, [manned by warriors] skilled with bow and arrow, / and his foot soldiers are to be known as twelve hundred thousand, of great might.

sanskrit_iast:
rājānastriśatānyeva mahīrājapadānugāḥ ..
sārddhaṃ dvābhyāṃ ca bandhubhyāṃ kānyakubje nṛpo'gamat .. 18 ..
meaning:
राजानस्त्रिशतान्येव महीराजपदानुगाः ..
सार्द्धं द्वाभ्यां च बन्धुभ्यां कान्यकुब्जे नृपोऽगमत् .. 18 ..
text_mt: Three hundred kings followed in Mahīrāja's footsteps; / along with his two kinsmen, the king marched to Kānyakubja.

sanskrit_iast:
dhundhukāraśca tadbandhurgajānīkapatissadā ..
hayānīkapatiḥ kṛṣṇa kumāro balavattaraḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
धुन्धुकारश्च तद्बन्धुर्गजानीकपतिस्सदा ..
हयानीकपतिः कृष्ण कुमारो बलवत्तरः .. 19 ..
text_mt: His kinsman Dhundhukāra was ever the commander of the elephant division; / the commander of the cavalry division was the exceedingly strong Prince Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
padātīnāṃ nṛpatayaḥ patayastatra cābhavan ..
mahānkolāhalo jātaḥ sthalīṃ śūnyāmakārayan .. 3.3.6.20 ..
meaning:
पदातीनां नृपतयः पतयस्तत्र चाभवन् ..
महान्कोलाहलो जातः स्थलीं शून्यामकारयन् .. 3.3.6.20 ..
text_mt: Kings were the commanders of the infantry there; / a tremendous uproar arose, and they emptied the countryside.

sanskrit_iast:
viṃśatkośapramāṇena sthitaṃ tasya mahābalam ..
jayacaṃdrastu saṃjñāya mahīrājasya cāgamam .. 21 ..
meaning:
विंशत्कोशप्रमाणेन स्थितं तस्य महाबलम् ..
जयचंद्रस्तु संज्ञाय महीराजस्य चागमम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: His mighty army encamped across an extent of twenty kos. / Jayacandra, learning of Mahīrāja's arrival,

sanskrit_iast:
svasainyaṃ kalpayāmāsa lakṣaṣoḍaśasaṃmitam ..
ekalakṣā gajāstasya saptalakṣāḥ padātayaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
स्वसैन्यं कल्पयामास लक्षषोडशसंमितम् ..
एकलक्षा गजास्तस्य सप्तलक्षाः पदातयः .. 22 ..
text_mt: marshalled his own army, numbering sixteen hundred thousand: / his elephants were one hundred thousand, his foot soldiers seven hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
vājinaścāṣṭalakṣāśca sarvayuddhaviśāradāḥ ..
dviśatānyeva rājānaḥ prāptāstatra samāgame .. 23 ..
meaning:
वाजिनश्चाष्टलक्षाश्च सर्वयुद्धविशारदाः ..
द्विशतान्येव राजानः प्राप्तास्तत्र समागमे .. 23 ..
text_mt: and eight hundred thousand horses, all skilled in warfare. / Exactly two hundred kings arrived at that assembly.

sanskrit_iast:
āgaskṛtaṃ mahīrājaṃ matvā te śuklavaṃśinaḥ ..
yuddhārthinaḥ sthitāstatra puramāgaskṛtaṃ hyabhūt .. 24 ..
meaning:
आगस्कृतं महीराजं मत्वा ते शुक्लवंशिनः ..
युद्धार्थिनः स्थितास्तत्र पुरमागस्कृतं ह्यभूत् .. 24 ..
text_mt: Considering Mahīrāja an offender, those of the Śukla lineage, / desiring war, stood there, for the city had indeed been offended.

sanskrit_iast:
īśanadyāḥ pare kūle taddolā sthapitā tadā ..
nānā vādyāni ramyāṇi tatra cakrurmahāravam .. 25 ..
meaning:
ईशनद्याः परे कूले तद्दोला स्थपिता तदा ..
नाना वाद्यानि रम्याणि तत्र चक्रुर्महारवम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Her palanquin was then placed on the other bank of the river Īśā; / there various pleasant musical instruments made a great sound.

sanskrit_iast:
ratnabhānurgajānīke rūpānīke hi lakṣaṇaḥ ..
tasyāṃ senāpatibhyāṃ tau saṃguptau balavattarau .. 26 ..
meaning:
रत्नभानुर्गजानीके रूपानीके हि लक्षणः ..
तस्यां सेनापतिभ्यां तौ संगुप्तौ बलवत्तरौ .. 26 ..
text_mt: Ratnabhānu [stood] in the elephant army, and Lakṣaṇa in the infantry division. / They, exceedingly strong, were protected by the two generals of that [army].

sanskrit_iast:
pradyotaścaiva vidyoto ratnabhānuṃ rarakṣatuḥ ..
bhīṣmaḥ parimalaścaiva lakṣaṇaṃ caṃdravaṃśajaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
प्रद्योतश्चैव विद्योतो रत्नभानुं ररक्षतुः ..
भीष्मः परिमलश्चैव लक्षणं चंद्रवंशजः .. 27 ..
text_mt: Pradyota and Vidyota protected Ratnabhānu; / and Bhīṣma and Parimala, born of the lunar dynasty, [protected] Lakṣaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūpāḥ padātisainye ca saṃsthitā madavihvalāḥ ..
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ dāruṇaṃ sainyasaṃkṣayam .. 28 ..
meaning:
भूपाः पदातिसैन्ये च संस्थिता मदविह्वलाः ..
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धं दारुणं सैन्यसंक्षयम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: The kings stood among the infantry forces, maddened with excitement. / And between the two [armies] arose a great battle, terrible and destructive to the troops.

sanskrit_iast:
hayā hayairmṛtā jātā gajāścaiva gajaistathā ..
padātayaḥ padātaiśca mṛtāścānye kramādraṇe .. 29 ..
meaning:
हया हयैर्मृता जाता गजाश्चैव गजैस्तथा ..
पदातयः पदातैश्च मृताश्चान्ये क्रमाद्रणे .. 29 ..
text_mt: Horses were killed by horses, and elephants by elephants; / foot soldiers were killed by foot soldiers, and others likewise in succession in the battle.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūpaiśca rakṣitāḥ sarve nirbhayā raṇamāyayuḥ ..
yāvatsūryaḥ sthito vyomni tāvadyuddhamavartata .. 3.3.6.30 ..
meaning:
भूपैश्च रक्षिताः सर्वे निर्भया रणमाययुः ..
यावत्सूर्यः स्थितो व्योम्नि तावद्युद्धमवर्तत .. 3.3.6.30 ..
text_mt: Protected by the kings, all went fearlessly into battle. / As long as the sun stood in the sky, so long did the battle continue.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ paṃcadinaṃ jātaṃ yuddhaṃ vīrajanakṣayam ..
gajā daśasahasraṇi hayā lakṣāṇi saṃkṣitāḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
एवं पंचदिनं जातं युद्धं वीरजनक्षयम् ..
गजा दशसहस्रणि हया लक्षाणि संक्षिताः .. 31 ..
text_mt: Thus for five days the battle went on, destroying heroic men. / Ten thousand elephants and hundreds of thousands of horses were slain.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcalakṣaṃ mahībharturhatāstatra padātayaḥ ..
rājāno dve śate tatra rathāśca triśataṃ tathā .. 32 ..
meaning:
पंचलक्षं महीभर्तुर्हतास्तत्र पदातयः ..
राजानो द्वे शते तत्र रथाश्च त्रिशतं तथा .. 32 ..
text_mt: Five hundred thousand foot soldiers of the lord of the earth were killed there, / along with two hundred kings and three hundred chariots.

sanskrit_iast:
kānyakubjādhipasyaiva gajā navasahasrakāḥ ..
sahasraikaṃ rathā jñeyāstrilakṣaṃ ca padātayaḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
कान्यकुब्जाधिपस्यैव गजा नवसहस्रकाः ..
सहस्रैकं रथा ज्ञेयास्त्रिलक्षं च पदातयः .. 33 ..
text_mt: Of the lord of Kānyakubja, nine thousand elephants, / one thousand chariots are to be known, and three hundred thousand foot soldiers,

sanskrit_iast:
ekalakṣaṃ hayāstatra mṛtāḥ svargapuraṃ yayuḥ ..
ṣaṣṭhāhe samanuprāpte pṛthivīrāja eva saḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
एकलक्षं हयास्तत्र मृताः स्वर्गपुरं ययुः ..
षष्ठाहे समनुप्राप्ते पृथिवीराज एव सः .. 34 ..
text_mt: [and] one hundred thousand horses died there and went to the city of heaven. / When the sixth day arrived, that very Pṛthivīrāja,

sanskrit_iast:
duḥkhito manasā devaṃ rudraṃ tuṣṭāva bhaktimān ..
saṃtuṣṭastu mahādevo mohayāmāsa tadbalam .. 35 ..
meaning:
दुःखितो मनसा देवं रुद्रं तुष्टाव भक्तिमान् ..
संतुष्टस्तु महादेवो मोहयामास तद्बलम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: pained in his mind, devoutly praised the god Rudra. / Mahādeva, well pleased, bewildered that army [of his enemy].

sanskrit_iast:
prasannastu mahīrājo gataḥ saṃyoginīṃ prati ..
dṛṣṭvā tatsundaraṃ rūpaṃ mumoha vasudhādhipaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
प्रसन्नस्तु महीराजो गतः संयोगिनीं प्रति ..
दृष्ट्वा तत्सुन्दरं रूपं मुमोह वसुधाधिपः .. 36 ..
text_mt: Glad at heart, Mahīrāja went towards Saṃyoginī. / Seeing her beautiful form, the ruler of the earth was enchanted.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃyoginī nṛpaṃ dṛṣṭvā mūrcchitā cābhavatkṣaṇāt ..
etasminnaṃtare rājā taddolāmanayadbalāt.. 37 ..
meaning:
संयोगिनी नृपं दृष्ट्वा मूर्च्छिता चाभवत्क्षणात् ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे राजा तद्दोलामनयद्बलात्.. 37 ..
text_mt: Seeing the king, Saṃyoginī fainted in an instant. / In the meantime, the king carried off her palanquin by force.

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma dehalīṃ bhūpaḥ sarvasainyasamanvitaḥ ..
yojanānte gate tasminbodhitāste madodbhaṭāḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
जगाम देहलीं भूपः सर्वसैन्यसमन्वितः ..
योजनान्ते गते तस्मिन्बोधितास्ते मदोद्भटाः .. 38 ..
text_mt: The king went to Dehalī, accompanied by all his troops. / When he had gone the distance of a yojana, those furious men awakened.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā naiva tadā dolāṃ prajagmurvegavattarāḥ ..
śrutvā kolāhalaṃ teṣāṃ mahīrājo nṛpottamaḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा नैव तदा दोलां प्रजग्मुर्वेगवत्तराः ..
श्रुत्वा कोलाहलं तेषां महीराजो नृपोत्तमः .. 39 ..
text_mt: Not seeing the palanquin then, they rushed forth with great speed. / Hearing their tumult, Mahīrāja, the best of kings,

sanskrit_iast:
arddhasainyaṃ ca saṃsthāpya svayaṃ gehamupāgamat ..
ubhau tadbhrātarau vīrau cārddhasainyasamanvitau .. 3.3.6.40 ..
meaning:
अर्द्धसैन्यं च संस्थाप्य स्वयं गेहमुपागमत् ..
उभौ तद्भ्रातरौ वीरौ चार्द्धसैन्यसमन्वितौ .. 3.3.6.40 ..
text_mt: stationed half his army and went home himself. / Both his heroic brothers, accompanied by half the army,

sanskrit_iast:
sūkarakṣetramāsādya yuddhāya samupasthitau ..
etasminnantare sarve pradyotādimahābalāḥ ..41..
meaning:
सूकरक्षेत्रमासाद्य युद्धाय समुपस्थितौ ..
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे सर्वे प्रद्योतादिमहाबलाः ..41..
text_mt: reached Sūkarakṣetra and drew up for battle. / In the meantime, all the mighty warriors such as Pradyota,

sanskrit_iast:
svasainyaiḥ saha saṃprāpya mahadyuddhamakārayan..
hayā hayaiśca saṃjagmurgajā atha gajaiḥ saha .. 42 ..
meaning:
स्वसैन्यैः सह संप्राप्य महद्युद्धमकारयन्..
हया हयैश्च संजग्मुर्गजा अथ गजैः सह .. 42 ..
text_mt: arriving with their own armies, engaged in a great battle. / Horses collided with horses, and elephants with elephants.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkulaśca mahānāsīddāruṇo lomaharṣaṇaḥ ..
dinānte saṃkṣayaṃ yātaṃ tayoścaiva mahadbalam .. 43 ..
meaning:
संकुलश्च महानासीद्दारुणो लोमहर्षणः ..
दिनान्ते संक्षयं यातं तयोश्चैव महद्बलम् .. 43 ..
text_mt: There was a great melee, terrible and hair-raising. / At the end of the day, their mighty armies were reduced to destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
bhayabhītā pare tatra jñātvā rātriṃ tamovṛtām ..
pradudruvurbhayādvīrā hataśeṣāstu dehalīm ..44 ..
meaning:
भयभीता परे तत्र ज्ञात्वा रात्रिं तमोवृताम् ..
प्रदुद्रुवुर्भयाद्वीरा हतशेषास्तु देहलीम् ..44 ..
text_mt: Frightened with fear, the survivors among the other heroes, knowing the night was covered in darkness, / fled in terror to Dehalī.

sanskrit_iast:
pradyotādyāśca te vīrā dehalīṃ prati saṃyayuḥ ..
punastayormahadyuddhaṃ hyabhavallomaharṣaṇam .. 45 ..
meaning:
प्रद्योताद्याश्च ते वीरा देहलीं प्रति संययुः ..
पुनस्तयोर्महद्युद्धं ह्यभवल्लोमहर्षणम् .. 45 ..
text_mt: Pradyota and those [other] heroes marched toward Dehalī. / Again a great battle occurred between them, causing the hair to stand on end.

sanskrit_iast:
dhuṃdhukāraśca pradyotaṃ hṛdi bāṇairatāḍayat ..
tribhiśca viṣanirdhūtairmūchitaḥ sa mamāra ca .. 46 ..
meaning:
धुंधुकारश्च प्रद्योतं हृदि बाणैरताडयत् ..
त्रिभिश्च विषनिर्धूतैर्मूछितः स ममार च .. 46 ..
text_mt: Dhundhukāra struck Pradyota in the chest with arrows; / struck by three [arrows] smeared with poison, he fainted and died.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrātaraṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā vidyotaśca mahāvalaḥ ..
ājagāma gajārūḍho dhuṃdhukāramatāḍayat .. 47 ..
meaning:
भ्रातरं निहतं दृष्ट्वा विद्योतश्च महावलः ..
आजगाम गजारूढो धुंधुकारमताडयत् .. 47 ..
text_mt: Seeing his brother slain, the mighty Vidyota / advanced mounted on an elephant and struck Dhundhukāra.

sanskrit_iast:
tribhiśca tomaraiḥ so'pi mūrchito bhūmimāgamat ..
mūrchitaṃ bhrātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā dhuṃdhukāraṃ mahābalam .. 48 ..
meaning:
त्रिभिश्च तोमरैः सोऽपि मूर्छितो भूमिमागमत् ..
मूर्छितं भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा धुंधुकारं महाबलम् .. 48 ..
text_mt: Struck by three javelins, he too fainted and fell to the ground. / Seeing his mighty brother Dhundhukāra fainted,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā kṛṣṇakumāro'sau gajasthastvarito yayau ..
rūpāviṣṭaśca taṃ vīraṃ bhallenaivamatāḍa yat .. .. 49 ..
meaning:
तदा कृष्णकुमारोऽसौ गजस्थस्त्वरितो ययौ ..
रूपाविष्टश्च तं वीरं भल्लेनैवमताड यत् .. .. 49 ..
text_mt: Kṛṣṇakumāra, mounted on an elephant, went swiftly at that moment, / and overcome with anger, he struck that hero with a spear.

sanskrit_iast:
bhallena tena saṃbhinno mṛtaḥ svargapuraṃ yayau ..
vidyote nihate tasmitsarvasainyacamūpatau .. 3.3.6.50 ..
meaning:
भल्लेन तेन संभिन्नो मृतः स्वर्गपुरं ययौ ..
विद्योते निहते तस्मित्सर्वसैन्यचमूपतौ .. 3.3.6.50 ..
text_mt: Pierced by that spear, he died and went to the city of heaven. / When Vidyota, the commander of their entire army, was slain,

sanskrit_iast:
ratnābhānurmahāvīro'yudhyattena samanvitaḥ ..
etasminnaṃtare rājā sahasragajasaṃyutaḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
रत्नाभानुर्महावीरोऽयुध्यत्तेन समन्वितः ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे राजा सहस्रगजसंयुतः .. 51 ..
text_mt: the great hero Ratnabhānu, joined by him, fought. / In the meantime, the king, accompanied by a thousand elephants,

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇaṃ sahitaṃ tābhyāṃ kruddhaṃ taṃ samayudhyata ..
śivadattavaro rājā bhīṣmaṃ parimalaṃ ruṣā .. .. 52 ..
meaning:
लक्षणं सहितं ताभ्यां क्रुद्धं तं समयुध्यत ..
शिवदत्तवरो राजा भीष्मं परिमलं रुषा .. .. 52 ..
text_mt: fought angrily against Lakṣaṇa along with the two of them. / The king, granted a boon by Śiva, in anger [struck] Bhīṣma and Parimala;

sanskrit_iast:
rudrāstrairmohayāmāsa lakṣaṇaṃ balavattaram ..
mūrchitāṃstānsamālokya ratnabhānuḥ śarairnijaiḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
रुद्रास्त्रैर्मोहयामास लक्षणं बलवत्तरम् ..
मूर्छितांस्तान्समालोक्य रत्नभानुः शरैर्निजैः .. 53 ..
text_mt: with Rudra-weapons he bewildered the mighty Lakṣaṇa. / Seeing them fainted, Ratnabhānu, with his own arrows,

sanskrit_iast:
dhuṃdhukāraṃ mahīrājaṃ vaiṣṇavaiḥ samamojayan ..
kṛṣṇako ratnabhānuśca yuyudhāte parasparam ..54..
meaning:
धुंधुकारं महीराजं वैष्णवैः सममोजयन् ..
कृष्णको रत्नभानुश्च युयुधाते परस्परम् ..54..
text_mt: bewildered Dhundhukāra and Mahīrāja with Vaiṣṇava [weapons]. / Kṛṣṇaka and Ratnabhānu fought against one another.

sanskrit_iast:
ubhau samabalau vīrau gajapṛṣṭhasthitau raṇe ..
anyonyanihatau nāgau khaṅgahastau mahī tale .. 55 ..
meaning:
उभौ समबलौ वीरौ गजपृष्ठस्थितौ रणे ..
अन्योन्यनिहतौ नागौ खङ्गहस्तौ मही तले .. 55 ..
text_mt: Both heroes of equal strength were mounted on the backs of elephants in battle. / Their elephants having killed each other, sword in hand on the surface of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
yuyudhāte bahūnmārgānkṛtavaṃtau sudurjayau ..
praharāntaṃ raṇaṃ kṛtvā maraṇāyopajagmatuḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
युयुधाते बहून्मार्गान्कृतवंतौ सुदुर्जयौ ..
प्रहरान्तं रणं कृत्वा मरणायोपजग्मतुः .. 56 ..
text_mt: the two very invincible [heroes] fought, executing many maneuvers. / Having fought until the end of a prahara, they met their deaths.

sanskrit_iast:
hate tasminmahāvīrye kānyakubjā bhayāturāḥ ..
mūrchitāṃstrīnsamādāya paṃcalakṣabalairyutāḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
हते तस्मिन्महावीर्ये कान्यकुब्जा भयातुराः ..
मूर्छितांस्त्रीन्समादाय पंचलक्षबलैर्युताः .. 57 ..
text_mt: When that [warrior] of great prowess was slain, the people of Kānyakubja, afflicted with fear, / taking the three who were unconscious, accompanied by an army of five hundred thousand,

sanskrit_iast:
raṇaṃ tyaktvā gṛhaṃ jagmurnṛpaśokaparāyaṇāḥ ..
ratnabhānau ca nihate hatotsāhāśca bhūmipāḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
रणं त्यक्त्वा गृहं जग्मुर्नृपशोकपरायणाः ..
रत्नभानौ च निहते हतोत्साहाश्च भूमिपाः .. 58 ..
text_mt: abandoned the battle and went home, devoted to grief for their king. / And when Ratnabhānu was slain, the kings, dispirited,

sanskrit_iast:
svaṃsvaṃ niveśanaṃ jagmurmahīrājabhayāturāḥ ..
devānārādhayāmāsuryatheṣṭaṃ te gṛhe gṛhe .. 59 ..
meaning:
स्वंस्वं निवेशनं जग्मुर्महीराजभयातुराः ..
देवानाराधयामासुर्यथेष्टं ते गृहे गृहे .. 59 ..
text_mt: went each to his own encampment, terrified of Mahīrāja. / In house after house, they worshipped the gods as they wished.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājastu balavānsaptalakṣabalānvitaḥ ..
dhuṃdhukāreṇa sahito vaṃdhukṛtyordhvamācarat .. 3.3.6.60 ..
meaning:
महीराजस्तु बलवान्सप्तलक्षबलान्वितः ..
धुंधुकारेण सहितो वंधुकृत्योर्ध्वमाचरत् .. 3.3.6.60 ..
text_mt: The mighty Mahīrāja, accompanied by an army of seven hundred thousand, / together with Dhundhukāra, having taken [him] captive, performed the funeral rites.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā bhīṣmaḥ parimalo lakṣaṇaḥ pitaraṃ svakam..
gaṃgākūle samāgamya caurdhvadaihikamācaran .. 61 ..
meaning:
तथा भीष्मः परिमलो लक्षणः पितरं स्वकम्..
गंगाकूले समागम्य चौर्ध्वदैहिकमाचरन् .. 61 ..
text_mt: Likewise Bhīṣma, Parimala, and Lakṣaṇa, having come / to the bank of the Gaṅgā, performed the funeral rites for their father.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmirājasya vijayo jayacaṃdayaśo raṇe ..
prasiddhamabhavadbhūmau gehegehe janejane ..62..
meaning:
भूमिराजस्य विजयो जयचंदयशो रणे ..
प्रसिद्धमभवद्भूमौ गेहेगेहे जनेजने ..62..
text_mt: The victory of Bhūmirāja and the glory of Jayacandra in battle / became famous on earth in every house and among every person.

sanskrit_iast:
jayacaṃdraḥ kānyakubje dehalyāṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ ..
utsavaṃ kārayitvā tu paramānandamāyayau .. 63 ..
meaning:
जयचंद्रः कान्यकुब्जे देहल्यां पृथिवीपतिः ..
उत्सवं कारयित्वा तु परमानन्दमाययौ .. 63 ..
text_mt: Jayacandra in Kānyakubja and the lord of the earth in Dehalī, / having celebrated a festival, attained supreme joy.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca ..
bhīṣmaḥ siṃhasthite gaṃgākūle śakraprapūjakaḥ ..
śakraṃ sūryamayaṃ jñātvā tapasā samatoṣayat .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच ..
भीष्मः सिंहस्थिते गंगाकूले शक्रप्रपूजकः ..
शक्रं सूर्यमयं ज्ञात्वा तपसा समतोषयत् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / When [the sun] stood in Leo, Bhīṣma, a worshipper of Śakra on the bank of the Gaṅgā, / knowing Śakra to be composed of the sun, propitiated him through asceticism.
title: adhyāyaḥ 07

sanskrit_iast:
māsāṃte bhagavāniṃdro jñātvā tadbhaktimuttamām ..
varaṃ varaya ca prāha śrutvā śūrobravīdidam .. 2 ..
meaning:
मासांते भगवानिंद्रो ज्ञात्वा तद्भक्तिमुत्तमाम् ..
वरं वरय च प्राह श्रुत्वा शूरोब्रवीदिदम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: At the end of the month, the lord Indra, recognizing his supreme devotion, / said, 'Choose a boon.' Hearing [this], the hero spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
dehi me vaḍavāṃ divyāṃ yadi tuṣṭo bhavānprabhuḥ ..
iti śrutvā tadā tasmai vaḍavāṃ hariṇīṃ śubhām .. 3 ..
meaning:
देहि मे वडवां दिव्यां यदि तुष्टो भवान्प्रभुः ..
इति श्रुत्वा तदा तस्मै वडवां हरिणीं शुभाम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: "Grant me a divine mare, if you, my lord, are pleased with me." / Hearing this, Lord Indra then gave him a splendid, swift mare,

sanskrit_iast: dadau sa bhagavāniṃdrastatraivāntarhitobhavat .. 4 ..
meaning: ददौ स भगवानिंद्रस्तत्रैवान्तर्हितोभवत् .. 4 ..
text_mt: and vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminkāle parimalaḥ pitṛśokaparāyaṇaḥ ..
pārthivaiḥ pūjayāmāsa mahādevamumāpatim ..
parīkṣārthaṃ śivaḥ sākṣātsarparogeṇa taṃ grasat .. 5 ..
meaning:
तस्मिन्काले परिमलः पितृशोकपरायणः ..
पार्थिवैः पूजयामास महादेवमुमापतिम् ..
परीक्षार्थं शिवः साक्षात्सर्परोगेण तं ग्रसत् .. 5 ..
text_mt: At that time, Parimala, overwhelmed with grief for his father, / worshipped Mahādeva, the lord of Umā, with earthen liṅgas. / In order to test him, Śiva himself afflicted him with a serpent-disease.

sanskrit_iast:
vyatīte paṃcame māse nṛpaḥ śaktivivarjitaḥ ..
na tatyāja mahāpūjāṃ mahākleśasamanvitaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
व्यतीते पंचमे मासे नृपः शक्तिविवर्जितः ..
न तत्याज महापूजां महाक्लेशसमन्वितः .. 6 ..
text_mt: When the fifth month had passed, the king, bereft of strength / and afflicted with great suffering, did not abandon the great worship.

sanskrit_iast:
maraṇāya yayau kāśīṃ svapatnyā sahito nṛpaḥ ..
uvāsa vaṭamūlāṃte rātrau rogaprapīḍitaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
मरणाय ययौ काशीं स्वपत्न्या सहितो नृपः ..
उवास वटमूलांते रात्रौ रोगप्रपीडितः .. 7 ..
text_mt: The king went to Kāśī with his wife to meet his death. / Tormented by the disease, he stayed at night at the foot of a banyan tree.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare kaścitpannago mūlasaṃsthitaḥ ..
śabdaṃ cakāra madhuraṃ śrutvā rudrāhirāyayau .. 8 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे कश्चित्पन्नगो मूलसंस्थितः ..
शब्दं चकार मधुरं श्रुत्वा रुद्राहिराययौ .. 8 ..
text_mt: Meanwhile, a serpent dwelling at the root [of the tree] / made a sweet sound; hearing it, the serpent of Rudra came there.

sanskrit_iast:
rudrāhiṃ pannagaḥ prāha bhavānnirdaya mandadhīḥ ..
śivabhaktaṃ nṛpamimaṃ pīḍayetpratyahaṃ khalaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
रुद्राहिं पन्नगः प्राह भवान्निर्दय मन्दधीः ..
शिवभक्तं नृपमिमं पीडयेत्प्रत्यहं खलः .. 9 ..
text_mt: The serpent said to Rudra's serpent: "You are merciless and foolish; / wicked one, you torment this king every day, though he is a devotee of Śiva!

sanskrit_iast:
mūrkho'yaṃ bhūpatiḥ sākṣādāranālaṃ pibennahi ..
iti śrutvā sa rudrāhirāha re pannagādhama .. 3.3.7.10 ..
meaning:
मूर्खोऽयं भूपतिः साक्षादारनालं पिबेन्नहि ..
इति श्रुत्वा स रुद्राहिराह रे पन्नगाधम .. 3.3.7.10 ..
text_mt: This king is a fool indeed, since he does not drink sour gruel!" / Hearing this, Rudra's serpent said: "O vile serpent!

sanskrit_iast:
rājño dehe paraṃ harṣaṃ pratyahaṃ prāptavānaham ..
svagehaṃ duḥkhatastyājyaṃ kathaṃ tyājyaṃ mayā śaṭha .. 11 ..
meaning:
राज्ञो देहे परं हर्षं प्रत्यहं प्राप्तवानहम् ..
स्वगेहं दुःखतस्त्याज्यं कथं त्याज्यं मया शठ .. 11 ..
text_mt: Every day I have attained supreme delight in the king's body. / One's own home is abandoned only out of sorrow; why should I abandon it, villain?

sanskrit_iast:
mūrkhotra bhūpatiryo vai tailoṣṇaṃ yanna dattavān ..
ityuktvāntargato dehe śrutvā sā malanā satī .. 12 ..
meaning:
मूर्खोत्र भूपतिर्यो वै तैलोष्णं यन्न दत्तवान् ..
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्गतो देहे श्रुत्वा सा मलना सती .. 12 ..
text_mt: The fool here is the king, who has not poured hot oil [into the hole]!" / Having said this, he re-entered the body. Hearing that, the virtuous Malanā

sanskrit_iast:
cakāra pannagoktaṃ tadgatarogo nṛpo'bhavat ..
tailoṣṇairbilamāpūrya cakhāna ca satī svayam .. 13 ..
meaning:
चकार पन्नगोक्तं तद्गतरोगो नृपोऽभवत् ..
तैलोष्णैर्बिलमापूर्य चखान च सती स्वयम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: did what the serpent had said, and the king became free from disease. / Having filled the hole with hot oil, the virtuous woman dug it up herself.

sanskrit_iast:
tato jātaṃ svayaṃ liṃgamaṃguṣṭhābhaṃ sanātanam ..
jyotīrūpaṃ cidānaṃdaṃ sarvalakṣmasamanvitam .. 14 ..
meaning:
ततो जातं स्वयं लिंगमंगुष्ठाभं सनातनम् ..
ज्योतीरूपं चिदानंदं सर्वलक्ष्मसमन्वितम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Then there appeared of itself an eternal liṅga the size of a thumb, / of the nature of light, conscious bliss, endowed with all auspicious marks.

sanskrit_iast:
niśīthe tama udbhūte dikṣu sūryatvamāgatam ..
dṛṣṭvā sa vismito rājā pūjayāmāsa śaṃkaram .. 15 ..
meaning:
निशीथे तम उद्भूते दिक्षु सूर्यत्वमागतम् ..
दृष्ट्वा स विस्मितो राजा पूजयामास शंकरम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: At midnight, when darkness arose, the brightness of the sun appeared in all directions. / Seeing it, the king was astonished and worshipped Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
mahimnastavapāṭhaiśca tuṣṭāva girijāpatim ..
tadā prasanno bhagavānvaraṃ brūhi tamabravīt .. 16 ..
meaning:
महिम्नस्तवपाठैश्च तुष्टाव गिरिजापतिम् ..
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवान्वरं ब्रूहि तमब्रवीत् .. 16 ..
text_mt: With recitations of the Mahimnastava, he praised the lord of Girijā. / Then the Lord was pleased and said to him: "Choose a boon!"

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvāha nṛpatirdevaṃ yadi tuṣṭo maheśvara ..
śrīpatirme gṛhaṃ prāpya vasenmatpriyakārakaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वाह नृपतिर्देवं यदि तुष्टो महेश्वर ..
श्रीपतिर्मे गृहं प्राप्य वसेन्मत्प्रियकारकः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, the king said to the god: "If you are pleased, O Maheśvara, / may Śrīpati come to my home and dwell there, bringing me delight."

sanskrit_iast:
tathetyuktvā mahādevo liṃgarūpatvamāgataḥ ..
pratyahaṃ bhāramekaṃ ca suvarṇaṃ suṣuve tanoḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
तथेत्युक्त्वा महादेवो लिंगरूपत्वमागतः ..
प्रत्यहं भारमेकं च सुवर्णं सुषुवे तनोः .. 18 ..
text_mt: Saying "So be it," Mahādeva took the form of a liṅga, / and daily produced from his form a bhāra of gold.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā malastu saṃtuṣṭaḥ prāpto gehaṃ mahāvatīm ..
bhīmasiṃhena sahitaḥ paramānaṃdamāyayau .. 19 ..
meaning:
तदा मलस्तु संतुष्टः प्राप्तो गेहं महावतीम् ..
भीमसिंहेन सहितः परमानंदमाययौ .. 19 ..
text_mt: Then Mala, well contented, reached his home, Mahāvatī. / Together with Bhīmasiṃha, he attained supreme joy.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥprabhṛti varṣāṃte jayacaṃdrapurīṃ yayau ..
dṛṣṭvā parimalaṃ rājā kṛtakṛtyatvamāgataḥ .. 3.3.7.20 ..
meaning:
ततःप्रभृति वर्षांते जयचंद्रपुरीं ययौ ..
दृष्ट्वा परिमलं राजा कृतकृत्यत्वमागतः .. 3.3.7.20 ..
text_mt: From that time forth, at the end of the year he went to Jayacandra's city. / Seeing Parimala, the king felt his purpose accomplished [and said]:

sanskrit_iast:
diṣṭyā te saṃkṣito rogo diṣṭyā te darśitaṃ mukham ..
bhavānnijapurīṃ prāpya sukhī bhavatu mā ciram .. 21 ..
meaning:
दिष्ट्या ते संक्षितो रोगो दिष्ट्या ते दर्शितं मुखम् ..
भवान्निजपुरीं प्राप्य सुखी भवतु मा चिरम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: "By good fortune your disease has been destroyed! By good fortune I have seen your face! / Go to your own city and be happy without delay.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā me vighna ābhūyāttadā tvaṃ māṃ samācara ..
iti śrutvā parimalo gatvā sthānamavāsayat .. 22 ..
meaning:
यदा मे विघ्न आभूयात्तदा त्वं मां समाचर ..
इति श्रुत्वा परिमलो गत्वा स्थानमवासयत् .. 22 ..
text_mt: Whenever an obstacle arises for me, then come to my aid!" / Hearing this, Parimala departed and settled in his place.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu lakṣaṇo vīro bhagavantamuṣāpatim ..
jagannāthamupāgamya samabhyarccāparo'bhavat .. 23 ..
meaning:
तदा तु लक्षणो वीरो भगवन्तमुषापतिम् ..
जगन्नाथमुपागम्य समभ्यर्च्चापरोऽभवत् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Then the heroic Lakṣaṇa approached the Lord, the husband of Uṣā, / Jagannātha, and devoted himself to worshipping him.

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣamātrāṃtare viṣṇurjagannātha uṣāpatiḥ ..
varaṃ brūhi vacaśceti lakṣaṇaṃ prāha harṣataḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
पक्षमात्रांतरे विष्णुर्जगन्नाथ उषापतिः ..
वरं ब्रूहि वचश्चेति लक्षणं प्राह हर्षतः .. 24 ..
text_mt: After an interval of just a fortnight, Viṣṇu, Jagannātha, the husband of Uṣā, / said with delight to Lakṣaṇa: "Choose a boon!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktaḥ sa tu taṃ devaṃ natvovāca vinamradhīḥ ..
dehi me vāhanaṃ divyaṃ sarvaśatruvināśanam .. 25 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तः स तु तं देवं नत्वोवाच विनम्रधीः ..
देहि मे वाहनं दिव्यं सर्वशत्रुविनाशनम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Thus addressed, he bowed down to the god with a humble mind and said: / "Give me a divine mount that destroys all enemies."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā jagannāthaḥ śaktimairāvatādgajāt ..
samutpādya dadau tasmai divyāmairāvatīṃ mudā .. 26 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा जगन्नाथः शक्तिमैरावताद्गजात् ..
समुत्पाद्य ददौ तस्मै दिव्यामैरावतीं मुदा .. 26 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, Jagannātha produced a power from the elephant Airāvata / and joyfully gave him the divine female elephant Airāvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
āruhyairāvatīṃ rājā lakṣaṇo gehamāyayau ..
sa vai parimalo rājā jagāma ca mahāvatīm .. 27 ..
meaning:
आरुह्यैरावतीं राजा लक्षणो गेहमाययौ ..
स वै परिमलो राजा जगाम च महावतीम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: Mounting Airāvatī, King Lakṣaṇa went to his home. / And that King Parimala went to Mahāvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare vīrāstālanādyā madotkaṭāḥ ..
mahāvatīṃ purīṃ prāpya dadṛśustaṃ mahīpatim .. 28 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे वीरास्तालनाद्या मदोत्कटाः ..
महावतीं पुरीं प्राप्य ददृशुस्तं महीपतिम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Meanwhile, the heroes headed by Tālana, furious with pride, / arrived at the city of Mahāvatī and saw that king.

sanskrit_iast:
tena sārddhaṃ ca mahatīṃ prītiṃ kṛtvā nyavāsayan ..
māsānte ca punaste vai rājāno vinayānvitāḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
तेन सार्द्धं च महतीं प्रीतिं कृत्वा न्यवासयन् ..
मासान्ते च पुनस्ते वै राजानो विनयान्विताः .. 29 ..
text_mt: Forming a great friendship with him, they stayed there. / And at the end of a month, those kings, filled with modesty,

sanskrit_iast:
ūcustaṃ śṛṇu bhūpāla vayaṃ gacchāmahe purīḥ ..
tadā rājāpi tānprāha sarvānkṣitipatī natha ..
dattvādhikāraṃ putrebhyastadā''yāsyāmi vo'ntikam .. 3.3.7.30 ..
meaning:
ऊचुस्तं शृणु भूपाल वयं गच्छामहे पुरीः ..
तदा राजापि तान्प्राह सर्वान्क्षितिपती नथ ..
दत्त्वाधिकारं पुत्रेभ्यस्तदा'ऽयास्यामि वोऽन्तिकम् .. 3.3.7.30 ..
text_mt: said to him: "Listen, O king, we are departing for our cities." / Then the king also said to all those rulers of the earth: / "Having given authority to my sons, I shall then come to you."

sanskrit_iast:
tathetyuktāstu te rājñā svagehaṃ punarāyayuḥ ..
sānujo deśarājastu dvijebhyaḥ svapuraṃ dadau .. 31 ..
meaning:
तथेत्युक्तास्तु ते राज्ञा स्वगेहं पुनराययुः ..
सानुजो देशराजस्तु द्विजेभ्यः स्वपुरं ददौ .. 31 ..
text_mt: Told "So be it" by the king, they returned to their own homes. / And Deśarāja, along with his younger brother, gave his city to the brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
putrebhyastālano vīro dadau vārāṇasīṃ purīm ..
alikollāmatiḥ kālaḥ patra puṣpodarī varī .. 32 ..
meaning:
पुत्रेभ्यस्तालनो वीरो ददौ वाराणसीं पुरीम् ..
अलिकोल्लामतिः कालः पत्र पुष्पोदरी वरी .. 32 ..
text_mt: The heroic Tālana gave the city of Vārāṇasī to his sons. / Alika, Ullāmati, Kāla, Patra, Puṣpodarī, Varī,

sanskrit_iast:
karīnarī sulalitasteṣāṃ nāmāni vai kramāt ..
dvau dvau putrau smṛtau teṣāṃ pitustulyaparākramau .. 33 ..
meaning:
करीनरी सुललितस्तेषां नामानि वै क्रमात् ..
द्वौ द्वौ पुत्रौ स्मृतौ तेषां पितुस्तुल्यपराक्रमौ .. 33 ..
text_mt: Karī, Narī, and Sulalita were their names in order. / Two sons each are remembered for them, equal in valor to their fathers.

sanskrit_iast:
sa vai putrājñayā śūrastālano rākṣasapriyaḥ ..
yātudhānamayaṃ devaṃ tuṣṭāva mlecchapūjanaiḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
स वै पुत्राज्ञया शूरस्तालनो राक्षसप्रियः ..
यातुधानमयं देवं तुष्टाव म्लेच्छपूजनैः .. 34 ..
text_mt: That hero Tālana, dear to rākṣasas, by his sons' command / praised the god consisting of yātudhānas with rites of mleccha worship.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā vasumataḥ putrau bhūpatīdeśavatsajau ..
śakraṃ sūryyaṃ samārādhya kṛtakṛtyau babhūvatuḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
तथा वसुमतः पुत्रौ भूपतीदेशवत्सजौ ..
शक्रं सूर्य्यं समाराध्य कृतकृत्यौ बभूवतुः .. 35 ..
text_mt: Likewise the two sons of Vasumat, the rulers of the earth born as Deśa and Vatsa, / worshipped Indra and Sūrya and had their desires fulfilled.

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhinīnāma vaḍavāṃ yā tu dattā bhayānakā ..
āruhya balavāñchūro gamanāya mano dadhau .. 36 ..
meaning:
सिंहिनीनाम वडवां या तु दत्ता भयानका ..
आरुह्य बलवाञ्छूरो गमनाय मनो दधौ .. 36 ..
text_mt: Mounting the terrifying mare named Siṃhinī that had been given [to him], / that powerful hero set his mind on departing.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcaśabdaṃ mahānāgamindradattaṃ manoramam ..
deśarājastamāruhya gamanāya mano dadhe .. 37 ..
meaning:
पंचशब्दं महानागमिन्द्रदत्तं मनोरमम् ..
देशराजस्तमारुह्य गमनाय मनो दधे .. 37 ..
text_mt: Mounting the delightful great elephant named Pañcaśabda given by Indra, / Deśarāja set his mind on departing.

sanskrit_iast:
hayaṃ papīhakaṃ nāma sūryadattaṃ narasvaram ..
vatsarājastamāruhya gamanāya mano dadhe .. 38 ..
meaning:
हयं पपीहकं नाम सूर्यदत्तं नरस्वरम् ..
वत्सराजस्तमारुह्य गमनाय मनो दधे .. 38 ..
text_mt: Mounting the horse named Papīhaka given by Sūrya, which possessed a human voice, / Vatsarāja set his mind on departing.

sanskrit_iast:
trayaḥ śūrāḥ samāgamya nagarīṃ te mahāvatīm ..
ūṣustatra mahātmāno bahumānena satkṛtāḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
त्रयः शूराः समागम्य नगरीं ते महावतीम् ..
ऊषुस्तत्र महात्मानो बहुमानेन सत्कृताः .. 39 ..
text_mt: Those three heroes arrived together at the city of Mahāvatī; / honored with great respect, those noble ones dwelled there.

sanskrit_iast:
senā ṣaṣṭisahasraṃ tatteṣāṃ svāmī sa tālanaḥ ..
maṃtriṇau bhrātarau tau ca nṛpateścandravaṃśinaḥ .. 3.3.7.40 ..
meaning:
सेना षष्टिसहस्रं तत्तेषां स्वामी स तालनः ..
मंत्रिणौ भ्रातरौ तौ च नृपतेश्चन्द्रवंशिनः .. 3.3.7.40 ..
text_mt: Their army numbered sixty thousand, and their master was Tālana; / the two brothers were the ministers of the king of the lunar lineage.

sanskrit_iast: tairvīrai rakṣito rājā kṛtakṛtyatvamāgataḥ .. 41 .. ..
meaning: तैर्वीरै रक्षितो राजा कृतकृत्यत्वमागतः .. 41 .. ..
text_mt: Protected by those heroes, the king attained complete fulfillment.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
jambuko nāma bhūpālo mahīrājo bhayāturaḥ ..
kāliyena yutaḥ prāpto narmadāyāstaṭe śubhe .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
जम्बुको नाम भूपालो महीराजो भयातुरः ..
कालियेन युतः प्राप्तो नर्मदायास्तटे शुभे .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / A king named Jambuka, terrified of Mahīrāja, / came along with Kāliya to the auspicious bank of the Narmadā.
title: adhyāyaḥ 08

sanskrit_iast:
pārthivaiḥ pūjayāmāsa devadevaṃ pinākinam ..
ṣaṇmāsānte mahādevo jambukaṃ prāha bhūpatim .. 2 ..
meaning:
पार्थिवैः पूजयामास देवदेवं पिनाकिनम् ..
षण्मासान्ते महादेवो जम्बुकं प्राह भूपतिम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: He worshipped Pinākin, the god of gods, with earthen liṅgas. / At the end of six months, Mahādeva spoke to King Jambuka:

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ varaya te'bhīṣṭaṃ bhūpa āha kṛtāṃjaliḥ ..
ajitatvaṃ nṛpaiḥ sarvairdehi me karuṇānidhe .. 3 ..
meaning:
वरं वरय तेऽभीष्टं भूप आह कृतांजलिः ..
अजितत्वं नृपैः सर्वैर्देहि मे करुणानिधे .. 3 ..
text_mt: "Choose the boon you desire!" With folded hands, the king said: / "Grant me invincibility against all kings, O treasure of compassion!"

sanskrit_iast:
tathetyuktvā mahādevastatraivāntarhitobhavat ..
kāliyasta tsuto labdhvā vīro māheśvaraṃ varam .. 4 ..
meaning:
तथेत्युक्त्वा महादेवस्तत्रैवान्तर्हितोभवत् ..
कालियस्त त्सुतो लब्ध्वा वीरो माहेश्वरं वरम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Saying "So be it," Mahādeva vanished right there. / That hero, his son Kāliya, having obtained the boon of Maheśvara,

sanskrit_iast:
mohanaṃ sarvasainyānāṃ pituraṃtikamāyayau ..
pitaraṃ prāha namrātmā dehyājñāṃ tāta matpriyām .. 5 .
meaning:
मोहनं सर्वसैन्यानां पितुरंतिकमाययौ ..
पितरं प्राह नम्रात्मा देह्याज्ञां तात मत्प्रियाम् .. 5 .
text_mt: [and] a stupefying [arrow] for all armies, he approached his father. / Bowing low, he said to his father, "Father, grant me my cherished command:

sanskrit_iast:
gamiṣyāmi balaiḥ sārddhaṃ gaṃgāṃ śuddhajalāṃ śubhām ..
tathetyuktvā pitā tasmai yayau tu svaṃ niveśanam .. 6 ..
meaning:
गमिष्यामि बलैः सार्द्धं गंगां शुद्धजलां शुभाम् ..
तथेत्युक्त्वा पिता तस्मै ययौ तु स्वं निवेशनम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: I shall march with the forces to the auspicious Gaṅgā of pure waters." / Saying "So be it," the father went to his own dwelling.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaginīṃ prāha balavānvijayaiṣiṇi śobhane ..
kimicchasi śubhaṃ vastu tadājñāṃ dehi mā ciram .. 7 ..
meaning:
भगिनीं प्राह बलवान्विजयैषिणि शोभने ..
किमिच्छसि शुभं वस्तु तदाज्ञां देहि मा चिरम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: The strong warrior said to his sister, "Fair one who desires victory! / What auspicious thing do you desire? Command it without delay!"

sanskrit_iast:
sāha graiveyakaṃ hāraṃ maṇimuktāvibhūṣitam ..
matpriyaṃ dehi me vīra tathetyuktvā yayau gṛhāt .. 8 ..
meaning:
साह ग्रैवेयकं हारं मणिमुक्ताविभूषितम् ..
मत्प्रियं देहि मे वीर तथेत्युक्त्वा ययौ गृहात् .. 8 ..
text_mt: She said, "Give me my cherished necklace adorned with gems and pearls, / O hero!" Saying "So be it," he went forth from the house.

sanskrit_iast:
kāliyo lakṣaturagaiḥ saṃyutastvarito'gamat ..
prāpya gaṃgāṃ sāgaragāṃ kṛtvā snānaṃ vidhānataḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
कालियो लक्षतुरगैः संयुतस्त्वरितोऽगमत् ..
प्राप्य गंगां सागरगां कृत्वा स्नानं विधानतः .. 9 ..
text_mt: Accompanied by one hundred thousand horses, Kāliya swiftly set out. / Reaching the ocean-going Gaṅgā and performing his bath according to rite,

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā dānāni viprebhyo jayacandrapurīṃ yayau ..
nirdhanaḥ samabhūdrājā bāhuśālī mahābalaḥ .. 3.3.8.10 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वा दानानि विप्रेभ्यो जयचन्द्रपुरीं ययौ ..
निर्धनः समभूद्राजा बाहुशाली महाबलः .. 3.3.8.10 ..
text_mt: and giving gifts to the Brahmins, he went to the city of Jayacandra. / The king, strong-armed and mighty, had become impoverished;

sanskrit_iast:
kānyakubje mahāhārau na prāpto bahumūlyakaḥ ..
tadorvīyādhipenaiva mahīśena prabodhitaḥ ..11..
meaning:
कान्यकुब्जे महाहारौ न प्राप्तो बहुमूल्यकः ..
तदोर्वीयाधिपेनैव महीशेन प्रबोधितः ..11..
text_mt: in Kānyakubja, two great necklaces of immense value were not to be obtained. / Then, prompted by the lord of the earth himself, the ruler of the realm,

sanskrit_iast:
yayau mahāvatīṃ ramyāṃ śivadattavaro balī ..
rurodha nagarīṃ sarvāṃ śrutvā rājā bhayāturaḥ ..12..
meaning:
ययौ महावतीं रम्यां शिवदत्तवरो बली ..
रुरोध नगरीं सर्वां श्रुत्वा राजा भयातुरः ..12..
text_mt: the mighty warrior, endowed with the boon given by Śiva, went to lovely Mahāvatī. / He besieged the entire city; hearing this, the king, stricken with fear,

sanskrit_iast:
rudraṃ kapardinaṃ śaṃbhuṃ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ..
śivājñayā nṛpo dhīmānbalaiḥ ṣaṣṭisahasrakaiḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
रुद्रं कपर्दिनं शंभुं शरण्यं शरणं ययौ ..
शिवाज्ञया नृपो धीमान्बलैः षष्टिसहस्रकैः .. 13 ..
text_mt: went for refuge to Rudra, the matted-haired Sambhu, the refuge of all. / By Śiva's command, the wise king, with sixty thousand troops

sanskrit_iast:
sārddhaṃ purādbahiryātastribhiḥ śūraiḥ surakṣitaḥ ..
tasya nāgāḥ sahasraṃ ca deśarājaśca tatpatiḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
सार्द्धं पुराद्बहिर्यातस्त्रिभिः शूरैः सुरक्षितः ..
तस्य नागाः सहस्रं च देशराजश्च तत्पतिः .. 14 ..
text_mt: and well-guarded by three heroes, marched out of the city. / His elephants were a thousand, and Deśarāja was their commander;

sanskrit_iast:
hayāḥ ṣoḍaśasāhasrā vatsarājastu tatpatiḥ ..
śeṣāḥ padātayastasya tālanenaiva rakṣitāḥ .. 15 ..
pranaṣṭo mulaṃ yuddhaṃ teṣāṃ vīravarakṣayam ..7
meaning:
हयाः षोडशसाहस्रा वत्सराजस्तु तत्पतिः ..
शेषाः पदातयस्तस्य तालनेनैव रक्षिताः .. 15 ..
प्रनष्टो मुलं युद्धं तेषां वीरवरक्षयम् ..7
text_mt:
the horses were sixteen thousand, and Vatsarāja was their commander; / the rest were his foot-soldiers, protected indeed by Tālana.
A fierce battle began among them, causing the destruction of choice warriors;

sanskrit_iast: ahorātrapramāṇena mahadghoramavartata .. 16 ..
meaning: अहोरात्रप्रमाणेन महद्घोरमवर्तत .. 16 ..
text_mt: for the duration of a day and night, it raged exceedingly terribly.

sanskrit_iast:
te hatvā śātravīṃ senāṃ cakrurjayaravānmuhuḥ ..
bhayārtā nārmadeyāśca māhiṣmatinivāsinaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
ते हत्वा शात्रवीं सेनां चक्रुर्जयरवान्मुहुः ..
भयार्ता नार्मदेयाश्च माहिष्मतिनिवासिनः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Having slain the enemy host, they raised shouts of victory again and again. / Stricken with fear, the people of the Narmadā, inhabitants of Māhiṣmatī,

sanskrit_iast:
dudruvuḥ sarvato vipra dṛṣṭvā tānkāliyo nṛpaḥ ..
āśvāsya prayayau yuddhamarddhasainyasamanvitaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
दुद्रुवुः सर्वतो विप्र दृष्ट्वा तान्कालियो नृपः ..
आश्वास्य प्रययौ युद्धमर्द्धसैन्यसमन्वितः .. 18 ..
text_mt: fled in every direction, O Brahmin. Seeing them, King Kāliya / comforted them and marched into battle accompanied by half his army.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdi kṛtvā mahādevaṃ mohanaṃ bāṇamādadhat ..
siddhamantraprabhāveṇa mohitāste babhūvire .. 19 ..
meaning:
हृदि कृत्वा महादेवं मोहनं बाणमादधत् ..
सिद्धमन्त्रप्रभावेण मोहितास्ते बभूविरे .. 19 ..
text_mt: Holding Mahādeva in his heart, he fitted the stupefying arrow; / by the power of the perfected mantra, they became bewitched.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣāste śatravaḥ sarve ripughātāya saṃyayuḥ ..
alasāṃstānkapāleṣu jaghnuste bhayavarjitāḥ .. 3.3.8.20 ..
meaning:
शेषास्ते शत्रवः सर्वे रिपुघाताय संययुः ..
अलसांस्तान्कपालेषु जघ्नुस्ते भयवर्जिताः .. 3.3.8.20 ..
text_mt: All the remaining enemies went forth to strike the foe; / devoid of fear, they struck those languid ones upon their heads.

sanskrit_iast:
bhīṣmasiṃhastathā dṛṣṭvā bodhayāmāsa sainikān ..
sūryadattena bāṇena saṃjñākhyānena tatra vai .. .. 21 ..
meaning:
भीष्मसिंहस्तथा दृष्ट्वा बोधयामास सैनिकान् ..
सूर्यदत्तेन बाणेन संज्ञाख्यानेन तत्र वै .. .. 21 ..
text_mt: Seeing this, Bhīṣmasiṃha revived the soldiers / there with the arrow named Saṃjñākhyāna, given by Sūrya.

sanskrit_iast:
bhairavākhyena bhallena śatrudehamatāḍayat ..
mūrcchitaḥ so'patadvīro gajapṛṣṭhe śarārditaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
भैरवाख्येन भल्लेन शत्रुदेहमताडयत् ..
मूर्च्छितः सोऽपतद्वीरो गजपृष्ठे शरार्दितः .. 22 ..
text_mt: With a broad-headed arrow named Bhairava, he struck the enemy's body. / Tormented by the arrows, that hero fell unconscious on the back of his elephant.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā māhiṣmatī senā niryayau sā diśau daśa ..
muhūrtaṃ kaśmalaṃ prāpya punarutthāya kāliyaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
तदा माहिष्मती सेना निर्ययौ सा दिशौ दश ..
मुहूर्तं कश्मलं प्राप्य पुनरुत्थाय कालियः .. 23 ..
text_mt: Then the army of Māhiṣmatī fled in the ten directions. / Overcome by faintness for a moment, Kāliya arose once more;

sanskrit_iast:
bhallena tacchiraḥ kāyādapāharata bhūmipaḥ ..
hate tasminmahāvīrye tālanādyā mahā balāḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
भल्लेन तच्छिरः कायादपाहरत भूमिपः ..
हते तस्मिन्महावीर्ये तालनाद्या महा बलाः .. 24 ..
text_mt: with a broad-headed arrow, the king severed his head from his body. / When that hero of great valor was slain, the mighty Tālana and the others,

sanskrit_iast:
kāliyaṃ te parājitya taṃ śatruṃ pratyaṣedhayan ..
mahākaṣṭānvito bhūpo dhyātvā manasi śaṃkaram .. 25 ..
meaning:
कालियं ते पराजित्य तं शत्रुं प्रत्यषेधयन् ..
महाकष्टान्वितो भूपो ध्यात्वा मनसि शंकरम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: having defeated Kāliya, repelled that enemy. / In great distress, the king, meditating on Śaṅkara in his mind,

sanskrit_iast:
mohayitvā ripūnsarvān yayau svaṃ niveśanam ..
arddhasainyena sahitā hataśeṣāstrayastathā .. 26 ..
meaning:
मोहयित्वा रिपून्सर्वान् ययौ स्वं निवेशनम् ..
अर्द्धसैन्येन सहिता हतशेषास्त्रयस्तथा .. 26 ..
text_mt: bewitched all his enemies and went to his own abode, / as did the three survivors along with half the army.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā parimalo rājā dṛṣṭvā śatruparājayam ..
pariṣvajya mahāvīrānsva gehaṃ punarāyayau .. 27 ..
meaning:
तदा परिमलो राजा दृष्ट्वा शत्रुपराजयम् ..
परिष्वज्य महावीरान्स्व गेहं पुनराययौ .. 27 ..
text_mt: Then King Parimala, seeing the defeat of the enemy, / embraced the great heroes and returned to his house.

sanskrit_iast:
jayacandrastu tacchutvā paraṃ vismayamāgataḥ ..
tālanaṃ ca samāhūya senādhīśamakarāyat .. 28 ..
meaning:
जयचन्द्रस्तु तच्छुत्वा परं विस्मयमागतः ..
तालनं च समाहूय सेनाधीशमकरायत् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Hearing of this, Jayacandra was filled with great astonishment; / summoning Tālana, he appointed him commander of the army.

sanskrit_iast:
bhīṣmasiṃhe gate loke paṃcamāsāntare nṛpe ..
tatpatnī janayāmāsa putraratnaṃ śubhānanam .. 29 ..
meaning:
भीष्मसिंहे गते लोके पंचमासान्तरे नृपे ..
तत्पत्नी जनयामास पुत्ररत्नं शुभाननम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: When five months had passed after King Bhīṣmasiṃha departed to the [other] world, / his wife gave birth to an excellent jewel of a son with an auspicious face.

sanskrit_iast:
sā tu gurjarabhūpasya tanayākhyā madālasā ..
divyaṃ putraṃ samālokya mumude sagaṇā bhṛśam .. 3.3.8.30 ..
meaning:
सा तु गुर्जरभूपस्य तनयाख्या मदालसा ..
दिव्यं पुत्रं समालोक्य मुमुदे सगणा भृशम् .. 3.3.8.30 ..
text_mt: She, the daughter of the king of Gurjara named Madālasā, / seeing her divine son, rejoiced greatly together with her attendants.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā tajjanma nṛpatirvitatāra dhanaṃ bahu ..
āhūya gaṇakānprājñāñjātakarma hyakārayat .. 31 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा तज्जन्म नृपतिर्विततार धनं बहु ..
आहूय गणकान्प्राज्ञाञ्जातकर्म ह्यकारयत् .. 31 ..
text_mt: Hearing of his birth, the king distributed abundant wealth; / summoning wise astrologers, he had the birth-rites performed.

sanskrit_iast:
sahadevāṃśa evāsau bhuvi jātaḥ śivājñayā ..
devasiṃhaḥ kṛto nāma gaṇakaiḥ śāstraciṃtakaiḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
सहदेवांश एवासौ भुवि जातः शिवाज्ञया ..
देवसिंहः कृतो नाम गणकैः शास्त्रचिंतकैः .. 32 ..
text_mt: He was an incarnation of a portion of Sahadeva, born on earth by Śiva's command. / The astrologers, scholars of the śāstras, gave him the name Devasiṃha.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
kāliyaṃ tau parājitya bhrātarau nṛpasevakau ..
gatau gopālake rāṣṭre bhūpatirdalavāhanaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
कालियं तौ पराजित्य भ्रातरौ नृपसेवकौ ..
गतौ गोपालके राष्ट्रे भूपतिर्दलवाहनः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having defeated Kāliya, those two brothers, servants of the king, / went to the kingdom of Gopālaka, whose ruler was Dalavāhana.
title: Kṛṣṇāṃśāvatāraḥ

sanskrit_iast:
sahasracaṃḍikāhome nānābhūpasamāgame ..
gṛhītau mahiṣau tābhyāṃ bhūpairanyaiśca durjayau .. 2 ..
meaning:
सहस्रचंडिकाहोमे नानाभूपसमागमे ..
गृहीतौ महिषौ ताभ्यां भूपैरन्यैश्च दुर्जयौ .. 2 ..
text_mt: At a Sahasra-Caṇḍikā homa, when various kings had assembled, / two buffaloes, invincible to the other kings, were seized by the two of them;

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaṃ hi nṛpakanyābhyāṃ pratyahaṃ baṃdhanaṃ gatau ..
tau saṃpūjya vidhānena dadau tābhyāṃ ca kanyake .. 3 ..
meaning:
पूर्वं हि नृपकन्याभ्यां प्रत्यहं बंधनं गतौ ..
तौ संपूज्य विधानेन ददौ ताभ्यां च कन्यके .. 3 ..
text_mt: for previously they had daily been tied up by the king's two daughters. / Having honored them duly, [the king] gave the two maidens to them:

sanskrit_iast:
devakīṃ deśarājāya brāhmīṃ tasyānujāya vai ..
dadau durgājñayā rājā rūpayauvanaśāli nīm .. 4 ..
meaning:
देवकीं देशराजाय ब्राह्मीं तस्यानुजाय वै ..
ददौ दुर्गाज्ञया राजा रूपयौवनशालि नीम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Devakī to Deśarāja, and Brāhmī to his younger brother, / the king gave by Durgā's command, maidens endowed with beauty and youth.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣāvṛttiṃ tathā veśyāṃ gītanṛtyaviśāradām ..
kanyayośca sakhīṃ ramyāṃ meghamallārarāgiṇīm .. 5 ..
meaning:
लक्षावृत्तिं तथा वेश्यां गीतनृत्यविशारदाम् ..
कन्ययोश्च सखीं रम्यां मेघमल्लाररागिणीम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: [He gave] Lakṣāvṛtti, a courtesan skilled in song and dance, / a delightful friend to the two maidens, adept in the Meghamallāra melody,

sanskrit_iast:
śataṃ gajānrathānpaṃca hayāṃścaiva sahasrakān ..
catvāriṃśacca śibikāḥ pradadau dalavāhanaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
शतं गजान्रथान्पंच हयांश्चैव सहस्रकान् ..
चत्वारिंशच्च शिबिकाः प्रददौ दलवाहनः .. 6 ..
text_mt: a hundred elephants, five chariots, a thousand horses, / and forty palanquins did Dalavāhana give.

sanskrit_iast:
bahudravyayutāṃ kanyāṃ dāsadāsīsamanvitām ..
udūhya vedavidhinā prāpatuśca mahāvatīm .. 7 ..
meaning:
बहुद्रव्ययुतां कन्यां दासदासीसमन्विताम् ..
उदूह्य वेदविधिना प्रापतुश्च महावतीम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: Having married the maidens, accompanied by great wealth and servant men and women, / according to the Vedic rite, the two went to Mahāvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
malanā tāṃ vadhūṃ dṛṣṭvā tasyai graiveyakaṃ dadau ..
brāhmyai ṣoḍaśaśṛṃgāraṃ tathā dvādaśabhūṣaṇam .. 8 ..
meaning:
मलना तां वधूं दृष्ट्वा तस्यै ग्रैवेयकं ददौ ..
ब्राह्म्यै षोडशशृंगारं तथा द्वादशभूषणम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Seeing that bride, Malanā gave her a necklace; / to Brāhmī she gave the sixteen embellishments and the twelve ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
rājā ca paramānandī deśarājāya śūriṇe ..
dadau daśapuraṃ ramyaṃ nānājananiṣevitam .. 9 ..
meaning:
राजा च परमानन्दी देशराजाय शूरिणे ..
ददौ दशपुरं रम्यं नानाजननिषेवितम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: And the king, exceedingly delighted, gave the heroic Deśarāja / lovely Daśapura, frequented by diverse peoples.

sanskrit_iast:
ūṣatustatra tau vīrau rājamānyau mahābalau ..
etasminnantare jāto devasiṃho harājñayā .. 3.3.9.10 ..
meaning:
ऊषतुस्तत्र तौ वीरौ राजमान्यौ महाबलौ ..
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे जातो देवसिंहो हराज्ञया .. 3.3.9.10 ..
text_mt: The two heroes, highly esteemed by the king and possessed of great might, lived there. / In the meantime, Devasiṃha was born by the command of Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
jāte tasminkumāre tu devakī garbhamādadhau ..
dāsaśrutā paterdevī suṣuve putramūrjitam .. 1 1..
meaning:
जाते तस्मिन्कुमारे तु देवकी गर्भमादधौ ..
दासश्रुता पतेर्देवी सुषुवे पुत्रमूर्जितम् .. 1 1..
text_mt: When that boy was born, Devakī conceived; / the queen of the husband famed as a servant gave birth to an energetic son,

sanskrit_iast:
gaurāṃgaṃ kamalākṣaṃ ca dīpyamānaṃ svatejasā ..
tadānaṃdamayo devaḥ śakraḥ suragaṇaiḥ saha .. 12 ..
meaning:
गौरांगं कमलाक्षं च दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा ..
तदानंदमयो देवः शक्रः सुरगणैः सह .. 12 ..
text_mt: fair-limbed, lotus-eyed, and blazing with his own splendor. / Then the god Śakra, filled with joy, together with the host of gods,

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkhaśabdaṃ cakāroccairjayaśabdaṃ punaḥpunaḥ ..
diśaḥ praphullitāścāsangrahāḥ sarve tathā divi .. 13 ..
meaning:
शंखशब्दं चकारोच्चैर्जयशब्दं पुनःपुनः ..
दिशः प्रफुल्लिताश्चासन्ग्रहाः सर्वे तथा दिवि .. 13 ..
text_mt: sounded his conch loudly and uttered cries of victory again and again. / The directions blossomed, and so did all the planets in the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
āyātā bahavo viprā vedaśāstraparāyaṇāḥ ..
cakruste jātakarmāsya nāmakarma tathāvidham .. 14 ..
meaning:
आयाता बहवो विप्रा वेदशास्त्रपरायणाः ..
चक्रुस्ते जातकर्मास्य नामकर्म तथाविधम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Many Brahmins devoted to the Vedas and śāstras arrived; / they performed his birth-rites and the naming-rites accordingly.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmāṃśaṃ taṃ śiśuṃ jñātvā prasannavadanaṃ śubham ..
bhādrakṛṣṇatithau ṣaṣṭhyāṃ candravāre'ruṇodaye .. 15 ..
meaning:
रामांशं तं शिशुं ज्ञात्वा प्रसन्नवदनं शुभम् ..
भाद्रकृष्णतिथौ षष्ठ्यां चन्द्रवारेऽरुणोदये .. 15 ..
text_mt: Knowing that child of bright and auspicious face to be a portion of Rāma, / on the sixth lunar day of the dark fortnight of Bhādrapada, on a Monday at dawn,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃjātaḥ kṛttikābhe ca pitṛvaṃśayaśaskaraḥ ..
āhlādanāmnā hyabhavatpraśritaśca mahītale .. 16 ..
meaning:
संजातः कृत्तिकाभे च पितृवंशयशस्करः ..
आह्लादनाम्ना ह्यभवत्प्रश्रितश्च महीतले .. 16 ..
text_mt: Born under the asterism Kṛttikā, he brought renown to his paternal lineage; / he was named Āhlāda, and he became obedient upon the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
māsānte ca sute jāte brāhmī putramajījanat ..
dharmajāṃśaṃ tathā gauraṃ mahābāhuṃ suvakṣasam .. 17 ..
meaning:
मासान्ते च सुते जाते ब्राह्मी पुत्रमजीजनत् ..
धर्मजांशं तथा गौरं महाबाहुं सुवक्षसम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: At the end of a month after the son was born, Brāhmī gave birth to a son / who was a portion of Dharma's son [Yudhiṣṭhira], fair-complexioned, with mighty arms and a broad chest.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā ca brāhmaṇāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā bālaṃ śubhānanam ..
prasannavadanaṃ cāruṃ padmacihnapadasthitam .. 18 ..
meaning:
तदा च ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे दृष्ट्वा बालं शुभाननम् ..
प्रसन्नवदनं चारुं पद्मचिह्नपदस्थितम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: Then all the brāhmaṇas, seeing the boy with an auspicious face, / delightful countenance, handsome, bearing lotus marks upon his feet,

sanskrit_iast:
tairdvijaiśca kṛto nāmnā balakhānirmahābalaḥ ..
varṣānte vatsaje jātaṃ mūlagaṃḍāntasaṃbhavaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
तैर्द्विजैश्च कृतो नाम्ना बलखानिर्महाबलः ..
वर्षान्ते वत्सजे जातं मूलगंडान्तसंभवः .. 19 ..
text_mt: were given the name Balakhāni, possessed of great strength, by those twice-born ones. / At the year's end, born of Vatsarāja under the conjunction of Mūla and Gaṇḍānta,

sanskrit_iast:
cāmuṇḍo devakisuto nijavaṃśabhayaṃkaraḥ ..
janitāraṃ tatastyājya ityūcurdvijasattamāḥ ..
na tatyāja sutaṃ rājā bālatve'pi dayāparaḥ .. 3.3.9.20 ..
meaning:
चामुण्डो देवकिसुतो निजवंशभयंकरः ..
जनितारं ततस्त्याज्य इत्यूचुर्द्विजसत्तमाः ..
न तत्याज सुतं राजा बालत्वेऽपि दयापरः .. 3.3.9.20 ..
text_mt: was Cāmuṇḍa, the son of Devakī, terrifying to his own family. / The best of the twice-born said, 'He must be abandoned by his progenitor.' / Yet the king, filled with compassion, did not abandon his son, though he was an infant.

sanskrit_iast:
trivarṣāṃte gate tasminbalakhānau sute śubhe ..
śūdryāṃ jātaḥ śikhaṃḍayaṃśo rūpaṇo nāma viśrutaḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
त्रिवर्षांते गते तस्मिन्बलखानौ सुते शुभे ..
शूद्र्यां जातः शिखंडयंशो रूपणो नाम विश्रुतः .. 21 ..
text_mt: When three years had passed for that auspicious son Balakhāni, / there was born of a Śūdrā woman an incarnation of Śikhaṇḍin, renowned by the name Rūpaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vatsarājo yayau deśe gurjare ca madālasām.
sa sutāṃ ca samādāya dine tasminsamāgataḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
वत्सराजो ययौ देशे गुर्जरे च मदालसाम्.
स सुतां च समादाय दिने तस्मिन्समागतः .. 22 ..
text_mt: Vatsarāja went to the Gurjara country for Madālasā; / taking that daughter, he returned on that very day.

sanskrit_iast:
prāpte tasminvatsarāje jambukaḥ svabalairvṛtaḥ ..
saptalakṣaiśca saṃprāpto bāhuśālī yateṃdriyaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
प्राप्ते तस्मिन्वत्सराजे जम्बुकः स्वबलैर्वृतः ..
सप्तलक्षैश्च संप्राप्तो बाहुशाली यतेंद्रियः .. 23 ..
text_mt: When Vatsarāja arrived, Jambuka, surrounded by his own forces, / arrived with seven hundred thousand men, mighty-armed and self-controlled.

sanskrit_iast:
rurodha nagarīṃ sarvāṃ rājñaḥ parimalasya vai ..
trilakṣaiśca māhāvatyai sārddhaṃ tau jagmatuḥ purāt .. 24 ..
meaning:
रुरोध नगरीं सर्वां राज्ञः परिमलस्य वै ..
त्रिलक्षैश्च माहावत्यै सार्द्धं तौ जग्मतुः पुरात् .. 24 ..
text_mt: He besieged the entire city of King Parimala. / With three hundred thousand men, the two set forth from the city of Mahāvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
māhiṣmataiḥ saptalakṣaiḥ sārddhaṃ yuddhamabhūnmahat ..
trirātraṃ dāruṇaṃ ghoraṃ yamarāṣṭravivarddhanam .. 25 ..
meaning:
माहिष्मतैः सप्तलक्षैः सार्द्धं युद्धमभून्महत् ..
त्रिरात्रं दारुणं घोरं यमराष्ट्रविवर्द्धनम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: A great battle took place with the seven hundred thousand men of Māhiṣmatī; / it was dread and terrifying, lasting three nights, swelling the realm of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
śivasya varadānena bhrātrorjātaḥ parājayaḥ ..
baddhvā tau jambuko rājā luṃṭhayitvā mahāvatīm .. 26 ..
meaning:
शिवस्य वरदानेन भ्रात्रोर्जातः पराजयः ..
बद्ध्वा तौ जम्बुको राजा लुंठयित्वा महावतीम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: By virtue of Śiva's boon, defeat befell the two brothers. / King Jambuka, having bound them both and plundered Mahāvatī,

sanskrit_iast:
veśyāṃ lakṣāratiṃ tasya taṃ hataṃ tadgajaṃ tathā ..
graiveyakaṃ tathā hāraṃ maṇiratnavibhūṣitam .. 27 ..
meaning:
वेश्यां लक्षारतिं तस्य तं हतं तद्गजं तथा ..
ग्रैवेयकं तथा हारं मणिरत्नविभूषितम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: and [taken] his courtesan Lakṣārati, killed that elephant of his, / and [taken] his necklace and string adorned with jewels and gems,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā nagarīṃ sarvāṃ bhasmayitvā gṛhaṃ yayau ..
ye guptā bhūtale śūrāste śeṣāśca tadā'bhavan ..28 ..
meaning:
गृहीत्वा नगरीं सर्वां भस्मयित्वा गृहं ययौ ..
ये गुप्ता भूतले शूरास्ते शेषाश्च तदाऽभवन् ..28 ..
text_mt: took [them], burned the entire city to ashes, and departed for home. / The heroes who were hidden on earth alone remained at that time.

sanskrit_iast:
durgeṣu yāni ratnāni tāni prāpya mudā yayau ..
luṃṭhite nagare tasmindevakī garbhamuttamam .. 29 ..
meaning:
दुर्गेषु यानि रत्नानि तानि प्राप्य मुदा ययौ ..
लुंठिते नगरे तस्मिन्देवकी गर्भमुत्तमम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: Having obtained the jewels that were in the forts, he departed joyfully. / When that city was plundered, Devakī conceived an excellent womb,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ saptamāsyaṃ hi cādadhāddaivatapriyā ..
jñātvā kulādhamaṃ putraṃ cāmuṃḍaṃ devakī satī .. 3.3.9.30 ..
meaning:
कृष्णांशं सप्तमास्यं हि चादधाद्दैवतप्रिया ..
ज्ञात्वा कुलाधमं पुत्रं चामुंडं देवकी सती .. 3.3.9.30 ..
text_mt: for the beloved of the gods bore a portion of Kṛṣṇa for seven months. / The virtuous Devakī, knowing her son Cāmuṇḍa to be the disgrace of the family,

sanskrit_iast:
kalpakṣetraṃ samāgamya kāliṃdyāṃ tamapātayat..
yojanānte gate tasmitmahīrājapurohitaḥ ..31..
meaning:
कल्पक्षेत्रं समागम्य कालिंद्यां तमपातयत्..
योजनान्ते गते तस्मित्महीराजपुरोहितः ..31..
text_mt: came to Kalpakṣetra and cast him into the Kālindī. / When a yojana had passed, the royal priest of Mahīrāja,

sanskrit_iast:
sāmanto nāma taṃ gṛhya śvaśurālayamāyayau ..
jātastu daśamāsānte rātrau ghoratamovṛte .. 32 ..
meaning:
सामन्तो नाम तं गृह्य श्वशुरालयमाययौ ..
जातस्तु दशमासान्ते रात्रौ घोरतमोवृते .. 32 ..
text_mt: named Sāmanta, took him and arrived at his father-in-law's house. / But at the end of ten months, in the night enveloped in pitch darkness,

sanskrit_iast:
bhādrakṛṣṇāṣṭamīsaumye brāhmanakṣatrasaṃyute ..
prādurāsījjagannātho devakyāṃ ca mahottamaḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
भाद्रकृष्णाष्टमीसौम्ये ब्राह्मनक्षत्रसंयुते ..
प्रादुरासीज्जगन्नाथो देवक्यां च महोत्तमः .. 33 ..
text_mt: on the Bhādrapada dark aṣṭamī, a Wednesday joined with the brāhma asterism [Rohiṇī], / the Lord of the World, most supreme, manifested from Devakī.

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmāṃgaḥ sa ca padmākṣa iṃdranīlamaṇidyutiḥ ..
vimānānāṃ sahasrāṇāṃ prakāśaḥ samajāyata .. 34 ..
meaning:
श्यामांगः स च पद्माक्ष इंद्रनीलमणिद्युतिः ..
विमानानां सहस्राणां प्रकाशः समजायत .. 34 ..
text_mt: He was dark-limbed, lotus-eyed, with the lustre of a sapphire gem; / a radiance like that of a thousand celestial chariots came into being.

sanskrit_iast:
vismitā jananī tatra dṛṣṭvā bālaṃ tamadbhutam ..
nagare ca mahāścaryaṃ jātaṃ sarve samāyayuḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
विस्मिता जननी तत्र दृष्ट्वा बालं तमद्भुतम् ..
नगरे च महाश्चर्यं जातं सर्वे समाययुः .. 35 ..
text_mt: The mother was astonished there, seeing that wondrous child. / A great marvel occurred in the city, and everyone gathered together.

sanskrit_iast:
udayaḥ kimaho jāto devānāṃ sūryarūpakaḥ ..
ityāścaryyajujāṃ teṣāṃ vāguvācāśarīriṇī .. 36 ..
meaning:
उदयः किमहो जातो देवानां सूर्यरूपकः ..
इत्याश्चर्य्यजुजां तेषां वागुवाचाशरीरिणी .. 36 ..
text_mt: 'Has there arisen a sun of the gods?' / As they were thus filled with wonder, a bodiless voice spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśo bhūtale jātaḥ sarvānandapradāyakaḥ ..
sa nāmnodayasiṃho hi sarvaśatruprakāśahā .. 37 ..
meaning:
कृष्णांशो भूतले जातः सर्वानन्दप्रदायकः ..
स नाम्नोदयसिंहो हि सर्वशत्रुप्रकाशहा .. 37 ..
text_mt: 'A portion of Kṛṣṇa is born on earth, bestowing joy upon all. / Truly, he shall be named Udayasiṃha, the destroyer of the glory of all foes.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityākāśavacaḥ śrutvā te paraṃ harṣa māyayuḥ ..
yasminkāle suto jātastadā ca malanā satī .. 38 ..
meaning:
इत्याकाशवचः श्रुत्वा ते परं हर्ष माययुः ..
यस्मिन्काले सुतो जातस्तदा च मलना सती .. 38 ..
text_mt: Hearing this speech from the sky, they experienced supreme joy. / At the time the son was born, the virtuous Malanā then

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmāṃgaṃ sundaraṃ bālaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam ..
suṣuve paramodāraṃ phālgunāṃśaṃ śivājñayā .. 39 ..
meaning:
श्यामांगं सुन्दरं बालं सर्वलक्षणलक्षितम् ..
सुषुवे परमोदारं फाल्गुनांशं शिवाज्ञया .. 39 ..
text_mt: gave birth, by the command of Śiva, to a dark-limbed, handsome boy marked with every auspicious sign, / exceedingly generous, a portion of Phālguna [Arjuna].

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu nagarī sarvā harṣabhūtā babhūva ha ..
ṣaṣṭhāhani sute jāte brahmānandaguṇākare .. 3.3.9.40 ..
meaning:
तदा तु नगरी सर्वा हर्षभूता बभूव ह ..
षष्ठाहनि सुते जाते ब्रह्मानन्दगुणाकरे .. 3.3.9.40 ..
text_mt: Then indeed the entire city was filled with rejoicing. / On the sixth day after the son, a mine of the virtues of Brahman's bliss, was born,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmī tu suṣuve putraṃ pārṣadāṃśaṃ mahābalam ..
śyāmāṃgaṃ kamalākṣaṃ ca dṛḍhaskandhaṃ mahābhujam .. 41 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मी तु सुषुवे पुत्रं पार्षदांशं महाबलम् ..
श्यामांगं कमलाक्षं च दृढस्कन्धं महाभुजम् .. 41 ..
text_mt: Brāhmī gave birth to a son of great might, an incarnation of a divine attendant, / dark-limbed, lotus-eyed, with firm shoulders and mighty arms.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāśca tadāgatya jātakarma hyakārayan ..
sukhakhānirdvijairnāmnā kṛtastu gaṇakottamaiḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाश्च तदागत्य जातकर्म ह्यकारयन् ..
सुखखानिर्द्विजैर्नाम्ना कृतस्तु गणकोत्तमैः .. 42 ..
text_mt: The brāhmaṇas arrived then and performed his birth rites; / he was named Sukhakhāni by the twice-born foremost among astrologers.

sanskrit_iast:
krameṇa varddhitā bālāḥ sarvalokaśivaṃkarāḥ ..
teṣāṃ kālī mahacchreṣṭhā pitṛmātṛpriyaṃkarī .. 43 ..
meaning:
क्रमेण वर्द्धिता बालाः सर्वलोकशिवंकराः ..
तेषां काली महच्छ्रेष्ठा पितृमातृप्रियंकरी .. 43 ..
text_mt: Gradually the boys grew, bringing auspiciousness to all the world; / superior among them was Kālī, who gave delight to his father and mother.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyābde vayaḥ prāpte kṛṣṇāṃśe balavattare ..
śakrastaddarśanakāṃkṣī hayārūḍho jagāma ha .. 44 ..
meaning:
तृतीयाब्दे वयः प्राप्ते कृष्णांशे बलवत्तरे ..
शक्रस्तद्दर्शनकांक्षी हयारूढो जगाम ह .. 44 ..
text_mt: When the portion of Kṛṣṇa reached the age of three years and grew very strong, / Śakra, desiring to see him, rode on his horse and went there.

sanskrit_iast:
krīḍansa candanāraṇye kṛṣṇāṃśo bhrātṛbhiḥ saha ..
nabhasthaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasrākṣaṃ jahāsa vai .. 45 ..
meaning:
क्रीडन्स चन्दनारण्ये कृष्णांशो भ्रातृभिः सह ..
नभस्थं पुरुषं दृष्ट्वा सहस्राक्षं जहास वै .. 45 ..
text_mt: While playing in the sandalwood forest with his brothers, / the portion of Kṛṣṇa, seeing the thousand-eyed one standing in the sky, laughed.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvinī hariṇī divyā uccaiḥśravasamantike ..
gatvā garbhamupādāya svagehaṃ punarāyayau .. 46 ..
meaning:
अश्विनी हरिणी दिव्या उच्चैःश्रवसमन्तिके ..
गत्वा गर्भमुपादाय स्वगेहं पुनराययौ .. 46 ..
text_mt: A divine mare went near Uccaiḥśravas, / and having conceived, returned once more to her abode.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣāṃtare ca suṣuve kapotaṃ tanayaṃ śubham ..
pañcābdaṃ ca samāyāte vidyādhyanamāsthitāḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
वर्षांतरे च सुषुवे कपोतं तनयं शुभम् ..
पञ्चाब्दं च समायाते विद्याध्यनमास्थिताः .. 47 ..
text_mt: After a year, she gave birth to an auspicious colt named Kapota. / When they reached the age of five years, they applied themselves to the study of sciences.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaṃ śivaśarmāṇaṃ sarvavidyāviśāradam ..
svabhaktyā sevanaṃ kṛtvā te cakrurvedapāṭhikām .. 48 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणं शिवशर्माणं सर्वविद्याविशारदम् ..
स्वभक्त्या सेवनं कृत्वा ते चक्रुर्वेदपाठिकाम् .. 48 ..
text_mt: Serving with devotion the brāhmaṇa Śivaśarman, who was skilled in all disciplines of knowledge, / they engaged in the recitation of the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭābde caiva kṛṣṇāṃśo nāmapatrādikāṃ kriyām ..
likhatāṃ bālakānāṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ śreṣṭhatāmagāt .. 49 ..
meaning:
अष्टाब्दे चैव कृष्णांशो नामपत्रादिकां क्रियाम् ..
लिखतां बालकानां च कृष्णांशः श्रेष्ठतामगात् .. 49 ..
text_mt: At the age of eight years, the portion of Kṛṣṇa, among the boys writing / in the practice of letters and the like, attained pre-eminence.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca .. ..
navamābdaṃ vayaḥ prāpte kṛṣṇāṃśo balavattaraḥ ..
paṭhitvānvīkṣikīṃ vidyāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭikalāstathā .. 1 ..
meaning:
सूत उवाच .. ..
नवमाब्दं वयः प्राप्ते कृष्णांशो बलवत्तरः ..
पठित्वान्वीक्षिकीं विद्यां चतुःषष्टिकलास्तथा .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / When the portion of Kṛṣṇa reached the age of nine years, being exceedingly strong, / having studied the science of logic and the sixty-four arts,
title: adhyāyaḥ 10

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaśāstraṃ tathaivāpi sarvaśreṣṭhaṃ babhūva ha ..
tasminkāle bhṛguśreṣṭha mahīrājo nṛpottamaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
धर्मशास्त्रं तथैवापि सर्वश्रेष्ठं बभूव ह ..
तस्मिन्काले भृगुश्रेष्ठ महीराजो नृपोत्तमः .. 2 ..
text_mt: as well as the treatises on dharma, he became the foremost of all. / At that time, O best of the Bhṛgus, the noble king Mahīrāja

sanskrit_iast:
karārthaṃ preṣayāmāsa svasainyaṃ ca mahāvatīm ..
te vai lakṣaṃ mahāśūrāḥ sarvaśastrāstradhāriṇaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
करार्थं प्रेषयामास स्वसैन्यं च महावतीम् ..
ते वै लक्षं महाशूराः सर्वशस्त्रास्त्रधारिणः .. 3 ..
text_mt: sent his army to Mahāvatī for the sake of tribute. / Those one hundred thousand great warriors, bearing all weapons and missiles,

sanskrit_iast:
ūcuḥ parimalaṃ bhūpaṃ śṛṇu caṃdrakulodbhava ..
sarve ca bhārate varṣe ye rājāno mahābalāḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
ऊचुः परिमलं भूपं शृणु चंद्रकुलोद्भव ..
सर्वे च भारते वर्षे ये राजानो महाबलाः .. 4 ..
text_mt: said to King Parimala: 'Listen, O descendant of the lunar race! / All the mighty kings in the land of Bhārata

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍaṃśaṃ karamādāyāsmadrājāya dadaṃti vai ..
bhavānkare hi tasyaiva yogyo bhavati sāṃpratam .. 5..
meaning:
षडंशं करमादायास्मद्राजाय ददंति वै ..
भवान्करे हि तस्यैव योग्यो भवति सांप्रतम् .. 5..
text_mt: take a one-sixth tribute and pay it to our king. / You too are now subject to his tribute.

sanskrit_iast:
adyaprabhṛti cedrājñe tasmai dadyātkaraṃ na hi ..
mahīrājasya raudrāstraiḥ kṣayaṃ yāsyati sainikaiḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
अद्यप्रभृति चेद्राज्ञे तस्मै दद्यात्करं न हि ..
महीराजस्य रौद्रास्त्रैः क्षयं यास्यति सैनिकैः .. 6 ..
text_mt: If from this day forth you do not pay tribute to that king, / you shall meet destruction at the hands of Mahīrāja's soldiers with dread weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
ye bhūpā jayacaṃdrasya pakṣagāste hi tadbhayāt ..
dadaṃte bhūmirājāya daṃḍaṃ tanmānasatkṛtāḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
ये भूपा जयचंद्रस्य पक्षगास्ते हि तद्भयात् ..
ददंते भूमिराजाय दंडं तन्मानसत्कृताः .. 7 ..
text_mt: Those kings who side with Jayacandra, through fear of him, / pay tribute to Bhūmirāja, being respected in their minds.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā sa nṛpatistasmai rājñe mahātmane..
karaṃ ṣaḍaṃśamādāya dadau prītisamanvitaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा स नृपतिस्तस्मै राज्ञे महात्मने..
करं षडंशमादाय ददौ प्रीतिसमन्वितः .. 8 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, that king, taking a one-sixth tribute, / gave it to that great-souled king, filled with goodwill.

sanskrit_iast:
daśalakṣamitaṃ dravyaṃ gṛhītvā te samāyayuḥ ..
mahīrājaḥ prasannātmā pūrvavairamapāharat .. 9 ..
meaning:
दशलक्षमितं द्रव्यं गृहीत्वा ते समाययुः ..
महीराजः प्रसन्नात्मा पूर्ववैरमपाहरत् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Taking wealth to the amount of one million, they returned. / Mahīrāja, his mind appeased, cast aside the former enmity.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā te lakṣaśūrāśca kānyakubjamupāyayuḥ ..
jayacaṃdraṃ tu natvocuḥ śṛṇu lakṣaṇakovida .. 3.3.10.10 ..
meaning:
तदा ते लक्षशूराश्च कान्यकुब्जमुपाययुः ..
जयचंद्रं तु नत्वोचुः शृणु लक्षणकोविद .. 3.3.10.10 ..
text_mt: Then those hundred thousand warriors went to Kānyakubja. / Bowing before Jayacandra, they said: “Listen, expert in marks [of majesty]!

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthvīrājo mahārājo daṃḍaṃ tvattaḥ samicchati ..
ityuktastairvaiṣṇavāstrī lakṣaṇastānuvāca ha .. 11 ..
meaning:
पृथ्वीराजो महाराजो दंडं त्वत्तः समिच्छति ..
इत्युक्तस्तैर्वैष्णवास्त्री लक्षणस्तानुवाच ह .. 11 ..
text_mt: Great King Pṛthvīrāja demands tribute from you.” / Thus spoken to by them, Lakṣaṇa, master of the Vaiṣṇava missile, said to them:

sanskrit_iast:
maddeśe maṃḍalīkāśca bahavaḥ saṃti sāṃpratam ..
bhūmirājo māṃḍaliko mayi jīvati mā bhavet .. 12 ..
meaning:
मद्देशे मंडलीकाश्च बहवः संति सांप्रतम् ..
भूमिराजो मांडलिको मयि जीवति मा भवेत् .. 12 ..
text_mt: “In my realm there are many feudatory rulers at present. / Bhūmirāja shall not be my feudatory while I live!”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā vaiṣṇavāstraṃ tānkruddhaḥ sa ca samādadhat ..
tadastrajvālataḥ sarve bhayabhītā pradudruvuḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा वैष्णवास्त्रं तान्क्रुद्धः स च समादधत् ..
तदस्त्रज्वालतः सर्वे भयभीता प्रदुद्रुवुः .. 13 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, enraged, he hurled the Vaiṣṇava weapon at them. / From the fire of that weapon, terrified, they all fled.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājastu tacchrutvā mahadbhayamupāgamat ..
daśābdaṃ ca vayaḥ prāpte kṛṣṇāṃśe mallakovide .. 14 ..
meaning:
महीराजस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा महद्भयमुपागमत् ..
दशाब्दं च वयः प्राप्ते कृष्णांशे मल्लकोविदे .. 14 ..
text_mt: Hearing of that, Mahīrāja experienced great fear. / When Kṛṣṇāṃśa, expert in wrestling, reached the age of ten years,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāmallāḥ samājagmustena rājñaiva satkṛtāḥ ..
teṣāṃ madhye sa kṛṣṇāṃśo bāhuśālī babhūva ha .. 15 ..
meaning:
नानामल्लाः समाजग्मुस्तेन राज्ञैव सत्कृताः ..
तेषां मध्ये स कृष्णांशो बाहुशाली बभूव ह .. 15 ..
text_mt: various wrestlers arrived, honoured by the king himself. / In their midst that mighty-armed Kṛṣṇāṃśa stood supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
urvīyādhipateḥ putraḥ ṣoḍaśābdavayā balī ..
śatamallaiśca sahitaḥ kadācitsa samāgataḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
उर्वीयाधिपतेः पुत्रः षोडशाब्दवया बली ..
शतमल्लैश्च सहितः कदाचित्स समागतः .. 16 ..
text_mt: The son of the ruler of Urvīyā, mighty and sixteen years of age, / once arrived accompanied by a hundred wrestlers.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛṣvasṛpatiṃ bhūpaṃ natvā nāmnā'bhayo balī ..
uvāca śṛṇu bhūpāla kṛṣṇo'yaṃ madamattaraḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
पितृष्वसृपतिं भूपं नत्वा नाम्नाऽभयो बली ..
उवाच शृणु भूपाल कृष्णोऽयं मदमत्तरः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Bowing to the king, the husband of his father's sister, the mighty youth named Abhaya / said: “Listen, O protector of the earth! This Kṛṣṇa is exceedingly haughty.

sanskrit_iast:
tena sārddhaṃ bhavenmallayuddhaṃ mama nṛpottama ..
iti vajrasamaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā rājā bhayāturaḥ .. 10 ..
meaning:
तेन सार्द्धं भवेन्मल्लयुद्धं मम नृपोत्तम ..
इति वज्रसमं वाक्यं श्रुत्वा राजा भयातुरः .. 10 ..
text_mt: Let there be a wrestling match between him and me, O best of kings!” / Hearing these words resembling a thunderbolt, the king, anxious with fear,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca śyālajaṃ premṇā bhavānyuddhaviśāradaḥ ..
aṣṭābdo'yaṃ sutaḥ snigdho mama prāṇasamo bhuvi .. 19 ..
meaning:
उवाच श्यालजं प्रेम्णा भवान्युद्धविशारदः ..
अष्टाब्दोऽयं सुतः स्निग्धो मम प्राणसमो भुवि .. 19 ..
text_mt: spoke with love to his brother-in-law's son: “You are skilled in combat. / This boy is only eight years old, dear and equal to my life on earth.

sanskrit_iast:
kva bhavānvajrasadṛśaḥ kva suto'yaṃ sukomalaḥ ..
anyairmallairmadīyaiśca sārddhaṃ yogyo bhavānraṇe ..3.3.10.20..
meaning:
क्व भवान्वज्रसदृशः क्व सुतोऽयं सुकोमलः ..
अन्यैर्मल्लैर्मदीयैश्च सार्द्धं योग्यो भवान्रणे ..3.3.10.20..
text_mt: Where are you, like a thunderbolt, and where this tender child? / You are suited to fight in battle with other wrestlers of mine.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā nṛpaḥ syālo mahīpatiriti smṛtaḥ ..
sa tamāha ruṣāviṣṭo bālo'yaṃ balavattaraḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा नृपः स्यालो महीपतिरिति स्मृतः ..
स तमाह रुषाविष्टो बालोऽयं बलवत्तरः .. 21 ..
