text_mt: Hearing this, the king, his brother-in-law known as Mahīpati, / filled with anger, said to him: “This boy is remarkably strong.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu tatkāraṇaṃ bhūpa yathā jñāto mayā śiśuḥ ..
āgaskṛtaṃ mahīrājaṃ matvā satilakaḥ sutam .. 22 ..
meaning:
शृणु तत्कारणं भूप यथा ज्ञातो मया शिशुः ..
आगस्कृतं महीराजं मत्वा सतिलकः सुतम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: Hear the reason, O king, how this child became known to me. / Considering that Mahīrāja had committed an offense, having marked his son with the tilaka,

sanskrit_iast:
paṃḍitāṃśca samāhūya muhūrtaṃ pṛṣṭavānmudā ..
gaṇeśo nāma matimāñjyotiśśāstraviśāradaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
पंडितांश्च समाहूय मुहूर्तं पृष्टवान्मुदा ..
गणेशो नाम मतिमाञ्ज्योतिश्शास्त्रविशारदः .. 23 ..
text_mt: he called the learned scholars and gladly asked for an auspicious moment. / The wise Gaṇeśa, an expert in the science of astrology,

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇaṃ vacanaṃ prāha mahīrājamanuttamam ..
śivadattavaro rājankubera iva sāṃpratam .. 24 ..
meaning:
लक्षणं वचनं प्राह महीराजमनुत्तमम् ..
शिवदत्तवरो राजन्कुबेर इव सांप्रतम् .. 24 ..
text_mt: spoke this supreme word concerning the marks of Mahīrāja: / ‘O king, having received a boon from Śiva, he is now like Kubera.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśastasya yogyo'yaṃ deśarājasuto'varaḥ ..
nānyo'sti bhūtale rājansatyaṃ satyaṃ bravīmyaham ... 25 ..
meaning:
कृष्णांशस्तस्य योग्योऽयं देशराजसुतोऽवरः ..
नान्योऽस्ति भूतले राजन्सत्यं सत्यं ब्रवीम्यहम् ... 25 ..
text_mt: Kṛṣṇāṃśa, the younger son of Deśarāja, is worthy of him; / there is no other on the surface of the earth, O king; I speak the absolute truth.’

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā lakṣaṇo vīraḥ pūrve barhiṣmatīṃ prati ..
kalpakṣetraṃ dakṣiṇe ca bhūmigrāmaṃ tu paścime .. 26 ..
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा लक्षणो वीरः पूर्वे बर्हिष्मतीं प्रति ..
कल्पक्षेत्रं दक्षिणे च भूमिग्रामं तु पश्चिमे .. 26 ..
text_mt: Hearing that, the heroic Lakṣaṇa established his kingdom / towards Barhiṣmatī in the east, Kalpakṣetra in the south,

sanskrit_iast:
uttare naimiṣāraṇyaṃ svakīyaṃ rāṣṭramādadhat ..
ataḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kumāro'yaṃ kānyakubje mayā śrutaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
उत्तरे नैमिषारण्यं स्वकीयं राष्ट्रमादधत् ..
अतः श्रेष्ठः कुमारोऽयं कान्यकुब्जे मया श्रुतः .. 27 ..
text_mt: Bhūmigrāma in the west, and the Naimiṣa forest in the north. / Hence I heard of this eminent prince in Kānyakubja.

sanskrit_iast:
nāgotsave ca bhūpāla paṃcamyāṃ ca nabhassite ..
dṛśyamātraṃ kumārāṃgaṃ tasmādyogyo hyayaṃ sutaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
नागोत्सवे च भूपाल पंचम्यां च नभस्सिते ..
दृश्यमात्रं कुमारांगं तस्माद्योग्यो ह्ययं सुतः .. 28 ..
text_mt: And on the Nāga festival, O ruler of the earth, on the fifth day of the bright half of Śrāvaṇa, / the prince's body was merely to be seen; therefore this son is worthy indeed.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā sa kṛṣṇāṃśo vākchareṇa prapīḍitaḥ.
abhayaṃ bhujayoḥ śīghraṃ gṛhītvā so'yudhadbalī .. 29 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा स कृष्णांशो वाक्छरेण प्रपीडितः.
अभयं भुजयोः शीघ्रं गृहीत्वा सोऽयुधद्बली .. 29 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, pierced by that arrow of words, / quickly seized Abhaya by the arms, and the mighty boy fought.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇamātraṃ raṇaṃ kṛtvā bhūmimadhye tamakṣipat ..
abhayasya bhujo bhagnastatra jāto balena vai .. 3.3.10.30 ..
meaning:
क्षणमात्रं रणं कृत्वा भूमिमध्ये तमक्षिपत् ..
अभयस्य भुजो भग्नस्तत्र जातो बलेन वै .. 3.3.10.30 ..
text_mt: Fighting for just a moment, he hurled him to the ground; / indeed, Abhaya's arm was broken then by his strength.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrcchitaṃ svasutaṃ jñātvā khaḍgahasto mahīpatiḥ ..
preṣayāmāsa tānmallānkṛṣṇāṃśasya prahāraṇe .. 31 ..
meaning:
मूर्च्छितं स्वसुतं ज्ञात्वा खड्गहस्तो महीपतिः ..
प्रेषयामास तान्मल्लान्कृष्णांशस्य प्रहारणे .. 31 ..
text_mt: Seeing his son unconscious, Mahīpati, sword in hand, / dispatched those wrestlers to strike Kṛṣṇāṃśa.

sanskrit_iast:
ruṣāviṣṭāṃśca tāñjñātvā kṛṣṇāṃśo balavattaraḥ ..
tānekaikaṃ samākṣipya vijayī sa babhūva ha .. 32 ..
meaning:
रुषाविष्टांश्च ताञ्ज्ञात्वा कृष्णांशो बलवत्तरः ..
तानेकैकं समाक्षिप्य विजयी स बभूव ह .. 32 ..
text_mt: Perceiving them overcome with wrath, the exceedingly mighty Kṛṣṇāṃśa / threw down each one of them and emerged victorious.

sanskrit_iast:
parājite mallabale khaḍgahasto mahīpatiḥ ..
maraṇāya matiṃ cakre kṛṣṇāṃśasya prabhāvataḥ ..33..
meaning:
पराजिते मल्लबले खड्गहस्तो महीपतिः ..
मरणाय मतिं चक्रे कृष्णांशस्य प्रभावतः ..33..
text_mt: When the army of wrestlers was defeated, Mahīpati, sword in hand, / resolved to slay Kṛṣṇāṃśa because of his power.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā tamīdṛśaṃ bhūpaṃ vārayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ ..
abhayaṃ nīrujaṃ kṛtvā premṇā gehamavāsayat .. 34 ..
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा तमीदृशं भूपं वारयामास भूपतिः ..
अभयं नीरुजं कृत्वा प्रेम्णा गेहमवासयत् .. 34 ..
text_mt: Seeing that king behaving in this way, the protector of the earth stopped him. / Making Abhaya free from injury, he settled him in his house with affection.

sanskrit_iast:
navābdāṃge ca kṛṣṇāṃśe cāhlādādyāḥ kumārakāḥ..
mṛgayārthe dadhuścittaṃ tamūcurbhūpatiṃ priyam ..35..
meaning:
नवाब्दांगे च कृष्णांशे चाह्लादाद्याः कुमारकाः..
मृगयार्थे दधुश्चित्तं तमूचुर्भूपतिं प्रियम् ..35..
text_mt: When Kṛṣṇāṃśa was nine years old, Āhlāda and the other princes / turned their minds to hunting, and they spoke to that beloved ruler of the earth:

sanskrit_iast:
namaste tāta bhūpāgrya sarvānaṃdapradāyaka ..
asmabhyaṃ tvaṃ hayāndehi matpriyānkaruṇākara .. 36 ..
meaning:
नमस्ते तात भूपाग्र्य सर्वानंदप्रदायक ..
अस्मभ्यं त्वं हयान्देहि मत्प्रियान्करुणाकर .. 36 ..
text_mt: “Obeisance to you, father, foremost of earth-protectors, bestower of joy upon all! / O compassionate one, grant us our favorite horses.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vacasteṣāṃ tathetyuktvā mahīpatiḥ ..
bhūtale vāsino'śvānvai divyānrāṭ caturo varān .. 37 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तेषां तथेत्युक्त्वा महीपतिः ..
भूतले वासिनोऽश्वान्वै दिव्यान्राट् चतुरो वरान् .. 37 ..
text_mt: Hearing their words, the king, saying “So be it,” / the king, filled with joy, gave them four excellent divine steeds

sanskrit_iast:
dadau tebhyo mudā yukto hariṇīgarbhasaṃbhavān ..
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ..
tvanmukhena śrutaṃ sūta hariṇī vaḍavā yathā..38 ..
meaning:
ददौ तेभ्यो मुदा युक्तो हरिणीगर्भसंभवान् ..
ऋषय ऊचुः ..
त्वन्मुखेन श्रुतं सूत हरिणी वडवा यथा..38 ..
text_mt: dwelling on the earth, born from the womb of the mare Hariṇī. / The sages said: / “From your mouth, O Sūta, it was heard how the mare Hariṇī

sanskrit_iast:
bhīṣmasiṃhāya saṃprāptā śakrāddeveśato mune ..
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmaḥ kuto jātāsturaṃgamāḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
भीष्मसिंहाय संप्राप्ता शक्राद्देवेशतो मुने ..
इदानीं श्रोतुमिच्छामः कुतो जातास्तुरंगमाः .. 39 ..
text_mt: was obtained by Bhīṣmasiṃha from Śakra, the lord of the gods, O sage. / Now we wish to hear from where those horses were born,

sanskrit_iast:
divyāṃgā bhūṣaṇāpannā nabhassalilagāminaḥ ..
.. sūta uvāca ..
deśarājena bhūpena purā dharmayutena vai..3.3.10.40..
meaning:
दिव्यांगा भूषणापन्ना नभस्सलिलगामिनः ..
.. सूत उवाच ..
देशराजेन भूपेन पुरा धर्मयुतेन वै..3.3.10.40..
text_mt: possessing celestial forms, adorned with ornaments, traversing both the sky and water.” / Sūta said: / “Formerly by the king Deśarāja, endowed with righteousness,

sanskrit_iast:
sevanaṃ bhāskarasyaiva kṛtaṃ ca dvādaśābdikam ..
sevānte bhagavānsūryo varaṃ brūhi tamabravīt.. .. 41 ..
meaning:
सेवनं भास्करस्यैव कृतं च द्वादशाब्दिकम् ..
सेवान्ते भगवान्सूर्यो वरं ब्रूहि तमब्रवीत्.. .. 41 ..
text_mt: service was rendered to the Sun for twelve years. / At the end of his service, the blessed Sun said to him: ‘Ask for a boon!’

sanskrit_iast:
prāha deva namastubhyaṃ yadi deyo varastvayā ..
hayaṃ divyamayaṃ dehi nabhasthalajalātigam .. 42 ..
meaning:
प्राह देव नमस्तुभ्यं यदि देयो वरस्त्वया ..
हयं दिव्यमयं देहि नभस्थलजलातिगम् .. 42 ..
text_mt: He said: ‘O Lord, obeisance to you! If a boon is to be granted by you, / give me a divine horse capable of traversing the sky and water.’

sanskrit_iast:
tathetyuktvā raviḥ sākṣāddadau tasmai papihakam ..
lokānpāti papīrjñeyastasyedaṃ nāma cottamam .. 43 ..
meaning:
तथेत्युक्त्वा रविः साक्षाद्ददौ तस्मै पपिहकम् ..
लोकान्पाति पपीर्ज्ञेयस्तस्येदं नाम चोत्तमम् .. 43 ..
text_mt: Saying “So be it,” the Sun visibly gave him Papihaka. / One who protects the worlds is known as Papī; this is his supreme name.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ papīhako nāma lokapālanakarmavān ..
sa hayo madamattaśca hariṇīṃ divyarūpiṇīm .. 44 ..
meaning:
अतः पपीहको नाम लोकपालनकर्मवान् ..
स हयो मदमत्तश्च हरिणीं दिव्यरूपिणीम् .. 44 ..
text_mt: Hence he was named Papīhaka, having the role of protecting the world. / That impassioned horse, driven by the urge of desire,

sanskrit_iast:
bubhuje smaravegena tasyāṃ jātāsturaṃgamāḥ ..
manorathaśca pītāṃgaḥ karālaḥ kṛṣṇarūpakaḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
बुभुजे स्मरवेगेन तस्यां जातास्तुरंगमाः ..
मनोरथश्च पीतांगः करालः कृष्णरूपकः .. 45 ..
text_mt: coupled with Hariṇī of divine form; from her the horses were born: / Manoratha of yellow body, Karāla of black form,

sanskrit_iast:
ekagarbhe samudbhūtau śaibyasugrīvakāṃśakau ..
yasmindine samudbhūtau jiṣṇuviṣṇukalāṃśataḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
एकगर्भे समुद्भूतौ शैब्यसुग्रीवकांशकौ ..
यस्मिन्दिने समुद्भूतौ जिष्णुविष्णुकलांशतः .. 6 ..
text_mt: the two born from one womb, portions of Śaibya and Sugrīva. / On the day those two were born from parts of the portions of Jiṣṇu and Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā jātau hariṇyāśca meghapuṣpabalāhakau ..
bindulaśca suvarṇāṃgaḥ śvetāṃgo harināgaraḥ.. 47 ..
meaning:
तदा जातौ हरिण्याश्च मेघपुष्पबलाहकौ ..
बिन्दुलश्च सुवर्णांगः श्वेतांगो हरिनागरः.. 47 ..
text_mt: there were then born from Hariṇī Meghapuṣpa and Balāhaka, / and Bindula of golden body, and Harināgara of white body.

sanskrit_iast:
divyāṃgāste hi catvāraḥ pūrvaṃ jātā mahābalāḥ ..
paścādaṃśāvatārāśca jātāsteṣāṃ mahātmanām .. 48 ..
meaning:
दिव्यांगास्ते हि चत्वारः पूर्वं जाता महाबलाः ..
पश्चादंशावताराश्च जातास्तेषां महात्मनाम् .. 48 ..
text_mt: Those four of celestial bodies were born first, possessed of great strength; / afterwards, partial incarnations of those great souls were born.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ vipra śṛṇu tatra kathāṃ śubhām ..
bhūtale te hayāḥ sarve prāptāścoparibhūmigāḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
इति ते कथितं विप्र शृणु तत्र कथां शुभाम् ..
भूतले ते हयाः सर्वे प्राप्ताश्चोपरिभूमिगाः .. 49 ..
text_mt: Thus it has been related to you, O brāhmaṇa; listen now to that auspicious story. / All those horses, though traversing upper realms, were obtained on earth.

sanskrit_iast:
devasiṃhāya baline dadau cāśvaṃ manoratham ..
āhlādāya karālaṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃśāyaiva bindulam .. 3.3.10.50 ..
meaning:
देवसिंहाय बलिने ददौ चाश्वं मनोरथम् ..
आह्लादाय करालं च कृष्णांशायैव बिन्दुलम् .. 3.3.10.50 ..
text_mt: To the mighty Devasiṃha he gave the horse Manoratha, / to Āhlāda, Karāla, and to Kṛṣṇāṃśa, Bindula.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmānaṃdāya putrāya pradadau harināgaram ..
te catvāro hayārūḍhā mṛgayārthaṃ vanaṃ yayuḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मानंदाय पुत्राय प्रददौ हरिनागरम् ..
ते चत्वारो हयारूढा मृगयार्थं वनं ययुः .. 51 ..
text_mt: To his son Brahmānanda he gave Harināgara. / Mounted on their horses, the four went to the forest for hunting.

sanskrit_iast:
hariṇīṃ vaḍavāṃ śubhrāṃ balakhāniḥ samāruhat ..
tadanu prayayau vīro vanaṃ siṃhaniṣevitam .. 52 ..
meaning:
हरिणीं वडवां शुभ्रां बलखानिः समारुहत् ..
तदनु प्रययौ वीरो वनं सिंहनिषेवितम् .. 52 ..
text_mt: Balakhāni mounted the white mare Hariṇī. / Thereupon that hero went toward the forest frequented by lions.

sanskrit_iast:
āhlādenaiva śārdūlo hataḥ prāṇibhayaṃkaraḥ ..
devasiṃhena siṃhaśca sūkaro balakhāninā .. 53 ..
meaning:
आह्लादेनैव शार्दूलो हतः प्राणिभयंकरः ..
देवसिंहेन सिंहश्च सूकरो बलखानिना .. 53 ..
text_mt: Āhlāda killed a tiger that terrified living beings, / and Devasiṃha [killed] a lion, and Balakhāni a boar.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmānaṃdena hariṇo hatastatra mahāvane ..
mṛgāḥ śataṃ hatāstaiśca tāngṛhītvā gṛhaṃ yayuḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मानंदेन हरिणो हतस्तत्र महावने ..
मृगाः शतं हतास्तैश्च तान्गृहीत्वा गृहं ययुः .. 54 ..
text_mt: Brahmānanda killed a deer there in the great forest; / and they killed a hundred beasts, took them, and went home.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare devī śāradā ca śubhānanā ..
mṛgī svarṇamayī bhūtvā teṣāmagre pradhāvitā ..55..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे देवी शारदा च शुभानना ..
मृगी स्वर्णमयी भूत्वा तेषामग्रे प्रधाविता ..55..
text_mt: Meanwhile, the goddess Śāradā of auspicious face, / having turned into a golden doe, ran before them.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ mohitāḥ sarve svaiḥ svairbāṇairatāḍayan ..
śarāstu saṃkṣayaṃ jagmurmṛgyaṃge balavattarāḥ ..56..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तां मोहिताः सर्वे स्वैः स्वैर्बाणैरताडयन् ..
शरास्तु संक्षयं जग्मुर्मृग्यंगे बलवत्तराः ..56..
text_mt: Seeing her, they were all enchanted and struck her with their various arrows; / but the very mighty arrows perished upon the body of the doe.

sanskrit_iast:
āhlādādyāśca te śūrā vismitāśca babhūvire ..
tasminkāle sa kṛṣṇāṃgo bāṇenaiva hyatāḍayat ..57..
meaning:
आह्लादाद्याश्च ते शूरा विस्मिताश्च बभूविरे ..
तस्मिन्काले स कृष्णांगो बाणेनैव ह्यताडयत् ..57..
text_mt: Āhlāda and those other heroes were astonished. / At that time Kṛṣṇāṅga struck her with an arrow.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā ca pīḍitā devī bhayabhītā yayau vanam ..
kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ krodhatāmrākṣastatpaścātprayayau balī ..58..
meaning:
तदा च पीडिता देवी भयभीता ययौ वनम् ..
कृष्णांशः क्रोधताम्राक्षस्तत्पश्चात्प्रययौ बली ..58..
text_mt: Then, distressed and struck with fear, the goddess fled to the forest; / and the mighty Kṛṣṇāṃśa, his eyes red with rage, pursued her.

sanskrit_iast:
vanāṃtaraṃ ca saṃprāpya devī dhṛtvā svakaṃ vapuḥ ..
tamuvāca prasannākṣī parīkṣā te mayā kṛtā .. 59 ..
meaning:
वनांतरं च संप्राप्य देवी धृत्वा स्वकं वपुः ..
तमुवाच प्रसन्नाक्षी परीक्षा ते मया कृता .. 59 ..
text_mt: Reaching another forest, the goddess assumed her own form / and, with gracious eyes, said to him: “I was testing you.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā te ca bhayaṃ bhūyāttadā tvaṃ māṃ sadā smara ..
sādhayiṣyāmi te kāryaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśo hi bhavānvibhuḥ .. 3.3.10.60 ..
meaning:
यदा ते च भयं भूयात्तदा त्वं मां सदा स्मर ..
साधयिष्यामि ते कार्यं कृष्णांशो हि भवान्विभुः .. 3.3.10.60 ..
text_mt: Whenever you experience danger, remember me always; / I shall accomplish your goal, for you, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, are an all-pervading lord.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvāntarhitā devī śāradā sarvamaṃgalā ..
kṛṣṇāṃśastu yayau gehaṃ taiśca sārddhaṃ mudā yutaḥ .. 61 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्हिता देवी शारदा सर्वमंगला ..
कृष्णांशस्तु ययौ गेहं तैश्च सार्द्धं मुदा युतः .. 61 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the goddess Śāradā, all-auspicious, vanished; / and Kṛṣṇāṃśa, filled with joy, went home along with them.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā parākramaṃ teṣāṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā sukho'bhavat ..
gṛhe gṛhe ca sarveṣāṃ lakṣmīrdevī samāviśat .. 62 .. ..
3.3.10.43
papīhakaḥ -- papi kṣāntau (sahane) - kāśakṛtsnadhātukośaḥ 9.35 (curādigaṇaḥ)
meaning:
तदा पराक्रमं तेषां दृष्ट्वा राजा सुखोऽभवत् ..
गृहे गृहे च सर्वेषां लक्ष्मीर्देवी समाविशत् .. 62 .. ..
3.3.10.43
पपीहकः -- पपि क्षान्तौ (सहने) - काशकृत्स्नधातुकोशः 9.35 (चुरादिगणः)
text_mt:
Then, seeing their prowess, the king was happy; / and the goddess Lakṣmī entered the house of each and every one.
3.3.10.43
papīhakaḥ — papi in the sense of endurance (bearing) — Kāśakṛtsna-dhātukośa 9.35 (curādi class)

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
daśābde ca vayaḥ prāpte viṣṇoḥ śaktyavatārake ..
vasaṃtasamaye ramye yayuste pramadāvanam .. .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
दशाब्दे च वयः प्राप्ते विष्णोः शक्त्यवतारके ..
वसंतसमये रम्ये ययुस्ते प्रमदावनम् .. .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / When the energetic incarnation of Viṣṇu reached ten years of age, / they went to the pleasure grove in the delightful springtime.
title: adhyāyaḥ 11

sanskrit_iast:
ūṣustatra vratācāre mādhave kṛṣṇavallabhe ..
snātvā ca sāgare prātaḥ pūjayāmāsuraṃbikām .. 2 ..
meaning:
ऊषुस्तत्र व्रताचारे माधवे कृष्णवल्लभे ..
स्नात्वा च सागरे प्रातः पूजयामासुरंबिकाम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: They dwelt there practicing a votive observance during Mādhava, dear to Kṛṣṇa; / and having bathed in the ocean at dawn, they worshipped Ambikā.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtukālodbhavaiḥ puṣpairdhūpairdīpairvidhānataḥ ..
japtvā saptaśatīstotraṃ dadhyuḥ sarvakarīṃ śivām .. 3 ..
meaning:
ऋतुकालोद्भवैः पुष्पैर्धूपैर्दीपैर्विधानतः ..
जप्त्वा सप्तशतीस्तोत्रं दध्युः सर्वकरीं शिवाम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: With flowers born of the season, with incense and lamps according to the rules, / and reciting the hymn of seven hundred verses, they meditated upon Śivā, who accomplishes everything.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṃdamūlaphalāhārā jīvahiṃsāvivarjitāḥ ..
teṣāṃ bhaktiṃ samālokya māsāṃte jagadaṃbikā ..4 ..
meaning:
कंदमूलफलाहारा जीवहिंसाविवर्जिताः ..
तेषां भक्तिं समालोक्य मासांते जगदंबिका ..4 ..
text_mt: Eating roots, tubers, and fruits, abstaining from harm to living beings, / at the end of the month, the Mother of the Universe, beholding their devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
dadau tebhyo varaṃ ramyaṃ tacchṛṇudhvaṃ samāhitāḥ..
āhlādāya suratvaṃ ca balatvaṃ balakhānaye .. 5 ..
meaning:
ददौ तेभ्यो वरं रम्यं तच्छृणुध्वं समाहिताः..
आह्लादाय सुरत्वं च बलत्वं बलखानये .. 5 ..
text_mt: Granted them a delightful boon; listen to that with concentrated minds: / divinity to Āhlāda and strength to Balakhāni;

sanskrit_iast:
kālajñatvaṃ ca devāya brahmajñatvaṃ nṛpāya ca...
kṛṣṇāṃśāyaiva yogatvaṃ dattvā cāṃtardadhe śivā .. 6 ..
meaning:
कालज्ञत्वं च देवाय ब्रह्मज्ञत्वं नृपाय च...
कृष्णांशायैव योगत्वं दत्त्वा चांतर्दधे शिवा .. 6 ..
text_mt: Knowledge of time to Deva, and knowledge of brahman to the king; / and having granted yoga to Kṛṣṇāṃśa, Śivā vanished.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtakṛtyāstadā te vai svagehaṃ punarāyayuḥ ..
teṣāṃ prāpte vare ramye malanā putramūrjitam ..7..
meaning:
कृतकृत्यास्तदा ते वै स्वगेहं पुनराययुः ..
तेषां प्राप्ते वरे रम्ये मलना पुत्रमूर्जितम् ..7..
text_mt: Having accomplished their purpose, they then returned to their own home. / When they had obtained this delightful boon, Malanā [gave birth to] a mighty son;

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmāṃgaṃ sātyakeraṃśaṃ suṣuve śubhalakṣaṇam ..
sa jñeyo raṇajicchūro rājanyapriyakārakaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
श्यामांगं सात्यकेरंशं सुषुवे शुभलक्षणम् ..
स ज्ञेयो रणजिच्छूरो राजन्यप्रियकारकः .. 8 ..
text_mt: She bore Śyāmāṅga, an amanuensis of Sātyaki, possessing auspicious marks; / he was known as a hero who conquers in battle and brings joy to the warrior class.

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhe māsi saṃprāpte kṛṣṇāṃśo hayavāhanaḥ ..
urvīyāṃ nagarīṃ prāpta ekākī nirbhayo valī .. 9 ..
meaning:
आषाढे मासि संप्राप्ते कृष्णांशो हयवाहनः ..
उर्वीयां नगरीं प्राप्त एकाकी निर्भयो वली .. 9 ..
text_mt: When the month of Āṣāḍha arrived, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, mounted on a horse, / reached the city of Urvīyā alone, fearless and mighty.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā sa nagarīṃ ramyāṃ caturvarṇaniṣevitām ..
dvijaśālāṃ yayau śūro dvijadhenuprapūjakaḥ .. 3.3.11.10 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा स नगरीं रम्यां चतुर्वर्णनिषेविताम् ..
द्विजशालां ययौ शूरो द्विजधेनुप्रपूजकः .. 3.3.11.10 ..
text_mt: Seeing that delightful city served by the four castes, / the hero, who reveres brāhmaṇas and cows, went to the hall of the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā svarṇaṃ dvijātibhyaḥ saṃtarpya dvijadevatāḥ ..
mahīpatigṛhaṃ ramyaṃ jagāma balavattaraḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वा स्वर्णं द्विजातिभ्यः संतर्प्य द्विजदेवताः ..
महीपतिगृहं रम्यं जगाम बलवत्तरः .. 11 ..
text_mt: Having given gold to the twice-born and satisfied the gods of the twice-born, / the most mighty one went to the delightful house of the king.

sanskrit_iast: natvā sa mātulaṃ dhīmāṃstathānyām̐śca sabhāsadaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning: नत्वा स मातुलं धीमांस्तथान्याम्̐श्च सभासदः .. 12 ..
text_mt: Having bowed to his maternal uncle, the wise one, and to the other courtiers,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā nṛpājñayā śūrā baṃdhanāya samudyatāḥ ..
khaṅgahastāḥ samājagmuryathā siṃhaṃ gajāḥ śaśāḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
तदा नृपाज्ञया शूरा बंधनाय समुद्यताः ..
खङ्गहस्ताः समाजग्मुर्यथा सिंहं गजाः शशाः .. 13 ..
text_mt: Then, by the king's command, heroes prepared to bind him, / and with swords in hand they approached, as elephants [approach] a lion, or hares [an elephant].

sanskrit_iast:
mohitaṃ taṃ nṛpaṃ kṛtvā duṣṭabuddhirmahīpatiḥ ..
kṛtvā lohamayaṃ jālaṃ tasyopari samādadheḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
मोहितं तं नृपं कृत्वा दुष्टबुद्धिर्महीपतिः ..
कृत्वा लोहमयं जालं तस्योपरि समादधेः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Having bewildered that prince, the evil-minded king / made an iron net and threw it over him.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare vīro bodhito devamāyayā ..
āgaskṛtānripūñjñātvā khaṅgahastaḥ samāvadhīt .. 15 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे वीरो बोधितो देवमायया ..
आगस्कृतान्रिपूञ्ज्ञात्वा खङ्गहस्तः समावधीत् .. 15 ..
text_mt: Meanwhile, the hero, awakened by divine Māyā, / recognized the foes who had committed offences and struck them down, sword in hand.

sanskrit_iast:
hatvā paṃcaśataṃ śūro hayārūḍho mahābalī ..
urvīyāṃ nagarīṃ prāpya jalapāne mano dadhau 16 ..
meaning:
हत्वा पंचशतं शूरो हयारूढो महाबली ..
उर्वीयां नगरीं प्राप्य जलपाने मनो दधौ 16 ..
text_mt: Having slain five hundred, the mighty hero mounted his horse, / and arriving in the city of Urvīyā, turned his mind toward drinking water.

sanskrit_iast:
kūpe dṛṣṭvā śubhā nāryo ghaṭapūrtikarīstadā ..
uvāca madhuro vākyaṃ dehi suṃdari me jalam .. 17 ..
meaning:
कूपे दृष्ट्वा शुभा नार्यो घटपूर्तिकरीस्तदा ..
उवाच मधुरो वाक्यं देहि सुंदरि मे जलम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: Seeing beautiful women at the well then filling their water pots, / he spoke sweet words: “O beautiful one, give me water.”

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tāḥ suṃdaraṃ rūpaṃ mohanāyopacakrire ..
bhittvā tāsāṃ tu vai kumbhānpāyayitvā hayaṃ jalam .. 18 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा ताः सुंदरं रूपं मोहनायोपचक्रिरे ..
भित्त्वा तासां तु वै कुम्भान्पाययित्वा हयं जलम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: Seeing his handsome form, they set about enchanting him; / but he smashed their jars, watered his horse,

sanskrit_iast:
vanaṃ gatvā ripuṃ jitvā baddhvā tamubhayaṃ balī ..
caṇḍikāpārśvamāgamya tadvadhāya mano dadhe .. 19 ..
meaning:
वनं गत्वा रिपुं जित्वा बद्ध्वा तमुभयं बली ..
चण्डिकापार्श्वमागम्य तद्वधाय मनो दधे .. 19 ..
text_mt: Went to the forest, defeated the enemy, and, having bound both of them, the mighty one / came to the presence of Caṇḍikā and set his mind on their slaughter.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā sa karuṇaṃ vākyaṃ tyaktvā svanagaraṃ yayau ..
nṛpāṃtikamupāgamya varṇayāmāsa kāraṇam .. 3.3.11.20 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा स करुणं वाक्यं त्यक्त्वा स्वनगरं ययौ ..
नृपांतिकमुपागम्य वर्णयामास कारणम् .. 3.3.11.20 ..
text_mt: Hearing their pitiful speech, he released [them] and went to his own city; / and approaching the king, he described the reason.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā parimalo rājā dvijātibhyo dadau dhanam ..
samāghrāya sa kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ kṛtakṛtyo'bhavannṛpaḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा परिमलो राजा द्विजातिभ्यो ददौ धनम् ..
समाघ्राय स कृष्णांशं कृतकृत्योऽभवन्नृपः .. 21 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, King Parimala gave wealth to the twice-born; / and having smelled Kṛṣṇāṃśa's head, the king felt he had achieved his purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāptaikādaśadābde tu kṛṣṇāṃśe yuddhadurmade ..
mahīpatirnirutsāhaḥ prayayau dehalīṃ prati .. 22 ..
meaning:
संप्राप्तैकादशदाब्दे तु कृष्णांशे युद्धदुर्मदे ..
महीपतिर्निरुत्साहः प्रययौ देहलीं प्रति .. 22 ..
text_mt: When Kṛṣṇāṃśa, furious in battle, reached his eleventh year, / the dispirited king set out toward Delhi.

sanskrit_iast:
baliṃ yathocitaṃ dattvā bhaginyai bhayakātaraḥ ..
ruroda vahudhā duḥkhaṃ deśarājātmajaprajam .. 23 ..
meaning:
बलिं यथोचितं दत्त्वा भगिन्यै भयकातरः ..
रुरोद वहुधा दुःखं देशराजात्मजप्रजम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Having given a suitable offering to his sister, trembling with fear, / he wept bitterly over the grief caused by the son of Deśarāja.

sanskrit_iast:
agamā bhaginī tasya dṛṣṭvā bhrātaramāturam ..
svapatiṃ varṇayāmāsa śrutvā rājābravīdidam .. 24 ..
meaning:
अगमा भगिनी तस्य दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरमातुरम् ..
स्वपतिं वर्णयामास श्रुत्वा राजाब्रवीदिदम् .. 24 ..
text_mt: His sister Agamā, seeing her brother in distress, / described it to her husband; and hearing it, the king said this:

sanskrit_iast:
adyāhaṃ svabalaiḥ sārddhaṃ gatvā tatra mahāvatīm ..
haniṣyāmi mahāduṣṭaṃ deśarājasutaṃ ripum .. 25 ..
meaning:
अद्याहं स्वबलैः सार्द्धं गत्वा तत्र महावतीम् ..
हनिष्यामि महादुष्टं देशराजसुतं रिपुम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: “Today, accompanied by my own forces, I will go there to Mahāvatī / and kill the exceedingly wicked enemy, the son of Deśarāja.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā dhuṃdhukāraṃ ca samāhūya mahābalam ..
sainyamājñāpayāmāsa saptalakṣaṃ tanutyajam .. 26 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा धुंधुकारं च समाहूय महाबलम् ..
सैन्यमाज्ञापयामास सप्तलक्षं तनुत्यजम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus and summoned the mighty Dhuṃdhukāra, / he gave orders to an army of seven hundred thousand who were ready to abandon their lives.

sanskrit_iast:
kecicchūrā hayārūḍhā uṣṭrārūḍhā mahābalāḥ ..
gajārūḍhā rathārūḍhāḥ saṃyayuśca padātayaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
केचिच्छूरा हयारूढा उष्ट्रारूढा महाबलाः ..
गजारूढा रथारूढाः संययुश्च पदातयः .. 27 ..
text_mt: Some heroes were mounted on horses, others mighty ones mounted on camels; / and mounted on elephants, mounted on chariots, and on foot, they marched forth.

sanskrit_iast:
devasiṃhastu kālajñaḥ śrutvā cāgamanaṃ ripoḥ ..
nṛpapārśvaṃ samāgamya sarvaṃ rājñe nyavedayat .. 28 ..
meaning:
देवसिंहस्तु कालज्ञः श्रुत्वा चागमनं रिपोः ..
नृपपार्श्वं समागम्य सर्वं राज्ञे न्यवेदयत् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Then Devasiṃha, who knew the times, hearing of the enemy’s approach, / came to the side of the king and reported everything to him.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā parimalo rājā vihvalo'bhūdbhayāturaḥ ..
balakhānistamutthāya harṣayukta ivāha ca .. .. 29 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा परिमलो राजा विह्वलोऽभूद्भयातुरः ..
बलखानिस्तमुत्थाय हर्षयुक्त इवाह च .. .. 29 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, King Parimala was overwhelmed and afflicted with fear; / but Balakhāni stood up before him and said, as if filled with joy:

sanskrit_iast:
adyāhaṃ ca mahīrājaṃ dhuṃdhukāraṃ sasainyakam ..
jitvā daṃḍyaṃ ca bhavataḥ kariṣyāmi tavājñayā .. 3.3.11.30 ..
meaning:
अद्याहं च महीराजं धुंधुकारं ससैन्यकम् ..
जित्वा दंड्यं च भवतः करिष्यामि तवाज्ञया .. 3.3.11.30 ..
text_mt: “Today, by your command, I will conquer King Mahīpati / and Dhuṃdhukāra along with his army, and make him pay a penalty to you.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā taṃ namaskṛtya senāpatirabhūnmune ..
tadā tu nirbhayā vīrā dṛṣṭvā rājānamāturam .. 31 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा तं नमस्कृत्य सेनापतिरभून्मुने ..
तदा तु निर्भया वीरा दृष्ट्वा राजानमातुरम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: Having said this and bowed to him, O sage, he became commander of the army; / then those fearless heroes, seeing the king distressed,

sanskrit_iast:
caturlakṣabalaiḥ sārddhaṃ te yuddhāya samāyayuḥ ..
śiṃśapākhyaṃ vanaṃ ghoraṃ chedayitvā ripostadā .. 32 ..
meaning:
चतुर्लक्षबलैः सार्द्धं ते युद्धाय समाययुः ..
शिंशपाख्यं वनं घोरं छेदयित्वा रिपोस्तदा .. 32 ..
text_mt: Marched out for battle along with four hundred thousand troops; / and having cut down the terrible forest called Śiṃśapā belonging to the enemy,

sanskrit_iast:
ūṣustatra raṇe mattāḥ sarvaśatrubhayaṃkarāḥ ..
etasminnantare tatra dhuṃdhukārādayo balā .. 33 ..
meaning:
ऊषुस्तत्र रणे मत्ताः सर्वशत्रुभयंकराः ..
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र धुंधुकारादयो बला .. 33 ..
text_mt: Furious in battle and terrifying to all enemies, they remained there. / Meanwhile, the mighty Dhundhukāra and others,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā kolāhalaṃ śabdaṃ yuddhāya samupāyayuḥ ..
pūrvāhṇe tu bhṛguśreṣṭha sannaddhāste śataghnipāḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा कोलाहलं शब्दं युद्धाय समुपाययुः ..
पूर्वाह्णे तु भृगुश्रेष्ठ सन्नद्धास्ते शतघ्निपाः .. 34 ..
text_mt: raising a tumultuous uproar, approached for battle. / In the forenoon, O best of the Bhṛgus, those cannon-bearers were armed and ready;

sanskrit_iast:
śataghnībhistrisāhasraiḥ pañcasāhasrakā yayuḥ ..
dvisahasraśataghnībhiḥ sahitā ścandravaṃśinaḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
शतघ्नीभिस्त्रिसाहस्रैः पञ्चसाहस्रका ययुः ..
द्विसहस्रशतघ्नीभिः सहिता श्चन्द्रवंशिनः .. 35 ..
text_mt: five thousand [warriors] marched with three thousand cannons. / Along with two thousand cannons, the descendants of the Lunar dynasty [advanced];

sanskrit_iast:
sainyaṃ ṣaṣṭisahasraṃ ca svagarlokamupāyayau ..
tadarddhaṃ ca tathā sainyaṃ mahīrājasya saṃkṣitam .. 36 ..
meaning:
सैन्यं षष्टिसहस्रं च स्वगर्लोकमुपाययौ ..
तदर्द्धं च तथा सैन्यं महीराजस्य संक्षितम् .. 36 ..
text_mt: sixty thousand of their army went to the world of heaven, / and half that number of Mahīrāja’s army was destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
dudruvurbhīrukāḥ śūrā valakhānerdiśo daśa ..
rathā rathai raṇe hanyurgajāścaiva gajaistathā .. 37 ..
meaning:
दुद्रुवुर्भीरुकाः शूरा वलखानेर्दिशो दश ..
रथा रथै रणे हन्युर्गजाश्चैव गजैस्तथा .. 37 ..
text_mt: The timid ran away in ten directions from the hero Malkhān. / In the battle, chariots slew chariots, and likewise elephants [slew] elephants;

sanskrit_iast:
hayā hayaistathā uṣṭrā uṣṭrapaiśca samāhanan ..
evaṃ sutumule jāte dāruṇe roma harṣaṇe .. 38 ..
meaning:
हया हयैस्तथा उष्ट्रा उष्ट्रपैश्च समाहनन् ..
एवं सुतुमुले जाते दारुणे रोम हर्षणे .. 38 ..
text_mt: horses struck horses, and camels with camel-riders struck [camels]. / When such a dreadful, hair-raising tumoil had arisen,

sanskrit_iast:
hāhābhūtānsvakīyāṃśca sainyāndṛṣṭvā mahābalān ..
aparāhṇe bhṛguśreṣṭha pañca śūrāḥ samāyayuḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
हाहाभूतान्स्वकीयांश्च सैन्यान्दृष्ट्वा महाबलान् ..
अपराह्णे भृगुश्रेष्ठ पञ्च शूराः समाययुः .. 39 ..
text_mt: and seeing their own powerful troops crying out in distress, / in the afternoon, O best of the Bhṛgus, five heroes arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmānaṃdaḥ śaraiḥ śatrūnanayadyamasādanam ..
devasiṃhastathā bhallairāhrādastatra tomaraiḥ .. 3.3.11.40 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मानंदः शरैः शत्रूननयद्यमसादनम् ..
देवसिंहस्तथा भल्लैराह्रादस्तत्र तोमरैः .. 3.3.11.40 ..
text_mt: Brahmānanda dispatched the enemies to the abode of Yama with his arrows, / Devasiṃha likewise with javelins, and Āhlāda with iron clubs.

sanskrit_iast:
balakhāniḥ svakhaḍgena kṛṣṇāṃśastu tathaiva ca ..
dvilakṣānkṣatriyāñjaghnuḥ sarvasainyaiḥ samaṃ tataḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
बलखानिः स्वखड्गेन कृष्णांशस्तु तथैव च ..
द्विलक्षान्क्षत्रियाञ्जघ्नुः सर्वसैन्यैः समं ततः .. 41 ..
text_mt: Malkhān with his sword and likewise the partial incarnation of Kṛṣṇa / together with all the troops then slew two hundred thousand kṣatriyas.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā parājitaṃ sainyaṃ dhuṃdhukāro mahābalaḥ ..
āhlādaṃ ca svabhallena gajārūḍhaḥ samāvadhīt .. 42 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा पराजितं सैन्यं धुंधुकारो महाबलः ..
आह्लादं च स्वभल्लेन गजारूढः समावधीत् .. 42 ..
text_mt: Seeing his army defeated, the mighty Dhundhukāra, / mounted on an elephant, struck Āhlāda with his javelin.

sanskrit_iast:
āhlāde mūrcchite tatra devasiṃho mahābalaḥ ..
bhallena bhrātaraṃ tasya daṃśayāmāsa vegataḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
आह्लादे मूर्च्छिते तत्र देवसिंहो महाबलः ..
भल्लेन भ्रातरं तस्य दंशयामास वेगतः .. 43 ..
text_mt: When Āhlāda fell unconscious there, the mighty Devasiṃha / swiftly pierced his brother with a javelin.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tīkṣṇavraṇamāsādya gajasthaḥ saṃmumoha vai ..
āgatāḥ śatarājāno nānādeśyā mahābalāḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
स तीक्ष्णव्रणमासाद्य गजस्थः संमुमोह वै ..
आगताः शतराजानो नानादेश्या महाबलाः .. 44 ..
text_mt: Receiving a severe wound, he fell unconscious while on his elephant. / A hundred powerful kings had arrived from various countries;

sanskrit_iast:
śastrāṇyastrāṇi teṣāṃ tu chittvā khaṅgena vatsajaḥ ..
svakhaḍgena śirāṃsyeṣāṃ pātayāmāsa bhūtale .. 45 ..
meaning:
शस्त्राण्यस्त्राणि तेषां तु छित्त्वा खङ्गेन वत्सजः ..
स्वखड्गेन शिरांस्येषां पातयामास भूतले .. 45 ..
text_mt: cutting down their weapons and missiles with his sword, the son of Vatsa / caused their heads to fall to the earth with his sword.

sanskrit_iast:
hate śatrusamūhe tu taccheṣāstu pradudruvuḥ ..
mahīrājastu balavāndṛṣṭvā bhagnaṃ svasainyakam .. 46 ..
meaning:
हते शत्रुसमूहे तु तच्छेषास्तु प्रदुद्रुवुः ..
महीराजस्तु बलवान्दृष्ट्वा भग्नं स्वसैन्यकम् .. 46 ..
text_mt: When the host of enemies was slain, the remnants fled. / Then the powerful Mahīrāja, seeing his army broken,

sanskrit_iast:
ājagāma gajārūḍhaḥ śivadattavaro balī ..
raudreṇāstreṇa hṛdaye cāvadhīdvatsajaṃ ripum .. 47 ..
meaning:
आजगाम गजारूढः शिवदत्तवरो बली ..
रौद्रेणास्त्रेण हृदये चावधीद्वत्सजं रिपुम् .. 47 ..
text_mt: came forward riding an elephant, empowered by a boon from Śiva. / With a dreadful missile he struck his enemy, the son of Vatsa, in the heart,

sanskrit_iast:
āhlādaṃ ca tathā vīraṃ devaṃ parimalātmajam ..
mūrcchayitvā mahāvīrāñchatrusainyamupāgamat .. 48 ..
meaning:
आह्लादं च तथा वीरं देवं परिमलात्मजम् ..
मूर्च्छयित्वा महावीराञ्छत्रुसैन्यमुपागमत् .. 48 ..
text_mt: and likewise the hero Āhlāda, and Deva, the son of Parimala. / Having rendered the great heroes unconscious, he approached the enemy army;

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā śataghnīśca mahāvadhamakārayat ..
ropaṇastvarito gatvā rājñe sarvamavarṇayat .. 49 ..
meaning:
पूजयित्वा शतघ्नीश्च महावधमकारयत् ..
रोपणस्त्वरितो गत्वा राज्ञे सर्वमवर्णयत् .. 49 ..
text_mt: worshiping the cannons, he caused a great slaughter. / Ropaṇa went swiftly and described everything to the king.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare vīraḥ sukhakhānirmahābalaḥ .
kapotaṃ hayamāruhya nabhomārgeṇa cāgamat .. 3.3.11.50 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे वीरः सुखखानिर्महाबलः .
कपोतं हयमारुह्य नभोमार्गेण चागमत् .. 3.3.11.50 ..
text_mt: In the meantime, the mighty hero Sukhadāsa / mounted his horse Kapota and arrived by the path of the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrcchayitvā mahīrājaṃ svabaṃdhūṃśca savāhanān ..
kṛtvā nṛpāṃtamāgamya baṃdhanāya samudyataḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
मूर्च्छयित्वा महीराजं स्वबंधूंश्च सवाहनान् ..
कृत्वा नृपांतमागम्य बंधनाय समुद्यतः .. 51 ..
text_mt: Having knocked Mahīrāja unconscious along with his kinsmen and their mounts, / he approached the king and prepared to bind him.

sanskrit_iast:
tadotthāya mahīrājo mahādevena bodhitaḥ ..
punastānsvaśarai raudrairmūrcchayāmāsa kopavān .. 52 ..
meaning:
तदोत्थाय महीराजो महादेवेन बोधितः ..
पुनस्तान्स्वशरै रौद्रैर्मूर्च्छयामास कोपवान् .. 52 ..
text_mt: Then Mahīrāja arose, awakened by Mahādeva, / and being enraged, he again knocked them unconscious with his terrible arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
sukhakhānyādikāñchūrānsaṃbadhya nigaḍairdṛḍhaiḥ ..
nṛpaṃ parimalaṃ prāpya punaryuddhamacīkarat .. 53 ..
meaning:
सुखखान्यादिकाञ्छूरान्संबध्य निगडैर्दृढैः ..
नृपं परिमलं प्राप्य पुनर्युद्धमचीकरत् .. 53 ..
text_mt: Having firmly bound the heroes Sukhakhāni and the others with iron chains, / he advanced against King Parimala and resumed the battle.

sanskrit_iast:
hāhābhūtaṃ svasainyaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā sa udayo hariḥ ..
nabhomārge hayaṃ kṛtvā tāḥ śatadhnīranāśayat .. 54 ..
meaning:
हाहाभूतं स्वसैन्यं च दृष्ट्वा स उदयो हरिः ..
नभोमार्गे हयं कृत्वा ताः शतध्नीरनाशयत् .. 54 ..
text_mt: Seeing his own army crying out in distress, that Udaya Hari / sent his horse into the sky and destroyed those cannons.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājagajaṃ prāpya baddhvā taṃ nigaḍairbalo ..
āhlādapārśvamāgamya bhrātre bhūpaṃ samarpayat .. 55 ..
meaning:
महीराजगजं प्राप्य बद्ध्वा तं निगडैर्बलो ..
आह्लादपार्श्वमागम्य भ्रात्रे भूपं समर्पयत् .. 55 ..
text_mt: The mighty one reached Mahīrāja's elephant, bound him with chains, / came before Āhlāda, and handed the king over to his brother.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu pṛthivīrājo lajjitastena nirjitaḥ ..
pañcakoṭidhanaṃ dattvā svagehaṃ punarāyayau .. 56 ..
meaning:
तदा तु पृथिवीराजो लज्जितस्तेन निर्जितः ..
पञ्चकोटिधनं दत्त्वा स्वगेहं पुनराययौ .. 56 ..
text_mt: Then Pṛthivīrāja, humiliated at being conquered by him, / gave fifty million in wealth and returned to his own home.

sanskrit_iast:
devasiṃhājñayā śūro balakhānirhi vatsajaḥ ..
tairdravyairnagarīṃ ramyāṃ kārayāmāsa sundarīm .. 57 ..
meaning:
देवसिंहाज्ञया शूरो बलखानिर्हि वत्सजः ..
तैर्द्रव्यैर्नगरीं रम्यां कारयामास सुन्दरीम् .. 57 ..
text_mt: By order of Devasiṃha, the heroic Malkhān, the son of Vatsa, / caused a pleasant and beautiful city to be built with that wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
śirīṣākhyaṃ puraṃ nāma tena vīreṇa vai kṛtam ..
sarvavarṇasamāyuktaṃ dvikrośāyāmasaṃmitam .. 58 ..
meaning:
शिरीषाख्यं पुरं नाम तेन वीरेण वै कृतम् ..
सर्ववर्णसमायुक्तं द्विक्रोशायामसंमितम् .. 58 ..
text_mt: The city named Sirisā was founded by that hero, / filled with all classes and measuring two krośas in length.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva nyavasadvīro vatsajaḥ svakulaiḥ saha ..
triṃśatkośe kṛtaṃ rāṣṭraṃ tatraiva balakhāninā .. 59 ..
meaning:
तत्रैव न्यवसद्वीरो वत्सजः स्वकुलैः सह ..
त्रिंशत्कोशे कृतं राष्ट्रं तत्रैव बलखानिना .. 59 ..
text_mt: There the heroic son of Vatsa lived together with his kin; / a realm of thirty kośas was established right there by Malkhān.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā parimalo rājā tatrāgatya mudānvitaḥ ..
āghrāya vatsajaṃ śūraṃ deśarājasutaṃ tathā .. 3.3.11.60 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा परिमलो राजा तत्रागत्य मुदान्वितः ..
आघ्राय वत्सजं शूरं देशराजसुतं तथा .. 3.3.11.60 ..
text_mt: Hearing of this, King Parimala arrived there filled with joy; / smelling the head of the heroic son of Vatsa, the son of Deśarāja,

sanskrit_iast: brahmānaṃdena sahitaḥ svagehaṃ punarāyayau .. 61 .. ..
meaning: ब्रह्मानंदेन सहितः स्वगेहं पुनराययौ .. 61 .. ..
text_mt: he returned to his own home along with Brahmānanda.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
dvādaśābde hi kṛṣṇāṃśe yathājātaṃ tathā śṛṇu ..
iṣaśukladaśamyāṃ ca rājñāṃ jātaḥ samāgamaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
द्वादशाब्दे हि कृष्णांशे यथाजातं तथा शृणु ..
इषशुक्लदशम्यां च राज्ञां जातः समागमः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Hear what happened in the twelfth year of the partial incarnation of Kṛṣṇa. / On the tenth day of the bright fortnight of Āśvina, an assembly of kings took place;
title: adhyāyaḥ 12

sanskrit_iast:
kānyakubje mahāramye nānābhūpāḥ samāyayuḥ ..
śrutvā parājayaṃ rājño mahīrājasya lakṣaṇaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
कान्यकुब्जे महारम्ये नानाभूपाः समाययुः ..
श्रुत्वा पराजयं राज्ञो महीराजस्य लक्षणः .. 2 ..
text_mt: various kings assembled in delightful Kānyakubja. / Hearing of the defeat of King Mahīrāja, Lakṣaṇa

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśadarśane vāṃchā tasya cāsīttadā mune ..
pitṛvyaṃ bhūpatiṃ prāha draṣṭuṃ yāsyāmi taṃ śubham .. 3 ..
meaning:
कृष्णांशदर्शने वांछा तस्य चासीत्तदा मुने ..
पितृव्यं भूपतिं प्राह द्रष्टुं यास्यामि तं शुभम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: then had a desire to see the partial incarnation of Kṛṣṇa, O sage. / He said to his uncle, the king: 'I will go to see that auspicious one,

sanskrit_iast:
jito yena mahīrājaḥ sarvalokaprapūjitaḥ ..
iti śrutvā vacastasya jayacaṃdro mahīpatiḥ ..
bhrātṛjaṃ praṇataṃ prāha śṛṇu śuklayaśaskara ..4..
meaning:
जितो येन महीराजः सर्वलोकप्रपूजितः ..
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य जयचंद्रो महीपतिः ..
भ्रातृजं प्रणतं प्राह शृणु शुक्लयशस्कर ..4..
text_mt: by whom Mahīrāja, revered by all people, was defeated.' / Hearing these words of his, King Jayacandra / said to his bowing nephew: 'Listen, O glorifier of the Śukla lineage,

sanskrit_iast:
rājarājapadaṃ te hi kathaṃ saṃhartumicchasi..
ityuktvā jayacaṃdrastu tadājñāṃ naiva dattavān .. 5 ..
meaning:
राजराजपदं ते हि कथं संहर्तुमिच्छसि..
इत्युक्त्वा जयचंद्रस्तु तदाज्ञां नैव दत्तवान् .. 5 ..
text_mt: why do you wish to destroy your imperial status?' / Having spoken thus, Jayacandra did not give him permission.

sanskrit_iast:
rājānaste ca sahitāḥ svasainyaiḥ parivāritāḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ draṣṭumicchantaḥ saṃyayuśca mahīpatim .. 6 ..
meaning:
राजानस्ते च सहिताः स्वसैन्यैः परिवारिताः ..
कृष्णांशं द्रष्टुमिच्छन्तः संययुश्च महीपतिम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Those kings, joined together and surrounded by their own armies, / wishing to see the partial incarnation of Kṛṣṇa, approached the king.

sanskrit_iast:
śirīṣākhyapurasthaṃ ca jñātvā kṛṣṇāṃśamuttamam ..
mahīpatiṃ puraskṛtya samājagmurnṛpāstadā .. 7 ..
meaning:
शिरीषाख्यपुरस्थं च ज्ञात्वा कृष्णांशमुत्तमम् ..
महीपतिं पुरस्कृत्य समाजग्मुर्नृपास्तदा .. 7 ..
text_mt: Knowing the noble partial incarnation of Kṛṣṇa to be in the city of Sirisā, / the kings then arrived, placing the king at their head.

sanskrit_iast:
dadṛśustaṃ mahātmānaṃ puṃḍarīkanibhānanam ..
prasannavadanāḥ sarve praśaśaṃsuḥ samaṃtataḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
ददृशुस्तं महात्मानं पुंडरीकनिभाननम् ..
प्रसन्नवदनाः सर्वे प्रशशंसुः समंततः .. 8 ..
text_mt: They beheld that great-souled one whose face resembled a white lotus; / with pleased countenances, all of them praised him all around.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā mahīpatiḥ kruddho vacanaṃ prāha bhūpatīn ..
yasyeyaṃ ca kṛtā ślāghā yuṣmābhirdūravāsibhiḥ ..
pitarau tasya balinau māhiṣmatyāṃ mṛtiṃ gatau .. 9 ..
meaning:
तदा महीपतिः क्रुद्धो वचनं प्राह भूपतीन् ..
यस्येयं च कृता श्लाघा युष्माभिर्दूरवासिभिः ..
पितरौ तस्य बलिनौ माहिष्मत्यां मृतिं गतौ .. 9 ..
text_mt: Then the king angrily addressed the kings: / 'He who has been praised by you who dwell far away— / his two strong parents died at Māhiṣmatī.

sanskrit_iast:
jambuko nāma bhūpālo nārmadīyaiḥ samanvitaḥ ..
baddhvā tau prayayau gehaṃ luṃṭhayitvā dhanaṃ bahu ..
śilāpatre samāropya tayorgātramacūrṇayat ..
śirasī ca tayośchittvā vaṭavṛkṣe samāruhat .. 3.3.12.10 ..
meaning:
जम्बुको नाम भूपालो नार्मदीयैः समन्वितः ..
बद्ध्वा तौ प्रययौ गेहं लुंठयित्वा धनं बहु ..
शिलापत्रे समारोप्य तयोर्गात्रमचूर्णयत् ..
शिरसी च तयोश्छित्त्वा वटवृक्षे समारुहत् .. 3.3.12.10 ..
text_mt: A king named Jambuka, joined by the people from the Narmadā, / bound the two, plundered much wealth, and went home; / placing their limbs on a stone slab, he crushed them, / and cutting off their heads, he hung them on a banyan tree.

sanskrit_iast:
adyāpi tau sthitau vīrau hā putreti prabhāṣiṇau ..
pretadehe ca pitarau yasya prāpto mahābalo ..
tasyodayo vṛthā jñeyo vṛthākīrtiḥ priyaṃkarī .. 11 ..
meaning:
अद्यापि तौ स्थितौ वीरौ हा पुत्रेति प्रभाषिणौ ..
प्रेतदेहे च पितरौ यस्य प्राप्तो महाबलो ..
तस्योदयो वृथा ज्ञेयो वृथाकीर्तिः प्रियंकरी .. 11 ..
text_mt: Even today those two heroes remain there, crying out: "Alas, my son!" / For one whose parents have attained the state of preta bodies, / his rise should be deemed useless, and his beloved fame in vain.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā sa kṛṣṇāṃśo bhūpatīnprāha namradhīḥ ..
gatau matpitarau sārddhaṃ gurjare yatra vai raṇaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा स कृष्णांशो भूपतीन्प्राह नम्रधीः ..
गतौ मत्पितरौ सार्द्धं गुर्जरे यत्र वै रणः .. 12 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, that partial incarnation of Kṛṣṇa with a humble mind said to the kings: / 'My parents departed together to Gurjara where the battle was.'

sanskrit_iast:
mlecchairnarāśanaiḥ sārddhaṃ tannṛpeṇa raṇo'bhavat ..
deśarājo vatsarājo yuddhaṃ kṛtvā bhayaṃkaram ..
mlecchaistaiśca hatau tatra śruteyaṃ viśrutā kathā ..13..
meaning:
म्लेच्छैर्नराशनैः सार्द्धं तन्नृपेण रणोऽभवत् ..
देशराजो वत्सराजो युद्धं कृत्वा भयंकरम् ..
म्लेच्छैस्तैश्च हतौ तत्र श्रुतेयं विश्रुता कथा ..13..
text_mt: A battle took place between its king and the flesh-eating foreigners. / Having fought a terrible fight, Deśarāja and Vatsarāja / were slain there by those foreigners; this is the famous story that is heard.

sanskrit_iast:
mātulenādya kathitaṃ navīnaṃ maraṇaṃ tayoḥ..
cetsatyaṃ vacanaṃ tasya pauruṣaṃ mama paśyata ..14..
meaning:
मातुलेनाद्य कथितं नवीनं मरणं तयोः..
चेत्सत्यं वचनं तस्य पौरुषं मम पश्यत ..14..
text_mt: Today our uncle has reported their death as fresh news. / If his word is true, behold my valor!

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā tānsa kṛṣṇāṃśo mātaraṃ prāha satvaram ..
hetuṃ ca varṇayāmāsa bhāṣitaṃ ca mahīpateḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा तान्स कृष्णांशो मातरं प्राह सत्वरम् ..
हेतुं च वर्णयामास भाषितं च महीपतेः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus to them, that portion of Kṛṣṇa went quickly to his mother, / and described the motive and what had been spoken by the king.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā vajrasamaṃ vākyaṃ ruroda jananī tadā ..
nottaraṃ pradadau mātā pati duḥkhena duḥkhitā ..16..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा वज्रसमं वाक्यं रुरोद जननी तदा ..
नोत्तरं प्रददौ माता पति दुःखेन दुःखिता ..16..
text_mt: Hearing those words like a thunderbolt, his mother then wept; / afflicted with sorrow for her husband, the mother gave no answer.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā pitṛvadhaṃ śrutvā jambukaṃ śivakiṃkaram ..
manasā sa ca kṛṣṇāṃśastuṣṭāva parameśvarīm ..17..
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा पितृवधं श्रुत्वा जम्बुकं शिवकिंकरम् ..
मनसा स च कृष्णांशस्तुष्टाव परमेश्वरीम् ..17..
text_mt: Having learned of the slaughter of his father and heard of Jambuka, the servant of Śiva, / that portion of Kṛṣṇa praised Parameśvarī in his mind:

sanskrit_iast:
jaya jaya jaya jagadamba bhavāni hyakhilalokasurapitṛmunikhāni ..
tvayā tataṃ sacarācarameva viśvaṃ pātamidaṃ hṛtameva .. 18 ..
meaning:
जय जय जय जगदम्ब भवानि ह्यखिललोकसुरपितृमुनिखानि ..
त्वया ततं सचराचरमेव विश्वं पातमिदं हृतमेव .. 18 ..
text_mt: "Victory, victory, victory, O Mother of the World, O Bhavānī, origin of all the worlds, gods, ancestors, and sages! / By you alone this universe, with the moving and the unmoving, is pervaded, protected, and destroyed!

sanskrit_iast:
iti dhyātvā sa kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ suṣvāpa nijasa dmani ..
tadā bhagavatī tuṣṭā tālanaṃ balavattaram ..
mohayitvāśu tatpārśve preṣayāmāsa sarvagā .. 19 ..
meaning:
इति ध्यात्वा स कृष्णांशः सुष्वाप निजस द्मनि ..
तदा भगवती तुष्टा तालनं बलवत्तरम् ..
मोहयित्वाशु तत्पार्श्वे प्रेषयामास सर्वगा .. 19 ..
text_mt: Having thus meditated, that portion of Kṛṣṇa fell asleep in his own dwelling. / Then, being pleased, the omnipresent goddess / quickly enchanted the mighty Tālana and dispatched him to his side.

sanskrit_iast:
caturlakṣabalaiḥ sārddhaṃ tālanaḥ śīghramāgataḥ ..
svasainyaṃ codayāmāsa caikalakṣaṃ mahābalam ..3.3.12.20..
meaning:
चतुर्लक्षबलैः सार्द्धं तालनः शीघ्रमागतः ..
स्वसैन्यं चोदयामास चैकलक्षं महाबलम् ..3.3.12.20..
text_mt: Along with a force of four hundred thousand, Tālana came swiftly. / He mobilized his own powerful army of one hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
balakhānistadā prāptaścaikalakṣabalānvitaḥ ..
anujaṃ tatra saṃsthāpya śirīṣākhye mahābalaḥ ..21..
meaning:
बलखानिस्तदा प्राप्तश्चैकलक्षबलान्वितः ..
अनुजं तत्र संस्थाप्य शिरीषाख्ये महाबलः ..21..
text_mt: Then Balakhāni arrived, accompanied by a force of one hundred thousand, / stationing his younger brother there in the city named Śirīṣa, very mighty.

sanskrit_iast:
sajjībhūtānsamālokya tānudyāne sasainyakān ..
bhītaḥ parimalo rājā kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ prati cāyayau .. 22 ..
meaning:
सज्जीभूतान्समालोक्य तानुद्याने ससैन्यकान् ..
भीतः परिमलो राजा कृष्णांशं प्रति चाययौ .. 22 ..
text_mt: Seeing them ready in the garden together with their troops, / King Parimala was terrified and went toward the portion of Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast: vihvalaṃ nṛpamālokya kṛṣṇāṃśo''śvāsayanmudā .. 23 ..
meaning: विह्वलं नृपमालोक्य कृष्णांशो'ऽश्वासयन्मुदा .. 23 ..
text_mt: Seeing the king distressed, the portion of Kṛṣṇa joyfully comforted him.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣasainyaṃ tadīyaṃ ca gṛhītvā cādhipo'bhavat ..
śataghnyaḥ paṃcasāhasrā nānāvarṇāḥ suvāhanāḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
लक्षसैन्यं तदीयं च गृहीत्वा चाधिपोऽभवत् ..
शतघ्न्यः पंचसाहस्रा नानावर्णाः सुवाहनाः .. 24 ..
text_mt: Taking his army of one hundred thousand, he became its commander. / There were five thousand cannons of various colors, mounted on fine vehicles,

sanskrit_iast:
patākāḥ pañcasāhasrāḥ sāhasraṃ kāṣṭhakāriṇaḥ ..
gajā daśasahasrāśca rathāḥ paṃcasahasrakāḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
पताकाः पञ्चसाहस्राः साहस्रं काष्ठकारिणः ..
गजा दशसहस्राश्च रथाः पंचसहस्रकाः .. 25 ..
text_mt: five thousand banners, a thousand wood-carpenters, / ten thousand elephants, and five thousand chariots,

sanskrit_iast:
trilakṣāśca hayāḥ sarve uṣṭrā daśasahasrakāḥ ..
śeṣāḥ padātayo jñeyāsta sminsainye bhayānake .. 26 ..
meaning:
त्रिलक्षाश्च हयाः सर्वे उष्ट्रा दशसहस्रकाः ..
शेषाः पदातयो ज्ञेयास्त स्मिन्सैन्ये भयानके .. 26 ..
text_mt: three hundred thousand horses in all, and ten thousand camels; / the rest in that dreadful army should be known as foot-soldiers.

sanskrit_iast:
tālanaśca samāyātaḥ sarvasenādhipo'bhavat ..
devasiṃho rathānāṃ ca sarveṣāmīśvaro'bhavat .. 27 ..
meaning:
तालनश्च समायातः सर्वसेनाधिपोऽभवत् ..
देवसिंहो रथानां च सर्वेषामीश्वरोऽभवत् .. 27 ..
text_mt: Having arrived, Tālana became the commander of the entire army; / Devasiṃha became the master of all the chariots;

sanskrit_iast:
balakhānirhayānāṃ ca sarveṣāmadhipo'bhavat ..
āhlādaśca gajānāṃ ca sarveṣāmadhipo'bhavat ..
pattīnāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaścādhipo'bhavat .. 28 ..
meaning:
बलखानिर्हयानां च सर्वेषामधिपोऽभवत् ..
आह्लादश्च गजानां च सर्वेषामधिपोऽभवत् ..
पत्तीनां चैव सर्वेषां कृष्णांशश्चाधिपोऽभवत् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Balakhāni became the master of all the horses; / Āhlāda became the master of all the elephants; / and the portion of Kṛṣṇa became the commander of all the foot-soldiers.

sanskrit_iast:
natvā te malanāṃ bhūpo dattvā dānānyanekaśaḥ ..
samāyayuśca te sarve dakṣiṇāśāṃ balānvitāḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
नत्वा ते मलनां भूपो दत्त्वा दानान्यनेकशः ..
समाययुश्च ते सर्वे दक्षिणाशां बलान्विताः .. 29 ..
text_mt: Bowing to Malanā, the king gave gifts in great numbers. / And all of them, endowed with strength, set out toward the southern quarter.

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣamātragataḥ kālo mārge tasminraṇaiṣiṇām ..
chittvā tatra vanaṃ ghoraṃ nānākaṃṭakasaṃyutam ..
senāṃ nivāsayāmāsurnirbhayāste mahābalāḥ .. 3.3.12.30 ..
meaning:
पक्षमात्रगतः कालो मार्गे तस्मिन्रणैषिणाम् ..
छित्त्वा तत्र वनं घोरं नानाकंटकसंयुतम् ..
सेनां निवासयामासुर्निर्भयास्ते महाबलाः .. 3.3.12.30 ..
text_mt: The time of just a fortnight elapsed on that march for those seeking battle. / Clearing a terrible forest there, filled with various thorns, / those very mighty men camped their army without fear.

sanskrit_iast:
devasiṃhamatenaiva yoginaste tadābhavan ..
nartakaścaiva kṛṣṇāṃśaścāhlādo ḍamarupriyaḥ .. 31..
meaning:
देवसिंहमतेनैव योगिनस्ते तदाभवन् ..
नर्तकश्चैव कृष्णांशश्चाह्लादो डमरुप्रियः .. 31..
text_mt: Following the counsel of Devasiṃha, they then became yogins: / the portion of Kṛṣṇa became a dancer, and Āhlāda took delight in the small drum;

sanskrit_iast:
maḍḍudhārī tadā devo vīṇādhārī ca tālanaḥ ..
vatsajaḥ kāṃsyadhārī ca balakhānirmahābalaḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
मड्डुधारी तदा देवो वीणाधारी च तालनः ..
वत्सजः कांस्यधारी च बलखानिर्महाबलः .. 32 ..
text_mt: then Deva held the maḍḍu drum, Tālana held the vīṇā, / the son of Vatsa held the cymbals, and Balakhāni was exceedingly powerful.

sanskrit_iast:
māturagre sthitāste vai nanṛtuḥ premavihvalāḥ..
mohitā devakī cāsīnna jñātaṃ tatra kāraṇam .. 33..
meaning:
मातुरग्रे स्थितास्ते वै ननृतुः प्रेमविह्वलाः..
मोहिता देवकी चासीन्न ज्ञातं तत्र कारणम् .. 33..
text_mt: Standing before the mother, overcome with affection, they danced. / Devakī was enchanted and did not understand the cause.

sanskrit_iast:
mohitāṃ mātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā paraṃ harṣamupāyayuḥ ..
tadā tāṃ kathayāmāsurvayaṃ te tanayā hi bhoḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
मोहितां मातरं दृष्ट्वा परं हर्षमुपाययुः ..
तदा तां कथयामासुर्वयं ते तनया हि भोः .. 34 ..
text_mt: Seeing the mother enchanted, they reached supreme joy; / then they said to her, "O Lady, we are indeed your sons!"

sanskrit_iast:
natvā tāṃ prayayuḥ sarve purīṃ māhiṣmatīṃ śubhām ..
nagaraṃ mohayāmāsurvādyagānaviśāradāḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
नत्वा तां प्रययुः सर्वे पुरीं माहिष्मतीं शुभाम् ..
नगरं मोहयामासुर्वाद्यगानविशारदाः .. 35 ..
text_mt: Bowing to her, all of them went to the auspicious city of Māhiṣmatī. / Skilled in instrumental music and singing, they enchanted the city.

sanskrit_iast:
dūtyā sārddhaṃ riporgehaṃ yayuste kāryatatparāḥ ..
nṛtyagānasuvādyaiśca rājñaste mohane ratāḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
दूत्या सार्द्धं रिपोर्गेहं ययुस्ते कार्यतत्पराः ..
नृत्यगानसुवाद्यैश्च राज्ञस्ते मोहने रताः .. 36 ..
text_mt: Intent on their duty, they went to the enemy's house accompanied by a female messenger; / and with dancing, singing, and fine instruments they engaged in captivating the queen.

sanskrit_iast:
visaṃjñāṃ mahiṣīṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ sarvamohanaḥ ..
prāptavāṃstatra yatrāsau tatsutā vijayaiṣiṇī .. 37 ..
meaning:
विसंज्ञां महिषीं कृत्वा कृष्णांशः सर्वमोहनः ..
प्राप्तवांस्तत्र यत्रासौ तत्सुता विजयैषिणी .. 37 ..
text_mt: Having rendered the chief queen unconscious, that portion of Kṛṣṇa who enchants all / arrived there where his daughter was, she who desired victory.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā sā suṃdaraṃ rūpaṃ śyāmāṃgaṃ puruṣottamam ..
mumoha vaśamāpannā maithunārthaṃ samudyatā .. 38 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा सा सुंदरं रूपं श्यामांगं पुरुषोत्तमम् ..
मुमोह वशमापन्ना मैथुनार्थं समुद्यता .. 38 ..
text_mt: Seeing his handsome form, dark-complexioned, the supreme man, / she was enchanted, fell under his power, and became eager for love-making.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tathā gatāṃ nārīṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ ślakṣṇayā girā ..
śatrorbhedaṃ ca papraccha kāminīṃ madavihvalām ..39..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तथा गतां नारीं कृष्णांशः श्लक्ष्णया गिरा ..
शत्रोर्भेदं च पप्रच्छ कामिनीं मदविह्वलाम् ..39..
text_mt: Seeing the woman in such a state, the portion of Kṛṣṇa with gentle words / inquired into the secrets of the enemy from the passionate woman overcome with desire.

sanskrit_iast:
sāha bho devakīputra yadi pāṇiṃ grahīṣyasi..
tarhi te kathayiṣyāmi piturbhedaṃ hi dāruṇam .. 3.3.12.40 ..
meaning:
साह भो देवकीपुत्र यदि पाणिं ग्रहीष्यसि..
तर्हि ते कथयिष्यामि पितुर्भेदं हि दारुणम् .. 3.3.12.40 ..
text_mt: She said: "O son of Devakī, if you take my hand [in marriage], / then I will reveal to you the formidable secrets of my father!"

sanskrit_iast:
tathetyuktvā sa balavām̐stasyāḥ pāṇiṃ gṛhītavān ..
jñātvā bhedaṃ ripoḥ sarvaṃ tāmāśvāsya yayau mudā ..41..
meaning:
तथेत्युक्त्वा स बलवाम्̐स्तस्याः पाणिं गृहीतवान् ..
ज्ञात्वा भेदं रिपोः सर्वं तामाश्वास्य ययौ मुदा ..41..
text_mt: "So be it," said the mighty one, and took her hand. / Knowing all the enemy's secrets, he consoled her and departed with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare rājñī bādhitā prāha yoginam ..
deśarājapriyāhāraṃ navalakṣasya mūlyakam ..
tubhyaṃ dāsyāmi saṃtuṣṭā nṛtyagānavimohitā .. 42 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राज्ञी बाधिता प्राह योगिनम् ..
देशराजप्रियाहारं नवलक्षस्य मूल्यकम् ..
तुभ्यं दास्यामि संतुष्टा नृत्यगानविमोहिता .. 42 ..
text_mt: Meanwhile, the queen, having regained her senses, said to the yogin: / "Delighted and enchanted by your dancing and singing, / I will give you the necklace dear to Deśarāja, worth nine hundred thousand."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vatsasutastāṃ praśasya gṛhītavān ..
prayayau baṃdhubhiḥ sārddhaṃ jambūko yatra tiṣṭhati .. 43 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वत्ससुतस्तां प्रशस्य गृहीतवान् ..
प्रययौ बंधुभिः सार्द्धं जम्बूको यत्र तिष्ठति .. 43 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, the son of Vatsa praised her and accepted it. / Together with his kinsmen, he went to where Jambūka stayed.

sanskrit_iast:
nanarta tatra kṛṣṇāṃśo balakhāniragāyata ..
āhlādastālano devo dadhmurvādyagatīrmudā .. 44 ..
meaning:
ननर्त तत्र कृष्णांशो बलखानिरगायत ..
आह्लादस्तालनो देवो दध्मुर्वाद्यगतीर्मुदा .. 44 ..
text_mt: There the portion of Kṛṣṇa danced, Balakhāni sang, / and Āhlāda, Tālana, and Deva joyfully sounded the rhythms of musical instruments.

sanskrit_iast:
mohito'bhūnnṛpastatra kāliyaḥ svajanaiḥ saha ..
kāmaṃ varaya kṛṣṇāṃga yacca te hṛdaye sthitam .. 45 ..
meaning:
मोहितोऽभून्नृपस्तत्र कालियः स्वजनैः सह ..
कामं वरय कृष्णांग यच्च ते हृदये स्थितम् .. 45 ..
text_mt: King Kāliya was enchanted there along with his people: / "Choose a boon at will, O dark-limbed youth, whatever rests in your heart!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vacaḥ śatrorbalakhānirmahābalaḥ ..
tamāha bho mahīpāla lakṣāvartirvarāṃganā ..
svavidyāṃ darśayenmahyaṃ tadā tṛptiṃ vrajāmyaham .. 46 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचः शत्रोर्बलखानिर्महाबलः ..
तमाह भो महीपाल लक्षावर्तिर्वरांगना ..
स्वविद्यां दर्शयेन्मह्यं तदा तृप्तिं व्रजाम्यहम् .. 46 ..
text_mt: Hearing this speech of the enemy, the mighty Balakhāni / said to him: "O King, if the excellent woman Lakṣāvarti / shows me her art, then I shall be satisfied."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tathā matvā lakṣāvartiṃ nṛpottamaḥ ..
sabhāyāṃ nartayāmāsa deśarājapriyāṃ tathā .. 47 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तथा मत्वा लक्षावर्तिं नृपोत्तमः ..
सभायां नर्तयामास देशराजप्रियां तथा .. 47 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, and agreeing to it, that best of kings / made Lakṣāvarti, the beloved of Deśarāja, dance in the assembly.

sanskrit_iast:
sā veśyā sutamāhlādaṃ jñātvā yogitvamāgatam ..
ruroda tatra duḥkhārtā netrādaśrūṇi muṃcatī .. 48 ..
meaning:
सा वेश्या सुतमाह्लादं ज्ञात्वा योगित्वमागतम् ..
रुरोद तत्र दुःखार्ता नेत्रादश्रूणि मुंचती .. 48 ..
text_mt: Recognizing that her son Āhlāda had assumed the state of a yogin, that courtesan / wept there, overcome with grief, shedding tears from her eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
ruditāṃ tāṃ samālokya rudannāhlāda eva saḥ ..
svabhujau tāḍayāmāsa tatpriyārthe mahābalaḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
रुदितां तां समालोक्य रुदन्नाह्लाद एव सः ..
स्वभुजौ ताडयामास तत्प्रियार्थे महाबलः .. 49 ..
text_mt: Seeing her weeping, Āhlāda himself wept / and, for the sake of his beloved [mother], that mighty one beat his own arms.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśastatra taṃ hāraṃ tasyāḥ kaṃṭhe pradattavān ..
uvāca krodhatāmrākṣastāmāśvāsya punaḥpunaḥ .. 3.3.12.50 ..
meaning:
कृष्णांशस्तत्र तं हारं तस्याः कंठे प्रदत्तवान् ..
उवाच क्रोधताम्राक्षस्तामाश्वास्य पुनःपुनः .. 3.3.12.50 ..
text_mt: There the portion of Kṛṣṇa placed that necklace upon her neck; / and with eyes red with fury, comforting her again and again, he said:

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ codayasiṃho'yaṃ piturvairārthamāgataḥ ..
haniṣyāmi ripuṃ bhūpaṃ sātmajaṃ sabalaṃ tathā .. 51 ..
meaning:
अहं चोदयसिंहोऽयं पितुर्वैरार्थमागतः ..
हनिष्यामि रिपुं भूपं सात्मजं सबलं तथा .. 51 ..
text_mt: "I, Udayasiṃha, have come for revenge on behalf of my father! / I will kill the enemy king, along with his son and his army!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vacastasya kāliyo balavattaraḥ ..
piturājñāṃ puraskṛtya śatavyūhasamanvitaḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य कालियो बलवत्तरः ..
पितुराज्ञां पुरस्कृत्य शतव्यूहसमन्वितः .. 52 ..
text_mt: Hearing these words of his, the very powerful Kāliya, / carrying out his father's command, accompanied by a hundred battle-arrays,

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ ca baṃdhanāyaiva kapāṭaṃ samaruddha saḥ ..
tāñchatrūnsamanujñāya pāśahastānsaśastragān ..53..
meaning:
तेषां च बंधनायैव कपाटं समरुद्ध सः ..
ताञ्छत्रून्समनुज्ञाय पाशहस्तान्सशस्त्रगान् ..53..
text_mt: shut the doors in order to bind them. / Having commanded those enemies armed with weapons and nooses in hand,

sanskrit_iast:
svaṃsvaṃ khaḍgaṃ samākṛṣya kṣatriyāste samāghnata ..
śataśūre hate taiśca kāliyo bhayakātaraḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
स्वंस्वं खड्गं समाकृष्य क्षत्रियास्ते समाघ्नत ..
शतशूरे हते तैश्च कालियो भयकातरः .. 54 ..
text_mt: those kṣatriyas drew their respective swords and struck. / And when a hundred warriors were slain by them, Kāliya was agitated with fear.

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktvā tātaṃ pradudrāva te tu gehādbahiryayuḥ ..
svasainyaṃ śīghramāsādya yuddhāya samupasthitaḥ ..
śibirāṇi kṛtānyeva narmadākūlamāsthitaiḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
त्यक्त्वा तातं प्रदुद्राव ते तु गेहाद्बहिर्ययुः ..
स्वसैन्यं शीघ्रमासाद्य युद्धाय समुपस्थितः ..
शिबिराणि कृतान्येव नर्मदाकूलमास्थितैः .. 55 ..
text_mt: Leaving his father, he fled, while they went out of the house. / Having quickly reached his army, he stood ready for battle; / encampments were indeed made by those stationed on the bank of the Narmadā.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā tu narmadāsetuṃ nalvamātraṃ supuṣṭidam ..
svasainyaṃ tārayāmāsa caturaṃgasamanvitam .. 56 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा तु नर्मदासेतुं नल्वमात्रं सुपुष्टिदम् ..
स्वसैन्यं तारयामास चतुरंगसमन्वितम् .. 56 ..
text_mt: Having constructed a bridge over the Narmadā, one nalva across and very solid, / he made his fourfold army cross over.

sanskrit_iast:
rurodha nagarīṃ sarvāṃ balakhānirbalairyutaḥ ..
śataghnīragrataḥ kṛtvā mahāśabdakarīstadā ..
māhiṣmatyāśca harmyāṇi pātayāmāsa bhūtale .. 57 ..
meaning:
रुरोध नगरीं सर्वां बलखानिर्बलैर्युतः ..
शतघ्नीरग्रतः कृत्वा महाशब्दकरीस्तदा ..
माहिष्मत्याश्च हर्म्याणि पातयामास भूतले .. 57 ..
text_mt: Balakhāni, accompanied by his troops, besieged the entire city. / Having placed cannons in front, which made a tremendous noise, / he then brought down the mansions of Māhiṣmatī to the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
narāśca svakulaiḥ sārddhaṃ mukhyadravyasamanvitāḥ ..
viṃdhyādreśca guhāṃ prāpya tatroṣurbhayakātarāḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
नराश्च स्वकुलैः सार्द्धं मुख्यद्रव्यसमन्विताः ..
विंध्याद्रेश्च गुहां प्राप्य तत्रोषुर्भयकातराः .. 58 ..
text_mt: And the men, along with their families and taking their most precious belongings, / reached the caves of Mount Vindhya and stayed there, trembling with fear.

sanskrit_iast:
kāliyastu gajānīke paṃcaśabdagaje sthitaḥ ..
hastipā daśasāhasrā yuddhāya samupāyayuḥ .. 59 ..
meaning:
कालियस्तु गजानीके पंचशब्दगजे स्थितः ..
हस्तिपा दशसाहस्रा युद्धाय समुपाययुः .. 59 ..
text_mt: Kāliya, however, stood amidst his elephant division upon the elephant Pañcaśabda; / ten thousand elephant-drivers advanced for battle.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyānujaḥ sūryavarmā trilakṣaisturagairyutaḥ ..
tuṃdilaśca rathaiḥ sārddhaṃ rathasthaśca sahasrakaiḥ .. 3.3.12.60 ..
meaning:
तस्यानुजः सूर्यवर्मा त्रिलक्षैस्तुरगैर्युतः ..
तुंदिलश्च रथैः सार्द्धं रथस्थश्च सहस्रकैः .. 3.3.12.60 ..
text_mt: His younger brother Sūryavarman was accompanied by three hundred thousand horses, / and Tuṇḍila, mounted on a chariot, was accompanied by thousands of chariots.

sanskrit_iast:
raṃkaṇo vaṃkaṇaścobhau caturlakṣapadātibhiḥ ..
jagmatustau mahāmlecchau mlecchabhūpasahasrakaiḥ ..
dākṣiṇātyagrāmapāste tau puraskṛtya saṃyayuḥ ..61..
meaning:
रंकणो वंकणश्चोभौ चतुर्लक्षपदातिभिः ..
जग्मतुस्तौ महाम्लेच्छौ म्लेच्छभूपसहस्रकैः ..
दाक्षिणात्यग्रामपास्ते तौ पुरस्कृत्य संययुः ..61..
text_mt: Both Raṅkaṇa and Vaṅkaṇa, accompanied by four hundred thousand foot-soldiers, / those two great foreigners marched with thousands of foreign kings; / and the southern village heads advanced, placing those two at their head.

sanskrit_iast:
ubhe sene samāsādya yuddhāya samupasthite ..
tayośca tumulayuddhamabhavallomaharṣaṇam ..62..
meaning:
उभे सेने समासाद्य युद्धाय समुपस्थिते ..
तयोश्च तुमुलयुद्धमभवल्लोमहर्षणम् ..62..
text_mt: Both armies, having approached, stood ready for battle, / and between them arose a tumultuous, hair-raising battle.

sanskrit_iast:
triyāme rudhiraisteṣāṃ nadī prāvartata drutam ..
dṛṣṭvāsrajāṃ nadīṃ ghorāṃ māṃsakardamavāhinīm ..
balakhānirameyātmā khaṅgapāṇirnaro yayau .. 63 ..
meaning:
त्रियामे रुधिरैस्तेषां नदी प्रावर्तत द्रुतम् ..
दृष्ट्वास्रजां नदीं घोरां मांसकर्दमवाहिनीम् ..
बलखानिरमेयात्मा खङ्गपाणिर्नरो ययौ .. 63 ..
text_mt: Within three hours, a river quickly began to flow with their blood. / Beholding that terrible river of blood carrying mud of flesh, / the man Balakhāni, of boundless spirit, sword in hand, advanced.

sanskrit_iast:
bhallahastastadā devo manorathahaye sthitaḥ ..
biṃdulasthaśca kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ khaṅgenaiva ripūnahan .. 64 ..
meaning:
भल्लहस्तस्तदा देवो मनोरथहये स्थितः ..
बिंदुलस्थश्च कृष्णांशः खङ्गेनैव रिपूनहन् .. 64 ..
text_mt: Then Deva, holding a spear, mounted on his horse Manoratha, / and the incarnation of Kṛṣṇa, mounted on Bindula, struck down the foes with his sword alone.

sanskrit_iast:
āhlādaśca gadāhastaḥ pothayāmāsa vāhinīm ..
rūpaṇo nāma śūdraśca śaktihastonyahanripūn ..
tālano hastanistriṃśo māhiṣmatyāṃ hananyayau .. 65 ..
meaning:
आह्लादश्च गदाहस्तः पोथयामास वाहिनीम् ..
रूपणो नाम शूद्रश्च शक्तिहस्तोन्यहन्रिपून् ..
तालनो हस्तनिस्त्रिंशो माहिष्मत्यां हनन्ययौ .. 65 ..
text_mt: And Āhlāda, mace in hand, crushed the army; / a Śūdra named Rūpaṇa, lance in hand, slew the enemies; / and Tālana, sword in hand, went forth striking them down in Māhiṣmatī.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ mahābhaye jāte raṇe tasminmahābale ..
dudruvuḥ sarvato vīrāḥ pāhipāhītyathābruvan .. 66 ..
meaning:
एवं महाभये जाते रणे तस्मिन्महाबले ..
दुद्रुवुः सर्वतो वीराः पाहिपाहीत्यथाब्रुवन् .. 66 ..
text_mt: When such great terror arose in that mighty battle, / heroes fled in every direction, shouting, 'Save us! Save us!'

sanskrit_iast:
prabhagnaṃ svabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā kāliyo balakhānikam ..
gajasthastāḍayāmāsa svabāṇaistaṃ mahābalaḥ .. 67 ..
meaning:
प्रभग्नं स्वबलं दृष्ट्वा कालियो बलखानिकम् ..
गजस्थस्ताडयामास स्वबाणैस्तं महाबलः .. 67 ..
text_mt: Seeing his army broken, the mighty Kāliya, mounted on his elephant, / struck Balakhāni with his arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
hariṇī vaḍavā tasya jñātvā svāminamāturam ..
gajopari samāsthāya svapādaistamapātayat .. 68 ..
meaning:
हरिणी वडवा तस्य ज्ञात्वा स्वामिनमातुरम् ..
गजोपरि समास्थाय स्वपादैस्तमपातयत् .. 68 ..
text_mt: His mare Hariṇī, recognizing that her master was distressed, / sprang upon the elephant and brought him down with her hooves.

sanskrit_iast:
patite kāliye vīre paṃcaśabdo mahāgajaḥ ..
śṛṃkhalaistāḍayāmāsa śūrāṃstānmadamattakān.. .. 69 ..
meaning:
पतिते कालिये वीरे पंचशब्दो महागजः ..
शृंखलैस्ताडयामास शूरांस्तान्मदमत्तकान्.. .. 69 ..
text_mt: When the heroic Kāliya fell, the great elephant Pañcaśabda / struck those heroes, frenzied with rut, with his chains.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrcchite paṃcaśūre tu rūpaṇo bhayakātaraḥ ..
devakīṃ varṇayāmāsa yathājātaṃ gajena vai ..3.3.12.70..
meaning:
मूर्च्छिते पंचशूरे तु रूपणो भयकातरः ..
देवकीं वर्णयामास यथाजातं गजेन वै ..3.3.12.70..
text_mt: When the five heroes were rendered unconscious, Rūpaṇa, overcome with fear, / recounted to Devakī what had indeed been done by the elephant.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu duḥkhitā devī dolāmāruhya satvarā ..
taṃ gajaṃ ca samāsādya varṇayāmāsa kāraṇam .. 71 ..
meaning:
तदा तु दुःखिता देवी दोलामारुह्य सत्वरा ..
तं गजं च समासाद्य वर्णयामास कारणम् .. 71 ..
text_mt: Then the distressed queen, quickly mounting a palanquin / and approaching that elephant, explained the matter:

sanskrit_iast:
gajarāja namastubhyaṃ śakradatta mahābala ..
ete putrāstu te vīra pālanīyā yathā pituḥ ..72..
meaning:
गजराज नमस्तुभ्यं शक्रदत्त महाबल ..
एते पुत्रास्तु ते वीर पालनीया यथा पितुः ..72..
text_mt: 'O king of elephants, praise be to you, gifted by Indra, possessed of great strength! / These are your sons, O hero, and are to be protected just as by a father.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā divyagajo devamāyāviśāradaḥ ..
devakīṃ śaraṇaṃ prāpya kṣamasvāgaskṛtaṃ mama .. 73 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा दिव्यगजो देवमायाविशारदः ..
देवकीं शरणं प्राप्य क्षमस्वागस्कृतं मम .. 73 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, the celestial elephant, skilled in divine illusion, / sought refuge with Devakī, [saying,] 'Forgive my offence!'

sanskrit_iast:
ityukte gajarāje tu kṛṣṇāṃśo balavattaraḥ ..
tyaktvā mūrcchāṃ yayau tatra yatrāhlādaśca mūrcchitaḥ .. 74 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्ते गजराजे तु कृष्णांशो बलवत्तरः ..
त्यक्त्वा मूर्च्छां ययौ तत्र यत्राह्लादश्च मूर्च्छितः .. 74 ..
text_mt: When this was spoken by the king of elephants, the exceedingly strong incarnation of Kṛṣṇa, / casting off his swoon, went there where Āhlāda lay unconscious.

sanskrit_iast:
tamutthāpya karasparśairbalakhānisamanvitaḥ ..
piturgajaṃ mahāmattamāhlādāya pradattavān ..
karāla mandaṃ smitaṃ rūpaṇāya tadā dadau .. 75 ..
meaning:
तमुत्थाप्य करस्पर्शैर्बलखानिसमन्वितः ..
पितुर्गजं महामत्तमाह्लादाय प्रदत्तवान् ..
कराल मन्दं स्मितं रूपणाय तदा ददौ .. 75 ..
text_mt: Rousing him with the touch of his hands, together with Balakhāni, / he gave their father's fiercely rutting elephant to Āhlāda, / and Karāla then gave a faint smile to Rūpaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrcchitaṃ kāliyaṃ śatruṃ baddhvā sa nigaḍairdṛḍhaiḥ ..
senāntaṃ preṣayāmāsa balakhānirmahābalaḥ .. 76 ..
meaning:
मूर्च्छितं कालियं शत्रुं बद्ध्वा स निगडैर्दृढैः ..
सेनान्तं प्रेषयामास बलखानिर्महाबलः .. 76 ..
text_mt: Binding the swooned enemy Kāliya with firm iron fetters, / the mighty Balakhāni sent him to the rear of the army.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryavarmā tadā jñātvā baddhaṃ baṃdhuṃ ca kāliyam ..
prayayau śatrusenāntaṃ krodhena sphuritādharaḥ .. 77 ..
meaning:
सूर्यवर्मा तदा ज्ञात्वा बद्धं बंधुं च कालियम् ..
प्रययौ शत्रुसेनान्तं क्रोधेन स्फुरिताधरः .. 77 ..
text_mt: Then Sūryavarman, learning that his kinsman Kāliya was captured, / advanced toward the front of the enemy army, his lips trembling with rage.

sanskrit_iast:
tamāyāntaṃ samālokya te vīrā yuddhadurmadāḥ ..
rathasthaṃ maṃḍalīkṛtya svasvamastraṃ samākṣipan .. 78 ..
meaning:
तमायान्तं समालोक्य ते वीरा युद्धदुर्मदाः ..
रथस्थं मंडलीकृत्य स्वस्वमस्त्रं समाक्षिपन् .. 78 ..
text_mt: Seeing him arriving, those heroes fierce in combat, / having encircled him as he stood on his chariot, discharged their weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṃṭhite'stre tadā teṣāṃ vismitāste'bhavanmune ..
cintāṃ ca mahatīṃ prāptāḥ kathaṃ vadhyo bhavedayam .. 79 ..
meaning:
कुंठितेऽस्त्रे तदा तेषां विस्मितास्तेऽभवन्मुने ..
चिन्तां च महतीं प्राप्ताः कथं वध्यो भवेदयम् .. 79 ..
text_mt: When their weapons were blunted, O sage, they were astonished, / and they fell into great anxiety: 'How can this man be slain?'

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāstraiste mahāvīrā vraṇārtibhayapīḍitāḥ ..
tyaktvā yuddhaṃ punargatvā raṇaṃ cakruḥ punaḥpunaḥ .. 3.3.12.80 ..
meaning:
तस्यास्त्रैस्ते महावीरा व्रणार्तिभयपीडिताः ..
त्यक्त्वा युद्धं पुनर्गत्वा रणं चक्रुः पुनःपुनः .. 3.3.12.80 ..
text_mt: Afflicted by the pain of wounds and dread from his weapons, those great heroes, / having abandoned the fight, returned again and fought repeatedly.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kati dinānyeva babhūva raṇa uttamaḥ ..
āhlādo vatsajo devastālano bhayasaṃyutaḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmustena vīreṇa mohitāḥ .. 81 ..
meaning:
एवं कति दिनान्येव बभूव रण उत्तमः ..
आह्लादो वत्सजो देवस्तालनो भयसंयुतः ..
कृष्णांशं शरणं जग्मुस्तेन वीरेण मोहिताः .. 81 ..
text_mt: Thus for several days a magnificent battle took place. / Āhlāda, Deva born of Vatsa, and Tālana, filled with fear, / bewildered by that hero, sought refuge with the incarnation of Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇastu taṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā devīṃ viśvavimohinīm ..
tuṣṭāva manasā vīro rātrisūktaṃ paṭhanhṛdi .. 82 ..
meaning:
कृष्णस्तु तं तथा दृष्ट्वा देवीं विश्वविमोहिनीम् ..
तुष्टाव मनसा वीरो रात्रिसूक्तं पठन्हृदि .. 82 ..
text_mt: And Kṛṣṇa, seeing him thus, the hero praised in his mind / the Goddess who bewilders the universe, reciting the Rātrisūkta in his heart.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tuṣṭā jagaddhātrī durgā durgārtināśinī ..
mohayitvā tu taṃ vīraṃ tatraivāṃtaradhīyataḥ ..83..
meaning:
तदा तुष्टा जगद्धात्री दुर्गा दुर्गार्तिनाशिनी ..
मोहयित्वा तु तं वीरं तत्रैवांतरधीयतः ..83..
text_mt: Then Durgā, the sustainer of the world, destroyer of distress, pleased, / bewildered that hero and vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
nidrayā mohitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇāṃśastu mahābalaḥ ..
babaṃdha nigaḍaistaṃ ca devakyante samāgamat .. 84 ..
meaning:
निद्रया मोहितं दृष्ट्वा कृष्णांशस्तु महाबलः ..
बबंध निगडैस्तं च देवक्यन्ते समागमत् .. 84 ..
text_mt: Seeing him bewildered by sleep, the mighty incarnation of Kṛṣṇa / bound him with iron fetters and went into the presence of Devakī.

sanskrit_iast:
tuṃdilaśca tathā jñātvā bhātṛśokapariplutaḥ ..
ājagāma hayārūḍhaḥ khaṅgahasto mahābalaḥ ..
ripusainyasya madhye tu bahuśūrānatāḍayat .. 85 ..
meaning:
तुंदिलश्च तथा ज्ञात्वा भातृशोकपरिप्लुतः ..
आजगाम हयारूढः खङ्गहस्तो महाबलः ..
रिपुसैन्यस्य मध्ये तु बहुशूरानताडयत् .. 85 ..
text_mt: And Tuṇḍila, learning of this, overwhelmed with grief for his brother, / mounted a horse, sword in hand, mighty in strength, and came forth; / he struck down many champions in the midst of the enemy army.

sanskrit_iast:
māhiṣmatyāśca te śūrā raṃkaṇena samanvitāḥ ..
tatsainyaṃ bhañjayāmāsustālanena prapālitam .. 86 ..
meaning:
माहिष्मत्याश्च ते शूरा रंकणेन समन्विताः ..
तत्सैन्यं भञ्जयामासुस्तालनेन प्रपालितम् .. 86 ..
text_mt: And those champions of Māhiṣmatī, together with Raṅkaṇa, / routed that army protected by Tālana.

sanskrit_iast:
pradrutaṃ svaṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā tālanaḥ parighāyudhaḥ ..
śirāṃsi pothayāmāsa mlecchānāṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak .. 87 ..
meaning:
प्रद्रुतं स्वं बलं दृष्ट्वा तालनः परिघायुधः ..
शिरांसि पोथयामास म्लेच्छानां च पृथक्पृथक् .. 87 ..
text_mt: Seeing his own army fleeing, Tālana, armed with an iron club, / crushed the heads of the foreigners one by one.

sanskrit_iast:
vaṃkaṇaṃ ca tathā hatvā khaḍgenaiva ca raṃkaṇam ..
tuṃdilaṃ ca tathā baddhvā dinānte śibiraṃ yayau ..88..
meaning:
वंकणं च तथा हत्वा खड्गेनैव च रंकणम् ..
तुंदिलं च तथा बद्ध्वा दिनान्ते शिबिरं ययौ ..88..
text_mt: Having slain Vaṅkaṇa and Raṅkaṇa with his sword, / and having bound Tuṇḍila, he went to the camp at the close of the day.

sanskrit_iast:
kāliye ca ripau baddhe subaddhe sūryavarmaṇi ..
tuṃdile ca tathā baddhe raṃkaṇe vaṃkaṇe hate .. 89 ..
meaning:
कालिये च रिपौ बद्धे सुबद्धे सूर्यवर्मणि ..
तुंदिले च तथा बद्धे रंकणे वंकणे हते .. 89 ..
text_mt: When the enemy Kāliya was bound, Sūryavarman securely bound, / Tuṇḍila likewise bound, and Raṅkaṇa and Vaṅkaṇa slain,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraṃ mleccharājāno hataśeṣā balānvitāḥ ..
pakṣamātramahorātraṃ yuddhaṃ cakruḥ samaṃtataḥ .. 3.3.12.90 ..
meaning:
सहस्रं म्लेच्छराजानो हतशेषा बलान्विताः ..
पक्षमात्रमहोरात्रं युद्धं चक्रुः समंततः .. 3.3.12.90 ..
text_mt: the thousand foreign kings, the powerful remnants of the slaughtered, / fought on all sides for a full fortnight, day and night.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyahaṃ tālano vīraḥ senāpatiramarṣaṇaḥ ..
ṣaṣṭiṃ bhūpāñjaghānāśu śatrusainyabhayaṃkaraḥ .. 91 ..
meaning:
प्रत्यहं तालनो वीरः सेनापतिरमर्षणः ..
षष्टिं भूपाञ्जघानाशु शत्रुसैन्यभयंकरः .. 91 ..
text_mt: Every day the heroic Tālana, the indignant commander of the army, / terrifying to the hostile forces, swiftly slew sixty kings.

sanskrit_iast:
bhayabhītā ripoḥ śūrā hatā bhūpā hataujasaḥ ..
hataśeṣā yayurgehamarddhasainyā bhayāturāḥ .. 92 ..
meaning:
भयभीता रिपोः शूरा हता भूपा हतौजसः ..
हतशेषा ययुर्गेहमर्द्धसैन्या भयातुराः .. 92 ..
text_mt: Terrified, the enemy champions and kings were slain, their vigour crushed; / the surviving half of the army, tormented by fear, fled home.

sanskrit_iast:
jambukastu tathā śrutvā duḥkhito gehamāyayau ..
vrataṃ hyanaśanaṃ kṛtvā rātrau śocannaśeta saḥ .. 93 ..
meaning:
जम्बुकस्तु तथा श्रुत्वा दुःखितो गेहमाययौ ..
व्रतं ह्यनशनं कृत्वा रात्रौ शोचन्नशेत सः .. 93 ..
text_mt: And Jambuka, hearing this, came home in sorrow; / observing a fast, he lay down at night, lamenting.

sanskrit_iast:
niśīthe samanuprāpte tatsutā vijayaiṣiṇī ..
pūrṇā tu sā kalā jñeyā rādhāyā vrajavāsinī ..94..
meaning:
निशीथे समनुप्राप्ते तत्सुता विजयैषिणी ..
पूर्णा तु सा कला ज्ञेया राधाया व्रजवासिनी ..94..
text_mt: When midnight arrived, his daughter, who desired victory / — and who should be recognized as a full portion of Rādhā residing in Vraja —

sanskrit_iast:
āśvāsya pitaraṃ taṃ ca yayau māyāviśāradā ..
rakṣakāñchivirāṇāṃ ca mohayitvā samāyayau .. 99 ..
meaning:
आश्वास्य पितरं तं च ययौ मायाविशारदा ..
रक्षकाञ्छिविराणां च मोहयित्वा समाययौ .. 99 ..
text_mt: having comforted her father, departed, skilled in illusion; / and having bewildered the guards of the camps, she arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrātaro tatra gatvāsau yatra sarvānabodhayat ..
kṛtvā sā rākṣasīṃ māyāṃ paṃcavīrānamohayat .. 96 ..
meaning:
भ्रातरो तत्र गत्वासौ यत्र सर्वानबोधयत् ..
कृत्वा सा राक्षसीं मायां पंचवीरानमोहयत् .. 96 ..
text_mt: Going there where her brothers were, she awakened none of them; / employing demoniac Māyā, she bewildered the five heroes.

sanskrit_iast:
nirastrakavacānbaṃdhūnpratidolāṃ samāruhat ..
pituraṃtikamāsādya tasmai bhrātṛndadau mudā ..97..
meaning:
निरस्त्रकवचान्बंधून्प्रतिदोलां समारुहत् ..
पितुरंतिकमासाद्य तस्मै भ्रातृन्ददौ मुदा ..97..
text_mt: She mounted a litter alongside her kinsmen, who were stripped of their weapons and armour. / Approaching her father, she joyfully gave the brothers to him.

sanskrit_iast:
prabhāte bodhitāḥ sarve snānadhyānādikāḥ kriyāḥ ..
kṛtvā yayū ripoḥ śālāṃ dṛṣṭavanto na tāṃstadā .. 98..
meaning:
प्रभाते बोधिताः सर्वे स्नानध्यानादिकाः क्रियाः ..
कृत्वा ययू रिपोः शालां दृष्टवन्तो न तांस्तदा .. 98..
text_mt: In the morning, they were all awakened. Having performed their rites such as bathing and meditation, / they went to the enemy's camp, but then they did not see them.

sanskrit_iast:
babhūburduḥkhitāḥ sarve kimidaṃ kāraṇaṃ katham ..
tānuvāca tadā devaḥ prāptā hyatra ripoḥ sutā .. 99 ..
meaning:
बभूबुर्दुःखिताः सर्वे किमिदं कारणं कथम् ..
तानुवाच तदा देवः प्राप्ता ह्यत्र रिपोः सुता .. 99 ..
text_mt: They were all grief-stricken: "What is the cause of this? How [could this happen]?" / Then the Lord spoke to them: "Indeed, the enemy's daughter arrived here.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā sā rākṣasīṃ māyāṃ hṛtvā tāngehamāyayau ..
tasmādyūyaṃ mayā sārddhaṃ gatvā yatraiva tadguruḥ .. .. 3.3.12.100 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा सा राक्षसीं मायां हृत्वा तान्गेहमाययौ ..
तस्माद्यूयं मया सार्द्धं गत्वा यत्रैव तद्गुरुः .. .. 3.3.12.100 ..
text_mt: Employing demoniac Māyā and seizing them, she returned to her home. / Therefore, having gone along with me to the very place where her guru [dwells]—

sanskrit_iast:
viṃdhyopari mahāraṇye nānāsattvaniṣevite ..
kuṭīraṃ tasya tatraiva nāmnaivailavilī hi saḥ .. ilavilā
yogasiddhiyutaḥ kāmī rākṣasebhyo hi nirbhayaḥ .. 101 ..
meaning:
विंध्योपरि महारण्ये नानासत्त्वनिषेविते ..
कुटीरं तस्य तत्रैव नाम्नैवैलविली हि सः .. इलविला
योगसिद्धियुतः कामी राक्षसेभ्यो हि निर्भयः .. 101 ..
text_mt: upon the Vindhya [mountain] in the great forest inhabited by various creatures, / his cottage is right there, and he is named Ailavilī; / endowed with yogic perfection, he is lustful and truly fearless of demons.

sanskrit_iast:
jambukasya sutā tatra pratyahaṃ svajanairyutā ..
ekākinī ca sā rātrau svaṃ guruṃ tamarīramat .. 102 ..
meaning:
जम्बुकस्य सुता तत्र प्रत्यहं स्वजनैर्युता ..
एकाकिनी च सा रात्रौ स्वं गुरुं तमरीरमत् .. 102 ..
text_mt: Jambuka's daughter goes there every day accompanied by her people, / and at night she, alone, sported with that guru of hers.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛteyaṃ cailavilinā māyā manujamohinī ..
kāryasiddhiṃ gamiṣyāmo gatvā taṃ puruṣādhamam ..
iti śrutvā tu catvāro vināhrādaṃ yayurvanam .. 103 ..
meaning:
कृतेयं चैलविलिना माया मनुजमोहिनी ..
कार्यसिद्धिं गमिष्यामो गत्वा तं पुरुषाधमम् ..
इति श्रुत्वा तु चत्वारो विनाह्रादं ययुर्वनम् .. 103 ..
text_mt: And this Māyā that bewitched the men was wrought by Ailavilin. / Having gone to that vilest of men, we shall accomplish our purpose." / Hearing this, the four went to the forest without Āhlāda.

sanskrit_iast:
gītanṛtyapravādyaiśca mohayitvā ca ta dine ..
vāsaṃ cakruśca tatraiva dhūrtaṃ māyāviśāradam .. 104 ..
meaning:
गीतनृत्यप्रवाद्यैश्च मोहयित्वा च त दिने ..
वासं चक्रुश्च तत्रैव धूर्तं मायाविशारदम् .. 104 ..
text_mt: And having captivated on that day with song, dance, and musical instruments / that rogue who was skilled in Māyā, they made their dwelling right there.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tu pūrvabhave daityaścitro nāma mahāsuraḥ ..
bāṇakanyāmuṣāṃ nityamavāñchacchiva pūjakaḥ ..
jāta ailavilī nāma pakṣapūjī sa vegavān ..1 05..
meaning:
स तु पूर्वभवे दैत्यश्चित्रो नाम महासुरः ..
बाणकन्यामुषां नित्यमवाञ्छच्छिव पूजकः ..
जात ऐलविली नाम पक्षपूजी स वेगवान् ..1 05..
text_mt: In a previous existence, he was a Daitya, a great Asura named Citra; / a worshipper of Śiva, he constantly desired Uṣā, the daughter of Bāṇa. / He was born [now] as the swift-moving Ailavilī, worshipping her faction.

sanskrit_iast:
tayormadhye pramāṇo'yaṃ vivāho me yadā bhavet ..
tadāhaṃ tvāṃ bhajiṣyāmi saṃtyaktvodvāhitaṃ patim .. 106 ..
meaning:
तयोर्मध्ये प्रमाणोऽयं विवाहो मे यदा भवेत् ..
तदाहं त्वां भजिष्यामि संत्यक्त्वोद्वाहितं पतिम् .. 106 ..
text_mt: "When this marriage of mine becomes authoritative between those two, / then I shall serve you, having abandoned the husband I wed."

sanskrit_iast:
hate tasminmahādhūrte gatvā saṃgrāmamūrddhani ..
jambukasya yayurdurgaṃ dṛṣṭvā te taṃ samāruhan ..
hatvā tatra sthitānvīrāñchataghnyaḥ parikhākṛtāḥ .. 107 ..
meaning:
हते तस्मिन्महाधूर्ते गत्वा संग्राममूर्द्धनि ..
जम्बुकस्य ययुर्दुर्गं दृष्ट्वा ते तं समारुहन् ..
हत्वा तत्र स्थितान्वीराञ्छतघ्न्यः परिखाकृताः .. 107 ..
text_mt: When that great rogue was slain, having gone to the forefront of battle, / they went to the stronghold of Jambuka. Seeing it, they scaled it, / having slain the heroes stationed there and the trench-making cannons.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu jambuko rājā śivadattavaro balī ..
jitvā pañca mahāvīrānbaddhvā tānnigaḍairdṛḍhaiḥ ..
śaivaṃ yajñaṃ ca kṛtavāṃsteṣāṃ nāmnopabṛṃhitam .. 108 ..
meaning:
तदा तु जम्बुको राजा शिवदत्तवरो बली ..
जित्वा पञ्च महावीरान्बद्ध्वा तान्निगडैर्दृढैः ..
शैवं यज्ञं च कृतवांस्तेषां नाम्नोपबृंहितम् .. 108 ..
text_mt: Then the mighty King Jambuka, who had been granted boons by Śiva, / having conquered the five great heroes and bound them with strong iron shackles, / performed a Śaiva sacrifice magnified with their names.

sanskrit_iast:
rūpaṇastu tathā jñātvā devakīṃ pratyavarṇayat ..
tadā tu duḥkhitā devī bhavānīṃ bhayahāriṇīm ..
manasā ca jagāmāśu śaraṇyāṃ śaraṇaṃ satī .. 109 ..
meaning:
रूपणस्तु तथा ज्ञात्वा देवकीं प्रत्यवर्णयत् ..
तदा तु दुःखिता देवी भवानीं भयहारिणीम् ..
मनसा च जगामाशु शरण्यां शरणं सती .. 109 ..
text_mt: Rūpaṇa, having learned of this, described it to Devakī. / Then the distressed lady, the virtuous wife, / swiftly went with her mind for refuge to Bhavānī, who dispels fear and is worthy of refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tuṣṭā jagāddhātrī svapnāṃte tāmavarṇayat ..
