मृते पंचशते रौद्रे तच्छेषा दुद्रुवुर्भयात् ..
कपाटं सुदृढं कृत्वा नृपांतिकमुपाययुः .. 23 ..
text_mt: When five hundred of those terrible men were slain, the survivors fled in terror; / having barred the door firmly, they approached the king.

sanskrit_iast:
sa nṛpaḥ kāraṇaṃ jñātvā hastabaddho mahābalī ..
uvāca tatra gatvāsau vacanaṃ kāryatatparaḥ ..24..
meaning:
स नृपः कारणं ज्ञात्वा हस्तबद्धो महाबली ..
उवाच तत्र गत्वासौ वचनं कार्यतत्परः ..24..
text_mt: Learning the cause, that king, having his hands bound in supplication, mighty though he was, / went there and spoke these words, intent upon his purpose:

sanskrit_iast:
bhavānmahābalo vīra cāṃḍālairbaṃdhanaṃ gataḥ ..
dasyubhirluṃṭhitastatra nidrāvaśyo vanaṃ gataḥ..25..
meaning:
भवान्महाबलो वीर चांडालैर्बंधनं गतः ..
दस्युभिर्लुंठितस्तत्र निद्रावश्यो वनं गतः..25..
text_mt: “You are a hero of great strength; you were bound by cāṇḍālas, / plundered there by bandits, and overcome by sleep, you went to the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
matsutā bhavane prāptā diṣṭyā tvaṃ jīvitaṃ gataḥ ..
udvāhya matsutāṃ śīghraṃ svagehaṃ yātumarhasi ..
iti śrutvā priyaṃ vākyaṃ taṃ praśasya tathākarot..26..
meaning:
मत्सुता भवने प्राप्ता दिष्ट्या त्वं जीवितं गतः ..
उद्वाह्य मत्सुतां शीघ्रं स्वगेहं यातुमर्हसि ..
इति श्रुत्वा प्रियं वाक्यं तं प्रशस्य तथाकरोत्..26..
text_mt: My daughter has arrived at the palace; fortunately, you have remained alive. / Having married my daughter, you should quickly go to your own home.” / Hearing these pleasant words, praising him, he acted accordingly.

sanskrit_iast:
maṃḍape vedakarmāṇi vivāhārthaṃ cakāra saḥ ..
jātāyāṃ maṃḍapārcāyāṃ patramāhlādahetave .. 27 ..
meaning:
मंडपे वेदकर्माणि विवाहार्थं चकार सः ..
जातायां मंडपार्चायां पत्रमाह्लादहेतवे .. 27 ..
text_mt: He performed the Vedic rites in the pavilion for the sake of the marriage; / when the worship of the pavilion was completed, for the purpose of [bringing] Āhlāda,

sanskrit_iast:
tadājñayā likhitvāsau gajaseno'gnisevakaḥ ..
uṣṭrārūḍhaṃ samāhūya śīghraṃ patramacodayat .. 28 ..
meaning:
तदाज्ञया लिखित्वासौ गजसेनोऽग्निसेवकः ..
उष्ट्रारूढं समाहूय शीघ्रं पत्रमचोदयत् .. 28 ..
text_mt: having written a letter at his command, Gajasena, the worshipper of fire, / summoned an emissary mounted on a camel and dispatched the letter quickly:

sanskrit_iast:
balakhānervivāho'tra bhavānsainyasamanvitaḥ ..
saṃprāpya yogyadravyāṇi bhuktvā tvaṃ tṛptimāvaha .. 29 ..
meaning:
बलखानेर्विवाहोऽत्र भवान्सैन्यसमन्वितः ..
संप्राप्य योग्यद्रव्याणि भुक्त्वा त्वं तृप्तिमावह .. 29 ..
text_mt: “Here is Balakhāni's marriage; accompanied by your army, / having arrived and received suitable gifts and enjoyed food, find satisfaction.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityukte niśi jātāyāṃ balakhānirmahābalaḥ ..
bhojanaṃ kṛtavāṃstatra viṣajuṣṭaṃ nṛpārpitam .. 3.3.16.30 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्ते निशि जातायां बलखानिर्महाबलः ..
भोजनं कृतवांस्तत्र विषजुष्टं नृपार्पितम् .. 3.3.16.30 ..
text_mt: Having said this, when night fell, the mighty Balakhāni / ate food there that was tainted with poison, offered by the king.

sanskrit_iast:
garalaṃ tena saṃbhuktaṃ na mamāra varācchubhāt ..
tataḥ kāle ca saṃprāpte dṛṣṭvā mohatvamāgatam ..
punarbabaṃdha nigaḍaistāḍayāmāsa vetasaiḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
गरलं तेन संभुक्तं न ममार वराच्छुभात् ..
ततः काले च संप्राप्ते दृष्ट्वा मोहत्वमागतम् ..
पुनर्बबंध निगडैस्ताडयामास वेतसैः .. 31 ..
text_mt: Though the poison was consumed by him, he did not die, on account of an auspicious boon; / then, when the time came, seeing that he had fallen into a stupor, / he bound him again with fetters and beat him with canes.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣadoṣamasṛkdvārānnissṛtaṃ sarvadehataḥ ..
tadā bubodha balavānbhūpatiṃ prāha namradhīḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
विषदोषमसृक्द्वारान्निस्सृतं सर्वदेहतः ..
तदा बुबोध बलवान्भूपतिं प्राह नम्रधीः .. 32 ..
text_mt: The effect of the poison flowed out with blood from his whole body; / then the strong man awakened, and with a humble mind said to the king:

sanskrit_iast:
rājankimīdṛśaṃ jātaṃ tvatsainyaṃ tāḍane ratam ..
sa āha bho mahāvīra matkule rītirīdṛśī ..
yātanāṃ prathamaṃ prāpya tadanūdvāhito bhavet .. 33 ..
meaning:
राजन्किमीदृशं जातं त्वत्सैन्यं ताडने रतम् ..
स आह भो महावीर मत्कुले रीतिरीदृशी ..
यातनां प्रथमं प्राप्य तदनूद्वाहितो भवेत् .. 33 ..
text_mt: “O King, what sort of thing has happened, that your army is intent upon beating me?” / He replied: “O mighty hero, such is the custom in my family; / having first endured suffering, one should then be married.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityukte sati bhūpāle gajamuktā samāgatā ..
pitaraṃ prāha vacanaṃ ko'yaṃ tattāḍane gataḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्ते सति भूपाले गजमुक्ता समागता ..
पितरं प्राह वचनं कोऽयं तत्ताडने गतः .. 34 ..
text_mt: While the king was speaking thus, Gajamuktā arrived; / she addressed these words to her father: “Who is this person who has undergone such beating?”

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpaḥ prāha sute śīghraṃ yāhi tvaṃ nijamaṃdire ..
kṛṣikaroyamāyāto dravyārthaṃ tāḍane gataḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
नृपः प्राह सुते शीघ्रं याहि त्वं निजमंदिरे ..
कृषिकरोयमायातो द्रव्यार्थं ताडने गतः .. 35 ..
text_mt: The king said: “Daughter, go quickly to your own palace; / this is a farmer who came for wealth and has undergone beating.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ balakhānirmahābalaḥ ..
chittvā tadbaṃdhanaṃ ghoraṃ khaḍgahastaḥ samāyayau .. 36 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो घोरं बलखानिर्महाबलः ..
छित्त्वा तद्बंधनं घोरं खड्गहस्तः समाययौ .. 36 ..
text_mt: Hearing these dreadful words, the mighty Balakhāni / cut through those terrible bonds and advanced, sword in hand.

sanskrit_iast:
śūrānpaṃcaśataṃ taṃ ca ruddhvā śastraiḥ samaṃtataḥ ..
prajaghnatastu tānsarvānbalakhānirvyanāśayat .. 37 ..
meaning:
शूरान्पंचशतं तं च रुद्ध्वा शस्त्रैः समंततः ..
प्रजघ्नतस्तु तान्सर्वान्बलखानिर्व्यनाशयत् .. 37 ..
text_mt: Five hundred warriors surrounded him on all sides with weapons; / but as they attacked him, Balakhāni destroyed them all.

sanskrit_iast:
gajasena suto jyeṣṭhaḥ sūryadyutirupāgataḥ ..
baddhvā punastaṃ balinaṃ gartamadhye samākṣipat .. 38 ..
meaning:
गजसेन सुतो ज्येष्ठः सूर्यद्युतिरुपागतः ..
बद्ध्वा पुनस्तं बलिनं गर्तमध्ये समाक्षिपत् .. 38 ..
text_mt: The eldest son of Gajasena, Sūryadyuti, approached; / having bound the strong one again, he threw him into a pit.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā gataṃ patiṃ dṛṣṭvā gajamuktā suduḥkhitā ..
niśi tatra gatā devī dattvā dravyaṃ tu rakṣakān .. 39..
meaning:
तथा गतं पतिं दृष्ट्वा गजमुक्ता सुदुःखिता ..
निशि तत्र गता देवी दत्त्वा द्रव्यं तु रक्षकान् .. 39..
text_mt: Seeing her husband in such a state, Gajamuktā was deeply grieved; / at night, the lady went there, having bribed the guards with wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
patiṃ niṣkāsya rudatī vyajanaṃ pataye dadau ..
rātraurātrau tathā prāptā vyatītaṃ pakṣamātrakam .. 3.3.16.40 ..
meaning:
पतिं निष्कास्य रुदती व्यजनं पतये ददौ ..
रात्रौरात्रौ तथा प्राप्ता व्यतीतं पक्षमात्रकम् .. 3.3.16.40 ..
text_mt: Taking her husband out and weeping, she fanned her husband. / Reaching there night after night, a mere fortnight passed by.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare vīraścāhlādaḥ saptalakṣakaiḥ ..
sainyaiḥ sahāyayau śīghraṃ śrutvā tatraiva kāraṇam .. 41 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे वीरश्चाह्लादः सप्तलक्षकैः ..
सैन्यैः सहाययौ शीघ्रं श्रुत्वा तत्रैव कारणम् .. 41 ..
text_mt: Meanwhile, the hero Āhlāda, with seven hundred thousand / soldiers, arrived swiftly as soon as he heard of the cause.

sanskrit_iast:
balakhānirgato garte rurodha nagarīṃ tadā ..
gajaiḥ ṣoḍaśasāhasrairgajaseno raṇaṃ yayau .. 42 ..
meaning:
बलखानिर्गतो गर्ते रुरोध नगरीं तदा ..
गजैः षोडशसाहस्रैर्गजसेनो रणं ययौ .. 42 ..
text_mt: Balakhāni emerged from the pit and then besieged the city. / With sixteen thousand elephants, Gajasena marched to battle.

sanskrit_iast:
trilakṣaiśca hayaiḥ sārddhaṃ sūryadyutirupāyayau ..
kāṃtāmalastadā prāptastrilakṣaiśca padātibhiḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
त्रिलक्षैश्च हयैः सार्द्धं सूर्यद्युतिरुपाययौ ..
कांतामलस्तदा प्राप्तस्त्रिलक्षैश्च पदातिभिः .. 43 ..
text_mt: And with three hundred thousand horses, Sūryadyuti approached; / Kāntāmala then arrived with three hundred thousand foot soldiers.

sanskrit_iast:
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhamahorātraṃ hi sainyayoḥ ..
rakṣite tālanādye ca gajasenādyake tadā .. 44 ..
meaning:
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धमहोरात्रं हि सैन्ययोः ..
रक्षिते तालनाद्ये च गजसेनाद्यके तदा .. 44 ..
text_mt: And a great battle took place between the two armies for a day and night, / while the forces led by Tālana and Gajasena were held in check.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye'hni samāyāte gajaseno mahābalaḥ ..
prabhagnaṃ svabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā pāvakī'yaṃ samāruhat ..
dāhayāmāsa tatsainyaṃ tālanādyaiśca pālitam .. 45 ..
meaning:
द्वितीयेऽह्नि समायाते गजसेनो महाबलः ..
प्रभग्नं स्वबलं दृष्ट्वा पावकीऽयं समारुहत् ..
दाहयामास तत्सैन्यं तालनाद्यैश्च पालितम् .. 45 ..
text_mt: When the second day arrived, the mighty Gajasena, / seeing his own army shattered, mounted a fiery chariot [and] / burned that army led and protected by Tālana and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmībhūtaṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā tālanaḥ śatrusammukhe ..
gatvā bhallena bhūpālaṃ tāḍayāmāsa vegataḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
भस्मीभूतं बलं दृष्ट्वा तालनः शत्रुसम्मुखे ..
गत्वा भल्लेन भूपालं ताडयामास वेगतः .. 46 ..
text_mt: Seeing his army turned to ashes, Tālana, advancing before the enemy, / quickly struck the king with a spear.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrchitaṃ nṛpamājñāya sūryadyutirupāyayau ..
pāvakīyaṃ samāruhya dāhayāmāsa tālanam .. 47 ..
meaning:
मूर्छितं नृपमाज्ञाय सूर्यद्युतिरुपाययौ ..
पावकीयं समारुह्य दाहयामास तालनम् .. 47 ..
text_mt: Knowing the king had fainted, Sūryadyuti approached, / [and] mounting a fiery chariot, burned Tālana.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare śūrau devau cāhlādakṛṣṇakau ..
babandhatū ruṣāviṣṭau sūryadyutimariṃdamam .. 48 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे शूरौ देवौ चाह्लादकृष्णकौ ..
बबन्धतू रुषाविष्टौ सूर्यद्युतिमरिंदमम् .. 48 ..
text_mt: Meanwhile, the two heroic lords, Āhlāda and Kṛṣṇaka, / seized with fury, bound Sūryadyuti, the subduer of foes.

sanskrit_iast:
subaddhaṃ bhrātaraṃ jñātvā hayaṃ kāṃtāmalo'ruhat ..
devasiṃhaṃ ca saṃmohya kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ prati so'gamat ..
gṛhītvā taṃ sa kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ tasya tejaḥ samāharat .. 49 ..
meaning:
सुबद्धं भ्रातरं ज्ञात्वा हयं कांतामलोऽरुहत् ..
देवसिंहं च संमोह्य कृष्णांशं प्रति सोऽगमत् ..
गृहीत्वा तं स कृष्णांशं तस्य तेजः समाहरत् .. 49 ..
text_mt: Knowing his brother firmly bound, Kāntāmala mounted a horse, / and bewitching Devasiṃha, went against Kṛṣṇāṃśa; / seizing Kṛṣṇāṃśa, he took away his splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
saptalakṣabalaṃ sarvaṃ vahnibhūtamabhūttadā ..
amaratvātsa āhlādastadā tu samajīvayat .. 3.3.16.50 ..
meaning:
सप्तलक्षबलं सर्वं वह्निभूतमभूत्तदा ..
अमरत्वात्स आह्लादस्तदा तु समजीवयत् .. 3.3.16.50 ..
text_mt: Then the entire army of seven hundred thousand turned to fire; / but because of his immortality, Āhlāda brought it back to life.

sanskrit_iast:
gajasenasyārddhasainyaṃ taiśca sarvairvināśitam ..
vijayaṃ nṛpatiḥ prāpya harṣito gehamāyayau . 51 ..
meaning:
गजसेनस्यार्द्धसैन्यं तैश्च सर्वैर्विनाशितम् ..
विजयं नृपतिः प्राप्य हर्षितो गेहमाययौ . 51 ..
text_mt: Half of Gajasena's army was destroyed by all of them; / having gained victory, the king returned home delighted.

sanskrit_iast:
vahnibhūtaṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ dṛṣṭvāhlādaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ ..
durgāṃ devīṃ sa tuṣṭāva manasā raṇamūrddhani .. 52 ..
meaning:
वह्निभूतं च कृष्णांशं दृष्ट्वाह्लादः सुदुःखितः ..
दुर्गां देवीं स तुष्टाव मनसा रणमूर्द्धनि .. 52 ..
text_mt: And seeing Kṛṣṇāṃśa turned to fire, Āhlāda, overwhelmed with sorrow, / praised the goddess Durgā in his mind on the battlefield.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā devī vacaḥ prāha vatsa te putra eva ca ..
svargādāgatya sarvāṇi punarujjīvayiṣyati .. 53 ..
meaning:
तदा देवी वचः प्राह वत्स ते पुत्र एव च ..
स्वर्गादागत्य सर्वाणि पुनरुज्जीवयिष्यति .. 53 ..
text_mt: Then the goddess spoke these words: 'Child, your son indeed, / coming from heaven, will bring all back to life.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityukte vacane devyā indulo vāsavājñayā ..
dvādaśābdasamaṃ rūpaṃ dhṛtvā vidyāviśāradaḥ ..
vaḍavāmṛtamāruhya hayaṃ tatra samāgataḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्ते वचने देव्या इन्दुलो वासवाज्ञया ..
द्वादशाब्दसमं रूपं धृत्वा विद्याविशारदः ..
वडवामृतमारुह्य हयं तत्र समागतः .. 54 ..
text_mt: When these words were spoken by the goddess, Indula, by command of Indra, / taking the form of a twelve-year-old, skilled in knowledge, / arrived there, mounted upon the horse Vaḍavāmṛta.

sanskrit_iast:
tadaṅgāduddhṛtā vāhā meghā iva samantataḥ ..
pāvakaṃ śamayāmāsustrayaste devatopamāḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
तदङ्गादुद्धृता वाहा मेघा इव समन्ततः ..
पावकं शमयामासुस्त्रयस्ते देवतोपमाः .. 55 ..
text_mt: Horses brought forth from his body, like clouds on every side, / extinguished the fire, as did those three who were like gods.

sanskrit_iast:
śamībhūte tadā vahnau svamukhātsahayo mudā ..
lālāmudvāhayāmāsa tayā te jīvitāstataḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
शमीभूते तदा वह्नौ स्वमुखात्सहयो मुदा ..
लालामुद्वाहयामास तया ते जीवितास्ततः .. 56 ..
text_mt: When the fire had subsided, the horse gladly discharged saliva / from its mouth; through that they were brought to life.

sanskrit_iast:
jīvite saptalakṣe tu śamībhūte hi pāvake ..
gajasenaḥ sutābhyāṃ ca prayātaḥ sarvatodiśam .. 57 ..
meaning:
जीविते सप्तलक्षे तु शमीभूते हि पावके ..
गजसेनः सुताभ्यां च प्रयातः सर्वतोदिशम् .. 57 ..
text_mt: When the seven hundred thousand were revived and the fire was extinguished, / Gajasena along with his two sons fled in all directions.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṃ sainyaṃ tu ye śiṣṭāste sarve'pi bhayāturāḥ ..
dudruvurbhārgavaśreṣṭha divyarūpatvadhāriṇaḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
लक्षं सैन्यं तु ये शिष्टास्ते सर्वेऽपि भयातुराः ..
दुद्रुवुर्भार्गवश्रेष्ठ दिव्यरूपत्वधारिणः .. 58 ..
text_mt: The hundred thousand soldiers who were left, all tormented by fear, / ran away, O best of Bhārgavas, taking divine forms.

sanskrit_iast:
kecitsaṃnyāsino bhūtvā kecidvai brahmacāriṇaḥ ..
jīvatvaṃ prāptavantaste tathānye saṃkṣayaṃ gatāḥ .. 59 ..
meaning:
केचित्संन्यासिनो भूत्वा केचिद्वै ब्रह्मचारिणः ..
जीवत्वं प्राप्तवन्तस्ते तथान्ये संक्षयं गताः .. 59 ..
text_mt: Some becoming ascetics, and some indeed brahmacārins, / they attained life, while others went to destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
baddhvā tāngajasenādīṃstrīñchūrānsa ca tālanaḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśena samāyukta iṃdradurgaṃ samāyayau .. 3.3.16.60 ..
meaning:
बद्ध्वा तान्गजसेनादींस्त्रीञ्छूरान्स च तालनः ..
कृष्णांशेन समायुक्त इंद्रदुर्गं समाययौ .. 3.3.16.60 ..
text_mt: Tālana, having bound those three heroes, Gajasena and the others, / accompanied by Kṛṣṇāṃśa, arrived at Indradurga.

sanskrit_iast:
balakhāniṃ ca niṣkāsya tālanastadanaṃtaram ..
pṛṣṭavān kāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ śrutvā tanmukhato vacaḥ ..
tānvīrāṃstāḍayāmāsa vetasaiḥ staṃbhabaṃdhanaiḥ .. 61 ..
meaning:
बलखानिं च निष्कास्य तालनस्तदनंतरम् ..
पृष्टवान् कारणं सर्वं श्रुत्वा तन्मुखतो वचः ..
तान्वीरांस्ताडयामास वेतसैः स्तंभबंधनैः .. 61 ..
text_mt: And having brought out Balakhāni, Tālana thereupon / asked about the entire matter; hearing the words from his mouth, / he beat those heroes with cane reeds while tied to posts.

sanskrit_iast:
gajamuktājñayā vipra senāpatarirudāradhīḥ ..
tālanastānsamutsṛjya vivāhārthaṃ samāyayau ..
balakhānirhayārūḍho gajamuktā ca maṃḍape .. 62 ..
meaning:
गजमुक्ताज्ञया विप्र सेनापतरिरुदारधीः ..
तालनस्तान्समुत्सृज्य विवाहार्थं समाययौ ..
बलखानिर्हयारूढो गजमुक्ता च मंडपे .. 62 ..
text_mt: At the command of Gajamuktā, O brāhmaṇa, the noble-minded general / Tālana released them and arrived for the wedding; / Balakhāni was mounted on a horse, and Gajamuktā was in the pavilion.

sanskrit_iast:
gajasenastadā divyairbhojanaistānabhojayat ..
nivāsya lohadurge tānkapāṭaḥ sudṛḍhīkṛtaḥ ..
lakṣaśūrānsa saṃsthāpya svayaṃ rudrapuraṃ yayau ..63..
meaning:
गजसेनस्तदा दिव्यैर्भोजनैस्तानभोजयत् ..
निवास्य लोहदुर्गे तान्कपाटः सुदृढीकृतः ..
लक्षशूरान्स संस्थाप्य स्वयं रुद्रपुरं ययौ ..63..
text_mt: Then Gajasena fed them with divine feasts; / having housed them in the iron fortress, the gate was made very secure; / stationing a hundred thousand heroes, he himself went to Rudrapura.

sanskrit_iast:
te rātrau lohadurgeṣu hyuṣitvā yatnato balāt ..
prabhāte ca kapāṭe na dvāraṃ dṛṣṭvā tadābravīt ..
dvāramudghāṭayāśu tvaṃ no cetprāṇāṃstyajiṣyasi .. 64 ..
meaning:
ते रात्रौ लोहदुर्गेषु ह्युषित्वा यत्नतो बलात् ..
प्रभाते च कपाटे न द्वारं दृष्ट्वा तदाब्रवीत् ..
द्वारमुद्घाटयाशु त्वं नो चेत्प्राणांस्त्यजिष्यसि .. 64 ..
text_mt: Having stayed the night in the iron fortress with effort and force, / seeing at dawn no doorway in the gate, [one of them] then said: / 'Open the door quickly, or else you will lose your lives!'

sanskrit_iast:
iti senāpatiḥ śrutvā lakṣaśūrānsamādiśat ..
nānāyatnaiśca haṃtavyāḥ śatravo bhayakāriṇaḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
इति सेनापतिः श्रुत्वा लक्षशूरान्समादिशत् ..
नानायत्नैश्च हंतव्याः शत्रवो भयकारिणः .. 65 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, the general commanded the hundred thousand heroes: / 'These terrifying enemies must be slain by various efforts.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu te śūrāḥ śataghnyastaiḥ suropitāḥ ..
ekaikaṃ kramaśo jaghnurvṛṃdaṃ te vairatatparāḥ .. 66 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु ते शूराः शतघ्न्यस्तैः सुरोपिताः ..
एकैकं क्रमशो जघ्नुर्वृंदं ते वैरतत्पराः .. 66 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, those heroes, having set up cannons, / intent on hostility, gradually slew troop after troop, one by one.

sanskrit_iast:
hate daśasahasre tu kṛṣṇāṃśo biṃdulaṃ hayam ..
samāruhya jaghānāśu svakhaḍgena mahadbalam .. 67 ..
meaning:
हते दशसहस्रे तु कृष्णांशो बिंदुलं हयम् ..
समारुह्य जघानाशु स्वखड्गेन महद्बलम् .. 67 ..
text_mt: When ten thousand were slain, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, having mounted / the horse Bindula, quickly slew the great army with his sword.

sanskrit_iast:
hataśeṣā bhayārtāśca sahayāśītisammitāḥ ..
iṃdradurgaṃ prati prāhuryathā jāto balakṣayaḥ .. 68 ..
meaning:
हतशेषा भयार्ताश्च सहयाशीतिसम्मिताः ..
इंद्रदुर्गं प्रति प्राहुर्यथा जातो बलक्षयः .. 68 ..
text_mt: The survivors, afflicted with fear, numbering about eighty on horses, / told [the king] toward Indradurga how the destruction of the army had happened.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā bhayāturo rājā svasutābhyāṃ samanvitaḥ ..
gajamuktāṃ puraskṛtya vahudravyasamanvitām ..
svapāpaṃ kṣālayāmāsa dattvā kanyāṃ vidhānataḥ .. 69 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा भयातुरो राजा स्वसुताभ्यां समन्वितः ..
गजमुक्तां पुरस्कृत्य वहुद्रव्यसमन्विताम् ..
स्वपापं क्षालयामास दत्त्वा कन्यां विधानतः .. 69 ..
text_mt: Hearing [this], the king, seized with fear, accompanied by his two sons, / placing Gajamuktā at the head, accompanied by much wealth, / washed away his sin by giving his daughter according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśoṣṭrāṇi svarṇāni gṛhītvāhlāda eva saḥ ..
yayau svagehaṃ sahitaḥ putrabhrātṛsamanvitaḥ .. 3.3.16.70 ..
meaning:
षोडशोष्ट्राणि स्वर्णानि गृहीत्वाह्लाद एव सः ..
ययौ स्वगेहं सहितः पुत्रभ्रातृसमन्वितः .. 3.3.16.70 ..
text_mt: Having taken sixteen camels [laden with] gold, Āhlāda indeed / went to his home, accompanied by his son and brother.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāpte gehamāhlāde devī svarṇavatī svayam ..
indulaṃ svāṃkamāropya lalāpa karuṇaṃ bahu .. 71 ..
meaning:
संप्राप्ते गेहमाह्लादे देवी स्वर्णवती स्वयम् ..
इन्दुलं स्वांकमारोप्य ललाप करुणं बहु .. 71 ..
text_mt: When Āhlāda reached home, Queen Svarṇavatī herself, / placing Indula on her lap, wept very piteously:

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtāhaṃ ca tvayā putra punarujjīvitā khalu ..
dhanyāhaṃ kṛtakṛtyāsmi jayanta tava darśanāt ..72..
meaning:
मृताहं च त्वया पुत्र पुनरुज्जीविता खलु ..
धन्याहं कृतकृत्यास्मि जयन्त तव दर्शनात् ..72..
text_mt: ‘Dead as I was, I have indeed been brought back to life by you, my son! / Blessed am I, my purpose accomplished, O Jayanta, by the sight of you!’

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvendulo vīro natvāha jananīṃ mudā..
anṛṇaṃ nādhigacchāmi tvatto mātaḥ kadācana..73..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वेन्दुलो वीरो नत्वाह जननीं मुदा..
अनृणं नाधिगच्छामि त्वत्तो मातः कदाचन..73..
text_mt: Hearing this, the heroic Indula, bowing, gladly said to his mother: / ‘I can never be free from debt to you, mother!’

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāpte gehamāhlāde rājā parimalaḥ sudhīḥ ..
vādyāni vādayāmāsa viprebhyaśca dadau dhanam.. 74..
meaning:
संप्राप्ते गेहमाह्लादे राजा परिमलः सुधीः ..
वाद्यानि वादयामास विप्रेभ्यश्च ददौ धनम्.. 74..
text_mt: When Āhlāda reached home, the wise King Parimala / caused musical instruments to be played and gave wealth to the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
kṛṣṇāṃśe'ṣṭādaśābde tu yathājātaṃ tathā śṛṇu ..
mṛte kṛṣṇakumāre tu bhūpatau ratnabhānunā .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
कृष्णांशेऽष्टादशाब्दे तु यथाजातं तथा शृणु ..
मृते कृष्णकुमारे तु भूपतौ रत्नभानुना .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Hear what happened in the eighteenth year of Kṛṣṇāṃśa: / when King Kṛṣṇakumāra had died by Ratnabhānu,
title: adhyāyaḥ 17

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājaḥ suduḥkhārto lakṣacaṃḍīmakārayat ..
homānte tu tadā devī vāguvāca nṛpaṃ prati .. 2 ..
meaning:
महीराजः सुदुःखार्तो लक्षचंडीमकारयत् ..
होमान्ते तु तदा देवी वागुवाच नृपं प्रति .. 2 ..
text_mt: Mahīrāja, overwhelmed with sorrow, had the Lakṣacaṇḍī performed; / and at the end of the oblation, a divine voice spoke to the king:

sanskrit_iast:
varṣevarṣe tu te sapta bhaviṣyaṃtyaṃgasambhavāḥ ..
kumārāḥ kauravāṃśāśca draupadyaṃśā sutā nṛpa .. 3 ..
meaning:
वर्षेवर्षे तु ते सप्त भविष्यंत्यंगसम्भवाः ..
कुमाराः कौरवांशाश्च द्रौपद्यंशा सुता नृप .. 3 ..
text_mt: ‘Year after year, seven sons born from your body / shall be [born as] portions of the Kauravas, and a daughter as a portion of Draupadī, O king.’

sanskrit_iast:
ityukte vacane tasminrājñī garbhamatho dadhau ..
karṇāṃśaśca suto jātastārako balavattaraḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्ते वचने तस्मिन्राज्ञी गर्भमथो दधौ ..
कर्णांशश्च सुतो जातस्तारको बलवत्तरः .. 4 ..
text_mt: When these words were spoken, the queen then conceived; / and a son was born, a portion of Karṇa, named Tāraka, who was exceedingly strong.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyābde tathā jāte duśśāsanaśubhāṃśataḥ ..
nṛhaririti vikhyātastṛtīyābde tu cābhavat .. 5 ..
meaning:
द्वितीयाब्दे तथा जाते दुश्शासनशुभांशतः ..
नृहरिरिति विख्यातस्तृतीयाब्दे तु चाभवत् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Likewise, in the second year, from the auspicious portion of Duḥśāsana, / he was born who was renowned as Nṛhari; and in the third year there was [another son]:

sanskrit_iast:
uddharṣāṃśaḥ saradano durmukhāṃśastu mardanaḥ ..
vikarṇāṃśaḥ sūryyakarmā bhīmaścāṃśo viviṃśateḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
उद्धर्षांशः सरदनो दुर्मुखांशस्तु मर्दनः ..
विकर्णांशः सूर्य्यकर्मा भीमश्चांशो विविंशतेः .. 6 ..
text_mt: Saradana, a portion of Uddharṣa; Mardana, a portion of Durmukha; / Sūryakarmā, a portion of Vikarṇa; Bhīma, a portion of Viviṃśati;

sanskrit_iast:
varddhanaścitrabāṇāṃśo velā tadanu cābhavat ..
yathā kṛṣṇā tathā saiva rūpaceṣṭāguṇairmune .. 7 ..
meaning:
वर्द्धनश्चित्रबाणांशो वेला तदनु चाभवत् ..
यथा कृष्णा तथा सैव रूपचेष्टागुणैर्मुने .. 7 ..
text_mt: Vardhana, a portion of Citrabāṇa; and after that was born Velā. / Just as Draupadī was, so was she, in beauty, deeds, and virtues, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuvi tasyāṃ ca jātāyāṃ bhūkampo dāruṇo'bhavat ..
aṭṭāṭṭahāsamaśivaṃ cāmuṃḍā khe cakāra ha ..
raktavṛṣṭiḥ pure cāsīdasthiśarkarayā yutā .. 8 ..
meaning:
भुवि तस्यां च जातायां भूकम्पो दारुणोऽभवत् ..
अट्टाट्टहासमशिवं चामुंडा खे चकार ह ..
रक्तवृष्टिः पुरे चासीदस्थिशर्करया युता .. 8 ..
text_mt: And when she was born on earth, a terrible earthquake occurred; / Cāmuṇḍā uttered an inauspicious loud burst of laughter in the sky, / and a rain of blood accompanied by bone fragments fell upon the city.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāśca samāgatya jātakarmādikāṃ kriyām ..
kṛtvā nāma tathā cakre śṛṇu bhūmipa sākṣaram .. 9 ..9..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाश्च समागत्य जातकर्मादिकां क्रियाम् ..
कृत्वा नाम तथा चक्रे शृणु भूमिप साक्षरम् .. 9 ..9..
text_mt: And the brahmins arrived, performed the natal rites and others, / and gave her a name; listen to the syllables, O king:

sanskrit_iast:
ilā ca śaśino mātā vikalpenā'bhavadbhuvi ..
tasmādveleti vikhyātā kanyeyaṃ rūpaśālinī .. 3.3.17.10 ..
meaning:
इला च शशिनो माता विकल्पेनाऽभवद्भुवि ..
तस्माद्वेलेति विख्याता कन्येयं रूपशालिनी .. 3.3.17.10 ..
text_mt: “Ilā, the mother of the Moon, was [born] on earth by alternative course (vikalpena); / therefore this daughter, possessed of beauty, is renowned as Velā.”

sanskrit_iast:
jātāyāṃ ca sutāyāṃ sa pitā viprebhya uttamam ..
dadau dānaṃ mudā yukto vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca .. 11 ..
meaning:
जातायां च सुतायां स पिता विप्रेभ्य उत्तमम् ..
ददौ दानं मुदा युक्तो वासांसि विविधानि च .. 11 ..
text_mt: And when that daughter was born, her father, filled with joy, / gave excellent gifts and various garments to the brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśābdavayaḥ prāpte sā sutā varavarṇinī ..
uvāca pitaraṃ namrā śṛṇu tvaṃ pṛthivīpate .. 12 ..
meaning:
द्वादशाब्दवयः प्राप्ते सा सुता वरवर्णिनी ..
उवाच पितरं नम्रा शृणु त्वं पृथिवीपते .. 12 ..
text_mt: When she reached twelve years of age, that daughter of excellent complexion, / humble, spoke to her father: “Listen, O ruler of the earth!

sanskrit_iast:
maṃḍape raktadhārābhiryo māṃ saṃsnāpayiṣyati ..
draupadyā bhūṣaṇaṃ dātā sa me bhartā bhaviṣyati ..13..
meaning:
मंडपे रक्तधाराभिर्यो मां संस्नापयिष्यति ..
द्रौपद्या भूषणं दाता स मे भर्ता भविष्यति ..13..
text_mt: He who will bathe me in the pavilion with streams of blood / and who will give me the ornament of Draupadī shall be my husband.”

sanskrit_iast:
svarṇapatre tadā rājā padyaṃ velāmukhodbhavam ..
likhitvā tārakaṃ prāha tvamanveṣaya tatpatim .. 14 ..
meaning:
स्वर्णपत्रे तदा राजा पद्यं वेलामुखोद्भवम् ..
लिखित्वा तारकं प्राह त्वमन्वेषय तत्पतिम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Then the king inscribed on a golden leaf the verse uttered from the mouth of Velā / and said to Tāraka: “Search for her husband.”

sanskrit_iast:
sārddhaṃ lakṣatrayaṃ dravyaṃ gṛhītvā lakṣasainyakaḥ ..
nṛpāntaraṃ yayau śīghraṃ tārakaḥ piturājñayā .. 15..
meaning:
सार्द्धं लक्षत्रयं द्रव्यं गृहीत्वा लक्षसैन्यकः ..
नृपान्तरं ययौ शीघ्रं तारकः पितुराज्ञया .. 15..
text_mt: Taking three and a half lakhs of wealth, accompanied by an army of one lakh, / Tāraka swiftly went to other kings at his father's command.

sanskrit_iast:
siṃdhusthāne cāryadeśe bhūpaṃ bhūpaṃ yayau balī ..
na gṛhītaṃ nṛpaiḥ keścittadvākyaṃ ghoramulbaṇam ..
mahīpatiṃ sa saṃprāpya mātulaṃ tadvaco'bravīt .. 16 ..
meaning:
सिंधुस्थाने चार्यदेशे भूपं भूपं ययौ बली ..
न गृहीतं नृपैः केश्चित्तद्वाक्यं घोरमुल्बणम् ..
महीपतिं स संप्राप्य मातुलं तद्वचोऽब्रवीत् .. 16 ..
text_mt: The mighty one went from king to king in Sindh and in the Āryan lands; / but none of the kings accepted that terrible and fierce decree. / Reaching the monarch, his maternal uncle, he spoke those words.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā sa āha bho vīra brahmānando mahābalaḥ ..
sa ca vākyaṃ pragṛhṇīyādāhlādādyaiḥ surakṣitaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा स आह भो वीर ब्रह्मानन्दो महाबलः ..
स च वाक्यं प्रगृह्णीयादाह्लादाद्यैः सुरक्षितः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, he said: “O hero, the mighty Brahmānanda, / well-guarded by Āhlāda and others, may accept this decree.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ tvayā viditaṃ naiva caritaṃ tasya viśrutam ..
bhavānṣaḍbaṃdhusahitaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśādyairvivāhitaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
किं त्वया विदितं नैव चरितं तस्य विश्रुतम् ..
भवान्षड्बंधुसहितः कृष्णांशाद्यैर्विवाहितः .. 18 ..
text_mt: Is his renowned deed not known to you? / He, along with his six brothers, was given in marriage by Kṛṣṇāṃśa and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
te sarve vaśagāstasya brahmānaṃdasya dhīmataḥ ..
nāsti bhūmaṃḍale kaścittadbalena samo nṛpaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
ते सर्वे वशगास्तस्य ब्रह्मानंदस्य धीमतः ..
नास्ति भूमंडले कश्चित्तद्बलेन समो नृपः .. 19 ..
text_mt: They are all subject to that wise Brahmānanda; / there is no king on the circle of the earth equal to his power.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā yayau tūrṇaṃ tārakaḥ svabalaiḥ saha ..
tatpadyaṃ kathayitvāgre hastabaddhastadābhavat .. 3.3.17.20 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा ययौ तूर्णं तारकः स्वबलैः सह ..
तत्पद्यं कथयित्वाग्रे हस्तबद्धस्तदाभवत् .. 3.3.17.20 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, Tāraka quickly went with his own troops; / reciting that verse before him, he then stood with joined hands.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśastu gṛhītvāśu padyaṃ vākyamuvāca ha ..
ahaṃ vivāhayiṣyāmi brahmānaṃdaṃ nṛpottamam .. 21 ..
meaning:
कृष्णांशस्तु गृहीत्वाशु पद्यं वाक्यमुवाच ह ..
अहं विवाहयिष्यामि ब्रह्मानंदं नृपोत्तमम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: Kṛṣṇāṃśa, swiftly taking the verse, said these words: / “I shall wed the best of kings, Brahmānanda [to her].”

sanskrit_iast:
tūṣṇīṃ bhūtāstadā sarve tārakaḥ sa dvijaiḥ saha ..
abhiṣekaṃ tadā kṛtvā svagehaṃ punarāyayau .. 22 ..
meaning:
तूष्णीं भूतास्तदा सर्वे तारकः स द्विजैः सह ..
अभिषेकं तदा कृत्वा स्वगेहं पुनराययौ .. 22 ..
text_mt: Then, all falling silent, Tāraka along with the twice-born / performed the consecration and returned to his home.

sanskrit_iast:
māghamāse site pakṣe trayodaśyāṃ suvāsare ..
vivāhalagnaṃ śubhadaṃ varakanyārthayostadā .. 23 ..
meaning:
माघमासे सिते पक्षे त्रयोदश्यां सुवासरे ..
विवाहलग्नं शुभदं वरकन्यार्थयोस्तदा .. 23 ..
text_mt: In the month of Māgha, during the bright fortnight, on an auspicious thirteenth lunar day, / the auspicious time for marriage was set for the groom and the bride.

sanskrit_iast:
saptalakṣabalaiḥ sārddhaṃ lakṣaṇaśca satālanaḥ ..
mahāvatīṃ purīṃ prāpto balī parimalādibhiḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
सप्तलक्षबलैः सार्द्धं लक्षणश्च सतालनः ..
महावतीं पुरीं प्राप्तो बली परिमलादिभिः .. 24 ..
text_mt: Accompanied by an army of seven lakhs, Lakṣaṇa along with Tālana, / mighty with Parimala and the others, reached the city of Mahāvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
āhlādo lakṣasainyāḍhyaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśena samanvitaḥ ..
balakhānirlakṣasainyaḥ saṃyutaḥ sukhakhāninā .. 25 ..
meaning:
आह्लादो लक्षसैन्याढ्यः कृष्णांशेन समन्वितः ..
बलखानिर्लक्षसैन्यः संयुतः सुखखानिना .. 25 ..
text_mt: Āhlāda was equipped with an army of a lakh, accompanied by Kṛṣṇāṃśa; / Balakhāni had an army of a lakh, joined with Sukhakhāni;

sanskrit_iast:
netrasiṃho lakṣasainyo yogabhogasamanvitaḥ ..
raṇajicca balī bālo dvilakṣabalasaṃyutaḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
नेत्रसिंहो लक्षसैन्यो योगभोगसमन्वितः ..
रणजिच्च बली बालो द्विलक्षबलसंयुतः .. 26 ..
text_mt: Netrasiṃha had an army of a lakh, accompanied by Yoga and Bhoga; / and the mighty youth Raṇajit was accompanied by a force of two lakhs.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dvādaśalakṣāṇāṃ sainyānāmadhipo balī ..
tālanaḥ siṃhinīsaṃstho vaḍavāṃ prayayau saha .. 27 ..
meaning:
एवं द्वादशलक्षाणां सैन्यानामधिपो बली ..
तालनः सिंहिनीसंस्थो वडवां प्रययौ सह .. 27 ..
text_mt: Thus the mighty Tālana, commander of twelve lakhs of troops, / mounted upon a lioness, proceeded together towards Vaḍavā.

sanskrit_iast:
sainyairdvādaśalakṣaiśca sahitastālano balī ..
āyayau dehalīgrāme mahīrājānupālite .. 28 ..
meaning:
सैन्यैर्द्वादशलक्षैश्च सहितस्तालनो बली ..
आययौ देहलीग्रामे महीराजानुपालिते .. 28 ..
text_mt: Accompanied by the twelve lakhs of troops, the mighty Tālana / arrived at the village of Dehalī, protected by King Mahīrāja.

sanskrit_iast:
devo manorathārūḍho viṃdulasthaḥ sa kṛṣṇakaḥ ..
vaḍavāmṛtamāsādya svarṇavatyāḥ suto gataḥ .. .. 29 ..
meaning:
देवो मनोरथारूढो विंदुलस्थः स कृष्णकः ..
वडवामृतमासाद्य स्वर्णवत्याः सुतो गतः .. .. 29 ..
text_mt: Deva, mounted upon Manoratha, and Kṛṣṇaka, mounted upon Vindula, / having obtained nectar at Vaḍavā, went as the son of Svarṇavatī.

sanskrit_iast:
rūpaṇaśca karālastha āhlādaśca papīhake ..
balakhāniḥ kapotastho hariṇastho'nujastataḥ .. 3.3.17.30 ..
meaning:
रूपणश्च करालस्थ आह्लादश्च पपीहके ..
बलखानिः कपोतस्थो हरिणस्थोऽनुजस्ततः .. 3.3.17.30 ..
text_mt: Rūpaṇa was mounted on Karāla, Āhlāda on Papīhaka, / Balakhāni on Kapota, and next his younger brother mounted on a deer;

sanskrit_iast:
raṇajinmalanāputraḥ saṃsthito harināgare ..
pañcaśabdagajārūḍho mahāvatyadhipo gataḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
रणजिन्मलनापुत्रः संस्थितो हरिनागरे ..
पञ्चशब्दगजारूढो महावत्यधिपो गतः .. 31 ..
text_mt: Raṇajit, the son of Malanā, was mounted on Harināgara; / and the lord of Mahāvatī, mounted upon an elephant of five sounds, proceeded.

sanskrit_iast:
vimānavaramāruhya dhīvaraiḥ śatavāhikaiḥ ..
maṇimuktāsvarṇamayaṃ sahasrairvādyakairyutam .. 32 ..
meaning:
विमानवरमारुह्य धीवरैः शतवाहिकैः ..
मणिमुक्तास्वर्णमयं सहस्रैर्वाद्यकैर्युतम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: Mounting an excellent celestial chariot borne by a hundred fishermen, / fashioned of gems, pearls, and gold, accompanied by thousands of musical instruments,

sanskrit_iast:
ayutaiśca patākaiśca vetrapāṇisahakrakaiḥ ..
sahasraiḥ śibikābhiśca pañcasāhasrakai rathaiḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
अयुतैश्च पताकैश्च वेत्रपाणिसहक्रकैः ..
सहस्रैः शिबिकाभिश्च पञ्चसाहस्रकै रथैः .. 33 ..
text_mt: with tens of thousands of banners and thousands of cane-bearing guards, / with thousands of palanquins and five thousand chariots,

sanskrit_iast:
śakaṭairmahiṣoḍhaistu tathā pañcasahasrakaiḥ ..
sarvatopaskṛtaṃ ramyaṃ brahmānaṃdaṃ samāgataḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
शकटैर्महिषोढैस्तु तथा पञ्चसहस्रकैः ..
सर्वतोपस्कृतं रम्यं ब्रह्मानंदं समागतः .. 34 ..
text_mt: and likewise with five thousand carts drawn by buffaloes, / fully adorned on all sides, the delightful Brahmānanda arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā kolāhalaṃ teṣāṃ mahīrājo nṛpottamaḥ ..
vismitaḥ sa babhūvātra śibirāṇi mudā dadau .. 35 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा कोलाहलं तेषां महीराजो नृपोत्तमः ..
विस्मितः स बभूवात्र शिबिराणि मुदा ददौ .. 35 ..
text_mt: Hearing their tumult, Mahīrāja, the best of kings, / was filled with wonder and joyfully assigned camps there.

sanskrit_iast:
durgadvāri kriyāṃ ramyāṃ kṛtvā vidhividhānataḥ ..
draupadyā bhūṣaṇaṃ dehi velāyai sa tamabravīt .. 36 ..
meaning:
दुर्गद्वारि क्रियां रम्यां कृत्वा विधिविधानतः ..
द्रौपद्या भूषणं देहि वेलायै स तमब्रवीत् .. 36 ..
text_mt: Having performed the charming rites at the fort gate in accordance with the rules, / he said to him: “Give the ornament of Draupadī to Velā.”

sanskrit_iast:
indulastu yayau svargaṃ vāsavaṃ prati cābravīt ..
draupadyā bhūṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ dehi mahyaṃ surottama .. 37 ..
meaning:
इन्दुलस्तु ययौ स्वर्गं वासवं प्रति चाब्रवीत् ..
द्रौपद्या भूषणं सर्वं देहि मह्यं सुरोत्तम .. 37 ..
text_mt: Indula went to heaven and said to Indra: / “Give all the ornaments of Draupadī to me, O best of gods.”

sanskrit_iast:
kuberātsa samānīya divyamābhūṣaṇaṃ dadau ..
indulaḥ praharānte ca prāptaḥ pitre nyavedayat .. 38 ..
meaning:
कुबेरात्स समानीय दिव्यमाभूषणं ददौ ..
इन्दुलः प्रहरान्ते च प्राप्तः पित्रे न्यवेदयत् .. 38 ..
text_mt: Bringing them from Kubera, he gave the divine ornaments; / and Indula, having returned at the end of a watch, offered them to his father.

sanskrit_iast:
āhlādastu svayaṃ gatvā velāye bhūṣaṇaṃ dadau ..
prāpte brāhme muhūrte tu vivāhastatra cābhavat .. 39 ..
meaning:
आह्लादस्तु स्वयं गत्वा वेलाये भूषणं ददौ ..
प्राप्ते ब्राह्मे मुहूर्ते तु विवाहस्तत्र चाभवत् .. 39 ..
text_mt: Āhlāda himself went and gave the ornament to Velā; / and when the auspicious hour of Brahmā arrived, the wedding took place there.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāpte prathamāvarte tārakaḥ khaḍgamādadau ..
āhlādastaṃ samāsādya yuyudhe bahulīlayā .. 3.3.17.40 ..
meaning:
संप्राप्ते प्रथमावर्ते तारकः खड्गमाददौ ..
आह्लादस्तं समासाद्य युयुधे बहुलीलया .. 3.3.17.40 ..
text_mt: When the first circumambulation arrived, Tāraka took up his sword; / Āhlāda, confronting him, fought with abundant skill.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛharistu dvitīye ca kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ prati cārudhat ..
tathā saradanaṃ vīraṃ balakhānirupāyayau .. 41 ..
meaning:
नृहरिस्तु द्वितीये च कृष्णांशं प्रति चारुधत् ..
तथा सरदनं वीरं बलखानिरुपाययौ .. 41 ..
text_mt: At the second, Nṛhari blocked Kṛṣṇāṃśa; / likewise Balakhāni approached the heroic Saradana.

sanskrit_iast:
mardanaṃ sukhakhānistu caturthāvartake'rudhat ..
raṇajitsūryavarmāṇaṃ sa bhīmaṃ rūpaṇo balī ..
devastu vardhanaṃ vīraṃ saptāvarte kramādyayau .. 42 ..
meaning:
मर्दनं सुखखानिस्तु चतुर्थावर्तकेऽरुधत् ..
रणजित्सूर्यवर्माणं स भीमं रूपणो बली ..
देवस्तु वर्धनं वीरं सप्तावर्ते क्रमाद्ययौ .. 42 ..
text_mt: At the fourth circumambulation, Sukhakhāni checked Mardana; / Raṇajit [confronted] Sūryavarmā, the mighty Rūpaṇa [checked] Bhīma, / and Deva successively went against the heroic Vardhana at the seventh circumambulation.

sanskrit_iast:
śatabhūpānkhaḍgadharāngajasenādikāṃstadā ..
lakṣaṇādyāḥ samājagmurmaṃḍape bahuvistate .. 43 ..
meaning:
शतभूपान्खड्गधरान्गजसेनादिकांस्तदा ..
लक्षणाद्याः समाजग्मुर्मंडपे बहुविस्तते .. 43 ..
text_mt: Then Lakṣaṇa and the others came upon a hundred sword-bearing kings, / elephant forces, and the rest in the wide pavilion.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagnabhūtaṃ nṛpabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā ruṣānvitaḥ ..
mahīrājo yayau rūḍho gajaṃ cāribhayaṃkaram .. 44 ..
meaning:
भग्नभूतं नृपबलं दृष्ट्वा राजा रुषान्वितः ..
महीराजो ययौ रूढो गजं चारिभयंकरम् .. 44 ..
text_mt: Seeing his royal army broken, the king, overcome with fury— / Mahīrāja, mounted upon an elephant that terrified enemies—proceeded.

sanskrit_iast:
jitvā tānnetrasiṃhādīñchabdavedhī nṛpottamaḥ ..
lakṣaṇaṃ prayayau śīghraṃ bauddhinīṃ hastinīṃ sthitam .. 45 ..
meaning:
जित्वा तान्नेत्रसिंहादीञ्छब्दवेधी नृपोत्तमः ..
लक्षणं प्रययौ शीघ्रं बौद्धिनीं हस्तिनीं स्थितम् .. 45 ..
text_mt: Having defeated Netrasiṃha and the others, that best of kings, who shot by sound, / swiftly went towards Lakṣaṇa, who was mounted upon the elephant Bauddhinī.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaṃ manasi saṃsthāpya jitvā baddhvā ruṣānvitaḥ ..
agamattamupagṛhya darśayāmāsa taṃ nṛpam .. 46 ..
meaning:
शिवं मनसि संस्थाप्य जित्वा बद्ध्वा रुषान्वितः ..
अगमत्तमुपगृह्य दर्शयामास तं नृपम् .. 46 ..
text_mt: Fixing Śiva in his mind, having defeated and bound him in fury, / he seized him, took him away, and displayed that king.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā parimalo rājā kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ bhīruko yayau ..
vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa cāhrādādiparājayam.. 47 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा परिमलो राजा कृष्णांशं भीरुको ययौ ..
वृत्तान्तं कथयामास चाह्रादादिपराजयम्.. 47 ..
text_mt: Hearing of this, King Parimala, terrified, went to Kṛṣṇāṃśa / and narrated the account of the defeat of Āhlāda and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
ajitaḥ sa ca kṛṣṇāṃśo nabhomārgeṇa maṃdiram ..
gatvā jagarja balavānyoginyānaṃdadāyakaḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
अजितः स च कृष्णांशो नभोमार्गेण मंदिरम् ..
गत्वा जगर्ज बलवान्योगिन्यानंददायकः .. 48 ..
text_mt: And that invincible Kṛṣṇāṃśa, powerful and giving joy to the yoginīs, / went through the sky to the palace and roared.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā sa lakṣaṇo vīrastyaktvā baṃdhanamuttamam ..
viṣṇuṃ manasi saṃsthāpya mahīrājaṃ samāyayau .. 49 ..
meaning:
तदा स लक्षणो वीरस्त्यक्त्वा बंधनमुत्तमम् ..
विष्णुं मनसि संस्थाप्य महीराजं समाययौ .. 49 ..
text_mt: Then that hero Lakṣaṇa, leaving aside that excellent binding / and placing Viṣṇu in his mind, came to King Mahī.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhītvā cāgamāṃ dolāṃ svayaṃ śibiramāptavān .. 3.3.17.50 ..
text_mt: And taking the inaccessible litter, he himself reached the camp.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare sarve tyaktvā mūrcchāṃ samaṃtataḥ ..
khaḍgayuddhena tāñjitvā baddhvā tānnigaḍairdṛḍhaiḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे सर्वे त्यक्त्वा मूर्च्छां समंततः ..
खड्गयुद्धेन ताञ्जित्वा बद्ध्वा तान्निगडैर्दृढैः .. 51 ..
text_mt: In the meantime, they all completely cast off their swoon; / having conquered them in a duel with swords and bound them with strong iron chains,

sanskrit_iast:
sānvayāñchatabhūpāṃśca hatvā tadrudhirāvahaiḥ ..
draupadīṃ snāpayāmāsurvelārūpāṃ kalottamām .. 52 ..
meaning:
सान्वयाञ्छतभूपांश्च हत्वा तद्रुधिरावहैः ..
द्रौपदीं स्नापयामासुर्वेलारूपां कलोत्तमाम् .. 52 ..
text_mt: and having slain one hundred kings along with their lineages, with the streams of their blood / they bathed Draupadī, who was in the form of Velā, that supreme portion [of divinity].

sanskrit_iast:
vivāhānte ca te sarve śibirāṇi samāyayuḥ ..
samutsṛjya sutānsapta subhojyaiste hyabhojayan .. 53 ..
meaning:
विवाहान्ते च ते सर्वे शिबिराणि समाययुः ..
समुत्सृज्य सुतान्सप्त सुभोज्यैस्ते ह्यभोजयन् .. 53 ..
text_mt: And at the end of the wedding, they all returned to their camps; / releasing the seven sons, they fed them with sumptuous food.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktavatsu suvīreṣu sāhasrāstaiḥ sutaiḥ saha ..
rurudhuḥ sarvato jaghnurastraśastraiḥ samaṃtataḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
भुक्तवत्सु सुवीरेषु साहस्रास्तैः सुतैः सह ..
रुरुधुः सर्वतो जघ्नुरस्त्रशस्त्रैः समंततः .. 54 ..
text_mt: When those fine heroes had eaten, [the enemies] together with those sons in their thousands / besieged them on every side and struck all around with missile weapons and hand-weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraśūrāṃstānhatvā punarbaddhvā mahābalān ..
śibirāṇi samājagmusteṣāṃ hāsyaviśāradāḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
सहस्रशूरांस्तान्हत्वा पुनर्बद्ध्वा महाबलान् ..
शिबिराणि समाजग्मुस्तेषां हास्यविशारदाः .. 55 ..
text_mt: Having slain those thousand warriors and bound those mighty ones once again, / skilled in mocking them, they returned to their camps.

sanskrit_iast:
daśalakṣasuvarṇāni gṛhītvā nṛpatirbalī ..
velāṃ navoḍhāmādāya gatvā natvā tamabravīt .. 56 ..
meaning:
दशलक्षसुवर्णानि गृहीत्वा नृपतिर्बली ..
वेलां नवोढामादाय गत्वा नत्वा तमब्रवीत् .. 56 ..
text_mt: Taking ten hundred thousand gold coins, the strong king, / taking the newlywed Velā, went, bowed, and said to him:

sanskrit_iast:
pradyotasuta he rājam̐llakṣaṇo'sau mahābalaḥ ..
mama patnīṃ samādāya dāsīṃ kartuṃ samicchati .. 57 ..
meaning:
प्रद्योतसुत हे राजम्̐ल्लक्षणोऽसौ महाबलः ..
मम पत्नीं समादाय दासीं कर्तुं समिच्छति .. 57 ..
text_mt: “O King, son of Pradyota! That mighty Lakṣaṇa, / taking my wife, wishes to make her a slave-girl.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā parimalaḥ sarva bhūpasamanvitaḥ ..
bahudhā bodhitaścaiva na bubodha tadā nṛpaḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा परिमलः सर्व भूपसमन्वितः ..
बहुधा बोधितश्चैव न बुबोध तदा नृपः .. 58 ..
text_mt: Having heard this, Parimala, accompanied by all the kings, / although instructed in many ways, did not listen then, O King.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā mahāsatī velā vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ muhuḥ ..
tacchutvā sa ca kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ sahito balakhāninā ..
tāmāśvāsya tadā velāṃ nabhomārgeṇa cāyayau ..59..
meaning:
तदा महासती वेला विललाप भृशं मुहुः ..
तच्छुत्वा स च कृष्णांशः सहितो बलखानिना ..
तामाश्वास्य तदा वेलां नभोमार्गेण चाययौ ..59..
text_mt: Then the great, faithful wife Velā lamented bitterly again and again. / Hearing that, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, accompanied by Balakhānin, / having consoled Velā then, came through the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇaṃ tarjayitvāsau gṛhītvā cāgamanmudā..
nabhomārgeṇa gehe taṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ samapeṣayat .. 3.3.17.60 ..
meaning:
लक्षणं तर्जयित्वासौ गृहीत्वा चागमन्मुदा..
नभोमार्गेण गेहे तं कृष्णांशः समपेषयत् .. 3.3.17.60 ..
text_mt: Having threatened Lakṣaṇa and seized him, they came with joy; / Kṛṣṇāṃśa sent him to his home through the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
punastyaktvā sapta sutānsahitānnṛpatestu te ..
śapathaṃ kārayāmāsurdaṃbhaṃ prati mahābalāḥ ..
uṣitvā daśarātrāṃte dadhyurgaṃtumano mune ..61..
meaning:
पुनस्त्यक्त्वा सप्त सुतान्सहितान्नृपतेस्तु ते ..
शपथं कारयामासुर्दंभं प्रति महाबलाः ..
उषित्वा दशरात्रांते दध्युर्गंतुमनो मुने ..61..
text_mt: Releasing the seven sons once again along with the king, / those mighty ones made them swear an oath against deceit; / having stayed for ten nights, they set their minds on departing, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājastu balavāngṛhītvā bhūpateḥ padau ..
sa uvācāśrupūrṇākṣastadā parimalaṃ nṛpam .. 62 ..
meaning:
महीराजस्तु बलवान्गृहीत्वा भूपतेः पदौ ..
स उवाचाश्रुपूर्णाक्षस्तदा परिमलं नृपम् .. 62 ..
text_mt: Then mighty King Mahī, grasping the feet of the monarch, / with eyes filled with tears, said to King Parimala:

sanskrit_iast:
mahārāja vadhūste ca veleyaṃ dvādaśābdikā ..
pitṛmātṛviyogaṃ ca na kṣamaṃtī tu bālikā .. 63 ..
meaning:
महाराज वधूस्ते च वेलेयं द्वादशाब्दिका ..
पितृमातृवियोगं च न क्षमंती तु बालिका .. 63 ..
text_mt: “O Great King, this Velā, your daughter-in-law, is twelve years old; / being a young girl, she cannot bear separation from her mother and father.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttāṃ tvaṃ parityajya gaccha gehaṃ sukhī bhava ..
patiyogyā yadā bhūyāttadā tvāṃ punareṣyati..64..
meaning:
तस्मात्तां त्वं परित्यज्य गच्छ गेहं सुखी भव ..
पतियोग्या यदा भूयात्तदा त्वां पुनरेष्यति..64..
text_mt: Therefore, leave her, go home, and be happy. / When she becomes fit for a husband, she will come to you again.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā ca vaco rājā sa snehādaṃkamaspṛśat..
cūrṇībhūte parimale cāhlādastatra duḥkhitaḥ..
mahīrājaṃ sa pasparśa sa rājā cūrṇatāṃ gataḥ.. 65..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा च वचो राजा स स्नेहादंकमस्पृशत्..
चूर्णीभूते परिमले चाह्लादस्तत्र दुःखितः..
महीराजं स पस्पर्श स राजा चूर्णतां गतः.. 65..
text_mt: Having spoken these words, the king touched his lap out of affection. / When Parimala was crushed [in embrace], Cāhlāda, distressed there, / touched King Mahī, and that king became crushed.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagnāsthī bhūpatī cobhau pāvakīyaiścikitsakaiḥ..
sukhavaṃtau gṛhaṃ prāpya kṛtakṛtyatvamāgatau..66..
meaning:
भग्नास्थी भूपती चोभौ पावकीयैश्चिकित्सकैः..
सुखवंतौ गृहं प्राप्य कृतकृत्यत्वमागतौ..66..
text_mt: Both monarchs, with their bones broken, by means of fire-physicians / became comfortable, reached home, and attained fulfillment.

sanskrit_iast:
malanā svasutaṃ dṛṣṭvā prāptamudvāhitaṃ gṛhe ..
kṛtvotsavaṃ bahuvidhaṃ viprebhyaśca dadau dhanam ..
homaṃ vai kārayāmāsa caṃḍikāyāḥ prasādataḥ .. 67 ..
meaning:
मलना स्वसुतं दृष्ट्वा प्राप्तमुद्वाहितं गृहे ..
कृत्वोत्सवं बहुविधं विप्रेभ्यश्च ददौ धनम् ..
होमं वै कारयामास चंडिकायाः प्रसादतः .. 67 ..
text_mt: Malanā, seeing her son arrive home married, / held various festivities, gave wealth to the brahmins, / and caused a fire offering to be performed through the favor of Caṇḍikā.

sanskrit_iast:
sabhāyāṃ lakṣaṇo vīro yātrākāle tamabravīt ..
agamā jayacandrāya matvā jitvā hṛtāṃ tu tām ..
nabhomārgeṇa saṃprāptau yoginau ca śivājñayā..68..
meaning:
सभायां लक्षणो वीरो यात्राकाले तमब्रवीत् ..
अगमा जयचन्द्राय मत्वा जित्वा हृतां तु ताम् ..
नभोमार्गेण संप्राप्तौ योगिनौ च शिवाज्ञया..68..
text_mt: In the assembly, at the time of departure, the heroic Lakṣaṇa said to him: / “Thinking her inaccessible to Jayacandra, she was seized after conquering [him]; / but two yogins arrived through the sky by the command of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
jahatustau ca māṃ jitvā tattīkṣṇabhaya mohitam ..
adyāhaṃ dhāma gacchāmi ciraṃ jīva nṛpottama ..
ityuktavaṃtaṃ taṃ natvā yayurbhūpāḥ svamālayam .. 69 ..
meaning:
जहतुस्तौ च मां जित्वा तत्तीक्ष्णभय मोहितम् ..
अद्याहं धाम गच्छामि चिरं जीव नृपोत्तम ..
इत्युक्तवंतं तं नत्वा ययुर्भूपाः स्वमालयम् .. 69 ..
text_mt: Having conquered me, bewildered by intense terror, those two left me. / Today I go to my abode; live long, O best of kings!” / Having bowed to him who had spoken thus, the kings went to their own dwellings.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
viṃśābde caiva kṛṣṇāṃśe yathā jātaṃ tathā śṛṇu ..
sāgarākhyasarastīre kadācidiṃdulo balī ..
japtvā saptaśatīstotraṃ tatra dhyānānvito'bhavat ..1..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
विंशाब्दे चैव कृष्णांशे यथा जातं तथा शृणु ..
सागराख्यसरस्तीरे कदाचिदिंदुलो बली ..
जप्त्वा सप्तशतीस्तोत्रं तत्र ध्यानान्वितोऽभवत् ..1..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Hear what happened in the twentieth year of Kṛṣṇāṃśa: / Once, on the shore of the lake named Sāgara, mighty Indula, / having recited the Saptaśatī hymn, became absorbed in meditation there.
title: adhyāyaḥ 18

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare haṃsā ākāśādbhū mimāgatāḥ ..
teṣāṃ ca rutaśabdaiśca sa dhyānādutthito'bhavat .. 2 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे हंसा आकाशाद्भू मिमागताः ..
तेषां च रुतशब्दैश्च स ध्यानादुत्थितोऽभवत् .. 2 ..
text_mt: In the meantime, wild geese came down from the sky to the earth, / and at the sounds of their calls, he arose from meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
vakṣyamāṇaṃ vacaḥ prāhurdhanyo'yaṃ divyavigrahaḥ ..
parvatānāṃ himagirirvanaṃ vṛṃdāvanaṃ tathā .. 3 ..
meaning:
वक्ष्यमाणं वचः प्राहुर्धन्योऽयं दिव्यविग्रहः ..
पर्वतानां हिमगिरिर्वनं वृंदावनं तथा .. 3 ..
text_mt: They spoke the word about to be related: “Blessed is this divine form! / Among mountains the Himālaya, and among forests Vṛndāvana;

sanskrit_iast:
mahāvatī purīṇāṃ ca sāgaraḥ sarasāmapi ..
nārīṇāṃ padminī nārī nṛṇāṃ śreṣṭhastvamiṃdulaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
महावती पुरीणां च सागरः सरसामपि ..
नारीणां पद्मिनी नारी नृणां श्रेष्ठस्त्वमिंदुलः .. 4 ..
text_mt: and Mahāvatī among cities, and the ocean among lakes; / among women the padminī woman, and among men you, Indula, are the foremost.

sanskrit_iast:
bho indula mahāprājña mānase sarasi sthitāḥ ..
vayaṃ śrutvā śriyo vākyaṃ nalinī sāgaraṃ gatāḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
भो इन्दुल महाप्राज्ञ मानसे सरसि स्थिताः ..
वयं श्रुत्वा श्रियो वाक्यं नलिनी सागरं गताः .. 5 ..
text_mt: O wise Indula, residing in Lake Mānasa, / we, having heard the words of Śrī, went to the Nalinīsāgara.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tatra śubhāṃ nārīṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām ..
saptālibhiryutāṃ ramyāṃ gītanāṭya viśāradām .. 6 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तत्र शुभां नारीं सर्वाभरणभूषिताम् ..
सप्तालिभिर्युतां रम्यां गीतनाट्य विशारदाम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Seeing there an auspicious woman adorned with all ornaments, / accompanied by seven female companions, lovely, skilled in song and dance,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā mohatvamāpannā vayaṃ deśāntaraṃ gatāḥ ..
vilokitā narāḥ sarve'trāsmābhirjagatītale ..
tvatsamo na hi ko'pyatra padminī sadṛśo varaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा मोहत्वमापन्ना वयं देशान्तरं गताः ..
विलोकिता नराः सर्वेऽत्रास्माभिर्जगतीतले ..
त्वत्समो न हि कोऽप्यत्र पद्मिनी सदृशो वरः .. 7 ..
text_mt: falling into bewilderment upon seeing her, we went to other lands. / All men here upon the surface of the earth were observed by us; / indeed, there is no bridegroom here equal to you, matching the padminī.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttvaṃ naḥ samāruhya tāṃ devīṃ draṣṭumarhasi ..
tathetyuktvā śakrasuto haṃsarājaṃ samāruhat .. 8 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्त्वं नः समारुह्य तां देवीं द्रष्टुमर्हसि ..
तथेत्युक्त्वा शक्रसुतो हंसराजं समारुहत् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Therefore, mounting upon us, you ought to see that lady.” / Saying “So be it,” the son of Śakra mounted the king of wild geese.

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhaladvīpake ramye hyāryasiṃho nṛpaḥ sthitaḥ ..
tatsutā padminī nāmnā rūpayauvanaśālinī ..
rāgiṇyaḥ sapta vikhyātāstatsakhyaḥ pramadottamāḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
सिंहलद्वीपके रम्ये ह्यार्यसिंहो नृपः स्थितः ..
तत्सुता पद्मिनी नाम्ना रूपयौवनशालिनी ..
रागिण्यः सप्त विख्यातास्तत्सख्यः प्रमदोत्तमाः .. 9 ..
text_mt: In the lovely island of Siṃhala, King Āryasiṃha resides; / his daughter, named Padminī, is endowed with beauty and youth. / Seven well-known rāgiṇīs, the best of young women, are her female companions.

sanskrit_iast:
nalinīsāgare ramye girijāmaṃdiraṃ śubham ..
tatra sthitāṃ ca tāṃ devīmindulaḥ sa dadarśa ha .. 3.3.18.10 ..
meaning:
नलिनीसागरे रम्ये गिरिजामंदिरं शुभम् ..
तत्र स्थितां च तां देवीमिन्दुलः स ददर्श ह .. 3.3.18.10 ..
text_mt: At the lovely Nalinīsāgara, there is an auspicious temple of Girijā; / and Indula indeed saw that lady staying there.

sanskrit_iast:
sāpi taṃ sundaraṃ dṛṣṭvā haṃsadehe samāsthitam ..
saṃmohyāhūya taṃ devaṃ tena sārddhamarīramat ..11..
meaning:
सापि तं सुन्दरं दृष्ट्वा हंसदेहे समास्थितम् ..
संमोह्याहूय तं देवं तेन सार्द्धमरीरमत् ..11..
text_mt: Seeing that handsome one mounted upon the body of a wild goose, / she, being enraptured and having summoned that godlike man, took delight with him.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣamekaṃ yayau tatra nānālīlāsu mohitaḥ ..
naktaṃ divaṃ na bubudhe ramamāṇastayā saha .. 12..
meaning:
वर्षमेकं ययौ तत्र नानालीलासु मोहितः ..
नक्तं दिवं न बुबुधे रममाणस्तया सह .. 12..
text_mt: A year passed there while he was fascinated by various amorous sports; / sporting with her, he did not notice night or day.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktigarvatvamāpanne cāhlāde jagadaṃbikā ..
dṛṣṭvā cāntardadhe devī garvācaraṇakuṃṭhitā .. 13 ..
meaning:
भक्तिगर्वत्वमापन्ने चाह्लादे जगदंबिका ..
दृष्ट्वा चान्तर्दधे देवी गर्वाचरणकुंठिता .. 13 ..
text_mt: When Āhlāda fell into the pride of devotion, the Mother of the World, / seeing it, disappeared, the goddess offended by his arrogant conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya prāptaṃ mahadduḥkhamāhlādasya jayaiṣiṇaḥ ..
sa kaiścitpuruṣairvīraḥ kathito'bhūtsva maṃdire .. 14 ..
meaning:
तस्य प्राप्तं महद्दुःखमाह्लादस्य जयैषिणः ..
स कैश्चित्पुरुषैर्वीरः कथितोऽभूत्स्व मंदिरे .. 14 ..
text_mt: Great sorrow befell that Āhlāda, who was desirous of victory. / That hero was reported by certain men in his palace:

sanskrit_iast:
indulaṃ rūpasampannaṃ laṃkāpuranivāsinaḥ ..
rākṣasāstaṃ samāhṛtya svagehaṃ śīghramāyayuḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
इन्दुलं रूपसम्पन्नं लंकापुरनिवासिनः ..
राक्षसास्तं समाहृत्य स्वगेहं शीघ्रमाययुः .. 15 ..
text_mt: “Rākṣasas residing in the city of Laṅkā, / having seized Indula who is endowed with beauty, quickly went to their own abode.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ sakulo vilalāpa ha ..
hāhāśabdo mahāṃścāsītteṣāṃ tu rudatāṃ mune .. 16 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो घोरं सकुलो विललाप ह ..
हाहाशब्दो महांश्चासीत्तेषां तु रुदतां मुने .. 16 ..
text_mt: Having heard this terrible news, he lamented with his family; / and a great cry of distress arose among those who were weeping, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśo ruditaṃ prāhāhlādaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ śṛṇuṣva bhoḥ ..
jitvāhaṃ rākṣasānsarvāṃstālanādyaiḥ samanvitaḥ ..
iṃdulaṃ tvāṃ sameṣyāmi bhavāndhairyaparo bhavet ..17..
meaning:
कृष्णांशो रुदितं प्राहाह्लादं ज्येष्ठं शृणुष्व भोः ..
जित्वाहं राक्षसान्सर्वांस्तालनाद्यैः समन्वितः ..
इंदुलं त्वां समेष्यामि भवान्धैर्यपरो भवेत् ..17..
text_mt: Kṛṣṇāṃśa said to the weeping elder brother Āhlāda: “Listen, sir! / Having conquered all the rākṣasas together with Tālana and the others, / I shall bring Indula back to you; may you be resolute!”

sanskrit_iast:
balakhāniśca kṛṣṇāṃśo devasiṃhaśca tālanaḥ ..
saptalakṣabalaiḥ sārddhaṃ lakāṃ prati yayurmudā .. 18 ..
meaning:
बलखानिश्च कृष्णांशो देवसिंहश्च तालनः ..
सप्तलक्षबलैः सार्द्धं लकां प्रति ययुर्मुदा .. 18 ..
text_mt: And Balakhāni, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, Devasiṃha, and Tālana, / together with an army of seven hundred thousand, set out with joy towards Laṅkā.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaprāptāśca ye bhūpā grāmapā rāṣṭrapāstathā ..
yathāyogya baliṃ ramyaṃ prāpya tasmai nyavedayan ..19..
meaning:
मार्गप्राप्ताश्च ये भूपा ग्रामपा राष्ट्रपास्तथा ..
यथायोग्य बलिं रम्यं प्राप्य तस्मै न्यवेदयन् ..19..
text_mt: And whichever kings, village chiefs, and district governors were encountered on the way, / having brought suitable, pleasant tribute, presented it to him.

sanskrit_iast:
ye bhūpā madamattāśca jitvā tāṃstālano balī ..
baddhvā taiśca samāgacchatsetubaṃdhaṃ śivasthalam ..3.3.18.20..
meaning:
ये भूपा मदमत्ताश्च जित्वा तांस्तालनो बली ..
बद्ध्वा तैश्च समागच्छत्सेतुबंधं शिवस्थलम् ..3.3.18.20..
text_mt: And the mighty Tālana, having conquered those kings who were intoxicated with pride / and having bound them, arrived with them at Setubandha, the sacred place of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā ca rāmeśaṃ rāmeṇa sthāpitaṃ śivam ..
siṃhaladvīpamaganṣaṇmāsābhyaṃtare tadā ..21..
meaning:
पूजयित्वा च रामेशं रामेण स्थापितं शिवम् ..
सिंहलद्वीपमगन्षण्मासाभ्यंतरे तदा ..21..
text_mt: And having worshipped Rāmeśa, the Śiva established by Rāma, / they then went to the island of Siṃhala within six months.

sanskrit_iast:
nalinīsāgaraṃ prāpya tatra vāsamakārayan ..
patraṃ saṃpreṣayāmāsa balakhānirnṛpāya ca ..22..
meaning:
नलिनीसागरं प्राप्य तत्र वासमकारयन् ..
पत्रं संप्रेषयामास बलखानिर्नृपाय च ..22..
text_mt: Reaching the Nalinī Ocean, they encamped there, / and Balakhāni dispatched a letter to the king:

sanskrit_iast:
āryyasiṃha mahābhāga svapotāndehi tīrṇakān ..
bhavām̐śca svabalaiḥ sārddhaṃ laṃkāṃ prati vrajādhunā ..
no cettvāṃ sabalaṃ jitvā rāṣṭrabhaṃgaṃ karomyaham ..23..
meaning:
आर्य्यसिंह महाभाग स्वपोतान्देहि तीर्णकान् ..
भवाम्̐श्च स्वबलैः सार्द्धं लंकां प्रति व्रजाधुना ..
नो चेत्त्वां सबलं जित्वा राष्ट्रभंगं करोम्यहम् ..23..
text_mt: "O noble Āryasiṃha, give up your sea-crossing ships, / and now march towards Laṅkā along with your own forces; / otherwise, having conquered you together with your army, I will destroy your kingdom."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā patravaco bhūpatirbalavattaraḥ ..
rakṣitaḥ śakraputreṇa yuddhāya samupāyayau ..24..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा पत्रवचो भूपतिर्बलवत्तरः ..
रक्षितः शक्रपुत्रेण युद्धाय समुपाययौ ..24..
text_mt: Hearing these words of the letter, the exceedingly powerful king, / protected by the son of Śakra, came forth for battle.

sanskrit_iast:
indulaḥ staṃbhanaṃ maṃtraṃ saṃsthāpya śara uttame ..
staṃbhayāmāsa tatsainyaṃ tālanādyaiḥ surakṣitam .. ..25..
meaning:
इन्दुलः स्तंभनं मंत्रं संस्थाप्य शर उत्तमे ..
स्तंभयामास तत्सैन्यं तालनाद्यैः सुरक्षितम् .. ..25..
text_mt: Indula, having placed an immobilising mantra upon an excellent arrow, / immobilised that army well-protected by Tālana and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
divase sukhaśarmā ca trilakṣaiḥ svadalaiḥ saha ..
āryyasiṃhasya tanayo mahadyuddhamacīkarat .. 26 ..
meaning:
दिवसे सुखशर्मा च त्रिलक्षैः स्वदलैः सह ..
आर्य्यसिंहस्य तनयो महद्युद्धमचीकरत् .. 26 ..
text_mt: By day, Sukhaśarman, the son of Āryasiṃha, / waged a great battle with his own divisions of three hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
niśāmukhe ca saṃprāpte śakraputro mahābalaḥ.
śataputraiḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ sārddhaṃ yuddhāya cāyayau ..27..
meaning:
निशामुखे च संप्राप्ते शक्रपुत्रो महाबलः.
शतपुत्रैः क्षत्रियाणां सार्द्धं युद्धाय चाययौ ..27..
text_mt: And when nightfall arrived, the mighty son of Śakra / came forth to battle along with a hundred sons of kṣatriyas.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ hayā haridvarṇā yogiveṣadharā balāt ..
mahatīṃ te sahasraṃ ca ripoḥ senāṃ vyanāśayat ..
tatpaścādgehamāsādya tadā taiḥ sukhito'vasat .. 28 ..
meaning:
तेषां हया हरिद्वर्णा योगिवेषधरा बलात् ..
महतीं ते सहस्रं च रिपोः सेनां व्यनाशयत् ..
तत्पश्चाद्गेहमासाद्य तदा तैः सुखितोऽवसत् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Their green-coloured horses forcibly bearing the guises of yogins, / they destroyed a great army of thousands belonging to the enemy; / thereafter, having reached his house, he then dwelt happily with them.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ jātāśca ṣaṇmāsāstayoryuddhaṃ hi senayoḥ ..
krameṇa saṃkṣayaṃ prāptaṃ balakhānermahadbalam .. 29 ..
meaning:
एवं जाताश्च षण्मासास्तयोर्युद्धं हि सेनयोः ..
क्रमेण संक्षयं प्राप्तं बलखानेर्महद्बलम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: In this way six months passed in the battle of those two armies; / gradually, the great force of Balakhāni suffered destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
dṛṣṭvā sainyanipātaṃ ca balakhānirmahābalaḥ ..
saṃprāpya mānasīṃ pīḍāṃ yuddhārthaṃ vimukho'bhavat ..1..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
दृष्ट्वा सैन्यनिपातं च बलखानिर्महाबलः ..
संप्राप्य मानसीं पीडां युद्धार्थं विमुखोऽभवत् ..1..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Seeing the slaughter of his army, the mighty Balakhāni, / suffering mental distress, became averse to battle.
title: adhyāyaḥ 19

sanskrit_iast:
devasiṃhaṃ samāhūya trikālajñaṃ mahāmatim ..
taṃ maṃtraṃ maṃtrayāmāsa kāryasiddhiryathā bhavet ..
śrutvovāca mahāyogī devasiṃho mahābalaḥ ..2..
meaning:
देवसिंहं समाहूय त्रिकालज्ञं महामतिम् ..
तं मंत्रं मंत्रयामास कार्यसिद्धिर्यथा भवेत् ..
श्रुत्वोवाच महायोगी देवसिंहो महाबलः ..2..
text_mt: Having summoned the highly intelligent Devasiṃha, who knew the three times, / he held counsel with him so that success in his enterprise might come about. / Hearing him, the great yogin Devasiṃha, of great might, said:

sanskrit_iast:
maheṃdratanayaḥ kaścitsarvaśastrāstrakovidaḥ ..
tvatsainyaṃ rodhayitvā vai divyāstreṇa divāmukhe ..
rātrau svayaṃ samāgamya karoti balasaṃkṣayam ..3..
meaning:
महेंद्रतनयः कश्चित्सर्वशस्त्रास्त्रकोविदः ..
त्वत्सैन्यं रोधयित्वा वै दिव्यास्त्रेण दिवामुखे ..
रात्रौ स्वयं समागम्य करोति बलसंक्षयम् ..3..
text_mt: "A certain son of Mahendra, skilled in all weapons and divine missiles, / having checked your army with a divine missile at daybreak, / comes himself at night and causes the destruction of your forces.

sanskrit_iast:
atastvaṃ matsahāyena tālanena samanvitaḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśena samāgamya śakra putraṃ śubhānanam ..
vijayī bhava śīghraṃ hi no cedyāyāṃ yamakṣayam ..4..
meaning:
अतस्त्वं मत्सहायेन तालनेन समन्वितः ..
कृष्णांशेन समागम्य शक्र पुत्रं शुभाननम् ..
विजयी भव शीघ्रं हि नो चेद्यायां यमक्षयम् ..4..
text_mt: Therefore, with my assistance and accompanied by Tālana, / uniting with Kṛṣṇāṃśa, quickly become victorious / over the fair-faced son of Śakra; otherwise I shall go to the abode of Yama."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vacastasya devasiṃhasya bhāṣitam ..
yatnaṃ cakāra balavānbhrātṛmitrasamanvitaḥ ....
ekaviṃśābdakṛṣṇāṃśe saṃprāpte yuddhakovide ..
senāṃ niveśayāmāsa poteṣu hayavāhanaḥ ..6..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य देवसिंहस्य भाषितम् ..
यत्नं चकार बलवान्भ्रातृमित्रसमन्वितः ....
एकविंशाब्दकृष्णांशे संप्राप्ते युद्धकोविदे ..
सेनां निवेशयामास पोतेषु हयवाहनः ..6..
text_mt: Hearing these spoken words of Devasiṃha, / the mighty one made an effort together with his brother and friends. / When Kṛṣṇāṃśa, skilled in battle, reached his twenty-first year, / he, having horses as mounts, embarked his army onto ships.

sanskrit_iast:
arddhaṃ sainyaṃ ca tatraiva sthāpayitvā mahābalaḥ ..
arddhasainyena kṛṣṇāṃśo dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāgamat .. 7 ..
meaning:
अर्द्धं सैन्यं च तत्रैव स्थापयित्वा महाबलः ..
अर्द्धसैन्येन कृष्णांशो दक्षिणां दिशमागमत् .. 7 ..
text_mt: Having stationed half of the army right there, the mighty / Kṛṣṇāṃśa went toward the southern direction with half of the army.

sanskrit_iast:
hayārūḍhāśca te śūrāḥ sarve yuddhasamanvitāḥ ..
kapāṭaṃ dṛḍhamudghāṭya nagarāntamupāyayuḥ ..8..
meaning:
हयारूढाश्च ते शूराः सर्वे युद्धसमन्विताः ..
कपाटं दृढमुद्घाट्य नगरान्तमुपाययुः ..8..
text_mt: And those heroes mounted on horses, all prepared for battle, / having forced open the firm city-gate, reached the interior of the city.

sanskrit_iast:
hatvā te rakṣiṇaḥ sarvām̐lluṃṭhayitvā puraṃ śubham ..
ripordurgaṃ samāsādya cakruḥ śatrormahākṣayam .. 9 ..
meaning:
हत्वा ते रक्षिणः सर्वाम्̐ल्लुंठयित्वा पुरं शुभम् ..
रिपोर्दुर्गं समासाद्य चक्रुः शत्रोर्महाक्षयम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Having slain all the guards and plundered the fair city, / they reached the enemy's citadel and brought about the great destruction of the foe.

sanskrit_iast:
rājño'ntaḥ puramāgatya kṛṣṇāṃśo balavattaraḥ ..
dadarśa sundarīṃ bālāṃ padminīṃ padmalocanām ..
saptālibhirvṛtāṃ ramyāṃ gītanṛtyaviśāradām .. 3.3.19.10 ..
meaning:
राज्ञोऽन्तः पुरमागत्य कृष्णांशो बलवत्तरः ..
ददर्श सुन्दरीं बालां पद्मिनीं पद्मलोचनाम् ..
सप्तालिभिर्वृतां रम्यां गीतनृत्यविशारदाम् .. 3.3.19.10 ..
text_mt: Entering the king's inner apartments, the exceedingly powerful Kṛṣṇāṃśa / beheld a beautiful young maiden, a lotus-eyed padminī, / surrounded by seven female companions, lovely and skilled in singing and dancing.

sanskrit_iast:
balāddolāṃ samāropya luṃṭhayitvā riporgṛham..
jagāma śivire tasminyatra jāto mahāraṇaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
बलाद्दोलां समारोप्य लुंठयित्वा रिपोर्गृहम्..
जगाम शिविरे तस्मिन्यत्र जातो महारणः .. 11 ..
text_mt: Having forcibly placed her into a palanquin and plundered the enemy's palace, / he went to that camp where the great battle was taking place.

sanskrit_iast:
balakhānistu balavāndevatālanasaṃyutaḥ ..
jaghāna śātravīṃ senāmindulāstreṇa pālitām .. 12 ..
meaning:
बलखानिस्तु बलवान्देवतालनसंयुतः ..
जघान शात्रवीं सेनामिन्दुलास्त्रेण पालिताम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Meanwhile, the mighty Balakhāni, accompanied by Deva[siṃha] and Tālana, / struck down the enemy army protected by Indula's missile.

sanskrit_iast:
sukhavarmāṇamāgatya senādhyakṣaṃ ripoḥ sutam ..
sarvatastaṃ svakīyāstrairjaghnuste madavihvalāḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
सुखवर्माणमागत्य सेनाध्यक्षं रिपोः सुतम् ..
सर्वतस्तं स्वकीयास्त्रैर्जघ्नुस्ते मदविह्वलाः .. 13 ..
text_mt: Approaching Sukhavarman, the enemy's son who was commander of the army, / they, frantic with fury, struck him from all sides with their own weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
hate tasminmahāvīrye jayantaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ ..
senāmujjīvayāṃcakre śakraputraḥ pratāpavān .. 14 ..
meaning:
हते तस्मिन्महावीर्ये जयन्तः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः ..
सेनामुज्जीवयांचक्रे शक्रपुत्रः प्रतापवान् .. 14 ..
text_mt: When that hero of great valour was slain, the glorious Jayanta, / the son of Śakra, overcome with rage, revived the army.

sanskrit_iast:
śyālaṃ ca sukhavarmāṇaṃ saṃjīvya svagṛhaṃ yayau ..
tatra dṛṣṭvā janānsarvānbahurodanatatparān .. 15 ..
meaning:
श्यालं च सुखवर्माणं संजीव्य स्वगृहं ययौ ..
तत्र दृष्ट्वा जनान्सर्वान्बहुरोदनतत्परान् .. 15 ..
text_mt: And having revived his brother-in-law Sukhavarman, he went to his own house; / there he saw all the people engaged in much weeping.

sanskrit_iast:
vismitaḥ sa yayau gehaṃ yathā pūrvaṃ tathāvidhaḥ ..
na dadarśa priyāṃ tatra sakhībhiḥ sahitāṃ mune .. 16 ..
meaning:
विस्मितः स ययौ गेहं यथा पूर्वं तथाविधः ..
न ददर्श प्रियां तत्र सखीभिः सहितां मुने .. 16 ..
text_mt: Astonished, he entered the house just as it was before; / he did not see his beloved there accompanied by her friends, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
āryyasiṃhagṛhaṃ gatvā pṛṣṭavānsarvakāraṇam ..
jñātvā saṃluṭhitaṃ gehaṃ śatrubhiḥ śastrakovidaiḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
आर्य्यसिंहगृहं गत्वा पृष्टवान्सर्वकारणम् ..
ज्ञात्वा संलुठितं गेहं शत्रुभिः शस्त्रकोविदैः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Going to Āryasiṃha's house, he asked the cause of it all; / he learned that the house had been plundered by the enemies skilled in weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
ruroda subhṛśaṃ vīro hā priye madavihvale ..
darśayādya mukhaṃ ramyaṃ tvatpatistvāṃ samutsukaḥ ..18..
meaning:
रुरोद सुभृशं वीरो हा प्रिये मदविह्वले ..
दर्शयाद्य मुखं रम्यं त्वत्पतिस्त्वां समुत्सुकः ..18..
text_mt: The hero wept exceedingly: "Alas, my beloved, overcome with passion! / Show your lovely face today; your husband is longing for you!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ rodanaṃ kṛtvā vaḍavopari saṃsthitaḥ ..
dhanustūṇīramādāya khaḍgaṃ śatruvimohanam ..
ekākī sa yayau kruddho niśi yatra sthito ripuḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
इत्येवं रोदनं कृत्वा वडवोपरि संस्थितः ..
धनुस्तूणीरमादाय खड्गं शत्रुविमोहनम् ..
एकाकी स ययौ क्रुद्धो निशि यत्र स्थितो रिपुः .. 19 ..
text_mt: Having wept in this manner, seated upon his mare, / taking his bow, quivers, and a sword that confounds the enemy, / he went alone, enraged, at night to where the enemy was stationed.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminsamaye vīro balakhānirmahābalaḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ sundarīṃ bālāṃ vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ muhuḥ .. 3.3.19.20 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्समये वीरो बलखानिर्महाबलः ..
दृष्ट्वा तां सुन्दरीं बालां विललाप भृशं मुहुः .. 3.3.19.20 ..
text_mt: At that very time, the hero, the mighty Balakhāni, / seeing that beautiful young girl, lamented greatly again and again:

sanskrit_iast:
hā indula mahāvīra hā madbaṃdho priyaṃkara ..
tvadyogyeyaṃ śubhā nārī rūpayauvanaśālinī..21..
meaning:
हा इन्दुल महावीर हा मद्बंधो प्रियंकर ..
त्वद्योग्येयं शुभा नारी रूपयौवनशालिनी..21..
text_mt: "Alas, Indula, great hero! Alas, my kinsman who does what is dear! / This auspicious woman, endowed with beauty and youth, is worthy of you!

sanskrit_iast:
darśanaṃ dehi me śīghraṃ gṛhāṇādya śubhānanām ..
ityuktvā mūrcchito bhūtvā mānase pūjayañchivām ..22.. .
meaning:
दर्शनं देहि मे शीघ्रं गृहाणाद्य शुभाननाम् ..
इत्युक्त्वा मूर्च्छितो भूत्वा मानसे पूजयञ्छिवाम् ..22.. .
text_mt: Grant me your presence quickly; take this fair-faced woman today!" / Having spoken thus, he fainted, worshipping Śivā in his mind.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminkāle ca saṃprāptaḥ śakraputro mahābalaḥ..
jaghāna śātravīṃ senāṃ kṛṣṇāṃśenaiva pālitām .. 23 ..
meaning:
तस्मिन्काले च संप्राप्तः शक्रपुत्रो महाबलः..
जघान शात्रवीं सेनां कृष्णांशेनैव पालिताम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: And at that time the mighty son of Śakra arrived / and struck down the enemy army protected by Kṛṣṇāṃśa.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā sainyanipātaṃ ca tālano vāhinīpatiḥ.. .
siṃhanādaṃ nanādoccaiḥ siṃhinyupari saṃsthitaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा सैन्यनिपातं च तालनो वाहिनीपतिः.. .
सिंहनादं ननादोच्चैः सिंहिन्युपरि संस्थितः .. 24 ..
text_mt: Seeing the destruction of the army, Tālana, the commander of the forces, / roared a lion's roar loudly, mounted upon a lioness:

sanskrit_iast:
na jayaḥ sainyanāśena tava vīra bhaviṣyati ..
māṃ hatvā jahi matsainyaṃ yoginbālasvarūpaka .. ...25..
meaning:
न जयः सैन्यनाशेन तव वीर भविष्यति ..
मां हत्वा जहि मत्सैन्यं योगिन्बालस्वरूपक .. ...25..
text_mt: "Victory will not be yours by the destruction of the army, O hero! / Slay me and then destroy my army, O yogin who have the form of a boy!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vacastasya śakraputro bhayaṃkaraḥ ..
jaghāna hṛdaye bāṇānsa tu khaḍgena cācchinat ..
svabhallena punarvīro daṃśayāmāsa vakṣasi ..26..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य शक्रपुत्रो भयंकरः ..
जघान हृदये बाणान्स तु खड्गेन चाच्छिनत् ..
स्वभल्लेन पुनर्वीरो दंशयामास वक्षसि ..26..
text_mt: Hearing these words of his, the terrible son of Śakra / struck arrows into his heart, but he cut them down with his sword; / then the hero pierced him in the chest with his own spear.

sanskrit_iast:
iṃdule mūrchite tasminvaḍavā divyarūpiṇī ..
ākāśopari saṃprāpya jayantaṃ samabodhayat ..27..
meaning:
इंदुले मूर्छिते तस्मिन्वडवा दिव्यरूपिणी ..
आकाशोपरि संप्राप्य जयन्तं समबोधयत् ..27..
text_mt: When that Indula fainted, the mare possessing a divine form, / ascending into the sky, revived Jayanta.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā sa bālastvaritaḥ kālāstraṃ cāpa ādadhe..
tena jāto mahāñchabdastālanaḥ sa mamāra ha .. 28 ..
meaning:
तदा स बालस्त्वरितः कालास्त्रं चाप आदधे..
तेन जातो महाञ्छब्दस्तालनः स ममार ह .. 28 ..
text_mt: Then that boy quickly fitted the weapon of Death to his bow; / by it a great sound arose, and Tālana died.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛte senāpatau tasminkṛṣṇāṃśo madavihvalaḥ ..
nabhomārgeṇa saṃprāpya jagarjja ca muhurmuhuḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
मृते सेनापतौ तस्मिन्कृष्णांशो मदविह्वलः ..
नभोमार्गेण संप्राप्य जगर्ज्ज च मुहुर्मुहुः .. 29 ..
text_mt: When that general died, the portion of Kṛṣṇa, overwhelmed with fury, / arrived by the path of the sky and roared again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
indulaḥ krodhatāmrākṣastvāgneyaṃ śaramādade ..
vahnibhūtaṃ nabhastatra svayogena mahābalaḥ ..
kṛtvā śīghraṃ yayau śatruṃ sa tu vāyavyamādadhe .. 3.3.19.30 ..
meaning:
इन्दुलः क्रोधताम्राक्षस्त्वाग्नेयं शरमाददे ..
वह्निभूतं नभस्तत्र स्वयोगेन महाबलः ..
कृत्वा शीघ्रं ययौ शत्रुं स तु वायव्यमादधे .. 3.3.19.30 ..
text_mt: Indula, his eyes red with anger, took up a fire-arrow; / having turned the sky into fire with his yoga, that very mighty one / swiftly approached his enemy, but he [the other] fitted the wind-weapon.

sanskrit_iast:
svayogenaiva kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ pītvā vāyavyamuttamam ..
punarjagāma tatpārśvaṃ kalaikaḥ sa hareḥ svayam ..31..
meaning:
स्वयोगेनैव कृष्णांशः पीत्वा वायव्यमुत्तमम् ..
पुनर्जगाम तत्पार्श्वं कलैकः स हरेः स्वयम् ..31..
text_mt: Drinking up the excellent wind-weapon by his yoga alone, / the portion of Kṛṣṇa, himself a single part of Hari, approached his side once more.

sanskrit_iast:
tathāvidhaṃ ripuṃ dṛṣṭvā śakraputro mahābalaḥ ..
gaṃdharvāstraṃ samādāya mohanāyopacakrame .. 32 ..
meaning:
तथाविधं रिपुं दृष्ट्वा शक्रपुत्रो महाबलः ..
गंधर्वास्त्रं समादाय मोहनायोपचक्रमे .. 32 ..
text_mt: Seeing the enemy in such a state, the very mighty son of Śakra / took up the gandharva-weapon and set out to bewilder him.

sanskrit_iast:
punaryogabalenaiva tadastraṃ saṃkṣayaṃ gatam ..
vāruṇaṃ śaramādāya tasyopari samākṣipat .. 33 ..
meaning:
पुनर्योगबलेनैव तदस्त्रं संक्षयं गतम् ..
वारुणं शरमादाय तस्योपरि समाक्षिपत् .. 33 ..
text_mt: By the power of his yoga alone, that weapon was completely destroyed; / taking up a water-arrow, he hurled it down upon him.

sanskrit_iast:
svayogenaiva kṛṣṇāṃśo jalaṃ sarvaṃ mukhe'karot ..
evaṃ sarvāṇi cāstrāṇi pītvā pītvā punaḥpunuḥ ..34..
meaning:
स्वयोगेनैव कृष्णांशो जलं सर्वं मुखेऽकरोत् ..
एवं सर्वाणि चास्त्राणि पीत्वा पीत्वा पुनःपुनुः ..34..
text_mt: By his yoga alone, the portion of Kṛṣṇa drew all the water into his mouth; / thus drinking up all the divine weapons again and again,

sanskrit_iast:
yayau śīghraṃ prasannātmā bāhuśālī yatendriyaḥ ..
iṃdulastu tadā kruddho'śvinīṃ tyaktvā bhuvi sthitaḥ ..
carma khaḍgaṃ gṛhītvāśu khaḍgayuddhamacīkarat ..35..
meaning:
ययौ शीघ्रं प्रसन्नात्मा बाहुशाली यतेन्द्रियः ..
इंदुलस्तु तदा क्रुद्धोऽश्विनीं त्यक्त्वा भुवि स्थितः ..
चर्म खड्गं गृहीत्वाशु खड्गयुद्धमचीकरत् ..35..
text_mt: that strong-armed one of restrained senses, cheerful in spirit, advanced swiftly. / Then Indula, enraged, dismounted from the mare and stood upon the ground; / taking shield and sword, he immediately engaged in sword combat.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare prāptā devādyāḥ sarvabhūmipāḥ ..
dadṛśustanmahadyuddhaṃ sarvavismayakāraṇam .. 36 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्ता देवाद्याः सर्वभूमिपाः ..
ददृशुस्तन्महद्युद्धं सर्वविस्मयकारणम् .. 36 ..
text_mt: In the meantime, the gods and all the kings of the earth arrived; / they watched that great battle which was a cause of wonder to all.

sanskrit_iast:
prātaḥkāle ca saṃprāpte balakhānirmahābalaḥ ..
dadarśa vālakaṃ ramyaṃ jaṭājinasamanvitam .. 37 ..
meaning:
प्रातःकाले च संप्राप्ते बलखानिर्महाबलः ..
ददर्श वालकं रम्यं जटाजिनसमन्वितम् .. 37 ..
text_mt: And when morning came, the very mighty Balakhāni / beheld the handsome boy, adorned with matted hair and an antelope skin.

sanskrit_iast:
śrameṇa karśito vīraḥ śakraputraḥ pratāpavān ..
balakhāneḥ piturbandhoḥ śapathaṃ kṛtavānsvayam .. 38 ..
meaning:
श्रमेण कर्शितो वीरः शक्रपुत्रः प्रतापवान् ..
बलखानेः पितुर्बन्धोः शपथं कृतवान्स्वयम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: Exhausted by fatigue, that heroic and glorious son of Śakra / himself swore an oath by Balakhāni, his father’s brother:

sanskrit_iast:
svakhaḍgenaiva kṛṣṇāṃśa śirastava harāmyaham ..
no cenme dūṣitā mātā nāmnā svarṇavatī satī ..
ityuktvā khaḍgamādāya yayau śīghraṃ ruṣānvitaḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
स्वखड्गेनैव कृष्णांश शिरस्तव हराम्यहम् ..
नो चेन्मे दूषिता माता नाम्ना स्वर्णवती सती ..
इत्युक्त्वा खड्गमादाय ययौ शीघ्रं रुषान्वितः .. 39 ..
text_mt: “O portion of Kṛṣṇa, with my own sword I shall take off your head; / if not, my mother, the virtuous woman named Svarṇavatī, is defiled!” / Having said this and taken up his sword, he advanced swiftly, filled with wrath.

sanskrit_iast:
balakhānistu taṃ jñātvā tyaktvāstraṃ premakātaraḥ ..
putrāṃtikamupāgamya vacanaṃ cedamabravīt .. 3.3.19.40 ..
meaning:
बलखानिस्तु तं ज्ञात्वा त्यक्त्वास्त्रं प्रेमकातरः ..
पुत्रांतिकमुपागम्य वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् .. 3.3.19.40 ..
text_mt: Recognising him, Balakhāni cast aside his weapon, overcome with affection; / having approached near his son, he spoke this word:

sanskrit_iast:
he indula mahābhāga pitṛmātṛyaśaskara ..
āhlādaprāṇasadṛśa svarṇavatyaṃgamānasa .. 41 ..
meaning:
हे इन्दुल महाभाग पितृमातृयशस्कर ..
आह्लादप्राणसदृश स्वर्णवत्यंगमानस .. 41 ..
text_mt: “O noble Indula, bringer of glory to your father and mother, / you who are like the very life of Āhlāda, mind and limb of Svarṇavatī!

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaṃ hatvā ca māṃ vīra svapitṛvyaṃ tataḥ punaḥ ..
tathaivodayasiṃhaṃ ca devasiṃhaṃ tathā kulam ..
sukhī bhava mahāvīra gehe vai sukhavarmaṇaḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
पूर्वं हत्वा च मां वीर स्वपितृव्यं ततः पुनः ..
तथैवोदयसिंहं च देवसिंहं तथा कुलम् ..
सुखी भव महावीर गेहे वै सुखवर्मणः .. 42 ..
text_mt: O hero, having first slain me, your own paternal uncle, and then again / likewise Udayasiṃha, Devasiṃha, and your family, / be happy, O great hero, in the house of Sukhavarman!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vacastasya jñātvā ca svakulaṃ śiśuḥ ..
tyaktvā khaḍgaṃ patitvā ca svapitṛvyasya pādayoḥ ..
kṛtavānrodanaṃ gāḍhamaparādhanivṛttaye .. 43 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य ज्ञात्वा च स्वकुलं शिशुः ..
त्यक्त्वा खड्गं पतित्वा च स्वपितृव्यस्य पादयोः ..
कृतवान्रोदनं गाढमपराधनिवृत्तये .. 43 ..
text_mt: Hearing his words and recognising his own family, the child / cast aside his sword, fell at the feet of his paternal uncle, / and wept bitterly in order to avert his offense.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ śṛṇu tāta mama priya ..
nārīyaṃ dūṣitā vedairnṛṇāṃ mohapradāyinī .. 44 ..
meaning:
उवाच मधुरं वाक्यं शृणु तात मम प्रिय ..
नारीयं दूषिता वेदैर्नृणां मोहप्रदायिनी .. 44 ..
text_mt: He spoke sweet words: “Listen, O father, my dear one! / This woman is reviled by the Vedas, bestowing delusion upon men.

sanskrit_iast:
devo vā mānuṣo vāpi pannago vāpi dānavaḥ ..
āryya nārīmayairjālairbandhanāya samudyataḥ ..45..
meaning:
देवो वा मानुषो वापि पन्नगो वापि दानवः ..
आर्य्य नारीमयैर्जालैर्बन्धनाय समुद्यतः ..45..
text_mt: Be he a god, a mortal, a serpent, or a dānava, / O noble one, he is bound by the snares made of women.

sanskrit_iast:
sohamājanmaśuddhasya piturāhlādakasya ca ..
gehe jāto jayantaśca śakraputraḥ svayaṃ vibho .. 46 ..
meaning:
सोहमाजन्मशुद्धस्य पितुराह्लादकस्य च ..
गेहे जातो जयन्तश्च शक्रपुत्रः स्वयं विभो .. 46 ..
text_mt: Such as I am, born in the house of my father Āhlādaka, who was pure from birth, / I am Jayanta himself, the son of Śakra, O lord!

sanskrit_iast:
padminyā janitaṃ mohaṃ gṛhītvā jñātavānna hi ..
kṣamasva mama mandasya śeṣamajñānajaṃ pituḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
पद्मिन्या जनितं मोहं गृहीत्वा ज्ञातवान्न हि ..
क्षमस्व मम मन्दस्य शेषमज्ञानजं पितुः .. 47 ..
text_mt: Seized by the delusion produced by Padminī, I did not know! / Forgive the remnant of my, a foolish one's, [offense] born of ignorance towards a father!”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sa punarbālo ruroda snehakātaraḥ ..
senāmujjīvayāmāsa tālanaṃ ca mahābalam ..48..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा स पुनर्बालो रुरोद स्नेहकातरः ..
सेनामुज्जीवयामास तालनं च महाबलम् ..48..
text_mt: Having said this, that boy wept again, overcome with affection; / and he revived the army and the very mighty Tālana.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vacastasya kṛṣṇāṃśo vacanaṃ śiśoḥ ..
paramānandamāgamya hṛdaye tamaropayat..
utsavaṃ kārayāmāsa tatra deśe janejane ..49..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य कृष्णांशो वचनं शिशोः ..
परमानन्दमागम्य हृदये तमरोपयत्..
उत्सवं कारयामास तत्र देशे जनेजने ..49..
text_mt: Hearing the words of that child, the portion of Kṛṣṇa / attained supreme bliss and clasped him to his heart; / he caused a festival to be celebrated among all the people in that region.

sanskrit_iast:
āryyasiṃhastu tacchrutvā nānādravyasamanvitaḥ ..
dadau kanyāṃ vidhānena padminīmiṃdulāya vai ..3.3.19.50..
meaning:
आर्य्यसिंहस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा नानाद्रव्यसमन्वितः ..
ददौ कन्यां विधानेन पद्मिनीमिंदुलाय वै ..3.3.19.50..
text_mt: Hearing of that, Āryasiṃha, possessing diverse treasures, / gave the maiden Padminī in marriage to Indula according to the prescribed rites.

sanskrit_iast:
śataṃ hayāṃstathā nāgānmuktāmaṇi vibhūṣitān ..
kanyārthe tāndadau rājā jāmātre bahubhūṣaṇam ..51..
meaning:
शतं हयांस्तथा नागान्मुक्तामणि विभूषितान् ..
कन्यार्थे तान्ददौ राजा जामात्रे बहुभूषणम् ..51..
text_mt: A hundred horses and elephants adorned with pearls and gems— / these the king gave for the maiden’s sake, and many ornaments to his son-in-law.

sanskrit_iast:
prasthānamakarotteṣāṃ sa premṇā vākyagadgadaḥ ..
te tu sarve mudā yuktāḥ svagehaṃ śīghra māyayuḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
प्रस्थानमकरोत्तेषां स प्रेम्णा वाक्यगद्गदः ..
ते तु सर्वे मुदा युक्ताः स्वगेहं शीघ्र माययुः .. 52 ..
text_mt: With voice choked with love, he made their departure; / and they, all filled with joy, quickly returned to their own home.

sanskrit_iast:
uṣitvā māsamekaṃ tu tasminmārge bhayānake ..
kīrtisāgaramāsādya cakruste bahudhotsavam..53..
meaning:
उषित्वा मासमेकं तु तस्मिन्मार्गे भयानके ..
कीर्तिसागरमासाद्य चक्रुस्ते बहुधोत्सवम्..53..
text_mt: Having tarried for one month on that perilous journey, / they reached Kīrtisāgara and held a great festival in many ways.

sanskrit_iast:
āhlādastu prasannātmā sutaṃ patnīsamanvitam ..
dṛṣṭvā viprānsamāhūya dadau dānānyanekaśaḥ ..54 ..
meaning:
आह्लादस्तु प्रसन्नात्मा सुतं पत्नीसमन्वितम् ..
दृष्ट्वा विप्रान्समाहूय ददौ दानान्यनेकशः ..54 ..
text_mt: Cheerful in spirit, Āhlāda, seeing his son accompanied by his wife, / summoned the brāhmaṇas and gave diverse gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
daśahārākhyanagaraṃ saṃprāptaḥ svakulaissaha ..
kṛṣṇāṃśasya mahākīrtirjātā loke jane jane ..59..
meaning:
दशहाराख्यनगरं संप्राप्तः स्वकुलैस्सह ..
कृष्णांशस्य महाकीर्तिर्जाता लोके जने जने ..59..
text_mt: Together with his family, he reached the city named Daśahāra; / great renown arose for the portion of Kṛṣṇa among all the people in the world.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthvīrājastu tacchrutvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayau ..
sā tu vai padminī nārī durvāsaḥśāpamohitā .. 56 ..
meaning:
पृथ्वीराजस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा विस्मयं परमं ययौ ..
सा तु वै पद्मिनी नारी दुर्वासःशापमोहिता .. 56 ..
text_mt: Pṛthvīrāja, hearing that, fell into supreme astonishment. / But that woman Padminī, deluded by the curse of Durvāsas,

sanskrit_iast:
apsasarastvaṃ svayaṃ tyaktvā bhūmau nārītvamāgatā ..
dvādaśābdapramāṇena soṣitvā jagatītale ..57..
meaning:
अप्ससरस्त्वं स्वयं त्यक्त्वा भूमौ नारीत्वमागता ..
द्वादशाब्दप्रमाणेन सोषित्वा जगतीतले ..57..
text_mt: having abandoned her nature as an apsaras, had assumed womanhood on earth; / having dwelt upon the surface of the earth for the measure of twelve years,

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣmaṇā maraṇaṃ prāpya svargalokamupāyayau ..
nava māsānkṛto vāsastayā cāhlā damaṃdire ..58..
meaning:
यक्ष्मणा मरणं प्राप्य स्वर्गलोकमुपाययौ ..
नव मासान्कृतो वासस्तया चाह्ला दमंदिरे ..58..
text_mt: she met death from consumption and departed for the world of heaven; / a dwelling of nine months was made by her in the house of Āhlāda.

sanskrit_iast:
.. .. sūta uvāca .. ..
mune pāṃcāladeśe tu rājāsīdbalavarddhanaḥ ..
