text_mt: Hearing of this, Vīrasena, devoted to the worship of the Sun, / took up the solar missile and burned his army; / by that very weapon, the portion of Kṛṣṇa fell fainting to the ground along with his horse.

sanskrit_iast:
vīrasenastu taṃ baddhvā mocayitvā sutānvadhūm ..
svagehamāgatastṛrṇaṃ nānāvādyānyavādayat .. 58 ..
meaning:
वीरसेनस्तु तं बद्ध्वा मोचयित्वा सुतान्वधूम् ..
स्वगेहमागतस्तृर्णं नानावाद्यान्यवादयत् .. 58 ..
text_mt: Having bound him and freed his sons and daughter-in-law, / Vīrasena quickly returned to his own home and had various musical instruments played.

sanskrit_iast:
hataroṣāstadā vīrāḥ kṛṣṇāṃśasya yayurdiśaḥ ..
hetuṃ parimalasyāgre sarvamūcustadāditaḥ .. 59 ..
meaning:
हतरोषास्तदा वीराः कृष्णांशस्य ययुर्दिशः ..
हेतुं परिमलस्याग्रे सर्वमूचुस्तदादितः .. 59 ..
text_mt: Then, their fury subdued, the warriors of the portion of Kṛṣṇa dispersed in all directions; / in the presence of Parimala, they told the whole cause from the beginning.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīpatiṃ mahādhūrtaṃ matvā rājābravīdidam ..
gaccha tvaṃ malanāputra lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ .. 3.3.22.60 ..
meaning:
महीपतिं महाधूर्तं मत्वा राजाब्रवीदिदम् ..
गच्छ त्वं मलनापुत्र लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः .. 3.3.22.60 ..
text_mt:
Considering that king to be a great rogue, the king said this:
“Go, son of Malanā, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
baddhvā svabhaginīkāṃtaṃ svabaṃdhuṃ mocayāśu vai ..
iti śrutvā ca sa suto lakṣasenāsamanvitaḥ ..61..
meaning:
बद्ध्वा स्वभगिनीकांतं स्वबंधुं मोचयाशु वै ..
इति श्रुत्वा च स सुतो लक्षसेनासमन्वितः ..61..
text_mt:
Bind the beloved of your own sister and release your kinsman at once!”
Having heard this, that son, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand,

sanskrit_iast:
śīghraṃ gatvā ca nagarīṃ rurodha balavānruṣā ..
yuddhī bhūte bale tasminvīraseno nṛpottamaḥ ..
sauramastramupādāya dāhanārthaṃ samudyataḥ .. 62 ..
meaning:
शीघ्रं गत्वा च नगरीं रुरोध बलवान्रुषा ..
युद्धी भूते बले तस्मिन्वीरसेनो नृपोत्तमः ..
सौरमस्त्रमुपादाय दाहनार्थं समुद्यतः .. 62 ..
text_mt:
went swiftly and, being mighty, besieged the city in anger.
When that army engaged in battle, Vīrasena, the best of kings,
took up a solar weapon and prepared to burn [them].

sanskrit_iast:
sajjībhūte tadastre tu brahmānaṃdo mahābalaḥ ..
brahmāstreṇaiva sa śaraṃ vārayāmāsa vai ruṣā .. 63 ..
meaning:
सज्जीभूते तदस्त्रे तु ब्रह्मानंदो महाबलः ..
ब्रह्मास्त्रेणैव स शरं वारयामास वै रुषा .. 63 ..
text_mt:
When that weapon was readied, the mighty Brahmānanda,
with a Brahmā-weapon itself, warded off that arrow in fury.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā bhayānvito bhūpastameva śaraṇaṃ yayau ..
brahmānaṃdastu taṃ bhūpaṃ vacanaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ .. 64 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा भयान्वितो भूपस्तमेव शरणं ययौ ..
ब्रह्मानंदस्तु तं भूपं वचनं प्राह निर्भयः .. 64 ..
text_mt:
Seeing [this], the king, filled with fear, went to him alone for refuge.
Brahmānanda, however, fearlessly addressed words to that king:

sanskrit_iast:
dhūrtavākyena he bhūpa madbaṃdhurbādhitastvayā ..
avadhyā ca sadā nārī tvatsutastāmatāḍayat ..
atastvaṃ bhaginīyuktaṃ svasutaṃ dehi me nṛpa .. 65..
meaning:
धूर्तवाक्येन हे भूप मद्बंधुर्बाधितस्त्वया ..
अवध्या च सदा नारी त्वत्सुतस्तामताडयत् ..
अतस्त्वं भगिनीयुक्तं स्वसुतं देहि मे नृप .. 65..
text_mt:
“O king, on the word of a rogue my kinsman was troubled by you.
And a woman is ever unslayable, [yet] your son struck her.
Therefore, O king, give me your son along with your sister!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā ca nṛpatirvacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ ..
matsutā ca gṛhe nāsti kāmasenaṃ gṛhāṇa bhoḥ .. 66 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा च नृपतिर्वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः ..
मत्सुता च गृहे नास्ति कामसेनं गृहाण भोः .. 66 ..
text_mt:
Having heard this, the king, humble in mind, spoke these words:
“My daughter is not at home; take Kāmasena, sir!”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā vīrasenaśca sutaṃ caṃdrāvalīṃ tathā ..
dattvā tasmai prasannātmā tatprasthānamakārayat .. 67 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा वीरसेनश्च सुतं चंद्रावलीं तथा ..
दत्त्वा तस्मै प्रसन्नात्मा तत्प्रस्थानमकारयत् .. 67 ..
text_mt:
Having said this, Vīrasena, with a pleased mind,
gave him his son and also Candrāvalī, and caused their departure.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmānando'pi balavānkṛṣṇāṃśena samanvitaḥ ..
senayāśītisāhasryā yayau sārddhaṃ mahāvatīm .. 68 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मानन्दोऽपि बलवान्कृष्णांशेन समन्वितः ..
सेनयाशीतिसाहस्र्या ययौ सार्द्धं महावतीम् .. 68 ..
text_mt:
The mighty Brahmānanda too, accompanied by Kṛṣṇāṃśa,
went with an army of eighty thousand to Mahāvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
malanā svasutaṃ dṛṣṭvā premavihvalakaṃpitā ..
snāpayitvāśrudhārābhirdvijātibhyo dadau dhanam .. 69 ..
meaning:
मलना स्वसुतं दृष्ट्वा प्रेमविह्वलकंपिता ..
स्नापयित्वाश्रुधाराभिर्द्विजातिभ्यो ददौ धनम् .. 69 ..
text_mt:
Seeing her son, Malanā, trembling and overwhelmed with love,
bathed [him] with streams of tears and gave wealth to the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ vipra kṛṣṇāṃśacaritaṃ śubham ..
śṛṇvatāṃ kalipāpaghnaṃ kathayiṣyāmi vai punaḥ .. 3.3.22.70 ..
meaning:
इति ते कथितं विप्र कृष्णांशचरितं शुभम् ..
शृण्वतां कलिपापघ्नं कथयिष्यामि वै पुनः .. 3.3.22.70 ..
text_mt:
Thus has been narrated to you, O brāhmaṇa, the auspicious deeds of Kṛṣṇāṃśa,
which destroy the sins of the Kali age for those who hear it; indeed, I shall tell it again.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
caturviśābdakaṃ prāpte kṛṣṇāṃśe balaśālini ..
iṣaśukladaśamyāṃ ca kṛto rājñā mahotsavaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
चतुर्विशाब्दकं प्राप्ते कृष्णांशे बलशालिनि ..
इषशुक्लदशम्यां च कृतो राज्ञा महोत्सवः .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Sūta said:
When the mighty Kṛṣṇāṃśa reached his twenty-fourth year,
the king held a great festival on the tenth day of the bright fortnight of Iṣa.
title: adhyāyaḥ 23

sanskrit_iast:
bhojayitvā dvijaśreṣṭhāndattvā tebhyo hi dakṣiṇāḥ ..
svabhṛtyebhyastathā vittaṃ yathāyogyaṃ kramāddadau .. 2 ..
meaning:
भोजयित्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठान्दत्त्वा तेभ्यो हि दक्षिणाः ..
स्वभृत्येभ्यस्तथा वित्तं यथायोग्यं क्रमाद्ददौ .. 2 ..
text_mt:
Having fed the best of the twice-born and given them sacrificial gifts,
he duly bestowed wealth upon his servants in proper order.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtikyāṃ śubhayuktāyāṃ kṛṣṇāṃśo balasaṃyutaḥ ..
indulena ca saṃyukto devasiṃhena saṃyutaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
कार्तिक्यां शुभयुक्तायां कृष्णांशो बलसंयुतः ..
इन्दुलेन च संयुक्तो देवसिंहेन संयुतः .. 3 ..
text_mt:
On the auspicious full-moon day of Kārtika, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, endowed with might,
together with Indula and accompanied by Devasiṃha,

sanskrit_iast:
ayutaiḥ svarṇadravyaiśca śūrairdaśasahasrakaiḥ ..
yayau barhiṣmatīsthāne nānābhūpasamanvite .. 4 ..
meaning:
अयुतैः स्वर्णद्रव्यैश्च शूरैर्दशसहस्रकैः ..
ययौ बर्हिष्मतीस्थाने नानाभूपसमन्विते .. 4 ..
text_mt:
along with ten thousand measures of gold and ten thousand warriors,
went to the place of Barhiṣmatī, which was filled with various kings.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare tatra citrarekhā samāgatā ..
vṛtā saptālibhirdevī citraguptaprapūjinī .. 5 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तत्र चित्ररेखा समागता ..
वृता सप्तालिभिर्देवी चित्रगुप्तप्रपूजिनी .. 5 ..
text_mt:
In the meantime, Citrarekhā arrived there,
the goddess surrounded by seven female companions, a devout worshipper of Citragupta.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃgāmadhye mahāramyaṃ yānaṃ māyāmayaṃ tayā ..
kṛtaṃ kautūhalayutaṃ bahusaṃpatsamanvitam .. 6 ..
meaning:
गंगामध्ये महारम्यं यानं मायामयं तया ..
कृतं कौतूहलयुतं बहुसंपत्समन्वितम् .. 6 ..
text_mt:
In the midst of the Gaṅgā, she created an exceedingly delightful vehicle made of illusion,
full of wonders and endowed with abundant treasures.

sanskrit_iast:
āgatāstatra rājāno nānā taddarśanotsukāḥ ..
tadodayo devayuto jayaṃtena samanvitaḥ ..
śataśūraiśca sahito darśanārthamupāyayau .. 7 ..
meaning:
आगतास्तत्र राजानो नाना तद्दर्शनोत्सुकाः ..
तदोदयो देवयुतो जयंतेन समन्वितः ..
शतशूरैश्च सहितो दर्शनार्थमुपाययौ .. 7 ..
text_mt:
Various kings arrived there, eager to see it.
Then Udaya, accompanied by Deva and accompanied by Jayanta,
went to see it together with a hundred warriors.

sanskrit_iast:
citrarekhā mahāramyā vāhīkanṛpateḥ sutā ..
dadarśa sudaraṃ kāntamiṃdulaṃ śaśivanmukham ..
yena svapnāṃtare ramyaṃ sārddhaṃ bhuktaṃ tayā sukham .. 8 ..
meaning:
चित्ररेखा महारम्या वाहीकनृपतेः सुता ..
ददर्श सुदरं कान्तमिंदुलं शशिवन्मुखम् ..
येन स्वप्नांतरे रम्यं सार्द्धं भुक्तं तया सुखम् .. 8 ..
text_mt:
The exceedingly lovely Citrarekhā, daughter of the king of the Vāhīkas,
saw the handsome and beloved Indula, whose face was like the moon,
with whom she had enjoyed delightful pleasure within a dream.

sanskrit_iast:
tamāhlādasutaṃ jñātvā sābhinaṃdanadehajā ..
kṛtvā mohamayaṃ jālaṃ śukabhūtaṃ tadeṃdulam .. 9 ..
meaning:
तमाह्लादसुतं ज्ञात्वा साभिनंदनदेहजा ..
कृत्वा मोहमयं जालं शुकभूतं तदेंदुलम् .. 9 ..
text_mt:
Recognising him as the son of Āhlāda, that daughter born of the body of Abhinandana,
having cast a net of illusion, turned Indula into a parrot,

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtvā svayaṃvare ramye paramānandamāyayau ..
punarāhṛtya tāṃ māyāṃ svagehāya yayau mudā .. 3.3.23.10 ..
meaning:
हृत्वा स्वयंवरे रम्ये परमानन्दमाययौ ..
पुनराहृत्य तां मायां स्वगेहाय ययौ मुदा .. 3.3.23.10 ..
text_mt:
abducted him at the delightful svayaṃvara, and reached supreme bliss.
Withdrawing that illusion again, she joyfully went to her own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśastu tadā buddhvā na dadarśa svakaṃ śiśum ..
devasiṃhaṃ bodhayitvā papraccha kva gataḥ śiśuḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
कृष्णांशस्तु तदा बुद्ध्वा न ददर्श स्वकं शिशुम् ..
देवसिंहं बोधयित्वा पप्रच्छ क्व गतः शिशुः .. 11 ..
text_mt:
Kṛṣṇāṃśa, however, waking up then, did not see his child.
Waking Devasiṃha, he asked: “Where has the child gone?”

sanskrit_iast:
kālajño devasiṃho'pi mohitaścitramāyayā ..
na jñātastena vai bālaḥ kva gataḥ kena vā hṛtaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
कालज्ञो देवसिंहोऽपि मोहितश्चित्रमायया ..
न ज्ञातस्तेन वै बालः क्व गतः केन वा हृतः .. 12 ..
text_mt:
Even Devasiṃha, who knew the proper time, was deluded by the wondrous illusion;
he did not know where the boy had gone, or by whom he had been taken.

sanskrit_iast:
vismitaṃ devasiṃhaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇāṃśako balī ..
rurodoccaistadā gāḍhaṃ citramāyāvimohitaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
विस्मितं देवसिंहं च दृष्ट्वा कृष्णांशको बली ..
रुरोदोच्चैस्तदा गाढं चित्रमायाविमोहितः .. 13 ..
text_mt:
Seeing Devasiṃha bewildered, the mighty Kṛṣṇāṃśa
wept bitterly and aloud, deluded by the wondrous illusion.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā tu rodanaṃ tasya khalastatra mahīpatiḥ ..
yayau śīghraṃ prasannātmā yatrāhlādaḥ svayaṃ sthitaḥ ..
ruditvā tatra vai gāḍhaṃ vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा तु रोदनं तस्य खलस्तत्र महीपतिः ..
ययौ शीघ्रं प्रसन्नात्मा यत्राह्लादः स्वयं स्थितः ..
रुदित्वा तत्र वै गाढं वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः .. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
udayo nāma te bhrātā mohayitvā madena tau ..
devamindulamevāsau hatvā dhārāsvaropayat .. 15 ..
meaning:
उदयो नाम ते भ्राता मोहयित्वा मदेन तौ ..
देवमिन्दुलमेवासौ हत्वा धारास्वरोपयत् .. 15 ..
text_mt:
“Your brother named Udaya, having intoxicated those two with pride,
slew Deva and Indula, and threw them into the river's current!

sanskrit_iast:
pratyakṣaṃ ca mayā dṛṣṭaṃ tena vīreṇa vai kṛtam ..
śataṃ svarṇaṃ ca me dattvā vinayenāvarodhitaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
प्रत्यक्षं च मया दृष्टं तेन वीरेण वै कृतम् ..
शतं स्वर्णं च मे दत्त्वा विनयेनावरोधितः .. 16 ..
text_mt:
And with my own eyes I saw what was done by that warrior.
Giving me a hundred [pieces of] gold, he courteously constrained me.

sanskrit_iast:
devasiṃhastato buddhyā na jñātaṃ tena yatkṛtam ..
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ niścayaṃ nādhigacchati .. 17 ..
meaning:
देवसिंहस्ततो बुद्ध्या न ज्ञातं तेन यत्कृतम् ..
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं निश्चयं नाधिगच्छति .. 17 ..
text_mt:
Therefore, Devasiṃha, through his wit, did not realise what was done by him.”
Hearing these words, however, he could not reach a certain conclusion.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare prāptau tau vīrau rodane ratau ..
tadviyogena kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ svadehaṃ tyaktumudyataḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्तौ तौ वीरौ रोदने रतौ ..
तद्वियोगेन कृष्णांशः स्वदेहं त्यक्तुमुद्यतः .. 18 ..
text_mt:
Meanwhile, those two warriors arrived, engaged in weeping;
from separation from him, Kṛṣṇāṃśa prepared to abandon his own body.

sanskrit_iast:
āhlādo niścayaṃ jñātvā bhāṣitaṃ ca mahīpateḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ tāḍayāmāsa vaitasaiścarmakartanaiḥ..19..
meaning:
आह्लादो निश्चयं ज्ञात्वा भाषितं च महीपतेः ..
कृष्णांशं ताडयामास वैतसैश्चर्मकर्तनैः..19..
text_mt:
Āhlāda, believing the king's words to be a certainty,
beat Kṛṣṇāṃśa with cane whips and leather thongs.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya mātā tathā patnī bhaginī premaduḥkhitāḥ ..
āhlādaṃ bodhayāmāsurdhūrtamāyāvimohitam ..
na bodhitastadā vīraścitramāyāvimohitaḥ .. 3.3.23.20 ..
meaning:
तस्य माता तथा पत्नी भगिनी प्रेमदुःखिताः ..
आह्लादं बोधयामासुर्धूर्तमायाविमोहितम् ..
न बोधितस्तदा वीरश्चित्रमायाविमोहितः .. 3.3.23.20 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tadā puṣpavatī devī svapatiṃ bhrātṛpīḍitam ..
dṛṣṭvā tatra gatā śīghraṃ patiduḥkhena duḥkhitā ..21..
meaning:
तदा पुष्पवती देवी स्वपतिं भ्रातृपीडितम् ..
दृष्ट्वा तत्र गता शीघ्रं पतिदुःखेन दुःखिता ..21..
text_mt:
Then Queen Puṣpavatī, seeing her husband afflicted by his brother,
went there swiftly, sorrowful over her husband's distress.

sanskrit_iast:
vināparādhaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśo mahāniṃdāmavāptavān ..
tadā vedavido viprā āhlādaṃ prāhurūrjitam .. 22 ..
meaning:
विनापराधं कृष्णांशो महानिंदामवाप्तवान् ..
तदा वेदविदो विप्रा आह्लादं प्राहुरूर्जितम् .. 22 ..
text_mt:
Without any fault, Kṛṣṇāṃśa met with great reproach.
Then the brāhmaṇas who knew the Vedas spoke forcefully to Āhlāda:

sanskrit_iast:
vadhastyāgaḥ samo jñeyo yogyaṃ buddhyā vicāraya ..
ityuktaḥ sa turīyātmā putraśokena duḥkhitaḥ .. ..23 ..
meaning:
वधस्त्यागः समो ज्ञेयो योग्यं बुद्ध्या विचारय ..
इत्युक्तः स तुरीयात्मा पुत्रशोकेन दुःखितः .. ..23 ..
text_mt:
“Banishment is to be known as equal to execution; consider what is fitting with your intellect!”
Thus addressed, that high-minded man, grief-stricken over the sorrow for his son,

sanskrit_iast:
cāṃḍālāṃśca samāhūya baddhvā taṃ putraghātinam ..
dattvā tebhyaḥ sapatnīkaṃ vadhaṃ kuruta mā ciram .. 24 ..
meaning:
चांडालांश्च समाहूय बद्ध्वा तं पुत्रघातिनम् ..
दत्त्वा तेभ्यः सपत्नीकं वधं कुरुत मा चिरम् .. 24 ..
text_mt:
summoned the Cāṇḍālas, bound that slayer of his son,
handed him over to them together with his wife, [and said:] “Put [him] to death without delay!

sanskrit_iast:
asya netre samutpāṭya māṃ darśayata saṃyutāḥ ..
iti śrutvā gatāste vai gahanaṃ vyāghrasevitam .. 25 ..
meaning:
अस्य नेत्रे समुत्पाट्य मां दर्शयत संयुताः ..
इति श्रुत्वा गतास्ते वै गहनं व्याघ्रसेवितम् .. 25 ..
text_mt:
Gouge out his two eyes and, together, show them to me!”
Hearing this, they went to a dense forest frequented by tigers.

sanskrit_iast:
devasiṃhastato gatvā dattvā tebhyo mahaddhanam ..
saṃprāpya daṃpatī vīraścāṃḍālebhyo vanaṃ yayau .. 26 ..
meaning:
देवसिंहस्ततो गत्वा दत्त्वा तेभ्यो महद्धनम् ..
संप्राप्य दंपती वीरश्चांडालेभ्यो वनं ययौ .. 26 ..
text_mt:
Then Devasiṃha went, gave them great wealth,
and having received the couple from the Cāṇḍālas, the warrior went into the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
balakhānestu yā patnī gajamuktā pativratā ..
daṃpatī pālayāmāsa guhyagehe mudā yutā .. 27 ..
meaning:
बलखानेस्तु या पत्नी गजमुक्ता पतिव्रता ..
दंपती पालयामास गुह्यगेहे मुदा युता .. 27 ..
text_mt:
The devoted wife of Balakhāni, Gajamuktā,
joyfully protected the couple in a secret dwelling.

sanskrit_iast:
cāṃḍālāste tu saṃgatya mṛganetre ca taṃ daduḥ ..
devasiṃhastadāgatya krodhātmā ca tamabravīt ..
dhiktvāṃ pāpaṃ durācāraṃ tvayā me hiṃsitaḥ sakhā .. 28 ..
meaning:
चांडालास्ते तु संगत्य मृगनेत्रे च तं ददुः ..
देवसिंहस्तदागत्य क्रोधात्मा च तमब्रवीत् ..
धिक्त्वां पापं दुराचारं त्वया मे हिंसितः सखा .. 28 ..
text_mt:
Those Cāṇḍālas, having assembled, gave him the eyes of a deer.
Devasiṃha then came, filled with anger, and said to him:
“Fie on you, wicked and evil-doer! By you my friend was harmed!”

sanskrit_iast:
jīvitastvatsuto bhūmau tadanveṣaṇahetave ..
yāsyāmi vividhānrāṣṭrānsatyaṃsatyaṃ bravīmyaham ..
ityuktvā prayayau vīraḥ śirīṣākhyapuraṃ śubham .. 29 ..
meaning:
जीवितस्त्वत्सुतो भूमौ तदन्वेषणहेतवे ..
यास्यामि विविधान्राष्ट्रान्सत्यंसत्यं ब्रवीम्यहम् ..
इत्युक्त्वा प्रययौ वीरः शिरीषाख्यपुरं शुभम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: “Your son is alive on earth; to search for him / I will go to various lands; truly, truly I say [this].” / Having spoken thus, the hero set forth to the auspicious city named Śirīṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
gajamuktāmanujñāpya daṃpatī prāpya nirbhayaḥ ..
mayūranagaraṃ ramyaṃ niśi ghoraṃ samāyayau .. 3.3.23.30 ..
meaning:
गजमुक्तामनुज्ञाप्य दंपती प्राप्य निर्भयः ..
मयूरनगरं रम्यं निशि घोरं समाययौ .. 3.3.23.30 ..
text_mt: Taking leave of Gajamuktā, having reached the couple, fearless, / he arrived at the delightful Mayūranagara in the terrifying night.

sanskrit_iast:
makaraṃdastu balavānjñātvā tatsarvakāraṇam ..
svasuḥ patiṃ ca bhaginīṃ svāṃte premṇā nyavāsayat .. 31 ..
meaning:
मकरंदस्तु बलवान्ज्ञात्वा तत्सर्वकारणम् ..
स्वसुः पतिं च भगिनीं स्वांते प्रेम्णा न्यवासयत् .. 31 ..
text_mt: The mighty Makaranda, however, having learned the whole matter, / lovingly settled his sister's husband and his sister in his own residence.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmamārādhayāmāsa yajñairnānāvidhaiḥ stavaiḥ ..
prasanno dharmarājaśca makarandamuvāca ha .. 32 ..
meaning:
धर्ममाराधयामास यज्ञैर्नानाविधैः स्तवैः ..
प्रसन्नो धर्मराजश्च मकरन्दमुवाच ह .. 32 ..
text_mt: He worshiped Dharma with sacrifices of various kinds and with hymns of praise. / Pleased, the lord of Dharma spoke to Makaranda:

sanskrit_iast:
abhinaṃdanabhūpasya sutā citraprapūjinī ..
nāṭyātmajā kesariṇī tatsakhī daṃbhakovidā .. 33 ..
meaning:
अभिनंदनभूपस्य सुता चित्रप्रपूजिनी ..
नाट्यात्मजा केसरिणी तत्सखी दंभकोविदा .. 33 ..
text_mt: “King Abhinandana has a daughter who worships images, / born of dramatic art, Kesariṇī, her friend, who is skilled in deceit.

sanskrit_iast:
kesariṇyā gururjñeyaḥ kutuko yogurūpadhṛk ..
tena prasāritā māyā śatayojanamantarā .. 34 ..
meaning:
केसरिण्या गुरुर्ज्ञेयः कुतुको योगुरूपधृक् ..
तेन प्रसारिता माया शतयोजनमन्तरा .. 34 ..
text_mt: The teacher of Kesariṇī should be known as Kutuka, who wears the guise of a yogi; / by him a magical illusion has been spread across a distance of a hundred yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
śatrubhirdurgamā bhūmiḥ śatrupāṣāṇakāriṇī ..
citraguptaprabhāveṇa nirbhayo bhūpatiḥ svayam .. 35 ..
meaning:
शत्रुभिर्दुर्गमा भूमिः शत्रुपाषाणकारिणी ..
चित्रगुप्तप्रभावेण निर्भयो भूपतिः स्वयम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: The ground is impassable to enemies, turning enemies to stone; / through the power of Citragupta, the king himself is fearless.

sanskrit_iast:
citrarekhābhūpasutā jayaṃtastu tayā hṛtaḥ ..
nararūpadharo rātrau śukarūpadharo dine ..
indulaśca sthito duḥkhī citramāyāvimohitaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
चित्ररेखाभूपसुता जयंतस्तु तया हृतः ..
नररूपधरो रात्रौ शुकरूपधरो दिने ..
इन्दुलश्च स्थितो दुःखी चित्रमायाविमोहितः .. 36 ..
text_mt: Citrarekhā is the king's daughter; and Jayanta was carried off by her; / he takes human form by night, and takes the form of a parrot by day; / and Indula remains there sorrowful, bewildered by the wonderful magical illusion.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśaśca bhavāndevaḥ sahitaḥ sūryavarmaṇā ..
mayā dattāni yaṃtrāṇi gṛhītvā te mudā yutāḥ ..
citrarekhāṃ samāgatya nṛtyādīṃstaiḥ samaṃ kuru .. 37 ..
meaning:
कृष्णांशश्च भवान्देवः सहितः सूर्यवर्मणा ..
मया दत्तानि यंत्राणि गृहीत्वा ते मुदा युताः ..
चित्ररेखां समागत्य नृत्यादींस्तैः समं कुरु .. 37 ..
text_mt: And you, noble lord, being a portion of Kṛṣṇa, accompanied by Sūryavarman, / taking the magical diagrams given by me, filled with joy, / approach Citrarekhā and perform dances and the like together with them.

sanskrit_iast:
mohayitvā ca tāṃ devīṃ paṭhitvā tanmataṃ śubham ..
punarāgaccha vai śīghraṃ sainyayogaṃ punaḥ kuru .. .. 38 ..
meaning:
मोहयित्वा च तां देवीं पठित्वा तन्मतं शुभम् ..
पुनरागच्छ वै शीघ्रं सैन्ययोगं पुनः कुरु .. .. 38 ..
text_mt: Enchanting that queen, and reciting her auspicious teaching, / come back swiftly indeed, and assemble your army again.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvāntardadhe devassa rājā vismayānvitaḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ varṇayāmāsa yathā dharmeṇa bhāṣitam .. 39 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे देवस्स राजा विस्मयान्वितः ..
कृष्णांशं वर्णयामास यथा धर्मेण भाषितम् .. 39 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the god disappeared. Filled with amazement, the king / described [it all] to the portion of Kṛṣṇa, exactly as told by Dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
phālgune māsi saṃprāpte trayaste yogirūpiṇaḥ ..
yayurinnagaṭaṃ ramyaṃ nṛtyagītaviśāradāḥ .. 3.3.23.40 ..
meaning:
फाल्गुने मासि संप्राप्ते त्रयस्ते योगिरूपिणः ..
ययुरिन्नगटं रम्यं नृत्यगीतविशारदाः .. 3.3.23.40 ..
text_mt: When the month of Phālguna arrived, the three of them, disguised as yogis, / skilled in dance and song, went to the charming Innagaṭa.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdaṃgāṃkastadā devo makaraṃdo vipaṃcimān..
nṛtyagānakaro vīraḥ kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ sarva mohanaḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
मृदंगांकस्तदा देवो मकरंदो विपंचिमान्..
नृत्यगानकरो वीरः कृष्णांशः सर्व मोहनः .. 41 ..
text_mt: Then Lord [Devasiṃha] played the mṛdaṅga drum, Makaranda had the vīṇā, / and the hero who is a portion of Kṛṣṇa, enchanting everyone, sang and danced.

sanskrit_iast:
mohayitvā ca nagaraṃ tathā gajapatiṃ nṛpam ..
sakulaṃ ca sasainyaṃ ca tuṣṭo rājābravīdididam .. 42 ..
meaning:
मोहयित्वा च नगरं तथा गजपतिं नृपम् ..
सकुलं च ससैन्यं च तुष्टो राजाब्रवीदिदिदम् .. 42 ..
text_mt: Having enchanted the city, and likewise King Gajapati, / along with his family and army, the delighted king spoke this:

sanskrit_iast:
vāṃchitaṃ brūhi me yoginsa śrutvā prāha namradhīḥ ..
dehi me sūryavarmāṇaṃ svasutaṃ kāryahetave ..43..
meaning:
वांछितं ब्रूहि मे योगिन्स श्रुत्वा प्राह नम्रधीः ..
देहि मे सूर्यवर्माणं स्वसुतं कार्यहेतवे ..43..
text_mt: “Tell me your desire, O yogi!” Having heard that, with humble mind he said: / “Give me Sūryavarman, your own son, for the sake of our mission.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā kāryamahaṃ śīghraṃ punardāsyami te sutam..
vidhinā nirmito dharmo rājabhirviśvarakṣaṇam ..44..
meaning:
कृत्वा कार्यमहं शीघ्रं पुनर्दास्यमि ते सुतम्..
विधिना निर्मितो धर्मो राजभिर्विश्वरक्षणम् ..44..
text_mt: Having quickly accomplished the mission, I will give your son back to you; / the duty ordained by Fate for kings is the protection of the universe.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā gajapatirdattvā tebhyaḥ svakaṃ sutam ..
svarājñīmāyayau rājā gatāste kāryatatparāḥ ..45..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा गजपतिर्दत्त्वा तेभ्यः स्वकं सुतम् ..
स्वराज्ञीमाययौ राजा गतास्ते कार्यतत्पराः ..45..
text_mt: Hearing this, Gajapati gave them his own son; / the king went to his queen, and they departed intent upon their task.

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣamātreṇa bāhlīkaṃ nagaraṃ prayayurmudā ..
dharmadattāni yaṃtrāṇi gṛhītvā śatrumaṃdiram .. 46 ..
meaning:
पक्षमात्रेण बाह्लीकं नगरं प्रययुर्मुदा ..
धर्मदत्तानि यंत्राणि गृहीत्वा शत्रुमंदिरम् .. 46 ..
text_mt: Within just a fortnight, they gladly went to the city of Bāhlīka, / taking the magical diagrams given by Dharma to the dwelling of the enemy.

sanskrit_iast:
āyayurlāsyatattvajñā nṛpamohanatatparāḥ ..
sarve ca nāgarāḥ prāptāstatra kṣatragaṇā mudā ..47..
meaning:
आययुर्लास्यतत्त्वज्ञा नृपमोहनतत्पराः ..
सर्वे च नागराः प्राप्तास्तत्र क्षत्रगणा मुदा ..47..
text_mt: Knowing the principles of dance, intent on enchanting the king, they arrived; / and all the citizens and the hosts of kṣatriyas gathered there joyfully.

sanskrit_iast:
mohitāstaiśca te sarve gītanṛtyaviśāradaiḥ ..
mahaddhanaṃ dadau tebhyastomarānvayasaṃbhavāḥ ..48..
meaning:
मोहितास्तैश्च ते सर्वे गीतनृत्यविशारदैः ..
महद्धनं ददौ तेभ्यस्तोमरान्वयसंभवाः ..48..
text_mt: They were all enchanted by those skilled in song and dance; / those born of the Tomara lineage gave them immense wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
tānādāya punarbhūpaḥ svagehamabhinaṃdanaḥ ..
āyayau gehanṛtyārthī kārayāmāsa vai punaḥ ..49..
meaning:
तानादाय पुनर्भूपः स्वगेहमभिनंदनः ..
आययौ गेहनृत्यार्थी कारयामास वै पुनः ..49..
text_mt: Taking them, King Abhinandana again went to his own palace; / desiring a dance in his house, he had it performed once more.

sanskrit_iast:
makaraṃdastadā vīṇāṃ mṛdaṃgaṃ bhīṣmajo balī..
maṃjīraṃ sūryavarmā ca kṛṣṇāṃśo gānanṛtyakam ..3.3.23.50..
meaning:
मकरंदस्तदा वीणां मृदंगं भीष्मजो बली..
मंजीरं सूर्यवर्मा च कृष्णांशो गाननृत्यकम् ..3.3.23.50..
text_mt: Then Makaranda [played] the vīṇā, the mighty son of Bhīṣma the mṛdaṅga drum, / Sūryavarman the cymbals, and the portion of Kṛṣṇa performed singing and dancing.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā modayāmāsurnārīvṛndā mahottamam ..
citrarekhā svayaṃ dṛṣṭvā teṣāṃ mohanahetave .. 51 ..
meaning:
गृहीत्वा मोदयामासुर्नारीवृन्दा महोत्तमम् ..
चित्ररेखा स्वयं दृष्ट्वा तेषां मोहनहेतवे .. 51 ..
text_mt: Holding these, they delighted the multitude of women exceedingly; / Citrarekhā herself, having seen them, for the sake of enchanting them,

sanskrit_iast:
māyāṃ nirvāpayāmāsa niṣphalā sā'bhavatkṣaṇāt ..
mohitā taiśca sā devī tānuvāca mudānvitā .. 52 ..
meaning:
मायां निर्वापयामास निष्फला साऽभवत्क्षणात् ..
मोहिता तैश्च सा देवी तानुवाच मुदान्विता .. 52 ..
text_mt: discharged a magical illusion; but in an instant it became fruitless. / Enchanted by them, that queen, filled with joy, spoke to them:

sanskrit_iast:
vāṃchitaṃ brūhi me vīra kṛṣṇāṃśaścāha tāṃ vadhūm..
śukaṃ dehi ca me dehi no cecchāpaṃ dadāmya'ham .. 53 ..
meaning:
वांछितं ब्रूहि मे वीर कृष्णांशश्चाह तां वधूम्..
शुकं देहि च मे देहि नो चेच्छापं ददाम्यऽहम् .. 53 ..
text_mt: “O hero, tell me your desire!” And the portion of Kṛṣṇa said to the young woman: / “Give me the parrot, give it to me, or else I shall pronounce a curse!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā citrarekhā śokavyākulacetanā ..
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ yoginaṃ prāha satyaṃ kathaya ko bhavān .. 54 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा चित्ररेखा शोकव्याकुलचेतना ..
कृष्णांशं योगिनं प्राह सत्यं कथय को भवान् .. 54 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, Citrarekhā, her mind agitated with grief, / said to the yogi, the portion of Kṛṣṇa: “Tell the truth, who are you?

sanskrit_iast:
iṃdrādyā devatāssarve mayā nirmitayā yayā ..
mohitāḥ kṣaṇamātreṇa na bhavānmohito mayā ..55..
meaning:
इंद्राद्या देवतास्सर्वे मया निर्मितया यया ..
मोहिताः क्षणमात्रेण न भवान्मोहितो मया ..55..
text_mt: All the deities headed by Indra were enchanted in an instant / by me through the [illusion] that I produced; yet you were not enchanted by me.

sanskrit_iast:
devo nārāyaṇo vāpi dharmo vāpi śivaḥ svayam ..
ityuktassa tu kṛṣṇāṃśo vacanaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ ..56..
meaning:
देवो नारायणो वापि धर्मो वापि शिवः स्वयम् ..
इत्युक्तस्स तु कृष्णांशो वचनं प्राह निर्भयः ..56..
text_mt: Are you Lord Nārāyaṇa, or Dharma, or Śiva himself?” / Addressed thus, that portion of Kṛṣṇa spoke fearless words:

sanskrit_iast:
udayo nāma me rājñi devasiṃho'yamuttamaḥ ..
macchyālo makaraṃdo'yaṃ sūryavarmā tathāvidhaḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
उदयो नाम मे राज्ञि देवसिंहोऽयमुत्तमः ..
मच्छ्यालो मकरंदोऽयं सूर्यवर्मा तथाविधः .. 57 ..
text_mt: “O queen, my name is Udaya; this excellent one is Devasiṃha; / this is my brother-in-law Makaranda; and Sūryavarman is such a one.

sanskrit_iast:
indulasya viyogena vayaṃ yogitvamāgatāḥ ..
madguruśca tathonmādī saṃkulastadviyogataḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
इन्दुलस्य वियोगेन वयं योगित्वमागताः ..
मद्गुरुश्च तथोन्मादी संकुलस्तद्वियोगतः .. 58 ..
text_mt: Because of separation from Indula, we have assumed the state of yogis; / and my teacher, distressed by separation from him, has likewise become mad.

sanskrit_iast:
śukaṃ dehi mahāmāye iṃdulaṃ dehi vā yadi ..
ityuktvāśu rurodoccairhā indula mahābala .. 59 ..
meaning:
शुकं देहि महामाये इंदुलं देहि वा यदि ..
इत्युक्त्वाशु रुरोदोच्चैर्हा इन्दुल महाबल .. 59 ..
text_mt: Give the parrot, O Mahāmāyā, or else give Indula!” / Having spoken thus, he wept aloud: “Alas, Indula of mighty strength!

sanskrit_iast:
darśanaṃ dehi me śīghraṃ no cetprāṇāṃstyajāmyaham ..
ityevaṃvādinaṃ vīraṃ citrarekhā mahottamā .. 3.3.23.60 ..
meaning:
दर्शनं देहि मे शीघ्रं नो चेत्प्राणांस्त्यजाम्यहम् ..
इत्येवंवादिनं वीरं चित्ररेखा महोत्तमा .. 3.3.23.60 ..
text_mt: Show yourself to me quickly, or else I shall abandon my life!” / As the hero was speaking in this way, the most excellent Citrarekhā,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā lajjāṃ punaḥ prāha māṃ ca putraṃ gṛhāṇa bhoḥ ..
kṛtvā naramayaṃ rūpaṃ svakāntaṃ sarvasuṃdaram .. 61 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा लज्जां पुनः प्राह मां च पुत्रं गृहाण भोः ..
कृत्वा नरमयं रूपं स्वकान्तं सर्वसुंदरम् .. 61 ..
text_mt: feeling shame, said again: “Take both me and my son, sir!” / Making her beloved, who was handsome in every limb, assume human form,

sanskrit_iast:
patitvā taccaraṇayo rurodoccaiśca daṃpatī ..
tathāvidhau ca tau dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇāṃśo harṣasaṃyutaḥ .. 62 ..
meaning:
पतित्वा तच्चरणयो रुरोदोच्चैश्च दंपती ..
तथाविधौ च तौ दृष्ट्वा कृष्णांशो हर्षसंयुतः .. 62 ..
text_mt: the couple fell at his feet and wept aloud. / Seeing the two of them in such a state, the portion of Kṛṣṇa was filled with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
iṃdulenaiva likhitaṃ gṛhītvā patramuttamam..
dharmayaṃtraprabhāveṇa mayūranagaraṃ yayau .. 63 ..
meaning:
इंदुलेनैव लिखितं गृहीत्वा पत्रमुत्तमम्..
धर्मयंत्रप्रभावेण मयूरनगरं ययौ .. 63 ..
text_mt: Taking the excellent letter written by Indula himself, / through the power of Dharma's magical diagram, he went to Mayūranagara.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryavarmā gato gehaṃ makaraṃdena mānitaḥ ..
devasiṃhastu balavāngṛhītvā patramuttamam ..64..
meaning:
सूर्यवर्मा गतो गेहं मकरंदेन मानितः ..
देवसिंहस्तु बलवान्गृहीत्वा पत्रमुत्तमम् ..64..
text_mt: Honored by Makaranda, Sūryavarman went home. / But the mighty Devasiṃha, taking the excellent letter,

sanskrit_iast:
yayau manorathārūḍho yatrāhlādaḥ śucānvitaḥ ..
ko bhavāniti taṃ prāha mahonmādīva dṛśyate .. 65 ..
meaning:
ययौ मनोरथारूढो यत्राह्लादः शुचान्वितः ..
को भवानिति तं प्राह महोन्मादीव दृश्यते .. 65 ..
text_mt: mounted upon a chariot of his desire, went to where Āhlāda was, overcome with sorrow. / [Āhlāda], who looked like a great madman, said to him: “Who are you?”

sanskrit_iast:
devasiṃhaṃ ca māṃ viddhi tava putrānveṣaṇe ratam ..
patraṃ gṛhāṇa bho vīra likhitaṃ tatsutena vai .. 66 ..
meaning:
देवसिंहं च मां विद्धि तव पुत्रान्वेषणे रतम् ..
पत्रं गृहाण भो वीर लिखितं तत्सुतेन वै .. 66 ..
text_mt: “Know me to be Devasiṃha, devoted to the search for your son; / take the letter, O hero, written indeed by your son!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā sa āhlādaścā hlādaṃ paramāptavān ..
jñātvā tatkāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ yathāvidhi suto hṛtaḥ ..67..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा स आह्लादश्चा ह्लादं परमाप्तवान् ..
ज्ञात्वा तत्कारणं सर्वं यथाविधि सुतो हृतः ..67..
text_mt: Hearing this, Āhlāda attained supreme delight; / he understood the whole reason why his son had been carried off in that manner.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīpatiṃ samāhūya vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ..
satyaṃ kathaya me bhūpa kṛṣṇāṃśena hatassutaḥ .. 68 ..
meaning:
महीपतिं समाहूय वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः..
सत्यं कथय मे भूप कृष्णांशेन हतस्सुतः .. 68 ..
text_mt: Summoning the king, with humble mind he said: / “Tell me the truth, O king! Was my son slain by the portion of Kṛṣṇa?”

sanskrit_iast:
sa hovāca śrutaṃ vīra kṛṣṇāṃśena yathā hataḥ ..
ityuktvā tu vihasyāśu kāryasiddhimupāgataḥ .. 69 ..
meaning:
स होवाच श्रुतं वीर कृष्णांशेन यथा हतः ..
इत्युक्त्वा तु विहस्याशु कार्यसिद्धिमुपागतः .. 69 ..
text_mt: He replied: “It was heard, O hero, that he was slain by the portion of Kṛṣṇa.” / Having spoken thus, laughing quickly, he attained the accomplishment of his purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
ahlādaḥ krodhatāmrākṣaḥ keśānā kṛṣya taṃ mudā ..
vetasaistāḍayāmāsa svahastena punaḥ punaḥ .. 3.3.23.70 ..
meaning:
अह्लादः क्रोधताम्राक्षः केशाना कृष्य तं मुदा ..
वेतसैस्ताडयामास स्वहस्तेन पुनः पुनः .. 3.3.23.70 ..
text_mt: Āhlāda, his eyes red with rage, pulling him joyfully by the hair, / struck him again and again with his own hand using cane rods.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā parimalo rājā sapatnīkassamāgataḥ ..
bahudhā modayāmāsa rāmāṃśaṃ bahurūpiṇam .. 71 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा परिमलो राजा सपत्नीकस्समागतः ..
बहुधा मोदयामास रामांशं बहुरूपिणम् .. 71 ..
text_mt: Having heard of it, King Parimala came along with his wife; / he cheered the multiform portion of Rāma in many ways.

sanskrit_iast:
are dhūrta mahāpāpinmadbaṃdhurghātitastvayā ..
gato yatra mama prāṇassakulaṃ tvāṃ nayāmyaham .. 72 ..
meaning:
अरे धूर्त महापापिन्मद्बंधुर्घातितस्त्वया ..
गतो यत्र मम प्राणस्सकुलं त्वां नयाम्यहम् .. 72 ..
text_mt: "Ah, rogue, great sinner! You have had my brother killed! / Where my life has gone, there shall I take you along with your kin!"

sanskrit_iast:
tadā mahīpatirduḥkhī niḥśvāso maunamāsthitaḥ ..
tadaghaṃ hṛdi saṃsthāpya mahāpīḍāmavāptavān .. 73 ..
meaning:
तदा महीपतिर्दुःखी निःश्वासो मौनमास्थितः ..
तदघं हृदि संस्थाप्य महापीडामवाप्तवान् .. 73 ..
text_mt: Then the king, sorrowful, sighing, took to silence; / holding that sin in his heart, he suffered great affliction.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare vīro balakhāniḥ samāgataḥ ..
vimucya mātulaṃ dhūrtaṃ jyeṣṭhabandhumasāntvayat .. 74 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे वीरो बलखानिः समागतः ..
विमुच्य मातुलं धूर्तं ज्येष्ठबन्धुमसान्त्वयत् .. 74 ..
text_mt: In the meantime, the heroic Balakhāni arrived; / releasing the roguish maternal uncle, he consoled his elder brother.

sanskrit_iast:
sa cakāra vivāhārthamudyogaṃ bhrātṛjasya vai ..
netrasiṃho nṛpaḥ prāpto lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ .. 75 ..
meaning:
स चकार विवाहार्थमुद्योगं भ्रातृजस्य वै ..
नेत्रसिंहो नृपः प्राप्तो लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः .. 75 ..
text_mt: He made preparations for the marriage of his nephew. / King Netrasiṃha arrived, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
tārakaśca tamāyātassārddhaṃ śūrasahasrakaiḥ ..
vīrasenaḥ svayaṃ prāptaḥ śūraiḥ sārddhaṃ navā'yutaiḥ .. 76 ..
meaning:
तारकश्च तमायातस्सार्द्धं शूरसहस्रकैः ..
वीरसेनः स्वयं प्राप्तः शूरैः सार्द्धं नवाऽयुतैः .. 76 ..
text_mt: And Tāraka came to him together with thousands of heroes; / Vīrasena himself arrived with ninety thousand heroes.

sanskrit_iast:
tālanaśca tataḥ prāpto lakṣasainyasama nvitaḥ ..
sūryavarmā tathā prāpto lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ .. 77 ..
meaning:
तालनश्च ततः प्राप्तो लक्षसैन्यसम न्वितः ..
सूर्यवर्मा तथा प्राप्तो लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः .. 77 ..
text_mt: Then Tālana arrived, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand; / likewise Sūryavarmā arrived, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmānaṃdaḥ svayaṃ prāptastrilakṣabalasaṃyutaḥ ..
āhlādaśca śucāviṣṭo lakṣasainya samanvitaḥ .. 78 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मानंदः स्वयं प्राप्तस्त्रिलक्षबलसंयुतः ..
आह्लादश्च शुचाविष्टो लक्षसैन्य समन्वितः .. 78 ..
text_mt: Brahmānanda himself arrived, joined by a force of three hundred thousand; / and Āhlāda, overcome with grief, [came] accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
hā baṃdho kva gatastvaṃ vai māṃ tyaktvā puruṣādhamam ..
ityuktvā prayayau vīraḥ śokavyākulacetanaḥ .. 79 ..
meaning:
हा बंधो क्व गतस्त्वं वै मां त्यक्त्वा पुरुषाधमम् ..
इत्युक्त्वा प्रययौ वीरः शोकव्याकुलचेतनः .. 79 ..
text_mt: "Alas, brother, where have you gone, having abandoned me, the lowest of men?" / Having spoken thus, the hero departed, his mind agitated by sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
balakhānistu balavām̐llakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ ..
devasiṃhena sahito bāhlīkaṃ prati sogamat .. 3.3.23.80 ..
meaning:
बलखानिस्तु बलवाम्̐ल्लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः ..
देवसिंहेन सहितो बाह्लीकं प्रति सोगमत् .. 3.3.23.80 ..
text_mt: Mighty Balakhāni, however, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, / went towards Bāhlīka together with Devasiṃha.

sanskrit_iast:
ahorātrapramāṇena māsaikaḥ pathi vai gataḥ ..
jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇasya paṃcamyāṃ vāhlīkagrāmamāptavān ..
vyūhaḥ svakīyasainyānāṃ racito balakhāninā .. 81 ..
meaning:
अहोरात्रप्रमाणेन मासैकः पथि वै गतः ..
ज्येष्ठकृष्णस्य पंचम्यां वाह्लीकग्राममाप्तवान् ..
व्यूहः स्वकीयसैन्यानां रचितो बलखानिना .. 81 ..
text_mt: By the measure of day and night, one month passed on the road; / on the fifth [tithi] of the dark fortnight of Jyeṣṭha, he reached the village of Vāhlīka. / A battle array of his own troops was arranged by Balakhāni:

sanskrit_iast:
eko rathaḥ sthito yuddhe tatpaścātsaṃsthitā gajāḥ ..
pañcāśacca kramātteṣāṃ vājinaśca śataṃśatam .. 82 ..
meaning:
एको रथः स्थितो युद्धे तत्पश्चात्संस्थिता गजाः ..
पञ्चाशच्च क्रमात्तेषां वाजिनश्च शतंशतम् .. 82 ..
text_mt: One chariot stood in the battle, and behind it stood elephants; / fifty in order of them, and horses one hundred by one hundred.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ paścātkramājjñeyā pattayo daśa saṃsthitāḥ ..
ekā senā ca sā jñeyā tatpramāṇaṃ bravīmyaham .. 83 ..
meaning:
तेषां पश्चात्क्रमाज्ज्ञेया पत्तयो दश संस्थिताः ..
एका सेना च सा ज्ञेया तत्प्रमाणं ब्रवीम्यहम् .. 83 ..
text_mt: Behind them, ten foot-soldiers are to be known standing in order. / That is to be known as one division, and I shall tell its measure:

sanskrit_iast:
eko ratho gajāssarve śatārddhaṃ tu hayāstu ye ..
senāyāṃ pañcasāhasrāḥ śataghnyastu tathā smṛtāḥ.. 84 ..
meaning:
एको रथो गजास्सर्वे शतार्द्धं तु हयास्तु ये ..
सेनायां पञ्चसाहस्राः शतघ्न्यस्तु तथा स्मृताः.. 84 ..
text_mt: One chariot, all the elephants, half a hundred, and whatever horses there are— / five thousand in a division, and likewise śataghnīs are traditionally taught.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāyutāni senāyāṃ sarve padacarāḥ smṛtāḥ ..
evaṃvidhāśca tāḥ senā balakhāneśca ṣoḍaśa .. 85 ..
meaning:
पञ्चायुतानि सेनायां सर्वे पदचराः स्मृताः ..
एवंविधाश्च ताः सेना बलखानेश्च षोडश .. 85 ..
text_mt: Fifty thousand in a division are traditionally taught to be all foot-soldiers. / And of such kind were the sixteen divisions of Balakhāni.

sanskrit_iast:
gajāstu daśasāhasrā madamattāḥ pṛthagyayuḥ ..
yuddhe 'smingaṇitaṃ hyevaṃ śūrāḥ śatruprahāriṇaḥ .. 86 ..
meaning:
गजास्तु दशसाहस्रा मदमत्ताः पृथग्ययुः ..
युद्धे ऽस्मिन्गणितं ह्येवं शूराः शत्रुप्रहारिणः .. 86 ..
text_mt: Ten thousand elephants, intoxicated with rut, marched separately. / Thus was the calculation in this battle of heroes striking the enemy.

sanskrit_iast:
abhinandanabhūpasya mlecchāḥ paiśācadharmiṇaḥ ..
trilakṣāśca hayārūḍhā ekalakṣāḥ śatapripāḥ? .. .. 87 ..
meaning:
अभिनन्दनभूपस्य म्लेच्छाः पैशाचधर्मिणः ..
त्रिलक्षाश्च हयारूढा एकलक्षाः शतप्रिपाः? .. .. 87 ..
text_mt: Of King Abhinandana there were mlecchas of piśāca-like nature: / three hundred thousand mounted on horses, [and] one hundred thousand […];

sanskrit_iast:
ekalakṣaḥ padacarā bhuśuṇḍīparighāyudhāḥ ..
tomarānvayasaṃyuktāḥ kṣatriyāḥ prayutāni vai ..
gajasthāstatra saṃprāptā yatrāhlādamahā camūḥ .. 88 ..
meaning:
एकलक्षः पदचरा भुशुण्डीपरिघायुधाः ..
तोमरान्वयसंयुक्ताः क्षत्रियाः प्रयुतानि वै ..
गजस्थास्तत्र संप्राप्ता यत्राह्लादमहा चमूः .. 88 ..
text_mt: One hundred thousand foot-soldiers armed with bhuśuṇḍīs and iron clubs; / and kṣatriyas belonging to the Tomara lineage, indeed millions / mounted on elephants, arrived there where Āhlāda's great army was.

sanskrit_iast:
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ tumulaṃ romaharṣaṇam ..
madamattāśca te sarve nirbhayā raṇamāyayuḥ .. 89 ..
meaning:
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम् ..
मदमत्ताश्च ते सर्वे निर्भया रणमाययुः .. 89 ..
text_mt: And between the two there was a great battle, tumultuous and hair-raising; / and all of them, intoxicated with pride, entered the battle fearlessly.

sanskrit_iast:
saptāhorātramabhavadyuddhaṃ samaraśāli nām ..
bāhlīkasyārddhasenā ca kṣayaṃ nītā ca tairnṛpaiḥ .. 3.3.23.90 ..
meaning:
सप्ताहोरात्रमभवद्युद्धं समरशालि नाम् ..
बाह्लीकस्यार्द्धसेना च क्षयं नीता च तैर्नृपैः .. 3.3.23.90 ..
text_mt: A battle of those adorned with valor took place for seven days and nights; / and half the army of the Bāhlīka [king] was brought to destruction by those kings.

sanskrit_iast:
ekalakṣaṃ hatāḥ sarve balakhāneśca sainyapaiḥ ..
hāhābhūte śatrusainye bhayabhīte diśo gate ..
harṣitā balakhānyādyā jaya durge vaco'bruvan..91..
meaning:
एकलक्षं हताः सर्वे बलखानेश्च सैन्यपैः ..
हाहाभूते शत्रुसैन्ये भयभीते दिशो गते ..
हर्षिता बलखान्याद्या जय दुर्गे वचोऽब्रुवन्..91..
text_mt: One hundred thousand were all slain by Balakhāni's commanders. / When the enemy army cried out "Alas, alas!", terrified and fleeing in all directions, / Balakhāni and the others, delighted, spoke the words: "Victory to Durgā!"

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā sainyavināśaṃ ca rājñaḥ saptakumārakāḥ ..
kauravāṃśāśca te jagmuryatra jāto mahārathāḥ..92..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा सैन्यविनाशं च राज्ञः सप्तकुमारकाः ..
कौरवांशाश्च ते जग्मुर्यत्र जातो महारथाः..92..
text_mt: Seeing the destruction of the army, the seven sons of the king, / who were portions of the Kauravas, great chariot-warriors, went to where it had happened:

sanskrit_iast:
mahānandaśca nandaśca parānandopanandakau ..
sunandaśca surānandaḥ pranandaḥ kramatobhavāḥ .. 93 ..
meaning:
महानन्दश्च नन्दश्च परानन्दोपनन्दकौ ..
सुनन्दश्च सुरानन्दः प्रनन्दः क्रमतोभवाः .. 93 ..
text_mt: Mahānanda and Nanda, Parānanda and Upanandaka, / Sunanda, Surānanda, and Prananda, born in succession.

sanskrit_iast:
gajasthāste mahāvīrāstomarānvayasaṃbhavāḥ ..
senāṃ jaghnuḥ śaraistīkṣṇairbalakhānermahātmanaḥ .. 94 ..
meaning:
गजस्थास्ते महावीरास्तोमरान्वयसंभवाः ..
सेनां जघ्नुः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्बलखानेर्महात्मनः .. 94 ..
text_mt: Mounted on elephants, those great heroes born of the Tomara lineage / struck with sharp arrows the army of the great-souled Balakhāni.

sanskrit_iast:
bhayabhītāśca te sarve balakhānimupāyayu ..
dṛṣṭvā sainyaṃ parābhūtaṃ balakhānistadā ruṣā .. 95 ..
meaning:
भयभीताश्च ते सर्वे बलखानिमुपाययु ..
दृष्ट्वा सैन्यं पराभूतं बलखानिस्तदा रुषा .. 95 ..
text_mt: Terrified by fear, they all approached Balakhāni. / Seeing his army defeated, Balakhāni then, in wrath,

sanskrit_iast:
abhyadhāvata vegena kapotastho mahābalaḥ ..
naṃdaṃ prati tathā devaḥ parānaṃdaṃ ca tālanaḥ .. 96 ..
meaning:
अभ्यधावत वेगेन कपोतस्थो महाबलः ..
नंदं प्रति तथा देवः परानंदं च तालनः .. 96 ..
text_mt: rushed forward with speed, the mighty one mounted on Kapota; / Deva likewise against Nanda, and Tālana against Parānanda;

sanskrit_iast:
upanandaṃ sūryavarmā sunandaṃ prati tārakaḥ ..
netrasiṃhaḥ surānandaṃ pranandaṃ prati yādavaḥ .. 97 ..
meaning:
उपनन्दं सूर्यवर्मा सुनन्दं प्रति तारकः ..
नेत्रसिंहः सुरानन्दं प्रनन्दं प्रति यादवः .. 97 ..
text_mt: Sūryavarmā against Upananda; Tāraka against Sunanda; / Netrasiṃha against Surānanda; and the Yādava against Prananda.

sanskrit_iast:
yudhyamānāstu te sarve parasparaṃ vadhaiṣiṇaḥ ..
dinārddhamabhavadyuddhaṃ bahuvīrapraṇāśanam .. 98 ..
meaning:
युध्यमानास्तु ते सर्वे परस्परं वधैषिणः ..
दिनार्द्धमभवद्युद्धं बहुवीरप्रणाशनम् .. 98 ..
text_mt: All of them fighting, desiring to slay one another; / for half a day there was a battle that destroyed many heroes.

sanskrit_iast:
parājitāstu te putrā bāhlīkasya mahābalāḥ ..
tyaktvā yuddhaṃ yayurgehaṃ bhīrukā balakhāninā .. 99 ..
meaning:
पराजितास्तु ते पुत्रा बाह्लीकस्य महाबलाः ..
त्यक्त्वा युद्धं ययुर्गेहं भीरुका बलखानिना .. 99 ..
text_mt: Those mighty sons of Bāhlīka were defeated; / abandoning the battle, cowardly, they went home, [overcome] by Balakhāni.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā teṣāṃ balaṃ ghoramabhinandanabhūmipaḥ ..
kutukaṃ ca samāhūya nāṭyāṃ kesīraṇīṃ tathā ..
kathitaṃ kāraṇaṃ rājñā yathā jātaḥ parājayaḥ .. 3.3.23.100 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तेषां बलं घोरमभिनन्दनभूमिपः ..
कुतुकं च समाहूय नाट्यां केसीरणीं तथा ..
कथितं कारणं राज्ञा यथा जातः पराजयः .. 3.3.23.100 ..
text_mt: Seeing their terrible army, King Abhinandana / summoned Kutuka and the dancer Kesīraṇī; / the cause was recounted by the king, how the defeat occurred.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu kutukastamāśvāsya mahīpatim ..
sa dhyātvā śāṃbarīṃ māyāṃ mahādevena nirmitām ..
tatsainyaṃ mohayāmāsa śilābhūtamacetanam .. 101 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु कुतुकस्तमाश्वास्य महीपतिम् ..
स ध्यात्वा शांबरीं मायां महादेवेन निर्मिताम् ..
तत्सैन्यं मोहयामास शिलाभूतमचेतनम् .. 101 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, Kutuka, having comforted the king, / contemplated the illusory magic of Śambara fashioned by Mahādeva, / and bewitched that army, making it turn to stone and senseless.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā kesariṇī nāṭyā aṣṭau baddhvā mahābalān..
rājñaḥ pārśvamupāgamya dattvā tāngehamāyayau ..102..
meaning:
तदा केसरिणी नाट्या अष्टौ बद्ध्वा महाबलान्..
राज्ञः पार्श्वमुपागम्य दत्त्वा तान्गेहमाययौ ..102..
text_mt: Then the dancer Kesariṇī, having bound the eight mighty ones, / approached the presence of the king, handed them over, and went home.

sanskrit_iast:
bāhlīkaśca prasannātmā baddhvā tānnigaḍairdṛḍhaiḥ ..
luṃṭhitvā draviṇaṃ teṣāṃ kośamadhye samākṣipat .. 103 ..
meaning:
बाह्लीकश्च प्रसन्नात्मा बद्ध्वा तान्निगडैर्दृढैः ..
लुंठित्वा द्रविणं तेषां कोशमध्ये समाक्षिपत् .. 103 ..
text_mt: And the Bāhlīka [king], with delighted mind, having bound them with strong fetters, / plundered their wealth and threw it into his treasury.

sanskrit_iast:
devyāśca varadānena devasiṃho bhayāturaḥ ..
mahāvatīṃ samāgamya svarṇavatyai nyavedayat .. 104 ..
meaning:
देव्याश्च वरदानेन देवसिंहो भयातुरः ..
महावतीं समागम्य स्वर्णवत्यै न्यवेदयत् .. 104 ..
text_mt: And by the granting of a boon from the goddess, Devasiṃha, afflicted with fear, / arrived at Mahāvatī and informed Svarṇavatī.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā svarṇavatī devī sarvavidyāviśāradā ..
śyenīṃ mūrtiṃ samāsthāya yayau puṣpavatīṃ prati .. 105 ..
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा स्वर्णवती देवी सर्वविद्याविशारदा ..
श्येनीं मूर्तिं समास्थाय ययौ पुष्पवतीं प्रति .. 105 ..
text_mt: Having learned [this], queen Svarṇavatī, skilled in all sciences, / assumed the form of a female falcon and went towards Puṣpavatī.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tu daṃpatī tatra makaraṃdaṃ gṛhe sthitau ..
ruditvā kathayāmāsa yathā prāptaḥ parājayaḥ .. .. 106 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तु दंपती तत्र मकरंदं गृहे स्थितौ ..
रुदित्वा कथयामास यथा प्राप्तः पराजयः .. .. 106 ..
text_mt: Seeing the married couple staying there at home with Makaranda, / she wept and recounted how the defeat had occurred.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśastu tadā duḥkhī makarandaṃ vaco'bravīt ..
gaccha vīra mayā sārddhaṃ madgururbaṃdhanaṃ gataḥ .. 107 ..
meaning:
कृष्णांशस्तु तदा दुःखी मकरन्दं वचोऽब्रवीत् ..
गच्छ वीर मया सार्द्धं मद्गुरुर्बंधनं गतः .. 107 ..
text_mt: Then the portion of Kṛṣṇa, sorrowful, addressed words to Makaranda: / "Go, hero, along with me; my guru has fallen into captivity.

sanskrit_iast:
kulakṣaye mahatpāpaṃ suproktaṃ pūrva sūribhiḥ ..
nimagnānduḥkhajaladhau samuddhara mama priya .. 108 ..
meaning:
कुलक्षये महत्पापं सुप्रोक्तं पूर्व सूरिभिः ..
निमग्नान्दुःखजलधौ समुद्धर मम प्रिय .. 108 ..
text_mt: Great sin in the destruction of one's family has been well spoken of by ancient sages; / deliver those submerged in the ocean of sorrow, my dear friend!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu tacchayālaḥ śūrāyutasamanvitaḥ ..
saṃnyastaveṣamāsthāya khaḍgacarmasamanvitaḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśena hayārūḍho bāhlīkaṃ tvarito yayau .. 109 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु तच्छयालः शूरायुतसमन्वितः ..
संन्यस्तवेषमास्थाय खड्गचर्मसमन्वितः ..
कृष्णांशेन हयारूढो बाह्लीकं त्वरितो ययौ .. 109 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, his brother-in-law, accompanied by ten thousand heroes, / assuming the dress of an ascetic, equipped with sword and shield, / mounted on a horse along with the portion of Kṛṣṇa, went swiftly to Bāhlīka.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā svarṇavatī devī puṣpavatyā samanvitā ..
śyenīrūpamupāsthāya yayau yatra mahāraṇaḥ .. 3.3.23.110 ..
meaning:
तदा स्वर्णवती देवी पुष्पवत्या समन्विता ..
श्येनीरूपमुपास्थाय ययौ यत्र महारणः .. 3.3.23.110 ..
text_mt: Then queen Svarṇavatī, accompanied by Puṣpavatī, / assuming the form of female falcons, went to where the great battle was.

sanskrit_iast:
sa chittvā śāṃbarīṃ māyāṃ bodhayitvā svasainikān ..
rurodha nagarīṃ tasya bāhlīkasya mahātmanaḥ .. 111 ..
meaning:
स छित्त्वा शांबरीं मायां बोधयित्वा स्वसैनिकान् ..
रुरोध नगरीं तस्य बाह्लीकस्य महात्मनः .. 111 ..
text_mt: Having severed the illusory magic of Śambara and awakened her soldiers, / she besieged the city of that great-souled Bāhlīka [king].

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tāñchatrusaṃyuktānkutukastu tayā saha ..
punaśca śāṃbarīṃ māyāṃ preṣayāmāsa tānprati .. 112 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा ताञ्छत्रुसंयुक्तान्कुतुकस्तु तया सह ..
पुनश्च शांबरीं मायां प्रेषयामास तान्प्रति .. 112 ..
text_mt: Seeing them joined with the enemies, Kutuka together with her / once again sent forth the illusory magic of Śambara against them.

sanskrit_iast:
chittvā sā sakalāṃ māyāṃ baddhvā tau daityasannibhau ..
nagaraṃ dāhayāmāsa tasya bhūpasya māyayā .. 113 ..
meaning:
छित्त्वा सा सकलां मायां बद्ध्वा तौ दैत्यसन्निभौ ..
नगरं दाहयामास तस्य भूपस्य मायया .. 113 ..
text_mt: Having dispelled all illusion and bound those two who resembled Daityas, / she burned the king's city by her illusion.

sanskrit_iast:
na dāho dāhamāpanno na bhasmī bhasmavānkhalu ..
svarṇavatyā kṛtaṃ citraṃ svayaṃ devyā ca māyayā .. .. 114 ..
meaning:
न दाहो दाहमापन्नो न भस्मी भस्मवान्खलु ..
स्वर्णवत्या कृतं चित्रं स्वयं देव्या च मायया .. .. 114 ..
text_mt: There was no burning that underwent destruction, nor ash that truly remained as ash; / a wonder was wrought by Svarṇavatī herself, the goddess, through her illusion.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā puṣpavatī devī hatvā kesariṇī ruṣā ..
tanmāṃsaistarpayāmāsa gṛdhragomāyuvāyasān .. 115 ..
meaning:
तदा पुष्पवती देवी हत्वा केसरिणी रुषा ..
तन्मांसैस्तर्पयामास गृध्रगोमायुवायसान् .. 115 ..
text_mt: Then the goddess Puṣpavatī, having angrily slain Kesariṇī, / sated the vultures, jackals, and crows with her flesh.

sanskrit_iast:
kutukaṃ ca tathābhūtaṃ hatvā svarṇavatī svayam ..
kārāgāre lohamaye sthitānvīrānamocayat .. 116 ..
meaning:
कुतुकं च तथाभूतं हत्वा स्वर्णवती स्वयम् ..
कारागारे लोहमये स्थितान्वीरानमोचयत् .. 116 ..
text_mt: And having herself slain Kutuka, who had become likewise, / Svarṇavatī released the heroes who were held in the iron prison.

sanskrit_iast:
punarāgamya sā devī tayā sārddhaṃ śubhānanā ..
makarandaḥ sthito yatra kṛṣṇāṃśena samanvitaḥ .. 117 ..
meaning:
पुनरागम्य सा देवी तया सार्द्धं शुभानना ..
मकरन्दः स्थितो यत्र कृष्णांशेन समन्वितः .. 117 ..
text_mt: Returning again along with her, that fair-faced goddess / went to where Makaranda stayed, accompanied by Kṛṣṇāṃśa.

sanskrit_iast:
te sarve vismitāścāsañjñātvā devyā vimohitāḥ ..
krodhavanto mahāvīrā yuddhāya samupāyayuḥ .. 118 ..
meaning:
ते सर्वे विस्मिताश्चासञ्ज्ञात्वा देव्या विमोहिताः ..
क्रोधवन्तो महावीरा युद्धाय समुपाययुः .. 118 ..
text_mt: They were all astonished, and realizing they had been deluded by the goddess, / those mighty heroes, full of wrath, advanced to battle.

sanskrit_iast:
punaścāsīttayoryuddhaṃ senayorubhayormṛdhe ..
balakhāniṃ mahānando nandaścāhlādamāyayau .. 119 ..
meaning:
पुनश्चासीत्तयोर्युद्धं सेनयोरुभयोर्मृधे ..
बलखानिं महानन्दो नन्दश्चाह्लादमाययौ .. 119 ..
text_mt: Again the fight took place between those two armies in combat; / Mahānanda went against Balkhān, and Nanda against Āhlāda.

sanskrit_iast:
parānaṃdastathā devaṃ tārakaṃ copanaṃdanaḥ ..
sunando netra siṃhaṃ ca surānaṃdaśca tālanam .. 3.3.23.120 ..
meaning:
परानंदस्तथा देवं तारकं चोपनंदनः ..
सुनन्दो नेत्र सिंहं च सुरानंदश्च तालनम् .. 3.3.23.120 ..
text_mt: Parānanda went against Deva, Upanandana against Tāraka, / Sunanda against Netrasiṃha, and Surānanda against Tālana.

sanskrit_iast:
pranando vīrasenaṃ ca brahmānandaṃ sa bhūpatiḥ ..
gajasthitāśca te sarve dhanuryuddhaparāyaṇāḥ ..
ahorātramabhūdyuddhaṃ teṣāṃ ca tumulaṃ kramāt .. 121 ..
meaning:
प्रनन्दो वीरसेनं च ब्रह्मानन्दं स भूपतिः ..
गजस्थिताश्च ते सर्वे धनुर्युद्धपरायणाः ..
अहोरात्रमभूद्युद्धं तेषां च तुमुलं क्रमात् .. 121 ..
text_mt: Prananda went against Vīrasena, and that king against Brahmānanda. / All of them, mounted on elephants and devoted to archery combat, / fought continuously day and night, their clash gradually turning into a tumult.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare rātrau citrarekhā samāgatā ..
svakīyānvyākulībhūtāṃstādṛśāṃśca vilokya vai .. 122 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रात्रौ चित्ररेखा समागता ..
स्वकीयान्व्याकुलीभूतांस्तादृशांश्च विलोक्य वै .. 122 ..
text_mt: Meanwhile, Citrarekhā arrived at night, / and seeing her own people in such a distressed state,

sanskrit_iast:
citraguptaṃ tadā dhyātvā citramāyāmacīkarat ..
tadā tadbāṃdhavāścāsanbahudhā cābhinaṃdanāḥ .. 123 ..
meaning:
चित्रगुप्तं तदा ध्यात्वा चित्रमायामचीकरत् ..
तदा तद्बांधवाश्चासन्बहुधा चाभिनंदनाः .. 123 ..
text_mt: she meditated upon Citragupta and manifested a wondrous illusion; / then her relatives rejoiced in many ways.

sanskrit_iast:
tān dṛṣṭvā vismitāḥ sarve bhayabhītāśca dudruvuḥ ..
tyaktvā yuddhamayīṃ bhūmiṃ śokavyākulacetanā .. 124 ..
meaning:
तान् दृष्ट्वा विस्मिताः सर्वे भयभीताश्च दुद्रुवुः ..
त्यक्त्वा युद्धमयीं भूमिं शोकव्याकुलचेतना .. 124 ..
text_mt: Seeing them, all were astonished, and stricken with fear, they fled, / abandoning the battlefield, their minds bewildered by grief.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcayojanamāgatya tato vāsamakārayan ..
saṃdhyākāle tamobhūte nirutsāhā mahābalāḥ .. 125..
meaning:
पंचयोजनमागत्य ततो वासमकारयन् ..
संध्याकाले तमोभूते निरुत्साहा महाबलाः .. 125..
text_mt: Having traveled five yojanas, they made camp there / at twilight as darkness fell, those mighty warriors bereft of zeal.

sanskrit_iast:
hā kṛṣṇāṃśa mahābāho śaraṇāgatavatsala ..
indulaste kumāro'yaṃ saṃhṛtaścitrarekhayā .. 126 ..
meaning:
हा कृष्णांश महाबाहो शरणागतवत्सल ..
इन्दुलस्ते कुमारोऽयं संहृतश्चित्ररेखया .. 126 ..
text_mt: "Alas, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, mighty-armed one, affectionate to those seeking refuge! / This youth, your Indula, has been seized by Citrarekhā!

sanskrit_iast:
tayā vimohitā vīrā vayaṃ te śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ..
ityuktvā rodanaṃ cakruḥ kva gato'si mahāmate ..127..
meaning:
तया विमोहिता वीरा वयं ते शरणं गताः ..
इत्युक्त्वा रोदनं चक्रुः क्व गतोऽसि महामते ..127..
text_mt: Deluded by her, we heroes have taken refuge with you!" / Saying this, they wept: "Where have you gone, O wise one?"

sanskrit_iast:
tadā kolāhalaścāsīdrudatāṃ balaśālinām ..
āhlādaṃ garhayitvā te mūrchitā bhuvi vihvalāḥ .. 128 ..
meaning:
तदा कोलाहलश्चासीद्रुदतां बलशालिनाम् ..
आह्लादं गर्हयित्वा ते मूर्छिता भुवि विह्वलाः .. 128 ..
text_mt: Then there was an uproar among those strong men who wept; / reproaching Āhlāda, they fell faint and distressed upon the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
āhlādastu'tathā śrutvā vajrapātāhataḥ svayam ..
unmādivattadā bhūtvā tāḍayāmāsa vakṣasi .. 129 ..
meaning:
आह्लादस्तुऽतथा श्रुत्वा वज्रपाताहतः स्वयम् ..
उन्मादिवत्तदा भूत्वा ताडयामास वक्षसि .. 129 ..
text_mt: Āhlāda, hearing that, felt struck as if by a thunderbolt; / becoming like a madman, he beat his chest.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare yogī kṛṣṇāṃśo bhagavatkalā ..
caṃdrodaye svayaṃ prāptaścāṣṭamyāṃ bhṛguvāsare .. 3.3.23.130 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे योगी कृष्णांशो भगवत्कला ..
चंद्रोदये स्वयं प्राप्तश्चाष्टम्यां भृगुवासरे .. 3.3.23.130 ..
text_mt: Meanwhile, the yogin Kṛṣṇāṃśa, a portion of the Lord, / arrived in person at moonrise, on the aṣṭamī, on a Friday.

sanskrit_iast:
śūraśca daśasāhasrairmakaraṃdena saṃyutaḥ ..
tatsenāṃ bodhayāmāsa pālitāṃ balakhā ninā .. 131 ..
meaning:
शूरश्च दशसाहस्रैर्मकरंदेन संयुतः ..
तत्सेनां बोधयामास पालितां बलखा निना .. 131 ..
text_mt: The heroic warrior, accompanied by ten thousand and joined with Makaranda, / rallied that army protected by Balkhān.

sanskrit_iast:
jitvā tānsarvabhūpālāngṛhītvā vipulaṃ dhanam ..
pañcaśabdasthitaṃ baṃdhuṃ pratyāgatya jagarja vai .. 132 ..
meaning:
जित्वा तान्सर्वभूपालान्गृहीत्वा विपुलं धनम् ..
पञ्चशब्दस्थितं बंधुं प्रत्यागत्य जगर्ज वै .. 132 ..
text_mt: Having defeated all those kings and seized immense wealth, / he returned to his kinsman, who stood with five musical instruments, and roared aloud.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya śabdena śeṣāṃśo bodhito balaśālinā ..
śakunaṃ śubhamālokya bhujāvutthāpya vīryavān ..
svāṃke niveśayāmāsa kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ yogirūpiṇam .. 133 ..
meaning:
तस्य शब्देन शेषांशो बोधितो बलशालिना ..
शकुनं शुभमालोक्य भुजावुत्थाप्य वीर्यवान् ..
स्वांके निवेशयामास कृष्णांशं योगिरूपिणम् .. 133 ..
text_mt: Awakened by his roar, that mighty hero, the portion of Śeṣa, / beholding an auspicious omen and raising his arms, the valiant one / took Kṛṣṇāṃśa, who had the form of a yogin, onto his lap.

sanskrit_iast:
snāpayitvā śrudhārābhiḥ kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ premavihvalaḥ ..
dattvā dvijātimukhyebhyo varṇayāmāsa kāraṇam .. 134 ..
meaning:
स्नापयित्वा श्रुधाराभिः कृष्णांशं प्रेमविह्वलः ..
दत्त्वा द्विजातिमुख्येभ्यो वर्णयामास कारणम् .. 134 ..
text_mt: Bathing Kṛṣṇāṃśa with streams of tears, overwhelmed with love, / he made gifts to the foremost of the twice-born and narrated the circumstance.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśo'pi prasannātmā svakīyāṃ sakalāṃ kathām..
varṇayitvā yathābhūtāṃ punarbāhlīkamāyayau ..135..
meaning:
कृष्णांशोऽपि प्रसन्नात्मा स्वकीयां सकलां कथाम्..
वर्णयित्वा यथाभूतां पुनर्बाह्लीकमाययौ ..135..
text_mt: Kṛṣṇāṃśa too, with a delighted heart, having related his entire story / just as it had occurred, went again to Bāhlīka.

sanskrit_iast:
citravidyāṃ svayaṃ kṛtvā pāṭhitāṃ citrarekhayā ..
baddhvābhinaṃdanaṃ bhūpaṃ sasutaṃ ca samaṃtriṇam ..
vivāhaṃ kārayāmāsa jayaṃtasya tayā saha .. 136 ..
meaning:
चित्रविद्यां स्वयं कृत्वा पाठितां चित्ररेखया ..
बद्ध्वाभिनंदनं भूपं ससुतं च समंत्रिणम् ..
विवाहं कारयामास जयंतस्य तया सह .. 136 ..
text_mt: Having himself performed the wondrous magic taught by Citrarekhā, / and having bound King Abhinandana along with his son and minister, / he arranged the marriage of Jayanta with her.

sanskrit_iast:
bāhlīkastu prasannātmā dattvā ca vipulaṃ dhanam ..
svasutāṃ citrarekhāṃ ca jayantāya mudā dadau ..137..
meaning:
बाह्लीकस्तु प्रसन्नात्मा दत्त्वा च विपुलं धनम् ..
स्वसुतां चित्ररेखां च जयन्ताय मुदा ददौ ..137..
text_mt: Bāhlīka, with a pleased mind, having given immense wealth, / joyfully bestowed his daughter Citrarekhā upon Jayanta.

sanskrit_iast:
śataṃ gajānhayāṃstatra sahasrāṇi dhanairyutān ..
śataṃ dāsāṃstathā dāsīrjayaṃtāya svaya dadau .. 138 ..
meaning:
शतं गजान्हयांस्तत्र सहस्राणि धनैर्युतान् ..
शतं दासांस्तथा दासीर्जयंताय स्वय ददौ .. 138 ..
text_mt: A hundred elephants, thousands of horses accompanied with riches, / and a hundred male and female slaves he gave personally to Jayanta.

sanskrit_iast:
prasthānaṃ kārayāmāsa balakhānermahātmanaḥ ..
śrāvaṇe māsi saṃprāptāste sarve ca mahāvatīm .. 139 ..
meaning:
प्रस्थानं कारयामास बलखानेर्महात्मनः ..
श्रावणे मासि संप्राप्तास्ते सर्वे च महावतीम् .. 139 ..
text_mt: He caused the departure of the high-souled Balkhān; / and in the month of Śrāvaṇa they all reached Mahāvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
svaṃsvaṃ gehaṃ yayussarve bhūpāścāhlādamānitāḥ ..
iti te kathitaṃ vipra caritraṃ kalināśa nam..
śṛṇvatāṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ kathayiṣyāmi vai punaḥ .. 3.3.23.140 ..
meaning:
स्वंस्वं गेहं ययुस्सर्वे भूपाश्चाह्लादमानिताः ..
इति ते कथितं विप्र चरित्रं कलिनाश नम्..
शृण्वतां सर्वपापघ्नं कथयिष्यामि वै पुनः .. 3.3.23.140 ..
text_mt: All the kings, honored by Āhlāda, went to their respective homes. / Thus has been recounted to you, O brāhmaṇa, the narrative that destroys the Kali age, / which destroys all sins for those who hear it; I shall narrate further.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
kṛṣṇāṃśe ca gṛhaṃ prāpte cendule ca vivāhite ..
mahīpatissadā duḥkhī dehalīṃ prati cāgamat.. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
कृष्णांशे च गृहं प्राप्ते चेन्दुले च विवाहिते ..
महीपतिस्सदा दुःखी देहलीं प्रति चागमत्.. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / When Kṛṣṇāṃśa had reached home and Indula was married, / Mahīpati, ever sorrowful, went toward Delhi.
title: adhyāyaḥ 24

sanskrit_iast:
vṛttāṃtaṃ ca nṛpasyāgre kathayitvā sa tārakaḥ ..
paraṃ vismayamāpannaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśacaritaṃ prati .. 2 ..
meaning:
वृत्तांतं च नृपस्याग्रे कथयित्वा स तारकः ..
परं विस्मयमापन्नः कृष्णांशचरितं प्रति .. 2 ..
text_mt: Having narrated the account before the king, that Tāraka / was filled with supreme astonishment regarding the deeds of Kṛṣṇāṃśa.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare maṃtrī caṃdrabhaṭṭa udāradhīḥ ..
bhūmirājaṃ vacaḥ prāha śṛṇu pārthivasattama..3..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे मंत्री चंद्रभट्ट उदारधीः ..
भूमिराजं वचः प्राह शृणु पार्थिवसत्तम..3..
text_mt: Meanwhile, the minister Candra Bhaṭṭa, of noble intellect, / addressed words to the king Bhūmirāja: "Hear, O best of earthly rulers!

sanskrit_iast:
mayā cārādhitā devī vaiṣṇavī viśvakāriṇī ..
trivarṣāṃte ca tuṣṭābhūdvaradā bhayahāriṇī..4..
meaning:
मया चाराधिता देवी वैष्णवी विश्वकारिणी ..
त्रिवर्षांते च तुष्टाभूद्वरदा भयहारिणी..4..
text_mt: I propitiated the Vaiṣṇava goddess, the creator of the universe; / at the end of three years she was pleased, bestowing boons and removing fear.

sanskrit_iast:
tayā dattaṃ śubhaṃ jñānaṃ kumatidhvaṃsakārakam..
tato'haṃ jñānavānbhūtvā kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ prati bhṛpate ..
caritraṃ varṇayāmāsa tasya kalmaṣanāśanam .. 5 ..
meaning:
तया दत्तं शुभं ज्ञानं कुमतिध्वंसकारकम्..
ततोऽहं ज्ञानवान्भूत्वा कृष्णांशं प्रति भृपते ..
चरित्रं वर्णयामास तस्य कल्मषनाशनम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: By her was given auspicious knowledge, which destroys wicked thoughts. / Thereupon, endowed with knowledge regarding Kṛṣṇāṃśa, O king, / I narrated his deeds which destroy sins."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sa ca śuddhātmā graṃthaṃ bhāṣāmayaṃ śubham ..
māhātmyaṃ devibhaktānāṃ śrāvayāmāsa vai sabhām ..6..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा स च शुद्धात्मा ग्रंथं भाषामयं शुभम् ..
माहात्म्यं देविभक्तानां श्रावयामास वै सभाम् ..6..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, that pure-souled one recited to the assembly / an auspicious work composed in the vernacular, the majesty of the goddess's devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā bhūmirājastu vismitaścābhavatkṣa ṇāt ..
mahīpatistadā prāha divyāśvabaladarpitaḥ. ..
udayo nāma balavānyasyaivaṃ varṇitā kathā ..7..
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा भूमिराजस्तु विस्मितश्चाभवत्क्ष णात् ..
महीपतिस्तदा प्राह दिव्याश्वबलदर्पितः. ..
उदयो नाम बलवान्यस्यैवं वर्णिता कथा ..7..
text_mt: Hearing that, Bhūmirāja was astonished in an instant. / Then Mahīpati, arrogant with the might of divine horses, said: / "There is a mighty man named Udaya, whose story has thus been narrated.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāro vājino divyā jalasthalakhagāśca te ..
śīghraṃ tāṃśca samāhṛtya svayaṃ bhūpa balī bhava .. 8 ..
meaning:
चत्वारो वाजिनो दिव्या जलस्थलखगाश्च ते ..
शीघ्रं तांश्च समाहृत्य स्वयं भूप बली भव .. 8 ..
text_mt: Four are his divine horses, moving on water, land, and through the sky. / Quickly fetch them, O king, and become mighty yourself."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā sa nṛpatiḥ śrutavākyaviśāradam ..
āhūya kuṃdanamalaṃ preṣayāmāsa satvaram .. 9 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा स नृपतिः श्रुतवाक्यविशारदम् ..
आहूय कुंदनमलं प्रेषयामास सत्वरम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Having heard this, that monarch summoned Kundanamala, / who was skilled in hearing and speaking, and dispatched him swiftly.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāvatīṃ samāgatya sa dūto bhūpatiṃ prati ..
uvāca vacanaṃ premṇā mahīrājasya bhūpateḥ .. 3.3.24.10 ..
meaning:
महावतीं समागत्य स दूतो भूपतिं प्रति ..
उवाच वचनं प्रेम्णा महीराजस्य भूपतेः .. 3.3.24.10 ..
text_mt: Having arrived at Mahāvatī, that messenger lovingly spoke / the words of the king, Bhūpati Mahīrāja, to the ruler:

sanskrit_iast:
vājinaste hi catvāro divyarūpāḥ śubha prabhāḥ ..
darśanātheṃ tava vadhūrvelā nāma mamātmajā .. 11 ..
meaning:
वाजिनस्ते हि चत्वारो दिव्यरूपाः शुभ प्रभाः ..
दर्शनाथें तव वधूर्वेला नाम ममात्मजा .. 11 ..
text_mt: "Your four horses are of divine form and auspicious splendor. / For the purpose of seeing them, your daughter-in-law Velā, who is my daughter,

sanskrit_iast:
tayāhūtānhayānbhūpa dehi me vismayaṃ tyaja ..
no cedvelāgninā sarve kṣayaṃ yāsyaṃti sainyapāḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
तयाहूतान्हयान्भूप देहि मे विस्मयं त्यज ..
नो चेद्वेलाग्निना सर्वे क्षयं यास्यंति सैन्यपाः .. 12 ..
text_mt: has summoned the horses; give them to me, O king, and cast off amazement! / Otherwise, through Velā's fire, all your army commanders will meet destruction!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ sa bhūpo bhayakātaraḥ ..
āhlādādīnsamāhūya vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ ..
hayānsvānsvānmudā dehi madīyaṃ vacanaṃ kuru .. ..13..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो घोरं स भूपो भयकातरः ..
आह्लादादीन्समाहूय वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः ..
हयान्स्वान्स्वान्मुदा देहि मदीयं वचनं कुरु .. ..13..
text_mt:
Hearing these dreadful words, the king, distressed with fear,
called Āhlāda and the others and spoke with humble mind:
“Give up your horses with joy; carry out my word.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā sa āhlādo dhyātvā sarvamayīṃ śivām ..
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ śṛṇu bhūpa śivapriya ..14..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा स आह्लादो ध्यात्वा सर्वमयीं शिवाम् ..
उवाच मधुरं वाक्यं शृणु भूप शिवप्रिय ..14..
text_mt:
Hearing this, Āhlāda, having meditated upon all-pervading Śivā,
spoke sweet words: “Listen, O king, dear to Śiva!

sanskrit_iast:
yatra naḥ saṃsthitāḥ prāṇāstatra te vā jinaḥ sthitāḥ ..
na dāsyāmo vayaṃ rājansatyaṃsatyaṃ na cānyathā .. 15 ..
meaning:
यत्र नः संस्थिताः प्राणास्तत्र ते वा जिनः स्थिताः ..
न दास्यामो वयं राजन्सत्यंसत्यं न चान्यथा .. 15 ..
text_mt:
Where our vital breaths reside, there those horses remain.
We will not give them, O king, in truth, in truth, and not otherwise.”

sanskrit_iast: iti śrutvā vacastasya rājā parimalo balī ..16..
meaning: इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य राजा परिमलो बली ..16..
text_mt: Hearing his words, the powerful King Parimala,

sanskrit_iast:
śapathaṃ kṛtavānghoraṃ śṛṇvatāṃ balaśālinām ..
bhojanaṃ brahmamāṃsasya pānīyaṃ go'sṛjopamam..17..
meaning:
शपथं कृतवान्घोरं शृण्वतां बलशालिनाम् ..
भोजनं ब्रह्ममांसस्य पानीयं गोऽसृजोपमम्..17..
text_mt:
made a dreadful oath within the hearing of those mighty ones:
“Eating the flesh of a brahmin, drinking like cow's blood,

sanskrit_iast:
śayyā svamātṛsadṛśī brahmahatyopamā sabhā ..
mama rāṣṭre ca yuṣmābhirvāsaḥ pāpamayo mahān ..18..
meaning:
शय्या स्वमातृसदृशी ब्रह्महत्योपमा सभा ..
मम राष्ट्रे च युष्माभिर्वासः पापमयो महान् ..18..
text_mt:
a bed resembling one's own mother, an assembly like the murder of a brahmin—
[such] dwelling in my kingdom would be for you, full of great sin.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu śapathaṃ devakī śokatatparā ..
cakāra rodanaṃ gāḍhaṃ sagehajanavigrahā..19..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु शपथं देवकी शोकतत्परा ..
चकार रोदनं गाढं सगेहजनविग्रहा..19..
text_mt:
Hearing this oath, Devakī, overcome with grief,
wept bitterly together with her household members.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcaviṃśābdake prāpte kṛṣṇāṃśe yogatatpare ..
bhādraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ tadgehāddharmatatparāḥ .. 3.3.24.20 ..
meaning:
पंचविंशाब्दके प्राप्ते कृष्णांशे योगतत्परे ..
भाद्रशुक्लचतुर्दश्यां तद्गेहाद्धर्मतत्पराः .. 3.3.24.20 ..
text_mt:
When the twenty-fifth year was reached by Kṛṣṇāṃśa, who was intent on yoga,
on the fourteenth lunar day of the bright fortnight of Bhādrapada, they, devoted to righteousness, from that house

sanskrit_iast:
niryayuḥ kānyakubjaṃ te jayacaṃdreṇa pālitam ..
svarṇavatyā puṣpavatyā sahitāścitrarekhayā ..21..
meaning:
निर्ययुः कान्यकुब्जं ते जयचंद्रेण पालितम् ..
स्वर्णवत्या पुष्पवत्या सहिताश्चित्ररेखया ..21..
text_mt:
departed for Kānyakubja, which was protected by Jayacandra,
accompanied by Svarṇavatī, Puṣpavatī, and Citrarekhā.

sanskrit_iast:
indulaḥ prayayau śīghramayutāśvabalaissaha ..
karālaṃ hayamāruhya paṃcaśabdaṃ ca tatpitā ..
kṛṣṇāṃśo biṃdulārūḍho devakīmanusaṃyayau ..22..
meaning:
इन्दुलः प्रययौ शीघ्रमयुताश्वबलैस्सह ..
करालं हयमारुह्य पंचशब्दं च तत्पिता ..
कृष्णांशो बिंदुलारूढो देवकीमनुसंययौ ..22..
text_mt:
Indula set out swiftly together with a force of ten thousand horses.
Mounted upon the horse Karāla and with the five sounds [of royalty], his father,
and Kṛṣṇāṃśa, mounted on Bindulā, followed Devakī.

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktvā te bhūpatergrāmaṃ sarvasaṃpatsamanvitam ..
pathi tryahamuṣitvā te jayacaṃdramupāyayuḥ ..23..
meaning:
त्यक्त्वा ते भूपतेर्ग्रामं सर्वसंपत्समन्वितम् ..
पथि त्र्यहमुषित्वा ते जयचंद्रमुपाययुः ..23..
text_mt:
Leaving that king's village endowed with all wealth,
having stayed three days on the road, they approached Jayacandra.

sanskrit_iast:
natvā taṃ bhūpatiṃ premṇā gaditvā sarvakāraṇam ..
uṣitvā śītalāsthāne pūjayāmāsurambikām..24..
meaning:
नत्वा तं भूपतिं प्रेम्णा गदित्वा सर्वकारणम् ..
उषित्वा शीतलास्थाने पूजयामासुरम्बिकाम्..24..
text_mt:
Bowing to that king with love and explaining the whole matter,
having stayed in the temple of Śītalā, they worshipped Ambikā.

sanskrit_iast:
jayacaṃdrastu bhūpālo devasiṃhena varṇitaḥ..
tebhyaśca na dadau vṛttiṃ bhūmā parimalājñayā..25..
meaning:
जयचंद्रस्तु भूपालो देवसिंहेन वर्णितः..
तेभ्यश्च न ददौ वृत्तिं भूमा परिमलाज्ञया..25..
text_mt:
King Jayacandra, however, informed by Devasiṃha,
did not grant them a livelihood or land, by the order of Parimala.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṃṭhito devasiṃhastu gatvā kṛṣṇāṃśamuttamam ..
uditvā kāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ sa śrutvā roṣamādadhau .. 26..
meaning:
कुंठितो देवसिंहस्तु गत्वा कृष्णांशमुत्तमम् ..
उदित्वा कारणं सर्वं स श्रुत्वा रोषमादधौ .. 26..
text_mt:
Dejected, Devasiṃha approached the noble Kṛṣṇāṃśa
and reported the whole matter. Hearing it, he became enraged.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaritaṃ biṃdulārūḍho hayapaṃcaśatāvṛtaḥ ..
luṃṭhayāmāsa nagaraṃ pālitaṃ lakṣaṇena tat .. 27 ..
meaning:
त्वरितं बिंदुलारूढो हयपंचशतावृतः ..
लुंठयामास नगरं पालितं लक्षणेन तत् .. 27 ..
text_mt:
Quickly mounted on Bindulā, surrounded by five hundred horses,
he plundered that city, which was protected by Lakṣaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā taṃ lakṣaṇo vīro hastinaḥ pṛṣṭhamāsthitaḥ ..
śareṇa tāḍayāmāsa kṛṣṇāṃśahṛdayaṃ dṛḍham ..28..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तं लक्षणो वीरो हस्तिनः पृष्ठमास्थितः ..
शरेण ताडयामास कृष्णांशहृदयं दृढम् ..28..
text_mt:
Seeing him, the heroic Lakṣaṇa, stationed on the back of an elephant,
struck Kṛṣṇāṃśa's chest forcefully with an arrow.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣphalatvaṃ gato bāṇo viṣṇumaṃtreṇa preritaḥ ..
vismitaḥ sa tu bhūpālo vāhanādbhūmimāgataḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
निष्फलत्वं गतो बाणो विष्णुमंत्रेण प्रेरितः ..
विस्मितः स तु भूपालो वाहनाद्भूमिमागतः .. 29 ..
text_mt:
The arrow, countered by the Viṣṇu mantra, became ineffective.
Astonished, that king descended from his mount to the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
natvā taccaraṇau divyau kuliśādibhiranvitau ..
tuṣṭāva daṃḍavadbhūtvā lakṣaṇo gadgadaṃ girā .. 3.3.24.30 ..
meaning:
नत्वा तच्चरणौ दिव्यौ कुलिशादिभिरन्वितौ ..
तुष्टाव दंडवद्भूत्वा लक्षणो गद्गदं गिरा .. 3.3.24.30 ..
text_mt:
Bowing to his divine feet marked with the thunderbolt and other signs,
falling like a staff, Lakṣaṇa praised him with a voice choked with emotion:

sanskrit_iast:
.. lakṣaṇa uvāca .. ..
vaiṣṇavaṃ viddhi māṃ svāminviṣṇupūjanatatparam ..
jāne'haṃ tvāṃ mahābāho kṛṣṇaśaktyavatārakam ..31..
meaning:
.. लक्षण उवाच .. ..
वैष्णवं विद्धि मां स्वामिन्विष्णुपूजनतत्परम् ..
जानेऽहं त्वां महाबाहो कृष्णशक्त्यवतारकम् ..31..
text_mt:
Lakṣaṇa said:
“Know me, O master, to be a Vaiṣṇava, devoted to the worship of Viṣṇu.
I recognize you, O mighty-armed one, as an avatar of the power of Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
tvadṛte ko hi me bāṇaṃ niṣphalaṃ kurute bhuvi ..
kṣamasva mama daurātmyaṃ nātha te māyayā kṛtam ..32..
meaning:
त्वदृते को हि मे बाणं निष्फलं कुरुते भुवि ..
क्षमस्व मम दौरात्म्यं नाथ ते मायया कृतम् ..32..
text_mt:
Apart from you, who on earth could render my arrow fruitless?
Forgive my wickedness, O Lord, which was brought about by your Māyā.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā tena sahito jayacandraṃ mahīpatim..
gatvā taṃ kathayāmāsa yathā prāptaḥ parājayam..33..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा तेन सहितो जयचन्द्रं महीपतिम्..
गत्वा तं कथयामास यथा प्राप्तः पराजयम्..33..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, together with him he went to King Jayacandra
and told him how he had suffered defeat.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpastayoḥ parīkṣārthaṃ yau tu chāyāvimohitau..
gajau kuvalayāpīḍau tyaktavācchītalāsthale..34..
meaning:
नृपस्तयोः परीक्षार्थं यौ तु छायाविमोहितौ..
गजौ कुवलयापीडौ त्यक्तवाच्छीतलास्थले..34..
text_mt:
To test the two of them, the king released two elephants, Kuvalayāpīḍas,
who were bewildered by their own shadows, into the courtyard of Śītalā.

sanskrit_iast:
tadāhlādodayau vīrau gṛhītvā tau svalīlayā ..
cakṛṣaturbalātpucche krośamātraṃ punaḥpunaḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
तदाह्लादोदयौ वीरौ गृहीत्वा तौ स्वलीलया ..
चकृषतुर्बलात्पुच्छे क्रोशमात्रं पुनःपुनः .. 35 ..
text_mt:
Then those two heroes, Āhlāda and Udaya, seizing them effortlessly,
dragged them repeatedly by the tail by force for a whole krośa.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtau kuvalayāpīḍau dṛṣṭvā rājā bhayāturaḥ ..
dadau rājagṛhaṃ grāmaṃ tayorarthe prasannadhīḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
मृतौ कुवलयापीडौ दृष्ट्वा राजा भयातुरः ..
ददौ राजगृहं ग्रामं तयोरर्थे प्रसन्नधीः .. 36 ..
text_mt:
Seeing the two Kuvalayāpīḍas dead, the king, stricken with fear,
with a pleased mind granted the village of Rājagṛha for the sake of the two.

sanskrit_iast:
iṣaśuddhe tu saṃprāpte lakṣaṇo nāma vai balī ..
nṛpājñayā yayau śīghraṃ taiśca digvijayaṃ prati .. 37 ..
meaning:
इषशुद्धे तु संप्राप्ते लक्षणो नाम वै बली ..
नृपाज्ञया ययौ शीघ्रं तैश्च दिग्विजयं प्रति .. 37 ..
text_mt:
When the bright fortnight of Āśvina arrived, the mighty Lakṣaṇa,
by order of the king, set out quickly with them on a world conquest.

sanskrit_iast:
saptalakṣabalaissārddhaṃ tālanādyaiśca saṃyutaḥ ..
vārāṇasīṃ purīṃ prāpya rurodha nagarīṃ tadā .. 38 ..
meaning:
सप्तलक्षबलैस्सार्द्धं तालनाद्यैश्च संयुतः ..
वाराणसीं पुरीं प्राप्य रुरोध नगरीं तदा .. 38 ..
text_mt:
Accompanied by a force of seven hundred thousand, equipped with cymbals, pipes, and other [instruments],
reaching the city of Vārāṇasī, he besieged the city at that time.

sanskrit_iast:
rudravarmā ca bhūpālo gauḍavaṃśayaśaskaraḥ ..
paṃcāyutaiḥ svasainyaiśca sārddhaṃ yuddhārthamāptavān .. 39 ..
meaning:
रुद्रवर्मा च भूपालो गौडवंशयशस्करः ..
पंचायुतैः स्वसैन्यैश्च सार्द्धं युद्धार्थमाप्तवान् .. 39 ..
text_mt:
King Rudravarmā, who brought glory to the Gauḍa dynasty,
approached for battle along with his own fifty thousand troops.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmamātreṇa taṃ jitvā ṣoḍaśābdasya vai karam ..
koṭimudrāmayaṃ prāpya jayacaṃdrāya cārpayat ..3.3.24.40 ..
meaning:
याममात्रेण तं जित्वा षोडशाब्दस्य वै करम् ..
कोटिमुद्रामयं प्राप्य जयचंद्राय चार्पयत् ..3.3.24.40 ..
text_mt:
Conquering him in just a single watch, obtaining the tribute of sixteen years
consisting of ten million coins, he offered it to Jayacandra.

sanskrit_iast:
māgadheśaṃ punarjitvā nāmnā vijayakāriṇam ..
viṃśatyabdakaraṃ prāpya svabhūpāya samarpayat .. 41 ..
meaning:
मागधेशं पुनर्जित्वा नाम्ना विजयकारिणम् ..
विंशत्यब्दकरं प्राप्य स्वभूपाय समर्पयत् .. 41 ..
text_mt:
Then, having conquered the lord of Magadha, named Vijayakārin,
obtaining the tribute of twenty years, he surrendered it to his king,

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcakoṭīśca vai mudrā rājatasya punaryayau ..
aṃga vaṃgadeśapatiṃ vīro lakṣaṇo vai yutaśca taiḥ..
lakṣasainyayutaṃ bhūpaṃ kālīvarmāṇamuttamam..
ahorātreṇa taṃ jitvā mahāyuddhena lakṣaṇaḥ.. 44.
meaning:
पंचकोटीश्च वै मुद्रा राजतस्य पुनर्ययौ ..
अंग वंगदेशपतिं वीरो लक्षणो वै युतश्च तैः..
लक्षसैन्ययुतं भूपं कालीवर्माणमुत्तमम्..
अहोरात्रेण तं जित्वा महायुद्धेन लक्षणः.. 44.
text_mt:
and fifty million silver coins. Next the heroic Lakṣaṇa, joined by them,
went against the lord of the Aṅga and Vaṅga countries,
the excellent King Kālīvarmā, who was accompanied by a hundred thousand troops;
conquering him in a day and a night in a great battle, Lakṣaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
viṃśatyabda karaṃ prāpya koṭiṃ svarṇamayaṃ tadā..
preṣayāmāsa bhūpāya jayacaṃdrāya vai mudā..45..
meaning:
विंशत्यब्द करं प्राप्य कोटिं स्वर्णमयं तदा..
प्रेषयामास भूपाय जयचंद्राय वै मुदा..45..
text_mt:
having received twenty years of tribute amounting to ten million gold [coins],
then sent it with joy to King Jayacandra.

sanskrit_iast:
uṣṭradeśaṃ yayau vīraḥ pālitaṃ tairmahābalaiḥ..
dhoyīkavistatranṛpo lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ.46..
meaning:
उष्ट्रदेशं ययौ वीरः पालितं तैर्महाबलैः..
धोयीकविस्तत्रनृपो लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः.46..
text_mt:
The hero went to the country of Uṣṭra, which was protected by those of great might.
King Dhoyīkavi was there, accompanied by a hundred thousand troops.

sanskrit_iast:
jagannāthājñayā prāptastaiśca sārddhaṃ raṇonmukhe..
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ tumulaṃ romaharṣaṇam..
ahorātrapramāṇena kṛṣṇāṃśena jito nṛpaḥ..47..
meaning:
जगन्नाथाज्ञया प्राप्तस्तैश्च सार्द्धं रणोन्मुखे..
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम्..
अहोरात्रप्रमाणेन कृष्णांशेन जितो नृपः..47..

sanskrit_iast:
viṃśatyabdakaraṃ sarvaṃ koṭisvarṇasamanvitam ..
saṃprāpya preṣayāmāsa kānyakubjādhipāya vai .. 48 ..
meaning:
विंशत्यब्दकरं सर्वं कोटिस्वर्णसमन्वितम् ..
संप्राप्य प्रेषयामास कान्यकुब्जाधिपाय वै .. 48 ..
text_mt:
Having obtained the entire twenty years' tribute along with ten million gold [coins],
he sent it to the sovereign of Kānyakubja.

sanskrit_iast:
puṃḍradeśaṃ yayau vīro lakṣaṇo balavattaraḥ ..
nṛpaṃ nāgapatiṃ nāma paṃcāyutabalairyutam ..
dinamātreṇa taṃ jitvā koṭimudrā gṛhītavān .. 49 ..
meaning:
पुंड्रदेशं ययौ वीरो लक्षणो बलवत्तरः ..
नृपं नागपतिं नाम पंचायुतबलैर्युतम् ..
दिनमात्रेण तं जित्वा कोटिमुद्रा गृहीतवान् .. 49 ..
text_mt:
The heroic Lakṣaṇa, exceedingly powerful, went to the Puṇḍra country.
Conquering the king named Nāgapati, who was accompanied by fifty thousand troops,
in merely a single day, he took ten million coins.

sanskrit_iast:
maheṃdragirimāgatya natvā taṃ bhārgavaṃ munim ..
nato nivṛtya te sarve netrapālapuraṃ yayuḥ .. 3.3.24.50 ..
meaning:
महेंद्रगिरिमागत्य नत्वा तं भार्गवं मुनिम् ..
नतो निवृत्य ते सर्वे नेत्रपालपुरं ययुः .. 3.3.24.50 ..
text_mt:
Coming to Mount Mahendra and bowing to that sage, the descendant of Bhṛgu,
having bowed and turned back, they all went to the city of Netrapāla.

sanskrit_iast:
yogasiṃhastadāgatya kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ prati bhārgava ..
koṭimudrā dadau tasmai saptarātrama vāsayat .. 51 ..
meaning:
योगसिंहस्तदागत्य कृष्णांशं प्रति भार्गव ..
कोटिमुद्रा ददौ तस्मै सप्तरात्रम वासयत् .. 51 ..
text_mt:
Then Yogasiṃha, having come to Kṛṣṇāṃśa, O descendant of Bhṛgu,
gave him ten million coins and hosted him for seven nights.

sanskrit_iast:
vīrasiṃhapuraṃ jagmuste vīrā madavattarāḥ ..
rurudhurnagarīṃ sarvāṃ himatuṃgopari sthitām ..
pālitāṃ gorakhākhyena yoginā bhaktakāra ṇāt .. 52 ..
meaning:
वीरसिंहपुरं जग्मुस्ते वीरा मदवत्तराः ..
रुरुधुर्नगरीं सर्वां हिमतुंगोपरि स्थिताम् ..
पालितां गोरखाख्येन योगिना भक्तकार णात् .. 52 ..

sanskrit_iast:
bhūpānujaḥ pravīraśca sainyāyutasamanvitaḥ ..
kṛtavāndāruṇaṃ yuddhaṃ lakṣaṇasyaiva senayā .. 53 ..
meaning:
भूपानुजः प्रवीरश्च सैन्यायुतसमन्वितः ..
कृतवान्दारुणं युद्धं लक्षणस्यैव सेनया .. 53 ..
text_mt:
The king's younger brother, Pravīra, accompanied by ten thousand troops,
waged a terrible battle with the army of Lakṣaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyahaṃ balavāñchūro hatvā śūrasahasra kam ..
sāyaṃkāle gṛhaṃ prāpya yoginaṃ tamapūjayat .. 54 ..
meaning:
प्रत्यहं बलवाञ्छूरो हत्वा शूरसहस्र कम् ..
सायंकाले गृहं प्राप्य योगिनं तमपूजयत् .. 54 ..
text_mt:
Every day that mighty warrior, slaying a thousand heroes,
returned to his house at eventide and worshipped that yogin.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjanātsa prasannātmā sainyamujjīvya bhūpateḥ ..
dattvā gajabalaṃ tebhyaḥ punaryogaṃ karoti vai .. 55 ..
meaning:
पूजनात्स प्रसन्नात्मा सैन्यमुज्जीव्य भूपतेः ..
दत्त्वा गजबलं तेभ्यः पुनर्योगं करोति वै .. 55 ..
text_mt:
Pleasured by the worship, reviving the king's army
and giving them the strength of elephants, he engaged again in yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
sārddhamāso gatastatra yuddhyatāṃ balaśālinām ..
tadā te tu nirutsāhā devasiṃhaṃ tamabruvavan .. 56 ..
meaning:
सार्द्धमासो गतस्तत्र युद्ध्यतां बलशालिनाम् ..
तदा ते तु निरुत्साहा देवसिंहं तमब्रुववन् .. 56 ..
text_mt:
A month and a half passed there as those powerful ones fought.
Then, dispirited, they spoke to Devasiṃha:

sanskrit_iast:
vijayo naḥ kathaṃ bhūpa brūhi nastattvamagrataḥ..
iti śrutvā sa hovāca śṛṇu kṛṣṇāṃśa me vacaḥ ..57..
meaning:
विजयो नः कथं भूप ब्रूहि नस्तत्त्वमग्रतः..
इति श्रुत्वा स होवाच शृणु कृष्णांश मे वचः ..57..
text_mt:
"How shall we gain victory, O king? Tell us the truth beforehand."
Having heard this, he said: "Listen to my words, O Kṛṣṇāṃśa:

sanskrit_iast:
yogināṃ gorakhaṃ nāma parājitya svanṛtyataḥ ..
punaryuddhaṃ kuru tvaṃ vai tato jaya mavāpsyasi .. 58 ..
meaning:
योगिनां गोरखं नाम पराजित्य स्वनृत्यतः ..
पुनर्युद्धं कुरु त्वं वै ततो जय मवाप्स्यसि .. 58 ..
text_mt:
Having defeated Gorakha, chief among yogins, by your own dancing,
fight the battle again indeed; from that you will obtain victory."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktāste hi kṛṣṇādyāḥ kṛtvā yogamayaṃ vapuḥ ..
sthāpayitvā raṇe senāṃ pālitāṃ lakṣaṇena vai .. 59 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तास्ते हि कृष्णाद्याः कृत्वा योगमयं वपुः ..
स्थापयित्वा रणे सेनां पालितां लक्षणेन वै .. 59 ..
text_mt:
Addressed thus, Kṛṣṇa and the others, having assumed forms endowed with yoga,
and having stationed their army in battle protected indeed by Lakṣaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
prātaḥ kāle yayuste vai maṃdiraṃ tasya yoginaḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśo nartakaścāsīdveṇuvādyaviśāradaḥ .. 3.3.24.60 ..
meaning:
प्रातः काले ययुस्ते वै मंदिरं तस्य योगिनः ..
कृष्णांशो नर्तकश्चासीद्वेणुवाद्यविशारदः .. 3.3.24.60 ..
text_mt:
went in the morning to the dwelling of that yogin.
Kṛṣṇāṃśa was the dancer, skilled in playing the flute;

sanskrit_iast:
devasiṃho mṛdaṃgāḍhyo vīṇādhārī ca tālanaḥ ..
kāṃsyadhārī tadāhlādo jagau gītāṃ sanātanīm .. 61 ..
meaning:
देवसिंहो मृदंगाढ्यो वीणाधारी च तालनः ..
कांस्यधारी तदाह्लादो जगौ गीतां सनातनीम् .. 61 ..
text_mt:
Devasiṃha was endowed with a mṛdaṅga drum, and Tālana held a vīṇā;
