holding cymbals, Āhlāda then sang eternal songs.

sanskrit_iast:
tadarthaṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā gorakhassarvayogavān ..
varaṃ vṛṇuta tānāha te tacchrutvā'bruvanvacaḥ .. 62 ..
meaning:
तदर्थं हृदये कृत्वा गोरखस्सर्वयोगवान् ..
वरं वृणुत तानाह ते तच्छ्रुत्वाऽब्रुवन्वचः .. 62 ..
text_mt:
Taking the meaning to heart, Gorakha, master of all yoga,
said to them: "Choose a boon." Having heard that, they spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
namasyāmo vayaṃ tubhyaṃ yadi deyo varastvayā ..
dehi saṃjīvinī vidyāmāhlādāya mahātmane ..63..
meaning:
नमस्यामो वयं तुभ्यं यदि देयो वरस्त्वया ..
देहि संजीविनी विद्यामाह्लादाय महात्मने ..63..
text_mt:
"We bow to you. If a boon is to be given by you,
give the Saṃjīvinī vidyā to the high-souled Āhlāda."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā hṛdi dhyātvā tānuvāca prasannadhīḥ ..
vidyā saṃjīvinī tubhyaṃ varṣamātraṃ bhaviṣyati ..
tatpaścānniṣkalībhūyāgamiṣyati madaṃtikam ..64..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा हृदि ध्यात्वा तानुवाच प्रसन्नधीः ..
विद्या संजीविनी तुभ्यं वर्षमात्रं भविष्यति ..
तत्पश्चान्निष्कलीभूयागमिष्यति मदंतिकम् ..64..
text_mt:
Having heard this, contemplating it in his heart, his mind pleased, he said to them:
"The Saṃjīvinī vidyā will belong to you for just one year.
After that, becoming inactive, it will return to my presence.

sanskrit_iast:
adyaprabhṛti bho vīra mayā tyaktamidaṃ jagat ..
yatra bhartṛhariḥ śiṣyastatra gatvā śaye hyaham.. 65 ..
meaning:
अद्यप्रभृति भो वीर मया त्यक्तमिदं जगत् ..
यत्र भर्तृहरिः शिष्यस्तत्र गत्वा शये ह्यहम्.. 65 ..
text_mt:
From today onward, O hero, this world has been abandoned by me.
Going to where my disciple Bhartṛhari is, I shall indeed rest."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvāntarhito yogī jagmuste raṇamūrddhani ..
jitvā pravīrasiṃhaṃ ca vīrasiṃhaṃ tathaiva ca .. 66 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्हितो योगी जग्मुस्ते रणमूर्द्धनि ..
जित्वा प्रवीरसिंहं च वीरसिंहं तथैव च .. 66 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, the yogin vanished, and they went to the forefront of the battle.
Having conquered Pravīrasiṃha and likewise Vīrasiṃha,

sanskrit_iast:
hatvā tasyāyutaṃ sainyaṃ luṇṭhayitvā ca tadgṛham ..
kṛtvā dāsamayaṃ bhūpaṃ lakṣaṇaḥ prayayau mudā .. 67 ..
meaning:
हत्वा तस्यायुतं सैन्यं लुण्ठयित्वा च तद्गृहम् ..
कृत्वा दासमयं भूपं लक्षणः प्रययौ मुदा .. 67 ..
text_mt:
having slain ten thousand of his troops and looted his house,
and having turned the king into a servant, Lakṣaṇa departed with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
kośalaṃ deśamāgatya jitvā tasya mahīpatim ..
sainyāyutaṃ sūryadharaṃ karayogyamacīkarat .. 68 ..
meaning:
कोशलं देशमागत्य जित्वा तस्य महीपतिम् ..
सैन्यायुतं सूर्यधरं करयोग्यमचीकरत् .. 68 ..
text_mt:
Having reached the country of Kośala and defeated its ruler,
he made Sūryadhara, who had ten thousand troops, subject to tribute.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśābdakaraṃ prāpya mudrākoṭyayutaṃ mudā ..
naimiṣāraṇyamāgamya tatroṣuḥ snānatatparāḥ .. 69 ..
meaning:
षोडशाब्दकरं प्राप्य मुद्राकोट्ययुतं मुदा ..
नैमिषारण्यमागम्य तत्रोषुः स्नानतत्पराः .. 69 ..
text_mt:
Having obtained sixteen years of tribute, ten million coins, with joy,
and having come to the Naimiṣa forest, they stayed there, intent on ritual bathing.

sanskrit_iast:
holikāyā dine ramye lakṣaṇo balavattaraḥ ..
dattvā dānāni viprebhyo mahotsavamakārayat .. 3.3.24.70 ..
meaning:
होलिकाया दिने रम्ये लक्षणो बलवत्तरः ..
दत्त्वा दानानि विप्रेभ्यो महोत्सवमकारयत् .. 3.3.24.70 ..
text_mt:
On the delightful day of Holikā, Lakṣaṇa, of exceedingly great strength,
having given gifts to the brahmins, held a great festival.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā vayaṃ ca munayaḥ samādhisthāśca bhūpatiḥ ..
yadā sa lakṣaṇaḥ prāpto naimiṣāraṇyamuttamam .. 71 ..
meaning:
तदा वयं च मुनयः समाधिस्थाश्च भूपतिः ..
यदा स लक्षणः प्राप्तो नैमिषारण्यमुत्तमम् .. 71 ..
text_mt:
Then we, the sages, and the king were absorbed in meditation,
when that Lakṣaṇa arrived at the excellent Naimiṣa forest.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā sarvāṇi tīrthāni saṃtarpya dvijadevatāḥ ..
kānyakubjapuraṃ jagmuścaitrakṛṣṇāṣṭamīdine .. 72 ..
meaning:
स्नात्वा सर्वाणि तीर्थानि संतर्प्य द्विजदेवताः ..
कान्यकुब्जपुरं जग्मुश्चैत्रकृष्णाष्टमीदिने .. 72 ..
text_mt:
Having bathed at all the sacred bathing places and gratified the twice-born and the gods,
they went to the city of Kānyakubja on the eighth lunar day of the dark fortnight of Caitra.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ vipra yathādigvijayobhavat ..
śṛṇu vipra kathāṃ ramyāṃ balakhāniryathā mṛtaḥ .. 73 ..
meaning:
इति ते कथितं विप्र यथादिग्विजयोभवत् ..
शृणु विप्र कथां रम्यां बलखानिर्यथा मृतः .. 73 ..
text_mt:
Thus it has been related to you, O brahmin, how the conquest of the quarters took place.
Listen, O brahmin, to the delightful story of how Balakhāni died.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgakṛṣṇasya saptamyāṃ bhūmirājo mahābalaḥ ..
mahīpateśca vākyena sāmaṃtaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ .. 74 ..
meaning:
मार्गकृष्णस्य सप्तम्यां भूमिराजो महाबलः ..
महीपतेश्च वाक्येन सामंतं प्राह निर्भयः .. 74 ..
text_mt:
On the seventh lunar day of the dark fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa, the mighty Bhūmirāja,
at the word of the monarch, spoke fearlessly to the feudatory lord:

sanskrit_iast:
mayā śrutaste tanayaḥ śāradāvaradarpitaḥ ..
raktabījatvamāpannastaṃ me dehi kṛpāṃ kuru .. 75 ..
meaning:
मया श्रुतस्ते तनयः शारदावरदर्पितः ..
रक्तबीजत्वमापन्नस्तं मे देहि कृपां कुरु .. 75 ..
text_mt:
"I have heard that your son is proud through the boon of Śāradā,
having attained the nature of Raktabīja; give him to me, show favor!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktassa tu sāmantastena rājñeva satkṛtaḥ .
cāmuṃḍaṃ nāma tanayaṃ samāhūyābravīdidam .. 76 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तस्स तु सामन्तस्तेन राज्ञेव सत्कृतः .
चामुंडं नाम तनयं समाहूयाब्रवीदिदम् .. 76 ..
text_mt:
Addressed thus, that feudatory lord, honoured by that king,
summoned his son named Cāmuṇḍa and spoke this:

sanskrit_iast:
putra tvaṃ nṛpateḥ kāryaṃ sadā kuru raṇapriya ..
iti śrutvā piturvākyaṃ sa vai rājānamabravīt .. 77 ..
meaning:
पुत्र त्वं नृपतेः कार्यं सदा कुरु रणप्रिय ..
इति श्रुत्वा पितुर्वाक्यं स वै राजानमब्रवीत् .. 77 ..
text_mt:
"O son, you who love battle, always perform the business of the king."
Having heard the words of his father, he indeed said to the king:

sanskrit_iast:
dehyājñāṃ bhūpate mahyaṃ śīghraṃ jayamavāpsyasi ..
iti śrutvā sa hovāca balakhānirmahābalaḥ .. 78 ..
meaning:
देह्याज्ञां भूपते मह्यं शीघ्रं जयमवाप्स्यसि ..
इति श्रुत्वा स होवाच बलखानिर्महाबलः .. 78 ..
text_mt:
"Give me the command, O king; you will quickly attain victory."
Having heard this, the mighty Balakhāni spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
macchirīṣavanaṃ chitvā gṛhīttvā rāṣṭramuttamam ..
susthito nirbhayo gehe bāhuśālī yateṃdriyaḥ ..79..
meaning:
मच्छिरीषवनं छित्वा गृहीत्त्वा राष्ट्रमुत्तमम् ..
सुस्थितो निर्भयो गेहे बाहुशाली यतेंद्रियः ..79..
text_mt:
"Having cut down my Śirīṣa forest and seized my excellent kingdom,
he stays comfortably and fearlessly in his house, mighty-armed and self-controlled.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi tvaṃ balakhāniṃ ca jitvā me hyarpayiṣyasi..
hatvā vā tasya sakalaṃ rāṣṭraṃ tvayi bhaviṣyati .. 3.3.24.80 ..
meaning:
यदि त्वं बलखानिं च जित्वा मे ह्यर्पयिष्यसि..
हत्वा वा तस्य सकलं राष्ट्रं त्वयि भविष्यति .. 3.3.24.80 ..
text_mt:
If you conquer Balakhāni and deliver him to me,
or kill him, his entire kingdom will belong to you."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā raktabījaṃ taṃ samāhūya svakaṃ balam ..
saptalakṣaṃ dadau tasmai sa tatprāpya mudā yayau .. .. 81 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा रक्तबीजं तं समाहूय स्वकं बलम् ..
सप्तलक्षं ददौ तस्मै स तत्प्राप्य मुदा ययौ .. .. 81 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus and summoned his own force, he gave seven hundred thousand [troops]
to that Raktabīja; having received that, he set out with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
uṣitvā tridinaṃ mārge śirīṣākhyamupāgataḥ ..
rurodha nagarīṃ sarvāṃ balakhānermahātmanaḥ.. 82 ..
meaning:
उषित्वा त्रिदिनं मार्गे शिरीषाख्यमुपागतः ..
रुरोध नगरीं सर्वां बलखानेर्महात्मनः.. 82 ..
text_mt:
Having stayed for three days on the road, he arrived at the city called Śirīṣa,
and besieged the entire city of the noble Balakhāni.

sanskrit_iast:
cāmuṃḍāgamanaṃ śrutvā balakhānirmahābalaḥ..
pūjayitvā mahamāyāṃ dattvā dānānyanekaśaḥ ..
lakṣasainyena sahitaḥ prayayau nagarādbahiḥ .. 83 ..
meaning:
चामुंडागमनं श्रुत्वा बलखानिर्महाबलः..
पूजयित्वा महमायां दत्त्वा दानान्यनेकशः ..
लक्षसैन्येन सहितः प्रययौ नगराद्बहिः .. 83 ..
text_mt:
Hearing of the arrival of Cāmuṇḍa, the mighty Balakhāni,
having worshipped Mahāmāyā and given many gifts,
set out from the city accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyānujo mahāvīrassukhakhānirbalaiḥ saha ..
hariṇīṃ tāṃ samāruhya śatrusainyamacikṣapat .. 84 ..
meaning:
तस्यानुजो महावीरस्सुखखानिर्बलैः सह ..
हरिणीं तां समारुह्य शत्रुसैन्यमचिक्षपत् .. 84 ..
text_mt:
His younger brother, the great hero Sukhakhāni, accompanied by forces,
having mounted that mare, drove back the enemy army.

sanskrit_iast:
balakhāniḥ kapotastho nāśayitvā riporbalam ..
lakṣasainyaṃ mudā yuktaścāmuṃḍaṃ prati cāgamat .. .. 85 ..
meaning:
बलखानिः कपोतस्थो नाशयित्वा रिपोर्बलम् ..
लक्षसैन्यं मुदा युक्तश्चामुंडं प्रति चागमत् .. .. 85 ..
text_mt:
Balakhāni, riding his pigeon, having destroyed the force of the enemy,
advanced toward Cāmuṇḍa with an army of one hundred thousand, filled with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ svasvasainyakṣayaṃkaram ..
ahorātrapramāṇena nihatāḥ kṣatriyā raṇe .. 86 ..
meaning:
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धं स्वस्वसैन्यक्षयंकरम् ..
अहोरात्रप्रमाणेन निहताः क्षत्रिया रणे .. 86 ..
text_mt:
A great battle took place between the two, causing the destruction of their respective armies;
for the duration of a day and night, kṣatriyas were slain in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
prātaḥkāle tu saṃprāpte kṛtvā snānādikāḥ kriyāḥ ..
jagmatustau raṇe vīrau dhanurbāṇaviśāradau .. 87 ..
meaning:
प्रातःकाले तु संप्राप्ते कृत्वा स्नानादिकाः क्रियाः ..
जग्मतुस्तौ रणे वीरौ धनुर्बाणविशारदौ .. 87 ..
text_mt:
When morning arrived, having performed their ablutions and other rites,
those two heroes, skilled with bow and arrow, entered the battle.

sanskrit_iast:
rathastho balakhāniśca cāmuṇḍo gajapṛṣṭhagaḥ ..
cakratustumulaṃ ghoraṃ naravismayakārakam .. 88 ..
meaning:
रथस्थो बलखानिश्च चामुण्डो गजपृष्ठगः ..
चक्रतुस्तुमुलं घोरं नरविस्मयकारकम् .. 88 ..
text_mt:
Balakhāni mounted on a chariot and Cāmuṇḍa on the back of an elephant
fought a tumultuous, terrible combat that caused wonder among men.

sanskrit_iast:
bāṇairbāṇāṃśca saṃchidya devībhaktau ca tau mudā ..
anyonyaṃ vāhane hatvā bhūtalatvamupāgatau ..
khaḍgacarmadharau vīrau yuyudhāte parasparam..89..
meaning:
बाणैर्बाणांश्च संछिद्य देवीभक्तौ च तौ मुदा ..
अन्योन्यं वाहने हत्वा भूतलत्वमुपागतौ ..
खड्गचर्मधरौ वीरौ युयुधाते परस्परम्..89..

sanskrit_iast:
yāvanto raktabījāṃgātsaṃjātā raktabiṃdavaḥ ..
tāvantaḥ puruṣā jātā raktabījaparākramāḥ .. 3.3.24.90 ..
meaning:
यावन्तो रक्तबीजांगात्संजाता रक्तबिंदवः ..
तावन्तः पुरुषा जाता रक्तबीजपराक्रमाः .. 3.3.24.90 ..
text_mt:
As many drops of blood as sprang from the body of Raktabīja,
so many men were born possessing the prowess of Raktabīja.

sanskrit_iast:
taiśca vīrairmadonmattairbalakhānissamaṃtataḥ ..
saṃruddho'bhūd bhṛguśreṣṭha śāradāṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau..91..
meaning:
तैश्च वीरैर्मदोन्मत्तैर्बलखानिस्समंततः ..
संरुद्धोऽभूद् भृगुश्रेष्ठ शारदां शरणं ययौ..91..
text_mt:
By those heroes maddened with battle, Balakhāni was besieged on all sides,
O best of the Bhṛgus; he went to Śāradā for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare vīraḥ sukhakhānistato'nujaḥ..
āgneyaṃ śaramādāya raktabījānadāhayat..92..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे वीरः सुखखानिस्ततोऽनुजः..
आग्नेयं शरमादाय रक्तबीजानदाहयत्..92..
text_mt:
In the meantime, his younger brother, the heroic Sukhakhāni,
took an arrow of fire and burned the Raktabījas.

sanskrit_iast:
purā tu sukhakhā niśca havyairdevaṃ ca pāvakam ..
paṃcābdānpūjayāmāsa tadā tuṣṭassvayaṃ prabhuḥ .. 93 ..
meaning:
पुरा तु सुखखा निश्च हव्यैर्देवं च पावकम् ..
पंचाब्दान्पूजयामास तदा तुष्टस्स्वयं प्रभुः .. 93 ..
text_mt:
Formerly, indeed, Sukhakhāni had worshipped the divine fire with oblations
for five years; then the Lord himself was pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
pāvakīyaṃ śaraṃ ramyaṃ śatrusaṃhārakārakam ..
dadau tasmai prasannātmā tenāsāvabhavajjayī .. 94 ..
meaning:
पावकीयं शरं रम्यं शत्रुसंहारकारकम् ..
ददौ तस्मै प्रसन्नात्मा तेनासावभवज्जयी .. 94 ..
text_mt:
With a pleased mind, he gave him a beautiful arrow of fire that slays enemies;
by means of that, he became victorious.

sanskrit_iast:
balakhānistu balavāndṛṣṭvā śatruvināśanam ..
parājitaṃ ca cāmuṃḍaṃ baddhvā gehamupāgatam .. 95..
meaning:
बलखानिस्तु बलवान्दृष्ट्वा शत्रुविनाशनम् ..
पराजितं च चामुंडं बद्ध्वा गेहमुपागतम् .. 95..
text_mt:
The mighty Balakhāni, having seen the destruction of the enemy,
and bound the defeated Cāmuṇḍa, returned home.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā nārīmayaṃ veṣaṃ sa bhīto brahmahatyayā ..
dolāmāropya balavānpreṣayāmāsa śatrave .. 96 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा नारीमयं वेषं स भीतो ब्रह्महत्यया ..
दोलामारोप्य बलवान्प्रेषयामास शत्रवे .. 96 ..
text_mt:
Having dressed him in woman's attire, the strong one, afraid of the sin of slaying a brahmin,
placed him in a palanquin and sent him back to the enemy.

sanskrit_iast:
hataśeṣaṃ paṃcalakṣaṃ sainyaṃ gatvā ca dehalīm ..
vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa yathā jāto mahāraṇaḥ .. 97 ..
meaning:
हतशेषं पंचलक्षं सैन्यं गत्वा च देहलीम् ..
वृत्तान्तं कथयामास यथा जातो महारणः .. 97 ..
text_mt:
The remainder of the army, five hundred thousand who were not slain, having gone to Delhi,
related the account of how the great battle took place.

sanskrit_iast:
nārīveṣaṃ ca cāmuṃḍaṃ sa dṛṣṭvā pṛthivīpatiḥ ..
krodhāviṣṭaśca balavānmahīpatimuvāca ha .. 98 ..
meaning:
नारीवेषं च चामुंडं स दृष्ट्वा पृथिवीपतिः ..
क्रोधाविष्टश्च बलवान्महीपतिमुवाच ह .. 98 ..
text_mt:
Having seen Cāmuṇḍa in woman's attire, the ruler of the earth,
seized with fury, the mighty one spoke to Mahīpati:

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ jayo me bhavitā sukhakhānau ca jīvite ..
śrutvā mahīpatiḥ prāha cchadmanā kāryamākuru .. 99 ..
meaning:
कथं जयो मे भविता सुखखानौ च जीविते ..
श्रुत्वा महीपतिः प्राह च्छद्मना कार्यमाकुरु .. 99 ..
text_mt:
"How will there be victory for me while Sukhakhāni lives?"
Having heard him, Mahīpati said: "Accomplish the deed by deceit."

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmī mātā tayorjñeyā śuddhā saiva pativratā ..
dūtībhiḥ kāraṇaṃ jñātvā punaryuddhaṃ kuruṣva bhoḥ .. 3.3.24.100 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मी माता तयोर्ज्ञेया शुद्धा सैव पतिव्रता ..
दूतीभिः कारणं ज्ञात्वा पुनर्युद्धं कुरुष्व भोः .. 3.3.24.100 ..
text_mt: "Their mother, Brāhmī, should be known as pure and devoted to her husband alone. / Having discovered the cause through female messengers, O sir, wage war once more!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā mahīrājo dūtīstāśchalakovidāḥ ..
āhūya preṣayāmāsa balakhānigṛhaṃ prati ..1 01..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा महीराजो दूतीस्ताश्छलकोविदाः ..
आहूय प्रेषयामास बलखानिगृहं प्रति ..1 01..
text_mt: Having heard this, Mahīrāja summoned those female messengers skilled in deceit / and sent them to the dwelling of Balakhāni.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇyastāstadā bhūtvā balakhānigṛhaṃ yayuḥ ..
sasutāṃ tāṃ praśasyāśu papracchurvinayānvitāḥ .. 102 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मण्यस्तास्तदा भूत्वा बलखानिगृहं ययुः ..
ससुतां तां प्रशस्याशु पप्रच्छुर्विनयान्विताः .. 102 ..
text_mt: Having then become Brahmin women, they went to the dwelling of Balakhāni. / Promptly praising that woman along with her sons, filled with modesty, they inquired:

sanskrit_iast:
tava putrau mahāvīrau diṣṭyā śatrukṣayaṃkarau ..
tayormṛtyuḥ kathaṃ bhūyājjīvatāṃ śaradāṃ śatam .. 103 ..
meaning:
तव पुत्रौ महावीरौ दिष्ट्या शत्रुक्षयंकरौ ..
तयोर्मृत्युः कथं भूयाज्जीवतां शरदां शतम् .. 103 ..
text_mt: "By good fortune, your two sons are great heroes who bring about the destruction of enemies. / How could death ever come to them? May they live for a hundred autumns!"

sanskrit_iast:
tadā brāhmī vacaḥ prāha pāvakīyaḥ śaraḥ śubhaḥ ..
sukhakhānerjīvakaro balakhāneḥ padāhvakaḥ .. 104 ..
meaning:
तदा ब्राह्मी वचः प्राह पावकीयः शरः शुभः ..
सुखखानेर्जीवकरो बलखानेः पदाह्वकः .. 104 ..
text_mt: Then Brāhmī spoke these words: "An auspicious arrow belonging to Pāvaka [Agni] / brings life to Sukhakhāni, and an arrow bearing the name of 'foot' [destroys] Balakhāni."

sanskrit_iast:
iti jñātvā tu tā dūtyaḥ prayayurdehalīṃ prati ..
kathayitvā nṛpasyāgre dhanaṃ prāpyaṃ gṛhaṃ yayuḥ ..105..
meaning:
इति ज्ञात्वा तु ता दूत्यः प्रययुर्देहलीं प्रति ..
कथयित्वा नृपस्याग्रे धनं प्राप्यं गृहं ययुः ..105..
text_mt: Having learned this, those female messengers set out toward Dehalī. / Having related it before the king and received wealth, they went home.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājastu tacchrutvā mahādevamumāpatim ..
pārthivaiḥ pūjanaṃ cakre sahasradivasānmudā ..106..
meaning:
महीराजस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा महादेवमुमापतिम् ..
पार्थिवैः पूजनं चक्रे सहस्रदिवसान्मुदा ..106..
text_mt: Having heard that, Mahīrāja joyfully performed worship of Mahādeva, the lord of Umā, / with earthen liṅgas for a thousand days.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca ..
ṣaḍviṃśābde ca kṛṣṇāṃśe yathā jātaṃ tathā śṛṇu ..
mune biṃdusaro nāma dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi sthitam ..1..
meaning:
सूत उवाच ..
षड्विंशाब्दे च कृष्णांशे यथा जातं तथा शृणु ..
मुने बिंदुसरो नाम दक्षिणस्यां दिशि स्थितम् ..1..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Hear, O sage, what happened in the twenty-sixth year in the portion of Kṛṣṇa: / There is [a lake] named Bindusaras situated in the southern direction.
title: adhyāyaḥ 25

sanskrit_iast:
tasya tīre'vasadgrāmo yojanāyāmasaṃyutaḥ ..
nāmnā biṃdugaḍho durgo varṇadharmapravartakaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
तस्य तीरेऽवसद्ग्रामो योजनायामसंयुतः ..
नाम्ना बिंदुगढो दुर्गो वर्णधर्मप्रवर्तकः .. 2 ..
text_mt: On its bank stood a village extending for a yojana, / a fortress named Bindugaḍha that maintained the duties of the social classes.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmingrāme'vasadbhūpo viṣvaksenānvayodbhavaḥ ..
śāradānandano nāma brahmadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ..3..
meaning:
तस्मिन्ग्रामेऽवसद्भूपो विष्वक्सेनान्वयोद्भवः ..
शारदानन्दनो नाम ब्रह्मध्यानपरायणः..3..
text_mt: In that village lived a king born in the lineage of Viṣvaksena, / named Śāradānandana, devoted to meditation on Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacaryaprabhāveṇa tadvīryaṃ śirasi sthitam ..
atassa kāmapālākhyaḥ prathito'bhūnmahītale..4..
meaning:
ब्रह्मचर्यप्रभावेण तद्वीर्यं शिरसि स्थितम् ..
अतस्स कामपालाख्यः प्रथितोऽभून्महीतले..4..
text_mt: Through the power of his celibacy, his semen remained in his head; / therefore he became renowned on the surface of the earth by the name Kāmapāla.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñaiḥ saṃpūjayāmāsa surajyeṣṭhaṃ prajāpatim..
yajñāṃśabhuktamātreṇa rājñī garbhamupādadhau..5..
meaning:
यज्ञैः संपूजयामास सुरज्येष्ठं प्रजापतिम्..
यज्ञांशभुक्तमात्रेण राज्ञी गर्भमुपादधौ..5..
text_mt: He worshipped Prajāpati, the eldest of the gods, with sacrifices; / merely by consuming the sacrificial share, the queen conceived.

sanskrit_iast:
daśamāsāntare jātā kanyā sarvaguṇālayā ..
padminī nāma vikhyātā sarvaśobhāsamanvitā.. 6 ..
meaning:
दशमासान्तरे जाता कन्या सर्वगुणालया ..
पद्मिनी नाम विख्याता सर्वशोभासमन्विता.. 6 ..
text_mt: At the end of ten months, a daughter was born, an abode of all virtues, / renowned by the name Padminī, endowed with all beauty.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśābdavayaḥ prāptau babhūva varavarṇinī ..
padmākaro bhūpasuto mahīrājapadānugaḥ ..7..
meaning:
द्वादशाब्दवयः प्राप्तौ बभूव वरवर्णिनी ..
पद्माकरो भूपसुतो महीराजपदानुगः ..7..
text_mt: When she reached twelve years of age, she became a fair-complexioned maiden. / Padmākara, the king’s son, was a follower of Mahīrāja.

sanskrit_iast:
piturājñānusāreṇa bhūpānāhūya satvaram ..
svayaṃ varaṃ bhaginyāśca kārayāmāsa vai mudā .. 8 ..
meaning:
पितुराज्ञानुसारेण भूपानाहूय सत्वरम् ..
स्वयं वरं भगिन्याश्च कारयामास वै मुदा .. 8 ..
text_mt: In accordance with his father's command, swiftly summoning the kings, / he joyfully arranged a svayaṃvara for his sister.

sanskrit_iast:
nānādeśyā yayurbhūpā mukhyaśūrasamanvitāḥ ..
sahāhlādaiścatuvīrairlakṣaṇaḥ piturājñayā .. 9 ..
meaning:
नानादेश्या ययुर्भूपा मुख्यशूरसमन्विताः ..
सहाह्लादैश्चतुवीरैर्लक्षणः पितुराज्ञया .. 9 ..
text_mt: Kings from various lands went, accompanied by their foremost heroes. / Together with the four heroes led by Āhlāda, Lakṣaṇa, by his father's command,

sanskrit_iast:
yayau biṃdugaḍhaṃ grāmaṃ sthito yatra mahotsavaḥ ..
mahīrājastu balavāndṛṣṭvā lakṣaṇamāgatam .. 3.3.25.10 ..
meaning:
ययौ बिंदुगढं ग्रामं स्थितो यत्र महोत्सवः ..
महीराजस्तु बलवान्दृष्ट्वा लक्षणमागतम् .. 3.3.25.10 ..
text_mt: went to the village of Bindugaḍha, where a great festival was underway. / But mighty Mahīrāja, seeing that Lakṣaṇa had arrived,

sanskrit_iast:
svasenāṃ sthāpayāmāsa rakṣārthe sarvabhūbhujām ..
etasminnaṃtare devī sakhībhiḥ saha padminī .. 11 ..
meaning:
स्वसेनां स्थापयामास रक्षार्थे सर्वभूभुजाम् ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे देवी सखीभिः सह पद्मिनी .. 11 ..
text_mt: stationed his own army for the protection of all the kings. / In the meantime, the lady Padminī, together with her female companions,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhūpānvilokyāśu lakṣaṇāṃtamupāyayau ..
śyāmāṃgaṃ ca yuvānaṃ ca sarvalakṣaṇa lakṣitam .. 12 ..
meaning:
सर्वभूपान्विलोक्याशु लक्षणांतमुपाययौ ..
श्यामांगं च युवानं च सर्वलक्षण लक्षितम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: quickly looking upon all the kings, approached the side of Lakṣaṇa— / dark-limbed and youthful, marked by every auspicious sign,

sanskrit_iast:
catvāriṃśattathā paṃcāśanmānābdavayovṛtam ..
vyūḍhoraskaṃ dṛḍhaskaṃdhaṃ nirjaraṃ rogavarjitam .. 13 ..
meaning:
चत्वारिंशत्तथा पंचाशन्मानाब्दवयोवृतम् ..
व्यूढोरस्कं दृढस्कंधं निर्जरं रोगवर्जितम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: surpassing men of forty and fifty years of age in stature, / broad-chested, firm-shouldered, ageless, and free from disease.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tamātmasadṛśamāhlādādyaiśca rakṣitam ..
jayamālāṃ dadau tasmai padminī lakṣaṇāya ca .. 14 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तमात्मसदृशमाह्लादाद्यैश्च रक्षितम् ..
जयमालां ददौ तस्मै पद्मिनी लक्षणाय च .. 14 ..
text_mt: Seeing him as suitable for herself and guarded by Āhlāda and the others, / Padminī placed the garland of victory upon that Lakṣaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā sa lakṣaṇo vīro gṛhītvā pāṇimuttamam ..
svarathaṃ ca samāruhya rājñāṃ madhye yayau mudā .. 15 ..
meaning:
तदा स लक्षणो वीरो गृहीत्वा पाणिमुत्तमम् ..
स्वरथं च समारुह्य राज्ञां मध्ये ययौ मुदा .. 15 ..
text_mt: Then that heroic Lakṣaṇa, taking her excellent hand, / mounted his own chariot and joyfully departed amidst the kings.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛdhvīrājastathā sarve bhūmipā balasaṃyutāḥ ..
rurudhuḥ sarvato vīraṃ lakṣaṇaṃ balavattaram .. 16 ..
meaning:
पृध्वीराजस्तथा सर्वे भूमिपा बलसंयुताः ..
रुरुधुः सर्वतो वीरं लक्षणं बलवत्तरम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: Pṛthvīrāja and all the kings, endowed with strength, / blockaded the immensely powerful hero Lakṣaṇa on all sides.

sanskrit_iast:
tālanaḥ siṃhinīsaṃstho gṛhītvā parighaṃ mudā ..
sainyāni yodhayāmāsa bhīmasenāṃśasaṃbhavaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
तालनः सिंहिनीसंस्थो गृहीत्वा परिघं मुदा ..
सैन्यानि योधयामास भीमसेनांशसंभवः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Tālana, mounted on a lioness and joyfully seizing an iron club, / fought the armies, born as an incarnation of a portion of Bhīmasena.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcaśabdagajārūḍhaścāhlādastomarāyudhaḥ ..
ripūnvidārayāmāsa balabhadrāṃśasaṃbhavaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
पंचशब्दगजारूढश्चाह्लादस्तोमरायुधः ..
रिपून्विदारयामास बलभद्रांशसंभवः .. 18 ..
text_mt: Mounted on the elephant Pañcaśabda and armed with a javelin, Āhlāda, / born as an incarnation of a portion of Balabhadra, tore apart the enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśo bindulārūḍho gṛhītvā khaḍgamuttamam ..
bhūpatīnbahudhā chittvā mahāvadhamakārayat .. 19 ..
meaning:
कृष्णांशो बिन्दुलारूढो गृहीत्वा खड्गमुत्तमम् ..
भूपतीन्बहुधा छित्त्वा महावधमकारयत् .. 19 ..
text_mt: The incarnation of a portion of Kṛṣṇa, mounted on Bindula and taking an excellent sword, / repeatedly struck down the kings and wrought a great slaughter.

sanskrit_iast:
devo manorathārūḍho bhairavaṃ bhallamādadhau ..
hatvā ca bahudhā sainyaṃ nanarda ca punaḥpunaḥ .. 3.3.25.20 ..
meaning:
देवो मनोरथारूढो भैरवं भल्लमादधौ ..
हत्वा च बहुधा सैन्यं ननर्द च पुनःपुनः .. 3.3.25.20 ..
text_mt: Deva, mounted on Manoratha, held a terrifying spear; / having slain the army in many ways, he roared again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇo dhanurādāya vaiṣṇavāstrāṇi vai punaḥ ..
saṃdhāya ca jaghānāśu mahīrājasya sainyapān .. 21 ..
meaning:
लक्षणो धनुरादाय वैष्णवास्त्राणि वै पुनः ..
संधाय च जघानाशु महीराजस्य सैन्यपान् .. 21 ..
text_mt: Lakṣaṇa, taking up his bow and fitting Vaiṣṇava missiles, / swiftly struck down the army commanders of Mahīrāja.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmamātramabhūyuddhaṃ teṣāṃ taiśca samanvitam ..
tyaktvā yuddhaṃ mahīrājaḥ sarvabhūpasamanvitaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
याममात्रमभूयुद्धं तेषां तैश्च समन्वितम् ..
त्यक्त्वा युद्धं महीराजः सर्वभूपसमन्वितः .. 22 ..
text_mt: The battle between them lasted only for a single watch of the day. / Abandoning the fight, Mahīrāja, accompanied by all the kings,

sanskrit_iast:
yayau sa dehalīgrāme śāradānaṃdanastadā ..
saṃsthāpya maṇḍapaśubhaṃ kṛtvā vaivāhikīḥ kriyāḥ ..
dadau kanyāṃ vidhānena dhanadhānyādisaṃvṛtām .. 23 ..
meaning:
ययौ स देहलीग्रामे शारदानंदनस्तदा ..
संस्थाप्य मण्डपशुभं कृत्वा वैवाहिकीः क्रियाः ..
ददौ कन्यां विधानेन धनधान्यादिसंवृताम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: went to the village of Dehalī. Then Śāradānandana, / having erected an auspicious pavilion and performed the marriage rites, / gave away his daughter according to rule, endowed with wealth, grain, and other gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare prāpto mahīpatiruvāca tam ..
padmākaraṃ bhūpasutaṃ lakṣasainyasamanvitam .. 24 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे प्राप्तो महीपतिरुवाच तम् ..
पद्माकरं भूपसुतं लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितम् .. 24 ..
text_mt: In the meantime, the king [Mahīrāja] arrived and spoke to that / prince Padmākara, who was accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand:

sanskrit_iast:
aho mitra mahāvīra kīdṛśī te matiḥ sthitā ..
viṣvaksenānvaye tvaṃ vai saṃjātaḥ kṣatriyottamaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
अहो मित्र महावीर कीदृशी ते मतिः स्थिता ..
विष्वक्सेनान्वये त्वं वै संजातः क्षत्रियोत्तमः .. 25 ..
text_mt: "O friend, great hero! What sort of intellect has settled in you? / You were indeed born in the lineage of Viṣvaksena, a foremost kṣatriya.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇo dharmarahito varṇasaṃkarasaṃyutaḥ ..
āhlādādyāśca te śūrā ābhīramātṛsaṃbhavāḥ ..
tairyutaśca nivāso vai saṃtyājyo dharmakovidaiḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
लक्षणो धर्मरहितो वर्णसंकरसंयुतः ..
आह्लादाद्याश्च ते शूरा आभीरमातृसंभवाः ..
तैर्युतश्च निवासो वै संत्याज्यो धर्मकोविदैः .. 26 ..
text_mt: Lakṣaṇa is devoid of dharma and sprung from a mixture of castes, / and those heroes led by Āhlāda are born of an Ābhīra mother; / cohabitation with them is certainly to be shunned by those skilled in dharma."

sanskrit_iast:
iti padmākaraḥ śrutvā sarvamāyāviśāradaḥ ..
sa kṛtvā śāmbarīṃ māyāṃ baddhvā tāneva durjayān ..
svagehe sthāpayāmāsa kārāgāre śilāmaye .. 27 ..
meaning:
इति पद्माकरः श्रुत्वा सर्वमायाविशारदः ..
स कृत्वा शाम्बरीं मायां बद्ध्वा तानेव दुर्जयान् ..
स्वगेहे स्थापयामास कारागारे शिलामये .. 27 ..
text_mt: Having heard this, Padmākara, an expert in all magical arts, / employing Śāmbarī magic and binding those very men who were hard to conquer, / kept them in his own residence in a prison made of stone.

sanskrit_iast:
devyāśca varadānena devasiṃhastadā niśi ..
tyaktvā māyāmohamayī kānyakubjamupāyayau .. 28 ..
meaning:
देव्याश्च वरदानेन देवसिंहस्तदा निशि ..
त्यक्त्वा मायामोहमयी कान्यकुब्जमुपाययौ .. 28 ..
text_mt: By the boons of the goddess, Devasiṃha on that night, / breaking free from the delusion created by magic, went to Kānyakubja.

sanskrit_iast:
iṃdulāgre ca tatsarve gaditvā tena saṃyutaḥ ..
prāpto biṃdugaḍhaṃ śīghraṃ divyamāyāviśāradaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
इंदुलाग्रे च तत्सर्वे गदित्वा तेन संयुतः ..
प्राप्तो बिंदुगढं शीघ्रं दिव्यमायाविशारदः .. 29 ..
text_mt: Having related all of that before Indula, he, accompanied by him / who was skilled in divine magic, quickly reached Bindugaḍha.

sanskrit_iast:
padmākarastu tacchutvā kṛtvā māyāṃ ca śāmbarīm ..
mohanāyodyatastatra yathā megho raviṃ divi .. 3.3.25.30 ..
meaning:
पद्माकरस्तु तच्छुत्वा कृत्वा मायां च शाम्बरीम् ..
मोहनायोद्यतस्तत्र यथा मेघो रविं दिवि .. 3.3.25.30 ..
text_mt: Hearing that, Padmākara, having produced his Śāmbarī magic, / stepped forward to delude them there, just as a cloud [obscures] the sun in the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
iṃdulaśca tadā cāpe saṃdhāya śaramuttamam ..
kāmāstreṇa tu tanmāyā bhasmībhūtābhavatkṣaṇāt .. 31 ..
meaning:
इंदुलश्च तदा चापे संधाय शरमुत्तमम् ..
कामास्त्रेण तु तन्माया भस्मीभूताभवत्क्षणात् .. 31 ..
text_mt: Then Indula, fitting an excellent arrow to his bow, / reduced that magic to ashes in an instant with a love-missile.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā te bodhitāḥ sarve kāmāstreṇa mahābalāḥ ..
bhittvā lohamayaṃ jālaṃ kapāṭaṃ ca tathā dṛḍham .. 32 ..
meaning:
तदा ते बोधिताः सर्वे कामास्त्रेण महाबलाः ..
भित्त्वा लोहमयं जालं कपाटं च तथा दृढम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: Then, awakened by the love-missile, all those mighty heroes, / breaking through the iron grating and the sturdy door,

sanskrit_iast:
bahirbhūtāḥ samājagmuḥ śatrusainyānyanāśayan ..
kṣatriyāḥ paṃcasāhasrā mṛtā yamapuraṃ yayuḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
बहिर्भूताः समाजग्मुः शत्रुसैन्यान्यनाशयन् ..
क्षत्रियाः पंचसाहस्रा मृता यमपुरं ययुः .. 33 ..
text_mt: came outside, destroying the enemy armies; / five thousand kṣatriyas died and went to the realm of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
śāradānaṃdano bhūpastatrāgatya vinamya tān ..
svasutāṃ ca dadau tasmai lakṣaṇāya mahātmane ..34..
meaning:
शारदानंदनो भूपस्तत्रागत्य विनम्य तान् ..
स्वसुतां च ददौ तस्मै लक्षणाय महात्मने ..34..
text_mt: King Śāradānandana, arriving there and bowing to them, / gave his daughter to that great-souled Lakṣaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvidhāni bhojyāni praśasyābharaṇāni ca ..
sarvebhyaśca dadau rājā sahasrebhyastadā mudā .. 35 ..
meaning:
नानाविधानि भोज्यानि प्रशस्याभरणानि च ..
सर्वेभ्यश्च ददौ राजा सहस्रेभ्यस्तदा मुदा .. 35 ..
text_mt: The king then joyfully gave various kinds of food / and praiseworthy ornaments to all the thousands [of people].

sanskrit_iast:
kumārikāṃ svakīyāṃ ca bahurodanatatparām..
sa matvā kāmapālo vai svagehāttaṃ nyavāsayat ..
āgato lakṣaṇo gehaṃ māghakṛṣṇāṣṭamīdine .. 36 ..
meaning:
कुमारिकां स्वकीयां च बहुरोदनतत्पराम्..
स मत्वा कामपालो वै स्वगेहात्तं न्यवासयत् ..
आगतो लक्षणो गेहं माघकृष्णाष्टमीदिने .. 36 ..
text_mt: And considering his maiden daughter, intent on much weeping, / Kāmapāla lodged him away from his house. / Lakṣaṇa came home on the eighth lunar day of the dark fortnight of Māgha.

sanskrit_iast:
jayacaṃdrastu taṃ dṛṣṭvā lakṣaṇaṃ premavihvalaḥ ..
śatagrāmāndadau tebhyastālanādibhya eva ca..37..
meaning:
जयचंद्रस्तु तं दृष्ट्वा लक्षणं प्रेमविह्वलः ..
शतग्रामान्ददौ तेभ्यस्तालनादिभ्य एव च..37..
text_mt: Seeing him, Jayacandra was overwhelmed with affection; / he gave a hundred villages to them, Tālanā and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā tato'nyadānāni govastrābharaṇāni ca ..
pradadau brāhmaṇebhyaśca sa cakāra mahotsavam ..38.. ..
meaning:
दत्त्वा ततोऽन्यदानानि गोवस्त्राभरणानि च ..
प्रददौ ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च स चकार महोत्सवम् ..38.. ..
text_mt: Having given then other gifts, cattle, garments, and ornaments, / he gave them to the Brahmins and held a great festival.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
mahīrājo varaṃ prāptaḥ śaṃkarātpārthivārcanāt ..
saṃyojya phālgune māsi senāṃ śatrubhayaṃkarām .. 39 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
महीराजो वरं प्राप्तः शंकरात्पार्थिवार्चनात् ..
संयोज्य फाल्गुने मासि सेनां शत्रुभयंकराम् .. 39 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Mahīrāja obtained a boon from Śaṅkara by worshipping an earthen liṅga. / Marshaling an army in the month of Phālguna that struck fear into his enemies,

sanskrit_iast:
saptalakṣaiśca sahitaḥ śirīṣākhyapuraṃ yayau ..
nṛpājñayā ca cāṃmuḍo rurodha nagaraṃ punaḥ .. 3.3.25.40 ..
meaning:
सप्तलक्षैश्च सहितः शिरीषाख्यपुरं ययौ ..
नृपाज्ञया च चांमुडो रुरोध नगरं पुनः .. 3.3.25.40 ..
text_mt: accompanied by seven hundred thousand, he went to the city named Śirīṣa. / And at the king's command, Cāmuṇḍa again besieged the city.

sanskrit_iast:
sukhakhānistadā kruddho lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ ..
nagarādbahirāgatya mahāvadhamakārayat .. 41 ..
meaning:
सुखखानिस्तदा क्रुद्धो लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः ..
नगराद्बहिरागत्य महावधमकारयत् .. 41 ..
text_mt: Then Sukhakhāni, enraged, accompanied by an army of a hundred thousand, / came out of the city and caused a great slaughter.

sanskrit_iast:
pāvakāstreṇa balavānhatvā daśasahasrakam ..
mahīrājamupāgamya vacanaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
पावकास्त्रेण बलवान्हत्वा दशसहस्रकम् ..
महीराजमुपागम्य वचनं प्राह निर्भयः .. 42 ..
text_mt: The mighty one, having killed ten thousand with a fire-weapon, / approached Mahīrāja and spoke fearless words:

sanskrit_iast:
adya tvāṃ ca haniṣyāmi tvaṃ vā hantā raṇe mama ..
svavidyāṃ kuru bhūpa tvaṃ no cedyāsyasi vaiśasam .. 43 ..
meaning:
अद्य त्वां च हनिष्यामि त्वं वा हन्ता रणे मम ..
स्वविद्यां कुरु भूप त्वं नो चेद्यास्यसि वैशसम् .. 43 ..
text_mt: "Today I shall kill you, or you will be my slayer in battle. / Display your skill, O king, otherwise you will meet your destruction."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā mahīrājo raudrāstraṃ cāpa ādadhe ..
tadastrācca mahāvahniḥ prādurbhūto bhayaṃkaraḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा महीराजो रौद्रास्त्रं चाप आदधे ..
तदस्त्राच्च महावह्निः प्रादुर्भूतो भयंकरः .. 44 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, Mahīrāja set a Raudra weapon upon his bow. / From that weapon a terrible, great fire burst forth.

sanskrit_iast:
sukhakhānistadāgneyaṃ saṃdadhau tasya śāṃtaye ..
raudrāgninā ca saśaraḥ sukhakhānirlayaṃ gataḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
सुखखानिस्तदाग्नेयं संदधौ तस्य शांतये ..
रौद्राग्निना च सशरः सुखखानिर्लयं गतः .. 45 ..
text_mt: Then Sukhakhāni discharged a fire-missile to pacify it. / But by the Raudra fire, Sukhakhāni perished along with his arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
tadastraṃ śivatūṇīre gataṃ kāryaṃ vidhāya tat ..
balakhānistu tacchrutvā bhayabhītaḥ samāgataḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
तदस्त्रं शिवतूणीरे गतं कार्यं विधाय तत् ..
बलखानिस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा भयभीतः समागतः .. 46 ..
text_mt: Having accomplished its task, that weapon returned to Śiva's quiver. / Hearing of that, Balakhāni came up, terrified with fear.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrāturvairamupādāya jaghāna ca riporbalam ..
dhyātvā ca śāradāṃ devīṃ bhūmirājamupāgamat .. 47 ..
meaning:
भ्रातुर्वैरमुपादाय जघान च रिपोर्बलम् ..
ध्यात्वा च शारदां देवीं भूमिराजमुपागमत् .. 47 ..
text_mt: Taking up his brother's enmity, he struck down the enemy's host. / Meditating upon goddess Śāradā, he approached the earth's ruler [Mahīrāja].

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmirājastu taṃ dṛṣṭvā tadbalādhikyamohitaḥ ..
uvāca vacanaṃ premṇā balakhāne śṛṇuṣva bhoḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
भूमिराजस्तु तं दृष्ट्वा तद्बलाधिक्यमोहितः ..
उवाच वचनं प्रेम्णा बलखाने शृणुष्व भोः .. 48 ..
text_mt: Seeing him, the earth's ruler [Mahīrāja], astonished by the superiority of his power, / spoke words with affection: "Listen, O Balakhāni!

sanskrit_iast:
krośamātrāntare gartā dvādaśaiva mayā kṛtāḥ ..
rakṣitā dvādaśaśataiḥ śūrairyuddhaviśāradaiḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
क्रोशमात्रान्तरे गर्ता द्वादशैव मया कृताः ..
रक्षिता द्वादशशतैः शूरैर्युद्धविशारदैः .. 49 ..
text_mt: At an interval of just one krośa, twelve pits have been made by me, / guarded by twelve hundred heroes skilled in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
śūrāñjitvā samullaṃghya gartāndvādaśasammitān ..
mamārddhaṃ sakalaṃ rāṣṭraṃ gṛhāṇa balisattama .. 3.3.25.50 ..
meaning:
शूराञ्जित्वा समुल्लंघ्य गर्तान्द्वादशसम्मितान् ..
ममार्द्धं सकलं राष्ट्रं गृहाण बलिसत्तम .. 3.3.25.50 ..
text_mt: Having conquered the heroes and leaped over those twelve pits, / take the whole half of my kingdom, O best among the strong!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā priyaṃ vākyaṃ tadrājñā satyabhāṣitam ..
kapotaṃ hayamāruhya khaḍgahasto vanaṃ yayau .. 51 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा प्रियं वाक्यं तद्राज्ञा सत्यभाषितम् ..
कपोतं हयमारुह्य खड्गहस्तो वनं ययौ .. 51 ..
text_mt: Hearing these pleasing words spoken truly by that king, / he mounted his horse Kapota and went into the forest, sword in hand.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā gartānmahāvīro hatvā śūrāñchatañchatam..
yayau sa dvādaśāngarttānbāhuśālī jiteṃdriyaḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा गर्तान्महावीरो हत्वा शूराञ्छतञ्छतम्..
ययौ स द्वादशान्गर्त्तान्बाहुशाली जितेंद्रियः .. 52 ..
text_mt: Seeing the pits, that great hero, slaying heroes by hundreds, / that long-armed master of his senses passed those twelve pits.

sanskrit_iast:
cāmuṃḍastu tadāgatya śarāyutasamanvitaḥ ...
rurodha sarvato vīraṃ chadmakārī dvijādhamaḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
चामुंडस्तु तदागत्य शरायुतसमन्वितः ...
रुरोध सर्वतो वीरं छद्मकारी द्विजाधमः .. 53 ..
text_mt: Then Cāmuṇḍa arrived, equipped with ten thousand arrows; / that vile Brahmin, a worker of deceit, surrounded the hero on every side.

sanskrit_iast:
balakhāniśca mahatīṃ senāṃ tasya jaghāna ha ..
cāmuṃḍaṃ tamupāgamya nanarda ca punaḥpunaḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
बलखानिश्च महतीं सेनां तस्य जघान ह ..
चामुंडं तमुपागम्य ननर्द च पुनःपुनः .. 54 ..
text_mt: Balakhāni slaughtered his great army, / and approaching that Cāmuṇḍa, roared again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
trayodaśaṃ guptagartaṃ tṛṇairācchāditaṃ mṛdā ..
viṣadhautairmahābhallaissaṃruddhaṃ vivaraprabham .. 55 ..
meaning:
त्रयोदशं गुप्तगर्तं तृणैराच्छादितं मृदा ..
विषधौतैर्महाभल्लैस्संरुद्धं विवरप्रभम् .. 55 ..
text_mt: A thirteenth hidden pit, covered with grass and soil, / was bristling with large lances cleansed with poison, resembling a chasm.

sanskrit_iast:
patitaḥ sakapotaśca sa vīro daivamohitaḥ ..
aṃdhakāre mahāghoraṃ gaṃbhīraṃ krośamātrakam .. 56 ..
meaning:
पतितः सकपोतश्च स वीरो दैवमोहितः ..
अंधकारे महाघोरं गंभीरं क्रोशमात्रकम् .. 56 ..
text_mt: Bewildered by fate, that hero fell into it along with Kapota; / in the darkness it was exceedingly dreadful, deep, measuring a krośa.

sanskrit_iast:
vidīrṇastatra caraṇassa padmo vatsajasya vai ..
mahākaṣṭena tadvājī gartādāgatya vai bahiḥ ..
svapadaistāḍayāmāsa mahīrājasya tadbalam .. 57 ..
meaning:
विदीर्णस्तत्र चरणस्स पद्मो वत्सजस्य वै ..
महाकष्टेन तद्वाजी गर्तादागत्य वै बहिः ..
स्वपदैस्ताडयामास महीराजस्य तद्बलम् .. 57 ..
text_mt: There the foot, indeed the hoof of the foal was torn open. / With great difficulty that steed came out from the pit / and struck down Mahīrāja's host with its hooves.

sanskrit_iast:
cāmuṃḍastu tadāgatya balakhāneśca vai śiraḥ ..
chittvā jaghāna tatsainyaṃ hāhābhūtaṃ vineśvaram .. 58 ..
meaning:
चामुंडस्तु तदागत्य बलखानेश्च वै शिरः ..
छित्त्वा जघान तत्सैन्यं हाहाभूतं विनेश्वरम् .. 58 ..
text_mt: Then Cāmuṇḍa, coming forward, cut off Balakhāni's head / and slaughtered his army, which was crying 'Alas!' and left without a master.

sanskrit_iast:
gajamuktā ca tacchutvā citāmāropya vai patim ..
dāhayāmāsa cāṃgāni sā patyā saha vai satī .. 59 ..
meaning:
गजमुक्ता च तच्छुत्वा चितामारोप्य वै पतिम् ..
दाहयामास चांगानि सा पत्या सह वै सती .. 59 ..
text_mt: Hearing of that, Gajamuktā placed her husband on the funeral pyre; / that faithful wife burned her limbs together with her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā brahmā svavadhvā ca sārddhamāgatya tatra vai ..
sukhakhāniṃ ca saṃhūya dadāha tatkalevaram .. 3.3.25.60 ..
meaning:
तदा ब्रह्मा स्ववध्वा च सार्द्धमागत्य तत्र वै ..
सुखखानिं च संहूय ददाह तत्कलेवरम् .. 3.3.25.60 ..
text_mt: Then Brahmā, having arrived there together with his daughter-in-law, / called forth Sukhakhāni and burned his body.

sanskrit_iast:
śūnyabhūtaṃ ca nagaraṃ bhasma kṛtvā sa vai nṛpaḥ ..
jagāma dehalī śīghraṃ mahotsāhasamanvitaḥ .. 61 ..
meaning:
शून्यभूतं च नगरं भस्म कृत्वा स वै नृपः ..
जगाम देहली शीघ्रं महोत्साहसमन्वितः .. 61 ..
text_mt: Having reduced that deserted city to ashes, that king / went swiftly to Dehalī, filled with great enthusiasm.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
śrāvaṇe māsi saṃprāpte dehalīṃ ca mahīpatiḥ ..
nāgotsavāya prayayau sadaiva kalahapriyaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
श्रावणे मासि संप्राप्ते देहलीं च महीपतिः ..
नागोत्सवाय प्रययौ सदैव कलहप्रियः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / When the month of Śrāvaṇa arrived, the earth-ruler, / who was always fond of strife, went to Dehalī for the serpent festival.
title: adhyāyaḥ 26

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā nāgotsavaṃ tatra gītanṛtyasamanvitam ..
mahīrājaṃ namaskṛtya vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा नागोत्सवं तत्र गीतनृत्यसमन्वितम् ..
महीराजं नमस्कृत्य वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Seeing the serpent festival there, accompanied by singing and dancing, / he bowed to Mahīrāja and, humble in mind, spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
rājanmahāvatīgrāme kīrtisāgaramadhyage ..
vāmanotsavamatyaṃ taṃ yavavrīhisamanvitaḥ ..
paśya tvaṃ tatra gatvā ca mamaiva vacanaṃ kuru .. 3 ..
meaning:
राजन्महावतीग्रामे कीर्तिसागरमध्यगे ..
वामनोत्सवमत्यं तं यवव्रीहिसमन्वितः ..
पश्य त्वं तत्र गत्वा च ममैव वचनं कुरु .. 3 ..
text_mt: "O king, in the village of Mahāvatī, located in the middle of Kīrtisāgara, / is the great festival of Vāmana, furnished with barley and rice. / Go there, see it, and do what I say."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā mahīrājo dhuṃdhukāreṇa saṃyutaḥ ..
saptalakṣabalairyuktaścāmuṇḍena samanvitaḥ ..
prāptaḥ śirīṣavipine tatra vāsamakārayat .. 4 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा महीराजो धुंधुकारेण संयुतः ..
सप्तलक्षबलैर्युक्तश्चामुण्डेन समन्वितः ..
प्राप्तः शिरीषविपिने तत्र वासमकारयत् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, Mahīrāja, accompanied by Dhundhukāra, / endowed with a force of seven hundred thousand, and accompanied by Cāmuṇḍa, / reached the forest of Śirīṣa and took up residence there.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīpatistu nṛpatiṃ natvā vai candravaṃśinam ..
uvāca vacanaṃ duḥkhī dhūrto māyāviśāradaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
महीपतिस्तु नृपतिं नत्वा वै चन्द्रवंशिनम् ..
उवाच वचनं दुःखी धूर्तो मायाविशारदः .. 5 ..
text_mt: Then the earth-ruler [Mahīpati], bowing to the king of the lunar dynasty, / spoke these words sorrowfully, a rogue skilled in deception:

sanskrit_iast:
rājanprāpto mahīrājo yuddhārthī tvāmupasthitaḥ ..
candrāvalīṃ ca tanayāṃ brahmānaṃdaṃ tavātmajam ..
divyaliṃgaṃ sa saṃpūjya balātkārādgrahīṣyati .. 6 ..
meaning:
राजन्प्राप्तो महीराजो युद्धार्थी त्वामुपस्थितः ..
चन्द्रावलीं च तनयां ब्रह्मानंदं तवात्मजम् ..
दिव्यलिंगं स संपूज्य बलात्काराद्ग्रहीष्यति .. 6 ..
text_mt: "O king, Mahīrāja has arrived, desiring war, and approaches you. / Having worshipped the divine liṅga, he will violently seize / your daughter Candrāvalī and your son Brahmānanda.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttvaṃ svabalaiḥ sārddhaṃ mayā saha mahāmate ..
chadmanā taṃ parājitya nagare'sminsukhī bhava .. 7 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्त्वं स्वबलैः सार्द्धं मया सह महामते ..
छद्मना तं पराजित्य नगरेऽस्मिन्सुखी भव .. 7 ..
text_mt: Therefore, along with your forces and together with me, O great-minded one, / conquer him by deceit and live happily in this city."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā daiva vaśo rājā parimalo balī ..
caturlakṣabalaissārddhaṃ niśīthe ca samāgataḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा दैव वशो राजा परिमलो बली ..
चतुर्लक्षबलैस्सार्द्धं निशीथे च समागतः .. 8 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, the mighty King Parimala, subject to destiny, / came at midnight along with a force of four hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
śayitānkṣatriyāñchūrānhatvā paṃcasahasrakān ..
śataghnīṃ roṣaṇīṃ cakre bahuśūravināśinīm .. 9 ..
meaning:
शयितान्क्षत्रियाञ्छूरान्हत्वा पंचसहस्रकान् ..
शतघ्नीं रोषणीं चक्रे बहुशूरविनाशिनीम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Having slain five thousand sleeping kṣatriya heroes, / he made the cannon furious, destroying many heroes.

sanskrit_iast:
tadotthāya mahīrājaḥ kaṭimābadhya saṃbhramāt ..
vairiṇaṃ paramaṃ matvā mahadyuddhamacīkarat .. 3.3.26.10 ..
meaning:
तदोत्थाय महीराजः कटिमाबध्य संभ्रमात् ..
वैरिणं परमं मत्वा महद्युद्धमचीकरत् .. 3.3.26.10 ..
text_mt: Then Mahīrāja arose, quickly girded his loins, / and considering his enemy supreme, waged a great battle.

sanskrit_iast:
yuddhyaṃtyoḥ senayo statra malanā putragṛddhinī ..
śāradāmādarādgatvā pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
युद्ध्यंत्योः सेनयो स्तत्र मलना पुत्रगृद्धिनी ..
शारदामादराद्गत्वा पूजयामास भक्तितः .. 11 ..
text_mt: While the two armies were fighting there, Malanā, longing for her son, / went respectfully to Śāradā and worshipped her with devotion:

sanskrit_iast:
devidevi mahādevi sarvaduḥkhavināśini ..
hara me sakalāṃ bādhāṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ bodhayāśu ca .. 12 ..
meaning:
देविदेवि महादेवि सर्वदुःखविनाशिनि ..
हर मे सकलां बाधां कृष्णांशं बोधयाशु च .. 12 ..
text_mt: "O Goddess, O Goddess, O Great Goddess, destroyer of all sorrow! / Remove all my distress and quickly awaken the portion of Kṛṣṇa!"

sanskrit_iast:
japtvāyutamimaṃ maṃtraṃ hutvā tarpaṇamārjane ..
kṛtvā suṣvāpa tadveśmastadā tuṣṭā svayaṃ śivā .. 13 ..
meaning:
जप्त्वायुतमिमं मंत्रं हुत्वा तर्पणमार्जने ..
कृत्वा सुष्वाप तद्वेश्मस्तदा तुष्टा स्वयं शिवा .. 13 ..
text_mt: Having chanted this mantra ten thousand times, offering oblations, libation, and sprinkling, / she slept in that temple; then Śivā herself was pleased:

sanskrit_iast: malane mahatī bādhā kṣayaṃ yāsyati mā śucaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning: मलने महती बाधा क्षयं यास्यति मा शुचः .. 14 ..
text_mt: "O Malanā, your great distress will go to ruin; do not grieve!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā śāradā devī kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ prati cāgamat ..
putra te jananī bhūmirmahīrājena pīḍitā..
kṣayaṃ yāsyati śīghraṃ ca tasmāttvaṃ tāṃ samuddhara .. 15 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा शारदा देवी कृष्णांशं प्रति चागमत् ..
पुत्र ते जननी भूमिर्महीराजेन पीडिता..
क्षयं यास्यति शीघ्रं च तस्मात्त्वं तां समुद्धर .. 15 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the goddess Śāradā came before the portion of Kṛṣṇa [and said]: / "Son, your mother, the land, is tormented by Mahīrāja; / she will soon meet with destruction, therefore do you rescue her."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vaco devyāssa vīro vismayānvitaḥ ..
devakīṃ prati saṃprāptaḥ kathayāmāsa kāraṇam .. 16 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो देव्यास्स वीरो विस्मयान्वितः ..
देवकीं प्रति संप्राप्तः कथयामास कारणम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: Hearing these words of the goddess, that hero, filled with wonder, / went to Devakī and related the cause.

sanskrit_iast:
sā tu śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ svarṇavatyā samanvitā ..
ruroda bhṛśamudvignā vilapya bahudhā satī .. 17 ..
meaning:
सा तु श्रुत्वा वचो घोरं स्वर्णवत्या समन्विता ..
रुरोद भृशमुद्विग्ना विलप्य बहुधा सती .. 17 ..
text_mt: Having heard those terrible words, she, accompanied by Svarṇavatī, / wept, intensely distressed, and wailed in many ways, chaste woman [that she was].

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśastu tadā duḥkhī devasiṃhamuvāca ha ..
kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā vīra dehyājñāṃ dāruṇe bhaye .. 18 ..
meaning:
कृष्णांशस्तु तदा दुःखी देवसिंहमुवाच ह ..
किं कर्तव्यं मया वीर देह्याज्ञां दारुणे भये .. 18 ..
text_mt: Then the portion of Kṛṣṇa, sorrowful, spoke to Devasiṃha: / "What should I do, O hero? Give an order in [this] terrible peril."

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā tena sahito lakṣaṇena samanvitaḥ ..
yayau digvijayārthena vyājena ca mahāvatīm .. .. 19 ..
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा तेन सहितो लक्षणेन समन्वितः ..
ययौ दिग्विजयार्थेन व्याजेन च महावतीम् .. .. 19 ..
text_mt: Having heard that, accompanied by him and joined by Lakṣaṇa, / he set out for Mahāvatī under the pretext of a world conquest.

sanskrit_iast:
tālano bhīmasenāṃśaḥ senāpatirudāradhīḥ ..
saptalakṣabalaissārddhaṃ vināhlādena saṃyayau .. 3.3.26.20 ..
meaning:
तालनो भीमसेनांशः सेनापतिरुदारधीः ..
सप्तलक्षबलैस्सार्द्धं विनाह्लादेन संययौ .. 3.3.26.20 ..
text_mt: Tālana, the noble-minded portion of Bhīmasena and commander of the army, / set out together with a force of seven hundred thousand, without Āhlāda.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpakṣretramupāgamya yoginaste tadābhavan ..
senāṃ niveśayāmāsa vipine tatra dāruṇe .. 21 ..
meaning:
कल्पक्ष्रेत्रमुपागम्य योगिनस्ते तदाभवन् ..
सेनां निवेशयामास विपिने तत्र दारुणे .. 21 ..
text_mt: Approaching Kalpakṣetra, they then disguised themselves as yogins; / he quartered the army there in that dreadful forest.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśastālano devo lakṣaṇo balavattaraḥ ..
gṛhītvā lāsyavastūni yuddhabhūmimupāgaman ..22..
meaning:
कृष्णांशस्तालनो देवो लक्षणो बलवत्तरः ..
गृहीत्वा लास्यवस्तूनि युद्धभूमिमुपागमन् ..22..
text_mt: The portion of Kṛṣṇa, Tālana, Deva, and the very powerful Lakṣaṇa, / taking the instruments of dance, approached the battlefield.

sanskrit_iast:
saptāhaṃ ca tayoryuddhaṃ jātaṃ mṛtyuvivarddhanam ..
saptame'hani te vīrāssaṃprāptā raṇamūrddhani ..23..
meaning:
सप्ताहं च तयोर्युद्धं जातं मृत्युविवर्द्धनम् ..
सप्तमेऽहनि ते वीरास्संप्राप्ता रणमूर्द्धनि ..23..
text_mt: And for seven days a battle took place between the two, swelling the ranks of death; / on the seventh day those heroes arrived at the forefront of battle.

sanskrit_iast: tasmindine mahābhāga mahadyuddhamavartata .. 24 ..
meaning: तस्मिन्दिने महाभाग महद्युद्धमवर्तत .. 24 ..
text_mt: On that day, O highly fortunate one, a great battle took place.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā parājitaṃ sainyaṃ rājā parimalo balī ..
rathasthaścāpamādāya mahīrājamupāyayau .. 25 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा पराजितं सैन्यं राजा परिमलो बली ..
रथस्थश्चापमादाय महीराजमुपाययौ .. 25 ..
text_mt: Seeing the army defeated, the powerful king Parimala, / mounted on a chariot and taking his bow, advanced against Mahīrāja.

sanskrit_iast:
yādavaśca gajārūḍhastadā caṃdrāvalīpatiḥ ..
dhundhukāraṃ samāhūya dhanuryuddhamacīkarat .. 26 ..
meaning:
यादवश्च गजारूढस्तदा चंद्रावलीपतिः ..
धुन्धुकारं समाहूय धनुर्युद्धमचीकरत् .. 26 ..
text_mt: And the Yādava, mounted on an elephant, the husband of Candrāvalī, / challenged Dhundhukāra and waged an archery battle.

sanskrit_iast:
harināgaramāruhya brahmānaṃdo mahābala. ..
tārakaṃ śatrumāhūya dhanuryuddhaṃ cakāra ha .. 27 ..
meaning:
हरिनागरमारुह्य ब्रह्मानंदो महाबल. ..
तारकं शत्रुमाहूय धनुर्युद्धं चकार ह .. 27 ..
text_mt: Mounting Harināgara, the mighty Brahmānanda / challenged the enemy Tāraka and waged an archery battle.

sanskrit_iast:
mardanaṃ rājaputraṃ ca raṇajidga jasaṃsthitaḥ ..
svaśaraistāḍayāmāsa tatsutaṃ ca jaghāna ha .. 28 ..
meaning:
मर्दनं राजपुत्रं च रणजिद्ग जसंस्थितः ..
स्वशरैस्ताडयामास तत्सुतं च जघान ह .. 28 ..
text_mt: And Raṇajit, mounted on an elephant, struck the prince Mardana / with his arrows, and slew his son.

sanskrit_iast:
rūpaṇo vai saradanaṃ hayārūḍho jagāma ha ..
ābhīrītanayo jāto madano nāma vai balī ..
nṛharaṃ rājaputraṃ ca śaṃkhāṃśaśca jagāma ha .. 29 ..
meaning:
रूपणो वै सरदनं हयारूढो जगाम ह ..
आभीरीतनयो जातो मदनो नाम वै बली ..
नृहरं राजपुत्रं च शंखांशश्च जगाम ह .. 29 ..
text_mt: Rūpaṇa, mounted on a horse, went against Saradana; / and the mighty son born of the cowherd woman, named Madana, / and the portion of Śaṅkha, went against the prince Nṛhara.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣu saṃgrāmameteṣu cāmuṇḍo'yutasainyapaḥ ..
mahīpateśca vacanaṃ matvā nagaramāyayau .. 3.3.26.30 ..
meaning:
तेषु संग्राममेतेषु चामुण्डोऽयुतसैन्यपः ..
महीपतेश्च वचनं मत्वा नगरमाययौ .. 3.3.26.30 ..
text_mt: While they were engaged in these battles, Cāmuṇḍa, commander of ten thousand troops, / heeding the word of the king, went to the city.

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa nagarīṃ ramyāṃ caturvarṇasamanvitām ..
dhanadhānyayutāṃ vīro devībhaktiparāyaṇaḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
ददर्श नगरीं रम्यां चतुर्वर्णसमन्विताम् ..
धनधान्ययुतां वीरो देवीभक्तिपरायणः .. 31 ..
text_mt: The hero, devoted to the worship of the goddess, / saw the charming city endowed with the four classes and filled with wealth and grain.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīpatistu vai dhūrto durgadvāri samāgataḥ ..
cāmuṃḍena yutaḥ pāpī rājagehamupāyayau ..32..
meaning:
महीपतिस्तु वै धूर्तो दुर्गद्वारि समागतः ..
चामुंडेन युतः पापी राजगेहमुपाययौ ..32..
text_mt: The rogue Mahīpati arrived at the fortress gate; / accompanied by Cāmuṇḍa, the wicked one went to the royal palace.

sanskrit_iast:
malanā bhrātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā vacanaṃ prāha duḥkhitā ..
bhādrakṛṣṇāṣṭamī cādya yavavrīhi gṛhe sthitam ..33..
meaning:
मलना भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा वचनं प्राह दुःखिता ..
भाद्रकृष्णाष्टमी चाद्य यवव्रीहि गृहे स्थितम् ..33..
text_mt: Seeing her brother, Malanā, sorrowful, spoke these words: / "Today is Bhādrapada dark aṣṭamī, and barley and rice remain in the house;

sanskrit_iast:
na prāptaṃ jala saṃsthāne supuṇye kīrtisāgare ..
mahīrājo mahāpāpī vāmanotsavamāgataḥ ..34..
meaning:
न प्राप्तं जल संस्थाने सुपुण्ये कीर्तिसागरे ..
महीराजो महापापी वामनोत्सवमागतः ..34..
text_mt: they have not been taken to the water-place, the most meritorious Kīrtisāgara; / the wicked Mahīrāja has come for the Vāmana festival.

sanskrit_iast:
vināhlādaṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ mahadduḥkhamupāgatam ..
ityuktasya vihasyāha brāhmaṇo'yaṃ mahābalī ..
kānyakubjātsamāyātaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśena prayojitaḥ ..35..
meaning:
विनाह्लादं च कृष्णांशं महद्दुःखमुपागतम् ..
इत्युक्तस्य विहस्याह ब्राह्मणोऽयं महाबली ..
कान्यकुब्जात्समायातः कृष्णांशेन प्रयोजितः ..35..
text_mt: Deprived of Āhlāda and the portion of Kṛṣṇa, great sorrow has arrived." / To her who spoke thus, he laughed and said: "This very powerful brāhmaṇa, / sent by the portion of Kṛṣṇa, has come from Kānyakubja;

sanskrit_iast:
devīdattaśca nāmnā'yaṃ sa te kāryaṃ kariṣyati ..
śrutvā caṃdrāvalī devī sarvabhūṣaṇasaṃyutā ..36..
meaning:
देवीदत्तश्च नाम्नाऽयं स ते कार्यं करिष्यति ..
श्रुत्वा चंद्रावली देवी सर्वभूषणसंयुता ..36..
text_mt: and this one named Devīdatta will accomplish your task." / Hearing [this], the queen Candrāvalī, adorned with all ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
kāmāgnipīḍitaṃ vipraṃ cāmuṃḍaṃ ca dadarśa ha..
mātaraṃ prati cāgamya vacanaṃ prāha nirbharam..37..
meaning:
कामाग्निपीडितं विप्रं चामुंडं च ददर्श ह..
मातरं प्रति चागम्य वचनं प्राह निर्भरम्..37..
text_mt: saw the brāhmaṇa tormented by the fire of desire, as well as Cāmuṇḍa; / and approaching her mother, she spoke these words with deep anxiety:

sanskrit_iast:
dhūrto'yaṃ brāhmaṇo mātarniścayaṃ māṃ hariṣyati ..
ko'yaṃ vīro na jānāmi kathaṃ yāmi pativratā ..38..
meaning:
धूर्तोऽयं ब्राह्मणो मातर्निश्चयं मां हरिष्यति ..
कोऽयं वीरो न जानामि कथं यामि पतिव्रता ..38..
text_mt: "This brāhmaṇa is a rogue, O mother; he will surely carry me off; / I do not know who this warrior is; how can I, devoted to my husband, go?"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vacastasyā lajjitassa mahīpatiḥ..
cāmuṃḍena yutaḥ prāpto yatrābhūtsa mahāraṇaḥ..39..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्या लज्जितस्स महीपतिः..
चामुंडेन युतः प्राप्तो यत्राभूत्स महारणः..39..
text_mt: Hearing her words, that Mahīpati was ashamed; / accompanied by Cāmuṇḍa, he went where that great battle was [taking place].

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare te vai brahmādyāstaiḥ parājitāḥ..
tyaktvā yuddhaṃ gṛhaṃ prāptāstrilakṣabalasaṃyutāḥ ..3.3.26.40..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे ते वै ब्रह्माद्यास्तैः पराजिताः..
त्यक्त्वा युद्धं गृहं प्राप्तास्त्रिलक्षबलसंयुताः ..3.3.26.40..
text_mt: Meanwhile, those [warriors] led by Brahmā, defeated by them, / abandoning the battle, returned home with a force of three hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
kapāṭaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ kṛtvā mahāciṃtāmupāyayuḥ .
mahīrājastu balavānmahīpatyanumoditaḥ..41..
meaning:
कपाटं सुदृढं कृत्वा महाचिंतामुपाययुः .
महीराजस्तु बलवान्महीपत्यनुमोदितः..41..
text_mt: Barring the door firmly, they fell into great anxiety; / but the mighty Mahīrāja, approved by Mahīpati,

sanskrit_iast:
pramadāvanamāgatya ṣaṣṭilakṣabalānvitaḥ..
jugopa tatra balavānmānanotsavahetave ..
tālanādyāśca catvāraḥ śirīṣākhyapuraṃ yayuḥ..
sthalībhūtaṃ ca taṃ grāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā te vismayānvitāḥ..
prayayuste sukhabhraṣṭā dadṛśurhimadaṃ munim..43..
meaning:
प्रमदावनमागत्य षष्टिलक्षबलान्वितः..
जुगोप तत्र बलवान्माननोत्सवहेतवे ..
तालनाद्याश्च चत्वारः शिरीषाख्यपुरं ययुः..
स्थलीभूतं च तं ग्रामं दृष्ट्वा ते विस्मयान्विताः..
प्रययुस्ते सुखभ्रष्टा ददृशुर्हिमदं मुनिम्..43..
text_mt: came to the pleasure grove accompanied by a force of six million; / the powerful one guarded [it] there for the sake of the celebration; / and the four [heroes] led by Tālana went to the city named Śirīṣa; / seeing that town turned into a desolate field, they were filled with wonder; / stripped of their happiness, they went on and saw the sage Himada.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamyocuḥ śucāviṣṭā balakhā nirmune balī ..
kva gataḥ samaraślāghī sa ca kunāgarairyutaḥ ..44..
meaning:
प्रणम्योचुः शुचाविष्टा बलखा निर्मुने बली ..
क्व गतः समरश्लाघी स च कुनागरैर्युतः ..44..
text_mt: Bowing, filled with grief, they said: "O sage, where has the mighty Balakhāni gone, / he who took pride in battle and was accompanied by Kunāgaras?"

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvāha himado yogī mahīrājena nāśitaḥ ..
chadmanā balakhāniśca tasyeyaṃ sundarī citā ..45..
meaning:
श्रुत्वाह हिमदो योगी महीराजेन नाशितः ..
छद्मना बलखानिश्च तस्येयं सुन्दरी चिता ..45..
text_mt: Hearing this, the yogin Himada said: "Balakhāni was destroyed / through deceit by Mahīrāja, and this is his beautiful funeral pyre."

sanskrit_iast: iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ śokatatparaḥ ..46..
meaning: इति श्रुत्वा वचो घोरं कृष्णांशः शोकतत्परः ..46..
text_mt: Hearing these dreadful words, the portion of Kṛṣṇa was consumed by grief.

sanskrit_iast:
vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ tatra hā bandho dharmajāṃśaka ..
tvadṛte bhūtale vāso mamātīva bhayaṃkaraḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
विललाप भृशं तत्र हा बन्धो धर्मजांशक ..
त्वदृते भूतले वासो ममातीव भयंकरः .. 47 ..
text_mt: He wailed intensely there: "Alas, brother, portion of the son of Dharma! / Without you, dwelling on the earth is utterly terrifying to me.

sanskrit_iast: darśanaṃ dehi me kṣipraṃ no cetprāṇāṃstyajāmyaham .. 48 ..
meaning: दर्शनं देहि मे क्षिप्रं नो चेत्प्राणांस्त्यजाम्यहम् .. 48 ..
text_mt: Show yourself to me quickly; otherwise I shall abandon my life-breaths!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktaḥ sa tu tadbhrātā balakhāniḥ piśācagaḥ ..
sapatnīkassamāyāto rodanaṃ kṛtavānbahu ..
kathitvā sarvavṛttāntaṃ yathājātaṃ svavaiśasam .. 49 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तः स तु तद्भ्राता बलखानिः पिशाचगः ..
सपत्नीकस्समायातो रोदनं कृतवान्बहु ..
कथित्वा सर्ववृत्तान्तं यथाजातं स्ववैशसम् .. 49 ..
text_mt: Addressed thus, his brother Balakhāni, having joined the piśācas, / arrived together with his wife and wept abundantly; / and having related the entire account of how his ruin occurred,

sanskrit_iast:
divyaṃ vimānamāruhya gato nākaṃ manoramam ..
yudhiṣṭhire tasya kalā balakhānerlayaṃ gatā .. 3.3.26.50 ..
meaning:
दिव्यं विमानमारुह्य गतो नाकं मनोरमम् ..
युधिष्ठिरे तस्य कला बलखानेर्लयं गता .. 3.3.26.50 ..
text_mt: he mounted a celestial chariot and went to charming heaven; / that portion of his, Balakhāni's, merged into Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā duḥkhī sa kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ kṛtvā bhrātustilāṃjalim ..
mahāvatīṃ samāgatya rājagehamupāyayau .. 51 ..
meaning:
तदा दुःखी स कृष्णांशः कृत्वा भ्रातुस्तिलांजलिम् ..
महावतीं समागत्य राजगेहमुपाययौ .. 51 ..
text_mt: Then, sorrowful, that portion of Kṛṣṇa, having offered a handful of sesamum water for his brother, / arrived at Mahāvatī and went to the royal palace.

sanskrit_iast:
veṇuśabdena kṛṣṇāṃśo nanarta janamohanaḥ ..
vīṇāpravādyaṃ ca jagau tālano yogirūpadhṛka .. 52 ..
meaning:
वेणुशब्देन कृष्णांशो ननर्त जनमोहनः ..
वीणाप्रवाद्यं च जगौ तालनो योगिरूपधृक .. 52 ..
text_mt: With the sound of the flute, the portion of Kṛṣṇa, enchanter of people, danced; / and Tālana, bearing the form of a yogin, played the vīṇā and sang.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdaṃgadhvaninā devo lakṣaṇaḥ kāṃsyavādyakaḥ ..
susvaraṃ ca jagau tatra śrutvā rājā vimohitaḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
मृदंगध्वनिना देवो लक्षणः कांस्यवाद्यकः ..
सुस्वरं च जगौ तत्र श्रुत्वा राजा विमोहितः .. 53 ..
text_mt: To the sound of the mṛdaṅga, Deva [danced, and] Lakṣaṇa played the bronze bell; / and he sang sweetly there; hearing it, the king was completely enchanted.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu malanā rājñī dṛṣṭvā tadvāmanotsavam ..
ruditvā vacanaṃ prāha kva gato me priyaṃkaraḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
तदा तु मलना राज्ञी दृष्ट्वा तद्वामनोत्सवम् ..
रुदित्वा वचनं प्राह क्व गतो मे प्रियंकरः .. 54 ..
text_mt: Then queen Malanā, seeing that Vāmana festival, / wept and spoke these words: "Where has my beloved gone,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśo bandhusahitastyaktvā māṃ mandabhāginīm ..
tvayā virahito deśo mahīrājena luṃṭhitaḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
कृष्णांशो बन्धुसहितस्त्यक्त्वा मां मन्दभागिनीम् ..
त्वया विरहितो देशो महीराजेन लुंठितः .. 55 ..
text_mt: the portion of Kṛṣṇa, together with his kinsman, abandoning me, ill-fated [as I am]? / Bereft of you, the realm has been plundered by Mahīrāja!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktāṃ malanāṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ sneha kātaraḥ ..
vacanaṃ prāha namrātmā devi tvaṃ vacanaṃ kuru .. 56 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तां मलनां दृष्ट्वा कृष्णांशः स्नेह कातरः ..
वचनं प्राह नम्रात्मा देवि त्वं वचनं कुरु .. 56 ..
text_mt: Seeing Malanā who spoke thus, the portion of Kṛṣṇa, agitated with affection, / humbled in spirit, spoke these words: "O queen, keep my word.

sanskrit_iast:
yoginaśca vayaṃ rājñi sarvayuddhaviśāradāḥ ..
tavedaṃ sakalaṃ kāryaṃ kṛtvā yāmo hi naimiṣam .. 57 ..
meaning:
योगिनश्च वयं राज्ञि सर्वयुद्धविशारदाः ..
तवेदं सकलं कार्यं कृत्वा यामो हि नैमिषम् .. 57 ..
text_mt: We are yogins, O queen, skilled in all forms of warfare; / having accomplished all this work of yours, we shall indeed go to Naimiṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
ye yavavrīhayaścaiva tava sadmani saṃsthitāḥ ..
gṛhītvā yoṣitassarvā gacchantu sāgarāntikam ..
vayaṃ tu yogasainyena tava rakṣāṃ ca kurmahe .. 58 ..
meaning:
ये यवव्रीहयश्चैव तव सद्मनि संस्थिताः ..
गृहीत्वा योषितस्सर्वा गच्छन्तु सागरान्तिकम् ..
वयं तु योगसैन्येन तव रक्षां च कुर्महे .. 58 ..
text_mt: Whatever barley and rice remain in your house, / let all the women take it and go to the edge of the lake; / we, for our part, shall protect you with our yogic army."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vacastasya tatsutā ca pativratā ..
mātaraṃ vacanaṃ prāha kṛṣṇāṃśo'yaṃ na nartakaḥ .. 59 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य तत्सुता च पतिव्रता ..
मातरं वचनं प्राह कृष्णांशोऽयं न नर्तकः .. 59 ..
text_mt: Hearing his words, her devoted daughter / said to her mother: “This is an incarnation of Kṛṣṇa, not a dancer.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇḍarīkanibhe netre śyāmāṃgaṃ tasya sundaram ..
kṛṣṇāṃśena vinā mātaḥ ko rakṣārthaṃ kṣamo bhuvi ..
durjayaśca mahīrājaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśena vinirjitaḥ .. 3.3.26.60 ..
meaning:
पुण्डरीकनिभे नेत्रे श्यामांगं तस्य सुन्दरम् ..
कृष्णांशेन विना मातः को रक्षार्थं क्षमो भुवि ..
दुर्जयश्च महीराजः कृष्णांशेन विनिर्जितः .. 3.3.26.60 ..
text_mt: His eyes resemble white lotuses, and his dark body is beautiful. / Who on earth, Mother, is capable of protecting [us] without an incarnation of Kṛṣṇa? / And King Mahī, difficult to conquer, was completely defeated by this incarnation of Kṛṣṇa.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā malanā premavihvalā ..
yavavīhayo niṣkāsya yoṣitāṃ sthāpitāḥ kare .. 61 ..
meaning:
इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मलना प्रेमविह्वला ..
यववीहयो निष्कास्य योषितां स्थापिताः करे .. 61 ..
text_mt: Hearing her words, Malanā, overwhelmed with love, / brought out barley and rice and placed them in the hands of the women.

sanskrit_iast:
jagustā yoṣitassarvāḥ kṛṣṇāṃśacaritaṃ śubham ..
lakṣaṇaḥ śīghramāgamya yogiveṣānsvasainikān ..
sajjīkṛtya sthitastatra tālanādyaiḥ surakṣitaḥ .. 62 ..
meaning:
जगुस्ता योषितस्सर्वाः कृष्णांशचरितं शुभम् ..
लक्षणः शीघ्रमागम्य योगिवेषान्स्वसैनिकान् ..
सज्जीकृत्य स्थितस्तत्र तालनाद्यैः सुरक्षितः .. 62 ..
text_mt: All those women sang the auspicious deeds of Kṛṣṇa’s incarnation. / Lakṣaṇa, arriving quickly, drew up his soldiers / disguised as yogins and stood there, well guarded by Tālana and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
kīrtisāgaramāgamya te vīrā bala darpitāḥ ..
rurudhuḥ sarvato nārīrdolāyutamitasthitāḥ .. 63 ..
meaning:
कीर्तिसागरमागम्य ते वीरा बल दर्पिताः ..
रुरुधुः सर्वतो नारीर्दोलायुतमितस्थिताः .. 63 ..
text_mt: Reaching Kīrtisāgara, those heroes, arrogant in their strength, / surrounded on all sides the women who were seated in their palanquins.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīpatistu kulahā jñātvā kṛṣṇāṃśamāgatam ..
caṃdravaṃśinamāgamya saputraśca ruroda ha .. 64 ..
meaning:
महीपतिस्तु कुलहा ज्ञात्वा कृष्णांशमागतम् ..
चंद्रवंशिनमागम्य सपुत्रश्च रुरोद ह .. 64 ..
text_mt: The king, destroyer of his family, knowing that Kṛṣṇa’s incarnation had come, / approached the scion of the lunar dynasty and wept along with his son:

sanskrit_iast:
yogibhistairmahārāja luṃṭhitāḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ ..
malanā saṃhṛtā tatra tathā caṃdrāvalī sutā .. 65 ..
meaning:
योगिभिस्तैर्महाराज लुंठिताः सर्वयोषितः ..
मलना संहृता तत्र तथा चंद्रावली सुता .. 65 ..
text_mt: “O Great King, all the women were plundered by those yogins! / Malanā was carried off there, as was her daughter Candrāvalī.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājasya te sainyā yogiveṣāssamāgatāḥ ..
tārakāya sutāṃ prādānmahīrājāya matsvasām .. 66 ..
meaning:
महीराजस्य ते सैन्या योगिवेषास्समागताः ..
तारकाय सुतां प्रादान्महीराजाय मत्स्वसाम् .. 66 ..
text_mt: Those troops of King Mahī arrived in the disguise of yogins; / he gave his daughter to Tāraka, and my sister to King Mahī.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ brahmānando mahābalaḥ ..
lakṣasainyānvitastatra yayau roṣasamanvitaḥ .. 67 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो घोरं ब्रह्मानन्दो महाबलः ..
लक्षसैन्यान्वितस्तत्र ययौ रोषसमन्वितः .. 67 ..
text_mt: Hearing these dreadful words, the mighty Brahmānanda, / accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, went there filled with wrath.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājastu kalahī sainyāyutamahātmajaḥ ..
rakṣitaḥ kāmasenena tathā raṇajitā yayau .. 68 ..
meaning:
महीराजस्तु कलही सैन्यायुतमहात्मजः ..
रक्षितः कामसेनेन तथा रणजिता ययौ .. 68 ..
text_mt: King Mahī, fond of strife, having ten thousand troops and his son, / protected by Kāmasena and by Raṇajit, marched forth.

sanskrit_iast:
tayoścāsīnmahayuddhaṃ senayorubhayorbhuvi ..
tālano yogiveṣaśca brahmānaṃdamupāyayau .. 69 ..
meaning:
तयोश्चासीन्महयुद्धं सेनयोरुभयोर्भुवि ..
तालनो योगिवेषश्च ब्रह्मानंदमुपाययौ .. 69 ..
text_mt: A great battle took place on earth between the two armies. / Tālana, disguised as a yogin, approached Brahmānanda.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇaścābhayaṃ śūraṃ devasiṃho mahīpatim ..
jitvā baddhvā ca muditau kāmasenassamāgataḥ .. 3.3.26.70 ..
meaning:
लक्षणश्चाभयं शूरं देवसिंहो महीपतिम् ..
जित्वा बद्ध्वा च मुदितौ कामसेनस्समागतः .. 3.3.26.70 ..
text_mt: Lakṣaṇa [approached] the heroic Abhaya, and Devasiṃha [approached] the king. / When, having conquered and bound them, the two were rejoicing, Kāmasena arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇaḥ kāmasenaṃ ca devo raṇajitaṃ tadā ..
baddhvā tatra sthitau vīrau śatrūsainyakṣayaṃkarau .. 71 .
meaning:
लक्षणः कामसेनं च देवो रणजितं तदा ..
बद्ध्वा तत्र स्थितौ वीरौ शत्रूसैन्यक्षयंकरौ .. 71 .
text_mt: Then Lakṣaṇa [bound] Kāmasena, and Deva bound Raṇajit; / the two heroes stood there, causing the destruction of the enemy’s army.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare brahmā baddhvā vai tālanaṃ balī ..
lakṣaṇāntamupāgamya dhanuryuddhamacīkarat .. 72 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे ब्रह्मा बद्ध्वा वै तालनं बली ..
लक्षणान्तमुपागम्य धनुर्युद्धमचीकरत् .. 72 ..
text_mt: Meanwhile, the mighty Brahmā, having bound Tālana, / went near Lakṣaṇa and engaged in a duel of bows.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇaṃ chinnadhanvānaṃ punarbaddhvā mahābalaḥ ..
devasiṃhamupāgamya mūrchitaṃ taṃ cakāra ha .. 73 ..
meaning:
लक्षणं छिन्नधन्वानं पुनर्बद्ध्वा महाबलः ..
देवसिंहमुपागम्य मूर्छितं तं चकार ह .. 73 ..
text_mt: Having broken Lakṣaṇa’s bow and bound him again, the mighty one / approached Devasiṃha and made him lose consciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
hāhābhūte yogisainye pradrute sarvato diśam ..
kṛṣṇāṃśo yoṣitassarvā vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ .. 74 ..
meaning:
हाहाभूते योगिसैन्ये प्रद्रुते सर्वतो दिशम् ..
कृष्णांशो योषितस्सर्वा वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः .. 74 ..
text_mt: When the army of yogins raised a cry of despair and fled in all directions, / the incarnation of Kṛṣṇa spoke these words with humble mind to all the women:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmānando'yamāyāto mama sainya kṣayaṃkaraḥ ..
tasmādyūyaṃ mayā sārddhaṃ gacchāśu ca taṃ prati .. 75 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मानन्दोऽयमायातो मम सैन्य क्षयंकरः ..
तस्माद्यूयं मया सार्द्धं गच्छाशु च तं प्रति .. 75 ..
text_mt: “This Brahmānanda has arrived, destroying my army; / therefore, quickly go with me against him!”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā tāssamādāya brahmānandamupāyayau ..
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ naranārāyaṇāṃ śayoḥ .. 76 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा तास्समादाय ब्रह्मानन्दमुपाययौ ..
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धं नरनारायणां शयोः .. 76 ..
text_mt: Having said this and taken them, he went near Brahmānanda; / and a great battle ensued between the two, who were portions of Nara and Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśastatra balavānnabhomārgeṇa taṃ prati ..
rathasthaṃ ca samāgamya mohayāmāsa so'sinā .. 77 ..
meaning:
कृष्णांशस्तत्र बलवान्नभोमार्गेण तं प्रति ..
रथस्थं च समागम्य मोहयामास सोऽसिना .. 77 ..
text_mt: There the mighty incarnation of Kṛṣṇa, moving through the sky towards him / who stood in a chariot, arrived and stunned him with his sword.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu mūrchite tasminmocayitvā ca tā mudā ..
yogī sainyānvito yuddhātpalāyanaparo'bhavat .. 78 ..
meaning:
तदा तु मूर्छिते तस्मिन्मोचयित्वा च ता मुदा ..
योगी सैन्यान्वितो युद्धात्पलायनपरोऽभवत् .. 78 ..
text_mt: Then, while he was unconscious, joyfully freeing them, / the yogin with his troops set about fleeing from the battle.

sanskrit_iast:
parājite yogisainye brahmānaṃdo mahābalaḥ ..
yoṣitastāḥ samādāya svagehāya dadhau manaḥ .. 79 ..
meaning:
पराजिते योगिसैन्ये ब्रह्मानंदो महाबलः ..
योषितस्ताः समादाय स्वगेहाय दधौ मनः .. 79 ..
text_mt: When the army of yogins was defeated, the mighty Brahmānanda, / taking those women, set his mind on [returning to] his own home.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājastu saṃprāpto mahīpatyanumoditaḥ ..
rurodha sarvato nārīḥ śivadattavaro balī .. 3.3.26.80 ..
meaning:
महीराजस्तु संप्राप्तो महीपत्यनुमोदितः ..
रुरोध सर्वतो नारीः शिवदत्तवरो बली .. 3.3.26.80 ..
text_mt: King Mahī, having arrived and been praised by the king, / the strong one who had received a boon from Śiva, blocked the women on all sides.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛharaścābhayaṃ śūraṃ mardanaścaiva rūpaṇam ..
madanaṃ vai saradano brahmānaṃdaṃ ca tārakaḥ .. 81 ..
meaning:
नृहरश्चाभयं शूरं मर्दनश्चैव रूपणम् ..
मदनं वै सरदनो ब्रह्मानंदं च तारकः .. 81 ..
text_mt: Nṛhara [attacked] the heroic Abhaya, Mardana [attacked] Rūpaṇa, / Saradana [attacked] Madana, and Tāraka [attacked] Brahmānanda.

sanskrit_iast:
cāmuṇḍaḥ kāmasenaṃ ca dhanuryuddhamacīkarat ..
tadābhayo mahāvīro dhunvaṃtaṃ nṛharaṃ ripum .. 82 ..
meaning:
चामुण्डः कामसेनं च धनुर्युद्धमचीकरत् ..
तदाभयो महावीरो धुन्वंतं नृहरं रिपुम् .. 82 ..
text_mt: Cāmuṇḍa waged archery combat against Kāmasena. / Then the great hero Abhaya, against his enemy Nṛhara who was brandishing [his bow],

sanskrit_iast:
chittvā dhanustamāgatya khaḍgayuddhamacīkarat ..
nṛharaḥ khaḍgarahito'bhavadyuddhaparāṅmukhaḥ ..
tamāha vacanaṃ kruddho'bhayo yuddhārthamudyataḥ .. .. 83 ..
meaning:
छित्त्वा धनुस्तमागत्य खड्गयुद्धमचीकरत् ..
नृहरः खड्गरहितोऽभवद्युद्धपराङ्मुखः ..
तमाह वचनं क्रुद्धोऽभयो युद्धार्थमुद्यतः .. .. 83 ..
text_mt: severed his bow, approached him, and fought with swords. / Nṛhara, bereft of his sword, turned away from the fight. / Enraged, Abhaya, intent on fighting, said to him:

sanskrit_iast: bhavānvai mātṛṣvasrīyo mahīrājasya cātmajaḥ .. 84 ..
meaning: भवान्वै मातृष्वस्रीयो महीराजस्य चात्मजः .. 84 ..
text_mt: “You are indeed a maternal aunt’s son, and the son of King Mahī.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatriyāṇāṃ paraṃ dharmaṃ kathaṃ saṃhartumicchati ..
iti śrutvā tu nṛharo gṛhītvā parighaṃ ruṣā .. 85 ..
meaning:
क्षत्रियाणां परं धर्मं कथं संहर्तुमिच्छति ..
इति श्रुत्वा तु नृहरो गृहीत्वा परिघं रुषा .. 85 ..
text_mt: Why do you wish to abandon the supreme duty of kṣatriyas?” / Hearing this, Nṛhara, seizing an iron mace in rage,

sanskrit_iast:
jaghāna taṃ ca śirasi sa hataḥ svargamāyayau ..
sa ca vai kṛtavarmāṃśo vilīnaḥ kṛtavarmaṇi .. 86 ..
meaning:
जघान तं च शिरसि स हतः स्वर्गमाययौ ..
स च वै कृतवर्मांशो विलीनः कृतवर्मणि .. 86 ..
text_mt: struck him on the head, and, slain, he went to heaven. / A portion of Kṛtavarman, he merged into Kṛtavarman.

sanskrit_iast:
madanaṃ gopajātaṃ ca hatvā saradano balī ..
jayaśabdaṃ cakāroccairpunarhatvā riporbalam ..
uttarāṃśaśca sa jñeyo madanaścottare layaḥ .. 87 ..
meaning:
मदनं गोपजातं च हत्वा सरदनो बली ..
जयशब्दं चकारोच्चैर्पुनर्हत्वा रिपोर्बलम् ..
उत्तरांशश्च स ज्ञेयो मदनश्चोत्तरे लयः .. 87 ..
text_mt: Having slain Madana, who was born of a cowherd, the mighty Saradana / shouted aloud a cry of victory, having further destroyed the enemy’s force. / Madana is to be known as a portion of Uttara, and he dissolved into Uttara.

sanskrit_iast:
rūpaṇaśca samāgatya mūrchayitvā ca mardanam ..
punassaradanaṃ prāpya khaḍgayuddhaṃ cakāra ha .. 88 ..
meaning:
रूपणश्च समागत्य मूर्छयित्वा च मर्दनम् ..
पुनस्सरदनं प्राप्य खड्गयुद्धं चकार ह .. 88 ..
text_mt: Rūpaṇa, having arrived and rendered Mardana unconscious, / then reached Saradana and fought a sword duel [with him].

sanskrit_iast:
brahmānaṃdaśca balavānsa baddhvā tārakaṃ ruṣā ..
mahīrājāntamāgamya dhanuryuddhaṃ cakāra ha .. 89 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मानंदश्च बलवान्स बद्ध्वा तारकं रुषा ..
महीराजान्तमागम्य धनुर्युद्धं चकार ह .. 89 ..
text_mt: And the mighty Brahmānanda, having bound Tāraka in anger, / approached King Mahī and fought an archery duel.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛharaṃ raṇajitprāpya svabhallena tadā ruṣā ..
jaghāna samaraślāghī mahīrājasutaṃ śubham ..3.3.26.90..
meaning:
नृहरं रणजित्प्राप्य स्वभल्लेन तदा रुषा ..
जघान समरश्लाघी महीराजसुतं शुभम् ..3.3.26.90..
text_mt: Reaching Nṛhara, Raṇajit, praised in battle, then in anger / struck the noble son of King Mahī with his spear.

sanskrit_iast: sa vai duśśāsanāṃśaśca mṛtastasminsamāgataḥ .. 91 ..
meaning: स वै दुश्शासनांशश्च मृतस्तस्मिन्समागतः .. 91 ..
text_mt: He was indeed a portion of Duḥśāsana, and upon dying he entered him.

sanskrit_iast:
nihate nṛhare baṃdhau mardanaḥ krodhatatparaḥ ..
svaśaraistāḍayāmāsa sātyakeraṃśamuttamam .. 92 ..
meaning:
निहते नृहरे बंधौ मर्दनः क्रोधतत्परः ..
स्वशरैस्ताडयामास सात्यकेरंशमुत्तमम् .. 92 ..
text_mt: When his kinsman Nṛhara was killed, Mardana, intent on wrath, / struck that excellent portion of Sātyaki with his arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
chittvā tānraṇajicchūrassa vai parimalodbhavaḥ ..
svabhallena śiraḥ kāyānmardanasya sa cāharat .. 93 ..
meaning:
छित्त्वा तान्रणजिच्छूरस्स वै परिमलोद्भवः ..
स्वभल्लेन शिरः कायान्मर्दनस्य स चाहरत् .. 93 ..
text_mt: The heroic Raṇajit, born of Parimala, cutting down those [arrows], / severed Mardana’s head from his body with his spear.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛte'sminmardane vīre tadā saradano balī ..
tāḍayāmāsa taṃ vīraṃ svabhallenaiva vakṣasi .. 94 ..
meaning:
मृतेऽस्मिन्मर्दने वीरे तदा सरदनो बली ..
ताडयामास तं वीरं स्वभल्लेनैव वक्षसि .. 94 ..
text_mt: When the hero Mardana died, the mighty Saradana / struck that hero right in the chest with his spear.

sanskrit_iast:
mahatkaṣṭamupāgamya raṇajinmalanodbhavaḥ ..
svakhaṅgena śiraḥ kāyādapāharata vairiṇaḥ .. 95 ..
meaning:
महत्कष्टमुपागम्य रणजिन्मलनोद्भवः ..
स्वखङ्गेन शिरः कायादपाहरत वैरिणः .. 95 ..
text_mt: Suffering great distress, Raṇajit, born of Malanā, / severed the enemy’s head from his body with his sword.

sanskrit_iast:
tribaṃdhau nihate yuddhe tārakaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ ..
rathasthaśca rathasthaṃ ca tāḍayāmāsa vai śaraiḥ .. 96 ..
meaning:
त्रिबंधौ निहते युद्धे तारकः क्रोधमूर्छितः ..
रथस्थश्च रथस्थं च ताडयामास वै शरैः .. 96 ..
text_mt: When the three kinsmen were slain in battle, Tāraka, overcome with wrath, / standing in his chariot, struck [Raṇajit] standing in his chariot with arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
chittvā bāṇaṃ ca raṇajittathaiva ca riporddhanuḥ ..
triśaraistāḍayāmāsa karṇāṃśaṃ tārakaṃ hṛdi .. 97 ..
meaning:
छित्त्वा बाणं च रणजित्तथैव च रिपोर्द्धनुः ..
त्रिशरैस्ताडयामास कर्णांशं तारकं हृदि .. 97 ..
text_mt: Having cut down the arrow and also the enemy’s bow, Raṇajit / struck Tāraka, who was a portion of Karṇa, in the heart with three arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
amarṣavaśamāpanno yathā daṃḍairbhujaṃgamaḥ ..
dhyātvā ca śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ viṣadhautaṃ śaraṃ punaḥ .. 98 ..
meaning:
अमर्षवशमापन्नो यथा दंडैर्भुजंगमः ..
ध्यात्वा च शंकरं देवं विषधौतं शरं पुनः .. 98 ..
text_mt: Falling under the sway of fury like a serpent [struck] with sticks, / and meditating on the god Śaṅkara, [Tāraka] again took an arrow washed in poison,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhāya tarjayitvā ca śatrukaṃṭhamatāḍayat ..
tena bāṇena raṇajittyaktvā dehaṃ divaṃ gataḥ .. 99 ..
meaning:
संधाय तर्जयित्वा च शत्रुकंठमताडयत् ..
तेन बाणेन रणजित्त्यक्त्वा देहं दिवं गतः .. 99 ..
text_mt: fitted it to the bow, shouted defiance, and struck his enemy’s throat. / By that arrow, Raṇajit, abandoning his body, went to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
hate tasminmahāvīrye brahmānaṃdaśca duḥkhitaḥ ..
mahīrājabhayādbrahmā puraskṛsya ca yoṣitaḥ ..
saṃdhyākāle tu saṃprāpte bhādrakṛṣṇāṣṭamīdine .. 3.3.26.100 ..
meaning:
हते तस्मिन्महावीर्ये ब्रह्मानंदश्च दुःखितः ..
महीराजभयाद्ब्रह्मा पुरस्कृस्य च योषितः ..
संध्याकाले तु संप्राप्ते भाद्रकृष्णाष्टमीदिने .. 3.3.26.100 ..
text_mt: When that hero of great valour was slain, Brahmānanda was sorrowful. / Out of fear of King Mahī, Brahmā, placing the women before him, / when evening time arrived on the eighth lunar day of the dark fortnight of Bhādra,

sanskrit_iast:
kapāṭaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ kṛtvā sainyaiḥ ṣaṣṭisahasrakaiḥ ..
sārddhaṃ gehamupāgamya śāradāṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau .. 101 ..
meaning:
कपाटं सुदृढं कृत्वा सैन्यैः षष्टिसहस्रकैः ..
सार्द्धं गेहमुपागम्य शारदां शरणं ययौ .. 101 ..
text_mt: fastening the door firmly, went to his house / together with sixty thousand troops and sought refuge with Śāradā.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājastu balavānputraśokena duḥkhitaḥ ..
saṃkalpaṃ kṛtavānghoraṃ śṛṇvatāṃ sarvabhūbhṛtām .. 102 ..
meaning:
महीराजस्तु बलवान्पुत्रशोकेन दुःखितः ..
संकल्पं कृतवान्घोरं शृण्वतां सर्वभूभृताम् .. 102 ..
text_mt: The powerful Mahīrāja, however, grieved by sorrow for his son, / made a dreadful vow within the hearing of all the kings:

sanskrit_iast:
śirīṣākhyapuraṃ ramyaṃ yathā śūnyaṃ mayā kṛtam ..
tathā mahāvatī sarvā brahmānaṃdādibhissaha ..
kṣayaṃ yāsyaṃti madbāṇaiḥ sarve te caṃdravaṃśinaḥ .. 103 ..
meaning:
शिरीषाख्यपुरं रम्यं यथा शून्यं मया कृतम् ..
तथा महावती सर्वा ब्रह्मानंदादिभिस्सह ..
क्षयं यास्यंति मद्बाणैः सर्वे ते चंद्रवंशिनः .. 103 ..
text_mt: "Just as the lovely city called Śirīṣa was desolated by me, / so shall the entire Mahāvatī, along with Brahmānanda and the rest, / perish by my arrows—all those born of the Lunar lineage!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā dhuṃdhukāraṃ vai cāhvayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ ..
paṃcalakṣabalaissārddhaṃ śīghramāgamyatāṃ priya .. 104 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा धुंधुकारं वै चाह्वयामास भूपतिः ..
पंचलक्षबलैस्सार्द्धं शीघ्रमागम्यतां प्रिय .. 104 ..
text_mt: Having said this, the king indeed summoned Dhundhukāra: / "Come quickly, my dear friend, along with a force of five hundred thousand!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā dhuṃdhukāro gatvā śīghraṃ ca dehalīm ..
uṣitvā sapta divasānyuddhabhūmimupāgamat .. 105 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा धुंधुकारो गत्वा शीघ्रं च देहलीम् ..
उषित्वा सप्त दिवसान्युद्धभूमिमुपागमत् .. 105 ..
text_mt: Having heard this, Dhundhukāra went swiftly to Dehalī, / and after staying there for seven days, he came to the battleground.

sanskrit_iast:
tadāṣṭalakṣasahito mahīrājo mahābalaḥ ..
tārakeṇa ca saṃyukto yuddhāya samupāyayau .. 106 ..
meaning:
तदाष्टलक्षसहितो महीराजो महाबलः ..
तारकेण च संयुक्तो युद्धाय समुपाययौ .. 106 ..
text_mt: Then the mighty Mahīrāja, accompanied by eight hundred thousand [troops], / and joined with Tāraka, marched out for battle.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
saptaviṃśābdake prāpte kṛṣṇāṃśe sarvamaṃgale ..
bhādrakṛṣṇadaśamyāṃ ca malanā śokakātarā ..
jananāyakamāhūya vacanaṃ prāha duḥkhitā .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
सप्तविंशाब्दके प्राप्ते कृष्णांशे सर्वमंगले ..
भाद्रकृष्णदशम्यां च मलना शोककातरा ..
जननायकमाहूय वचनं प्राह दुःखिता .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / When the twenty-seventh year arrived, the all-auspicious portion of Kṛṣṇa, / on the tenth day of the dark fortnight of Bhādrapada, Malanā, distraught with grief, / summoned Jananāyaka and, sorrowful, spoke these words:
title: adhyāyaḥ 27

sanskrit_iast:
aye kacchapadeśīya gotamānvayasaṃbhava ..
harināgaramāruhya kānyakubjaṃ vrajādhunā .. 2 ..
meaning:
अये कच्छपदेशीय गोतमान्वयसंभव ..
हरिनागरमारुह्य कान्यकुब्जं व्रजाधुना .. 2 ..
text_mt: "O native of the Kacchapa country, born in the lineage of Gautama, / mount Harināgara and go at once to Kānyakubja!

sanskrit_iast:
putramāhlādamāhūya sānujaṃ matpriyaṃkaram ..
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ hṛdi saṃciṃtya trai punaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
पुत्रमाह्लादमाहूय सानुजं मत्प्रियंकरम् ..
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं हृदि संचिंत्य त्रै पुनः .. 3 ..
text_mt: Summon my son Āhlāda, together with his younger brother, who brings joy to me!" / Having heard these words and reflected upon them in his heart, Trai once again

sanskrit_iast:
malanāṃ duḥkhitāṃ prāha na tvāyāsyati sa prabhuḥ ..
rājñaḥ parimalasyaiva vākyaṃ matvā suduḥkhadam .. 4 ..
meaning:
मलनां दुःखितां प्राह न त्वायास्यति स प्रभुः ..
राज्ञः परिमलस्यैव वाक्यं मत्वा सुदुःखदम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: spoke to the grieving Malanā: "That lord will not come, / regarding the command of King Parimala as exceedingly painful."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ ruroda malanā satī ..
punarmūrcchāṃ gatā bhūmau jīvanaṃ tyaktumudyatā .. 5 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं रुरोद मलना सती ..
पुनर्मूर्च्छां गता भूमौ जीवनं त्यक्तुमुद्यता .. 5 ..
text_mt: Hearing this speech, the virtuous Malanā wept, / fainted again upon the ground, and was ready to surrender her life:

sanskrit_iast:
