hā rāmāṃśa mahābāho vatsa kṛṣṇāṃśa sundara ..
kva gatau saha devakyā tyaktvā māṃ maṃdabhāginīm ..6..
meaning:
हा रामांश महाबाहो वत्स कृष्णांश सुन्दर ..
क्व गतौ सह देवक्या त्यक्त्वा मां मंदभागिनीम् ..6..
text_mt: "Alas, mighty-armed portion of Rāma! O handsome child, portion of Kṛṣṇa! / Where have you both gone with Devakī, abandoning me, ill-fated woman?"

sanskrit_iast:
tadā parimalāputro dṛṣṭvā rājñīṃ tathā gatām ..
bahudhāśvāsya balavānkānyakubjapuraṃ yayau .. 7 ..
meaning:
तदा परिमलापुत्रो दृष्ट्वा राज्ञीं तथा गताम् ..
बहुधाश्वास्य बलवान्कान्यकुब्जपुरं ययौ .. 7 ..
text_mt: Then the son of Parimalā, seeing the queen reduced to that state, / consoled her in many ways and, mighty as he was, departed for the city of Kānyakubja.

sanskrit_iast:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
tvayā parimalāputrassaṃprokto jananāyakaḥ ..
romaharṣaṇa no brūhi so'yaṃ kastena kiṃ kṛtam .. 8 ..
meaning:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
त्वया परिमलापुत्रस्संप्रोक्तो जननायकः ..
रोमहर्षण नो ब्रूहि सोऽयं कस्तेन किं कृतम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: The sages said: / "You have spoken of Jananāyaka as the son of Parimalā. / O Romaharṣaṇa, tell us who he was and what he did!"

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
iṃdraprasthapurevātsītpradyotaḥ kathito mayā ..
pitā parimalasyaivāmātyo'naṃgamahīpateḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
इंद्रप्रस्थपुरेवात्सीत्प्रद्योतः कथितो मया ..
पिता परिमलस्यैवामात्योऽनंगमहीपतेः .. 9 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / In the city of Indraprastha lived Pradyota, of whom I have spoken, / the father of Parimala and minister to King Anaṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya kanyā samājātā nāmnā parimalā mune ..
duḥśalāṃśasamudbhūtā raṃbheva sukumārikā .. 3.3.27.10 ..
meaning:
तस्य कन्या समाजाता नाम्ना परिमला मुने ..
दुःशलांशसमुद्भूता रंभेव सुकुमारिका .. 3.3.27.10 ..
text_mt: A daughter was born to him named Parimalā, O sage, / originating from a portion of Duḥśalā, delicate as Rambhā.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvivāhārthamudyogaḥ kṛtaḥ pitrā svayaṃvaraḥ ..
putraḥ kacchapabhūpasya sa nāmnā kamalāpatiḥ ..
tāmudvāhma vidhānena svagehāya yayau mudā.. 11 ..
meaning:
तद्विवाहार्थमुद्योगः कृतः पित्रा स्वयंवरः ..
पुत्रः कच्छपभूपस्य स नाम्ना कमलापतिः ..
तामुद्वाह्म विधानेन स्वगेहाय ययौ मुदा.. 11 ..
text_mt: Her father made preparations for her marriage through a svayaṃvara. / The son of the Kacchapa king, named Kamalāpati, / married her according to the prescribed rites and returned home with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
tayossamāgamo jātaḥ putro'yaṃ jananāyakaḥ ..
śatruvidyāparaḥ śūraḥ khaḍgayuddhaviśāradaḥ ..12..
meaning:
तयोस्समागमो जातः पुत्रोऽयं जननायकः ..
शत्रुविद्यापरः शूरः खड्गयुद्धविशारदः ..12..
text_mt: From their union this son, Jananāyaka, was born, / devoted to the military science of enemies, heroic, and skilled in sword combat.

sanskrit_iast:
jitvā bhūpānbalādvīraḥ siṃdhutīralanivāsinaḥ ..
ṣaḍaṃśakaramādāya pitṛrājyamupasthitaḥ ..13..
meaning:
जित्वा भूपान्बलाद्वीरः सिंधुतीरलनिवासिनः ..
षडंशकरमादाय पितृराज्यमुपस्थितः ..13..
text_mt: Conquering by force the kings dwelling on the banks of the Sindhu / and taking a sixth-part tribute, the hero arrived at his ancestral realm.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā tu mahīrājaḥ svasainyaparivāritaḥ ..
kacchadeśamupāgamya karārthaṃ samupasthitaḥ ..14..
meaning:
एकदा तु महीराजः स्वसैन्यपरिवारितः ..
कच्छदेशमुपागम्य करार्थं समुपस्थितः ..14..
text_mt: Once, however, Mahīrāja, surrounded by his army, / came to the Kaccha country and arrived to demand tribute.

sanskrit_iast:
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ jananāyakabhūpayoḥ..
māsānte sūryavaṃśīyo mahīrājena nirjitaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धं जननायकभूपयोः..
मासान्ते सूर्यवंशीयो महीराजेन निर्जितः .. 15 ..
text_mt: A great battle took place between the two kings, [Mahīrāja] and Jananāyaka. / At the end of a month, the Solar descendant was defeated by Mahīrāja.

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktvā rāṣṭraṃ ca sakulaḥ saṃprāptaśca mahāvatīm ..
parimalastu tadā rājā tasmai grāmaṃ śubhaṃ dadau .. 16 ..
meaning:
त्यक्त्वा राष्ट्रं च सकुलः संप्राप्तश्च महावतीम् ..
परिमलस्तु तदा राजा तस्मै ग्रामं शुभं ददौ .. 16 ..
text_mt: Abandoning his kingdom along with his clan, he arrived at Mahāvatī. / King Parimala then granted him an auspicious village.

sanskrit_iast:
nivāsaṃ kṛtavāṃstatra svanāmnā prathitaṃ bhuvi ..
sa vai kacchapadeśīyo yayau parimalājñayā.. 17 ..
meaning:
निवासं कृतवांस्तत्र स्वनाम्ना प्रथितं भुवि ..
स वै कच्छपदेशीयो ययौ परिमलाज्ञया.. 17 ..
text_mt: He took up residence there, renown on earth by his own name. / Then, at the command of Parimala, that native of the Kacchapa country set forth.

sanskrit_iast:
tadāsau ca mahīrājo mahīpatyanumoditaḥ ..
cāmuṃḍaṃ śīghramāhūya lakṣasainyasamanvitam ..
ādeśaṃ kṛtavānrājā tasya baṃdhanahetave .. 18 ..
meaning:
तदासौ च महीराजो महीपत्यनुमोदितः ..
चामुंडं शीघ्रमाहूय लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितम् ..
आदेशं कृतवान्राजा तस्य बंधनहेतवे .. 18 ..
text_mt: Thereupon that Mahīrāja, encouraged by the sovereign, / swiftly summoned Cāmuṇḍa along with an army of a hundred thousand, / and the king gave orders to capture him.

sanskrit_iast:
sa ca netravatīkūle saṃprāpte lakṣa sainyapaḥ ..
rurodha sūryavaṃśīyaṃ jananāyakamuttamam ..19..
meaning:
स च नेत्रवतीकूले संप्राप्ते लक्ष सैन्यपः ..
रुरोध सूर्यवंशीयं जननायकमुत्तमम् ..19..
text_mt: Arriving at the banks of the Netravatī, the commander of a hundred-thousand strong / blocked the noble Jananāyaka of the Solar lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tadā khaḍgamādāya bāhuśālī yateṃdriyaḥ ..
tatra śūraśataṃ hatvā nabhomārgamupāyayau ..3.3.27.20..
meaning:
स तदा खड्गमादाय बाहुशाली यतेंद्रियः ..
तत्र शूरशतं हत्वा नभोमार्गमुपाययौ ..3.3.27.20..
text_mt: Then, drawing his sword, the strong-armed and self-controlled hero / killed a hundred warriors there and leaped up into the path of the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
senāpateśca mukuṭaṃ gajasthasya gṛhītavān ..
lajjitaḥ sa tu cāmuṃḍo vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ ..21..
meaning:
सेनापतेश्च मुकुटं गजस्थस्य गृहीतवान् ..
लज्जितः स तु चामुंडो वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः ..21..
text_mt: He seized the diadem of the general who was mounted on an elephant. / Ashamed, Cāmuṇḍa spoke these words with a humble mind:

sanskrit_iast:
bhavānvṛttikaro mahyaṃ kṣatriyo brāhmaṇasya vai ..
dehi me mukuṭaṃ vīra ciraṃ jīva sukhī bhava..22..
meaning:
भवान्वृत्तिकरो मह्यं क्षत्रियो ब्राह्मणस्य वै ..
देहि मे मुकुटं वीर चिरं जीव सुखी भव..22..
text_mt: "You are a source of livelihood to me, a kṣatriya to a brāhmaṇa! / Return my diadem, O hero; live long and be happy!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā sa vinayaṃ dattvā tasmai śubhaṃ vasu ..
kuṭhāranagare prāpto vāmanena surakṣitaḥ ..23..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा स विनयं दत्त्वा तस्मै शुभं वसु ..
कुठारनगरे प्राप्तो वामनेन सुरक्षितः ..23..
text_mt: Hearing this courteous plea, he gave him auspicious wealth, / and, protected by Vāmana, arrived in the town of Kuṭhāra.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tatra vaṭacchāyāṃ śrameṇātīva karṣitaḥ..
suṣvāpa nirbhayo vīrastatra sthāne sukhaprade .. 24 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तत्र वटच्छायां श्रमेणातीव कर्षितः..
सुष्वाप निर्भयो वीरस्तत्र स्थाने सुखप्रदे .. 24 ..
text_mt: Seeing the shade of a banyan tree there, utterly exhausted by toil, / the fearless hero fell asleep in that place which provided comfort.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu vāmano jñātvā svadūtaistatra kāraṇam ..
vastrāṇyācchādya cāgamya cāharaddharināgaram .. 25 ..
meaning:
तदा तु वामनो ज्ञात्वा स्वदूतैस्तत्र कारणम् ..
वस्त्राण्याच्छाद्य चागम्य चाहरद्धरिनागरम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Then Vāmana, learning through his spies the situation there, / disguised himself in garments, arrived, and stole Harināgara.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛte tasmiṃśca divyāśve prabuddho jananāyakaḥ ..
ciṃtāmavāpya mahatīṃ rodanaṃ kṛtavānbahu .. 26 ..
meaning:
हृते तस्मिंश्च दिव्याश्वे प्रबुद्धो जननायकः ..
चिंतामवाप्य महतीं रोदनं कृतवान्बहु .. 26 ..
text_mt: When that celestial horse had been stolen, Jananāyaka woke up; / overcome by great distress, he wept copiously.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvāṃghricihnamālokya vāmanaṃ prāpya nirbhayaḥ ..
vacanaṃ prāha namrātmā nṛpaṃ gaurānvayodbhavam .. 27 ..
meaning:
अश्वांघ्रिचिह्नमालोक्य वामनं प्राप्य निर्भयः ..
वचनं प्राह नम्रात्मा नृपं गौरान्वयोद्भवम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: Tracing the hoof-prints of the horse, he fearlessly approached Vāmana; / with humble disposition, he addressed the king born in the Gaura lineage:

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatriyāṇāṃ hi saṃhāsyo bhayado bhuvi sarvadā ..
sa bhavānrājanītijño dehi me'śvaṃ sukhī bhava ..28..
meaning:
क्षत्रियाणां हि संहास्यो भयदो भुवि सर्वदा ..
स भवान्राजनीतिज्ञो देहि मेऽश्वं सुखी भव ..28..
text_mt: "A matter for ridicule among kṣatriyas is always terrifying on earth. / As one who knows statecraft, give me back my horse, and be happy,

sanskrit_iast:
no cettvāṃ vai sanagaraṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ kṣapayiṣyati ..
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ vāmano gauravaṃśajaḥ..29..
meaning:
नो चेत्त्वां वै सनगरं कृष्णांशः क्षपयिष्यति ..
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं वामनो गौरवंशजः..29..
text_mt: lest the portion of Kṛṣṇa destroy you along with your city!" / Hearing these words, Vāmana, born of the Gaura lineage,

sanskrit_iast: bhayabhīto viniścitya pradadau harināgaram .. 3.3.27.30 ..
meaning: भयभीतो विनिश्चित्य प्रददौ हरिनागरम् .. 3.3.27.30 ..
text_mt: terrified, resolved [to do so] and returned Harināgara.

sanskrit_iast:
pratodaṃ svarṇaracitaṃ nānāratnasamanvitam ..
lobhācca na dadau rājā mṛṣā śapathakārakaḥ ..31 ..
meaning:
प्रतोदं स्वर्णरचितं नानारत्नसमन्वितम् ..
लोभाच्च न ददौ राजा मृषा शपथकारकः ..31 ..
text_mt: The whip, fashioned of gold and adorned with diverse jewels, / out of greed the king did not return, swearing a false oath.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā parimalāputraḥ kuṃṭhitaḥ prāha bhūpatim ..
pratodalobhātte rājankṣayaṃ durgo gamiṣyati .. 32 ..
meaning:
तदा परिमलापुत्रः कुंठितः प्राह भूपतिम् ..
प्रतोदलोभात्ते राजन्क्षयं दुर्गो गमिष्यति .. 32 ..
text_mt: Then the son of Parimalā, frustrated, said to the king: / "Out of greed for the whip, O king, your fortress will go to destruction!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā prayayau vīraḥ kānyakubjaṃ mahottamam..
lakṣaṇo hastinīsaṃstho vacanaṃ prāha garvitaḥ ..
kastvaṃ prāpto hayārūḍho nirbhayaḥ kṣatriyottamaḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा प्रययौ वीरः कान्यकुब्जं महोत्तमम्..
लक्षणो हस्तिनीसंस्थो वचनं प्राह गर्वितः ..
कस्त्वं प्राप्तो हयारूढो निर्भयः क्षत्रियोत्तमः .. 33 ..
text_mt: Having said this, the hero departed for the great and pre-eminent Kānyakubja. / Lakṣaṇa, seated upon a female elephant, proudly spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
sa hovāca mahārāja preṣitaścaṃdravaṃśinā ..
tavāntikaṃ samāyātaḥ śaraṇāgatavatsala .. 34 ..
meaning:
स होवाच महाराज प्रेषितश्चंद्रवंशिना ..
तवान्तिकं समायातः शरणागतवत्सल .. 34 ..
text_mt: "Who are you, an excellent kṣatriya, who have arrived fearless upon a horse?" / He replied: "O great king, sent by one of the Lunar dynasty,

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājaśca balavānsakulaṃ caṃdravaṃśinam ..
haniṣyati ca raudrāstrairmahīpatyanumoditaḥ .. 35 .. .
meaning:
महीराजश्च बलवान्सकुलं चंद्रवंशिनम् ..
हनिष्यति च रौद्रास्त्रैर्महीपत्यनुमोदितः .. 35 .. .
text_mt: I have come to your presence, O you who are kind to those seeking refuge! / The mighty Mahīrāja, encouraged by the sovereign,

sanskrit_iast:
atastvaṃ svabalaissārddhaṃ sahāhlādādibhiryutaḥ ..
gacchagaccha mahārāja mṛtānujīvayādhunā .. 36 ..
meaning:
अतस्त्वं स्वबलैस्सार्द्धं सहाह्लादादिभिर्युतः ..
गच्छगच्छ महाराज मृतानुजीवयाधुना .. 36 ..
text_mt: will slaughter the Lunar dynasty along with their families using dreadful weapons. / Therefore, march forth, march forth with your forces, O great king, together with Āhlāda and the rest, / and revive the fallen at once!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityukto lakṣaṇastena jayacaṃdraṃ praṇamya saḥ ..
sarvaṃ vai kathayāmāsa mahīrājo yathāgataḥ .. 37..
meaning:
इत्युक्तो लक्षणस्तेन जयचंद्रं प्रणम्य सः ..
सर्वं वै कथयामास महीराजो यथागतः .. 37..
text_mt: Addressed thus by him, Lakṣaṇa bowed to Jayacandra / and told him everything regarding how Mahīrāja had arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
jayacaṃdrastu tacchrutvā cāhūya jananāyakam ..
vacanaṃ prāha kruddhātmā śṛṇu gautamavaṃśaja .. 38 ..
meaning:
जयचंद्रस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा चाहूय जननायकम् ..
वचनं प्राह क्रुद्धात्मा शृणु गौतमवंशज .. 38 ..
text_mt: Having heard that, Jayacandra summoned the leader of men / and, enraged in his soul, spoke these words: 'Listen, O scion of the Gautama race!

sanskrit_iast:
rājā parimalaḥ krūrastyaktvā māṃ nijabhūpatim ..
prītiṃ ca kṛtavāṃstena macchatrordehalīpateḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
राजा परिमलः क्रूरस्त्यक्त्वा मां निजभूपतिम् ..
प्रीतिं च कृतवांस्तेन मच्छत्रोर्देहलीपतेः .. 39 ..
text_mt: Cruel King Parimala abandoned me, his own king, / and made friendship with that enemy of mine, the lord of Dehalī.

sanskrit_iast:
priyaṃ saṃbadhinaṃ matvā saṃtyaktāstena rakṣakāḥ ..
yathā kṛtaṃ phalaṃ tena bhoktavyaṃ ca tathā bhuvi .. 3.3.27.40 ..
meaning:
प्रियं संबधिनं मत्वा संत्यक्तास्तेन रक्षकाः ..
यथा कृतं फलं तेन भोक्तव्यं च तथा भुवि .. 3.3.27.40 ..
text_mt: Considering him a beloved relation by marriage, he discarded his protectors; / he must reap on earth the fruit according as he has acted.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ prāha namradhīḥ ..
rājañchuddhaḥ parimalo mahīpatyanuvācakaḥ ..
ato vai tvāṃ samutsṛjya bhūmirājavaśaṃ gataḥ ..41..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं कृष्णांशः प्राह नम्रधीः ..
राजञ्छुद्धः परिमलो महीपत्यनुवाचकः ..
अतो वै त्वां समुत्सृज्य भूमिराजवशं गतः ..41..
text_mt: Hearing these words, the part of Kṛṣṇa, of humble mind, said: / 'O King, Parimala was blameless, acting upon the word of the king of the earth; / therefore indeed, abandoning you, he fell under the sway of Bhūmirāja.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavānvai sarvadharmajñastatkṣamasvāparādhakam ..
ājñāṃ dehi mahārāja nivatsyāmastadaṃtikam.. 42 ..
meaning:
भवान्वै सर्वधर्मज्ञस्तत्क्षमस्वापराधकम् ..
आज्ञां देहि महाराज निवत्स्यामस्तदंतिकम्.. 42 ..
text_mt: You know all dharma; therefore forgive his offence. / Give your command, O great king: we shall dwell near him.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ jayacaṃdro mahīpatiḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ prāha bho vīra dehi me bhuktimūlyakam ..
śīghraṃ vraja tvaṃ sakulo no cenno gaṃtumarhasi .. 43 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं जयचंद्रो महीपतिः ..
कृष्णांशं प्राह भो वीर देहि मे भुक्तिमूल्यकम् ..
शीघ्रं व्रज त्वं सकुलो नो चेन्नो गंतुमर्हसि .. 43 ..
text_mt: Hearing these words, King Jayacandra / said to the part of Kṛṣṇa: 'O hero, pay me the tribute of usufruct; / go quickly with your family; otherwise you ought not to go.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vihasyāha kṛṣṇāṃśassarvamohanaḥ ..
mayā digvijayaḥ sarvaḥ kṛto bhīrubhayaṃkaraḥ ..
taddeyaṃ dehi me rājangṛhāṇa bhuktimūlyakam..44..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा विहस्याह कृष्णांशस्सर्वमोहनः ..
मया दिग्विजयः सर्वः कृतो भीरुभयंकरः ..
तद्देयं देहि मे राजन्गृहाण भुक्तिमूल्यकम्..44..
text_mt: Hearing this, laughing, the part of Kṛṣṇa, who enchants everyone, said: / 'I carried out the conquest of all quarters, terrifying to cowards; / give me that which is to be given, O King, and take your tribute of usufruct!'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktassa tu bhūpālaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśena vilajjitaḥ ..
sainyamājñāpayāmāsa saptalakṣaṃ mahābalam .. 45 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तस्स तु भूपालः कृष्णांशेन विलज्जितः ..
सैन्यमाज्ञापयामास सप्तलक्षं महाबलम् .. 45 ..
text_mt: Spoken to thus by the part of Kṛṣṇa, that king felt ashamed; / he commanded an army of seven hundred thousand of great might.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā vai sakulo vīraścāhlādo lakṣaṇānvitaḥ ..
nṛpasyāgre samāsthāya namaskṛtya yayau mudā .. 46 ..
meaning:
तदा वै सकुलो वीरश्चाह्लादो लक्षणान्वितः ..
नृपस्याग्रे समास्थाय नमस्कृत्य ययौ मुदा .. 46 ..
text_mt: Then indeed, the hero Āhlāda, accompanied by his family and Lakṣaṇa, / stood before the king, paid homage, and departed with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṭhāranagaraṃ prāpya nṛpadurgaṃ rurodha ha ..
jñātvā sa vāmano bhūpaḥ pratodaṃ ca dadau mudā .. 47 ..
meaning:
कुठारनगरं प्राप्य नृपदुर्गं रुरोध ह ..
ज्ञात्वा स वामनो भूपः प्रतोदं च ददौ मुदा .. 47 ..
text_mt: Having reached the city of Kuṭhāra, he besieged the king's fortress. / Understanding this, King Vāmana joyfully gave him an iron-tipped goad.

sanskrit_iast:
sainyāyuta yutaṃ bhūpaṃ vāmanaṃ lakṣaṇo balī ..
paścātkṛtya yayau śīghraṃ yamunātaṭamuttamam .. 48 ..
meaning:
सैन्यायुत युतं भूपं वामनं लक्षणो बली ..
पश्चात्कृत्य ययौ शीघ्रं यमुनातटमुत्तमम् .. 48 ..
text_mt: Placing King Vāmana, endowed with ten thousand troops, behind him, / mighty Lakṣaṇa quickly went to the excellent bank of the Yamunā.

sanskrit_iast:
yamunājalamuttīrya kalpakṣetramavāptavān..
gaṃgāsiṃhaṃ ca nṛpatiṃ ṣaṣṭisāhasrasaṃyutam ..
puraskṛtya yayau vīro lakṣaṇo balavattaraḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
यमुनाजलमुत्तीर्य कल्पक्षेत्रमवाप्तवान्..
गंगासिंहं च नृपतिं षष्टिसाहस्रसंयुतम् ..
पुरस्कृत्य ययौ वीरो लक्षणो बलवत्तरः .. 49 ..
text_mt: Crossing the waters of the Yamunā, he reached the field of Kalpa; / placing King Gaṅgāsiṃha, accompanied by sixty thousand [soldiers], at the front, / the more powerful hero Lakṣaṇa went forward.

sanskrit_iast:
nadīṃ vetravatīṃ ramyāṃ samāgamya balaissaha ..
tatroṣuḥ kṣatriyāḥ śūrāssarva śastrāstrasaṃyutāḥ .. 3.3.27.50 ..
meaning:
नदीं वेत्रवतीं रम्यां समागम्य बलैस्सह ..
तत्रोषुः क्षत्रियाः शूरास्सर्व शस्त्रास्त्रसंयुताः .. 3.3.27.50 ..
text_mt: Having approached the charming river Vetravatī along with their forces, / the valiant kṣatriyas, equipped with all weapons and missiles, encamped there.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare vīraścāmuṃḍo lakṣasainyapaḥ ..
śataghnīḥ sthāpayāmāsa bhairavīḥ śatrunāśinīḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे वीरश्चामुंडो लक्षसैन्यपः ..
शतघ्नीः स्थापयामास भैरवीः शत्रुनाशिनीः .. 51 ..
text_mt: Meanwhile, the hero Cāmuṇḍa, commander of a hundred thousand troops, / set up the Bhairavī śataghnī cannons that destroy enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ śataghrīraṇasaṃsthayoḥ ..
praharānte ca tatsainyaṃ dṛṣṭvā śūraḥ parājitam .. 52 ..
meaning:
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धं शतघ्रीरणसंस्थयोः ..
प्रहरान्ते च तत्सैन्यं दृष्ट्वा शूरः पराजितम् .. 52 ..
text_mt: A great battle arose between the two who stood in the battle of cannons. / And at the end of a watch, seeing his army routed, the hero

sanskrit_iast:
raktabījaḥ samāgamya gajasthastvarito balī..
svabāṇaistāḍayāmāsa sainyaṃ tālanapālitam .. 53 ..
meaning:
रक्तबीजः समागम्य गजस्थस्त्वरितो बली..
स्वबाणैस्ताडयामास सैन्यं तालनपालितम् .. 53 ..
text_mt: Raktabīja, mounted on an elephant, advanced quickly, being mighty; / with his arrows he struck down the army protected by Tālana.

sanskrit_iast:
kecicchūrā hatā yuddhe kecittatra parājitāḥ ..
dudruvurbhayabhītāśca cāmuṃḍena ca pīḍitāḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
केचिच्छूरा हता युद्धे केचित्तत्र पराजिताः ..
दुद्रुवुर्भयभीताश्च चामुंडेन च पीडिताः .. 54 ..
text_mt: Some warriors were killed in battle, some were routed there; / terrified, they fled, afflicted by Cāmuṇḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
prabhagnaṃ svabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā tālanaḥ parighāyudhaḥ ..
jaghāna tena sa gajaṃ cāmuṃḍo bhūmimāgataḥ 55 ..
meaning:
प्रभग्नं स्वबलं दृष्ट्वा तालनः परिघायुधः ..
जघान तेन स गजं चामुंडो भूमिमागतः 55 ..
text_mt: Seeing his army broken, Tālana, armed with an iron club, / struck his elephant with it; Cāmuṇḍa fell to the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
khaḍgayuddhaparo vīrastālanaṃ pīraghāyudham..
parājitya yayau paścācchatru sainyakṣayaṃkaraḥ ..56..
meaning:
खड्गयुद्धपरो वीरस्तालनं पीरघायुधम्..
पराजित्य ययौ पश्चाच्छत्रु सैन्यक्षयंकरः ..56..
text_mt: Devoted to sword-fighting, the hero defeated Tālana, whose weapon was an iron club; / bringing destruction upon the enemy army, he then withdrew.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇastvarito gatvā svabhallena ca taṃ ripum ..
bhujayostāḍayāmāsa tadā te bahudhā'bhavan.. 57 ..
meaning:
लक्षणस्त्वरितो गत्वा स्वभल्लेन च तं रिपुम् ..
भुजयोस्ताडयामास तदा ते बहुधाऽभवन्.. 57 ..
text_mt: Going swiftly, Lakṣaṇa struck that enemy / on both arms with his spear; then they multiplied into many.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraṃ raktabījāśca khaḍga śaktyṛṣṭipāṇayaḥ ..
tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti bhāṣantaḥ kṣatriyānyuddhadurmadān .. 58 ..
meaning:
सहस्रं रक्तबीजाश्च खड्ग शक्त्यृष्टिपाणयः ..
तिष्ठतिष्ठेति भाषन्तः क्षत्रियान्युद्धदुर्मदान् .. 58 ..
text_mt: A thousand Raktabījas, holding swords, spears, and lances in hand, / saying 'Halt, halt!' [attacked] the kṣatriyas who were reckless in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
āhlādādyāśca te śūrā raktabījabhayāturāḥ ..
tyaktvā yuddhaṃ yayussarve brahmānaṃdaṃ mahābalam .. 59 ..
meaning:
आह्लादाद्याश्च ते शूरा रक्तबीजभयातुराः ..
त्यक्त्वा युद्धं ययुस्सर्वे ब्रह्मानंदं महाबलम् .. 59 ..
text_mt: And Āhlāda and those other warriors, frantic with fear of Raktabīja, / abandoned the fight and all went to the mighty Brahmānanda.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmānaṃdastu tāndṛṣṭvā gatvā svapitaraṃ prati ..
vṛttāṃtaṃ kathayāmāsa lakṣaṇāgamanaṃ mune .. 3.3.27.60 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मानंदस्तु तान्दृष्ट्वा गत्वा स्वपितरं प्रति ..
वृत्तांतं कथयामास लक्षणागमनं मुने .. 3.3.27.60 ..
text_mt: Seeing them, Brahmānanda went to his father / and reported the matter, O sage, [including] the arrival of Lakṣaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā parimalo rājā premavihvalagadgadaḥ ..
āhlādapārśvamāgamya ruroda bhṛśamāturaḥ .. 61 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा परिमलो राजा प्रेमविह्वलगद्गदः ..
आह्लादपार्श्वमागम्य रुरोद भृशमातुरः .. 61 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, King Parimala, choking, overcome with love, / came to Āhlāda's side and wept bitterly, greatly distressed.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu devakī devī nṛpatiṃ prematatparam ..
uvāca sumukhī dīnā vayaṃ te bhakti tatparāḥ .. 62 ..
meaning:
तदा तु देवकी देवी नृपतिं प्रेमतत्परम् ..
उवाच सुमुखी दीना वयं ते भक्ति तत्पराः .. 62 ..
text_mt: Then fair-faced Queen Devakī, looking miserable, / spoke to the king who was devoted to affection: 'We were devoted in devotion to you.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavatā saṃparityaktā vicarāmo'nyabhūpatim ..
kṣamasva mama daurātmyaṃ pūrvajanmavipākajam.. 63 ..
meaning:
भवता संपरित्यक्ता विचरामोऽन्यभूपतिम् ..
क्षमस्व मम दौरात्म्यं पूर्वजन्मविपाकजम्.. 63 ..
text_mt: Abandoned by you, we approached another king. / Forgive my wickedness born of the ripening of deeds in a previous birth.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā ca nṛpatiḥ paramā naṃdanirbharaḥ ..
maṃtriṇaścādhikāraṃ ca rāmāṃśāya dadau mudā ..
svakīyaṃ lakṣasainyaṃ ca tatpatiścodayaḥ kṛtaḥ .. 64 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा च नृपतिः परमा नंदनिर्भरः ..
मंत्रिणश्चाधिकारं च रामांशाय ददौ मुदा ..
स्वकीयं लक्षसैन्यं च तत्पतिश्चोदयः कृतः .. 64 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, the king was filled with supreme joy; / he joyfully granted the office of minister to the part of Rāma, / and as for his own army of a hundred thousand, Udaya was made its commander.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ paṃcadinānte tu mahīrājassamāgataḥ ..
rurodha nagarīṃ sarvāṃ cāmuṃḍabaladarpitaḥ ..
tayoścāsīnmahayuddhaṃ māsamātraṃ bhayānakam ..65..
meaning:
ततः पंचदिनान्ते तु महीराजस्समागतः ..
रुरोध नगरीं सर्वां चामुंडबलदर्पितः ..
तयोश्चासीन्महयुद्धं मासमात्रं भयानकम् ..65..
text_mt: Then, at the end of five days, Mahīrāja arrived; / haughty with the strength of Cāmuṇḍa, he besieged the whole city. / And between the two there was a dreadful battle lasting for an entire month.

sanskrit_iast:
prabhāte vimale jāte kṛṣṇāṃśo lakṣasainyapaḥ..
cāmuḍāntamupāgamya sahasraṃ svāṃgasaṃbhavam ..
ciccheda ca śirasteṣāṃ cāmuṃḍānāṃ pṛthakpṛthak .. 66 ..
meaning:
प्रभाते विमले जाते कृष्णांशो लक्षसैन्यपः..
चामुडान्तमुपागम्य सहस्रं स्वांगसंभवम् ..
चिच्छेद च शिरस्तेषां चामुंडानां पृथक्पृथक् .. 66 ..
text_mt: When pure dawn appeared, the part of Kṛṣṇa, leader of a hundred thousand soldiers, / approached Cāmuṇḍa; the thousand born from his body— / he severed the heads of each and every one of those Cāmuṇḍas.

sanskrit_iast:
chinne śirasi te sarve lakṣavīrā babhūvire ..
tadā tadvyākulaṃ sainyaṃ cāmuṇḍaistaiḥ prapīḍitam ..67..
meaning:
छिन्ने शिरसि ते सर्वे लक्षवीरा बभूविरे ..
तदा तद्व्याकुलं सैन्यं चामुण्डैस्तैः प्रपीडितम् ..67..
text_mt: When the heads were severed, they all became a hundred thousand warriors. / Then that army became distressed, tormented by those Cāmuṇḍas.

sanskrit_iast:
vismitaścaiva kṛṣṇāṃśo bhayabhītastadā mune ..
tuṣṭāva śāradāṃ devīṃ sarvamaṃgalakāriṇīm .. 68 ..
meaning:
विस्मितश्चैव कृष्णांशो भयभीतस्तदा मुने ..
तुष्टाव शारदां देवीं सर्वमंगलकारिणीम् .. 68 ..
text_mt: Both astonished and terrified then, O sage, the part of Kṛṣṇa / praised goddess Śāradā, the bringer of all auspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśa uvāca..
namaste śārade mātarbrahmalokanivāsini..
tvayā tatamidaṃ viśvaṃ śabdamātraniraṃtaram..69..
meaning:
कृष्णांश उवाच..
नमस्ते शारदे मातर्ब्रह्मलोकनिवासिनि..
त्वया ततमिदं विश्वं शब्दमात्रनिरंतरम्..69..
text_mt: The part of Kṛṣṇa said: / 'Homage to you, Mother Śāradā, dweller in the world of Brahmā! / By you this entire universe is pervaded perpetually by mere sound.

sanskrit_iast:
raktabījavināśāya cāmuṃḍārūpadhāriṇi..
namaste divyacāmuṇḍe pāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam..3.3.27.70..
meaning:
रक्तबीजविनाशाय चामुंडारूपधारिणि..
नमस्ते दिव्यचामुण्डे पाहि मां शरणागतम्..3.3.27.70..
text_mt: O you who assume the form of Cāmuṇḍā for the destruction of Raktabīja, / homage to you, divine Cāmuṇḍā; protect me who have come for refuge!'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā stavaṃ devī varadā sarvakāriṇī..
tasya khaḍgamupāgamya raktabījaṃ dadāha vai.. 71..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा स्तवं देवी वरदा सर्वकारिणी..
तस्य खड्गमुपागम्य रक्तबीजं ददाह वै.. 71..
text_mt: Hearing this hymn of praise, the goddess, giver of boons and maker of all, / entered his sword and indeed burnt Raktabīja to ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmībhūte lakṣaripau cāmuṇḍo bhūmimāgataḥ..
babaṃdha taṃ sa kṛṣṇāṃśo brahmānaṃdāṃtikaṃ yayau..
bhūmirājastu tacchrutvā bhayabhītaḥ samāgataḥ..
tadā parimalaṃ bhūpaṃ dayāluṃ premavihvalam ..
uvāca vacanaṃ rājā kṣamasva mama duṣkṛtam .. 73 ..
meaning:
भस्मीभूते लक्षरिपौ चामुण्डो भूमिमागतः..
बबंध तं स कृष्णांशो ब्रह्मानंदांतिकं ययौ..
भूमिराजस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा भयभीतः समागतः..
तदा परिमलं भूपं दयालुं प्रेमविह्वलम् ..
उवाच वचनं राजा क्षमस्व मम दुष्कृतम् .. 73 ..
text_mt: When the hundred thousand enemies were reduced to ashes, Cāmuṇḍa fell to the ground; / that part of Kṛṣṇa bound him and went near Brahmānanda. / Hearing of that, Bhūmirāja, terrified, came there; / then to King Parimala, who was compassionate and overcome with love, / the king spoke these words: 'Forgive my misdeed!

sanskrit_iast:
mahīpateśca vacanānmahadbhayamupāgatam ..
adyaprabhṛti bho vīra saṃtyaktaḥ kalahaḥ priyaḥ ..
bhavāṃśca mama saṃbandhī vayaṃ vai tava kiṃkarāḥ ..74 ..
meaning:
महीपतेश्च वचनान्महद्भयमुपागतम् ..
अद्यप्रभृति भो वीर संत्यक्तः कलहः प्रियः ..
भवांश्च मम संबन्धी वयं वै तव किंकराः ..74 ..
text_mt: Great fear has overtaken me due to the command of the king of the earth. / From this day forth, O hero, sweet strife is abandoned; / you are my relative, and we are indeed your servants.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā parimalo rājānamidamabravīt ..
ratnabhānośca tanayaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ nāma viśrutam ..
śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāhi viṣṇubhaktaṃ dayāparam .. 75 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा परिमलो राजानमिदमब्रवीत् ..

meaning:

text_mt: Hearing these charming words, the learned men, skilled in the Śāstras, / spoke pleasing words to Kṛṣṇāṃśa, who was conversant with all dharma:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: Then, having been foiled, she wept copiously and piteously. / Seeing her weeping, he, compassionate and cheerful-minded,

sanskrit_iast:

ityuktvā māyayā dhūrtā kṛtvā śavamayāntyajān .. 32 ..
meaning:
अतो रौमि महाभाग संप्राप्ता शरणं त्वयि ..
इत्युक्त्वा मायया धूर्ता कृत्वा शवमयान्त्यजान् .. 32 ..
text_mt: Therefore I lament, O noble one, and have sought refuge in you!” / Having said this, that rogue by her illusion created outcasts made of corpses,

sanskrit_iast:
tasmai pradarśayāmāsa nijakāryaparāyaṇā ..
ruditvā ca punastatra prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ samudyatā .. 33 ..
meaning:
तस्मै प्रदर्शयामास निजकार्यपरायणा ..
रुदित्वा च पुनस्तत्र प्राणांस्त्यक्तुं समुद्यता .. 33 ..
text_mt: And showed them to him, intent upon her own objective; / and having wept again there, she made as if to abandon her life.

sanskrit_iast:
dayālussa ca kṛṣṇāṃśastāmāha karuṇaṃ vacaḥ ..
kathaṃ te jīvayiṣyanti śobhane kathayāśu me .. 34 ..
meaning:
दयालुस्स च कृष्णांशस्तामाह करुणं वचः ..
कथं ते जीवयिष्यन्ति शोभने कथयाशु मे .. 34 ..
text_mt: Compassionate Kṛṣṇāṃśa addressed piteous words to her: / “How will they revive, O fair one? Tell me quickly!”

sanskrit_iast:
sāha vīra tavāsye tu saṃsthitā guṭikā śubhā ..
dehi me kṛpayā vīra jīvayiṣyanti te tathā .. 35 ..
meaning:
साह वीर तवास्ये तु संस्थिता गुटिका शुभा ..
देहि मे कृपया वीर जीवयिष्यन्ति ते तथा .. 35 ..
text_mt: She said: “O hero, the auspicious pill that rests in your mouth— / give it to me out of pity, O hero, and then they will revive.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktastu tayā vīro dadau tasyai ca tadvasu..
tadā prasannā sā dhūrtā kṛtvā śukamayaṃ vapuḥ ..
paṃjarasthamupādāya kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ kāmavihvalā .. 36 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तस्तु तया वीरो ददौ तस्यै च तद्वसु..
तदा प्रसन्ना सा धूर्ता कृत्वा शुकमयं वपुः ..
पंजरस्थमुपादाय कृष्णांशं कामविह्वला .. 36 ..
text_mt: Thus addressed by her, the hero gave her that treasure. / Then delighted, that rogue, taking the form of a parrot, / took Kṛṣṇāṃśa in a cage, being overcome with passion.

sanskrit_iast:
bāhlīkadeśamāgamya sāraṭṭanagaraṃ śubham ..
uvāsa ca svayaṃ gehe kṛtvā divyamayaṃ vapuḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
बाह्लीकदेशमागम्य सारट्टनगरं शुभम् ..
उवास च स्वयं गेहे कृत्वा दिव्यमयं वपुः .. 37 ..
text_mt: Having arrived in the country of Bāhlīka, at the auspicious city of Sāraṭṭa, / she assumed a divine form and lived in her own house.

sanskrit_iast:
niśīthe samanuprāpte kṛtvā taṃ nararūpiṇam ..
āliliṃga hi kāmārtā kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ dharmakovidam .. 38 ..
meaning:
निशीथे समनुप्राप्ते कृत्वा तं नररूपिणम् ..
आलिलिंग हि कामार्ता कृष्णांशं धर्मकोविदम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: When midnight arrived, she turned him into human form, / and, afflicted with love, she embraced Kṛṣṇāṃśa, who was learned in dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ sa tathābhūtāṃ kṛṣṇāṃśo jagadaṃbikām ..
tuṣṭāva manasā dhīro rātrisūktena namradhīḥ ..39..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तां स तथाभूतां कृष्णांशो जगदंबिकाम् ..
तुष्टाव मनसा धीरो रात्रिसूक्तेन नम्रधीः ..39..
text_mt: Seeing her in that state, the steadfast Kṛṣṇāṃśa praised the Mother of the Universe in his mind with the Rātrisūkta, his intellect bowed in devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā sā sveḍinī bhūtvā tyaktvā kṛṣṇāṃśamuttamam ..
punaḥ śukamayaṃ kṛtvā ciṃciṇīvṛkṣamāruhat .. 3.3.28.40 ..
meaning:
तदा सा स्वेडिनी भूत्वा त्यक्त्वा कृष्णांशमुत्तमम् ..
पुनः शुकमयं कृत्वा चिंचिणीवृक्षमारुहत् .. 3.3.28.40 ..
text_mt: Then, becoming a lizard [and] abandoning the noble Kṛṣṇāṃśa, / she turned him back into a parrot and climbed a tamarind tree.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā svarṇavatī devī bodhitā viṣṇumāyayā ..
kṛtvā śyenīmayaṃ rūpaṃ tatra gatvā mudānvitā ..
dadarśa śukabhūtaṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ yogatatparam 41 ..
meaning:
तदा स्वर्णवती देवी बोधिता विष्णुमायया ..
कृत्वा श्येनीमयं रूपं तत्र गत्वा मुदान्विता ..
ददर्श शुकभूतं च कृष्णांशं योगतत्परम् 41 ..
text_mt: Then the noble woman Svarṇavatī, awakened by the Māyā of Viṣṇu, / assumed the form of a female falcon and went there full of joy, / and she beheld Kṛṣṇāṃśa, who had become a parrot, intent upon yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare veśyā punaḥ kṛtvā śubhaṃ vapuḥ ..
narabhūtaṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे वेश्या पुनः कृत्वा शुभं वपुः ..
नरभूतं च कृष्णांशं वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः .. 42 ..
text_mt: Meanwhile, the courtesan assumed a beautiful form once again, / and, with a bowed mind, spoke these words to Kṛṣṇāṃśa who had become a man:

sanskrit_iast:
aye prāṇapriya svāminbhaja māṃ kāmavihvalām ..
pāhi māṃ ratidānena dharmajñosi bhavānsadā .. 43 ..
meaning:
अये प्राणप्रिय स्वामिन्भज मां कामविह्वलाम् ..
पाहि मां रतिदानेन धर्मज्ञोसि भवान्सदा .. 43 ..
text_mt: "O lord dear as life, make love to me who am overwhelmed with desire! / Protect me by granting sexual pleasure; you are ever a knower of dharma."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktassa tu tāmāha vacanaṃ śṛṇu śobhane ..
te āryavartmasthitohaṃ vai vedamārgaparāyaṇaḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तस्स तु तामाह वचनं शृणु शोभने ..
ते आर्यवर्त्मस्थितोहं वै वेदमार्गपरायणः .. 44 ..
text_mt: Being addressed thus, he said to her: "Listen to my words, O fair one! / I abide in the path of the Āryas, devoted to the way of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
vivāhitāṃ śubhāṃ nārīṃ yo bhajeta ṛtau na hi ..
sa pāpī narakaṃ yāti tiryyagyonimayaṃ smṛtam ..
ataḥ parastriyā bhogo jñeyo vai nirayapradaḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
विवाहितां शुभां नारीं यो भजेत ऋतौ न हि ..
स पापी नरकं याति तिर्य्यग्योनिमयं स्मृतम् ..
अतः परस्त्रिया भोगो ज्ञेयो वै निरयप्रदः .. 45 ..
text_mt: Whoever does not make love to his lawfully wedded, auspicious wife in her fertile period, / that sinner goes to hell, remembered as being of animal wombs. / Therefore, enjoying another's wife must truly be understood as bringing hell.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu sā prāha viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā ..
śṛṃgiṇā ca mahāprājña veśyāsaṃgaḥ kṛtaḥ purā ..
na ko'pi narakaṃ prāptastasmānmāṃ bhaja kāminīm .. 46 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु सा प्राह विश्वामित्रेण धीमता ..
शृंगिणा च महाप्राज्ञ वेश्यासंगः कृतः पुरा ..
न कोऽपि नरकं प्राप्तस्तस्मान्मां भज कामिनीम् .. 46 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, she said: "By the wise Viśvāmitra / and by Śṛṅgin, O greatly wise one, union with courtesans was performed in ancient times, / and neither went to hell; therefore, make love to me, a woman full of passion!"

sanskrit_iast:
punaścāha sa kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ kṛttaṃ pāpaṃ tapobalāt ..
tābhyāṃ ca muniyugmābhyāmasamartho hi sāṃpratam .. 47 ..
meaning:
पुनश्चाह स कृष्णांशः कृत्तं पापं तपोबलात् ..
ताभ्यां च मुनियुग्माभ्यामसमर्थो हि सांप्रतम् .. 47 ..
text_mt: Kṛṣṇāṃśa spoke again: "That sin was severed by the power of their austerities / by those two sages, but I am incapable [of that] at present.

sanskrit_iast:
arddhāṃgaṃ puruṣasya strī maithune ca viśeṣataḥ ..
ahamāryaśca bhavatī veśyā ca bahubhoginī .. 48 ..
meaning:
अर्द्धांगं पुरुषस्य स्त्री मैथुने च विशेषतः ..
अहमार्यश्च भवती वेश्या च बहुभोगिनी .. 48 ..
text_mt: A woman is half the body of a man, especially during sexual union. / I am an Ārya, and you are a courtesan enjoyed by many.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛci śabdaśca pūrvāsyājjāta ṛgjassanātanaḥ ..
yogajaścaiva yaḥ śabdo dakṣiṇāsyādyajurbhavaḥ ..49..
meaning:
ऋचि शब्दश्च पूर्वास्याज्जात ऋग्जस्सनातनः ..
योगजश्चैव यः शब्दो दक्षिणास्याद्यजुर्भवः ..49..
text_mt: The sound born in the ṛc arose from the eastern mouth, born of the Ṛgveda, eternal; / and the sound born of yoga is from the southern mouth, originating from the Yajurveda;

sanskrit_iast:
taddhitāntaśca yaśśabdaḥ paścimāsyācca sāmajaḥ ..
chandobhūtāśca ye śabdās te sarve brāhmaṇapriyāḥ ..
kevalo varṇamātraśca sa śabdo'tharvajaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 3.3.28.50 ..
meaning:
तद्धितान्तश्च यश्शब्दः पश्चिमास्याच्च सामजः ..
छन्दोभूताश्च ये शब्दास् ते सर्वे ब्राह्मणप्रियाः ..
केवलो वर्णमात्रश्च स शब्दोऽथर्वजः स्मृतः .. 3.3.28.50 ..
text_mt: and the sound ending in a taddhita suffix is from the western mouth, originating from the Sāmaveda. / And those sounds that consist of metre are all dear to brāhmaṇas; / and that sound which is a mere phoneme is remembered as born from the Atharvaveda.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamāsyācca ye jātāḥ śabdāḥ saṃsārakāriṇaḥ ..
te sarve prākṛtā jñeyāścaturlakṣavibhedinaḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
पञ्चमास्याच्च ये जाताः शब्दाः संसारकारिणः ..
ते सर्वे प्राकृता ज्ञेयाश्चतुर्लक्षविभेदिनः .. 51 ..
text_mt: And the sounds born from the fifth mouth, which bring about worldly existence, / all those are to be known as Prākrit, divided into four hundred thousand varieties.

sanskrit_iast:
hitvā tānyo hi śuddhātmā caturvedaparāyaṇaḥ ..
sa vai bhavāṭavīṃ tyaktvā padaṃ gacchatyanāmayam .. 52 ..
meaning:
हित्वा तान्यो हि शुद्धात्मा चतुर्वेदपरायणः ..
स वै भवाटवीं त्यक्त्वा पदं गच्छत्यनामयम् .. 52 ..
text_mt: Abandoning those, the pure-souled one who is devoted to the four Vedas / abandons the wilderness of worldly existence and goes to the sorrowless state.

sanskrit_iast:
na vadedyāvanīṃ bhāṣāṃ prāṇaiḥ kaṃṭhagatairapi ..
gajairāpīḍayamāno'pi na gacchejjainamaṃdiram .. 53 ..
meaning:
न वदेद्यावनीं भाषां प्राणैः कंठगतैरपि ..
गजैरापीडयमानोऽपि न गच्छेज्जैनमंदिरम् .. 53 ..
text_mt: One should not speak the Yāvana tongue even if one's breath reaches one's throat; / even if being crushed by elephants, one should not enter a Jaina temple.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ smṛtivākyāni muninā paṭhitāni vai ..
kathaṃ tyājyo mayā dharmassarvalokasukhapradaḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
इत्येवं स्मृतिवाक्यानि मुनिना पठितानि वै ..
कथं त्याज्यो मया धर्मस्सर्वलोकसुखप्रदः .. 54 ..
text_mt: Thus indeed are the statements of Smṛti recited by the sage! / How can dharma, which grants happiness to all worlds, be abandoned by me?"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu sā veśyā mlecchāyāścāṃśasaṃbhavā ..
śobhanā nāma raṃbhorūrmahākrodhamupāyayau .. 55 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु सा वेश्या म्लेच्छायाश्चांशसंभवा ..
शोभना नाम रंभोरूर्महाक्रोधमुपाययौ .. 55 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, that courtesan, who arose from a portion of a mleccha woman, / named Śobhanā, having thighs like plantain trunks, fell into a great rage.

sanskrit_iast:
vetasaistāḍayitvā taṃ punaḥ kṛtvā śukaṃ svayam ..
na dadau bhojanaṃ tasmai phalāhāraṃ śukāya vai .. 56 ..
meaning:
वेतसैस्ताडयित्वा तं पुनः कृत्वा शुकं स्वयम् ..
न ददौ भोजनं तस्मै फलाहारं शुकाय वै .. 56 ..
text_mt: Striking him with canes, turning him into a parrot herself once more, / she gave no food, no meal of fruits to the parrot.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā svarṇavatī devī kṛtvā nārīmayaṃ vapuḥ ..
maśakīkṛtya taṃ vīraṃ tatraivāntardadhe tu sā .. 57 ..
meaning:
तदा स्वर्णवती देवी कृत्वा नारीमयं वपुः ..
मशकीकृत्य तं वीरं तत्रैवान्तर्दधे तु सा .. 57 ..
text_mt: Then the noble woman Svarṇavatī assumed a female form, / turned that hero into a mosquito, and vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ śyenīvapuḥ kṛtvā taddeśādyātumudyatā ..
pṛṣṭhamāropya maśakaṃ mayūranagaraṃ yayau .. 58 .
meaning:
पुनः श्येनीवपुः कृत्वा तद्देशाद्यातुमुद्यता ..
पृष्ठमारोप्य मशकं मयूरनगरं ययौ .. 58 .
text_mt: Assuming once again the body of a female falcon, she prepared to depart from that land; / setting the mosquito on her back, she went to Mayūranagara.

sanskrit_iast:
makaraṃdastu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇāṃśena samanvitām ..
netrapālasya tanayāṃ nāmnā svarṇavatī balī ..
caraṇāvupasaṃgṛhya svagehe tāmavāsayat .. 59 ..
meaning:
मकरंदस्तु तां दृष्ट्वा कृष्णांशेन समन्विताम् ..
नेत्रपालस्य तनयां नाम्ना स्वर्णवती बली ..
चरणावुपसंगृह्य स्वगेहे तामवासयत् .. 59 ..
text_mt: Seeing her accompanied by Kṛṣṇāṃśa— / the mighty daughter of Netrapāla, named Svarṇavatī— / Makaranda took hold of her feet and lodged her in his own house.

sanskrit_iast:
śobhanāpi ca saṃbudhya pañjarāntamupasthitā ..
na dadarśa śukaṃ ramyaṃ mūrchitā cāpatadbhuvi .. 3.3.28.60 ..
meaning:
शोभनापि च संबुध्य पञ्जरान्तमुपस्थिता ..
न ददर्श शुकं रम्यं मूर्छिता चापतद्भुवि .. 3.3.28.60 ..
text_mt: Śobhanā too, having awakened, approached the interior of the cage; / not seeing the charming parrot, she fell fainting to the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi vinā taṃ ramaṇaṃ param ..
ityeva bahudhālapya madahīnapuraṃ yayau .. 61 ..
meaning:
किं करोमि क्व गच्छामि विना तं रमणं परम् ..
इत्येव बहुधालप्य मदहीनपुरं ययौ .. 61 ..
text_mt: "What shall I do? Where shall I go without that supreme lover?" / Wailing thus in many ways, she went to the city of Madahīnapura.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra sthitaṃ ca paiśācaṃ māyāmadaviśāradam ..
mahāmadaṃ ca saṃpūjya svadehaṃ tyaktumudyatā .. 62 ..
meaning:
तत्र स्थितं च पैशाचं मायामदविशारदम् ..
महामदं च संपूज्य स्वदेहं त्यक्तुमुद्यता .. 62 ..
text_mt: Worshipping the Piśāca residing there, Mahāmada, / who was skilled in the madness of illusion, she prepared to give up her body.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāmadastu saṃtuṣṭo gatvā vai śivamaṃdiram ..
marusthaleśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tuṣṭāvārṣabhabhāṣayā .. 63 ..
meaning:
महामदस्तु संतुष्टो गत्वा वै शिवमंदिरम् ..
मरुस्थलेश्वरं लिंगं तुष्टावार्षभभाषया .. 63 ..
text_mt: Mahāmada, being well-pleased, went to a temple of Śiva / and praised the liṅga Marusthaleśvara in the language of bulls.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prasanno bhagavānvacanaṃ prāha sevakam ..
svarṇavatyā hṛto vīraḥ kṛṣṇāṃśaścāryadharmagaḥ ..
mayā saha samāgaccha mayūranagaraṃ prati .. 64 ..
meaning:
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवान्वचनं प्राह सेवकम् ..
स्वर्णवत्या हृतो वीरः कृष्णांशश्चार्यधर्मगः ..
मया सह समागच्छ मयूरनगरं प्रति .. 64 ..
text_mt: Then the blessed lord, being pleased, spoke words to his servant: / "The hero Kṛṣṇāṃśa, follower of the Āryan dharma, has been abducted by Svarṇavatī; / come together with me toward Mayūranagara."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktastena paiśāco naṭaiḥ paṃcasahasrakaiḥ ..
tayā saha yayau tūrṇaṃ sahureṇaṃ samanvitaḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तस्तेन पैशाचो नटैः पंचसहस्रकैः ..
तया सह ययौ तूर्णं सहुरेणं समन्वितः .. 65 ..
text_mt: Addressed thus by him, the Piśāca, with five thousand actors, / accompanied by Sahura, went quickly along with her.

sanskrit_iast:
indulaśca tathāhlādo bodhito viṣṇumāyayā ..
trilakṣabalasaṃyukto devasiṃhena saṃyutaḥ ..
mayūranagaraṃ prāpya makaraṃdamupāyayau ..66..
meaning:
इन्दुलश्च तथाह्लादो बोधितो विष्णुमायया ..
त्रिलक्षबलसंयुक्तो देवसिंहेन संयुतः ..
मयूरनगरं प्राप्य मकरंदमुपाययौ ..66..
text_mt: Indula and Āhlāda, awakened by the Māyā of Viṣṇu, / accompanied by a force of three hundred thousand, joined by Devasiṃha, / reached Mayūranagara and approached Makaranda.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu śobhanā veśyā sahureṇa balaissaha ..
cakāra bhairavīṃ māyāṃ sarvaśatrubhayaṃkarīm ..67..
meaning:
तदा तु शोभना वेश्या सहुरेण बलैस्सह ..
चकार भैरवीं मायां सर्वशत्रुभयंकरीम् ..67..
text_mt: Then the courtesan Śobhanā, together with Sahura and the troops, / produced a fierce Māyā that caused fear in all enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvataścotthito vāto mahāmeghasamanvitaḥ..
pataṃti bahudhā colkāḥ śarkarāvarṣaṇe ratāḥ .. 68
meaning:
सर्वतश्चोत्थितो वातो महामेघसमन्वितः..
पतंति बहुधा चोल्काः शर्करावर्षणे रताः .. 68
text_mt: A wind arose on all sides accompanied by great clouds; / meteors fell in various ways, occupied with raining down gravel.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ bhairavīṃ māyāṃ tamobhūtāṃ samantataḥ ..
makarandaśca balavānrathasthaḥ svayamāyayau .. 69 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तां भैरवीं मायां तमोभूतां समन्ततः ..
मकरन्दश्च बलवान्रथस्थः स्वयमाययौ .. 69 ..
text_mt: Seeing that fierce Māyā which had turned into darkness on all sides, / the mighty Makaranda came in person, mounted upon his chariot.

sanskrit_iast:
śanibhallena tāṃ māyāṃ bhasma kṛtvā mahābalaḥ ..
gṛhītvā sahuraṃ dhūrtaṃ sabalaṃ gehamāptavān .. 3.3.28.70 ..
meaning:
शनिभल्लेन तां मायां भस्म कृत्वा महाबलः ..
गृहीत्वा सहुरं धूर्तं सबलं गेहमाप्तवान् .. 3.3.28.70 ..
text_mt: Having reduced that Māyā to ash with his Saturn-spear, the greatly powerful one / seized the rogue Sahura along with his army and reached his home.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu śobhanā nārī kāmamāyāṃ cakāra ha ..
bahulāssaṃsthitā veśyā gītanṛtyaviśāradāḥ .. 71 ..
meaning:
तदा तु शोभना नारी काममायां चकार ह ..
बहुलास्संस्थिता वेश्या गीतनृत्यविशारदाः .. 71 ..
text_mt: Then the woman Śobhanā produced the Māyā of desire; / numerous courtesans stood there, skilled in singing and dancing.

sanskrit_iast:
mohitāḥ kṣatriyāḥ sarve mumuhurlāsyadarśanāt ..
devasiṃhācca kṛṣṇāṃśādṛte te jaḍatāṃ gatāḥ .. ..72..
meaning:
मोहिताः क्षत्रियाः सर्वे मुमुहुर्लास्यदर्शनात् ..
देवसिंहाच्च कृष्णांशादृते ते जडतां गताः .. ..72..
text_mt: All the kṣatriyas were bewitched and swooned from beholding the dance; / except for Devasiṃha and Kṛṣṇāṃśa, they lapsed into stupor.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā svarṇavatī devī kāmākṣī dhyānatatparā ..
punarutthāpya tānsarvāngṛhītvā śobhanāṃ punaḥ ..
mayūradhvajamāgamya nigaḍaistānbabaṃdha ha..73..
meaning:
तदा स्वर्णवती देवी कामाक्षी ध्यानतत्परा ..
पुनरुत्थाप्य तान्सर्वान्गृहीत्वा शोभनां पुनः ..
मयूरध्वजमागम्य निगडैस्तान्बबंध ह..73..
text_mt: Then the noble woman Svarṇavatī, intent on meditating upon Kāmākṣī, / revived them all again, seized Śobhanā once more, / came to Mayūradhvaja, and bound them with iron shackles.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāmadastu tajjñātvā rudradhyānaparāyaṇaḥ ..
cakāra śāmbarīṃ māyāṃ nānāsattvavidhāyinīm ..74..
meaning:
महामदस्तु तज्ज्ञात्वा रुद्रध्यानपरायणः ..
चकार शाम्बरीं मायां नानासत्त्वविधायिनीम् ..74..
text_mt: Knowing that, Mahāmada, intent upon meditating on Rudra, / created an illusory Māyā producing manifold creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāghrāḥ siṃhā varāhāśca vānarā daṃśakā narāḥ ..
sarpā gṛdhrāstathā kākā bhakṣayaṃti samaṃtataḥ .. 75 ..
meaning:
व्याघ्राः सिंहा वराहाश्च वानरा दंशका नराः ..
सर्पा गृध्रास्तथा काका भक्षयंति समंततः .. 75 ..
text_mt: Tigers, lions, boars, monkeys, biting flies, men, / serpents, vultures, and crows devoured [people] on all sides.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā svarṇavatī devī kāmākṣīdhyānatatparā ..
sasarja smarajāṃ māyāṃ tanmāyādhvaṃsinīṃ raṇe .. ..76..
meaning:
तदा स्वर्णवती देवी कामाक्षीध्यानतत्परा ..
ससर्ज स्मरजां मायां तन्मायाध्वंसिनीं रणे .. ..76..
text_mt: Then the noble woman Svarṇavatī, intent upon meditating on Kāmākṣī, / released a Māyā born of desire that destroyed his Māyā in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
tayā tārkṣyāssamutpannāḥ śarabhāśca mahābalāḥ ..
siṃhādīnbhakṣayāmāsurjaghnuścaiva sahasraśaḥ ..77..
meaning:
तया तार्क्ष्यास्समुत्पन्नाः शरभाश्च महाबलाः ..
सिंहादीन्भक्षयामासुर्जघ्नुश्चैव सहस्रशः ..77..
text_mt: From it, eagles and exceedingly strong śarabhas arose; / they devoured the lions and other beasts and slew them by the thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
hāhābhūte ca tatsainye dikṣu vidrāvite sati ..
śobhanā cābhavaddāsī svarṇavatyāśca māyinī .. 78..
meaning:
हाहाभूते च तत्सैन्ये दिक्षु विद्राविते सति ..
शोभना चाभवद्दासी स्वर्णवत्याश्च मायिनी .. 78..
text_mt: When that army burst into cries of distress and was routed in all directions, / Śobhanā the sorceress became the maidservant of Svarṇavatī.

sanskrit_iast:
sahurastairnaṭaissārddhaṃ cāhlādenaiva cūrṇitaḥ ..
teṣāṃ rudhirakabhāśca? bhūmimadhye samāruhan .. 79 ..
meaning:
सहुरस्तैर्नटैस्सार्द्धं चाह्लादेनैव चूर्णितः ..
तेषां रुधिरकभाश्च? भूमिमध्ये समारुहन् .. 79 ..
text_mt: Sahura, along with those actors, was crushed by Āhlāda alone; / their pools of blood welled up within the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ ca muniśārdūla caturmāssvabhavadraṇaḥ ..
vaiśākhe māsi saṃprāpte te vīrā gehamāyayuḥ ..
iti te kathitaṃ vipra cānyatkiṃ śrotumicchasi .. 3.3.28.80 ..
meaning:
एवं च मुनिशार्दूल चतुर्मास्स्वभवद्रणः ..
वैशाखे मासि संप्राप्ते ते वीरा गेहमाययुः ..
इति ते कथितं विप्र चान्यत्किं श्रोतुमिच्छसि .. 3.3.28.80 ..
text_mt: And thus, O tiger among sages, the battle lasted for four months. / When the month of Vaiśākha arrived, those heroes went home. / Thus has it been told to you, O brāhmaṇa; what else do you wish to hear?

sanskrit_iast:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kinnarī nāma yā kanyā tvayā proktā mahāmune ..
kutra sthāne kathaṃ jātā tatsarvaṃ kṛpayā vada .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
किन्नरी नाम या कन्या त्वया प्रोक्ता महामुने ..
कुत्र स्थाने कथं जाता तत्सर्वं कृपया वद .. 1 ..
text_mt: The sages said: / The maiden named Kinnarī who was spoken of by you, O great sage, / in what place and how was she born? Please tell us all that, out of kindness.
title: adhyāyaḥ 29

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
purā caitrarathe deśe nānājananiṣevite ..
vasaṃtasamaye prāpte krīḍaṃtyatra divaukasaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
पुरा चैत्ररथे देशे नानाजननिषेविते ..
वसंतसमये प्राप्ते क्रीडंत्यत्र दिवौकसः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Long ago, in the region of Caitraratha frequented by various peoples, / when the spring season arrived, the gods were sporting there.

sanskrit_iast:
maṃjughoṣā ca svarveśyā śukasthāne samāgatā ..
dṛṣṭvā taṃ sundaraṃ bālaṃ mohanāya samudyatā .. 3 ..
meaning:
मंजुघोषा च स्वर्वेश्या शुकस्थाने समागता ..
दृष्ट्वा तं सुन्दरं बालं मोहनाय समुद्यता .. 3 ..
text_mt: And Mañjughoṣā, the celestial courtesan, came to the abode of Śuka. / Seeing that handsome youth, she set about to bewitch him.

sanskrit_iast:
gītanṛtyādirāgāṃśca kṛtvā sā kāmavihvalā ..
prāṃjaliṃ praṇatā baddhvā punastuṣṭāva taṃ munim ..4..
meaning:
गीतनृत्यादिरागांश्च कृत्वा सा कामविह्वला ..
प्रांजलिं प्रणता बद्ध्वा पुनस्तुष्टाव तं मुनिम् ..4..
text_mt: Performing songs, dances, and musical modes, agitated by love, / she bowed down with folded hands and praised that sage again.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā śukastu bhagavānpadyaṃ stuti mayaṃ śubham ..
śrutvā prasannahṛdayo varaṃ brūhīti so'bravīt .. 5 ..
meaning:
तदा शुकस्तु भगवान्पद्यं स्तुति मयं शुभम् ..
श्रुत्वा प्रसन्नहृदयो वरं ब्रूहीति सोऽब्रवीत् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Then the blessed Śuka, hearing the auspicious verse of praise, / pleased at heart, spoke to her: 'Choose a boon!'

sanskrit_iast:
sā tu śrutvā śubhaṃ vākyaṃ provāca ślakṣṇayā girā ..
patirme bhava he nātha śaraṇāgatavatsala .. 6 ..
meaning:
सा तु श्रुत्वा शुभं वाक्यं प्रोवाच श्लक्ष्णया गिरा ..
पतिर्मे भव हे नाथ शरणागतवत्सल .. 6 ..
text_mt: Hearing that auspicious speech, she spoke in a soft voice: / 'Be my husband, O master, O you who are affectionate to those who seek refuge!'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ tathā kṛtvā tayā saha ..
sa reme muniśārdūlaḥ śuko vijñānakovidaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तथा कृत्वा तया सह ..
स रेमे मुनिशार्दूलः शुको विज्ञानकोविदः .. 7 ..
text_mt: Hearing that word and doing accordingly, / that tiger among sages, Śuka, skilled in spiritual knowledge, sported with her.

sanskrit_iast:
tayossakāśātsaṃjajñe munirnāma suto'nayoḥ ..
tapaścakāra balavāndvādaśābdaṃ prayatnataḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
तयोस्सकाशात्संजज्ञे मुनिर्नाम सुतोऽनयोः ..
तपश्चकार बलवान्द्वादशाब्दं प्रयत्नतः .. 8 ..
text_mt: From the two of them a son named Muni was born. / Powerful, he performed penance diligently for twelve years.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmai dadau tadā patnīṃ svarṇadevasya vai sutām ..
kubero rudrasahitaḥ sa munistu mudānvitaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
तस्मै ददौ तदा पत्नीं स्वर्णदेवस्य वै सुताम् ..
कुबेरो रुद्रसहितः स मुनिस्तु मुदान्वितः .. 9 ..
text_mt: Then Kubera together with Rudra gave him as wife the daughter of Svarṇadeva, / and that sage was filled with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
tayā reme prasannātmā tayorjātā sutottamā ..
kinnarī nāma vikhyātā himatuṃge samudbhavā ..
tapaścacāra sā devī rūpayauvana śālinī .. 3.3.29.10 ..
meaning:
तया रेमे प्रसन्नात्मा तयोर्जाता सुतोत्तमा ..
किन्नरी नाम विख्याता हिमतुंगे समुद्भवा ..
तपश्चचार सा देवी रूपयौवन शालिनी .. 3.3.29.10 ..
text_mt: Pleased in soul, he sported with her, and an excellent daughter was born to them, / renowned by the name Kinnarī, born on the Himatuṅga peak. / Possessing beauty and youth, that divine lady performed penance.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prasanno bhagavāñchaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ ..
makaraṃdāya dhīrāya dadau tāṃ rucirānanām .. 11 ..
meaning:
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवाञ्छंकरो लोकशंकरः ..
मकरंदाय धीराय ददौ तां रुचिराननाम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Then the blessed Śaṅkara, the benefactor of the world, was pleased / and gave that lovely-faced woman to the wise Makaranda.

sanskrit_iast:
munistu śaṃkaraṃ prāha devadeva namo'stu te ..
matsutāyai varaṃ dehi rāṣṭravardhanamuttamam .. 12 ..
meaning:
मुनिस्तु शंकरं प्राह देवदेव नमोऽस्तु ते ..
मत्सुतायै वरं देहि राष्ट्रवर्धनमुत्तमम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: The sage then said to Śaṅkara: 'O God of gods, homage to you! / Grant an excellent boon to my daughter, one that increases her kingdom.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā śivaḥ prāha guruṃḍānte ca bhūtale ..
madhyadeśe ca te rāṣṭraṃ bhaviṣyati sukhapradam ..
triṃśadabdapramāṇena tatpaścātkṣayameṣyati .. 13 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा शिवः प्राह गुरुंडान्ते च भूतले ..
मध्यदेशे च ते राष्ट्रं भविष्यति सुखप्रदम् ..
त्रिंशदब्दप्रमाणेन तत्पश्चात्क्षयमेष्यति .. 13 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, Śiva said: 'On the earth, at the border of Guruṇḍa, / and in the Madhyadeśa, your kingdom will bring happiness. / It will last for a measure of thirty years; after that, it will go to ruin.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu sa munirhimatuṃganivāsakaḥ ..
makaraṃdena sahitastatra vāsamakārayat..14..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु स मुनिर्हिमतुंगनिवासकः ..
मकरंदेन सहितस्तत्र वासमकारयत्..14..
text_mt: Hearing this, that sage, residing on the Himatuṅga peak, / made his dwelling there together with Makaranda.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ vipra punaḥ śṛṇu kathāṃ śubhām ..
ūnatriṃśābdakaṃ prāpte kṛṣṇāṃśe raṇakāraṇam .. 15 ..
meaning:
इति ते कथितं विप्र पुनः शृणु कथां शुभाम् ..
ऊनत्रिंशाब्दकं प्राप्ते कृष्णांशे रणकारणम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: Thus it has been told to you, O brāhmaṇa; hear again the auspicious tale: / the cause of the battle when Kṛṣṇāṃśa reached his twenty-ninth year.

sanskrit_iast:
netrapālasya nagaraṃ nānādhātuvicitritam ..
matvā nyūnapatirbauddho rurodha nagaraṃ śubham .. 16 ..
meaning:
नेत्रपालस्य नगरं नानाधातुविचित्रितम् ..
मत्वा न्यूनपतिर्बौद्धो रुरोध नगरं शुभम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: Thinking the city of Netrapāla, adorned with various minerals, / to have a weak protector, the Buddhist besieged the fair city.

sanskrit_iast:
saptalakṣayuto rājā bauddhasiṃho mahābalaḥ ..
trilakṣabalasaṃyuktaissārddhaṃ yuddhamacīkarat .. 17 ..
meaning:
सप्तलक्षयुतो राजा बौद्धसिंहो महाबलः ..
त्रिलक्षबलसंयुक्तैस्सार्द्धं युद्धमचीकरत् .. 17 ..
text_mt: King Bauddhasiṃha, very powerful, endowed with seven hundred thousand [men], / engaged in battle with [kings] endowed with a force of three hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
saptāhorātramabhavatsenāyuddhaṃ bhayānakam ..
yogasiṃho bhogasiṃho vijayaśca mahābalaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
सप्ताहोरात्रमभवत्सेनायुद्धं भयानकम् ..
योगसिंहो भोगसिंहो विजयश्च महाबलः .. 18 ..
text_mt: A terrible battle between the armies lasted for seven days and nights. / Yogasiṃha, Bhogasiṃha, and the very powerful Vijaya

sanskrit_iast:
jaghāna śātravīṃ senāṃ bauddhasiṃhena pālitām ..
etasminnaṃtare prāptāḥ śyāmajāpakadeśagāḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
जघान शात्रवीं सेनां बौद्धसिंहेन पालिताम् ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्ताः श्यामजापकदेशगाः .. 19 ..
text_mt: struck down the hostile army protected by Bauddhasiṃha. / In the meantime, there arrived those who lived in the lands of Śyāma and Jāpaka,

sanskrit_iast:
bauddhā māyāvinassarve lokamānyaprapūjakāḥ ..
punarjātaṃ mahadyuddhaṃ māsamekaṃ tayostadā .. 3.3.29.20 ..
meaning:
बौद्धा मायाविनस्सर्वे लोकमान्यप्रपूजकाः ..
पुनर्जातं महद्युद्धं मासमेकं तयोस्तदा .. 3.3.29.20 ..
text_mt: all of them deceitful Buddhists, worshippers of the revered one of the world. / Then another great battle took place between the two sides for a month.

sanskrit_iast:
netrapālājñayā sarve kṛṣṇāṃśādyāḥ samāgatāḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśo biṃdulārūḍho devaḥ svahayasaṃsthitaḥ ..21..
meaning:
नेत्रपालाज्ञया सर्वे कृष्णांशाद्याः समागताः ..
कृष्णांशो बिंदुलारूढो देवः स्वहयसंस्थितः ..21..
text_mt: By command of Netrapāla, Kṛṣṇāṃśa and all the others arrived. / Kṛṣṇāṃśa mounted on Bindula, Deva mounted on his own horse,

sanskrit_iast:
iṃdulaśca karālāśve maṃḍalīko gaje sthitaḥ ..
gautamaśca samāyāto harināgarasaṃsthitaḥ ..22..
meaning:
इंदुलश्च करालाश्वे मंडलीको गजे स्थितः ..
गौतमश्च समायातो हरिनागरसंस्थितः ..22..
text_mt: Indula on a fierce horse, Maṇḍalīka mounted on an elephant; / and Gautama arrived mounted on Harināgara.

sanskrit_iast:
tālanaśca samāyātaḥ siṃhinyupari saṃsthitaḥ ..
dhānyapālastailyakāro yuyutsoraṃśasaṃbhavaḥ ..23..
meaning:
तालनश्च समायातः सिंहिन्युपरि संस्थितः ..
धान्यपालस्तैल्यकारो युयुत्सोरंशसंभवः ..23..
text_mt: And Tālana arrived mounted upon a lioness; / Dhānyapāla the oil-presser, born from a portion of Yuyutsu;

sanskrit_iast:
lallasiṃhaśca balavānkuṃtibhojāṃśasaṃbhavaḥ ..
tāmbūlīyakajātīyo lakṣaṇānujñayā yayau .. 24 ..
meaning:
लल्लसिंहश्च बलवान्कुंतिभोजांशसंभवः ..
ताम्बूलीयकजातीयो लक्षणानुज्ञया ययौ .. 24 ..
text_mt: and the powerful Lallasiṃha, born from a portion of Kuntibhoja, / belonging to the betel-grower caste, set forth by permission of Lakṣaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu netrasiṃhaśca saptalakṣabalairvṛtaḥ ..
pālitaścāṣṭabhirvīraisteṣāṃ nāśāya cāyayau .. 25 ..
meaning:
तदा तु नेत्रसिंहश्च सप्तलक्षबलैर्वृतः ..
पालितश्चाष्टभिर्वीरैस्तेषां नाशाय चाययौ .. 25 ..
text_mt: Then Netrasiṃha, surrounded by a force of seven hundred thousand / and protected by eight heroes, advanced for their destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
bhayabhītāśca te bauddhāstyaktvā deśaṃ samantataḥ ..
cīnadeśamupāgamya yuddhabhūmimakārayan .. 26 ..
meaning:
भयभीताश्च ते बौद्धास्त्यक्त्वा देशं समन्ततः ..
चीनदेशमुपागम्य युद्धभूमिमकारयन् .. 26 ..
text_mt: Frightened by fear, those Buddhists completely abandoned the region, / and having gone to the country of Cīna, they set up a battleground.

sanskrit_iast:
tadanuprayayuste vai hūhānadamupasthitāḥ ..
māghamāse tu saṃprāpte punaryuddhamavartata .. 27 ..
meaning:
तदनुप्रययुस्ते वै हूहानदमुपस्थिताः ..
माघमासे तु संप्राप्ते पुनर्युद्धमवर्तत .. 27 ..
text_mt: Following them, they arrived at the Hūhā river. / When the month of Māgha arrived, the battle commenced once again.

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmadeśodbhavā lakṣaṃ tathā lakṣaṃ ca jāpakāḥ ..
daśa lakṣāścīnadeśyā yuddhāya samupasthitāḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
श्यामदेशोद्भवा लक्षं तथा लक्षं च जापकाः ..
दश लक्षाश्चीनदेश्या युद्धाय समुपस्थिताः .. 28 ..
text_mt: A hundred thousand born in the country of Śyāma, and likewise a hundred thousand Jāpakas, / and one million natives of Cīna stood ready for battle.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśo lakṣasenāḍhyo devo lakṣasamanvitaḥ ..
netrapālaśca lakṣāḍhayo yogabhogasamanvitaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
कृष्णांशो लक्षसेनाढ्यो देवो लक्षसमन्वितः ..
नेत्रपालश्च लक्षाढयो योगभोगसमन्वितः .. 29 ..
text_mt: Kṛṣṇāṃśa was accompanied by an army of a hundred thousand; Deva had a hundred thousand; / and Netrapāla had a hundred thousand, accompanied by Yoga and Bhoga.

sanskrit_iast:
maṃḍalīkaścendulena lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ ..
dhyānapālo lallasiṃho lakṣasainyānvitaḥ sthitaḥ .. 3.3.29.30 ..
meaning:
मंडलीकश्चेन्दुलेन लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः ..
ध्यानपालो लल्लसिंहो लक्षसैन्यान्वितः स्थितः .. 3.3.29.30 ..
text_mt: Maṇḍalīka together with Indula was accompanied by an army of a hundred thousand; / Dhyānapāla and Lallasiṃha stood with an army of a hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
jananāyaka evāpi lakṣasainyayutaḥ sthitaḥ ..
tālano lakṣasenāḍhyo yuddhāya samupāgataḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
जननायक एवापि लक्षसैन्ययुतः स्थितः ..
तालनो लक्षसेनाढ्यो युद्धाय समुपागतः .. 31 ..
text_mt: Jananāyaka also stood with an army of a hundred thousand; / and Tālana, endowed with an army of a hundred thousand, approached for battle.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra yuddhamabhūdghoraṃ bauddhānāmāryakaissaha ..
pakṣamātraṃ muniśreṣṭha yamalokavivarddhanam .. 32 ..
meaning:
तत्र युद्धमभूद्घोरं बौद्धानामार्यकैस्सह ..
पक्षमात्रं मुनिश्रेष्ठ यमलोकविवर्द्धनम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: There took place a dreadful battle between the Buddhists and the Āryans / lasting for half a month, O best of sages, enlarging the realm of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
sapta lakṣaṃ hatā bauddhā dvilakṣaṃ cāryadeśajāḥ ..
tataste bhayabhītāśca tyaktvā yuddhaṃ gṛhaṃ yayuḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
सप्त लक्षं हता बौद्धा द्विलक्षं चार्यदेशजाः ..
ततस्ते भयभीताश्च त्यक्त्वा युद्धं गृहं ययुः .. 33 ..
text_mt: Seven hundred thousand Buddhists were slain, and two hundred thousand born in the Āryan land. / Then, frightened by fear, they abandoned the battle and went home.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā dārumayīṃ senāṃ kalayaṃtraprabhāvataḥ ..
gajāśca daśasāhasrā saśūrāḥ kāṣṭhanirmitāḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा दारुमयीं सेनां कलयंत्रप्रभावतः ..
गजाश्च दशसाहस्रा सशूराः काष्ठनिर्मिताः .. 34 ..
text_mt: Having created a wooden army by the power of mechanical devices, / ten thousand wooden elephants were made, along with warriors,

sanskrit_iast:
ekalakṣaṃ hayārūḍhā dārupāśca raṇonmukhāḥ ..
sahasraṃ mahiṣārūḍhāssahasraṃ kolapṛṣṭhagāḥ.. 35 ..
meaning:
एकलक्षं हयारूढा दारुपाश्च रणोन्मुखाः ..
सहस्रं महिषारूढास्सहस्रं कोलपृष्ठगाः.. 35 ..
text_mt: one hundred thousand wooden mounted cavalrymen eager for battle, / a thousand mounted on buffaloes, a thousand mounted on the backs of boars,

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhārūḍhāssahasraṃ ca sahasraṃ haṃsavāhanāḥ..
kaṃkagomāyugṛdhrāṇāṃ śyāmārūḍhāḥ pṛthaktathā .. 36 ..
meaning:
सिंहारूढास्सहस्रं च सहस्रं हंसवाहनाः..
कंकगोमायुगृध्राणां श्यामारूढाः पृथक्तथा .. 36 ..
text_mt: and a thousand mounted on lions, a thousand with geese as mounts, / and similarly, separately mounted on herons, jackals, vultures, and Śyāmā-birds,

sanskrit_iast:
uṣṭrāḥ saptasahasrāṇi saśūrāśca raṇonmukhāḥ ..
evaṃ sapādalakṣaiśca kāṣṭhasainyaiśca mānuṣāḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
उष्ट्राः सप्तसहस्राणि सशूराश्च रणोन्मुखाः ..
एवं सपादलक्षैश्च काष्ठसैन्यैश्च मानुषाः .. 37 ..
text_mt: and seven thousand camels along with warriors eager for battle. / Thus, by means of one hundred and twenty-five thousand wooden troops, men

sanskrit_iast:
dvilakṣāṇi kṣayaṃ jagmuḥ kṛṣṇāṃśādyaiḥ surakṣitāḥ ..
tato hāhākṛtaṃ sainyaṃ cāryyāṇāṃ ca nanāśa tat .. .. 38 ..
meaning:
द्विलक्षाणि क्षयं जग्मुः कृष्णांशाद्यैः सुरक्षिताः ..
ततो हाहाकृतं सैन्यं चार्य्याणां च ननाश तत् .. .. 38 ..
text_mt: numbering two hundred thousand, well-protected by Kṛṣṇāṃśa and others, met destruction. / Then that army of the Āryans cried out in distress and was routed.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tatkautukaṃ ramyaṃ jayanto yuddhakovidaḥ ..
āgneyaṃ śaramādāya kāṣṭhasainyeṣu cākṣipat .. 39 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तत्कौतुकं रम्यं जयन्तो युद्धकोविदः ..
आग्नेयं शरमादाय काष्ठसैन्येषु चाक्षिपत् .. 39 ..
text_mt: Seeing that delightful marvel, Jayanta, skilled in battle, / took an arrow of fire and loosed it at the wooden troops.

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmībhūtāśca te sarve tatraiva vilayaṃ gatāḥ ..
trilakṣaṃ kṣatriyāḥ śeṣā jayaṃtaṃ raṇakovidam ..
cakrurjayaravaṃ tatra tuṣṭuvuśca punaḥ punaḥ .. 3.3.29.40 ..
meaning:
भस्मीभूताश्च ते सर्वे तत्रैव विलयं गताः ..
त्रिलक्षं क्षत्रियाः शेषा जयंतं रणकोविदम् ..
चक्रुर्जयरवं तत्र तुष्टुवुश्च पुनः पुनः .. 3.3.29.40 ..
text_mt: Turned to ashes, all of them dissolved right there. / The remaining three hundred thousand kṣatriyas shouted cries of victory / to Jayanta, skilled in battle, and praised him again and again.

sanskrit_iast: tadā tu cīnajā bauddhāḥ kṛtvā viṃśatsahasrakān.. hayārūḍhām̐llohamayānpreṣayāmāsurūrjitān .. 41 ..
meaning: तदा तु चीनजा बौद्धाः कृत्वा विंशत्सहस्रकान्.. हयारूढाम्̐ल्लोहमयान्प्रेषयामासुरूर्जितान् .. 41 ..
text_mt: Then the Buddhists born in China made twenty thousand / iron [warriors] mounted on horses and sent them forth, mighty.

sanskrit_iast:
yogasiṃho gajārūḍho dhanurbāṇadharo valī ..
kaṃṭheṣu lohajānvīrāṃstāḍayāmāsa vai tadā .. .. 42 ..
meaning:
योगसिंहो गजारूढो धनुर्बाणधरो वली ..
कंठेषु लोहजान्वीरांस्ताडयामास वै तदा .. .. 42 ..
text_mt: Strong Yogasiṃha, mounted on an elephant and holding bow and arrows, / then struck those iron-born heroes in the throats.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtāste paṃcasāhasrā yogasiṃhaśarārditāḥ ..
bauddhasiṃhastadā śūro dṛṣṭvā tasya parākramam ..
kṛtvā lohamayaṃ siṃhaṃ yogasiṃhamapeṣayat ..43..
meaning:
मृतास्ते पंचसाहस्रा योगसिंहशरार्दिताः ..
बौद्धसिंहस्तदा शूरो दृष्ट्वा तस्य पराक्रमम् ..
कृत्वा लोहमयं सिंहं योगसिंहमपेषयत् ..43..
text_mt: Five thousand of them died, afflicted by Yogasiṃha's arrows. / Then the valiant Bauddhasiṃha, seeing his prowess, / made an iron lion and hurled it at Yogasiṃha.

sanskrit_iast:
pātena tasya siṃhasya sa vīro maraṇaṃ gataḥ ..
tadā tu bhogasiṃhaśca hayārūḍho jagāma ha ..
svabhallena ca taṃ siṃhaṃ hatvā tatra jagarja vai .. 44 ..
meaning:
पातेन तस्य सिंहस्य स वीरो मरणं गतः ..
तदा तु भोगसिंहश्च हयारूढो जगाम ह ..
स्वभल्लेन च तं सिंहं हत्वा तत्र जगर्ज वै .. 44 ..
text_mt: By the fall of that lion, that hero met his death. / But then Bhogasiṃha, mounted on a horse, advanced; / slaying that lion with his spear, he roared there.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu bauddhasiṃhena śārdūlastatra coditaḥ ..
sahayo bhogasiṃhaśca tenaiva maraṇaṃ gataḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
तदा तु बौद्धसिंहेन शार्दूलस्तत्र चोदितः ..
सहयो भोगसिंहश्च तेनैव मरणं गतः .. 45 ..
text_mt: Then Bauddhasiṃha impelled a tiger there; / and Bhogasiṃha, along with his horse, was killed by that very [beast].

sanskrit_iast:
mātulau mṛtyuvaśagau dṛṣṭvā svarṇavatīsutaḥ ..
karālaṃ hayamā ruhya bauddhasiṃhamupāyayau .. 46 ..
meaning:
मातुलौ मृत्युवशगौ दृष्ट्वा स्वर्णवतीसुतः ..
करालं हयमा रुह्य बौद्धसिंहमुपाययौ .. 46 ..
text_mt: Seeing his maternal uncles fallen under the power of death, the son of Svarṇavatī / mounted a terrible horse and approached Bauddhasiṃha.

sanskrit_iast:
śaramādāya vai śīghraṃ nāmnā saṃmohanaṃ śubham ..
mohayitvā ripubalaṃ bauddhasiṃhasamanvitam .. 47 ..
meaning:
शरमादाय वै शीघ्रं नाम्ना संमोहनं शुभम् ..
मोहयित्वा रिपुबलं बौद्धसिंहसमन्वितम् .. 47 ..
text_mt: Swiftly taking up an arrow named auspicious Saṃmohana, / having bewildered the enemy army along with Bauddhasiṃha,

sanskrit_iast:
baddhvā tānbauddhasiṃhādīnnṛpāndaśasahasrakam ..
kalayaṃtraṃ ca saṃcūrṇya kṛṣṇāṃ śāṃtikamāyayau .. 48 ..
meaning:
बद्ध्वा तान्बौद्धसिंहादीन्नृपान्दशसहस्रकम् ..
कलयंत्रं च संचूर्ण्य कृष्णां शांतिकमाययौ .. 48 ..
text_mt: binding those ten thousand kings headed by Bauddhasiṃha / and crushing their mechanical contrivance, he returned near to Kṛṣṇā.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā te harṣitāssarve prapeṣya nagaraṃ yayuḥ ..
tadveśma yojanāyāmaṃ sarvasaṃpatsamanvitam ..
luṇṭhayitvā balātsarve nṛpadurgamupāyayuḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
तदा ते हर्षितास्सर्वे प्रपेष्य नगरं ययुः ..
तद्वेश्म योजनायामं सर्वसंपत्समन्वितम् ..
लुण्ठयित्वा बलात्सर्वे नृपदुर्गमुपाययुः .. 49 ..
text_mt: Then, rejoicing, they all sent [the prisoners ahead] and marched to the city. / Having forcibly plundered that palace, a yojana in extent and endowed with all wealth, / they all went to the king's fortress.

sanskrit_iast:
bauddhasiṃhastadāgatya jayantena vimocitaḥ ..
sutāṃ svāṃ padmajāṃ nāmnā jayantāya dadau mudā .. 3.3.29.50 ..
meaning:
बौद्धसिंहस्तदागत्य जयन्तेन विमोचितः ..
सुतां स्वां पद्मजां नाम्ना जयन्ताय ददौ मुदा .. 3.3.29.50 ..
text_mt: Then Bauddhasiṃha, having come, was released by Jayanta; / and with joy he gave his daughter named Padmajā to Jayanta,

sanskrit_iast:
daśakoṭīḥ suvarṇasya cāhlādāya tadā dhanam..
sarvaiśca bauddhavṛndaiśca tatraiva śapathaḥ kṛtaḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
दशकोटीः सुवर्णस्य चाह्लादाय तदा धनम्..
सर्वैश्च बौद्धवृन्दैश्च तत्रैव शपथः कृतः .. 51 ..
text_mt: and then wealth of one hundred million gold [pieces] to Āhlāda. / And an oath was taken right there by all the hosts of Buddhists:

sanskrit_iast:
āryadeśaṃ na yāsyāmaḥ kadācidrāṣṭrahetave ..
ityuktvā tānpraṇamyāśu saṃprasthānamakārayan ..
trilakṣaiśca yutāste vai netrapālagṛhaṃ gatāḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
आर्यदेशं न यास्यामः कदाचिद्राष्ट्रहेतवे ..
इत्युक्त्वा तान्प्रणम्याशु संप्रस्थानमकारयन् ..
त्रिलक्षैश्च युतास्ते वै नेत्रपालगृहं गताः .. 52 ..
text_mt: "We shall never go to the Aryan land for the sake of kingdom." / Having spoken thus and quickly bowed to them, they had them depart; / and accompanied by three hundred thousand [men], they went to Netrapāla's house.

sanskrit_iast:
.. ṛṣayaḥ ūcuḥ .. ..
indulena kathaṃ sūta tatra prāṇīkṛtā na hi ..
supriyā yogasiṃhādyāstanno vada vicakṣaṇa .. 53 ..
meaning:
.. ऋषयः ऊचुः .. ..
इन्दुलेन कथं सूत तत्र प्राणीकृता न हि ..
सुप्रिया योगसिंहाद्यास्तन्नो वद विचक्षण .. 53 ..
text_mt: The sages said: / Why, O Sūta, were their dear [comrades] Yogasiṃha and the rest not restored to life there / by Indula? Tell us that, O wise one!

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
āgatā yamalokādvai katicitprāṇino bhuvi ..
tadā tu duḥkhito devo maheṃdrāntamupāyayau .. 54 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
आगता यमलोकाद्वै कतिचित्प्राणिनो भुवि ..
तदा तु दुःखितो देवो महेंद्रान्तमुपाययौ .. 54 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / When certain living beings had returned to earth from the realm of Yama, / then that god [Yama], grieving, went before Mahendra:

sanskrit_iast:
devarāja namastubhyaṃ sarvadevapriyaṃkara ..
jayaṃto jagatīṃ prāpya mṛtāñjīvayati svayam ..
ato vai lokamaryādā viruddhā dṛśyate bhuvi .. 55 ..
meaning:
देवराज नमस्तुभ्यं सर्वदेवप्रियंकर ..
जयंतो जगतीं प्राप्य मृताञ्जीवयति स्वयम् ..
अतो वै लोकमर्यादा विरुद्धा दृश्यते भुवि .. 55 ..
text_mt: "O king of gods, homage to you, doer of what is pleasing to all gods! / Jayanta, having reached the earth, revives the dead himself; / therefore the established order of the world appears violated on earth."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ mahendro devamāyayā ..
vaḍavāmṛtamāhṛtya tathā vai svargagāṃ gatim ..
jayaṃtasya svaputrasya mumoda sa suraiḥ saha .. 56 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं महेन्द्रो देवमायया ..
वडवामृतमाहृत्य तथा वै स्वर्गगां गतिम् ..
जयंतस्य स्वपुत्रस्य मुमोद स सुरैः सह .. 56 ..
text_mt: Hearing this speech, Mahendra, by divine power, / took away the amṛta of the submarine mare as well as the power to ascend to heaven / from his son Jayanta, and rejoiced with the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
indulaśca tadā duḥkhī śāradāṃ sarvamaṃgalām ..
pūjayitvā vidhānena yogadhyāna paro'bhavat .. 57 ..
meaning:
इन्दुलश्च तदा दुःखी शारदां सर्वमंगलाम् ..
पूजयित्वा विधानेन योगध्यान परोऽभवत् .. 57 ..
text_mt: And Indula, grieving then, worshipped all-auspicious Śāradā / according to rule, and devoted himself to yogic meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ vipra punaḥ śṛṇu kathāṃ śubhām ..
netrapālaśca balavānbahuputraḥ śucānvitaḥ ..
daśakoṭimitaṃ svarṇaṃ tebhyo dattvā samaṃ samam .. 58 ..
meaning:
इति ते कथितं विप्र पुनः शृणु कथां शुभाम् ..
नेत्रपालश्च बलवान्बहुपुत्रः शुचान्वितः ..
दशकोटिमितं स्वर्णं तेभ्यो दत्त्वा समं समम् .. 58 ..
text_mt: Thus has this been told to you, O brāhmaṇa; listen again to the auspicious tale. / Mighty Netrapāla, who had many sons and was filled with sorrow, / gave gold measuring one hundred million equally to them,

sanskrit_iast:
prasthānaṃ kārayāmāsa cāṣṭānāṃ balaśālinām ..
te vai dvilakṣasainyāḍhyāḥ svagehāya yayurmudā .. 59 .. ..
meaning:
प्रस्थानं कारयामास चाष्टानां बलशालिनाम् ..
ते वै द्विलक्षसैन्याढ्याः स्वगेहाय ययुर्मुदा .. 59 .. ..
text_mt: and sent forth the eight mighty warriors. / Abundantly accompanied by an army of two hundred thousand, they went joyfully to their own home.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
yadā te cīnadeśasthāstadāhūto nṛpeṇa vai ..
kāmapālena bho vipra lakṣaṇo nakulāṃśakaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
यदा ते चीनदेशस्थास्तदाहूतो नृपेण वै ..
कामपालेन भो विप्र लक्षणो नकुलांशकः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / When they were in the country of China, then Lakṣaṇa, a portion of Nakula, / was summoned, O brāhmaṇa, by King Kāmapāla:
title: adhyāyaḥ 30

sanskrit_iast:
jayacaṃdra mahābhāga sāvadhānaṃ vacaḥ śṛṇu ..
vaiśākhaśukla saptamyāṃ muhūrto'yaṃ dināgame .. 2 ..
meaning:
जयचंद्र महाभाग सावधानं वचः शृणु ..
वैशाखशुक्ल सप्तम्यां मुहूर्तोऽयं दिनागमे .. 2 ..
text_mt: "O highly fortunate Jayacandra, listen attentively to my word: / On the seventh day of the bright fortnight of Vaiśākha is the auspicious time at daybreak.

sanskrit_iast:
ato vai lakṣaṇo vīraścaikākī māṃ samāpnuyāt ..
gṛhītvā matsutāṃ dolāṃ gamiṣyati tavāṃtikam .. 3 ..
meaning:
अतो वै लक्षणो वीरश्चैकाकी मां समाप्नुयात् ..
गृहीत्वा मत्सुतां दोलां गमिष्यति तवांतिकम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Therefore let the heroic Lakṣaṇa come to me alone; / taking my daughter and her litter, he will go to you.

sanskrit_iast:
senānvitaṃ ca taṃ jñātvā mahīrājo mahābalaḥ ..
grahīṣyati parājitya tasmādyogyaṃ vaco mama .. 4 ..
meaning:
सेनान्वितं च तं ज्ञात्वा महीराजो महाबलः ..
ग्रहीष्यति पराजित्य तस्माद्योग्यं वचो मम .. 4 ..
text_mt: And knowing him to be accompanied by an army, the mighty Mahīrāja / would defeat him and seize [her]; therefore my word is fitting."

sanskrit_iast:
iti tatratyavacanaṃ matvā rājā prasannadhīḥ ..
lakṣaṇaṃ hastinīsaṃsthaṃ śataśūrasamanvitam .. 5 ..
meaning:
इति तत्रत्यवचनं मत्वा राजा प्रसन्नधीः ..
लक्षणं हस्तिनीसंस्थं शतशूरसमन्वितम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Thinking thus upon the word [received] from there, the king, pleased in mind, / summoned Lakṣaṇa, who was mounted on a female elephant and accompanied by a hundred heroes,

sanskrit_iast:
āhūya preṣayāmāsa kāmapālāya dhīmate ..
mārge paṃcadinaṃ vīra uṣitvā tadgṛhaṃ yayau .. 6 ..
meaning:
आहूय प्रेषयामास कामपालाय धीमते ..
मार्गे पंचदिनं वीर उषित्वा तद्गृहं ययौ .. 6 ..
text_mt: and sent him to wise Kāmapāla. / Having stayed five days on the road, the hero went to his house.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā padmākaraḥ śyālo jñātvā lakṣaṇamāgatam ..
bhūmirājaṃ samāhūya tena yuddhamacīkarat .. 7 ..
meaning:
तदा पद्माकरः श्यालो ज्ञात्वा लक्षणमागतम् ..
भूमिराजं समाहूय तेन युद्धमचीकरत् .. 7 ..
text_mt: Then his brother-in-law Padmākara, knowing that Lakṣaṇa had arrived, / summoned Bhūmirāja and caused a battle with him.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇo nakulāṃśaśca dṛṣṭvā śatrumupasthitam ..
svaśaraistarpayāmāsa rājarājaṃ mahābalam .. 8 ..
meaning:
लक्षणो नकुलांशश्च दृष्ट्वा शत्रुमुपस्थितम् ..
स्वशरैस्तर्पयामास राजराजं महाबलम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: And Lakṣaṇa, a portion of Nakula, seeing the enemy arrived, / gratified that mighty king of kings with his arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrcchayitvā mahīrājaṃ hatvā paṃcaśataṃ balī ..
kāmapālaṃ samāgamya natvā vāsamakārayat .. 9 ..
meaning:
मूर्च्छयित्वा महीराजं हत्वा पंचशतं बली ..
कामपालं समागम्य नत्वा वासमकारयत् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Having rendered Mahīrāja unconscious and slain five hundred [men], the strong one / went to Kāmapāla, bowed, and took up residence.

sanskrit_iast:
utthitaśca mahīrājo gatvā padmākaraṃ prati ..
vacanaṃ prāha kāryārthī śṛṇu mitra vaco mama .. 3.3.30.10 ..
meaning:
उत्थितश्च महीराजो गत्वा पद्माकरं प्रति ..
वचनं प्राह कार्यार्थी शृणु मित्र वचो मम .. 3.3.30.10 ..
text_mt: And Mahīrāja, having arisen, went to Padmākara / and, seeking his purpose, spoke these words: "Listen, friend, to my word:

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇo me mahāñchatrussa ca tvadgehamāgataḥ ..
yadi dāsyasi taṃ baddhvā tvāṃ madaṃgaṃ karomyaham .. 11 ..
meaning:
लक्षणो मे महाञ्छत्रुस्स च त्वद्गेहमागतः ..
यदि दास्यसि तं बद्ध्वा त्वां मदंगं करोम्यहम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Lakṣaṇa is my great enemy, and he has come to your house. / If you give him up bound, I will make you my own ally."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā sa lobhātmā dattvā hālāhalaṃ viṣam ..
baddhvā taṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vīraṃ mahīrājāya cārpayat ..
hatvā tāñchataśūrāṃśca guptavārtāmakārayan .. 12 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा स लोभात्मा दत्त्वा हालाहलं विषम् ..
बद्ध्वा तं लक्षणं वीरं महीराजाय चार्पयत् ..
हत्वा ताञ्छतशूरांश्च गुप्तवार्तामकारयन् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, that greedy-minded one administered hālāhala poison, / bound that heroic Lakṣaṇa, and delivered him to Mahīrāja; / and having slain those hundred heroes, they kept the news secret.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā tatpadminī nārī duḥkhitālapya vai bhṛśam ..
caṃḍikāṃ pūjayāmāsa patimaṃgalahetave .. 13 ..
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा तत्पद्मिनी नारी दुःखितालप्य वै भृशम् ..
चंडिकां पूजयामास पतिमंगलहेतवे .. 13 ..
text_mt: Knowing that, the woman Padminī, deeply distressed and lamenting, / worshipped Caṇḍikā for the auspicious welfare of her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prasannā sā devī varadā sarvamaṃgalā ..
āśvāsya padminīṃ nārīṃ lakṣaṇāṃtamupāyayau .. 14 ..
meaning:
तदा प्रसन्ना सा देवी वरदा सर्वमंगला ..
आश्वास्य पद्मिनीं नारीं लक्षणांतमुपाययौ .. 14 ..
text_mt: Then that gracious goddess, boon-giving and all-auspicious, / having consoled the woman Padminī, approached Lakṣaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
svapne tamāha sā devī hrīṃ phaṭ gheghe japaṃ kuru ..
asya maṃtraprabhāvācca sarvavighnaḥ praṇaśyati .. 15 ..
meaning:
स्वप्ने तमाह सा देवी ह्रीं फट् घेघे जपं कुरु ..
अस्य मंत्रप्रभावाच्च सर्वविघ्नः प्रणश्यति .. 15 ..
text_mt: In a dream that goddess said to him: "Repeat the mantra 'hrīṃ phaṭ gheghe'! / By the power of this mantra, every obstacle is destroyed."

sanskrit_iast:
sa buddhvā lakṣaṇo vīrastaṃ maṃtraṃ ca jajāpa ha ..
āṣāḍhe māsi saṃprāpte kṛṣṇāṃśādyā gṛhaṃ yayuḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
स बुद्ध्वा लक्षणो वीरस्तं मंत्रं च जजाप ह ..
आषाढे मासि संप्राप्ते कृष्णांशाद्या गृहं ययुः .. 16 ..
text_mt: Awakening, that heroic Lakṣaṇa repeated that mantra. / When the month of Āṣāḍha arrived, those led by the portion of Kṛṣṇa went home.

sanskrit_iast:
tālanaśca yutastābhyāṃ kalyakubjamupāyayau ..
na dṛṣṭo lakṣaṇo vīro jayacaṃdrapriyaṃkaraḥ ..
jñātvā tatkāraṇaṃ taiśca kṛtaṃ yogamayaṃ vapuḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
तालनश्च युतस्ताभ्यां कल्यकुब्जमुपाययौ ..
न दृष्टो लक्षणो वीरो जयचंद्रप्रियंकरः ..
ज्ञात्वा तत्कारणं तैश्च कृतं योगमयं वपुः .. 17 ..
text_mt: And Tālana, accompanied by the two of them, arrived at Kalyakubja; / the heroic Lakṣaṇa, dear to Jayacandra, was not seen. / Learning the cause of that, they assumed the guise of yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
dhānyapālaḥ kāṃsyadhārī vīṇādhārī ca tālanaḥ ..
lallasiṃho mṛdaṃgāṃko yayuste vai mahāvatīm .. 18 ..
meaning:
धान्यपालः कांस्यधारी वीणाधारी च तालनः ..
लल्लसिंहो मृदंगांको ययुस्ते वै महावतीम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: Dhānyapāla holding bronze cymbals, Tālana holding a vīṇā, / and Lallasiṃha marked with a mṛdaṅga drum went to Mahāvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
sabhāṃ parimalasyaiva gatvā te yogarūpiṇaḥ ..
cakrurgānaṃ mudā yuktāḥ sarve te mohamāgatāḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
सभां परिमलस्यैव गत्वा ते योगरूपिणः ..
चक्रुर्गानं मुदा युक्ताः सर्वे ते मोहमागताः .. 19 ..
text_mt: Having gone to the assembly of Parimala, those disguised as yogins / sang with joy, and all those [present] were enchanted.

sanskrit_iast:
prasannaśca tadā rājā muktāmālāṃ svakaṇṭhagām ..
tālanāya dadau prītyā tābhyāṃ svarṇāṃgulīyake .. 3.3.30.20 ..
meaning:
प्रसन्नश्च तदा राजा मुक्तामालां स्वकण्ठगाम् ..
तालनाय ददौ प्रीत्या ताभ्यां स्वर्णांगुलीयके .. 3.3.30.20 ..
text_mt: Pleased, the king then lovingly gave the pearl necklace from his own neck / to Tālana, and two gold rings to the other two.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā te harṣitāḥ sarve kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ prati cāyayuḥ ..
jñātvā kṛṣṇāṃśa evāpi dhṛtvā yogamayaṃ vapuḥ ..
yayau biṃdugaḍhaṃ vīrastālanādyaissamanvitaḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
तदा ते हर्षिताः सर्वे कृष्णांशं प्रति चाययुः ..
ज्ञात्वा कृष्णांश एवापि धृत्वा योगमयं वपुः ..
ययौ बिंदुगढं वीरस्तालनाद्यैस्समन्वितः .. 21 ..
text_mt: Then, rejoicing, all of them came to Kṛṣṇāṃśa. / Having learned [of this], Kṛṣṇāṃśa too assumed an ascetic's form; / the hero went to Bindugaḍha accompanied by Tālana and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
haṭṭamadhye samāgamya kṛtvā rāsotsavaṃ śubham ..
gehaṃ padmākarasyaiva gatvā te nanṛturmudā .. .. 22 ..
meaning:
हट्टमध्ये समागम्य कृत्वा रासोत्सवं शुभम् ..
गेहं पद्माकरस्यैव गत्वा ते ननृतुर्मुदा .. .. 22 ..
text_mt: Arriving in the middle of the market, performing an auspicious rāsa-dance festival, / they went to the house of Padmākara and danced joyfully.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare sarvā yoṣitastatra cāgatāḥ ..
veṇuvādyavṛtaṃvīraṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ dadṛśurmuhuḥ ..
mohitāstasya gānena jaḍībhūtā dhanaṃ daduḥ .. .. 23 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे सर्वा योषितस्तत्र चागताः ..
वेणुवाद्यवृतंवीरं कृष्णांशं ददृशुर्मुहुः ..
मोहितास्तस्य गानेन जडीभूता धनं ददुः .. .. 23 ..
text_mt: Meanwhile, all the women came there; / they repeatedly gazed upon the hero Kṛṣṇāṃśa, surrounded by the music of flutes. / Charmed by his singing, rendered motionless, they gave him wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu padminī nārī sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā ..
jñātvā kṛṣṇāṃśamevāpi ruroda ciramāturā .. 24 ..
meaning:
तदा तु पद्मिनी नारी सर्वलक्षणसंयुता ..
ज्ञात्वा कृष्णांशमेवापि रुरोद चिरमातुरा .. 24 ..
text_mt: Then the Padminī woman, endowed with all auspicious marks, / recognizing Kṛṣṇāṃśa himself, wept for a long time, distressed.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca ca vilapyāśu matpatirla kṣaṇo balī ..
mahīrājena śūreṇa kārāgāre balātkṛtaḥ ..
ahaṃ yoṣā bhavānyogī kathaṃ kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 25 ..
meaning:
उवाच च विलप्याशु मत्पतिर्ल क्षणो बली ..
महीराजेन शूरेण कारागारे बलात्कृतः ..
अहं योषा भवान्योगी कथं कार्यं भविष्यति .. 25 ..
text_mt: And weeping, she quickly said: "My strong husband, Lakṣaṇa, / has been forcibly put into prison by the valiant Mahīrāja. / I am a woman, you are an ascetic; how will the deed be accomplished?"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu sa nṛpo bhujamutthāpya satvaram ..
āśvāsya padminīṃ nārīṃ yayuste dehalīṃ prati ..
rājadvāramupāgamya kṛṣṇāṃśassa nanarta ha .. 26 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु स नृपो भुजमुत्थाप्य सत्वरम् ..
आश्वास्य पद्मिनीं नारीं ययुस्ते देहलीं प्रति ..
राजद्वारमुपागम्य कृष्णांशस्स ननर्त ह .. 26 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, that king swiftly raised his arm, / comforted the Padminī woman, and they set out toward Delhi. / Approaching the royal gate, Kṛṣṇāṃśa danced indeed.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājastu balavānprasannastasyalīlayā ..
vāṃchitaṃ brūhi kṛṣṇāṃśa sarvaṃ yogindadāmyaham .. 27 ..
meaning:
महीराजस्तु बलवान्प्रसन्नस्तस्यलीलया ..
वांछितं ब्रूहि कृष्णांश सर्वं योगिन्ददाम्यहम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: Mighty Mahīrāja, pleased by his playful sport, [said]: / "State what you desire, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, O ascetic; I will give everything."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā bhūpavaco vihasyovāca taṃ prati..
kārāgāraṃ lohamayaṃ nṛpayogyaṃ ca me nṛpa ..
darśayāśu svakīyaṃ vai bhavānbhūpaśiromaṇiḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा भूपवचो विहस्योवाच तं प्रति..
कारागारं लोहमयं नृपयोग्यं च मे नृप ..
दर्शयाशु स्वकीयं वै भवान्भूपशिरोमणिः .. 28 ..
text_mt: Hearing the king's words, he laughed and said to him: / "O king, quickly show me your own iron prison, / which is fit for kings; for you are the crest-jewel of kings."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā sa nṛpatirmohitaḥ kṛṣṇalīlayā ..
darśayitvā ca vai śīpraṃ punastebhyo dadau dhanam .. 29 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा स नृपतिर्मोहितः कृष्णलीलया ..
