दर्शयित्वा च वै शीप्रं पुनस्तेभ्यो ददौ धनम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, the king, enchanted by the sport of Kṛṣṇa, / quickly showed it, and then gave them wealth again.

sanskrit_iast:
tataste yoginassarve saṃprāpya ca mahāvatīm ..
natvā parimalaṃ bhūpaṃ gaditvā sarvakāraṇam .. .. 3.3.30.30 ..
meaning:
ततस्ते योगिनस्सर्वे संप्राप्य च महावतीम् ..
नत्वा परिमलं भूपं गदित्वा सर्वकारणम् .. .. 3.3.30.30 ..
text_mt: Then all those ascetics, reaching Mahāvatī, / bowed to King Parimala and told the whole matter.

sanskrit_iast:
svasenāṃ sajjayāmāsa cāhlādaśca nṛpājñayā ..
pañcalakṣaṃ mahāvatyā hayārūḍhāssamāsthitāḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
स्वसेनां सज्जयामास चाह्लादश्च नृपाज्ञया ..
पञ्चलक्षं महावत्या हयारूढास्समास्थिताः .. 31 ..
text_mt: And by the king's command, Āhlāda readied his army; / five hundred thousand, mounted on horses, stood ready in Mahāvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
tālanassapta lakṣāṇi sainyānyāhūya cāgataḥ ..
evaṃ dvādaśalakṣāṇi kṣatriyā raṇadurmadāḥ ..
dehalīṃ ca samājagmussarvaśastrasamanvitāḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
तालनस्सप्त लक्षाणि सैन्यान्याहूय चागतः ..
एवं द्वादशलक्षाणि क्षत्रिया रणदुर्मदाः ..
देहलीं च समाजग्मुस्सर्वशस्त्रसमन्विताः .. 32 ..
text_mt: Tālana summoned seven hundred thousand troops and arrived; / thus twelve hundred thousand Kṣatriyas, furious in battle, / equipped with all weapons, marched on Delhi.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare mantrī cadrabhaṭṭo viśāradaḥ ..
sarvaśāstrārthakuśalo vaiṣṇavīśaktipūjakaḥ ..33..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे मन्त्री चद्रभट्टो विशारदः ..
सर्वशास्त्रार्थकुशलो वैष्णवीशक्तिपूजकः ..33..
text_mt: Meanwhile, the wise minister Cadrabhaṭṭa, / skilled in the meaning of all śāstras and a worshipper of the Vaiṣṇava Śakti,

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājaṃ samāgamya vacaḥ prāha śṛṇuṣva bhoḥ ..
mayā vai ca rahaḥ krīḍā dṛṣṭā devīprasādataḥ ..34..
meaning:
महीराजं समागम्य वचः प्राह शृणुष्व भोः ..
मया वै च रहः क्रीडा दृष्टा देवीप्रसादतः ..34..
text_mt: approached Mahīrāja and spoke these words: "Listen, sire! / By the grace of the Devī, I have witnessed a secret sport.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrodayaśca kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ pūrṇabrahmāṇamāgamat ..
vacaḥ prāha prasannātmā śṛṇu tvaṃ sattvavigraha .. 35 ..
meaning:
तत्रोदयश्च कृष्णांशः पूर्णब्रह्माणमागमत् ..
वचः प्राह प्रसन्नात्मा शृणु त्वं सत्त्वविग्रह .. 35 ..
text_mt: There Udaya, an incarnation of Kṛṣṇa, came to the supreme Brahman; / pleased at heart, he spoke these words: 'Listen, you who are goodness incarnate!

sanskrit_iast:
agnivaṃśavināśāya cādya yāsyāmi dehalīm ..
hatvāhaṃ kauravāṃśāṃśca sthāpayitvā kaliṃ bhuvi .. 36 ..
meaning:
अग्निवंशविनाशाय चाद्य यास्यामि देहलीम् ..
हत्वाहं कौरवांशांश्च स्थापयित्वा कलिं भुवि .. 36 ..
text_mt: Today I will go to Delhi for the destruction of the fire-lineage; / having slain the portions of the Kauravas and established the Kali [age] on earth,

sanskrit_iast:
punastavāntikaṃ prāpya rahaḥ krīḍāṃ karomyaham ..
ityuktvā biṃdulārūḍhaḥ sa vīrastvāmupa sthitaḥ ..
ityahaṃ dṛṣṭavānbhūpa kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ yoganidrayā .. 37 ..
meaning:
पुनस्तवान्तिकं प्राप्य रहः क्रीडां करोम्यहम् ..
इत्युक्त्वा बिंदुलारूढः स वीरस्त्वामुप स्थितः ..
इत्यहं दृष्टवान्भूप कृष्णांशं योगनिद्रया .. 37 ..
text_mt: I will return to your presence and carry out my secret sport.' / Having said this, the hero, mounted on Bindulā, approached you; / thus, O king, did I perceive Kṛṣṇāṃśa through yogic sleep."

sanskrit_iast:
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sa bhūpo vismayānvitaḥ ..
bhayabhītaḥ sahasrāṇi śūrānāhūya satvaram ..
tebhyaśca lakṣaṇaṃ dattvā vacanaṃ prāha tānprati .. 38 ..
meaning:
इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा स भूपो विस्मयान्वितः ..
भयभीतः सहस्राणि शूरानाहूय सत्वरम् ..
तेभ्यश्च लक्षणं दत्त्वा वचनं प्राह तान्प्रति .. 38 ..
text_mt: Hearing his words, that king was filled with amazement; / terrified with fear, he quickly summoned thousands of heroes, / handed Lakṣaṇa over to them, and spoke these words to them:

sanskrit_iast:
padmākarāya bhūpāya gatvā dattvāśu lakṣaṇam ..
mamāntikamupāgamya kāraṇaṃ vadatāśu tat .. 39 ..
meaning:
पद्माकराय भूपाय गत्वा दत्त्वाशु लक्षणम् ..
ममान्तिकमुपागम्य कारणं वदताशु तत् .. 39 ..
text_mt: "Go quickly, hand Lakṣaṇa over to King Padmākara, / and coming back to my presence, quickly tell me the reason [for this]."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu te sarve vahnivaṃśyā mahābalāḥ ..
gatvā tatra tathā kṛtvā mahīrājamupāgaman .. 3.3.30.40 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु ते सर्वे वह्निवंश्या महाबलाः ..
गत्वा तत्र तथा कृत्वा महीराजमुपागमन् .. 3.3.30.40 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, all those mighty [heroes] born of the fire-lineage / went there, acted accordingly, and returned to Mahīrāja.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagadaṃtaśca teṣāṃ tu sahasrāṇāṃ ca nāyakaḥ..
mahīrājaṃ vacaḥ prāha śṛṇu tannṛpabhāṣitam ..41..
meaning:
भगदंतश्च तेषां तु सहस्राणां च नायकः..
महीराजं वचः प्राह शृणु तन्नृपभाषितम् ..41..
text_mt: And Bhagadanta, the leader of those thousands, / spoke these words to Mahīrāja; listen to what was said to the king:

sanskrit_iast:
padminī me svasā rājan guptavidyāviśāradā ..
tayā yajñapatirdevaḥ samyagārādhitaḥ purā .. 42 ..
meaning:
पद्मिनी मे स्वसा राजन् गुप्तविद्याविशारदा ..
तया यज्ञपतिर्देवः सम्यगाराधितः पुरा .. 42 ..
text_mt: "Padminī is my sister, O king, skilled in occult lore; / formerly, she thoroughly worshipped the Lord of Sacrifice, the god.

sanskrit_iast:
dattastena varo ramyo hyantardhānamayaḥ paraḥ ..
sā tu taṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kāṃtamaṃtardhānaṃ kariṣyati ..
iti śrutvā sa nṛpatiḥ paramānandamāptavān .. 43 ..
meaning:
दत्तस्तेन वरो रम्यो ह्यन्तर्धानमयः परः ..
सा तु तं लक्षणं कांतमंतर्धानं करिष्यति ..
इति श्रुत्वा स नृपतिः परमानन्दमाप्तवान् .. 43 ..
text_mt: A delightful boon was granted by him, a supreme [boon] of invisibility; / she will make her beloved Lakṣaṇa disappear." / Hearing this, that king attained supreme joy.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare prāptāḥ kṛṣṇāṃśādyā mahābalāḥ ..
rurudhurdehalīṃ sarvāṃ mahīrājena pālitām .. 44 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्ताः कृष्णांशाद्या महाबलाः ..
रुरुधुर्देहलीं सर्वां महीराजेन पालिताम् .. 44 ..
text_mt: Meanwhile, the mighty Kṛṣṇāṃśa and others arrived / and besieged all of Delhi, which was ruled by Mahīrāja.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tadā pṛthivīrājo gṛhītvā bahubhūṣaṇam ..
sarvebhyaśca dadau premṇā vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
स तदा पृथिवीराजो गृहीत्वा बहुभूषणम् ..
सर्वेभ्यश्च ददौ प्रेम्णा वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः .. 45 ..
text_mt: Then Pṛthivīrāja, taking many ornaments, / gave them affectionately to all, and spoke these words with a humble mind:

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇo nāma te rājā kārāgāre na vai mama ..
yadi mannagare cāsti tarhi te roṣa īdṛśaḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
लक्षणो नाम ते राजा कारागारे न वै मम ..
यदि मन्नगरे चास्ति तर्हि ते रोष ईदृशः .. 46 ..
text_mt: "The king named Lakṣaṇa is indeed not in my prison; / why [then] is there such anger in you if he is [not] in my city?"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā taṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ darśayāmāsa vai gṛham. ..
mahādevasya śapathaṃ kṛtavānbhūpatirbhayāt .. 47 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा तं च कृष्णांशं दर्शयामास वै गृहम्. ..
महादेवस्य शपथं कृतवान्भूपतिर्भयात् .. 47 ..
text_mt: Having said this, he showed that house to Kṛṣṇāṃśa; / the king swore an oath by Mahādeva out of fear.

sanskrit_iast:
tadodayo bhūpavacaḥ satyaṃ matvā suduḥkhitaḥ ..
svakīyaiḥ saha saṃprāpto grāmaṃ biṃdugaḍhaṃ śubham .. 48.
meaning:
तदोदयो भूपवचः सत्यं मत्वा सुदुःखितः ..
स्वकीयैः सह संप्राप्तो ग्रामं बिंदुगढं शुभम् .. 48.
text_mt: Believing the king's words to be true, Udaya, very sorrowful, / returned together with his men to the fair village of Bindugaḍha.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmapālastu tacchrutvā kṛṣṇāṃśāgamanaṃ balī ..
baliṃ bahuṃ gṛhītvāśu kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ..
prāṃjaliḥ praṇato bhūtvā vacanaṃ prāha bhīrukaḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
कामपालस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा कृष्णांशागमनं बली ..
बलिं बहुं गृहीत्वाशु कृष्णांशं शरणं ययौ ..
प्रांजलिः प्रणतो भूत्वा वचनं प्राह भीरुकः .. 49 ..
text_mt: Hearing of Kṛṣṇāṃśa's arrival, the strong Kāmapāla / quickly took many offerings and sought refuge with Kṛṣṇāṃśa; / terrified, folding his hands and bowing low, he spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
sutā me padminī nārī lakṣaṇena samanvitā ..
na jñātvā kva gatā'smābhissatyaṃ satyaṃ bravīmyaham ..3.3.30.50..
meaning:
सुता मे पद्मिनी नारी लक्षणेन समन्विता ..
न ज्ञात्वा क्व गताऽस्माभिस्सत्यं सत्यं ब्रवीम्यहम् ..3.3.30.50..
text_mt: "My daughter, the Padminī woman, along with Lakṣaṇa— / where they have gone is not known by us; truly, truly I speak!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ svabalaissaha ..
kānyakubjaṃ samāgatya jayacandramuvāca ha .. 51 ..
meaning:
इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा कृष्णांशः स्वबलैस्सह ..
कान्यकुब्जं समागत्य जयचन्द्रमुवाच ह .. 51 ..
text_mt: Hearing his words, Kṛṣṇāṃśa with his forces / went to Kānyakubja and said to Jayacandra:

sanskrit_iast:
bhrātṛjastava bhūpāla padminyā lakṣaṇo'nvitaḥ ..
kāmapālagṛhe nāsti niścito bahudhā mayā .. 52 ..
meaning:
भ्रातृजस्तव भूपाल पद्मिन्या लक्षणोऽन्वितः ..
कामपालगृहे नास्ति निश्चितो बहुधा मया .. 52 ..
text_mt: "O king, your brother's son Lakṣaṇa, along with Padminī, / is not in Kāmapāla's house; this has been thoroughly verified by me.

sanskrit_iast:
na jāne kva gato rājā mama prāṇasamo bhuvi ..
yadi bhūpa na paśyāmi satyaṃ prāṇāṃstyajāmyaham .. 53 ..
meaning:
न जाने क्व गतो राजा मम प्राणसमो भुवि ..
यदि भूप न पश्यामि सत्यं प्राणांस्त्यजाम्यहम् .. 53 ..
text_mt: I do not know where the king, who is dear as my own life on earth, has gone; / if I do not see him, O king, truly I shall give up my life.

sanskrit_iast:
hā ratnabhānutanaya viṣṇubhakta śubhaṃkara ..
svamitraṃ māṃ parityajya kāṃ diśaṃ gatavānbhavān ..
ityuktvā mūrchitaścāsītkṛṣṇāṃśo vaiṣṇavapriyaḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
हा रत्नभानुतनय विष्णुभक्त शुभंकर ..
स्वमित्रं मां परित्यज्य कां दिशं गतवान्भवान् ..
इत्युक्त्वा मूर्छितश्चासीत्कृष्णांशो वैष्णवप्रियः .. 54 ..
text_mt: Alas, son of Ratnabhānu, devotee of Viṣṇu, maker of auspiciousness! / Having abandoned me, your friend, to which direction have you gone?" / Having spoken thus, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, beloved of Vaiṣṇavas, fainted.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā svarṇavatī devī svadāsyā śobhayā saha ..
dhṛtvā śukamayaṃ rūpaṃ tatrāgatya svamūrtigā .. 55 ..
meaning:
तदा स्वर्णवती देवी स्वदास्या शोभया सह ..
धृत्वा शुकमयं रूपं तत्रागत्य स्वमूर्तिगा .. 55 ..
text_mt: Then Queen Svarṇavatī, accompanied by her maid Śobhā, / assumed the form of a parrot, came there, and returned to her own form.

sanskrit_iast:
tayā saṃpreṣitā śobhā mlecchamāyāviśāradā ..
jayacaṃdramupāgamya dhṛtvā divyamayaṃ vapuḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
तया संप्रेषिता शोभा म्लेच्छमायाविशारदा ..
जयचंद्रमुपागम्य धृत्वा दिव्यमयं वपुः .. 56 ..
text_mt: Sent by her, Śobhā, skilled in the sorcery of the barbarians, / approached Jayacandra, assuming a divine form,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca vacanaṃ tatra śṛṇu bhūpaśiromaṇe ..
māyāvinī ca māṃ viddhi śobhanāṃ nāma viśrutām .. 57..
meaning:
उवाच वचनं तत्र शृणु भूपशिरोमणे ..
मायाविनी च मां विद्धि शोभनां नाम विश्रुताम् .. 57..
text_mt: and spoke these words there: "Listen, O crest-jewel of kings! / Know me to be a sorceress, renowned by the name Śobhanā.

sanskrit_iast:
daṃpatī tava bhūpāla saṃhṛtau yena yatra vai ..
tatrāhaṃ ca gamiṣyāmi mahāmadasamanvitā .. 58 ..
meaning:
दंपती तव भूपाल संहृतौ येन यत्र वै ..
तत्राहं च गमिष्यामि महामदसमन्विता .. 58 ..
text_mt: Wherever and by whomsoever your couple has been taken away, O king, / thither I will go, filled with great zeal.

sanskrit_iast:
āhlādaścendulo vīro devo vai tālano balī ..
kṛṣṇāṃśapālitāssarve yāsyāmo bhūpate vayam .. 59..
meaning:
आह्लादश्चेन्दुलो वीरो देवो वै तालनो बली ..
कृष्णांशपालितास्सर्वे यास्यामो भूपते वयम् .. 59..
text_mt: Āhlāda, the hero Indula, Deva, and mighty Tālana— / all of us, protected by Kṛṣṇāṃśa, will go, O king!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā śobhanā veśyā kṛtvā yogamayaṃ vapuḥ ..
mahāmadaṃ samāruhya paiśācaṃ rudrakiṃkaram ..
prayayau tānpuraskṛtya yogiveṣānmahāba lān.. 3.3.30.60 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा शोभना वेश्या कृत्वा योगमयं वपुः ..
महामदं समारुह्य पैशाचं रुद्रकिंकरम् ..
प्रययौ तान्पुरस्कृत्य योगिवेषान्महाब लान्.. 3.3.30.60 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the courtesan Śobhanā, assuming a body made of yoga, / mounted Mahāmada, a demonic servant of Rudra, / and set out, placing those mighty warriors in ascetics' garb at the head.

sanskrit_iast:
āhlādo gajasaṃstho vai karālārūḍha indulaḥ ..
tālanaḥ siṃhinīsaṃstho devasiṃho manorathe ..
kṛṣṇāṃśo bindulārūḍho nartayāmāsa taṃ hayam.. 61 ..
meaning:
आह्लादो गजसंस्थो वै करालारूढ इन्दुलः ..
तालनः सिंहिनीसंस्थो देवसिंहो मनोरथे ..
कृष्णांशो बिन्दुलारूढो नर्तयामास तं हयम्.. 61 ..
text_mt: Āhlāda rode an elephant, Indula mounted Karālā, / Tālana rode a lioness, Devasiṃha a chariot, / and Kṛṣṇāṃśa, mounted on Bindulā, made that horse dance.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmarūpamayaṃ deśaṃ śatayojanagāminaḥ ..
balavaṃtaśca saṃprāptā gehegehe janejane ..
lakṣaṇaṃ śodhayāmāsurna prāptāstatra taṃ nṛpam .. 62 ..
meaning:
कामरूपमयं देशं शतयोजनगामिनः ..
बलवंतश्च संप्राप्ता गेहेगेहे जनेजने ..
लक्षणं शोधयामासुर्न प्राप्तास्तत्र तं नृपम् .. 62 ..
text_mt: Moving a hundred leagues, those mighty warriors arrived / at the land of Kāmarūpa; in house after house, among person after person, / they searched for Lakṣaṇa, but did not find the king there.

sanskrit_iast:
punarmayūranagaraṃ śobhanā taiḥ samanvitā ..
cinvatī taṃ manuṣyeṣu na prāptā tatra vai nṛpam .. 63 ..
meaning:
पुनर्मयूरनगरं शोभना तैः समन्विता ..
चिन्वती तं मनुष्येषु न प्राप्ता तत्र वै नृपम् .. 63 ..
text_mt: Then, accompanied by them, Śobhanā went to the city of Mayūra; / searching for him among the people, she did not find the king there.

sanskrit_iast:
punarinnagaḍhagrāmaṃ śobhanā ca janejane ..
lakṣaṇaṃ mṛgayāmāsa na prāpa tatra lakṣaṇam.. 64 ..
meaning:
पुनरिन्नगढग्रामं शोभना च जनेजने ..
लक्षणं मृगयामास न प्राप तत्र लक्षणम्.. 64 ..
text_mt: Then in the village of Innagaḍha, Śobhanā, person by person, / hunted for Lakṣaṇa, but did not find Lakṣaṇa there.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā bāhlīkanagaraṃ śobhanā taissamanvitā ..
lakṣaṇaṃ ca nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ nāpaśyattatra duḥkhitā .. 65 ..
meaning:
गत्वा बाह्लीकनगरं शोभना तैस्समन्विता ..
लक्षणं च नृपश्रेष्ठं नापश्यत्तत्र दुःखिता .. 65 ..
text_mt: Having gone to the city of Bāhlīka, Śobhanā, accompanied by them, / did not see the excellent king Lakṣaṇa there and was sorrowful.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ svadeśamāgamya bāhlīkaṃ mlecchavāsinam ..
markaṭeśvaramīśānaṃ tatrāha vanavāsinam ..
pūjayitvā ca sā veśyā gānanṛtyaparābhavat .. 66 ..
meaning:
पुनः स्वदेशमागम्य बाह्लीकं म्लेच्छवासिनम् ..
मर्कटेश्वरमीशानं तत्राह वनवासिनम् ..
पूजयित्वा च सा वेश्या गाननृत्यपराभवत् .. 66 ..
text_mt: Returning again to her own land of Bāhlīka inhabited by mlecchas, / she spoke there to the forest-dwelling lord Markaṭeśvara. / Having worshipped [him], the courtesan devoted herself to singing and dancing.

sanskrit_iast:
sa devo bhūmimadhyāt samāgamya mudānvitaḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ praṇato bhūtvā'bravīnmlecchaprapūjitaḥ .. 67 ..
meaning:
स देवो भूमिमध्यात् समागम्य मुदान्वितः ..
कृष्णांशं प्रणतो भूत्वाऽब्रवीन्म्लेच्छप्रपूजितः .. 67 ..
text_mt: That god, coming forth from within the earth filled with joy, / bowed down to Kṛṣṇāṃśa and spoke, he who was worshipped by mlecchas:

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ kālāgnirudreṇa bhūmigarte suropitaḥ ..
asamarthaṃ ca māṃ viddhi gaccha vīra yathāsukham .. 68 ..
meaning:
अहं कालाग्निरुद्रेण भूमिगर्ते सुरोपितः ..
असमर्थं च मां विद्धि गच्छ वीर यथासुखम् .. 68 ..
text_mt: "I have been placed in a hole in the earth by Kālāgnirudra. / Know that I am powerless; go, hero, at your pleasure."

sanskrit_iast: iti śrutvā ca sā śobhā nirāśābhūttadā svayam .. 69 ..
meaning: इति श्रुत्वा च सा शोभा निराशाभूत्तदा स्वयम् .. 69 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, Śobhā herself then became hopeless.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ svarṇavatīṃ prāpya sarvamevā dito'bravīt ..
triṃśadabdaiśca kṛṣṇāṃśe caitraśukla samāgate .. 3.3.30.70 ..
meaning:
पुनः स्वर्णवतीं प्राप्य सर्वमेवा दितोऽब्रवीत् ..
त्रिंशदब्दैश्च कृष्णांशे चैत्रशुक्ल समागते .. 3.3.30.70 ..
text_mt: Reaching Svarṇavatī once more, she told everything from the beginning. / When thirty years [had passed] for Kṛṣṇāṃśa, and the bright [fortnight] of Caitra had arrived,

sanskrit_iast:
tānāśvāsya suvarṇāṃgī pūjayāmāsa caṃḍikām ..
navarātraṃ gataṃ tasyā bhojanācchādanaṃ vinā ..
niśīthānte tamaḥprāpte gatvāha jagadambikā .. 71 ..
meaning:
तानाश्वास्य सुवर्णांगी पूजयामास चंडिकाम् ..
नवरात्रं गतं तस्या भोजनाच्छादनं विना ..
निशीथान्ते तमःप्राप्ते गत्वाह जगदम्बिका .. 71 ..
text_mt: having comforted them, the golden-limbed woman worshipped Caṇḍikā. / Her Navarātra passed without food or clothing. / At the end of midnight, when darkness arrived, the Mother of the Universe went and said:

sanskrit_iast:
padminī nāma yā nārī maṇidevasya vai priyā ..
jātā sā kāmapālasya gṛhe yajñāvamānitā .. 72 ..
meaning:
पद्मिनी नाम या नारी मणिदेवस्य वै प्रिया ..
जाता सा कामपालस्य गृहे यज्ञावमानिता .. 72 ..
text_mt: "The woman named Padminī, the beloved of Maṇideva, / was born in the house of Kāmapāla, having been dishonoured at a sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
senāpatiḥ kuberasya maṇidevo hi sa smṛtaḥ ..
pūrvaṃ hi bhīmasenena yakṣayuddheṣu ghātitaḥ .. 73 ..
meaning:
सेनापतिः कुबेरस्य मणिदेवो हि स स्मृतः ..
पूर्वं हि भीमसेनेन यक्षयुद्धेषु घातितः .. 73 ..
text_mt: Maṇideva is remembered as the general of Kubera; / long ago he was slain by Bhīmasena in the battles with the yakṣas.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tatpadminī nārī devadevamumāpatim ..
tuṣṭāva ca nirāhārā matpatiṃ dehi śaṃkara .. 74 ..
meaning:
तदा तत्पद्मिनी नारी देवदेवमुमापतिम् ..
तुष्टाव च निराहारा मत्पतिं देहि शंकर .. 74 ..
text_mt: Then that woman Padminī, abstaining from food, praised / the god of gods, the lord of Umā: 'Grant me my husband, O Śaṅkara!'

sanskrit_iast:
śatavarṣāṃtare devo mahādeva uvāca tām ..
kalau vikramakāle hi śatadvādaśake'ntike .. 75 ..
meaning:
शतवर्षांतरे देवो महादेव उवाच ताम् ..
कलौ विक्रमकाले हि शतद्वादशकेऽन्तिके .. 75 ..
text_mt: After a hundred years, the god Mahādeva said to her: / 'In the Kali [age], at the time of Vikrama, near the twelfth hundred [year],

sanskrit_iast:
nakulāṃśaṃ ca saṃprāpya bhuktvā tena mahatsukham ..
tadviyogena saṃtyajya dehaṃ padmānuvāsitam ..
svapatiṃ ca tadā prāpya kailāsaṃ punareṣyasi .. 76 ..
meaning:
नकुलांशं च संप्राप्य भुक्त्वा तेन महत्सुखम् ..
तद्वियोगेन संत्यज्य देहं पद्मानुवासितम् ..
स्वपतिं च तदा प्राप्य कैलासं पुनरेष्यसि .. 76 ..
text_mt: having obtained a portion of Nakula and enjoyed great pleasure with him, / you will abandon this body perfumed with lotus on separation from him; / and having then obtained your husband, you will return to Kailāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāvatīṃ purīṃ ramyāṃ rāṣṭrapālāya śāradā ..
kariṣyati tadā devī maṇidevastu tvatpatiḥ .. 77 ..
meaning:
महावतीं पुरीं रम्यां राष्ट्रपालाय शारदा ..
करिष्यति तदा देवी मणिदेवस्तु त्वत्पतिः .. 77 ..
text_mt: The goddess Śāradā will then make the delightful city of Mahāvatī / for Rāṣṭrapāla; but your husband Maṇideva,

sanskrit_iast:
tayā viracito bhūmau grāmarakṣārthamudyataḥ ..
prāptastvāṃ padminīṃ nārīṃ kailāsaṃ punareṣyati .. 78 ..
meaning:
तया विरचितो भूमौ ग्रामरक्षार्थमुद्यतः ..
प्राप्तस्त्वां पद्मिनीं नारीं कैलासं पुनरेष्यति .. 78 ..
text_mt: fashioned by her on earth, intent upon protecting the villages, / having obtained you, the woman Padminī, will return to Kailāsa.'

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ svarṇavati tvaṃ vai kailāsaṃ guhyakālayam ..
gatvāśu padminīṃ tatra bodhayāśu vacaḥ kuru .. 79 ..
meaning:
अतः स्वर्णवति त्वं वै कैलासं गुह्यकालयम् ..
गत्वाशु पद्मिनीं तत्र बोधयाशु वचः कुरु .. 79 ..
text_mt: Therefore, O Svarṇavatī, go quickly to Kailāsa, the abode of the Guhyakas; / awaken Padminī there and carry out my word."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā svarṇavatī padminīṃ prati cāgamat ..
vṛttāṃtaṃ kathayitvāgre padminīṃ tu dayāturā .. 3.3.30.80 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा स्वर्णवती पद्मिनीं प्रति चागमत् ..
वृत्तांतं कथयित्वाग्रे पद्मिनीं तु दयातुरा .. 3.3.30.80 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, Svarṇavatī went to Padminī. / Overcome with compassion, she recounted the story to Padminī;

sanskrit_iast:
kāmapālagṛhaṃ prāpya tatra vāsamakārayat ..
svarṇavatyapi saṃprāptā tadā śīghraṃ mahāvatīm .. 81 ..
meaning:
कामपालगृहं प्राप्य तत्र वासमकारयत् ..
स्वर्णवत्यपि संप्राप्ता तदा शीघ्रं महावतीम् .. 81 ..
text_mt: reaching the house of Kāmapāla, she made her residence there. / Svarṇavatī too then quickly arrived at Mahāvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ gatāyāṃ gehe vai padminyā likhitaṃ śubham ..
patraṃ parimalo rājā vartayāmāsa harṣitaḥ ..83..
meaning:
तस्यां गतायां गेहे वै पद्मिन्या लिखितं शुभम् ..
पत्रं परिमलो राजा वर्तयामास हर्षितः ..83..
text_mt: When she had gone to her home, King Parimala, / filled with joy, delivered the auspicious letter written by Padminī:

sanskrit_iast:
āgaccha senayā sārddhaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśa balavattara ..
jitvā padmākaraṃ baṃdhuṃ matpatiṃ mocayāśu vai..
bhūtale lakṣaṇo rājā sthitaḥ padmākarārtigaḥ .. 83 ..
meaning:
आगच्छ सेनया सार्द्धं कृष्णांश बलवत्तर ..
जित्वा पद्माकरं बंधुं मत्पतिं मोचयाशु वै..
भूतले लक्षणो राजा स्थितः पद्माकरार्तिगः .. 83 ..
text_mt: "Come with your army, O most mighty Kṛṣṇāṃśa! / Conquer our kinsman Padmākara and swiftly release my husband! / King Lakṣaṇa is on earth, suffering affliction from Padmākara."

sanskrit_iast:
iti jñātvā ca kṛṣṇāṃśo lakṣadvādaśasenayā ..
rurodha nagarīṃ sarvāṃ kāmapālena rakṣitām .. 84 ..
meaning:
इति ज्ञात्वा च कृष्णांशो लक्षद्वादशसेनया ..
रुरोध नगरीं सर्वां कामपालेन रक्षिताम् .. 84 ..
text_mt: Knowing this, Kṛṣṇāṃśa with an army of twelve hundred thousand / besieged the entire city guarded by Kāmapāla.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmapālastu balavāṃstrilakṣabalasaṃyutaḥ ..
sutājñayā yayau yuddhaṃ sārddhaṃ padmākareṇa vai .. 85..
meaning:
कामपालस्तु बलवांस्त्रिलक्षबलसंयुतः ..
सुताज्ञया ययौ युद्धं सार्द्धं पद्माकरेण वै .. 85..
text_mt: Then the mighty Kāmapāla, accompanied by a force of three hundred thousand, / went out to battle together with Padmākara at his daughter's command.

sanskrit_iast:
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ senayorubhayostadā ..
ahorātrapramāṇena bhūpasenā parājitā .. 86 ..
meaning:
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धं सेनयोरुभयोस्तदा ..
अहोरात्रप्रमाणेन भूपसेना पराजिता .. 86 ..
text_mt: Then a great battle took place between the two armies; / in the measure of a day and night, the king's army was defeated.

sanskrit_iast:
padminīṃ śaraṇaṃ prāpya tadā bhrātā pitā sthitaḥ ..
tayorvijayamevāśu yathāprāptaṃ cakāra sā ..
antarddhānamayaṃ patraṃ tayorarthe ca sā dadau .. 87 ..
meaning:
पद्मिनीं शरणं प्राप्य तदा भ्राता पिता स्थितः ..
तयोर्विजयमेवाशु यथाप्राप्तं चकार सा ..
अन्तर्द्धानमयं पत्रं तयोरर्थे च सा ददौ .. 87 ..
text_mt: Then the brother and father stood, having taken refuge with Padminī. / She swiftly brought about their victory as it had been obtained: / she gave them a leaf that possessed [the power of] invisibility.

sanskrit_iast:
tau tatrāntarhitau bhūtvā svakhaḍgena riporbalam ..
ayutaṃ jaghnaturmattau tadā te vismayaṃ gatāḥ ..88..
meaning:
तौ तत्रान्तर्हितौ भूत्वा स्वखड्गेन रिपोर्बलम् ..
अयुतं जघ्नतुर्मत्तौ तदा ते विस्मयं गताः ..88..
text_mt: The two, having become invisible there, struck down ten thousand / of the enemy's force with their own swords, intoxicated [with battle]; then they were astonished.

sanskrit_iast:
tālanādyā raṇaṃ tyaktvā kṛṣṇāṃṇaśaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśo'pi tadā duḥkhī dhyātvā sarvamayīṃ śivām .. 89 ..
meaning:
तालनाद्या रणं त्यक्त्वा कृष्णांणशं शरणं ययुः ..
कृष्णांशोऽपि तदा दुःखी ध्यात्वा सर्वमयीं शिवाम् .. 89 ..
text_mt: Tālana and the others abandoned the battle and fled to Kṛṣṇāṃśa for refuge. / Kṛṣṇāṃśa too, grieving then, meditated upon Śivā, who consists of all things.

sanskrit_iast:
divyadṛṣṭistato jātaḥ saṃprāpya tamayudhyata ..
nabhogataṃ kāmapālaṃ tathā padmākaraṃ nṛpam .. 3.3.30.90 ..
meaning:
दिव्यदृष्टिस्ततो जातः संप्राप्य तमयुध्यत ..
नभोगतं कामपालं तथा पद्माकरं नृपम् .. 3.3.30.90 ..
text_mt: Endowed with divine sight as a result, he reached and fought / Kāmapāla who had gone into the sky, and likewise King Padmākara.

sanskrit_iast:
baddhvā tatra mudāviṣṭo lakṣaṇaṃ prāpya nirbhayaḥ ..
dolāmāropya tāṃ devīṃ svagehāya mudā yayau .. 91 ..
meaning:
बद्ध्वा तत्र मुदाविष्टो लक्षणं प्राप्य निर्भयः ..
दोलामारोप्य तां देवीं स्वगेहाय मुदा ययौ .. 91 ..
text_mt: Having bound [them] there, filled with joy, fearless after finding Lakṣaṇa, / and placing that lady in a palanquin, he went with joy to his own home.

sanskrit_iast:
jayacaṃdrāya bhūpāya dattvā vai tau ca daṃpatī ..
lakṣaṇaṃ padminīṃ caiva kṛtakṛtyastadābhavat .. 92 ..
meaning:
जयचंद्राय भूपाय दत्त्वा वै तौ च दंपती ..
लक्षणं पद्मिनीं चैव कृतकृत्यस्तदाभवत् .. 92 ..
text_mt: Having given that couple, Lakṣaṇa and Padminī, / to King Jayacandra, he then accomplished his purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
jayacaṃdro'pi balavāndṛṣṭvā gehe svadaṃpatī ..
dadau dānaṃ dvijātibhyo bhūpatiṃ samamocayat ..
jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe kṛṣṇāṃśo gehamāgataḥ .. 93 ..
meaning:
जयचंद्रोऽपि बलवान्दृष्ट्वा गेहे स्वदंपती ..
ददौ दानं द्विजातिभ्यो भूपतिं सममोचयत् ..
ज्येष्ठे मासि सिते पक्षे कृष्णांशो गेहमागतः .. 93 ..
text_mt: The mighty Jayacandra too, seeing the couple in his own home, / gave gifts to the twice-born and released the king. / In the month of Jyeṣṭha, in the bright fortnight, Kṛṣṇāṃśa returned home.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ vipra kṛṣṇāṃśacaritaṃ śubham ..
punaste kathayiṣyāmi dṛṣṭaṃ yogabalena vai ..94..
meaning:
इति ते कथितं विप्र कृष्णांशचरितं शुभम् ..
पुनस्ते कथयिष्यामि दृष्टं योगबलेन वै ..94..
text_mt: Thus has the auspicious deeds of Kṛṣṇāṃśa been told to you, O brāhmaṇa. / I shall tell you again what was seen by the power of yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu vipra mahābhāga caṃdrabhaṭṭastadā svayam ..
mahīrājaṃ sadaḥsthaṃ taṃ candratulyassamāgataḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
शृणु विप्र महाभाग चंद्रभट्टस्तदा स्वयम् ..
महीराजं सदःस्थं तं चन्द्रतुल्यस्समागतः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Listen, O greatly fortunate brāhmaṇa: Candrabhaṭṭa himself then, / equal to the moon, came to King Mahīrāja as he sat in assembly.
title: adhyāyaḥ 31

sanskrit_iast:
tamāgataṃ samālokya sa rājā śokatatparaḥ ..
uvāca vacanaṃ ramyaṃ śṛṇu maṃtrivara prabho .. 2 ..
meaning:
तमागतं समालोक्य स राजा शोकतत्परः ..
उवाच वचनं रम्यं शृणु मंत्रिवर प्रभो .. 2 ..
text_mt: Seeing him arrive, that king, intent on sorrow, / spoke charming words: "Listen, O best of ministers, O lord!

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśādyairmahāśūrairmadgrāme bhayamāgatam ..
kadā te ca mariṣyaṃti kaṃṭakā mama dāruṇāḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
कृष्णांशाद्यैर्महाशूरैर्मद्ग्रामे भयमागतम् ..
कदा ते च मरिष्यंति कंटका मम दारुणाः .. 3 ..
text_mt: Because of Kṛṣṇāṃśa and the other great heroes, fear has come upon my village. / When will those terrible thorns of mine die?"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktassa tu śuddhātmā dhyātvā sarvamayīṃ śivām ..
vacanaṃ prāha rājānaṃ stha bhūpaśiromaṇe .. 4 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तस्स तु शुद्धात्मा ध्यात्वा सर्वमयीं शिवाम् ..
वचनं प्राह राजानं स्थ भूपशिरोमणे .. 4 ..
text_mt: Having been addressed thus, that pure-souled one, having meditated upon Śivā who consists of all things, / spoke these words to the king: "Wait, O crest-jewel of kings!"

sanskrit_iast:
jiṣṇoraṃśātsamudbhūto brahmānaṃdo mahāvatīm ..
sa kṛṣṇāṃśasakhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvadā tatpriye rataḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
जिष्णोरंशात्समुद्भूतो ब्रह्मानंदो महावतीम् ..
स कृष्णांशसखः श्रेष्ठः सर्वदा तत्प्रिये रतः .. 5 ..
text_mt:
Born from a portion of Jiṣṇu, Brahmānanda [dwells in] Mahāvatī.
He is the foremost friend of Kṛṣṇāṃśa, always devoted to his welfare.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā ca malanāputro dehaṃ tyaktvā gamiṣyati ..
tadā te sarvadevāṃśā gamiṣyaṃti yato gatāḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
यदा च मलनापुत्रो देहं त्यक्त्वा गमिष्यति ..
तदा ते सर्वदेवांशा गमिष्यंति यतो गताः .. 6 ..
text_mt:
And when the son of Malanā abandons his body and departs,
then all those portions of the gods will depart whence they came.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃvādinaṃ dhīramamātyaṃ ca mahīpatiḥ ..
vacanaṃ prāha namrātmā ko'pyarthaściṃtito mayā .. 7 .. .
meaning:
इत्येवंवादिनं धीरममात्यं च महीपतिः ..
वचनं प्राह नम्रात्मा कोऽप्यर्थश्चिंतितो मया .. 7 .. .
text_mt:
To the wise minister speaking thus, the king,
humbling himself, said these words: “A plan has been conceived by me.

sanskrit_iast:
ekākinaṃ mahāśūraṃ brahmānaṃdaṃ nṛpottamam ..
samāhūya mahīrājo dvirāgamanahetave ..
chadmanā ghātayitvā taṃ kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyati .. 8 ..
meaning:
एकाकिनं महाशूरं ब्रह्मानंदं नृपोत्तमम् ..
समाहूय महीराजो द्विरागमनहेतवे ..
छद्मना घातयित्वा तं कृतकृत्यो भविष्यति .. 8 ..
text_mt:
Summoning the lone, heroic, best of kings, Brahmānanda,
on the pretext of the second-homecoming rite,
King Mahīrāja, having him killed by deceit, will have accomplished his purpose.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityukte nṛpatiṃ prāha mahīrājaḥ prasannadhīḥ ..
vacanaṃ śṛṇu bho mitra gaccha śīghraṃ mahāvatīm .. 9 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्ते नृपतिं प्राह महीराजः प्रसन्नधीः ..
वचनं शृणु भो मित्र गच्छ शीघ्रं महावतीम् .. 9 ..
text_mt:
When this was said, Mahīrāja, with a pleased mind, said to the king:
“Listen to my words, O friend: go quickly to Mahāvatī,

sanskrit_iast:
malanāṃ ca samāgatya bodhayitvā tu tāṃ svayam ..
mamāntikamupāgamya ciraṃ jīva sukhībhava .. 3.3.31.10 ..
meaning:
मलनां च समागत्य बोधयित्वा तु तां स्वयम् ..
ममान्तिकमुपागम्य चिरं जीव सुखीभव .. 3.3.31.10 ..
text_mt:
and having approached Malanā and instructed her yourself,
come back to my side; live long and be happy!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ natvā taṃ ca mahīpatiḥ ..
rātrau ghoraṃ muniśreṣṭha malanāṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ ..11 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं नत्वा तं च महीपतिः ..
रात्रौ घोरं मुनिश्रेष्ठ मलनां प्राह निर्भयः ..11 ..
text_mt:
Having heard those words and bowed to him, that king,
fearless, in the dreadful night, O best of sages, said to Malanā:

sanskrit_iast:
vadhūstava mahārājñi velā nāma surūpiṇī ..
saṃprāptā yauvanavatī patiyogyā śubhānanā .. 12 ..
meaning:
वधूस्तव महाराज्ञि वेला नाम सुरूपिणी ..
संप्राप्ता यौवनवती पतियोग्या शुभानना .. 12 ..
text_mt:
“O queen, your daughter-in-law, beautiful, named Velā,
has attained her youth; she is fit for a husband, with an auspicious face.

sanskrit_iast:
kujātiścaiva kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ śruto rājñā mahātmanā ..
ato na preṣitā putrī tava putrāya dhīmate ..
ato madvacanaṃ matvā kuru kāryaṃ tava priyam .. 13 ..
meaning:
कुजातिश्चैव कृष्णांशः श्रुतो राज्ञा महात्मना ..
अतो न प्रेषिता पुत्री तव पुत्राय धीमते ..
अतो मद्वचनं मत्वा कुरु कार्यं तव प्रियम् .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
mayā sārddhaṃ tava suto brahmānaṃdo mahābalaḥ ..
urvīyāṃ nagarīṃ prāpya tadā matsainyasaṃyutaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
मया सार्द्धं तव सुतो ब्रह्मानंदो महाबलः ..
उर्वीयां नगरीं प्राप्य तदा मत्सैन्यसंयुतः .. 14 ..
text_mt:
Together with me, your mighty son Brahmānanda,
having reached the city in the land, accompanied by my army,

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājamupāgamya patnīṃ śīghramavāpsyati ..
no cenmamājñayā velā tyaktvā kāntaṃ mariṣyati .. 15 ..
meaning:
महीराजमुपागम्य पत्नीं शीघ्रमवाप्स्यति ..
नो चेन्ममाज्ञया वेला त्यक्त्वा कान्तं मरिष्यति .. 15 ..
text_mt:
and approaching Mahīrāja, will quickly obtain his wife;
otherwise, by my command, Velā will abandon her lover and die.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu sā rājñī mohitā devamāyayā ..
rājānaṃ samupāgamya bhrāturvacanamuttamam ..
kathayāmāsa vai sarvaṃ śrutvā bhūpo'bravīdidam .. 16 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु सा राज्ञी मोहिता देवमायया ..
राजानं समुपागम्य भ्रातुर्वचनमुत्तमम् ..
कथयामास वै सर्वं श्रुत्वा भूपोऽब्रवीदिदम् .. 16 ..
text_mt:
Hearing this, that queen, bewildered by the illusion of the gods,
went to the king and told him all the excellent words
of her brother; having heard it, the king said this:

sanskrit_iast:
mahīpatirmahādhūrto madvināśāya codyataḥ ..
tasya vārtā na me ramyā kapaṭastena nirmitaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
महीपतिर्महाधूर्तो मद्विनाशाय चोद्यतः ..
तस्य वार्ता न मे रम्या कपटस्तेन निर्मितः .. 17 ..
text_mt:
“The ruler is an utter rogue, intent upon my destruction.
His report does not please me; a fraud has been concocted by him.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā ca malanā rājānaṃ kopasaṃyutam ..
vacanaṃ prāha bho rājanyathā baṃdhustathā hyaham..
vacanaṃ kuru me rājanno cetprāṇāṃstyajāmyaham..18..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा च मलना राजानं कोपसंयुतम् ..
वचनं प्राह भो राजन्यथा बंधुस्तथा ह्यहम्..
वचनं कुरु मे राजन्नो चेत्प्राणांस्त्यजाम्यहम्..18..

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktavādinīṃ rātrau tadā parimalo nṛpaḥ ..
brahmānandaṃ dadau tasmai sa suto mātṛvatsalaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तवादिनीं रात्रौ तदा परिमलो नृपः ..
ब्रह्मानन्दं ददौ तस्मै स सुतो मातृवत्सलः .. 19 ..
text_mt:
To her who spoke thus in the night, King Parimala then
surrendered Brahmānanda; that son was devoted to his mother.

sanskrit_iast:
māturājñāṃ puraskṛtya mātulena samanvitaḥ ..
rātrau ca mātulagrāmaṃ saṃprāpya mudito'bhavat ..3.3.31.20..
meaning:
मातुराज्ञां पुरस्कृत्य मातुलेन समन्वितः ..
रात्रौ च मातुलग्रामं संप्राप्य मुदितोऽभवत् ..3.3.31.20..
text_mt:
Placing his mother’s command foremost, accompanied by his maternal uncle,
he arrived at his uncle’s village in the night and was glad.

sanskrit_iast:
prātaḥkāle ca saṃprāpte harināgaramāsthitaḥ ..
ekākī dehalīṃ ramyāṃ prayayau devamohitaḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
प्रातःकाले च संप्राप्ते हरिनागरमास्थितः ..
एकाकी देहलीं रम्यां प्रययौ देवमोहितः .. 21 ..
text_mt:
And when morning arrived, mounted on Harināgara,
alone, enchanted by the gods, he set out for lovely Dehalī.

sanskrit_iast:
sāyaṃkāle tu saṃprāpte mahīrājasya maṃdire ..
agamāṃ darśayāmāsa surūpāṃ divyavigrahām .. 22 ..
meaning:
सायंकाले तु संप्राप्ते महीराजस्य मंदिरे ..
अगमां दर्शयामास सुरूपां दिव्यविग्रहाम् .. 22 ..
text_mt:
When evening arrived at the mansion of Mahīrāja,
[the king] presented Agamā, of lovely form and divine body.

sanskrit_iast:
agamā ca samālokya paraṃ harṣamupāyayau ..
māghaśuklasya cāṣṭamyāṃ brahmānaṃdaśca nirbhayaḥ ..
śyālānāṃ yoṣitaḥ sapta dadarśa rucirānanā .. 23 ..
meaning:
अगमा च समालोक्य परं हर्षमुपाययौ ..
माघशुक्लस्य चाष्टम्यां ब्रह्मानंदश्च निर्भयः ..
श्यालानां योषितः सप्त ददर्श रुचिरानना .. 23 ..
text_mt:
And Agamā, seeing [him], felt supreme joy.
On the eighth day of the bright fortnight of Māgha, fearless Brahmānanda
saw the seven charming-faced wives of his brothers-in-law.

sanskrit_iast:
tisro nāryaśca vidhavāścatasro dhavasaṃyutāḥ ..
brahmānaṃdaṃ śarumayaṃ vākyamūcurmudānvitāḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
तिस्रो नार्यश्च विधवाश्चतस्रो धवसंयुताः ..
ब्रह्मानंदं शरुमयं वाक्यमूचुर्मुदान्विताः .. 24 ..
text_mt:
Three women were widows, and four were with husbands;
filled with joy, they spoke words sharp as arrows to Brahmānanda:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmānaṃda mahābhāga sāvadhānaṃ vacaḥ śṛṇu ..
tava patnī svayaṃ kālī velā kalaharūpiṇī ..
saṃjahāra dhavāneva no vayaṃ tu suduḥkhitā .. 25 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मानंद महाभाग सावधानं वचः शृणु ..
तव पत्नी स्वयं काली वेला कलहरूपिणी ..
संजहार धवानेव नो वयं तु सुदुःखिता .. 25 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sāpatnyamastu tattasyā gṛhāṇāsmānmanohara ..
dhavānvidehi no vīra patirbhava mudānvitaḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
सापत्न्यमस्तु तत्तस्या गृहाणास्मान्मनोहर ..
धवान्विदेहि नो वीर पतिर्भव मुदान्वितः .. 26 ..
text_mt:
Let that be co-wifehood for her; accept us, O handsome one!
Make us possessors of husbands, O hero; become our husband with joy!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vacastāsāṃ brahmānaṃdo mahābalaḥ ..
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ śrutismṛtisamanvitam .. 27 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तासां ब्रह्मानंदो महाबलः ..
उवाच मधुरं वाक्यं श्रुतिस्मृतिसमन्वितम् .. 27 ..
text_mt:
Hearing those words of theirs, the mighty Brahmānanda
spoke sweet words consistent with the Śruti and Smṛti:

sanskrit_iast:
purā satyayuge nārī cottamā ca pativratā ..
tretāyāṃ madhyamā jātā nikṛṣṭā dvāpare punaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
पुरा सत्ययुगे नारी चोत्तमा च पतिव्रता ..
त्रेतायां मध्यमा जाता निकृष्टा द्वापरे पुनः .. 28 ..
text_mt:
“In ancient times, in the Satya Yuga, a woman was supreme and devoted to her husband;
in the Tretā she became mediocre, and in the Dvāpara, degenerate.

sanskrit_iast:
adhamā hi kalau nārī parapuṃsopabhoginī ..
atastu kalikāle vai vihāho? vidhavāstriyāḥ ..
devalena śubhaḥ proktaścāsitena svayaṃ smṛtau ..29..
meaning:
अधमा हि कलौ नारी परपुंसोपभोगिनी ..
अतस्तु कलिकाले वै विहाहो? विधवास्त्रियाः ..
देवलेन शुभः प्रोक्तश्चासितेन स्वयं स्मृतौ ..29..

sanskrit_iast: satī satye tu sā proktā tretāyāṃ patibhasmagā ..3.3.31.30..
meaning: सती सत्ये तु सा प्रोक्ता त्रेतायां पतिभस्मगा ..3.3.31.30..
text_mt: She was declared a satī in the Satya; in the Tretā, she reduced herself to ashes with her husband;

sanskrit_iast:
satī sā madhyamā proktā dvāpare vidhavā satī ..
brahmacaryaparā jñeyā kalau nāsti satīvratam .. 31 ..
meaning:
सती सा मध्यमा प्रोक्ता द्वापरे विधवा सती ..
ब्रह्मचर्यपरा ज्ञेया कलौ नास्ति सतीव्रतम् .. 31 ..
text_mt:
she was declared a mediocre satī; in the Dvāpara, a widowed satī
should be known as devoted to celibacy; in the Kali age, there is no vow of a satī.

sanskrit_iast:
ato yūyaṃ mayā sārddhaṃ bhuṃkṣadhvamamalaṃ sukham ..
iti śrutvā priyaṃ vākyaṃ tisrastā vidhavāḥ striyaḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
अतो यूयं मया सार्द्धं भुंक्षध्वममलं सुखम् ..
इति श्रुत्वा प्रियं वाक्यं तिस्रस्ता विधवाः स्त्रियः .. 32 ..
text_mt:
Therefore, enjoy spotless pleasure together with me!”
Hearing these agreeable words, those three widowed women,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā śṛṃgāra rūpāṇi bhūṣaṇāni ca sarvaśaḥ ..
brahmānaṃdamupāgamya samāliṃganatatparāḥ ..33..
meaning:
कृत्वा शृंगार रूपाणि भूषणानि च सर्वशः ..
ब्रह्मानंदमुपागम्य समालिंगनतत्पराः ..33..
text_mt:
putting on erotic attire and all kinds of ornaments,
approached Brahmānanda, intent on embracing him.

sanskrit_iast: tā dṛṣṭvā malanāputro vacanaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ ..34..
meaning: ता दृष्ट्वा मलनापुत्रो वचनं प्राह निर्भयः ..34..
text_mt: Seeing them, the son of Malanā spoke fearlessly:

sanskrit_iast: yuṣmābhiḥ patayo muktā ye ca madbaṃdhunā hatāḥ .. 35 ..
meaning: युष्माभिः पतयो मुक्ता ये च मद्बंधुना हताः .. 35 ..
text_mt: “Your husbands were abandoned by you, and they were slain by my kinsman;

sanskrit_iast:
yuṣmānato na gṛhṇīyāṃ satyaṃsatyaṃ bravīmyaham..
iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ hāsyayuktaṃ ca yoṣitaḥ ..36..
meaning:
युष्मानतो न गृह्णीयां सत्यंसत्यं ब्रवीम्यहम्..
इति श्रुत्वा वचो घोरं हास्ययुक्तं च योषितः ..36..
text_mt:
therefore I will not take you; truly, truly I say [this]!”
Hearing this dread and mocking speech, the women,

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājantamāgamya rurudurbhṛśaduḥkhitāḥ..
rājanvelāpatirdhūrto mama dharmaṃ jahāti vai ..
daṃḍaṃ dehi ca dhūrtāya no cetprāṇāṃstyajāmyaham .. 37 ..
meaning:
महीराजन्तमागम्य रुरुदुर्भृशदुःखिताः..
राजन्वेलापतिर्धूर्तो मम धर्मं जहाति वै ..
दंडं देहि च धूर्ताय नो चेत्प्राणांस्त्यजाम्यहम् .. 37 ..
text_mt:
approaching Mahīrāja, wept, exceedingly afflicted:
“O King, Velā’s husband is a rogue; indeed, he violates my virtue!
Inflict punishment on that rogue; otherwise I shall abandon my life-breaths!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā mahīrājo brahmānandaṃ mahābalam ..
samāhūya vacaḥ prāha bhavānbhūpakulādhamaḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा महीराजो ब्रह्मानन्दं महाबलम् ..
समाहूय वचः प्राह भवान्भूपकुलाधमः .. 38 ..
text_mt:
Hearing this, Mahīrāja summoned the mighty Brahmānanda
and spoke these words: “You are the lowest of the royal line!

sanskrit_iast:
parastriyaṃ ca yo bhuṃkte sa yāti yamamaṃdiram ..
adyaiva tvaṃ sutākānta kārāgṛhamavāpnuyāḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
परस्त्रियं च यो भुंक्ते स याति यममंदिरम् ..
अद्यैव त्वं सुताकान्त कारागृहमवाप्नुयाः .. 39 ..
text_mt:
He who enjoys another’s wife goes to the abode of Yama.
This very day, O son-in-law, you shall be cast into prison!”

sanskrit_iast:
itiśrutvā vaco ghoraṃ brahmānaṃdo mahābalaḥ ..
satsaroḥ khaḍgamutsṛjya mahīrājamadhāvata .. 3.3.31.40 ..
meaning:
इतिश्रुत्वा वचो घोरं ब्रह्मानंदो महाबलः ..
सत्सरोः खड्गमुत्सृज्य महीराजमधावत .. 3.3.31.40 ..
text_mt:
Hearing these dreadful words, the mighty Brahmānanda
drew his sword from its scabbard and rushed at Mahīrāja.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā bhayāturo rājā cāmuṃḍāntamupāyayau..
kapāṭaṃ dṛḍhamācchādya tatra vāsamakārayat .. 41 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा भयातुरो राजा चामुंडान्तमुपाययौ..
कपाटं दृढमाच्छाद्य तत्र वासमकारयत् .. 41 ..
text_mt:
Seeing [him], the king, overcome with terror, fled to Cāmuṇḍā;
firmly shutting the door-leaf, he remained there.

sanskrit_iast:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ.. .. ..
tāsāṃ kathaṃ vivāhāḥ syustattvaṃ no brūhi vistarāt..
kutratyāstāḥ kimaṃśāśca dṛṣṭā yogena vai tvayā .. 42..
meaning:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः.. .. ..
तासां कथं विवाहाः स्युस्तत्त्वं नो ब्रूहि विस्तरात्..
कुत्रत्यास्ताः किमंशाश्च दृष्टा योगेन वै त्वया .. 42..
text_mt:
The sages said:
How did their marriages take place? Tell us the truth in detail.
From where were they, and of what were they portions, as seen by you through yoga?

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca. ..
aṃgadeśe muniśreṣṭha māyāvarmanṛpo'bhavat ..
tāmasīṃ pūjayitvā vai śaktiṃ sarvavimohinīm .. 43 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच. ..
अंगदेशे मुनिश्रेष्ठ मायावर्मनृपोऽभवत् ..
तामसीं पूजयित्वा वै शक्तिं सर्वविमोहिनीम् .. 43 ..
text_mt:
Sūta said:
In the country of Aṅga, O best of sages, there was a king named Māyāvarman.
Having worshipped the dark Power who deludes all,

sanskrit_iast:
varmottamaṃ tayā dattaṃ sarvasattvabhayaṃkaram.
gṛhītvā sa tu bhūpālaḥ prasthito'bhūnmahītale ..44..
meaning:
वर्मोत्तमं तया दत्तं सर्वसत्त्वभयंकरम्.
गृहीत्वा स तु भूपालः प्रस्थितोऽभून्महीतले ..44..
text_mt:
he was given an excellent armour by her, which struck terror into all beings;
having received it, that king set forth on the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
pramadā nāma tatpatnī daśa putrānasūṣuvat ..
kauravāṃśānmahābhāga varṣānte nāma me śṛṇu ..45..
meaning:
प्रमदा नाम तत्पत्नी दश पुत्रानसूषुवत् ..
कौरवांशान्महाभाग वर्षान्ते नाम मे शृणु ..45..
text_mt:
His wife, named Pramadā, gave birth to ten sons,
portions of the Kauravas, O noble one, at the end of the year; hear their names from me:

sanskrit_iast:
mattaḥ pramatta unmatta sumatto durmadastathā..
durmukho durdharo bāhuḥ suratho virathaḥ kramāt.
teṣāṃ svasānujā cāsītsunāmnā madirekṣaṇā..46..
meaning:
मत्तः प्रमत्त उन्मत्त सुमत्तो दुर्मदस्तथा..
दुर्मुखो दुर्धरो बाहुः सुरथो विरथः क्रमात्.
तेषां स्वसानुजा चासीत्सुनाम्ना मदिरेक्षणा..46..

sanskrit_iast:
tasyā vai suṃdaraṃ rūpaṃ madāghūrṇitalocanam ..
kitavo nāma vai daityo dṛṣṭvā mohamupāgataḥ .. 47..
meaning:
तस्या वै सुंदरं रूपं मदाघूर्णितलोचनम् ..
कितवो नाम वै दैत्यो दृष्ट्वा मोहमुपागतः .. 47..
text_mt: Seeing her beautiful form, with eyes rolling from intoxication, / a daitya named Kitava fell under the sway of delusion.

sanskrit_iast:
māyāvarmāṇamāgatya vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ ..
yadi tvaṃ me svatanayāṃ dehi kāmāturāya ca ..48..
meaning:
मायावर्माणमागत्य वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः ..
यदि त्वं मे स्वतनयां देहि कामातुराय च ..48..
text_mt: Approaching Māyāvarman, he said with a humble mind: / “If you give me your daughter, afflicted as I am with desire,

sanskrit_iast:
tarhi te sakalaṃ kāryaṃ kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ..
iti śrutvā tadā bhūpo dadau tasmai svakanyakām..49..
meaning:
तर्हि ते सकलं कार्यं करिष्यामि न संशयः ..
इति श्रुत्वा तदा भूपो ददौ तस्मै स्वकन्यकाम्..49..
text_mt: then I will accomplish all your tasks—of this there is no doubt.” / Hearing this, the king then gave him his daughter.

sanskrit_iast:
kitavo gahvarāvāsī rātrau ghore tamovṛte ..
nṛpagehamupāgamya bubhuje smaravihvalaḥ ..
prātaḥkāle tu tāṃ tyaktvā kandarāntamupāyayau..3.3.31.50..
meaning:
कितवो गह्वरावासी रात्रौ घोरे तमोवृते ..
नृपगेहमुपागम्य बुभुजे स्मरविह्वलः ..
प्रातःकाले तु तां त्यक्त्वा कन्दरान्तमुपाययौ..3.3.31.50..
text_mt: Kitava, dwelling in a cave, approached the king’s abode / at night in thick darkness and, frantic with passion, enjoyed her; / but at dawn he abandoned her and went back to his cave.

sanskrit_iast:
varmadevamate jāte tato rājā madāturaḥ..
purohitaṃ samāhūya lakṣadravyasamanvitam ..
mahīrājāya saṃpreṣya tārakaṃ sa samāvṛṇot ..51..
meaning:
वर्मदेवमते जाते ततो राजा मदातुरः..
पुरोहितं समाहूय लक्षद्रव्यसमन्वितम् ..
महीराजाय संप्रेष्य तारकं स समावृणोत् ..51..
text_mt: When Varman was inclined, the king, overcome with passion, / summoned the royal priest and sent him to Mahīrāja with a hundred thousand in wealth, / choosing Tāraka [for her].

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājastu balavām̐llakṣaṣoḍaśasainyapaḥ..
saṃyutaḥ śatabhūpālairmāsānte samupāgamat ..52..
meaning:
महीराजस्तु बलवाम्̐ल्लक्षषोडशसैन्यपः..
संयुतः शतभूपालैर्मासान्ते समुपागमत् ..52..
text_mt: Mahīrāja, mighty and commander of an army of one million six hundred thousand, / accompanied by a hundred kings, arrived at the end of the month.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśe paṃcadaśake saṃprāpte vratatatpare..
tārakaśca vivāhāya bahubhūpoṃgamānayat..53..
meaning:
कृष्णांशे पंचदशके संप्राप्ते व्रततत्परे..
तारकश्च विवाहाय बहुभूपोंगमानयत्..53..
text_mt: When the fifteenth [tithi] arrived in the dark fortnight, devoted to his vow, / Tāraka brought along many kings for the marriage.

sanskrit_iast:
māyāvarmā ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā tārakaṃ bhūpasaṃyutam..
vacanaṃ prāha balavānrājarāja vacaḥ śṛṇu.. 54..
meaning:
मायावर्मा च तं दृष्ट्वा तारकं भूपसंयुतम्..
वचनं प्राह बलवान्राजराज वचः शृणु.. 54..
text_mt: Seeing Tāraka accompanied by the kings, / mighty Māyāvarman said: “King of kings, hear my words!

sanskrit_iast:
kitavo nāma medhāvī daityavaṃśayaśaskaraḥ..
tena me pīḍitā bālā rātrau ghoratamovṛte ..55..
meaning:
कितवो नाम मेधावी दैत्यवंशयशस्करः..
तेन मे पीडिता बाला रात्रौ घोरतमोवृते ..55..
text_mt: A wise [demon] named Kitava, the glorifier of the daitya race, / has tormented my girl at night in the thick darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
hatā bhūpakumārāśca matsutārthaṃ samāgatāḥ..
bhakṣitāstena daityena saṃyayuste yamālayam.. 56 ..
meaning:
हता भूपकुमाराश्च मत्सुतार्थं समागताः..
भक्षितास्तेन दैत्येन संययुस्ते यमालयम्.. 56 ..
text_mt: The princes who came for my daughter’s sake were slain, / devoured by that daitya, and went to Yama’s abode.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ ca bahudhā dravyaṃ luṃṭhayitvā madāturaḥ..
matsutāyai dadau sarvaṃ tasmāttvaṃ ditijaṃ jahi..57..
meaning:
तेषां च बहुधा द्रव्यं लुंठयित्वा मदातुरः..
मत्सुतायै ददौ सर्वं तस्मात्त्वं दितिजं जहि..57..
text_mt: Having looted their wealth in many ways, mad with passion, / he gave it all to my daughter; therefore, slay that son of Diti!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā mahīrājassarvasainyasamanvitaḥ ..
kitavaṃ ca samāhūya mahadyuddhamacīkarat ..58..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा महीराजस्सर्वसैन्यसमन्वितः ..
कितवं च समाहूय महद्युद्धमचीकरत् ..58..
text_mt: Hearing this, Mahīrāja, accompanied by his entire army, / challenged Kitava and waged a great battle.

sanskrit_iast:
kitavassa tu māyāvī jitvā sarvānmahābalān..
tārakaṃ ca samāhṛtya guhāyāṃ samupāgamat .. 59 ..
meaning:
कितवस्स तु मायावी जित्वा सर्वान्महाबलान्..
तारकं च समाहृत्य गुहायां समुपागमत् .. 59 ..
text_mt: Kitava, that sorcerer, having defeated all those mighty men / and seized Tāraka, retreated into his cave.

sanskrit_iast:
tārakaśca tadā duḥkhī dhyātvā śaṃkaramuttamam ..
pāṣāṇabhūto hyagamanmahādevaprasādataḥ .. 3.3.31.60 ..
meaning:
तारकश्च तदा दुःखी ध्यात्वा शंकरमुत्तमम् ..
पाषाणभूतो ह्यगमन्महादेवप्रसादतः .. 3.3.31.60 ..
text_mt: Then sorrowful Tāraka, meditating on the supreme Śaṅkara, / turned to stone by the grace of Mahādeva.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare prāptā mahāvatīnivāsinaḥ ..
kṣatriyā daśasāhasrā kṛṣṇāṃśādyaiśca pālitāḥ .. 61 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्ता महावतीनिवासिनः ..
क्षत्रिया दशसाहस्रा कृष्णांशाद्यैश्च पालिताः .. 61 ..
text_mt: In the meantime, ten thousand kṣatriyas residing in Mahāvatī, / protected by Kṛṣṇāṃśa and the others, arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājastu tāndṛṣṭvā balakhāniṃ mahābalam ..
uvāca vacanaṃ premṇā putraśokena duḥkhitaḥ .. 62 ..
meaning:
महीराजस्तु तान्दृष्ट्वा बलखानिं महाबलम् ..
उवाच वचनं प्रेम्णा पुत्रशोकेन दुःखितः .. 62 ..
text_mt: Seeing them and the mighty Balakhāni, / Mahīrāja, grieved by sorrow for his son, spoke words with affection:

sanskrit_iast:
tārakaḥ kitavenaiva saṃhṛto ditijena vai ..
yadi tvaṃ me sutaṃ dehi koṭisvarṇaṃ dadāmi tat ..63..
meaning:
तारकः कितवेनैव संहृतो दितिजेन वै ..
यदि त्वं मे सुतं देहि कोटिस्वर्णं ददामि तत् ..63..
text_mt: “Tāraka has indeed been carried off by that son of Diti, Kitava. / If you give me back my son, I will give ten million in gold.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu te dhīrāḥ kṛṣṇāṃśo devasiṃhakaḥ ..
vatsajau ca tathāgamya kitavaṃ rurudhurbalāt ..64..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु ते धीराः कृष्णांशो देवसिंहकः ..
वत्सजौ च तथागम्य कितवं रुरुधुर्बलात् ..64..
text_mt: Hearing this, those resolute heroes—Kṛṣṇāṃśa, Devasiṃhaka, / and the two sons of Vatsa—went and besieged Kitava by force.

sanskrit_iast:
ahorātramabhūdyuddhaṃ teṣāṃ tena samanvitam ..
kitavastu ruṣāviṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ devasiṃhakam ..
balakhāniṃ mohayitvā jagarja ca punaḥpunaḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
अहोरात्रमभूद्युद्धं तेषां तेन समन्वितम् ..
कितवस्तु रुषाविष्टः कृष्णांशं देवसिंहकम् ..
बलखानिं मोहयित्वा जगर्ज च पुनःपुनः .. 65 ..
text_mt: A battle took place between them and him for a day and a night. / Filled with fury, Kitava bewitched Kṛṣṇāṃśa, Devasiṃhaka, / and Balakhāni, and roared repeatedly.

sanskrit_iast:
sukhakhānistadā śūraḥ kitavaṃ balavattaram ..
svakhaḍgena śirastasya chittvā rājānamāgamat .. 66 ..
meaning:
सुखखानिस्तदा शूरः कितवं बलवत्तरम् ..
स्वखड्गेन शिरस्तस्य छित्त्वा राजानमागमत् .. 66 ..
text_mt: Then heroic Sukhakhāni, severing the head of the exceedingly mighty Kitava / with his sword, approached the king.

sanskrit_iast:
trayaste sukhino bhūtvā sukhakhāniṃ praśasya ca ..
mahīrājāya ca dadau tārakaṃ kaitavaṃ śiraḥ .. .. 67 ..
meaning:
त्रयस्ते सुखिनो भूत्वा सुखखानिं प्रशस्य च ..
महीराजाय च ददौ तारकं कैतवं शिरः .. .. 67 ..
text_mt: Those three rejoiced, praised Sukhakhāni, / and delivered Tāraka and the head of Kitava to Mahīrāja.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā bhūpasutā devī sukhakhāniṃ samāvṛṇot ..
mahīpatistadāgatya tatsutāṃ madirekṣaṇām .. 68 ..
meaning:
तदा भूपसुता देवी सुखखानिं समावृणोत् ..
महीपतिस्तदागत्य तत्सुतां मदिरेक्षणाम् .. 68 ..
text_mt: Then the king’s daughter, a lady, chose Sukhakhāni. / The ruler of the earth, coming to his daughter with eyes rolling in intoxication,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbodhya vividhairvākyairbhūmirājāṃtamāgamat ..
tārakasya tayā sārddhaṃ vivāho mudito'bhavat .. 69 ..
meaning:
संबोध्य विविधैर्वाक्यैर्भूमिराजांतमागमत् ..
तारकस्य तया सार्द्धं विवाहो मुदितोऽभवत् .. 69 ..
text_mt: and comforting her with various words, went before King Mahīrāja; / and the marriage of Tāraka with her was joyfully celebrated.

sanskrit_iast:
koṭisvarṇaṃ nṛpātprāpya balakhānirmahābalaḥ ..
prayayau baṃdhubhissārddhaṃ śirīṣākhyapuraṃ śubham .. 3.3.31.70 ..
meaning:
कोटिस्वर्णं नृपात्प्राप्य बलखानिर्महाबलः ..
प्रययौ बंधुभिस्सार्द्धं शिरीषाख्यपुरं शुभम् .. 3.3.31.70 ..
text_mt: Having received ten million in gold from the king, the mighty Balakhāni / departed along with his kinsmen for the auspicious city named Śirīṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
gurjare nṛpatiścāsīnmūlavarmā mahābalaḥ ..
prabhāvatī tasya sutā daśaputrānujābhavat .. 71 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
गुर्जरे नृपतिश्चासीन्मूलवर्मा महाबलः ..
प्रभावती तस्य सुता दशपुत्रानुजाभवत् .. 71 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / In Gurjara there was a mighty king named Mūlavarman. / He had a daughter named Prabhāvatī, the younger sister of ten sons:

sanskrit_iast:
balaśca prabalaścaiva subalo balavānbalī ..
sumūlaśca mahābhūlo durgo bhīmo bhayaṃkaraḥ .. 72 ..
meaning:
बलश्च प्रबलश्चैव सुबलो बलवान्बली ..
सुमूलश्च महाभूलो दुर्गो भीमो भयंकरः .. 72 ..
text_mt: Bala, Prabala, Subala, Balavān, Balī, / Sumūla, Mahāmūla, Durga, Bhīma, and Bhayaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
karabho nāma vai yakṣo lallarājasya sevakaḥ ..
prabhāvatīṃ samālokya mumoha madavihvalaḥ ..
pañcavarṣāṃtare jāte tena bhuktā kumārikā .. 73 ..
meaning:
करभो नाम वै यक्षो लल्लराजस्य सेवकः ..
प्रभावतीं समालोक्य मुमोह मदविह्वलः ..
पञ्चवर्षांतरे जाते तेन भुक्ता कुमारिका .. 73 ..
text_mt: A yakṣa named Karabho, a servant of King Lalla, / saw Prabhāvatī and was bewitched, frantic with passion; / when five years had elapsed, he enjoyed the young girl.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlavarmā mahīrājaṃ samāhūya sasainyakam ..
vacanaṃ prāha namrātmā rājarāja vacaḥ kuru .. 74 ..
meaning:
मूलवर्मा महीराजं समाहूय ससैन्यकम् ..
वचनं प्राह नम्रात्मा राजराज वचः कुरु .. 74 ..
text_mt: Mūlavarman summoned Mahīrāja along with his army, / and with a humble spirit said: “King of kings, grant my request!

sanskrit_iast:
prabhāvatīṃ śubhāṃ kanyāṃ nṛharāya dadāmyaham ..
ityuktvā nṛharaṃ putraṃ samāhūya svamaṃdire ..
dadau vedavidhānena sutāṃ ca nṛharāya vai .. .. 75 ..
meaning:
प्रभावतीं शुभां कन्यां नृहराय ददाम्यहम् ..
इत्युक्त्वा नृहरं पुत्रं समाहूय स्वमंदिरे ..
ददौ वेदविधानेन सुतां च नृहराय वै .. .. 75 ..
text_mt: I give my auspicious daughter Prabhāvatī to Nṛhari.” / Having spoken thus, he summoned his son Nṛhari into his palace / and gave his daughter to Nṛhari according to Vedic rites.

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣamātrāṃtare yakṣaḥ karabhastatra cāgataḥ ..
daṃpatī pīḍayāmāsa jitvā sarvamahīpatīn .. 76 ..
meaning:
पक्षमात्रांतरे यक्षः करभस्तत्र चागतः ..
दंपती पीडयामास जित्वा सर्वमहीपतीन् .. 76 ..
text_mt: Within a fortnight the yakṣa Karabho arrived there; / defeating all the rulers of the earth, he tormented the couple.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājastadā duḥkhī vatsajau balavattarau ..
samāhūya kathitvāgre ruroda balavānbalī .. 77 ..
meaning:
महीराजस्तदा दुःखी वत्सजौ बलवत्तरौ ..
समाहूय कथित्वाग्रे रुरोद बलवान्बली .. 77 ..
text_mt: Then sorrowful Mahīrāja summoned the two exceedingly mighty sons of Vatsa, / spoke before them, and the powerful man wept.

sanskrit_iast:
dayālū vatsajau vīrau karabhāṃtamupeyatuḥ ..
karabhastau samālokya tatraivāṃtardhimāgamat ..
nāgapāśena tau baddhvā pīḍayāmāsa daṃpatī .. 7 ..
meaning:
दयालू वत्सजौ वीरौ करभांतमुपेयतुः ..
करभस्तौ समालोक्य तत्रैवांतर्धिमागमत् ..
नागपाशेन तौ बद्ध्वा पीडयामास दंपती .. 7 ..
text_mt: The two compassionate and heroic sons of Vatsa went to Karabho. / Seeing them, Karabho disappeared on the spot; / binding the two with a serpent-noose, he tormented the couple.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā sa kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ karabhaṃ yakṣakiṃkaram ..
baddhvā yogabalenaiva mocayāmāsa dampatī .. 79 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा स कृष्णांशः करभं यक्षकिंकरम् ..
बद्ध्वा योगबलेनैव मोचयामास दम्पती .. 79 ..
text_mt: Hearing of this, Kṛṣṇāṃśa bound the yakṣa-servant Karabho / by the power of yoga alone and released the couple.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrātarau tau samāgamya nāgapāśaṃ tu cāsinā ..
chittvā mumoda balavānkoṭisvarṇaṃ gṛhītavān..
bhūmirājaḥ prasannātmā dehalīṃ mudito'gamat.. 3.3.31.80 .. ..
meaning:
भ्रातरौ तौ समागम्य नागपाशं तु चासिना ..
छित्त्वा मुमोद बलवान्कोटिस्वर्णं गृहीतवान्..
भूमिराजः प्रसन्नात्मा देहलीं मुदितोऽगमत्.. 3.3.31.80 .. ..
text_mt: Approaching the two brothers, he cut the serpent-noose with a sword; / the mighty one rejoiced and received ten million in gold. / King Mahīrāja, his heart pleased, joyfully departed for Delhi.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
kāśmīre ca nṛpaścāsītkaikayo nāma viśrutaḥ ..
daśa putrāśca tasyaiva kanyā ca madanāvatī .. 81 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
काश्मीरे च नृपश्चासीत्कैकयो नाम विश्रुतः ..
दश पुत्राश्च तस्यैव कन्या च मदनावती .. 81 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / In Kaśmīra there was a renowned king named Kaikaya; / he had ten sons and a daughter named Madanāvatī:

sanskrit_iast:
kāmaḥ prakāmaḥ sakāmo niṣkāmo nirapatrapaḥ ..
jayaśca vijayaścaiva jayanto jayavāñjayaḥ .. 82 ..
meaning:
कामः प्रकामः सकामो निष्कामो निरपत्रपः ..
जयश्च विजयश्चैव जयन्तो जयवाञ्जयः .. 82 ..
text_mt: Kāma, Prakāma, Sakāma, Niṣkāma, Nirapatrapa, / Jaya, Vijaya, Jayanta, Jayavān, and Jaya.

sanskrit_iast:
sa bhūpo bhūmirājaṃ ca samāhūya vaco'bravīt ..
putraste vai saradano matkanyāṃ prāptumarhati .. 83 ..
meaning:
स भूपो भूमिराजं च समाहूय वचोऽब्रवीत् ..
पुत्रस्ते वै सरदनो मत्कन्यां प्राप्तुमर्हति .. 83 ..
text_mt: That king summoned King Mahīrāja and spoke these words: / “Your son Saradana is worthy to win my daughter.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃdharvassukalo nāma matkanyāṃ ca śubhānanām ..
jyotsnāyāṃ niśi saṃhṛtya tayā sārddhaṃ hi dīvyati .. 84 ..
meaning:
गंधर्वस्सुकलो नाम मत्कन्यां च शुभाननाम् ..
ज्योत्स्नायां निशि संहृत्य तया सार्द्धं हि दीव्यति .. 84 ..
text_mt: A gandharva named Sukala carries off my fair-faced daughter / on moonlit nights and sports with her.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇimāyāṃ ca saṃprāptaḥ sa vai citrarathapriyaḥ ..
vaiśākhasyāsite pakṣe cāṣṭamī cādya maṃgalā ..
vadhaṃ kuru nṛpaśreṣṭha dehalīṃ gaṃtumarhasi .. 85 ..
meaning:
पूर्णिमायां च संप्राप्तः स वै चित्ररथप्रियः ..
वैशाखस्यासिते पक्षे चाष्टमी चाद्य मंगला ..
वधं कुरु नृपश्रेष्ठ देहलीं गंतुमर्हसि .. 85 ..
text_mt: He, the favorite of Citraratha, arrives on the full moon. / Today is the auspicious aṣṭamī of the dark fortnight of Vaiśākha; / slay him, best of kings, and then you may go to Delhi.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā mahīrājo lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ ..
gṛhītvā daṃpatī śīghraṃ dehalīnagaraṃ yayau .. 86 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा महीराजो लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः ..
गृहीत्वा दंपती शीघ्रं देहलीनगरं ययौ .. 86 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, Mahīrāja, accompanied by an army of a hundred thousand, / quickly took the couple and went to the city of Delhi.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśākhyāṃ sukhajātāyāṃ sukalonāma vīryavān ..
gaṃdharvo daśa sāhasrai rurodha nagaraṃ ruṣā .. 87 ..
meaning:
वैशाख्यां सुखजातायां सुकलोनाम वीर्यवान् ..
गंधर्वो दश साहस्रै रुरोध नगरं रुषा .. 87 ..
text_mt: When the full moon of Vaiśākha peacefully arrived, the valiant / gandharva named Sukala furiously besieged the city with ten thousand [troops].

sanskrit_iast:
nagarācca bahirjātā ye śūrā madavihvalāḥ ..
hatvā tānsukalaḥ śīghraṃ rājñe duḥkhaṃ cakāra ha .. 88 ..
meaning:
नगराच्च बहिर्जाता ये शूरा मदविह्वलाः ..
हत्वा तान्सुकलः शीघ्रं राज्ञे दुःखं चकार ह .. 88 ..
text_mt: And whatever warriors went outside the city, bewildered with pride, / Sukala quickly slew them, causing distress to the king.

sanskrit_iast:
bhayabhīto mahīrājo dhyātvā sarvamayīṃ śivām ..
suṣvāpa niśi śuddhātmā tuṣṭābhūjjagadaṃbikā .. 89 ..
meaning:
भयभीतो महीराजो ध्यात्वा सर्वमयीं शिवाम् ..
सुष्वाप निशि शुद्धात्मा तुष्टाभूज्जगदंबिका .. 89 ..
text_mt: Terrified with fear, Mahīrāja meditated on Śivā, who embodies all things, / and slept at night, pure in spirit; the mother of the universe was pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśādīnbodhayitvā taiśca sārdhaṃ samāgamat ..
teṣāṃ cāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ gaṃdharveṇa tadāhnikam.. 3.3.31.90 ..
meaning:
कृष्णांशादीन्बोधयित्वा तैश्च सार्धं समागमत् ..
तेषां चासीन्महद्युद्धं गंधर्वेण तदाह्निकम्.. 3.3.31.90 ..
text_mt: She awakened Kṛṣṇāṃśa and the others, and came together with them; / and a great daytime battle ensued between them and the gandharva.

sanskrit_iast:
balakhāniśca balavāñchatagaṃdharvamuttamam ..
tridināṃte ca saṃhatya sukhakhānistathaiva ca .. 91 ...
meaning:
बलखानिश्च बलवाञ्छतगंधर्वमुत्तमम् ..
त्रिदिनांते च संहत्य सुखखानिस्तथैव च .. 91 ...
text_mt: The mighty Balakhāni, having slain a hundred noble gandharvas / at the end of three days, and likewise Sukhakhāni,

sanskrit_iast:
sukalaśca tadā kruddho gāṃdharvīṃ ca sasarja ha ..
bahudhā te hi gaṃdharvāstaiśca sārddhaṃ samārudhan .. 92 ..
meaning:
सुकलश्च तदा क्रुद्धो गांधर्वीं च ससर्ज ह ..
बहुधा ते हि गंधर्वास्तैश्च सार्द्धं समारुधन् .. 92 ..
text_mt: Sukala then, enraged, released Gandharva illusions; / in manifold forms indeed, those gandharvas besieged them together.

sanskrit_iast:
bhayabhītāstadā sarve rāmāṃśaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ..
āhlādaśca prasannātmā śāradāṃ sarvamaṃgalām .. 93 ..
meaning:
भयभीतास्तदा सर्वे रामांशं शरणं ययुः ..
आह्लादश्च प्रसन्नात्मा शारदां सर्वमंगलाम् .. 93 ..
text_mt: Then, terrified with fear, they all took refuge with Rāmāṃśa; / and Āhlāda, pleased in spirit, [praised] Śāradā, who is all-auspicious,

sanskrit_iast:
divāsūktena tuṣṭāva tadā prādurabhūcchivā. ..
gaṃdharvānmohayitvāśu drāvayāmāsa śāradā .. 94 ..
meaning:
दिवासूक्तेन तुष्टाव तदा प्रादुरभूच्छिवा. ..
गंधर्वान्मोहयित्वाशु द्रावयामास शारदा .. 94 ..
text_mt: praising her with the hymn to the Sun; then Śivā appeared. / Bewildering the gandharvas, Śāradā quickly put them to flight.

sanskrit_iast:
parājite ca gaṃdharve kṛṣṇāṃśo janamohanaḥ ..
mahīrājamupāgamya koṭisvarṇaṃ gṛhītavān .. 95 ..
meaning:
पराजिते च गंधर्वे कृष्णांशो जनमोहनः ..
महीराजमुपागम्य कोटिस्वर्णं गृहीतवान् .. 95 ..
text_mt: When the gandharva was defeated, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, the charmer of men, / approached Mahīrāja and received ten million gold pieces.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśābde ca kṛṣṇāṃśe saṃprāpte devipūjake ..
mārgamāsaṃ tu saṃprāpte mardanaśca vivāhitaḥ .. 96 ..
meaning:
षोडशाब्दे च कृष्णांशे संप्राप्ते देविपूजके ..
मार्गमासं तु संप्राप्ते मर्दनश्च विवाहितः .. 96 ..
text_mt: When Kṛṣṇāṃśa, the worshipper of the goddess, reached his sixteenth year, / and the month of Mārga arrived, Mardana was married.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
puṃḍradeśe mahārājo nāgavarmā mahābalaḥ ..
babhūva takṣakaparo dharmavāñjagatītale ...1 .. 97 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
पुंड्रदेशे महाराजो नागवर्मा महाबलः ..
बभूव तक्षकपरो धर्मवाञ्जगतीतले ...1 .. 97 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / In the Puṇḍra country, there was a mighty king named Nāgavarmā, / devoted to Takṣaka, righteous upon the surface of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
patnī nāgavatī tasya takṣakasya sutā śubhā ..
pituḥ śāpena sañjātā kaliṃgādhipateḥ sutā .. 98 ..
meaning:
पत्नी नागवती तस्य तक्षकस्य सुता शुभा ..
पितुः शापेन सञ्जाता कलिंगाधिपतेः सुता .. 98 ..
text_mt: His wife was Nāgavatī, the auspicious daughter of Takṣaka; / by her father’s curse, she was born as the daughter of the ruler of Kaliṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
daśaiva tanayāścāsankanyā tasya śubhānanā ..
suvelā nāma vikhyātā rūpayauvanaśālinī .. 99 ..
meaning:
दशैव तनयाश्चासन्कन्या तस्य शुभानना ..
सुवेला नाम विख्याता रूपयौवनशालिनी .. 99 ..
text_mt: He had ten sons, and an auspicious-faced daughter / renowned by the name Suvelā, endowed with beauty and youth.

sanskrit_iast:
purohitaṃ samāhūya mahīrājāya praiṣayat ..
sa gatvā kathayitvāgre mardano vīrato mayā .. 3.3.31.100 ..
meaning:
पुरोहितं समाहूय महीराजाय प्रैषयत् ..
स गत्वा कथयित्वाग्रे मर्दनो वीरतो मया .. 3.3.31.100 ..
text_mt: Summoning his family priest, he dispatched him to Mahīrāja; / going there, he announced beforehand: “Mardana, the hero, [is chosen] by me.”

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājastu tacchrutvā trilakṣabalasaṃyutaḥ ..
maṃgalaṃ kārayāmāsa gatvā nāgapure śubhe .. 101 ..
meaning:
महीराजस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा त्रिलक्षबलसंयुतः ..
मंगलं कारयामास गत्वा नागपुरे शुभे .. 101 ..
text_mt: Having heard that, Mahīrāja, accompanied by an army of three hundred thousand, / went to the auspicious city of Nāgapura and arranged the auspicious ceremonies.

sanskrit_iast:
suvelā pitaraṃ prāha dehi me nāgabhūṣaṇam..
vivāhaṃ hi kariṣyāmi nocetprāṇāṃstyajāmyaham .. 102 ..
meaning:
सुवेला पितरं प्राह देहि मे नागभूषणम्..
विवाहं हि करिष्यामि नोचेत्प्राणांस्त्यजाम्यहम् .. 102 ..
text_mt: Suvelā said to her father: “Give me the serpent ornament! / [Then] I will perform the marriage; otherwise, I shall give up my life.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā nāgavarmā mahīrājāntamāyayau ..
suvelāyā abhiprāyaṃ varṇayāmāsa vistarāt .. 103 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा नागवर्मा महीराजान्तमाययौ ..
सुवेलाया अभिप्रायं वर्णयामास विस्तरात् .. 103 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, Nāgavarmā came into the presence of Mahīrāja; / he described in detail Suvelā’s intention.

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktaḥ sa mahīrājo vismitobhūtsuduḥkhitaḥ ..
preṣayāmāsa vai patraṃ yatrāhlādādayaḥ sthitāḥ .. 104 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तः स महीराजो विस्मितोभूत्सुदुःखितः ..
प्रेषयामास वै पत्रं यत्राह्लादादयः स्थिताः .. 104 ..
text_mt: Being told this, King Mahīrāja was astonished and deeply grieved; / he sent a letter to where Āhlāda and the others dwelt.

sanskrit_iast:
iti jñātvā tadā''hlādaḥ śūrapaṃcaśatāvṛtaḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśavatsajaissārddhaṃ dināṃte ca samāgamat .. 105 ..
meaning:
इति ज्ञात्वा तदा'ऽह्लादः शूरपंचशतावृतः ..
कृष्णांशवत्सजैस्सार्द्धं दिनांते च समागमत् .. 105 ..
text_mt: Having learned this, Āhlāda, surrounded by five hundred heroes / along with the descendants of Kṛṣṇāṃśa and Vatsa, arrived at the end of the day.

sanskrit_iast:
śatayojanagāminyo vājinyaśca dviyāmake ....
sahasrayojanaṃ vīryaṃ tāsāṃ caiva dine niśi..106..
meaning:
शतयोजनगामिन्यो वाजिन्यश्च द्वियामके ....
सहस्रयोजनं वीर्यं तासां चैव दिने निशि..106..
text_mt: The mares traversed a hundred yojanas in two watches of the day; / their power indeed was a thousand yojanas in a day and night.

sanskrit_iast:
kalāṃśādudbhavā aśvā vājinā ca hareḥ svayam..
ratnāśvasya kalāṃśaśca kapoto haraṇībhavaḥ..107..
meaning:
कलांशादुद्भवा अश्वा वाजिना च हरेः स्वयम्..
रत्नाश्वस्य कलांशश्च कपोतो हरणीभवः..107..
text_mt: The horses were born from portions of the part of Hari himself; / Kapota, born of Haraṇī, was a portion of the part of the Jewel-Horse.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatro yobhavadvājī kālacakrapravartakaḥ ..
tatkalāṃśātsamudbhūto ravidattaḥ papīhakaḥ ..
hariṇī nāma tacchaktiḥ kalāṃśādbhūmimāgatā .. 108 ...
meaning:
गायत्रो योभवद्वाजी कालचक्रप्रवर्तकः ..
तत्कलांशात्समुद्भूतो रविदत्तः पपीहकः ..
हरिणी नाम तच्छक्तिः कलांशाद्भूमिमागता .. 108 ...
text_mt: The horse named Gāyatra, who sets in motion the wheel of Time— / from a portion of his part arose Papīhaka, given by the Sun; / and the potency named Hariṇī came to earth from a portion of his part.

sanskrit_iast:
sukhakhāniḥ papīhastho balakhāniḥ kapotagaḥ..
āhlādaśca karālastho biṃdulastho hareḥ kalā ..109..
meaning:
सुखखानिः पपीहस्थो बलखानिः कपोतगः..
आह्लादश्च करालस्थो बिंदुलस्थो हरेः कला ..109..
text_mt: Sukhakhāni mounted Papīha, and Balakhāni mounted Kapota; / Āhlāda mounted Karāla, and the portion of Hari mounted Biṃdula.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā te tu mahīrājaṃ natvā tuṃgāsanāṃ yayuḥ ..
prasannaḥ sa mahīrājo vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ .. 3.3.31.110 ..
meaning:
गत्वा ते तु महीराजं नत्वा तुंगासनां ययुः ..
प्रसन्नः स महीराजो वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः .. 3.3.31.110 ..
text_mt: Having gone and bowed to Mahīrāja, they took high seats; / pleased, Mahīrāja addressed them with humble mind:

sanskrit_iast:
mama putrāśca yuṣmābhistrayaḥ śūrā vivāhitāḥ ..
tathaiva mardanaṃ vīraṃ samudvāhya sukhī bhava ..111..
meaning:
मम पुत्राश्च युष्माभिस्त्रयः शूरा विवाहिताः ..
तथैव मर्दनं वीरं समुद्वाह्य सुखी भव ..111..
text_mt: “My three heroic sons have been married by you; / likewise, having married off the hero Mardana, be happy!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā sa āhlādo gatvā bhūtalamuttamam ..
rasātalaṃ ca vikhyātaṃ nāginīṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ .. 112 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा स आह्लादो गत्वा भूतलमुत्तमम् ..
रसातलं च विख्यातं नागिनीं प्राह निर्भयः .. 112 ..
text_mt: Having heard this, Āhlāda went to the noble netherworld / known as Rasātala, and, fearless, spoke to the serpent queen:

sanskrit_iast:
supto hi tava bhartā ca puṃḍarīkaḥ śubhānanaḥ ..
bodhayāśu mahārājñi nāgānāṃ no dayāṃ kuru ..113..
meaning:
सुप्तो हि तव भर्ता च पुंडरीकः शुभाननः ..
बोधयाशु महाराज्ञि नागानां नो दयां कुरु ..113..
text_mt: “Your handsome husband Puṇḍarīka is asleep; / awaken him quickly, O great queen, and have mercy upon us serpents!”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktā sāha taṃ vīraṃ puṃḍarīkaśca matpatiḥ ..
ruṣāviṣṭaśca balavāndāhayecca vapustava .. 114 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्ता साह तं वीरं पुंडरीकश्च मत्पतिः ..
रुषाविष्टश्च बलवान्दाहयेच्च वपुस्तव .. 114 ..
text_mt: Thus addressed, she said to the hero: “Puṇḍarīka is my husband; / seized with anger, powerful as he is, he would burn up your body.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vihasyāha tava bharturna no bhayam ..
ityevaṃ vacanaṃ kṛtvā padbhyāṃ pucchamatāḍayat .. 115 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा विहस्याह तव भर्तुर्न नो भयम् ..
इत्येवं वचनं कृत्वा पद्भ्यां पुच्छमताडयत् .. 115 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, he laughed and said: “We have no fear of your husband”; / having spoken thus, he struck the serpent’s tail with his two feet.

sanskrit_iast:
prabuddhaśca tadā rājā nāgānāṃ ca mahābalaḥ..
jvālāmālāṃ svadehācca janayāmāsa vīryavān..116..
meaning:
प्रबुद्धश्च तदा राजा नागानां च महाबलः..
ज्वालामालां स्वदेहाच्च जनयामास वीर्यवान्..116..
text_mt: Then the mighty king of the serpents was awakened; / valorous, he produced a wreath of flames from his body.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tadviṣamujjvālaṃ sa dhyātvā sarvamaṃgalām..
śamayāmāsa balavāndevīpūjanatatparaḥ ..117..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तद्विषमुज्ज्वालं स ध्यात्वा सर्वमंगलाम्..
शमयामास बलवान्देवीपूजनतत्परः ..117..
text_mt: Seeing that fierce, blazing poison, the mighty one, intent on worshipping the goddess, / meditated upon the all-auspicious goddess and pacified it.

sanskrit_iast:
puṃḍarīkaḥ prasannātmā nāgabhūṣaṇamuttamam ..
āhlādāya dadau śīghraṃ sarvaśṛṅgārasaṃyutam .. 118 ..
meaning:
पुंडरीकः प्रसन्नात्मा नागभूषणमुत्तमम् ..
आह्लादाय ददौ शीघ्रं सर्वशृङ्गारसंयुतम् .. 118 ..
text_mt: Puṇḍarīka, pleased in spirit, quickly gave the excellent serpent ornament, / complete with all decorations, to Āhlāda.

sanskrit_iast:
āhlādastu hayārūḍho mahīrājāya dattavān ..
vivāhaṃ kārayāmāsa vaivāhikavidhānataḥ ..
koṭisvarṇaṃ nṛpātprāptaṃ gṛhītvā śīghramāyayau .. 119 ..
meaning:
आह्लादस्तु हयारूढो महीराजाय दत्तवान् ..
विवाहं कारयामास वैवाहिकविधानतः ..
कोटिस्वर्णं नृपात्प्राप्तं गृहीत्वा शीघ्रमाययौ .. 119 ..
text_mt: Mounted on his horse, Āhlāda gave it to Mahīrāja; / he performed the marriage in accordance with the bridal rites, / and having received ten million gold coins from the king, he returned swiftly.

sanskrit_iast:
hayavidyāsamārūḍhāste hayā gehamāgatāḥ ..
jñeyāḥ paṃcaśataṃ sarve saśūrā gṛhamāyayuḥ .. 3.3.31.120 ..
meaning:
हयविद्यासमारूढास्ते हया गेहमागताः ..
ज्ञेयाः पंचशतं सर्वे सशूरा गृहमाययुः .. 3.3.31.120 ..
text_mt: Ridden with equestrian skill, those horses came home; / five hundred in all, together with the warriors, they returned home.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca ..
madradeśeṣu yaścāsīnmadrakeśo mahābalaḥ..
pañcābdaṃ pūjayāmāsa svargavaidyau surottamau .. 121 ..
meaning:
सूत उवाच ..
मद्रदेशेषु यश्चासीन्मद्रकेशो महाबलः..
पञ्चाब्दं पूजयामास स्वर्गवैद्यौ सुरोत्तमौ .. 121 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / In the Madra country, there was the mighty Madrakeśa; / for five years he worshipped the two heavenly physicians, the best of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tayośca varadānena daśa putrā babhūvire ..
sutā kāntimatī jātā rūpayauvanaśālinī ..122..
meaning:
तयोश्च वरदानेन दश पुत्रा बभूविरे ..
सुता कान्तिमती जाता रूपयौवनशालिनी ..122..
text_mt: By the boon granted by the two, ten sons were born to him; / a daughter was born, Kāntimatī, endowed with beauty and youth.

sanskrit_iast:
sa mahīrājamāhūya trilakṣabalasaṃyutam ..
dadau kanyāṃ vidhānena madreśaḥ sūryavarmaṇe ..123..
meaning:
स महीराजमाहूय त्रिलक्षबलसंयुतम् ..
ददौ कन्यां विधानेन मद्रेशः सूर्यवर्मणे ..123..
text_mt: Having summoned Mahīrāja, who was accompanied by three hundred thousand troops, / the lord of Madra duly gave his daughter to Sūryavarmā.

sanskrit_iast:
navoḍhāṃ tu tadā patnīṃ sūryavarmā gṛhītavān..
svagehāya yayau śīghraṃ mahīrājo balaissaha .. 124 ..
meaning:
नवोढां तु तदा पत्नीं सूर्यवर्मा गृहीतवान्..
स्वगेहाय ययौ शीघ्रं महीराजो बलैस्सह .. 124 ..
text_mt: Then Sūryavarmā took his newly wedded wife; / Mahīrāja quickly departed for his own home along with his forces.

sanskrit_iast:
karburonāma māyāvī vibhīṣaṇasuto balī ..
rākṣasastatra saṃprāpto dṛṣṭvā kāṃtimatīṃ śubhām .. 125 ..
meaning:
कर्बुरोनाम मायावी विभीषणसुतो बली ..
राक्षसस्तत्र संप्राप्तो दृष्ट्वा कांतिमतीं शुभाम् .. 125 ..
text_mt: A deceitful and mighty rākṣasa named Karbura, son of Vibhīṣaṇa, / arrived there, and having seen the auspicious Kāntimatī,

sanskrit_iast:
madrakeśasya tanayāṃ divyaśobhāsamanvi tām ..
jahāra paśyatāṃ teṣāṃ sahyādrigirimāyayau .. 126 ..
meaning:
मद्रकेशस्य तनयां दिव्यशोभासमन्वि ताम् ..
जहार पश्यतां तेषां सह्याद्रिगिरिमाययौ .. 126 ..
text_mt: the daughter of Madrakeśa, endowed with divine splendour, / he abducted her before their eyes and went to Mount Sahyādri.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājastadā duḥkhī vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ muhuḥ ..
dehalīgehamāgamya dūtamāhūya satva ram .. 127 ..
meaning:
महीराजस्तदा दुःखी विललाप भृशं मुहुः ..
देहलीगेहमागम्य दूतमाहूय सत्व रम् .. 127 ..
text_mt: Then Mahīrāja, deeply grieving, lamented aloud repeatedly; / having returned to his abode in Delhi, he quickly summoned a messenger,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ preṣayāmāsa sa gatvā samavarṇayat ..
jñātvā te tu hayārūḍhāḥ śūrāḥ paṃcaśatāvṛtāḥ .. 128 ..
meaning:
कृष्णांशं प्रेषयामास स गत्वा समवर्णयत् ..
ज्ञात्वा ते तु हयारूढाः शूराः पंचशतावृताः .. 128 ..
text_mt: and dispatched him to Kṛṣṇāṃśa; he went and recounted everything. / Having learned this, the warriors, five hundred in number, mounted their horses,

sanskrit_iast:
sahyādrigirimāgamya kṛṣṇāṃ śaḥ karburaṃ prati ..
nirbhayo vacanaṃ prāha śṛṇu rākṣasasattama .. 129 ..
meaning:
सह्याद्रिगिरिमागम्य कृष्णां शः कर्बुरं प्रति ..
निर्भयो वचनं प्राह शृणु राक्षससत्तम .. 129 ..
text_mt: and coming to Mount Sahyādri, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, fearless, / addressed Karbura: “Listen, O best of rākṣasas!

sanskrit_iast:
vibhīṣaṇo bhaktarājastasya tvaṃ dayitaḥ sutaḥ ..
tasmāttvayā na kartavyaṃ pāpaṃ vaṃśa vināśanam ..
rāvaṇena purā sītā saṃhṛtā viditaṃ tava .. 3.3.31.130 ..
meaning:
विभीषणो भक्तराजस्तस्य त्वं दयितः सुतः ..
तस्मात्त्वया न कर्तव्यं पापं वंश विनाशनम् ..
रावणेन पुरा सीता संहृता विदितं तव .. 3.3.31.130 ..
text_mt: Vibhīṣaṇa is the king of devotees, and you are his beloved son; / therefore, you must not commit a sin that destroys your lineage! / Formerly Sītā was abducted by Rāvaṇa, as is known to you.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā sa hovāca pureyaṃ dayitā priyā ..
mama gaṃdharvatanayā muniśāpānmahīṃ gatā .. 131 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा स होवाच पुरेयं दयिता प्रिया ..
मम गंधर्वतनया मुनिशापान्महीं गता .. 131 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, he spoke: "Formerly she was my cherished beloved, / a daughter of a gandharva who came to earth through a sage's curse.

sanskrit_iast:
ato'haṃ tadviyogena tyaktvā laṃkāṃ mahāpurīm ..
madrakeśamahaṃ prāpya madrakeśabhayādaham ..
na jahāra priyāṃ ramyāṃ tatroṣitvā dinaṃ bahu .. 132 ..
meaning:
अतोऽहं तद्वियोगेन त्यक्त्वा लंकां महापुरीम् ..
मद्रकेशमहं प्राप्य मद्रकेशभयादहम् ..
न जहार प्रियां रम्यां तत्रोषित्वा दिनं बहु .. 132 ..
text_mt: Therefore, separated from her, I abandoned the great city of Laṅkā. / Reaching the lord of Madraka, out of fear of the lord of Madraka, / I did not seize my lovely beloved, having dwelt there for many days.

sanskrit_iast:
adya me vaśagā sābhūnnāmnā kāṃtimatī śubhā ..
jitvā māṃ ca gṛhāṇāśu samarthāśca vayaṃ sadā .. 133 ..
meaning:
अद्य मे वशगा साभून्नाम्ना कांतिमती शुभा ..
जित्वा मां च गृहाणाशु समर्थाश्च वयं सदा .. 133 ..
text_mt: Today she has come under my power, the auspicious one named Kāntimatī. / Defeating me, take [her] swiftly; we are always capable!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā sa kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ khaḍgayuddhamacīkarat ..
saptarātreṇa taṃ jitvā labdhvā kāṃtimatīṃ śubhām ..
tadā ca dehalīṃ prāpya mahīrājāntamāyayau ..134..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा स कृष्णांशः खड्गयुद्धमचीकरत् ..
सप्तरात्रेण तं जित्वा लब्ध्वा कांतिमतीं शुभाम् ..
तदा च देहलीं प्राप्य महीराजान्तमाययौ ..134..
text_mt: Hearing this, that portion of Kṛṣṇa waged a sword-fight. / Conquering him in seven nights and winning the auspicious Kāntimatī, / he then went to Dehalī and came before Mahīrāja.

sanskrit_iast:
koṭisvarṇaṃ dadau rājā kṛṣṇāṃśāya mahātmane ..
sa vīro baṃdhubhiḥ sārdhaṃ pramadāvanamāyayau ..135..
meaning:
कोटिस्वर्णं ददौ राजा कृष्णांशाय महात्मने ..
स वीरो बंधुभिः सार्धं प्रमदावनमाययौ ..135..
text_mt: The king gave ten million in gold to the great-souled portion of Kṛṣṇa. / That hero, together with his kinsmen, went to Pramadavana.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
paṭṭanākhyapure rājā nāmnā pūrṇāmalo balī ..
vasūnārādhāyāmāsa paṃcavarṣāntare mudā ..
tadā prasannāste devā dadustasmai varaṃ śubham .. 136 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
पट्टनाख्यपुरे राजा नाम्ना पूर्णामलो बली ..
वसूनाराधायामास पंचवर्षान्तरे मुदा ..
तदा प्रसन्नास्ते देवा ददुस्तस्मै वरं शुभम् .. 136 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / In the city named Paṭṭana was a mighty king named Pūrṇāmala. / He worshipped the Vasus with joy within five years. / Then those pleased gods granted him an auspicious boon.

sanskrit_iast:
varadānācca sañjātā daśa putrā mahīpateḥ ..
vidyunmālā sutā jātā rūpayauvanaśālinī .. 137
meaning:
वरदानाच्च सञ्जाता दश पुत्रा महीपतेः ..
विद्युन्माला सुता जाता रूपयौवनशालिनी .. 137
text_mt: And from the granting of the boon, ten sons were born to the king, / [and] a daughter, Vidyunmālā, endowed with beauty and youth, was born.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvivāhārthamāhūya mahīrājaṃ mahābalam ..
saptalakṣabalaiḥ sārddhaṃ tatputrāya sutāṃ dadau .. 138 ..
meaning:
तद्विवाहार्थमाहूय महीराजं महाबलम् ..
सप्तलक्षबलैः सार्द्धं तत्पुत्राय सुतां ददौ .. 138 ..
text_mt: Having summoned the mighty Mahīrāja for her wedding, / he gave his daughter to his son along with an army of seven hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājasuto bhīmaḥ patnīṃ prāpya manoramām ..
gehamāgamya taiḥ sārddhaṃ dehalīṃ harṣamāptavān .. 139 ..
meaning:
महीराजसुतो भीमः पत्नीं प्राप्य मनोरमाम् ..
गेहमागम्य तैः सार्द्धं देहलीं हर्षमाप्तवान् .. 139 ..
text_mt: Mahīrāja's son Bhīma, having obtained his charming wife, / returned home with them to Dehalī and attained joy.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā paiśācadeśasthaḥ sahodaśca mahīpatiḥ ..
mlecchaiśca daśasāhasrairvidyunmālārthamudyataḥ ..3.3.31.140..
meaning:
तदा पैशाचदेशस्थः सहोदश्च महीपतिः ..
म्लेच्छैश्च दशसाहस्रैर्विद्युन्मालार्थमुद्यतः ..3.3.31.140..
text_mt: Then King Sahoda, who dwelt in the Paiśāca country, / prepared [for battle] for the sake of Vidyunmālā with ten thousand mlecchas.

sanskrit_iast:
balidaityājñayā prāptaḥ kurukṣetraṃ śubhasthalam ..
bhittvā mūrtīḥ surāṇāṃ goraktaistīrthajalaṃ kṛtam .. .. 141 ..
meaning:
बलिदैत्याज्ञया प्राप्तः कुरुक्षेत्रं शुभस्थलम् ..
भित्त्वा मूर्तीः सुराणां गोरक्तैस्तीर्थजलं कृतम् .. .. 141 ..
text_mt: By command of the Daitya Bali, he reached the auspicious place Kurukṣetra. / Breaking the images of the gods, he turned the holy water into the blood of cows.

sanskrit_iast:
patramālikhya balavānmahīrājāya dharmiṇe ..
svadūtaḥ preṣitastena śrutvā bhūpo'bravīdidam .. 142 ..
meaning:
पत्रमालिख्य बलवान्महीराजाय धर्मिणे ..
स्वदूतः प्रेषितस्तेन श्रुत्वा भूपोऽब्रवीदिदम् .. 142 ..
text_mt: Having written a letter to the righteous Mahīrāja, / the mighty one sent his messenger. Hearing it, the king said this:

sanskrit_iast:
bhavānmlecchapatī rājā vidyunmālārthamudyataḥ ..
māṃ śabdavedhinaṃ viddhi cauryadeśadhuraṃdharam .. 143 ..
meaning:
भवान्म्लेच्छपती राजा विद्युन्मालार्थमुद्यतः ..
मां शब्दवेधिनं विद्धि चौर्यदेशधुरंधरम् .. 143 ..
text_mt: "You are a king who is a lord of mlecchas, prepared [to fight] for the sake of Vidyunmālā. / Know that I pierce by sound alone, foremost in the country of Cauryadeśa!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sa trilakṣaiśca kurukṣetramupāgataḥ ..
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhamahorātraṃ bhayānakam .. 144 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा स त्रिलक्षैश्च कुरुक्षेत्रमुपागतः ..
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धमहोरात्रं भयानकम् .. 144 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, he went to Kurukṣetra with three hundred thousand [warriors]. / And between the two of them there occurred a great, dreadful battle day and night.

sanskrit_iast:
niśīthe samanuprāpte jyeṣṭhe māsi tamomaye ..
pātālādbalirāgatya daityāyutasamanvitaḥ .. 145 ..
meaning:
निशीथे समनुप्राप्ते ज्येष्ठे मासि तमोमये ..
पातालाद्बलिरागत्य दैत्यायुतसमन्वितः .. 145 ..
text_mt: When midnight arrived in the dark month of Jyeṣṭha, / Bali came from Pātāla accompanied by ten thousand Daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpasainyaṃ jaghānāśu bhakṣayitvā punaḥ punaḥ ..
bhayabhītastadā rājā śāradāṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau .. 146 ..
meaning:
नृपसैन्यं जघानाशु भक्षयित्वा पुनः पुनः ..
भयभीतस्तदा राजा शारदां शरणं ययौ .. 146 ..
text_mt: He swiftly slew the king's army, devouring [them] again and again. / Terrified with fear, the king then went to Śāradā for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare devāḥ kṛṣṇāṃśādyā mahābalāḥ ..
kṣaṇamātreṇa saṃprāptāstadā padacarā mune .. 147 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे देवाः कृष्णांशाद्या महाबलाः ..
क्षणमात्रेण संप्राप्तास्तदा पदचरा मुने .. 147 ..
text_mt: In the meantime, the mighty gods led by the portion of Kṛṣṇa, / moving on foot, arrived in a mere moment, O sage!

sanskrit_iast:
hatvā daityasahasrāṇi balidaityamupāyayuḥ ..
deśajau vatsajau vīrau devasiṃhastathaiva ca ..
svakhaḍgaistarpayāmāsa daityarājaṃ mahābalam .. 148 ..
meaning:
हत्वा दैत्यसहस्राणि बलिदैत्यमुपाययुः ..
देशजौ वत्सजौ वीरौ देवसिंहस्तथैव च ..
स्वखड्गैस्तर्पयामास दैत्यराजं महाबलम् .. 148 ..
text_mt: Having slain thousands of Daityas, they approached the Daitya Bali. / The two heroes born in the land, born of Vatsa, and likewise Devingha, / gratified the mighty king of Daityas with their swords.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prasanno balavāndaityarājo baliḥ svayam ..
varaṃ vṛṇuta tānāha te tu śrutvābruvanvacaḥ ..149..
meaning:
तदा प्रसन्नो बलवान्दैत्यराजो बलिः स्वयम् ..
वरं वृणुत तानाह ते तु श्रुत्वाब्रुवन्वचः ..149..
text_mt: Then the mighty Bali himself, king of the Daityas, became pleased. / "Choose a boon!" he said to them, and they, hearing [him], spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
āryadeśaṃ ca te daityā nāgacchantu tvayā saha..
mlecchadeśaṃ sadā prāpya bhakṣadhvaṃ mlecchadharmagān .. 3.3.31.150 ..
meaning:
आर्यदेशं च ते दैत्या नागच्छन्तु त्वया सह..
म्लेच्छदेशं सदा प्राप्य भक्षध्वं म्लेच्छधर्मगान् .. 3.3.31.150 ..
