text_mt: "Let your Daityas not enter the land of the Āryas with you! / Having always gone to the mleccha country, devour those who follow the mleccha religion!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ vipriyaṃ ca baliḥ svayam ..
kṛṣṇāṃśamudayaṃ gatvā tuṣṭāva parayā girā .. 151 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो घोरं विप्रियं च बलिः स्वयम् ..
कृष्णांशमुदयं गत्वा तुष्टाव परया गिरा .. 151 ..
text_mt: Hearing this terrible and unwelcome statement, Bali himself / approached the noble portion of Kṛṣṇa and praised [him] with supreme speech.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prasannaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśo vacanaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ ..
yāvadahaṃ bhūmivāsī tāvattvaṃ gehamāvasa ..
tatpaścādbhūmimāgatya yathāyogyaṃ kuruṣva bhoḥ .. 152 ..
meaning:
तदा प्रसन्नः कृष्णांशो वचनं प्राह निर्भयः ..
यावदहं भूमिवासी तावत्त्वं गेहमावस ..
तत्पश्चाद्भूमिमागत्य यथायोग्यं कुरुष्व भोः .. 152 ..
text_mt: Then the pleased portion of Kṛṣṇa, fearless, spoke these words: / "As long as I dwell on earth, so long do you dwell in your abode. / After that, having come to earth, do whatever is fitting, O sir!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sahodo nīlasaṃyutaḥ ..
paiśācaṃ deśamagamatpunaḥ prāpto rasātalam .. 153 ..
meaning:
इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सहोदो नीलसंयुतः ..
पैशाचं देशमगमत्पुनः प्राप्तो रसातलम् .. 153 ..
text_mt: Hearing his words, Sahoda, accompanied by Nīla, / went to the Paiśāca country and returned again to Rasātala.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmirājaḥ prasannātmā koṭisvarṇaṃ dadau tadā ..
gajārūḍhāśca te paṃca saṃyayuśca mahāvatīm .. 154 ..
meaning:
भूमिराजः प्रसन्नात्मा कोटिस्वर्णं ददौ तदा ..
गजारूढाश्च ते पंच संययुश्च महावतीम् .. 154 ..
text_mt: Bhūmirāja, pleased in heart, then gave ten million in gold. / Mounted on elephants, those five departed for Mahāvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
varddhano bhūmirājasya sutaḥ sarvebhya uttamaḥ..
paṃcamābdavayā bhūtvā śrīdaṃ tuṣṭāva bhaktitaḥ..
varṣāṃtare ca bhagavāndadau sarvaṃ śubhaṃ nidhim ..155..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
वर्द्धनो भूमिराजस्य सुतः सर्वेभ्य उत्तमः..
पंचमाब्दवया भूत्वा श्रीदं तुष्टाव भक्तितः..
वर्षांतरे च भगवान्ददौ सर्वं शुभं निधिम् ..155..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Vardhana, the son of Bhūmirāja, was the best of all. / When he was five years of age, he praised Śrīda with devotion. / And after a year, the Lord gave every auspicious treasure.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsarvanidhibhāvena nṛpakośaḥ samantataḥ ..
pūrṇo babhūva kanakai rājarājaprabhāvataḥ ..156..
meaning:
तत्सर्वनिधिभावेन नृपकोशः समन्ततः ..
पूर्णो बभूव कनकै राजराजप्रभावतः ..156..
text_mt: Because of all those treasures, the king's treasury on all sides / became filled with gold by the power of the king of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃnarī nāma yā kanyā maṃkaṇasya prakīrtitā ..
kuberaśca dadau tasmai varddhanāya priyāya ca ..
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ vivāhacaritaṃ mune .. 157 ..
meaning:
किंनरी नाम या कन्या मंकणस्य प्रकीर्तिता ..
कुबेरश्च ददौ तस्मै वर्द्धनाय प्रियाय च ..
इति ते कथितं सर्वं विवाहचरितं मुने .. 157 ..
text_mt: And Kubera gave that maiden named Kinnarī, celebrated as [daughter] of Maṅkaṇa, / to him, his dear Vardhana. / Thus all the details of the marriage have been told to you, O sage!

sanskrit_iast:
dhundhukāro mahāśūro lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ ..
brahmānaṃdamupāgamya yuddhārthāya tamāhvayat.. 158 ..
meaning:
धुन्धुकारो महाशूरो लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः ..
ब्रह्मानंदमुपागम्य युद्धार्थाय तमाह्वयत्.. 158 ..
text_mt: Dhundhukāra, a great hero accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, / approached Brahmānanda and challenged him to battle.

sanskrit_iast:
ekatriṃśābdake prāpte kṛṣṇāṃśe balavattare ..
ekākī malanāputro dṛṣṭvā sainyamupasthitam ..
brahmāstraṃ cāpa ādhāya cārdhasainyamadāhayat .. 159 ..
meaning:
एकत्रिंशाब्दके प्राप्ते कृष्णांशे बलवत्तरे ..
एकाकी मलनापुत्रो दृष्ट्वा सैन्यमुपस्थितम् ..
ब्रह्मास्त्रं चाप आधाय चार्धसैन्यमदाहयत् .. 159 ..
text_mt: When the portion of Kṛṣṇa reached thirty-one years and was even mightier, / the son of Malanā, alone, seeing the army arrived, / set the Brahmā weapon to his bow and incinerated half the army.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcāyutāśca te śūrā bhayabhītā diśo gatāḥ ..
dhundhukāro raṇaṃ tvaktvā bhūmirājamupāgamat .. 3.3.31.160 ..
meaning:
पंचायुताश्च ते शूरा भयभीता दिशो गताः ..
धुन्धुकारो रणं त्वक्त्वा भूमिराजमुपागमत् .. 3.3.31.160 ..
text_mt: And those fifty thousand heroes fled in all directions, terrified with fear. / Abandoning the battle, Dhundhukāra went to Bhūmirāja.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājastadā duḥkhī bhayabhītaḥ samaṃtataḥ ..
mahīpatiṃ samāhūya candrabhaṭṭaṃ ca so'bravīt .. 161 ..
meaning:
महीराजस्तदा दुःखी भयभीतः समंततः ..
महीपतिं समाहूय चन्द्रभट्टं च सोऽब्रवीत् .. 161 ..
text_mt: Then Mahīrāja, sorrowful and terrified on all sides, / summoned the ruler of the earth and spoke to Candrabhaṭṭa:

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ jayo me bhavitā tatsarvaṃ maṃtrayāśu vai ..
mahīpatistadā prāha śṛṇu bhūpaśiromaṇe .. .. 162 ..
meaning:
कथं जयो मे भविता तत्सर्वं मंत्रयाशु वै ..
महीपतिस्तदा प्राह शृणु भूपशिरोमणे .. .. 162 ..
text_mt: "How will my victory come to be? Counsel all of that swiftly!" / Then the ruler of the earth said: "Listen, O crest-jewel of kings!

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā nārīmayaṃ veṣaṃ cāmuṇḍaṃ balaśālinam ..
velāṃ matvā ca taddolāṃ brahmānaṃdāya cārpaya .. 163 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा नारीमयं वेषं चामुण्डं बलशालिनम् ..
वेलां मत्वा च तद्दोलां ब्रह्मानंदाय चार्पय .. 163 ..
text_mt: Having assumed a woman's disguise, disguise the mighty Cāmuṇḍa / as Velā, and deliver that palanquin to Brahmānanda!

sanskrit_iast:
catvāraste sutāḥ śūrā dhuṃdhukāreṇa saṃyutā ..
chadmanā ca svaśastraiśca ghātayeyustamūrjitāḥ .. 164 ..
meaning:
चत्वारस्ते सुताः शूरा धुंधुकारेण संयुता ..
छद्मना च स्वशस्त्रैश्च घातयेयुस्तमूर्जिताः .. 164 ..
text_mt: Your four heroic sons, accompanied by Dhundhukāra, / being powerful, should slay him by deceit and with their weapons!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā mahīrājo brahmānaṃdāya harṣitaḥ ..
tathā kṛtvā dadau dolāṃ paṃcaśūraiśca pālitām .. 165 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा महीराजो ब्रह्मानंदाय हर्षितः ..
तथा कृत्वा ददौ दोलां पंचशूरैश्च पालिताम् .. 165 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, Mahīrāja, delighted, did so / and presented the palanquin, guarded by the five heroes, to Brahmānanda.

sanskrit_iast:
sāyaṃkāle tu saṃprāpte māghaśuklāṣṭamīdine ..
velāvaṃśaśca cāmuṇḍo brahmānaṃdamupāyayau .. 166 ..
meaning:
सायंकाले तु संप्राप्ते माघशुक्लाष्टमीदिने ..
वेलावंशश्च चामुण्डो ब्रह्मानंदमुपाययौ .. 166 ..
text_mt: When evening arrived on the day of the bright aṣṭamī of Māgha, / Cāmuṇḍa, disguised as Velā, approached Brahmānanda.

sanskrit_iast:
chadmanā ca triśūlaṃ ca balātkṛtvā ripūdare ..
ruroda balavāñchūraste tu śūrāḥ samāgatāḥ .. 167 ..
meaning:
छद्मना च त्रिशूलं च बलात्कृत्वा रिपूदरे ..
रुरोद बलवाञ्छूरस्ते तु शूराः समागताः .. 167 ..
text_mt: And by deceit, having forcefully thrust a trident into the enemy's belly, / the mighty hero wept, and those heroes arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
tārako hṛdi taṃ bāṇaiḥ sūryavarmā ca tomaraiḥ ..
bhīmaśca gadayā cātra varddhanaśca tadāsinā ..
dhuṃdhukāraśca bhallena jaghāna ripumūrddhani .. 168 ..
meaning:
तारको हृदि तं बाणैः सूर्यवर्मा च तोमरैः ..
भीमश्च गदया चात्र वर्द्धनश्च तदासिना ..
धुंधुकारश्च भल्लेन जघान रिपुमूर्द्धनि .. 168 ..
text_mt: Tāraka struck the enemy on the chest with arrows, Sūryavarmā with javelins, / Bhīma with a mace, Vardhana with a sword, / and Dhundhukāra with a spear on the head.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrchitaḥ patito bhūmau bahmānaṃdo mahābalaḥ ..
mahadvraṇayutastatra svakhaṅgaṃ ca samādadat .. 169 ..
meaning:
मूर्छितः पतितो भूमौ बह्मानंदो महाबलः ..
महद्व्रणयुतस्तत्र स्वखङ्गं च समाददत् .. 169 ..
text_mt: Fainting, the mighty Brahmānanda fell to the ground, / covered in severe wounds there, and grasped his sword.

sanskrit_iast:
bhīmasya ca śiraḥ kāyādvarddhanasya tathaiva ca ..
chittvā tathaiva bhūmadhye sūryavarmāṇamāgataṃḥ .. 3.3.31.170 ..
meaning:
भीमस्य च शिरः कायाद्वर्द्धनस्य तथैव च ..
छित्त्वा तथैव भूमध्ये सूर्यवर्माणमागतंः .. 3.3.31.170 ..
text_mt: And severing Bhīma's head from his trunk, and likewise Vardhana's, / and Sūryavarman's as he came upon the ground,

sanskrit_iast:
tārako dhuṃdhukāraśca cāmu ṇḍaśca tathaiva ca ..
brahmānaṃdaṃ tadā tyaktvā mahīrājāntamāyayau .. 171 ..
meaning:
तारको धुंधुकारश्च चामु ण्डश्च तथैव च ..
ब्रह्मानंदं तदा त्यक्त्वा महीराजान्तमाययौ .. 171 ..
text_mt: Tāraka, Dhuṃdhukāra, and Cāmuṇḍa as well / then abandoned Brahmānanda and went to King Mahīrāja.

sanskrit_iast:
hateṣu teṣu putreṣu mahīrājo bhayāturaḥ ..
velāpārśvamupāgamya ruroda bahu duḥkhitaḥ .. 172 ..
meaning:
हतेषु तेषु पुत्रेषु महीराजो भयातुरः ..
वेलापार्श्वमुपागम्य रुरोद बहु दुःखितः .. 172 ..
text_mt: When those sons were slain, Mahīrāja was stricken with fear; / approaching Velā's side, deeply grieved, he wept aloud.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tadā velā dolāmāruhya satvaram ..
brahmānaṃdaṃ yayau śīghraṃ mūrcchitaṃ taṃ dadarśa ha .. 173 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तदा वेला दोलामारुह्य सत्वरम् ..
ब्रह्मानंदं ययौ शीघ्रं मूर्च्छितं तं ददर्श ह .. 173 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, Velā at once mounted a litter; / she went swiftly to Brahmānanda and saw him lying in a swoon.

sanskrit_iast:
kaniṣṭhāmṛtabhāvena velāyā balavāṃstadā ..
utthāya rudatīṃ nārīṃ dadarśa rucirānvitām .. 174 ..
meaning:
कनिष्ठामृतभावेन वेलाया बलवांस्तदा ..
उत्थाय रुदतीं नारीं ददर्श रुचिरान्विताम् .. 174 ..
text_mt: Then, through the nectar-like touch of Velā's little finger, the mighty warrior / arose and beheld the lovely woman weeping.

sanskrit_iast:
kā tvaṃ kasya sutā ramyā saṃgrāme māmupasthitā ..
jalaṃ dehi mahā subhūrvacanaṃ kuru supriyam .. 175 ..
meaning:
का त्वं कस्य सुता रम्या संग्रामे मामुपस्थिता ..
जलं देहि महा सुभूर्वचनं कुरु सुप्रियम् .. 175 ..
text_mt: "Who are you, fair lady? Whose daughter are you, that have come to me in battle? / Give me water, O lady of fair brow; speak words most dear."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tadā velā jalaṃ dattvā śucānvitā ..
vacanaṃ prāha vai rātrau śṛṇu tvaṃ malanāsuta .. 176 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तदा वेला जलं दत्त्वा शुचान्विता ..
वचनं प्राह वै रात्रौ शृणु त्वं मलनासुत .. 176 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, Velā gave him water, filled with sorrow, / and at night she spoke these words: "Listen, O son of Malanā!

sanskrit_iast:
velā nāma mahībhartuḥ sutāhaṃ tvāmupasthitā ..
matpatiśca bhavāndhīraśchadmanā vaṃcakairhataḥ ..
jīvanaṃ kuru rājeṃdra bhuṃkṣva bhogānmayā saha .. 177 ..
meaning:
वेला नाम महीभर्तुः सुताहं त्वामुपस्थिता ..
मत्पतिश्च भवान्धीरश्छद्मना वंचकैर्हतः ..
जीवनं कुरु राजेंद्र भुंक्ष्व भोगान्मया सह .. 177 ..
text_mt: I am Velā by name, the daughter of the king, who have come to you. / You, the resolute one, are my husband, struck down deceitfully by treacherous men. / Return to life, O lord of kings; enjoy pleasures with me!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktaḥ sa tu tāmāha kalikāle samāgate ..
jīvanānmaraṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tasmānmadvacanaṃ kuru .. 178 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तः स तु तामाह कलिकाले समागते ..
जीवनान्मरणं श्रेष्ठं तस्मान्मद्वचनं कुरु .. 178 ..
text_mt: Thus addressed, he said to her: "Now that the Kali age has arrived, / death is better than life; therefore heed my words.

sanskrit_iast:
harināgaramāruhya mayā sārddhaṃ śubhānane ..
gatvā tīrthāni ramyāṇi saṃtyajāmi kalevaram..179..
meaning:
हरिनागरमारुह्य मया सार्द्धं शुभानने ..
गत्वा तीर्थानि रम्याणि संत्यजामि कलेवरम्..179..
text_mt: Mounting the steed Harināgara together with me, O fair-faced one, / having gone to the delightful pilgrimage sites, I shall cast off my body."

sanskrit_iast:
itpuktvā tau samāruhya pūrve ca kapilāntikam..
gatvā snātvā ca vidhivattatodhye jagmaturmudā..3.3.31.180..
meaning:
इत्पुक्त्वा तौ समारुह्य पूर्वे च कपिलान्तिकम्..
गत्वा स्नात्वा च विधिवत्ततोध्ये जग्मतुर्मुदा..3.3.31.180..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the two mounted it and went eastward to Kapilā's presence; / having bathed according to rule, they then proceeded with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthakpṛthaksutārthāni snātvā dattvā ca .jagmatuḥ ..
dakṣiṇe setubaṃdhānte paścime dvārikāmanu .. 181 ..
meaning:
पृथक्पृथक्सुतार्थानि स्नात्वा दत्त्वा च .जग्मतुः ..
दक्षिणे सेतुबंधान्ते पश्चिमे द्वारिकामनु .. 181 ..
text_mt: Having bathed at the various sacred shrines and given [gifts], they proceeded / southward as far as Setubandha, and westward to Dvārikā.

sanskrit_iast:
uttare badarīsthāne snātvā tīrthāni jagmatuḥ ..
gaṃdhamādanamāgatya brahmānaṃdo mahābalaḥ .. 182 ..
meaning:
उत्तरे बदरीस्थाने स्नात्वा तीर्थानि जग्मतुः ..
गंधमादनमागत्य ब्रह्मानंदो महाबलः .. 182 ..
text_mt: In the north, having bathed at the site of Badarī, they visited the pilgrimage places; / and reaching Gandhamādana, the mighty Brahmānanda

sanskrit_iast:
velāmuvāca vacanaṃ bhādraśuklāṣṭamīdine ..
dehaṃ tyajāmi bho rājñi tārakaṃ jahi bhūtale ..183..
meaning:
वेलामुवाच वचनं भाद्रशुक्लाष्टमीदिने ..
देहं त्यजामि भो राज्ञि तारकं जहि भूतले ..183..
text_mt: spoke these words to Velā: "On the day of the bright aṣṭamī of Bhādra, / I shall cast off my body, O queen; slay Tāraka upon the earth!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu sā prāha svāminmadvacanaṃ kuru ..
kurukṣetraṃ mayā sārddhaṃ bhavānvai gaṃtumarhati ..184..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु सा प्राह स्वामिन्मद्वचनं कुरु ..
कुरुक्षेत्रं मया सार्द्धं भवान्वै गंतुमर्हति ..184..
text_mt: Hearing this, she said: "O lord, do as I say: / you ought to go with me to Kurukṣetra.

sanskrit_iast:
sthitvā tatra samasvānto bhaja tvaṃ sarvamaṃgalām ..
ahaṃ mahāvatīṃ prāpya punarvai dehalīṃ prati .. 185 ..
meaning:
स्थित्वा तत्र समस्वान्तो भज त्वं सर्वमंगलाम् ..
अहं महावतीं प्राप्य पुनर्वै देहलीं प्रति .. 185 ..
text_mt: Remaining there with calm mind, worship Sarvamaṅgalā. / Reaching Mahāvatī, and then once more toward Delhi,

sanskrit_iast:
tārakaṃ ca tathā hatvā tvatsamīpaṃ vrajāmyaham ..
ityuktaḥ sa tathetyuktvā brahmadhyānaparo'bhavat .. 186 ..
meaning:
तारकं च तथा हत्वा त्वत्समीपं व्रजाम्यहम् ..
इत्युक्तः स तथेत्युक्त्वा ब्रह्मध्यानपरोऽभवत् .. 186 ..
text_mt: and slaying Tāraka, I shall return to your presence." / Thus addressed, he said, "So be it," and became devoted to meditation on Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
dvātriṃśābde ca kṛṣṇāṃśe saṃprāpte yogarūpiṇī ..
velā nāma śubhā nārī harināgarasaṃsthitā ..
mahāvatīṃ samāgamya sabhāyāṃ tatra cāviśat .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
द्वात्रिंशाब्दे च कृष्णांशे संप्राप्ते योगरूपिणी ..
वेला नाम शुभा नारी हरिनागरसंस्थिता ..
महावतीं समागम्य सभायां तत्र चाविशत् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / In the thirty-second year, when Kṛṣṇāṃśa had arrived, the auspicious woman / named Velā, embodiment of yoga, mounted on Harināgara, / reached Mahāvatī and entered the assembly there.
title: adhyāyaḥ 32

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare prāptāḥ kṛṣṇāṃśādyā mahābalāḥ ..
natvā parimalaṃ bhūpaṃ velā vacanamabravīt .. 2 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्ताः कृष्णांशाद्या महाबलाः ..
नत्वा परिमलं भूपं वेला वचनमब्रवीत् .. 2 ..
text_mt: Meanwhile, the mighty warriors led by Kṛṣṇāṃśa arrived; / having bowed to King Parimala, Velā spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
mahīpatiṃ priyaṃ matvā kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ nṛpa duṣpriyam ..
tvayā me ghātito bhartā brahmānaṃdo mahābalaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
महीपतिं प्रियं मत्वा कृष्णांशं नृप दुष्प्रियम् ..
त्वया मे घातितो भर्ता ब्रह्मानंदो महाबलः .. 3 ..
text_mt: "Thinking the ruler of the earth to be dear, and Kṛṣṇāṃśa disliked, O king, / you caused my husband, the mighty Brahmānanda, to be slain

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājasutairdhūrtaistārakādyairmahābalaiḥ ..
nārīveṣaṃ ca cāmuṇḍo dhuṃdhukāreṇa kāritaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
महीराजसुतैर्धूर्तैस्तारकाद्यैर्महाबलैः ..
नारीवेषं च चामुण्डो धुंधुकारेण कारितः .. 4 ..
text_mt: by the deceitful sons of Mahīrāja, the mighty Tāraka and the others. / And Cāmuṇḍa was made by Dhuṃdhukāra to disguise himself as a woman.

sanskrit_iast:
svāminaṃ prati cāgamya te jagmuśchadmanā priyam ..
kurukṣetraṃ sthitaḥ svāmī mahatyā mūrchayānvitaḥ ..
tasmādyūyaṃ mayā sārddhaṃ gaṃtumarhatha taṃ prati .. 5 ..
meaning:
स्वामिनं प्रति चागम्य ते जग्मुश्छद्मना प्रियम् ..
कुरुक्षेत्रं स्थितः स्वामी महत्या मूर्छयान्वितः ..
तस्माद्यूयं मया सार्द्धं गंतुमर्हथ तं प्रति .. 5 ..
text_mt: Approaching my husband, they went deceitfully to my beloved. / My husband stays at Kurukṣetra, overcome with a deep swoon; / therefore you ought to go with me to him."

sanskrit_iast:
iti ghoratamaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā sarve śucānvitāḥ ..
dhigbhūpatiṃ ca malanāṃ tābhyāṃ no ghātitaḥ sakhā .. 6 ..
meaning:
इति घोरतमं वाक्यं श्रुत्वा सर्वे शुचान्विताः ..
धिग्भूपतिं च मलनां ताभ्यां नो घातितः सखा .. 6 ..
text_mt: Hearing these most terrible words, all were filled with sorrow: / "Fie upon the king and upon Malanā! By those two our friend was slain!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvoccaiśca ruruduḥ kṛṣṇāṃśādyā mahābalāḥ ..
patrāṇi preṣayāmāsuḥ svakīyānbhūpatī nprati .. 7 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वोच्चैश्च रुरुदुः कृष्णांशाद्या महाबलाः ..
पत्राणि प्रेषयामासुः स्वकीयान्भूपती न्प्रति .. 7 ..
text_mt: Having said this, the mighty warriors led by Kṛṣṇāṃśa wept aloud; / they dispatched letters to their own kings.

sanskrit_iast:
krodhayuktā tadā velā likhitvā patramulbaṇam ..
mahīrājāya saṃpreṣya malanāgehamāgamat .. 8 ..
meaning:
क्रोधयुक्ता तदा वेला लिखित्वा पत्रमुल्बणम् ..
महीराजाय संप्रेष्य मलनागेहमागमत् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Then Velā, filled with wrath, wrote a fierce letter, / sent it to Mahīrāja, and went to Malanā's house.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpatraṃ ca mahīrājo vācayitvā vidhānataḥ ..
jñātvā tatkāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ tanniśamya viśāmpatiḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
तत्पत्रं च महीराजो वाचयित्वा विधानतः ..
ज्ञात्वा तत्कारणं सर्वं तन्निशम्य विशाम्पतिः .. 9 ..
text_mt: Mahīrāja had that letter read according to rule; / knowing the whole reason for it, when he heard it, the lord of men

sanskrit_iast:
cintākalevaraṃ prāpya sukhanidrāṃ vyanāśayat ..
āhūya bhūpatīnsarvānghorayuddhonmukho'bhavat .. 3.3.32.10 ..
meaning:
चिन्ताकलेवरं प्राप्य सुखनिद्रां व्यनाशयत् ..
आहूय भूपतीन्सर्वान्घोरयुद्धोन्मुखोऽभवत् .. 3.3.32.10 ..
text_mt: became an embodiment of anxiety and lost his peaceful sleep; / summoning all the kings, he resolved upon a terrible war.

sanskrit_iast:
caturviṃśatilakṣaiśca śūrairbhūpasamanvitaiḥ ..
kurukṣetraṃ yayau śīghraṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrāṃśasaṃbhavaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
चतुर्विंशतिलक्षैश्च शूरैर्भूपसमन्वितैः ..
कुरुक्षेत्रं ययौ शीघ्रं धृतराष्ट्रांशसंभवः .. 11 ..
text_mt: Born of the portion of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, he went quickly to Kurukṣetra / with twenty-four hundred thousand heroes accompanied by kings.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā parimalo bhūpo lakṣaṣoḍaśasainyapaḥ ..
drupadāṃśo yayau śīghraṃ velayā svakulaiḥ saha .. 12 ..
meaning:
तथा परिमलो भूपो लक्षषोडशसैन्यपः ..
द्रुपदांशो ययौ शीघ्रं वेलया स्वकुलैः सह .. 12 ..
text_mt: Likewise King Parimala, commander of an army of sixteen hundred thousand, / an incarnation of Drupada, went swiftly with Velā and his kinsmen.

sanskrit_iast:
syamantapaṃcake tīrthe śibirāṇi cakāra ha ..
brahmānaṃdaḥ sthito yatra samādhidhyānatatparaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
स्यमन्तपंचके तीर्थे शिबिराणि चकार ह ..
ब्रह्मानंदः स्थितो यत्र समाधिध्यानतत्परः .. 13 ..
text_mt: He pitched his camp at the sacred site of Syamantapañcaka, / where Brahmānanda remained, absorbed in meditation and concentration.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃgākūle ca te sarve kauravāṃśā mahābalāḥ ..
śibirāṇi vicitrāṇi cakruste vijayaiṣiṇaḥ ..14..
meaning:
गंगाकूले च ते सर्वे कौरवांशा महाबलाः ..
शिबिराणि विचित्राणि चक्रुस्ते विजयैषिणः ..14..
text_mt: And on the bank of the Gaṅgā, all those mighty warriors born of the Kauravas' portion / made manifold camps, eager for victory.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā te kārtikīsnānaṃ dattvā dānānyanekaśaḥ ..
mārgakṛṣṇadvitīyāyāṃ yuddhabhūmimupāyayuḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा ते कार्तिकीस्नानं दत्त्वा दानान्यनेकशः ..
मार्गकृष्णद्वितीयायां युद्धभूमिमुपाययुः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Having performed the bath on the Kārtikī day and given numerous gifts, / on the second lunar day of the dark fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa they advanced to the battlefield.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣvaksenīyabhūpālo laharastatra cāgataḥ ..
kauravāṃśāśca tatputrāḥ ṣoḍaśaiva mahābalāḥ ..
pūrvajanmani yannāma tannāmnā praśritā iha .. 16 ..
meaning:
विष्वक्सेनीयभूपालो लहरस्तत्र चागतः ..
कौरवांशाश्च तत्पुत्राः षोडशैव महाबलाः ..
पूर्वजन्मनि यन्नाम तन्नाम्ना प्रश्रिता इह .. 16 ..
text_mt: Lahara, a king of Viṣvaksena's lineage, arrived there, / and his sixteen mighty sons, incarnations of the Kauravas; / with the names they bore in their previous birth, they were renowned here:

sanskrit_iast:
dussaho duśśalaścaiva jalasaṃdhaḥ samaḥ sahaḥ ..
viṃdastathānuviṃdaśca subāhurduṣpradharṣaṇaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
दुस्सहो दुश्शलश्चैव जलसंधः समः सहः ..
विंदस्तथानुविंदश्च सुबाहुर्दुष्प्रधर्षणः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Dussaha, Duśśala, Jalasaṃdha, Sama, Saha, / Vinda, and Anuvinda, Subāhu, Duṣpradharṣaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
durmarṣaṇaśca duṣkarṇaḥ somakīrtiranūdaraḥ ..
śalaḥ sattvo vivitsuśca kramājjñeyā mahābalāḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
दुर्मर्षणश्च दुष्कर्णः सोमकीर्तिरनूदरः ..
शलः सत्त्वो विवित्सुश्च क्रमाज्ज्ञेया महाबलाः .. 18 ..
text_mt: Durmarṣaṇa, Duṣkarṇa, Somakīrti, Anūdara, / Śala, Sattva, and Vivitsu are to be known in order, mighty in valour.

sanskrit_iast:
tomarānvayabhūpālo bāhlīkapatirāgataḥ ..
trilakṣaiśca tathā sainyaiḥ saptaputraiśca bhūpatiḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
तोमरान्वयभूपालो बाह्लीकपतिरागतः ..
त्रिलक्षैश्च तथा सैन्यैः सप्तपुत्रैश्च भूपतिः .. 19 ..
text_mt: The king born of the Tomara lineage, ruler of Bāhlīka, arrived, / a king with three hundred thousand troops and seven sons:

sanskrit_iast:
citropacitrau citrākṣaścāruścitraḥ śarāsanaḥ ..
sulocanaḥ savarṇaśca pūrvajanmani kauravāḥ .. 3.3.32.20 ..
meaning:
चित्रोपचित्रौ चित्राक्षश्चारुश्चित्रः शरासनः ..
सुलोचनः सवर्णश्च पूर्वजन्मनि कौरवाः .. 3.3.32.20 ..
text_mt: Citra, Upacitra, Citrākṣa, Cārucitra, Śarāsana, / Sulocana, and Savarṇa, who were Kauravas in their previous birth.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāmaṃśāḥ kramājjātā abhinaṃdanadehajāḥ ..
mahānaṃdaśca naṃdaśca parānaṃdopanaṃdakau ..
sunaṃdaśca surānandaḥ pranaṃdaḥ kauravāṃśakaḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
तेषामंशाः क्रमाज्जाता अभिनंदनदेहजाः ..
महानंदश्च नंदश्च परानंदोपनंदकौ ..
सुनंदश्च सुरानन्दः प्रनंदः कौरवांशकः .. 21 ..
text_mt: Born as their portions in order from the body of Abhinandana were / Mahānanda, Nanda, Parānanda, Upanandaka, / Sunanda, Surānanda, and Prananda, incarnations of the Kauravas.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpaḥ pariharavaṃśīyo māyāvarmā mahābalī ..
lakṣa sainyayutaḥ prāpto daśaputrasamanvitaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
नृपः परिहरवंशीयो मायावर्मा महाबली ..
लक्ष सैन्ययुतः प्राप्तो दशपुत्रसमन्वितः .. 22 ..
text_mt: The mighty King Māyāvarman of the Parihāra dynasty / arrived accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand and ten sons:

sanskrit_iast:
durmado durvigāhaśca naṃdaśca vikaṭānanaḥ ..
citravarmā suvarmā ca sudurmocana eva ca .. 23 ..
meaning:
दुर्मदो दुर्विगाहश्च नंदश्च विकटाननः ..
चित्रवर्मा सुवर्मा च सुदुर्मोचन एव च .. 23 ..
text_mt: Durmada, Durvigāha, Nanda, Vikaṭānana, / Citravarman, Suvarman, and Sudurmocana,

sanskrit_iast:
ūrṇanābhaḥ sunābhaśca copanaṃdaśca kauravāḥ ..
teṣāmaṃśāḥ kramājjātāḥ sutā aṃgapateḥ smṛtāḥ 24 ..
meaning:
ऊर्णनाभः सुनाभश्च चोपनंदश्च कौरवाः ..
तेषामंशाः क्रमाज्जाताः सुता अंगपतेः स्मृताः 24 ..
text_mt: Ūrṇanābha, Sunābha, and Upananda were Kauravas; / portions of them, born in succession, are commemorated as the sons of the lord of Aṅga:

sanskrit_iast:
mattaḥ pramatta unmattaḥ sumatto durmadastathā..
durmukho durdaro vāyuḥ suratho virathaḥ kramāt .. 25 ..
meaning:
मत्तः प्रमत्त उन्मत्तः सुमत्तो दुर्मदस्तथा..
दुर्मुखो दुर्दरो वायुः सुरथो विरथः क्रमात् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Matta, Pramatta, Unmatta, Sumatta, and Durmada, / Durmukha, Durdhara, Vāyu, Suratha, and Viratha in order.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklavaṃśīyabhūpālo mūlavarmā samāgataḥ ..
lakṣasainyaiśca balavāndaśaputrasamanvitaḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
शुक्लवंशीयभूपालो मूलवर्मा समागतः ..
लक्षसैन्यैश्च बलवान्दशपुत्रसमन्वितः .. 26 ..
text_mt: King Mūlavarman, born of the Śukla lineage, arrived, / powerful, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, along with ten sons:

sanskrit_iast:
ayobāhurmahābāhuścitrāṃgaścitrakuṇḍalaḥ ..
citrāyudho niṣaṃgī ca pāśī vṛndārakastathā .. 27 ..
meaning:
अयोबाहुर्महाबाहुश्चित्रांगश्चित्रकुण्डलः ..
चित्रायुधो निषंगी च पाशी वृन्दारकस्तथा .. 27 ..
text_mt: Ayobāhu, Mahābāhu, Citrāṅga, Citrakuṇḍala, / Citrāyudha, Niṣaṅgin, Pāśin, Vṛndāraka,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛḍhavarmā dṛḍhakṣatraḥ pūrvajanmani kauravāḥ ..
teṣāmaṃśā mahīṃ jātā gṛhe te mūlavarmaṇaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
दृढवर्मा दृढक्षत्रः पूर्वजन्मनि कौरवाः ..
तेषामंशा महीं जाता गृहे ते मूलवर्मणः .. 28 ..
text_mt: Dṛḍhavarman, and Dṛḍhakṣatra were Kauravas in a former birth; / portions of them were born on earth in the house of Mūlavarman:

sanskrit_iast:
balaśca prabalaścaiva subalo balavānbalī ..
sumūlaśca mahāmūlo durgo bhīmo bhayaṃkaraḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
बलश्च प्रबलश्चैव सुबलो बलवान्बली ..
सुमूलश्च महामूलो दुर्गो भीमो भयंकरः .. 29 ..
text_mt: Bala, Prabala, Subala, Balavat, Balin, / Sumūla, Mahāmūla, Durga, Bhīma, and Bhayaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
kaikayaścaṃdravaṃśīyo lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ ..
daśaputrānvitaḥ prāptaḥ kurukṣetre mahā raṇe .. 3.3.32.30 ..
meaning:
कैकयश्चंद्रवंशीयो लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः ..
दशपुत्रान्वितः प्राप्तः कुरुक्षेत्रे महा रणे .. 3.3.32.30 ..
text_mt: Kaikaya, born of the Lunar lineage, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand / and accompanied by ten sons, arrived at Kurukṣetra for the great battle:

sanskrit_iast:
bhīmavego bhīmabalo balākī balavarddhanaḥ ..
ugrāyudho daṃḍadharo dṛḍhasaṃdho mahīdharaḥ ..31..
meaning:
भीमवेगो भीमबलो बलाकी बलवर्द्धनः ..
उग्रायुधो दंडधरो दृढसंधो महीधरः ..31..
text_mt: Bhīmavega, Bhīmabala, Balākin, Balavardhana, / Ugrāyudha, Daṇḍadhara, Dṛḍhasaṃdha, Mahīdhara,

sanskrit_iast:
jarāsaṃdhaḥ satyasaṃdhaḥ pūrvajanmani kauravāḥ ..
teṣāmaṃśāḥ samudbhūtāḥ kaikayasya gṛhe śubhe .. 32 ..
meaning:
जरासंधः सत्यसंधः पूर्वजन्मनि कौरवाः ..
तेषामंशाः समुद्भूताः कैकयस्य गृहे शुभे .. 32 ..
text_mt: Jarāsaṃdha, and Satyasaṃdha were Kauravas in a former birth; / portions of them were born in the auspicious house of Kaikaya:

sanskrit_iast:
kāmaḥ prakāmaḥ saṃkāmo niṣkāmo nirapatrapaḥ ..
jayaśca vijayaścaiva jayaṃto jayavāñjayaḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
कामः प्रकामः संकामो निष्कामो निरपत्रपः ..
जयश्च विजयश्चैव जयंतो जयवाञ्जयः .. 33 ..
text_mt: Kāma, Prakāma, Saṅkāma, Niṣkāma, Nirapatrapa, / Jaya, Vijaya, Jayanta, Jayavat, and Jaya.

sanskrit_iast:
nāgavaṃśīyabhūpālo nāgavarmā samāgataḥ ..
lakṣasenānvitaḥ prāpto daśaputrasamanvitaḥ ..34..
meaning:
नागवंशीयभूपालो नागवर्मा समागतः ..
लक्षसेनान्वितः प्राप्तो दशपुत्रसमन्वितः ..34..
text_mt: King Nāgavarman, born of the Nāga lineage, arrived, / accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, along with ten sons.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvajanmani yannāmnā tannāmnā kauravā bhuvi..
puṃḍradeśapateḥ putrā jātā daśa śivājñayā ..35..
meaning:
पूर्वजन्मनि यन्नाम्ना तन्नाम्ना कौरवा भुवि..
पुंड्रदेशपतेः पुत्रा जाता दश शिवाज्ञया ..35..
text_mt: Those Kauravas, by whatever name they had in a former birth, / were born on earth with the same names as ten sons of the lord of the Puṇḍra country by order of Śiva:

sanskrit_iast:
ugraśravā ugrasenaḥ senānīrduṣparāyaṇaḥ..
aparājitaḥ kuṇḍaśāyī viśālākṣo durādharaḥ..36..
meaning:
उग्रश्रवा उग्रसेनः सेनानीर्दुष्परायणः..
अपराजितः कुण्डशायी विशालाक्षो दुराधरः..36..
text_mt: Ugraśravas, Ugrasena, Senānī, Duṣparāyaṇa, / Aparājita, Kuṇḍaśāyin, Viśālākṣa, Durādhara,

sanskrit_iast: dṛḍhahastaḥ suhastaśca sutāste nāgavarmaṇaḥ .. 37 ..
meaning: दृढहस्तः सुहस्तश्च सुतास्ते नागवर्मणः .. 37 ..
text_mt: Dṛḍhahasta, and Suhasta—these were the sons of Nāgavarman.

sanskrit_iast:
madrakeśaḥ samāyātastomarānvayasaṃbhavaḥ ..
lakṣasainyairyuto rājā daśaputrasamanvitaḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
मद्रकेशः समायातस्तोमरान्वयसंभवः ..
लक्षसैन्यैर्युतो राजा दशपुत्रसमन्वितः .. 38 ..
text_mt: Madrakeśa arrived, born of the Tomara lineage; / the king, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, was endowed with ten sons:

sanskrit_iast:
vātavegaḥ suvarcāśca nāgadaṃtograyājakaḥ ..
ādiketuśca vakśī ca kavacī krātha eva ca .. 39 ..
meaning:
वातवेगः सुवर्चाश्च नागदंतोग्रयाजकः ..
आदिकेतुश्च वक्शी च कवची क्राथ एव च .. 39 ..
text_mt: Vātavega, Suvarcas, Nāgadanta, Ugrayājaka, / Ādiketu, Vakśin, Kavacī, and Krātha,

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇḍaśca kuṇḍadhāraśca kauravāḥ pūrvajanmani ..
tannāmnā bhuvi vai jātā madra keśasya maṃdire .. 3.3.32.40 ..
meaning:
कुण्डश्च कुण्डधारश्च कौरवाः पूर्वजन्मनि ..
तन्नाम्ना भुवि वै जाता मद्र केशस्य मंदिरे .. 3.3.32.40 ..
text_mt: Kuṇḍa, and Kuṇḍadhāra were Kauravas in a former birth; / with those very names they were indeed born on earth in the palace of Madrakeśa.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpaḥ śārdūlavaṃśīyau lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ ..
pūrṇāmalo māgadheśo daśaputrānvito yayau .. 41 ..
meaning:
नृपः शार्दूलवंशीयौ लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः ..
पूर्णामलो मागधेशो दशपुत्रान्वितो ययौ .. 41 ..
text_mt: The king born of the Śārdūla lineage, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, / Pūrṇāmala, lord of Magadha, departed accompanied by ten sons:

sanskrit_iast:
vīrabāhurbhīmarathaścograścaiva dhanurdharaḥ..
raudrakarmā dṛḍharatho'lolupaścābhayastathā..42..
meaning:
वीरबाहुर्भीमरथश्चोग्रश्चैव धनुर्धरः..
रौद्रकर्मा दृढरथोऽलोलुपश्चाभयस्तथा..42..
text_mt: Vīrabāhu, Bhīmaratha, Ugra, Dhanurdhara, / Raudrakarman, Dṛḍharatha, Alolupa, Abhaya,

sanskrit_iast:
anādhṛṣṭaḥ kuṇḍabhedī kauravāḥ pūrvajanmani..
pūrṇāmalasya vai gehe tannāmnā bhuvi saṃbhava..43..
meaning:
अनाधृष्टः कुण्डभेदी कौरवाः पूर्वजन्मनि..
पूर्णामलस्य वै गेहे तन्नाम्ना भुवि संभव..43..
text_mt: Anādhṛṣṭa, and Kuṇḍabhedin were Kauravas in a former birth; / with those very names their birth took place on earth in the house of Pūrṇāmala.

sanskrit_iast:
maṃkaṇaḥ kiṃnaro nāma rūpadeśe mahīpatiḥ ..
cīnadeśātpare pāre rūmadeśaḥ smṛto budhaiḥ ..
naraḥ kinnarajātīyo vasati priyadarśanaḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
मंकणः किंनरो नाम रूपदेशे महीपतिः ..
चीनदेशात्परे पारे रूमदेशः स्मृतो बुधैः ..
नरः किन्नरजातीयो वसति प्रियदर्शनः .. 44 ..
text_mt: A kinnara named Maṅkaṇa was a monarch in the country of Rūma; / across the further bank from the country of Cīna, the country of Rūma is remembered by the wise, / where men of the kinnara class, handsome in appearance, dwell.

sanskrit_iast:
maṃkaṇaśca tadā prāptaḥ kinnarāyutasaṃyutaḥ ..
aṣṭaputrānvitaḥ prāpto yatra sarvanṛpāḥ sthitāḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
मंकणश्च तदा प्राप्तः किन्नरायुतसंयुतः ..
अष्टपुत्रान्वितः प्राप्तो यत्र सर्वनृपाः स्थिताः .. 45 ..
text_mt: Then Maṅkaṇa arrived, accompanied by ten thousand kinnaras, / endowed with eight sons, [he] arrived where all the kings stood:

sanskrit_iast:
virāvī prathamaścaiva pramāthī dīrgharomakaḥ ..
dīrghabāhurmahābāhurvyūḍhorāḥ kanakadhvajaḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
विरावी प्रथमश्चैव प्रमाथी दीर्घरोमकः ..
दीर्घबाहुर्महाबाहुर्व्यूढोराः कनकध्वजः .. 46 ..
text_mt: Virāvin was first, and Pramāthin, Dīrgharoman, / Dīrghabāhu, Mahābāhu, Vyūḍhoraska, and Kanakadhvaja.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvajanmani yannāmnā tannāmnā kinnarā bhuvi ..
virajoṃśaśca yo jāto maṃkaṇo nāma kinnaraḥ ..47..
meaning:
पूर्वजन्मनि यन्नाम्ना तन्नाम्ना किन्नरा भुवि ..
विरजोंशश्च यो जातो मंकणो नाम किन्नरः ..47..
text_mt: By whatever names [they were called] in a former birth, with those names the kinnaras [appeared] on earth; / and he who was born as a portion of Virajas was the kinnara named Maṅkaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
netrasiṃhaḥ samāyāto lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ ..
śalyāṃśaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ śārdūlānvayasaṃbhavaḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
नेत्रसिंहः समायातो लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः ..
शल्यांशः स तु विज्ञेयः शार्दूलान्वयसंभवः .. 48 ..
text_mt: Netrasiṃha arrived, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand; / he should be known as a portion of Śalya, born of the Śārdūla lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā gajapatī rājā lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ..
saṃprāptaḥ śakuneraṃśastyaktvā gehe svaputrakān ..49..
meaning:
तदा गजपती राजा लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः..
संप्राप्तः शकुनेरंशस्त्यक्त्वा गेहे स्वपुत्रकान् ..49..
text_mt: Then King Gajapati, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, / arrived, an incarnation of Śakuni, having left his own sons at home.

sanskrit_iast:
mayūradhvaja evāpi lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ ..
makaraṃdaṃ gṛhe tyaktvā virāṭāṃśaḥ samāgataḥ .. 3.3.32.50 ..
meaning:
मयूरध्वज एवापि लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः ..
मकरंदं गृहे त्यक्त्वा विराटांशः समागतः .. 3.3.32.50 ..
text_mt: Mayūradhvaja as well, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, / an incarnation of Virāṭa, arrived, having left Makaranda at home.

sanskrit_iast:
vīrasenaḥ samāyātaḥ kāmasenasamanvitaḥ ..
lakṣasenānvitastatra cograsenāṃśasaṃbhavaḥ ..51..
meaning:
वीरसेनः समायातः कामसेनसमन्वितः ..
लक्षसेनान्वितस्तत्र चोग्रसेनांशसंभवः ..51..
text_mt: Vīrasena arrived, accompanied by Kāmasena / and an army of one hundred thousand there, an incarnation of Ugrasena.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇaśca samāyātaḥ saptalakṣabalairyutaḥ ..
saṃtyajya padminīṃ nārīṃ mahā kaṣṭena bhūpatiḥ ..52..
meaning:
लक्षणश्च समायातः सप्तलक्षबलैर्युतः ..
संत्यज्य पद्मिनीं नारीं महा कष्टेन भूपतिः ..52..
text_mt: And Lakṣaṇa arrived, endowed with forces of seven hundred thousand; / abandoning the lotus-like woman [Padminī] with great hardship, the monarch [came].

sanskrit_iast:
tālano dhānyapālaśca lallasiṃhastathaiva ca ..
bhīmasyāṃśo yuyutsośca kuṃtibhojasya vai kramāt ..53 ..
meaning:
तालनो धान्यपालश्च लल्लसिंहस्तथैव च ..
भीमस्यांशो युयुत्सोश्च कुंतिभोजस्य वै क्रमात् ..53 ..
text_mt: Tālana, Dhānyapāla, and likewise Lallasiṃha / were portions of Bhīma, Yuyutsu, and Kuntibhoja respectively in order.

sanskrit_iast:
āhlādaśca samāyātaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśena samanvitaḥ ..
jayantena ca vai vīro lakṣasainyānvito balī .. 54 ..
meaning:
आह्लादश्च समायातः कृष्णांशेन समन्वितः ..
जयन्तेन च वै वीरो लक्षसैन्यान्वितो बली .. 54 ..
text_mt: And Āhlāda arrived, endowed with a portion of Kṛṣṇa, / along with Jayanta—the hero was mighty, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
jagannāyaka evāpi śūrāyutasamanvitaḥ ..
saṃprāpto bhagadattāṃśo gautamānvayasaṃbhavaḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
जगन्नायक एवापि शूरायुतसमन्वितः ..
संप्राप्तो भगदत्तांशो गौतमान्वयसंभवः .. 55 ..
text_mt: Jagannāyaka as well, accompanied by ten thousand warriors, / arrived, an incarnation of Bhagadatta, born of the Gautama lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
anye ca kṣudrabhūpāśca sahasrāḍhyāḥ pṛthakpṛthak ..
kurukṣetraṃ paraṃ sthānaṃ saṃyayurmadavihvalāḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
अन्ये च क्षुद्रभूपाश्च सहस्राढ्याः पृथक्पृथक् ..
कुरुक्षेत्रं परं स्थानं संययुर्मदविह्वलाः .. 56 ..
text_mt: And other minor kings, each possessing thousands [of troops], / went to Kurukṣetra, the supreme place, agitated with warrior-frenzy.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlavarmā ca nṛpatiḥ saputro lakṣasainyapaḥ ..
nṛpaṃ parimalaṃ prāpya saṃyukto dehalīpateḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
मूलवर्मा च नृपतिः सपुत्रो लक्षसैन्यपः ..
नृपं परिमलं प्राप्य संयुक्तो देहलीपतेः .. 57 ..
text_mt: King Mūlavarman, with his sons, commander of an army of one hundred thousand, / having reached King Parimala, joined the side of the lord of Dehalī.

sanskrit_iast:
kaikayo lakṣasenāḍhyaḥ saputro nṛpatiḥ svayam ..
nṛpaṃ parimalaṃ prāpya sa yuddhārthamupasthitaḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
कैकयो लक्षसेनाढ्यः सपुत्रो नृपतिः स्वयम् ..
नृपं परिमलं प्राप्य स युद्धार्थमुपस्थितः .. 58 ..
text_mt: Kaikaya himself, the king endowed with an army of one hundred thousand, with his sons, / having reached King Parimala, presented himself for battle.

sanskrit_iast:
netrasiṃhaśca nṛpatiḥ sa vīro lakṣasainyapaḥ ..
mayūradhvaja evāpi lakṣapaḥ śaśivaṃśinam .. 59 ..
meaning:
नेत्रसिंहश्च नृपतिः स वीरो लक्षसैन्यपः ..
मयूरध्वज एवापि लक्षपः शशिवंशिनम् .. 59 ..
text_mt: And King Netrasiṃha, that hero, commander of one hundred thousand, / and also Mayūradhvaja, commander of one hundred thousand, [joined] the descendant of the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
vīrasenaśca lakṣāḍhyaḥ saputraścāṃdripakṣagaḥ ..
lakṣaṇaḥ saptalakṣāḍhyo yuddhārthaṃ samupasthitaḥ .. 3.3.32.60 ..
meaning:
वीरसेनश्च लक्षाढ्यः सपुत्रश्चांद्रिपक्षगः ..
लक्षणः सप्तलक्षाढ्यो युद्धार्थं समुपस्थितः .. 3.3.32.60 ..
text_mt: Vīrasena, possessing one hundred thousand, with his sons, took the side of the king; / Lakṣaṇa, possessing seven hundred thousand, stood ready for battle.

sanskrit_iast:
āhlādo lakṣasainyāḍhyaḥ pakṣagaścaṃdravaṃśinaḥ ..
dvilakṣasaṃyuto rājā candravaṃśo raṇonmukhaḥ ..
evaṃ ṣoḍaśalakṣāḍhyaḥ sthitaḥ parimalo raṇe .. 61 ..
meaning:
आह्लादो लक्षसैन्याढ्यः पक्षगश्चंद्रवंशिनः ..
द्विलक्षसंयुतो राजा चन्द्रवंशो रणोन्मुखः ..
एवं षोडशलक्षाढ्यः स्थितः परिमलो रणे .. 61 ..
text_mt: Āhlāda, endowed with an army of one hundred thousand, was an ally of the descendant of the Moon; / the king, born of the Lunar lineage, facing battle, was joined by two hundred thousand; / thus Parimala stood in battle, endowed with one million six hundred thousand [warriors].

sanskrit_iast:
laharo bhūpatiśreṣṭho lakṣapaḥ putrasaṃyutaḥ ..
mahīrājamupāgamya yuddhārthaṃ samupasthitaḥ .. 62 ..
meaning:
लहरो भूपतिश्रेष्ठो लक्षपः पुत्रसंयुतः ..
महीराजमुपागम्य युद्धार्थं समुपस्थितः .. 62 ..
text_mt: Lahandhara, the best of monarchs, commander of one hundred thousand, with his sons, / having approached Mahīrāja, stood ready for battle.

sanskrit_iast:
abhinandana evāpi saputro lakṣasainyapaḥ ..
māyāvarmā ca nṛpatiḥ saputro lakṣasainyapaḥ .. 63 ..
meaning:
अभिनन्दन एवापि सपुत्रो लक्षसैन्यपः ..
मायावर्मा च नृपतिः सपुत्रो लक्षसैन्यपः .. 63 ..
text_mt: Abhinandana as well, with his sons, commander of an army of one hundred thousand, / and King Māyāvarman, with his sons, commander of an army of one hundred thousand,

sanskrit_iast:
nāgavarmā samāyātaḥ saputro lakṣasainyapaḥ ..
madrakeśaḥ saputraśca lakṣasainyo raṇonmukhaḥ .. 64 ..
meaning:
नागवर्मा समायातः सपुत्रो लक्षसैन्यपः ..
मद्रकेशः सपुत्रश्च लक्षसैन्यो रणोन्मुखः .. 64 ..
text_mt: Nāgavarman arrived, with his sons, commander of an army of one hundred thousand; / Madrakeśa, with his sons, accompanied by one hundred thousand troops, turned his face to battle.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇāmalaḥ saputraśca lakṣapaścaiva pakṣagaḥ ..
maṃkaṇaḥ kinnaro nāma saputrastatra saṃsthitaḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
पूर्णामलः सपुत्रश्च लक्षपश्चैव पक्षगः ..
मंकणः किन्नरो नाम सपुत्रस्तत्र संस्थितः .. 65 ..
text_mt: Pūrṇāmala, with his sons, commander of one hundred thousand, was an ally; / the kinnara named Maṅkaṇa, with his sons, took his stand there.

sanskrit_iast:
gajarājaḥ samāyāto mahīrājaṃ hi lakṣapaḥ ..
dhuṃdhukāraḥ samāyātaḥ pañcalakṣapatiḥ svayam .. 66 ..
meaning:
गजराजः समायातो महीराजं हि लक्षपः ..
धुंधुकारः समायातः पञ्चलक्षपतिः स्वयम् .. 66 ..
text_mt: Gajarāja arrived to support Mahīrāja, commander of one hundred thousand; / Dhundhukāra arrived in person, master of five hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
putraḥ kṛṣṇakumārasya bhagadattaḥ samāgataḥ ..
trilakṣabalasaṃyukto mahīrājaṃ mahīpatim .. 67 ..
meaning:
पुत्रः कृष्णकुमारस्य भगदत्तः समागतः ..
त्रिलक्षबलसंयुक्तो महीराजं महीपतिम् .. 67 ..
text_mt: Bhagadatta, the son of Kṛṣṇakumāra, arrived, / endowed with a force of three hundred thousand, to King Mahīrāja.

sanskrit_iast:
balavāhanaputraśca daśagopālasaṃsthitaḥ ..
aṃgadastatra saṃprāptaḥ sāyuto devakī priyaḥ ..
mahīrājamupāgamya yuddhārthaṃ samupasthitaḥ ..68..
meaning:
बलवाहनपुत्रश्च दशगोपालसंस्थितः ..
अंगदस्तत्र संप्राप्तः सायुतो देवकी प्रियः ..
महीराजमुपागम्य युद्धार्थं समुपस्थितः ..68..
text_mt: And Balavāhana's son, stationed with ten herdsmen, / Aṅgada, dear to Devakī, arrived there with ten thousand. / Having approached Mahīrāja, he stood ready for battle.

sanskrit_iast:
kaliṃgaśca nṛpaḥ prāptastrikoṇaśca tathaiva ca ..
śrīpatiśca tathā rājā śrītāraśca tathā gataḥ .. .. 69 ..
meaning:
कलिंगश्च नृपः प्राप्तस्त्रिकोणश्च तथैव च ..
श्रीपतिश्च तथा राजा श्रीतारश्च तथा गतः .. .. 69 ..
text_mt: And King Kaliṅga arrived, and likewise Trikoṇa; / King Śrīpati also, and Śrītāra went there as well.

sanskrit_iast:
mukundaśca suketuśca ruhilo guhilastathā ..
induvāraśca valavāñjayaṃtaśca tathāvidhaḥ ..
sarve daśasahasrāḍhyā mahīrājamupasthitāḥ .. 3.3.32.70 ..
meaning:
मुकुन्दश्च सुकेतुश्च रुहिलो गुहिलस्तथा ..
इन्दुवारश्च वलवाञ्जयंतश्च तथाविधः ..
सर्वे दशसहस्राढ्या महीराजमुपस्थिताः .. 3.3.32.70 ..
text_mt: Mukunda, Suketu, Ruhila, and Guhila, / the mighty Induvāra, and Jayanta of similar kind— / all endowed with ten thousand [troops] attended upon Mahīrāja.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājasya pakṣe tu sahasraṃ kṣudrabhūmipāḥ ..
te tu sāhasrasenāḍhyā mahīrājamupasthitāḥ .. 71 ..
meaning:
महीराजस्य पक्षे तु सहस्रं क्षुद्रभूमिपाः ..
ते तु साहस्रसेनाढ्या महीराजमुपस्थिताः .. 71 ..
text_mt: On Mahīrāja's side, however, were a thousand petty kings; / endowed with armies of thousands, they attended upon Mahīrāja.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ madhye ca vai bhūpāndviśatāndehalīṃ prati ..
sasainyānpreṣayāmāsa rāṣṭrarakṣaṇahetave ..
evaṃ sa dehalīrājaścaturviṃśatilakṣapaḥ .. 72 ..
meaning:
तेषां मध्ये च वै भूपान्द्विशतान्देहलीं प्रति ..
ससैन्यान्प्रेषयामास राष्ट्ररक्षणहेतवे ..
एवं स देहलीराजश्चतुर्विंशतिलक्षपः .. 72 ..
text_mt: From among them, he sent two hundred kings towards Delhi / with their armies for the sake of protecting the realm. / Thus that king of Delhi commanded twenty-four hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
yuddhamaṣṭādaśāhāni sañjātaṃ sarvasaṃkṣayam ..
śṛṇu yuddhakathāṃ ramyāṃ bhṛguvarya suvistarāt .. 73 ..
meaning:
युद्धमष्टादशाहानि सञ्जातं सर्वसंक्षयम् ..
शृणु युद्धकथां रम्यां भृगुवर्य सुविस्तरात् .. 73 ..
text_mt: A battle lasting eighteen days took place, bringing total destruction. / Hear in detail, O best of the Bhṛgus, the captivating tale of the war:

sanskrit_iast:
mārgakṛṣṇadvitīyāyāṃ mahīrājo mahābalaḥ ..
āhūya laharaṃ bhūpaṃ vacanaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ ..9..
meaning:
मार्गकृष्णद्वितीयायां महीराजो महाबलः ..
आहूय लहरं भूपं वचनं प्राह निर्भयः ..9..
text_mt: On the second lunar day of the dark fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa, the mighty Mahīrāja, / having summoned King Lahara, spoke fearless words:

sanskrit_iast:
bhavānsaputraḥ senāḍhyo dhuṃdhukāreṇa rakṣitaḥ ..
cāmuṇḍena yuto yuddhe gantumarhati sattama ..
iti śrutvā yayau śīghraṃ kurukṣetre mahāraṇe .. 75 ..
meaning:
भवान्सपुत्रः सेनाढ्यो धुंधुकारेण रक्षितः ..
चामुण्डेन युतो युद्धे गन्तुमर्हति सत्तम ..
इति श्रुत्वा ययौ शीघ्रं कुरुक्षेत्रे महारणे .. 75 ..
text_mt: "Accompanied by your sons, endowed with an army, protected by Dhuṃdhukāra, / and joined by Cāmuṇḍa, you ought to go to battle, O best of men." / Having heard this, he quickly went to the great battlefield at Kurukṣetra.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā parimalo rājā mayūradhvajameva hi ..
samāhūya vacaḥ prāha śṛṇu pārthivasattama .. 76 ..
meaning:
तदा परिमलो राजा मयूरध्वजमेव हि ..
समाहूय वचः प्राह शृणु पार्थिवसत्तम .. 76 ..
text_mt: Then King Parimala, summoning Mayūradhvaja, / spoke these words: "Hear, O best of kings:

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśena jayaṃtena devasiṃhena rakṣitaḥ ..
sa bhavām̐llakṣasainyāḍhyo gaṃtumarhati vai raṇe .. .. 77 ..
meaning:
कृष्णांशेन जयंतेन देवसिंहेन रक्षितः ..
स भवाम्̐ल्लक्षसैन्याढ्यो गंतुमर्हति वै रणे .. .. 77 ..
text_mt: Protected by Jayanta, an expansion of Kṛṣṇa, and by Devasiṃha, / you, endowed with a hundred thousand troops, ought to go to battle."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ mayūradhvaja eva hi ..
lakṣasainyānvitaḥ prāpto laharaṃ nṛpatiṃ prati .. 78 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं मयूरध्वज एव हि ..
लक्षसैन्यान्वितः प्राप्तो लहरं नृपतिं प्रति .. 78 ..
text_mt: Having heard these words, Mayūradhvaja, / accompanied by a hundred thousand troops, advanced against King Lahara.

sanskrit_iast:
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ senayorubhayo raṇe ..
senā tu lakṣavīrasya tatra yuddhe prakīrtitā .. 79 ..
meaning:
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धं सेनयोरुभयो रणे ..
सेना तु लक्षवीरस्य तत्र युद्धे प्रकीर्तिता .. 79 ..
text_mt: And a great battle between those two armies took place in the war. / The army of a hundred thousand warriors in that battle was thus described:

sanskrit_iast:
eko ratho gajāstatra jñeyāḥ pañcaśataṃ raṇe..
hayāśca pañcasāhasrā pattayastadgaṇā daśa ..
ete sainyā narā jñeyā sainyapāṃśca śṛṇuṣva bhoḥ ..3.3.32.80..
meaning:
एको रथो गजास्तत्र ज्ञेयाः पञ्चशतं रणे..
हयाश्च पञ्चसाहस्रा पत्तयस्तद्गणा दश ..
एते सैन्या नरा ज्ञेया सैन्यपांश्च शृणुष्व भोः ..3.3.32.80..
text_mt: One chariot, five hundred elephants are to be known there in the battle, / five thousand horses, and ten times as many foot-soldiers; / these men are to be known as the troops, and hear now of the troop commanders, O dear one!

sanskrit_iast:
daśānāṃ paccarāṇāṃ ca patirnāmnā sa pattipaḥ ..
paṃcānāṃ ca hayānāṃ ca patirnāmnā sa gulmapaḥ..81..
meaning:
दशानां पच्चराणां च पतिर्नाम्ना स पत्तिपः ..
पंचानां च हयानां च पतिर्नाम्ना स गुल्मपः..81..
text_mt: The master over ten foot-soldiers is called a pattipa; / and the master over five horses is called a gulmapa.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcānāṃ ca gajānāṃ ca patirnāmnā gajādhipaḥ ..
etaiḥ sārddhaṃ rathī jñeyo raṇe'smindāruṇe kalau ..82..
meaning:
पंचानां च गजानां च पतिर्नाम्ना गजाधिपः ..
एतैः सार्द्धं रथी ज्ञेयो रणेऽस्मिन्दारुणे कलौ ..82..
text_mt: And the master over five elephants is called a gajādhipa; / together with these, a chariot-fighter is to be recognized in this dreadful Kali age of battle.

sanskrit_iast:
uṣṭrārūḍhāḥ smṛtā dūtāścatvāriṃśacca tadbale ..
śataghnyastatra sāhasrāsteṣāṃ madhye pṛthakpṛthak ..
ṣaḍtriṃśadvai padacarāsteṣāṃ karmāṇi me śṛṇu .. 83 ..
meaning:
उष्ट्रारूढाः स्मृता दूताश्चत्वारिंशच्च तद्बले ..
शतघ्न्यस्तत्र साहस्रास्तेषां मध्ये पृथक्पृथक् ..
षड्त्रिंशद्वै पदचरास्तेषां कर्माणि मे शृणु .. 83 ..
text_mt: Forty messengers mounted on camels are remembered in that force; / there were a thousand śataghnīs, and among them, separately, / thirty-six footmen. Hear from me their duties:

sanskrit_iast:
daśa golakadātāro daśatatpuṣṭikārakāḥ ..
daśa cārdrakarāstāṃ vai trayaste vahnidāyinaḥ ..
trayo dṛṣṭikarā jñeyāstriyāmeṣu pṛthakpṛthak .. 84 ..
meaning:
दश गोलकदातारो दशतत्पुष्टिकारकाः ..
दश चार्द्रकरास्तां वै त्रयस्ते वह्निदायिनः ..
त्रयो दृष्टिकरा ज्ञेयास्त्रियामेषु पृथक्पृथक् .. 84 ..
text_mt: Ten supply the balls, ten load them, / ten moisten them, and three provide the fire; / three are known to keep watch, separately throughout the watches of the night.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣāḥ śūdrāstu senānāṃ śūrakṛtyaparāyaṇāḥ ..
evaṃ ca lakṣavīrāṇāṃ senā tatra prakīrtitā .. 85 ..
meaning:
शेषाः शूद्रास्तु सेनानां शूरकृत्यपरायणाः ..
एवं च लक्षवीराणां सेना तत्र प्रकीर्तिता .. 85 ..
text_mt: The rest of the troops are Śūdras, devoted to the actions of heroes. / In this way was described the army of a hundred thousand warriors there.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāsīttumulaṃ yuddhaṃ dharmeṇa ca samantataḥ ..
prātaḥkālātsamārabhya madhyāhnaṃ sainyayordvayoḥ .. 86 ..
meaning:
तत्रासीत्तुमुलं युद्धं धर्मेण च समन्ततः ..
प्रातःकालात्समारभ्य मध्याह्नं सैन्ययोर्द्वयोः .. 86 ..
text_mt: There was a tumultuous battle fought according to righteousness on all sides / between the two armies, from morning until noon.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpaścādyāmamātreṇa sainyapā yuddhamāgatāḥ ..
tatpaścācca mahāśūrā dhuṃdhukārādayo balāḥ ..87..
meaning:
तत्पश्चाद्याममात्रेण सैन्यपा युद्धमागताः ..
तत्पश्चाच्च महाशूरा धुंधुकारादयो बलाः ..87..
text_mt: After that, within merely a watch, the commanders arrived for battle; / and after that, the great heroes, Dhuṃdhukāra and the other mighty ones,

sanskrit_iast:
yāmamātraṃ ca yuddhāya saṃsthitā raṇamūrdhani ..
cāmuṇḍena ca kṛṣṇāṃśo dhuṃdhukāreṇa cendulaḥ .. 88 ..
meaning:
याममात्रं च युद्धाय संस्थिता रणमूर्धनि ..
चामुण्डेन च कृष्णांशो धुंधुकारेण चेन्दुलः .. 88 ..
text_mt: stood at the forefront of the battle for merely a watch to fight: / Kṛṣṇāṃśa with Cāmuṇḍa, and Indula with Dhuṃdhukāra;

sanskrit_iast:
bhagadattena vai devaḥ kṛtavānyuddhamuttamam ..
sāyaṃkāle tu saṃprāpte sarve śūrāḥ kṣayaṃ gatāḥ .. 89 ..
meaning:
भगदत्तेन वै देवः कृतवान्युद्धमुत्तमम् ..
सायंकाले तु संप्राप्ते सर्वे शूराः क्षयं गताः .. 89 ..
text_mt: and Deva fought a preeminent battle with Bhagadatta. / When evening arrived, all the warriors were exhausted.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśastatra cāmuṇḍaṃ jitvā tu laharātmajān ..
ṣoḍaśaiva jaghānāśu ghaṭīmātreṇa vīryavān ..
dadhmau śaṃkhaṃ prasannātmā lakṣaṇāntamupāyayau ..3.3.32.90..
meaning:
कृष्णांशस्तत्र चामुण्डं जित्वा तु लहरात्मजान् ..
षोडशैव जघानाशु घटीमात्रेण वीर्यवान् ..
दध्मौ शंखं प्रसन्नात्मा लक्षणान्तमुपाययौ ..3.3.32.90..
text_mt: Having conquered Cāmuṇḍa there, the heroic Kṛṣṇāṃśa / quickly slew the sixteen sons of Lahara within merely a ghaṭikā. / He blew his conch, gladdened in heart, and approached Lakṣaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
cāmuṃḍo dhuṃdhukāraśca bhagadatto yutaḥ śataiḥ ..
mahīrājamupāgamya suṣupurniśi nirbhayāḥ .. 91 ..
meaning:
चामुंडो धुंधुकारश्च भगदत्तो युतः शतैः ..
महीराजमुपागम्य सुषुपुर्निशि निर्भयाः .. 91 ..
text_mt: Cāmuṇḍa, Dhuṃdhukāra, and Bhagadatta, accompanied by hundreds, / approached Mahīrāja and slept fearlessly at night.

sanskrit_iast:
iṃdulo devasiṃhaśca sahasraiḥ saṃyutau mudā ..
gatvā parimalaṃ bhūpaṃ rātrau suṣupatustadā .. 92 ..
meaning:
इंदुलो देवसिंहश्च सहस्रैः संयुतौ मुदा ..
गत्वा परिमलं भूपं रात्रौ सुषुपतुस्तदा .. 92 ..
text_mt: Indula and Devasiṃha, joyfully accompanied by thousands, / went to King Parimala and then slept at night.

sanskrit_iast:
prātaḥkāle tu saṃprāpte tṛtīyāyāṃ bhayaṃkare ..
mahīrājastadāhūya nṛpaṃ gajapatiṃ balī .. 93 ..
meaning:
प्रातःकाले तु संप्राप्ते तृतीयायां भयंकरे ..
महीराजस्तदाहूय नृपं गजपतिं बली .. 93 ..
text_mt: When morning arrived on the terrifying third [lunar day], / the mighty Mahīrāja then summoned King Gajapati,

sanskrit_iast:
vacanaṃ prāha bho rājam̐stvaṃ trivīraiḥ surakṣitaḥ ..
svakīyairlakṣasainyaiśca gaṃtumarhasi vai raṇe ..94 ..
meaning:
वचनं प्राह भो राजम्̐स्त्वं त्रिवीरैः सुरक्षितः ..
स्वकीयैर्लक्षसैन्यैश्च गंतुमर्हसि वै रणे ..94 ..
text_mt: and spoke these words: "O king, well protected by the three heroes / and with your own hundred thousand troops, you ought to go to battle."

sanskrit_iast:
tadā parimalo bhūpo netrasiṃhaṃ mahīpatim ..
yuddhāyājñāpayāmāsa kṛṣṇāṃśādyaiḥ surakṣitam .. 95 ..
meaning:
तदा परिमलो भूपो नेत्रसिंहं महीपतिम् ..
युद्धायाज्ञापयामास कृष्णांशाद्यैः सुरक्षितम् .. 95 ..
text_mt: Then King Parimala commanded King Netrasiṃha, / who was well protected by Kṛṣṇāṃśa and the others, to fight.

sanskrit_iast:
tayoścāsīnmahayuddhaṃ senayorubhayoḥ kramāt ..
hayā hayaiḥ kṣayaṃ jagmurgajāścaiva tathā gajaiḥ ..
paccarāḥ paccaraiḥ sārddhaṃ śataghnyaśca śataghnibhiḥ ..96..
meaning:
तयोश्चासीन्महयुद्धं सेनयोरुभयोः क्रमात् ..
हया हयैः क्षयं जग्मुर्गजाश्चैव तथा गजैः ..
पच्चराः पच्चरैः सार्द्धं शतघ्न्यश्च शतघ्निभिः ..96..
text_mt: And a great battle took place between their two armies in succession: / horses were destroyed by horses, and elephants likewise by elephants, / foot-soldiers together with foot-soldiers, and śataghnīs with śataghnīs.

sanskrit_iast:
aparāhne muniśreṣṭha netrasiṃho mahābalaḥ ..
mahāgajaṃ gajapatiṃ gatvā yuddhamacīkarat ..97..
meaning:
अपराह्ने मुनिश्रेष्ठ नेत्रसिंहो महाबलः ..
महागजं गजपतिं गत्वा युद्धमचीकरत् ..97..
text_mt: In the afternoon, O best of sages, the mighty Netrasiṃha, / having gone up to Gajapati who was upon his great elephant, joined battle.

sanskrit_iast:
parasparaṃ ca virathau saṃchinnadhanuṣau tadā ..
khaḍgahastau mahīṃ prāpya cakratū raṇamulbaṇam ..
anyonyena vadhaṃ kṛtvā svargalokamupāgatau .. 98 ..
meaning:
परस्परं च विरथौ संछिन्नधनुषौ तदा ..
खड्गहस्तौ महीं प्राप्य चक्रतू रणमुल्बणम् ..
अन्योन्येन वधं कृत्वा स्वर्गलोकमुपागतौ .. 98 ..
text_mt: Deprived of their chariots and their bows cut to pieces, / they reached the ground, took swords in hand, and fought a fierce combat. / Having slain each other, both went to the heavenly realm.

sanskrit_iast:
indulastaṃ tu cāmuṃḍaṃ devo vai dhuṃdhukaṃ tathā ..
kṛṣṇāṃśo bhagadattaṃ ca jitvā rājānamāyayuḥ .. 99 ..
meaning:
इन्दुलस्तं तु चामुंडं देवो वै धुंधुकं तथा ..
कृष्णांशो भगदत्तं च जित्वा राजानमाययुः .. 99 ..
text_mt: Indula, having conquered Cāmuṇḍa, Deva having conquered Dhuṃdhuka, / and Kṛṣṇāṃśa having conquered Bhagadatta, returned to the king.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣaiḥ paṃcaśataiḥ śūraistaiḥ sārddhaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ prati ..
parājitāśca te sarve sahasraiḥ sahitā yayuḥ .. 3.3.32.100..
meaning:
शेषैः पंचशतैः शूरैस्तैः सार्द्धं लक्षणं प्रति ..
पराजिताश्च ते सर्वे सहस्रैः सहिता ययुः .. 3.3.32.100..
text_mt: Together with the remaining five hundred warriors they went towards Lakṣaṇa; / and having all been defeated, they retreated together with thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
prātaḥkāle tu saṃprāpte mahīrājo mahābalaḥ ..
māyāvarmāṇamāhūya vacanaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ .. 101 ..
meaning:
प्रातःकाले तु संप्राप्ते महीराजो महाबलः ..
मायावर्माणमाहूय वचनं प्राह निर्भयः .. 101 ..
text_mt: When morning arrived, the mighty Mahīrāja, / having summoned Māyāvarmā, spoke fearless words:

sanskrit_iast:
bhavāndaśasutairvīrairlakṣasainyaiśca saṃyutaḥ ..
sarvaśatruvināśāya gaṃtumarhati sattama ..
iti śrutvā sa nṛpatirvādyānsaṃvādya cāyayau .. 102 ..
meaning:
भवान्दशसुतैर्वीरैर्लक्षसैन्यैश्च संयुतः ..
सर्वशत्रुविनाशाय गंतुमर्हति सत्तम ..
इति श्रुत्वा स नृपतिर्वाद्यान्संवाद्य चाययौ .. 102 ..
text_mt: "Endowed with ten heroic sons and a hundred thousand troops, / you ought to go forth for the destruction of all enemies, O best of men." / Having heard this, that king sounded his musical instruments and advanced.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā parimalo bhūpo māyāvarmāṇamāgatam ..
jagannāyakamāhūya vacanaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ .. 103 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा परिमलो भूपो मायावर्माणमागतम् ..
जगन्नायकमाहूय वचनं प्राह निर्भयः .. 103 ..
text_mt: Seeing that Māyāvarmā had arrived, King Parimala, / having summoned Jagannāyaka, spoke fearless words:

sanskrit_iast:
bhavāndaśasahasraiśca sārddhaṃ taistribhiranvitaḥ ..
gantumarhati yuddhāya śīghraṃ madvijayaṃ kuru .. 104 ..
meaning:
भवान्दशसहस्रैश्च सार्द्धं तैस्त्रिभिरन्वितः ..
गन्तुमर्हति युद्धाय शीघ्रं मद्विजयं कुरु .. 104 ..
text_mt: "Accompanied by ten thousand troops and joined by those three, / you ought to go to battle; bring me swift victory."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā yayau śīghraṃ senayorubhayormahat ..
yuddhaṃ cāsīnmuniśreṣṭha yāmamātraṃ bhayānakam .. 105 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा ययौ शीघ्रं सेनयोरुभयोर्महत् ..
युद्धं चासीन्मुनिश्रेष्ठ याममात्रं भयानकम् .. 105 ..
text_mt: Having heard this, he quickly set out; between both armies, O best of sages, / a great and terrifying battle took place lasting merely a watch.

sanskrit_iast:
hatāste daśasāhasrā kṛṣṇāṃśādyaiḥ surakṣitāḥ .. śaṃ
khāndadhmuśca te sarve cāṃgadeśanivāsinaḥ .. 106 ..
meaning:
हतास्ते दशसाहस्रा कृष्णांशाद्यैः सुरक्षिताः .. शं
खान्दध्मुश्च ते सर्वे चांगदेशनिवासिनः .. 106 ..
text_mt: Protected by Kṛṣṇāṃśa and the others, those ten thousand were slain; / and all those inhabitants of the Aṅga country blew their conches.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare dhīrāḥ kṛṣṇāṃśādyāsturīyakāḥ ..
yāmamātreṇa saṃjaghnurlakṣasainyaṃ ripostadā .. 107 ..
aparāhṇe mahārājo māyāvarmā sutaiḥ saha..
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ devasiṃhaṃ ca saṃprāpto jaganāyakam ..1 08..
athāṅgabhūpaṃ daśaputrayuktaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśa evāśu jagāma śīghram ..
hayasthito vīravaraḥ pramāthī kalaikajāto madhusūdanasya ..1 09..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे धीराः कृष्णांशाद्यास्तुरीयकाः ..
याममात्रेण संजघ्नुर्लक्षसैन्यं रिपोस्तदा .. 107 ..
अपराह्णे महाराजो मायावर्मा सुतैः सह..
कृष्णांशं देवसिंहं च संप्राप्तो जगनायकम् ..1 08..
अथाङ्गभूपं दशपुत्रयुक्तं कृष्णांश एवाशु जगाम शीघ्रम् ..
हयस्थितो वीरवरः प्रमाथी कलैकजातो मधुसूदनस्य ..1 09..
text_mt:
In the meantime, the steadfast ones, Kṛṣṇāṃśa and the rest of the fourth rank, / then slaughtered a hundred thousand of the enemy’s troops within just one watch.
In the afternoon, the great king Māyāvarmā, accompanied by his sons, / came up against Kṛṣṇāṃśa, Devasiṃha, and Jaganāyaka.
Then Kṛṣṇāṃśa, mounted on his horse, swiftly advanced against the king of Aṅga, who was accompanied by his ten sons— / [Kṛṣṇāṃśa] the foremost hero, the crusher of foes, born of a single part of Madhusūdana.

sanskrit_iast:
tatoṃgabhūpastribhireva bāṇairatāḍayanmūrdhni ca pārśvayorvai ..
amarṣa māṇo balavānmahīpatirdaṃḍairhataḥ kāla ivāśu sarpaḥ.. .. 3.3.32.110 ..
meaning:
ततोंगभूपस्त्रिभिरेव बाणैरताडयन्मूर्ध्नि च पार्श्वयोर्वै ..
अमर्ष माणो बलवान्महीपतिर्दंडैर्हतः काल इवाशु सर्पः.. .. 3.3.32.110 ..
text_mt: Then the king of Aṅga struck him with just three arrows upon the head and on both flanks; / the powerful lord of the earth, unable to endure [it], was struck like the black serpent of Death by rods.

sanskrit_iast:
hayaṃ samuḍḍīya su puṣkarāntaṃ tatobhyagāttaṃ nṛpatiṃ rathastham ..
hayasya pātairvirathī cakāra sa eva bhūpo'simupādadhānaḥ .. 111 ..
meaning:
हयं समुड्डीय सु पुष्करान्तं ततोभ्यगात्तं नृपतिं रथस्थम् ..
हयस्य पातैर्विरथी चकार स एव भूपोऽसिमुपादधानः .. 111 ..
text_mt: Making his horse leap up to the tip of his lotus [bow], he then charged that king stationed in his chariot; / by the leaps of his horse he deprived him of his chariot, and that very king drew his sword.

sanskrit_iast:
svenāsinā biṃdulamaṃgaśalyaṃ kṛtvā sa kṛṣṇāṃśamuvāca vākyam ..
kallolamāyāttava nāśanāya tvayā jitā bhūpatayaḥ pradhānāḥ ..1 12..
meaning:
स्वेनासिना बिंदुलमंगशल्यं कृत्वा स कृष्णांशमुवाच वाक्यम् ..
कल्लोलमायात्तव नाशनाय त्वया जिता भूपतयः प्रधानाः ..1 12..
text_mt: Having wounded Bindula with his sword, the thorn in the side of Aṅga spoke these words to Kṛṣṇāṃśa: / "The principal kings were conquered by you through the illusion of waves to bring about your destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
tadaiva kīrtirbhavitā mamāśu hatvā bhavaṃtaṃ ca sukhī bhavāmi ..
ityuktavantaṃ nṛpatiṃ mahāntaṃ svenāsinā tasya śiro jahāra .. 113 ..
meaning:
तदैव कीर्तिर्भविता ममाशु हत्वा भवंतं च सुखी भवामि ..
इत्युक्तवन्तं नृपतिं महान्तं स्वेनासिना तस्य शिरो जहार .. 113 ..
text_mt: Only then will my fame be instantly achieved, and having slain you, I shall be happy." / When the great king had spoken thus, [Kṛṣṇāṃśa] severed his head with his sword.

sanskrit_iast:
hate'ṅgabhūpe daśa tasya putrāstameva jagmuryudhi kauravāṃśāḥ ..
tānāgatāniṃdula eva paṃca jaghāna bāṇaistu tadā samanyuḥ .. 114..
meaning:
हतेऽङ्गभूपे दश तस्य पुत्रास्तमेव जग्मुर्युधि कौरवांशाः ..
तानागतानिंदुल एव पंच जघान बाणैस्तु तदा समन्युः .. 114..
text_mt: When the king of Aṅga was slain, his ten sons, portions of the Kauravas, advanced against him in battle; / Indula himself, filled with wrath, then struck down five of them as they approached with his arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
ubhau ca devastu jaghāna tatra bhallena siddhena nṛpātmajau ca..
jyeṣṭhaṃ sutaṃ gautama eva hatvā dvau yau sa kṛṣṇāṃśa upājaghāna..115..
meaning:
उभौ च देवस्तु जघान तत्र भल्लेन सिद्धेन नृपात्मजौ च..
ज्येष्ठं सुतं गौतम एव हत्वा द्वौ यौ स कृष्णांश उपाजघान..115..
text_mt: And the lord there slew two sons of the king with a perfected broad-headed arrow; / Gautama slew the eldest son, and Kṛṣṇāṃśa struck down the two who [remained].

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkhānpradadhmū rucirānanāste pradoṣakāle śibirāṇi jagmuḥ..
śramānvitāste suṣupurniśāyāṃ prātaḥ samutthāya svakarma kṛtvā..116..
meaning:
शंखान्प्रदध्मू रुचिराननास्ते प्रदोषकाले शिबिराणि जग्मुः..
श्रमान्वितास्ते सुषुपुर्निशायां प्रातः समुत्थाय स्वकर्म कृत्वा..116..
text_mt: Those [heroes] with radiant faces blew their conches, and at dusk they returned to their encampments; / overcome with weariness, they slept through the night, and rising in the morning, they performed their regular duties.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā sabhāyāṃ nṛpatiṃ praṇamya vākyaṃ samūcuḥ śṛṇu caṃdravaṃśin..
adyaiva senāpatirasti ko vai cājñāpayāsmānnṛpa tasya guptyai..117..
meaning:
गत्वा सभायां नृपतिं प्रणम्य वाक्यं समूचुः शृणु चंद्रवंशिन्..
अद्यैव सेनापतिरस्ति को वै चाज्ञापयास्मान्नृप तस्य गुप्त्यै..117..
text_mt: Going to the assembly hall and bowing to the king, they spoke these words: "Listen, O descendant of the Lunar dynasty! / Who indeed is the commander of the army today? Command us, O king, for his protection."

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvāha bhūpodya tu vīrasenaḥ sakāmasenaḥ svabalaiḥ sametaḥ..
raṇaṃ kariṣyatyacireṇa vīrāstasmātsurakṣadhvamaribhya eva.. 118
meaning:
श्रुत्वाह भूपोद्य तु वीरसेनः सकामसेनः स्वबलैः समेतः..
रणं करिष्यत्यचिरेण वीरास्तस्मात्सुरक्षध्वमरिभ्य एव.. 118
text_mt: Hearing this, the king said: "Today Vīrasena, accompanied by Kāmasena and his own forces, / will shortly do battle, O heroes; therefore protect him well from the enemies."

sanskrit_iast:
sa vīraseno nṛpatiṃ praṇamya lakṣaiḥ svasainyairyudhi saṃjagāma..
tadā mahīrājanṛpaḥ pratāpī sa nāgavarmāṇamuvāca tāpī .. 119 ..
meaning:
स वीरसेनो नृपतिं प्रणम्य लक्षैः स्वसैन्यैर्युधि संजगाम..
तदा महीराजनृपः प्रतापी स नागवर्माणमुवाच तापी .. 119 ..
text_mt: That Vīrasena, having bowed to the king, set out for battle with hundred-thousands of his own troops; / then the glorious, tormenting king Mahīrāja said to Nāgavarmā:

sanskrit_iast:
raṇāya gacchāśu sutaiḥ sameto lakṣaiḥ svasainyairuta bhūpavarya ..
hatvā ripuṃ ghoratamaṃ hi vīraṃ patiṃ mahāntaṃ yudhi vīrasenam .. 3.3.32.120 ..
meaning:
रणाय गच्छाशु सुतैः समेतो लक्षैः स्वसैन्यैरुत भूपवर्य ..
हत्वा रिपुं घोरतमं हि वीरं पतिं महान्तं युधि वीरसेनम् .. 3.3.32.120 ..
text_mt: "Go swiftly into battle accompanied by your sons, along with hundred-thousands of your own troops, O best of kings, / to slay in battle that most dreadful hero, the mighty commander, the enemy Vīrasena."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktavaṃtaṃ nṛpatiṃ praṇamya suvādayāmāsa tadā hi vīraḥ ..
tayorbabhūvāśu raṇo mahānvai susenayoḥ saṃkulayuddhakartroḥ .. 121 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तवंतं नृपतिं प्रणम्य सुवादयामास तदा हि वीरः ..
तयोर्बभूवाशु रणो महान्वै सुसेनयोः संकुलयुद्धकर्त्रोः .. 121 ..
text_mt: Bowing to the king who had spoken thus, the hero then caused [the war drums] to be sounded; / between the two excellent armies, engaged in tumultuous combat, a great battle immediately arose.

sanskrit_iast:
triyāmamātreṇa hatāśca sarve vimānamāruhya yayuśca nākam ..
hateṣu sarveṣu ca nāgavarmā suteṣu vai yādavabhūpamāha .. 122 ..
meaning:
त्रियाममात्रेण हताश्च सर्वे विमानमारुह्य ययुश्च नाकम् ..
हतेषु सर्वेषु च नागवर्मा सुतेषु वै यादवभूपमाह .. 122 ..
text_mt: Within just three watches, all were slain, and mounting celestial chariots, they went to heaven; / and when all his sons had been killed, Nāgavarmā spoke to the Yādava king:

sanskrit_iast:
bhavānvisainyaśca tathaiva cāhaṃ bhavānsaputraśca tathāhameva ..
saṃsmṛtya dharmaṃ kuru yuddhamāśu tato rathasthaḥ sudhanurgṛhītvā .. 123 ..
meaning:
भवान्विसैन्यश्च तथैव चाहं भवान्सपुत्रश्च तथाहमेव ..
संस्मृत्य धर्मं कुरु युद्धमाशु ततो रथस्थः सुधनुर्गृहीत्वा .. 123 ..
text_mt: "You are without an army, and so am I; you are with your son, and so am I; / recollecting righteousness, fight swiftly!" Then, standing in his chariot and taking up his fine bow,

sanskrit_iast:
bāṇaiśca bāṇānbhuvi tau ca chittvā babhūvastustau virathau nṛpāgryau ..
khaḍgena khaḍgaṃ ca tathaiva chittvā vimānamāruhya gatau hi nākam .. 124 ..
meaning:
बाणैश्च बाणान्भुवि तौ च छित्त्वा बभूवस्तुस्तौ विरथौ नृपाग्र्यौ ..
खड्गेन खड्गं च तथैव छित्त्वा विमानमारुह्य गतौ हि नाकम् .. 124 ..
text_mt: the two foremost kings cut down each other’s arrows on the earth with arrows, and both were deprived of their chariots; / then, having similarly shattered sword with sword, they mounted celestial chariots and went to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kāmasenaḥ svaripośca putrāñjaghāna bāṇaiśca tadāṣṭasaṃkhyān ..
jyeṣṭhau tadā kopasamanvitau taṃ gṛhītakhaḍgau ca samīyatuśca .. 125 ..
meaning:
स कामसेनः स्वरिपोश्च पुत्राञ्जघान बाणैश्च तदाष्टसंख्यान् ..
ज्येष्ठौ तदा कोपसमन्वितौ तं गृहीतखड्गौ च समीयतुश्च .. 125 ..
text_mt: That Kāmasena then slew eight of his enemy's sons with his arrows; / then the two eldest, filled with rage, took up their swords and rushed at him.

sanskrit_iast:
ripoḥ śiro jahraturugravegī sa kāmasenaśca kabaṃdha eva ..
hatvā ripū tau ca tadā militvā svargaṃ yayuste ca vimānarūḍhāḥ .. 126 ..
meaning:
रिपोः शिरो जह्रतुरुग्रवेगी स कामसेनश्च कबंध एव ..
हत्वा रिपू तौ च तदा मिलित्वा स्वर्गं ययुस्ते च विमानरूढाः .. 126 ..
text_mt: Moving with fierce speed, they severed their enemy’s head; and that Kāmasena, even as a headless torso, / having slain those two enemies, then joined them, and mounted on celestial chariots, they went to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
hateṣu sarveṣu tadā trayaste cāmuṃḍakādyā jaganāyakaṃ te ..
ruddhā sametāḥ svaśaraiḥ kaṭhorairjaghnustamaśvaṃ harināgaraṃ ca .. 127 ..
meaning:
हतेषु सर्वेषु तदा त्रयस्ते चामुंडकाद्या जगनायकं ते ..
रुद्धा समेताः स्वशरैः कठोरैर्जघ्नुस्तमश्वं हरिनागरं च .. 127 ..
text_mt: When all were slain, those three, Cāmuṇḍaka and the others, surrounded Jaganāyaka; / coming together, they struck him and his horse Harināgara with their harsh arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
sa divyavājī ca tadā svapakṣau prasāryya khenāśu ripuṃ jagāma ..
sa puṃdhukārasya gajaṃ vihatya cāmuṃḍakasyaiva gajaṃ vimardya ..128 ..
meaning:
स दिव्यवाजी च तदा स्वपक्षौ प्रसार्य्य खेनाशु रिपुं जगाम ..
स पुंधुकारस्य गजं विहत्य चामुंडकस्यैव गजं विमर्द्य ..128 ..
text_mt: That divine steed then spread its two wings and quickly flew through the sky toward the enemy; / slaying the elephant of Pundhukāra, and crushing the elephant of Cāmuṇḍaka,

sanskrit_iast:
rathaṃ ca bhūmau bhagadattakasya vicūrṇya śīghraṃ ca nabho jagāma ..
pravādya śaṃkhaṃ jaganāyakaśca kṛṣṇāṃśamāgamya kathāṃ cakāra ..129..
meaning:
रथं च भूमौ भगदत्तकस्य विचूर्ण्य शीघ्रं च नभो जगाम ..
प्रवाद्य शंखं जगनायकश्च कृष्णांशमागम्य कथां चकार ..129..
text_mt: and swiftly smashing the chariot of Bhagadattaka to dust upon the earth, it flew into the sky; / and blowing his conch, Jaganāyaka approached Kṛṣṇāṃśa and told the tale.

sanskrit_iast:
niśāmuṣitvā jaganāyakādyāḥ prātaḥ samutthāya raṇaṃ prajagmuḥ ..
tadā mahīrāja utāśukā rī sa kinnareśaṃ kaṇakaṃ saputram ..3.3.32.130..
meaning:
निशामुषित्वा जगनायकाद्याः प्रातः समुत्थाय रणं प्रजग्मुः ..
तदा महीराज उताशुका री स किन्नरेशं कणकं सपुत्रम् ..3.3.32.130..
text_mt: Having spent the night, Jaganāyaka and the others rose in the morning and set out for battle; / then Mahīrāja, the swift-acting king, [spoke] to the lord of the kinnaras, Kaṇaka, along with his sons.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca rājañchṛṇu kinnarāṇāṃ mahābalāste ripavo mamaite ..
vināśayāśu prabalārighātāndevairna sārddhaṃ yudhi vai manuṣyāḥ .. 131 ..
meaning:
उवाच राजञ्छृणु किन्नराणां महाबलास्ते रिपवो ममैते ..
विनाशयाशु प्रबलारिघातान्देवैर्न सार्द्धं युधि वै मनुष्याः .. 131 ..
text_mt: He said: "O king of the kinnaras, listen! These enemies of mine are of great strength; / swiftly destroy those slayers of powerful foes; humans do not [usually] fight with deities in battle."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktavānmaṃkaṇabhūpatistu yayau saputro'yutasainyapaśca ..
tamāgataṃ tatra vilokya rājā vīrānsvakīyāṃśca samādideśa ..132..
meaning:
इत्युक्तवान्मंकणभूपतिस्तु ययौ सपुत्रोऽयुतसैन्यपश्च ..
तमागतं तत्र विलोक्य राजा वीरान्स्वकीयांश्च समादिदेश ..132..
text_mt: Having been spoken to thus, King Maṅkaṇa, commander of ten thousand troops, set out with his sons; / seeing him arrived there, the king ordered his own heroes.

sanskrit_iast:
manorathastho jaganāyakaśca sa tālano vai vaḍavāṃ vigṛhya ..
karālasaṃsthaśca tadā jayanto vigṛhya cāpaṃ tarasā jagāma..133..
meaning:
मनोरथस्थो जगनायकश्च स तालनो वै वडवां विगृह्य ..
करालसंस्थश्च तदा जयन्तो विगृह्य चापं तरसा जगाम..133..
text_mt: Jaganāyaka, mounted on Manoratha, and Tālana, taking up a mare, / and then Jayanta, seated on Karāla and grasping his bow, set forth with speed.

sanskrit_iast:
papīhakasthaśca sa rūpaṇo vai jagāma kṛṣṇāṃśasamanvitaśca ..
sa lallasiṃho gajamattasaṃsthaḥ sa dhānyapālo hayamāruroha .. 134 ..
meaning:
पपीहकस्थश्च स रूपणो वै जगाम कृष्णांशसमन्वितश्च ..
स लल्लसिंहो गजमत्तसंस्थः स धान्यपालो हयमारुरोह .. 134 ..
text_mt: Rūpaṇa, mounted on Papīhaka, went forth accompanied by Kṛṣṇāṃśa; / Lallasiṃha was mounted on a furious elephant, and Dhānyapāla mounted a horse.

sanskrit_iast:
samaṃtataḥ kinnarasainyaghoraṃ vināśayāmāsurupāṃśukhaḍgaiḥ..
vinaśyamāne trisahasrasainye sa kinnareśastarasā jagāma ..135..
meaning:
समंततः किन्नरसैन्यघोरं विनाशयामासुरुपांशुखड्गैः..
विनश्यमाने त्रिसहस्रसैन्ये स किन्नरेशस्तरसा जगाम ..135..
text_mt: On all sides they destroyed the dreadful army of the kinnaras with silent swords; / as his three-thousand-strong army was being destroyed, the lord of the kinnaras rushed forward with speed.

sanskrit_iast: dhyātvā kuberaṃ ca gṛhītacāpo nabhogatastatra babhūva sūkṣmaḥ..136..
meaning: ध्यात्वा कुबेरं च गृहीतचापो नभोगतस्तत्र बभूव सूक्ष्मः..136..
text_mt: Meditating on Kubera and taking up his bow, he flew into the sky and became subtle there.

sanskrit_iast:
adṛśyamānaḥ svaśaraiḥ kaṭhorairvinardya sarvānhi nanarda ghoram ..
vilapyamāne ca samastaśūre jayanta evāśu jagāma śatruma .. 137 ..
meaning:
अदृश्यमानः स्वशरैः कठोरैर्विनर्द्य सर्वान्हि ननर्द घोरम् ..
विलप्यमाने च समस्तशूरे जयन्त एवाशु जगाम शत्रुम .. 137 ..
text_mt: Remaining invisible, crushing everyone with his harsh arrows, he roared terribly; / and as all the warriors were lamenting, Jayanta swiftly went after the enemy.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvā maheṃdraṃ kaṇakaṃ ca baddhvā kṛṣṇāṃśamāgamya padau nanāma ..
tadā tu te śatrusahasrasainye niśamya baddhaṃ kaṇakaṃ nijeṃdram .. 138 ..
meaning:
ध्यात्वा महेंद्रं कणकं च बद्ध्वा कृष्णांशमागम्य पदौ ननाम ..
तदा तु ते शत्रुसहस्रसैन्ये निशम्य बद्धं कणकं निजेंद्रम् .. 138 ..
text_mt: Meditating on Mahendra, he bound Kaṇaka, approached Kṛṣṇāṃśa, and bowed at his feet; / then the enemy’s thousand-strong army, hearing that their own lord Kaṇaka was bound,

sanskrit_iast:
vinargha ghoraṃ rurudhuśca sarvānmāyā vino guhyakamastramūhuḥ ..
dineṣu sapteṣu tathā niśāsu babhūva yuddhaṃ ca samaṃtatastaiḥ .. 139 ..
meaning:
विनर्घ घोरं रुरुधुश्च सर्वान्माया विनो गुह्यकमस्त्रमूहुः ..
दिनेषु सप्तेषु तथा निशासु बभूव युद्धं च समंततस्तैः .. 139 ..
text_mt: roared dreadfully and held back all [the warriors]; skilled in illusion, they discharged the guhyaka missile; / for seven days and nights, battle raged with them on all sides.

sanskrit_iast:
śramānvitāḥ sapta mahāpravīrā hateṣu sarveṣu suṣupuśca vai yadā..
tadā kuberaṃ kaṇakaśca dhyātvā labdhvā varaṃ baṃdhanamāśu chittvā .. 3.3.32.140 ..
meaning:
श्रमान्विताः सप्त महाप्रवीरा हतेषु सर्वेषु सुषुपुश्च वै यदा..
तदा कुबेरं कणकश्च ध्यात्वा लब्ध्वा वरं बंधनमाशु छित्त्वा .. 3.3.32.140 ..
text_mt: When, exhausted with fatigue, the seven great warriors fell asleep after all [the foes] were slain, / then Kaṇaka, meditating on Kubera, obtained a boon and quickly severed his bonds.

sanskrit_iast:
suptānsamutthāya ca sapta śūrānniśīthakāle sa cakāra yuddham ..
jitvā ca tānṣaṭ sa varaprabhāvāttadeṃdulenaiva raṇaṃ cakāra .. 141 ..
meaning:
सुप्तान्समुत्थाय च सप्त शूरान्निशीथकाले स चकार युद्धम् ..
जित्वा च तान्षट् स वरप्रभावात्तदेंदुलेनैव रणं चकार .. 141 ..
text_mt: Rising up, he fought at midnight against the seven sleeping warriors. / Having conquered the six of them by the power of his boon, he then fought with Indula alone.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītakhaḍgau raṇaghoramattau hatvā tato vai bhuvi ceyatuśca ..
prajagmaturnākamupāntadevau saṃstūyamānau surasattamaiśca .. 142 ..
meaning:
गृहीतखड्गौ रणघोरमत्तौ हत्वा ततो वै भुवि चेयतुश्च ..
प्रजग्मतुर्नाकमुपान्तदेवौ संस्तूयमानौ सुरसत्तमैश्च .. 142 ..
text_mt: Taking their swords, furious and terrible in battle, having struck [each other], both fell to the earth. / Attended by the gods, praised by the foremost among the gods, they went to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabhāte vimale vijāte ruroda rāmāṃśa utālalāpa ..
pāpaiḥ kalāpaiḥ parīpīḍyamānaḥ kulānvitaḥ sarva yuto munīṃdra .. 143 ..
meaning:
ततः प्रभाते विमले विजाते रुरोद रामांश उताललाप ..
पापैः कलापैः परीपीड्यमानः कुलान्वितः सर्व युतो मुनींद्र .. 143 ..
text_mt: Then, when the bright dawn appeared, the portion of Rāma wept and lamented, / tormented by a multitude of wicked deeds, along with his family and accompanied by all, O prince of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
sa paṃcaśabdaṃ gajamāruroha trilakṣasainyaistarasā jagāma ..
tadā mahīrāja utāha śṛṇvangacchadhvamadyaiva mayā sametāḥ .. .. 144 ..
meaning:
स पंचशब्दं गजमारुरोह त्रिलक्षसैन्यैस्तरसा जगाम ..
तदा महीराज उताह शृण्वन्गच्छध्वमद्यैव मया समेताः .. .. 144 ..
text_mt: He mounted the elephant Pañcaśabda and swiftly set out with an army of three hundred thousand. / Then king Mahīrāja, listening, said: 'March forth this very day, accompanied by me!'

sanskrit_iast:
svapaṃcalakṣaiḥ prabalaiśca śūraiḥ sārddhaṃ rurodhāśu ripośca senām ..
tayorbabhūvāśu raṇaḥ praghoro vinardatoryudanimittamāśu .. 145 ..
meaning:
स्वपंचलक्षैः प्रबलैश्च शूरैः सार्द्धं रुरोधाशु रिपोश्च सेनाम् ..
तयोर्बभूवाशु रणः प्रघोरो विनर्दतोर्युदनिमित्तमाशु .. 145 ..
text_mt: Together with his five hundred thousand mighty warriors, he swiftly blocked the enemy's army. / A very terrible battle quickly took place between the two, who were roaring for the sake of war.

sanskrit_iast:
triyāma mātreṇa hatāśca sarve dvayośca pakṣā balaśālinaśca ..
tadā mahīrāja utāyayau vai samaṃḍalīkaśca dhanurvigṛhya .. 146 ..
meaning:
त्रियाम मात्रेण हताश्च सर्वे द्वयोश्च पक्षा बलशालिनश्च ..
तदा महीराज उताययौ वै समंडलीकश्च धनुर्विगृह्य .. 146 ..
text_mt: In the span of just three watches, all the mighty warriors of both sides were slain. / Then king Mahīrāja advanced with his vassals, grasping his bow.

sanskrit_iast:
sa dhuṃdhukāraśca tadājagāma ratha sthitaṃ lakṣaṇamugravīram ..
tadodayo vai bhagadattameva cāmuṃḍakaṃ bhīṣmakarājasūnuḥ .. 147 ..
meaning:
स धुंधुकारश्च तदाजगाम रथ स्थितं लक्षणमुग्रवीरम् ..
तदोदयो वै भगदत्तमेव चामुंडकं भीष्मकराजसूनुः .. 147 ..
text_mt: Then Dhundhukāra advanced against the fierce hero Lakṣaṇa who stood on his chariot. / Then Udaya [advanced] against Bhagadatta, and the son of king Bhīṣmaka against Cāmuṇḍaka.

sanskrit_iast:
sa paṃcaśabdaṃ gajamāsthito vai gataḥ sa evāśu jagāma bhūpam ..
dhanurvigṛhyāśugamulbaṇaṃ ca nṛpasthitaścātha bhayaṃkaraṃ ca .. 148 ..
meaning:
स पंचशब्दं गजमास्थितो वै गतः स एवाशु जगाम भूपम् ..
धनुर्विगृह्याशुगमुल्बणं च नृपस्थितश्चाथ भयंकरं च .. 148 ..
text_mt: Mounted upon the elephant Pañcaśabda, he quickly marched against the king, / taking up his formidable bow and swift arrows, standing terrifyingly before the king.

sanskrit_iast:
gajaṃ pramattaṃ śivadattamugramāhlādahantāramuvāca vākyam ..
aye pramattāgragajeṃdra śūra jayaṃ ca me dehi śivapradatta .. 149 ..
meaning:
गजं प्रमत्तं शिवदत्तमुग्रमाह्लादहन्तारमुवाच वाक्यम् ..
अये प्रमत्ताग्रगजेंद्र शूर जयं च मे देहि शिवप्रदत्त .. 149 ..
text_mt: He spoke these words to the rutting elephant Śivadatta, fierce slayer of Āhlāda: / 'O foremost of rutting lordly elephants, O hero granted by Śiva, grant me victory!

sanskrit_iast:
sa maṃḍalīko raṇadurmadaśca rāmāṃśa āhlāda iti prasiddhaḥ..
tasmācca māṃ rakṣa javena hastinmahābalātkāla rasācca vīrāt .. 3.3.32.150 ..
meaning:
स मंडलीको रणदुर्मदश्च रामांश आह्लाद इति प्रसिद्धः..
तस्माच्च मां रक्ष जवेन हस्तिन्महाबलात्काल रसाच्च वीरात् .. 3.3.32.150 ..
text_mt: He is a sovereign lord, intoxicated with battle, a portion of Rāma known as Āhlāda. / Therefore, swiftly protect me, O elephant, from that mighty hero of death-like vigor!'

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamukto nṛpatiṃ sa hastī vacastamāhāśu śṛṇuṣva rājan..
yāvadahaṃ vai tanujīvadhārī tāvadbhavāñchatrubhayaṃkaraśca..151..
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्तो नृपतिं स हस्ती वचस्तमाहाशु शृणुष्व राजन्..
यावदहं वै तनुजीवधारी तावद्भवाञ्छत्रुभयंकरश्च..151..
text_mt: Addressed in this manner, that elephant spoke quickly to the king: 'Listen, O king! / As long as I maintain life in this body, so long shall you cause terror to your enemies.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktavaṃtaṃ ca gajaṃ pramattaṃ sa paṃcaśabdaśca tadā svadaṃtaiḥ ..
mukhaṃ caturbhiśca vidārya śatrornanarda ghoraṃ sa maheṃdradattaḥ .. 152 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तवंतं च गजं प्रमत्तं स पंचशब्दश्च तदा स्वदंतैः ..
मुखं चतुर्भिश्च विदार्य शत्रोर्ननर्द घोरं स महेंद्रदत्तः .. 152 ..
text_mt: To the rutting elephant who had spoken thus, Pañcaśabda then, with his own tusks— / tearing open the enemy's face with four [tusks]—roared terribly, that elephant given by Mahendra.

sanskrit_iast:
sa rudradattaśca gajaḥ pramatto ruṣānvadhāvattarasā gajeṃdram ..
ripuṃ svapadbhyāṃ ca cakhāna kuṃbhaiḥ svatuṃḍadaṃḍena tudaṃ prakurvan .. 153 ..
meaning:
स रुद्रदत्तश्च गजः प्रमत्तो रुषान्वधावत्तरसा गजेंद्रम् ..
रिपुं स्वपद्भ्यां च चखान कुंभैः स्वतुंडदंडेन तुदं प्रकुर्वन् .. 153 ..
text_mt: That rutting elephant given by Rudra quickly charged the lordly elephant in rage; / with his feet he dug into the enemy, striking his frontal globes with his trunk-club.

sanskrit_iast:
avāpa mūrchāṃ ca sa paṃcaśabdastadāśu bhūpaṃ prati maṃḍalīkaḥ ..
svatomareṇāṃgavraṇaṃ pradāya khaḍgena hatvā gajarājamugram ..
jagāma padbhyāṃ sa ripupramāthī yatra sthitaścendula ugradhanvā .. .. 154 ..
meaning:
अवाप मूर्छां च स पंचशब्दस्तदाशु भूपं प्रति मंडलीकः ..
स्वतोमरेणांगव्रणं प्रदाय खड्गेन हत्वा गजराजमुग्रम् ..
जगाम पद्भ्यां स रिपुप्रमाथी यत्र स्थितश्चेन्दुल उग्रधन्वा .. .. 154 ..
text_mt: Pañcaśabda then fell unconscious; quickly facing the king, the sovereign lord, / inflicting a wound on his body with his javelin and striking down the fierce lord of elephants with his sword, / that crusher of foes went on foot to where Indula of fierce bow stood.

sanskrit_iast:
utthāpya putraṃ ca vilapyamānāṃ patnīṃ svakīyāṃ prati cājagāma ..
tadā pramattau ca gajau samūrchāṃ tyaktvā punaścakratureva yuddham .. .. 155 ..
meaning:
उत्थाप्य पुत्रं च विलप्यमानां पत्नीं स्वकीयां प्रति चाजगाम ..
तदा प्रमत्तौ च गजौ समूर्छां त्यक्त्वा पुनश्चक्रतुरेव युद्धम् .. .. 155 ..
text_mt: Raising up his son, he went toward his lamenting wife. / Then the two rutting elephants, casting off their stupor, resumed fighting again.

sanskrit_iast:
sa lakṣaṇaḥ khaḍgavareṇa bāṇānripośca chittvā nijavaiṣṇavāstram ..
dadhāra cāpe ca sumaṃtrayitvā sadhuṃdhukāraṃ ca gajaṃ dadāha .. 156 ..
meaning:
स लक्षणः खड्गवरेण बाणान्रिपोश्च छित्त्वा निजवैष्णवास्त्रम् ..
दधार चापे च सुमंत्रयित्वा सधुंधुकारं च गजं ददाह .. 156 ..
text_mt: Lakṣaṇa, having severed the enemy's arrows with his excellent sword, fitted his Vaiṣṇava missile / upon his bow, reciting the proper mantra, and burnt Dhundhukāra along with his elephant.

sanskrit_iast:
hate ca tasminnijamukhyabaṃdhau sabhūmirājaśca gṛhītacāpaḥ ..
śareṇa raudreṇa ca lakṣaṇaṃ taṃ jaghāna tatrādibhayaṃkarasthaḥ .. 157 ..
meaning:
हते च तस्मिन्निजमुख्यबंधौ सभूमिराजश्च गृहीतचापः ..
शरेण रौद्रेण च लक्षणं तं जघान तत्रादिभयंकरस्थः .. 157 ..
text_mt: When that chief kinsman of his was slain, king Mahīrāja took up his bow; / standing formidable at the vanguard, he struck Lakṣaṇa there with a terrible arrow.

sanskrit_iast:
sa mūrchitaḥ śukla kuleṣu sūryastadodayo vai bhagadattameva ..
sumūrchayitvā ca jagāma śīghraṃ yatra sthito lakṣaṇa ekavīraḥ .. 158 ..
meaning:
स मूर्छितः शुक्ल कुलेषु सूर्यस्तदोदयो वै भगदत्तमेव ..
सुमूर्छयित्वा च जगाम शीघ्रं यत्र स्थितो लक्षण एकवीरः .. 158 ..
text_mt: He, the sun among the Śukla lineage, swooned. Then Udaya, having knocked / Bhagadatta into a deep faint, went quickly where the sole hero Lakṣaṇa stood.

sanskrit_iast:
bhayānvitastaṃ ca vilokya rājā javena dudrāva ca raktabījam ..
tadā sudevaṃ ca sa raktabījo jitvā tu kṛṣṇāṃśayutaṃ jagāma .. 159 ..
meaning:
भयान्वितस्तं च विलोक्य राजा जवेन दुद्राव च रक्तबीजम् ..
तदा सुदेवं च स रक्तबीजो जित्वा तु कृष्णांशयुतं जगाम .. 159 ..
text_mt: Seeing him, the king, terrified, quickly ran toward Raktabīja. / Then Raktabīja, having defeated Sudeva, went together with the portion of Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
bāṇena śīghraṃ sa ca mūrcchayitvā punaśca devaṃ ca sa mūrchayitvā ..
tadbaṃdhanāyodyata āśukārī sa lakṣaṇastatra tadā jagāma .. 3.3.32.160 ..
meaning:
बाणेन शीघ्रं स च मूर्च्छयित्वा पुनश्च देवं च स मूर्छयित्वा ..
तद्बंधनायोद्यत आशुकारी स लक्षणस्तत्र तदा जगाम .. 3.3.32.160 ..
text_mt: Quickly causing him to swoon with an arrow, and again causing Deva to swoon, / he prepared to bind him; then swift-acting Lakṣaṇa went there.

sanskrit_iast:
pradhāya cāpe ca sa vaiṣṇavāstraṃ pracodayāmāsa ca raktabīje ..
tadā sa sāmantasuto balīyānraṇaṃ vihāyāśu vilokya saṃdhyām ..
bhayānvitaḥ svaiśca yuto yayau vai yatra sthitā bhūpatayaḥ sakopāḥ .. 161 ..
meaning:
प्रधाय चापे च स वैष्णवास्त्रं प्रचोदयामास च रक्तबीजे ..
तदा स सामन्तसुतो बलीयान्रणं विहायाशु विलोक्य संध्याम् ..
भयान्वितः स्वैश्च युतो ययौ वै यत्र स्थिता भूपतयः सकोपाः .. 161 ..
text_mt: Placing the Vaiṣṇava missile on his bow, he hurled it at Raktabīja. / Then that mighty son of a feudatory, beholding the twilight, quickly abandoned the battle; / filled with fear, accompanied by his men, he went where the wrathful kings were stationed.

sanskrit_iast:
vilokya śatruṃ ca sa ratnabhānoḥ suto yayau vai śibirāṇi yuktaḥ ..
niśāmya bhūpaḥ sa ca caṃdravaṃśī jayaṃ svakīyaṃ suṣupustu te vai ..
prātaśca kāle sa ca caṃdravaṃśī vilokya śuklānvayamāha bhūpam..162..
meaning:
विलोक्य शत्रुं च स रत्नभानोः सुतो ययौ वै शिबिराणि युक्तः ..
निशाम्य भूपः स च चंद्रवंशी जयं स्वकीयं सुषुपुस्तु ते वै ..
प्रातश्च काले स च चंद्रवंशी विलोक्य शुक्लान्वयमाह भूपम्..162..
text_mt: Beholding the enemy, the son of Ratnabhānu went to the tents with his troops. / Having heard of their victory, that king of the Lunar dynasty and his men went to sleep. / In the morning, that scion of the Lunar race, beholding the king of the Śukla lineage, said:
