sanskrit_iast:
aye gurjaradeśīya mūlavarmansutaiḥ saha..
lakṣasainyānvito bhūtvā gantumarhatu vai bhavān.. 163..
meaning:
अये गुर्जरदेशीय मूलवर्मन्सुतैः सह..
लक्षसैन्यान्वितो भूत्वा गन्तुमर्हतु वै भवान्.. 163..
text_mt: 'O Mūlavarman of the Gurjara country, along with your sons, / accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, you ought to advance!'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktaḥ sa tu bhūpālo yuddhabhūmimupāyayau..
mahīrājājñayā prāpto nāmnā pūrṇāmalo balī.. 164..
meaning:
इत्युक्तः स तु भूपालो युद्धभूमिमुपाययौ..
महीराजाज्ञया प्राप्तो नाम्ना पूर्णामलो बली.. 164..
text_mt: Thus addressed, that king went to the battlefield; / by order of Mahīrāja, the mighty warrior named Pūrṇāmala arrived,

sanskrit_iast:
daśaputrānvito yuddhe sainya lakṣeṇa saṃyutḥ..
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ yāmadvayamupasthitam..165..
meaning:
दशपुत्रान्वितो युद्धे सैन्य लक्षेण संयुत्ः..
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धं यामद्वयमुपस्थितम्..165..
text_mt: accompanied by his ten sons in battle and joined by an army of one hundred thousand. / A great battle ensued between the two, which lasted for two watches.

sanskrit_iast:
hateṣu teṣu sarveṣu tau nṛpau sasutairbalau ..
anonyena raṇaṃ kṛtvā yamaloka mupāgatau .. 166 ..
meaning:
हतेषु तेषु सर्वेषु तौ नृपौ ससुतैर्बलौ ..
अनोन्येन रणं कृत्वा यमलोक मुपागतौ .. 166 ..
text_mt: When all those [soldiers] were slain, those two mighty kings, together with their sons, / having fought one another, departed to the realm of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ prabhāte vimale ravau ..
kaikayo lakṣasenāḍhyo dayāputrasamanvitaḥ ..
lakṣaṇānujñayā prāptastasminyudhi bhayānake .. 167 ..
meaning:
मार्गकृष्णचतुर्दश्यां प्रभाते विमले रवौ ..
कैकयो लक्षसेनाढ्यो दयापुत्रसमन्वितः ..
लक्षणानुज्ञया प्राप्तस्तस्मिन्युधि भयानके .. 167 ..
text_mt: On the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa, when the clear sun rose in the morning, / the Kaikaya king, endowed with an army of one hundred thousand and accompanied by the sons of Dayā, / arrived at that terrible battle by permission of Lakṣaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
madrakeśastadā rājā daśaputrasamanvitaḥ ..
lakṣasainyānvitastatra yatra yuddhaṃ samanvabhūt..
parasparaṃ hatāḥ sarve dinānte kṣatriyā raṇe .. 168 ..
meaning:
मद्रकेशस्तदा राजा दशपुत्रसमन्वितः ..
लक्षसैन्यान्वितस्तत्र यत्र युद्धं समन्वभूत्..
परस्परं हताः सर्वे दिनान्ते क्षत्रिया रणे .. 168 ..
text_mt: Then the king of the Madras, accompanied by his ten sons / and accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, [arrived] where the battle took place. / At the end of the day, all those kṣatriyas were slain by one another in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ prabhāte vimale bhagadatto mahābalī ..
trilakṣabalasaṃyukto jagarjja raṇamūrddhani.. 169..
meaning:
पुनः प्रभाते विमले भगदत्तो महाबली ..
त्रिलक्षबलसंयुक्तो जगर्ज्ज रणमूर्द्धनि.. 169..
text_mt: Again, at clear dawn, the mighty Bhagadatta, / joined by a force of three hundred thousand, roared at the head of the battle.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā taṃ lakṣaṇo vīrastrilakṣabalasaṃyutaḥ ..
cakāra tumulaṃ ghoraṃ senayā ca svakīyayā .. 3.3.32.170 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तं लक्षणो वीरस्त्रिलक्षबलसंयुतः ..
चकार तुमुलं घोरं सेनया च स्वकीयया .. 3.3.32.170 ..
text_mt: Seeing him, the hero Lakṣaṇa, accompanied by a force of three hundred thousand, / engaged in a fierce, tumultuous combat with his army.

sanskrit_iast:
aparāhṇe hatāḥ sarve sainikā nṛpayostadā ..
bhagadattaḥ svayaṃ kruddho rathastho lakṣaṇaṃ yayau .. 171 ..
meaning:
अपराह्णे हताः सर्वे सैनिका नृपयोस्तदा ..
भगदत्तः स्वयं क्रुद्धो रथस्थो लक्षणं ययौ .. 171 ..
text_mt: In the afternoon, all the soldiers of both kings were slain. / Bhagadatta himself, enraged, mounted his chariot and advanced against Lakṣaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇo rathamāruhya svapituḥ śatrujaṃ nṛpam ..
tribhirbāṇaiśca saṃtodya bhallena samatāḍayat .. .172 ..
meaning:
लक्षणो रथमारुह्य स्वपितुः शत्रुजं नृपम् ..
त्रिभिर्बाणैश्च संतोद्य भल्लेन समताडयत् .. .172 ..
text_mt: Mounting his chariot, Lakṣaṇa pierced the king born of his father's enemy / with three arrows and struck him with a broad-headed shaft.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagadattastadā kruddho virathaṃ taṃ cakāra ha ..
kruddhavaṃtaṃ ripuṃ ghoraṃ lakṣaṇaḥ khaṅgapāṇikaḥ ..
hatvā hayāṃstathā sūtaṃ bhagadattamupāyayau .. 173 ..
meaning:
भगदत्तस्तदा क्रुद्धो विरथं तं चकार ह ..
क्रुद्धवंतं रिपुं घोरं लक्षणः खङ्गपाणिकः ..
हत्वा हयांस्तथा सूतं भगदत्तमुपाययौ .. 173 ..
text_mt: Bhagadatta then, enraged, deprived him of his chariot. / Lakṣaṇa, sword in hand, slaying the horses and charioteer / of his terrible, wrathful enemy, advanced on Bhagadatta.

sanskrit_iast:
mardayitvā ca taccarma cchittvā varma tadudbhavam ..
tridhā cakāra balavānbhagadattaṃ ripossutam .. 174 ..
meaning:
मर्दयित्वा च तच्चर्म च्छित्त्वा वर्म तदुद्भवम् ..
त्रिधा चकार बलवान्भगदत्तं रिपोस्सुतम् .. 174 ..
text_mt:
And crushing his shield and cutting through his armour,
the mighty one cut Bhagadatta, the enemy's son, into three pieces.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyākāle hate tasmim̐llakṣaṇastvarayānvitaḥ ..
ekākī śiviraṃ prāpto hastinyupari saṃsthitaḥ .. 175 ..
meaning:
संध्याकाले हते तस्मिम्̐ल्लक्षणस्त्वरयान्वितः ..
एकाकी शिविरं प्राप्तो हस्तिन्युपरि संस्थितः .. 175 ..
text_mt:
When he was slain at twilight, Lakṣaṇa, filled with haste,
mounted upon an elephant, reached his camp alone.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagadatte hate tasminsa rājā krodhamūrchitaḥ ..
svakīyānsarvabhūpāṃśca cāmuṃḍena samanvitān ..
preṣayāmāsa yuddhāya mārge ca pratipaddine .. 176 ..
meaning:
भगदत्ते हते तस्मिन्स राजा क्रोधमूर्छितः ..
स्वकीयान्सर्वभूपांश्च चामुंडेन समन्वितान् ..
प्रेषयामास युद्धाय मार्गे च प्रतिपद्दिने .. 176 ..
text_mt:
When Bhagadatta was slain, that king, overcome with fury,
sent all his own kings, together with Cāmuṇḍa,
into battle on the road on the pratipad lunar day.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃgadaśca kaliṃgaśca trikoṇaḥ śrīpatistathā ..
śrītāraśca mukuṃdañca ruhilo guhilastathā .. 177 ..
meaning:
अंगदश्च कलिंगश्च त्रिकोणः श्रीपतिस्तथा ..
श्रीतारश्च मुकुंदञ्च रुहिलो गुहिलस्तथा .. 177 ..
text_mt:
Aṅgada and Kaliṅga, Trikoṇa and Śrīpati,
Śrītāra and Mukuṃda, Ruhila and Guhila,

sanskrit_iast:
suketurnava bhūpāste navāyutabalairyutāḥ ..
vādyāni vādayāmāsustasminyuddhamahotsave .. 178 ..
meaning:
सुकेतुर्नव भूपास्ते नवायुतबलैर्युताः ..
वाद्यानि वादयामासुस्तस्मिन्युद्धमहोत्सवे .. 178 ..
text_mt:
and Suketu: those nine kings, accompanied by forces of ninety thousand,
played musical instruments in that great festival of battle.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tām̐llakṣaṇo vīro rājabhiśca svakīyakaiḥ ..
sārddhaṃ jagāma yuddhāya tathā vyūhyāyudhadripūn .. 179 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा ताम्̐ल्लक्षणो वीरो राजभिश्च स्वकीयकैः ..
सार्द्धं जगाम युद्धाय तथा व्यूह्यायुधद्रिपून् .. 179 ..
text_mt:
Seeing them, the heroic Lakṣaṇa, together with his own kings,
arraying the enemy soldiers, advanced to battle.

sanskrit_iast:
rudravarmā ca nṛpatiḥ śūrairdaśasahasrakaiḥ ..
aṃgadaṃ vairiṇaṃ matvā tena sārddhamayudhyata .. 3.3.32.180 ..
meaning:
रुद्रवर्मा च नृपतिः शूरैर्दशसहस्रकैः ..
अंगदं वैरिणं मत्वा तेन सार्द्धमयुध्यत .. 3.3.32.180 ..
text_mt:
And King Rudravarmā, with ten thousand warriors,
regarding Aṅgada as his enemy, fought with him.

sanskrit_iast:
kālīvarmā'yutaissārdhaṃ kaliṃgaṃ pratyabudhyata ..
vīrasiṃho'yutaissārddhaṃ trikoṇaṃ pratyayudhyata .. 181 ..
meaning:
कालीवर्माऽयुतैस्सार्धं कलिंगं प्रत्यबुध्यत ..
वीरसिंहोऽयुतैस्सार्द्धं त्रिकोणं प्रत्ययुध्यत .. 181 ..
text_mt:
Kālīvarmā fought against Kaliṅga with ten thousand;
Vīrasiṃha fought against Trikoṇa with ten thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
tatonujaḥ pravīraśca śrīpatiṃ so'yutaissaha ..
nṛpaḥ sūryo dharo vīro'yutāḍhayo balavānraṇe ..
śrītāraṃ nṛpamāsādya mahadyuddhamacīkarat ..182..
meaning:
ततोनुजः प्रवीरश्च श्रीपतिं सोऽयुतैस्सह ..
नृपः सूर्यो धरो वीरोऽयुताढयो बलवान्रणे ..
श्रीतारं नृपमासाद्य महद्युद्धमचीकरत् ..182..
text_mt:
Then his younger brother, the mighty hero, along with ten thousand, [fought] Śrīpati.
King Sūryadhara, heroic and mighty, rich with ten thousand in battle,
approaching King Śrītāra, waged a great fight.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmanoyutasaṃyukto mukuṃdaṃ prati so'gamat ..
gaṃgāsiṃhaśca balavānmahilaṃ prati sāyutaḥ ..183..
meaning:
वामनोयुतसंयुक्तो मुकुंदं प्रति सोऽगमत् ..
गंगासिंहश्च बलवान्महिलं प्रति सायुतः ..183..
text_mt:
Vāmana, accompanied by ten thousand, advanced against Mukuṃda;
and the mighty Gaṅgāsiṃha, along with ten thousand, [advanced] against Mahila.

sanskrit_iast:
lallasiṃhoyutaissārddhaṃ guhilaṃ prati so'gamat ..
triśatāni tato bhūpāḥ sahasrāḍhyāḥ pṛthakpṛthak ..184..
meaning:
लल्लसिंहोयुतैस्सार्द्धं गुहिलं प्रति सोऽगमत् ..
त्रिशतानि ततो भूपाः सहस्राढ्याः पृथक्पृथक् ..184..
text_mt:
Lallasiṃha, together with ten thousand, advanced against Guhila.
Then three hundred kings, each rich with a thousand [men],

sanskrit_iast:
kṣudrabhūpāḥ kṣudrabhūpāṃstriśatāni samāyayuḥ ..
anyonyena hatāḥ sarve kṛtvā yuddhaṃ bhayānakam.. 185 ..
meaning:
क्षुद्रभूपाः क्षुद्रभूपांस्त्रिशतानि समाययुः ..
अन्योन्येन हताः सर्वे कृत्वा युद्धं भयानकम्.. 185 ..
text_mt:
three hundred petty kings came upon petty kings;
having fought a terrifying battle, they were all slain by one another.

sanskrit_iast:
cāmuṃḍastu tadā dṛṣṭvā mṛtakānsarvabhūpatīn ..
lakṣaṇāntamupāgamya mahadyuddhaṃ cakāra ha ..186.
meaning:
चामुंडस्तु तदा दृष्ट्वा मृतकान्सर्वभूपतीन् ..
लक्षणान्तमुपागम्य महद्युद्धं चकार ह ..186.
text_mt:
Then Cāmuṇḍa, seeing that all the kings were dead,
approached near Lakṣaṇa and waged a great battle.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇo raktabījaṃ taṃ jñātvā brāhmaṇasaṃmatam ..
vaiṣṇavāstraṃ tadā tasmai na dadau tena pīḍita..187..
meaning:
लक्षणो रक्तबीजं तं ज्ञात्वा ब्राह्मणसंमतम् ..
वैष्णवास्त्रं तदा तस्मै न ददौ तेन पीडित..187..
text_mt:
Lakṣaṇa, knowing him to be Raktabīja, approved by the brahmins,
though tormented by him, did not release the Vaiṣṇava missile against him then.

sanskrit_iast:
sāyaṃkāle tu saṃprāpte lakṣaṇo hastinīsthitaḥ ..
ekākī śiviraṃ prāptaścāmuṃḍaṃ nṛpamāyayau .. 188 ..
meaning:
सायंकाले तु संप्राप्ते लक्षणो हस्तिनीस्थितः ..
एकाकी शिविरं प्राप्तश्चामुंडं नृपमाययौ .. 188 ..
text_mt:
When evening arrived, Lakṣaṇa, seated upon a female elephant,
reached his camp alone; [and] Cāmuṇḍa came to the king.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyāyāṃ prabhāte ca kṛṣṇāṃśo devasaṃyutaḥ ..
śūrairdaśasahasraiśca yuddhabhūmimupāyayau .. 189 ..
meaning:
द्वितीयायां प्रभाते च कृष्णांशो देवसंयुतः ..
शूरैर्दशसहस्रैश्च युद्धभूमिमुपाययौ .. 189 ..
text_mt:
And at dawn on the dvitīyā, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, accompanied by Devasiṃha
and with ten thousand heroes, went to the battlefield.

sanskrit_iast:
tārakaśca sacāmuṃḍo dvilakṣabalasaṃyutaḥ ..
dviśataiśca tathā bhūpaiḥ sārddhaṃ yuddhamupasthitau..3.3.32.190..
meaning:
तारकश्च सचामुंडो द्विलक्षबलसंयुतः ..
द्विशतैश्च तथा भूपैः सार्द्धं युद्धमुपस्थितौ..3.3.32.190..
text_mt:
And Tāraka, along with Cāmuṇḍa, possessing a force of two hundred thousand
and with two hundred kings, stood ready for battle.

sanskrit_iast:
puraskṛtya ,nṛpānsarvānsasainyau balavattarau ..
teṣāmanu sthitau yuddhe tatra jāto mahāraṇaḥ .. 191 ..
meaning:
पुरस्कृत्य ,नृपान्सर्वान्ससैन्यौ बलवत्तरौ ..
तेषामनु स्थितौ युद्धे तत्र जातो महारणः .. 191 ..
text_mt:
Placing all the kings in front, those two very powerful warriors with their army
stood behind them in battle; there a great combat took place.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmamātreṇa tau vīrau hatvā sarvamahīpatīn ..
lakṣasainyāṃstathā hatvā saṃsthitau śramakarṣitau..192..
meaning:
याममात्रेण तौ वीरौ हत्वा सर्वमहीपतीन् ..
लक्षसैन्यांस्तथा हत्वा संस्थितौ श्रमकर्षितौ..192..
text_mt:
In merely a single watch, those two heroes, having slain all the kings
and having killed an army of a hundred thousand, stood exhausted by fatigue.

sanskrit_iast:
cāmuṃḍastārako dhūrtaḥ saṃprāptau chidradarśinau ..
tābhyāṃ śramānvitābhyāṃ ca cakratustau samaṃ raṇam..193..
meaning:
चामुंडस्तारको धूर्तः संप्राप्तौ छिद्रदर्शिनौ ..
ताभ्यां श्रमान्विताभ्यां च चक्रतुस्तौ समं रणम्..193..
text_mt:
The rogue Cāmuṇḍa and Tāraka, watching for a weakness, arrived;
the two fought an equal battle with those two who were afflicted by fatigue.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ triyāmamātreṇa saṃbabhūva mahānraṇaḥ ..
sāyaṃkāle tu saṃprāpte kṛṣṇāṃśaśca nirāyudhaḥ ..
talaprahāreṇa ripuṃ mūrcchayāmāsa vīryavān ..194..
meaning:
तेषां त्रियाममात्रेण संबभूव महान्रणः ..
सायंकाले तु संप्राप्ते कृष्णांशश्च निरायुधः ..
तलप्रहारेण रिपुं मूर्च्छयामास वीर्यवान् ..194..

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare vīrastārako devasiṃhakam ..
hayaṃ manorathaṃ hatvā śaṃkhaśabdamathākarot .. 195 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे वीरस्तारको देवसिंहकम् ..
हयं मनोरथं हत्वा शंखशब्दमथाकरोत् .. 195 ..
text_mt:
In the meantime, the heroic Tāraka, having slain Devasiṃhaka
and his horse Manoratha, blew his conch.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchabdātsa ca cāmuṃḍastyaktvā mūrchāṃ mahābalaḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśasya śiraḥ kāyādapahṛtya ca vegavān ..
tayorgṛhītvā śirasī mahīrājamupāyayau .. 196 ..
meaning:
तच्छब्दात्स च चामुंडस्त्यक्त्वा मूर्छां महाबलः ..
कृष्णांशस्य शिरः कायादपहृत्य च वेगवान् ..
तयोर्गृहीत्वा शिरसी महीराजमुपाययौ .. 196 ..
text_mt:
At that sound, the mighty Cāmuṇḍa recovered from his faint,
swiftly severed Kṛṣṇāṃśa's head from his body,
and taking both their heads, went to Mahīrāja.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājastu te dṛṣṭvā paramānaṃdanirbharaḥ ..
dattvā dānaṃ dvijātibhyo mahotsavamakārayat .. 197 ..
meaning:
महीराजस्तु ते दृष्ट्वा परमानंदनिर्भरः ..
दत्त्वा दानं द्विजातिभ्यो महोत्सवमकारयत् .. 197 ..
text_mt:
And Mahīrāja, seeing them, filled with supreme joy,
gave gifts to the twice-born and held a great festival.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇasya tadā sainye hāhāśabdo mahānabhūt ..
śrutvā kolāhalaṃ teṣāṃ jñātvā tau ca hatau nṛpaḥ ..
brahmānaṃdastadā mūrcchāṃ tyaktvā velāmuvāca ha .. 198 ..
meaning:
लक्षणस्य तदा सैन्ये हाहाशब्दो महानभूत् ..
श्रुत्वा कोलाहलं तेषां ज्ञात्वा तौ च हतौ नृपः ..
ब्रह्मानंदस्तदा मूर्च्छां त्यक्त्वा वेलामुवाच ह .. 198 ..

sanskrit_iast:
priye gaccha raṇaṃ śīghraṃ harināgaramāsthitā ..
mama veṣaṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā tārakaṃ jahi mā ciram .. 199 ..
meaning:
प्रिये गच्छ रणं शीघ्रं हरिनागरमास्थिता ..
मम वेषं शुभं कृत्वा तारकं जहि मा चिरम् .. 199 ..
text_mt:
“Beloved, go quickly to battle, riding the Harināgara horse;
assuming my auspicious guise, slay Tāraka without delay!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu sā velā rāmāṃśena samanvitā ..
sahasraśūrasahitā yuddhabhūmimupāyayau .. 3.3.32.200 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु सा वेला रामांशेन समन्विता ..
सहस्रशूरसहिता युद्धभूमिमुपाययौ .. 3.3.32.200 ..
text_mt:
Having heard this, Velā, accompanied by Rāmāṃśa
and with a thousand heroes, went to the battlefield.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā sa lakṣaṇo vīrastālanena samanvitaḥ ..
sainyaiśca daśasāhasrairmahīrājamupāyayau ..201..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा स लक्षणो वीरस्तालनेन समन्वितः ..
सैन्यैश्च दशसाहस्रैर्महीराजमुपाययौ ..201..
text_mt:
Hearing [this], the heroic Lakṣaṇa, accompanied by Tālana
and with armies of ten thousand, advanced against Mahīrāja.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyāyāṃ prabhāte ca tārako balavattaraḥ ..
brahmānaṃdaṃ ca taṃ matvā mahadyuddhamacī karat .. 202 ..
meaning:
तृतीयायां प्रभाते च तारको बलवत्तरः ..
ब्रह्मानंदं च तं मत्वा महद्युद्धमची करत् .. 202 ..
text_mt:
And at dawn on the tṛtīyā, the very mighty Tāraka,
thinking her to be Brahmānanda, waged a great battle.

sanskrit_iast:
raktabījaśca cāmuṃḍo rāmāṃśo balavattaraḥ ..
cakāra dāruṇaṃ yuddhaṃ tasminvīrasamāgame .. 203 ..
meaning:
रक्तबीजश्च चामुंडो रामांशो बलवत्तरः ..
चकार दारुणं युद्धं तस्मिन्वीरसमागमे .. 203 ..
text_mt:
And Cāmuṇḍa, who was Raktabīja, [and] the very powerful Rāmāṃśa
fought a dread battle in that clash of heroes.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmamātreṇa rāmāṃśo hatvā tasya mahāgajam ..
tacchastrāṇi tathā cchitvā mallayuddhamacīkarat .. 204 ..
meaning:
याममात्रेण रामांशो हत्वा तस्य महागजम् ..
तच्छस्त्राणि तथा च्छित्वा मल्लयुद्धमचीकरत् .. 204 ..
text_mt:
In merely a watch, Rāmāṃśa, having killed his great elephant
and destroyed his weapons, engaged in wrestling.

sanskrit_iast:
triyāmamātreṇa tadā sāyaṃkāle samāgate ..
mamaṃtha bhrātṛhantāraṃ sa ca vīro mamāra ha .. 205 ..
meaning:
त्रियाममात्रेण तदा सायंकाले समागते ..
ममंथ भ्रातृहन्तारं स च वीरो ममार ह .. 205 ..
text_mt:
In merely three watches, as evening then arrived,
he crushed the slayer of his brother, and that hero died.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā velā mahāśatruṃ tārakaṃ balavattaram ..
chittvāstrāṇi svakhaḍgena śiraḥ kāyādapāharat .. 206 ..
meaning:
तदा वेला महाशत्रुं तारकं बलवत्तरम् ..
छित्त्वास्त्राणि स्वखड्गेन शिरः कायादपाहरत् .. 206 ..
text_mt:
Then Velā, severing the weapons of the very mighty enemy Tāraka
with her sword, struck off his head from his body.

sanskrit_iast:
citāṃ kṛtvā vidhānena sā devī drupadātmajā ..
brahmānaṃdaṃ namaskṛtya taccitāyāṃ samāruhat .. 207 ..
meaning:
चितां कृत्वा विधानेन सा देवी द्रुपदात्मजा ..
ब्रह्मानंदं नमस्कृत्य तच्चितायां समारुहत् .. 207 ..
text_mt:
Having prepared the pyre according to rite, that goddess, the daughter of Drupada,
bowing to Brahmānanda, mounted his pyre.

sanskrit_iast:
tena sārddhaṃ ca sā śuddhā śvaśurasyājñayā mudā ..
saptajanmakathāṃ kṛtvā svapatestu dadāha vai .. 208 ..
meaning:
तेन सार्द्धं च सा शुद्धा श्वशुरस्याज्ञया मुदा ..
सप्तजन्मकथां कृत्वा स्वपतेस्तु ददाह वै .. 208 ..
text_mt:
And with him, that pure woman, by the order of her father-in-law, joyfully
recounting the story of seven births, burned herself with her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
taccitāyāṃ ca bhartāramiṃdulaṃ balavattaram ..
saṃsthāpya dāhayāmāsa tena sārddhaṃ kalevaram .. 209 ..
meaning:
तच्चितायां च भर्तारमिंदुलं बलवत्तरम् ..
संस्थाप्य दाहयामास तेन सार्द्धं कलेवरम् .. 209 ..
text_mt:
And placing her husband Indula, the very mighty one, upon that pyre,
she caused her body to be burned together with him.

sanskrit_iast:
rātrau parimalo rājā lakṣaṇena samanvitaḥ ..
mahīrājamupāgamya mahadyuddhamakārayat .. 3.3.32.210 ..
meaning:
रात्रौ परिमलो राजा लक्षणेन समन्वितः ..
महीराजमुपागम्य महद्युद्धमकारयत् .. 3.3.32.210 ..
text_mt:
At night, King Parimala, accompanied by Lakṣaṇa,
approached Mahīrāja and fought a great battle.

sanskrit_iast:
sapādalakṣāśca tadā hataśeṣā mahābalāḥ ..
trilakṣairhataśeṣaiśca sārddhaṃ yoddhumupasthitāḥ..211..
meaning:
सपादलक्षाश्च तदा हतशेषा महाबलाः ..
त्रिलक्षैर्हतशेषैश्च सार्द्धं योद्धुमुपस्थिताः..211..
text_mt:
And then one hundred and twenty-five thousand survivors, men of great might,
stood ready to fight with three hundred thousand survivors.

sanskrit_iast:
dhānyapālaḥ śataṃ bhūpām̐llakṣaṇaśca tathā śatam..
tālanaśca śataṃ bhūpānhatvā rājānamāyayau..212..
meaning:
धान्यपालः शतं भूपाम्̐ल्लक्षणश्च तथा शतम्..
तालनश्च शतं भूपान्हत्वा राजानमाययौ..212..
text_mt:
Dhānyapāla [slew] a hundred kings, and Lakṣaṇa likewise a hundred;
and Tālana, having slain a hundred kings, advanced toward the king.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājastadā duḥkhī dhyātvā rudraṃ maheśvaram..
niśīthe samanuprāpte hataśeṣaissamāgataḥ..
ekākī gajamāruhya yayau cādibhayaṃkaram.. 213..
meaning:
महीराजस्तदा दुःखी ध्यात्वा रुद्रं महेश्वरम्..
निशीथे समनुप्राप्ते हतशेषैस्समागतः..
एकाकी गजमारुह्य ययौ चादिभयंकरम्.. 213..
text_mt:
Then Mahīrāja, sorrowful, meditating upon Rudra Maheśvara,
when midnight arrived, joined by those who remained,
mounting an elephant alone, went forth, causing primeval terror.

sanskrit_iast:
rudradattena bāṇena hatvā parimalaṃ nṛpam..
dhānyapālaṃ tathā hatvā tālanaṃ balavattaram ..
lakṣaṇāntamupāgamya mahadyuddhamacīkarat .. 214 ..
meaning:
रुद्रदत्तेन बाणेन हत्वा परिमलं नृपम्..
धान्यपालं तथा हत्वा तालनं बलवत्तरम् ..
लक्षणान्तमुपागम्य महद्युद्धमचीकरत् .. 214 ..
text_mt:
Slaying King Parimala with an arrow given by Rudra,
and likewise slaying Dhānyapāla and the very powerful Tālana,
he approached near Lakṣaṇa and waged a great battle.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājasya raudrāstraissainyāssarve kṣayaṃ gatāḥ ..
lakṣaṇaṃ prati raudrāstraṃ mahīrājaḥ samādadhe .. 215 ..
meaning:
महीराजस्य रौद्रास्त्रैस्सैन्यास्सर्वे क्षयं गताः ..
लक्षणं प्रति रौद्रास्त्रं महीराजः समादधे .. 215 ..
text_mt: All the troops were destroyed by the Raudra missiles of Mahīrāja. / Mahīrāja aimed a Raudra missile against Lakṣaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu lakṣaṇo vīro vaiṣṇavāstraṃ samādadhe ..
tenāstreṇa kṣayaṃ jāto mahīrājasya sāyakaḥ ..
tenāstratejasā rājā mahāsaṃtāpamāptavān .. 216 ..
meaning:
तदा तु लक्षणो वीरो वैष्णवास्त्रं समादधे ..
तेनास्त्रेण क्षयं जातो महीराजस्य सायकः ..
तेनास्त्रतेजसा राजा महासंतापमाप्तवान् .. 216 ..
text_mt: Then, however, the hero Lakṣaṇa aimed a Vaiṣṇava missile. / By that missile the arrow of Mahīrāja was destroyed; / by the splendour of that missile the king suffered great torment.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvā rudraṃ mahādevaṃ tyaktvā vidyāṃ ca vaiṣṇavīm ..
svabhallena śiraḥ kāyādapāharata bhūmipaḥ .. 217 ..
meaning:
ध्यात्वा रुद्रं महादेवं त्यक्त्वा विद्यां च वैष्णवीम् ..
स्वभल्लेन शिरः कायादपाहरत भूमिपः .. 217 ..
text_mt: Meditating upon Rudra, the Great God, and relinquishing the Vaiṣṇava lore, / the ruler of the earth severed his [own] head from his body with his spear.

sanskrit_iast:
hastinī ca tadā ruṣṭā gajamādibhayaṃkaram ..
gatvā yuddhaṃ muhūrtena kṛtvā svargamupāyayau .. 218 ..
meaning:
हस्तिनी च तदा रुष्टा गजमादिभयंकरम् ..
गत्वा युद्धं मुहूर्तेन कृत्वा स्वर्गमुपाययौ .. 218 ..
text_mt: And then the enraged female elephant, having gone to battle / with the elephant Ādibhayaṅkara, died within an hour and ascended to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
uṣaḥkāle ca saṃprāpte malanā patimuttamam ..
taccitāyāṃ samāropya dadāha svaṃ kalevaram.. 219 ..
meaning:
उषःकाले च संप्राप्ते मलना पतिमुत्तमम् ..
तच्चितायां समारोप्य ददाह स्वं कलेवरम्.. 219 ..
text_mt: And when the time of dawn arrived, Malanā, placing her excellent husband / upon his funeral pyre, burned her own body.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu devakī śuddhaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ balavattaram..
tālanādīṃstathā hutvā dadāha svaṃ kalevaram .. 3.3.32.220 ..
meaning:
तदा तु देवकी शुद्धं लक्षणं बलवत्तरम्..
तालनादींस्तथा हुत्वा ददाह स्वं कलेवरम् .. 3.3.32.220 ..
text_mt: Then Devakī consigned the pure, exceedingly mighty Lakṣaṇa, / as well as Tālana and the others, [to the fire] and burned her own body.

sanskrit_iast:
prabhāte vimale jāte caturthe bhaumavāsare ..
tathā hutvā svarṇavatī kṛtvā teṣāṃ tilāṃjalim ..
dhyātvā sarvamayīṃ devīṃ sthirībhūya svayaṃ sthitaḥ .. 221 ..
meaning:
प्रभाते विमले जाते चतुर्थे भौमवासरे ..
तथा हुत्वा स्वर्णवती कृत्वा तेषां तिलांजलिम् ..
ध्यात्वा सर्वमयीं देवीं स्थिरीभूय स्वयं स्थितः .. 221 ..
text_mt: When the clear dawn arose on the fourth day, a Tuesday, / Svarṇavatī, likewise offering [them] and making a water-and-sesame libation for them, / meditated on the goddess consisting of all things and stood firm by herself.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare tatra kalirbhāryāsamanvitaḥ ..
vāṃchitaṃ phalamāgamya tuṣṭāva ślakṣṇayā girā .. 222 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तत्र कलिर्भार्यासमन्वितः ..
वांछितं फलमागम्य तुष्टाव श्लक्ष्णया गिरा .. 222 ..
text_mt: Meanwhile, Kali arrived there accompanied by his wife, / and having attained his desired fruit, praised [Āhlāda] with sweet words:

sanskrit_iast:
.. kaliruvāca .. ..
nama āhlāda mahate sarvānaṃdapradāyine ..
yogeśvarāya śuddhāya mahāvatīnivāsine .. 223 ..
meaning:
.. कलिरुवाच .. ..
नम आह्लाद महते सर्वानंदप्रदायिने ..
योगेश्वराय शुद्धाय महावतीनिवासिने .. 223 ..
text_mt: Kali said: / “Homage to the great Āhlāda, the granter of all bliss, / the lord of yoga, the pure one, the dweller of Mahāvatī!

sanskrit_iast:
rāmāṃśastvaṃ mahābāho mama pālanatatparaḥ ..
kalaikayā samāgamya bhuvo bhārastvayā hṛtaḥ .. 224 ..
meaning:
रामांशस्त्वं महाबाहो मम पालनतत्परः ..
कलैकया समागम्य भुवो भारस्त्वया हृतः .. 224 ..
text_mt: You are a portion of Balarāma, O mighty-armed one, devoted to protecting me! / Having arrived as a single portion, the burden of the earth has been lifted by you.

sanskrit_iast:
rājānaḥ pāvakīyāśca tapobalasamanvitāḥ ..
hatvā tānpañcasāhasrānkṣudrabhūpānanekaśaḥ ..
yogamadhye samāsīno namastasmai mahātmane .. 225 ..
meaning:
राजानः पावकीयाश्च तपोबलसमन्विताः ..
हत्वा तान्पञ्चसाहस्रान्क्षुद्रभूपाननेकशः ..
योगमध्ये समासीनो नमस्तस्मै महात्मने .. 225 ..
text_mt: The kings descended from fire, endowed with the power of asceticism— / having slain those five thousand, and numerous petty kings, / you sit immersed in yoga; homage to that great-souled one!

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ sainyāḥ ṣaṣṭilakṣāḥ kramādvīra tvayā hatāḥ ..
varaṃ brūhi mahā bhāga yatte manasi vartate .. 226 ..
meaning:
तेषां सैन्याः षष्टिलक्षाः क्रमाद्वीर त्वया हताः ..
वरं ब्रूहि महा भाग यत्ते मनसि वर्तते .. 226 ..
text_mt: Their armies, numbering six million, were slain by you in succession, O hero. / Choose a boon, O fortunate one, whatever is in your mind.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā sa āhlādo vacanaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ ..
mama kīrtistvayā deva kartavyā ca jane jane .. 227 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा स आह्लादो वचनं प्राह निर्भयः ..
मम कीर्तिस्त्वया देव कर्तव्या च जने जने .. 227 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, Āhlāda spoke [these] words without fear: / “My fame, O lord, must be spread by you from person to person.

sanskrit_iast:
punaste kāryamatulaṃ kariṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva bhoḥ ..
mahīrājaśca dharmātmā śivabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ..
tasya netre mayā śuddhe kartavye nīlarūpake .. 228 ..
meaning:
पुनस्ते कार्यमतुलं करिष्यामि शृणुष्व भोः ..
महीराजश्च धर्मात्मा शिवभक्तिपरायणः ..
तस्य नेत्रे मया शुद्धे कर्तव्ये नीलरूपके .. 228 ..
text_mt: Listen, sir, I shall perform another incomparable deed for you: / Mahīrāja is righteous, devoted to the worship of Śiva; / his eyes must be made by me into pure blue ones.

sanskrit_iast:
tava priyaḥ sadā nīlastathaiva ca mama priyaḥ ..
devānāṃ duḥkhado deva daityānāṃ harṣavarddhanaḥ .. 229 ..
meaning:
तव प्रियः सदा नीलस्तथैव च मम प्रियः ..
देवानां दुःखदो देव दैत्यानां हर्षवर्द्धनः .. 229 ..
text_mt: Blue is ever dear to you, and likewise it is dear to me; / it brings grief to the gods, O lord, and increases the joy of the Daityas.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sa tu rāmāṃśo gajamāruhya vegataḥ ..
mahīrājamupāgamya mahadyuddhaṃ cakāra ha .. 3.3.32.230 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा स तु रामांशो गजमारुह्य वेगतः ..
महीराजमुपागम्य महद्युद्धं चकार ह .. 3.3.32.230 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, that portion of Balarāma swiftly mounted his elephant, / approached Mahīrāja, and fought a great battle.

sanskrit_iast:
rudradatto gajastūrṇaṃ paṃcaśabdamupasthitaḥ ..
padmadaṃtānsamāruhya yuyudhāte parasparam.. 231 ..
meaning:
रुद्रदत्तो गजस्तूर्णं पंचशब्दमुपस्थितः ..
पद्मदंतान्समारुह्य युयुधाते परस्परम्.. 231 ..
text_mt: The elephant given by Rudra quickly arrived [at the place of] five sounds; / mounting [their elephants with] lotus tusks, they fought one another.

sanskrit_iast: anyonyena tathā hatvā gajau svargamupeyatuḥ .. 232 ..
meaning: अन्योन्येन तथा हत्वा गजौ स्वर्गमुपेयतुः .. 232 ..
text_mt: Having thus slain each other, the two elephants went to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā bhayāturo rājā tyaktvā yuddhaṃ bhayaṃkaram..
sa tu dudrāva vegena rāmāṃśo'nuyayau tataḥ .. 233 ..
meaning:
तदा भयातुरो राजा त्यक्त्वा युद्धं भयंकरम्..
स तु दुद्राव वेगेन रामांशोऽनुययौ ततः .. 233 ..
text_mt: Then the king, stricken with terror, abandoned the frightful battle / and fled with speed; the portion of Balarāma then pursued him.

sanskrit_iast:
keśeṣu ca mahīrājaṃ gṛhītvā tarasā balī ..
kalidattaṃ mahānīlaṃ netrayostena tatkṛtam .. 234 ..
meaning:
केशेषु च महीराजं गृहीत्वा तरसा बली ..
कलिदत्तं महानीलं नेत्रयोस्तेन तत्कृतम् .. 234 ..
text_mt: Seizing Mahīrāja by the hair with swift force, the mighty one / applied to his two eyes the great blue substance given by Kali.

sanskrit_iast:
tadāprabhṛti vai śambhuraśuddhaṃ nṛpatiṃ priyam ..
matvā tyaktvā yayau sthāne kailāse guhyakālaye .. 235 ..
meaning:
तदाप्रभृति वै शम्भुरशुद्धं नृपतिं प्रियम् ..
मत्वा त्यक्त्वा ययौ स्थाने कैलासे गुह्यकालये .. 235 ..
text_mt: From that time forth, Śambhu, considering his beloved king / to be impure, abandoned him and departed to his abode on Kailāsa, the dwelling of the Guhyakas.

sanskrit_iast:
āhlādaḥ kalinā sārddhaṃ kadalīvanamuttamam..
gatvā yogaṃ cakārāśu parvate gaṃdhamādane .. 236 ..
meaning:
आह्लादः कलिना सार्द्धं कदलीवनमुत्तमम्..
गत्वा योगं चकाराशु पर्वते गंधमादने .. 236 ..
text_mt: Āhlāda, together with Kali, went to the excellent Kadalī forest / on Mount Gandhamādana and quickly practised yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
tathābhūtaṃ ca rāmāṃśaṃ kalirdṛṣṭvā mudānvitaḥ ..
balipārśvamupāgamya varṇayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ .. 237 ..
meaning:
तथाभूतं च रामांशं कलिर्दृष्ट्वा मुदान्वितः ..
बलिपार्श्वमुपागम्य वर्णयामास सर्वशः .. 237 ..
text_mt: Seeing that portion of Balarāma in such a state, Kali, filled with joy, / approached Bali and described everything in full.

sanskrit_iast:
sa vai balirdaityarājo'yutaiḥ saha vinirgataḥ ..
gaura deśamupāgamya sahoḍḍīnamuvāca ha .. 238 ..
meaning:
स वै बलिर्दैत्यराजोऽयुतैः सह विनिर्गतः ..
गौर देशमुपागम्य सहोड्डीनमुवाच ह .. 238 ..
text_mt: That Daitya king Bali set forth with myriads [of warriors]; / arriving in the Gaura country, he said to Sahoḍḍīna:

sanskrit_iast:
gaccha vīra balaissārddhaṃ niśāyāṃ rakṣito mayā ..
hatvā bhūpaṃ mahīrājaṃ vidyunmālāṃ gṛhāṇa bhoḥ ..239..
meaning:
गच्छ वीर बलैस्सार्द्धं निशायां रक्षितो मया ..
हत्वा भूपं महीराजं विद्युन्मालां गृहाण भोः ..239..
text_mt: “Go, O hero, together with the troops, protected by me in the night! / Having slain King Mahīrāja, seize Vidyunmālā, sir!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vacastasya ṣoḍaśābdāṃtare gate ..
sapādalakṣaiśca balaiḥ kurukṣetramupāyayau .. 3.3.32.240 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य षोडशाब्दांतरे गते ..
सपादलक्षैश्च बलैः कुरुक्षेत्रमुपाययौ .. 3.3.32.240 ..
text_mt: Hearing his words, when an interval of sixteen years had passed, / he marched to Kurukṣetra with an army of one hundred and twenty-five thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājasutāñjitvā samāhūya mahāvatīm ..
mahīpatiṃ preṣayitvā luṇṭhayitvā ca tadvasu ..241..
meaning:
महीराजसुताञ्जित्वा समाहूय महावतीम् ..
महीपतिं प्रेषयित्वा लुण्ठयित्वा च तद्वसु ..241..
text_mt: Having conquered the sons of Mahīrāja, he summoned Mahāvatī; / sending forth the king and plundering his wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
liṃgārthaṃ kṛtavānyatnaṃ sa nṛpaḥ kīrtisāgare ..
na prāptassa nṛpastaṃ vai svagehāya tadā yayau ..242..
meaning:
लिंगार्थं कृतवान्यत्नं स नृपः कीर्तिसागरे ..
न प्राप्तस्स नृपस्तं वै स्वगेहाय तदा ययौ ..242..
text_mt: that king made an effort to obtain the liṅga in Kīrtisāgara; / not obtaining it, that king then went to his own home.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣacaṃḍīṃ kārayitvā paramānaṃdamāptavān..
jayacaṃdrastu tacchrutvā putraśokasamanvitaḥ .. 243 ..
meaning:
लक्षचंडीं कारयित्वा परमानंदमाप्तवान्..
जयचंद्रस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा पुत्रशोकसमन्वितः .. 243 ..
text_mt: Having caused the Lakṣacaṇḍī [ritual] to be performed, he attained supreme joy. / But Jayacandra, hearing that, was overcome with grief for his son;

sanskrit_iast:
nirāhāro yatirbhūtvā mṛtaḥ svargapuraṃ yayau ..
sahoḍḍīnena sa nṛpaḥ kṛtvā yuddhaṃ bhayaṃkaram .. 244 ..
meaning:
निराहारो यतिर्भूत्वा मृतः स्वर्गपुरं ययौ ..
सहोड्डीनेन स नृपः कृत्वा युद्धं भयंकरम् .. 244 ..
text_mt: fasting and becoming an ascetic, he died and went to the city of heaven. / That king, having fought a dreadful battle with Sahoḍḍīna,

sanskrit_iast:
saptāhorātramātreṇa mleccharājavaśaṃ gataḥ ..
mārito bahuyatnena mahīrājo na vai mṛtaḥ .. 245 ..
meaning:
सप्ताहोरात्रमात्रेण म्लेच्छराजवशं गतः ..
मारितो बहुयत्नेन महीराजो न वै मृतः .. 245 ..
text_mt: fell under the sway of the Mleccha king in just seven days and nights. / Though Mahīrāja was subjected to being killed with great effort, he did not die.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā mlecchassahoḍḍīno nirbaṃdhanamathākarot ..
jyotirūpasthitaṃ tatra caṃdrabhaṭṭo nṛpājñayā ..
kṣurapreṇa ca bāṇena hatvā vahnau dadāha vai .. 246 ..
meaning:
तदा म्लेच्छस्सहोड्डीनो निर्बंधनमथाकरोत् ..
ज्योतिरूपस्थितं तत्र चंद्रभट्टो नृपाज्ञया ..
क्षुरप्रेण च बाणेन हत्वा वह्नौ ददाह वै .. 246 ..
text_mt: Then the Mleccha Sahoḍḍīna bound him fast. / Candrabhaṭṭa, by order of the king, slew with a crescent-shaped arrow / him who stood there in the form of light, and burned him in fire.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyunmālāṃ sa ca mleccho gṛhītvā ca dhanaṃ bahu ..
tatrāsthāpya svadāsaṃ ca kutukoḍḍīnamāgataḥ .. 247 ..
1 281 sūtena śaunakādīnprati vikramarājyakālād dvādaśaśatābdīsamaye jāyamānaitihā- sikavṛttāntavarṇanam tatra-pūrvaṃ bhāratayuddhe mṛtānāṃ kauravāṇāṃ yādavānāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ śrīkṛṣṇādīnāṃ ca punaravatārakathāprastāvavarṇanam ślo. 34
2 282 bharatakhaṇḍasthāṣṭādaśarājyasthānavibhāgādivarṇanam, śakarājairāryadeśavidhvaṃse kṛte sati vikramādityapautreṇa śālivāhanena śakānāṃ parājayakaraṇam. āryadeśamle- cchadeśayormaryādākaraṇam īśaputreṇa sāmasiṃhasya mlecchadeśe sthāpanam, śālivāhanasya ṣaṣṭivarṣaparyantaṃ rājyakaraṇottaraṃ svargamanam ślo. 34
meaning:
विद्युन्मालां स च म्लेच्छो गृहीत्वा च धनं बहु ..
तत्रास्थाप्य स्वदासं च कुतुकोड्डीनमागतः .. 247 ..
1 281 सूतेन शौनकादीन्प्रति विक्रमराज्यकालाद् द्वादशशताब्दीसमये जायमानैतिहा- सिकवृत्तान्तवर्णनम् तत्र-पूर्वं भारतयुद्धे मृतानां कौरवाणां यादवानां पाण्डवानां श्रीकृष्णादीनां च पुनरवतारकथाप्रस्ताववर्णनम् श्लो. 34
2 282 भरतखण्डस्थाष्टादशराज्यस्थानविभागादिवर्णनम्, शकराजैरार्यदेशविध्वंसे कृते सति विक्रमादित्यपौत्रेण शालिवाहनेन शकानां पराजयकरणम्. आर्यदेशम्ले- च्छदेशयोर्मर्यादाकरणम् ईशपुत्रेण सामसिंहस्य म्लेच्छदेशे स्थापनम्, शालिवाहनस्य षष्टिवर्षपर्यन्तं राज्यकरणोत्तरं स्वर्गमनम् श्लो. 34
text_mt:
That Mleccha, seizing Vidyunmālā and much wealth, / installed his own servant Kutukoḍḍīna there and departed.
1 [Page] 281. Description by Sūta to Śaunaka and others of historical events occurring around the twelfth century from the time of the reign of Vikrama. Therein: Description introducing the account of the re-incarnation of the Kauravas, Yādavas, Pāṇḍavas, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, and others who had died previously in the Bhārata War. Verses: 34.
2 [Page] 282. Description of the division of the eighteen royal territories located in the land of Bharata and so forth; the defeat of the Śakas by Śālivāhana, the grandson of Vikramāditya, after the devastation of the Aryan realm was wrought by the Śaka kings; the fixing of the boundary between the Aryan and Mleccha lands; the installation of Sāmasiṃha in the Mleccha realm by the Son of God; the ascent of Śālivāhana to heaven after ruling for sixty years. Verses: 34.

31 322 kṛṣṇāṃśasya śyālayoṣidbhiḥ saṃkaṭānayanam kṛṣṇāṃśaśyālayoṣidvivāhādivṛttānta- varṇanam gurjarasthamūladevanṛpatikanyāprabhāvatītatpatipīḍakayakṣavinigrahaḥ,kāśmī- rastha kekayabhūpatitanayā madanāvatīvivāhavṛttāntavarṇanam puṇḍradeśasthanāgavarmabhū- pālatanayāsuvelāvivāhavṛttāntavarṇanam madrakeśakanyākāntimatīvivāhavṛttāntavarṇanam dehalīṃprati mleccharājasya sahodasyāgamanavṛttāntavarṇanam āryadeśe mlecchāgamanādivṛttāntādivarṇanam ślo. 186
meaning:
29 319 किंनरीकन्योत्पत्तिवृत्तान्तवर्णनम् बौद्धराज्य-चीनराज्य श्यामराजस्थैः सह युद्धवृत्तान्तवर्णनम् श्लो. 59
30 320 लक्षणपद्मिनीसमानयनयुद्धवृत्तान्तवर्णनम् श्लो, 94
31 322 कृष्णांशस्य श्यालयोषिद्भिः संकटानयनम् कृष्णांशश्यालयोषिद्विवाहादिवृत्तान्त- वर्णनम् गुर्जरस्थमूलदेवनृपतिकन्याप्रभावतीतत्पतिपीडकयक्षविनिग्रहः,काश्मी- रस्थ केकयभूपतितनया मदनावतीविवाहवृत्तान्तवर्णनम् पुण्ड्रदेशस्थनागवर्मभू- पालतनयासुवेलाविवाहवृत्तान्तवर्णनम् मद्रकेशकन्याकान्तिमतीविवाहवृत्तान्तवर्णनम् देहलींप्रति म्लेच्छराजस्य सहोदस्यागमनवृत्तान्तवर्णनम् आर्यदेशे म्लेच्छागमनादिवृत्तान्तादिवर्णनम् श्लो. 186
text_mt:
29 [page] 319: An account of the birth of the maiden who was a Kinnarī; an account of the battle against those who dwelled in the Buddhist kingdom, the kingdom of Cīna, and the kingdom of Śyāma: 59 verses.
30 [page] 320: An account of the battle fought for the fetching of Lakṣaṇā and Padminī: 94 verses.
31 [page] 322: The plunging of the part of Kṛṣṇa into a crisis by the wives of his brothers-in-law; an account of the marriage of the part of Kṛṣṇa with the wives of his brothers-in-law and other matters; the subduing of the yakṣa who afflicted Prabhāvatī, daughter of King Mūladeva residing in Gurjara, and her husband; an account of the marriage with Madanāvatī, daughter of the king of Kekaya residing in Kāśmīra; an account of the marriage with Suvelā, daughter of King Nāgavarma residing in the country of Puṇḍra; an account of the marriage with Kāntimatī, daughter of the king of Madra; an account of the arrival toward Dehalī of Sahoda, the mleccha king; an account of the arrival of the mlecchas into the Āryan country and other matters: 186 verses.

sanskrit_iast: 32 326 candravaṃśīyādisarvanṛpāṇāmaṃtimamahāghorasaṃgrāmaḥ, tatra prāyaḥ sarvanṛpāṇāṃ kṣayavṛttā ntavarṇanam pṛdhvīrājamṛtyuvidvanmālāharaṇavṛttāntavarṇanam mlecchena sahoḍḍīnena dehalyāṃ svadūtasya kutukoḍḍīnasya sthāpanavarṇanam ślo, 347
meaning: 32 326 चन्द्रवंशीयादिसर्वनृपाणामंतिममहाघोरसंग्रामः, तत्र प्रायः सर्वनृपाणां क्षयवृत्ता न्तवर्णनम् पृध्वीराजमृत्युविद्वन्मालाहरणवृत्तान्तवर्णनम् म्लेच्छेन सहोड्डीनेन देहल्यां स्वदूतस्य कुतुकोड्डीनस्य स्थापनवर्णनम् श्लो, 347
text_mt: 32 [fol.] 326. Account of the final terrible battle of all the kings of the Lunar dynasty and others; account of the destruction of almost all kings there; account of the death of Pṛthvīrāja and the abduction of Vidvanmālā; account of the installation of his envoy Kutukoḍḍīna in Delhi by the mleccha Sahoḍḍīna. Verses: 347.

sanskrit_iast:
.. vedavyāsa uvāca .. ..
evaṃ dvāparasaṃdhyāyā ante sūtena varṇitam ..
sūryacaṃdrānvayākhyānaṃ tanmayā kathitaṃ tava ..1..
meaning:
.. वेदव्यास उवाच .. ..
एवं द्वापरसंध्याया अन्ते सूतेन वर्णितम् ..
सूर्यचंद्रान्वयाख्यानं तन्मया कथितं तव ..1..
text_mt: Vedavyāsa said: / Thus at the close of the Dvāpara twilight, as narrated by the Sūta, / the story of the solar and lunar lineages has been told to you by me.
title: Pramaravaṃśavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
viśālāyāṃ punargatvā vaitālena vinirmitam ..
kathayiṣyati sūtastamitihāsasamuccayam ..2..
meaning:
विशालायां पुनर्गत्वा वैतालेन विनिर्मितम् ..
कथयिष्यति सूतस्तमितिहाससमुच्चयम् ..2..
text_mt: Having gone again to Viśālā, the Sūta / will relate that Itihāsasamuccaya composed by Vetāla.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmayā kathitaṃ sarvaṃ hṛṣīkottamapuṇyadam..
punarvikramabhūpena bhaviṣyati samāhvayaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
तन्मया कथितं सर्वं हृषीकोत्तमपुण्यदम्..
पुनर्विक्रमभूपेन भविष्यति समाह्वयः .. 3 ..
text_mt: All that, yielding religious merit, O best of the senses, has been recounted by me. / Again there will be an assembly with King Vikrama.

sanskrit_iast:
naimiṣāraṇyamāsādya śrāvayiṣyati vai kathām..
punaruktāni yānyeva purāṇāṣṭādaśāni vai .. 4 ..
meaning:
नैमिषारण्यमासाद्य श्रावयिष्यति वै कथाम्..
पुनरुक्तानि यान्येव पुराणाष्टादशानि वै .. 4 ..
text_mt: Having reached the Naimiṣa forest, he will indeed recite the story. / The eighteen Purāṇas, indeed, which have been repeated,

sanskrit_iast:
tāni copapurāṇāni bhaviṣyaṃti kalau yuge ..
teṣāṃ copapurāṇānāṃ dvādaśādhyāyamuttamam .. 5 ..
meaning:
तानि चोपपुराणानि भविष्यंति कलौ युगे ..
तेषां चोपपुराणानां द्वादशाध्यायमुत्तमम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: and those Upapurāṇas will come to be in the Kali age. / Of those Upapurāṇas, the excellent twelfth chapter

sanskrit_iast:
sārabhūtaśca kathitaṃ itihāsasamuccayaḥ ..
yaste mayā ca kathito hṛṣīkottama te mudā .. 6 ..
meaning:
सारभूतश्च कथितं इतिहाससमुच्चयः ..
यस्ते मया च कथितो हृषीकोत्तम ते मुदा .. 6 ..
text_mt: which contains their essence, the Itihāsasamuccaya, / which has gladly been told to you by me, O best of masters of the senses.

sanskrit_iast:
vikramākhyānakālāṃte'vatāraḥ kalayā hareḥ ..
sa ca śaktyāvatāro hi rādhākṛṣṇasya bhūtale .. 7 ..
meaning:
विक्रमाख्यानकालांतेऽवतारः कलया हरेः ..
स च शक्त्यावतारो हि राधाकृष्णस्य भूतले .. 7 ..
text_mt: At the close of the period of the narrative of Vikrama, there will be an incarnation of Hari by a portion; / and that is indeed an incarnation of power of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa upon the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkathāṃ bhagavānsūto naimiṣāraṇyamāsthitaḥ ..
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi śrāvayiṣyati vai munīm .. 8 ..
meaning:
तत्कथां भगवान्सूतो नैमिषारण्यमास्थितः ..
अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि श्रावयिष्यति वै मुनीम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: The venerable Sūta, staying in the Naimiṣa forest, / will narrate that story to the eighty-eight thousand sages.

sanskrit_iast:
yattanmayā ca kathitaṃ haṣīkottama te mudā ..
punaste śaunakādyāśca kṛtvā snānādikāḥ kriyāḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
यत्तन्मया च कथितं हषीकोत्तम ते मुदा ..
पुनस्ते शौनकाद्याश्च कृत्वा स्नानादिकाः क्रियाः .. 9 ..
text_mt: That which has gladly been told to you by me, O best of the senses. / Then Śaunaka and the others, having performed rites such as bathing,

sanskrit_iast:
sūtapārśvaṃ gamiṣyaṃti naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ ..
tatpṛṣṭenaiva sūtena yaduktaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva bhoḥ .. 3.4.1.10 ..
meaning:
सूतपार्श्वं गमिष्यंति नैमिषारण्यवासिनः ..
तत्पृष्टेनैव सूतेन यदुक्तं तच्छृणुष्व भोः .. 3.4.1.10 ..
text_mt: the dwellers of the Naimiṣa forest will approach the Sūta. / Listen, sir, to what was said by the Sūta when questioned by them!

sanskrit_iast:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
śrutaṃ kṛṣṇasya caritaṃ bhagavanbhavatoditam ..
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi rājñāṃ teṣāṃ kramātkulam .. ..11 ..
meaning:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
श्रुतं कृष्णस्य चरितं भगवन्भवतोदितम् ..
इदानीं श्रोतुमिच्छामि राज्ञां तेषां क्रमात्कुलम् .. ..11 ..
text_mt: The sages said: / The deeds of Kṛṣṇa spoken by you have been heard, O venerable one; / now I wish to hear in order the lineage of those kings,

sanskrit_iast:
caturṇāṃ vahnijātānāṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ ..
sa haristriyugī proktaḥ kathaṃ jātaḥ kalau yuge .. 12 ..
meaning:
चतुर्णां वह्निजातानां परं कौतूहलं हि नः ..
स हरिस्त्रियुगी प्रोक्तः कथं जातः कलौ युगे .. 12 ..
text_mt: the four born of fire, for our curiosity is immense. / That Hari is called the one who belongs to the three ages; how was he born in the Kali age?

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
kathayāmi muniśreṣṭhā yuṣmākaṃ praśnamuttamam ..
agnivaṃśanṛpāṇāṃ ca caritraṃ śṛṇu vistarāt .. 13 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
कथयामि मुनिश्रेष्ठा युष्माकं प्रश्नमुत्तमम् ..
अग्निवंशनृपाणां च चरित्रं शृणु विस्तरात् .. 13 ..
text_mt: The Sūta said: / I shall answer your excellent question, O best of sages; / and hear in detail the deeds of the kings of the fire lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
pramaraśca mahīpālo dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāsthitaḥ ..
ambayā racitāṃ divyāṃ pramarāya purīṃ śubhām .. 14 ..
meaning:
प्रमरश्च महीपालो दक्षिणां दिशमास्थितः ..
अम्बया रचितां दिव्यां प्रमराय पुरीं शुभाम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: King Pramara occupied the southern direction. / In the divine, auspicious city constructed for Pramara by Ambā,

sanskrit_iast:
nivāsaṃ kṛtavānrājā sāmavedaparo balī ..
ṣaḍvarṣāṇi kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmājjāto mahāmaraḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
निवासं कृतवान्राजा सामवेदपरो बली ..
षड्वर्षाणि कृतं राज्यं तस्माज्जातो महामरः .. 15 ..
text_mt: the powerful king, devoted to the Sāmaveda, made his dwelling. / He ruled for six years; from him Mahāmara was born.

sanskrit_iast:
trivarṣaṃ ca kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ devāpistanayo'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ devadūtastato'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śṛṇu tatkāraṇaṃ mune .. 16 ..
meaning:
त्रिवर्षं च कृतं राज्यं देवापिस्तनयोऽभवत् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं देवदूतस्ततोऽभवत् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं शृणु तत्कारणं मुने .. 16 ..
text_mt: He ruled for three years, and Devāpi was his son. / He ruled equal to his father; then came Devadūta. / He ruled equal to his father. Hear the reason for that, O sage:

sanskrit_iast:
aśoke nihate tasminbauddhabhūpe mahābale ..
kalirbhāskaramārādhya tapasā dhyānatatparaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
अशोके निहते तस्मिन्बौद्धभूपे महाबले ..
कलिर्भास्करमाराध्य तपसा ध्यानतत्परः .. 17 ..
text_mt: When that mighty Buddhist king Aśoka was slain, / Kali, absorbed in meditation through asceticism, worshipped the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcavarṣāntare sūryastasmai ca kalaye mudā ..
śakākhyaṃ nāma puruṣaṃ dadau tadbhaktitoṣitaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
पंचवर्षान्तरे सूर्यस्तस्मै च कलये मुदा ..
शकाख्यं नाम पुरुषं ददौ तद्भक्तितोषितः .. 18 ..
text_mt: After five years, the sun, pleased with his devotion, / gladly gave to that Kali a man named Śaka.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prasannaḥ sa kaliḥ śakāya ca mahātmane ..
taittiraṃ nagaraṃ premṇā dadau harṣitamānasaḥ ..19..
meaning:
तदा प्रसन्नः स कलिः शकाय च महात्मने ..
तैत्तिरं नगरं प्रेम्णा ददौ हर्षितमानसः ..19..
text_mt: Then, being pleased, with a delighted mind, / that Kali affectionately gave the city of Taittira to the great-souled Śaka.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra gopāndasyugaṇānvaśīkṛtya mahābalī ..
āryadeśavināśāya kṛtvovodyogaṃ punaḥpunaḥ ..
hatavānbhūpatīnbāṇaistasmātte svalpajīvinaḥ .. 3.4.1.20 ..
meaning:
तत्र गोपान्दस्युगणान्वशीकृत्य महाबली ..
आर्यदेशविनाशाय कृत्वोवोद्योगं पुनःपुनः ..
हतवान्भूपतीन्बाणैस्तस्मात्ते स्वल्पजीविनः .. 3.4.1.20 ..
text_mt: Having subdued the herdsmen and hordes of robbers there, that powerful one, / making constant efforts to destroy the land of the Āryas, / slew the kings with arrows; therefore they were short-lived.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃdharvasenaśca nṛpo devadūtātmajo balī ..
śatārddhābdaṃ padaṃ kṛtvā tapase punarāgataḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
गंधर्वसेनश्च नृपो देवदूतात्मजो बली ..
शतार्द्धाब्दं पदं कृत्वा तपसे पुनरागतः .. 21 ..
text_mt: And King Gandharvasena, the powerful son of Devadūta, / having held sovereignty for fifty years, retired again for penance.

sanskrit_iast:
śivājñayā ca nṛpatirvikramastanayastataḥ ..
śatavarṣakṛtaṃ rājyaṃ devabhaktastato'bhavat ..
daśavarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śakairduṣṭairlayaṃ gataḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
शिवाज्ञया च नृपतिर्विक्रमस्तनयस्ततः ..
शतवर्षकृतं राज्यं देवभक्तस्ततोऽभवत् ..
दशवर्षं कृतं राज्यं शकैर्दुष्टैर्लयं गतः .. 22 ..
text_mt: And by Śiva’s command, King Vikrama was then his son. / His reign lasted one hundred years; then came Devabhakta. / He ruled for ten years and met his destruction at the hands of the wicked Śakas.

sanskrit_iast:
śālivāhana evāpi devabhaktasya cātmajaḥ ..
jitvā śakānsa ṣaṣṭyabdaṃ rājyaṃ kṛtvā divaṃ gataḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
शालिवाहन एवापि देवभक्तस्य चात्मजः ..
जित्वा शकान्स षष्ट्यब्दं राज्यं कृत्वा दिवं गतः .. 23 ..
text_mt: And Śālivāhana, the son of Devabhakta, / having defeated the Śakas and ruled for sixty years, went to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
śālihotrastasya suto rājyaṃ kṛtvā śatārddhakam ..
svargalokaṃ tataḥ prāptastatsutaḥ śālivarddhanaḥ ..24..
meaning:
शालिहोत्रस्तस्य सुतो राज्यं कृत्वा शतार्द्धकम् ..
स्वर्गलोकं ततः प्राप्तस्तत्सुतः शालिवर्द्धनः ..24..
text_mt: His son Śālihotra, having ruled for fifty years, / then attained the heavenly world; his son was Śālivardhana.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śakahantā tato'bhavat..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ suhotrastanayo'bhavat .. 25 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं शकहन्ता ततोऽभवत्..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सुहोत्रस्तनयोऽभवत् .. 25 ..
text_mt: He ruled equal to his father; then came Śakahantṛ. / He ruled equal to his father; Suhotra was his son.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ havirhotrastato'bhavat..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamiṃdrapālastato'bhavat .. 26 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं हविर्होत्रस्ततोऽभवत्..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यमिंद्रपालस्ततोऽभवत् .. 26 ..
text_mt: He ruled equal to his father; Havirhotra came next. / He ruled equal to his father; then came Indrapāla.

sanskrit_iast:
purīmiṃdrāvatīṃ kṛtvā tatra rājyamakārayat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ mālyavānnāma tatsutaḥ ..
purīṃ mālyavatīṃ kṛtvā pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 27 ..
meaning:
पुरीमिंद्रावतीं कृत्वा तत्र राज्यमकारयत् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं माल्यवान्नाम तत्सुतः ..
पुरीं माल्यवतीं कृत्वा पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: Having founded the city of Indrāvatī, he exercised his rule there. / He ruled equal to his father; his son was named Mālyavat. / Having founded the city of Mālyavatī, he held office equal to his father.

sanskrit_iast:
anāvṛṣṭistataścāsīnmahatī caturabdikā ..
tataḥ kṣudhāturo rājā śvaviṣṭhādhānyagarhitam .. 28 ..
meaning:
अनावृष्टिस्ततश्चासीन्महती चतुरब्दिका ..
ततः क्षुधातुरो राजा श्वविष्ठाधान्यगर्हितम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Then there was a great drought lasting four years. / Thereupon the king, tormented by hunger, took grain defiled by dog excrement,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃskṛtya maṃdire rājā śālagrāmāya cārpayat ..
tadā prasanno bhagavānvacanaṃ nabhaseritam .. 29 ..
meaning:
संस्कृत्य मंदिरे राजा शालग्रामाय चार्पयत् ..
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवान्वचनं नभसेरितम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: cleansed it in the temple, and offered it to the Śālagrāma. / Then the Lord was pleased, and a voice uttered from the sky

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā dadau varaṃ tasmai śṛṇu tanmunisattama..
kule yāvannṛpā bhāvyāstava bhūpatisattama..
anāvṛṣṭirna bhavitā tāvatte rāṣṭra uttame..3.4.1.30..
meaning:
कृत्वा ददौ वरं तस्मै शृणु तन्मुनिसत्तम..
कुले यावन्नृपा भाव्यास्तव भूपतिसत्तम..
अनावृष्टिर्न भविता तावत्ते राष्ट्र उत्तमे..3.4.1.30..
text_mt: spoke, giving a boon to him; hear that, O best of sages: / 'As long as kings shall arise in your family, O best of kings, / so long shall there be no drought in your excellent kingdom!'

sanskrit_iast:
suto mālyavataścāsīcchaṃbhudatto harapriyaḥ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bhaumarājastato'bhavat..31..
meaning:
सुतो माल्यवतश्चासीच्छंभुदत्तो हरप्रियः..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं भौमराजस्ततोऽभवत्..31..
text_mt: And the son of Mālyavat was Śambhudatta, dear to Hara. / He ruled equal to his father; then came Bhaumarāja.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ vatsarājastato'bhavat..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bhojarājastato'bhavat..32..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं वत्सराजस्ततोऽभवत्..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं भोजराजस्ततोऽभवत्..32..
text_mt: He ruled equal to his father; then came Vatsarāja. / He ruled equal to his father; then came Bhojarāja.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śaṃbhudattastato'bhavat..
daśahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bhojarājapitussamam..33 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं शंभुदत्तस्ततोऽभवत्..
दशहीनं कृतं राज्यं भोजराजपितुस्समम्..33 ..
text_mt: He ruled equal to his father; then came Śambhudatta. / He ruled for ten [years] less than King Bhojarāja, his father.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃbhudattasya tanayo biṃdupālastato'bhavat ..
biṃdukhaṇḍaṃ ca rāṣṭraṃ vai kṛtvā sa sukhito'bhavat ..
tena rājyaṃ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ vedavidā mune .. 34 ..
meaning:
शंभुदत्तस्य तनयो बिंदुपालस्ततोऽभवत् ..
बिंदुखण्डं च राष्ट्रं वै कृत्वा स सुखितोऽभवत् ..
तेन राज्यं पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं वेदविदा मुने .. 34 ..
text_mt: Then Bindupāla was born as the son of Śambhudatta; / and having established the Bindukhaṇḍa realm, he became happy. / He, knower of the Vedas, ruled equal to his father, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
biṃdupālasya tanayo rājapālastato'bhavat..
pitustulyakṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmājjāto mahīnaraḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
बिंदुपालस्य तनयो राजपालस्ततोऽभवत्..
पितुस्तुल्यकृतं राज्यं तस्माज्जातो महीनरः .. 35 ..
text_mt: Then Rājapāla was born as the son of Bindupāla. / He ruled equal to his father; from him was born Mahīnara.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ somavarmā nṛpo'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ kāmavarmā suto'bhavat .. 36 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सोमवर्मा नृपोऽभवत् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं कामवर्मा सुतोऽभवत् .. 36 ..
text_mt: He ruled equal to his father; King Somavarmā came next. / He ruled equal to his father; his son was Kāmavarmā.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bhūmipālastato'bhavat ..
bhūsarastena khanitaṃ puraṃ tatra śubhaṃ kṛtam .. 37 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं भूमिपालस्ततोऽभवत् ..
भूसरस्तेन खनितं पुरं तत्र शुभं कृतम् .. 37 ..
text_mt: He ruled equal to his father; then came Bhūmipāla. / A lake called Bhūsaras was excavated by him, and an auspicious city was built there.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ raṃgapālastato'bhavat ..
bhūmipālastu nṛpatirjitvā bhūpānanekaśaḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं रंगपालस्ततोऽभवत् ..
भूमिपालस्तु नृपतिर्जित्वा भूपाननेकशः .. 38 ..
text_mt: He ruled equal to his father; then came Raṅgapāla. / But King Bhūmipāla, having defeated numerous kings,

sanskrit_iast:
vīrasiṃhastato nāmnā vikhyāto'bhūnmahītale ..
svarājye raṃgapālaṃ sa cābhiṣicya vanaṃ yayau ..
tapaḥ kṛtvā divaṃ yāto devadevaprasādataḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
वीरसिंहस्ततो नाम्ना विख्यातोऽभून्महीतले ..
स्वराज्ये रंगपालं स चाभिषिच्य वनं ययौ ..
तपः कृत्वा दिवं यातो देवदेवप्रसादतः .. 39 ..
text_mt: Then Vīrasiṃha became famed by name on the surface of the earth. / Having consecrated Raṅgapāla in his own kingdom, he went to the forest. / Having performed asceticism, he went to heaven by the grace of the God of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpasiṃhastato jāto raṃgapālānnṛpottamāt ..
anapatyo hi nṛpatiḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 3.4.1.40 ..
meaning:
कल्पसिंहस्ततो जातो रंगपालान्नृपोत्तमात् ..
अनपत्यो हि नृपतिः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् .. 3.4.1.40 ..
text_mt: Then Kalpasiṃha was born from Raṅgapāla, that best of kings. / That king, being childless, held his position equal [in duration] to his father's.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā jāhnavītoye snānārthaṃ mudito yayau ..
dānaṃ dattvā dvijātibhyaḥ kalpakṣetramavāptavān .. 41 ..
meaning:
एकदा जाह्नवीतोये स्नानार्थं मुदितो ययौ ..
दानं दत्त्वा द्विजातिभ्यः कल्पक्षेत्रमवाप्तवान् .. 41 ..
text_mt: Once he went, delighted, to bathe in the waters of the Jāhnavī. / Having given gifts to the twice-born, he reached Kalpakṣetra.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyabhūmiṃ samālokya śūnyabhūtāṃ sthalīmapi ..
nagaraṃ kārayāmāsa tatra sthāne mudānvitaḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
पुण्यभूमिं समालोक्य शून्यभूतां स्थलीमपि ..
नगरं कारयामास तत्र स्थाने मुदान्वितः .. 42 ..
text_mt: Beholding that holy land, though it was a desolate site, / he gladly caused a city to be built in that place.

sanskrit_iast:
kalāpanagaraṃ nāmnā prasiddhamabhavadbhuvi ..
tatra rājyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena gaṃgāsiṃhastato'bhavat .. 43 ..
meaning:
कलापनगरं नाम्ना प्रसिद्धमभवद्भुवि ..
तत्र राज्यं कृतं तेन गंगासिंहस्ततोऽभवत् .. 43 ..
text_mt: It became famed on earth by the name Kalāpanagara. / He ruled there; after him came Gaṅgāsiṃha.

sanskrit_iast:
navatyabdavapurbhūtvā so'napatyo raṇaṃ gataḥ ..
tyaktvā prāṇānkurukṣetre svargalokamavāptavān ..
samāptimagamadvipra pramarasya kulaṃ śubham .. 44 ..
meaning:
नवत्यब्दवपुर्भूत्वा सोऽनपत्यो रणं गतः ..
त्यक्त्वा प्राणान्कुरुक्षेत्रे स्वर्गलोकमवाप्तवान् ..
समाप्तिमगमद्विप्र प्रमरस्य कुलं शुभम् .. 44 ..
text_mt: Having attained a body of ninety years, he, childless, went to battle. / Giving up his life at Kurukṣetra, he attained heaven. / O twice-born one, the auspicious lineage of Pramara came to an end.

sanskrit_iast:
tadanvaye ca ye śeṣāḥ kṣatriyāstadanaṃtaram ..
tannārīṣvamitovipra babhūva varṇasaṃkaraḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
तदन्वये च ये शेषाः क्षत्रियास्तदनंतरम् ..
तन्नारीष्वमितोविप्र बभूव वर्णसंकरः .. 45 ..
text_mt: And the kṣatriyas who remained thereafter in that lineage, / on their women, O twice-born one, boundless mixture of castes occurred.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśyavṛttikarāḥ sarve mlecchatulyā mahītale ..
iti te kathitaṃ vipra kulaṃ dakṣiṇabhūpateḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
वैश्यवृत्तिकराः सर्वे म्लेच्छतुल्या महीतले ..
इति ते कथितं विप्र कुलं दक्षिणभूपतेः .. 46 ..
text_mt: They all follow the livelihood of vaiśyas, equal to mlecchas on the surface of the earth. / Thus has been related to you, O twice-born one, the lineage of the southern king.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
vayahānirmahīpālo madhyadeśe svakaṃ padam ..
gṛhītvā brahmaracitamajameramavāsayat .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
वयहानिर्महीपालो मध्यदेशे स्वकं पदम् ..
गृहीत्वा ब्रह्मरचितमजमेरमवासयत् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / The earth-ruler Vayahāni, taking his own position in the Madhyadeśa, / founded Ajamera, which was fashioned by Brahmā.
title: Pramaravaṃśavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
ajasya brahmaṇo mā ca lakṣmīstatra ramā gatā ..
tayā ca nagaraṃ ramyamajameramajaṃ smṛtam .. 2 ..
meaning:
अजस्य ब्रह्मणो मा च लक्ष्मीस्तत्र रमा गता ..
तया च नगरं रम्यमजमेरमजं स्मृतम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: The "mā" of Aja Brahmā is Lakṣmī; Ramā went there. / By her, that lovely city is remembered as Ajamera, the unborn.

sanskrit_iast:
daśavarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tomarastatsuto'bhavat ..
pārthivaiḥ pūjayāmāsa varṣamātraṃ maheśvaram .. 3 ..
meaning:
दशवर्षं कृतं राज्यं तोमरस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ..
पार्थिवैः पूजयामास वर्षमात्रं महेश्वरम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: A reign of ten years was made; his son was Tomara. / He worshipped Maheśvara for merely a year with earthly [emblems].

sanskrit_iast:
iṃdraprasthaṃ dadau tasmai prasanno nagaraṃ śivaḥ ..
tadanvaye ca ye jātāstomarāḥ kṣatriyāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
इंद्रप्रस्थं ददौ तस्मै प्रसन्नो नगरं शिवः ..
तदन्वये च ये जातास्तोमराः क्षत्रियाः स्मृताः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Pleased, Śiva gave him the city Indraprastha. / And those born in his lineage are known as the Tomara kṣatriyas.

sanskrit_iast:
tomarāvarajaścaiva cayahānisutaḥ śubhaḥ ..
nāmnā sāmaladevaśca praśrito'bhūnmahītale .. 5 ..
meaning:
तोमरावरजश्चैव चयहानिसुतः शुभः ..
नाम्ना सामलदेवश्च प्रश्रितोऽभून्महीतले .. 5 ..
text_mt: And the younger brother of Tomara, the auspicious son of Cayahāni, / Sāmaladeva by name, was modest on the surface of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
saptavarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ mahādevastato'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamajayaśca tato bhavat .. 6 ..
meaning:
सप्तवर्षं कृतं राज्यं महादेवस्ततोऽभवत् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यमजयश्च ततो भवत् .. 6 ..
text_mt: A reign of seven years was made; after him was Mahādeva. / A reign equal to his father's was made, and after him was Ajaya.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ vīrasiṃhastato'bhavat ..
śatārddhābdaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tato biṃdusuro'bhavat .. 7 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं वीरसिंहस्ततोऽभवत् ..
शतार्द्धाब्दं कृतं राज्यं ततो बिंदुसुरोऽभवत् .. 7 ..
text_mt: A reign equal to his father's was made; after him was Vīrasiṃha. / A reign of half a hundred years was made; after him was Bindusura.

sanskrit_iast:
piturarddhaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ madhyadeśe mahātmanā ..
tasmācca mithunaṃ jātaṃ vīrā vīravihāttakaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
पितुरर्द्धं कृतं राज्यं मध्यदेशे महात्मना ..
तस्माच्च मिथुनं जातं वीरा वीरविहात्तकः .. 8 ..
text_mt: Half [the reign] of his father was made in Madhyadeśa by that great-souled one. / From him a pair was born: Vīrā and Vīravihāttaka.

sanskrit_iast:
vikramāya dadau vīrāṃ pitā vedavidhānataḥ ..
svaputrāya svakaṃ rājyaṃ madhyadeśāntaraṃ mudā .. 9 ..
meaning:
विक्रमाय ददौ वीरां पिता वेदविधानतः ..
स्वपुत्राय स्वकं राज्यं मध्यदेशान्तरं मुदा .. 9 ..
text_mt: The father gave Vīrā to Vikrama according to the Vedic rite, / and gladly gave his own kingdom within Madhyadeśa to his son.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ māṇikyastatsutobhavat ..
śatārddhābdaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ mahāsiṃhastato'bhavat .. 3.4.2.10 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं माणिक्यस्तत्सुतोभवत् ..
शतार्द्धाब्दं कृतं राज्यं महासिंहस्ततोऽभवत् .. 3.4.2.10 ..
text_mt: A reign equal to his father's was made; Māṇikya was his son. / A reign of half a hundred years was made; after him was Mahāsiṃha.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ caṃdraguptastato'bhavat..
piturddhaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tatsutaśca pratāpavān .. 11 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं चंद्रगुप्तस्ततोऽभवत्..
पितुर्द्धं कृतं राज्यं तत्सुतश्च प्रतापवान् .. 11 ..
text_mt: A reign equal to his father's was made; after him was Candragupta. / A reign of half [that of] his father was made by his majestic son.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ mohanastatsuto'bhavat ..
triṃśadabdaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śvetarāyastato'bhavat ..12..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं मोहनस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ..
त्रिंशदब्दं कृतं राज्यं श्वेतरायस्ततोऽभवत् ..12..
text_mt: A reign equal to his father's was made; Mohana was his son. / A reign of thirty years was made; after him was Śvetarāya.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ nāgavāhastato'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ lohadhāra'statobhavat .. .. 13 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं नागवाहस्ततोऽभवत् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं लोहधारऽस्ततोभवत् .. .. 13 ..
text_mt: A reign equal to his father's was made; after him was Nāgavāha. / A reign equal to his father's was made; after him was Lohadhāra.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ vīrasiṃhastato'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ vibudhastatsuto'bhavat .. 14 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं वीरसिंहस्ततोऽभवत् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं विबुधस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् .. 14 ..
text_mt: A reign equal to his father's was made; after him was Vīrasiṃha. / A reign equal to his father's was made; Vibudha was his son.

sanskrit_iast:
śatārddhābdaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ caṃdrarāya statobhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tato hariharo'bhavat ..15..
meaning:
शतार्द्धाब्दं कृतं राज्यं चंद्रराय स्ततोभवत् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं ततो हरिहरोऽभवत् ..15..
text_mt: A reign of half a hundred years was made; after him was Candrarāya. / A reign equal to his father's was made; after him was Harihara.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ vasaṃtastasya cātmajaḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ balāṃga stanayo'bhavat .. 16 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं वसंतस्तस्य चात्मजः ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं बलांग स्तनयोऽभवत् .. 16 ..
text_mt: A reign equal to his father's was made; Vasanta was his son. / A reign equal to his father's was made; Balāṅga was his son.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ pramathastatsuto'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamaṃgarāyastato'bhavat .. 17 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं प्रमथस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यमंगरायस्ततोऽभवत् .. 17 ..
text_mt: A reign equal to his father's was made; Pramatha was his son. / A reign equal to his father's was made; after him was Aṅgarāya.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ viśālastasya cātmajaḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śārṅgadevastato'bhavat .. 18 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं विशालस्तस्य चात्मजः ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं शार्ङ्गदेवस्ततोऽभवत् .. 18 ..
text_mt: A reign equal to his father's was made; Viśāla was his son. / A reign equal to his father's was made; after him was Śārṅgadeva.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ maṃtradevastato'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ jayasiṃhastato'bhavat ..19..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं मंत्रदेवस्ततोऽभवत् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं जयसिंहस्ततोऽभवत् ..19..
text_mt: A reign equal to his father's was made; after him was Mantradeva. / A reign equal to his father's was made; after him was Jayasiṃha.

sanskrit_iast:
āryadeśāśca sakalā jitāstena mahātmanā ..
taddhanaiḥ kārayāmāsa yajñaṃ bahuphalapradam .. 3.4.2.20 ..
meaning:
आर्यदेशाश्च सकला जितास्तेन महात्मना ..
तद्धनैः कारयामास यज्ञं बहुफलप्रदम् .. 3.4.2.20 ..
text_mt: All the Aryan lands were conquered by that great-souled one. / With their wealth, he performed a sacrifice yielding great fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
tataścānaṃda devo hi jātaḥ putraḥ śubhānanaḥ ..
śatārddhābdaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ jayasiṃhena dhīmatā .. 21 ..
meaning:
ततश्चानंद देवो हि जातः पुत्रः शुभाननः ..
शतार्द्धाब्दं कृतं राज्यं जयसिंहेन धीमता .. 21 ..
text_mt: Then indeed a son of auspicious face, Ānandadeva, was born. / A reign of half a hundred years was made by the wise Jayasiṃha.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsutena pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ mahītale ..
someśvarastasya suto mahāśūro babhūva ha .. 22 ..
meaning:
तत्सुतेन पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं महीतले ..
सोमेश्वरस्तस्य सुतो महाशूरो बभूव ह .. 22 ..
text_mt: A reign equal to his father's was made on the surface of the earth by his son. / His son was Someśvara, who was a great hero.

sanskrit_iast:
anaṃgapālasya suto jyeṣṭhāṃ vai kīrtimālinīm ..
tāmudvāhya vidhānena tasyāṃ putrānajījanat .. 23 ..
meaning:
अनंगपालस्य सुतो ज्येष्ठां वै कीर्तिमालिनीम् ..
तामुद्वाह्य विधानेन तस्यां पुत्रानजीजनत् .. 23 ..
text_mt: He properly married Kīrtimālinī, the eldest daughter / of the son of Anaṅgapāla, and engendered sons upon her.

sanskrit_iast:
dhuṃdhukāraśca vai jyeṣṭho mathurārāṣṭrasaṃsthitaḥ ..
madhyaḥ kumārākhyasutaḥ pituḥ padasamāsthitaḥ ..24..
meaning:
धुंधुकारश्च वै ज्येष्ठो मथुराराष्ट्रसंस्थितः ..
मध्यः कुमाराख्यसुतः पितुः पदसमास्थितः ..24..
text_mt: Dhundhukāra was the eldest, established in the territory of Mathurā. / The middle son, named Kumāra, occupied his father's position.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīrājastu balavāṃstṛtīyo dehalīpatiḥ ..
sahoddīnasya nṛpatervaśamāpya mṛtiṃ gataḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
महीराजस्तु बलवांस्तृतीयो देहलीपतिः ..
सहोद्दीनस्य नृपतेर्वशमाप्य मृतिं गतः .. 25 ..
text_mt: Mahīrāja, the mighty third [son], was the lord of Delhi. / Coming under the power of King Sahoddīna, he went to death.

sanskrit_iast:
capahāneśca sa kulaṃ chāyayitvā divaṃ yayau ..
tasya vaṃśe tu rājanyāsteṣāṃ patnyaḥ piśācakaiḥ ..26..
meaning:
चपहानेश्च स कुलं छाययित्वा दिवं ययौ ..
तस्य वंशे तु राजन्यास्तेषां पत्न्यः पिशाचकैः ..26..
text_mt: Having brought a shadow upon the family of Capahāna, he went to heaven. / The noble women of his lineage, their wives, / were enjoyed by piśāca-like

sanskrit_iast:
mlecchaiśca bhuktavatyastā babhūburvarṇasaṃkarāḥ ..
na vai āryā na vai mlecchā jaṭṭā jātyā ca mehanāḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
म्लेच्छैश्च भुक्तवत्यस्ता बभूबुर्वर्णसंकराः ..
न वै आर्या न वै म्लेच्छा जट्टा जात्या च मेहनाः .. 27 ..
text_mt: mlecchas, and became mixed in caste. / They are neither truly Aryans nor truly mlecchas; they are Jāṭs and, by caste, Mehanas.

sanskrit_iast:
mehanā mlecchajātīyā jaṭṭā āryamayāḥ smṛtāḥ ..
kvacitkacicca ye śeṣāḥ kṣatriyāścapahānijāḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
मेहना म्लेच्छजातीया जट्टा आर्यमयाः स्मृताः ..
क्वचित्कचिच्च ये शेषाः क्षत्रियाश्चपहानिजाः .. 28 ..
text_mt: The Mehanas are of mleccha caste; the Jāṭs are considered of Aryan nature. / Here and there remain some kṣatriyas born of Capahāna.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
śuklavaṃśaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu vipravarāditaḥ ..
yadā kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ brahma tyaktvā bhūmiṃ svakaṃ padam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
शुक्लवंशं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु विप्रवरादितः ..
यदा कृष्णः स्वयं ब्रह्म त्यक्त्वा भूमिं स्वकं पदम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / I shall declare the Śukla dynasty from its beginning; listen, O best of the twice-born! / When Kṛṣṇa, who is Brahmā Himself, leaving the earth and his own realm,
title: Pramaravaṃśavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
divyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ prayayau bhūtale tadā ..
kalerāgamanaṃ jñātvā mlecchapā dvīpamadhyage .. 2 ..
meaning:
दिव्यं वृन्दावनं रम्यं प्रययौ भूतले तदा ..
कलेरागमनं ज्ञात्वा म्लेच्छपा द्वीपमध्यगे .. 2 ..
text_mt: went to the divine and lovely Vṛndāvana, then, on the surface of the earth, / knowing the arrival of Kali, the mleccha rulers situated in the middle of the continent—

sanskrit_iast:
sthitā dvīpeṣu vai nānā manujā vedatatparāḥ ..
kalinā mitradharmeṇa dūṣitāste babhūvire .. 3 ..
meaning:
स्थिता द्वीपेषु वै नाना मनुजा वेदतत्पराः ..
कलिना मित्रधर्मेण दूषितास्ते बभूविरे .. 3 ..
text_mt: various men devoted to the Vedas dwelling across the continents / were corrupted by Kali through false friendship.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇāṃ varṣāṇāṃ munisattama ..
adyaprabhṛti vai jātaḥ kālaḥ kalisamāgame .. 4 ..
meaning:
अष्टषष्टिसहस्राणां वर्षाणां मुनिसत्तम ..
अद्यप्रभृति वै जातः कालः कलिसमागमे .. 4 ..
text_mt: O best of sages, sixty-eight thousand / years of time have passed from today at the arrival of Kali.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi dvīparājyamacīkarat ..
sa kalirmlecchayā sārdhaṃ sūryapūjanatatparaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि द्वीपराज्यमचीकरत् ..
स कलिर्म्लेच्छया सार्धं सूर्यपूजनतत्परः .. 5 ..
text_mt: For sixty thousand years he ruled the continents, / that Kali, together with his Mleccha wife, devoted to worshiping the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpaścādbhārate varṣe mlecchayā kalirāyayau ..
dṛṣṭvā tadbhārataṃ varṣaṃ lokapālaiśca pālitam .. 6 ..
meaning:
तत्पश्चाद्भारते वर्षे म्लेच्छया कलिराययौ ..
दृष्ट्वा तद्भारतं वर्षं लोकपालैश्च पालितम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Thereafter Kali came to the land of Bhārata with his Mleccha wife. / Seeing that land of Bhārata protected by the world protectors,

sanskrit_iast:
bhayabhītastvarāviṣṭo gandharvāṇāṃ yaśaskaraḥ ..
sa kaliḥ sūryamārādhya samādhistho babhūva ha ..7..
meaning:
भयभीतस्त्वराविष्टो गन्धर्वाणां यशस्करः ..
स कलिः सूर्यमाराध्य समाधिस्थो बभूव ह ..7..
text_mt: terrified and seized with haste, that Kali, who brought fame to the Gandharvas, / worshipped the sun and became absorbed in deep meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
tato varṣaśatābdāṃte saṃtuṣṭo ravirāgataḥ ..
soṃśubhirlokamātapya mahāvṛṣṭimakārayat .. 8 ..
meaning:
ततो वर्षशताब्दांते संतुष्टो रविरागतः ..
सोंशुभिर्लोकमातप्य महावृष्टिमकारयत् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Then, at the end of a hundred years, the sun was pleased and came. / Scorching the world with his rays, he caused a great downpour of rain.

sanskrit_iast:
caturvarṣasahasrāṇi caturvarṣaśatāni ca ..
vyatītāni muniśreṣṭha cādya prabhṛti saṃlape ..9..
meaning:
चतुर्वर्षसहस्राणि चतुर्वर्षशतानि च ..
व्यतीतानि मुनिश्रेष्ठ चाद्य प्रभृति संलपे ..9..
text_mt: Four thousand and four hundred years / have passed, O best of sages, and starting from today I speak [of this].

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpannaṃ bhārataṃ varṣaṃ tadā jātaṃ samaṃtataḥ ..
nyūhākhyo yavano nāma tena vai pūritaṃ jagat ... ... 3.4.3.10 ..
meaning:
संपन्नं भारतं वर्षं तदा जातं समंततः ..
न्यूहाख्यो यवनो नाम तेन वै पूरितं जगत् ... ... 3.4.3.10 ..
text_mt: Then the land of Bhārata became prosperous on all sides. / There was a Yavana named Nyūha, and by him indeed the world was filled.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrābdakalau prāpte mahendro devarāṭ svayam ..
kāśyapaṃ preṣayāmāsa brahmāvarte mahottame .. 11 ..
meaning:
सहस्राब्दकलौ प्राप्ते महेन्द्रो देवराट् स्वयम् ..
काश्यपं प्रेषयामास ब्रह्मावर्ते महोत्तमे .. 11 ..
text_mt: When a thousand years of the Kali age had arrived, Mahendra, the king of the gods himself, / sent Kāśyapa to the most exalted Brahmāvarta.

sanskrit_iast:
āryāvatī devaśaktistatkaraṃ cāgrahīnmudā ..
daśaputrānsamutpādya sa dvijo miśramāgamat .. 12 ..
meaning:
आर्यावती देवशक्तिस्तत्करं चाग्रहीन्मुदा ..
दशपुत्रान्समुत्पाद्य स द्विजो मिश्रमागमत् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Āryāvatī, divine power [herself], joyfully took his hand [in marriage]. / Having begotten ten sons, that twice-born went to Miśra.

sanskrit_iast:
miśradeśodbhavānmlecchānvaśīkṛtyāyutaṃ mudā ..
svadeśaṃ punarāgatya śiṣyāṃstānsa cakāra ha .. 13 ..
meaning:
मिश्रदेशोद्भवान्म्लेच्छान्वशीकृत्यायुतं मुदा ..
स्वदेशं पुनरागत्य शिष्यांस्तान्स चकार ह .. 13 ..
text_mt: Having joyfully subdued ten thousand Mlecchas born in the land of Miśra, / he returned again to his own country and made them his disciples.

sanskrit_iast:
naṣṭāyāṃ saptapuryāṃ ca brahmāvartaṃ mahottamam..
sarasvatīdṛṣadvatyormadhyagaṃ tatra cāvasat .. 14 ..
meaning:
नष्टायां सप्तपुर्यां च ब्रह्मावर्तं महोत्तमम्..
सरस्वतीदृषद्वत्योर्मध्यगं तत्र चावसत् .. 14 ..
text_mt: And when the seven sacred cities were destroyed, he lived there in the most exalted Brahmāvarta, / situated between the Sarasvatī and the Dṛṣadvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
svaputraṃ śuklamāhūya dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ tapodhanam ..
ājñāya raivataṃ śṛṃgaṃ tapase tu punaḥ svayam .. 15 ..
meaning:
स्वपुत्रं शुक्लमाहूय द्विजश्रेष्ठं तपोधनम् ..
आज्ञाय रैवतं शृंगं तपसे तु पुनः स्वयम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: Having summoned his son Śukla, the best of the twice-born rich in penance, / and directed [him], he himself went again to the Raivata peak for penance.

sanskrit_iast:
navaputrām̐stathā śiṣyānmanudharmaṃ sanātanam ..
śrāvayāmāsa dharmātmā sa rājā manudharmagaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
नवपुत्राम्̐स्तथा शिष्यान्मनुधर्मं सनातनम् ..
श्रावयामास धर्मात्मा स राजा मनुधर्मगः .. 16 ..
text_mt: To his nine sons and likewise to his disciples, that righteous king, / adhering to the duty of Manu, proclaimed the eternal duty of Manu.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklopi raivataṃ prāpya saccidānaṃdavigraham ..
vāsudevaṃ jagannāthaṃ tapasā samatoṣayat .. 17 ..
meaning:
शुक्लोपि रैवतं प्राप्य सच्चिदानंदविग्रहम् ..
वासुदेवं जगन्नाथं तपसा समतोषयत् .. 17 ..
text_mt: Śukla too, having reached Raivata, satisfied with his penance / Vāsudeva, the Lord of the World, whose embodiment is being, consciousness, and bliss.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prasanno bhagavāndvāra kānāyako balī ..
kare gṛhītvā taṃ vipraṃ samudrāṃtamupāyayau .. 18 ..
meaning:
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवान्द्वार कानायको बली ..
करे गृहीत्वा तं विप्रं समुद्रांतमुपाययौ .. 18 ..
text_mt: Then, pleased, the mighty Lord, the leader of Dvārakā, / took that Brahmin by the hand and went to the edge of the ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
dvārakāṃ darśayāmāsa divyaśobhāsamanvitām ..
vyatīte dvisahasrābde kiñcijjāte bhṛgūttama .. 19 ..
meaning:
द्वारकां दर्शयामास दिव्यशोभासमन्विताम् ..
व्यतीते द्विसहस्राब्दे किञ्चिज्जाते भृगूत्तम .. 19 ..
text_mt: He showed [him] Dvārakā endowed with celestial splendour. / When two thousand years had passed and a little more had begun, O best of the Bhṛgus,

sanskrit_iast:
agnidvāreṇa prayayau sa śuklo'rbudaparvate ..
jitvā bauddhāndvijaiḥ sārdhaṃ tribhiranyaiśca baṃdhubhiḥ .. 3.4.3.20 ..
meaning:
अग्निद्वारेण प्रययौ स शुक्लोऽर्बुदपर्वते ..
जित्वा बौद्धान्द्विजैः सार्धं त्रिभिरन्यैश्च बंधुभिः .. 3.4.3.20 ..
text_mt: that Śukla set out through the Fire Gate to Mount Arbuda. / Having conquered the Buddhists along with three other Brahmins and his kinsmen,

sanskrit_iast:
dvārakāṃ kārayāmāsa hareśca kṛpayā hi saḥ ..
tatroṣya mudito rājā kṛṣṇadhyānaparobhavat .. 21 ..
meaning:
द्वारकां कारयामास हरेश्च कृपया हि सः ..
तत्रोष्य मुदितो राजा कृष्णध्यानपरोभवत् .. 21 ..
text_mt: he built Dvārakā by the grace of Hari. / Residing there, delighted, the king was devoted to meditating on Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
paścime bhārate varṣe daśābdaṃ kṛtavānpadam ..
nārāyaṇasya kṛpayā viṣvaksenaḥ suto'bhavat .. 22 ..
meaning:
पश्चिमे भारते वर्षे दशाब्दं कृतवान्पदम् ..
नारायणस्य कृपया विष्वक्सेनः सुतोऽभवत् .. 22 ..
text_mt: In western Bhārata he established his realm for ten years. / By the grace of Nārāyaṇa, Viṣvaksena became his son.

sanskrit_iast:
viṃśadabdaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ jayasenastato'bhavat ..
triṃśadabdaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ visenastasya cātmajaḥ ... .. 23 ..
meaning:
विंशदब्दं कृतं राज्यं जयसेनस्ततोऽभवत् ..
त्रिंशदब्दं कृतं राज्यं विसेनस्तस्य चात्मजः ... .. 23 ..
text_mt: He ruled for twenty years; then Jayasena was born. / He ruled for thirty years, and Visena was his son.

sanskrit_iast:
śatārdhābdaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ mithunaṃ tasya cābhavat ..
pramodo modasiṃhaśca vikramāya nijāṃ sutām .. 24 ..
meaning:
शतार्धाब्दं कृतं राज्यं मिथुनं तस्य चाभवत् ..
प्रमोदो मोदसिंहश्च विक्रमाय निजां सुताम् .. 24 ..
text_mt: He ruled for fifty years, and twins were born to him: / Pramoda and Modasiṃha. And his own daughter to Vikrama

sanskrit_iast:
visenaśca dadau prītyā rāṣṭraṃ putrāya cottamam ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ siṃdhuvarmā suto'bhavat .. 25 ..
meaning:
विसेनश्च ददौ प्रीत्या राष्ट्रं पुत्राय चोत्तमम् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सिंधुवर्मा सुतोऽभवत् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Visena gave with affection, and the excellent realm to his son. / He ruled like his father, and Sindhuvarmā became his son.

sanskrit_iast:
siṃdhukūle kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tyaktvā tatpaitṛkaṃ padam ..
siṃdhudeśastato nāmnā prasiddhobhūnmahītale .. 26 ..
meaning:
सिंधुकूले कृतं राज्यं त्यक्त्वा तत्पैतृकं पदम् ..
सिंधुदेशस्ततो नाम्ना प्रसिद्धोभून्महीतले .. 26 ..
text_mt: Leaving that ancestral domain, he established his kingdom on the bank of the Indus; / hence the land became renowned on earth by the name of the Sindhu country.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ rājñā vai siṃdhuvarmaṇā ..
siṃdhudvīpastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 27 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं राज्ञा वै सिंधुवर्मणा ..
सिंधुद्वीपस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: King Sindhuvarmā ruled just like his father. / Sindhudvīpa was his son; he held the throne like his father.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīpatistasya tanayo gautamānvayasaṃbhavām ..
kācchapīṃ mahiṣīṃ prāpya kacchadeśamupāyayau .. 28 ..
meaning:
श्रीपतिस्तस्य तनयो गौतमान्वयसंभवाम् ..
काच्छपीं महिषीं प्राप्य कच्छदेशमुपाययौ .. 28 ..
text_mt: Śrīpati was his son. Having obtained as his queen Kācchapī, / born of Gautama's lineage, he went to the land of Kaccha.

sanskrit_iast:
pulindānyavanāñjitvā tatra deśamakārayat ..
deśo vai śrīpatirnāmnā siṃdhukūle babhūva ha .. 29 ..
meaning:
पुलिन्दान्यवनाञ्जित्वा तत्र देशमकारयत् ..
देशो वै श्रीपतिर्नाम्ना सिंधुकूले बभूव ह .. 29 ..
text_mt: Having conquered the Pulindas and Yavanas, he founded a land there. / Indeed, a land named Śrīpati arose on the bank of the Indus.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bhujavarmā tato'bhavat ..
jitvā sa śabarānbhillāṃstatra rāṣṭramakārayat .. .. 3.4.3.30 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं भुजवर्मा ततोऽभवत् ..
जित्वा स शबरान्भिल्लांस्तत्र राष्ट्रमकारयत् .. .. 3.4.3.30 ..
text_mt: He ruled like his father; then Bhujavarmā was born. / Having conquered the Śabaras and Bhillas, he created a realm there.

sanskrit_iast:
bhujadeśastato jātaḥ prasiddho'bhūnmahītale ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ raṇavarmā suto'bhavat .. 31 ..
meaning:
भुजदेशस्ततो जातः प्रसिद्धोऽभून्महीतले ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं रणवर्मा सुतोऽभवत् .. 31 ..
text_mt: From that the land of Bhuja arose and became renowned on earth. / He ruled like his father, and Raṇavarmā became his son.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ citravarmā suto'bhavat ..
kṛtvā sa citranagarīṃ vanamadhye nṛpottamaḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं चित्रवर्मा सुतोऽभवत् ..
कृत्वा स चित्रनगरीं वनमध्ये नृपोत्तमः .. 32 ..
text_mt: He ruled like his father, and Citravarmā became his son. / Having built the city of Citranagarī in the midst of the forest, that best of kings

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ dharmavarmā suto'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ kṛṣṇa varmā suto'bhavat .. 33 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं धर्मवर्मा सुतोऽभवत् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं कृष्ण वर्मा सुतोऽभवत् .. 33 ..
text_mt: ruled like his father, and Dharmavarmā became his son. / He ruled like his father, and Kṛṣṇavarmā became his son.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamudayastatsuto'bhavat ..
kṛtvodayapuraṃ ramyaṃ vanamadhye nṛpottamaḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यमुदयस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ..
कृत्वोदयपुरं रम्यं वनमध्ये नृपोत्तमः .. 34 ..
text_mt: He ruled like his father, and Udaya became his son. / Having built lovely Udayapura in the midst of the forest, that best of kings

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ vāpyakarmā suto'bhavat ..
vāpīkūpataḍāgāni nānāharmyāṇi tena vai .. 35 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं वाप्यकर्मा सुतोऽभवत् ..
वापीकूपतडागानि नानाहर्म्याणि तेन वै .. 35 ..
text_mt: ruled like his father, and Vāpyakarmā became his son. / Step-wells, wells, ponds, and various palaces were by him

sanskrit_iast:
dharmārthe kārayāmāsa dharmātmā sa ca vai puram ..
etasminnantare prāpto balado nāma bhūpatiḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
धर्मार्थे कारयामास धर्मात्मा स च वै पुरम् ..
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे प्राप्तो बलदो नाम भूपतिः .. 36 ..
text_mt: built for the sake of dharma, and that righteous one [built] a city. / In the meantime, a king named Balada arrived,

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣasainyayuto vīro mahāmadamate sthitaḥ ..
tena sārdhamabhūyuddhaṃ rājño vai vāpyakarmaṇaḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
लक्षसैन्ययुतो वीरो महामदमते स्थितः ..
तेन सार्धमभूयुद्धं राज्ञो वै वाप्यकर्मणः .. 37 ..
text_mt: a hero endowed with an army of a hundred thousand, abiding in the doctrine of Mahāmada. / With him there was a battle of King Vāpyakarmā.

sanskrit_iast:
jitvā paiśācakānmlecchānkṛṣṇotsavamakārayat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ guhilastatsuto'bhavat .. 38 ..
meaning:
जित्वा पैशाचकान्म्लेच्छान्कृष्णोत्सवमकारयत् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं गुहिलस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् .. 38 ..
text_mt: Having conquered the fiendish Mlecchas, he celebrated the festival of Kṛṣṇa. / He ruled like his father, and Guhila became his son.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ kālabhojaḥ suto'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ rāṣṭrapālastato'bhavat .. 39 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं कालभोजः सुतोऽभवत् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं राष्ट्रपालस्ततोऽभवत् .. 39 ..
text_mt: He ruled like his father, and Kālabhoja became his son. / He ruled like his father; then Rāṣṭrapāla was born.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tyaktvā paitṛkaṃ sthānaṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ śaktimāgamat ..
tapasārādhayāmāsa śāradāṃ sarvamaṃgalām .. .. 3.4.3.40 ..
meaning:
स त्यक्त्वा पैतृकं स्थानं वैष्णवीं शक्तिमागमत् ..
तपसाराधयामास शारदां सर्वमंगलाम् .. .. 3.4.3.40 ..
text_mt: Leaving his ancestral place, he took refuge in the Vaiṣṇava power. / Through penance he worshipped Śāradā, all-auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
prasannā sā tadā devī kārayāmāsa vai purīm ..
mahāvatīṃ mahāramyāṃ maṇidevena rakṣitām .. 41 ..
meaning:
प्रसन्ना सा तदा देवी कारयामास वै पुरीम् ..
महावतीं महारम्यां मणिदेवेन रक्षिताम् .. 41 ..
text_mt: Then, pleased, the goddess caused a city to be built, / Mahāvatī, most lovely, protected by Maṇideva.

sanskrit_iast:
tatroṣya nṛpatirdhīmāndaśābdaṃ rājyamāptavān ..
tasyobhau tanayau jātau vijayaḥ prajayastathā .. 42 ..
meaning:
तत्रोष्य नृपतिर्धीमान्दशाब्दं राज्यमाप्तवान् ..
तस्योभौ तनयौ जातौ विजयः प्रजयस्तथा .. 42 ..
text_mt: Residing there, the wise king obtained sovereignty for ten years. / To him were born two sons, Vijaya and Prajaya.

sanskrit_iast:
prajayaḥ pitarau tyaktvā gaṃgākūlamupāyayau ..
dvādaśābdaṃ ca tapasā pūjayāmāsa śāradām .. 43 ..
meaning:
प्रजयः पितरौ त्यक्त्वा गंगाकूलमुपाययौ ..
द्वादशाब्दं च तपसा पूजयामास शारदाम् .. 43 ..
text_mt: Prajaya, leaving his parents, went to the bank of the Gaṅgā, / and for twelve years he worshipped Śāradā with penance.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyā mūrtimayī devī veṇuvādanatatparā ..
hayamāruhya saṃprāptā vihasyāha mahīpatim .. 44..
meaning:
कन्या मूर्तिमयी देवी वेणुवादनतत्परा ..
