हयमारुह्य संप्राप्ता विहस्याह महीपतिम् .. 44..
text_mt: The goddess, embodied as a maiden, intent on playing the flute, / arrived mounted on a horse and smiling, said to the king:

sanskrit_iast:
kinnimittaṃ bhūpasuta tvayā cārādhitā śivā ..
tatphalaṃ tvaṃ hi tapasā mattaḥ śīghramavāpsyasi .. 45 ..
meaning:
किन्निमित्तं भूपसुत त्वया चाराधिता शिवा ..
तत्फलं त्वं हि तपसा मत्तः शीघ्रमवाप्स्यसि .. 45 ..
text_mt: ‘For what reason, O prince, have you worshipped Śivā? / By your penance you shall quickly attain that fruit from me.’

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā sa hovāca kumāri madhurasvare ..
navīnaṃ nagaraṃ mahyaṃ kuru devi namostu te .. 46 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा स होवाच कुमारि मधुरस्वरे ..
नवीनं नगरं मह्यं कुरु देवि नमोस्तु ते .. 46 ..
text_mt: Having heard this, he said: ‘O maiden of sweet voice, / build a new city for me, O goddess! Homage to you!’

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu sā devī dadau tasmai hayaṃ śubham ..
puro bhūtvā vādyakarī dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāgatā .. 47 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु सा देवी ददौ तस्मै हयं शुभम् ..
पुरो भूत्वा वाद्यकरी दक्षिणां दिशमागता .. 47 ..
text_mt: Having heard this, the goddess gave him an auspicious horse. / Going before him playing an instrument, she went toward the southern direction.

sanskrit_iast:
sa bhūpo hayamāruhya netra ācchādya cāyayau ..
punaḥ sa bhūpatiḥ paścātpaścimāṃ diśamāgatā .. 48 ..
meaning:
स भूपो हयमारुह्य नेत्र आच्छाद्य चाययौ ..
पुनः स भूपतिः पश्चात्पश्चिमां दिशमागता .. 48 ..
text_mt: Mounting the horse and covering his eyes, the king followed. / Then, behind that king, she went toward the western direction.

sanskrit_iast:
tatonuprayayau pūrvamarkaṇo yatra pakṣirāṭ ..
bhayabhīto nṛpastena samunmīlya sa cakṣuṣī .. 49 ..
meaning:
ततोनुप्रययौ पूर्वमर्कणो यत्र पक्षिराट् ..
भयभीतो नृपस्तेन समुन्मील्य स चक्षुषी .. 49 ..
text_mt: Then he followed toward the east, where Arkaṇa, the king of birds, [dwelt]. / Filled with terror, the king opened both his eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa nagaraṃ ramyaṃ kanyāyā racitaṃ śubham ..
uttare tasya vai gaṃgā dakṣiṇenāsa pāṇḍurā .. 3.4.3.50 ..
meaning:
ददर्श नगरं रम्यं कन्याया रचितं शुभम् ..
उत्तरे तस्य वै गंगा दक्षिणेनास पाण्डुरा .. 3.4.3.50 ..
text_mt: He beheld a charming, auspicious city fashioned by the maiden. / To its north was the Gaṅgā, and to its south flowed the Pāṇḍurā.

sanskrit_iast:
paścime īśasaritā pūrve pakṣī sa markaṇaḥ ..
kubjabhūtamabhūdgrāmaṃ kānyakubja iti smṛtaḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
पश्चिमे ईशसरिता पूर्वे पक्षी स मर्कणः ..
कुब्जभूतमभूद्ग्रामं कान्यकुब्ज इति स्मृतः .. 51 ..
text_mt: To the west was the Īśasarit river, and to the east was that bird Arkaṇa. / The village became curved; hence it is known as Kānyakubja.

sanskrit_iast:
daśavarṣaṃ ca tenaiva jayapālena vai padam ..
kṛtaṃ tasya suto jāto veṇuvādyācca veṇukaḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
दशवर्षं च तेनैव जयपालेन वै पदम् ..
कृतं तस्य सुतो जातो वेणुवाद्याच्च वेणुकः .. 52 ..
text_mt: For ten years that very Jayapāla exercised his rule. / His son was born, Veṇuka, called after the flute-music.

sanskrit_iast:
sa veṇuśca mahīpālo devīdattāṃ manoharām ..
patnīṃ kanyāvatīṃ nāmnā samudvāhya rarāja ha .. 53 ..
meaning:
स वेणुश्च महीपालो देवीदत्तां मनोहराम् ..
पत्नीं कन्यावतीं नाम्ना समुद्वाह्य रराज ह .. 53 ..
text_mt: And King Veṇu shone, having married the charming wife / named Kanyāvatī, who had been bestowed by the Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ sapta sutā jātā mātṝṇāṃ maṃgalāḥ kalāḥ ..
śītalā pārvatī kanyā tathā puṣpavatī smṛtā .. 54 ..
meaning:
तस्यां सप्त सुता जाता मातॄणां मंगलाः कलाः ..
शीतला पार्वती कन्या तथा पुष्पवती स्मृता .. 54 ..
text_mt: From her were born seven daughters, the auspicious portions of the Mothers: / known as Śītalā, Pārvatī, Kanyā, and likewise Puṣpavatī,

sanskrit_iast:
govardhanī ca siṃdūrā kālī nāmnā prakīrtitā ..
brāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā .. 55 ..
meaning:
गोवर्धनी च सिंदूरा काली नाम्ना प्रकीर्तिता ..
ब्राह्मी माहेश्वरी चैव कौमारी वैष्णवी तथा .. 55 ..
text_mt: and Govardhanī, Siṃdūrā, and celebrated by the name Kālī. / They became, in succession, Brāhmī, Māheśvarī, Kaumārī, Vaiṣṇavī,

sanskrit_iast:
vārāhī ca tathendrāṇī cāmuṇḍāḥ kramato'bhavan..
ekadā bhūpateḥ patnī taṃtunā mṛttikāghaṭam .. .. 56 ..
meaning:
वाराही च तथेन्द्राणी चामुण्डाः क्रमतोऽभवन्..
एकदा भूपतेः पत्नी तंतुना मृत्तिकाघटम् .. .. 56 ..
text_mt: Vārāhī, and likewise Indrāṇī and Cāmuṇḍā. / Once, the king's wife, with a thread, [lowered] an earthen jar

sanskrit_iast:
kūpe kṛtavatī premṇā yathā pūrvaṃ tathādya sā ..
dadarśa bahulā nārīrnānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
कूपे कृतवती प्रेम्णा यथा पूर्वं तथाद्य सा ..
ददर्श बहुला नारीर्नानाभूषणभूषिताः .. 57 ..
text_mt: into a well with love, just as before, so today. / She beheld numerous women adorned with various ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
svayamekaiva vasanā manoglānimupāyayau ..
tadaiva sa ghaṭo bhūmau na prāptaḥ sapravṛttikām .. 58 ..
meaning:
स्वयमेकैव वसना मनोग्लानिमुपाययौ ..
तदैव स घटो भूमौ न प्राप्तः सप्रवृत्तिकाम् .. 58 ..
text_mt: Wearing only a single garment herself, she fell into dejection of mind. / Right then, that jar did not reach the ground in its proper state.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā kanyāvatī devī ghaṭahīnā gṛhaṃ yayau ..
tadā tu saptakanyāśca śilābhūtā gṛhe sthitāḥ .. 59 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा कन्यावती देवी घटहीना गृहं ययौ ..
तदा तु सप्तकन्याश्च शिलाभूता गृहे स्थिताः .. 59 ..
text_mt: Seeing this, Queen Kanyāvatī went home without the jar. / At that time, the seven maidens stood in the house, turned to stone.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā veṇustadāgatya bhartsayitvā svakāṃ priyām ..
brahmacaryavrataṃ tyaktvā ramayāmāsa yoṣitam .. 3.4.3.60 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा वेणुस्तदागत्य भर्त्सयित्वा स्वकां प्रियाम् ..
ब्रह्मचर्यव्रतं त्यक्त्वा रमयामास योषितम् .. 3.4.3.60 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, Veṇu came there, rebuked his beloved, / abandoned his vow of celibacy, and took pleasure with the woman.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpādvai vīravatyāṃ ca yaśovigraha ātmajaḥ ..
babhūva balavāndharmī cāryadeśapatiḥ svayam .. 61 ..
meaning:
नृपाद्वै वीरवत्यां च यशोविग्रह आत्मजः ..
बभूव बलवान्धर्मी चार्यदेशपतिः स्वयम् .. 61 ..
text_mt: From the king and Vīravatī was born a son, Yaśovigraha, / mighty, righteous, and lord of the Ārya country in his own right.

sanskrit_iast:
viṃśadvarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tena rājñā mahītale ..
mahīcaṃdrastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 62 ..
meaning:
विंशद्वर्षं कृतं राज्यं तेन राज्ञा महीतले ..
महीचंद्रस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् .. 62 ..
text_mt: For twenty years did that king rule upon the earth. / His son was Mahīcandra; he held office equal to his father.

sanskrit_iast:
caṃdradevastasya suto rājyaṃ tena pituḥ samam ..
kṛtaṃ tasmātsuto jāto maṃdapālo mahīpatiḥ .. 63 ..
meaning:
चंद्रदेवस्तस्य सुतो राज्यं तेन पितुः समम् ..
कृतं तस्मात्सुतो जातो मंदपालो महीपतिः .. 63 ..
text_mt: His son was Candradeva; he ruled for a time equal to his father. / From him a son was born, King Mandapāla.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya bhūpasya samaye sarve bhūpāḥ samantataḥ ..
tyaktvā taṃ maṃdapālaṃ ca taddatte saṃsthitā gṛhe .. 64 ..
meaning:
तस्य भूपस्य समये सर्वे भूपाः समन्ततः ..
त्यक्त्वा तं मंदपालं च तद्दत्ते संस्थिता गृहे .. 64 ..
text_mt: In the time of that king, all the kings around / abandoned that Mandapāla and stayed in the dwelling granted by him.

sanskrit_iast:
piturarddhaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ kumbhapālastato 'bhavat ..
rājanīyā ca nagarī piśācaviṣaye sthitā .. 65 ..
meaning:
पितुरर्द्धं कृतं राज्यं कुम्भपालस्ततो ऽभवत् ..
राजनीया च नगरी पिशाचविषये स्थिता .. 65 ..
text_mt: He ruled for half his father's term; thereafter came Kumbhapāla. / Now, the city Rājanīyā was situated in the Piśāca country.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpatiśca mahāmodo mlecchapaiśācadharmagaḥ ..
sa jitvā bahudhā deśām̐lluṃṭhayitvā dhanaṃ bahu .. 66 ..
meaning:
तत्पतिश्च महामोदो म्लेच्छपैशाचधर्मगः ..
स जित्वा बहुधा देशाम्̐ल्लुंठयित्वा धनं बहु .. 66 ..
text_mt: Its ruler was Mahāmoda, given to the ways of the Mlecchas and Piśācas. / Having conquered the lands in many ways and plundered much wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
mlecchadharmakaraḥ prāptaḥ kumbhapālo yataḥ sthitaḥ ..
kumbhapālastu taṃ dṛṣṭvā kalinā nirmitaṃ nṛpa .. 67 ..
meaning:
म्लेच्छधर्मकरः प्राप्तः कुम्भपालो यतः स्थितः ..
कुम्भपालस्तु तं दृष्ट्वा कलिना निर्मितं नृप .. 67 ..
text_mt: he who practiced the customs of the Mlecchas arrived where Kumbhapāla stayed. / Seeing him fashioned by Kali, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāmodaṃ samāgamya praṇanāma sa buddhimān ..
tadā mlecchapatiḥ śūro dattvā tasmai dhanaṃ bahu .. 68 ..
meaning:
महामोदं समागम्य प्रणनाम स बुद्धिमान् ..
तदा म्लेच्छपतिः शूरो दत्त्वा तस्मै धनं बहु .. 68 ..
text_mt: the wise Kumbhapāla approached Mahāmoda and bowed down. / Then the valiant Mleccha lord, having given him much wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
rājanīyāṃ ca nagarīṃ prāptavānmūrtikhaṃḍakam ..
viṃśadabdaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ kuṃbhapālena dhīmatā .. 69 ..
meaning:
राजनीयां च नगरीं प्राप्तवान्मूर्तिखंडकम् ..
विंशदब्दं कृतं राज्यं कुंभपालेन धीमता .. 69 ..
text_mt: and the city Rājanīyā, gained the fragment of an idol. / For twenty years the wise Kumbhapāla ruled.

sanskrit_iast:
tatputro devapālaścānaṃgabhūpasya kanyakām ..
samudvāhya vidhānena caṃdrakāṃtiṃ tayā saha .. 3.4.3.70 ...
meaning:
तत्पुत्रो देवपालश्चानंगभूपस्य कन्यकाम् ..
समुद्वाह्य विधानेन चंद्रकांतिं तया सह .. 3.4.3.70 ...
text_mt: His son Devapāla married according to rite the maiden / Candrakānti, the daughter of King Anaṅga. Together with her,

sanskrit_iast:
kānyakubjagṛhaṃ prāpya jitvā bhūpānanekaśaḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasyobhau tanayau smṛtau .. 71..
meaning:
कान्यकुब्जगृहं प्राप्य जित्वा भूपाननेकशः ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्योभौ तनयौ स्मृतौ .. 71..
text_mt: having obtained the realm of Kānyakubja and conquered many kings, / he ruled for a term equal to his father. Two sons are remembered of him:

sanskrit_iast:
jayacaṃdro ratnabhānurdiśaṃ pūrvāṃ tathottarām ..
āryadeśasya vai jitvā vaiṣṇavo rājyamāptavān..72..
meaning:
जयचंद्रो रत्नभानुर्दिशं पूर्वां तथोत्तराम् ..
आर्यदेशस्य वै जित्वा वैष्णवो राज्यमाप्तवान्..72..
text_mt: Jayacandra and Ratnabhānu. Having conquered the eastern and northern / quarters of the Ārya country, the Vaiṣṇava [king] obtained the kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
ratnabhānośca tanayo lakṣaṇo nāma viśrutaḥ ..
kurukṣetre raṇaṃ prāpya tyaktvā prāṇāndivaṃ gataḥ..73..
meaning:
रत्नभानोश्च तनयो लक्षणो नाम विश्रुतः ..
कुरुक्षेत्रे रणं प्राप्य त्यक्त्वा प्राणान्दिवं गतः..73..
text_mt: Ratnabhānu's son was famous by the name Lakṣaṇa. / Having joined battle at Kurukṣetra, he gave up his life and went to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
samāptimagamadvaṃśo vaiśyapālasya dhīmataḥ ..
kuṃbhapālasya śauklasya vaiśyānāṃ rakṣakasya ca ..74..
meaning:
समाप्तिमगमद्वंशो वैश्यपालस्य धीमतः ..
कुंभपालस्य शौक्लस्य वैश्यानां रक्षकस्य च ..74..
text_mt: The lineage of the wise Vaiśyapāla came to an end, / of Kumbhapāla the Śaukla, the protector of the Vaiśyas.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣvaksenānvaye jātā viṣvaksenā(viśvaknenā?) nṛpāḥ smṛtāḥ..
visenasya kule jātā visenāḥ kṣatriyāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 75 ..
meaning:
विष्वक्सेनान्वये जाता विष्वक्सेना(विश्वक्नेना?) नृपाः स्मृताः..
विसेनस्य कुले जाता विसेनाः क्षत्रियाः स्मृताः .. 75 ..
text_mt: Born in the lineage of Viṣvaksena, kings are remembered as Viṣvaksenas; / born in the family of Visena, kṣatriyas are remembered as Visenas.

sanskrit_iast:
guhilasya kule jātā gauhilāḥ kṣatriyā hi te ..
rāṣṭrapālānvaye jātā rāṣṭrapālā nṛpāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 76 ..
meaning:
गुहिलस्य कुले जाता गौहिलाः क्षत्रिया हि ते ..
राष्ट्रपालान्वये जाता राष्ट्रपाला नृपाः स्मृताः .. 76 ..
text_mt: Those born in the family of Guhila are indeed Gauhila kṣatriyas; / born in the lineage of Rāṣṭrapāla, kings are remembered as Rāṣṭrapālas.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśyapālasya vai vaṃśe kuṃbhapālasya dhīmataḥ ..
vaiśyapālāśca rājanyā babhūburbahudhā hi te .. 77 ..
meaning:
वैश्यपालस्य वै वंशे कुंभपालस्य धीमतः ..
वैश्यपालाश्च राजन्या बभूबुर्बहुधा हि ते .. 77 ..
text_mt: In the lineage of Vaiśyapāla, the wise Kumbhapāla, / there arose many Vaiśyapāla warriors.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇe maraṇaṃ prāpte śukla vaṃśadhuraṃdhure ..
sarve te kṣatriyā mukhyāḥ kurukṣetre layaṃ gatāḥ .. 78 ..
meaning:
लक्षणे मरणं प्राप्ते शुक्ल वंशधुरंधुरे ..
सर्वे ते क्षत्रिया मुख्याः कुरुक्षेत्रे लयं गताः .. 78 ..
text_mt: When Lakṣaṇa met his death, the bearer of the yoke of the Śukla lineage, / all those foremost kṣatriyas met their destruction at Kurukṣetra.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣāstu kṣudrabhūpālā varṇasaṃkarasaṃbhavāḥ ..
mlecchaiśca dūṣitā jātā mleccharājye bhayānake .. 79 .. ..
meaning:
शेषास्तु क्षुद्रभूपाला वर्णसंकरसंभवाः ..
म्लेच्छैश्च दूषिता जाता म्लेच्छराज्ये भयानके .. 79 .. ..
text_mt: The remaining petty kings, born of the mixture of castes, / became corrupted by the Mlecchas in the dread Mleccha kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
..sūta uvāca .. ..
bhṛguvarya śṛṇu tvaṃ vai vaṃśaṃ pariharasya ca ..
jitvā bauddhānpariharo'tharvavedaparāyaṇaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
..सूत उवाच .. ..
भृगुवर्य शृणु त्वं वै वंशं परिहरस्य च ..
जित्वा बौद्धान्परिहरोऽथर्ववेदपरायणः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / O best of the Bhṛgus, hear the lineage of Parihara. / Having conquered the Buddhists, Parihara, devoted to the Atharvaveda,
title: adhyāyaḥ 04

sanskrit_iast:
śaktiṃ sarvamayīṃ nityāṃ dhyātvā premaparo'bhavat ..
prasannā sā tadā devī sārdhayojanamāyatam .. 2 ..
meaning:
शक्तिं सर्वमयीं नित्यां ध्यात्वा प्रेमपरोऽभवत् ..
प्रसन्ना सा तदा देवी सार्धयोजनमायतम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: meditated on the eternal, all-pervading Śakti and became filled with devotion. / Pleased then, that goddess made a city on Mount Citrakūṭa,

sanskrit_iast:
nagaraṃ citrakūṭādrau cakāra kalinirjaram ..
kaliryatra bhavedbaddho nagare'sminsurapriye .. 3 ..
meaning:
नगरं चित्रकूटाद्रौ चकार कलिनिर्जरम् ..
कलिर्यत्र भवेद्बद्धो नगरेऽस्मिन्सुरप्रिये .. 3 ..
text_mt: one and a half yojanas in extent, which defeated Kali. / Because Kali would be bound in this city dear to the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ kaliṃjaro nāmnā prasiddho'bhūnmahītale ..
dvādaśābdaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tena pūrvapradeśake .. 4 ..
meaning:
अतः कलिंजरो नाम्ना प्रसिद्धोऽभून्महीतले ..
द्वादशाब्दं कृतं राज्यं तेन पूर्वप्रदेशके .. 4 ..
text_mt: it became famed by the name Kaliñjara on the earth. / For twelve years he exercised rule in the eastern region.

sanskrit_iast:
gauravarmā tasya sutaḥ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ pituḥ samam ..
svānujaṃ ghoravarmāṇaṃ tatrāsthāpya mudānvitaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
गौरवर्मा तस्य सुतः कृतं राज्यं पितुः समम् ..
स्वानुजं घोरवर्माणं तत्रास्थाप्य मुदान्वितः .. 5 ..
text_mt: His son was Gauravarmā; he ruled for a period equal to his father. / Having installed his younger brother Ghoravarmā there, full of joy,

sanskrit_iast:
gauḍadeśaṃ samāgamya tatra rājyamakārayat ..
suparṇo nāma nṛpatistato'bhūdgauravarmaṇaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
गौडदेशं समागम्य तत्र राज्यमकारयत् ..
सुपर्णो नाम नृपतिस्ततोऽभूद्गौरवर्मणः .. 6 ..
text_mt: he went to the Gauḍa country and ruled there. / From Gauravarmā there arose a king named Suparṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ rūpaṇastatsuto'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ kāravarmā suto'bhavat ..7..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं रूपणस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं कारवर्मा सुतोऽभवत् ..7..
text_mt: He ruled for a period equal to his father; his son was Rūpaṇa. / He ruled for a period equal to his father; his son was Kāravarmā.

sanskrit_iast:
śako nāma tato rājā mahālakṣmīṃ sanātanīm ..
trivarṣāṃte ca sā devī kāmākṣīrūpadhāriṇī .. 8 ..
meaning:
शको नाम ततो राजा महालक्ष्मीं सनातनीम् ..
त्रिवर्षांते च सा देवी कामाक्षीरूपधारिणी .. 8 ..
text_mt: Then there was a king named Śaka. [He worshipped] eternal Mahālakṣmī; / and at the end of three years, that goddess, assuming the form of Kāmākṣī,

sanskrit_iast:
svabhaktapālanā caiva tatra vāsamakārayat ..
śatārddhābdaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tena vai kāmavarmaṇā .. 9 ..
meaning:
स्वभक्तपालना चैव तत्र वासमकारयत् ..
शतार्द्धाब्दं कृतं राज्यं तेन वै कामवर्मणा .. 9 ..
text_mt: made her dwelling there in order to protect her devotee. / For half a century that Kāmavarmā exercised rule.

sanskrit_iast:
mithunaṃ janayāmāsa bhogo bhogavatī hi sā ..
vikramāyaiva nṛpatiḥ sutāṃ bhogavatīṃ dadau .. .. 3.4.4.10 ..
meaning:
मिथुनं जनयामास भोगो भोगवती हि सा ..
विक्रमायैव नृपतिः सुतां भोगवतीं ददौ .. .. 3.4.4.10 ..
text_mt: He begot a pair of twins: Bhoga and Bhogavatī. / The king gave his daughter Bhogavatī to Vikrama,

sanskrit_iast:
svarājyaṃ ca svaputrāya pradadau bhogavarmaṇe ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ kālivarmā suto'vat .. 11 ..
meaning:
स्वराज्यं च स्वपुत्राय प्रददौ भोगवर्मणे ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं कालिवर्मा सुतोऽवत् .. 11 ..
text_mt: and bestowed his own kingdom on his son Bhogavarmā. / He ruled for a period equal to his father; his son was Kālivarmā.

sanskrit_iast:
mahotsavaṃ mahākālyāḥ kṛtavānsa ca bhūpatiḥ ..
tasmai prasannā varadā kālī bhūtvā svayaṃ sthitā .. 12..
meaning:
महोत्सवं महाकाल्याः कृतवान्स च भूपतिः ..
तस्मै प्रसन्ना वरदा काली भूत्वा स्वयं स्थिता .. 12..
text_mt: And that king performed a great festival for Mahākālī. / Pleased with him, Kālī stood there in person to grant a boon.

sanskrit_iast:
kalikā bahupuṣpāṇāṃ sā cakāra svaharṣataḥ ..
tābhirbhavaṃ ca nagaraṃ saṃjātaṃ ca manoharam .. 13 ..
meaning:
कलिका बहुपुष्पाणां सा चकार स्वहर्षतः ..
ताभिर्भवं च नगरं संजातं च मनोहरम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Out of her joy she made a bud of many flowers. / From those arose a charming city,

sanskrit_iast:
kalikātā purī nāmnā prasiddhābhūnmahītale ..
kauśikastasya tanayaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 14 ..
meaning:
कलिकाता पुरी नाम्ना प्रसिद्धाभून्महीतले ..
कौशिकस्तस्य तनयः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: known on the surface of the earth by the name Kalikātā. / His son was Kauśika, who held a position equal to his father's.

sanskrit_iast:
kātyāyanastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
tasya putro hemavataḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 15 ..
meaning:
कात्यायनस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ..
तस्य पुत्रो हेमवतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: His son was Kātyāyana, who held a position equal to his father's. / His son was Hemavata, who held a position equal to his father's.

sanskrit_iast:
śivavarmā ca tatputraḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
bhavavarmā ca tatputraḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 16 ..
meaning:
शिववर्मा च तत्पुत्रः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ..
भववर्मा च तत्पुत्रः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: And his son was Śivavarmā, who held a position equal to his father's. / And his son was Bhavavarmā, who held a position equal to his father's.

sanskrit_iast:
rudravarmā ca tatputraḥ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ pituḥ samam ..
bhojavarmā ca tatputrastyaktvā vai paitṛkaṃ padam .. 17 ..
meaning:
रुद्रवर्मा च तत्पुत्रः कृतं राज्यं पितुः समम् ..
भोजवर्मा च तत्पुत्रस्त्यक्त्वा वै पैतृकं पदम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: And his son was Rudravarmā, who ruled equal to his father. / And abandoning his ancestral position, his son Bhojavarmā

sanskrit_iast:
bhojarāṣṭraṃ vanoddeśe kārayāmāsa vīryavān ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ gavavarmā nṛpobhavat ..18..
meaning:
भोजराष्ट्रं वनोद्देशे कारयामास वीर्यवान् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं गववर्मा नृपोभवत् ..18..
text_mt: valorous, established the realm of Bhoja in a forested region. / Gavavarmā became king, who ruled equal to his father.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ viṃdhyavarmā nṛpo'bhavat ..
svānujāya svakaṃ rājyaṃ dattvā vaṃgamupāyayau .. 19 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं विंध्यवर्मा नृपोऽभवत् ..
स्वानुजाय स्वकं राज्यं दत्त्वा वंगमुपाययौ .. 19 ..
text_mt: Vindhyavarmā became king, who ruled equal to his father; / having given his kingdom to his younger brother, he departed for Vaṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sukhasenastato'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ balākastasya cātmajaḥ .. 3.4.4.20 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सुखसेनस्ततोऽभवत् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं बलाकस्तस्य चात्मजः .. 3.4.4.20 ..
text_mt: Then came Sukhasena, who ruled equal to his father. / And his son was Balāka, who ruled equal to his father.

sanskrit_iast:
daśavarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ lakṣmaṇastatsuto'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ mādhavastatsuto'bhavat .. 21 ..
meaning:
दशवर्षं कृतं राज्यं लक्ष्मणस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं माधवस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् .. 21 ..
text_mt: Lakṣmaṇa, his son, ruled for ten years. / His son Mādhava ruled equal to his father.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ veśavastatsuto' bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ surasenastato'bhavat .. 22 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं वेशवस्तत्सुतो' भवत् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सुरसेनस्ततोऽभवत् .. 22 ..
text_mt: His son Veśava ruled equal to his father. / Then came Surasena, who ruled equal to his father.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tato nārāyaṇo'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śāṃtivarmā sutobhavat .. 23 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं ततो नारायणोऽभवत् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं शांतिवर्मा सुतोभवत् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Then came Nārāyaṇa, who ruled equal to his father. / His son Śāntivarmā ruled equal to his father.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃgākūle śāṃtipuraṃ racitaṃ tena dhīmatā ..
nivāsaṃ kṛtavānbhūpaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 24 ..
meaning:
गंगाकूले शांतिपुरं रचितं तेन धीमता ..
निवासं कृतवान्भूपः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् .. 24 ..
text_mt: That wise king built Śāntipura on the bank of the Gaṅgā. / Taking up residence there, the king held a position equal to his father's.

sanskrit_iast:
nadīvarmā tasya suto gaṃgādattavaro balī ..
cakāra nagarīṃ ramyāṃ nadīhāṃ gauḍarāṣṭragām .. 25 ..
meaning:
नदीवर्मा तस्य सुतो गंगादत्तवरो बली ..
चकार नगरीं रम्यां नदीहां गौडराष्ट्रगाम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: His son Nadīvarmā was mighty, having received a boon from the Gaṅgā. / He founded the delightful city of Nadīhā situated in the realm of Gauḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃgayā ca tadāhūtobhijño vidyādharaḥ svayam..
tenaiva rakṣitā cāsītpurī vedaparāyaṇā .. 26 ..
meaning:
गंगया च तदाहूतोभिज्ञो विद्याधरः स्वयम्..
तेनैव रक्षिता चासीत्पुरी वेदपरायणा .. 26 ..
text_mt: And a wise Vidyādhara was summoned in person by the Gaṅgā; / by him alone was that city, devoted to the Veda, protected.

sanskrit_iast:
viṃśadvarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tena rājñā mahātmanā ..
gaṃgāvaṃśastato jāto viśruto'bhūnmahītale .. 27 ..
meaning:
विंशद्वर्षं कृतं राज्यं तेन राज्ञा महात्मना ..
गंगावंशस्ततो जातो विश्रुतोऽभून्महीतले .. 27 ..
text_mt: A reign of twenty years was held by that noble-minded king. / From him arose the Gaṅgā dynasty, celebrated across the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
śārṅgadevastasya suto balavānharipūjakaḥ ..
gauḍadeśamupāgamya haridhyānaparobhavat .. 28 ..
meaning:
शार्ङ्गदेवस्तस्य सुतो बलवान्हरिपूजकः ..
गौडदेशमुपागम्य हरिध्यानपरोभवत् .. 28 ..
text_mt: His son Śārṅgadeva was powerful and a worshipper of Hari; / having arrived in the Gauḍa region, he became devoted to meditating on Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
daśavarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ gaṃgādevastu tatsutaḥ ..
viṃśadvarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ cānaṃgastasya bhūpatiḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
दशवर्षं कृतं राज्यं गंगादेवस्तु तत्सुतः ..
विंशद्वर्षं कृतं राज्यं चानंगस्तस्य भूपतिः .. 29 ..
text_mt: His son was Gaṅgādeva, who ruled for ten years; / and his [son], the king Anaṅga, ruled for twenty years.

sanskrit_iast:
tanayo balavāṃścāsīdgauḍadeśamahīpatiḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājya tato rājeśvaro'bhavat .. 3.4.4.30 ..
meaning:
तनयो बलवांश्चासीद्गौडदेशमहीपतिः ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्य ततो राजेश्वरोऽभवत् .. 3.4.4.30 ..
text_mt: His son was powerful, a ruler over the Gauḍa region. / Then came Rājeśvara, who ruled equal to his father.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ nṛsiṃha stanayo'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ kalivarmā suto'bhavat .. 31 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं नृसिंह स्तनयोऽभवत् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं कलिवर्मा सुतोऽभवत् .. 31 ..
text_mt: His son was Nṛsiṃha, who ruled equal to his father. / His son Kalivarmā ruled equal to his father.

sanskrit_iast:
rāṣṭradeśamupāgamya jitvā tasya nṛpaṃ balī ..
mahāvatīṃ purīṃ ramyāmadhyāsya sukhito'bhavat .. 32 ..
meaning:
राष्ट्रदेशमुपागम्य जित्वा तस्य नृपं बली ..
महावतीं पुरीं रम्यामध्यास्य सुखितोऽभवत् .. 32 ..
text_mt: Coming to the Rāṣṭra region, that mighty one conquered its king / and, settling in the delightful city of Mahāvatī, lived happily.

sanskrit_iast:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ dhṛtivarmā suto'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasya putro mahīpatiḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं धृतिवर्मा सुतोऽभवत् ..
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्य पुत्रो महीपतिः .. 33 ..
text_mt: His son Dhṛtivarmā ruled equal to his father. / His son Mahīpati ruled equal to his father.

sanskrit_iast:
jayacaṃdrājñayā bhūpa urvīmāyāmiti smṛtām ..
nagarīṃ kārayāmāsa tatra vāsamakārayat .. 34 ..
meaning:
जयचंद्राज्ञया भूप उर्वीमायामिति स्मृताम् ..
नगरीं कारयामास तत्र वासमकारयत् .. 34 ..
text_mt: By order of Jayacandra, the king built a city / known as Urvīmāyā and took up residence there.

sanskrit_iast:
kurukṣetre hatāḥ sarve kṣatriyāścaṃdravaṃśinaḥ ..
tadā mahīpatī rājā mahāvatyadhipo'bhavat .. 35 ..
meaning:
कुरुक्षेत्रे हताः सर्वे क्षत्रियाश्चंद्रवंशिनः ..
तदा महीपती राजा महावत्यधिपोऽभवत् .. 35 ..
text_mt: When all the kṣatriyas of the lunar race were slain at Kurukṣetra, / king Mahīpati then became ruler of Mahāvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
viṃśadvarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sahoddīnena vai tataḥ ..
kurukṣetre mṛtiṃ prāptāḥ suyodhanakalāṃśakāḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
विंशद्वर्षं कृतं राज्यं सहोद्दीनेन वै ततः ..
कुरुक्षेत्रे मृतिं प्राप्ताः सुयोधनकलांशकाः .. 36 ..
text_mt: Then, having ruled for twenty years along with Sahoddīna, / those who were portions of the essence of Suyodhana met death at Kurukṣetra.

sanskrit_iast:
ghoravarmā tu nṛpatiḥ sutaḥ pariharasya vai..
kaliṃjare kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śārdūlastatsuto'bhavat.. 37 ..
meaning:
घोरवर्मा तु नृपतिः सुतः परिहरस्य वै..
कलिंजरे कृतं राज्यं शार्दूलस्तत्सुतोऽभवत्.. 37 ..
text_mt: King Ghoravarmā, the son of Parihara, / ruled at Kaliñjara; his son was Śārdūla.

sanskrit_iast:
tadanvaye ca ye bhūpāḥ śārdūlīyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ..
bhūpānāṃ bahudhā rāṣṭraṃ śārdūlānvayasaṃbhavam..38..
meaning:
तदन्वये च ये भूपाः शार्दूलीयाः प्रकीर्तिताः ..
भूपानां बहुधा राष्ट्रं शार्दूलान्वयसंभवम्..38..
text_mt: And the kings in his lineage are celebrated as the Śārdūlīyas. / Through the lineage of Śārdūla, a kingdom was formed in manifold ways for kings

sanskrit_iast:
babhūva sarvato bhūmau mahāmāyāprasādataḥ ..
iti te kathitaṃ vipra pāvakīyamahībhujām..39..
meaning:
बभूव सर्वतो भूमौ महामायाप्रसादतः ..
इति ते कथितं विप्र पावकीयमहीभुजाम्..39..
text_mt: everywhere on earth, by the grace of Mahāmāyā. / Thus have I told you, O brahmin, of the kings born of fire,

sanskrit_iast:
kulaṃ sakalapāpaghnaṃ yathaiva śaśisūryayoḥ ..
punaranyatpravakṣyāmi yathā jātaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ ..3.4.4.40..
meaning:
कुलं सकलपापघ्नं यथैव शशिसूर्ययोः ..
पुनरन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यथा जातः स्वयं हरिः ..3.4.4.40..
text_mt: a lineage that destroys all sin, just like those of the Moon and the Sun. / Next I shall relate another matter: how Hari himself was born.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
madhyāhnakāle saṃprāpte brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ ..
cākṣuṣāṃtaramevāpi mahāvāyurbabhūva ha .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
मध्याह्नकाले संप्राप्ते ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः ..
चाक्षुषांतरमेवापि महावायुर्बभूव ह .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / When the midday time of Brahmā, whose birth is unmanifest, arrived, / right at the transitional deluge of Cākṣuṣa Manu, a great wind arose.
title: adhyāyaḥ 05

sanskrit_iast:
tatprabhāvena hemādriḥ kaṃpamānaḥ punaḥpunaḥ..
yathā vṛkṣastathaivāsau tatkaṃpādeva maṃḍalaḥ ..2..
meaning:
तत्प्रभावेन हेमाद्रिः कंपमानः पुनःपुनः..
यथा वृक्षस्तथैवासौ तत्कंपादेव मंडलः ..2..
text_mt: Through its force the Golden Mountain trembled repeatedly; / and from that trembling, its orb shook just like a tree.

sanskrit_iast:
nabhaso bhūtale prāptastadā bhūmiḥ prakaṃpitā ..
babhūva muniśārdūla sarvalokavināśinī .. 3..
meaning:
नभसो भूतले प्राप्तस्तदा भूमिः प्रकंपिता ..
बभूव मुनिशार्दूल सर्वलोकविनाशिनी .. 3..
text_mt: It fell from the sky onto the surface of the earth; then the earth shook, / O tiger among sages, bringing destruction to all the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
saptadvīpāḥ samudrāśca jalabhūtā babhūvire ..
lokālokastadā śeṣo'bhavatsottaraparvataḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
सप्तद्वीपाः समुद्राश्च जलभूता बभूविरे ..
लोकालोकस्तदा शेषोऽभवत्सोत्तरपर्वतः .. 4 ..
text_mt: The seven continents and the oceans were turned entirely to water; / then the Lokāloka mountain alone remained, together with the Northern Mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣā bhūmirlayaṃ prāptā manvaṃtare laye ..
sahasrābdāṃtare bhūmirbabhūva jalamadhyagā.. .. 5 ..
meaning:
शेषा भूमिर्लयं प्राप्ता मन्वंतरे लये ..
सहस्राब्दांतरे भूमिर्बभूव जलमध्यगा.. .. 5 ..
text_mt: The rest of the earth dissolved in the dissolution between the Manvantaras; / for an interval of a thousand years the earth lay in the midst of the waters.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā sa bhagavānviṣṇurbhavena vidhinā saha ..
śaiśumāraṃ śubhaṃ cakraṃ cakāra nabhasi sthitam .. 6 ..
meaning:
तदा स भगवान्विष्णुर्भवेन विधिना सह ..
शैशुमारं शुभं चक्रं चकार नभसि स्थितम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Then the blessed Viṣṇu, together with Bhava and the Creator, / fashioned the auspicious Śaiśumāra system situated in the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā sakalāstārā grahānsarvānyathāvidhi ..
sthāpayāmāsa bhagavānyathāyogyaṃ pitāmahaḥ ..7..
meaning:
गृहीत्वा सकलास्तारा ग्रहान्सर्वान्यथाविधि ..
स्थापयामास भगवान्यथायोग्यं पितामहः ..7..
text_mt: Taking all the stars and all the planets according to rule, / the blessed Grandfather installed them each in its proper place.

sanskrit_iast:
punarvai jyotiṣāṃ cakraiḥ śoṣitā sakalā mahī ..
sthalībhūyāyutābdānte dṛśyamānā babhūva ha .. 8 ..
meaning:
पुनर्वै ज्योतिषां चक्रैः शोषिता सकला मही ..
स्थलीभूयायुताब्दान्ते दृश्यमाना बभूव ह .. 8 ..
text_mt: Then the entire earth was dried by the spheres of celestial lights; / having turned dry at the end of ten thousand years, it became visible.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā sa bhagavānbrahmā mukhātsomaṃ cakāra ha ..
dvijarājaṃ mahāprājñaṃ sarvavedaviśāradam .. 9 ..
meaning:
तदा स भगवान्ब्रह्मा मुखात्सोमं चकार ह ..
द्विजराजं महाप्राज्ञं सर्ववेदविशारदम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Then the blessed Brahmā produced Soma from his mouth, / the king of the twice-born, deeply wise and versed in all the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
bhujābhyāṃ bhagavānbrahmā kṣatrarājaṃ mahābalam ..
sūryaṃ ca janayāmāsa rājanītiparāyaṇam .. 3.4.5.10 ..
meaning:
भुजाभ्यां भगवान्ब्रह्मा क्षत्रराजं महाबलम् ..
सूर्यं च जनयामास राजनीतिपरायणम् .. 3.4.5.10 ..
text_mt: From his two arms the blessed Brahmā brought forth Sūrya, / the king of kṣatriyas, possessed of great strength and devoted to royal statecraft.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrubhyāṃ vaiśyarājaṃ ca samudraṃ saritāṃ patim..
ratnākaraṃ ca kṛtavānparameṣṭhī pitāmahaḥ ..11..
meaning:
ऊरुभ्यां वैश्यराजं च समुद्रं सरितां पतिम्..
रत्नाकरं च कृतवान्परमेष्ठी पितामहः ..11..
text_mt: From his thighs the Grandfather, the supreme lord, created the king of vaiśyas: / the ocean, lord of rivers and mine of jewels.

sanskrit_iast:
padbhyāṃ ca janayāmāsa viśvakarmāṇamuttamam ..
dakṣaṃ nāma kalābhijñaṃ śūdrarājaṃ sukṛtyakam ..12..
meaning:
पद्भ्यां च जनयामास विश्वकर्माणमुत्तमम् ..
दक्षं नाम कलाभिज्ञं शूद्रराजं सुकृत्यकम् ..12..
text_mt: And from his two feet he generated the supreme Viśvakarman / named Dakṣa, skilled in arts, the king of śūdras, dutiful in action.

sanskrit_iast:
somādvai brāhmaṇā jātāḥ sūryādrājanyavaṃśajāḥ ..
samudrātsakalā vaiśyā dakṣācchūdrā babhūvire ..13..
meaning:
सोमाद्वै ब्राह्मणा जाताः सूर्याद्राजन्यवंशजाः ..
समुद्रात्सकला वैश्या दक्षाच्छूद्रा बभूविरे ..13..
text_mt: From Soma were born the brāhmaṇas, from Sūrya those of the royal lineages, / from the ocean all the vaiśyas, and from Dakṣa were born the śūdras.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryamaṃḍalato jāto manurvaivasvataḥ svayam ..
tasya rājyamabhūtsarvaṃ prāṇināṃ lokavāsinām ..14..
meaning:
सूर्यमंडलतो जातो मनुर्वैवस्वतः स्वयम् ..
तस्य राज्यमभूत्सर्वं प्राणिनां लोकवासिनाम् ..14..
text_mt: From the orb of the sun, Vaivasvata Manu himself was born; / his was the sovereignty over all living beings dwelling in the world.

sanskrit_iast:
divyānāṃ ca yugānāṃ ca tajjñeyaṃ caikasaptatiḥ ..
tadā sa bhagavānviṣṇurviśvarūpā'vatārakaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
दिव्यानां च युगानां च तज्ज्ञेयं चैकसप्ततिः ..
तदा स भगवान्विष्णुर्विश्वरूपाऽवतारकः .. 15 ..
text_mt: And that [duration] is to be known as seventy-one celestial yugas. / At that time, the Blessed Lord Viṣṇu, who incarnates as the universal form,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuḥ pūrvārddhato jātaḥ parārddhādvāmanaḥ svayam ..
bālaḥ satyayuge devo viśvarūpaḥ sanātanaḥ ..16..
meaning:
विष्णुः पूर्वार्द्धतो जातः परार्द्धाद्वामनः स्वयम् ..
बालः सत्ययुगे देवो विश्वरूपः सनातनः ..16..
text_mt: Viṣṇu was born from the first half, and from the second half Vāmana himself. / In the Kṛtayuga the eternal Lord of universal form was a child.

sanskrit_iast:
catuśśatāni varṣāṇi paramāyurnṛṇāṃ tadā ..
tretāyāṃ yauvanaṃ prāptaḥ pūrvārddhātsaṃbhavo hareḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
चतुश्शतानि वर्षाणि परमायुर्नृणां तदा ..
त्रेतायां यौवनं प्राप्तः पूर्वार्द्धात्संभवो हरेः .. 17 ..
text_mt: At that time, the maximum lifespan of mortals was four hundred years. / In the Tretā[yuga], Hari, born from the first half, attained youth.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣāṇāṃ triśatānāṃ ca nṛṇāmāyuḥ prakīrtitam ..
dvāpare vārddhiko devo nṛṇāmāyuḥ śatadvayam .. 18 ..
meaning:
वर्षाणां त्रिशतानां च नृणामायुः प्रकीर्तितम् ..
द्वापरे वार्द्धिको देवो नृणामायुः शतद्वयम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: And the lifespan of mortals was proclaimed to be three hundred years. / In the Dvāpara[yuga] the Lord was an old man, and the lifespan of mortals was two hundred [years].

sanskrit_iast:
kalau tu maraṇaṃ prāpto viśvarūpo hariḥ svayam ..
nṛṇāmāyuḥ śatābdaṃ ca keṣāṃciddharmaśālinām .. 19 ..
meaning:
कलौ तु मरणं प्राप्तो विश्वरूपो हरिः स्वयम् ..
नृणामायुः शताब्दं च केषांचिद्धर्मशालिनाम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: In the Kali[yuga], however, Hari himself of universal form met his death. / And the lifespan of mortals, for some who possess righteousness, is one hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
parārddhādvāmano devo mahendrāvarajo hariḥ ..
caturbhujo mahāśyāmo garuḍopari saṃsthitaḥ .. 3.4.5.20 ..
meaning:
परार्द्धाद्वामनो देवो महेन्द्रावरजो हरिः ..
चतुर्भुजो महाश्यामो गरुडोपरि संस्थितः .. 3.4.5.20 ..
text_mt: From the second half [came] Lord Vāmana, Hari, the younger brother of Mahendra, / four-armed, exceedingly dark, seated upon Garuḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvarūpahitārthāya triyugī saṃbabhūva ha ..
vāmanārddhācca triyugī jāto nārāyaṇaḥ svayam..21..
meaning:
विश्वरूपहितार्थाय त्रियुगी संबभूव ह ..
वामनार्द्धाच्च त्रियुगी जातो नारायणः स्वयम्..21..
text_mt: He became Triyugī for the welfare of the universal form. / And from the half [constituting] Vāmana, Nārāyaṇa himself was born as Triyugī.

sanskrit_iast:
śvetarūpo hariḥ satye haṃsākhyo bhagavānsvayam ..
tretāyāṃ raktarūpaśca yajñākhyo bhagavānsvayam ..
dvāpare pītarūpaśca svarṇagarbho hariḥ svayam ..22..
meaning:
श्वेतरूपो हरिः सत्ये हंसाख्यो भगवान्स्वयम् ..
त्रेतायां रक्तरूपश्च यज्ञाख्यो भगवान्स्वयम् ..
द्वापरे पीतरूपश्च स्वर्णगर्भो हरिः स्वयम् ..22..
text_mt: In the Kṛtayuga Hari was white in form, the Blessed Lord himself named Haṃsa. / In the Tretā[yuga] he was red in form, the Blessed Lord himself named Yajña. / In the Dvāpara[yuga] Hari was yellow in form, Svarṇagarbha himself.

sanskrit_iast:
kalikāle tu saṃprāpte saṃdhyāyāṃ dvāpare yuge ..
kalā tu sakalā viṣṇorvāmanasya tathā kalā ..
ekībhūtā ca devakyāṃ jāto viṣṇustadā svayam .. 23 ..
meaning:
कलिकाले तु संप्राप्ते संध्यायां द्वापरे युगे ..
कला तु सकला विष्णोर्वामनस्य तथा कला ..
एकीभूता च देवक्यां जातो विष्णुस्तदा स्वयम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: When the Kali age arrived, at the twilight of the Dvāparayuga, / all the portions of Viṣṇu and the portions of Vāmana / became united, and Viṣṇu himself was then born in Devakī.

sanskrit_iast:
vasudevagṛhe ramye mathurāyāṃ ca devatāḥ ..
brahmādyāstuṣṭuvurdevaṃ paraṃ brahma sanātanam .. 24 ..
meaning:
वसुदेवगृहे रम्ये मथुरायां च देवताः ..
ब्रह्माद्यास्तुष्टुवुर्देवं परं ब्रह्म सनातनम् .. 24 ..
text_mt: In the delightful house of Vasudeva in Mathurā, the deities / headed by Brahmā praised the eternal Lord, the supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prasanno bhagavāndevānāha śubhaṃ vacaḥ ..
devānāṃ ca hitārthāya daityānāṃ nidhanāya ca ..
ahaṃ kalau ca bahudhā bhavāmi surasattamāḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवान्देवानाह शुभं वचः ..
देवानां च हितार्थाय दैत्यानां निधनाय च ..
अहं कलौ च बहुधा भवामि सुरसत्तमाः .. 25 ..
text_mt: Then the Blessed Lord, being pleased, spoke an auspicious word to the gods: / “For the welfare of the gods and for the destruction of the daityas, / I shall become many in the Kali[yuga], O best of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
divyaṃ vṛṃdāvanaṃ ramyaṃ sūkṣmaṃ bhūtalasaṃsthitam ..
tatrāhaṃ ca rahaḥkrīḍāṃ kariṣyāmi kalau yuge .. 26 ..
meaning:
दिव्यं वृंदावनं रम्यं सूक्ष्मं भूतलसंस्थितम् ..
तत्राहं च रहःक्रीडां करिष्यामि कलौ युगे .. 26 ..
text_mt: There is celestial Vṛndāvana, delightful and subtle, situated on the earth's surface. / There I shall perform secret pastimes in the Kaliyuga.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve vedāḥ kalau ghore gopībhūtāḥ samaṃtataḥ ..
raṃsyante hi mayā sārddhaṃ tyaktvā bhūmaṃḍalaṃ tadā .. 27 ..
meaning:
सर्वे वेदाः कलौ घोरे गोपीभूताः समंततः ..
रंस्यन्ते हि मया सार्द्धं त्यक्त्वा भूमंडलं तदा .. 27 ..
text_mt: In the terrible Kali[yuga], all the Vedas, having become cowherd women all around, / having abandoned the terrestrial sphere, shall sport with me.

sanskrit_iast:
rādhayā prārthito'haṃ vai yadā kaliyugāṃtake ..
samāpya ca rahaḥkrīḍāṃ kalkī ca bhavitāsmyaham .. 28 ..
meaning:
राधया प्रार्थितोऽहं वै यदा कलियुगांतके ..
समाप्य च रहःक्रीडां कल्की च भवितास्म्यहम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: When besought by Rādhā at the end of the Kaliyuga, / having concluded my secret pastimes, I shall become Kalki.

sanskrit_iast:
yugāṃtapralayaṃ kṛtvā punarbhūtvā dvidhātanuḥ ..
satyadharmaṃ kariṣyāmi satye prāpte surottamāḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
युगांतप्रलयं कृत्वा पुनर्भूत्वा द्विधातनुः ..
सत्यधर्मं करिष्यामि सत्ये प्राप्ते सुरोत्तमाः .. 29 ..
text_mt: Having caused the dissolution at the end of the yuga, and having again assumed a twofold body, / I shall establish true righteousness when the Kṛtayuga arrives, O best of gods.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu te devāstatraivāntarlayaṃ gatāḥ ..
evaṃ yugeyuge krīḍā hareradbhutakarmaṇaḥ .. 3.4.5.30 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु ते देवास्तत्रैवान्तर्लयं गताः ..
एवं युगेयुगे क्रीडा हरेरद्भुतकर्मणः .. 3.4.5.30 ..
text_mt: Having heard this, those gods vanished right there. / Such is the sport, in yuga after yuga, of Hari of wondrous deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
ye tu vai viṣṇubhaktāśca te hi jānaṃti viśvagam ..
yathaiva nṛpaterdāsāḥ svarājñaḥ kāryagauravam ..
jānaṃti nāpare vipra tathā dāsā hareḥ svayam ..31..
meaning:
ये तु वै विष्णुभक्ताश्च ते हि जानंति विश्वगम् ..
यथैव नृपतेर्दासाः स्वराज्ञः कार्यगौरवम् ..
जानंति नापरे विप्र तथा दासा हरेः स्वयम् ..31..
text_mt: Those who are devotees of Viṣṇu indeed know the all-pervading one. / Just as the servants of a king know the gravity of their king's affairs / and others do not, O brahmin, so do Hari's own servants.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuvāṃchānusāreṇa viṣṇumāyā sanātanī ..
racitvā vividhām̐llokānmahākālī babhūva ha ..32..
meaning:
विष्णुवांछानुसारेण विष्णुमाया सनातनी ..
रचित्वा विविधाम्̐ल्लोकान्महाकाली बभूव ह ..32..
text_mt: In accordance with Viṣṇu's desire, the eternal Viṣṇumāyā, / having fashioned the manifold worlds, became Mahākālī.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā kālamayaṃ sarvaṃ jagadeccarācaram ..
paścāttu bhakṣayitvā tānmahāgaurī bhaviṣyati ..33..
meaning:
कृत्वा कालमयं सर्वं जगदेच्चराचरम् ..
पश्चात्तु भक्षयित्वा तान्महागौरी भविष्यति ..33..
text_mt: Having made this entire universe of moving and unmoving beings full of time, / and having subsequently devoured them, she will become Mahāgaurī.

sanskrit_iast:
namastasyai mahākālyai viṣṇumāye namonamaḥ ..
mahāgauri namastubhyamasmānpāhi bhayānvitān ..34..
meaning:
नमस्तस्यै महाकाल्यै विष्णुमाये नमोनमः ..
महागौरि नमस्तुभ्यमस्मान्पाहि भयान्वितान् ..34..
text_mt: Obeisance to her, Mahākālī; repeated obeisance to Viṣṇumāyā! / O Mahāgaurī, obeisance to you! Protect us who are filled with fear!

sanskrit_iast:
.. ṛṣiruvāca .. ..
mahīrājānmuniśreṣṭha ke rājāno babhūvire ..
tānno vada mahābhāga sarvajño'sti bhavānsadā ..1..
meaning:
.. ऋषिरुवाच .. ..
महीराजान्मुनिश्रेष्ठ के राजानो बभूविरे ..
तान्नो वद महाभाग सर्वज्ञोऽस्ति भवान्सदा ..1..
text_mt: The sage said: / Which kings arose on earth, O best of sages? / Tell us of them, O fortunate one; you are ever omniscient.
title: Pramaravaṃśavarṇanaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
paiśācaḥ kutukoddīno dehalīrājyamāsthitaḥ ..
valīgaḍhaṃ mahāramyaṃ yādavai rakṣitaṃ puram ..
yayau tatra sa paiśācaḥ śūrāyutasamanvitaḥ ..2..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
पैशाचः कुतुकोद्दीनो देहलीराज्यमास्थितः ..
वलीगढं महारम्यं यादवै रक्षितं पुरम् ..
ययौ तत्र स पैशाचः शूरायुतसमन्वितः ..2..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Kutukoddīna, of demonic nature, occupied the kingdom of Dehalī. / There was a city, Valīgaḍha, exceedingly delightful, guarded by the Yādavas; / thither went that demonic one, accompanied by ten thousand warriors.

sanskrit_iast:
vīrasenasya vai pautraṃ bhūpasenaṃ nṛpottamam ..
sa jitvā kutukoddīno dehalīgrāmasaṃsthitaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
वीरसेनस्य वै पौत्रं भूपसेनं नृपोत्तमम् ..
स जित्वा कुतुकोद्दीनो देहलीग्रामसंस्थितः .. 3 ..
text_mt: Having conquered Bhūpasena, the best of kings, the grandson of Vīrasena, / Kutukoddīna established himself in the town of Dehalī.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare bhūpā nānādeśyāḥ samāgatāḥ ..
jitvā sa kutukoddīnaḥ svadeśāttairnirākṛtaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे भूपा नानादेश्याः समागताः ..
जित्वा स कुतुकोद्दीनः स्वदेशात्तैर्निराकृतः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Meanwhile, kings from various lands assembled; / having defeated Kutukoddīna, he was expelled by them from his own country.

sanskrit_iast:
sahoddīnastu tacchrutvā punarāgatya dehalīm ..
jitvā bhūpāndaityavaro mūrtikhaṃḍamathākarot .. 5 ..
meaning:
सहोद्दीनस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा पुनरागत्य देहलीम् ..
जित्वा भूपान्दैत्यवरो मूर्तिखंडमथाकरोत् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Sahoddīna, having heard of that, came again to Dehalī; / having conquered the kings, that foremost of daityas then broke the [sacred] images.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpaścādbahudhā mlecchā ihāgatya samantataḥ ..
paṃcaṣaṭsaptavarṣāṇi kṛtvā rājyaṃ layaṃ gatāḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
तत्पश्चाद्बहुधा म्लेच्छा इहागत्य समन्ततः ..
पंचषट्सप्तवर्षाणि कृत्वा राज्यं लयं गताः .. 6 ..
text_mt: After that, numerous mlecchas arrived here from every side; / having ruled for five, six, or seven years, they met their demise.

sanskrit_iast:
adyaprabhṛti deśe'smiñchatavarṣāntare hi te ..
bhūtvā cālpāyuṣo mandā devatīrthavināśakāḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
अद्यप्रभृति देशेऽस्मिञ्छतवर्षान्तरे हि ते ..
भूत्वा चाल्पायुषो मन्दा देवतीर्थविनाशकाः .. 7 ..
text_mt: Beginning today, within a hundred years in this land, / having become short-lived, dull-witted destroyers of gods and sacred places,

sanskrit_iast:
mlecchabhūpā muniśreṣṭhāstasmādyūyaṃ mayā saha ..
gaṃtumarhatha vai śīghraṃ viśālāṃ nagarīṃ śubhām .. 8 ..
meaning:
म्लेच्छभूपा मुनिश्रेष्ठास्तस्माद्यूयं मया सह ..
गंतुमर्हथ वै शीघ्रं विशालां नगरीं शुभाम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: the mleccha kings [will perish], O best of sages! Therefore, you ought / to go quickly with me to the auspicious city of Viśālā.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ duḥkhātsaṃtyajya naimiṣam ..
yayuḥ sarve viśālāyāṃ himādrau girisattame .. 9 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं दुःखात्संत्यज्य नैमिषम् ..
ययुः सर्वे विशालायां हिमाद्रौ गिरिसत्तमे .. 9 ..
text_mt: Having heard this speech, abandoning Naimiṣa out of grief, / they all went to Viśālā in the snowy mountain, the best of mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra sarve samādhisthā dhyātvā sarvamayaṃ harim ..
śatavarṣāntare sarve dhyānādbrahmagṛhaṃ yayuḥ ..3.4.6.1 0..
meaning:
तत्र सर्वे समाधिस्था ध्यात्वा सर्वमयं हरिम् ..
शतवर्षान्तरे सर्वे ध्यानाद्ब्रह्मगृहं ययुः ..3.4.6.1 0..
text_mt: There, all remaining in deep absorption, meditating upon Hari who consists of all, / after a hundred years they all went from their meditation to the abode of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca ..
ityevaṃ sakalaṃ bhāvyaṃ yogābhyāsavaśāddrutam ..
varṇitaṃ ca mayā tubhyaṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi . .. 11 ..
meaning:
व्यास उवाच ..
इत्येवं सकलं भाव्यं योगाभ्यासवशाद्द्रुतम् ..
वर्णितं च मया तुभ्यं किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छसि . .. 11 ..
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Thus everything that is to happen has been swiftly described / to you by me through the power of yogic practice. What else do you wish to hear?

sanskrit_iast:
.. manuruvāca .. ..
bhagavanvedatattvajña sarvalokaśivaṃkaraḥ ..
ahaṃ māyābhavo jāto bhavānvedabhavo bhuvi .. 12 ..
meaning:
.. मनुरुवाच .. ..
भगवन्वेदतत्त्वज्ञ सर्वलोकशिवंकरः ..
अहं मायाभवो जातो भवान्वेदभवो भुवि .. 12 ..
text_mt: Manu said: / O Blessed One, knower of the truth of the Veda, creator of auspiciousness for all the worlds! / I was born from Māyā; you were born from the Veda on the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
avidyayā ca sakalaṃ mama jñānaṃ samāhṛtam ..
ato'haṃ vividhā yonīrgṛhītvā lokamāgataḥ ..13..
meaning:
अविद्यया च सकलं मम ज्ञानं समाहृतम् ..
अतोऽहं विविधा योनीर्गृहीत्वा लोकमागतः ..13..
text_mt: And through nescience all my knowledge was taken away; / therefore, assuming various wombs, I have come to this world.

sanskrit_iast:
paraṃ brahmaiva kṛpayā dṛṣṭvā māṃ maṃdabhāginam ..
vyāsarūpaṃ svayaṃ kṛtvā samuddhartumupāgataḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
परं ब्रह्मैव कृपया दृष्ट्वा मां मंदभागिनम् ..
व्यासरूपं स्वयं कृत्वा समुद्धर्तुमुपागतः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Seeing me unfortunate, the supreme Brahman itself, out of compassion, / having assumed the form of Vyāsa, has arrived to uplift [me].

sanskrit_iast:
namastasmai munīṃdrāya vedavyāsāya sākṣiṇe ..
avidyāmohabhāvebhyo rakṣaṇāya namonamaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
नमस्तस्मै मुनींद्राय वेदव्यासाय साक्षिणे ..
अविद्यामोहभावेभ्यो रक्षणाय नमोनमः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Obeisance to that lord of sages, Veda-Vyāsa, the witness; / repeated obeisance to him for protection from the states of nescience and delusion!

sanskrit_iast:
punaranyacca me brūhi sūtādyaiḥ kiṃ kṛtaṃ mune ..
tatsarvaṃ kṛpayā svāminvaktumarhasi sāṃpratam .. 16 ..
meaning:
पुनरन्यच्च मे ब्रूहि सूताद्यैः किं कृतं मुने ..
तत्सर्वं कृपया स्वामिन्वक्तुमर्हसि सांप्रतम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: Tell me yet another thing, O sage: what was done by Sūta and the others? / You ought kindly to tell all of that now, O master.

sanskrit_iast:
.. vyāsa uvāca .. ..
brahmāṃḍe ye sthitā lokāste sarvesminkalevare ..
ahaṃkāro hi jīvātmā sarvaḥ syātkoṭihīnakaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
.. व्यास उवाच .. ..
ब्रह्मांडे ये स्थिता लोकास्ते सर्वेस्मिन्कलेवरे ..
अहंकारो हि जीवात्मा सर्वः स्यात्कोटिहीनकः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Whatever worlds are situated in the cosmic egg are all within this body. / The individual soul is indeed the ego, [though] it is entirely devoid of multiplicity.

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇo'ṇoraṇīyāṃśca ṣoḍaśātmā sanātanaḥ ..
indriyāṇi manaścaiva pañca cendriyagocarāḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
पुराणोऽणोरणीयांश्च षोडशात्मा सनातनः ..
इन्द्रियाणि मनश्चैव पञ्च चेन्द्रियगोचराः .. 18 ..
text_mt: It is ancient, subtler than the subtle, sixteenfold, and eternal: / the senses, the mind, and the five objects of the senses.

sanskrit_iast:
jñeyo jīvaḥ śarīre'sminsa īśaguṇabaṃdhitaḥ ..
īśo hyaṣṭādaśātmā vai śaṃkaro jīvaśaṃkaraḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
ज्ञेयो जीवः शरीरेऽस्मिन्स ईशगुणबंधितः ..
ईशो ह्यष्टादशात्मा वै शंकरो जीवशंकरः .. 19 ..
text_mt: The soul in this body is to be known as bound by the qualities of the Lord. / The Lord is eighteenfold, Śaṅkara, the benefactor of the soul.

sanskrit_iast:
buddhirmanaśca viṣayā iṃdriyāṇi tathaiva ca ..
ahaṃkārasya ceśo vai mahādevaḥ sanātanaḥ .. 3.4.6.20 ..
meaning:
बुद्धिर्मनश्च विषया इंद्रियाणि तथैव च ..
अहंकारस्य चेशो वै महादेवः सनातनः .. 3.4.6.20 ..
text_mt: Intellect, mind, sensory objects, and likewise the senses; / and the Lord of ego is eternal Mahādeva.

sanskrit_iast:
jīvo nārāyaṇassākṣācchaṃkareṇa vimohitaḥ ..
sa baddhastriguṇaiḥ pāśairekaśca bahudhābhavat .. .. 21 ..
meaning:
जीवो नारायणस्साक्षाच्छंकरेण विमोहितः ..
स बद्धस्त्रिगुणैः पाशैरेकश्च बहुधाभवत् .. .. 21 ..
text_mt: The embodied soul is directly Nārāyaṇa, deluded by Śaṅkara; / bound by the three strands as if by snares, though one, it became manifold.

sanskrit_iast:
kālātmā bhagavānīśo mahākalpasvarūpakaḥ ..
śivakalpo brahmakalpo viṣṇukalpastṛtīyakaḥ ..
īśanetrāṇi tānyeva bandhakalpaścaturthakaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
कालात्मा भगवानीशो महाकल्पस्वरूपकः ..
शिवकल्पो ब्रह्मकल्पो विष्णुकल्पस्तृतीयकः ..
ईशनेत्राणि तान्येव बन्धकल्पश्चतुर्थकः .. 22 ..
text_mt: The Lord, the supreme master, is the embodiment of time, consisting of the great kalpas: / the Śivakalpa, the Brahmakalpa, and the Viṣṇukalpa as the third; / those very ones are the eyes of the Lord, and the Bandhakalpa is the fourth.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyukalpo vahnikalpo brahmāṃḍo liṃgakalpakaḥ ..
īśavaktrāṇi pañcaiva tattvajñaiḥ kathitāni vai .. 23 ..
meaning:
वायुकल्पो वह्निकल्पो ब्रह्मांडो लिंगकल्पकः ..
ईशवक्त्राणि पञ्चैव तत्त्वज्ञैः कथितानि वै .. 23 ..
text_mt: The Vāyukalpa, the Vahnikalpa, the Brahmāṇḍa, and the Liṅgakalpa— / these five are indeed spoken of by the knowers of reality as the faces of the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyakalpaśca tathā tathā garuḍaka lpakaḥ ..
kalpo bhāgavataścaiva mārkaṇḍeyaśca kalpakaḥ ..24..
meaning:
भविष्यकल्पश्च तथा तथा गरुडक ल्पकः ..
कल्पो भागवतश्चैव मार्कण्डेयश्च कल्पकः ..24..
text_mt: And likewise the Bhaviṣyakalpa, as well as the Garuḍakalpa, / the Bhāgavatakalpa, and the Mārkaṇḍeyakalpa,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmanaśca nṛsiṃhaśca varāho matsyakūrmakau ..
jñānātmano maheśasya jñeyā daśa bhujā budhaiḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
वामनश्च नृसिंहश्च वराहो मत्स्यकूर्मकौ ..
ज्ञानात्मनो महेशस्य ज्ञेया दश भुजा बुधैः .. 25 ..
text_mt: and Vāmana, Nṛsiṃha, Varāha, Matsya, and Kūrma: / these should be known by the wise as the ten arms of Maheśa, whose essence is knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭādaśadineṣveva brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ ..
kalpāścāṣṭādaśāssarve budhairjñeyā vilomataḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
अष्टादशदिनेष्वेव ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः ..
कल्पाश्चाष्टादशास्सर्वे बुधैर्ज्ञेया विलोमतः .. 26 ..
text_mt: Over the eighteen days of Brahmā, whose birth is unmanifest, / all eighteen kalpas should be known by the wise in reverse order.

sanskrit_iast:
kūrmakalpaśca tatrādyo matsyakalpo dvitīyakaḥ ..
tṛtīyaḥ śvetavārāhaḥ kalpo jñeyaḥ purātanaiḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
कूर्मकल्पश्च तत्राद्यो मत्स्यकल्पो द्वितीयकः ..
तृतीयः श्वेतवाराहः कल्पो ज्ञेयः पुरातनैः .. 27 ..
text_mt: Among them, the Kūrmakalpa is the first, the Matsyakalpa is the second, / and the third should be known by the ancients as the Śvetavārāha kalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
dvidhā ca bhagavānbrahmā sūkṣmaḥ sthūlo'guṇo guṇī ..
saguṇaḥ sa virāṇnāmnā viṣṇu nābhisamudbhavaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
द्विधा च भगवान्ब्रह्मा सूक्ष्मः स्थूलोऽगुणो गुणी ..
सगुणः स विराण्नाम्ना विष्णु नाभिसमुद्भवः .. 28 ..
text_mt: And the Lord Brahmā is twofold: subtle and gross, without qualities and endowed with qualities. / The one endowed with qualities is called Virāj, born from the navel of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
nirguṇovyayarūpaścāvyaktajanmā svabhūḥ svayam ..
brahmaṇaḥ saguṇasyaiva śatāyuḥ kālanirmitam .. 29 ..
meaning:
निर्गुणोव्ययरूपश्चाव्यक्तजन्मा स्वभूः स्वयम् ..
ब्रह्मणः सगुणस्यैव शतायुः कालनिर्मितम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: The one without qualities is imperishable in nature, born from the unmanifest, self-existent himself. / The lifespan of Brahmā endowed with qualities is ordained by time as one hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
ūnaviṃśasahasrāṇi lakṣaiko mānuṣābdakaiḥ ..
ebhirvarṣairdinaṃ jñeyaṃ virājo brahmaṇaḥ svayam .. 3.4.6.30 ..
meaning:
ऊनविंशसहस्राणि लक्षैको मानुषाब्दकैः ..
एभिर्वर्षैर्दिनं ज्ञेयं विराजो ब्रह्मणः स्वयम् .. 3.4.6.30 ..
text_mt: One hundred and nineteen thousand human years— / by these years, a single day of Virāj-Brahmā himself is to be known.

sanskrit_iast:
nirguṇo'vyaktajanmā ca kālātsarveśvaraḥ paraḥ ..
avyaktaṃ prakṛtirjñeyā dvādaśāṃgāni vai tataḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
निर्गुणोऽव्यक्तजन्मा च कालात्सर्वेश्वरः परः ..
अव्यक्तं प्रकृतिर्ज्ञेया द्वादशांगानि वै ततः .. 31 ..
text_mt: He who is without qualities, born of the unmanifest, is the supreme ruler of all, beyond time. / The unmanifest is to be known as Prakṛti; from it, indeed, come the twelve limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
indriyāṇi mano buddhiravyaktasya smṛtāni vai ..
avyaktācca paraṃ brahma sūkṣmajyotistadavyayam .. 32 ..
meaning:
इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिरव्यक्तस्य स्मृतानि वै ..
अव्यक्ताच्च परं ब्रह्म सूक्ष्मज्योतिस्तदव्ययम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: The sense organs, the mind, and the intellect are traditionally taught as belonging to the unmanifest. / Beyond the unmanifest is the supreme Brahman, that subtle, imperishable light.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā vyakte svayaṃ prāpto'vyaktajanmā hi saṃsmṛtaḥ ..
śatavarṣasamādhistho yastiṣṭhecca niraṃtaram .. 33 ..
meaning:
यदा व्यक्ते स्वयं प्राप्तोऽव्यक्तजन्मा हि संस्मृतः ..
शतवर्षसमाधिस्थो यस्तिष्ठेच्च निरंतरम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: When he who is known as born of the unmanifest arrives in the manifest himself, / whoever remains continuously absorbed in samādhi for a hundred years,

sanskrit_iast:
sūkṣmo manonilo bhūtvā gacchedvai brahmaṇaḥ padam ..
satya lokamiti jñeyaṃ yogagamyaṃ sanātanam ..34..
meaning:
सूक्ष्मो मनोनिलो भूत्वा गच्छेद्वै ब्रह्मणः पदम् ..
सत्य लोकमिति ज्ञेयं योगगम्यं सनातनम् ..34..
text_mt: becoming subtle as the wind of the mind, will go to the abode of Brahmā, / known as Satyaloka, accessible through yoga, eternal.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra sthāne tu munayo gatāḥ sarve samādhinā ..
tatroṣitvā ca lakṣābdaṃ bhūrlokātkṣaṇamātrakam ..35..
meaning:
तत्र स्थाने तु मुनयो गताः सर्वे समाधिना ..
तत्रोषित्वा च लक्षाब्दं भूर्लोकात्क्षणमात्रकम् ..35..
text_mt: All the sages, having gone to that realm through samādhi, / and having dwelt there for a hundred thousand years—which was but a moment from the perspective of the earthly realm—

sanskrit_iast:
saccidānaṃdaghanakaṃ tataḥ prāptāḥ kalevare ..
netrāṇi ca samunmīlya saṃprāpte dvitayāhnike .. 36 ..
meaning:
सच्चिदानंदघनकं ततः प्राप्ताः कलेवरे ..
नेत्राणि च समुन्मील्य संप्राप्ते द्वितयाह्निके .. 36 ..
text_mt: then returned into their physical bodies, dense with being, consciousness, and bliss; / and opening their eyes when the second day arrived,

sanskrit_iast:
dadṛśurmanujānsarvānpaśutulyānhi sūkṣmakān..
ṣaṣṭyabdāyuryutānghorānsārddhakiṣkudvayonnatān ..37..
meaning:
ददृशुर्मनुजान्सर्वान्पशुतुल्यान्हि सूक्ष्मकान्..
षष्ट्यब्दायुर्युतान्घोरान्सार्द्धकिष्कुद्वयोन्नतान् ..37..
text_mt: they saw all men to be like beasts, diminished in size, / with a lifespan of sixty years, terrible, two and a half cubits tall.

sanskrit_iast:
kvacitkvacitsthitā varṇā varṇasaṃkarasannibhāḥ ..
sarve mlecchāśca pāṣaṃḍā bahurūpamato sthitāḥ ..38..
meaning:
क्वचित्क्वचित्स्थिता वर्णा वर्णसंकरसन्निभाः ..
सर्वे म्लेच्छाश्च पाषंडा बहुरूपमतो स्थिताः ..38..
text_mt: The classes remained here and there resembling a confusion of castes; / all were barbarians and heretics, established in various sectarian views.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthāni sakalā vedāstyaktvā bhūmaṃḍalaṃ tadā ..
gopyo bhūtvā ca hariṇā sārddhaṃ cakrurmahotsavam 39 ..
meaning:
तीर्थानि सकला वेदास्त्यक्त्वा भूमंडलं तदा ..
गोप्यो भूत्वा च हरिणा सार्द्धं चक्रुर्महोत्सवम् 39 ..
text_mt: All the sacred fords and the Vedas then abandoned the earth, / and, having become cowherdesses, celebrated a great festival together with Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
pāṣaṃḍā bahujātīyā nānāmārgapradarśakāḥ ..
kalinā nirmitānvarṇānvaṃcayitvā sthitā bhuvi .. 3.4.6.40 ..
meaning:
पाषंडा बहुजातीया नानामार्गप्रदर्शकाः ..
कलिना निर्मितान्वर्णान्वंचयित्वा स्थिता भुवि .. 3.4.6.40 ..
text_mt: The heretics, belonging to many sects and showing various paths, / remained on earth having deceived the castes created by the Kali age.

sanskrit_iast:
iti dṛṣṭvā tu munayo romaharṣaṇamaṃtike ..
gatvā tatra bhaviṣyaṃti tataḥ prāṃjalayo hi te .. 41 ..
meaning:
इति दृष्ट्वा तु मुनयो रोमहर्षणमंतिके ..
गत्वा तत्र भविष्यंति ततः प्रांजलयो हि ते .. 41 ..
text_mt: Having seen this, the sages went near Romaharṣaṇa; / there, with folded hands, they will stand before him.

sanskrit_iast:
taiśca tatra stutaḥ sūto yoganidrāṃ sanātanīm ..
kathayiṣyati saṃtyajya kalpākhyānaṃ munīnprati ..
tacchṛṇuṣva nṛpaśreṣṭha yathā sūtena varṇitam .. 42 ..
meaning:
तैश्च तत्र स्तुतः सूतो योगनिद्रां सनातनीम् ..
कथयिष्यति संत्यज्य कल्पाख्यानं मुनीन्प्रति ..
तच्छृणुष्व नृपश्रेष्ठ यथा सूतेन वर्णितम् .. 42 ..
text_mt: Praised there by them, the Sūta, abandoning his eternal yogic slumber, / will narrate the account of the kalpas to the sages. / Hear that, O best of kings, just as it was described by the Sūta.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
kalpākhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi yaddṛṣṭaṃ yoganidrayā ..
tacchṛṇudhvaṃ muniśreṣṭhā lakṣābdāṃte yathābhavat ..43..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
कल्पाख्यानं प्रवक्ष्यामि यद्दृष्टं योगनिद्रया ..
तच्छृणुध्वं मुनिश्रेष्ठा लक्षाब्दांते यथाभवत् ..43..
text_mt: Sūta said: / I shall declare the account of the kalpas that was seen through yogic slumber. / Listen to that, O best of sages, as it happened at the end of a hundred thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
mukulānvayasaṃbhūto mlecchabhūpaḥ piśācakaḥ ..
nāmnā timiraliṃgaśca madhyadeśamupāyayau .. 44 ..
meaning:
मुकुलान्वयसंभूतो म्लेच्छभूपः पिशाचकः ..
नाम्ना तिमिरलिंगश्च मध्यदेशमुपाययौ .. 44 ..
text_mt: Born in the lineage of Mukula, a barbarian king, a demon / named Timiraliṅga, arrived in the Middle Country.

sanskrit_iast:
āryānmlecchāṃstadā bhūpāñjitvā kālasvarūpakaḥ ..
dehalīnagarīmadhye mahāvadhamakārayat .. 45 ..
meaning:
आर्यान्म्लेच्छांस्तदा भूपाञ्जित्वा कालस्वरूपकः ..
देहलीनगरीमध्ये महावधमकारयत् .. 45 ..
text_mt: Having conquered both the Āryan and barbarian kings, that embodiment of death / caused a great slaughter within the city of Dehalī.

sanskrit_iast:
āhūya sakalānviprānāryadeśanivāsinaḥ ..
uvāca vacanaṃ dhīmānyūyaṃ mūrtiprapūjakāḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
आहूय सकलान्विप्रानार्यदेशनिवासिनः ..
उवाच वचनं धीमान्यूयं मूर्तिप्रपूजकाः .. 46 ..
text_mt: Summoning all the brahmins dwelling in the Āryan country, / the shrewd man spoke these words: 'You are idol-worshippers.

sanskrit_iast:
nirmitā yena vā mūrtistasya putrīsamā smṛtā ..
tasyāḥ kiṃ pūjanaṃ śuddhaṃ śālagrāmaśilāmayam ..
viṣṇudevaśca yuṣmābhiḥ proktaḥ sa tu na vai hariḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
निर्मिता येन वा मूर्तिस्तस्य पुत्रीसमा स्मृता ..
तस्याः किं पूजनं शुद्धं शालग्रामशिलामयम् ..
विष्णुदेवश्च युष्माभिः प्रोक्तः स तु न वै हरिः .. 47 ..
text_mt: By whomever an idol is fashioned, it is considered like his daughter. / What pure worship can there be of that, or of what is made of śālagrāma stone? / And that god Viṣṇu spoken of by you is certainly not Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
ato vaḥ sakalā vedāḥ śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca ..
vṛthā kṛtāni munibhirlokavañcanahetave ..
ityuktvā tānbalādgṛhya jvaladagnau samākṣipat ..48..
meaning:
अतो वः सकला वेदाः शास्त्राणि विविधानि च ..
वृथा कृतानि मुनिभिर्लोकवञ्चनहेतवे ..
इत्युक्त्वा तान्बलाद्गृह्य ज्वलदग्नौ समाक्षिपत् ..48..
text_mt: Therefore all your Vedas and various sacred texts / were composed in vain by sages for the purpose of deceiving the world.' / Having spoken thus, he seized them by force and cast them into a blazing fire.

sanskrit_iast:
śālagrāmaśilāḥ sarvā balātteṣāṃ supūjyakāḥ ..
gṛhītvā coṣṭrapṛṣṭheṣu samāropya gṛhaṃ yayau ..49..
meaning:
शालग्रामशिलाः सर्वा बलात्तेषां सुपूज्यकाः ..
गृहीत्वा चोष्ट्रपृष्ठेषु समारोप्य गृहं ययौ ..49..
text_mt: Forcibly taking all their highly venerated śālagrāma stones / and loading them onto the backs of camels, he went home.

sanskrit_iast:
taittiraṃ deśamāgamya durgaṃ tatra cakāra saḥ ..
śālagrāmaśilānāṃ ca svāsanārohaṇaṃ kṛtam .. 3.4.6.50 ..
meaning:
तैत्तिरं देशमागम्य दुर्गं तत्र चकार सः ..
शालग्रामशिलानां च स्वासनारोहणं कृतम् .. 3.4.6.50 ..
text_mt: Having reached the Taittira country, he built a fortress there, / and used the śālagrāma stones as steps to mount his throne.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu sakalā devā duḥkhitā vāsavaṃ prabhum ..
samūcurbahudhālapya devadevaṃ śacīpatim ..51..
meaning:
तदा तु सकला देवा दुःखिता वासवं प्रभुम् ..
समूचुर्बहुधालप्य देवदेवं शचीपतिम् ..51..
text_mt: Then all the gods, distressed, spoke in various ways, / crying out to Lord Vāsava, the god of gods, husband of Śacī:

sanskrit_iast:
vayaṃ tu bhagavansarve śālagrāmaśilāsthitāḥ ..
tyaktvā mūrtīśca sakalāḥ kṛṣṇāṃśena prabodhitāḥ ..
śālagrāmaśilāmadhye vasāmo muditā vayam ..52 ..
meaning:
वयं तु भगवन्सर्वे शालग्रामशिलास्थिताः ..
त्यक्त्वा मूर्तीश्च सकलाः कृष्णांशेन प्रबोधिताः ..
शालग्रामशिलामध्ये वसामो मुदिता वयम् ..52 ..
text_mt: 'Lord, all of us dwell in the śālagrāma stones; / having abandoned all idols, awakened by an aṃśa of Kṛṣṇa, / we reside happily within the śālagrāma stones.

sanskrit_iast:
śilāssarvāśca no deva śāladeśasamudbhavāḥ ..
tāśca vai mleccharājena svapadārohaṇīkṛtāḥ ..53..
meaning:
शिलास्सर्वाश्च नो देव शालदेशसमुद्भवाः ..
ताश्च वै म्लेच्छराजेन स्वपदारोहणीकृताः ..53..
text_mt: All our stones, O god, originated in the Śāla country; / and those very stones have been made into footstools by the barbarian king.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ devānāṃ bhagavānsvarāṭ..
jñātvā balikṛtaṃ sarvaṃ devapūjānirākṛtam .. 54 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं देवानां भगवान्स्वराट्..
ज्ञात्वा बलिकृतं सर्वं देवपूजानिराकृतम् .. 54 ..
text_mt: Hearing these words of the gods, the blessed sovereign ruler, / knowing that everything had been done by Bali and that the worship of the gods was obstructed,

sanskrit_iast:
cukopa bhagavānindro daityānpratyabhravāhanaḥ ..
gṛhītvā vajramatulaṃ svāyudhaṃ daityanāśanam ..
taittire preṣayāmāsa deśe mlecchanivāsake .. 55 ..
meaning:
चुकोप भगवानिन्द्रो दैत्यान्प्रत्यभ्रवाहनः ..
गृहीत्वा वज्रमतुलं स्वायुधं दैत्यनाशनम् ..
तैत्तिरे प्रेषयामास देशे म्लेच्छनिवासके .. 55 ..
text_mt: Lord Indra, who rides the clouds, grew furious at the demons; / grasping his incomparable thunderbolt, his own weapon that destroys demons, / he hurled it into the Taittira country, the dwelling place of the barbarian.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya śabdena sakalā deśāśca bahubhinnakāḥ ..
sa mleccho maraṇaṃ prāptastadā sarvasabhājanaiḥ ..56..
meaning:
तस्य शब्देन सकला देशाश्च बहुभिन्नकाः ..
स म्लेच्छो मरणं प्राप्तस्तदा सर्वसभाजनैः ..56..
text_mt: By its sound all the regions were greatly shattered; / that barbarian met his death, together with all his courtiers.

sanskrit_iast:
śālagrāmaśilāḥ sarvā gṛhītvā vibudhāstadā ..
gaṃḍakyāṃ ca samākṣipya svargalokamupāyayuḥ ..57..
meaning:
शालग्रामशिलाः सर्वा गृहीत्वा विबुधास्तदा ..
गंडक्यां च समाक्षिप्य स्वर्गलोकमुपाययुः ..57..
text_mt: Then, gathering all the śālagrāma stones, the gods / cast them into the Gaṇḍakī river and returned to the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast:
mahendrastu suraiḥ sārddhaṃ devapūjyamuvāca ha ..
mahītale kalau prāpte bhagavandānavottamāḥ ..58..
meaning:
महेन्द्रस्तु सुरैः सार्द्धं देवपूज्यमुवाच ह ..
महीतले कलौ प्राप्ते भगवन्दानवोत्तमाः ..58..
text_mt: Then Mahendra, together with the gods, spoke to the teacher of the gods: / 'Lord, when the Kali age arrived on earth, the foremost among the Dānavas,

sanskrit_iast:
vedadharmaṃ samullaṃghya mama nāśanatatparāḥ ..
ato māṃ rakṣa bhagavandevaiḥ sārddhaṃ kalau yuge ..59..
meaning:
वेदधर्मं समुल्लंघ्य मम नाशनतत्पराः ..
अतो मां रक्ष भगवन्देवैः सार्द्धं कलौ युगे ..59..
text_mt: transgressing Vedic duty, became intent upon my destruction. / Therefore, O Lord, protect me along with the gods in the Kali age.'

sanskrit_iast:
..jīva uvāca .. ..
mahendra tava yā patnī śacī nāmnā mahottamā ..
dadau tasyai varaṃ viṣṇurbhavitāsmi sutaḥ kalau ..3.4.6.60..
meaning:
..जीव उवाच .. ..
महेन्द्र तव या पत्नी शची नाम्ना महोत्तमा ..
ददौ तस्यै वरं विष्णुर्भवितास्मि सुतः कलौ ..3.4.6.60..
text_mt: Jīva said: / 'O Mahendra, to that most excellent wife of yours named Śacī, / Viṣṇu gave a boon: "I shall become your son in the Kali age."

sanskrit_iast:
tvadājñayā ca sā devī purīṃ śāṃtimayīṃ śubhām..
gauḍadeśe ca gaṃgāyāḥ kūle lokanivāsinīm ..61..
meaning:
त्वदाज्ञया च सा देवी पुरीं शांतिमयीं शुभाम्..
गौडदेशे च गंगायाः कूले लोकनिवासिनीम् ..61..
text_mt: And by your command, that goddess [shall go to] the auspicious city full of peace, / in the Gauḍa country on the bank of the Gaṅgā, where people dwell.'

sanskrit_iast:
pratyāgatya dvijo bhūtvā kāryasiddhiṃ kariṣyati ..
bhavānvai brāhmaṇo bhūtvā devakāryaṃ prasādhaya .. .. 62 ..
meaning:
प्रत्यागत्य द्विजो भूत्वा कार्यसिद्धिं करिष्यति ..
भवान्वै ब्राह्मणो भूत्वा देवकार्यं प्रसाधय .. .. 62 ..
text_mt: Returning and becoming a twice-born, he will accomplish the objective. / You yourself indeed, becoming a brāhmaṇa, accomplish the task of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā gurorvākyaṃ rudrairekādaśaiḥ saha ..
aṣṭabhirvasubhiḥ sārdhamaśvibhyāṃ sa ca vāsavaḥ .. 63 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा गुरोर्वाक्यं रुद्रैरेकादशैः सह ..
अष्टभिर्वसुभिः सार्धमश्विभ्यां स च वासवः .. 63 ..
text_mt: Having heard this word of the preceptor, along with the eleven Rudras, / together with the eight Vasus and the two Aśvins, that Vāsava,

sanskrit_iast:
tīrtharājamupāgamya prayāgaṃ ca ravipriyam..
māghe tu makare sūrye sūryadevamatoṣayat.. 64 ..
meaning:
तीर्थराजमुपागम्य प्रयागं च रविप्रियम्..
माघे तु मकरे सूर्ये सूर्यदेवमतोषयत्.. 64 ..
text_mt: having approached Prayāga, the king of sacred fords, dear to the Sun, / in Māgha when the sun was in Capricorn, propitiated the Sun God.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatistadāgatya sūryamāhātmyamuttamam..
indrādīnkathayāmāsa dvādaśādhyāyamāpaṭhan..65..
meaning:
बृहस्पतिस्तदागत्य सूर्यमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम्..
इन्द्रादीन्कथयामास द्वादशाध्यायमापठन्..65..
text_mt: Bṛhaspati, having arrived then, recited twelve chapters, / relating the supreme majesty of the Sun to Indra and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
bṛhaspatistu bhagavānmunirdevānsamāsthitān ..
kiṃ provāca ca māhātmyaṃ maṃḍalasthasya vai raveḥ ..1..
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
बृहस्पतिस्तु भगवान्मुनिर्देवान्समास्थितान् ..
किं प्रोवाच च माहात्म्यं मंडलस्थस्य वै रवेः ..1..
text_mt: The sages said: / What majesty of the Sun abiding in his disc did the venerable sage Bṛhaspati indeed proclaim / to the assembled gods?
title: Rāmānaṃdaniṃbārkasamutpāttivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
tatsarvaṃ kṛpayā brahmanbrūhi nastatsamutsukān ..
iti śrutvā vacasteṣāṃ sūto vacanamabravīt ..2..
meaning:
तत्सर्वं कृपया ब्रह्मन्ब्रूहि नस्तत्समुत्सुकान् ..
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तेषां सूतो वचनमब्रवीत् ..2..
text_mt: O brāhmaṇa, graciously tell all that to us who are eager for it. / Having heard their speech, Sūta spoke [these] words:

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiṃ samāsīnaṃ jīvarūpaṃ guṇālayam ..
prayāgastho mahendraśca suraiḥ sārddhamuvāca ha..3..
meaning:
बृहस्पतिं समासीनं जीवरूपं गुणालयम् ..
प्रयागस्थो महेन्द्रश्च सुरैः सार्द्धमुवाच ह..3..
text_mt: To Bṛhaspati, who was seated, the embodiment of Jīva, an abode of virtues, / great Indra, residing at Prayāga, spoke along with the gods:

sanskrit_iast:
kathayasva mahābhāga sūryamāhātmyamuttamam..
yacchrutena raviḥ sākṣātprasannodya bhavetprabhuḥ..4..
meaning:
कथयस्व महाभाग सूर्यमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम्..
यच्छ्रुतेन रविः साक्षात्प्रसन्नोद्य भवेत्प्रभुः..4..
text_mt: Relate, O highly fortunate one, the supreme majesty of the Sun, / by the hearing of which the lord Sun may become directly pleased today.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca..
dhātṛśarmā dvijaḥ kaścidapatyārthe prajāpatim..
tapasā toṣayāmāsa barhiṣmatipure sthitaḥ..5..
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच..
धातृशर्मा द्विजः कश्चिदपत्यार्थे प्रजापतिम्..
तपसा तोषयामास बर्हिष्मतिपुरे स्थितः..5..
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / A certain twice-born named Dhātṛśarman, residing in the city of Barhiṣmatī, / propitiated Prajāpati through ascetic penance for the sake of offspring.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcamābde tu bhagavānsaṃtuṣṭaśca prajāpatiḥ..
sutaṃ kanyāṃ punaḥ putraṃ trīṇyapatyāni saṃdadau ..6..
meaning:
पंचमाब्दे तु भगवान्संतुष्टश्च प्रजापतिः..
सुतं कन्यां पुनः पुत्रं त्रीण्यपत्यानि संददौ ..6..
text_mt: In the fifth year, the venerable Prajāpati, being well pleased, / bestowed three offspring: a son, a daughter, and again a son.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣāṃtare janayitvā tryapatya sa dvijottamaḥ ..
dhātṛśarmā paraṃ harṣamāptavānputralālanaiḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
वर्षांतरे जनयित्वा त्र्यपत्य स द्विजोत्तमः ..
धातृशर्मा परं हर्षमाप्तवान्पुत्रलालनैः .. 7 ..
text_mt: Having fathered three offspring at yearly intervals, that best of twice-born, / Dhātṛśarman, attained supreme joy through fondling his children.

sanskrit_iast:
vivāhāśca kathaṃ teṣāṃ bhavitavyā mahottamāḥ ..
iti cintānvito vipro gaṃdharveśaṃ ca tumburum .. 8 ..
meaning:
विवाहाश्च कथं तेषां भवितव्या महोत्तमाः ..
इति चिन्तान्वितो विप्रो गंधर्वेशं च तुम्बुरुम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: “How shall their highly auspicious marriages take place?” / Filled with anxiety thus, the brāhmaṇa [propitiated] Tumburu, lord of the gandharvas,

sanskrit_iast:
havanaistoṣayāmāsa varṣamātravidhānataḥ ..
tumburuśca tadāgatya taṃ cakāra manoratham .. 9 ..
meaning:
हवनैस्तोषयामास वर्षमात्रविधानतः ..
तुम्बुरुश्च तदागत्य तं चकार मनोरथम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: pleasing [him] with fire oblations according to rule for the space of a year. / And Tumburu, arriving then, fulfilled that desire.

sanskrit_iast:
prasannastu tadā vipro vadhūrjāmātaraṃ mudā ..
dṛṣṭvā teṣāṃ vihāraṃ ca punaściṃtāṃ cakāra ha .. 3.4.7.10 ..
meaning:
प्रसन्नस्तु तदा विप्रो वधूर्जामातरं मुदा ..
दृष्ट्वा तेषां विहारं च पुनश्चिंतां चकार ह .. 3.4.7.10 ..
text_mt: Pleased, the brāhmaṇa then, having seen with joy his daughters-in-law and sons-in-law / and their merriment, again fell into anxiety:

sanskrit_iast:
bhūṣaṇāni ca vāsāṃsi dhanāni vividhāni ca ..
teṣāṃ kathaṃ bhaviṣyaṃti nirdhanānāṃ mamāśuca .. 11 ..
meaning:
भूषणानि च वासांसि धनानि विविधानि च ..
तेषां कथं भविष्यंति निर्धनानां ममाशुच .. 11 ..
text_mt: “How will there be ornaments, clothes, and various kinds of wealth / for them, who are destitute, and [what of] my sorrow?”

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭivarṣamayo bhūtvā caṃdanādyairdhanādhipam ..
vidhivatpūjayāmāsa varṣamātraṃ tu tatparaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
षष्टिवर्षमयो भूत्वा चंदनाद्यैर्धनाधिपम् ..
विधिवत्पूजयामास वर्षमात्रं तु तत्परः .. 12 ..
text_mt: Having reached sixty years of age, devoted to that, he worshipped the lord of wealth according to rule / with sandalwood and other [offerings] for just a year.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prasanno bhagavāndadau tasmai dhanaṃ bahu ..
vidyāṃ yakṣamayīṃ ramyāṃ paṃcasvarṇapradāṃ mudā .. 13 ..
meaning:
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवान्ददौ तस्मै धनं बहु ..
विद्यां यक्षमयीं रम्यां पंचस्वर्णप्रदां मुदा .. 13 ..
text_mt: Then, being pleased, the lord joyfully gave him much wealth / and a charming knowledge pertaining to the yakṣas, which bestows five gold [coins].

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrajāpī saṃpūjya havanaṃ taddaśāṃśakam ..
tarpaṇaṃ mārjanaṃ caiva kṛtvā vāṃchāmavāptavān ..14..
meaning:
सहस्रजापी संपूज्य हवनं तद्दशांशकम् ..
तर्पणं मार्जनं चैव कृत्वा वांछामवाप्तवान् ..14..
text_mt: Reciting [the mantra] a thousand times, having worshipped, having offered one-tenth of that as fire oblations, / and having performed libation and sprinkling, he obtained his desire.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ vartamānasya gataḥ kālo mahānsvayam ..
mṛtyorāgamanaṃ tasya jātaṃ rogasamanvitam .. 15 ..
meaning:
इत्येवं वर्तमानस्य गतः कालो महान्स्वयम् ..
मृत्योरागमनं तस्य जातं रोगसमन्वितम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: As he was living in this manner, a great length of time passed of itself. / The approach of death came upon him, accompanied by illness.

sanskrit_iast:
pīḍitastu rujā vipraḥ śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram ..
stutibhiḥ śrutirūpābhistuṣṭāva balavarjitaḥ ..
māsamātreṇa bhagavāndadau jñānaṃ svayaṃ haraḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
पीडितस्तु रुजा विप्रः शंकरं लोकशंकरम् ..
स्तुतिभिः श्रुतिरूपाभिस्तुष्टाव बलवर्जितः ..
मासमात्रेण भगवान्ददौ ज्ञानं स्वयं हरः .. 16 ..
text_mt: Tormented by disease, bereft of strength, the brāhmaṇa praised Śaṅkara, / the benefactor of the world, with hymns in the form of Vedic verses; / in just a month, the venerable Hara himself gave [him] knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
dhātṛśarmā tu tatprāpya bhāskaraṃ mohanāśanam ..
sūryavāravrataistatra toṣayāmāsa namradhīḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
धातृशर्मा तु तत्प्राप्य भास्करं मोहनाशनम् ..
सूर्यवारव्रतैस्तत्र तोषयामास नम्रधीः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Having obtained that, Dhātṛśarman, with humble mind, / propitiated the Sun, the destroyer of delusion, with Sunday observances there.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcābde bhagavānsūryo bhaktibhāvena vatsalaḥ ..
caitryāṃ tamāha vacanaṃ varaṃ brūhi punaḥ punaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
पंचाब्दे भगवान्सूर्यो भक्तिभावेन वत्सलः ..
चैत्र्यां तमाह वचनं वरं ब्रूहि पुनः पुनः .. 18 ..
text_mt: In the fifth year, the venerable Sun, affectionate because of his devotional disposition, / said to him on the full moon day of Caitra: “Ask a boon,” again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
dhātṛśarmā tu tacchrutvā bhāskaraṃ mohanāśanam ..
praśrayāvanato bhūtvā tuṣṭāva parayā girā.. 19 ..
meaning:
धातृशर्मा तु तच्छ्रुत्वा भास्करं मोहनाशनम् ..
प्रश्रयावनतो भूत्वा तुष्टाव परया गिरा.. 19 ..
text_mt: Having heard that, Dhātṛśarman, bowing down with modesty / before the Sun, the destroyer of delusion, praised [him] with exalted speech.

sanskrit_iast:
.. dhātṛśarmovāca .. ..
pravṛttiśca nivṛttiśca manasosya tanau priyā ..
rātrirūpā pravṛttiśca nivṛttirdinarūpiṇī..
bhavatastejasā jāte lokabaṃdhanahetave..3.4.7.20..
meaning:
.. धातृशर्मोवाच .. ..
प्रवृत्तिश्च निवृत्तिश्च मनसोस्य तनौ प्रिया ..
रात्रिरूपा प्रवृत्तिश्च निवृत्तिर्दिनरूपिणी..
भवतस्तेजसा जाते लोकबंधनहेतवे..3.4.7.20..
text_mt: Dhātṛśarman said: / Both active worldly life and cessation from action are dear to this mind in the body; / active worldly life has the form of night, and cessation from action has the form of day; / they have arisen from your splendor for the purpose of binding the world.

sanskrit_iast:
avyakte tu sthitaṃ tejo bhavato divyasūkṣmakam..
tridhābhūtaṃ tu viśvāya tasmai tejātmane namaḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
अव्यक्ते तु स्थितं तेजो भवतो दिव्यसूक्ष्मकम्..
त्रिधाभूतं तु विश्वाय तस्मै तेजात्मने नमः .. 21 ..
text_mt: Your divine and subtle splendor resides in the unmanifest, / yet it has become threefold for the sake of the universe; salutation to that embodiment of splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
rājasī yā smṛtā buddhistatpatirbhagavānvidhiḥ..
bhavatastejasā jātastasmai te vidhaye namaḥ..22..
meaning:
राजसी या स्मृता बुद्धिस्तत्पतिर्भगवान्विधिः..
भवतस्तेजसा जातस्तस्मै ते विधये नमः..22..
text_mt: That intellect which is termed passionate has the venerable Vidhi as its lord; / he was born from your splendor; salutation to you who are that Vidhi.

sanskrit_iast:
sāttvikī yā tanau buddhistatpatirbhagavānhariḥ..
bhavatā nirmitassattvāttasmai te haraye namaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
सात्त्विकी या तनौ बुद्धिस्तत्पतिर्भगवान्हरिः..
भवता निर्मितस्सत्त्वात्तस्मै ते हरये नमः .. 23 ..
text_mt: That intellect which is pure in the body has the venerable Hari as its lord; / he was fashioned by you out of goodness; salutation to you who are that Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmasī mohanā buddhistatpatiśca svayaṃ śivaḥ ..
tamobhūtena bhavatā jātastasmai namonamaḥ ..
dehi me bhagavanmokṣaṃ saṃjñākāṃta namonamaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
तामसी मोहना बुद्धिस्तत्पतिश्च स्वयं शिवः ..
तमोभूतेन भवता जातस्तस्मै नमोनमः ..
देहि मे भगवन्मोक्षं संज्ञाकांत नमोनमः .. 24 ..
text_mt: The intellect that is dark and delusive has Śiva himself as its lord; / he was born from you who have become darkness; salutations, salutations to him. / Bestow liberation upon me, O Lord! O beloved of Saṃjñā, salutations, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
.. bṛhaspatiruvāca .. ..
ityevaṃ saṃstutastena bhagavāndhātṛśarmaṇā ..
mahendravacanaṃ prāha taṃ dvijaṃ jñānakovidam .. 25 ..
meaning:
.. बृहस्पतिरुवाच .. ..
इत्येवं संस्तुतस्तेन भगवान्धातृशर्मणा ..
महेन्द्रवचनं प्राह तं द्विजं ज्ञानकोविदम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / Praised in this manner by Dhātṛśarman, / the venerable one spoke words, O great Indra, to that twice-born who was skilled in knowledge:

sanskrit_iast:
mokṣaścaturvidho vipra sālokyaṃ tapasodbhavam ..
sāmīpyaṃ bhaktito jātaṃ sārūpyaṃ dhyānasaṃbhavam .. .. 26 ..
meaning:
मोक्षश्चतुर्विधो विप्र सालोक्यं तपसोद्भवम् ..
सामीप्यं भक्तितो जातं सारूप्यं ध्यानसंभवम् .. .. 26 ..
text_mt: “Liberation is of four kinds, O brāhmaṇa: dwelling in the same realm arises from ascetic penance; / proximity is born from devotion; having the same form arises from meditation;

sanskrit_iast:
sāyujyaṃ jñānato jñeyaṃ teṣāṃ svāmī paraḥ pumān ..
saguṇo viguṇo jñeya ānando mokṣiṇāṃ kramāt .. 27 ..
meaning:
सायुज्यं ज्ञानतो ज्ञेयं तेषां स्वामी परः पुमान् ..
सगुणो विगुणो ज्ञेय आनन्दो मोक्षिणां क्रमात् .. 27 ..
text_mt: absorption should be known to come from knowledge; the Supreme Person is the master of these. / Bliss for the liberated is to be known successively as qualified and unqualified.

sanskrit_iast:
devānāṃ caiva deheṣu ye mokṣāḥ punarāgatāḥ ..
yadgatvā na nivartaṃte tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam .. 28 ..
meaning:
देवानां चैव देहेषु ये मोक्षाः पुनरागताः ..
यद्गत्वा न निवर्तंते तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Those liberations in the bodies of the gods are subject to return; / that highest abode of Viṣṇu is that from which, having gone, they do not return.

sanskrit_iast:
yatprasannena viprendra sāyujyaṃ me bhavettava ..
manumātraśca yaḥ kālastāvatte mokṣa āsthitaḥ ..
ityuktvāṃtardadhe devastena mokṣīkṛto dvijaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
यत्प्रसन्नेन विप्रेन्द्र सायुज्यं मे भवेत्तव ..
मनुमात्रश्च यः कालस्तावत्ते मोक्ष आस्थितः ..
इत्युक्त्वांतर्दधे देवस्तेन मोक्षीकृतो द्विजः .. 29 ..
text_mt: Since I am pleased, O best of twice-born, your absorption into me shall occur; / and as long as the duration of a Manu lasts, so long is your liberation established.” / Having spoken thus, the god vanished, and the twice-born was liberated by him.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ityuktavaṃtaṃ vāgīśaṃ caitramāse divākaraḥ ..
svarūpaṃ darśayāmāsa devadevaḥ sanātanaḥ .. 3.4.7.30 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्तवंतं वागीशं चैत्रमासे दिवाकरः ..
स्वरूपं दर्शयामास देवदेवः सनातनः .. 3.4.7.30 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / While the Lord of Speech was speaking thus in the month of Caitra, the Sun, / the eternal god of gods, showed his own form [saying]:

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇudhvaṃ sakalā devā yannimitāḥ samāgatāḥ ..
vaṃgīye svāṃśamutpādya devakāryaṃ karomyaham .. 31 ..
meaning:
शृणुध्वं सकला देवा यन्निमिताः समागताः ..
वंगीये स्वांशमुत्पाद्य देवकार्यं करोम्यहम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: “Listen, all you gods, for whose sake you have gathered! / Having produced a portion of myself in Bengal, I shall accomplish the work of the gods.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā svamukhāttejaḥ samutpādya divākaraḥ ..
svabhaktāyai sukanyāyai dvijapatnyai dadau hi tat .. 32 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा स्वमुखात्तेजः समुत्पाद्य दिवाकरः ..
स्वभक्तायै सुकन्यायै द्विजपत्न्यै ददौ हि तत् .. 32 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the Sun, having brought forth splendor from his own mouth, / gave it indeed to his devotee, Sukanyā, the wife of a twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
dhātṛśarmā dvijo yo vai sūrye mokṣamupāgataḥ ..
sa vai tattejasā jātaḥ kāvyakārasya maṃdire .. 33 ..
meaning:
धातृशर्मा द्विजो यो वै सूर्ये मोक्षमुपागतः ..
स वै तत्तेजसा जातः काव्यकारस्य मंदिरे .. 33 ..
text_mt: That twice-born Dhātṛśarman who had attained liberation in the Sun / was indeed born from that splendor in the house of a poet.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvaro nāma vikhyātaḥ purīśadvānta ātmavān ..
jitvā viprānvedaparānmahatīṃ kīrtimāptavān..34..
meaning:
ईश्वरो नाम विख्यातः पुरीशद्वान्त आत्मवान् ..
जित्वा विप्रान्वेदपरान्महतीं कीर्तिमाप्तवान्..34..
text_mt: Renowned by the name Īśvara, self-controlled, dispeller of darkness in the city of the Lord, / having defeated brāhmaṇas devoted to the Vedas, he attained great renown.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ vipra yathā jīvanabhāṣitam ..
punaḥ śṛṇu kathāṃ ramyāṃ devabhyo jīvanirmitām .. 35 ..
meaning:
इति ते कथितं विप्र यथा जीवनभाषितम् ..
पुनः शृणु कथां रम्यां देवभ्यो जीवनिर्मिताम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: Thus has been related to you, O brāhmaṇa, what was spoken by Jīvana. / Hear again the charming narrative composed by Jīva for the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
.. bṛhaspatiruvāca.. ..
māyāvatyāṃ dvijaḥ kaścinmitraśarmeti viśrutaḥ ..
kāvyavidyāparo nityaṃ rasikaḥ kāminīpriyaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
.. बृहस्पतिरुवाच.. ..
मायावत्यां द्विजः कश्चिन्मित्रशर्मेति विश्रुतः ..
काव्यविद्यापरो नित्यं रसिकः कामिनीप्रियः .. 36 ..
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / In Māyāvatī, there was a certain twice-born renowned as Mitraśarman, / always devoted to the art of poetry, a connoisseur, fond of passionate women.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṃbharāśiṃ mayi prāpte gaṃgādvāre mahotsavaḥ ..
babhūva bahu lairbhūpeḥ kāritastīrthatatparaiḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
कुंभराशिं मयि प्राप्ते गंगाद्वारे महोत्सवः ..
बभूव बहु लैर्भूपेः कारितस्तीर्थतत्परैः .. 37 ..
text_mt: When I arrived in the sign of Kumbha, a great festival at Gaṅgādvāra / was celebrated by many kings devoted to sacred places.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrotsave narā nāryyo bahubhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ ..
samāyayurdarśanārthe paramānandanirbharāḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
तत्रोत्सवे नरा नार्य्यो बहुभूषणभूषिताः ..
