समाययुर्दर्शनार्थे परमानन्दनिर्भराः .. 38 ..
text_mt: At that festival, men and women adorned with many ornaments / came to see it, filled with supreme joy.

sanskrit_iast:
mitraśarmā tu sa prāpya kāmasenasya vai sutām ..
kāvyakelikalāyuktāṃ dvādaśābdamayīṃ śubhām.. 39 ..
meaning:
मित्रशर्मा तु स प्राप्य कामसेनस्य वै सुताम् ..
काव्यकेलिकलायुक्तां द्वादशाब्दमयीं शुभाम्.. 39 ..
text_mt: Then Mitraśarman met the daughter of Kāmasena, / skilled in the arts of poetic play, twelve years of age and auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
dākṣiṇātyasya bhūpasya tanayāṃ madhurānanām ..
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ mṛgaśāvākṣīṃ tadvaśitvamupāgataḥ .. 3.4.7.40 ..
meaning:
दाक्षिणात्यस्य भूपस्य तनयां मधुराननाम् ..
दृष्ट्वा तां मृगशावाक्षीं तद्वशित्वमुपागतः .. 3.4.7.40 ..
text_mt: Seeing that fawn-eyed daughter of the southern king, / endowed with a sweet face, he fell under her sway.

sanskrit_iast:
sā tu taṃ citriṇī nāmnā mitraśarmāṇamuttamam ..
dṛṣṭvā tu mūrcchitā cāsīdvipramūrtirhadi sthitā .. 41 ..
meaning:
सा तु तं चित्रिणी नाम्ना मित्रशर्माणमुत्तमम् ..
दृष्ट्वा तु मूर्च्छिता चासीद्विप्रमूर्तिर्हदि स्थिता .. 41 ..
text_mt: And that [maiden] named Citriṇī, having seen the excellent Mitraśarman, / swooned, and the form of the brahmin remained in her heart.

sanskrit_iast:
svagehaṃ punarāgatya citriṇī bhāskaraṃ prabhum ..
pratyahaṃ pūjayāmāsa bahumānapurassarā .. 42 ..
meaning:
स्वगेहं पुनरागत्य चित्रिणी भास्करं प्रभुम् ..
प्रत्यहं पूजयामास बहुमानपुरस्सरा .. 42 ..
text_mt: Having returned to her home, Citriṇī worshipped the lord Bhāskara / every day, preceded by great reverence.

sanskrit_iast:
mitraśarmā tu tatsthāne gaṃgākūle manohare ..
prātaḥ snātvā śucirbhūtvā vaiśākhe jalamadhyagaḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
मित्रशर्मा तु तत्स्थाने गंगाकूले मनोहरे ..
प्रातः स्नात्वा शुचिर्भूत्वा वैशाखे जलमध्यगः .. 43 ..
text_mt: Mitraśarman, however, in that place on the charming bank of the Gaṅgā, / having bathed in the morning and become pure, standing in the water in the month of Vaiśākha,

sanskrit_iast:
stotramādityahṛdayamajapatsūryatatparaḥ ..
pratyahaṃ dvādaśāvartaistoṣayāmāsa bhāskaram .. 44 ..
meaning:
स्तोत्रमादित्यहृदयमजपत्सूर्यतत्परः ..
प्रत्यहं द्वादशावर्तैस्तोषयामास भास्करम् .. 44 ..
text_mt: devoted to the Sun, chanted the Ādityahṛdaya hymn; / with twelve recitations each day, he pleased Bhāskara.

sanskrit_iast:
māsānte bhagavānsūryo dadau tasmai hi taṃ varam ..
sa tu labdhavaro vipraḥ svagehaṃ punarāgataḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
मासान्ते भगवान्सूर्यो ददौ तस्मै हि तं वरम् ..
स तु लब्धवरो विप्रः स्वगेहं पुनरागतः .. 45 ..
text_mt: At the end of the month, the blessed Sun granted him that boon; / having obtained the boon, that brahmin returned to his home.

sanskrit_iast:
citriṇī tu varaṃ prāptā vāṃchitaṃ lokabhāskarāt ..
punastau pitarau svapne bhāskareṇa prabodhitau .. 46 ..
meaning:
चित्रिणी तु वरं प्राप्ता वांछितं लोकभास्करात् ..
पुनस्तौ पितरौ स्वप्ने भास्करेण प्रबोधितौ .. 46 ..
text_mt: Citriṇī, too, obtained her desired boon from the Sun of the worlds; / then both parents were awakened in a dream by Bhāskara.

sanskrit_iast:
mitraśarmāṇamāhūya varayāmāsatuḥ sutām ..
svānte nivāsayāmāsa kāmasenaśca daṃpatī..47..
meaning:
मित्रशर्माणमाहूय वरयामासतुः सुताम् ..
स्वान्ते निवासयामास कामसेनश्च दंपती..47..
text_mt: Having summoned Mitraśarman, they chose him for their daughter; / and Kāmasena made the couple dwell in his own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
tau tu cakraṃ mudāviṣṭau pratyahaṃ sūryadevatam ..
tāmrapātre ca tadyaṃtraṃ lekhayitvā vidhānataḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
तौ तु चक्रं मुदाविष्टौ प्रत्यहं सूर्यदेवतम् ..
ताम्रपात्रे च तद्यंत्रं लेखयित्वा विधानतः .. 48 ..
text_mt: Filled with joy, the two of them daily worshipped the sun deity, / having caused his yantra to be inscribed on a copper vessel according to rule.

sanskrit_iast: ījatū raktakusumairvrataṃ kṛtvā ravipriyam .. 49 ..
meaning: ईजतू रक्तकुसुमैर्व्रतं कृत्वा रविप्रियम् .. 49 ..
text_mt: Having undertaken the votive observance dear to the Sun, they worshipped him with red flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
śatābdavapuṣau cobhau nirjarau śramavarjitau ..
ārogyau maraṇaṃ prāpya sāmīpyaṃ ca ravergatau .. 3.4.7.50 ..
meaning:
शताब्दवपुषौ चोभौ निर्जरौ श्रमवर्जितौ ..
आरोग्यौ मरणं प्राप्य सामीप्यं च रवेर्गतौ .. 3.4.7.50 ..
text_mt: Both, having bodies lasting a hundred years, ageless, free from weariness, / and healthy, met death and went to the proximity of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā ravergāthāṃ vaiśākhyāṃ devarāṭ svayam ..
pratyakṣaṃ bhāskaraṃ devaṃ dadarśa sahitaṃ suraiḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा रवेर्गाथां वैशाख्यां देवराट् स्वयम् ..
प्रत्यक्षं भास्करं देवं ददर्श सहितं सुरैः .. 51 ..
text_mt: Having heard this story of the Sun on the full moon of Vaiśākha, the king of gods himself / directly beheld the divine Bhāskara along with the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktinamrānsurāndṛṣṭvā bhagavāṃstimirāpahaḥ ..
uvāca vacanaṃ ramyaṃ devakāryaparaṃ śubham ..
mamāṃśāttanayo bhūmau bhaviṣyati surottama .. 52 ..
meaning:
भक्तिनम्रान्सुरान्दृष्ट्वा भगवांस्तिमिरापहः ..
उवाच वचनं रम्यं देवकार्यपरं शुभम् ..
ममांशात्तनयो भूमौ भविष्यति सुरोत्तम .. 52 ..
text_mt: Seeing the gods bowed in devotion, the blessed Dispeller of Darkness / spoke these charming, auspicious words dedicated to the gods' work: / “Best of gods, a son will be born on earth from a portion of me.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ityuktvā svasya biṃbasya tejorāśiṃ samantataḥ ..
samutpādya kṛtaḥ kāśyāṃ rāmānaṃdastatobhavat .. 53 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्त्वा स्वस्य बिंबस्य तेजोराशिं समन्ततः ..
समुत्पाद्य कृतः काश्यां रामानंदस्ततोभवत् .. 53 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having spoken thus, producing a mass of brilliance from all around his orb / and placing it in Kāśī, Rāmānanda was born from it.

sanskrit_iast:
devalasya ca viprasya kānyakubjasya vai sutaḥ ..
bālyātprabhṛti sa jñānī rāmanāmaparāyaṇaḥ ..
pitrā mātrā parityakto rāghavaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
देवलस्य च विप्रस्य कान्यकुब्जस्य वै सुतः ..
बाल्यात्प्रभृति स ज्ञानी रामनामपरायणः ..
पित्रा मात्रा परित्यक्तो राघवं शरणं गतः .. 54 ..
text_mt: He was the son of a Kanyakubja brahmin named Devala; / a knower of truth from his childhood, devoted to the name of Rāma. / Abandoned by his father and mother, he took refuge in Rāghava.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu bhagavānsākṣāccaturdaśakalo hariḥ ..
sītāpatistaddhṛdaye nivāsaṃ kṛtavānmudā .. 55 ..
meaning:
तदा तु भगवान्साक्षाच्चतुर्दशकलो हरिः ..
सीतापतिस्तद्धृदये निवासं कृतवान्मुदा .. 55 ..
text_mt: Then indeed the blessed Hari in person, endowed with fourteen digits, / the husband of Sītā, joyfully took up residence in his heart.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ vipra mitradevāṃśato yathā ..
rāmānaṃdastu balavānharibhakteśca saṃbhavaḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
इति ते कथितं विप्र मित्रदेवांशतो यथा ..
रामानंदस्तु बलवान्हरिभक्तेश्च संभवः .. 56 ..
text_mt: Thus it has been told to you, O brahmin, how from a portion of the god Mitra / the mighty Rāmānanda was born, and the origin of devotion to Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
.. bṛhaspatiruvāca .. ..
śṛṇu śakra kathāṃ ramyāṃ jyeṣṭhamāsasya vai raveḥ..
aryamā nāma vai vipraḥ purā satyayuge hyabhūt ..
vedavedāṃgatattvajño dharmaśāstraparāyaṇaḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
.. बृहस्पतिरुवाच .. ..
शृणु शक्र कथां रम्यां ज्येष्ठमासस्य वै रवेः..
अर्यमा नाम वै विप्रः पुरा सत्ययुगे ह्यभूत् ..
वेदवेदांगतत्त्वज्ञो धर्मशास्त्रपरायणः .. 57 ..
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / Hear, O Śakra, the charming tale of the Sun in the month of Jyeṣṭha: / Formerly in the Satyayuga there lived a brahmin named Aryaman, / who knew the essence of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas and was devoted to the Dharmaśāstras.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya patnī pitṛmatī śrāddhayajñasya bhūpateḥ ..
tanayā ca mahāsādhvī sapta putrānakalmaṣān ..
aryamṇo janayāmāsa dharmaśāstraparāyaṇan.. 58 ..
meaning:
तस्य पत्नी पितृमती श्राद्धयज्ञस्य भूपतेः ..
तनया च महासाध्वी सप्त पुत्रानकल्मषान् ..
अर्यम्णो जनयामास धर्मशास्त्रपरायणन्.. 58 ..
text_mt: His wife, Pitṛmatī, the daughter of King Śrāddhayajña, / a very virtuous woman, bore to Aryaman / seven sinless sons devoted to the Dharmaśāstras.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā sa dvijo dhīmānvicāryya bahudhā hṛdi..
dhanārthī bhāskaraṃ devaṃ tuṣṭāva bahupūjanaiḥ .. 59 ..
meaning:
एकदा स द्विजो धीमान्विचार्य्य बहुधा हृदि..
धनार्थी भास्करं देवं तुष्टाव बहुपूजनैः .. 59 ..
text_mt: Once, that wise brahmin, having reflected deeply in his heart, / desiring wealth, praised the divine Bhāskara with many acts of worship:

sanskrit_iast:
prabhāte śvetakusumaiścandanādibhirarcanaiḥ ..
madhyāhne raktakusumaiḥ pītapuṣpaiḥ pitṛprasau .. 3.4.7.60 ..
meaning:
प्रभाते श्वेतकुसुमैश्चन्दनादिभिरर्चनैः ..
मध्याह्ने रक्तकुसुमैः पीतपुष्पैः पितृप्रसौ .. 3.4.7.60 ..
text_mt: at dawn with white flowers and acts of worship like sandalwood paste, / at midday with red flowers, and with yellow flowers in the evening.

sanskrit_iast:
māsamātraṃ tu vidhinā pūjayāmāsa bhāskaram ..
jyeṣṭhe vai bhagavānsūryo dadau tasmai maṇiṃ śubham .. 61 ..
meaning:
मासमात्रं तु विधिना पूजयामास भास्करम् ..
ज्येष्ठे वै भगवान्सूर्यो ददौ तस्मै मणिं शुभम् .. 61 ..
text_mt: He worshipped Bhāskara according to rule for a whole month; / in Jyeṣṭha, the blessed Sun gave him an auspicious gem.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmaṇeśca prabhāveṇa prasthamātraṃ ca kāṃcanam ..
pratyahaṃ janayāmāsa tena dharmaḥ samarjitaḥ .. 62 ..
meaning:
तन्मणेश्च प्रभावेण प्रस्थमात्रं च कांचनम् ..
प्रत्यहं जनयामास तेन धर्मः समर्जितः .. 62 ..
text_mt: By the power of that gem, he produced a prastha measure of gold / each day; by means of that, religious merit was amassed.

sanskrit_iast:
vāpīkūpataḍāgānhi tathā harmyāṇi bhūtale ..
kārayāmāsa dharmārthī sūryadevaprasādataḥ .. 63 ..
meaning:
वापीकूपतडागान्हि तथा हर्म्याणि भूतले ..
कारयामास धर्मार्थी सूर्यदेवप्रसादतः .. 63 ..
text_mt: Desiring religious merit, he caused stepped wells, regular wells, and reservoirs to be made, / as well as mansions on the earth, by the grace of the sun deity.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrābda vapurbhūtvā nirjaro nirupadravaḥ ..
tyaktvā kalevaraṃ ramyaṃ sūryalokamupāyayau ..
uṣitvā tatra lakṣābdaṃ sūryarūpo babhūva ha .. 64 ..
meaning:
सहस्राब्द वपुर्भूत्वा निर्जरो निरुपद्रवः ..
त्यक्त्वा कलेवरं रम्यं सूर्यलोकमुपाययौ ..
उषित्वा तत्र लक्षाब्दं सूर्यरूपो बभूव ह .. 64 ..
text_mt: Having attained a body lasting a thousand years, ageless and free from misfortune, / he abandoned his handsome body and departed for the world of the Sun; / having dwelled there for a hundred thousand years, he assumed the form of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ bhāskarasyaiva māhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ mayā ..
tasmācchakra suraiḥ sārddhaṃ bhaja maṃḍalagaṃ ravim .. 65 ..
meaning:
इत्येवं भास्करस्यैव माहात्म्यं कथितं मया ..
तस्माच्छक्र सुरैः सार्द्धं भज मंडलगं रविम् .. 65 ..
text_mt: In this way the greatness of Bhāskara has been told by me; / therefore, O Śakra, worship together with the gods the Sun who resides in his orb.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu te devāḥ padyaiḥ sūryakathā mayaiḥ ..
toṣayāṃcakrire premṇā jyeṣṭhamāsi ravistvasau ..
pratyakṣamabhavattatra devānāha prasannadhīḥ .. 66 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु ते देवाः पद्यैः सूर्यकथा मयैः ..
तोषयांचक्रिरे प्रेम्णा ज्येष्ठमासि रविस्त्वसौ ..
प्रत्यक्षमभवत्तत्र देवानाह प्रसन्नधीः .. 66 ..
text_mt: Having heard this, those gods, with verses consisting of the stories of the Sun, / pleased him with love in the month of Jyeṣṭha; and that Sun / appeared visibly there and, with a pleased mind, spoke to the gods:

sanskrit_iast: sudarśano dvāparānte kṛṣṇājñapto janiṣyati .. 67 ..
meaning: सुदर्शनो द्वापरान्ते कृष्णाज्ञप्तो जनिष्यति .. 67 ..
text_mt: “At the end of the Dvāparayuga, Sudarśana will be born by command of Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: To the king who spoke thus, Meghaśarman replied: / “When the month of Śrāvaṇa arrives, summon twelve Brahmins devoted to the Veda,

sanskrit_iast:

jāpayitvā sumanasā pūrṇimāyāṃ tu tadvratī ..
sūryamantrāhutīrvahnau taddaśāṃśaṃ hi taddvijaiḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
द्वादशैव समाहूय लक्षमात्रं रवेः स्वयम्..
जापयित्वा सुमनसा पूर्णिमायां तु तद्व्रती ..
सूर्यमन्त्राहुतीर्वह्नौ तद्दशांशं हि तद्द्विजैः .. 21 ..

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: in accordance with ritual injunctions, you will attain your desire and be happy.” / Hearing this, having acted accordingly, he fed the knowers of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:

भूमिमाच्छाद्य स दिशं प्रभुर्वृष्टिमकारयत्..23..

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃ yaṃ kareṇa spṛśati vṛddho bhavati vai yuvā ..
sūryadevaprabhāvena meghaśarmā tathā hyabhūt.. 25 ..
meaning:

सूर्यदेवप्रभावेन मेघशर्मा तथा ह्यभूत्.. 25 ..
text_mt: Whomever [the king] touched with his hand, an old man would become a youth; / and by the power of the Sun god, Meghaśarman likewise became thus.

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:

त्यक्त्वा प्राणान्रविर्भूत्वा सूर्यलोकमुपागमत्..
लक्षाब्द भुवमासाद्य ब्रह्मलोकं गमिष्यति ..26..
text_mt: Living for five hundred years, free from old age and calamities, / he abandoned his life-breaths and, becoming the sun, went to the world of the Sun. / Having reached the earth for a hundred thousand years, he will go to the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃvādinaṃ jīvaṃ parjanyo bhagavānraviḥ ..
svarūpaṃ darśayāmāsa prayāgaṃ prati cāgataḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
इत्येवंवादिनं जीवं पर्जन्यो भगवान्रविः ..
स्वरूपं दर्शयामास प्रयागं प्रति चागतः .. 27 ..
text_mt: To Jīva speaking thus, the blessed Sun, the rain-cloud, / revealed his true form and came toward Prayāga.

sanskrit_iast:
murā nāha prasannātmā mleccharājye kalau yuge ..
vṛndāvane samāgamya devakāryaṃ karomyaham .. 28 ..
meaning:
मुरा नाह प्रसन्नात्मा म्लेच्छराज्ये कलौ युगे ..
वृन्दावने समागम्य देवकार्यं करोम्यहम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Graciously, he said: “In the Kali age, during the reign of the mlecchas, / I shall arrive in Vṛndāvana and perform the work of the gods.”

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ityuktvā bhagavānsūryo gatvā vṛndāvanaṃ śubham ..
śrīdharo nāma vikhyātaḥ putrobhūdvedaśarmaṇaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्त्वा भगवान्सूर्यो गत्वा वृन्दावनं शुभम् ..
श्रीधरो नाम विख्यातः पुत्रोभूद्वेदशर्मणः .. 29 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having spoken thus, the blessed Sun went to auspicious Vṛndāvana, / and became the son of Vedaśarman, renowned by the name Śrīdhara.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmadbhāgavataṃ śāstraṃ samālokya viśāradaḥ ..
cakāra viduṣāmarthe pradīptaṃ śrīdharaḥ śubham ..
śrīmadbhāgavataṃ śāstraṃ purāṇopari tatkṛtam .. 3.4.8.30 ..
meaning:
श्रीमद्भागवतं शास्त्रं समालोक्य विशारदः ..
चकार विदुषामर्थे प्रदीप्तं श्रीधरः शुभम् ..
श्रीमद्भागवतं शास्त्रं पुराणोपरि तत्कृतम् .. 3.4.8.30 ..
text_mt: Having examined the scripture Śrīmad Bhāgavata, the learned Śrīdhara / composed an illuminating and auspicious [commentary] for the sake of the wise; / it was composed upon that Purāṇa, the scripture Śrīmad Bhāgavata.

sanskrit_iast:
.. jīva uvāca .. ..
purā kalau yuge prāpte prāṃśuśarmā dvijo'bhavat..
vedaśāstraparo nityaṃ devatātithipūjakaḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
.. जीव उवाच .. ..

वेदशास्त्रपरो नित्यं देवतातिथिपूजकः .. 31 ..
text_mt: Jīva said: / Formerly, when the Kali age had arrived, there was a Brahmin named Prāṃśuśarman, / ever devoted to the Vedic scriptures, a worshipper of the deities and guests,

sanskrit_iast:
satyavādī mahāsādhuḥ steyahiṃsāvivarjitaḥ ..
bhikṣāvṛttiparo nityaṃ putradāraprapoṣakaḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
सत्यवादी महासाधुः स्तेयहिंसाविवर्जितः ..
भिक्षावृत्तिपरो नित्यं पुत्रदारप्रपोषकः .. 32 ..
text_mt: truth-speaking, a great saint, free from theft and violence, / ever devoted to a livelihood of begging, providing for his sons and wife.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā pathi bhikṣārthaṃ gacchatastasya bhūpateḥ ..
māyākṛtyakaro dhūrtaḥ kalistatrākṣigocaraḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
एकदा पथि भिक्षार्थं गच्छतस्तस्य भूपतेः ..
मायाकृत्यकरो धूर्तः कलिस्तत्राक्षिगोचरः .. 33 ..
text_mt: Once, as he was walking along the path seeking alms, O king, / the rogue Kali, who works with deceit, appeared before his eyes.

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:
बभूव वाटिकां कृत्वा कलिर्दानमनोहराम् ..
तमुवाच द्विजो भूत्वा प्रांशुशर्मन्वचः शृणु .. 34 ..
text_mt: Creating a garden charming with gifts, Kali waited; / becoming a twice-born, he spoke to him: “Hear my words, Prāṃśuśarman!

sanskrit_iast:

iti vipravacaḥ śrutvā vāṭikāṃ tāṃ samāgataḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:

इति विप्रवचः श्रुत्वा वाटिकां तां समागतः .. 35 ..

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:

द्विजस्तु तत्फलं गृह्य भूमिग्राममुपाययौ ..3.4.8.40..

meaning:

किं गृहीतं त्वया विप्र दर्शयाशु प्रियं कुरु .. 41 ..
text_mt: The king arrived there and spoke to the twice-born with a pleased mind: / “What have you received, O twice-born? Show it at once and do what is pleasing.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā prāṃśuśarmā tatphalaṃ vatsamuṃḍavat ..
gṛhītvā pradadau rājñe vismito dvijasattamaḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:

गृहीत्वा प्रददौ राज्ञे विस्मितो द्विजसत्तमः .. 42 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, Prāṃśuśarman took that fruit, which resembled a calf’s severed head, / and gave it to the king, astonished, best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:

कारागारे लोहमये कृतवान्न्यायमित्रकः .. .. 43 ..
text_mt: Then that Kali, as the king, having beaten that twice-born with cane-rods, / the friend of injustice put him into an iron prison.

sanskrit_iast:
prātaḥkāle ravau prāpte prāṃśuśarmā suduḥkhitaḥ ..
tuṣṭāva bhāskaraṃ devaṃ stotrairṛgvedasaṃbhavaiḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
प्रातःकाले रवौ प्राप्ते प्रांशुशर्मा सुदुःखितः ..
तुष्टाव भास्करं देवं स्तोत्रैरृग्वेदसंभवैः .. 44 ..
text_mt: In the morning, when the sun had risen, Prāṃśuśarman, deeply grieved, / praised the divine Bhāskara with hymns originating from the Ṛgveda.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prasanno bhagavānraviḥ sākṣātsanātanaḥ ..
viprasya karṇayorvākyamuvāca nabhaseritam .. 45 ..
meaning:
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवान्रविः साक्षात्सनातनः ..
विप्रस्य कर्णयोर्वाक्यमुवाच नभसेरितम् .. 45 ..
text_mt: Then the blessed eternal Sun, directly present, was pleased, / and spoke words uttered from the sky into the twice-born’s ears:

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu vipra mahābhāga kālarūpo hariḥ svayam ..
caturyugaṃ tena kṛtaṃ viśvapālādihetave .. 46 ..
meaning:
शृणु विप्र महाभाग कालरूपो हरिः स्वयम् ..
चतुर्युगं तेन कृतं विश्वपालादिहेतवे .. 46 ..
text_mt: “Hear, O highly fortunate twice-born! Hari Himself is Time incarnate. / The four yugas were created by Him for the protection of the universe and other purposes.

sanskrit_iast:
kalirviśvasamūhānāṃ mṛtyave racitastathā ..
ato ghore kalau prāpte viṣṇumāyāvinirmitam ..

meaning:
कलिर्विश्वसमूहानां मृत्यवे रचितस्तथा ..
अतो घोरे कलौ प्राप्ते विष्णुमायाविनिर्मितम् ..
कलिञ्जरं च नगरं तत्रोष्य मुदितो भव .. 47 ..
text_mt: Kali was likewise fashioned for the destruction of the hosts of the universe. / Therefore, now that terrible Kali has arrived, reside in the city of Kaliñjara / fashioned by the Māyā of Viṣṇu, and be joyful there.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā rakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā tasya viprasya bhāskaraḥ ..

meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा रक्षणं कृत्वा तस्य विप्रस्य भास्करः ..
कलिञ्जरे च नगरे प्रेषयामास तं द्विजम् .. .. 48 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus and protected that twice-born, Bhāskara / dispatched that twice-born to the city of Kaliñjara.

sanskrit_iast:
sapādaśatavarṣaṃ ca dvijastatra vasanravim ..
ārādhya putrapatnīko ravilokamupāyayau .. 49 ..
meaning:
सपादशतवर्षं च द्विजस्तत्र वसन्रविम् ..
आराध्य पुत्रपत्नीको रविलोकमुपाययौ .. 49 ..
text_mt: Dwelling there for a hundred and twenty-five years, / worshipping the Sun, the twice-born went with his sons and wife to the realm of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
sa vai bhādrapade māsi sūryo bhūtvāyutābdakam..
paścādbrahmapuraṃ prāpya paramānandamāptavān ..
iti te kathitaṃ vipra yathā jīvastamabravīt .. 3.4.8.50 ..
meaning:
स वै भाद्रपदे मासि सूर्यो भूत्वायुताब्दकम्..
पश्चाद्ब्रह्मपुरं प्राप्य परमानन्दमाप्तवान् ..
इति ते कथितं विप्र यथा जीवस्तमब्रवीत् .. 3.4.8.50 ..
text_mt: Having become the Sun for ten thousand years in the month of Bhādrapada, / he later reached the city of Brahmā and attained supreme bliss. / Thus has been related to you, O twice-born, as Jīva spoke to him.

sanskrit_iast:
āgatya bhāskaro devaḥ pūrṇimāyāṃ tu bhādrake ..
aṣṭāviṃśe kalau prāpte svayaṃ jātaḥ kaliñjare .. 51 ..
meaning:
आगत्य भास्करो देवः पूर्णिमायां तु भाद्रके ..
अष्टाविंशे कलौ प्राप्ते स्वयं जातः कलिञ्जरे .. 51 ..
text_mt: The divine Bhāskara, arriving on the full-moon day in Bhādra, / was Himself born in Kaliñjara when the twenty-eighth Kali arrived,

sanskrit_iast:
śivadattasya tanayo viṣṇuśarmeti viśrutaḥ ..
vedaśāstrakalābhijño vaiṣṇavo deva pūjakaḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
शिवदत्तस्य तनयो विष्णुशर्मेति विश्रुतः ..
वेदशास्त्रकलाभिज्ञो वैष्णवो देव पूजकः .. 52 ..
text_mt: as the son of Śivadatta, renowned as Viṣṇuśarman, / knowledgeable in the Vedas, śāstras, and arts, a Vaiṣṇava worshipper of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:

vacanaṃ prāha dharmātmā viṣṇuḥ sarveśvaro hariḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
चतुर्वर्णान्नरान्विप्र समाहूय हरेर्गृहे ..
वचनं प्राह धर्मात्मा विष्णुः सर्वेश्वरो हरिः .. 53 ..
text_mt: Summoning men of the four varṇas to the house of Hari, O twice-born, / the righteous one spoke these words: “Viṣṇu, Hari, is the Lord of all.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu tatkāraṇaṃ śiṣya viśvakāraṇa kārakaḥ ..
bhagavānsaccidānandaścaturviśatitattvavān ..
devānsasarja lokārthe tasmātsarveśvaro'bhavat .. 54 ..
meaning:
शृणु तत्कारणं शिष्य विश्वकारण कारकः ..
भगवान्सच्चिदानन्दश्चतुर्विशतितत्त्ववान् ..
देवान्ससर्ज लोकार्थे तस्मात्सर्वेश्वरोऽभवत् .. 54 ..
text_mt: Hear the cause of that, O disciple: the Maker, the cause of the universe, / the Blessed One, being, consciousness, and bliss, possessing the twenty-four tattvas, / created the gods for the sake of the worlds; therefore He became the Lord of all.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaṃ hi sakalāndevānpūjayitvā naraḥ śuciḥ ..
paścācca pūjayedviṣṇuṃ yathā bhṛtyā nṛpaṃ punaḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
पूर्वं हि सकलान्देवान्पूजयित्वा नरः शुचिः ..
पश्चाच्च पूजयेद्विष्णुं यथा भृत्या नृपं पुनः .. 55 ..
text_mt: Having first worshipped all the gods, a pure man / should afterwards worship Viṣṇu, just as servants [honour ministers before] the king.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu te sarve praśasya bahudhā hi tam ..
viṣṇusvāmīti taṃ nāmnā kathāṃ cakruśca harṣitāḥ ..56..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु ते सर्वे प्रशस्य बहुधा हि तम् ..
विष्णुस्वामीति तं नाम्ना कथां चक्रुश्च हर्षिताः ..56..
text_mt: Hearing this, they all praised him in many ways, / and, delighted, referred to him by the name Viṣṇusvāmin.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ vipra viṣṇusvāmī yathābhavat ..
punaḥ śṛṇu kathāṃ ramyāṃ bṛhaspatimukheritām ..57..
meaning:
इति ते कथितं विप्र विष्णुस्वामी यथाभवत् ..
पुनः शृणु कथां रम्यां बृहस्पतिमुखेरिताम् ..57..
text_mt: Thus it has been related to you, O twice-born, how he became Viṣṇusvāmin. / Listen again to the delightful narrative uttered from the mouth of Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast:
.. jīva uvāca .. ..
purā caitrarathe deśe bhagaśarmā dvijo'bhavat ..
svarveśyā maṃjughoṣāyāṃ munimedhāvinā bhuvi .. 58 ..
meaning:
.. जीव उवाच .. ..
पुरा चैत्ररथे देशे भगशर्मा द्विजोऽभवत् ..
स्वर्वेश्या मंजुघोषायां मुनिमेधाविना भुवि .. 58 ..
text_mt: Jīva said: / Formerly, in the Caitraratha region, there was a twice-born named Bhagaśarman, / born on earth through the sage Medhāvin from the celestial courtesan Mañjughoṣā.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛmātṛparityaktaḥ sa bālaḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ ..
sūryamārādhayāmāsa tapasā śatavārṣikam .. 99 ..
meaning:
पितृमातृपरित्यक्तः स बालः श्रद्धयान्वितः ..
सूर्यमाराधयामास तपसा शतवार्षिकम् .. 99 ..
text_mt: Abandoned by his parents, that boy, endowed with faith, / propitiated the Sun with ascetic penance for a hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryamaṇḍalamadhyasthā sāvitrī nāma devatā ..
sarvasūryasya jananī kanyā tanmaṇḍalasya vai .. 3.4.8.60..
meaning:
सूर्यमण्डलमध्यस्था सावित्री नाम देवता ..
सर्वसूर्यस्य जननी कन्या तन्मण्डलस्य वै .. 3.4.8.60..
text_mt: The deity named Sāvitrī, abiding in the midst of the Sun's orb, / the mother of all the suns, the maiden of that orb,

sanskrit_iast:
prasannā tapasā tasya prādurbhūtā sanātanī ..
āśvine māsi rājānaṃ dvijaṃ cakre ca maṇḍale .. 61 ..
meaning:
प्रसन्ना तपसा तस्य प्रादुर्भूता सनातनी ..
आश्विने मासि राजानं द्विजं चक्रे च मण्डले .. 61 ..
text_mt: pleased by his penance, that eternal goddess manifested Herself / and made the twice-born a king in the orb in the month of Āśvina.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣavarṣasahasrāṇi māsi māsi tathāśvine ..
prakāśaṃ kṛtavānvipraḥ pūjito lokavāsibhiḥ .. 62 ..
meaning:
लक्षवर्षसहस्राणि मासि मासि तथाश्विने ..
प्रकाशं कृतवान्विप्रः पूजितो लोकवासिभिः .. 62 ..
text_mt: For a hundred thousand years, month after month in Āśvina, / the twice-born shone forth, worshipped by the inhabitants of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ sūryaṃ bhaja devendra sa te kāryaṃ kariṣyati ..
iti śrutvāśvine māsi sa ravirdevapūjanāt .. 63 ..
meaning:
त्वं सूर्यं भज देवेन्द्र स ते कार्यं करिष्यति ..
इति श्रुत्वाश्विने मासि स रविर्देवपूजनात् .. 63 ..
text_mt: “Worship the Sun, O lord of the gods; he will accomplish your purpose.” / Hearing this, in the month of Āśvina, through the worship of the gods, that Sun

sanskrit_iast:
pratyakṣamagamattatra vacaḥ prāha surānprati ..
kānyakubje śubhe deśe vāṇībhūṣaṇa ityaham ..
bhavāmi satyadevasya viprasya tanayaḥ śubhaḥ .. 64 ..
meaning:
प्रत्यक्षमगमत्तत्र वचः प्राह सुरान्प्रति ..
कान्यकुब्जे शुभे देशे वाणीभूषण इत्यहम् ..
भवामि सत्यदेवस्य विप्रस्य तनयः शुभः .. 64 ..
text_mt: became visible there and spoke words to the gods: / “In the auspicious land of Kānyakubja, I shall become / the auspicious son of the twice-born Satyadeva, named Vāṇībhūṣaṇa.”

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ityuktvā bhagavānsūryo jātaḥ kānyapure śubhe ..
jitvā pākhaṃḍino viprānmāṃsabhakṣaṇatatparān ..
chaṃdograṃthaṃ svanāmnā vai kṛtavāndaivatapriyaḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्त्वा भगवान्सूर्यो जातः कान्यपुरे शुभे ..
जित्वा पाखंडिनो विप्रान्मांसभक्षणतत्परान् ..
छंदोग्रंथं स्वनाम्ना वै कृतवान्दैवतप्रियः .. 65 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having spoken thus, the blessed Sun was born in the auspicious city of Kānya. / Having defeated the heretical twice-born devoted to eating meat, / he, beloved of the gods, composed a work on meter under his own name.

sanskrit_iast:
matsyamāṃsāśanā viprā mṛgameṣājakāśanāḥ ..
ekībhūya samāgamya cakruḥ śāstrārthamulbaṇam ..66..
meaning:
मत्स्यमांसाशना विप्रा मृगमेषाजकाशनाः ..
एकीभूय समागम्य चक्रुः शास्त्रार्थमुल्बणम् ..66..
text_mt: The twice-born who ate fish and meat, who ate deer, sheep, and goats, / gathered together as one and engaged in a fierce scriptural debate.

sanskrit_iast:
kalinā'dharmamitreṇa rakṣitāste dvijātayaḥ ..
taṃ dvijaṃ ca parājitya matsyaketuṃ ca tadgṛhe .. 67 ..
meaning:
कलिनाऽधर्ममित्रेण रक्षितास्ते द्विजातयः ..
तं द्विजं च पराजित्य मत्स्यकेतुं च तद्गृहे .. 67 ..
text_mt: Those twice-born were protected by Kali, the friend of unrighteousness; / and having defeated that twice-born, they forcefully set up

sanskrit_iast:
balācca staṃbhanaṃ cakrustadā viṣṇupriyo dvijaḥ ..
vaiṣṇavīṃ śaktimāgamya svamukhānmīnakhāditān .. 68 ..
meaning:
बलाच्च स्तंभनं चक्रुस्तदा विष्णुप्रियो द्विजः ..
वैष्णवीं शक्तिमागम्य स्वमुखान्मीनखादितान् .. 68 ..
text_mt: a fish-banner in his house by paralytic power. Then the twice-born, beloved of Viṣṇu, / resorting to the Vaiṣṇava power, from his own mouth

sanskrit_iast:
saṃjīvya darśayāmāsa te dṛṣṭvā vismitāstadā ..
śiṣyabhūtāśca te tasya vaiṣṇavaṃ matamā gaman .. 69 ..
meaning:
संजीव्य दर्शयामास ते दृष्ट्वा विस्मितास्तदा ..
शिष्यभूताश्च ते तस्य वैष्णवं मतमा गमन् .. 69 ..
text_mt: revived the fish that had been eaten and displayed them. Seeing them, they were astonished; / becoming his disciples, they adopted the Vaiṣṇava doctrine.

sanskrit_iast:
.. jīva uvāca .. ..
kadācitsarayūtīre devayājī dvijo'bhavat ..
sarvadevaparo nityaṃ vedapāṭhaparāyaṇaḥ .. 3.4.8.70 ..
meaning:
.. जीव उवाच .. ..
कदाचित्सरयूतीरे देवयाजी द्विजोऽभवत् ..
सर्वदेवपरो नित्यं वेदपाठपरायणः .. 3.4.8.70 ..
text_mt: Jīva said: / Once, on the bank of the Sarayū, there was a twice-born named Devayājin, / always devoted to all the gods, dedicated to the recitation of the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsutastu mṛtiṃ prāpto janmamātre hi dāruṇe ..
tadā tu sa dvijaḥ śrutvā sūryadevamatoṣayat .. 71 ..
meaning:
तत्सुतस्तु मृतिं प्राप्तो जन्ममात्रे हि दारुणे ..
तदा तु स द्विजः श्रुत्वा सूर्यदेवमतोषयत् .. 71 ..
text_mt: His son met his death immediately upon his dreadful birth. / Then that twice-born, hearing this, propitiated the Sun god.

sanskrit_iast:
jijīva tatprasādena vivasvānnāma cābhavat ..
ṣoḍaśābda vapurbhūtvā sarvavidyāviśāradaḥ .. 72 ..
meaning:
जिजीव तत्प्रसादेन विवस्वान्नाम चाभवत् ..
षोडशाब्द वपुर्भूत्वा सर्वविद्याविशारदः .. 72 ..
text_mt: By his grace he lived, and his name became Vivasvat. / Having attained a sixteen-year-old body, skilled in all sciences,

sanskrit_iast:
apatyavāndharmaparaḥ sūryavataparāyaṇaḥ ..
śivarātridine prāpte tatpatnī bhūṣaṇapriyā .. 73 ..
meaning:
अपत्यवान्धर्मपरः सूर्यवतपरायणः ..
शिवरात्रिदिने प्राप्ते तत्पत्नी भूषणप्रिया .. 73 ..
text_mt: blessed with offspring, devoted to righteousness, intent on the Sun's vrata, / when the day of Śivarātri arrived, his wife, who loved ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
suśīlā nāma vikhyātā patisevārthamāgatā ..
sa vratī rudradevasya dṛṣṭvā tāṃ madhurānanām .. 74 ..
meaning:
सुशीला नाम विख्याता पतिसेवार्थमागता ..
स व्रती रुद्रदेवस्य दृष्ट्वा तां मधुराननाम् .. 74 ..
text_mt: renowned by the name Suśīlā, she came to attend upon her husband. / Observing the vow of the god Rudra, he saw her of sweet countenance,

sanskrit_iast:
balādgṛhītvā tu niśi bubhuje smaravihvalaḥ ..
maithunasyaiva doṣeṇa tasya kuṣṭho mahānabhūt .. 75 ..
meaning:
बलाद्गृहीत्वा तु निशि बुभुजे स्मरविह्वलः ..
मैथुनस्यैव दोषेण तस्य कुष्ठो महानभूत् .. 75 ..
text_mt: and, seized by passion, took her by force at night and enjoyed her. / From the very sin of that intercourse, a severe leprosy afflicted him,

sanskrit_iast:
liṃgedriyaṃ ca patitaṃ gudabhraṣṭo mahāṃgaruk ..
kena cidupadeśena ravivārasya vai vratam .. 76 ..
meaning:
लिंगेद्रियं च पतितं गुदभ्रष्टो महांगरुक् ..
केन चिदुपदेशेन रविवारस्य वै व्रतम् .. 76 ..
text_mt: his organ of generation fell off, his rectum collapsed, and he suffered great bodily pain. / Then, through some advice, he undertook the observance of Sunday;

sanskrit_iast:
sa cakre dvādaśaṃ premṇā nirāhāro yatendriyaḥ ..
tena vrataprabhāveṇa sarvapīḍā layaṃ gatāḥ .. 77 ..
meaning:
स चक्रे द्वादशं प्रेम्णा निराहारो यतेन्द्रियः ..
तेन व्रतप्रभावेण सर्वपीडा लयं गताः .. 77 ..
text_mt: subduing his senses, he lovingly observed the twelfth [day] fasting. / By the power of that observance, all his afflictions dissolved.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā śraddhā ravau prāptā pratyahaṃ sa dvijottamaḥ ..
āditya hṛdayaṃ japtvā kāmarūpo dvijo'bhavat .. 78 ..
meaning:
तदा श्रद्धा रवौ प्राप्ता प्रत्यहं स द्विजोत्तमः ..
आदित्य हृदयं जप्त्वा कामरूपो द्विजोऽभवत् .. 78 ..
text_mt: He then gained faith in the sun; daily reciting the Ādityahṛdaya, / that best of twice-born became endowed with a form assumed at will.

sanskrit_iast:
nārībhirbhartsitaḥ pūrvaṃ sotha kāminīyācitaḥ ..
brahmacaryavrataṃ kṛtvā brahmadhyānaparo'bhavat .. 79 ..
meaning:
नारीभिर्भर्त्सितः पूर्वं सोथ कामिनीयाचितः ..
ब्रह्मचर्यव्रतं कृत्वा ब्रह्मध्यानपरोऽभवत् .. 79 ..
text_mt: Formerly reviled by women, he was now solicited by passionate maidens. / Undertaking the vow of celibacy, he devoted himself to meditation on brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
śatāyurbrāhmaṇo bhūtvā jñānavānrogavarjitaḥ ..
tyaktvā prāṇānravirbhūtvā sūryamaṇḍalamadhyagāt .. 3.4.8.80 ..
meaning:
शतायुर्ब्राह्मणो भूत्वा ज्ञानवान्रोगवर्जितः ..
त्यक्त्वा प्राणान्रविर्भूत्वा सूर्यमण्डलमध्यगात् .. 3.4.8.80 ..
text_mt: Living as a centenarian brāhmaṇa, endowed with knowledge and free from disease, / he relinquished his vital breaths, became the sun, and entered the midst of the solar orb.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtike māsi lakṣābdaṃ prakāśaṃ kṛtavānnabhaḥ ..
taṃ ca sūryaṃ mahendrastvaṃ pūjayāśu suraiḥ saha .. 81 ..
meaning:
कार्तिके मासि लक्षाब्दं प्रकाशं कृतवान्नभः ..
तं च सूर्यं महेन्द्रस्त्वं पूजयाशु सुरैः सह .. 81 ..
text_mt: For a hundred thousand years in the month of Kārtika, he illumined the sky. / You too, O Mahendra, together with the gods, quickly worship that sun.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
iti śrutvā mahendrastu māsamātraṃ hi bhāskaram ..
pūjayitvā vidhānena pūrṇimāyāṃ dadarśa ha .. 82 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
इति श्रुत्वा महेन्द्रस्तु मासमात्रं हि भास्करम् ..
पूजयित्वा विधानेन पूर्णिमायां ददर्श ह .. 82 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Hearing this, Mahendra worshipped the sun for just one month / according to rule, and beheld him on the full moon day.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca śakraṃ sa ravirdevakāryaṃ karomyaham ..
bhaṭṭairvidyāmayairdhūrtaiḥ sūtrapāṭhaśca khaṃḍitaḥ .. 83 ..
meaning:
उवाच शक्रं स रविर्देवकार्यं करोम्यहम् ..
भट्टैर्विद्यामयैर्धूर्तैः सूत्रपाठश्च खंडितः .. 83 ..
text_mt: The sun said to Śakra: "I am carrying out the work of the gods. / The recitation of the sūtras has been corrupted by rascally scholars pretending to learning;

sanskrit_iast:
dhātupāṭho nyapaṭhito bhraṃśārthaḥ svaravarṇakaḥ ..
jitvā tānbhaṭṭapāṣaṃḍānvedamuddhārayāmi bhoḥ .. 84 ..
meaning:
धातुपाठो न्यपठितो भ्रंशार्थः स्वरवर्णकः ..
जित्वा तान्भट्टपाषंडान्वेदमुद्धारयामि भोः .. 84 ..
text_mt: the recitation of the roots has been misread, with their accents and letters distorted in meaning. / Conquering those heretic scholars, I shall redeem the Veda, O King!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sa gataḥ kāśyāṃ gehe vai vedaśarmaṇaḥ ..
dīkṣitānvayabhūtasya nāmnā kāryaguṇo'bhavat .. 85 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा स गतः काश्यां गेहे वै वेदशर्मणः ..
दीक्षितान्वयभूतस्य नाम्ना कार्यगुणोऽभवत् .. 85 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, he went to Kāśī, to the house of Vedaśarman, / born of the lineage of Dīkṣita, and became known by the name Kāryaguṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśābdavapurbhūtvā sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ ..
śivamārādhayāmāsa viśvanāthaṃ śivāpriyam .. 86 ..
meaning:
द्वादशाब्दवपुर्भूत्वा सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः ..
शिवमाराधयामास विश्वनाथं शिवाप्रियम् .. 86 ..
text_mt: At the age of twelve years, versed in all the treatises, / he worshipped Śiva, Viśvanātha, dear to Śivā.

sanskrit_iast:
trivarṣānte ca bhagavāṃstasmai jñānaṃ mahaddadau ..
tasya jñānaprabhāveṇa vyaktamavyaktamuttamam .. 87 ..
meaning:
त्रिवर्षान्ते च भगवांस्तस्मै ज्ञानं महद्ददौ ..
तस्य ज्ञानप्रभावेण व्यक्तमव्यक्तमुत्तमम् .. 87 ..
text_mt: At the end of three years, the Lord gave him supreme knowledge. / By the power of that knowledge, the highest manifested and unmanifested

sanskrit_iast:
jñātaṃ kāryaguṇenaiva dīkṣitena tadā hṛdi ..
avyakte yadā buddhiḥ sā vidyā dvādaśāṃginī .. 88 ..
meaning:
ज्ञातं कार्यगुणेनैव दीक्षितेन तदा हृदि ..
अव्यक्ते यदा बुद्धिः सा विद्या द्वादशांगिनी .. 88 ..
text_mt: was understood in his heart by Kāryaguṇa Dīkṣita himself. / When the intellect is fixed on the unmanifest, that is the twelve-limbed knowledge;

sanskrit_iast:
vyakte'haṃkārabhūte ca buddhirjñeyā budhairajā ..
avidyā nāma vikhyātā ṣoḍaśāṃgasvarūpiṇī .. 89 ..
meaning:
व्यक्तेऽहंकारभूते च बुद्धिर्ज्ञेया बुधैरजा ..
अविद्या नाम विख्याता षोडशांगस्वरूपिणी .. 89 ..
text_mt: and when the intellect is fixed on the manifest, which consists of the ego, the wise should know it as unborn [matter], / renowned by the name Avidyā, whose nature possesses sixteen limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktaṃ tu paraṃ brahma vyaktaṃ śabdamayaṃ smṛtam ..
ahaṃkāro lokakaro hi vyakto'ṣṭadaśāṃgakaḥ ..3.4.8.90..
meaning:
अव्यक्तं तु परं ब्रह्म व्यक्तं शब्दमयं स्मृतम् ..
अहंकारो लोककरो हि व्यक्तोऽष्टदशांगकः ..3.4.8.90..
text_mt: The unmanifest is regarded as the supreme brahman, and the manifest is regarded as consisting of sound. / The ego is the creator of the world, manifested indeed with eighteen limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣarūpadharo mukhyo nandiyānaḥ smṛto budhaiḥ ..
śṛṅgāṇi tasya catvāri tripādo dviśirā vṛṣaḥ..91..
meaning:
वृषरूपधरो मुख्यो नन्दियानः स्मृतो बुधैः ..
शृङ्गाणि तस्य चत्वारि त्रिपादो द्विशिरा वृषः..91..
text_mt: Taking the form of a bull, he is the foremost, celebrated by the wise as the mount Nandin. / Four are his horns, three his feet, and two his heads, this bull;

sanskrit_iast:
saptahastastridhā baddho nityaśuddho mukhe sthitaḥ..
suvantaśca tiṅantaśca kṛdaṃtaścāvyayastathā..92..
meaning:
सप्तहस्तस्त्रिधा बद्धो नित्यशुद्धो मुखे स्थितः..
सुवन्तश्च तिङन्तश्च कृदंतश्चाव्ययस्तथा..92..
text_mt: he has seven hands, is tied in three places, eternally pure, seated in the mouth: / nominal inflections, verbal inflections, primary suffixes, and likewise indeclinables.

sanskrit_iast:
dvaudvau śṛṃgau ca śirasornaṃdiyānasya vai smṛtau ..
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhavaccaiva trayaḥ pādā hi tasya vai .. 93 ..
meaning:
द्वौद्वौ शृंगौ च शिरसोर्नंदियानस्य वै स्मृतौ ..
भूतं भव्यं भवच्चैव त्रयः पादा हि तस्य वै .. 93 ..
text_mt: Two horns each on his two heads are recorded for the mount Nandin; / the past, the future, and the present are his three feet.

sanskrit_iast:
rūḍhiśca yogarūḍhiśca śabdau tasya śirodvayam ..
kartā karma ca karaṇaṃ saṃpradānaṃ vibhāgataḥ .. 94 ..
meaning:
रूढिश्च योगरूढिश्च शब्दौ तस्य शिरोद्वयम् ..
कर्ता कर्म च करणं संप्रदानं विभागतः .. 94 ..
text_mt: Conventional usage and etymological-conventional usage are the two words that are his two heads; / the agent, the object, the instrument, and the recipient in their division,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvaṃdhaścādhikāraśca bhujāstasya vṛṣasya vai ..
vākyaṃ svarānvitaṃ jñeyaṃ vibhattyaṃtaṃ padaṃ smṛtam .. 95 ..
meaning:
संवंधश्चाधिकारश्च भुजास्तस्य वृषस्य वै ..
वाक्यं स्वरान्वितं ज्ञेयं विभत्त्यंतं पदं स्मृतम् .. 95 ..
text_mt: relation, and domain are the arms of that bull. / A sentence should be known as endowed with accents, and a word is remembered as ending with an inflectional suffix.

sanskrit_iast:
tābhyāṃ baddhaśca sa vṛṣo nandiyānātha te namaḥ ..
tasyoparisthitaṃ nityamavyaktaṃ liṃgarūpi yat .. 96 ..
meaning:
ताभ्यां बद्धश्च स वृषो नन्दियानाथ ते नमः ..
तस्योपरिस्थितं नित्यमव्यक्तं लिंगरूपि यत् .. 96 ..
text_mt: Bound by these two is that bull; homage to you, O mount Nandin! / Situated eternally above him is the unmanifest, which takes the form of the liṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
jātaśca vṛṣaliṃgābhyāṃ so'haṃkāro hariḥ svayam..
nārāyaṇaḥ ṣoḍaśātmā bahumūrtiramūrtikaḥ .. 97 ..
meaning:
जातश्च वृषलिंगाभ्यां सोऽहंकारो हरिः स्वयम्..
नारायणः षोडशात्मा बहुमूर्तिरमूर्तिकः .. 97 ..
text_mt: And born from the bull and the liṅga is that ego, Hari himself, / Nārāyaṇa possessing sixteen aspects, multiform and formless.

sanskrit_iast:
iti jñānaṃ hṛdi prāpya tadā siddhāntakaumudīm ..
jitvā bhaṭṭāṃścakārāśu bhaṭṭojiḥ praśruto'bhavat ..98..
meaning:
इति ज्ञानं हृदि प्राप्य तदा सिद्धान्तकौमुदीम् ..
जित्वा भट्टांश्चकाराशु भट्टोजिः प्रश्रुतोऽभवत् ..98..
text_mt: Attaining such knowledge in his heart, he then quickly composed the Siddhāntakaumudī / after defeating the Bhaṭṭas, and became renowned as Bhaṭṭoji.

sanskrit_iast:
.. jīva uvāca .. ..
purā kāṃcīpure ramye gaṇako brāhmaṇottamaḥ..
purodhāḥ satyadattasya rājño vedaparasya vai .. 99 ..
meaning:
.. जीव उवाच .. ..
पुरा कांचीपुरे रम्ये गणको ब्राह्मणोत्तमः..
पुरोधाः सत्यदत्तस्य राज्ञो वेदपरस्य वै .. 99 ..
text_mt: Jīva said: / Formerly in lovely Kāñcīpura there was an astrologer, an excellent brāhmaṇa, / the royal priest of King Satyadatta, who was devoted to the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā gaṇako dhīmānsatyadattamuvāca ha ..
muhūrto'bhijidākhyoyaṃ puṣyanakṣatrasaṃyutaḥ ..
hāṭaṃ kuru mahārāja sāṃprataṃ bahuvṛttidam .. 3.4.8.100 ..
meaning:
एकदा गणको धीमान्सत्यदत्तमुवाच ह ..
मुहूर्तोऽभिजिदाख्योयं पुष्यनक्षत्रसंयुतः ..
हाटं कुरु महाराज सांप्रतं बहुवृत्तिदम् .. 3.4.8.100 ..
text_mt: Once the wise astrologer said to Satyadatta: / "This moment is named Abhijit, combined with the constellation Puṣya. / Establish a marketplace now, O great king; it will yield abundant livelihood."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tathā kṛtvā ḍiṃḍimadhvaninā pure ..
narānājñāpayāmāsa tacchṛṇuṣva surottama .. 101 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तथा कृत्वा डिंडिमध्वनिना पुरे ..
नरानाज्ञापयामास तच्छृणुष्व सुरोत्तम .. 101 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, he acted accordingly and, by the beating of drums in the city, / gave an order to the people; listen to that, O best of gods:

sanskrit_iast:
akrītaṃ yasya vai vastu hāṭe'sminvaiśyakovidaiḥ ..
mayā krītaṃ ca tajjñeyaṃ satyametadvaco mama .. 102 ..
meaning:
अक्रीतं यस्य वै वस्तु हाटेऽस्मिन्वैश्यकोविदैः ..
मया क्रीतं च तज्ज्ञेयं सत्यमेतद्वचो मम .. 102 ..
text_mt: "Whatever item is left unbought in this marketplace by the skilled vaiśyas / shall be known as bought by me; this word of mine is true."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā śūdrajanāścakrurnānāvidhaṃ vasu ..
vaiśyaissarvaṃ tadā krītaṃ mahānhāṭo hi so'bhavat .. 103 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा शूद्रजनाश्चक्रुर्नानाविधं वसु ..
वैश्यैस्सर्वं तदा क्रीतं महान्हाटो हि सोऽभवत् .. 103 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, the śūdra people produced various kinds of goods; / the vaiśyas then bought everything, and it became a great market.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā lohakāraśca dāridraṃ loharūpiṇam ..
kṛtvā hāṭamupāgamya śatamudrāmayācata .. 104 ..
meaning:
एकदा लोहकारश्च दारिद्रं लोहरूपिणम् ..
कृत्वा हाटमुपागम्य शतमुद्रामयाचत .. 104 ..
text_mt: One day, a blacksmith made [an image of] Poverty in the form of iron / and, coming to the market, asked for a hundred coins.

sanskrit_iast:
akrītaṃ puruṣaṃ rājā jñātvā lohadaridrakam ..
krītaṃ taṃ śatamudrābhirgṛhītvā gehamāgamat ..
kośāgāre tadā rājñā sthāpitobhūddaridrakaḥ .. 105 ..
meaning:
अक्रीतं पुरुषं राजा ज्ञात्वा लोहदरिद्रकम् ..
क्रीतं तं शतमुद्राभिर्गृहीत्वा गेहमागमत् ..
कोशागारे तदा राज्ञा स्थापितोभूद्दरिद्रकः .. 105 ..
text_mt: Learning of that person, the iron Poverty, remaining unbought, the king / purchased it for a hundred coins, took it, and returned home. / The king then deposited Poverty in his treasury.

sanskrit_iast:
niśīthe tama udbhūte karma dharmaśca mā tathā ..
bhūpagehātsamāgatya paśyatastasya nirgatāḥ .. 106 ..
meaning:
निशीथे तम उद्भूते कर्म धर्मश्च मा तथा ..
भूपगेहात्समागत्य पश्यतस्तस्य निर्गताः .. 106 ..
text_mt: At midnight, when darkness arose, Action and Duty, and likewise Fortune, / came forth from the king's palace and departed before his eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpaścātsatyapuruṣo rājānamidamabravīt ..
daridro yatra bhūpāla tatra karmaparo na hi ..
karmaṇā rahito dharmo bhūtale na sthiro bhavet .. 107 ..
meaning:
तत्पश्चात्सत्यपुरुषो राजानमिदमब्रवीत् ..
दरिद्रो यत्र भूपाल तत्र कर्मपरो न हि ..
कर्मणा रहितो धर्मो भूतले न स्थिरो भवेत् .. 107 ..
text_mt: After that, the embodiment of Truth spoke thus to the king: / "Where Poverty is, O protector of the earth, there is no one devoted to action; / and duty devoid of action cannot stand firm upon the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmeṇa rahitā lakṣmīrna śobheta kadācana ..
ahaṃ lakṣmyā vihīnaśca na tiṣṭhāmi kadācana .. 108 ..
meaning:
धर्मेण रहिता लक्ष्मीर्न शोभेत कदाचन ..
अहं लक्ष्म्या विहीनश्च न तिष्ठामि कदाचन .. 108 ..
text_mt: Lakṣmī bereft of duty never shines; / and I, separated from Lakṣmī, never remain."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā gantumicchaṃtaṃ gṛhītvā karayornṛpaḥ ..
namrībhūto vacaḥ prāha śṛṇu satyaṃ mama priyam .. 109 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा गन्तुमिच्छंतं गृहीत्वा करयोर्नृपः ..
नम्रीभूतो वचः प्राह शृणु सत्यं मम प्रियम् .. 109 ..
text_mt: As he spoke thus and wished to depart, the king grasped him by the hands, / bowed low, and spoke these words: "Hear, O Truth, my beloved:

sanskrit_iast:
na tyājyo hi mayā deva bhavānkiṅgantumarhati ..
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ satyadevo gṛhegamat .. 3.4.8.110 ..
meaning:
न त्याज्यो हि मया देव भवान्किङ्गन्तुमर्हति ..
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं सत्यदेवो गृहेगमत् .. 3.4.8.110 ..
text_mt: You must not be abandoned by me, O lord! Why should you depart?" / Hearing these words, the god of Truth entered his house.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpaścācca svayaṃ lakṣmīstadgehe gaṃtumudyatā ..
tāmāha bhūpatirdhīro devi tvaṃ caṃcalā sadā .. 111 ..
meaning:
तत्पश्चाच्च स्वयं लक्ष्मीस्तद्गेहे गंतुमुद्यता ..
तामाह भूपतिर्धीरो देवि त्वं चंचला सदा .. 111 ..
text_mt: Thereafter, Lakṣmī herself prepared to depart from his house. / To her the steadfast king said: "O goddess, you are ever fickle;

sanskrit_iast:
acalā bhava bho mātastarhi manmadiraṃ vraja ..
iti śrutvā varaṃ dattvā nṛpagehaṃ yayau tadā .. 112 ..
meaning:
अचला भव भो मातस्तर्हि मन्मदिरं व्रज ..
इति श्रुत्वा वरं दत्त्वा नृपगेहं ययौ तदा .. 112 ..
text_mt: become firm, O mother! Then enter my dwelling." / Hearing this and granting the boon, she then entered the king's house.

sanskrit_iast:
purodhasaṃ taṃ gaṇakaṃ samāhūya nṛpottamaḥ ..
lakṣasvarṇaṃ dadau tasmai kathitvā sarvakāraṇam .. 113 ..
meaning:
पुरोधसं तं गणकं समाहूय नृपोत्तमः ..
लक्षस्वर्णं ददौ तस्मै कथित्वा सर्वकारणम् .. 113 ..
text_mt: Summoning that astrologer priest, the best of kings / gave him a hundred thousand gold pieces, having related the whole reason.

sanskrit_iast:
putrajanmani kāle tu saṃprāptaṃ tena vai dhanam ..
vyayaṃ kṛtvā dhanaṃ sarvaṃ poṣayāmāsa bālakam .. 114 ..
meaning:
पुत्रजन्मनि काले तु संप्राप्तं तेन वै धनम् ..
व्ययं कृत्वा धनं सर्वं पोषयामास बालकम् .. 114 ..
text_mt: At the time of the birth of a son, that wealth was received by him; / spending all that wealth, he nourished the boy.

sanskrit_iast:
pūṣā nāma tato jātaṃ mārgaśīrṣe śubhe dine ..
sa tu sūryaṃ samārādhya jyotiḥśāstraparaḥ sutaḥ .. 115 ..
meaning:
पूषा नाम ततो जातं मार्गशीर्षे शुभे दिने ..
स तु सूर्यं समाराध्य ज्योतिःशास्त्रपरः सुतः .. 115 ..
text_mt: Then, on an auspicious day in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, he was named Pūṣan. / Worshipping the sun, that son became devoted to the science of astronomy.

sanskrit_iast:
sūrye tu mokṣamagamaddevadevaprasādataḥ ..
tasmāttvaṃ mārgamāse vai raviṃ devendra pūjaya ..116..
meaning:
सूर्ये तु मोक्षमगमद्देवदेवप्रसादतः ..
तस्मात्त्वं मार्गमासे वै रविं देवेन्द्र पूजय ..116..
text_mt: [He] attained liberation in the sun by the grace of the God of gods. / Therefore, O Devendra, worship the sun in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
devendrapūjanātsūryassamāgamya tadā svayam ..
pūṣā nāma vaco devānuvāca madhurasvaram ..117..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
देवेन्द्रपूजनात्सूर्यस्समागम्य तदा स्वयम् ..
पूषा नाम वचो देवानुवाच मधुरस्वरम् ..117..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Then, because of Devendra's worship, the sun, called Pūṣan, / having come there in person, spoke sweet words to the gods:

sanskrit_iast:
ujjayinyāmahaṃ devā yāsye rudrapaśorgṛhe ..
nāmnā ca mihirācāryo jyotiśśāstrapravarttakaḥ .. 118 ..
meaning:
उज्जयिन्यामहं देवा यास्ये रुद्रपशोर्गृहे ..
नाम्ना च मिहिराचार्यो ज्योतिश्शास्त्रप्रवर्त्तकः .. 118 ..
text_mt: "O gods, I shall go to Ujjayinī to the house of Rudrapaśu / by the name of Mihirācārya, promulgator of the science of astronomy."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā bhagavānpūṣā putro jāto dvijasya vai ..
mūlagaḍāntaviṣaye'bhijidyoge śubhaṃkare .. 119 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा भगवान्पूषा पुत्रो जातो द्विजस्य वै ..
मूलगडान्तविषयेऽभिजिद्योगे शुभंकरे .. 119 ..
text_mt: Having said this, the blessed Pūṣan was indeed born as the son of the twice-born / in the region of the Mūla-gaṇḍānta under the auspicious Abhijit conjunction.

sanskrit_iast:
jātamātraṃ ca taṃ putraṃ pitā kāṣṭhakaṭāhake ..
dhṛtvā kṣiptvā nadīmadhye niśīthe samavāhayat .. 3.4.8.120 ..
meaning:
जातमात्रं च तं पुत्रं पिता काष्ठकटाहके ..
धृत्वा क्षिप्त्वा नदीमध्ये निशीथे समवाहयत् .. 3.4.8.120 ..
text_mt: And as soon as his son was born, the father placed him in a wooden vessel, / threw it into the middle of a river, and let it float away at midnight.

sanskrit_iast:
samudramagamatputro rākṣasībhiśca rakṣitaḥ ..
laṃkāmāgamya tatraiva jyotiḥśāstramadhīta vān.. 121 ..
meaning:
समुद्रमगमत्पुत्रो राक्षसीभिश्च रक्षितः ..
लंकामागम्य तत्रैव ज्योतिःशास्त्रमधीत वान्.. 121 ..
text_mt: The son went to the ocean, protected by rākṣasīs; / reaching Laṅkā, right there he studied the science of astronomy.

sanskrit_iast:
jātakaṃ phalitaṃ caiva mūkapraśnaṃ tathāditaḥ ..
paṭhitvā rākṣaseṃdraṃ ca vibhīṣaṇamupāgatam .. 122 ..
meaning:
जातकं फलितं चैव मूकप्रश्नं तथादितः ..
पठित्वा राक्षसेंद्रं च विभीषणमुपागतम् .. 122 ..
text_mt: Having studied horoscopy, predictive [astrology], and silent questioning from the beginning, / he approached Vibhīṣaṇa, the king of the rākṣasas [who had] come [there]:

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktarāja namastubhyaṃ vibhīṣaṇa hari priya ..
āhṛto rākṣasībhiśca tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ .. 123 ..
meaning:
भक्तराज नमस्तुभ्यं विभीषण हरि प्रिय ..
आहृतो राक्षसीभिश्च त्वामहं शरणं गतः .. 123 ..
text_mt: "King of devotees, homage to you, Vibhīṣaṇa, dear to Hari! / Brought by rākṣasīs, I have come to you for refuge."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā ca sa nṛpo vaiṣṇavaṃ dvijamuttamam ..
matvā saṃpreṣayāmasa yatra tajjanmabhūmikā .. 124 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा च स नृपो वैष्णवं द्विजमुत्तमम् ..
मत्वा संप्रेषयामस यत्र तज्जन्मभूमिका .. 124 ..
text_mt: Having heard this, the king, considering him a Vaiṣṇava, an excellent twice-born, / sent him to the land of his birth.

sanskrit_iast:
mlecchairvināśitaṃ yattu vedāṃgaṃ jyotiṣāṃ gatiḥ ..
punaruddhāritaṃ tena tridhābhūtaṃ sanātanam .. 125 ..
meaning:
म्लेच्छैर्विनाशितं यत्तु वेदांगं ज्योतिषां गतिः ..
पुनरुद्धारितं तेन त्रिधाभूतं सनातनम् .. 125 ..
text_mt: That which was the limb of the Veda, the course of the heavenly luminaries, destroyed by the mlecchas, / was restored again by him, threefold and eternal.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca ..
ityuktvā bhagavāñjīvassūryamāhātmyamuttamam..
prayāge tu punardevānuvāca vacasāṃ patiḥ ..1..
meaning:
सूत उवाच ..
इत्युक्त्वा भगवाञ्जीवस्सूर्यमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम्..
प्रयागे तु पुनर्देवानुवाच वचसां पतिः ..1..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having related this excellent greatness of the sun, / the blessed Jīva, the master of speech, spoke again to the gods at Prayāga:
title: Dhanvaṃtarisuśrutajayadevasamutpattivarṇanaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhānapure ramye sūryo jāto harājñayā ..
purā tretāyugāṃte ca tacchṛṇuṣva surottama .. 2 ..
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठानपुरे रम्ये सूर्यो जातो हराज्ञया ..
पुरा त्रेतायुगांते च तच्छृणुष्व सुरोत्तम .. 2 ..
text_mt: "In the delightful city of Pratiṣṭhāna, the sun was born by the command of Hara / formerly at the end of the Tretāyuga. Listen to that, O best of the gods!

sanskrit_iast:
tretānte siṃhaladvīpe parīkṣitanṛpo'bhavat ..
vedadharmaparo nityaṃ devatātithipūjakaḥ ..3..
meaning:
त्रेतान्ते सिंहलद्वीपे परीक्षितनृपोऽभवत् ..
वेदधर्मपरो नित्यं देवतातिथिपूजकः ..3..
text_mt: At the end of the Tretā[yuga], on the island of Siṃhala, there was a king [named] Parīkṣit, / constantly devoted to Vedic duty, a worshipper of the gods and guests.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyā bhānumatī tasya sūryavrataparāyaṇā ..
bhaktibhāvena savitā pratyahaṃ tadgṛhe svayam .. 4 ..
meaning:
कन्या भानुमती तस्य सूर्यव्रतपरायणा ..
भक्तिभावेन सविता प्रत्यहं तद्गृहे स्वयम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: His daughter Bhānumatī was devoted to the observance of the sun. / Out of devotion, Savitṛ himself [came] every day to her house.

sanskrit_iast:
tayā kṛtaṃ śubhaṃ bhakṣyaṃ madhyāhne bhuktavānprabhuḥ..
ravivāre kadācitsā nalinī sāgaraṃ prati ..5..
meaning:
तया कृतं शुभं भक्ष्यं मध्याह्ने भुक्तवान्प्रभुः..
रविवारे कदाचित्सा नलिनी सागरं प्रति ..5..
text_mt: At midday the Lord ate the auspicious food prepared by her. / Once on a Sunday, the maiden, [as lovely as] a lotus, went towards the ocean

sanskrit_iast:
snānārthamāgatā kanyā tadā nārada āgataḥ..
dṛṣṭvā manoramāṃ bālāmekākīṃ jalamadhyagām..6..
meaning:
स्नानार्थमागता कन्या तदा नारद आगतः..
दृष्ट्वा मनोरमां बालामेकाकीं जलमध्यगाम्..6..
text_mt: to bathe. Then Nārada arrived. / Seeing the lovely girl alone, standing in the middle of the water,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā vasanaṃ tasyā vacanaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ..
pāṇiṃ gṛhāṇa me subhrūstvaddṛṣṭyā vaśamāgataḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
गृहीत्वा वसनं तस्या वचनं प्राह निर्भयः..
पाणिं गृहाण मे सुभ्रूस्त्वद्दृष्ट्या वशमागतः .. 7 ..
text_mt: taking her garment, he spoke fearlessly: / 'Take my hand, O fair-browed one! I have fallen under your power by your glance.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktavaṃtaṃ tu muniṃ kumārī namrakandharā ..
uvāca śṛṇu devarṣe kanyāhaṃ tvaṃ sutapradaḥ .. 8..
meaning:
इत्युक्तवंतं तु मुनिं कुमारी नम्रकन्धरा ..
उवाच शृणु देवर्षे कन्याहं त्वं सुतप्रदः .. 8..
text_mt: To the sage who spoke thus, the maiden, her head bowed, / said: 'Listen, O celestial sage! I am a maiden, and you are a giver of sons.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavāndevāṅganābhiśca prārthitaḥ svargamaṇḍale ..
kva ca vai menakā raṃbhā kvāhaṃ manujayonijā .. ..9..
meaning:
भवान्देवाङ्गनाभिश्च प्रार्थितः स्वर्गमण्डले ..
क्व च वै मेनका रंभा क्वाहं मनुजयोनिजा .. ..9..
text_mt: You are sought after by divine maidens in the realm of heaven. / Where indeed are Menakā and Rambhā, and where am I, born of human womb?

sanskrit_iast:
navadvāreṣu dehesmindurgandhāḥ saṃsthitāḥ sadā ..
naiva devāṅganāṅge vai tasmāttubhyaṃ namonamaḥ..3.4.9.10
meaning:
नवद्वारेषु देहेस्मिन्दुर्गन्धाः संस्थिताः सदा ..
नैव देवाङ्गनाङ्गे वै तस्मात्तुभ्यं नमोनमः..3.4.9.10
text_mt: In the nine apertures of this body foul odours are ever present; / they are not at all in the body of a divine maiden. Therefore, homage, homage to you!'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vacastasyā lajjito nāradastadā..
mahādevamupāgamya coktavānsarvakāraṇam .. 11 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्या लज्जितो नारदस्तदा..
महादेवमुपागम्य चोक्तवान्सर्वकारणम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Hearing her words, Nārada was then ashamed. / Approaching Mahādeva, he told him the entire cause.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṣṭhībhūtaṃ muniṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ ..
tuṣṭāva bhāskaraṃ devaṃ tadā prādurabhūtprabhuḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
कुष्ठीभूतं मुनिं दृष्ट्वा शंकरो लोकशंकरः ..
तुष्टाव भास्करं देवं तदा प्रादुरभूत्प्रभुः .. 12 ..
text_mt: Seeing the sage stricken with leprosy, Śaṅkara, the benefactor of the world, / praised the god Bhāskara; then the Lord appeared.

sanskrit_iast:
nāradasya śubhaṃ dehaṃ kṛtvā śivamuvāca ha ..
ājñāṃ dehi mahādeva tavāśāṃ pūrayāmyaham .. 13 ..
meaning:
नारदस्य शुभं देहं कृत्वा शिवमुवाच ह ..
आज्ञां देहि महादेव तवाशां पूरयाम्यहम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Making Nārada's body auspicious, [the Sun] said to Śiva: / 'Give the command, O Mahādeva, and I shall fulfill your wish.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktaṃ taṃ śivaḥ prāha dvijo bhūtvā bhavānbhuvi ..
gṛhāṇa nṛpateḥ kanyāṃ raviṇā tu tathā kṛtam .. 14 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तं तं शिवः प्राह द्विजो भूत्वा भवान्भुवि ..
गृहाण नृपतेः कन्यां रविणा तु तथा कृतम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: To him who spoke thus, Śiva said: 'Becoming a twice-born on earth, / take the king's daughter.' And it was done so by Ravi.

sanskrit_iast:
savitā bhānumatyā ca sārddhaṃ kṛtvā taponvaham ..
sūryalokaṃ punaḥ prāptassa pauṣe ca prakāśa kṛt..
taṃ bhajāśu mahendra tvaṃ devakāryaṃ prasādhaya..15..
meaning:
सविता भानुमत्या च सार्द्धं कृत्वा तपोन्वहम् ..
सूर्यलोकं पुनः प्राप्तस्स पौषे च प्रकाश कृत्..
तं भजाशु महेन्द्र त्वं देवकार्यं प्रसाधय..15..
text_mt: Savitṛ, performing asceticism daily together with Bhānumatī, / reached the world of the sun again, and he brings light in the month of Pauṣa. / Worship him swiftly, O Mahendra, and accomplish the task of the gods!"

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
iti śrutvā gurorvākyaṃ mahendraśca suraissaha ..
savitāraṃ pauṣamāse tuṣṭāva śubha pūjanaiḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
इति श्रुत्वा गुरोर्वाक्यं महेन्द्रश्च सुरैस्सह ..
सवितारं पौषमासे तुष्टाव शुभ पूजनैः .. 16 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Hearing this word of the Guru, Mahendra together with the gods / praised Savitṛ in the month of Pauṣa with auspicious offerings of worship.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prasanno bhagavāndevānāha śubhaṃ vacaḥ ..
ahaṃ kāśyāṃ bhavāmyadya nāmnā dhanvatariḥ svayam .. 17 ..
meaning:
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवान्देवानाह शुभं वचः ..
अहं काश्यां भवाम्यद्य नाम्ना धन्वतरिः स्वयम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: Then, pleased, the Blessed One spoke an auspicious word to the gods: / "Today I will become Dhanvantari myself in Kāśī.

sanskrit_iast:
rogaiśca pīḍitām̐llokānkalinā nirmitairbhuvi ..
śamayiṣyāmi tatroṣya devakāryaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 18 ..
meaning:
रोगैश्च पीडिताम्̐ल्लोकान्कलिना निर्मितैर्भुवि ..
शमयिष्यामि तत्रोष्य देवकार्यं भविष्यति .. 18 ..
text_mt: And dwelling there, I shall pacify the people tormented by diseases / created on earth by Kali; the task of the gods will be accomplished."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā bhagavānsūryaḥ kāśīnagaramāgataḥ ..
kalpadattasya viprasya putro bhūtvā mahītale .. 19 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा भगवान्सूर्यः काशीनगरमागतः ..
कल्पदत्तस्य विप्रस्य पुत्रो भूत्वा महीतले .. 19 ..
text_mt: Having said this, the blessed Sun came to the city of Kāśī, / becoming the son of the twice-born Kalpadatta on the surface of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
suśrutaṃ rājaputraṃ ca vipravṛddhasamanvitam ..
śiṣyaṃ kṛtvā prasannātmā kalpavedamacīkarat .. 3.4.9.20 ..
meaning:
सुश्रुतं राजपुत्रं च विप्रवृद्धसमन्वितम् ..
शिष्यं कृत्वा प्रसन्नात्मा कल्पवेदमचीकरत् .. 3.4.9.20 ..
text_mt: Making the prince Suśruta, accompanied by an aged brāhmaṇa, / his pupil, the gracious-minded one caused the Kalpaveda to be composed.

sanskrit_iast:
rogaiśca kṣayitaṃ dehaṃ kālpametatsmṛtaṃ budhaiḥ ..
tasya jñānaṃ ca taṃtre'smikalpavedohyataḥ smṛtaḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
रोगैश्च क्षयितं देहं काल्पमेतत्स्मृतं बुधैः ..
तस्य ज्ञानं च तंत्रेऽस्मिकल्पवेदोह्यतः स्मृतः .. 21 ..
text_mt: "A body wasted by diseases is known by the wise as kālpa; / and the knowledge of that [is] in this Tantra, hence it is considered the Kalpaveda."

sanskrit_iast:
dhanvatarissa bhagavānprasiddhobhūtkalau yuge ..
yasya darśanamātreṇa rogā naśyaṃti tatkṣaṇāt .. 22 ..
meaning:
धन्वतरिस्स भगवान्प्रसिद्धोभूत्कलौ युगे ..
यस्य दर्शनमात्रेण रोगा नश्यंति तत्क्षणात् .. 22 ..
text_mt: He, the blessed Dhanvantari, became renowned in the Kali age, / at the mere sight of whom diseases perish that very instant.

sanskrit_iast:
suśrutaḥ kalpavedaṃ taṃ dhanvattarivinirmitam ..
paṭhitvā ca śatādhyāyaṃ sau'śrutaṃ taṃtramākarot ..23..
meaning:
सुश्रुतः कल्पवेदं तं धन्वत्तरिविनिर्मितम् ..
पठित्वा च शताध्यायं सौऽश्रुतं तंत्रमाकरोत् ..23..
text_mt: Suśruta, having studied that Kalpaveda composed by Dhanvantari, / composed the Tantra of Suśruta consisting of one hundred chapters.

sanskrit_iast:
.. bṛhaspatiruvāca .. ..
purā paṃpāpure ramye helī nāmnā dvijo'bhavat ..
catuṣṣaṣṭikalābhijño ravipūjanatatparaḥ ..24..
meaning:
.. बृहस्पतिरुवाच .. ..
पुरा पंपापुरे रम्ये हेली नाम्ना द्विजोऽभवत् ..
चतुष्षष्टिकलाभिज्ञो रविपूजनतत्परः ..24..
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / Formerly, in the delightful city of Pampāpura, there was a twice-born named Helī, / skilled in the sixty-four arts, intent on the worship of Ravi.

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktvā pratigrahaṃ vṛttiṃ kāruvṛttiṃ gṛhītavān ..
kṛtvā vastrakalaṃ lauhaṃ tathā citrakalaṃ punaḥ ..25..
meaning:
त्यक्त्वा प्रतिग्रहं वृत्तिं कारुवृत्तिं गृहीतवान् ..
कृत्वा वस्त्रकलं लौहं तथा चित्रकलं पुनः ..25..
text_mt: Abandoning the livelihood of accepting gifts, he took up the livelihood of an artisan, / producing textiles, ironwork, and also paintings,

sanskrit_iast:
dhātumūrtikalaṃ caiva sarvakārukalaṃ tathā ..
pañcasahasramudrābhirākrīṇankāruko'bhavat ..26..
meaning:
धातुमूर्तिकलं चैव सर्वकारुकलं तथा ..
पञ्चसहस्रमुद्राभिराक्रीणन्कारुकोऽभवत् ..26..
text_mt: as well as metal sculptures, and all the crafts of an artisan; / selling them for five thousand coins, he became an artisan.

sanskrit_iast:
kalaeko māsamātre kāle tenaiva nirmitaḥ ..
taddhanena raviṃ devaṃ yajñairmāghe hi so'rcayat..
viśvakarmā raviḥ sākṣānmāghamāse prakāśakaḥ ..27..
meaning:
कलएको मासमात्रे काले तेनैव निर्मितः ..
तद्धनेन रविं देवं यज्ञैर्माघे हि सोऽर्चयत्..
विश्वकर्मा रविः साक्षान्माघमासे प्रकाशकः ..27..
text_mt: A single mechanical device was fashioned by him in the space of just one month; / with that wealth he indeed worshipped the god Ravi with sacrifices in Māgha. / The sun is Viśvakarman himself, radiating light in the month of Māgha.

sanskrit_iast:
helino bahulairyajñaissantuṣṭaḥ pratyahaṃ prabhuḥ ..
paṃpāsarovare ramye nirmitaḥ staṃbha uttamaḥ ..28..
meaning:
हेलिनो बहुलैर्यज्ञैस्सन्तुष्टः प्रत्यहं प्रभुः ..
पंपासरोवरे रम्ये निर्मितः स्तंभ उत्तमः ..28..
text_mt: Pleased daily by Helī's abundant sacrifices, the Lord / fashioned an excellent pillar in the delightful lake Pampā.

sanskrit_iast:
jyotīrūpo mahāramyastatra prāpto raviḥ svayam..
madhyāhne helinā dattaṃ bhojana daivatapriyam ..29..
meaning:
ज्योतीरूपो महारम्यस्तत्र प्राप्तो रविः स्वयम्..
मध्याह्ने हेलिना दत्तं भोजन दैवतप्रियम् ..29..
text_mt: Consisting of light, exceedingly delightful, Ravi himself arrived there; / at midday, Helī offered food dear to the deities.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktvā sa pratyahaṃ svāmī māsimāsi divākaraḥ ..
trailokyaṃ bhāvayāṃcakre sarvadevamayo hariḥ ..3.4.9.30..
meaning:
भुक्त्वा स प्रत्यहं स्वामी मासिमासि दिवाकरः ..
त्रैलोक्यं भावयांचक्रे सर्वदेवमयो हरिः ..3.4.9.30..
text_mt: Eating [it] every day, the Master, the Maker of Day, month by month, / Hari, who embodies all the gods, sustained the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrāyurdvijo bhūtvā tyaktvā prāṇānraviḥ svayam ..
bhūtvā maṇḍalamadhyāsya māghamāsamatoṣayat ..
taṃ sūryaṃ bhaja devendra sa te kāryaṃ kariṣyati .. 31 ..
meaning:
सहस्रायुर्द्विजो भूत्वा त्यक्त्वा प्राणान्रविः स्वयम् ..
भूत्वा मण्डलमध्यास्य माघमासमतोषयत् ..
तं सूर्यं भज देवेन्द्र स ते कार्यं करिष्यति .. 31 ..
text_mt: Having lived a thousand years as a twice-born, the Sun himself relinquished his vital breaths, / and sitting in the midst of his orb, he pleased the month of Māgha. / Worship that Sun, O lord of the gods; he will accomplish your purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
iti śrutvā gurorvākyaṃ vāsavo daivataissaha..
sūryamārādhayāmāsa viśvakarmāṇamuttamam..32..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
इति श्रुत्वा गुरोर्वाक्यं वासवो दैवतैस्सह..
सूर्यमाराधयामास विश्वकर्माणमुत्तमम्..32..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Hearing this advice from the preceptor, Indra, together with the gods, / worshipped the Sun, the supreme Viśvakarman.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prasanno bhagavāṃstvaṣṭā tuṣṭikarojanān..
surānāha vaco ramyaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ surasattamāḥ ..33..
meaning:
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवांस्त्वष्टा तुष्टिकरोजनान्..
सुरानाह वचो रम्यं शृणुध्वं सुरसत्तमाः ..33..
text_mt: Then the blessed Tvaṣṭṛ, delighting people, was pleased / and spoke delightful words to the gods: “Listen, O best of the gods!

sanskrit_iast:
bilgrāme vaṃgadeśe saṃbhavāmi niruktakṛt ..
jayadeva iti khyātaḥ kavīnāṃ hi śiromaṇiḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
बिल्ग्रामे वंगदेशे संभवामि निरुक्तकृत् ..
जयदेव इति ख्यातः कवीनां हि शिरोमणिः .. 34 ..
text_mt: In the village of Bilva in the country of Bengal, I will be born as an author of Nirukta, / renowned as Jayadeva, indeed the crest-jewel of poets.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā bhagavānsūryo vaṃgadeśamupāyayau ..
gehe kaṃdukino jāto brāhmaṇasya mahītale .. 35 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा भगवान्सूर्यो वंगदेशमुपाययौ ..
गेहे कंदुकिनो जातो ब्राह्मणस्य महीतले .. 35 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the blessed Sun arrived in the country of Bengal / and was born on earth in the house of a brāhmaṇa named Kandukin.

sanskrit_iast:
sa paṃcābdavapurbhūtvā pitṛmātṛparāyaṇaḥ ..
dvādaśābdaṃ mahāsevā tatra tena tayoḥ kṛtā .. 36 ..
meaning:
स पंचाब्दवपुर्भूत्वा पितृमातृपरायणः ..
द्वादशाब्दं महासेवा तत्र तेन तयोः कृता .. 36 ..
text_mt: Reaching five years of age, devoted to his mother and father, / he performed great service there for the two of them for twelve years.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtimaṃtau ca pitarau pretakṛtyena tarpitau ..
jayadevena tau nākaṃ gayāśrāddhe hi jagmatuḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
मृतिमंतौ च पितरौ प्रेतकृत्येन तर्पितौ ..
जयदेवेन तौ नाकं गयाश्राद्धे हि जग्मतुः .. 37 ..
text_mt: When both parents died, they were gratified with funeral rites; / by Jayadeva’s śrāddha at Gayā, they indeed went to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
jayadevastadā vipro bhūtvā vairāgyavānbhuvi ..
tatrasthāne mahāramye vane vāsamakārayat .. 38 ..
meaning:
जयदेवस्तदा विप्रो भूत्वा वैराग्यवान्भुवि ..
तत्रस्थाने महारम्ये वने वासमकारयत् .. 38 ..
text_mt: Then the brāhmaṇa Jayadeva, having attained detachment in the world, / made his dwelling in a forest at a very charming place there.

sanskrit_iast:
triviṃśābde tataḥ prāpte kenacinmadhurānanā ..
brāhmaṇena śubhā kanyā jagannāthāya cārpitā .. 39 ..
meaning:
त्रिविंशाब्दे ततः प्राप्ते केनचिन्मधुरानना ..
ब्राह्मणेन शुभा कन्या जगन्नाथाय चार्पिता .. 39 ..
text_mt: Then, when he reached his twenty-third year, a beautiful maiden with a sweet face / was offered by a certain brāhmaṇa to Jagannātha.

sanskrit_iast:
arcāvasāne bhagavānaniruddhassanātanaḥ ..
dārubrahmamayaḥ sākṣādāha taṃ svena vai vacaḥ .. 3.4.9.40 ..
meaning:
अर्चावसाने भगवाननिरुद्धस्सनातनः ..
दारुब्रह्ममयः साक्षादाह तं स्वेन वै वचः .. 3.4.9.40 ..
text_mt: At the conclusion of the worship, the eternal Lord Aniruddha, / who consists directly of the wooden Brahman, addressed him with his own voice:

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu tvaṃ bhoḥ satyavrata jayadevo vapurmama ..
padmāvatīṃ sutāṃ tasmai nivedaya mamājñayā .. 41 ..
meaning:
शृणु त्वं भोः सत्यव्रत जयदेवो वपुर्मम ..
पद्मावतीं सुतां तस्मै निवेदय ममाज्ञया .. 41 ..
text_mt: “Listen, O Satyavrata, Jayadeva is my own form; / by my command, offer your daughter Padmāvatī to him.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktassa dvijastūrṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā vairāgarūpiṇam ..
tatra sthāpya nijāṃ kanyāṃ svagehāya mudā yayau .. 42 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तस्स द्विजस्तूर्णं दृष्ट्वा वैरागरूपिणम् ..
तत्र स्थाप्य निजां कन्यां स्वगेहाय मुदा ययौ .. 42 ..
text_mt: Addressed thus, that twice-born, quickly seeing the ascetic embodiment, / placed his daughter there and went gladly to his own home.

sanskrit_iast:
sā tu padmāvatī kanyā matvā taṃ suṃdaraṃ patim ..
tatsevāṃ sā mudā yuktā cakāra bahuvārṣikam .. 43 ..
meaning:
सा तु पद्मावती कन्या मत्वा तं सुंदरं पतिम् ..
तत्सेवां सा मुदा युक्ता चकार बहुवार्षिकम् .. 43 ..
text_mt: The maiden Padmāvatī, regarding him as her handsome husband, / served him with joy for many years.

sanskrit_iast:
niruktaṃ vaidikaṃ cāṃgaṃ kṛtavānsa samādhinā ..
varṇāgamo gaveṃdrādau siṃhe varṇaviparyayaḥ ..
ṣoḍaśādau vikāraśca varṇanāśaḥ pṛṣodare .. 44 ..
meaning:
निरुक्तं वैदिकं चांगं कृतवान्स समाधिना ..
वर्णागमो गवेंद्रादौ सिंहे वर्णविपर्ययः ..
षोडशादौ विकारश्च वर्णनाशः पृषोदरे .. 44 ..
text_mt: Through profound contemplation he composed Nirukta, the Vedic ancillary: / phonetic augmentation as in *gavendra* and the like, phonetic inversion in *siṃha*, / phonetic modification in *ṣoḍaśa* and the like, and phonetic elision in *pṛṣodara*;

sanskrit_iast:
varṇavikāranāśābhyāṃ dhātoratiśayena yaḥ ..
yogastaducyate prājñairmayūrabhramarādiṣu .. 49 ..
meaning:
वर्णविकारनाशाभ्यां धातोरतिशयेन यः ..
योगस्तदुच्यते प्राज्ञैर्मयूरभ्रमरादिषु .. 49 ..
text_mt: the combination that arises from the modification and elision of phonemes / by the intensity of the verbal root is described by the wise in words such as *mayūra* and *bhramara*.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ paṃcavidhānyeva niruktāni smṛtāni vai ..
śūdraiśca nāgavaṃśīyairbhraṃśitāni kalau yuge .. 46 ..
meaning:
एवं पंचविधान्येव निरुक्तानि स्मृतानि वै ..
शूद्रैश्च नागवंशीयैर्भ्रंशितानि कलौ युगे .. 46 ..
text_mt: Thus the Niruktas are recalled to be of five types; / they were corrupted in the Kali age by the Śūdras and members of the serpent race.

sanskrit_iast:
jitvā prākṛtabhāṣāyāḥ kartṝnmūḍhānkalipriyān ..
śuddhaṃ hi pāṇiniḥ śāstraṃ cakāra surahetave .. 47 ..
meaning:
जित्वा प्राकृतभाषायाः कर्तॄन्मूढान्कलिप्रियान् ..
शुद्धं हि पाणिनिः शास्त्रं चकार सुरहेतवे .. 47 ..
text_mt: Conquering the foolish authors of the Prakrit language, who are fond of Kali, / Pāṇini composed the pure treatise for the sake of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā tu kalirdhūrto hṛdisthaścaurakarmaṇām ..
nṛpadattaṃ dvijasyaiva luṃṭhayitvā dhanaṃ bahu .. 48 ..
meaning:
एकदा तु कलिर्धूर्तो हृदिस्थश्चौरकर्मणाम् ..
नृपदत्तं द्विजस्यैव लुंठयित्वा धनं बहु .. 48 ..
text_mt: Once, however, the rogue Kali, residing in the hearts of robbers, / robbed the abundant wealth given by the king to the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
padmāvatīṃ satīṃ matvā tyaktvā tadvai gato gṛham ..
hastau pādau dvijasyaiva kaliścoraiḥ samācchinat .. 49 ..
meaning:
पद्मावतीं सतीं मत्वा त्यक्त्वा तद्वै गतो गृहम् ..
हस्तौ पादौ द्विजस्यैव कलिश्चोरैः समाच्छिनत् .. 49 ..
text_mt: Regarding Padmāvatī as a virtuous wife, Kali spared her and went to his house; / and through the thieves, he severed the hands and feet of that very twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu duḥkhitā devī gartamadhye sthitaṃ patim ..
niṣkāsya bahudhālapyāpīḍya hastena cāharat .. 3.4.9.50 ..
meaning:
तदा तु दुःखिता देवी गर्तमध्ये स्थितं पतिम् ..
निष्कास्य बहुधालप्यापीड्य हस्तेन चाहरत् .. 3.4.9.50 ..
text_mt: Then the distressed lady, extracting her husband who lay inside a pit, / weeping bitterly and embracing him with her hand, carried him away.

sanskrit_iast:
ekasmindivase rājā mṛgayārthamupāgataḥ..
ahastapādaṃ ca muniṃ jayadevaṃ dadarśa ha ..
sa pṛṣṭastena tatraiva kṛtaṃ kena tavedṛśam .. 51 ..
meaning:
एकस्मिन्दिवसे राजा मृगयार्थमुपागतः..
अहस्तपादं च मुनिं जयदेवं ददर्श ह ..
स पृष्टस्तेन तत्रैव कृतं केन तवेदृशम् .. 51 ..
text_mt: One day the king, arriving for a hunt, / saw the sage Jayadeva devoid of hands and feet. / He was asked by the king right there: “By whom was this done to you?”

sanskrit_iast:
sa hovāca mahārāja hastapādavihīnakaḥ ..
karmaṇāhamiha prāpto na kenāpi kṛtaṃ khalu .. 52 ..
meaning:
स होवाच महाराज हस्तपादविहीनकः ..
कर्मणाहमिह प्राप्तो न केनापि कृतं खलु .. 52 ..
text_mt: Deceitless, he said: “O great king, destitute of hands and feet, / I have reached this state through my own action; indeed, it was done by no one.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā dharmapālo nṛpatistaṃ dvijottamam ..
sapatnīkaṃ ca śibikāmāropya svagṛhaṃ yayau .. 53 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा धर्मपालो नृपतिस्तं द्विजोत्तमम् ..
सपत्नीकं च शिबिकामारोप्य स्वगृहं ययौ .. 53 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, King Dharmapāla placed that best of twice-born / along with his wife into a palanquin and went to his own palace.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya dīkṣāṃ nṛpaḥ prāpya dharmaśālāmakāraya t ..
kadācidvaiṣṇavā bhūtā te caurāḥ kalinirmitāḥ ..
dharmapālagṛhaṃ prāpya rājānamidamabruvan .. 54 ..
meaning:
तस्य दीक्षां नृपः प्राप्य धर्मशालामकारय त् ..
कदाचिद्वैष्णवा भूता ते चौराः कलिनिर्मिताः ..
धर्मपालगृहं प्राप्य राजानमिदमब्रुवन् .. 54 ..
text_mt: Receiving initiation from him, the king caused a rest-house to be built. / Sometime later, those thieves created by Kali became Vaiṣṇavas, / and arriving at Dharmapāla’s residence, they said this to the king:

sanskrit_iast:
vayaṃ hi śāstranipuṇāstava gehamupāgatāḥ..
asmābhirnirmitaṃ bhojyaṃ svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ śilāmayaḥ ..
saṃbhuṃkte pratyahaṃ prītyā tatpaśya nṛpasattama .. 55 ..
meaning:
वयं हि शास्त्रनिपुणास्तव गेहमुपागताः..
अस्माभिर्निर्मितं भोज्यं स्वयं विष्णुः शिलामयः ..
संभुंक्ते प्रत्यहं प्रीत्या तत्पश्य नृपसत्तम .. 55 ..
text_mt: “We are skilled in the scriptures and have come to your house. / Viṣṇu himself in stone form joyfully eats daily / the food prepared by us; look upon that, O best of kings.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā kalibhaktāste viṣṇurūpaṃ caturbhujam ..
nṛpāya darśayāmāsurbhuktavaṃtaṃ svamāyayā .. 56 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा कलिभक्तास्ते विष्णुरूपं चतुर्भुजम् ..
नृपाय दर्शयामासुर्भुक्तवंतं स्वमायया .. 56 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, those devotees of Kali, through their own delusion, / showed to the king Viṣṇu’s four-armed form eating.

sanskrit_iast:
vismito dharmapālaśca jayadevamuvāca ha ..
guro madbhavane prāptā vaiṣṇavā viṣṇutatparāḥ..
adīdṛśanhariṃ sākṣāttasmāttvaṃ śīghramāvraja ..57..
meaning:
विस्मितो धर्मपालश्च जयदेवमुवाच ह ..
गुरो मद्भवने प्राप्ता वैष्णवा विष्णुतत्पराः..
अदीदृशन्हरिं साक्षात्तस्मात्त्वं शीघ्रमाव्रज ..57..
text_mt: Amazed, Dharmapāla said to Jayadeva: / “O master, Vaiṣṇavas devoted to Viṣṇu have arrived at my palace / and have shown Hari visibly before my eyes; therefore, come quickly.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā dvijaḥ prāpto vismito'bhūttathā nṛpaḥ ..
tadā tu taṃ hi pākhaṃḍā bhūpamūcurvihasya te .. .. 58 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा द्विजः प्राप्तो विस्मितोऽभूत्तथा नृपः ..
तदा तु तं हि पाखंडा भूपमूचुर्विहस्य ते .. .. 58 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, the twice-born arrived, and the king was also amazed. / Then those heretics, laughing, said to the king:

sanskrit_iast:
asau vipraśca nṛpate gauḍadeśe nivāsinaḥ ..
sūdo bhakṣyakarastasmai kadāciddhanalobhataḥ .. 59 ..
meaning:
असौ विप्रश्च नृपते गौडदेशे निवासिनः ..
सूदो भक्ष्यकरस्तस्मै कदाचिद्धनलोभतः .. 59 ..
text_mt: “This twice-born, O king, was a cook who prepared food for a resident / of the Gauḍa country; once, out of greed for wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
garalaṃ miśritaṃ bhakṣye tena pākhaṃḍarūpiṇā ..
jñātvā rājā tu taṃ vipraṃ śūlamadhye hyaropayat .. 3.4.9.60 ..
meaning:
गरलं मिश्रितं भक्ष्ये तेन पाखंडरूपिणा ..
ज्ञात्वा राजा तु तं विप्रं शूलमध्ये ह्यरोपयत् .. 3.4.9.60 ..
text_mt: poison was mixed into the food by that heretic. / But the king, discovering him, impaled that twice-born on a stake.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare rājanvayaṃ tatra samāgatāḥ ..
āgaskṛtaṃ dvijaṃ matvā dattvā jñānānya nekaśaḥ ..
śūlāttaṃ hi samuttārya hastau pādau nṛpo'cchinat .. 61 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे राजन्वयं तत्र समागताः ..
आगस्कृतं द्विजं मत्वा दत्त्वा ज्ञानान्य नेकशः ..
शूलात्तं हि समुत्तार्य हस्तौ पादौ नृपोऽच्छिनत् .. 61 ..
text_mt: In the meantime, O king, we arrived there; / considering that the twice-born had committed a crime, after giving various teachings / and lifting him from the stake, the king severed his hands and feet.

sanskrit_iast:
asmākaṃ śiṣyabhūto hi rājāsmābhiḥ prabodhitaḥ ..
ityuktamātre vacane duḥkhitābhūcca dāritā .. 62 ..
meaning:
अस्माकं शिष्यभूतो हि राजास्माभिः प्रबोधितः ..
इत्युक्तमात्रे वचने दुःखिताभूच्च दारिता .. 62 ..
text_mt: The king became our disciple and was enlightened by us.” / As soon as these words were spoken, [the earth] became grieved and split open,

sanskrit_iast:
caurām̐stānsā hi pātāle cakāra surarakṣitān ..
jayadevastathā bhūtāndṛṣṭvā caurānruroda ha .. 63 ..
meaning:
चौराम्̐स्तान्सा हि पाताले चकार सुररक्षितान् ..
जयदेवस्तथा भूतान्दृष्ट्वा चौरान्रुरोद ह .. 63 ..
text_mt: and she cast those thieves into the netherworld, guarded by the gods. / Seeing the thieves in that state, Jayadeva wept.

sanskrit_iast:
kraṃdamāne dvije tasminhastāṃghrī prakṛtiṃ gatau ..
vismitaṃ nṛpatiṃ tatra sarvaṃ hetumavarṇayat .. 64 ..
meaning:
क्रंदमाने द्विजे तस्मिन्हस्तांघ्री प्रकृतिं गतौ ..
विस्मितं नृपतिं तत्र सर्वं हेतुमवर्णयत् .. 64 ..
text_mt: While that twice-born was weeping, his hands and feet returned to their natural state; / and to the astonished king, he explained the whole cause there.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā rājā prasannātmā jayadevamukhodbhavam ..
gītagoviṃdamevāśu paṭhitvā mokṣamāgamat .. 65 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा राजा प्रसन्नात्मा जयदेवमुखोद्भवम् ..
गीतगोविंदमेवाशु पठित्वा मोक्षमागमत् .. 65 ..
text_mt: Having heard it, the king, delighted in mind, recited the Gītagovinda / that had arisen from the mouth of Jayadeva, and quickly attained liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ vipra jayadevo yathābhavat ..
kṛṣṇacaitanyacaritaṃ yathā jātaṃ śṛṇuśva tat .. 66 ..
meaning:
इति ते कथितं विप्र जयदेवो यथाभवत् ..
कृष्णचैतन्यचरितं यथा जातं शृणुश्व तत् .. 66 ..
text_mt: Thus it has been related to you, O twice-born, how Jayadeva came to be. / Hear about the deeds of Kṛṣṇa Caitanya as they occurred.

sanskrit_iast:
.. jīva uvāca .. ..
viṣṇuśarmā purā kaścidviprobhūdvedapāragaḥ ..
sarvadevamayaṃ viṣṇuṃ pūjayitvā prasannadhīḥ ..1..
meaning:
.. जीव उवाच .. ..
विष्णुशर्मा पुरा कश्चिद्विप्रोभूद्वेदपारगः ..
सर्वदेवमयं विष्णुं पूजयित्वा प्रसन्नधीः ..1..
text_mt: Jīva said: / Formerly, there was a certain twice-born named Viṣṇuśarman who had mastered the Vedas. / Having worshipped Viṣṇu, who comprises all deities, he was clear-minded.
title: Kṛṣṇacaitanyaśaṃkarācāryasamutpattivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
anyaissuraiśca saṃpūjyo babhūva haripūjanāt ..
bhikṣāvṛttiparo nityaṃ patnīmānputravarjitaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
अन्यैस्सुरैश्च संपूज्यो बभूव हरिपूजनात् ..
भिक्षावृत्तिपरो नित्यं पत्नीमान्पुत्रवर्जितः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Through his worship of Hari, he became worthy of worship even by other gods. / Constantly devoted to living on alms, he had a wife but was childless.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācittasya gehe vai vratī kaścitsamāgataḥ ..
dvijapatnīṃ tadaikākīṃ bhaktinamrāṃ daridriṇīm ..
dṛṣṭvovāca mahābhāgaḥ sa sparśāḍhyo dayāparaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
कदाचित्तस्य गेहे वै व्रती कश्चित्समागतः ..
द्विजपत्नीं तदैकाकीं भक्तिनम्रां दरिद्रिणीम् ..
दृष्ट्वोवाच महाभागः स स्पर्शाढ्यो दयापरः .. 3 ..
text_mt: Once, a certain ascetic came to his house. / Seeing the brāhmaṇa’s wife alone, bowed in devotion and destitute, / the noble one, compassionate and full of divine touch, said:

sanskrit_iast:
anena sparśamaṇinā lohadhātuśca kāṃcanam ..
bhavettasmānmahāsādhvi tridināṃtaṃ gṛhāṇa tam .. 4 ..
meaning:
अनेन स्पर्शमणिना लोहधातुश्च कांचनम् ..
भवेत्तस्मान्महासाध्वि त्रिदिनांतं गृहाण तम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: "By this philosopher's stone, base iron turns to gold. / Therefore, O great and virtuous woman, keep it for three days."

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā tāvatsarayvāṃ cāyāsyāmi teṃtikaṃ mudā ..
ityuktvā sa yayau vipro brāhmaṇī bahu kāṃcanam ..
kṛtvā lakṣmīṃ samāpyāsīdviṣṇuśarmā tadāgamat .. 5 ..
meaning:
स्नात्वा तावत्सरय्वां चायास्यामि तेंतिकं मुदा ..
इत्युक्त्वा स ययौ विप्रो ब्राह्मणी बहु कांचनम् ..
कृत्वा लक्ष्मीं समाप्यासीद्विष्णुशर्मा तदागमत् .. 5 ..
text_mt: "I shall bathe in the Sarayū meanwhile and return to your presence with joy." / Having spoken thus, that brāhmaṇa departed. The brāhmaṇa woman, having made much gold, / attained wealth, and then Viṣṇuśarman arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
bahusvarṇayutāṃ patnīṃ dṛṣṭvovāca haripriyaḥ ..
gaccha nāri madāghūrṇe yatra vai rasiko janaḥ .. .. 6 ..
meaning:
बहुस्वर्णयुतां पत्नीं दृष्ट्वोवाच हरिप्रियः ..
गच्छ नारि मदाघूर्णे यत्र वै रसिको जनः .. .. 6 ..
text_mt: Seeing his wife possessing much gold, he who was dear to Hari said: / "Go, woman intoxicated with pride, where men of pleasure dwell!

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ viṣṇuparo dīnaścaurabhītaḥ sadaiva hi ..
madhumattāṃ kathaṃ tvāṃ vai gṛhītuṃ bhuvi ca kṣamaḥ ..7..
meaning:
अहं विष्णुपरो दीनश्चौरभीतः सदैव हि ..
मधुमत्तां कथं त्वां वै गृहीतुं भुवि च क्षमः ..7..
text_mt: I am devoted to Viṣṇu, destitute, and always terrified of thieves. / How can I be capable of keeping you on earth when you are intoxicated with sweet wine?"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ patibhītā pativratā ..
sasvarṇaṃ sparśakaṃ tasmai dattvā sevāparābhavat .. 8 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो घोरं पतिभीता पतिव्रता ..
सस्वर्णं स्पर्शकं तस्मै दत्त्वा सेवापराभवत् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Hearing these dreadful words, the devoted wife, fearing her husband, / gave him the philosopher's stone along with the gold and became dedicated to serving him.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijo'pi ghargharāmadhye taddravyaṃ balato'kṣipat ..
tridinānte ca sa yatistatrāgatya mudānvitaḥ ..
uvāca brāhmaṇīṃ dīnāṃ svarṇaṃ kiṃ na kṛtaṃ tvayā .. 9 ..
meaning:
द्विजोऽपि घर्घरामध्ये तद्द्रव्यं बलतोऽक्षिपत् ..
त्रिदिनान्ते च स यतिस्तत्रागत्य मुदान्वितः ..
उवाच ब्राह्मणीं दीनां स्वर्णं किं न कृतं त्वया .. 9 ..
text_mt: The brāhmaṇa forcibly cast that wealth into the midst of the Ghargharā river. / At the end of the three days, that ascetic arrived there filled with joy / and said to the humble brāhmaṇa woman: "Why have you made no gold?"

sanskrit_iast:
sāha bho matpatiśśuddho gṛhītvā sparśakaṃ ruṣā ..
gharghare ca nicikṣepa tatohaṃ vahnipākinī ..
nirloho vartate viprastataḥ prabhṛti he guro .. 3.4.10.10 ..
meaning:
साह भो मत्पतिश्शुद्धो गृहीत्वा स्पर्शकं रुषा ..
घर्घरे च निचिक्षेप ततोहं वह्निपाकिनी ..
निर्लोहो वर्तते विप्रस्ततः प्रभृति हे गुरो .. 3.4.10.10 ..
text_mt: She said: "O Guru, my pure husband took the touchstone in anger / and cast it into the Ghargharā. Since then, I cook with fire [alone], / and the brāhmaṇa remains without any iron!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ sa yatirvismayānvitaḥ ..
sthitvā dinānte taṃ vipramuvāca bahu bhartsayan .. 11 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं स यतिर्विस्मयान्वितः ..
स्थित्वा दिनान्ते तं विप्रमुवाच बहु भर्त्सयन् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Hearing these words, the ascetic was filled with wonder. / Remaining until the end of the day, he spoke to that brāhmaṇa, rebuking him greatly:

sanskrit_iast:
daridro bhikṣukaścāsti bhavāndaivena mohitaḥ ..
dehi me sparśakaṃ śīghraṃ no cetprāṇāṃstyajāmyaham.. 12 ..
meaning:
दरिद्रो भिक्षुकश्चास्ति भवान्दैवेन मोहितः ..
देहि मे स्पर्शकं शीघ्रं नो चेत्प्राणांस्त्यजाम्यहम्.. 12 ..
text_mt: "You are a destitute beggar, deluded by fate! / Give me my touchstone at once, or else I shall abandon my life!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktavaṃtaṃ yatinaṃ viṣṇu śarmā tadābravīt ..
gaccha tvaṃ ghargharākūle tatra vai sparśakastava ..13..
meaning:
इत्युक्तवंतं यतिनं विष्णु शर्मा तदाब्रवीत् ..
गच्छ त्वं घर्घराकूले तत्र वै स्पर्शकस्तव ..13..
text_mt: To the ascetic who spoke thus, Viṣṇuśarman then said: / "Go to the bank of the Ghargharā; there is your touchstone."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā yatinā sārddhaṃ gṛhītvā kaṃṭakānbahūn ..
yatine darśayāmāsa sparśakāniva kaṃṭakān .. 14 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा यतिना सार्द्धं गृहीत्वा कंटकान्बहून् ..
यतिने दर्शयामास स्पर्शकानिव कंटकान् .. 14 ..
