text_mt: Having said this, going along with the ascetic and taking many thorns, / he showed the thorns to the ascetic as if they were touchstones.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu sa yatī vipraṃ natvā provāca namradhīḥ ..
mayā vai dvādaśābdāṃtaṃ samyagārādhitaḥ śivaḥ ..
tataḥ prāptaṃ śubhaṃ ratnaṃ tattu taddarśanena vai .. 15 ..
meaning:
तदा तु स यती विप्रं नत्वा प्रोवाच नम्रधीः ..
मया वै द्वादशाब्दांतं सम्यगाराधितः शिवः ..
ततः प्राप्तं शुभं रत्नं तत्तु तद्दर्शनेन वै .. 15 ..
text_mt: Then, bowing to the brāhmaṇa with a humble mind, that ascetic said: / "Indeed, for twelve years Śiva was duly worshipped by me; / thence was this auspicious jewel obtained, but simply by seeing you,

sanskrit_iast:
sparśako bahudhā prāpto mayā lobhātmanā dvija ..
ityābhāṣya śubhaṃ jñānaṃ prāpto mokṣamavāptavān .. 16 ..
meaning:
स्पर्शको बहुधा प्राप्तो मया लोभात्मना द्विज ..
इत्याभाष्य शुभं ज्ञानं प्राप्तो मोक्षमवाप्तवान् .. 16 ..
text_mt: touchstones were obtained in abundance by greedy-minded me, O brāhmaṇa!" / Having spoken thus, he attained auspicious knowledge and reached liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuśarmā sahasrābdamuṣitvā jagatītale ..
sūryamārādhya vidhivadviṣṇormokṣamavāptavān..17..
meaning:
विष्णुशर्मा सहस्राब्दमुषित्वा जगतीतले ..
सूर्यमाराध्य विधिवद्विष्णोर्मोक्षमवाप्तवान्..17..
text_mt: Viṣṇuśarman, having dwelt on the surface of the earth for a thousand years / and having worshipped Sūrya according to rule, attained liberation in Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
sa dvijo vaiṣṇavaṃ tejo dhṛtvā vai māsi phālgune..
trailokyamatapatsvāmī devakāryaparāyaṇaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
स द्विजो वैष्णवं तेजो धृत्वा वै मासि फाल्गुने..
त्रैलोक्यमतपत्स्वामी देवकार्यपरायणः .. 18 ..
text_mt: Assuming the splendour of Viṣṇu in the month of Phālguna, / that brāhmaṇa, as master, warmed the three worlds, devoted to the work of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca ..
ityuktvā bhagavāñjīvaḥ punaḥ prāha śacīpatim ..
phālgune māsi taṃ sūryaṃ samārādhya sukhī bhava .. .. 19 ..
meaning:
सूत उवाच ..
इत्युक्त्वा भगवाञ्जीवः पुनः प्राह शचीपतिम् ..
फाल्गुने मासि तं सूर्यं समाराध्य सुखी भव .. .. 19 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having spoken thus, the venerable Jīva again spoke to the lord of Śacī: / "In the month of Phālguna, worship that Sūrya and be happy!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityukto guruṇā devo dhyātvā sarvamayaṃ harim ..
pūjanairbahudhākārairdevadevamapūjayat .. 3.4.10.20 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तो गुरुणा देवो ध्यात्वा सर्वमयं हरिम् ..
पूजनैर्बहुधाकारैर्देवदेवमपूजयत् .. 3.4.10.20 ..
text_mt: Addressed thus by his guru, the god [Indra], meditating on Hari who is made of everything, / worshipped the God of gods with offerings of many kinds.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prasanno bhagavānsamabhūtsūryamaṇḍalāt ..
caturbhujo hi raktāṃgo yathā yakṣastathaiva saḥ ..
paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ śakradehamupāgamat .. 21 ..
meaning:
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवान्समभूत्सूर्यमण्डलात् ..
चतुर्भुजो हि रक्तांगो यथा यक्षस्तथैव सः ..
पश्यतां सर्वदेवानां शक्रदेहमुपागमत् .. 21 ..
text_mt: Then the Blessed Lord, pleased, emerged from the solar orb— / four-armed, red-limbed, resembling a yakṣa; / before the eyes of all the gods, he entered the body of Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
tattejasā tadā śakraḥ svāntarlīya svakaṃ vapuḥ .. .
ayonissa dvijo bhūtvā śacī devī tathaiva sā .. 22 ..
meaning:
तत्तेजसा तदा शक्रः स्वान्तर्लीय स्वकं वपुः .. .
अयोनिस्स द्विजो भूत्वा शची देवी तथैव सा .. 22 ..
text_mt: By his splendour, Indra then dissolved his own form within himself; / unborn of a womb, he became that brāhmaṇa, and goddess Śacī likewise became [his wife].

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tau mithunībhūtau vaiṣṇavāgniprapīḍitau ..
remāte varṣaparyantaṃ gaṃgākūle mahāvane.. ... 23 ..
meaning:
तदा तौ मिथुनीभूतौ वैष्णवाग्निप्रपीडितौ ..
रेमाते वर्षपर्यन्तं गंगाकूले महावने.. ... 23 ..
text_mt: Then the two, having become a couple, ignited by the fire of Viṣṇu, / sported for a year in the great forest on the bank of the Gaṅgā.

sanskrit_iast:
adhādgarbhaṃ tadā devī śacī tu dvijarūpiṇī ..
bhādraśukle gurau vāre dvādaśyāṃ brāhmamaṇḍale .. 24 ..
meaning:
अधाद्गर्भं तदा देवी शची तु द्विजरूपिणी ..
भाद्रशुक्ले गुरौ वारे द्वादश्यां ब्राह्ममण्डले .. 24 ..
text_mt: Then the goddess Śacī, in the form of a brāhmaṇa woman, bore a child in her womb / on the bright twelfth lunar day of Bhādra, on a Thursday, in the Brāhma-maṇḍala.

sanskrit_iast:
prādurāsītsvayaṃ viṣṇurdhṛtvā sarva kalāṃ hariḥ ..
caturbhujaśca raktāṅgo ravikuṃbhasamaprabhaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
प्रादुरासीत्स्वयं विष्णुर्धृत्वा सर्व कलां हरिः ..
चतुर्भुजश्च रक्ताङ्गो रविकुंभसमप्रभः .. 25 ..
text_mt: Viṣṇu Hari manifested himself, bearing every digit [of divinity]— / four-armed, red-limbed, with splendour like the pitcher of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā rudrāśca vasavo viśvedevā marudgaṇāḥ ..
sādhyāśca bhāskarāḥ siddhāstuṣṭuvustaṃ sanātanam .. 26 ..
meaning:
तदा रुद्राश्च वसवो विश्वेदेवा मरुद्गणाः ..
साध्याश्च भास्कराः सिद्धास्तुष्टुवुस्तं सनातनम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: Then the Rudras, the Vasus, the Viśvedevas, the hosts of Maruts, / the Sādhyas, the Ādityas, and the Siddhas praised that eternal Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
kuliśadhvajapadmagadāṃkuśābhaṃ caraṇaṃ tava nātha mahābharaṇam ..
ramaṇaṃ munibhirvidhiśaṃbhuyutaṃ praṇamāma vayaṃ bhavabhītiharam .. 27 ..
meaning:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
कुलिशध्वजपद्मगदांकुशाभं चरणं तव नाथ महाभरणम् ..
रमणं मुनिभिर्विधिशंभुयुतं प्रणमाम वयं भवभीतिहरम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: The gods said: / "O Lord, we bow to your foot, an exalted ornament shining like the thunderbolt, banner, lotus, mace, and elephant goad, / which is the delight of the sages together with Brahmā and Śambhu, and which removes the fear of worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
daracakragadāmbujamānadharaḥ suraśatrukaṭhoraśarīraharaḥ ..
sacarācaralokabharaścapalaḥ khalanāśakarassurakārya karaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
दरचक्रगदाम्बुजमानधरः सुरशत्रुकठोरशरीरहरः ..
सचराचरलोकभरश्चपलः खलनाशकरस्सुरकार्य करः .. 28 ..
text_mt: Holding the standard of the conch, discus, mace, and lotus, destroying the fierce bodies of the enemies of the gods, / supporting the moving and unmoving worlds, active, destroying the wicked, performing the work of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
namaste śacīnaṃdanānandakārinmahāpāpasantāpadurlāpahārin ..
surārīnnihatyāśu lokādhidhārinsvabhaktyāghajātāṅgakoṭi prahārin .. 29 ..
meaning:
नमस्ते शचीनंदनानन्दकारिन्महापापसन्तापदुर्लापहारिन् ..
सुरारीन्निहत्याशु लोकाधिधारिन्स्वभक्त्याघजाताङ्गकोटि प्रहारिन् .. 29 ..
text_mt: Salutations to you, O son of Śacī, who cause delight, who remove great sins, torments, and evil talk, / who quickly slay the enemies of the gods, who uphold the worlds, who strike down millions of sins born of the body by devotion to you!

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā haṃsarūpeṇa satyaṃ prapālyaṃ tvayā yajñarūpeṇa vedaḥ prarakṣya ..
sa vai yajñarūpo bhavām̐llokadhārī śacīnandanaḥ śakraśarmaprasaktaḥ .. 3.4.10.30 ..
meaning:
त्वया हंसरूपेण सत्यं प्रपाल्यं त्वया यज्ञरूपेण वेदः प्ररक्ष्य ..
स वै यज्ञरूपो भवाम्̐ल्लोकधारी शचीनन्दनः शक्रशर्मप्रसक्तः .. 3.4.10.30 ..
text_mt: Truth was protected by you in the form of a swan; the Veda was preserved by you in the form of sacrifice. / You, the supporter of the world in the form of sacrifice, are the son of Śacī, devoted to the delight of Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
anarpitacarocirātkaruṇayāvatīrṇaḥ kalau samarpayitumunnatojvalarasāṃ svabhaktiśriyam ..
hareḥ punarasundaradyutikadaṃbasandīpitaḥ sadā sphuratu no hṛdayakandare śacīnaṃdanaḥ .. 31..
meaning:
अनर्पितचरोचिरात्करुणयावतीर्णः कलौ समर्पयितुमुन्नतोज्वलरसां स्वभक्तिश्रियम् ..
हरेः पुनरसुन्दरद्युतिकदंबसन्दीपितः सदा स्फुरतु नो हृदयकन्दरे शचीनंदनः .. 31..
text_mt: Descended out of compassion in the Kali age, though never before bestowed, to deliver the radiant wealth of his own devotion imbued with exalted, luminous aesthetic emotion— / may that son of Śacī, illuminated by the cluster of Hari's incomparably beautiful radiances, shine forever in the cavern of our hearts!

sanskrit_iast:
visarjati narānbhavānkaruṇayā prapālya kṣitau nivedayitumudbhavaḥ parātparaṃ svakīyaṃ padam ..
kalau ditijasaṃbhavādhivyathābdhisuramagnagānsamuddhara mahāprabho kṛṣṇacaitanya śacīsuta .. 32 ..
meaning:
विसर्जति नरान्भवान्करुणया प्रपाल्य क्षितौ निवेदयितुमुद्भवः परात्परं स्वकीयं पदम् ..
कलौ दितिजसंभवाधिव्यथाब्धिसुरमग्नगान्समुद्धर महाप्रभो कृष्णचैतन्य शचीसुत .. 32 ..
text_mt: You dispatch men [to this world], protecting them out of compassion on earth, appearing in order to present your own highest abode, beyond the supreme. / In the Kali age, deliver those submerged in the ocean of agony and distress born of the sons of Diti, O great Lord, Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, son of Śacī!

sanskrit_iast:
mādhuryyairmadhubhissugaṃdhavadanaḥ svarṇāṃbujānāṃ vanaṃ kāruṇyā mṛtanirjharairupacitaḥ satpremahemācalaḥ ..
bhaktāṃbhodharadhāriṇī vijayinī niṣkaṃpasaptāvalī devo naḥ kuladevataṃ vijayate caitanyakṛṣṇo hariḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
माधुर्य्यैर्मधुभिस्सुगंधवदनः स्वर्णांबुजानां वनं कारुण्या मृतनिर्झरैरुपचितः सत्प्रेमहेमाचलः ..
भक्तांभोधरधारिणी विजयिनी निष्कंपसप्तावली देवो नः कुलदेवतं विजयते चैतन्यकृष्णो हरिः .. 33 ..
text_mt: With a fragrant mouth [sweet] with the sweetness of honey, a forest of golden lotuses, nourished by cascades of the nectar of compassion, a golden mountain of true love, / bearing the clouds of devotees, victorious, with an unshakeable row of seven [modes of devotion], our family deity, the divine Caitanya Kṛṣṇa Hari, triumphs!

sanskrit_iast:
devārātijanairadharmajanitaissapīḍiteyaṃ mahī saṃkucyāśu kalau kalevaramidaṃ bījāya hā vartate ..
tvannāmnaiva surārayo vidalitāḥ pātālagāḥ pīḍitā mlecchā dharmaparāḥ sureśanamanāstasmai namo vyāpine .. 34 ..
meaning:
देवारातिजनैरधर्मजनितैस्सपीडितेयं मही संकुच्याशु कलौ कलेवरमिदं बीजाय हा वर्तते ..
त्वन्नाम्नैव सुरारयो विदलिताः पातालगाः पीडिता म्लेच्छा धर्मपराः सुरेशनमनास्तस्मै नमो व्यापिने .. 34 ..
text_mt: Afflicted by the enemies of the gods born of unrighteousness, this earth, shrinking rapidly in the Kali age, remains as this body merely for the sake of seed, alas! / By your name alone, the enemies of the gods are shattered, cast into the netherworld, and tormented, while even barbarians become devoted to righteousness and bow to the Lord of the gods. Salutations to that all-pervading One!"

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ityabhiṣṭūya puruṣaṃ yajñeśaṃ ca śacīpatim ..
bṛhaspatimupāgamya devā vacanamabruvan .. 35 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
इत्यभिष्टूय पुरुषं यज्ञेशं च शचीपतिम् ..
बृहस्पतिमुपागम्य देवा वचनमब्रुवन् .. 35 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having thus praised the Puruṣa, the Lord of sacrifice, and the husband of Śacī, / the gods approached Bṛhaspati and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
vayaṃ rudrā mahābhāga ime ca vasavo'śvinau ..
kena kenāṃśakenaiva janiṣyāmo mahītale ..
tatsarvaṃ kṛpayā deva vaktu marhati no bhavān .. 36 ..
meaning:
वयं रुद्रा महाभाग इमे च वसवोऽश्विनौ ..
केन केनांशकेनैव जनिष्यामो महीतले ..
तत्सर्वं कृपया देव वक्तु मर्हति नो भवान् .. 36 ..
text_mt: "O highly fortunate one, as what portions shall we, the Rudras, / these Vasus, and the two Aśvins, be born on the face of the earth? / You ought, out of compassion, O god, to tell us all that."

sanskrit_iast:
.. bṛhaspatiruvāca .. ..
ahaṃ vaḥ kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ surasattamāḥ ..
purā pūrvabhave cāsīnmṛgavyādho dvijādhamaḥ ..
dhanurbāṇadharo nityaṃ mārge vipravihiṃsakaḥ ..37..
meaning:
.. बृहस्पतिरुवाच .. ..
अहं वः कथयिष्यामि शृणुध्वं सुरसत्तमाः ..
पुरा पूर्वभवे चासीन्मृगव्याधो द्विजाधमः ..
धनुर्बाणधरो नित्यं मार्गे विप्रविहिंसकः ..37..
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / "I shall tell you; listen, O best of the gods! / Long ago, in a previous birth, there was a deer-hunter, a vile brāhmaṇa, / always bearing bow and arrows, who harmed brāhmaṇas on the road.

sanskrit_iast:
hatvā dvijānmahāmūḍhasteṣāṃ yajñopavītakam ..
gṛhītvā helayā duṣṭo mahākrośastu tatkṛtaḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
हत्वा द्विजान्महामूढस्तेषां यज्ञोपवीतकम् ..
गृहीत्वा हेलया दुष्टो महाक्रोशस्तु तत्कृतः .. 38 ..
text_mt:
Having slain brāhmaṇas, the great fool took their sacred threads
with ease; indeed, that wicked man made a great outcry [among them].

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇasya ca yaddravyaṃ sudhopamamanuttamam ..
madhuraṃ kṣatriyasyaiva vaiśyasyānnasamaṃ smṛtam .. 39 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणस्य च यद्द्रव्यं सुधोपममनुत्तमम् ..
मधुरं क्षत्रियस्यैव वैश्यस्यान्नसमं स्मृतम् .. 39 ..
text_mt:
The property of a brāhmaṇa is like nectar, unsurpassed;
that of a kṣatriya is sweet, while that of a vaiśya is considered equal to ordinary food;

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrasya vastu rudhiramiti jñātvā dvijā dhamaḥ ..
sa jaghāna trivarṇāṃśca brāhmaṇānbahulānkhalaḥ .. 3.4.10.40 ..
meaning:
शूद्रस्य वस्तु रुधिरमिति ज्ञात्वा द्विजा धमः ..
स जघान त्रिवर्णांश्च ब्राह्मणान्बहुलान्खलः .. 3.4.10.40 ..
text_mt:
and the possession of a śūdra is blood—knowing this, the vile twice-born
slew members of the three varnas, and that villain killed many brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijanāśātsurāssarve bhayabhītāssamaṃtataḥ ..
parameṣṭhinamāgamya kathāṃścakuśca kāraṇam.. .. 41 ..
meaning:
द्विजनाशात्सुरास्सर्वे भयभीतास्समंततः ..
परमेष्ठिनमागम्य कथांश्चकुश्च कारणम्.. .. 41 ..
text_mt:
From the destruction of the twice-born, all the gods were terrified on every side;
approaching Parameṣṭhin, they told him the tale and the cause.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā ca duḥkhito brahmā saptarṣīnprāha lokagān ..
uddeśaṃ kuru tatraiva gatvā tasya dvijottama .. 42 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा च दुःखितो ब्रह्मा सप्तर्षीन्प्राह लोकगान् ..
उद्देशं कुरु तत्रैव गत्वा तस्य द्विजोत्तम .. 42 ..
text_mt:
Hearing this, Brahmā was grieved and spoke to the Seven Rṣis who roam the worlds:
“Go right there, O best of the twice-born, and show him guidance!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā marīcistu vaśiṣṭhādibhiranvitaḥ ..
tatra gatvā sthitāssarve mṛgavyādhasya vai vane .. 43
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा मरीचिस्तु वशिष्ठादिभिरन्वितः ..
तत्र गत्वा स्थितास्सर्वे मृगव्याधस्य वै वने .. 43
text_mt:
Hearing this, Marīci, accompanied by Vasiṣṭha and others,
went there, and they all halted in the forest of the hunter.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgavyādhastu tāndṛṣṭvā dhanurbāṇadharo balī ..
uvāca vacanaṃ ghoraṃ haniṣyehaṃ ca vodya vai .. 44 ..
meaning:
मृगव्याधस्तु तान्दृष्ट्वा धनुर्बाणधरो बली ..
उवाच वचनं घोरं हनिष्येहं च वोद्य वै .. 44 ..
text_mt:
Seeing them, the mighty hunter, bearing bow and arrow,
spoke terrifying words: “Today I shall surely slay you!”

sanskrit_iast:
marīcādyā vihasyāhuḥ kimarthaṃ haṃtumudyataḥ ..
kulārthaṃ vātmano'rthaṃ vā śīghraṃ vada mahābala .. 45 ..
meaning:
मरीचाद्या विहस्याहुः किमर्थं हंतुमुद्यतः ..
कुलार्थं वात्मनोऽर्थं वा शीघ्रं वद महाबल .. 45 ..
text_mt:
Marīci and the others laughed and said, “Why are you intent on killing?
Is it for the sake of your family or for yourself? Speak quickly, O mighty one!”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktastāndvijaḥ prāha kulārthaṃ cātmano hite ..
hanmi yuṣmāndhanairyuktānbrāhmaṇām̐śca viśeṣataḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तस्तान्द्विजः प्राह कुलार्थं चात्मनो हिते ..
हन्मि युष्मान्धनैर्युक्तान्ब्राह्मणाम्̐श्च विशेषतः .. 46 ..
text_mt:
Thus addressed, the twice-born said to them: “For the sake of my family and my own welfare,
I slay you who possess riches, and brāhmaṇas in particular.”

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā tamāhuste viprā gaccha śīghraṃ dhanurdhara ..
viprahatyākṛtaṃ pāpaṃ bhuñjīyātko vicāraya ..47..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा तमाहुस्ते विप्रा गच्छ शीघ्रं धनुर्धर ..
विप्रहत्याकृतं पापं भुञ्जीयात्को विचारय ..47..
text_mt:
Hearing him, those vipras said: “Go quickly, O archer!
Reflect on who will partake of the sin committed by slaying vipras.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu ghorātmā teṣāṃ dṛṣṭyā sunirmalaḥ ..
gatvā vaṃśajanānāha bhūri pāpaṃ mayārjitam ..48..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु घोरात्मा तेषां दृष्ट्या सुनिर्मलः ..
गत्वा वंशजनानाह भूरि पापं मयार्जितम् ..48..
text_mt:
Hearing this, he of terrible soul became completely pure through their gaze;
he went and said to his family members: “Abundant sin has been earned by me.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpāpakaṃ bhavadbhiśca grahaṇīyaṃ dhanaṃ yathā ..
te tu śrutvā dvijaṃ prāhurna vayaṃ pāpabhoginaḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
तत्पापकं भवद्भिश्च ग्रहणीयं धनं यथा ..
ते तु श्रुत्वा द्विजं प्राहुर्न वयं पापभोगिनः .. 49 ..
text_mt:
That little sin must be taken by you, just as you take the wealth.”
Hearing him, they said to the twice-born: “We are not partakers of your sin.

sanskrit_iast:
sākṣīyaṃ bhūmiracalā sākṣī sūryo'yamuttamaḥ ..
iti śrutvā mṛgavyādho munīnāha kṛtāṃjaliḥ .. 3.4.10.50 ..
meaning:
साक्षीयं भूमिरचला साक्षी सूर्योऽयमुत्तमः ..
इति श्रुत्वा मृगव्याधो मुनीनाह कृतांजलिः .. 3.4.10.50 ..
text_mt:
This unmoving earth is witness, and this supreme sun is witness!”
Hearing this, the hunter, with folded hands, said to the sages:

sanskrit_iast:
yathā pāpaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti tathā mājñātumarhatha ..
ityuktāstena te prāhuḥ śṛṇu tvaṃ maṃtramuttamam .. 51 ..
meaning:
यथा पापं क्षयं याति तथा माज्ञातुमर्हथ ..
इत्युक्तास्तेन ते प्राहुः शृणु त्वं मंत्रमुत्तमम् .. 51 ..
text_mt:
“You ought to teach me so that my sin may be destroyed.”
Thus addressed by him, they said: “Hear the supreme mantra!

sanskrit_iast:
rāma nāma hi tajjñeyaṃ sarvāghaughavināśanam ..
yāvattvatpārśvamāyāmastāvattvaṃ japa cottamam .. 52 ..
meaning:
राम नाम हि तज्ज्ञेयं सर्वाघौघविनाशनम् ..
यावत्त्वत्पार्श्वमायामस्तावत्त्वं जप चोत्तमम् .. 52 ..
text_mt:
It is known as the name ‘Rāma’, which destroys the flood of all sins.
Until we come back to your side, do you recite this supreme [name].”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā te gatā viprāstīrthāttīrthāntaraṃ prati ..
marāmarāmaretyevaṃ sahasrābdaṃ jajāpa ha .. 53 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा ते गता विप्रास्तीर्थात्तीर्थान्तरं प्रति ..
मरामरामरेत्येवं सहस्राब्दं जजाप ह .. 53 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, those vipras departed from holy site to holy site;
and he muttered “Marā, Marā, Marā” for a thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
japaprabhāvādabhavadvanamutpalasaṃkulam ..
tatsthānamutpalāraṇyaṃ prasiddhamabhavadbhuvi.. 54 ..
meaning:
जपप्रभावादभवद्वनमुत्पलसंकुलम् ..
तत्स्थानमुत्पलारण्यं प्रसिद्धमभवद्भुवि.. 54 ..
text_mt:
By the power of his recitation, the forest became filled with lotuses;
that place became famous on earth as the Utpalāraṇya.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saptarṣayaḥ prāptā valmīkāttaṃ nirākṛtam ..
dṛṣṭvā śuddhaṃ tadā vipramūcuste vismayānvitāḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
ततः सप्तर्षयः प्राप्ता वल्मीकात्तं निराकृतम् ..
दृष्ट्वा शुद्धं तदा विप्रमूचुस्ते विस्मयान्विताः .. 55 ..
text_mt:
Then the Seven Ṛṣis arrived, and seeing that pure vipra
emerged from an anthill, they spoke with wonder:

sanskrit_iast:
valmīkānnissṛto yasmāttasmādvālmīkiruttamam ..
tava nāma bhavedvipra trikālajña mahāmate .. 56 ..
meaning:
वल्मीकान्निस्सृतो यस्मात्तस्माद्वाल्मीकिरुत्तमम् ..
तव नाम भवेद्विप्र त्रिकालज्ञ महामते .. 56 ..
text_mt:
“Because you came forth from an anthill (valmīka), therefore ‘Vālmīki’
shall be your supreme name, O wise vipra who knows past, present, and future!”

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā yayurlokaṃ sa tu rāmāyaṇaṃ muniḥ ..
kalpāṣṭādaśayuktaṃ hi śatakoṭipravistaram ..57..
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा ययुर्लोकं स तु रामायणं मुनिः ..
कल्पाष्टादशयुक्तं हि शतकोटिप्रविस्तरम् ..57..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, they went to their world; and that sage [composed] the Rāmāyaṇa,
consisting of eighteen kalpas and extending to a hundred crores [of verses].

sanskrit_iast:
cakāra nirmalaṃ padyaiḥ sarvāghaughavināśanam ..
tatpaścātsa śivo bhūtvā tatra vāsamakārayat .. 58 ..
meaning:
चकार निर्मलं पद्यैः सर्वाघौघविनाशनम् ..
तत्पश्चात्स शिवो भूत्वा तत्र वासमकारयत् .. 58 ..
text_mt:
He made it spotless in verse, destroying the flood of all sins.
After that, he became Śiva and made his dwelling there.

sanskrit_iast:
adyāpi saṃsthitaḥ svāmī mṛgavyādhaḥ sanātanaḥ ..
śṛṇudhvaṃ ca surāḥ sarve taccaritraṃ harapriyam .. 59 ..
meaning:
अद्यापि संस्थितः स्वामी मृगव्याधः सनातनः ..
शृणुध्वं च सुराः सर्वे तच्चरित्रं हरप्रियम् .. 59 ..
text_mt:
Even today, the eternal master, the hunter, remains there.
Hear, all you gods, his deed dear to Hara!

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvate'ntare prāpte cādye satyayuge śubhe ..
brahmāgatyotpalāraṇyaṃ tatra yajñaṃ cakāra ha .. 3.4.10.60 ..
meaning:
वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे प्राप्ते चाद्ये सत्ययुगे शुभे ..
ब्रह्मागत्योत्पलारण्यं तत्र यज्ञं चकार ह .. 3.4.10.60 ..
text_mt:
When the Vaivasvata interval arrived in the first auspicious Kṛtayuga,
Brahmā, having come to Utpalāraṇya, performed a sacrifice there.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā sarasvatī devī nadī bhūtvā samāgatā ..
taddarśanātsvayaṃ brahmā mukhato brāhmaṇaṃ śubham.. 61 ..
meaning:
तदा सरस्वती देवी नदी भूत्वा समागता ..
तद्दर्शनात्स्वयं ब्रह्मा मुखतो ब्राह्मणं शुभम्.. 61 ..
text_mt:
Then goddess Sarasvatī, having become a river, arrived;
at the sight of her, the potent Brahmā himself [produced] from his mouth the auspicious brāhmaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
bāhubhyāṃ kṣatriyaṃ caiva corubhyāṃ vaiśyamuttamam ..
padbhyāṃ śūdraṃ śubhācāraṃ janayāmāsa vīryavān .. 62 ..
meaning:
बाहुभ्यां क्षत्रियं चैव चोरुभ्यां वैश्यमुत्तमम् ..
पद्भ्यां शूद्रं शुभाचारं जनयामास वीर्यवान् .. 62 ..
text_mt:
from his arms the kṣatriya, from his thighs the excellent vaiśya,
and from his feet he produced the śūdra of auspicious conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijarājastathā somaścaṃdramā nāmato dvijaḥ ..
loke sarvātapaḥ sūryaḥ kaśyaṃ vīryaṃ hi pāti yaḥ .. 63 ..
meaning:
द्विजराजस्तथा सोमश्चंद्रमा नामतो द्विजः ..
लोके सर्वातपः सूर्यः कश्यं वीर्यं हि पाति यः .. 63 ..
text_mt:
Likewise, Soma, the king of the twice-born, and the moon is a twice-born by name;
the sun gives all heat in the world, and he who protects the kaśya-virility,

sanskrit_iast:
kaśyapo hi dvitīyo'sau marīcistu tato'bhavat ..
ratnānāmākaro yo vai sa hi ratnākaraḥ smṛtaḥ .. 64..
meaning:
कश्यपो हि द्वितीयोऽसौ मरीचिस्तु ततोऽभवत् ..
रत्नानामाकरो यो वै स हि रत्नाकरः स्मृतः .. 64..
text_mt:
he was Kaśyapa, that second one; and Marīci arose from him;
he who is a mine of gems is known as Ratnākara;

sanskrit_iast:
lokāndharati yo dravyaiḥ sa tu dharmo hi nāmataḥ ..
gaṃbhīraścāsti sadṛśaḥ kośo yasya saritpatiḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
लोकान्धरति यो द्रव्यैः स तु धर्मो हि नामतः ..
गंभीरश्चास्ति सदृशः कोशो यस्य सरित्पतिः .. 65 ..
text_mt:
he who upholds the worlds with riches is Dharma by name;
he is deep, like whom the lord of rivers is his treasury;

sanskrit_iast:
lokāndakṣati yaḥ kṛtyaiḥ sa tu dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ ..
brahmaṇoṃgācca te jātāstasmādvai brāhmaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 66 ..
meaning:
लोकान्दक्षति यः कृत्यैः स तु दक्षः प्रजापतिः ..
ब्रह्मणोंगाच्च ते जातास्तस्माद्वै ब्राह्मणाः स्मृताः .. 66 ..
text_mt:
he who shows skill toward the worlds through duties is Dakṣa Prajāpati.
They were born from the body of Brahmā; therefore they are remembered as brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇadharmeṇa te sarve varṇātmānaśca vai kramāt ..
dakṣasya manaso jātāḥ kanyāḥ paṃcaśataṃ tataḥ ..
viṣṇu māyāprabhāvena kalābhūtāḥ sthitā bhuvi ..67..
meaning:
वर्णधर्मेण ते सर्वे वर्णात्मानश्च वै क्रमात् ..
दक्षस्य मनसो जाताः कन्याः पंचशतं ततः ..
विष्णु मायाप्रभावेन कलाभूताः स्थिता भुवि ..67..

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu bhagavānbrahmā somāyāśvinimaṇḍalam ..
saptaviṃśadgaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dadau lokavivṛddhaye ..68..
meaning:
तदा तु भगवान्ब्रह्मा सोमायाश्विनिमण्डलम् ..
सप्तविंशद्गणं श्रेष्ठं ददौ लोकविवृद्धये ..68..
text_mt:
Then the lord Brahmā gave to Soma the group of twenty-seven best [daughters],
the circle of Aśvinī [and the others], for the increase of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
kaśyapāyāditigaṇaṃ kṣatrarūpaṃ trayodaśam ..
dharmāya kīrtiprabhṛtīrdadau sa ca mahāmuniḥ .. 69 ..
meaning:
कश्यपायादितिगणं क्षत्ररूपं त्रयोदशम् ..
धर्माय कीर्तिप्रभृतीर्ददौ स च महामुनिः .. 69 ..
text_mt:
To Kaśyapa he gave the thirteen, the group of Aditi, having the form of sovereignty;
and to Dharma that great sage gave Kīrti and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvidhāni sṛṣṭāni cāsanvaivasvate'ntare ..
teṣāṃ patistvayaṃ dakṣo'bhūdvidherājñayā bhuvi .. 3.4.10.70 ..
meaning:
नानाविधानि सृष्टानि चासन्वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे ..
तेषां पतिस्त्वयं दक्षोऽभूद्विधेराज्ञया भुवि .. 3.4.10.70 ..
text_mt:
Various kinds of creatures were created in the Vaivasvata interval;
by the command of the Ordainer, this Dakṣa became their lord on earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra vāsaṃ svayaṃ dakṣaḥ kṛtavānyajñatatparaḥ ..
sarve devagaṇā dakṣaṃ namaskṛtya caraṃti hi ..71..
meaning:
तत्र वासं स्वयं दक्षः कृतवान्यज्ञतत्परः ..
सर्वे देवगणा दक्षं नमस्कृत्य चरंति हि ..71..
text_mt:
Dakṣa himself took up dwelling there, intent on sacrifice.
All the hosts of gods go about bowing to Dakṣa;

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtanātho mahādevo na nanāma kadācana ..
tadā kruddhaḥ svayaṃ dakṣaḥ śivabhāgaṃ na dattavān .. 72 ..
meaning:
भूतनाथो महादेवो न ननाम कदाचन ..
तदा क्रुद्धः स्वयं दक्षः शिवभागं न दत्तवान् .. 72 ..
text_mt:
Mahādeva, the lord of beings, never bowed.
Then Dakṣa himself became angry and did not give Śiva his share.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgavyādhaḥ śivaḥ kruddho vīrabhadro babhūva ha ..
triśirāśca trinetraśca tripadastatra cāgataḥ .. 73 ..
meaning:
मृगव्याधः शिवः क्रुद्धो वीरभद्रो बभूव ह ..
त्रिशिराश्च त्रिनेत्रश्च त्रिपदस्तत्र चागतः .. 73 ..
text_mt:
Angry Śiva became the hunter and Vīrabhadra;
three-headed, three-eyed, and three-footed, he arrived there.

sanskrit_iast:
tenaiva pīḍitā devā munayaḥ pitaro'bhavan ..
tadā vai yajñapuruṣo bhayabhītaḥ samaṃtataḥ .. 74 ..
meaning:
तेनैव पीडिता देवा मुनयः पितरोऽभवन् ..
तदा वै यज्ञपुरुषो भयभीतः समंततः .. 74 ..
text_mt:
The gods, sages, and ancestors were afflicted by him alone;
then the Sacrifice Person became terrified on every side.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgabhūto yayau tūrṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā vyādhaḥ śivobhavat ..
rudravyādhena sa mṛgo vibhinnāṅgo babhūva ha .. 75 ..
meaning:
मृगभूतो ययौ तूर्णं दृष्ट्वा व्याधः शिवोभवत् ..
रुद्रव्याधेन स मृगो विभिन्नाङ्गो बभूव ह .. 75 ..
text_mt:
Having assumed the form of a deer, he fled swiftly; seeing him, Śiva became a hunter.
By the Rudra-hunter, that deer had his limbs torn apart.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu bhagavānbrahmā tuṣṭāva madhurasvaraiḥ ..
saṃtuṣṭaśca mṛgavyādho yajñaṃ pūrṇamakārayat .. 76 ..
meaning:
तदा तु भगवान्ब्रह्मा तुष्टाव मधुरस्वरैः ..
संतुष्टश्च मृगव्याधो यज्ञं पूर्णमकारयत् .. 76 ..
text_mt:
Then the lord Brahmā praised him with sweet voices;
and the hunter, being pleased, had the sacrifice completed.

sanskrit_iast:
tulārāśisthite bhānau taṃ rudraṃ candramaṇḍale ..
sthāpayitvā svayaṃ brahmā saptaviṃśaddinātmake ..
prayayau saptalokaṃ vai sa rudraścaṃdrarūpavān .. 77 ..
meaning:
तुलाराशिस्थिते भानौ तं रुद्रं चन्द्रमण्डले ..
स्थापयित्वा स्वयं ब्रह्मा सप्तविंशद्दिनात्मके ..
प्रययौ सप्तलोकं वै स रुद्रश्चंद्ररूपवान् .. 77 ..
text_mt:
When the sun stood in the sign of Libra, Brahmā himself,
having placed that Rudra in the orb of the moon consisting of twenty-seven days,
went away to the seven worlds; and that Rudra had the form of the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vīrabhadro rudraḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ ..
svāṃśaṃ dehātsamutpādya dvijagehamacodayat .. 78 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वीरभद्रो रुद्रः संहृष्टमानसः ..
स्वांशं देहात्समुत्पाद्य द्विजगेहमचोदयत् .. 78 ..
text_mt:
Hearing this, Vīrabhadra-Rudra, with a delighted mind,
emitted a portion of himself from his body and sent it to the house of a twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
vipra bhairavadattasya gehaṃ gatvā sa vai śivaḥ ..
tatputro'bhūtkalau ghore śaṃkaro nāma viśrutaḥ ..79..
meaning:
विप्र भैरवदत्तस्य गेहं गत्वा स वै शिवः ..
तत्पुत्रोऽभूत्कलौ घोरे शंकरो नाम विश्रुतः ..79..
text_mt:
Having gone to the house of the vipra Bhairavadatta, that Śiva
became his son in the terrible Kali age, renowned by the name Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
sa bālaśca guṇī vettā brahmacārī babhūva ha ..
kṛtvā śaṃkarabhāṣyaṃ ca śaivamārgamadarśayat .. 3.4.10.80 ..
meaning:
स बालश्च गुणी वेत्ता ब्रह्मचारी बभूव ह ..
कृत्वा शंकरभाष्यं च शैवमार्गमदर्शयत् .. 3.4.10.80 ..
text_mt: That boy became virtuous, wise, and a celibate student. / Having composed the Śaṅkarabhāṣya, he revealed the Śaiva path.

sanskrit_iast:
tripuṇḍraścākṣamālā ca maṃtraḥ paṃcākṣaraḥ śubhaḥ ..
śaivānāṃ maṃgalakaraḥ śaṃkarācāryanirmitaḥ .. 81 ..
ānandagirivanaśarmapurīśarmautpattivarṇanam
meaning:
त्रिपुण्ड्रश्चाक्षमाला च मंत्रः पंचाक्षरः शुभः ..
शैवानां मंगलकरः शंकराचार्यनिर्मितः .. 81 ..
आनन्दगिरिवनशर्मपुरीशर्मौत्पत्तिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
The tripuṇḍra, the rosary of akṣa beads, and the auspicious five-syllable mantra, / bringing welfare to the Śaivas, were instituted by Śaṅkarācārya.
The description of the birth of Ānandagiri, Vanaśarman, and Purīśarman.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca
purā tu naimiṣāraṇye vipraścājagaro'bhavat.
vedāntaśāstranipuṇo jñānavāñchambhupūjakaḥ..1..
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच
पुरा तु नैमिषारण्ये विप्रश्चाजगरोऽभवत्.
वेदान्तशास्त्रनिपुणो ज्ञानवाञ्छम्भुपूजकः..1..
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / Formerly, in the Naimiṣa forest, there was a brāhmaṇa named Ajagara, / skilled in the Vedānta scriptures, full of knowledge, and a worshipper of Śambhu.
title: athaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśābdāntare rudrastuṣṭo'bhūtpārthivārcanāt .
tadāgatya dadau jñānaṃ jīvanmokṣatvamāgataḥ . . 2
meaning:
द्वादशाब्दान्तरे रुद्रस्तुष्टोऽभूत्पार्थिवार्चनात् .
तदागत्य ददौ ज्ञानं जीवन्मोक्षत्वमागतः . . 2
text_mt: After twelve years, Rudra was pleased with his worship of the earthen liṅga. / Coming then, he gave him knowledge, and he attained liberation while living.

sanskrit_iast:
saṅkarṣaṇaṃ samārādhya tajjñānena dvijottamaḥ .
tuṣṭāva puṣkalābhiśca stutibhiḥ parameśvaram . . 3
meaning:
सङ्कर्षणं समाराध्य तज्ज्ञानेन द्विजोत्तमः .
तुष्टाव पुष्कलाभिश्च स्तुतिभिः परमेश्वरम् . . 3
text_mt: Having worshipped Saṅkarṣaṇa with that knowledge, that best of brāhmaṇas / praised the Supreme Lord with copious hymns of praise.

sanskrit_iast:
ajagara uvāca
sadaivyaṃ pradhānaṃ paraṃ jyotirūpaṃ nirākāramavyaktamānandanityam .
tridhā tattu jātaṃ triliṅgaikyabhinnaṃ pumānsattvarūpo rajorūpanārī . .
tayoryattu śeṣaṃ tamorūpameva tataśśeṣanāmne namastenamaste . . 4
meaning:
अजगर उवाच
सदैव्यं प्रधानं परं ज्योतिरूपं निराकारमव्यक्तमानन्दनित्यम् .
त्रिधा तत्तु जातं त्रिलिङ्गैक्यभिन्नं पुमान्सत्त्वरूपो रजोरूपनारी . .
तयोर्यत्तु शेषं तमोरूपमेव ततश्शेषनाम्ने नमस्तेनमस्ते . . 4
text_mt: Ajagara said: / Always divine, the unmanifest source, supreme, possessing the form of light, formless, unmanifest, eternal bliss, / that [reality] became threefold, divided into the union of the three genders: the male having the form of sattva, the female having the form of rajas, / and that which is their remainder, having the form of tamas; therefore, praise, praise unto you whose name is Śeṣa!

sanskrit_iast:
rajaścādibhūto guṇasyaiva māyā tathā madhyabhūto narassattvarūpam .
tathaivāntabhūto napuṃskaṃ tamovatsadaivādya nāgeśa tubhyaṃ namaste . . 5
meaning:
रजश्चादिभूतो गुणस्यैव माया तथा मध्यभूतो नरस्सत्त्वरूपम् .
तथैवान्तभूतो नपुंस्कं तमोवत्सदैवाद्य नागेश तुभ्यं नमस्ते . . 5
text_mt: Rajas is the primary element of the quality, Māyā; and in the middle is man, the form of sattva; / likewise, at the end is the neuter, like tamas; eternal, primeval lord of serpents, praise unto you!

sanskrit_iast:
narādhārarūpo bhavānkālakartā narākarṣaṇastvaṃ hi saṅkarṣaṇaśca .
ramante munīśāstvayi brahmadhāmni namastenamaste punaste namo'stu . .
narāṅgeṣu cādhārabhūtā śivā yā smṛtā yoganidrā hi śaktistvadīyā . . 6
meaning:
नराधाररूपो भवान्कालकर्ता नराकर्षणस्त्वं हि सङ्कर्षणश्च .
रमन्ते मुनीशास्त्वयि ब्रह्मधाम्नि नमस्तेनमस्ते पुनस्ते नमोऽस्तु . .
नराङ्गेषु चाधारभूता शिवा या स्मृता योगनिद्रा हि शक्तिस्त्वदीया . . 6
text_mt: You are the foundation of humanity, the maker of time; you draw in men, and are indeed Saṅkarṣaṇa. / The lords of sages delight in you, the realm of Brahman; praise, praise unto you, and once again praise be unto you! / And that auspicious goddess who is the foundation in human limbs is remembered as Yoganidrā, your very own power.

sanskrit_iast:
jīva uvāca
evaṃ hi saṃstuto devo dvijaṃ cājagaraṃ prabhuḥ .
sāyujyaṃ kṛtavānsvāṅge rudraḥ sarpo hi so'bhavat . . 7
meaning:
जीव उवाच
एवं हि संस्तुतो देवो द्विजं चाजगरं प्रभुः .
सायुज्यं कृतवान्स्वाङ्गे रुद्रः सर्पो हि सोऽभवत् . . 7
text_mt: Jīva said: / Thus praised, the lord and god Rudra united the brāhmaṇa Ajagara / into his own body, and he indeed became a serpent.

sanskrit_iast:
phaṇāsahasrasahito gaurāṅgo gauravigrahaḥ .
kṣīrābdhau mandiraṃ yasya babhūva ca guṇākaram . . 8
meaning:
फणासहस्रसहितो गौराङ्गो गौरविग्रहः .
क्षीराब्धौ मन्दिरं यस्य बभूव च गुणाकरम् . . 8
text_mt: Endowed with a thousand hoods, white-limbed, of fair body, / his abode, a mine of virtues, was in the ocean of milk.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ sarpākhyaṃ mahārudraṃ pratyāgatyātmabhūḥ svayam .
karkarāśisthite sūrye candre bhagaṇamaṇḍale . . 9
meaning:
तं सर्पाख्यं महारुद्रं प्रत्यागत्यात्मभूः स्वयम् .
कर्कराशिस्थिते सूर्ये चन्द्रे भगणमण्डले . . 9
text_mt: Approaching that Mahārudra known as the serpent, the Self-born one himself, / when the sun was in the sign of Cancer and the moon in the lunar mansion,

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ rudraṃ sthāpayāmāsa candramāḥ sa tu cābhavat .
iti śrutvā śeṣanāgo rudraḥ śrīgurubhāṣitam . . 3.4.11.10
meaning:
तं रुद्रं स्थापयामास चन्द्रमाः स तु चाभवत् .
इति श्रुत्वा शेषनागो रुद्रः श्रीगुरुभाषितम् . . 3.4.11.10
text_mt: established that Rudra, and he became Candramas. / Having heard these words spoken by the holy guru, the serpent Śeṣa, Rudra,

sanskrit_iast:
vacanaṃ sa prasannātmā teja utpādya vai mukhāt .
vindhyādrau janayāmāsa devadattadvijālaye . . 11
meaning:
वचनं स प्रसन्नात्मा तेज उत्पाद्य वै मुखात् .
विन्ध्याद्रौ जनयामास देवदत्तद्विजालये . . 11
text_mt: with a delighted mind, brought forth light from his mouth / and caused it to be born on the Vindhya mountain in the home of the brāhmaṇa Devadatta.

sanskrit_iast:
giriśarmā sa vai vipro vijitya viduṣāṃ gaṇān .
kāśīpurīṃ samāyātaḥ śiṣyobhūcchaṅkarasya vai . . 12
meaning:
गिरिशर्मा स वै विप्रो विजित्य विदुषां गणान् .
काशीपुरीं समायातः शिष्योभूच्छङ्करस्य वै . . 12
text_mt: That brāhmaṇa Giriśarman, having defeated hosts of scholars, / arrived at the city of Kāśī and became a disciple of Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ vipra yathā rudro babhūva ha .
punaḥ śṛṇu kathāṃ vipra yathā jīvena bhāṣitām . . 13
meaning:
इति ते कथितं विप्र यथा रुद्रो बभूव ह .
पुनः शृणु कथां विप्र यथा जीवेन भाषिताम् . . 13
text_mt: Thus has it been told to you, O brāhmaṇa, how he became Rudra. / Hear again the story, O brāhmaṇa, as told by Jīva.

sanskrit_iast:
jīva uvāca
prayāge ca purā hyāsīdbrāhmaṇo harisevakaḥ .
dāridryārtto mandabhāgyo nairṛto nāma viśrutaḥ . . 14
meaning:
जीव उवाच
प्रयागे च पुरा ह्यासीद्ब्राह्मणो हरिसेवकः .
दारिद्र्यार्त्तो मन्दभाग्यो नैरृतो नाम विश्रुतः . . 14
text_mt: Jīva said: / Formerly, in Prayāga, there was a brāhmaṇa who was a servant of Hari, / afflicted by poverty, unfortunate, renowned by the name Nairṛta.

sanskrit_iast:
mahākaṣṭena tasyaiva bhikṣā prāptā dināntake .
nairṛtaḥ putrapatnīko dāridryārto dinedine . . 15
meaning:
महाकष्टेन तस्यैव भिक्षा प्राप्ता दिनान्तके .
नैरृतः पुत्रपत्नीको दारिद्र्यार्तो दिनेदिने . . 15
text_mt: Only with great hardship did he obtain alms at the end of the day. / Accompanied by his wife and son, Nairṛta was afflicted by poverty day after day.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā nārado yogī samprāpto vaiṣṇavapriyaḥ .
pūjitastena vipreṇa viṣṇulokamupāyayau . . 16
meaning:
एकदा नारदो योगी सम्प्राप्तो वैष्णवप्रियः .
पूजितस्तेन विप्रेण विष्णुलोकमुपाययौ . . 16
text_mt: Once, the yogin Nārada arrived, beloved of the Vaiṣṇavas. / Worshipped by that brāhmaṇa, he departed for the world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ namaskṛtya punaḥpunaḥ .
vacanaṃ prāha namrātmā sadaiva bhagavatpriyaḥ . . 17
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा नारायणं देवं नमस्कृत्य पुनःपुनः .
वचनं प्राह नम्रात्मा सदैव भगवत्प्रियः . . 17
text_mt: Seeing the god Nārāyaṇa, bowing down again and again, / humble-minded, ever dear to the Lord, he spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavanye surāḥ sarve sadā tvatpūjane ratāḥ .
teṣāṃ bhaktāśca ye bhūmau dhanadhānyasamanvitāḥ . . 18
meaning:
भगवन्ये सुराः सर्वे सदा त्वत्पूजने रताः .
तेषां भक्ताश्च ये भूमौ धनधान्यसमन्विताः . . 18
text_mt: "O Lord, all those gods who are ever devoted to worshipping you, / their devotees on earth are endowed with wealth and grain.

sanskrit_iast:
tvadbhaktāśca mayā dṛṣṭā dāridyārtāḥ sadā bhuvi .
kimarthaṃ brūhi me svāmiñjanārdana namo'stu te . . 19
meaning:
त्वद्भक्ताश्च मया दृष्टा दारिद्यार्ताः सदा भुवि .
किमर्थं ब्रूहि मे स्वामिञ्जनार्दन नमोऽस्तु ते . . 19
text_mt: Yet your devotees on earth are seen by me to be ever afflicted by poverty. / For what reason? Tell me, O Master Janārdana, praise be unto you!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityukto nāradenaiva bhagavānbhaktavatsalaḥ .
tamāha vacanaṃ ramyaṃ tacchṛṇu tvaṃ surottama . . 3.4.11.20
meaning:
इत्युक्तो नारदेनैव भगवान्भक्तवत्सलः .
तमाह वचनं रम्यं तच्छृणु त्वं सुरोत्तम . . 3.4.11.20
text_mt: Thus addressed by Nārada, the Blessed Lord, affectionate to his devotees, / addressed pleasing words to him; hear that, O best of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
madbhakto bhagavānbrahmā dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇapriyān .
janām̐śca svavaśīkṛtya lokakāryaṃ karoti hi . . 21
meaning:
मद्भक्तो भगवान्ब्रह्मा दृष्ट्वा नारायणप्रियान् .
जनाम्̐श्च स्ववशीकृत्य लोककार्यं करोति हि . . 21
text_mt: "My devotee, the blessed Brahmā, seeing people beloved of Nārāyaṇa, / brings them under his sway and carries out the affairs of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmo'dharmastena kṛto dharmo vedamayaḥ smṛtaḥ .
sapta lokāśca dharmasya nirmitāstena dhīmatā . . 22
meaning:
धर्मोऽधर्मस्तेन कृतो धर्मो वेदमयः स्मृतः .
सप्त लोकाश्च धर्मस्य निर्मितास्तेन धीमता . . 22
text_mt: Dharma and adharma were made by him; dharma is remembered as consisting of the Veda. / Seven worlds of dharma were created by that wise one:

sanskrit_iast:
bhūrbhuvaḥ svo mahaścaiva janaścaiva tapastathā .
satyaṃ tathaiva kramato nṛṇāṃ dviguṇadaṃ sukham . . 23
meaning:
भूर्भुवः स्वो महश्चैव जनश्चैव तपस्तथा .
सत्यं तथैव क्रमतो नृणां द्विगुणदं सुखम् . . 23
text_mt: Bhūḥ, Bhuvaḥ, Svaḥ, and Mahaḥ, Janaḥ, and likewise Tapaḥ, / and Satya; in this order, they grant doubled happiness to humans.

sanskrit_iast:
adharmo vedarahito bhuvi śabdānyakartṛkaḥ .
ye śabdāśca mahāvāṇyā dūṣitāste hi lokagāḥ . . 24
meaning:
अधर्मो वेदरहितो भुवि शब्दान्यकर्तृकः .
ये शब्दाश्च महावाण्या दूषितास्ते हि लोकगाः . . 24
text_mt: Adharma is devoid of the Veda, made of other sounds on earth. / Those sounds which are corrupted by the Great Voice, they dwell in the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
vedetara pāpamayā daityavṛddhikarāḥ sadā .
adharmaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ saptalokāśca tasya vai . . 25
meaning:
वेदेतर पापमया दैत्यवृद्धिकराः सदा .
अधर्मः स तु विज्ञेयः सप्तलोकाश्च तस्य वै . . 25
text_mt: They are outside the Veda, full of sin, constantly increasing the daityas. / That is to be understood as adharma; and its seven worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmigarteṣu vidhinā nirmitāḥ sukhadāyakāḥ .
atalaṃ vitalaṃ caiva sutalaṃ ca talātalam . .
mahātalaṃ rasā caiva pātālaṃ cānyadharmajam . . 26
meaning:
भूमिगर्तेषु विधिना निर्मिताः सुखदायकाः .
अतलं वितलं चैव सुतलं च तलातलम् . .
महातलं रसा चैव पातालं चान्यधर्मजम् . . 26
text_mt: created in the cavities of the earth by the Creator, bestow comfort: / Atala, Vitala, Sutala, Talātala, / Mahātala, Rasā[tala], and Pātāla, born of another dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
anyadharmo hyadharmaśca devāstvanye hi te'surāḥ .
dharmapakṣāḥ surā jñeyā asurāścānyadharmajāḥ . . 27
meaning:
अन्यधर्मो ह्यधर्मश्च देवास्त्वन्ये हि तेऽसुराः .
धर्मपक्षाः सुरा ज्ञेया असुराश्चान्यधर्मजाः . . 27
text_mt: That other dharma is indeed adharma; and the other gods are those asuras. / The gods are known to be on the side of dharma, and the asuras are born of the other dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
tayorvihīno yo dharmo devairdetyaiśca dūṣitaḥ .
vidharmaḥ sa nu vijñeyastatra lokā vyathākulāḥ . . 28
meaning:
तयोर्विहीनो यो धर्मो देवैर्देत्यैश्च दूषितः .
विधर्मः स नु विज्ञेयस्तत्र लोका व्यथाकुलाः . . 28
text_mt: The conduct devoid of both, condemned by both gods and daityas, / is known as vidharma; there the worlds are agitated by suffering:

sanskrit_iast:
tāmisramandhatāmisraṃ kumbhīpākaśca rauravam .
mahārauravamevāpi tathāmūrtirayastathā . . 29
meaning:
तामिस्रमन्धतामिस्रं कुम्भीपाकश्च रौरवम् .
महारौरवमेवापि तथामूर्तिरयस्तथा . . 29
text_mt: Tāmisra, Andhatāmisra, Kumbhīpāka, Raurava, / Mahāraurava, and likewise Amūrtirayas,

sanskrit_iast:
ikṣuyantraṃ śālmalaṃ ca hyasipatravanaṃ tathā .
jñeyamityeva racitaṃ vidhinā caikaviṃśatiḥ . . 3.4.11.30
meaning:
इक्षुयन्त्रं शाल्मलं च ह्यसिपत्रवनं तथा .
ज्ञेयमित्येव रचितं विधिना चैकविंशतिः . . 3.4.11.30
text_mt: Ikṣuyantra, Śālmala, and Asipatravana; / thus are twenty-one [hells] arranged and created by the Creator.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍo'yaṃ lokamayaḥ paraṃ tasmācca matpadam .
madbhaktā bhūtale ye vai te gacchanti paraṃ padam . . 31
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डोऽयं लोकमयः परं तस्माच्च मत्पदम् .
मद्भक्ता भूतले ये वै ते गच्छन्ति परं पदम् . . 31
text_mt: This cosmic egg consists of worlds, but higher than that is my abode. / Those who are my devotees on the surface of the earth go to that supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
devabhaktāśca ye lokāḥ sapta lokānvrajanti te .
ye tu vai tāmasā lokā daityapūjanatatparāḥ . .
te gacchanti bhahīlokānatalādimayām̐stathā . . 32
meaning:
देवभक्ताश्च ये लोकाः सप्त लोकान्व्रजन्ति ते .
ये तु वै तामसा लोका दैत्यपूजनतत्पराः . .
ते गच्छन्ति भहीलोकानतलादिमयाम्̐स्तथा . . 32
text_mt: And those people who are devotees of the gods proceed to the seven [upper] worlds. / But those people who are tāmasic, intent on worshipping the daityas, / go to the lower worlds consisting of Atala and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
pātālādyojanaṃ lakṣamadholokaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .
vidharmatatparā lokāste gacchanti hyadhogatim . .
ato vai vidhinā bhraṣṭā madbhaktāśca daridragāḥ . . 33
meaning:
पातालाद्योजनं लक्षमधोलोकः प्रकीर्तितः .
विधर्मतत्परा लोकास्ते गच्छन्ति ह्यधोगतिम् . .
अतो वै विधिना भ्रष्टा मद्भक्ताश्च दरिद्रगाः . . 33
text_mt: One hundred thousand yojanas below Pātāla is declared to be the nether world. / People devoted to vidharma go to that downward course. / Therefore, fallen from the ordainment, my devotees fall into poverty.

sanskrit_iast:
ye madbhaktāḥ surānpūrvaṃ pūjayitvā bhajanti mām .
lakṣmīvantaśca te jñeyā bhuktimuktiparāyaṇāḥ . . 34
meaning:
ये मद्भक्ताः सुरान्पूर्वं पूजयित्वा भजन्ति माम् .
लक्ष्मीवन्तश्च ते ज्ञेया भुक्तिमुक्तिपरायणाः . . 34
text_mt: Those devotees of mine who worship me after first worshipping the gods, / they are to be known as wealthy, dedicated to worldly enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
prayāge nairṛto viprastyaktvā devānmama priyān .
bhajatyananyabhāvena tasmātsa hi daridravān . . 35
meaning:
प्रयागे नैरृतो विप्रस्त्यक्त्वा देवान्मम प्रियान् .
भजत्यनन्यभावेन तस्मात्स हि दरिद्रवान् . . 35
text_mt: In Prayāga, the brāhmaṇa Nairṛta, having abandoned the gods dear to me, / worships me with single-minded devotion; therefore he is poor."

sanskrit_iast:
devairdattaṃ hi yaddravyaṃ bhoktavyaṃ sarvadā janaiḥ .
mayā dattaṃ hi yadvastu brahmāṇḍe nāsti nārada . .
ato madājñayā vipra dehi tasmai varaṃ śubham . . 36
meaning:
देवैर्दत्तं हि यद्द्रव्यं भोक्तव्यं सर्वदा जनैः .
मया दत्तं हि यद्वस्तु ब्रह्माण्डे नास्ति नारद . .
अतो मदाज्ञया विप्र देहि तस्मै वरं शुभम् . . 36
text_mt: For whatever wealth is given by the gods must always be enjoyed by men; / but whatever thing is given by me, O Nārada, does not exist in the cosmic egg. / Therefore, at my command, O Brahmin, grant him an auspicious boon.

sanskrit_iast:
ityukto nārado yogī hariṇā viśvakāriṇā .
dvijapatnī sthitā gehe tatra prāpya vaco'bravīt . . 37
meaning:
इत्युक्तो नारदो योगी हरिणा विश्वकारिणा .
द्विजपत्नी स्थिता गेहे तत्र प्राप्य वचोऽब्रवीत् . . 37
text_mt: Thus addressed by Hari, the maker of the universe, the yogin Nārada / reached the Brahmin's wife as she stayed in her house and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ varaya he sādhvi tvayā yadvāñchitaṃ hṛdi .
sāha dehi varaṃ svāminbhūparājñī bhavāmyaham . . 38
meaning:
वरं वरय हे साध्वि त्वया यद्वाञ्छितं हृदि .
साह देहि वरं स्वामिन्भूपराज्ञी भवाम्यहम् . . 38
text_mt: "Choose a boon, O virtuous woman, whatever is desired in your heart." / She said, "Grant me a boon, my lord: let me become the queen of a king!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā vacanaṃ tatra divyarūpā babhūva sā .
āgatastatra nṛpatirgṛhītvā gehamāyayau . . 39
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा वचनं तत्र दिव्यरूपा बभूव सा .
आगतस्तत्र नृपतिर्गृहीत्वा गेहमाययौ . . 39
text_mt: Having spoken those words, she then assumed a divine form. / A king arrived there, took her, and departed for his home.

sanskrit_iast:
sāyaṅkāle tu samprāpte dvijastatra samāgataḥ .
nāradastaṃ vacaḥ prāha śṛṇu vipra haripriya . . 3.4.11.40
meaning:
सायङ्काले तु सम्प्राप्ते द्विजस्तत्र समागतः .
नारदस्तं वचः प्राह शृणु विप्र हरिप्रिय . . 3.4.11.40
text_mt: When evening arrived, the Brahmin returned there. / Nārada spoke these words to him: "Listen, O Brahmin, dear to Hari!

sanskrit_iast:
varadānācca te patnī bhūparājñī hi vartate .
tvayā kiṃ vāñchitaṃ vastu mattaḥ prāpya sukhī bhava . . 41
meaning:
वरदानाच्च ते पत्नी भूपराज्ञी हि वर्तते .
त्वया किं वाञ्छितं वस्तु मत्तः प्राप्य सुखी भव . . 41
text_mt: By the granting of a boon, your wife is indeed a king's queen. / What object is desired by you? Receive it from me and be happy."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā daivavaśo vacaḥ prāha ruṣānvitaḥ .
kroṣṭrī bhavecca matpatnī dehi vipra varaṃ mama . . 42
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा दैववशो वचः प्राह रुषान्वितः .
क्रोष्ट्री भवेच्च मत्पत्नी देहि विप्र वरं मम . . 42
text_mt: Hearing this, overwhelmed by fate, he spoke words full of anger: / "Let my wife become a female jackal! O Brahmin, grant me this boon!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā vacanātkroṣṭrī sā babhūva dvijapriyā .
ekasminnantare prāstastatputro gurupūjakaḥ . . 43
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा वचनात्क्रोष्ट्री सा बभूव द्विजप्रिया .
एकस्मिन्नन्तरे प्रास्तस्तत्पुत्रो गुरुपूजकः . . 43
text_mt: As he spoke these words, that beloved [wife] of the Brahmin became a female jackal. / Meanwhile, his son arrived, a worshipper of elders.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā tatkāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ nāradaṃ sa vaco'bravīt .
mama mātā yathā svāmiṃstathā śīghraṃ varādbhavet . . 44
meaning:
श्रुत्वा तत्कारणं सर्वं नारदं स वचोऽब्रवीत् .
मम माता यथा स्वामिंस्तथा शीघ्रं वराद्भवेत् . . 44
text_mt: Having heard the whole matter, he spoke these words to Nārada: / "O lord, through your boon let my mother swiftly become just as she was!"

sanskrit_iast:
etattribhirvaraiḥ prāptaṃ daivamāyāvimohitaiḥ .
tadā tu nārado duḥkhī nairṛtaṃ prāha vai vacaḥ . . 45
meaning:
एतत्त्रिभिर्वरैः प्राप्तं दैवमायाविमोहितैः .
तदा तु नारदो दुःखी नैरृतं प्राह वै वचः . . 45
text_mt: Thus [nothing] was gained through these three boons by those deluded by the divine Māyā. / Then Nārada, grieved, spoke words indeed to Nairṛta:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍo'yaṃ devamayo bhavastasya maheśvaraḥ .
ato bhavaṃ bhajāśu tvaṃ sa te kāryaṃ kariṣyati . . 46
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डोऽयं देवमयो भवस्तस्य महेश्वरः .
अतो भवं भजाशु त्वं स ते कार्यं करिष्यति . . 46
text_mt: "This cosmic egg is pervaded by the gods; Bhava is its great lord. / Therefore worship Bhava quickly; he will accomplish your purpose."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktavacano vipro bhavaṃ taṃ pārthivārcanaiḥ .
tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā varṣamātraṃ hi nairṛtaḥ . . 47
meaning:
इत्युक्तवचनो विप्रो भवं तं पार्थिवार्चनैः .
तुष्टाव परया भक्त्या वर्षमात्रं हि नैरृतः . . 47
text_mt: Having been thus addressed, the Brahmin Nairṛta praised Bhava / with supreme devotion through earthly worship for a whole year.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prasanno bhagavānmaheśo bhaktavatsalaḥ .
kuberasadṛśaṃ divyaṃ dadau tasmai mahaddhanam . . 48
meaning:
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवान्महेशो भक्तवत्सलः .
कुबेरसदृशं दिव्यं ददौ तस्मै महद्धनम् . . 48
text_mt: Then the blessed Maheśa, who loves his devotees, being pleased, / gave him great, divine wealth equal to that of Kubera.

sanskrit_iast:
taddhanena sa vai vipro dharmakāryaṃ cakāra ha .
prasiddho'bhūnmahīpṛṣṭhe nāmnā puṇyajano dhanaiḥ . . 49
meaning:
तद्धनेन स वै विप्रो धर्मकार्यं चकार ह .
प्रसिद्धोऽभून्महीपृष्ठे नाम्ना पुण्यजनो धनैः . . 49
text_mt: With that wealth, the Brahmin performed righteous deeds. / Famous on the face of the earth, he was known as Puṇyajana for his riches.

sanskrit_iast:
śivabhaktiprabhāveṇa prāpya dravyamakaṇṭakam .
sahasrābdavapurbhūtvā tyaktvā prāṇāndivaṃ yayau . . 3.4.11.50
meaning:
शिवभक्तिप्रभावेण प्राप्य द्रव्यमकण्टकम् .
सहस्राब्दवपुर्भूत्वा त्यक्त्वा प्राणान्दिवं ययौ . . 3.4.11.50
text_mt: Having obtained undisputed wealth through the power of devotion to Śiva, / and having lived in a body for a thousand years, he gave up his vital breaths and went to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣarāśisthite sūrye rājā candrasya somavat .
nairṛto nāma vikhyāto rudraḥ sarvajanapriyaḥ . . 51
meaning:
वृषराशिस्थिते सूर्ये राजा चन्द्रस्य सोमवत् .
नैरृतो नाम विख्यातो रुद्रः सर्वजनप्रियः . . 51
text_mt: When the sun stood in the sign of Taurus, he became a king of the moon, like Soma, / renowned by the name Nairṛta, a Rudra dear to all people.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā nairṛtastu bhṛguvarya gurūditam .
svāṃśādbhūtalamāgamya girinālagirau vane . . 52
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा नैरृतस्तु भृगुवर्य गुरूदितम् .
स्वांशाद्भूतलमागम्य गिरिनालगिरौ वने . . 52
text_mt: Having heard this what was told by the guru, O best of the Bhṛgus, Nairṛta / came from a portion of himself to the earthly plane, in the forest on Mount Girināla.

sanskrit_iast:
yoginaḥ siddhasāṅkhyasya putro'bhūdvanavāsinaḥ .
vanaśarmeti vikhyāto vedaśāstraparāyaṇaḥ . . 53
meaning:
योगिनः सिद्धसाङ्ख्यस्य पुत्रोऽभूद्वनवासिनः .
वनशर्मेति विख्यातो वेदशास्त्रपरायणः . . 53
text_mt: He became the son of a forest-dwelling yogin who had perfected Sāṅkhya; / known as Vanaśarman, he was dedicated to the Vedas and Śāstras.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśābdavapurbhūtvā jitvā vidvajjanānbahūn .
kāśīmāgamya tattvārthī śaṅkarācāryamuttamam . .
praṇamya tasya śiṣyo'bhūdvanaśarmā viśāradaḥ . . 54
meaning:
द्वादशाब्दवपुर्भूत्वा जित्वा विद्वज्जनान्बहून् .
काशीमागम्य तत्त्वार्थी शङ्कराचार्यमुत्तमम् . .
प्रणम्य तस्य शिष्योऽभूद्वनशर्मा विशारदः . . 54
text_mt: Attaining a body of twelve years and conquering many learned men, / he went to Kāśī seeking the highest truth, bowed to the excellent Śaṅkarācārya, / and the wise Vanaśarman became his disciple.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca
vasuśarmā dvijaḥ kaścinmāhiṣmatyāṃ purābhavat .
śivavrataparo nityaṃ putrārthī pārthivārcaka. . . 55
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच
वसुशर्मा द्विजः कश्चिन्माहिष्मत्यां पुराभवत् .
शिवव्रतपरो नित्यं पुत्रार्थी पार्थिवार्चक. . . 55
text_mt:
Bṛhaspati said:
In ancient times there was a Brahmin named Vasuśarman in Māhiṣmatī, / constantly devoted to vows to Śiva, worshipping [him] with earthen emblems in desire of a son.

sanskrit_iast:
caturviṃśativarṣāṇi pūjatastasya dhīmata .
vyatītāni surāstatra na prasanno'bhavacchivaḥ . . 56
meaning:
चतुर्विंशतिवर्षाणि पूजतस्तस्य धीमत .
व्यतीतानि सुरास्तत्र न प्रसन्नोऽभवच्छिवः . . 56
text_mt: As the wise man worshipped, twenty-four years / passed by, O gods, but Śiva was not pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu duḥkhito vipro vahniṃ prajvālya bhairavam .
juhāva svāṅgamāṃsāni mukhataścaraṇāntakam . . 57
meaning:
तदा तु दुःखितो विप्रो वह्निं प्रज्वाल्य भैरवम् .
जुहाव स्वाङ्गमांसानि मुखतश्चरणान्तकम् . . 57
text_mt: Then, distressed, the Brahmin kindled a terrible fire / and offered the flesh of his own limbs, from his face down to his feet.

sanskrit_iast:
na prasannobhavadrudrastadā vipraḥ śucānvitaḥ .
gṛhītvā cottamaṃ meṣaṃ saṃskāraṃ kṛtavāñchuciḥ . .
tena meṣeṇa sahito jvaladagnau samāyayau . . 58
meaning:
न प्रसन्नोभवद्रुद्रस्तदा विप्रः शुचान्वितः .
गृहीत्वा चोत्तमं मेषं संस्कारं कृतवाञ्छुचिः . .
तेन मेषेण सहितो ज्वलदग्नौ समाययौ . . 58
text_mt: When Rudra was still not pleased, the Brahmin, overwhelmed with sorrow, / took an excellent ram, purified it through ritual consecration, / and, pure himself, entered the blazing fire along with that ram.

sanskrit_iast:
prasanno bhagavānrudrastatrāgatya gaṇairyutaḥ .
svarūpaṃ darśayāmāsa śuddhasphaṭikasundaram . .
varaṃ brūhi vacaḥ prāha vasuśarmāṇamuttamam . . 59
meaning:
प्रसन्नो भगवान्रुद्रस्तत्रागत्य गणैर्युतः .
स्वरूपं दर्शयामास शुद्धस्फटिकसुन्दरम् . .
वरं ब्रूहि वचः प्राह वसुशर्माणमुत्तमम् . . 59
text_mt: Then the blessed Rudra, being pleased, came there accompanied by his gaṇas / and revealed his own form, beautiful like pure crystal. / He spoke words to the excellent Vasuśarman: "State a boon!"

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā sa prasannātmā natvā pārvativallabham .
praśrayāvanato bhūtvā vacanaṃ prāha śaṅkaram . . 3.4.11.60
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा स प्रसन्नात्मा नत्वा पार्वतिवल्लभम् .
प्रश्रयावनतो भूत्वा वचनं प्राह शङ्करम् . . 3.4.11.60
text_mt: Hearing that, his soul delighted, he bowed to the beloved of Pārvatī, / and bowing low in humility, spoke these words to Śaṅkara:

sanskrit_iast:
dehi me tanayaṃ svāmiñcharaṇāgatavatsala .
ityuktaśśaṅkarastena vihasyovāca taṃ dvijam . . 61
meaning:
देहि मे तनयं स्वामिञ्छरणागतवत्सल .
इत्युक्तश्शङ्करस्तेन विहस्योवाच तं द्विजम् . . 61
text_mt: "Grant me a son, O lord who are affectionate to those who take refuge in you!" / Thus addressed by him, Śaṅkara laughed and said to the Brahmin:

sanskrit_iast:
putradātā svayaṃ brahmā bhāgyakarttā parātparaḥ .
tubhyaṃ ca śatajanmāntaṃ tena putro na nirmitaḥ . .
tasmādahaṃ sutaṃ svāṃśāttava vipra dadāmi bhoḥ . . 62
meaning:
पुत्रदाता स्वयं ब्रह्मा भाग्यकर्त्ता परात्परः .
तुभ्यं च शतजन्मान्तं तेन पुत्रो न निर्मितः . .
तस्मादहं सुतं स्वांशात्तव विप्र ददामि भोः . . 62
text_mt: "Brahmā himself is the giver of sons, the highest maker of destiny; / and by him no son has been fashioned for you for a hundred births to come. / Therefore, O Brahmin, I grant you a son from a portion of myself."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā svamukhāttejo nirākṛtya maheśvaraḥ .
tatpatnyāṃ janayāmāsa sakāśādvasuvarmaṇaḥ . . 63
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा स्वमुखात्तेजो निराकृत्य महेश्वरः .
तत्पत्न्यां जनयामास सकाशाद्वसुवर्मणः . . 63
text_mt: Having said this, Maheśvara brought forth splendor from his own mouth / and engendered it in the wife of that Vasuvarman from his presence.

sanskrit_iast:
daśamāsāntare jātaḥ suputro madhurānanaḥ .
ajasyeva padaścaiko dvitīyo naravattataḥ . .
ajaikapāda iti sa prasiddho'bhūnmahītale . . 64
meaning:
दशमासान्तरे जातः सुपुत्रो मधुराननः .
अजस्येव पदश्चैको द्वितीयो नरवत्ततः . .
अजैकपाद इति स प्रसिद्धोऽभून्महीतले . . 64
text_mt: After ten months, a fine son with a sweet face was born; / one foot of his was like that of a goat, and the other was like a man's; / hence he became famous on the surface of the earth as Ajaikapād.

sanskrit_iast:
catuśśatābdavapuṣi prāpte tasminsute priye .
samprāpto bhagavānmṛtyustadā rogagaṇairyutaḥ . . 65
meaning:
चतुश्शताब्दवपुषि प्राप्ते तस्मिन्सुते प्रिये .
सम्प्राप्तो भगवान्मृत्युस्तदा रोगगणैर्युतः . . 65
text_mt: When that beloved son had reached four hundred years of age, / the blessed Lord Death then arrived, accompanied by hosts of diseases.

sanskrit_iast: tasya tairabhavadyuddhamajaikacaraṇasya vai . . 66
meaning: तस्य तैरभवद्युद्धमजैकचरणस्य वै . . 66
text_mt: A battle indeed took place between them and that one-footed Ajaikapād.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣamātreṇa tānsarvāñjitvā mallaraṇotkaṭaḥ .
mṛtyuñjayaḥ sa vai nāmnā prasiddho'bhūnmahītale . . 67
meaning:
वर्षमात्रेण तान्सर्वाञ्जित्वा मल्लरणोत्कटः .
मृत्युञ्जयः स वै नाम्ना प्रसिद्धोऽभून्महीतले . . 67
text_mt: Having conquered them all in just a year, mighty in wrestling combat, / he became famous indeed on the surface of the earth by the name Mṛtyuñjaya.

sanskrit_iast:
duḥkhito bhagavānmṛtyustena vipreṇa nirjitaḥ .
parameṣṭhinamāgamya kathayāmāsa kāraṇam . . 68
meaning:
दुःखितो भगवान्मृत्युस्तेन विप्रेण निर्जितः .
परमेष्ठिनमागम्य कथयामास कारणम् . . 68
text_mt: The blessed Lord Death, distressed at being defeated by that Brahmin, / went to the Supreme Lord [Brahmā] and related the matter.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu bhagavānbrahmā sarvadevagaṇairyutaḥ .
kumbhage dyumaṇau deve candramaṇḍalagaṃ nṛpam . .
taṃ dvijaṃ ca cakārāśu rudrarūpaṃ bhayāpaham . . 69
meaning:
तदा तु भगवान्ब्रह्मा सर्वदेवगणैर्युतः .
कुम्भगे द्युमणौ देवे चन्द्रमण्डलगं नृपम् . .
तं द्विजं च चकाराशु रुद्ररूपं भयापहम् . . 69
text_mt: Then the blessed Brahmā, accompanied by all the hosts of gods, / while the sun-jewel was in Aquarius, quickly made that Brahmin, / who was in the lunar orb, into a king, a form of Rudra that dispels fear.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
iti śrutvā mahādevaḥ sa vipraśca tadājapād .
purīṃ māhiṣmatīṃ prāptaḥ kaliśuddhikaraḥ prabhuḥ . .
purīśarmeti vikhyāto yatidattasya vai sutaḥ . . 3.4.11.70
ṣoḍaśābdavapurbhūtvā jitvā veda parāyaṇān .
śaṅkarācāryamāgamya tasya śiṣyo babhūva ha . .
iti te kathitaṃ vipra yathā mṛtyuñjayobhavat . . 7
.. sūta uvāca ..
punaḥ śṛṇu kathāṃ ramyāṃ prayāge jīvabhāṣitām..
meaning:
सूत उवाच
इति श्रुत्वा महादेवः स विप्रश्च तदाजपाद् .
पुरीं माहिष्मतीं प्राप्तः कलिशुद्धिकरः प्रभुः . .
पुरीशर्मेति विख्यातो यतिदत्तस्य वै सुतः . . 3.4.11.70
षोडशाब्दवपुर्भूत्वा जित्वा वेद परायणान् .
शङ्कराचार्यमागम्य तस्य शिष्यो बभूव ह . .
इति ते कथितं विप्र यथा मृत्युञ्जयोभवत् . . 7
.. सूत उवाच ..
पुनः शृणु कथां रम्यां प्रयागे जीवभाषिताम्..
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Having heard this, that lord, Mahādeva, and the Brahmin born from Ajaikapād / who purifies the Kali age, came to the city of Māhiṣmatī / as the son of Yatidatta, renowned as Purīśarman.
Attaining a body of sixteen years and conquering those dedicated to the Vedas, / he approached Śaṅkarācārya and became his disciple. / Thus has it been related to you, O Brahmin, how he became Mṛtyuñjaya.
Sūta said:
Listen again to a delightful story told by Bṛhaspati at Prayāga.

sanskrit_iast:
hirburnāma purā cāsīddānavo lokakaṃṭakaḥ..1..
nikuṃbhānvayasaṃbhūtaḥ śakratulyaparākramaḥ ..
meaning:
हिर्बुर्नाम पुरा चासीद्दानवो लोककंटकः..1..
निकुंभान्वयसंभूतः शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः ..
text_mt:
Formerly there was a Dānava named Hirbu, a thorn to the worlds,
born in the lineage of Nikuṃbha, equal in valor to Śakra.
title: Varṇanaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrābdaṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā tāpayāmāsa vai surān .. 2 ..
tadā lokapatirbrahmā lokarakṣārthamudyataḥ ..
meaning:
सहस्राब्दं तपः कृत्वा तापयामास वै सुरान् .. 2 ..
तदा लोकपतिर्ब्रह्मा लोकरक्षार्थमुद्यतः ..
text_mt:
Having performed austerities for a thousand years, he tormented the gods.
Then Brahmā, the lord of the worlds, set out to protect the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ brūhīti vacanamuvāca danujeśvaram .. 3 ..
namaskṛtya vidhātāraṃ vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ ..
meaning:
वरं ब्रूहीति वचनमुवाच दनुजेश्वरम् .. 3 ..
नमस्कृत्य विधातारं वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः ..
text_mt:
He spoke these words to the lord of the Danus: "Choose a boon!"
Having bowed to the Creator, his mind humbled, he spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
yadi deyo varaḥ svāmiṃstvayā viśvakṛtā vibho ..4..
maraṇaṃ na ca mebhūyāttvatkṛtaiśca carācaraiḥ ..
meaning:
यदि देयो वरः स्वामिंस्त्वया विश्वकृता विभो ..4..
मरणं न च मेभूयात्त्वत्कृतैश्च चराचरैः ..
text_mt:
"If a boon is to be granted by you, O lord, creator of the universe, O pervasive one,
may my death not come from moving and unmoving beings made by you."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktassa tathetyuktvā brahma lokamupāyayau .. 5 ..
dānavassa
tu raudrātmā jitvā svarganivāsinaḥ ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तस्स तथेत्युक्त्वा ब्रह्म लोकमुपाययौ .. 5 ..
दानवस्स
तु रौद्रात्मा जित्वा स्वर्गनिवासिनः ..
text_mt:
Having been spoken to thus, he said, "So be it," and went to the world of Brahmā.
Then that dānava of terrible nature, having conquered the dwellers of heaven,

sanskrit_iast:
āhūya dānavāndaityānvivarebhyaḥ prasannadhīḥ .. 6 ..
svarge nivāsayāmāsa te devā bhūtalīkṛtāḥ ..
meaning:
आहूय दानवान्दैत्यान्विवरेभ्यः प्रसन्नधीः .. 6 ..
स्वर्गे निवासयामास ते देवा भूतलीकृताः ..
text_mt:
called the dānavas and daityas from their subterranean cavities, pleased in mind,
and settled them in heaven; those gods were brought down to the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣābdaṃ ca surāssarve bubhujuḥ paramāpadaḥ .. 7 ..
ekadā nārado dhīmāndṛṣṭvā devāṃstathāgatān ..
meaning:
लक्षाब्दं च सुरास्सर्वे बुभुजुः परमापदः .. 7 ..
एकदा नारदो धीमान्दृष्ट्वा देवांस्तथागतान् ..
text_mt:
And for a hundred thousand years all the gods suffered extreme calamities.
Once, wise Nārada, having seen the gods reduced to that state,

sanskrit_iast:
vacanaṃ prāha yogātmā bhajadhvaṃ lokaśaṃkaram .. 8 ..
sa devaśca mahādevo brahmāṇḍeśo vipattihā ..
meaning:
वचनं प्राह योगात्मा भजध्वं लोकशंकरम् .. 8 ..
स देवश्च महादेवो ब्रह्माण्डेशो विपत्तिहा ..
text_mt:
that yogic-souled one spoke words [to them]: "Worship the benefactor of the world!
He is the god, Mahādeva, lord of the universe, destroyer of calamity."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ te devā vismayānvitāḥ .. 9 ..
pārthivaiḥ pūjayā māsurdevadevamumāpatim ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं ते देवा विस्मयान्विताः .. 9 ..
पार्थिवैः पूजया मासुर्देवदेवमुमापतिम् ..
text_mt:
Hearing this speech, those gods were filled with wonder;
they worshipped the god of gods, the husband of Umā, with earthen [liṅgas].

sanskrit_iast:
gataikādaśavarṣāśca teṣāṃ pūjanakāriṇām .. 10 ..
tadā prasanno bhagavānmaheśo lokaśaṃkaraḥ ..
meaning:
गतैकादशवर्षाश्च तेषां पूजनकारिणाम् .. 10 ..
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवान्महेशो लोकशंकरः ..
text_mt:
Eleven years passed for them as they performed worship.
Then the blessed Maheśa, benefactor of the world, became pleased;

sanskrit_iast:
jyotirliṃgamayo bhūtvā lokām̐strīnsamadāhayat .. 11 ..
ye tu vai devabhaktāśca śeṣāścāsanmahābhaye ..
meaning:
ज्योतिर्लिंगमयो भूत्वा लोकाम्̐स्त्रीन्समदाहयत् .. 11 ..
ये तु वै देवभक्ताश्च शेषाश्चासन्महाभये ..
text_mt:
having assumed the form of a liṅga of light, he burned the three worlds.
Those who were devotees of the gods remained in that great peril,

sanskrit_iast:
anye tu dānavaissārddhaṃ bhasmībhūtā babhūvire .. 12 ..
etasminnantare brahmā viṣṇunā saha harṣitaḥ ..
meaning:
अन्ये तु दानवैस्सार्द्धं भस्मीभूता बभूविरे .. 12 ..
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे ब्रह्मा विष्णुना सह हर्षितः ..
text_mt:
while others were turned to ashes along with the dānavas.
In the meantime, Brahmā, delighted along with Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭāva sa mahārudraṃ stotraissāmasamudbhavaiḥ .. 13 ..
mithunasthe divānāthe śaśimaṇḍalabhūpatim ..
meaning:
तुष्टाव स महारुद्रं स्तोत्रैस्सामसमुद्भवैः .. 13 ..
मिथुनस्थे दिवानाथे शशिमण्डलभूपतिम् ..
text_mt:
praised that Mahārudra with hymns born of the Sāmaveda.
When the sun was in Gemini, for the sake of the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
hirbughnaṃ ca mahārudraṃ cakāra surahetave .. 14 ..
iti śrutvā sa hirbughno devakāryārthamudyataḥ ..
meaning:
हिर्बुघ्नं च महारुद्रं चकार सुरहेतवे .. 14 ..
इति श्रुत्वा स हिर्बुघ्नो देवकार्यार्थमुद्यतः ..
text_mt:
he made Mahārudra, king of the moon's orb, as Ahirbudhnya.
Having heard this, that Ahirbudhnya was ready for the mission of the gods;

sanskrit_iast:
himālaye girau ramye putro'bhūtsādyakarmaṇaḥ ..35 ..
patirūpaḥ kalābhijño bhāratīśa iti śrutaḥ ..
sa jitvā viduṣāṃ vṛṃdānkāśīnagaramāgataḥ ..
meaning:
हिमालये गिरौ रम्ये पुत्रोऽभूत्साद्यकर्मणः ..35 ..
पतिरूपः कलाभिज्ञो भारतीश इति श्रुतः ..
स जित्वा विदुषां वृंदान्काशीनगरमागतः ..

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkarācāryamāgamya śiṣyo'bhūttena nirjitaḥ .. 16 ..
.. bṛhaspati ruvāca .. ..
meaning:
शंकराचार्यमागम्य शिष्योऽभूत्तेन निर्जितः .. 16 ..
.. बृहस्पति रुवाच .. ..
text_mt:
having approached Śaṅkarācārya, he was defeated by him and became his pupil.
Bṛhaspati said:

sanskrit_iast:
mayaputraḥ smṛto māyī tapo ghoraṃ cakāra ha .. 17 ..
padaikena sthitaḥ sūrye sahasrābdaṃ prayatnataḥ ..
meaning:
मयपुत्रः स्मृतो मायी तपो घोरं चकार ह .. 17 ..
पदैकेन स्थितः सूर्ये सहस्राब्दं प्रयत्नतः ..
text_mt:
The sorcerer known as the son of Maya performed severe asceticism.
Standing on one foot, facing the sun, he [remained] zealously for a thousand years;

sanskrit_iast:
sa lokām̐stāpayāmāsa tapasā lokavāsinaḥ .. 18 ..
tadā prasanno bhagavānparameṣṭhī pitāmahaḥ ..
meaning:
स लोकाम्̐स्तापयामास तपसा लोकवासिनः .. 18 ..
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवान्परमेष्ठी पितामहः ..
text_mt:
he tormented the worlds and the inhabitants of the worlds by his asceticism.
Then the blessed grandfather Parameṣṭhin was pleased;

sanskrit_iast:
trayo grāmāstatpriyārthe kramādvai tena nirmitāḥ .. 19 ..
sauvarṇaṃ svargasadṛśaṃ puraṃ ṣoḍaśayojanam ..
meaning:
त्रयो ग्रामास्तत्प्रियार्थे क्रमाद्वै तेन निर्मिताः .. 19 ..
सौवर्णं स्वर्गसदृशं पुरं षोडशयोजनम् ..
text_mt:
for his gratification three settlements were built by him in succession:
a golden city, resembling heaven, measuring sixteen yojanas;

sanskrit_iast:
tadadho yojanānte ca rājataṃ ca bhuvarmayam..20..
tadadho yojanānte ca bhūrlokamiva cāyasam ..
meaning:
तदधो योजनान्ते च राजतं च भुवर्मयम्..20..
तदधो योजनान्ते च भूर्लोकमिव चायसम् ..
text_mt:
beneath that, at the distance of a yojana, a silver one consisting of Bhuvarloka;
and beneath that, at the distance of a yojana, one of iron, like the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ puranivāsinyo daityānāṃ yoṣito mudā .. 21 ..
śatakoṭimitā daityā dharmātmāno nivāsinaḥ ..
meaning:
एवं पुरनिवासिन्यो दैत्यानां योषितो मुदा .. 21 ..
शतकोटिमिता दैत्या धर्मात्मानो निवासिनः ..
text_mt:
Thus the women of the daityas dwelt with joy in the cities.
The daityas who dwelt there, numbering one billion, were righteous in nature;

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā yajñabhāgaṃ ca devatulyā babhūvire .. 22 ..
tadā nirbalino devāḥ kṣudhayā pīḍitāḥ prabhum ..
meaning:
गृहीत्वा यज्ञभागं च देवतुल्या बभूविरे .. 22 ..
तदा निर्बलिनो देवाः क्षुधया पीडिताः प्रभुम् ..
text_mt:
receiving their share of the sacrifice, they became equal to the gods.
Then the gods, rendered powerless and afflicted with hunger,

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavantaṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ parayā girā .. 23 ..
caturyugasamūhānāṃ varṣāṇāṃ bhagavanprabho ..
meaning:
भगवन्तं महाविष्णुं तुष्टुवुः परया गिरा .. 23 ..
चतुर्युगसमूहानां वर्षाणां भगवन्प्रभो ..
text_mt:
praised the master, the blessed Mahāviṣṇu, with supreme speech:
"O blessed master, for [many] years comprising collections of four yugas,

sanskrit_iast:
adhikāravihīnāśca vartaṃte svargamaṇḍale .. 24 ..
tāmasāṃtaramevāpi ṣoḍaśaiva caturyugam ..
meaning:
अधिकारविहीनाश्च वर्तंते स्वर्गमण्डले .. 24 ..
तामसांतरमेवापि षोडशैव चतुर्युगम् ..
text_mt:
[we] remain in the heavenly realm stripped of authority.
Indeed, in the Tāmasa Manu's era, sixteen cycles of four yugas

sanskrit_iast:
vyatītāni mahāviṣṇo māyināṃ duḥkhaṃ bhuṃjatām .. 25 ..
iti śrutvā vacasteṣāṃ bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ ..
meaning:
व्यतीतानि महाविष्णो मायिनां दुःखं भुंजताम् .. 25 ..
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तेषां भगवान्मधुसूदनः ..
text_mt:
have passed, O Mahāviṣṇu, while the sorcerers enjoy our distress!"
Having heard their words, the blessed Madhusūdana,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā saṃskṛtavārtāyāṃ daityāndharmaparāyaṇān ..26..
vauddharūpastvayaṃ jātaḥ kalau prāpte bhayānake ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा संस्कृतवार्तायां दैत्यान्धर्मपरायणान् ..26..
वौद्धरूपस्त्वयं जातः कलौ प्राप्ते भयानके ..
text_mt:
seeing the daityas devoted to dharma according to traditional report,
this [Janārdana] was born in the form of the Buddha when the terrible Kali [age] arrived;

sanskrit_iast:
ajinasya dvijasyaiva suto bhūtvā janārdanaḥ .. 27 ..
vedadharmaparānviprānmohayāmāsa vīryavān ..
meaning:
अजिनस्य द्विजस्यैव सुतो भूत्वा जनार्दनः .. 27 ..
वेदधर्मपरान्विप्रान्मोहयामास वीर्यवान् ..
text_mt:
having become the son of the twice-born Ajina, Janārdana,
the mighty one, deluded the brahmins devoted to Vedic dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
nirvedāḥ karmarahitāstrivarṇāstāmasāntare .. 28 ..
ṣoḍaśe ca kalau prāpte babhūburyajñavarjitāḥ ..
meaning:
निर्वेदाः कर्मरहितास्त्रिवर्णास्तामसान्तरे .. 28 ..
षोडशे च कलौ प्राप्ते बभूबुर्यज्ञवर्जिताः ..
text_mt:
Without the Vedas and devoid of ritual acts, the three twice-born classes in the Tāmasa era,
when the sixteenth Kali [age] arrived, became devoid of sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā daityā ruṣāviṣṭāssarve tripuravāsinaḥ .. 29 ..
manujānpīḍayāmāsurniryajñānvedavarjitān ..
meaning:
तदा दैत्या रुषाविष्टास्सर्वे त्रिपुरवासिनः .. 29 ..
मनुजान्पीडयामासुर्निर्यज्ञान्वेदवर्जितान् ..
text_mt:
Then the daityas, all the dwellers of Tripura, filled with wrath,
tormented the men who were devoid of sacrifice and without the Vedas;

sanskrit_iast:
kṣayaṃ jagmurnarāssarve kalpāṃte daityabhakṣitāḥ .. 30 ..
punassatyayuge prāpte kailāse guhyakālaye ..
meaning:
क्षयं जग्मुर्नरास्सर्वे कल्पांते दैत्यभक्षिताः .. 30 ..
पुनस्सत्ययुगे प्राप्ते कैलासे गुह्यकालये ..
text_mt:
all men went to destruction at the end of the kalpa, devoured by the daityas.
When the Satya Yuga arrived again, on Kailāsa, the abode of the guhyakas,

sanskrit_iast:
devaiścārādhitaḥ śaṃbhussarvalokaśivaṃkaraḥ .. 31 ..
jyotirligaṃ vapuḥ kṛtvā tatra tasthau bhayaṃkaraḥ ..
meaning:
देवैश्चाराधितः शंभुस्सर्वलोकशिवंकरः .. 31 ..
ज्योतिर्लिगं वपुः कृत्वा तत्र तस्थौ भयंकरः ..
text_mt:
Śambhu, who brings auspiciousness to all the world, was worshipped by the gods.
Having made his body a liṅga of light, the terrible one stood there.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare devāḥ prasannāstāmasāntare .. 32 ..
bhūmessāraṃ gṛhītvā te rathaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवाः प्रसन्नास्तामसान्तरे .. 32 ..
भूमेस्सारं गृहीत्वा ते रथं कृत्वा विधानतः ..
text_mt:
In the meantime, the gods, delighted in that Tāmasa era,
took the essence of the earth and constructed a chariot according to rule;

sanskrit_iast:
caṃdrabhāskarayossārāccakre kṛtvā tathaiva ca ..33..
sumerośca tathā sārātketuṃ kṛtvā rathasya vai ..
meaning:
चंद्रभास्करयोस्साराच्चक्रे कृत्वा तथैव च ..33..
सुमेरोश्च तथा सारात्केतुं कृत्वा रथस्य वै ..
text_mt:
and likewise made the two wheels from the essence of the moon and the sun.
And making the banner of the chariot from the essence of Mount Sumeru,

sanskrit_iast:
dadau śivāya mahate yānaṃ syandanarūpi tat .. 34 ..
tadā brahmā svayaṃ prāpya babhūva rathasārathiḥ ..
meaning:
ददौ शिवाय महते यानं स्यन्दनरूपि तत् .. 34 ..
तदा ब्रह्मा स्वयं प्राप्य बभूव रथसारथिः ..
text_mt:
they gave that vehicle in the form of a chariot to great Śiva.
Then Brahmā himself, arriving there, became the charioteer.

sanskrit_iast:
vedāśca vājinaścāsandevadevasya vai rathe .. 35 ..
lokālokagireḥ sāro dhanuścāsīnmahātmanaḥ ..
meaning:
वेदाश्च वाजिनश्चासन्देवदेवस्य वै रथे .. 35 ..
लोकालोकगिरेः सारो धनुश्चासीन्महात्मनः ..
text_mt:
And the Vedas became the horses on the chariot of the God of gods.
The essence of Mount Lokāloka became the bow of the great-souled one,

sanskrit_iast:
ghoraṃ cājagavaṃ nāma prasiddha mabhavaddhanuḥ .. 36 ..
sajyaṃ cakāra bhagavāṃstaddhanuḥ kaṭhinaṃ mahat ..
meaning:
घोरं चाजगवं नाम प्रसिद्ध मभवद्धनुः .. 36 ..
सज्यं चकार भगवांस्तद्धनुः कठिनं महत् ..
text_mt:
and that fierce bow became famous by the name Ajagava.
The Lord strung that huge, stiff bow;

sanskrit_iast:
bhagnībhūtamabhūccāpaṃ devadevasya vai ruṣā .. 37 ..
vismito bhagavānviṣṇussāraṃ svargasya vai tadā ..
meaning:
भग्नीभूतमभूच्चापं देवदेवस्य वै रुषा .. 37 ..
विस्मितो भगवान्विष्णुस्सारं स्वर्गस्य वै तदा ..
text_mt:
and the bow of the God of gods shattered through his wrath.
Astonished, the blessed Lord Viṣṇu then, taking the essence of heaven,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvāśu dhanurdivyaṃ pinākaṃ sa cakāra ha .. 38 ..
sajyaṃ jātaṃ ca rudreṇa puṣṭibhūtaṃ mahaddhanuḥ ..
meaning:
गृहीत्वाशु धनुर्दिव्यं पिनाकं स चकार ह .. 38 ..
सज्यं जातं च रुद्रेण पुष्टिभूतं महद्धनुः ..
text_mt:
swiftly fashioned the divine bow Pināka.
The great bow was strung and strengthened by Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā brahmarṣayastuṣṭāstuṣṭuvu rmanasā haram .. 39 ..
pinākīti ca tannāmā prasiddhobhūnmaheśvaraḥ ..
meaning:
तदा ब्रह्मर्षयस्तुष्टास्तुष्टुवु र्मनसा हरम् .. 39 ..
पिनाकीति च तन्नामा प्रसिद्धोभून्महेश्वरः ..
text_mt:
Then the brahmin seers, pleased, praised Hara in their minds.
And Maheśvara became renowned by the name Pinākin.

sanskrit_iast:
guṇaścāpasya vai śeṣaḥ śakro vāṇastadābhavat .. 40 ..
śarapakṣau vahnivāyū śalyaṃ viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ ..
meaning:
गुणश्चापस्य वै शेषः शक्रो वाणस्तदाभवत् .. 40 ..
शरपक्षौ वह्निवायू शल्यं विष्णुः सनातनः ..
text_mt:
Śeṣa became the bowstring, and Śakra was the arrow then.
Fire and Wind were the two feathers of the arrow, and eternal Viṣṇu was the shaft.

sanskrit_iast:
tena bāṇena daityānāṃ koṭisaṃkhyā mṛtā ca khe .. 41 ..
tripuraṃ dāhayāmāsa māyinā pālitaṃ śivaḥ ..
meaning:
तेन बाणेन दैत्यानां कोटिसंख्या मृता च खे .. 41 ..
त्रिपुरं दाहयामास मायिना पालितं शिवः ..
text_mt:
By that arrow, a crore of Daityas were slain in the sky.
Śiva burned Tripura, which had been protected by the illusionist [demon].

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmībhūte pure ghore tadā lokapatirvidhiḥ .. 42 ..
pinākinaṃ mahārudraṃ mīnarāśisthite ravau ..
śaśino maṇḍalasyaiva rājānaṃ sa cakāra tam ..
meaning:
भस्मीभूते पुरे घोरे तदा लोकपतिर्विधिः .. 42 ..
पिनाकिनं महारुद्रं मीनराशिस्थिते रवौ ..
शशिनो मण्डलस्यैव राजानं स चकार तम् ..
text_mt:
When that terrible city had turned to ashes, then the creator Brahmā, the lord of the worlds,
when the sun was in the sign of Pisces, to Pinākin, Great Rudra,
made him the king of the disc of the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
svādhikārām̐stadā devā avāpustāmasāntare .. 43 ..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
meaning:
स्वाधिकाराम्̐स्तदा देवा अवापुस्तामसान्तरे .. 43 ..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
text_mt:
Then the gods obtained their own offices during the interval of Tāmasa.
Sūta said:

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā pinākī ca svamukhātsvāṃśamuttamam .. 44 ..
samutpādya haradvāre hima sānau cakāra ha ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा पिनाकी च स्वमुखात्स्वांशमुत्तमम् .. 44 ..
समुत्पाद्य हरद्वारे हिम सानौ चकार ह ..
text_mt:
Having heard this, Pinākin, producing an excellent portion of himself from his mouth,
placed it at Haridvāra on the snow-peak.

sanskrit_iast:
macchando nāma tatraiva yogī śaṃbhuparāyaṇaḥ .. 45 ..
gorakhasya gururyo vai tanmukhe teja āviśat ..
meaning:
मच्छन्दो नाम तत्रैव योगी शंभुपरायणः .. 45 ..
गोरखस्य गुरुर्यो वै तन्मुखे तेज आविशत् ..
text_mt:
Right there was a yogin devoted to Śaṃbhu named Macchanda.
The splendour entered the mouth of him who was the guru of Gorakha.

sanskrit_iast:
raṃbhā nāmnaiva tatraiva svarveśyā kāmarūpiṇī .. 46 ..
macchandaṃ ca vaśīkṛtya bubhuje smaravihvalā ..
meaning:
रंभा नाम्नैव तत्रैव स्वर्वेश्या कामरूपिणी .. 46 ..
मच्छन्दं च वशीकृत्य बुभुजे स्मरविह्वला ..
text_mt:
Right there, a celestial courtezan named Rambhā, capable of changing her form at will,
enchanted Macchanda and, agitated by love, enjoyed union with him.

sanskrit_iast:
tayossakāśādvai jātassa putro rucirānanaḥ .. 47 ..
nāthaśarmeti vikhyāto vidvāñcchreṣṭhataro'bhavat ..
sa jitvā paṃḍitānbhūmau purīṃ kāśīṃ samāgataḥ ..
meaning:
तयोस्सकाशाद्वै जातस्स पुत्रो रुचिराननः .. 47 ..
नाथशर्मेति विख्यातो विद्वाञ्च्छ्रेष्ठतरोऽभवत् ..
स जित्वा पंडितान्भूमौ पुरीं काशीं समागतः ..
text_mt:
From the two of them was born a charming-faced son.
Renowned as Nāthaśarman, he became a foremost scholar.
Having conquered the pandits on earth, he arrived at the city of Kāśī.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkarācāryavijitastasya śiṣyo babhūva ha .. 48 ..
.. bṛhaspatiruvāca .. ..
meaning:
शंकराचार्यविजितस्तस्य शिष्यो बभूव ह .. 48 ..
.. बृहस्पतिरुवाच .. ..
text_mt:
Defeated by Śaṅkarācārya, he became his disciple.
Bṛhaspati said:

sanskrit_iast:
cākṣuṣāṃtarasaṃprāpte dvādaśe dvāpare yuge .. 49 ..
kṣatriyaistālajaṃghīyairbrāhmaṇā bhṛguvaṃśajāḥ ..
meaning:
चाक्षुषांतरसंप्राप्ते द्वादशे द्वापरे युगे .. 49 ..
क्षत्रियैस्तालजंघीयैर्ब्राह्मणा भृगुवंशजाः ..
text_mt:
When the twelfth Dvāpara age arrived in the Cākṣuṣa Manvantara,
the brāhmaṇas born of the lineage of Bhṛgu were destroyed in Kurukṣetra

sanskrit_iast:
vināśitāḥ kurukṣetre gṛhītvā taddhanaṃ bahu .. 50 ..
babhujurbalavaṃtaste daityapakṣā mahādhamāḥ ..
meaning:
विनाशिताः कुरुक्षेत्रे गृहीत्वा तद्धनं बहु .. 50 ..
बभुजुर्बलवंतस्ते दैत्यपक्षा महाधमाः ..
text_mt:
by the kṣatriyas descended from Tālajaṅgha, who seized their abundant wealth.
Those mighty ones, sided with the Daityas, most vile, enjoyed [that wealth].

sanskrit_iast:
kasyacittu muneḥ patnī gurviṇī ca bhayānvitā .. 51 ..
himatuṃge samāgamya tadgarbhaṃ munisaṃbhavam ..
meaning:
कस्यचित्तु मुनेः पत्नी गुर्विणी च भयान्विता .. 51 ..
हिमतुंगे समागम्य तद्गर्भं मुनिसंभवम् ..
text_mt:
The pregnant and terrified wife of a certain sage,
reaching the snow-capped peak, that womb born of a sage

sanskrit_iast:
śatavarṣaṃ dadau devī tapasā jñānarūpiṇī .. 52 ..
māturūrū suto bhittvā tato jāto mahītale ..
meaning:
शतवर्षं ददौ देवी तपसा ज्ञानरूपिणी .. 52 ..
मातुरूरू सुतो भित्त्वा ततो जातो महीतले ..
text_mt:
the lady, the embodiment of wisdom, carried for a hundred years by her ascetic power.
The son, bursting forth from his mother's thigh, was then born on the surface of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tejasā tasya putrasya bhasmībhūtamabhūjjagat .. 53 ..
tadā tu sakalā devāḥ puraskṛtya prajāpatim ..
meaning:
तेजसा तस्य पुत्रस्य भस्मीभूतमभूज्जगत् .. 53 ..
तदा तु सकला देवाः पुरस्कृत्य प्रजापतिम् ..
text_mt:
By the splendour of that son, the world turned to ashes.
Then all the gods, placing Prajāpati at their head,

sanskrit_iast:
vajrasthitaśca vai tālāssamājagmu rbhayāturāḥ .. 54 ..
pitṛbhidaivatairbālassamājñāto himācale ..
meaning:
वज्रस्थितश्च वै तालास्समाजग्मु र्भयातुराः .. 54 ..
पितृभिदैवतैर्बालस्समाज्ञातो हिमाचले ..
text_mt:
and the Tālas situated in the thunderbolt, gathered together, afflicted with fear.
Instructed on the Himālaya by his ancestors and the deities, the boy

sanskrit_iast:
lokanāśakaraṃ tejo jalamadhye sa cākṣipat .. 55 ..
jaladevī ca vaḍavā bhūtvā tatteja uttamam ..
meaning:
लोकनाशकरं तेजो जलमध्ये स चाक्षिपत् .. 55 ..
जलदेवी च वडवा भूत्वा तत्तेज उत्तमम् ..
text_mt:
cast into the water that splendour which caused the destruction of the world.
And the goddess of waters, becoming a mare, drank that supreme splendour,

sanskrit_iast:
pītvā vavāma tatraiva pīḍitā raudratejasā .. 56 ..
tadāgatya svayaṃ brahmā trikuṭo yatra vai giriḥ ..
meaning:
पीत्वा ववाम तत्रैव पीडिता रौद्रतेजसा .. 56 ..
तदागत्य स्वयं ब्रह्मा त्रिकुटो यत्र वै गिरिः ..
text_mt:
and vomited it right there, tormented by the fierce fire.
Then, having arrived in person where Mount Trikuṭa stands,

sanskrit_iast:
tadadhaḥ sāgare ghore sthāpayāmāsa lokapaḥ .. 57 ..
meṣage dyumaṇau prāpte śaśimaṇḍalagaṃ prabhum ..
meaning:
तदधः सागरे घोरे स्थापयामास लोकपः .. 57 ..
मेषगे द्युमणौ प्राप्ते शशिमण्डलगं प्रभुम् ..
text_mt:
Brahmā, the protector of the worlds, placed it beneath it in the terrible ocean.
When the sun had entered Aries, to the Lord situated in the disc of the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ rudraṃ sa cakārāśu parameṣṭhī pitāmahaḥ .. 58 ..
ūrujātātsmṛto vorvo dahano lokadāhataḥ ..
meaning:
तं रुद्रं स चकाराशु परमेष्ठी पितामहः .. 58 ..
ऊरुजातात्स्मृतो वोर्वो दहनो लोकदाहतः ..
text_mt:
to that Rudra, Brahmā, the grandfather of all, swiftly made [him lord].
Because he was born from the thigh, Aurva is remembered; he is the fire because he burns the world;

sanskrit_iast:
vaḍavāmukhato jāto vāḍavo nāma sa prabhuḥ .. 59 ..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
iti śrutvā tu dahano guruvākyaṃ manoharam ..
meaning:
वडवामुखतो जातो वाडवो नाम स प्रभुः .. 59 ..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
इति श्रुत्वा तु दहनो गुरुवाक्यं मनोहरम् ..
text_mt:
because he was born from the mouth of the mare, that Lord is named Vāḍava.
Sūta said:
Having heard the charming words of his guru, the Fire,

sanskrit_iast:
svamukhātteja utpādya kurukṣetraṃ cakāra ha .. 60 ..
sārasvatasya viprasya gṛhe jātassa vai śivaḥ ..
meaning:
स्वमुखात्तेज उत्पाद्य कुरुक्षेत्रं चकार ह .. 60 ..
सारस्वतस्य विप्रस्य गृहे जातस्स वै शिवः ..
text_mt:
producing splendour from his mouth, directed it to Kurukṣetra.
Born in the house of a Sārasvata brāhmaṇa, that Śiva

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetraśarmeti vikhyāto vidvacchreṣṭho babhūva ha .. 61 ..
śaṃkarācāryamāgamya śiṣyo bhūtvā parājitaḥ ..
meaning:
क्षेत्रशर्मेति विख्यातो विद्वच्छ्रेष्ठो बभूव ह .. 61 ..
शंकराचार्यमागम्य शिष्यो भूत्वा पराजितः ..
text_mt:
became renowned as Kṣetraśarman, a foremost scholar.
Approaching Śaṅkarācārya, he was defeated and became his disciple.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacaryavratī kāśyāṃ tasthau śaṃbhuparāyaṇaḥ .. 62
.. bṛhaspatiruvāca ..
ekārṇave purā jāte naṣṭe sthāvara jaṃgame ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मचर्यव्रती काश्यां तस्थौ शंभुपरायणः .. 62
.. बृहस्पतिरुवाच ..
एकार्णवे पुरा जाते नष्टे स्थावर जंगमे ..
text_mt:
observing the vow of celibacy, dwelt in Kāśī, devoted to Śambhu.
Bṛhaspati said:
Long ago, when the single ocean had arisen and the stationary and moving [beings] had perished,

sanskrit_iast:
śatābde brahmaṇaḥ prāpte'vyaktajanmani lokage .. 63 ..
avyaktaṃ prakṛtirmāyā pītvā sarvajalaṃ mudā ..
meaning:
शताब्दे ब्रह्मणः प्राप्तेऽव्यक्तजन्मनि लोकगे .. 63 ..
अव्यक्तं प्रकृतिर्माया पीत्वा सर्वजलं मुदा ..
text_mt:
when a century of Brahmā had arrived, at the unmanifest birth belonging to the world,
the unmanifest, nature, Māyā, joyfully drinking up all the water,

sanskrit_iast:
mahākālī svayaṃ mūrtiraṃdhakārasvarū piṇī .. 64 ..
ekā babhūva tatraiva prākṛte kalpadāruṇe ..
meaning:
महाकाली स्वयं मूर्तिरंधकारस्वरू पिणी .. 64 ..
एका बभूव तत्रैव प्राकृते कल्पदारुणे ..
text_mt:
herself [became] Mahākālī, the embodiment whose very nature is darkness.
She alone remained there in that terrible elemental dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
