caturyugānāṃ koṭīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ dāruṇe laye .. 65 ..
ṣaṣṭilakṣayutānāṃ ca kālastatra vyatī tavān..
meaning:
चतुर्युगानां कोटीनां त्रयाणां दारुणे लये .. 65 ..
षष्टिलक्षयुतानां च कालस्तत्र व्यती तवान्..
text_mt:
During the terrible dissolution of three crores of caturyugas
and sixty lakhs [more], time passed there.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā sā prakṛtirdevī nityaśuddhā sanātanī ..66..
svecchayā ca svarūpaṃ svaṃ mahāgauramanuttamam ..
meaning:
तदा सा प्रकृतिर्देवी नित्यशुद्धा सनातनी ..66..
स्वेच्छया च स्वरूपं स्वं महागौरमनुत्तमम् ..
text_mt:
Then that Goddess, nature, eternally pure and everlasting,
by her own will assumed her own unsurpassed form, dazzling white,

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcavaktraṃ daśabhujaṃ trinetraṃ ca dadhau śivā.. .. 67 ..
bhālanetreṇa sā mātā sūkṣmatejo dadarśa ha ..
meaning:
पंचवक्त्रं दशभुजं त्रिनेत्रं च दधौ शिवा.. .. 67 ..
भालनेत्रेण सा माता सूक्ष्मतेजो ददर्श ह ..
text_mt:
five-faced, ten-armed, and three-eyed, [as] Śivā.
With the eye in her forehead, that Mother perceived a subtle light,

sanskrit_iast:
śūnyabhūtaṃ paraṃ nityamavikāri niraṃjanam .. 68 ..
tadā dikṣu gataṃ brahma svabhujaiḥ prakṛtiḥ purā ..
meaning:
शून्यभूतं परं नित्यमविकारि निरंजनम् .. 68 ..
तदा दिक्षु गतं ब्रह्म स्वभुजैः प्रकृतिः पुरा ..
text_mt:
become a void, supreme, eternal, immutable, and taintless.
Then, long ago, nature, wishing with her own arms

sanskrit_iast:
grahītumicchatī tatra na samarthā babhūva vai .. 69 ..
vismitā prakṛtirmātā paṃcavaktraiḥ sanātanam ..
meaning:
ग्रहीतुमिच्छती तत्र न समर्था बभूव वै .. 69 ..
विस्मिता प्रकृतिर्माता पंचवक्त्रैः सनातनम् ..
text_mt:
to seize that Brahman which had gone into the quarters, was not able to do so there.
Astonished, Mother Nature, with her five mouths, praised the eternal,

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā cirakālātparātparam .. .. 70 ..
dhātuśabdaiḥ prāṅmukhajaiḥ pratyayairyāmyavaktrajaiḥ ..
meaning:
तुष्टाव परया भक्त्या चिरकालात्परात्परम् .. .. 70 ..
धातुशब्दैः प्राङ्मुखजैः प्रत्ययैर्याम्यवक्त्रजैः ..
text_mt:
the highest of the high, with supreme devotion after a long time:
with words consisting of verbal roots born of her east-facing mouth, with suffixes born of her southern mouth,

sanskrit_iast:
suvibhaktimayaiḥ śabdairmukhapaścimajaiḥ sthirā .. 71 ..
tiṅvibhaktimayairnityā mukhottaramayai rmudā ..
meaning:
सुविभक्तिमयैः शब्दैर्मुखपश्चिमजैः स्थिरा .. 71 ..
तिङ्विभक्तिमयैर्नित्या मुखोत्तरमयै र्मुदा ..
text_mt:
with words composed of nominal case-endings born of her western mouth, the steadfast one,
with those composed of verbal endings born of her northern mouth, the eternal one joyfully [praised],

sanskrit_iast:
nabhovaktramayaiḥ śabdairvarṇamātrairniraṃjanam .. 72 ..
saccidānaṃdaghanakaṃ pūrṇabrahma sanātanam ..
meaning:
नभोवक्त्रमयैः शब्दैर्वर्णमात्रैर्निरंजनम् .. 72 ..
सच्चिदानंदघनकं पूर्णब्रह्म सनातनम् ..
text_mt:
and with words consisting solely of phonemes born of her upward mouth, [she praised] the taintless,
mass of being, consciousness, and bliss, the full and eternal Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
tutoṣa tattu sarvajñaṃ pacavaktreṣu cāgamat .. 73 ..
puruṣatvamabhūdbrahma svayaṃbhūrnāma cābhavat..
meaning:
तुतोष तत्तु सर्वज्ञं पचवक्त्रेषु चागमत् .. 73 ..
पुरुषत्वमभूद्ब्रह्म स्वयंभूर्नाम चाभवत्..
text_mt:
That omniscient [Brahman] was pleased and entered into her five mouths.
Brahman attained manhood and came to be named Svayambhū.

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktātprakṛterjāto'vyaktajanmā hi sa smṛtaḥ .. 74 ..
tasya hetoḥ svayaṃ devī varadā lokarūpiṇī ..
meaning:
अव्यक्तात्प्रकृतेर्जातोऽव्यक्तजन्मा हि स स्मृतः .. 74 ..
तस्य हेतोः स्वयं देवी वरदा लोकरूपिणी ..
text_mt:
Born from unmanifest nature, he is indeed remembered as of unmanifest birth.
For his sake, the Goddess herself, the granter of boons, whose form is the worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
mahālakṣmīśca pūrvārddhājjātā ṣoḍaśalokinī .. 75 ..
aṣṭādaśabhujāstasyā lokarakṣaṇatatparāḥ ..
meaning:
महालक्ष्मीश्च पूर्वार्द्धाज्जाता षोडशलोकिनी .. 75 ..
अष्टादशभुजास्तस्या लोकरक्षणतत्पराः ..
text_mt:
Mahālakṣmī, possessing sixteen worlds, was born from her front half.
Her eighteen arms were intent upon protecting the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tadadbhutaṃ rūpaṃ svayaṃbhūrvismayānvitaḥ .. .. 76 ..
praviśya bahudhā bhūtvā nāntaṃ tasyā jagāma ha ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तदद्भुतं रूपं स्वयंभूर्विस्मयान्वितः .. .. 76 ..
प्रविश्य बहुधा भूत्वा नान्तं तस्या जगाम ह ..
text_mt:
Beholding that wondrous form, Svayambhū was filled with astonishment.
Having entered and become manifold, he did not reach her end.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhatvādbahurūpatvādbrahmā nāmeti viśrutaḥ .. 77 ..
śramito bhagavānbrahmā satyalokamupa sthitaḥ ..
meaning:
बृहत्वाद्बहुरूपत्वाद्ब्रह्मा नामेति विश्रुतः .. 77 ..
श्रमितो भगवान्ब्रह्मा सत्यलोकमुप स्थितः ..
text_mt:
Because of his immensity and his manifold forms, he is renowned by the name Brahmā.
Exhausted, the Lord Brahmā arrived at Satyaloka.

sanskrit_iast:
mukhebhya udbhavairdevo vedaistuṣṭāva śaṃkaram .. 78 ..
ciraṃ kālaṃ tadaṃgādvai nadīnadasamudbhavaḥ ..
meaning:
मुखेभ्य उद्भवैर्देवो वेदैस्तुष्टाव शंकरम् .. 78 ..
चिरं कालं तदंगाद्वै नदीनदसमुद्भवः ..
text_mt:
With the Vedas born from his mouths, the god praised Śaṅkara.
For a long time, indeed, the arising of rivers and streams [came] from his limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
ekārṇavaṃ tadā jātaṃ śete tatra svayaṃ prabhuḥ .. .. 79 ..
sahasrayugaparyaṃtamuṣitvā'vyaktabhūḥ svayam ..
meaning:
एकार्णवं तदा जातं शेते तत्र स्वयं प्रभुः .. .. 79 ..
सहस्रयुगपर्यंतमुषित्वाऽव्यक्तभूः स्वयम् ..
text_mt:
A single ocean then arose; the Lord himself slept upon it.
Having dwelt [there] for the duration of a thousand yugas, the one born from the unmanifest himself,

sanskrit_iast:
satyalokamupāgamya punaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ cakāra ha .. 80 ..
anantāḥ sṛṣṭayaścāsangaṇarūpāḥ pṛthakpṛthak ..
meaning:
सत्यलोकमुपागम्य पुनः सृष्टिं चकार ह .. 80 ..
अनन्ताः सृष्टयश्चासन्गणरूपाः पृथक्पृथक् ..
text_mt:
having gone to Satyaloka, performed creation again.
And the creations were endless, having distinct forms of host after host.

sanskrit_iast:
tābhirvyaktamabhūtsarvaṃ mahālakṣmīmayaṃ jagat.. 81 ..
dṛṣṭvā bahutvaṃ sṛṣṭīnāṃ mahālakṣmīḥ sanātanī..
meaning:
ताभिर्व्यक्तमभूत्सर्वं महालक्ष्मीमयं जगत्.. 81 ..
दृष्ट्वा बहुत्वं सृष्टीनां महालक्ष्मीः सनातनी..
text_mt:
Through them, the entire universe, consisting of Mahālakṣmī, became manifest.
Seeing the multitude of creations, eternal Mahālakṣmī

sanskrit_iast:
vismitābhūcca sarveśaṃ bhagavantamupāyayau .. .. 82 ..
natvovāca vaco ramyaṃ kṛṣṇamavyaktamaṃgalam ..
meaning:
विस्मिताभूच्च सर्वेशं भगवन्तमुपाययौ .. .. 82 ..
नत्वोवाच वचो रम्यं कृष्णमव्यक्तमंगलम् ..
text_mt:
was astonished and approached the Lord, the master of all.
Bowing down, she spoke delightful words, dark and auspiciously unmanifest:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavannityaśuddhātmannarāścāsanmahattarāḥ .. 83 ..
kathaṃ teṣāṃ ca gaṇanā kartavyā ca mayā sadā ..
meaning:
भगवन्नित्यशुद्धात्मन्नराश्चासन्महत्तराः .. 83 ..
कथं तेषां च गणना कर्तव्या च मया सदा ..
text_mt:
“O Lord, whose self is eternally pure! Men have become exceedingly great.
How, then, is their reckoning always to be carried out by me?”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vacastasyā dvidhābhūtaśca so'vyayaḥ .. 84 ..
pūrvārddhātsa tu raktāṅgaḥ parārddhādgaurarūpavān ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्या द्विधाभूतश्च सोऽव्ययः .. 84 ..
पूर्वार्द्धात्स तु रक्ताङ्गः परार्द्धाद्गौररूपवान् ..
text_mt:
Hearing this speech of hers, that imperishable one divided in two:
from his front half he had red limbs, and from his other half he had a fair form.

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhujassa raktāṃgo gauravarṇaścatu rbhujaḥ ..85..
sarvasṛṣṭigaṇānāṃ ca sa īśo bhagavānbhavaḥ ..
meaning:
चतुर्भुजस्स रक्तांगो गौरवर्णश्चतु र्भुजः ..85..
सर्वसृष्टिगणानां च स ईशो भगवान्भवः ..
text_mt:
The red-limbed one was four-armed, and the fair-complexioned one was four-armed.
And he, the Lord Bhava, is the master of all the hosts of creation.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśo nāma vikhyātaśceśvarassa tu viśrutaḥ ..86..
paraścaturbhujo yo vai yogidhyeyo niraṃ janaḥ ..
meaning:
गणेशो नाम विख्यातश्चेश्वरस्स तु विश्रुतः ..86..
परश्चतुर्भुजो यो वै योगिध्येयो निरं जनः ..
text_mt:
He is renowned by the name Gaṇeśa and celebrated as Īśvara.
The other four-armed one is indeed the taintless one to be meditated upon by yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā vidhito jātaḥ śivaḥ pārvativallabhaḥ .. 87 ..
gaṇeśaṃ pūjayāmāsa sahasrābdaṃ prayatnataḥ ..
meaning:
एकदा विधितो जातः शिवः पार्वतिवल्लभः .. 87 ..
गणेशं पूजयामास सहस्राब्दं प्रयत्नतः ..
text_mt:
Once, Śiva, the beloved of Pārvatī, born through fate,
zealously worshipped Gaṇeśa for a thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prasanno bhagavāngaṇeśaḥ śarvapūjakaḥ .. .. 88 ..
varaṃ varaya taṃ prāha pārvatīsahitaṃ haram ..
meaning:
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवान्गणेशः शर्वपूजकः .. .. 88 ..
वरं वरय तं प्राह पार्वतीसहितं हरम् ..
text_mt:
Then the Lord Gaṇeśa, the worshipper of Śarva, was pleased.
“Choose a boon,” he said to that Hara accompanied by Pārvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
prasannātmā bhavaḥ sākṣāttuṣṭāva ca vinamradhīḥ .. 89 ..
.. śiva uvāca .. ..
namo viṣṇusvarūpāya gaṇeśāya parātmane ..
meaning:
प्रसन्नात्मा भवः साक्षात्तुष्टाव च विनम्रधीः .. 89 ..
.. शिव उवाच .. ..
नमो विष्णुस्वरूपाय गणेशाय परात्मने ..
text_mt:
With a pleased soul and humble mind, Bhava in person praised [him]:
Śiva said:
“Homage to Gaṇeśa, the supreme self, whose form is Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhujāya raktāya yajñapūrṇakarāya ca .. 90 ..
vighnahaṃtre jagadbhartre sarvānandapradāyine ..
meaning:
चतुर्भुजाय रक्ताय यज्ञपूर्णकराय च .. 90 ..
विघ्नहंत्रे जगद्भर्त्रे सर्वानन्दप्रदायिने ..
text_mt:
four-armed, red-bodied, and the completer of sacrifices,
the destroyer of obstacles, the maintainer of the universe, the bestower of all bliss!”

sanskrit_iast:
siddhīnāṃ pataye tubhyaṃ nidhīnāṃ pataye namaḥ .. 91 ..
prasanno bhava deveśa putro bhava mama priyaḥ ..
meaning:
सिद्धीनां पतये तुभ्यं निधीनां पतये नमः .. 91 ..
प्रसन्नो भव देवेश पुत्रो भव मम प्रियः ..
text_mt:
Homage to you, lord of attainments, lord of treasures.
Be pleased, O lord of gods; become my dear son.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvādipūjyastu gaṇeśo bhaktavatsalaḥ ..92..
pārvatyāḥ sarvadehāttu tejobhūtātsamu dbhavaḥ ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वादिपूज्यस्तु गणेशो भक्तवत्सलः ..92..
पार्वत्याः सर्वदेहात्तु तेजोभूतात्समु द्भवः ..
text_mt:
Hearing this, Gaṇeśa, the first to be worshipped, fond of his devotees,
was born from the entire body of Pārvatī, formed of her splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā kailāsaśikhare sarve devāssavāsavāḥ .. 93 ..
maṃgalārthamupājagmurdevadevasya mandire..
meaning:
तदा कैलासशिखरे सर्वे देवास्सवासवाः .. 93 ..
मंगलार्थमुपाजग्मुर्देवदेवस्य मन्दिरे..
text_mt:
Then, upon the peak of Kailāsa, all the gods together with Indra
came to the temple of the god of gods for the sake of celebration.

sanskrit_iast:
mahotsavaśca tatrāsītsarvalokasukhāvahaḥ .. 94 ..
etasminnaṃtare tatra sūryaputraḥ śaniḥ svayam ..
meaning:
महोत्सवश्च तत्रासीत्सर्वलोकसुखावहः .. 94 ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तत्र सूर्यपुत्रः शनिः स्वयम् ..
text_mt:
And there was a great festival there, bringing joy to all the worlds.
Meanwhile, Śani, the son of the Sun himself,

sanskrit_iast:
krūradṛṣṭiḥ samāyātaḥ kālātmā devamaṇḍape .. 95 ..
tasya darśanamātreṇa sa bālo viśirā hyabhūt ..
meaning:
क्रूरदृष्टिः समायातः कालात्मा देवमण्डपे .. 95 ..
तस्य दर्शनमात्रेण स बालो विशिरा ह्यभूत् ..
text_mt:
arrived in the gods' pavilion, of cruel gaze and the embodiment of Time.
At mere sight of him, that boy became headless indeed.

sanskrit_iast:
hāhākāro mahām̐ścāsītkailāse guhyakālaye .. 96 ..
tacchiraścaṃdraloke vai tulāsaṃsthe divākare ..
meaning:
हाहाकारो महाम्̐श्चासीत्कैलासे गुह्यकालये .. 96 ..
तच्छिरश्चंद्रलोके वै तुलासंस्थे दिवाकरे ..
text_mt:
And a great cry of grief arose on Kailāsa, the abode of the Guhyakas.
That head went indeed to the realm of the Moon; when the Sun is in Libra,

sanskrit_iast:
saptaviṃśaddinānyeva prakāśayati bhūtale .. 97 ..
niṃdito daivataistatra śanirjanabhayaṃkaraḥ ..
meaning:
सप्तविंशद्दिनान्येव प्रकाशयति भूतले .. 97 ..
निंदितो दैवतैस्तत्र शनिर्जनभयंकरः ..
text_mt:
it shines down upon the earth for twenty-seven days alone.
Śani, terrifying to people, was rebuked there by the deities.

sanskrit_iast:
gajasya mastakaṃ chittvā dantaikaṃ rāgarūpi yat .. 98 ..
tacchiśoḥ kaṃdhare rakte'ropayatsūryasaṃbhavaḥ ..
meaning:
गजस्य मस्तकं छित्त्वा दन्तैकं रागरूपि यत् .. 98 ..
तच्छिशोः कंधरे रक्तेऽरोपयत्सूर्यसंभवः ..
text_mt:
Cutting off an elephant's head, which possessed a single tusk, red in color,
the son of the Sun fixed it onto the bloody neck of that child.

sanskrit_iast:
gaja yonyā stuto brahmā karkaṭasya tadā śiraḥ .. 99 ..
samāropya tu tadyoniḥ karkaṭo viśirīkṛtaḥ ..
meaning:
गज योन्या स्तुतो ब्रह्मा कर्कटस्य तदा शिरः .. 99 ..
समारोप्य तु तद्योनिः कर्कटो विशिरीकृतः ..
text_mt:
Praised by the elephant's womb, Brahmā then fixed
the head of a crab upon it; thus the crab of that womb was rendered headless.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ gajānano jāto gaṇeśaśceśvaraḥ svayam .. .. 100
.. sūta uvāca ..
iti śrutvā gaṇeśastu gurorvacanamuttamam ..
meaning:
एवं गजाननो जातो गणेशश्चेश्वरः स्वयम् .. .. 100
.. सूत उवाच ..
इति श्रुत्वा गणेशस्तु गुरोर्वचनमुत्तमम् ..
text_mt:
Thus the elephant-faced Gaṇeśa, the Lord himself, was born.
Sūta said:
Hearing these excellent words of his guru, Gaṇeśa,

sanskrit_iast:
svamukhātskaṃdhamutpādya kāśyāṃ jātaḥ sa ceśvaraḥ .. 101 ..
daivajñasya dvijasyaiva putro bhūtvā śubhānanaḥ ..
meaning:
स्वमुखात्स्कंधमुत्पाद्य काश्यां जातः स चेश्वरः .. 101 ..
दैवज्ञस्य द्विजस्यैव पुत्रो भूत्वा शुभाननः ..
text_mt:
emitting a shoulder from his own mouth, was born in Kāśī as the Lord.
Having become the handsome-faced son of an astrologer brahmin,

sanskrit_iast:
ḍhuṃḍhirājastato nāmnā prasiddho'bhūnmahītale .. 102 ..
jātakābharaṇaṃ nāma jyotiḥśāstraṃ phalātmakam ..
meaning:
ढुंढिराजस्ततो नाम्ना प्रसिद्धोऽभून्महीतले .. 102 ..
जातकाभरणं नाम ज्योतिःशास्त्रं फलात्मकम् ..
text_mt:
he then became famed by the name Ḍhuṇḍhirāja on the surface of the earth.
Having composed the astrological treatise of prognostications named Jātakābharaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā sa vedarakṣārthe śaṃkarācāryamāgamat .. 103 ..
śiṣyo bhūtvā prasannātmā gurusevāparo'bhavat ..
meaning:
कृत्वा स वेदरक्षार्थे शंकराचार्यमागमत् .. 103 ..
शिष्यो भूत्वा प्रसन्नात्मा गुरुसेवापरोऽभवत् ..
text_mt:
he went to Śaṅkarācārya for the protection of the Veda.
Becoming his pupil, pure in heart, he devoted himself to serving the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ vipra ḍhuṃḍhirājo yathābhavat .. 104 ..
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe pratisargaparvaṇi caturyugakhaṇḍāparaparyāye
kaliyugīyetihāsasamuccaye bhāratīśagorakhanāthakṣetraśarmaḍhuṃḍhirājasamutpatti varṇano nāma
dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 12 .. cha ..
aghorapathabhairavahanumajjanmarudramāhātmyabālaśarmasamutpattivarṇanam
meaning:
इति ते कथितं विप्र ढुंढिराजो यथाभवत् .. 104 ..
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे प्रतिसर्गपर्वणि चतुर्युगखण्डापरपर्याये
कलियुगीयेतिहाससमुच्चये भारतीशगोरखनाथक्षेत्रशर्मढुंढिराजसमुत्पत्ति वर्णनो नाम
द्वादशोऽध्यायः .. 12 .. छ ..
अघोरपथभैरवहनुमज्जन्मरुद्रमाहात्म्यबालशर्मसमुत्पत्तिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus has it been told to you, O brahmin, how Ḍhuṇḍhirāja came to be.
Thus ends the twelfth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Origins of Bhāratīśa, Gorakhanātha, Kṣetraśarman, and Ḍhuṇḍhirāja', in the Compendium of Kaliyuga Histories, in the Four-Age Section, in the Pratisarga Book of the glorious and great Bhaviṣya Purāṇa.
The description of the Aghora path, the birth of Bhairava and Hanūmat, the glory of Rudra, and the origin of Bālaśarman.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca
ṣoḍaśābde ca samprāpte brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ .
sa uṣitvā ca kamale sthitaḥ sṛṣṭyarthamudyataḥ . . 1
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच
षोडशाब्दे च सम्प्राप्ते ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः .
स उषित्वा च कमले स्थितः सृष्ट्यर्थमुद्यतः . . 1
text_mt:
Bṛhaspati said:
When the sixteenth year of Brahmā, whose birth is unmanifest, arrived,
he, having dwelt and stayed on the lotus, set about creating.
title: atha trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare vaktrātsamudbhūtā ca śāradā .
dvivyāṅgaṃ sundaraṃ tasyā dṛṣṭvā brahmā smarāturaḥ . . 2
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वक्त्रात्समुद्भूता च शारदा .
द्विव्याङ्गं सुन्दरं तस्या दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मा स्मरातुरः . . 2
text_mt:
Meanwhile, Śāradā arose from his mouth.
Seeing her splendid and divine limb, Brahmā was afflicted with desire.

sanskrit_iast:
balād gṛhītvā tāṃ kanyāmuvāca smarapīḍitaḥ .
ratiṃ dehi madāghūrṇe rakṣa māṃ kāmavihvalam . . 3
meaning:
बलाद् गृहीत्वा तां कन्यामुवाच स्मरपीडितः .
रतिं देहि मदाघूर्णे रक्ष मां कामविह्वलम् . . 3
text_mt:
Seizing that maiden by force, tormented by desire, he said:
'Grant me intercourse, O woman reeling with intoxication! Protect me, distraught with passion!'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu sā mātā ruṣā prāha pitāmaham .
pañcavaktro'yamaśubho na yogyastava kandhare . . 4
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु सा माता रुषा प्राह पितामहम् .
पञ्चवक्त्रोऽयमशुभो न योग्यस्तव कन्धरे . . 4
text_mt:
Hearing this, that mother spoke in anger to the grandfather [of the worlds]:
'This inauspicious fifth face is not fit for your neck.

sanskrit_iast:
caturvaktro vedamayo yogyassarveśvare tvayi .
ityuktvāntardadhe mātā brahmā krodhānvito'bhavat . . 5
meaning:
चतुर्वक्त्रो वेदमयो योग्यस्सर्वेश्वरे त्वयि .
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे माता ब्रह्मा क्रोधान्वितोऽभवत् . . 5
text_mt:
The four-faced one consisting of the Vedas is fit for you, the Lord of All.'
Having spoken thus, the mother vanished, and Brahmā was filled with wrath.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya kopāgninā toyaṃ śuṣkabhūtamabhūdbhuvi .
śāntibhūte ca tatkope rudro jāto bhayaṅkaraḥ . . 6
meaning:
तस्य कोपाग्निना तोयं शुष्कभूतमभूद्भुवि .
शान्तिभूते च तत्कोपे रुद्रो जातो भयङ्करः . . 6
text_mt:
By the fire of his anger, water became dried up on the earth.
And when that anger subsided, terrifying Rudra was born.

sanskrit_iast:
bhairavo nāma vikhyātaḥ kālātmā saptavāhanaḥ .
svanakhaiśca nṛsiṃhābhaiḥ kṣiptvā tatpañcamaṃ śiraḥ . . 7
meaning:
भैरवो नाम विख्यातः कालात्मा सप्तवाहनः .
स्वनखैश्च नृसिंहाभैः क्षिप्त्वा तत्पञ्चमं शिरः . . 7
text_mt:
Known by the name Bhairava, the embodiment of Time, having seven vehicles,
having cast down that fifth head with his claws resembling Narasiṃha's,

sanskrit_iast:
jagarja balavānrudraḥ śaṅkaro lokaśaṅkaraḥ .
bhayabhītastadā brahmā bhairavaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau . . 8
meaning:
जगर्ज बलवान्रुद्रः शङ्करो लोकशङ्करः .
भयभीतस्तदा ब्रह्मा भैरवं शरणं ययौ . . 8
text_mt:
mighty Rudra, Śaṅkara the maker of auspiciousness for the worlds, roared.
Then Brahmā, terrified with fear, sought refuge in Bhairava:

sanskrit_iast:
nātha naḥ pāpabhūtānāṃ dhiyo yo'sau pracodayāt .
iti śrutvā sa bhagavānbhairavo lokaviśrutaḥ . . 9
meaning:
नाथ नः पापभूतानां धियो योऽसौ प्रचोदयात् .
इति श्रुत्वा स भगवान्भैरवो लोकविश्रुतः . . 9
text_mt:
'[May he be] our lord who impels the intellects of us who have become sinful!'
Hearing this, the blessed Bhairava, renowned in the world, [said]:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmabhūtamahaṃ svāminvareṇyaṃ tvāmupāgataḥ .
savitustadvareṇyaṃ yadbhargo devasya dhīmahi . . 3.4.13.10
meaning:
ब्रह्मभूतमहं स्वामिन्वरेण्यं त्वामुपागतः .
सवितुस्तद्वरेण्यं यद्भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि . . 3.4.13.10
text_mt:
'O Master, I have approached you, who have become Brahman, the most excellent one:
May we meditate upon that most excellent splendour of the divine Savitṛ.'

sanskrit_iast:
gāḍhamuccai rurodāśu khātpetuścāśrubindavaḥ .
tato vṛkṣāssamudbhūtā rudrākṣāṇāṃ pṛthakpṛthak . . 11
meaning:
गाढमुच्चै रुरोदाशु खात्पेतुश्चाश्रुबिन्दवः .
ततो वृक्षास्समुद्भूता रुद्राक्षाणां पृथक्पृथक् . . 11
text_mt:
He wept vehemently and loudly at once, and tears fell from the sky.
From them arose various trees of rudrākṣa beads.

sanskrit_iast:
śivo brahmavadhādbhītastatkapālaṃ gṛhītavān .
kapālī nāma vikhyātaṃ bhairavasya tadā hyabhūt . . 12
meaning:
शिवो ब्रह्मवधाद्भीतस्तत्कपालं गृहीतवान् .
कपाली नाम विख्यातं भैरवस्य तदा ह्यभूत् . . 12
text_mt:
Frightened by the slaying of a brahmin, Śiva took up that skull.
Then indeed Bhairava became renowned by the name Kapālin.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalokeṣu pūtāni yāni cāyatanāni ca .
tāni tānyeva gatvāśu śuddho nābhūcchivaṅkaraḥ . . 13
meaning:
सर्वलोकेषु पूतानि यानि चायतनानि च .
तानि तान्येव गत्वाशु शुद्धो नाभूच्छिवङ्करः . . 13
text_mt:
Whatever holy sanctuaries there were across all the worlds,
having gone to each of those at once, the bringer of auspiciousness was still not purified.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā teṣu vṛkṣeṣu saṃsthito bhagavānharaḥ .
tadā brahmavadhe doṣaṃ tyaktvā dūramupāgataḥ . . 14
meaning:
एकदा तेषु वृक्षेषु संस्थितो भगवान्हरः .
तदा ब्रह्मवधे दोषं त्यक्त्वा दूरमुपागतः . . 14
text_mt:
Once, the blessed Hara stood among those trees;
then, casting off the guilt of slaying a brahmin, he came afar.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabhṛti vai śambhurdhṛtvā rudrākṣamuttamam .
purīṃ kāśīṃ samāyātaḥ kapālastena mocitaḥ . . 15
meaning:
ततः प्रभृति वै शम्भुर्धृत्वा रुद्राक्षमुत्तमम् .
पुरीं काशीं समायातः कपालस्तेन मोचितः . . 15
text_mt:
From then on indeed, Śambhu, wearing the excellent rudrākṣa,
arrived at the city of Kāśī; by him the skull was released.

sanskrit_iast:
kapālamocanaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ jātamaghāpaham .
etasminnantare brahmā sarvadevasamanvitaḥ . . 16
meaning:
कपालमोचनं नाम तीर्थं जातमघापहम् .
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे ब्रह्मा सर्वदेवसमन्वितः . . 16
text_mt:
The holy place named Kapālamocana came into being, removing sins.
Meanwhile, Brahmā, accompanied by all the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
samāgatya mahādevaṃ tuṣṭāva stutijaistavaiḥ .
makarasthe divānāthe śaśinaśceśvaraṃ śubham . .
kapālinaṃ mahārudraṃ cakāra bhagavānvidhiḥ . . 17
meaning:
समागत्य महादेवं तुष्टाव स्तुतिजैस्तवैः .
मकरस्थे दिवानाथे शशिनश्चेश्वरं शुभम् . .
कपालिनं महारुद्रं चकार भगवान्विधिः . . 17
text_mt:
having arrived, praised Mahādeva with praises born of hymn.
When the lord of day was in Capricorn, the blessed Ordainer made the auspicious Kapālin, the great Rudra, the lord of the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
iti śrutvā gurorvākyaṃ kapālī bhairavaḥ śivaḥ .
svamukhātsvāṃśamutpādya kāśyāṃ jāto hyayonijaḥ . . 18
meaning:
सूत उवाच
इति श्रुत्वा गुरोर्वाक्यं कपाली भैरवः शिवः .
स्वमुखात्स्वांशमुत्पाद्य काश्यां जातो ह्ययोनिजः . . 18
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Hearing the guru's word, Kapālin, Bhairava, Śiva,
having produced a portion of himself from his own mouth, was born not from a womb in Kāśī.

sanskrit_iast:
kapālamocanātkuṇḍātsamāgamya mahītale .
yatirūpo vedanidhirbhairavo nāma viśrutaḥ . .
aghoraṃ kaṭhinaṃ mārgaṃ svaśiṣyānsamacodaya . . 19
meaning:
कपालमोचनात्कुण्डात्समागम्य महीतले .
यतिरूपो वेदनिधिर्भैरवो नाम विश्रुतः . .
अघोरं कठिनं मार्गं स्वशिष्यान्समचोदय . . 19
text_mt:
Coming forth onto the surface of the earth from the Kapālamocana pool,
the treasury of the Vedas in the form of an ascetic, famed by the name Bhairava,
he urged his disciples onto the harsh Aghora path.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkarācāryamāgamya śiṣyobhūtvā sa bhairavaḥ .
ḍāmaraṃ nāma vai tantraṃ mantrabhūtaṃ cakāra ha . .
kīlitā ye tu vai mantrāstena cotkīlitīkṛtāḥ . . 3.4.13.20
meaning:
शङ्कराचार्यमागम्य शिष्योभूत्वा स भैरवः .
डामरं नाम वै तन्त्रं मन्त्रभूतं चकार ह . .
कीलिता ये तु वै मन्त्रास्तेन चोत्कीलितीकृताः . . 3.4.13.20

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca
mandodarī mayasutā tripurādhipateḥ svasā .
tripure tu tadā naṣṭe mahāviṣṇuṃ sanātanam . .
bhaktyā tuṣṭāva sā devī pratyahaṃ guptabhāvinī . . 21
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच
मन्दोदरी मयसुता त्रिपुराधिपतेः स्वसा .
त्रिपुरे तु तदा नष्टे महाविष्णुं सनातनम् . .
भक्त्या तुष्टाव सा देवी प्रत्यहं गुप्तभाविनी . . 21
text_mt:
Bṛhaspati said:
Mandodarī was the daughter of Maya and sister of the lord of Tripura.
When Tripura was destroyed, that goddess, full of secret devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktibhāvāttato yogaṃ harau prāpya mahottamam .
vindhyādrikandhare ghore tatraivāntaradhīyata . . 22
meaning:
भक्तिभावात्ततो योगं हरौ प्राप्य महोत्तमम् .
विन्ध्याद्रिकन्धरे घोरे तत्रैवान्तरधीयत . . 22
text_mt:
praised eternal Mahāviṣṇu with devotion every day.
Then, having attained supreme yoga in Hari through devotional feeling,
she vanished right there in a terrifying cave of the Vindhya mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
caturyugaṃ ca dviśataṃ tasyā jātaṃ samādhitaḥ .
vaivasvate'ntare prāpte dvādaśe caiva kṛdyuge . . 23
meaning:
चतुर्युगं च द्विशतं तस्या जातं समाधितः .
वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे प्राप्ते द्वादशे चैव कृद्युगे . . 23
text_mt:
Two hundred and four ages passed for her in meditative absorption.
When the Vaivasvata interval arrived, and in the twelfth Kṛta age,

sanskrit_iast:
pulastyo brahmaṇaḥ putro viśravā roṣato'bhavat .
śatābdaṃ ca tapastaptvā viśravā nāma yo muniḥ . . 24
meaning:
पुलस्त्यो ब्रह्मणः पुत्रो विश्रवा रोषतोऽभवत् .
शताब्दं च तपस्तप्त्वा विश्रवा नाम यो मुनिः . . 24
text_mt:
Pulastya was the son of Brahmā, and from anger Viśravas was born.
The sage named Viśravas, having performed ascetic penance for a hundred years,

sanskrit_iast:
sumālino'tha daityasya sutāṃ vai kaikasīṃ mudā .
samudvāhya vidhānena pulastyassa ca viśravāḥ . . 25
meaning:
सुमालिनोऽथ दैत्यस्य सुतां वै कैकसीं मुदा .
समुद्वाह्य विधानेन पुलस्त्यस्स च विश्रवाः . . 25
text_mt:
then joyfully married Kaikasī, the daughter of the demon Sumālin, according to ritual rule;
he was Pulastya's [son] Viśravas.

sanskrit_iast:
kadalīvipine ramye gandhamādanaparvate .
sa reme ca tayā sārddhaṃ viśravā bhagavānṛṣiḥ . . 26
meaning:
कदलीविपिने रम्ये गन्धमादनपर्वते .
स रेमे च तया सार्द्धं विश्रवा भगवानृषिः . . 26
text_mt:
In a delightful plantain forest on Mount Gandhamādana,
he, the venerable sage Viśravas, sported with her.

sanskrit_iast:
rāvaṇaḥ kumbhakarṇaśca tayorjāto hi rākṣasau .
rāvaṇo mātṛbhaktaśca pitṛbhaktastato'nujaḥ . . 27
meaning:
रावणः कुम्भकर्णश्च तयोर्जातो हि राक्षसौ .
रावणो मातृभक्तश्च पितृभक्तस्ततोऽनुजः . . 27
text_mt: Rāvaṇa and Kumbhakarṇa were indeed the two rākṣasas born to them. / Rāvaṇa was devoted to his mother, and his younger brother was devoted to his father.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrābdaṃ tapo ghoraṃ cakratustau varārthinau .
tadā prasanno bhagavānparameṣṭhī pitāmahaḥ . . 28
meaning:
सहस्राब्दं तपो घोरं चक्रतुस्तौ वरार्थिनौ .
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवान्परमेष्ठी पितामहः . . 28
text_mt: Desiring a boon, the two performed severe asceticism for a thousand years. / Then the venerable grandfather Parameṣṭhin was pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
dadau tābhyāṃ varaṃ ramyamajeyaṃ devadānavaiḥ .
tau tu labdhavarau kruddhau puṣpakaṃ yānamuttamam . .
gṛhītvā ca balādvīrau yuyudhāte parasparam . . 29
meaning:
ददौ ताभ्यां वरं रम्यमजेयं देवदानवैः .
तौ तु लब्धवरौ क्रुद्धौ पुष्पकं यानमुत्तमम् . .
गृहीत्वा च बलाद्वीरौ युयुधाते परस्परम् . . 29
text_mt: He granted them a delightful boon [rendering them] invincible to gods and dānavas. / Having obtained the boon, enraged, those two heroes seized the supreme vehicle Puṣpaka by force / and fought with one another.

sanskrit_iast:
tābhyāṃ vinirjitā devāstyaktvā svargaṃ sukhapradam .
pārthivaiḥ pūjayāmāsuḥ śivaṃ kailāsasaṃsthitāḥ . . 3.4.13.30
meaning:
ताभ्यां विनिर्जिता देवास्त्यक्त्वा स्वर्गं सुखप्रदम् .
पार्थिवैः पूजयामासुः शिवं कैलाससंस्थिताः . . 3.4.13.30
text_mt: Utterly vanquished by the two, the gods abandoned the bliss-bestowing heaven / and, residing on Mount Kailāsa, worshipped Śiva with earthly [lingas].

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśābdamārādhya te devā girijāpatim .
śaṅkarācca varaṃ prāptā nirbhayāśca tadābhavan . . 31
meaning:
एकादशाब्दमाराध्य ते देवा गिरिजापतिम् .
शङ्कराच्च वरं प्राप्ता निर्भयाश्च तदाभवन् . . 31
text_mt: Having propitiated the lord of the Mountain's Daughter for eleven years, / those gods received a boon from Śaṅkara and then became fearless.

sanskrit_iast:
śivo'pi ca svapūrvārddhājjāto vai mānasottare .
girau yatra sthitā devī gautamasya tanūdbhavā . .
añjanā nāma vikhyātā kīśakesaribhoginī . . 32
meaning:
शिवोऽपि च स्वपूर्वार्द्धाज्जातो वै मानसोत्तरे .
गिरौ यत्र स्थिता देवी गौतमस्य तनूद्भवा . .
अञ्जना नाम विख्याता कीशकेसरिभोगिनी . . 32
text_mt: Moreover, from his own anterior half, Śiva was indeed born on Mount Mānasottara, / where the goddess born of Gautama's body dwelt, / renowned by the name Añjanā, who enjoyed the monkey Kesarin.

sanskrit_iast:
raudraṃ tejastadā ghoraṃ mukhe kesariṇo yayau .
smarāturaḥ kapīndrastu bubhuje tāṃ śubhānanām . . 33
meaning:
रौद्रं तेजस्तदा घोरं मुखे केसरिणो ययौ .
स्मरातुरः कपीन्द्रस्तु बुभुजे तां शुभाननाम् . . 33
text_mt: Then the fierce, terrible splendour of Rudra entered the mouth of Kesarin. / Afflicted by love, the lord of monkeys enjoyed that fair-faced woman.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare vāyuḥ kapīndrasya tanau gataḥ .
vāñchitāmañjanāṃ śubhrāṃ ramayāmāsa vai balāt . . 34
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वायुः कपीन्द्रस्य तनौ गतः .
वाञ्छितामञ्जनां शुभ्रां रमयामास वै बलात् . . 34
text_mt: Meanwhile, Vāyu entered the body of the lord of monkeys / and indeed forcibly took pleasure with the fair Añjanā whom he desired.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśābdamato jātaṃ dampatyormaithunasthayoḥ .
tadanu bhrūṇamāsādya varṣamātraṃ hi sā dadhat . . 35
meaning:
द्वादशाब्दमतो जातं दम्पत्योर्मैथुनस्थयोः .
तदनु भ्रूणमासाद्य वर्षमात्रं हि सा दधत् . . 35
text_mt: From that, twelve years passed while the couple remained in intercourse. / After that, conceiving an embryo, she bore it for only a year.

sanskrit_iast:
putro jātassa rāgātmā sa rudro vānarānanaḥ .
kurūpācca tato mātrā prakṣipto'bhūdgireradhaḥ . . 36
meaning:
पुत्रो जातस्स रागात्मा स रुद्रो वानराननः .
कुरूपाच्च ततो मात्रा प्रक्षिप्तोऽभूद्गिरेरधः . . 36
text_mt: A son was born, passionate by nature, who was Rudra with a monkey's face. / And because he was deformed, he was thrown down below the mountain by his mother.

sanskrit_iast:
balādāgatya balavāndṛṣṭvā sūryamupasthitam .
vilikhya bhagavānrudro devastatra samāgataḥ . . 37
meaning:
बलादागत्य बलवान्दृष्ट्वा सूर्यमुपस्थितम् .
विलिख्य भगवान्रुद्रो देवस्तत्र समागतः . . 37
text_mt: Advancing with force, the mighty one, seeing the sun present [before him], / scratched [him], and the venerable god Rudra arrived there.

sanskrit_iast:
vajrasantāḍito vāpi na tatyāja tadā ravim .
bhayabhītastadā prāṃśussūryaṃ trāhīti jalpitaḥ . . 38
meaning:
वज्रसन्ताडितो वापि न तत्याज तदा रविम् .
भयभीतस्तदा प्रांशुस्सूर्यं त्राहीति जल्पितः . . 38
text_mt: Even when struck by the thunderbolt, he did not release the sun then. / Terrified with fear, the tall one then cried out to the sun, 'Save [me]!'

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā tadārtavacanaṃ rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ .
pucche gṛhītvā taṃ kīśaṃ muṣṭiyuddhamacīkarat . . 39
meaning:
श्रुत्वा तदार्तवचनं रावणो लोकरावणः .
पुच्छे गृहीत्वा तं कीशं मुष्टियुद्धमचीकरत् . . 39
text_mt: Hearing that distressed cry, Rāvaṇa, who makes the worlds cry out, / seized that monkey by the tail and engaged [him] in fist-fighting.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu kesarisuto raviṃ tyaktvā ruṣānvitaḥ .
varṣamātraṃ mahāghoraṃ mallayuddhaṃ cakāra ha . . 3.4.13.40
meaning:
तदा तु केसरिसुतो रविं त्यक्त्वा रुषान्वितः .
वर्षमात्रं महाघोरं मल्लयुद्धं चकार ह . . 3.4.13.40
text_mt: Then, releasing the sun, filled with rage, / the son of Kesarin indeed waged a most terrible wrestling combat for a full year.

sanskrit_iast:
śramito rāvaṇastatra bhayabhītassamantataḥ .
palāyanaparo bhūtaḥ kīśarudreṇa tāḍitaḥ . . 41
meaning:
श्रमितो रावणस्तत्र भयभीतस्समन्ततः .
पलायनपरो भूतः कीशरुद्रेण ताडितः . . 41
text_mt: Exhausted there, terrified with fear on all sides, / Rāvaṇa was bent on fleeing, beaten by the monkey Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare prāpto viśravā bhagavānṛṣiḥ .
stotrairvedamayairdevaṃ tuṣṭāva parayā girā . .4 2
prasannastu tadā rudro rāvaṇaṃ lokarāvaṇam .
tyaktvā pampāsarastīre nivāsaṃ kṛtavānbalī . .
sthāṇubhūtaḥ sthitastatra sthāṇurnāma tato'bhavat . . 43
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे प्राप्तो विश्रवा भगवानृषिः .
स्तोत्रैर्वेदमयैर्देवं तुष्टाव परया गिरा . .4 2
प्रसन्नस्तु तदा रुद्रो रावणं लोकरावणम् .
त्यक्त्वा पम्पासरस्तीरे निवासं कृतवान्बली . .
स्थाणुभूतः स्थितस्तत्र स्थाणुर्नाम ततोऽभवत् . . 43
text_mt: Meanwhile, the venerable sage Viśravas arrived / and praised the god with supreme speech through Vedic hymns. / Then Rudra was pleased; releasing Rāvaṇa, who makes the worlds cry out, / the mighty one made his dwelling on the shore of Lake Pampā. / Remaining there motionlessly like a post, he was thereafter named Sthāṇu.

sanskrit_iast: nighnantaṃ ca surānmukhyānrāvaṇaṃ lokarāvaṇam . . 44
meaning: निघ्नन्तं च सुरान्मुख्यान्रावणं लोकरावणम् . . 44
text_mt: And Rāvaṇa, who makes the worlds cry out, who was slaying the foremost gods—

sanskrit_iast: nihanti muṣṭibhiryo na hanumāniti viśrutaḥ . . 45
meaning: निहन्ति मुष्टिभिर्यो न हनुमानिति विश्रुतः . . 45
text_mt: He who struck [him] down with fists is celebrated as Hanumān.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā tasya kīśasya prasanno bhagavānvidhiḥ .
namradhīrvacanaṃ prāha śṛṇu rudra taponidhe . . 46
meaning:
तपसा तस्य कीशस्य प्रसन्नो भगवान्विधिः .
नम्रधीर्वचनं प्राह शृणु रुद्र तपोनिधे . . 46
text_mt: Pleased with the asceticism of that monkey, the venerable Vidhi, / with a humble mind, spoke these words: 'Listen, Rudra, treasure of asceticism!

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvate'ntare prāpte cāṣṭāviṃśattame yuge .
tretāyāḥ pūrvacaraṇe rāmassākṣādbhaviṣyati . .
tasya bhaktiṃ ca samprāpya kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyasi . . 47
meaning:
वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे प्राप्ते चाष्टाविंशत्तमे युगे .
त्रेतायाः पूर्वचरणे रामस्साक्षाद्भविष्यति . .
तस्य भक्तिं च सम्प्राप्य कृतकृत्यो भविष्यसि . . 47
text_mt: When the Vaivasvata interval arrives, in the twenty-eighth age, / in the first quarter of the Tretā [yuga], Rāma will become manifest in person. / And having attained devotion to him, you will have accomplished your purpose.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti coktvā dadau tasmai candraṃ bhādraprakāśakam .
rāvaṇāya priyāṃ ramyāṃ dadau mandodarī vidhiḥ . . 48
meaning:
इति चोक्त्वा ददौ तस्मै चन्द्रं भाद्रप्रकाशकम् .
रावणाय प्रियां रम्यां ददौ मन्दोदरी विधिः . . 48
text_mt: Having spoken thus, he gave him the moon that shines in the month of Bhādra. / To Rāvaṇa, Vidhi gave the lovely Mandodarī as his beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
nairṛtasyaiva dikpālassa babhūva ca rāvaṇaḥ .
alpāyurmaraṇaṃ prāpto rāmeṇa harirūpiṇā . . 49
meaning:
नैरृतस्यैव दिक्पालस्स बभूव च रावणः .
अल्पायुर्मरणं प्राप्तो रामेण हरिरूपिणा . . 49
text_mt: And that Rāvaṇa became the guardian of the south-western direction. / Short-lived, he met death at the hands of Rāma in the form of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
iti śrutvā sa hanumānayoniḥ kadalīvane .
dehabhūto mahīṃ prāpto bālaśarmeti viśrutaḥ . . 3.4.13.50
meaning:
सूत उवाच
इति श्रुत्वा स हनुमानयोनिः कदलीवने .
देहभूतो महीं प्राप्तो बालशर्मेति विश्रुतः . . 3.4.13.50
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having heard this, that Hanumān, not born from a womb, in the plantain forest / attained an embodied form on earth, renowned as Bālaśarman.

sanskrit_iast:
purīṃ kāśīṃ samāyāto yatra vai maṇikarṇikā .
rāmapakṣe bālaśarmā śivapakṣe tu śaṅkaraḥ . . 51
meaning:
पुरीं काशीं समायातो यत्र वै मणिकर्णिका .
रामपक्षे बालशर्मा शिवपक्षे तु शङ्करः . . 51
text_mt: He arrived at the city of Kāśī where Maṇikarṇikā is situated. / Bālaśarman was on the side of Rāma, while Śaṅkara was on the side of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
māsamātraṃ ca śāstrārthastayoścāsīnmahottamaḥ .
śaṅkarācāryayatinā bālaśarmā parājitaḥ . . 52
meaning:
मासमात्रं च शास्त्रार्थस्तयोश्चासीन्महोत्तमः .
शङ्कराचार्ययतिना बालशर्मा पराजितः . . 52
text_mt: And for a full month there was a most excellent debate on scripture between the two. / Bālaśarman was defeated by the ascetic Śaṅkarācārya.

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyo bhūtvā ca tatraiva gurusevāparo'bhavat .
yaścakāra tantramantraṃ sarva jātikathāmayam . . 53
rudramāhātmyavarṇanam
meaning:
शिष्यो भूत्वा च तत्रैव गुरुसेवापरोऽभवत् .
यश्चकार तन्त्रमन्त्रं सर्व जातिकथामयम् . . 53
रुद्रमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Becoming his disciple right there, he devoted himself to serving his guru, / [he] who composed tantra and mantra consisting of stories of all castes.
Description of the Greatness of Rudra

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca
idaṃ dṛśyaṃ yadā nāsītsadasadātsakaṃ ca yat .
tadākṣaramayaṃ tejo vyāptarūpamacintyakam . . 1
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच
इदं दृश्यं यदा नासीत्सदसदात्सकं च यत् .
तदाक्षरमयं तेजो व्याप्तरूपमचिन्त्यकम् . . 1
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / When this visible world did not exist, nor that which consists of being and non-being, / then there was an imperishable splendour, all-pervading in form and unthinkable,
title: Rudramāhātmyavarṇanottararāmānujotpattivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
na ca sthūlaṃ na ca sūkṣṇaṃ śītaṃ noṣṇaṃ ca tatparam .
ādimadhyāntarahitaṃ manāgākāravarjitam . . 2
meaning:
न च स्थूलं न च सूक्ष्णं शीतं नोष्णं च तत्परम् .
आदिमध्यान्तरहितं मनागाकारवर्जितम् . . 2
text_mt: neither gross nor subtle, neither cold nor hot, and supreme, / devoid of beginning, middle, and end, and entirely without form,

sanskrit_iast:
yogidṛśyaṃ paraṃ nityaṃ śūnyabhūtaṃ parātparam .
ekā vai prakṛtirmāyā rekhā yā tadadhaḥ smṛtā . . 3
meaning:
योगिदृश्यं परं नित्यं शून्यभूतं परात्परम् .
एका वै प्रकृतिर्माया रेखा या तदधः स्मृता . . 3
text_mt: visible to yogins, supreme, eternal, existing as a void, higher than the highest. / Below that is taught a single line, which is primordial matter, Māyā,

sanskrit_iast:
mahattatvamayī jñeyā tadadhaścordhvarekhikāḥ .
rājassattvatamobhūtā omityevasulakṣaṇam . . 4
meaning:
महत्तत्वमयी ज्ञेया तदधश्चोर्ध्वरेखिकाः .
राजस्सत्त्वतमोभूता ओमित्येवसुलक्षणम् . . 4
text_mt: to be known as consisting of the principle of the intellect; and below that are upward lines, / consisting of passion, purity, and darkness, with the auspicious mark 'Om'.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsadbrahma paraṃ jñeyaṃ yatra prāpya punarbhavaḥ .
kiyatā caiva kālena tasyecchā samapadyata . . 5
meaning:
तत्सद्ब्रह्म परं ज्ञेयं यत्र प्राप्य पुनर्भवः .
कियता चैव कालेन तस्येच्छा समपद्यत . . 5
text_mt: That supreme Brahman, which is being, is to be known, attaining which there is [no] rebirth. / And after some time, a desire arose in it.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṅkārastato jātastatastanmātrikāḥ parāḥ .
pañcabhūtānyatopyāsañjñānavijñānakānyataḥ . . 6
meaning:
अहङ्कारस्ततो जातस्ततस्तन्मात्रिकाः पराः .
पञ्चभूतान्यतोप्यासञ्ज्ञानविज्ञानकान्यतः . . 6
text_mt: From that arose the ego-sense, and from that the supreme subtle elements; / from that were the five gross elements, and from that knowledge and discernment.

sanskrit_iast:
dvāviṃśajjaḍabhūtāṃśca dṛṣṭvā svecchāmayo vibhuḥ .
dvandvabhūtaśca saguṇo buddhirjīvassamāgataḥ . . 7
meaning:
द्वाविंशज्जडभूतांश्च दृष्ट्वा स्वेच्छामयो विभुः .
द्वन्द्वभूतश्च सगुणो बुद्धिर्जीवस्समागतः . . 7
text_mt: Seeing the twenty-two insentient principles, the all-pervading lord, consisting of his own will, / became dual and endowed with qualities; intellect and the individual soul arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvārddhātsaguṇaḥ sosau nirguṇaśca parārddhataḥ .
tābhyāṃ gṛhītaṃ tatsarvaṃ caitanyamabhavattataḥ . . 8
meaning:
पूर्वार्द्धात्सगुणः सोसौ निर्गुणश्च परार्द्धतः .
ताभ्यां गृहीतं तत्सर्वं चैतन्यमभवत्ततः . . 8
text_mt: From his anterior half he was endowed with qualities, and from his posterior half devoid of qualities. / By the two of them all that was grasped, and from that consciousness arose.

sanskrit_iast:
savirāḍitisaṃjño vai jīvo jātassanātanaḥ .
virāḍo nābhito jātaṃ padmaṃ tacchatayojanam . . 9
meaning:
सविराडितिसंज्ञो वै जीवो जातस्सनातनः .
विराडो नाभितो जातं पद्मं तच्छतयोजनम् . . 9
text_mt: The eternal soul was born, known indeed as Virāj. / From the navel of Virāj a lotus was born, measuring a hundred leagues.

sanskrit_iast:
padmācca kusumaṃ jātaṃ yojanāyāmamuttamam .
tatpadmakusumājjāto virañciḥ kamalāsanaḥ . . 3.4.14.10
meaning:
पद्माच्च कुसुमं जातं योजनायाममुत्तमम् .
तत्पद्मकुसुमाज्जातो विरञ्चिः कमलासनः . . 3.4.14.10
text_mt: And from the lotus a flower arose, an excellent one measuring a league across. / From that lotus-flower was born Virañci, seated upon a lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
dvibhujassa caturvaktro dvipādo bhagavānvidhiḥ .
jñeyaḥ saptavitatyaṅgo mahācintāmavāptavān . . 11
meaning:
द्विभुजस्स चतुर्वक्त्रो द्विपादो भगवान्विधिः .
ज्ञेयः सप्तवितत्यङ्गो महाचिन्तामवाप्तवान् . . 11
text_mt: Two-armed, four-faced, two-footed was the venerable Vidhi, / to be known as having limbs measuring seven spans; he fell into great reflection:

sanskrit_iast:
ko'haṃ kasmātkuta āyātaḥ kā me jananī ko me tātaḥ .
ityadhicintaya taṃ hṛdi devaṃ śabdamahattvamayena sa āha . . 12
meaning:
कोऽहं कस्मात्कुत आयातः का मे जननी को मे तातः .
इत्यधिचिन्तय तं हृदि देवं शब्दमहत्त्वमयेन स आह . . 12
text_mt: 'Who am I? From what or whence have I come? Who is my mother? Who is my father?' / As he was pondering this god in his heart, he spoke by means of the greatness of sound:

sanskrit_iast:
tapaścaiva tu kartavyaṃ saṃśayasyāpanuttaye .
tadākarṇya vidhissākṣāttapastepe mahattaram . . 13
meaning:
तपश्चैव तु कर्तव्यं संशयस्यापनुत्तये .
तदाकर्ण्य विधिस्साक्षात्तपस्तेपे महत्तरम् . . 13
text_mt: 'Asceticism indeed must be performed for the dispelling of doubt.' / Hearing that, Vidhi in person performed exceedingly great asceticism

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrābdaṃ prayatnena dhyātvā viṣṇuṃ sanātanam .
caturbhujaṃ yogagamyaṃ nirguṇaṃ guṇavistaram . . 14
meaning:
सहस्राब्दं प्रयत्नेन ध्यात्वा विष्णुं सनातनम् .
चतुर्भुजं योगगम्यं निर्गुणं गुणविस्तरम् . . 14
text_mt: for a thousand years with diligence, meditating upon eternal Viṣṇu, / four-armed, accessible through yoga, devoid of qualities, the expansion of qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
samādhiniṣṭho bhagavānbabhūva kamalāsanaḥ .
etasminnantare viṣṇurbālo bhūtvā caturbhujaḥ . . 15
meaning:
समाधिनिष्ठो भगवान्बभूव कमलासनः .
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे विष्णुर्बालो भूत्वा चतुर्भुजः . . 15
text_mt: The venerable one seated upon a lotus became established in absorption. / In the meantime, Viṣṇu became a four-armed child.

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmāṅgo balavānastrī divyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ .
brahmaṇo'ṅke haristasthau yathā bālaḥ pituḥ svayam . . 16
meaning:
श्यामाङ्गो बलवानस्त्री दिव्यभूषणभूषितः .
ब्रह्मणोऽङ्के हरिस्तस्थौ यथा बालः पितुः स्वयम् . . 16
text_mt: With dark-complexioned limbs, mighty, bearing weapons, adorned with divine ornaments, / Hari sat of his own accord upon Brahmā's lap, like a boy on his father's.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prabuddhaśca vidhistaṃ dṛṣṭvā mohamāgataḥ .
vatsavatseti vacanaṃ vidhiḥ prāha prasannadhīḥ . . 17
meaning:
तदा प्रबुद्धश्च विधिस्तं दृष्ट्वा मोहमागतः .
वत्सवत्सेति वचनं विधिः प्राह प्रसन्नधीः . . 17
text_mt: Then Brahmā awakened, and seeing him, was seized with delusion. / With a delighted mind, Brahmā said: "Child! Child!"

sanskrit_iast:
vihasyāha tadā viṣṇurahaṃ brahmanpitā tava .
tayorvivadatorevaṃ rudro jātastamomayaḥ . . 18
meaning:
विहस्याह तदा विष्णुरहं ब्रह्मन्पिता तव .
तयोर्विवदतोरेवं रुद्रो जातस्तमोमयः . . 18
text_mt: Laughing, Viṣṇu then said: "O Brahmā, I am your father." / As they were disputing thus, Rudra, composed of darkness, was born,

sanskrit_iast:
jyotirliṅgaśca bhayado yojanānantavistaraḥ .
haṃsarūpaṃ tadā brahmā varāho bhagavānprabhu . . 19
meaning:
ज्योतिर्लिङ्गश्च भयदो योजनानन्तविस्तरः .
हंसरूपं तदा ब्रह्मा वराहो भगवान्प्रभु . . 19
text_mt: As a terrifying Liṅga of light, extending over endless leagues. / Then Brahmā took the form of a wild goose, and the blessed Lord [Viṣṇu] took that of a boar.

sanskrit_iast:
śatābdaṃ tau prayatnena jātau cordhvamadhaḥ kramāt .
lajjitau punarāgatya tadā tuṣṭuvaturmudā . . 3.4.14.20
meaning:
शताब्दं तौ प्रयत्नेन जातौ चोर्ध्वमधः क्रमात् .
लज्जितौ पुनरागत्य तदा तुष्टुवतुर्मुदा . . 3.4.14.20
text_mt: For a hundred years, the two went with effort upwards and downwards respectively. / Returning ashamed, they then joyfully praised [him].

sanskrit_iast:
tābhyāṃ stuto haraḥ sākṣādbhavo nāmnā samāgataḥ .
kailāsanilayaṃ kṛtvā samādhistho babhūva ha . . 21
meaning:
ताभ्यां स्तुतो हरः साक्षाद्भवो नाम्ना समागतः .
कैलासनिलयं कृत्वा समाधिस्थो बभूव ह . . 21
text_mt: Praised by both, Hara, directly known by the name Bhava, arrived. / Making Kailāsa his abode, he became absorbed in meditative absorption.

sanskrit_iast:
jātaṃ pañcayugaṃ tatra divyaṃ rudrasya yoginaḥ .
etasminnantare ghoro dānavastārakāsuraḥ . . 22
meaning:
जातं पञ्चयुगं तत्र दिव्यं रुद्रस्य योगिनः .
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे घोरो दानवस्तारकासुरः . . 22
text_mt: Five divine ages passed there for the yogin Rudra. / In the meantime, there arose the terrible Danava Tārakāsura.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrābdaṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā brahmaṇo varamāptavān .
bhavavīryodbhavaḥ putraḥ sa te mṛtyuṃ kariṣyati . . 23
meaning:
सहस्राब्दं तपः कृत्वा ब्रह्मणो वरमाप्तवान् .
भववीर्योद्भवः पुत्रः स ते मृत्युं करिष्यति . . 23
text_mt: Having performed austerities for a thousand years, he obtained a boon from Brahmā: / "A son born from the semen of Bhava—he will cause your death."

sanskrit_iast:
iti matvā surāñjitvā mahendraśca tadābhavat .
te surāścaiva kailāsaṃ gatvā rudraṃ pratuṣṭuvuḥ . . 24
meaning:
इति मत्वा सुराञ्जित्वा महेन्द्रश्च तदाभवत् .
ते सुराश्चैव कैलासं गत्वा रुद्रं प्रतुष्टुवुः . . 24
text_mt: Thinking thus, he conquered the gods and then became the Great Indra. / Those gods went to Kailāsa and praised Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ brūhīti vacanaṃ surānprāha tadā śivaḥ .
te tu śrutvā praṇamyocurvacanaṃ namrakandharāḥ . . 25
meaning:
वरं ब्रूहीति वचनं सुरान्प्राह तदा शिवः .
ते तु श्रुत्वा प्रणम्योचुर्वचनं नम्रकन्धराः . . 25
text_mt: Śiva then said to the gods: "Choose a boon." / Having heard this, bowing their necks and paying homage, they said:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavanbrahmaṇā datto varo vai tārakāya ca .
śivavīryodbhavaḥ putra sa te mṛtyurbhaviṣyati . .
ato'smānrakṣa bhagavanvivāhaṃ kuru śaṅkara . . 26
meaning:
भगवन्ब्रह्मणा दत्तो वरो वै तारकाय च .
शिववीर्योद्भवः पुत्र स ते मृत्युर्भविष्यति . .
अतोऽस्मान्रक्ष भगवन्विवाहं कुरु शङ्कर . . 26
text_mt: "O Lord, a boon was indeed granted by Brahmā to Tāraka: / 'A son born of Śiva's semen—he shall be your death.' / Therefore protect us, O Lord! Enter into marriage, O Śaṅkara!

sanskrit_iast:
svāyambhuve'ntare pūrvaṃ dakṣaścāsītprajāpatiḥ .
ṣaṣṭikanyāstato jātāstāsāṃ madhye satī varā . . 27
meaning:
स्वायम्भुवेऽन्तरे पूर्वं दक्षश्चासीत्प्रजापतिः .
षष्टिकन्यास्ततो जातास्तासां मध्ये सती वरा . . 27
text_mt: Formerly, in the Svāyambhuva Manvantara, there was Dakṣa Prajāpati. / Sixty daughters were born from him; among them, Satī was the foremost.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣamātraṃ bhavantaṃ sā pārthivaiḥ samapūjayat .
tasyai tvayā varo dattaḥ sā babhūva tava priyā . . 28
meaning:
वर्षमात्रं भवन्तं सा पार्थिवैः समपूजयत् .
तस्यै त्वया वरो दत्तः सा बभूव तव प्रिया . . 28
text_mt: For merely a year, she worshipped you with earthen [emblems]. / A boon was granted to her by you, and she became your beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpitrā yā kṛtā nindā bhavato'jñānacakṣuṣā .
tasya doṣātsatī devī tatyāja svaṃ kalevaram . . 29
meaning:
तत्पित्रा या कृता निन्दा भवतोऽज्ञानचक्षुषा .
तस्य दोषात्सती देवी तत्याज स्वं कलेवरम् . . 29
text_mt: Because of the censure of you made by her father through his eye of ignorance, / the goddess Satī cast off her own body on account of his transgression.

sanskrit_iast:
satītejastadā divyaṃ himādrau ghoramāgamat .
pīḍitastena girirāḍ babhūva smaravihvalaḥ . . 3.4.14.30
meaning:
सतीतेजस्तदा दिव्यं हिमाद्रौ घोरमागमत् .
पीडितस्तेन गिरिराड् बभूव स्मरविह्वलः . . 3.4.14.30
text_mt: The terrible, divine splendour of Satī then entered the Himālaya mountain. / Afflicted by that, the king of mountains became overwhelmed with love.

sanskrit_iast:
pitrīśvaraṃ sa tuṣṭāva kāmavyākulacetanaḥ .
aryamā tu tadā tuṣṭo dadau tasmai sutā nijām . .
menāṃ manoharāṃ śuddhāṃ sa dṛṣṭvā harṣito'bhavat . . 31
meaning:
पित्रीश्वरं स तुष्टाव कामव्याकुलचेतनः .
अर्यमा तु तदा तुष्टो ददौ तस्मै सुता निजाम् . .
मेनां मनोहरां शुद्धां स दृष्ट्वा हर्षितोऽभवत् . . 31
text_mt: With his mind agitated by desire, he praised the lord of the Pitṛs. / Aryaman, being pleased, then gave him his own daughter, / the captivating and pure Menā; seeing her, he became delighted.

sanskrit_iast:
nararūpaṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā devatulyaṃ ca tatpriyam .
sa reme ca tayā sārddhaṃ ciraṃ kālaṃ mahāvane . . 32
meaning:
नररूपं शुभं कृत्वा देवतुल्यं च तत्प्रियम् .
स रेमे च तया सार्द्धं चिरं कालं महावने . . 32
text_mt: Assuming an auspicious human form like that of a god, pleasing to her, / he sported with her for a long time in the great forest.

sanskrit_iast:
garbho jātastadā ramyo navavarṣāntamuttamaḥ .
kanyā jātā tadā subhrūrgaurī gauramayī satī . . 33
meaning:
गर्भो जातस्तदा रम्यो नववर्षान्तमुत्तमः .
कन्या जाता तदा सुभ्रूर्गौरी गौरमयी सती . . 33
text_mt: Then a delightful, excellent pregnancy arose, lasting for nine years. / Then a fair-browed girl was born, Gaurī, fair-complexioned and virtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
jātamātrā ca sā kanyā babhūva navahāyinī .
tuṣṭāva śaṅkaraṃ devaṃ bhavantaṃ tapasā ciram . . 34
meaning:
जातमात्रा च सा कन्या बभूव नवहायिनी .
तुष्टाव शङ्करं देवं भवन्तं तपसा चिरम् . . 34
text_mt: As soon as she was born, that maiden was [as if] nine years old. / For a long time, she praised Lord Śaṅkara, yourself, through austerity:

sanskrit_iast:
śatābdaṃ ca jale magnā śatābdavahnisaṃsthitā .
śatābde ca sthitā vāyau śatābdaṃ nabhasi sthitā . . 35
meaning:
शताब्दं च जले मग्ना शताब्दवह्निसंस्थिता .
शताब्दे च स्थिता वायौ शताब्दं नभसि स्थिता . . 35
text_mt: immersed in water for a hundred years, standing in fire for a hundred years, / remaining in the wind for a hundred years, and remaining in the sky for a hundred years;

sanskrit_iast:
śatābdaṃ ca sthitā candre śatābdaṃ ravimaṇḍale .
śatābdaṃ garbhabhūmyāṃ ca sthitā sā girijā satī . . 36
meaning:
शताब्दं च स्थिता चन्द्रे शताब्दं रविमण्डले .
शताब्दं गर्भभूम्यां च स्थिता सा गिरिजा सती . . 36
text_mt: remaining in the moon for a hundred years, in the orb of the sun for a hundred years, / and that virtuous mountain-born maiden remained in the womb of the earth for a hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
śatābdaṃ ca mahattatve gatvā yogabalena sā .
bhavantaṃ śaṅkaraṃ śuddhaṃ tatra dṛṣṭvā sthitādya vai . . 37
meaning:
शताब्दं च महत्तत्वे गत्वा योगबलेन सा .
भवन्तं शङ्करं शुद्धं तत्र दृष्ट्वा स्थिताद्य वै . . 37
text_mt: And going to the Mahattattva for a hundred years by the power of yoga, / having seen you there, pure Śaṅkara, she has indeed remained until today.

sanskrit_iast:
triśatābdamato jātaṃ tasmāttvaṃ pārvatīṃ śivām 1 .
varaṃ dehi prasannātmā mahādeva namo'stu te . . 38
meaning:
त्रिशताब्दमतो जातं तस्मात्त्वं पार्वतीं शिवाम् 1 .
वरं देहि प्रसन्नात्मा महादेव नमोऽस्तु ते . . 38
text_mt: Three hundred years have passed since then; therefore, with a gracious mind, / grant a boon to Pārvatī, Śivā! O Mahādeva, homage be to you!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vaco ramyaṃ śaṅkaro lokaśaṅkaraḥ .
devānāha tadā vākyamayogyaṃ vacanaṃ hi vaḥ . . 39
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो रम्यं शङ्करो लोकशङ्करः .
देवानाह तदा वाक्यमयोग्यं वचनं हि वः . . 39
text_mt: Hearing these pleasing words, Śaṅkara, who brings welfare to the world, / then addressed the gods with these words: "Your speech is indeed improper.

sanskrit_iast:
matto jyeṣṭhāśca ye rudrāḥ kumāravratadhāriṇaḥ .
mṛgavyādhādayo mukhyā daśajyotissamudbhavāḥ . . 3.4.14.40
meaning:
मत्तो ज्येष्ठाश्च ये रुद्राः कुमारव्रतधारिणः .
मृगव्याधादयो मुख्या दशज्योतिस्समुद्भवाः . . 3.4.14.40
text_mt: Those Rudras who are elder to me observe the vow of celibacy; / chief among them are Mṛgavyādha and the others, born of ten lights.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ teṣāmavarajo bhavo nāmaiva yogarāṭ .
māyārūpāṃ śubhāṃ nārīṃ kathaṃ gṛhṇāmi lokadām . . 41
meaning:
अहं तेषामवरजो भवो नामैव योगराट् .
मायारूपां शुभां नारीं कथं गृह्णामि लोकदाम् . . 41
text_mt: I am the youngest of them, indeed named Bhava, king of yoga. / How can I take an auspicious woman, a form of Māyā, who produces the worlds?

sanskrit_iast:
nārī bhagavatī sākṣāttayā sarvamidaṃ tatam .
mātṛrūpā tu sā jñeyā yogināṃ lokavāsinām . . 42
meaning:
नारी भगवती साक्षात्तया सर्वमिदं ततम् .
मातृरूपा तु सा ज्ञेया योगिनां लोकवासिनाम् . . 42
text_mt: Woman is the Goddess herself manifest; by her, all this is pervaded. / She is to be known as the mother of the yogins who dwell in the world.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ yogī kathaṃ nārīṃ mātaraṃ vārituṃ kṣamaḥ .
tasmādahaṃ bhavadarthe svavīryamādadāmyaham . . 43
meaning:
अहं योगी कथं नारीं मातरं वारितुं क्षमः .
तस्मादहं भवदर्थे स्ववीर्यमाददाम्यहम् . . 43
text_mt: Being a yogin, how am I able to wed a woman, a mother? / Therefore, for your sake, I surrender my semen.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvīryaṃ bhagavānvahniḥ prāpya kāryaṃ kariṣyati .
ityuktvā vahnaye devo dadau vīryamanuttamam . .
svayaṃ tatra samādhistho babhūva bhagavānharaḥ . . 44
meaning:
तद्वीर्यं भगवान्वह्निः प्राप्य कार्यं करिष्यति .
इत्युक्त्वा वह्नये देवो ददौ वीर्यमनुत्तमम् . .
स्वयं तत्र समाधिस्थो बभूव भगवान्हरः . . 44
text_mt: Receiving that semen, the blessed Vahni will accomplish the task." / Having spoken thus, the god gave his unsurpassed semen to Vahni, / and Lord Hara himself became absorbed in meditative absorption right there.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā śakrādayo devā vahninā saha niryayuḥ .
satyalokaṃ samāgatyābruvansarvaṃ prajāpatim . . 45
meaning:
तदा शक्रादयो देवा वह्निना सह निर्ययुः .
सत्यलोकं समागत्याब्रुवन्सर्वं प्रजापतिम् . . 45
text_mt: Then the gods headed by Śakra went out along with Vahni. / Coming to Satyaloka, they told everything to the Prajāpati [Brahmā].

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā tatkāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ svayambhūścaturānanaḥ .
namaskṛtya paraṃ brahma kṛṣṇadhyānaparo'bhavat . . 46
meaning:
श्रुत्वा तत्कारणं सर्वं स्वयम्भूश्चतुराननः .
नमस्कृत्य परं ब्रह्म कृष्णध्यानपरोऽभवत् . . 46
text_mt: Hearing that whole matter, the self-born four-faced [Brahmā], / having bowed to the Supreme Brahman, became devoted to meditating on Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānamārgeṇa bhagavāngatvā brahmā paraṃ padam .
hetuṃ tadvarṇayāmāsa yathā śaṅkarabhāṣitam . . 47
meaning:
ध्यानमार्गेण भगवान्गत्वा ब्रह्मा परं पदम् .
हेतुं तद्वर्णयामास यथा शङ्करभाषितम् . . 47
text_mt: The blessed Brahmā, going to the supreme abode by the path of meditation, / related that cause just as it had been spoken by Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā vihasya bhagavānsvamukhātteja uttamam .
samutpādya tato jātaḥ puruṣo rucirānanaḥ . . 48
meaning:
श्रुत्वा विहस्य भगवान्स्वमुखात्तेज उत्तमम् .
समुत्पाद्य ततो जातः पुरुषो रुचिराननः . . 48
text_mt: Hearing this, the Lord smiled, and producing an excellent radiance from his own mouth, / a man with a charming face was born from it.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍasya cchaviryā vai sthitā tasya kalevare .
pradyumno nāma vikhyātaṃ tasya jātaṃ mahātmanaḥ . . 49
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डस्य च्छविर्या वै स्थिता तस्य कलेवरे .
प्रद्युम्नो नाम विख्यातं तस्य जातं महात्मनः . . 49
text_mt: Whatever splendour belonged to the cosmic egg indeed resided in his body; / the renowned name of that great soul became Pradyumna.

sanskrit_iast:
tena sārddhaṃ tadā brahmā samprāpya svaṃ kalevaram .
dadau tebhyassa puruṣaṃ pradyumnaṃ śambarārtidam . . 3.4.14.50
meaning:
तेन सार्द्धं तदा ब्रह्मा सम्प्राप्य स्वं कलेवरम् .
ददौ तेभ्यस्स पुरुषं प्रद्युम्नं शम्बरार्तिदम् . . 3.4.14.50
text_mt: Brahmā then, having regained his own body along with him, / gave to them that man, Pradyumna, who causes torment to Śambara.

sanskrit_iast:
tejasā tasya devasya narā nāryassamantataḥ .
ekībhūtāstrilokeṣu babhūvuḥ smarapīḍitāḥ . . 51
meaning:
तेजसा तस्य देवस्य नरा नार्यस्समन्ततः .
एकीभूतास्त्रिलोकेषु बभूवुः स्मरपीडिताः . . 51
text_mt: By the radiance of that god, men and women everywhere / in the three worlds became united, afflicted by love.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāvarāḥ saumyabhūtā vai te tu kāmāgnipīḍitāḥ .
saridbhiśca latābhiśca militāssambabhūvire . . 52
meaning:
स्थावराः सौम्यभूता वै ते तु कामाग्निपीडिताः .
सरिद्भिश्च लताभिश्च मिलितास्सम्बभूविरे . . 52
text_mt: The immovables, becoming gentle creatures, were afflicted by the fire of desire; / they joined together with the rivers and creepers.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍeśaḥ śivaḥ sākṣādrudraḥ kālāgnisannibhaḥ .
1trinetrātteja utpādya śamayāmāsa tadvyathām . . 53
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डेशः शिवः साक्षाद्रुद्रः कालाग्निसन्निभः .
1त्रिनेत्रात्तेज उत्पाद्य शमयामास तद्व्यथाम् . . 53
text_mt: Śiva, the lord of the universe, manifest Rudra resembling the fire of cosmic dissolution, / produced a radiance from his third eye and calmed that distress.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā kruddhaḥ sa kṛṣṇāṅgo gṛhītvā kausumaṃ dhanuḥ .
divyānpañca śarānghorānmahādevāya bandhave . . 54
meaning:
तदा क्रुद्धः स कृष्णाङ्गो गृहीत्वा कौसुमं धनुः .
दिव्यान्पञ्च शरान्घोरान्महादेवाय बन्धवे . . 54
text_mt: Then, enraged, that dark-limbed one, taking up a bow of flowers, / aimed five terrible, divine arrows at Mahādeva, his kin.

sanskrit_iast:
uccāṭanena bāṇena gantābhūllokaśaṅkaraḥ .
vaśīkaraṇabāṇena nārīvaśyaḥ śivo'bhavat . . 55
meaning:
उच्चाटनेन बाणेन गन्ताभूल्लोकशङ्करः .
वशीकरणबाणेन नारीवश्यः शिवोऽभवत् . . 55
text_mt: By the arrow of expulsion, the benefactor of the worlds was made to wander; / by the arrow of subjugation, Śiva became subject to a woman.

sanskrit_iast:
stambhanena mahādevaḥ śivāpārśve sthiro'bhavat .
ākarṣaṇena bhagavācchivākarṣaṇatatparaḥ . .
māraṇenaiva bāṇena mūrchito'bhūnmaheśvaraḥ . . 56
meaning:
स्तम्भनेन महादेवः शिवापार्श्वे स्थिरोऽभवत् .
आकर्षणेन भगवाच्छिवाकर्षणतत्परः . .
मारणेनैव बाणेन मूर्छितोऽभून्महेश्वरः . . 56
text_mt: By the arrow of immobilisation, Mahādeva became fixed beside Śivā; / by that of attraction, the Lord was bent on attracting Śivā; / and by the arrow of death, Maheśvara swooned.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare devī mahattatve sthitā śivā .
mūrchitaṃ śivamālokya tatraivāntarddhimāgamat . . 57
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवी महत्तत्वे स्थिता शिवा .
मूर्छितं शिवमालोक्य तत्रैवान्तर्द्धिमागमत् . . 57
text_mt: In the meantime, the goddess Śivā, who was abiding in the Mahattattva, / seeing Śiva swooning, vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
tadotthāya mahādevo vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ muhuḥ .
hā priye candravadane hā śive ca ghaṭastani . . 58
meaning:
तदोत्थाय महादेवो विललाप भृशं मुहुः .
हा प्रिये चन्द्रवदने हा शिवे च घटस्तनि . . 58
text_mt: Then, rising up, Mahādeva lamented bitterly again and again: / "Alas, my beloved, moon-faced one! Alas, Śivā, with breasts like water-jars!"

sanskrit_iast:
hā ume sundarābhe ca pāhi māṃ smaravihvalam .
darśanaṃ dehi rambhoru dāsabhūto'smi sāmpratam . . 59
meaning:
हा उमे सुन्दराभे च पाहि मां स्मरविह्वलम् .
दर्शनं देहि रम्भोरु दासभूतोऽस्मि साम्प्रतम् . . 59
text_mt: "Ah, Umā of beautiful splendour, protect me who am overcome by love! / Grant me your sight, O plantain-thighed one; I have now become your servant."

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vilapamānaṃ taṃ girijā yoginī svayam .
samāgatya vacaḥ prāha natvā taṃ śaṅkaraḥ priyam . . 3.4.14.60
meaning:
एवं विलपमानं तं गिरिजा योगिनी स्वयम् .
समागत्य वचः प्राह नत्वा तं शङ्करः प्रियम् . . 3.4.14.60
text_mt: As he was lamenting in this way, Girijā, the yoginī herself, / arrived, bowed to her beloved Śaṅkara, and spoke [these] words: 3.4.14.60

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāhaṃ bhagavandeva mātṛpitrānusāriṇī .
tayossakāśādbhagavanmama pāṇiṃ gṛhāṇa bhoḥ . . 61
meaning:
कन्याहं भगवन्देव मातृपित्रानुसारिणी .
तयोस्सकाशाद्भगवन्मम पाणिं गृहाण भोः . . 61
text_mt: "O Lord, O God, I am a maiden obedient to my mother and father. / From their presence, O Lord, take my hand!"

sanskrit_iast:
tatheti matvā sa śivaḥ pradyumnaśarapīḍitaḥ .
saptarṣīnpreṣayāmāsa te tu gatvā himācalam . .
sambodhya ca vivāhasya vidhiṃ cakrurmudānvitāḥ . . 62
meaning:
तथेति मत्वा स शिवः प्रद्युम्नशरपीडितः .
सप्तर्षीन्प्रेषयामास ते तु गत्वा हिमाचलम् . .
सम्बोध्य च विवाहस्य विधिं चक्रुर्मुदान्विताः . . 62
text_mt: Agreeing, "So be it," Śiva, afflicted by Pradyumna's arrows, / dispatched the Seven Sages. They went to the Himālaya, / and having addressed [him], joyfully arranged the wedding rites.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍe ye sthitā devāsteṣāṃ svāmī maheśvaraḥ .
vivāhe tasya samprāpte sarve devāssamāyayuḥ . . 63
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डे ये स्थिता देवास्तेषां स्वामी महेश्वरः .
विवाहे तस्य सम्प्राप्ते सर्वे देवास्समाययुः . . 63
text_mt: Maheśvara is the lord of those gods who dwell within the cosmic egg; / when his wedding arrived, all the gods assembled.

sanskrit_iast:
anantaśca gaṇām̐ścaiva surāndṛṣṭvā himācalaḥ .
girijāṃ śaraṇaṃ prāpya tasthau parvatarāṭ svayam . . 64
meaning:
अनन्तश्च गणाम्̐श्चैव सुरान्दृष्ट्वा हिमाचलः .
गिरिजां शरणं प्राप्य तस्थौ पर्वतराट् स्वयम् . . 64
text_mt: Seeing the infinite troops and the gods, the Himālaya, / the king of mountains himself, sought refuge in Girijā and stood [before her].

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu pārvatī devī nidhīnsiddhīḥ samantataḥ .
cakāra koṭiśastatra bahurūpā sanātanī . . 65
meaning:
तदा तु पार्वती देवी निधीन्सिद्धीः समन्ततः .
चकार कोटिशस्तत्र बहुरूपा सनातनी . . 65
text_mt: Then the eternal goddess Pārvatī of manifold forms / produced treasures and magical powers there on all sides by the millions.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tadvismitā devā brahmaṇā saha harṣitāḥ .
tuṣṭuvuḥ pārvatīṃ devīṃ nārīratnaṃ sanātanīm . . 66
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तद्विस्मिता देवा ब्रह्मणा सह हर्षिताः .
तुष्टुवुः पार्वतीं देवीं नारीरत्नं सनातनीम् . . 66
text_mt: Seeing that, the gods were astonished and, delighted together with Brahmā, / praised the eternal goddess Pārvatī, the jewel among women.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
u vitarke ca mā lakṣmīrbahurūpā vidṛśyate .
umā tasmācca te nāma namastasyai namo namaḥ . . 67
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
उ वितर्के च मा लक्ष्मीर्बहुरूपा विदृश्यते .
उमा तस्माच्च ते नाम नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः . . 67
text_mt: The gods said: / "'U' signifies inquiry, and 'mā' is seen as Lakṣmī of manifold forms; / therefore your name is Umā. Homage to her, homage, homage!

sanskrit_iast:
katicidayanānyeva brahmāṇḍe'smicchive tava .
kātyāyanī hi vijñeyā namastasyai namo namaḥ . . 68
meaning:
कतिचिदयनान्येव ब्रह्माण्डेऽस्मिच्छिवे तव .
कात्यायनी हि विज्ञेया नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः . . 68
text_mt: Whatever courses there are in this cosmic egg, O Śivā, / you are to be known as Kātyāyanī; homage to her, homage, homage!

sanskrit_iast:
gauravarṇācca vai gaurī śyāmavarṇācca kālikā .
raktavarṇāddhaimavatī namastasyai namo namaḥ . . 69
meaning:
गौरवर्णाच्च वै गौरी श्यामवर्णाच्च कालिका .
रक्तवर्णाद्धैमवती नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः . . 69
text_mt: From your fair complexion [you are] Gaurī; from your dark complexion, Kālikā; / from your red complexion, Haimavatī. Homage to her, homage, homage!

sanskrit_iast:
bhavasya dayitā tvaṃ vai bhavānī rudrasaṃyutā .
durgā tvaṃ yogi duṣprāpyā namastasyai namonamaḥ . . 3.4.14.70
meaning:
भवस्य दयिता त्वं वै भवानी रुद्रसंयुता .
दुर्गा त्वं योगि दुष्प्राप्या नमस्तस्यै नमोनमः . . 3.4.14.70
text_mt: You are the beloved of Bhava, Bhavānī united with Rudra; / you are Durgā, difficult for yogins to attain. Homage to her, homage, homage! 3.4.14.70

sanskrit_iast:
nāntaṃ jagmurvayaṃ 3 te vai caṇḍikā nāma viśrutā .
ambā tvaṃ mātṛbhūtā no namastasyai namonamaḥ . . 71
meaning:
नान्तं जग्मुर्वयं 3 ते वै चण्डिका नाम विश्रुता .
अम्बा त्वं मातृभूता नो नमस्तस्यै नमोनमः . . 71
text_mt: We do not reach the end of your [forms]; you are renowned by the name Caṇḍikā; / you are Ambā, having become our mother. Homage to her, homage, homage!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā stavaṃ teṣāṃ varadā sarvamaṅgalā .
devānuvāca muditā daityabhītiṃ harāmi vaḥ . . 72
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा स्तवं तेषां वरदा सर्वमङ्गला .
देवानुवाच मुदिता दैत्यभीतिं हरामि वः . . 72
text_mt: Hearing their praise, the granter of boons, all-auspicious, / spoke gladly to the gods: "I take away your fear of the Daityas.

sanskrit_iast: stotreṇānena samprītā bhavāmi jagatītale . . 73
meaning: स्तोत्रेणानेन सम्प्रीता भवामि जगतीतले . . 73
text_mt: By this hymn I am well-pleased upon the surface of the earth."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā śambhusahitā kailāsaṃ guhyakālayam .
guhāyāṃ mithunībhūya sahasrābdaṃ mumoda vai . . 74
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा शम्भुसहिता कैलासं गुह्यकालयम् .
गुहायां मिथुनीभूय सहस्राब्दं मुमोद वै . . 74
text_mt: Having spoken thus, united with Śambhu, she went to Kailāsa, the abode of Guhyakas; / coupling in a cave, she rejoiced for a thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare devā bhīrukā lokanāśanāt .
brahmāṇaṃ ca puraskṛtya tuṣṭuvurgirijāpatim . . 75
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवा भीरुका लोकनाशनात् .
ब्रह्माणं च पुरस्कृत्य तुष्टुवुर्गिरिजापतिम् . . 75
text_mt: In the meantime the gods, fearful of the destruction of the worlds, / placed Brahmā at their head and praised the husband of Girijā.

sanskrit_iast:
lajjitau tau tadā tatra paścāttāpaṃ hi cakratuḥ .
mahānkrodhastayoścāsīttena vai dudruvuḥ surāḥ . . 76
meaning:
लज्जितौ तौ तदा तत्र पश्चात्तापं हि चक्रतुः .
महान्क्रोधस्तयोश्चासीत्तेन वै दुद्रुवुः सुराः . . 76
text_mt: Ashamed then, the two felt regret; / and great anger arose in them, from which the gods fled.

sanskrit_iast:
pradyumno balavāṃstatra santasthe gaurivācalaḥ .
rudrakopāgninā dagdho babhūva balavattaraḥ . . 77
meaning:
प्रद्युम्नो बलवांस्तत्र सन्तस्थे गौरिवाचलः .
रुद्रकोपाग्निना दग्धो बभूव बलवत्तरः . . 77
text_mt: The mighty Pradyumna stood firm there like a white mountain; / burnt by the fire of Rudra's wrath, he became even mightier.

sanskrit_iast:
pradyumnaḥ sthalarūpaṃ ca tyaktvā bhasmamayaṃ tadā .
sūkṣmadehamupāgamya viśruto'bhūdanaṅgakaḥ . .
yathā pūrvaṃ tathaivāsītkāyaṃ kṛtvā smaro vibhuḥ . . 78
meaning:
प्रद्युम्नः स्थलरूपं च त्यक्त्वा भस्ममयं तदा .
सूक्ष्मदेहमुपागम्य विश्रुतोऽभूदनङ्गकः . .
यथा पूर्वं तथैवासीत्कायं कृत्वा स्मरो विभुः . . 78
text_mt: Having then cast off his gross form made of ashes, / Pradyumna assumed a subtle body and became renowned as Anaṅga; / having fashioned a body, the all-pervading Smara was just as before.

sanskrit_iast:
sthūlarūpā ratirdevī śatābdaṃ śaṅkaraṃ param .
dhyānenārādhayāmāsa girijāvallabhaṃ vrataiḥ . .
tadā dadau varaṃ devastasya ratyai sanātanaḥ . . 79
meaning:
स्थूलरूपा रतिर्देवी शताब्दं शङ्करं परम् .
ध्यानेनाराधयामास गिरिजावल्लभं व्रतैः . .
तदा ददौ वरं देवस्तस्य रत्यै सनातनः . . 79
text_mt: The goddess Rati, of gross form, worshipped supreme Śaṅkara, / the beloved of Girijā, through meditation and votive observances for a hundred years; / then the eternal god granted a boon to Rati:

sanskrit_iast:
ratidevi śṛṇu tvaṃ vai lokānāṃ hṛtsu jāyase .
yauvane vayasi prāpte nṛṇāṃ dehaiḥ patiṃ svakam . .
bhajiṣyasi madardhena pradyumnaṃ kṛṣṇasambhavam . . 3.4.14.80
meaning:
रतिदेवि शृणु त्वं वै लोकानां हृत्सु जायसे .
यौवने वयसि प्राप्ते नृणां देहैः पतिं स्वकम् . .
भजिष्यसि मदर्धेन प्रद्युम्नं कृष्णसम्भवम् . . 3.4.14.80
text_mt: "O goddess Rati, listen! You are born in the hearts of creatures; / when they reach youth, through the bodies of men you shall serve your husband, / Pradyumna born of Kṛṣṇa, through half of my [nature]. 3.4.14.80

sanskrit_iast:
svārociṣāntaraḥ kālo vartate cā'dyasupriyaḥ .
vaivasvate'ntare prāpte hyaṣṭāviṃśatame yuge . .
dvāparānte ca bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ sākṣājjaniṣyati . . 81
meaning:
स्वारोचिषान्तरः कालो वर्तते चाऽद्यसुप्रियः .
वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे प्राप्ते ह्यष्टाविंशतमे युगे . .
द्वापरान्ते च भगवान् कृष्णः साक्षाज्जनिष्यति . . 81
text_mt: The present, dearly beloved time is the Svārociṣa Manvantara; / when the Vaivasvata Manvantara arrives, in the twenty-eighth age, / at the end of Dvāpara, the Lord Kṛṣṇa will be born in visible form.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tasya sutaṃ devaṃ pradyumnaṃ merumūrddhani .
bhajiṣyasi sukhaṃ ramye vipine nandane ciram . . 82
meaning:
तदा तस्य सुतं देवं प्रद्युम्नं मेरुमूर्द्धनि .
भजिष्यसि सुखं रम्ये विपिने नन्दने चिरम् . . 82
text_mt: Then, on the peak of Meru, in the charming grove of Nandana, / you shall happily serve his divine son, Pradyumna, for a long time.

sanskrit_iast:
anyeṣu dvāparānteṣu svarṇagarbho hi tatpatiḥ .
janmavānvartate bhūmau yathā kṛṣṇastathaiva saḥ . . 83
meaning:
अन्येषु द्वापरान्तेषु स्वर्णगर्भो हि तत्पतिः .
जन्मवान्वर्तते भूमौ यथा कृष्णस्तथैव सः . . 83
text_mt: At the ends of other Dvāparas, her husband is Svarṇagarbha; / he takes birth upon the earth, just as Kṛṣṇa does.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyāhne caiva sandhyāyāṃ brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ .
kalpekalpe harissākṣātkaroti janamaṅgalam . . 84
meaning:
मध्याह्ने चैव सन्ध्यायां ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः .
कल्पेकल्पे हरिस्साक्षात्करोति जनमङ्गलम् . . 84
text_mt: At midday and twilight of Brahmā of unmanifest origin, / in eon after eon, Hari visibly brings about the welfare of the people."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā bhagavāñchambhustatraivāntarddhimāgamat .
rājā babhūva rudrāṇī girijāvallabho bhavaḥ . . 85
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा भगवाञ्छम्भुस्तत्रैवान्तर्द्धिमागमत् .
राजा बभूव रुद्राणी गिरिजावल्लभो भवः . . 85
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the divine Śambhu vanished right there. / Rudrāṇī became queen, and Bhava the beloved of Girijā.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
iti śrutvā bhavaḥ sākṣātsvamukhātsvāṃśamuttamam .
samutpādya tadā bhūmau godāvaryāṃ babhūva ha . . 86
meaning:
सूत उवाच
इति श्रुत्वा भवः साक्षात्स्वमुखात्स्वांशमुत्तमम् .
समुत्पाद्य तदा भूमौ गोदावर्यां बभूव ह . . 86
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having heard this, Bhava visibly generated an excellent portion of himself from his own mouth / and was then born on the earth beside the Godāvarī.

sanskrit_iast:
ācāryaśarmaṇo gehe putro jāto bhavāṃśakaḥ .
rāmānujassa vai nāmnānujo'bhūdrāmaśarmaṇaḥ . . 87
meaning:
आचार्यशर्मणो गेहे पुत्रो जातो भवांशकः .
रामानुजस्स वै नाम्नानुजोऽभूद्रामशर्मणः . . 87
text_mt: In the house of Ācāryaśarman, a son was born as a portion of Bhava; / by name Rāmānuja, he was the younger brother of Rāmaśarman.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā rāmaśarmā vai patañjalimate sthitaḥ .
tīrthāttīrthāntaraṃ prāptaḥ purīṃ kāśīṃ śivapriyām . . 88
meaning:
एकदा रामशर्मा वै पतञ्जलिमते स्थितः .
तीर्थात्तीर्थान्तरं प्राप्तः पुरीं काशीं शिवप्रियाम् . . 88
text_mt: Once Rāmaśarman, adhering to the doctrine of Patañjali, / went from one sacred place to another and reached the city of Kāśī, dear to Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkarācāryamāgamya śataśiṣyasamanvitaḥ .
śāstrārthaṃ kṛtavānramyaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣo haripriyaḥ . . 89
meaning:
शङ्कराचार्यमागम्य शतशिष्यसमन्वितः .
शास्त्रार्थं कृतवान्रम्यं कृष्णपक्षो हरिप्रियः . . 89
text_mt: Approaching Śaṅkarācārya, accompanied by a hundred disciples, / he, taking the side of Kṛṣṇa and beloved of Hari, conducted a brilliant debate on the scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkarācāryavijito lajjito niśi bhīrukaḥ .
svagehaṃ punarāyātaḥ śāṅkarairvā śarairhataḥ . . 3.4.14.90
meaning:
शङ्कराचार्यविजितो लज्जितो निशि भीरुकः .
स्वगेहं पुनरायातः शाङ्करैर्वा शरैर्हतः . . 3.4.14.90
text_mt: Defeated by Śaṅkarācārya, ashamed, fearful at night, / struck down by the arrows of Śaṅkara's arguments, he returned to his own home. 3.4.14.90

sanskrit_iast:
rāmānujastu tacchrutvā sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ .
bhrātṛśiṣyaiśca sahitaḥ purīṃ kāśīṃ samāyayau . . 91
meaning:
रामानुजस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः .
भ्रातृशिष्यैश्च सहितः पुरीं काशीं समाययौ . . 91
text_mt: Hearing of that, Rāmānuja, skilled in all scriptures, / arrived at the city of Kāśī accompanied by his brother's disciples.

sanskrit_iast:
vādo vedāntaśāstre ca tayoścāsīnmahātmanoḥ .
śaṅkaraḥ śivapakṣaśca kṛṣṇapakṣassa vai dvijaḥ . . 92
meaning:
वादो वेदान्तशास्त्रे च तयोश्चासीन्महात्मनोः .
शङ्करः शिवपक्षश्च कृष्णपक्षस्स वै द्विजः . . 92
text_mt: A dispute in the Vedānta scripture took place between the two great-souled ones: / Śaṅkara took the side of Śiva, and the twice-born took the side of Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
māsamātreṇa vedānte darśitastena vai hariḥ .
vāsudevassa vai nāma saccidānandavigrahaḥ . . 93
meaning:
मासमात्रेण वेदान्ते दर्शितस्तेन वै हरिः .
वासुदेवस्स वै नाम सच्चिदानन्दविग्रहः . . 93
text_mt: In only a month, Hari was shown by him in the Vedānta; / his name is Vāsudeva, his form being existence, consciousness, and bliss.

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudevassa vai jñeyo vasuṣvaṃśena dīvyati .
vasudevassa vai brahmā tasya sāro hi yaḥ smṛtaḥ . . 94
meaning:
वासुदेवस्स वै ज्ञेयो वसुष्वंशेन दीव्यति .
वसुदेवस्स वै ब्रह्मा तस्य सारो हि यः स्मृतः . . 94
text_mt: Vāsudeva should be known to shine through his portion among the Vasus; / Vasudeva is Brahmā, and he is remembered as his essence.

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudevo harissākṣācchivapūjyaḥ sanātanaḥ .
śaṅkaro lajjitastatra bhāṣyaśāstre samāgataḥ . . 95
meaning:
वासुदेवो हरिस्साक्षाच्छिवपूज्यः सनातनः .
शङ्करो लज्जितस्तत्र भाष्यशास्त्रे समागतः . . 95
text_mt: Vāsudeva is visibly Hari, worshipped by Śiva, eternal. / Śaṅkara was put to shame there and took recourse to the scripture of the commentaries.

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣamātraṃ śivaissūtrairvarṇayāmāsa vai śivas .
rāmānujena tatraiva bhāṣye sandarśito hariḥ . . 96
meaning:
पक्षमात्रं शिवैस्सूत्रैर्वर्णयामास वै शिवस् .
रामानुजेन तत्रैव भाष्ये सन्दर्शितो हरिः . . 96
text_mt: For merely a fortnight Śiva described through the sūtras what pertains to Śiva; / right there in the commentary Hari was demonstrated by Rāmānuja.

sanskrit_iast:
govindo nāma vikhyāto vaiyyākaraṇadevatā .
gāṃ parāṃ vindate yasmādgovindo nāma vai hariḥ . . 97
meaning:
गोविन्दो नाम विख्यातो वैय्याकरणदेवता .
गां परां विन्दते यस्माद्गोविन्दो नाम वै हरिः . . 97
text_mt: The deity of the grammarians is renowned as Govinda; / because he obtains supreme speech, Hari is called Govinda.

sanskrit_iast:
girīśastu na govindo girīṇāmīśvaro hi saḥ .
gopālastu na vai rudro gavārūḍhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ . . 98
meaning:
गिरीशस्तु न गोविन्दो गिरीणामीश्वरो हि सः .
गोपालस्तु न वै रुद्रो गवारूढः प्रकीर्तितः . . 98
text_mt: Girīśa is not Govinda, for he is the lord of mountains; / Rudra is not Gopāla, for he is proclaimed to be mounted on a bull.

sanskrit_iast:
jñeyaḥ paśupatiḥ śambhurgopatirnaiva viśrutaḥ .
lajjitaḥ śaṅkarācāryo mīmāṃsāśāstramāgataḥ . . 99
meaning:
ज्ञेयः पशुपतिः शम्भुर्गोपतिर्नैव विश्रुतः .
लज्जितः शङ्कराचार्यो मीमांसाशास्त्रमागतः . . 99
text_mt: Śambhu is known as Paśupati, and not celebrated as Gopati. / Disgraced, Śaṅkarācārya took recourse to the Mīmāṃsā scripture.

sanskrit_iast:
tayordaśadinaṃ śāstre vivādassumahānabhūt .
yastu vai yajñapuruṣo rāmānujamatapriyaḥ . . 3.4.14.100
meaning:
तयोर्दशदिनं शास्त्रे विवादस्सुमहानभूत् .
यस्तु वै यज्ञपुरुषो रामानुजमतप्रियः . . 3.4.14.100
text_mt: For ten days there was a very great dispute between the two in that scripture. / The Yajñapuruṣa, who is dear to Rāmānuja's doctrine, 3.4.14.100

sanskrit_iast:
vicchinnaḥ śaṅkareṇaiva mṛgabhūtaḥ parājitaḥ .
ācāraprabhavo dharmo yajñadevena nirmitaḥ . . 101
meaning:
विच्छिन्नः शङ्करेणैव मृगभूतः पराजितः .
आचारप्रभवो धर्मो यज्ञदेवेन निर्मितः . . 101
text_mt: was refuted by Śaṅkara, becoming a deer and suffering defeat. / Duty originated from conduct was fashioned by the deity of sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
bhraṣṭācārastadā jāto yajñe dakṣaprajāpateḥ .
iti rāmānujaḥ śrutvā vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ . . 102
meaning:
भ्रष्टाचारस्तदा जातो यज्ञे दक्षप्रजापतेः .
इति रामानुजः श्रुत्वा वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः . . 102
text_mt:
became corrupt in his conduct at the sacrifice of Prajāpati Dakṣa."
Having heard this speech, Rāmānuja said with a humble mind:

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇe janito yajño viśvapālanahetave .
karmabrahmodbhavaṃ viddhi brahmākṣarasamudbhavam . . 103
meaning:
कर्मणे जनितो यज्ञो विश्वपालनहेतवे .
कर्मब्रह्मोद्भवं विद्धि ब्रह्माक्षरसमुद्भवम् . . 103
text_mt:
"Sacrifice was produced for action, for the purpose of preserving the universe.
Know that action arises from Brahman, and Brahman arises from the Imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣaro'yaṃ śivaḥ sākṣācchabdabrahmaṇi saṃsthitaḥ .
purāṇapuruṣo yajño jñeyo'kṣarakaro bhuvi . .
akṣarātsa tu vai śreṣṭhaḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ . . 104
meaning:
अक्षरोऽयं शिवः साक्षाच्छब्दब्रह्मणि संस्थितः .
पुराणपुरुषो यज्ञो ज्ञेयोऽक्षरकरो भुवि . .
अक्षरात्स तु वै श्रेष्ठः परमात्मा सनातनः . . 104
text_mt:
This Imperishable is Śiva directly, abiding in the Brahman of sound.
The ancient person, Sacrifice, should be known as the maker of the Imperishable on earth;

sanskrit_iast:
akṣareṇa na vai tṛptāttṛpto'bhūdyajñakarmaṇi .
nāmnā sa yajñapuruṣo vede loke hi viśrutaḥ . . 105
meaning:
अक्षरेण न वै तृप्तात्तृप्तोऽभूद्यज्ञकर्मणि .
नाम्ना स यज्ञपुरुषो वेदे लोके हि विश्रुतः . . 105
text_mt:
and the eternal supreme Self is superior to the Imperishable.
Since he was not satisfied with the Imperishable, he became satisfied in sacrificial activity;

sanskrit_iast:
prapautrasya tadā vṛddhiṃ dṛṣṭvā sparddhāturaḥ śivaḥ .
mṛgabhūtaśca rudro'sau divyabāṇairatarpayat . . 106
meaning:
प्रपौत्रस्य तदा वृद्धिं दृष्ट्वा स्पर्द्धातुरः शिवः .
मृगभूतश्च रुद्रोऽसौ दिव्यबाणैरतर्पयत् . . 106
text_mt:
he is renowned by name in the Veda and in the world as the Sacrifice-Person.
Then, seeing the growth of his great-grandson, Śiva, afflicted with jealousy,

sanskrit_iast:
samartho yajñapuruṣo jñātvā gurumayaṃ śivam .
palāyanaparo bhūto dharmastena mahānkṛtaḥ . . 107
meaning:
समर्थो यज्ञपुरुषो ज्ञात्वा गुरुमयं शिवम् .
पलायनपरो भूतो धर्मस्तेन महान्कृतः . . 107
text_mt:
and becoming a deer, that Rudra satisfied [him] with divine arrows.
The capable Sacrifice-Person, knowing Śiva to be made of his teacher,

sanskrit_iast:
lajjitaḥ śaṅkarācāryo nyāyaśāstre samāgataḥ .
bhavatīti bhavo jñeyo mṛḍatīti sa vai mṛḍaḥ . . 108
meaning:
लज्जितः शङ्कराचार्यो न्यायशास्त्रे समागतः .
भवतीति भवो ज्ञेयो मृडतीति स वै मृडः . . 108
text_mt:
became intent on fleeing; by him a great duty was performed."
Ashamed, Śaṅkarācārya resorted to the system of logic:

sanskrit_iast:
lokānbharati yo devaḥ sa kartā bharga eva hi .
haratīti haro jñeyaḥ sa rudraḥ pāparāvaṇaḥ . . 109
meaning:
लोकान्भरति यो देवः स कर्ता भर्ग एव हि .
हरतीति हरो ज्ञेयः स रुद्रः पापरावणः . . 109
text_mt: "He is to be known as Bhava because he comes into being; he is Mṛḍa because he shows mercy; / he is the creator Bharga because he supports the worlds; / he is to be known as Hara because he destroys; he is Rudra, the tearer away of sins;

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ kartā svayaṃ bharttā svayaṃ hartā śivaḥ svayam .
śivādviṣṇurmahīṃ yāto viṣṇorbrahmā ca padmabhūḥ . . 3.4.14.110
meaning:
स्वयं कर्ता स्वयं भर्त्ता स्वयं हर्ता शिवः स्वयम् .
शिवाद्विष्णुर्महीं यातो विष्णोर्ब्रह्मा च पद्मभूः . . 3.4.14.110
text_mt:
Śiva is himself the creator, himself the supporter, himself the destroyer.
From Śiva, Viṣṇu came to the earth, and from Viṣṇu, Brahmā, born from the lotus."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ prāha rāmānujastadā .
dhanyo'yaṃ bhagavācchambhuryasyāyaṃ mahimā paraḥ . . 111
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं प्राह रामानुजस्तदा .
धन्योऽयं भगवाच्छम्भुर्यस्यायं महिमा परः . . 111
text_mt:
Hearing that speech, Rāmānuja then said:
"Blessed is this Lord Śambhu, whose supreme majesty this is!

sanskrit_iast:
satyaṃ satyaṃ mamājñeyaṃ kartā kārayitā śivaḥ .
rāmanāma paraṃ nityaṃ kathaṃ śambhurjapeddharim . . 112
meaning:
सत्यं सत्यं ममाज्ञेयं कर्ता कारयिता शिवः .
रामनाम परं नित्यं कथं शम्भुर्जपेद्धरिम् . . 112
text_mt:
True, true; it is to be known by me that Śiva is the doer and the instigator.
[Yet] why does Śambhu constantly chant the supreme name of Rāma, [namely] Hari?

sanskrit_iast:
anantā sṛṣṭayaḥ sarvā udbhūtā yasya tejasā .
anantaḥ śeṣataḥ śeṣā 1ramante yogino hi tam . . 113
meaning:
अनन्ता सृष्टयः सर्वा उद्भूता यस्य तेजसा .
अनन्तः शेषतः शेषा 1रमन्ते योगिनो हि तम् . . 113
text_mt:
All creations, which are endless, arose by his splendour;
he is endless from Śeṣa, [and] remaining yogins delight in him.

sanskrit_iast:
sa ca vai matprabhordhāma saccidānandavigrahaḥ .
iti śrutvā tadā vākyaṃ lajjitaḥ śaṅkaro'bhavat . . 114
meaning:
स च वै मत्प्रभोर्धाम सच्चिदानन्दविग्रहः .
इति श्रुत्वा तदा वाक्यं लज्जितः शङ्करोऽभवत् . . 114
text_mt:
And he is the abode of my Lord, his form being being, consciousness, and bliss."
Hearing that statement then, Śaṅkara was ashamed.

sanskrit_iast:
yogaśāstra paro devaḥ kṛṣṇastenaiva darśitaḥ .
kālātmā bhagavānkṛṣṇo yogeśo yogatatparaḥ . . 115
meaning:
योगशास्त्र परो देवः कृष्णस्तेनैव दर्शितः .
कालात्मा भगवान्कृष्णो योगेशो योगतत्परः . . 115
text_mt:
By him was Kṛṣṇa shown as the supreme god of the system of Yoga:
Lord Kṛṣṇa, whose self is time, the lord of yoga, intent on yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
sāṅkhyaśāstre ca kapilastasmai tenaiva darśitaḥ .
kaṃ vīryaṃ pāti yo vai sa kapistaṃ caiva lāti yaḥ . .
kapilassa tu vijñeyaḥ kapī rudraḥ prakīrtitaḥ . . 116
meaning:
साङ्ख्यशास्त्रे च कपिलस्तस्मै तेनैव दर्शितः .
कं वीर्यं पाति यो वै स कपिस्तं चैव लाति यः . .
कपिलस्स तु विज्ञेयः कपी रुद्रः प्रकीर्तितः . . 116
text_mt:
And in the system of Sāṅkhya, Kapila was shown to him by him:
He who preserves the seed (ka) is kapi, and he who receives it / is to be known as Kapila; and Kapi is proclaimed as Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
kapilo bhagavānviṣṇuḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvarūpavān .
tadā tu śaṅkarācāryo lajjito namrakandharaḥ . . 117
meaning:
कपिलो भगवान्विष्णुः सर्वज्ञः सर्वरूपवान् .
तदा तु शङ्कराचार्यो लज्जितो नम्रकन्धरः . . 117
text_mt:
Kapila is the Lord Viṣṇu, omniscient and having all forms.
Then Śaṅkarācārya, ashamed, with his neck bowed down,

sanskrit_iast:
śuklāmbaradharo bhūtvā govindo nāma nirmalam .
jajāpa hṛdi śuddhātmā śiṣyo rāmānujasya vai . . 118
meaning:
शुक्लाम्बरधरो भूत्वा गोविन्दो नाम निर्मलम् .
जजाप हृदि शुद्धात्मा शिष्यो रामानुजस्य वै . . 118
text_mt:
wearing white garments, with a purified soul, chanted
the stainless name Govinda in his heart, becoming a disciple of Rāmānuja.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te rudramāhātmyaṃ prasaṅgenāpi varṇitam .
