ऊर्ध्वध्रुवे दिवा नित्यं तपोमध्ये निशा दिवा .. 58 ..
text_mt: In the lower Dhruva there is always night, and the dwellers of hell abide there; / in the upper Dhruva there is perpetual day, and within Tapas there is both night and day.

sanskrit_iast:
maho janastapassatyaṃ teṣu nityaṃ dinaṃ smṛtam ..
rauravaścāṃdhakūpaśca tāmisraṃ ca tamomayam ..
teṣu nityaṃ smṛtā rātriḥ kalpamānaṃ ca kovidaiḥ .. 59 ..
meaning:
महो जनस्तपस्सत्यं तेषु नित्यं दिनं स्मृतम् ..
रौरवश्चांधकूपश्च तामिस्रं च तमोमयम् ..
तेषु नित्यं स्मृता रात्रिः कल्पमानं च कोविदैः .. 59 ..
text_mt: In Mahas, Janas, Tapas, and Satya, there is traditionally perpetual day; / in Raurava, Andhakūpa, and Tāmisra full of darkness, / there is traditionally perpetual night, as the measure of a kalpa is understood by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tu pūrvabhave cāsīdbrāhmaṇo mādhavapriyaḥ ..
ṣaṣṭyabdaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu prātaḥsnānaṃ cakāra ha .. 3.4.17.60 ..
meaning:
स तु पूर्वभवे चासीद्ब्राह्मणो माधवप्रियः ..
षष्ट्यब्दं सर्वतीर्थेषु प्रातःस्नानं चकार ह .. 3.4.17.60 ..
text_mt: In a previous life, he was a brāhmaṇa dear to Mādhava; / for sixty years he took his morning bath in all the sacred fords.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrtha puṇyātsa vai vipro mādhavo mādhavapriyaḥ ..
sunītyāṃ garbhamāsādya dhruvo bhūtvā rarāja ha ..
ṣaṭtriṃśacca sahasrābdaṃ rājyaṃ kṛtvā dhruvo'bhavat .. 61 .. ..
meaning:
तीर्थ पुण्यात्स वै विप्रो माधवो माधवप्रियः ..
सुनीत्यां गर्भमासाद्य ध्रुवो भूत्वा रराज ह ..
षट्त्रिंशच्च सहस्राब्दं राज्यं कृत्वा ध्रुवोऽभवत् .. 61 .. ..
text_mt: By the merit of the sacred fords, that brāhmaṇa Mādhava, dear to Mādhava, / entered the womb of Sunīti, became Dhruva, and shone forth; / having ruled for thirty-six thousand years, he became [the pole-star] Dhruva.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
iti śrutvā gurorvākyaṃ sa dhruvaḥ paṃcamo vasuḥ ..
gurjare deśa āgamya vaiśyajātyāṃ samudbhavaḥ ..
naraśrīrnāma vikhyāto guṇavaiśyasya vai sutaḥ .. 62 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
इति श्रुत्वा गुरोर्वाक्यं स ध्रुवः पंचमो वसुः ..
गुर्जरे देश आगम्य वैश्यजात्यां समुद्भवः ..
नरश्रीर्नाम विख्यातो गुणवैश्यस्य वै सुतः .. 62 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Hearing this speech of the guru, that Dhruva, the fifth Vasu, / came to the Gurjara country and was born in the vaiśya caste, / famous by the name Naraśrī, the son of a virtuous vaiśya.

sanskrit_iast:
kusīdaguṇaguptaśca naraśrīḥ putravatsalaḥ ..
tyaktvā prāṇānyayau svargaṃ sa vaiśyatanayo dhruvaḥ .. 63 ..
meaning:
कुसीदगुणगुप्तश्च नरश्रीः पुत्रवत्सलः ..
त्यक्त्वा प्राणान्ययौ स्वर्गं स वैश्यतनयो ध्रुवः .. 63 ..
text_mt: Prudent in the ways of lending and loving toward his son, / that Dhruva, the son of a vaiśya named Naraśrī, gave up his life-breaths and went to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyahaṃ sa hareḥ krīḍāṃ vṛndāvanamahottame ..
śivaprasādātpratyakṣāṃ dṛṣṭvā harṣamavāptavān .. 64 ..
meaning:
प्रत्यहं स हरेः क्रीडां वृन्दावनमहोत्तमे ..
शिवप्रसादात्प्रत्यक्षां दृष्ट्वा हर्षमवाप्तवान् .. 64 ..
text_mt: By the grace of Śiva, he directly beheld every day / the sport of Hari in most excellent Vṛndāvana, and attained joy.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya putravivāhe ca bhagavānbhaktavatsalaḥ ..
yādavaissaha saṃprāptastasya vāṃchitadāyakaḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
यस्य पुत्रविवाहे च भगवान्भक्तवत्सलः ..
यादवैस्सह संप्राप्तस्तस्य वांछितदायकः .. 65 ..
text_mt: At the wedding of whose son, the Lord, compassionate to his devotees, / arrived along with the Yādavas, granting his desire.

sanskrit_iast:
purīṃ kāśīṃ samāgamya naraśrībharktarāṭ svayam ..
rāmānandasya śiṣyo'bhūdviṣṇudharma viśāradaḥ .. 66 ..
meaning:
पुरीं काशीं समागम्य नरश्रीभर्क्तराट् स्वयम् ..
रामानन्दस्य शिष्योऽभूद्विष्णुधर्म विशारदः .. 66 ..
text_mt: Having come to the city of Kāśī, Naraśrī, himself the king of devotees, / became a disciple of Rāmānanda, skilled in the dharma of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
.. bṛhaspatiruvāca .. ..
kadācidbhagavānatrirgaṃgākūle'nasūyayā ..
sārddhaṃ tapo mahatkurvanbrahmadhyānaparo'bhavat .. .. 67 ..
meaning:
.. बृहस्पतिरुवाच .. ..
कदाचिद्भगवानत्रिर्गंगाकूलेऽनसूयया ..
सार्द्धं तपो महत्कुर्वन्ब्रह्मध्यानपरोऽभवत् .. .. 67 ..
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / Once the venerable Atri, on the bank of the Gaṅgā, / performing great austerity together with Anasūyā, became devoted to meditating on Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā brahmā hariśśaṃbhuḥ svasvavāhanamāsthitāḥ ..
varaṃ brūhīti vacanaṃ tamāhuste sanātanāḥ .. 68 ..
meaning:
तदा ब्रह्मा हरिश्शंभुः स्वस्ववाहनमास्थिताः ..
वरं ब्रूहीति वचनं तमाहुस्ते सनातनाः .. 68 ..
text_mt: Then Brahmā, Hari, and Śambhu, mounted on their respective vehicles, / these eternal ones, spoke to him the words: 'Choose a boon!'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vaca steṣāṃ svayaṃbhūtanayo muniḥ ..
naiva kiñcidvacaḥ prāha saṃsthitaḥ paramātmani .. 69 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वच स्तेषां स्वयंभूतनयो मुनिः ..
नैव किञ्चिद्वचः प्राह संस्थितः परमात्मनि .. 69 ..
text_mt: Hearing their words, the sage, the son of the Self-born, / being established in the Supreme Self, spoke not a word.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya bhāvaṃ samālokya trayo devāḥ sanātanāḥ ..
anasūyāṃ tasya patnīṃ samāgamya vaco'bruvan ..3.4.17.70..
meaning:
तस्य भावं समालोक्य त्रयो देवाः सनातनाः ..
अनसूयां तस्य पत्नीं समागम्य वचोऽब्रुवन् ..3.4.17.70..
text_mt: Observing his state, the three eternal gods / approached his wife Anasūyā and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
liṃgahastaḥ svayaṃ rudro viṣṇustadrasavarddhanaḥ ..
brahmā kāmabrahmalopaḥ sthitastasyā vaśaṃ gataḥ ..
ratiṃ dehi madāghūrṇe no cetprāṇāṃstyajāmyaham .. 71 ..
meaning:
लिंगहस्तः स्वयं रुद्रो विष्णुस्तद्रसवर्द्धनः ..
ब्रह्मा कामब्रह्मलोपः स्थितस्तस्या वशं गतः ..
रतिं देहि मदाघूर्णे नो चेत्प्राणांस्त्यजाम्यहम् .. 71 ..
text_mt: Rudra himself with liṅga in hand, Viṣṇu intensifying that passion, / and Brahmā with the desire for Brahman abandoned, stood overcome by her: / 'Grant us sexual union, O woman reeling with passion! If not, I shall abandon my life-breaths.'

sanskrit_iast:
pativratā'nasūyā ca śrutvā teṣāṃ vaco'śubham ..
naiva kiṃcidvacaḥ prāha kopa bhītā surānprati .. 72 ..
meaning:
पतिव्रताऽनसूया च श्रुत्वा तेषां वचोऽशुभम् ..
नैव किंचिद्वचः प्राह कोप भीता सुरान्प्रति .. 72 ..
text_mt: Hearing their inauspicious words, the devoted wife Anasūyā, / fearful of her own wrath, spoke not a word to the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
mohitāstatra te devā gṛhītvā tāṃ balāttadā ..
maithunāya samudyogaṃ cakrurmāyāvimohitāḥ .. 73 ..
meaning:
मोहितास्तत्र ते देवा गृहीत्वा तां बलात्तदा ..
मैथुनाय समुद्योगं चक्रुर्मायाविमोहिताः .. 73 ..
text_mt: Bewildered there, those gods, seizing her by force then, / deluded by Māyā, made an effort to have intercourse.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā kruddhā satī sā vai tāñchaśāpa munipriyā ..
mama putrā bhaviṣyaṃti yūyaṃ kāmavimohitāḥ .. 74 ..
meaning:
तदा क्रुद्धा सती सा वै ताञ्छशाप मुनिप्रिया ..
मम पुत्रा भविष्यंति यूयं कामविमोहिताः .. 74 ..
text_mt: Then that chaste woman, the beloved of the sage, enraged, cursed them: / 'You who are deluded by lust shall become my sons!

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevasya vai liṃgaṃ brahmaṇo'sya mahāśiraḥ ..
caraṇau vāsudevasya pūjanīyā naraissadā ..
bhaviṣyaṃti suraśreṣṭhā upahāso'yamuttamaḥ .. 75 ..
meaning:
महादेवस्य वै लिंगं ब्रह्मणोऽस्य महाशिरः ..
चरणौ वासुदेवस्य पूजनीया नरैस्सदा ..
भविष्यंति सुरश्रेष्ठा उपहासोऽयमुत्तमः .. 75 ..
text_mt: The liṅga of Mahādeva, this great head of Brahmā, / and the feet of Vāsudeva are always to be worshipped by men, / O best of gods; this will be an excellent mockery!'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ namaskṛtya munipriyām ..
tuṣṭuvurbhaktinamrāśca devapāṭhaiśca ṛṅmayaiḥ ..76..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो घोरं नमस्कृत्य मुनिप्रियाम् ..
तुष्टुवुर्भक्तिनम्राश्च देवपाठैश्च ऋङ्मयैः ..76..
text_mt: Hearing these dreadful words, bowing down to the sage's beloved, / humble with devotion, they praised her with divine hymns composed of ṛcs.

sanskrit_iast:
anasūyā tadā prāha bhavanto mama putrakāḥ ..
bhūtvā śāpaṃ madīyaṃ ca tyaktvā tṛptimavāpsyatha ..77..
meaning:
अनसूया तदा प्राह भवन्तो मम पुत्रकाः ..
भूत्वा शापं मदीयं च त्यक्त्वा तृप्तिमवाप्स्यथ ..77..
text_mt: Then Anasūyā said: 'Becoming my little sons / and being freed from my curse, you will attain contentment.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityukte vacane brahmā caṃdramāśca tadā hyabhūt ..
dattātreyo hariḥ sākṣāddurvāsā bhagavānharaḥ ..
tatpāpaparihārārthaṃ yogavanto babhūvire .. 78 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्ते वचने ब्रह्मा चंद्रमाश्च तदा ह्यभूत् ..
दत्तात्रेयो हरिः साक्षाद्दुर्वासा भगवान्हरः ..
तत्पापपरिहारार्थं योगवन्तो बभूविरे .. 78 ..
text_mt: When these words were spoken, Brahmā then became the Moon, / Hari directly became Dattātreya, and the venerable Hara became Durvāsas; / in order to remove that sin, they became endowed with yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare devī prakṛtissarva dharmiṇī ..
vidhiṃ viṣṇuṃ haraṃ cānyaṃ cakre sā guṇarūpiṇī .. 79 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे देवी प्रकृतिस्सर्व धर्मिणी ..
विधिं विष्णुं हरं चान्यं चक्रे सा गुणरूपिणी .. 79 ..
text_mt: Meanwhile, the goddess Prakṛti, possessing all properties, / embodied in the guṇas, made another Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
manvaṃtaramato jātaṃ teṣāṃ yogaṃ prakurvatām ..
hṛṣitāśca trayo devāssamāgamya ca tānprati .. 3.4.17.80 ..
meaning:
मन्वंतरमतो जातं तेषां योगं प्रकुर्वताम् ..
हृषिताश्च त्रयो देवास्समागम्य च तान्प्रति .. 3.4.17.80 ..
text_mt: Then, as they practiced yoga, a Manvantara elapsed. / And the three delighted gods approached them

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca vacanaṃ ramyaṃ teṣāṃ maṃgalahetave ..
candramāśca bhavetsomo vasuḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ surapriyaḥ .. 81 ..
meaning:
उवाच वचनं रम्यं तेषां मंगलहेतवे ..
चन्द्रमाश्च भवेत्सोमो वसुः षष्ठः सुरप्रियः .. 81 ..
text_mt: and spoke pleasant words for their welfare: / 'May the Moon become Soma, the sixth Vasu, dear to the gods;

sanskrit_iast:
rudrāṃśaścaiva durvāsāḥ pratyūṣaḥ saptamo vasuḥ ..
dattātreyamayo yogī prabhāsaścāṣṭamo vasuḥ ..
teṣāṃ vākyaṃ samākarṇya vasavaste trayo'bhavan ..82..
meaning:
रुद्रांशश्चैव दुर्वासाः प्रत्यूषः सप्तमो वसुः ..
दत्तात्रेयमयो योगी प्रभासश्चाष्टमो वसुः ..
तेषां वाक्यं समाकर्ण्य वसवस्ते त्रयोऽभवन् ..82..
text_mt: and may Durvāsas, a portion of Rudra, become Pratyūṣa, the seventh Vasu; / and may the yogin who is Dattātreya become Prabhāsa, the eighth Vasu.' / Hearing their words, those three became Vasus.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
iti śrutvā gurorvākyaṃ vasavo harṣitāstrayaḥ ..
svāṃśena bhūtalaṃ jagmuḥ kaliśuddhāya dāruṇe ..
dākṣiṇātye rājagṛhe vaiśyajātyāṃ samudbhavaḥ .. 83 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
इति श्रुत्वा गुरोर्वाक्यं वसवो हर्षितास्त्रयः ..
स्वांशेन भूतलं जग्मुः कलिशुद्धाय दारुणे ..
दाक्षिणात्ये राजगृहे वैश्यजात्यां समुद्भवः .. 83 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having heard the words of the guru thus, the three delighted Vasus / went with their own portions to the earth to purify the terrible Kali age. / In the south, an incarnation occurred in a royal house, in the vaiśya class:

sanskrit_iast:
pīpā nāma sutaḥ somaḥ sudevasya tadā hyabhūt ..
kṛtaṃ rājyapadaṃ tena yathā bhūpena tatpure .. 84..
meaning:
पीपा नाम सुतः सोमः सुदेवस्य तदा ह्यभूत् ..
कृतं राज्यपदं तेन यथा भूपेन तत्पुरे .. 84..
text_mt: Soma became the son of Sudeva named Pīpā; / the rank of royalty was maintained by him as king in that city.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmānandasya śiṣyo'bhūddvārakāṃ sa samāgataḥ ..
harermudrāṃ svarṇamayīṃ prāpya kṛṣṇātsa vai nṛpaḥ ..
vaiṣṇavebhyo dadau tatra pretatattvavināśinīm .. 85 ..
meaning:
रामानन्दस्य शिष्योऽभूद्द्वारकां स समागतः ..
हरेर्मुद्रां स्वर्णमयीं प्राप्य कृष्णात्स वै नृपः ..
वैष्णवेभ्यो ददौ तत्र प्रेततत्त्वविनाशिनीम् .. 85 ..
text_mt: He became a disciple of Rāmānanda and went to Dvārakā. / Having obtained the golden seal of Hari from Kṛṣṇa, that king / gave it there to the Vaiṣṇavas, destroying the nature of pretas.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyūṣaścaiva pāṃcāle vaiśyajātyāṃ samudbhavaḥ ..
mārgapālasya tanayo nānako nāma viśrutaḥ .. 86 ..
meaning:
प्रत्यूषश्चैव पांचाले वैश्यजात्यां समुद्भवः ..
मार्गपालस्य तनयो नानको नाम विश्रुतः .. 86 ..
text_mt: And Pratyūṣa was born in Pāñcāla in the vaiśya class / as the son of Mārgapāla, renowned by the name Nānaka.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmānandaṃ samāgamya śiṣyo bhūtvā sa nānakaḥ ..
sa vai mlecchānvaśīkṛtya sūkṣmamārgamadarśayat .. 87 ..
meaning:
रामानन्दं समागम्य शिष्यो भूत्वा स नानकः ..
स वै म्लेच्छान्वशीकृत्य सूक्ष्ममार्गमदर्शयत् .. 87 ..
text_mt: Approaching Rāmānanda, that Nānaka became his disciple; / having subdued the mlecchas, he showed the subtle path.

sanskrit_iast:
prabhāso vai śāṃtipure brahmajātyāṃ samudbhavaḥ ..
śukladattasya tanayo nityānaṃda iti smṛtaḥ ..
iti te vasumāhātmyaṃ mayā śaunaka varṇitam .. 88 ..
atri śabdopari ṭippaṇī
meaning:
प्रभासो वै शांतिपुरे ब्रह्मजात्यां समुद्भवः ..
शुक्लदत्तस्य तनयो नित्यानंद इति स्मृतः ..
इति ते वसुमाहात्म्यं मया शौनक वर्णितम् .. 88 ..
अत्रि शब्दोपरि टिप्पणी
text_mt:
Prabhāsa was born in Śāntipura in the brāhmaṇa class, / the son of Śukladatta, known as Nityānanda. / Thus the greatness of the Vasus has been described to you by me, O Śaunaka.
Note on the word Atri.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ityuktvā tānsurāndevo bhagavānbṛhatāṃpatiḥ ..
aśvinau ca samālokya tayorgāthāmavarṇayat .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्त्वा तान्सुरान्देवो भगवान्बृहतांपतिः ..
अश्विनौ च समालोक्य तयोर्गाथामवर्णयत् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having spoken thus to those gods, the lord, the master of speech, / looked at the two Aśvins and described their story:
title: adhyāyaḥ 18

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvate'ntare pūrvaṃ viśvakarmā vicitrakṛt ..
citraguptaśriyaṃ dṛṣṭvā citralekhāvinirmitām ..
sparddhābhūto mahāmāyāṃ tuṣṭāva bahupūjanaiḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे पूर्वं विश्वकर्मा विचित्रकृत् ..
चित्रगुप्तश्रियं दृष्ट्वा चित्रलेखाविनिर्मिताम् ..
स्पर्द्धाभूतो महामायां तुष्टाव बहुपूजनैः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Formerly, in the Vaivasvata interval, Viśvakarman, the creator of wonders, / seeing the glory of Citragupta crafted by Citralekhā, / felt rivalry and praised Mahāmāyā with many worships.

sanskrit_iast:
prasannā sā tadā devī citrāyāṃ tasya yoṣiti ..
svāṃśājjātā smṛtā saṃjñā sarvajñānakarī svayam .. 3 ..
meaning:
प्रसन्ना सा तदा देवी चित्रायां तस्य योषिति ..
स्वांशाज्जाता स्मृता संज्ञा सर्वज्ञानकरी स्वयम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Then that pleased goddess was born from her own portion in his wife Citrā; / she is known as Saṃjñā, who herself produces all knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśābde vayaḥ prāpte saṃjñāyāstatpitā sukhī ..
vivāhārthī surānsarvānāhvayanmerumūrddhani .. 4 ..
meaning:
षोडशाब्दे वयः प्राप्ते संज्ञायास्तत्पिता सुखी ..
विवाहार्थी सुरान्सर्वानाह्वयन्मेरुमूर्द्धनि .. 4 ..
text_mt: When Saṃjñā reached sixteen years of age, her joyful father, / desiring her marriage, summoned all the gods to the peak of Mount Meru.

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣādhīśāśca ṣaḍviṃśatkuberādyāssamāgatāḥ ..
yādasāṃ patayaḥ prāptā daśa tatraiva kāmukāḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
यक्षाधीशाश्च षड्विंशत्कुबेराद्यास्समागताः ..
यादसां पतयः प्राप्ता दश तत्रैव कामुकाः .. 5 ..
text_mt: Twenty-six lords of yakṣas, Kubera and others, arrived; / ten lustful lords of aquatic creatures arrived right there;

sanskrit_iast:
pāvakā ūnapaṃcāśadvāyavaśca tathā smṛtāḥ ..
dhruvau dvau ca svayaṃ prāptau somāstatraiva ṣoḍaśa ..6..
meaning:
पावका ऊनपंचाशद्वायवश्च तथा स्मृताः ..
ध्रुवौ द्वौ च स्वयं प्राप्तौ सोमास्तत्रैव षोडश ..6..
text_mt: forty-nine fires, and likewise the winds, are recorded; / two Dhruvas arrived in person, and right there sixteen Somas;

sanskrit_iast:
trayodaśa ca pratyūṣāḥ prāptā viśvaprarakṣakāḥ ..
ṣaṣṭyuttaraṃ ca triśataṃ prabhāsā dinarakṣakāḥ ..7 ..
meaning:
त्रयोदश च प्रत्यूषाः प्राप्ता विश्वप्ररक्षकाः ..
षष्ट्युत्तरं च त्रिशतं प्रभासा दिनरक्षकाः ..7 ..
text_mt: thirteen Pratyūṣas arrived, protectors of the universe; / three hundred and sixty Prabhāsas, protectors of the day;

sanskrit_iast:
bhavādyāśca tadāḥ rudrāḥ śaśimaṇḍalarakṣakāḥ ..
ādityāśca sthitāssarve saṃjñāyāśca svayaṃvare .. 8 ..
meaning:
भवाद्याश्च तदाः रुद्राः शशिमण्डलरक्षकाः ..
आदित्याश्च स्थितास्सर्वे संज्ञायाश्च स्वयंवरे .. 8 ..
text_mt: Bhava and the other Rudras, protectors of the lunar disc; / and all the Ādityas stood at the svayaṃvara of Saṃjñā.

sanskrit_iast:
dānavā vipracittyādyāścaturāśītirāyayuḥ ..
prahlādādyāstadā daityā vāsukyādyāśca pannagāḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
दानवा विप्रचित्त्याद्याश्चतुराशीतिराययुः ..
प्रह्लादाद्यास्तदा दैत्या वासुक्याद्याश्च पन्नगाः .. 9 ..
text_mt: Eighty-four Dānavas, Vipracitti and others, arrived; / then Daityas such as Prahlāda, and snakes such as Vāsuki;

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣādyāśca tadā nāgāstārkṣyādyā garuḍāḥ smṛtāḥ ..
sarve svayaṃvare prāptā mahākolāhalohyabhūt .. 3.4.18.10 ..
meaning:
शेषाद्याश्च तदा नागास्तार्क्ष्याद्या गरुडाः स्मृताः ..
सर्वे स्वयंवरे प्राप्ता महाकोलाहलोह्यभूत् .. 3.4.18.10 ..
text_mt: the nāgas such as Śeṣa, and the Garuḍas such as Tārkṣya are mentioned; / all arrived at the svayaṃvara, and a great uproar arose.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnaṃtare devī devakanyāsamanvitā ..
saṃjñā devānprati tadā pratyakṣamabhavaddivi .. 11 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे देवी देवकन्यासमन्विता ..
संज्ञा देवान्प्रति तदा प्रत्यक्षमभवद्दिवि .. 11 ..
text_mt: At that moment, the goddess Saṃjñā, accompanied by divine maidens, / became visible before the gods in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ samālokya balavānbaliḥ kāmavimohitaḥ ..
kare gṛhītvā prayayau paśyatāṃ sarvadhanvinām .. 12 ..
meaning:
तां समालोक्य बलवान्बलिः कामविमोहितः ..
करे गृहीत्वा प्रययौ पश्यतां सर्वधन्विनाम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Seeing her, the mighty Bali, infatuated with desire, / seized her by the hand and went away before the eyes of all the archers.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā krodhāturā devā rurudhurdaityasattamam ..
śastrāstraistarpayitvā taṃ mahadyuddhamakārayan .. 13 ..
meaning:
तदा क्रोधातुरा देवा रुरुधुर्दैत्यसत्तमम् ..
शस्त्रास्त्रैस्तर्पयित्वा तं महद्युद्धमकारयन् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Then the gods, overcome with anger, obstructed that best of Daityas; / gratifying him with weapons and missiles, they fought a great battle.

sanskrit_iast:
dānavāśca tadā daityā nānāvāhanasaṃsthitāḥ ..
devaiḥ sārddhaṃ mahadyuddhaṃ tumulaṃ cakrire mudā .. 14 ..
meaning:
दानवाश्च तदा दैत्या नानावाहनसंस्थिताः ..
देवैः सार्द्धं महद्युद्धं तुमुलं चक्रिरे मुदा .. 14 ..
text_mt: Then the Dānavas and Daityas, mounted on various vehicles, / gladly fought a great, tumultuous battle alongside the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
dānavaiśca hatā devāḥ surairdaityā vināśitāḥ ..
śavabhūtairilāvarte'bhūdagamyā vasuṃdharā .. 15 ..
meaning:
दानवैश्च हता देवाः सुरैर्दैत्या विनाशिताः ..
शवभूतैरिलावर्तेऽभूदगम्या वसुंधरा .. 15 ..
text_mt: Gods were killed by the Dānavas, and Daityas were destroyed by the gods; / filled with corpses in Ilāvarta, the earth became impassable.

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣamātra mabhūdyuddhaṃ divyaṃ dānavadevayoḥ ..
pāṃcajanyastathā dhātā hayagrīvaśca mitrakaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
पक्षमात्र मभूद्युद्धं दिव्यं दानवदेवयोः ..
पांचजन्यस्तथा धाता हयग्रीवश्च मित्रकः .. 16 ..
text_mt: The heavenly battle between the Dānavas and the gods lasted for a fortnight: / Pāñcajanya and Dhātṛ, Hayagrīva and Mitra,

sanskrit_iast:
aghāsuro'ryamā caiva balaḥ śakrastathaiva ca ..
bakāsuraśca varuṇaḥ śakaṭaḥ prāṃśureva ca .. 17 ..
meaning:
अघासुरोऽर्यमा चैव बलः शक्रस्तथैव च ..
बकासुरश्च वरुणः शकटः प्रांशुरेव च .. 17 ..
text_mt: Aghāsura and Aryaman, and likewise Bala and Śakra, / Bakāsura and Varuṇa, Śakaṭa and Prāṃśu,

sanskrit_iast:
vatsāsuro bhagaścaiva vivasvāṃśca baliḥ svayam ..
pralaṃbaśca tathā pūṣā gardabhaḥ savitā yudhi ..18..
meaning:
वत्सासुरो भगश्चैव विवस्वांश्च बलिः स्वयम् ..
प्रलंबश्च तथा पूषा गर्दभः सविता युधि ..18..
text_mt: Vatsāsura and Bhaga, and Vivasvat and Bali himself, / Pralamba and Pūṣan, Gardabha and Savitṛ in battle,

sanskrit_iast:
viśvakarmā mayaścaiva kālanemirhariḥ svayam ..
kāṃkṣamāṇau ca vijayaṃ yuyudhāte parasparam ..
parājitāśca te daityā yuddhaṃ tyaktvā pradudruvuḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
विश्वकर्मा मयश्चैव कालनेमिर्हरिः स्वयम् ..
कांक्षमाणौ च विजयं युयुधाते परस्परम् ..
पराजिताश्च ते दैत्या युद्धं त्यक्त्वा प्रदुद्रुवुः .. 19 ..
text_mt: Viśvakarman and Maya, and Kālanemi and Hari himself— / desiring victory, they fought one another. / And defeated, those Daityas abandoned the battle and fled.

sanskrit_iast:
vivasvām̐śca tadā saṃjñāṃ gṛhītvā rathasaṃsthitām ..
viśvakarmāṇamāgamya dadau tasmai prasannadhīḥ .. 3.4.18.20 ..
meaning:
विवस्वाम्̐श्च तदा संज्ञां गृहीत्वा रथसंस्थिताम् ..
विश्वकर्माणमागम्य ददौ तस्मै प्रसन्नधीः .. 3.4.18.20 ..
text_mt: Then Vivasvat, having taken Saṃjñā standing in the chariot, / approached Viśvakarman and gave her to him with a pleased mind.

sanskrit_iast:
vivasvaṃtaṃ suraśreṣṭhaṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃjñā vaco'bravīt ..
matpatiśca bhavāndevo bhavetkāryakarassadā .. 21 ..
meaning:
विवस्वंतं सुरश्रेष्ठं दृष्ट्वा संज्ञा वचोऽब्रवीत् ..
मत्पतिश्च भवान्देवो भवेत्कार्यकरस्सदा .. 21 ..
text_mt: Seeing Vivasvat, the best of the gods, Saṃjñā spoke these words: / 'May you, O god, be my husband, always doing what is needed.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā jitāhaṃ bhagavanbalervipriyakāriṇaḥ ..
bhrātṛjāgrahaṇe doṣo na bhavetsa kadācana .. 22 ..
meaning:
त्वया जिताहं भगवन्बलेर्विप्रियकारिणः ..
भ्रातृजाग्रहणे दोषो न भवेत्स कदाचन .. 22 ..
text_mt: I was won by you, O lord, from Bali who does unwelcome deeds; / in taking a brother’s daughter, there can never be any fault.

sanskrit_iast:
vīrabhuktā sadā nārī strīratnaṃ munibhiḥ smṛtam ..
caturddhā prakṛtirdevī guṇabhinnā guṇaikikā ..
ekā sā prakṛtirmātā guṇasāmyātsanātanī .. 23 ..
meaning:
वीरभुक्ता सदा नारी स्त्रीरत्नं मुनिभिः स्मृतम् ..
चतुर्द्धा प्रकृतिर्देवी गुणभिन्ना गुणैकिका ..
एका सा प्रकृतिर्माता गुणसाम्यात्सनातनी .. 23 ..
text_mt: A woman enjoyed by a hero is always considered a gem among women by the sages. / The goddess Prakṛti is fourfold, differentiated by guṇas or united with each guṇa; / through the equilibrium of the guṇas, that eternal Prakṛti is one, the Mother.

sanskrit_iast:
sattvabhūtā ca bhagi nī rajobhūtā ca gehinī ..
tamobhūtā ca sā kanyā tasyai devyai namonamaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
सत्त्वभूता च भगि नी रजोभूता च गेहिनी ..
तमोभूता च सा कन्या तस्यै देव्यै नमोनमः .. 24 ..
text_mt: Embodying sattva, she is the sister; embodying rajas, she is the wife; / and embodying tamas, she is the maiden. Reverence, reverence to that goddess!

sanskrit_iast:
bahavaḥ puruṣā ye vai nirguṇāścaikarūpiṇaḥ ..
caitanyā'jñānavaṃtaśca loke prakṛtisaṃbhavāḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
बहवः पुरुषा ये वै निर्गुणाश्चैकरूपिणः ..
चैतन्याऽज्ञानवंतश्च लोके प्रकृतिसंभवाः .. 25 ..
text_mt: The many puruṣas, who are without attributes and uniform, / conscious and ignorant, are born of Prakṛti in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
aloke pāpajāssarve devabrahmasamudbhavāḥ ..
yā tu jñānamayī nārī vṛṇedyaṃ puruṣaṃ śubham ..
ko'pi putraḥ pitā bhrātā sa ca tasyāḥ patirbhavet .. 26 ..
meaning:
अलोके पापजास्सर्वे देवब्रह्मसमुद्भवाः ..
या तु ज्ञानमयी नारी वृणेद्यं पुरुषं शुभम् ..
कोऽपि पुत्रः पिता भ्राता स च तस्याः पतिर्भवेत् .. 26 ..
text_mt: In the unworldly, all born of sin arise from gods and Brahmā. / But whichever auspicious man a woman made of knowledge chooses, / be he a son, father, or brother, he becomes her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
svakīyāṃ ca sutāṃ brahmā viṣṇudevaḥ svamātaram ..
bhaginīṃ bhagavāñchaṃbhurgṛhītvā śreṣṭhatāmagāt .. 27 ..
meaning:
स्वकीयां च सुतां ब्रह्मा विष्णुदेवः स्वमातरम् ..
भगिनीं भगवाञ्छंभुर्गृहीत्वा श्रेष्ठतामगात् .. 27 ..
text_mt: Taking his own daughter, Brahmā, taking his mother, Lord Viṣṇu, / and taking his sister, Lord Śambhu attained preeminence.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vedamayaṃ vākyaṃ cāditisaṃbhavaḥ ..
vivasvānbhrātṛjāṃ saṃjñāṃ gṛhītvā śreṣṭhavānabhūt .. 28 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वेदमयं वाक्यं चादितिसंभवः ..
विवस्वान्भ्रातृजां संज्ञां गृहीत्वा श्रेष्ठवानभूत् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Hearing this speech filled with the Veda, the son of Aditi, / Vivasvat, took his brother's daughter Saṃjñā and attained preeminence.

sanskrit_iast:
sutāḥ kanyāstayorjātā manurvaivasvatastathā ..
yamaśca yamunā caiva divyatejobhiranvitāḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
सुताः कन्यास्तयोर्जाता मनुर्वैवस्वतस्तथा ..
यमश्च यमुना चैव दिव्यतेजोभिरन्विताः .. 29 ..
text_mt: Sons and a daughter were born to the two: Manu Vaivasvata, / and Yama, and Yamunā, endowed with divine splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā saṃjñā satī sākṣāttejobhūtaṃ patiṃ svakam ..
jñātvā chāyāṃ samutpādya tapase vanamā gatā .. 3.4.18.30 ..
meaning:
तदा संज्ञा सती साक्षात्तेजोभूतं पतिं स्वकम् ..
ज्ञात्वा छायां समुत्पाद्य तपसे वनमा गता .. 3.4.18.30 ..
text_mt: Then the virtuous Saṃjñā, realising directly that her husband was made of fiery energy, / created Chāyā and went to the forest to perform austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
sāvarṇiśca manustasyāṃ śaniśca tapatī tathā ..
chāyāyāṃ ca samudbhūtāḥ kūradṛṣṭyā vivasvataḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
सावर्णिश्च मनुस्तस्यां शनिश्च तपती तथा ..
छायायां च समुद्भूताः कूरदृष्ट्या विवस्वतः .. 31 ..
text_mt: And through Chāyā were born Manu Sāvarṇi, / and Śani, and Tapatī, under the harsh gaze of Vivasvat.

sanskrit_iast:
putrabhedena tāṃ nārīṃ matvā māyāṃ ruṣānvitaḥ ..
cakāra bhasmabhūtāṃ tāṃ vivasvānbhagavānraviḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
पुत्रभेदेन तां नारीं मत्वा मायां रुषान्वितः ..
चकार भस्मभूतां तां विवस्वान्भगवान्रविः .. 32 ..
text_mt: Considering that woman an illusion because of the difference between the sons, filled with rage, / the blessed Sun, Vivasvat, reduced her to ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā śaniśca sāvarṇirvivasvataṃ ruṣānvitam ..
jñātvā ca krodhatāmrākṣau yuyudhāte parasparam .. 33 ..
meaning:
तदा शनिश्च सावर्णिर्विवस्वतं रुषान्वितम् ..
ज्ञात्वा च क्रोधताम्राक्षौ युयुधाते परस्परम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: Then Śani and Sāvarṇi, seeing Vivasvat filled with rage, / with eyes red with fury, fought against each other.

sanskrit_iast:
kiyato caiva kālena bhagnabhūtau vivasvatā ..
himācale girau prāpya tepatuḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
कियतो चैव कालेन भग्नभूतौ विवस्वता ..
हिमाचले गिरौ प्राप्य तेपतुः परमं तपः .. 34 ..
text_mt: And after some time, having been defeated by Vivasvat, / they reached the Himālaya mountain and performed supreme austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
trivarṣānte ca sā devī mahākālī samāgatā..
arcitaṃ ca varaṃ tābhyāṃ dadau tadbhaktivatsalā ..35..
meaning:
त्रिवर्षान्ते च सा देवी महाकाली समागता..
अर्चितं च वरं ताभ्यां ददौ तद्भक्तिवत्सला ..35..
text_mt: At the end of three years, that goddess Mahākālī arrived; / affectionate toward her devotees, she granted the boon requested by the two.

sanskrit_iast:
punastau ca samāgamya yuyudhāte vivasvatā..
vivasvānbhayabhītaśca tyaktvā yuddhaṃ parābhavat .. 36 ..
meaning:
पुनस्तौ च समागम्य युयुधाते विवस्वता..
विवस्वान्भयभीतश्च त्यक्त्वा युद्धं पराभवत् .. 36 ..
text_mt: Returning again, the two fought with Vivasvat; / terrified, Vivasvat abandoned the fight and suffered defeat.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra sthitā priyā saṃjñā vaḍavārūpadhariṇī ..
kurukhaṃḍe mahāramye tapaṃtī tapa ulbaṇam .. 37 ..
meaning:
तत्र स्थिता प्रिया संज्ञा वडवारूपधरिणी ..
कुरुखंडे महारम्ये तपंती तप उल्बणम् .. 37 ..
text_mt: His beloved Saṃjñā was staying there, having assumed the form of a mare, / performing severe austerities in the delightful region of Kurukṣetra.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā dadarśa bhagavānsajñāṃ saṃbodhakāriṇīm ..
kāmāturo hayo bhūtvā tatra reme tayā saha .. 38 ..
meaning:
गत्वा ददर्श भगवान्सज्ञां संबोधकारिणीम् ..
कामातुरो हयो भूत्वा तत्र रेमे तया सह .. 38 ..
text_mt: Going there, the Lord saw Saṃjñā, who brought enlightenment; / stricken with passion, he became a horse and sported with her there.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcavarṣāntare saṃjñā garbhaṃ tasmāddadhau svayam ..
tanayau ca samudbhūtau divya rūpaparākramau .. 39 ..
meaning:
पंचवर्षान्तरे संज्ञा गर्भं तस्माद्दधौ स्वयम् ..
तनयौ च समुद्भूतौ दिव्य रूपपराक्रमौ .. 39 ..
text_mt: At the end of five years, Saṃjñā herself conceived from him; / and two sons were born, possessed of divine beauty and prowess.

sanskrit_iast:
piturduḥkhaṃ samālokya jagmatū ravimaṇḍalam ..
jitvā baṃdhū durācārau krūradṛṣṭyā tadā svayam .. 3.4.18.40 ..
meaning:
पितुर्दुःखं समालोक्य जग्मतू रविमण्डलम् ..
जित्वा बंधू दुराचारौ क्रूरदृष्ट्या तदा स्वयम् .. 3.4.18.40 ..
text_mt: Seeing their father's distress, they went to the orb of the Sun; / having defeated the two wicked brothers then by their fierce glance,

sanskrit_iast:
baddhvā tau svapituḥ pārśvama saṃprāptau vaḍavāsutau ..
dṛṣṭvā vivasvānbhagavānvairiṇau samupāgatau .. 41 ..
meaning:
बद्ध्वा तौ स्वपितुः पार्श्वम संप्राप्तौ वडवासुतौ ..
दृष्ट्वा विवस्वान्भगवान्वैरिणौ समुपागतौ .. 41 ..
text_mt: and binding the two, the sons of the mare brought them to their father's presence. / Seeing his two enemies arrived, the blessed Vivasvat

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpīḍya tāḍayāmāsa lohadaṃḍairbhayānakaiḥ ..
paṃgubhūtau punastyaktvā chāyāputrau divākaraḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
संपीड्य ताडयामास लोहदंडैर्भयानकैः ..
पंगुभूतौ पुनस्त्यक्त्वा छायापुत्रौ दिवाकरः .. 42 ..
text_mt: tormented them and struck them with terrifying iron rods. / Having rendered the two sons of Chāyā lame, the Sun-god dismissed them.

sanskrit_iast:
āśvineyau samālokya vacanaṃ prāha tau mudā ..
jīva īśo yathā mitre naranārāyaṇau yathā..
ekanāmnā yuvāṃ prītau nāsatyau ca bhaviṣyathaḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
आश्विनेयौ समालोक्य वचनं प्राह तौ मुदा ..
जीव ईशो यथा मित्रे नरनारायणौ यथा..
एकनाम्ना युवां प्रीतौ नासत्यौ च भविष्यथः .. 43 ..
text_mt: Looking at the two sons of Aśvinī, he gladly spoke these words: / 'Just as the individual soul and God are friends, just as Nara and Nārāyaṇa are, / so you two, affectionate, shall be known by a single name as the Nāsatyas.

sanskrit_iast:
somaśaktiriḍādevī jyeṣṭhapatnī bhaviṣyati ..
piṃgalā sūryaśaktiśca laghupatnī bhaviṣyati .. 44 ..
meaning:
सोमशक्तिरिडादेवी ज्येष्ठपत्नी भविष्यति ..
पिंगला सूर्यशक्तिश्च लघुपत्नी भविष्यति .. 44 ..
text_mt: Goddess Iḍā, the lunar power, will be the elder wife; / and Piṅgalā, the solar power, will be the younger wife.

sanskrit_iast:
iḍāpatissa vai nāma dvitīyaḥ piṃgalāpatiḥ ..
dvādaśassa nṛṇāṃ rāśeḥ krūradṛṣṭiḥ śanaiścaraḥ ..
tasya śāntikaro jyeṣṭho bhaviṣyati mahītale .. 45 ..
meaning:
इडापतिस्स वै नाम द्वितीयः पिंगलापतिः ..
द्वादशस्स नृणां राशेः क्रूरदृष्टिः शनैश्चरः ..
तस्य शान्तिकरो ज्येष्ठो भविष्यति महीतले .. 45 ..
text_mt: One shall indeed be named Iḍāpati, and the second Piṅgalāpati. / Saturn of cruel gaze is in the twelfth sign of men; / the elder one will be his pacifier on the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyaśca nṛṇāṃ rāśeḥ sāvarṇirbhramakārakaḥ ..
tasya śāntikaro bhūmau bhavitā piṃgalāpatiḥ .. 46..
meaning:
द्वितीयश्च नृणां राशेः सावर्णिर्भ्रमकारकः ..
तस्य शान्तिकरो भूमौ भविता पिंगलापतिः .. 46..
text_mt: And Sāvarṇi, the cause of delusion, is in the second sign of men; / Piṅgalāpati will be his pacifier on earth.

sanskrit_iast:
janmarāśisthitā devī tapatī tā pakāriṇī ..
iḍā ca piṃgalā tasyāḥ śāntikartryau bhaviṣyataḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
जन्मराशिस्थिता देवी तपती ता पकारिणी ..
इडा च पिंगला तस्याः शान्तिकर्त्र्यौ भविष्यतः .. 47 ..
text_mt: Goddess Tapatī, residing in the birth sign, causes burning; / Iḍā and Piṅgalā will both become her pacifiers.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vacastasya suravaidyau babhūvatuḥ ..
sāvarṇiśca śanī rāhuḥ ketuḥ svargapratāpanaḥ ..
teṣāṃ tu parihārārthau dasrau cāśvinisaṃbhavau .. 48 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य सुरवैद्यौ बभूवतुः ..
सावर्णिश्च शनी राहुः केतुः स्वर्गप्रतापनः ..
तेषां तु परिहारार्थौ दस्रौ चाश्विनिसंभवौ .. 48 ..
text_mt: Having heard his words, the two became physicians to the gods. / To counter Sāvarṇi, Śani, Rāhu, and Ketu who torments heaven, / the Dasras were born of Aśvinī.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca ..
iti śrutvā gurorvākyaṃ prasannau surasattamau ..
svāṃśānmahītale jātau śūdrayonyāṃ ravestutau .. 49 ..
meaning:
सूत उवाच ..
इति श्रुत्वा गुरोर्वाक्यं प्रसन्नौ सुरसत्तमौ ..
स्वांशान्महीतले जातौ शूद्रयोन्यां रवेस्तुतौ .. 49 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Hearing thus the words of their father, the two best of gods were pleased. / By their own portions, the two sons of the Sun were born on earth in the womb of Śūdras.

sanskrit_iast:
cāṇḍālasya gṛhe jātaśchāgahaṃturiḍāpatiḥ ..
sadhano nāma vikhyātaḥ pitṛmātṛparāyaṇaḥ .. 3.4.18.50 ..
meaning:
चाण्डालस्य गृहे जातश्छागहंतुरिडापतिः ..
सधनो नाम विख्यातः पितृमातृपरायणः .. 3.4.18.50 ..
text_mt: Iḍāpati was born in the house of an outcaste, a slaughterer of goats; / renowned by the name Sadhana, devoted to his parents,

sanskrit_iast:
śāligrāmaśilātulyaṃ chāgamāṃsaṃ vicikriye ..
kabīraṃ samupāgamya śiṣyo bhūtvā rarāja vai.. 51 ..
meaning:
शालिग्रामशिलातुल्यं छागमांसं विचिक्रिये ..
कबीरं समुपागम्य शिष्यो भूत्वा रराज वै.. 51 ..
text_mt: he sold goat meat [weighed] equal to the Śāligrāma stone. / Approaching Kabīra, he became his disciple and shone forth.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tu satyanidhiḥ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇastapa āsthitaḥ..
bhayabhītāṃ ca gāṃ tatra cāṇḍālāya hyadarśayat ..
rājagehe karastasmātsadhanasya layaṃ gataḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
स तु सत्यनिधिः पूर्वं ब्रह्मणस्तप आस्थितः..
भयभीतां च गां तत्र चाण्डालाय ह्यदर्शयत् ..
राजगेहे करस्तस्मात्सधनस्य लयं गतः .. 52 ..
text_mt: He had formerly been Satyanidhi, engaged in the asceticism of Brahmā; / there he had pointed out a terrified cow to an outcaste, / and therefore in the royal palace Sadhana's hand was cut off.

sanskrit_iast:
carmakāragṛhe jāto dvitīyaḥ piṃgalāpatiḥ ..
mānadā sasya tanayo raidāsa iti viśrutaḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
चर्मकारगृहे जातो द्वितीयः पिंगलापतिः ..
मानदा सस्य तनयो रैदास इति विश्रुतः .. 53 ..
text_mt: The second, Piṅgalāpati, was born in the house of a leather-worker; / the son of Mānadāsa, renowned as Raidāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
purīṃ kāśīṃ samāgamya kabīraṃ rāmatatparam ..
jitvā matavivādena śaṃkarācāryamāgataḥ ..54 ..
meaning:
पुरीं काशीं समागम्य कबीरं रामतत्परम् ..
जित्वा मतविवादेन शंकराचार्यमागतः ..54 ..
text_mt: Going to the city of Kāśī, he defeated Kabīra, who was devoted to Rāma, / in a doctrinal dispute, and then went to Śaṅkarācārya.

sanskrit_iast:
tayorvivādo sabhavadahorātraṃ matāntare ..
parājitassa raidāso natvā taṃ dvijasattamam ..
rāmānandamupāgamya tasya śiṣyatvamāgataḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
तयोर्विवादो सभवदहोरात्रं मतान्तरे ..
पराजितस्स रैदासो नत्वा तं द्विजसत्तमम् ..
रामानन्दमुपागम्य तस्य शिष्यत्वमागतः .. 55 ..
text_mt: A debate on differing doctrines took place between the two day and night. / Defeated, Raidāsa bowed to that best of Brahmins; / he approached Rāmānanda and became his disciple.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ vipra surāṃśāśca yathābhavan ..
kaliśuddhikarī līlā teṣāṃ mārgapradarśinām .. 56 ..
viṣṇusvāmīmadhvācāryavarṇanam
meaning:
इति ते कथितं विप्र सुरांशाश्च यथाभवन् ..
कलिशुद्धिकरी लीला तेषां मार्गप्रदर्शिनाम् .. 56 ..

text_mt:
Thus has been told to you, O Brahmin, how the portions of the gods came to be; / their pastimes, purifying the Kali age, show the right path.
Description of Viṣṇusvāmin and Madhvācārya

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
ityuktvā bhagavāñjīvo devamāhātmyamuttamam .
svamukhātsvāṃśamutpādya brahmayonau babhūva ha . . 1
meaning:
सूत उवाच
इत्युक्त्वा भगवाञ्जीवो देवमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् .
स्वमुखात्स्वांशमुत्पाद्य ब्रह्मयोनौ बभूव ह . . 1
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having spoken thus of the supreme greatness of the gods, the blessed Jīva, / producing a portion of himself from his mouth, was born indeed from a Brahmin womb.
title: Kṛṣṇacaitanyayajñāṃśaśiṣyabalabhadraviṣṇusvāmimadhvācāryādivṛttāntavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭikā nagarī ramyā gurudattasya vai sutaḥ .
ropaṇo nāma vikhyāto brahmamārgapradarśakaḥ . . 2
meaning:
इष्टिका नगरी रम्या गुरुदत्तस्य वै सुतः .
रोपणो नाम विख्यातो ब्रह्ममार्गप्रदर्शकः . . 2
text_mt: In the delightful town of Iṣṭikā, the son of Gurudatta, / renowned by the name Ropaṇa, showed the path of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
sūtragranthamayīṃ mālāṃ tilakaṃ jalanirmitam .
vāsudeveti tanmantre kalau kṛtvā janejane . . 3
meaning:
सूत्रग्रन्थमयीं मालां तिलकं जलनिर्मितम् .
वासुदेवेति तन्मन्त्रे कलौ कृत्वा जनेजने . . 3
text_mt: Giving a garland of knotted threads and a tilaka made with water, / and chanting the mantra 'Vāsudeva' to every person in the Kali age,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇacaitanyamāgamya kambalaṃ ca tadājñayā .
gṛhītvā svapurīṃ prāpya kṛṣṇadhyānaparobhavat . . 4
meaning:
कृष्णचैतन्यमागम्य कम्बलं च तदाज्ञया .
गृहीत्वा स्वपुरीं प्राप्य कृष्णध्यानपरोभवत् . . 4
text_mt: he approached Kṛṣṇa Caitanya and, receiving a blanket by his order, / returned to his town and became devoted to meditation on Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paraṃ śṛṇu mune caritraṃ ca harermudā .
yacchrutvā ca kalau ghore jano naiva bhayaṃ vrajet . . 5
meaning:
अतः परं शृणु मुने चरित्रं च हरेर्मुदा .
यच्छ्रुत्वा च कलौ घोरे जनो नैव भयं व्रजेत् . . 5
text_mt: Listen further with joy, O sage, to the acts of Hari, / hearing which in the terrible Kali age a man will never experience fear.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcābde kṛṣṇacaitanye yajñāṃśe yajñakāriṇi .
vaṅgadeśabhavo vipra īśvaraḥ śāradāpriyaḥ . . 6
meaning:
पञ्चाब्दे कृष्णचैतन्ये यज्ञांशे यज्ञकारिणि .
वङ्गदेशभवो विप्र ईश्वरः शारदाप्रियः . . 6
text_mt: When Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, a portion of the sacrifice who performs sacrifices, was five years old, / a Brahmin born in the country of Bengal named Īśvara, beloved of Sarasvatī,

sanskrit_iast:
prāptaḥ śāntipure grāme vāgdevīvaradarpitaḥ .
satāṃ digvijayaṃ kṛtvā sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ . . 7
meaning:
प्राप्तः शान्तिपुरे ग्रामे वाग्देवीवरदर्पितः .
सतां दिग्विजयं कृत्वा सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः . . 7
text_mt: proud of the boon of the goddess of speech, arrived at the village of Śāntipura, / having conquered the wise everywhere, skilled in all scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgākūle stavaṃ divyaṃ racitvā 1 so'paṭhaddvijaḥ .
etasminnantare tatra yajñāṃśassamupāgataḥ . .
uvāca vacanaṃ ramyamīśvaraṃ stutikāriṇam . . 8
meaning:
गङ्गाकूले स्तवं दिव्यं रचित्वा 1 सोऽपठद्द्विजः .
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र यज्ञांशस्समुपागतः . .
उवाच वचनं रम्यमीश्वरं स्तुतिकारिणम् . . 8
text_mt: Having composed a divine hymn on the bank of the Gaṅgā, that Brahmin recited it. / Meanwhile, the incarnation of the sacrifice came there / and spoke pleasant words to Īśvara who was reciting the praise:

sanskrit_iast:
sukṛtaṃ pūrtamarṇaṃ ca śrutīnāṃ sārameva hi .
ityuktaṃ bhavatā stotre dūṣaṇaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ vada . . 9
meaning:
सुकृतं पूर्तमर्णं च श्रुतीनां सारमेव हि .
इत्युक्तं भवता स्तोत्रे दूषणं भूषणं वद . . 9
text_mt: '"Good deeds, civic works, the ocean, and the essence of the Vedic revelations"; / since this was said by you in the hymn, state the defect or the ornament [of it].'

sanskrit_iast:
tathāha ceśvaro dhīmāndūṣaṇaṃ naiva dṛśyate .
ityuktyā prāha bhagavānbhūṣaṇaṃ naiva dṛśyate . . 3.4.19.10
meaning:
तथाह चेश्वरो धीमान्दूषणं नैव दृश्यते .
इत्युक्त्या प्राह भगवान्भूषणं नैव दृश्यते . . 3.4.19.10
text_mt: Then the wise Īśvara said, 'No defect is seen.' / Having heard this statement, the Lord said, 'No ornament is seen.'

sanskrit_iast:
sukṛtaṃ ca smṛtaṃ dharmaḥ pūrtaṃ caitanyamucyate .
arṇaṃ vīryamiti jñeyaṃ śrutisāramatastrayam . .
gaṅgājale dūṣaṇo'yaṃ bhūṣaṇo'yaṃ kalevare 11
iti śrutvā sa vai bhikṣurvismito'bhūcca gīḥ priyaḥ .
lajjitaṃ svajanaṃ dṛṣṭvā śāradā sarvamaṅgalā . .
vihasyeśvaramityāha kṛṣṇaścaitanyasaṃjñakaḥ . . 12
meaning:
सुकृतं च स्मृतं धर्मः पूर्तं चैतन्यमुच्यते .
अर्णं वीर्यमिति ज्ञेयं श्रुतिसारमतस्त्रयम् . .
गङ्गाजले दूषणोऽयं भूषणोऽयं कलेवरे 11
इति श्रुत्वा स वै भिक्षुर्विस्मितोऽभूच्च गीः प्रियः .
लज्जितं स्वजनं दृष्ट्वा शारदा सर्वमङ्गला . .
विहस्येश्वरमित्याह कृष्णश्चैतन्यसंज्ञकः . . 12
text_mt: "Right action (sukṛta) is considered to be dharma, and civil works (pūrta) are called consciousness (caitanya). / Flood (arṇa) should be known as virility; therefore these three are the essence of the Śrutis. / In the water of the Gaṅgā, this is a fault; in the bodily frame, this is an ornament." / Hearing this, the mendicant was astonished, and his voice faltered. / Seeing her own person humbled, Śāradā, the all-auspicious, / smiled and said to Īśvara, "He is Kṛṣṇa, named Caitanya."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu tacchiṣyaḥ kṛṣṇamantraupāsakaḥ .
babhūva vaiṣṇavaśreṣṭhaḥ kṛṣṇacaitanyasevakaḥ . . 13
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु तच्छिष्यः कृष्णमन्त्रौपासकः .
बभूव वैष्णवश्रेष्ठः कृष्णचैतन्यसेवकः . . 13
text_mt: Having heard this, his disciple, who worshipped the mantra of Kṛṣṇa, / became the foremost of Vaiṣṇavas, a servant of Kṛṣṇa Caitanya.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
śrīdharo nāma vikhyāto brāhmaṇaḥ śivapūjakaḥ .
pattane nagare ramye tasya saptāhamuttamam . . 14
meaning:
सूत उवाच
श्रीधरो नाम विख्यातो ब्राह्मणः शिवपूजकः .
पत्तने नगरे रम्ये तस्य सप्ताहमुत्तमम् . . 14
text_mt: Sūta said: / A brāhmaṇa named Śrīdhara, renowned as a worshipper of Śiva, / held an excellent seven-day recitation [of the Bhāgavata] in the charming city of Pattana.

sanskrit_iast:
rājñā bhāgavataṃ tatra kāritaṃ sadhanaṃ bahu .
gṛhītvā śrīdharo vipro jagāma śvaśurālaye . . 15
meaning:
राज्ञा भागवतं तत्र कारितं सधनं बहु .
गृहीत्वा श्रीधरो विप्रो जगाम श्वशुरालये . . 15
text_mt: A recitation of the Bhāgavata was caused to be performed there by the king, along with great wealth. / Taking it, the brāhmaṇa Śrīdhara went to his father-in-law's house.

sanskrit_iast:
tatroṣya māsamātraṃ ca svapatnyā saha vai dvijaḥ .
svagehamagamanmārge caurāḥ sapta tu taṃ prati .
śapathaṃ rāmadevasya kṛtvā sārddhamupāyayuḥ . . 16
meaning:
तत्रोष्य मासमात्रं च स्वपत्न्या सह वै द्विजः .
स्वगेहमगमन्मार्गे चौराः सप्त तु तं प्रति .
शपथं रामदेवस्य कृत्वा सार्द्धमुपाययुः . . 16
text_mt: Having stayed there for only a month together with his wife, the twice-born went toward his own home. / On the road, seven thieves, having sworn an oath / in the name of the god Rāma, came upon him.

sanskrit_iast:
samāpte vipine ramye hatvā te śrīdharaṃ dvijam .
gorathaṃ sadhanaṃ tatra sabhāryaṃ jagṛhustadā . . 17
meaning:
समाप्ते विपिने रम्ये हत्वा ते श्रीधरं द्विजम् .
गोरथं सधनं तत्र सभार्यं जगृहुस्तदा . . 17
text_mt: Having killed the brāhmaṇa Śrīdhara when the charming forest came to an end, / they then seized the bullock cart, together with the wealth and his wife.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare rāmaḥ saccidānandavigrahaḥ .
sapta tāṃśca śarairhatvā punarujjīvya taṃ dvijam . . 18
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रामः सच्चिदानन्दविग्रहः .
सप्त तांश्च शरैर्हत्वा पुनरुज्जीव्य तं द्विजम् . . 18
text_mt: In the meantime, Rāma, whose form is truth, consciousness, and bliss, / slew the seven [thieves] with arrows and brought the twice-born back to life.

sanskrit_iast:
preṣayāmāsa bhagavāṃstadā vṛndāvane prabhuḥ .
tadā prabhṛti vai vipraḥ śrīdharo vaiṣṇavo'bhavat . . 19
meaning:
प्रेषयामास भगवांस्तदा वृन्दावने प्रभुः .
तदा प्रभृति वै विप्रः श्रीधरो वैष्णवोऽभवत् . . 19
text_mt: Then the lord, the master, sent him to Vṛndāvana. / From that time onward, the brāhmaṇa Śrīdhara became a Vaiṣṇava.

sanskrit_iast:
saptābde caiva yajñāṃśe gatvā śāntipurīṃ śubhām .
brahmajñānamupāgamya yajñāṃśācchiṣyatāṃ gataḥ . .
ṭīkā bhāgavatasyaiva kṛtā tena mahātmanā . . 3.4.19.20
meaning:
सप्ताब्दे चैव यज्ञांशे गत्वा शान्तिपुरीं शुभाम् .
ब्रह्मज्ञानमुपागम्य यज्ञांशाच्छिष्यतां गतः . .
टीका भागवतस्यैव कृता तेन महात्मना . . 3.4.19.20
text_mt: When Yajñāṃśa was seven years old, [Śrīdhara] went to the auspicious Śāntipurī; / having approached spiritual knowledge, he became a disciple of Yajñāṃśa. / A commentary on the Bhāgavata was composed by that great soul.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
rāmaśarmā sthitaḥ kāśyāṃ śaṅkarārcanatatparaḥ .
śivarātre dvijo dhīmānavimukteśvarasthale . .
ekākī jāgarandhyānī japtvā pañcākṣaraṃ śubham . . 21
meaning:
सूत उवाच
रामशर्मा स्थितः काश्यां शङ्करार्चनतत्परः .
शिवरात्रे द्विजो धीमानविमुक्तेश्वरस्थले . .
एकाकी जागरन्ध्यानी जप्त्वा पञ्चाक्षरं शुभम् . . 21
text_mt: Sūta said: / Rāmaśarman, staying in Kāśī, devoted to the worship of Śaṅkara, / a wise twice-born, on the night of Śivarātri at the shrine of Avimukteśvara, / staying awake alone, absorbed in meditation, recited the auspicious five-syllable mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prasanno bhagavāñchaṅkaro lokaśaṅkaraḥ .
varaṃ brūhīti vacanaṃ tamāha dvijasattamam . . 22
meaning:
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवाञ्छङ्करो लोकशङ्करः .
वरं ब्रूहीति वचनं तमाह द्विजसत्तमम् . . 22
text_mt: Then the blessed Śaṅkara, who causes welfare to the world, was pleased; / he said to that best of the twice-born the words, "Choose a boon!"

sanskrit_iast:
rāmaśarmā śivaṃ natvā vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ .
bhavānyasya samādhistho dhyāne yasya paro bhavān . . 23
meaning:
रामशर्मा शिवं नत्वा वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः .
भवान्यस्य समाधिस्थो ध्याने यस्य परो भवान् . . 23
text_mt: Bowing to Śiva, Rāmaśarman spoke these words with a humble mind: / "The one in whom you remain absorbed in meditation, the one upon whom you meditate as supreme—

sanskrit_iast:
sa devo hṛdaye mahyaṃ vasettava varātprabho .
ityuktavacane tasminvihasyāha maheśvaraḥ . . 24
meaning:
स देवो हृदये मह्यं वसेत्तव वरात्प्रभो .
इत्युक्तवचने तस्मिन्विहस्याह महेश्वरः . . 24
text_mt: may that god dwell in my heart by your boon, O Lord!" / When these words had been spoken, Maheśvara smiled and said:

sanskrit_iast:
ekā vai prakṛtirmāyā tridhā brahmasvarūpiṇī .
śūnyabhūtāvyavasyaiva puruṣasyārddhataijasam . .
gṛhītvā lokajananī puṃklībau suṣuve sutau . . 25
meaning:
एका वै प्रकृतिर्माया त्रिधा ब्रह्मस्वरूपिणी .
शून्यभूताव्यवस्यैव पुरुषस्यार्द्धतैजसम् . .
गृहीत्वा लोकजननी पुंक्लीबौ सुषुवे सुतौ . . 25
text_mt: "The one Prakṛti, Māyā, having the nature of Brahman, threefold, / having received half the fiery energy of the Puruṣa who is void and immutable, / the Mother of the World, gave birth to two sons, a male and a neuter.

sanskrit_iast:
pumānnārāyaṇaḥ sākṣādgauraścāṣṭabhujairyutaḥ .
tridhā babhūva bhagavānsvecchayā viśvarakṣakaḥ . . 26
meaning:
पुमान्नारायणः साक्षाद्गौरश्चाष्टभुजैर्युतः .
त्रिधा बभूव भगवान्स्वेच्छया विश्वरक्षकः . . 26
text_mt: The male is Nārāyaṇa directly, fair-complexioned and endowed with eight arms; / by his own will the blessed protector of the universe became threefold.

sanskrit_iast:
ardhatejāssa vai viṣṇurvanamālī caturbhujaḥ .
kṣīraśāyī sa ādityaḥ svayaṃ sadguṇadevatā . . 27
meaning:
अर्धतेजास्स वै विष्णुर्वनमाली चतुर्भुजः .
क्षीरशायी स आदित्यः स्वयं सद्गुणदेवता . . 27
text_mt: Endowed with half of that fiery energy, Viṣṇu wears a garland of forest flowers, has four arms, / lies upon the milk-ocean, is the Sun, and is himself the deity of good qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
ardhatejā dvidhā saiva naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī .
jiṣṇurviṣṇuḥ sa vai jñeyo parvate gandhamādane . . 28
meaning:
अर्धतेजा द्विधा सैव नरनारायणावृषी .
जिष्णुर्विष्णुः स वै ज्ञेयो पर्वते गन्धमादने . . 28
text_mt: With half of that fiery energy, he became twofold as the sages Nara and Nārāyaṇa; / on Mount Gandhamādana, he is to be known as Jiṣṇu and Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
klībaḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ sākṣādbrahmarūpaṃ tridhābhavat .
pūrvārddhādgauraśeṣaśca parārdhādrāmalakṣmaṇau . . 29
meaning:
क्लीबः सङ्कर्षणः साक्षाद्ब्रह्मरूपं त्रिधाभवत् .
पूर्वार्द्धाद्गौरशेषश्च परार्धाद्रामलक्ष्मणौ . . 29
text_mt: The neuter is Saṅkarṣaṇa directly, whose nature of Brahman became threefold: / from the first half came the fair-complexioned Śeṣa, and from the latter half, Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
gauraśeṣo dvāparānte balabhadraḥ sa vai svayam .
rāmalakṣmaṇayordhyānaṃ balabhadrasya pūjanam . .
sadā mayā ca kartavyaṃ tatprāpya tvaṃ sukhī bhava . . 3.4.19.30
meaning:
गौरशेषो द्वापरान्ते बलभद्रः स वै स्वयम् .
रामलक्ष्मणयोर्ध्यानं बलभद्रस्य पूजनम् . .
सदा मया च कर्तव्यं तत्प्राप्य त्वं सुखी भव . . 3.4.19.30
text_mt: At the end of the Dvāpara age, the fair Śeṣa was Balabhadra himself. / Meditation upon Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa and the worship of Balabhadra / should always be performed by me; having attained that, may you be happy."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvāntardadhe devo rāmānandasya cābhavat .
kṛṣṇacaitanyamāgamya dvādaśābdavayovṛtam . . 31
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे देवो रामानन्दस्य चाभवत् .
कृष्णचैतन्यमागम्य द्वादशाब्दवयोवृतम् . . 31
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the god vanished. And [Rāmaśarman] became Rāmānanda. / Approaching Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, who had reached twelve years of age,

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyo bhūtvā sthitastatra kṛṣṇacaitanyapūjakaḥ .
kṛtaṃ tadājñayā tenādhyātmarāmāyaṇaṃ śubham . . 32
meaning:
शिष्यो भूत्वा स्थितस्तत्र कृष्णचैतन्यपूजकः .
कृतं तदाज्ञया तेनाध्यात्मरामायणं शुभम् . . 32
text_mt: and having become his disciple, he stayed there worshipping Kṛṣṇa Caitanya. / By his command, he composed the auspicious Adhyātmarāmāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
jīvānandassa vai vipro rūpānandasamanvitaḥ .
śrutvā caitanyacaritaṃ purīṃ śāntimayīṃ gataḥ . . 33
meaning:
सूत उवाच
जीवानन्दस्स वै विप्रो रूपानन्दसमन्वितः .
श्रुत्वा चैतन्यचरितं पुरीं शान्तिमयीं गतः . . 33
text_mt: Sūta said: / The brāhmaṇa Jīvānanda, accompanied by Rūpānanda, / having heard of the life of Caitanya, went to the city full of peace.

sanskrit_iast:
caitanye ṣoḍaśābde ca natvā taṃ tau samāsthitau .
ūcatuḥ kṛṣṇacaitanyaṃ bhavatā kiṃ mataṃ smṛtam . . 34
meaning:
चैतन्ये षोडशाब्दे च नत्वा तं तौ समास्थितौ .
ऊचतुः कृष्णचैतन्यं भवता किं मतं स्मृतम् . . 34
text_mt: When Caitanya was sixteen years old, the two bowed down and attended upon him; / they said to Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, "What doctrine is held by you?"

sanskrit_iast:
vihasyāha sa caitanyaḥ śākto'haṃ śaktipūjakaḥ .
śaivo'haṃ vai dvijau 1 nityaṃ lokārthe śaṅkaravratī . .
vaiṣṇavo'haṃ dhyānaparo devadevasya bhaktimān . . 35
meaning:
विहस्याह स चैतन्यः शाक्तोऽहं शक्तिपूजकः .
शैवोऽहं वै द्विजौ 1 नित्यं लोकार्थे शङ्करव्रती . .
वैष्णवोऽहं ध्यानपरो देवदेवस्य भक्तिमान् . . 35
text_mt: Smiling, Caitanya said: "I am a Śākta, a worshipper of Śakti; / I am a Śaiva, O two brāhmaṇas, ever observant of Śaṅkara's vows for the sake of the world; / I am a Vaiṣṇava, devoted to meditation, full of devotion for the God of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ bhaktimadaṃ pītvā pāpapuṃso baliṃ śubham .
śaktyai samarpya homānte jñānāgnau yajñatatparaḥ . . 36
meaning:
अहं भक्तिमदं पीत्वा पापपुंसो बलिं शुभम् .
शक्त्यै समर्प्य होमान्ते ज्ञानाग्नौ यज्ञतत्परः . . 36
text_mt: Having drunk the intoxicating liquor of devotion, / and offering the auspicious sacrifice of the sinful person to Śakti, / at the end of the oblation I am intent upon sacrifice in the fire of knowledge."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā dvijau tau tu tasya śiṣyatvamāgatau .
ācāramārgamāgamya sarvapūjyau babhūvatuḥ . . 37
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा द्विजौ तौ तु तस्य शिष्यत्वमागतौ .
आचारमार्गमागम्य सर्वपूज्यौ बभूवतुः . . 37
text_mt: Having heard this, those two twice-born became his disciples; / having adopted the path of proper conduct, they became revered by all.

sanskrit_iast:
tadājñayā ṣaṭsandarbhaṃ jīvānandaścakāra vai .
uvāsa tatra matimānkṛṣṇacaitanyasevakaḥ . . 38
meaning:
तदाज्ञया षट्सन्दर्भं जीवानन्दश्चकार वै .
उवास तत्र मतिमान्कृष्णचैतन्यसेवकः . . 38
text_mt: By his command, Jīvānanda composed the Ṣaṭsandarbha; / the wise man lived there as a servant of Kṛṣṇa Caitanya.

sanskrit_iast:
rūpānando gurorājñāṃ puraskṛtya mahāmuniḥ .
kṛṣṇakhaṇḍaṃ purāṇāṅgaṃ cakre daśasahasrakam . .
tatroṣya gurusevāḍhyo rādhākṛṣṇa prapūjakaḥ . . 39
meaning:
रूपानन्दो गुरोराज्ञां पुरस्कृत्य महामुनिः .
कृष्णखण्डं पुराणाङ्गं चक्रे दशसहस्रकम् . .
तत्रोष्य गुरुसेवाढ्यो राधाकृष्ण प्रपूजकः . . 39
text_mt: Setting before him the command of his guru, the great sage Rūpānanda / composed the Kṛṣṇakhaṇḍa, a branch of the Purāṇa consisting of ten thousand [verses]; / residing there, rich in service to his guru, he was a worshipper of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
viṣṇusvāmī sa vai vipro gataḥ śāntipurīṃ śubhām .
yajñāṃśa ūnaviṃśābde natvā taṃ prāha sa dvijaḥ . . 3.4.19.40
meaning:
सूत उवाच
विष्णुस्वामी स वै विप्रो गतः शान्तिपुरीं शुभाम् .
यज्ञांश ऊनविंशाब्दे नत्वा तं प्राह स द्विजः . . 3.4.19.40
text_mt: Sūta said: / That brāhmaṇa Viṣṇusvāmin went to the auspicious Śāntipurī. / In the nineteenth year of Yajñāṃśa, the twice-born bowed to him and said:

sanskrit_iast:
ko devaḥ sarvadevānāṃ pūjyo brahmāṇḍagocare .
iti śrutvā sa bhagavānuvāca dvijasattamam . . 41
meaning:
को देवः सर्वदेवानां पूज्यो ब्रह्माण्डगोचरे .
इति श्रुत्वा स भगवानुवाच द्विजसत्तमम् . . 41
text_mt: "Which god among all the gods within the realm of the cosmos is worthy of worship?" / Hearing this, the Blessed One said to the best of the twice-born:

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapūjyo mahādevo bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ .
viṣṇvīśvaraśca rudreśo brahmeśo bhagavānharaḥ . . 42
meaning:
सर्वपूज्यो महादेवो भक्तानुग्रहकारकः .
विष्ण्वीश्वरश्च रुद्रेशो ब्रह्मेशो भगवान्हरः . . 42
text_mt: "Mahādeva, who bestows grace upon his devotees, is worthy of worship by all. / The Blessed Hara is the lord of Viṣṇu, the lord of Rudra, and the lord of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
vinā tatpūjakenaiva padārthā niṣphalā hi te .
ye tu vai viṣṇubhaktāśca śaṅkarārcanatatparāḥ . . 43
meaning:
विना तत्पूजकेनैव पदार्था निष्फला हि ते .
ये तु वै विष्णुभक्ताश्च शङ्करार्चनतत्पराः . . 43
text_mt: Without one being his worshipper, those objects [of worship] are indeed fruitless. / But those who are devotees of Viṣṇu and are intent upon the worship of Śaṅkara—

sanskrit_iast:
śivaprasādātsulabhā vaiṣṇavī bhaktiruttamā .
vaiṣṇavaḥ puruṣo bhūtvā śaṅkaraṃ lokaśaṅkaram . . 44
meaning:
शिवप्रसादात्सुलभा वैष्णवी भक्तिरुत्तमा .
वैष्णवः पुरुषो भूत्वा शङ्करं लोकशङ्करम् . . 44
text_mt: by Śiva's grace, supreme devotion to Viṣṇu is easily obtained. / If a man, having become a Vaiṣṇava, comes to this land of action

sanskrit_iast:
karmabhūmyāṃ samāgamya na pūjayati nārakaḥ .
viṣṇusvāmīti tacchrutvā śiṣyo bhūtvā ca tadguṇaiḥ . . 45
meaning:
कर्मभूम्यां समागम्य न पूजयति नारकः .
विष्णुस्वामीति तच्छ्रुत्वा शिष्यो भूत्वा च तद्गुणैः . . 45
text_mt: and does not worship Śaṅkara, who causes welfare to the world, he is destined for hell." / Viṣṇusvāmin, having heard this and having become his disciple on account of his virtues,

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇamantramupāsitvā 1 sa babhūva śivārcakaḥ . . 46
meaning: कृष्णमन्त्रमुपासित्वा 1 स बभूव शिवार्चकः . . 46
text_mt: worshipped the mantra of Kṛṣṇa and became a worshipper of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavī saṃhitā tena nirmitā ca tadājñayā .
tatroṣya viṣṇubhaktaśca kṛṣṇacaitanyapūjakaḥ . . 47
meaning:
वैष्णवी संहिता तेन निर्मिता च तदाज्ञया .
तत्रोष्य विष्णुभक्तश्च कृष्णचैतन्यपूजकः . . 47
text_mt: A Vaiṣṇava Saṃhitā was composed by him at his command. / Residing there, he was a devotee of Viṣṇu and a worshipper of Kṛṣṇa Caitanya.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
madhvācāryaḥ kṛṣṇaparo jñātvā yajñāṃśamuttamam .
gatvā śāntipurīṃ ramyāṃ natvā taṃ prāha sa dvijaḥ . . 48
meaning:
सूत उवाच
मध्वाचार्यः कृष्णपरो ज्ञात्वा यज्ञांशमुत्तमम् .
गत्वा शान्तिपुरीं रम्यां नत्वा तं प्राह स द्विजः . . 48
text_mt: Sūta said: / Madhvācārya, devoted to Kṛṣṇa, knowing of the excellent Yajñāṃśa, / went to the charming Śāntipurī, bowed down, and said to him:

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇo'yaṃ bhagavānsākṣāttadanye viśvakārakāḥ .
devā dhātrādayo jñeyāstarhi tatpūjanena kim . . 49
meaning:
कृष्णोऽयं भगवान्साक्षात्तदन्ये विश्वकारकाः .
देवा धात्रादयो ज्ञेयास्तर्हि तत्पूजनेन किम् . . 49
text_mt: "Kṛṣṇa is the Blessed One directly; others besides him are the creators of the universe. / Gods such as Dhātṛ are to be understood [as subordinate]; therefore, what is the use of worshipping them?

sanskrit_iast:
śaktimārgaparā viprā vṛthā hiṃsāmayairmakhaiḥ .
aśvamedhādibhirdevānpūjayanti mahītale . 3.4.19.50
meaning:
शक्तिमार्गपरा विप्रा वृथा हिंसामयैर्मखैः .
अश्वमेधादिभिर्देवान्पूजयन्ति महीतले . 3.4.19.50
text_mt: Brāhmaṇas devoted to the path of Śakti in vain worship the gods on the face of the earth / with sacrifices filled with violence, such as the horse sacrifice."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vihasyāha yajñāṃśaśca śacīsutaḥ .
na kṛṣṇo bhagavānsākṣāttāmaso'yaṃ ca śaktijaḥ . . 51
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा विहस्याह यज्ञांशश्च शचीसुतः .
न कृष्णो भगवान्साक्षात्तामसोऽयं च शक्तिजः . . 51
text_mt:
Hearing this, the portion of sacrifice, the son of Śacī, laughed and said:
“Kṛṣṇa is not the Lord directly; he is tāmasic and born of Śakti.

sanskrit_iast:
cauro'yaṃ sarvabhogī ca hiṃsako māṃsabhakṣakaḥ .
parastriyaṃ bhajedyo vai sa gacchedyamamandiram . . 52
meaning:
चौरोऽयं सर्वभोगी च हिंसको मांसभक्षकः .
परस्त्रियं भजेद्यो वै स गच्छेद्यममन्दिरम् . . 52
text_mt:
He is a thief, an enjoyer of everything, violent, and a meat-eater.
Whoever consorts with another’s wife certainly goes to the abode of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
cauro yamālayaṃ gacchejjīvahantā viśeṣataḥ .
ebhiśca lakṣaṇairhīno bhagavānprakṛteḥ paraḥ . . 53
meaning:
चौरो यमालयं गच्छेज्जीवहन्ता विशेषतः .
एभिश्च लक्षणैर्हीनो भगवान्प्रकृतेः परः . . 53
text_mt:
A thief goes to the abode of Yama, especially a slayer of living beings.
The Lord, being devoid of these marks, is beyond material nature.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya buddhiḥ sa vai brahmā'haṅkāro yasya vai śivaḥ .
śabdamātrā gaṇeśaśca sparśamātrā yamaḥ svayam . . 54
meaning:
यस्य बुद्धिः स वै ब्रह्माऽहङ्कारो यस्य वै शिवः .
शब्दमात्रा गणेशश्च स्पर्शमात्रा यमः स्वयम् . . 54
text_mt:
He whose intellect is indeed Brahmā, whose ego is indeed Śiva,
whose sound-tanmātra is Gaṇeśa, and whose touch-tanmātra is Yama himself,

sanskrit_iast:
rūpamātrā kumāro vai rasamātrā ca yakṣarāṭ .
gandhamātrā viśvakarmā śravaṇaṃ bhagavāñchaniḥ . . 55
meaning:
रूपमात्रा कुमारो वै रसमात्रा च यक्षराट् .
गन्धमात्रा विश्वकर्मा श्रवणं भगवाञ्छनिः . . 55
text_mt:
whose form-tanmātra is Kumāra, whose taste-tanmātra is the king of the yakṣas,
whose smell-tanmātra is Viśvakarman, and whose hearing is Lord Śani,

sanskrit_iast:
yasya tvaksa budho jñeyaścakṣussūryaḥ sanātanaḥ .
yajjitvā bhagavāñchukro ghrāṇastasyāśvinīsutau . . 56
meaning:
यस्य त्वक्स बुधो ज्ञेयश्चक्षुस्सूर्यः सनातनः .
यज्जित्वा भगवाञ्छुक्रो घ्राणस्तस्याश्विनीसुतौ . . 56
text_mt:
whose skin is to be known as Budha, whose eye is the eternal Sūrya,
whose tongue is Lord Śukra, and whose sense of smell is the two sons of Aśvinī,

sanskrit_iast:
yanmukhaṃ bhagavāñjīvo yasya hastastu devarāṭ .
kṛṣṇo'yaṃ tasya caraṇau liṅgaṃ dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ . .
gudaṃ tadbhagavānmṛtyustasmai bhagavate namaḥ . . 57
meaning:
यन्मुखं भगवाञ्जीवो यस्य हस्तस्तु देवराट् .
कृष्णोऽयं तस्य चरणौ लिङ्गं दक्षः प्रजापतिः . .
गुदं तद्भगवान्मृत्युस्तस्मै भगवते नमः . . 57
text_mt:
whose mouth is Lord Bṛhaspati, whose hand is the king of the gods,
whose feet are this Kṛṣṇa, whose phallus is Dakṣa Prajāpati, / and whose anus is Lord Mṛtyu—homage to that Lord!

sanskrit_iast:
hiṃsāyajñaiśca bhagavānsa ca tṛptimavāpnuyāt .
sa ca yajñapaśurvahnau brahmabhūyāya kalpate . .
tasya mokṣaprabhāvena mahatpuṇyamavāpnuyāt . . 58
meaning:
हिंसायज्ञैश्च भगवान्स च तृप्तिमवाप्नुयात् .
स च यज्ञपशुर्वह्नौ ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते . .
तस्य मोक्षप्रभावेन महत्पुण्यमवाप्नुयात् . . 58
text_mt:
And through sacrifices involving slaughter, the Lord attains satisfaction,
and that sacrificial animal in the fire becomes fit for absorption into Brahman; / by the power of its liberation, one attains great merit.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhihīno naraḥ pāpī hiṃsāyajñaṃ karoti yaḥ .
andhatāmisranarakaṃ taddoṣeṇa vasecciram . . 59
meaning:
विधिहीनो नरः पापी हिंसायज्ञं करोति यः .
अन्धतामिस्रनरकं तद्दोषेण वसेच्चिरम् . . 59
text_mt:
A sinful man who performs a violent sacrifice devoid of proper injunction
shall dwell in the Andhatāmisra hell for a long time on account of that fault.

sanskrit_iast:
mahatpuṇyaṃ mahatpāpaṃ hiṃsāyajñeṣu vartate .
atastu bhagavānkṛṣṇo hiṃsāyajñaṃ kalau yuge . . 3.4.19.60
meaning:
महत्पुण्यं महत्पापं हिंसायज्ञेषु वर्तते .
अतस्तु भगवान्कृष्णो हिंसायज्ञं कलौ युगे . . 3.4.19.60
text_mt:
Great merit and great sin exist in sacrifices involving slaughter.
Therefore, in the Kali age, Lord Kṛṣṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
samāpya kārtike māsi pratipacchuklapakṣake .
annakūṭamayaṃ yajñaṃ sthāpayāmāsa bhūtale . . 61
meaning:
समाप्य कार्तिके मासि प्रतिपच्छुक्लपक्षके .
अन्नकूटमयं यज्ञं स्थापयामास भूतले . . 61
text_mt:
having brought the violent sacrifice to an end, established on the surface of the earth
a sacrifice consisting of a mountain of food, on the first tithi of the bright fortnight in the month of Kārtika.

sanskrit_iast:
devarājastadā kruddho hyanujaṃ prati duḥkhitaḥ .
vajraṃ saplāvayāmāsa tadā kṛṣṇaḥ sanātanīm . .
prakṛtiṃ sa ca tuṣṭāva lokamaṅgalahetave . . 62
meaning:
देवराजस्तदा क्रुद्धो ह्यनुजं प्रति दुःखितः .
वज्रं सप्लावयामास तदा कृष्णः सनातनीम् . .
प्रकृतिं स च तुष्टाव लोकमङ्गलहेतवे . . 62
text_mt:
Then the king of the gods, enraged and grieved with his younger brother,
caused an inundation with the thunderbolt; then Kṛṣṇa praised / the eternal material nature for the sake of the welfare of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā sā prakṛtirmātā svapūrvāddivyavigraham .
rādhārūpaṃ mahatkṛtvā hadi kṛṣṇasya cāgatā . . 63
meaning:
तदा सा प्रकृतिर्माता स्वपूर्वाद्दिव्यविग्रहम् .
राधारूपं महत्कृत्वा हदि कृष्णस्य चागता . . 63
text_mt:
Then Mother Nature, making a great, divine form
in the shape of Rādhā from her own primary nature, entered Kṛṣṇa's heart.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchaktyā bhagavānkṛṣṇo dhṛtvā govardhanaṃ girim .
nāmnā giridharo devaḥ sarvapūjyo babhūva ha . . 64
meaning:
तच्छक्त्या भगवान्कृष्णो धृत्वा गोवर्धनं गिरिम् .
नाम्ना गिरिधरो देवः सर्वपूज्यो बभूव ह . . 64
text_mt:
Through her power, Lord Kṛṣṇa held up Mount Govardhana;
under the name Giridhara, the god became worshipful by all.

sanskrit_iast:
rādhākṛṣṇassa bhagavānpūrṇabrahma sanātanaḥ .
ataḥ kṛṣṇo na bhagavānrādhākṛṣṇaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ . . 65
meaning:
राधाकृष्णस्स भगवान्पूर्णब्रह्म सनातनः .
अतः कृष्णो न भगवान्राधाकृष्णः परः प्रभुः . . 65
text_mt:
Rādhākṛṣṇa is the Lord, the complete, eternal Brahman;
therefore Kṛṣṇa [alone] is not the Lord: Rādhākṛṣṇa is the supreme sovereign.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vacastasya madhvācāryo haripriyaḥ .
śiṣyo bhūtvā sthitastatra kṛṣṇacaitanyapūjakaḥ . . 66
jagannāthamāhātmyavarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य मध्वाचार्यो हरिप्रियः .
शिष्यो भूत्वा स्थितस्तत्र कृष्णचैतन्यपूजकः . . 66
जगन्नाथमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Hearing his speech, Madhvācārya, dear to Hari,
became his disciple and stayed there as a worshipper of Kṛṣṇa Caitanya.
Description of the Greatness of Jagannātha

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
bhaṭṭojissa ca śuddhātmā śivabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ .
kṛṣṇacaitanyamāgamya namaskṛtya vaco'bravīt . . 1
meaning:
सूत उवाच
भट्टोजिस्स च शुद्धात्मा शिवभक्तिपरायणः .
कृष्णचैतन्यमागम्य नमस्कृत्य वचोऽब्रवीत् . . 1
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Bhaṭṭoji, pure of soul and devoted to the worship of Śiva,
came to Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, bowed, and spoke these words:
title: Jagannāthamāhātmyavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevo guruḥ sa vai śiva ātmā śarīriṇām .
viṣṇurbrahmā ca taddāsau tarhi tatpūjanena kim . . 2
meaning:
महादेवो गुरुः स वै शिव आत्मा शरीरिणाम् .
विष्णुर्ब्रह्मा च तद्दासौ तर्हि तत्पूजनेन किम् . . 2
text_mt:
“Mahādeva is indeed the guru; Śiva is the self of embodied beings;
Viṣṇu and Brahmā are his two servants. What is the use, then, of worshipping them?”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā sa yajñāṃśo viṃśadabdavayovṛtaḥ .
vihasyāha sa bhaṭṭojiṃ nāyaṃ śambhurmaheśvaraḥ . . 3
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा स यज्ञांशो विंशदब्दवयोवृतः .
विहस्याह स भट्टोजिं नायं शम्भुर्महेश्वरः . . 3
text_mt:
Hearing this, that portion of sacrifice, twenty years of age,
laughed and said to Bhaṭṭoji: “This Śambhu is not Maheśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
samartho bhagavāñchambhuḥ kartā kinna śarīriṇām .
na bhartā ca vinā viṣṇuṃ saṃhartāyaṃ sadā śivaḥ . . 4
meaning:
समर्थो भगवाञ्छम्भुः कर्ता किन्न शरीरिणाम् .
न भर्ता च विना विष्णुं संहर्तायं सदा शिवः . . 4
text_mt:
Lord Śambhu is capable: why would he not be the creator of embodied beings?
Yet he is not the maintainer without Viṣṇu; he is ever the destroyer, Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
ekamūrtistridhā jātā brahmā viṣṇurmaheśvaraḥ .
śāktamārgeṇa bhagavānbrahmā mokṣapradāyakaḥ . . 5
meaning:
एकमूर्तिस्त्रिधा जाता ब्रह्मा विष्णुर्महेश्वरः .
शाक्तमार्गेण भगवान्ब्रह्मा मोक्षप्रदायकः . . 5
text_mt:
A single form became threefold: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara.
By the Śākta path, Lord Brahmā is the granter of liberation;

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇurvaiṣṇavamārgeṇa jīvānāṃ mokṣadāyakaḥ .
śambhurvai śaivamārgeṇa mokṣadātā śarīriṇām . . 6
meaning:
विष्णुर्वैष्णवमार्गेण जीवानां मोक्षदायकः .
शम्भुर्वै शैवमार्गेण मोक्षदाता शरीरिणाम् . . 6
text_mt:
Viṣṇu, by the Vaiṣṇava path, is the granter of liberation to living beings;
Śambhu, by the Śaiva path, is the granter of liberation to embodied souls.

sanskrit_iast:
śāktaḥ sadāśramo gehī yajñabhukpitṛdevagaḥ .
vānaprasthāśramī yo vai vaiṣṇavaḥ kandamūlabhuk . . 7
meaning:
शाक्तः सदाश्रमो गेही यज्ञभुक्पितृदेवगः .
वानप्रस्थाश्रमी यो वै वैष्णवः कन्दमूलभुक् . . 7
text_mt:
The Śākta is always of the householder stage, an eater of sacrificial [food], devoted to ancestors and gods;
he who is in the forest-dweller stage is a Vaiṣṇava, eating roots and bulbs.

sanskrit_iast:
yatyāśramaḥ sadā raudrau nirguṇaḥ śuddhavigrahaḥ .
brahmacaryāśramasteṣāmanugāmī mahāśramaḥ . . 8
meaning:
यत्याश्रमः सदा रौद्रौ निर्गुणः शुद्धविग्रहः .
ब्रह्मचर्याश्रमस्तेषामनुगामी महाश्रमः . . 8
text_mt:
The ascetic stage is always Raudra, devoid of qualities, of pure form;
the student stage is an attendant of these, a great stage of life.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā gurorvākyaṃ śiṣyo bhūtvā sa vai dvijaḥ .
tṛtīyāṅgaṃ ca vedānāṃ vyācakhyau pāṇinikṛtam . . 9
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा गुरोर्वाक्यं शिष्यो भूत्वा स वै द्विजः .
तृतीयाङ्गं च वेदानां व्याचख्यौ पाणिनिकृतम् . . 9
text_mt:
Hearing this word of the guru, that twice-born man became his disciple,
and he composed a commentary on the third limb of the Vedas, made by Pāṇini.

sanskrit_iast:
tadājñayā ca siddhāntakaumudyāssa cakāra ha .
tatroṣya dīkṣito dhīmānkṛṣṇacaitanyasevakaḥ . . 3.4.20.10
meaning:
तदाज्ञया च सिद्धान्तकौमुद्यास्स चकार ह .
तत्रोष्य दीक्षितो धीमान्कृष्णचैतन्यसेवकः . . 3.4.20.10
text_mt:
By his command he composed the Siddhāntakaumudī;
dwelling there, initiated and wise, he was a servant of Kṛṣṇa Caitanya.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
varāhamihiro dhīmānsa ca sūryaparāyaṇaḥ .
dvāviṃśābde ca yajñāṃśe tamāgatya vaco'bravīt . . 11
meaning:
सूत उवाच
वराहमिहिरो धीमान्स च सूर्यपरायणः .
द्वाविंशाब्दे च यज्ञांशे तमागत्य वचोऽब्रवीत् . . 11
text_mt:
Sūta said:
The wise Varāhamihira, devoted to Sūrya,
came to the portion of sacrifice when he was twenty-two years old and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
sūryo'yaṃ bhagavātsākṣāttrayo devā yato'bhavan .
prātarbrahmā ca madhyāhne viṣṇuḥ sāyaṃ sadāśivaḥ . . 12
meaning:
सूर्योऽयं भगवात्साक्षात्त्रयो देवा यतोऽभवन् .
प्रातर्ब्रह्मा च मध्याह्ने विष्णुः सायं सदाशिवः . . 12
text_mt:
“This Sūrya is the Lord directly, from whom the three gods arose:
in the morning Brahmā, at midday Viṣṇu, and in the evening Sadāśiva.

sanskrit_iast:
ato raveḥ śubhā pūjā tridevayajanena kim .
iti śrutvā sa yajñāṃśo vihasyāha śubhaṃ vacaḥ . . 13
meaning:
अतो रवेः शुभा पूजा त्रिदेवयजनेन किम् .
इति श्रुत्वा स यज्ञांशो विहस्याह शुभं वचः . . 13
text_mt:
Therefore, worship of the Sun is auspicious; what is the use of sacrificing to the three gods?”
Hearing this, that portion of sacrifice laughed and spoke an auspicious word:

sanskrit_iast:
dvidhā babhūva prakṛtiraparā ca parā tathā .
nāmamātrā tathā puṣpamātrā tanmātrikā tathā . . 14
meaning:
द्विधा बभूव प्रकृतिरपरा च परा तथा .
नाममात्रा तथा पुष्पमात्रा तन्मात्रिका तथा . . 14
text_mt:
“Material nature became twofold: the lower and likewise the higher—
the name-element, the flower-element, and the subtle elements,

sanskrit_iast:
śabdamātrā sparśamātrā rūpamātrā rasā tathā .
gaṃdhamātrā tathā jñeyā parā prakṛtiraṣṭadhā . . 15
meaning:
शब्दमात्रा स्पर्शमात्रा रूपमात्रा रसा तथा .
गंधमात्रा तथा ज्ञेया परा प्रकृतिरष्टधा . . 15
text_mt:
the sound-element, the touch-element, the form-element, and the taste-element,
and the smell-element: thus the higher nature is to be known as eightfold.

sanskrit_iast:
aparāyāṃ jīvabhūtā nityaśuddhā jaganmayī .
bhūmirāpo'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ manobuddhireva ca . .
ahaṅkāra iti jñeyā prakṛtiścāparāṣṭadhā . . 16
meaning:
अपरायां जीवभूता नित्यशुद्धा जगन्मयी .
भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनोबुद्धिरेव च . .
अहङ्कार इति ज्ञेया प्रकृतिश्चापराष्टधा . . 16
text_mt:
In the lower nature, consisting of living beings, ever-pure and comprising the universe:
earth, water, fire, wind, space, mind, intellect, / and ego: thus the lower nature is to be known as eightfold.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇurbrahmā mahādevo gaṇeśo yamarāḍ guhaḥ .
kubero viśvakarmā ca parā prakṛtidevatā . . 17
meaning:
विष्णुर्ब्रह्मा महादेवो गणेशो यमराड् गुहः .
कुबेरो विश्वकर्मा च परा प्रकृतिदेवता . . 17
text_mt:
Viṣṇu, Brahmā, Mahādeva, Gaṇeśa, King Yama, Guha,
Kubera, and Viśvakarman are the deities of the higher nature.

sanskrit_iast:
sumerurvaruṇo vahnirvāyuścaiva dhruvastathā .
somo ravistathā śeṣo'parā prakṛtidevatā . . 18
meaning:
सुमेरुर्वरुणो वह्निर्वायुश्चैव ध्रुवस्तथा .
सोमो रविस्तथा शेषोऽपरा प्रकृतिदेवता . . 18
text_mt:
Sumeru, Varuṇa, Agni, Vāyu, and Dhruva,
Soma, Ravi, and Śeṣa are the deities of the lower nature.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ somapatī rudro raviḥ svāmī vidhiḥ svayam .
śeṣasvāmī hariḥ sākṣānnamastebhyo namo namaḥ . . 19
meaning:
अतः सोमपती रुद्रो रविः स्वामी विधिः स्वयम् .
शेषस्वामी हरिः साक्षान्नमस्तेभ्यो नमो नमः . . 19
text_mt:
Therefore, Rudra is the master of Soma; Brahmā himself is the master of Ravi;
Hari directly is the master of Śeṣa. Homage to them, homage, homage!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tadā vipraḥ śiṣyo bhūtvā ca tadguroḥ .
tadājñayā caturthāṅgaṃ jyotiḥśāstraṃ cakāra ha . . 3.4.20.20
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तदा विप्रः शिष्यो भूत्वा च तद्गुरोः .
तदाज्ञया चतुर्थाङ्गं ज्योतिःशास्त्रं चकार ह . . 3.4.20.20
text_mt:
Hearing this, that brāhmaṇa then became a disciple of that guru,
and by his command he composed the fourth limb [of the Veda], the science of astronomy.

sanskrit_iast:
varāhasaṃhitā nāma bṛhajjātakameva hi .
kṣudratantrāṃstathānyānvai kṛtvā tatra sa cāvasat . . 21
meaning:
वराहसंहिता नाम बृहज्जातकमेव हि .
क्षुद्रतन्त्रांस्तथान्यान्वै कृत्वा तत्र स चावसत् . . 21
text_mt:
Having composed the Varāhasaṃhitā, the Bṛhajjātaka,
and other minor treatises, he dwelt there.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
vāṇībhūṣaṇa evāpi śivabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ .
kṛṣṇacaitanyamāgamya vacaḥ prāha vinamradhīḥ . . 22
meaning:
सूत उवाच
वाणीभूषण एवापि शिवभक्तिपरायणः .
कृष्णचैतन्यमागम्य वचः प्राह विनम्रधीः . . 22
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Vāṇībhūṣaṇa also, devoted to the worship of Śiva,
came to Kṛṣṇa Caitanya and, with humble mind, spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇumāyā jagaddhātrī saikā prakṛtirutkṛtā .
tayā jātamidaṃ viśvaṃ viśvāddevasamudbhavaḥ . . 23
meaning:
विष्णुमाया जगद्धात्री सैका प्रकृतिरुत्कृता .
तया जातमिदं विश्वं विश्वाद्देवसमुद्भवः . . 23
text_mt:
“Viṣṇumāyā, the supporter of the universe, is that single, exalted material nature;
by her this universe was born, and from the universe arose the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvedevassa puruṣaśśaktijo bahudhābhavat .
brahmā viṣṇurharaścaiva devāḥ prakṛtisambhavāḥ . .
ato bhagavatī pūjyā tarhi tatpūjanena kim . . 24
meaning:
विश्वेदेवस्स पुरुषश्शक्तिजो बहुधाभवत् .
ब्रह्मा विष्णुर्हरश्चैव देवाः प्रकृतिसम्भवाः . .
अतो भगवती पूज्या तर्हि तत्पूजनेन किम् . . 24
text_mt:
The Puruṣa, the Universal Divinity, born of Śakti, became manifold;
Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Hara are gods arisen from material nature. / Therefore, the Goddess is to be worshipped; what is the use, then, of worshipping them?”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā sa yajñāṃśo vihasyāha dvijottamam .
na vai bhagavatī śreṣṭhā jaḍarūpā guṇātmikā . . 25
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा स यज्ञांशो विहस्याह द्विजोत्तमम् .
न वै भगवती श्रेष्ठा जडरूपा गुणात्मिका . . 25
text_mt:
Hearing this, that portion of sacrifice smiled and said to the best of brāhmaṇas:
“Indeed, the Goddess is not supreme, for her form is insentient, consisting of the guṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
ekā sā prakṛtirmāyā raciturjagatāṃ kṣamā .
puruṣasya sahāyena yoṣiteva narasya ca . . 26
meaning:
एका सा प्रकृतिर्माया रचितुर्जगतां क्षमा .
पुरुषस्य सहायेन योषितेव नरस्य च . . 26
text_mt:
Prakṛti, which is Māyā, alone is capable of creating the worlds
[only] with the assistance of Puruṣa, just as a woman [creates] with a man.

sanskrit_iast:
devībhāgavate śāstre prasiddheyaṃ kathā dvija .
kadācitprakṛtirdevī svecchayedaṃ jagatkhalu . . 27
meaning:
देवीभागवते शास्त्रे प्रसिद्धेयं कथा द्विज .
कदाचित्प्रकृतिर्देवी स्वेच्छयेदं जगत्खलु . . 27
text_mt:
O brāhmaṇa, this well-known story is found in the Devībhāgavata text:
Once, indeed, the goddess Prakṛti by her own will [fashioned] this world;

sanskrit_iast:
nirmitaṃ jaḍabhūtaṃ tadbahudhā bodhitaṃ tadā .
na caitanyamabhūdviprā vismitā prakṛtistadā . . 28
meaning:
निर्मितं जडभूतं तद्बहुधा बोधितं तदा .
न चैतन्यमभूद्विप्रा विस्मिता प्रकृतिस्तदा . . 28
text_mt:
it was made inert, and though awakened in many ways then,
no consciousness arose, O brāhmaṇas; then Prakṛti was astonished.

sanskrit_iast:
śūnyabhūtaṃ ca puruṣaṃ caitanyaṃ samatoṣayat .
praviṣṭo bhagavāndevīmāyājanitagolake . . 29
meaning:
शून्यभूतं च पुरुषं चैतन्यं समतोषयत् .
प्रविष्टो भगवान्देवीमायाजनितगोलके . . 29
text_mt:
And she propitiated Puruṣa, who is voidness and consciousness.
The Lord entered into the cosmic sphere produced by the Māyā of the Goddess;

sanskrit_iast:
svapnavadvā svayaṃ jātaścaitanyamabhavajjagat .
ataḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sa bhagavānpuruṣo nirguṇaḥ paraḥ . . 3.4.20.30
meaning:
स्वप्नवद्वा स्वयं जातश्चैतन्यमभवज्जगत् .
अतः श्रेष्ठः स भगवान्पुरुषो निर्गुणः परः . . 3.4.20.30
text_mt:
or, like a dream, he was born of himself, and the world became conscious.
Therefore, the Lord is supreme—Puruṣa beyond the guṇas, the highest.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtyāṃ svecchayā jāto liṅgarūpastadā'bhavat .
pum̐lliṅgaprakṛtau jātaḥ pum̐lliṅgo'yaṃ sanātanaḥ . . 31
meaning:
प्रकृत्यां स्वेच्छया जातो लिङ्गरूपस्तदाऽभवत् .
पुम्̐ल्लिङ्गप्रकृतौ जातः पुम्̐ल्लिङ्गोऽयं सनातनः . . 31
text_mt:
Born in Prakṛti of his own will, he then assumed gender.
Born in masculine Prakṛti, this eternal one is masculine;

sanskrit_iast:
strīlliṅgaprakṛtau jātaḥ strīlliṅgo'yaṃ sanātanaḥ .
napuṃskaprakṛtau jātaḥ klībarūpaḥ sa vai prabhuḥ . . 32
meaning:
स्त्रील्लिङ्गप्रकृतौ जातः स्त्रील्लिङ्गोऽयं सनातनः .
नपुंस्कप्रकृतौ जातः क्लीबरूपः स वै प्रभुः . . 32
text_mt:
born in feminine Prakṛti, this eternal one is feminine;
born in neuter Prakṛti, that Lord indeed takes neuter form;

sanskrit_iast:
avyayaprakṛtau jātau nirguṇo'yamadhokṣajaḥ .
namastasmai bhagavate śūnyarūpāya sākṣiṇe . . 33
meaning:
अव्ययप्रकृतौ जातौ निर्गुणोऽयमधोक्षजः .
नमस्तस्मै भगवते शून्यरूपाय साक्षिणे . . 33
text_mt:
born in immutable Prakṛti, this Adhokṣaja is beyond the guṇas.
Obeisance to that Lord whose form is void, the witness.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu tadvākyaṃ śiṣyo bhūtvā sa vai dvijaḥ .
triviṃśābde ca yajñāṃśe tatra vāsamakārayat . . 3 4
chandogranthaṃ tu vedāṅgaṃ svanāmnā tena nirmitam .
rādhākṛṣṇaparaṃ nāma japtvā harṣamavāptavān . . 35
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु तद्वाक्यं शिष्यो भूत्वा स वै द्विजः .
त्रिविंशाब्दे च यज्ञांशे तत्र वासमकारयत् . . 3 4
छन्दोग्रन्थं तु वेदाङ्गं स्वनाम्ना तेन निर्मितम् .
राधाकृष्णपरं नाम जप्त्वा हर्षमवाप्तवान् . . 35
text_mt:
Hearing his speech, that brāhmaṇa became his disciple,
and when that portion of sacrifice was twenty-three years old, he had him dwell there.
He composed the Vedāṅga text on metrics under his own name;
chanting the supreme name of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, he attained joy.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
dhanvantarirdvijo nāma brahmabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ .
kṛṣṇacaitanyamāgamya natvā vacanamabravīt . . 36
meaning:
सूत उवाच
धन्वन्तरिर्द्विजो नाम ब्रह्मभक्तिपरायणः .
कृष्णचैतन्यमागम्य नत्वा वचनमब्रवीत् . . 36
text_mt:
Sūta said:
A brāhmaṇa named Dhanvantari, devoted to the worship of Brahman,
came to Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, bowed, and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
bhavāṃstu puruṣaḥ śreṣṭho nityaśuddhassanātanaḥ .
jaḍabhūtā ca tanmāyā samartho bhagavānsvayam . . 37
meaning:
भवांस्तु पुरुषः श्रेष्ठो नित्यशुद्धस्सनातनः .
जडभूता च तन्माया समर्थो भगवान्स्वयम् . . 37
text_mt:
“You are indeed the supreme Puruṣa, eternally pure and eternal;
his Māyā is insentient, and the Lord himself is all-capable.

sanskrit_iast:
nityo'vyaktaḥ paraḥ sūkṣmastasmātprakṛtirudbhavaḥ .
ataḥ pūjyassa bhagavānprakṛtyāḥ pūjanena kim . . 38
meaning:
नित्योऽव्यक्तः परः सूक्ष्मस्तस्मात्प्रकृतिरुद्भवः .
अतः पूज्यस्स भगवान्प्रकृत्याः पूजनेन किम् . . 38
text_mt:
He is eternal, unmanifest, supreme, and subtle; from him arises Prakṛti.
Therefore, that Lord is to be worshipped; what is the use of worshipping Prakṛti?”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vihasyāha yajñāṃśassarvaśāstragaḥ .
nāyaṃ śreṣṭhassa puruṣo na kṣamaḥ prakṛtiṃ vinā . . 39
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा विहस्याह यज्ञांशस्सर्वशास्त्रगः .
नायं श्रेष्ठस्स पुरुषो न क्षमः प्रकृतिं विना . . 39
text_mt:
Hearing this, that portion of sacrifice, versed in all the scriptures, smiled and said:
“This Puruṣa is not supreme; he is not capable without Prakṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇe caiva vārāhe prasiddheyaṃ kathā śubhā .
kadācitpuruṣo nityo nāmamātraḥ svakecchayā . .
babhūva bahudhā tatra yathā pretastathā svayam . . 3.4.20.40
meaning:
पुराणे चैव वाराहे प्रसिद्धेयं कथा शुभा .
कदाचित्पुरुषो नित्यो नाममात्रः स्वकेच्छया . .
बभूव बहुधा तत्र यथा प्रेतस्तथा स्वयम् . . 3.4.20.40
text_mt:
This auspicious story is well known in the Varāha Purāṇa:
Once the eternal Puruṣa, being only a name, by his own will / became manifold there, just as a preta does by himself.

sanskrit_iast:
asamartho viracituṃ jaganti puruṣaḥ paraḥ .
tuṣṭāva prakṛtiṃ devīṃ cirakālaṃ sanātanīm . . 41
meaning:
असमर्थो विरचितुं जगन्ति पुरुषः परः .
तुष्टाव प्रकृतिं देवीं चिरकालं सनातनीम् . . 41
text_mt:
Unable to create the worlds, the supreme Puruṣa
praised the eternal goddess Prakṛti for a long time.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā devī ca taṃ prāpya mahattatvaṃ cakāra ha .
so'haṅkāraśca mahato jātastanmātrikāstataḥ . . 42
meaning:
तदा देवी च तं प्राप्य महत्तत्वं चकार ह .
सोऽहङ्कारश्च महतो जातस्तन्मात्रिकास्ततः . . 42
text_mt:
Then the Goddess, reaching him, produced the principle of the Mahat;
and from the Mahat, Ahaṅkāra was born, and from that, the subtle elements;

sanskrit_iast: mahābhūtānyato'pyāsaṃstaiḥ sañjātamidaṃ jagat . . 43
meaning: महाभूतान्यतोऽप्यासंस्तैः सञ्जातमिदं जगत् . . 43
text_mt: from these also the gross elements came to be, and by them this world was produced.

sanskrit_iast:
atassanātanau cobhau puruṣātprakṛtiḥ parā .
prakṛteḥ puruṣaścaiva tasmāttābhyāṃ namo namaḥ . . 44
meaning:
अतस्सनातनौ चोभौ पुरुषात्प्रकृतिः परा .
प्रकृतेः पुरुषश्चैव तस्मात्ताभ्यां नमो नमः . . 44
text_mt:
Therefore both are eternal: Prakṛti is higher than Puruṣa,
and Puruṣa is higher than Prakṛti; therefore, homage, homage to the two of them!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti dhanvantariḥ śrutvā śiṣyo bhūtvā ca tadguroḥ .
tatroṣya caiva vedāṅgaṃ kalpavedaṃ cakāra ha . .
suśrutādapare cāpi śiṣyā dhanvantareḥ smṛtaḥ . . 45
meaning:
इति धन्वन्तरिः श्रुत्वा शिष्यो भूत्वा च तद्गुरोः .
तत्रोष्य चैव वेदाङ्गं कल्पवेदं चकार ह . .
सुश्रुतादपरे चापि शिष्या धन्वन्तरेः स्मृतः . . 45

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
jayadevassa vai vipro bauddhamārgaparāyaṇaḥ .
kṛṣṇacaitanyamāgamya pañcaviṃśavayovṛtam . .
natvovāca vaco ramyaṃ sa ca śreṣṭha uṣāpatiḥ . . 46
meaning:
सूत उवाच
जयदेवस्स वै विप्रो बौद्धमार्गपरायणः .
कृष्णचैतन्यमागम्य पञ्चविंशवयोवृतम् . .
नत्वोवाच वचो रम्यं स च श्रेष्ठ उषापतिः . . 46
text_mt:
Sūta said:
The brāhmaṇa Jayadeva, who was devoted to the Buddhist path,
came to Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, who had reached the age of twenty-five,
bowed, and spoke charming words: “He is the supreme Uṣāpati,

sanskrit_iast:
yasya nābherabhūtpadmaṃ brahmaṇā saha nirgatam .
atassa brahmasūrnāma sāmavedeṣu gīyate . . 47
meaning:
यस्य नाभेरभूत्पद्मं ब्रह्मणा सह निर्गतम् .
अतस्स ब्रह्मसूर्नाम सामवेदेषु गीयते . . 47
text_mt:
from whose navel arose the lotus that came forth with Brahmā;
therefore his name 'Brahmasū' is sung in the Sāmavedas.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvo nārāyaṇassākṣādyasya ketau samāsthitaḥ .
viśva keturato nāma na niruddho'niruddhakaḥ . . 48
meaning:
विश्वो नारायणस्साक्षाद्यस्य केतौ समास्थितः .
विश्व केतुरतो नाम न निरुद्धोऽनिरुद्धकः . . 48
text_mt:
The cosmic Nārāyaṇa himself is seated upon his banner;
therefore his name is Viśvaketu, Aniruddha who is not obstructed.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmavelā ca tatpatnī nityā coṣā mahottamā .
sa vai lokahitārthāya svayamarcāvatārakaḥ . . 49
meaning:
ब्रह्मवेला च तत्पत्नी नित्या चोषा महोत्तमा .
स वै लोकहितार्थाय स्वयमर्चावतारकः . . 49
text_mt:
And his wife Brahmavelā is the eternal, most exalted Uṣā;
for the welfare of the world, he is himself the image-incarnation.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vihasyāha yajñāṃśastaṃ dvijottamam .
vedo nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣātpūjanīyo naraḥ sadā . . 3.4.20.50
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा विहस्याह यज्ञांशस्तं द्विजोत्तमम् .
वेदो नारायणः साक्षात्पूजनीयो नरः सदा . . 3.4.20.50
text_mt:
Hearing this, that portion of sacrifice smiled and said to that best of brāhmaṇas:
“The Veda is Nārāyaṇa manifest; man must always worship him.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kālastataḥ karma tato dharmaḥ pravartate .
dharmātmakāmaḥ samudbhūtaḥ kāmapatnī ratiḥ svayam . . 51
meaning:
ततः कालस्ततः कर्म ततो धर्मः प्रवर्तते .
धर्मात्मकामः समुद्भूतः कामपत्नी रतिः स्वयम् . . 51
text_mt:
From him arises time, from that action, and from that dharma proceeds;
from dharma Kāma is born, whose wife is Rati herself.

sanskrit_iast:
ratyāṃ kāmātsamudbhūto'niruddho nāmadevatā .
