text_mt: having held power for two hundred years, they went to the heavenly world. / And the eleventh Mauna was renowned as Pannagāri.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāriṃśacca varṣāṇi rājyaṃ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ .
svargalokaṃ gato rājā pannagairmaraṇaṃ gataḥ . . 96
meaning:
चत्वारिंशच्च वर्षाणि राज्यं कृत्वा प्रयत्नतः .
स्वर्गलोकं गतो राजा पन्नगैर्मरणं गतः . . 96
text_mt: Having ruled with effort for forty years, / the king went to the heavenly world, having met his death through serpents.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ ca mauryajātīyaiḥ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ mahītale . . 97
kaliyugīyetihāsasamuccayavarṇanam
meaning:
एवं च मौर्यजातीयैः कृतं राज्यं महीतले . . 97
कलियुगीयेतिहाससमुच्चयवर्णनम्
text_mt:
And thus was the kingdom ruled on the surface of the earth by those born of the Maurya race.
Description of the Compendium of the History of the Kali Age

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
vaikrame rājyavigate catuṣṣaṣṭyuttaraṃ mune .
dvāviṃśadabdaśatakaṃ bhūtanandistadā nṛpaḥ . . 1
meaning:
सूत उवाच
वैक्रमे राज्यविगते चतुष्षष्ट्युत्तरं मुने .
द्वाविंशदब्दशतकं भूतनन्दिस्तदा नृपः . . 1
text_mt: Sūta said: / When two thousand two hundred and sixty-four years of the reign of Vikrama / had passed, O sage, King Bhūtanandi then arose.
title: Kaliyugīyetihāsasamuccayavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
kuberayakṣakānmaunāndhanadhānyasamanvitān .
sārddhalakṣānkalairghorairjitvā tānyuddhakāriṇaḥ . . 2
meaning:
कुबेरयक्षकान्मौनान्धनधान्यसमन्वितान् .
सार्द्धलक्षान्कलैर्घोरैर्जित्वा तान्युद्धकारिणः . . 2
text_mt: Having conquered the Maunas who were Yakṣas of Kubera, endowed with wealth and grain, / a hundred and fifty thousand warriors, by means of fierce arts of war,

sanskrit_iast:
kilkilāyāṃ svayaṃ rājyaṃ nāgavaṃśaiścakāra ha .
āgneyyāṃ diśi vikhyātā puṇḍarīkeṇa nirmitā . . 3
meaning:
किल्किलायां स्वयं राज्यं नागवंशैश्चकार ह .
आग्नेय्यां दिशि विख्याता पुण्डरीकेण निर्मिता . . 3
text_mt: he himself established a kingdom in Kilkilā through the lineages of the Nāgas. / Renowned in the southeast direction and built by Puṇḍarīka

sanskrit_iast:
purī kilakilā nāma tatra rājā babhūva ha .
puṇḍarīkādayo nāgāstasminrājyaṃ praśāsati . . 4
meaning:
पुरी किलकिला नाम तत्र राजा बभूव ह .
पुण्डरीकादयो नागास्तस्मिन्राज्यं प्रशासति . . 4
text_mt: was the city named Kilakilā; there he became king. / While he ruled the kingdom, the Nāgas headed by Puṇḍarīka

sanskrit_iast:
gehe gehe janaissarvaiḥ pūjanīyā babhūvire .
svāhā svadhā vaṣaṭkāro devapūjā mahītale . . 5
meaning:
गेहे गेहे जनैस्सर्वैः पूजनीया बभूविरे .
स्वाहा स्वधा वषट्कारो देवपूजा महीतले . . 5
text_mt: came to be worshipped in house after house by all people. / Svāhā, svadhā, the exclamation vaṣaṭ, and the worship of the gods on the surface of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktvā devānupāgamya saṃsthitā merumūrddhani .
śakrājñayā kuberastu śūkadhānyaṃ samantataḥ . . 6
meaning:
त्यक्त्वा देवानुपागम्य संस्थिता मेरुमूर्द्धनि .
शक्राज्ञया कुबेरस्तु शूकधान्यं समन्ततः . . 6
text_mt: having left the gods, approached and took their stand upon the summit of Meru. / By order of Śakra, Kubera, collecting from all sides

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣaiḥ ṣaḍaṃśānādāya devebhyaḥ pradadau prabhuḥ .
maṇisvarṇādivastūni maunarājyeṣu yāni vai . . 7
meaning:
यक्षैः षडंशानादाय देवेभ्यः प्रददौ प्रभुः .
मणिस्वर्णादिवस्तूनि मौनराज्येषु यानि वै . . 7
text_mt: the sixth share of bearded grain through his Yakṣas, gave it to the gods, the lord; / and whatever goods such as gems and gold there were in the kingdoms of the Maunas,

sanskrit_iast:
dattāni tāni kośeṣu punardevaścakāra ha .
maṇḍalīkaṃ padaṃ tena satkṛtaṃ bhūtanandinā . . 8
meaning:
दत्तानि तानि कोशेषु पुनर्देवश्चकार ह .
मण्डलीकं पदं तेन सत्कृतं भूतनन्दिना . . 8
text_mt: given into the treasuries, the god restored again. / The position of a regional lord was honored by that Bhūtanandi.

sanskrit_iast:
śatārddhaṃ tu tato rājā śiśunandirbabhūva ha .
nāgapūjāṃ puraskṛtya tiraskṛtya surānbhuvi . . 9
meaning:
शतार्द्धं तु ततो राजा शिशुनन्दिर्बभूव ह .
नागपूजां पुरस्कृत्य तिरस्कृत्य सुरान्भुवि . . 9
text_mt: For half a century thereafter, Śiśunandi was king; / exalting the worship of Nāgas and despising the gods on earth,

sanskrit_iast:
cakāra rājyaṃ viśābdaṃ yaśonandistato'nujaḥ .
bhrātrāsanaṃ svayaṃ prāpto nāgapūjāparāyaṇaḥ . . 3.4.23.10
meaning:
चकार राज्यं विशाब्दं यशोनन्दिस्ततोऽनुजः .
भ्रात्रासनं स्वयं प्राप्तो नागपूजापरायणः . . 3.4.23.10
text_mt: he ruled for twenty years; then his younger brother Yaśonandi, / himself ascending his brother's throne, dedicated to the worship of Nāgas,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcaviṃśativarṣāṇi sa ca rājyamacīkarat .
tatastattanayo rājā sa babhūva pravīrakaḥ . . 11
meaning:
पञ्चविंशतिवर्षाणि स च राज्यमचीकरत् .
ततस्तत्तनयो राजा स बभूव प्रवीरकः . . 11
text_mt: caused the kingdom to be ruled for twenty-five years. / Then his son, the heroic Pravīraka, became king.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśābdaṃ tadrājyaṃ karmabhūmyāṃ prakīrtitam .
kadācitsa ca bāhlīke senayā sārddhamāgataḥ . . 12
meaning:
एकादशाब्दं तद्राज्यं कर्मभूम्यां प्रकीर्तितम् .
कदाचित्स च बाह्लीके सेनया सार्द्धमागतः . . 12
text_mt: His reign on the land of action is proclaimed to have lasted eleven years. / Once he came to Bāhlīka together with his army.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tairabhavadyuddhaṃ paiśācairmlecchadāruṇaiḥ .
māsamātrāntare mlecchā lakṣasaṃkhyā mṛtiṃ gatāḥ . . 13
meaning:
तत्र तैरभवद्युद्धं पैशाचैर्म्लेच्छदारुणैः .
मासमात्रान्तरे म्लेच्छा लक्षसंख्या मृतिं गताः . . 13
text_mt: There a battle took place between them and the dreadful mlecchas of Paiśāca nature; / within the space of just a month, a hundred thousand mlecchas met their death.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā ṣaṣṭisahasrāśca nāgabhaktā layaṃ gatāḥ .
bādalo nāma tadrājā romajastho mahābalaḥ . . 14
meaning:
तथा षष्टिसहस्राश्च नागभक्ता लयं गताः .
बादलो नाम तद्राजा रोमजस्थो महाबलः . . 14
text_mt: Likewise, sixty thousand serpent-devotees met their destruction. / Their king was named Bādala, ruling in Romaja, possessed of great strength.

sanskrit_iast:
yaśonandinamāhūya dadau jālavatīṃ sutām .
gṛhītvā mleccharājasya sutāṃ gehamupāgataḥ . . 15
meaning:
यशोनन्दिनमाहूय ददौ जालवतीं सुताम् .
गृहीत्वा म्लेच्छराजस्य सुतां गेहमुपागतः . . 15
text_mt: Having summoned Yaśonandin, he gave him his daughter Jālavatī. / Taking the daughter of the mleccha king, he returned home.

sanskrit_iast:
garbho jātastatastasyāṃ babhūva tanayo balī .
bāhlīko nāma vikhyāto nāgapūjanatatparaḥ . . 16
meaning:
गर्भो जातस्ततस्तस्यां बभूव तनयो बली .
बाह्लीको नाम विख्यातो नागपूजनतत्परः . . 16
text_mt: Then a child was conceived in her, and a mighty son was born / renowned by the name Bāhlīka, intent upon worshipping the serpents.

sanskrit_iast:
tadanvaye nṛpā jātā bāhlīkāśca trayodaśa .
catuśśatāni varṣāṇi kṛtvā rājyaṃ mṛtiṃ gatāḥ . . 17
meaning:
तदन्वये नृपा जाता बाह्लीकाश्च त्रयोदश .
चतुश्शतानि वर्षाणि कृत्वा राज्यं मृतिं गताः . . 17
text_mt: In his lineage thirteen Bāhlīka kings were born; / having ruled for four hundred years, they passed away.

sanskrit_iast:
ayomukhe ca bāhlīke rājyamatra praśāsati .
tadā pitṛgaṇāssarve kṛṣṇacaitanyamāyayuḥ . . 18
meaning:
अयोमुखे च बाह्लीके राज्यमत्र प्रशासति .
तदा पितृगणास्सर्वे कृष्णचैतन्यमाययुः . . 18
text_mt: And while the Bāhlīka [king] named Ayomukha was ruling the kingdom here, / then all the hosts of ancestors came to Kṛṣṇa-Caitanya.

sanskrit_iast:
natvocurvacanaṃ tatra bhagavañchṛṇu me vacaḥ .
vayaṃ pitṛgaṇā bhūpairnāgavaṃśyairnirākṛtāḥ . . 19
meaning:
नत्वोचुर्वचनं तत्र भगवञ्छृणु मे वचः .
वयं पितृगणा भूपैर्नागवंश्यैर्निराकृताः . . 19
text_mt: Bowing down, they spoke these words there: "Lord, hear our words: / we, the hosts of ancestors, have been rejected by the kings of the serpent lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhatarpaṇakarmāṇi tairvayaṃ varddhitāssadā .
pitṛvṛddhātsomavṛddhistato devāśca varddhanāḥ . . 3.4.23.20
meaning:
श्राद्धतर्पणकर्माणि तैर्वयं वर्द्धितास्सदा .
पितृवृद्धात्सोमवृद्धिस्ततो देवाश्च वर्द्धनाः . . 3.4.23.20
text_mt: Through rites of ancestral offerings and water-libations we were ever nourished by them; / from the flourishing of ancestors comes the flourishing of Soma, and from that the gods flourish.

sanskrit_iast:
devavṛddhāllokavṛddhistasmādbrahmā prajāpatiḥ .
brahmavṛddhātparaṃ harṣaṃ gehe gehe jane jane . . 21
meaning:
देववृद्धाल्लोकवृद्धिस्तस्माद्ब्रह्मा प्रजापतिः .
ब्रह्मवृद्धात्परं हर्षं गेहे गेहे जने जने . . 21
text_mt: From the flourishing of the gods comes the flourishing of the worlds, and from that Brahmā Prajāpati; / from the flourishing of Brahmā comes supreme joy in every house, among all people.

sanskrit_iast:
ato'smānrakṣa bhagavanprajāḥ pāhi sanātanīḥ .
iti śrutvā vacasteṣāṃ yajñāṃśo bhagavānhariḥ . . 22
meaning:
अतोऽस्मान्रक्ष भगवन्प्रजाः पाहि सनातनीः .
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तेषां यज्ञांशो भगवान्हरिः . . 22
text_mt: Therefore protect us, O Lord! Protect the eternal subjects!" / Having heard their words, the Lord Hari, a portion of the sacrifice,

sanskrit_iast: puṣyamitraṃ dharmaparamāryavaśavivarddhanam . . 23
meaning: पुष्यमित्रं धर्मपरमार्यवशविवर्द्धनम् . . 23
text_mt: [manifested as] Puṣyamitra, devoted to righteousness, causing the Aryan lineage to flourish.

sanskrit_iast:
jātamātraḥ sa vai bālaḥ ṣoḍaśārddhavayo'bhavat .
ayoniryonibhūtāṃstānayomukha purassarān . . 24
meaning:
जातमात्रः स वै बालः षोडशार्द्धवयोऽभवत् .
अयोनिर्योनिभूतांस्तानयोमुख पुरस्सरान् . . 24
text_mt: As soon as he was born, that child attained the age of eight years. / Not born of a womb, [he conquered] those born of wombs headed by Ayomukha;

sanskrit_iast:
jitvā deśānnirākṛtya svayaṃ rājyaṃ gṛhītavān .
yathā śivāṃśato jāto vikramo nāma bhūpatiḥ . . 25
meaning:
जित्वा देशान्निराकृत्य स्वयं राज्यं गृहीतवान् .
यथा शिवांशतो जातो विक्रमो नाम भूपतिः . . 25
text_mt: having conquered and expelled them from the land, he took the kingdom for himself, / just as King Vikrama, born of a portion of Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
śakāngandharvapakṣīyāñjitvā pūjyo babhūva ha .
nāgapakṣāṃstathā bhūpāngolakāsyānbhayaṅkarān . . 26
meaning:
शकान्गन्धर्वपक्षीयाञ्जित्वा पूज्यो बभूव ह .
नागपक्षांस्तथा भूपान्गोलकास्यान्भयङ्करान् . . 26
text_mt: having conquered the Śakas of the Gandharva faction, became worthy of worship; / likewise, having conquered the terrifying kings of the serpent faction with spherical faces,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣyamitrastadā jitvā sarvapūjyo'bhavadbhuvi .
saptaviṃśacchataṃ varṣaṃ dvisaptatyuttaraṃ tathā . . 27
meaning:
पुष्यमित्रस्तदा जित्वा सर्वपूज्योऽभवद्भुवि .
सप्तविंशच्छतं वर्षं द्विसप्तत्युत्तरं तथा . . 27
text_mt: Puṣyamitra then became worshipped by all on earth. / For one hundred and twenty-seven years and seventy-two [months],

sanskrit_iast:
rājyaṃ vikramato jātaṃ samāptimagamattadā .
puṣyamitre rājyapadaṃ prāpte samabhavattadā . . 28
meaning:
राज्यं विक्रमतो जातं समाप्तिमगमत्तदा .
पुष्यमित्रे राज्यपदं प्राप्ते समभवत्तदा . . 28
text_mt: the kingdom originating from Vikrama then came to an end, / when Puṣyamitra attained the status of king.

sanskrit_iast:
śatavarṣaṃ rājyapadaṃ tena dharmātmanā dhṛtam .
ayodhyā mathurā māyā kāśī kāñcī hyavantikā . . 29
meaning:
शतवर्षं राज्यपदं तेन धर्मात्मना धृतम् .
अयोध्या मथुरा माया काशी काञ्ची ह्यवन्तिका . . 29
text_mt: For a hundred years the royal office was held by that righteous one. / Ayodhyā, Mathurā, Māyā, Kāśī, Kāñcī, and Avantikā,

sanskrit_iast:
purī dvāravatī tena rājñā ca punaruddhṛtāḥ .
kurusūkarapadmāni kṣetrāṇi vividhāni ca . . 3.4.23.30
meaning:
पुरी द्वारवती तेन राज्ञा च पुनरुद्धृताः .
कुरुसूकरपद्मानि क्षेत्राणि विविधानि च . . 3.4.23.30
text_mt: and the city of Dvāravatī were restored by that king, / as well as various sacred fields such as Kuru, Sūkara, and Padma,

sanskrit_iast:
naimiṣotpalavṛndānāṃ vanakṣetrāṇi bhūtale .
nānātīrthāni tenaiva sthāpitāni samantataḥ . . 31
meaning:
नैमिषोत्पलवृन्दानां वनक्षेत्राणि भूतले .
नानातीर्थानि तेनैव स्थापितानि समन्ततः . . 31
text_mt: and the forest-shrines of Naimiṣa and Utpalavṛnda on the surface of the earth; / various sacred bathing places were established on all sides by him alone.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā kaliḥ sa gandharvo devatāpitṛdūṣakaḥ .
brāhmaṇaṃ vapurāsthāya puṣyamitramupāgamat . . 32
meaning:
तदा कलिः स गन्धर्वो देवतापितृदूषकः .
ब्राह्मणं वपुरास्थाय पुष्यमित्रमुपागमत् . . 32
text_mt: Then that Kali, a gandharva who vilifies gods and ancestors, / assumed the form of a brāhmaṇa and approached Puṣyamitra.

sanskrit_iast:
natvovāca priyaṃ vākyaṃ śṛṇu bhūpa dayāpara .
āryadeśe pitṛgaṇāḥ pūjārhāḥ śrāddhatarpaṇaiḥ . . 33
meaning:
नत्वोवाच प्रियं वाक्यं शृणु भूप दयापर .
आर्यदेशे पितृगणाः पूजार्हाः श्राद्धतर्पणैः . . 33
text_mt: Bowing, he spoke pleasant words: "Listen, O king devoted to compassion! / In the land of the Āryas, the hosts of ancestors are deemed worthy of worship through ancestral offerings and water-libations.

sanskrit_iast:
ajñānamiti tajjñeya bhuvi yatpitṛpūjanam .
mṛtā ye tu narā bhūmau pūrvakarmavaśānugāḥ . . 34
meaning:
अज्ञानमिति तज्ज्ञेय भुवि यत्पितृपूजनम् .
मृता ये तु नरा भूमौ पूर्वकर्मवशानुगाः . . 34
text_mt: This worship of the ancestors on earth is to be understood as ignorance. / For human beings who have died on earth, subject to their past actions,

sanskrit_iast:
bhavanti dehavantaste caturāśītilakṣadhā .
chadmanā mayadevena pitṛpūjā vinirmitā . . 35
meaning:
भवन्ति देहवन्तस्ते चतुराशीतिलक्षधा .
छद्मना मयदेवेन पितृपूजा विनिर्मिता . . 35
text_mt: become embodied in eighty-four hundred thousand ways. / The worship of the ancestors was devised deceitfully by Mayadeva.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛthā śramaṃ vṛthā karma nṛṇāṃ ca pitṛpūjanam .
iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ vihasyāha mahīpatiḥ . . 36
meaning:
वृथा श्रमं वृथा कर्म नृणां च पितृपूजनम् .
इति श्रुत्वा वचो घोरं विहस्याह महीपतिः . . 36
text_mt: Worship of the ancestors by men is useless toil and vain action." / Hearing this dreadful speech, the lord of the earth laughed and said:

sanskrit_iast:
bhavānmūrkho mahāmūḍho na jānīṣa paraṃ phalam .
bhuvarloke na ye dṛṣṭāḥ śūnyabhūtāśca bhāsvarāḥ . . 37
meaning:
भवान्मूर्खो महामूढो न जानीष परं फलम् .
भुवर्लोके न ये दृष्टाः शून्यभूताश्च भास्वराः . . 37
text_mt: "You are a fool, utterly deluded; you do not know the highest reward. / Those who are not seen in the intermediate world, void-formed and radiant,

sanskrit_iast:
ye tu te vai pitṛgaṇāḥ piṇḍarūpavimānagāḥ .
satputraiśca vidhānena piṇḍadānaṃ ca yatkṛtam . . 38
meaning:
ये तु ते वै पितृगणाः पिण्डरूपविमानगाः .
सत्पुत्रैश्च विधानेन पिण्डदानं च यत्कृतम् . . 38
text_mt: they are indeed the hosts of ancestors, mounted on celestial chariots made of rice-ball offerings. / Whatever offering of rice-balls is made by virtuous sons according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
tadvimānaṃ nabhojātaṃ sarvānandapradāyakam .
abdamātraṃ sthitisteṣāṃ piṇḍapāyasarūpiṇām . . 39
meaning:
तद्विमानं नभोजातं सर्वानन्दप्रदायकम् .
अब्दमात्रं स्थितिस्तेषां पिण्डपायसरूपिणाम् . . 39
text_mt: that becomes a celestial chariot born in the sky, granting all delight. / The stay of those who take the form of rice-balls and sweet milk lasts for a full year.

sanskrit_iast:
gītāṣṭādaśakādhyāyaiḥ saptaśatyāścaritrakaiḥ .
pāvitaṃ yattu vai piṇḍaṃ triśatābdaṃ ca tatsthitiḥ . . 3.4.23.40
meaning:
गीताष्टादशकाध्यायैः सप्तशत्याश्चरित्रकैः .
पावितं यत्तु वै पिण्डं त्रिशताब्दं च तत्स्थितिः . . 3.4.23.40
text_mt: A rice-ball purified by the eighteen chapters of the Gītā / and by the narratives of the Saptaśatī endures for three hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhatarpaṇahīnā ye dṛśyante mānavā bhuvi .
te sarve nārakā jñeyāḥ kulamekottaraṃ śatam . . 41
meaning:
श्राद्धतर्पणहीना ये दृश्यन्ते मानवा भुवि .
ते सर्वे नारका ज्ञेयाः कुलमेकोत्तरं शतम् . . 41
text_mt: Those men seen on earth devoid of ancestral offerings and water-libations / are all to be known as hell-dwellers, along with one hundred and one generations of their family.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhakarma mahāndharmaḥ śrāddho'yaṃ sarvakāraṇam .
iti śrutvā sa gandharvaḥ kalīrājo'tra dehinām . . 42
meaning:
श्राद्धकर्म महान्धर्मः श्राद्धोऽयं सर्वकारणम् .
इति श्रुत्वा स गन्धर्वः कलीराजोऽत्र देहिनाम् . . 42
text_mt: The ancestral rite is a great duty; this ancestral rite is the cause of all." / Hearing this, the gandharva, King Kali over embodied beings here,

sanskrit_iast:
natvovāca nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ prasannavadano hi saḥ .
sadā bhava mamāśu tvaṃ tavāhaṃ nṛpa kiṅkaraḥ . . 43
meaning:
नत्वोवाच नृपश्रेष्ठं प्रसन्नवदनो हि सः .
सदा भव ममाशु त्वं तवाहं नृप किङ्करः . . 43
text_mt: bowed and spoke to the best of kings, with a cheerful countenance indeed: / "Always be mine quickly; I am your servant, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
kalimitraḥ puṣyamitro bhavānbhuvi bhavetsadā .
yathā vikramarājasya vaitālasya ca vai sakhā ..44
meaning:
कलिमित्रः पुष्यमित्रो भवान्भुवि भवेत्सदा .
यथा विक्रमराजस्य वैतालस्य च वै सखा ..44
text_mt: May you always be known on earth as Puṣyamitra, the friend of Kali, / just as King Vikrama was the friend of the vetāla.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāryakaro'haṃ vai tathā tava na saṃśayaḥ .
ityuktyā ca nṛpaṃ dhīraṃ samādāya sa vai kaliḥ ..45
meaning:
सर्वकार्यकरोऽहं वै तथा तव न संशयः .
इत्युक्त्या च नृपं धीरं समादाय स वै कलिः ..45
text_mt: I will perform all your tasks; of this there is no doubt." / Having spoken thus and taken the steadfast king,

sanskrit_iast:
saptadvīpāṃstathā khaṇḍānnabhomārgānanekaśaḥ .
svapṛṣṭhasthāya rājñe ca darśayāmāsa vīryavān ..46
meaning:
सप्तद्वीपांस्तथा खण्डान्नभोमार्गाननेकशः .
स्वपृष्ठस्थाय राज्ञे च दर्शयामास वीर्यवान् ..46
text_mt: the mighty Kali showed him the seven continents, divisions, / and numerous paths through the sky as the king stood on his back.

sanskrit_iast:
āryadharmaṃ kalau sthāpya naṣṭabhūtaṃ sa vai nṛpaḥ .
tyaktvā prāṇāṃśca yajñāṃśe tejastasya samāgamat ..47
meaning:
आर्यधर्मं कलौ स्थाप्य नष्टभूतं स वै नृपः .
त्यक्त्वा प्राणांश्च यज्ञांशे तेजस्तस्य समागमत् ..47
text_mt: Having re-established the Aryan righteousness that had been destroyed in the Kali age, / that king abandoned his life-breaths, and his splendour merged into the portion of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
āndhradeśodbhavo rājā sugado nāma vīryavān .
vinā bhūpaṃ ca taṃ deśaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājyamacīkarat ..48
meaning:
आन्ध्रदेशोद्भवो राजा सुगदो नाम वीर्यवान् .
विना भूपं च तं देशं दृष्ट्वा राज्यमचीकरत् ..48
text_mt: A mighty king born in the Andhra country named Sugada, / seeing that land without a king, ruled the kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
viṃśadabdaṃ padaṃ tena karmabhūmyāṃ ca satkṛtam .
tadanvaye ṣaṣṭinṛpā babhūvurbahumārgiṇaḥ ..49
meaning:
विंशदब्दं पदं तेन कर्मभूम्यां च सत्कृतम् .
तदन्वये षष्टिनृपा बभूवुर्बहुमार्गिणः ..49
text_mt: For twenty years the office was honoured by him in the realm of action. / In his lineage sixty kings arose, following various paths.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣyamitragate rājye daśottaraśatatrayam .
tasminkāle layaṃ jagmuścāndhradeśanivāsinaḥ ..3.4.23.50
meaning:
पुष्यमित्रगते राज्ये दशोत्तरशतत्रयम् .
तस्मिन्काले लयं जग्मुश्चान्ध्रदेशनिवासिनः ..3.4.23.50
text_mt: Three hundred and ten [years] after the kingdom of Puṣyamitra had passed, / at that time the inhabitants of the Andhra country met their destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
śatārddhābdaṃ tato bhūmirvinā rājñā babhūva ha .
tadā kṣudrā narā lubdhā luṇṭhitāścauradāruṇaiḥ ..5 1
dāridramagamanghoraṃ vinā svarṇaṃ ca bhūrabhūt .
punardevaśca bhagavānprārthitastānuvāca ha ..52
meaning:
शतार्द्धाब्दं ततो भूमिर्विना राज्ञा बभूव ह .
तदा क्षुद्रा नरा लुब्धा लुण्ठिताश्चौरदारुणैः ..5 1
दारिद्रमगमन्घोरं विना स्वर्णं च भूरभूत् .
पुनर्देवश्च भगवान्प्रार्थितस्तानुवाच ह ..52
text_mt: Then for half a century the earth was indeed without a king. / At that time petty and greedy men were plundered by cruel thieves; / they fell into terrible poverty, and the earth was devoid of gold. / Being entreated again, the divine Lord spoke to them:

sanskrit_iast:
deśe kauśalake jātaḥ sūryyāṃśācya mahīpatiḥ .
rākṣasāririti khyāto devamārgaparāyaṇaḥ ..53
meaning:
देशे कौशलके जातः सूर्य्यांशाच्य महीपतिः .
राक्षसारिरिति ख्यातो देवमार्गपरायणः ..53
text_mt: "Born in the Kauśala country from a portion of the Sun is an earthly ruler / renowned as Rākṣasāri, dedicated to the path of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
mamājñayā sa vai rājā bhaviṣyati mahītale .
ityuktvāntardadhe viṣṇurdevalokānupāgamat ..54
meaning:
ममाज्ञया स वै राजा भविष्यति महीतले .
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे विष्णुर्देवलोकानुपागमत् ..54
text_mt: By my command he shall indeed be king on the surface of the earth." / Having spoken thus, Viṣṇu vanished and departed to the realm of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
rākṣasārimayodhyāyāṃ sthāpayāmāsureva tam .
āndhrarāṣṭre ca yaddravyaṃ rākṣasaiśca samāhṛtam ..55
meaning:
राक्षसारिमयोध्यायां स्थापयामासुरेव तम् .
आन्ध्रराष्ट्रे च यद्द्रव्यं राक्षसैश्च समाहृतम् ..55
text_mt: They installed that Rākṣasāri in Ayodhyā itself. / And whatever wealth had been seized by the rākṣasas in the Andhra realm,

sanskrit_iast:
taddravyaṃ rākṣasāñjitvā grāme grāme cakāra saḥ .
tāradhātoraṣṭamūlyaṃ suvarṇaṃ bhuvi tatkṛtam ..56
meaning:
तद्द्रव्यं राक्षसाञ्जित्वा ग्रामे ग्रामे चकार सः .
तारधातोरष्टमूल्यं सुवर्णं भुवि तत्कृतम् ..56
text_mt: having conquered the rākṣasas, he distributed that wealth village by village. / Gold was established on earth as eight times the value of silver;

sanskrit_iast:
āradhā(dha?)toḥ śataṃ mūlyaṃ rājataṃ tena vai kṛtam .
tāmradhātoḥ pañcamūlyamāradhātośca tatkṛtam ..57
meaning:
आरधा(ध?)तोः शतं मूल्यं राजतं तेन वै कृतम् .
ताम्रधातोः पञ्चमूल्यमारधातोश्च तत्कृतम् ..57
text_mt: he made silver one hundred times the value of brass, / and he made brass five times the value of copper.

sanskrit_iast:
nāgadhātoḥ pañcamūlyaṃ bhuvi tenaiva nirmitam .
tāmraṃ pavitramadhikaṃ nāgo vaṅgastathottamaḥ . . 58
meaning:
नागधातोः पञ्चमूल्यं भुवि तेनैव निर्मितम् .
ताम्रं पवित्रमधिकं नागो वङ्गस्तथोत्तमः . . 58
text_mt: He established lead on earth as five times the value [of iron]. / Copper is exceedingly sacred; lead and tin are likewise excellent.

sanskrit_iast:
lauhadhātoḥ śataṃ mūlyaṃ vaṅgo'sau tena satkṛtaḥ .
śatārddhābdaṃ mahīṃ bhuktvā sūryalokamupāyayau . . 59
meaning:
लौहधातोः शतं मूल्यं वङ्गोऽसौ तेन सत्कृतः .
शतार्द्धाब्दं महीं भुक्त्वा सूर्यलोकमुपाययौ . . 59
text_mt: Tin was valued by him at one hundred times the value of iron. / Having enjoyed the earth for half a century, he went to the world of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tadanvaye ṣaṣṭinṛpā jātā vedaparāyaṇāḥ .
puṣyamitragate rājye cābde saptaśate gate . . 3.4.23.60
meaning:
तदन्वये षष्टिनृपा जाता वेदपरायणाः .
पुष्यमित्रगते राज्ये चाब्दे सप्तशते गते . . 3.4.23.60
text_mt: In his lineage sixty kings were born, devoted to the Veda. / When the rule passed to Puṣyamitra, and seven hundred years had gone by,

sanskrit_iast:
kauśalānvayasambhūtā bhūpāḥ svargamupāyayuḥ .
śatārddhābdaṃ tato bhūmirmaṇḍalīkaṃ nṛpaṃ vinā . . 61
meaning:
कौशलान्वयसम्भूता भूपाः स्वर्गमुपाययुः .
शतार्द्धाब्दं ततो भूमिर्मण्डलीकं नृपं विना . . 61
text_mt: the kings born in the lineage of Kauśala went to heaven. / Then for half a century the earth was without an imperial ruler;

sanskrit_iast:
kṣudrabhūpāśca bubhuje deśe deśe ca bhārgavaḥ .
tato baidaradeśīyo nāmnā bhūpo viśāradaḥ . . 62
meaning:
क्षुद्रभूपाश्च बुभुजे देशे देशे च भार्गवः .
ततो बैदरदेशीयो नाम्ना भूपो विशारदः . . 62
text_mt: petty kings and the Bhārgava enjoyed [the land] in region after region. / Then a king from the Vaidara country, named Viśārada,

sanskrit_iast:
āryadeśamupāgamya lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ .
kṣudrabhūpānvaśīkṛtya maṇḍalīko babhūva ha . . 63
meaning:
आर्यदेशमुपागम्य लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः .
क्षुद्रभूपान्वशीकृत्य मण्डलीको बभूव ह . . 63
text_mt: having entered the Āryan country accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, / subjugated the petty kings and became an imperial ruler.

sanskrit_iast:
nānākalaiśca karmāṇi vicitrāṇi mahītale .
grāme grāme narāścakurvarṇasaṅkarakārakāḥ . . 64
meaning:
नानाकलैश्च कर्माणि विचित्राणि महीतले .
ग्रामे ग्रामे नराश्चकुर्वर्णसङ्करकारकाः . . 64
text_mt: By various arts, men creating confusion of castes / performed strange works across the earth in village after village.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmakṣatramayo varṇo nāmamātreṇa dṛśyate .
vaiśyaprāyā narā āryāḥ śūdraprāyāśca kāriṇaḥ . . 65
meaning:
ब्रह्मक्षत्रमयो वर्णो नाममात्रेण दृश्यते .
वैश्यप्राया नरा आर्याः शूद्रप्रायाश्च कारिणः . . 65
text_mt: The caste composed of Brahmins and Kṣatriyas was seen in name only; / the Āryan men were mostly Vaiśyas, and the artisans were mostly Śūdras.

sanskrit_iast:
tadrāṣṭre manujāścāsannāmamātraṃ surārcakāḥ .
ṣaṣṭivarṣaṃ padaṃ tena karmabhūmyāṃ ca satkṛtam . . 66
meaning:
तद्राष्ट्रे मनुजाश्चासन्नाममात्रं सुरार्चकाः .
षष्टिवर्षं पदं तेन कर्मभूम्यां च सत्कृतम् . . 66
text_mt: In his realm, men were worshippers of the gods in name only. / For sixty years he held his honored position on this land of action.

sanskrit_iast:
tato nṛpā mahīṃ prāptāḥ ṣaṭsaṅkhyāstu tadanvayāḥ .
puṣyamitragate rāṣṭre śataṣoḍaśahāyanī . . 67
meaning:
ततो नृपा महीं प्राप्ताः षट्सङ्ख्यास्तु तदन्वयाः .
पुष्यमित्रगते राष्ट्रे शतषोडशहायनी . . 67
text_mt: Then kings of his lineage, six in number, obtained the earth. / When one hundred and sixteen years had passed in the realm of Puṣyamitra,

sanskrit_iast:
vaidūrā nidhanaṃ jagmuḥ kalikāle bhayānake .
catuśśatāni varṣāṇi kṣudrarūpā ca bhūrabhūt . . 68
meaning:
वैदूरा निधनं जग्मुः कलिकाले भयानके .
चतुश्शतानि वर्षाणि क्षुद्ररूपा च भूरभूत् . . 68
text_mt: the Vaidūras met their end in the dreadful Kali age. / For four hundred years the earth remained divided into petty forms.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpaścānnaiṣadhe rāṣṭraṃ kālamālī nṛpo'bhavat .
kṣudrabhūpānvaśīkṛtya svayaṃ rājā babhūva vai . . 69
meaning:
तत्पश्चान्नैषधे राष्ट्रं कालमाली नृपोऽभवत् .
क्षुद्रभूपान्वशीकृत्य स्वयं राजा बभूव वै . . 69
text_mt: Thereafter, King Kālamālī arose in the realm of the Naiṣadhas; / having subjugated the petty kings, he became the sole ruler.

sanskrit_iast:
yamābhūyā bhuvi tvaṣṭrā nagarī yamunātaṭe .
nirmitā yojanāyātu kālakāleti viśrutā . . 3.4.23.70
meaning:
यमाभूया भुवि त्वष्ट्रा नगरी यमुनातटे .
निर्मिता योजनायातु कालकालेति विश्रुता . . 3.4.23.70
text_mt: On the bank of the Yamunā, a city one yojana in extent, / named Kālakalā, was built on earth by Tvaṣṭṛ, resembling [the city of] Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāryadeśa bhūpānāṃ pūjyo rājā sa cābhavat .
devānpitṝṃstiraskṛtya pretapūjāṃ jane jane . . 71
meaning:
तत्रार्यदेश भूपानां पूज्यो राजा स चाभवत् .
देवान्पितॄंस्तिरस्कृत्य प्रेतपूजां जने जने . . 71
text_mt: There he became a king revered among the rulers of the Āryan country. / Dismissing the gods and the ancestors, among people after people,

sanskrit_iast:
kālamālī ca kṛtavāndeśanaiṣadhasaṃsthitaḥ .
dvātriṃśadvarṣarājyaṃ tadbabhūva janapīḍanam . . 72
meaning:
कालमाली च कृतवान्देशनैषधसंस्थितः .
द्वात्रिंशद्वर्षराज्यं तद्बभूव जनपीडनम् . . 72
text_mt: Kālamālī, dwelling in the land of Naiṣadha, instituted the worship of pretas. / His reign of thirty-two years brought oppression to the people.

sanskrit_iast:
tadanvaye ṣaṣṭinṛpā babhūvuḥ pretapūjakāḥ .
śatābdāṃtamabhūdrājyaṃ teṣāṃ naiṣadhadeśinām . . 73
meaning:
तदन्वये षष्टिनृपा बभूवुः प्रेतपूजकाः .
शताब्दांतमभूद्राज्यं तेषां नैषधदेशिनाम् . . 73
text_mt: In his lineage sixty kings were born who worshipped pretas. / The rule of those lords of the Naiṣadha country lasted until the end of a century.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrābdaṃ tu tatpaścātkṣudrabhūpā mahī hyabhūt .
surārcanaṃ vedamārgaḥ śrutamātraśca dṛśyate . . 74
meaning:
सहस्राब्दं तु तत्पश्चात्क्षुद्रभूपा मही ह्यभूत् .
सुरार्चनं वेदमार्गः श्रुतमात्रश्च दृश्यते . . 74
text_mt: Thereafter for a thousand years the earth belonged to petty kings. / Worship of the gods and the Vedic path were seen as mere rumors.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣyamitragate rājye caikatriṃśacchate kalau .
dvātriṃśaduttare caiva tadā devāśca duḥkhitāḥ . . 75
meaning:
पुष्यमित्रगते राज्ये चैकत्रिंशच्छते कलौ .
द्वात्रिंशदुत्तरे चैव तदा देवाश्च दुःखिताः . . 75
text_mt: When three thousand one hundred and thirty-two years had passed in Kali, / while the kingdom remained with Puṣyamitra, the gods were grieved.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇacaitanyamāgamya natvocurvacanaṃ priyam .
bhagavankalikāle'dya varṇāścatvāribhūtale 1 . . 76
meaning:
कृष्णचैतन्यमागम्य नत्वोचुर्वचनं प्रियम् .
भगवन्कलिकालेऽद्य वर्णाश्चत्वारिभूतले 1 . . 76
text_mt: Approaching Kṛṣṇa Caitanya and bowing down, they spoke pleasant words: / "O Blessed One, now in the Kali age, the four castes on earth

sanskrit_iast:
bhraṣṭācārāḥ pretamayāḥ śatārddhābdaprajīvinaḥ .
devānpitṝṃstiraskṛtya piśācānpūjayanti vai . . 77
meaning:
भ्रष्टाचाराः प्रेतमयाः शतार्द्धाब्दप्रजीविनः .
देवान्पितॄंस्तिरस्कृत्य पिशाचान्पूजयन्ति वै . . 77
text_mt: have fallen from proper conduct, are given to pretas, and live only half a century. / Dismissing the gods and ancestors, they worship piśācas.

sanskrit_iast:
grāme grāme ca kughnāni pūjitāni narairbhuvi .
dṛśyante'smābhiradyaiva duḥkhitāśca narā bhṛśam . . 78
meaning:
ग्रामे ग्रामे च कुघ्नानि पूजितानि नरैर्भुवि .
दृश्यन्तेऽस्माभिरद्यैव दुःखिताश्च नरा भृशम् . . 78
text_mt: In village after village on earth, harmful things are worshipped by men; / they are seen by us today, and the people are exceedingly afflicted.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtapretapiśācāśca ḍākinīśākinīgaṇāḥ .
svapūjābhirmadāndhāśca nindayanti surānpitṝn . . 79
meaning:
भूतप्रेतपिशाचाश्च डाकिनीशाकिनीगणाः .
स्वपूजाभिर्मदान्धाश्च निन्दयन्ति सुरान्पितॄन् . . 79
text_mt: Hosts of bhūtas, pretas, piśācas, ḍākinīs, and śākinīs, / blinded with pride by the worship offered them, revile the gods and ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
ato'smāndurbalānviddhi sabalānbhūtanāyakān .
kṛpayā pāhi naḥ svāmiñcharaṇāgatavatsala . . 3.4.23.80
meaning:
अतोऽस्मान्दुर्बलान्विद्धि सबलान्भूतनायकान् .
कृपया पाहि नः स्वामिञ्छरणागतवत्सल . . 3.4.23.80
text_mt: Therefore know us to be weak, and the lords of the bhūtas to be strong. / In your mercy protect us, O Lord, who are affectionate to those who seek refuge!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā sa yajñāṃśo nadīhopavane sthitaḥ .
namrabhūtānsurānprāha māgadhe tu mahīpatiḥ . . 81
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा स यज्ञांशो नदीहोपवने स्थितः .
नम्रभूतान्सुरान्प्राह मागधे तु महीपतिः . . 81
text_mt: Hearing this, that portion of the sacrifice, dwelling in a grove by the river, / said to the humbled gods: "In Magadha there is a ruler of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
purañjayo brahmaparastasya patnī purañjanī .
madājñayā tayoḥ putro bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ . . 82
meaning:
पुरञ्जयो ब्रह्मपरस्तस्य पत्नी पुरञ्जनी .
मदाज्ञया तयोः पुत्रो भविष्यति महाबलः . . 82
text_mt: Purañjaya, devoted to Brahman; his wife is Purañjanī. / By my command, a mighty son will be born to them,

sanskrit_iast:
viśvasphūrjiriti khyāto brahmamārgaparo guṇī .
ityuktavacane tasmingarbhaṃ dhatte purañjanī . . 83
meaning:
विश्वस्फूर्जिरिति ख्यातो ब्रह्ममार्गपरो गुणी .
इत्युक्तवचने तस्मिन्गर्भं धत्ते पुरञ्जनी . . 83
text_mt: renowned as Viśvasphūrji, virtuous and devoted to the path of Brahman." / When these words were spoken, Purañjanī conceived a child.

sanskrit_iast:
daśamāsāntare jāto viśvasphūrjirmahābalaḥ .
jātamātre sute tasminvāguvācāśarīriṇī . . 84
meaning:
दशमासान्तरे जातो विश्वस्फूर्जिर्महाबलः .
जातमात्रे सुते तस्मिन्वागुवाचाशरीरिणी . . 84
text_mt: At the end of ten months the mighty Viśvasphūrji was born. / As soon as that son was born, a bodiless voice spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
puṣyamitro yathā cāsīdvarṇadharmapravartakaḥ .
tathāyaṃ bālako jāto brahmamārgaparo balī . . 85
meaning:
पुष्यमित्रो यथा चासीद्वर्णधर्मप्रवर्तकः .
तथायं बालको जातो ब्रह्ममार्गपरो बली . . 85
text_mt: "Just as Puṣyamitra was a promoter of the duty of the castes, / so this strong boy has been born, devoted to the path of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
kariṣyati paro varṇānkalindayadumadrakān .
prajāśca brahmabhūyiṣṭhāḥ sthāpayiṣyati durmatiḥ . . 86
meaning:
करिष्यति परो वर्णान्कलिन्दयदुमद्रकान् .
प्रजाश्च ब्रह्मभूयिष्ठाः स्थापयिष्यति दुर्मतिः . . 86
text_mt: He will make the Kalindas, Yadus, and Madras into other castes, / and the wrong-minded one will establish subjects consisting mostly of Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
vīryavānkṣatramutsādya padmavatyāḥ sa vai puram .
ityākāśavacaḥ śrutvā sa nṛpastu purañjayaḥ . . 87
meaning:
वीर्यवान्क्षत्रमुत्साद्य पद्मवत्याः स वै पुरम् .
इत्याकाशवचः श्रुत्वा स नृपस्तु पुरञ्जयः . . 87
text_mt: Heroic, having uprooted the Kṣatriyas, he [will make] his city at Padmāvatī." / Hearing this voice from the sky, King Purañjaya,

sanskrit_iast:
dadau dānaṃ kṣudhārtebhyo'tithibhyassaparicchadaḥ .
aṣṭau varṣasahasrāṇi cāṣṭavarṣaśatāni ca . . 88
meaning:
ददौ दानं क्षुधार्तेभ्योऽतिथिभ्यस्सपरिच्छदः .
अष्टौ वर्षसहस्राणि चाष्टवर्षशतानि च . . 88
text_mt: along with his retinue, gave gifts to guests afflicted with hunger. / Eight thousand eight hundred years,

sanskrit_iast:
karmabhūmyāṃ kalau prāpte vyatītāni tadā mune .
viśvasphūrjirnṛpaścāsīnmahābuddho mahābalaḥ . . 89
meaning:
कर्मभूम्यां कलौ प्राप्ते व्यतीतानि तदा मुने .
विश्वस्फूर्जिर्नृपश्चासीन्महाबुद्धो महाबलः . . 89
text_mt: O sage, had then passed on this land of action since the arrival of Kali. / Then Viśvasphūrji became king, of great intellect and great strength.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣudrabhūpānvaśīkṛtya sarvavarṇānnarāṃstadā .
sthāpayāmāsa vai brahme varṇe brahmaparāyaṇe . . 3.4.23.90
meaning:
क्षुद्रभूपान्वशीकृत्य सर्ववर्णान्नरांस्तदा .
स्थापयामास वै ब्रह्मे वर्णे ब्रह्मपरायणे . . 3.4.23.90
text_mt: Subjugating the petty kings, he then established / men of all castes in the Brahmin caste, devoted to Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatraviṭcchūdrakā varṇāḥ piśācā varṇasaṅkarāḥ .
guruṇḍādyāstathā mlecchā brāhmaṇāste babhūvire . . 91
meaning:
क्षत्रविट्च्छूद्रका वर्णाः पिशाचा वर्णसङ्कराः .
गुरुण्डाद्यास्तथा म्लेच्छा ब्राह्मणास्ते बभूविरे . . 91
text_mt: The Kṣatriya, Vaiśya, and Śūdra castes, piśācas, mixed castes, / Guruṇḍas and other mlecchas—all these became Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
sandhyātarpaṇadevānāṃ pūjādivividhāḥ kriyāḥ .
cakruste vedavidhinā tulyabhojanaśīlinaḥ . . 92
meaning:
सन्ध्यातर्पणदेवानां पूजादिविविधाः क्रियाः .
चक्रुस्ते वेदविधिना तुल्यभोजनशीलिनः . . 92
text_mt: Accustomed to eating together, they performed the twilight libations, the water-offerings to the gods, / and various rites such as worship according to the Vedic rule.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭivarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tena samyakkṛtā mune .
tadanvaye nṛpāścāsansahasrā bhuvi viśrutāḥ . . 93
meaning:
षष्टिवर्षं कृतं राज्यं तेन सम्यक्कृता मुने .
तदन्वये नृपाश्चासन्सहस्रा भुवि विश्रुताः . . 93
text_mt: For sixty years he ruled, [and rites] were performed correctly by him, O sage. / In his lineage there were kings renowned on earth by the thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
ayutābdāntare jātā brahmamārgaparāyaṇāḥ .
taiśca dattāni bhāgāni yajñamadhye vidhānataḥ . . 94
meaning:
अयुताब्दान्तरे जाता ब्रह्ममार्गपरायणाः .
तैश्च दत्तानि भागानि यज्ञमध्ये विधानतः . . 94
text_mt: Over the span of ten thousand years, they were born devoted to the path of Brahman; / and by them portions were duly offered in the midst of sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
daityebhyaśca surebhyaśca tulyarūpāṇi cāgaman .
vismitāśca surāssarve yajñāṃśaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ . . 95
meaning:
दैत्येभ्यश्च सुरेभ्यश्च तुल्यरूपाणि चागमन् .
विस्मिताश्च सुरास्सर्वे यज्ञांशं शरणं ययुः . . 95
text_mt: Equal shares went both to the Daityas and to the gods. / Astonished, all the gods went for refuge to that portion of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
taduktaṃ kāraṇaṃ jñātvā śakraputra uvāca tān .
vedo nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣādvivekī haṃsarūpavān . . 96
meaning:
तदुक्तं कारणं ज्ञात्वा शक्रपुत्र उवाच तान् .
वेदो नारायणः साक्षाद्विवेकी हंसरूपवान् . . 96
text_mt: Knowing the cause of what was said, the son of Śakra said to them: / "The Veda is Nārāyaṇa himself, discriminating, having the form of a swan.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛṇāṃ ca yugabhedena varṇabhedaṃ cakāra ha .
tadguṇo brāhmaṇo varṇaḥ kṣatriyastu rajoguṇaḥ . . 97
meaning:
नृणां च युगभेदेन वर्णभेदं चकार ह .
तद्गुणो ब्राह्मणो वर्णः क्षत्रियस्तु रजोगुणः . . 97
text_mt: He made the division of castes for men according to the different yugas: / the Brahmin caste has that [sattva] quality, but the Kṣatriya has the quality of rajas,

sanskrit_iast:
tamoguṇastathā vaiśyo guṇasāmyāttu śūdrakaḥ .
tṛptiṃ yānti piturvṛndā brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyaiḥ surāḥ . . 98
meaning:
तमोगुणस्तथा वैश्यो गुणसाम्यात्तु शूद्रकः .
तृप्तिं यान्ति पितुर्वृन्दा ब्राह्मणैः क्षत्रियैः सुराः . . 98
text_mt: likewise the Vaiśya has the quality of tamas, and the Śūdra from an equilibrium of qualities. / The hosts of ancestors find satisfaction through Brahmins, the gods through Kṣatriyas,

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśyaiśca yakṣarakṣāṃsi kṣudrairdaityāśca dānavāḥ .
ekavarṇe ca catvāro varṇāḥ kāyastha eva saḥ . . 99
meaning:
वैश्यैश्च यक्षरक्षांसि क्षुद्रैर्दैत्याश्च दानवाः .
एकवर्णे च चत्वारो वर्णाः कायस्थ एव सः . . 99
text_mt: yakṣas and rākṣasas through Vaiśyas, and Daityas and Dānavas through the lower [castes]. / And the four castes in a single caste—that is the Kāyastha.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtapretapiśācādyāḥ kāyasthaistarpitāssadā .
brahmavarṇe tu varṇāśca sthitāścatvāri sāmpratam . . 3.4.23.100
meaning:
भूतप्रेतपिशाचाद्याः कायस्थैस्तर्पितास्सदा .
ब्रह्मवर्णे तु वर्णाश्च स्थिताश्चत्वारि साम्प्रतम् . . 3.4.23.100
text_mt: Bhūtas, pretas, piśācas, and the like are always propitiated by Kāyasthas. / Now the four castes have been placed into the Brahmin caste.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaśaṅkaravarṇo'yaṃ tebhyaḥ pūrvaṃ hi dānavāḥ .
arddhatṛptā bhaviṣyanti tatpaścātsvargavāsinaḥ .. 101
meaning:
ब्रह्मशङ्करवर्णोऽयं तेभ्यः पूर्वं हि दानवाः .
अर्द्धतृप्ता भविष्यन्ति तत्पश्चात्स्वर्गवासिनः .. 101
text_mt: This caste is mixed with Brahman; before them, indeed, the Dānavas / will become half-satisfied, and after that the dwellers of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
ato'haṃ ca kalau ghore yuṣmadarthe mahītale .
saurāṣṭanṛpatergehaṃ svāṃśādyāsyāmi bhoḥ surāḥ .. 102
meaning:
अतोऽहं च कलौ घोरे युष्मदर्थे महीतले .
सौराष्टनृपतेर्गेहं स्वांशाद्यास्यामि भोः सुराः .. 102
text_mt: Therefore, O gods, in the dreadful Kali age, for your sake / I shall go with a portion of myself to the house of the king of Saurāṣṭra on earth."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sa ca yajñāṃśaḥ somanāthaḥ kalaikayā .
nāmnā babhūva tadgehe saurāṣṭranagarīsthitaḥ .. 103
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा स च यज्ञांशः सोमनाथः कलैकया .
नाम्ना बभूव तद्गेहे सौराष्ट्रनगरीस्थितः .. 103
text_mt: Having said this, that portion of the sacrifice, through a single part, / became known as Somanātha in his house, residing in the city of Saurāṣṭra.

sanskrit_iast:
jitvā bhūpānsvayaṃ rājyaṃ cakārābdhitaṭe mudā .
kṣatravarṇamayī bhūmistadā jātā kalau yuge .. 104
meaning:
जित्वा भूपान्स्वयं राज्यं चकाराब्धितटे मुदा .
क्षत्रवर्णमयी भूमिस्तदा जाता कलौ युगे .. 104
text_mt: Having conquered the kings, he joyfully established his own rule on the seashore. / Then, in the Kali yuga, the earth became filled with the Kṣatriya caste.

sanskrit_iast:
somanāthaḥ sa vai yajñaiḥ surānsarvānatarpayat .
śatābdaṃ ca kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tena devaprasādataḥ .. 105
meaning:
सोमनाथः स वै यज्ञैः सुरान्सर्वानतर्पयत् .
शताब्दं च कृतं राज्यं तेन देवप्रसादतः .. 105
text_mt: That Somanātha propitiated all the gods with sacrifices. / By the grace of the gods, he ruled the kingdom for a hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya rājyamayaṃ saṃvadabhavallokaviśrutam .
tadanvaye sārddhaśataṃ bhūpāścāsansurapriyāḥ .. 106
meaning:
तस्य राज्यमयं संवदभवल्लोकविश्रुतम् .
तदन्वये सार्द्धशतं भूपाश्चासन्सुरप्रियाः .. 106
text_mt: His realm, rich in rule, became renowned throughout the world. / In his lineage there were one hundred and fifty kings dear to the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
ayutābdāntare kiñcidadhike ca sukhapradāḥ .
karmabhūmyāṃ kalau prāpte hāyanā ayutatrayam .. 107
meaning:
अयुताब्दान्तरे किञ्चिदधिके च सुखप्रदाः .
कर्मभूम्यां कलौ प्राप्ते हायना अयुतत्रयम् .. 107
text_mt: Bestowing happiness over the span of ten thousand years and somewhat more. / When thirty thousand years of the Kali age had elapsed in the land of action,

sanskrit_iast:
vyatītaṃ ca tato daityā duḥkhitāḥ kalimabruvan .
purāssamābhiḥ śatābdaṃ ca tapasā vai maheśvaraḥ .. 108
meaning:
व्यतीतं च ततो दैत्या दुःखिताः कलिमब्रुवन् .
पुरास्समाभिः शताब्दं च तपसा वै महेश्वरः .. 108
text_mt: The demons, distressed, then said to Kali: / 'Long ago Maheśvara was pleased by us through penance for a hundred years,

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭīkṛtastadāsmabhyaṃ bhavāndatto hitena vai .
ardhabhāgaṃ vajramayamardhabhāgaṃ ca komalam .. 109
meaning:
तुष्टीकृतस्तदास्मभ्यं भवान्दत्तो हितेन वै .
अर्धभागं वज्रमयमर्धभागं च कोमलम् .. 109
text_mt: And you were indeed bestowed upon us then for our benefit. / Half of your body is made of adamantine diamond, and half is tender;

sanskrit_iast:
tavāṅgaṃ sundaraṃ deva kale'smānrakṣa duḥkhitān .
iti śrutvā ca sa kalirdetyapakṣavivarddhanaḥ .. 3.4.23.110
meaning:
तवाङ्गं सुन्दरं देव कलेऽस्मान्रक्ष दुःखितान् .
इति श्रुत्वा च स कलिर्देत्यपक्षविवर्द्धनः .. 3.4.23.110
text_mt: Your form is handsome, O god! O Kali, protect us who are afflicted!' / Having heard this, that Kali, who promotes the side of the demons,

sanskrit_iast:
svāṃśājjanma kalau prāpya gurjare deśadāruṇe .
ābhīrī siṃhikā nāma sihamāṃsāśanā khalā .. 111
meaning:
स्वांशाज्जन्म कलौ प्राप्य गुर्जरे देशदारुणे .
आभीरी सिंहिका नाम सिहमांसाशना खला .. 111
text_mt: Took birth from a portion of himself in the Kali age in the harsh Gurjara land. / A wicked Ābhīra woman named Siṃhikā, who ate lion-meat,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyā yonau samāgamya rāhurnāma sa cābhavat .
yathā rāhurnabhomārge dāruṇo hi vidhuntudaḥ .. 112
meaning:
तस्या योनौ समागम्य राहुर्नाम स चाभवत् .
यथा राहुर्नभोमार्गे दारुणो हि विधुन्तुदः .. 112
text_mt: He entered her womb and became [the one] named Rāhu. / Just as Rāhu in the path of the sky is indeed dreadful, the tormentor of the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā rāhuḥ kaleraṃśo bhuvi jātaḥ surantudaḥ .
jātamātre sute tasminbhūmikampo mahānabhūt .. 113
meaning:
तथा राहुः कलेरंशो भुवि जातः सुरन्तुदः .
जातमात्रे सुते तस्मिन्भूमिकम्पो महानभूत् .. 113
text_mt: Even so Rāhu, a portion of Kali, was born on earth as a tormentor of the gods. / As soon as that son was born, a great earthquake occurred;

sanskrit_iast:
viparītā grahāḥ sarve janayanti mahadbhayam .
tadbhayātsakalā devāstyaktvā mūrtīḥ samantataḥ .. 114
meaning:
विपरीता ग्रहाः सर्वे जनयन्ति महद्भयम् .
तद्भयात्सकला देवास्त्यक्त्वा मूर्तीः समन्ततः .. 114
text_mt: All the planets became adverse, causing great terror. / Out of fear of him, all the gods abandoned their images all around,

sanskrit_iast:
mahendraṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmuḥ sumerugirimūrddhani .
tadarthe bhagavāñchakrastuṣṭāva jagadambikām . . 115
meaning:
महेन्द्रं शरणं जग्मुः सुमेरुगिरिमूर्द्धनि .
तदर्थे भगवाञ्छक्रस्तुष्टाव जगदम्बिकाम् . . 115
text_mt: And went to Mahendra for refuge on the summit of Mount Sumeru. / On their behalf, the blessed Śakra praised the Mother of the Universe.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāmūrtimayī devī surānprāha śivaṅkarī .
mamāṅgadarśanāddevāḥ kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ ca vinā sadā . . 116
meaning:
कन्यामूर्तिमयी देवी सुरान्प्राह शिवङ्करी .
ममाङ्गदर्शनाद्देवाः क्षुत्तृड्भ्यां च विना सदा . . 116
text_mt: The goddess, embodying the form of a maiden, the bringer of auspiciousness, said to the gods: / 'O gods, by the sight of my body, you shall always be free from hunger and thirst;

sanskrit_iast:
bhavadhvaṃ ca tato yūyaṃ madvilokanatatparāḥ .
iti śrutvā tu te devā harṣitāḥ sambamūvire . . 117
meaning:
भवध्वं च ततो यूयं मद्विलोकनतत्पराः .
इति श्रुत्वा तु ते देवा हर्षिताः सम्बमूविरे . . 117
text_mt: Therefore, remain devoted to gazing upon me.' / Hearing this, those gods became joyful.

sanskrit_iast:
ābhīrītanayo rāhuḥ kṛtvā rājyaṃ śataṃ samāḥ .
tyaktvā prāṇānkalau līno babhūva munisattama . . 118
meaning:
आभीरीतनयो राहुः कृत्वा राज्यं शतं समाः .
त्यक्त्वा प्राणान्कलौ लीनो बभूव मुनिसत्तम . . 118
text_mt: Rāhu, the son of the Ābhīra woman, having ruled for a hundred years / And having yielded up his breath, merged into Kali, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
tadanvaye sārddhaśatamayutābdāntarebhavat .
mahāmadamataṃ ghoraṃ cirakālādvināśitam . . 119
meaning:
तदन्वये सार्द्धशतमयुताब्दान्तरेभवत् .
महामदमतं घोरं चिरकालाद्विनाशितम् . . 119
text_mt: In his lineage there were one hundred and fifty [kings] over the span of ten thousand years. / The dread doctrine of Mahāmada, which had been destroyed for a long time,

sanskrit_iast:
taiḥ punaścoddhṛtaṃ bhūmau sarve mlecchā babhūvire .
na vedāśca na devāśca na varṇāśca kalau yuge . . 3.4.23.120
meaning:
तैः पुनश्चोद्धृतं भूमौ सर्वे म्लेच्छा बभूविरे .
न वेदाश्च न देवाश्च न वर्णाश्च कलौ युगे . . 3.4.23.120
text_mt: Was revived again on earth by them, and all became Mlecchas. / In the Kali age neither the Vedas, nor the gods, nor the social orders

sanskrit_iast:
dṛśyante na ca maryādā kalikāle tadanvaye .
dvijaśeṣāḥ sahasrāśca punararbudamūrddhani . . 121
meaning:
दृश्यन्ते न च मर्यादा कलिकाले तदन्वये .
द्विजशेषाः सहस्राश्च पुनरर्बुदमूर्द्धनि . . 121
text_mt: Nor proper boundaries are to be seen in his lineage during the Kali age. / The thousands of remaining twice-born again on the summit of Arbuda,

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśāhaṃ prayatnena devānārādhituṃ kṣamā .
arbudācca samudbhūto rājanyaḥ khaḍgacarmadhṛk . . 122
mahendraṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmuḥ sumerugirimūrddhani .
tadarthe bhagavāñchakrastuṣṭāva jagadambikām . . 115
kanyāmūrtimayī devī surānprāha śivaṅkarī .
mamāṅgadarśanāddevāḥ kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ ca vinā sadā . . 116
bhavadhvaṃ ca tato yūyaṃ madvilokanatatparāḥ .
iti śrutvā tu te devā harṣitāḥ sambamūvire . . 117
ābhīrītanayo rāhuḥ kṛtvā rājyaṃ śataṃ samāḥ .
tyaktvā prāṇānkalau līno babhūva munisattama . . 118
tadanvaye sārddhaśatamayutābdāntarebhavat .
mahāmadamataṃ ghoraṃ cirakālādvināśitam . . 119
taiḥ punaścoddhṛtaṃ bhūmau sarve mlecchā babhūvire .
na vedāśca na devāśca na varṇāśca kalau yuge . . 120
dṛśyante na ca maryādā kalikāle tadanvaye .
dvijaśeṣāḥ sahasrāśca punararbudamūrddhani . . 121
meaning:
द्वादशाहं प्रयत्नेन देवानाराधितुं क्षमा .
अर्बुदाच्च समुद्भूतो राजन्यः खड्गचर्मधृक् . . 122
महेन्द्रं शरणं जग्मुः सुमेरुगिरिमूर्द्धनि .
तदर्थे भगवाञ्छक्रस्तुष्टाव जगदम्बिकाम् . . 115
कन्यामूर्तिमयी देवी सुरान्प्राह शिवङ्करी .
ममाङ्गदर्शनाद्देवाः क्षुत्तृड्भ्यां च विना सदा . . 116
भवध्वं च ततो यूयं मद्विलोकनतत्पराः .
इति श्रुत्वा तु ते देवा हर्षिताः सम्बमूविरे . . 117
आभीरीतनयो राहुः कृत्वा राज्यं शतं समाः .
त्यक्त्वा प्राणान्कलौ लीनो बभूव मुनिसत्तम . . 118
तदन्वये सार्द्धशतमयुताब्दान्तरेभवत् .
महामदमतं घोरं चिरकालाद्विनाशितम् . . 119
तैः पुनश्चोद्धृतं भूमौ सर्वे म्लेच्छा बभूविरे .
न वेदाश्च न देवाश्च न वर्णाश्च कलौ युगे . . 120
दृश्यन्ते न च मर्यादा कलिकाले तदन्वये .
द्विजशेषाः सहस्राश्च पुनरर्बुदमूर्द्धनि . . 121
text_mt:
Being capable, worshipped the gods diligently for twelve days. / And from Arbuda arose a warrior bearing a sword and a shield.
They went to Mahendra for refuge on the summit of Mount Sumeru. / On their behalf, the blessed Śakra praised the Mother of the Universe.
The goddess, embodying the form of a maiden, the bringer of auspiciousness, said to the gods: / 'O gods, by the sight of my body, you shall always be free from hunger and thirst;
Therefore, remain devoted to gazing upon me.' / Hearing this, those gods became joyful.
Rāhu, the son of the Ābhīra woman, having ruled for a hundred years / And having yielded up his breath, merged into Kali, O best of sages.
In his lineage there were one hundred and fifty [kings] over the span of ten thousand years. / The dread doctrine of Mahāmada, which had been destroyed for a long time,
Was revived again on earth by them, and all became Mlecchas. / In the Kali age neither the Vedas, nor the gods, nor the social orders
Nor proper boundaries are to be seen in his lineage during the Kali age. / The thousands of remaining twice-born again on the summit of Arbuda,

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśāhaṃ prayatnena devānārādhituṃ kṣamā .
arbudācca samudbhūto rājanyaḥ khaḍgacarmadhṛk . . 122
meaning:
द्वादशाहं प्रयत्नेन देवानाराधितुं क्षमा .
अर्बुदाच्च समुद्भूतो राजन्यः खड्गचर्मधृक् . . 122
text_mt: Being capable, worshipped the gods diligently for twelve days. / And from Arbuda arose a warrior bearing a sword and a shield.

sanskrit_iast:
jitvā mlecchāndurādharṣānnāmnā cārvabalī hyabhūt .
pañcayojanamānā sa bhūmirātmavivṛddhaye . . 123
meaning:
जित्वा म्लेच्छान्दुराधर्षान्नाम्ना चार्वबली ह्यभूत् .
पञ्चयोजनमाना स भूमिरात्मविवृद्धये . . 123
text_mt: Conquering the invincible Mlecchas, he was indeed known by the name Cārvabalī. / A territory measuring five yojanas was fashioned by that pure one

sanskrit_iast:
nirmitā tena śuddhena nāmnā cārvapurī smṛtā .
śanaiḥ śanairāryakulaṃ punastatra vavarddha ha . . 124
meaning:
निर्मिता तेन शुद्धेन नाम्ना चार्वपुरी स्मृता .
शनैः शनैरार्यकुलं पुनस्तत्र ववर्द्ध ह . . 124
text_mt: For his own growth, and was known by the name Cārvapurī. / Little by little the noble lineage increased there once again.

sanskrit_iast:
śatārddhābdaṃ prayatnena tena rājyaṃ mahatkṛtam .
tadanvaye sārddhaśataṃ nṛpāścāsaṃstadā mune . . 125
meaning:
शतार्द्धाब्दं प्रयत्नेन तेन राज्यं महत्कृतम् .
तदन्वये सार्द्धशतं नृपाश्चासंस्तदा मुने . . 125
text_mt: For half a century a great reign was maintained by him with effort. / In his lineage there were then one hundred and fifty kings, O sage,

sanskrit_iast:
ayutābdāntare vīrā mlecchamitrāśca saṅkarāḥ .
mlecchakanyodvahā ghorā nāmamātrāryyamārgagāḥ . . 126
meaning:
अयुताब्दान्तरे वीरा म्लेच्छमित्राश्च सङ्कराः .
म्लेच्छकन्योद्वहा घोरा नाममात्रार्य्यमार्गगाः . . 126
text_mt: Over the span of ten thousand years—warriors, allies of the Mlecchas, of mixed breed, / Marrying Mleccha maidens, fearsome, following the Aryan path in name only.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā malayadeśasthairmlecchairlakṣapramāṇakaiḥ .
ārvudāryaiḥ samaṃ yuddhamabhavallomaharṣaṇam . . 127
meaning:
तदा मलयदेशस्थैर्म्लेच्छैर्लक्षप्रमाणकैः .
आर्वुदार्यैः समं युद्धमभवल्लोमहर्षणम् . . 127
text_mt: Then between the Mlecchas dwelling in the Malaya country, one hundred thousand in number, / And the noble folk of Arbuda, there occurred a hair-raising battle.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣamātrāntare jitvā mālavasthā mahābalāḥ .
maṇḍalīkapadātaiśca muktamāryaiḥ samantataḥ . . 128
meaning:
वर्षमात्रान्तरे जित्वा मालवस्था महाबलाः .
मण्डलीकपदातैश्च मुक्तमार्यैः समन्ततः . . 128
text_mt: Those mightily strong ones dwelling in Mālava, having conquered within a year, / Abandoned the Aryans on all sides with district foot-soldiers.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi varṣāṇi jagatītale .
mlecchabhūpāśca śataśo babhūvuḥ svalpajīvinaḥ . . 129
meaning:
चत्वारिंशत्सहस्राणि वर्षाणि जगतीतले .
म्लेच्छभूपाश्च शतशो बभूवुः स्वल्पजीविनः . . 129
text_mt: For forty thousand years on the surface of the earth, / Short-lived Mleccha kings arose by the hundreds;

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcaviṃśatsahasrāṇi teṣāṃ saṃkhyā ca bhūbhujām .
ye tu puṇyā mahīpālāḥ pūrvajanmatapodbhavāḥ . . 3.4.23.130
meaning:
पंचविंशत्सहस्राणि तेषां संख्या च भूभुजाम् .
ये तु पुण्या महीपालाः पूर्वजन्मतपोद्भवाः . . 3.4.23.130
text_mt: The count of those kings was twenty-five thousand. / Those rulers of the earth who were meritorious, born of the austerities of previous births,

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ līlā ca munibhiḥ purāṇeṣu prakīrtitā .
nānāsaṃvatkarāḥ sarve paiśācā dharmadūṣakāḥ . . 131
meaning:
तेषां लीला च मुनिभिः पुराणेषु प्रकीर्तिता .
नानासंवत्कराः सर्वे पैशाचा धर्मदूषकाः . . 131
text_mt: Their deeds have been proclaimed by the sages in the Purāṇas. / All [the others] were founders of various eras, demonic, and spoilers of dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
navatyabdasahasrāṇi vyatītāni kalau yuge .
jātā mlecchamayī bhūmiralakṣmīstu janejane . . 132
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe pratisargaparvaṇi caturyugakhaṇḍāparaparyāye
kaliyugīyetihāsasamuccayavarṇanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ . 23
kaliyugīyetihāsasamuccayavarṇanam
meaning:
नवत्यब्दसहस्राणि व्यतीतानि कलौ युगे .
जाता म्लेच्छमयी भूमिरलक्ष्मीस्तु जनेजने . . 132
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे प्रतिसर्गपर्वणि चतुर्युगखण्डापरपर्याये
कलियुगीयेतिहाससमुच्चयवर्णनं नाम त्रयोविंशोऽध्यायः . 23
कलियुगीयेतिहाससमुच्चयवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Ninety thousand years elapsed in the Kali age; / The earth became full of Mlecchas, and misfortune clung to every person.
Thus ends the twenty-third chapter, entitled 'A Description of the Collection of Histories of the Kali Age,' in the Pratisargaparvan in the section on the four yugas, in the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
A description of the collection of histories of the Kali age

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
tataste sakalā daityāḥ kalinā ca puraskṛtāḥ .
kṛtvā ca jalayānāni harikhaṇḍamupāyayuḥ . . 1
meaning:
सूत उवाच
ततस्ते सकला दैत्याः कलिना च पुरस्कृताः .
कृत्वा च जलयानानि हरिखण्डमुपाययुः . . 1
text_mt: Sūta said: / Then all those demons, led by Kali, / Made water-vessels and went to Harikhaṇḍa.
title: Kaliyugīyetihāsasamuccayaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
manujā harikhaṇḍe ca devatulyā mahābalāḥ .
ayudhyaṃstānmahāśastrairayutābdaprajīvinaḥ . . 2
meaning:
मनुजा हरिखण्डे च देवतुल्या महाबलाः .
अयुध्यंस्तान्महाशस्त्रैरयुताब्दप्रजीविनः . . 2
text_mt: The humans in Harikhaṇḍa, equal to gods and mightily strong, / Living for ten thousand years, fought them with great weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
daśavarṣāntare sarve māyāyuddhaiḥ parājitāḥ .
mahendraṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmurharikhaṇḍanivāsinaḥ . . 3
meaning:
दशवर्षान्तरे सर्वे मायायुद्धैः पराजिताः .
महेन्द्रं शरणं जग्मुर्हरिखण्डनिवासिनः . . 3
text_mt: Over a span of ten years, all the inhabitants of Harikhaṇḍa, / Defeated by battles fought with illusory arts, went to Mahendra for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu bhagavāñchakro viśvakarmāṇamabravīt .
bhramiśca nāmayantro'yaṃ saṃsthitaḥ saptasindhuṣu . . 4
meaning:
तदा तु भगवाञ्छक्रो विश्वकर्माणमब्रवीत् .
भ्रमिश्च नामयन्त्रोऽयं संस्थितः सप्तसिन्धुषु . . 4
text_mt: Then the blessed Śakra spoke to Viśvakarman: / 'This mechanism named Bhrami, situated in the seven seas,

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā viracitastāta tatprabhāvānnarā bhuvi .
anyakhaṇḍe na gacchanti sa ca yantrastu māyinā . . 5
meaning:
त्वया विरचितस्तात तत्प्रभावान्नरा भुवि .
अन्यखण्डे न गच्छन्ति स च यन्त्रस्तु मायिना . . 5
text_mt: Was fashioned by you, dear father; by its power men on earth / Do not cross over to another continent. But that machine, by the sorcerer

sanskrit_iast:
mayena bhraṃśito bhrātrā mlecchaiḥ sārddhaṃ samantataḥ .
saptadvīpeṣu yāsyanti manujā mama vairiṇaḥ . . 6
meaning:
मयेन भ्रंशितो भ्रात्रा म्लेच्छैः सार्द्धं समन्ततः .
सप्तद्वीपेषु यास्यन्ति मनुजा मम वैरिणः . . 6
text_mt: Maya, along with his brother and with Mlecchas on every side, has been broken. / My human enemies will go into the seven continents;

sanskrit_iast:
ato naḥ pāhi maryādāṃ bhūmadhye bhavatā kṛtām .
iti śrutvā viśvakarmā divyayantramacīkarat . . 7
meaning:
अतो नः पाहि मर्यादां भूमध्ये भवता कृताम् .
इति श्रुत्वा विश्वकर्मा दिव्ययन्त्रमचीकरत् . . 7
text_mt: Therefore protect for us the boundary established by you in the midst of the earth.' / Hearing this, Viśvakarman constructed a divine mechanism.

sanskrit_iast:
tena yantraprabhāvena bhramitāste babhūvire .
bhramiyantrānmahāvāyurjjāto mlecchavināśakaḥ . . 8
meaning:
तेन यन्त्रप्रभावेन भ्रमितास्ते बभूविरे .
भ्रमियन्त्रान्महावायुर्ज्जातो म्लेच्छविनाशकः . . 8
text_mt: By the power of that mechanism, they were thrown into confusion. / From the whirl-machine a mighty wind arose, destroying the Mlecchas.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvāyorabhavatputro vātyo vātyāsamudbhavaḥ .
daityayakṣām̐śca paiśācāñjitvā jñānamayo balī . . 9
meaning:
तद्वायोरभवत्पुत्रो वात्यो वात्यासमुद्भवः .
दैत्ययक्षाम्̐श्च पैशाचाञ्जित्वा ज्ञानमयो बली . . 9
text_mt: From that wind was born a son, Vātya, born of a whirlwind; / Having conquered the Daityas, Yakṣas, and Piśācas, he was mighty and full of wisdom.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāstrivarṇāstena satkṛtāḥ .
balānmlecchānvarṇamayānkṛtvā vātyo mahābalaḥ . . 3.4.24.10
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्यास्त्रिवर्णास्तेन सत्कृताः .
बलान्म्लेच्छान्वर्णमयान्कृत्वा वात्यो महाबलः . . 3.4.24.10
text_mt: The three classes—the Brāhmaṇas, Kṣatriyas, and Vaiśyas—were honoured by him. / Having forcibly brought the barbarians into the class system, the mighty Vātya

sanskrit_iast:
śatārddhābdaṃ maṇḍalīkaṃ padaṃ bhuvi gṛhītavān .
tadanvaye sahasrāśca nṛpāścāsankalau yuge . . 11
meaning:
शतार्द्धाब्दं मण्डलीकं पदं भुवि गृहीतवान् .
तदन्वये सहस्राश्च नृपाश्चासन्कलौ युगे . . 11
text_mt: held the status of an overlord on earth for fifty years. / In his lineage, there were thousands of kings in the Kali Age.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyupakṣāstrivarṇāḍhyāḥ ṣoḍaśābdasahasrake .
vāyorjātaḥ svayaṃ brahmā vāyorjātaḥ sa vai hariḥ . . 12
meaning:
वायुपक्षास्त्रिवर्णाढ्याः षोडशाब्दसहस्रके .
वायोर्जातः स्वयं ब्रह्मा वायोर्जातः स वै हरिः . . 12
text_mt: Siding with the Wind and enriched by the three classes, for sixteen thousand years [they ruled]. / Brahmā himself was born of the Wind; Hari was indeed born of the Wind;

sanskrit_iast:
vāyorjāto mahādevaḥ sarvaṃ vāyumayaṃ jagat .
vinā vāyuṃ mṛtāḥ sarve vāyunā bhuvi jīvinaḥ . . 13
meaning:
वायोर्जातो महादेवः सर्वं वायुमयं जगत् .
विना वायुं मृताः सर्वे वायुना भुवि जीविनः . . 13
text_mt: Mahādeva was born of the Wind; the entire universe is composed of the Wind. / Without the Wind, all are dead; through the Wind, they live upon earth.

sanskrit_iast:
iti matvā tu te lokā vāyuṃ ca samatarpayan .
punastadā kalirghoro daityarājaṃ baliṃ prabhum . . 14
meaning:
इति मत्वा तु ते लोका वायुं च समतर्पयन् .
पुनस्तदा कलिर्घोरो दैत्यराजं बलिं प्रभुम् . . 14
text_mt: Thinking thus, those people propitiated the Wind. / Then again, the terrible Kali, bowed before the Daitya king, the lord Bali,

sanskrit_iast:
natvā nivedayāmāsa duḥkhito'bhūttadā baliḥ .
vāmanāntikamāgamya kalimitreṇa saṃyutaḥ . . 15
meaning:
नत्वा निवेदयामास दुःखितोऽभूत्तदा बलिः .
वामनान्तिकमागम्य कलिमित्रेण संयुतः . . 15
text_mt: and made an appeal. Then Bali was grieved. / Approaching Vāmana together with his friend Kali,

sanskrit_iast:
natvovāca sa vai rājā devadevaṃ janārdanam .
tvayā kaliḥ kṛto mahyaṃ prasannena surottama . . 16
meaning:
नत्वोवाच स वै राजा देवदेवं जनार्दनम् .
त्वया कलिः कृतो मह्यं प्रसन्नेन सुरोत्तम . . 16
text_mt: bowing down, that king said to Janārdana, the god of gods: / 'Kali was granted to me by you when you were pleased, O best of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
vātyairdvijaiḥ karmabhūmeḥ kalistu sa nirākṛtaḥ .
ekapādo vyatīto'yaṃ kiñcidūnaṃ kaleḥ prabhoḥ . . 17
meaning:
वात्यैर्द्विजैः कर्मभूमेः कलिस्तु स निराकृतः .
एकपादो व्यतीतोऽयं किञ्चिदूनं कलेः प्रभोः . . 17
text_mt: Yet Kali has been driven out from the land of ritual actions by the twice-born born of Vātya. / One quarter of the lord Kali has now passed, with a little remaining.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā samyaktu vai bhuktā bhūmirdevendramāyayā .
sahasrābdaṃ kalau prāpte mayā bhuktaṃ mahītalam . . 18
meaning:
मया सम्यक्तु वै भुक्ता भूमिर्देवेन्द्रमायया .
सहस्राब्दं कलौ प्राप्ते मया भुक्तं महीतलम् . . 18
text_mt: By me the earth was indeed properly enjoyed through the illusion of the lord of the gods. / When Kali arrived, for a thousand years the surface of the earth was enjoyed by me.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sārddhaṃ sahasrābdaṃ devairbhuktaṃ surasthalam .
tataḥ paṃcaśataṃ varṣaṃ kiñcidadhikameva ca . . 19
meaning:
ततः सार्द्धं सहस्राब्दं देवैर्भुक्तं सुरस्थलम् .
ततः पंचशतं वर्षं किञ्चिदधिकमेव च . . 19
text_mt: Then for fifteen hundred years the abode of the gods was enjoyed by the gods. / Then for five hundred years and a little more,

sanskrit_iast:
mayā bhuktā karmabhūmiḥ sarvalokasya kāraṇāt .
tataḥ sārddhaṃ sahasrābdaṃ devairbhukteyamuttamā . . 3.4.24.20
meaning:
मया भुक्ता कर्मभूमिः सर्वलोकस्य कारणात् .
ततः सार्द्धं सहस्राब्दं देवैर्भुक्तेयमुत्तमा . . 3.4.24.20
text_mt: the land of ritual actions was enjoyed by me for the sake of all the worlds. / Then for fifteen hundred years this excellent [earth] was enjoyed by the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sārddhasahasrābdaṃ kiñcidūnaṃ mayā dhṛtā .
sārddhatriṃśatsahasrābdaṃ devairdetyaistathā mahī . . 21
meaning:
ततः सार्द्धसहस्राब्दं किञ्चिदूनं मया धृता .
सार्द्धत्रिंशत्सहस्राब्दं देवैर्देत्यैस्तथा मही . . 21
text_mt: Then for fifteen hundred years, lacking a little, it was held by me. / For thirty-five thousand years, the earth [was enjoyed] by the gods and likewise by the Daityas;

sanskrit_iast: bhuktā daityaiḥ punardevaiḥ tathā devaiśca dānavaiḥ . . 22
meaning: भुक्ता दैत्यैः पुनर्देवैः तथा देवैश्च दानवैः . . 22
text_mt: enjoyed by the Daityas, then again by the gods, and likewise by the gods and the Dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā datto hi me deva kaliḥ kalivināśana .
nādhikāraṃ kṛtaṃ nātha satyaṃ satyapriyakṣama . . 23
meaning:
त्वया दत्तो हि मे देव कलिः कलिविनाशन .
नाधिकारं कृतं नाथ सत्यं सत्यप्रियक्षम . . 23
text_mt: Kali was indeed given to me by you, O God, O destroyer of distress! / Authority was not established, O Lord, who are truthful, fond of truth, and forgiving.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā balervākyaṃ bhagavānvāmano hariḥ .
svāṃśānmahītale prāpto daityapakṣavivardhanaḥ . . 24
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा बलेर्वाक्यं भगवान्वामनो हरिः .
स्वांशान्महीतले प्राप्तो दैत्यपक्षविवर्धनः . . 24
text_mt: Hearing this speech of Bali, the blessed Vāmana, Hari, / arrived upon the surface of the earth through his own portion, increasing the faction of the Daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmaśarmā tadā vipro yamunātaṭasaṃsthitaḥ .
hariṃ tuṣṭāva manasā dvādaśābdaṃ prayatnataḥ . . 25
meaning:
कामशर्मा तदा विप्रो यमुनातटसंस्थितः .
हरिं तुष्टाव मनसा द्वादशाब्दं प्रयत्नतः . . 25
text_mt: At that time, a Brāhmaṇa named Kāmaśarman, residing on the bank of the Yamunā, / diligently praised Hari in his mind for twelve years.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu vāmanaḥ śrīmānvacaḥ prāha dvijottamam .
varaṃ brūhi dvijaśreṣṭha yatte manasi saṃsthitam . .
iti śrutvā kāmaśarmā tuṣṭāva ślakṣṇayā girā . . 26
meaning:
तदा तु वामनः श्रीमान्वचः प्राह द्विजोत्तमम् .
वरं ब्रूहि द्विजश्रेष्ठ यत्ते मनसि संस्थितम् . .
इति श्रुत्वा कामशर्मा तुष्टाव श्लक्ष्णया गिरा . . 26
text_mt: Then the glorious Vāmana spoke words to that best of the twice-born: / 'Choose a boon, O best of the twice-born, whatever is in your heart.' / Hearing this, Kāmaśarman praised him with smooth speech.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmaśarmovāca
namo devāya mahate sarvapūjyāya te namaḥ . . 27
meaning:
कामशर्मोवाच
नमो देवाय महते सर्वपूज्याय ते नमः . . 27
text_mt: Kāmaśarman said: / 'Obeisance to the great God, obeisance to you who are worthy of all worship!

sanskrit_iast:
dharmapriyāya dharmāya devadaityakarāya ca .
daivādhīnanṛṇāṃ bhartre karmakartre namo namaḥ . . 28
meaning:
धर्मप्रियाय धर्माय देवदैत्यकराय च .
दैवाधीननृणां भर्त्रे कर्मकर्त्रे नमो नमः . . 28
text_mt: To the one who loves righteousness, who is righteousness, who creates gods and Daityas, / to the master of men who are subject to fate, to the creator of actions, obeisance, obeisance!

sanskrit_iast:
daivādhīnāśca te devā daivollaṅghāśca dānavāḥ .
teṣāṃ bharttā kramāddhartā tasmai devāya te namaḥ . . 29
meaning:
दैवाधीनाश्च ते देवा दैवोल्लङ्घाश्च दानवाः .
तेषां भर्त्ता क्रमाद्धर्ता तस्मै देवाय ते नमः . . 29
text_mt: Those gods are subject to fate, and the Dānavas transgress fate. / To you, the god who is their master and in turn their destroyer, obeisance!

sanskrit_iast:
putro bhava hare svāminsaphalaṃ vāñchitaṃ kuru .
iti śrutvā hariḥ sākṣādvāmano balirakṣakaḥ . . 3.4.24.30
meaning:
पुत्रो भव हरे स्वामिन्सफलं वाञ्छितं कुरु .
इति श्रुत्वा हरिः साक्षाद्वामनो बलिरक्षकः . . 3.4.24.30
text_mt: Become my son, O master Hari; make my desire fruitful!' / Hearing this, Hari himself, Vāmana the protector of Bali,

sanskrit_iast:
svapūrvārddhāddevahūtyāṃ tatpatnyāṃ ca samudbhavaḥ .
dvidhā bhūtvā mahī jātau divyāṅgau divyavigrahau . . 31
meaning:
स्वपूर्वार्द्धाद्देवहूत्यां तत्पत्न्यां च समुद्भवः .
द्विधा भूत्वा मही जातौ दिव्याङ्गौ दिव्यविग्रहौ . . 31
text_mt: was born from his own front half in Devahūti, his wife. / Having become two, they were born on earth with divine limbs and divine forms:

sanskrit_iast:
bhogasihaḥ kelisiṃha devapo daityapo hariḥ .
jitvā vātyodbhavānbhūpātkalpakṣetramupasthitaḥ . . 32
meaning:
भोगसिहः केलिसिंह देवपो दैत्यपो हरिः .
जित्वा वात्योद्भवान्भूपात्कल्पक्षेत्रमुपस्थितः . . 32
text_mt: Bhogasiṃha and Kelisiṃha, Hari as the protector of gods and protector of Daityas. / Having conquered the kings descended from Vātya, he reached the Kalpakṣetra.

sanskrit_iast:
rahaḥ krīḍāvatī nāma nagarī mayanirmitā .
tatroṣya balavantau tau dadhatuśca kalerdhuram . . 33
meaning:
रहः क्रीडावती नाम नगरी मयनिर्मिता .
तत्रोष्य बलवन्तौ तौ दधतुश्च कलेर्धुरम् . . 33
text_mt: There is a city named Rahaḥkrīḍāvatī, built by Maya. / Residing there, those two mighty ones bore the burden of Kali.

sanskrit_iast:
patnīyaṃ sarvadharmāṇāṃ sārabhūtā sanātanī .
pativratāyāṃ ye jātā narā āryāḥ surapriyāḥ . . 34
meaning:
पत्नीयं सर्वधर्माणां सारभूता सनातनी .
पतिव्रतायां ये जाता नरा आर्याः सुरप्रियाः . . 34
text_mt: A wife is the essence of all dharmas, eternal. / Men born of a devoted wife are noble and dear to the gods;

sanskrit_iast:
dūṣitāyāṃ narā jātāste sarve varṇasaṅkarāḥ .
iti sañcintya bhagavānkṛtvā kāmamayaṃ vapuḥ . . 35
meaning:
दूषितायां नरा जातास्ते सर्वे वर्णसङ्कराः .
इति सञ्चिन्त्य भगवान्कृत्वा काममयं वपुः . . 35
text_mt: men born of a corrupted woman are all of mixed caste.' / Thinking thus, the Blessed One assumed a form made of desire.

sanskrit_iast:
dine dine sahasrāṇi yoṣito bubhuje hariḥ .
tāḥ sarvā garbhamādhāya yamau suṣuvire mudā . . 36
meaning:
दिने दिने सहस्राणि योषितो बुभुजे हरिः .
ताः सर्वा गर्भमाधाय यमौ सुषुविरे मुदा . . 36
text_mt: Day after day, Hari enjoyed thousands of women. / They all conceived and joyfully gave birth to twins.

sanskrit_iast:
nāryā tayā sahodaryā remire te sahodarāḥ .
evaṃ ca bahudhā sṛṣṭisteṣāṃ jātā kalau yuge . . 37
meaning:
नार्या तया सहोदर्या रेमिरे ते सहोदराः .
एवं च बहुधा सृष्टिस्तेषां जाता कलौ युगे . . 37
text_mt: Those brothers made love with that sister born of the same womb; / and thus their diverse offspring arose in the Kali Age.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvajātāstrivarṇāśca bhakṣayitvā dinedine .
karmabhūmyāṃ vavṛdhire pakṣiṇaśca yathā drume . . 38
meaning:
पूर्वजातास्त्रिवर्णाश्च भक्षयित्वा दिनेदिने .
कर्मभूम्यां ववृधिरे पक्षिणश्च यथा द्रुमे . . 38
text_mt: Consuming day after day the previously born members of the three classes, / they increased in the land of ritual actions like birds upon a tree.

sanskrit_iast:
ubhayābdasahasrānte tairannāḥ pūrvamānavāḥ .
tadā kaleśca caraṇo dvitīyo bhuvi cāgamat . . 39
meaning:
उभयाब्दसहस्रान्ते तैरन्नाः पूर्वमानवाः .
तदा कलेश्च चरणो द्वितीयो भुवि चागमत् . . 39
text_mt: At the end of two thousand years, the former humans were devoured by them. / Then the second quarter of Kali arrived upon the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmprataṃ vartate vārtā kinnarāṇāṃ ca bhūtale .
dvikiṣkumātrāśca narāḥ sārddhā daityamayāḥ smṛtāḥ . . 3.4.24.40
meaning:
साम्प्रतं वर्तते वार्ता किन्नराणां च भूतले .
द्विकिष्कुमात्राश्च नराः सार्द्धा दैत्यमयाः स्मृताः . . 3.4.24.40
text_mt: Presently the condition of Kinnaras exists on the surface of the earth: / men are remembered as measuring only two and a half cubits, consisting of Daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā khagāḥ karmahīnāścatvāriṃśābdajīvinaḥ .
bhūmigāśca tathā te vai bhedaṃ teṣveṣu naiva bhoḥ . . 41
meaning:
यथा खगाः कर्महीनाश्चत्वारिंशाब्दजीविनः .
भूमिगाश्च तथा ते वै भेदं तेष्वेषु नैव भोः . . 41
text_mt: Just as birds devoid of ritual action live for forty years, / so too do those on earth; there is indeed no difference among them, O sirs!

sanskrit_iast:
dṛśyante cādya yuṣmābhirbhūtale kinnarā narāḥ .
dvitīyacaraṇānte ca bhaviṣyantyevameva hi . .4 2
na vivāho na bhūpaśca nodyamo na hi karmakṛt .
bhavitā ca tadā teṣāṃ dvitīyacaraṇāntike . .4 3
sapādalakṣābdamitamadyaprabhṛti bho dvijāḥ .
bhogakelyanvayodbhūtā bhaviṣyanti mahītale . . 44
meaning:
दृश्यन्ते चाद्य युष्माभिर्भूतले किन्नरा नराः .
द्वितीयचरणान्ते च भविष्यन्त्येवमेव हि . .4 2
न विवाहो न भूपश्च नोद्यमो न हि कर्मकृत् .
भविता च तदा तेषां द्वितीयचरणान्तिके . .4 3
सपादलक्षाब्दमितमद्यप्रभृति भो द्विजाः .
भोगकेल्यन्वयोद्भूता भविष्यन्ति महीतले . . 44
text_mt: Today Kinnara men are seen by you on the surface of the earth; / and at the end of the second quarter, they will indeed be just like that: / there will be no marriage, no king, no enterprise, and no performer of rites / at the end of the second quarter for them. / From this day forward for one hundred and twenty-five thousand years, O twice-born, / those born in the lineage of Bhoga and Keli shall exist on the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
ato mayā ca sahitā bhavanto munisattamāḥ .
kṛṣṇacaitanyamāgamya gamiṣyāmastadājñayā . . 45
meaning:
अतो मया च सहिता भवन्तो मुनिसत्तमाः .
कृष्णचैतन्यमागम्य गमिष्यामस्तदाज्ञया . . 45
text_mt: Therefore, accompanied by me, you best of sages, / having approached Kṛṣṇacaitanya, shall depart by his command.'

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
iti śrutvā tu munayo viśālāpūrnivāsinaḥ .
bho namaste gamiṣyanti yajñāṃśaṃ prati harṣitāḥ . .46
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
इति श्रुत्वा तु मुनयो विशालापूर्निवासिनः .
भो नमस्ते गमिष्यन्ति यज्ञांशं प्रति हर्षिताः . .46
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Hearing this, the sages residing in the city of Viśālā / joyfully said, 'Hail to you!' and will go towards Yajñāṃśa.

sanskrit_iast:
natvā sarve muniśreṣṭhā yajñāṃśaṃ yajñarūpiṇam .
vacanaṃ ca vadiṣyanti dehyājñāṃ bhagavanprabho . . 47
meaning:
नत्वा सर्वे मुनिश्रेष्ठा यज्ञांशं यज्ञरूपिणम् .
वचनं च वदिष्यन्ति देह्याज्ञां भगवन्प्रभो . . 47
text_mt: All the best sages, bowing to Yajñāṃśa, who embodies the sacrifice, / will speak these words: 'Give your command, O Blessed Lord!

sanskrit_iast:
indraloke gamiṣyāmo nākamadhyaṃ manoharam .
iti śrutvā tu yajñāṃśaḥ sarvaśiṣyasamanvitaḥ . .48
meaning:
इन्द्रलोके गमिष्यामो नाकमध्यं मनोहरम् .
इति श्रुत्वा तु यज्ञांशः सर्वशिष्यसमन्वितः . .48
text_mt: We shall go to the world of Indra, into the middle of the enchanting heaven.' / Hearing this, Yajñāṃśa, accompanied by all his disciples,

sanskrit_iast:
taiḥ sarvaiḥ saha svarlokaṃ gamiṣyati surapriyaḥ .
tadā kaliḥ samaṃ daityairbhajiṣyati mahītalam . .
kimanyacchrotumicchā te hṛṣīkottama tadvada . .49
meaning:
तैः सर्वैः सह स्वर्लोकं गमिष्यति सुरप्रियः .
तदा कलिः समं दैत्यैर्भजिष्यति महीतलम् . .
किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छा ते हृषीकोत्तम तद्वद . .49
text_mt: dear to the gods, will go together with all of them to heaven. / Then Kali, along with the Daityas, will enjoy the surface of the earth. / What else do you wish to hear, O best of senses? Speak that.'

sanskrit_iast:
manuruvāca
bhagavanvistarādbrūhi bhogakelicaritrakam .
kalau yathā bhaviṣyanti manujāstattathā prabho . . 3.4.24.50
meaning:
मनुरुवाच
भगवन्विस्तराद्ब्रूहि भोगकेलिचरित्रकम् .
कलौ यथा भविष्यन्ति मनुजास्तत्तथा प्रभो . . 3.4.24.50
text_mt: Manu said: / 'O Blessed Lord, relate in detail the deeds of Bhoga and Keli, / and how men will be in Kali, O Master.'

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
bhogasiṃhe kelisiṃhe vāmanāṃśasamudbhave . . 51
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
भोगसिंहे केलिसिंहे वामनांशसमुद्भवे . . 51
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / 'When Bhogasiṃha and Kelisiṃha were born of a portion of Vāmana,

sanskrit_iast:
jitvā daityānnaramayānnarānvātyodbhavānbhuvi .
vāmanāṃśamupāgamya harṣitāḥ sambabhūvire . . 52
meaning:
जित्वा दैत्यान्नरमयान्नरान्वात्योद्भवान्भुवि .
वामनांशमुपागम्य हर्षिताः सम्बभूविरे . . 52
text_mt: having conquered on earth the Daityas made of men and the men born of Vātya, / they approached the portion of Vāmana and became overjoyed.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu duḥkhitā devāstyaktvā mūrtīḥ samantataḥ .
kṛṣṇacaitanyamāgamya natvocurnatakandharāḥ . . 53
meaning:
तदा तु दुःखिता देवास्त्यक्त्वा मूर्तीः समन्ततः .
कृष्णचैतन्यमागम्य नत्वोचुर्नतकन्धराः . . 53
text_mt: Then the grieved gods, abandoning their forms on all sides, / approached Kṛṣṇacaitanya and, bowing their heads, spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavaṃstvatprasādena caraṇaṃ prathamaṃ kaleḥ .
bhuktā tathā mahī svāmiñjitvā vai daityaprapūjakān . . 54
meaning:
भगवंस्त्वत्प्रसादेन चरणं प्रथमं कलेः .
भुक्ता तथा मही स्वामिञ्जित्वा वै दैत्यप्रपूजकान् . . 54
text_mt: 'O Blessed Lord, by your grace the first quarter of Kali / and the earth were enjoyed, O Master, having conquered the worshippers of the Daityas.'

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ kartavyaṃ ca yajñāṃśa namaste karuṇākara .
iti śrutvā hariḥ prāha tadā śṛṇudhvaṃ surasattamāḥ . . 55
meaning:
किं कर्तव्यं च यज्ञांश नमस्ते करुणाकर .
इति श्रुत्वा हरिः प्राह तदा शृणुध्वं सुरसत्तमाः . . 55
text_mt: "And what should be done, O portion of the sacrifice? Salutations to you, O maker of compassion!" / Hearing this, Hari then spoke: "Listen, O best of gods:

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ svargaṃ gamiṣyāmi bhavadbhiḥ saha harṣitaḥ .
ato yūyaṃ surāḥ sarve devavaṃśānnarānsadā . . 56
meaning:
अहं स्वर्गं गमिष्यामि भवद्भिः सह हर्षितः .
अतो यूयं सुराः सर्वे देववंशान्नरान्सदा . . 56
text_mt: Delighted, I shall go to heaven together with you. / Therefore, O all you gods, always [gathering] men of divine descent,

sanskrit_iast:
utthāpya śīghramāgamya gacchadhvaṃ ca triviṣṭapam .
iti sūtena kathite munīnprati sumaṇḍalam . . 57
meaning:
उत्थाप्य शीघ्रमागम्य गच्छध्वं च त्रिविष्टपम् .
इति सूतेन कथिते मुनीन्प्रति सुमण्डलम् . . 57
text_mt: rousing them, coming quickly, go to heaven!" / When this was spoken by Sūta to the sages, O mind,

sanskrit_iast:
devā vimānamādāya tatra yāsyanti bho manaḥ .
sūtādīṃśca munīnsarvānsamāruhya surāstadā . . 58
meaning:
देवा विमानमादाय तत्र यास्यन्ति भो मनः .
सूतादींश्च मुनीन्सर्वान्समारुह्य सुरास्तदा . . 58
text_mt: the gods, taking celestial chariots, will go there, O mind. / Then the gods, having mounted, [taking] Sūta and all the other sages,

sanskrit_iast:
yajñāṃśaṃ ca gamiṣyanti nadīhopavane tadā .
ahlādaśca tadā yogī gorakhādyāstathaiva ca . . 59
meaning:
यज्ञांशं च गमिष्यन्ति नदीहोपवने तदा .
अह्लादश्च तदा योगी गोरखाद्यास्तथैव च . . 59
text_mt: and the portion of the sacrifice, will go to the river grove then. / And then the yogin Āhlāda, and likewise Gorakha and others,

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkarādyāśca rudrāṃśā nṛpo bhartṛharistadā .
anye tu yoganiṣṭhāśca gamiṣyanti hitapradāḥ . . 3.4.24.60
meaning:
शङ्कराद्याश्च रुद्रांशा नृपो भर्तृहरिस्तदा .
अन्ये तु योगनिष्ठाश्च गमिष्यन्ति हितप्रदाः . . 3.4.24.60
text_mt: and the portions of Rudra headed by Śaṅkara, and then king Bhartṛhari, / and others devoted to yoga, who bestow benefit, will depart.

sanskrit_iast:
taiḥ sārddhaṃ kṛṣṇacaitanyo devalokaṃ gamiṣyati .
tadā tau vāmanāṃśau ca dvitīyacaraṇe kalau . . 61
meaning:
तैः सार्द्धं कृष्णचैतन्यो देवलोकं गमिष्यति .
तदा तौ वामनांशौ च द्वितीयचरणे कलौ . . 61
text_mt: Together with them, Kṛṣṇacaitanya will go to the world of the gods. / Then those two portions of Vāmana, in the second quarter of the Kali [age],

sanskrit_iast:
yoganiṣṭhāṃ samādhāya kalpakṣetre vasiṣyataḥ .
tadaiva sakalā daityā harṣitāstairnṛbhirmuhuḥ . . 62
meaning:
योगनिष्ठां समाधाय कल्पक्षेत्रे वसिष्यतः .
तदैव सकला दैत्या हर्षितास्तैर्नृभिर्मुहुः . . 62
text_mt: having attained steadfastness in yoga, will dwell in Kalpakṣetra. / At that very time, all the Daityas, repeatedly gladdened by those men,

sanskrit_iast:
vivarānvarddhayiṣyanti pātālādyānsamantataḥ .
kalestutīyacaraṇe samprāpte kinnarāśca te . . 63
meaning:
विवरान्वर्द्धयिष्यन्ति पातालाद्यान्समन्ततः .
कलेस्तुतीयचरणे सम्प्राप्ते किन्नराश्च ते . . 63
text_mt: will enlarge the chasms all around, beginning with Pātāla. / When the third quarter of the Kali [age] has arrived, those Kinnaras

sanskrit_iast:
śanaiḥśanaiḥ kṣayaṃ bhūmau gamiṣyanti samantataḥ .
ṣaḍviṃśābdasahasre ca tṛtīyacaraṇe gate . . 64
meaning:
शनैःशनैः क्षयं भूमौ गमिष्यन्ति समन्ततः .
षड्विंशाब्दसहस्रे च तृतीयचरणे गते . . 64
text_mt: will gradually perish on the earth on every side. / And when twenty-six thousand years of the third quarter have passed,

sanskrit_iast:
rudrājñayā bhṛṅgaṛṣirbhūtapakṣo gamiṣyati .
saurabhī nāma tatpatnī janiṣyati mahābalān . . 65
meaning:
रुद्राज्ञया भृङ्गऋषिर्भूतपक्षो गमिष्यति .
सौरभी नाम तत्पत्नी जनिष्यति महाबलान् . . 65
text_mt: by order of Rudra, the sage Bhṛṅga, siding with the bhūtas, will go forth. / His wife named Saurabhī will bear immensely powerful [sons]—

sanskrit_iast:
kaulakalpānnarānghorānsarvakinnarabhakṣakān .
ṣaḍviṃśābdavayasteṣāṃ bhaviṣyati tadā kalau . . 66
meaning:
कौलकल्पान्नरान्घोरान्सर्वकिन्नरभक्षकान् .
षड्विंशाब्दवयस्तेषां भविष्यति तदा कलौ . . 66
text_mt: dreadful men resembling Kaulas, devourers of all Kinnaras. / Their lifespan will then be twenty-six years in the Kali [age].

sanskrit_iast:
śaraṇaṃ vāmanāṃśaṃ ca gamiṣyanti sakinnarāḥ .
bhogasihaḥ kelisiṃhastaiśca sārddhaṃ mahadraṇam . . 67
meaning:
शरणं वामनांशं च गमिष्यन्ति सकिन्नराः .
भोगसिहः केलिसिंहस्तैश्च सार्द्धं महद्रणम् . . 67
text_mt: The Kinnaras will go for refuge to the portion of Vāmana. / Bhogasiṃha and Kelisiṃha, together with them, a great battle

sanskrit_iast:
kariṣyati daśābdaṃ ca punastaiśca parājitau .
daityaiḥ sārddhaṃ ca pātālaṃ vāmanāṃśo gamiṣyataḥ . . 68
meaning:
करिष्यति दशाब्दं च पुनस्तैश्च पराजितौ .
दैत्यैः सार्द्धं च पातालं वामनांशो गमिष्यतः . . 68
text_mt: will wage for ten years, and defeated again by them, / the two portions of Vāmana will go to Pātāla along with the Daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛṅgasṛṣṭirmahāghorā bhaviṣyati tadā kalau .
mātṛḥ svasuḥ sutāste vai narāśca paśurūpiṇaḥ . . 69
meaning:
भृङ्गसृष्टिर्महाघोरा भविष्यति तदा कलौ .
मातृः स्वसुः सुतास्ते वै नराश्च पशुरूपिणः . . 69
text_mt: The creation of Bhṛṅga will then be exceedingly dreadful in the Kali [age]. / Enjoying their mothers, sisters, and daughters with lust, those men,

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktvā prītyā ca kāmāndhā janiṣyanti sutānbahūn .
kalestṛtīyacaraṇe samāpte tāstu sṛṣṭayaḥ . . 3.4.24.70
meaning:
भुक्त्वा प्रीत्या च कामान्धा जनिष्यन्ति सुतान्बहून् .
कलेस्तृतीयचरणे समाप्ते तास्तु सृष्टयः . . 3.4.24.70
text_mt: blinded by desire like beasts, will father many sons. / When the third quarter of the Kali [age] is completed, those creations,

sanskrit_iast:
tiryyagyonidharā ghorāḥ kṣayiṣyanti kalau yuge .
kaleścaturthacaraṇe samprāpte tu tadā narāḥ . . 71
meaning:
तिर्य्यग्योनिधरा घोराः क्षयिष्यन्ति कलौ युगे .
कलेश्चतुर्थचरणे सम्प्राप्ते तु तदा नराः . . 71
text_mt: bearing the wombs of beasts, dreadful, will perish in the Kali age. / But when the fourth quarter of the Kali [age] arrives, men

sanskrit_iast:
viṃśadabdavayaskāśca mariṣyanti ca nārakāḥ .
yathā jalamanuṣyāśca yathaiva vanajā narāḥ . . 72
meaning:
विंशदब्दवयस्काश्च मरिष्यन्ति च नारकाः .
यथा जलमनुष्याश्च यथैव वनजा नराः . . 72
text_mt: will have a lifespan of twenty years, and hellish people will die, / just like water-dwelling humans and forest-born men.

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt:
Then, all those primary hells will become filled with those men. / Thus all that was asked by you, O Manu, has been told to you by me."
Thus ends the twenty-fourth chapter, entitled "The Summary of the History of the Kali Age", in the Pratisargaparvan, also termed the Caturyugakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
namaste dharmarājāya naśca tṛptikarāya ca .

text_mt: Act in such a way, O best of gods, that we may return to our natural state." / Hearing this, the king of Dharma, accompanied by Citragupta,

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

जय जय जय निर्गुण गुणधारिन्रगजगजीवतत्त्वशुभकारिन् .
सारभूतसद्गुणमय तत्त्वैर्देवान्रचयति पाति गुणसत्त्वैः . .

sanskrit_iast:
rajobhūtatattvebhya utāśu viracati bhuvi ca narānsvayamāśu .

text_mt: From the principles consisting of passion, indeed, He swiftly creates men on earth by Himself. / The noble god who protects and destroys, upon whose head rests the burden of the world: / protect us, O Lord, destroyer of the Daityas, shining with the qualities of sport born of time!"

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: Hearing their words, the Lord quickly [decided to descend] upon the earth. / Listen quickly, O Manu, how that Lord will be born! / To the gods who had bowed down with words of homage, Viṣṇu / will speak pleasing words for the welfare of the world:

भोः सुराः सम्भलग्रामे कश्यपोऽयं जनिष्यति .

तं द्विजं विष्णुयशसं गृहीत्वा निगडैर्दृढैः .
बद्ध्वा सर्वे सपत्नीकं कारागारे दृढायसे . . 13

विष्णुकीर्त्या स भगवान्पूर्णो नारायणो हरिः . . 14

janiṣyati mahāviṣṇuḥ sarvalokaśivaṅkaraḥ .
niśīthe tamasodbhūte mārgakṛṣṇāṣṭamīdine . . 15

जनिष्यति महाविष्णुः सर्वलोकशिवङ्करः .
निशीथे तमसोद्भूते मार्गकृष्णाष्टमीदिने . . 15

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍaṃ maṅgalaṃ kurvansurāḥ prādurbhaviṣyati .

ब्रह्माण्डं मङ्गलं कुर्वन्सुराः प्रादुर्भविष्यति .

text_mt:
Bringing auspiciousness to the universe, O gods, he will appear:
Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Hara, Gaṇeśa, Vāsava, Guru,

sanskrit_iast:
vahniḥ pitṛpatiḥ pakṣo varuṇaḥ savibhīṣaṇaḥ .

वह्निः पितृपतिः पक्षो वरुणः सविभीषणः .
चित्रो वायुर्ध्रुवो विश्वे रविः सोमः कुजो बुधः . . 17

Vahni, the Lord of the Pitṛs, Pakṣa, Varuṇa with Vibhīṣaṇa,
Citra, Vāyu, Dhruva, the Viśvedevas, Ravi, Soma, Kuja, Budha,

guruḥ śukraḥ śaniḥ rāhuḥ ketustatra gamiṣyati .
padyaikaikena te devāḥ stoṣyanti parameśvaram . . 18
meaning:
गुरुः शुक्रः शनिः राहुः केतुस्तत्र गमिष्यति .
