Guru, Śukra, Śani, Rāhu, and Ketu will go there.
With one verse each, those gods will praise the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
mahattamā mūrtimayī tavājā tadāsya pūrvājjanitoha'mādau .
mayā tataṃ viśvamidaṃ sadaiva yato namastatpuruṣottamāya . . 19
meaning:
महत्तमा मूर्तिमयी तवाजा तदास्य पूर्वाज्जनितोहऽमादौ .
मया ततं विश्वमिदं सदैव यतो नमस्तत्पुरुषोत्तमाय . . 19
text_mt:
[Brahmā said:]
“Your unborn, supreme embodied form—from its eastern face I was born in the beginning.
By me this entire universe is ever pervaded; wherefore, praise be to that Supreme Person!”

sanskrit_iast:
ajasya yāmyājjanito'hamādau viṣṇurmahākalpakaro'dhikārī .
svakīyanāmnā tu mayā tataṃ tadviśve sadaivaṃ ca namo namaste . . 3.4.25.20
meaning:
अजस्य याम्याज्जनितोऽहमादौ विष्णुर्महाकल्पकरोऽधिकारी .
स्वकीयनाम्ना तु मया ततं तद्विश्वे सदैवं च नमो नमस्ते . . 3.4.25.20
text_mt:
[Viṣṇu said:]
“From the southern [face] of the unborn [Lord] I, Viṣṇu, was born in the beginning, the overseer who makes the great cosmic eon.
By my own name, indeed, it is pervaded in the universe always thus; praise, praise be to you!”

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktapāścātyamukhātsujanmā śivo'hamādau suratattvakārī .

अव्यक्तपाश्चात्यमुखात्सुजन्मा शिवोऽहमादौ सुरतत्त्वकारी .

text_mt:
[Śiva said:]
“From the unmanifest western face of noble birth, I, Śiva, in the beginning produced the essence of the gods.
By me the third great cosmic eon is made by your command; O god, praise, praise be to you!”

sanskrit_iast:
pradhānavaktrottarato'hamādau jāto gaṇeśaḥ kila kalpakartā .

meaning:
प्रधानवक्त्रोत्तरतोऽहमादौ जातो गणेशः किल कल्पकर्ता .
मया ततं विश्वमिदं सदैव तस्मै नमः कारुणिकोत्तमाय . . 22
text_mt:
[Gaṇeśa said:]
“From the northern face of the Pradhāna I, Gaṇeśa, was indeed born in the beginning as the maker of the eon.
By me this universe is ever pervaded; praise be to him, the best of the compassionate!”

sanskrit_iast:
ajārddhavaktrājjanito'hamādau marunmahākalpakaro mahendraḥ .
mayā tataṃ viśvamidaṃ svakalpe yadājñayā deva namo namaste . . 23
meaning:
अजार्द्धवक्त्राज्जनितोऽहमादौ मरुन्महाकल्पकरो महेन्द्रः .
मया ततं विश्वमिदं स्वकल्पे यदाज्ञया देव नमो नमस्ते . . 23
text_mt:
[Indra said:]
“From half the face of the unborn one I was born in the beginning as the Wind, Mahendra, the maker of the great cosmic eon.
By me this universe is pervaded in my own eon by whose command; O god, praise, praise be to you!”

sanskrit_iast:
prathānabhālākṣisamudbhavo'haṃ vahnermahākalpakaro guhākhyaḥ .
vinirmitaṃ viśvamidaṃ mayā tadyadājñayā nātha namo namaste . . 24
meaning:
प्रथानभालाक्षिसमुद्भवोऽहं वह्नेर्महाकल्पकरो गुहाख्यः .
विनिर्मितं विश्वमिदं मया तद्यदाज्ञया नाथ नमो नमस्ते . . 24
text_mt:
[Kārttikeya said:]
“Born from the eye in the forehead of the Pradhāna, I am named Guha, the maker of the great cosmic eon of fire.
By me this universe was fashioned by whose command; O Lord, praise, praise be to you!”

sanskrit_iast:
ajāmukhātpūrvagatācca jātaścādau mahākalpakaro'hamagniḥ .
brahmāṇḍametacca mayā tataṃ vai brahmāṇḍakalpāya namo namaste . . 25
meaning:
अजामुखात्पूर्वगताच्च जातश्चादौ महाकल्पकरोऽहमग्निः .
ब्रह्माण्डमेतच्च मया ततं वै ब्रह्माण्डकल्पाय नमो नमस्ते . . 25
text_mt:
[Agni said:]
“And born from the eastern face of the unborn one in the beginning, I am Agni, the maker of the great cosmic eon.
And by me this universe is pervaded; praise, praise be to you who are the cosmic eon of the universe!”

sanskrit_iast:
ajābhujāddakṣiṇato'hamādau jāto mahākalpakakaraḥ sadharmaḥ .
mayā sadevai racitaṃ samagraṃ liṅgākhyakalpāya namo namaste . . 26
meaning:
अजाभुजाद्दक्षिणतोऽहमादौ जातो महाकल्पककरः सधर्मः .
मया सदेवै रचितं समग्रं लिङ्गाख्यकल्पाय नमो नमस्ते . . 26
text_mt:
[Yama said:]
“From the southern arm of the unborn one I was born in the beginning, Dharma, maker of the great cosmic eon.
By me the whole [world] was ever fashioned; praise, praise be to you who are the eon named Liṅga!”

sanskrit_iast:
ajābhujātpaścimato'hamādau jāto mahākalpakaraḥ sa yajñaḥ .
mayā tataṃ viśvamidaṃ samagraṃ matsyākhyakalpāya namo namaste . . 27
meaning:
अजाभुजात्पश्चिमतोऽहमादौ जातो महाकल्पकरः स यज्ञः .
मया ततं विश्वमिदं समग्रं मत्स्याख्यकल्पाय नमो नमस्ते . . 27
text_mt:
[Yajña said:]
“From the western arm of the unborn one I was born in the beginning, Yajña, maker of the great cosmic eon.
By me this whole universe is pervaded; praise, praise be to you who are the eon named Matsya!”

sanskrit_iast:
pradhānabāhūttarato'hamādau jāto mahākalpakaraḥ pracetāḥ .
mayā tataṃ nātha tavājñayedaṃ karmākhyakalpāya namo namaste . . 28
meaning:
प्रधानबाहूत्तरतोऽहमादौ जातो महाकल्पकरः प्रचेताः .
मया ततं नाथ तवाज्ञयेदं कर्माख्यकल्पाय नमो नमस्ते . . 28
text_mt:
[Varuṇa said:]
“From the northern arm of the Pradhāna I was born in the beginning, Pracetas, maker of the great cosmic eon.
By me, O Lord, this [universe] is pervaded by your command; praise, praise be to you who are the eon named Karma!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍatamaso jātastvaddāso'haṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ .
mayā tataṃ trilokaṃ ca namaste manurūpiṇe . . 29
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डतमसो जातस्त्वद्दासोऽहं विभीषणः .
मया ततं त्रिलोकं च नमस्ते मनुरूपिणे . . 29
text_mt:
[Vibhīṣaṇa said:]
“Born from the darkness of the universe, I am your servant Vibhīṣaṇa.
And by me the three worlds are pervaded; praise be to you who possess the form of Manu!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍasadguṇājjātaścitto'haṃ manukārakaḥ .
mayā tataṃ ca trailokyaṃ svāyambhuva namo'stu te . . 3.4.25.30
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डसद्गुणाज्जातश्चित्तोऽहं मनुकारकः .
मया ततं च त्रैलोक्यं स्वायम्भुव नमोऽस्तु ते . . 3.4.25.30
text_mt:
[Citra said:]
“Born from the good quality of the universe, I am Citta, maker of a Manu.
And by me the three worlds are pervaded; O Svāyambhuva, let there be praise to you!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍarajaso jāto vāyurmanvantaraṃ tatam .
mayā svārociṣaṃ svāminnamaste manurūpiṇe . . 31
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डरजसो जातो वायुर्मन्वन्तरं ततम् .
मया स्वारोचिषं स्वामिन्नमस्ते मनुरूपिणे . . 31
text_mt:
[Vāyu said:]
“Born from the passion of the universe, I am Vāyu; the Svārociṣa Manvantara was pervaded
by me, O Master; praise be to you who possess the form of Manu!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍamanaso jāto dhruvo'haṃ manukārakaḥ .
mayottamaṃ ca racitaṃ namaste'stu tavājñayā . . 32
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डमनसो जातो ध्रुवोऽहं मनुकारकः .
मयोत्तमं च रचितं नमस्तेऽस्तु तवाज्ञया . . 32
text_mt:
[Dhruva said:]
“Born from the cosmic mind, I am Dhruva, maker of a Manu.
And the Uttama [Manvantara] was fashioned by me by your command; let there be praise to you!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍaśravaṇājjāto viśvakarmāhamīśvaraḥ .
mayā tataṃ raivataṃ ca namo deva tavājñayā . . 33
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डश्रवणाज्जातो विश्वकर्माहमीश्वरः .
मया ततं रैवतं च नमो देव तवाज्ञया . . 33
text_mt:
[Viśvakarman said:]
“Born from the cosmic ear, I am Viśvakarman, the lord.
And by me the Raivata [Manvantara] was pervaded by your command; praise, O god!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍadehato jātassūryo'haṃ cākṣuṣapradaḥ .
tavājñayā tataṃ viśvaṃ manurūpāya te namaḥ . . 34
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डदेहतो जातस्सूर्योऽहं चाक्षुषप्रदः .
तवाज्ञया ततं विश्वं मनुरूपाय ते नमः . . 34
text_mt:
[Sūrya said:]
“Born from the cosmic body, I am Sūrya, the bestower of Cākṣuṣa.
By your command the universe is pervaded; praise be to you whose form is Manu!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍanetrato jātaḥ somo'haṃ tu mayā tatam .
vaivasvatāntaraṃ ramyaṃ namaste manurūpiṇe . . 35
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डनेत्रतो जातः सोमोऽहं तु मया ततम् .
वैवस्वतान्तरं रम्यं नमस्ते मनुरूपिणे . . 35
text_mt:
[Soma said:]
“Born from the cosmic eye, I am Soma; by me the delightful
Vaivasvata era was pervaded; praise be to you who possess the form of Manu!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍarasanājjāto moho'haṃ manukārakaḥ .
namaste manurūpāya mayā sāvarṇikaṃ tatam . . 36
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डरसनाज्जातो मोहोऽहं मनुकारकः .
नमस्ते मनुरूपाय मया सावर्णिकं ततम् . . 36
text_mt:
[Moha said:]
“Born from the cosmic tongue, I am Moha, maker of a Manu.
Praise be to you whose form is Manu; by me the Sāvarṇika [Manvantara] was pervaded!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍaghrāṇato jāto budho'haṃ nātha kiṅkaraḥ .
nirmitaṃ brahmasāvarṇaṃ mayā tāta namo namaḥ . . 37
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डघ्राणतो जातो बुधोऽहं नाथ किङ्करः .
निर्मितं ब्रह्मसावर्णं मया तात नमो नमः . . 37
text_mt:
[Budha said:]
“Born from the cosmic nose, I am Budha, O Lord, your servant.
The Brahma-Sāvarṇa [Manvantara] was fashioned by me, O Father; praise, praise!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍavaktrato jāto jīvo'haṃ manukārakaḥ .
mayā vai dakṣasāvarṇaṃ tataṃ tatte namo namaḥ . . 38
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डवक्त्रतो जातो जीवोऽहं मनुकारकः .
मया वै दक्षसावर्णं ततं तत्ते नमो नमः . . 38
text_mt:
[Bṛhaspati said:]
“Born from the cosmic mouth, I am Jīva, maker of a Manu.
By me, indeed, the Dakṣa-Sāvarṇa [Manvantara] was pervaded; so praise, praise to you!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍakarato jātaḥ śukrohaṃ tava kiṅkaraḥ .
nirmitaṃ rudrasāvarṇaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ . . 39
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डकरतो जातः शुक्रोहं तव किङ्करः .
निर्मितं रुद्रसावर्णं मया तुभ्यं नमो नमः . . 39
text_mt:
[Śukra said:]
“Born from the cosmic hand, I am Śukra, your servant.
The Rudra-Sāvarṇa [Manvantara] was fashioned by me; praise, praise to you!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍapadato jātomando'haṃ nātha te'nugaḥ .
tataṃ vai dharmasāvarṇaṃ prabhātesmai namo namaḥ . . 3.4.25.40
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डपदतो जातोमन्दोऽहं नाथ तेऽनुगः .
ततं वै धर्मसावर्णं प्रभातेस्मै नमो नमः . . 3.4.25.40
text_mt:
[Śani said:]
“Born from the cosmic foot, I am Manda, O Lord, your follower.
The Dharma-Sāvarṇa [Manvantara] was indeed pervaded; at dawn, praise, praise to him!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍaliṅgato jāto rāhuścāhaṃ tava priyaḥ .
mayā bhaumaṃ kṛtaṃ nātha namaste manurūpiṇe . . 41
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डलिङ्गतो जातो राहुश्चाहं तव प्रियः .
मया भौमं कृतं नाथ नमस्ते मनुरूपिणे . . 41
text_mt:
[Rāhu said:]
“Born from the cosmic phallus, I am Rāhu, your beloved.
By me the Bhauma [Manvantara] was made, O Lord; praise be to you who possess the form of Manu!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍaguhyato jātaḥ ketuścāhaṃ tavānugaḥ .
bhautaṃ manvataraṃ sṛṣṭaṃ tasmai devāya te namaḥ . . 42
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डगुह्यतो जातः केतुश्चाहं तवानुगः .
भौतं मन्वतरं सृष्टं तस्मै देवाय ते नमः . . 42
text_mt:
[Ketu said:]
“Born from the cosmic secret parts, I am Ketu, your follower.
The Bhauta Manvantara was created; praise be to you, that god!”

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
iti teṣāṃ stavānsvāmī śrutvā devānvadiṣyati .
varaṃ brūhīti vacanaṃ tataṃ prati manuḥ kramāt . .4 3
iti kṛtvā tu te devā bālarūpaṃ hariṃ svayam .
namaskṛtya vadiṣyanti vāñchitaṃ lokahetave . .
keyaṃ bhavānbrūhi lokānāṃ kalpe kalpe tamudbhavam .
tathā manvantare caiva śrotumicchāmahe vayam . .45
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
इति तेषां स्तवान्स्वामी श्रुत्वा देवान्वदिष्यति .
वरं ब्रूहीति वचनं ततं प्रति मनुः क्रमात् . .4 3
इति कृत्वा तु ते देवा बालरूपं हरिं स्वयम् .
नमस्कृत्य वदिष्यन्ति वाञ्छितं लोकहेतवे . .
केयं भवान्ब्रूहि लोकानां कल्पे कल्पे तमुद्भवम् .
तथा मन्वन्तरे चैव श्रोतुमिच्छामहे वयम् . .45
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Having heard these praises from them, the Master will speak to the gods,
uttering the words, “Ask a boon,” towards the pervaded [worlds] of each Manu in turn.
Having done thus, those gods, bowing down
to Hari himself in the form of an infant, will speak their wish for the sake of the worlds:
“Tell us what this manifestation of the worlds is in eon after eon,
as well as in each Manvantara; we wish to hear.”

sanskrit_iast:
kalkyuvāca
aṣṭādaśa mahākalpāḥ prakṛteśca tanau sthitāḥ .
ādyo brahmamahākalpastatra brahmā paraḥ pumān . .46
meaning:
कल्क्युवाच
अष्टादश महाकल्पाः प्रकृतेश्च तनौ स्थिताः .
आद्यो ब्रह्ममहाकल्पस्तत्र ब्रह्मा परः पुमान् . .46
text_mt:
Kalki said:
“Eighteen great cosmic eons abide in the body of Prakṛti.
The first is the Brahmā great cosmic eon; in it Brahmā is the supreme person.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpūrvārddhātsamudbhūtāstrayastriṃśacca devatāḥ .
parārddhādbhagavānbrahmā yogidhyeyo nirañjanaḥ . .47
meaning:
तत्पूर्वार्द्धात्समुद्भूतास्त्रयस्त्रिंशच्च देवताः .
परार्द्धाद्भगवान्ब्रह्मा योगिध्येयो निरञ्जनः . .47
text_mt:
From its first half arose the thirty-three deities;
from its second half, the blessed Brahmā, who is spotless and to be meditated upon by yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminkalpe tu yā līlā brahmapaurāṇikaiḥ smṛtā .
śatakoṭipravistāro brahmapaurāṇikasya vai . .48
meaning:
तस्मिन्कल्पे तु या लीला ब्रह्मपौराणिकैः स्मृता .
शतकोटिप्रविस्तारो ब्रह्मपौराणिकस्य वै . .48
text_mt:
And the sport in that eon is remembered by the experts on the Brahma Purāṇa;
the extent of the Brahma Purāṇa is indeed one hundred crores [of verses].

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇapuruṣasyānte mahākalpaḥ smṛto budhaiḥ .
brahmāṇḍapralaye kalpo yugadaivasahasrakaḥ . .4 9
kalpāścāṣṭādaśa khyātāsteṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu .
kūrmakalpo matsya kalpaḥ śvetavārāhakalpakaḥ . . 3.4.25.50
meaning:
पुराणपुरुषस्यान्ते महाकल्पः स्मृतो बुधैः .
ब्रह्माण्डप्रलये कल्पो युगदैवसहस्रकः . .4 9
कल्पाश्चाष्टादश ख्यातास्तेषां नामानि मे शृणु .
कूर्मकल्पो मत्स्य कल्पः श्वेतवाराहकल्पकः . . 3.4.25.50
text_mt:
At the end of the Purāṇa Person, a great cosmic eon is remembered by the wise;
at the dissolution of the universe, an eon lasts a thousand divine yugas.
And eighteen eons are renowned; hear their names from me:
the Kūrma eon, the Matsya eon, the Śveta-Vārāha eon,

sanskrit_iast:
nṛsiṃhakalpaśca tathā tathā vāmanakalpakaḥ .
skandakalpo rāmakalpaḥ kalpo bhāgavatastathā . . 51
meaning:
नृसिंहकल्पश्च तथा तथा वामनकल्पकः .
स्कन्दकल्पो रामकल्पः कल्पो भागवतस्तथा . . 51
text_mt:
and likewise the Nṛsiṃha eon, and likewise the Vāmana eon,
the Skanda eon, the Rāma eon, and likewise the Bhāgavata eon,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā mārkaṇḍakalpaśca tathā bhaviṣyakalpakaḥ .
liṅgakalpastathā jñeyastathā brahmāṇḍakalpakaḥ . . 52
meaning:
तथा मार्कण्डकल्पश्च तथा भविष्यकल्पकः .
लिङ्गकल्पस्तथा ज्ञेयस्तथा ब्रह्माण्डकल्पकः . . 52
text_mt:
and likewise the Mārkaṇḍa eon, and likewise the Bhaviṣya eon,
the Liṅga eon is to be known as well, and likewise the Brahmāṇḍa eon,

sanskrit_iast:
agnikalpo vāyukalpaḥ padmakalpastathaiva ca .
śivakalpo viṣṇukalpo brahmakalpastathā kramāt . . 53
meaning:
अग्निकल्पो वायुकल्पः पद्मकल्पस्तथैव च .
शिवकल्पो विष्णुकल्पो ब्रह्मकल्पस्तथा क्रमात् . . 53
text_mt:
the Agni eon, the Vāyu eon, and likewise the Padma eon,
the Śiva eon, the Viṣṇu eon, and the Brahma eon, in that order.

sanskrit_iast:
dvisahasramitāvartaireṣāṃ kalpo mahānsmṛtaḥ .
sahasrayugaparyantaṃ brahmāṇḍāyuḥ prakīrtitam . . 54
meaning:
द्विसहस्रमितावर्तैरेषां कल्पो महान्स्मृतः .
सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तं ब्रह्माण्डायुः प्रकीर्तितम् . . 54
text_mt:
A great cosmic eon of these is remembered as measuring two thousand revolutions;
the lifespan of the universe is proclaimed as lasting up to a thousand yugas.

sanskrit_iast:
yannāmnā ca smṛtaḥ kalpastasmājjāto virāḍayam ..
caturdaśamanūnāṃ ca madhye kalpaḥ sa kālavān.. 55..
meaning:
यन्नाम्ना च स्मृतः कल्पस्तस्माज्जातो विराडयम् ..
चतुर्दशमनूनां च मध्ये कल्पः स कालवान्.. 55..
text_mt:
By whose name an eon is remembered, from him this Virāj was born;
and within the fourteen Manus, that eon possesses its divisions of time.

sanskrit_iast:
svāyaṃbhuvāṃtare yadvai jāṃtaṃjātaṃ caturyugam..
tasmiṃścaturyuge sarve nṛṇāmāyurhare śṛṇu ..56..
meaning:
स्वायंभुवांतरे यद्वै जांतंजातं चतुर्युगम्..
तस्मिंश्चतुर्युगे सर्वे नृणामायुर्हरे शृणु ..56..
text_mt:
The four-age cycle that was born repeatedly during the interval of Svāyambhuva—
hear, O Hari, the lifespan of men in that four-age cycle:

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣābdaṃ vai satyayuge tretāyāmayutābdakam ..
dvāpare ca sahasrābdaṃ kalau cāyuśśatābdakam..57..
meaning:
लक्षाब्दं वै सत्ययुगे त्रेतायामयुताब्दकम् ..
द्वापरे च सहस्राब्दं कलौ चायुश्शताब्दकम्..57..
text_mt:
one hundred thousand years in the Satya-yuga, ten thousand years in the Tretā,
one thousand years in the Dvāpara, and a lifespan of one hundred years in the Kali.”

sanskrit_iast:
svārociṣe'ntare aiva jātaṃjātaṃ caturyugam ..
śṛṇu tatra nṛṇāmāyussatyeśītisahasrakam .. 58 ..
meaning:
स्वारोचिषेऽन्तरे ऐव जातंजातं चतुर्युगम् ..
शृणु तत्र नृणामायुस्सत्येशीतिसहस्रकम् .. 58 ..
text_mt:
In the Svārociṣa period, each four-age cycle was born.
Hear the lifespan of men there: in the Satya [age], eighty thousand [years];

sanskrit_iast:
tretāyāṃ ca tadarddhābdaṃ dvāpare tu tadarddhakam ..
kalau dvika sahasrābdaṃ nṛṇāmāyuḥ prakīrtitam .. 59 ..
meaning:
त्रेतायां च तदर्द्धाब्दं द्वापरे तु तदर्द्धकम् ..
कलौ द्विक सहस्राब्दं नृणामायुः प्रकीर्तितम् .. 59 ..
text_mt:
and half of that number of years in the Tretā, but half of that in the Dvāpara;
in the Kali [age], the lifespan of men is declared to be two thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
auttamasyāntare caiva satye ṣaṣṭisahasrakam ..
tretāyāṃ ca tadarddhābdaṃ dvāpare tu tadarddhakam ..3.4.25.60..
meaning:
औत्तमस्यान्तरे चैव सत्ये षष्टिसहस्रकम् ..
त्रेतायां च तदर्द्धाब्दं द्वापरे तु तदर्द्धकम् ..3.4.25.60..
text_mt:
And in the period of Auttama, in the Satya, [it is] sixty thousand [years];
and half of that number of years in the Tretā, but half of that in the Dvāpara;

sanskrit_iast:
kalau sārddhasahasrābdaṃ nṛṇāmāyuḥ prakīrtitam ..
tāmasāntarake caiva ṣaṭtriṃśābdasahasrakam .. 61 ..
meaning:
कलौ सार्द्धसहस्राब्दं नृणामायुः प्रकीर्तितम् ..
तामसान्तरके चैव षट्त्रिंशाब्दसहस्रकम् .. 61 ..
text_mt:
in the Kali, the lifespan of men is declared to be one thousand five hundred years.
And in the Tāmasa period, thirty-six thousand years

sanskrit_iast:
nṛṇāmāyuḥ satyayuge tretāyāṃ ca tadarddhakam ..
dvāpare ca tadarddhābdaṃ kalau varṣasahasrakam .. 62 ..
meaning:
नृणामायुः सत्ययुगे त्रेतायां च तदर्द्धकम् ..
द्वापरे च तदर्द्धाब्दं कलौ वर्षसहस्रकम् .. 62 ..
text_mt:
[is] the lifespan of men in the Satya age, and half of that in the Tretā;
and half of that number of years in the Dvāpara, [and] one thousand years in the Kali.

sanskrit_iast:
raivatāntarake caiva satye triṃśatsahasrakam ..
tretāyāṃ ca tadarddhābdaṃ dvāpare ca tadarddhakam .. 63 ..
meaning:
रैवतान्तरके चैव सत्ये त्रिंशत्सहस्रकम् ..
त्रेतायां च तदर्द्धाब्दं द्वापरे च तदर्द्धकम् .. 63 ..
text_mt:
And in the Raivata period, in the Satya, [it is] thirty thousand [years];
and half of that number of years in the Tretā, but half of that in the Dvāpara;

sanskrit_iast:
kalau cāṣṭaśatābdāyurnṛṇāṃ vedaiḥ prakīrtitam ..
cākṣuṣāntarake caiva satye turyasahasrakam.. 64 ..
meaning:
कलौ चाष्टशताब्दायुर्नृणां वेदैः प्रकीर्तितम् ..
चाक्षुषान्तरके चैव सत्ये तुर्यसहस्रकम्.. 64 ..
text_mt:
and in the Kali, the lifespan of men is declared by the Vedas to be eight hundred years.
And in the Cākṣuṣa period, in the Satya, [it is] four thousand [years];

sanskrit_iast:
tretāyāṃ trisahasrābdaṃ dvāpare dvisahasrakam ..
kalau sahasra varṣāntaṃ nṛṇāmāyuḥ prakīrtitam.. 65 ..
meaning:
त्रेतायां त्रिसहस्राब्दं द्वापरे द्विसहस्रकम् ..
कलौ सहस्र वर्षान्तं नृणामायुः प्रकीर्तितम्.. 65 ..
text_mt:
in the Tretā, three thousand years; in the Dvāpara, two thousand;
[and] in the Kali, the lifespan of men is declared to end at a thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvatentare caiva satye turyasahasrakam ..
tretāyāṃ triśatābdaṃ ca dvāpare dviśatābdakam .. 66 ..
meaning:
वैवस्वतेन्तरे चैव सत्ये तुर्यसहस्रकम् ..
त्रेतायां त्रिशताब्दं च द्वापरे द्विशताब्दकम् .. 66 ..
text_mt:
And in the Vaivasvata period, in the Satya, [it is] four thousand [years];
and in the Tretā, three hundred years; and in the Dvāpara, two hundred years;

sanskrit_iast:
kalau śatābdakaṃ proktamāyurvedaistathā nṛṇām ..
sāvarṇike'ntare deva nṛṇāṃ viṃśatsahasrakam .. 67 ..
meaning:
कलौ शताब्दकं प्रोक्तमायुर्वेदैस्तथा नृणाम् ..
सावर्णिकेऽन्तरे देव नृणां विंशत्सहस्रकम् .. 67 ..
text_mt:
in the Kali, the lifespan of men is likewise stated by the Vedas to be a hundred years.
In the Sāvarṇika period, O god, twenty thousand [years] of men

sanskrit_iast:
āyuḥ satye tadarddhaṃ tu tretāyāṃ ca prakīrtitam ..
dvāpare ca tadarddhābdaṃ tadarddhābdaṃ tu vai kalau .. 68 ..
meaning:
आयुः सत्ये तदर्द्धं तु त्रेतायां च प्रकीर्तितम् ..
द्वापरे च तदर्द्धाब्दं तदर्द्धाब्दं तु वै कलौ .. 68 ..
text_mt:
[is] the lifespan in the Satya, but half of that is declared in the Tretā;
and half of that number of years in the Dvāpara, and indeed half of that number of years in the Kali.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmasāvarṇike caiva satye daśasahasrakam ..
tretāyāṃ ca tadarddhābdaṃ dvāpare tu tadarddhakam .. .. 69 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मसावर्णिके चैव सत्ये दशसहस्रकम् ..
त्रेतायां च तदर्द्धाब्दं द्वापरे तु तदर्द्धकम् .. .. 69 ..
text_mt:
And in the Brahma-sāvarṇika, in the Satya, [it is] ten thousand [years];
and half of that number of years in the Tretā, but half of that in the Dvāpara;

sanskrit_iast:
kalau caiva tadarddhābdaṃ nṛṇāmāyuḥ prakīrtitam..
dakṣasāvarṇike caiva tathābdāyuścaturyuge .. 3.4.25.70 ..
meaning:
कलौ चैव तदर्द्धाब्दं नृणामायुः प्रकीर्तितम्..
दक्षसावर्णिके चैव तथाब्दायुश्चतुर्युगे .. 3.4.25.70 ..
text_mt:
and in the Kali, the lifespan of men is declared to be half of that number of years.
And in the Dakṣa-sāvarṇika, the lifespan in years in the four-age cycle is the same.

sanskrit_iast:
rudrasāvarṇike caiva satye cāṣṭasahasrakam ..
tretāyāṃ tadarddhābdaṃ dvāpare ca tadarddhakam .. 71 ..
meaning:
रुद्रसावर्णिके चैव सत्ये चाष्टसहस्रकम् ..
त्रेतायां तदर्द्धाब्दं द्वापरे च तदर्द्धकम् .. 71 ..
text_mt:
And in the Rudra-sāvarṇika, in the Satya, [it is] eight thousand [years];
half of that number of years in the Tretā, and half of that in the Dvāpara;

sanskrit_iast:
kalau tadarddhakaṃ jñeyaṃ nṛṇāmāyuḥ purātane ..
dharmasāvarṇike caiva tathābdāyuścaturyuge .. 72 ..
meaning:
कलौ तदर्द्धकं ज्ञेयं नृणामायुः पुरातने ..
धर्मसावर्णिके चैव तथाब्दायुश्चतुर्युगे .. 72 ..
text_mt:
in the Kali, the lifespan of men of old is to be known as half of that.
And in the Dharma-sāvarṇika, the lifespan in years in the four-age cycle is the same.

sanskrit_iast:
bhauma manvaṃtare caiva satye turyasahasrakam ..
tretāyāṃ trisahasrābdaṃ dvāpare ca tadarddhakam .. 73 ..
meaning:
भौम मन्वंतरे चैव सत्ये तुर्यसहस्रकम् ..
त्रेतायां त्रिसहस्राब्दं द्वापरे च तदर्द्धकम् .. 73 ..
text_mt:
And in the Bhauma manvantara, in the Satya, [it is] four thousand [years];
three thousand years in the Tretā, and half of that in the Dvāpara;

sanskrit_iast:
kalau tadarddhakaṃ jñeyaṃ narāyuścārṣasammatam ..
bhautamanvaṃtare caiva satye turyaśatābdakam.. 74 ..
meaning:
कलौ तदर्द्धकं ज्ञेयं नरायुश्चार्षसम्मतम् ..
भौतमन्वंतरे चैव सत्ये तुर्यशताब्दकम्.. 74 ..
text_mt:
in the Kali, the lifespan of men is to be known as half of that, agreed upon by the ṛṣis.
And in the Bhauta manvantara, in the Satya, [it is] four hundred years;

sanskrit_iast:
tretāyāṃ triśatābdaṃ ca dvāpare tu tadarddhakam ..
tadarddhakaṃ kalau ghore nṛṇāmāyuḥ prakīrtitam .. 75 ..
meaning:
त्रेतायां त्रिशताब्दं च द्वापरे तु तदर्द्धकम् ..
तदर्द्धकं कलौ घोरे नृणामायुः प्रकीर्तितम् .. 75 ..
text_mt:
and in the Tretā, three hundred years, but in the Dvāpara, half of that;
half of that is declared to be the lifespan of men in the dreadful Kali.

sanskrit_iast:
manvaṃtare tu yannāmnā bhūpāścāsaṃścaturyuge ..
tannāmnā ca nṛpā jātāsteṣāṃ līlāḥ pṛthakpṛthak .. 76 ..
meaning:
मन्वंतरे तु यन्नाम्ना भूपाश्चासंश्चतुर्युगे ..
तन्नाम्ना च नृपा जातास्तेषां लीलाः पृथक्पृथक् .. 76 ..
text_mt:
In a manvantara, by whichever name kings existed in the four-age cycle,
kings were born by that name; their deeds are each distinct.

sanskrit_iast:
evamanyatra vai jñeyaṃ yuge turye manau manau ..
yo manustasya vaṃśāśca divyaikayugasaptatau .. 77 ..
meaning:
एवमन्यत्र वै ज्ञेयं युगे तुर्ये मनौ मनौ ..
यो मनुस्तस्य वंशाश्च दिव्यैकयुगसप्ततौ .. 77 ..
text_mt:
Thus it is to be understood elsewhere, in the fourth age, in Manu after Manu:
whoever is the Manu, his lineages also exist during seventy-one divine [four-age] cycles.

sanskrit_iast:
yugāṃte karmabhūmeśca layaḥ kalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ ..
manvante sarvabhūmeśca pralayaḥ sa ca kalpakaḥ .. 78 ..
meaning:
युगांते कर्मभूमेश्च लयः कल्पः स वै स्मृतः ..
मन्वन्ते सर्वभूमेश्च प्रलयः स च कल्पकः .. 78 ..
text_mt:
At the end of an age, there is the dissolution of the land of religious action; that is indeed remembered as a kalpa.
At the end of a Manu's period, there is a cosmic dissolution of the entire earth, and that is a minor kalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇa puruṣasyaiva dinānte pralayo hi yaḥ ..
mukhyakalpaḥ sa vai jñeyaḥ sarvalokavināśakaḥ .. 79 ..
meaning:
पुराण पुरुषस्यैव दिनान्ते प्रलयो हि यः ..
मुख्यकल्पः स वै ज्ञेयः सर्वलोकविनाशकः .. 79 ..
text_mt:
The dissolution that occurs at the end of the day of the Ancient Person—
that is to be known as the primary kalpa, destroying all worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍviṃśatkalpasāhasrairmahākalpo hi yaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣo meṣarāśau samāsthitaḥ ..3.4.25.80..
meaning:
षड्विंशत्कल्पसाहस्रैर्महाकल्पो हि यः स्मृतः ..
यदा पुराणपुरुषो मेषराशौ समास्थितः ..3.4.25.80..
text_mt:
By twenty-six thousand kalpas, a mahākalpa is indeed remembered.
When the Ancient Person stood in the sign of Aries,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā brahmā suraiḥ sārddhaṃ bhūpaṃ svāyaṃbhuvaṃ gataḥ ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣo makare ca samāgataḥ ..81..
meaning:
तदा ब्रह्मा सुरैः सार्द्धं भूपं स्वायंभुवं गतः ..
यदा पुराणपुरुषो मकरे च समागतः ..81..
text_mt:
then Brahmā, together with the gods, went to King Svāyambhuva.
When the Ancient Person arrived in Capricorn,

sanskrit_iast:
svāyaṃbhuvamanormadhye vārāho'bhūtsa vai bhuvi ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣo gataḥ siṃhe svakecchayā .. 82 ..
meaning:
स्वायंभुवमनोर्मध्ये वाराहोऽभूत्स वै भुवि ..
यदा पुराणपुरुषो गतः सिंहे स्वकेच्छया .. 82 ..
text_mt:
in the midst of the Manu Svāyambhuva, he became the Boar on earth.
When the Ancient Person went into Leo by his own will,

sanskrit_iast:
svārociṣamanorante nṛsiṃho'bhūtsa vai bhuvi ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣo vṛṣarāśau samāsthitaḥ .. 83 ..
meaning:
स्वारोचिषमनोरन्ते नृसिंहोऽभूत्स वै भुवि ..
यदा पुराणपुरुषो वृषराशौ समास्थितः .. 83 ..
text_mt:
at the end of the Manu Svārociṣa, he became the Man-Lion on earth.
When the Ancient Person stood in the sign of Taurus,

sanskrit_iast:
tadauttamamanormadhye rudro'bhūtsagaṇo bhuvi ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣo mīnarāśau samāsthitaḥ .. 84 ..
meaning:
तदौत्तममनोर्मध्ये रुद्रोऽभूत्सगणो भुवि ..
यदा पुराणपुरुषो मीनराशौ समास्थितः .. 84 ..
text_mt:
then, in the midst of the Manu Auttama, Rudra arose on earth with his attendants.
When the Ancient Person stood in the sign of Pisces,

sanskrit_iast:
tāmasānte'bhavanmatsyaḥ sa vai bhuvi sanātanaḥ ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣo yugmarāśau samāsthitaḥ .. 85 ..
meaning:
तामसान्तेऽभवन्मत्स्यः स वै भुवि सनातनः ..
यदा पुराणपुरुषो युग्मराशौ समास्थितः .. 85 ..
text_mt:
at the end of Tāmasa, he, the eternal one, became the Fish on earth.
When the Ancient Person stood in the sign of Gemini,

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvatamanormadhye kṛṣṇobhūdbhuvi sa prabhuḥ ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣaḥ karkarāśau samāsthitaḥ .. 86 ..
meaning:
वैवस्वतमनोर्मध्ये कृष्णोभूद्भुवि स प्रभुः ..
यदा पुराणपुरुषः कर्कराशौ समास्थितः .. 86 ..
text_mt:
in the midst of the Manu Vaivasvata, he, the Lord, became Kṛṣṇa on earth.
When the Ancient Person stood in the sign of Cancer,

sanskrit_iast:
raivatānte'bhavatkūrmaḥ sa vai bhuvi sanātanaḥ ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣaḥ kanyārāśau samāsthitaḥ .. 87 ..
meaning:
रैवतान्तेऽभवत्कूर्मः स वै भुवि सनातनः ..
यदा पुराणपुरुषः कन्याराशौ समास्थितः .. 87 ..
text_mt:
at the end of Raivata, he, the eternal one, became the Tortoise on earth.
When the Ancient Person stood in the sign of Virgo,

sanskrit_iast:
cākṣuṣānte jāmadagnyo'bhavadrāmaḥ sa vai bhuvi ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣaḥ prāpto'lau ca svakecchayā .. 88 ..
meaning:
चाक्षुषान्ते जामदग्न्योऽभवद्रामः स वै भुवि ..
यदा पुराणपुरुषः प्राप्तोऽलौ च स्वकेच्छया .. 88 ..
text_mt:
at the end of Cākṣuṣa, he became Rāma Jāmadagnya on earth.
When the Ancient Person reached Scorpio by his own will,

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvatamanorādau vāmano'bhūtsa vai bhuvi ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣastulārāśau samāsthitaḥ .. 89 ..
meaning:
वैवस्वतमनोरादौ वामनोऽभूत्स वै भुवि ..
यदा पुराणपुरुषस्तुलाराशौ समास्थितः .. 89 ..
text_mt:
at the beginning of the Manu Vaivasvata, he became the Dwarf on earth.
When the Ancient Person stood in the sign of Libra,

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvatamanormadhye kalkī nāmnāhamāgataḥ ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣaḥ kumbharāśau samāsthitaḥ ..3.4.25.90..
meaning:
वैवस्वतमनोर्मध्ये कल्की नाम्नाहमागतः ..
यदा पुराणपुरुषः कुम्भराशौ समास्थितः ..3.4.25.90..
text_mt:
in the midst of the Manu Vaivasvata, I arrived under the name Kalkī.
When the Ancient Person stood in the sign of Aquarius,

sanskrit_iast:
sāvarṇikādau bhavitā buddho nāmnā sa vai bhuvi ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣo dhanurāśau samāsthitaḥ .. 91 ..
meaning:
सावर्णिकादौ भविता बुद्धो नाम्ना स वै भुवि ..
यदा पुराणपुरुषो धनुराशौ समास्थितः .. 91 ..
text_mt:
at the beginning of Sāvarṇika, he will be on earth under the name Buddha.
When the Ancient Person stood in the sign of Sagittarius,

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvatamanormadhye rāmo dāśarathirbhuvi ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣo nakrarāśau samāsthitaḥ .. 92 ..
meaning:
वैवस्वतमनोर्मध्ये रामो दाशरथिर्भुवि ..
यदा पुराणपुरुषो नक्रराशौ समास्थितः .. 92 ..
text_mt:
[he was] Rāma, son of Daśaratha, on earth in the midst of the Manu Vaivasvata.
When the Ancient Person stood in the sign of Capricorn,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapūjyāvatāraśca na bhavedvai kadācana ..
asmiṃścaturyuge devāḥ purāṇapuruṣasya hi .. 93 ..
meaning:
सर्वपूज्यावतारश्च न भवेद्वै कदाचन ..
अस्मिंश्चतुर्युगे देवाः पुराणपुरुषस्य हि .. 93 ..
text_mt:
an incarnation worshipped by all would never occur.
In this four-age cycle, O gods, of the Ancient Person

sanskrit_iast:
trayo'vatārāḥ kathitāstathā nānyaccaturyuge ..
tretāyāḥ prathame pāde rāmo dāśarathiḥ prabhuḥ .. 94 ..
meaning:
त्रयोऽवताराः कथितास्तथा नान्यच्चतुर्युगे ..
त्रेतायाः प्रथमे पादे रामो दाशरथिः प्रभुः .. 94 ..
text_mt:
three incarnations are spoken of, and not so in any other four-age cycle:
in the first quarter of the Tretā, the lord Rāma, son of Daśaratha;

sanskrit_iast:
dvāparasya tathā kṛṣṇaḥ śeṣeṇa saha vai bhuvi..
kaleśśeṣe tathāhaṃ vai dvātriṃśābdasahasrake .. 95 ..
meaning:
द्वापरस्य तथा कृष्णः शेषेण सह वै भुवि..
कलेश्शेषे तथाहं वै द्वात्रिंशाब्दसहस्रके .. 95 ..
text_mt:
in the Dvāpara, likewise Kṛṣṇa together with Śeṣa on earth;
and likewise I, at the end of Kali, in the thirty-second thousandth year.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ khaṃḍaḥ pavitro'yaṃ nṛṇāṃ pātakanāśanaḥ ..
imaṃ caturyugaṃ khaṇḍaṃ yaḥ paṭhecchrāvayecca yaḥ .. 96 ..
meaning:
अतः खंडः पवित्रोऽयं नृणां पातकनाशनः ..
इमं चतुर्युगं खण्डं यः पठेच्छ्रावयेच्च यः .. 96 ..
text_mt:
Therefore this section is holy, destroying the sins of men.
Whoever recites or causes to be heard this section of the four-age cycle,

sanskrit_iast:
janma prabhṛti pāpāni tasya naśyaṃti nānyathā ..
iti vaḥ kathitaṃ devā mahākalpacaritrakam .. 97..
meaning:
जन्म प्रभृति पापानि तस्य नश्यंति नान्यथा ..
इति वः कथितं देवा महाकल्पचरित्रकम् .. 97..
text_mt:
his sins from birth onwards are destroyed, not otherwise.
Thus has been told to you, O gods, the history of the mahākalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyo yo mahākalpo viṣṇukalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ ..
tatkathā paṭhitā devā viṣṇupaurāṇikairnaraiḥ .. 98 ..
meaning:
द्वितीयो यो महाकल्पो विष्णुकल्पः स वै स्मृतः ..
तत्कथा पठिता देवा विष्णुपौराणिकैर्नरैः .. 98 ..
text_mt:
The second mahākalpa is remembered as the Viṣṇukalpa;
its story has been recited, O gods, by men versed in the Viṣṇu Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śatakoṭipravistāro viṣṇupaurāṇikasya vai ..
tatraiva ca mahākalpo viṣṇornābhisamudbhavaḥ .. .. 99 ..
meaning:
शतकोटिप्रविस्तारो विष्णुपौराणिकस्य वै ..
तत्रैव च महाकल्पो विष्णोर्नाभिसमुद्भवः .. .. 99 ..
text_mt:
The extent of the Viṣṇu Purāṇa is one hundred crores [of verses];
and in that very [Purāṇa is described] the mahākalpa arising from the navel of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvārddhādbhagavānbrahmā .sarvadevasamanvitaḥ ..
parārddhādbhagavānviṣṇuḥ purāṇapuruṣaḥ sa vai .. 3.4.25.100 ..
meaning:
पूर्वार्द्धाद्भगवान्ब्रह्मा .सर्वदेवसमन्वितः ..
परार्द्धाद्भगवान्विष्णुः पुराणपुरुषः स वै .. 3.4.25.100 ..
text_mt:
From its first half [comes] the Lord Brahmā, accompanied by all the gods;
from its second half, the Lord Viṣṇu, who is indeed the Ancient Person.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyo yo mahākalpaḥ śivakalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ ..
śivapūrvārddhato jāto viṣṇustasmādvidhiḥ svayam .. 101 ..
meaning:
तृतीयो यो महाकल्पः शिवकल्पः स वै स्मृतः ..
शिवपूर्वार्द्धतो जातो विष्णुस्तस्माद्विधिः स्वयम् .. 101 ..
text_mt:
The third mahākalpa is remembered as the Śivakalpa;
from the first half of Śiva, Viṣṇu was born, [and] from him, the Creator himself.

sanskrit_iast:
śatakoṭipravistāraḥ śivapaurāṇikaiḥ smṛtaḥ ..
caturtho yo mahākalpaḥ padma kalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ .. 102 ..
meaning:
शतकोटिप्रविस्तारः शिवपौराणिकैः स्मृतः ..
चतुर्थो यो महाकल्पः पद्म कल्पः स वै स्मृतः .. 102 ..
text_mt: Extending across a hundred million [verses], it is recalled by the Śaiva mythologists. / The fourth great kalpa is remembered as the Padma-kalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśastatra bhagavānpurāṇapuruṣāsane ..
gaṇeśādabhavadrudro rudrādviṣṇuḥ surottamaḥ .. 103 ..
meaning:
गणेशस्तत्र भगवान्पुराणपुरुषासने ..
गणेशादभवद्रुद्रो रुद्राद्विष्णुः सुरोत्तमः .. 103 ..
text_mt: There the Lord Gaṇeśa sat on the seat of the ancient Puruṣa. / From Gaṇeśa arose Rudra; from Rudra, Viṣṇu, the best of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇornābhisamudbhūtaḥ parameṣṭhī pitāmahaḥ ..
kalpekalpe kramādādau devāścāsansamaṃtataḥ ..104..
meaning:
विष्णोर्नाभिसमुद्भूतः परमेष्ठी पितामहः ..
कल्पेकल्पे क्रमादादौ देवाश्चासन्समंततः ..104..
text_mt: From Viṣṇu's navel was born the grandfather, Parameṣṭhin. / In each kalpa, successively at the beginning, the gods emerged all around.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcamo yo mahākalpo vāyukalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ ..
maheṃdrastatra bhagavānpurāṇa puruṣāsane .. 105 ..
meaning:
पंचमो यो महाकल्पो वायुकल्पः स वै स्मृतः ..
महेंद्रस्तत्र भगवान्पुराण पुरुषासने .. 105 ..
text_mt: The fifth great kalpa is remembered as the Vāyu-kalpa. / There the Lord Mahendra sat on the seat of the ancient Puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
mahendrādabhavatprāpto maheṃdrādiṃdriyāṇi ca ..
indriyebhyaśca taddevāsteṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu ..106..
meaning:
महेन्द्रादभवत्प्राप्तो महेंद्रादिंद्रियाणि च ..
इन्द्रियेभ्यश्च तद्देवास्तेषां नामानि मे शृणु ..106..
text_mt: From Mahendra came forth [life], and from Mahendra arose the senses. / And from the senses came their presiding deities; hear their names from me:

sanskrit_iast:
śanirbudho raviḥ śukro viśva karmā bṛhaspatiḥ ..
indro viṣṇustathā brahmā rudraḥ somaḥ kramātsmṛtāḥ ..107..
meaning:
शनिर्बुधो रविः शुक्रो विश्व कर्मा बृहस्पतिः ..
इन्द्रो विष्णुस्तथा ब्रह्मा रुद्रः सोमः क्रमात्स्मृताः ..107..
text_mt: Saturn, Mercury, the Sun, Venus, Viśvakarman, and Jupiter, / Indra, Viṣṇu, Brahmā, Rudra, and Soma are enumerated in order.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭikartā sa vai brahmā liṅgendriyasamudbhavaḥ .
sṛṣṭipātā sa vai viṣṇuravatāripadodbhavaḥ . . 108
meaning:
सृष्टिकर्ता स वै ब्रह्मा लिङ्गेन्द्रियसमुद्भवः .
सृष्टिपाता स वै विष्णुरवतारिपदोद्भवः . . 108
text_mt: Brahmā is the creator of the cosmos, born from the organ of generation; / Viṣṇu is the protector of the cosmos, born from the realm of incarnations.

sanskrit_iast:
caturviṃśatitattveṣu kalpekalpe prabhurgataḥ .
sanatkumāro haṃsaśca vārāho nāradastathā . . 109
meaning:
चतुर्विंशतितत्त्वेषु कल्पेकल्पे प्रभुर्गतः .
सनत्कुमारो हंसश्च वाराहो नारदस्तथा . . 109
text_mt: Across the twenty-four cosmic principles, in every kalpa the Lord walked: / Sanatkumāra, Haṃsa, the Boar, and Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇau ca kapilātreyau yajñāśvakaṇṭakau .
vṛṣabhaśca pṛthurmatsyaḥ kūrmo dhanvantaristathā . . 3.4.25.110
meaning:
नारायणौ च कपिलात्रेयौ यज्ञाश्वकण्टकौ .
वृषभश्च पृथुर्मत्स्यः कूर्मो धन्वन्तरिस्तथा . . 3.4.25.110
text_mt: both Nārāyaṇas, Kapila, Ātreya, Yajña, and Aśvakaṇṭaka, / Vṛṣabha, Pṛthu, the Fish, the Tortoise, and Dhanvantari,

sanskrit_iast:
mohinī ca nṛsiṃhaśca vāmano bhārgavastathā .
rāmo vyāso balaḥ kṛṣṇo buddhaḥ kalkī svatattvagaḥ . . 111
meaning:
मोहिनी च नृसिंहश्च वामनो भार्गवस्तथा .
रामो व्यासो बलः कृष्णो बुद्धः कल्की स्वतत्त्वगः . . 111
text_mt: Mohinī, the Man-Lion, the Dwarf, the Bhārgava, / Rāma, Vyāsa, Bala, Kṛṣṇa, the Buddha, and Kalkin, walking within his own reality.

sanskrit_iast:
guhyajanmā mahādevaḥ sṛṣṭidaityavināśakaḥ .
evaṃ jātāstrayo devā mahākalpe ca pañcame . . 112
meaning:
गुह्यजन्मा महादेवः सृष्टिदैत्यविनाशकः .
एवं जातास्त्रयो देवा महाकल्पे च पञ्चमे . . 112
text_mt: Mahādeva, whose birth is mysterious, is the destroyer of creation and demons. / In this way the three gods arose in the fifth great kalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭho yastu mahākalpo vahnikalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ .
skandastatraiva bhagavānpurāṇapuruṣāsane . . 113
meaning:
षष्ठो यस्तु महाकल्पो वह्निकल्पः स वै स्मृतः .
स्कन्दस्तत्रैव भगवान्पुराणपुरुषासने . . 113
text_mt: The sixth great kalpa is remembered as the Vahni-kalpa. / There the Lord Skanda sat on the seat of the ancient Puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣāvyayataḥ skannaḥ skandastasmānmahārcimān .
sūryarūpā mahārciryā tasyāṃ jāto hariḥ svayam . . 114
meaning:
पुरुषाव्ययतः स्कन्नः स्कन्दस्तस्मान्महार्चिमान् .
सूर्यरूपा महार्चिर्या तस्यां जातो हरिः स्वयम् . . 114
text_mt: Emitted from the imperishable Puruṣa, Skanda became possessed of great radiance. / In the great radiance having the form of the sun, Hari was born himself.

sanskrit_iast:
vahnirūpā mahārciryā tasyāṃ jātaḥ pitāmahaḥ .
candrarūpā mahārciryā tasyāṃ jātaḥ sa vai haraḥ . . 115
meaning:
वह्निरूपा महार्चिर्या तस्यां जातः पितामहः .
चन्द्ररूपा महार्चिर्या तस्यां जातः स वै हरः . . 115
text_mt: In the great radiance having the form of fire, the Grandfather was born; / in the great radiance having the form of the moon, Hara was born.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayo munayo varṇā lokā jātāḥ pitāmahāt .
ādityā viśvavasavastuṣitā bhāsvarānilāḥ . . 116
meaning:
ऋषयो मुनयो वर्णा लोका जाताः पितामहात् .
आदित्या विश्ववसवस्तुषिता भास्वरानिलाः . . 116
text_mt: From the Grandfather were born the seers, sages, castes, and worlds. / The Ādityas, Viśves, Vasus, Tuṣitas, Bhāsvaras, and Anilas,

sanskrit_iast:
mahārājikasādhyāśca devā viṣṇusamudbhavāḥ .
yakṣarākṣasagandharvāḥ piśācāḥ kinnarādayaḥ . . 117
meaning:
महाराजिकसाध्याश्च देवा विष्णुसमुद्भवाः .
यक्षराक्षसगन्धर्वाः पिशाचाः किन्नरादयः . . 117
text_mt: the Mahārājikas and Sādhyas—these gods were born from Viṣṇu. / The yakṣas, rākṣasas, gandharvas, piśācas, kinnaras, and so on,

sanskrit_iast:
daityāśca dānavā bhūtāstāmasā rudrasambhavāḥ .
kalpe kalpe samudbhūtamevaṃ brahmāṇḍagocare . . 118
meaning:
दैत्याश्च दानवा भूतास्तामसा रुद्रसम्भवाः .
कल्पे कल्पे समुद्भूतमेवं ब्रह्माण्डगोचरे . . 118
text_mt: the daityas, dānavas, and ghosts, of tamasic nature, originated from Rudra. / In this way, creation appeared in the range of the cosmic egg in kalpa after kalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
saptamo yo mahākalpaḥ sa vai brahmāṇḍakalpakaḥ .
pāvakastatra bhagavānpurāṇapuruṣāsane . . 119
meaning:
सप्तमो यो महाकल्पः स वै ब्रह्माण्डकल्पकः .
पावकस्तत्र भगवान्पुराणपुरुषासने . . 119
text_mt: The seventh great kalpa is indeed the Brahmāṇḍa-kalpa. / There the Lord Pāvaka sat on the seat of the ancient Puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
acintyatejasastasmātpuruṣādvahnirudbhavaḥ .
tato jāto mahābdhiśca tasmājjātaṃ virāṇmayam . . 3.4.25.120
meaning:
अचिन्त्यतेजसस्तस्मात्पुरुषाद्वह्निरुद्भवः .
ततो जातो महाब्धिश्च तस्माज्जातं विराण्मयम् . . 3.4.25.120
text_mt: From that Puruṣa of unimaginable splendor, fire arose; / from that the great ocean was born, and from that arose the cosmic body (virāj).

sanskrit_iast:
romṇi romṇi tatastasya brahmāṇḍāḥ koṭiśo'bhavan .
brahmāṇḍādabhavadbrahmā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ . . 121
meaning:
रोम्णि रोम्णि ततस्तस्य ब्रह्माण्डाः कोटिशोऽभवन् .
ब्रह्माण्डादभवद्ब्रह्मा सर्वलोकपितामहः . . 121
text_mt: Then, from his every hair, tens of millions of cosmic eggs emerged. / From the cosmic egg was born Brahmā, the grandfather of all worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmājjāto vibhurviṣṇustasmājjāto haraḥ svayam .
śatakoṭipravistāro brahmāṇḍākhyapurāṇake . . 122
meaning:
तस्माज्जातो विभुर्विष्णुस्तस्माज्जातो हरः स्वयम् .
शतकोटिप्रविस्तारो ब्रह्माण्डाख्यपुराणके . . 122
text_mt: From him the all-pervading Viṣṇu was born; from him Hara arose himself. / Extending across a hundred million [verses], in the Purāṇa called Brahmāṇḍa,

sanskrit_iast:
trinetraṃ pañcavaktraṃ ca daśabāhurbhavasya ca .
aṣṭādaśānāṃ kalpānāṃ vāyurvai vaidikaiḥ smṛtaḥ . . 123
meaning:
त्रिनेत्रं पञ्चवक्त्रं च दशबाहुर्भवस्य च .
अष्टादशानां कल्पानां वायुर्वै वैदिकैः स्मृतः . . 123
text_mt: having three eyes, five faces, and ten arms for Bhava, / Vāyu is remembered by the followers of the Veda for the eighteen kalpas.

sanskrit_iast:
mahākalpe'bhavansarve dvisahasrāḥ kṣayaṃ gatāḥ .
aṣṭamo yo mahākalpo liṅgakalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ . . 124
meaning:
महाकल्पेऽभवन्सर्वे द्विसहस्राः क्षयं गताः .
अष्टमो यो महाकल्पो लिङ्गकल्पः स वै स्मृतः . . 124
text_mt: In the great kalpa all two thousand [kalpas] came to perish. / The eighth great kalpa is remembered as the Liṅga-kalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva bhagavāndharmaḥ purāṇapuruṣāsane .
acintyāvyaktarūpaśca jāto dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ . . 125
meaning:
तत्रैव भगवान्धर्मः पुराणपुरुषासने .
अचिन्त्याव्यक्तरूपश्च जातो धर्मः सनातनः . . 125
text_mt: There the Lord Dharma sat on the seat of the ancient Puruṣa. / Having an unimaginable and unmanifest form, eternal Dharma was born.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmātkāmaḥ samudbhūtaḥ kāmālliṅgastridhābhavat .
puṃlliṅgaḥ klībaliṅgaśca strīliṅgaśca surottama . . 126
meaning:
धर्मात्कामः समुद्भूतः कामाल्लिङ्गस्त्रिधाभवत् .
पुंल्लिङ्गः क्लीबलिङ्गश्च स्त्रीलिङ्गश्च सुरोत्तम . . 126
text_mt: From Dharma desire (Kāma) was born, and from desire the gendered sign (liṅga) became threefold: / masculine, neuter, and feminine, O best of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
pum̐lliṅgādabhavadviṣṇuḥ strīliṅgācca mahendirā .
klībaliṅgātsa vai śeṣastasyopari sa ca sthitaḥ . . 127
meaning:
पुम्̐ल्लिङ्गादभवद्विष्णुः स्त्रीलिङ्गाच्च महेन्दिरा .
क्लीबलिङ्गात्स वै शेषस्तस्योपरि स च स्थितः . . 127
text_mt: From the masculine sign Viṣṇu was born, and from the feminine sign came Mahendirā; / from the neuter sign came Śeṣa, upon whom he rested.

sanskrit_iast:
tribhyastamomayebhyaśca jātamekārṇavaṃ jagat .
supte nārāyaṇe deve nābheḥ paṅkajamuttamam . . 128
meaning:
त्रिभ्यस्तमोमयेभ्यश्च जातमेकार्णवं जगत् .
सुप्ते नारायणे देवे नाभेः पङ्कजमुत्तमम् . . 128
text_mt: From the three dark entities arose the single oceanic world. / When the divine Nārāyaṇa fell asleep, from his navel an excellent lotus [sprang].

sanskrit_iast:
jātaṃ tasmātsa vai brahmā tasmājjāto virāḍayam .
śatakoṭipravistārairliṅgapaurāṇikaiḥ kathā . . 129
meaning:
जातं तस्मात्स वै ब्रह्मा तस्माज्जातो विराडयम् .
शतकोटिप्रविस्तारैर्लिङ्गपौराणिकैः कथा . . 129
text_mt: From that Brahmā was born, and from him arose this cosmic person (virāj). / The story told by the experts on the Liṅgapurāṇa, extending across a hundred million [verses],

sanskrit_iast:
gītā caiva vidheragre tasya sāro'yamuttamaḥ .
navamo yo mahākalpo matsyakalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ . . 3.4.25.130
meaning:
गीता चैव विधेरग्रे तस्य सारोऽयमुत्तमः .
नवमो यो महाकल्पो मत्स्यकल्पः स वै स्मृतः . . 3.4.25.130
text_mt: was sung before Brahmā; this is its excellent essence. / The ninth great kalpa is remembered as the Matsya-kalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
kuberastatra bhagavānpurāṇapuruṣāsane .
avyayācca samudbhūto dhūlivṛndo mahāṃstathā . . 131
meaning:
कुबेरस्तत्र भगवान्पुराणपुरुषासने .
अव्ययाच्च समुद्भूतो धूलिवृन्दो महांस्तथा . . 131
text_mt: There the Lord Kubera sat on the seat of the ancient Puruṣa. / And from the imperishable arose a great cloud of dust.

sanskrit_iast:
rajobhūtācca tasmācca kuberasya samudbhavaḥ .
kuberādudbhavanmatsyo vedamūrtiśca sadguṇaḥ . . 132
meaning:
रजोभूताच्च तस्माच्च कुबेरस्य समुद्भवः .
कुबेरादुद्भवन्मत्स्यो वेदमूर्तिश्च सद्गुणः . . 132
text_mt: From that entity turned to dust, Kubera took birth; / from Kubera arose the Fish, the embodiment of the Vedas, endowed with good qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
matsyodarātsamudbhūto viṣṇurnārāyaṇo hariḥ .
viṣṇornābheḥ samudbhūto brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ . . 133
meaning:
मत्स्योदरात्समुद्भूतो विष्णुर्नारायणो हरिः .
विष्णोर्नाभेः समुद्भूतो ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः . . 133
text_mt: From the belly of the Fish arose Viṣṇu, Nārāyaṇa, Hari; / from the navel of Viṣṇu arose Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇaścodbhavaṃ daivaṃ daivāddevā babhūvire .
caturviṃśatitattvāni tairdevairjanitāni vai . . 134
meaning:
ब्रह्मणश्चोद्भवं दैवं दैवाद्देवा बभूविरे .
चतुर्विंशतितत्त्वानि तैर्देवैर्जनितानि वै . . 134
text_mt: From Brahmā arose the divine sphere, and from that divine sphere the gods came to be. / The twenty-four cosmic principles were brought into being by those gods.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpekalpe kramādevaṃ kalpanāmānyakārayat .
matsyakalpe tu matsyaśca mahāmatsyātsamudbhavaḥ . . 135
meaning:
कल्पेकल्पे क्रमादेवं कल्पनामान्यकारयत् .
मत्स्यकल्पे तु मत्स्यश्च महामत्स्यात्समुद्भवः . . 135
text_mt: In this way, in kalpa after kalpa, in order, he gave names to the kalpas: / In the Matsya-kalpa, the Fish arose from the Great Fish;

sanskrit_iast:
tanmatsyādbhagavānviṣṇustato brahmaṇa udbhavaḥ .
kūrmakalpe mahāmatsyātkūrmo jātaḥ sa kacchapaḥ . . 136
meaning:
तन्मत्स्याद्भगवान्विष्णुस्ततो ब्रह्मण उद्भवः .
कूर्मकल्पे महामत्स्यात्कूर्मो जातः स कच्छपः . . 136
text_mt: from that Fish arose the Lord Viṣṇu, and from him the birth of Brahmā occurred. / In the Kūrma-kalpa, from the Great Fish was born the Tortoise, that turtle;

sanskrit_iast:
kūrmācca bhagavānviṣṇustato brahmā tato virāṭ .
śvetavārāhakalpe ca varāhādviṣṇurudbhavaḥ . . 137
meaning:
कूर्माच्च भगवान्विष्णुस्ततो ब्रह्मा ततो विराट् .
श्वेतवाराहकल्पे च वराहाद्विष्णुरुद्भवः . . 137
text_mt: and from the Tortoise came the Lord Viṣṇu, from him Brahmā, and from him the cosmic person. / And in the Śvetavārāha-kalpa, Viṣṇu's emergence was from the Boar;

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇornābheśca sa brahmā tato jāto virāḍayam .
evaṃ sarve ca vai kalpā jñeyāḥ sarvatra vai budhaiḥ . . 138
meaning:
विष्णोर्नाभेश्च स ब्रह्मा ततो जातो विराडयम् .
एवं सर्वे च वै कल्पा ज्ञेयाः सर्वत्र वै बुधैः . . 138
text_mt: and from the navel of Viṣṇu came that Brahmā, and from him this cosmic person was born. / Thus should all the kalpas be known everywhere by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
daśamo yo mahākalpaḥ kūrmakalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ .
acetāstatra bhagavānpurāṇapuruṣāsane . . 139
meaning:
दशमो यो महाकल्पः कूर्मकल्पः स वै स्मृतः .
अचेतास्तत्र भगवान्पुराणपुरुषासने . . 139
text_mt: The tenth great kalpa is remembered as the Kūrma-kalpa. / There the Lord Pracetas sat on the seat of the ancient Puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛteśca paro yo vai turīyo'vyaya eva ca .
śūnyabhūtāttato jātaḥ pracetā bhagavānsvayam . . 3.4.25.140
meaning:
प्रकृतेश्च परो यो वै तुरीयोऽव्यय एव च .
शून्यभूतात्ततो जातः प्रचेता भगवान्स्वयम् . . 3.4.25.140
text_mt: Beyond primordial nature (prakṛti), the fourth and imperishable one: / from that empty entity, the Lord Pracetas was born himself.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmājjāto mahānabdhistatra suṣvāpa sa prabhuḥ .
nārāyaṇa iti khyātaḥ sa vai jalapatiḥ svayam . . 141
meaning:
तस्माज्जातो महानब्धिस्तत्र सुष्वाप स प्रभुः .
नारायण इति ख्यातः स वै जलपतिः स्वयम् . . 141
text_mt: From him the great ocean was born, and there the Lord fell asleep, / known as Nārāyaṇa, he who is himself the master of the waters.

sanskrit_iast:
tadarddhācca mahākūrmastataḥ śeṣo mahānabhūt .
tridhā'bhavatsa vai śeṣo bhūmā śeṣaśca bhaumanī . . 142
meaning:
तदर्द्धाच्च महाकूर्मस्ततः शेषो महानभूत् .
त्रिधाऽभवत्स वै शेषो भूमा शेषश्च भौमनी . . 142
text_mt: From half of him the Great Tortoise emerged, and from that Śeṣa the great came to be. / That Śeṣa became threefold: the vast one (bhūman), Śeṣa, and Bhaumanī.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmā sa vai virāḍ jñeyaḥ śeṣopari sa cāsthitaḥ .
bhaumanī ca mahālakṣmīḥ sā bhūmno hṛdi saṃsthitā . . 143
meaning:
भूमा स वै विराड् ज्ञेयः शेषोपरि स चास्थितः .
भौमनी च महालक्ष्मीः सा भूम्नो हृदि संस्थिता . . 143
text_mt: The vast one is known as the cosmic person (virāj), resting upon Śeṣa, / and Bhaumanī is Mahālakṣmī, situated in the heart of the vast one.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmno jātaḥ sa vai brahmā sṛṣṭisthitivināśakaḥ .
tridhāmūrtiḥ sa vai brahmā kalpekalpe kramādayam .. 144
meaning:
भूम्नो जातः स वै ब्रह्मा सृष्टिस्थितिविनाशकः .
त्रिधामूर्तिः स वै ब्रह्मा कल्पेकल्पे क्रमादयम् .. 144
text_mt: From the vast one was born Brahmā, the creator, maintainer, and destroyer; / having a threefold form, this Brahmā exists in kalpa after kalpa in succession.

sanskrit_iast:
paṭaṃ suṣuptabhūtaṃ yatpurāṇapuruṣāsanam .
yatra gatvendriyāṇyeva tṛptiṃ prāpya kṣayanti vai .. 145
meaning:
पटं सुषुप्तभूतं यत्पुराणपुरुषासनम् .
यत्र गत्वेन्द्रियाण्येव तृप्तिं प्राप्य क्षयन्ति वै .. 145
text_mt: The screen, being in deep sleep, which is the seat of the ancient Puruṣa— / where the senses go, attain satisfaction, and dissolve—

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṅkārastadāgatya caitanyaṃ manasi sthitam .
vañcayitvā punarlokaṃ karoti sma svalīlayā .. 146
meaning:
अहङ्कारस्तदागत्य चैतन्यं मनसि स्थितम् .
वञ्चयित्वा पुनर्लोकं करोति स्म स्वलीलया .. 146
text_mt: then the ego (ahaṅkāra), having come and deceived consciousness situated in the mind, / produced the world once more by its own play.

sanskrit_iast:
turīyaśaktiryā jñeyā mahākālī sanātanī .
mahākalpaśca taiḥ sarvaistadaṅgaṃ śrutibhiḥ smṛtam .. 147
meaning:
तुरीयशक्तिर्या ज्ञेया महाकाली सनातनी .
महाकल्पश्च तैः सर्वैस्तदङ्गं श्रुतिभिः स्मृतम् .. 147
text_mt: She who is to be known as the fourth power is the eternal Mahākālī; / and the Great Aeon is remembered by all the Vedas as her limb.

sanskrit_iast:
namastasyai mahākālyai mama mātre namo namaḥ .
yataḥ purāṇapuruṣā bhavanti ca liyanti ca .. 148
meaning:
नमस्तस्यै महाकाल्यै मम मात्रे नमो नमः .
यतः पुराणपुरुषा भवन्ति च लियन्ति च .. 148
text_mt: Salutations to that Mahākālī, salutations again and again to my mother, / from whom the ancient Persons arise and [into whom] they dissolve.

sanskrit_iast:
daśaiva ca mahākalpā vyatītā iha bhoḥ surāḥ .
sāmprataṃ vartate yo vai mahākalpo bhaviṣyakaḥ .. 149
meaning:
दशैव च महाकल्पा व्यतीता इह भोः सुराः .
साम्प्रतं वर्तते यो वै महाकल्पो भविष्यकः .. 149
text_mt: O gods, only ten Great Aeons have passed away here. / The Great Aeon that is present now is the Bhaviṣyaka.

sanskrit_iast:
tadutpattiṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ bho devāḥ sarpigaṇā mama .
acintyamakṣaraṃ yattu turīyaṃ ca sadā sthitam .. 3.4.25.150
meaning:
तदुत्पत्तिं शृणुध्वं भो देवाः सर्पिगणा मम .
अचिन्त्यमक्षरं यत्तु तुरीयं च सदा स्थितम् .. 3.4.25.150
text_mt: Hear its origin, O gods, my hosts of serpents! / That which is inconceivable, imperishable, the fourth, and ever-enduring—

sanskrit_iast:
yadgatvā na nivartante narāstatraiva tatpadam .
anekasṛṣṭiracanāḥ santi tasyaiva līlayā .. 151
meaning:
यद्गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते नरास्तत्रैव तत्पदम् .
अनेकसृष्टिरचनाः सन्ति तस्यैव लीलया .. 151
text_mt: having gone to which men do not return, that very place is its abode. / Multiple acts of creation exist merely through its play.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāntaṃ na vidurdevāḥ kathaṃ jānanti vai narāḥ .
bhūto bhūto mahākalpo dṛṣṭo vaidestadīritaḥ .. 152
meaning:
तस्यान्तं न विदुर्देवाः कथं जानन्ति वै नराः .
भूतो भूतो महाकल्पो दृष्टो वैदेस्तदीरितः .. 152
text_mt: The gods do not know its end; how indeed can men know it? / Each past Great Aeon was seen and declared by the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvyā ye tu mahākalpā na vai jānanti te sadā .
trayastriṃśanmahākalpāḥ kaiścidvedairudīritāḥ .. 153
meaning:
भाव्या ये तु महाकल्पा न वै जानन्ति ते सदा .
त्रयस्त्रिंशन्महाकल्पाः कैश्चिद्वेदैरुदीरिताः .. 153
text_mt: But the Great Aeons that are yet to be, they do not ever know. / Thirty-three Great Aeons have been proclaimed by some Vedas;

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭādaśa mahākalpāḥ pṛthaṅ nāmnopavarṇitāḥ .
ekādaśa mahākalpāḥ kaiścitproktāḥ purātanaiḥ .. 154
meaning:
अष्टादश महाकल्पाः पृथङ् नाम्नोपवर्णिताः .
एकादश महाकल्पाः कैश्चित्प्रोक्ताः पुरातनैः .. 154
text_mt: eighteen Great Aeons have been described separately by name; / eleven Great Aeons have been mentioned by some ancients.

sanskrit_iast:
ato'haṃ niścayenādya bhāvyakalpeṣu bhoḥ surāḥ .
vedānāṃ vacanaṃ satyaṃ nānyathā ca bhavetkvacit .. 155
meaning:
अतोऽहं निश्चयेनाद्य भाव्यकल्पेषु भोः सुराः .
वेदानां वचनं सत्यं नान्यथा च भवेत्क्वचित् .. 155
text_mt: Therefore, O gods, today I [speak] with certainty among the future aeons. / The word of the Vedas is true, and it can never be otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
tadavyayātsamudbhūto rādhākṛṣṇaḥ sanātanaḥ .
ekībhūtaṃ dvayoraṅgaṃ rādhākṛṣṇo budhaiḥ smṛtaḥ .. 156
meaning:
तदव्ययात्समुद्भूतो राधाकृष्णः सनातनः .
एकीभूतं द्वयोरङ्गं राधाकृष्णो बुधैः स्मृतः .. 156
text_mt: From that imperishable arose the eternal Rādhākṛṣṇa. / The body of the two unified is recalled by the wise as Rādhākṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrayugaparyantaṃ yattepe paramaṃ tapaḥ .
tadā sa ca dvidhā jāto rādhākṛṣṇaḥ pṛthakpṛthak .. 157
meaning:
सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तं यत्तेपे परमं तपः .
तदा स च द्विधा जातो राधाकृष्णः पृथक्पृथक् .. 157
text_mt: When he performed supreme asceticism for a thousand yugas, / then he became divided into two, Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, separately.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrayugaparyantaṃ tepatustau paraṃ tapaḥ .
tayoraṅgātsamudbhūtā jyotsnā tamanāśinī . . 158
meaning:
सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तं तेपतुस्तौ परं तपः .
तयोरङ्गात्समुद्भूता ज्योत्स्ना तमनाशिनी . . 158
text_mt: For a thousand yugas the two performed supreme asceticism. / From their bodies arose a moonlight that destroys darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
tajyotsnābhiḥ samudbhūtaṃ divyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ śubham .
ekaviṃśatprakṛtayo yojane yojane smṛtāḥ . . 159
meaning:
तज्योत्स्नाभिः समुद्भूतं दिव्यं वृन्दावनं शुभम् .
एकविंशत्प्रकृतयो योजने योजने स्मृताः . . 159
text_mt: From that moonlight arose the divine, auspicious Vṛndāvana. / Twenty-one elements are taught, league by league.

sanskrit_iast:
divyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ jātaṃ caturāśītisammite .
krośāyāmaṃ mahāramyaṃ talliṅgaṃ śṛṇu me prabho . . 3.4.25.160
meaning:
दिव्यं वृन्दावनं जातं चतुराशीतिसम्मिते .
क्रोशायामं महारम्यं तल्लिङ्गं शृणु मे प्रभो . . 3.4.25.160
text_mt: Divine Vṛndāvana came into being, measured at eighty-four / krośas in extent, exceedingly delightful. Hear its characteristics from me, O Lord:

sanskrit_iast:
indriyaprakṛtīnāṃ ca daśānāṃ grāmataddaśa 1 .
gokulaṃ vārṣa nāndaṃ bhāṇḍīraṃ māthuraṃ tathā . . 161
meaning:
इन्द्रियप्रकृतीनां च दशानां ग्रामतद्दश 1 .
गोकुलं वार्ष नान्दं भाण्डीरं माथुरं तथा . . 161
text_mt: And there were ten villages from the ten elements of the senses: / Gokula, Vārṣa, Nānda, Bhāṇḍīra, and likewise Māthura,

sanskrit_iast:
vrajaṃ ca yāmunaṃ mānyaṃ śreyaskaṃ gopikaṃ kramāt .
mātrābhūtadaśabhyaśca prakṛtibhyaḥ samudbhavam . . 162
meaning:
व्रजं च यामुनं मान्यं श्रेयस्कं गोपिकं क्रमात् .
मात्राभूतदशभ्यश्च प्रकृतिभ्यः समुद्भवम् . . 162
text_mt: Vraja, Yāmuna, Mānya, Śreyaska, and Gopika in order. / And arising from the ten elements consisting of subtle elements and gross elements,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā daśavanaṃ ramyaṃ teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu .
vṛndāvanaṃ gopavanaṃ bahulāvanameva ca . . 163
meaning:
तथा दशवनं रम्यं तेषां नामानि मे शृणु .
वृन्दावनं गोपवनं बहुलावनमेव च . . 163
text_mt: there were likewise ten delightful forests. Hear their names from me: / Vṛndāvana, Gopavana, and Bahulāvana,

sanskrit_iast:
madhuśṛṅgaṃ kuñjavanaṃ vanaṃ dadhivanaṃ tathā .
rahaḥ krīḍāvanaṃ ramyaṃ veṇupadmavanaṃ kramāt . . 164
meaning:
मधुशृङ्गं कुञ्जवनं वनं दधिवनं तथा .
रहः क्रीडावनं रम्यं वेणुपद्मवनं क्रमात् . . 164
text_mt: Madhuśṛṅga, Kuñjavana, the forest Dadhivana as well, / the delightful Rahaḥkrīḍāvana, and Veṇupadmavana in succession.

sanskrit_iast:
manasaḥ prakṛterjāto girirgovarddhano mahān .
divyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ dṛṣṭvā paramānandamāpa saḥ . . 165
meaning:
मनसः प्रकृतेर्जातो गिरिर्गोवर्द्धनो महान् .
दिव्यं वृन्दावनं दृष्ट्वा परमानन्दमाप सः . . 165
text_mt: From the element of the mind arose the great mountain Govardhana. / Seeing divine Vṛndāvana, he attained supreme bliss.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇādudabhavangopāstisraḥ koṭyo guṇātmakāḥ .
śrīdāmādyāḥ sātvikāśca rājasā arjunādayaḥ . . 166
meaning:
कृष्णादुदभवन्गोपास्तिस्रः कोट्यो गुणात्मकाः .
श्रीदामाद्याः सात्विकाश्च राजसा अर्जुनादयः . . 166
text_mt: From Kṛṣṇa arose three crores of cowherds, consisting of the guṇas: / Śrīdāman and others of sattva, Arjuna and others of rajas,

sanskrit_iast:
kaṃsādyāstāmasā jātā divyalīlāprakāriṇaḥ .
rādhāṅgādudbhavā gopyastisraḥ koṭyastathā kramāt . . 167
meaning:
कंसाद्यास्तामसा जाता दिव्यलीलाप्रकारिणः .
राधाङ्गादुद्भवा गोप्यस्तिस्रः कोट्यस्तथा क्रमात् . . 167
text_mt: and Kaṃsa and others were born of tamas, displaying divine play. / From Rādhā's body arose three crores of cowherd women likewise in order:

sanskrit_iast:
lalitādyāḥ sāttvikāśca kubjādyā rājasāstathā .
tāmasāḥ pūtanādyāśca nānāhelācaritrakāḥ . . 168
meaning:
ललिताद्याः सात्त्विकाश्च कुब्जाद्या राजसास्तथा .
तामसाः पूतनाद्याश्च नानाहेलाचरित्रकाः . . 168
text_mt: Lalitā and others of sattva, Kubjā and others of rajas, / and Pūtanā and others of tamas, engaging in various playful deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrayugaparyantaṃ teṣāṃ līlā babhūva ha .
tatastau tānsamāhṛtya tepatuśca punastapaḥ . . 169
meaning:
सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तं तेषां लीला बभूव ह .
ततस्तौ तान्समाहृत्य तेपतुश्च पुनस्तपः . . 169
text_mt: For a thousand yugas their divine play took place. / Then, withdrawing them, the two again performed asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
dvidhā jātaḥ sa vai kṛṣṇo rādhā devī tathā dvidhā .
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt . . 3.4.25.170
meaning:
द्विधा जातः स वै कृष्णो राधा देवी तथा द्विधा .
सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषः सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् . . 3.4.25.170
text_mt: Kṛṣṇa became divided into two, and goddess Rādhā likewise into two. / The thousand-headed Person, thousand-eyed, and thousand-footed—

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvārddhātsa ca vai jātaḥ parārddhātkṛṣṇa eva hi .
ekaśīrṣā trinetrā ca dvipadī dvisahasrikā . . 171
meaning:
पूर्वार्द्धात्स च वै जातः परार्द्धात्कृष्ण एव हि .
एकशीर्षा त्रिनेत्रा च द्विपदी द्विसहस्रिका . . 171
text_mt: he was born from the front half, while Kṛṣṇa alone [remained] from the back half. / One-headed, three-eyed, two-footed, and two-thousand-[armed]—

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvārdhātsā tu vai jātā rādhā devī parārddhataḥ .
puruṣaḥ prakṛtiścobhau tepatuḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ . . 172
meaning:
पूर्वार्धात्सा तु वै जाता राधा देवी परार्द्धतः .
पुरुषः प्रकृतिश्चोभौ तेपतुः परमं तपः . . 172
text_mt: she was born from the front half, while goddess Rādhā [remained] from the back half. / Both Puruṣa and Prakṛti performed supreme asceticism

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrayugaparyyantaṃ divye vṛndāvane śubhe .
tapasā vavṛdhāte tau nāmnānanto hyanantakaḥ . . 173
meaning:
सहस्रयुगपर्य्यन्तं दिव्ये वृन्दावने शुभे .
तपसा ववृधाते तौ नाम्नानन्तो ह्यनन्तकः . . 173
text_mt: for a thousand yugas in the divine, auspicious Vṛndāvana. / Through asceticism the two grew, endless indeed by the name Ananta.

sanskrit_iast:
ekībhūtau tu tatpaścātsaṃsthitau maithunecchayā .
tadaṅkaromakūpeṣu brahmāṇḍāḥ koṭiśo'bhavan . . 174
meaning:
एकीभूतौ तु तत्पश्चात्संस्थितौ मैथुनेच्छया .
तदङ्करोमकूपेषु ब्रह्माण्डाः कोटिशोऽभवन् . . 174
text_mt: Then, having united, they remained with the desire for union. / In the hair-follicles of their bodies, crores of cosmic eggs came to be,

sanskrit_iast:
koṭyarddhayojanāyāmāste tu sarve pṛthakpṛthak .
hṛdi romasamudbhūto brahmāṇḍo'yaṃ ca bhoḥ surāḥ . . 175
meaning:
कोट्यर्द्धयोजनायामास्ते तु सर्वे पृथक्पृथक् .
हृदि रोमसमुद्भूतो ब्रह्माण्डोऽयं च भोः सुराः . . 175
text_mt: all extending separately for half a crore of leagues. / And this cosmic egg, O gods, arose from a hair on the chest.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍādudbhavo brahmā padmapuṣpe samāsthitaḥ .
sa padmo yojanāyāmo bhūmimaṇḍalasaṃsthitaḥ . . 176
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डादुद्भवो ब्रह्मा पद्मपुष्पे समास्थितः .
स पद्मो योजनायामो भूमिमण्डलसंस्थितः . . 176
text_mt: From the cosmic egg arose Brahmā, seated upon a lotus flower. / That lotus, extending a league, stood upon the circle of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
yato jātaṃ vidheḥ padmaṃ tadvai padmasarovaram .
prasiddhaṃ puṣkarakṣetraṃ tatpadmasarasaṃ surāḥ . . 177
meaning:
यतो जातं विधेः पद्मं तद्वै पद्मसरोवरम् .
प्रसिद्धं पुष्करक्षेत्रं तत्पद्मसरसं सुराः . . 177
text_mt: From which the lotus of the Creator arose, that indeed is the Lotus Lake. / The renowned holy site of Puṣkara, O gods, is that Lotus Lake.

sanskrit_iast:
vismitaḥ sa tadā brahmā nararūpaścaturmukhaḥ .
nāle nāle gatosau vai divyaṃ jātaṃ śataṃ samāḥ . . 178
meaning:
विस्मितः स तदा ब्रह्मा नररूपश्चतुर्मुखः .
नाले नाले गतोसौ वै दिव्यं जातं शतं समाः . . 178
text_mt: Astonished then was four-faced Brahmā in human form. / He went along stalk after stalk, and a hundred divine years passed.

sanskrit_iast:
nāntaṃ jagāma padmasya punarbrahmā sa cāgataḥ .
māyayā mohitastatra ruroda bahudhā tadā . . 179
meaning:
नान्तं जगाम पद्मस्य पुनर्ब्रह्मा स चागतः .
मायया मोहितस्तत्र रुरोद बहुधा तदा . . 179
text_mt: Brahmā did not reach the end of the lotus, and he returned again. / Deluded there by Māyā, he then wept in many ways.

sanskrit_iast:
rodanādrudra utpannaḥ sa ca tatkṣemakārakaḥ .
kiṃ rodiṣi mahābhāga tvadīśo hṛdaye tava . . 3.4.25.180
meaning:
रोदनाद्रुद्र उत्पन्नः स च तत्क्षेमकारकः .
किं रोदिषि महाभाग त्वदीशो हृदये तव . . 3.4.25.180
text_mt: From his weeping Rudra was born, who brought about his welfare: / 'Why do you weep, O noble one? Your Lord is in your heart.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vacastasya brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ .
samādhibhūto hṛdaye ciraṃ tepe svakecchayā . . 181
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः .
समाधिभूतो हृदये चिरं तेपे स्वकेच्छया . . 181
text_mt: Hearing these words of his, Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, / entered into meditation in his heart and practiced asceticism for a long time of his own accord.

sanskrit_iast:
divyavarṣaśatābde tu prādurbhūto hariḥ svayam .
vacanaṃ prāha bhagavānmeghagambhīrayā girā . . 182
meaning:
दिव्यवर्षशताब्दे तु प्रादुर्भूतो हरिः स्वयम् .
वचनं प्राह भगवान्मेघगम्भीरया गिरा . . 182
text_mt: At the end of a hundred divine years, Hari himself appeared. / The Lord spoke words with a voice deep as a thundercloud:

sanskrit_iast:
karmabhūmiriyaṃ brahmañjīvāntā jīvakāriṇī .
sahasrayojanāyāṃ tu viśvasminbhūmimaṇḍale . . 183
meaning:
कर्मभूमिरियं ब्रह्मञ्जीवान्ता जीवकारिणी .
सहस्रयोजनायां तु विश्वस्मिन्भूमिमण्डले . . 183
text_mt: 'O Brahmā, this is the land of works, ending in living beings, producing living beings, / extending a thousand leagues in the entire circle of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
himādriruttare tasyāḥ pūrve'bdhiśca mahodadhiḥ .
ratnākaraḥ paścime'bdhirdakṣiṇe vaḍavābdhikaḥ . . 184
meaning:
हिमाद्रिरुत्तरे तस्याः पूर्वेऽब्धिश्च महोदधिः .
रत्नाकरः पश्चिमेऽब्धिर्दक्षिणे वडवाब्धिकः . . 184
text_mt: The Snow Mountain is to its north, and to the east is the ocean, the Great Sea; / the Jewel-Mine is the ocean to the west, and to the south is the Submarine-Fire ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti lokāścorddhvaṃ tathā hyadhaḥ .
karmabhūmermadhyabhūtaḥ puṣkaro'yaṃ sanātanaḥ . . 185
meaning:
अतः सर्वे भविष्यन्ति लोकाश्चोर्द्ध्वं तथा ह्यधः .
कर्मभूमेर्मध्यभूतः पुष्करोऽयं सनातनः . . 185
text_mt: From this, all worlds will come to be, both above and below. / This eternal Puṣkara is the center of the land of works.

sanskrit_iast:
matto vedānbhavānprāpya kariṣyati makhaṃ śubham .
yajñāddevā bhaviṣyanti tridhābhūtā guṇatrayāt . . 186
meaning:
मत्तो वेदान्भवान्प्राप्य करिष्यति मखं शुभम् .
यज्ञाद्देवा भविष्यन्ति त्रिधाभूता गुणत्रयात् . . 186
text_mt: Having obtained the Vedas from me, you shall perform an auspicious sacrifice. / From the sacrifice the gods will arise, threefold through the three guṇas:

sanskrit_iast:
siddhā vidyādharāścaiva cāraṇāḥ sāttvikāstridhā .
gandharvayakṣarakṣāṃsi rājasā girisaṃsthitāḥ . . 187
meaning:
सिद्धा विद्याधराश्चैव चारणाः सात्त्विकास्त्रिधा .
गन्धर्वयक्षरक्षांसि राजसा गिरिसंस्थिताः . . 187
text_mt: the siddhas, vidyādharas, and cāraṇas are the three sattva ones; / the gandharvas, yakṣas, and rākṣasas dwelling on mountains are of rajas;

sanskrit_iast:
piśācaguhyakā bhūtāstāmasā gāmino hyadhaḥ .
tathā svadhāmayā yajñāstridhā pitṛgaṇā vidhe . . 188
meaning:
पिशाचगुह्यका भूतास्तामसा गामिनो ह्यधः .
तथा स्वधामया यज्ञास्त्रिधा पितृगणा विधे . . 188
text_mt: the piśācas, guhyakas, and ghosts are of tamas, going downward. / Likewise, sacrifices consisting of svadhā [produce] the threefold hosts of ancestors, O Creator.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyanti surai ramyā vimānasadṛśāśca khe .
khecarā gauravarṇāśca śyāmāste sāttvikāḥ smṛtāḥ . . 189
meaning:
भविष्यन्ति सुरै रम्या विमानसदृशाश्च खे .
खेचरा गौरवर्णाश्च श्यामास्ते सात्त्विकाः स्मृताः . . 189
text_mt: They will be delightful with the gods, resembling celestial chariots in the sky. / Moving in the sky, fair-complexioned and dark, they are taught as sattva ones.

sanskrit_iast:
giridvīpamayā ramyāḥ sarorūpāśca rājasāḥ .
bhūcarāste bhaviṣyanti tridhā pitṛgaṇā vidhe . . 3.4.25.190
meaning:
गिरिद्वीपमया रम्याः सरोरूपाश्च राजसाः .
भूचरास्ते भविष्यन्ति त्रिधा पितृगणा विधे . . 3.4.25.190
text_mt: Delightful, composed of mountains and islands, and of the form of lakes, are those of rajas; / they will be dwellers on earth—the threefold hosts of ancestors, O Creator.

sanskrit_iast:
biletalamayā ye tu nārakā yātanāmayāḥ .
tāmasāste bhaviṣyanti pitaro'dhomahītale . . 191
meaning:
बिलेतलमया ये तु नारका यातनामयाः .
तामसास्ते भविष्यन्ति पितरोऽधोमहीतले . . 191
text_mt: Those that consist of subterranean realms, belonging to hell and full of torment, / they, belonging to tamas, will be the ancestors in the netherworld.'

sanskrit_iast:
vyayabhūtāśca te lokā vṛddhā madhyāḥ kṣayāḥ kramāt .
iyaṃ bhūmirmahābhāgā sarvadā ca sanātanī . . 192
meaning:
व्ययभूताश्च ते लोका वृद्धा मध्याः क्षयाः क्रमात् .
इयं भूमिर्महाभागा सर्वदा च सनातनी . . 192
text_mt: And those worlds are subject to decay, waxing, intermediate, and waning in succession. / This earth, highly fortunate, is eternal and everlasting.

sanskrit_iast:
merurvai ca nameruśca dvīpāścāsaṃstathā na hi .
ilāvartādikhaṇḍāśca santi naiva kvacitkvacit . . 193
meaning:
मेरुर्वै च नमेरुश्च द्वीपाश्चासंस्तथा न हि .
इलावर्तादिखण्डाश्च सन्ति नैव क्वचित्क्वचित् . . 193
text_mt: Meru and Nameru, and the continents, did not exist thus, / nor indeed were there regions such as Ilāvarta anywhere at all.

sanskrit_iast:
ye tu tārāmayā lokā vimānasadṛśā vidhe .
svecchayā ca kariṣyanti rakṣitā yajñakarmaṇā . . 194
meaning:
ये तु तारामया लोका विमानसदृशा विधे .
स्वेच्छया च करिष्यन्ति रक्षिता यज्ञकर्मणा . . 194
text_mt: Those worlds consisting of stars, resembling celestial chariots, O creator, / protected by sacrificial rites, will move at their own will.

sanskrit_iast:
yajño nāsti yadā bhūmau tadā te bhagaṇā vidhe .
vighnabhūtāścariṣyanti nityavakrāticāriṇaḥ . 195
meaning:
यज्ञो नास्ति यदा भूमौ तदा ते भगणा विधे .
विघ्नभूताश्चरिष्यन्ति नित्यवक्रातिचारिणः . 195
text_mt: When sacrifice is absent on earth, then those constellations, O creator, / will move as obstacles, perpetually retrograde and in excess motion.

sanskrit_iast:
karmabhūmiśca gaurjñeyā śrutirūpā jaganmayī .
yastāṃ pāti ca bho brahmansa gopa iti viśrutaḥ . . 196
meaning:
कर्मभूमिश्च गौर्ज्ञेया श्रुतिरूपा जगन्मयी .
यस्तां पाति च भो ब्रह्मन्स गोप इति विश्रुतः . . 196
text_mt: The land of religious action should be known as the cow, consisting of the Veda and embodying the universe. / He who protects her, O Brahmā, is renowned as Gopa.

sanskrit_iast:
gopaśaktiḥ sa vai gopo gopānāmarcako hariḥ .
koṭikoṭisahasrāśca sarva gopā hareḥ kalāḥ . . 197
meaning:
गोपशक्तिः स वै गोपो गोपानामर्चको हरिः .
कोटिकोटिसहस्राश्च सर्व गोपा हरेः कलाः . . 197
text_mt: He indeed is Gopa, possessing the cowherd's power, and Hari is the worshipper of cowherds. / All the thousands of tens of millions of cowherds are portions of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvantaścaiva brahmāṇḍā gopanāmnā prakīrtitāḥ .
karmabhūmestathordhvaṃ ca raviryojanalakṣakaḥ . . 198
meaning:
तावन्तश्चैव ब्रह्माण्डा गोपनाम्ना प्रकीर्तिताः .
कर्मभूमेस्तथोर्ध्वं च रविर्योजनलक्षकः . . 198
text_mt: And so many universes are proclaimed under the name of Gopa. / Above the land of religious action is the sun, a hundred thousand yojanas away.

sanskrit_iast:
tataśśaśī tathāmānastataścordhvaṃ bhamaṇḍalam .
dvilakṣayojanagatastato bhaumastathāvidhaḥ . . 199
meaning:
ततश्शशी तथामानस्ततश्चोर्ध्वं भमण्डलम् .
द्विलक्षयोजनगतस्ततो भौमस्तथाविधः . . 199
text_mt: Beyond that is the moon of equal measure; beyond that is the sphere of the stars; / two hundred thousand yojanas further is Mars of like extent.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaumādbudhastathā jñeyo budhācca bṛhatāṃpatiḥ .
guroḥ śukrastathāmānaḥ śukrātsauristathāgataḥ . . 3.4.25.200
meaning:
भौमाद्बुधस्तथा ज्ञेयो बुधाच्च बृहतांपतिः .
गुरोः शुक्रस्तथामानः शुक्रात्सौरिस्तथागतः . . 3.4.25.200
text_mt: Beyond Mars, Mercury is to be known; beyond Mercury, Jupiter; / beyond Jupiter, Venus of equal measure; beyond Venus, Saturn is situated.

sanskrit_iast:
śanerāhustathā jñeyo rāhoḥ ketustathordhvagaḥ .
saptalakṣamitaṃ jñeyaṃ ketoḥ saptarṣimaṇḍalam . . 201
meaning:
शनेराहुस्तथा ज्ञेयो राहोः केतुस्तथोर्ध्वगः .
सप्तलक्षमितं ज्ञेयं केतोः सप्तर्षिमण्डलम् . . 201
text_mt: Beyond Saturn, Rāhu is to be known; beyond Rāhu, Ketu is positioned higher; / Ketu's distance to the circle of the Seven Sages is to be known as seven hundred thousand [yojanas].

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaikādaśagāḥ sarve tataścordhvaṃ dhruvāspadam .
lakṣayojanagaṃ caiva tataścordhvaṃ mahatpadam . . 202
meaning:
लक्षैकादशगाः सर्वे ततश्चोर्ध्वं ध्रुवास्पदम् .
लक्षयोजनगं चैव ततश्चोर्ध्वं महत्पदम् . . 202
text_mt: All these reach eleven hundred thousand [yojanas]; beyond that is the abode of Dhruva, / situated at a hundred thousand yojanas; and beyond that is Maharloka.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣayojanagaṃ jñeyaṃ tataścordhvaṃ janāspadam .
lakṣayojanagaṃ jñeyaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ tapasaḥ sthalam . . 203
meaning:
लक्षयोजनगं ज्ञेयं ततश्चोर्ध्वं जनास्पदम् .
लक्षयोजनगं ज्ञेयं तदूर्ध्वं तपसः स्थलम् . . 203
text_mt: It should be known as situated at a hundred thousand yojanas; beyond that is the realm of Janas; / situated at a hundred thousand yojanas; above that is the realm of Tapas.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ ca karmabhūmeśca tapaḥ koṭyardhayojanam .
karmabhūmeradhaścaiva pātālāḥ sapta cāntarāḥ . . 204
meaning:
एवं च कर्मभूमेश्च तपः कोट्यर्धयोजनम् .
कर्मभूमेरधश्चैव पातालाः सप्त चान्तराः . . 204
text_mt: Thus, from the land of religious action to Tapas is five million yojanas. / And beneath the land of religious action are the seven intermediate underworlds.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣayojanagā jñeyāstataścādhogatāśca ye .
narakāśca kramājjeyā bhūmeḥ koṭyarddhayojanāḥ . . 205
meaning:
लक्षयोजनगा ज्ञेयास्ततश्चाधोगताश्च ये .
नरकाश्च क्रमाज्जेया भूमेः कोट्यर्द्धयोजनाः . . 205
text_mt: They are to be known as extending a hundred thousand yojanas; those below them, / the hells, in succession, should be known as five million yojanas from the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
karmabhūmeruttare ca khaṇḍānyaṣṭau tataḥ param .
lavaṇābdhistato dvīpastataḥ kṣīrābdhireva hi . .
tato dvīpastataḥ sindhustato dvīpastato'bdhikaḥ . . 206
meaning:
कर्मभूमेरुत्तरे च खण्डान्यष्टौ ततः परम् .
लवणाब्धिस्ततो द्वीपस्ततः क्षीराब्धिरेव हि . .
ततो द्वीपस्ततः सिन्धुस्ततो द्वीपस्ततोऽब्धिकः . . 206
text_mt: To the north of the land of religious action are eight continents; beyond that / is the Salt Ocean, then a continent, then indeed the Ocean of Milk, / then a continent, then an ocean, then a continent, then an ocean,

sanskrit_iast: koṭyarddhalakṣavyānena yojanena vidhe svayam . . 207
meaning: कोट्यर्द्धलक्षव्यानेन योजनेन विधे स्वयम् . . 207
text_mt: with an extent of fifty thousand yojanas, O creator, by itself.

sanskrit_iast:
karmabhūmeḥ sa vai jñeyo lokālokā mahācalaḥ .
lokāloko dakṣiṇe ca paścime ca sa vai giriḥ . . 208
meaning:
कर्मभूमेः स वै ज्ञेयो लोकालोका महाचलः .
लोकालोको दक्षिणे च पश्चिमे च स वै गिरिः . . 208
text_mt: From the land of religious action, that Lokāloka is to be known as the great mountain; / Lokāloka is that mountain in the south and in the west.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrve ca karmabhūmeśca lokālokastathāvidhaḥ .
eteṣāṃ samudāyānāṃ brahmāṇḍo'yaṃ prakīrtitaḥ . . 209
meaning:
पूर्वे च कर्मभूमेश्च लोकालोकस्तथाविधः .
एतेषां समुदायानां ब्रह्माण्डोऽयं प्रकीर्तितः . . 209
text_mt: And to the east of the land of religious action, Lokāloka is likewise situated. / This universe is proclaimed as composed of these collections.

sanskrit_iast:
tvatto bhaviṣyati vidhe kalpaparyantameva hi .
omityekākṣaraṃ brahma tato viṣṇustridhābhavat . . 3.4.25.210
meaning:
त्वत्तो भविष्यति विधे कल्पपर्यन्तमेव हि .
ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म ततो विष्णुस्त्रिधाभवत् . . 3.4.25.210
text_mt: It will arise from you, O creator, until the end of the kalpa. / The monosyllable Om is brahman; from it Viṣṇu became threefold:

sanskrit_iast:
adya viṣṇuḥ sa vai kṛṣṇa iha viṣṇuḥ sa vai virāṭ .
iti viṣṇuḥ sa vai jñeyaḥ purāṇapuruṣottamaḥ . . 211
meaning:
अद्य विष्णुः स वै कृष्ण इह विष्णुः स वै विराट् .
इति विष्णुः स वै ज्ञेयः पुराणपुरुषोत्तमः . . 211
text_mt: Viṣṇu as the primordial is indeed Kṛṣṇa; Viṣṇu here is indeed the cosmic Virāṭ. / Thus Viṣṇu is to be known as the ancient Supreme Spirit.

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇapuruṣo jñeya ādibrahmā cirāyugaḥ .
daive yugasahasre dve'horātraṃ tasya kīrtitam . . 212
meaning:
पुराणपुरुषो ज्ञेय आदिब्रह्मा चिरायुगः .
दैवे युगसहस्रे द्वेऽहोरात्रं तस्य कीर्तितम् . . 212
text_mt: The ancient Person is to be known as the primordial Brahmā, long-lived; / his day and night are declared to be two thousand divine yugas.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇostu romakūpeṣu brahmāṇḍāḥ koṭiśo'bhavan .
adya viṣṇurahaṃ brahmanvighnahā tava bhūtale . . 213
meaning:
विष्णोस्तु रोमकूपेषु ब्रह्माण्डाः कोटिशोऽभवन् .
अद्य विष्णुरहं ब्रह्मन्विघ्नहा तव भूतले . . 213
text_mt: In the hair-pores of Viṣṇu, tens of millions of universes have arisen. / I am Viṣṇu the primordial, O Brahmā, the remover of obstacles for you on the surface of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktavāntardadhe viṣṇurbrahmā sṛṣṭimacīkarat .
tena proktaṃ yato bhāvyaṃ mahākalpo hi sa smṛtaḥ . . 214
meaning:
इत्युक्तवान्तर्दधे विष्णुर्ब्रह्मा सृष्टिमचीकरत् .
तेन प्रोक्तं यतो भाव्यं महाकल्पो हि स स्मृतः . . 214
text_mt: Having spoken thus, Viṣṇu vanished; Brahmā brought forth the creation. / Since the future was spoken by him, it is remembered as the great kalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyo nāma vikhyāto dvisahasrabhavāyuṣā .
pūrvārddhaśca kūparārddhaśca purāṇapuruṣasya hiḥ . . 215
meaning:
भविष्यो नाम विख्यातो द्विसहस्रभवायुषा .
पूर्वार्द्धश्च कूपरार्द्धश्च पुराणपुरुषस्य हिः . . 215
text_mt: It is renowned by the name Bhaviṣya, with a lifespan of two thousand existences; / there are the first half and the second half of the ancient Person.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi kalpāḥ pūrvārddhake gatāḥ .
parārddhaḥ sāmprataṃ jñeyo jātaṃ tasya dinadvayam . . 216
meaning:
अष्टादशसहस्राणि कल्पाः पूर्वार्द्धके गताः .
परार्द्धः साम्प्रतं ज्ञेयो जातं तस्य दिनद्वयम् . . 216
text_mt: Eighteen thousand kalpas passed in the first half; / the second half should be known as current; two days of his have elapsed.

sanskrit_iast:
adyāhaṃ kūrmakaścaiva vāhane matsyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .
tṛtīyaḥ śvetavārāho divasastasya kalpavān . . 217
meaning:
अद्याहं कूर्मकश्चैव वाहने मत्स्यः प्रकीर्तितः .
तृतीयः श्वेतवाराहो दिवसस्तस्य कल्पवान् . . 217
text_mt: Today is myself as Kūrma; in the vehicle it is Matsya; / the third day, possessing a kalpa, is the Śvetavārāha.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā madhyāhnakālo hi sāmprataṃ vartate surāḥ .
bhaviṣyākhye mahākalpe kathā bhāviṣyakairjanaiḥ . . 218
meaning:
तथा मध्याह्नकालो हि साम्प्रतं वर्तते सुराः .
भविष्याख्ये महाकल्पे कथा भाविष्यकैर्जनैः . . 218
text_mt: And now it is midday, O gods. / In the great kalpa named Bhaviṣya, the account of future people

sanskrit_iast:
kathitā brahmaṇaścāgre śatakoṭipravistaraiḥ .
daśalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ śatakoṭipravistaram . . 219
meaning:
कथिता ब्रह्मणश्चाग्रे शतकोटिप्रविस्तरैः .
दशलक्षणसंयुक्तं शतकोटिप्रविस्तरम् . . 219
text_mt: was spoken before Brahmā in an extent of a billion [verses]. / Endowed with ten characteristics, with an extent of a billion [verses],

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpurāṇa kathitaṃ purāṇaṃ pañcalakṣaṇam .
padyatriṃśatsahasraṃ ca kalpe kalpe prakīrtitam . . 3.4.25.220
meaning:
महापुराण कथितं पुराणं पञ्चलक्षणम् .
पद्यत्रिंशत्सहस्रं च कल्पे कल्पे प्रकीर्तितम् . . 3.4.25.220
text_mt: the Mahāpurāṇa is declared, whereas a Purāṇa has five characteristics. / Thirty thousand verses are proclaimed in kalpa after kalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpanāmnā purāṇaṃ ca mahādevena nirmitam .
aṣṭādaśapurāṇāni nirmitāni śivātmanā . . 221
meaning:
कल्पनाम्ना पुराणं च महादेवेन निर्मितम् .
अष्टादशपुराणानि निर्मितानि शिवात्मना . . 221
text_mt: The Purāṇa named after the kalpas was composed by Mahādeva; / eighteen Purāṇas were composed by the nature of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
dvāparānte ca bhagavānvyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ .
tānyeva janayāmāsa lokamaṅgalahetave . . 222
meaning:
द्वापरान्ते च भगवान्व्यासः सत्यवतीसुतः .
तान्येव जनयामास लोकमङ्गलहेतवे . . 222
text_mt: And at the end of Dvāpara, the blessed Vyāsa, son of Satyavatī, / brought forth those very texts for the welfare of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
iti kalkivacaḥ śrutvā te devā vismayānvitāḥ .
namaskṛtya gamiṣyanti svaṃ svaṃ dhāma praharṣitāḥ . . 223
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe pratisargaparvaṇi caturyugakhaṇḍāparaparyāye
kaliyugīyetihāsasamuccayavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ . 25
kaliyugīyetihāsasamuccayavarṇanam
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
इति कल्किवचः श्रुत्वा ते देवा विस्मयान्विताः .
नमस्कृत्य गमिष्यन्ति स्वं स्वं धाम प्रहर्षिताः . . 223
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे प्रतिसर्गपर्वणि चतुर्युगखण्डापरपर्याये
कलियुगीयेतिहाससमुच्चयवर्णनं नाम पञ्चविंशोऽध्यायः . 25
कलियुगीयेतिहाससमुच्चयवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Vyāsa said: / Having heard these words of Kalki, those gods, filled with astonishment, / having bowed, will go each to his own abode, greatly rejoicing.
Thus ends the twenty-fifth chapter, named 'Description of the Compendium of History of the Kali Age', in the section on the Four Yugas of the Pratisargaparvan in the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Compendium of History of the Kali Age

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
tadā sa bhagavānkalkiḥ purāṇapuruṣodbhavaḥ .
divyaṃ vājinamāruhya khaḍgī varmī ca carmadhṛk . .
mlecchāṃstāndaityabhūtāṃśca hatvā yogaṃ gamiṣyati . . 1
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
तदा स भगवान्कल्किः पुराणपुरुषोद्भवः .
दिव्यं वाजिनमारुह्य खड्गी वर्मी च चर्मधृक् . .
म्लेच्छांस्तान्दैत्यभूतांश्च हत्वा योगं गमिष्यति . . 1
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Then the blessed Kalki, born of the ancient Person, / having mounted a divine steed, equipped with sword, armour, and shield, / having slain those barbarians who were Daityas, will enter into yoga.
title: Kaliyugīyetihāsasamuccayavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśābdasahasrāṇi tadyogāgnipratāpitā .
bhasmabhūtā karmabhūmirnirjīvā bhavitā tadā . . 2
meaning:
षोडशाब्दसहस्राणि तद्योगाग्निप्रतापिता .
भस्मभूता कर्मभूमिर्निर्जीवा भविता तदा . . 2
text_mt: Scorched by the fire of his yoga for sixteen thousand years, / the land of religious action, turned to ashes, will then become devoid of life.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'nuyogaṃ janito megho bhūtvā layaṅkaraḥ .
pralayāgreṇa sā bhūmirjalamadhye gamiṣyati . . 3
meaning:
ततोऽनुयोगं जनितो मेघो भूत्वा लयङ्करः .
प्रलयाग्रेण सा भूमिर्जलमध्ये गमिष्यति . . 3
text_mt: Then, following upon yoga, a cloud causing dissolution will arise; / through the vanguard of the deluge, that earth will enter into the waters.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā kaliyugo ghoro balipārśvaṃ gamiṣyati .
gate kaliyuge ghore karmabhūmiṃ punarhariḥ . .
kṛtvā sthalamayīṃ ramyāṃ yajñairdevānyajiṣyati . . 4
meaning:
तदा कलियुगो घोरो बलिपार्श्वं गमिष्यति .
गते कलियुगे घोरे कर्मभूमिं पुनर्हरिः . .
कृत्वा स्थलमयीं रम्यां यज्ञैर्देवान्यजिष्यति . . 4
text_mt: Then the terrible Kaliyuga will go to the side of Bali. / When the terrible Kaliyuga has departed, Hari will once again / make the land of religious action solid and delightful, and worship the gods with sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñabhāgamupādāya devāste balasaṃyutāḥ .
vaivasvataṃ manuṃ gatvā kathayiṣyanti kāraṇam . . 5
meaning:
यज्ञभागमुपादाय देवास्ते बलसंयुताः .
वैवस्वतं मनुं गत्वा कथयिष्यन्ति कारणम् . . 5
text_mt: Having received their share of the sacrifice, those gods, endowed with strength, / will go to Vaivasvata Manu and declare the cause.

sanskrit_iast:
kalkino vadanājjāto brāhmaṇo varṇa eva hi .
bāhvoḥ kṣatraṃ viśo jānvoḥ śūdro varṇastadaṅghrayoḥ . . 6
meaning:
कल्किनो वदनाज्जातो ब्राह्मणो वर्ण एव हि .
बाह्वोः क्षत्रं विशो जान्वोः शूद्रो वर्णस्तदङ्घ्रयोः . . 6
text_mt: From the mouth of Kalki, the brāhmaṇa class indeed was born; / the kṣatriya from his arms, the vaiśya from his thighs, and the śūdra class from his feet.

sanskrit_iast:
gauro raktastathā pītaḥ śyāmaste brāhmaṇādayaḥ .
devyāḥ śaktiṃ samādāya janiṣyanti sutānbahūn . . 7
meaning:
गौरो रक्तस्तथा पीतः श्यामस्ते ब्राह्मणादयः .
देव्याः शक्तिं समादाय जनिष्यन्ति सुतान्बहून् . . 7
