text_mt: Flesh flying in the air is eaten by birds, on earth by beasts of prey, / and in water it is eaten by fish; likewise is the wealthy man everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
vimohayati saṃpatsu tāpayaṃti vipattiṣu ..
khedayaṃtyarjanākāle kadā hyarthāḥ sukhāvahāḥ .. 124 ..
meaning:
विमोहयति संपत्सु तापयंति विपत्तिषु ..
खेदयंत्यर्जनाकाले कदा ह्यर्थाः सुखावहाः .. 124 ..
text_mt: [Riches] delude in prosperity, torment in adversity, / and cause exhaustion at the time of acquisition; when are riches ever conducive to happiness?

sanskrit_iast:
yathārthapatirudvigno yaśca sarvārthaniḥspṛhaḥ ..
yataścārthapatirduḥkhī sukhī sarvārthaniḥspṛhaḥ .. 125 ..
meaning:
यथार्थपतिरुद्विग्नो यश्च सर्वार्थनिःस्पृहः ..
यतश्चार्थपतिर्दुःखी सुखी सर्वार्थनिःस्पृहः .. 125 ..
text_mt: Just as the owner of wealth is anxious, so he who is free from desire for all riches [is not]; / because the owner of wealth is miserable, while he who is free from desire for all riches is happy.

sanskrit_iast:
śītena duḥkhaṃ hemaṃte grīṣme tāpena dāruṇam ..
varṣāsu vātavarṣābhyāṃ kāle'pyevaṃ kutaḥ sukham .. 126 ..
meaning:
शीतेन दुःखं हेमंते ग्रीष्मे तापेन दारुणम् ..
वर्षासु वातवर्षाभ्यां कालेऽप्येवं कुतः सुखम् .. 126 ..
text_mt: There is pain through cold in winter, and terrible [pain] through heat in summer; / in the rains through wind and rain; even in season, how can there be happiness?

sanskrit_iast:
vivāhavistare duḥkhaṃ tadgarbhodvahane punaḥ ..
prasave'patyadoṣaiśca duḥkhaṃ duḥkhādikarmabhiḥ .. 127 ..
meaning:
विवाहविस्तरे दुःखं तद्गर्भोद्वहने पुनः ..
प्रसवेऽपत्यदोषैश्च दुःखं दुःखादिकर्मभिः .. 127 ..
text_mt: There is pain in the elaborate affair of marriage, and again in carrying the fetus; / in childbirth and through faults of children, there is pain from painful deeds and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
dantākṣiraugaiḥ putrasya hā kaṣṭaṃ kiṃ karomyaham ..
gāvo naṣṭāḥ kṛṣirbhagnā vṛṣāḥ kvāpi palāyitāḥ .. 128 ..
meaning:
दन्ताक्षिरौगैः पुत्रस्य हा कष्टं किं करोम्यहम् ..
गावो नष्टाः कृषिर्भग्ना वृषाः क्वापि पलायिताः .. 128 ..
text_mt: 'Due to diseases of the son's teeth and eyes, alas, what misery, what shall I do? / The cows are lost, the farming is ruined, the bulls have fled somewhere!'

sanskrit_iast:
amī prāghūrṇakāḥ prāptā bhaktacchede ca me gṛhe ..
bālāpatyā ca me bhāryā kaḥ kariṣyati raṃdhanam .. .. 129 ..
meaning:
अमी प्राघूर्णकाः प्राप्ता भक्तच्छेदे च मे गृहे ..
बालापत्या च मे भार्या कः करिष्यति रंधनम् .. .. 129 ..
text_mt: "These guests have arrived, and there is no cooked food in my house; / my wife has small children—who will do the cooking?"

sanskrit_iast:
pradānakāle kanyāyāḥ kīdṛśaśca varo bhavet ..
iti cintābhibhūtānāṃ kutaḥ saukhyaṃ kuṭubinām .. 4.4.130 ..
meaning:
प्रदानकाले कन्यायाः कीदृशश्च वरो भवेत् ..
इति चिन्ताभिभूतानां कुतः सौख्यं कुटुबिनाम् .. 4.4.130 ..
text_mt: "At the time of giving away the maiden, what kind of groom will he be?" / Overcome by such anxiety, whence can there be happiness for householders?

sanskrit_iast:
kuṭuṃbaciṃtākulitasya puṃsaḥ śrutaṃ ca śīlaṃ ca guṇāśca sarve ..
apakvakuṃbhe nihitā ivāpaḥ prayāṃti dehena samaṃ vināśam ..131..
meaning:
कुटुंबचिंताकुलितस्य पुंसः श्रुतं च शीलं च गुणाश्च सर्वे ..
अपक्वकुंभे निहिता इवापः प्रयांति देहेन समं विनाशम् ..131..
text_mt: For a man distressed by household worries, sacred learning, character, and all virtues / perish along with the body, like water poured into an unbaked pot.

sanskrit_iast:
rājyepi ca mahadduḥkhaṃ saṃdhivigrahaciṃtayā ..
putrādapi bhayaṃ yatra tatra saukhyaṃ hi kīdṛśam ..132..
meaning:
राज्येपि च महद्दुःखं संधिविग्रहचिंतया ..
पुत्रादपि भयं यत्र तत्र सौख्यं हि कीदृशम् ..132..
text_mt: Even in kingship there is great suffering through the worry of peace and war; / where there is fear even of one's own son, what happiness can there be?

sanskrit_iast:
sajātīyādvadhaḥ prāyaḥ sarveṣāmeva dehinām ..
ekadravyābhilāṣitvācchunāmiva parasparam .. .. 133 ..
meaning:
सजातीयाद्वधः प्रायः सर्वेषामेव देहिनाम् ..
एकद्रव्याभिलाषित्वाच्छुनामिव परस्परम् .. .. 133 ..
text_mt: Slaughter occurs for nearly all living beings at the hands of their own kind, / out of desiring the same object, just like dogs with one another.

sanskrit_iast:
nāpradhṛṣyabalaḥ kaścinnṛpaḥ khyātosti bhūtale ..
nikhilaṃ yastiraskṛtya sukhaṃ tiṣṭhati nirbhayaḥ .. 134 ..
meaning:
नाप्रधृष्यबलः कश्चिन्नृपः ख्यातोस्ति भूतले ..
निखिलं यस्तिरस्कृत्य सुखं तिष्ठति निर्भयः .. 134 ..
text_mt: No king of unassailable might is known on the earth / who, having subdued everyone, remains fearless and happy.

sanskrit_iast:
ā janmanaḥ prabhṛti duḥkha mayaṃ śarīraṃ karmātmakaṃ tava mayā kathitaṃ narendra ..
dānopavāsaniyamaiśca kṛtaistadeva sarvopabhogasukhabhāgbhavatīha puṃsām .. 135 ..
pāpabhedākhyānavarṇanam
meaning:
आ जन्मनः प्रभृति दुःख मयं शरीरं कर्मात्मकं तव मया कथितं नरेन्द्र ..
दानोपवासनियमैश्च कृतैस्तदेव सर्वोपभोगसुखभाग्भवतीह पुंसाम् .. 135 ..
पापभेदाख्यानवर्णनम्
text_mt:
From birth onwards, O lord of men, the body is full of suffering, consisting of karma—this I have told you; / yet when performed with gifts, fasts, and observances, that very body partakes here of the happiness of all enjoyments for men.
The description explaining the divisions of sins.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
adhodhaḥ patanaṃ puṃsāmadhaḥkarma prakīrtitam ..
narakārṇavaghoreṣu yātanā pāpamucyate .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
अधोधः पतनं पुंसामधःकर्म प्रकीर्तितम् ..
नरकार्णवघोरेषु यातना पापमुच्यते .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Downward and downward falling of men is proclaimed as base karma; / the torment in the terrible oceans of hell is called sin.
title: Pāpabhedākhyānam

sanskrit_iast:
adharmabhedā vijñeyāścittavṛttiprabhedataḥ ..
sthūlāḥ sūkṣmāḥ susūkṣmāśca koṭi bhedairanekadhā .. 2 ..
meaning:
अधर्मभेदा विज्ञेयाश्चित्तवृत्तिप्रभेदतः ..
स्थूलाः सूक्ष्माः सुसूक्ष्माश्च कोटि भेदैरनेकधा .. 2 ..
text_mt: The varieties of unrighteousness are to be known through the varieties of mental states— / gross, subtle, and very subtle, manifold in tens of millions of divisions.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra ye pāpanicayāḥ sthūlā narakahetavaḥ ..
te samāsena kathyaṃte manovākkāyasādhanāḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
तत्र ये पापनिचयाः स्थूला नरकहेतवः ..
ते समासेन कथ्यंते मनोवाक्कायसाधनाः .. 3 ..
text_mt: Among them, the accumulations of gross sins that are the causes of hell, / accomplished by mind, speech, and body, are related in brief.

sanskrit_iast:
parastrīṣvatha saṃkalpaścetasāniṣṭaciṃtanam ..
akāryābhiniveśaśca caturdhā karma mānasam.. 4 ..
meaning:
परस्त्रीष्वथ संकल्पश्चेतसानिष्टचिंतनम् ..
अकार्याभिनिवेशश्च चतुर्धा कर्म मानसम्.. 4 ..
text_mt: Lustful intent toward another's wife, pondering misfortune [for others] in the mind, / and adherence to what ought not to be done: mental karma is fourfold.

sanskrit_iast:
anibaddhapralāpitvamasatyaṃ cāpriyaṃ ca yat ..
parāpavādapaiśunyaṃ caturdhā karma vācikam .. 5 ..
meaning:
अनिबद्धप्रलापित्वमसत्यं चाप्रियं च यत् ..
परापवादपैशुन्यं चतुर्धा कर्म वाचिकम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Unconnected babbling, that which is untrue and unpleasant, / slander of others, and malice: vocal karma is fourfold.

sanskrit_iast:
abhakṣyabhakṣaṇaṃ hiṃsā mithyā kāmasya sevanam ..
parasvānāmupādānaṃ caturddhā karma kāyikam .. 6 ..
meaning:
अभक्ष्यभक्षणं हिंसा मिथ्या कामस्य सेवनम् ..
परस्वानामुपादानं चतुर्द्धा कर्म कायिकम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Eating forbidden food, violence, indulging in wrongful lust, / and taking the property of others: bodily karma is fourfold.

sanskrit_iast:
ityetaddvādaśavidhaṃ karma proktaṃ sasādhanam ..
teṣāṃ bhedaṃ punarvacmi yeṣāṃ phalamanaṃtakam ). 7 '
ye dviṣaṃti mahādevaṃ saṃsārārṇavatāraṇam ..
samastapātakopetāste yānti narakāgniṣu ...8...
meaning:
इत्येतद्द्वादशविधं कर्म प्रोक्तं ससाधनम् ..
तेषां भेदं पुनर्वच्मि येषां फलमनंतकम् ). 7 '
ये द्विषंति महादेवं संसारार्णवतारणम् ..
समस्तपातकोपेतास्ते यान्ति नरकाग्निषु ...8...
text_mt: Thus this karma is stated to be of twelve kinds along with its means. / I shall tell further the division of those whose fruit is endless. / Those who hate Mahādeva, the deliverer across the ocean of saṃsāra, / endowed with all sins, go into the fires of hell.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaghnaśca surāpaśca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ ..
mahāpātakinaścaite tatsaṃsargī ca paṃcamaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मघ्नश्च सुरापश्च स्तेयी च गुरुतल्पगः ..
महापातकिनश्चैते तत्संसर्गी च पंचमः .. 9 ..
text_mt: The killer of a brāhmaṇa, the drinker of liquor, the thief, and the violator of the guru's bed— / these are the perpetrators of great sins, and the fifth is one who associates with them.

sanskrit_iast:
krodhāddveṣādbhayāllobhādbrāhmaṇaṃ viśasaṃti ye ..
prāṇāṃtiko mahādoṣo brahmaghnāste prakīrtitāḥ... 4.5.10..
meaning:
क्रोधाद्द्वेषाद्भयाल्लोभाद्ब्राह्मणं विशसंति ये ..
प्राणांतिको महादोषो ब्रह्मघ्नास्ते प्रकीर्तिताः... 4.5.10..
text_mt: Those who slaughter a brāhmaṇa out of anger, hatred, fear, or greed— / a great sin that ends life—they are proclaimed as killers of brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaṃ ca samāhūya yācamānamakiñcanam ..
paścānnāstīti taṃ brūyātsa caivaṃ brahmahā smṛtaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणं च समाहूय याचमानमकिञ्चनम् ..
पश्चान्नास्तीति तं ब्रूयात्स चैवं ब्रह्महा स्मृतः .. 11 ..
text_mt: And having summoned a destitute brāhmaṇa who is begging, / if one afterwards says to him, "There is nothing," he too is considered a killer of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu vidyābhimānena nityaṃ jayati vai dvijān ..
samāsīnaḥ sabhāmadhye brahmahā so'pi kīrtitaḥ..12..
meaning:
यस्तु विद्याभिमानेन नित्यं जयति वै द्विजान् ..
समासीनः सभामध्ये ब्रह्महा सोऽपि कीर्तितः..12..
text_mt: He who, out of pride in his learning, constantly defeats twice-born men / while seated in the midst of an assembly, he too is proclaimed a killer of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
mithyāguṇaiḥ svamātmānaṃ nayatyutkarṣaṇaṃ balāt..
gurūṇāṃ ca viruddho yaḥ sa caiva brahmahā smṛtaḥ..
kṣuttṛṭsaṃtaptadehānāṃ dvijānāṃ bhoktumicchatām..
samācarati yo vighnaṃ tamāhurbrahmaghātakam..14..
meaning:
मिथ्यागुणैः स्वमात्मानं नयत्युत्कर्षणं बलात्..
गुरूणां च विरुद्धो यः स चैव ब्रह्महा स्मृतः..
क्षुत्तृट्संतप्तदेहानां द्विजानां भोक्तुमिच्छताम्..
समाचरति यो विघ्नं तमाहुर्ब्रह्मघातकम्..14..
text_mt: He who forcibly elevates himself with false virtues, / and he who is hostile to his gurus, is also considered a killer of a brāhmaṇa; / he who causes obstruction to twice-born men whose bodies are afflicted with hunger and thirst and who wish to eat, / him they call a slayer of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
piśunaḥ sarvalokānāṃ chidrānveṣaṇatatparaḥ ..
udvegajananaḥ krūraḥ sa caiva brahmahā smṛtaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
पिशुनः सर्वलोकानां छिद्रान्वेषणतत्परः ..
उद्वेगजननः क्रूरः स चैव ब्रह्महा स्मृतः .. 15 ..
text_mt: A slanderer of all people, intent on seeking out weaknesses, / causing anxiety, cruel—he too is considered a killer of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
gavāṃ tṛṣṇābhibhūtānāṃ jalārthamupasarpatām ..
samācarati yo vighnaṃ sa caiva brahmahā smṛtaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
गवां तृष्णाभिभूतानां जलार्थमुपसर्पताम् ..
समाचरति यो विघ्नं स चैव ब्रह्महा स्मृतः .. 16 ..
text_mt: He who causes obstruction to cows overcome with thirst / as they approach for water, he too is considered a killer of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
paradoṣamabhijñāya nṛpakarṇe karoti yaḥ ..
pāpīyānpiśunaḥ kṣudraḥ sa caiva brahmahā smṛtaḥ .. 17 ...
meaning:
परदोषमभिज्ञाय नृपकर्णे करोति यः ..
पापीयान्पिशुनः क्षुद्रः स चैव ब्रह्महा स्मृतः .. 17 ...
text_mt: He who, discovering another's fault, pours it into the king's ear, / wicked, malicious, base—he too is considered a killer of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
devadvijagavāṃ bhūmiṃ pūrvabhuktā harettu yaḥ ..
pranaṣṭāmapi kālena tamāhurbrahmaghātakam .. 18 ..
meaning:
देवद्विजगवां भूमिं पूर्वभुक्ता हरेत्तु यः ..
प्रनष्टामपि कालेन तमाहुर्ब्रह्मघातकम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: He who seizes the land of gods, twice-born men, and cows that was previously enjoyed, / even if lost over time, him they call a slayer of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijavittāpaharaṇe nyāyataḥ samupārjite ..
brahmahatyā samaṃ jñeyaṃ pātakaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
द्विजवित्तापहरणे न्यायतः समुपार्जिते ..
ब्रह्महत्या समं ज्ञेयं पातकं नात्र संशयः .. 19 ..
text_mt: In stealing the wealth of a twice-born man acquired lawfully, / the sin is to be known as equal to the killing of a brāhmaṇa; there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
agnihotraparityāgo yastu yājñikakarmaṇām ..
mātāpitṛparityāgaḥ kūṭasākṣyaṃ suhṛdvadhaḥ .. 4.5.20 ..
meaning:
अग्निहोत्रपरित्यागो यस्तु याज्ञिककर्मणाम् ..
मातापितृपरित्यागः कूटसाक्ष्यं सुहृद्वधः .. 4.5.20 ..
text_mt: Abandonment of the agnihotra on the part of those performing sacrifices, / abandonment of mother and father, false testimony, murder of a friend,

sanskrit_iast:
gavāṃ mārge vane cāgniṃ pure grāme ca dīpayet ..
iti pāpāni ghorāṇi surāpānasamāni tu .. 21 ..
meaning:
गवां मार्गे वने चाग्निं पुरे ग्रामे च दीपयेत् ..
इति पापानि घोराणि सुरापानसमानि तु .. 21 ..
text_mt: kindling a fire on a path of cows, in a forest, in a city, or in a village— / such terrible sins are equal to drinking liquor.

sanskrit_iast:
hīnasvaharaṇe cāpi narastrīgajavājinām ..
gobhūrajataratnānāmauṣadhīnāṃ rajasya ca .. 22 ..
meaning:
हीनस्वहरणे चापि नरस्त्रीगजवाजिनाम् ..
गोभूरजतरत्नानामौषधीनां रजस्य च .. 22 ..
text_mt: In stealing what is inferior, and also men, women, elephants, and horses, / cows, land, silver, jewels, medicinal herbs, and dust,

sanskrit_iast:
caṃdanāgarukarpūrakastūrīkhaṇḍavāsasām ..
haste nyasyāpaharaṇaṃ rukmasteyasamaṃ smṛtam .. 23 ..
meaning:
चंदनागरुकर्पूरकस्तूरीखण्डवाससाम् ..
हस्ते न्यस्यापहरणं रुक्मस्तेयसमं स्मृतम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: sandalwood, agallochum, camphor, musk, pieces of cloth— / seizing what was placed in one's hand is remembered as equal to the theft of gold.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyānāṃ varayogyānāmadānaṃ sadṛśe vare ..
putramitrakalatreṣu gamanaṃ bhaginīṣu ca .. 24 ..
meaning:
कन्यानां वरयोग्यानामदानं सदृशे वरे ..
पुत्रमित्रकलत्रेषु गमनं भगिनीषु च .. 24 ..
text_mt: Not giving maidens fit for a groom to a suitable groom, / going to the wives of sons and friends, and to sisters,

sanskrit_iast:
kumārīsāhasaṃ ghoramantyajastrīniṣevaṇam ..
avarṇāyāśca gamanaṃ gurutalpasamaṃ smṛtam .. 25 ..
meaning:
कुमारीसाहसं घोरमन्त्यजस्त्रीनिषेवणम् ..
अवर्णायाश्च गमनं गुरुतल्पसमं स्मृतम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: violating an unmarried girl, enjoying an outcaste woman, / and going to a woman of no caste is considered equal to violating the guru's bed.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpātakatulyāni pāpānyuktāni yāni tu ..
tāni pātakasaṃjñāni tadvadāmyupapātakam .. 26 ..
meaning:
महापातकतुल्यानि पापान्युक्तानि यानि तु ..
तानि पातकसंज्ञानि तद्वदाम्युपपातकम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: Those sins that have been stated as equal to the great sins / are termed pātaka; now I shall tell of the secondary sins.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijārthaṃ ca pratijñāya na prayacchati yaḥ punaḥ ..
tasmānnarapate vighnatulyaṃ tadupapātakam .. 27 ..
meaning:
द्विजार्थं च प्रतिज्ञाय न प्रयच्छति यः पुनः ..
तस्मान्नरपते विघ्नतुल्यं तदुपपातकम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: He who promises [a gift] for the sake of a twice-born man and then does not give it, / therefore, O lord of men, that is a secondary sin equal to an obstruction.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijadravyāpaharaṇaṃ maryādāyā vyatikramaḥ ..
atikopaśca mānaśca dāṃbhikatvaṃ kṛtaghnatā .. 28 ..
meaning:
द्विजद्रव्यापहरणं मर्यादाया व्यतिक्रमः ..
अतिकोपश्च मानश्च दांभिकत्वं कृतघ्नता .. 28 ..
text_mt: Seizing the property of a twice-born man, transgression of bounds, / excessive anger, arrogance, deceitfulness, ingratitude,

sanskrit_iast:
atyaṃtaviṣayāsaktiḥ kārpaṇyaṃ śreṣṭhamatsaraḥ ..
paradārāpaharaṇaṃ sādhukanyāvidūṣaṇam .. 29 ..
meaning:
अत्यंतविषयासक्तिः कार्पण्यं श्रेष्ठमत्सरः ..
परदारापहरणं साधुकन्याविदूषणम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: extreme attachment to sense-objects, miserliness, malice toward the eminent, / abduction of another's wife, defiling a virtuous maiden,

sanskrit_iast:
parivittiḥ parīvettā yayā ca parividyate ..
tayorddānaṃ ca kanyāyāstayoreva ca yājanam .. 4.5.30 ..
meaning:
परिवित्तिः परीवेत्ता यया च परिविद्यते ..
तयोर्द्दानं च कन्यायास्तयोरेव च याजनम् .. 4.5.30 ..
text_mt: the unmarried elder brother, the younger brother who marries first, and she through whom he marries first, / giving a maiden to them, and officiating at a sacrifice for them,

sanskrit_iast:
putramitrakalatrāṇāmabhāve svāminastathā ..
śiṣṭānāṃ caiva saṃnyāsaḥ sahajānāṃ tapasvinām .. 31 ..
meaning:
पुत्रमित्रकलत्राणामभावे स्वामिनस्तथा ..
शिष्टानां चैव संन्यासः सहजानां तपस्विनाम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: renunciation [of them] by the master in the absence of [other provision for] sons, friends, and wives, / and likewise for virtuous dependents and ascetic family members,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaṃgaśca dharmakṛtyānāṃ sahāyānāṃ vināśanam ..
pīḍāmāśramasaṃsthānānnācarettvalpikāmapi .. 32 ..
meaning:
भंगश्च धर्मकृत्यानां सहायानां विनाशनम् ..
पीडामाश्रमसंस्थानान्नाचरेत्त्वल्पिकामपि .. 32 ..
text_mt: interruption of righteous acts, the destruction of companions— / one should not inflict even the slightest torment on those dwelling in hermitages—

sanskrit_iast:
svabhṛtyaparivargasya paśudhānyadhanasya ca ..
kupyadhānyapaśusteyamayācyānāṃ ca yācanam .. 33 ..
meaning:
स्वभृत्यपरिवर्गस्य पशुधान्यधनस्य च ..
कुप्यधान्यपशुस्तेयमयाच्यानां च याचनम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: of one's own servants and retainers, of cattle, grain, and wealth; / the theft of base metals, grain, and cattle, and begging from those from whom one should not beg;

sanskrit_iast:
gavāṃ kṣatriyaveśyānāṃ strīśūdrāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
yajñārāmataḍāgānāṃ dārāpatyasya vikrayaḥ ..
tīrthayātropavāsānāṃ vratāyatanakarmaṇām .. 34 ..
meaning:
गवां क्षत्रियवेश्यानां स्त्रीशूद्राणां विशेषतः ..
यज्ञारामतडागानां दारापत्यस्य विक्रयः ..
तीर्थयात्रोपवासानां व्रतायतनकर्मणाम् .. 34 ..
text_mt: the selling of cows, kṣatriyas, and vaiśyas, and especially of women and śūdras, / of sacrifices, groves, and reservoirs, of wife and offspring, / of pilgrimages, fasts, votive observances, shrines, and sacred acts;

sanskrit_iast:
strīdhanānyupajīvaṃti strībhiratyaṃtanirjitāḥ ..
arakṣaṇaṃ ca nārīṇāṃ madyapastrīniṣevaṇam .. 35 ..
meaning:
स्त्रीधनान्युपजीवंति स्त्रीभिरत्यंतनिर्जिताः ..
अरक्षणं च नारीणां मद्यपस्त्रीनिषेवणम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: living off a woman's wealth, being thoroughly subjugated by women, / failing to protect women, and consorting with a woman who drinks liquor—

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṇānāmapradānaṃ ca dhānyavṛddhyupajīvinām ..
niṃditācca dhanādānamapaṇyānāṃ ca vikrayaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
ऋणानामप्रदानं च धान्यवृद्ध्युपजीविनाम् ..
निंदिताच्च धनादानमपण्यानां च विक्रयः .. 36 ..
text_mt: And non-repayment of debts by those living on usury of grain, / taking wealth from a censured person, and selling forbidden goods;

sanskrit_iast:
viṣamāraṇamaṃtrāṇāṃ prayogo mūlakarmaṇām ..
uccāṭanāvicāraśca garavidveṣaṇakriyā .. 37 ..
meaning:
विषमारणमंत्राणां प्रयोगो मूलकर्मणाम् ..
उच्चाटनाविचारश्च गरविद्वेषणक्रिया .. 37 ..
text_mt: The use of mantras for poison and killing, practices of root-sorcery, / spells to drive people away and bewitch them, and rites of poisoning and creating hatred;

sanskrit_iast:
jihvāsamupabhogārthaṃ yasyārambhaḥ svakarmasu ..
mūlyenādhyāpayedyaśca mūlyenādhīyate ca ye .. 38 ..
meaning:
जिह्वासमुपभोगार्थं यस्यारम्भः स्वकर्मसु ..
मूल्येनाध्यापयेद्यश्च मूल्येनाधीयते च ये .. 38 ..
text_mt: One whose enterprise in his own duties is only for the gratification of the tongue, / and he who teaches for a fee, and those who study for a fee;

sanskrit_iast:
vrātyatā vratasaṃtyāgaḥ sarvāhāraniṣevaṇam ..
asaddārābhigamanaṃ śuṣkatarkāvalaṃbanam .. 39 ..
meaning:
व्रात्यता व्रतसंत्यागः सर्वाहारनिषेवणम् ..
असद्दाराभिगमनं शुष्कतर्कावलंबनम् .. 39 ..
text_mt: Lapsing from caste duties, abandoning vows, consuming all kinds of food, / intercourse with an improper woman, and relying on dry logic;

sanskrit_iast:
devāgnisādhusādhvīnāṃ niṃdā gobrāhmaṇasya ca.
pratyakṣaṃ vā parokṣaṃ vā rājñāṃ maṇḍalikāmapi ..
duḥśīlā nāstikāḥ pāpāḥ sarvaśūnyasya vādinaḥ .. 4.5.40 ..
meaning:
देवाग्निसाधुसाध्वीनां निंदा गोब्राह्मणस्य च.
प्रत्यक्षं वा परोक्षं वा राज्ञां मण्डलिकामपि ..
दुःशीला नास्तिकाः पापाः सर्वशून्यस्य वादिनः .. 4.5.40 ..
text_mt: Reviling gods, fire, holy men, virtuous women, cattle, and Brahmins, / whether openly or secretly, or [reviling] even kings and vassal rulers, / being ill-behaved, atheists, sinners, and proponents of universal void;

sanskrit_iast:
parvakāle divā caiva viyonau paśuyoniṣu ..
rajasvalānāṃ yonau ca maithunaṃ ca samācaret ..41..
meaning:
पर्वकाले दिवा चैव वियोनौ पशुयोनिषु ..
रजस्वलानां योनौ च मैथुनं च समाचरेत् ..41..
text_mt: And one should [not] engage in sexual intercourse during the sacred festivals, or by day, / or in an unnatural orifice, among beasts, or in the vagina of menstruating women;

sanskrit_iast:
strīputramitrasaṃprīte grāsānnacchedakāśca ye ..
janasyā priyavaktāro dhūrtāḥ samayabhedinaḥ ..42..
meaning:
स्त्रीपुत्रमित्रसंप्रीते ग्रासान्नच्छेदकाश्च ये ..
जनस्या प्रियवक्तारो धूर्ताः समयभेदिनः ..42..
text_mt: And those who withhold mouthfuls of food from beloved wives, sons, and friends, / speakers of unkind words to people, knaves, and violators of agreements;

sanskrit_iast:
bhettā taḍāgacakrāṇāṃ saṃkramāṇāṃ rathasya ca ..
ekapaṃktisthitānāṃ ca pākabhedaṃ karoti yaḥ ..43..
meaning:
भेत्ता तडागचक्राणां संक्रमाणां रथस्य च ..
एकपंक्तिस्थितानां च पाकभेदं करोति यः ..43..
text_mt: A breaker of reservoirs, water-wheels, causeways, and chariots, / and one who discriminates in food served to those seated in a single row;

sanskrit_iast:
ityetaiste narāḥ pāpairupapātakinaḥ smṛtāḥ ..
yuktāstadūnakaiḥ kṣudraiḥ pāpaiḥ pāpatarāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
इत्येतैस्ते नराः पापैरुपपातकिनः स्मृताः ..
युक्तास्तदूनकैः क्षुद्रैः पापैः पापतराः स्मृताः .. 44 ..
text_mt: Men are considered guilty of secondary sins by these misdeeds; / joined with minor sins lesser than these, they are considered even more sinful.

sanskrit_iast:
ye gobrāhmaṇakanyānāṃ svāmimitratapasvinām ..
aṃtaraṃ yāṃti kāryeṣu te narā nārakāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
ये गोब्राह्मणकन्यानां स्वामिमित्रतपस्विनाम् ..
अंतरं यांति कार्येषु ते नरा नारकाः स्मृताः .. 45 ..
text_mt: Those who cause discord or ruin in the affairs of cattle, Brahmins, maidens, / masters, friends, and ascetics—those men are known as destined for hell.

sanskrit_iast:
paraśriyā ye tapyaṃte ye paradravyasūcakāḥ ..
paravyāpāraniratāḥ parastrīnaradūṣakāḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
परश्रिया ये तप्यंते ये परद्रव्यसूचकाः ..
परव्यापारनिरताः परस्त्रीनरदूषकाः .. 46 ..
text_mt: Those who torment themselves over another’s fortune, informants regarding another’s property, / those meddling in others' business, and defilers of others' wives and men;

sanskrit_iast:
dvijāya duḥkhaṃ yaḥ kuryātprakārairbahubhiḥ sadā ..
sevate yo dvijaḥ śūdrāṃ surāṃ jighrati kāmataḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
द्विजाय दुःखं यः कुर्यात्प्रकारैर्बहुभिः सदा ..
सेवते यो द्विजः शूद्रां सुरां जिघ्रति कामतः .. 47 ..
text_mt: One who constantly causes distress to a twice-born man in many ways, / a twice-born man who serves a Śūdra woman, and one who willfully smells liquor;

sanskrit_iast:
ye pānābhiratāḥ krūrā ye ca hiṃsāpriyā narāḥ ..
vittārthaṃ ye ca kurvaṃti dānayajñādikāṃ kriyām .. 48 ..
meaning:
ये पानाभिरताः क्रूरा ये च हिंसाप्रिया नराः ..
वित्तार्थं ये च कुर्वंति दानयज्ञादिकां क्रियाम् .. 48 ..
text_mt: Those men who are devoted to drinking, cruel, and fond of violence, / and those who perform acts such as gifts and sacrifices solely for the sake of wealth;

sanskrit_iast:
goṣṭhāgnijalarathyāsu tarucchāyāmaṭheṣu ca ..
tyajaṃtyamedhyaṃ puruṣā ārāmāyataneṣu ca .. .. 49 ..
meaning:
गोष्ठाग्निजलरथ्यासु तरुच्छायामठेषु च ..
त्यजंत्यमेध्यं पुरुषा आरामायतनेषु च .. .. 49 ..
text_mt: Men who deposit feces or urine in cattle-pens, fire, water, and roadways, / under the shade of trees, in hermitages, in gardens, and in temples;

sanskrit_iast:
madyapānaratā nityaṃ gānavādyaratā narāḥ ..
kelīkalābhujaṃgāśca raṃdhrānveṣaṇatatparāḥ .. 4.5.50 ..
meaning:
मद्यपानरता नित्यं गानवाद्यरता नराः ..
केलीकलाभुजंगाश्च रंध्रान्वेषणतत्पराः .. 4.5.50 ..
text_mt: Men constantly devoted to drinking liquor, singing, and playing musical instruments, / gallants versed in the arts of love-play, and those intent on seeking out vulnerabilities;

sanskrit_iast:
vaṃśeṣu kāśakāṣṭhaiśca śubhaiḥ śaṃkubhireva vā ..
ye mārgānsamupaghnaṃti parastrīrāharaṃti ca .. 51 ..
meaning:
वंशेषु काशकाष्ठैश्च शुभैः शंकुभिरेव वा ..
ये मार्गान्समुपघ्नंति परस्त्रीराहरंति च .. 51 ..
text_mt: Those who obstruct roadways with bamboos, kāśa grass, pieces of wood, / or pointed stakes, and those who carry off other men's wives;

sanskrit_iast:
kūṭaśāsanahartāraḥ kūṭakarmakriyāratāḥ ..
kūṭayuddhāśca śastreṇa kūṭasaṃvyavahāriṇaḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
कूटशासनहर्तारः कूटकर्मक्रियारताः ..
कूटयुद्धाश्च शस्त्रेण कूटसंव्यवहारिणः .. 52 ..
text_mt: Those who forge royal charters, those engaged in fraudulent acts, / those who fight deceitfully with weapons, and those who trade fraudulently;

sanskrit_iast:
dhanuṣāṃ śalyaśastrāṇāṃ yaḥ kartā yaśca vikrayī ..
nirdayo'tīva bhṛtyeṣu paśūnāṃ damakaśca yaḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
धनुषां शल्यशस्त्राणां यः कर्ता यश्च विक्रयी ..
निर्दयोऽतीव भृत्येषु पशूनां दमकश्च यः .. 53 ..
text_mt: He who makes bows, missile-points, and weapons, and he who sells them; / he who is exceedingly cruel toward servants, and he who cruelly tames animals;

sanskrit_iast:
mithyā pravadato vākyamākarṇayati yaḥ śanaiḥ ..
svāmimitragurudrohī māyāvī capalaḥ śaṭhaḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
मिथ्या प्रवदतो वाक्यमाकर्णयति यः शनैः ..
स्वामिमित्रगुरुद्रोही मायावी चपलः शठः .. 54 ..
text_mt: He who secretly listens to the words of one who speaks falsely, / one who betrays his master, friend, or guru, one who is deceitful, fickle, and rogue;

sanskrit_iast:
ye bhāryāputramitrāṇi bālavṛddhakṛśāturān ..
bhṛtyānatithibandhūṃśca prabādhante bubhukṣayā .. 55 ..
meaning:
ये भार्यापुत्रमित्राणि बालवृद्धकृशातुरान् ..
भृत्यानतिथिबन्धूंश्च प्रबाधन्ते बुभुक्षया .. 55 ..
text_mt: Those who torment their wife, sons, and friends, the young, old, emaciated, and sick, / servants, guests, and relatives with hunger;

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ svayaṃ miṣṭamaśnāti viprāyānyatprayacchati ..
vṛthāpākaḥ sa vijñeyo brahmavādiṣu garhitaḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
यः स्वयं मिष्टमश्नाति विप्रायान्यत्प्रयच्छति ..
वृथापाकः स विज्ञेयो ब्रह्मवादिषु गर्हितः .. 56 ..
text_mt: He who eats delicacies himself and gives something else to a Brahmin— / he is to be known as a vain-cook, condemned among knowers of the Veda;

sanskrit_iast:
niyamānsvayamādāya ye tyajaṃtyajiteṃdriyāḥ ..
pravrajyāvāsino ye ca rahasyānāṃ ca bhedakāḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
नियमान्स्वयमादाय ये त्यजंत्यजितेंद्रियाः ..
प्रव्रज्यावासिनो ये च रहस्यानां च भेदकाः .. 57 ..
text_mt: Those who, having undertaken rules of conduct themselves, abandon them due to uncontrolled senses, / those residing in ascetic orders [who break their rules], and revealers of secrets;

sanskrit_iast:
tāḍayaṃti ca vegādye śapaṃti ca muhurmuhuḥ ..
durbalāṃśca na puṣṇaṃti punastānvāhayaṃti ca .. 56 ..
meaning:
ताडयंति च वेगाद्ये शपंति च मुहुर्मुहुः ..
दुर्बलांश्च न पुष्णंति पुनस्तान्वाहयंति च .. 56 ..
text_mt: Those who violently strike [beasts] and curse them again and again, / and do not nourish weak ones, yet continue to drive them;

sanskrit_iast:
pīḍayaṃtyatibhāreṇa sakṣatānvāhayaṃti ca ..
sārddhayāmāduparitaḥ saṃyukteṣu ca bhuṃjate .. 59 ..
meaning:
पीडयंत्यतिभारेण सक्षतान्वाहयंति च ..
सार्द्धयामादुपरितः संयुक्तेषु च भुंजते .. 59 ..
text_mt: Those who torment them with excessive loads and drive wounded animals, / and eat while the yoked beasts remain beyond a watch and a half;

sanskrit_iast:
ye bhagnakṣatarogārtānsvagorūpānbubhukṣayā ..
na pālayaṃti yatnena te goptā nārakā narāḥ .. 4.5.60 ..
meaning:
ये भग्नक्षतरोगार्तान्स्वगोरूपान्बुभुक्षया ..
न पालयंति यत्नेन ते गोप्ता नारका नराः .. 4.5.60 ..
text_mt: Those keepers who do not care diligently for their own cattle / that are broken, wounded, or diseased, and starving—those men are destined for hell.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣāṇāṃ vṛṣaṇānyeva pāpiṣṭhā gālayaṃti ye ..
vāhayaṃti ca gāṃ vadhyāṃ te mahānārakāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 61 ..
meaning:
वृषाणां वृषणान्येव पापिष्ठा गालयंति ये ..
वाहयंति च गां वध्यां ते महानारकाः स्मृताः .. 61 ..
text_mt: Those vile sinners who castrate the testicles of bulls, / and drive cows to slaughter—they are known as dwellers of great hells.

sanskrit_iast:
āśramaṃ samanuprāptaṃ kṣuttṛṣṇāśramapīḍitam ..
ye'tithiṃ nābhimanyaṃte te vai nirayagāminaḥ..62..
meaning:
आश्रमं समनुप्राप्तं क्षुत्तृष्णाश्रमपीडितम् ..
येऽतिथिं नाभिमन्यंते ते वै निरयगामिनः..62..
text_mt: Those who do not honour a guest who has arrived at their hermitage / afflicted with hunger, thirst, and exhaustion, indeed go to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
anāthaṃ vikalaṃ dīnaṃ bālaṃ vṛddhaṃ kṛśāturam..
nānukaṃpaṃti ye mūḍhāste yānti nirayārṇavam .. 63 ..
meaning:
अनाथं विकलं दीनं बालं वृद्धं कृशातुरम्..
नानुकंपंति ये मूढास्ते यान्ति निरयार्णवम् .. 63 ..
text_mt: Those fools who do not pity the helpless, the crippled, the wretched, / the child, the aged, the emaciated, and the sick, go to the ocean of hell.

sanskrit_iast:
ajāviko māhiṣikaḥ sāmudro vṛṣalīpatiḥ ..
śūdraviṭkṣatravṛttiśca nārakī syāddvijādhamaḥ .. 64 ..
meaning:
अजाविको माहिषिकः सामुद्रो वृषलीपतिः ..
शूद्रविट्क्षत्रवृत्तिश्च नारकी स्याद्द्विजाधमः .. 64 ..
text_mt: The keeper of goats and sheep, the keeper of buffaloes, a seafarer, the husband of a Śūdra woman, / and the vilest of twice-born men who lives by the occupations of Śūdras, Vaiśyas, or Kṣatriyas, becomes a dweller of hell.

sanskrit_iast:
śilpinaḥ kārukā vaidyā hemakārā naṭā dvijāḥ ..
kṛtakaukṣeya sayuktāstathānye nārakāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
शिल्पिनः कारुका वैद्या हेमकारा नटा द्विजाः ..
कृतकौक्षेय सयुक्तास्तथान्ये नारकाः स्मृताः .. 65 ..
text_mt: Twice-born artisans, craftsmen, physicians, goldsmiths, and actors, / along with those bearing hired swords—such others are known as hell-dwellers.

sanskrit_iast:
yaścoditamatikramya svecchayā vā haretkaram ..
narake tu sa pacyeta yaśca daṃḍarucirbhavet .. 66 ..
meaning:
यश्चोदितमतिक्रम्य स्वेच्छया वा हरेत्करम् ..
नरके तु स पच्येत यश्च दंडरुचिर्भवेत् .. 66 ..
text_mt: And he who exceeds the prescribed rate or seizes taxes arbitrarily, / and he who delights in excessive punishment, is cooked in hell.

sanskrit_iast:
utkocakairadhikṛtaistaskaraiśca prapīḍyate ..
yasya rājñaḥ prajā ruṣṭā pacyate narakeṣu saḥ .. 67 ..
meaning:
उत्कोचकैरधिकृतैस्तस्करैश्च प्रपीड्यते ..
यस्य राज्ञः प्रजा रुष्टा पच्यते नरकेषु सः .. 67 ..
text_mt: That king whose subjects, enraged, are oppressed by bribe-takers, / officials, and thieves, is cooked in hells.

sanskrit_iast:
ye dvijāḥ pratigṛhṇaṃti nṛpasyānyāyavartinaḥ ..
prayāṃti tepi ghorāṇi narakāṇi na saṃśayaḥ ..68..
meaning:
ये द्विजाः प्रतिगृह्णंति नृपस्यान्यायवर्तिनः ..
प्रयांति तेपि घोराणि नरकाणि न संशयः ..68..
text_mt: Those twice-born men who accept gifts from an unjust king / go to dreadful hells; there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
pāradārikacaurāṇāṃ yatpāpaṃ pārthivasya tat ..
bhavedarakṣatastasmādghorastasya pratigrahaḥ .. 69 ..
meaning:
पारदारिकचौराणां यत्पापं पार्थिवस्य तत् ..
भवेदरक्षतस्तस्माद्घोरस्तस्य प्रतिग्रहः .. 69 ..
text_mt: Whatever sin belongs to adulterers and thieves belongs to the king / who fails to protect [his subjects]; therefore, receiving gifts from him is dreadful.

sanskrit_iast:
acauraṃ cauravatpaśyeccoraṃ vā'caurarūpavat ..
avicārya nṛpastasmāddhātayannarakaṃ vrajet .. 4.5.70 ..
meaning:
अचौरं चौरवत्पश्येच्चोरं वाऽचौररूपवत् ..
अविचार्य नृपस्तस्माद्धातयन्नरकं व्रजेत् .. 4.5.70 ..
text_mt: A king who views a non-thief as a thief or a thief as a non-thief, / and executes them without inquiry, goes to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtatailānnapānāni madhumāṃsasurāsavam ..
guḍekṣukṣāraśākāni dadhimūlaphalāni ca .. 71 ..
meaning:
घृततैलान्नपानानि मधुमांससुरासवम् ..
गुडेक्षुक्षारशाकानि दधिमूलफलानि च .. 71 ..
text_mt: Ghee, oil, food, drinks, honey, meat, spirituous liquor, / jaggery, sugarcane, alkaline salt, vegetables, curds, roots, and fruits;

sanskrit_iast:
tṛṇaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ puṣpapatramauṣadhaṃ kāṃsyabhājanam ..
upānacchatraśakaṭamāsanaṃ śayanāṃbaram .. 72 ..
meaning:
तृणं काष्ठं पुष्पपत्रमौषधं कांस्यभाजनम् ..
उपानच्छत्रशकटमासनं शयनांबरम् .. 72 ..
text_mt: Grass, wood, flowers, leaves, medicine, bronze vessels, / shoes, parasols, carts, seats, beds, and clothing;

sanskrit_iast:
tāmraṃ sīsaṃ trapuṃ kācaṃ śaṃkhādyaṃ ca jalodbhavam ..
vārkṣaṃ vā vaiṇavādyaṃ vā gṛheṣūpaskarāṇi ca .. 73 ..
meaning:
ताम्रं सीसं त्रपुं काचं शंखाद्यं च जलोद्भवम् ..
वार्क्षं वा वैणवाद्यं वा गृहेषूपस्कराणि च .. 73 ..
text_mt: Copper, lead, tin, glass, items born of water such as conches, / things made of wood or bamboo, and household utensils;

sanskrit_iast:
ūrṇākārpāsakauśeyabhaṃgapaṭṭodbhavāni ca ..
sthūlasūkṣmāṇi vastrāṇi ye ca lobhāddharaṃti ca .. 74 ..
meaning:
ऊर्णाकार्पासकौशेयभंगपट्टोद्भवानि च ..
स्थूलसूक्ष्माणि वस्त्राणि ये च लोभाद्धरंति च .. 74 ..
text_mt: And those who, out of greed, take fabrics coarse or fine, / made from wool, cotton, silk, hemp, or bark-fibre—

sanskrit_iast:
evamādīni cānyāni dravyāṇi vividhāni ca ..
narakāṇi dhruvaṃ yāṃti narā vā nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 75 ..
meaning:
एवमादीनि चान्यानि द्रव्याणि विविधानि च ..
नरकाणि ध्रुवं यांति नरा वा नात्र संशयः .. 75 ..
text_mt: Men who steal these and various other such goods / certainly go to hells; there is no doubt here.

sanskrit_iast:
yadvā tadvā paradravyamapi sarṣapamātrakam ..
apahṛtya naro yāti narakaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 76 ..
meaning:
यद्वा तद्वा परद्रव्यमपि सर्षपमात्रकम् ..
अपहृत्य नरो याति नरकं नात्र संशयः .. 76 ..
text_mt: By stealing another’s property, whatever it may be, / even the size of a mustard seed, a man goes to hell; there is no doubt here.

sanskrit_iast:
evamādyairnaraḥ pāpairutkrāṃteḥ samanaṃtaram ..
śarīraṃ yātanārthāya pūrvākāramavāpnuyāt .. 77 ..
meaning:
एवमाद्यैर्नरः पापैरुत्क्रांतेः समनंतरम् ..
शरीरं यातनार्थाय पूर्वाकारमवाप्नुयात् .. 77 ..
text_mt: Immediately after departing [this life] through such sins, / a man obtains a body of the former shape for the sake of torture.

sanskrit_iast:
yamalokaṃ vrajettena śarīreṇa yamājñayā ..
yamadūtairmahāghorairnīyamānaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ .. 78 ..
meaning:
यमलोकं व्रजेत्तेन शरीरेण यमाज्ञया ..
यमदूतैर्महाघोरैर्नीयमानः सुदुःखितः .. 78 ..
text_mt: By that body he goes to the realm of Yama by Yama's command, / led by the exceedingly terrible messengers of Yama, in great suffering.

sanskrit_iast:
tiryaṅmānuṣadehānāmadharmaniratātmanām ..
dharmarājaḥ smṛtaḥ śāstā sughorairvividhairvadhaiḥ .. 79 ..
meaning:
तिर्यङ्मानुषदेहानामधर्मनिरतात्मनाम् ..
धर्मराजः स्मृतः शास्ता सुघोरैर्विविधैर्वधैः .. 79 ..
text_mt: Dharmarāja is known as the punisher of those in animal and human bodies / who are devoted to unrighteousness, by means of various dreadful executions.

sanskrit_iast:
vinayācārayuktānāṃ pramādātskhalitātmanām ..
prāyaścitterguruḥ śāstā na ca tairdṛśyate yamaḥ .. 4.5.80 ..
meaning:
विनयाचारयुक्तानां प्रमादात्स्खलितात्मनाम् ..
प्रायश्चित्तेर्गुरुः शास्ता न च तैर्दृश्यते यमः .. 4.5.80 ..
text_mt: For those endowed with modesty and proper conduct whose minds have stumbled through negligence, / the guru is the punisher through expiation, and Yama is not seen by them.

sanskrit_iast:
pāradārikacaurāṇāmanyāyavyavahāriṇām ..
nṛpatiḥ śāsakasteṣāṃ pracchannānāṃ ca dharmarāṭ .. 81 ..
meaning:
पारदारिकचौराणामन्यायव्यवहारिणाम् ..
नृपतिः शासकस्तेषां प्रच्छन्नानां च धर्मराट् .. 81 ..
text_mt: The king is the punisher of adulterers, thieves, and those who conduct unlawful dealings; and Dharmarāj is [the punisher] of those who remain secret.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātkṛtasya pāpasya prāyaścittaṃ samācaret ..
nābhuktasyānyathā nāśaḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi .. 82 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्कृतस्य पापस्य प्रायश्चित्तं समाचरेत् ..
नाभुक्तस्यान्यथा नाशः कल्पकोटिशतैरपि .. 82 ..
text_mt: Therefore, one should perform expiation for an act of sin committed; otherwise, what is not experienced is not destroyed even in hundreds of millions of kalpas.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ karoti svayaṃ karma kārayedvāpi moda yet ..
kāyena manasā vācā tasya cādhogatiḥ phalam .. 83 ..
meaning:
यः करोति स्वयं कर्म कारयेद्वापि मोद येत् ..
कायेन मनसा वाचा तस्य चाधोगतिः फलम् .. 83 ..
text_mt: Whether one commits an action oneself, causes [another] to do it, or rejoices [in it] by body, mind, or speech, its fruit is a fall to a low state.

sanskrit_iast:
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktāḥ pāpabhedāḥ sasādhanāḥ ..
kathyate gatayaścitrā narāṇāṃ pāpakarmaṇām .. 84 ..
meaning:
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्ताः पापभेदाः ससाधनाः ..
कथ्यते गतयश्चित्रा नराणां पापकर्मणाम् .. 84 ..
text_mt: Thus the varieties of sins along with their means have been briefly stated. Now the manifold paths of evil-doing men are described.

sanskrit_iast:
vākkāyacittajanitairbahubhedabhinnaiḥ kṛtyaiḥ śubhāśubhaphalodayahetubhūtaiḥ .. bhāsvatsureśabhuvanaṃ narakānanekānsaṃprāpnuvaṃti manujā manujeṃdracandra..85..
śubhāśubhaphalanirdeśavarṇanam
meaning:
वाक्कायचित्तजनितैर्बहुभेदभिन्नैः कृत्यैः शुभाशुभफलोदयहेतुभूतैः .. भास्वत्सुरेशभुवनं नरकाननेकान्संप्राप्नुवंति मनुजा मनुजेंद्रचन्द्र..85..
शुभाशुभफलनिर्देशवर्णनम्
text_mt:
By actions produced by speech, body, and mind, divided into many kinds, which cause the arising of auspicious and inauspicious fruits, men reach the shining realm of the lord of the gods or many hells, O moon among kings!
Description of the Instruction on Auspicious and Inauspicious Fruits

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca..
athaibhiḥ pātakairyāṃti yamalokaṃ caturvidhaiḥ..
saṃtrāsajananaṃ ghoraṃ vivaśāḥ sarvadehinaḥ..1..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच..
अथैभिः पातकैर्यांति यमलोकं चतुर्विधैः..
संत्रासजननं घोरं विवशाः सर्वदेहिनः..1..
text_mt: Glorious Kṛṣṇa said: / Now, on account of these fourfold sins, all embodied beings go, helpless, to the realm of Yama, terrifying and dreadful,
title: Śubhāśubhaphalanirdeśaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
garbhasthairjāyamānaiśca bālaistaruṇamadhyamaiḥ..
puṃstrīnapuṃsakairvṛddhairjñātavyaṃ sarvajaṃtubhiḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
गर्भस्थैर्जायमानैश्च बालैस्तरुणमध्यमैः..
पुंस्त्रीनपुंसकैर्वृद्धैर्ज्ञातव्यं सर्वजंतुभिः .. 2 ..
text_mt: by those in the womb, by those being born, by children, youths, and the middle-aged, / by men, women, eunuchs, and the aged—this must be understood by all living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
śubhāśubhaphalaṃ tatra dehināṃ pravicāryate ..
citraguptādibhiḥ sabhyairmadhyasthaiḥ sarvadarśibhiḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
शुभाशुभफलं तत्र देहिनां प्रविचार्यते ..
चित्रगुप्तादिभिः सभ्यैर्मध्यस्थैः सर्वदर्शिभिः .. 3 ..
text_mt: There the auspicious and inauspicious fruit of embodied beings is deliberated upon / by Citragupta and other impartial, all-seeing assembly members.

sanskrit_iast:
na te'tra prāṇinaḥ saṃti ye na yāṃti yamakṣayam ..
avaśyaṃ hi kṛtaṃ karma bhoktavyaṃ tadvidhāritam.. 4 ..
tatra ye śubhakarmāṇaḥ saumyacittā dayānvitāḥ ...8
meaning:
न तेऽत्र प्राणिनः संति ये न यांति यमक्षयम् ..
अवश्यं हि कृतं कर्म भोक्तव्यं तद्विधारितम्.. 4 ..
तत्र ये शुभकर्माणः सौम्यचित्ता दयान्विताः ...8
text_mt:
There are no living creatures here who do not go to Yama’s abode; / for the action performed must inevitably be experienced as determined by him.
There, those whose deeds are auspicious, whose minds are gentle, who are endowed with compassion,

sanskrit_iast: te narā yāṃti saumyena pathā yamaniketanam .. 5 ..
meaning: ते नरा यांति सौम्येन पथा यमनिकेतनम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: those men go by a gentle path to Yama's dwelling.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ pradadyāddvijendrāṇāmupānatkāṣṭhapādukām ..
sa varāśvena mahatā sukhaṃ yāti yamālayam ..6..
meaning:
यः प्रदद्याद्द्विजेन्द्राणामुपानत्काष्ठपादुकाम् ..
स वराश्वेन महता सुखं याति यमालयम् ..6..
text_mt: He who gives shoes and wooden sandals to noble twice-born men / goes comfortably to Yama’s abode upon an excellent, mighty horse.

sanskrit_iast:
chatradānena gacchaṃti yathā chatreṇa dehinaḥ ..
divyavastraparīdhānā yāṃti vastrapradāyinaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
छत्रदानेन गच्छंति यथा छत्रेण देहिनः ..
दिव्यवस्त्रपरीधाना यांति वस्त्रप्रदायिनः .. 7 ..
text_mt: Embodied beings go as if beneath a parasol through the gift of a parasol; / givers of clothing go clad in divine garments.

sanskrit_iast:
śibikāśvapradānena tatastena sukhaṃ vrajet ..
śayyāsana pradānena sukhaṃ yāṃti yamāśrayam .. 8 ..
meaning:
शिबिकाश्वप्रदानेन ततस्तेन सुखं व्रजेत् ..
शय्यासन प्रदानेन सुखं यांति यमाश्रयम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: By the gift of a palanquin or a horse, one then travels comfortably upon it; / by the gift of a bed or a seat, they go comfortably to Yama’s retreat.

sanskrit_iast:
ārāmakartā chāyāsu śītalāsu sukhaṃ vrajet ..
yāṃti puṣpakayānena puṣpārāmapradāyinaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
आरामकर्ता छायासु शीतलासु सुखं व्रजेत् ..
यांति पुष्पकयानेन पुष्पारामप्रदायिनः .. 9 ..
text_mt: The maker of a grove travels comfortably in cool shade; / givers of flower gardens go in the Puṣpaka vehicle.

sanskrit_iast:
devāyatanakartā ca yatīnāmāśramasya ca ..
anāthamaṃḍapānāṃ ca krīḍanyāti gṛhottamaiḥ .. 4.6.10 ..
meaning:
देवायतनकर्ता च यतीनामाश्रमस्य च ..
अनाथमंडपानां च क्रीडन्याति गृहोत्तमैः .. 4.6.10 ..
text_mt: A builder of a temple of a deity, of a hermitage for ascetics, / and of pavilions for the destitute travels sportively in excellent mansions.

sanskrit_iast:
devāgniguruviprāṇāṃ mātāpitrośca pūjakāḥ ..
pūjyamānā narā yāṃti kāmikena pathā sukham .. 11 ..
meaning:
देवाग्निगुरुविप्राणां मातापित्रोश्च पूजकाः ..
पूज्यमाना नरा यांति कामिकेन पथा सुखम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Worshippers of the gods, the sacred fire, the guru, brahmins, and mother and father / go comfortably by a path that fulfills all desires, being worshipped themselves.

sanskrit_iast:
dyotayaṃto diśaḥ sarvā yāṃti dīpapradāyinaḥ ..
pratiśrayapradānena sukhaṃ yāṃti gṛhaṃ svayam .. 12 ..
meaning:
द्योतयंतो दिशः सर्वा यांति दीपप्रदायिनः ..
प्रतिश्रयप्रदानेन सुखं यांति गृहं स्वयम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Givers of lamps go illuminating all the directions; / by the gift of shelter, they go comfortably to [his] home on their own.

sanskrit_iast:
sarva kāmasamṛddhena pathā gacchaṃti gopradāḥ ..
ye na pāpāni kurvaṃti te tṛptā yāṃti nānyathā ..13..
meaning:
सर्व कामसमृद्धेन पथा गच्छंति गोप्रदाः ..
ये न पापानि कुर्वंति ते तृप्ता यांति नान्यथा ..13..
text_mt: Givers of cows travel by a path abounding in all desires; / those who commit no sins go contented, not otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
ārtauṣadhapradātāraḥ sukhaṃ yāṃti nirākulāḥ ..
viśrāmyamāṇā gacchaṃti guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ..14..
meaning:
आर्तौषधप्रदातारः सुखं यांति निराकुलाः ..
विश्राम्यमाणा गच्छंति गुरुशुश्रूषणे रताः..14..
text_mt: Givers of medicine to the sick go comfortably and untroubled; / those devoted to serving their guru go being rested along the way.

sanskrit_iast:
pādaśaucapradānena śītalena pathā vrajet ..
pādābhyaṃgaṃ ca yaḥ kuryādaśvapṛṣṭhena sa vrajet..15..
meaning:
पादशौचप्रदानेन शीतलेन पथा व्रजेत् ..
पादाभ्यंगं च यः कुर्यादश्वपृष्ठेन स व्रजेत्..15..
text_mt: By providing water for washing feet, one travels along a cool path; / and he who performs anointing of the feet travels on horseback.

sanskrit_iast:
hemaratnapradānena yāti durgāṇi nistaran ..
yānavāhanadānena narayānena gacchati .. 16 ..
meaning:
हेमरत्नप्रदानेन याति दुर्गाणि निस्तरन् ..
यानवाहनदानेन नरयानेन गच्छति .. 16 ..
text_mt: By the gift of gold and jewels, one goes crossing over difficulties; / by the gift of conveyances and mounts, one goes in a palanquin borne by men.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā bhūmidānena gacchati ..
annapānapradānena pibankhādaṃśca gacchati .. 17 ..
meaning:
सर्वकामसमृद्धात्मा भूमिदानेन गच्छति ..
अन्नपानप्रदानेन पिबन्खादंश्च गच्छति .. 17 ..
text_mt: By the gift of land, one goes with a self enriched with all desires; / by the gift of food and drink, one goes drinking and eating.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamādibhirdānaiḥ sukhaṃ yāṃti yamakṣayam ..
svargepi vipulānbhogānprāpnuvaṃti narottama .. 18 ..
meaning:
इत्येवमादिभिर्दानैः सुखं यांति यमक्षयम् ..
स्वर्गेपि विपुलान्भोगान्प्राप्नुवंति नरोत्तम .. 18 ..
text_mt: Through gifts such as these, they go comfortably to Yama’s abode; / and in heaven too they obtain vast enjoyments, O best of men!

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmeva dānānāmannadānaṃ paraṃ smṛtam ..
sadyaḥ prītikaraṃ divyaṃ balabuddhivivarddhanam .. 19 ..
meaning:
सर्वेषामेव दानानामन्नदानं परं स्मृतम् ..
सद्यः प्रीतिकरं दिव्यं बलबुद्धिविवर्द्धनम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: Among all gifts indeed, the gift of food is considered supreme; / it gives immediate delight, is divine, and increases strength and intellect.

sanskrit_iast:
trayāṇāmapi lokānāṃ jīvitaṃ hyudakaṃ smṛtam ..
pavitramamṛtaṃ divyaṃ śuddhaṃ sarvarasāyanam .. 4.6.20 ..
meaning:
त्रयाणामपि लोकानां जीवितं ह्युदकं स्मृतम् ..
पवित्रममृतं दिव्यं शुद्धं सर्वरसायनम् .. 4.6.20 ..
text_mt: Water is considered the very life of the three worlds; / it is pure, an elixir, divine, clean, and an elixir of all tastes.

sanskrit_iast:
annaṃ pānaṃ ca govastrabhūśayyācchatramāsanam ..
paraloke praśastāni dānānyaṣṭau viśeṣataḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
अन्नं पानं च गोवस्त्रभूशय्याच्छत्रमासनम् ..
परलोके प्रशस्तानि दानान्यष्टौ विशेषतः .. 21 ..
text_mt: Food, drink, a cow, clothing, land, a bed, a parasol, and a seat— / these eight gifts in particular are praised for the other world.

sanskrit_iast:
annadānaṃ viśeṣeṇa dharma rājapure narāḥ ..
yasmādyāṃti sukhenaiva tasmāddharmaṃ samācaret .. 22 ..
meaning:
अन्नदानं विशेषेण धर्म राजपुरे नराः ..
यस्माद्यांति सुखेनैव तस्माद्धर्मं समाचरेत् .. 22 ..
text_mt: Since, through the gift of food in particular, men go with ease / to the city of Dharmarāja, one should therefore practice righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
ye punaḥ krūrakarmāṇaḥ pāpā dānavivarjitāḥ ..
te ghoreṇa pathā yāṃti dakṣiṇena svamālayam .. 23 ..
meaning:
ये पुनः क्रूरकर्माणः पापा दानविवर्जिताः ..
ते घोरेण पथा यांति दक्षिणेन स्वमालयम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Those, on the other hand, who are of cruel deeds, sinful, and destitute of charity, / go by a dreadful southern path to their own abode,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍaśītisahasrāṇi yojanānāmatītya yat ..
vaivasvatapuraṃ jñeyaṃ nānārūpavyavasthitam .. 24 ..
meaning:
षडशीतिसहस्राणि योजनानामतीत्य यत् ..
वैवस्वतपुरं ज्ञेयं नानारूपव्यवस्थितम् .. 24 ..
text_mt: beyond eighty-six thousand yojanas, where lies / the city of Vaivasvata, known to exist in various forms.

sanskrit_iast:
samīpasthamivābhāti narāṇāṃ śubhakarmaṇām ..
pāpānāmatidūrasthaṃ pathā raudreṇa gacchatām .. 25 ..
meaning:
समीपस्थमिवाभाति नराणां शुभकर्मणाम् ..
पापानामतिदूरस्थं पथा रौद्रेण गच्छताम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: It appears as if nearby to men of auspicious deeds, / but extremely distant to the sinful who travel by a terrifying path,

sanskrit_iast:
tīvrakaṃṭakayuktena śarkarānicitena ca ..
kṣuradhārānibhaistīvraiḥ pāṣāṇairnicitena ca .. 26 ..
meaning:
तीव्रकंटकयुक्तेन शर्करानिचितेन च ..
क्षुरधारानिभैस्तीव्रैः पाषाणैर्निचितेन च .. 26 ..
text_mt: filled with sharp thorns, strewn with gravel, / and covered with sharp stones resembling the edges of razors,

sanskrit_iast:
kvacitpaṃkena mahatā duruttāraiśca khātakaiḥ ..
lohasūcīnibhairdarbhaiḥ saṃchannena pathā kvacit .. 27 ..
meaning:
क्वचित्पंकेन महता दुरुत्तारैश्च खातकैः ..
लोहसूचीनिभैर्दर्भैः संछन्नेन पथा क्वचित् .. 27 ..
text_mt: in some places with deep mud and ditches difficult to cross, / and in some places by a path blanketed with kuśa grass resembling iron needles,

sanskrit_iast:
taṭaprapātaviṣṭaṃbhaiḥ parvatairvṛkṣasaṃkulaiḥ ..
prataptāṃgārayuktena yāṃti mārgeṇa duḥkhitāḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
तटप्रपातविष्टंभैः पर्वतैर्वृक्षसंकुलैः ..
प्रतप्तांगारयुक्तेन यांति मार्गेण दुःखिताः .. 28 ..
text_mt: with precipitous cliffs and obstacles, mountains crowded with trees, / [and] along a road covered with glowing embers they travel in misery,

sanskrit_iast:
kvacidviṣamagartaiśca kvacilloṣṭaiḥ supicchilaiḥ ..
prataptavālukābhiśca tathā tīkṣṇaiśca śaṃkubhiḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
क्वचिद्विषमगर्तैश्च क्वचिल्लोष्टैः सुपिच्छिलैः ..
प्रतप्तवालुकाभिश्च तथा तीक्ष्णैश्च शंकुभिः .. 29 ..
text_mt: in some places with uneven pits, in some with very slippery clods of earth, / with scorching sands, and likewise with sharp stakes,

sanskrit_iast:
anekatāpairvitatairvyāptaṃ vaṃśavanaṃ kvacit ..
kvacidvālukayā vyāptaṃ kaṣṭenaiva praveśanam .. 4.6.30 ..
meaning:
अनेकतापैर्विततैर्व्याप्तं वंशवनं क्वचित् ..
क्वचिद्वालुकया व्याप्तं कष्टेनैव प्रवेशनम् .. 4.6.30 ..
text_mt: in some places a bamboo forest spread out, beset by manifold fires, / in some places covered in sand where entrance is gained only with great hardship,

sanskrit_iast:
kvaciduṣṇāṃbunā vyāptaṃ kvacitkārīṣavahninā ..
kvacitsiṃhairvṛkairvyāptaṃ daṃśaiḥ kīṭaiśca dāruṇaiḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
क्वचिदुष्णांबुना व्याप्तं क्वचित्कारीषवह्निना ..
क्वचित्सिंहैर्वृकैर्व्याप्तं दंशैः कीटैश्च दारुणैः .. 31 ..
text_mt: in some places filled with boiling water, in some with fire from dried cow dung, / in some places filled with lions and wolves, with gadflies and fierce insects,

sanskrit_iast:
kvacinmahājalaukābhiḥ kvaciccājagaraiḥ punaḥ ..
makṣikābhiśca raudrābhiḥ kvacitsarpairviṣolbaṇaiḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
क्वचिन्महाजलौकाभिः क्वचिच्चाजगरैः पुनः ..
मक्षिकाभिश्च रौद्राभिः क्वचित्सर्पैर्विषोल्बणैः .. 32 ..
text_mt: in some places with giant leeches, and again in some with pythons, / with fearsome flies, and in some places with fiercely venomous snakes,

sanskrit_iast:
mattamātaṃgayūthaiśca balonmattaiḥ pramāthibhiḥ ..
paṃthānamullikhadbhiśca tīkṣṇaśṛṃgairmahāvṛṣaiḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
मत्तमातंगयूथैश्च बलोन्मत्तैः प्रमाथिभिः ..
पंथानमुल्लिखद्भिश्च तीक्ष्णशृंगैर्महावृषैः .. 33 ..
text_mt: and with herds of rutting elephants, maddened by strength, violent crushers, / and with great bulls with sharp horns that tear up the path,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāviṣāṇairmahiṣairuṣṭrairmattaiśca khādakaiḥ ..
ḍākinībhiśca raudrābhirvikarālaiśca rākṣasaiḥ .. 34 ....
meaning:
महाविषाणैर्महिषैरुष्ट्रैर्मत्तैश्च खादकैः ..
डाकिनीभिश्च रौद्राभिर्विकरालैश्च राक्षसैः .. 34 ....
text_mt: with huge-horned buffaloes, with rutting, man-eating camels, / with terrifying ḍākinīs, and with hideous rākṣasas.

sanskrit_iast:
vyādhibhiśca mahāghoraiḥ pīḍyamānā vrajaṃti ca ..
mahādhūlīvimiśreṇa mahācaṇḍena vāyunā .. 35 ..
meaning:
व्याधिभिश्च महाघोरैः पीड्यमाना व्रजंति च ..
महाधूलीविमिश्रेण महाचण्डेन वायुना .. 35 ..
text_mt: Tormented by terrible diseases, they travel onward, / and by a fiercely violent wind mixed with great clouds of dust,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpāṣāṇavarṣeṇa hanyamānā nirāśrayāḥ ..
kvacidvidyutprapātena dīryamāṇā vrajaṃti ca .. 36 ..
meaning:
महापाषाणवर्षेण हन्यमाना निराश्रयाः ..
क्वचिद्विद्युत्प्रपातेन दीर्यमाणा व्रजंति च .. 36 ..
text_mt: struck by a rain of huge stones, shelterless, / and in some places torn apart by lightning strikes, they travel on,

sanskrit_iast:
mahatā bāṇavarṣeṇa vidhyamānāśca sarvaśaḥ ..
patadbhirvajrasaṃghātairulkāpātaiśca dāruṇaiḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
महता बाणवर्षेण विध्यमानाश्च सर्वशः ..
पतद्भिर्वज्रसंघातैरुल्कापातैश्च दारुणैः .. 37 ..
text_mt: pierced on all sides by a mighty shower of arrows, / by falling clusters of thunderbolts, and by dread meteor showers,

sanskrit_iast:
prataptāgāravarṣeṇa dahyamānā vrajaṃti ca ..
taptena pāṃśuvarṣeṇa pūryamāṇā rudaṃti ca .. 38 ..
meaning:
प्रतप्तागारवर्षेण दह्यमाना व्रजंति च ..
तप्तेन पांशुवर्षेण पूर्यमाणा रुदंति च .. 38 ..
text_mt: burned by a rain of glowing embers, they travel on, / and, covered by a shower of hot dust, they weep.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāmegharavairghorairvitrāsyaṃte muhurmuhuḥ ..
niśitāyudhavarṣeṇa cūryamāṇā narairvṛtāḥ ..
mahākṣārāmbudhārābhiḥ sicyamānā dravaṃti ca .. 39 ..
meaning:
महामेघरवैर्घोरैर्वित्रास्यंते मुहुर्मुहुः ..
निशितायुधवर्षेण चूर्यमाणा नरैर्वृताः ..
महाक्षाराम्बुधाराभिः सिच्यमाना द्रवंति च .. 39 ..
text_mt: They are constantly terrified by the dreadful roars of great storm-clouds, / pulverized by a shower of sharp weapons while surrounded by men, / and they flee while being drenched with great streams of caustic water.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāśītena marutā tīkṣṇena paruṣeṇa ca ..
samaṃtātpīḍyamānāste śuṣyaṃte saṃkucaṃti ca .. 4.6.40 ..
meaning:
महाशीतेन मरुता तीक्ष्णेन परुषेण च ..
समंतात्पीड्यमानास्ते शुष्यंते संकुचंति च .. 4.6.40 ..
text_mt: Tormented on all sides by an intensely cold, piercing, and harsh wind, / they wither away and shrink.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ mārgeṇa raudreṇa pāṃthairvi rahitena ca ..
nirālaṃbena durgeṇa nirjalena samaṃtataḥ ..41..
meaning:
इत्थं मार्गेण रौद्रेण पांथैर्वि रहितेन च ..
निरालंबेन दुर्गेण निर्जलेन समंततः ..41..
text_mt: Along such a terrible path, devoid of travelers, / without support, impassable, and waterless on all sides,

sanskrit_iast:
aviśrāmeṇa mahatā nirgatāpāśrayeṇa ca ..
tamorūpeṇa kaṣṭena sarvaduḥkhāśrayeṇa ca..42..
meaning:
अविश्रामेण महता निर्गतापाश्रयेण च ..
तमोरूपेण कष्टेन सर्वदुःखाश्रयेण च..42..
text_mt: unrelenting, vast, devoid of shelter, / dark in form, distressing, and an abode of all misery—

sanskrit_iast:
nīyaṃte dehinaḥ sarve ye mūḍhāḥ pāpakarmiṇaḥ ..
yamadūtairmahāghoraistadājñākāribhirbalāt ..43..
meaning:
नीयंते देहिनः सर्वे ये मूढाः पापकर्मिणः ..
यमदूतैर्महाघोरैस्तदाज्ञाकारिभिर्बलात् ..43..
text_mt: all those embodied beings who were foolish and committed evil deeds / are led by force by the most dreadful messengers of Yama who carry out his commands.

sanskrit_iast:
ekākinaḥ parādhīnā mitrabaṃdhuvivarjitāḥ ..
śocaṃtaḥ svāni karmāṇi rudaṃtaśca muhurmuhuḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
एकाकिनः पराधीना मित्रबंधुविवर्जिताः ..
शोचंतः स्वानि कर्माणि रुदंतश्च मुहुर्मुहुः .. 44 ..
text_mt: Alone, dependent on others, bereft of friends and relatives, / grieving their own actions and weeping again and again,

sanskrit_iast:
pretabhūtā vivastrāśca śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukāḥ ..
kṛśāṅgā bhītabhītāśca dahyamānāḥ kṣudhāgninā .. 45 ..
meaning:
प्रेतभूता विवस्त्राश्च शुष्ककण्ठोष्ठतालुकाः ..
कृशाङ्गा भीतभीताश्च दह्यमानाः क्षुधाग्निना .. 45 ..
text_mt: turned into pretas, unclothed, their throats, lips, and palates parched, / emaciated in body, thoroughly terrified, and burning with the fire of hunger,

sanskrit_iast:
baddhāḥ śṛṃkhalayā keciduttānāḥ pādayornarāḥ ..
ākṛṣyaṃte ghṛṣyamāṇā yamadūtairbalotkaṭaiḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
बद्धाः शृंखलया केचिदुत्तानाः पादयोर्नराः ..
आकृष्यंते घृष्यमाणा यमदूतैर्बलोत्कटैः .. 46 ..
text_mt: some men, bound by the feet with a chain, face upward, / are dragged along, scraping against the ground, by the messengers of Yama of formidable strength.

sanskrit_iast:
punaścādhomukhāścānye ghṛṣyamāṇāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ..
keśapāśanibaddhāśca kṛṣyaṃte rajjubhirnarāḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
पुनश्चाधोमुखाश्चान्ये घृष्यमाणाः सुदुःखिताः..
केशपाशनिबद्धाश्च कृष्यंते रज्जुभिर्नराः .. 47 ..
text_mt: Others, facing downward, deeply afflicted, are scraped along; / and men, bound by their braids of hair, are pulled with ropes.

sanskrit_iast:
lalāṭe cāṃkuśaistīkṣṇairbhinnāḥ kṛṣyaṃti dehinaḥ ..
uttānā raṭamānāśca kvacidaṃgāravartmanā.. 48 ..
meaning:
ललाटे चांकुशैस्तीक्ष्णैर्भिन्नाः कृष्यंति देहिनः ..
उत्ताना रटमानाश्च क्वचिदंगारवर्त्मना.. 48 ..
text_mt: Pierced on the forehead with sharp goads, embodied beings are dragged along; / lying on their backs and screaming, in some places along a path of burning coals,

sanskrit_iast:
pāścādbāhvaṃsabaddhāśca jaṭhare ca prapīḍitāḥ ..
pūritāḥ śṛṃkhalābhiśca hastayośca prakīlitāḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
पाश्चाद्बाह्वंसबद्धाश्च जठरे च प्रपीडिताः ..
पूरिताः शृंखलाभिश्च हस्तयोश्च प्रकीलिताः .. 49 ..
text_mt: bound behind by their arms and shoulders, squeezed in their bellies, / locked with chains, and pinned down by their hands,

sanskrit_iast:
grīvāyāmarddhacandreṇa kṣipyamāṇā itastataḥ ..
śiśne ca vṛṣaṇe baddhvā nīyaṃte carmarajjunā .. 4.6.50 ..
meaning:
ग्रीवायामर्द्धचन्द्रेण क्षिप्यमाणा इतस्ततः ..
शिश्ने च वृषणे बद्ध्वा नीयंते चर्मरज्जुना .. 4.6.50 ..
text_mt: flung here and there by a crescent-shaped blade at the neck, / and having their penis and testicles bound with a leather strap, they are led away.

sanskrit_iast:
vibhinnā udare cānye taptaśṛṃkhalayā narāḥ ..
kṛṣyaṃte karṇayoścānye bhinnāśca cibukopari .. .. 51 ..
meaning:
विभिन्ना उदरे चान्ये तप्तशृंखलया नराः ..
कृष्यंते कर्णयोश्चान्ये भिन्नाश्च चिबुकोपरि .. .. 51 ..
text_mt: Other men are pierced in the belly with a glowing chain; / others are dragged by their ears, and pierced above the chin.

sanskrit_iast:
chinnāgrapādahastāśca chinnakarṇauṣṭhanāsikāḥ ..
saṃchinnaśiśnavṛṣaṇāśchinnabhinnāṃgasaṃdhayaḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
छिन्नाग्रपादहस्ताश्च छिन्नकर्णौष्ठनासिकाः ..
संछिन्नशिश्नवृषणाश्छिन्नभिन्नांगसंधयः .. 52 ..
text_mt: With the tips of their feet and hands cut off, with ears, lips, and noses severed, / with penises and testicles completely amputated, their joints slashed and pierced,

sanskrit_iast:
pratudyamānāḥ kuṃtaiśca sāyakaiśca tatastataḥ ..
bhidyamānāḥ pradhāvaṃti krandamānā nirāśrayāḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
प्रतुद्यमानाः कुंतैश्च सायकैश्च ततस्ततः ..
भिद्यमानाः प्रधावंति क्रन्दमाना निराश्रयाः .. 53 ..
text_mt: prodded here and there with lances and arrows, / pierced through, they run about, crying out, without shelter,

sanskrit_iast:
mudgarairllohadaṇḍaiśca hanyamānā muhurmuhuḥ ..
kaśaiśca vividhaighorairjvalitāgnisamaprabhaiḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
मुद्गरैर्ल्लोहदण्डैश्च हन्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः ..
कशैश्च विविधैघोरैर्ज्वलिताग्निसमप्रभैः .. 54 ..
text_mt: beaten again and again with clubs and iron rods, / and with various terrible whips resembling blazing fire,

sanskrit_iast:
bhiṃdipālairvibhidyaṃte sravaṃtaḥ pūyaśoṇitam ..
māṃse kṣatāśca kṛmibhirnīyaṃte vivaśā narāḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
भिंदिपालैर्विभिद्यंते स्रवंतः पूयशोणितम् ..
मांसे क्षताश्च कृमिभिर्नीयंते विवशा नराः .. 55 ..
text_mt: they are pierced with slings, oozing pus and blood; / their flesh wounded by worms, the helpless men are led away.

sanskrit_iast:
yācamānāśca salilamannaṃ cāpi bubhukṣitāḥ ..
chāyāṃ prārthayamānāśca śītārtā bahuvāyunā .. 56 ..
meaning:
याचमानाश्च सलिलमन्नं चापि बुभुक्षिताः ..
छायां प्रार्थयमानाश्च शीतार्ता बहुवायुना .. 56 ..
text_mt: Begging for water and for food, famished, / and imploring for shade, shivering from the strong wind,

sanskrit_iast:
dānahīnāḥ prayāṃtyevaṃ yāvaṃto vimukhā narāḥ ..
gṛhītadānapātheyāḥ sukhaṃ yāṃti yamālayam .. 57 ..
meaning:
दानहीनाः प्रयांत्येवं यावंतो विमुखा नराः ..
गृहीतदानपाथेयाः सुखं यांति यमालयम् .. 57 ..
text_mt: so many men who were devoid of giving go thus, turned away [from virtue]; / those who took the travel-provisions of gifts go happily to the abode of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pathātikaṣṭena prāptā yamapuraṃ tadā ..
prajñāpitāstadā dūtairniveśyaṃte yamāgrataḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
एवं पथातिकष्टेन प्राप्ता यमपुरं तदा ..
प्रज्ञापितास्तदा दूतैर्निवेश्यंते यमाग्रतः .. 58 ..
text_mt: Having thus reached the city of Yama along that most painful path, / announced then by the messengers, they are ushered into the presence of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra ye śubhakarmāṇastāṃśca saṃmānayedyamaḥ ..
svāgatāsanadānena pādyārgheṇa priyeṇa ca .. 59 ..
meaning:
तत्र ये शुभकर्माणस्तांश्च संमानयेद्यमः ..
स्वागतासनदानेन पाद्यार्घेण प्रियेण च .. 59 ..
text_mt: There, Yama honors those whose deeds were auspicious / by offering a welcome, a seat, foot-water, arghya, and kind words:

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyā yūyaṃ mahātmāna ātmano hitakāriṇaḥ ..
yena divyasukhārthāya bhavadbhiḥ sukṛtaṃ kṛtam .. 4.6.60 ..
meaning:
धन्या यूयं महात्मान आत्मनो हितकारिणः ..
येन दिव्यसुखार्थाय भवद्भिः सुकृतं कृतम् .. 4.6.60 ..
text_mt: ‘Blessed are you, great-souled ones, benefactors of yourselves, / by whom good deeds were performed for the sake of divine happiness!

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ vimānamāruhya divyastrībhogabhūṣitam ..
svargaṃ gacchadhvamatulaṃ sarvakāmasamanvitam .. 61 ..
meaning:
इदं विमानमारुह्य दिव्यस्त्रीभोगभूषितम् ..
स्वर्गं गच्छध्वमतुलं सर्वकामसमन्वितम् .. 61 ..
text_mt: Having ascended this celestial chariot adorned with the pleasures of heavenly women, / go to peerless heaven, endowed with every desire.

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhuktvā mahābhogānaṃte puṇyasya saṃkṣayāt ..
yatkiñcidalpamaśubhaṃ punastadiha bhokṣyatha .. 62 ..
meaning:
ततो भुक्त्वा महाभोगानंते पुण्यस्य संक्षयात् ..
यत्किञ्चिदल्पमशुभं पुनस्तदिह भोक्ष्यथ .. 62 ..
text_mt: Then, having enjoyed great pleasures, at the end, through the exhaustion of merit, / whatever little evil there is, you will experience it again here.’

sanskrit_iast:
te cāpi dharmarājānaṃ narāḥ puṇyānubhāvataḥ ..
paśyaṃti saumyavadanaṃ pitṛbhūtamivātmanaḥ .. 63 ..
meaning:
ते चापि धर्मराजानं नराः पुण्यानुभावतः ..
पश्यंति सौम्यवदनं पितृभूतमिवात्मनः .. 63 ..
text_mt: Those men too, by the power of their merit, / behold Dharmarāja with a gentle face, like a father to them.

sanskrit_iast:
ye punaḥ pāpakarmāṇaste paśyaṃti bhayānakam ..
pāpāviśuddhanayanā viparītātmabuddhayaḥ .. 64 ..
meaning:
ये पुनः पापकर्माणस्ते पश्यंति भयानकम् ..
पापाविशुद्धनयना विपरीतात्मबुद्धयः .. 64 ..
text_mt: Those, on the other hand, who committed evil deeds, see him as terrifying, / their eyes clouded by sin, their intellects utterly perverted:

sanskrit_iast:
daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇam ..
ūrdhvakeśaṃ mahāśmaśruprasphuradadharottaram .. 65 ..
meaning:
दंष्ट्राकरालवदनं भ्रुकुटीकुटिलेक्षणम् ..
ऊर्ध्वकेशं महाश्मश्रुप्रस्फुरदधरोत्तरम् .. 65 ..
text_mt: his face dreadful with fangs, his glance crooked with a frown, / his hair standing erect, with a huge beard, his upper and lower lips quivering,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭādaśabhujaṃ kruddhaṃ nīlāṃjanacayopamam ..
savāryudhodyatakaraṃ brahmadaṇḍena tarjakam .. 66 ..
meaning:
अष्टादशभुजं क्रुद्धं नीलांजनचयोपमम् ..
सवार्युधोद्यतकरं ब्रह्मदण्डेन तर्जकम् .. 66 ..
text_mt: eighteen-armed, enraged, resembling a heap of blue collyrium, / his hands raised with all kinds of weapons, threatening with the staff of Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāmahiṣamārūḍhaṃ dīptāgnisamalocanam ..
raktamālyāmbaradharaṃ mahāmerumivocchritam .. 67 ..
meaning:
महामहिषमारूढं दीप्ताग्निसमलोचनम् ..
रक्तमाल्याम्बरधरं महामेरुमिवोच्छ्रितम् .. 67 ..
text_mt: mounted upon a great buffalo, his eyes like blazing fire, / wearing red garlands and garments, towering like Mount Meru,

sanskrit_iast:
pralayāṃbudanirghoṣaṃ pibaṃtamiva sāgaram ..
grasaṃtamiva lokānāmudgiraṃtamivānalam .. 68 ..
meaning:
प्रलयांबुदनिर्घोषं पिबंतमिव सागरम् ..
ग्रसंतमिव लोकानामुद्गिरंतमिवानलम् .. 68 ..
text_mt: roaring like the storm-clouds of cosmic dissolution, seeming to swallow the ocean, / seeming to devour the worlds, seeming to vomit forth fire.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtyuśca tatsamīpasthaḥ kālānalasamaprabhaḥ ..
kālaścāṃjanasaṃkāśaḥ kṛtāṃtaśca bhayānakaḥ .. 69 ..
meaning:
मृत्युश्च तत्समीपस्थः कालानलसमप्रभः ..
कालश्चांजनसंकाशः कृतांतश्च भयानकः .. 69 ..
text_mt: And Mṛtyu stands near him, radiant like the fire of destruction, / and Kāla resembling collyrium, and terrifying Kṛtānta,

sanskrit_iast:
mārī cogrā mahāmārī kālarātriḥ sudāruṇā ..
vividhā vyādhayaḥ kaṣṭā nānārūpabhayāvahāḥ .. 4.6.70 ..
meaning:
मारी चोग्रा महामारी कालरात्रिः सुदारुणा ..
विविधा व्याधयः कष्टा नानारूपभयावहाः .. 4.6.70 ..
text_mt: and fierce Mārī, Mahāmārī, and dreadful Kālarātri, / along with various painful diseases, terrifying in their many forms,

sanskrit_iast:
śaktiśūlāṃkuśadharāḥ pāśacakrāsidhāriṇaḥ ..
vajradaṇḍadharā raudrāḥ kṣudratūṇīdhanurdharāḥ .. 71 ..
meaning:
शक्तिशूलांकुशधराः पाशचक्रासिधारिणः ..
वज्रदण्डधरा रौद्राः क्षुद्रतूणीधनुर्धराः .. 71 ..
text_mt: holding spears, tridents, and goads, bearing nooses, discs, and swords, / holding thunderbolts and staffs, fierce, carrying small quivers and bows,

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃkhyātā mahāvīryāḥ krūrāścāñjanasaṃprabhāḥ ..
sarvāyudhodyatakarā yamadūtā bhayānakāḥ .. 72 ..
meaning:
असंख्याता महावीर्याः क्रूराश्चाञ्जनसंप्रभाः ..
सर्वायुधोद्यतकरा यमदूता भयानकाः .. 72 ..
text_mt: innumerable, of great prowess, cruel, shining like collyrium, / the terrifying messengers of Yama, with their hands raised with all weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
anena parivāreṇa mahāghoreṇa saṃvṛtam ..
yamaṃ paśyaṃti pāpiṣṭhāścitraguptaṃ ca bhīṣaṇam ..
nirbhartsayataṃ cātyantaṃ yamaṃ sadupakāriṇam ..73..
meaning:
अनेन परिवारेण महाघोरेण संवृतम् ..
यमं पश्यंति पापिष्ठाश्चित्रगुप्तं च भीषणम् ..
निर्भर्त्सयतं चात्यन्तं यमं सदुपकारिणम् ..73..
text_mt: Surrounded by this most dreadful retinue, / the wicked see Yama and fearsome Citragupta, / who severely reproaches [them, while honoring] Yama, the benefactor of the virtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
citraguptaśca bhagavāndharmavākyaiḥ prabodhayan ..
bhobho duṣkṛtakarmāṇaḥ paradravyāpahāriṇaḥ .
garvitā rūpavīryeṇa paradāravimardakāḥ ..74..
meaning:
चित्रगुप्तश्च भगवान्धर्मवाक्यैः प्रबोधयन् ..
भोभो दुष्कृतकर्माणः परद्रव्यापहारिणः .
गर्विता रूपवीर्येण परदारविमर्दकाः ..74..
text_mt: And the blessed Citragupta, admonishing them with words of righteousness, [says]: / ‘O evil-doers, robbers of others' wealth, / proud of your beauty and prowess, violators of others' wives!

sanskrit_iast:
yatsvayaṃ kriyate karma tatsvayaṃ bhujyate punaḥ ..
tatkimātmopaghātārthaṃ bhavadbhirduṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam ..75..
meaning:
यत्स्वयं क्रियते कर्म तत्स्वयं भुज्यते पुनः ..
तत्किमात्मोपघातार्थं भवद्भिर्दुष्कृतं कृतम् ..75..
text_mt: The deed that one does oneself, that very deed one enjoys in return. / Why then did you perform evil for your own destruction?

sanskrit_iast:
idānīṃ kiṃ pratapyadhvaṃ pīḍyamānāḥ svakarmabhiḥ ..
bhuñjadhvaṃ svāni karmāṇi nātra doṣo'sti kasyacit .. 76 ..
meaning:
इदानीं किं प्रतप्यध्वं पीड्यमानाः स्वकर्मभिः ..
भुञ्जध्वं स्वानि कर्माणि नात्र दोषोऽस्ति कस्यचित् .. 76 ..
text_mt: Why do you now burn with anguish, tormented by your own actions? / Suffer your own deeds; no one else is at fault here.’

sanskrit_iast:
ete ca pṛthivīpālāḥ saṃprāptā matsamīpataḥ ..
svakīyaiḥ karmabhirghorairduṣprajñā balagarvitāḥ .. 77 ..
meaning:
एते च पृथिवीपालाः संप्राप्ता मत्समीपतः ..
स्वकीयैः कर्मभिर्घोरैर्दुष्प्रज्ञा बलगर्विताः .. 77 ..
text_mt: ‘And these rulers of the earth have arrived in my presence / through their own dreadful deeds, foolish and arrogant in their might.

sanskrit_iast:
bhobho nṛpā durācārāḥ prajāvidhvaṃsakāriṇaḥ ..
alpakālasya rājyasya kṛte kiṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam .. 78 ..
meaning:
भोभो नृपा दुराचाराः प्रजाविध्वंसकारिणः ..
अल्पकालस्य राज्यस्य कृते किं दुष्कृतं कृतम् .. 78 ..
text_mt: O kings of evil conduct, destroyers of your subjects! / For the sake of a short-lived sovereignty, why was evil done?

sanskrit_iast:
rājyalobhena mohādvā balādanyāyataḥ prajāḥ ..
yatpīḍitāḥ phalaṃ tasya bhuṃjadhvamadhunā nṛpāḥ .. 79 ..
meaning:
राज्यलोभेन मोहाद्वा बलादन्यायतः प्रजाः ..
यत्पीडिताः फलं तस्य भुंजध्वमधुना नृपाः .. 79 ..
text_mt: Because through greed for kingdom or through delusion, by force and injustice, your subjects / were oppressed—now, O kings, experience the fruit of that!

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ kalatraṃ ca yadarthamaśubhaṃ kṛtam ..
tatsarvaṃ saṃparityajya yūyamekākinaḥ sthitāḥ .. 4.6.80 ..
meaning:
कृतं राज्यं कलत्रं च यदर्थमशुभं कृतम् ..
तत्सर्वं संपरित्यज्य यूयमेकाकिनः स्थिताः .. 4.6.80 ..
text_mt: The kingdom that was won and the wives for whose sake evil was done— / leaving all that behind, you stand alone.

sanskrit_iast:
paśyāma tadbalaṃ tubhyaṃ yena vidhvaṃsitāḥ prajāḥ ..
yamadūtaistāḍyamānā adhunā kīdṛśaṃ bhavet.. 81 ..
meaning:
पश्याम तद्बलं तुभ्यं येन विध्वंसिताः प्रजाः ..
यमदूतैस्ताड्यमाना अधुना कीदृशं भवेत्.. 81 ..
text_mt: Let us see that might of yours by which your subjects were destroyed! / Being struck by the messengers of Yama, what will it be like now?’

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ bahuvidhairvākyairupālabdhā yamena te ..
śocaṃtaḥ svāni karmāṇi tūṣṇīṃ tiṣṭhaṃti pārthiva .. 82 ..
meaning:
एवं बहुविधैर्वाक्यैरुपालब्धा यमेन ते ..
शोचंतः स्वानि कर्माणि तूष्णीं तिष्ठंति पार्थिव .. 82 ..
text_mt: Thus reproached with diverse words by Yama, / those [kings], grieving over their own deeds, stood in silence, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
iti dharmaṃ samādiśya nṛpāṇāṃ dharmarāṭ punaḥ ..
tatpāpapaṃkaśuddhyarthamidaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 83 ..
meaning:
इति धर्मं समादिश्य नृपाणां धर्मराट् पुनः ..
तत्पापपंकशुद्ध्यर्थमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् .. 83 ..
text_mt: Having thus instructed the kings in righteousness, the King of Dharma again / spoke these words to cleanse the mire of their sins:

sanskrit_iast:
bhobhoścaṇḍa mahācaṇḍa gṛhītvā nṛpatīnimān ..
viśodhayadhvaṃ pāpebhyaḥ krameṇa narakāgniṣu ..84..
meaning:
भोभोश्चण्ड महाचण्ड गृहीत्वा नृपतीनिमान् ..
विशोधयध्वं पापेभ्यः क्रमेण नरकाग्निषु ..84..
text_mt: "O Caṇḍa, O Mahācaṇḍa, take hold of these kings, / and cleanse them from their sins by degrees in the hellish fires."

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śīghraṃ samutthāya nṛpānsaṃgṛhya pādayoḥ ..
bhrāmayitvātivegena vikṣipyordhvaṃ vigṛhya ca .. 85 ..
meaning:
ततः शीघ्रं समुत्थाय नृपान्संगृह्य पादयोः ..
भ्रामयित्वातिवेगेन विक्षिप्योर्ध्वं विगृह्य च .. 85 ..
text_mt: Then, rising swiftly and seizing the kings by their feet, / whirling [them] with great speed, hurling [them] upwards and catching [them],

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaprāṇena mahatā sutapte tu śilātale ..
ā sphālayaṃti tarasā vajreṇeva mahādrumam .. 86 ..
meaning:
सर्वप्राणेन महता सुतप्ते तु शिलातले ..
आ स्फालयंति तरसा वज्रेणेव महाद्रुमम् .. 86 ..
text_mt: with all their great might, upon the thoroughly heated surface of a rock / they dash [them] down violently, like a great tree with a thunderbolt.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa raktasrotobhiḥ sravate jarjarīkṛtaḥ ..
sa niḥsaṃjñastadā dehī niśceṣṭaḥ saṃprajāyate .. 87 ..
meaning:
ततः स रक्तस्रोतोभिः स्रवते जर्जरीकृतः ..
स निःसंज्ञस्तदा देही निश्चेष्टः संप्रजायते .. 87 ..
text_mt: Then, shattered, he bleeds with streams of blood; / then that embodied soul becomes unconscious and motionless.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa vāyunā spṛṣṭaḥ śanairujīvate punaḥ ..
tataḥ pāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ kṣipyate narakārṇave .. 88 ..
meaning:
ततः स वायुना स्पृष्टः शनैरुजीवते पुनः ..
ततः पापविशुद्ध्यर्थं क्षिप्यते नरकार्णवे .. 88 ..
text_mt: Then, touched by the wind, he slowly revives again; / then, for the purification of his sins, he is cast into the ocean of hell.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāviṃśatirevādhaḥ kṣiternarakakoṭayaḥ..
saptamasya talasyāṃte ghore tamasi saṃsthitāḥ .. 89 ..
meaning:
अष्टाविंशतिरेवाधः क्षितेर्नरककोटयः..
सप्तमस्य तलस्यांते घोरे तमसि संस्थिताः .. 89 ..
text_mt: Indeed, twenty-eight crores of hells lie beneath the earth, / stationed in dreadful darkness at the end of the seventh level.

sanskrit_iast:
rauravaprabhṛtīnāṃ ca narakāṇāṃ śataṃ smṛtam ..
catvāriṃśatsamadhikaṃ mahānarakamaṃḍalam .. 4.6.90 ..
meaning:
रौरवप्रभृतीनां च नरकाणां शतं स्मृतम् ..
चत्वारिंशत्समधिकं महानरकमंडलम् .. 4.6.90 ..
text_mt: And of the hells beginning with Raurava, one hundred and forty / are remembered as the great sphere of hells,

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣu pāpāḥ prapacyaṃte narāḥ karmānurūpataḥ ..
yātanābhirvicitrābhirākarmaprakṣayādbhṛśam .. 91 ..
meaning:
येषु पापाः प्रपच्यंते नराः कर्मानुरूपतः ..
यातनाभिर्विचित्राभिराकर्मप्रक्षयाद्भृशम् .. 91 ..
text_mt: in which sinful men are cooked according to their deeds / with diverse torments, intensely, until their deeds are exhausted.

sanskrit_iast:
ā malaprakṣayādyadvadagnau dhāsyaṃti dhātavaḥ ..
tathā pāpakṣayātpāpāśśodhyaṃte narakāgniṣu .. 92 ..
meaning:
आ मलप्रक्षयाद्यद्वदग्नौ धास्यंति धातवः ..
तथा पापक्षयात्पापाश्शोध्यंते नरकाग्निषु .. 92 ..
text_mt: Just as minerals will be held in fire until their dross is destroyed, / even so, until their sins are destroyed, sinners are cleansed in the fires of hell.

sanskrit_iast:
sugāḍhahastayā bāḍhaṃ taptaśṛṃkhalayā narāḥ ..
mahāvṛkṣāgraśākhāyāṃ laṃbyaṃte yamakiṃkaraiḥ .. 93 .. .
meaning:
सुगाढहस्तया बाढं तप्तशृंखलया नराः ..
महावृक्षाग्रशाखायां लंब्यंते यमकिंकरैः .. 93 .. .
text_mt: Men with their hands bound very tightly by red-hot chains / are suspended from the top branch of a great tree by Yama's attendants.

sanskrit_iast:
tataste sarpayaṃtreṇa kṣiptā dolyaṃti kiṃkaraiḥ ..
dolyaṃtaścātivegena niḥsaṃjñā yāṃti yojanam .. 94 ..
meaning:
ततस्ते सर्पयंत्रेण क्षिप्ता दोल्यंति किंकरैः ..
दोल्यंतश्चातिवेगेन निःसंज्ञा यांति योजनम् .. 94 ..
text_mt: Then, propelled by a serpentine apparatus, they are swung by the attendants; / and being swung with extreme speed, they travel a yojana, senseless.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃtarikṣasthitānāṃ ca lohabhāraśataṃ tataḥ ..
pādayorbadhyate teṣāṃ yamadūtairmahābalaiḥ .. 95 ..
meaning:
अंतरिक्षस्थितानां च लोहभारशतं ततः ..
पादयोर्बध्यते तेषां यमदूतैर्महाबलैः .. 95 ..
text_mt: And as they hang in mid-air, a weight of a hundred iron [bars] / is then bound to their feet by Yama's mighty messengers.

sanskrit_iast:
tena bhāreṇa mahatā bhṛśamātardditā narāḥ ..
dhyāyaṃtaḥ svāni karmāṇi tūṣṇīṃ tiṣṭheti vihvalāḥ .. ..96 ..
meaning:
तेन भारेण महता भृशमातर्द्दिता नराः ..
ध्यायंतः स्वानि कर्माणि तूष्णीं तिष्ठेति विह्वलाः .. ..96 ..
text_mt: Tormented exceedingly by that great weight, / men, meditating upon their own deeds, stay in silence, distraught.

sanskrit_iast:
jvālābhiragnivarṇābhirllohadaṃḍaiḥ sakaṃṭakaiḥ..
hanyaṃte kiṃkarairghoraiḥ samaṃtātpāpakāriṇaḥ ..97 ..
meaning:
ज्वालाभिरग्निवर्णाभिर्ल्लोहदंडैः सकंटकैः..
हन्यंते किंकरैर्घोरैः समंतात्पापकारिणः ..97 ..
text_mt: With iron rods, barbed and glowing like flames of fire, / the evil-doers are struck on all sides by terrible attendants.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kṣāreṇa dīptena vahnerapi viśeṣataḥ ..
samaṃtataḥ pralipyaṃte kṣatāṃgā jarjarīkṛtāḥ .. 98 ..
meaning:
ततः क्षारेण दीप्तेन वह्नेरपि विशेषतः ..
समंततः प्रलिप्यंते क्षतांगा जर्जरीकृताः .. 98 ..
text_mt: Then, with burning caustic, even more intense than fire, / their wounded limbs, mangled, are smeared all over.

sanskrit_iast:
punarvidārya cāṃgeṣu śirasaḥprabhṛti kramāt ..
vṛntākavatprapacyaṃte taptatailakaṭāhake .. 99 ..
meaning:
पुनर्विदार्य चांगेषु शिरसःप्रभृति क्रमात् ..
वृन्ताकवत्प्रपच्यंते तप्ततैलकटाहके .. 99 ..
text_mt: Then, torn open again in their limbs successively from the head downwards, / they are cooked like eggplants in a cauldron of boiling oil.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṭhāpūrṇe tataḥ kūpe kṛmīṇāṃ nicaye tataḥ ..
medastvakpūyapūrṇāyāṃ vāpyāṃ kṣipyaṃti te punaḥ .. 4.6.100 ..
meaning:
विष्ठापूर्णे ततः कूपे कृमीणां निचये ततः ..
मेदस्त्वक्पूयपूर्णायां वाप्यां क्षिप्यंति ते पुनः .. 4.6.100 ..
text_mt: Then into a pit filled with feces, then into a mass of worms, / and into a reservoir filled with fat, skin, and pus they cast them again.

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣyaṃte krimibhistīkṣṇairlohatuṇḍaiśca vāyasaiḥ ..
śvabhirdaṃśairvṛkairghorairvyāghrairapyatha vānaraiḥ .. 101 ..
meaning:
भक्ष्यंते क्रिमिभिस्तीक्ष्णैर्लोहतुण्डैश्च वायसैः ..
श्वभिर्दंशैर्वृकैर्घोरैर्व्याघ्रैरप्यथ वानरैः .. 101 ..
text_mt: They are devoured by fierce worms, by crows with iron beaks, / by dogs, by gadflies, by dreadful wolves, by tigers, and also by monkeys.

sanskrit_iast:
pacyaṃte māṃsavaccāpi pradīptāṃgārarāśiṣu ..
protāḥ śūleṣu tīkṣṇeṣu narāḥ pāpena karmaṇā .. 102..
meaning:
पच्यंते मांसवच्चापि प्रदीप्तांगारराशिषु ..
प्रोताः शूलेषु तीक्ष्णेषु नराः पापेन कर्मणा .. 102..
text_mt: And impaled on sharp stakes, men through their sinful deed / are cooked like meat upon heaps of blazing coals.

sanskrit_iast:
tilapiṃḍairivākramya ghoraiḥ karmabhirātmanaḥ ..
tilavatsamprapīḍayante cakrākhye narake tathā .. 103 ..
meaning:
तिलपिंडैरिवाक्रम्य घोरैः कर्मभिरात्मनः ..
तिलवत्सम्प्रपीडयन्ते चक्राख्ये नरके तथा .. 103 ..
text_mt: Overcome by their own terrible deeds, as if by sesame balls, / they are thoroughly crushed like sesame seeds in the hell named Cakra.

sanskrit_iast:
bhidyaṃte cāpi talpeṣu lohabhrāṣṭreṣvanekadhā ..
tailapūrṇakaṭāheṣu sutapteṣu punaḥpunaḥ .. 104 ..
meaning:
भिद्यंते चापि तल्पेषु लोहभ्राष्ट्रेष्वनेकधा ..
तैलपूर्णकटाहेषु सुतप्तेषु पुनःपुनः .. 104 ..
text_mt: And on couches of iron frying-pans they are shattered in many ways, / and again and again in intensely heated cauldrons filled with oil.

sanskrit_iast:
bahuśaḥ pīḍyate jihvā yā'satyapriyavādinī ..
saṃdaṃśena sutaptena prapīḍyante ca pādayoḥ .. 1-5..
meaning:
बहुशः पीड्यते जिह्वा याऽसत्यप्रियवादिनी ..
संदंशेन सुतप्तेन प्रपीड्यन्ते च पादयोः .. 1-5..
text_mt: Frequently crushed is the tongue that spoke untruth and flattery, / and they are squeezed at the feet with a red-hot pair of tongs.

sanskrit_iast:
mithyāgamapravaktuśca dvijihvasya ca nirgatā ..
jihvārddhakrośavistīrṇā halaistīkṣṇaiśca bādhyate .. .. 106 ..
meaning:
मिथ्यागमप्रवक्तुश्च द्विजिह्वस्य च निर्गता ..
जिह्वार्द्धक्रोशविस्तीर्णा हलैस्तीक्ष्णैश्च बाध्यते .. .. 106 ..
text_mt: And the tongue of the false teacher of tradition, of the two-tongued [liar], protruding / half a krośa in width, is afflicted with sharp ploughs.

sanskrit_iast:
nirbhartsayaṃti ye krūrā mātaraṃ pitaraṃ gurum ..
teṣāṃ vakṣa ulūkābhirmukhamāpūrya sevyate ..107..
meaning:
निर्भर्त्सयंति ये क्रूरा मातरं पितरं गुरुम् ..
तेषां वक्ष उलूकाभिर्मुखमापूर्य सेव्यते ..107..
text_mt: As for those cruel ones who reviled mother, father, or guru, / their chest is subjected [to torment], their mouth having been filled with embers.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kṣāreṇa dīptena tāmreṇa tu punaḥpunaḥ ..
hatenāpūryate'tyarthaṃ taptatailaiśca tanmukham .. 108 ..
meaning:
ततः क्षारेण दीप्तेन ताम्रेण तु पुनःपुनः ..
हतेनापूर्यतेऽत्यर्थं तप्ततैलैश्च तन्मुखम् .. 108 ..
text_mt: Then, with blazing caustic, and again and again with molten copper, / and with boiling oils, that mouth, struck violently, is filled.

sanskrit_iast:
itastataḥ punarvaktraṃ bhṛśamāpūrya hanyate ..
viṣṭhābhiḥ kṛmibhiścāpi suvarṇaharaṇairnaraḥ .. 109 ..
meaning:
इतस्ततः पुनर्वक्त्रं भृशमापूर्य हन्यते ..
विष्ठाभिः कृमिभिश्चापि सुवर्णहरणैर्नरः .. 109 ..
text_mt: Having filled his mouth abundantly on this side and that, a man / who stole gold is beaten again with excrement and with worms.

sanskrit_iast:
pariṣvajati cātyugrāṃ pradīptāṃ lohaśālmalīm ..
hanyate pṛṣṭhadeśe ca punastīkṣṇairmahāghanaiḥ .. 4.6.110 ..
meaning:
परिष्वजति चात्युग्रां प्रदीप्तां लोहशाल्मलीम् ..
हन्यते पृष्ठदेशे च पुनस्तीक्ष्णैर्महाघनैः .. 4.6.110 ..
text_mt: And he embraces a most terrifying, blazing iron silk-cotton tree, / and on his back he is struck again with sharp, heavy clubs.

sanskrit_iast:
daṃtureṇātikūṭena krakacena balīyasā ..
śiraḥ prabhṛti pādāṃtaṃ ghoraiḥ karmabhirātmajaiḥ ..
khādyate svāni māṃsāni pāyate śoṇitaṃ svakam .. 111 ..
meaning:
दंतुरेणातिकूटेन क्रकचेन बलीयसा ..
शिरः प्रभृति पादांतं घोरैः कर्मभिरात्मजैः ..
खाद्यते स्वानि मांसानि पायते शोणितं स्वकम् .. 111 ..
text_mt: By a jagged, exceedingly treacherous, powerful saw, / from head to foot, because of the terrible deeds born of oneself, / he is made to eat his own flesh and made to drink his own blood.

sanskrit_iast:
annaṃ pānaṃ na dattaṃ yairmūḍhairnāpyanumoditam..
ikṣuvatte prapīḍyante jarjarīkṛtamastakāḥ .. 112 ..
meaning:
अन्नं पानं न दत्तं यैर्मूढैर्नाप्यनुमोदितम्..
इक्षुवत्ते प्रपीड्यन्ते जर्जरीकृतमस्तकाः .. 112 ..
text_mt: Those fools by whom food and drink were not given, nor even approved of, / are pressed like sugarcane, their heads completely shattered.

sanskrit_iast:
asitālavane ghore cchidyaṃte khaṃḍakhaṃḍaśaḥ..
sūcībhirbhinnasarvāṃgāstaptaśūlapraropitāḥ ..
saṃbādhyamānā vivaśāḥ kliśyaṃte na mriyaṃti vai .. 113 ..
meaning:
असितालवने घोरे च्छिद्यंते खंडखंडशः..
सूचीभिर्भिन्नसर्वांगास्तप्तशूलप्ररोपिताः ..
संबाध्यमाना विवशाः क्लिश्यंते न म्रियंति वै .. 113 ..
text_mt: In the dreadful forest of sword-leaves, they are hacked into pieces; / with all their limbs pierced by needles, mounted upon red-hot stakes, / being harassed, helpless, they suffer and indeed do not die.

sanskrit_iast:
dehādutsādyamāṃsāni bhidyaṃte'sthīni mudgaraiḥ ..
dṛṣṭirākṛṣyate tūrṇaṃ yamadūtairbalotkaṭaiḥ .. 114 ..
meaning:
देहादुत्साद्यमांसानि भिद्यंतेऽस्थीनि मुद्गरैः ..
दृष्टिराकृष्यते तूर्णं यमदूतैर्बलोत्कटैः .. 114 ..
text_mt: Tearing the flesh from the body, their bones are broken with mallets; / their eyesight is swiftly plucked out by Yama's mighty messengers.

sanskrit_iast:
nirastāste nirucchvāsāstiṣṭhaṃti narake dhruvam ..
ucchvasaṃti sadā śvāsairvālukāvadanāvṛtāḥ .. 115 ..
meaning:
निरस्तास्ते निरुच्छ्वासास्तिष्ठंति नरके ध्रुवम् ..
उच्छ्वसंति सदा श्वासैर्वालुकावदनावृताः .. 115 ..
text_mt: Cast out and breathless, they remain in hell constantly; / their mouths covered with sand, they continually gasp for breath.

sanskrit_iast:
raurave rodamānāśca pīḍyante vividhaiḥ śaraiḥ ..
mahārauravapīḍābhirmahatībhistadaṃtike .. 116 ..
meaning:
रौरवे रोदमानाश्च पीड्यन्ते विविधैः शरैः ..
महारौरवपीडाभिर्महतीभिस्तदंतिके .. 116 ..
text_mt: Weeping in Raurava, they are afflicted with various arrows, / and near it with the immense torments of Mahāraurava.

sanskrit_iast:
padorāsye gude caiva pārśve corasi mastake ..
nikhanyaṃte ghanaistīkṣṇaiḥ sutaptairlohaśaṃkubhiḥ .. 117 ..
meaning:
पदोरास्ये गुदे चैव पार्श्वे चोरसि मस्तके ..
निखन्यंते घनैस्तीक्ष्णैः सुतप्तैर्लोहशंकुभिः .. 117 ..
text_mt: Into the two feet, the mouth, the anus, the sides, the chest, and the head, / solid, sharp, intensely heated iron stakes are driven.

sanskrit_iast:
sutaptavālukāyāṃ ca praluṭhyante punaḥpunaḥ ..
