jatupaṃke bhṛśaṃ tapte kṣiprā krandaṃti vistaram .. 118 ..
meaning:
सुतप्तवालुकायां च प्रलुठ्यन्ते पुनःपुनः ..
जतुपंके भृशं तप्ते क्षिप्रा क्रन्दंति विस्तरम् .. 118 ..
text_mt: And they are rolled again and again in intensely heated sand; / cast into intensely hot mire of lac, they wail loudly.

sanskrit_iast:
tenatenaiva rūpeṇa hasante pāradārikam ..
gāḍhamāliṅgyate nārīṃ jvalaṃtīṃ lohanirmitām .. 119 ..
meaning:
तेनतेनैव रूपेण हसन्ते पारदारिकम् ..
गाढमालिङ्ग्यते नारीं ज्वलंतीं लोहनिर्मिताम् .. 119 ..
text_mt: Laughing at the adulterer in that very form, / he is made to embrace tightly a blazing woman made of iron.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvākāraṃ ca puruṣaṃ prajvalaṃtaṃ samaṃtataḥ ..
duścāriṇīḥ striyo gāḍhamāliṃgaṃti vadaṃti ca .. 4.6.120 ..
meaning:
पूर्वाकारं च पुरुषं प्रज्वलंतं समंततः ..
दुश्चारिणीः स्त्रियो गाढमालिंगंति वदंति च .. 4.6.120 ..
text_mt: And women of wicked conduct tightly embrace a man of their previous form, / blazing all around, and [the messengers] say:

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ pradhāvasi vegena te na mokṣo'sti sāṃpratam ..
laṃghitaste yathā bhartā pāpaṃ bhuṃkṣva tathādhunā .. 121 ..
meaning:
किं प्रधावसि वेगेन ते न मोक्षोऽस्ति सांप्रतम् ..
लंघितस्ते यथा भर्ता पापं भुंक्ष्व तथाधुना .. 121 ..
text_mt: "Why do you run with speed? There is no release for you now; / just as your husband was transgressed by you, so now enjoy your sin."

sanskrit_iast:
lohakumbhe tathā kṣiptāḥ savidhānaiḥ śanaiḥśanaiḥ ..
mṛdvagninātha pacyaṃte svapāpaireva mānavāḥ .. 122 ..
meaning:
लोहकुम्भे तथा क्षिप्ताः सविधानैः शनैःशनैः ..
मृद्वग्निनाथ पच्यंते स्वपापैरेव मानवाः .. 122 ..
text_mt: Likewise cast into an iron jar, slowly, by prescribed means / men are cooked with a gentle fire solely by their own sins.

sanskrit_iast:
kvaṇaṃtyudūkhale sāsrāḥ prakṣipyaṃte śilāsu ca ..
kṣipyaṃte cāṃdhakūpeṣu daśyaṃte bhramarairbhṛśam .. 123 ..
meaning:
क्वणंत्युदूखले सास्राः प्रक्षिप्यंते शिलासु च ..
क्षिप्यंते चांधकूपेषु दश्यंते भ्रमरैर्भृशम् .. 123 ..
text_mt: Weeping with tears in a mortar, they groan and are cast upon rocks; / and they are cast into blind wells and bitten severely by bees.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛmibhirbhinnasarvāṃgāḥ śataśo jarjarīkṛtāḥ ..
sutīkṣṇakṣārakūpepu kṣipyaṃte tadanaṃtaram.. 124 ..
meaning:
कृमिभिर्भिन्नसर्वांगाः शतशो जर्जरीकृताः ..
सुतीक्ष्णक्षारकूपेपु क्षिप्यंते तदनंतरम्.. 124 ..
text_mt: Their bodies completely pierced by worms and shattered into hundreds [of pieces], / they are immediately cast into pits of extremely sharp caustic.

sanskrit_iast:
mahājvāle ca narake pāpāḥ phūtkārayaṃti ca ..
itastataśca dhāvaṃti dahyamānāstadarcciṣā .. 125 ..
meaning:
महाज्वाले च नरके पापाः फूत्कारयंति च ..
इतस्ततश्च धावंति दह्यमानास्तदर्च्चिषा .. 125 ..
text_mt: And in the Mahājvāla hell, the sinners scream / and run hither and thither, burning from its flames.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛṣṭhe cānīya jaṃghe dve vinyaste skandhayoḥ sthite ..
tayormadhyena cākṛṣya bāhupṛṣṭhena gāḍhataḥ ..
baddhvā parasparaṃ sarvaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ gāḍharajjubhi. .. 126 ..
meaning:
पृष्ठे चानीय जंघे द्वे विन्यस्ते स्कन्धयोः स्थिते ..
तयोर्मध्येन चाकृष्य बाहुपृष्ठेन गाढतः ..
बद्ध्वा परस्परं सर्वं सुदृढं गाढरज्जुभि. .. 126 ..
text_mt: Bringing both shanks behind the back and placing them on the shoulders, / pulling [the arms] through the middle of the two, behind the back, tightly, / binding everything firmly together with strong ropes,

sanskrit_iast:
pīḍayaṃti susaṃrabdhā bhramarāstīkṣṇalohajāḥ ..
mānināṃ krodhināṃ caiva purā pāpasya saṃśayāt .. 127 ..
meaning:
पीडयंति सुसंरब्धा भ्रमरास्तीक्ष्णलोहजाः ..
मानिनां क्रोधिनां चैव पुरा पापस्य संशयात् .. 127 ..
text_mt: furious hornets born of sharp iron torment [them], / [the punishment] for the proud and the angry, on account of their former sin.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpānāṃ narake puṃsāṃ ghṛṣyate caṃdanaṃ yathā ..
śarīrābhyaṃtaragataṃ taruṇānāṃ ca dāruṇam .. 128 ..
meaning:
पापानां नरके पुंसां घृष्यते चंदनं यथा ..
शरीराभ्यंतरगतं तरुणानां च दारुणम् .. 128 ..
text_mt: In hell, [the bodies] of sinful men are rubbed down just as sandalwood [is rubbed]— / a dreadful [torment] penetrating into the interior of the bodies even of the young.

sanskrit_iast:
piṃḍabaṃdho smṛto yāmyo mahājvāleṣu yātanāḥ ..
rajjubhirveṣṭitāṃgāśca praliptāḥ kardamena ca ..
karīṣarūkṣavahnau ca pacyaṃte na mriyaṃti ca .. 129 ..
meaning:
पिंडबंधो स्मृतो याम्यो महाज्वालेषु यातनाः ..
रज्जुभिर्वेष्टितांगाश्च प्रलिप्ताः कर्दमेन च ..
करीषरूक्षवह्नौ च पच्यंते न म्रियंति च .. 129 ..
text_mt: This is known as the Yama-binding of the body; the torments in Mahājvāla [are as follows]: / with their limbs wrapped in ropes and smeared with mud, / they are cooked in dry fire fueled by cow dung, yet they do not die.

sanskrit_iast:
sutīkṣṇakṣāratoyena śarkarāsu śilāsu ca ..
ā pāpasaṃkṣayātpāpā ghṛṣyaṃte caṃdanaṃ yathā .. 4.6.130 ..
meaning:
सुतीक्ष्णक्षारतोयेन शर्करासु शिलासु च ..
आ पापसंक्षयात्पापा घृष्यंते चंदनं यथा .. 4.6.130 ..
text_mt: With extremely pungent alkaline water, upon gravel and rocks, / sinners are rubbed down like sandalwood until their sin is destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
śarīrābhyantaragataiḥ prabhūtaiḥ kṛmibhirnarāḥ ..
bhakṣyaṃte tīkṣṇavadanairādehaprakṣayāṭ bhṛśam .. 131 ..
meaning:
शरीराभ्यन्तरगतैः प्रभूतैः कृमिभिर्नराः ..
भक्ष्यंते तीक्ष्णवदनैरादेहप्रक्षयाट् भृशम् .. 131 ..
text_mt: By abundant worms with sharp mouths that enter inside their bodies, / men are devoured violently until their bodies perish.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛmīṇāṃ nicaye kṣiptāḥ pūtimāṃsasya rāśiṣu ..
tiṣṭhantyudvignahṛdayāḥ parvatābhyāṃ ca pīḍitāḥ .. 132 ..
meaning:
कृमीणां निचये क्षिप्ताः पूतिमांसस्य राशिषु ..
तिष्ठन्त्युद्विग्नहृदयाः पर्वताभ्यां च पीडिताः .. 132 ..
text_mt: Cast into an accumulation of worms and onto heaps of rotting flesh, / they remain with agitated hearts, crushed between two mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
sutaptavajralepena śarīramanulipyate ..
adhomukhordhvapādāśca dhṛtāstapyaṃti vahniṣu .. 133 ..
meaning:
सुतप्तवज्रलेपेन शरीरमनुलिप्यते ..
अधोमुखोर्ध्वपादाश्च धृतास्तप्यंति वह्निषु .. 133 ..
text_mt: Their bodies are smeared with a paste of boiling diamond-pitch; / held upside-down with feet upwards, they burn in fires.

sanskrit_iast:
vadanāṃte pravinyastaṃ sutaptāyomayaṃ guḍam ..
te khādaṃti parādhīnā hanyamānāstu mudgaraiḥ .. 134 ..
meaning:
वदनांते प्रविन्यस्तं सुतप्तायोमयं गुडम् ..
ते खादंति पराधीना हन्यमानास्तु मुद्गरैः .. 134 ..
text_mt: A glowing iron ball is placed inside their mouths; / helpless, struck with clubs, they are made to chew it.

sanskrit_iast:
ye śivāyatanārāmavāpīkūpamaṭhāṃga ṇāt ..
abhidravaṃti pāpiṣṭhā narāstatra vasaṃti ca .. 135 ..
meaning:
ये शिवायतनारामवापीकूपमठांग णात् ..
अभिद्रवंति पापिष्ठा नरास्तत्र वसंति च .. 135 ..
text_mt: Those most sinful men who run away from / the compound of a temple of Śiva, a grove, a pool, a well, or a monastery, and live there,

sanskrit_iast:
vyāyāmodvartanābhyaṃgasnānamāpānabhojanam ..
krīḍanaṃ maithunaṃ dyūtamāca raṃti ramaṃti ca .. 136 ..
meaning:
व्यायामोद्वर्तनाभ्यंगस्नानमापानभोजनम् ..
क्रीडनं मैथुनं द्यूतमाच रंति रमंति च .. 136 ..
text_mt: who practice and delight in physical exercise, body-scrubbing, oil-massage, / bathing, drinking-parties, dining, sports, sexual intercourse, and gambling—

sanskrit_iast:
te bādhairvividhairghorairikṣuyantrādipīḍanaiḥ ..
nirayāgniṣu pacyaṃte yāvadācandratārakam .. 137 ..
meaning:
ते बाधैर्विविधैर्घोरैरिक्षुयन्त्रादिपीडनैः ..
निरयाग्निषु पच्यंते यावदाचन्द्रतारकम् .. 137 ..
text_mt: they are cooked in the fires of hell as long as the moon and stars endure, / through various dreadful torments, being crushed in sugarcane-presses and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
ye śṛṇvaṃti gurorniṃdāṃ teṣāṃ karṇaḥ prapūryyate ..
agnivarṇairayaḥkīlaistaptatāmrādibhirdrutaiḥ .. 138 ..
meaning:
ये शृण्वंति गुरोर्निंदां तेषां कर्णः प्रपूर्य्यते ..
अग्निवर्णैरयःकीलैस्तप्तताम्रादिभिर्द्रुतैः .. 138 ..
text_mt: For those who listen to slander of the guru, their ear is filled / with fire-colored iron spikes, molten copper, and other [metals],

sanskrit_iast:
trapusīsārakūṭādyaiḥ kṣāreṇa jatunā punaḥ ..
kramādāpūryate karṇo narakeṣu ca yātanāḥ ..
anukrameṇa sarveṣu bhavaṃtyetāḥ samaṃtataḥ .. 139 ..
meaning:
त्रपुसीसारकूटाद्यैः क्षारेण जतुना पुनः ..
क्रमादापूर्यते कर्णो नरकेषु च यातनाः ..
अनुक्रमेण सर्वेषु भवंत्येताः समंततः .. 139 ..
text_mt: with tin, lead, brass, and the like, and again with alkali and lac; / gradually their ear is filled, and such torments / occur everywhere in all the hells in turn.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṃdriyāṇāmapyevaṃ kramātpāpena yātanāḥ ..
bhavaṃti ghorāḥ pratyekaṃ śarīre tatkṛtena ca .. 4.6.140 ..
meaning:
सर्वेंद्रियाणामप्येवं क्रमात्पापेन यातनाः ..
भवंति घोराः प्रत्येकं शरीरे तत्कृतेन च .. 4.6.140 ..
text_mt: In this way, terrible torments occur for all the senses in turn, / each according to the sin committed by the body.

sanskrit_iast:
sparśalobhena ye mūḍhāḥ saṃspṛśaṃti parastriyam ..
teṣāṃ tvagagnivarṇābhiḥ sūcībhiḥ pūryate bhṛśam ..141..
meaning:
स्पर्शलोभेन ये मूढाः संस्पृशंति परस्त्रियम् ..
तेषां त्वगग्निवर्णाभिः सूचीभिः पूर्यते भृशम् ..141..
text_mt: Those fools who, through longing for touch, touch another's wife, / their skin is pierced profusely with needles having the color of fire.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kṣārādibhiḥ sarvaiḥ śarīramanulipyate ..
yātanā ca mahākaṣṭā sarveṣu narakeṣu ca .. 142 ..
meaning:
ततः क्षारादिभिः सर्वैः शरीरमनुलिप्यते ..
यातना च महाकष्टा सर्वेषु नरकेषु च .. 142 ..
text_mt: Then the body is smeared with all [substances such as] alkali; / and there is extremely painful torment in all the hells.

sanskrit_iast:
guroḥ kurvaṃti bhrukuṭiṃ krūraṃ cakṣuśca ye narāḥ ..
paradārāṃśca paśyaṃti lubdhāḥ snigdhena cakṣuṣā ..143..
meaning:
गुरोः कुर्वंति भ्रुकुटिं क्रूरं चक्षुश्च ये नराः ..
परदारांश्च पश्यंति लुब्धाः स्निग्धेन चक्षुषा ..143..
text_mt: Those men who knit their brows at the guru and cast cruel eyes [at him], / and who look lustfully at another's wife with an affectionate gaze,

sanskrit_iast:
sūcībhiragnivarṇābhisteṣāṃ netraṃ prapūryate ..
kṣārādyaiśca kramātsarvairdehe sarvāśca yātanāḥ .. 144 ...
meaning:
सूचीभिरग्निवर्णाभिस्तेषां नेत्रं प्रपूर्यते ..
क्षाराद्यैश्च क्रमात्सर्वैर्देहे सर्वाश्च यातनाः .. 144 ...
text_mt: their eyes are filled with needles having the color of fire, / and their bodies [endure] all torments in turn with alkali and other [substances].

sanskrit_iast:
devāgniguruviprāṇāṃ ye'nivedya prabhuṃjate ..
lohakīlaśataistaptaistajjihvāsyaṃ prapūryate .. 145 ..
meaning:
देवाग्निगुरुविप्राणां येऽनिवेद्य प्रभुंजते ..
लोहकीलशतैस्तप्तैस्तज्जिह्वास्यं प्रपूर्यते .. 145 ..
text_mt: Those who eat without first offering to the gods, the fire, the guru, and the brāhmaṇas, / their mouth and tongue are filled with hundreds of heated iron spikes.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kṣāreṇa dīptena tailatāmrādibhiḥ kramāt ...
śarīre ca mahāghorāścitrā narakayātanāḥ ..146..
meaning:
ततः क्षारेण दीप्तेन तैलताम्रादिभिः क्रमात् ...
शरीरे च महाघोराश्चित्रा नरकयातनाः ..146..
text_mt: Then, in turn, with blazing alkali, oil, copper, and the like, / most terrible and diverse hell-torments [are inflicted] on the body.

sanskrit_iast:
ye śivārāmapuṣpāṇi lobhātsaṃgṛhya pāṇinā ..
jighraṃti mūḍhamanasaḥ śirasā dhārayaṃti ca ..147...
meaning:
ये शिवारामपुष्पाणि लोभात्संगृह्य पाणिना ..
जिघ्रंति मूढमनसः शिरसा धारयंति च ..147...
text_mt: Those foolish-minded who, grasping with the hand out of greed, / smell flowers from Śiva's grove and wear them on their heads,

sanskrit_iast:
āpūryate śirasteṣāṃ sutaptairlohaśaṃkubhiḥ ..
nāsikā cātibahuśastataḥ kṣārādibhiḥ punaḥ .. 148 ..
meaning:
आपूर्यते शिरस्तेषां सुतप्तैर्लोहशंकुभिः ..
नासिका चातिबहुशस्ततः क्षारादिभिः पुनः .. 148 ..
text_mt: their head is filled with glowing iron pegs, / as is the nose repeatedly, and then again with alkali and other [substances].

sanskrit_iast:
ye niṃdaṃti mahātmānamācāryaṃ dharmadeśikam ..
śivabhaktāṃśca ye mūḍhāḥ śivadharmaṃ ca śāśvatam .. 149 ..
meaning:
ये निंदंति महात्मानमाचार्यं धर्मदेशिकम् ..
शिवभक्तांश्च ये मूढाः शिवधर्मं च शाश्वतम् .. 149 ..
text_mt: Those fools who revile the high-souled master who teaches the dharma, / the devotees of Śiva, and the eternal Śaiva dharma,

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāmurasi kaṃṭhe ca jihvāyāṃ daṃtasaṃdhiṣu ..
tālukoṣṭhe ca nāsāyāṃ mūrdhni sarvāṃgasaṃ dhiṣu .. 4.6.150 ..
meaning:
तेषामुरसि कंठे च जिह्वायां दंतसंधिषु ..
तालुकोष्ठे च नासायां मूर्ध्नि सर्वांगसं धिषु .. 4.6.150 ..
text_mt: in their chest, throat, tongue, joints of the teeth, / palate, abdomen, nose, head, and all the joints of their limbs,

sanskrit_iast:
agnivarṇāḥ sutaptāśca triśikhā lohaśaṃkavaḥ ..
ākhanyaṃte subahuśaḥ sthāneṣveteṣu mudgaraiḥ .. 151 ..
meaning:
अग्निवर्णाः सुतप्ताश्च त्रिशिखा लोहशंकवः ..
आखन्यंते सुबहुशः स्थानेष्वेतेषु मुद्गरैः .. 151 ..
text_mt: heated three-pronged iron stakes, having the color of fire, / are hammered repeatedly into these places with clubs.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kṣāreṇa taptena tāmreṇa trapuṇā punaḥ ..
taptatailādibhiḥ sarvairāpūryaṃte samaṃtataḥ .. 152 ..
meaning:
ततः क्षारेण तप्तेन ताम्रेण त्रपुणा पुनः ..
तप्ततैलादिभिः सर्वैरापूर्यंते समंततः .. 152 ..
text_mt: Then with alkali, molten copper, tin, / and heated oil and other [liquids], they are filled on all sides.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣāratāmrādibhirdīptairdahyaṃte bahuśaḥ punaḥ ..
narakeṣu ca sarveṣu vicitrā dehayā tanāḥ .. 153 ..
meaning:
क्षारताम्रादिभिर्दीप्तैर्दह्यंते बहुशः पुनः ..
नरकेषु च सर्वेषु विचित्रा देहया तनाः .. 153 ..
text_mt: Burned repeatedly with blazing alkali, copper, and the like, / various bodily torments [are inflicted] in all the hells.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavaṃti bahuśaḥ kaṣṭāḥ pāṇipādasamudbhavāḥ ..
śivāyatanaparyaṃte śivārāme ca kutracit .. 154 ..
meaning:
भवंति बहुशः कष्टाः पाणिपादसमुद्भवाः ..
शिवायतनपर्यंते शिवारामे च कुत्रचित् .. 154 ..
text_mt: Frequent and painful [torments] arise from [sins committed with] hands and feet. / Those sinners who, around the precincts of a temple of Śiva or anywhere in a grove of Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
samutsṛjaṃti ye pāpāḥ purīṣaṃ mūtrameva vā ..
teṣāṃ liṃgaṃ savṛṣaṇaṃ cūrṇyate lohamudgaraiḥ .. 155 ..
meaning:
समुत्सृजंति ये पापाः पुरीषं मूत्रमेव वा ..
तेषां लिंगं सवृषणं चूर्ण्यते लोहमुद्गरैः .. 155 ..
text_mt: discharge feces or urine, / their penis along with the testicles is crushed with iron clubs.

sanskrit_iast:
sūcībhiragnivarṇābhistataścāpūryate punaḥ ..
lohadaṇḍaśca sumahānagnivarṇaḥ sakaṃṭakaḥ ..
ākhanyate gude teṣāṃ yāvanmūrdhni vinirgataḥ ..156..
meaning:
सूचीभिरग्निवर्णाभिस्ततश्चापूर्यते पुनः ..
लोहदण्डश्च सुमहानग्निवर्णः सकंटकः ..
आखन्यते गुदे तेषां यावन्मूर्ध्नि विनिर्गतः ..156..
text_mt: Then it is filled again with needles having the color of fire; / and a huge iron rod, having the color of fire and bearing thorns, / is driven into their anus until it comes out at the crown of the head.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kṣāreṇa mahatā tāmreṇa trapuṇā punaḥ ..
drutenāpūryate gāḍhaṃ gudaṃ śiśnaṃ hi dehinām..157..
meaning:
ततः क्षारेण महता ताम्रेण त्रपुणा पुनः ..
द्रुतेनापूर्यते गाढं गुदं शिश्नं हि देहिनाम्..157..
text_mt: Then, with strong alkali, copper, and tin, / in molten form, the anus and penis of the embodied souls are filled tightly.

sanskrit_iast:
manaḥ sarvendriyāṇāṃ ca yasmāduktaṃ pravarttakam ..
tasmādindriyaduḥkhena jāyate tatsuduḥkhitam ..158..
meaning:
मनः सर्वेन्द्रियाणां च यस्मादुक्तं प्रवर्त्तकम् ..
तस्मादिन्द्रियदुःखेन जायते तत्सुदुःखितम् ..158..
text_mt: Since the mind is said to be the instigator of all the senses, / it becomes exceedingly distressed through the suffering of the senses.

sanskrit_iast:
dhane satyapi ye dānaṃ na prayacchaṃti tṛṣṇayā ...
atithiṃ cāvamanyaṃte kālaprāptaṃ gṛhāśrame ..159..
meaning:
धने सत्यपि ये दानं न प्रयच्छंति तृष्णया ...
अतिथिं चावमन्यंते कालप्राप्तं गृहाश्रमे ..159..
text_mt: Those who, although having wealth, out of greed do not grant gifts, / and despise a guest who has arrived at the proper time in the householder's stage of life,

sanskrit_iast:
te lohatoraṇe baddhā hastapādāvatāḍitāḥ ..
vidāritāṃgāḥ śuṣyaṃte tiṣṭhaṃtyabdaśataṃ narāḥ ..4.6.160..
meaning:
ते लोहतोरणे बद्धा हस्तपादावताडिताः ..
विदारितांगाः शुष्यंते तिष्ठंत्यब्दशतं नराः ..4.6.160..
text_mt: bound to an iron arch, beaten on hands and feet, / their limbs torn open, they dry up and remain for a hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
hastapādalalāṭeṣu kīlitā lohaśaṃkubhiḥ ..
nityaṃ ca nīvṛtaṃ vaktraṃ kīlakadvayanāḍitam .. 161 ..
meaning:
हस्तपादललाटेषु कीलिता लोहशंकुभिः ..
नित्यं च नीवृतं वक्त्रं कीलकद्वयनाडितम् .. 161 ..
text_mt: Nailed through their hands, feet, and foreheads with iron pegs, / their mouth is constantly uncovered, pierced by two pegs.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛmibhiḥ prāṇibhiścograirlohadaṃḍaiśca vāyasaiḥ ..
upadravairbahuvidhaiḥ sarpairmukharakaistataḥ .. 162 ..
meaning:
कृमिभिः प्राणिभिश्चोग्रैर्लोहदंडैश्च वायसैः ..
उपद्रवैर्बहुविधैः सर्पैर्मुखरकैस्ततः .. 162 ..
text_mt: By worms, fierce creatures, iron rods, and crows, / by many kinds of afflictions, and then by noisy serpents,

sanskrit_iast:
āpīḍyaṃte jihvāmūle nibadhya śṛṃkhalāḥ punaḥ ..
tiṣṭhaṃti laṃbamānāśca lohabhāraprapīḍitāḥ ..163..
meaning:
आपीड्यंते जिह्वामूले निबध्य शृंखलाः पुनः ..
तिष्ठंति लंबमानाश्च लोहभारप्रपीडिताः ..163..
text_mt: they are tormented; having fastened chains at the base of their tongue, / they remain hanging, oppressed by a heavy load of iron.

sanskrit_iast:
snigdhe ca vṛṣaṇe naddhe lohabhāradvayaṃ punaḥ ..
tiṣṭhate laṃbamānaṃ ca bahubhāracaturguṇam .. 164 ..
meaning:
स्निग्धे च वृषणे नद्धे लोहभारद्वयं पुनः ..
तिष्ठते लंबमानं च बहुभारचतुर्गुणम् .. 164 ..
text_mt: And fastened to the moist scrotum, two iron weights / remain hanging, four times heavier.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ svamāṃsamutkṛtya tilamātrapramāṇataḥ ..
bhojanaṃ dīyate teṣāṃ sūcyagreṇa saśoṇitam .. 165 ..
meaning:
ततः स्वमांसमुत्कृत्य तिलमात्रप्रमाणतः ..
भोजनं दीयते तेषां सूच्यग्रेण सशोणितम् .. 165 ..
text_mt: Then, carving off their own flesh in portions the size of a sesame seed, / it is given to them as food on the point of a needle, mixed with blood.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā nirmāṃsatāṃ prāptāḥ kālena mahatā punaḥ ..
tataḥ kṣāreṇa dīptena vapusteṣāṃ pralipyate .. 166 ..
meaning:
यदा निर्मांसतां प्राप्ताः कालेन महता पुनः ..
ततः क्षारेण दीप्तेन वपुस्तेषां प्रलिप्यते .. 166 ..
text_mt: When, after a long time, they have become destitute of flesh, / their body is then smeared with blazing alkali.

sanskrit_iast:
sicyaṃte varṣadhārābhiḥ śoṣyaṃte vāyunā punaḥ ..
sicyaṃte taptatailena prataptena samaṃtataḥ .. 167 ..
meaning:
सिच्यंते वर्षधाराभिः शोष्यंते वायुना पुनः ..
सिच्यंते तप्ततैलेन प्रतप्तेन समंततः .. 167 ..
text_mt: They are sprinkled with torrents of rain, and then dried up by the wind; / they are sprinkled all over with boiling, burning oil.

sanskrit_iast:
paścātte vahninā bhūyo dūrasthena śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ..
niḥśeṣayātanābhiśca pīḍyaṃte kramaśaḥ punaḥ .. 168 ..
meaning:
पश्चात्ते वह्निना भूयो दूरस्थेन शनैः शनैः ..
निःशेषयातनाभिश्च पीड्यंते क्रमशः पुनः .. 168 ..
text_mt: Afterwards, they are tortured gradually again by fire / situated at a distance, slowly, slowly, and with every kind of torment.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛśaṃ bubhukṣayā pīḍā mūrcchayātipipāsayā ..
atyuṣṇenātiśītena pāpānāṃ samareṇa ca .. 169 ..
meaning:
भृशं बुभुक्षया पीडा मूर्च्छयातिपिपासया ..
अत्युष्णेनातिशीतेन पापानां समरेण च .. 169 ..
text_mt: Violent pain comes upon the sinners from hunger, from fainting, from extreme thirst, / from intense heat, from intense cold, and from conflict.

sanskrit_iast:
evamādimahāghorā yātanāḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ ..
ekaike narake caiva śataśotha sahasraśaḥ .. 4.6.170 ..
meaning:
एवमादिमहाघोरा यातनाः पापकारिणः ..
एकैके नरके चैव शतशोथ सहस्रशः .. 4.6.170 ..
text_mt: Such exceedingly terrible torments as these / afflict the evil-doers in each hell by the hundreds and thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyekaṃ yātanāścitrāḥ sarveṣu narakeṣu ca ..
kaṣṭaṃ varṣaśatenāpi soḍhuṃ sarvaiśca nārake ..171..
meaning:
प्रत्येकं यातनाश्चित्राः सर्वेषु नरकेषु च ..
कष्टं वर्षशतेनापि सोढुं सर्वैश्च नारके ..171..
text_mt: The torments are manifold and distinct in every hell; / hard indeed is it for all those in hell to endure them, even for a hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
ete ca vividhairghorairyātyamānāśca karmabhiḥ ..
mriyante naiva pāpiṣṭhā vividhāḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ .. .. 172 ..
meaning:
एते च विविधैर्घोरैर्यात्यमानाश्च कर्मभिः ..
म्रियन्ते नैव पापिष्ठा विविधाः पापकारिणः .. .. 172 ..
text_mt: Being tortured by these various terrible deeds, / the most wicked, the various wrongdoers, do not die at all.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāghorābhighorākhyā kālāgnisadṛśopamāḥ ..
śrutairetairmahāraudrairmriyante mṛducetasaḥ .. 173 ..
meaning:
महाघोराभिघोराख्या कालाग्निसदृशोपमाः ..
श्रुतैरेतैर्महारौद्रैर्म्रियन्ते मृदुचेतसः .. 173 ..
text_mt: [These hells,] called the Most Terrible and Exceedingly Terrifying, resemble the fire of time; / upon hearing of these exceedingly dreadful [terrors], the soft-hearted die.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastenātra kathitāḥ pāpā gacchaṃti tānsvayam ..
putramitrakalatrārthaṃ yadā puṇyaṃ tvapākṛtam .. 174 ..
meaning:
ततस्तेनात्र कथिताः पापा गच्छंति तान्स्वयम् ..
पुत्रमित्रकलत्रार्थं यदा पुण्यं त्वपाकृतम् .. 174 ..
text_mt: Then the sins spoken of here go of themselves to them: / 'When merit was cast aside for the sake of son, friend, or wife,

sanskrit_iast:
ekākī dahyate tena na ca paśyati tāni saḥ ..
ātmanā ca kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ bhoktavyaṃ dhruvamātmanā .. 175 ..
meaning:
एकाकी दह्यते तेन न च पश्यति तानि सः ..
आत्मना च कृतं पापं भोक्तव्यं ध्रुवमात्मना .. 175 ..
text_mt: one is burned alone on that account, and does not see them; / and the evil deed done by oneself must certainly be experienced by oneself.'

sanskrit_iast:
tatkimanyopaghātārthaṃ mūḍha pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā ..
evaṃ dūtairupālabdhāste pṛcchaṃti tataḥ punaḥ .. 176 ..
meaning:
तत्किमन्योपघातार्थं मूढ पापं कृतं त्वया ..
एवं दूतैरुपालब्धास्ते पृच्छंति ततः पुनः .. 176 ..
text_mt: 'Why then was evil done by you, fool, to injure others?' / Reproached thus by the messengers [of Yama], they then ask again:

sanskrit_iast:
kiyaṃtaṃ kena pāpena kālamatrāyate naraḥ ..
devadravyavināśena gurudrohādikarmabhiḥ ..
pāpātsarveṣu pacyaṃte narakeṣvāmahākṣayāt .. 377 ..
meaning:
कियंतं केन पापेन कालमत्रायते नरः ..
देवद्रव्यविनाशेन गुरुद्रोहादिकर्मभिः ..
पापात्सर्वेषु पच्यंते नरकेष्वामहाक्षयात् .. 377 ..
text_mt: 'For how long a time, and by what sin, does a man arrive here?' / By destroying the property of the gods, by betraying one's guru, and other such deeds, / the wicked are cooked in all the hells until the great dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpātakinaścāpi sarveṣu narakeṣviha ..
ācaṃdratārakaṃ yāvatpīḍyaṃte vividhairvadhaiḥ .. 178 ..
meaning:
महापातकिनश्चापि सर्वेषु नरकेष्विह ..
आचंद्रतारकं यावत्पीड्यंते विविधैर्वधैः .. 178 ..
text_mt: And the perpetrators of great sins in all the hells here / are tortured with various killings as long as the moon and the stars endure.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpātakinaścānye narakārṇavakoṭiṣu ..
caturdaśasu pacyaṃte kalārdhaṃ vividhairvadhaiḥ .. 179 ..
meaning:
महापातकिनश्चान्ये नरकार्णवकोटिषु ..
चतुर्दशसु पच्यंते कलार्धं विविधैर्वधैः .. 179 ..
text_mt: Other perpetrators of great sins are cooked in the fourteen / crores of hell-oceans with various killings for half a kalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
upapātakinaścāpi tadarthaṃ yāṃti mānavāḥ ..
śeṣapāpaistadardhaṃ tu kālaṃ cāpi tathāvidham .. 4.6.180 ..
meaning:
उपपातकिनश्चापि तदर्थं यांति मानवाः ..
शेषपापैस्तदर्धं तु कालं चापि तथाविधम् .. 4.6.180 ..
text_mt: Perpetrators of secondary sins go for half that duration; / and for the remaining sins, [they go] for half of that, and for a corresponding time.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātpāpaṃ na kurvīta caṃcale jīvite sati ..
pāpena hi dhruvaṃ yāṃti narakeṣu narāḥ svayam .. 181 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्पापं न कुर्वीत चंचले जीविते सति ..
पापेन हि ध्रुवं यांति नरकेषु नराः स्वयम् .. 181 ..
text_mt: Therefore, one should not commit sin while life is unsteady; / for by sin, men certainly go to the hells of themselves.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ karoti naraḥ pāpaṃ tasyātmā dhruvamapriyaḥ ..
pāpasyeha phalaṃ duḥkhaṃ tadbhoktavyamihātmanā .. 182 ..
meaning:
यः करोति नरः पापं तस्यात्मा ध्रुवमप्रियः ..
पापस्येह फलं दुःखं तद्भोक्तव्यमिहात्मना .. 182 ..
text_mt: The man who commits sin certainly holds his own self unloved; / the fruit of sin in this world is misery, and that must be experienced here by oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ te pāpaniratā narā rātriṣu śerate ..
maraṇāṃtaritā yeṣāṃ nārakī tīvrayātanā .. 183 ..
meaning:
कथं ते पापनिरता नरा रात्रिषु शेरते ..
मरणांतरिता येषां नारकी तीव्रयातना .. 183 ..
text_mt: How can those men devoted to sin sleep during the nights, / separated only by death from the sharp torment of hell?

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kliṣṭaviśuddhāśca sāvaśeṣeṇa karmaṇā ..
tataḥ kṣitiṃ samāsādya jāyante dehinaḥ puna. ..
sthāvarā vividhākārāstṛṇagulmādibhedataḥ .. ... 184 ..
meaning:
एवं क्लिष्टविशुद्धाश्च सावशेषेण कर्मणा ..
ततः क्षितिं समासाद्य जायन्ते देहिनः पुन. ..
स्थावरा विविधाकारास्तृणगुल्मादिभेदतः .. ... 184 ..
text_mt: Having been thus purified through affliction, with a remnant of their karma, / embodied souls then reach the earth and are born again / as immovable beings of various forms, distinguished as grasses, shrubs, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrānubhūya duḥkhāni jāyaṃte kīṭayoniṣu ..
niṣkrāṃtāḥ kīṭayonibhyo jāyante pakṣiṇastataḥ .. 185 ..
meaning:
तत्रानुभूय दुःखानि जायंते कीटयोनिषु ..
निष्क्रांताः कीटयोनिभ्यो जायन्ते पक्षिणस्ततः .. 185 ..
text_mt: Having experienced sufferings there, they are born in the wombs of worms and insects; / having emerged from the wombs of worms and insects, they are born as birds thereafter.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃśliṣṭāḥ pakṣibhāvena bhavaṃti mṛgajādiṣu ..
mārgaṃ duḥkhamatikramya jāyaṃte paśuyoniṣu .. 186 ..
meaning:
संश्लिष्टाः पक्षिभावेन भवंति मृगजादिषु ..
मार्गं दुःखमतिक्रम्य जायंते पशुयोनिषु .. 186 ..
text_mt: Held within the state of birds, they enter the species of deer and the like; / having crossed beyond that path of misery, they are born in the wombs of domestic animals.

sanskrit_iast:
kramādgoyonimāsādya jāyante mānavāḥ punaḥ ..
evaṃ yoniṣu sarvāsu parikramya krameṇa tu ..
kālāṃtaravaśādyāṃti mānuṣyamatidurlabham .. 187 ..
meaning:
क्रमाद्गोयोनिमासाद्य जायन्ते मानवाः पुनः ..
एवं योनिषु सर्वासु परिक्रम्य क्रमेण तु ..
कालांतरवशाद्यांति मानुष्यमतिदुर्लभम् .. 187 ..
text_mt: Reaching in due order the womb of cattle, they are born as human beings again; / having thus wandered through all wombs in succession, / they attain the exceedingly rare human state in the course of time.

sanskrit_iast:
vyutkrameṇāpi mānuṣyaṃ prāpyate puṇyagocarāt ..
vicitrā gatayaḥ proktāḥ karmaṇāṃ gurulāghavāt .. 188 ..
meaning:
व्युत्क्रमेणापि मानुष्यं प्राप्यते पुण्यगोचरात् ..
विचित्रा गतयः प्रोक्ताः कर्मणां गुरुलाघवात् .. 188 ..
text_mt: Human birth is also attained out of turn through the scope of merit; / the paths are declared to be manifold according to the weight or lightness of deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
mānuṣyaṃ yaḥ samāsādya svargamokṣaprasādhakam ..
dvayorna sādhayatyekaṃ sa mṛtastapyate ciram .. .. 189 ..
meaning:
मानुष्यं यः समासाद्य स्वर्गमोक्षप्रसाधकम् ..
द्वयोर्न साधयत्येकं स मृतस्तप्यते चिरम् .. .. 189 ..
text_mt: He who, having attained human birth, which accomplishes heaven and liberation, / does not achieve one of the two, burns with remorse for a long time when dead.

sanskrit_iast:
devāsurāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ mānuṣyamatidurlabham ..
tatsaṃprāpya kathāḥ kuryānna gacchennarakaṃ yathā .. 4.6.190 ..
meaning:
देवासुराणां सर्वेषां मानुष्यमतिदुर्लभम् ..
तत्संप्राप्य कथाः कुर्यान्न गच्छेन्नरकं यथा .. 4.6.190 ..
text_mt: Human birth is exceedingly rare among all gods and asuras; / having attained it, one should recount tales so that one does not go to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
svargāpavargalābhāya yadi nāsti samudyataḥ ..
svargasya mūlaṃ mānuṣyaṃ tadyatnādanupālayet .. 191 ..
meaning:
स्वर्गापवर्गलाभाय यदि नास्ति समुद्यतः ..
स्वर्गस्य मूलं मानुष्यं तद्यत्नादनुपालयेत् .. 191 ..
text_mt: If one is not striving to attain heaven and final liberation, / [still,] human birth is the root of heaven: one should guard it with effort.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmamūlena mānuṣyaṃ labdhvā sarvārthasādhakam ..
yadi lābhe na yatnaste mūlaṃ rakṣasva yatnataḥ .. 192 ..
meaning:
धर्ममूलेन मानुष्यं लब्ध्वा सर्वार्थसाधकम् ..
यदि लाभे न यत्नस्ते मूलं रक्षस्व यत्नतः .. 192 ..
text_mt: Having obtained, by the capital of virtue, human birth which achieves all aims, / if you have no effort toward gain, guard the capital with care.

sanskrit_iast:
manuṣyatve ca vipratvaṃ yaḥ saṃprāpyātidurllabham ..
na karotyātmanaḥ śreyaḥ konyastasmādacetanaḥ .. 193 ..
meaning:
मनुष्यत्वे च विप्रत्वं यः संप्राप्यातिदुर्ल्लभम् ..
न करोत्यात्मनः श्रेयः कोन्यस्तस्मादचेतनः .. 193 ..
text_mt: And who is more senseless than he who, having attained / the exceedingly rare status of a brāhmaṇa within humanity, does not work for his own welfare?

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmeva deśānāṃ madhyadeśaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ ..
ataḥ svargaśca mokṣaśca yaśaḥ saṃprāpyate naraiḥ .. 194 ..
meaning:
सर्वेषामेव देशानां मध्यदेशः परः स्मृतः ..
अतः स्वर्गश्च मोक्षश्च यशः संप्राप्यते नरैः .. 194 ..
text_mt: Of all lands, the Middle Country is declared to be the best; / from here, heaven, liberation, and fame are attained by men.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminbhārate puṇye prāpya mānuṣyamadhruvam ..
yaḥkuryādātmanaḥ śreyastenātmā rakṣitaḥ svayam ..
yaḥ kuryānnātmanaḥ śreyastenātmā vaṃcitaḥ svayam .. 195 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्भारते पुण्ये प्राप्य मानुष्यमध्रुवम् ..
यःकुर्यादात्मनः श्रेयस्तेनात्मा रक्षितः स्वयम् ..
यः कुर्यान्नात्मनः श्रेयस्तेनात्मा वंचितः स्वयम् .. 195 ..
text_mt: Having attained unsteady human birth in this sacred Bhārata, / he who works for his own welfare has protected his self by himself; / he who does not work for his own welfare has deceived his self by himself.

sanskrit_iast:
bhogabhūmiḥ smṛtaḥ svargaḥ karmabhūmiriyaṃ matā ..
iha yatkriyate karma svarge tadupabhujyate .. 196 ..
meaning:
भोगभूमिः स्मृतः स्वर्गः कर्मभूमिरियं मता ..
इह यत्क्रियते कर्म स्वर्गे तदुपभुज्यते .. 196 ..
text_mt: Heaven is declared to be the land of enjoyment; this is considered the land of action; / whatever action is done here is enjoyed in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvatsvāsthyaṃ śarīrasya tāvaddharmaṃ samācara ..
asvasthaścātiyatnena na kiñcitkartumutsa het .. 197 ..
meaning:
यावत्स्वास्थ्यं शरीरस्य तावद्धर्मं समाचर ..
अस्वस्थश्चातियत्नेन न किञ्चित्कर्तुमुत्स हेत् .. 197 ..
text_mt: As long as there is health in the body, so long practice dharma; / when unwell, even with great effort, one is not able to do anything.

sanskrit_iast:
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa hyadhruvaṃ yaḥ prasādhayet ..
dhruvaṃ tasya paribhraṣṭamadhruvaṃ naṣṭameva ca .. 198 ..
meaning:
अध्रुवेण शरीरेण ह्यध्रुवं यः प्रसाधयेत् ..
ध्रुवं तस्य परिभ्रष्टमध्रुवं नष्टमेव च .. 198 ..
text_mt: He who would accomplish the impermanent with an impermanent body, / has lost the permanent, and the impermanent is simply perished for him.

sanskrit_iast:
āyuṣaḥ khaṃḍakhaḍāni nipataṃti tavā grataḥ ..
ahorātrāpadeśena kimarthaṃ nāvabudhyase .. 199 ..
meaning:
आयुषः खंडखडानि निपतंति तवा ग्रतः ..
अहोरात्रापदेशेन किमर्थं नावबुध्यसे .. 199 ..
text_mt: Pieces of your lifespan are falling away before you / under the guise of days and nights; why do you not understand?

sanskrit_iast:
yadā na jñāyate mṛtyuḥ kadā kasya bhaviṣyati ..
ākasmike hi maraṇe dhṛtiṃ viṃdeta kastadā .. 4.6.200 ..
meaning:
यदा न ज्ञायते मृत्युः कदा कस्य भविष्यति ..
आकस्मिके हि मरणे धृतिं विंदेत कस्तदा .. 4.6.200 ..
text_mt: When it is not known when death will occur for whom, / who, then, could find fortitude in sudden death?

sanskrit_iast:
parityajya yadā sarvamekākī yāsyasi dhuvam ..
na dadāsi tadā kasmātpātheyārthamidaṃ dhanam .. 201 ..
meaning:
परित्यज्य यदा सर्वमेकाकी यास्यसि धुवम् ..
न ददासि तदा कस्मात्पाथेयार्थमिदं धनम् .. 201 ..
text_mt: When you will certainly depart alone, having abandoned everything, / why do you not give this wealth as provisions for the journey?

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītadānapātheyā sukhaṃ yāṃti mahādhvani ..
anyathā kliśyate jaṃtuḥ pātheyarahitaḥ pathi .. 202 ..
meaning:
गृहीतदानपाथेया सुखं यांति महाध्वनि ..
अन्यथा क्लिश्यते जंतुः पाथेयरहितः पथि .. 202 ..
text_mt: Those who have taken the provisions of gifts travel happily along the great road; / otherwise, a creature travels along the path suffering, bereft of provisions.

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣāṃ dvijendravāhitrī pūrṇabhāṃḍā tu gacchati ..
svargadeśasya pura tasteṣāṃ lābhaḥ padepade..203..
meaning:
येषां द्विजेन्द्रवाहित्री पूर्णभांडा तु गच्छति ..
स्वर्गदेशस्य पुर तस्तेषां लाभः पदेपदे..203..
text_mt: Those whose full vessel is carried by an eminent brāhmaṇa / ahead to the realm of heaven have gain at every step.

sanskrit_iast:
iti jñātvā naraḥ puṇyaṃ kuryātpāpaṃ vivarjayet ..
puṇyena yāti devatvamapuṇyānnarakaṃ vrajet 204..
meaning:
इति ज्ञात्वा नरः पुण्यं कुर्यात्पापं विवर्जयेत् ..
पुण्येन याति देवत्वमपुण्यान्नरकं व्रजेत् 204..
text_mt: Knowing this, a man should practice merit and avoid sin; / through merit one goes to godhood; through demerit one goes to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
ye manāgapi deveśaṃ prapannāḥ śaraṇaṃ śivam..
tepi ghoraṃ na paśyaṃti yamasya vadanaṃ narāḥ..205..
meaning:
ये मनागपि देवेशं प्रपन्नाः शरणं शिवम्..
तेपि घोरं न पश्यंति यमस्य वदनं नराः..205..
text_mt: Those men who take refuge in the lord of gods, Śiva, even in the slightest degree, / do not look upon the terrible face of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ tu pāpairmahāghoraiḥ kiñcitkālaṃ śivājñayā.
.. bhavaṃti preta rājānastato yāṃti śivālayam.. 206..
meaning:
किं तु पापैर्महाघोरैः किञ्चित्कालं शिवाज्ञया.
.. भवंति प्रेत राजानस्ततो यांति शिवालयम्.. 206..
text_mt: However, due to exceedingly terrible sins, by the command of Śiva they become / kings of pretas for a little while, and from there go to the abode of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
ye punaḥ sarvabhāvena pratipannā maheśvaram ..
na te lipyaṃti pāpena padmapatramivāṃbhasā .. 207 ..
meaning:
ये पुनः सर्वभावेन प्रतिपन्ना महेश्वरम् ..
न ते लिप्यंति पापेन पद्मपत्रमिवांभसा .. 207 ..
text_mt: Those, on the other hand, who have surrendered to Maheśvara with their whole being / are not smeared by sin, just as a lotus leaf is not by water.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmā dvivardhayedbhaktimīśvare satataṃ budhaḥ ..
tanmāhātmyavicāreṇa bhavadoṣavirāgataḥ .. 208 ..
meaning:
तस्मा द्विवर्धयेद्भक्तिमीश्वरे सततं बुधः ..
तन्माहात्म्यविचारेण भवदोषविरागतः .. 208 ..
text_mt: Therefore, the wise man should constantly increase his devotion to the Lord, / by reflecting on His majesty and by detachment from the flaws of worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpāni paṃca paramārthatayaiva pārtha duḥkhapradāni suciraṃ pitṛ rājaloke ..
anyāni yāni cirakālabhayānakāni vaktuṃ na yāṃti kila tāni parisphuṭāni .. 209 ..
śakaṭavratamāhātmyavarṇanam
meaning:
पापानि पंच परमार्थतयैव पार्थ दुःखप्रदानि सुचिरं पितृ राजलोके ..
अन्यानि यानि चिरकालभयानकानि वक्तुं न यांति किल तानि परिस्फुटानि .. 209 ..
शकटव्रतमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
text_mt:
In ultimate truth, O Pārtha, the five sins bring sorrow for a very long time in the realm of the King of the Ancestors; / and the others that are terrifying for ages cannot indeed be fully described.
Description of the Greatness of the Cart Votive Observance

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
yadetatte samākhyātaṃ gaṃbhīraṃ narakārṇavama..
vratopavāsaniyamaplavenottīryate sukham .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
यदेतत्ते समाख्यातं गंभीरं नरकार्णवम..
व्रतोपवासनियमप्लवेनोत्तीर्यते सुखम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / That deep ocean of hell which has been described to you / is easily crossed by means of the raft of votive observances, fasts, and religious restraints.
title: adhyāyaḥ 007

sanskrit_iast:
durllabhaṃ prāpya mānuṣyaṃ vidyutpatanacañcalam ..
tathātmānaṃ samādadhyādbhraśyate na punaryathā .. 2 ..
meaning:
दुर्ल्लभं प्राप्य मानुष्यं विद्युत्पतनचञ्चलम् ..
तथात्मानं समादध्याद्भ्रश्यते न पुनर्यथा .. 2 ..
text_mt: Having obtained a human birth, which is rare to attain and fleeting as the flash of lightning, / one should compose oneself in such a way that one does not fall again.

sanskrit_iast:
dāna vratamayī kīrtiryasya syādiha dehinaḥ ..
paraloke'pi sa tayā jñāyate jñātivarddhanaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
दान व्रतमयी कीर्तिर्यस्य स्यादिह देहिनः ..
परलोकेऽपि स तया ज्ञायते ज्ञातिवर्द्धनः .. 3 ..
text_mt: The fame of an embodied being in this world consisting of gifts and votive observances— / by that he is recognized even in the next world as one who elevates his kin.

sanskrit_iast:
jñāyate neha nāmutra vratasvādhyāyavarjitaḥ ..
puruṣaḥ puruṣavyāghra tasmādvrataparo bhavet .. 4 ..
meaning:
ज्ञायते नेह नामुत्र व्रतस्वाध्यायवर्जितः ..
पुरुषः पुरुषव्याघ्र तस्माद्व्रतपरो भवेत् .. 4 ..
text_mt: A man devoid of votive observances and sacred study is recognized neither here nor in the hereafter, / O tiger among men; therefore one should be devoted to votive observances.

sanskrit_iast:
atra te kathayiṣyāmi itihāsaṃ purātanam ..
siddhena saha saṃvādamavaṃtyāṃ brāhmaṇasya hi .. 5 ..
meaning:
अत्र ते कथयिष्यामि इतिहासं पुरातनम् ..
सिद्धेन सह संवादमवंत्यां ब्राह्मणस्य हि .. 5 ..
text_mt: Here I shall relate to you an ancient story: / the dialogue of a brāhmaṇa with a siddha in Avanti.

sanskrit_iast:
yogarddhisiddhyā saṃsiddhaḥ kaścitsiddho mahītalam ..
cacāra vikṛtaṃ kṛtvā vapuḥ paramabhīṣaṇam .. 6 ..
meaning:
योगर्द्धिसिद्ध्या संसिद्धः कश्चित्सिद्धो महीतलम् ..
चचार विकृतं कृत्वा वपुः परमभीषणम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: A certain siddha, perfected by the attainment of yogic power, roamed the earth, / having assumed a deformed and extremely terrifying body.

sanskrit_iast:
nigīrṇadaṃto laṃboṣṭhaḥ piṃgākṣastanumūrddhajaḥ ..
truṭitaika karṇo durvaṇaḥ śīrṇavastro mahodaraḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
निगीर्णदंतो लंबोष्ठः पिंगाक्षस्तनुमूर्द्धजः ..
त्रुटितैक कर्णो दुर्वणः शीर्णवस्त्रो महोदरः .. 7 ..
text_mt: He had sunken teeth, pendulous lips, tawny eyes, sparse hair, / one severed ear, discoloured skin, ragged garments, and a large belly.

sanskrit_iast:
cipiṭākṣaḥ sphuṭitapājjaṃghāḍhyaḥ kṛśakūrparaḥ ..
diśaḥ paśyati saṃhṛṣṭo babhrāmodbhrāṃtacittavat .. 8 ..
meaning:
चिपिटाक्षः स्फुटितपाज्जंघाढ्यः कृशकूर्परः ..
दिशः पश्यति संहृष्टो बभ्रामोद्भ्रांतचित्तवत् .. 8 ..
text_mt: He had flat eyes, cracked feet, stout shanks, and emaciated elbows; / looking in all directions, he wandered about joyful like one whose mind is distracted.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlajālikavipreṇa dṛṣṭaḥ pṛṣṭaśca ko bhavān ..
kadā svargātsamāyātaḥ kena kāryeṇa me vada .. 9 ..
meaning:
मूलजालिकविप्रेण दृष्टः पृष्टश्च को भवान् ..
कदा स्वर्गात्समायातः केन कार्येण मे वद .. 9 ..
text_mt: He was seen by a brāhmaṇa who lived on root-fibres and asked, 'Who are you? / When did you come from heaven, and on what business? Tell me.

sanskrit_iast:
kacciddṛṣṭā tvayā raṃbhā bhābhāsitadigaṃtarā ..
cittasaṃmohanakarī devānāmekasundarī .. 10 ..
meaning:
कच्चिद्दृष्टा त्वया रंभा भाभासितदिगंतरा ..
चित्तसंमोहनकरी देवानामेकसुन्दरी .. 10 ..
text_mt: Have you seen Rambhā, who illumines the directions with her splendour, / who enchants the heart, the unique beauty among the gods?

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā madvacanādvācyā nirvācyā doṣadarśibhiḥ ..
āvaṃtyastvāṃ kuśalinīṃ pṛcchati sma dvijo ttamaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
गत्वा मद्वचनाद्वाच्या निर्वाच्या दोषदर्शिभिः ..
आवंत्यस्त्वां कुशलिनीं पृच्छति स्म द्विजो त्तमः .. 11 ..
text_mt: Having gone there, she, who is beyond censure by fault-finders, is to be spoken to on my behalf: / "An excellent brāhmaṇa of Avanti asks after your welfare."'

sanskrit_iast:
siddhaḥ prasiddhaṃ taṃ vipraṃ prāhedaṃ vismayānvitaḥ ..
kathaṃ tvayāhaṃ vijñātaḥ svargādabhyāgataḥ sphuṭam .. 12 ..
meaning:
सिद्धः प्रसिद्धं तं विप्रं प्राहेदं विस्मयान्वितः ..
कथं त्वयाहं विज्ञातः स्वर्गादभ्यागतः स्फुटम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Filled with wonder, the siddha said to that renowned brāhmaṇa: / 'How was I recognized by you as clearly having arrived from heaven?'

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇastamathovāca vijñāto'si mayā yathā ..
tathā te'haṃ pravakṣyāmi kṣīṇāghaughāvadhāraya .. 13 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणस्तमथोवाच विज्ञातोऽसि मया यथा ..
तथा तेऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि क्षीणाघौघावधारय .. 13 ..
text_mt: Then the brāhmaṇa said to him: 'How you were recognized by me, / that I shall declare to you; listen, O you whose heap of sins has dwindled!

sanskrit_iast:
gātratrayaṃ virūpaṃ syāddvitīyaṃ vā svarūpataḥ..
dṛṣṭvā sarvāṃga vairūpyaṃ vijñāto'si tato mayā .. 14 ..
meaning:
गात्रत्रयं विरूपं स्याद्द्वितीयं वा स्वरूपतः..
दृष्ट्वा सर्वांग वैरूप्यं विज्ञातोऽसि ततो मया .. 14 ..
text_mt: Three limbs might be deformed, or a second, by nature; / but having seen the deformity of all your limbs, you were thereby recognized by me.

sanskrit_iast:
durllaṃghyā prakṛtiḥ sākṣādanubhūtakarī bhavet ..
prakṛteranyathābhāvaḥ sarvathā lakṣyate janaiḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
दुर्ल्लंघ्या प्रकृतिः साक्षादनुभूतकरी भवेत् ..
प्रकृतेरन्यथाभावः सर्वथा लक्ष्यते जनैः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Inborn nature is difficult to surmount, producing palpable experience; / any alteration of inborn nature is perceived in every way by men.'

sanskrit_iast:
viprasyaivaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā jagāmādarśanaṃ śanaiḥ ..
punaḥ kaiścidahorātrairājagāma sa tāṃ purīm .. 16 ..
meaning:
विप्रस्यैवं वचः श्रुत्वा जगामादर्शनं शनैः ..
पुनः कैश्चिदहोरात्रैराजगाम स तां पुरीम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: Hearing the brāhmaṇa's words, he vanished slowly. / Then, after some days and nights, he came again to that city.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlajālakavipreṇa pṛṣṭaḥ prāhāmarāvatīm ..
gato'haṃ pṛṣṭavāṃstatra raṃbhāṃ vibhramakāriṇīm .. 17 ..
meaning:
मूलजालकविप्रेण पृष्टः प्राहामरावतीम् ..
गतोऽहं पृष्टवांस्तत्र रंभां विभ्रमकारिणीम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: Questioned by the brāhmaṇa who lived on root-fibres, he said: 'I went to Amarāvatī; / there I questioned the wanton Rambhā.

sanskrit_iast:
śakrasyāvasare vṛtte vrajantyāḥ svagṛhaṃ mayā ..
tvatsaṃdeśaḥ samākhyātaḥ sāvadatko na vedmi tam ..18..
meaning:
शक्रस्यावसरे वृत्ते व्रजन्त्याः स्वगृहं मया ..
त्वत्संदेशः समाख्यातः सावदत्को न वेद्मि तम् ..18..
text_mt: When Śakra's court was concluded, as she was going to her own abode, / your message was related by me. She said: "Who is he? I do not know him.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyayā kalayā cāpi pauruṣeṇa vratena ca ..
tapasā vā pumānmartyo divi vijñāyate ciram .. 19 ..
meaning:
विद्यया कलया चापि पौरुषेण व्रतेन च ..
तपसा वा पुमान्मर्त्यो दिवि विज्ञायते चिरम् .. 19 ..

text_mt:
One attains the splendour of kingship in the world to be enjoyed by all people, and the abode of Śakra, Śiva, and Keśava; / nothing is unobtainable in the world for those of very firm votive observances; therefore a man should always be devoted to votive observances.
Thus ends the seventh chapter, titled "The Description of the Greatness of the Cart-Observance", in the dialogue between Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Yudhiṣṭhira, in the Uttaraparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.

text_mt: Having uttered this, endowed with faith, one should then offer the arghya, / having adorned [the tree] with banners and covered it with an auspicious garment.

sanskrit_iast:
damayantī yathā svāhā yathā vedavatī satī ..
tathāśokavratādasmājjāyate pativallabhā .. .. 6 ..

तथाशोकव्रतादस्माज्जायते पतिवल्लभा .. .. 6 ..

dīpālaṃkṛtanaivedyadhūpasūtraphalārccanaiḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा समीपे भर्तारं देवरं च तिलाक्षतैः ..
दीपालंकृतनैवेद्यधूपसूत्रफलार्च्चनैः .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yayāce taṃ mahābhāgā drumaṃ satyopayācanam ..

guṇakairghaṭakairdivyairnālikeraiḥ suśobhanaiḥ ..

meaning:

मौलिमंडनसद्रत्न नमस्ते केशवेशयोः .. 4 ..

text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / In former times, on the bank of the Yamunā, there was an auspicious city named Mathurā. / In it was a king named Śatrughna, established by Rāma.

.. श्रीवशिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
आषाढपूर्णिमायां तु संध्याकाले ह्युपस्थिते ..
संकल्पयेन्मासमेकं श्रावणे श्वःप्रभृत्यहम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Śrī Vaśiṣṭha said: / On the full moon day of Āṣāḍha, when twilight has arrived, / one should make the formal resolution: 'From tomorrow, in Śrāvaṇa, for one month, I,

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ kariṣye niyatā brahmacaryasthitā satī ..
bhokṣyāmi naktaṃ bhūśayyāṃ kariṣye prāṇināṃ dayām .. 7 ..
meaning:
स्नानं करिष्ये नियता ब्रह्मचर्यस्थिता सती ..
भोक्ष्यामि नक्तं भूशय्यां करिष्ये प्राणिनां दयाम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: restrained and abiding in celibacy as a chaste wife, will bathe, / eat a nocturnal meal, sleep on the ground, and practice compassion toward living beings.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti saṃkalpya puruṣo nārī vā brāhmaṇāṃtike ..
prāpyānujñāṃ tataḥ prātaḥ sarvasāmagrisaṃyutaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
इति संकल्प्य पुरुषो नारी वा ब्राह्मणांतिके ..
प्राप्यानुज्ञां ततः प्रातः सर्वसामग्रिसंयुतः .. 8 ..
text_mt: Having thus made the formal resolution in the presence of a brāhmaṇa, whether a man or a woman, / and having received his permission, then in the morning, equipped with all necessary materials,

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣaḥ pratipatkālāddantadhāvanapūrvakam ..
nadyāṃ gatvā tathā vāpyāṃ taḍāge girinirjhare .. 9 ..
meaning:
पुरुषः प्रतिपत्कालाद्दन्तधावनपूर्वकम् ..
नद्यां गत्वा तथा वाप्यां तडागे गिरिनिर्झरे .. 9 ..
text_mt: the person, beginning from the first lunar day, after first cleaning the teeth, / having gone to a river, a stepwell, a pond, or a mountain torrent,

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ kuryādvratī pārtha sugandhāmalakaistilaiḥ ..
dināṣṭakaṃ tathā paścātsarvauṣadhyā punaḥ pṛthak .. 4.11.10 ..
meaning:
स्नानं कुर्याद्व्रती पार्थ सुगन्धामलकैस्तिलैः ..
दिनाष्टकं तथा पश्चात्सर्वौषध्या पुनः पृथक् .. 4.11.10 ..
text_mt: the practitioner of the votive observance, O son of Pṛthā, should bathe with fragrant āmalaka and sesame / for eight days; then, subsequently, with all-herbs separately;

sanskrit_iast:
vacayāṣṭau punaḥ piṣṭvā śiroruhavimardanam ..
snātvā dhyātvā raviṃ caiva vaṃditvā ca pitṝnatha .. 11 ..
meaning:
वचयाष्टौ पुनः पिष्ट्वा शिरोरुहविमर्दनम् ..
स्नात्वा ध्यात्वा रविं चैव वंदित्वा च पितॄनथ .. 11 ..
text_mt: again for eight days, having ground vacā, rubbing it into the hair; / having bathed, meditated on the Sun, and revered the ancestors;

sanskrit_iast:
tarpayitvā tilāpiṣṭaiḥ kokilāṃ pakṣirūpiṇīm ..
kalakaṇṭhīṃ śubhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayeccaṃpakodbhavaiḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
तर्पयित्वा तिलापिष्टैः कोकिलां पक्षिरूपिणीम् ..
कलकण्ठीं शुभैः पुष्पैः पूजयेच्चंपकोद्भवैः .. 12 ..
text_mt: and having made libations with sesame flour, one should worship the cuckoo in the form of a bird, / sweet-throated, with auspicious campaka flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
patrairvā dhūpanaivedyadīpālaktakacaṃdanaiḥ ..
tila tanduladūrvāgraiḥ pūjayitvā kṣamāpayet ..
nityaṃ tilavratī bhakto maṃtreṇānena pāṃḍava .. 13 ..
meaning:
पत्रैर्वा धूपनैवेद्यदीपालक्तकचंदनैः ..
तिल तन्दुलदूर्वाग्रैः पूजयित्वा क्षमापयेत् ..
नित्यं तिलव्रती भक्तो मंत्रेणानेन पांडव .. 13 ..
text_mt: or with leaves, incense, food offerings, lamps, red lac, and sandal, / and with sesame, rice grains, and dūrvā tips; and, asking for forgiveness, / the devoted practitioner of the sesame votive observance should worship daily with this mantra, O son of Pāṇḍu:

sanskrit_iast:
tilasahe tilasaukhye tilavarṇe tilapriye ..
saubhāgyaṃ dravyaputrāṃśca dehi me kokile namaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
तिलसहे तिलसौख्ये तिलवर्णे तिलप्रिये ..
सौभाग्यं द्रव्यपुत्रांश्च देहि मे कोकिले नमः .. 14 ..
text_mt: "O you who endure sesame, who find joy in sesame, who have the colour of sesame, who love sesame! / Grant me good fortune, wealth, and sons. Homage to you, O cuckoo!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuccārya tataḥ paścādgṛhamabhyetya saṃyataḥ ..
kṛtvāhāraṃ svapetpārtha yāvanmāsaḥ samāpnute ..15..
meaning:
इत्युच्चार्य ततः पश्चाद्गृहमभ्येत्य संयतः ..
कृत्वाहारं स्वपेत्पार्थ यावन्मासः समाप्नुते ..15..
text_mt: Having uttered this, then afterwards returning home with self-restraint, / having taken food, one should sleep, O son of Pṛthā, until the month is complete.

sanskrit_iast:
māsāṃte tāmrapātryāṃ tu kokilāṃ tilapiṣṭajām ..
ratnanetrāṃ svarṇapakṣāṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet.. 16 ..
meaning:
मासांते ताम्रपात्र्यां तु कोकिलां तिलपिष्टजाम् ..
रत्ननेत्रां स्वर्णपक्षां ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत्.. 16 ..
text_mt: At the end of the month, one should present to a brāhmaṇa on a copper plate / a cuckoo made of sesame paste, with jewel eyes and golden wings,

sanskrit_iast:
vastrairddhanairguḍairyuktāṃ śrāvaṇyāṃ kuṃḍale'tha vā ..
śvaśrūśvaśuravarge vā daivajñe vā purohite ..
vyāse vā saṃpradātavyā vratibhiḥ śubhakāmyayā ..17..
meaning:
वस्त्रैर्द्धनैर्गुडैर्युक्तां श्रावण्यां कुंडलेऽथ वा ..
श्वश्रूश्वशुरवर्गे वा दैवज्ञे वा पुरोहिते ..
व्यासे वा संप्रदातव्या व्रतिभिः शुभकाम्यया ..17..
text_mt: provided with garments, wealth, and jaggery, or earrings, on the full moon of Śrāvaṇa; / or it should be given by practitioners of the votive observance desiring welfare / to mothers-in-law and fathers-in-law, or an astrologer, or the family priest, or a reciter of the Purāṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yā kurute nārī kokilāvratamādarāt ..
sapta janmāni saubhāgyaṃ sā prāpnoti suvistaram .. 18 ..
meaning:
एवं या कुरुते नारी कोकिलाव्रतमादरात् ..
सप्त जन्मानि सौभाग्यं सा प्राप्नोति सुविस्तरम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: Whatever woman performs the Kokilā votive observance in this manner with reverence / attains extensive good fortune for seven births.

sanskrit_iast:
niḥsāpatnyaṃ patiṃ bhavyaṃ sasnehaṃ prāpya bhūtale ..
mṛtā gaurīpuraṃ yāti vimānenārkavarcasā .. 19 ..
meaning:
निःसापत्न्यं पतिं भव्यं सस्नेहं प्राप्य भूतले ..
मृता गौरीपुरं याति विमानेनार्कवर्चसा .. 19 ..
text_mt: Having obtained on earth a splendid, affectionate husband free from rival wives, / upon dying she goes to the city of Gaurī in a celestial chariot shining like the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
etadvrataṃ vaśiṣṭhena muninā kathitaṃ purā ..
tathā cānuṣṭhitaṃ pārtha samastaṃ kīrtimālayā .. 4.11.20 ..
meaning:
एतद्व्रतं वशिष्ठेन मुनिना कथितं पुरा ..
तथा चानुष्ठितं पार्थ समस्तं कीर्तिमालया .. 4.11.20 ..
text_mt: This votive observance was spoken of old by the sage Vaśiṣṭha, / and was performed entirely, O son of Pṛthā, by Kīrtimālā.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāśca sarvaṃ saṃpannaṃ vaśiṣṭhavacanādiha ..
putrasaubhāgyasaṃmānaṃ śatrughnasya prasādajam.. 21 ..
meaning:
तस्याश्च सर्वं संपन्नं वशिष्ठवचनादिह ..
पुत्रसौभाग्यसंमानं शत्रुघ्नस्य प्रसादजम्.. 21 ..
text_mt: And everything was accomplished for her in this world from the words of Vaśiṣṭha: / sons, good fortune, and honour, born of the grace of Śatrughna.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yānyāpi kauṃteya kokilāvratamādarāt ..
kariṣyati dhruvaṃ tasyāḥ saubhāgyaṃ ca bhaviṣyati ..22..

करिष्यति ध्रुवं तस्याः सौभाग्यं च भविष्यति ..22..

sanskrit_iast:
ye kokilāṃ kalaravāṃ kalakaṃṭhapīṭhāṃ yacchaṃti sājyatilapiṣṭamayīṃ dvijebhyaḥ ..

bṛhattapovratavarṇanam

ते नंदनादिषु वनेषु विहृत्य कामं मर्त्ये समेत्य मधुरध्वनयो भवंति .. 23 .. ..
बृहत्तपोव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Those who give to the twice-born a cuckoo with sweet notes and an alluring throat, / made of sesame paste mixed with ghee, / sport at will in the Nandana and other celestial groves, and coming to the mortal world, they become possessed of sweet voices.
Description of the Great Austerity Votive Observance

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca.. ..
atha pāpāpahaṃ vakṣye bṛhadvratamanuttamam ..
surāsuramunīnāṃ ca durllabhaṃ vidhinā śṛṇu ..1..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच.. ..
