सुरासुरमुनीनां च दुर्ल्लभं विधिना शृणु ..1..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Now I shall declare the great, unsurpassed votive observance that removes sin, / difficult to obtain even for gods, asuras, and sages; listen to it with its rules.
title: Vṛhattapovratavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
parvaṇyāśvayujasyāṃte pāyasaṃ ghṛta saṃyutam ..
naktaṃ bhuñjīta śuddhātmā odanaṃ vaikṣavānvitam .. 2 ..
meaning:
पर्वण्याश्वयुजस्यांते पायसं घृत संयुतम् ..
नक्तं भुञ्जीत शुद्धात्मा ओदनं वैक्षवान्वितम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: At the full moon at the end of Āśvayuja, with a pure mind, / one should eat as a nocturnal meal milk rice accompanied by ghee, or boiled rice mixed with sugarcane juice.

sanskrit_iast:
ācamyātha śucirbhūtvā bilvajaṃ daṃtadhāvanam ..
bhakṣayitvā mahādevaṃ praṇamyedamudīrayet .. 3 ..
meaning:
आचम्याथ शुचिर्भूत्वा बिल्वजं दंतधावनम् ..
भक्षयित्वा महादेवं प्रणम्येदमुदीरयेत् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Then, having sipped water and become pure, having chewed / a tooth-cleaning twig born of the bilva tree, and having bowed to Mahādeva, one should declare this:

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ devavratamidaṃ kartumicchāmi śāśvatam ..
tavājñayā mahādeva yathā nirvahate kuru ..4..
meaning:
अहं देवव्रतमिदं कर्तुमिच्छामि शाश्वतम् ..
तवाज्ञया महादेव यथा निर्वहते कुरु ..4..
text_mt: "I desire to perform this eternal votive observance of the god. / By your command, O Mahādeva, act so that it is carried out successfully."

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ niyamaṃ kṛtvā yāvadvarṣāṇi ṣoḍaśa ..
tithayaḥ pratipatpūrvāṃ bhajiṣyāmītyanukramāt .. 5 ..
meaning:
इत्येवं नियमं कृत्वा यावद्वर्षाणि षोडश ..
तिथयः प्रतिपत्पूर्वां भजिष्यामीत्यनुक्रमात् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Having thus made a restriction: 'For sixteen years / I will attend upon the lunar days in succession, beginning with the first lunar day;'

sanskrit_iast:
tato mārgaśire māsi pratipadyapare'hani ..
pṛṣṭvā guruṃ copavāsaṃ mahādevaṃ smaranmuhuḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
ततो मार्गशिरे मासि प्रतिपद्यपरेऽहनि ..
पृष्ट्वा गुरुं चोपवासं महादेवं स्मरन्मुहुः .. 6 ..
text_mt: then, in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, on the first lunar day of the other fortnight, / having asked the guru about the fast, remembering Mahādeva repeatedly,

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā devaṃ samabhyarcya rātrau prajvālya dīpakān ..
yamunāṃ ca mahādevaṃ natvā paścānnimaṃtrayet .. 7 ..
meaning:
स्नात्वा देवं समभ्यर्च्य रात्रौ प्रज्वाल्य दीपकान् ..
यमुनां च महादेवं नत्वा पश्चान्निमंत्रयेत् .. 7 ..
text_mt: having bathed, worshipped the god, and kindled lamps at night, / and having bowed to the Yamunā and Mahādeva, one should then invite

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevaratānviprānsapatnīkānyatavratān ..
ṣoḍaśāṣṭau tadardhaṃ vā ekaṃ vā śaktyapekṣayā .. 8 ..
meaning:
महादेवरतान्विप्रान्सपत्नीकान्यतव्रतान् ..
षोडशाष्टौ तदर्धं वा एकं वा शक्त्यपेक्षया .. 8 ..
text_mt: brāhmaṇas devoted to Mahādeva, accompanied by their wives and firm in their vows, / sixteen, eight, or half of that, or one, according to one's capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
āmaṃtrya svagṛhaṃ gatvā mahādevaṃ smarankṣitau ..
śucivastrāstṛtāyāṃ tu nirāhāro niśi svapeta .. 9 ..
meaning:
आमंत्र्य स्वगृहं गत्वा महादेवं स्मरन्क्षितौ ..
शुचिवस्त्रास्तृतायां तु निराहारो निशि स्वपेत .. 9 ..
text_mt: Having invited them and gone to one's house, remembering Mahādeva, / one should sleep at night without food on the ground spread with a clean cloth.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāskarodayamāsādya snātvā cādāya dīpakān ..
naivedyaṃ snapanaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ gaccheṣchivālaye ..4.12.10..
meaning:
भास्करोदयमासाद्य स्नात्वा चादाय दीपकान् ..
नैवेद्यं स्नपनं पुष्पं धूपं गच्छेष्छिवालये ..4.12.10..
text_mt: When the sun rises, having bathed and taken lamps, / a food offering, ablution water, flowers, and incense, one should go to a temple of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
abhyaṃgayitvā deveśaṃ kaṣāyaiśca virūkṣayet ..
snapayetpañcagavyena payasā tadanaṃtaram .. 11 ..
meaning:
अभ्यंगयित्वा देवेशं कषायैश्च विरूक्षयेत् ..
स्नपयेत्पञ्चगव्येन पयसा तदनंतरम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Having anointed the lord of gods with oil, one should dry him with astringents; / one should bathe him with pañcagavya, and immediately afterwards with milk;

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtena madhunā dadhnā rasena payasā punaḥ ..
tilāṃbunā tataḥ snāpya snāpayeduṣṇavā riṇā .. 12 ..
meaning:
घृतेन मधुना दध्ना रसेन पयसा पुनः ..
तिलांबुना ततः स्नाप्य स्नापयेदुष्णवा रिणा .. 12 ..
text_mt: with ghee, honey, curd, sugarcane juice, and again with milk; / then, having bathed him with sesame water, one should bathe him with warm water.

sanskrit_iast:
lepayetsughanaṃ paścātkarpūrāgarucaṃdanaiḥ ..
puṣpaiḥ saṃpūjya dātavyaṃ haimaṃ śirasi paṃkajam .. 13 ..
meaning:
लेपयेत्सुघनं पश्चात्कर्पूरागरुचंदनैः ..
पुष्पैः संपूज्य दातव्यं हैमं शिरसि पंकजम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Afterwards, one should thickly smear [the deity] with camphor, agallochum, and sandalwood paste. / Having worshipped with flowers, a golden lotus should be placed upon the head.

sanskrit_iast:
vastrayugmaṃ patākāṃ ca pañcavarṇaṃ vitānakam..
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca ghaṃṭāñca dadyāddevasya śaktitaḥ ..14..
meaning:
वस्त्रयुग्मं पताकां च पञ्चवर्णं वितानकम्..
धूपं दीपं च घंटाञ्च दद्याद्देवस्य शक्तितः ..14..
text_mt: A pair of garments, a banner, and a five-coloured canopy, / incense, a lamp, and a bell, one should present to the god according to one's capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
paścānnivedya naivedyaṃ stutvā svabhavanaṃ vrajet..
susamiddhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pūjayejjātavedasam ..15..
meaning:
पश्चान्निवेद्य नैवेद्यं स्तुत्वा स्वभवनं व्रजेत्..
सुसमिद्धं ततः कृत्वा पूजयेज्जातवेदसम् ..15..
text_mt: Then, having offered food-offerings and chanted praises, he should go to his own abode. / Having then made [the sacred fire] well-kindled, he should worship Jātavedas.

sanskrit_iast:
vratinaśca tathācāryaṃ bhojayenmithunāni ca ..
hemavastrādidānena yathāśakti kṣamāpayet .. 16 ..
meaning:
व्रतिनश्च तथाचार्यं भोजयेन्मिथुनानि च ..
हेमवस्त्रादिदानेन यथाशक्ति क्षमापयेत् .. 16 ..
text_mt: He should feed the vow-observers, likewise the teacher, and married couples. / By giving gold, garments, and other gifts, he should ask their forgiveness according to his capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ visṛjya tānsarvānsārddhaṃ baṃdhujanaiḥ svayam ..
āśayitvā pañcagavyaṃ hṛṣṭo bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
एवं विसृज्य तान्सर्वान्सार्द्धं बंधुजनैः स्वयम् ..
आशयित्वा पञ्चगव्यं हृष्टो भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Having thus dismissed all of them, he himself, along with his kinsmen, / having first consumed the five products of the cow, should eat in joy, restrained in speech.

sanskrit_iast:
evameva vidhiṃ kṛtvā prārabhetādhano dhanī ..
vittasāmarthyataścaiva pratimāsaṃ ca kṛtsnaśaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
एवमेव विधिं कृत्वा प्रारभेताधनो धनी ..
वित्तसामर्थ्यतश्चैव प्रतिमासं च कृत्स्नशः .. 18 ..
text_mt: Having performed this very rite, whether poor or wealthy, / according to the extent of his wealth, he should undertake it in full each month.

sanskrit_iast:
vittahīno yathā kaścicchraddhayā ca punaḥpunaḥ ..
puṣpārcanavidhānena sarvametatsamācaret .. 19 ..
meaning:
वित्तहीनो यथा कश्चिच्छ्रद्धया च पुनःपुनः ..
पुष्पार्चनविधानेन सर्वमेतत्समाचरेत् .. 19 ..
text_mt: Even if someone is destitute of wealth, with faith again and again / by means of the ritual of flower-worship he should perform all of this.

sanskrit_iast:
pratimāsamupoṣyaivaṃ prati patkārttikāvadhau ..
pārayettaṃ hutaṃ pārtha prāraṃbhavidhinā sphuṭam .. 4.12.20 ..
meaning:
प्रतिमासमुपोष्यैवं प्रति पत्कार्त्तिकावधौ ..
पारयेत्तं हुतं पार्थ प्रारंभविधिना स्फुटम् .. 4.12.20 ..
text_mt: Fasting thus each month on the pratipad until Kārttika, / one should break that fast [after] offering oblations, O son of Pṛthā, clearly according to the rules of commencement.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye dve pañcadaśyāṃ kṛtvā naktaṃ narādhipaḥ ..
pratipatsa dvitīyā cettasyāmupavasetsudhīḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
द्वितीये द्वे पञ्चदश्यां कृत्वा नक्तं नराधिपः ..
प्रतिपत्स द्वितीया चेत्तस्यामुपवसेत्सुधीः .. 21 ..
text_mt: In the second [year], having eaten a nocturnal meal on two fifteenth [tithis], the king— / if the pratipad is joined with the dvitīyā, the wise man should fast upon it.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyopavasecchuklā tataḥ prabhṛti vatsaram ..
prāraṃbhavidhinā caivaṃ dvitīyāmapi pārayet .. 22 ..
meaning:
द्वितीयोपवसेच्छुक्ला ततः प्रभृति वत्सरम् ..
प्रारंभविधिना चैवं द्वितीयामपि पारयेत् .. 22 ..
text_mt: From then on he should fast on the bright dvitīyā for a year; / and following the rules of commencement he should thus break the fast on the dvitīyā as well.

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsadvayaṃ kṛtvā tṛtīyāṃ prārabhettataḥ ..
anena kramayogena yāvadvarṣaṃ samāpyate .. 23 ..
meaning:
उपवासद्वयं कृत्वा तृतीयां प्रारभेत्ततः ..
अनेन क्रमयोगेन यावद्वर्षं समाप्यते .. 23 ..
text_mt: Having kept two fasts, he should then commence the tṛtīyā; / through this order of progression, until the year is completed.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvaivaṃ ṣoḍaśe varṣe pūrṇamāsyāṃ samudyataḥ ..
pūrvavaddevamabhyarcya kṛśānuṃ vābhitarpya ca .. 24 ..
meaning:
कृत्वैवं षोडशे वर्षे पूर्णमास्यां समुद्यतः ..
पूर्ववद्देवमभ्यर्च्य कृशानुं वाभितर्प्य च .. 24 ..
text_mt: Having done this, in the sixteenth year, zealous on the full-moon day, / having worshipped the god as before or having gratified the fire,

sanskrit_iast:
hemaśṛṃgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ saghaṃṭāṃ kāṃsyadohanām ..
mahādevāya gāṃ dadyāddīkṣitāya dvijāya vai .. 25 ..
meaning:
हेमशृंगीं रौप्यखुरां सघंटां कांस्यदोहनाम् ..
महादेवाय गां दद्याद्दीक्षिताय द्विजाय वै .. 25 ..
text_mt: one should bestow upon an initiated brāhmaṇa, for Mahādeva, a cow / with golden horns, silver hooves, a bell, and a bronze milking vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
śivabhaktiratānviprānviśuddhāṃścaiva ṣoḍaśa ..
vastrābharaṇadānaiśca śaktyā saṃpūjayedvratī .. 26 ..
meaning:
शिवभक्तिरतान्विप्रान्विशुद्धांश्चैव षोडश ..
वस्त्राभरणदानैश्च शक्त्या संपूजयेद्व्रती .. 26 ..
text_mt: The vow-observer should worship sixteen pure brāhmaṇas devoted to the worship of Śiva, / according to his capacity, with gifts of garments and ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāṃśca yathāśaktyā bhojayedaparānapi ..
anyeṣāṃ ca kṣudhārtānāṃ dadyāddānaṃ yathecchayā .. 27 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणांश्च यथाशक्त्या भोजयेदपरानपि ..
अन्येषां च क्षुधार्तानां दद्याद्दानं यथेच्छया .. 27 ..
text_mt: And he should feed other brāhmaṇas as well according to his capacity; / and to others afflicted with hunger he should give gifts as he pleases.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhattapovrataṃ caiva brahmaghnādyaghaśoṣaṇam ..
bhūrbhuvādiṣu lokeṣu bhūribhogapradaṃ nṛṇām .. 28 ..
meaning:
बृहत्तपोव्रतं चैव ब्रह्मघ्नाद्यघशोषणम् ..
भूर्भुवादिषु लोकेषु भूरिभोगप्रदं नृणाम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: This Bṛhattapovrata dries up sins such as the slaying of a brāhmaṇa, / and bestows abundant enjoyments upon men in the worlds of Bhūr, Bhuvas, and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ svargasopānavatsthitam ..
na kuryādyo dhanaṃ prāpya sa muṣṭo naṣṭacetanaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
चतुर्णामपि वर्णानां स्वर्गसोपानवत्स्थितम् ..
न कुर्याद्यो धनं प्राप्य स मुष्टो नष्टचेतनः .. 29 ..
text_mt: It stands like a stairway to heaven for all four classes. / Whoever has acquired wealth and does not perform it is cheated and bereft of sense.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyamāyuḥpradaṃ puṇyaṃ rūpasaubhāgyavarddhanam ..
strīpuṃsayośca nirdiṣṭaṃ vratametatpurātanam .. 4.12.30 ..
meaning:
धन्यमायुःप्रदं पुण्यं रूपसौभाग्यवर्द्धनम् ..
स्त्रीपुंसयोश्च निर्दिष्टं व्रतमेतत्पुरातनम् .. 4.12.30 ..
text_mt: This ancient votive observance is declared for both women and men; / it brings prosperity, bestows long life, is meritorious, and increases beauty and fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhavayāpi kartavyaṃ bhūyo'vaidhavyahetave ..
sadhavayāpi kartavyamaviyogāya sadvratam .. 31 ..
meaning:
विधवयापि कर्तव्यं भूयोऽवैधव्यहेतवे ..
सधवयापि कर्तव्यमवियोगाय सद्व्रतम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: It should be performed even by a widow so that she may not become a widow again; / it should also be performed by a woman whose husband is alive, for the sake of non-separation.

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣya pratimāsaṃ tu bhuṃjīta brāhmaṇaiḥ saha ..
ekadvitricaturbhirvā svaśaktyā pāṃḍunaṃdana .. 32 ..
meaning:
उपोष्य प्रतिमासं तु भुंजीत ब्राह्मणैः सह ..
एकद्वित्रिचतुर्भिर्वा स्वशक्त्या पांडुनंदन .. 32 ..
text_mt: Having fasted each month, one should eat together with brāhmaṇas— / with one, two, three, or four, according to one's capacity, O son of Pāṇḍu.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃte cāṃte suvarṇānāṃ prāraṃbhavidhinācaret ..
puṇyasaṃbhāramanvicchangamayitvā śivālayam .. 33 ..
meaning:
अंते चांते सुवर्णानां प्रारंभविधिनाचरेत् ..
पुण्यसंभारमन्विच्छन्गमयित्वा शिवालयम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: At the very end, seeking an accumulation of merit, / having gone to a temple of Śiva, one should perform [the rite] with pieces of gold according to the rules of commencement.

sanskrit_iast:
vratavighne mahārāja jāte daivātkathaṃcana ..
tāvatyastithayaścānyāḥ samupoṣyāḥ samāptaye.. .. 34 ..
meaning:
व्रतविघ्ने महाराज जाते दैवात्कथंचन ..
तावत्यस्तिथयश्चान्याः समुपोष्याः समाप्तये.. .. 34 ..
text_mt: If by chance some obstacle arises in the votive observance, O great king, / that many other lunar days should be fasted upon for its completion.

sanskrit_iast:
atha śīghrataraṃ kaścidvrataṃ kartuṃ samudyataḥ ..
vidhinānena rājendra tena grāhyaṃ tithidvayam .. 35 ..
meaning:
अथ शीघ्रतरं कश्चिद्व्रतं कर्तुं समुद्यतः ..
विधिनानेन राजेन्द्र तेन ग्राह्यं तिथिद्वयम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: If someone is prepared to perform the votive observance more quickly, / O king of kings, he should undertake two lunar days according to this rule.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃte cāṃte ca varṣāṇāṃ prāraṃbhavidhinā ca ret ..
athārabdhe vrate kaścidasamāpte mriyeta cet .. 36 ..
meaning:
अंते चांते च वर्षाणां प्रारंभविधिना च रेत् ..
अथारब्धे व्रते कश्चिदसमाप्ते म्रियेत चेत् .. 36 ..
text_mt: At the end of the years he should perform it according to the rules of commencement. / If someone dies after beginning the votive observance while it is still unfinished,

sanskrit_iast:
so'pi tatphalamāpnoti satyāraṃbhaprabhāvataḥ ..
vācakāḥ śrāvakāścaiva vratasyāsya yudhiṣṭhira..
bhavaṃti putrasaṃśliṣṭāḥ śivadhyānānubhāvataḥ ..37..
meaning:
सोऽपि तत्फलमाप्नोति सत्यारंभप्रभावतः ..
वाचकाः श्रावकाश्चैव व्रतस्यास्य युधिष्ठिर..
भवंति पुत्रसंश्लिष्टाः शिवध्यानानुभावतः ..37..
text_mt: even he attains its fruit through the power of a true commencement. / The reciters and the listeners of this votive observance, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / become embraced by sons through the power of meditating on Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyaṃ bṛhattapa idaṃ vratamādarādye kurvaṃti ṣoḍaśasamā niratāḥ svadharme ..
te bhānumaṃḍalamabhedyamaciṃtyamādyaṃ bhittvā prayānti śaśiśekharapādamūlam .. 38 ..
bhadropavāsavratavarṇanam
meaning:
पुण्यं बृहत्तप इदं व्रतमादराद्ये कुर्वंति षोडशसमा निरताः स्वधर्मे ..
ते भानुमंडलमभेद्यमचिंत्यमाद्यं भित्त्वा प्रयान्ति शशिशेखरपादमूलम् .. 38 ..
भद्रोपवासव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Those who, devoted to their own duties, perform with reverence this meritorious Bṛhattapo-vrata for sixteen years, / pierce the impenetrable, inconceivable, primordial orb of the sun and go to the presence of the moon-crested god.
Description of the Bhadropavāsavrata

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
jātismaratvaṃ deveśa duṣprāpyamiti me matiḥ ..
tadahaṃ jñātumicchāmi prāpyate kena karmaṇā .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
जातिस्मरत्वं देवेश दुष्प्राप्यमिति मे मतिः ..
तदहं ज्ञातुमिच्छामि प्राप्यते केन कर्मणा .. 1 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / It is my thought, O Lord of gods, that remembrance of previous births is difficult to attain. / Therefore I wish to know: by what deed is it attained?
title: Bhadropavāsavratanirūpaṇam

sanskrit_iast:
varapradānāddevānāmṛṣīṇāṃ sevanena vā ..
tīrthasnānena vā deva tapohomavratena vā .. 2 ..
meaning:
वरप्रदानाद्देवानामृषीणां सेवनेन वा ..
तीर्थस्नानेन वा देव तपोहोमव्रतेन वा .. 2 ..
text_mt: Is it by the bestowal of a boon by the gods, or through attending upon the sages, / or by bathing at holy places, O god, or by penance, homa, and votive observance?

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
catvāri rājanbhadrāṇi samupoṣyāṇi yatnataḥ ..
tatprabhāvādbhavennūnaṃ rājañjātismaro naraḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
चत्वारि राजन्भद्राणि समुपोष्याणि यत्नतः ..
तत्प्रभावाद्भवेन्नूनं राजञ्जातिस्मरो नरः .. 3 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Four Bhadras are to be fasted upon with effort, O king; / by the power thereof, O king, a man surely remembers his previous births.

sanskrit_iast:
śubhodayaḥ purā vaiśyo babhūva yamunātaṭe ..
tena vratamidaṃ cīrṇaṃ mṛtaḥ kālakramādasau .. 4 ..
meaning:
शुभोदयः पुरा वैश्यो बभूव यमुनातटे ..
तेन व्रतमिदं चीर्णं मृतः कालक्रमादसौ .. 4 ..
text_mt: Formerly, a vaiśya named Śubhodaya lived on the bank of the Yamunā. / This votive observance was performed by him; he died in the course of time.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃjayasya suto jātaḥ svarṇaṣṭhīvīti viśrutaḥ ..
vrataprabhāvājjātijñaḥ sa ca caurernipātitaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
संजयस्य सुतो जातः स्वर्णष्ठीवीति विश्रुतः ..
व्रतप्रभावाज्जातिज्ञः स च चौरेर्निपातितः .. 5 ..
text_mt: He was born as the son of Saṃjaya, renowned as Svarṇaṣṭhīvin; / by the power of the votive observance he knew his previous birth, and he was killed by thieves.

sanskrit_iast:
nāradasya prabhāveṇa punaru jīvyate'pyasau ..
sasmāra pūrvavṛttāṃtaṃ sakalaṃ vratadharmataḥ ..6..
meaning:
नारदस्य प्रभावेण पुनरु जीव्यतेऽप्यसौ ..
सस्मार पूर्ववृत्तांतं सकलं व्रतधर्मतः ..6..
text_mt: Through the power of Nārada he was restored to life again; / he remembered the whole narrative of his past life through the merit of the votive observance.

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
saṃjayasya kathaṃ putraḥ svarṇaṣṭhīvīti vā katham ..
dasyubhiśca kathaṃ nīto mṛtyuṃ vai jīvitaḥ katham .. 7 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
संजयस्य कथं पुत्रः स्वर्णष्ठीवीति वा कथम् ..
दस्युभिश्च कथं नीतो मृत्युं वै जीवितः कथम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / How was he Saṃjaya's son, and why was he named Svarṇaṣṭhīvin? / And how was he put to death by robbers, and how was he brought to life?

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ... ..
saṃjayo nāma rājāsītkuśāvatyāṃ narādhipa ..
devarṣī tasya mitre ca sadā nāradaparvatau .. 8..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ... ..
संजयो नाम राजासीत्कुशावत्यां नराधिप ..
देवर्षी तस्य मित्रे च सदा नारदपर्वतौ .. 8..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / There was a king named Saṃjaya in Kuśāvatī, O lord of men; / the divine sages Nārada and Parvata were his constant friends.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā saṃjayagṛhaṃ saṃprāptau tau yadṛcchayā ..
svagatāsanadānādyairupacārairapūjayat .. 9 ..
meaning:
एकदा संजयगृहं संप्राप्तौ तौ यदृच्छया ..
स्वगतासनदानाद्यैरुपचारैरपूजयत् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Once, those two arrived at Saṃjaya's palace at will. / He honoured them with hospitable services, beginning with welcomes and the offer of seats.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāmathopaviṣṭānāṃ pūrvavṛttāṃtabhāṣiṇau ..
saṃjayasya sutā prāptā taruṇī pituraṃtikam .. 4.13.10 ..
meaning:
तेषामथोपविष्टानां पूर्ववृत्तांतभाषिणौ ..
संजयस्य सुता प्राप्ता तरुणी पितुरंतिकम् .. 4.13.10 ..
text_mt: As they sat there recounting past events, / Saṃjaya's young daughter came into the presence of her father.

sanskrit_iast:
parvataḥ prāha rājānaṃ kanyeyaṃ varavarṇinī ..
guptagulphā saṃhatorūḥ pīnaśroṇipayodharā .. 11 ..
meaning:
पर्वतः प्राह राजानं कन्येयं वरवर्णिनी ..
गुप्तगुल्फा संहतोरूः पीनश्रोणिपयोधरा .. 11 ..
text_mt: Parvata said to the king: 'This maiden is of splendid complexion, / with hidden ankles, closely knit thighs, and swelling hips and breasts,

sanskrit_iast:
padmapatrekṣaṇanakhā padmakiṃjalkasaprabhā ..
ākuñcitamṛdusnigdhaiḥ keśairavitatairghanaiḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
पद्मपत्रेक्षणनखा पद्मकिंजल्कसप्रभा ..
आकुञ्चितमृदुस्निग्धैः केशैरविततैर्घनैः .. 12 ..
text_mt: with eyes and fingernails like lotus petals, possessing the lustre of lotus filaments, / with curved, soft, glossy, neat, and thick hair,

sanskrit_iast:
savilāsā gajagatiḥ sunāsā kokilasvarā ..
aho rūpamaho dhairyamaho lāvaṇyamuttamam ..13..
meaning:
सविलासा गजगतिः सुनासा कोकिलस्वरा ..
अहो रूपमहो धैर्यमहो लावण्यमुत्तमम् ..13..
text_mt: graceful, with an elephant's gait, a lovely nose, and the voice of a cuckoo. / Ah, what beauty! Ah, what composure! Ah, what exquisite charm!

sanskrit_iast:
tilapuṣpasphuṭā nāsā rūpaṃ saṃparilakṣyate ..
kasyeyaṃ bhadrikā bhadrā mamātihṛdayaṃgamā .. 14 ..
meaning:
तिलपुष्पस्फुटा नासा रूपं संपरिलक्ष्यते ..
कस्येयं भद्रिका भद्रा ममातिहृदयंगमा .. 14 ..
text_mt: Her nose is prominent like a sesamum blossom; [her divine] form is clearly manifest. / Whose is this gracious, auspicious maiden who captivates my heart?'

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ bruvā ṇaṃ taṃ vipraṃ vismayotphullalocanam ..
sa rājā prāha kanyeyaṃ duhitā mama parvata .. 15 ..
meaning:
एवं ब्रुवा णं तं विप्रं विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनम् ..
स राजा प्राह कन्येयं दुहिता मम पर्वत .. 15 ..
text_mt: To that brāhmaṇa who spoke thus with eyes wide with wonder, / that king said: 'This maiden is my daughter, O Parvata.'

sanskrit_iast:
athovāca nṛpaṃ dhīmānnāradaḥ kṣubhitendriyaḥ ..
rājanniveṣṭukāmo'haṃ kanyeyaṃ mama dīyatām .. 16
meaning:
अथोवाच नृपं धीमान्नारदः क्षुभितेन्द्रियः ..
राजन्निवेष्टुकामोऽहं कन्येयं मम दीयताम् .. 16
text_mt: Then the wise Nārada, his senses agitated, said to the king: / 'O king, I wish to marry; let this maiden be given to me.

sanskrit_iast:
īpsitaṃ tava dāsyāmi varaṃ martyeṣu durllabham ..
evamukto nāradena prītātmā saṃjayastathā .. 17 ..
meaning:
ईप्सितं तव दास्यामि वरं मर्त्येषु दुर्ल्लभम् ..
एवमुक्तो नारदेन प्रीतात्मा संजयस्तथा .. 17 ..
text_mt: I shall grant you a desired boon, hard to obtain among mortals.' / Addressed thus by Nārada, Sañjaya, pleased in his heart,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtāñjaliruvācedaṃ praharṣotphullalocanaḥ ..
putro me dīyatāṃ kṣipramakṣīṇakanakākaraḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
कृताञ्जलिरुवाचेदं प्रहर्षोत्फुल्ललोचनः ..
पुत्रो मे दीयतां क्षिप्रमक्षीणकनकाकरः .. 18 ..
text_mt: Folded his hands and said this, his eyes blooming with joy: / 'Quickly grant me a son who is an inexhaustible mine of gold,

sanskrit_iast:
yasya mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā śleṣmāṇaṃ kṣipati kṣitau ..
jātarūpaṃ hi tatsarvaṃ suvarṇaṃ bhavatu sthiram .. 19 ..
meaning:
यस्य मूत्रं पुरीषं वा श्लेष्माणं क्षिपति क्षितौ ..
जातरूपं हि तत्सर्वं सुवर्णं भवतु स्थिरम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: Whatever urine, feces, or phlegm he casts upon the ground, / let all of that indeed become durable, refined gold.'

sanskrit_iast:
evamastviti taṃ rājannāradaḥ pratyabhāṣata ..
suvarṇaṣṭhīvinaṃ putraṃ dadāmi tava suvrata .. 4.13.20 ..
meaning:
एवमस्त्विति तं राजन्नारदः प्रत्यभाषत ..
सुवर्णष्ठीविनं पुत्रं ददामि तव सुव्रत .. 4.13.20 ..
text_mt: 'So be it,' Nārada replied to him, O king; / 'O man of good vows, I grant you a son who spits gold.'

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā sa tāṃ kanyāṃ sālaṅkārāṃ sumadhyamām ..
vivāhayāmāsa tayā nārado hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ..21 ..
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा स तां कन्यां सालङ्कारां सुमध्यमाम् ..
विवाहयामास तया नारदो हृष्टमानसः ..21 ..
text_mt: Having said this, Nārada, glad at heart, / took in marriage that slender-waisted maiden, adorned with ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
tattasya ceṣṭitaṃ dṛṣṭvā parvataḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ ..
uvāca nāradaṃ roṣāddīptākṣaḥ sphuritādharaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
तत्तस्य चेष्टितं दृष्ट्वा पर्वतः क्रोधमूर्छितः ..
उवाच नारदं रोषाद्दीप्ताक्षः स्फुरिताधरः .. 22 ..
text_mt: Seeing that deed of his, Parvata was overcome with rage; / his eyes blazing and his lower lip trembling, he spoke furiously to Nārada:

sanskrit_iast:
mayeyaṃ prārthitā pūrvaṃ tvayā yasmādvivāhitā ..
tasmānmayā samaṃ svargaṃ na gaṃtāsi kathaṃcana .. 23 ..
meaning:
मयेयं प्रार्थिता पूर्वं त्वया यस्माद्विवाहिता ..
तस्मान्मया समं स्वर्गं न गंतासि कथंचन .. 23 ..
text_mt: 'Since this maiden was sought by me first, yet married by you, / therefore you shall never go to heaven together with me.

sanskrit_iast:
dattastvayāsya yaḥ putro varadānena nārada ..
so'pi caurairabhihataḥ pañcatvamupayāsyati .. 24 ..
meaning:
दत्तस्त्वयास्य यः पुत्रो वरदानेन नारद ..
सोऽपि चौरैरभिहतः पञ्चत्वमुपयास्यति .. 24 ..
text_mt: And the son whom you granted to him by bestowing a boon, O Nārada, / he too shall meet his death, slain by thieves.'

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktaḥ parvatena nāradaḥ prāha durmanāḥ ..
na tvaṃ dharmaṃ vijānāsi kiñcinmūḍho'si durmate .. 25 ..
meaning:
एवमुक्तः पर्वतेन नारदः प्राह दुर्मनाः ..
न त्वं धर्मं विजानासि किञ्चिन्मूढोऽसि दुर्मते .. 25 ..
text_mt: Spoken to thus by Parvata, Nārada, downcast, said: / 'You know nothing of dharma; you are foolish, O wicked-minded one!

sanskrit_iast:
sāmānyaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ kanyā bhavati suvrata ..
na tasyā varaṇe duḥkhaṃ paśyaṃtīha bahuśrutāḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
सामान्यं सर्वभूतानां कन्या भवति सुव्रत ..
न तस्या वरणे दुःखं पश्यंतीह बहुश्रुताः .. 26 ..
text_mt: A maiden is common to all beings, O man of good vows; / the learned see no wrong in choosing her.

sanskrit_iast:
na sevitāstvayā vṛddhāstena māṃ śapase ruṣā ..
paṇigrahaṇamaṃtrāṇāṃ niṣṭhā syātsaptame pade .. 27 ..
meaning:
न सेवितास्त्वया वृद्धास्तेन मां शपसे रुषा ..
पणिग्रहणमंत्राणां निष्ठा स्यात्सप्तमे पदे .. 27 ..
text_mt: You have not served the elders; therefore, out of anger, you curse me. / The completion of the marriage mantras occurs at the seventh step.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmādetadavijñāya śapase māmanāgasam ..
tasmāttvamapyaho svargaṃ na gaṃtāsi mayā vinā .. 28 ..
meaning:
यस्मादेतदविज्ञाय शपसे मामनागसम् ..
तस्मात्त्वमप्यहो स्वर्गं न गंतासि मया विना .. 28 ..
text_mt: Since you, without knowing this, curse me who am innocent, / therefore you too, alas, shall not go to heaven without me.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃjayasya sutaḥ śāpādyadi pañcatvameṣyati ..
ānayiṣye tathāpyenaṃ yamalokānna saṃśayaḥ ..29..
meaning:
संजयस्य सुतः शापाद्यदि पञ्चत्वमेष्यति ..
आनयिष्ये तथाप्येनं यमलोकान्न संशयः ..29..
text_mt: If Sañjaya's son goes to his death on account of your curse, / nevertheless I will bring him back from the realm of Yama; there is no doubt.'

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ śaptvā tadā' nyonyaṃ devarṣī tāvubhau punaḥ ..
pūjitau saṃjayenātha jagmatuḥ svāśramaṃ prati .. 4.13.30 ..
meaning:
एवं शप्त्वा तदा' न्योन्यं देवर्षी तावुभौ पुनः ..
पूजितौ संजयेनाथ जग्मतुः स्वाश्रमं प्रति .. 4.13.30 ..
text_mt: Having thus cursed each other, both divine sages, / worshipped then by Sañjaya, departed toward their own hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
athāsya saptame māsi jātaḥ putro nṛpasya saḥ ..
svarṇaṣṭhīvīti nāmāsya yathārthamakarotpitā .. 31 ..
meaning:
अथास्य सप्तमे मासि जातः पुत्रो नृपस्य सः ..
स्वर्णष्ठीवीति नामास्य यथार्थमकरोत्पिता .. 31 ..
text_mt: Then, in the seventh month, that son was born to the king; / his father gave him the name Suvarṇaṣṭhīvin, which was true to fact.

sanskrit_iast:
jātismaraḥ smaravapuḥ suvarṇotpattikāraṇam ..
sarvabhūtarutajño'bhūdbhadravrataphalādiha .. 32 ..
meaning:
जातिस्मरः स्मरवपुः सुवर्णोत्पत्तिकारणम् ..
सर्वभूतरुतज्ञोऽभूद्भद्रव्रतफलादिह .. 32 ..
text_mt: He remembered his past lives, possessed the form of Kāma, was the source of gold, / and understood the cries of all creatures here, by the fruit of the Bhadra vow.

sanskrit_iast:
mūtraśleṣmapurīṣādi yatkiñcitkṣipati kṣitau ..
jāyate kanakaṃ sarvaṃ prasādānnāradasya ca ..33..
meaning:
मूत्रश्लेष्मपुरीषादि यत्किञ्चित्क्षिपति क्षितौ ..
जायते कनकं सर्वं प्रसादान्नारदस्य च ..33..
text_mt: Whatever urine, phlegm, feces, and the like he cast on the ground / turned entirely into gold, through the favor of Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
tenāsau yajate rājā vidhivadbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ ..
rājasūyādibhiryajñairvi vidhairbrāhmaṇairvṛtaḥ ..34..
meaning:
तेनासौ यजते राजा विधिवद्भूरिदक्षिणैः ..
राजसूयादिभिर्यज्ञैर्वि विधैर्ब्राह्मणैर्वृतः ..34..
text_mt: Therewith the king sacrificed according to rule with abundant gifts, / through various sacrifices such as the Rājasūya, surrounded by brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
babhāra bhṛtyānaniśaṃ pupoṣa svajanātithīn ..
cakāra devatāgāraṃ saraścārāmavāṭikāḥ ..35..
meaning:
बभार भृत्याननिशं पुपोष स्वजनातिथीन् ..
चकार देवतागारं सरश्चारामवाटिकाः ..35..
text_mt: He constantly maintained his servants and nourished his kin and guests; / he constructed temples, lakes, and pleasure-gardens.

sanskrit_iast:
jātasnehaṃ tathā putraṃ rarakṣa rakṣi bhirvṛtaḥ ..
rāśayaḥ kanakasyāsya babhūvurnṛpateḥ sutāt..36..
meaning:
जातस्नेहं तथा पुत्रं ररक्ष रक्षि भिर्वृतः ..
राशयः कनकस्यास्य बभूवुर्नृपतेः सुतात्..36..
text_mt: Surrounded by guards, he guarded his son, whom he loved dearly; / heaps of gold were produced for the king from his son.

sanskrit_iast:
athāsya dasyavaḥ kecicchrutvā taṃ kanakākaram..
dhanalolupayā jaghnurdākṣiṇātyā madoddha tāḥ..37..
meaning:
अथास्य दस्यवः केचिच्छ्रुत्वा तं कनकाकरम्..
धनलोलुपया जघ्नुर्दाक्षिणात्या मदोद्ध ताः..37..
text_mt: Then certain bandits, southern men swollen with arrogance, / hearing that he was a mine of gold, killed him out of greed for wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminvinaṣṭe tannaṣṭaṃ varadānasamudbhavam ..
kanakaṃ tadapaśyaṃto jagmuranyonyataḥ kṣayam ..38..
meaning:
तस्मिन्विनष्टे तन्नष्टं वरदानसमुद्भवम् ..
कनकं तदपश्यंतो जग्मुरन्योन्यतः क्षयम् ..38..
text_mt: When he perished, that gold born of the boon disappeared; / not seeing it, they destroyed one another.

sanskrit_iast:
pātitaṃ dasyubhiḥ putraṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā suduḥkhitaḥ..
vilalāpākulamatiḥ sa mumoha papāta ca ..39..
meaning:
पातितं दस्युभिः पुत्रं दृष्ट्वा राजा सुदुःखितः..
विललापाकुलमतिः स मुमोह पपात च ..39..
text_mt: Seeing his son struck down by bandits, the king was exceedingly distressed; / his mind agitated, he wailed, fainted, and fell to the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
vilapaṃtaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā nāradaḥ prāha saṃjayam ..
rājanviṣādaṃ mā kārṣīḥ śṛṇvimāṃ bhāratīṃ mama ..4.13.40..
meaning:
विलपंतं तु तं दृष्ट्वा नारदः प्राह संजयम् ..
राजन्विषादं मा कार्षीः शृण्विमां भारतीं मम ..4.13.40..
text_mt: Seeing him wailing, Nārada said to Sañjaya: / 'O king, do not despair; listen to these words of mine.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sa samācakhyau caritāni mahaujasām ..
viśiṣṭānāṃ narendrāṇāṃ yatīnāṃ dakṣiṇāvatām .. 41 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा स समाचख्यौ चरितानि महौजसाम् ..
विशिष्टानां नरेन्द्राणां यतीनां दक्षिणावताम् .. 41 ..
text_mt: Having said this, he related the deeds of illustrious men, / distinguished kings and ascetics who gave generous sacrificial gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā rājā nareṃdrāṇāṃ caritāni mahā tmanām ..
vinaṣṭaśokaḥ sahasā prakṛtistho vabhūva saḥ ..42..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा राजा नरेंद्राणां चरितानि महा त्मनाम् ..
विनष्टशोकः सहसा प्रकृतिस्थो वभूव सः ..42..
text_mt: Having heard the deeds of the great-souled kings, / the king's grief vanished at once and he returned to his natural state.

sanskrit_iast:
nārado'pi nareṃdrasya mṛtaṃ putraṃ yamālayāt ..
ānayāmāsa tarasā tathārūpaṃ yathā hatam .. 43 ..
meaning:
नारदोऽपि नरेंद्रस्य मृतं पुत्रं यमालयात् ..
आनयामास तरसा तथारूपं यथा हतम् .. 43 ..
text_mt: And Nārada swiftly brought the king's dead son from Yama's abode, / in the very same form as when he was slain.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā sa putraṃ taṃ parituṣṭena cetasā ..
vrīḍito vismitaścaiva kṛtāñjalirathāvravīt .. 44 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा स्पृष्ट्वा स पुत्रं तं परितुष्टेन चेतसा ..
व्रीडितो विस्मितश्चैव कृताञ्जलिरथाव्रवीत् .. 44 ..
text_mt: Having seen and touched that son with a delighted mind, / he, ashamed and astonished, folded his hands and then said:

sanskrit_iast:
kimāścaryaṃ prasannena bhavatā mama nārada ..
dattaḥ putrastathābhūto dasyubhirghātito yathā .. 45 ..
meaning:
किमाश्चर्यं प्रसन्नेन भवता मम नारद ..
दत्तः पुत्रस्तथाभूतो दस्युभिर्घातितो यथा .. 45 ..
text_mt: 'What a wonder that you, being pleased, O Nārada, / gave me a son of such a kind, even as he was slain by bandits!'

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṇmāsāṃte punarasau jīvitaṃ sarvameva tat ..
sasmāra pūrvaṃ vṛttāṃtaṃ bhadrāṇāṃ pāraṇātkila .. 46 ..
meaning:
षण्मासांते पुनरसौ जीवितं सर्वमेव तत् ..
सस्मार पूर्वं वृत्तांतं भद्राणां पारणात्किल .. 46 ..
text_mt: At the end of six months, he regained his life and all of that; / he remembered his past events, indeed, through the concluding meal of the Bhadras.

sanskrit_iast:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ jātismaraṇakārakam ..
vrataṃ vratādhikaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kimanyatkathayāmi te ..47 ..
meaning:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं जातिस्मरणकारकम् ..
व्रतं व्रताधिकं श्रेष्ठं किमन्यत्कथयामि ते ..47 ..
text_mt: This has all been related to you—the vow that causes remembrance of past lives, / supreme above all vows; what else shall I tell you?

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
brāhmaṇāścaiva śūdrāśca kule mahati janma ca ..
dātā kṣamī dhanī vāgmī rūpī svairbhadrakairbhavet ..48..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
ब्राह्मणाश्चैव शूद्राश्च कुले महति जन्म च ..
दाता क्षमी धनी वाग्मी रूपी स्वैर्भद्रकैर्भवेत् ..48..
text_mt: The Blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / 'Brāhmaṇas and śūdras, birth in a great family, / being generous, forgiving, wealthy, eloquent, and handsome, occur through one's own Bhadrakas.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāri rājanbhadrāṇi catuṣpādāni tāni vai ..
tānyeva bahuvighnāni duṣprāpyānyakṛtātmabhiḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
चत्वारि राजन्भद्राणि चतुष्पादानि तानि वै ..
तान्येव बहुविघ्नानि दुष्प्राप्यान्यकृतात्मभिः .. 49 ..
text_mt: There are four Bhadras, O king; they indeed have four quarters; / they have many obstacles and are difficult to attain by undisciplined persons.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśīrṣe tu prathamaṃ dvitīyaṃ phālgune tathā ..
jyeṣṭhe tṛtīyaṃ rājendra khyātaṃ bhādrapade param .. 4.13.50 ..
meaning:
मार्गशीर्षे तु प्रथमं द्वितीयं फाल्गुने तथा ..
ज्येष्ठे तृतीयं राजेन्द्र ख्यातं भाद्रपदे परम् .. 4.13.50 ..
text_mt: The first is in Mārgaśīrṣa, and the second is in Phālguna; / the third is in Jyeṣṭha, O king of kings, and the next is known to be in Bhādrapada.

sanskrit_iast:
phālgunāmalapakṣādau trīnmāsāṃstu narādhipa ..
tattripuṣpamiti khyātaṃ tapasyākaraṇaṃ param .. 51 ..
meaning:
फाल्गुनामलपक्षादौ त्रीन्मासांस्तु नराधिप ..
तत्त्रिपुष्पमिति ख्यातं तपस्याकरणं परम् .. 51 ..
text_mt: Beginning from the bright fortnight of Phālguna, for three months, O ruler of men, / that is known as Tripuṣpa, an excellent practice of austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhasya śuklapakṣādau trīnvai māsānyudhiṣṭhira ..
tattrirāmamiti khyātaṃ satyaśauryapradāyakam .. 52 ..
meaning:
ज्येष्ठस्य शुक्लपक्षादौ त्रीन्वै मासान्युधिष्ठिर ..
तत्त्रिराममिति ख्यातं सत्यशौर्यप्रदायकम् .. 52 ..
text_mt: Beginning from the bright fortnight of Jyeṣṭha, for three months, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / that is known as Trirāma, bestowing truth and valor.

sanskrit_iast:
śukle bhādrapadasyādau trīnmāsānpāṃḍunaṃdana ..
tattriraṃgamiti khyātaṃ vahuvidyāpradāyakam .. 53 ..
meaning:
शुक्ले भाद्रपदस्यादौ त्रीन्मासान्पांडुनंदन ..
तत्त्रिरंगमिति ख्यातं वहुविद्याप्रदायकम् .. 53 ..
text_mt: Beginning in the bright fortnight of Bhādrapada, for three months, O son of Pāṇḍu, / that is known as Triraṅga, bestowing much knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklamārgaśirasyādau trīnmāsāṃstu narādhipa ..
tadviṣṇupadamityuktaṃ sarvadharmapradāyakam .. 54 ..
meaning:
शुक्लमार्गशिरस्यादौ त्रीन्मासांस्तु नराधिप ..
तद्विष्णुपदमित्युक्तं सर्वधर्मप्रदायकम् .. 54 ..
text_mt: Beginning in the bright fortnight of Mārgaśiras, for three months, O ruler of men, / that is said to be Viṣṇupada, bestowing all dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
samāsenaiva coktāni bhadrāṇyetāni bhārata ..
kartavyāni naraiḥ strībhirvā brahmaṇānumatena vā .. 55 ..
meaning:
समासेनैव चोक्तानि भद्राण्येतानि भारत ..
कर्तव्यानि नरैः स्त्रीभिर्वा ब्रह्मणानुमतेन वा .. 55 ..
text_mt: These Bhadras have been declared in brief, O Bhārata; / they are to be performed by men, or by women with the permission of a brāhmaṇa.'

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
vistareṇaiva me brūhi devadeva jagatpate ..
bhadrāṇāṃ niyamādhānaṃ pradhānaniyamāṃstathā .. 56 .. ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
विस्तरेणैव मे ब्रूहि देवदेव जगत्पते ..
भद्राणां नियमाधानं प्रधाननियमांस्तथा .. 56 .. ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / 'Tell me in detail, O god of gods, Lord of the universe, / the adoption of the rules of the Bhadras, and their principal observances.'

sanskrit_iast:
..śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
śṛṇu rājannavahito bhadrāṇāṃ vistaraṃ param ..
kathayiṣye na kathitaṃ kasyacidyanmayāpurā ..57..
meaning:
..श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
शृणु राजन्नवहितो भद्राणां विस्तरं परम् ..
कथयिष्ये न कथितं कस्यचिद्यन्मयापुरा ..57..
text_mt: The Blessed Lord said: / 'Listen attentively, O king, to the supreme detail of the Bhadras; / I shall relate what has not been told by me to anyone before.

sanskrit_iast:
śukle mārgaśirasyādau catvārastithayo varāḥ ..
dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā ca caturthī pañcamī tathā .. 58 ..
meaning:
शुक्ले मार्गशिरस्यादौ चत्वारस्तिथयो वराः ..
द्वितीया च तृतीया च चतुर्थी पञ्चमी तथा .. 58 ..
text_mt: At the beginning of the bright fortnight of Mārgaśiras, four lunar days are excellent: / the second, the third, the fourth, and the fifth.

sanskrit_iast:
ekabhuktāsanastiṣṭhetpratipadyāṃ jitendriyaḥ ..
prabhāte tu dvitīyāyāṃ kṛtvā yatkaraṇīyakam .. 59 ..
meaning:
एकभुक्तासनस्तिष्ठेत्प्रतिपद्यां जितेन्द्रियः ..
प्रभाते तु द्वितीयायां कृत्वा यत्करणीयकम् .. 59 ..
text_mt: One should observe a single meal on the first day, self-controlled; / then, in the morning of the second day, having done what is to be done,

sanskrit_iast:
praharatraye samadhike gate snānaṃ samācaret ..
mṛdgomayaṃ ca saṃgṛhya maṃtrairebhirvicakṣaṇaḥ .. 4.13.60 ..
meaning:
प्रहरत्रये समधिके गते स्नानं समाचरेत् ..
मृद्गोमयं च संगृह्य मंत्रैरेभिर्विचक्षणः .. 4.13.60 ..
text_mt: When more than three watches have passed, he should perform his bath. / Gathering clay and cow dung, the wise man [bathes] with these mantras:

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ te tu pradiśyāmi maṃtrāṇāṃ vidhimuttamam ..
yeṣāṃ deyo na deyo vā tāñchṛṣva vadāmi te .. 61 ..
meaning:
अहं ते तु प्रदिश्यामि मंत्राणां विधिमुत्तमम् ..
येषां देयो न देयो वा ताञ्छृष्व वदामि ते .. 61 ..
text_mt: "I will instruct you in the supreme rule of the mantras; / hear from me to whom they should be given or not given, as I explain to you.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā ye śucayo'malāḥ ..
teṣāṃ maṃtrāḥ pradeyā vai na tu saṃkīrṇadharmiṇām .. 62 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः शूद्रा ये शुचयोऽमलाः ..
तेषां मंत्राः प्रदेया वै न तु संकीर्णधर्मिणाम् .. 62 ..
text_mt: Brāhmaṇas, Kṣatriyas, Vaiśyas, and those Śūdras who are pure and spotless— / to them mantras may indeed be imparted, but not to those of mixed conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
yā strī bhartrā viyuktāpi svācāraiḥ saṃyutā śubhā ..
sā ca mantrānpragṛhṇātu sabhartrī tadanujñayā ..63..
meaning:
या स्त्री भर्त्रा वियुक्तापि स्वाचारैः संयुता शुभा ..
सा च मन्त्रान्प्रगृह्णातु सभर्त्री तदनुज्ञया ..63..
text_mt: A woman who is separated from her husband, yet possessed of proper conduct and auspicious, / may also receive the mantras; and a woman with a husband, by his permission.

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ nadyāṃ taḍāge vā vāpyāṃ kūpe gṛhepi vā ..
daśottaraṃ phalaṃ jñeyamadhikaṃ hi samantrakam .. 64 ..
meaning:
स्नानं नद्यां तडागे वा वाप्यां कूपे गृहेपि वा ..
दशोत्तरं फलं ज्ञेयमधिकं हि समन्त्रकम् .. 64 ..
text_mt: Bathing in a river, a pond, a stepped reservoir, a well, or even at home / brings tenfold greater fruit, it should be known, when accompanied by mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdaṃ maṃtreṇa saṃgṛhya sarvāṃgeṣu pralepayet ..
tvaṃ mṛtsne vaṃditā devaiḥ samalairddaityaghātibhiḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
मृदं मंत्रेण संगृह्य सर्वांगेषु प्रलेपयेत् ..
त्वं मृत्स्ने वंदिता देवैः समलैर्द्दैत्यघातिभिः .. 65 ..
text_mt: Taking clay with the mantra, he should smear it over all his limbs: / 'O Earth, you have been praised by the gods, [though] soiled, slaying the daityas;

sanskrit_iast: mayāpi vaṃditā bhaktyā māmato vimalaṃ kuru .. 66 ..
meaning: मयापि वंदिता भक्त्या मामतो विमलं कुरु .. 66 ..
text_mt: I too have praised you with devotion; therefore, make me pure.'"

sanskrit_iast:
iti mṛnmaṃtraḥ ..
evaṃ japanmṛdaṃ dattvā svahastāgresamaṃtrakam ..
jalāvagāhanaṃ kuryātkuṇḍamālikhya dharmavit ..
siddhārthakaiḥ kṛṣṇatilairvacāsarvauṣadhīḥ kramāt .. 67 ..
meaning:
इति मृन्मंत्रः ..
एवं जपन्मृदं दत्त्वा स्वहस्ताग्रेसमंत्रकम् ..
जलावगाहनं कुर्यात्कुण्डमालिख्य धर्मवित् ..
सिद्धार्थकैः कृष्णतिलैर्वचासर्वौषधीः क्रमात् .. 67 ..
text_mt: This is the clay mantra. / Having applied the clay while thus reciting, he should immerse himself in the water / with mantras from the tips of his own hands. The knower of dharma, having drawn a pit / in sequence with white mustard seeds, black sesame seeds, sweet flag, and all medicinal herbs [recites]:

sanskrit_iast:
tvamādiḥ sarvadevānāṃ jagatāṃ ca jaganmaye ..
bhūtānāṃ vīrudhāṃcaiva rasānāṃpataye namaḥ .. 68 ..
meaning:
त्वमादिः सर्वदेवानां जगतां च जगन्मये ..
भूतानां वीरुधांचैव रसानांपतये नमः .. 68 ..
text_mt: "You are the origin of all gods and worlds, O universe-embodied one! / Homage to the lord of beings, plants, and juices!

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃgāsāgarajaṃ toyaṃ pauṣkaraṃ nārmadaṃ tathā ..
yāmunaṃ sāṃnihatyaṃ ca saṃnidhānamihāstu me .. 69 ..
meaning:
गंगासागरजं तोयं पौष्करं नार्मदं तथा ..
यामुनं सांनिहत्यं च संनिधानमिहास्तु मे .. 69 ..
text_mt: May the waters arising from Gaṅgā-Sāgara, from Puṣkara, from Narmadā, / from Yamunā, and from Sannihitī be present here for me!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti snānamaṃtraḥ ..
śarīrālaṃbhanaṃ pūrvaṃ kṛtvā mṛdgomayāṃbubhiḥ..
evaṃ snātvā samāplutya ācamya taṭamāsthitaḥ ..4.13.70..
meaning:
इति स्नानमंत्रः ..
शरीरालंभनं पूर्वं कृत्वा मृद्गोमयांबुभिः..
एवं स्नात्वा समाप्लुत्य आचम्य तटमास्थितः ..4.13.70..
text_mt: This is the bath mantra. / Having first touched his body with clay, cow dung, and water, / having thus bathed, dipped completely, and sipped water, standing on the bank,

sanskrit_iast:
nivasya vāsasī śubhre śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ ..
devānpitṝnmanuṣyāṃśca tarpayetsusamādhinā .. 71 ..
meaning:
निवस्य वाससी शुभ्रे शुचिः प्रयतमानसः ..
देवान्पितॄन्मनुष्यांश्च तर्पयेत्सुसमाधिना .. 71 ..
text_mt: putting on two clean garments, pure and with restrained mind, / he should gratify the gods, ancestors, and humans with good concentration.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ gṛhītaniyamo gṛhaṃ gacchecchucivrataḥ ..
upaviśya na saṃjalpedyāvaccandrasya darśanam .. 72 ..
meaning:
एवं गृहीतनियमो गृहं गच्छेच्छुचिव्रतः ..
उपविश्य न संजल्पेद्यावच्चन्द्रस्य दर्शनम् .. 72 ..
text_mt: Having thus undertaken the observance, pure in his vow, he should go home. / Sitting down, he should not converse until the sighting of the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā caiva tato nāma tṛtīyādi caturdine ..
namaḥ kṛṣṇācyutānaṃta hṛṣīkeśeti ca kramāta .. .. 73 ..
meaning:
स्नात्वा चैव ततो नाम तृतीयादि चतुर्दिने ..
नमः कृष्णाच्युतानंत हृषीकेशेति च क्रमात .. .. 73 ..
text_mt: And having bathed, then on the four days beginning with the third [tithi], the names / 'Homage to Kṛṣṇa, Acyuta, Ananta, Hṛṣīkeśa' [are uttered] in order.

sanskrit_iast:
caturdine dvitīyādau devamabhyarcaye'cyutam ..
prathamehni smṛtā pūjā pādayoścakrapāṇinaḥ .. 74 ..
meaning:
चतुर्दिने द्वितीयादौ देवमभ्यर्चयेऽच्युतम् ..
प्रथमेह्नि स्मृता पूजा पादयोश्चक्रपाणिनः .. 74 ..
text_mt: On the four days beginning with the second, he should worship the god Acyuta. / On the first day, worship of the feet of the discus-bearer is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
nābhipūjā dvitīyehni kartavyā vidhivannaraiḥ ..
muradviṣastatīyehni pūjāṃ vakṣasivinyaset .. 75 ..
meaning:
नाभिपूजा द्वितीयेह्नि कर्तव्या विधिवन्नरैः ..
मुरद्विषस्ततीयेह्नि पूजां वक्षसिविन्यसेत् .. 75 ..
text_mt: On the second day, worship of the navel should be performed properly by men. / On the third day, he should place worship upon the chest of the enemy of Mura.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthehni jagaddhātuḥ pūjāṃ śirasi kalpayet ..
puṣpairvilepanairdhūpairarghyaṃ dadyurvi bhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 76 ..
meaning:
चतुर्थेह्नि जगद्धातुः पूजां शिरसि कल्पयेत् ..
पुष्पैर्विलेपनैर्धूपैरर्घ्यं दद्युर्वि भूषणैः .. 76 ..
text_mt: On the fourth day, he should arrange worship upon the head of the sustainer of the world. / They should offer water of respect with flowers, unguents, incense, and ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
ghīvarairharinaivedyairdīpadānaiśca bhaktitaḥ ..
pūjayitvā vidhānena viṣṇuṃ viśveśvaraṃ vratī .. 77 ..
meaning:
घीवरैर्हरिनैवेद्यैर्दीपदानैश्च भक्तितः ..
पूजयित्वा विधानेन विष्णुं विश्वेश्वरं व्रती .. 77 ..
text_mt: with clarified butter preparations, food offerings for Hari, and gifts of lamps with devotion. / Having worshipped Viṣṇu, the lord of the universe, according to the rule, the observer of the vow,

sanskrit_iast:
tato dināvasāne tu muhūrte nirgate sati ..
arghyaṃ pradadyātsomāya bhaktyātadbhāvabhāvitaḥ .. 78 ..
meaning:
ततो दिनावसाने तु मुहूर्ते निर्गते सति ..
अर्घ्यं प्रदद्यात्सोमाय भक्त्यातद्भावभावितः .. 78 ..
text_mt: then at the end of the day, when a muhūrta has elapsed, / should offer water of respect to Soma with devotion, imbued with contemplation of him.

sanskrit_iast:
śaśicandraśaśāṃkendunāmāni kramaśo naraḥ ..
tṛtīyādiṣu candrasya saṃkīrtyārghyaṃ nivedayet .. 79 ..
meaning:
शशिचन्द्रशशांकेन्दुनामानि क्रमशो नरः ..
तृतीयादिषु चन्द्रस्य संकीर्त्यार्घ्यं निवेदयेत् .. 79 ..
text_mt: Reciting the names Śaśin, Candra, Śaśāṅka, and Indu in sequence / for the moon on the [days] beginning with the third, a man should present the water of respect.

sanskrit_iast:
sa cārghyo yādṛśo deya ṛddhimadbhirathetaraiḥ ..
tatte samyakpravakṣyāmi yudhiṣṭhira nibodha me .. 4.13.80 ..
meaning:
स चार्घ्यो यादृशो देय ऋद्धिमद्भिरथेतरैः ..
तत्ते सम्यक्प्रवक्ष्यामि युधिष्ठिर निबोध मे .. 4.13.80 ..
text_mt: And of what kind that water of respect should be given by the wealthy and by others, / that I shall fully explain to you; listen to me, Yudhiṣṭhira:

sanskrit_iast:
candanāgurukarpūradadhi dūrvākṣatādibhiḥ ..
ratnaiḥ samudrajaiścānyairvajravaidūryamauktikaiḥ .. 81 ..
meaning:
चन्दनागुरुकर्पूरदधि दूर्वाक्षतादिभिः ..
रत्नैः समुद्रजैश्चान्यैर्वज्रवैदूर्यमौक्तिकैः .. 81 ..
text_mt: With sandalwood, agallochum, camphor, curd, dūrvā grass, unbroken rice grains, and the like, / with gems born of the ocean and others—diamonds, lapis lazuli, and pearls—

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpaiḥ phalaiḥ svakālotthaiḥ kharjūrairnnālikerakaiḥ ..
vastrācchādanagovā jibhūmihemagajānvitaiḥ .. 82 ..
meaning:
पुष्पैः फलैः स्वकालोत्थैः खर्जूरैर्न्नालिकेरकैः ..
वस्त्राच्छादनगोवा जिभूमिहेमगजान्वितैः .. 82 ..
text_mt: with flowers and fruits in season, with dates and coconuts, / accompanied by garments, coverings, cows, horses, land, gold, and elephants.

sanskrit_iast:
sattvayuktasya ṛddhasya rājanneṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ..
itarasya yathāśakti phalapuṣpākṣatodakaiḥ .. 83 ..
meaning:
सत्त्वयुक्तस्य ऋद्धस्य राजन्नेष विधिः स्मृतः ..
इतरस्य यथाशक्ति फलपुष्पाक्षतोदकैः .. 83 ..
text_mt: This is remembered as the rule for an energetic, wealthy man, O king; / for another, according to his capacity, with fruits, flowers, unbroken rice grains, and water.

sanskrit_iast:
lavaṇaṃ guḍaṃ ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ payaḥkuṃbhāstilaiḥ saha ..
argheṣvetāni śastāni śaśivṛddhyā vivarddhayet .. 84 ..
meaning:
लवणं गुडं घृतं तैलं पयःकुंभास्तिलैः सह ..
अर्घेष्वेतानि शस्तानि शशिवृद्ध्या विवर्द्धयेत् .. 84 ..
text_mt: Salt, jaggery, ghee, oil, and pots of milk along with sesame— / these are commended in the waters of respect; he should increase them with the waxing of the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyahaṃ varddhayedarghyaṃ śaśi vṛddhyā narottama ..
evamarghaḥ pradātavyaḥ śṛṇu maṃtravidhikramam .. 85 ..
meaning:
प्रत्यहं वर्द्धयेदर्घ्यं शशि वृद्ध्या नरोत्तम ..
एवमर्घः प्रदातव्यः शृणु मंत्रविधिक्रमम् .. 85 ..
text_mt: Every day he should increase the water of respect with the waxing of the moon, O best of men. / Thus the water of respect should be given; hear the order of the mantra rule:

sanskrit_iast:
navonavosi māsāṃte jāyamānaḥ punaḥpunaḥ ..
triragnisamaveto vai devānāpyāyase haviḥ .. 86 ..
meaning:
नवोनवोसि मासांते जायमानः पुनःपुनः ..
त्रिरग्निसमवेतो वै देवानाप्यायसे हविः .. 86 ..
text_mt: "You become ever new, being born again and again at the end of the month; / united with the three fires, you fatten the gods with sacrificial offering.

sanskrit_iast:
gaganāṅgaṇasaddīpa dugdhābdhimathanodbhava ..
bhābhāsitadigābhoga ramānuja namo'stu te .. 87 ..
meaning:
गगनाङ्गणसद्दीप दुग्धाब्धिमथनोद्भव ..
भाभासितदिगाभोग रमानुज नमोऽस्तु ते .. 87 ..
text_mt: O auspicious lamp of the courtyard of the sky, born of the churning of the milk ocean, / illuminator of the compass of the directions with radiance, younger brother of Ramā, homage to you!"

sanskrit_iast:
dattvārghyaṃ dvijarājāya tadviprāya nivedayet ..
nirvartyārghyakramamimaṃ tato bhuṃjīta vāgyataḥ .. 88 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वार्घ्यं द्विजराजाय तद्विप्राय निवेदयेत् ..
निर्वर्त्यार्घ्यक्रममिमं ततो भुंजीत वाग्यतः .. 88 ..
text_mt: Having offered water of respect to the king of the twice-born, he should present it to a brāhmaṇa. / Having completed this procedure of water of respect, he should then eat with restrained speech,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmiṃ tu bhājanaṃ kṛtvā padmapatrasamāstṛtām ..
pālāśairmadhupatrairvā surūpairvā śilātale .. 89 ..
meaning:
भूमिं तु भाजनं कृत्वा पद्मपत्रसमास्तृताम् ..
पालाशैर्मधुपत्रैर्वा सुरूपैर्वा शिलातले .. 89 ..
text_mt: making the ground his dish, strewn with lotus leaves, / or with flame-of-the-forest leaves, or pleasant leaves, or on a rock surface.

sanskrit_iast:
samālabhya dharāṃ devīṃ maṃtreṇānena maṃtravit ..
tvattale bhoktukāmo'haṃ devi sarvarasodbhave .. 4.13.90 ..
meaning:
समालभ्य धरां देवीं मंत्रेणानेन मंत्रवित् ..
त्वत्तले भोक्तुकामोऽहं देवि सर्वरसोद्भवे .. 4.13.90 ..
text_mt: Touching the earth goddess with this mantra, the knower of mantras [recites]: / 'I wish to eat upon your surface, O goddess, source of all tastes;

sanskrit_iast:
madanugrahāya susvādaṃ kurvannamamṛtopamam ..
evaṃ japtvā ca bhuktvā ca śākaṃ pākaṃ guṇottaram .. 91 ..
meaning:
मदनुग्रहाय सुस्वादं कुर्वन्नममृतोपमम् ..
एवं जप्त्वा च भुक्त्वा च शाकं पाकं गुणोत्तरम् .. 91 ..
text_mt: for my favor, make the food delicious, resembling nectar.' / Having thus recited and eaten excellent cooked greens,

sanskrit_iast:
ācamya khānyupālabhya smṛtvā somaṃ svapedbhuvi ..
bhoktavyaṃ tu dritīyāyāmakṣāralavaṇaṃ haviḥ .. 92 ..
meaning:
आचम्य खान्युपालभ्य स्मृत्वा सोमं स्वपेद्भुवि ..
भोक्तव्यं तु द्रितीयायामक्षारलवणं हविः .. 92 ..
text_mt: having sipped water, touched the bodily apertures, and remembered Soma, he should sleep on the ground. / On the second day, sacrificial offering without salt or pungent seasoning should be eaten;

sanskrit_iast:
munyannaṃ tu tṛtīyāyāṃ caturthyāṃ gorasottaram ..
ghṛtāktāḥ saguṇāḥ śastāḥ pañcamyāṃ kṛśarāssadā 93 ..
meaning:
मुन्यन्नं तु तृतीयायां चतुर्थ्यां गोरसोत्तरम् ..
घृताक्ताः सगुणाः शस्ताः पञ्चम्यां कृशरास्सदा 93 ..
text_mt: sage's grain on the third day; cow's milk products on the fourth; / khicḍī smeared with ghee and seasoned is always commended on the fifth.

sanskrit_iast:
śastā bhadreṣu sarveṣu sadā śyāmākataṇḍulāḥ ..
prasādhikā ghṛtaṃ gavyaṃ vanyaṃ phalamayācitam .. 94 ..
meaning:
शस्ता भद्रेषु सर्वेषु सदा श्यामाकतण्डुलाः ..
प्रसाधिका घृतं गव्यं वन्यं फलमयाचितम् .. 94 ..
text_mt: Śyāmāka rice grains are always commended on all the Bhadrā days, / [as well as] wild rice, cow's ghee, and unbegged forest fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
prātaḥ snānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā saṃtarjya pitṛdevatāḥ ..
bhojayedbrāhmaṇānbhaktyā dattadānānvisarjayeta ..95..
meaning:
प्रातः स्नानं ततः कृत्वा संतर्ज्य पितृदेवताः ..
भोजयेद्ब्राह्मणान्भक्त्या दत्तदानान्विसर्जयेत ..95..
text_mt: Having then bathed in the morning and gratified the ancestors and deities, / he should feed brāhmaṇas with devotion and dismiss them after giving gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛtyabandhujanaiḥ sārddhaṃ paścādbhuñjīta kāmataḥ ..
evaṃ bhadreṣu sarveṣu trimāseṣu gateṣu yaḥ ..96..
meaning:
भृत्यबन्धुजनैः सार्द्धं पश्चाद्भुञ्जीत कामतः ..
एवं भद्रेषु सर्वेषु त्रिमासेषु गतेषु यः ..96..
text_mt: Afterwards he may eat at will along with servants and kinfolk. / Whoever performs this with devotion on all the Bhadrā days

sanskrit_iast:
karotyetannaro bhaktyā varṣamekamamatsarī ..
tasya śrīrvijayaścaiva nityaṃ somaḥ prasīdati ..97..
meaning:
करोत्येतन्नरो भक्त्या वर्षमेकममत्सरी ..
तस्य श्रीर्विजयश्चैव नित्यं सोमः प्रसीदति ..97..
text_mt: when three months have passed, for one year, free from jealousy— / to him belong fortune and victory, and Soma is always pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
etatkaroti yā kanyā śubhaṃ prāpnoti sā patim ..
durbhagā subhagā sādhvī bhavatyavidhavā sadā .. 98 ..
meaning:
एतत्करोति या कन्या शुभं प्राप्नोति सा पतिम् ..
दुर्भगा सुभगा साध्वी भवत्यविधवा सदा .. 98 ..
text_mt: A maiden who performs this obtains an auspicious husband; / an unfortunate woman becomes fortunate, virtuous, and never a widow.

sanskrit_iast:
rājyārthī labhate rājyaṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam ..
putrārthī labhate putrāniti prāha prabhākaraḥ .. 99 ..
meaning:
राज्यार्थी लभते राज्यं धनार्थी लभते धनम् ..
पुत्रार्थी लभते पुत्रानिति प्राह प्रभाकरः .. 99 ..
text_mt: One desiring a kingdom obtains a kingdom; one desiring wealth obtains wealth; / one desiring sons obtains sons: so spoke Prabhākara.

sanskrit_iast:
yoṣitkulākulavivāhamanoramāṇi śayyānnayānaśayanāsanaśobhitāni ..
bhadrāṇyavāpya dhanaputrakalatrajāni jātismaro bhavati bhārata bhadrakartā .. 4.13.100 ..
dvitīyāvratamāhātmyavarṇanam
meaning:
योषित्कुलाकुलविवाहमनोरमाणि शय्यान्नयानशयनासनशोभितानि ..
भद्राण्यवाप्य धनपुत्रकलत्रजानि जातिस्मरो भवति भारत भद्रकर्ता .. 4.13.100 ..
द्वितीयाव्रतमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Having obtained auspicious things delightful with weddings of suitable lineages, / adorned with beds, food, vehicles, couches, and seats, and consisting of wealth, sons, and wives, the performer of the Bhadrā vow remembers his past lives, O Bhārata.
Description of the Greatness of the Dvitīyā Vow

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
saṃtyanyāstithayaḥ pārtha dvitīyādyāḥ pariśrutāḥ ..
māsaiścaturbhiścatvāraḥ prāvṛṭchuklāḥ klamāpahāḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
संत्यन्यास्तिथयः पार्थ द्वितीयाद्याः परिश्रुताः ..
मासैश्चतुर्भिश्चत्वारः प्रावृट्छुक्लाः क्लमापहाः .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
There are other celebrated lunar days, O son of Pṛthā, beginning with the second,
four during the four months of the rainy season, in the bright fortnight, which dispel exhaustion.
title: Yamadvitīyāvratamāhātmyam

sanskrit_iast:
gopitāśca sadā loke na proktāśca mayā kvacit ..
prakāśayāmi tāḥ pārtha śṛṇu sarvā mayā hi tāḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
गोपिताश्च सदा लोके न प्रोक्ताश्च मया क्वचित् ..
प्रकाशयामि ताः पार्थ शृणु सर्वा मया हि ताः .. 2 ..
text_mt:
They have always been kept secret in the world and have never been spoken by me anywhere.
I shall reveal them, O son of Pṛthā; listen to them all from me.

sanskrit_iast:
ekā tu śrāvaṇe māsi anyā bhādrapade tathā ..
aparāśvayuje māsi caturthī kārtike bhavet .. 3 ..
meaning:
एका तु श्रावणे मासि अन्या भाद्रपदे तथा ..
अपराश्वयुजे मासि चतुर्थी कार्तिके भवेत् .. 3 ..
text_mt:
One is in the month of Śrāvaṇa, another in Bhādrapada,
another in the month of Āśvayuja, and the fourth is in Kārtika.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvaṇe kaluṣā nāma proṣṭhapāde ca gīrmalā ..
āśvine pretasaṃcārā kārtike ca yamā smṛtā ..4..
meaning:
श्रावणे कलुषा नाम प्रोष्ठपादे च गीर्मला ..
आश्विने प्रेतसंचारा कार्तिके च यमा स्मृता ..4..
text_mt:
In Śrāvaṇa it is called Kaluṣā, and in Proṣṭhapada, Gīrmalā;
in Āśvina it is Pretasaṃcārā, and in Kārtika it is known as Yamā.

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kasmātsā kaluṣā proktā kasmātsā gīrmalā matā .
kasmātsā pretasaṃcārā kasmādyāmyā prakīrtitā .. 5 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
कस्मात्सा कलुषा प्रोक्ता कस्मात्सा गीर्मला मता .
कस्मात्सा प्रेतसंचारा कस्माद्याम्या प्रकीर्तिता .. 5 ..
text_mt:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Why is it called Kaluṣā? Why is it considered Gīrmalā?
Why is it Pretasaṃcārā, and why is it proclaimed Yamā?

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
purā vṛtravadhe vṛtte prāptarājye puraṃdare ..
brahmahatyāpanodārthamaśvamedhe pravartite .. 6 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
पुरा वृत्रवधे वृत्ते प्राप्तराज्ये पुरंदरे ..
ब्रह्महत्यापनोदार्थमश्वमेधे प्रवर्तिते .. 6 ..
text_mt:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Formerly, when the slaying of Vṛtra took place and Puraṃdara attained his kingdom,
an Aśvamedha sacrifice was undertaken in order to remove the sin of killing a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
krodhādindreṇa vajeṇa brahmahatyā niṣūditā ..
ṣaṭkhaṇḍā ca kṛtā kṣiptā vṛkṣe toye mahītale .. 7 ..
meaning:
क्रोधादिन्द्रेण वजेण ब्रह्महत्या निषूदिता ..
षट्खण्डा च कृता क्षिप्ता वृक्षे तोये महीतले .. 7 ..
text_mt:
Out of anger, the sin of killing a brahmin was struck down by Indra with his thunderbolt,
split into six pieces, and cast into trees, water, and the surface of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
nāryāṃ brahmahane vahnau saṃvibhajya yathākramam ..
tatpāpaṃ śrāvaṇe vyūḍhaṃ dvitīyāyāṃ dinodaye ..8..
meaning:
नार्यां ब्रह्महने वह्नौ संविभज्य यथाक्रमम् ..
तत्पापं श्रावणे व्यूढं द्वितीयायां दिनोदये ..8..
text_mt:
into women, into the murderer of a brahmin, and into fire, having divided it in proper order.
That sin was washed away in Śrāvaṇa at the dawn of the second lunar day.

sanskrit_iast:
nārīvṛkṣanadībhūmivahnibrahmahaneṣvatha ..
nirmalīkaraṇaṃ jātamatorthaṃ kaluṣā smṛtā ..9..
meaning:
नारीवृक्षनदीभूमिवह्निब्रह्महनेष्वथ ..
निर्मलीकरणं जातमतोर्थं कलुषा स्मृता ..9..
text_mt:
Then purification occurred in women, trees, rivers, the earth, fire, and the murderer of a brahmin;
for this reason, it is remembered as Kaluṣā.

sanskrit_iast:
madhukaiṭabhayo rakte purā magneti medinī ..
aṣṭāṃgulā pavitrā sā nārīṇāṃ tu rajo malam .. 4.14.10 ..
meaning:
मधुकैटभयो रक्ते पुरा मग्नेति मेदिनी ..
अष्टांगुला पवित्रा सा नारीणां तु रजो मलम् .. 4.14.10 ..
text_mt:
Formerly, the earth was submerged in the blood of Madhu and Kaiṭabha;
it became pure by eight finger-widths, and for women the menstrual flow is impurity.

sanskrit_iast:
nadyaḥ pūramalāḥ sarvā vahnerdhūmaśikhā malaḥ ..
kaluṣāṇi caraṃtyasyāṃ tenaiṣā kaluṣā matā .. 11 ..
meaning:
नद्यः पूरमलाः सर्वा वह्नेर्धूमशिखा मलः ..
कलुषाणि चरंत्यस्यां तेनैषा कलुषा मता .. 11 ..
text_mt:
Rivers carry floods as impurity; the column of smoke is the impurity of fire.
Impurities wander on this [day], therefore it is regarded as Kaluṣā.

sanskrit_iast:
gīrgirā bhāratī vāṇī vācā medhā sarasvatī ..
gīrmalaṃ vahate yasmādvitīyā gīrmalā matā .. 12 ..
meaning:
गीर्गिरा भारती वाणी वाचा मेधा सरस्वती ..
गीर्मलं वहते यस्माद्वितीया गीर्मला मता .. 12 ..
text_mt:
Gīr, girā, bhāratī, vāṇī, vācā, medhā, and sarasvatī [are speech].
Because this second [lunar day] bears the impurity of speech, it is considered Gīrmalā.

sanskrit_iast:
devarṣipitṛdharmāṇāṃ niṃdakā nāstikāḥ śaṭhāḥ ..
teṣāṃ sā vāgmalavyūḍhā dvitīyā tena gīrmalā .. 13 ..
meaning:
देवर्षिपितृधर्माणां निंदका नास्तिकाः शठाः ..
तेषां सा वाग्मलव्यूढा द्वितीया तेन गीर्मला .. 13 ..
text_mt:
Scoffers, atheists, and rogues who revile the gods, sages, ancestors, and dharma—
their impurities of speech are removed by it; therefore the second lunar day is Gīrmalā.

sanskrit_iast:
anadhyāyeṣu śāstrāṇi pāṭhayaṃti paṭhaṃti ca ..
śābdikāstārkikāḥ śrautāsteṣāṃ śabdāpaśabdajāḥ .. 14 ..
malā vyūḍhā dvitīyāyāmato'rthaṃ gīrmalā ca sā ..14..
meaning:
अनध्यायेषु शास्त्राणि पाठयंति पठंति च ..
शाब्दिकास्तार्किकाः श्रौतास्तेषां शब्दापशब्दजाः .. 14 ..
मला व्यूढा द्वितीयायामतोऽर्थं गीर्मला च सा ..14..
text_mt:
Grammarians, logicians, and Vedic scholars who study and teach the sacred texts
on days when study is forbidden—their impurities born from correct and incorrect words
are washed away on the second lunar day; therefore it is Gīrmalā.

sanskrit_iast:
pretāstu pitaraḥ proktāsteṣāṃ tasyāṃ tu saṃcaraḥ ..
dvitīyāyāṃ ca lokeṣu tena sā pretasaṃcarā .. 15 ..
meaning:
प्रेतास्तु पितरः प्रोक्तास्तेषां तस्यां तु संचरः ..
द्वितीयायां च लोकेषु तेन सा प्रेतसंचरा .. 15 ..
text_mt:
The ancestors are declared to be pretas, and their wandering takes place on that day,
on the second lunar day in the worlds; therefore it is Pretasaṃcarā.

sanskrit_iast:
agniṣvāttā barhiṣada ājyapāḥ somapāstathā .. 16 ..
pitṛpitāmahapretasaṃcarātpretasaṃcarā .. 16 ..
meaning:
अग्निष्वात्ता बर्हिषद आज्यपाः सोमपास्तथा .. 16 ..
पितृपितामहप्रेतसंचरात्प्रेतसंचरा .. 16 ..
text_mt:
The Agniṣvāttas, the Barhiṣads, the Ājyapas, and the Somapas—
it is called Pretasaṃcarā from the wandering of the deceased fathers and grandfathers.

sanskrit_iast:
putraiḥ pautraiśca dauhitraiḥ svadhāmaṃtraiḥ supūjitāḥ ..
śrāddhadānamakhaistṛptā yātyataḥ pretasaṃcarāḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
पुत्रैः पौत्रैश्च दौहित्रैः स्वधामंत्रैः सुपूजिताः ..
श्राद्धदानमखैस्तृप्ता यात्यतः प्रेतसंचराः .. 17 ..
text_mt:
Well-worshipped with svadhā mantras by sons, grandsons, and daughter’s sons,
satisfied with śrāddhas, gifts, and sacrifices, the wandering ancestors depart thence.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtike śuklapakṣasya dvitīyāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ..
yamo yamunayā pūrvaṃ bhojitaḥ svagṛhe tadā .. 18 ..
meaning:
कार्तिके शुक्लपक्षस्य द्वितीयायां युधिष्ठिर ..
यमो यमुनया पूर्वं भोजितः स्वगृहे तदा .. 18 ..
text_mt:
On the second lunar day of the bright fortnight in Kārtika, O Yudhiṣṭhira,
Yama was formerly fed at home by Yamunā.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyāyāṃ mahotsarge nārakīyāśca tarpitāḥ ..
pāpebhyo vipramuktāste muktāḥ sarve vibaṃdhanāḥ ..
bhrāmitā nartitāstuṣṭāḥ sthitāḥ sarve yadṛcchayā ..19..
meaning:
द्वितीयायां महोत्सर्गे नारकीयाश्च तर्पिताः ..
पापेभ्यो विप्रमुक्तास्ते मुक्ताः सर्वे विबंधनाः ..
भ्रामिता नर्तितास्तुष्टाः स्थिताः सर्वे यदृच्छया ..19..

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ mahotsavo vṛtto yamarāṣṭre sukhāvahaḥ ..
tato yamadvitīyā sā proktā loke yudhiṣṭhira .. 4.14.20 ..
meaning:
तेषां महोत्सवो वृत्तो यमराष्ट्रे सुखावहः ..
ततो यमद्वितीया सा प्रोक्ता लोके युधिष्ठिर .. 4.14.20 ..
text_mt:
A great festival took place for them, bringing happiness in Yama’s realm;
hence it is known in the world as Yama-dvitīyā, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāṃ nijagṛhe pārtha na bhoktavyamato budhaiḥ ..
snehena bhaginīhastādbhoktavyaṃ puṣṭivarddhanam .. 21 ..
meaning:
अस्यां निजगृहे पार्थ न भोक्तव्यमतो बुधैः ..
स्नेहेन भगिनीहस्ताद्भोक्तव्यं पुष्टिवर्द्धनम् .. 21 ..
text_mt:
Therefore, O son of Pṛthā, the wise should not eat in their own house on this day;
out of love, one should eat from the hand of a sister, which increases strength.

sanskrit_iast:
dānāni ca pradeyāni bhaginībhyo vidhānataḥ ..
svarṇālaṃkāravastrādyaiḥ pūjāsatkārabhojanaiḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
दानानि च प्रदेयानि भगिनीभ्यो विधानतः ..
स्वर्णालंकारवस्त्राद्यैः पूजासत्कारभोजनैः .. 22 ..
text_mt:
And gifts must be properly presented to sisters,
with gold, ornaments, garments, and so on, with worship, honour, and feasts.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvā bhaginyaḥ saṃpūjyā abhāve pratipattigāḥ ..
pitṛvyabhaginī hastātprathamāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira .. 23 ..
meaning:
सर्वा भगिन्यः संपूज्या अभावे प्रतिपत्तिगाः ..
पितृव्यभगिनी हस्तात्प्रथमायां युधिष्ठिर .. 23 ..
text_mt:
All sisters should be worshipped, or in their absence, those treated as such:
on the first, from the hand of a paternal uncle’s sister, O Yudhiṣṭhira;

sanskrit_iast:
mātulasya sutāhastādvitīyāyāṃ punarnṛpa ..
pitṛmātṛsvasārau ye tṛtīyāyāṃ tayoḥ karāt .. 24 ..
meaning:
मातुलस्य सुताहस्ताद्वितीयायां पुनर्नृप ..
पितृमातृस्वसारौ ये तृतीयायां तयोः करात् .. 24 ..
text_mt:
on the second, O king, from the hand of a maternal uncle’s daughter;
on the third, from the hand of the two who are paternal and maternal aunts;

sanskrit_iast:
bhoktavyaṃ sahajāyāśca bhaginyā hastataḥ param ..
sarvāsu bhaginīhastādbhoktavyaṃ balavarddhanam .. ..25..
meaning:
भोक्तव्यं सहजायाश्च भगिन्या हस्ततः परम् ..
सर्वासु भगिनीहस्ताद्भोक्तव्यं बलवर्द्धनम् .. ..25..
text_mt:
and next, one should eat from the hand of one’s own sister.
Eating from the hand of any sister promotes strength.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ dharmakāmārthavarddhanam ..
vyākhyātaṃ sakalaṃ snehātsarahasyaṃ mayā tava ..26..
meaning:
धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं धर्मकामार्थवर्द्धनम् ..
व्याख्यातं सकलं स्नेहात्सरहस्यं मया तव ..26..
text_mt:
It is fortunate, brings fame, grants long life, and increases dharma, kāma, and artha.
Everything, along with the secret, has been explained by me out of love for you.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāṃ tithau yamunayā yamarājadevaḥ sambhojito jagati sattvarasauhṛdena ..
tasyāṃ svasuḥ karatalādiha yo bhunakti prāpnoti vittamatha bhojyamanuttamaṃ saḥ .. 27 ..
aśūnyaśayanamāhātmyavarṇanam
meaning:
यस्यां तिथौ यमुनया यमराजदेवः सम्भोजितो जगति सत्त्वरसौहृदेन ..
तस्यां स्वसुः करतलादिह यो भुनक्ति प्राप्नोति वित्तमथ भोज्यमनुत्तमं सः .. 27 ..
अशून्यशयनमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
text_mt:
On that lunar day when Lord Yamarāja was served food in the world by Yamunā with quick affection,
whoever eats here from the palm of his sister's hand obtains wealth and peerless food.
Description of the Greatness of the Aśūnyaśayana [Vrata]

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
bhagavanbhavatā proktaṃ dharmārthādeḥ susādhanam ..
gārhasthyaṃ tacca bhavati daṃpatyoḥ prīyamāṇayoḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
भगवन्भवता प्रोक्तं धर्मार्थादेः सुसाधनम् ..
गार्हस्थ्यं तच्च भवति दंपत्योः प्रीयमाणयोः .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Lord, you have spoken of the householder's life as the excellent means to attain dharma, artha, and the rest,
and that is achieved when husband and wife are mutually affectionate.
title: Aśūnyaśayanavratamāhātmyam

sanskrit_iast:
patnīhīnaḥ pumānpatnī bhartrā virahitā tathā ..
dharmakāmārthasaṃsiddhī na syātāṃ madhusūdana .. 2.
meaning:
पत्नीहीनः पुमान्पत्नी भर्त्रा विरहिता तथा ..
धर्मकामार्थसंसिद्धी न स्यातां मधुसूदन .. 2.
text_mt:
A man without a wife, and likewise a wife deprived of her husband,
would not attain success in dharma, kāma, and artha, O Madhusūdana.

sanskrit_iast:
tadbrūhi devadeveśa vidhavā strī na jāyate ..
vratena yena goviṃda patnyā'virahito naraḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
तद्ब्रूहि देवदेवेश विधवा स्त्री न जायते ..
व्रतेन येन गोविंद पत्न्याऽविरहितो नरः .. 3 ..
text_mt:
Therefore, O Lord of the gods of gods, tell [me] that vrata by which a woman does not become a widow,
and a man, O Govinda, is not separated from his wife.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
aśūnyaśayanīṃ nāma dvitīyāṃ śṛṇu tāṃ mama ..
yāmupoṣya na vaidhavyaṃ prāpnoti strī yudhiṣṭhira .. 4 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
अशून्यशयनीं नाम द्वितीयां शृणु तां मम ..
यामुपोष्य न वैधव्यं प्राप्नोति स्त्री युधिष्ठिर .. 4 ..
text_mt:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Hear from me of that second lunar day called Aśūnyaśayanī,
observing a fast upon which, a woman does not incur widowhood, O Yudhiṣṭhira,

sanskrit_iast:
patnīvimuktaśca naro na kadācitprajāyate ..
śete jagatpatirviṣṇuḥ striyā sārddhaṃ yadā kila .. 5 ..
meaning:
पत्नीविमुक्तश्च नरो न कदाचित्प्रजायते ..
शेते जगत्पतिर्विष्णुः स्त्रिया सार्द्धं यदा किल .. 5 ..
text_mt:
nor is a man ever abandoned by his wife.
When indeed Viṣṇu, Lord of the Universe, sleeps with his wife,

sanskrit_iast:
aśūnyaśayanaṃ nāma tadā grāhyā ca sā tithiḥ ..
upavāsena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca .. 6 ..
meaning:
अशून्यशयनं नाम तदा ग्राह्या च सा तिथिः ..
उपवासेन नक्तेन तथैवायाचितेन च .. 6 ..
text_mt:
that lunar day is then to be observed as Aśūnyaśayana,
by fasting, by eating only at night, or by consuming only unasked-for food.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇapakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ śrāvaṇe nṛpasattama ..
snānaṃ nadyāṃ taḍāge vā gṛhe vā niyatātmavān .. 7 ..
meaning:
कृष्णपक्षे द्वितीयायां श्रावणे नृपसत्तम ..
स्नानं नद्यां तडागे वा गृहे वा नियतात्मवान् .. 7 ..
text_mt:
On the second lunar day of the dark fortnight in Śrāvaṇa, O best of kings,
having bathed in a river, a pond, or at home, self-controlled,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā pitṝnmanuṣyāṃśca devānsaṃ tarpya bhaktimān ..
sthaṃḍilaṃ caturasraṃ tu mṛnmayaṃ kārayettataḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा पितॄन्मनुष्यांश्च देवान्सं तर्प्य भक्तिमान् ..
स्थंडिलं चतुरस्रं तु मृन्मयं कारयेत्ततः .. 8 ..
text_mt:
and having gratified the ancestors, humans, and gods with devotion,
one should then construct a four-sided earthen altar.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrasthaṃ śrīdharaṃ śrīśaṃ bhaktyābhyarcya śriyā saha ..
naivedyapuṣpadhūpādyaiḥ phalaiḥ kālodbhavaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
तत्रस्थं श्रीधरं श्रीशं भक्त्याभ्यर्च्य श्रिया सह ..
नैवेद्यपुष्पधूपाद्यैः फलैः कालोद्भवैः शुभैः .. 9 ..
text_mt:
There, having worshipped with devotion Śrīdhara, Lord of Śrī, together with Śrī,
with offerings of food, flowers, incense, and auspicious seasonal fruits,

sanskrit_iast:
imamuccārayenmaṃtraṃ praṇamya jagataḥ patim ..
śrīvatsadhāriñchrīkāṃta śrīdhāmañchrīpate'vyaya .. 4.15.10 ..
meaning:
इममुच्चारयेन्मंत्रं प्रणम्य जगतः पतिम् ..
श्रीवत्सधारिञ्छ्रीकांत श्रीधामञ्छ्रीपतेऽव्यय .. 4.15.10 ..
text_mt:
bowing to the Lord of the Universe, one should recite this mantra:
'O wearer of the Śrīvatsa, O beloved of Śrī, O abode of Śrī, O Lord of Śrī, O imperishable one!

sanskrit_iast:
gārhasthyaṃ mā praṇāśaṃ me yātu dharmārthakāmadam ..
agnayo mā praṇaśyaṃtu mā praṇaśyantu devatāḥ ..
pitaro mā praṇaśyaṃtu matto dāṃpatyabhedataḥ ..11..
meaning:
गार्हस्थ्यं मा प्रणाशं मे यातु धर्मार्थकामदम् ..
अग्नयो मा प्रणश्यंतु मा प्रणश्यन्तु देवताः ..
पितरो मा प्रणश्यंतु मत्तो दांपत्यभेदतः ..11..

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmyā viyujyate kṛṣṇa na kadācidyathā bhavān ..
tathā kalatrasambandho deva mā me praṇaśyatu .. 12 ..
meaning:
लक्ष्म्या वियुज्यते कृष्ण न कदाचिद्यथा भवान् ..
तथा कलत्रसम्बन्धो देव मा मे प्रणश्यतु .. 12 ..
text_mt:
Just as you, O Kṛṣṇa, are never separated from Lakṣmī,
so, O God, may my union with my wife never perish!'

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmyā na śūnyaṃ varada yathā te śayanaṃ sadā ..
śayyā mamāpyaśūnyāstu tathā janmanijanmani .. 13 ..
meaning:
लक्ष्म्या न शून्यं वरद यथा ते शयनं सदा ..
शय्या ममाप्यशून्यास्तु तथा जन्मनिजन्मनि .. 13 ..
text_mt: O giver of boons, just as your bed is never devoid of Lakṣmī, / so may my bed also never be devoid [of a spouse] in birth after birth.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ prasādya pūjāṃ ca kṛtvā lakṣmyā harestathā ..
candrodaye snānapūrvaṃ pañcagavyena saṃyutam ..
viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātsva śaktyā phalasaṃyutām .. 14 ..
meaning:
एवं प्रसाद्य पूजां च कृत्वा लक्ष्म्या हरेस्तथा ..
चन्द्रोदये स्नानपूर्वं पञ्चगव्येन संयुतम् ..
विप्राय दक्षिणां दद्यात्स्व शक्त्या फलसंयुताम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Having thus propitiated [them] and worshipped Lakṣmī and Hari, / at moonrise, preceded by bathing and together with the five products of the cow, / one should give a sacrificial fee to a brahmin according to one's capacity, along with fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
anenavidhinā rājanyāvanmāsacatuṣṭayam ..
kṛṣṇapakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ prāguktavidhimācaret .. 15 ..
meaning:
अनेनविधिना राजन्यावन्मासचतुष्टयम् ..
कृष्णपक्षे द्वितीयायां प्रागुक्तविधिमाचरेत् .. 15 ..
text_mt: By this procedure, O king, for four months, / on the second day of the dark fortnight, one should perform the rite mentioned earlier.

sanskrit_iast:
kārttike cātha saṃprāpte śayyāṃ śrīkāṃtasaṃyutām ..
sopaskarāṃ sodakuṃbhāṃ sānnāṃ dadyāddvijātaye .. 16 ..
meaning:
कार्त्तिके चाथ संप्राप्ते शय्यां श्रीकांतसंयुताम् ..
सोपस्करां सोदकुंभां सान्नां दद्याद्द्विजातये .. 16 ..
text_mt: And when Kārttika arrives, one should give a bed accompanied by [an image of] the husband of Śrī, / provided with furnishings, a water-pot, and cooked food, to a twice-born man.

sanskrit_iast:
pratimāsaṃ ca somāya arghyaṃ dadyātsamaṃtrakam ..
dadhyakṣatairmūla phalai ratnaiḥ sauvarṇabhājanaiḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
प्रतिमासं च सोमाय अर्घ्यं दद्यात्समंत्रकम् ..
दध्यक्षतैर्मूल फलै रत्नैः सौवर्णभाजनैः .. 17 ..
text_mt: And each month one should offer an arghya to Soma with mantras, / with curd, unbroken rice grains, roots, fruits, and jewels, using golden vessels:

sanskrit_iast:
gaganāṃgaṇasaddīpa durābdhimathanodbhava ..
ābhāsitadigābhoga ramānuja namostu te .. 18 ..
meaning:
गगनांगणसद्दीप दुराब्धिमथनोद्भव ..
आभासितदिगाभोग रमानुज नमोस्तु ते .. 18 ..
text_mt: “O noble lamp in the courtyard of the sky, born of the churning of the milk ocean, / O illuminator of the expanse of the directions, O younger brother of Ramā, reverence to you!”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ karoti yaḥ samyaṅnaro māsacatuṣṭayam ..
tasya janmatrayaṃ yāvadgṛhabhaṅgo na jāyate .. 19 ..
meaning:
एवं करोति यः सम्यङ्नरो मासचतुष्टयम् ..
तस्य जन्मत्रयं यावद्गृहभङ्गो न जायते .. 19 ..
text_mt: A man who performs this properly for four months / suffers no destruction of his household for three lifetimes.

sanskrit_iast:
aśūnyaśayanaścaiva dharmakāmārthasādhakaḥ ..
bhavatyavyāhataiśvaryaḥ puruṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 4.15.20 ..
meaning:
अशून्यशयनश्चैव धर्मकामार्थसाधकः ..
भवत्यव्याहतैश्वर्यः पुरुषो नात्र संशयः .. 4.15.20 ..
text_mt: His bed is never empty, he accomplishes virtue, desire, and wealth, / and his prosperity remains unimpeded—a man becomes such; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
nārī ca pārtha dharmajñā vratametadyathāvidhi ..
yā karoti na sā śocyā bandhuvargasya jāyate .. 21 ..
meaning:
नारी च पार्थ धर्मज्ञा व्रतमेतद्यथाविधि ..
या करोति न सा शोच्या बन्धुवर्गस्य जायते .. 21 ..
text_mt: And a woman, O Pārtha, who knows dharma and performs this votive observance according to rule, / does not become a source of sorrow for her circle of kin.

sanskrit_iast:
vaidhavyaṃ durbhagatvaṃ ca bhartṛtyāgaṃ ca sattama ..
prāpnoti janmatritayaṃ na sā pāṃḍukulodvaha .. 22 ..
meaning:
वैधव्यं दुर्भगत्वं च भर्तृत्यागं च सत्तम ..
प्राप्नोति जन्मत्रितयं न सा पांडुकुलोद्वह .. 22 ..
text_mt: Widowhood, misfortune, and abandonment by a husband— / these she does not encounter for three lifetimes, O best of men, O uplifter of the Pāṇḍu lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā hyaśūnyaśayanā nṛpate dvitīyā khyātā samastakaluṣāpaharā'dvitīyā ..
etāṃ samācarati yaḥ puruṣo'tha yoṣitprāpnotyasau śayanamagryamahārhabhogyam .. 23 ..
madhūkatṛtīyāvratavarṇanam
meaning:
एषा ह्यशून्यशयना नृपते द्वितीया ख्याता समस्तकलुषापहराऽद्वितीया ..
एतां समाचरति यः पुरुषोऽथ योषित्प्राप्नोत्यसौ शयनमग्र्यमहार्हभोग्यम् .. 23 ..
मधूकतृतीयाव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Indeed, O king, this is celebrated as the Aśūnyaśayanā Dvitīyā, unequalled, dispelling all sins; / whatever man or woman observes it attains an excellent bed worthy of high enjoyment.
Description of the Madhūkatṛtīyā Votive Observance

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
phālgune'pyasite pakṣe tṛtīyāyāmupoṣitā ..
prātaḥ sthitvā brahmacarye jaṭāmukuṭaśobhitā .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
फाल्गुनेऽप्यसिते पक्षे तृतीयायामुपोषिता ..
प्रातः स्थित्वा ब्रह्मचर्ये जटामुकुटशोभिता .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Fasting also on the third lunar day in the dark fortnight of Phālguna, / abiding in chastity in the morning, adorned with a crest of matted hair,
title: Madhūkatṛtīyāvratavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
godhārathagatāṃ devīṃ rudradhyānaparāyaṇām ..
pūjayedgandhakusumairdīpālaktakacaṃdanaiḥ ..
kesarairmadhurairdravyaiḥ svarṇamāṇikyapūjayā .. 2 ..
meaning:
गोधारथगतां देवीं रुद्रध्यानपरायणाम् ..
पूजयेद्गन्धकुसुमैर्दीपालक्तकचंदनैः ..
केसरैर्मधुरैर्द्रव्यैः स्वर्णमाणिक्यपूजया .. 2 ..
text_mt: one should worship the goddess mounted on an iguana-chariot, devoted to meditation on Rudra, / with perfumes, flowers, lamps, red lac, sandal-paste, / saffron, sweet substances, and an offering of gold and rubies:

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ bhūṣikā devabhūṣā ca bhūṣikā lalitā umā ..
tapovanaratā gaurī saubhāgyaṃ me prayacchatu .. 3 ..
meaning:
ओं भूषिका देवभूषा च भूषिका ललिता उमा ..
तपोवनरता गौरी सौभाग्यं मे प्रयच्छतु .. 3 ..
text_mt: “Oṃ, O Adorner, O Ornament of the gods, O Lalitā, O Umā, / O Gaurī delighting in the penance grove, grant me good fortune!

sanskrit_iast:
daurbhāgyaṃ me śamayatu suprasannamanāḥ sadā ..
avaidhavyaṃ kule janma dadātvaparajanmani .. 4 ..
meaning:
दौर्भाग्यं मे शमयतु सुप्रसन्नमनाः सदा ..
अवैधव्यं कुले जन्म ददात्वपरजन्मनि .. 4 ..
text_mt: May she, with an ever gracious mind, pacify my misfortune; / may she grant me freedom from widowhood and birth in a noble lineage in the next life.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgeṅge ca mamopāṅge parvepave sthitāmṛtam ..
sukhadṛṣṭisparśarasaṃ gaurī saubhāgyaṃ yacchatu .. 5 ..
meaning:
अङ्गेङ्गे च ममोपाङ्गे पर्वेपवे स्थितामृतम् ..
सुखदृष्टिस्पर्शरसं गौरी सौभाग्यं यच्छतु .. 5 ..
text_mt: In my every limb, sub-limb, and joint, where nectar resides, / may Gaurī grant good fortune endowed with the pleasure of sight, touch, and taste!”

sanskrit_iast:
evamuccārya maṃtrāṃśca nārījñānavatī satī ..
pūjayedbrāhmaṇoktaistu maṃtrairmukhasuvāsinī .. 6 ..
meaning:
एवमुच्चार्य मंत्रांश्च नारीज्ञानवती सती ..
पूजयेद्ब्राह्मणोक्तैस्तु मंत्रैर्मुखसुवासिनी .. 6 ..
text_mt: Having uttered these mantras, the wise, virtuous woman, / sweet-faced, should worship [her] with the mantras spoken by the brahmins,

sanskrit_iast:
jīrakaiḥ kaṭuhuṇḍaiśca lavaṇairguḍasarpiṣā ..
hṛdyairārdraiḥ phalaiḥ svarṇairmanojñaiḥ puṣpabandhanaiḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
जीरकैः कटुहुण्डैश्च लवणैर्गुडसर्पिषा ..
हृद्यैरार्द्रैः फलैः स्वर्णैर्मनोज्ञैः पुष्पबन्धनैः .. 7 ..
text_mt: with cumin, bitter gourds, salts, jaggery, and ghee, / with agreeable fresh fruits, gold, and delightful flower garlands,

sanskrit_iast:
kusumaiḥ. kuṃkumairgandhaiḥ kāleyāgurucandanaiḥ ..
sindūreṇātiraktena vastrairnānāvidhaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
कुसुमैः. कुंकुमैर्गन्धैः कालेयागुरुचन्दनैः ..
सिन्दूरेणातिरक्तेन वस्त्रैर्नानाविधैः शुभैः .. 8 ..
text_mt: with blossoms, saffron, perfumes, kāleya, agallochum, and sandalwood, / with very red vermilion and various auspicious garments,

sanskrit_iast:
netrairanekadeśotthaiḥ pūpakaistilataṇḍulaiḥ ..
aśokaiśca viguṇakairghṛtapūrṇaistu modakaiḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
नेत्रैरनेकदेशोत्थैः पूपकैस्तिलतण्डुलैः ..
अशोकैश्च विगुणकैर्घृतपूर्णैस्तु मोदकैः .. 9 ..
text_mt: with silk cloths born of many lands, cakes, sesamum and rice grains, / with aśoka flowers, doubled pastries, and sweetmeats filled with ghee.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamādinaivedyaiḥ pūjayitvā mahādrumam ..
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām .. 4.16.10 ..
meaning:
इत्येवमादिनैवेद्यैः पूजयित्वा महाद्रुमम् ..
प्रदक्षिणं ततः कृत्वा दत्त्वा विप्राय दक्षिणाम् .. 4.16.10 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped the great tree with these and other offerings, / and then circumambulating it and giving a sacrificial fee to a brahmin,

sanskrit_iast:
etatkaroti yā putrī tṛtīyāvratamuttamam ..
tataḥ prāpsyati duṣprāpyaṃ trailokye śrīdharaṃ prati .. 11 ..
meaning:
एतत्करोति या पुत्री तृतीयाव्रतमुत्तमम् ..
ततः प्राप्स्यति दुष्प्राप्यं त्रैलोक्ये श्रीधरं प्रति .. 11 ..
text_mt: whatever daughter performs this excellent votive observance of the third lunar day / will thereafter attain Śrīdhara, who is difficult to attain in the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
etadvrataṃ mayā khyātaṃ yāsyaṃti śāśvatīḥ samā ..
vyākhyātaṃ kaśyapenādau rukmiṇyā vratamuttamam .. 12 ..
meaning:
एतद्व्रतं मया ख्यातं यास्यंति शाश्वतीः समा ..
व्याख्यातं कश्यपेनादौ रुक्मिण्या व्रतमुत्तमम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: This votive observance has been proclaimed by me; they shall live for eternal years. / This excellent votive observance was initially explained by Kaśyapa to Rukmiṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
yāścariṣyaṃti tāḥ sarvā bhaviṣyaṃti nirāmayāḥ ..
aṅgapratyaṅgasubhagā lokadṛṣṭimanoharāḥ .. .. 11 ..
meaning:
याश्चरिष्यंति ताः सर्वा भविष्यंति निरामयाः ..
अङ्गप्रत्यङ्गसुभगा लोकदृष्टिमनोहराः .. .. 11 ..
text_mt: All those women who perform it will be free from disease, / charming in every major and minor limb, and captivating to the sight of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
sthitvā varṣaśataṃ cānte tato rudrapuraṃ śubham ..
yāsyaṃti haṃsayānena kiṃkiṇīśabdanādinā .. 14 ..
meaning:
स्थित्वा वर्षशतं चान्ते ततो रुद्रपुरं शुभम् ..
यास्यंति हंसयानेन किंकिणीशब्दनादिना .. 14 ..
text_mt: And having lived for a hundred years, at the end they will go to Rudra's auspicious city / on a swan-borne vehicle ringing with the tinkling of small bells.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tvāramayiṣyaṃti svabhartṝnvatsarānbahūn ..
divyabhogabhujo hṛṣṭāḥ siddhyaṣṭakasamanvitāḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
तत्र त्वारमयिष्यंति स्वभर्तॄन्वत्सरान्बहून् ..
दिव्यभोगभुजो हृष्टाः सिद्ध्यष्टकसमन्विताः .. 19 ..
text_mt: There, enjoying divine pleasures, joyful and endowed with the eight supernormal powers, / they will delight their husbands for many years.

sanskrit_iast:
arghaṃ mahārghamaṇikuṃkumakesarāḍhyaṃ sraggaṃdhamugdhamukharāli kulopagītam ..
dattvā phalākṣatayutaṃ madhupādapasya gaurīva lokamahitā bhavatīha nārī .. 16 ..
meghapālītṛtīyāvratavarṇanam
meaning:
अर्घं महार्घमणिकुंकुमकेसराढ्यं स्रग्गंधमुग्धमुखरालि कुलोपगीतम् ..
दत्त्वा फलाक्षतयुतं मधुपादपस्य गौरीव लोकमहिता भवतीह नारी .. 16 ..
मेघपालीतृतीयाव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Having offered an argha rich in costly gems, saffron, and filaments, praised by swarms of humming bees captivated by garlands and perfumes, / together with fruit and unbroken rice grains, to the madhūka tree, a woman becomes honoured in this world like Gaurī.
Description of the Meghapālītṛtīyā Votive Observance

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ..
meghapālīvrata kṛṣṇa kadācitkriyate nṛbhiḥ ..
kiṃ puṇyaṃ kimanuṣṭhānaṃ kīdṛgvallī smṛtā tu sā .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच ..
