किं पुण्यं किमनुष्ठानं कीदृग्वल्ली स्मृता तु सा .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
When is the Meghapālī votive observance performed by men, O Kṛṣṇa? / What is its merit? What is its practice? And what kind of creeper is that celebrated to be?
title: Meghapālītṛtīyāvratavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
āśvayukkṛṣṇapakṣe tu tṛtīyāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ..
meghapālyai pradātavyo bhaktyā strībhirnṛbhistathā .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
आश्वयुक्कृष्णपक्षे तु तृतीयायां युधिष्ठिर ..
मेघपाल्यै प्रदातव्यो भक्त्या स्त्रीभिर्नृभिस्तथा .. 2 ..
text_mt:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
On the third lunar day in the dark fortnight of Āśvayuja, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / an offering must be presented to Meghapālī with devotion by women and men alike.

sanskrit_iast:
argho virūḍhairgodhūmaiḥ saptadhānyasamanvitaiḥ ..
tilataṃḍulapiṃḍairvā dātavyo dharmalipsubhiḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
अर्घो विरूढैर्गोधूमैः सप्तधान्यसमन्वितैः ..
तिलतंडुलपिंडैर्वा दातव्यो धर्मलिप्सुभिः .. 3 ..
text_mt: An argha must be given with sprouted wheat mixed with the seven grains, / or with balls of sesamum and rice grains, by those who desire dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃbūlasadṛśaiḥ parvai raktā vallī samaṃjarī ..
vāṭīṣu grāmamārgeṣu protthitā parvate'pi ca ..4..
meaning:
तांबूलसदृशैः पर्वै रक्ता वल्ली समंजरी ..
वाटीषु ग्राममार्गेषु प्रोत्थिता पर्वतेऽपि च ..4..
text_mt: It is a red creeper with clusters of flowers, with joints resembling betel leaves, / growing in gardens, village roads, and also on mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
meghapālyāṃ dhānyatailaguḍakuṃkumahaimanān ..
padānapi ca kurvaṃti janā vāṇijyajīvanāḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
मेघपाल्यां धान्यतैलगुडकुंकुमहैमनान् ..
पदानपि च कुर्वंति जना वाणिज्यजीवनाः .. 5 ..
text_mt: On Meghapālī, people living by commerce make / payments of grain, oil, jaggery, saffron, and gold.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpaṃ satyānṛtaṃ kṛtvā dravyalubdhāḥ phalānvitāḥ ..
arghyaṃ dattvā meghapālye nāśayaṃti kṣaṇādiha .. 6 ..
meaning:
पापं सत्यानृतं कृत्वा द्रव्यलुब्धाः फलान्विताः ..
अर्घ्यं दत्त्वा मेघपाल्ये नाशयंति क्षणादिह .. 6 ..
text_mt: Those greedy for wealth who have committed sin consisting of truth and falsehood, / having offered an arghya with fruits to Meghapālī, destroy it here in an instant.

sanskrit_iast:
mānonmānairjanma madhye yatpāpaṃ kutracitkṛtam ..
satsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti vratenānena pāṃḍava .. 7 ..
meaning:
मानोन्मानैर्जन्म मध्ये यत्पापं कुत्रचित्कृतम् ..
सत्सर्वं नाशमायाति व्रतेनानेन पांडव .. 7 ..
text_mt: Whatever sin has been committed anywhere in one's life through weights and measures, / all that goes to destruction through this votive observance, O Pāṇḍava.

sanskrit_iast:
meghapālī śubhe sthāne śubhe deśe samutthitā ..
pūjanīyā varastrībhiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpaistathākṣataiḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
मेघपाली शुभे स्थाने शुभे देशे समुत्थिता ..
पूजनीया वरस्त्रीभिः फलैः पुष्पैस्तथाक्षतैः .. 8 ..
text_mt: Meghapālī, arisen in an auspicious spot, in an auspicious place, / is to be worshipped by noble women with fruits, flowers, and unbroken rice grains,

sanskrit_iast:
kharjūrairnālikeraiśca dāḍimaiḥ karavīrakaiḥ ..
gaṃdhadhūpairdadhidīpairvirūḍhairdhānyasaṃcayaiḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
खर्जूरैर्नालिकेरैश्च दाडिमैः करवीरकैः ..
गंधधूपैर्दधिदीपैर्विरूढैर्धान्यसंचयैः .. 9 ..
text_mt: with dates and coconuts, pomegranates and oleanders, / with perfumes, incenses, curds, lamps, and heaps of sprouted grains.

sanskrit_iast:
raktavastraiḥ samācchādya piṣṭātakavibhūṣitām ..
kṛtvārghyaḥ saṃpradātavyo maṃtreṇānena bhārata .. 4.17.10 ..
meaning:
रक्तवस्त्रैः समाच्छाद्य पिष्टातकविभूषिताम् ..
कृत्वार्घ्यः संप्रदातव्यो मंत्रेणानेन भारत .. 4.17.10 ..
text_mt: Covering it with red cloths and decorating it with piṣṭātaka powder, / having prepared the arghya, it is to be offered with this mantra, O Bhārata;

sanskrit_iast:
vedoktena dvijo vidvāṃstacca tasyai nivedayet ..
ityevaṃ pūjayitvā tāṃ meghapālīṃ pumāṃstataḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
वेदोक्तेन द्विजो विद्वांस्तच्च तस्यै निवेदयेत् ..
इत्येवं पूजयित्वा तां मेघपालीं पुमांस्ततः .. 11 ..
text_mt: the learned twice-born should offer that to her with a Vedic mantra. / Having thus worshipped that Meghapālī, a man then...

sanskrit_iast:
nārī vā puruṣavyāghra prāpnoti paramāṃ śriyam ..
sthitvā varṣaśataṃ martye sukhasaubhāgyagarvite .. 12 ..
meaning:
नारी वा पुरुषव्याघ्र प्राप्नोति परमां श्रियम् ..
स्थित्वा वर्षशतं मर्त्ये सुखसौभाग्यगर्विते .. 12 ..
text_mt: or a woman, O tiger among men, attains supreme fortune. / Having dwelt for a hundred years in the mortal world, proud of happiness and good fortune,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇulokamavāpnoti dehāṃte yānasaṃsthitaḥ ..
kulāni sapta nayati svargaṃ svāni rasātalāt ..
uddhṛtya nātra saṃdehastvayā kāryo yudhiṣṭhira .. 13 ..
meaning:
विष्णुलोकमवाप्नोति देहांते यानसंस्थितः ..
कुलानि सप्त नयति स्वर्गं स्वानि रसातलात् ..
उद्धृत्य नात्र संदेहस्त्वया कार्यो युधिष्ठिर .. 13 ..
text_mt: at the end of the body, seated on a celestial vehicle, they reach the world of Viṣṇu. / They lead seven generations of their family to heaven, lifting them up from the underworld; / you should entertain no doubt about this, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit_iast:
naraka bhīrutayā dadāti yo'rghyaṃ phalādyanuyutaṃ nanu meghapāleḥ ..
unmānakūṭakapaṭāni kṛtāni yāni pāpāni haṃti saviteva tamaḥ prarohān .. 14 ..
rūparambhāvratavarṇanam
meaning:
नरक भीरुतया ददाति योऽर्घ्यं फलाद्यनुयुतं ननु मेघपालेः ..
उन्मानकूटकपटानि कृतानि यानि पापानि हंति सवितेव तमः प्ररोहान् .. 14 ..
रूपरम्भाव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Whoever, out of fear of hell, offers an arghya endowed with fruit and other [gifts] to Meghapālī, / destroys sins committed through falsifying weights and dishonest deceit, just as the sun destroys shoots of darkness.
Description of the Rūparambhā Votive Observance

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ..
strīṇāṃ saṃpadyate yena martyaloke gṛhaṃ śubham ..
patiprema tathātyaṃtaṃ tanme brūhi vrataṃ śubham .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच ..
स्त्रीणां संपद्यते येन मर्त्यलोके गृहं शुभम् ..
पतिप्रेम तथात्यंतं तन्मे ब्रूहि व्रतं शुभम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Tell me that auspicious votive observance by which an auspicious household / and boundless love of a husband are obtained for women in the mortal world.
title: adhyāyaḥ 018

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ekadā pārvatīśaṃbhū sthitau munisurāvṛtau ..
kailāsaśikhare ramye nānādhātuvicitrite .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
एकदा पार्वतीशंभू स्थितौ मुनिसुरावृतौ ..
कैलासशिखरे रम्ये नानाधातुविचित्रिते .. 2 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Once, Pārvatī and Śaṃbhu were seated, surrounded by sages and gods, / on the delightful peak of Kailāsa, variegated with manifold minerals,

sanskrit_iast:
nānādrumalatākīrṇe nānāpuṣpopaśobhite ..
munikinnara saṃghuṣṭe geyanṛtyasamākule .. 3 ..
meaning:
नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णे नानापुष्पोपशोभिते ..
मुनिकिन्नर संघुष्टे गेयनृत्यसमाकुले .. 3 ..
text_mt: abounding with various trees and creepers, adorned with diverse flowers, / resounded by sages and kinnaras, and filled with song and dance.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkaraḥ pārvatīṃ prāha kiṃ tvayā sadvrataṃ kṛtam ..
vāmārūpeṇa metyaṃtaṃ priyāsi varavarṇini .. 4 ..
meaning:
शंकरः पार्वतीं प्राह किं त्वया सद्व्रतं कृतम् ..
वामारूपेण मेत्यंतं प्रियासि वरवर्णिनि .. 4 ..
text_mt: Śaṃkara said to Pārvatī: 'What good votive observance was performed by you? / In your fair form, you are exceedingly dear to me, O woman of excellent complexion!

sanskrit_iast:
āgaccha jānudeśaṃ tu suprasannā tathā priye ..
brūhi cāvitathaṃ sarvaṃ tvayā pārvati yatkṛtam .. 5 ..
meaning:
आगच्छ जानुदेशं तु सुप्रसन्ना तथा प्रिये ..
ब्रूहि चावितथं सर्वं त्वया पार्वति यत्कृतम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Come, sit upon my knee, well-pleased, O dear one; / and tell without falsehood everything that was done by you, O Pārvatī.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktā praṇatā bhūtvā gaurī prāha śivaṃ śubhā ..
tṛtīyāyāṃ mayā cīrṇaṃ purā raṃbhāvrataṃ śubham .. 6 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्ता प्रणता भूत्वा गौरी प्राह शिवं शुभा ..
तृतीयायां मया चीर्णं पुरा रंभाव्रतं शुभम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Thus addressed, the auspicious Gaurī bowed and spoke to Śiva: / 'In ancient times, on the third lunar day, I observed the auspicious Rambhā votive observance.

sanskrit_iast:
tena me tvaṃ manohārī bhartā labdhosi śaṃkara..
īśvarī vāpyahaṃ strīṇāṃ tava dehārddhahāriṇī .. 7 ..
meaning:
तेन मे त्वं मनोहारी भर्ता लब्धोसि शंकर..
ईश्वरी वाप्यहं स्त्रीणां तव देहार्द्धहारिणी .. 7 ..
text_mt: By that, you, who captivate the mind, were obtained by me as husband, O Śaṃkara, / and I became the sovereign lady among women, sharing half of your body.'

sanskrit_iast:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
kīdṛśaṃ tadvrataṃ bhadre sarvasaukhyapradāyakam ..
brūhi pārvati yatnena yaccīrṇaṃ pituraṃtike .. 8 ..
meaning:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
कीदृशं तद्व्रतं भद्रे सर्वसौख्यप्रदायकम् ..
ब्रूहि पार्वति यत्नेन यच्चीर्णं पितुरंतिके .. 8 ..
text_mt: The Lord said: / 'Of what kind is that votive observance, O blessed one, which bestows all happiness? / Tell carefully, O Pārvatī, what was observed [by you] near your father.'

sanskrit_iast:
.. gauryuvāca ..
purāhaṃ deva tiṣṭhāmi kumārī bhavane pituḥ ..
himavadgahvare ramye sakhīgaṇasamāvṛtā .. 9 ..
meaning:
.. गौर्युवाच ..
पुराहं देव तिष्ठामि कुमारी भवने पितुः ..
हिमवद्गह्वरे रम्ये सखीगणसमावृता .. 9 ..
text_mt: Gaurī said: / 'In ancient times, O Lord, I stayed as a maiden in my father's house, / in a delightful cave of the Himalayas, surrounded by a company of female companions.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'haṃ menayā proktā svapitrā ca himādriṇā ..
putri rabhāvrataṃ cāryaṃ varasaubhāgyavardhanam .. 4.18.10 ..
meaning:
ततोऽहं मेनया प्रोक्ता स्वपित्रा च हिमाद्रिणा ..
पुत्रि रभाव्रतं चार्यं वरसौभाग्यवर्धनम् .. 4.18.10 ..
text_mt: Then I was told by Menā and by my father, the snow-mountain: / "O daughter, observe the Rambhā votive observance, which increases excellent good fortune,

sanskrit_iast:
yena prārabdhamātreṇa sarvaṃ saṃpatsyate tava ..
saubhāgyaṃ strīgaṇaiśvaryaṃ mahādevīpadaṃ tathā .. 11 ..
meaning:
येन प्रारब्धमात्रेण सर्वं संपत्स्यते तव ..
सौभाग्यं स्त्रीगणैश्वर्यं महादेवीपदं तथा .. 11 ..
text_mt: by merely beginning which everything will be attained by you: / good fortune, sovereignty over groups of women, and the status of Mahādevī."

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ karomi vai mātarmama coktaṃ purastvayā ..
manobhilaṣitaṃ yena yena prāpnomi śaṃkaram .. 12
meaning:
एवं करोमि वै मातर्मम चोक्तं पुरस्त्वया ..
मनोभिलषितं येन येन प्राप्नोमि शंकरम् .. 12
text_mt: "I shall do so indeed, O mother," I replied, "as told by you before me, / so that my heart's desire [is fulfilled], by which I may attain Śaṃkara."

sanskrit_iast:
.. menovāca ..
adya śuklatṛtīyāyāṃ snātvā niyamatatparā ..
kuru pārśveṣu pañcāgnīñjvālamānānhutāśanān .. 13 ..
meaning:
.. मेनोवाच ..
अद्य शुक्लतृतीयायां स्नात्वा नियमतत्परा ..
कुरु पार्श्वेषु पञ्चाग्नीञ्ज्वालमानान्हुताशनान् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Menā said: / 'Today, on the bright third lunar day, having bathed and devoted to religious restrictions, / arrange five blazing fire-offerings around you on every side:

sanskrit_iast:
gārhapatyaṃ dakṣiṇāgnimanyaṃ cāhavanīyakam ..
paṃcamaṃ bhāskaraṃ teja ityete paṃca vahnayaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
गार्हपत्यं दक्षिणाग्निमन्यं चाहवनीयकम् ..
पंचमं भास्करं तेज इत्येते पंच वह्नयः .. 14 ..
text_mt: the Gārhapatya, the Dakṣiṇāgni, and the other, the Āhavanīya; / the fifth is the brilliance of the sun; these are the five fires.

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣāṃ madhyato bhūtvā tiṣṭha pūrvamukhā ciram ..
caturbhujāṃ dhyānaparāṃ paddvayopari saṃsthitām .. 15 ..
meaning:

text_mt:
That [observance] which removes fear, performed by Rambhā and then by Gaurī while residing in the home of the snow-mountain— / whoever diligently performs her votive observance, devoted to righteousness, shall obtain a joy-bestowing husband equal to Brahmā, Īśa, or Keśava.

arghyaṃ pradadyādgṛṣṭyāṃ vā gavāṃ pādeṣu pāṃḍava .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtānaṃ pūjitaṃ labdhvā tataḥ svarge'maro bhavet ..
divyarūpadharaḥ sragvī divyālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ ..14..
meaning:
संतानं पूजितं लब्ध्वा ततः स्वर्गेऽमरो भवेत् ..
दिव्यरूपधरः स्रग्वी दिव्यालंकारभूषितः ..14..
text_mt: Having obtained revered offspring, he then becomes an immortal in heaven, / possessing a divine form, wearing garlands, adorned with celestial ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvairgītavādyena sevyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ ..
divyaṃ yugaśataṃ chittvā tato viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet .. 15 ..
meaning:
गन्धर्वैर्गीतवाद्येन सेव्यमानोऽप्सरोगणैः ..
दिव्यं युगशतं छित्त्वा ततो विष्णुपुरं व्रजेत् .. 15 ..
text_mt: Served by the singing and instrumental music of gandharvas and by hosts of apsarases, / having spent a hundred divine yugas, he goes from there to the realm of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
yo gopadavratamidaṃ kurute trirātraṃ gā vai prapūjayati gorasapūjanācca ..
goviṃdamādipuruṣaṃ praṇataḥ savitrāmālokamuttamamupaiti gavāṃ pavitram .. 16 .. ..
harikālīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
यो गोपदव्रतमिदं कुरुते त्रिरात्रं गा वै प्रपूजयति गोरसपूजनाच्च ..
गोविंदमादिपुरुषं प्रणतः सवित्रामालोकमुत्तममुपैति गवां पवित्रम् .. 16 .. ..
हरिकालीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Whoever performs this Gopada votive observance for three nights and worships the cows through the worship of dairy products, / bowed down to Govinda the primal puruṣa, goes together with the mothers to the cows' supreme, pure realm.
Description of the Harikālī Votive Observance.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śukle bhādra padasyaiva tṛtīyāyāṃ samarcayet ..
sarvadhānyaistāṃ virūḍhāṃ bhūtāṃ haritaśāḍvalām ..
harakālīṃ devadevīṃ gaurīṃ śaṃkaravallabhām .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
शुक्ले भाद्र पदस्यैव तृतीयायां समर्चयेत् ..
सर्वधान्यैस्तां विरूढां भूतां हरितशाड्वलाम् ..
हरकालीं देवदेवीं गौरीं शंकरवल्लभाम् .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
On the third lunar day of the bright fortnight of Bhādrapada, one should worship / the sprouted green pasture that has grown with all kinds of grain, / [as] Harakālī, the goddess of gods, Gaurī, the beloved of Śaṅkara,
title: Harakālītṛtīyāvratam

sanskrit_iast:
gandhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalairdhūpairnaivedyairmodakādibhiḥ ..
prīṇayitvā samācchādya padmarāgena bhāsvatā .. 2 ..
meaning:
गन्धैः पुष्पैः फलैर्धूपैर्नैवेद्यैर्मोदकादिभिः ..
प्रीणयित्वा समाच्छाद्य पद्मरागेन भास्वता .. 2 ..
text_mt: having gratified her with perfumes, flowers, fruits, incenses, and food offerings such as modakas, / and having covered her with a shining ruby,

sanskrit_iast:
ghaṇṭāvādyādibhirgītaiḥ śubhairdivyakathānugaiḥ ..
kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau prabhāte hyudgate ravau .. 3 ..
meaning:
घण्टावाद्यादिभिर्गीतैः शुभैर्दिव्यकथानुगैः ..
कृत्वा जागरणं रात्रौ प्रभाते ह्युद्गते रवौ .. 3 ..
text_mt: keeping vigil at night with bell-ringing, musical instruments, / auspicious songs accompanied by divine tales; then at dawn, when the sun has risen,

sanskrit_iast:
suvāsinībhiḥ sā neyā madhye puṇyajalāśaye ..
tasminvisarjayetpārtha harakālīṃ haripriyām ..4..
meaning:
सुवासिनीभिः सा नेया मध्ये पुण्यजलाशये ..
तस्मिन्विसर्जयेत्पार्थ हरकालीं हरिप्रियाम् ..4..
text_mt: she should be brought by married women into the midst of an auspicious body of water; / in it one should submerge Harakālī, beloved of Hari, O son of Pṛthā.

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
bhagavanharakālīti kā devī procyate bhuvi ..
ārdradhānyaiḥ sthitā kasmātpūjyate strījanena sā ..
pūjitā kiṃ dadātīha sarvaṃ me brūhi keśava.. 5 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
भगवन्हरकालीति का देवी प्रोच्यते भुवि ..
आर्द्रधान्यैः स्थिता कस्मात्पूज्यते स्त्रीजनेन सा ..
पूजिता किं ददातीह सर्वं मे ब्रूहि केशव.. 5 ..
text_mt:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
O blessed one, what goddess on earth is called Harakālī? / Why is she worshipped by women while residing in moist grains? / What does she grant when worshipped here? Tell me everything, O Keśava.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
sarvapāpaharāṃ divyāṃ mattaḥ śṛṇu kathāmimām ..
āsīddakṣasya duhitā kālīnāmnī tu kanyakā .. 6 .
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
सर्वपापहरां दिव्यां मत्तः शृणु कथामिमाम् ..
आसीद्दक्षस्य दुहिता कालीनाम्नी तु कन्यका .. 6 .
text_mt:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Listen from me to this divine tale that destroys all sins: / Dakṣa had a maiden daughter named Kālī,

sanskrit_iast:
varṇenāpi ca sā kṛṣṇā navanīlotpalaprabhā ..
sā ca dattā tryaṃbakāya mahādevāya śūline ..7..
meaning:
वर्णेनापि च सा कृष्णा नवनीलोत्पलप्रभा ..
सा च दत्ता त्र्यंबकाय महादेवाय शूलिने ..7..
text_mt: who was also dark in colour, with the lustre of a fresh blue lotus; / and she was given to the three-eyed Mahādeva, the trident-wielder.

sanskrit_iast:
vivāhitā vidhānena śaṃkhatūryānunādinā ..
yatkuryādāgatairdevairbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca nisvanaiḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
विवाहिता विधानेन शंखतूर्यानुनादिना ..
यत्कुर्यादागतैर्देवैर्ब्राह्मणानां च निस्वनैः .. 8 ..
text_mt: She was married in according with tradition, resplendent with the sounds of conches and trumpets, / and with the chanting of brāhmaṇas alongside the assembled gods.

sanskrit_iast:
nirvartite vivāhe tu tayā sārdhaṃ trilocanaḥ ..
krīḍate vividhairbhogairmanasaḥ prītivardhanaiḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
निर्वर्तिते विवाहे तु तया सार्धं त्रिलोचनः ..
क्रीडते विविधैर्भोगैर्मनसः प्रीतिवर्धनैः .. 9 ..
text_mt: When the marriage had been performed, the three-eyed god with her / disported in various pleasures that increased the joy of the mind.

sanskrit_iast:
atha devasamānastu kadācitsa vṛṣadhvajaḥ ..
āsthānamaṃḍape ramye āste viṣṇusahāyavān .. 4.20.10 ..
meaning:
अथ देवसमानस्तु कदाचित्स वृषध्वजः ..
आस्थानमंडपे रम्ये आस्ते विष्णुसहायवान् .. 4.20.10 ..
text_mt: Then once that god, the bull-bannered one, equal to the gods, / was seated in the delightful assembly pavilion, accompanied by Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrasthaścāhvayāmāsa narmaṇā tripurāṃtakaḥ ..
kālī nīlotpalaśyāmāṃ gaṇamātṛgaṇāvṛtām .. 11 ..
meaning:
तत्रस्थश्चाह्वयामास नर्मणा त्रिपुरांतकः ..
काली नीलोत्पलश्यामां गणमातृगणावृताम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Sitting there, the destroyer of Tripura jokingly called out / to Kālī, who was as dark as a blue lotus and surrounded by the host of mothers and gaṇas:

sanskrit_iast:
ehyehi tvamitaḥ kāsi kṛṣṇāṃjanasamanvite ..
kālasuṃdari matpārśve dhavale tvamupāviśa .. 12 ..
meaning:
एह्येहि त्वमितः कासि कृष्णांजनसमन्विते ..
कालसुंदरि मत्पार्श्वे धवले त्वमुपाविश .. 12 ..
text_mt: “Come, come here! Who are you, coated in black collyrium? / O dark beauty, sit beside me, who am white!”

sanskrit_iast:
evamutkṣiptamanasā devī saṃkuddhamānasā ..
śvāsayāmāsa tāmrākṣī bāṣpagadgadayā girā .. 13 ..
meaning:
एवमुत्क्षिप्तमनसा देवी संकुद्धमानसा ..
श्वासयामास ताम्राक्षी बाष्पगद्गदया गिरा .. 13 ..
text_mt: Her mind thus agitated, the goddess, with anger in her heart, / sighed with copper-red eyes, and in a voice choked with tears,

sanskrit_iast:
ruroda sasvaraṃ bālā tatrasthā sphuritādharā ..
kiṃdaivayogāttāmrā gaurgaurī cetyabhidhīyate .. 14 ..
meaning:
रुरोद सस्वरं बाला तत्रस्था स्फुरिताधरा ..
किंदैवयोगात्ताम्रा गौर्गौरी चेत्यभिधीयते .. 14 ..
text_mt: the young woman, trembling-lipped, wept aloud right there: / “Is a coppery cow called ‘Gaurī’ by some twist of fate?

sanskrit_iast:
yasmānmamopamā dattā kṛṣṇavarṇena śaṃkara ..
harakālīti vāhūtā devarṣigaṇasevitā .. 15 ..
meaning:
यस्मान्ममोपमा दत्ता कृष्णवर्णेन शंकर ..
हरकालीति वाहूता देवर्षिगणसेविता .. 15 ..
text_mt: Because you have compared me to a black colour, O Śaṅkara, / or called me ‘Harakālī’, though I am attended by the hosts of gods and sages,

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāddehamimaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ juhomi jvalite'nale ..
ityuktvā vāryamāṇā tu harakālī ruṣānvitā .. 16 ..
meaning:
तस्माद्देहमिमं कृष्णं जुहोमि ज्वलितेऽनले ..
इत्युक्त्वा वार्यमाणा तु हरकाली रुषान्विता .. 16 ..
text_mt: therefore I shall cast this black body into the blazing fire!” / Having said this, Harakālī, full of wrath though restrained,

sanskrit_iast:
mumoca haritacchāyākāṃtiṃ haritaśādvale ..
cikṣepa doṣaṃ rāgeṇa jvalite havyavāhane .. 17 ..
meaning:
मुमोच हरितच्छायाकांतिं हरितशाद्वले ..
चिक्षेप दोषं रागेण ज्वलिते हव्यवाहने .. 17 ..
text_mt: released her greenish lustrous radiance onto the green pasture; / with passion she threw the blemish into the blazing fire.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ parvatarājasya gṛhe gaurī babhūva sā ..
mahādevasya dehārddhe sthitā saṃpūjyate suraiḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
पुनः पर्वतराजस्य गृहे गौरी बभूव सा ..
महादेवस्य देहार्द्धे स्थिता संपूज्यते सुरैः .. 18 ..
text_mt: She was born again as Gaurī in the house of the king of mountains; / dwelling in half of Mahādeva’s body, she is worshipped by the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sā harakālīti gaurīśasya vyavasthitā ..
pūjanīyā mahādevī maṃtreṇānena pāṃḍava .. 19 ..
meaning:
एवं सा हरकालीति गौरीशस्य व्यवस्थिता ..
पूजनीया महादेवी मंत्रेणानेन पांडव .. 19 ..
text_mt: Thus established as Harakālī, the consort of Gaurī’s lord, / that great goddess must be worshipped with this mantra, O son of Pāṇḍu:

sanskrit_iast:
harakarmasamutpanne harakāye harapriye ..
māṃ trāhīśasya mūrtisthe praṇatāstu namonamaḥ .. 4.20.20 ..
meaning:
हरकर्मसमुत्पन्ने हरकाये हरप्रिये ..
मां त्राहीशस्य मूर्तिस्थे प्रणतास्तु नमोनमः .. 4.20.20 ..
text_mt: “O you born of Hara's rite, O body of Hara, O beloved of Hara, / protect me, O you residing in the lord's form! Salutations, salutations to you who are bowed to!”

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ saṃpūjya naivedyaṃ dadyādviprāya pāṃḍava ..
tāṃ ca prātarjale ramye maṃtreṇaiva visarjayet .. 21 ..
meaning:
इत्थं संपूज्य नैवेद्यं दद्याद्विप्राय पांडव ..
तां च प्रातर्जले रम्ये मंत्रेणैव विसर्जयेत् .. 21 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped her thus, one should give the food offering to a brāhmaṇa, O son of Pāṇḍu, / and at dawn one should dismiss her into pleasant water with this very mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
arcitāsi mayā bhaktyā gaccha devi surālayam ..
harakāle śive gauri punarāgamanāya ca ..22..
meaning:
अर्चितासि मया भक्त्या गच्छ देवि सुरालयम् ..
हरकाले शिवे गौरि पुनरागमनाय च ..22..
text_mt: “You have been worshipped by me with devotion; go, O goddess, to the abode of the gods, / O Harakālī, O Śivā, O Gaurī, and [return] to come again!”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yaḥ pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha harakālīvrataṃ caret ..
varṣevarṣe vidhānena nārī narapate śubhā .. 23 ..
meaning:
एवं यः पांडवश्रेष्ठ हरकालीव्रतं चरेत् ..
वर्षेवर्षे विधानेन नारी नरपते शुभा .. 23 ..
text_mt: O best of the Pāṇḍavas, any auspicious woman who thus performs the Harakālī observance / year by year in accordance with the rules, O king of men,

sanskrit_iast:
sā yatphalamavāpnoti tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa ..
martyaloke ciraṃ tiṣṭhetsarvarogavivarjitā .. 24 ..
meaning:
सा यत्फलमवाप्नोति तच्छृणुष्व नराधिप ..
मर्त्यलोके चिरं तिष्ठेत्सर्वरोगविवर्जिता .. 24 ..
text_mt: hear the fruit that she obtains, O ruler of men: / she remains long in the mortal world, freed from all disease,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhogasamāyuktā sau bhāgyabalagarvitā ..
putrapautrasuhṛnmitranaptṛdauhitrasaṃkulā .. 25 ..
meaning:
सर्वभोगसमायुक्ता सौ भाग्यबलगर्विता ..
पुत्रपौत्रसुहृन्मित्रनप्तृदौहित्रसंकुला .. 25 ..
text_mt: endowed with every enjoyment, proud of the strength of her good fortune, / surrounded by sons, grandsons, well-wishers, friends, great-grandsons, and daughter’s sons.

sanskrit_iast:
sāgraṃ varṣaśataṃ yāvadbhogānbhuktvā mahītale ..
tatovasāne dehasya śivajñānā mahāmune .. 26 ..
meaning:
साग्रं वर्षशतं यावद्भोगान्भुक्त्वा महीतले ..
ततोवसाने देहस्य शिवज्ञाना महामुने .. 26 ..
text_mt: Having enjoyed pleasures on the earth for fully a hundred years, / then, at the end of her body, having attained knowledge of Śiva, O great sage,

sanskrit_iast:
cirabhadrā mahākālanaṃdīśvaravināyakāḥ ..
tadājñākiṃkarāḥ sarve mahādevaprasādataḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
चिरभद्रा महाकालनंदीश्वरविनायकाः ..
तदाज्ञाकिंकराः सर्वे महादेवप्रसादतः .. 27 ..
text_mt: she enjoys perpetual welfare; and Mahākāla, Nandīśvara, and the vināyakas / all become servants to her command, through the grace of Mahādeva.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūrṇasūryagaṇasaptavirūḍhaśasyāṃ tāṃ vai himādritanayāṃ harakālikākhyām ..
saṃpūjya jāgaramanuddhatagītavādyairyacchaṃti yā iha bhavaṃti patipriyāstāḥ .. 28 ..
lalitāvratavarṇanam
meaning:
संपूर्णसूर्यगणसप्तविरूढशस्यां तां वै हिमाद्रितनयां हरकालिकाख्याम् ..
संपूज्य जागरमनुद्धतगीतवाद्यैर्यच्छंति या इह भवंति पतिप्रियास्ताः .. 28 ..
ललिताव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Those women who, having worshipped that daughter of the snow-mountain called Harakālikā, / with shoots of grain sprouted for seven [days] when the company of the sun is complete, keep vigil with restrained song and musical instruments, become beloved of their husbands in this world.
Description of the Lalitā Votive Observance

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ..
atha pṛcchāmi bhagavanvrataṃ dvādaśamāsikam ..
lalitārādhanaṃ nāma māsamāsakrameṇa vā .. 1
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच ..
अथ पृच्छामि भगवन्व्रतं द्वादशमासिकम् ..
ललिताराधनं नाम मासमासक्रमेण वा .. 1
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Now I ask, O Blessed One, about the twelve-month observance / named the worship of Lalitā, or month by month in succession.
title: Lalitātṛtīyāvratamāhātmyam

sanskrit_iast:
.. kṛṣṇa uvāca ..
śṛṇu pāṃḍava yatnena yathā vṛttaṃ purātanam ..
śaṃkarasya mahādevyāḥ saṃvādaṃ kurusattama .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. कृष्ण उवाच ..
शृणु पांडव यत्नेन यथा वृत्तं पुरातनम् ..
शंकरस्य महादेव्याः संवादं कुरुसत्तम .. 2 ..
text_mt: Kṛṣṇa said: / Listen attentively, O Pāṇḍava, to how it took place of old, / the dialogue between Śaṅkara and Mahādevī, O best of the Kurus.

sanskrit_iast:
kailāsaśikhare ramye bahupuṣpaphalopage ..
sahakāradrumacchanne caṃpakāśokabhūṣite .. 3 ..
meaning:
कैलासशिखरे रम्ये बहुपुष्पफलोपगे ..
सहकारद्रुमच्छन्ने चंपकाशोकभूषिते .. 3 ..
text_mt: On the delightful peak of Kailāsa, covered with many flowers and fruits, / shaded by mango trees, adorned with campaka and aśoka,

sanskrit_iast:
kadaṃbabakulāmoda vaśīkṛtamadhuvrate ..
mayūraravasaṃghuṣṭe rājahaṃsopaśobhite .. 4 ..
meaning:
कदंबबकुलामोद वशीकृतमधुव्रते ..
मयूररवसंघुष्टे राजहंसोपशोभिते .. 4 ..
text_mt: where bees were captivated by the fragrance of kadamba and bakula, / resounding with the calls of peacocks, beautified by royal swans,

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgarkṣagajasiṃhaiśca śākhāmṛgagaṇāvṛte ..
gaṃdharvayakṣadevarṣisiddhakinnarapannagaiḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
मृगर्क्षगजसिंहैश्च शाखामृगगणावृते ..
गंधर्वयक्षदेवर्षिसिद्धकिन्नरपन्नगैः .. 5 ..
text_mt: surrounded by deer, bears, elephants, lions, and troops of monkeys, / [and] by gandharvas, yakṣas, divine seers, siddhas, kinnaras, and serpents,

sanskrit_iast:
tapasvibhirmahābhāgaiḥ sevamānaṃ samaṃtataḥ ..
sukhāsīnaṃ mahādevaṃ bhūtasaṃghaiḥ samāvṛtam .. 6 ..
meaning:
तपस्विभिर्महाभागैः सेवमानं समंततः ..
सुखासीनं महादेवं भूतसंघैः समावृतम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: continually attended on all sides by illustrious ascetics, / [to] Mahādeva seated comfortably, surrounded by hosts of ghosts,

sanskrit_iast:
apsarobhiḥ parivṛtamumā natvābravīdidam ..
umovāca ..
bhagavandevadeveśa śūlapāṇe vṛṣadhvaja .. 7 ..
meaning:
अप्सरोभिः परिवृतमुमा नत्वाब्रवीदिदम् ..
उमोवाच ..
भगवन्देवदेवेश शूलपाणे वृषध्वज .. 7 ..
text_mt: and encompassed by apsarases, Umā bowed and spoke this. / Umā said: / O Blessed One, lord of the gods of gods, trident-in-hand, who has a bull on your banner,

sanskrit_iast:
kathayasva maheśāna tṛtīyāvratamuttamam ..
saubhāgyaṃ labhate yena dhanaṃ putrānpaśūnsukham .. 8 ..
meaning:
कथयस्व महेशान तृतीयाव्रतमुत्तमम् ..
सौभाग्यं लभते येन धनं पुत्रान्पशून्सुखम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: tell me, O Great Lord, the excellent tṛtīyā observance / by which a woman obtains good fortune, wealth, sons, cattle, happiness,

sanskrit_iast:
nārī svargaṃ śubhaṃ rūpamārogyaṃ śriyamuttamām ..
evamukto dayitayā bhāryayā prītipūrvakam ..
vihasya śaṃkaraḥ prāha kiṃ vratena tava priye .. 9 ..
meaning:
नारी स्वर्गं शुभं रूपमारोग्यं श्रियमुत्तमाम् ..
एवमुक्तो दयितया भार्यया प्रीतिपूर्वकम् ..
विहस्य शंकरः प्राह किं व्रतेन तव प्रिये .. 9 ..
text_mt: heaven, auspicious beauty, health, and supreme prosperity. / Thus addressed with affection by his beloved wife, / Śaṅkara laughed and said: “What need have you of an observance, my dear?

sanskrit_iast:
ye kāmāstriṣu lokeṣu divyā bhūmyaṃtīrakṣajāḥ ..
sarvepi tena cāyattā vaśyastehaṃ yataḥ patiḥ .. 4.21.10 ..
meaning:
ये कामास्त्रिषु लोकेषु दिव्या भूम्यंतीरक्षजाः ..
सर्वेपि तेन चायत्ता वश्यस्तेहं यतः पतिः .. 4.21.10 ..
text_mt: Whatever desires exist in the three worlds—celestial, earthly, or produced in the intermediate realm— / all are subject to it, and I, being your husband, am in your control.”

sanskrit_iast:
umovāca .. satyametatsureśāna tvayi dṛṣṭe na durlabham ..
kiṃcittribhuvanābhogabhūṣaṇe śaśibhūṣaṇe .. 11 ..
meaning:
उमोवाच .. सत्यमेतत्सुरेशान त्वयि दृष्टे न दुर्लभम् ..
किंचित्त्रिभुवनाभोगभूषणे शशिभूषणे .. 11 ..
text_mt: Umā said: “This is true, O lord of the gods; when you are seen, nothing is difficult to attain / in the expanse of the three worlds, O ornament [of the universe], O moon-adorned one.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktyā striyo hi māṃ deva prajapaṃti śubhāśubham ..
virūpāḥ sulabhāḥ kāścidaputrā bahuputrakāḥ ..12..
meaning:
भक्त्या स्त्रियो हि मां देव प्रजपंति शुभाशुभम् ..
विरूपाः सुलभाः काश्चिदपुत्रा बहुपुत्रकाः ..12..
text_mt: Yet out of devotion, O god, women pray to me in good and bad circumstances: / some are deformed though easily available, some are sonless, some have many sons,

sanskrit_iast:
suśīlāstapasā kāścicchvaśrubhiḥ pīḍitā bhṛśam ..
śaucācārasamāyuktā na rocantetha kasyacit .. 13 ..
meaning:
सुशीलास्तपसा काश्चिच्छ्वश्रुभिः पीडिता भृशम् ..
शौचाचारसमायुक्ता न रोचन्तेथ कस्यचित् .. 13 ..
text_mt: some are well-behaved through asceticism but terribly oppressed by their mothers-in-law, / [and some,] endowed with cleanliness and good conduct, still please no one.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vahuvidhairduḥkhaiḥ pīḍyamānāstu dāruṇaiḥ ..
śaraṇaṃ māṃ prapannāstāḥ kṛpāviṣṭā tato hyaham .. 14 ..
meaning:
एवं वहुविधैर्दुःखैः पीड्यमानास्तु दारुणैः ..
शरणं मां प्रपन्नास्ताः कृपाविष्टा ततो ह्यहम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Tormented thus by manifold harsh sufferings, / they have taken refuge in me; therefore I am filled with pity.

sanskrit_iast:
yena tāḥ sukhasaṃbhogarūpalāvaṇyasaṃpadā ..
putraiḥ saubhāgyavittaughai ryuktāḥ syuḥ surasattama ..
tanme kathaya tattvena vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam .. 15 ..
meaning:
येन ताः सुखसंभोगरूपलावण्यसंपदा ..
पुत्रैः सौभाग्यवित्तौघै र्युक्ताः स्युः सुरसत्तम ..
तन्मे कथय तत्त्वेन व्रतानामुत्तमं व्रतम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: Tell me truly, O best of the gods, the most excellent of observances, / by which they may be endowed with happiness, enjoyment, beauty, grace, prosperity, / sons, good fortune, and abundant wealth.”

sanskrit_iast:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
māghe māsi site pakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ yatavratāḥ..
mukhaṃ prakṣālya hastau ca pādau caiva samāhitāḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
माघे मासि सिते पक्षे तृतीयायां यतव्रताः..
मुखं प्रक्षाल्य हस्तौ च पादौ चैव समाहिताः .. 16 ..
text_mt: The Lord said: / In the month of Māgha, in the bright fortnight, on the tṛtīyā, keeping their vows, / with concentrated minds, having washed their faces, hands, and feet,

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsasya niyamaṃ daṃtadhāvanapūrvakam ..
madhyāhne tu tataḥ snānaṃ bilvairāmalakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..17..
meaning:
उपवासस्य नियमं दंतधावनपूर्वकम् ..
मध्याह्ने तु ततः स्नानं बिल्वैरामलकैः शुभैः ..17..
text_mt: observing the rule of fasting after first brushing their teeth, / then bathing at midday with auspicious bilvas and āmalakas,

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā tīrthajale śubhre vāsasī paridhāya ca ..
sugaṃdhaiḥ sumanobhiśca prabhūtaiḥ kuṃkumādibhiḥ ..18..
meaning:
स्नात्वा तीर्थजले शुभ्रे वाससी परिधाय च ..
सुगंधैः सुमनोभिश्च प्रभूतैः कुंकुमादिभिः ..18..
text_mt: having bathed in sacred water and put on two white garments, / with fragrant flowers and abundant saffron and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
arcayaṃti sadā devi tvāṃ bhaktyā bhaktavatsale ..
karpūrādyaistathā dhūpairnaivedyaiḥ śarkarādibhiḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
अर्चयंति सदा देवि त्वां भक्त्या भक्तवत्सले ..
कर्पूराद्यैस्तथा धूपैर्नैवेद्यैः शर्करादिभिः .. 19 ..
text_mt: they always worship you, O goddess, with devotion, O you who are affectionate to your devotees, / with incense of camphor and the like, and food-offerings of sugar and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
yadṛcchālābhasaṃpannairdhūpadīpārcanādibhiḥ ..
nāmneśānīṃ gṛhītvā tu pratīkṣeddhaṭikāṃ tataḥ .. 4.21.20 ..
meaning:
यदृच्छालाभसंपन्नैर्धूपदीपार्चनादिभिः ..
नाम्नेशानीं गृहीत्वा तु प्रतीक्षेद्धटिकां ततः .. 4.21.20 ..
text_mt: and with worship of incense and lamps obtained as chance provides. / Taking the name Īśānī, one should then await the ghaṭikā.

sanskrit_iast:
pātre tāmramaye śuddhe jalākṣatavimiśrite ..
sahiraṇyaṃ dvijaṃ kṛtvā maṃtrapūrvaṃ samādhinā .. 21 ..
meaning:
पात्रे ताम्रमये शुद्धे जलाक्षतविमिश्रिते ..
सहिरण्यं द्विजं कृत्वा मंत्रपूर्वं समाधिना .. 21 ..
text_mt: In a clean copper vessel mixed with water and unbroken grains of rice, / having honoured a twice-born along with gold, according to the mantra with concentration,

sanskrit_iast:
śirasi prakṣipettoyaṃ dhyāyaṃtī manasepsitam ..
brahmāvartātsamāyātā brahmayonervinirgatā .. 22 ..
meaning:
शिरसि प्रक्षिपेत्तोयं ध्यायंती मनसेप्सितम् ..
ब्रह्मावर्तात्समायाता ब्रह्मयोनेर्विनिर्गता .. 22 ..
text_mt: she should sprinkle the water upon her head, meditating on her heart’s desire: / ‘Arrived from Brahmāvarta, issued from the womb of Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
bhadreśvarā tato devī lalitā śaṃkarapriyā ..
gaṃgādvārāddharaṃ prāptā gaṅgājalapavitritā .. 23 ..
meaning:
भद्रेश्वरा ततो देवी ललिता शंकरप्रिया ..
गंगाद्वाराद्धरं प्राप्ता गङ्गाजलपवित्रिता .. 23 ..
text_mt: thence the goddess Bhadreśvarā, Lalitā, beloved of Śaṅkara, / who reached the earth from Gaṅgādvāra, purified by the waters of the Gaṅgā,

sanskrit_iast:
saubhāgyārogyaputrārthamarthārthaṃ haravallabhe ..
āyātā ghaṭikāṃ bhadre pratīkṣasva namonamaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
सौभाग्यारोग्यपुत्रार्थमर्थार्थं हरवल्लभे ..
आयाता घटिकां भद्रे प्रतीक्षस्व नमोनमः .. 24 ..
text_mt: arrived for the sake of good fortune, health, sons, and wealth, O beloved of Hara; / wait for the ghaṭikā, O auspicious one! Salutation, salutation!’

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā hiraṇyaṃ tattasmai prāśnīyācca kuśodakam ..
ācamya prayato bhūtvā bhūbhisthā kṣapayetkṣapām .. 25 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वा हिरण्यं तत्तस्मै प्राश्नीयाच्च कुशोदकम् ..
आचम्य प्रयतो भूत्वा भूभिस्था क्षपयेत्क्षपाम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Having given that gold to him, she should consume kuśa-water; / having sipped water and become purified, lying on the ground, she should pass the night,

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyamānā umāṃ daivīṃ harite yavasaṃstare ..
dvitīyehni tataḥ snātvā tathaivābhyarcya pārvatīm .. 26 ..
meaning:
ध्यायमाना उमां दैवीं हरिते यवसंस्तरे ..
द्वितीयेह्नि ततः स्नात्वा तथैवाभ्यर्च्य पार्वतीम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: meditating upon the divine Umā on a bed of green barley-grass. / Then on the second day, having bathed and worshipped Pārvatī in the same manner,

sanskrit_iast:
yathāśakti dvijānpūjya tato bhuñjīta vāgyatā ..
evaṃ tu prathame māsi pūjanīyāsi kālike .. 27 ..
meaning:
यथाशक्ति द्विजान्पूज्य ततो भुञ्जीत वाग्यता ..
एवं तु प्रथमे मासि पूजनीयासि कालिके .. 27 ..
text_mt: having honoured the twice-born according to her means, she should eat, restrained in speech. / Thus in the first month you are to be worshipped as Kālikā;

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye pārvatīnāma tṛtīye śaṃkarapriyā ..
bhavānyatha caturthe tvaṃ skadamātātha pañcame .. 28 ..
meaning:
द्वितीये पार्वतीनाम तृतीये शंकरप्रिया ..
भवान्यथ चतुर्थे त्वं स्कदमाताथ पञ्चमे .. 28 ..
text_mt: in the second under the name Pārvatī; in the third as Śaṅkarapriyā; / then in the fourth you are Bhavānī; and in the fifth, Skandamātā;

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣasya duhitā ṣaṣṭhe mainākī saptame smṛtā ..
kātyāyanyaṣṭame māsi navame tu himādrijā ..29..
meaning:
दक्षस्य दुहिता षष्ठे मैनाकी सप्तमे स्मृता ..
कात्यायन्यष्टमे मासि नवमे तु हिमाद्रिजा ..29..
text_mt: in the sixth as the Daughter of Dakṣa; in the seventh she is remembered as Mainākī; / in the eighth month as Kātyāyanī; in the ninth as the Daughter of the Snow-Mountain;

sanskrit_iast:
daśame māsi vikhyātā devi saubhāgyadāyinī ..
umā tvekādaśe māsi gaurī tu dvādaśe parā .. ..4.21.30..
meaning:
दशमे मासि विख्याता देवि सौभाग्यदायिनी ..
उमा त्वेकादशे मासि गौरी तु द्वादशे परा .. ..4.21.30..
text_mt: in the tenth month, O goddess, she is renowned as Bestower of Good Fortune; / in the eleventh month as Umā; and in the twelfth as the supreme Gaurī.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśodakaṃ payaḥ sarppirgomūtraṃ gomaya phalam ..
niṃbapatraṃ kaṃṭakārī gavāṃ śṛṃgodakaṃ dadhi ..31..
meaning:
कुशोदकं पयः सर्प्पिर्गोमूत्रं गोमय फलम् ..
निंबपत्रं कंटकारी गवां शृंगोदकं दधि ..31..
text_mt: Kuśa-water, milk, clarified butter, cow's urine, cow dung, fruit, / neem leaves, kaṇṭakārī, water [washed from] cows' horns, curd,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcagavyaṃ tathā śākaḥ prāśanāni kramādamī ..
māsimāsi sthitā hyevamupavāsaparāyaṇā ..32..
meaning:
पञ्चगव्यं तथा शाकः प्राशनानि क्रमादमी ..
मासिमासि स्थिता ह्येवमुपवासपरायणा ..32..
text_mt: the five products of the cow, and vegetables—these are the foods to be consumed in succession. / Remaining thus month after month, devoted to fasting,

sanskrit_iast:
dadāti śraddhayaitāni vācake brāhmaṇottame ..
kusuṃbhamājyaṃ lavaṇaṃ jīrakaṃ guḍameva ca ..33..
meaning:
ददाति श्रद्धयैतानि वाचके ब्राह्मणोत्तमे ..
कुसुंभमाज्यं लवणं जीरकं गुडमेव च ..33..
text_mt: she faithfully gives these to an excellent brāhmaṇa who recites: / safflower, clarified butter, salt, cumin, and jaggery.

sanskrit_iast:
dattairebhiḥ sūryasthā tvaṃ sūryasthā tuṣyasi priye ..
māsimāsi bhavenmantro gakāro dvādaśākṣaraḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
दत्तैरेभिः सूर्यस्था त्वं सूर्यस्था तुष्यसि प्रिये ..
मासिमासि भवेन्मन्त्रो गकारो द्वादशाक्षरः .. 34 ..
text_mt: When these are given, you who abide in the sun are pleased, my dear. / Month by month there should be the twelve-syllable mantra beginning with the syllable 'ga',

sanskrit_iast:
oṅkārapūrvako devi namaskārāṃta īritaḥ ..
ebhistvaṃ pūjitā maṃtraistuṣyasi vratataḥ priye .. 35 ..
meaning:
ओङ्कारपूर्वको देवि नमस्कारांत ईरितः ..
एभिस्त्वं पूजिता मंत्रैस्तुष्यसि व्रततः प्रिये .. 35 ..
text_mt: preceded by the syllable 'om', O goddess, and declared to end with 'namas'. / Worshipped by these mantras through the observance, you are pleased, my dear.

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭā tvabhīpsitānkāmāndadāsi prītipūrvakam ..
samāpte tu vrate tasminbrāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam .. 36 ..
meaning:
तुष्टा त्वभीप्सितान्कामान्ददासि प्रीतिपूर्वकम् ..
समाप्ते तु व्रते तस्मिन्ब्राह्मणं वेदपारगम् .. 36 ..
text_mt:
And pleased, you grant desired wishes with affection.
When that vrata is completed, to a brāhmaṇa who has mastered the Vedas,

sanskrit_iast:
sahitaṃ bhāryayābhyarcya gaṃdhapuṣpādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
dvijaṃ maheśvaraṃ kṛtvā umāṃ bhāryāṃ tathaiva ca .. 37 ..
meaning:
सहितं भार्ययाभ्यर्च्य गंधपुष्पादिभिः शुभैः ..
द्विजं महेश्वरं कृत्वा उमां भार्यां तथैव च .. 37 ..
text_mt:
having worshipped [him] together with his wife using auspicious perfumes, flowers, and other offerings,
having regarded the twice-born as Maheśvara and his wife as Umā,

sanskrit_iast:
annaṃ sadakṣiṇaṃ dadyāttathā śukle ca vāsasī ..
raktaṃ vāsoyugaṃ dadyāttvāmuddiśya harapriye .. 38 ..
meaning:
अन्नं सदक्षिणं दद्यात्तथा शुक्ले च वाससी ..
रक्तं वासोयुगं दद्यात्त्वामुद्दिश्य हरप्रिये .. 38 ..
text_mt:
one should give food along with a sacrificial fee, and likewise two white garments;
one should give a pair of red garments dedicated to you, O beloved of Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇe śraddhayā yuktastasyāṃ phalamidaṃ śṛṇu ..
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi lokānprāpya parāparān .. 39 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणे श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्यां फलमिदं शृणु ..
दशवर्षसहस्राणि लोकान्प्राप्य परापरान् .. 39 ..
text_mt:
Endowed with faith toward the brāhmaṇa, hear this fruit on that [occasion]:
Having attained higher and lower worlds for ten thousand years,

sanskrit_iast:
modate bhartṛsahitā yatheṃdreṇa śacī tathā ..
mānuṣatvaṃ punaḥ prāpya svena bhartrā sahaiva sā .. 4.21.40..
meaning:
मोदते भर्तृसहिता यथेंद्रेण शची तथा ..
मानुषत्वं पुनः प्राप्य स्वेन भर्त्रा सहैव सा .. 4.21.40..
text_mt:
she rejoices along with her husband, just as Śacī does with Indra.
Having attained human birth once again, together with her own husband,

sanskrit_iast:
puṇye kule śriyā yuktā nīrogā sukhamaśnute ..
sapta janmāni yāvacca na vaidhavyamavāpnuyāt ..41..
meaning:
पुण्ये कुले श्रिया युक्ता नीरोगा सुखमश्नुते ..
सप्त जन्मानि यावच्च न वैधव्यमवाप्नुयात् ..41..
text_mt:
endowed with fortune in a virtuous family, free of disease, she enjoys happiness,
and for seven births she will not suffer widowhood.

sanskrit_iast:
putrānbhogāṃstathā rūpaṃ saubhāgyārogyameva ca ..
ekapatnī tathā bhartuḥ prāṇebhyo'pyadhikā bhavet..42..
meaning:
पुत्रान्भोगांस्तथा रूपं सौभाग्यारोग्यमेव च ..
एकपत्नी तथा भर्तुः प्राणेभ्योऽप्यधिका भवेत्..42..
text_mt:
She attains sons, pleasures, beauty, good fortune, and good health;
and as the sole wife of her husband, she becomes dearer [to him] than life itself.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇuyādvācyamānaṃ tu bhaktyā yā lalitāvratam ..
mayā snehena kathitaṃ sāpi tatphalabhāginī .. 43 ..
meaning:
शृणुयाद्वाच्यमानं तु भक्त्या या ललिताव्रतम् ..
मया स्नेहेन कथितं सापि तत्फलभागिनी .. 43 ..
text_mt:
Whichever woman hears with devotion this Lalitāvrata being recited,
which has been related by me out of love, she too partakes of that reward.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya lakṣalalitāṃ lalitāṃgayaṣṭiṃ gaṃdhodakāmṛtaghaṭīṃ śirasi kṣipedyaḥ..
sā svargametya lalitāsu lalāmabhūtā bhūpādhipaṃ patimavāpya bhuvaṃ bhunakti .. 44 ..
aviyogatṛtīyāvratavarṇanam
meaning:
संपूज्य लक्षललितां ललितांगयष्टिं गंधोदकामृतघटीं शिरसि क्षिपेद्यः..
सा स्वर्गमेत्य ललितासु ललामभूता भूपाधिपं पतिमवाप्य भुवं भुनक्ति .. 44 ..
अवियोगतृतीयाव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Whoever, having worshipped Lalitā a hundred thousand times, whose slender body is lovely, pours a jar of nectar-like scented water upon her head,
she, having attained heaven, becomes an ornament among graceful women, and having obtained a lord of kings as husband, enjoys the earth.
Description of the Aviyogatṛtīyāvrata

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
ihāpi yogamāsādya bhartṛbaṃdhujanaiḥ saha ..
vada nārī naraśreṣṭha vrajedyena śivālayam .. 5 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
इहापि योगमासाद्य भर्तृबंधुजनैः सह ..
वद नारी नरश्रेष्ठ व्रजेद्येन शिवालयम् .. 5 ..
text_mt:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
O best of men, tell by what means a woman, having achieved union with her husband and relatives here,
may go to the abode of Śiva,
title: Aviyogatṛtīyāvratam

sanskrit_iast:
vidhavā ca pare loke bhūyo'pi na viyujyate ..
sukhasaṃdohasaubhāgyayuktā bhavati bhāminī .. 2 ..
meaning:
विधवा च परे लोके भूयोऽपि न वियुज्यते ..
सुखसंदोहसौभाग्ययुक्ता भवति भामिनी .. 2 ..
text_mt:
and, not being a widow in the next world, is not separated again,
[and] the woman becomes endowed with abundant happiness and good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ubhayācaritaṃ yatnādbhavavāglalitāmṛtam ..
labdhvā hi bhavato janma dakṣakopādviyuktayā .. 3 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
उभयाचरितं यत्नाद्भववाग्ललितामृतम् ..
लब्ध्वा हि भवतो जन्म दक्षकोपाद्वियुक्तया .. 3 ..
text_mt:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Carefully [observe] what was performed by both—the lovely nectar of Bhava's words.
For she who had been separated [from him] by the anger of Dakṣa, having obtained birth from you,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāsaubhāgyasaṃdohaṃ dṛṣṭvā devyā mahātmanā ..
aruṃdhatyā vaśiṣṭhena pṛṣṭena kathitaṃ śṛṇu .. 4 ..
meaning:
महासौभाग्यसंदोहं दृष्ट्वा देव्या महात्मना ..
अरुंधत्या वशिष्ठेन पृष्टेन कथितं शृणु .. 4 ..
text_mt:
seeing the vast mass of supreme good fortune of the goddess, was told by the high-souled
Vasiṣṭha when questioned by Arundhatī; listen to it.

sanskrit_iast:
māsi mārgaśire prāpte caṃdravṛddhau śucismitā ..
dvitīyāyāṃ samāsādya naktaṃ bhuṃjīta pāyasam .. 5 ..
meaning:
मासि मार्गशिरे प्राप्ते चंद्रवृद्धौ शुचिस्मिता ..
द्वितीयायां समासाद्य नक्तं भुंजीत पायसम् .. 5 ..
text_mt:
When the month of Mārgaśiras arrives, during the waxing of the moon, she of bright smiles,
having arrived at the second lunar day, should eat a nocturnal meal of milk rice.

sanskrit_iast:
ācamya ca śucirbhūtvā daṃḍavacchaṃkaraṃ namet ..
mudānvitā namaskṛtya vijñāpya parameśvaram .. 6 ..
meaning:
आचम्य च शुचिर्भूत्वा दंडवच्छंकरं नमेत् ..
मुदान्विता नमस्कृत्य विज्ञाप्य परमेश्वरम् .. 6 ..
text_mt:
And having sipped water and become pure, she should bow to Śaṅkara like a staff.
Filled with joy, having paid homage and petitioned Parameśvara,

sanskrit_iast:
audumbaramṛjuṃ gṛhya bhakṣayeddaṃtadhāvanam ..
uttarāśāgataṃ sāgraṃ satvacaṃ nirvraṇaṃ śubham .. 7 ..
meaning:
औदुम्बरमृजुं गृह्य भक्षयेद्दंतधावनम् ..
उत्तराशागतं साग्रं सत्वचं निर्व्रणं शुभम् .. 7 ..
text_mt:
taking a straight udumbara tooth-cleansing stick, she should chew it—
one facing the northern direction, with its tip intact, with its bark, uninjured, and auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyāyāṃ pare vāhni gaurīṃ śaṃbhuṃ ca pūjayet ..
śālipiṣṭamaye kṛtvā rūpe strīpuṃsayoḥ śubhe ..
pātre saṃsthāpya saṃpūjya jāgaraṃ niśi kalpayet .. 8 ..
meaning:
द्वितीयायां परे वाह्नि गौरीं शंभुं च पूजयेत् ..
शालिपिष्टमये कृत्वा रूपे स्त्रीपुंसयोः शुभे ..
पात्रे संस्थाप्य संपूज्य जागरं निशि कल्पयेत् .. 8 ..
text_mt:
On the next day, the tṛtīyā, one should worship Gaurī and Śambhu.
Having made two auspicious figures of a woman and a man out of rice flour,
placing them in a vessel and worshipping them, one should arrange a vigil at night.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhivatpūjayitvā tu śaṃkaraṃ kīrtayatsvapet ..
prabhāte te gṛhītvā tu ācāryāya nivedayet .. 9..
meaning:
विधिवत्पूजयित्वा तु शंकरं कीर्तयत्स्वपेत् ..
प्रभाते ते गृहीत्वा तु आचार्याय निवेदयेत् .. 9..
text_mt:
Having worshipped according to the rules, praising Śaṅkara, one should sleep.
In the morning, taking those two, one should offer them to the teacher.

sanskrit_iast:
bhojayenmṛṣṭamannādyaṃ śivabhaktyā dvijottamān ..
dāṃpatyāni ca tatraiva śaktyā tānyapi bhojayet .. 4.22.10 ..
meaning:
भोजयेन्मृष्टमन्नाद्यं शिवभक्त्या द्विजोत्तमान् ..
दांपत्यानि च तत्रैव शक्त्या तान्यपि भोजयेत् .. 4.22.10 ..
text_mt:
Out of devotion to Śiva, one should feed the best of the twice-born with delicious foods and the like;
and right there one should also feed married couples according to one's capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
pratimāsaṃ prakurvīta vidhinā tena saṃyatā ..
kārtikāṃte tato māsi mārgaśīrṣe samudyamet .. 11 ..
meaning:
प्रतिमासं प्रकुर्वीत विधिना तेन संयता ..
कार्तिकांते ततो मासि मार्गशीर्षे समुद्यमेत् .. 11 ..
text_mt:
Restrained, she should perform this every month according to the rule.
Then, at the end of Kārttika, in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, she should conclude it.

sanskrit_iast:
nāmāni ca pravakṣyāmi pratimāsaṃ kramācchaṇu ..
pūjājāpyanimittaṃ ca siddhyarthaṃ ceti tasya ca .. 12 ..
meaning:
नामानि च प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रतिमासं क्रमाच्छणु ..
पूजाजाप्यनिमित्तं च सिद्ध्यर्थं चेति तस्य च .. 12 ..
text_mt:
And I shall proclaim the names month by month in order; hear them,
for the purpose of worship, recitation of mantras, and the attainment of perfection of that [vrata].

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pauṣe tu saṃprāpte giriśaṃ pārvatīṃ tathā ..
samabhyarcya caturthyāṃ tu paṃcagavyaṃ pibetsudhīḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
एवं पौषे तु संप्राप्ते गिरिशं पार्वतीं तथा ..
समभ्यर्च्य चतुर्थ्यां तु पंचगव्यं पिबेत्सुधीः .. 13 ..
text_mt:
Thus, when Pauṣa has arrived, having worshipped Giriśa and Pārvatī,
the wise one should drink the five products of the cow on the fourth lunar day.

sanskrit_iast:
etatpāraṇamuddiṣṭaṃ mārgādau mārgagocaram ..
na cānyatpañcagavyādi pāvanaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam ..14..
meaning:
एतत्पारणमुद्दिष्टं मार्गादौ मार्गगोचरम् ..
न चान्यत्पञ्चगव्यादि पावनं परमं स्मृतम् ..14..
text_mt:
This is declared to be the breaking of the fast occurring in Mārgaśīrṣa and the others at the beginning;
and no other purifier besides the five products of the cow is considered supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavaṃ caiva bhavānīṃ ca māsi māghe prapūjayet ..
phālgune tu mahādevamumayā sahitaṃ matam .. 15 ..
meaning:
भवं चैव भवानीं च मासि माघे प्रपूजयेत् ..
फाल्गुने तु महादेवमुमया सहितं मतम् .. 15 ..
text_mt:
In the month of Māgha, one should worship Bhava and Bhavānī;
and in Phālguna, Mahādeva together with Umā is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
lalitāṃ śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ caitre saṃpūjayettataḥ ..
sthāṇuṃ vaiśākhamāse tu lolanetrāyutaṃ yajet .. 16 ..
meaning:
ललितां शंकरं देवं चैत्रे संपूजयेत्ततः ..
स्थाणुं वैशाखमासे तु लोलनेत्रायुतं यजेत् .. 16 ..
text_mt:
Then in Caitra one should worship the goddess Lalitā and the god Śaṅkara;
in the month of Vaiśākha, one should sacrifice to Sthāṇu united with Lolanetrā.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhe vīreśvaraṃ devamekavīrāsamanvitam ..
āṣāḍhe paśunāthaṃ ca śaktyā sārddhaṃ trilocanam .. 17 ..
meaning:
ज्येष्ठे वीरेश्वरं देवमेकवीरासमन्वितम् ..
आषाढे पशुनाथं च शक्त्या सार्द्धं त्रिलोचनम् .. 17 ..
text_mt:
In Jyeṣṭha, to the god Vīreśvara accompanied by Ekavīrā;
in Āṣāḍha, to Paśunātha, the three-eyed god, together with his Śakti.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkaṃṭhaṃ śrāvaṇe devaṃ sutānvitamathārcayet ..
bhīmaṃ bhādrapade māsi durgayā sahitaṃ yajet ..
īśānaṃ kārttike māsi śivādevīyutaṃ yajet .. 18 ..
meaning:
श्रीकंठं श्रावणे देवं सुतान्वितमथार्चयेत् ..
भीमं भाद्रपदे मासि दुर्गया सहितं यजेत् ..
ईशानं कार्त्तिके मासि शिवादेवीयुतं यजेत् .. 18 ..

sanskrit_iast:
japyadhyānārcanāyaiva nāmānyetāni suvrata ..
smṛtāni vidhinā rājanvratasiddhirbhaved dhuvam ..19..
meaning:
जप्यध्यानार्चनायैव नामान्येतानि सुव्रत ..
स्मृतानि विधिना राजन्व्रतसिद्धिर्भवेद् धुवम् ..19..
text_mt:
These names are remembered for recitation, meditation, and worship, O you of good vows;
according to rule, O king, the perfection of the vrata will certainly come to be.

sanskrit_iast:
pratimāsaṃ tu puṣpāṇi yāni pūjāsu yojayet ..
tāni kramātpravakṣyāmi sadyaḥ prītikarāṇi vai .. 4.22.20 ..
meaning:
प्रतिमासं तु पुष्पाणि यानि पूजासु योजयेत् ..
तानि क्रमात्प्रवक्ष्यामि सद्यः प्रीतिकराणि वै .. 4.22.20 ..
text_mt:
And the flowers that one should employ in the worships month by month,
those I shall proclaim in order, which truly bring immediate delight.

sanskrit_iast:
ādau nīlotpalaṃ yojyaṃ tadabhāve'parāṇyapi ..
pavitrāṇi sugaṃdhīni yojayedbhaktito'rcane .. 21 ..
meaning:
आदौ नीलोत्पलं योज्यं तदभावेऽपराण्यपि ..
पवित्राणि सुगंधीनि योजयेद्भक्तितोऽर्चने .. 21 ..
text_mt:
At first, the blue water lily should be employed; in its absence, others as well,
pure and fragrant, one should employ with devotion in the worship.

sanskrit_iast:
karavīraṃ bilvapatraṃ kiṃśukaṃ kubjamallikā ..
pāṭalābjakadaṃbaṃ ca tagaraṃ droṇamālatī .. 22 ..
meaning:
करवीरं बिल्वपत्रं किंशुकं कुब्जमल्लिका ..
पाटलाब्जकदंबं च तगरं द्रोणमालती .. 22 ..
text_mt:
Oleander, bilva leaf, kiṃśuka, kubjamallikā,
pāṭalā, lotus, kadamba, tagara, droṇa, and mālatī:

sanskrit_iast:
etānyuktakrameṇaiva māseṣu dvādaśasvapi ..
bhaktyā yojyāni rājendra śivayostuṣṭihetave .. 23 ..
meaning:
एतान्युक्तक्रमेणैव मासेषु द्वादशस्वपि ..
भक्त्या योज्यानि राजेन्द्र शिवयोस्तुष्टिहेतवे .. 23 ..
text_mt:
These very ones, in the stated order, across all twelve months,
should be offered with devotion, O lord of kings, for the satisfaction of the two Śivas.

sanskrit_iast:
vatsarāṃte vitānaṃ ca dhūpotkṣepaṃ saghaṃṭikam ..
dhvajaṃ dīpaṃ vastrayugaṃ śaṅkarāya nivedayet..24..
meaning:
वत्सरांते वितानं च धूपोत्क्षेपं सघंटिकम् ..
ध्वजं दीपं वस्त्रयुगं शङ्कराय निवेदयेत्..24..
text_mt:
At the end of the year, one should offer a canopy, an incense-burner with a bell,
a banner, a lamp, and a pair of garments to Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
snāpayitvā ca liptvā ca sauvarṇaṃ mūrdhni paṅkajam ..
pūpayugmaṃ ca purataḥ śālipiṣṭamayaṃ nyaset .. 25 ..
meaning:
स्नापयित्वा च लिप्त्वा च सौवर्णं मूर्ध्नि पङ्कजम् ..
पूपयुग्मं च पुरतः शालिपिष्टमयं न्यसेत् .. 25 ..
text_mt:
Having bathed and anointed [the liṅga], one should place a golden lotus on its top,
and two cakes made of rice flour in front of it.

sanskrit_iast:
naivedyaṃ śaktito datvā nattvā ca vidhivacchivam ..
kuryānnīrājanaṃ śambhostato gacchetsvakaṃ gṛham .. 26 ..
meaning:
नैवेद्यं शक्तितो दत्वा नत्त्वा च विधिवच्छिवम् ..
कुर्यान्नीराजनं शम्भोस्ततो गच्छेत्स्वकं गृहम् .. 26 ..
text_mt:
Having offered food according to one's capacity and bowed down to Śiva according to rule,
one should perform the lustration of Śambhu; then one should go to one's own house.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra gatvā trikoṇaśca caturasraṃ ca kārayet ..
trikoṇe brāhmaṇī bhojyā caturasre dvijottamāḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
तत्र गत्वा त्रिकोणश्च चतुरस्रं च कारयेत् ..
त्रिकोणे ब्राह्मणी भोज्या चतुरस्रे द्विजोत्तमाः .. 27 ..
text_mt:
Having gone there, one should make a triangle and a square;
in the triangle a brāhmaṇa woman is to be fed, and in the square the best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
vratino bhojayetpaścādvādaśaiva dvijottamān ..
mithunāni ca tāvaṃti śaktyā bhaktyā ca pāṇḍava .. 28 ..
meaning:
व्रतिनो भोजयेत्पश्चाद्वादशैव द्विजोत्तमान् ..
मिथुनानि च तावंति शक्त्या भक्त्या च पाण्डव .. 28 ..
text_mt:
Then the observer of the vrata should feed twelve of the best twice-born,
and as many married couples, according to ability and with devotion, O Pāṇḍava.

sanskrit_iast:
umāmaheśvaraṃ haimaṃ kārayitvā suśobhanam ..
mauktikāni catuḥṣaṣṭistāvato'pi pravālakāḥ ..
tāvaṃti puṣparāgāṇi tāmrapātropari nyaset .. 25..
meaning:
उमामहेश्वरं हैमं कारयित्वा सुशोभनम् ..
मौक्तिकानि चतुःषष्टिस्तावतोऽपि प्रवालकाः ..
तावंति पुष्परागाणि ताम्रपात्रोपरि न्यसेत् .. 25..
text_mt:
Having had a very beautiful Umā and Maheśvara made of gold,
one should place sixty-four pearls, as many corals,
and as many topazes upon a copper vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
vastreṇa veṣṭayitvā ca gandhairdhūpaistathārcayet ..
etatsaṃbhārasaṃyuktamācāryāya nivedayet .. 4.22.30 ..
meaning:
वस्त्रेण वेष्टयित्वा च गन्धैर्धूपैस्तथार्चयेत् ..
एतत्संभारसंयुक्तमाचार्याय निवेदयेत् .. 4.22.30 ..
text_mt:
And having wrapped it with a cloth, one should worship it with perfumes and incenses;
endowed with these provisions, one should present it to the teacher.

sanskrit_iast:
vratināṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca dampatīnāṃ ca bhārata ..
dattvā hiraṇyavāsāṃsi kṣamayetpraṇipatya ca .. 31 ..
meaning:
व्रतिनां ब्राह्मणानां च दम्पतीनां च भारत ..
दत्त्वा हिरण्यवासांसि क्षमयेत्प्रणिपत्य च .. 31 ..
text_mt:
Having given gold and garments to the observers of the vrata, to the brāhmaṇas,
and to the married couples, O Bhārata, one should bow down and ask for their forbearance.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāriṃśattathāṣṭau ca kumbhāṃcchatramupānahau ..
sahiraṇyākṣatānsarvāndadyātpuṣpodakānvitān .. .. 32 ..
meaning:
चत्वारिंशत्तथाष्टौ च कुम्भांच्छत्रमुपानहौ ..
सहिरण्याक्षतान्सर्वान्दद्यात्पुष्पोदकान्वितान् .. .. 32 ..
text_mt: And forty-eight jars, an umbrella, and a pair of shoes, / all accompanied by gold, unbroken rice, flowers, and water, he should give.

sanskrit_iast:
dīnāndhaduḥkhitānāṃ ca taddine vā nivāritam ..
kalpayedannadānaṃ cālocayañchaktimātmanaḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
दीनान्धदुःखितानां च तद्दिने वा निवारितम् ..
कल्पयेदन्नदानं चालोचयञ्छक्तिमात्मनः .. 33 ..
text_mt: And on that day, considering his own capacity, / he should arrange an unhindered gift of food for the poor, the blind, and the afflicted.

sanskrit_iast:
nyūnādhikaṃ ca kartavyaṃ svavittapari māṇataḥ ..
saṃpūrayetkalpanayā vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet ..34..
meaning:
न्यूनाधिकं च कर्तव्यं स्ववित्तपरि माणतः ..
संपूरयेत्कल्पनया वित्तशाठ्यं न कारयेत् ..34..
text_mt: It should be done with more or less according to the measure of one's own wealth; / he should fulfil it with intention, and not practice deceit with wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
aviyogakaraṃ caitadrūpasaubhāgyavittadam ..
āyuḥputrapradaṃ svargyaṃ śivalokapradāyakam .. ... 35 ..
meaning:
अवियोगकरं चैतद्रूपसौभाग्यवित्तदम् ..
आयुःपुत्रप्रदं स्वर्ग्यं शिवलोकप्रदायकम् .. ... 35 ..
text_mt: And this brings non-separation, bestows beauty, good fortune, and wealth, / grants longevity and sons, leads to heaven, and bestows the world of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
samyakpurāṇapatitaṃ vratacaryametattattvaṃ carācaragurorhṛdayaṃgamāyāḥ..
pūjāṃ vidhāya vidhivanna viyogameti sādhvīsvabhartṛsutabandhujanairdhanaiśca..36..
umāmaheśvaravratavarṇanam
meaning:
सम्यक्पुराणपतितं व्रतचर्यमेतत्तत्त्वं चराचरगुरोर्हृदयंगमायाः..
पूजां विधाय विधिवन्न वियोगमेति साध्वीस्वभर्तृसुतबन्धुजनैर्धनैश्च..36..
उमामहेश्वरव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Having duly performed the worship of this real practice of the votive observance found in the Purāṇas, which is dear to the heart of the teacher of the moving and unmoving, / a virtuous woman never meets separation from her husband, sons, kinsmen, or riches.
Description of the Umāmaheśvara Votive Observance

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kena dharmeṇa nārīṇāṃ vratena niyamena ca ..
saubhāgyaṃ jāyate'tīva putrāśca bahavaḥ śubhāḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
केन धर्मेण नारीणां व्रतेन नियमेन च ..
सौभाग्यं जायतेऽतीव पुत्राश्च बहवः शुभाः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / By what virtue, by what votive observance and restriction, / do women obtain great good fortune and many auspicious sons,
title: Umāmaheśvaravratam

sanskrit_iast:
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca vastrāṇi vividhāni ca ..
aviyogaṃ ca satataṃ labhate putrapautrayoḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
धनं धान्यं सुवर्णं च वस्त्राणि विविधानि च ..
अवियोगं च सततं लभते पुत्रपौत्रयोः .. 2 ..
text_mt: wealth, grain, gold, various garments, / and constant non-separation from sons and grandsons?

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu pārtha pravakṣyāmi vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam ..
yatkṛtvā subhagā nārī bahvapatyā ca jāyate .. 3 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
शृणु पार्थ प्रवक्ष्यामि व्रतानामुत्तमं व्रतम् ..
यत्कृत्वा सुभगा नारी बह्वपत्या च जायते .. 3 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Hear, O Pārtha, I will declare the best votive observance among votive observances, / having performed which a woman becomes fortunate and possessed of many children.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca dāsīdāsādikaṃ vahu ..
utpadyate gṛhe yena tadvata kathayāmi te .. 4 ..
meaning:
धनं धान्यं हिरण्यं च दासीदासादिकं वहु ..
उत्पद्यते गृहे येन तद्वत कथयामि ते .. 4 ..
text_mt: I will tell you of that votive observance by which wealth, grain, gold, / and numerous female and male servants are generated in the home.

sanskrit_iast:
umāmaheśvaraṃ nāma apsarobhiḥ purā kṛtam ..
vidyādharaiḥ kinnaraiśca ṛṣikanyābhireva ca ..5..
meaning:
उमामहेश्वरं नाम अप्सरोभिः पुरा कृतम् ..
विद्याधरैः किन्नरैश्च ऋषिकन्याभिरेव च ..5..
text_mt: Named Umāmaheśvara, it was performed in ancient times by apsarases, / by vidyādharas, kinnaras, and daughters of sages,

sanskrit_iast:
rūpiṇyā raṃbhayā caiva sītayā'halyayā tathā..
rohiṇyā damayaṃtyā ca taptayā cānasūyayā .. ..6..
meaning:
रूपिण्या रंभया चैव सीतयाऽहल्यया तथा..
रोहिण्या दमयंत्या च तप्तया चानसूयया .. ..6..
text_mt: and by the beautiful Rambhā, by Sītā, Ahalyā, / Rohiṇī, Damayantī, and the ascetic Anasūyā.

sanskrit_iast:
etābhiścaritaṃ pārtha vrataṃ sarvavratottamam ..
saubhāgyārogyaphaladaṃ dāridryavyādhināśanam .. 7 ..
meaning:
एताभिश्चरितं पार्थ व्रतं सर्वव्रतोत्तमम् ..
सौभाग्यारोग्यफलदं दारिद्र्यव्याधिनाशनम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: By these, O Pārtha, this votive observance, the best of all votive observances, was performed; / it bears the fruit of good fortune and health, and destroys poverty and disease.

sanskrit_iast:
martyaloke striyo yāśca durbhagārūpavarjitāḥ ..
aputrā nirdhanāścaiva sarvabhogavivarjitāḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
मर्त्यलोके स्त्रियो याश्च दुर्भगारूपवर्जिताः ..
अपुत्रा निर्धनाश्चैव सर्वभोगविवर्जिताः .. 8 ..
text_mt: And whatever women in the mortal world are unfortunate, bereft of beauty, / childless, penniless, and devoid of all enjoyments,

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāṃ hitārthaṃ pārvatyā umāmaheśvaraṃ vratam ..
avatāritaṃ purā pārtha na jānaṃtyadhamāḥ striyaḥ ..9..
meaning:
तासां हितार्थं पार्वत्या उमामहेश्वरं व्रतम् ..
अवतारितं पुरा पार्थ न जानंत्यधमाः स्त्रियः ..9..
text_mt: for their benefit the Umāmaheśvara votive observance was brought down in ancient times by Pārvatī, / [yet] base women do not know it, O Pārtha.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaṃ mārgaśire māsi nārī dharmaparāyaṇā ..
śuklapakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāsā jitendriyā .. 4.23.10 ..
meaning:
पूर्वं मार्गशिरे मासि नारी धर्मपरायणा ..
शुक्लपक्षे तृतीयायां सोपवासा जितेन्द्रिया .. 4.23.10 ..
text_mt: First, in the month of Mārgaśira, a woman devoted to righteousness, / fasting and with controlled senses, on the third [lunar day] of the bright fortnight,

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā saṃpūjya lalitāṃ harakāyārdhavāsinīm ..
punaḥ prabhātasamaye snānaṃ cākṛtrime jale ..
kṛtvā devīstarpayitvā idaṃ vākyamudīrayet .. 11 ..
meaning:
स्नात्वा संपूज्य ललितां हरकायार्धवासिनीम् ..
पुनः प्रभातसमये स्नानं चाकृत्रिमे जले ..
कृत्वा देवीस्तर्पयित्वा इदं वाक्यमुदीरयेत् .. 11 ..
text_mt: having bathed and worshipped Lalitā who dwells in half of Hara's body, / having bathed again at dawn in natural water / and gratified the goddesses, should utter these words:

sanskrit_iast:
namo namaste deveśa umādehārddhadhāraka ..
mahādevi namaste'stu harakāyārddhavāsini .. 12 ..
meaning:
नमो नमस्ते देवेश उमादेहार्द्धधारक ..
महादेवि नमस्तेऽस्तु हरकायार्द्धवासिनि .. 12 ..
text_mt: “Homage, homage to you, O Lord of gods, who bear half the body of Umā! / O Great Goddess, homage be to you who dwell in half of Hara's body!”

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdi kṛtvā śivaṃ devīṃ japedyāvadgṛhaṃ gatā ..
pūjayeddevamīśānaṃ puṣpaiḥ kālodbhavaistataḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
हृदि कृत्वा शिवं देवीं जपेद्यावद्गृहं गता ..
पूजयेद्देवमीशानं पुष्पैः कालोद्भवैस्ततः .. 13 ..
text_mt: Holding Śiva and the Goddess in her heart, she should recite [prayers] until she has reached home; / then she should worship the god Īśāna with seasonal flowers:

sanskrit_iast:
vāmapārśve umāṃ devīṃ dakṣiṇe tu maheśvaram ..
dhūpaṃ vā gugguluṃ vāpi dahetpaścātsubhāvitā ..
naivedyaṃ tu yathāśakti ghṛtapakvaṃ nivedayet .. 14 ..
meaning:
वामपार्श्वे उमां देवीं दक्षिणे तु महेश्वरम् ..
धूपं वा गुग्गुलुं वापि दहेत्पश्चात्सुभाविता ..
नैवेद्यं तु यथाशक्ति घृतपक्वं निवेदयेत् .. 14 ..
text_mt: the Goddess Umā on the left side, and Maheśvara on the right. / Filled with devotion, she should then burn incense or bdellium, / and offer an offering of food cooked with ghee according to her capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
kārayedvaiśvadevaṃ tu tilājyena susaṃskṛtam ..
pañcagavyaṃ tataḥ prāśya ātmakāyaviśodhanam .. 15 ..
meaning:
कारयेद्वैश्वदेवं तु तिलाज्येन सुसंस्कृतम् ..
पञ्चगव्यं ततः प्राश्य आत्मकायविशोधनम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: She should have the Vaiśvadeva rite performed, well consecrated with sesame and clarified butter, / and then drink the five cow-products to purify her own body.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dvādaśamāsāṃstu pūjayitvā maheśvaram ..
udyāpanaṃ tataḥ kuryātprahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā .. 16 ..
meaning:
एवं द्वादशमासांस्तु पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम् ..
उद्यापनं ततः कुर्यात्प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना .. 16 ..
text_mt: Having thus worshipped Maheśvara for twelve months, / she should then perform the concluding rite with a joyful heart.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaṃ rūpyamayaṃ kṛtvā umāṃ haimamayīṃ tathā ..
ārūḍhau vṛṣabhe raupye sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitau .. 17 ..
meaning:
शिवं रूप्यमयं कृत्वा उमां हैममयीं तथा ..
आरूढौ वृषभे रौप्ये सर्वालंकारभूषितौ .. 17 ..
text_mt: Having made Śiva out of silver and Umā out of gold, / mounted upon a silver bull, adorned with all ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
candanena śivaṃ carcya kuṃkumena ca pārvatīm ..
arcayetkusumaiḥ paścātsugandhaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
चन्दनेन शिवं चर्च्य कुंकुमेन च पार्वतीम् ..
अर्चयेत्कुसुमैः पश्चात्सुगन्धैः सुमनोहरैः .. 18 ..
text_mt: anointing Śiva with sandalwood and Pārvatī with kumkuma, / she should then worship them with fragrant, delightful flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
veṣṭayecchuklavastreṇa śivaṃ raktena pārvatīm ..
paścāddhūpaṃ dahennārī bhaktibhāvena bhāvitā .. 19 ..
meaning:
वेष्टयेच्छुक्लवस्त्रेण शिवं रक्तेन पार्वतीम् ..
पश्चाद्धूपं दहेन्नारी भक्तिभावेन भाविता .. 19 ..
text_mt: She should clothe Śiva in a white garment and Pārvatī in a red one; / filled with the feeling of devotion, the woman should then burn incense.

sanskrit_iast:
bhojayecchivabhaktāṃśca brāhmaṇānvedapāragān ..
bhaktebhyo dakṣiṇā deyā bhaktyā śāṭhyavivarjitā .. 4.23.20 ..
meaning:
भोजयेच्छिवभक्तांश्च ब्राह्मणान्वेदपारगान् ..
भक्तेभ्यो दक्षिणा देया भक्त्या शाठ्यविवर्जिता .. 4.23.20 ..
text_mt: She should feed devotees of Śiva and brāhmaṇas who have mastered the Vedas; / a priestly fee should be given with devotion to the devotees, free of deceit.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya idamuccārayedbudhaḥ ..
umāmaheśvarau devau sarvalokapitāmahau ..
vratenānena suprītau bhavetāṃ mama sarvadā .. 21 ..
meaning:
ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य इदमुच्चारयेद्बुधः ..
उमामहेश्वरौ देवौ सर्वलोकपितामहौ ..
व्रतेनानेन सुप्रीतौ भवेतां मम सर्वदा .. 21 ..
text_mt: Then, having circumambulated, the wise person should recite this: / “May the two deities, Umā and Maheśvara, the grandparents of all worlds, / be ever well pleased with me through this votive observance.”

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā jitakrodhe brāhmaṇe vedapārage ..
vrataṃ nivedayedbhaktyā vācake vā guṇānvite .. 22 ..
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा जितक्रोधे ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे ..
व्रतं निवेदयेद्भक्त्या वाचके वा गुणान्विते .. 22 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, she should present the votive observance with devotion / to a brāhmaṇa who has subdued his anger and mastered the Vedas, or to a virtuous reciter.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ nārī maheśārpitamānasā ..
prayāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
इदं कृत्वा व्रतं नारी महेशार्पितमानसा ..
प्रयाति परमं स्थानं यत्र देवो महेश्वरः .. 23 ..
text_mt: Having performed this votive observance, a woman with mind fixed on Maheśa / goes to the supreme abode where the god Maheśvara resides.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaloke vasettāvadyāvadindrāścaturddaśa ..
apsarobhiḥ parivṛtā kinnarībhistathaiva ca .. 24 ..
meaning:
शिवलोके वसेत्तावद्यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्द्दश ..
अप्सरोभिः परिवृता किन्नरीभिस्तथैव च .. 24 ..
text_mt: She dwells in the world of Śiva as long as fourteen Indras endure, / surrounded by apsarases and likewise by kinnarīs.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā mānuṣyamāyāti jāyate vimale kule ..
rūpayauvanasaṃpannā bahuputrā pativratā .. 25 ..
meaning:
यदा मानुष्यमायाति जायते विमले कुले ..
रूपयौवनसंपन्ना बहुपुत्रा पतिव्रता .. 25 ..
text_mt: When she returns to human birth, she is born in a pure family, / endowed with beauty and youth, possessed of many sons, and faithful to her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanadhānyasamāyukte suvarṇamaṇimaṃḍite ..
yāvajjīvaṃ gṛhe ramye tiṣṭhatyavyāhatendriyā .. 26 ..
meaning:
धनधान्यसमायुक्ते सुवर्णमणिमंडिते ..
यावज्जीवं गृहे रम्ये तिष्ठत्यव्याहतेन्द्रिया .. 26 ..
text_mt: Endowed with wealth and grain, adorned with gold and jewels, / she remains for all her life in a delightful home, with unimpaired senses.

sanskrit_iast:
viyogaṃ naiva sā paśyedbhartṛmitrasutādikaiḥ ..
mṛtā śivapuraṃ yāti śivagaurīprasādataḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
वियोगं नैव सा पश्येद्भर्तृमित्रसुतादिकैः ..
मृता शिवपुरं याति शिवगौरीप्रसादतः .. 27 ..
text_mt: She never witnesses separation from husband, friends, sons, and the like; / when dead, she goes to the city of Śiva by the grace of Śiva and Gaurī.

sanskrit_iast:
haimīmumāṃ rajatapiṇḍamayaṃ maheśaṃ raupye surūpavṛṣabhe ca samāsthitau tau ..
sampūjya raktasitavastrayugāvagūḍhau nārī bhavatyavidhavā sutasaukhyayuktā .. 28 ..
rambhātṛtīyāvratavarṇanam
meaning:
हैमीमुमां रजतपिण्डमयं महेशं रौप्ये सुरूपवृषभे च समास्थितौ तौ ..
सम्पूज्य रक्तसितवस्त्रयुगावगूढौ नारी भवत्यविधवा सुतसौख्ययुक्ता .. 28 ..
रम्भातृतीयाव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Having worshipped the golden Umā and Maheśa made of solid silver, seated upon a handsome silver bull / and clad in a pair of red and white garments, a woman does not become a widow, and is endowed with the happiness of sons.
Description of the Rambhātṛtīyā Votive Observance

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
raṃbhātṛtīyāṃ vakṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm ..
putrasaubhāgyaphaladāṃ sarvāmayanivāriṇīm .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
रंभातृतीयां वक्ष्यामि सर्वपापप्रणाशिनीम् ..
पुत्रसौभाग्यफलदां सर्वामयनिवारिणीम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / I will declare the Rambhātṛtīyā, which destroys all sins, / yields the fruit of sons and good fortune, and removes all diseases;
title: Raṃbhātṛtīyāvratam

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaduṣṭaharāṃ puṇyāṃ sarvasaukhyapradāṃ tathā ..
sapatnīdarpadalanāṃ tathaiśvaryaṃ karīṃ śivām .. 2 ..
meaning:
सर्वदुष्टहरां पुण्यां सर्वसौख्यप्रदां तथा ..
सपत्नीदर्पदलनां तथैश्वर्यं करीं शिवाम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: which removes all evils, is holy, grants all happiness, / crushes the pride of co-wives, brings sovereign power, and is auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkareṇa purā proktā pārvatyāḥ priyakāmyayā ..
tāmimāṃ śṛṇu bhūpāla sarvabhūtahitāya vai .. 3 ..
meaning:
शंकरेण पुरा प्रोक्ता पार्वत्याः प्रियकाम्यया ..
तामिमां शृणु भूपाल सर्वभूतहिताय वै .. 3 ..
text_mt: It was declared in ancient times by Śaṅkara out of a desire to please Pārvatī; / hear this, O King, for the welfare of all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi tṛtī yāyāṃ narādhipa ..
śuklāyāṃ prātarutthāya daṃtadhāvanapūrvakam ..
upavāsasya niyamaṃ gṛhṇīyādbhaktibhāvitā .. 4 ..
meaning:
मार्गशीर्षे शुभे मासि तृती यायां नराधिप ..
शुक्लायां प्रातरुत्थाय दंतधावनपूर्वकम् ..
उपवासस्य नियमं गृह्णीयाद्भक्तिभाविता .. 4 ..
text_mt: In the auspicious month of Mārgaśīrṣa, on the third [lunar day] of the bright [fortnight], O ruler of men, / having risen in the morning and cleaned the teeth, / filled with devotion, she should undertake the rule of fasting:

sanskrit_iast:
devi saṃvatsaraṃ yāvattṛtīyāyāmupo ṣitā ..
pratimāsaṃ kariṣyāmi pāraṇaṃ cāpare'hani ..
tadavighnena me yātu prasādāttava pārvati .. 5 ..
meaning:
देवि संवत्सरं यावत्तृतीयायामुपो षिता ..
प्रतिमासं करिष्यामि पारणं चापरेऽहनि ..
तदविघ्नेन मे यातु प्रसादात्तव पार्वति .. 5 ..
text_mt: “O Goddess, having fasted on the third [lunar day] every month for a year, / I will break my fast on the following day; / by your grace, O Pārvatī, may it pass without obstacle for me.”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃkalpya vidhivatkauṃteya kṛtaniścayaḥ ..
bhaktyā naro vā nārī vā snānaṃ kuryādataṃdritaḥ ..6..
meaning:
एवं संकल्प्य विधिवत्कौंतेय कृतनिश्चयः ..
भक्त्या नरो वा नारी वा स्नानं कुर्यादतंद्रितः ..6..
text_mt: Having thus made the formal resolve according to rule, O son of Kuntī, firm of purpose, / a man or a woman should bathe with devotion, without sloth.

sanskrit_iast:
nadyāṃ taḍāge vāpyāṃ vā gṛhe vā niyatātmavān ..
pūjayetpārvatīṃ nāma rātrau prāśya kuśodakam.. .. 7 ..
meaning:
नद्यां तडागे वाप्यां वा गृहे वा नियतात्मवान् ..
पूजयेत्पार्वतीं नाम रात्रौ प्राश्य कुशोदकम्.. .. 7 ..
text_mt: In a river, a pond, a step-well, or in the house, with self-restraint, / one should worship the goddess named Pārvatī, after sipping kuśa-grass water at night.

sanskrit_iast:
prabhāte bhojayedvidvāñchivabhaktānviśeṣataḥ ..
hiraṇyaṃ lavaṇaṃ caiva teṣāṃ dadyāttu dakṣiṇām ..
gaurīśvaraṃ yathāśakti bhojayetprayatā satī .. 8 ..
meaning:
प्रभाते भोजयेद्विद्वाञ्छिवभक्तान्विशेषतः ..
हिरण्यं लवणं चैव तेषां दद्यात्तु दक्षिणाम् ..
गौरीश्वरं यथाशक्ति भोजयेत्प्रयता सती .. 8 ..
text_mt: At dawn, the wise person should feed especially devotees of Śiva; / he should bestow upon them gold and salt as the priestly fee. / The devoted chaste woman should feed the Lord of Gaurī according to her means.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā rājanyaḥ kuryānmāsi pauṣake ..
gomūtraṃ prāśayedrātrau prabhāte bhojayeddvijān .. 9 ..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना राजन्यः कुर्यान्मासि पौषके ..
गोमूत्रं प्राशयेद्रात्रौ प्रभाते भोजयेद्द्विजान् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Whoever performs this rite in the month of Pauṣa according to this rule, O king: / she should sip cow-urine at night, and at dawn feed the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyaṃ jīrakaṃ caiva svaśaktyā dāpayettataḥ ..
kaḍuhuṃḍaṃ ca kanakaṃ tebhyo dattvā visarjayet .. 4.24.10 ..
meaning:
हिरण्यं जीरकं चैव स्वशक्त्या दापयेत्ततः ..
कडुहुंडं च कनकं तेभ्यो दत्त्वा विसर्जयेत् .. 4.24.10 ..
text_mt: Then, according to her capacity, she should give gold and cumin seeds. / Bestowing on them a sweetmeat and gold, she should dismiss them.

sanskrit_iast:
vājapeyātirātrābhyāṃ phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ ..
śakraloke vasetkalpaṃ tataḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet .. 11 ..
meaning:
वाजपेयातिरात्राभ्यां फलं प्राप्नोत्यसंशयः ..
शक्रलोके वसेत्कल्पं ततः शिवपुरं व्रजेत् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Without doubt, she attains the fruit of both the Vājapeya and the Atirātra sacrifices. / She dwells in the realm of Śakra for a kalpa, and thence goes to the city of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
māghe māsi tṛtīyāyāṃ sudevīṃ nāma pūjayet ..
gomayaṃ prāśayedrātrau tataścaikākinī svapet .. 12 ..
meaning:
माघे मासि तृतीयायां सुदेवीं नाम पूजयेत् ..
गोमयं प्राशयेद्रात्रौ ततश्चैकाकिनी स्वपेत् .. 12 ..
text_mt: In the month of Māgha, on the third lunar day, she should worship the goddess named Sudevī; / she should ingest cow-dung at night, and then sleep alone.

sanskrit_iast:
prātaḥ kusuṃbhaṃ kanakaṃ dadyā cchaktyā dvijātiṣu ..
viṣṇuloke ciraṃ sthitvā prāpnoti śivasāmyatām .. 13 ..
meaning:
प्रातः कुसुंभं कनकं दद्या च्छक्त्या द्विजातिषु ..
विष्णुलोके चिरं स्थित्वा प्राप्नोति शिवसाम्यताम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: In the morning, she should give safflower and gold according to her capacity to the twice-born. / Dwelling for a long time in the world of Viṣṇu, she attains equality with Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
gaurīti phālgune nāma gokṣīraṃ prāśayenniśi ..
prabhāte bhojayedvidvāñchivabhaktānsuvāsinīḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
गौरीति फाल्गुने नाम गोक्षीरं प्राशयेन्निशि ..
प्रभाते भोजयेद्विद्वाञ्छिवभक्तान्सुवासिनीः .. 14 ..
text_mt: In Phālguna, she should worship the name Gaurī, and sip cow's milk at night; / at dawn, the wise woman should feed devotees of Śiva and married women.

sanskrit_iast:
kaḍuhuṃḍaṃ sakanakaṃ tebhyo dattvā visarjayet ..
vājapeyātirātrābhyāṃ phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ ..15..
meaning:
कडुहुंडं सकनकं तेभ्यो दत्त्वा विसर्जयेत् ..
वाजपेयातिरात्राभ्यां फलं प्राप्नोत्यसंशयः ..15..
text_mt: Bestowing a sweetmeat together with gold upon them, she should dismiss them. / She attains without doubt the fruit of both the Vājapeya and the Atirātra sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
caitre māsi viśālākṣīṃ pūjayedbhaktitatparā ..
dadhi prāśya svapetprātardadyāddhema sakuṃkumam ..
saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti viśālākṣyāḥ prasādataḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
चैत्रे मासि विशालाक्षीं पूजयेद्भक्तितत्परा ..
दधि प्राश्य स्वपेत्प्रातर्दद्याद्धेम सकुंकुमम् ..
सौभाग्यं महदाप्नोति विशालाक्ष्याः प्रसादतः .. 16 ..
text_mt: In the month of Caitra, intent on devotion, she should worship Viśālākṣī; / having tasted curds, she should sleep, and at dawn give gold with saffron. / She attains great fortune by the grace of Viśālākṣī.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ śrīmukhīṃ nāma pūjayet ..
ghṛtaṃ ca prāśayedrātrau tataścaikākinī svapet .. 17 ..
meaning:
वैशाखस्य तृतीयायां श्रीमुखीं नाम पूजयेत् ..
घृतं च प्राशयेद्रात्रौ ततश्चैकाकिनी स्वपेत् .. 17 ..
text_mt: On the third lunar day of Vaiśākha, she should worship the goddess named Śrīmukhī; / she should sip clarified butter at night, and then sleep alone.

sanskrit_iast:
śivabhaktāndvijānprātarbhojayitvā yathepsitam ..
tāṃbūla lavaṇaṃ dattvā praṇipatya visarjayet ..
anena vidhinā dattvā putrānāpnoti śobhanān .. 18 ..
meaning:
शिवभक्तान्द्विजान्प्रातर्भोजयित्वा यथेप्सितम् ..
तांबूल लवणं दत्त्वा प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् ..
अनेन विधिना दत्त्वा पुत्रानाप्नोति शोभनान् .. 18 ..
text_mt: In the morning, having fed the twice-born devotees of Śiva to their satisfaction, / and having given betel and salt, she should bow down and dismiss them. / Giving according to this rule, she obtains splendid sons.

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhe mādhavīṃ natvā prāśnīyācca tilodakam ..
prabhāte bhojayedviprāndakṣiṇāyāṃ guḍaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
sakāṃcanaḥ śubhāṃllokānprāpnoti hi na saṃśayaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
आषाढे माधवीं नत्वा प्राश्नीयाच्च तिलोदकम् ..
प्रभाते भोजयेद्विप्रान्दक्षिणायां गुडः स्मृतः ..
सकांचनः शुभांल्लोकान्प्राप्नोति हि न संशयः .. 19 ..
text_mt: In Āṣāḍha, having bowed to Mādhavī, she should drink sesame water. / At dawn she should feed the Brahmins; jaggery is prescribed for the priestly fee, / along with gold; she certainly attains auspicious worlds, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvaṇe tu śriyaṃ pūjya pibedgośṛṃgajaṃ jalam ..
śivabhaktāṃśca saṃpūjya dayāddhemaphalaiḥ saha ..
sarvalokeśvaro bhūtvā sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt .. 4.24.20 ..
meaning:
श्रावणे तु श्रियं पूज्य पिबेद्गोशृंगजं जलम् ..
शिवभक्तांश्च संपूज्य दयाद्धेमफलैः सह ..
सर्वलोकेश्वरो भूत्वा सर्वकामानवाप्नुयात् .. 4.24.20 ..
text_mt: In Śrāvaṇa, having worshipped Śrī, she should drink water sprinkled from a cow’s horn. / And having worshipped the devotees of Śiva, she should give [gifts] along with gold and fruits; / becoming lord of all realms, she would obtain all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
bhādre caiva tṛtīyāyāṃ haratālīti pūja yet ..
māhiṣaṃ ca pibeddugdhaṃ saubhāgyamatulaṃ labhet ..
iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā cāṃte śivapuraṃ brajet .. 21 ..
meaning:
भाद्रे चैव तृतीयायां हरतालीति पूज येत् ..
माहिषं च पिबेद्दुग्धं सौभाग्यमतुलं लभेत् ..
इह लोके सुखं भुक्त्वा चांते शिवपुरं ब्रजेत् .. 21 ..
text_mt: On the third lunar day in the month of Bhādrapada, she should worship Haratālī, / and drink buffalo milk; she obtains incomparable fortune. / Having enjoyed happiness in this world, at the end she goes to the city of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
āśvine tu tṛtīyāyāṃ giriputrīti pūjayet ..
saṃprāśya taṇḍulajalaṃ prātarviprāṃśca pūjayet ..22..
meaning:
आश्विने तु तृतीयायां गिरिपुत्रीति पूजयेत् ..
संप्राश्य तण्डुलजलं प्रातर्विप्रांश्च पूजयेत् ..22..
text_mt: On the third lunar day in Āśvina, she should worship Giriputrī. / Having consumed rice-water, she should worship Brahmins at dawn.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇā cāpi nirdiṣṭā kanakaṃ ca sacandanam ..
sarvayajñaphalaṃ prāpya gaurīloke mahī yate .. 23 ..
meaning:
दक्षिणा चापि निर्दिष्टा कनकं च सचन्दनम् ..
सर्वयज्ञफलं प्राप्य गौरीलोके मही यते .. 23 ..
text_mt: Gold together with sandalwood is also prescribed as the priestly fee. / Having obtained the fruit of all sacrifices, she is honoured in the world of Gaurī.

sanskrit_iast:
padmodbhavā kārtike ca pañcagavyaṃ pibettataḥ ..
rātrau prajāgaraṃ kuryātprabhāte bhojayeddvijān .. 24 ..
meaning:
पद्मोद्भवा कार्तिके च पञ्चगव्यं पिबेत्ततः ..
रात्रौ प्रजागरं कुर्यात्प्रभाते भोजयेद्द्विजान् .. 24 ..
text_mt: In Kārtika, she should worship Padmodbhavā, and then drink the five products of the cow; / she should keep a night-vigil, and feed the twice-born at dawn.

sanskrit_iast:
sapatnīkāñchubhācārānmālyavastra vibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
pūjayecchivabhaktāṃśca kumārīścaiva bhojayet .. 25 ..
meaning:
सपत्नीकाञ्छुभाचारान्माल्यवस्त्र विभूषणैः ..
पूजयेच्छिवभक्तांश्च कुमारीश्चैव भोजयेत् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Accompanied by their wives, men of auspicious conduct, / she should worship the devotees of Śiva with garlands, garments, and ornaments, and feed young maidens.

sanskrit_iast:
umāmaheśvaraṃ haimaṃ samāpte kārayennṛpa ..
yathāvibhavasāreṇa vitānaṃ pañcavarṇakam .. .. 26 ..
meaning:
उमामहेश्वरं हैमं समाप्ते कारयेन्नृप ..
यथाविभवसारेण वितानं पञ्चवर्णकम् .. .. 26 ..
text_mt: At the conclusion, O king, she should have made an image of Umā and Maheśvara of gold / and, according to the measure of her wealth, a canopy of five colours.

sanskrit_iast:
aśanaṃ ca śubhaṃ dadyācchvetacchatraṃ kamaṃḍalum ..
pādukopānahau divyairvastrayugmaiśca pāṃḍava .. 27 ..
meaning:
अशनं च शुभं दद्याच्छ्वेतच्छत्रं कमंडलुम् ..
पादुकोपानहौ दिव्यैर्वस्त्रयुग्मैश्च पांडव .. 27 ..
text_mt: And she should present auspicious food, a white royal parasol, an ascetic's waterpot, / sandals and shoes, and pairs of celestial garments, O Pāṇḍava,

sanskrit_iast:
pītayajñopavītaiśca dīpanetraiḥ samujjvalaiḥ ..
śaṃkhaśuktisamopetairddarpaṇaiśca suśobhitaiḥ ..28..
meaning:
पीतयज्ञोपवीतैश्च दीपनेत्रैः समुज्ज्वलैः ..
शंखशुक्तिसमोपेतैर्द्दर्पणैश्च सुशोभितैः ..28..
text_mt: and yellow sacred threads, radiant with eyes of lamps, / accompanied by conches and oyster shells, and adorned with mirrors.

sanskrit_iast:
umāmaheśvaraṃ sthāpya pūjayitvā yathāvidhi ..
nānāvidhaiḥ sugandhaiśca patraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaistathā .. 29 ..
meaning:
उमामहेश्वरं स्थाप्य पूजयित्वा यथाविधि ..
नानाविधैः सुगन्धैश्च पत्रैः पुष्पैः फलैस्तथा .. 29 ..
text_mt: Having installed Umā and Maheśvara and worshipped [them] according to rule / with various fragrances, leaves, flowers, and fruits,

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtapakvaiśca naivedyairdīpamālābhireva ca ..
śarkarānālikeraiśca dāḍimairbījapūrakaiḥ .. 4.24.30 ..
meaning:
घृतपक्वैश्च नैवेद्यैर्दीपमालाभिरेव च ..
शर्करानालिकेरैश्च दाडिमैर्बीजपूरकैः .. 4.24.30 ..
text_mt: and with food-offerings cooked in clarified butter, with rows of lamps, / with sugar and coconuts, pomegranates and citrons,

sanskrit_iast:
jīrakairlavaṇaiścaiva kusumbhaiḥ kuṃkumaistathā ..
satāmrabhājanairdivyodakai rasasaṃyutaiḥ ..
pūjayeddevadeveśaṃ kṣamayettadanaṃtaram .. 31 ..
meaning:
जीरकैर्लवणैश्चैव कुसुम्भैः कुंकुमैस्तथा ..
सताम्रभाजनैर्दिव्योदकै रससंयुतैः ..
पूजयेद्देवदेवेशं क्षमयेत्तदनंतरम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: and with cumin, salts, safflowers, and saffron, / along with copper vessels containing divine water imbued with juices, / she should worship the Lord of the gods of gods, and thereafter ask for forgiveness,

sanskrit_iast:
