विनायकचतुर्थीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
The Vināyaka bath of men endowed with modesty and virtue is praised here as destroying obstacles; / for those who perform it according to rule here, their undertakings yield the desired fruit—there is no doubt of this.
Description of the Vināyakacaturthī Votive Observance

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
athāvighnakaraṃ rājankathayāmi vrataṃ tava ..
yena samyakṛteneha na vighnamupajāyate .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
अथाविघ्नकरं राजन्कथयामि व्रतं तव ..
येन सम्यकृतेनेह न विघ्नमुपजायते .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / “Now, O king, I shall tell you the obstacle-removing votive observance, / by the proper performance of which here no obstacle arises.
title: Vināyakacaturthīvratam

sanskrit_iast:
caturthyāṃ phālgune māsi gṛhītavyaṃ vrataṃ tvidam ..
naktāhāreṇa rājendra tilānnaṃ pāraṇaṃ smṛtam .. 2 ..
meaning:
चतुर्थ्यां फाल्गुने मासि गृहीतव्यं व्रतं त्विदम् ..
नक्ताहारेण राजेन्द्र तिलान्नं पारणं स्मृतम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: This votive observance is to be undertaken on the fourth lunar day in the month of Phālguna. / With a nocturnal meal, O king of kings, sesamum-rice is prescribed as the concluding meal.

sanskrit_iast: tadeva vahnau hotavyaṃ brāhmaṇāya ca tadbhavet .. 3 ..
meaning: तदेव वह्नौ होतव्यं ब्राह्मणाय च तद्भवेत् .. 3 ..
text_mt: That very [food] is to be offered into the fire, and that should be given to a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śūrāya vīrāya gajānanāya laṃbodarāyaikaradāya caiva ..
evaṃ tu saṃpūjya punaśca homaṃ kuryādvratī vighnavināśahetoḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
शूराय वीराय गजाननाय लंबोदरायैकरदाय चैव ..
एवं तु संपूज्य पुनश्च होमं कुर्याद्व्रती विघ्नविनाशहेतोः .. 4 ..
text_mt: ‘To the brave, to the hero, to the Elephant-faced, to the Pot-bellied, and to the Single-tusked’— / having thus worshipped, the observer of the votive observance should further perform a fire sacrifice for the destruction of obstacles.

sanskrit_iast:
cāturmāsyāṃ vrataṃ caiva kṛtvetthaṃ pañcame tathā ..
sauvarṇaṃ gajavaktraṃ tu kṛtvā viprāya dāpayet .. 5 ..
meaning:
चातुर्मास्यां व्रतं चैव कृत्वेत्थं पञ्चमे तथा ..
सौवर्णं गजवक्त्रं तु कृत्वा विप्राय दापयेत् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Having performed the votive observance thus during the four months, on the fifth / he should fashion a golden elephant-faced [image] and give it to a vipra,

sanskrit_iast:
tāmrapātraiḥ pāyasabhṛtaiścaturbhiḥ sahitaṃ nṛpa ..
pañcamena tilaiḥ sārddhaṃ gaṇeśādhiṣṭhitena ca .. 6 ..
meaning:
ताम्रपात्रैः पायसभृतैश्चतुर्भिः सहितं नृप ..
पञ्चमेन तिलैः सार्द्धं गणेशाधिष्ठितेन च .. 6 ..
text_mt: accompanied by four copper vessels filled with pāyasa, O king, / along with a fifth filled with sesamum seeds and surmounted by Gaṇeśa.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛnmayānyapi pātrāṇi vittahīnastu kārayet ..
heraṃbaṃ rājataṃ tadvadvidhinānena dāpayet ..
itthaṃ vratamidaṃ kṛtvā sarvavipraiḥ pramucyate .. 7 ..
meaning:
मृन्मयान्यपि पात्राणि वित्तहीनस्तु कारयेत् ..
हेरंबं राजतं तद्वद्विधिनानेन दापयेत् ..
इत्थं व्रतमिदं कृत्वा सर्वविप्रैः प्रमुच्यते .. 7 ..
text_mt: One who is lacking in wealth may use vessels made of clay, / and likewise he should donate a silver Heramba according to this rule. / Having performed this votive observance in this manner, he is freed from all troubles.

sanskrit_iast:
hayamedhasya vighne tu saṃjāte sagaraḥ purā ..
etadeva vrataṃ cīrtvā punaraśvaṃ pralabdhavān .. 8 ..
meaning:
हयमेधस्य विघ्ने तु संजाते सगरः पुरा ..
एतदेव व्रतं चीर्त्वा पुनरश्वं प्रलब्धवान् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Anciently, when an obstacle arose to his horse sacrifice, Sagara, / having performed this very votive observance, recovered his horse.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā rudreṇa devena tripuraṃ nighnatā purā ..
etadeva kṛtaṃ yasmāttripurastena ghātitaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
तथा रुद्रेण देवेन त्रिपुरं निघ्नता पुरा ..
एतदेव कृतं यस्मात्त्रिपुरस्तेन घातितः .. 9 ..
text_mt: Likewise, when the divine Rudra was slaying Tripura in ancient times, / he performed this very [votive observance], and therefore Tripura was slain by him.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā samudraṃ viśatāṃ etadeva vrataṃ kṛtam ..
tenādridrumasaṃyuktā pṛthivī punaruddhṛtā .. 4.33.10 ..
meaning:
मया समुद्रं विशतां एतदेव व्रतं कृतम् ..
तेनाद्रिद्रुमसंयुक्ता पृथिवी पुनरुद्धृता .. 4.33.10 ..
text_mt: By me, entering the ocean, this very votive observance was performed; / through it the earth, joined with mountains and trees, was raised up again.

sanskrit_iast:
anyairapi mahīpālairetadeva kṛtaṃ purā ..
tapo'rthibhiryajña siddhyai nirvighnaṃ syātparaṃtapa .. 11 ..
meaning:
अन्यैरपि महीपालैरेतदेव कृतं पुरा ..
तपोऽर्थिभिर्यज्ञ सिद्ध्यै निर्विघ्नं स्यात्परंतप .. 11 ..
text_mt: By other rulers of the earth too this very [votive observance] was performed in ancient times, / and by those desirous of austerities for the success of their sacrifices, so that there would be freedom from obstacles, O scorcher of foes.

sanskrit_iast:
anena kṛtamātreṇa sarvavipraiḥ pramucyate ..
mṛto rudrapuraṃ yāti varāhavacanaṃ yathā .. 12 ..
meaning:
अनेन कृतमात्रेण सर्वविप्रैः प्रमुच्यते ..
मृतो रुद्रपुरं याति वराहवचनं यथा .. 12 ..
text_mt: Merely by performing this, one is freed from all troubles; / when he dies, he goes to the city of Rudra, as is the word of the Boar.

sanskrit_iast:
vighnāni tasya na bhavaṃti gṛhe kadāciddharmārthakāmasukhasiddhivighātakāni ..
yaḥ saptamīnduśakalākṛtikāṃ tadaṃtaṃ vighneśamarcayati naktakṛtī caturthyām .. 13 ..
śāntivratavarṇanam
meaning:
विघ्नानि तस्य न भवंति गृहे कदाचिद्धर्मार्थकामसुखसिद्धिविघातकानि ..
यः सप्तमीन्दुशकलाकृतिकां तदंतं विघ्नेशमर्चयति नक्तकृती चतुर्थ्याम् .. 13 ..
शान्तिव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
No obstacles, which ruin the achievement of righteousness, wealth, desire, and happiness, ever arise in the home of him / who, having performed the nocturnal rite on the fourth lunar day, worships the Lord of Obstacles, whose shape is that of the crescent of the seventh lunar day's moon.”
Description of the Śāntivrata

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śāṃtivrataṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvekamanādhunā ..
yena cīrṇena śāṃtiḥ syātsarvadā gṛhamedhinām .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
शांतिव्रतं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुष्वेकमनाधुना ..
येन चीर्णेन शांतिः स्यात्सर्वदा गृहमेधिनाम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / “I shall declare the Śāntivrata; listen now with one-pointed mind, / by the practice of which there will always be peace for householders.
title: Śāṃtivratam

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamyāṃ śuklapakṣasya kārtike māsi pārthiva ..
ārabhya varṣamekaṃ tu hyaśnīyādamlavarjitam .. 2 ..
meaning:
पञ्चम्यां शुक्लपक्षस्य कार्तिके मासि पार्थिव ..
आरभ्य वर्षमेकं तु ह्यश्नीयादम्लवर्जितम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: Starting on the fifth lunar day of the bright fortnight in the month of Kārttika, O king, / for one full year he should eat food free from sour things.

sanskrit_iast:
naktaṃ devaṃ ca saṃpūjya hariṃ śeṣoparisthitam ..
anaṃtāyeti pādau tu dhṛtarāṣṭrāya vai kaṭim .. 3 ..
meaning:
नक्तं देवं च संपूज्य हरिं शेषोपरिस्थितम् ..
अनंतायेति पादौ तु धृतराष्ट्राय वै कटिम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped the god Hari standing upon Śeṣa at night: / ‘To Ananta’—the feet; ‘to Dhṛtarāṣṭra’—the waist;

sanskrit_iast:
udaraṃ takṣakāyeti uraḥ karkoṭakāya ca ..
padmāya karṇau saṃpūjya mahāpadmāya doryugam .. 4 ..
meaning:
उदरं तक्षकायेति उरः कर्कोटकाय च ..
पद्माय कर्णौ संपूज्य महापद्माय दोर्युगम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: ‘to Takṣaka’—the belly; and ‘to Karkoṭaka’—the chest; / having worshipped the ears with ‘to Padma’, and the two arms with ‘to Mahāpadma’,

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkhapālāya vakṣastu kulikāyeti vai śiraḥ ..
evaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvagataṃ pṛthageva prapūjayet .. 5 ..
meaning:
शंखपालाय वक्षस्तु कुलिकायेति वै शिरः ..
एवं विष्णुं सर्वगतं पृथगेव प्रपूजयेत् .. 5 ..
text_mt: the chest with ‘to Śaṅkhapāla’, and the head with ‘to Kulika’; / thus he should worship all-pervading Viṣṇu distinctly.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīreṇa snapanaṃ kuryāddharimuddiśya vāgyataḥ ..
tadagre homayetkṣīraṃ tilaiḥ saha vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
क्षीरेण स्नपनं कुर्याद्धरिमुद्दिश्य वाग्यतः ..
तदग्रे होमयेत्क्षीरं तिलैः सह विचक्षणः .. 6 ..
text_mt: With speech restrained, he should bathe Hari with milk; / in front of him, the wise man should offer milk into the fire along with sesamum seeds.”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte kuryādbrāhmaṇabhojanam ..
acyutaṃ kāṃcanaṃ kṛtvā suvarṇaṃ tu vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
एवं संवत्सरस्यांते कुर्याद्ब्राह्मणभोजनम् ..
अच्युतं कांचनं कृत्वा सुवर्णं तु विचक्षणः .. 7 ..
text_mt: In this manner, at the end of the year, one should feed brāhmaṇas. / The discerning man should fashion an image of Acyuta out of gold, weighing a suvarṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
gāṃ savatsāṃ vastrayugaṃ kāṃsyapātraṃ sapāyasam ..
hiraṇyaṃ ca yathāśakti brāhmaṇāyopapādayet .. 8 ..
meaning:
गां सवत्सां वस्त्रयुगं कांस्यपात्रं सपायसम् ..
हिरण्यं च यथाशक्ति ब्राह्मणायोपपादयेत् .. 8 ..
text_mt: and give to a brāhmaṇa, according to his means, a cow with its calf, / a pair of garments, a bronze vessel filled with milk-rice, and gold.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā vratametannarādhipa ..
tasya śāṃtirbhavennityaṃ nāgānāmabhayaṃ tathā .. 9 ..
meaning:
एवं यः कुरुते भक्त्या व्रतमेतन्नराधिप ..
तस्य शांतिर्भवेन्नित्यं नागानामभयं तथा .. 9 ..
text_mt: Whoever performs this votive observance with devotion in this manner, O ruler of men, / to him peace will always belong, and likewise freedom from the fear of snakes.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣāhibhogaśayanasthamayogasūtiṃ saṃpūjya yajñapuruṣaṃ patageṃdranātham..
ye pūjayaṃti madhuraiḥ sitapañcamīṣu teṣāṃ na nāgajanitaṃ bhayamabhyupaiti .. 4.34.10 ..
sārasvatavratavarṇanam
meaning:
शेषाहिभोगशयनस्थमयोगसूतिं संपूज्य यज्ञपुरुषं पतगेंद्रनाथम्..
ये पूजयंति मधुरैः सितपञ्चमीषु तेषां न नागजनितं भयमभ्युपैति .. 4.34.10 ..
सारस्वतव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Those who worship the lord of the sacrifice, resting on the bed of Śeṣa the serpent's coils, who is the source beyond yoga, the lord of the king of birds, / and worship with sweet offerings on the bright fifth lunar days, no fear born of snakes approaches them.
Description of the Sārasvata Votive Observance

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
madhurā bhāratī kena vratena madhusūdana ..
tathaiva janasaubhāgyamatividyāsu kauśalam ..1..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
मधुरा भारती केन व्रतेन मधुसूदन ..
तथैव जनसौभाग्यमतिविद्यासु कौशलम् ..1..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / By which votive observance, O Madhusūdana, does sweet speech arise, / as well as popularity among people and great skill in the branches of knowledge?
title: Sārasvatavratanirūpaṇam

sanskrit_iast:
abhedaścāpi daṃpatyostathā baṃdhujanena ca ..
āyuśca vipulaṃ puṃsāṃ jāyate kena keśava .. 2 ..
meaning:
अभेदश्चापि दंपत्योस्तथा बंधुजनेन च ..
आयुश्च विपुलं पुंसां जायते केन केशव .. 2 ..
text_mt: And by what, O Keśava, does non-discord arise between husband and wife / and with kinsmen, as well as a long lifespan for men?

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
samyakpṛṣṭastvayā rājañchṛṇu sārasvataṃ vratam ..
yasya saṃkīrtanādeva tuṣyatīha sarasvatī .. 3 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
सम्यक्पृष्टस्त्वया राजञ्छृणु सारस्वतं व्रतम् ..
यस्य संकीर्तनादेव तुष्यतीह सरस्वती .. 3 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / You have asked well, O king. Hear the Sārasvata votive observance, / merely by the recitation of which Sarasvatī is pleased in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
yo'yaṃ bhaktaḥ pumānkuryādetadvratamanuttamam ..
tadvatsarādau saṃpūjya vipreṇa taṃ samācaret .. 4 ..
meaning:
योऽयं भक्तः पुमान्कुर्यादेतद्व्रतमनुत्तमम् ..
तद्वत्सरादौ संपूज्य विप्रेण तं समाचरेत् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Whatever devoted man would perform this supreme votive observance / should carry it out with the help of a brāhmaṇa, having worshipped at the beginning of that year.

sanskrit_iast:
atha cādityavāreṇa grahatārābalena ca ..
pāyasaṃ bhojayitvā ca kuryādbrāhmaṇavācanam .. 5 ..
meaning:
अथ चादित्यवारेण ग्रहताराबलेन च ..
पायसं भोजयित्वा च कुर्याद्ब्राह्मणवाचनम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Then, on a Sunday, when the planets and stars are strong, / having fed [brāhmaṇas] milk-rice, one should perform the brāhmaṇa-recitation of auspicious blessings.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklavastrāṇi dadyācca sahiraṇyāni śaktitaḥ ..
gāyatrīṃ pūjayedbhaktyā śuklamālyānulepanaiḥ ..
ebhirmaṃtrapadaiḥ paścātpūrvaṃ kṛtvā kṛtāñjaliḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
शुक्लवस्त्राणि दद्याच्च सहिरण्यानि शक्तितः ..
गायत्रीं पूजयेद्भक्त्या शुक्लमाल्यानुलेपनैः ..
एभिर्मंत्रपदैः पश्चात्पूर्वं कृत्वा कृताञ्जलिः .. 6 ..
text_mt: And one should give white garments along with gold, according to one's means. / With devotion one should worship Gāyatrī with white garlands and ointments, / having first folded one's hands in reverence, with these mantra words thereafter:

sanskrit_iast:
yathā tu devi bhagavānbrahmā lokapitā mahaḥ..
tvāṃ parityajya no tiṣṭhettathā bhava varapradā .. 7 ..
meaning:
यथा तु देवि भगवान्ब्रह्मा लोकपिता महः..
त्वां परित्यज्य नो तिष्ठेत्तथा भव वरप्रदा .. 7 ..
text_mt: "Just as the venerable Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, O goddess, / does not abide abandoning you, so become a giver of boons [to me]!

sanskrit_iast:
vedaśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi nṛtyagītādikaṃ ca yat ..
vāhitaṃ yattvayā devi tathā me saṃtu siddhayaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
वेदशास्त्राणि सर्वाणि नृत्यगीतादिकं च यत् ..
वाहितं यत्त्वया देवि तथा मे संतु सिद्धयः .. 8 ..
text_mt: Whatever Vedas and scriptures, and whatever dance, song, and the like, / have been borne forth by you, O goddess, so let these accomplishments be mine!

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīrmedhā varāriṣṭirgorī tuṣṭiḥ prabhā matiḥ ..
etābhiḥ pāhi tanubhiraṣṭābhirmāṃ sarasvati .. 9 ..
meaning:
लक्ष्मीर्मेधा वरारिष्टिर्गोरी तुष्टिः प्रभा मतिः ..
एताभिः पाहि तनुभिरष्टाभिर्मां सरस्वति .. 9 ..
text_mt: Lakṣmī, Medhā, the excellent Ariṣṭi, Gaurī, Tuṣṭi, Prabhā, and Mati— / with these eight bodies, O Sarasvatī, protect me!"

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃpūjya gāyatrīṃ vīṇākṣamaṇidhāriṇīm ..
śuklapakṣe'kṣatairbhaktyā sakamaṃḍalupustakām .. 4.35.10 ..
meaning:
एवं संपूज्य गायत्रीं वीणाक्षमणिधारिणीम् ..
शुक्लपक्षेऽक्षतैर्भक्त्या सकमंडलुपुस्तकाम् .. 4.35.10 ..
text_mt: Having thus worshipped Gāyatrī with devotion using unbroken grains during the bright fortnight, / holding a vīṇā and a rosary, together with a water pot and a book,

sanskrit_iast:
maunavratena bhuñjīta sāyaṃ prātaśca dharmavit ..
pañcamyāṃ pratipakṣe ca pūjayitvā suvāsinīḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
मौनव्रतेन भुञ्जीत सायं प्रातश्च धर्मवित् ..
पञ्चम्यां प्रतिपक्षे च पूजयित्वा सुवासिनीः .. 11 ..
text_mt: the knower of righteousness should eat in the evening and in the morning under a vow of silence, / having worshipped auspicious married women on the fifth lunar day of each fortnight.

sanskrit_iast:
tilaiśca taṃḍulaprasthaṃ ghṛtapātreṇa saṃyutam ..
kṣīraṃ tathā hiraṇyaṃ ca gāyatrī prīyatāmiti .. 12 ..
meaning:
तिलैश्च तंडुलप्रस्थं घृतपात्रेण संयुतम् ..
क्षीरं तथा हिरण्यं च गायत्री प्रीयतामिति .. 12 ..
text_mt: And [one should offer] a prastha of husked rice along with sesame seeds, accompanied by a vessel of clarified butter, / milk, and gold, saying: "May Gāyatrī be pleased."

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyāyāṃ ca tato maunaṃ tadvrata tu samācaret ..
nāṃtarā bhojanaṃ kuryādyāvanmāsāstrayodaśa .. 13 ..
meaning:
संध्यायां च ततो मौनं तद्व्रत तु समाचरेत् ..
नांतरा भोजनं कुर्याद्यावन्मासास्त्रयोदश .. 13 ..
text_mt: And at twilight one should maintain silence; one should perform that votive observance in this way. / One must not eat in between [meals] for as long as thirteen months.

sanskrit_iast:
samāpte tu vrate dadyādbhojanaṃ śuklataṃḍulaiḥ ..
pūrṇaṃ suvastrayugmaṃ ca gāṃ ca viprāya bhojanam .. 14 ..
meaning:
समाप्ते तु व्रते दद्याद्भोजनं शुक्लतंडुलैः ..
पूर्णं सुवस्त्रयुग्मं च गां च विप्राय भोजनम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: When the votive observance is completed, one should give a meal of white rice; / [one should give] a pair of fine garments filled [with grains], a cow, and food to a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
devyai vitānaṃ ghaṃṭāṃ ca sitanetraṃ paṭānvitam ..
candanaṃ vastrayugmaṃ ca dadhyannaṃ śikharairyutam .. 15 ..
meaning:
देव्यै वितानं घंटां च सितनेत्रं पटान्वितम् ..
चन्दनं वस्त्रयुग्मं च दध्यन्नं शिखरैर्युतम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: To the goddess, [one should offer] a canopy, a bell, white silk accompanied by cloth, / sandalwood, a pair of garments, and curd-rice accompanied by condiments.

sanskrit_iast:
tathopadeṣṭāramapi bhaktyā saṃpūjayedgurum ..
vittaśāṭhyena rahito vastramālyānulepanaiḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
तथोपदेष्टारमपि भक्त्या संपूजयेद्गुरुम् ..
वित्तशाठ्येन रहितो वस्त्रमाल्यानुलेपनैः .. 16 ..
text_mt: Likewise, one should worship with devotion the teacher who instructed oneself, / free from stinginess regarding wealth, with garments, garlands, and ointments.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā yastu kuryātsārasvataṃ vratam ..
vidyāvānarthayuktaśca raktakaṃṭhaśca jāyate .. 17 ..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु कुर्यात्सारस्वतं व्रतम् ..
विद्यावानर्थयुक्तश्च रक्तकंठश्च जायते .. 17 ..
text_mt: He who performs the Sārasvata votive observance according to this rule / becomes knowledgeable, endowed with wealth, and sweet-voiced.

sanskrit_iast:
sarasvatyāḥ prasādena vyāsavattu kavirbhavet ..
nārī vā kurute yā tu sāpi tatphalabhāginī ..
brahmaloke vasettāvadyāvatkalpāyutatrayam .. 18 ..
meaning:
सरस्वत्याः प्रसादेन व्यासवत्तु कविर्भवेत् ..
नारी वा कुरुते या तु सापि तत्फलभागिनी ..
ब्रह्मलोके वसेत्तावद्यावत्कल्पायुतत्रयम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: By the grace of Sarasvatī he becomes a poet like Vyāsa. / Or whichever woman performs it, she too shares in that fruit; / she dwells in the world of Brahmā as long as thirty thousand kalpas.

sanskrit_iast:
sārasvataṃ vrataṃ yastu śṛṇuyādapi yaḥ paṭhet ..
vidyādharapure so'pi vasetkalpāyutatrayam .. 19 ..
meaning:
सारस्वतं व्रतं यस्तु शृणुयादपि यः पठेत् ..
विद्याधरपुरे सोऽपि वसेत्कल्पायुतत्रयम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: Whoever hears or reads the Sārasvata votive observance / also dwells in the city of the Vidyādharas for thirty thousand kalpas.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsaraṃ vratavareṇa sarasvatīṃ ye saṃpūjayaṃti jagato jananīṃ janitrīm ..
madhurasvarāste rūpānvitā vahukalākuśalā bhavaṃti ..4.35.20..
nāgapañcamīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
संवत्सरं व्रतवरेण सरस्वतीं ये संपूजयंति जगतो जननीं जनित्रीम् ..
मधुरस्वरास्ते रूपान्विता वहुकलाकुशला भवंति ..4.35.20..
नागपञ्चमीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Those who for one year worship Sarasvatī, the progenitress and mother of the universe, by this best of votive observances, / become sweet-voiced, endowed with beauty, and skilled in many arts.
Description of the Nāgapañcamī Votive Observance

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
paṃcamī dayitā rājannāgānaṃdavivarddhanī ..
pañcamyāṃ kila nāgānāṃ bhavatītyutsavo mahān .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
पंचमी दयिता राजन्नागानंदविवर्द्धनी ..
पञ्चम्यां किल नागानां भवतीत्युत्सवो महान् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / The fifth lunar day is beloved, O king, increasing the delight of the snakes. / On the fifth lunar day, indeed, a great festival of the snakes takes place.
title: Nāgapaṃcamīvratavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
vāsukistakṣakaścaiva kāliko māṇibhadrakaḥ..
dhṛtarāṣṭro raivataśca karkoṭakadhanaṃjayau ..
ete prayacchaṃtyabhayaṃ prāṇināṃ prāṇajīvinām .. 2 ..
meaning:
वासुकिस्तक्षकश्चैव कालिको माणिभद्रकः..
धृतराष्ट्रो रैवतश्च कर्कोटकधनंजयौ ..
एते प्रयच्छंत्यभयं प्राणिनां प्राणजीविनाम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: Vāsuki, Takṣaka, Kāliya, Māṇibhadraka, / Dhṛtarāṣṭra, Raivata, Karkoṭaka, and Dhanañjaya— / these grant freedom from fear to living beings who live by breath.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamyāṃ snapayaṃtīha nāgānkṣī reṇa ye narāḥ ..
teṣāṃ kule prayacchaṃti abhayaṃ prāṇināṃ sadā .. 3 ..
meaning:
पञ्चम्यां स्नपयंतीह नागान्क्षी रेण ये नराः ..
तेषां कुले प्रयच्छंति अभयं प्राणिनां सदा .. 3 ..
text_mt: Those men who bathe the snakes with milk on the fifth lunar day in this world, / [the snakes] always grant freedom from fear to the living beings in their lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
śaptā nāgā yadā mātrā dahyamānā divāniśam ..
nirvāpitā gavāṃ kṣīraistataḥ prabhṛti vallabhāḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
शप्ता नागा यदा मात्रा दह्यमाना दिवानिशम् ..
निर्वापिता गवां क्षीरैस्ततः प्रभृति वल्लभाः .. 4 ..
text_mt: When the snakes were cursed by their mother and burning day and night, / they were cooled by cows' milk; since then, [such offerings] are beloved [to them].

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
mātrā śaptāḥ kathaṃ nāgāḥ kimuddiśya ca kāraṇam ..
kathaṃ vā tasya śāpasya vināśo' bhūjjanārdana .. 5 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
मात्रा शप्ताः कथं नागाः किमुद्दिश्य च कारणम् ..
कथं वा तस्य शापस्य विनाशो' भूज्जनार्दन .. 5 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Why were the snakes cursed by their mother, and on account of what cause? / And how did the destruction of that curse come to pass, O Janārdana?

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
uccaiḥśravāśvarājaśca śvetavarṇo'mṛtodbhavaḥ ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā cābravītkadrūrnāgānāṃ jananī svasām .. .. 6 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
उच्चैःश्रवाश्वराजश्च श्वेतवर्णोऽमृतोद्भवः ..
तं दृष्ट्वा चाब्रवीत्कद्रूर्नागानां जननी स्वसाम् .. .. 6 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Uccaiḥśravas was the king of horses, white-coloured, born from the nectar of immortality. / Having seen him, Kadrū, the mother of the snakes, said to her sister:

sanskrit_iast:
aśvaratnamidaṃ śvetaṃ paśyapaśyāmṛtodbhavam ..
kṛṣṇāṃśca vīkṣyase bālānsarvaśvetānutādya vai .. 7 ..
meaning:
अश्वरत्नमिदं श्वेतं पश्यपश्यामृतोद्भवम् ..
कृष्णांश्च वीक्ष्यसे बालान्सर्वश्वेतानुताद्य वै .. 7 ..
text_mt: "Look, look at this jewel of a horse, white, born from the nectar of immortality! / And do you perceive its hairs to be black, or completely white, today?"

sanskrit_iast:
.. vinatovāca .. ..
sarvaśveto hayavaro nāyaṃ kṛṣṇo na lohitaḥ ..
kathaṃ tvaṃ vīkṣase kṛṣṇaṃ vinatovāca tāṃ svasām .. 8 ..
meaning:
.. विनतोवाच .. ..
सर्वश्वेतो हयवरो नायं कृष्णो न लोहितः ..
कथं त्वं वीक्षसे कृष्णं विनतोवाच तां स्वसाम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Vinatā said: / "This excellent horse is completely white; it is neither black nor red. / How do you see it as black?" Vinatā said to that sister.

sanskrit_iast:
.. kadrūruvāca .. .
vīkṣe'hamekanayanā kṛṣṇabāla samanvitam ..
dvinetrā ca tvaṃ vinate na paśyasi paṇaṃ kuru .. 9 ..
meaning:
.. कद्रूरुवाच .. .
वीक्षेऽहमेकनयना कृष्णबाल समन्वितम् ..
द्विनेत्रा च त्वं विनते न पश्यसि पणं कुरु .. 9 ..
text_mt: Kadrū said: / "Though one-eyed, I see it endowed with black tail-hairs; / and you, having two eyes, Vinatā, do not see it! Make a wager!"

sanskrit_iast:
.. vinatovāca .. ..
ahaṃ dāsī bhavitrī te kṛṣṇakeśe pradarśite ..
na ceddarśayase kadru mama dāsī bhaviṣyasi .. 4.36.10 ..
meaning:
.. विनतोवाच .. ..
अहं दासी भवित्री ते कृष्णकेशे प्रदर्शिते ..
न चेद्दर्शयसे कद्रु मम दासी भविष्यसि .. 4.36.10 ..
text_mt: Vinatā said: / "I shall become your slave if a black hair is shown; / if you cannot show it, Kadrū, you shall become my slave."

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ te vipaṇaṃ kṛtvā gate krodhasamanvite ..
suṣupte prājyadoṣe tu kadrūrjihmamaciṃtayat .. 11 ..
meaning:
एवं ते विपणं कृत्वा गते क्रोधसमन्विते ..
सुषुप्ते प्राज्यदोषे तु कद्रूर्जिह्ममचिंतयत् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Having thus made a wager, filled with anger, they departed. / While they slept, in the dead of night, Kadrū devised deceit.

sanskrit_iast:
āhūya putrān provāca bālā bhūtvā hayottame ..
tiṣṭhadhvaṃ vipaṇau jeṣye vinatāṃ jayagṛddhinīm .. 12 ..
meaning:
आहूय पुत्रान् प्रोवाच बाला भूत्वा हयोत्तमे ..
तिष्ठध्वं विपणौ जेष्ये विनतां जयगृद्धिनीम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Summoning her sons, she said: "Becoming hairs on the excellent horse, / stay there in the wager, and I shall defeat Vinatā, who is greedy for victory!"

sanskrit_iast:
procuste jihmabuddhiṃ tāṃ nāgāḥ kadrūṃ vigṛhya ca ..
adharma eṣa tu mahānkariṣyāmo na te vacaḥ ..
aśapadruṣitā kadrūḥ pāvako vaḥ pradhakṣyati .. 13 ..
meaning:
प्रोचुस्ते जिह्मबुद्धिं तां नागाः कद्रूं विगृह्य च ..
अधर्म एष तु महान्करिष्यामो न ते वचः ..
अशपद्रुषिता कद्रूः पावको वः प्रधक्ष्यति .. 13 ..
text_mt: Opposing her, the snakes said to Kadrū of deceitful intent: / "This is a great unrighteousness; we will not obey your word." / Angered, Kadrū cursed them: "Fire shall consume you all!"

sanskrit_iast:
gate bahutithe kāle pāṃḍavo janamejayaḥ ..
sarpasatraṃ sa kartā vai bhūmāvanyaiḥ suduṣkaram ..14..
meaning:
गते बहुतिथे काले पांडवो जनमेजयः ..
सर्पसत्रं स कर्ता वै भूमावन्यैः सुदुष्करम् ..14..
text_mt: "When much time has passed, the Pāṇḍava Janamejaya / will perform a snake sacrifice on earth, most difficult for others to do.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminsatre ca tigmāṃśuḥ pāvako bhakṣayiṣyati ..
evaṃ śaptvā tadā kadrūḥ pratyuvāca na kiṃcana ..15..
meaning:
तस्मिन्सत्रे च तिग्मांशुः पावको भक्षयिष्यति ..
एवं शप्त्वा तदा कद्रूः प्रत्युवाच न किंचन ..15..
text_mt: And in that sacrifice, the blazing-rayed fire will consume [you]." / Having cursed [them] thus, Kadrū then said nothing [further].

sanskrit_iast:
mātrā śaptastadā nāgaḥ kartavyaṃ nānvapadyata ..
vāsukirduḥkhasaṃtaptaḥ papāta bhuvi mūrcchitaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
मात्रा शप्तस्तदा नागः कर्तव्यं नान्वपद्यत ..
वासुकिर्दुःखसंतप्तः पपात भुवि मूर्च्छितः .. 16 ..
text_mt: Cursed then by his mother, the serpent did not follow what was to be done. / Tormented by grief, Vāsuki fell senseless to the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
vāsukiṃ duḥkhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmā provāca sāṃtvayan..
mā śuco vāsuke'tyarthaṃ śṛṇu madvacanaṃ param.. 17..
meaning:
वासुकिं दुःखितं दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मा प्रोवाच सांत्वयन्..
मा शुचो वासुकेऽत्यर्थं शृणु मद्वचनं परम्.. 17..
text_mt: Seeing Vāsuki grieved, Brahmā consoled him, saying: / "Do not grieve excessively, O Vāsuki; hear my supreme word.

sanskrit_iast:
yāyāvarakule jāto jaratkāruriti dvijaḥ..
bhaviṣyati mahātejāstasminkāle taponidhiḥ ..18..
meaning:
यायावरकुले जातो जरत्कारुरिति द्विजः..
भविष्यति महातेजास्तस्मिन्काले तपोनिधिः ..18..
text_mt: Born in the Yāyāvara lineage, a brāhmaṇa named Jaratkāru, / possessed of great splendour and a storehouse of asceticism, will arise at that time.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaginīṃ ca jaratkāruṃ tasya tvaṃ pratidāsyasi ..
bhavitā tasya putro'sāvastīka iti viśrutaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
भगिनीं च जरत्कारुं तस्य त्वं प्रतिदास्यसि ..
भविता तस्य पुत्रोऽसावस्तीक इति विश्रुतः .. 19 ..
text_mt: And you shall give [your] sister Jaratkāru to him in marriage. / A son will be born to him, celebrated as Āstīka.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tatsatraṃ pravṛddhaṃ vai nāgānāṃ bhayadaṃ mahat ..
niṣedhayiṣyati munirvāgbhiḥ saṃpūjya pārthivam .. 4.36.20 ..
meaning:
स तत्सत्रं प्रवृद्धं वै नागानां भयदं महत् ..
निषेधयिष्यति मुनिर्वाग्भिः संपूज्य पार्थिवम् .. 4.36.20 ..
text_mt: That sage will halt that grand, ongoing sacrifice / that brings terror to the serpents, after honouring the king with his words.

sanskrit_iast:
tadiyaṃ bhaginī nāga rūpaudāryaguṇānvitā ..
jaratkārurjaratkāroḥ pradeyā hyavi cārataḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
तदियं भगिनी नाग रूपौदार्यगुणान्विता ..
जरत्कारुर्जरत्कारोः प्रदेया ह्यवि चारतः .. 21 ..
text_mt: Therefore, O serpent, this sister Jaratkāru, endowed with beauty, generosity, and virtues, / must indeed be given without hesitation to Jaratkāru.

sanskrit_iast:
yadāsau prārthyate'raṇye yatkiñcitpravadiṣyati ..
tatkartavyamaśeṣeṇa icchecchreyastathātmanaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
यदासौ प्रार्थ्यतेऽरण्ये यत्किञ्चित्प्रवदिष्यति ..
तत्कर्तव्यमशेषेण इच्छेच्छ्रेयस्तथात्मनः .. 22 ..
text_mt: When he is requested in the wilderness, whatever he will declare, / all of that must be done entirely if one desires welfare for oneself."

sanskrit_iast:
pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvā vāsukiṃ praṇipatya ca ..
tathākarodyathā coktaṃ yatnaṃ paramamāsthitaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
पितामहवचः श्रुत्वा वासुकिं प्रणिपत्य च ..
तथाकरोद्यथा चोक्तं यत्नं परममास्थितः .. 23 ..
text_mt: Hearing the Grandfather's word, and having bowed to Vāsuki, / he acted just as was told, exerting the utmost effort.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā pannagāḥ sarve praharṣotphullalocanāḥ ..
punarjātamivātmānaṃ menire bhujagottamāḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा पन्नगाः सर्वे प्रहर्षोत्फुल्ललोचनाः ..
पुनर्जातमिवात्मानं मेनिरे भुजगोत्तमाः .. 24 ..
text_mt: Hearing that, all the serpents, their eyes blossoming with immense joy, / those best of snakes, considered themselves as if born anew.

sanskrit_iast:
aplave tu nimagnānāṃ ghore yajñāgnisāgare ..
āstīkastatra bhavitā plavabhūto'bhayapradaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
अप्लवे तु निमग्नानां घोरे यज्ञाग्निसागरे ..
आस्तीकस्तत्र भविता प्लवभूतोऽभयप्रदः .. 25 ..
text_mt: To those submerged without a boat in the dreadful ocean of sacrificial fire, / Āstīka will be there as a boat, granting fearlessness.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā sa cāgnirājānamṛtvijastadanaṃtaram ..
nivartayiṣyati yāgaṃ nāgānāṃ mohanaṃ param .. 26 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा स चाग्निराजानमृत्विजस्तदनंतरम् ..
निवर्तयिष्यति यागं नागानां मोहनं परम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: And hearing that, the fire, the king, and subsequently the officiating priests, / will halt the sacrifice that was the utmost delusion of the serpents.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamyāṃ tacca bhavitā brahmā provāca lelihān ..
tasmādiyaṃ mahārāja pañcamī dayitā śubhā .. 27 ..
meaning:
पञ्चम्यां तच्च भविता ब्रह्मा प्रोवाच लेलिहान् ..
तस्मादियं महाराज पञ्चमी दयिता शुभा .. 27 ..
text_mt: "And that will occur on the pañcamī," Brahmā told the serpents. / "Therefore, O great king, this auspicious pañcamī is beloved,

sanskrit_iast:
nāgānāṃ harṣajananī dattā vai brahmaṇā purā ..
dattvā tu bhojanaṃ pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu kāmataḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
नागानां हर्षजननी दत्ता वै ब्रह्मणा पुरा ..
दत्त्वा तु भोजनं पूर्वं ब्राह्मणानां तु कामतः .. 28 ..
text_mt: bringing joy to the serpents, granted indeed by Brahmā of old. / But having first given food to the brāhmaṇas according to desire,

sanskrit_iast:
visṛjya nāgāḥ prīyaṃtāṃ ye kecitpṛthivītale ..
himācale ye vasanti yeṃ'tarikṣe divisthitāḥ ..
ye nadīṣu mahānāgā ye saraḥsvabhigāminaḥ ..29..
meaning:
विसृज्य नागाः प्रीयंतां ये केचित्पृथिवीतले ..
हिमाचले ये वसन्ति येंऽतरिक्षे दिविस्थिताः ..
ये नदीषु महानागा ये सरःस्वभिगामिनः ..29..
text_mt: having dismissed [them], [saying:] 'May the serpents be pleased, whichever ones are on the surface of the earth, / those who dwell on the Himālaya, those who reside in the atmosphere, in the sky, / those great serpents who are in rivers, those who frequent lakes,

sanskrit_iast: ye vāpīṣu taḍāgeṣu teṣu sarveṣu vai namaḥ ..4.36.30..
meaning: ये वापीषु तडागेषु तेषु सर्वेषु वै नमः ..4.36.30..
text_mt: those in stepwells and ponds—to all of them, indeed, homage!'

sanskrit_iast:
nāgānviprāṃśca saṃpūjya visṛjya ca yathārthataḥ ..
tataḥ paścācca bhuñjīyātsaha bhṛtyairnnarādhipa ..31..
meaning:
नागान्विप्रांश्च संपूज्य विसृज्य च यथार्थतः ..
ततः पश्चाच्च भुञ्जीयात्सह भृत्यैर्न्नराधिप ..31..
text_mt: Having worshipped the serpents and the brāhmaṇas and dismissed them according to rule, / thereafter one should eat together with [one's] servants, O lord of men.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaṃ madhuramaśnīyātsvecchayā tadanaṃta ram ..
evaṃ niyamayuktasya yatphalaṃ tannibodha me ..32..
meaning:
पूर्वं मधुरमश्नीयात्स्वेच्छया तदनंत रम् ..
एवं नियमयुक्तस्य यत्फलं तन्निबोध मे ..32..
text_mt: One should first eat sweet food, and thereafter according to one's wish. / Hear from me the reward of one who is engaged in such an observance:

sanskrit_iast:
mṛto nāgapuraṃ yāti pūjyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ ..
vimānavaramārūḍho ramate kālamīpsitam ..33..
meaning:
मृतो नागपुरं याति पूज्यमानोऽप्सरोगणैः ..
विमानवरमारूढो रमते कालमीप्सितम् ..33..
text_mt: When he dies, he goes to the city of serpents, honoured by hosts of apsarases; / mounted on a supreme celestial chariot, he enjoys himself for the desired time.

sanskrit_iast:
iha cāgatya rājāsau sarvarājavaro bhavet ..
sarvaratnasamṛddhaśca vāhanāḍhyaśca jāyate .. 34 ..
meaning:
इह चागत्य राजासौ सर्वराजवरो भवेत् ..
सर्वरत्नसमृद्धश्च वाहनाढ्यश्च जायते .. 34 ..
text_mt: And having returned here, he becomes a king, the best among all kings, / and he is born rich in all jewels and wealthy in mounts.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcajanmanyasau rājā dvāparedvāpare bhavet ..
ādhivyādhivinirmuktaḥ patnīputrasahāyavān ..
tasmātpūjyāśca nāgāśca ghṛtakṣīrādinā sadā .. 35 ..
meaning:
पञ्चजन्मन्यसौ राजा द्वापरेद्वापरे भवेत् ..
आधिव्याधिविनिर्मुक्तः पत्नीपुत्रसहायवान् ..
तस्मात्पूज्याश्च नागाश्च घृतक्षीरादिना सदा .. 35 ..
text_mt: For five births, in every Dvāpara [age], he will be a king, / freed from mental anguish and disease, accompanied by wife and sons. / Therefore the serpents must always be worshipped with ghee, milk, and the like."

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
daśaṃti yaṃ naraṃ kṛṣṇa nāgāḥ krodhasamanvitāḥ ..
bhavetkiṃ tasya daṣṭasya vistarādbrūhi māṃ hare .. 36 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
दशंति यं नरं कृष्ण नागाः क्रोधसमन्विताः ..
भवेत्किं तस्य दष्टस्य विस्तराद्ब्रूहि मां हरे .. 36 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / "O Kṛṣṇa, whichsoever man the serpents bite when filled with wrath, / what becomes of that bitten [man]? Tell me in detail, O Hari."

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
nāgadaṣṭo naro rājanprāpya mṛtyuṃ vrajatyadhaḥ ..
adho gatvā bhavetsarpo nirviṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
नागदष्टो नरो राजन्प्राप्य मृत्युं व्रजत्यधः ..
अधो गत्वा भवेत्सर्पो निर्विषो नात्र संशयः .. 37 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / "A man bitten by a serpent, meeting death, goes downward, O king. / Having gone downward, he becomes a venomless snake; there is no doubt in this."

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
nāgadaṣṭaḥ pitā yasya bhrātā mātā suhṛtsutaḥ ..
svasā vā duhitā bhāryā kiṃ kartavyaṃ vadasva me .. 38 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
नागदष्टः पिता यस्य भ्राता माता सुहृत्सुतः ..
स्वसा वा दुहिता भार्या किं कर्तव्यं वदस्व मे .. 38 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / "He whose father, brother, mother, friend, son, / sister, daughter, or wife has been bitten by a serpent—tell me what is to be done.

sanskrit_iast:
mokṣāya tasya govinda dānaṃ vratamupoṣitam ..
brūhi me yaduśārdūla yena svargatimāpnuyāt.. .. 39 ..
meaning:
मोक्षाय तस्य गोविन्द दानं व्रतमुपोषितम् ..
ब्रूहि मे यदुशार्दूल येन स्वर्गतिमाप्नुयात्.. .. 39 ..
text_mt: For his liberation, O Govinda, tell me of a gift, a votive observance, or a fast, / O tiger of the Yadus, by which he may attain heaven."

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
upoṣyā pañcamī rājannāgānāṃ puṣṭivarddhinī ..
varṣamekaṃ tu rājendra vidhānaṃ śṛṇu yādṛśam .. 4.36.40 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
उपोष्या पञ्चमी राजन्नागानां पुष्टिवर्द्धिनी ..
वर्षमेकं तु राजेन्द्र विधानं शृणु यादृशम् .. 4.36.40 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / "A pañcamī should be fasted on, O king, which increases the nourishment of the serpents, / for one year, O lord of kings; hear the manner of the procedure.

sanskrit_iast:
māse bhādrapade yā tu śuklapakṣe mahīpate ..
sā ca puṇyatamā proktā grāhyā sadgatikāmyayā .. 41 ..
meaning:
मासे भाद्रपदे या तु शुक्लपक्षे महीपते ..
सा च पुण्यतमा प्रोक्ता ग्राह्या सद्गतिकाम्यया .. 41 ..
text_mt: The one in the month of Bhādrapada, in the bright fortnight, O protector of the earth, / is declared to be most meritorious; it should be undertaken with the desire for a good realm.

sanskrit_iast:
jñeyā dvādaśa varṣāṃte pañcamyo bharatarṣabha ..
caturthyāmekabhaktaṃ tu tasyāṃ naktaṃ prakīrtitam .. 42 ..
meaning:
ज्ञेया द्वादश वर्षांते पञ्चम्यो भरतर्षभ ..
चतुर्थ्यामेकभक्तं तु तस्यां नक्तं प्रकीर्तितम् .. 42 ..
text_mt: Twelve pañcamīs are to be observed at the end of the year, O bull of the Bharatas. / On the caturthī, a single meal [is prescribed], and on that [pañcamī], a nocturnal meal is proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūricandramayaṃ nāgamathavā kaladhautajam ..
kṛtvā dārumayaṃ cāpi utāho mṛnmayaṃ nṛpa .. 43 ..
meaning:
भूरिचन्द्रमयं नागमथवा कलधौतजम् ..
कृत्वा दारुमयं चापि उताहो मृन्मयं नृप .. 43 ..
text_mt: Having fashioned a serpent made of abundant silver, or born of gold, / or made of wood, or indeed of clay, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamyāmarcayedbhaktyā nāgaṃ pañcaphaṇaṃ śṛṇu ..
karavīraistathā padmairjātīpuṣpaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
पञ्चम्यामर्चयेद्भक्त्या नागं पञ्चफणं शृणु ..
करवीरैस्तथा पद्मैर्जातीपुष्पैः सुशोभनैः .. 44 ..
text_mt: one should worship with devotion on the pañcamī a five-hooded serpent—hear [with what]: / with oleanders, as well as lotuses, and exceedingly beautiful jasmine flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapuṣpaiḥ sanaivedyaiḥ pūjya pannagasattamam ..
brāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścād ghṛtapāyasamodakaiḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
गन्धपुष्पैः सनैवेद्यैः पूज्य पन्नगसत्तमम् ..
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेत्पश्चाद् घृतपायसमोदकैः .. 45 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped the best of serpents with fragrant flowers and with food offerings, / one should afterwards feed the brāhmaṇas with ghee, milk-rice, and sweetmeats.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇabaliḥ kāryaḥ sarpadaṣṭasya dehinaḥ ..
dāne piṃḍapradāne ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpayet .. 46 ..
meaning:
नारायणबलिः कार्यः सर्पदष्टस्य देहिनः ..
दाने पिंडप्रदाने च ब्राह्मणानां च तर्पयेत् .. 46 ..
text_mt: A Nārāyaṇa-bali should be performed for an embodied soul bitten by a snake; / with gifts and the offering of piṇḍas, one should also gratify the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣotsargastu kartavyo gate saṃvatsare nṛpa ..
snānaṃ kṛtvodakaṃ dadyātkṛṣṇo'tra prīyatāmiti .. 47 ..
meaning:
वृषोत्सर्गस्तु कर्तव्यो गते संवत्सरे नृप ..
स्नानं कृत्वोदकं दद्यात्कृष्णोऽत्र प्रीयतामिति .. 47 ..
text_mt: A setting-free of a bull is to be performed when a full year has passed, O king. / Having bathed, one should offer water, saying: 'May Kṛṣṇa be pleased here.'

sanskrit_iast:
anaṃto vāsukiḥ śeṣaḥ padmaḥ kambala eva ca ..
tathā takṣaka nāgaśca nāgaścāśvataro nṛpa .. 48
meaning:
अनंतो वासुकिः शेषः पद्मः कम्बल एव च ..
तथा तक्षक नागश्च नागश्चाश्वतरो नृप .. 48
text_mt: Ananta, Vāsuki, Śeṣa, Padma, and Kambala, / and likewise the serpent Takṣaka, and the serpent Aśvatara, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ śaṃkhapālaḥ kāliyastakṣakastathā ..
piṃgalaśca mahānāgo māsimāsi prakīrtitāḥ ..
vatsarāṃte pāraṇaṃ syānmahābrāhmaṇabhojanam .. 49 ..
meaning:
धृतराष्ट्रः शंखपालः कालियस्तक्षकस्तथा ..
पिंगलश्च महानागो मासिमासि प्रकीर्तिताः ..
वत्सरांते पारणं स्यान्महाब्राह्मणभोजनम् .. 49 ..
text_mt: Dhṛtarāṣṭra, Śaṅkhapāla, Kāliya, and Takṣaka, / and Piṅgala, the great serpent, are proclaimed month by month. / At the end of the year, there should be the breaking of the fast with the feeding of great brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
itihāsavide nāgaḥ kāṃcanena kṛto nṛpa ..
tathārjunī pradātavyā savatsā kāṃsyadohanā .. 4.36.50 ..
meaning:
इतिहासविदे नागः कांचनेन कृतो नृप ..
तथार्जुनी प्रदातव्या सवत्सा कांस्यदोहना .. 4.36.50 ..
text_mt: A serpent made of gold should be given to one who knows the traditional lore, O king, / as well as a red cow along with her calf, and a bronze milking vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa pāraṇake pārtha vidhiḥ prokto vicakṣaṇaiḥ ..
kṛte vratavare tasminsadgatiṃ yāṃti bāndhavāḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
एष पारणके पार्थ विधिः प्रोक्तो विचक्षणैः ..
कृते व्रतवरे तस्मिन्सद्गतिं यांति बान्धवाः .. 51 ..
text_mt: This procedure for the breaking of the fast, O son of Pṛthā, has been declared by the wise. / When that best of votive observances has been performed, [one's] relatives go to a good realm.

sanskrit_iast:
ye dandaśūkaradanairdaṣṭāḥ prāptā hyadhogatim ..
varṣamekaṃ cari ṣyaṃti bhaktyā ye vratamuttamam ..
dāṃṣṭrikaṃ mokṣyate teṣāṃ śubhaṃ sthānamavāpsyati .. 52 ..
meaning:
ये दन्दशूकरदनैर्दष्टाः प्राप्ता ह्यधोगतिम् ..
वर्षमेकं चरि ष्यंति भक्त्या ये व्रतमुत्तमम् ..
दांष्ट्रिकं मोक्ष्यते तेषां शुभं स्थानमवाप्स्यति .. 52 ..
text_mt: Those who, bitten by the teeth of snakes, have indeed reached a downward realm, / for them, if [relatives] perform this best of votive observances with devotion for one year, / the state caused by fangs will be released, and they will attain an auspicious place.

sanskrit_iast:
yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ paṭhedbhaktyā samanvitaḥ ..
na vai kuṭumbe nāgebhyo bhayaṃ bhavati kutracit .. 53 ..
meaning:
यश्चेदं शृणुयान्नित्यं पठेद्भक्त्या समन्वितः ..
न वै कुटुम्बे नागेभ्यो भयं भवति कुत्रचित् .. 53 ..
text_mt: And whoever hears this constantly, or recites it filled with devotion, / there is indeed never any fear from serpents in their family."

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
tadvadbhādrapade māsi pañcamyāṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ ..
yastvālikhya naro nāgānkṛ ṣṇavarṇādivarṇakaiḥ ..
pūjayedgandhapuṣpaistu sarpirgguggulupāyasaiḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
तद्वद्भाद्रपदे मासि पञ्चम्यां श्रद्धयान्वितः ..
यस्त्वालिख्य नरो नागान्कृ ष्णवर्णादिवर्णकैः ..
पूजयेद्गन्धपुष्पैस्तु सर्पिर्ग्गुग्गुलुपायसैः .. 54 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / "Likewise, in the month of Bhādrapada, on the pañcamī, endowed with faith, / that man who draws serpents with black and other pigments / and worships them with fragrant flowers, ghee, bdellium, and milk-rice...

sanskrit_iast:
tasya tuṣṭiṃ samāyāṃti pannagāstakṣakādayaḥ ..
āsaptamātkulāttasya na bhayaṃ nāgato bhavet .. 55 ..
meaning:
तस्य तुष्टिं समायांति पन्नगास्तक्षकादयः ..
आसप्तमात्कुलात्तस्य न भयं नागतो भवेत् .. 55 ..
text_mt:
Takṣaka and the other serpents become pleased with him;
no fear of snakes shall arise for him unto the seventh generation.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena nāgānsaṃpūjayedbudhaḥ ..
tathā cāśvayuje māsi pañcamyāṃ kurunaṃdana .. 56 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन नागान्संपूजयेद्बुधः ..
तथा चाश्वयुजे मासि पञ्चम्यां कुरुनंदन .. 56 ..
text_mt:
Therefore, a wise person should worship the serpents with every effort.
Likewise, O son of Kuru, on the fifth [tithi] in the month of Āśvina,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā kuśamayānnāgāniṃdrāṇyā saha pūjayet ..
ghṛtodakābhyāṃ payasā snapayitvā viśāṃpate .. 57 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा कुशमयान्नागानिंद्राण्या सह पूजयेत् ..
घृतोदकाभ्यां पयसा स्नपयित्वा विशांपते .. 57 ..
text_mt:
having fashioned serpents out of kuśa grass, one should worship them together with Indrāṇī,
having bathed them in clarified butter, water, and milk, O lord of the people,

sanskrit_iast:
godhūmaiḥ payasā svinnairbhakṣyaiśca vividhaistathā ..
yastvasyāṃ vividhānnāgāñchucirbhaktyā samanvitaḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
गोधूमैः पयसा स्विन्नैर्भक्ष्यैश्च विविधैस्तथा ..
यस्त्वस्यां विविधान्नागाञ्छुचिर्भक्त्या समन्वितः .. 58 ..
text_mt:
with wheat steamed in milk, and likewise with diverse eatables.
One who, purified and full of devotion, on this [day] [worships] the various serpents,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayetkuruśārdūla tasya śeṣādayo nṛpa ..
nāgāḥ prītā bhavantīha śāṃtiṃ prāpnoti śobhanām ..
sa śāṃtilokamāsādya modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ .. 59 ..
meaning:
पूजयेत्कुरुशार्दूल तस्य शेषादयो नृप ..
नागाः प्रीता भवन्तीह शांतिं प्राप्नोति शोभनाम् ..
स शांतिलोकमासाद्य मोदते शाश्वतीः समाः .. 59 ..
text_mt: worships them, O tiger of the Kurus, O king, with him Śeṣa and the other / serpents are pleased in this world, and he obtains splendid peace; / reaching the world of peace, he rejoices for eternal years.

sanskrit_iast:
ityetatkathitaṃ vīra pañcamīvratamuttamam ..
tatrāyamucyate maṃtraḥ sarvadoṣaniṣedhakaḥ .. 4.36.60 ..
meaning:
इत्येतत्कथितं वीर पञ्चमीव्रतमुत्तमम् ..
तत्रायमुच्यते मंत्रः सर्वदोषनिषेधकः .. 4.36.60 ..
text_mt:
Thus this supreme votive observance of the fifth [tithi] has been declared, O hero.
In that regard, this mantra which averts all defects is uttered:

sanskrit_iast:
( oṃ kurukulle huṃ phaṭsvāhā )
bhaktena bhaktisahitāḥ śatapañcamīṣu ye pūjayaṃti bhujagānkusumopahāraiḥ..
teṣāṃ gṛheṣvabhayadā hi sadaiva sarpāḥ śaśvatpramodaparamā rucayo bhavaṃti .. 61 ..
śrīpañcamīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
( ओं कुरुकुल्ले हुं फट्स्वाहा )
भक्तेन भक्तिसहिताः शतपञ्चमीषु ये पूजयंति भुजगान्कुसुमोपहारैः..
तेषां गृहेष्वभयदा हि सदैव सर्पाः शश्वत्प्रमोदपरमा रुचयो भवंति .. 61 ..
श्रीपञ्चमीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
“Oṃ kurukulle huṃ phaṭ svāhā.”
Those who with devotion offer worship with offerings of flowers to serpents accompanied by devotion on a hundred fifth [tithis],
for them serpents are verily ever the givers of fearlessness in their homes, and they become splendours of supreme and perpetual joy.
Description of the Śrīpañcamī Votive Observance

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kathamāsādyate lakṣmīrdurllabhā bhuvanatraye ..
dānena tapasā vāpi vratena niyamena vā .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
कथमासाद्यते लक्ष्मीर्दुर्ल्लभा भुवनत्रये ..
दानेन तपसा वापि व्रतेन नियमेन वा .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
How is Lakṣmī, who is hard to obtain in the three worlds, acquired—
by gift, or by asceticism, or by votive observance, or by restriction,
title: adhyāyaḥ 037

sanskrit_iast:
japahomanamaskāraiḥ saṃskārairvā pṛthagvidhaiḥ ..
etadvada yaduśreṣṭha sarvavittvaṃ mato mama .. 2 ..
meaning:
जपहोमनमस्कारैः संस्कारैर्वा पृथग्विधैः ..
एतद्वद यदुश्रेष्ठ सर्ववित्त्वं मतो मम .. 2 ..
text_mt:
by recitation of mantras, offerings into the fire, prostrations, or various consecrations?
Tell this, O best of the Yadus; you are considered by me omniscient.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
bhṛgoḥ khyātyāṃ samutpannā pūrvaṃ śrīḥ śrūyate śubhā ..
vāsudevāya sā dattā muninā mānavṛddhaye .. 3 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
भृगोः ख्यात्यां समुत्पन्ना पूर्वं श्रीः श्रूयते शुभा ..
वासुदेवाय सा दत्ता मुनिना मानवृद्धये .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudevo'pi tāṃ prāpya pīnonnatapayodharām ..
padmapatraviśālākṣīṃ pūrṇacandranibhāna nām .. 4 ..
meaning:
वासुदेवोऽपि तां प्राप्य पीनोन्नतपयोधराम् ..
पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षीं पूर्णचन्द्रनिभान नाम् .. 4 ..
text_mt:
Vāsudeva too, having obtained her whose breasts were plump and high,
whose wide eyes were like lotus petals, whose face resembled the full moon,

sanskrit_iast:
bhābhāsitadigābhogāṃ sākṣādbhānoḥ prabhāmiva ..
nitaṃbāḍaṃbaravatīṃ mattamātaṃgagāminīm ..
reme saha tayā rājanbibhramodbhrāṃtacittayā .. 5 ..
meaning:
भाभासितदिगाभोगां साक्षाद्भानोः प्रभामिव ..
नितंबाडंबरवतीं मत्तमातंगगामिनीम् ..
रेमे सह तया राजन्बिभ्रमोद्भ्रांतचित्तया .. 5 ..
text_mt:
who illuminated the expanse of the directions with her radiance, like the visible splendour of the sun,
possessed of majestic hips, striding like an elephant in rut—
he sported with her, O king, whose heart was stirred by graceful play.

sanskrit_iast:
sā ca viṣṇuṃ jagajjiṣṇuṃ patiṃ trijagatāṃ patim ..
prāpya kṛtārthamātmānaṃ mene mānayaśodhanā .. 6 ..
meaning:
सा च विष्णुं जगज्जिष्णुं पतिं त्रिजगतां पतिम् ..
प्राप्य कृतार्थमात्मानं मेने मानयशोधना .. 6 ..
text_mt:
And she, whose wealth was pride and renown, having obtained Viṣṇu,
the conqueror of the world, her husband and lord of the three worlds, thought herself fulfilled.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛṣṭaṃ puṣṭaṃ jagatsarvamabhavadbhā vitaṃ tayā ..
lakṣmyā nirīkṣitaṃ caiva sānaṃdaṃ hi mahītalam .. 7 ..
meaning:
हृष्टं पुष्टं जगत्सर्वमभवद्भा वितं तया ..
लक्ष्म्या निरीक्षितं चैव सानंदं हि महीतलम् .. 7 ..
text_mt:
The entire world became joyful and prosperous, animated by her,
and the surface of the earth was indeed full of bliss, looked upon by Lakṣmī.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣemaṃ subhikṣamārogyamanākrandamanākulam ..
jagadāsīdanudbhrāntaṃ praśāṃtopadravaṃ tathā .. 8 ..
meaning:
क्षेमं सुभिक्षमारोग्यमनाक्रन्दमनाकुलम् ..
जगदासीदनुद्भ्रान्तं प्रशांतोपद्रवं तथा .. 8 ..
text_mt:
Safety, abundance, health, freedom from lamentation, freedom from distress—
the world was unagitated and its calamities quelled.

sanskrit_iast:
divi devā mumudire dānavā daityamāgatāḥ ..
visphāritaphaṇābhogā nāgāścaiva rasātale .. 9 ..
meaning:
दिवि देवा मुमुदिरे दानवा दैत्यमागताः ..
विस्फारितफणाभोगा नागाश्चैव रसातले .. 9 ..
text_mt:
In heaven the gods rejoiced, and the Dānavas who had come among the Daityas;
and in the netherworld, the serpents whose hoods expanded widely.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdaye brāhmaṇairvahnau bhujyate tridivairhaviḥ ..
cāturvarṇyamasaṃkīrṇaṃ pālyate pārtha pārthivaiḥ ..4.37.1 0..
meaning:
हृदये ब्राह्मणैर्वह्नौ भुज्यते त्रिदिवैर्हविः ..
चातुर्वर्ण्यमसंकीर्णं पाल्यते पार्थ पार्थिवैः ..4.37.1 0..
text_mt:
The oblation is consumed in the heart by Brahmins and in the sacrificial fire by the denizens of heaven;
the four social classes, unmixed, are protected by kings, O son of Pṛthā.

sanskrit_iast:
virocanaprabhṛtibhirdṛṣṭvaivaṃ daityasattamaiḥ ..
tapastaptumathārabdhamagnimāśritya saṃyataiḥ .. .. 11 ..
meaning:
विरोचनप्रभृतिभिर्दृष्ट्वैवं दैत्यसत्तमैः ..
तपस्तप्तुमथारब्धमग्निमाश्रित्य संयतैः .. .. 11 ..
text_mt:
Having seen this, the best of the Daityas, led by Virocana,
then, self-controlled, began to perform asceticism, having recourse to the fire.

sanskrit_iast:
somasaṃsthāhaviḥsaṃsthāpākasaṃkhyādibhirmakhaiḥ ..
sadācāraiḥ samārabdhamiṣṭaṃ sveṣṭābhilāṣibhiḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
सोमसंस्थाहविःसंस्थापाकसंख्यादिभिर्मखैः ..
सदाचारैः समारब्धमिष्टं स्वेष्टाभिलाषिभिः .. 12 ..
text_mt:
With sacrifices such as the Soma rites, oblation rites, and domestic offerings,
conducted with good conduct, they began that which was desired, aspiring for their own wishes.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dharmapradhānaistairvedavādaratātmabhi..
jagadāsītsamākrāṃtaṃ vikrameṇa krameṇa tu ..13..
meaning:
एवं धर्मप्रधानैस्तैर्वेदवादरतात्मभि..
जगदासीत्समाक्रांतं विक्रमेण क्रमेण तु ..13..
text_mt:
Thus by them, whose foremost principle was dharma, whose souls were devoted to the teachings of the Vedas,
the world was conquered by their valour by degrees.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīvilāsaprabhavo devānāmabhavanmadaḥ ..
madācchīlaṃ ca śaucaṃ ca satyaṃ sadyo vyanīnaśan .. .. 14 ..
meaning:
लक्ष्मीविलासप्रभवो देवानामभवन्मदः ..
मदाच्छीलं च शौचं च सत्यं सद्यो व्यनीनशन् .. .. 14 ..
text_mt:
Arising from the delights of Lakṣmī, arrogance arose among the gods;
from arrogance, they immediately destroyed their good character, purity, and truth.

sanskrit_iast:
satyaśaucavihīnāṃstāndevānsaṃtyajya cañcalān ..
jagāma dānavakulaṃ kuladevānurāgataḥ ..15..
meaning:
सत्यशौचविहीनांस्तान्देवान्संत्यज्य चञ्चलान् ..
जगाम दानवकुलं कुलदेवानुरागतः ..15..
text_mt:
Abandoning those gods who were devoid of truth and purity and unsteady,
she went to the race of the Dānavas out of affection for the gods of her race.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmyā bhāvitadehaistaiḥ punaruddhatamānasaiḥ..
vyavahartuṃ samārabdhamanyāyena madoddhataiḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
लक्ष्म्या भावितदेहैस्तैः पुनरुद्धतमानसैः..
व्यवहर्तुं समारब्धमन्यायेन मदोद्धतैः .. 16 ..
text_mt:
With their bodies animated by Lakṣmī, again their minds becoming haughty,
puffed up with pride, they began to conduct themselves unlawfully:

sanskrit_iast:
vayaṃ vedā vayaṃ yajñā vayaṃ vidyā vaya jagat ..
brahmaviṣṇuśaṃkarādyā vayaṃ sarve divaukasaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
वयं वेदा वयं यज्ञा वयं विद्या वय जगत् ..
ब्रह्मविष्णुशंकराद्या वयं सर्वे दिवौकसः .. 17 ..
text_mt:
“We are the Vedas! We are the sacrifices! We are knowledge! We are the world!
Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śaṅkara, and the others—we are all the celestial beings!”

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃkāravimūḍhāṃstāñjñātvā dānavasattamān ..
sāgaraṃ sā viveśātha bhrāṃtacittā bhṛgoḥ sutā .. 18 ..
meaning:
अहंकारविमूढांस्ताञ्ज्ञात्वा दानवसत्तमान् ..
सागरं सा विवेशाथ भ्रांतचित्ता भृगोः सुता .. 18 ..
text_mt:
Knowing those best of the Dānavas to be deluded by egotism,
then she, the daughter of Bhṛgu, her mind bewildered, entered the ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrābdhimadhyagatayā lakṣmyā kṣīṇārthasaṃcayam ..
nirānandagataśrīkamabhavadbhuvanatrayam .. 19 ..
meaning:
क्षीराब्धिमध्यगतया लक्ष्म्या क्षीणार्थसंचयम् ..
निरानन्दगतश्रीकमभवद्भुवनत्रयम् .. 19 ..
text_mt:
When Lakṣmī had gone into the midst of the milk ocean, the store of wealth diminished;
the three worlds became devoid of joy and stripped of splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
gataśrīkamathātmānaṃ matvā śaṃbarasūdanaḥ ..
papacchāṃgirasaṃ vipraṃ brūhi kiñcidvrataṃ mama .. 4.37.20 ..
meaning:
गतश्रीकमथात्मानं मत्वा शंबरसूदनः ..
पपच्छांगिरसं विप्रं ब्रूहि किञ्चिद्व्रतं मम .. 4.37.20 ..
text_mt:
Then, considering himself stripped of splendour, the slayer of Śambara
asked the Brahmin descended from Aṅgiras: “Tell me some votive observance,

sanskrit_iast:
yena saṃprāpyate lakṣmīrlabdhā na calate punaḥ ..
niścalāpi suhṛnmitrairbhogyā bhavati sā mune .. 21 ..
meaning:
येन संप्राप्यते लक्ष्मीर्लब्धा न चलते पुनः ..
निश्चलापि सुहृन्मित्रैर्भोग्या भवति सा मुने .. 21 ..
text_mt:
by which Lakṣmī is obtained, and, once obtained, does not depart again;
and even when immovable, she can be enjoyed by companions and friends, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
na sā śrītyabhimantavyā kanyā sā pālyate gṛhe ..
parārthaṃ yā suhṛnmitrabhṛtyairnaivopabhujyate .. 22 ..
meaning:
न सा श्रीत्यभिमन्तव्या कन्या सा पाल्यते गृहे ..
परार्थं या सुहृन्मित्रभृत्यैर्नैवोपभुज्यते .. 22 ..
text_mt:
That which is not enjoyed by companions, friends, and servants for another’s benefit
is not to be regarded as fortune; she is [merely] a maiden guarded in the home.”

sanskrit_iast:
śakrasyaitadvacaḥ śrutvā bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ ..
kathayāmāsa saṃciṃtya śubhaṃ śrīpañcamīvratam .. 23 ..
meaning:
शक्रस्यैतद्वचः श्रुत्वा बृहस्पतिरुदारधीः ..
कथयामास संचिंत्य शुभं श्रीपञ्चमीव्रतम् .. 23 ..
text_mt:
Hearing this speech of Śakra, Bṛhaspati of noble intellect,
having reflected, declared the auspicious Śrīpañcamī votive observance.

sanskrit_iast:
yatpurā kasyacitproktaṃ vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam ..
tadasmai kathayāmāsa sarahasyamaśeṣataḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
यत्पुरा कस्यचित्प्रोक्तं व्रतानामुत्तमं व्रतम् ..
तदस्मै कथयामास सरहस्यमशेषतः .. 24 ..
text_mt:
That which was anciently proclaimed to someone, the supreme votive observance among votive observances,
that he proclaimed to him together with its secret, completely without omission.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā kartumārabdhaṃ sureśena suraistathā ..
daityadānavagaṃdharvairyakṣaiḥ prakṣīṇakalmaṣaiḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा कर्तुमारब्धं सुरेशेन सुरैस्तथा ..
दैत्यदानवगंधर्वैर्यक्षैः प्रक्षीणकल्मषैः .. 25 ..
text_mt:
Hearing that, the lord of the gods and the gods began to perform it,
as did the Daityas, Dānavas, Gandharvas, and Yakṣas, whose sins were destroyed,

sanskrit_iast:
siddhaiḥ prasiddhacaritairviṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ..
brāhmaṇairbrahmatattvajñaiḥ samarthaiḥ pārthivaiḥ saha .. 26 ..
meaning:
सिद्धैः प्रसिद्धचरितैर्विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना ..
ब्राह्मणैर्ब्रह्मतत्त्वज्ञैः समर्थैः पार्थिवैः सह .. 26 ..
text_mt:
along with the Siddhas of renowned deeds, Viṣṇu the supreme lord,
Brahmins who know the truth of Brahman, and capable kings.

sanskrit_iast:
kaiścitsāttvikabhāvena rājasenāparairapi ..
tāmasena tathā kaiścitkṛtaṃ vratamidaṃ tathā .. 27 ..
meaning:
कैश्चित्सात्त्विकभावेन राजसेनापरैरपि ..
तामसेन तथा कैश्चित्कृतं व्रतमिदं तथा .. 27 ..
text_mt:
By some with a pure disposition, by others with an active disposition,
and likewise by some with a dark disposition, this votive observance was performed in that manner.

sanskrit_iast:
vrate samāpte bhūyiṣṭhe niṣṭhayā parayā prabho ..
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca yuddhamāsīdathoddhatam .. 28 ..
meaning:
व्रते समाप्ते भूयिष्ठे निष्ठया परया प्रभो ..
देवानां दानवानां च युद्धमासीदथोद्धतम् .. 28 ..
text_mt:
When the votive observance was almost completed with supreme fidelity, O lord,
there arose a fierce battle between the gods and the Dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
nirmathya bhujavīryeṇa sāgaraṃ saritāṃ patim..
samāharāmo hyamṛtaṃ hitāya tridivaukasām .. 29 ..
meaning:
निर्मथ्य भुजवीर्येण सागरं सरितां पतिम्..
समाहरामो ह्यमृतं हिताय त्रिदिवौकसाम् .. 29 ..
text_mt:
“Having churned the ocean, the lord of rivers, with the strength of our arms,
we shall bring forth the nectar of immortality for the benefit of the heaven-dwellers.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ samayaṃ kṛtvā mamaṃthurvaruṇālayam ..
maṃthānaṃ maṃdaraṃ kṛtvā netraṃ kṛtvā tu vāsukim .. 4.37.30 ..
meaning:
इत्येवं समयं कृत्वा ममंथुर्वरुणालयम् ..
मंथानं मंदरं कृत्वा नेत्रं कृत्वा तु वासुकिम् .. 4.37.30 ..
text_mt:
Having made an agreement thus, they churned the abode of Varuṇa,
making Mandara the churning stick, and making Vāsuki the churning rope.

sanskrit_iast:
mathyamānajalājjātaścandraḥ śītāṃśurujjvalaḥ ..
anaṃtaraṃ samutpannā lakṣmīḥ kṣīrābdhimadhyataḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
मथ्यमानजलाज्जातश्चन्द्रः शीतांशुरुज्ज्वलः ..
अनंतरं समुत्पन्ना लक्ष्मीः क्षीराब्धिमध्यतः .. 31 ..
text_mt:
From the waters being churned was born the bright, cool-rayed moon;
immediately thereafter, Lakṣmī arose from the midst of the milk ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
tayā vilokitāḥ sarve daityadānavasattamāḥ ..
ālokya sā jagāmāśu viṣṇorvakṣaḥsthalaṃ śubham .. 32 ..
meaning:
तया विलोकिताः सर्वे दैत्यदानवसत्तमाः ..
आलोक्य सा जगामाशु विष्णोर्वक्षःस्थलं शुभम् .. 32 ..
text_mt:
All the best of the Daityas and Dānavas were looked upon by her;
having looked, she went swiftly to the auspicious chest of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhinā viṣṇunā cīrṇaṃ vrataṃ tenābdhisaṃbhavā ..
śarīrasthā babhūvāsya vibhramodbhrāṃtalocanā .. 33 ..
meaning:
विधिना विष्णुना चीर्णं व्रतं तेनाब्धिसंभवा ..
शरीरस्था बभूवास्य विभ्रमोद्भ्रांतलोचना .. 33 ..
text_mt:
The votive observance had been performed by Viṣṇu according to rule; therefore, born of the ocean,
her eyes rolling with coquetry, she took her place upon his body.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ ca rājasabhāvena śakreṇaitatkṛtaṃ yataḥ ..
tatastribhuvanaiśvaryaṃ prāptaṃ tena maharddhikam .. 34 ..
meaning:
किं च राजसभावेन शक्रेणैतत्कृतं यतः ..
ततस्त्रिभुवनैश्वर्यं प्राप्तं तेन महर्द्धिकम् .. 34 ..
text_mt: Moreover, because this was performed by Indra with a passionate nature (rajas), / therefore sovereign rule over the three worlds, endowed with great prosperity, was obtained by him.

sanskrit_iast:
tamasāvṛtacittaistu saṃcīrṇaṃ daityadānavaiḥ ..
tena teṣāmathaiśvaryaṃ dṛṣṭanaṣṭamabhūtkila ..35..
meaning:
तमसावृतचित्तैस्तु संचीर्णं दैत्यदानवैः ..
तेन तेषामथैश्वर्यं दृष्टनष्टमभूत्किल ..35..
text_mt: However, it was observed by the Daityas and Dānavas with minds enveloped in darkness (tamas); / by that, their sovereignty became visible only to perish.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saśrīkamabhavatsadevāsuramānuṣam ..
jaracca jagatāṃ śreṣṭha vratasyāsya prabhāvataḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
एवं सश्रीकमभवत्सदेवासुरमानुषम् ..
जरच्च जगतां श्रेष्ठ व्रतस्यास्य प्रभावतः .. 36 ..
text_mt: Thus, along with gods, asuras, and humans, / and old [or young], O best of worlds, it became endowed with fortune (Śrī) through the power of this votive observance.

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kathametadvrataṃ kṛṣṇa kriyate manujaiḥ kadā ..
prārabhyate pāryate ca sarvaṃ vada yadūttama .. 37 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
कथमेतद्व्रतं कृष्ण क्रियते मनुजैः कदा ..
प्रारभ्यते पार्यते च सर्वं वद यदूत्तम .. 37 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / How is this votive observance performed by men, and when, O Kṛṣṇa? / How is it begun and completed? Tell everything, O best of the Yadus.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe paṃcamyāṃ patagodaye ..
upavāsasya niyamaṃ kuryādāśu suhṛddhṛdi .. 38 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
मार्गशीर्षे सिते पक्षे पंचम्यां पतगोदये ..
उपवासस्य नियमं कुर्यादाशु सुहृद्धृदि .. 38 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / In the bright fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa, on the fifth [tithi] at sunrise, / one should promptly undertake the vow of fasting in a friendly heart.

sanskrit_iast:
svarṇaraupyārakūṭotthā tāmramṛtkāṣṭhajātha vā ..
citrapaṭṭagatāṃ devīṃ lakṣmīṃ kṣmāpāla kārayet .. 39 ..
meaning:
स्वर्णरौप्यारकूटोत्था ताम्रमृत्काष्ठजाथ वा ..
चित्रपट्टगतां देवीं लक्ष्मीं क्ष्मापाल कारयेत् .. 39 ..
text_mt: Made of gold, silver, brass, copper, clay, or wood, / or depicted upon a painted cloth, O protector of the earth, one should have [the image of] goddess Lakṣmī fashioned:

sanskrit_iast:
padmahastāṃ padmavarṇāṃ padmāṃ padmadalekṣaṇām ..
diggajendraiḥ snāpyamānāṃ kāṃcanaiḥ kalaśottamaiḥ .. 4.37.40 ..
meaning:
पद्महस्तां पद्मवर्णां पद्मां पद्मदलेक्षणाम् ..
दिग्गजेन्द्रैः स्नाप्यमानां कांचनैः कलशोत्तमैः .. 4.37.40 ..
text_mt: Holding a lotus in her hand, lotus-coloured, lotus-like, with eyes resembling lotus petals, / being bathed by the royal elephants of the quarters with supreme golden water-pots.

sanskrit_iast:
tato yāmatraye jāte nimnagāyāṃ gṛhe'tha vā ..
snānaṃ kuryādasaṃbhrātaṃ śakravadupacārataḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
ततो यामत्रये जाते निम्नगायां गृहेऽथ वा ..
स्नानं कुर्यादसंभ्रातं शक्रवदुपचारतः .. 41 ..
text_mt: Then, when three watches have passed, in a river or at home, / one should take a bath unperturbed, with rites resembling Indra's.

sanskrit_iast:
devānpitṝṃśca saṃtarpya tato devagṛhaṃ vrajet ..
tatrasthāṃ pūjayeddevīṃ puṣpai statkālasaṃbhavaiḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
देवान्पितॄंश्च संतर्प्य ततो देवगृहं व्रजेत् ..
तत्रस्थां पूजयेद्देवीं पुष्पै स्तत्कालसंभवैः .. 42 ..
text_mt: Having satiated the gods and ancestors, one should then go to the temple of the deity; / there one should worship the goddess residing [there] with flowers available at that season:

sanskrit_iast:
capalāyai namaḥ pādau caṃcalāyai ca jānunī ..
kaṭiṃ kamalavāsinyai nābhiṃ khyātyai namonamaḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
चपलायै नमः पादौ चंचलायै च जानुनी ..
कटिं कमलवासिन्यै नाभिं ख्यात्यै नमोनमः .. 43 ..
text_mt: “Homage to Capalā” [worshipping] the feet, “and to Cañcalā” the knees, / the hips to Kamalavāsinī, “Homage, homage to Khyāti” the navel;

sanskrit_iast:
stanau manmathavāsinyai lalitāyai bhujadvayam ..
utkaṃṭhitāyai kaṇṭhaṃ ca mādhavyai mukhamaṇḍalam .. 44 ..
meaning:
स्तनौ मन्मथवासिन्यै ललितायै भुजद्वयम् ..
उत्कंठितायै कण्ठं च माधव्यै मुखमण्डलम् .. 44 ..
text_mt: the breasts to Manmathavāsinī, the two arms to Lalitā, / the neck to Utkaṇṭhitā, and the circle of the face to Mādhavī;

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ śriyai śiraḥ pūjya dadyānnaivedyamādarāt ..
phalāni ca yathālābhaṃ virūḍhāndhānyasaṃcayān .. 45 ..
meaning:
नमः श्रियै शिरः पूज्य दद्यान्नैवेद्यमादरात् ..
फलानि च यथालाभं विरूढान्धान्यसंचयान् .. 45 ..
text_mt: having worshipped the head with “Homage to Śrī,” one should respectfully offer food offering, / and fruits as available, and heaps of sprouted grains.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ suvāsinī pūjyā kusumaiḥ kuṃkumena ca ..
bhojayenmadhurānnena praṇipatya visarjayet .. 46 ..
meaning:
ततः सुवासिनी पूज्या कुसुमैः कुंकुमेन च ..
भोजयेन्मधुरान्नेन प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् .. 46 ..
text_mt: Then a married woman whose husband is alive should be worshipped with flowers and saffron; / one should feed her with sweet food and dismiss her after bowing down.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu taṃḍulaprasthaṃ ghṛtapātreṇa saṃyutam ..
brāhmaṇāya pradātavyaṃ śrīśaḥ saṃprīyatāmiti .. 47 ..
meaning:
ततस्तु तंडुलप्रस्थं घृतपात्रेण संयुतम् ..
ब्राह्मणाय प्रदातव्यं श्रीशः संप्रीयतामिति .. 47 ..
text_mt: Then a prastha of rice accompanied by a vessel of clarified butter / should be given to a brāhmaṇa, saying, “May the Lord of Śrī be pleased.”

sanskrit_iast:
nirvartya tadaśeṣeṇa tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ..
māsānumāsaṃ kartavyaṃ vidhinānena bhārata .. 48 ..
meaning:
निर्वर्त्य तदशेषेण ततो भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः ..
मासानुमासं कर्तव्यं विधिनानेन भारत .. 48 ..
text_mt: Having completed that in its entirety, one should then eat while restraining speech; / this should be done month after month according to this rite, O Bhārata.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīrlakṣmīḥ kamalā saṃpadumā nārāyaṇī tadā ..
padmā dhṛtiḥ sthitiḥ puṣṭirṛddhiḥ siddhiryathākramam ..
māsānumāsa rājendra prīyatāmiti kīrtayet .. 49 ..
meaning:
श्रीर्लक्ष्मीः कमला संपदुमा नारायणी तदा ..
पद्मा धृतिः स्थितिः पुष्टिरृद्धिः सिद्धिर्यथाक्रमम् ..
मासानुमास राजेन्द्र प्रीयतामिति कीर्तयेत् .. 49 ..
text_mt: “Śrī, Lakṣmī, Kamalā, Saṃpad, Umā, Nārāyaṇī then, / Padmā, Dhṛti, Sthiti, Puṣṭi, Ṛddhi, Siddhi” in order, / month after month, O king of kings, one should recite: “May she be pleased.”

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca dvādaśe māsi saṃprāpte paṃcame dine ..
vastramaṃḍapikāṃ kṛtvā puṣpagandhādhivāsitām .. .. 4.37.50 ..
meaning:
ततश्च द्वादशे मासि संप्राप्ते पंचमे दिने ..
वस्त्रमंडपिकां कृत्वा पुष्पगन्धाधिवासिताम् .. .. 4.37.50 ..
text_mt: And then, when the twelfth month has arrived, on the fifth day, / having erected a cloth pavilion perfumed with flowers and fragrant substances,

sanskrit_iast:
śayyāyāṃ sthāpayellakṣmīṃ sarvopaskarasaṃyutām ..
mauktikāṣṭakasaṃyuktāṃ netrapaṭṭāvṛtastanīm .. 51 ..
meaning:
शय्यायां स्थापयेल्लक्ष्मीं सर्वोपस्करसंयुताम् ..
मौक्तिकाष्टकसंयुक्तां नेत्रपट्टावृतस्तनीम् .. 51 ..
text_mt: one should place Lakṣmī upon a bed, equipped with all furnishings, / furnished with eight pearls, her breasts covered with fine silk cloth,

sanskrit_iast:
saptadhānyasamopetāṃ rasadhātusamanvitām..
pādukopānahacchatrabhājanāsanasatkṛtām..52..
meaning:
सप्तधान्यसमोपेतां रसधातुसमन्विताम्..
पादुकोपानहच्छत्रभाजनासनसत्कृताम्..52..
text_mt: endowed with the seven grains, accompanied by the elixir and mineral ores, / honoured with wooden shoes, sandals, a royal parasol, vessels, and a seat.

sanskrit_iast:
dadyātsaṃpūjya vidhivadbrāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine..
vyāsāya vedaviduṣe yasya vā rocate svayam..
sopaskarāṃ savatsāṃ ca dhenuṃ dattvā kṣamāpayet..53..
meaning:
दद्यात्संपूज्य विधिवद्ब्राह्मणाय कुटुम्बिने..
व्यासाय वेदविदुषे यस्य वा रोचते स्वयम्..
सोपस्करां सवत्सां च धेनुं दत्त्वा क्षमापयेत्..53..
text_mt: Having worshipped her according to the rules, one should give [her] to a brāhmaṇa householder, / an expounder (Vyāsa) learned in the Veda, or to whomever one pleases; / having given a milch cow along with her calf and furnishings, one should ask for forgiveness:

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrābdhimathanodbhūte viṣṇorvakṣaḥsthalālaye ..
sarvakāmaprade devi ṛddhiṃ yaccha namo'stu te ..54..
meaning:
क्षीराब्धिमथनोद्भूते विष्णोर्वक्षःस्थलालये ..
सर्वकामप्रदे देवि ऋद्धिं यच्छ नमोऽस्तु ते ..54..
text_mt: “O goddess born from the churning of the milk ocean, whose abode is the chest of Viṣṇu, / granter of all desires, bestow prosperity! Homage be to you.”

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ suvāsinīḥ pūjya vastrairābharaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
bhojayitvā svayaṃ paścādbhuñjīta saha bandhubhiḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
ततः सुवासिनीः पूज्य वस्त्रैराभरणैः शुभैः ..
भोजयित्वा स्वयं पश्चाद्भुञ्जीत सह बन्धुभिः .. 55 ..
text_mt: Then, having worshipped married women whose husbands are alive with auspicious garments and ornaments, / and having fed them, one should eat afterwards oneself along with one's kinsmen.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha bhaktyā śrīpañcamīvratam..
tasya śrīrbhavane bhāti kulānāmekaviṃśatiḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
एवं यः कुरुते पार्थ भक्त्या श्रीपञ्चमीव्रतम्..
तस्य श्रीर्भवने भाति कुलानामेकविंशतिः .. 56 ..
text_mt: The one who thus performs with devotion the Śrīpañcamī votive observance, O son of Pṛthā— / for twenty-one generations fortune (Śrī) shines in his home.

sanskrit_iast:
nārī vā kurute yā tu prāpyānujñāṃ svabhartṛtaḥ ..
subhagā darśanīyā ca bahuputrā ca jāyate ..57..
meaning:
नारी वा कुरुते या तु प्राप्यानुज्ञां स्वभर्तृतः ..
सुभगा दर्शनीया च बहुपुत्रा च जायते ..57..
text_mt: Or a woman who performs it having obtained permission from her husband / becomes fortunate, handsome to look upon, and having many sons.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīpañcamīvratamidaṃ dayitaṃ murārerbhaktyā samācarati pūjyabhṛgostanūjām ..
rājyaṃ nijaṃ sa bhuvi bhavyajanopabhogānbhuktvā prayāti bhuvanaṃ madhusūdanasya..58..
viśokaṣaṣṭhīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
श्रीपञ्चमीव्रतमिदं दयितं मुरारेर्भक्त्या समाचरति पूज्यभृगोस्तनूजाम् ..
राज्यं निजं स भुवि भव्यजनोपभोगान्भुक्त्वा प्रयाति भुवनं मधुसूदनस्य..58..
विशोकषष्ठीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Whoever performs with devotion this Śrīpañcamī votive observance dear to Murāri, worshipping the daughter of Bhṛgu, / after enjoying his own kingdom on earth and pleasures fit for distinguished people, goes to the abode of Madhusūdana.
Description of the Viśokaṣaṣṭhī votive observance

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
ṣaṣṭhīvidhānamadhunā kathayasva janārdana ..
sarvavyādhipraśamanaṃ sarvakarmaphalapradam .. .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
षष्ठीविधानमधुना कथयस्व जनार्दन ..
सर्वव्याधिप्रशमनं सर्वकर्मफलप्रदम् .. .. 1 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Now describe the procedure for the Ṣaṣṭhī [observance], O Janārdana, / which alleviates all diseases and grants the fruit of all deeds.
title: adhyāyaḥ 038

sanskrit_iast:
śrutaṃ mayā pūjyamāno bhānuḥ sarvaṃ prayacchati ..
divākarārādhanaṃ me tasmātkathaya keśava .. 2 ..
meaning:
श्रुतं मया पूज्यमानो भानुः सर्वं प्रयच्छति ..
दिवाकराराधनं मे तस्मात्कथय केशव .. 2 ..
text_mt: I have heard that the sun, when worshipped, bestows everything; / therefore describe to me the adoration of Divākara, O Keśava.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
viśoka ṣaṣṭhīmatulāṃ vakṣyāmi manujottama. ..
yāmupoṣya naraḥ śokaṃ na kadācidiha jāyate.. 3 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
विशोक षष्ठीमतुलां वक्ष्यामि मनुजोत्तम. ..
यामुपोष्य नरः शोकं न कदाचिदिह जायते.. 3 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / I shall describe the incomparable Viśokaṣaṣṭhī, O best of men, / fasting on which, a man never experiences grief in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
māghe kṛṣṇatilaiḥ snātaḥ pañcamyāṃ śuklapakṣataḥ..
kṛtāhāraḥ kṛśasyā daṃtadhāvanapūrvakam..
upavāsavrataṃ kṛtvā brahmacārī bhavenniśi..
tataḥ prabhāte cotthāya kṛtasnānastataḥ śuciḥ..5..
meaning:
माघे कृष्णतिलैः स्नातः पञ्चम्यां शुक्लपक्षतः..
कृताहारः कृशस्या दंतधावनपूर्वकम्..
उपवासव्रतं कृत्वा ब्रह्मचारी भवेन्निशि..
ततः प्रभाते चोत्थाय कृतस्नानस्ततः शुचिः..5..
text_mt: In the month of Māgha, having bathed with black sesame on the fifth of the bright fortnight, / having eaten lean food after cleaning the teeth, / having undertaken the fast-observance, he should be celibate at night; / then, having risen in the morning and bathed, and thus become pure,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā tu kāñcanaṃ padmamarko'yamiti pūjayet ..
karavīreṇa raktena raktavastrayugena ca .. 6 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा तु काञ्चनं पद्ममर्कोऽयमिति पूजयेत् ..
करवीरेण रक्तेन रक्तवस्त्रयुगेन च .. 6 ..
text_mt: having made a golden lotus, he should worship it [saying], “This is Arka,” / with red oleander and a pair of red garments:

sanskrit_iast:
yathā viśokaṃ bhavanaṃ tvayaivādityasarvadā ..
tathā viśokatāṃ me syāttvadbhaktirjanmajanmani .. 7 ..
meaning:
यथा विशोकं भवनं त्वयैवादित्यसर्वदा ..
तथा विशोकतां मे स्यात्त्वद्भक्तिर्जन्मजन्मनि .. 7 ..
text_mt: “Just as your abode, O Āditya, is always sorrowless (viśoka), / so may there be freedom from sorrow for me, and devotion to you in birth after birth.”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃpūjya ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu śaktyā saṃpūjayeddvijān ..
suptvā saṃprāśya gomūtramutthāya kṛtaniścayaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
एवं संपूज्य षष्ठ्यां तु शक्त्या संपूजयेद्द्विजान् ..
सुप्त्वा संप्राश्य गोमूत्रमुत्थाय कृतनिश्चयः .. 8 ..
text_mt: Having thus worshipped on the sixth [tithi], he should worship brāhmaṇas according to his means; / having slept, having sipped cow urine, and having risen resolute,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya vipramaṃtreṇa guḍapātrasamanvitaḥ ..
susūkṣmavastrayugalaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet .. 9 ..
meaning:
संपूज्य विप्रमंत्रेण गुडपात्रसमन्वितः ..
सुसूक्ष्मवस्त्रयुगलं ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् .. 9 ..
text_mt: having worshipped the brāhmaṇa with a mantra, accompanied by a vessel of jaggery, / he should offer a pair of very fine garments to the brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
atailalavaṇaṃ bhuktvā saptamyāṃ maunasaṃyutaḥ ..
tataḥ purāṇaśravaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā .. 4.38.10 ..
meaning:
अतैललवणं भुक्त्वा सप्तम्यां मौनसंयुतः ..
ततः पुराणश्रवणं कर्तव्यं भूतिमिच्छता .. 4.38.10 ..
text_mt: Having eaten food without oil or salt on the seventh [tithi] while maintaining silence, / the hearing of the Purāṇa should then be performed by one desiring prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā sarvamubhayorapi pakṣayoḥ ..
kuryādyāvatpunarmāghaśuklapakṣasya saptamī .. 11 ..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना सर्वमुभयोरपि पक्षयोः ..
कुर्याद्यावत्पुनर्माघशुक्लपक्षस्य सप्तमी .. 11 ..
text_mt: According to this procedure, he should perform everything on both fortnights, / until the seventh [tithi] of the bright fortnight of Māgha comes again.

sanskrit_iast:
vratāṃte kalaśaṃ dadyātsuvarṇakamalānvitam ..
śayyāṃ sopaskarāṃ tadvatkapilāṃ ca payasvinīm .. 12 ..
meaning:
व्रतांते कलशं दद्यात्सुवर्णकमलान्वितम् ..
शय्यां सोपस्करां तद्वत्कपिलां च पयस्विनीम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: At the conclusion of the votive observance, he should give a water-pot accompanied by a golden lotus, / likewise a bed with furnishings, and a brown cow yielding milk.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā yastu vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ..
viśokaṣaṣṭhīṃ kurute sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 13 ..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु वित्तशाठ्यविवर्जितः ..
विशोकषष्ठीं कुरुते स याति परमां गतिम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: He who, free from stinginess with wealth, performs the Viśokaṣaṣṭhī / according to this procedure, attains the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvajjanmasahasrāṇāṃ sāgrakoṭiśataṃ bhavet ..
tāvanna śokamabhyeti rogadaurgatyavarjitaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
यावज्जन्मसहस्राणां साग्रकोटिशतं भवेत् ..
तावन्न शोकमभ्येति रोगदौर्गत्यवर्जितः .. 14 ..
text_mt: As long as a hundred crore of thousands of births may be, / for that long he does not encounter sorrow, freed from disease and misfortune.

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃyaṃ prārthayate kāmaṃ taṃtaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam ..
niṣkāmaṃ kurute yastu sa paraṃ brahma gacchati. .. 15. ..
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi ṣaṣṭhīṃ śokavināśinīm..
sopīṃdralokamāpnoti na duḥkhī jāyate kvacit .. 16 ..
meaning:
यंयं प्रार्थयते कामं तंतं प्राप्नोति पुष्कलम् ..
निष्कामं कुरुते यस्तु स परं ब्रह्म गच्छति. .. 15. ..
यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि षष्ठीं शोकविनाशिनीम्..
सोपींद्रलोकमाप्नोति न दुःखी जायते क्वचित् .. 16 ..
text_mt:
Whatever desire one prays for, that very desire one obtains abundantly; / but whoever performs it free from desire goes to the supreme Brahman.
Whoever reads or listens to this grief-destroying ṣaṣṭhī, / he too attains the realm of Indra and is never anywhere made miserable.

sanskrit_iast:
ye bhāskaraṃ dinakaraṃ karavīrapuṣpaiḥ saṃpūjayaṃtyabhinamaṃti kṛtopavāsā ..
te duḥkhaśokarahitāḥ sahitāḥ suhṛdbhirbhūmau vihṛtya ravilokamavāpnuvaṃti .. 17 ..
kamalaṣaṣṭhīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
ये भास्करं दिनकरं करवीरपुष्पैः संपूजयंत्यभिनमंति कृतोपवासा ..
ते दुःखशोकरहिताः सहिताः सुहृद्भिर्भूमौ विहृत्य रविलोकमवाप्नुवंति .. 17 ..
कमलषष्ठीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Those who, having fasted, worship the Illuminator, the Day-Maker, with oleander flowers and bow down to him, / freed from misery and sorrow, enjoying themselves on earth with their friends, attain the realm of the Sun.
Description of the Kamalaṣaṣṭhī Votive Observance

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
anyāmapi pravakṣyāmi padmaṣaṣṭhī śubhāṃ tathā..
yāmupoṣya naraḥ pāpavimuktaḥ svargabhāgbhavet .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
अन्यामपि प्रवक्ष्यामि पद्मषष्ठी शुभां तथा..
यामुपोष्य नरः पापविमुक्तः स्वर्गभाग्भवेत् .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
I shall also declare another auspicious Padmaṣaṣṭhī, / by fasting on which a man is freed from sin and shares in heaven.
title: Kamalaṣaṣṭhīvratam

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi pañcamyāṃ niyatavrataḥ ..
ṣaṣṭhīmupoṣya kamalaṃ kārayitvā sukāñcanam .. 2 ..
meaning:
मार्गशीर्षे शुभे मासि पञ्चम्यां नियतव्रतः ..
षष्ठीमुपोष्य कमलं कारयित्वा सुकाञ्चनम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: In the auspicious month of Mārgaśīrṣa, restrained in vows on the fifth lunar day, / having fasted on the sixth lunar day and having had a lotus made of fine gold,

sanskrit_iast:
śarkarāsaṃyutaṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine ..
rūpaṃ ca kāṃcanaṃ kṛtvā phalasyaikasya dharmavit .. 3 ..
meaning:
शर्करासंयुतं दद्याद्ब्राह्मणाय कुटुंबिने ..
रूपं च कांचनं कृत्वा फलस्यैकस्य धर्मवित् .. 3 ..
text_mt: together with sugar, one should give it to a householder brāhmaṇa; / and having made a golden replica of a single fruit, knowing duty,

sanskrit_iast:
dadyātprātaḥ kṛtasnāno bhānurme prīyatāmiti ..
bhaktyā tu viprānsaṃpūjya saptamyāṃ kṣīrabhojanam .. 4 ..
meaning:
दद्यात्प्रातः कृतस्नानो भानुर्मे प्रीयतामिति ..
भक्त्या तु विप्रान्संपूज्य सप्तम्यां क्षीरभोजनम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: having bathed in the morning, one should give it, saying: 'May the Sun be pleased with me.' / Then, having faithfully worshipped the priests, eating a meal of milk on the seventh lunar day,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā kuryātphalatyāgaṃ yā ca syātkṛṣṇasaptamī ..
etāmupoṣya vidhivadanenaiva krameṇa tu.. 5 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा कुर्यात्फलत्यागं या च स्यात्कृष्णसप्तमी ..
एतामुपोष्य विधिवदनेनैव क्रमेण तु.. 5 ..
text_mt: having done so, one should renounce fruit; and on whichever dark seventh lunar day it is, / having fasted on this according to rule and in this very sequence,

sanskrit_iast:
tadvai haimaṃ phalaṃ dattvā suvarṇa kamalānvitam..
śarkarāpātrasaṃyuktaṃ vastramālāsamanvitam .. 6 ..
meaning:
तद्वै हैमं फलं दत्त्वा सुवर्ण कमलान्वितम्..
शर्करापात्रसंयुक्तं वस्त्रमालासमन्वितम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: having indeed given that golden fruit along with a gold lotus, / accompanied by a vessel of sugar and endowed with cloth and garlands,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhyorubhayormahārāja yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ tataḥ ..
upoṣya dadyātkramaśaḥ sūryamaṃtrānudīrayet .. 7 ..
meaning:
षष्ठ्योरुभयोर्महाराज यावत्संवत्सरं ततः ..
उपोष्य दद्यात्क्रमशः सूर्यमंत्रानुदीरयेत् .. 7 ..
text_mt: on both sixth lunar days, O great king, then for the duration of a year, / having fasted, one should successively give [these gifts] and recite the Sun mantras:

sanskrit_iast:
bhānurarko ravirbrahmā sūryaḥ śukro hariḥ śivaḥ ..
śrīmānvibhāvasustvaṣṭā varuṇaḥ prīyatāmiti .. 8 ..
meaning:
भानुरर्को रविर्ब्रह्मा सूर्यः शुक्रो हरिः शिवः ..
श्रीमान्विभावसुस्त्वष्टा वरुणः प्रीयतामिति .. 8 ..
text_mt: 'May Bhānu, Arka, Ravi, Brahmā, Sūrya, Śukra, Hari, Śiva, / the glorious Vibhāvasu, Tvaṣṭṛ, and Varuṇa be pleased.'

sanskrit_iast:
pratimāsaṃ ca saptamyāmekaikaṃ nāma kīrtayet ..
pratipakṣaṃ phalatyāgametatkurvansamācaret .. 9 ..
meaning:
प्रतिमासं च सप्तम्यामेकैकं नाम कीर्तयेत् ..
प्रतिपक्षं फलत्यागमेतत्कुर्वन्समाचरेत् .. 9 ..
text_mt: And every month on the seventh lunar day, one should recite one name at a time; / performing this, one should observe the renunciation of fruit in every fortnight.

sanskrit_iast:
vratāṃte vipramithunaṃ pūjayedvastrabhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
śarkarākalaśaṃ dadyāddhaimapadmaphalānvitam .. 4.39.10 ..
meaning:
व्रतांते विप्रमिथुनं पूजयेद्वस्त्रभूषणैः ..
शर्कराकलशं दद्याद्धैमपद्मफलान्वितम् .. 4.39.10 ..
text_mt: At the conclusion of the votive observance, one should worship a brāhmaṇa couple with clothes and ornaments; / one should give a pot of sugar together with a golden lotus and fruit, [saying:]

sanskrit_iast:
yathā phalakaro māsastvadbhaktānāṃ sadā rave ..
tathānaṃtaphalāvāptirastu janmanijanmani ..11..
meaning:
यथा फलकरो मासस्त्वद्भक्तानां सदा रवे ..
तथानंतफलावाप्तिरस्तु जन्मनिजन्मनि ..11..
text_mt: 'Just as the month is always fruit-bearing for your devotees, O Sun, / likewise may there be attainment of endless fruit in birth after birth.'

sanskrit_iast:
imāmanaṃtaphaladāṃ phalaṣaṣṭhīṃ karoti yaḥ ..
sa sarvapāpanirmuktaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate ..12..
meaning:
इमामनंतफलदां फलषष्ठीं करोति यः ..
स सर्वपापनिर्मुक्तः सूर्यलोके महीयते ..12..
text_mt: Whoever observes this Phalaṣaṣṭhī, which grants endless fruit, / he is freed from all sins and is magnified in the realm of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
surāpānādikaṃ kiñcidyadatrāmutra vā kṛtam ..
tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati ..13..
meaning:
सुरापानादिकं किञ्चिद्यदत्रामुत्र वा कृतम् ..
तत्सर्वं नाशमायाति सूर्यलोकं स गच्छति ..13..
text_mt: Whatever liquor-drinking and the like he has done here or elsewhere, / all that is destroyed, and he goes to the realm of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtānbhavyāṃśca puruṣāṃstārayedekaviṃśatim ..
śṛṇuyādyaḥ paṭhedvāpi sopi kalyāṇabhāgbhavet..14..
meaning:
भूतान्भव्यांश्च पुरुषांस्तारयेदेकविंशतिम् ..
शृणुयाद्यः पठेद्वापि सोपि कल्याणभाग्भवेत्..14..
text_mt: He delivers twenty-one past and future generations; / whoever listens to or reads this also shares in auspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
haimaṃ phalaṃ sakamalaṃ kalaśaṃ sitāyā ṣaṣṭhīmupoṣya vidhivaddvijapuṃgavāya ..
