text_mt: Beginning with these, the lying-in chamber should be prepared completely. / In the middle of this, she is to be installed, and she is remembered as of eight kinds:

sanskrit_iast:
kāṃcanī rājatī tāmrī paittalī mṛnmayī tathā ..
dārvī maṇimayī caiva karṇikā likhitātha vā .. 28 ..
meaning:
कांचनी राजती ताम्री पैत्तली मृन्मयी तथा ..
दार्वी मणिमयी चैव कर्णिका लिखिताथ वा .. 28 ..
text_mt: Made of gold, made of silver, made of copper, made of brass, and also made of clay, / made of wood, and made of jewels, or made of lotuses, or drawn in a picture.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalakṣaṇasampannā paryaṃke cārddhasuptikā ..
prataptakāṃcanābhāsā mayā saha tapasvinī .. 29 ..
meaning:
सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्ना पर्यंके चार्द्धसुप्तिका ..
प्रतप्तकांचनाभासा मया सह तपस्विनी .. 29 ..
text_mt: endowed with all auspicious marks, half-asleep on the couch, / glowing like refined gold, that ascetic woman together with me,

sanskrit_iast:
prastutā ca prasūtā ca tatkṣaṇācca praharṣitā ..
māṃ cāpi bālakaṃ suptaṃ paryaṃke stanapāyinam .. 4.55.30 ..
meaning:
प्रस्तुता च प्रसूता च तत्क्षणाच्च प्रहर्षिता ..
मां चापि बालकं सुप्तं पर्यंके स्तनपायिनम् .. 4.55.30 ..
text_mt: having given birth and yielded milk, filled with joy that very moment, / and me as an infant asleep upon the couch, drinking at her breast,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ pūrṇaṃ nīlotpaladala cchavim ..
yaśodā cāpi tatraiva prasūtā varakanyakām .. 31 ..
meaning:
श्रीवत्सवक्षसं पूर्णं नीलोत्पलदल च्छविम् ..
यशोदा चापि तत्रैव प्रसूता वरकन्यकाम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: with the śrīvatsa on my chest, perfect, with the complexion of a blue lotus petal; / and Yaśodā also, having given birth right there to an excellent daughter;

sanskrit_iast:
tatra devagṛhaṃ nāgā yakṣavidyādharā narāḥ ..
praṇatāḥ puṣpamālāgravyagrahastāḥ surāsurāḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
तत्र देवगृहं नागा यक्षविद्याधरा नराः ..
प्रणताः पुष्पमालाग्रव्यग्रहस्ताः सुरासुराः .. 32 ..
text_mt: there in the divine house, nāgas, yakṣas, vidyādharas, and men, / bowing down, their hands busy holding the tips of flower-garlands, gods and asuras,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃcaraṃta ivākāśe prākārairuditoditaiḥ ..
vasudevo'pi tatraiva khaḍgacarmadharaḥ sthitaḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
संचरंत इवाकाशे प्राकारैरुदितोदितैः ..
वसुदेवोऽपि तत्रैव खड्गचर्मधरः स्थितः .. 33 ..
text_mt: as if moving in the sky along towering ramparts; / Vasudeva too standing right there, holding a sword and shield.

sanskrit_iast:
kaśyapo vasudevoyamaditi ścāpi devakī ..
balabhadraḥ śeṣanāgo yaśodādityajāyata .. 34 ..
meaning:
कश्यपो वसुदेवोयमदिति श्चापि देवकी ..
बलभद्रः शेषनागो यशोदादित्यजायत .. 34 ..
text_mt: This Vasudeva was Kaśyapa, and Devakī was Aditi; / Balabhadra was the serpent Śeṣa, and Yaśodā was born of Diti.

sanskrit_iast:
nandaḥ prajāpatirdakṣo gargaścāpi caturmukhaḥ ..
eṣovatāro rājendra kaṃso'yaṃ kālanemijaḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
नन्दः प्रजापतिर्दक्षो गर्गश्चापि चतुर्मुखः ..
एषोवतारो राजेन्द्र कंसोऽयं कालनेमिजः .. 35 ..
text_mt: Nanda was the Prajāpati Dakṣa, and Garga was the four-faced Brahmā; / this was the incarnation, O king of kings, and this Kaṃsa was born of Kālanemi.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra kaṃsaniyuktā ye dānavā vividhāyudhāḥ ..
te ca prāhārikāḥ sarve suptā nidrāvimohitāḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
तत्र कंसनियुक्ता ये दानवा विविधायुधाः ..
ते च प्राहारिकाः सर्वे सुप्ता निद्राविमोहिताः .. 36 ..
text_mt: The dānavas appointed there by Kaṃsa, bearing various weapons, / and all those watchmen lay asleep, bewildered by slumber.

sanskrit_iast:
godhenukuñjarāścāsya dānavāḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ ..
nṛtyaṃtyapsaraso hṛṣṭā gaṃdharvā gītatatparāḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
गोधेनुकुञ्जराश्चास्य दानवाः शस्त्रपाणयः ..
नृत्यंत्यप्सरसो हृष्टा गंधर्वा गीततत्पराः .. 37 ..
text_mt: Cows, cattle, and elephants, and his weapon-bearing dānavas [should be depicted]; / joyful apsarases dance, and gandharvas are intent on singing.

sanskrit_iast:
lekhanīyaśca tatraiva kāliyo yamunāhrade ..
ramyamevaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā devakīṃ navasūtikām .. 38 ..
meaning:
लेखनीयश्च तत्रैव कालियो यमुनाह्रदे ..
रम्यमेवं विधिं कृत्वा देवकीं नवसूतिकाम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: And Kāliya in the pool of the Yamunā should be painted right there. / Having thus arranged this delightful rite, Devakī, newly delivered of a child,

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ pārtha pūjayedbhaktyā gandhapuṣpākṣataiḥ phalaiḥ ..
kūṣmāṇḍairnālikeraiśca kharjūrairdāḍimīphalaiḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
तां पार्थ पूजयेद्भक्त्या गन्धपुष्पाक्षतैः फलैः ..
कूष्माण्डैर्नालिकेरैश्च खर्जूरैर्दाडिमीफलैः .. 39 ..
text_mt: one should worship her with devotion, O Pārtha, with scents, flowers, unhusked grains, and fruits, / with pumpkins and coconuts, dates and pomegranates,

sanskrit_iast:
bījapūraiḥ pūgaphalairllakucaistrapusaistathā ..
kāladeśodbhavairmuṣṭaiḥ puṣpaiścāpi yudhiṣṭhira .. 4.55.40 ..
meaning:
बीजपूरैः पूगफलैर्ल्लकुचैस्त्रपुसैस्तथा ..
कालदेशोद्भवैर्मुष्टैः पुष्पैश्चापि युधिष्ठिर .. 4.55.40 ..
text_mt: with citrons, areca nuts, monkey-jack fruits, and cucumbers, / with handfuls of seasonal, local flowers as well, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit_iast: dhyātvāvatāraṃ prāguktaṃ maṃtreṇānena pūjayet .. 41 ..
meaning: ध्यात्वावतारं प्रागुक्तं मंत्रेणानेन पूजयेत् .. 41 ..
text_mt: Having meditated upon the incarnation previously described, one should worship with this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
gāyadbhiḥ kinnarādyaiḥ satataparivṛtā veṇuvīṇāninādairbhṛṅgārādarśakumbhapramarakṛtakaraiḥ sevyamānā munīndraiḥ ..
paryaṃke svāstṛte yā muditataramanāḥ putriṇī samyagāste sā devī devamātā jayati suvadanā devakī kāṃtarūpā .. 42 ..
meaning:
गायद्भिः किन्नराद्यैः सततपरिवृता वेणुवीणानिनादैर्भृङ्गारादर्शकुम्भप्रमरकृतकरैः सेव्यमाना मुनीन्द्रैः ..
पर्यंके स्वास्तृते या मुदिततरमनाः पुत्रिणी सम्यगास्ते सा देवी देवमाता जयति सुवदना देवकी कांतरूपा .. 42 ..
text_mt: “Constantly surrounded by singing kinnaras and others to the sounds of flutes and vīṇās, served by foremost sages holding pitchers, mirrors, and water-pots in their hands, / she who rests comfortably upon a well-spread couch, her mind exceedingly joyful, blessed with a child—victorious is that fair-faced, lovely goddess Devakī, mother of the gods.”

sanskrit_iast:
pādāvabhyaṃjayaṃtīṃ śrīrdevakyāścaraṇāṃtike ..
niṣaṇṇā paṅkaje pūjyā namo devyai ca maṃtrataḥ ..43..
meaning:
पादावभ्यंजयंतीं श्रीर्देवक्याश्चरणांतिके ..
निषण्णा पङ्कजे पूज्या नमो देव्यै च मंत्रतः ..43..
text_mt: And Śrī, seated upon a lotus beside Devakī's feet, massaging her feet, / should be worshipped with the mantra: “Homage to the Goddess!”

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ devakyai namaḥ .. oṃ vasudevāya namaḥ ..
oṃ balabhadrāya namaḥ .. oṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ ..
oṃ subhadrāyai namaḥ .. oṃ nandāya namaḥ.. oṃ yaśodāyai namaḥ ..
evamādīni nāmāni samuccārya pṛthakpṛthak ..
pūjayeyurdvijāḥ sarve strīśūdrāṇāmamaṃtrakam .. 44..
meaning:
ओं देवक्यै नमः .. ओं वसुदेवाय नमः ..
ओं बलभद्राय नमः .. ओं श्रीकृष्णाय नमः ..
ओं सुभद्रायै नमः .. ओं नन्दाय नमः.. ओं यशोदायै नमः ..
एवमादीनि नामानि समुच्चार्य पृथक्पृथक् ..
पूजयेयुर्द्विजाः सर्वे स्त्रीशूद्राणाममंत्रकम् .. 44..
text_mt: “Oṃ, homage to Devakī! Oṃ, homage to Vasudeva! / Oṃ, homage to Balabhadra! Oṃ, homage to Śrī Kṛṣṇa! / Oṃ, homage to Subhadrā! Oṃ, homage to Nanda! Oṃ, homage to Yaśodā!” / Having uttered these and other names individually, / all the twice-born should perform the worship; for women and śūdras it is done without mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhyaṃtaramapīcchaṃti kecidatra dvijottamāḥ ..
candrodaye śaśāṅkāya arghyaṃ dadyāddhariṃ smaret .. 45 ..
meaning:
विध्यंतरमपीच्छंति केचिदत्र द्विजोत्तमाः ..
चन्द्रोदये शशाङ्काय अर्घ्यं दद्याद्धरिं स्मरेत् .. 45 ..
text_mt: Certain best of the twice-born desire an alternate rite in this regard: / at moonrise one should offer water to the moon and remember Hari:

sanskrit_iast:
anaghaṃ vāmanaṃ śauriṃ vaikuṃṭhaṃ puruṣottamam ..
vāsudevaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ mādhavaṃ madhusūdanam .. 46 ..
meaning:
अनघं वामनं शौरिं वैकुंठं पुरुषोत्तमम् ..
वासुदेवं हृषीकेशं माधवं मधुसूदनम् .. 46 ..
text_mt: the sinless, Vāmana, Śauri, Vaikuṇṭha, Puruṣottama, / Vāsudeva, Hṛṣīkeśa, Mādhava, Madhusūdana,

sanskrit_iast:
vārāhaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ brāhmaṇapriyam ..
dāmodaraṃ padmanābhaṃ keśavaṃ garuḍadhvajam .. 47 ..
meaning:
वाराहं पुण्डरीकाक्षं नृसिंहं ब्राह्मणप्रियम् ..
दामोदरं पद्मनाभं केशवं गरुडध्वजम् .. 47 ..
text_mt: Vārāha, the lotus-eyed, Nṛsiṃha, beloved of brāhmaṇas, / Dāmodara, Padmanābha, Keśava, Garuda-bannered,

sanskrit_iast:
govindamacyutaṃ kṛṣṇamanaṃtamaparājitam ..
adhokṣajaṃ jagadbījaṃ sargasthityaṃtakāraṇam .. 48 ..
meaning:
गोविन्दमच्युतं कृष्णमनंतमपराजितम् ..
अधोक्षजं जगद्बीजं सर्गस्थित्यंतकारणम् .. 48 ..
text_mt: Govinda, Acyuta, Kṛṣṇa, the infinite, unconquered, / Adhokṣaja, the seed of the universe, the cause of creation, preservation, and dissolution,

sanskrit_iast:
anādinidhanaṃ viṣṇuṃ trailokyeśaṃ trivikramam ..
nārāyaṇaṃ caturbāhuṃ śaṃkha cakragadādharam .. 49 ..
meaning:
अनादिनिधनं विष्णुं त्रैलोक्येशं त्रिविक्रमम् ..
नारायणं चतुर्बाहुं शंख चक्रगदाधरम् .. 49 ..
text_mt: without beginning or end, Viṣṇu, lord of the three worlds, Trivikrama, / Nārāyaṇa, four-armed, holding the conch, discus, and mace,

sanskrit_iast:
pītāṃbaradharaṃ nityaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam ..
śrīvatsāṅkaṃ jagatsetuṃ śrīdharaṃ śrīpatiṃ harim .. 4.55.50 ..
meaning:
पीतांबरधरं नित्यं वनमालाविभूषितम् ..
श्रीवत्साङ्कं जगत्सेतुं श्रीधरं श्रीपतिं हरिम् .. 4.55.50 ..
text_mt: wearing yellow garments, ever adorned with a forest garland, / marked with the śrīvatsa, the dam of the universe, bearer of Śrī, lord of Śrī, Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
yogeśvarāya yogeśabhavāya yogapataye govindāya namonamaḥ .. (iti snāna maṃtraḥ ..)
yajñeśvarāya yajñasaṃbhavāya yajñapataye govindāya namonamaḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
योगेश्वराय योगेशभवाय योगपतये गोविन्दाय नमोनमः .. (इति स्नान मंत्रः ..)
यज्ञेश्वराय यज्ञसंभवाय यज्ञपतये गोविन्दाय नमोनमः .. 51 ..
text_mt: “Homage, homage to Govinda, the lord of yoga, born of the lord of yoga, master of yoga!” (This is the bathing mantra.) / “Homage, homage to Govinda, the lord of sacrifice, origin of sacrifice, master of sacrifice!”

sanskrit_iast:
ityanulepanārghyādyarcanadhūpamaṃtraḥ ..
viśvāya viśveśvarāya viśvasaṃbhavāya viśvapataye govindāya namonamaḥ .. 52 .. ( iti naivedyamaṃtraḥ ..)
meaning:
इत्यनुलेपनार्घ्याद्यर्चनधूपमंत्रः ..
विश्वाय विश्वेश्वराय विश्वसंभवाय विश्वपतये गोविन्दाय नमोनमः .. 52 .. ( इति नैवेद्यमंत्रः ..)
text_mt: This is the mantra for anointing, offering water, worship, incense, and the rest: / “Homage, homage to Govinda, the all, the lord of the universe, origin of the universe, master of the universe!” // 52 // (This is the food-offering mantra.)

sanskrit_iast: dharmeśvarāya dharmapataye dharmasaṃbhavāya govindāya namonamaḥ .. 53 .. (iti dīpāsanamaṃtraḥ ..)
meaning: धर्मेश्वराय धर्मपतये धर्मसंभवाय गोविन्दाय नमोनमः .. 53 .. (इति दीपासनमंत्रः ..)
text_mt: “Homage, homage to Govinda, lord of righteousness, master of righteousness, origin of righteousness!” // 53 // (This is the lamp-and-seat mantra.)

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrodārṇavasaṃbhūta atrinetrasamudbhava ..
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ śaśāṃkendo rohiṇyā sahito mama .. 54 ..
meaning:
क्षीरोदार्णवसंभूत अत्रिनेत्रसमुद्भव ..
गृहाणार्घ्यं शशांकेन्दो रोहिण्या सहितो मम .. 54 ..
text_mt: “Born of the ocean of milk, arisen from the eye of Atri, / accept my water offering, O moon, along with Rohiṇī!”

sanskrit_iast:
sthaṃḍile sthāpayeddevaṃ sacandrāṃ rohiṇīṃ tathā ..
devakīṃ vasudevaṃ ca yaśodāṃ nandameva ca .. 55 ..
meaning:
स्थंडिले स्थापयेद्देवं सचन्द्रां रोहिणीं तथा ..
देवकीं वसुदेवं च यशोदां नन्दमेव च .. 55 ..
text_mt: One should place the god upon the bare ground, as well as Rohiṇī with the moon, / and Devakī and Vasudeva, and Yaśodā and Nanda,

sanskrit_iast:
baladevaṃ tathā pūjya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ..
arddharātre vasorddhārāṃ pātayedguḍasarpiṣā ..56..
meaning:
बलदेवं तथा पूज्य सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ..
अर्द्धरात्रे वसोर्द्धारां पातयेद्गुडसर्पिषा ..56..
text_mt: as well as Baladeva; having worshipped them, one is freed from all sins. / At midnight one should pour a continuous stream of wealth with jaggery and clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
tato varddhāpanaṃ ṣaṣṭhīnāmādikaraṇaṃ mama ..
kartavyaṃ tatkṣaṇādrātrau prabhāte navamīdine ..57..
meaning:
ततो वर्द्धापनं षष्ठीनामादिकरणं मम ..
कर्तव्यं तत्क्षणाद्रात्रौ प्रभाते नवमीदिने ..57..
text_mt: Then the rite of celebration, the sixth-day ceremony, and my naming ceremony / should be performed at once during the night or at dawn on the navamī day.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā mama tathā kāryo bhagavatyā mahotsavaḥ ..
brāhmaṇānbhojayecchaktyā tebhyo dadyācca dakṣiṇām .. 58 ..
meaning:
यथा मम तथा कार्यो भगवत्या महोत्सवः ..
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेच्छक्त्या तेभ्यो दद्याच्च दक्षिणाम् .. 58 ..
text_mt: Just as for me, a great festival should be celebrated for the Goddess; / one should feed brāhmaṇas according to one's means and give them a fee,

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyaṃ kāñcanaṃ gāvo vāsāṃsi kusumāni ca ..
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ tattatkṛṣṇo me prīyatāmiti .. 59 ..
meaning:
हिरण्यं काञ्चनं गावो वासांसि कुसुमानि च ..
यद्यदिष्टतमं तत्तत्कृष्णो मे प्रीयतामिति .. 59 ..
text_mt: gold, bullion, cows, garments, and flowers, / saying, 'Whatever is most cherished, may that please Kṛṣṇa!'

sanskrit_iast:
yamevaṃ devakī devī vasudevādajījanat ..
bhaumasya brahmaṇo guptyai tasmai brahmātmane namaḥ .. 4.55.60 ..
meaning:
यमेवं देवकी देवी वसुदेवादजीजनत् ..
भौमस्य ब्रह्मणो गुप्त्यै तस्मै ब्रह्मात्मने नमः .. 4.55.60 ..
text_mt: “Homage to that Soul of the Absolute, whom the divine Devakī thus bore from Vasudeva / for the protection of the brāhmaṇa upon earth!

sanskrit_iast:
sujanmavāsudevāya gobrāhmaṇahitāya ca ..
śāntirastu śivaṃ cāstu ityuktvā tu visarjayet .. 61 ..
meaning:
सुजन्मवासुदेवाय गोब्राह्मणहिताय च ..
शान्तिरस्तु शिवं चास्तु इत्युक्त्वा तु विसर्जयेत् .. 61 ..
text_mt: May there be peace and auspiciousness for Vāsudeva of noble birth, and for the welfare of cows and brāhmaṇas!” / Having spoken thus, one should dismiss [the deities].

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute devyā devakyāḥ sumahotsavam ..
varṣevarṣe bhagavato madbhakto dharmanandana .. 62 ..
meaning:
एवं यः कुरुते देव्या देवक्याः सुमहोत्सवम् ..
वर्षेवर्षे भगवतो मद्भक्तो धर्मनन्दन .. 62 ..
text_mt: Whoever thus performs this great festival of the goddess Devakī / and of the Lord every year, being my devotee, O son of Dharma,

sanskrit_iast: naro vā yadi vā nārī yathoktaphalamāpnuyāt.. 63 ..
meaning: नरो वा यदि वा नारी यथोक्तफलमाप्नुयात्.. 63 ..
text_mt: whether a man or a woman, attains the fruit that has been described:

sanskrit_iast:
putrasaṃtānamārogyaṃ dhanadhānyādisadgṛham ..
śālīkṣuyavasaṃpūrṇamaṇḍalaṃ sumanoharam .. 64 ..
meaning:
पुत्रसंतानमारोग्यं धनधान्यादिसद्गृहम् ..
शालीक्षुयवसंपूर्णमण्डलं सुमनोहरम् .. 64 ..
text_mt: male offspring, health, an excellent house with wealth, grain, and the like, / a very charming province filled with winter rice, sugarcane, and barley;

sanskrit_iast:
tasminrāṣṭre prabhurbhuṃkte dīrghāyurmanasepsitān ..
paracakrabhayaṃ nāsti tasmi nrājye'pi pāṇḍava .. 65 ..
meaning:
तस्मिन्राष्ट्रे प्रभुर्भुंक्ते दीर्घायुर्मनसेप्सितान् ..
परचक्रभयं नास्ति तस्मि न्राज्येऽपि पाण्डव .. 65 ..
text_mt: as ruler in that kingdom he enjoys his heart’s desires with a long life, / and there is no fear of enemy armies in that realm either, O Pāṇḍava.

sanskrit_iast:
parjanyaḥ kāmavarṣī syādītibhyo na bhayaṃ bhavet ..
yasmingṛhe pāṃḍuputra kriyate devakīvratam .. 66 ..
meaning:
पर्जन्यः कामवर्षी स्यादीतिभ्यो न भयं भवेत् ..
यस्मिन्गृहे पांडुपुत्र क्रियते देवकीव्रतम् .. 66 ..
text_mt: Parjanya rains at will, and there is no fear of calamities; / in whichever house, O son of Pāṇḍu, the Devakī observance is performed,

sanskrit_iast:
na tatra mṛta niṣkrāṃtirna garbhapatanaṃ tathā ..
na ca vyādhibhayaṃ tatra bhavediti matirmama .. 67 ..
meaning:
न तत्र मृत निष्क्रांतिर्न गर्भपतनं तथा ..
न च व्याधिभयं तत्र भवेदिति मतिर्मम .. 67 ..
text_mt: no dead body is carried out from there, nor is there miscarriage, / nor does fear of disease arise there—this is my conviction.

sanskrit_iast:
na vaidyajanasaṃyogo na cāpi kalaho gṛhe ..
saṃparkeṇāpi yaḥ kaścitkuryājjanmāṣṭamīvratam ..
viṣṇulokamavāpnoti so'pi pārtha na saṃśayaḥ .. 68 ..
meaning:
न वैद्यजनसंयोगो न चापि कलहो गृहे ..
संपर्केणापि यः कश्चित्कुर्याज्जन्माष्टमीव्रतम् ..
विष्णुलोकमवाप्नोति सोऽपि पार्थ न संशयः .. 68 ..
text_mt: There is no recourse to physicians, nor strife in the home; / anyone who performs the Janmāṣṭamī observance, even by mere association, / attains the world of Viṣṇu, O Pārtha, of that there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
janmāṣṭamī janamanonayanābhirāmā pāpāpahā sapadi naṃditanaṃdagopā ..
yo devakīṃ sadayitāṃ yajatīha tasyāṃ putrānavāpya samupaiti padaṃ sa viṣṇoḥ .. 69 ..
dūrvāṣṭamīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
जन्माष्टमी जनमनोनयनाभिरामा पापापहा सपदि नंदितनंदगोपा ..
यो देवकीं सदयितां यजतीह तस्यां पुत्रानवाप्य समुपैति पदं स विष्णोः .. 69 ..
दूर्वाष्टमीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Janmāṣṭamī, delightful to the mind and eyes of humanity, takes away sins and immediately gladdened Nanda the cowherd; / whoever worships Devakī along with her beloved on it obtains sons and attains the abode of Viṣṇu.
Description of the Dūrvāṣṭamī Votive Observance

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śukle bhādrapadasyaiva pakṣe'ṣṭamyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ..
dūrvāṣṭamīvrataṃ puṇyaṃ yaḥ kuryācchraddhayānvitaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
शुक्ले भाद्रपदस्यैव पक्षेऽष्टम्यां युधिष्ठिर ..
दूर्वाष्टमीव्रतं पुण्यं यः कुर्याच्छ्रद्धयान्वितः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / On the aṣṭamī of the bright fortnight of the month of Bhādrapada, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / whoever performs the meritorious Dūrvāṣṭamī votive observance endowed with faith,
title: Dūrvāṣṭamīvratavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
na tasya kṣayamāpnoti saṃtānaṃ saptaṣauruṣam ..
naṃdate varddhate nityaṃ yathā pūrvaṃ tathā kulam .. 2 ..
meaning:
न तस्य क्षयमाप्नोति संतानं सप्तषौरुषम् ..
नंदते वर्द्धते नित्यं यथा पूर्वं तथा कुलम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: Their lineage does not perish for seven generations; / it rejoices and flourishes continually, as before, so the family.

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kuta eṣā samutpannā dūrvā kasmāccirāyuṣā ..
kasmācca sā pavitrā ca lokanātha bravīhi me..3..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
कुत एषा समुत्पन्ना दूर्वा कस्माच्चिरायुषा ..
कस्माच्च सा पवित्रा च लोकनाथ ब्रवीहि मे..3..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / From where did this dūrvā grass arise? Why is it long-lived? / And why is it sacred, O Lord of the World? Tell me.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
kṣīrodasāgare pūrvaṃ mathyamāne'mṛtārthinā ..
viṣṇunā bāhujaṃghābhyāṃ yaddhṛto mandaro giriḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ..
क्षीरोदसागरे पूर्वं मथ्यमानेऽमृतार्थिना ..
विष्णुना बाहुजंघाभ्यां यद्धृतो मन्दरो गिरिः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Anciently, when the ocean of milk was being churned by those seeking nectar, / Mount Mandara was supported by Viṣṇu with his arms and thighs.

sanskrit_iast:
bhramito vai sa vegena romaṇyuddharṣitāni vai ..
tānyetāni jalormībhirutkṣiptāni tadarṇavāt .. 5 ..
meaning:
भ्रमितो वै स वेगेन रोमण्युद्धर्षितानि वै ..
तान्येतानि जलोर्मीभिरुत्क्षिप्तानि तदर्णवात् .. 5 ..
text_mt: As it spun rapidly, his body-hairs stood erect; / those very [hairs] were cast out from that ocean by the waves of water.

sanskrit_iast:
ajāyata śubhā dūrvā ramyā haritaśādvalā ..
evameṣā samutpannā dūrvā vidhu tanūruhā .. 6 ..
meaning:
अजायत शुभा दूर्वा रम्या हरितशाद्वला ..
एवमेषा समुत्पन्ना दूर्वा विधु तनूरुहा .. 6 ..
text_mt: Auspicious dūrvā grass arose, delightful with green sward. / In this way, this dūrvā grass was born from the body-hairs of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāścopari vinyastaṃ mathitāmṛtamuttamam ..
devadānavagandharvairyakṣavidyādharaistathā .. 7 ..
meaning:
तस्याश्चोपरि विन्यस्तं मथितामृतमुत्तमम् ..
देवदानवगन्धर्वैर्यक्षविद्याधरैस्तथा .. 7 ..
text_mt: And upon it was placed the excellent churned nectar / by the gods, dānavas, gandharvas, yakṣas, and vidyādharas.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpyamṛtakuṃbhasya peturnniṣyaṃdabiṃdavaḥ ..
tairiyaṃ spṛṣṭamātrābhūddūrvā rasyā'jarā'marā .. 8 ..
meaning:
तत्राप्यमृतकुंभस्य पेतुर्न्निष्यंदबिंदवः ..
तैरियं स्पृष्टमात्राभूद्दूर्वा रस्याऽजराऽमरा .. 8 ..
text_mt: From the pot of nectar, trickling drops fell there; / as soon as it was touched by them, the dūrvā became sapful, unaging, and immortal.

sanskrit_iast:
vaṃdyā pavitrā devaistu vaṃditābhyarcitā purā ..
aṣṭamyāṃ phalapuṣpaistu kharjūrairnnālikerakaiḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
वंद्या पवित्रा देवैस्तु वंदिताभ्यर्चिता पुरा ..
अष्टम्यां फलपुष्पैस्तु खर्जूरैर्न्नालिकेरकैः .. 9 ..
text_mt: Worthy of worship and sacred, it was revered and worshipped by the gods in ancient times / on the aṣṭamī, with fruits and flowers, with dates and coconuts,

sanskrit_iast:
drākṣākṣoṭakapitthaiśca barbarairlakucaistathā ..
nāriṃgairjaṃbukairāmrairbījapūraiśca dāḍimaiḥ .. 4.56.10 ..
meaning:
द्राक्षाक्षोटकपित्थैश्च बर्बरैर्लकुचैस्तथा ..
नारिंगैर्जंबुकैराम्रैर्बीजपूरैश्च दाडिमैः .. 4.56.10 ..
text_mt: with grapes, walnuts, and wood apples, with barbara and lakuca fruits, / with oranges, rose apples, mangoes, citrons, and pomegranates,

sanskrit_iast:
dadhyakṣataiḥ supuṣpaiśca dhūpanaivedyadīpakaiḥ ..
maṃtreṇānena rājendra śṛṇu ṣvāvahitena ca .. 11 ..
meaning:
दध्यक्षतैः सुपुष्पैश्च धूपनैवेद्यदीपकैः ..
मंत्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र शृणु ष्वावहितेन च .. 11 ..
text_mt: with curd and unbroken grains, with lovely flowers, incense, food offerings, and lamps. / Listen with attentive mind, O king of kings, to this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ dūrve'mṛtajanmāsi vaṃditā ca surāsuraiḥ ..
saubhāgyaṃ saṃtatiṃ kṛtvā sarvakāryakarī bhava .. 12 ..
meaning:
त्वं दूर्वेऽमृतजन्मासि वंदिता च सुरासुरैः ..
सौभाग्यं संततिं कृत्वा सर्वकार्यकरी भव .. 12 ..
text_mt: 'O Dūrvā, you have your origin in nectar and are revered by gods and asuras; / having granted good fortune and progeny, fulfill all my desires.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā śākhāpraśākhābhirvistṛtāsi mahītale ..
tathā mamāpi saṃtānaṃ dehi tvamajarāmare .. 13 ..
meaning:
यथा शाखाप्रशाखाभिर्विस्तृतासि महीतले ..
तथा ममापि संतानं देहि त्वमजरामरे .. 13 ..
text_mt: Just as you spread across the earth with branches and sub-branches, / so grant me progeny as well, O unaging, immortal one.'

sanskrit_iast:
evameṣā purā pārtha pūjitā tridaśottamaiḥ ..
teṣāṃ patnīvadhūbhiśca bhaginībhi stathaiva ca .. 14 ..
meaning:
एवमेषा पुरा पार्थ पूजिता त्रिदशोत्तमैः ..
तेषां पत्नीवधूभिश्च भगिनीभि स्तथैव च .. 14 ..
text_mt: In this way, O son of Pṛthā, it was worshipped of old by the foremost of the thirty [gods], / and likewise by their wives, daughters-in-law, and sisters.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjitābhyarhitā vācā gauryā rājañchriyā tathā ..
martyaloke vedavatyā damayaṃtyāpi sītayā .. 15 ..
meaning:
पूजिताभ्यर्हिता वाचा गौर्या राजञ्छ्रिया तथा ..
मर्त्यलोके वेदवत्या दमयंत्यापि सीतया .. 15 ..
text_mt: It was worshipped and praised with speech, O king, by Gaurī and by Śrī, / and in the mortal realm by Vedavatī, Damayantī, and Sītā,

sanskrit_iast:
sukeśyā ca ghṛtācyā ca raṃbhayā ca sukeśayā ..
sahanyā kāmakaṃdanyā menakorvaśikādibhiḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
सुकेश्या च घृताच्या च रंभया च सुकेशया ..
सहन्या कामकंदन्या मेनकोर्वशिकादिभिः .. 16 ..
text_mt: by Sukeśī, Ghṛtācī, Rambhā, and Sukeśayā, / by Sahanā, Kāmakandā, Menakā, Urvaśī, and others.

sanskrit_iast:
strībhirevārcitā dūrvā saubhāgyasukhadāyinī ..
snātābhiḥ śuci vastrābhiḥ sakhībhiḥ sasuhṛjjanaiḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
स्त्रीभिरेवार्चिता दूर्वा सौभाग्यसुखदायिनी ..
स्नाताभिः शुचि वस्त्राभिः सखीभिः ससुहृज्जनैः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Dūrvā, the bestower of good fortune and happiness, was worshipped solely by women / who had bathed and worn pure clothes, together with female friends and kin.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā dānāni viprebhyaḥ phalaṃ dattvārcayetprabhoḥ ..
tilapiṣṭakagodhūmasaptadhānyāni pāṃḍava .. 18 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वा दानानि विप्रेभ्यः फलं दत्त्वार्चयेत्प्रभोः ..
तिलपिष्टकगोधूमसप्तधान्यानि पांडव .. 18 ..
text_mt: Giving gifts to brahmins and offering fruit, one should worship the Lord, / O son of Pāṇḍu, with sesame flour cakes, wheat, and the seven grains.

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣayitvā suhṛnmitrasaṃbaṃdhisvajane tathā ..
yā nāryo vicariṣyaṃti vratametatpurātanam .. 19 ..
meaning:
भक्षयित्वा सुहृन्मित्रसंबंधिस्वजने तथा ..
या नार्यो विचरिष्यंति व्रतमेतत्पुरातनम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: Feeding close friends, companions, relatives, and kin, / whichever women practice this ancient votive observance,

sanskrit_iast:
dūrvāṣṭamīti vikhyātaṃ puṇyaṃ saṃtānakārakam ..
tāḥ sarvāḥ sukhasaubhāgyaputrapautrādibhistathā .. 4.56.20 ..
meaning:
दूर्वाष्टमीति विख्यातं पुण्यं संतानकारकम् ..
ताः सर्वाः सुखसौभाग्यपुत्रपौत्रादिभिस्तथा .. 4.56.20 ..
text_mt: known as Dūrvāṣṭamī, meritorious and bringing forth offspring, / all of them, endowed with happiness, good fortune, sons, grandsons, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
martye loke ciraṃ sthitvā tataḥ svargaṃ gatāḥ punaḥ ..
devairānaṃditāstatra bhartṛbhiḥ saha bāṃdhavaiḥ .. 21 ...
meaning:
मर्त्ये लोके चिरं स्थित्वा ततः स्वर्गं गताः पुनः ..
देवैरानंदितास्तत्र भर्तृभिः सह बांधवैः .. 21 ...
text_mt: after residing long in the mortal world, then go once more to heaven; / made joyful there by the gods, together with their husbands and kin,

sanskrit_iast: vasaṃti ramamāṇastā yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 22 ..
meaning: वसंति रममाणस्ता यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: they dwell delighting until the dissolution of all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
meghāvṛteṃbaratale harite vanāṃte yā sāṣṭamī śubhaphalā saphalā nabhasye ..
dūrvāphalākṣatatilaiḥ pratipūjya yoṣiddūrveva vṛddhimupayāti sutaiḥ suhṛdbhiḥ .. 23 .. ..
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
मेघावृतेंबरतले हरिते वनांते या साष्टमी शुभफला सफला नभस्ये ..
दूर्वाफलाक्षततिलैः प्रतिपूज्य योषिद्दूर्वेव वृद्धिमुपयाति सुतैः सुहृद्भिः .. 23 .. ..
कृष्णाष्टमीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
When the sky is covered with clouds and the edge of the forest is green, on that fruitful, auspicious aṣṭamī in Nabhasya, / the woman who worships with dūrvā, fruits, unbroken grains, and sesame seeds thrives like dūrvā with sons and good friends.
Description of the Kṛṣṇāṣṭamī Votive Observance

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīvrataṃ pārtha śṛṇu pāpabhayāpaham ..
dharmasaṃjananaṃ loke rudraprītikaraṃ param .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
कृष्णाष्टमीव्रतं पार्थ शृणु पापभयापहम् ..
धर्मसंजननं लोके रुद्रप्रीतिकरं परम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Hear, O son of Pṛthā, the Kṛṣṇāṣṭamī votive observance, which removes sin and fear, / generates righteousness in the world, and brings supreme delight to Rudra.
title: Kṛṣṇāṣṭamīvratavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
māsi mārgaśire prāpte daṃtadhāvanapūrvakam ..
upavāsasya niyamaṃ kuryānnaktasya vā punaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
मासि मार्गशिरे प्राप्ते दंतधावनपूर्वकम् ..
उपवासस्य नियमं कुर्यान्नक्तस्य वा पुनः .. 2 ..
text_mt: When the month of Mārgaśiras arrives, having first cleaned the teeth, / one should undertake the observance of fasting, or else of taking a nocturnal meal.

sanskrit_iast:
aśaktaśaktabhedena gṛhānniṣkramya bāhyataḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ varṣamekaṃ guruṃ pṛṣṭvā vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
अशक्तशक्तभेदेन गृहान्निष्क्रम्य बाह्यतः ..
कृष्णाष्टम्यां वर्षमेकं गुरुं पृष्ट्वा विचक्षणः .. 3 ..
text_mt: According to the distinction between unable and able, having gone outside the house / on the kṛṣṇāṣṭamī, for one year, the wise person, having consulted the guru,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacārī jitakrodhaḥ śivārcanajape rataḥ ..
tato'parāhṇasamaye snātvā nadyāṃ viśuddhadhīḥ .. .. 4 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मचारी जितक्रोधः शिवार्चनजपे रतः ..
ततोऽपराह्णसमये स्नात्वा नद्यां विशुद्धधीः .. .. 4 ..
text_mt: chaste, having conquered anger, intent on worshipping and chanting to Śiva, / then, at the time of afternoon, having bathed in a river, of purified mind,

sanskrit_iast:
śivaliṅgaṃ samabhyarcya sumanobhiḥ sugaṃdhibhiḥ ..
gugguluṃ ca śubhaṃ dagdhvā dadyānnaivedyamuttamam .. 5 ..
meaning:
शिवलिङ्गं समभ्यर्च्य सुमनोभिः सुगंधिभिः ..
गुग्गुलुं च शुभं दग्ध्वा दद्यान्नैवेद्यमुत्तमम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: having worshipped the śivaliṅga with fragrant flowers, / and having burned auspicious bdellium, should offer an excellent food offering.

sanskrit_iast:
tato devasya purato homaṃ kuryāttilai rguru ..
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi śaṃkarāyeti pūjayet .. 6 ..
meaning:
ततो देवस्य पुरतो होमं कुर्यात्तिलै र्गुरु ..
मार्गशीर्षे शुभे मासि शंकरायेति पूजयेत् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Then, before the god, one should perform a copious oblation with sesame seeds; / in the auspicious month of Mārgaśīrṣa, one should worship him saying: 'To Śaṅkara'.

sanskrit_iast:
gomūtraprāśanaṃ kṛtvā svapyādbhūmau tato niśi ..
atirātrasya yajñasya phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
गोमूत्रप्राशनं कृत्वा स्वप्याद्भूमौ ततो निशि ..
अतिरात्रस्य यज्ञस्य फलमाप्नोति मानवः .. 7 ..
text_mt: Having drunk cow urine, one should then sleep on the ground at night; / a mortal attains the fruit of the Atirātra sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ puṣyepi saṃpūjya śaṃbhuṃ nāma maheśvaram ..
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ ghṛtaṃ prāśya vājapeyaphalaṃ bhajet .. 8 ..
meaning:
एवं पुष्येपि संपूज्य शंभुं नाम महेश्वरम् ..
कृष्णाष्टम्यां घृतं प्राश्य वाजपेयफलं भजेत् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Likewise, in Puṣya, having worshipped the Great Lord named Śambhu / on the kṛṣṇāṣṭamī and consumed clarified butter, one attains the fruit of the Vājapeya sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
māghe māheśvaraṃ nāma kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ prapūjayet ..
niśi pītvā gavāṃ kṣīraṃ gomedhāṣṭakamāpnuyāta .. 9 ..
meaning:
माघे माहेश्वरं नाम कृष्णाष्टम्यां प्रपूजयेत् ..
निशि पीत्वा गवां क्षीरं गोमेधाष्टकमाप्नुयात .. 9 ..
text_mt: In Māgha, one should worship him under the name Māheśvara on the kṛṣṇāṣṭamī; / having drunk cows' milk at night, one attains [the fruit of] eight Gomedha sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
phālgune ca mahādevaṃ saṃpūjya prāśayettilān ..
rājasūyasya yajñasya phalamaṣṭaguṇaṃ bhajet .. 5.57.10 ..
meaning:
फाल्गुने च महादेवं संपूज्य प्राशयेत्तिलान् ..
राजसूयस्य यज्ञस्य फलमष्टगुणं भजेत् .. 5.57.10 ..
text_mt: And in Phālguna, having worshipped Mahādeva, one should consume sesame seeds; / one attains eightfold the fruit of the Rājasūya sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
caitre ca sthāṇunāmānaṃ kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ śivaṃ yajet ..
yavāhārośvamedhasya yajñasya phalamāpnuyāt .. 11 ..
meaning:
चैत्रे च स्थाणुनामानं कृष्णाष्टम्यां शिवं यजेत् ..
यवाहारोश्वमेधस्य यज्ञस्य फलमाप्नुयात् .. 11 ..
text_mt: And in Caitra, one should worship Śiva under the name Sthāṇu on the kṛṣṇāṣṭamī; / subsisting on barley, one attains the fruit of the horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśākhe śivanāmānamiṣṭvā rātrau kuśodakam ..
pītvā puruṣamedhasya phalaṃ daśaguṇaṃ bhajet .. 12 ..
meaning:
वैशाखे शिवनामानमिष्ट्वा रात्रौ कुशोदकम् ..
पीत्वा पुरुषमेधस्य फलं दशगुणं भजेत् .. 12 ..
text_mt: In Vaiśākha, having worshipped him under the name Śiva, / drinking kuśa water at night, one attains tenfold the fruit of the human sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhe paśupatiṃ pūjya gavāṃ śṛṅgodakaṃ pibet ..
gavāṃ lakṣapradānasya naraḥ phalamavāpnuyāt .. 13 ..
meaning:
ज्येष्ठे पशुपतिं पूज्य गवां शृङ्गोदकं पिबेत् ..
गवां लक्षप्रदानस्य नरः फलमवाप्नुयात् .. 13 ..
text_mt: In Jyeṣṭha, having worshipped Paśupati, one should drink water from the horn of a cow; / a man attains the fruit of giving a hundred thousand cows.

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhe cogranāmānamiṣṭvā saṃprāśya gomayam ..
varṣāṇāṃ niyutaṃ sāgraṃ rudraloke mahīyate ..14..
meaning:
आषाढे चोग्रनामानमिष्ट्वा संप्राश्य गोमयम् ..
वर्षाणां नियुतं साग्रं रुद्रलोके महीयते ..14..
text_mt: In Āṣāḍha, having worshipped him under the name Ugra and consumed cow dung, / one is glorified in Rudra's world for more than a hundred thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvaṇe śarvanāmānamiṣṭvārkaṃ niśi bhakṣayet ..
bahusvarṇasya yajñasya naraḥ phalamavāpnuyāt .. 15 ..
meaning:
श्रावणे शर्वनामानमिष्ट्वार्कं निशि भक्षयेत् ..
बहुस्वर्णस्य यज्ञस्य नरः फलमवाप्नुयात् .. 15 ..
text_mt: In Śrāvaṇa, having worshipped him under the name Śarva, one should consume mud at night; / a man attains the fruit of the sacrifice of much gold.

sanskrit_iast:
māsi bhādrapade'ṣṭamyāṃ tryaṃbakaṃ nāma pūjayet ..
bilvapatraṃ niśi prāśya annadīkṣāphalaṃ bhajet .. 16 ..
meaning:
मासि भाद्रपदेऽष्टम्यां त्र्यंबकं नाम पूजयेत् ..
बिल्वपत्रं निशि प्राश्य अन्नदीक्षाफलं भजेत् .. 16 ..
text_mt: In the month of Bhādrapada, on the aṣṭamī, one should worship him under the name Tryambaka; / having consumed a bilva leaf at night, one attains the fruit of the rite of initiating [giving of] food.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavanāmāśvine pūjyaḥ prāśayettaṃḍulodakam ..
pauṇḍarīkasya yajñasya phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ bhajet .. 17 ..
meaning:
भवनामाश्विने पूज्यः प्राशयेत्तंडुलोदकम् ..
पौण्डरीकस्य यज्ञस्य फलं शतगुणं भजेत् .. 17 ..
text_mt: In Āśvina, he should be worshipped under the name Bhava, and one should consume rice water; / one attains a hundredfold the fruit of the Pauṇḍarīka sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtike rudranāmānaṃ saṃpūjya prāśayeddadhi ..
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
कार्तिके रुद्रनामानं संपूज्य प्राशयेद्दधि ..
अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः .. 18 ..
text_mt: In Kārtika, having worshipped [him] under the name Rudra, one should consume curds; / a mortal attains the fruit of the Agniṣṭoma sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
abdāṃte bhojayedviprāñchivabhaktiparāyaṇān ..
pāyasaṃ madhu saṃyuktaṃ ghṛtena samabhiplutam ..
śaktyā hiraṇyavāsāṃsi bhaktyā tebhyo nivedayet ..19..
meaning:
अब्दांते भोजयेद्विप्राञ्छिवभक्तिपरायणान् ..
पायसं मधु संयुक्तं घृतेन समभिप्लुतम् ..
शक्त्या हिरण्यवासांसि भक्त्या तेभ्यो निवेदयेत् ..19..
text_mt: At the end of the year, one should feed Brahmins devoted to the worship of Śiva / with milk-rice mixed with honey and flooded with ghee. / According to one's means, one should offer them gold and clothes with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
satilā kṛṣṇakalaśā bhakṣyabhojyena saṃyutāḥ ..
dvādaśātra pradātavyāśchatropānadyugānvitā ..
nivedayati rudrāṇāṃ gāṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃ payasvinīm .. 5.57.20 ..
meaning:
सतिला कृष्णकलशा भक्ष्यभोज्येन संयुताः ..
द्वादशात्र प्रदातव्याश्छत्रोपानद्युगान्विता ..
निवेदयति रुद्राणां गां च कृष्णां पयस्विनीम् .. 5.57.20 ..
text_mt: Twelve black jars filled with sesame seeds, accompanied by food to chew and to eat, / provided with a royal parasol and a pair of sandals, are to be given here; / and one offers a black, milk-giving cow to the Rudras.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣamekaṃ caredevaṃ nairantaryyeṇa yo naraḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīvrataṃ bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 21 ..
meaning:
वर्षमेकं चरेदेवं नैरन्तर्य्येण यो नरः ..
कृष्णाष्टमीव्रतं भक्त्या तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु .. 21 ..
text_mt: Hear the meritorious fruit of that man who observes thus without interruption / for one year the Kṛṣṇāṣṭamī votive observance with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ ..
modate bhūpavannityaṃ martyaloke śataṃ samāḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः सर्वैश्वर्यसमन्वितः ..
मोदते भूपवन्नित्यं मर्त्यलोके शतं समाः .. 22 ..
text_mt: Freed from all sins, endowed with all sovereignty, / he constantly rejoices like a king in the world of mortals for a hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā devāḥ sarve devatvamāgatāḥ ..
devī devītvamāpannā guhaḥ skaṃdatvamāgataḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना देवाः सर्वे देवत्वमागताः ..
देवी देवीत्वमापन्ना गुहः स्कंदत्वमागतः .. 23 ..
text_mt: By this rule all the gods attained godhood; / the Goddess attained her state as Goddess; Guha attained the state of Skanda;

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā brahmatvamāpanno hyahaṃ viṣṇutvamāgataḥ ..
indraśca devarājatvaṃ gāṇapatyaṃ gaṇo gataḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मत्वमापन्नो ह्यहं विष्णुत्वमागतः ..
इन्द्रश्च देवराजत्वं गाणपत्यं गणो गतः .. 24 ..
text_mt: Brahmā attained the state of Brahmā; I indeed attained the state of Viṣṇu; / Indra [attained] kingship over the gods; and the Gaṇa attained leadership of the Gaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
nārī vā puruṣo vāpi kṛtvā kṛṣṇāṣṭamīvratam ..
akhaṃḍitaṃ mahārāja puṇyaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam .. 25 ..
meaning:
नारी वा पुरुषो वापि कृत्वा कृष्णाष्टमीव्रतम् ..
अखंडितं महाराज पुण्यं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: A woman or a man, having performed the Kṛṣṇāṣṭamī votive observance / unbroken, O great king, obtains unequalled merit.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryakoṭipratīkāśairvimānaiḥ sarvakāmikaiḥ ..
rudrakanyāsamākīrṇairhaṃsasārasasaṃyutaiḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
सूर्यकोटिप्रतीकाशैर्विमानैः सर्वकामिकैः ..
रुद्रकन्यासमाकीर्णैर्हंससारससंयुतैः .. 26 ..
text_mt: In celestial chariots resembling ten million suns, fulfilling all desires, / crowded with Rudra-maidens, accompanied by geese and cranes,

sanskrit_iast:
nṛtyavāditrasaṃyuktairutkṛṣṭadhvanināditaiḥ ..
dodhūyamānaścamaraiḥ stūyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
नृत्यवादित्रसंयुक्तैरुत्कृष्टध्वनिनादितैः ..
दोधूयमानश्चमरैः स्तूयमानः सुरासुरैः .. 27 ..
text_mt: resounding with dances and musical instruments, echoing with loud cries, / fanned with chowries, praised by gods and asuras,

sanskrit_iast:
trinetraḥ śūlapāṇiśca śivaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ ..
āste śivapure tāvadyāvatkalpeṣu cāṣṭakam .. 28 ..
meaning:
त्रिनेत्रः शूलपाणिश्च शिवैश्वर्यसमन्वितः ..
आस्ते शिवपुरे तावद्यावत्कल्पेषु चाष्टकम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: three-eyed and trident-handed, endowed with the sovereignty of Śiva, / he dwells in Śiva's city for as long as eight kalpas.

sanskrit_iast:
ityetatte samākhyātaṃ pārtha kṛṣṇāṣṭamīvratam ..
yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
इत्येतत्ते समाख्यातं पार्थ कृष्णाष्टमीव्रतम् ..
यच्छ्रुत्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः .. 29 ..
text_mt: Thus has this Kṛṣṇāṣṭamī votive observance been declared to you, O Pārtha, / hearing which one is freed from all sins—of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīvratamidaṃ śivabhāvitātmā satyāśanairuditanāmayutairupoṣya ..
kṛṣṇāndadāti kalaśānsatilānnayuktānyosau prayāti padamuttamamindumauleḥ .. 5.57.30 ..
anaghāṣṭamīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
कृष्णाष्टमीव्रतमिदं शिवभावितात्मा सत्याशनैरुदितनामयुतैरुपोष्य ..
कृष्णान्ददाति कलशान्सतिलान्नयुक्तान्योसौ प्रयाति पदमुत्तममिन्दुमौलेः .. 5.57.30 ..
अनघाष्टमीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Having fasted during this Kṛṣṇāṣṭamī votive observance with one's mind purified by Śiva, [subsisting] on true food along with the pronounced names, / he who gives black jars filled with sesame seeds goes to the supreme abode of the Moon-crested Lord.
Description of the Anaghāṣṭamī Votive Observance

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
brahmaputro mahātejā atrirnāma mahānṛṣiḥ ..
tasya patnī mahābhāga anasūyā pativratā .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
ब्रह्मपुत्रो महातेजा अत्रिर्नाम महानृषिः ..
तस्य पत्नी महाभाग अनसूया पतिव्रता .. 1 ..
text_mt: The Holy Lord said: / There was a son of Brahmā, of great splendour, a great sage named Atri. / His wife, O fortunate one, was the faithful Anasūyā.
title: adhyāyaḥ 058

sanskrit_iast:
tayoḥ kālena mahatā jātaḥ putro mahā tapāḥ ..
datto nāma mahāyogī viṣṇoraṃśo mahītale .. 2 ..
meaning:
तयोः कालेन महता जातः पुत्रो महा तपाः ..
दत्तो नाम महायोगी विष्णोरंशो महीतले .. 2 ..
text_mt: To the two of them, after a long time, was born a son of great austerity, / a great yogin named Datta, a portion of Viṣṇu upon the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyo nāma lokesminnanaghaśceti viśrutaḥ ..
tasya bhāryā nadī nāma babhūva sahacāriṇī .. 3 ..
meaning:
द्वितीयो नाम लोकेस्मिन्ननघश्चेति विश्रुतः ..
तस्य भार्या नदी नाम बभूव सहचारिणी .. 3 ..
text_mt: His second name, celebrated in this world, is Anagha. / His wife, who became his companion, was named Nadī.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭaputrā jīvavatsā sarvabrāhmaguṇairvṛtā ..
anayorviṣṇurūpeṇa lakṣmīścaiva nadī smṛtā .. 4 ..
meaning:
अष्टपुत्रा जीववत्सा सर्वब्राह्मगुणैर्वृता ..
अनयोर्विष्णुरूपेण लक्ष्मीश्चैव नदी स्मृता .. 4 ..
text_mt: She had eight sons whose offspring were living, and was endowed with all the virtues of a Brahmin. / Of these two, Nadī is remembered as Lakṣmī, in the form of Viṣṇu [himself].

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tasya sabhāryasya yogābhyāsaratasya vā ..
ājagmuḥ śaraṇaṃ devāḥ śuṃbhadaityena pīḍitāḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
एवं तस्य सभार्यस्य योगाभ्यासरतस्य वा ..
आजग्मुः शरणं देवाः शुंभदैत्येन पीडिताः .. 5 ..
text_mt: While he, accompanied by his wife, was engaged in the practice of yoga, / the gods, tormented by the daitya Śumbha, came to him for refuge,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmalabdhaprasādena drutaṃ gatvāmarāvatīm ..
saṃruddhāṃ jaṃbhadaityena divyavarṣaśataṃ nṛpa .. 6 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मलब्धप्रसादेन द्रुतं गत्वामरावतीम् ..
संरुद्धां जंभदैत्येन दिव्यवर्षशतं नृप .. 6 ..
text_mt: having quickly gone to Amarāvatī by the grace obtained from Brahmā, / which had been besieged by the daitya Jambha for a hundred divine years, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
daityadānavasaṃyoge pātālādetya bhārata ..
tasya sainyamasaṃkhyeyaṃ daityadānavarākṣasaiḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
दैत्यदानवसंयोगे पातालादेत्य भारत ..
तस्य सैन्यमसंख्येयं दैत्यदानवराक्षसैः .. 7 ..
text_mt: having emerged from Pātāla in the gathering of the daityas and dānavas, O descendant of Bharata. / His army of daityas, dānavas, and rākṣasas was innumerable.

sanskrit_iast:
tena nirṇāśitā devāḥ seṃdracaṃdramarudgaṇāḥ ..
tyājitāḥ svāni dhiṣṇyāni tyaktvā jagmurdiśo daśa .. 8 ..
meaning:
तेन निर्णाशिता देवाः सेंद्रचंद्रमरुद्गणाः ..
त्याजिताः स्वानि धिष्ण्यानि त्यक्त्वा जग्मुर्दिशो दश .. 8 ..
text_mt: By him the gods, together with Indra, the Moon, and the host of Maruts, were destroyed; / forced to abandon their own stations, they fled in the ten directions.

sanskrit_iast:
agrataḥ pralayaṃ yāṃtaḥ sendrā devā bhayārditāḥ ..
pṛṣṭhatonu vrajaṃti sma daityā jaṃbhapuraḥsarāḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
अग्रतः प्रलयं यांतः सेन्द्रा देवा भयार्दिताः ..
पृष्ठतोनु व्रजंति स्म दैत्या जंभपुरःसराः .. 9 ..
text_mt: In front, the gods along with Indra, afflicted with fear, were fleeing; / behind them pursued the daityas, with Jambha at their head,

sanskrit_iast:
yudhyaṃtaḥ śarasaṃghātairgadāmusalamudgaraiḥ ..
nardanto vṛṣabhārūḍhāḥ kecinmahiṣavāhanāḥ .. 4.58.10 ..
meaning:
युध्यंतः शरसंघातैर्गदामुसलमुद्गरैः ..
नर्दन्तो वृषभारूढाः केचिन्महिषवाहनाः .. 4.58.10 ..
text_mt: fighting with showers of arrows, with clubs, pestles, and mallets, / roaring, mounted on bulls, and some riding buffaloes,

sanskrit_iast:
śarabhairgaṃḍakairvyāghrairvānarai rabhasairdrutāḥ ..
muñcanto yāṃti pāṣāṇācchataghnīstomarāñcharān .. 11 ..
meaning:
शरभैर्गंडकैर्व्याघ्रैर्वानरै रभसैर्द्रुताः ..
मुञ्चन्तो यांति पाषाणाच्छतघ्नीस्तोमराञ्छरान् .. 11 ..
text_mt: swiftly borne by śarabhas, rhinoceroses, tigers, and monkeys, / hurling stones, śataghnīs, javelins, and arrows as they advanced,

sanskrit_iast:
yāvadvindhyagiriṃ prāptāstattasyāśramamaṇḍalam ..
anaghaścānadī caiva dāṃpatyaṃ yatra tiṣṭhati .. 12 ..
meaning:
यावद्विन्ध्यगिरिं प्राप्तास्तत्तस्याश्रममण्डलम् ..
अनघश्चानदी चैव दांपत्यं यत्र तिष्ठति .. 12 ..
text_mt: until they reached the Vindhya mountain, the region of that hermitage / where the married couple, Anagha and Anadī, dwelt.

sanskrit_iast:
tayoḥ samīpaṃ saṃprāptāste narāḥ śaraṇārthinaḥ ..
anagho'pi ca tāndevām̐llīlayaiva savāsavān .. 13 ..
meaning:
तयोः समीपं संप्राप्तास्ते नराः शरणार्थिनः ..
अनघोऽपि च तान्देवाम्̐ल्लीलयैव सवासवान् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Those [gods], seeking refuge, approached the two of them. / And Anagha, quite effortlessly, [said] to those gods along with Indra:

sanskrit_iast:
abhyaṃtare praviśyātha tiṣṭhadhvaṃ vigatajvarāḥ ..
tatheti nāma te kṛtvā sarve tuṣṭiṃ samāsthitāḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
अभ्यंतरे प्रविश्याथ तिष्ठध्वं विगतज्वराः ..
तथेति नाम ते कृत्वा सर्वे तुष्टिं समास्थिताः .. 14 ..
text_mt: "Now enter within and remain free from distress." / Agreeing to this, they all attained contentment.

sanskrit_iast:
daityā api drutaṃ prāptā ghnaṃtaḥ praharaṇairarīn ..
ityūcurulbaṇā ghorā gṛhṇīdhvaṃ brāhmaṇīṃ muneḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
दैत्या अपि द्रुतं प्राप्ता घ्नंतः प्रहरणैररीन् ..
इत्यूचुरुल्बणा घोरा गृह्णीध्वं ब्राह्मणीं मुनेः .. 15 ..
text_mt: The daityas also arrived swiftly, slaying their enemies with weapons. / Thus spoke those fierce and terrible [demons]: "Seize the sage's Brahmin wife!

sanskrit_iast:
drutaṃ drumānākṣipadhvaṃ puṣpopagaphalopagān ..
athāropyānaghaṃ mūrdhni daityā jagmustadāśramān .. 16 ..
meaning:
द्रुतं द्रुमानाक्षिपध्वं पुष्पोपगफलोपगान् ..
अथारोप्यानघं मूर्ध्नि दैत्या जग्मुस्तदाश्रमान् .. 16 ..
text_mt: Quickly tear down the trees bearing flowers and fruits!" / Then, placing Anagha at their head, the daityas entered those hermitages.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkṣaṇāccāpi daityānāṃ śrīrbabhūva śirogatā ..
dattakenāpi te dṛṣṭā naṣṭā dhyānāgninā kṣaṇāt ..
nistejaso babhūvurhiḥ niḥśrīkā madapaṃḍitāḥ ..17..
meaning:
तत्क्षणाच्चापि दैत्यानां श्रीर्बभूव शिरोगता ..
दत्तकेनापि ते दृष्टा नष्टा ध्यानाग्निना क्षणात् ..
निस्तेजसो बभूवुर्हिः निःश्रीका मदपंडिताः ..17..
text_mt: And at that very moment, the fortune of the daityas departed from their heads; / seen by Dattaka, they were destroyed in an instant by the fire of his meditation. / They became devoid of splendour, bereft of fortune, and bewildered by arrogance.

sanskrit_iast:
devairapi gṛhītāste daityāśca haraṇe raṇe ..
rudaṃtī nistanaṃtaśca niśceṣṭā brahmakaṃṭakāḥ ..18..
meaning:
देवैरपि गृहीतास्ते दैत्याश्च हरणे रणे ..
रुदंती निस्तनंतश्च निश्चेष्टा ब्रह्मकंटकाः ..18..
text_mt: Those daityas, thorns to Brahmins, were seized by the gods in that battlefield, / weeping and groaning, rendered motionless,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣṭibhiḥ karaṇaiḥ śūlaistriśūlaiḥ parighairghanaiḥ ..
evaṃ te pralayaṃ jagmustatprabhāvānmunestadā .. 19 ..
meaning:
ऋष्टिभिः करणैः शूलैस्त्रिशूलैः परिघैर्घनैः ..
एवं ते प्रलयं जग्मुस्तत्प्रभावान्मुनेस्तदा .. 19 ..
text_mt: with spears, missiles, spikes, tridents, and heavy iron bars. / Thus they perished at that time through the power of that sage.

sanskrit_iast:
asurā devaśastraughairjitā indreṇa ghātitāḥ ..
devā api svarāṣṭreṣu tasthuḥ sarve yathā purā ..
surairapi munestasya devarṣermahimā'bhavat .. 4.58.20 ..
meaning:
असुरा देवशस्त्रौघैर्जिता इन्द्रेण घातिताः ..
देवा अपि स्वराष्ट्रेषु तस्थुः सर्वे यथा पुरा ..
सुरैरपि मुनेस्तस्य देवर्षेर्महिमाऽभवत् .. 4.58.20 ..
text_mt: The asuras, conquered by the multitudes of divine weapons, were slain by Indra. / The gods too all remained in their own realms as before; / and the greatness of that sage, the divine seer, was celebrated by the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa sarvalokānāṃ bhavāya satatotthitaḥ ..
karmaṇā manasā vācā śubhānyeva samācarat .. 21 ..
meaning:
ततः स सर्वलोकानां भवाय सततोत्थितः ..
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा शुभान्येव समाचरत् .. 21 ..
text_mt: Then, ever-intent upon the welfare of all worlds, / he performed only auspicious deeds in action, mind, and speech.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṣṭhakuḍayaśilābhūta ūrdhvabāhurmahātapāḥ ..
brahmottaraṃ nāma tapastepe suniyatavataḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
काष्ठकुडयशिलाभूत ऊर्ध्वबाहुर्महातपाः ..
ब्रह्मोत्तरं नाम तपस्तेपे सुनियतवतः .. 22 ..
text_mt: Becoming like wood, a wall, or stone, with raised arms, of great austerity, / he performed the austerity known as Brahmottara, observing strict vows,

sanskrit_iast:
netre hyanimiṣe kṛtvā bhruvormadhye vilokayan ..
trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi divyānīti hi naḥ śrutam .. 23 ..
meaning:
नेत्रे ह्यनिमिषे कृत्वा भ्रुवोर्मध्ये विलोकयन् ..
त्रीणि वर्षसहस्राणि दिव्यानीति हि नः श्रुतम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: keeping his eyes unblinking, gazing between his eyebrows, / for three thousand divine years, so indeed it has been heard by us.

sanskrit_iast:
tathorddhvaretasastasya sthitasyānimiṣasya hi ..
yogābhyāsaprayatnasya māhiṣmatyāḥ patiḥ prabhuḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
तथोर्द्ध्वरेतसस्तस्य स्थितस्यानिमिषस्य हि ..
योगाभ्यासप्रयत्नस्य माहिष्मत्याः पतिः प्रभुः .. 24 ..
text_mt: While he remained thus with upward-drawn semen, unblinking, / striving in the practice of yoga, the sovereign ruler of Māhiṣmatī,

sanskrit_iast:
ekāhāddrutamabhyetya kārtavīryorjuno nṛpaḥ ..
śuśrūṣāṃ vinayaṃ cakre divārātramataṃdritaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
एकाहाद्द्रुतमभ्येत्य कार्तवीर्योर्जुनो नृपः ..
शुश्रूषां विनयं चक्रे दिवारात्रमतंद्रितः .. 25 ..
text_mt: King Kārtavīryārjuna, arriving swiftly in a single day, / rendered service and homage day and night without sloth,

sanskrit_iast:
gātrasaṃvāhanaṃ pūjāṃ manasā ciṃtitaṃ tathā ..
sampūrṇe niyame vṛtte dṛḍhatuṣṭyā samanvitaḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
गात्रसंवाहनं पूजां मनसा चिंतितं तथा ..
सम्पूर्णे नियमे वृत्ते दृढतुष्ट्या समन्वितः .. 26 ..
text_mt: massaging his limbs, offering worship, and fulfilling whatever was thought of in [the sage's] mind. / When the observance was completed, filled with firm contentment,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyai dadau varānpuṣṭāṃścaturo bhūritejasaḥ ..
pūrvaṃ bāhusahasraṃ tu sa vavre prathamaṃ varam .. 27 ..
meaning:
तस्यै ददौ वरान्पुष्टांश्चतुरो भूरितेजसः ..
पूर्वं बाहुसहस्रं तु स वव्रे प्रथमं वरम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: he granted him four rich boons of great splendour. / First, indeed, he chose a thousand arms as his first boon.

sanskrit_iast:
adharmāddhīyamānasya sadbhistasmānnivāraṇam ..
dharmeṇa pṛthivīṃ jitvā dharmeṇaivānupālanam .. 28 ..
meaning:
अधर्माद्धीयमानस्य सद्भिस्तस्मान्निवारणम् ..
धर्मेण पृथिवीं जित्वा धर्मेणैवानुपालनम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: [and that,] if I should stray from righteousness, the virtuous restrain me from that; / having conquered the earth by righteousness, [its] protection by righteousness alone;

sanskrit_iast:
saṃgrāmānsubahūñjitvā hatvā vīrānsahasraśaḥ ..
saṃgrāme yudhyamānasya vadho me syāddhareḥ karāt .. 29 ..
tena dattena loke'smindattaṃ rājyaṃ mahītale ..
kārtavīryāya kauṃteya yogābhyāsaḥ savistaraḥ 1..
meaning:
संग्रामान्सुबहूञ्जित्वा हत्वा वीरान्सहस्रशः ..
संग्रामे युध्यमानस्य वधो मे स्याद्धरेः करात् .. 29 ..
तेन दत्तेन लोकेऽस्मिन्दत्तं राज्यं महीतले ..
कार्तवीर्याय कौंतेय योगाभ्यासः सविस्तरः 1..
text_mt:
having conquered very many battles and slain warriors by the thousands, / my death, while fighting in battle, should be from the hand of Hari.
By him, through that gift, sovereignty over the surface of the earth in this world was given / to Kārtavīrya, O son of Kuntī, as well as the practice of yoga in full detail,

sanskrit_iast: cakravartipadaṃ caiva aṣṭasiddhisamanvitam .. 4.58.30 ..
meaning: चक्रवर्तिपदं चैव अष्टसिद्धिसमन्वितम् .. 4.58.30 ..
text_mt: and the status of a universal emperor endowed with the eight supernatural powers.

sanskrit_iast:
tenāpi pṛthivī kṛtsnā saptadvīpā saparvatā ..
sasamudrākaravatī dharmeṇa vidhinā jitā .. 31 ..
meaning:
तेनापि पृथिवी कृत्स्ना सप्तद्वीपा सपर्वता ..
ससमुद्राकरवती धर्मेण विधिना जिता .. 31 ..
text_mt: By him too, the entire earth with its seven continents, with its mountains, / with its oceans and rich in mines, was conquered according to rule through righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya bāhusahasraṃ tu prabhāvātkila dhīmataḥ ..
yāgādratho dhvajaścaiva prādurbhavati māyayā .. 32 ..
meaning:
तस्य बाहुसहस्रं तु प्रभावात्किल धीमतः ..
यागाद्रथो ध्वजश्चैव प्रादुर्भवति मायया .. 32 ..
text_mt: Through the power of that wise one, indeed, a thousand arms, / and a chariot and banner from sacrifice, appear by Māyā.

sanskrit_iast:
daśayajñasahasrāṇi teṣu dvīpeṣu saptasu ..
nirargalāni vṛttāni svayaṃ vai tasya pāṃḍava .. 33 ..
meaning:
दशयज्ञसहस्राणि तेषु द्वीपेषु सप्तसु ..
निरर्गलानि वृत्तानि स्वयं वै तस्य पांडव .. 33 ..
text_mt: Ten thousand unimpeded sacrifices were conducted / by him in person across those seven continents, O Pāṇḍava.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve yajñā mahābāho prasannā bhūridakṣiṇāḥ ..
sarve kāñcanavedikyāḥ sarve yūpaiśca kāñcanaiḥ .. 34 ...
meaning:
सर्वे यज्ञा महाबाहो प्रसन्ना भूरिदक्षिणाः ..
सर्वे काञ्चनवेदिक्याः सर्वे यूपैश्च काञ्चनैः .. 34 ...
text_mt: All his sacrifices, O mighty-armed one, were delightful and accompanied by lavish sacrificial fees; / all had golden altars, and all had golden sacrificial posts;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadevairmahābhāgairvimānasthairalaṃkṛtāḥ ..
gaṃdharvairapsarobhiśca nityamevopaśobhitāḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
सर्वदेवैर्महाभागैर्विमानस्थैरलंकृताः ..
गंधर्वैरप्सरोभिश्च नित्यमेवोपशोभिताः .. 35 ..
text_mt: they were adorned by all the fortunate gods seated in celestial chariots, / and ever graced by gandharvas and apsarases.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya yajñe jagurgāthāṃ gaṃdharvā nāradastathā ..
caritaṃ rājasiṃhasya mahimānaṃ nirīkṣya te .. 36 ..
meaning:
तस्य यज्ञे जगुर्गाथां गंधर्वा नारदस्तथा ..
चरितं राजसिंहस्य महिमानं निरीक्ष्य ते .. 36 ..
text_mt: At his sacrifice, the gandharvas and Nārada sang a song, / having beheld the deeds and the greatness of that lion among kings:

sanskrit_iast:
na nūnaṃ kārtavīryasya gatiṃ yāsyanti pārthivāḥ ..
yajñairdānaistapobhirvā vikrameṇa śrutena ca .. 37 ..
meaning:
न नूनं कार्तवीर्यस्य गतिं यास्यन्ति पार्थिवाः ..
यज्ञैर्दानैस्तपोभिर्वा विक्रमेण श्रुतेन च .. 37 ..
text_mt: “Surely no earthly rulers will attain the state of Kārtavīrya / through sacrifices, gifts, or austerities, or through valour and sacred learning.”

sanskrit_iast:
dvīpeṣu saptasu sa vai khaḍgacarmaśarāsanī ..
vyacaracchyenavadyo vai dūrādārādavaikṣata .. 38 ..
meaning:
द्वीपेषु सप्तसु स वै खड्गचर्मशरासनी ..
व्यचरच्छ्येनवद्यो वै दूरादारादवैक्षत .. 38 ..
text_mt: Across the seven continents he indeed roved like a hawk, / armed with sword, shield, and bow, and looked from afar and near.

sanskrit_iast:
anaṣṭadravyatā cāsya na śoko na ca vai klamaḥ ..
prabhāveṇa mahīrājorakṣaddharmeṇa ca prajāḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
अनष्टद्रव्यता चास्य न शोको न च वै क्लमः ..
प्रभावेण महीराजोरक्षद्धर्मेण च प्रजाः .. 39 ..
text_mt: And for him there was no loss of property, no grief, and no fatigue; / by his majesty the king of the earth protected his subjects with righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāśītisahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ vai narādhipa ..
samudravasanāyāṃ sa cakravartī babhūva ha .. 4.58.40 ..
meaning:
पञ्चाशीतिसहस्राणि वर्षाणां वै नराधिप ..
समुद्रवसनायां स चक्रवर्ती बभूव ह .. 4.58.40 ..
text_mt: For eighty-five thousand years, O ruler of men, / he was indeed a universal emperor over her whose garment is the ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva paśupālobhūtkṣetrapālaḥ sa eva ca ..
sa eva vṛṣṭyāṃ parjanyo yogitvādarjuno'bhavat .. 41 ..
meaning:
स एव पशुपालोभूत्क्षेत्रपालः स एव च ..
स एव वृष्ट्यां पर्जन्यो योगित्वादर्जुनोऽभवत् .. 41 ..
text_mt: He alone was the guardian of cattle, and he alone was the protector of the fields; / in bringing rain he alone was Parjanya; Arjuna became [all this] through his status as a yogin.

sanskrit_iast:
sa vai bāhusahasreṇa jyāghātakaṭhinatvacā ..
vāti raśmisahasreṇa kṣobhyamāṇe mahodadhau .. 42 ..
meaning:
स वै बाहुसहस्रेण ज्याघातकठिनत्वचा ..
वाति रश्मिसहस्रेण क्षोभ्यमाणे महोदधौ .. 42 ..
text_mt: Indeed, with his thousand arms whose skin was hardened by the strikes of the bowstring, / he blew like a thousand rays when the great ocean was churned.

sanskrit_iast:
na hi nāgamanuṣyaistu māhipmatyāṃ mahādyutiḥ ..
karkoṭāheḥ sutāñjitvā puri tatra nyaveśayat .. 43 ..
meaning:
न हि नागमनुष्यैस्तु माहिप्मत्यां महाद्युतिः ..
कर्कोटाहेः सुताञ्जित्वा पुरि तत्र न्यवेशयत् .. 43 ..
text_mt: The greatly radiant one, having conquered the sons of the serpent Karkoṭaka / [who were untouchable] by serpent-folk and humans, settled them in the city of Māhiṣmatī.

sanskrit_iast:
sa vai patnīṃ samudrasya prāvṛṭkāleṃbujekṣaṇām ..
krīḍate ca madonmattaḥ pratisrotaścakāra ha .. .. 44 ..
meaning:
स वै पत्नीं समुद्रस्य प्रावृट्कालेंबुजेक्षणाम् ..
क्रीडते च मदोन्मत्तः प्रतिस्रोतश्चकार ह .. .. 44 ..
text_mt: Maddened with intoxication, he played with the lotus-eyed wife of the ocean / during the rainy season and made her flow upstream.

sanskrit_iast:
lalitaṃ krīḍatā tena phalaniṣpandamālinī ..
ūrmībhrukuṭimatyeva śaṃkitāsyeti narmadā .. 45 ..
meaning:
ललितं क्रीडता तेन फलनिष्पन्दमालिनी ..
ऊर्मीभ्रुकुटिमत्येव शंकितास्येति नर्मदा .. 45 ..
text_mt: As he played gracefully, the Narmadā, crowned with a wreath of still fruits, / was alarmed by him, her waves appearing like knit brows.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya bāhusahasreṇa kṣobhyamāṇe mahodadhau ..
bhavaṃtyālīnaniśceṣṭāḥ pātālasthā mahāsurāḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
तस्य बाहुसहस्रेण क्षोभ्यमाणे महोदधौ ..
भवंत्यालीननिश्चेष्टाः पातालस्था महासुराः .. 46 ..
text_mt: When the great ocean was agitated by his thousand arms, / the great asuras dwelling in the netherworld lay motionless and cowering.

sanskrit_iast:
tūṣṇīkṛto mahābhāga līnāhīnamahāmatiḥ ..
cakārottuṅgakṣubdhormi doḥsahasreṇa sāgaram .. 47 ..
meaning:
तूष्णीकृतो महाभाग लीनाहीनमहामतिः ..
चकारोत्तुङ्गक्षुब्धोर्मि दोःसहस्रेण सागरम् .. 47 ..
text_mt: Reduced to silence, O fortunate one, the wise [king] in whom the great serpent rested, / stirred the ocean with his thousand arms, causing towering, turbulent waves.

sanskrit_iast:
krāṃtā niścalamūrddhāno babhūvuśca mahoragāḥ ..
sāyāhne kadalīkhaṇḍānnirdhā(rghā)tanihatā iva ..
jitā dhanurdharāḥ sarve sutyaktaiḥ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
क्रांता निश्चलमूर्द्धानो बभूवुश्च महोरगाः ..
सायाह्ने कदलीखण्डान्निर्धा(र्घा)तनिहता इव ..
जिता धनुर्धराः सर्वे सुत्यक्तैः पञ्चभिः शरैः .. 48 ..
text_mt: The great serpents were overcome, their heads rendered motionless, / like groves of plantain trees struck by lightning at eventide; / all bowmen were conquered with his five well-loosed arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
laṅkādhipaṃ mohayitvā sabalaṃ rāvaṇaṃ balāt ..
nirjitya vaśamānīya māhiṣmatyāṃ babaṃdha ca .. 49 ..
meaning:
लङ्काधिपं मोहयित्वा सबलं रावणं बलात् ..
निर्जित्य वशमानीय माहिष्मत्यां बबंध च .. 49 ..
text_mt: Having bewildered Rāvaṇa, the lord of Laṅkā, along with his army, / he forcefully subdued him, brought him under his sway, and bound him in Māhiṣmatī.

sanskrit_iast:
tatobhyetya pulastyastu arjunaṃ saṃprasādayan ..
mumoca rakṣaḥ paulastyaṃ paulastyenānugāminā ..
tasya bāhusahasrasya babhūva jyātalasvanaḥ .. 4.58.50 ..
meaning:
ततोभ्येत्य पुलस्त्यस्तु अर्जुनं संप्रसादयन् ..
मुमोच रक्षः पौलस्त्यं पौलस्त्येनानुगामिना ..
तस्य बाहुसहस्रस्य बभूव ज्यातलस्वनः .. 4.58.50 ..
text_mt: Then Pulastya approached and, conciliating Arjuna, / released the rākṣasa descendant of Pulastya, accompanied by Pulastya. / The twang of the bowstring on the palm of his thousand arms arose.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣudhitena kadācitsa prārthitaścitrabhānunā ..
saptadvīpāṃ citrabhānoḥ prādādbhikṣāṃ mahīmimām .. 51 ..
meaning:
क्षुधितेन कदाचित्स प्रार्थितश्चित्रभानुना ..
सप्तद्वीपां चित्रभानोः प्रादाद्भिक्षां महीमिमाम् .. 51 ..
text_mt: Once, when solicited by hungry Agni, / he gave this earth of seven continents as alms to Agni.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṃḍeśayastato'dyāpi dṛśyate bhagavānhariḥ ..
niṃbādityaśca pratyakṣo jāgratsaṃstasya veśmani ..
babhūva duhiturhetoḥ śarado'dyāpi tiṣṭhati .. 52 ..
meaning:
कुंडेशयस्ततोऽद्यापि दृश्यते भगवान्हरिः ..
निंबादित्यश्च प्रत्यक्षो जाग्रत्संस्तस्य वेश्मनि ..
बभूव दुहितुर्हेतोः शरदोऽद्यापि तिष्ठति .. 52 ..
text_mt: From then on, the blessed Lord Hari is seen even today lying in the pit, / and Nimbāditya is visible, being awake in his house; / it happened for the sake of his daughter, and remains even today through the autumns.

sanskrit_iast:
sa evaṃ guṇasaṃyukto rājābhūdarjuno bhuvi ..
anaghasya prasādena yogācā ryasya pāṃḍava .. 53 ..
meaning:
स एवं गुणसंयुक्तो राजाभूदर्जुनो भुवि ..
अनघस्य प्रसादेन योगाचा र्यस्य पांडव .. 53 ..
text_mt: Endowed with such virtues, Arjuna became a king on earth / through the grace of Anagha, the master of yoga, O Pāṇḍava.

sanskrit_iast:
teneyaṃ varalabdhena kārtavīryeṇa yoginā ..
pravartitā martyaloke prasiddhā hyanaghāṣṭamī .. 54 ..
meaning:
तेनेयं वरलब्धेन कार्तवीर्येण योगिना ..
प्रवर्तिता मर्त्यलोके प्रसिद्धा ह्यनघाष्टमी .. 54 ..
text_mt: By that yogin Kārtavīrya, who had obtained this boon, / the famous Anaghāṣṭamī was inaugurated in the mortal world.

sanskrit_iast:
aghaṃ pāpaṃ smṛtaṃ loke taccāpi trividhaṃ bhavet ..
yasmādaghaṃ nāśayati tenāsāvanaghā smṛtā .. 55 ..
meaning:
अघं पापं स्मृतं लोके तच्चापि त्रिविधं भवेत् ..
यस्मादघं नाशयति तेनासावनघा स्मृता .. 55 ..
text_mt: Evil is known in the world as sin, and that is of three kinds; / because she destroys evil, she is remembered as Anaghā.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṣṭaguṇamaiśvaryaṃ vinodārthaṃ vibhāvyate ..
aṇimā mahimā prāptiḥ prākāmye laghimā tathā .. 56 ..
meaning:
तस्याष्टगुणमैश्वर्यं विनोदार्थं विभाव्यते ..
अणिमा महिमा प्राप्तिः प्राकाम्ये लघिमा तथा .. 56 ..
text_mt: Her eightfold sovereignty is contemplated for [divine] sport: / atomicity, greatness, attainment, irresistible will, lightness,

sanskrit_iast:
īśitvaṃ ca vaśitvaṃ ca sarvakāmāvasāyitā ..
ityaṣṭau yogasiddhasya siddhayo mokṣalakṣaṇāḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
ईशित्वं च वशित्वं च सर्वकामावसायिता ..
इत्यष्टौ योगसिद्धस्य सिद्धयो मोक्षलक्षणाः .. 57 ..
text_mt: lordship, subjugation, and the fulfilment of all desires— / these are the eight supernatural powers of one perfected in yoga, characterised by liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
samutpannā dattakasya loke pratyayakārakāḥ ..
yātrāsamāptau saṃgṛhya yadaghāni tathaiva vā .. 58 ..
meaning:
समुत्पन्ना दत्तकस्य लोके प्रत्ययकारकाः ..
यात्रासमाप्तौ संगृह्य यदघानि तथैव वा .. 58 ..
text_mt: Arisen from Dattātreya, producing conviction in the world, / taking hold [of them] at the end of the pilgrimage, or likewise the sins,

sanskrit_iast:
jagatsamastamanaghaṃ kuryādasmādato'naghā ..
madaṃśo madgataprāṇo loke sminnṛtako dvijaḥ .. 59 ..
meaning:
जगत्समस्तमनघं कुर्यादस्मादतोऽनघा ..
मदंशो मद्गतप्राणो लोके स्मिन्नृतको द्विजः .. 59 ..
text_mt: she makes the entire universe free of sin; hence she is Anaghā. / A portion of mine, his breath devoted to me, the twice-born has become deceased in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kīdṛśaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa sa vai rājārjuno vratam ..
cakre vā triṣu lokeṣu kairmantraiḥ samayaiśca kaiḥ ..
kasminkāle tithau kasyāmetanme vada keśava .. 4.58.60 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
कीदृशं पुण्डरीकाक्ष स वै राजार्जुनो व्रतम् ..
चक्रे वा त्रिषु लोकेषु कैर्मन्त्रैः समयैश्च कैः ..
कस्मिन्काले तिथौ कस्यामेतन्मे वद केशव .. 4.58.60 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / What kind of votive observance, O lotus-eyed one, did that King Arjuna / perform in the three worlds, with what mantras and with what rules? / At what time and on what lunar day? Tell me this, O Keśava.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ mārgaśīrṣe daṃpatī darbhanirmitau ..
anaghaṃ cānaghāṃ caiva bahuputraiḥ samanvitām .. 61 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
कृष्णाष्टम्यां मार्गशीर्षे दंपती दर्भनिर्मितौ ..
अनघं चानघां चैव बहुपुत्रैः समन्विताम् .. 61 ..
text_mt: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / On the eighth of the dark fortnight in Mārgaśīrṣa, [one should fashion] a couple made of darbha grass, / Anagha and Anaghā, accompanied by many sons.

sanskrit_iast:
purā kṛtīkṛtau śāṃtau bhūmibhāge sthitau śubhau ..
snātvaivamarcayetpuṣpaiḥ sasugandhairyudhiṣṭhira .. 62 ..
meaning:
पुरा कृतीकृतौ शांतौ भूमिभागे स्थितौ शुभौ ..
स्नात्वैवमर्चयेत्पुष्पैः ससुगन्धैर्युधिष्ठिर .. 62 ..
text_mt: Previously consecrated, tranquil, and placed upon an auspicious piece of ground, / having bathed, one should thus worship [them] with fragrant flowers, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛgvedoktaṛcā vipro viṣṇuṃ dhyātvā mamāṃśajam ..
anaghaṃ vāsudevenānaghāṃ lakṣmīṃ vrajāṃ tanum ..
pradyumnādiputravargaṃ harivaṃśe yathoditam .. 63
meaning:
ऋग्वेदोक्तऋचा विप्रो विष्णुं ध्यात्वा ममांशजम् ..
अनघं वासुदेवेनानघां लक्ष्मीं व्रजां तनुम् ..
प्रद्युम्नादिपुत्रवर्गं हरिवंशे यथोदितम् .. 63
text_mt: A brāhmaṇa, meditating on Viṣṇu born of a portion of mine with a verse proclaimed in the Ṛgveda, / [should worship] Anagha through Vāsudeva, and Anaghā as the body of Lakṣmī gone [there], / and the group of sons beginning with Pradyumna as declared in the Harivaṃśa:

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ ato devā avaṃtu no yato viṣṇurvicakrame ..
pṛthivyāḥ saptadhāmabhiḥ ..
idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame tredhā nidadhe padam ..
samūḻhamasyapāṃsure ..
trīṇi padā vicakrame viṣṇurgopā adābhyaḥ ..
ato dharmāṇi dhārayan ..
viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata yato vratāni paspaśe ..
iṃdrasya yujyaḥ sakhā ..
tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ sadā paśyaṃti sūrayaḥ ..
divīva cakṣurātatam..
tadviprāso vipanyavo jāgṛvāṃsaḥ samiṃdhate ..
viṣṇoryatparamaṃ padam ..
lokodbhavaiḥ phalaiḥ kandaiḥ śṛṃgārairbadaraiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
vittaiśca dhānyaiḥ puṣpaiśca gaṃdhadhūpaiḥ sadīpakaiḥ .. 64 ..
meaning:
ओं अतो देवा अवंतु नो यतो विष्णुर्विचक्रमे ..
पृथिव्याः सप्तधामभिः ..
इदं विष्णुर्विचक्रमे त्रेधा निदधे पदम् ..
समूḻहमस्यपांसुरे ..
त्रीणि पदा विचक्रमे विष्णुर्गोपा अदाभ्यः ..
अतो धर्माणि धारयन् ..
विष्णोः कर्माणि पश्यत यतो व्रतानि पस्पशे ..
इंद्रस्य युज्यः सखा ..
तद्विष्णोः परमं पदं सदा पश्यंति सूरयः ..
दिवीव चक्षुराततम्..
तद्विप्रासो विपन्यवो जागृवांसः समिंधते ..
विष्णोर्यत्परमं पदम् ..
लोकोद्भवैः फलैः कन्दैः शृंगारैर्बदरैः शुभैः ..
वित्तैश्च धान्यैः पुष्पैश्च गंधधूपैः सदीपकैः .. 64 ..
text_mt: “Oṃ. May the gods protect us from where Viṣṇu strode forth / across the seven realms of the earth. / Viṣṇu strode over this [universe]; thrice he set down his foot; / [all is] gathered in its dust. / Viṣṇu, the unbeguiled protector, strode three paces, / upholding the sacred ordinances from there. / Behold the deeds of Viṣṇu, whereby he looked upon the sacred vows, / the close ally of Indra. / The sages ever behold that supreme step of Viṣṇu, / like an eye extended in the sky. / The inspired, zealous priests, keeping vigil, kindle / that which is the supreme step of Viṣṇu.” / With fruits and roots grown in the world, with auspicious water-chestnuts and jujubes, / and with wealth, grains, flowers, scents, incenses, and lamps.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ pūjayedbhaktiyuktaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ..
tato dvijānbhojayecca suhṛtsaṃbaṃdhibāṃdhavān .. 65 ..
meaning:
यः पूजयेद्भक्तियुक्तः सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ..
ततो द्विजान्भोजयेच्च सुहृत्संबंधिबांधवान् .. 65 ..
text_mt: Whoever worships [thus] full of devotion is freed from all sins. / Then he should feed the twice-born, as well as friends, relatives, and kinsmen.

sanskrit_iast:
vratāvasāne gṛhṇīyātkaścideko naro vratam ..
teṣāṃ madhye dṛḍhāścakruranaghavratapāragāḥ .. 66 ..
meaning:
व्रतावसाने गृह्णीयात्कश्चिदेको नरो व्रतम् ..
तेषां मध्ये दृढाश्चक्रुरनघव्रतपारगाः .. 66 ..
text_mt: At the conclusion of the votive observance, some single man should undertake the votive observance. / Among them, those steadfast [practitioners] who crossed over the Anaghavrata took it up:

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ jīvanaghātī cetsatyaṃ tu samayoṣitam ..
varṣamekaṃ tataḥ svecchā idaṃ tavānaghavratam .. 67 ..
meaning:
इदं जीवनघाती चेत्सत्यं तु समयोषितम् ..
वर्षमेकं ततः स्वेच्छा इदं तवानघव्रतम् .. 67 ..
text_mt: "If he is the slayer of living beings, but adheres truly to the appointed rule, / then for one year, and thereafter according to his own wish, this Anaghavrata is yours."

sanskrit_iast:
tatropekṣaṇakaṃ kāryaṃ naṭanartakagāyakaiḥ ..
prabhāte tu navamyāṃ taṃ toyamadhye visarjayet .. 68 ..
meaning:
तत्रोपेक्षणकं कार्यं नटनर्तकगायकैः ..
प्रभाते तु नवम्यां तं तोयमध्ये विसर्जयेत् .. 68 ..
text_mt: There a festive spectacle is to be performed by actors, dancers, and singers. / In the morning, on the navamī, he should immerse him [i.e. the image] in water.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute yātrāṃ varṣevarṣe ca harṣitaḥ ..
bhaktiyuktaḥ śraddhayā ca sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 69 ..
meaning:
एवं यः कुरुते यात्रां वर्षेवर्षे च हर्षितः ..
भक्तियुक्तः श्रद्धया च सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 69 ..
text_mt: A person who thus conducts this procession year after year with joy, / full of devotion and with faith, is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṭuṃbaṃ varddhate tasya yasya viṣṇuḥ prasīdati ..
ārogyaṃ sapta janmāni tato yāṃti parāṃ gatim .. 4.58.70 ..
meaning:
कुटुंबं वर्द्धते तस्य यस्य विष्णुः प्रसीदति ..
आरोग्यं सप्त जन्मानि ततो यांति परां गतिम् .. 4.58.70 ..
text_mt: His family prospers, he with whom Viṣṇu is pleased; / [he attains] freedom from disease for seven births, and after that they attain the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
etāmaghaughaśamanāmanaghāṣṭamīṃ ca kauṃteya saṃprati mayā kathitā hitāya ..
kurvaṃtyananyamanasaḥ svayaśobhivṛddhyai ṛddhiṃ prayāṃti kṛtavīryasutānurūpām .. 71 .. ..
somāṣṭamīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
एतामघौघशमनामनघाष्टमीं च कौंतेय संप्रति मया कथिता हिताय ..
कुर्वंत्यनन्यमनसः स्वयशोभिवृद्ध्यै ऋद्धिं प्रयांति कृतवीर्यसुतानुरूपाम् .. 71 .. ..
सोमाष्टमीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
This Anaghāṣṭamī, which quells the flood of sins, has now been related by me for [your] benefit, O son of Kuntī. / Those who observe it with single-minded devotion for the increase of their own fame attain prosperity like that of Kārtavīrya's son.
Description of the Somāṣṭamī Votive Observance

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

पञ्चामृतादिना देवं स्थापयित्वा यतव्रती . . 3
text_mt: Having meditated on Hari in the right half, and on the Lord in the centre all around, / and having installed the god with the five nectars and the like, the observer of the vow,

harabhāgaṃ nīlaraktaṃ śivasyopari mauktikam . . 4

चन्दनेनेन्दुयुक्तेन दक्षिणार्धं विलेपयेत् .
हरभागं नीलरक्तं शिवस्योपरि मौक्तिकम् . . 4

संवत्सरांते कर्तव्यं यत्तत्सर्वं निबोध मे .. 8 ..
text_mt: Having repeated [this] and worshipped the parents by that rule, O you of good vows, / learn from me all that is to be done at the end of the year:

dadyādvitānakaṃ caiva patākāṃ ghaṭakīṃ tathā .. 9 ..
meaning:
प्रागुक्वविधिना पूज्या सितपीतयुगद्वयम् ..
दद्याद्वितानकं चैव पताकां घटकीं तथा .. 9 ..

meaning:

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: And he who should constantly practice this until the fall of his body, / is regarded in this very world as Hari manifest in human form.

text_mt: Calamities do not touch him; he never becomes miserable; / he is never afflicted by fevers, planetary afflictions, and the like.

संप्राप्यादित्ययोगेन प्राग्विधानेन चाभ्यसेत् .. 16 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Or know that same bright aṣṭamī in that manner: / when it coincides with Sunday, one should practice it according to the previous rule.

meaning:

पद्मरागेण दिव्येन सुवर्णेन च पार्वतीम् .. 17 ..

अभावे सर्वरत्नानां हेम सर्वत्र योजयेत् .. 18 ..

रक्तमाल्यांबरधरं नैवेद्यं घृतपाचितम् .. 19 ..

कृत्वा सूर्यादिलोकेषु भुक्त्वा भोगान्व्रजेत्परम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: Having performed this previously for one year, and likewise for five years, / having enjoyed pleasures in the worlds of the Sun and others, he reaches the supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
pataṃgavatpratāpī syādadīnaśca jana priyaḥ ..
asminrogo na bādheta dhanavānputravānbhavet .. 22 ..

पतंगवत्प्रतापी स्याददीनश्च जन प्रियः ..
अस्मिन्रोगो न बाधेत धनवान्पुत्रवान्भवेत् .. 22 ..
text_mt: He becomes majestic like the sun, noble, and beloved of the people; / disease does not torment him in this world; he becomes wealthy and possesses sons.

śrīvṛkṣanavamīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
यद्यष्टमी भवति सोमयुता कदाचिदर्केण वा कुरुकुलोद्वह तामुपोष्य ..
पूज्यो मया सह हरं हरिणांकचिह्नं भक्त्यायुषां पदमुपैति पदं पुरारेः .. 23 .. ..
श्रीवृक्षनवमीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
If the aṣṭamī falls on a Monday, or at any time with the Sun, O uplifter of the Kuru race, having fasted on it, / Hara, who bears the emblem of the hare-marked [moon], is to be worshipped together with me; through devotion he attains the realm of the long-lived, the realm of the enemy of Pura.
Description of the Śrīvṛkṣanavamī Votive Observance

sanskrit_iast:

samutpanneṣu ratneṣu kṣīrodamathane purā ..

meaning:

समुत्पन्नेषु रत्नेषु क्षीरोदमथने पुरा ..
दैत्यानां मोहनार्थाय योषिद्भूते जनार्दने .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / In ancient times, when the jewels arose during the churning of the Ocean of Milk, / and Janārdana assumed the form of a woman to delude the Daityas,

sanskrit_iast:

yāmevamiti vānyonyaṃ yuyudhurdevadānavāḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
बिल्वे वृक्षे क्षणं श्रांता विश्रांता कमलालया ..
यामेवमिति वान्योन्यं युयुधुर्देवदानवाः .. 2 ..
text_mt: she whose abode is the lotus, weary, rested for a moment on a bilva tree. / Saying 'She is mine! [She is mine!]', the gods and the Dānavas fought one another.

meaning:

पातालं गमिता दैत्याः सश्रीकः स्वयमाययौ .. 3 ..
text_mt: All were conquered in ancient times, O son of Pṛthā, in battle by Kṛṣṇa the discus-wielder; / the Daityas were driven to the netherworld, and he himself returned accompanied by Śrī.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīḥ samāvāsitā yasmācchrīvṛkṣastu tataḥ smṛtaḥ ..
tasmādbhādrapadasyaiva śuklapakṣe kurūttama .. 4 ..
meaning:
श्रीः समावासिता यस्माच्छ्रीवृक्षस्तु ततः स्मृतः ..
तस्माद्भाद्रपदस्यैव शुक्लपक्षे कुरूत्तम .. 4 ..
text_mt: Because Śrī made her dwelling there, it is known as the 'Śrīvṛkṣa'. / Therefore, in the bright fortnight of Bhādrapada, O best of Kurus,

sanskrit_iast:

śrīvṛkṣaṃ vividhaiḥ puṣpairanagnipācitaiḥ phalaiḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:

श्रीवृक्षं विविधैः पुष्पैरनग्निपाचितैः फलैः .. 5 ..

īṣadbhānukarātāmratāmrīkṛtanabhastale .. 6 ..

ईषद्भानुकराताम्रताम्रीकृतनभस्तले .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
maṃtreṇānena rājendra kṛtvā brāhmaṇabhojanam ..
tato bhuñjīta maunena tailakṣāravivarjitaḥ ..
anagnipākaṃ bhūpātre dadhipuṣpaphalaiḥ śubham .. 7 ..
meaning:
मंत्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र कृत्वा ब्राह्मणभोजनम् ..
ततो भुञ्जीत मौनेन तैलक्षारविवर्जितः ..
अनग्निपाकं भूपात्रे दधिपुष्पफलैः शुभम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: With this mantra, O king of kings, having fed brāhmaṇas, / he should then eat in silence, avoiding oil and alkaline food, / [eating] auspicious food not cooked over fire from an earthen vessel, with curd, flowers, and fruits.

sanskrit_iast:

श्रीमती फलिनी धन्या मर्त्यलोके महीयते... 9 ..

text_mt:
Having on the navamī draped the bilva tree, which bears uninjured fruit, with offerings of food, flowers, fruits, garments, and various grains, / and having worshipped [it] at the time of dawn, men beloved of the Supreme Spirit attain [fortune] praised by the lord of men.
Description of the Dhvajanavamī Vrata.

sanskrit_iast:

mahiṣāsure vinihate bhagavatyā mahāsuraiḥ ..
pūrvavairamanusmṛtya saṃgrāmā bahavaḥ kṛtāḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
