महिषासुरे विनिहते भगवत्या महासुरैः ..
पूर्ववैरमनुस्मृत्य संग्रामा बहवः कृताः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / When Mahiṣāsura had been slain by the Goddess, many battles were waged by the great asuras, / remembering their former enmity.
title: Dhvajanavamīvratavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
nānārūpadharā devī avatīrya punaḥpunaḥ ..
dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya nijaghne daityasattamān .. 2 ..
meaning:
नानारूपधरा देवी अवतीर्य पुनःपुनः ..
धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय निजघ्ने दैत्यसत्तमान् .. 2 ..
text_mt: Assuming various forms and descending again and again / in order to establish righteousness, the Goddess struck down the foremost Daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
atha raktāsuro nāma mahiṣasya suto mahān ..
āsīttena tapastaptaṃ varṣāṇāṃ niyutāni ṣaṭ ..
tasmai dadau caturvaktro rājyaṃ trailokyamaṇḍale .. 3 ..
meaning:
अथ रक्तासुरो नाम महिषस्य सुतो महान् ..
आसीत्तेन तपस्तप्तं वर्षाणां नियुतानि षट् ..
तस्मै ददौ चतुर्वक्त्रो राज्यं त्रैलोक्यमण्डले .. 3 ..
text_mt: Then there was a great son of Mahiṣa named Raktāsura; / he performed austerities for six hundred thousand years. / The Four-Faced [Brahmā] granted him sovereignty over the circle of the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tena labdhaṃ vareṇātha melayitvā danoḥ sutān ..
prārabdhaṃ saha śakreṇa yuddhaṃ gatvā'marāvatīm .. 4 ..
meaning:
तेन लब्धं वरेणाथ मेलयित्वा दनोः सुतान् ..
प्रारब्धं सह शक्रेण युद्धं गत्वाऽमरावतीम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Having obtained [it] through that boon, he assembled the sons of Danu, / went to Amarāvatī, and initiated a battle with Śakra.

sanskrit_iast:
taddṛṣṭvā dānavabalaṃ sannaddhātyuddhatadhvajam ..
yuyudhe dānavaiḥ sārddhaṃ suraiḥ śakrapurassaraiḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
तद्दृष्ट्वा दानवबलं सन्नद्धात्युद्धतध्वजम् ..
युयुधे दानवैः सार्द्धं सुरैः शक्रपुरस्सरैः .. 5 ..
text_mt: Beholding that Dānava army, arrayed for battle with exceedingly raised banners, / the gods, led by Śakra, fought together with the Dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra prāvartata nadī śoṇitaughataraṃgiṇī ..
khaḍgamatsyagadāgrāhavasunaṃdakakacchapā ..
vahaṃtī pitṛlokāya surāsurabhayānakā .. 6 ..
meaning:
तत्र प्रावर्तत नदी शोणितौघतरंगिणी ..
खड्गमत्स्यगदाग्राहवसुनंदककच्छपा ..
वहंती पितृलोकाय सुरासुरभयानका .. 6 ..
text_mt: There flowed a river rippling with floods of blood, / with swords as fish, maces as alligators, and Nandaka swords as turtles, / flowing toward the world of the ancestors, terrifying to gods and asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
atha raktāsuro roṣādyuyudhe vibudhaiḥ saha ..
te hanyamānā vibudhā raktākṣeṇa mahāraṇe .. 7 ..
meaning:
अथ रक्तासुरो रोषाद्युयुधे विबुधैः सह ..
ते हन्यमाना विबुधा रक्ताक्षेण महारणे .. 7 ..
text_mt: Then Raktāsura furiously fought with the gods; / those gods, being struck down in the great battle by the red-eyed one,

sanskrit_iast:
bhraṣṭāḥ svargaṃ parityajya tyaktapraharaṇā drutam ..
karacchatrāṃ purīṃ prāptā yatrāste bhavavallabhā .. 8 ..
meaning:
भ्रष्टाः स्वर्गं परित्यज्य त्यक्तप्रहरणा द्रुतम् ..
करच्छत्रां पुरीं प्राप्ता यत्रास्ते भववल्लभा .. 8 ..
text_mt: fled, abandoning heaven and quickly throwing down their weapons; / they reached the city Karacchatrā, where the beloved of Bhava resides,

sanskrit_iast:
durgā cāmuṇḍayā sārdhaṃ navadurgāsamanvitā ..
ādyā tāvanmahālakṣmīrnaṃdā kṣemakarī tathā .. 9 ..
meaning:
दुर्गा चामुण्डया सार्धं नवदुर्गासमन्विता ..
आद्या तावन्महालक्ष्मीर्नंदा क्षेमकरी तथा .. 9 ..
text_mt: Durgā, together with Cāmuṇḍā, accompanied by the nine Durgās: / first Mahālakṣmī, then Nandā, and Kṣemaṅkarī,

sanskrit_iast:
śivadūtī mahāruṇḍā bhrāmarī rudramaṃgalā ..
revatī harasiddhistu navaitāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
etāsāṃ te stutiṃ cakrustridaśāḥ praṇatānanāḥ .. 4.61.10 ..
meaning:
शिवदूती महारुण्डा भ्रामरी रुद्रमंगला ..
रेवती हरसिद्धिस्तु नवैताः परिकीर्तिताः ..
एतासां ते स्तुतिं चक्रुस्त्रिदशाः प्रणताननाः .. 4.61.10 ..
text_mt: Śivadūtī, Mahāruṇḍā, Bhrāmarī, Rudramaṅgalā, / Revatī, and Harasiddhi—these nine are proclaimed. / With bowed heads, the thirty [gods] made a hymn of praise to them:

sanskrit_iast:
amarapatimukuṭacumbitacaraṇāṃbujasakalabhuvanasukhajananī ..
jayati jagadīśavaṃditā sakalāmalaniṣkalā durgā .. 11 ..
meaning:
अमरपतिमुकुटचुम्बितचरणांबुजसकलभुवनसुखजननी ..
जयति जगदीशवंदिता सकलामलनिष्कला दुर्गा .. 11 ..
text_mt: "Victorious is Durgā, whose lotus feet are kissed by the crown of the lord of the immortals, who produces happiness for all the worlds, / who is revered by the Lord of the Universe, complete, spotless, and without parts.

sanskrit_iast:
vikṛtanakhadaśanabhūṣaṇarudhiravaśācchuritakṣatakhaḍgahastā ..
jayati naramuṃḍamuṃḍitapiśita surāhārakṛccaṇḍī .. 12 ..
meaning:
विकृतनखदशनभूषणरुधिरवशाच्छुरितक्षतखड्गहस्ता ..
जयति नरमुंडमुंडितपिशित सुराहारकृच्चण्डी .. 12 ..
text_mt: Victorious is Caṇḍī, whose ornaments are deformed claws and teeth, whose hand holds a sword wounded and smeared with blood and fat, / who is adorned with a garland of human heads and partakes of flesh and wine.

sanskrit_iast:
pracchāditaśikhigaṇodbalavikaṭajaṭābaddhacandramaṇiśobhā ..
jayati digaṃbarabhūṣā siddhavaṭeśā mahālakṣmīḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
प्रच्छादितशिखिगणोद्बलविकटजटाबद्धचन्द्रमणिशोभा ..
जयति दिगंबरभूषा सिद्धवटेशा महालक्ष्मीः .. 13 ..
text_mt: Victorious is Mahālakṣmī, adorned with space as her garments, the mistress of Siddhavaṭa, / whose beauty bears the moon-jewel bound in fierce, heavy matted hair covered with blazing fires.

sanskrit_iast:
karakamalajanitaśobhā padmāsanabaddhapadmavadanā ca ..
jayati kamaṇḍaluhastā naṃdā devī natārtiharā .. 14 ..
meaning:
करकमलजनितशोभा पद्मासनबद्धपद्मवदना च ..
जयति कमण्डलुहस्ता नंदा देवी नतार्तिहरा .. 14 ..
text_mt: Victorious is goddess Nandā, who dispels the distress of the bowed, / whose beauty arises from the lotus in her hand, who sits in the lotus posture with a lotus-face, holding a water-pot in her hand.

sanskrit_iast:
digvasanā vikṛtamukhā phetkāroddāma pūritadiśaughā ..
jayati vikarāladehā kṣemaṃkarī raudrabhāvasthā .. 15 ..
meaning:
दिग्वसना विकृतमुखा फेत्कारोद्दाम पूरितदिशौघा ..
जयति विकरालदेहा क्षेमंकरी रौद्रभावस्था .. 15 ..
text_mt: Victorious is Kṣemaṅkarī, clad in the directions, with a distorted face, filling the hosts of quarters with unrestrained howling, / of dreadful body, abiding in a furious mood.

sanskrit_iast:
krośitabrahmāṃḍodarasuravaramukharahuṃkṛtaninādā ..
jayati madātimihastā śivadūtī prathamaśivaśaktiḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
क्रोशितब्रह्मांडोदरसुरवरमुखरहुंकृतनिनादा ..
जयति मदातिमिहस्ता शिवदूती प्रथमशिवशक्तिः .. 16 ..
text_mt: Victorious is Śivadūtī, the primordial power of Śiva, holding […] in her hand, / who roars through the belly of the universe, noisy with the bellows of the foremost gods.

sanskrit_iast:
muktāṭṭahāsabhairavaduḥsahataracakitasakaladikcakrā ..
jayati bhujagendramaṇiśobhitakarṇā mahātuṇḍā .. 17 ..
meaning:
मुक्ताट्टहासभैरवदुःसहतरचकितसकलदिक्चक्रा ..
जयति भुजगेन्द्रमणिशोभितकर्णा महातुण्डा .. 17 ..
text_mt: Victorious is Mahātuṇḍā, whose ears are adorned with the jewel of the king of serpents, / who frightens the entire circle of directions, unbearable and terrifying with her loose, loud laughter.

sanskrit_iast:
paṭupaṭahamurajamardalajhallarijhaṅkāranartitāvayavā ..
jayati madhuvratarūpā daityaharī bhrāmarī devī .. 18 ..
meaning:
पटुपटहमुरजमर्दलझल्लरिझङ्कारनर्तितावयवा ..
जयति मधुव्रतरूपा दैत्यहरी भ्रामरी देवी .. 18 ..
text_mt: Victorious is goddess Bhrāmarī, having the form of a black bee, destroyer of Daityas, / whose limbs dance to the sound of loud paṭaha drums, murajas, mardalas, and jhallarīs.

sanskrit_iast:
śāṃtā praśāṃtavadanā siṃhavarā dhyānayogata nniṣṭhā ..
jayati caturbhujadehā candrakalā candramaṇḍalā devī .. 19 ..
meaning:
शांता प्रशांतवदना सिंहवरा ध्यानयोगत न्निष्ठा ..
जयति चतुर्भुजदेहा चन्द्रकला चन्द्रमण्डला देवी .. 19 ..
text_mt: Victorious is the tranquil goddess, with a serene countenance, seated on an excellent lion, intent upon the practice of meditation, / having a four-armed body, a crescent moon, and the lunar disc.

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣapuṭacaṃcughātaiḥ saṃcūrṇitavividhaśatrusaṃghātā ..
jayati śitaśūlahastā bahurūpā revatī bhadrā ..4.61.20..
meaning:
पक्षपुटचंचुघातैः संचूर्णितविविधशत्रुसंघाता ..
जयति शितशूलहस्ता बहुरूपा रेवती भद्रा ..4.61.20..
text_mt: Victorious is auspicious Revatī of multiform shape, holding a sharp pike in her hand, / who crushes the hosts of various enemies with blows from her wings and beak.

sanskrit_iast:
paryaṭati jagati haṣṭā pitṛvananilayeṣu yoginīsahitā..
jayati harasiddhināmnī harasiddhirvaṃditā siddhaiḥ ..21..
meaning:
पर्यटति जगति हष्टा पितृवननिलयेषु योगिनीसहिता..
जयति हरसिद्धिनाम्नी हरसिद्धिर्वंदिता सिद्धैः ..21..
text_mt: Rejoicing, she wanders through the world accompanied by yoginīs in the abodes of cremation grounds; / victorious is Harasiddhi, named Harasiddhi, praised by the Siddhas."

sanskrit_iast:
iti navadurgāsaṃstavamanupamamāryābhirapararāṭ kṛtvā ..
idamūce saha devaistrāhyasmānsarvabhītibhyaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
इति नवदुर्गासंस्तवमनुपममार्याभिरपरराट् कृत्वा ..
इदमूचे सह देवैस्त्राह्यस्मान्सर्वभीतिभ्यः .. 22 ..
text_mt: Having thus made this peerless praise of the nine Durgās with Āryā verses, the king [of the gods] / along with the gods spoke this: "Protect us from all terrors!"

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥpunaḥ praṇamyocurbhavānīṃ siṃhavāhinīm ..
asmākaṃ bhayabhītānāṃ śaraṇye śaraṇaṃ bhava .. 23 ..
meaning:
पुनःपुनः प्रणम्योचुर्भवानीं सिंहवाहिनीम् ..
अस्माकं भयभीतानां शरण्ये शरणं भव .. 23 ..
text_mt: Bowing again and again, they said to Bhavānī, who rides a lion: / "To us who are terrified with fear, O refuge, be our refuge!"

sanskrit_iast:
devānāṃ tadvacaḥ śrutvā dattvā tebhyo'bhayaṃ tataḥ ..
siṃhārūḍhā vinirgatya durgābhiḥ sahitā purā .. 24 ..
meaning:
देवानां तद्वचः श्रुत्वा दत्त्वा तेभ्योऽभयं ततः ..
सिंहारूढा विनिर्गत्य दुर्गाभिः सहिता पुरा .. 24 ..
text_mt: Hearing that speech of the gods and granting them fearlessness, / mounted upon her lion, she then went forth anciently accompanied by the Durgās.

sanskrit_iast:
yuyudhe dānavaissārdhaṃ mahāsamaradurdinam ..
kumārī viṃśatibhujā ghanavidyullatopamā .. 25 ..
meaning:
युयुधे दानवैस्सार्धं महासमरदुर्दिनम् ..
कुमारी विंशतिभुजा घनविद्युल्लतोपमा .. 25 ..
text_mt: She fought together with the Dānavas on a stormy day of great battle, / a maiden with twenty arms, resembling a streak of lightning in a cloud.

sanskrit_iast:
te'pi tatrāsurāḥ prāptāḥ pracaṃḍā rudrarūpiṇaḥ ..
sarve labdhavarāḥ śūrāḥ sutaptatapasastathā .. 26 ..
meaning:
तेऽपि तत्रासुराः प्राप्ताः प्रचंडा रुद्ररूपिणः ..
सर्वे लब्धवराः शूराः सुतप्ततपसस्तथा .. 26 ..
text_mt: Those asuras too arrived there, furious, of terrible forms like Rudra, / all having obtained boons, heroic, and having performed intense austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāgrāhaparākrāṃtā duṣṭamāyāvinaṣṭaye ..
abrāhmaṇyāddhṛdyamiṣā nāmataśca nijodyatāt .. 27 ..
meaning:
महाग्राहपराक्रांता दुष्टमायाविनष्टये ..
अब्राह्मण्याद्धृद्यमिषा नामतश्च निजोद्यतात् .. 27 ..
text_mt: Possessed of the prowess of great monsters, for the destruction of wicked illusions, / [they marched forth,] designated by their own names [in battle]:

sanskrit_iast:
indramārī asatkleśaḥ pralaṃbo narakaḥ sutaḥ ..
kuṣṭhaḥ pulomā śarabha śaṃbaro duṃdubhiḥ kharaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
इन्द्रमारी असत्क्लेशः प्रलंबो नरकः सुतः ..
कुष्ठः पुलोमा शरभ शंबरो दुंदुभिः खरः .. 28 ..
text_mt: Indramārin, Asatkleśa, Pralamba, Naraka, Suta, / Kuṣṭha, Puloman, Śarabha, Śambara, Dundubhi, Khara,

sanskrit_iast:
ilvalo namucirbhaumo vātāpi dhenukaḥ kaliḥ ..
māyāvṛtau balau bandhurmadhukaiṭabhakālajit .. 29 ..
meaning:
इल्वलो नमुचिर्भौमो वातापि धेनुकः कलिः ..
मायावृतौ बलौ बन्धुर्मधुकैटभकालजित् .. 29 ..
text_mt: Ilvala, Namuci, Bhauma, Vātāpi, Dhenuka, Kali, / the two Balas wrapped in illusion, Bandhu, Madhu, Kaiṭabha, Kālajit,

sanskrit_iast:
rahaḥ pauṃḍūādidaityendrāḥ prādhānyena prakīrtitāḥ ..
phanagobhirjanāḥ sarve sannaddhāḥ svāgrato dhvajaḥ .. 4.61.30 ..
meaning:
रहः पौंडूआदिदैत्येन्द्राः प्राधान्येन प्रकीर्तिताः ..
फनगोभिर्जनाः सर्वे सन्नद्धाः स्वाग्रतो ध्वजः .. 4.61.30 ..
text_mt: Rahas, Pauṇḍra, and other lords of the Daityas are proclaimed as foremost. / All the men were armed […], with banners in front of them.

sanskrit_iast:
rūpato varṇitāścaiva dhvajāsteṣāṃ pṛthakpṛthak ..
pratyadṛśyaṃta rājendra jvalitā iva pāvakāḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
रूपतो वर्णिताश्चैव ध्वजास्तेषां पृथक्पृथक् ..
प्रत्यदृश्यंत राजेन्द्र ज्वलिता इव पावकाः .. 31 ..
text_mt: Their banners, described distinctively according to their form, / were seen, O lord of kings, blazing like fires:

sanskrit_iast:
kāñcanāḥ kāñcanā pīḍāḥ kāñcanasragalaṃkṛtāḥ ..
patākā vividhairvālairucchritā lakṣaṇānvitāḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
काञ्चनाः काञ्चना पीडाः काञ्चनस्रगलंकृताः ..
पताका विविधैर्वालैरुच्छ्रिता लक्षणान्विताः .. 32 ..
text_mt: golden, adorned with golden chaplets, decorated with golden garlands, / their flags raised high with various tufts of hair and marked with symbols,

sanskrit_iast:
nīlyaḥ pītāḥ sitā raktāḥ kṛṣṇāsrāḥ pañcavarṇakāḥ ..
tatra paṭṭapaṭīsautrāḥ kṛtabudbudakarburāḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
नील्यः पीताः सिता रक्ताः कृष्णास्राः पञ्चवर्णकाः ..
तत्र पट्टपटीसौत्राः कृतबुद्बुदकर्बुराः .. 33 ..
text_mt: blue, yellow, white, red, black, and five-colored; / there were banners made of silk, patterned with spots and variegated bubbles.

sanskrit_iast: patākākāntiranalā nartakya iva śobhanāḥ .. 34 ..
meaning: पताकाकान्तिरनला नर्तक्य इव शोभनाः .. 34 ..
text_mt: The brilliant banners were like beautiful dancing girls.

sanskrit_iast:
tato halahalārāvaṃ cakruste dānavottamāḥ ..
prāsphālayaṃta paṇavabherījharjharagomukhān ..
nyavādayaṃtānakānye śaṃkhāḍaṃbaraḍiṃḍimān .. 35 ..
meaning:
ततो हलहलारावं चक्रुस्ते दानवोत्तमाः ..
प्रास्फालयंत पणवभेरीझर्झरगोमुखान् ..
न्यवादयंतानकान्ये शंखाडंबरडिंडिमान् .. 35 ..
text_mt: Then those foremost Dānavas raised a loud shouting tumult; / they beat paṇavas, kettledrums, jharjharas, and gomukhas; / others sounded drums, conches, dundubhis, and ḍiṇḍimas.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ te samayudhyaṃta bhavānīṃ daityadānavāḥ ..
samājaghnuḥ śaraiḥ śūlaiḥ parighaiḥ śaktitomaraiḥ ..
karṇakairīṣaṇaiḥ kuntaiḥ śataghnīkūṭamudgaraiḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
एवं ते समयुध्यंत भवानीं दैत्यदानवाः ..
समाजघ्नुः शरैः शूलैः परिघैः शक्तितोमरैः ..
कर्णकैरीषणैः कुन्तैः शतघ्नीकूटमुद्गरैः .. 36 ..

बलात्कारेण दैत्यानामनाथसमरे रुषा .. 38 ..

text_mt: Having conquered those Asuras and gone to the enemy city that was won, the gods / saw great banners hanging at the edge of the battlefield; / overjoyed, they held a procession marked with banners on the navamī.

sanskrit_iast:
kumārī subhagā devī siṃhasyaṃndanagāminī ..

meaning:

मालतीकुसुमैर्द्दीपैर्गन्धधूपविलेपनैः .. 47 ..
text_mt: Having made diverse banners for the maiden, the fortunate Goddess who rides a lion-chariot, / one should worship before her / with jasmine flowers, lamps, perfumes, incenses, and ointments,

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:

text_mt: with offerings, with pure sacrificial beasts, wine, meat, blood, and garments, / with curd, sandalwood powder, and uncooked grains, / with this mantra, O son of Kuntī, or indeed with [the mantra] of Brahmā:

bhadrāṃ bhagavatīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ viśvasya jagato hitām ..

ulkānavamīvratavarṇanam

That man who, with a mind intent on worshipping the Goddess, raises on the navamī an excellent banner with a golden garland, / having abundantly attained the pleasures desired by his heart, on casting off his body, goes to the world of heroes.

pūjayitvā stavaṃ kuryānmantreṇānena mānavaḥ ..

meaning:
पूजयित्वा स्तवं कुर्यान्मन्त्रेणानेन मानवः ..
समारोप्याञ्जलिं मूर्ध्नि जानुभ्यामवनीं गतः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped her, a person should recite praise with this mantra, / placing folded hands upon the head, having fallen to the earth on both knees:

mahiṣaghni mahāmāye cāmuṇḍe muṇḍamālini ..
dravyamārogyavijayau dehi devi namo'stu te .. 5 ..

meaning:
कुमारीर्भोजयेत्पश्चान्नवनीलसुकंचुकैः..
परिधानैर्भूषणैश्च भूषयित्वा क्षमापयेत् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Then one should feed maidens, and having adorned [them] / with new blue bodices, garments, and ornaments, seek their pardon.

श्रद्धया तुष्यते देवी इति वीरानुशासनम् .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:
अभ्युक्ष्य मण्डलं कृत्वा गोमयेन शुचिस्मितः ..
दत्तासने चोपविशेत्पात्रं च पुरतो न्यसेत् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Having sprinkled water and made a sacred diagram with cow dung, smiling brightly, / one should sit on a seat provided and place a vessel in front.

सुवर्णं शक्तितो दद्याद्गां च विप्राय शोभनाम् .. 13 ..

meaning:
य एवं कुरुते पार्थ पुरुषो नवमीव्रतम् ..
न तस्य शत्रवो नार्तिः स राजा नष्टतस्करः .. 14 ..
text_mt: The man who thus performs this navamī votive observance, O son of Pṛthā, / has no enemies and no distress; [if] a king, his thieves are vanished.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācā no janayaṃti bhayaṃ gṛhe ..
samudyateṣu śastreṣu haṃtā tasya na vidyate .. 15 ..
meaning:
भूताः प्रेताः पिशाचा नो जनयंति भयं गृहे ..
समुद्यतेषु शस्त्रेषु हंता तस्य न विद्यते .. 15 ..
text_mt: Ghosts, pretas, and piśācas do not produce fear in his house; / when weapons are raised, there is no slayer of him.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ rakṣati sadodyuktā sarvāsvāpatsu caṃḍikā ..
naro vā yadi vā nārī vratametatsamācaret ..
ulkāvatsa sapatnānāṃ jvalannāste sadā hṛdi .. 16 ..
meaning:
तं रक्षति सदोद्युक्ता सर्वास्वापत्सु चंडिका ..
नरो वा यदि वा नारी व्रतमेतत्समाचरेत् ..
उल्कावत्स सपत्नानां ज्वलन्नास्ते सदा हृदि .. 16 ..
text_mt: Ever alert, Caṇḍikā protects him in all misfortunes; / if a man or a woman should perform this votive observance, / he ever dwells blazing like a meteor in the hearts of his rivals.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ śuṣkakoharamukhīṃ prakaṭorudaṃṣṭrāṃ kāpālinīṃ samavalaṃbitamuṇḍamālām ..
uktavrateṣu puruṣo navamīṣu caṇḍīṃ saṃpūjya kasya hṛdaye na ca śaṃ karoti.. 17 ..
daśāvatāracaritravratavarṇanam
meaning:
तां शुष्ककोहरमुखीं प्रकटोरुदंष्ट्रां कापालिनीं समवलंबितमुण्डमालाम् ..
उक्तव्रतेषु पुरुषो नवमीषु चण्डीं संपूज्य कस्य हृदये न च शं करोति.. 17 ..
दशावतारचरित्रव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Having worshipped that Caṇḍī whose face has hollow, withered cheeks, whose large fangs are exposed, who bears a skull-cup, and who has a hanging garland of severed heads, / on the navamīs during the prescribed votive observances, in whose heart does a man not produce dread?
Description of the Votive Observance on the Deeds of the Ten Avatāras

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
pūrvaṃ kṛtayugasyādau bhṛgorbhāryā mahāsatī ..
divyārāmāśrame ramyā gṛhakāryaikatatparā .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
पूर्वं कृतयुगस्यादौ भृगोर्भार्या महासती ..
दिव्यारामाश्रमे रम्या गृहकार्यैकतत्परा .. 1 ..
text_mt: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / Formerly, at the beginning of the Kṛta age, the wife of Bhṛgu, a most virtuous woman, / charming in the hermitage of Divyārāma, was devoted solely to household duties.
title: Daśāvatāracaritravratam

sanskrit_iast:
babhūva sā bhṛgornityaṃ hṛdayepsitakāriṇī ..
tasyāṃ munirmahātejā agnihotraṃ nidhāya ca .. 2 ..
meaning:
बभूव सा भृगोर्नित्यं हृदयेप्सितकारिणी ..
तस्यां मुनिर्महातेजा अग्निहोत्रं निधाय च .. 2 ..
text_mt: She continually carried out what was desired in Bhṛgu's heart. / Having placed his agnihotra fire with her, the sage of great splendour,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇostrāsāddānavānāṃ kulatrāṇasamākulam ..
muktvā yuddhasthitaṃ pārśve samarpya munipuṅgavaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
विष्णोस्त्रासाद्दानवानां कुलत्राणसमाकुलम् ..
मुक्त्वा युद्धस्थितं पार्श्वे समर्प्य मुनिपुङ्गवः .. 3 ..
text_mt: troubled for the protection of the race of the Dānavas out of fear of Viṣṇu, / after leaving them standing by in battle and entrusting them [to her], the foremost of sages,

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā nikṣepakaṃ sarvaṃ divyāyai sumahātapāḥ ...
jagāma himavatpārśve haraṃ toṣayituṃ rahaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वा निक्षेपकं सर्वं दिव्यायै सुमहातपाः ...
जगाम हिमवत्पार्श्वे हरं तोषयितुं रहः .. 4 ..
text_mt: having given over the whole deposit to Divyā, he of very great ascetic heat / went to the slope of Himavat in secret to propitiate Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃjīvanīkṛte nityaṃ kaṇairdhūmamadhomukhaḥ ..
papau dānavarājasya vijayāya purohitaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
संजीवनीकृते नित्यं कणैर्धूममधोमुखः ..
पपौ दानवराजस्य विजयाय पुरोहितः .. 5 ..
text_mt: Hanging head downwards, he continually drank smoke with specks [of fire] for the sake of the Saṃjīvanī [lore], / for the victory of the Dānava king, as his family priest.

sanskrit_iast:
ājagāma gate tasmingaruḍenāśrito hariḥ ..
abhyetya jalpanaṃ cakre cakraṇotkṛttakaṃdharam .. 6 ..
meaning:
आजगाम गते तस्मिन्गरुडेनाश्रितो हरिः ..
अभ्येत्य जल्पनं चक्रे चक्रणोत्कृत्तकंधरम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: When he had gone, Hari, mounted upon Garuḍa, arrived. / Approaching, he cut off the necks with his discus [even as] talk was made.

sanskrit_iast:
galadrudhirasaṃpannaṃ lohitārṇavavasaṃnibham ..
dṛṣṭvāsurabalaṃ sarvaṃ nihataṃ viṣṇunā tadā ..
divyā saṃśaptukāmābhūdviṣṇuṃ sāsrāvilekṣaṇā .. 7 ..
meaning:
गलद्रुधिरसंपन्नं लोहितार्णववसंनिभम् ..
दृष्ट्वासुरबलं सर्वं निहतं विष्णुना तदा ..
दिव्या संशप्तुकामाभूद्विष्णुं सास्राविलेक्षणा .. 7 ..
text_mt: Flowing with blood, resembling a red ocean, / seeing all the Asura army slain by Viṣṇu then, / Divyā, her eyes clouded with tears, wished to curse Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvannoccarate vācaṃ cakreṇa kṛttakaṃdharam ..
tāvannipātayāmāsa śirastasyāḥ sakuṇḍalam .. 8 ..
meaning:
यावन्नोच्चरते वाचं चक्रेण कृत्तकंधरम् ..
तावन्निपातयामास शिरस्तस्याः सकुण्डलम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Before she could utter a word, with his discus he severed her neck, / and struck down her head adorned with earrings.

sanskrit_iast:
prāpya saṃjīvanīṃ vidyāṃ yāvadāyātyasau muniḥ ..
tāvatsa daityānnāpaśyatpaśyati sma nipātitam .. 9 ..
meaning:
प्राप्य संजीवनीं विद्यां यावदायात्यसौ मुनिः ..
तावत्स दैत्यान्नापश्यत्पश्यति स्म निपातितम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: When that sage returned, having obtained the Saṃjīvanī lore, / he did not see the Daityas, [but] saw [her] struck down.

sanskrit_iast:
roṣācchaśāpa ca hariṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilānanaḥ ..
avaśyabhāvabhāvitvādviśvasya hitakāraṇāt .. 4.63.10 ..
meaning:
रोषाच्छशाप च हरिं भ्रुकुटीकुटिलाननः ..
अवश्यभावभावित्वाद्विश्वस्य हितकारणात् .. 4.63.10 ..
text_mt: And in his wrath, his face twisted in a frown, he cursed Hari / because it was destined to happen and for the sake of the welfare of the universe:

sanskrit_iast:
yasmāttvayā hatā daityā brahmaṇo matparigrahāḥ ..
tasmāttvaṃ mānuṣe loke daśa vārāngamiṣyasi .. 11 ..
meaning:
यस्मात्त्वया हता दैत्या ब्रह्मणो मत्परिग्रहाः ..
तस्मात्त्वं मानुषे लोके दश वारान्गमिष्यसि .. 11 ..
text_mt: “Since you have slain the Daityas and a brahmin woman under my protection, / therefore you shall go ten times into the mortal world.”

sanskrit_iast:
ato'rthaṃ mānuṣe loke rakṣārthaṃ ca mahīkṣitām..
avatāraṃ cakārāhaṃ bhūyobhūyaḥ pṛthagvidham .. 12 .....
meaning:
अतोऽर्थं मानुषे लोके रक्षार्थं च महीक्षिताम्..
अवतारं चकाराहं भूयोभूयः पृथग्विधम् .. 12 .....
text_mt: For this reason, and for the protection of the rulers of the earth, in the mortal world / I made descent again and again in various forms.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvoktaiḥ kāraṇaiḥ pārtha avatīrṇaṃ mahītale ..
māṃ narā ye'rcayiṣyaṃti teṣāṃ vāsastriviṣṭape .. 13 ..
meaning:
पूर्वोक्तैः कारणैः पार्थ अवतीर्णं महीतले ..
मां नरा येऽर्चयिष्यंति तेषां वासस्त्रिविष्टपे .. 13 ..
text_mt: Those men who will worship me, descended upon the surface of the earth / for the reasons declared previously, O son of Pṛthā, will have their dwelling in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
vrataṃ daśāvatārākhyaṃ kṛṣṇa brūhi savistaram ..
samaṃtraṃ sarahasyaṃ ca sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 14 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
व्रतं दशावताराख्यं कृष्ण ब्रूहि सविस्तरम् ..
समंत्रं सरहस्यं च सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / O Kṛṣṇa, tell in detail of the votive observance called the Ten Avatāras, / with its mantras and secrets, which destroys all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
proṣṭhapade site pakṣe daśamyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ ..
snātvā jalāśaye svacche pitṛdevāditarpaṇam.. 15 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
प्रोष्ठपदे सिते पक्षे दशम्यां नियतः शुचिः ..
स्नात्वा जलाशये स्वच्छे पितृदेवादितर्पणम्.. 15 ..
text_mt: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / In the month of Proṣṭhapada, in the bright fortnight, on the tenth [lunar day], restrained and pure, / having bathed in a clear body of water and made libations to the ancestors, gods, and others,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā kurukulaśreṣṭha gṛhamāgatya mānavaḥ ..
gṛhṇīyāddhānyacūrṇasya dvihastaprasṛti trayam .. 16 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा कुरुकुलश्रेष्ठ गृहमागत्य मानवः ..
गृह्णीयाद्धान्यचूर्णस्य द्विहस्तप्रसृति त्रयम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: having done [so], O best of Kuru's line, a man, having come home, / should take three double handfuls of grain flour.

sanskrit_iast:
krameṇa pāvayettāṃ tu puṃsaṃjñaṃ ghṛtasaṃśritam ..
varṣe varṣe dine tasminyāvadvarṣāṇi vai daśa .. 17 ..
meaning:
क्रमेण पावयेत्तां तु पुंसंज्ञं घृतसंश्रितम् ..
वर्षे वर्षे दिने तस्मिन्यावद्वर्षाणि वै दश .. 17 ..
text_mt: He should cook it in order, [an offering] called male, mixed with ghee, / year after year on that day, for ten years.

sanskrit_iast:
prathame pūrikānvarṣe dvitīye ghṛtapūrakān ..
tṛtīye śuklakāsāraṃ caturthe modakāñchubhān .. 18 ..
meaning:
प्रथमे पूरिकान्वर्षे द्वितीये घृतपूरकान् ..
तृतीये शुक्लकासारं चतुर्थे मोदकाञ्छुभान् .. 18 ..
text_mt: In the first year [he offers] pūrikās, in the second ghṛtapūrakas, / in the third white kāsāra, in the fourth auspicious modakas,

sanskrit_iast:
sohālakānpañcame'bde ṣaṣṭhe'bde khaṇḍaveṣṭakān ..
saptame'bde kokarasānapūpāṃśca tathāṣṭame .. 19 ..
meaning:
सोहालकान्पञ्चमेऽब्दे षष्ठेऽब्दे खण्डवेष्टकान् ..
सप्तमेऽब्दे कोकरसानपूपांश्च तथाष्टमे .. 19 ..
text_mt: in the fifth year sohālakas, in the sixth year khaṇḍaveṣṭakas, / in the seventh year kokarasas, and in the eighth apūpas,

sanskrit_iast:
navame karṇaveṣṭāṃstu daśame khaṇḍakāñchubhān ..
daśa dhenūrdaśahare daśaviprāya dāpayet .. 4.63.20 ..
meaning:
नवमे कर्णवेष्टांस्तु दशमे खण्डकाञ्छुभान् ..
दश धेनूर्दशहरे दशविप्राय दापयेत् .. 4.63.20 ..
text_mt: in the ninth karṇaveṣṭas, and in the tenth auspicious khaṇḍakas. / On Daśaharā he should give ten cows to ten brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
krameṇa bhakṣayitvā ca yathoktaṃ bharatarṣabha ..
arddhārddhaṃ piṣṭayedevamarddhārddhaṃ vā dvijātaye ..
svata evārdhamaśnīyādgatvā ramye jalāśaye .. 21 ..
meaning:
क्रमेण भक्षयित्वा च यथोक्तं भरतर्षभ ..
अर्द्धार्द्धं पिष्टयेदेवमर्द्धार्द्धं वा द्विजातये ..
स्वत एवार्धमश्नीयाद्गत्वा रम्ये जलाशये .. 21 ..
text_mt: Having eaten in proper order as prescribed, O bull of the Bharatas, / he should give half the dough to the deity, or half to a twice-born, / and he should eat half himself, having gone to a charming body of water.

sanskrit_iast:
daśāvatārānabhyarcya puṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ ..
maṃtreṇānena medhāvī harimabhyukṣya vāriṇā .. 22 ..
meaning:
दशावतारानभ्यर्च्य पुष्पधूपविलेपनैः ..
मंत्रेणानेन मेधावी हरिमभ्युक्ष्य वारिणा .. 22 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped the ten avatāras with flowers, incense, and ointments, / the wise man, having sprinkled Hari with water by means of this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
matsyaṃ kūrmaṃ varāhaṃ ca narasiṃhaṃ trivikramam ..
śrīrāmaṃ rāma kṛṣṇau ca buddhaṃ caiva sakalkinam .. 23 ..
meaning:
मत्स्यं कूर्मं वराहं च नरसिंहं त्रिविक्रमम् ..
श्रीरामं राम कृष्णौ च बुद्धं चैव सकल्किनम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: “The Fish, the Tortoise, the Boar, the Man-Lion, Trivikrama, / Śrī Rāma, Rāma and Kṛṣṇa, the Buddha, and Kalkin—

sanskrit_iast:
gato'smi śaraṇaṃ devaṃ hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ..
praṇato'smi jagannāthaṃ sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu .. 24 ..
meaning:
गतोऽस्मि शरणं देवं हरिं नारायणं प्रभुम् ..
प्रणतोऽस्मि जगन्नाथं स मे विष्णुः प्रसीदतु .. 24 ..
text_mt: I have gone for refuge to the god Hari, the lord Nārāyaṇa; / I am bowed down to the lord of the world; may that Viṣṇu be pleased with me.

sanskrit_iast:
chinattu vaiṣṇavīṃ māyāṃ bhaktyā jāto janardanaḥ ..
śvetadvīpaṃ nayasyasmānsamātmani nivedayet .. 25 ..
meaning:
छिनत्तु वैष्णवीं मायां भक्त्या जातो जनर्दनः ..
श्वेतद्वीपं नयस्यस्मान्समात्मनि निवेदयेत् .. 25 ..
text_mt: May Janārdana, who is born through devotion, cut away the Vaiṣṇava Māyā; / lead us to Śvetadvīpa!”—he should dedicate [this] within himself.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha vidhinānena suvrata ..
daśāvatāranāmākhyaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 26 ..
meaning:
एवं यः कुरुते पार्थ विधिनानेन सुव्रत ..
दशावतारनामाख्यं तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु .. 26 ..
text_mt: Hear the meritorious fruit, O son of Pṛthā, of him of good vows who performs / [the rite] named the Ten Avatāras in this manner according to the rule.

sanskrit_iast:
śrūyate yāstvimālocya puruṣāṇāṃ daśā daśa ..
tāśchinatti na saṃdehaḥ śakrapraharaṇairhariḥ .. .. 27 ..
meaning:
श्रूयते यास्त्विमालोच्य पुरुषाणां दशा दश ..
ताश्छिनत्ति न संदेहः शक्रप्रहरणैर्हरिः .. .. 27 ..
text_mt: Observing these ten states of men that are spoken of, / Hari cuts them down with Indra's weapons; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsārasāgare ghore majjata tatra māṃ hariḥ ..
śvetadvīpaṃ nayatvāśu vratenānena toṣitaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
संसारसागरे घोरे मज्जत तत्र मां हरिः ..
श्वेतद्वीपं नयत्वाशु व्रतेनानेन तोषितः .. 28 ..
text_mt: “Let Hari quickly lead me, sinking there in the terrible ocean of cyclic existence, / to Śvetadvīpa, pleased by this votive observance.”

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ tasya na bhavelloke yasya tuṣṭo janārdanaḥ ..
so'haṃ janārdano rājankālarūpī dharāsutaḥ ..
martyaloke svayaṃ pārtha bhūbhārottārakāraṇam .. 29 ..
meaning:
किं तस्य न भवेल्लोके यस्य तुष्टो जनार्दनः ..
सोऽहं जनार्दनो राजन्कालरूपी धरासुतः ..
मर्त्यलोके स्वयं पार्थ भूभारोत्तारकारणम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: What would there not be in the world for him with whom Janārdana is pleased? / I, that Janārdana, O king, am the son of the earth who has the form of Time, / myself in the mortal world, O son of Pṛthā, the cause of lifting the earth’s burden.

sanskrit_iast:
yā strī vratamidaṃ pārtha cariṣyati mayoditam ..
sā lakṣmyā'calayā yuktā bhartṛputrasamanvitā .. 4.63.30 ..
meaning:
या स्त्री व्रतमिदं पार्थ चरिष्यति मयोदितम् ..
सा लक्ष्म्याऽचलया युक्ता भर्तृपुत्रसमन्विता .. 4.63.30 ..
text_mt: Whatever woman shall perform this votive observance spoken by me, O son of Pṛthā, / endowed with steadfast fortune, accompanied by husband and sons,

sanskrit_iast:
martyaloke ciraṃ sthitvā viṣṇuloke mahīyate ..
viṣṇulokādrudralokaṃ tato yāti paraṃ padam .. 31 ..
meaning:
मर्त्यलोके चिरं स्थित्वा विष्णुलोके महीयते ..
विष्णुलोकाद्रुद्रलोकं ततो याति परं पदम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: after staying long in the mortal world, she is exalted in the realm of Viṣṇu; / from Viṣṇu's realm [she goes] to Rudra's realm, and from there she goes to the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
ye pūjayaṃti puruṣāḥ puruṣottamasya matsyādikāṃstu daśamīṣu daśāvatārān ..
martyā daśasvapi daśāsu sukhaṃ vihṛtya te yāṃti yānamadhiruhya sureśalokān .. 32 .. ..
āśādaśamīvarṇanam
meaning:
ये पूजयंति पुरुषाः पुरुषोत्तमस्य मत्स्यादिकांस्तु दशमीषु दशावतारान् ..
मर्त्या दशस्वपि दशासु सुखं विहृत्य ते यांति यानमधिरुह्य सुरेशलोकान् .. 32 .. ..
आशादशमीवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Those men who worship the ten avatāras of the Supreme Spirit, beginning with the Fish, on the tenth [lunar days], / having sported happily through all ten states of life, those mortals mount a celestial vehicle and go to the realms of the lord of the gods.
Description of the Āśādaśamī

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
pārtha pārthivavṛndānāṃ mukhapaṅkajasadrave ..
śṛṇuṣvāvahito vacmi tavāśādaśamīvratam .. .. 1..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
पार्थ पार्थिववृन्दानां मुखपङ्कजसद्रवे ..
शृणुष्वावहितो वच्मि तवाशादशमीव्रतम् .. .. 1..
text_mt: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / O son of Pṛthā, a sweet essence to the lotus faces of hosts of kings, / listen attentively; I will tell you of the Āśādaśamī votive observance.
title: Āśādaśamīvratam

sanskrit_iast:
nalanāmābhavatpūrvaṃ niṣadheṣu mahīpate ..
sa bhrātrā nirjito rājye puṣkareṇeti naḥ śrutam .. 2 ..
meaning:
नलनामाभवत्पूर्वं निषधेषु महीपते ..
स भ्रात्रा निर्जितो राज्ये पुष्करेणेति नः श्रुतम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: Formerly among the Niṣadhas there was a king named Nala, O lord of the earth; / he was defeated in his kingdom by his brother Puṣkara, so it is heard by us.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣairdyūtena rājendra niryayau bhāryayā saha ..
vanaṃ pratibhayaṃ śūnyaṃ jhillīkagaṇanāditam .. 3 ..
meaning:
अक्षैर्द्यूतेन राजेन्द्र निर्ययौ भार्यया सह ..
वनं प्रतिभयं शून्यं झिल्लीकगणनादितम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Defeated at dice, O lord of kings, he set out with his wife / for the fearful, deserted forest resounding with swarms of crickets.

sanskrit_iast:
sa gatvā pratyahorātraṃ jalamātreṇa vartayan ..
dadarśa vanamadhyasthāñchakunīnkāṃcanacchavīn .. 4 ..
meaning:
स गत्वा प्रत्यहोरात्रं जलमात्रेण वर्तयन् ..
ददर्श वनमध्यस्थाञ्छकुनीन्कांचनच्छवीन् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Having gone, subsisting day and night on water alone, / he saw birds of golden hue in the midst of the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
grahītumicchaṃstānrājansamācchādya svavāsasā ..
khamāpetuḥ khagāstūrṇaṃ gṛhītvā vasanaṃ śubham ..5..
meaning:
ग्रहीतुमिच्छंस्तान्राजन्समाच्छाद्य स्ववाससा ..
खमापेतुः खगास्तूर्णं गृहीत्वा वसनं शुभम् ..5..
text_mt: Wishing to catch them, O king, having covered them with his own garment, / the birds quickly flew up into the sky, carrying off his fine garment.

sanskrit_iast:
āsasāda samāḥ kāściddhṛtavāsāḥ suduḥkhitaḥ..
damayaṃtīṃ samāprāpya nidrayāpahṛtāṃ tadā ..
duḥkhādutsṛjya gatavānbhāgyataḥ prāgdhaneśvaram .. 5 ..
meaning:
आससाद समाः काश्चिद्धृतवासाः सुदुःखितः..
दमयंतीं समाप्राप्य निद्रयापहृतां तदा ..
दुःखादुत्सृज्य गतवान्भाग्यतः प्राग्धनेश्वरम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Deeply sorrowful, with his garment taken, he endured some years; / having reached Damayantī who was then overcome with sleep, / he abandoned her out of grief and went away, through fate, toward Kuvera.

sanskrit_iast:
gate tu naiṣadhe bhaimī prabuddhai vāñcitānanā..
apaśyaṃtī nalaṃ vīraṃ vīra bhīmasutā vane ..
itaścetaśca babhrāma hāheti rudatī muhuḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
गते तु नैषधे भैमी प्रबुद्धै वाञ्चितानना..
अपश्यंती नलं वीरं वीर भीमसुता वने ..
इतश्चेतश्च बभ्राम हाहेति रुदती मुहुः .. 7 ..
text_mt: When the lord of the Niṣadhas had gone, the daughter of Bhīma awoke, her face dejected; / not seeing the heroic Nala in the forest, O hero, the daughter of Bhīma / wandered here and there, weeping repeatedly, crying “Alas! Alas!”

sanskrit_iast:
duḥkhaśokasamākrāṃtā naladarśanalālasā ..
āsasāda dine kaiścitsā caidyapuramaṃjasā .. 8 ..
meaning:
दुःखशोकसमाक्रांता नलदर्शनलालसा ..
आससाद दिने कैश्चित्सा चैद्यपुरमंजसा .. 8 ..
text_mt: Overcome with sorrow and grief, yearning for the sight of Nala, / she reached in a few days the city of the Cedis directly.

sanskrit_iast:
unmattavatparivṛtā śiśubhiḥ kautukākulaiḥ ..
sā dṛṣṭā cedirājasya jananyā janaveṣṭitā ..9..
meaning:
उन्मत्तवत्परिवृता शिशुभिः कौतुकाकुलैः ..
सा दृष्टा चेदिराजस्य जनन्या जनवेष्टिता ..9..
text_mt: Surrounded like a madwoman by children overcome with curiosity, / encircled by the people, she was seen by the mother of the Cedi king.

sanskrit_iast:
candralekheva patitā bhūmau bhāsitadiṅmukhā ..
āropya sā svabhavanaṃ pṛṣṭā kā tvaṃ varānane .. 4.64.10 ..
meaning:
चन्द्रलेखेव पतिता भूमौ भासितदिङ्मुखा ..
आरोप्य सा स्वभवनं पृष्टा का त्वं वरानने .. 4.64.10 ..
text_mt: Like a crescent of the moon fallen upon the earth, illumining the directions, / she was brought up to her own palace and asked: “Who are you, fair-faced one?”

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca bhaimī savrīḍaṃ sairaṃdhrīṃ māṃ nibodhatām ..
na dhāvayeyaṃ caraṇau nocchiṣṭaṃ bhakṣayāmyaham .. 11 ..
meaning:
उवाच भैमी सव्रीडं सैरंध्रीं मां निबोधताम् ..
न धावयेयं चरणौ नोच्छिष्टं भक्षयाम्यहम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: The daughter of Bhīma spoke with shame: “Know me to be a sairaṃdhrī. / I will not wash [another’s] feet, nor do I eat table scraps.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi prārthayate kaściddaṃḍyaste sāṃprataṃ bhavet ..
pratijñayānayā devi tiṣṭheyaṃ tava veśmani ..
evamastvanavadyāṃgi rāja mātāpyuvāca tām .. 12 ..
meaning:
यदि प्रार्थयते कश्चिद्दंड्यस्ते सांप्रतं भवेत् ..
प्रतिज्ञयानया देवि तिष्ठेयं तव वेश्मनि ..
एवमस्त्वनवद्यांगि राज माताप्युवाच ताम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: If anyone solicits me, he must presently be punished by you. / On this promise, O queen, I would stay in your house.” / “So be it, O faultless-limbed one,” the king’s mother said to her.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃvidhā tadbhavane kaṃcitkālamaniṃditā ..
uvāsa vasanārddhena pravṛttāṃte kila dvijaḥ ..
ānayāmāsa mudito damayaṃtīṃ gṛhaṃ pituḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
एवंविधा तद्भवने कंचित्कालमनिंदिता ..
उवास वसनार्द्धेन प्रवृत्तांते किल द्विजः ..
आनयामास मुदितो दमयंतीं गृहं पितुः .. 13 ..
text_mt: Being of such a disposition, she, blameless, for some time / lived in her palace wearing half a garment, until, upon learning the situation, a twice-born man / brought Damayantī with joy to her father’s house.

sanskrit_iast:
mātrā pitrā samāyuktā sutairbhrātṛbhireva ca ..
damayaṃtī tathāpyāste duḥkhaṃ naiṣadhavarjitā .. 14 ..
meaning:
मात्रा पित्रा समायुक्ता सुतैर्भ्रातृभिरेव च ..
दमयंती तथाप्यास्ते दुःखं नैषधवर्जिता .. 14 ..
text_mt: Reunited with her mother, her father, her sons, and her brothers, / Damayantī nevertheless remained in sorrow, bereft of the Naiṣadha.

sanskrit_iast:
provāca vimanāhūya vrataṃ dānamathāpi vā ..
kathayadhvaṃ yathā me syādiṣṭena saha saṃgamaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
प्रोवाच विमनाहूय व्रतं दानमथापि वा ..
कथयध्वं यथा मे स्यादिष्टेन सह संगमः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Depressed, she summoned [the priests] and said: “A votive observance or a gift, / declare to me, by which I might attain reunion with my beloved.”

sanskrit_iast:
tatretihāsakuśalo vipraḥ provāca buddhimān ..
bhadre tvamāśādaśamīṃ kuruṣvepsitasiddhidām .. 16 ..
meaning:
तत्रेतिहासकुशलो विप्रः प्रोवाच बुद्धिमान् ..
भद्रे त्वमाशादशमीं कुरुष्वेप्सितसिद्धिदाम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: Thereupon a wise brāhmaṇa, skilled in traditional history, spoke: / “O auspicious lady, perform the Āśādaśamī, which grants the attainment of desired ends.”

sanskrit_iast:
cakāra sarvaṃ tanvaṃgī yatpurāṇavidā tadā ..
khyātamākhyānaviduṣā damanena purodhasā .. 17 ..
meaning:
चकार सर्वं तन्वंगी यत्पुराणविदा तदा ..
ख्यातमाख्यानविदुषा दमनेन पुरोधसा .. 17 ..
text_mt: The slender-bodied lady performed everything that was then related / by the royal priest Damana, the knower of the Purāṇas and expert in ancient tales.

sanskrit_iast:
vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa damayaṃtyā narottama ..
saṃjātaḥ sukhado'tyarthaṃ bharttrā saha samāgamaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
व्रतस्यास्य प्रभावेण दमयंत्या नरोत्तम ..
संजातः सुखदोऽत्यर्थं भर्त्त्रा सह समागमः .. 18 ..
text_mt: By the power of this votive observance, O best of men, / for Damayantī an exceedingly joyous reunion with her husband took place.

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kathamāśādaśamyeṣā govinda kriyate kadā ..
sarvametatsamācakṣva māṃ sarvajñosi yādava .. 19 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
कथमाशादशम्येषा गोविन्द क्रियते कदा ..
सर्वमेतत्समाचक्ष्व मां सर्वज्ञोसि यादव .. 19 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / How is this Āśādaśamī performed, Govinda, and when? / Tell me all of this; you are omniscient, O Yādava.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
rājyāśayā rājaputraḥ kṛṣyarthaṃ tu kṛṣīvalaḥ ..
bhāryārthaṃ tu vaṇikputraḥ putrārthe gurviṇī tathā .. 4.64.20 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
राज्याशया राजपुत्रः कृष्यर्थं तु कृषीवलः ..
भार्यार्थं तु वणिक्पुत्रः पुत्रार्थे गुर्विणी तथा .. 4.64.20 ..
text_mt: The holy Kṛṣṇa said: / A prince desiring kingdom, a farmer for the sake of farming, / a merchant’s son for the sake of a wife, and likewise a pregnant woman for the sake of a son,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmārthakāmasaṃsiddhayai lokakanyā varārthinī ..
yaṣṭukāmo dvijavaro rogī rogāpanuttaye .. 21 ..
meaning:
धर्मार्थकामसंसिद्धयै लोककन्या वरार्थिनी ..
यष्टुकामो द्विजवरो रोगी रोगापनुत्तये .. 21 ..
text_mt: an ordinary maiden seeking a bridegroom for the fulfillment of virtue, wealth, and pleasure, / an eminent twice-born wishing to sacrifice, a sick person for the removal of disease,

sanskrit_iast:
cirapravāsite kāṃte kālena dhṛtipaṃḍitā ..
eteṣvanyeṣu kartavyamāśāvratamidaṃ sadā .. 22 ..
meaning:
चिरप्रवासिते कांते कालेन धृतिपंडिता ..
एतेष्वन्येषु कर्तव्यमाशाव्रतमिदं सदा .. 22 ..
text_mt: and [a woman] wise in steadfastness when her beloved has long been abroad— / this Āśāvrata must always be performed in these and other circumstances.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā yasya bhavedārtaṃ kāryate hi tadā vratam ..
śuklapakṣe daśamyāṃ tu snātvā saṃpūjya devatāḥ ..23..
meaning:
यदा यस्य भवेदार्तं कार्यते हि तदा व्रतम् ..
शुक्लपक्षे दशम्यां तु स्नात्वा संपूज्य देवताः ..23..
text_mt: Whenever someone has distress, then indeed the votive observance should be performed. / Having bathed on the tenth [lunar day] in the bright fortnight and worshipped the deities,

sanskrit_iast:
naktaṃ tadāśāḥ saṃpūjyāḥ puṣpālaktakacandanaiḥ ..
gṛhāṅgaṇe lekhayitvā yavaiḥ piṣṭātakena vā ..
dattvā ghṛtāktaṃ naivedyaṃ punaḥ kāryaṃ nivedayet ..24..
meaning:
नक्तं तदाशाः संपूज्याः पुष्पालक्तकचन्दनैः ..
गृहाङ्गणे लेखयित्वा यवैः पिष्टातकेन वा ..
दत्त्वा घृताक्तं नैवेद्यं पुनः कार्यं निवेदयेत् ..24..
text_mt: the quarters are then to be worshipped at night with flowers, red lac, and sandalpaste, / having drawn them in the courtyard of the house with barley or with fragrant powder; / having offered a food-offering smeared with ghee, one should again submit one's purpose:

sanskrit_iast:
āśāścāśāḥ sadā saṃtu vidyaṃtāṃ ca manorathāḥ..
bhavatīnāṃ prasādena sadā kalyāṇamastviti ..25..
meaning:
आशाश्चाशाः सदा संतु विद्यंतां च मनोरथाः..
भवतीनां प्रसादेन सदा कल्याणमस्त्विति ..25..
text_mt: “May the quarters always be full of hope, and may desires be realized! / By your grace, may there always be auspiciousness!”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃpūjya bhuñjīta dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām..
anena kramayogena māsimāsi samācaret..26..
meaning:
एवं संपूज्य भुञ्जीत दत्त्वा विप्राय दक्षिणाम्..
अनेन क्रमयोगेन मासिमासि समाचरेत्..26..
text_mt: Having thus worshipped, one should eat, having given a priestly fee to a brāhmaṇa. / In this orderly sequence, one should perform it month after month,

sanskrit_iast:
yāvanmanorathaḥ pūrṇastataḥ paścātsamudyamāt ..
māsi pūrṇe ca ṣaṇmāse varṣe varṣadvaye gate..27..
meaning:
यावन्मनोरथः पूर्णस्ततः पश्चात्समुद्यमात् ..
मासि पूर्णे च षण्मासे वर्षे वर्षद्वये गते..27..
text_mt: until the desire is fulfilled; thereafter, from diligent effort, / when a month has completed, or six months, a year, or two years have passed,

sanskrit_iast:
sauvarṇāḥ kārayedāśā raupyapiṣṭātakena vā..
jñātibaṃdhujanaiḥ sārddhaṃ snātaḥ samyagalaṃkṛtaḥ ..28..
meaning:
सौवर्णाः कारयेदाशा रौप्यपिष्टातकेन वा..
ज्ञातिबंधुजनैः सार्द्धं स्नातः सम्यगलंकृतः ..28..
text_mt: one should cause [images of] the quarters to be made of gold, or of silver and fragrant powder. / Bathed and well adorned along with relatives and kin,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayenmaṃtrasaṃdarbhairebhirdhyātvā gṛhāṃgaṇe...
tava saṃnihitaḥ śakraḥ surāsuranamaskṛtaḥ ..
pūrvā candreṇa sahitā aindrīdigdevate namaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
पूजयेन्मंत्रसंदर्भैरेभिर्ध्यात्वा गृहांगणे...
तव संनिहितः शक्रः सुरासुरनमस्कृतः ..
पूर्वा चन्द्रेण सहिता ऐन्द्रीदिग्देवते नमः .. 29 ..
text_mt: one should worship, meditating in the courtyard of the house with these compositions of mantras: / “Śakra, reverenced by gods and asuras, is present near you. / O Eastern, Aindrī, deity of the direction accompanied by the Moon, obeisance to you.

sanskrit_iast:
agneḥ parigrahādārye tvamāgneyīti paṭhyase ..
tejomayī parā śaktirāgneyī varadā bhava .. 4.64.30 ..
meaning:
अग्नेः परिग्रहादार्ये त्वमाग्नेयीति पठ्यसे ..
तेजोमयी परा शक्तिराग्नेयी वरदा भव .. 4.64.30 ..
text_mt: Because of being accepted by Agni, O noble lady, you are declared to be Āgneyī. / Embodied in splendor, supreme energy, Āgneyī, be a giver of boons!

sanskrit_iast:
devarājaṃ samāsādya lokaḥ saṃyamayatyasau ..
tena saṃyamanī yāsi yāmye kāmapradā bhava .. 31 ..
meaning:
देवराजं समासाद्य लोकः संयमयत्यसौ ..
तेन संयमनी यासि याम्ये कामप्रदा भव .. 31 ..
text_mt: Reaching the king of the gods, this world restrains itself; / therefore you who are Saṃyamanī in the south, be a granter of desires!

sanskrit_iast:
khaḍgaṃsahātivikṛtā nairṛtistvamupābhṛtā ..
tena nairṛtanāmnītvaṃ kṛtavānmaghavā sadā .. 32 ..
meaning:
खड्गंसहातिविकृता नैरृतिस्त्वमुपाभृता ..
तेन नैरृतनाम्नीत्वं कृतवान्मघवा सदा .. 32 ..
text_mt: Bearing a sword, exceedingly fierce, you are Nairṛtī, approached [with fear]; / therefore Maghavan has always made you bear the name Nairṛtā.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayyāste bhavanādhāravaruṇo yādasāṃ patiḥ ..
iṣṭakāmārthasiddhyarthaṃ vāruṇiprabhavā bhava .. 33 ..
meaning:
त्वय्यास्ते भवनाधारवरुणो यादसां पतिः ..
इष्टकामार्थसिद्ध्यर्थं वारुणिप्रभवा भव .. 33 ..
text_mt: In you dwells Varuṇa, the support of the world, the lord of aquatic creatures; / for the fulfillment of desired wishes, be auspicious, O Vāruṇī!

sanskrit_iast:
adhiśritāsi yasmāttvaṃ vāyunā jagadāyunā..
vāyavye tvamataḥ śāntiṃ nityaṃ yaccha namonamaḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
अधिश्रितासि यस्मात्त्वं वायुना जगदायुना..
वायव्ये त्वमतः शान्तिं नित्यं यच्छ नमोनमः .. 34 ..
text_mt: Because you are inhabited by Vāyu, the life-breath of the world, / therefore, O Vāyavī, grant perpetual peace; salutations, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
kuberavāsataḥ saumyā prakhyātā tvamathottarā ..
aiśānī jagadīśena śaṃbhunā tvamalaṃkṛtā ..
atastvaṃ śivasānnidhyaṃ devi dehi śive namaḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
कुबेरवासतः सौम्या प्रख्याता त्वमथोत्तरा ..
ऐशानी जगदीशेन शंभुना त्वमलंकृता ..
अतस्त्वं शिवसान्निध्यं देवि देहि शिवे नमः .. 35 ..
text_mt: From the dwelling of Kubera, you are renowned as the gentle Northern [quarter]. / O Aiśānī, you are adorned by Śambhu, the lord of the universe; / therefore, O goddess, grant the proximity of Śiva; O Śivā, obeisance to you!

sanskrit_iast:
sarpāṣṭakakulena tvaṃ sevitāsi tathāpyadhaḥ ..
nāgāṃganābhiḥ sahitā hitā naḥ sarvadā bhava .. 36 ..
meaning:
सर्पाष्टककुलेन त्वं सेवितासि तथाप्यधः ..
नागांगनाभिः सहिता हिता नः सर्वदा भव .. 36 ..
text_mt: You are served below also by the lineage of the eight serpents; / accompanied by nāga maidens, be always beneficial to us!

sanskrit_iast:
saptalokaiḥ parigatā sarvadā tvaṃ śivā yataḥ ..
sanakādyaiḥ parivṛtā brāhmī jihmānapākuru .. 37 ..
meaning:
सप्तलोकैः परिगता सर्वदा त्वं शिवा यतः ..
सनकाद्यैः परिवृता ब्राह्मी जिह्मानपाकुरु .. 37 ..
text_mt: Since you are encompassed by the seven worlds, always auspicious, / surrounded by Sanaka and the others, O Brāhmī, banish crookedness!

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvāṇi grahāstārāgrahāstathā ..
nakṣatramātaro ye ca bhūtapretavināyakāḥ ..
sarve mameṣṭasiddhyarthe bhavaṃtu praṇatāḥ sadā .. 38 ..
meaning:
नक्षत्राणि च सर्वाणि ग्रहास्ताराग्रहास्तथा ..
नक्षत्रमातरो ये च भूतप्रेतविनायकाः ..
सर्वे ममेष्टसिद्ध्यर्थे भवंतु प्रणताः सदा .. 38 ..
text_mt: And all the lunar mansions, the planets, and likewise the planetary stars, / and whichever are the mother-stars, ghosts, pretas, and vināyakas— / may all of them always be bowed down for the fulfillment of my desired end.”

sanskrit_iast:
ebhirmaṃtraiḥ samabhyarcya puṣpadhūpādinā tataḥ ..
vāsobhirabhisaṃsthāpya phalāni vinivedayet.. 39 ..
meaning:
एभिर्मंत्रैः समभ्यर्च्य पुष्पधूपादिना ततः ..
वासोभिरभिसंस्थाप्य फलानि विनिवेदयेत्.. 39 ..
text_mt: Having thoroughly worshipped with these mantras using flowers, incense, and other articles, / then having covered them with garments, one should present fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
tattūryadhvanighoṣeṇa gatimaṅgalaniḥsvanaiḥ ..
nṛtyatībhirvarastrībhistāṃ rātrimativāhayet .. 4.64.40 ..
meaning:
तत्तूर्यध्वनिघोषेण गतिमङ्गलनिःस्वनैः ..
नृत्यतीभिर्वरस्त्रीभिस्तां रात्रिमतिवाहयेत् .. 4.64.40 ..
text_mt: With the roar of the sound of those musical instruments, with the sounds of auspicious songs, / and with excellent women dancing, one should pass that night.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṃkumakṣodatīvreṇa dānamānādibhiḥ sukham ..
prabhāte vedaviduṣe sarvaṃ tatpratipādayet .. 41 ..
meaning:
कुंकुमक्षोदतीव्रेण दानमानादिभिः सुखम् ..
प्रभाते वेदविदुषे सर्वं तत्प्रतिपादयेत् .. 41 ..
text_mt: Pleasantly, with the sharp fragrance of saffron powder, and with gifts, honors, and so forth, / at dawn one should bestow all that upon a knower of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā sarvaṃ kṣamayanpraṇipatya ca ..
bhuñjīta mitrasahitaḥ suhṛdbaṃdhujanairapi .. 42 ..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना सर्वं क्षमयन्प्रणिपत्य च ..
भुञ्जीत मित्रसहितः सुहृद्बंधुजनैरपि .. 42 ..
text_mt: According to this rule, begging pardon of all and bowing down, / one should eat along with friends, well-wishers, and relatives.

sanskrit_iast:
ya evaṃ kurute pārtha daśamīvratamādarāt ..
sa sarvakāmamāpnoti manasābhīpsitaṃ naraḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
य एवं कुरुते पार्थ दशमीव्रतमादरात् ..
स सर्वकाममाप्नोति मनसाभीप्सितं नरः .. 43 ..
text_mt: Whoever performs the Daśamīvrata thus with devotion, O son of Pṛthā, / that person attains every wish desired by the mind.

sanskrit_iast:
strībhirviśeṣataḥ kāryaṃ vratametadyudhiṣṭhira ..
laghucittā yato nāryaḥ sadā kāmaparāyaṇāḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
स्त्रीभिर्विशेषतः कार्यं व्रतमेतद्युधिष्ठिर ..
लघुचित्ता यतो नार्यः सदा कामपरायणाः .. 44 ..
text_mt: This votive observance is especially to be performed by women, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / because women are fickle-minded and always intent upon desires.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam ..
kathitaṃ te mahārāja mayā vratamanuttamam .. 45 ..
meaning:
धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् ..
कथितं ते महाराज मया व्रतमनुत्तमम् .. 45 ..
text_mt: Bestowing fortune, fame, and longevity, yielding the fruit of all desires, / this supreme votive observance has been related to you by me, O great king.

sanskrit_iast:
ye mānavā manujapuṅgava kāmakāmāḥ saṃpūjayaṃti daśamīṣu sadā daśāśāḥ ..
teṣāṃ viśeṣanihitā hṛdaye prakāmamāśāḥ phalaṃtyalamalaṃ bahunoditena .. 46 ..
tārakadvādaśīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
ये मानवा मनुजपुङ्गव कामकामाः संपूजयंति दशमीषु सदा दशाशाः ..
तेषां विशेषनिहिता हृदये प्रकाममाशाः फलंत्यलमलं बहुनोदितेन .. 46 ..
तारकद्वादशीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Those men desirous of their wishes, O bull among men, who always worship the ten directions on the tenth [lunar days], / the hopes especially placed within their hearts bear fruit in full measure; enough, enough of speaking at length!
Description of the Tārakadvādaśīvrata.

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
ahaṃ tvāgaskaraḥ pāpaḥ pṛthivīkṣayakārakaḥ ..
paripṛcchāmi govinda tvāṃ namaskṛtya pādayoḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
अहं त्वागस्करः पापः पृथिवीक्षयकारकः ..
परिपृच्छामि गोविन्द त्वां नमस्कृत्य पादयोः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / I am a wrongdoer, a sinner, the cause of the destruction of the earth; / bowing at your feet, Govinda, I ask you:
title: Tārakadvādaśīvratam

sanskrit_iast:
guhyādguhyataraṃ brūhi vrataṃ kiṃcidanuttamam..
tarāmi yena pāpaughaṃ bhīṣmadroṇavadhārṇavam .. 2 ..
meaning:
गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं ब्रूहि व्रतं किंचिदनुत्तमम्..
तरामि येन पापौघं भीष्मद्रोणवधार्णवम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: Speak of some supreme votive observance, more secret than the secret, / by which I may cross over the flood of sin, the ocean of slaying Bhīṣma and Droṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
āsītpurottaro nāmnā vidarbhāyāṃ kuśadhvajaḥ ..
sāṃtaḥpurasuto yaśca cakre rājyamataṃdritaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
आसीत्पुरोत्तरो नाम्ना विदर्भायां कुशध्वजः ..
सांतःपुरसुतो यश्च चक्रे राज्यमतंद्रितः .. 3 ..
text_mt: The venerable Kṛṣṇa said: / In the past, in Vidarbhā, there was an excellent [king] named Kuśadhvaja, / who, having an inner apartment and sons, ruled his kingdom without indolence.

sanskrit_iast:
jaghāna tāpasaṃ so'tha pramādānmṛgayāṃ gataḥ ..
mṛgaṃ matvā mahāraṇye brāhmaṇaṃ daivamohitaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
जघान तापसं सोऽथ प्रमादान्मृगयां गतः ..
मृगं मत्वा महारण्ये ब्राह्मणं दैवमोहितः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Then, having gone hunting, bewildered by fate, he struck down an ascetic / in the great forest, mistaking the brāhmaṇa for a deer.

sanskrit_iast:
tena karmavipākena dehāṃte narakaṃ gataḥ ..
tatrāsau yātanā ghorā anubhūyātipīḍitaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
तेन कर्मविपाकेन देहांते नरकं गतः ..
तत्रासौ यातना घोरा अनुभूयातिपीडितः .. 5 ..
text_mt: By that ripening of karma, he went to hell at the end of his body. / There, having experienced terrible torment, severely afflicted,

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādihāgato martye raudro viṣadharo'bhavat..
adaśatso'pi rājendra brāhmaṇaṃ caraṇe ruṣā .. 6 ..
meaning:
तस्मादिहागतो मर्त्ये रौद्रो विषधरोऽभवत्..
अदशत्सोऽपि राजेन्द्र ब्राह्मणं चरणे रुषा .. 6 ..
text_mt: he came here to the mortal realm from that [hell] and became a fierce venomous serpent. / O best of kings, he too bit a brāhmaṇa on the foot in rage.

sanskrit_iast:
labdhvā saha ca paṃcatvaṃ jagāma dvijasaṃyutaḥ ..
vipannastu tataḥ siṃho dvitīye'bhūtsudāruṇaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
लब्ध्वा सह च पंचत्वं जगाम द्विजसंयुतः ..
विपन्नस्तु ततः सिंहो द्वितीयेऽभूत्सुदारुणः .. 7 ..
text_mt: Meeting his dissolution together with the twice-born, he died; / and having perished, he then became an exceedingly fierce lion in his second [birth],

sanskrit_iast:
vidāritamukho hiṃsro nānāsattvabhayaṃkaraḥ ..
jaghānāsau punaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ rājanyaṃ mṛgayā gatam .. 8 ..
meaning:
विदारितमुखो हिंस्रो नानासत्त्वभयंकरः ..
जघानासौ पुनः श्रेष्ठं राजन्यं मृगया गतम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: with an open maw, violent, terrifying to various living beings. / He again killed an excellent kṣatriya who had gone hunting.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'pi bahubhiḥ śastrai rājalokairnipātitaḥ ..
punarvyāghro babhūvāsau tṛtīye'pi bhavāṃtare .. 9 ..
meaning:
ततोऽपि बहुभिः शस्त्रै राजलोकैर्निपातितः ..
पुनर्व्याघ्रो बभूवासौ तृतीयेऽपि भवांतरे .. 9 ..
text_mt: Then he too was brought down with many weapons by the king's men. / He became a tiger again in his third rebirth,

sanskrit_iast:
tīkṣṇapādanakhāghātavyāpāditamṛgānvayaḥ ..
tenāpi vaiśyo nidhanaṃ nītaḥ kiñcidvanāṃtaram .. 4.65.10 ..
meaning:
तीक्ष्णपादनखाघातव्यापादितमृगान्वयः ..
तेनापि वैश्यो निधनं नीतः किञ्चिद्वनांतरम् .. 4.65.10 ..
text_mt: destroying herds of deer with the blows of his sharp claws. / By him, too, a vaiśya was brought to his death deep in the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
sa nītaḥ kṛmirāśitvaṃ lokaiḥ khātanipātanāt ..
saṃjātastu mahānṛkṣo nakharāhatajaṃturuk .. 11 ..
meaning:
स नीतः कृमिराशित्वं लोकैः खातनिपातनात् ..
संजातस्तु महानृक्षो नखराहतजंतुरुक् .. 11 ..
text_mt: He was reduced to a heap of worms by people through being cast into a pit. / He was then born as a great bear, bringing pain to creatures struck by his claws.

sanskrit_iast:
jaghāna bālaṃ caṇḍālādasau mṛtyumavāpnuyāt ..
pañcame makaro jātaḥ samudre' tibhayaṃkaraḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
जघान बालं चण्डालादसौ मृत्युमवाप्नुयात् ..
पञ्चमे मकरो जातः समुद्रे' तिभयंकरः .. 12 ..
text_mt: He killed a boy, [and] met his death at the hands of an outcaste. / In his fifth [birth] he was born as an exceedingly terrifying crocodile in the ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
striyaṃ jaghāna taruṇīṃ snātukāmāmathāgatām ..
prabhāte śaṅkarasyāgre śaśāṅkagrahaṇe niśi .. 13 ..
meaning:
स्त्रियं जघान तरुणीं स्नातुकामामथागताम् ..
प्रभाते शङ्करस्याग्रे शशाङ्कग्रहणे निशि .. 13 ..
text_mt: He killed a young woman who had come wishing to bathe / at dawn before Śaṅkara on the night of a lunar eclipse.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpi baḍiśaṃ dattvā janaiḥ prāṇairviyojitaḥ ..
punaḥ ṣaṣṭhe bhave jātaḥ piśācaḥ piśitāśanaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
तत्रापि बडिशं दत्त्वा जनैः प्राणैर्वियोजितः ..
पुनः षष्ठे भवे जातः पिशाचः पिशिताशनः .. 14 ..
text_mt: There, too, struck with a hook, he was deprived of his life by men. / Then in his sixth birth he was born as a flesh-eating piśāca,

sanskrit_iast:
krūraśchidraparaḥ kṣudro naraprāṇaviyojakaḥ ..
so'vatīrṇo narasyāṃgaṃ karṣayāmāsa kasyacit .. 15 ..
meaning:
क्रूरश्छिद्रपरः क्षुद्रो नरप्राणवियोजकः ..
सोऽवतीर्णो नरस्यांगं कर्षयामास कस्यचित् .. 15 ..
text_mt: cruel, intent on others' weaknesses, vile, taking human lives. / Having descended, he tormented the body of a certain man.

sanskrit_iast:
maṃtreṇāhūya siddhena vātikena vyasuḥ kṛtaḥ ..
saptame sa punarjāto durnirīkṣyavapurbhṛśam.. 16 ..
meaning:
मंत्रेणाहूय सिद्धेन वातिकेन व्यसुः कृतः ..
सप्तमे स पुनर्जातो दुर्निरीक्ष्यवपुर्भृशम्.. 16 ..
text_mt: Summoned with an accomplished mantra, he was rendered lifeless by a sorcerer. / In his seventh [birth] he was born again with a body exceedingly hideous to behold,

sanskrit_iast:
krūradaṃṣdraḥ karālāsyo māṃsaśoṇitabhojanaḥ ..
digvāsā marubhūmīṣu vāśiṣṭho brahmarākṣasaḥ ..17..
meaning:
क्रूरदंष्द्रः करालास्यो मांसशोणितभोजनः ..
दिग्वासा मरुभूमीषु वाशिष्ठो ब्रह्मराक्षसः ..17..
text_mt: with cruel fangs, a terrifying face, feeding on flesh and blood, / naked, roaming in desert lands, a brahmarākṣasa sprung from Vasiṣṭha's lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
sa rāṣṭraṃ jarjaraṃ śūnyaṃ sarvaṃ cakre viṣādiṣu ..
ākramya bhīmadāsena rājñā rākṣasaśatruṇā .. 18..
meaning:
स राष्ट्रं जर्जरं शून्यं सर्वं चक्रे विषादिषु ..
आक्रम्य भीमदासेन राज्ञा राक्षसशत्रुणा .. 18..
text_mt: He made the entire realm shattered and desolate among the afflicted. / Assailed by King Bhīmadāsa, a foe of rākṣasas,

sanskrit_iast:
samāropya dhanuḥ saṃkhye brahmāstreṇa nipātitaḥ ..
bhūyo'bhavadvyāghrasamaḥ svajanmanyaṣṭame bhuvi ..19..
meaning:
समारोप्य धनुः संख्ये ब्रह्मास्त्रेण निपातितः ..
भूयोऽभवद्व्याघ्रसमः स्वजन्मन्यष्टमे भुवि ..19..
text_mt: who strung his bow in battle, he was brought down with the Brahmā weapon. / Again, he became like a tiger in his eighth birth on earth.

sanskrit_iast:
vanecarāṇāṃ kruddhāṅgo brāhmaṇānnidhanaṃ gataḥ ..
tato hastī ca bhallūko mātaṃgena dhanuṣmatā .. 4.65.20 ..
meaning:
वनेचराणां क्रुद्धाङ्गो ब्राह्मणान्निधनं गतः ..
ततो हस्ती च भल्लूको मातंगेन धनुष्मता .. 4.65.20 ..
text_mt: Enraged against forest-dwellers, he met his death from a brāhmaṇa. / Then an elephant, and [next] a bear [killed] by a hunter equipped with a bow.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśe'pi pāñcālo bhavamadhye'pi bhīṣaṇaḥ ..
ūrdhvakeśoti raktākṣo jāto hrasvatanurdṛḍhaḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
एकादशेऽपि पाञ्चालो भवमध्येऽपि भीषणः ..
ऊर्ध्वकेशोति रक्ताक्षो जातो ह्रस्वतनुर्दृढः .. 21 ..
text_mt: In his eleventh [birth], terrifying even amidst existence, [he was born in] Pañcāla, / with bristling hair, intensely red eyes, a short and sturdy body,

sanskrit_iast:
pāpo dharmadhvajo rakṣo devatojjhitamālyadhṛka ..
sa daṇḍapāśikenaiva vṛkṣāgre hyavalaṃbitaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
पापो धर्मध्वजो रक्षो देवतोज्झितमाल्यधृक ..
स दण्डपाशिकेनैव वृक्षाग्रे ह्यवलंबितः .. 22 ..
text_mt: wicked, an ostentatiously pious rakṣas, wearing garlands cast off from deities. / He was indeed hanged from the top of a tree by the royal executioner.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśe sa punarjātaḥ puṣkalakleśabhājanaḥ ..
bhakṣyalobhādbilagato vyādhena vinipātitaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
द्वादशे स पुनर्जातः पुष्कलक्लेशभाजनः ..
भक्ष्यलोभाद्बिलगतो व्याधेन विनिपातितः .. 23 ..
text_mt: In his twelfth [birth] he was born again as an abode of abundant suffering; / entering a hole out of greed for food, he was slain by a hunter.

sanskrit_iast:
tena cāsītkṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ tārakadvādaśīvratam ..
tasya prabhāvājāto'pi duṣṭayonau punaḥpunaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
तेन चासीत्कृतं पूर्वं तारकद्वादशीव्रतम् ..
तस्य प्रभावाजातोऽपि दुष्टयोनौ पुनःपुनः .. 24 ..
text_mt: And by him the tārakadvādaśī votive observance had been performed formerly. / By the power of that, even though he was born again and again in evil wombs,

sanskrit_iast:
avāpa śīghraṃ paṃcatvaṃ saṃsārabhavasāgare ..
punarevābhavadrājā vidarbhāyāṃ sudhārmikaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
अवाप शीघ्रं पंचत्वं संसारभवसागरे ..
पुनरेवाभवद्राजा विदर्भायां सुधार्मिकः .. 25 ..
text_mt: he quickly met dissolution in the ocean of transmigratory existence. / He then became an exceedingly righteous king again in Vidarbhā,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyaścopoṣitā tena tārakadvādaśī śubhā ..
dṛśyatāṃ vratamāhātmyaṃ jātojātaḥ punaḥpunaḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
भूयश्चोपोषिता तेन तारकद्वादशी शुभा ..
दृश्यतां व्रतमाहात्म्यं जातोजातः पुनःपुनः .. 26 ..
text_mt: and the auspicious tārakadvādaśī was observed as a fast by him once more. / Behold the greatness of the votive observance! Though born again and again,

sanskrit_iast:
vrataprabhāvādbhuvane bhuktvā rājyamakaṇṭakam ..
prāpa viṣṇupure sthānaṃ yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 27 ..
meaning:
व्रतप्रभावाद्भुवने भुक्त्वा राज्यमकण्टकम् ..
प्राप विष्णुपुरे स्थानं यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: by the power of the votive observance, having enjoyed an unhindered kingdom in the world, / he attained an abode in the realm of Viṣṇu until the dissolution of all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kathametadvrataṃ kṛṣṇa kartavyaṃ puruṣottamaiḥ ..
strībhirvā bhartṛvākyena snānadānajapādikam .. 28 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
कथमेतद्व्रतं कृष्ण कर्तव्यं पुरुषोत्तमैः ..
स्त्रीभिर्वा भर्तृवाक्येन स्नानदानजपादिकम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / How should this votive observance, consisting of bathing, giving, recitation and so forth, / be performed by excellent men, O Kṛṣṇa, or by women at the command of their husbands?

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe gṛhītvā dvādaśīvratam ..
akṛtrime jale snānamaparāhṇe samācaret .. .. 29 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
मार्गशीर्षे सिते पक्षे गृहीत्वा द्वादशीव्रतम् ..
अकृत्रिमे जले स्नानमपराह्णे समाचरेत् .. .. 29 ..
text_mt: The venerable Kṛṣṇa said: / Having undertaken the dvādaśī votive observance in the bright fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa, / one should bathe in natural water in the afternoon.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya bhāskarāyātha kṛtvā devārcanaṃ tathā ..
homaśca tāvatsthātavyo yāvadastamito raviḥ .. 4.65.30 ..
meaning:
प्रणम्य भास्करायाथ कृत्वा देवार्चनं तथा ..
होमश्च तावत्स्थातव्यो यावदस्तमितो रविः .. 4.65.30 ..
text_mt: Having bowed to the sun and likewise performed the worship of the deities, / the oblation into fire should be maintained until the sun has set.

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhuktvā phalaiḥ puṣpairgandhadhūpa vilepanaiḥ ..
sajalaṃ sākṣataṃ kṛtvā sahiraṇyaṃ śubhaiḥ phalaiḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
ततो भुक्त्वा फलैः पुष्पैर्गन्धधूप विलेपनैः ..
सजलं साक्षतं कृत्वा सहिरण्यं शुभैः फलैः .. 31 ..
text_mt: Then, having eaten, [providing] with fruits, flowers, incense, fragrant unguents and ointments, / making [the offering] with water, unbroken grains, gold and auspicious fruits,

sanskrit_iast:
ramye tāmramaye pātre jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ gataḥ ..
pūrvāmukhaḥ pradoṣāgre mūrdhni kṛtvārghyabhājanam .. 32 ..
meaning:
रम्ये ताम्रमये पात्रे जानुभ्यां धरणीं गतः ..
पूर्वामुखः प्रदोषाग्रे मूर्ध्नि कृत्वार्घ्यभाजनम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: in a lovely copper vessel, having gone to the earth on his knees, / facing east at the beginning of the evening twilight, placing the vessel of arghya on his head,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmau tu maṃḍalaṃ kṛtvā gomayena satārakam ..
caṃdanena samālikhya dhruvaṃ hi gaganonmukhaḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
भूमौ तु मंडलं कृत्वा गोमयेन सतारकम् ..
चंदनेन समालिख्य ध्रुवं हि गगनोन्मुखः .. 33 ..
text_mt: having made a diagram on the ground with cow dung together with the stars, / having drawn the Pole Star with sandalwood, looking up toward the sky,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraśīrṣāmaṃtreṇa bhūmau śaktyā śanaiḥ svayam ..
tārakāṇāṃ kuruśreṣṭha dadyādarghyamataṃdritaḥ ..34..
meaning:
सहस्रशीर्षामंत्रेण भूमौ शक्त्या शनैः स्वयम् ..
तारकाणां कुरुश्रेष्ठ दद्यादर्घ्यमतंद्रितः ..34..
text_mt: with the Sahasraśīrṣā mantra, slowly by himself according to his ability on the ground, / O best of the Kurus, he should unweariedly offer the arghya to the stars.

sanskrit_iast:
paryukṣya dhūmamutkṣipya dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇām ..
krameṇa sarvaṃ nirvartya bhojyaṃ bhojyaṃ niśāgame ..35..
meaning:
पर्युक्ष्य धूममुत्क्षिप्य दद्याद्विप्राय दक्षिणाम् ..
क्रमेण सर्वं निर्वर्त्य भोज्यं भोज्यं निशागमे ..35..
text_mt: Having sprinkled water, having offered incense, he should give a priestly gift to a brāhmaṇa. / Having carried out everything in order, he should take his food at the arrival of night:

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśīrṣe khaṃḍakhādyaṃ pauṣe sohālakaṃ tathā ..
tilataṃḍulakaṃ māghe guḍāpūpaṃ ca phālgune ..36..
meaning:
मार्गशीर्षे खंडखाद्यं पौषे सोहालकं तथा ..
तिलतंडुलकं माघे गुडापूपं च फाल्गुने ..36..
text_mt: candied sweets in Mārgaśīrṣa, and likewise sohālaka pastry in Pauṣa; / sesame and rice in Māgha, and jaggery-cakes in Phālguna;

sanskrit_iast:
modakāṃścaitramāse tu vaiśākhe khaṃḍaveṣṭakam ..
jyeṣṭhe saktubhṛtaiḥ pātrairāṣāḍhe guḍapūrikaiḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
मोदकांश्चैत्रमासे तु वैशाखे खंडवेष्टकम् ..
ज्येष्ठे सक्तुभृतैः पात्रैराषाढे गुडपूरिकैः .. 37 ..
text_mt: sweetmeats (modakas) in the month of Caitra, candied sweet rolls in Vaiśākha; / vessels filled with roasted barley meal in Jyeṣṭha, and jaggery-filled puris in Āṣāḍha;

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvaṇe madhuśīrṣeṇa nabhasye pāyasena ca ..
ghṛtaparṇaiścāśvayuje kāṃsāraiḥ kārttike kramān .. 38 ..
meaning:
श्रावणे मधुशीर्षेण नभस्ये पायसेन च ..
घृतपर्णैश्चाश्वयुजे कांसारैः कार्त्तिके क्रमान् .. 38 ..
text_mt: with honey-sweets in Śrāvaṇa, and with milk-rice pudding in Nabhasya; / with ghee-leaf cakes in Āśvayuja, and kāṃsāra sweetmeats in Kārttika, in succession.

sanskrit_iast:
ebhirdvādaśabhirvarṣairbhojayitvā dvijānsvayam ..
bhuñjīta bhaktyā rājendra paścāddevaṃ kṣamāpayet .. 39 ..
meaning:
एभिर्द्वादशभिर्वर्षैर्भोजयित्वा द्विजान्स्वयम् ..
भुञ्जीत भक्त्या राजेन्द्र पश्चाद्देवं क्षमापयेत् .. 39 ..
text_mt: Having himself fed twice-born men for these twelve years, / he should eat with devotion, O best of kings, and afterwards ask forgiveness of the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
samāpte tu vrate kṛtvā rājataṃ tārakāgaṇam ..
dṛṣṭvā vā pūrvavidhinā pūjayitvā kṣamāpayet .. 4.65.40 ..
meaning:
समाप्ते तु व्रते कृत्वा राजतं तारकागणम् ..
दृष्ट्वा वा पूर्वविधिना पूजयित्वा क्षमापयेत् .. 4.65.40 ..
text_mt: When the votive observance is completed, having fashioned the cluster of stars in silver, / or having seen it, having worshipped according to the former rule, he should ask forgiveness.

sanskrit_iast:
kumbhā dvādaśa dātavyāḥ sodakā modakāśritāḥ ..
brāhmaṇyāṃ paridhānaṃ ca padmarāgaḥ sakuṃcakaḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
कुम्भा द्वादश दातव्याः सोदका मोदकाश्रिताः ..
ब्राह्मण्यां परिधानं च पद्मरागः सकुंचकः .. 41 ..
text_mt: Twelve jars filled with water and accompanied by modakas should be given, / and a garment, along with a ruby and a bodice, to a brāhmaṇa's wife;

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇe valgulallāṭaṃ lakṣapuṣpopaśobhitam ..
cālakenopavītaṃ ca puṣpaṃ dattvā kṣamāpayet .. 42 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणे वल्गुलल्लाटं लक्षपुष्पोपशोभितम् ..
चालकेनोपवीतं च पुष्पं दत्त्वा क्षमापयेत् .. 42 ..
text_mt: and to a brāhmaṇa, a lovely turban adorned with a hundred thousand flowers, / a fine sieve, a sacred thread, and flowers, and having given [these], he should ask forgiveness.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā rājanyaḥ karoti vrataṃ naraḥ ..
nārī vā bharataśreṣṭha bhaktibhāvapuraḥsarā .. 43 ..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना राजन्यः करोति व्रतं नरः ..
नारी वा भरतश्रेष्ठ भक्तिभावपुरःसरा .. 43 ..
text_mt: A man who performs the votive observance according to this rule, O king, / or a woman, O best of the Bharatas, preceded by a state of devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatralokaṃ vrajati vimānenārkavarcasā ..
apsarogaṇagandharvayakṣavidyādharāmaraiḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
नक्षत्रलोकं व्रजति विमानेनार्कवर्चसा ..
अप्सरोगणगन्धर्वयक्षविद्याधरामरैः .. 44 ..
text_mt: goes to the world of the stars by a celestial chariot as radiant as the sun, / [accompanied] by hosts of apsarases, gandharvas, yakṣas, vidyādharas, and gods.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrabharttā svarloke pūjyamāno divākaraiḥ..
vasetkalpāyutaṃ yāvatpunarviṣṇupuraṃ vrajet .. 45 ..
meaning:
सहस्रभर्त्ता स्वर्लोके पूज्यमानो दिवाकरैः..
वसेत्कल्पायुतं यावत्पुनर्विष्णुपुरं व्रजेत् .. 45 ..
text_mt: Honoured by suns in the heavenly realm as a master of thousands, / he would dwell there for myriad kalpas, and then return to the realm of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
etadvrataṃ purā cīrṇaṃ śacyā rājñyā śriyomayā ..
sītayā damayaṃtyā ca rukmiṇyā satyabhāmayā .. 46 ..
meaning:
एतद्व्रतं पुरा चीर्णं शच्या राज्ञ्या श्रियोमया ..
सीतया दमयंत्या च रुक्मिण्या सत्यभामया .. 46 ..
text_mt: This votive observance was formerly undertaken by Śacī the queen, by Śrī, by Umā, / by Sītā, Damayantī, Rukmiṇī, and Satyabhāmā;

sanskrit_iast:
menayā raṃbhayā svarge urvaśyā devadattayā ..
anyābhirapi nārībhiḥ puruṣaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
मेनया रंभया स्वर्गे उर्वश्या देवदत्तया ..
अन्याभिरपि नारीभिः पुरुषैश्च पृथग्विधैः .. 47 ..
text_mt: by Menā, Rambhā in heaven, Urvaśī, and Devadattā; / and by other women too, and various men.

sanskrit_iast: cīrṇametadvrataṃ pārtha sarvapāpabhayāpaham .. 48 ..
meaning: चीर्णमेतद्व्रतं पार्थ सर्वपापभयापहम् .. 48 ..
text_mt: This votive observance, removing all sins and fears, was practiced, O son of Pṛthā.

sanskrit_iast:
janmāṃtareṣvapi kṛtāni haratyaghāni yā saṃdahatyaharahaḥ sukṛtopayogāt ..
sā dvādaśī jagati tārakanāmadheyā tannāsti yanna vidadhāti kṛtā manuṣyaiḥ .. 49 ..
araṇyadvādaśīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
जन्मांतरेष्वपि कृतानि हरत्यघानि या संदहत्यहरहः सुकृतोपयोगात् ..
सा द्वादशी जगति तारकनामधेया तन्नास्ति यन्न विदधाति कृता मनुष्यैः .. 49 ..
अरण्यद्वादशीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
That which removes sins committed even in other lifetimes, which burns them away day after day through the use of meritorious deeds— / that is the dvādaśī named Tārakā in this world; there is nothing it does not accomplish when performed by human beings.
Description of the Araṇyadvādaśī Votive Observance

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
bhagavanbrūhi me samyagaraṇyadvādaśīvratam ..
saprāśanaṃ sopavāsaṃ sarahasyaṃ samantrakam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
भगवन्ब्रूहि मे सम्यगरण्यद्वादशीव्रतम् ..
सप्राशनं सोपवासं सरहस्यं समन्त्रकम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / O Blessed One, tell me properly about the votive observance of the Araṇyadvādaśī, / with its consumption [of food], its fast, its secret [instructions], and its mantras.
title: Saṃvāderaṇyadvādaśīvratam

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
kauṃteya yatpurā cīrṇaṃ sītayā vanasaṃsthayā ..
vrataṃ rāghavavākyena praśastaṃ doṣavarjitam .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
कौंतेय यत्पुरा चीर्णं सीतया वनसंस्थया ..
व्रतं राघववाक्येन प्रशस्तं दोषवर्जितम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / O son of Kuntī, this votive observance, which was formerly undertaken by Sītā while living in the forest / at the instruction of Rāghava, is praised and free of faults.

sanskrit_iast:
lopāmudrālaye sādhvyo munipatnyo bahuprajāḥ ..
bhojitāstarpitāḥ sarvairāhāraiḥ sarvakāmikaiḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
लोपामुद्रालये साध्व्यो मुनिपत्न्यो बहुप्रजाः ..
भोजितास्तर्पिताः सर्वैराहारैः सर्वकामिकैः .. 3 ..
text_mt: In the hermitage of Lopāmudrā, virtuous wives of sages having many children / were fed and satisfied with all kinds of foods fulfilling all desires,

sanskrit_iast:
padminīpatravistīrṇe sopadaṃśai ryathā navaiḥ ..
bhakṣyabhojyaistathā lehyaiścoṣyaiścāpi yadṛcchayā .. 4 ..
meaning:
पद्मिनीपत्रविस्तीर्णे सोपदंशै र्यथा नवैः ..
भक्ष्यभोज्यैस्तथा लेह्यैश्चोष्यैश्चापि यदृच्छया .. 4 ..
text_mt: spread out upon lotus leaves, with fresh condiments, / with confectionery, staple foods, licked dishes, and sucked delicacies, as desired.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmihaikamanāḥ pārthaḥ śṛṇuṣvāraṇyadvādaśīm ..
mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe ekādaśyāṃ dinodaye .. 5 ..
meaning:
तामिहैकमनाः पार्थः शृणुष्वारण्यद्वादशीम् ..
मार्गशीर्षे सिते पक्षे एकादश्यां दिनोदये .. 5 ..
text_mt: Hear about that Araṇyadvādaśī here with a single mind, O son of Pṛthā: / In the bright fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa, on the ekādaśī, at sunrise,

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā naraḥ sopavāsaḥ kṛtvā pūjāṃ janārdane ..
gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatairdhūpairdīpairjāgaraṇairniśām ..6..
meaning:
स्नात्वा नरः सोपवासः कृत्वा पूजां जनार्दने ..
गंधपुष्पाक्षतैर्धूपैर्दीपैर्जागरणैर्निशाम् ..6..
text_mt: a man should bathe, observe a fast, and perform worship to Janārdana / with perfumes, flowers, unhusked barley grains, incense, and lamps, passing the night in a vigil.

sanskrit_iast:
nītvā prabhāte gatvā ca vane vedāṅgapāragān ..
bhojayitvā phalaprāyaṃ svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
नीत्वा प्रभाते गत्वा च वने वेदाङ्गपारगान् ..
भोजयित्वा फलप्रायं स्वयं भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः .. 7 ..
text_mt: Having passed [the night], he should go into the forest at dawn, feed those who have mastered the Vedāṅgas / mostly with fruits, and then eat himself, restrained in speech.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcagavyaṃ prāśayitvā pūrvamevātha taddine ..
varṣamekaṃ śubhaṃ pūrṇa pārayitvā yudhiṣṭhira..8..
meaning:
पञ्चगव्यं प्राशयित्वा पूर्वमेवाथ तद्दिने ..
वर्षमेकं शुभं पूर्ण पारयित्वा युधिष्ठिर..8..
text_mt: Having first consumed the five products of the cow on that day, / and having completed one full auspicious year [of the rite], O Yudhiṣṭhira,

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvaṇe kārttike māghe caitre vātha samarcite ..
sopadaṃśaiḥ patraśākaistilaśaṣkulikādibhiḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
श्रावणे कार्त्तिके माघे चैत्रे वाथ समर्चिते ..
सोपदंशैः पत्रशाकैस्तिलशष्कुलिकादिभिः .. 9 ..
text_mt: in Śrāvaṇa, Kārttika, Māgha, or Caitra, when [the Lord] has been properly worshipped, / with condiments, leafy vegetables, sesame cakes, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
apūpaiḥ khaṇḍaveṣṭaiśca marīcaiḥ siṃhakesaraiḥ ..
dhūlīmukhai ramṛtaphalaiḥ svādukokarasaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 4.66.10 ..
meaning:
अपूपैः खण्डवेष्टैश्च मरीचैः सिंहकेसरैः ..
धूलीमुखै रमृतफलैः स्वादुकोकरसैः शुभैः .. 4.66.10 ..
text_mt: with flatbreads, sugar-wrapped cakes, black pepper, lion-mane savouries, / dhūlīmukha pastries, amṛta fruits, and sweet, auspicious wild mango juices;

sanskrit_iast:
ebhirdvādaśabhirmantrairnamaskārāṃtayojitaiḥ ..

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:
तस्मादेत्य महातेजाः पृथिव्यां नृपपूजिताः ..
मर्त्यलोके कीर्तिमंतः संभवंति नरोत्तमाः .. 25 ..
text_mt: Returning from there, endowed with great splendour, worshipped by kings on earth, / they are born as the best of men, renowned in the mortal world.

kulastriyaḥ prayacchaṃti kasyānnaṃ kā'tra devatā ..

किं व्रतं कृष्ण विख्यातमन्नं कस्यां तिथौ भवेत् .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / When the month of Śrāvaṇa has commenced and the dark fortnight has arrived, / on the ekādaśī, having purified oneself with auspicious waters infused with all medicinal herbs,

sanskrit_iast:

modakāṃśca tathā paṃca ghṛtapakvānsunirmalān .. 4 ..

माषचूर्णेन राजेन्द्र कुर्यादिंदुरिकाशनम् ..
मोदकांश्च तथा पंच घृतपक्वान्सुनिर्मलान् .. 4 ..
text_mt: O best of kings, one should make food of indurikās with black gram flour, / and likewise five very clean sweetmeat dumplings cooked in ghee,

sanskrit_iast:
naramekaikamuddiśya tato gatvā jalāśayam ..
duṣṭayādovirahitaṃ satoyaṃ jalajairyutam .. 5 ..

kṛtvā maṃḍalakaṃ vṛttaṃ piṣṭakādibhirarcitam .. 6 ..

कृत्वा मंडलकं वृत्तं पिष्टकादिभिरर्चितम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: on the charming sandy bank of that very [water], having purified the ground with cow-dung and the like, / and having drawn a circular diagram decorated with ground rice paste and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
carcitaṃ gaṃdhakusumairdhūpa dīpākṣatojjvalam ..
tatra caṃdraṃ likhedeva rohiṇyā sahitaṃ vibhum..
arcayecca sabhāryo vai mantreṇānena bhāvitaḥ ..7 ..
meaning:
चर्चितं गंधकुसुमैर्धूप दीपाक्षतोज्ज्वलम् ..
तत्र चंद्रं लिखेदेव रोहिण्या सहितं विभुम्..
अर्चयेच्च सभार्यो वै मन्त्रेणानेन भावितः ..7 ..
text_mt: anointed with perfumes and flowers, radiant with incense, lamps, and unhusked barley grains, / one should draw the Moon, the all-pervading deity, along with Rohiṇī there; / and accompanied by one's wife, absorbed in contemplation, one should worship [him] with this mantra:

mahāsati mahādevi saṃpādaya mamepsitam .. 8 ..
meaning:

महासति महादेवि संपादय ममेप्सितम् .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:

प्रीयतामिति मे देवी रोहिणी सहितप्रिया .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:

यावत्समस्तं तद्भुक्तं भुक्त्वा चांतस्तटे स्थितः .. 11 ..
text_mt: And he should then meditate in his mind upon Soma accompanied by Rohiṇī / while all that [gifted food] is eaten; and when [the brāhmaṇa] has eaten, he stands on the bank inside.

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: And having controlled [himself], while others reside [there], he should then give food accompanied by a sacrificial fee to a vipra; / he should formulate a resolve in words, / with devotion, according to his capacity, according to his disposition, and according to his wealth, in that manner.

वर्षेवर्षे विधानेन पार्थेदं रोहिणीव्रतम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Whatever man performs this, O king, or woman, or maiden, / year after year according to the injunction, O son of Pṛthā, this Rohiṇī-vrata,

gṛhāśrame śubhāṃ labdhvā putrapautrādisaṃtatim .. 14 ..
meaning:
इह लोके चिरं स्थित्वा धनधान्यसमाकुले ..
गृहाश्रमे शुभां लब्ध्वा पुत्रपौत्रादिसंततिम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: having remained long in this world filled with wealth and grain, / having obtained an auspicious lineage of sons, grandsons, and so forth in the householder's stage of life,

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:
ततः सुतीर्थे मरणं ततो ब्रह्मपुरं व्रजेत् ..
तस्माद्विष्णुपुरं पार्थ ततो रुद्रपुरं शुभम् ..15..
text_mt: then dies at a sacred bathing-place and then goes to the realm of Brahmā. / From that [he goes] to the realm of Viṣṇu, O son of Pṛthā, and then to the auspicious realm of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:

aviyogavratavarṇanam
