text_mt: And further, how has my sin been exhausted here, / such that you, a support to my hand, have arrived in this desolate forest? / And how are you satisfied with merely a mouthful, O you of auspicious vows?

sanskrit_iast:
kastvamasyāṃ sughorāyāmaṭavyāṃ tu kṛtālayaḥ ..
tametaṃ saṃśayaṃ chiṃdhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ mama .. 44 ..
meaning:
कस्त्वमस्यां सुघोरायामटव्यां तु कृतालयः ..
तमेतं संशयं छिंधि परं कौतूहलं मम .. 44 ..
text_mt: Who are you who have made your dwelling in this most dreadful forest? / Dispel this doubt of mine; great is my curiosity.”

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktaḥ sa vāṇijyā preto vacanamabravīta ..
śṛṇu bhadra pravakṣyāmi duṣkṛtaṃ karma cātmanaḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
एवमुक्तः स वाणिज्या प्रेतो वचनमब्रवीत ..
शृणु भद्र प्रवक्ष्यामि दुष्कृतं कर्म चात्मनः .. 45 ..
text_mt: Addressed thus by the merchant, the preta spoke these words: / “Listen, good sir; I shall tell of my own misdeeds.

sanskrit_iast:
śākale nagare ramye ahamāsaṃ sudurmatiḥ ..
vāṇijyāsaktitaḥ pūrvaṃ kālo nīto mayānagha .. 46 ..
meaning:
शाकले नगरे रम्ये अहमासं सुदुर्मतिः ..
वाणिज्यासक्तितः पूर्वं कालो नीतो मयानघ .. 46 ..
text_mt: In the charming city of Śākala, I was a very wicked-minded person; / in the past, my time was spent engrossed in trade, O sinless one.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanalobhānmayā tatra kadācicca pramādinā ..
na dattā bhikṣave bhikṣā tṛṣṇayā pīḍitāya ca .. 47 ..
meaning:
धनलोभान्मया तत्र कदाचिच्च प्रमादिना ..
न दत्ता भिक्षवे भिक्षा तृष्णया पीडिताय च .. 47 ..
text_mt: Out of greed for wealth, being heedless, at no time there / was alms given by me to a beggar or to one tormented by thirst.

sanskrit_iast:
prativeśe ca tatrāsīdbrāhmaṇo guṇavānmama ..
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge māsi bhādrapade tathā .. 48 ..
meaning:
प्रतिवेशे च तत्रासीद्ब्राह्मणो गुणवान्मम ..
श्रवणद्वादशीयोगे मासि भाद्रपदे तथा .. 48 ..
text_mt: And there was in my neighbourhood a virtuous brāhmaṇa. / In the month of Bhādrapada, on the conjunction of Śravaṇadvādaśī,

sanskrit_iast:
sa kadācinmayā sārdhaṃ toṣāṃ nāma nadīṃ yayau ..
tasyāśca saṃgamaḥ puṇyo yatrāsīccandrabhāgayā .. 49 ..
meaning:
स कदाचिन्मया सार्धं तोषां नाम नदीं ययौ ..
तस्याश्च संगमः पुण्यो यत्रासीच्चन्द्रभागया .. 49 ..
text_mt: he once went with me to the river named Toṣā, / where there was its sacred confluence with the Candrabhāgā.

sanskrit_iast:
caṃdrabhāgā somasutā toṣā caivārkanaṃdinī ..
tayoḥ śītoṣṇasalilasaṃgamaḥ sumanoharaḥ .. 4.75.50 ..
meaning:
चंद्रभागा सोमसुता तोषा चैवार्कनंदिनी ..
तयोः शीतोष्णसलिलसंगमः सुमनोहरः .. 4.75.50 ..
text_mt: The Candrabhāgā is the daughter of Soma, and the Toṣā is the daughter of the sun; / the confluence of their cold and warm waters is very delightful.

sanskrit_iast:
tattīrthavaramāsādya prātiveśyaḥ sa ca dvijaḥ ..
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge snātaścaivamupoṣitaḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
तत्तीर्थवरमासाद्य प्रातिवेश्यः स च द्विजः ..
श्रवणद्वादशीयोगे स्नातश्चैवमुपोषितः .. 51 ..
text_mt: Having reached that supreme holy site on the conjunction of Śravaṇadvādaśī, / that neighbouring twice-born man bathed and fasted in this manner.

sanskrit_iast:
caṃdrabhāgātoṣayośca vāridhānyairnavairdṛḍhaiḥ ..
dadhyodanayutaiḥ sārdhaṃ sampūrṇairvardhamānakaiḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
चंद्रभागातोषयोश्च वारिधान्यैर्नवैर्दृढैः ..
दध्योदनयुतैः सार्धं सम्पूर्णैर्वर्धमानकैः .. 52 ..
text_mt: With water and fresh, firm vessels of grain from the Candrabhāgā and Toṣā, / accompanied by curd-rice, along with full shallow dishes,

sanskrit_iast:
chatropānadyugaṃ vastraṃ pratimāṃ vidhivaddhareḥ ..
caṃdrabhāgājīvanena dadhyodanayutaṃ tadā .. 53 ..
meaning:
छत्रोपानद्युगं वस्त्रं प्रतिमां विधिवद्धरेः ..
चंद्रभागाजीवनेन दध्योदनयुतं तदा .. 53 ..
text_mt: a royal parasol, a pair of sandals, clothing, an image of Hari according to rule, / [offered] then with curd-rice by means of the waters of the Candrabhāgā—

sanskrit_iast:
etatkṛtvā gṛhaṃ prāptastataḥ kālena kenacit ..
pañcatvamahamāsādya nāstikyātpretatāṃ gataḥ ..
asyāmaṭavyāṃ ghorāyāṃ yathā dṛṣṭastvayānagha .. 54 ..
meaning:
एतत्कृत्वा गृहं प्राप्तस्ततः कालेन केनचित् ..
पञ्चत्वमहमासाद्य नास्तिक्यात्प्रेततां गतः ..
अस्यामटव्यां घोरायां यथा दृष्टस्त्वयानघ .. 54 ..
text_mt: having done this, he returned home. Then, after some time, / having met with death, on account of disbelief I fell into the condition of a preta / in this dreadful forest, just as you have seen, O sinless one.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmasvahāriṇastvete pāpāḥ pretatvamāgatāḥ ..
paradāraratāḥ kecitsvāmidroharatāḥ pare .. 55 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मस्वहारिणस्त्वेते पापाः प्रेतत्वमागताः ..
परदाररताः केचित्स्वामिद्रोहरताः परे .. 55 ..
text_mt: These sinners who seized the property of brāhmaṇas have come to the state of pretas; / some were devoted to others' wives, others to betraying their masters,

sanskrit_iast:
mitradroharatāḥ keciddeśe'smiṃstu sudāruṇe ..
mamaite bhṛtyatāṃ yātā annapānakṛtena ca .. ..56..
meaning:
मित्रद्रोहरताः केचिद्देशेऽस्मिंस्तु सुदारुणे ..
ममैते भृत्यतां याता अन्नपानकृतेन च .. ..56..
text_mt: and some were devoted to betraying their friends in this most dreadful region; / these have become my servants for the sake of food and drink.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣayyo bhagavānkṛṣṇaḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ ..
yaddīyate tamuddiśya akṣayyaṃ tatprakīrtitam ..57..
meaning:
अक्षय्यो भगवान्कृष्णः परमात्मा सनातनः ..
यद्दीयते तमुद्दिश्य अक्षय्यं तत्प्रकीर्तितम् ..57..
text_mt: Imperishable is the blessed Lord Kṛṣṇa, the eternal Supreme Self; / whatever is given dedicating to Him is declared to be imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā vihīnāḥ kiṃ tvete vane'sminbhṛśadāruṇe..
pīḍāmanubhaviṣyaṃti dāruṇāṃ karmayonijām ..58..
meaning:
मया विहीनाः किं त्वेते वनेऽस्मिन्भृशदारुणे..
पीडामनुभविष्यंति दारुणां कर्मयोनिजाम् ..58..
text_mt: Bereft of me, however, in this exceedingly terrible forest, / these will experience frightful torment born of the womb of their past deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣāṃ tvaṃ mahābhāga mamānugrahakāmyayā ..
anekanāmagotrāṇi gṛhāṇa lekhanena ca ..59..
meaning:
एतेषां त्वं महाभाग ममानुग्रहकाम्यया ..
अनेकनामगोत्राणि गृहाण लेखनेन च ..59..
text_mt: Out of a desire to show favour to me, O highly fortunate one, / take down the various names and lineages of these [pretas] in writing.

sanskrit_iast:
astu kakṣāgatā caiva tava saṃpuṭikā śubhā ..
himavatyāṃ tathāsādya tatra tvaṃ lapsyase nidhim .. 4.75.60 ..
meaning:
अस्तु कक्षागता चैव तव संपुटिका शुभा ..
हिमवत्यां तथासाद्य तत्र त्वं लप्स्यसे निधिम् .. 4.75.60 ..
text_mt: May your auspicious writing-box remain tucked under your arm; / and having arrived thus in the Himavat region, you will find a treasure there.

sanskrit_iast:
gayāśīrṣe tato gatvā śrāddhaṃ kuru mahāmate ..
ekamekamathoddiśya pretaṃpretaṃ yathāsukham .. 61 ..
meaning:
गयाशीर्षे ततो गत्वा श्राद्धं कुरु महामते ..
एकमेकमथोद्दिश्य प्रेतंप्रेतं यथासुखम् .. 61 ..
text_mt: Having gone then to Gayāśīrṣa, perform a śrāddha, O highly intelligent one, / dedicating it one by one to each individual preta as you please.”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sambhāṣamāṇo'sau taptajāṃbūnadaprabhaḥ ..
vimānavaramāruhya svargalokamito gataḥ ..62..
meaning:
एवं सम्भाषमाणोऽसौ तप्तजांबूनदप्रभः ..
विमानवरमारुह्य स्वर्गलोकमितो गतः ..62..
text_mt: Speaking thus, he, shining like molten gold, / mounted an excellent celestial chariot and went from here to the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast:
svargate pretanāthe tu prabhāvātsa vaṇikpumān ..
nāmagotrāṇi saṃgṛhya prayātaḥ sa himācalam .. 63 ..
meaning:
स्वर्गते प्रेतनाथे तु प्रभावात्स वणिक्पुमान् ..
नामगोत्राणि संगृह्य प्रयातः स हिमाचलम् .. 63 ..
text_mt: When the lord of pretas had gone to heaven, by his power that merchant, / having collected the names and lineages, set out for the Himālaya.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra prāpya nidhiṃ gatvā vinikṣipya svake gṛhe ..
dhanabhāgamupādāya gayāśīrṣavaṭaṃ yayau ..
pretānāṃ kramaśastatra cakre śrāddhaṃ dinedine .. 64 ..
meaning:
तत्र प्राप्य निधिं गत्वा विनिक्षिप्य स्वके गृहे ..
धनभागमुपादाय गयाशीर्षवटं ययौ ..
प्रेतानां क्रमशस्तत्र चक्रे श्राद्धं दिनेदिने .. 64 ..
text_mt: Having obtained the treasure there, he went and deposited it in his own house, / and taking a portion of the wealth, went to the banyan tree at Gayāśīrṣa; / there he performed the śrāddha for the pretas day by day in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyayasya gayāśrāddhaṃ sa karoti dine vaṇik ..
sa ca tasya sadā svapne darśayatyātmanastanum .. 65 ..
meaning:
यस्ययस्य गयाश्राद्धं स करोति दिने वणिक् ..
स च तस्य सदा स्वप्ने दर्शयत्यात्मनस्तनुम् .. 65 ..
text_mt: For whichever [preta] the merchant performed the Gayā-śrāddha on a given day, / that one would always show his form to him in a dream,

sanskrit_iast:
bravīti ca mahābhāga prasādena tavānagha ..
pretabhāvo mayā tyaktaḥ prāptosmi paramāṃ gatim ..66..
meaning:
ब्रवीति च महाभाग प्रसादेन तवानघ ..
प्रेतभावो मया त्यक्तः प्राप्तोस्मि परमां गतिम् ..66..
text_mt: and say: “O highly fortunate one, by your grace, O sinless one, / the state of a preta has been abandoned by me, and I have attained the supreme goal.”

sanskrit_iast:
sa kṛtvā dhanalobhācca pretānāṃ satkṛtiṃ vaṇik ..
jagāma svagṛhaṃ tatra māsi bhādrapade tathā .. 67 ..
meaning:
स कृत्वा धनलोभाच्च प्रेतानां सत्कृतिं वणिक् ..
जगाम स्वगृहं तत्र मासि भाद्रपदे तथा .. 67 ..
text_mt: Having performed the honouring of the pretas, out of greed for wealth / the merchant went to his own house; and then, in the month of Bhādrapada,

sanskrit_iast:
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge pūjayitvā janārdanam ..
dānaṃ ca dattvā viprebhyaḥ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ .. 68 ..
meaning:
श्रवणद्वादशीयोगे पूजयित्वा जनार्दनम् ..
दानं च दत्त्वा विप्रेभ्यः सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः .. 68 ..
text_mt: on the conjunction of Śravaṇadvādaśī, having worshipped Janārdana / and given gifts to the brāhmaṇas, fasting and with senses conquered,

sanskrit_iast:
mahānadīsaṃgameṣu prativarṣaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ..
cakāra vidhivaddānaṃ tato diṣṭāṃtamāgataḥ .. 69 ..
meaning:
महानदीसंगमेषु प्रतिवर्षं युधिष्ठिर ..
चकार विधिवद्दानं ततो दिष्टांतमागतः .. 69 ..
text_mt: he made gifts according to rule every year at the confluences of great rivers, O Yudhiṣṭhira; / then he reached the end of his appointed lifespan.

sanskrit_iast:
avāpa paramaṃ sthānaṃ durlabhaṃ cātra mānavaiḥ ..
yatra kāmaphalā vṛkṣā nadyaḥ pāyasakardamāḥ ..
śītalāmalapānīyāḥ puṣkariṇyo manoharāḥ .. 4.75.70 ..
meaning:
अवाप परमं स्थानं दुर्लभं चात्र मानवैः ..
यत्र कामफला वृक्षा नद्यः पायसकर्दमाः ..
शीतलामलपानीयाः पुष्करिण्यो मनोहराः .. 4.75.70 ..
text_mt: He attained the supreme realm, difficult to be obtained by human beings here, / where trees yield desired fruits, rivers have mud of milk-rice, / and charming lotus ponds possess cool and pure water.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ deśamāsādya vaṇiṅ mahātmā sutaptajāṃbūnadabhūṣitāṃgaḥ ..
kalpaṃ samagraṃ saha sundarībhiḥ svarge sa reme muditaḥ sadaiva .. 71 ..
vijayaśravaṇadvādaśīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
तं देशमासाद्य वणिङ् महात्मा सुतप्तजांबूनदभूषितांगः ..
कल्पं समग्रं सह सुन्दरीभिः स्वर्गे स रेमे मुदितः सदैव .. 71 ..
विजयश्रवणद्वादशीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Having reached that region, the noble-minded merchant, his limbs adorned with refined molten gold, / delighted continuously with beautiful maidens in heaven for a complete kalpa.
Description of the Vijaya-Śravaṇa-Dvādaśī Vrata

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
dvādaśyāste vidhiḥ proktaḥ śrāvaṇe yo yudhiṣṭhira ..
sarvapāpapraśamanaḥ sarvasaukhyapradāyakaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
द्वादश्यास्ते विधिः प्रोक्तः श्रावणे यो युधिष्ठिर ..
सर्वपापप्रशमनः सर्वसौख्यप्रदायकः .. 1 ..
text_mt: The holy Kṛṣṇa said: / The rite of the dvādaśī in Śrāvaṇa has been spoken of to you, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / which destroys all sins and grants all happiness.
title: Vijayaśravaṇadvādaśīvratavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśī yadā sā syācchravaṇena samanvitā ..
vijayā sā tithiḥ proktā bhaktānāṃ vijayapradā .. 2 ..
meaning:
एकादशी यदा सा स्याच्छ्रवणेन समन्विता ..
विजया सा तिथिः प्रोक्ता भक्तानां विजयप्रदा .. 2 ..
text_mt: When that ekādaśī is conjoined with Śravaṇa, / that lunar day is called Vijaya, granting victory to devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
balavānajito daityo balirnāmā mahābalaḥ ..
tena devagaṇāḥ sarve tyājitāḥ suramaṃdiram ..
tato devā mahāviṣṇuṃ gatvā vacanamūcire ..
tvaṃ gatiḥ sarvadevānāṃ śīghraṃ kaṣṭātsamuddhara .. 4 ..
meaning:
बलवानजितो दैत्यो बलिर्नामा महाबलः ..
तेन देवगणाः सर्वे त्याजिताः सुरमंदिरम् ..
ततो देवा महाविष्णुं गत्वा वचनमूचिरे ..
त्वं गतिः सर्वदेवानां शीघ्रं कष्टात्समुद्धर .. 4 ..
text_mt: There was a powerful, unconquered Daitya named Bali, of great strength. / By him all the hosts of gods were driven from the abode of the gods. / Then the gods went to Mahāviṣṇu and spoke these words: / 'You are the refuge of all the gods; quickly deliver us from distress!

sanskrit_iast:
jahi daityaṃ mahābāho baliṃ balaniṣūdana ..
śrutvā viṣṇustadā vākyaṃ devānāṃ karuṇodayam .. 5 ..
meaning:
जहि दैत्यं महाबाहो बलिं बलनिषूदन ..
श्रुत्वा विष्णुस्तदा वाक्यं देवानां करुणोदयम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Slay the Daitya Bali, O long-armed one, O destroyer of Bala!' / Hearing then the compassionate words of the gods, Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca vākyaṃ kālajño devānāṃ hitakāmyayā ..
jāne vairocaniṃ daityaṃ baliṃ trailokyakaṇṭakam .. 6 ..
meaning:
उवाच वाक्यं कालज्ञो देवानां हितकाम्यया ..
जाने वैरोचनिं दैत्यं बलिं त्रैलोक्यकण्टकम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: knowing the right time, spoke these words with a desire for the good of the gods: / 'I know the Daitya Bali, son of Virocana, the thorn of the three worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā bhāvitātmānaṃ śāntaṃ dāntaṃ jitendriyam ..
madbhaktaṃ madgataprāṇaṃ satyasandhaṃ mahābalam ..
tapasontaḥ subahunā kāle nāsya bhaviṣyati .. 7 ..
meaning:
तपसा भावितात्मानं शान्तं दान्तं जितेन्द्रियम् ..
मद्भक्तं मद्गतप्राणं सत्यसन्धं महाबलम् ..
तपसोन्तः सुबहुना काले नास्य भविष्यति .. 7 ..
text_mt: whose soul is purified by austerity, calm, self-restrained, victorious over his senses, / devoted to me, with his life-breath dedicated to me, true to his word, of great strength. / The end of his austerity will not come about in a very long time.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā vinayasampannaṃ jñāsye kālena kenacit ..
samāhṛtya priyaṃ tasya tadā dāsye divaukasām .. 8 ..
meaning:
यदा विनयसम्पन्नं ज्ञास्ये कालेन केनचित् ..
समाहृत्य प्रियं तस्य तदा दास्ये दिवौकसाम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: When I know him to be endowed with humility after some time, / then, taking away what is dear to him, I shall give it to the heaven-dwellers.

sanskrit_iast:
aditirmāṃ prapannā vai putrārthe putralobhinī ..
tasyāmatihitaṃ devāḥ kariṣye nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
अदितिर्मां प्रपन्ना वै पुत्रार्थे पुत्रलोभिनी ..
तस्यामतिहितं देवाः करिष्ये नात्र संशयः .. 9 ..
text_mt: Aditi indeed has surrendered to me, desiring a son, eager for offspring. / I shall bring about what is exceedingly beneficial to her, O gods; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
taddevānāṃ hitaṃ sarve cāhitaṃ tu suradviṣām ..
tadgacchadhvaṃ nirudvignāḥ kālaḥ kaścitpratīkṣyatām .. 4.76.10 ..
meaning:
तद्देवानां हितं सर्वे चाहितं तु सुरद्विषाम् ..
तद्गच्छध्वं निरुद्विग्नाः कालः कश्चित्प्रतीक्ष्यताम् .. 4.76.10 ..
text_mt: All that shall be for the good of the gods and to the detriment of the enemies of the gods. / Therefore go, free from anxiety; let a certain time be waited for.'

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktā gatā devāḥ kāryaṃ viṣṇuraciṃtayat ..
sā cintayitvā suciraṃ devyā garbhāvatāraṇam ..
aditirvarayāmāsa vāṃchitaṃ me bhaviṣyati .. 11 ..
meaning:
एवमुक्ता गता देवाः कार्यं विष्णुरचिंतयत् ..
सा चिन्तयित्वा सुचिरं देव्या गर्भावतारणम् ..
अदितिर्वरयामास वांछितं मे भविष्यति .. 11 ..
text_mt: Thus addressed, the gods departed; Viṣṇu reflected upon what was to be done. / Having reflected for a long time upon descent into the womb through the goddess, / Aditi chose [the boon]: 'May my desire be fulfilled.'

sanskrit_iast:
atha kāle bahutithe gate sā garbhiṇī hyabhūt ..
suṣuve navame māsi putraṃ sā vāmanaṃ harim .. 12 ..
meaning:
अथ काले बहुतिथे गते सा गर्भिणी ह्यभूत् ..
सुषुवे नवमे मासि पुत्रं सा वामनं हरिम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Then, after a great deal of time had passed, she became pregnant. / In the ninth month she gave birth to a son, Hari as the Dwarf,

sanskrit_iast:
hrasvapādaṃ hrasvakāyaṃ mahacchirasamarbhakam ..
pāṇipādodarakṛśaṃ svayaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim .. 13 ..
meaning:
ह्रस्वपादं ह्रस्वकायं महच्छिरसमर्भकम् ..
पाणिपादोदरकृशं स्वयं नारायणं हरिम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: short-footed, short-bodied, a child with a large head, / slender in hands, feet, and belly, Hari who was Nārāyaṇa himself.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tu vāmanaṃ jātaṃ yadi sā vaktumudyatā ..
niruddhavākyā hyabhavadvaktuṃ kiṃcinna pāritam .. 14 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तु वामनं जातं यदि सा वक्तुमुद्यता ..
निरुद्धवाक्या ह्यभवद्वक्तुं किंचिन्न पारितम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: When she saw the Dwarf born, as she prepared to speak, / her voice was choked, and she was not able to say anything.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyāṃ bhādrapade śravaṇena narottama ..
saṃcacāla mahī jāte vāmane tu trivikrame .. 15 ..
meaning:
एकादश्यां भाद्रपदे श्रवणेन नरोत्तम ..
संचचाल मही जाते वामने तु त्रिविक्रमे .. 15 ..
text_mt: On the ekādaśī in Bhādrapada, under Śravaṇa, O best of men, / the earth trembled when the Dwarf Trivikrama was born.

sanskrit_iast:
bhayaṃ babhūva daityānāṃ devānāṃ toṣa ābhavat ..
jātakarmādikāṃstasya saṃskārānsvayameva hi .. 16 ..
meaning:
भयं बभूव दैत्यानां देवानां तोष आभवत् ..
जातकर्मादिकांस्तस्य संस्कारान्स्वयमेव हि .. 16 ..
text_mt: There was fear among the Daityas, and satisfaction arose among the gods. / His birth-rites and other sacraments / the wise Prajāpati Kaśyapa performed spontaneously himself.

sanskrit_iast:
cakāra kaśyapo dhīmānprajāpatiranudyataḥ ..
ābaddhamekhalo daṃḍī dhṛtvā yajñopavītakam .. 17 ..
meaning:
चकार कश्यपो धीमान्प्रजापतिरनुद्यतः ..
आबद्धमेखलो दंडी धृत्वा यज्ञोपवीतकम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: Girded with a grass-belt, carrying a staff, wearing the sacrificial cord,

sanskrit_iast:
kuśasvacchodakadharaḥ kamaṃḍaluvibhūṣitaḥ ..
balerbalavato yajñaṃ jagāma bahuvistaram .. 18 ..
meaning:
कुशस्वच्छोदकधरः कमंडलुविभूषितः ..
बलेर्बलवतो यज्ञं जगाम बहुविस्तरम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: holding kuśa grass and clear water, adorned with a water pot, / he went to the sacrifice of the mighty Bali, which was very extensive.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā balimathovāca vāmano'bhyetya tatkṣaṇam ..
atha cāha yajñapate dīyatāṃ mama medinī .. 19 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा बलिमथोवाच वामनोऽभ्येत्य तत्क्षणम् ..
अथ चाह यज्ञपते दीयतां मम मेदिनी .. 19 ..
text_mt: Seeing Bali, the Dwarf, having approached him at that moment, spoke; / he said: 'O lord of the sacrifice, let earth be given to me

sanskrit_iast:
pādatrayapramāṇena paṭhanārthe sthito hyasi ..
dattādattā tava mayā baliḥ prāha dvijottamam .. 4.76.20 ..
meaning:
पादत्रयप्रमाणेन पठनार्थे स्थितो ह्यसि ..
दत्तादत्ता तव मया बलिः प्राह द्विजोत्तमम् .. 4.76.20 ..
text_mt: to the measure of three strides; for you are established for study.' / Bali said to that best of Brahmins: 'Given, given to you by me!'

sanskrit_iast:
tato varddhitumārabdho vāmano'naṃtavikramaḥ ..
pādau bhūmau pratiṣṭhāpya śirasāvṛtya rodasī .. 21 ..
meaning:
ततो वर्द्धितुमारब्धो वामनोऽनंतविक्रमः ..
पादौ भूमौ प्रतिष्ठाप्य शिरसावृत्य रोदसी .. 21 ..
text_mt: Then the Dwarf of infinite stride began to grow; / having placed his two feet upon the earth, he covered heaven and earth with his head.

sanskrit_iast:
tābhyāmiṃdrādikām̐llokām̐llalāṭe brahmaṇaḥ padam ..
na tṛtīya padaṃ lebhe tato nedurdivaukasaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
ताभ्यामिंद्रादिकाम्̐ल्लोकाम्̐ल्ललाटे ब्रह्मणः पदम् ..
न तृतीय पदं लेभे ततो नेदुर्दिवौकसः .. 22 ..
text_mt: With those two [strides he covered] the worlds of Indra and others; on his forehead was the realm of Brahmā. / He found no [space for] a third stride; then the gods cried out.

sanskrit_iast:
taddṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ siddhā devarṣayastathā ..
sādhusādhviti deveśaṃ praśaśaṃsurmudānvitāḥ ..23..
meaning:
तद्दृष्ट्वा महदाश्चर्यं सिद्धा देवर्षयस्तथा ..
साधुसाध्विति देवेशं प्रशशंसुर्मुदान्विताः ..23..
text_mt: Seeing that great wonder, the Siddhas and the divine seers / praised the lord of the gods with joy, saying: 'Well done! Well done!'

sanskrit_iast:
tato daityagaṇānsarvāñjitvā tribhuvanaṃ vaśī ..
balimāha tato gaccha sutalaṃ svabalānugaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
ततो दैत्यगणान्सर्वाञ्जित्वा त्रिभुवनं वशी ..
बलिमाह ततो गच्छ सुतलं स्वबलानुगः .. 24 ..
text_mt: Then, having conquered all the Daitya hosts, the master of the three worlds / said to Bali: 'Go then to Sutala, accompanied by your own army.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tvamīpsitānbhogānbhuktvā madbāhupālitaḥ ..
asyeṃdrasyāvasāne tu tvamevendro bhaviṣyasi .. 25 .....
meaning:
तत्र त्वमीप्सितान्भोगान्भुक्त्वा मद्बाहुपालितः ..
अस्येंद्रस्यावसाने तु त्वमेवेन्द्रो भविष्यसि .. 25 .....
text_mt: There, having enjoyed desired pleasures, protected by my arm, / at the end of this Indra you alone shall become Indra.'

sanskrit_iast:
evamukto baliḥ prāyānnamaskṛtya narottamam ..
visṛjyemaṃ baliṃ devānsakalānsa uvāca ha .. 26 ..
meaning:
एवमुक्तो बलिः प्रायान्नमस्कृत्य नरोत्तमम् ..
विसृज्येमं बलिं देवान्सकलान्स उवाच ह .. 26 ..
text_mt: Thus spoken to, Bali bowed to the best of men and departed. / Having dismissed this Bali, he spoke to all the gods:

sanskrit_iast:
svāni dhiṣṇyāni gacchadhvaṃ tiṣṭhadhvaṃ vigata jvarāḥ ..
devenoktā gatā devā hṛṣṭāḥ saṃpūjya vāmanam .. 27 ..
meaning:
स्वानि धिष्ण्यानि गच्छध्वं तिष्ठध्वं विगत ज्वराः ..
देवेनोक्ता गता देवा हृष्टाः संपूज्य वामनम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: 'Go to your own abodes, stay free from fever.' / Addressed by the Lord, the gods, delighted, departed after worshipping the Dwarf.

sanskrit_iast:
devaḥ kṛtvā jagatkāryaṃ tatraivāṃtarddhimāgamat ..
etatsarvaṃ samabhavadekādaśyāṃ narādhipa...
teneṣṭā devadevasya sarvadā vijayā tithiḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
देवः कृत्वा जगत्कार्यं तत्रैवांतर्द्धिमागमत् ..
एतत्सर्वं समभवदेकादश्यां नराधिप...
तेनेष्टा देवदेवस्य सर्वदा विजया तिथिः .. 28 ..
text_mt: Having accomplished the purpose of the universe, the God vanished right there. / All this took place on the ekādaśī, O king; / therefore the Vijaya lunar day is always dear to the God of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā vai phālgune māsi puṣyeṇa sahitā nṛpa ..
vijayā procyate sadbhiḥ koṭikoṭiguṇottarā ..29..
meaning:
एषा वै फाल्गुने मासि पुष्येण सहिता नृप ..
विजया प्रोच्यते सद्भिः कोटिकोटिगुणोत्तरा ..29..
text_mt: When it is conjoined with Puṣya in the month of Phālguna, O king, / this Vijaya is declared by the virtuous to bear millions and millions of times more fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyāṃ sopavāso rātrau saṃpūjayeddharim ..
raupye sauvarṇapātre vā dāruvaṃśamaye'pi vā .. 4.76.30 ..
meaning:
एकादश्यां सोपवासो रात्रौ संपूजयेद्धरिम् ..
रौप्ये सौवर्णपात्रे वा दारुवंशमयेऽपि वा .. 4.76.30 ..
text_mt: Fasting on the ekādaśī, one should worship Hari at night / on a silver or golden vessel, or on one made of wood or bamboo.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṃḍikāṃ sthāpayetpārśve chatraṃ vai pāduke tathā ..
śubhāṃ ca vaiṣṇavīṃ yaṣṭiṃ tathā sūtrakamaḍalū .. 31 ..
meaning:
कुंडिकां स्थापयेत्पार्श्वे छत्रं वै पादुके तथा ..
शुभां च वैष्णवीं यष्टिं तथा सूत्रकमडलू .. 31 ..
text_mt: Beside it one should place a small jar, a royal parasol, and sandals, / and an auspicious staff of Viṣṇu, as well as a thread and water pot,

sanskrit_iast:
ācchādya pātraṃ vāsobhiḥ phalaiścāpi suśobhanaiḥ ..
mārgacārmaṇagandhaiśca bhaktyā vā mṛgacarmaṇā .. 32 ..
meaning:
आच्छाद्य पात्रं वासोभिः फलैश्चापि सुशोभनैः ..
मार्गचार्मणगन्धैश्च भक्त्या वा मृगचर्मणा .. 32 ..
text_mt: covering the vessel with garments and with very beautiful fruits, / and with the scents of deerskin, or with devotion with a deerskin.

sanskrit_iast:
tilāḍhakena vittāḍhyaḥ prasthena kuḍavena vā ..
vrīhibhirvātha godhūmaiḥ phalaiḥ śuklatilairbhavet .. 33 ..
meaning:
तिलाढकेन वित्ताढ्यः प्रस्थेन कुडवेन वा ..
व्रीहिभिर्वाथ गोधूमैः फलैः शुक्लतिलैर्भवेत् .. 33 ..
text_mt: If rich, [he should worship] with an āḍhaka of sesame, or a prastha, or a kuḍava, / or with unhusked rice, or wheat, with fruits, or white sesame seeds.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpairgaṃdhairdhūpadīpaiḥ pakvānnai rarcayeddharim ..
nānāvidhaiśca naivedyairbhakṣyabhojyairguḍaudanaiḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
पुष्पैर्गंधैर्धूपदीपैः पक्वान्नै रर्चयेद्धरिम् ..
नानाविधैश्च नैवेद्यैर्भक्ष्यभोज्यैर्गुडौदनैः .. 34 ..
text_mt: One should worship Hari with flowers, fragrances, incense, lamps, and cooked foods, / and with various kinds of offerings, eatables, chewables, and rice cooked with jaggery.

sanskrit_iast:
svasvavittānusāreṇa sahiraṇyaṃ ca kārayet ..
maṃtraiḥ śataguṇaṃ caiva bhaktyā lakṣa guṇottaram ..
bhaktimāṃśca guṇopetaṃ koṭikoṭiguṇottaram .. 35 ..
meaning:
स्वस्ववित्तानुसारेण सहिरण्यं च कारयेत् ..
मंत्रैः शतगुणं चैव भक्त्या लक्ष गुणोत्तरम् ..
भक्तिमांश्च गुणोपेतं कोटिकोटिगुणोत्तरम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: According to one's own wealth, one should also present gold. / With mantras it is a hundredfold; with devotion it is a hundred thousandfold; / and for one who is devoted and endowed with virtues, it is millions and millions of times greater.

sanskrit_iast:
ebhirmaṃtrapadaistatra pūjayedgaruḍadhvajam ..
upahārairnaraśreṣṭha śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ .. .. 36 ..
meaning:
एभिर्मंत्रपदैस्तत्र पूजयेद्गरुडध्वजम् ..
उपहारैर्नरश्रेष्ठ शुचिर्भूत्वा समाहितः .. .. 36 ..
text_mt: With these mantra-words one should worship the Garuda-bannered one there / with offerings, O best of men, having become pure and concentrated:

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ jalajopamadehāya jalajāsyāya śaṃkhine ..
jalarāśisvarūpāya namaste puruṣottama .. 37 ..
meaning:
ओं जलजोपमदेहाय जलजास्याय शंखिने ..
जलराशिस्वरूपाय नमस्ते पुरुषोत्तम .. 37 ..
text_mt: 'Oṃ! Salutation to you whose body resembles a lotus, whose face is like a lotus, who bear the conch, / whose form is the mass of waters; salutation to you, Puruṣottama!

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ kamalanābhāya namaste jala śāyine ..
namaste keśavānaṃta vāsudeva namo'stu te .. 38 .. iti snānamaṃtraḥ ..
meaning:
नमः कमलनाभाय नमस्ते जल शायिने ..
नमस्ते केशवानंत वासुदेव नमोऽस्तु ते .. 38 .. इति स्नानमंत्रः ..
text_mt: Salutation to the lotus-naveled one; salutation to you who lie upon the waters; / salutation to you, Keśava, Ananta; O Vāsudeva, salutation be to you!' Thus the bath mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
malayeṣu samutpannaṃ gandhāḍhayaṃ sumanoharam ..
mayā niveditaṃ tubhyaṃ gṛhāṇa parameśvara .. 39 .. iti candanamaṃtraḥ ..
meaning:
मलयेषु समुत्पन्नं गन्धाढयं सुमनोहरम् ..
मया निवेदितं तुभ्यं गृहाण परमेश्वर .. 39 .. इति चन्दनमंत्रः ..
text_mt: 'Produced in the Malaya hills, rich in fragrance, exceedingly charming, / this is offered by me to you; receive it, O Parameśvara!' Thus the sandalwood mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
vanaspatisamutpannaṃ gandhāḍhyaṃ sumanoharam ..
mayā niveditaṃ puṣpaṃ gṛhāṇa puruṣottama .. 4.76.40 .. iti puṣpamantraḥ ..
meaning:
वनस्पतिसमुत्पन्नं गन्धाढ्यं सुमनोहरम् ..
मया निवेदितं पुष्पं गृहाण पुरुषोत्तम .. 4.76.40 .. इति पुष्पमन्त्रः ..
text_mt: 'Produced from trees of the forest, rich in fragrance, exceedingly charming, / this flower is offered by me; receive it, O Puruṣottama!' Thus the flower mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ kamalakiṃjalkapītanirmalavāsase ..
manoharavapuḥskandhadhṛtacakrāya śārṅgiṇe .. 41 .. iti pūjāmaṃtraḥ ..
meaning:
नमः कमलकिंजल्कपीतनिर्मलवाससे ..
मनोहरवपुःस्कन्धधृतचक्राय शार्ङ्गिणे .. 41 .. इति पूजामंत्रः ..
text_mt: 'Salutation to the bearer of the Śārṅga bow, whose immaculate yellow garments are like the filaments of a lotus, / who holds the discus on his charming shoulder!' Thus the worship mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
matsyaḥ kūrmo varā haśca nārasiṃhaśca vāmanaḥ ..
rāmo rāmaśca kṛṣṇaśca nāmabhirvāmanāya te ..
pādādyaikaikāṃgasya pūjanaṃ śīrṣagaṃ tataḥ .. 42 .. iti sarvāṃgapūjā ..
meaning:
मत्स्यः कूर्मो वरा हश्च नारसिंहश्च वामनः ..
रामो रामश्च कृष्णश्च नामभिर्वामनाय ते ..
पादाद्यैकैकांगस्य पूजनं शीर्षगं ततः .. 42 .. इति सर्वांगपूजा ..
text_mt: Fish, Tortoise, and Boar; Narasiṃha and Vāmana; / Rāma, Rāma, and Kṛṣṇa: with these names unto you who are Vāmana, / worship of each limb is performed, beginning with the feet and going to the head. Thus the worship of all limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpo'yaṃ devadeveśa śaṃkhacakragadādhara ..
acyutānaṃta govinda vāsudeva namo'stu te .. 43 .. iti dhūpamaṃtraḥ ..
meaning:
धूपोऽयं देवदेवेश शंखचक्रगदाधर ..
अच्युतानंत गोविन्द वासुदेव नमोऽस्तु ते .. 43 .. इति धूपमंत्रः ..
text_mt: "This is incense, O lord of the gods of gods, wielder of conch, discus, and mace; / O Acyuta, Ananta, Govinda, Vāsudeva, reverence be to you." Thus the incense mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva pṛthivī jyotirvāyurākāśameva ca ..
tvameva jyotiṣāṃ jyotirdīpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām .. 44 .. iti dīpamaṃtraḥ ..
meaning:
त्वमेव पृथिवी ज्योतिर्वायुराकाशमेव च ..
त्वमेव ज्योतिषां ज्योतिर्दीपोऽयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् .. 44 .. इति दीपमंत्रः ..
text_mt: "You alone are the earth, light, wind, and sky as well; / you alone are the light of lights; let this lamp be accepted." Thus the lamp mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
annaṃ caturvidhaṃ svādu rasaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ samanvitam ..
bhakṣyabhojyasamāyuktaṃ prasīda parameśvara .. 45 ..
meaning:
अन्नं चतुर्विधं स्वादु रसैः षड्भिः समन्वितम् ..
भक्ष्यभोज्यसमायुक्तं प्रसीद परमेश्वर .. 45 ..
text_mt: "Food of four kinds, tasty, endowed with the six flavours, / furnished with masticables and feast-fare: be pleased, O Supreme Lord!

sanskrit_iast:
annaṃ prajāpatirviṣṇū rudreṃdraśaśibhāskarāḥ ..
annaṃ tvaṣṭā yamo'gniśca pāpaṃ haratu me'vyayaḥ .. 46 .. iti naivedyamaṃtraḥ ..
meaning:
अन्नं प्रजापतिर्विष्णू रुद्रेंद्रशशिभास्कराः ..
अन्नं त्वष्टा यमोऽग्निश्च पापं हरतु मेऽव्ययः .. 46 .. इति नैवेद्यमंत्रः ..
text_mt: Food is Prajāpati and Viṣṇu; Rudra, Indra, moon, and sun; / food is Tvaṣṭṛ, Yama, and Agni: may the imperishable one take away my sin." Thus the food-offering mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
jagadādirjagadūpamanādirjagadaṃtakṛt ..
jalāśayo jagadyoniḥ prīyatāṃ me janārdanaḥ .. 47 .. iti prīṇanamaṃtraḥ ..
meaning:
जगदादिर्जगदूपमनादिर्जगदंतकृत् ..
जलाशयो जगद्योनिः प्रीयतां मे जनार्दनः .. 47 .. इति प्रीणनमंत्रः ..
text_mt: "Origin of the world, embodiment of the world, without beginning, destroyer of the world, / dwelling in water, source of the world: may Janārdana be pleased with me." Thus the propitiation mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
anekakarmanirbaṃdhadhvaṃsinaṃ jala śāyinam..
nato'smi mathurāvāsaṃ mādhavaṃ madhusūdanam .. 48 ..
meaning:
अनेककर्मनिर्बंधध्वंसिनं जल शायिनम्..
नतोऽस्मि मथुरावासं माधवं मधुसूदनम् .. 48 ..
text_mt: I bow down to the destroyer of the bonds of various karmas, who reclines on the waters, / residing in Mathurā, Mādhava, slayer of Madhu.

sanskrit_iast:
namo vāmanarūpāya namaste'stu trivikrama ..
namaste maṇibandhāya vāsudeva namo'stu te .. 49 .. iti namaskāramaṃtraḥ ..
meaning:
नमो वामनरूपाय नमस्तेऽस्तु त्रिविक्रम ..
नमस्ते मणिबन्धाय वासुदेव नमोऽस्तु ते .. 49 .. इति नमस्कारमंत्रः ..
text_mt: Reverence to the one whose form is Vāmana; reverence to you, O Trivikrama; / reverence to you whose wrists bear bracelets; O Vāsudeva, reverence be to you!" Thus the prostration mantra.

sanskrit_iast: namo namaste govinda vāmaneśa trivikrama .. 4.76.50 ..
meaning: नमो नमस्ते गोविन्द वामनेश त्रिविक्रम .. 4.76.50 ..
text_mt: Reverence, reverence to you, O Govinda, Lord Vāmana, Trivikrama!

sanskrit_iast: aghaughasaṃkṣayaṃ kṛtvā sarvakāmaprado bhava ..51.. iti prārthanāmaṃtraḥ ..
meaning: अघौघसंक्षयं कृत्वा सर्वकामप्रदो भव ..51.. इति प्रार्थनामंत्रः ..
text_mt: Having destroyed the heap of sins, become the granter of all desires." Thus the prayer mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvagaḥ sarvadeveśaḥ śrīdharaḥ śrīniketanaḥ ..
viśveśvaraśca viṣṇuśca śrīśāyī ca namonamaḥ ..52.. iti śayanamaṃtraḥ ..
meaning:
सर्वगः सर्वदेवेशः श्रीधरः श्रीनिकेतनः ..
विश्वेश्वरश्च विष्णुश्च श्रीशायी च नमोनमः ..52.. इति शयनमंत्रः ..
text_mt: "All-pervading, lord of all gods, bearer of Śrī, abode of Śrī, / Lord of the universe, Viṣṇu, reclining with Śrī: reverence, reverence!" Thus the reclining mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃpūjya yo rātrāvekādaśyāṃ nṛpottama ..
jāgaraṃ tatra kurvīta gītavāditranisvanaiḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
एवं संपूज्य यो रात्रावेकादश्यां नृपोत्तम ..
जागरं तत्र कुर्वीत गीतवादित्रनिस्वनैः .. 53 ..
text_mt: Having thus worshipped at night on the ekādaśī, O best of kings, / one should keep a vigil there with the sounds of song and instrumental music.

sanskrit_iast:
yā ca śravaṇasaṃyuktā dvādaśī paramā tithiḥ ..
tasyāṃ ca saṃgame snātvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 54 ..
meaning:
या च श्रवणसंयुक्ता द्वादशी परमा तिथिः ..
तस्यां च संगमे स्नात्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 54 ..
text_mt: And the supreme lunar day, the dvādaśī conjoined with Śravaṇā: / having bathed at a river confluence on it, one is released from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃpūjya yatnena prabhāte vimale sati ..
pradeyaṃ śāstraviduṣe brāhmaṇāya ca maṃtrataḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
एवं संपूज्य यत्नेन प्रभाते विमले सति ..
प्रदेयं शास्त्रविदुषे ब्राह्मणाय च मंत्रतः .. 55 ..
text_mt: Having thus worshipped diligently, when the morning has become bright and clear, / a gift should be given with mantras to a brahmin learned in the scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaścāpi mantreṇa pratigṛhṇīta maṃtravat ..
vāmano'sya pratigrāhī vāmanāya namonamaḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणश्चापि मन्त्रेण प्रतिगृह्णीत मंत्रवत् ..
वामनोऽस्य प्रतिग्राही वामनाय नमोनमः .. 56 ..
text_mt: And the brahmin too should accept it with a mantra according to the ritual rules: / "Vāmana is its receiver; reverence, reverence to Vāmana!"

sanskrit_iast:
( oṃ guhye . oṃ śirasi . oṃ pādayoḥ . oṃ nābhau .. oṃ bhujayoḥ . oṃ sarvāṃge . sarvātmane namaḥ ..)
puṣpaṃ phalaṃ ca naivedyaṃ sarvametadyathāvidhi ..
naro dadyādupoṣyaivamekādaśyāṃ samaṃtrakam .. 57 ..
meaning:
( ओं गुह्ये . ओं शिरसि . ओं पादयोः . ओं नाभौ .. ओं भुजयोः . ओं सर्वांगे . सर्वात्मने नमः ..)
पुष्पं फलं च नैवेद्यं सर्वमेतद्यथाविधि ..
नरो दद्यादुपोष्यैवमेकादश्यां समंत्रकम् .. 57 ..
text_mt: ("Oṃ, on the private parts; Oṃ, on the head; Oṃ, on the feet; Oṃ, on the navel; Oṃ, on the two arms; Oṃ, on all limbs; reverence to the Self of all!") / Flowers, fruit, and food offering—all this according to rule / a person should give with mantras, having fasted on the ekādaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvoktavidhinā prātarbhojanaṃ pṛṣadājyakam ..
pūrvaṃ dattvā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ paścādbhuñjīta vāgyataḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
पूर्वोक्तविधिना प्रातर्भोजनं पृषदाज्यकम् ..
पूर्वं दत्त्वा ब्राह्मणेभ्यः पश्चाद्भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः .. 58 ..
text_mt: According to the previously declared rule, in the morning a meal of spotted butter, / having first given it to brahmins, he should eat afterwards with restrained speech.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyobhūyo'pi rājeṃdra sarvatraivaṃ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ..
samāpte tu vrate rājanyatpuṇyaṃ tannibodha me .. 59 ..
meaning:
भूयोभूयोऽपि राजेंद्र सर्वत्रैवं विधिः स्मृतः ..
समाप्ते तु व्रते राजन्यत्पुण्यं तन्निबोध मे .. 59 ..
text_mt: Again and again, O king of kings, such a rule is handed down everywhere. / But upon the completion of the votive observance, O king, hear from me that merit:

sanskrit_iast:
caturyugāni rājeṃdra ekasaptatisaṃkhyayā ..
prāpya viṣṇupure rājankrīḍate kālamakṣayam .. 4.76.60 ..
meaning:
चतुर्युगानि राजेंद्र एकसप्ततिसंख्यया ..
प्राप्य विष्णुपुरे राजन्क्रीडते कालमक्षयम् .. 4.76.60 ..
text_mt: For seventy-one four-age cycles, O king of kings, / reaching the city of Viṣṇu, O king, he sports for imperishable time.

sanskrit_iast:
ihāgatya bhavedrājā pratipakṣakṣayaṃkaraḥ ..
hastyaśvarathapattīnāṃ dātā bhoktā vimatsarī .. 61 ..
meaning:
इहागत्य भवेद्राजा प्रतिपक्षक्षयंकरः ..
हस्त्यश्वरथपत्तीनां दाता भोक्ता विमत्सरी .. 61 ..
text_mt: Having returned here, he becomes a king who brings about the destruction of his adversaries, / a giver and enjoyer of elephants, horses, chariots, and infantry, free from envy.

sanskrit_iast:
rūpasaubhāgyasaṃpanno dīrghāyurnīrujo bhavet ..
putraiḥ parivṛto jīvo jīvecca śaradaḥ śatam .. 62 ..
meaning:
रूपसौभाग्यसंपन्नो दीर्घायुर्नीरुजो भवेत् ..
पुत्रैः परिवृतो जीवो जीवेच्च शरदः शतम् .. 62 ..
text_mt: Endowed with beauty and good fortune, long-lived, he will be free from disease; / surrounded by sons, the living person will live for a hundred autumns.

sanskrit_iast:
etasyāḥ phalamākhyātamekādaśyā mayā tava ..
pūrvameva samākhyātā dvādaśī śravaṇānvitā .. 63 ..
meaning:
एतस्याः फलमाख्यातमेकादश्या मया तव ..
पूर्वमेव समाख्याता द्वादशी श्रवणान्विता .. 63 ..
text_mt: The fruit of this ekādaśī has been recounted to you by me; / the dvādaśī conjoined with Śravaṇā has already been described previously.

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣyaikādaśīṃ paścāddvādaśīmapyupoṣayet ..
na cātra vidhilopaḥ syādubhayordevatā hariḥ .. 64 ..
meaning:
उपोष्यैकादशीं पश्चाद्द्वादशीमप्युपोषयेत् ..
न चात्र विधिलोपः स्यादुभयोर्देवता हरिः .. 64 ..
text_mt: Having fasted on the ekādaśī, one should fast on the dvādaśī as well; / and there would be no breach of rule here, since Hari is the deity of both.

sanskrit_iast:
(ekādaśīdvādaśyoranyatarasyāṃ śravaṇayuktāyāṃ śravaṇayuktopavāsenaiva batadvayasiddhiḥ ..
ekasminvrate pūrvamanyāṃ tithimupoṣya paścādapārayitvaivānyopoṣyata iti yo vidhilopaḥ sa ekadevatākatvena na bhavatītyarthaḥ) ..
budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā dvādaśī saṃgamodakam ..
dānaṃ dadhyodanaṃ satyamupavāsaḥ paro vidhiḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
(एकादशीद्वादश्योरन्यतरस्यां श्रवणयुक्तायां श्रवणयुक्तोपवासेनैव बतद्वयसिद्धिः ..
एकस्मिन्व्रते पूर्वमन्यां तिथिमुपोष्य पश्चादपारयित्वैवान्योपोष्यत इति यो विधिलोपः स एकदेवताकत्वेन न भवतीत्यर्थः) ..
बुधश्रवणसंयुक्ता द्वादशी संगमोदकम् ..
दानं दध्योदनं सत्यमुपवासः परो विधिः .. 65 ..
text_mt: (On either the ekādaśī or the dvādaśī conjoined with Śravaṇā, by the fast conjoined with Śravaṇā alone comes the accomplishment of both vows. In a single vow, having first fasted on one lunar day and then fasting on the other without breaking the fast, the breach of rule that might occur does not occur because of having a single deity, such is the meaning.) / The dvādaśī conjoined with Wednesday and Śravaṇā, confluence water, / gifts, curd-rice, truth, and fasting are the supreme rule.

sanskrit_iast:
sagareṇa kakutsthena dhuṃdhumāreṇa gādhinā ..
etaiścānyaiśca rājeṃdra kṛtaṃ vai dvādaśīvratam .. 66 ..
meaning:
सगरेण ककुत्स्थेन धुंधुमारेण गाधिना ..
एतैश्चान्यैश्च राजेंद्र कृतं वै द्वादशीव्रतम् .. 66 ..
text_mt: By Sagara, by Kakutstha, by Dhundhumāra, by Gādhi, / and by others, O king of kings, this votive observance of the dvādaśī was performed.

sanskrit_iast:
sā dvādaśī budhayutā śravaṇena sākaṃ syādvai jayāya kathitā ṛṣibhirnabhasye ..
tāmādareṇa samupoṣya naro'maratvaṃ prāpnoti pārtha aṇimādiguṇopapannam .. 67 ..
samprāptidvādaśīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
सा द्वादशी बुधयुता श्रवणेन साकं स्याद्वै जयाय कथिता ऋषिभिर्नभस्ये ..
तामादरेण समुपोष्य नरोऽमरत्वं प्राप्नोति पार्थ अणिमादिगुणोपपन्नम् .. 67 ..
सम्प्राप्तिद्वादशीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
That dvādaśī joined with Wednesday along with Śravaṇā is indeed declared by the ṛṣis for victory in Nabhasya; / having fasted on it with reverence, O son of Pṛthā, a man attains immortality endowed with the qualities of anima and the rest.
Description of the Votive Observance of Samprāpti-dvādaśī

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
kṛṣṇapakṣe tu pauṣasya saṃprāptaṃ dvādaśīvratam ..
pauṣādipāraṇaṃ māsaiḥ ṣaḍbhirjyeṣṭhāṃtikaṃ smṛtam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
कृष्णपक्षे तु पौषस्य संप्राप्तं द्वादशीव्रतम् ..
पौषादिपारणं मासैः षड्भिर्ज्येष्ठांतिकं स्मृतम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Lord Kṛṣṇa said: / In the dark fortnight of Pauṣa, the dvādaśī observance is obtained; / breaking the fast begins with Pauṣa and is remembered to last for six months until Jyeṣṭha.
title: Saṃprāptidvādaśīvratam

sanskrit_iast:
prathamaṃ puṃḍarīkākṣaṃ nāma kṛṣṇasya gīyate ..
dvitīyaṃ mādhavākhyaṃ tu viśvarūpaṃ tu phālgune .. 2 ..
meaning:
प्रथमं पुंडरीकाक्षं नाम कृष्णस्य गीयते ..
द्वितीयं माधवाख्यं तु विश्वरूपं तु फाल्गुने .. 2 ..
text_mt: First, the name Lotus-Eyed is sung for Kṛṣṇa; / second is the name Mādhava, and in Phālguna it is Universal Form;

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣottamākhyaṃ tu tataḥ paṃcame'cyutasaṃjñakam ..
ṣaṣṭhe jayeti deveśa guhyanāma prakīrtitam .. 3 ..
meaning:
पुरुषोत्तमाख्यं तु ततः पंचमेऽच्युतसंज्ञकम् ..
षष्ठे जयेति देवेश गुह्यनाम प्रकीर्तितम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: the name Puruṣottama thereafter, in the fifth one named Acyuta, / and in the sixth Jayā, O lord of gods, is proclaimed as the secret name.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvokteṣu ca māseṣu snānaprāśana yostilāḥ ..
āṣāḍhādiṣu māseṣu paṃcagavyamudāhṛtam ..4..
meaning:
पूर्वोक्तेषु च मासेषु स्नानप्राशन योस्तिलाः ..
आषाढादिषु मासेषु पंचगव्यमुदाहृतम् ..4..
text_mt: And in the previously mentioned months, sesamum is used for bathing and sipping; / in the months beginning with Āṣāḍha, the five products of the cow are declared.

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ ca prāśanaṃ caiva paṃcagavyaṃ sadeṣyate..
pūjayetpuṃḍarīkākṣaṃ testaireva ca nāmabhiḥ...
pratimāsaṃ ca deveśa kṛtvā pūjāṃ yathāvidhi ..
viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyācchraddadhānaśca bhaktitaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
स्नानं च प्राशनं चैव पंचगव्यं सदेष्यते..
पूजयेत्पुंडरीकाक्षं तेस्तैरेव च नामभिः...
प्रतिमासं च देवेश कृत्वा पूजां यथाविधि ..
विप्राय दक्षिणां दद्याच्छ्रद्दधानश्च भक्तितः .. 6 ..
text_mt: Bathing and consuming the five products of the cow is always desired; / one should worship the Lotus-Eyed One with those very names; / having performed the worship month by month according to rule, O lord of gods, / faithful, one should give a priestly gift to a brahmin with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
pāraṇaṃ caiva deveśa prīṇanaṃ bhaktipūrvakam ..
kurvīta bhaktyā goviṃdasadbhāvenārcanaṃ yataḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
पारणं चैव देवेश प्रीणनं भक्तिपूर्वकम् ..
कुर्वीत भक्त्या गोविंदसद्भावेनार्चनं यतः .. 7 ..
text_mt: And breaking the fast, O lord of gods, and propitiation preceded by devotion / one should perform with devotion, since worship of Govinda is done with true disposition.

sanskrit_iast:
naktaṃ bhuṃjīta satataṃ tailakṣāravivarjitam ..
ekādaśyāmupoṣyaivaṃ dvādaśyāmatha vā dine .. 8 ..
meaning:
नक्तं भुंजीत सततं तैलक्षारविवर्जितम् ..
एकादश्यामुपोष्यैवं द्वादश्यामथ वा दिने .. 8 ..
text_mt: One should always take a nocturnal meal devoid of oil and alkali, / having fasted thus on the ekādaśī, or on the day of the dvādaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte yadabhipretamātmanaḥ ..
dhanaṃ vasu hiraṇyaṃ ca dhānyaṃ bhājanamāsanam ..
śayyāṃ vā brāhmaṇe dadyātkeśavaḥ pratigṛhyatām .. 9 ..
meaning:
एवं संवत्सरस्यांते यदभिप्रेतमात्मनः ..
धनं वसु हिरण्यं च धान्यं भाजनमासनम् ..
शय्यां वा ब्राह्मणे दद्यात्केशवः प्रतिगृह्यताम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Thus, at the end of the year, whatever is desired by oneself— / money, wealth, gold, grain, utensils, a seat, / or a bed—one should give to a brahmin, [saying] "May Keśava be accepted."

sanskrit_iast:
etāmupoṣya vidhinā viṣṇuprītau ca tatparaḥ ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti yadyadicchati cetasā ..
tato lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ saṃprāptaṃ dvādaśīti vai .. 4.77.10 ..
meaning:
एतामुपोष्य विधिना विष्णुप्रीतौ च तत्परः ..
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति यद्यदिच्छति चेतसा ..
ततो लोकेषु विख्यातं संप्राप्तं द्वादशीति वै .. 4.77.10 ..
text_mt: Having fasted on this according to rule and devoted to pleasing Viṣṇu, / he attains all desires, whatever he wishes in his mind; / therefore it is known in the worlds as the Samprāptā dvādaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtābhilaṣitā dṛṣṭā prārabdhā dharmatatparaiḥ..
pūrayedakhilānkāmānsaṃsmṛtā vā dinedine .. 11 ..
meaning:
कृताभिलषिता दृष्टा प्रारब्धा धर्मतत्परैः..
पूरयेदखिलान्कामान्संस्मृता वा दिनेदिने .. 11 ..
text_mt: Performed, desired, witnessed, or undertaken by those devoted to righteousness, / or remembered day by day, it fulfills all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāptikāmupavasaṃti samīhitārthā ye mānavā manu japuṃgava viṣṇubhaktāḥ ..
teṣāṃ samīhitaphalāni dadāti śaśvadvāsaḥ sureśabhavane bhagavatprasādāt .. 12 ..
govindadvādaśīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
संप्राप्तिकामुपवसंति समीहितार्था ये मानवा मनु जपुंगव विष्णुभक्ताः ..
तेषां समीहितफलानि ददाति शश्वद्वासः सुरेशभवने भगवत्प्रसादात् .. 12 ..
गोविन्दद्वादशीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Those men who, desiring attained results, fast on the Saṃprāptidvādaśī, O bull among the reciters of mantras, devoted to Viṣṇu, / to them she constantly grants their desired rewards, and residence in the abode of the lord of the gods, by the grace of the Blessed One.
Description of the Votive Observance of Govindadvādaśī

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
tathānyāmapi te vacmi goviṃda dvādaśīṃ śṛṇu ..
tasyāḥ samyaganuṣṭhānātprāpnotyabhimataṃ phalam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
तथान्यामपि ते वच्मि गोविंद द्वादशीं शृणु ..
तस्याः सम्यगनुष्ठानात्प्राप्नोत्यभिमतं फलम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / "Listen, and I shall tell you of another as well, the Govindadvādaśī; / from its proper performance, one obtains one's desired reward.
title: adhyāyaḥ 078

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣe māse site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ ..
samyaksaṃpūjya govindaṃ nāmnā devamadhokṣajam .. 2 ..
meaning:
पौषे मासे सिते पक्षे द्वादश्यां समुपोषितः ..
सम्यक्संपूज्य गोविन्दं नाम्ना देवमधोक्षजम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: In the month of Pauṣa, in the bright fortnight, having fasted on the twelfth lunar day, / having duly worshipped Govinda, the god Adhokṣaja, by name,

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpapuṣpopacāraiśca naivedyaiśca samāhitaḥ ..
goviṃdeti japennāma punastadgatamānasaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
धूपपुष्पोपचारैश्च नैवेद्यैश्च समाहितः ..
गोविंदेति जपेन्नाम पुनस्तद्गतमानसः .. 3 ..
text_mt: with services of incense, flowers, and food offerings, concentrated in mind, / one should murmur the name 'Govinda', with one's mind again absorbed in him.

sanskrit_iast:
viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādyathāśaktyā narādhipa ..
svayaṃ vibuddhastulito goviṃdeti ca kīrtayet .. 4 ..
meaning:
विप्राय दक्षिणां दद्याद्यथाशक्त्या नराधिप ..
स्वयं विबुद्धस्तुलितो गोविंदेति च कीर्तयेत् .. 4 ..
text_mt: One should give a sacrificial fee to a brāhmaṇa according to one's capacity, O king of men; / having awakened oneself and become composed, one should chant 'Govinda'.

sanskrit_iast:
pākhaṃḍibhirvikarmasthairālāpāṃśca vivarjayet ..
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ vāpi dadhi kṣīrama thāpi vā .. 5 ..
meaning:
पाखंडिभिर्विकर्मस्थैरालापांश्च विवर्जयेत् ..
गोमूत्रं गोमयं वापि दधि क्षीरम थापि वा .. 5 ..
text_mt: One should avoid conversations with heretics and those persisting in wrong actions. / Cow urine, cow dung, curd, or milk,

sanskrit_iast:
godohataḥ samudbhūtaṃ prāśnīyādātmaśuddhaye ..
dvitīye'hni punaḥ snānaṃ tathaivābhyarcya keśavam .. 6 ..
meaning:
गोदोहतः समुद्भूतं प्राश्नीयादात्मशुद्धये ..
द्वितीयेऽह्नि पुनः स्नानं तथैवाभ्यर्च्य केशवम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: produced from the milking of a cow, one should consume for self-purification. / On the second day, bathing again and worshipping Keśava in the same manner,

sanskrit_iast:
tenaiva nāmnā saṃpūjya dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām ..
tato bhuñjīta godohaṃ saṃbhūtena samudbhavam .. 7 ..
meaning:
तेनैव नाम्ना संपूज्य दत्त्वा विप्राय दक्षिणाम् ..
ततो भुञ्जीत गोदोहं संभूतेन समुद्भवम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: having worshipped [him] with that very name, and having given a sacrificial fee to a brāhmaṇa, / one should then eat what is produced from that which is born of cow-milking.

sanskrit_iast:
evamevākhilānmāsānupoṣya prayataḥ śuciḥ ..
dadyādgavāhnikaṃ vidvānpratimāsaṃ tu śaktitaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
एवमेवाखिलान्मासानुपोष्य प्रयतः शुचिः ..
दद्याद्गवाह्निकं विद्वान्प्रतिमासं तु शक्तितः .. 8 ..
text_mt: Fasting in this very way through all the months, restrained and pure, / the wise person should give daily fodder for cows each month according to capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
pārite ca punarvaṣe govindaṃ padmayā saha ..
govindaḥ prītimāyātu vratenānena me sadā .. 9 ..
meaning:
पारिते च पुनर्वषे गोविन्दं पद्मया सह ..
गोविन्दः प्रीतिमायातु व्रतेनानेन मे सदा .. 9 ..
text_mt: When the year is completed, [one should worship] Govinda together with Padmā, [praying:] / 'May Govinda always be pleased with me through this votive observance.'

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣataḥ punardadyāttasminnahni gavāhnikam ..
bhaktyā paramayā rājañchṛṇu yatphalamāpnuyāt .. 4.78.10 ..
meaning:
विशेषतः पुनर्दद्यात्तस्मिन्नह्नि गवाह्निकम् ..
भक्त्या परमया राजञ्छृणु यत्फलमाप्नुयात् .. 4.78.10 ..
text_mt: One should give daily fodder for cows especially on that day, / with supreme devotion, O king. Hear the fruit that one attains:

sanskrit_iast:
svarṇaśṛṃgaṃ raupyakhuraṃ gośatairvṛṣabhaṃ varam ..
iti māsaṃ dvijātibhyo dattvā yatphalamaśnute .. 11 ..
meaning:
स्वर्णशृंगं रौप्यखुरं गोशतैर्वृषभं वरम् ..
इति मासं द्विजातिभ्यो दत्त्वा यत्फलमश्नुते .. 11 ..
text_mt: an excellent bull with golden horns and silver hooves, along with a hundred cows— / the reward one enjoys by giving this to the twice-born for a month,

sanskrit_iast:
tadāpnotyakhilaṃ samyagvratametadupoṣitaḥ ..
taṃ ca lokamavāpnoti govindo yatra tiṣṭhati ..12..
meaning:
तदाप्नोत्यखिलं सम्यग्व्रतमेतदुपोषितः ..
तं च लोकमवाप्नोति गोविन्दो यत्र तिष्ठति ..12..
text_mt: all of that does one fully attain who has fasted for this votive observance, / and one reaches that world where Govinda abides.

sanskrit_iast:
govindadvādaśīmetāṃ samupoṣya vidhānataḥ ..

गोविन्दद्वादशीमेतां समुपोष्य विधानतः ..
विद्योतमाना दृश्यंते लोकेद्यापि शशांकवत् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Having fasted on this Govindadvādaśī according to the prescribed rule, / [such persons] are seen shining in the world even today, like the moon.

sanskrit_iast:

yo dvādaśīṣu kururāja kṛtopavāsaḥ prāpnotyasau surabhilokamapetaśokam .. 14 ..
akhaṇḍadvādaśīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
गोविन्दमर्चयति गोरसभोजनस्तु गा वै विनोदयति तद्वद्गवाह्निकश्च ..
यो द्वादशीषु कुरुराज कृतोपवासः प्राप्नोत्यसौ सुरभिलोकमपेतशोकम् .. 14 ..
अखण्डद्वादशीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
He who worships Govinda, dining on the dairy products of cows, pleases cows, and likewise gives daily fodder for cows, / and fasts on the twelfth lunar days, O king of the Kurus, reaches the griefless world of Surabhi.
Description of the Votive Observance of Akhaṇḍadvādaśī

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..

dānadharme kṛtaṃ yasya vipākaṃ vada yādṛśaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:

दानधर्मे कृतं यस्य विपाकं वद यादृशः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / "O highly intelligent one, as for the defectiveness of fasting observances / that is incurred in the duty of giving, tell me what kind of ripening [of karma] it has."
title: adhyāyaḥ 079

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
yajñānāmupavāsānāṃ vratānāṃ ca nareśvara ..
vaikalyātphalavaikalyaṃ yādṛśa tacchṛṇuṣva me .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
यज्ञानामुपवासानां व्रतानां च नरेश्वर ..
वैकल्यात्फलवैकल्यं यादृश तच्छृणुष्व मे .. 2 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / "Of sacrifices, fasts, and votive observances, O lord of men, / hear from me what kind of defective reward comes from defectiveness:

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsānvinā khaṇḍaṃ prāpnuvaṃtyeva tāñchṛṇu ..
bhraṣṭaiśvaryā nirddhanāśca vasaṃti puruṣāḥ punaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
उपवासान्विना खण्डं प्राप्नुवंत्येव ताञ्छृणु ..
भ्रष्टैश्वर्या निर्द्धनाश्च वसंति पुरुषाः पुनः .. 3 ..
text_mt: Hear about those who incur a break [in observances] other than fasting: / they live as men fallen from fortune and destitute of wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
rūpaṃ tathottaraṃ prāpya vratavaikalyadoṣataḥ ..
kāṇāḥ kubjāśca ṣaṇḍāśca bhavaṃtyaṃdhāśca mānavāḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
रूपं तथोत्तरं प्राप्य व्रतवैकल्यदोषतः ..
काणाः कुब्जाश्च षण्डाश्च भवंत्यंधाश्च मानवाः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Even having attained an excellent form, through the fault of a defect in the votive observance, / men become one-eyed, hunchbacked, eunuchs, and blind.

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsī naraḥ patnīṃ nārīṃ prāpya tathā patim ..
viyogaṃ vratavaikalye durbhagatvamavāpnuyāt .. 5 ..
meaning:
उपवासी नरः पत्नीं नारीं प्राप्य तथा पतिम् ..
वियोगं व्रतवैकल्ये दुर्भगत्वमवाप्नुयात् .. 5 ..
text_mt: A fasting man, having obtained a wife, or a woman a husband, / would suffer separation and ill-fortune when there is a defect in the votive observance.

sanskrit_iast:
ye dravye satyadātārastathānne satyanagnayaḥ ..
kule vasaṃti duḥśīlā duṣkulāḥ śīlaniścaye .. 6 ..
meaning:
ये द्रव्ये सत्यदातारस्तथान्ने सत्यनग्नयः ..
कुले वसंति दुःशीला दुष्कुलाः शीलनिश्चये .. 6 ..
text_mt: Those who are ungenerous when wealth is present, and likewise unfed when food is present, / live bad-mannered in a [noble] family, or of low family when character is assured.

sanskrit_iast:
vastrānulepanairhīnā bhūṣaṇaiścātirūpiṇaḥ ..
virūparūpāśca tathā prasādhakaguṇānvitāḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
वस्त्रानुलेपनैर्हीना भूषणैश्चातिरूपिणः ..
विरूपरूपाश्च तथा प्रसाधकगुणान्विताः .. 7 ..
text_mt: Though exceedingly handsome, they are bereft of garments, unguents, and ornaments; / or they are ugly in appearance, though endowed with the qualities of an adorner.

sanskrit_iast:
te sarve vratavaikalyātphala vaikalyamāgatāḥ ..
tasmāttadvratavaikalyaṃ yajñavaikalyameva ca ..
upavāsena kartavyaṃ vaikalyādvikalaṃ phalam ..8..
meaning:
ते सर्वे व्रतवैकल्यात्फल वैकल्यमागताः ..
तस्मात्तद्व्रतवैकल्यं यज्ञवैकल्यमेव च ..
उपवासेन कर्तव्यं वैकल्याद्विकलं फलम् ..8..
text_mt: All of them have arrived at a defective reward because of a defect in the votive observance. / Therefore, that defect of a votive observance or defect of a sacrifice / must be made up through fasting; from defectiveness comes a defective result."

sanskrit_iast:

किं तत्र वद कर्तव्यमच्छिद्रं येन जायते .. 9 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / "If somehow there should be a defect in a fast or the like, / tell me what should be done there so that it becomes flawless."

sanskrit_iast:
vaikalyaṃ praśamaṃ yāti śṛṇuṣva gadato mama ..
mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ ..
kṛtopavāso deveśaṃ samabhyarcya janārdanam .. 11 ..
meaning:
वैकल्यं प्रशमं याति शृणुष्व गदतो मम ..
मार्गशीर्षे सिते पक्षे द्वादश्यां नियतः शुचिः ..
कृतोपवासो देवेशं समभ्यर्च्य जनार्दनम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Hear as I tell how the defect is pacified: / In Mārgaśīrṣa, on the twelfth lunar day of the bright fortnight, restrained, pure, / having observed a fast, and having worshipped Janārdana, the lord of gods,

sanskrit_iast:
snāto nārāyaṇaṃ brūyādbhuñjannārāyaṇaṃ tathā ..
gacchannārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ svapannārāyaṇaṃ punaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
स्नातो नारायणं ब्रूयाद्भुञ्जन्नारायणं तथा ..
गच्छन्नारायणं देवं स्वपन्नारायणं पुनः .. 12 ..
text_mt: having bathed, one should utter 'Nārāyaṇa'; while eating, likewise 'Nārāyaṇa'; / while walking, the god 'Nārāyaṇa'; and while sleeping, 'Nārāyaṇa'.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcagavyajalasnāto viśuddhātmā jitendriyaḥ ..
yavavrīhimayaṃ pātraṃ dattvā viprāya bhaktitaḥ ..
idamuccārayetpaścāddevasya purato hareḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
पञ्चगव्यजलस्नातो विशुद्धात्मा जितेन्द्रियः ..
यवव्रीहिमयं पात्रं दत्त्वा विप्राय भक्तितः ..
इदमुच्चारयेत्पश्चाद्देवस्य पुरतो हरेः .. 13 ..
text_mt: Bathed in water mixed with the five products of the cow, purified in soul, with senses conquered, / having given a vessel filled with barley and rice to a brāhmaṇa with devotion, / one should then utter this before the god Hari:

sanskrit_iast:
saptajanmani yatkiñcinmayā khaṇḍavrataṃ kṛtam ..
bhagavaṃstvatprasādena tadakhaṃḍamihāstu me .. 14 ..
meaning:
सप्तजन्मनि यत्किञ्चिन्मया खण्डव्रतं कृतम् ..
भगवंस्त्वत्प्रसादेन तदखंडमिहास्तु मे .. 14 ..
text_mt: 'Whatever broken observance was performed by me in seven lifetimes, / O Blessed One, by your grace may that become unbroken for me here!

sanskrit_iast:
yathākhaṃḍaṃ jagatsarvaṃ tvameva puruṣottama ..
tathākhilānyakhaṃḍāni vratāni mama saṃtu vai .. 15 ..
meaning:
यथाखंडं जगत्सर्वं त्वमेव पुरुषोत्तम ..
तथाखिलान्यखंडानि व्रतानि मम संतु वै .. 15 ..
text_mt: Just as the entire universe is unbroken, you yourself, O supreme person, / so indeed let all my votive observances be unbroken!'

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhirapi māsaistu pāraṇaṃ prathamaṃ smṛtam ..
prīṇanaṃ ca hareḥ kuryātpārite pāraṇe tataḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
चतुर्भिरपि मासैस्तु पारणं प्रथमं स्मृतम् ..
प्रीणनं च हरेः कुर्यात्पारिते पारणे ततः .. 16 ..
text_mt: The first conclusion of the fast is taught to be after four months; / then, when the fast's conclusion has been accomplished, one should propitiate Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
caitrādiṣu ca māseṣu caturguṇyaṃ tu pāraṇam ..

meaning:
चैत्रादिषु च मासेषु चतुर्गुण्यं तु पारणम् ..
तत्रापि सक्तुपात्राणि दद्याच्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः .. 17 ..
text_mt: In the months beginning with Caitra, the conclusion of the fast is of fourfold quality; / there too, endowed with faith, one should give vessels of barley flour.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvaṇādiṣu māseṣu kārttikāṃteṣu pāraṇam ..
tatrāpi ghṛtapātrāṇi dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇāḥ .. .. 18 ..
meaning:
श्रावणादिषु मासेषु कार्त्तिकांतेषु पारणम् ..
तत्रापि घृतपात्राणि दद्याद्विप्राय दक्षिणाः .. .. 18 ..
text_mt: In the months beginning with Śrāvaṇa and ending with Kārttika is the conclusion of the fast; / there too, one should give vessels of clarified butter and sacrificial fees to a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sauvarṇaṃ raupyaṃ tāmraṃ ca mṛnmayaṃ pātramiṣyate ..
svaśaktyapekṣayā rājanpālāśaṃ vāpi kārayet .. 19 ..
meaning:
सौवर्णं रौप्यं ताम्रं च मृन्मयं पात्रमिष्यते ..
स्वशक्त्यपेक्षया राजन्पालाशं वापि कारयेत् .. 19 ..
text_mt: A golden, silver, copper, or earthen vessel is desired; / or, according to one's own means, O king, one may have one made of palāśa wood.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte brāhmaṇānsa jitendriyaḥ ..
dvādaśāmantrya viprāṃśca bhojayeddhṛtapāyasaiḥ .. 4.79.20 ..
meaning:
एवं संवत्सरस्यांते ब्राह्मणान्स जितेन्द्रियः ..
द्वादशामन्त्र्य विप्रांश्च भोजयेद्धृतपायसैः .. 4.79.20 ..
text_mt: Thus, at the end of the year, having conquered his senses, / having invited twelve brāhmaṇas, he should feed the priests with milk-rice and clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
vastrābharaṇadānaiśca praṇipatya kṣamāpayet ..
upadeṣṭāramapyatra pūjayedvidhivadgurum .. 21 ..
meaning:
वस्त्राभरणदानैश्च प्रणिपत्य क्षमापयेत् ..
उपदेष्टारमप्यत्र पूजयेद्विधिवद्गुरुम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: With gifts of garments and ornaments, prostrating oneself, one should beg their forgiveness; / and here one should also worship the preceptor, the spiritual guide, according to the rule.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ samyagyathānyāyyamakhaṃḍadvādaśīṃ naraḥ ..
samupoṣya akhaṃḍasya vratasya phalamaśnute .. 22 ..
meaning:
एवं सम्यग्यथान्याय्यमखंडद्वादशीं नरः ..
समुपोष्य अखंडस्य व्रतस्य फलमश्नुते .. 22 ..
text_mt: Having thus fasted on the Akhaṇḍadvādaśī fully and in the proper manner, / a man enjoys the reward of an unbroken votive observance.

sanskrit_iast:
saptajanmasu vaikalyaṃ yadvratasya kvacitkṛtam ..
karotyavikalaṃ sarvamakhaṃḍadvādaśī tu tat .. 23 ..
meaning:
सप्तजन्मसु वैकल्यं यद्व्रतस्य क्वचित्कृतम् ..
करोत्यविकलं सर्वमखंडद्वादशी तु तत् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Whatever defect of a votive observance was committed anywhere in seven births, / the Akhaṇḍadvādaśī makes all of that completely flawless.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādeṣā prayatnena naraiḥ strībhiśca suvrata ..
akhaṃḍadvādaśī samyagupoṣyā phalakāṃkṣayā ..24 ..
meaning:
तस्मादेषा प्रयत्नेन नरैः स्त्रीभिश्च सुव्रत ..
अखंडद्वादशी सम्यगुपोष्या फलकांक्षया ..24 ..
text_mt: Therefore, O you of noble vows, this Akhaṇḍadvādaśī should be observed with fasting diligently and properly by men and women desiring [its] fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
ye dvādaśīvratamakhaṃḍamiti prasiddhaṃ mārgottamāṅgamadhikṛtya kṛtena yena ..
khaṃḍavratāni puruṣaiḥ sukṛtāni yāni saṃpūrṇatāṃ samupayānti hareḥ prasādāt .. 25 ..
manorathadvādaśīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
ये द्वादशीव्रतमखंडमिति प्रसिद्धं मार्गोत्तमाङ्गमधिकृत्य कृतेन येन ..
खंडव्रतानि पुरुषैः सुकृतानि यानि संपूर्णतां समुपयान्ति हरेः प्रसादात् .. 25 ..
मनोरथद्वादशीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Those broken votive observances that were well-performed by men, through this well-known Akhaṇḍadvādaśī observance undertaken on the crown of months (Mārgaśīrṣa), reach completeness by the grace of Hari.
Description of the Manorathadvādaśī Votive Observance

.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..

text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Having fasted on the eleventh [lunar day] of the dark fortnight of Phālguna, / a man or a woman, having worshipped the Lord of the world,
title: adhyāyaḥ 080

uttiṣṭhanprasvapaṃścaiva harimevānukīrtayet .. 2 ..
meaning:
हरेर्नाम वदन्भक्त्या भावयुक्तो युधिष्ठिर ..
उत्तिष्ठन्प्रस्वपंश्चैव हरिमेवानुकीर्तयेत् .. 2 ..
text_mt: uttering the name of Hari with devotion, full of faith, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / whether rising or sleeping, should praise Hari alone.

sanskrit_iast:

snātvā samyaksamabhyarcya dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām .. 3 ..
meaning:
ततोन्यस्मिन्दिने प्राप्ते द्रादश्यां नियतो हरिम् ..
स्नात्वा सम्यक्समभ्यर्च्य दत्त्वा विप्राय दक्षिणाम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Then, when the next day arrives, on the twelfth [lunar day], self-restrained, / having bathed and thoroughly worshipped Hari, having given a fee to a brāhmaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
harimuddiśya caivāgnau ghṛtahomakṛtakriyaḥ ..
praṇipatya jagannāthamiti vāṇīmudīrayeta .. 4 ..
meaning:
हरिमुद्दिश्य चैवाग्नौ घृतहोमकृतक्रियः ..
प्रणिपत्य जगन्नाथमिति वाणीमुदीरयेत .. 4 ..
text_mt: and having performed the rite of offering ghee into the fire for the sake of Hari, / having bowed down to the Lord of the universe, one should utter these words:

sanskrit_iast:
pātālasaṃsthāṃ vasudhāṃ yāṃ prasādya manorathā..
avāpa vāsudevosau pradadyāttu manorathān ..5..
meaning:
पातालसंस्थां वसुधां यां प्रसाद्य मनोरथा..
अवाप वासुदेवोसौ प्रदद्यात्तु मनोरथान् ..5..
text_mt: "That Vāsudeva who, propitiating whom [brought about] desires, / obtained the earth situated in the netherworld, may he grant [my] desires.

sanskrit_iast:
yamabhyarcya divi prāptaḥ sakalāṃśca manorathān ..
bhraṣṭarājyaśca devendro yamabhyarcya jagatpatim .. 6 ..
meaning:
यमभ्यर्च्य दिवि प्राप्तः सकलांश्च मनोरथान् ..
भ्रष्टराज्यश्च देवेन्द्रो यमभ्यर्च्य जगत्पतिम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: By worshipping whom, Indra, fallen from his realm, reached all desires in heaven— / by worshipping which Lord of the world

sanskrit_iast:
manorathānabhinavānprāptavāṃśca manoharān ..
evamabhyarcya pūjāṃ ca niṣpādya ca harestataḥ ..
bhuñjīta prayataḥ samyaghaviṣyaṃ pāṃḍunandana .. 7 ..
meaning:
मनोरथानभिनवान्प्राप्तवांश्च मनोहरान् ..
एवमभ्यर्च्य पूजां च निष्पाद्य च हरेस्ततः ..
भुञ्जीत प्रयतः सम्यघविष्यं पांडुनन्दन .. 7 ..
text_mt: he obtained fresh and charming desires;" / having worshipped thus and completed the worship of Hari, / one should eat, self-restrained and properly, sacrificial food, O son of Pāṇḍu.

sanskrit_iast:
phālgune caitre vaiśākhe jyeṣṭhe māsi ca sattama ..
caturbhiḥ pāraṇaṃ māsairebhirniṣpāditaṃ bhavet .. 8 ..
meaning:
फाल्गुने चैत्रे वैशाखे ज्येष्ठे मासि च सत्तम ..
चतुर्भिः पारणं मासैरेभिर्निष्पादितं भवेत् .. 8 ..
text_mt: In the months of Phālguna, Caitra, Vaiśākha, and Jyeṣṭha, O best of men, / the breaking of the fast should be accomplished over these four months.

sanskrit_iast:
raktapuṣpaiśca caturo māsā nkurvīta cārcanam ..
dahettu gugguluṃ prāśya gośṛṃgakṣālanaṃ jalam ..9..
meaning:
रक्तपुष्पैश्च चतुरो मासा न्कुर्वीत चार्चनम् ..
दहेत्तु गुग्गुलुं प्राश्य गोशृंगक्षालनं जलम् ..9..
text_mt: One should perform worship for four months with red flowers, / burn guggulu, and consume water washed over a cow's horn.

sanskrit_iast:
haviṣyānnaṃ ca naivedyamātmanaścāpi bhojanam ..
tataśca śrūyatāṃ pārtha āṣāḍhādau tu yā kriyā ..4.80.1 0..
meaning:
हविष्यान्नं च नैवेद्यमात्मनश्चापि भोजनम् ..
ततश्च श्रूयतां पार्थ आषाढादौ तु या क्रिया ..4.80.1 0..
text_mt: Sacrificial food is the offering [to the deity] and also the meal for oneself. / And then, O son of Pṛthā, listen to the rite in Āṣāḍha and the following [months]:

sanskrit_iast:
jātīpuṣpāṇi dhūpaśca śastaḥ sārjaraso nṛpa ..
prāśya darbhodakaṃ cāsya śālyannaṃ ca nivedanam ..11..
meaning:
जातीपुष्पाणि धूपश्च शस्तः सार्जरसो नृप ..
प्राश्य दर्भोदकं चास्य शाल्यन्नं च निवेदनम् ..11..
text_mt: Jasmine flowers and incense of resin are prescribed, O king; / after consuming darbha grass water, one's offering to him is cooked śāli rice.

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ tadeva cāśnīyāccheṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret ..
kārtikādiṣu māseṣu gomūtraṃ kāyaśodhanam ..12..
meaning:
स्वयं तदेव चाश्नीयाच्छेषं पूर्ववदाचरेत् ..
कार्तिकादिषु मासेषु गोमूत्रं कायशोधनम् ..12..
text_mt: One should oneself eat that very [food]; the rest should be performed as before. / In the months beginning with Kārtika, cow urine is the purifier of the body.

sanskrit_iast:
sugaṃdhiścecchayā dhūpaṃ pūjā bhṛṃgārakena ca ..
kāṃsāraṃ cātra naivedyamaśnīyāttacca vai svayam ..13..
meaning:
सुगंधिश्चेच्छया धूपं पूजा भृंगारकेन च ..
कांसारं चात्र नैवेद्यमश्नीयात्तच्च वै स्वयम् ..13..
text_mt: Fragrant incense as desired, worship with a water pitcher, / and the offering of kāṃsāra sweetmeat here, which one should indeed eat oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
pratimāsaṃ ca viprāya dātavyā dakṣiṇā tathā ..
pāraṇaṃ cecchayā viṣṇoḥ pāraṇe pāvane mate .. 14 ..
meaning:
प्रतिमासं च विप्राय दातव्या दक्षिणा तथा ..
पारणं चेच्छया विष्णोः पारणे पावने मते .. 14 ..
text_mt: And every month a fee is to be given to a brāhmaṇa in like manner; / the breaking of the fast may be at will, deemed sacred in the breaking of Viṣṇu's fast.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāśaktyā yathāprītyā vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet ..
sadbhāvenaiva goviṃdaḥ pūjitaḥ prīyate yataḥ ..15..
meaning:
यथाशक्त्या यथाप्रीत्या वित्तशाठ्यं विवर्जयेत् ..
सद्भावेनैव गोविंदः पूजितः प्रीयते यतः ..15..
text_mt: According to one's means, according to one's affection, one should avoid deception in wealth, / since Govinda, worshipped with pure heart alone, is pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
pāraṇāṃte yathāśakti snāpitaḥ pūjito hariḥ ..
prīṇitaścepsitānkāmāṃstāndadātyavyayān nṛpa ..16..
meaning:
पारणांते यथाशक्ति स्नापितः पूजितो हरिः ..
प्रीणितश्चेप्सितान्कामांस्तान्ददात्यव्ययान् नृप ..16..
text_mt: At the end of the fast-breaking, Hari, bathed and worshipped according to one's means, / being pleased, grants those imperishable desired wishes, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣāṃte pratimāmiṣṭāṃ kārayitvā suśobhanām..
svarṇakena yathā śaktyā śaṃkhaśārṅgavibhūṣitām .. 17 ..
meaning:
वर्षांते प्रतिमामिष्टां कारयित्वा सुशोभनाम्..
स्वर्णकेन यथा शक्त्या शंखशार्ङ्गविभूषिताम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: At the end of the year, having had a beloved, very beautiful image made / of gold according to one's means, adorned with a conch and the Śārṅga bow,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpavastrayugacchannāṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ..
dvādaśa brāhmaṇāṃstatra bhojayitvā kṣamāpayet ..18..
meaning:
पुष्पवस्त्रयुगच्छन्नां ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ..
द्वादश ब्राह्मणांस्तत्र भोजयित्वा क्षमापयेत् ..18..
text_mt: covered with a pair of flower-patterned garments, one should present it to a brāhmaṇa. / Having fed twelve brāhmaṇas there, one should ask their pardon.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśātra pradātavyāḥ kuṃbhāḥ sānnajalākṣatāḥ ..
chatropānadyugaiḥ sārddhaṃ dakṣiṇābhiśca bhārata .. 19 ..
meaning:
द्वादशात्र प्रदातव्याः कुंभाः सान्नजलाक्षताः ..
छत्रोपानद्युगैः सार्द्धं दक्षिणाभिश्च भारत .. 19 ..
text_mt: Twelve jars filled with cooked grain, water, and unbroken grains are to be given here, / together with pairs of parasols and sandals, and with fees, O Bhārata.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā puṇyā pāpaharā dvādaśī phalamicchatām ..
yathābhilaṣitānkāmāndadāti nṛpasattama ..4.80.20..
meaning:
एषा पुण्या पापहरा द्वादशी फलमिच्छताम् ..
यथाभिलषितान्कामान्ददाति नृपसत्तम ..4.80.20..
text_mt: This holy, sin-destroying twelfth [lunar day], to those who desire fruit, / grants wishes just as desired, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrayatyakhilānbhaktyā yataścaiṣāṃ manorathān ..
manorathā dvādaśīyaṃ tato lokeṣu viśrutā ..21..
meaning:
पूरयत्यखिलान्भक्त्या यतश्चैषां मनोरथान् ..
मनोरथा द्वादशीयं ततो लोकेषु विश्रुता ..21..
text_mt: And since through devotion it fulfills all their desires, / therefore this twelfth [lunar day] is renowned in the worlds as Manorathā ("Desire-granting").

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣyaitāṃ tribhuvanaṃ labdhamindreṇa vai purā ..
ādityāśceṣṭitāḥ putrā dhanamauśanasā tathā .. 22 ..
meaning:
उपोष्यैतां त्रिभुवनं लब्धमिन्द्रेण वै पुरा ..
आदित्याश्चेष्टिताः पुत्रा धनमौशनसा तथा .. 22 ..
text_mt: Having fasted on this [day] of old, the three worlds were indeed obtained by Indra, / sons were obtained by the Ādityas, and wealth likewise by the son of Uśanas (Śukra).

sanskrit_iast:
dhaumyenādhyayanaṃ prāptamanyaiścābhimataṃ phalam ..
rājarṣibhistathā vipraiḥ strīviṭśūdraiśca bhūtale .. 23 ..
meaning:
धौम्येनाध्ययनं प्राप्तमन्यैश्चाभिमतं फलम् ..
राजर्षिभिस्तथा विप्रैः स्त्रीविट्शूद्रैश्च भूतले .. 23 ..
text_mt: Vedic study was attained by Dhaumya, and desired fruit by others, / by royal sages, by brāhmaṇas, and on earth by women, vaiśyas, and śūdras.

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃyaṃ kāmamabhidhyāya vratametadupoṣitam ..
tattadāpnotyasaṃdigdhaṃ viṣṇorārādhanodyataḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
यंयं काममभिध्याय व्रतमेतदुपोषितम् ..
तत्तदाप्नोत्यसंदिग्धं विष्णोराराधनोद्यतः .. 24 ..
text_mt: Whatever desire one ponders while observing this votive fast, / that very thing one undoubtedly obtains, intent upon the worship of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
aputro labhate putramadhano labhate dhanam ..
rogābhibhūtaścārogyaṃ kanyā prāpnoti satpatim .. 25 ..
meaning:
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रमधनो लभते धनम् ..
रोगाभिभूतश्चारोग्यं कन्या प्राप्नोति सत्पतिम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: The childless obtains a son; the poor obtains wealth; / one afflicted by disease [attains] freedom from illness; a maiden obtains a good husband.

sanskrit_iast:
samāgamaṃ pravasanairupoṣyaitāmavāpyate ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti mṛtaḥ svarge ca modate .. 26 ..
meaning:
समागमं प्रवसनैरुपोष्यैतामवाप्यते ..
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति मृतः स्वर्गे च मोदते .. 26 ..
text_mt: Reunion with those living abroad is obtained by fasting on this [day]; / one attains all desires, and upon death rejoices in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
nāputro nādhano jyeṣṭho viyogī na ca nirguṇaḥ ..
upoṣyaitadvrataṃ martyaḥ strīśūdro vāpi jāyate .. 27 ..
meaning:
नापुत्रो नाधनो ज्येष्ठो वियोगी न च निर्गुणः ..
उपोष्यैतद्व्रतं मर्त्यः स्त्रीशूद्रो वापि जायते .. 27 ..
text_mt: Neither childless, nor poor, nor an outcaste, nor separated [from kin], nor devoid of virtues / is a mortal born, whether a woman or even a śūdra, after fasting on this votive observance.

sanskrit_iast:
svargaloke sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāmayutāni ca ..
bhogānabhimatānbhuktvā tatratatra yathecchayā .. 28 ..
meaning:
स्वर्गलोके सहस्राणि वर्षाणामयुतानि च ..
भोगानभिमतान्भुक्त्वा तत्रतत्र यथेच्छया .. 28 ..
text_mt: In the heavenly world, for tens of thousands of years, / having enjoyed desired pleasures there at will,

sanskrit_iast:
iha puṇyavatāṃ nṝṇāṃ dhanināṃ laghuśālinām ..
gṛhe prajāyate rājansarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
इह पुण्यवतां नॄणां धनिनां लघुशालिनाम् ..
गृहे प्रजायते राजन्सर्वव्याधिविवर्जितः .. 29 ..
text_mt: here [on earth], in the house of virtuous, wealthy, and noble men, / one is born, O king, free from all diseases.

sanskrit_iast:
na dvādaśīmupavasanti manorathākhyāṃ naivārcayaṃti puruṣottamamādidevam ..
gobrāhmaṇāṃśca na namaṃti na pūjayaṃti ye te manobhilaṣitaṃ kathamāpnuvaṃti .. 4.80.30 ..
ulkānavamīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
न द्वादशीमुपवसन्ति मनोरथाख्यां नैवार्चयंति पुरुषोत्तममादिदेवम् ..
गोब्राह्मणांश्च न नमंति न पूजयंति ये ते मनोभिलषितं कथमाप्नुवंति .. 4.80.30 ..
उल्कानवमीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Those who do not fast on the twelfth [lunar day] named Manorathā, nor worship the Supreme Spirit, the primordial god, / nor bow to or revere cows and brāhmaṇas—how do they obtain their heart's desire?
Description of the Tiladvādaśī Votive Observance

sanskrit_iast:
..yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
alpāyāsena bhagavandhanenālpena vā vibho ..
pāpaṃ praśamamāyāti yena tadvaktumarhasi .. .. 1 ..
meaning:
..युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
अल्पायासेन भगवन्धनेनाल्पेन वा विभो ..
पापं प्रशममायाति येन तद्वक्तुमर्हसि .. .. 1 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / With little effort, O Blessed One, or with little wealth, O Lord, / by which sin goes to cessation—you ought to speak of that.
title: Ulkānavamīvratavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu pārtha parāṃ puṇyāṃ dvādaśīṃ pāpanāśinīm ..
yāmupoṣya paraṃ puṇyamāpnuyācchraddhayānvitaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
शृणु पार्थ परां पुण्यां द्वादशीं पापनाशिनीम् ..
यामुपोष्य परं पुण्यमाप्नुयाच्छ्रद्धयान्वितः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Hear, O son of Pṛthā, of the supreme, holy twelfth [lunar day] that destroys sin, / by fasting on which, endowed with faith, one attains supreme merit.

sanskrit_iast:
māghamāse ca saṃprāpte āṣāḍharkṣaṃ bhavedyadi ..
mūlaṃ vā kṛṣṇapakṣasya dvādaśyāṃ niyatavrataḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
माघमासे च संप्राप्ते आषाढर्क्षं भवेद्यदि ..
मूलं वा कृष्णपक्षस्य द्वादश्यां नियतव्रतः .. 3 ..
text_mt: When the month of Māgha arrives, if there should be the asterism of Āṣāḍhā / or Mūla on the twelfth [lunar day] of the dark fortnight, one firm in vows

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhṇīyātpuṇyaphaladaṃ vidhānaṃ tasya me śṛṇu ..
devadevaṃ samabhyarcya susnātaḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
गृह्णीयात्पुण्यफलदं विधानं तस्य मे शृणु ..
देवदेवं समभ्यर्च्य सुस्नातः प्रयतः शुचिः .. 4 ..
text_mt: should undertake it, which yields holy fruit; listen to its procedure from me: / Having worshipped the God of gods, well-bathed, self-restrained, and pure,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇanāmnā ca saṃpūjya ekādaśyāṃ mahāmate ..
upoṣito dvitīyehni punaḥ saṃpūjya keśavam .. 5 ..
meaning:
कृष्णनाम्ना च संपूज्य एकादश्यां महामते ..
उपोषितो द्वितीयेह्नि पुनः संपूज्य केशवम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: having worshipped [him] with the name of Kṛṣṇa on the eleventh [lunar day], O wise one, / having fasted, on the second day, having worshipped Keśava again,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃstūya nāmnā tenaiva kṛṣṇākhyena punaḥpunaḥ ..
dadyāttilāṃśca viprāya kṛṣṇo me prīyatāmiti .. 6 ..
meaning:
संस्तूय नाम्ना तेनैव कृष्णाख्येन पुनःपुनः ..
दद्यात्तिलांश्च विप्राय कृष्णो मे प्रीयतामिति .. 6 ..
text_mt: having praised him repeatedly with that very name of Kṛṣṇa, / one should give sesame seeds to a brāhmaṇa, saying, "May Kṛṣṇa be pleased with me."

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca prāśayecchastāṃstathā kṛṣṇatilānnṛpa ..
viṣṇuprīṇanamaṃtrokte samāpte varṣapāraṇe .. 7 ..
meaning:
ततश्च प्राशयेच्छस्तांस्तथा कृष्णतिलान्नृप ..
विष्णुप्रीणनमंत्रोक्ते समाप्ते वर्षपारणे .. 7 ..
text_mt: And then one should consume the praised black sesame seeds, O king, / when the yearly fast-breaking, pronounced with mantras pleasing to Viṣṇu, is completed.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇakuṃbhāṃstilaiḥ sārddhaṃ pakvānnena ca saṃyutāḥ ..
chatropānadyugairvastraiḥ sahitā annagarbhiṇaḥ ..
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradeyāste yathāvanmāsasaṃkhyayā .. 8 ..
meaning:
कृष्णकुंभांस्तिलैः सार्द्धं पक्वान्नेन च संयुताः ..
छत्रोपानद्युगैर्वस्त्रैः सहिता अन्नगर्भिणः ..
ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रदेयास्ते यथावन्माससंख्यया .. 8 ..
text_mt: Black jars filled with sesame seeds, along with cooked food, / provided with umbrellas, pairs of shoes, garments, and filled with grains, / should be properly given to brāhmaṇas according to the number of months.

sanskrit_iast:
tilaprarohājjāyaṃte yāvatsaṃkhyāstilā nṛpa ..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ..
arogo jāyate nityaṃ naro janmanijanmani .. 9 ..
meaning:
तिलप्ररोहाज्जायंते यावत्संख्यास्तिला नृप ..
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते ..
अरोगो जायते नित्यं नरो जन्मनिजन्मनि .. 9 ..
text_mt: As many sesame seeds as are produced from the sprout of a sesame, O king, / for that many thousands of years one is honoured in the world of heaven; / a man is constantly born free from disease in birth after birth.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃdho na badhiraścaiva na kuṣṭhī na ca kutsitaḥ ..
bhavatyetāmuṣitvā tu tilākhyāṃ dvādaśīṃ naraḥ .. 4.81.10 ..
meaning:
अंधो न बधिरश्चैव न कुष्ठी न च कुत्सितः ..
भवत्येतामुषित्वा तु तिलाख्यां द्वादशीं नरः .. 4.81.10 ..
text_mt: Neither blind, nor deaf, nor a leper, nor deformed / does a man become after observing this twelfth [day] named Tilā.

sanskrit_iast:
anena pārtha vidhinā tiladātā na saṃśayaḥ ..
mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvairanāyāsena mānavaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
अनेन पार्थ विधिना तिलदाता न संशयः ..
मुच्यते पातकैः सर्वैरनायासेन मानवः .. 11 ..
text_mt: By this procedure, O son of Pṛthā, the giver of sesame, without a doubt, / is easily liberated from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
dānaṃ vidhistathā śrāddhaṃ sarvapātakaśāṃtaye ..
nārthaḥ prabhūto nāyāsaḥ śarīre nṛpasattama .. 12 ..
meaning:
दानं विधिस्तथा श्राद्धं सर्वपातकशांतये ..
नार्थः प्रभूतो नायासः शरीरे नृपसत्तम .. 12 ..
text_mt: The gift, the ritual, and likewise the śrāddha are for the appeasement of all sins; / there is neither great expense nor physical distress, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvopabhoganiratohni pare daśamyāṃ snānaṃ tilaistilanivedanakṛttilāśī ..
dattvā tilāndvijavarāya virājaketu saṃpūjya viṣṇupadavīṃ samupaiti martyaḥ .. 13 ..
sukṛtadvādaśīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
सर्वोपभोगनिरतोह्नि परे दशम्यां स्नानं तिलैस्तिलनिवेदनकृत्तिलाशी ..
दत्त्वा तिलान्द्विजवराय विराजकेतु संपूज्य विष्णुपदवीं समुपैति मर्त्यः .. 13 ..
सुकृतद्वादशीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Engrossed in every enjoyment on the previous day, on the tenth [day] bathing with sesame, offering sesame, eating sesame, / giving sesame to an excellent twice-born, [and] worshipping the One with the bird on his banner, a mortal attains the abode of Viṣṇu.
Description of the Sukṛtadvādaśī Vrata.

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
yanna tāpāya vai puṃsāṃ bhavatyāmuṣmikaṃ kṛtam ..
tadapāpāya bhavati tadācakṣva yadūttama .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
यन्न तापाय वै पुंसां भवत्यामुष्मिकं कृतम् ..
तदपापाय भवति तदाचक्ष्व यदूत्तम .. 1 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / What is done for the other world does not lead to torment for men; / tell that which leads to freedom from sin, O best of the Yadus.
title: Sukṛtadvādaśīvratavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsaprabhāvaṃ vai kṛṣṇārādhanakāṃkṣiṇām ..
kathayeha mahābāho naiva tṛpyāmi jalpataḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
उपवासप्रभावं वै कृष्णाराधनकांक्षिणाम् ..
कथयेह महाबाहो नैव तृप्यामि जल्पतः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Tell here the power of fasting for those who desire the worship of Kṛṣṇa, / O mighty-armed one; I am not satisfied by your speech.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śrūyatāṃ pārtha yatpṛṣṭāḥ kautukādbhavatā vayam ..
āmuṣmikaṃ na tāpāya pratāpāya ca jāyate .. 3 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
श्रूयतां पार्थ यत्पृष्टाः कौतुकाद्भवता वयम् ..
आमुष्मिकं न तापाय प्रतापाय च जायते .. 3 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Listen, O son of Pṛthā, to what we are asked by you out of curiosity; / what is done for the other world does not lead to torment, but results in majesty.

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣitaprabhāvaṃ ca kṛṣṇārādhanakāṃkṣiṇām ..
kathayāmi yathāvṛttaṃ pūrvameva narottama .. 4 ..
meaning:
उपोषितप्रभावं च कृष्णाराधनकांक्षिणाम् ..
कथयामि यथावृत्तं पूर्वमेव नरोत्तम .. 4 ..
text_mt: And the power of fasting for those who desire the worship of Kṛṣṇa / I shall tell just as it happened formerly, O best of men.

sanskrit_iast:
vaidiśaṃ nāma nagaraṃ prakhyātaṃ nṛpasattama ..
tatra vaiśyo'bhavatpūrvaṃ sīrabhadra iti śrutaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
वैदिशं नाम नगरं प्रख्यातं नृपसत्तम ..
तत्र वैश्योऽभवत्पूर्वं सीरभद्र इति श्रुतः .. 5 ..
text_mt: There is a renowned city named Vaidiśa, O best of kings; / there lived formerly a vaiśya known as Sīrabhadra.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāryayā mātṛduhitā putrapautraiḥ samanvitaḥ ..
prabhūta bhṛtyavargaśca bahuvyāpārakārakaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
भार्यया मातृदुहिता पुत्रपौत्रैः समन्वितः ..
प्रभूत भृत्यवर्गश्च बहुव्यापारकारकः .. 6 ..
text_mt: Accompanied by his wife, mother, daughter, sons, and grandsons, / possessing a large group of servants, and carrying on many trades,

sanskrit_iast:
putrapautrādibharaṇe vyāsaktirmatireva ca ..
paralokaṃ prati matistasya nāsītkadācana .. 7 ..
meaning:
पुत्रपौत्रादिभरणे व्यासक्तिर्मतिरेव च ..
परलोकं प्रति मतिस्तस्य नासीत्कदाचन .. 7 ..
text_mt: his mind and intellect were deeply attached to supporting his sons, grandsons, and others; / his mind was never turned towards the other world.

sanskrit_iast:
cakārānudinaṃ so'tha nyāyānyāyairddhanārjanam ..
sarvatrānyatra niḥsnehaḥ putrasnehapariplutaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
चकारानुदिनं सोऽथ न्यायान्यायैर्द्धनार्जनम् ..
सर्वत्रान्यत्र निःस्नेहः पुत्रस्नेहपरिप्लुतः .. 8 ..
text_mt: Then, day by day, he acquired wealth by fair means and foul; / devoid of affection everywhere else, he was overflowed with love for his sons.

sanskrit_iast:
na juhotyudite kāle na dadātyatitṛṣṇayā ..
babhūva codyamastasya putrādibharaṇe paraḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
न जुहोत्युदिते काले न ददात्यतितृष्णया ..
बभूव चोद्यमस्तस्य पुत्रादिभरणे परः .. 9 ..
text_mt: He did not offer sacrifice at the proper time; he did not give out of excessive greed; / and his exertion was entirely devoted to maintaining his sons and others.

sanskrit_iast:
nityanaimittikānāṃ ca hāniṃ cakre svakarmaṇā ..
tṛṣṇābhibhūto rājendra svavargabharaṇojjhitaḥ .. 4.82.10 ..
meaning:
नित्यनैमित्तिकानां च हानिं चक्रे स्वकर्मणा ..
तृष्णाभिभूतो राजेन्द्र स्ववर्गभरणोज्झितः .. 4.82.10 ..
text_mt: Through his own conduct he caused the neglect of daily and occasional rites; / overcome by greed, O lord of kings, he neglected the maintenance of his own kindred.

sanskrit_iast:
kālenāgacchatāso'tha mṛto viṃdhyāṭavītaṭe ..
yātanādehabhṛtpreto grīṣmakāle'bhavannṛpa .. 11 ..
meaning:
कालेनागच्छतासोऽथ मृतो विंध्याटवीतटे ..
यातनादेहभृत्प्रेतो ग्रीष्मकालेऽभवन्नृप .. 11 ..
text_mt: Then in the course of time he died on the edge of the Vindhya forest; / bearing a body of torture, he became a preta in the summer season, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dadarśa mahābhāgo divyayānasamanvitaḥ ..
