text_mt: She said: "I too will perform this supreme votive observance in this manner. / What is the rule for it? What is the gift? Whose worship [is performed]?"

sanskrit_iast:
.. striya ūcuḥ .. ..
śīle pakvānnaprasthasya punnāmnaḥ sukṛtasya tu ..
arddhaṃ viprāya dātavyamarddhamātmani bhojanam .. 29 ..
meaning:
.. स्त्रिय ऊचुः .. ..
शीले पक्वान्नप्रस्थस्य पुन्नाम्नः सुकृतस्य तु ..
अर्द्धं विप्राय दातव्यमर्द्धमात्मनि भोजनम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: The women said: / "O Śīlā, of a prastha of cooked food, well made and bearing a male name, / half should be given to a Brahmin, and half is for eating oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
kartavyaṃ tu sarittīre kathāṃ śrutvā harerimām ..
anaṃtānaṃtamabhyarcya maṃḍale gaṃdhadīpakaiḥ .. 30 ..
meaning:
कर्तव्यं तु सरित्तीरे कथां श्रुत्वा हरेरिमाम् ..
अनंतानंतमभ्यर्च्य मंडले गंधदीपकैः .. 30 ..
text_mt: It should be performed on a riverbank after hearing this story of Hari, / having worshipped Ananta, the boundless, on a maṇḍala with perfumes, lamps,

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sanaivedyaiḥ pītālaktaiścatuḥśataiḥ ..
tasyāgrato dṛḍhaṃ sūtraṃ kuṃkumāktaṃ sudorakam .. 31 ..
meaning:
धूपैः पुष्पैः सनैवेद्यैः पीतालक्तैश्चतुःशतैः ..
तस्याग्रतो दृढं सूत्रं कुंकुमाक्तं सुदोरकम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: incense, flowers, food offerings, and four hundred yellow lac marks. / In front of him, a strong cord smeared with saffron, an excellent thread

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaśagraṃthiyutaṃ vāme strī dakṣiṇe pumān ..
maṃtreṇānena rājendra yāvadvarṣaṃ samāpyate .. 32 ..
meaning:
चतुर्दशग्रंथियुतं वामे स्त्री दक्षिणे पुमान् ..
मंत्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र यावद्वर्षं समाप्यते .. 32 ..
text_mt: furnished with fourteen knots, [should be tied] on the left [arm] for a woman, and on the right for a man, / with this mantra, O lord of kings, until the year is completed:

sanskrit_iast:
anaṃta saṃsāramahāsamudre magnānsamabhyuddhara vāsudeva ..
anaṃtarūpe viniyojitātmā hyanaṃtarūpāya namonamaste .. 33 ..
meaning:
अनंत संसारमहासमुद्रे मग्नान्समभ्युद्धर वासुदेव ..
अनंतरूपे विनियोजितात्मा ह्यनंतरूपाय नमोनमस्ते .. 33 ..
text_mt: 'O Ananta, rescue those submerged in the great ocean of cyclic existence, O Vāsudeva! / Having applied my soul to your infinite form, homage, homage to you whose form is infinite!'

sanskrit_iast:
anena dorakaṃ baddhvā bhoktavyaṃ svasthamānasaiḥ ..
dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ devamanaṃtaṃ viśvarūpiṇam .. 34 ..
meaning:
अनेन दोरकं बद्ध्वा भोक्तव्यं स्वस्थमानसैः ..
ध्यात्वा नारायणं देवमनंतं विश्वरूपिणम् .. 34 ..
text_mt: Having bound the cord with this [mantra], food should be eaten with tranquil minds, / having meditated upon the god Nārāyaṇa, Ananta, whose form is the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktvā cāṃte vrajedveśma hīdaṃ proktaṃ vrataṃ tava ..
sāpi śrutvā vrataṃ cakre śīlā baddhvā sudorakam .. 35 ..
meaning:
भुक्त्वा चांते व्रजेद्वेश्म हीदं प्रोक्तं व्रतं तव ..
सापि श्रुत्वा व्रतं चक्रे शीला बद्ध्वा सुदोरकम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: And having eaten, one should go home at the conclusion; this votive observance has been described to you." / Having heard it, Śīlā also performed the observance and tied the excellent cord.

sanskrit_iast:
bhartā tasyāḥ samāgatya tāṃ dadarśa mahādhanām ..
pātheyaśeṣaṃ viprāya dattvā bhuktvā tathaiva ca .. 36 ..
meaning:
भर्ता तस्याः समागत्य तां ददर्श महाधनाम् ..
पाथेयशेषं विप्राय दत्त्वा भुक्त्वा तथैव च .. 36 ..
text_mt: Her husband, having arrived, saw her possessed of great wealth. / Giving the remainder of the travel provisions to a Brahmin and eating likewise,

sanskrit_iast:
punarjagāma sā hṛṣṭā gorathena svamāśramam ..
bhartrā sahaiva śanakaiḥ pratyakṣaṃ tatkṣaṇādabhūt ..
tenānaṃtaprabhāveṇa śubhagodhanasaṃkulaḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
पुनर्जगाम सा हृष्टा गोरथेन स्वमाश्रमम् ..
भर्त्रा सहैव शनकैः प्रत्यक्षं तत्क्षणादभूत् ..
तेनानंतप्रभावेण शुभगोधनसंकुलः .. 37 ..
text_mt: she went again, joyful, in the ox-cart to her own hermitage / slowly along with her husband. Instantly it became evident: / through the power of Ananta, [the hermitage] was filled with auspicious cattle wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhāśramaḥ śriyā yukto dhanadhānyasamāyutaḥ ..
ākulo vyākulo ramyaḥ sarvatrātithipūjanaḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
गृहाश्रमः श्रिया युक्तो धनधान्यसमायुतः ..
आकुलो व्याकुलो रम्यः सर्वत्रातिथिपूजनः .. 38 ..
text_mt: The household hermitage was endowed with fortune, supplied with wealth and grain, / bustling, lively, pleasant, and everywhere honouring guests.

sanskrit_iast:
sāpi māṇikyakāñcībhirmuktāhāravibhūṣitā ..
divyāṃgavastrasaṃchannā sāvitrīpratimābhavat .. 39 ..
meaning:
सापि माणिक्यकाञ्चीभिर्मुक्ताहारविभूषिता ..
दिव्यांगवस्त्रसंछन्ना सावित्रीप्रतिमाभवत् .. 39 ..
text_mt: She too, adorned with ruby girdles and pearl necklaces, / covered in garments for celestial bodies, became like Sāvitrī.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācidupaviṣṭena dṛṣṭaṃ baddhaṃ sudorakam ..
śīlāyā hastamūle tu sākṣepaṃ troṭitaṃ ruṣā .. 40 ..
meaning:
कदाचिदुपविष्टेन दृष्टं बद्धं सुदोरकम् ..
शीलाया हस्तमूले तु साक्षेपं त्रोटितं रुषा .. 40 ..
text_mt: Once, as he sat, the excellent cord tied / at the root of Śīlā's hand was seen [by him], and with reproach he broke it in anger.

sanskrit_iast:
tena karmavipākeṇa tasya sā śrīḥ kṣayaṃ gatā ..
godhanaṃ taskarairnītaṃ gṛhaṃ cāgnividāhitam .. 41 ..
meaning:
तेन कर्मविपाकेण तस्य सा श्रीः क्षयं गता ..
गोधनं तस्करैर्नीतं गृहं चाग्निविदाहितम् .. 41 ..
text_mt: By the fruition of that deed, that prosperity of his went to ruin: / the cattle wealth was taken by thieves, and the house was burned by fire.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyadevāgataṃ gehe tatra tatraiva naśyati ..
svajanaiḥ kalaho mitrairvacanaṃ na janaistathā .. 42 ..
meaning:
यद्यदेवागतं गेहे तत्र तत्रैव नश्यति ..
स्वजनैः कलहो मित्रैर्वचनं न जनैस्तथा .. 42 ..
text_mt: Whatever entered his house perished right there and then. / There were quarrels with relatives and friends, and people would not speak [to him].

sanskrit_iast:
anaṃtākṣepadoṣeṇa dāridryaṃ patitaṃ gṛhe ..
na kaścidvadate lokastena sārddhaṃ yudhiṣṭhira .. 43 ..
meaning:
अनंताक्षेपदोषेण दारिद्र्यं पतितं गृहे ..
न कश्चिद्वदते लोकस्तेन सार्द्धं युधिष्ठिर .. 43 ..
text_mt: Through the fault of scorning Ananta, poverty fell upon his house. / No one spoke with him, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit_iast:
tato jagāma kauṃḍinyo nirvedādvanagahvaram ..
manasā dhyāyatenaṃtaṃ kadā drakṣyāmi keśavam .. 44 ..
meaning:
ततो जगाम कौंडिन्यो निर्वेदाद्वनगह्वरम् ..
मनसा ध्यायतेनंतं कदा द्रक्ष्यामि केशवम् .. 44 ..
text_mt: Then, out of despondency, Kauṇḍinya went into the depths of the forest, / meditating in his mind upon Ananta: “When shall I see Keśava?”

sanskrit_iast:
vrataṃ niraśanaṃ gṛhya brahmacaryaṃ japanharim ..
vihvalaḥ prayayau pārtha araṇyaṃ janavarjitam..45..
meaning:
व्रतं निरशनं गृह्य ब्रह्मचर्यं जपन्हरिम् ..
विह्वलः प्रययौ पार्थ अरण्यं जनवर्जितम्..45..
text_mt: Undertaking a fast as his votive observance, practicing celibacy, murmuring Hari's names, / he wandered, distraught, into the wilderness devoid of men, O Pārtha.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpaśyanmahāvṛkṣaṃ phalitaṃ puṣpitaṃ tathā ..
tamapṛcchattvayānaṃtaḥ kaccidṛṣṭo mahādruma ..
tadbrūhi sopyuvācedaṃ nānaṃtaṃ vedmyahaṃ dvija .. 46 ..
meaning:
तत्रापश्यन्महावृक्षं फलितं पुष्पितं तथा ..
तमपृच्छत्त्वयानंतः कच्चिदृष्टो महाद्रुम ..
तद्ब्रूहि सोप्युवाचेदं नानंतं वेद्म्यहं द्विज .. 46 ..
text_mt: There he saw a great tree, laden with fruit and in full bloom. / He asked it: “O great tree, have you seen Ananta? / Tell me that!” But it replied: “I do not know Ananta, O twice-born one.”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ nirīkṣitastena gāṃ dadarśa savatsakām ..
tṛṇamadhye pradhāvantīmitaścetaśca pāṃḍava ..47..
meaning:
एवं निरीक्षितस्तेन गां ददर्श सवत्सकाम् ..
तृणमध्ये प्रधावन्तीमितश्चेतश्च पांडव ..47..
text_mt: Having looked upon it thus, he saw a cow with her calf / running here and there in the middle of the grass, O descendant of Pāṇḍu.

sanskrit_iast:
sobravīddhenuke brūhi yadyanaṃtastvayekṣitaḥ ..
gauruvācātha kauṃḍinya nānaṃtaṃ vedmyahaṃ vibho .. 48 ..
meaning:
सोब्रवीद्धेनुके ब्रूहि यद्यनंतस्त्वयेक्षितः ..
गौरुवाचाथ कौंडिन्य नानंतं वेद्म्यहं विभो .. 48 ..
text_mt: He said: “O gentle cow, tell me if Ananta has been seen by you.” / Then the cow said: “O Kauṇḍinya, I do not know Ananta, O lord.”

sanskrit_iast:
tato jagāmātha vane govṛṣaṃ śādvale sthitam ..
dṛṣṭvā papraccha gosvāminnanaṃto lakṣitastvayā .. 49 ..
meaning:
ततो जगामाथ वने गोवृषं शाद्वले स्थितम् ..

text_mt: [Quotation from] Śabdakalpadruma: / King Yudhiṣṭhira, self-controlled, dwelling in forest exile, / was approached by Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Self and lord of the three worlds. / A conversation concerning agreeable and disagreeable matters took place between the two of them there, / and Yudhiṣṭhira especially questioned Govinda. / Yudhiṣṭhira said: / “By what votive observance, O Lord of gods, is the desired fruit attained, / and do all people become free from sin life after life?” / Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / “There is a votive observance named Ananta, which was performed in the abode of the gods / by Indra and the other world protectors; listen to it as I tell it. / On the fourteenth lunar day of the bright fortnight in the month of Bhādrapada, / merely by its performance all sin is destroyed.” / Yudhiṣṭhira said: / “O Kṛṣṇa, who is this one spoken of by you who is called Ananta? / Who is this Śeṣa, this serpent Ananta known as Takṣaka? / Or is the Supreme and highest Brahman spoken of? / Who indeed is this one called Ananta? Tell me that, O Janārdana.” / Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / “I am Ananta, O Pārtha; understand that to be my form: / that Time which manifests as the lord in the form of the sun’s course, / through the division of kalās, kāṣṭhās, muhūrtas, days, and nights, / fortnights, months, seasons, and years, arranged by yugas and kalpas.”

text_mt:
I am Time, descended to lighten the burden of the earth, / born of Vasudeva to destroy the Danavas. / Know Me, O son of Pṛthā, as Ananta, Kṛṣṇa, Viṣṇu, Hari, Śiva, / Brahmā, the Sun, Śeṣa, the all-pervading Lord. / To give you conviction, O son of Pṛthā, perceive that universal form of mine, / Supreme, meditated upon by yogins, which I showed you previously, O mighty-armed one.
Yudhiṣṭhira said: / [Tell me] the greatness and ritual procedure of the Ananta observance, O best of those who know ritual procedure; / what is its merit, what is its fruit, and what is its performance?
By whom was it previously performed, and by whom was it revealed in the world? / Explain all that at length, O Lord Nārāyaṇa.
The Blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / Formerly, in the Kṛta age, there lived a twice-born named Sumantu, / born in the lineage of Vasiṣṭha, learned, virtuous, and of subdued senses.
His wife was Dīkṣā, virtuous, devoted to vows of truth, / endowed with good conduct and character, beautiful, and born of the Bhṛgu lineage.
In the course of time a daughter possessing all auspicious marks was born to her; / named Śīlā, well-behaved, she grew up in her father's house.

text_mt:
The maiden worshipped deities and guests every day; / ever skillful in household duties, she was extremely dear to her father.
After some time, seeing her arrived at youth, / the brahmin became anxious: 'To whom should I give my daughter?'
Then, by the force of destiny, Kauṇḍinya arrived there— / the best of sages, fortunate, of noble lineage, devoted to dharma.
Sumantu of good intellect and great asceticism thought in his mind: / 'By the power of fortune, Śīlā should be given to him with care.'
Having decided thus, on an auspicious day the brahmin gave his daughter, / the adorned, virtuous Śīlā whose face resembled the moon;

Sumantu said to Karkaśā: 'Give a sacrificial fee to the son-in-law; / make my gift fruitful, my dear one born of a sage's lineage, / for an act bereft of a sacrificial fee becomes fruitless.' / But upon hearing his words, Karkaśā became furious. / She rebuked her husband Sumantu with harsh words; / gathering up her ornaments and her valuables,
and putting them away in a secret place, Karkaśā went to another house. / Then Sumantu became very dejected and ashamed.
Bringing whatever trifling goods were suitable for a gift, / the brahmin gave them as a dowry to the son-in-law, attending upon him repeatedly.
Then, having concluded the wedding, Kauṇḍinya set out for his own hermitage, / placing Śīlā upon an ox-cart and taking her with him. / Then, travelling on the road, Śīlā, whose face resembled the moon, / alighted at midday at the time of eating on the bank of a river.

By the grace of which god you enjoy abundant wealth— / how do you not know him, master, the lord of the universe in this manner?”
Then, having heard Śīlā's words, Kauṇḍinya became furious: / “Who indeed is this one called Ananta? He has not even been heard of, fair-faced woman!” / Saying this, enraged, he tore the Ananta thread from her arm, / cast it into the fire full of flames, and rebuked his beloved in many ways.
Then Śīlā, running forward in agitation crying “Alas, alas!”, / took the cord from the fire and threw it into the milk.
Then the fine thread was tied again by her on her left hand. / But through the fault of casting away Ananta, poverty fell upon the house.
That brāhmaṇa was not praised by any people, O Yudhiṣṭhira; / filthiness came upon his body, and his eyes were overcome with sleep.
The dwellings became empty, burnt by fire in places. / Beholding his own town, the brāhmaṇa reflected in his mind.
Then Śīlā, pale and sorrowful because of her husband's fault, / wandered through the whole city, which was filled with empty houses.

text_mt:
Then excellent understanding arose in the brāhmaṇa Kauṇḍinya: / “An evil deed was done by me, or a blameworthy act performed by me.
Through the fault of casting away Ananta, such is my condition too. / Wherever I may see Ananta, there I, evil-minded, will go.”
Then Kauṇḍinya went to the forest infested with tigers and other beasts, / in order to search for the votive observance and to behold the feet of Hari.
Distraught, he went along a path devoid of people or animals. / There he saw a tree endowed with fruits and flowers,
devoid of flocks of birds and especially of insects. / He asked it: “O great tree, have you seen Ananta anywhere?”
And that great tree said: “I do not know Ananta, O twice-born.” / Then, going on, he saw ahead [a cow] with her calf in the midst of grass.
Running in the midst of grass, she neither eats nor smells it. / “O great cow, tell me: was Ananta seen by you?”
She with her calf then said to him: “I do not know Ananta, O twice-born.” / Then, going on, he saw ahead an excellent bull standing in the forest.

text_mt:
“Homage to Ananta of a thousand forms, of a thousand feet, eyes, heads, thighs, and arms, / of a thousand names, the eternal person, the bearer of thousands of crores of yugas, homage!
Whatever has been done through ignorance by me, a sinner, / proclaim and forgive all that in mercy, O Madhusūdana!”
Then, having heard the praise of the brāhmaṇa Kauṇḍinya, Janārdana, / the gracious blessed lord, Ananta who bears infinite forms, [said:] / “How is it that what is dear to me has been declared? Come here, O brāhmaṇa!”
Ananta said:
I am pleased, O best of brāhmaṇas, especially with your devotion. / Choose a boon, O foremost of vipras; I am pleased, cast away your astonishment.
Kauṇḍinya said:
Into whatever womb I may enter through the experience of the fruit of my own deeds, / in that very [womb], O Hṛṣīkeśa, may my devotion to Hari remain steadfast!
Whatever misdeed I have committed out of excessive heedlessness or delusion, / may that offense be forgiven, O Lord! I bow down again and again.
Having heard his speech, Ananta gave him three boons: / the destruction of poverty, righteousness, and likewise the imperishable world of Viṣṇu.

text_mt:
Kauṇḍinya said:
My desire is fulfilled today, O God, especially; / I ask something, O Lord of gods; tell me that, O Lord of the universe!
What was the mango tree? What was the bull? What was the cow? What were those two lotus ponds? / What was the donkey, or what was the elephant, or who was that excellent old twice-born [man]? / Graciously tell me today, O omnipresent Lord, [whom] I saw along the path.
Śrī Ananta said:
The mango tree that was seen was indeed a vipra proud of his learning, / since he did not give his learning to a pupil who approached him. / By the fruition of that deed, he remains having obtained the condition of a tree. / The bull that was seen by you was formerly one who performed greedy deeds.
Because he gave stale goods and ate delicious [food] himself, / therefore, having attained the state of a bull, he stands in a lonely place.
Having given to a vipra land that was barren and devoid of crops, / by that [deed] he attained the state of a cow and runs about in the midst of grass.
One should know the two lotus ponds to be righteousness and unrighteousness. / The donkey was endowed with ignorance, [and] the elephant was proud with intoxication.

text_mt:
That brāhmaṇa was I, Ananta, who showed himself to you, O sage. / All this has been told to you; go, O vipra, to your own hermitage.
Again you will have prosperity, O vipra, without a doubt. / Having enjoyed vast pleasures, you will attain the supreme abode.
Having given him the boon in this manner, he vanished right there. / Kauṇḍinya, too, having gone home, performs the excellent vrata,
greatly meritorious, named Ananta, for fourteen years, / together with Śīlā, the righteous-minded [sage] happily enjoying his desires.
Having reached the world of Viṣṇu, he shone together with Śīlā. / In this world, merely by completing the vrata named Ananta, O ruler of the earth,
freed from all sins, they will go to the supreme state. / In this very way, by the rule of the Anantavrata, O king, women,
endowed with sons, grandsons, and wealth, having enjoyed the pleasures of their desires, / attain the world of Viṣṇu as long as the moon and the sun [endure].
Thus ends the Anantavrata in the Bhaviṣyapurāṇa.
The Śravaṇikāvrata.

sanskrit_iast:

बुभुजे सापि तत्रैव अरुंधत्या कृता दरा .. 19 ..

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: Having heard that, King Nahuṣa quickly set about [giving] food, / exactly as had been spoken by Arundhatī, whatever and as much as was desired.

And having given eight water-pitchers dedicated to that Jayasrī,

text_mt:
She went to Indra's world in a celestial chariot brilliant as the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..

In all twelve months beginning with Mārgaśīrṣa, O son of Pāṇḍu,

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt:
Having eaten at a sacrifice on the fourteenth or on the eighth, O Yudhiṣṭhira,

text_mt:
should invite ten individual women who embody Gaurī,
of restrained conduct and fine dress, or Brahmin women born of his own lineage;

sanskrit_iast:

and there twelve Brahmins who have mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas,
knowers of mantras, knowers of the Itihāsas, tranquil and self-controlled.

with fragrant sandalwood, flowers, incense, and the like;

सोहालकादिभिश्च्छन्नाः पुष्पमालाविभूषिताः .. 33 ..
text_mt:
flawless, filled with water, well-rounded, wrapped with cord,
covered with sohālaka pastries and the like, adorned with garlands of flowers,

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:
चंदनेन समालब्धाः सहिरण्याः पृथक्पृथक् ..
तन्मध्ये वर्द्धनीं चैकां स्वके शीर्षे निवेशयेत् .. 34 ..

And among them he should place one vardhanī vessel upon his own head.

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:

text_mt:
Standing then in the center of the diagram, the patron of the rite himself [should say]:
'Whatever has been done in childhood, youth, or old age,
may all that perish, of the ancestors, gods, seers, and men.

sanskrit_iast:
imā me samayaṃ svarṇaṃ tārayasva bhavārṇavāt ..
adyāhaṃ gantumicchāmi viṣṇoḥ padamanuttamam ..
evamastviti tā brūyuḥ striyaḥ sarvā yudhiṣṭhira .. 36 ..

अद्याहं गन्तुमिच्छामि विष्णोः पदमनुत्तमम् ..
एवमस्त्विति ता ब्रूयुः स्त्रियः सर्वा युधिष्ठिर .. 36 ..
text_mt:
Keep this covenant of mine with gold; carry [me] across the ocean of worldly existence.
Today I desire to go to the supreme abode of Viṣṇu.'
'May it be so,' all those women should say, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

meaning:
ततो ब्राह्मणमाहूय यजमान इदं वदेत् ..
ब्रूहि ब्राह्मण यन्मे त्वमघं येन क्षयं व्रजेत् .. 37 ..
text_mt:
Then, having summoned a Brahmin, the patron of the rite should say this:
'Tell me, Brahmin, that through which my sin may be destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
uttīrya śrāvaṇaṃ māsaṃ samuttāraya sāṃpratam ..
uttārayeta maṃtreṇa brāhmaṇo vardhanī ca tām .. 38 ..
meaning:
उत्तीर्य श्रावणं मासं समुत्तारय सांप्रतम् ..
उत्तारयेत मंत्रेण ब्राह्मणो वर्धनी च ताम् .. 38 ..
text_mt:
Having crossed over the month of Śrāvaṇa, now carry [me] completely across.'
The Brahmin should remove that vardhanī vessel with the mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣya śiraso devyāḥ samuttīrya ruhadrumān ..
kaṭukaṃ niṃbavṛkṣaṃ vā tato madhukamāruha ..
tato gaccha mahādevaṃ śravaṇe śravaṇottame .. 39 .. iti vardhanikottāraṇamantraḥ ..
meaning:
उपोष्य शिरसो देव्याः समुत्तीर्य रुहद्रुमान् ..
कटुकं निंबवृक्षं वा ततो मधुकमारुह ..
ततो गच्छ महादेवं श्रवणे श्रवणोत्तमे .. 39 .. इति वर्धनिकोत्तारणमन्त्रः ..
text_mt:
'Having fasted, crossing over the ascending trees from the goddess's head,
either the bitter nimba tree, then climb the madhuka;
then go to Mahādeva on Śravaṇa, the best of the Śravaṇa asterisms.'
Thus is the mantra for removing the vardhanī vessel.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ tāḥ samayaṃ procya dattvāśīrvacanāni ca ..4.95.40..

gṛhītvā karakānnāryyo vrajeyuḥ sveṣu veśmasu .. 41 ..
meaning:
तां वर्द्धनिकामेकान्ते विप्राय प्रतिपादयेत् ..
गृहीत्वा करकान्नार्य्यो व्रजेयुः स्वेषु वेश्मसु .. 41 ..
text_mt:
he should present that vardhanī vessel to the Brahmin in private.
Taking the water-pitchers, the women should depart to their own homes.

evamācarate pārtha śrāvaṇīvrata mādarāt ..42..
meaning:
यजमानोऽपि यातासु यथेष्टं काममाचरेत् ..
एवमाचरते पार्थ श्रावणीव्रत मादरात् ..42..
text_mt:
When they have gone, the patron of the rite may act according to his desire.
Whoever thus observes with respect the Śrāvaṇī-vrata, O son of Pṛthā,

sanskrit_iast:
tasya kāle tu saṃprāpte sukhaṃ mṛtyuḥ prajāyate ..
nirvyādhirnīrujo bhogī sthitvāsthitvā śataṃ sukham .. 43 ..
meaning:
तस्य काले तु संप्राप्ते सुखं मृत्युः प्रजायते ..
निर्व्याधिर्नीरुजो भोगी स्थित्वास्थित्वा शतं सुखम् .. 43 ..
text_mt:
for him, when the time arrives, an easy death occurs.
Free of disease, without illness, enjoying pleasures, after living happily for a hundred [years],

sanskrit_iast:
putrapautrasamṛddhyādau bhuktvā martyasukhāni ca ..
rudralokamavāpnoti somalokaṃ sa gacchati .. 44 ..
meaning:
पुत्रपौत्रसमृद्ध्यादौ भुक्त्वा मर्त्यसुखानि च ..
रुद्रलोकमवाप्नोति सोमलोकं स गच्छति .. 44 ..
text_mt:
having enjoyed mortal pleasures in the prosperity of sons and grandsons and so forth,
he attains Rudra's world and goes to Soma's world.

sanskrit_iast:
strīṇāṃ tulyaṃ sa hīno'pi vratī vrataphalaṃ vrajet ..

meaning:
स्त्रीणां तुल्यं स हीनोऽपि व्रती व्रतफलं व्रजेत् ..
गौरीभोज्येषु दत्तेषु एकादशसु यत्फलम् .. 45 ..
text_mt:
Even a low person observing the votive observance attains the fruit of the observance equal to women.
Whatever fruit comes when eleven feasts of Gaurī are given,

sanskrit_iast:

bhaktyā gacchaṃti te lokānvihṛtya sukhamādarāt .. 46 .. ..
śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvādavarṇanam
meaning:
तदेकेनापि लभते पार्थ श्रावणिकाव्रते ..
भक्त्या गच्छंति ते लोकान्विहृत्य सुखमादरात् .. 46 .. ..
श्रीकृष्णयुधिष्ठिरसंवादवर्णनम्
text_mt:
one obtains that even through a single [observance] in the Śrāvaṇikā-vrata, O son of Pṛthā.
With devotion they go to those worlds, sporting happily and with honor.

atha naktopavāsasya vidhānaṃ śṛṇu pāṃḍava ..
yena vijñātamātreṇa naro mokṣamavāpnuyāt .. 1 ..

Now hear the procedure for the nocturnal fast, O son of Pāṇḍu,
by merely knowing which a man may attain liberation.
title: adhyāyaḥ 096

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣu teṣu ca māseṣu śuklapakṣe caturdaśīm ..
brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayitvā tu prārabheta tato vratam .. 2 ..
meaning:
येषु तेषु च मासेषु शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्दशीम् ..
ब्राह्मणं भोजयित्वा तु प्रारभेत ततो व्रतम् .. 2 ..
text_mt:
On the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight in any of the months,
having fed a Brahmin, he should then begin the votive observance.

sanskrit_iast:
māsimāsi bhavaṃti dvāvaṣṭamyau ca caturdaśī ..
śivārcanarato bhūtvā śivadhyānaikamānasaḥ ..
vasudhābhājanaṃ kṛtvā bhuñjīyānnaktabhojanam .. 3 ..
meaning:
मासिमासि भवंति द्वावष्टम्यौ च चतुर्दशी ..
शिवार्चनरतो भूत्वा शिवध्यानैकमानसः ..
वसुधाभाजनं कृत्वा भुञ्जीयान्नक्तभोजनम् .. 3 ..
text_mt:
In every month there are two eighth days and a fourteenth.
Devoted to the worship of Śiva, his mind solely fixed in meditation on Śiva,
using the earth as his dish, he should eat the nocturnal meal.

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsātparaṃ bhaikṣyaṃ bhaikṣyātparamayācitam ..
ayācitātparaṃ naktaṃ tasmānnaktena bhojayet .. 4 ..
meaning:
उपवासात्परं भैक्ष्यं भैक्ष्यात्परमयाचितम् ..
अयाचितात्परं नक्तं तस्मान्नक्तेन भोजयेत् .. 4 ..
text_mt:
Begged food is superior to fasting; unasked-for food is superior to begged food;
the nocturnal meal is superior to unasked-for food; therefore he should feed with the nocturnal meal.

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:

अपराह्णे च पितृभिः सन्ध्यायां गुह्यकादिभिः .. 5 ..
text_mt:
The gods eat in the forenoon, and likewise the sages at midday,
the ancestors in the afternoon, and the guhyakas and others at twilight.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalokānatikramya naktabhojī sadā bhavet ..
haviṣya bhojanaṃ snānaṃ satyamāhāralāghavam .. 6 ..

सर्वलोकानतिक्रम्य नक्तभोजी सदा भवेत् ..
हविष्य भोजनं स्नानं सत्यमाहारलाघवम् .. 6 ..

Transcending all beings, one should always eat only at night.
Eating sacrificial food, bathing, truthfulness, lightness of diet,

agnikāryo hyadhaḥśayyo naktabhojī sadā bhavet ..
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte vratapūrṇasya sarpiṣā ..
pūrṇakumbhoparisthāpya pūjayecca suśobhane .. 7 ..
meaning:
अग्निकार्यो ह्यधःशय्यो नक्तभोजी सदा भवेत् ..
एवं संवत्सरस्यांते व्रतपूर्णस्य सर्पिषा ..
पूर्णकुम्भोपरिस्थाप्य पूजयेच्च सुशोभने .. 7 ..
text_mt:
tending the sacred fire, sleeping on the ground—he should always be an eater of the nocturnal meal.
Thus at the end of a year of the completed votive observance, with clarified butter
placed upon a full water-jar, he should worship [Śiva], O fair one.

sanskrit_iast:
kapilāpañcagavyena sthāpayenmṛnmayaṃ śivam ..
phalaṃ puṣpaṃ yavakṣīraṃ dadhi dūrvāṃkurāṃstathā ..8 ..
meaning:
कपिलापञ्चगव्येन स्थापयेन्मृन्मयं शिवम् ..
फलं पुष्पं यवक्षीरं दधि दूर्वांकुरांस्तथा ..8 ..
text_mt:
With the five products of a brown cow he should install an earthen Śiva.
Fruit, flowers, barley with milk, curd, and sprouts of dūrvā grass,

sanskrit_iast:
tatkumbhānāṃ jalonmiśramarghamaṣṭāṃgamucyate ..
śirasā dhārayitvā tu jānū kṛtvā mahītale .. 9 ..
meaning:
तत्कुम्भानां जलोन्मिश्रमर्घमष्टांगमुच्यते ..
शिरसा धारयित्वा तु जानू कृत्वा महीतले .. 9 ..
text_mt:
mixed with the water of those jars, is called the eightfold guest-offering.
Bearing it upon his head, placing both knees upon the surface of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevāya dātavyaṃ gandhapuṣpaṃ yathākramam ..
bhakṣyodenairbaliṃ kṛtvā praṇamya parameśvarīm .. 4.96.10 ..
meaning:
महादेवाय दातव्यं गन्धपुष्पं यथाक्रमम् ..
भक्ष्योदेनैर्बलिं कृत्वा प्रणम्य परमेश्वरीम् .. 4.96.10 ..
text_mt:
he should offer perfume and flowers in due order to Mahādeva.
Having made an offering with edible grains and bowed to Parameśvarī,

sanskrit_iast:
dhenuṃ vā dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādvṛṣaṃ vāpi dhuraṃdharam ..
śrotriyāya daridrāya kalpavratavidāya ca ..
yo dadāti śive bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 11 ..
meaning:
धेनुं वा दक्षिणां दद्याद्वृषं वापि धुरंधरम् ..
श्रोत्रियाय दरिद्राय कल्पव्रतविदाय च ..
यो ददाति शिवे भक्त्या तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु .. 11 ..
text_mt:
he should give as a priestly fee a cow or a draft ox
to a poor Brahmin learned in the Veda who knows the ritual of votive observances.
Hear the meritorious fruit of him who gives with devotion to Śiva:

sanskrit_iast:
vimānamarkapratimaṃ haṃsayuktamalaṃkṛtam..
ārūḍho'psarasāṃ gītairyāti rudrālaye sukham .. 12 ..
meaning:
विमानमर्कप्रतिमं हंसयुक्तमलंकृतम्..
आरूढोऽप्सरसां गीतैर्याति रुद्रालये सुखम् .. 12 ..
text_mt:
Mounted on a celestial chariot resembling the sun, adorned and drawn by swans,
he goes happily to Rudra's abode accompanied by the songs of apsarases.

sanskrit_iast:
sthitvā rudrasya bhavane varṣakoṭiśatatrayam ..
iha loke nṛpaśreṣṭha grāmalakṣeśvaro bhavet .. 13 ..
meaning:
स्थित्वा रुद्रस्य भवने वर्षकोटिशतत्रयम् ..
इह लोके नृपश्रेष्ठ ग्रामलक्षेश्वरो भवेत् .. 13 ..
text_mt:
Remaining in Rudra's mansion for three hundred crores of years,
he becomes the lord of a hundred thousand villages in this world, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
yaścāṣṭamīṣu ca śivāsu caturdaśīṣu naktaṃ samācarati śāstravidhāna dṛṣṭam ..
svargāṃganākalaravākulitaṃ vimānamāruhya yāti sa sukhena sureśalokam .. 14 .. ..
śivacaturdaśīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
यश्चाष्टमीषु च शिवासु चतुर्दशीषु नक्तं समाचरति शास्त्रविधान दृष्टम् ..
स्वर्गांगनाकलरवाकुलितं विमानमारुह्य याति स सुखेन सुरेशलोकम् .. 14 .. ..
शिवचतुर्दशीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
And he who observes the nocturnal meal on the auspicious eighth and fourteenth days according to the prescription of the scriptures,
mounting a celestial chariot filled with the sweet murmur of celestial maidens, goes happily to the world of the lord of the gods.
Description of the Śivacaturdaśī-vrata

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājanvakṣye māheśvaraṃ vratam ..
triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ nāmnā śivacaturdaśī .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
शृणुष्वावहितो राजन्वक्ष्ये माहेश्वरं व्रतम् ..
त्रिषु लोकेषु विख्यातं नाम्ना शिवचतुर्दशी .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Lord Kṛṣṇa said:
Listen attentively, O king; I shall explain the votive observance of Maheśvara,
renowned in the three worlds by the name Śivacaturdaśī.
title: Śivacaturdaśīvratavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśīrṣatrayodaśyāṃ sitāyāmekabhuṅnaraḥ ..
māseṣvanyeṣu vā rājanpārtha evaṃ na kārayet .. 2 ..
meaning:
मार्गशीर्षत्रयोदश्यां सितायामेकभुङ्नरः ..
मासेष्वन्येषु वा राजन्पार्थ एवं न कारयेत् .. 2 ..
text_mt:
A man should eat only once on the bright thirteenth of Mārgaśīrṣa;
in other months, O king, O son of Pṛthā, he should not do so.

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ samabhyarcya maheśvaram ..
sauvarṇaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ dattvā bhakṣyāmi ca pare'hani.. 3 ..
meaning:
चतुर्दश्यां निराहारः समभ्यर्च्य महेश्वरम् ..
सौवर्णं वृषभं दत्त्वा भक्ष्यामि च परेऽहनि.. 3 ..
text_mt: "Fasting without food on the fourteenth day, having worshipped Maheśvara, / and having given a golden bull, I will eat on the next day."

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ niyamakṛtsuptvā prātarutthāya mānavaḥ ..
kṛtasnānajapaḥ paścādumayā saha śaṃkaram ..
pūjayetkusumaiḥ śuklairgaṃdhadhūpānulepanaiḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
एवं नियमकृत्सुप्त्वा प्रातरुत्थाय मानवः ..
कृतस्नानजपः पश्चादुमया सह शंकरम् ..
पूजयेत्कुसुमैः शुक्लैर्गंधधूपानुलेपनैः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Having made such a resolve and slept, waking up in the morning, a man, / having performed his bath and muttered prayers, should afterwards worship Śaṅkara along with Umā / with white flowers, fragrances, incenses, and ointments.

sanskrit_iast:
pādau namaḥ śivāyeti śiraḥ sarvātmane namaḥ ..
lalāṭaṃ tu trinetrāya netrāṇi haraye namaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
पादौ नमः शिवायेति शिरः सर्वात्मने नमः ..
ललाटं तु त्रिनेत्राय नेत्राणि हरये नमः .. 5 ..
text_mt: [He should worship] the feet with "Homage to Śiva"; the head with "Homage to the Soul of All"; / the forehead indeed with "[Homage] to the Three-Eyed One"; the eyes with "Homage to Hara";

sanskrit_iast:
mukhamindumukhāyeti tatheśānāya codaram ..
pārśve cānaṃtadharmāya jñānarūpāya vai kaṭim .. 6 ..
meaning:
मुखमिन्दुमुखायेति तथेशानाय चोदरम् ..
पार्श्वे चानंतधर्माय ज्ञानरूपाय वै कटिम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: the face with "[Homage] to the Moon-faced One"; likewise the belly with "[Homage] to Īśāna"; / the two flanks with "[Homage] to Infinite Virtue"; and the waist with "[Homage] to the Embodiment of Knowledge";

sanskrit_iast:
ūrū cānantyavairāgyaṃ jānunī cārcayedbudhaḥ ..
pradhānāya namo jaṃghe gulphau vyomātmane namaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
ऊरू चानन्त्यवैराग्यं जानुनी चार्चयेद्बुधः ..
प्रधानाय नमो जंघे गुल्फौ व्योमात्मने नमः .. 7 ..
text_mt: and the wise man should worship the thighs with "[Homage to] Infinite Dispassion" and the two knees; / the shanks with "Homage to Pradhāna"; the ankles with "Homage to the Sky-souled One";

sanskrit_iast:
vyomavyomātmarūpāya pṛṣṭhamabhyarcayennaraḥ ..
namaḥ sṛṣṭyai namastuṣṭyai pārvatīṃ cāpi pūjayet .. 8 ..
meaning:
व्योमव्योमात्मरूपाय पृष्ठमभ्यर्चयेन्नरः ..
नमः सृष्ट्यै नमस्तुष्ट्यै पार्वतीं चापि पूजयेत् .. 8 ..
text_mt: a man should worship the back with "[Homage] to the Embodiment of the Sky and of the Nature of Sky." / He should also worship Pārvatī with "Homage to Sṛṣṭi, homage to Tuṣṭi!"

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca vṛṣabhaṃ haimamudakumbhasamanvitam ..
śuklamālyāṃbarayutaṃ pañcaratnavibhūṣitam .. 9 ..
meaning:
ततश्च वृषभं हैममुदकुम्भसमन्वितम् ..
शुक्लमाल्यांबरयुतं पञ्चरत्नविभूषितम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Then, a golden bull accompanied by a water-pot, / provided with white garlands and garments, adorned with five jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣyairnānāvidhairyuktaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ..
prīyatāṃ devadevo'tra sadyojātaḥ pinākadhṛk.. 4.97.10 ..
meaning:
भक्ष्यैर्नानाविधैर्युक्तं ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ..
प्रीयतां देवदेवोऽत्र सद्योजातः पिनाकधृक्.. 4.97.10 ..
text_mt: and furnished with various kinds of edible foods, he should present to a brāhmaṇa, [saying:] / "May the God of gods, Sadyojāta, wielder of the Pināka, be pleased here."

sanskrit_iast:
pṛṣadājyaṃ ca saṃprāśya svapyādbhūmāvudaṅmukhaḥ ..
pañcadaśyāṃ tataḥ prātaḥ sarvametatsamācaret .. 11 ..
meaning:
पृषदाज्यं च संप्राश्य स्वप्याद्भूमावुदङ्मुखः ..
पञ्चदश्यां ततः प्रातः सर्वमेतत्समाचरेत् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Having consumed ghee mixed with curd, he should sleep on the ground facing north. / Then, in the morning on the fifteenth day, he should perform all of this:

sanskrit_iast:
tarpayitvā tatonnena brāhmaṇāñchaktitaḥ śubhān ..
suhṛtpadātisahitaḥ paścādbhuñjīta vāgyataḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
तर्पयित्वा ततोन्नेन ब्राह्मणाञ्छक्तितः शुभान् ..
सुहृत्पदातिसहितः पश्चाद्भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः .. 12 ..
text_mt: Having then gratified auspicious brāhmaṇas with food according to his means, / he should eat afterwards together with his friends and foot-soldiers, with speech restrained.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāmetatsarvaṃ samācaret ..
caturdaśīṣu sarvāsu kuryātpūrvavadarcanam .. 13 ..
meaning:
ततः कृष्णचतुर्दश्यामेतत्सर्वं समाचरेत् ..
चतुर्दशीषु सर्वासु कुर्यात्पूर्ववदर्चनम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Then, he should perform all this on the dark fourteenth day. / On all fourteenth days he should perform the worship as before.

sanskrit_iast:
ye ca māse viśeṣāḥ syustānnibodha kramādiha ..
mārgaśīrṣādimāseṣu svapannetānudīrayet .. 14 ..
meaning:
ये च मासे विशेषाः स्युस्तान्निबोध क्रमादिह ..
मार्गशीर्षादिमासेषु स्वपन्नेतानुदीरयेत् .. 14 ..
text_mt: And learn here in due order whatever particulars exist for each month. / In the months beginning with Mārgaśīrṣa, lying down he should recite these:

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkarāya namastubhyaṃ namaste karavīraka ..
tryaṃbakāya namastubhyaṃ maheśvaramataḥ param .. 15 ..
meaning:
शंकराय नमस्तुभ्यं नमस्ते करवीरक ..
त्र्यंबकाय नमस्तुभ्यं महेश्वरमतः परम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: "Homage to you, O Śaṅkara! Homage to you, O Karavīraka! / Homage to you, O Tryambaka!" Thereafter, "O Maheśvara!"

sanskrit_iast:
namaste'stu mahādeva sthāṇave ca tataḥ param ..
namaḥ paśupate nātha namaste śaṃbhave namaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
नमस्तेऽस्तु महादेव स्थाणवे च ततः परम् ..
नमः पशुपते नाथ नमस्ते शंभवे नमः .. 16 ..
text_mt: "Homage be to you, O Mahādeva!" And thereafter, "to Sthāṇu!" / "Homage, O Paśupati, Lord! Homage to you, O Śambhu, homage!"

sanskrit_iast:
namaste paramānaṃda namaḥ somārddhadhāriṇe ..
namo bhīmāya cogrāya tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
नमस्ते परमानंद नमः सोमार्द्धधारिणे ..
नमो भीमाय चोग्राय त्वामहं शरणं गतः .. 17 ..
text_mt: "Homage to you, O Supreme Bliss! Homage to the bearer of the half-moon! / Homage to the Terrific and Fierce One! I have approached you for refuge."

sanskrit_iast:
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhisarpiḥ kuśodakam ..
paṃcagavyaṃ tathā bilvaṃ yavāgūkṣīravārijam .. 18 ..
meaning:
गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं दधिसर्पिः कुशोदकम् ..
पंचगव्यं तथा बिल्वं यवागूक्षीरवारिजम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: Cow's urine, cow dung, milk, curd, ghee, kuśa water, / the five products of the cow, as well as bilva, barley-gruel, lotus rooted in water,

sanskrit_iast:
tilāṃśca kṛṣṇānvidhivatprāśnīyātsamudāhṛtān ..
pratimāsaṃ caturdaśyāmekaikaṃ prāśanaṃ smṛtam .. 19 ..
meaning:
तिलांश्च कृष्णान्विधिवत्प्राश्नीयात्समुदाहृतान् ..
प्रतिमासं चतुर्दश्यामेकैकं प्राशनं स्मृतम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: and black sesame seeds prescribed by rule, he should consume as stated. / One by one, their consumption is traditionally ordained on the fourteenth day in each successive month.

sanskrit_iast:
maṃdārairmālatībhiśca tathā dhattūkairapi ..
siṃduvārairaśokaiśca mallikākubjapāṭalaiḥ .. 4.97.20 ..
meaning:
मंदारैर्मालतीभिश्च तथा धत्तूकैरपि ..
सिंदुवारैरशोकैश्च मल्लिकाकुब्जपाटलैः .. 4.97.20 ..
text_mt: With mandāra and mālatī flowers, and likewise with dhattūras, / with sinduvāras and aśokas, with mallikā, kubja, and pāṭala blossoms,

sanskrit_iast:
arkapuṣpaiḥ kadaṃbaiśca śatapatraistathotpalaiḥ ..
karavīraiśca rājendra tathā pūjyo maheśvaraḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
अर्कपुष्पैः कदंबैश्च शतपत्रैस्तथोत्पलैः ..
करवीरैश्च राजेन्द्र तथा पूज्यो महेश्वरः .. 21 ..
text_mt: with arka flowers and kadambas, with lotuses and blue water-lilies, / and with karavīras, O best of kings, Maheśvara is thus to be worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikena caturdaśyāmarcayetpārvatīpatim ..
punaśca kārttike māsi saṃprāpte tarpayeddvijān .. 22 ..
meaning:
एकैकेन चतुर्दश्यामर्चयेत्पार्वतीपतिम् ..
पुनश्च कार्त्तिके मासि संप्राप्ते तर्पयेद्द्विजान् .. 22 ..
text_mt: With each single one [in turn], he should worship Pārvatī's husband on the fourteenth day. / And once more, when the month of Kārttika has arrived, he should gratify the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
annairnānāvidhairbhakṣyairvastrairmālyavibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
kṛtvā nīlaṃ vṛṣotsargaṃ śrutyuktavidhinā naraḥ..23..
meaning:
अन्नैर्नानाविधैर्भक्ष्यैर्वस्त्रैर्माल्यविभूषणैः ..
कृत्वा नीलं वृषोत्सर्गं श्रुत्युक्तविधिना नरः..23..
text_mt: With various kinds of foods, edibles, garments, garlands, and ornaments, / having performed the release of a dark bull according to the rule declared in the Vedic texts, a man

sanskrit_iast:
umāmaheśvaraṃ haimaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ ca gavā saha..
muktāphalāṣṭakayutaṃ sitanetrapaṭāvṛtam..24..
meaning:
उमामहेश्वरं हैमं वृषभं च गवा सह..
मुक्ताफलाष्टकयुतं सितनेत्रपटावृतम्..24..
text_mt: should present golden images of Umā and Maheśvara and a bull together with a cow, / endowed with eight pearls, covered with a white silk cloth,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvopaskarayuktāyāṃ śayyāyāṃ vinivedayet..
udakuṃbhayutaṃ tadvacchālitaṃdulasaṃyutam..25..
meaning:
सर्वोपस्करयुक्तायां शय्यायां विनिवेदयेत्..
उदकुंभयुतं तद्वच्छालितंदुलसंयुतम्..25..
text_mt: upon a bed equipped with all furnishings, / likewise accompanied by a water-pot and provided with śāli-rice.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpya viprāya śāṃtāya vedavrataparāya ca..
jyeṣṭhasāmavide deyaṃ na ca kurvaṃti te kvacit..26..
meaning:
स्थाप्य विप्राय शांताय वेदव्रतपराय च..
ज्येष्ठसामविदे देयं न च कुर्वंति ते क्वचित्..26..
text_mt: Having placed [it], it should be given to a peaceful vipra devoted to Vedic vows / who knows the Jyeṣṭhasāman; and such [gifts] are not given by them just anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
avyaṃgāya ca saumyāya sadākalyāṇakāriṇe ..
sapatnīkāya saṃpūjya mālyavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
na vittaśāṭhyaṃ kurvīta kurvaṃllobhātpatatyadhaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
अव्यंगाय च सौम्याय सदाकल्याणकारिणे ..
सपत्नीकाय संपूज्य माल्यवस्त्रविभूषणैः ..
न वित्तशाठ्यं कुर्वीत कुर्वंल्लोभात्पतत्यधः .. 27 ..

text_mt: Long life, good health, increase of lineage [are gained] here, imperishable [merit] elsewhere, and the state of having four arms; / lordship over the gaṇas in heaven; having dwelt in heaven for tens of millions of kalpas, he attains the abode of Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:
न बृहस्पतिरप्यत्मन्नरस्य फलमिंद्रो न पितामहोऽपि वक्तुम् ..
न च सिद्धगुणोरऽप्यलं न वाहं यदि जिह्वायुतकोट्यपीह वक्त्रे .. 31 ..
text_mt: Even Bṛhaspati cannot declare the fruit of such a man, nor Indra, nor the Grandfather, / nor are the Siddhas capable, nor am I, even if there were tens of millions of myriad tongues in the mouth.

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:
भवत्यमरवल्लभः पठति यः स्मरेद्वा सदा शृणोत्यपि विमत्सरः सकलपापनिर्मोचनीम् ..
इमां शिवचतुर्दशीममरकामिनीकोटयः स्तुवंति दिवि नंदिता किमु समाचरेद्यः सदा .. 32 ..
text_mt: He becomes dear to the gods who, free from jealousy, reads, remembers, or constantly hears / this Śivacaturdaśī which releases from all sins; millions of celestial women praise him in heaven, delighted; what more for one who observes it constantly?

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt:
Whatever woman, O Pārtha, performs [it] with great devotion, having asked her husband or her auspicious guru, / she also, through the grace of Parameśvara, goes to the supreme abode of the Pināka-bearer.

sanskrit_iast:

.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..

text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / "Listen likewise, O descendant of Bharata, to the greatness of the renunciation of all fruits, / which is imperishable in the next world and grants the fruit of all desires.
title: adhyāyaḥ 098

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi caturdaśyāṃ dhṛtavrataḥ ..
āraṃbhe śuklapakṣasya kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam .. 2 ..
meaning:
मार्गशीर्षे शुभे मासि चतुर्दश्यां धृतव्रतः ..
आरंभे शुक्लपक्षस्य कृत्वा ब्राह्मणवाचनम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: Having undertaken the votive observance on the fourteenth day in the auspicious month of Mārgaśīrṣa, / at the beginning of the bright fortnight, having performed the invocation of blessings from brāhmaṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
anyeṣvapi tu māseṣu aṣṭamyāṃ narasattama ..
sadakṣiṇāpāyasena śaktitaḥ pūjayeddvijān..3..
meaning:
अन्येष्वपि तु मासेषु अष्टम्यां नरसत्तम ..
सदक्षिणापायसेन शक्तितः पूजयेद्द्विजान्..3..
text_mt: and also on the eighth day in other months, O best of men, / he should worship the twice-born according to his means with milk-rice pudding and sacrificial fees.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭādaśānāṃ dhānyānāmanyatra phalamūlakam ..
varjayedabdamekaṃ tu vidhinauṣadhakārakam .. .. 4 ..
meaning:
अष्टादशानां धान्यानामन्यत्र फलमूलकम् ..
वर्जयेदब्दमेकं तु विधिनौषधकारकम् .. .. 4 ..
text_mt: Aside from eighteen grains, he should renounce fruit and roots, / and what is used as medicine, for one year according to the rule.

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:

अशक्तश्च व्रतं कर्तुं सहसैव प्रमुच्यते ..5..
text_mt: Then at the end of the year, on the fourteenth and eighth days, / even one unable to perform the votive observance is immediately liberated.

sanskrit_iast:
sauvarṇaṃ kārayedrudraṃ dharmarājaṃ tathaiva ca ..
kūṣmāṇḍaṃ mātuluṃgaṃ ca vṛṃtākaṃ panasaṃ tathā ..6..
meaning:
सौवर्णं कारयेद्रुद्रं धर्मराजं तथैव च ..
कूष्माण्डं मातुलुंगं च वृंताकं पनसं तथा ..6..
text_mt: He should have a golden image of Rudra made, and likewise of Dharmarāja, / and [images of] ash gourd, citron, eggplant, and jackfruit,

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: mango, hog-plum, wood-apple, watermelon, cucumber, / bilva fruit, banyan and sacred fig, lime, plantain fruit,

sanskrit_iast:

mūlakāmalakaṃ jaṃbūpuṣkaraṃ karamardakam .. 8 ..
meaning:
बदरं दाडिमं शक्त्या कार्याण्येतानि षोडश ..
मूलकामलकं जंबूपुष्करं करमर्दकम् .. 8 ..

meaning:

कंकाली काकतुंडीरं करीरकुटजं शमी .. 9 ..
text_mt: cluster-fig, coconut, grapes, and the two bṛhatīs, / kaṅkālī, kākatuṇḍīra, karīra, kuṭaja, and śamī."

meaning:

पिंडीरकं च खर्जूरं तथा सूरण कंदकम् ..

text_mt: as well as a piṇḍīraka, a date, and an elephant-foot yam tuber, / a jackfruit, a lakuca, a karkaṭa, and a tamarind,

madhūkaṃ kāravellaṃ ca vallīṃ gudapaṭola kam ..12..
meaning:
चित्रावल्लीफलं तद्वत्कूटशाल्मलिकाफलम् ..
मधूकं कारवेल्लं च वल्लीं गुदपटोल कम् ..12..
text_mt: likewise the fruit of the citrāvallī, the fruit of the kūṭaśālmalī, / a madhūka, a bitter gourd, a creeper, and a sweet paṭola.

sanskrit_iast:
kārayecchaktito dhīmānphalānyetāni ṣoḍaśa ..
udakuṃbhadvayaṃ kuryādānyopari savāsasam ..
pakṣapātradvayopetaṃ yamarudrasamanvitam..13..
meaning:
कारयेच्छक्तितो धीमान्फलान्येतानि षोडश ..
उदकुंभद्वयं कुर्यादान्योपरि सवाससम् ..
पक्षपात्रद्वयोपेतं यमरुद्रसमन्वितम्..13..
text_mt: The wise person should, according to their means, have these sixteen fruits made. / One should place two water-jars on a stand, covered with cloth, / accompanied by two cups, and dedicated to Yama and Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
dhenvā sahaiva śāṃtāya viprāyātha kuṭuṃbine ..
sapatnīkāya saṃpūjya puṇyehani nivedayet .. 14 ..
meaning:
धेन्वा सहैव शांताय विप्रायाथ कुटुंबिने ..
सपत्नीकाय संपूज्य पुण्येहनि निवेदयेत् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Then, having worshipped, one should present them together with a cow on an auspicious day / to a peaceful brahmin householder accompanied by his wife:

sanskrit_iast:
yathā phaleṣu sarveṣu vasaṃtyamarakoṭayaḥ ..
tathā sarvaphalatyāgācchive bhaktiḥ sadāstu me .. 15 ..
meaning:
यथा फलेषु सर्वेषु वसंत्यमरकोटयः ..
तथा सर्वफलत्यागाच्छिवे भक्तिः सदास्तु मे .. 15 ..
text_mt: “Just as tens of millions of immortals dwell in all fruits, / so, through the renunciation of all fruits, may there always be devotion to Śiva in me!

sanskrit_iast:
yathā śivaśca dharmaśca sadānantaphalapradau ..
tadyuktaphaladānena tau syātāṃ me varapradau .. 16 ..
meaning:
यथा शिवश्च धर्मश्च सदानन्तफलप्रदौ ..
तद्युक्तफलदानेन तौ स्यातां मे वरप्रदौ .. 16 ..
text_mt: Just as Śiva and Dharma are always the givers of endless fruit, / may they, through this gift of fruits accompanied by that [rite], be granters of boons to me!

sanskrit_iast:
yathā phalānāṃ kāmasya śivabhaktasya sarvadā ..
yathānaṃtaphalāvāptirastu janmanijanmani .. 17 ..
meaning:
यथा फलानां कामस्य शिवभक्तस्य सर्वदा ..
यथानंतफलावाप्तिरस्तु जन्मनिजन्मनि .. 17 ..
text_mt: Just as there is a desire for fruits, so may there always be, for a devotee of Śiva, / the attainment of endless fruit birth after birth!

sanskrit_iast:
yathā bhedaṃ na paśyāmi śivaviṣṇvarkapadmajām ..
tathā mamāstu viśvātmā śaṅkaraḥ śaṃkaraḥ sadā .. 18 ..
meaning:
यथा भेदं न पश्यामि शिवविष्ण्वर्कपद्मजाम् ..
तथा ममास्तु विश्वात्मा शङ्करः शंकरः सदा .. 18 ..
text_mt: Just as I see no difference between Śiva, Viṣṇu, the Sun, and the Lotus-born [Brahmā], / so may Śaṅkara, the Self of the universe, always be auspicious to me!”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuccārya ca tatsarvamalaṃkṛtya vibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
śaktaścecchayanaṃ dadyātsarvopaskarasaṃyutam ..
aśaktastu phalānyeva yathoktāni vidhānataḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
इत्युच्चार्य च तत्सर्वमलंकृत्य विभूषणैः ..
शक्तश्चेच्छयनं दद्यात्सर्वोपस्करसंयुतम् ..
अशक्तस्तु फलान्येव यथोक्तानि विधानतः .. 19 ..

meaning:

विप्राय दत्त्वा भुञ्जीत तैलक्षारविवर्जितम् ..
अन्यानपि यथा शक्त्या भोजयेद्द्विजपुङ्गवान् .. 4.98.20 ..
text_mt: Likewise, having given to the brahmin two golden [images of] Śiva and Dharma accompanied by water-jars, / one should eat food free from oil and alkaline substances. / One should also feed other eminent twice-born men according to one's means.

एकमेव परित्यज्य तदित्थं प्रतिपादयेत् .. 21 ..
text_mt: If one is unable to give up all fruits, / one should abandon even a single one and present it in this manner.

sanskrit_iast:
etattyāgavratānāṃ tu gave vaiṣṇavayoginām ..
śastaṃ sarvaphalatyāgaṃ vrataṃ vedavido viduḥ ..
nārībhiśca yathāśaktyā kartavyaṃ rājasattama .. 22 ..
meaning:
एतत्त्यागव्रतानां तु गवे वैष्णवयोगिनाम् ..

sanskrit_iast:
naitasmādaparaṃ kiñcidiha loke paratra ca ..

meaning:

व्रतमस्ति मुनिश्रेष्ठ यदन्नं तत्फलप्रदम् ..23..

tāvadyugasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate .. 24 ..
meaning:
सौवर्णरौप्यताम्रेषु यावंतः परमाणवः..

sanskrit_iast:
etatsamastakaluṣāpaharaṃ janānāmājīvanāya manujeśvara sarvadā syāt ..

meaning:
एतत्समस्तकलुषापहरं जनानामाजीवनाय मनुजेश्वर सर्वदा स्यात् ..

पौर्णमासी महाराज सोमस्य दयिता तिथिः ..
पूर्णमासो भवेद्यस्यां पौर्णमासी ततः स्मृता .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / The full moon day, O great king, is the beloved lunar day of Soma. / Because the full month is completed on it, it is therefore traditionally called paurṇamāsī.
title: Māsīvratavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
paurṇamāsyāṃ ca saṃjātaḥ saṃgrāmo jayalakṣaṇaḥ ..
somasyāribudhaiḥ sārddhaṃ sarvasattvabhayaṃkaram .. .. 2 ..
meaning:
पौर्णमास्यां च संजातः संग्रामो जयलक्षणः ..
सोमस्यारिबुधैः सार्द्धं सर्वसत्त्वभयंकरम् .. .. 2 ..
text_mt: And on the full moon day there took place a battle marked by victory, / between Soma and his wise enemies, terrifying to all living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
tārāyāṃ candramāḥ saktastasyā bhartā bṛhaspatiḥ ..
tayorabhūnmahāyuddhaṃ bhāryākṛtyeṣu vai purā .. 3 ..
meaning:
तारायां चन्द्रमाः सक्तस्तस्या भर्ता बृहस्पतिः ..
तयोरभून्महायुद्धं भार्याकृत्येषु वै पुरा .. 3 ..
text_mt: The Moon was attached to Tārā; Bṛhaspati was her husband. / In ancient times a great war arose between the two of them concerning the duties toward a wife.

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ..
tārā kasya sutā kasmātsa kruddhaḥ sasurārihā ..
somena saha saṃgrāmaṃ cakre cakragadādhara .. 4 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच ..
तारा कस्य सुता कस्मात्स क्रुद्धः ससुरारिहा ..
सोमेन सह संग्रामं चक्रे चक्रगदाधर .. 4 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Whose daughter was Tārā, and why did he, the slayer of the enemies of the gods, / become enraged and fight a battle with Soma, O wielder of the discus and mace?

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
prajāpaterabhūtkanyā tārā vṛtrasya cānujā ..
tāṃ bṛhaspataye prādātpṛthivyāmekasuṃdarīm .. 5 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
प्रजापतेरभूत्कन्या तारा वृत्रस्य चानुजा ..
तां बृहस्पतये प्रादात्पृथिव्यामेकसुंदरीम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Tārā was the daughter of Prajāpati and the younger sister of Vṛtra. / He gave her, the singular beauty upon the earth, to Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast:
devācāryāya sā bhāryā tvanirdeśyā tathāvidhā ..
rūpeṇābhyāṃ rūpavatī sā nirdhūya vyavasthitā .. 6 ..
meaning:
देवाचार्याय सा भार्या त्वनिर्देश्या तथाविधा ..
रूपेणाभ्यां रूपवती सा निर्धूय व्यवस्थिता .. 6 ..
text_mt: She, such a wife, was beyond description for the teacher of the gods; / surpassing all others in beauty, she stood pre-eminent with her lovely form.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiṃ paryacaradyathā cānyāḥ striyaḥ kvacit ..
tāṃ dadarśāyatāpāṃgīṃ tanvaṃgīṃ cāruhāsinīm .. 7 ..
meaning:
बृहस्पतिं पर्यचरद्यथा चान्याः स्त्रियः क्वचित् ..
तां ददर्शायतापांगीं तन्वंगीं चारुहासिनीम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: She served Bṛhaspati just as other women do elsewhere. / The Cool-rayed [Moon] saw her, long-eyed, slender-limbed, and sweetly smiling;

sanskrit_iast:
śītāṃśurdarśanādeva kāmasya vaśamīyivān ..
ābabhāṣe ca madhuraṃ tāre ehyehi mā ciram .. 8 ..
meaning:
शीतांशुर्दर्शनादेव कामस्य वशमीयिवान् ..
आबभाषे च मधुरं तारे एह्येहि मा चिरम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: the moment he saw her, he fell under the sway of desire. / And he spoke sweetly: “O Tārā, come, come, do not delay!”

sanskrit_iast:
iṃgitākārakuśalā tārā somasya ceṣṭitam ..
buddhvā śuddhimatho tanvī prāhedaṃ madhurākṣaram .. 9 ..
meaning:
इंगिताकारकुशला तारा सोमस्य चेष्टितम् ..
बुद्ध्वा शुद्धिमथो तन्वी प्राहेदं मधुराक्षरम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Skilled in reading gestures and facial expressions, the slender woman, / having perceived Soma's intention, then spoke these sweet words with purity of mind:

sanskrit_iast:
muneraṃgirasaḥ putrastvaṃ ca saumyo'si somarāṭ ..
aṃgiraso munervīra snuṣāhamucitaṃ na te ..
saha saumyena yo yogastava siddho' dbhuto mahān .. 4.99.10 ..
meaning:
मुनेरंगिरसः पुत्रस्त्वं च सौम्योऽसि सोमराट् ..
अंगिरसो मुनेर्वीर स्नुषाहमुचितं न ते ..
सह सौम्येन यो योगस्तव सिद्धो' द्भुतो महान् .. 4.99.10 ..
text_mt: “You are the son of the sage Aṅgiras, and you are gentle, King Soma! / O hero, I am the daughter-in-law of the sage Aṅgiras; this is not proper for you. / What a great and wonderful union has been accomplished for you with the gentle one!

sanskrit_iast:
aṃgirāstvāṃ kila purā sasurāsurarākṣasaiḥ ..
rājatve sthāpayāmāsa naitatsmarasi kiṃ vidho .. 11 ..
meaning:
अंगिरास्त्वां किल पुरा ससुरासुरराक्षसैः ..
राजत्वे स्थापयामास नैतत्स्मरसि किं विधो .. 11 ..
text_mt: In ancient times, indeed, Aṅgiras established you in kingship / along with the gods, asuras, and rākṣasas; do you not remember this, O Moon?

sanskrit_iast:
kathamadya niśānātha hyanaṃgenāsi pīḍitaḥ ..
tasmādbravīmi siddhiṃ te rocaye ghaṭitaṃ kuru ..
paravatyasmi bhadraṃ te na gamyāsmi budhottama .. 12 ..
meaning:
कथमद्य निशानाथ ह्यनंगेनासि पीडितः ..
तस्माद्ब्रवीमि सिद्धिं ते रोचये घटितं कुरु ..
परवत्यस्मि भद्रं ते न गम्यास्मि बुधोत्तम .. 12 ..
text_mt: How is it that today, O lord of the night, you are tormented by the bodiless one [Kāma]? / Therefore I speak for your welfare; do what is right according to my wish. / I am under another's authority, may you be blessed; I am not to be approached, O best of the wise!”

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktastathā cāsau na caitatkṛtavāṃstataḥ ..
gṛhītvākarṣayāmāsa somo'naṃgavaśīkṛtaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
एवमुक्तस्तथा चासौ न चैतत्कृतवांस्ततः ..
गृहीत्वाकर्षयामास सोमोऽनंगवशीकृतः .. 13 ..
text_mt: Though spoken to thus, he did not act accordingly. / Overcome by the bodiless one [Kāma], Soma seized her and pulled her away.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatistu tāṃ jñātvā sa taṃ somamagarhayat ..
preṣayiṣyati me bhāryāṃ svayameva mamāṃtikam .. 14 ..
meaning:
बृहस्पतिस्तु तां ज्ञात्वा स तं सोममगर्हयत् ..
प्रेषयिष्यति मे भार्यां स्वयमेव ममांतिकम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Bṛhaspati, having learned of her [abduction], censured Soma, [thinking]: / “He will surely send my wife back to me of his own accord.”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ cireṇa vijñāya bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ ..
nāsasāda svakāṃ bhāryāṃ roṣātprasphuritādharaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
एवं चिरेण विज्ञाय बृहस्पतिरुदारधीः ..
नाससाद स्वकां भार्यां रोषात्प्रस्फुरिताधरः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Knowing thus after a long time, the noble-minded Bṛhaspati, / not recovering his own wife, had his lower lip trembling with rage.

sanskrit_iast:
ācakhyau sarvamindrāya somasyedaṃ viceṣṭitam ..
iṃdraḥ samāhvayāmāsa devānṛṣigaṇāṃstathā .. 16 ..
meaning:
आचख्यौ सर्वमिन्द्राय सोमस्येदं विचेष्टितम् ..
इंद्रः समाह्वयामास देवानृषिगणांस्तथा .. 16 ..
text_mt: He related all this conduct of Soma to Indra. / Indra summoned the gods and the hosts of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
na somo gaṇayāmāsa tato'budhyata devarāṭ ..
ākāryaṃ tridaśānsarvānācakhyau candraceṣṭitam .. 17 ..
meaning:
न सोमो गणयामास ततोऽबुध्यत देवराट् ..
आकार्यं त्रिदशान्सर्वानाचख्यौ चन्द्रचेष्टितम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: Soma paid no heed; then the king of the gods understood. / Having summoned all the thirty [gods], he recounted the Moon's conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā devagaṃdharvāḥ krodhāndhāḥ kṣubdhamānasāḥ ..
pragṛhītapraharaṇā rathānāruruhuḥ svakān.. 18 ..
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा देवगंधर्वाः क्रोधान्धाः क्षुब्धमानसाः ..
प्रगृहीतप्रहरणा रथानारुरुहुः स्वकान्.. 18 ..
text_mt: Hearing that, the gods and gandharvas, blinded by anger and agitated in mind, / took up their weapons and mounted their chariots.

sanskrit_iast:
somo'pi devānsodyogāñjñātvā sukṛtaniścayān ..
daityadānavarakṣāṃsi samānīya vyavasthitaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
सोमोऽपि देवान्सोद्योगाञ्ज्ञात्वा सुकृतनिश्चयान् ..
दैत्यदानवरक्षांसि समानीय व्यवस्थितः .. 19 ..
text_mt: Soma too, knowing that the gods were prepared for action and firm in their resolve, / stood ready, having brought together the daityas, dānavas, and rakṣases.

sanskrit_iast:
āruhya ca rathaśreṣṭhaṃ yuddhāyaiva mano dadhe ..
pravṛttaṃ sumahadyuddhaṃ śaratomarakaṃpanaiḥ .. 4.99.20 ..
meaning:
आरुह्य च रथश्रेष्ठं युद्धायैव मनो दधे ..
प्रवृत्तं सुमहद्युद्धं शरतोमरकंपनैः .. 4.99.20 ..
text_mt: Mounting his excellent chariot, he set his mind on battle. / A tremendous war commenced with arrows, javelins, and shaking spears.

sanskrit_iast:
kauṇapaiḥ kṣmāsuraiḥ śūlairdevadānavadāraṇam ..
sa teṣāṃ sumahadyuddhaṃ dattvā tārāgaṇādhipaḥ...
babhaṃja devānsendrāṃśca hemavṛṣṭyā kṣapākaraḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
कौणपैः क्ष्मासुरैः शूलैर्देवदानवदारणम् ..
स तेषां सुमहद्युद्धं दत्त्वा तारागणाधिपः...
बभंज देवान्सेन्द्रांश्च हेमवृष्ट्या क्षपाकरः .. 21 ..
text_mt: With spear-like missiles, earthen arrows, and tridents that tore apart gods and Dānavas. / Offering them tremendous battle, the lord of the stars, / the night-maker, broke the gods, along with Indra, with a shower of gold.

sanskrit_iast:
sa jitvā devagandharvānsomo rājanyasattama ..
śriyā paramayā yukto yathā nānyo havirbhujām .. .. 22 ..
meaning:
स जित्वा देवगन्धर्वान्सोमो राजन्यसत्तम ..
श्रिया परमया युक्तो यथा नान्यो हविर्भुजाम् .. .. 22 ..
text_mt: Having vanquished the gods and Gandharvas, O best of kings, / Soma was endowed with supreme splendor, as was no other among the consumers of oblations.

sanskrit_iast:
devāśca nirjitāstena somenāmitatejasā ..
ājagmuḥ śaraṇaṃ devaṃ śaraṇyaṃ svargavāsinām .. 23 ..
meaning:
देवाश्च निर्जितास्तेन सोमेनामिततेजसा ..
आजग्मुः शरणं देवं शरण्यं स्वर्गवासिनाम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: And the gods, utterly defeated by that Soma of boundless brilliance, / went for refuge to the god who is the refuge of the dwellers in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
indraḥ sarvaṃ samācakhyau somasyedṛgviceṣṭitam ..
śrutvā kruddho hṛṣīkeśa āruhya garuḍaṃ ruṣā ..
gṛhītvā cāyudhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yuddhāyaiva mano dadhe .. 24 ..
meaning:
इन्द्रः सर्वं समाचख्यौ सोमस्येदृग्विचेष्टितम् ..
श्रुत्वा क्रुद्धो हृषीकेश आरुह्य गरुडं रुषा ..
गृहीत्वा चायुधं श्रेष्ठं युद्धायैव मनो दधे .. 24 ..
text_mt: Indra recounted everything—such conduct of Soma. / Hearing it, Hṛṣīkeśa became angry; mounting Garuḍa in wrath / and taking up his supreme weapon, he set his mind on war.

sanskrit_iast:
prakartuṃ sumahadyuddhaṃ cakraśārṅgagadā dharaḥ ..
jagāma vibudhaiḥ sārdhaṃ somasyopari roṣitaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
प्रकर्तुं सुमहद्युद्धं चक्रशार्ङ्गगदा धरः ..
जगाम विबुधैः सार्धं सोमस्योपरि रोषितः .. 25 ..
text_mt: Bearing the discus, Śārṅga bow, and mace to wage a great battle, / he went, enraged, along with the gods, against Soma.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuṃ viditvā saṃprāptaṃ somo daityagaṇaiḥ saha ..
yuddhāya samarāmarṣī sthitaḥ pradhmāya vārijam .. 26 ..
meaning:
विष्णुं विदित्वा संप्राप्तं सोमो दैत्यगणैः सह ..
युद्धाय समरामर्षी स्थितः प्रध्माय वारिजम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: Knowing Viṣṇu had arrived, Soma, along with the hosts of Daityas, / stood eager for the battle's rage, having blown his conch.

sanskrit_iast:
sa jitvā devasaṃghātaṃ seṃdraṃ vāyupurassaram ..
viṣṇunā saha saṃyuktaḥ śastrāstrairasubhojanaiḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
स जित्वा देवसंघातं सेंद्रं वायुपुरस्सरम् ..
विष्णुना सह संयुक्तः शस्त्रास्त्रैरसुभोजनैः .. 27 ..
text_mt: Having defeated the assembly of gods headed by Vāyu and with Indra, / he engaged with Viṣṇu with weapons and missiles that devour life.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā nāsāvuparamedyuddhāya saha viṣṇunā ..
tadā''dade ruṣā viṣṇuścakaṃ krodhasamanvitaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
यदा नासावुपरमेद्युद्धाय सह विष्णुना ..
तदा'ऽददे रुषा विष्णुश्चकं क्रोधसमन्वितः .. 28 ..
text_mt: When he would not desist from battling Viṣṇu, / then Viṣṇu in anger, filled with wrath, took up his discus.

sanskrit_iast:
athāha brahmā deveśamajitaṃ viṣṇumavyayam ..
yo'sau meghaprapuṣṭāṃgaṃ yattvāṃ vacmi nibodha tat .. 29 ..
meaning:
अथाह ब्रह्मा देवेशमजितं विष्णुमव्ययम् ..
योऽसौ मेघप्रपुष्टांगं यत्त्वां वच्मि निबोध तत् .. 29 ..
text_mt: Then Brahmā said to Viṣṇu, the imperishable, unconquered lord of the gods, / whose body is like a raincloud: 'Understand what I say to you:

sanskrit_iast:
nāsti vadhyaṃ tribhuvane cakrasyāsya tavānagha ..
somo dvijādhipatye ca mayā samabhiṣecitaḥ .. 4.99.30 ..
meaning:
नास्ति वध्यं त्रिभुवने चक्रस्यास्य तवानघ ..
सोमो द्विजाधिपत्ये च मया समभिषेचितः .. 4.99.30 ..
text_mt: There is nothing in the three worlds that cannot be slain by this discus of yours, O sinless one. / But Soma was consecrated by me to the sovereignty over the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādyadyujyate devakārye'smiṃstadvidhīyatām ..
athāha bhagavānviṣṇuḥ surabrahmarṣisannidhau .. 31 ..
meaning:
तस्माद्यद्युज्यते देवकार्येऽस्मिंस्तद्विधीयताम् ..
अथाह भगवान्विष्णुः सुरब्रह्मर्षिसन्निधौ .. 31 ..
text_mt: Therefore, do whatever is fitting in this matter of the gods.' / Then the blessed Lord Viṣṇu spoke in the presence of the gods and celestial sages:

sanskrit_iast:
sinīvālī kuhūrnāma tasyāṃ naṣṭaḥ kṣapākaraḥ ..
vinaṣṭo'pi punarjanma prāpsyatīti na saṃśayaḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
सिनीवाली कुहूर्नाम तस्यां नष्टः क्षपाकरः ..
विनष्टोऽपि पुनर्जन्म प्राप्स्यतीति न संशयः .. 32 ..
text_mt: 'On Sinīvālī and Kuhū, the night-maker shall disappear. / Even when vanished, he shall obtain rebirth; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
rākāṃ cānumatiṃ prāpya vṛddhirasya bhaviṣyati ..
āpyāyitaśca śrutyuktaiḥ pitṛpiṇḍaiḥ samaṃtrakaiḥ ..
brāhmaṇairhavyakavyāni devebhyaḥ prāpayiṣyati .. 33..
meaning:
राकां चानुमतिं प्राप्य वृद्धिरस्य भविष्यति ..
आप्यायितश्च श्रुत्युक्तैः पितृपिण्डैः समंत्रकैः ..
ब्राह्मणैर्हव्यकव्यानि देवेभ्यः प्रापयिष्यति .. 33..
text_mt: And having reached Rākā and Anumati, he shall experience growth. / And nourished by ancestral balls of rice accompanied by mantras as stated in the Śruti, / through the brāhmaṇas he will deliver the offerings to gods and ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛddhiḥ kṛṣṇena caivāsya na ca jātasya bhūyasī ..
evameva vidhirdṛṣṭastasyāpyāya nameva me .. 34 ..
meaning:
वृद्धिः कृष्णेन चैवास्य न च जातस्य भूयसी ..
एवमेव विधिर्दृष्टस्तस्याप्याय नमेव मे .. 34 ..
text_mt: And his increase shall come through the dark fortnight, yet not greater than when he was born; / thus has the rule been seen: his waxing indeed belongs to me.

sanskrit_iast:
amoghasya na moghatvaṃ bhaviṣyati kadācana ..
śaptaśca somo dakṣeṇa sa cāvaśyaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 35 ..
meaning:
अमोघस्य न मोघत्वं भविष्यति कदाचन ..
शप्तश्च सोमो दक्षेण स चावश्यं भविष्यति .. 35 ..
text_mt: What is infallible can never become in vain. / Moreover, Soma was cursed by Dakṣa, and that [curse] must certainly come to pass.

sanskrit_iast:
sudarśanasya ca prītirevameva bhaviṣyati ..
evamastviti deveśa yadbhavānprabravīti vai .. 36 ..
meaning:
सुदर्शनस्य च प्रीतिरेवमेव भविष्यति ..
एवमस्त्विति देवेश यद्भवान्प्रब्रवीति वै .. 36 ..
text_mt: And thus will be the pleasure of Sudarśana.' / [Brahmā said:] 'Let it be so, O lord of gods, just as you say.'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā provāca somaṃ tu vinītavadupasthitam ..
arpayasva gurorbhāryāṃ na kāryaṃ punarīdṛśam .. 37 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मा प्रोवाच सोमं तु विनीतवदुपस्थितम् ..
अर्पयस्व गुरोर्भार्यां न कार्यं पुनरीदृशम् .. 37 ..
text_mt: Then Brahmā spoke to Soma, who stood humbly before him: / 'Surrender the guru's wife; such an act is not to be done again.'

sanskrit_iast:
sa tathoktaḥ samānīya dadau tārāṃ bṛhaspateḥ ..
punarūce śaśī spaṣṭaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tridivaukasām ..38 ..
meaning:
स तथोक्तः समानीय ददौ तारां बृहस्पतेः ..
पुनरूचे शशी स्पष्टं शृण्वतां त्रिदिवौकसाम् ..38 ..
text_mt: Being thus addressed, he brought Tārā and gave her to Bṛhaspati. / Again the moon spoke clearly, while the dwellers of heaven were listening:

sanskrit_iast:
asyāṃ garbho madīyo'yaṃ yadapatyaṃ mamaiva tat ..
bṛhaspatirathovāca mayā garbhaḥ samāhitaḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
अस्यां गर्भो मदीयोऽयं यदपत्यं ममैव तत् ..
बृहस्पतिरथोवाच मया गर्भः समाहितः .. 39 ..
text_mt: 'This embryo in her is mine; whatever child it is, is mine alone.' / Bṛhaspati then said: 'The seed was placed by me;

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetre madīye cotpannastasmātsa mama putrakaḥ..
uktaṃ ca vedaśāstrajñairṣibhirddharmadarśibhiḥ .. 4.99.40 ..
meaning:
क्षेत्रे मदीये चोत्पन्नस्तस्मात्स मम पुत्रकः..
उक्तं च वेदशास्त्रज्ञैर्षिभिर्द्धर्मदर्शिभिः .. 4.99.40 ..
text_mt: and it was born in my field; therefore he is my son. / And it is declared by the sages who know the Vedas and treatises, who perceive dharma:

sanskrit_iast:
uptaṃ vātāhṛtaṃ bījaṃ yasya kṣetre prarohati ..
kṣetriṇastasya tadbījaṃ na bījī phalabhāgbhavet .. 41 ..
meaning:
उप्तं वाताहृतं बीजं यस्य क्षेत्रे प्ररोहति ..
क्षेत्रिणस्तस्य तद्बीजं न बीजी फलभाग्भवेत् .. 41 ..
text_mt: "A seed sown or brought by the wind, which sprouts in someone's field, / belongs to the owner of the field; the owner of the seed shall not share in the fruit."'

sanskrit_iast:
samyaguktaṃ na bhavatā śaśāṃkaḥ prāha tattvavit ..
mātā bhastrā pituḥ putro yena jātaḥ sa eva saḥ ..
iti paurāṇikāḥ prāhurmunayo nayacakṣuṣaḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
सम्यगुक्तं न भवता शशांकः प्राह तत्त्ववित् ..
माता भस्त्रा पितुः पुत्रो येन जातः स एव सः ..
इति पौराणिकाः प्राहुर्मुनयो नयचक्षुषः .. 42 ..
text_mt: 'That was not correctly spoken by you,' said the moon, knowing the truth. / 'The mother is a bellows; the son belongs to the father: he is the very one by whom he was begotten. / Thus have declared the knowers of the Purāṇas, the sages whose eyes are discernment.'

sanskrit_iast:
vivadaṃtau nivāryātha brahmā provāca tāṃ vadhūm ..
śanairekāṃtamānīya garbhoyaṃ kasya śaṃsa me .. 43 ..
meaning:
विवदंतौ निवार्याथ ब्रह्मा प्रोवाच तां वधूम् ..
शनैरेकांतमानीय गर्भोयं कस्य शंस मे .. 43 ..
text_mt: Restraining the two who were disputing, Brahmā then said to that young woman, / having led her aside quietly: 'Tell me, whose embryo is this?'

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktā tu sā tārā hriyā novāca kiṃcana ..
utsasarja kṣaṇādgarbhaṃ bhābhāsitasurālayam .. 44 ..
meaning:
एवमुक्ता तु सा तारा ह्रिया नोवाच किंचन ..
उत्ससर्ज क्षणाद्गर्भं भाभासितसुरालयम् .. 44 ..
text_mt: Being thus addressed, Tārā said nothing out of shame; / in an instant she gave birth to the child, who illuminated the abode of the gods with his splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
tamuvāca tato brahmā putra kasya suto bhavān ..
somasyāhaṃ suto brahmanniti tathyaṃ mayoditam .. .. 45 ..
meaning:
तमुवाच ततो ब्रह्मा पुत्र कस्य सुतो भवान् ..
सोमस्याहं सुतो ब्रह्मन्निति तथ्यं मयोदितम् .. .. 45 ..
text_mt: Then Brahmā said to him: 'Child, whose son are you?' / [He replied:] 'O Brahmā, I am the son of Soma; this is the truth spoken by me.'

sanskrit_iast:
budho'yaṃ vibudhāḥ prāhuḥ sarvajñānavidāṃ varaḥ ..
gṛhītvā putrakaṃ somo jagāma svaṃ niveśanam .. 46 ..
meaning:
बुधोऽयं विबुधाः प्राहुः सर्वज्ञानविदां वरः ..
गृहीत्वा पुत्रकं सोमो जगाम स्वं निवेशनम् .. 46 ..
text_mt: 'He is Budha!' the gods proclaimed, 'foremost among knowers of all knowledge.' / Taking the child, Soma went to his own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
gururgṛhītvā svāṃ bhāryāṃ jagāma bhavanaṃ śanaiḥ ..
somo'pi tanayaṃ labdhvā harṣavyākulamānasaḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
गुरुर्गृहीत्वा स्वां भार्यां जगाम भवनं शनैः ..
सोमोऽपि तनयं लब्ध्वा हर्षव्याकुलमानसः .. 47 ..
text_mt: The guru, taking his wife, went slowly to his residence. / Soma also, having obtained a son, had his mind overwhelmed with joy, [thinking:]

sanskrit_iast:
paurṇamāsī samākhyātā prāptapūrṇamanorathā ..
prāptaḥ putro mayā hyasyāṃ labdhaśca vi jayastathā ..48..
meaning:
पौर्णमासी समाख्याता प्राप्तपूर्णमनोरथा ..
प्राप्तः पुत्रो मया ह्यस्यां लब्धश्च वि जयस्तथा ..48..
text_mt: '[This tithi] is called Paurṇamāsī, on which all desires are fulfilled! / For on it a son has been obtained by me, and victory has also been achieved.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādenāmupāsiṣye vidhinā vratatatparaḥ..
evamanyo'pi pūrṇārthaḥ pūrṇāṃśaḥ pūrṇalakṣaṇaḥ ..49..
meaning:
तस्मादेनामुपासिष्ये विधिना व्रततत्परः..
एवमन्योऽपि पूर्णार्थः पूर्णांशः पूर्णलक्षणः ..49..
text_mt: Therefore, devoted to vows, I will worship this [tithi] according to the injunctions. / Likewise, any other person whose purposes, parts, and marks are complete,

sanskrit_iast:
yo māmakyāṃ tithau bhaktyā vidhivatpūjayiṣyati ..
tasya prasādābhimukhaḥ sarvakāmaprado hyaham .. 4.99.50 ..
meaning:
यो मामक्यां तिथौ भक्त्या विधिवत्पूजयिष्यति ..
तस्य प्रसादाभिमुखः सर्वकामप्रदो ह्यहम् .. 4.99.50 ..
text_mt: who worships [me] according to rule with devotion on my tithi, / to him I shall be favorably disposed, bestowing all desires.'

sanskrit_iast:
evameṣā tithiḥ pārtha somasya dayitā śubhā ..
paurṇamāsī samākhyātā pūrṇo māso bhavedyathā .. 51 ..
meaning:
एवमेषा तिथिः पार्थ सोमस्य दयिता शुभा ..
पौर्णमासी समाख्याता पूर्णो मासो भवेद्यथा .. 51 ..
text_mt: Thus, O son of Pṛthā, this auspicious tithi is beloved of Soma; / it is called Paurṇamāsī, when the month becomes full.

sanskrit_iast:
tadasyāṃ srotasi snātvā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ ..
ālikhya maṃḍale somaṃ nakṣatraiḥ sahitaṃ vibhum .. 52 ..
meaning:
तदस्यां स्रोतसि स्नात्वा संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः ..
आलिख्य मंडले सोमं नक्षत्रैः सहितं विभुम् .. 52 ..
text_mt: Therefore, bathing in a stream on this day and propitiating the ancestors and gods, / drawing the lord Soma along with the lunar mansions in a mandala,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayetkusumairhṛdyairnaivedyairghṛtapācitaiḥ ..
śuklākṣataiḥ śuklavastraiḥ pūjayitvā kṣamāpayet..
śākāharaṇamunyannairnaktaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
पूजयेत्कुसुमैर्हृद्यैर्नैवेद्यैर्घृतपाचितैः ..
शुक्लाक्षतैः शुक्लवस्त्रैः पूजयित्वा क्षमापयेत्..
शाकाहरणमुन्यन्नैर्नक्तं भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः .. 53 ..
text_mt: one should worship him with lovely flowers, food-offerings cooked in ghee, / white unhusked barley grains, and white garments, and after worshipping, beg forgiveness. / One should eat a nocturnal meal in silence, consisting of gathered greens or ascetics' food.

sanskrit_iast:
vasaṃtabāṃdhava vidho śītāṃśo svasti naḥ kuru ..
gaganārṇavamāṇikya candra dākṣāyaṇīpate .. 54 ..
meaning:
वसंतबांधव विधो शीतांशो स्वस्ति नः कुरु ..
गगनार्णवमाणिक्य चन्द्र दाक्षायणीपते .. 54 ..
text_mt: 'O friend of spring, O moon, O cold-rayed one, grant us well-being! / O ruby of the sky-ocean, O Candra, O husband of the daughters of Dakṣa!'

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣepakṣe paurṇamāsyāṃ vidhireṣa prakīrtitaḥ ..
kṛṣṇapakṣe'pi yaḥ kaścicchraddhāvānvai vratī bhavet .. 55..
meaning:
पक्षेपक्षे पौर्णमास्यां विधिरेष प्रकीर्तितः ..
कृष्णपक्षेऽपि यः कश्चिच्छ्रद्धावान्वै व्रती भवेत् .. 55..
text_mt: Fortnight after fortnight on the full-moon day, this rite has been proclaimed. / If someone, full of faith, observes a votive observance on the dark fortnight as well,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāpyeṣa vidhiḥ proktaḥ sarvasaukhyapradāyakaḥ ..
āmāvāsyā tithiriyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ dayitā sadā ..
asyāṃ dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ pitṝṇāmakṣayaṃ bhavet .. 56 ..
meaning:
तस्याप्येष विधिः प्रोक्तः सर्वसौख्यप्रदायकः ..
आमावास्या तिथिरियं पितॄणां दयिता सदा ..
अस्यां दत्तं तपस्तप्तं पितॄणामक्षयं भवेत् .. 56 ..
text_mt: for him too this rite has been declared, granting all comforts. / This new-moon tithi is always dear to the ancestors; / what is given and the asceticism performed on it become imperishable for the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
amāvāsyā mahārāja prayatnairyairupoṣitā ..
tairakṣayyaṃ bhaveddattaṃ pitṛbhyastīrthamuttamam .. 57 ..
meaning:
अमावास्या महाराज प्रयत्नैर्यैरुपोषिता ..
तैरक्षय्यं भवेद्दत्तं पितृभ्यस्तीर्थमुत्तमम् .. 57 ..
text_mt: Those by whom the new-moon day is observed with fasting and diligence, O great king, / by them is given an imperishable, supreme sacred water to the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ kaścitkurute tasminpitṛpiṇḍodakakriyām ..
sa tārayati puṇyātmā puruṣānekaviṃśatim .. 58 ..
meaning:
यः कश्चित्कुरुते तस्मिन्पितृपिण्डोदकक्रियाम् ..
स तारयति पुण्यात्मा पुरुषानेकविंशतिम् .. 58 ..
text_mt: Whoever performs the rite of ancestral balls of rice and water on that day, / that virtuous soul delivers twenty-one generations [of his lineage].

sanskrit_iast:
bhaveyurakṣayāstasya lokāḥ pitṛniṣevitāḥ ..
yadā tu iha kālāṃte tasyātrāgamanaṃ bhavet .. 59 ..
meaning:
भवेयुरक्षयास्तस्य लोकाः पितृनिषेविताः ..
यदा तु इह कालांते तस्यात्रागमनं भवेत् .. 59 ..
text_mt: Imperishable worlds frequented by the ancestors shall be his. / When, at the end of time, his return here takes place,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaḥ pitṛbhaktaśca sarvavidyāviśāradaḥ ..
evaṃ janmani rājendra bhaveddhanasamanvitaḥ .. 4.99.60 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणः पितृभक्तश्च सर्वविद्याविशारदः ..
एवं जन्मनि राजेन्द्र भवेद्धनसमन्वितः .. 4.99.60 ..
text_mt: he will be born as a brāhmaṇa, devoted to his ancestors, skilled in all branches of learning, / and endowed with wealth, O ruler of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte haimaṃ kṛtvā suśobhanam ..
somaṃ nakṣatrasahitaṃ viprāya pratipādayet .. 61 ..
meaning:
एवं संवत्सरस्यांते हैमं कृत्वा सुशोभनम् ..
सोमं नक्षत्रसहितं विप्राय प्रतिपादयेत् .. 61 ..
text_mt: Thus, at the end of a year, having fashioned a beautiful golden [image of] / Soma together with the lunar mansions, he should bestow it upon a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
upadeśaṃ prayacchedyastasmai vratakṛte naraḥ ..
saṃpūjya vastrābharaṇairmaṃtreṇetthaṃ nivedayet ..
māsemāse vidhirayaṃ vratasyāsya narādhipa .. 62 ..
meaning:
उपदेशं प्रयच्छेद्यस्तस्मै व्रतकृते नरः ..
संपूज्य वस्त्राभरणैर्मंत्रेणेत्थं निवेदयेत् ..
मासेमासे विधिरयं व्रतस्यास्य नराधिप .. 62 ..
text_mt: The man who performs the votive observance should bestow instruction upon that [priest]; / having honoured him with garments and ornaments, he should present [the gift] with a mantra thus: / 'This is the procedure for this votive observance month after month, O ruler of men.'

sanskrit_iast:
yo na śaknoti vā kartuṃ pakṣaṃ vātha niraṃtaram ..
sa ekāmapyupoṣyaiva kuryādudyāpanaṃ sudhīḥ .. 63 ..
meaning:
यो न शक्नोति वा कर्तुं पक्षं वाथ निरंतरम् ..
स एकामप्युपोष्यैव कुर्यादुद्यापनं सुधीः .. 63 ..
text_mt: Or whoever is unable to perform it continuously for a fortnight [or year], / that wise person, having fasted for even a single [lunar day], should perform the concluding rite.

sanskrit_iast:
yaścaitatkurute pārtha paurṇamāsīvrataṃ naraḥ ..
sarvapāpavinirmuktaścandravaddivi rājate .. 64 ..
meaning:
यश्चैतत्कुरुते पार्थ पौर्णमासीव्रतं नरः ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तश्चन्द्रवद्दिवि राजते .. 64 ..
text_mt: And whatever man observes this full-moon votive observance, O Pārtha, / freed from all sins, shines in heaven like the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
putrapautradhanopeto yajvā dātā priyaṃvadaḥ ..
saṃtatiṃ vipulāṃ prāpya prayāge maraṇaṃ bhajet .. 65 ..
meaning:
पुत्रपौत्रधनोपेतो यज्वा दाता प्रियंवदः ..
संततिं विपुलां प्राप्य प्रयागे मरणं भजेत् .. 65 ..
text_mt: Endowed with sons, grandsons, and wealth, a sacrificer, generous, and speaking pleasantly, / having attained extensive progeny, he should meet his death at Prayāga.

sanskrit_iast:
tataścaivākṣayām̐llokānprāpnoti surasevitān ..
sevyamānaḥ sa gandharvaiḥ stūyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ ..
āste saṃpūrṇasarvāṃgo yāvatkalpāyutatrayam .. 66 ..
meaning:
ततश्चैवाक्षयाम्̐ल्लोकान्प्राप्नोति सुरसेवितान् ..
सेव्यमानः स गन्धर्वैः स्तूयमानः सुरासुरैः ..
आस्ते संपूर्णसर्वांगो यावत्कल्पायुतत्रयम् .. 66 ..
text_mt: And from there he attains the imperishable worlds attended by the gods; / attended by Gandharvas and praised by gods and Asuras, / he dwells with all his limbs perfected for thirty thousand kalpas.

sanskrit_iast:
abhyarcayaṃti sitapañcadaśīṣu somaṃ kṛṣṇāsu ye pitṛgaṇaṃ jalapiṃḍadānaiḥ ..
teṣāṃ gṛhāṇi dhana dhānyasutādisaṃpatpūrṇāni pārthiva bhavaṃti vidhervidhānāt .. 67 ..
vaiśākhīkārttikīmāghīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
अभ्यर्चयंति सितपञ्चदशीषु सोमं कृष्णासु ये पितृगणं जलपिंडदानैः ..
तेषां गृहाणि धन धान्यसुतादिसंपत्पूर्णानि पार्थिव भवंति विधेर्विधानात् .. 67 ..
वैशाखीकार्त्तिकीमाघीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Those who worship the Moon on the bright fifteenth days, and the host of ancestors with offerings of water and rice-balls on the dark ones— / their houses, O king, become filled with wealth, grain, sons, and other fortunes, by destiny’s ordinance.
Description of the Votive Observance of the Full Moons of Vaiśākha, Kārttika, and Māgha

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
saṃvatsare ca yāḥ kāścittithayaḥ puṇyalakṣaṇāḥ ..
tā me vada yaduśreṣṭha snāne dāne mahāphalāḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
संवत्सरे च याः काश्चित्तिथयः पुण्यलक्षणाः ..
ता मे वद यदुश्रेष्ठ स्नाने दाने महाफलाः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / 'And whatever lunar days throughout the year possess auspicious marks / and yield great fruits through bathing and giving, tell them to me, O best of the Yadus.'
title: Vaiśākhīkārtikīmāghīvratavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
vaiśākhī kārtikī māghī tithayo'tīva pūjitāḥ ..
snānadānavihīnaistā na neyāḥ pāṃḍunandana .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
वैशाखी कार्तिकी माघी तिथयोऽतीव पूजिताः ..
स्नानदानविहीनैस्ता न नेयाः पांडुनन्दन .. 2 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / 'The lunar days of Vaiśākhī, Kārtikī, and Māghī are exceedingly revered; / they should not be spent without bathing and giving, O son of Pāṇḍu.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthasnānaṃ tadā śastaṃ dānaṃ vittānurūpataḥ ..
vaiśākhyāṃ pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha śreṣṭhā dyotanikā matā .. 3 ..
meaning:
तीर्थस्नानं तदा शस्तं दानं वित्तानुरूपतः ..
वैशाख्यां पांडवश्रेष्ठ श्रेष्ठा द्योतनिका मता .. 3 ..
text_mt: Bathing at a sacred ford is praised at that time, and giving according to one’s wealth; / on Vaiśākhī, O best of the Pāṇḍavas, the Dyotanikā [river] is considered supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
kārttikyāṃ puṣkarāraṇyaṃ māghyāṃ vārāṇasī smṛtā ..
snānenodakadānena tārayatyapi duṣkṛtīn ..4..
meaning:
कार्त्तिक्यां पुष्करारण्यं माघ्यां वाराणसी स्मृता ..
स्नानेनोदकदानेन तारयत्यपि दुष्कृतीन् ..4..
text_mt: On Kārttikī, the forest of Puṣkara is remembered [as best], and on Māghī, Vārāṇasī; / by bathing and giving water, one delivers even evil-doers.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṃbhānsvachāṃbhasaḥ pūrṇānsahiraṇyānnasaṃyutān..
vaiśākhyāṃ brāhmaṇo dattvā na śocati kṛte vrate .. 5 ..
meaning:
कुंभान्स्वछांभसः पूर्णान्सहिरण्यान्नसंयुतान्..
वैशाख्यां ब्राह्मणो दत्त्वा न शोचति कृते व्रते .. 5 ..
text_mt: Pots filled with clear water, along with gold and food— / having given these on Vaiśākhī, a Brahmin does not grieve when the votive observance is performed.

sanskrit_iast:
madhurānnarasaiḥ pūrṇānbhājanānkanakojjvalān ..
gobhūhiraṇyavāsāṃsi vidhivatpratipādayet .. .. 6 ..
meaning:
मधुरान्नरसैः पूर्णान्भाजनान्कनकोज्ज्वलान् ..
गोभूहिरण्यवासांसि विधिवत्प्रतिपादयेत् .. .. 6 ..
text_mt: Vessels gleaming with gold, filled with sweet dishes and broths, / cows, land, gold, and garments should be presented according to the rule.

sanskrit_iast:
māghyāṃ maghāsu ca tathā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ ..
tilapātrāṇi deyāni tilāṃśca palalaudanam .. 7 ..
meaning:
माघ्यां मघासु च तथा संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः ..
तिलपात्राणि देयानि तिलांश्च पललौदनम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: On Māghī and when the moon is in Maghā, having likewise gratified the ancestors and deities, / vessels filled with sesame, sesame seeds, and rice cooked with meat should be given.

sanskrit_iast:
kārpāsadānamatraiva tiladānaṃ ca śasyate ..
kaṃbalājinaratnāni mocakau pāpamocakau ..8..
meaning:
कार्पासदानमत्रैव तिलदानं च शस्यते ..
कंबलाजिनरत्नानि मोचकौ पापमोचकौ ..8..
text_mt: Right here, the gift of cotton and the gift of sesame are praised; / blankets, deer hides, and jewels are liberators, liberators from sin.

sanskrit_iast:
upānaddānamatraiva kathitaṃ sarvakāmadam ..
yatra vā tatra vā snānaṃ dānaṃ vittānurūpataḥ ..9..
meaning:
उपानद्दानमत्रैव कथितं सर्वकामदम् ..
यत्र वा तत्र वा स्नानं दानं वित्तानुरूपतः ..9..
text_mt: The gift of sandals right here is declared to bestow all desires; / bathing anywhere and giving according to one's wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
kalikālodbhavaṃ sarvaṃ śasyate pāṃḍunandana ..
kārtikyāṃ tu vṛṣotsargo vivāhaḥ puṇyalakṣaṇaḥ ..
kāryaṃ kurukulaśreṣṭha harernīrājanaṃ tathā .. 4.100.10 ..
meaning:
कलिकालोद्भवं सर्वं शस्यते पांडुनन्दन ..
कार्तिक्यां तु वृषोत्सर्गो विवाहः पुण्यलक्षणः ..
कार्यं कुरुकुलश्रेष्ठ हरेर्नीराजनं तथा .. 4.100.10 ..
text_mt: [and whatever is given in charity] arising in the Kali age, all is praised, O son of Pāṇḍu. / But on Kārtikī, the dedication of a bull, an auspicious marriage, / and the wave-offering of lamps to Hari should be performed, O best of Kuru's line.

sanskrit_iast:
gajāśvarathadānaṃ ca ghṛtadhenvādayastathā ..
pradeyāḥ puṇyakṛdbhiśca tāstāḥ saṃkalpya devatāḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
गजाश्वरथदानं च घृतधेन्वादयस्तथा ..
प्रदेयाः पुण्यकृद्भिश्च तास्ताः संकल्प्य देवताः .. 11 ..
text_mt: The gift of elephants, horses, and chariots, and ghee cows and the like, / should be presented by the doers of merit, having consecrated them to those various deities.

sanskrit_iast:
phalāni yāni vidyaṃte sugandhimadhurāṇi ca ..
jātīphalaṃ ca kaṃkolaṃ lavaṃgaṃ lavalīphalam .. 12 ..
meaning:
फलानि यानि विद्यंते सुगन्धिमधुराणि च ..
जातीफलं च कंकोलं लवंगं लवलीफलम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Whatever fruits are available that are fragrant and sweet— / nutmeg, kankola, clove, and lavalī fruit,

sanskrit_iast:
kharjūrīṃ nālikerāṃśca kadalyāśca phalāni ca ..
dāḍimānmātuluṃgāṃśca karkoṭāṃstrapusāṃstathā .. .. 13 ..
meaning:
खर्जूरीं नालिकेरांश्च कदल्याश्च फलानि च ..
दाडिमान्मातुलुंगांश्च कर्कोटांस्त्रपुसांस्तथा .. .. 13 ..
text_mt: dates, coconuts, and banana fruits, / pomegranates, citrons, spiny gourds, and cucumbers,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṃtākānkāravellāṃśca biṃbānkūṣmāṃḍakarburān ..
apradānena yeṣāṃ tu tithayo yāṃti bhārata ..
te vyādhitā daridrāśca jāyaṃte bhuvi mānavāḥ .. .. 14 ..
meaning:
वृंताकान्कारवेल्लांश्च बिंबान्कूष्मांडकर्बुरान् ..
अप्रदानेन येषां तु तिथयो यांति भारत ..
ते व्याधिता दरिद्राश्च जायंते भुवि मानवाः .. .. 14 ..
