etatkāmavrataṃnāma sarvaśokavināśanam ..
āṣāḍhādicaturmāsaṃ varjayennakhakartanam .. 28 ..
meaning:
एतत्कामव्रतंनाम सर्वशोकविनाशनम् ..
आषाढादिचतुर्मासं वर्जयेन्नखकर्तनम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: This is named the Kāmavrata, destroying all sorrow. / One should avoid cutting the nails for the four months beginning with Āṣāḍha,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṃtākabhakṣaṇaṃ caiva madhusarpirghaṭānvitam ..
kārtikyāṃ tu punarhaimaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet .. 29 ..
meaning:
वृंताकभक्षणं चैव मधुसर्पिर्घटान्वितम् ..
कार्तिक्यां तु पुनर्हैमं ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् .. 29 ..
text_mt: and the eating of aubergine; and on the Kārttika full moon, / one should present to a brāhmaṇa a golden [image] along with a jar of honey and ghee.

sanskrit_iast:
rudralokamavāpnoti śivavratamidaṃ smṛtam ..
evaṃ pañcadaśīṃ smṛtvā ekabhaktena mānavaḥ .. 4.121.30 ..
meaning:
रुद्रलोकमवाप्नोति शिवव्रतमिदं स्मृतम् ..
एवं पञ्चदशीं स्मृत्वा एकभक्तेन मानवः .. 4.121.30 ..
text_mt: He attains the realm of Rudra; this is remembered as the Śivavrata. / Thus a person, mindful on the fifteenth lunar day, eating a single meal,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya pūrṇimāṃ devīṃ likhitvā candanādinā ..
tataḥ pañcaghaṭānpūrṇānpayodadhighṛtena ca ..
madhunā sitakhaṇḍena brāhmaṇāyopapādayet .. 31 ..
meaning:
संपूज्य पूर्णिमां देवीं लिखित्वा चन्दनादिना ..
ततः पञ्चघटान्पूर्णान्पयोदधिघृतेन च ..
मधुना सितखण्डेन ब्राह्मणायोपपादयेत् .. 31 ..
text_mt: having worshipped the goddess of the full moon after drawing [her] with sandalwood paste and the like, / should then present to a brāhmaṇa five jars filled with milk, curd, and ghee, / with honey and white sugar:

sanskrit_iast:
manorathānpūrayasva saṃpūrṇānpūrṇimā hyasi ..
pañcakumbhapradānena bhūtānāṃ tuṣṭirastu me ..
dvijānevaṃ namaskṛtya sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 32 ..
meaning:
मनोरथान्पूरयस्व संपूर्णान्पूर्णिमा ह्यसि ..
पञ्चकुम्भप्रदानेन भूतानां तुष्टिरस्तु मे ..
द्विजानेवं नमस्कृत्य सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् .. 32 ..
text_mt: “Fulfill my desires completely, for you are the full moon! / May the beings be pleased with me through the gift of five water jars!” / Having thus bowed to the twice-born, he would obtain all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
etatpaṃcaghaṭaṃ nāma vrataṃ puṣṭipradāyakam...
varjayedyastu puṣpāṇi hemaṃtaśiśirāvratam .. 33 ..
meaning:
एतत्पंचघटं नाम व्रतं पुष्टिप्रदायकम्...
वर्जयेद्यस्तु पुष्पाणि हेमंतशिशिराव्रतम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: This is named the Pañcaghaṭavrata, granting nourishment. / Whoever avoids flowers throughout the winter and cool seasons,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpatrayaṃ ca phālgunyāṃ kṛtvā śaktyātha kāñcanam ..
dadyādvai kālavelāyāṃ prīyetāṃ śivakeśavau .. .. 34 ..
meaning:
पुष्पत्रयं च फाल्गुन्यां कृत्वा शक्त्याथ काञ्चनम् ..
दद्याद्वै कालवेलायां प्रीयेतां शिवकेशवौ .. .. 34 ..
text_mt: and on the full moon of Phālguna, according to his capacity, having made three golden flowers, / gives [them] at the twilight hour: “May Śiva and Keśava be pleased!”

sanskrit_iast:
śiraḥsaugandhajananaṃ sadānandakaraṃ nṛṇām ..
kṛtvā parapadaṃ yāti saugandhyavratamuttamam .. 35 ..
meaning:
शिरःसौगन्धजननं सदानन्दकरं नृणाम् ..
कृत्वा परपदं याति सौगन्ध्यव्रतमुत्तमम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: It produces fragrance of the head and brings perpetual delight to mortals; / having performed this excellent Saugandhyavrata, he goes to the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
phālgunāditṛtīyāyāṃ lavaṇaṃ yastu varjayet ..
samāpte śayanaṃ dayādgṛhe copaskarānvitam .. 36 ..
meaning:
फाल्गुनादितृतीयायां लवणं यस्तु वर्जयेत् ..
समाप्ते शयनं दयाद्गृहे चोपस्करान्वितम् .. 36 ..
text_mt: Whoever avoids salt on the third lunar day beginning with Phālguna, / and at the completion gives a bed in a house supplied with utensils,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya vipramithunaṃ bhavānī prīyatāmiti ..
gaurīloke vasetkalpaṃ saubhāgyavratamutta mam .. 37 ..
meaning:
संपूज्य विप्रमिथुनं भवानी प्रीयतामिति ..
गौरीलोके वसेत्कल्पं सौभाग्यव्रतमुत्त मम् .. 37 ..
text_mt: having worshipped a brāhmaṇa couple, saying, “May Bhavānī be pleased!” / would dwell in the realm of Gaurī for an eon; this is the excellent Saubhāgyavrata.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyāmaunaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā samāpte ghṛtakuṃbhadaḥ ..
vastrayugmaṃ ca ghaṃṭāṃ ca brāhmaṇāya nivedayet .. 38 ..
meaning:
संध्यामौनं नरः कृत्वा समाप्ते घृतकुंभदः ..
वस्त्रयुग्मं च घंटां च ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् .. 38 ..
text_mt: A man, observing silence at twilight, at its completion gives a jar of ghee, / and presents a pair of garments and a bell to a brāhmaṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
sārasvataṃ padaṃ yāti punarāvṛtti durlabham..
etatsārasvataṃ nāma rūpavidyāpradāyakam .. 39 ..
meaning:
सारस्वतं पदं याति पुनरावृत्ति दुर्लभम्..
एतत्सारस्वतं नाम रूपविद्याप्रदायकम् .. 39 ..
text_mt: he goes to the realm of Sarasvatī, from which return is hard to obtain. / This is named the Sārasvata[vrata], granting beauty and learning.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīmadhye'tha pañcamyāmupavāsī bhavennaraḥ ..
samāpte hemakamalaṃ dadyāddhenusamanvitam .. .. 4.121.40 ..
meaning:
लक्ष्मीमध्येऽथ पञ्चम्यामुपवासी भवेन्नरः ..
समाप्ते हेमकमलं दद्याद्धेनुसमन्वितम् .. .. 4.121.40 ..
text_mt: A man should fast on the fifth lunar day in the midst of Lakṣmī; / at the completion, he should give a golden lotus accompanied by a cow.

sanskrit_iast:
sa vaiṣṇavaṃ padaṃ yāti lakṣmīḥ syājjanmajanmani ..
etallakṣmīvrataṃ nāma duḥkhaśokavināśanam ..41..
meaning:
स वैष्णवं पदं याति लक्ष्मीः स्याज्जन्मजन्मनि ..
एतल्लक्ष्मीव्रतं नाम दुःखशोकविनाशनम् ..41..
text_mt: He goes to the realm of Viṣṇu, and fortune attends him in birth after birth; / this is named the Lakṣmīvrata, destroying grief and sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
yā tu nārī pibettoyaṃ jaladhārāṃ prapātayet ..
samāptaghṛtasaṃpūrṇāṃ dadyādvadvaṃtikāṃ? navām ..42 ..
meaning:
या तु नारी पिबेत्तोयं जलधारां प्रपातयेत् ..
समाप्तघृतसंपूर्णां दद्याद्वद्वंतिकां? नवाम् ..42 ..
text_mt: A woman who, drinking water, causes a stream of water to pour down, / at its completion should give a new vessel filled with ghee.

sanskrit_iast:
etaddhārāvrataṃ nāma sarvarogaharaṃ param..
kāṃtisaubhāgyajananaṃ sapatnīdarpanāśanam..43..
meaning:
एतद्धाराव्रतं नाम सर्वरोगहरं परम्..
कांतिसौभाग्यजननं सपत्नीदर्पनाशनम्..43..
text_mt: This is named the Dhārāvrata, supreme, dispelling all diseases, / producing radiance and good fortune, destroying the arrogance of co-wives.

sanskrit_iast:
gaurīsamanvitaṃ rudraṃ lakṣmyā saha janārdanam ..
rājñīsamanvitaṃ sūryaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi .. 44 ..
meaning:
गौरीसमन्वितं रुद्रं लक्ष्म्या सह जनार्दनम् ..
राज्ञीसमन्वितं सूर्यं प्रतिष्ठाप्य यथाविधि .. 44 ..
text_mt: Having duly established Rudra accompanied by Gaurī, Janārdana with Lakṣmī, / and Sūrya accompanied by Rājñī,

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpākṣepeṇasahitāṃ sughaṃṭāṃ pātrasaṃyutām ..
yo dadāti dvijendrāṇāṃ puṣpairabhyarcya pāṃḍuraiḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
धूपाक्षेपेणसहितां सुघंटां पात्रसंयुताम् ..
यो ददाति द्विजेन्द्राणां पुष्पैरभ्यर्च्य पांडुरैः .. 45 ..
text_mt: whoever gives to the best of twice-born a fine bell along with a vessel, accompanied by the offering of incense, / having worshipped with white flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāsahitāṃ kṛtvā praṇamya ca visarjayet ..
etaddevavrataṃ nāma divyadehapradāyakam .. 46 ..
meaning:
दक्षिणासहितां कृत्वा प्रणम्य च विसर्जयेत् ..
एतद्देवव्रतं नाम दिव्यदेहप्रदायकम् .. 46 ..
text_mt: having provided a sacrificial fee and having bowed, sends [them] away; / this is named the Devavrata, granting a celestial body.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvopalepanaṃ śaṃbhoragrataḥ keśavasya ca ..
yāvadvrataṃ samāpyaitaddhenuṃ ca sajalānvitām .. 47 ..
meaning:
कृत्वोपलेपनं शंभोरग्रतः केशवस्य च ..
यावद्व्रतं समाप्यैतद्धेनुं च सजलान्विताम् .. 47 ..
text_mt: Having performed plastering in front of Śambhu and Keśava, / as long as this votive observance lasts, and [giving] a cow along with water,

sanskrit_iast:
janmāyutaṃ sa rājā syāttataḥ śivapuraṃ vaset ..
etacchrutvā vrataṃ nāma bahukalyāṇakārakam .. 48 ..
meaning:
जन्मायुतं स राजा स्यात्ततः शिवपुरं वसेत् ..
एतच्छ्रुत्वा व्रतं नाम बहुकल्याणकारकम् .. 48 ..
text_mt: He shall become a king for ten thousand births; then he shall dwell in the city of Śiva. / Having heard this, it is an observance named [Devavrata] that brings abundant welfare.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvatthaṃ bhāskaraṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamyaiva ca vāgyataḥ ..
ekabhuktaṃ naraḥ kuryādaṣṭa caikaṃ vimatsaraḥ .. 49 ...
meaning:
अश्वत्थं भास्करं गंगां प्रणम्यैव च वाग्यतः ..
एकभुक्तं नरः कुर्यादष्ट चैकं विमत्सरः .. 49 ...
text_mt: Bowing to the holy fig tree, the sun, and the Gaṅgā, with tongue controlled, / a man free from envy should eat only one single meal a day for eight [months].

sanskrit_iast:
vratāṃte vipramithunaṃ pūjya dhenutrayānvitam ..
vṛkṣaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ dadyātsośvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 4.121.50 ..
meaning:
व्रतांते विप्रमिथुनं पूज्य धेनुत्रयान्वितम् ..
वृक्षं हिरण्मयं दद्यात्सोश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .. 4.121.50 ..
text_mt: At the end of the votive observance, having worshipped a brahmin couple along with three cows, / he should give a golden tree; he obtains the fruit of an Aśvamedha sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
divi divyavimānasthaḥ sevyate'psarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ...
etatkīrtivrataṃ nāma bhūtikīrtiphalapradam ..51..
meaning:
दिवि दिव्यविमानस्थः सेव्यतेऽप्सरसां गणैः...
एतत्कीर्तिव्रतं नाम भूतिकीर्तिफलप्रदम् ..51..
text_mt: Seated in a celestial chariot in heaven, he is served by hosts of apsarases. / This is an observance named Kīrtivrata, which bestows prosperity and fame as its fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtena snapanaṃ kṛtvā śaṃbhorvā keśavasya ca ..
brāhmaṇo bhāskarasyāpi gauryā laṃbodarasya vā.. 52..
meaning:
घृतेन स्नपनं कृत्वा शंभोर्वा केशवस्य च ..
ब्राह्मणो भास्करस्यापि गौर्या लंबोदरस्य वा.. 52..
text_mt: Having bathed with ghee either Śambhu, Keśava, / the sun, Gaurī, or Lambodara, a brahmin

sanskrit_iast:
akṣataistu samaṃ kuryātpadmaṃ gomayamaṇḍale ..
samāpya hemakamalaṃ tiladhenusamanvitam .. 53 ..
meaning:
अक्षतैस्तु समं कुर्यात्पद्मं गोमयमण्डले ..
समाप्य हेमकमलं तिलधेनुसमन्वितम् .. 53 ..
text_mt: should make a lotus of whole grains on a cow-dung circle. / Having completed [the rite], a golden lotus together with a sesame cow,

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhamaṣṭāṅgulaṃ dayācchivaloke mahīyate ..
sāmagāyanataścaitatsāmavratamihocyate .. 54 ..
meaning:
शुद्धमष्टाङ्गुलं दयाच्छिवलोके महीयते ..
सामगायनतश्चैतत्सामव्रतमिहोच्यते .. 54 ..
text_mt: pure, eight finger-breadths in size, he should give away; he is glorified in the world of Śiva. / Because of the singing of the Sāmaveda hymns, this is called here the Sāmavrata.

sanskrit_iast:
navamyāmekabhuktaṃ tu kṛtvā kanyāśca śaktitaḥ ..
bhojayitvā samādadyāddhaimakaṃcukavāsasī .. 55 ..
meaning:
नवम्यामेकभुक्तं तु कृत्वा कन्याश्च शक्तितः ..
भोजयित्वा समादद्याद्धैमकंचुकवाससी .. 55 ..
text_mt: Eating only one meal on the navamī, and having fed maidens / according to one's ability, one should offer a golden bodice and clothing,

sanskrit_iast:
haimaṃ ca siṃhaṃ viprāya dattvā śivapuraṃ vrajet ..
bhavārbudaṃ surūpaśca śatrubhiścāparājitaḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
हैमं च सिंहं विप्राय दत्त्वा शिवपुरं व्रजेत् ..
भवार्बुदं सुरूपश्च शत्रुभिश्चापराजितः .. 56 ..
text_mt: and having given a golden lion to a brahmin, he goes to the city of Śiva. / For one hundred million births he will be handsome and unvanquished by enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
etadvīravrataṃ nāma nārīṇāṃ ca sukhapradam ..
yāvatsamārabhedyastu pañcadaśyāṃ payovrataḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
एतद्वीरव्रतं नाम नारीणां च सुखप्रदम् ..
यावत्समारभेद्यस्तु पञ्चदश्यां पयोव्रतः .. 57 ..
text_mt: This is an observance named Vīravrata, which bestows happiness upon women. / Whoever undertakes the vow of consuming only milk until the fifteenth lunar day,

sanskrit_iast:
samāpte śraddhayā dayadgāśca pañca payasvinīḥ ..
vāsāṃsi ca piśaṃgāni jalakuṃbhayutāni ca .. 58 ..
meaning:
समाप्ते श्रद्धया दयद्गाश्च पञ्च पयस्विनीः ..
वासांसि च पिशंगानि जलकुंभयुतानि च .. 58 ..
text_mt: upon its completion should give with faith five milch cows, / tawny garments, along with water-jars.

sanskrit_iast:
sa yāti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tārayecchatam..
kalpāṃte rājarājaḥ syātpitṛvratamidaṃ smṛtam .. 59 ..
meaning:
स याति वैष्णवं लोकं पितॄणां तारयेच्छतम्..
कल्पांते राजराजः स्यात्पितृव्रतमिदं स्मृतम् .. 59 ..
text_mt: He goes to the world of Viṣṇu and redeems a hundred of his ancestors; / at the end of a kalpa he becomes a king of kings; this is known as the Pitṛvrata.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃbūlaṃ samaye nityaṃ gaurīputraṃ dadāti yā..
pūgacūrṇasamāyuktaṃ nārī vā puruṣo'pi vā .. 4.121.60 ..
meaning:
तांबूलं समये नित्यं गौरीपुत्रं ददाति या..
पूगचूर्णसमायुक्तं नारी वा पुरुषोऽपि वा .. 4.121.60 ..
text_mt: Whatever woman or man constantly gives betel at the proper time / accompanied by areca-nut powder to the son of Gaurī,

sanskrit_iast:
varṣasyāṃte tu sauvarṇaṃ kārayitvā phalānvitam ..
muktāphalamayaṃ cūrṇatritayaṃ yā prayacchati .. 61 ..
meaning:
वर्षस्यांते तु सौवर्णं कारयित्वा फलान्वितम् ..
मुक्ताफलमयं चूर्णत्रितयं या प्रयच्छति .. 61 ..
text_mt: and at the end of the year has a golden [leaf] made with the nut, / and gives three powders made of pearls,

sanskrit_iast:
na sā prāpnoti daurbhāgyaṃ na daurgandhyaṃ mukhasya ca ..
etatpatravrataṃ nāma saugandhyajananaṃ param .. 62 ..
meaning:
न सा प्राप्नोति दौर्भाग्यं न दौर्गन्ध्यं मुखस्य च ..
एतत्पत्रव्रतं नाम सौगन्ध्यजननं परम् .. 62 ..
text_mt: she does not encounter misfortune, nor foul odor of the mouth. / This is an observance named Patravrata, bringing supreme fragrance.

sanskrit_iast:
caitrādicaturo māsāñjalaṃ kuryādayācitam ..
jyeṣṭhāṣāḍhe ca vā māsaṃ pakṣaṃ vā pāṃḍunaṃdana .. 63 ..
meaning:
चैत्रादिचतुरो मासाञ्जलं कुर्यादयाचितम् ..
ज्येष्ठाषाढे च वा मासं पक्षं वा पांडुनंदन .. 63 ..
text_mt: For the four months beginning with Caitra one should drink unbegged water, / or during Jyeṣṭha and Āṣāḍha for a month, or a fortnight, O son of Pāṇḍu.

sanskrit_iast:
vratāṃte maṇikaṃ dadyādannavastrasamanvitam ..
ghṛtena sahitaṃ tadvatsaptadhānyasamanvitam .. 64 ..
meaning:
व्रतांते मणिकं दद्यादन्नवस्त्रसमन्वितम् ..
घृतेन सहितं तद्वत्सप्तधान्यसमन्वितम् .. 64 ..
text_mt: At the end of the votive observance he should give a water jar accompanied by food and clothing, / likewise along with ghee and accompanied by the seven grains,

sanskrit_iast:
tilapātraṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca brahmaloke mahīyate ..
kalpāṃte rājarājaḥ syādvārivratamihocyate .. 65 ..
meaning:
तिलपात्रं हिरण्यं च ब्रह्मलोके महीयते ..
कल्पांते राजराजः स्याद्वारिव्रतमिहोच्यते .. 65 ..
text_mt: a vessel of sesame and gold; he is glorified in the world of Brahmā. / At the end of a kalpa he becomes a king of kings; this is called here the Vārivrata.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāmṛtena snapanaṃ kṛtvā viṣṇoḥ śivasya ca ..
vatsarāṃte punardadyāddhenuṃ pañcāmṛtairyutām .. 66 ..
meaning:
पञ्चामृतेन स्नपनं कृत्वा विष्णोः शिवस्य च ..
वत्सरांते पुनर्दद्याद्धेनुं पञ्चामृतैर्युताम् .. 66 ..
text_mt: Having bathed Viṣṇu and Śiva with the five nectars, / at the end of the year he should further give a cow together with the five nectars,

sanskrit_iast:
viprāya kanakaṃ śaṃkhaṃ sa padaṃ yāti śāṃkaram ..
rājā bhavati kalpāṃte vṛttivratamihocyate .. 67 ..
meaning:
विप्राय कनकं शंखं स पदं याति शांकरम् ..
राजा भवति कल्पांते वृत्तिव्रतमिहोच्यते .. 67 ..
text_mt: and gold and a conch to a brahmin; he goes to the abode of Śaṅkara. / At the end of a kalpa he becomes a king; this is called here the Vṛttivrata.

sanskrit_iast:
yo hiṃsāṃ varjayitvā tu māsaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ tathā ..
vratāṃte hemahariṇaṃ kṛtvā śaktyā vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 68 ..
meaning:
यो हिंसां वर्जयित्वा तु मासं संवत्सरं तथा ..
व्रतांते हेमहरिणं कृत्वा शक्त्या विचक्षणः .. 68 ..
text_mt: A wise man who, abstaining from violence for a month or for a year, / makes a golden deer at the end of the votive observance according to his means,

sanskrit_iast:
tadvatsavatsāṃ gāṃ dadyātso'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ..
ahiṃsāvratamityetatsarvaśāṃtipradaṃ nṛṇām .. 69 ..
meaning:
तद्वत्सवत्सां गां दद्यात्सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् ..
अहिंसाव्रतमित्येतत्सर्वशांतिप्रदं नृणाम् .. 69 ..
text_mt: and likewise gives a cow along with her calf, obtains the fruit of an Aśvamedha sacrifice. / This is the Ahiṃsāvrata, which bestows all peace upon human beings.

sanskrit_iast:
māghamāsyuṣasi snānaṃ kṛtvā dāṃpatyamarcayet ..
bhojayitvā yathāśaktyā mālyavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 4.121.70 ..
meaning:
माघमास्युषसि स्नानं कृत्वा दांपत्यमर्चयेत् ..
भोजयित्वा यथाशक्त्या माल्यवस्त्रविभूषणैः .. 4.121.70 ..
text_mt: Having bathed at dawn in the month of Māgha, one should worship a married couple, / and having fed them according to one's ability, [honor them] with garlands, clothes, and ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti śarīrārogyamuttamam..
sūryaloke vasetkalpaṃ sūryavratamidaṃ smṛtam ..71..
meaning:
सौभाग्यं महदाप्नोति शरीरारोग्यमुत्तमम्..
सूर्यलोके वसेत्कल्पं सूर्यव्रतमिदं स्मृतम् ..71..
text_mt: He attains great good fortune and excellent bodily health; / he dwells in the world of Sūrya for a kalpa; this is known as the Sūryavrata.

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhādicaturmāsaṃ prātaḥsnāyī bhavennaraḥ ..
viprāya bhojanaṃ dadyātkārtikyāṃ goprado bhavet .. 72 ..
meaning:
आषाढादिचतुर्मासं प्रातःस्नायी भवेन्नरः ..
विप्राय भोजनं दद्यात्कार्तिक्यां गोप्रदो भवेत् .. 72 ..
text_mt: A man should bathe in the morning for the four months beginning with Āṣāḍha, / give food to a brahmin, and become a giver of a cow on the Kārtika full-moon day.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtakuṃbhaṃ tato dattvā sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ..
vaiṣṇavavratamityuktaṃ viṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt .. 73 ..
meaning:
घृतकुंभं ततो दत्त्वा सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ..
वैष्णवव्रतमित्युक्तं विष्णुलोकमवाप्नुयात् .. 73 ..
text_mt: Then, having given a jar of ghee, he attains all desires. / It is called the Vaiṣṇavavrata; he attains the world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
ayanādayanaṃ yāvadvarjayenmadhusarpiṣī ..
tadaṃte puṇyadānāni ghṛtadhenvā sahaiva tu .. 74 ..
meaning:
अयनादयनं यावद्वर्जयेन्मधुसर्पिषी ..
तदंते पुण्यदानानि घृतधेन्वा सहैव तु .. 74 ..
text_mt: From solstice to solstice one should avoid honey and ghee; / at the end of that, having given auspicious gifts along with a ghee-cow,

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā śivapadaṃ yāti dattvā tu ghṛtapāyasam ..
etacchīlavrataṃ nāma śīlārogyaphalapradam .. 75 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वा शिवपदं याति दत्त्वा तु घृतपायसम् ..
एतच्छीलव्रतं नाम शीलारोग्यफलप्रदम् .. 75 ..
text_mt: and having given milk-rice with ghee, he goes to the abode of Śiva. / This is an observance named Śīlavrata, which bestows good character and health as its fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyādīpaprado yastu māṃsaṃ tailaṃ vivarjayet ..
samāpte dīpakaṃ dadyāccakraśūle ca kāñcane .. 76 ..
meaning:
संध्यादीपप्रदो यस्तु मांसं तैलं विवर्जयेत् ..
समाप्ते दीपकं दद्याच्चक्रशूले च काञ्चने .. 76 ..
text_mt: Whoever offers an evening lamp and completely avoids meat and oil, / at its completion should give a lamp and a golden discus and trident,

sanskrit_iast:
vastrayugmaṃ ca viprāya sa tejasvī bhaveddṛḍham ..
etaddīpavrataṃ nāma sadā kāṃtipradāyakam .. 77 ..
meaning:
वस्त्रयुग्मं च विप्राय स तेजस्वी भवेद्दृढम् ..
एतद्दीपव्रतं नाम सदा कांतिप्रदायकम् .. 77 ..
text_mt: and a pair of garments to a brahmin; he will certainly become radiant. / This is an observance named Dīpavrata, continually bestowing luster.

sanskrit_iast:
ekabhaktena saptāhaṃ gaurīṃ vā yastu pūjayet ..
saṃpūjya pārvatīṃ bhaktyā gandhapuṣpavilepanaiḥ .. 78 ..
meaning:
एकभक्तेन सप्ताहं गौरीं वा यस्तु पूजयेत् ..
संपूज्य पार्वतीं भक्त्या गन्धपुष्पविलेपनैः .. 78 ..
text_mt: Whoever worships Gaurī for seven days with a single meal a day, / having worshipped Pārvatī with devotion using perfumes, flowers, and unguents,

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ suvāsinībhyāṃ tu kuṃkumena vilepayet ..
puṣpairvilepayeccaināṃ karpūrāgarucandanaiḥ .. 79 ..
meaning:
ततः सुवासिनीभ्यां तु कुंकुमेन विलेपयेत् ..
पुष्पैर्विलेपयेच्चैनां कर्पूरागरुचन्दनैः .. 79 ..
text_mt: he should then anoint two married women with vermilion, / and anoint her with flowers, camphor, agarwood, and sandalwood.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃbūlaṃ śobhanaṃ dattvā nārikelaphalaṃ tathā ..
prīyatāṃ kumudā devī praṇipatya visarjayet .. 4.121.80 ..
meaning:
तांबूलं शोभनं दत्त्वा नारिकेलफलं तथा ..
प्रीयतां कुमुदा देवी प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् .. 4.121.80 ..
text_mt: Having offered handsome betel and also a coconut, / [saying] “May the goddess Kumudā be pleased,” he should bow down and dismiss them.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikāṃ pūjayeddevīṃ saptāhaṃ yāvadeva tu ..
punastu saptame pūrṇe tāḥ saptaiva nimaṃtrayet .. 81 ..
meaning:
एकैकां पूजयेद्देवीं सप्ताहं यावदेव तु ..
पुनस्तु सप्तमे पूर्णे ताः सप्तैव निमंत्रयेत् .. 81 ..
text_mt: He should worship each single goddess for seven days; / then, when the seventh is complete, he should invite those very seven [women]:

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍrasaṃ bhojayitvā tu yathāśaktyā vibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
bhūṣayitvā mālyavastraiḥ karṇaveṣṭāṃgulīyakaiḥ .. 82 ..
meaning:
षड्रसं भोजयित्वा तु यथाशक्त्या विभूषणैः ..
भूषयित्वा माल्यवस्त्रैः कर्णवेष्टांगुलीयकैः .. 82 ..
text_mt: having fed them [food of] the six flavors, and having adorned them according to his ability with ornaments, / with garlands and garments, earrings and rings,

sanskrit_iast:
kumudā mādhavī gaurī bhavānī pārvatī umā ..
kālī ca darpaṇaṃ haste pratyekaṃ vinivedayet .. 83 ..
meaning:
कुमुदा माधवी गौरी भवानी पार्वती उमा ..
काली च दर्पणं हस्ते प्रत्येकं विनिवेदयेत् .. 83 ..
text_mt: [representing] Kumudā, Mādhavī, Gaurī, Bhavānī, Pārvatī, Umā, / and Kālī, he should present a mirror into each one's hand.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaṃ pṛjayitvaikaṃ vācyaḥ saṃpamannamastu te..
saptasundarakaṃ nāma vrataṃ caitadyudhiṣṭhira .. 84 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणं पृजयित्वैकं वाच्यः संपमन्नमस्तु ते..
सप्तसुन्दरकं नाम व्रतं चैतद्युधिष्ठिर .. 84 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped a single brahmin, it should be spoken: “May you be prosperous.” / This is the observance named Saptasundaraka, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit_iast:
karoti sundaraṃ dehaṃ saubhāgyaṃ yacchate param ..
varjayeccaiva māse tu yastu gandhānulepanam .. 85 ..
meaning:
करोति सुन्दरं देहं सौभाग्यं यच्छते परम् ..
वर्जयेच्चैव मासे तु यस्तु गन्धानुलेपनम् .. 85 ..
text_mt: It makes the body beautiful and gives supreme good fortune. / Whoever avoids fragrant unguents for a month,

sanskrit_iast:
śuktiṃ gaṃdhabhṛtāṃ dattvā viprāya sitavāsasī ..
śaktyā ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātsarvānkāmānsamaśnute .. 86 ..
meaning:
शुक्तिं गंधभृतां दत्त्वा विप्राय सितवाससी ..
शक्त्या च दक्षिणां दद्यात्सर्वान्कामान्समश्नुते .. 86 ..
text_mt: and having given a shell filled with fragrance and two white garments to a brahmin, / gives a fee according to his means, attains all desires,

sanskrit_iast:
vāruṇaṃ ca padaṃ yāti tadetadvaruṇavratam ..
vaiśākhamāse lavaṇaṃ varjayitvā yatavrataḥ .. 87 ..
meaning:
वारुणं च पदं याति तदेतद्वरुणव्रतम् ..
वैशाखमासे लवणं वर्जयित्वा यतव्रतः .. 87 ..
text_mt: and goes to the realm of Varuṇa; that is the Varuṇavrata. / Having avoided salt in the month of Vaiśākha, restraining his vows,

sanskrit_iast:
māsāṃte'tha tato dadyātsavatsāṃ gāṃ dvijātaye ..
sthitvā viṣṇupade kalpaṃ tato rājā bhavediha.88..
meaning:
मासांतेऽथ ततो दद्यात्सवत्सां गां द्विजातये ..
स्थित्वा विष्णुपदे कल्पं ततो राजा भवेदिह.88..
text_mt: at the end of the month he should then give a cow along with her calf to a twice-born man. / Having remained in the abode of Viṣṇu for a kalpa, he will then become a king in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
etatkāṃtivrataṃ nāma kāṃtikīrtipradāyakam ..
brahmāṇḍaṃ kāṃcanaṃ kṛtvā tiladroṇopari sthitam .. 89 ..
meaning:
एतत्कांतिव्रतं नाम कांतिकीर्तिप्रदायकम् ..
ब्रह्माण्डं कांचनं कृत्वा तिलद्रोणोपरि स्थितम् .. 89 ..
text_mt: This is an observance named Kāntivrata, which bestows splendor and fame. / Having made a golden cosmic egg, resting upon a droṇa of sesame,

sanskrit_iast:
tryahaṃ tilavratī bhūtvā vahniṃ saṃtarpayeddvijam ..
saṃpūjya vipradāṃpatyaṃ mālyavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 4.121.90 ..
meaning:
त्र्यहं तिलव्रती भूत्वा वह्निं संतर्पयेद्द्विजम् ..
संपूज्य विप्रदांपत्यं माल्यवस्त्रविभूषणैः .. 4.121.90 ..
text_mt: observing the sesame vow for three days, he should gratify the fire and the twice-born. / Having worshipped a brahmin couple with garlands, garments, and ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
śaktitastripalādūrdhvaṃ viśvātmā prīyatāmiti ..
puṇye'hni dadyātsa paraṃ brahma yātyapunarbhavam ..91..
meaning:
शक्तितस्त्रिपलादूर्ध्वं विश्वात्मा प्रीयतामिति ..
पुण्येऽह्नि दद्यात्स परं ब्रह्म यात्यपुनर्भवम् ..91..
text_mt: weighing more than three palas according to his ability, [saying] “May the Self of all be pleased,” / he should give it on an auspicious day; he goes to the supreme Brahman, never to be reborn.

sanskrit_iast: etadbrahmavrataṃ nāma nirvāṇaphaladaṃ nṛṇām .. 92 ..
meaning: एतद्ब्रह्मव्रतं नाम निर्वाणफलदं नृणाम् .. 92 ..
text_mt: This is called the Brahmavrata, which grants the fruit of liberation to men.

sanskrit_iast:
yaścobhayamukhīṃ dadyātprabhūtakanakānvitām ..
dinaṃ payovrataṃ tiṣṭhetsa yāti paramaṃ padam .. 93 ..
meaning:
यश्चोभयमुखीं दद्यात्प्रभूतकनकान्विताम् ..
दिनं पयोव्रतं तिष्ठेत्स याति परमं पदम् .. 93 ..
text_mt: And whoever gives an ubhayamukhī cow endowed with abundant gold, / observing a milk-diet for a day, he goes to the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
tryahaṃ payovrataḥ sthitvā kāñcanaṃ kalpapādapam ..
palādūrdhvaṃ yathā śaktyā taṃḍulaṃ rūpasaṃyutam .. 94 ..
meaning:
त्र्यहं पयोव्रतः स्थित्वा काञ्चनं कल्पपादपम् ..
पलादूर्ध्वं यथा शक्त्या तंडुलं रूपसंयुतम् .. 94 ..
text_mt: Observing a milk-diet for three days, [having fashioned] a golden wishing-tree / weighing more than a pala according to one's capacity, together with silver and rice,

sanskrit_iast:
chāditaṃ varavāsobhiḥ puṣpamālāvibhūṣitam .....
dattvā svarge vasetkalpaṃ kalpavratamidaṃ smṛtam .. 95 ..
meaning:
छादितं वरवासोभिः पुष्पमालाविभूषितम् .....
दत्त्वा स्वर्गे वसेत्कल्पं कल्पव्रतमिदं स्मृतम् .. 95 ..
text_mt: covered with choice garments and adorned with garlands of flowers— / having given it, one dwells in heaven for a kalpa; this is remembered as the Kalpavrata.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu vatsatarīṃ bhavyāṃ kaṇṭhābharaṇabhūṣitām ..
suparyāṇāṃ sukhaspṛṣṭāṃ khalīnālaṃkṛtā nanām .. 96 ..
meaning:
यस्तु वत्सतरीं भव्यां कण्ठाभरणभूषिताम् ..
सुपर्याणां सुखस्पृष्टां खलीनालंकृता ननाम् .. 96 ..
text_mt: Whoever [dedicates] an auspicious young heifer adorned with throat-ornaments, / well-saddled, pleasant to touch, and decorated with a bridle,

sanskrit_iast:
modakodakapātreṇa tāṃbūlena samanvitām ..
sthagitāṃ sthāpayetpṛṣṭhe śṛṃgāgreṣu himānvitām .. 97 ..
meaning:
मोदकोदकपात्रेण तांबूलेन समन्विताम् ..
स्थगितां स्थापयेत्पृष्ठे शृंगाग्रेषु हिमान्विताम् .. 97 ..
text_mt: furnished with a vessel containing sweets and water, and with betel, / having placed a covered pouch on its back, and its horn-tips adorned with silver,

sanskrit_iast:
īdṛgvidhāṃ vyatīpāte grahaṇe cāyanadvaye ..
ayācitena ca sthitvā tato dadyāddvijātaye .. 98 ..
meaning:
ईदृग्विधां व्यतीपाते ग्रहणे चायनद्वये ..
अयाचितेन च स्थित्वा ततो दद्याद्द्विजातये .. 98 ..
text_mt: and during a vyatīpāta, an eclipse, or the two solstices, / having maintained oneself on unasked food, then gives such a one to a twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
etadvāravrataṃ nāma mārgakhedavināśanam ..
paralokārddhagamane klāṃtiśramaharaṃ param .. 99 ..
meaning:
एतद्वारव्रतं नाम मार्गखेदविनाशनम् ..
परलोकार्द्धगमने क्लांतिश्रमहरं परम् .. 99 ..
text_mt: this is named the Vāravrata, which destroys the distress of the road, / and supremely removes fatigue and exhaustion when going half the way to the other world.

sanskrit_iast:
naktāśī tvaṣṭamīṣu syādvatsarāṃte'ṣṭagopradaḥ ..
pauraṃdaraṃ padaṃ yāti sugativratamucyate .. 4.121.100 ..
meaning:
नक्ताशी त्वष्टमीषु स्याद्वत्सरांतेऽष्टगोप्रदः ..
पौरंदरं पदं याति सुगतिव्रतमुच्यते .. 4.121.100 ..
text_mt: If one eats only at night on the eighth lunar days and at the end of the year gives eight cows, / he goes to the realm of Purandara; this is called the Sugativrata.

sanskrit_iast:
yaścendhanaprado rājanhemaṃtaśiśira vratam ..
ghṛtadhenuṃ prayaccheta paraṃ brahma sa gacchati ... 101..
meaning:
यश्चेन्धनप्रदो राजन्हेमंतशिशिर व्रतम् ..
घृतधेनुं प्रयच्छेत परं ब्रह्म स गच्छति ... 101..
text_mt: And whoever gives firewood, O king, during the winter and dewy seasons as an observance, / and presents a cow of clarified butter, he goes to the supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
śarīrārogyajananaṃ dyutikāṃtipradāyakam ..
vaiśvānaravrataṃ nāma sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ..102..
meaning:
शरीरारोग्यजननं द्युतिकांतिप्रदायकम् ..
वैश्वानरव्रतं नाम सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ..102..
text_mt: Generating health for the body, bestowing splendour and lustre, / this is named the Vaiśvānaravrata, which destroys all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyāṃ tu naktāśī yaścakraṃ vinivedayet ..
tadvacchaṃkhaṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ caitre citrāsu pāṃḍava .. 103 ..
meaning:
एकादश्यां तु नक्ताशी यश्चक्रं विनिवेदयेत् ..
तद्वच्छंखं तु सौवर्णं चैत्रे चित्रासु पांडव .. 103 ..
text_mt: Whoever eats only at night on the eleventh lunar day and offers a discus, / and likewise a golden conch in Caitra under the Citrā asterism, O Pāṇḍava,

sanskrit_iast:
ya etatkurute bhaktyā sa viṣṇoḥ padamāpnuyāt ..
etadviṣṇuvrataṃ nāma kalpādau rājyalābhakṛt .. 104 ..
meaning:
य एतत्कुरुते भक्त्या स विष्णोः पदमाप्नुयात् ..
एतद्विष्णुव्रतं नाम कल्पादौ राज्यलाभकृत् .. 104 ..
text_mt: whoever performs this with devotion, he attains the abode of Viṣṇu. / This is named the Viṣṇuvrata, which brings about the attainment of kingship at the beginning of a kalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
payovratastu pañcamyāṃ vratāṃte goyugapradaḥ ..
lakṣmīloke vasetkalpametaddevīvrataṃ smṛtam .. 105 ..
meaning:
पयोव्रतस्तु पञ्चम्यां व्रतांते गोयुगप्रदः ..
लक्ष्मीलोके वसेत्कल्पमेतद्देवीव्रतं स्मृतम् .. 105 ..
text_mt: One who observes a milk-diet on the fifth lunar day and gives a pair of cattle at the end of the observance, / dwells in the realm of Lakṣmī for a kalpa; this is remembered as the Devīvrata.

sanskrit_iast:
saptamyāṃ naktabhugdadyātsamāpte gāṃ payasvinīm ..
so'rkalokamavāpnoti bhānuvratamihocyate .. 106 ..
meaning:
सप्तम्यां नक्तभुग्दद्यात्समाप्ते गां पयस्विनीम् ..
सोऽर्कलोकमवाप्नोति भानुव्रतमिहोच्यते .. 106 ..
text_mt: If one eats only at night on the seventh lunar day and gives a milch cow upon its completion, / he attains the realm of the Sun; this is called the Bhānuvrata here.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthyāṃ naktabhugdadyādaṣṭa gā homacāraṇam ..
vrataṃ vaināyakaṃ nāma sarvavighnavināśanam .. 107 ..
meaning:
चतुर्थ्यां नक्तभुग्दद्यादष्ट गा होमचारणम् ..
व्रतं वैनायकं नाम सर्वविघ्नविनाशनम् .. 107 ..
text_mt: Eating only at night on the fourth lunar day, one should give eight cows and the pasture for the fire offering; / this observance is named Vaināyaka, destroying all obstacles.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāphalāni yastyaktvā cāturmāsaṃ dvijātaye ..
haimāni kārttike dadyādgoyugena samaṃ naraḥ .. 108 ..
meaning:
महाफलानि यस्त्यक्त्वा चातुर्मासं द्विजातये ..
हैमानि कार्त्तिके दद्याद्गोयुगेन समं नरः .. 108 ..
text_mt: A man who, having given up great fruits for the four months of the rainy season, / gives golden ones together with a pair of cattle to a twice-born in Kārttika,

sanskrit_iast:
sitaṃ vastrayugaṃ nāma saṃpūrṇādyaghaṭāni ca ..
etatphalavrataṃ nāma phalāvāptikaraṃ sadā ..1 09..
meaning:
सितं वस्त्रयुगं नाम संपूर्णाद्यघटानि च ..
एतत्फलव्रतं नाम फलावाप्तिकरं सदा ..1 09..
text_mt: along with a pair of white garments and filled pots and the like— / this is named the Phalavrata, ever granting the attainment of all fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
yaścopavāsī saptamyāṃ samāṃte hemapaṅkajam ..
dhenūśca śaktito dadyātsavatsāḥ kāṃsyadohanāḥ .. 4.121.110 ..
meaning:
यश्चोपवासी सप्तम्यां समांते हेमपङ्कजम् ..
धेनूश्च शक्तितो दद्यात्सवत्साः कांस्यदोहनाः .. 4.121.110 ..
text_mt: And whoever fasts on the seventh lunar day and at the end of the year gives a golden lotus, / and cows with calves and bronze milking vessels according to his means,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktyā rājendra viprāya vācakāya nivedayet ..
etatsauravrataṃ nāma sūryalokapradāyakam .. 111 ..
meaning:
भक्त्या राजेन्द्र विप्राय वाचकाय निवेदयेत् ..
एतत्सौरव्रतं नाम सूर्यलोकप्रदायकम् .. 111 ..
text_mt: and with devotion presents them, O king of kings, to a learned twice-born reciter— / this is named the Sauravrata, bestowing the realm of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśa dvādaśīryastu nāma prāśanasaṃyutaḥ ..
samupoṣya samāṃte tu savastrāḥ sodakā ghaṭāḥ .. 112 ..
meaning:
द्वादश द्वादशीर्यस्तु नाम प्राशनसंयुतः ..
समुपोष्य समांते तु सवस्त्राः सोदका घटाः .. 112 ..
text_mt: Whoever, having consumed the sacred names, fasts / on twelve twelfth lunar days, and then at the end of the year presents jars filled with water and covered with cloth,

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśātra pradeyāśca sarvakāmaprasiddhaye ..
govindavratamityetadgovindapadadāyakam .. 113 ..
meaning:
द्वादशात्र प्रदेयाश्च सर्वकामप्रसिद्धये ..
गोविन्दव्रतमित्येतद्गोविन्दपददायकम् .. 113 ..
text_mt: twelve of them are to be given here for the accomplishment of all desires; / this is the Govindavrata, bestowing the realm of Govinda.

sanskrit_iast:
kārttikyāṃ yo vṛṣotsargaṃ kṛtvā naktaṃ samācaret ..
sa golokamavāpnoti vṛṣavratamidaṃ smṛtam .. 114 ..
meaning:
कार्त्तिक्यां यो वृषोत्सर्गं कृत्वा नक्तं समाचरेत् ..
स गोलोकमवाप्नोति वृषव्रतमिदं स्मृतम् .. 114 ..
text_mt: Whoever releases a bull on the full moon day of Kārttika and eats only at night, / he attains the world of cows; this is remembered as the Vṛṣavrata.

sanskrit_iast:
vratāṃte gauḥ pradātavyā bhojanaṃ śaktitaḥ param ..
viprāṇāmatra kathitaṃ prājāpatyamidaṃ vratam.. 115 ..
meaning:
व्रतांते गौः प्रदातव्या भोजनं शक्तितः परम् ..
विप्राणामत्र कथितं प्राजापत्यमिदं व्रतम्.. 115 ..
text_mt: At the end of the observance, a cow is to be given, and food to twice-borns / according to one's means; this is declared as the Prājāpatyavrata.

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaśyāṃ tu naktāśī samāṃte goyugapradaḥ ..
śaivaṃ padamavāpnoti jñeyaṃ ca tryaṃbakavratam .. 116 ..
meaning:
चतुर्दश्यां तु नक्ताशी समांते गोयुगप्रदः ..
शैवं पदमवाप्नोति ज्ञेयं च त्र्यंबकव्रतम् .. 116 ..
text_mt: Eating only at night on the fourteenth lunar day and giving a pair of cattle at the end of the year, / one attains the realm of Śiva; this should be known as the Tryambakavrata.

sanskrit_iast:
saptarātroṣito dadyādghṛtakuṃbhaṃ dvijātaye ..
brahmavratamidaṃ prāhurbrahmalokapradāyakam .. 117 ..
meaning:
सप्तरात्रोषितो दद्याद्घृतकुंभं द्विजातये ..
ब्रह्मव्रतमिदं प्राहुर्ब्रह्मलोकप्रदायकम् .. 117 ..
text_mt: Having fasted for seven nights, one should give a pot of clarified butter to a twice-born; / this they declare as the Brahmavrata, bestowing the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
māsāṃte ca sa gāṃ dadyāddhenumaṃte payasvinīm ..
śakraloke vasetkalpaṃ śakravratamidaṃ smṛtam .. 118 ...
meaning:
मासांते च स गां दद्याद्धेनुमंते पयस्विनीम् ..
शक्रलोके वसेत्कल्पं शक्रव्रतमिदं स्मृतम् .. 118 ...
text_mt: And at the end of a month he should give a cow, a milch cow at the conclusion; / he dwells in the realm of Śakra for a kalpa; this is remembered as the Śakravrata.

sanskrit_iast:
kārttikasya site pakṣe caturdaśyāṃ narādhipa ..
sopavāsaḥ pañcagavyaṃ pibedrātrau vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 119 ..
meaning:
कार्त्तिकस्य सिते पक्षे चतुर्दश्यां नराधिप ..
सोपवासः पञ्चगव्यं पिबेद्रात्रौ विचक्षणः .. 119 ..
text_mt: In the bright fortnight of Kārttika on the fourteenth lunar day, O ruler of men, / the wise person, fasting, should drink pañcagavya at night.

sanskrit_iast:
kapilāyāstu gomūtraṃ kṛṣṇāyā gomayaṃ tathā ..
sitadhenvāstathā kṣīraṃ raktāyāstu tathā dadhi .. 4.121.120 ..
meaning:
कपिलायास्तु गोमूत्रं कृष्णाया गोमयं तथा ..
सितधेन्वास्तथा क्षीरं रक्तायास्तु तथा दधि .. 4.121.120 ..
text_mt: Taking the cow dung of a black cow, the urine of a tawny cow, / the milk of a white cow, and the curds of a red cow,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā karburāyāstu ghṛtamekatra melayet ..
vedoktamantrai rājendra kuśodakasamanvitam .. ..121..
meaning:
गृहीत्वा कर्बुरायास्तु घृतमेकत्र मेलयेत् ..
वेदोक्तमन्त्रै राजेन्द्र कुशोदकसमन्वितम् .. ..121..
text_mt: and the clarified butter of a speckled cow, he should mix them together, / O king of kings, with kuśa-water along with mantras spoken in the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabhātasamaye snātvā saṃtarpya devatāḥ..
brāhmaṇānvācayitvā tu bhuñjīyādvāgyataḥ śuciḥ..122..
meaning:
ततः प्रभातसमये स्नात्वा संतर्प्य देवताः..
ब्राह्मणान्वाचयित्वा तु भुञ्जीयाद्वाग्यतः शुचिः..122..
text_mt: Then, at dawn, having bathed and gratified the deities, / and having caused the brāhmaṇas to recite blessings, he should eat, pure and restrained in speech.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmakūrcavrataṃ hyetatsarvapāpapraṇāśanam ..
yadbālye yacca kaumāre vārdhakye cāpi yatkṛtam ..
brahmakūrcopavāsena tatsarvaṃ naśyati kṣaṇāt ..123..
meaning:
ब्रह्मकूर्चव्रतं ह्येतत्सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ..
यद्बाल्ये यच्च कौमारे वार्धक्ये चापि यत्कृतम् ..
ब्रह्मकूर्चोपवासेन तत्सर्वं नश्यति क्षणात् ..123..
text_mt: For this is the Brahmakūrcavrata, destroying all sins. / Whatever sin was committed in childhood, in youth, or in old age, / all of that perishes in an instant through the fasting of Brahmakūrca.

sanskrit_iast:
anagnipakvamaśnāti tṛtīyāyāṃ tu yo naraḥ ..
gāṃ dattvā śivamabhyeti punarāvṛttivarjitam .. 124 ..
meaning:
अनग्निपक्वमश्नाति तृतीयायां तु यो नरः ..
गां दत्त्वा शिवमभ्येति पुनरावृत्तिवर्जितम् .. 124 ..
text_mt: Whatever person eats what is not cooked by fire on the third lunar day / and gives a cow, attains Śiva, free from return [to rebirth].

sanskrit_iast:
etaddṛṣivrataṃ nāma sarvamāṅgalyakārakam ..
haimaṃ paladvayādūrdhvaṃ rathamaśvayugānvitam .. 125..
meaning:
एतद्दृषिव्रतं नाम सर्वमाङ्गल्यकारकम् ..
हैमं पलद्वयादूर्ध्वं रथमश्वयुगान्वितम् .. 125..
text_mt: This is named the Ṛṣivrata, producing all auspiciousness. / [Making] a golden chariot of more than two palas, equipped with a pair of horses,

sanskrit_iast:
tilaprasthopari gataṃ sitamālyayugānvitam ..
dattvā kṛtopavāsastu divi kalpaśataṃ vaset..
tadaṃte rājarājaḥ syādagnivratamidaṃ smṛtam .. .. 126 ..
meaning:
तिलप्रस्थोपरि गतं सितमाल्ययुगान्वितम् ..
दत्त्वा कृतोपवासस्तु दिवि कल्पशतं वसेत्..
तदंते राजराजः स्यादग्निव्रतमिदं स्मृतम् .. .. 126 ..
text_mt: placed upon a prastha of sesame and accompanied by a pair of white garlands— / having given it after observing a fast, one dwells in heaven for a hundred kalpas, / and at the end of that becomes a king of kings; this is remembered as the Agnivrata.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā paladvayādūrdhvaṃ śayyābhyāṃ saṃyutaṃ naraḥ ..
haimaṃ rathavaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvopaskarasaṃyutam .. 127 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा पलद्वयादूर्ध्वं शय्याभ्यां संयुतं नरः ..
हैमं रथवरं श्रेष्ठं सर्वोपस्करसंयुतम् .. 127 ..
text_mt: Having fashioned an excellent golden chariot weighing more than two palas, / equipped with two couches and furnished with all accessories,

sanskrit_iast:
satyaloke vasetkalpaṃ sahasramatha bhūpatiḥ ..
bhavedupoṣito dattvā karivratamidaṃ śubham .. 128 ..
meaning:
सत्यलोके वसेत्कल्पं सहस्रमथ भूपतिः ..
भवेदुपोषितो दत्त्वा करिव्रतमिदं शुभम् .. 128 ..
text_mt: one dwells in the world of truth for a thousand kalpas; then he becomes a king. / Having fasted and given it, this is the auspicious Karivrata.

sanskrit_iast:
mukhavāsaṃ parityajya samāṃte goprado bhavet ..
yakṣādhipaṃ samāpnoti sumukha vratamucyate .. 129 ..
meaning:
मुखवासं परित्यज्य समांते गोप्रदो भवेत् ..
यक्षाधिपं समाप्नोति सुमुख व्रतमुच्यते .. 129 ..
text_mt: Having abstained from mouth-perfumes and becoming a giver of a cow at the end of the year, / one reaches the lord of the yakṣas; this is called the Sumukhavrata.

sanskrit_iast:
niśi kṛtvā jale vāsaṃ prabhāte goprado bhavet ..
ruṇaṃ lokamāpnoti varuṇavratamucyate .. 4.121.130 ..
meaning:
निशि कृत्वा जले वासं प्रभाते गोप्रदो भवेत् ..
रुणं लोकमाप्नोति वरुणव्रतमुच्यते .. 4.121.130 ..
text_mt: Having stayed in water at night, he should become a giver of a cow at dawn; / he attains the world of Varuṇa; this is called the Varuṇavrata.

sanskrit_iast:
cāndrāyaṇaṃ ca yaḥ kuryāddhaimaṃ candraṃ nivedayet ..
candravratamidaṃ proktaṃ candralokapradāyakam .. 131 ..
meaning:
चान्द्रायणं च यः कुर्याद्धैमं चन्द्रं निवेदयेत् ..
चन्द्रव्रतमिदं प्रोक्तं चन्द्रलोकप्रदायकम् .. 131 ..
text_mt: Whoever performs a cāndrāyaṇa penance and presents a golden moon, / this is declared as the Candravrata, bestowing the realm of the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhe pañcatapāḥ sāyaṃ hemadhenuprado divam ..
athāṣṭamīcaturdaśyau rudravratamidaṃ smṛtam .. 132 ..
meaning:
ज्येष्ठे पञ्चतपाः सायं हेमधेनुप्रदो दिवम् ..
अथाष्टमीचतुर्दश्यौ रुद्रव्रतमिदं स्मृतम् .. 132 ..
text_mt: In Jyeṣṭha, practicing the austerity of five fires, giving a golden cow in the evening, he attains heaven; / furthermore, on the eighth and fourteenth lunar days—this is remembered as the Rudravrata.

sanskrit_iast:
anulepanaṃ yaḥ kuryāttṛtīyāyāṃ śivālaye ..
sa svargaṃ dhenudo yāti bhavānī vratamucyate .. 133 ..
meaning:
अनुलेपनं यः कुर्यात्तृतीयायां शिवालये ..
स स्वर्गं धेनुदो याति भवानी व्रतमुच्यते .. 133 ..
text_mt: Whoever applies unguents on the third lunar day in an abode of Śiva / and gives a cow, goes to heaven; this is called the Bhavānīvrata.

sanskrit_iast:
māghe niśyārdravāsāḥ syātsaptamyāṃ goprado bhaveta ..
divi kalpaṃ vasitveha rājā syāttāpanaṃ vratam .. 134 ..
meaning:
माघे निश्यार्द्रवासाः स्यात्सप्तम्यां गोप्रदो भवेत ..
दिवि कल्पं वसित्वेह राजा स्यात्तापनं व्रतम् .. 134 ..
text_mt: Wearing wet clothes at night on the seventh lunar day in Māgha, one should become a giver of a cow; / having dwelt in heaven for a kalpa, he becomes a king here; this is the Tāpanavrata.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā kṛtopavāsastu divi kalpaśataṃ vaset ..
tadaṃte rājarājaḥ syādaśvavratamidaṃ smṛtam ..135..
meaning:
दत्त्वा कृतोपवासस्तु दिवि कल्पशतं वसेत् ..
तदंते राजराजः स्यादश्वव्रतमिदं स्मृतम् ..135..
text_mt: Having given [a horse] and observed a fast, one dwells in heaven for a hundred kalpas, / and at the end of that becomes a king of kings; this is remembered as the Aśvavrata.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvatkalpadvayādūrdhvaṃ karibhyāṃ saṃyutaṃ naraḥ ..
haimaṃ rathaṃ naraśreṣṭha sarvopaskaraṇānvitam .. 136 ..
meaning:
तद्वत्कल्पद्वयादूर्ध्वं करिभ्यां संयुतं नरः ..
हैमं रथं नरश्रेष्ठ सर्वोपस्करणान्वितम् .. 136 ..
text_mt: Likewise, after two kalpas, a man who, equipped with two elephants, / [gives] a golden chariot, O best of men, furnished with all equipment,

sanskrit_iast:
trirātropoṣito dadyātphālgunyāṃ bhavanaṃ śubham ..
ādityalokamāpnoti pūjitaḥ sa surāsuraiḥ .. 137 ..
meaning:
त्रिरात्रोपोषितो दद्यात्फाल्गुन्यां भवनं शुभम् ..
आदित्यलोकमाप्नोति पूजितः स सुरासुरैः .. 137 ..
text_mt: having fasted for three nights, gives on the full moon of Phālguna an auspicious pavilion, / reaches the world of the sun, worshipped by gods and asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
suralokamavāpnoti dhāma vratasamanvitam ..
trisaṃdhyaṃ pūjya dāṃpatyamupavāsī vibhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 138 ..
meaning:
सुरलोकमवाप्नोति धाम व्रतसमन्वितम् ..
त्रिसंध्यं पूज्य दांपत्यमुपवासी विभूषणैः .. 138 ..
text_mt: He attains the realm of the gods, an abode accompanied by [the fruits of] the votive observance. / Having worshipped a married couple at the three twilights with ornaments while fasting,

sanskrit_iast: paurṇamāsyāmavāpnoti mokṣaminduvratādiha..139..
meaning: पौर्णमास्यामवाप्नोति मोक्षमिन्दुव्रतादिह..139..
text_mt: on the full moon day he attains liberation from this world through the Induvrata.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā sitadvitīyāyāmiṃdorlavaṇabhojanam ..
kāṃsyaṃ savastraṃ rājendra dakṣiṇāsahitaṃ tathā .. 4.121.140 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वा सितद्वितीयायामिंदोर्लवणभोजनम् ..
कांस्यं सवस्त्रं राजेन्द्र दक्षिणासहितं तथा .. 4.121.140 ..
text_mt: Having given on the bright second lunar day food with salt for the moon, / [along with] a bronze vessel covered with cloth, O king of kings, and accompanied by a priestly gift,

sanskrit_iast:
samāṃte goprado yāti viprāya śivamaṃdiram ..
kalpāṃte rājarājaḥ syātsomavratamidaṃ smṛtam .. 141 ..
meaning:
समांते गोप्रदो याति विप्राय शिवमंदिरम् ..
कल्पांते राजराजः स्यात्सोमव्रतमिदं स्मृतम् .. 141 ..
text_mt: he who gives a cow to a Brahmin at the end of the year goes to the abode of Śiva. / At the end of the kalpa he becomes a king of kings; this is known as the Somavrata.

sanskrit_iast:
pratipadyekabhaktāśī samāṃte kapilāpradaḥ ..
vaiśvānarapuraṃ yāti āgneyavratamucyate ..142..
meaning:
प्रतिपद्येकभक्ताशी समांते कपिलाप्रदः ..
वैश्वानरपुरं याति आग्नेयव्रतमुच्यते ..142..
text_mt: Eating a single meal on the first lunar day, giving a tawny cow at the end of the year, / he goes to the city of Agni; this is called the Āgneyavrata.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyāṃ māghamāse caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca ..
ekabhaktena yo dadyādbālakānyajināni ca .. 143 ..
meaning:
एकादश्यां माघमासे चतुर्दश्यष्टमीषु च ..
एकभक्तेन यो दद्याद्बालकान्यजिनानि च .. 143 ..
text_mt: On the eleventh lunar day in the month of Māgha, and on the fourteenth and eighth [lunar days], / he who, keeping to a single meal, gives carpets of hair and skins,

sanskrit_iast:
upānahau kaṃbalāṃśca caitre chatrādikaṃ tataḥ ..
karapatrādikaṃ cāpi yathā śaktyā vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 144 ..
meaning:
उपानहौ कंबलांश्च चैत्रे छत्रादिकं ततः ..
करपत्रादिकं चापि यथा शक्त्या विचक्षणः .. 144 ..
text_mt: shoes, and woolen blankets, and then in Caitra a royal parasol and so forth, / and also hand-saws and other tools according to his ability, being discerning,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānāṃ mahārāja so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ..
etatsaukhyavrataṃ nāma sarvasaukhyapradāyakam .. .. 145 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणानां महाराज सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् ..
एतत्सौख्यव्रतं नाम सर्वसौख्यप्रदायकम् .. .. 145 ..
text_mt: to Brahmins, O great king, he obtains the fruit of a horse-sacrifice. / This is named the Saukhyavrata, which bestows all happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
daśamyāmekabhaktāśī samāṃte daśadhenudaḥ ..
diśaśca kāñcanīrdadyānnārīrūpā yudhiṣṭhira ..146..
meaning:
दशम्यामेकभक्ताशी समांते दशधेनुदः ..
दिशश्च काञ्चनीर्दद्यान्नारीरूपा युधिष्ठिर ..146..
text_mt: Eating a single meal on the tenth lunar day, giving ten cows at the end of the year, / and giving the directions made of gold in the form of women, O Yudhiṣṭhira,

sanskrit_iast:
tiladroṇoparigato brahmāṃḍādhipatirbhavet..
etadviśvavrataṃ nāma mahāpātakanāśanam .. 147 ..
meaning:
तिलद्रोणोपरिगतो ब्रह्मांडाधिपतिर्भवेत्..
एतद्विश्वव्रतं नाम महापातकनाशनम् .. 147 ..
text_mt: placed upon a droṇa of sesame seeds, he becomes ruler of the universe. / This is named the Viśvavrata, which destroys great sins.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya sitasaptamyāṃ bhānudhānyāni sapta yaḥ ..
dadāti naktabhugrājam̐llavaṇena samaṃ dvije .. 148 ..
meaning:
संपूज्य सितसप्तम्यां भानुधान्यानि सप्त यः ..
ददाति नक्तभुग्राजम्̐ल्लवणेन समं द्विजे .. 148 ..
text_mt: He who, having worshipped the sun on the bright seventh lunar day, / gives seven grains along with salt to a Brahmin, eating a nocturnal meal, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
sa tārayati saptāṣṭau kulānyātmānameva ca ..
etaddhānyavrataṃ nāma dhanadhānyapradāyakam .. 149 ..
meaning:
स तारयति सप्ताष्टौ कुलान्यात्मानमेव च ..
एतद्धान्यव्रतं नाम धनधान्यप्रदायकम् .. 149 ..
text_mt: he delivers seven or eight generations of his family and himself as well. / This is named the Dhānyavrata, which bestows wealth and grain.

sanskrit_iast:
māsopavāsī yo dadyāddhenuṃ viprāya śobhanām ..
sa vaiṣṇavaṃ padaṃ yāti bhīmavratamidaṃ smṛtam .. 4.121.150 ..
meaning:
मासोपवासी यो दद्याद्धेनुं विप्राय शोभनाम् ..
स वैष्णवं पदं याति भीमव्रतमिदं स्मृतम् .. 4.121.150 ..
text_mt: He who, fasting for a month, gives a fine cow to a Brahmin / goes to the realm of Viṣṇu; this is known as the Bhīmavrata.

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣopavāsī yo dadyādviprāya kapilādvayam ..
sa brahmalokamāpnoti pūjitaḥ surasattamaiḥ .. .. 151 ..
meaning:
पक्षोपवासी यो दद्याद्विप्राय कपिलाद्वयम् ..
स ब्रह्मलोकमाप्नोति पूजितः सुरसत्तमैः .. .. 151 ..
text_mt: He who, fasting for a fortnight, gives two tawny cows to a Brahmin / attains the world of Brahmā, worshipped by the foremost of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
dadyāttriṃśatpalādūrdhvaṃ mahīṃ kṛtvā tu kāṃcanīm ..
kulācalādrisahitāṃ tilavastrasamanvitām .. 152 ..
meaning:
दद्यात्त्रिंशत्पलादूर्ध्वं महीं कृत्वा तु कांचनीम् ..
कुलाचलाद्रिसहितां तिलवस्त्रसमन्विताम् .. 152 ..
text_mt: He should give [an image of] the earth made of gold, weighing more than thirty palas, / endowed with the principal mountain ranges and accompanied by sesame and cloth,

sanskrit_iast:
tiladroṇopari gatāṃ brāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine ..
dinaṃ payovratastiṣṭhedrudraloke mahīyate .. 153 ..
meaning:
तिलद्रोणोपरि गतां ब्राह्मणाय कुटुंबिने ..
दिनं पयोव्रतस्तिष्ठेद्रुद्रलोके महीयते .. 153 ..
text_mt: placed upon a droṇa of sesame seeds, to a householder Brahmin. / If he observes a milk-fast for a day, he is exalted in the world of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
etanmahīvrataṃ proktaṃ saptakalpānuvartakam ..
māghamāse'tha caitre vā guḍadhenuprado bhavet .. .. 154 ..
meaning:
एतन्महीव्रतं प्रोक्तं सप्तकल्पानुवर्तकम् ..
माघमासेऽथ चैत्रे वा गुडधेनुप्रदो भवेत् .. .. 154 ..
text_mt: This is declared to be the Mahīvrata, enduring for seven kalpas. / In the month of Māgha, or else in Caitra, one should give a cow made of raw sugar.

sanskrit_iast:
guḍavratastṛtīyāyāṃ sarvopaskaraṇairyutaḥ ..
gaurīlokamavāpnoti pūjyate'psarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ .. 155 ..
meaning:
गुडव्रतस्तृतीयायां सर्वोपस्करणैर्युतः ..
गौरीलोकमवाप्नोति पूज्यतेऽप्सरसां गणैः .. 155 ..
text_mt: Observing the Guḍavrata on the third lunar day, equipped with all furnishings, / he attains the world of Gaurī and is worshipped by hosts of apsarases.

sanskrit_iast:
umāvratamidaṃ proktaṃ satatānandadāyakam..
vatsaraṃ tvekabhaktāśī sabhakṣyajalakuṃbhadaḥ .. 156 ..
meaning:
उमाव्रतमिदं प्रोक्तं सततानन्ददायकम्..
वत्सरं त्वेकभक्ताशी सभक्ष्यजलकुंभदः .. 156 ..
text_mt: This is declared to be the Umāvrata, bestowing perpetual joy. / Eating a single meal for a year and giving a pot of water accompanied by edible offerings,

sanskrit_iast:
śivaloke vasetkalpaṃ prāptivratamidaṃ smṛtam ..
kārttikāditṛtīyāyāṃ prāśya gomūtrayāvakam .. .. 157 ..
meaning:
शिवलोके वसेत्कल्पं प्राप्तिव्रतमिदं स्मृतम् ..
कार्त्तिकादितृतीयायां प्राश्य गोमूत्रयावकम् .. .. 157 ..
text_mt: he dwells in the world of Śiva for a kalpa; this is known as the Prāptivrata. / Having consumed barley gruel cooked in cow-urine on the third lunar day beginning with Kārttika,

sanskrit_iast:
gaurīloke vasetkalpaṃ tato rājā bhavediha ..
etadrudravrataṃ nāma mahākalyāṇakārakam .. 158 ..
meaning:
गौरीलोके वसेत्कल्पं ततो राजा भवेदिह ..
एतद्रुद्रव्रतं नाम महाकल्याणकारकम् .. 158 ..
text_mt: he dwells in the world of Gaurī for a kalpa, and then becomes a king in this world. / This is named the Rudravrata, which brings about great auspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
caitrī trirātraṃ naktāśī nadyāṃ snātvā dadāti yaḥ ..
ajāḥ payasvinīḥ pañca brāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine .. 159 ..
meaning:
चैत्री त्रिरात्रं नक्ताशी नद्यां स्नात्वा ददाति यः ..
अजाः पयस्विनीः पञ्च ब्राह्मणाय कुटुंबिने .. 159 ..
text_mt: On the full moon of Caitra, eating a nocturnal meal for three nights, having bathed in a river, he who gives / five milk-bearing goats to a householder Brahmin,

sanskrit_iast:
na jāyate punarasau jīvaloke kadācana ..
etadbastavrataṃ proktaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam .. 4.121.160 ..
meaning:
न जायते पुनरसौ जीवलोके कदाचन ..
एतद्बस्तव्रतं प्रोक्तं सर्वव्याधिविनाशनम् .. 4.121.160 ..
text_mt: he is never born again into the world of the living. / This is declared to be the Bastavrata, which destroys all diseases.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyādānaṃ tu yaḥ kuryādudvāhaṃ kārayecca yaḥ ..
ekaviṃśatikulopeto brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati .. 161 ..
meaning:
कन्यादानं तु यः कुर्यादुद्वाहं कारयेच्च यः ..
एकविंशतिकुलोपेतो ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति .. 161 ..
text_mt: He who bestows a maiden in marriage or arranges a marriage, / accompanied by twenty-one generations of his family, goes to the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyādānātparaṃ dānaṃ na cāstyabhyadhikaṃ kvacit ..
ye kariṣyaṃti nṛpate teṣāṃ loko'kṣayo divi .. 162 ..
meaning:
कन्यादानात्परं दानं न चास्त्यभ्यधिकं क्वचित् ..
ये करिष्यंति नृपते तेषां लोकोऽक्षयो दिवि .. 162 ..
text_mt: There is no gift anywhere greater than the gift of a maiden. / For those who perform it, O king, an imperishable world awaits in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
tilapiṣṭamayaṃ kṛtvā gajaṃ hemavibhūṣitam ..
kuryātkuśamayaṃ tadvadārohakasamanvitam .. 163 ..
meaning:
तिलपिष्टमयं कृत्वा गजं हेमविभूषितम् ..
कुर्यात्कुशमयं तद्वदारोहकसमन्वितम् .. 163 ..
text_mt: Having fashioned an elephant made of ground sesame and decorated with gold, / he should likewise make one of kuśa grass, accompanied by a rider,

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatramālāsahitaṃ cāmarāpīḍadhāriṇam ..
daśanāprabaddhanetraraktavastrayugānvitam .. 164 ..
meaning:
नक्षत्रमालासहितं चामरापीडधारिणम् ..
दशनाप्रबद्धनेत्ररक्तवस्त्रयुगान्वितम् .. 164 ..
text_mt: furnished with an ornamental garland, wearing chowries and crests, / its tusks bound with two strips of red cloth for eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmrapātryāṃ kuṇḍakaṃ vā kṛtaṃ dattvāgramodakam ..
pradadyāddvijadāṃpatyaṃ pūjya mālyavibhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 165 ..
meaning:
ताम्रपात्र्यां कुण्डकं वा कृतं दत्त्वाग्रमोदकम् ..
प्रदद्याद्द्विजदांपत्यं पूज्य माल्यविभूषणैः .. 165 ..
text_mt: Having placed it in a copper vessel or a small basin, and offered foremost sweetmeats, / he should bestow it after worshipping a Brahmin couple with garlands and ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
kaṃṭhapramāṇamāviśya jalaṃ malavivarjitaḥ ..
kāṃtārakāriṇā hyetatkathitaṃ tu yudhiṣṭhira .. 166 ..
meaning:
कंठप्रमाणमाविश्य जलं मलविवर्जितः ..
कांतारकारिणा ह्येतत्कथितं तु युधिष्ठिर .. 166 ..
text_mt: entering water up to neck-level, freed from impurity. / This was indeed proclaimed, O Yudhiṣṭhira, by the maker of the Kāntāra rite.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṃtārakāridurgeṣu vārayatyapi duṣkṛtīn..
iha loke pare caiva nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 167 ..
meaning:
कांतारकारिदुर्गेषु वारयत्यपि दुष्कृतीन्..
इह लोके परे चैव नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 167 ..
text_mt: In the perilous paths and strongholds made by the wild forests, it wずる wards off evil-doers / in this world and in the next; there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
ye kurvaṃti dine puṇye vrataṃ pauraṃdaraṃ narāḥ ..
teṣāṃ pauraṃdaro loko bhavedābhūtasaṃplavam .. 168 ..
meaning:
ये कुर्वंति दिने पुण्ये व्रतं पौरंदरं नराः ..
तेषां पौरंदरो लोको भवेदाभूतसंप्लवम् .. 168 ..
text_mt: The men who perform the pauraṃdara votive observance on an auspicious day, / their world shall be Indra's world until the dissolution of all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
payovratastu pañcamyāṃ dattvā nāgaṃ dvijātaye ..
sauvarṇaṃ sarpajanitaṃ bhayaṃ tebhyo na jāyate .. 169 ..
meaning:
पयोव्रतस्तु पञ्चम्यां दत्त्वा नागं द्विजातये ..
सौवर्णं सर्पजनितं भयं तेभ्यो न जायते .. 169 ..
text_mt: Observing a milk-fast on the fifth lunar day, having given a serpent / made of gold to a twice-born, no fear born of snakes arises for them.

sanskrit_iast:
sitāṣṭamyāṃ sopavāso vṛṣabhaṃ yaḥ prayacchati ..
sitavastrasamācchannaṃ ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitam .. 4.121.170 ..
meaning:
सिताष्टम्यां सोपवासो वृषभं यः प्रयच्छति ..
सितवस्त्रसमाच्छन्नं घण्टाभरणभूषितम् .. 4.121.170 ..
text_mt: He who, fasting on the bright eighth lunar day, gives a bull / covered in white cloth and adorned with bell ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
śivaloke vasetkalpaṃ tato rājā bhavediha ..
vṛṣavratamidaṃ proktaṃ sarvadharmapradāyakam ..171..
meaning:
शिवलोके वसेत्कल्पं ततो राजा भवेदिह ..
वृषव्रतमिदं प्रोक्तं सर्वधर्मप्रदायकम् ..171..
text_mt: dwells in the world of Śiva for a kalpa, and then becomes a king in this world. / This is declared to be the Vṛṣavrata, which bestows all righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
uttare tvayane prāpte ghṛtaprasthena yo harim ..
snāpayitvā brāhmaṇāya vaḍavāṃ yaḥ prayacchati..172..
meaning:
उत्तरे त्वयने प्राप्ते घृतप्रस्थेन यो हरिम् ..
स्नापयित्वा ब्राह्मणाय वडवां यः प्रयच्छति..172..
text_mt: When the northern solstice has arrived, he who, having bathed Hari / with a prastha of clarified butter, gives a mare to a Brahmin,

sanskrit_iast:
sa sarvakāmasaṃyuktaḥ putrabhrātṛsamanvitaḥ..
sūryaloke vasedrājanrājñīvratamihocyate ..173..
meaning:
स सर्वकामसंयुक्तः पुत्रभ्रातृसमन्वितः..
सूर्यलोके वसेद्राजन्राज्ञीव्रतमिहोच्यते ..173..
text_mt: endowed with all desires, accompanied by sons and brothers, / dwells in the world of the sun, O king; this is called the Rājñīvrata in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
sakṛnnavamyāṃ bhaktena pūjayedvindhyavāsinīm..
puṣpardhūpaistato dadyātpañjaraṃ śukaśobhitam ..174..
meaning:
सकृन्नवम्यां भक्तेन पूजयेद्विन्ध्यवासिनीम्..
पुष्पर्धूपैस्ततो दद्यात्पञ्जरं शुकशोभितम् ..174..
text_mt: He should worship Vindhyavāsinī on the ninth lunar day once with devotion / using flowers and incenses; then he should give a cage adorned with a parrot,

sanskrit_iast:
haimaṃ viprāya śāṃtāya sa vāgmī jāyate naraḥ ..
etadāgneyamityuktaṃ vratamagnipadapradam .. 175 ..
meaning:
हैमं विप्राय शांताय स वाग्मी जायते नरः ..
एतदाग्नेयमित्युक्तं व्रतमग्निपदप्रदम् .. 175 ..
text_mt: made of gold, to a serene Brahmin; that man becomes eloquent. / This is declared to be the Āgneyavrata, which bestows the realm of Agni.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāṃ guhyakānāṃ ca palalaikṣavasaṃyutam ..
viprāya bhojanaṃ dattvā yaḥ sa yāti hareḥ padam .. 176 ..
meaning:
द्वादश्यां गुह्यकानां च पललैक्षवसंयुतम् ..
विप्राय भोजनं दत्त्वा यः स याति हरेः पदम् .. 176 ..
text_mt: And on the twelfth lunar day of the Guhyakas, he who gives food / mixed with meat and sugarcane products to a Brahmin, goes to the abode of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣkambhādiṣu yogeṣu ekamuktarato naraḥ ..
etadāgneyamityuktaṃ vratamagnipadapradam .. 177 ..
meaning:
विष्कम्भादिषु योगेषु एकमुक्तरतो नरः ..
एतदाग्नेयमित्युक्तं व्रतमग्निपदप्रदम् .. 177 ..
text_mt: A man dedicated to a single meal during the Viṣkambha and other yogas— / this is declared to be the Āgneyavrata, which bestows the realm of Agni.

sanskrit_iast:
yo dadāti kramādeṣu ghṛtatailaphalaikṣavam ..
yavagodhūmacaṇakānniṣpāvāñchālitaṃḍulān .. 178 ..
meaning:
यो ददाति क्रमादेषु घृततैलफलैक्षवम् ..
यवगोधूमचणकान्निष्पावाञ्छालितंडुलान् .. 178 ..
text_mt: He who in succession gives clarified butter, oil, fruits, sugarcane products, / barley, wheat, chickpeas, niṣpāva beans, śāli rice,

sanskrit_iast:
lavaṇaṃ dadhi dugdhaṃ ca vastraṃ kanakameva ca ..
kaṃbalaṃ gāṃ vṛṣaṃ chatramupānadyugalaṃ tathā .. 179 ..
meaning:
लवणं दधि दुग्धं च वस्त्रं कनकमेव च ..
कंबलं गां वृषं छत्रमुपानद्युगलं तथा .. 179 ..
text_mt: salt, curds, milk, cloth, and gold, / a blanket, a cow, a bull, a royal parasol, and a pair of shoes,

sanskrit_iast:
karpūraṃ kuṃkumaṃ caiva caṃdanaṃ kusumāni ca ..
lohaṃ kanaka tāmraṃ ca raupyaṃ ceti yudhiṣṭhira .. 4.121.180 ..
meaning:
कर्पूरं कुंकुमं चैव चंदनं कुसुमानि च ..
लोहं कनक ताम्रं च रौप्यं चेति युधिष्ठिर .. 4.121.180 ..
text_mt: camphor, saffron, sandalwood, and flowers, / iron, gold, copper, and silver, O Yudhiṣṭhira—

sanskrit_iast:
snātaḥ svaśaktyā vidhivatsarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ..
na viyogamavāpnoti yogavratamidaṃ smṛtam .. 181 ..
meaning:
स्नातः स्वशक्त्या विधिवत्सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ..
न वियोगमवाप्नोति योगव्रतमिदं स्मृतम् .. 181 ..
text_mt: Having bathed according to one's capacity and according to rule, one is liberated from all sins. / One never suffers separation; this is known as the Yogavrata.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtikyāṃ naktabhugdadyānmeṣaṃ mārgaśire vṛṣam ..
pauṣamāghādimāseṣu sauvarṇīḥ sarva eva hi..182..
meaning:
कार्तिक्यां नक्तभुग्दद्यान्मेषं मार्गशिरे वृषम् ..
पौषमाघादिमासेषु सौवर्णीः सर्व एव हि..182..
text_mt: On the full moon of Kārttika, eating at night, one should give a ram; in Mārgaśīrṣa, a bull; / and in the months beginning with Pauṣa and Māgha, golden [images of] all

sanskrit_iast:
krameṇa rāśayaḥ sarvā vastramālyairvibhūṣitāḥ..
paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ kauṃteya bahudakṣiṇām .. 183 ..
meaning:
क्रमेण राशयः सर्वा वस्त्रमाल्यैर्विभूषिताः..
पौर्णमास्यां पौर्णमास्यां कौंतेय बहुदक्षिणाम् .. 183 ..
text_mt: the signs of the zodiac in succession, adorned with garments and garlands, / on each and every full moon, O son of Kuntī, accompanied by generous fees.

sanskrit_iast:
etadrāśivrataṃ nāma sarvopadravanāśanam ..
sarvāśāpūrakaṃ tadvatsomalokapradāyakam .. 184 ..
meaning:
एतद्राशिव्रतं नाम सर्वोपद्रवनाशनम् ..
सर्वाशापूरकं तद्वत्सोमलोकप्रदायकम् .. 184 ..
text_mt: This is named the Rāśivrata, which destroys all calamities; / likewise it fulfills all desires and grants the world of the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāśītirvratānāṃ te kathitā pāṃḍunaṃdana ..
yāṃ śrutvā brahmahā goghnaḥ pitṛhā mātṛhā tathā .. 185 ..
meaning:
पञ्चाशीतिर्व्रतानां ते कथिता पांडुनंदन ..
यां श्रुत्वा ब्रह्महा गोघ्नः पितृहा मातृहा तथा .. 185 ..
text_mt: Eighty-five observances have been told to you, O joy of Pāṇḍu, / hearing which, the killer of a brahmin, the killer of a cow, the killer of a father, and likewise the killer of a mother

sanskrit_iast: mucyate tatkṣaṇādeva pātakaiḥ sopapātakaiḥ .. 186 ..
meaning: मुच्यते तत्क्षणादेव पातकैः सोपपातकैः .. 186 ..
text_mt: is freed that very moment from major sins and minor sins.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcādhikā tava mayā kathitā vratānāṃ rājannaśītiratisaukhyadhanapradānām..
etāṃ samācarati yaḥ śṛṇuyātpaṭhedvā hastāgra lagna iva tasya sureśalokaḥ .. 187 .. ..
māghasnānavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
पंचाधिका तव मया कथिता व्रतानां राजन्नशीतिरतिसौख्यधनप्रदानाम्..
एतां समाचरति यः शृणुयात्पठेद्वा हस्ताग्र लग्न इव तस्य सुरेशलोकः .. 187 .. ..
माघस्नानविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Eighty-five observances that bestow supreme happiness and wealth have been told to you by me, O King. / Whoever performs this, or hears or reads it, the realm of the lord of the gods is as if resting in the palm of his hand.
Description of the rules for bathing in Māgha

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
kṛtaṃ brahmayugaṃ proktaṃ tretā tu kṣatriyaṃ yugam ..
vaiśyaṃ dvāparamityāhuḥ śūdraṃ kaliyugaṃ smṛtam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
कृतं ब्रह्मयुगं प्रोक्तं त्रेता तु क्षत्रियं युगम् ..
वैश्यं द्वापरमित्याहुः शूद्रं कलियुगं स्मृतम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / The Kṛta is declared to be the Brāhmaṇa age, and the Tretā the Kṣatriya age; / they say the Dvāpara is Vaiśya, and the Kali age is remembered as Śūdra.
title: Māghasnānavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
kalau rājanmanuṣyāṇāṃ śaithilyaṃ snānakarmaṇi ..
tathāpi māghavyājena kathayiṣyāmi te śṛṇu .. 2 ..
meaning:
कलौ राजन्मनुष्याणां शैथिल्यं स्नानकर्मणि ..
तथापि माघव्याजेन कथयिष्यामि ते शृणु .. 2 ..
text_mt: In the Kali age, O King, there is laxity among men regarding the rite of bathing; / nevertheless, under the pretext of Māgha, I shall tell it to you; listen.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya hastau ca pādau ca vāṅmanastu susaṃyatam ..
vidyā tapaśca kīrtiśca sa tīrthaphalamaśnute .. 3 ..
meaning:
यस्य हस्तौ च पादौ च वाङ्मनस्तु सुसंयतम् ..
विद्या तपश्च कीर्तिश्च स तीर्थफलमश्नुते .. 3 ..
text_mt: He whose hands, feet, speech, and mind are well controlled, / who has learning, ascetic heat, and renown, enjoys the fruit of sacred bathing places.

sanskrit_iast:
aśraddadhānaḥ pāpātmā nāstiko'cchinnasaṃśayaḥ ..
hetuniṣṭhāśca pañcaite na tīrthaphalabhāginaḥ ..4..
meaning:
अश्रद्दधानः पापात्मा नास्तिकोऽच्छिन्नसंशयः ..
हेतुनिष्ठाश्च पञ्चैते न तीर्थफलभागिनः ..4..
text_mt: One who lacks faith, the sinful soul, the atheist, one whose doubts are unsevered, / and those reliant on sophistry—these five do not share in the fruit of sacred bathing places.

sanskrit_iast:
prayāgaṃ puṣkaraṃ prāpya kurukṣetramathāpi vā ..
yatra vā tatra vā snāyānmāghe nityamiti śrutiḥ..5..
meaning:
प्रयागं पुष्करं प्राप्य कुरुक्षेत्रमथापि वा ..
यत्र वा तत्र वा स्नायान्माघे नित्यमिति श्रुतिः..5..
text_mt: Having reached Prayāga, Puṣkara, or Kurukṣetra, / or wherever it may be, one should bathe daily in Māgha; such is the sacred tradition.

sanskrit_iast:
trirātraphaladā nadyo yāḥ kāścidasamudragāḥ ..
samudragāstu pakṣasya māsasya saritāṃ patiḥ ..6..
meaning:
त्रिरात्रफलदा नद्यो याः काश्चिदसमुद्रगाः ..
समुद्रगास्तु पक्षस्य मासस्य सरितां पतिः ..6..
text_mt: Whatever rivers do not reach the ocean grant the fruit of three nights [of bathing]; / those flowing to the ocean grant that of a fortnight, while the lord of rivers grants that of a month.

sanskrit_iast:
uṣaḥsamīpe yaḥ snānaṃ saṃdhyāyāmudite ravau ..
prājāpatyena tattulyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam .. 7 ..
meaning:
उषःसमीपे यः स्नानं संध्यायामुदिते रवौ ..
प्राजापत्येन तत्तुल्यं महापातकनाशनम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: A bath taken near dawn, at twilight as the sun rises, / is equal to a Prājāpatya penance and destroys major sins.

sanskrit_iast:
prātarutthāya yo vipraḥ prātaḥsnāyī sadā bhavet ..
sa sarvapāpanirmuktaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati .. 8 ..
meaning:
प्रातरुत्थाय यो विप्रः प्रातःस्नायी सदा भवेत् ..
स सर्वपापनिर्मुक्तः परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति .. 8 ..
text_mt: The twice-born who rises at dawn and always bathes in the morning, / freed from all sins, attains the supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛthā coṣṇodakasnānaṃ vṛthā jāpyamavaidikam ..
aśrotriye vṛthā śrāddhaṃ vṛthā bhuktamasākṣikam .. 9 ..
meaning:
वृथा चोष्णोदकस्नानं वृथा जाप्यमवैदिकम् ..
अश्रोत्रिये वृथा श्राद्धं वृथा भुक्तमसाक्षिकम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Useless is a bath in hot water, useless is non-Vedic recitation, / useless is an ancestral rite for one who is not learned in the Vedas, and useless is food eaten without witnesses.

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ caturvidhaṃ proktaṃ snānavidbhiryudhiṣṭhira ..
vāyavyaṃ vāruṇaṃ brāhmaṃ divyaṃ ceti pṛthakśṛṇu . 4.122.10 ...
meaning:
स्नानं चतुर्विधं प्रोक्तं स्नानविद्भिर्युधिष्ठिर ..
वायव्यं वारुणं ब्राह्मं दिव्यं चेति पृथक्शृणु . 4.122.10 ...
text_mt: Bathing is declared to be fourfold by those who know bathing rites, O Yudhiṣṭhira: / Vāyavya, Vāruṇa, Brāhma, and Divya; hear about them separately.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyavyaṃ gorajaḥ snānaṃ vāruṇaṃ sāgarādiṣu..
brāhmaṃ brāhmaṇamaṃtroktaṃ divyaṃ meghāṃbubhāskaram..
sarveṣāmeva snānāṃ viśiṣṭaṃ tatra vāruṇam..11..
meaning:
वायव्यं गोरजः स्नानं वारुणं सागरादिषु..
ब्राह्मं ब्राह्मणमंत्रोक्तं दिव्यं मेघांबुभास्करम्..
सर्वेषामेव स्नानां विशिष्टं तत्र वारुणम्..11..
text_mt: The Vāyavya is bathing with cow-dust; the Vāruṇa is in the ocean and the like; / the Brāhma is that spoken of with brāhmaṇa mantras; the Divya is with rain-water in sunshine. / Among all these baths, the Vāruṇa is the most distinguished.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprastho'tha bhikṣukaḥ..
ete sarve praśaṃsaṃti sarvadā māghamajjanam..12..
meaning:
ब्रह्मचारी गृहस्थश्च वानप्रस्थोऽथ भिक्षुकः..
एते सर्वे प्रशंसंति सर्वदा माघमज्जनम्..12..
text_mt: The student, the householder, the forest-dweller, and the mendicant— / all of these constantly praise immersing oneself in Māgha.

sanskrit_iast:
bālāstaruṇakā vṛddhā naranārīnapuṃsakāḥ..
snātvā māghe śubhe tīrthe prāpnuvaṃtīpsitaṃ phalam..13..
meaning:
बालास्तरुणका वृद्धा नरनारीनपुंसकाः..
स्नात्वा माघे शुभे तीर्थे प्राप्नुवंतीप्सितं फलम्..13..
text_mt: Children, youths, the elderly, men, women, and eunuchs, / having bathed in an auspicious sacred bathing place in Māgha, attain their desired reward.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmakṣatraviśāṃ caiva mantravatsnānamiṣyate ..
tūṣṇīmeva hi śūdrasya strīṇāṃ ca kurunaṃdana .. 14 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशां चैव मन्त्रवत्स्नानमिष्यते ..
तूष्णीमेव हि शूद्रस्य स्त्रीणां च कुरुनंदन .. 14 ..
text_mt: Bathing with mantras is prescribed for Brahmins, Kṣatriyas, and Vaiśyas; / but for a Śūdra and for women it is indeed silent, O joy of the Kurus.

sanskrit_iast:
māghamāse raṭaṃtyāpaḥ kiñcidabhyudite ravau ..
brahmaghraṃ vā surāpaṃ vā kaṃpaṃ taṃtaṃ punīmahe .. 15 ..
meaning:
माघमासे रटंत्यापः किञ्चिदभ्युदिते रवौ ..
ब्रह्मघ्रं वा सुरापं वा कंपं तंतं पुनीमहे .. 15 ..
text_mt: In the month of Māgha, when the sun is slightly risen, the waters cry out: / “Whether he is a killer of a brahmin or a drinker of liquor, whomsoever he may be, we purify him!”

sanskrit_iast:
prāsādā yatra sauvarṇāḥ striyaścāpsarasopamāḥ ..
dadhikulyavahā yatra nadyaḥ pāyasakardamāḥ ..
tatra te yāṃti majjaṃti ye māghe bhāskarodaye ..16..
meaning:
प्रासादा यत्र सौवर्णाः स्त्रियश्चाप्सरसोपमाः ..
दधिकुल्यवहा यत्र नद्यः पायसकर्दमाः ..
तत्र ते यांति मज्जंति ये माघे भास्करोदये ..16..
text_mt: Where there are golden palaces, and women resembling apsarases, / where rivers flow with streams of curd and have mud of sweet rice milk, / there go those who immerse themselves in Māgha at sunrise.

sanskrit_iast:
yativatpathi gaccheta maunī paiśunyavarjitaḥ ..
yadīcchedvipulānbhogāṃścandrasūryopamāngṛhān .. 1 7..
meaning:
यतिवत्पथि गच्छेत मौनी पैशुन्यवर्जितः ..
यदीच्छेद्विपुलान्भोगांश्चन्द्रसूर्योपमान्गृहान् .. 1 7..
text_mt: One should walk on the road like an ascetic, silent and free from slander, / if one desires abundant pleasures and homes resembling the moon and the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣaphālgunayormadhye prātaḥsnāyī bhavennaraḥ ..
paurṇamāsyā hyamāvāsyāḥ prārabhya snānamācaret .. 18 ..
meaning:
पौषफाल्गुनयोर्मध्ये प्रातःस्नायी भवेन्नरः ..
पौर्णमास्या ह्यमावास्याः प्रारभ्य स्नानमाचरेत् .. 18 ..
text_mt: Between Pauṣa and Phālguna, a man should become a morning-bather; / beginning from the full moon or indeed from the new moon, he should perform the bath.

sanskrit_iast:
triṃśaddināni puṇyāṇi makarasthe divākare ..
tatra utthāya niyamaṃ gṛhṇīyādvidhipūrvakam .. 19 ..
meaning:
त्रिंशद्दिनानि पुण्याणि मकरस्थे दिवाकरे ..
तत्र उत्थाय नियमं गृह्णीयाद्विधिपूर्वकम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: Thirty days are holy when the sun is in Capricorn; / rising then, one should undertake the observance according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
māghamāsamimaṃ pūrṇaṃ sthāpyehaṃ devamādhavam ..
tīrthaṃ śītajale nityamiti saṃkalpya cetasā .. 4.122.20 ..
meaning:
माघमासमिमं पूर्णं स्थाप्येहं देवमाधवम् ..
तीर्थं शीतजले नित्यमिति संकल्प्य चेतसा .. 4.122.20 ..
text_mt: having resolved in one's mind: “Having installed the god Mādhava here for this entire month of Māgha, / [I shall bathe] daily in the sacred place in cold water.”

sanskrit_iast:
aprāvṛtaśarīrastu yaḥ kaṣṭaṃ snānamācaret..
padepade'śvamedhasya phalaṃ prāptoti mā navaḥ ..21 ..
meaning:
अप्रावृतशरीरस्तु यः कष्टं स्नानमाचरेत्..
पदेपदेऽश्वमेधस्य फलं प्राप्तोति मा नवः ..21 ..
text_mt: A man who performs the arduous bath with his body uncovered / obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice at every step.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvā śubhe tīrthe dattvā śirasi vai mṛdam ..
vedoktavidhinā rājansūryasyārghaṃ nivedayet .. 22 ..
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वा शुभे तीर्थे दत्त्वा शिरसि वै मृदम् ..
वेदोक्तविधिना राजन्सूर्यस्यार्घं निवेदयेत् .. 22 ..
text_mt: Having bathed there in an auspicious sacred bathing place and placed earth on his head, / he should offer water for honouring to the sun according to the rule declared in the Veda, O King.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝnsaṃtarpya tatrastho hyavatīrya tato jalāt ..
iṣṭadevaṃ namaskṛtya pūjayetpuruṣottamam ..23 ..
meaning:
पितॄन्संतर्प्य तत्रस्थो ह्यवतीर्य ततो जलात् ..
इष्टदेवं नमस्कृत्य पूजयेत्पुरुषोत्तमम् ..23 ..
text_mt: Having gratified the ancestors while standing there, and then stepped out of the water, / having bowed to his chosen deity, he should worship Puruṣottama.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhacakradharaṃ devaṃ mādhavaṃ nāma pūjayet ..
vahniṃ hutvā vidhānena tatastvekāśano bhavet.. .. 24 ..
meaning:
शङ्खचक्रधरं देवं माधवं नाम पूजयेत् ..
वह्निं हुत्वा विधानेन ततस्त्वेकाशनो भवेत्.. .. 24 ..
text_mt: He should worship the god named Mādhava who holds the conch and discus; / having offered into the fire according to rule, he should then eat only one meal [a day].

sanskrit_iast:
bhūśayyābrahmacaryeṇa śaktaḥ snānaṃ samācaret ..
aśaktasya dhanāḍhyasya svecchā sā tatra kathyate .. 25 ..
meaning:
भूशय्याब्रह्मचर्येण शक्तः स्नानं समाचरेत् ..
अशक्तस्य धनाढ्यस्य स्वेच्छा सा तत्र कथ्यते .. 25 ..
text_mt: Sleeping on the ground and practicing celibacy, one who is able should perform the bath; / for one who is unable though wealthy, his own choice is declared in that case.

sanskrit_iast:
avaśyamapi kartavyaṃ māghe snānamiti śrutiḥ ..
īśvareṇa yathākāmaṃ balaṃ dharmo'nuvartate .. 26 ..
meaning:
अवश्यमपि कर्तव्यं माघे स्नानमिति श्रुतिः ..
ईश्वरेण यथाकामं बलं धर्मोऽनुवर्तते .. 26 ..
text_mt: The bath in Māgha must certainly be performed; such is the sacred tradition. / According to one's desire, righteousness conforms to the power given by the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tilasnāyī tilodvartī tilabhoktā tilodakī ..
tilahotā ca dātā ca ṣaṭtilo nāvasīdati ..27..
meaning:
तिलस्नायी तिलोद्वर्ती तिलभोक्ता तिलोदकी ..
तिलहोता च दाता च षट्तिलो नावसीदति ..27..
text_mt: Bathing with sesame, rubbing with sesame, eating sesame, offering water with sesame, / sacrificing sesame in fire, and donating sesame: one who employs sesame in these six ways never sinks down.

sanskrit_iast:
tailasyāmalakānāṃ ca tīrthe deyāni nityaśaḥ ..
tathā prajvālayedvahniṃ nivātārthaṃ dvijanmanām ..28..
meaning:
तैलस्यामलकानां च तीर्थे देयानि नित्यशः ..
तथा प्रज्वालयेद्वह्निं निवातार्थं द्विजन्मनाम् ..28..
text_mt: Oil and myrobalan fruits should be given daily at the sacred bathing place; / likewise, one should kindle a fire to provide shelter from the wind for twice-born men.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ snānāvasāne tu bhojyaṃ deyamavāritam ..
bhojayeddvijadāṃpatyaṃ bhūṣayedvastrabhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
एवं स्नानावसाने तु भोज्यं देयमवारितम् ..
भोजयेद्द्विजदांपत्यं भूषयेद्वस्त्रभूषणैः .. 29 ..
text_mt: Thus at the conclusion of the bath, food should be given unstintingly; / one should feed a twice-born couple and adorn them with garments and ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
kaṃbalājinaratnāni vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca ..
colakāni ca divyāni pracchādanapaṭīstathā .. .. 4.122.30 ..
meaning:
कंबलाजिनरत्नानि वासांसि विविधानि च ..
चोलकानि च दिव्यानि प्रच्छादनपटीस्तथा .. .. 4.122.30 ..
text_mt: blankets, deerskins, jewels, and various kinds of garments, / divine tunics, and covering cloths,

sanskrit_iast:
upānahau tathā guptaṃ modakaiḥ pāpamocakaiḥ ..
anena vidhinā dadyānmādhavaḥ prīyatāmiti .. 31 ..
meaning:
उपानहौ तथा गुप्तं मोदकैः पापमोचकैः ..
अनेन विधिना दद्यान्माधवः प्रीयतामिति .. 31 ..
text_mt: as well as sandals, and a concealed gift with sweetmeats that release from sin. / By this rule one should give, saying: “May Mādhava be pleased!”

sanskrit_iast:
agamyāgamanasteyapāpebhyaśca parigrahāt ..
rahasyācaritādvāpi mucyate snānamācaret .. 32 ..
meaning:
अगम्यागमनस्तेयपापेभ्यश्च परिग्रहात् ..
रहस्याचरिताद्वापि मुच्यते स्नानमाचरेत् .. 32 ..
text_mt: From the sins of intercourse with forbidden women, theft, and accepting improper gifts, / or even from what was practiced in secret, he is freed; he should perform the bath.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛbhiḥ pitāmahaiḥ sārddhaṃ tathaiva prapitāmahaiḥ ..
mātāmātāmahaiḥ sārddhaṃ vṛddhamātāmahaistathā .. 33 ..
meaning:
पितृभिः पितामहैः सार्द्धं तथैव प्रपितामहैः ..
मातामातामहैः सार्द्धं वृद्धमातामहैस्तथा .. 33 ..
text_mt: Together with his fathers, grandfathers, and likewise great-grandfathers, / together with his mother's ancestors, maternal grandfathers, and maternal great-grandfathers,

sanskrit_iast:
ekaviṃśakulaiḥ sārddhaṃ bhogānbhuktvā yathepsitān ..
māghamāsyuṣasi snātvā viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati .. 34 ..
meaning:
एकविंशकुलैः सार्द्धं भोगान्भुक्त्वा यथेप्सितान् ..
माघमास्युषसि स्नात्वा विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति .. 34 ..
text_mt: together with twenty-one families, having enjoyed pleasures according to his desire, / having bathed at dawn in the month of Māgha, he goes to the realm of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
yo māghamāsyuṣasi sūryyakarābhitāmre snānaṃ samācarati cārunadīpravāhe ..
uddhṛtya saptapuruṣānpitṛmātṛtaśca svargaṃ prayātyamaladehadharo naro'sau .. 35 .. ..
nityasnānavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
यो माघमास्युषसि सूर्य्यकराभिताम्रे स्नानं समाचरति चारुनदीप्रवाहे ..
उद्धृत्य सप्तपुरुषान्पितृमातृतश्च स्वर्गं प्रयात्यमलदेहधरो नरोऽसौ .. 35 .. ..
नित्यस्नानविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
The man who, at dawn in the month of Māgha when [the sky] is coppery red with the rays of the sun, bathes in the delightful stream of a river, / having delivered seven generations [of ancestors] on both the father's and mother's sides, goes to heaven, endowed with a spotless body.
Description of the Rules for Daily Bathing

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
nairmalyaṃ bhāvaśuddhiśca vinā snānaṃ na yujyate ..
tasmātkāyaviśuddhyarthaṃ snānamādau vidhīyate .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
नैर्मल्यं भावशुद्धिश्च विना स्नानं न युज्यते ..
तस्मात्कायविशुद्ध्यर्थं स्नानमादौ विधीयते .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Purity and mental cleanness are not possible without bathing; / therefore, bathing is prescribed first of all for the purification of the body.
title: Nityasnānavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
anuddhatairuddhatairvā jalaiḥ snānaṃ samācaret ..
tīrthaṃ prakalpayedvidvānmūlamaṃtreṇa maṃtravit .. 2 ..
meaning:
अनुद्धतैरुद्धतैर्वा जलैः स्नानं समाचरेत् ..
तीर्थं प्रकल्पयेद्विद्वान्मूलमंत्रेण मंत्रवित् .. 2 ..
text_mt: One should bathe with water drawn out or not drawn out; / the wise man who knows mantras should invoke a sacred bathing place with the root-mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
namo nārāyaṇāyeti mūlamantra udāhṛtaḥ ..
darbhapāṇistu vidhinā svācāntaḥ prayataḥ sudhīḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
नमो नारायणायेति मूलमन्त्र उदाहृतः ..
दर्भपाणिस्तु विधिना स्वाचान्तः प्रयतः सुधीः .. 3 ..
text_mt: "Oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya" is declared to be the root-mantra; / holding darbha grass in hand, having properly sipped water and purified oneself, the wise man,

sanskrit_iast:
caturhastasamāyuktaṃ caturasraṃ samaṃtataḥ ..
prakalpyāvāhayedgaṅgāmebhirmaṃtrairvicakṣaṇaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
चतुर्हस्तसमायुक्तं चतुरस्रं समंततः ..
प्रकल्प्यावाहयेद्गङ्गामेभिर्मंत्रैर्विचक्षणः .. 4 ..
text_mt: having visualised a square of four cubits on all sides, / the discerning one should invoke Gaṅgā with these mantras:

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ viṣṇupādaprasūtāsi vaiṣṇavī viṣṇudevatā..
pāhi nastvenasastasmādājanmamaraṇāṃtikāt .. 5 ..
meaning:
ओं विष्णुपादप्रसूतासि वैष्णवी विष्णुदेवता..
पाहि नस्त्वेनसस्तस्मादाजन्ममरणांतिकात् .. 5 ..
text_mt: "Oṃ, you are born from Viṣṇu's foot, belonging to Viṣṇu, having Viṣṇu as deity; / protect us from that sin committed from birth until death.

sanskrit_iast:
tisraḥ koṭyo'rddhakoṭī ca tīrthānāṃ vāyurabravīt ..
divi bhuvyaṃtarikṣe ca tāni te santi jāhnavi .. 6 ..
meaning:

text_mt:
Bathing every day is indeed declared by the lords of sages to dispel sin, remove impurity, and grant happiness always; / therefore, a man should perform this in rivers, at home, or in a reservoir, with a pious mind.

meaning:
देवीं विनायकं चैव स्थापयेत्तस्य पार्श्वतः ..
दत्त्वार्घं गन्धपुष्पं च धूपदीपं गुडौदनम् .. 11 ..

bhakṣyānnānāvidhāndadyātphalāni vividhāni ca ..
catuṣkoṇeṣu bhṛṃgāramaśvatthadalabhūṣitam .. 12 ..
meaning:
भक्ष्यान्नानाविधान्दद्यात्फलानि विविधानि च ..
चतुष्कोणेषु भृंगारमश्वत्थदलभूषितम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: He should offer various kinds of edible foods and various fruits; / at the four corners, a water jar adorned with leaves of the sacred fig tree,

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikaṃ vinyasedbrahmansarvauṣadhisamanvitam ..
caturdiśaṃ maṃḍapasya dadyādbhūtabaliṃ tataḥ .. 13 ..

चतुर्दिशं मंडपस्य दद्याद्भूतबलिं ततः .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
āgneyyāṃ diśi kartavyaṃ maṃḍapasya samīpataḥ ..
agnikāryaṃ śubhe kuṇḍe puṣpapatrairalaṃkṛte .. 14 ..
meaning:
आग्नेय्यां दिशि कर्तव्यं मंडपस्य समीपतः ..
अग्निकार्यं शुभे कुण्डे पुष्पपत्रैरलंकृते .. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
lavaṇaṃ sarṣapairyuktaṃ ghṛtena madhunā saha ..

मानस्तोकेन जुहुयात्कृतहोमे नवग्रहे ..15..
text_mt: Having offered oblations to the nine planets, he should offer into the fire / salt mixed with mustard seeds along with ghee and honey, [reciting] the Mānastoka [hymn].

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyamagnikāryasya kartāraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ kuru ..

text_mt: Appoint a second Brahmin as the performer of the fire-ritual, / [and an] officiating priest who recites the Rudra hymns, anointed with white sandalwood,

text_mt: wearing white garments, adorned with white garlands, auspicious, / graced with bracelets, necklaces, ear-ornaments, and rings.

sanskrit_iast:
maṃḍala sya samīpastho japedrudrānvimatsaraḥ ..
yāvadekādaśa gatāḥ punareva japettu tān .. 18 ..
meaning:
मंडल स्य समीपस्थो जपेद्रुद्रान्विमत्सरः ..
यावदेकादश गताः पुनरेव जपेत्तु तान् .. 18 ..
text_mt: Remaining near the circle, free from envy, he should recite the Rudra hymns; / as soon as eleven have passed, he should recite them again.

sanskrit_iast:
devamaṃḍalavatkāryaṃ dvitīyaṃ maṃḍalaṃ śubham ..
tasya madhye tu sā nārī śvetapuṣpairalaṃkṛtā.. 19..
meaning:
देवमंडलवत्कार्यं द्वितीयं मंडलं शुभम् ..

text_mt: A second auspicious circle should be made like the circle of the deities; / in its middle that woman, adorned with white flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
śvetavastraiśca saṃchannā śvetagaṃdhānulepitā..
sukhāsanopaviṣṭāyāmācāryo rudraciṃtakaḥ..4.124.20..

सुखासनोपविष्टायामाचार्यो रुद्रचिंतकः..4.124.20..
text_mt: covered in white garments, smeared with white perfume, / is seated upon a comfortable seat; the officiating priest, contemplating Rudra,

abhiṣiṃcettataścaiva nāmarkapatrapuṭāṃbunā ..
catuḥṣaṣṭividhenaiva rudreṇaikādaśena tu .. 21 ..

śatāni saptaparṇānāṃ caturbhiradhikāni tu ..
acchidrāṇāṃ manūnāṃ ca snānārthaṃ viniyojayet .. 22 ..
