sanskrit_iast:
aśvasthānādgajasthānādvalmīkātsaṃgamādhradāt ..
veśyāgaṇādrājagṛhādgoṣṭhādānīya vai mṛdaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
अश्वस्थानाद्गजस्थानाद्वल्मीकात्संगमाध्रदात् ..
वेश्यागणाद्राजगृहाद्गोष्ठादानीय वै मृदः .. 23 ..
text_mt: Having brought earth indeed from a horse-stable, from an elephant-stable, from an anthill, from a river-confluence, from a deep lake, / from the house of courtesans, from the king’s palace, and from a cow-pen,

etānsaṃkṣipya kalaśe śivasaṃjñe supūjite .. 24 ..

text_mt: all kinds of herbs, rocanā, and the waters of river sacred places, / having placed these in a well-worshipped water jar called Śiva,

āpādatalakeśaṃ ca kukṣī caiva viśeṣataḥ ..
sarvāṃgaṃ lepayennāryāḥ suśīlā kācidaṅganā .. 25 ..
meaning:
आपादतलकेशं च कुक्षी चैव विशेषतः ..
सर्वांगं लेपयेन्नार्याः सुशीला काचिदङ्गना .. 25 ..
text_mt: from the soles of her feet up to her hair, and especially the belly, / some virtuous woman should smear the entire body of the woman.

रुद्राभिजप्तेन ततः स्नापयेत्कलशेन ताम् ..
तोयपूर्णाष्टकलशैरश्वत्थदलपूरितैः .. 26 ..

meaning:
सर्वतोदिक्स्थितैः पश्चात्स्नापयेत्सफलाक्षतैः ..

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:
हेतुरप्यत्र निर्दिष्टा दक्षिणा गौः पयस्विनी ..

सर्वेष्वपि हि मासेषु ब्राह्मणाभिमते शुभम् .. 4.124.30 ..

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: That slender-limbed woman who, endowed with faith and approved by the best of the twice-born, performs the bath known as Rudra, / having destroyed all faults from the limbs of her body, becomes dear to her husband and has living children, O descendant of Bharata.

text_mt:
Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-fourth chapter, entitled “Description of the Rule for the Rudra Bath,” in the dialogue between Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Yudhiṣṭhira, in the Uttaraparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Rule for the Bath during Eclipses of the Moon and the Sun

.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
candrādityoparāgeṣu yatsnānamabhidhīyate ..

text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / What is said to be the bath during eclipses of the moon and the sun, / that I wish to hear, primarily the materials and the food.
title: Vidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
yasya rāśiṃ samāsādya bhavedgrahaṇasaṃplavaḥ ..
tasya snānaṃ pravakṣyāmi maṃtrauṣadhisamanvitam .. 2 ..

.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
यस्य राशिं समासाद्य भवेद्ग्रहणसंप्लवः ..
तस्य स्नानं प्रवक्ष्यामि मंत्रौषधिसमन्वितम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: The Blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / In whatever zodiacal sign an eclipse-affliction should occur, / I shall proclaim the bath for him, accompanied by mantras and herbs.

sanskrit_iast:
candroparāgaṃ saṃprāpya kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam..
saṃpūjya caturo viprāngandhamālyānulepanaiḥ .. 3 ..

चन्द्रोपरागं संप्राप्य कृत्वा ब्राह्मणवाचनम्..
संपूज्य चतुरो विप्रान्गन्धमाल्यानुलेपनैः .. 3 ..
text_mt: When a lunar eclipse arrives, having arranged the blessing of Brahmins / and having worshipped four Brahmins with perfumes, garlands, and ointments,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvamevoparāgasya samānīyauṣadhādikam ..
sthāpayeccaturaḥ kumbhānagrataḥ sāgarāniti .. 4 ..
meaning:
पूर्वमेवोपरागस्य समानीयौषधादिकम् ..
स्थापयेच्चतुरः कुम्भानग्रतः सागरानिति .. 4 ..
text_mt: having brought the herbs and other materials even prior to the eclipse, / one should place four pots before him, representing the oceans:

sanskrit_iast:
gajāśvarathyāvalmīkasaṅgamāddhradagokulāt ..
rājadvārapradeśāttu mṛdamānīya prakṣipet .. 5 ..
meaning:
गजाश्वरथ्यावल्मीकसङ्गमाद्ध्रदगोकुलात् ..
राजद्वारप्रदेशात्तु मृदमानीय प्रक्षिपेत् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Having brought earth from an elephant-street, a horse-street, an anthill, a river-confluence, a deep lake, a cattle-pen, / and indeed from the region of the royal gate, he should cast it in.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcagavyaṃ ca kuṃbheṣu paṃcaratnāni caiva hi ..
rocanā padmaśaṃkhau ca pañcabhaṅgasamanvitau .. 6 ..
meaning:
पंचगव्यं च कुंभेषु पंचरत्नानि चैव हि ..
रोचना पद्मशंखौ च पञ्चभङ्गसमन्वितौ .. 6 ..
text_mt: And the five products of the cow into the pots, and the five jewels indeed, / rocanā, and a lotus and a conch together with five sprigs,

sanskrit_iast:
sphaṭikaṃ candanaṃ śvetaṃ tīrthavārisasarṣapam ..
gajadaṃtaṃ kuṃkumaṃ ca tathaivośīraguggulam ..
etatsarvaṃ vinikṣipya kumbheṣvāvāhayetsurān .. 7 ..
meaning:
स्फटिकं चन्दनं श्वेतं तीर्थवारिससर्षपम् ..
गजदंतं कुंकुमं च तथैवोशीरगुग्गुलम् ..
एतत्सर्वं विनिक्षिप्य कुम्भेष्वावाहयेत्सुरान् .. 7 ..
text_mt: crystal, white sandalwood, sacred-place water with mustard seeds, / elephant tusk, and saffron, and likewise uśīra and guggulu— / having thrown all this in, he should invoke the gods into the pots:

sanskrit_iast:

āyāṃtu yajamānasya duritakṣayakārakāḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
सर्वे समुद्राः सरितस्तीर्थानि जलदा ह्रदाः ..
आयांतु यजमानस्य दुरितक्षयकारकाः .. 8 ..
text_mt: “May all the oceans, rivers, sacred places, clouds, and deep lakes / come, bringing about the destruction of the patron's misfortunes.

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: May that god who holds the thunderbolt, regarded as the lord of the Ādityas, / Indra of a thousand eyes, remove my affliction here!

खड्गव्यग्रोऽति भीमश्च रक्षःपीडां व्यपोहतु .. 4.125.10 ..
text_mt: May the supreme lord of the host of demons, having a lustre like the wind of cosmic dissolution, / brandishing a sword and exceedingly dreadful, remove the affliction caused by demons!

चन्द्रोपरागपापानि स नाशयतु शङ्करः .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
trailokye yāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ..

meaning:
त्रैलोक्ये यानि भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च ..
ब्रह्मार्कविष्णुयुक्तानि तानि पापं दहंतु वै .. 12 ..
text_mt: Whatever beings are in the three worlds, both stationary and moving, / joined with Brahmā, the Sun, and Viṣṇu, may they indeed burn up sin!”

sanskrit_iast:

एवमामंत्रितैः कुम्भैरंभोयुक्तैर्युगान्वितैः ..
ऋग्यजुः साममंत्रैश्च शुक्लमाल्यानुलेपनैः ..
पूजयेद्वस्त्रगोदानैर्ब्राह्मणानिष्टदेवताः .. 13 ..
text_mt: With the pots thus addressed with mantras, filled with water, joined as pairs, / and with the mantras of the Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma, with white garlands and ointments, / he should worship the Brahmins and chosen deities with garments and gifts of cows.

sanskrit_iast:
etāneva tato maṃtrānsaṃlikhya kanakānvitān .
yajamānasya śirasi uddhāryāste narottama .. 14 ..
meaning:
एतानेव ततो मंत्रान्संलिख्य कनकान्वितान् .
यजमानस्य शिरसि उद्धार्यास्ते नरोत्तम .. 14 ..
text_mt: Then having written these very mantras accompanied with gold, / they are to be borne upon the head of the patron, O best of men,

sanskrit_iast:
kalaśāndravyasaṃyuktānprāpte grahaṇaparvaṇi ..
candragrahe nivṛtte tu kṛtagodānamaṅgalaḥ . .. 15 ..
meaning:
कलशान्द्रव्यसंयुक्तान्प्राप्ते ग्रहणपर्वणि ..
चन्द्रग्रहे निवृत्ते तु कृतगोदानमङ्गलः . .. 15 ..
text_mt: the jars filled with ritual materials when the eclipse-juncture has arrived. / When the lunar eclipse has ceased, having performed the auspicious giving of a cow,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtasnānaḥ śvetapaṭṭaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ..
anena vidhinā yastu sagrahaṃ snānamācaret .. 16 ..
meaning:
कृतस्नानः श्वेतपट्टं ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ..
अनेन विधिना यस्तु सग्रहं स्नानमाचरेत् .. 16 ..
text_mt: Having bathed, he should present a white silk cloth to a brāhmaṇa. / But whoever performs the eclipse-bath according to this rule,

sanskrit_iast:
na tasya grahapīḍā syānna ca baṃdhujanakṣayaḥ ..
paramāṃ siddhimāpnoti punarāvṛttidurlabhām .. 17 ..
meaning:
न तस्य ग्रहपीडा स्यान्न च बंधुजनक्षयः ..
परमां सिद्धिमाप्नोति पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभाम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: For him there is no affliction from the planets, nor loss of kin; / he attains the highest perfection, difficult [to attain] because of non-return.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryagrahe sūryanāma sadā maṃtreṣu kīrtayet ..
dravyaistaireva kathitaṃ snānaṃ kurukulodvaha .. 18
meaning:
सूर्यग्रहे सूर्यनाम सदा मंत्रेषु कीर्तयेत् ..
द्रव्यैस्तैरेव कथितं स्नानं कुरुकुलोद्वह .. 18
text_mt: During a solar eclipse, one should always recite the name of the Sun in the mantras. / The bath is declared to be [performed] with those very materials, O bull of the Kuru race.

sanskrit_iast:
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ śrāvayedvāpi mānavaḥ ..
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śakraloke mahīyate .. 19 ..
meaning:
य इदं शृणुयान्नित्यं श्रावयेद्वापि मानवः ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः शक्रलोके महीयते .. 19 ..
text_mt: A person who constantly hears this or causes [others] to hear it, / freed from all sins, is glorified in the world of Śakra.

sanskrit_iast:
candragrahe nṛpa ravigrahaṇe japanmāṃ maṃtrairimaiḥ samabhimaṃtrya śubhodakuṃbhāt ..
snānaṃ karoti niyamena naraśca yaśca pīḍā na taṃ grahakṛtā ca punardunoti .. 4.125.20 ..
meaning:
चन्द्रग्रहे नृप रविग्रहणे जपन्मां मंत्रैरिमैः समभिमंत्र्य शुभोदकुंभात् ..
स्नानं करोति नियमेन नरश्च यश्च पीडा न तं ग्रहकृता च पुनर्दुनोति .. 4.125.20 ..
text_mt: During a lunar eclipse, O king, or a solar eclipse, a man who, reciting these mantras, chants over the water from the auspicious pot and bathes according to the rule, is not tormented again by affliction caused by the planets. // 4.125.20

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde candrādityagrahaṇasnāna vidhivarṇanaṃ nāma paṃcaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 125 .. ..
sāṃbharāyaṇīvratavarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराण उत्तरपर्वणि श्रीकृष्णयुधिष्ठिरसंवादे चन्द्रादित्यग्रहणस्नान विधिवर्णनं नाम पंचविंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 125 .. ..
सांभरायणीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-fifth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Rule for Bathing during Lunar and Solar Eclipses', in the dialogue between Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Yudhiṣṭhira, in the Uttaraparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Sāṃbharāyaṇī vow

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
gṛhastho maraṇe prāpte kathaṃ tyajati jīvitam..
etanme brūhi govinda paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me..1..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
गृहस्थो मरणे प्राप्ते कथं त्यजति जीवितम्..
एतन्मे ब्रूहि गोविन्द परं कौतूहलं हि मे..1..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / When death arrives, how does a householder abandon life? / Tell me this, O Govinda, for great indeed is my curiosity.
title: Sāṃbharāyaṇīvratavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca..
nānyaduṣkṛṣṭamuddiṣṭaṃ tajjñairanaśanātparam ..
tasyāhaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye yajjapyaṃ ca mumūrṣatā .. 2
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच..
नान्यदुष्कृष्टमुद्दिष्टं तज्ज्ञैरनशनात्परम् ..
तस्याहं लक्षणं वक्ष्ये यज्जप्यं च मुमूर्षता .. 2
text_mt: The Holy Lord said: / Nothing else is declared higher by those who know it than fasting to death. / I shall describe its characteristics, and what should be recited by one who is about to die,

sanskrit_iast:
yādṛgrūpaśca bhagavāṃściṃtanīyo janārdanaḥ ..
āsannamātmanaḥ kālaṃ jñātvā prājño yudhiṣṭhira .. 3 ..
meaning:
यादृग्रूपश्च भगवांश्चिंतनीयो जनार्दनः ..
आसन्नमात्मनः कालं ज्ञात्वा प्राज्ञो युधिष्ठिर .. 3 ..
text_mt: And what form the blessed Janārdana should be contemplated in. / Knowing his time to be near, a wise man, O Yudhiṣṭhira,

sanskrit_iast:
nirdhūtamaladoṣaśca snāto niyatamānasaḥ ..
samabhyarcya hṛṣīkeśaṃ puṣpadhūpādibhistataḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
निर्धूतमलदोषश्च स्नातो नियतमानसः ..
समभ्यर्च्य हृषीकेशं पुष्पधूपादिभिस्ततः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Having washed away the taint of impurities, bathed, and controlled his mind, / and having then worshipped Hṛṣīkeśa with flowers, incense, and other offerings,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇipātaiḥ stavaiḥ puṇyairgaṃdhairdhūpaistu pūjayet ..
dattvā dānaṃ ca viprebhyo vikalādibhya eva ca ..
samarpya brāhmaṇebhyaśca devārcādyupayogi ca .. 5 ..
meaning:
प्रणिपातैः स्तवैः पुण्यैर्गंधैर्धूपैस्तु पूजयेत् ..
दत्त्वा दानं च विप्रेभ्यो विकलादिभ्य एव च ..
समर्प्य ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च देवार्चाद्युपयोगि च .. 5 ..
text_mt: Should revere him with prostrations, sacred hymns of praise, scents, and incense. / Having bestowed gifts upon brāhmaṇas and upon the crippled and distressed, / and having given to brāhmaṇas what is useful for divine worship and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
baṃdhu putrakalatreṣu kṣetradhānyadhanādiṣu ..
mitravarge ca rājendra mamatvaṃ vinivartayet .. 6 ..
meaning:
बंधु पुत्रकलत्रेषु क्षेत्रधान्यधनादिषु ..
मित्रवर्गे च राजेन्द्र ममत्वं विनिवर्तयेत् .. 6 ..
text_mt: He should relinquish a sense of ownership over kin, sons, wives, / fields, grain, wealth, and the rest, and over his circle of friends, O king of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
mitrāṇyamitrānmadhyasthānparānsvāṃśca punaḥ punaḥ ..
atyarthamapakāreṇa nopakāreṇa cintayet .. 7 ..
meaning:
मित्राण्यमित्रान्मध्यस्थान्परान्स्वांश्च पुनः पुनः ..
अत्यर्थमपकारेण नोपकारेण चिन्तयेत् .. 7 ..
text_mt: He should not think excessively of friends, enemies, neutrals, / strangers, and his own people over and over again with regard to harm or help.

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca prayataḥ kuryādutsargaṃ sarvakarmaṇām ..
śubhāśubhānāṃ rājendra vākyaṃ cedamudīrayet .. 8 ..
meaning:
ततश्च प्रयतः कुर्यादुत्सर्गं सर्वकर्मणाम् ..
शुभाशुभानां राजेन्द्र वाक्यं चेदमुदीरयेत् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Then, pure and concentrated, he should make a formal renunciation of all actions, / both auspicious and inauspicious, O king of kings, and utter these words:

sanskrit_iast:
parityajāmyahaṃ bhogāṃstyajāmi suhṛdo'khilān ..
bhojanaṃ hi mayotsṛṣṭamutsṛṣṭamanulepanam .. 9 ..
meaning:
परित्यजाम्यहं भोगांस्त्यजामि सुहृदोऽखिलान् ..
भोजनं हि मयोत्सृष्टमुत्सृष्टमनुलेपनम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: "I abandon pleasures; I abandon all friends. / Food indeed has been cast aside by me; unguent has been cast aside.

sanskrit_iast:
sragbhūṣaṇādikaṃ geyaṃ dānamāsanameva ca ..
homādayaḥ parārthā ye ye ca nityakramāgatāḥ .. 4.126.10 ..
meaning:
स्रग्भूषणादिकं गेयं दानमासनमेव च ..
होमादयः परार्था ये ये च नित्यक्रमागताः .. 4.126.10 ..
text_mt: Garlands, ornaments, and the like, singing, gift-giving, and the seat itself; / sacrifices and rites that are for the sake of others, and those that have come down in regular sequence;

sanskrit_iast:
naimittikāstathā kāmyāḥ śrāddhadharmādayojjhitāḥ ..
tyaktāścāśramikā dharmā varṇadharmāstathojjhitāḥ ..11..
meaning:
नैमित्तिकास्तथा काम्याः श्राद्धधर्मादयोज्झिताः ..
त्यक्ताश्चाश्रमिका धर्मा वर्णधर्मास्तथोज्झिताः ..11..
text_mt: Occasional rites and optional rites, śrāddhas and related duties are abandoned; / duties of the life stages are relinquished, and duties of the castes are likewise abandoned.

sanskrit_iast:
padbhyāṃ karābhyāṃ viharankurvāṇaḥ karma codvahan ..
na pāpaṃ kasyacinnyāyyāḥ prāṇinaḥ saṃtu nirbhayāḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
पद्भ्यां कराभ्यां विहरन्कुर्वाणः कर्म चोद्वहन् ..
न पापं कस्यचिन्न्याय्याः प्राणिनः संतु निर्भयाः .. 12 ..
text_mt: Moving about with my two feet, acting with my two hands, and bearing [my bodily frame], / may there be no sin toward anyone; may living beings be free from fear.

sanskrit_iast:
nabhasi prāṇino ye ca ye jale ye ca bhūtale ..
kṣitervivaragā ye ca ye ca pāṣāṇasaṃpuṭe .. 13 ..
meaning:
नभसि प्राणिनो ये च ये जले ये च भूतले ..
क्षितेर्विवरगा ये च ये च पाषाणसंपुटे .. 13 ..
text_mt: Those beings who are in the sky, who are in the water, and who are on the earth's surface, / those who live in the cavities of the earth, and those in the crevice of a rock,

sanskrit_iast:
dhānyādiṣu ca vastreṣu śayaneṣvāsaneṣu ca ..
te svayaṃ tu vibudhyaṃte dattaṃ tebhyo'bhayaṃ mayā .. 14 ..
meaning:
धान्यादिषु च वस्त्रेषु शयनेष्वासनेषु च ..
ते स्वयं तु विबुध्यंते दत्तं तेभ्योऽभयं मया .. 14 ..
text_mt: In grain and the like, in clothes, in beds, and in seats— / let them know of their own accord that fearlessness has been granted to them by me.

sanskrit_iast:
na me'sti bāṃdhavaḥ kaścidviṣṇuṃ muktvā jagadgurum ..
mitrapakṣe ca me viṣṇuradhaścordhvaṃ tathā punaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
न मेऽस्ति बांधवः कश्चिद्विष्णुं मुक्त्वा जगद्गुरुम् ..
मित्रपक्षे च मे विष्णुरधश्चोर्ध्वं तथा पुनः .. 15 ..
text_mt: I have no kinsman whatsoever except Viṣṇu, the teacher of the universe. / Viṣṇu is on the side of my friends; below and above, likewise again,

sanskrit_iast:
pārśvato mūrdhni hṛdaye bāhubhyāṃ caiva cakṣuṣoḥ ..
śrotrādiṣu ca sarveṣu mama viṣṇuḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
पार्श्वतो मूर्ध्नि हृदये बाहुभ्यां चैव चक्षुषोः ..
श्रोत्रादिषु च सर्वेषु मम विष्णुः प्रतिष्ठितः .. 16 ..
text_mt: To my sides, on my crown, in my heart, and in my arms and eyes, / and in all my sense-organs such as ears, Viṣṇu is established."

sanskrit_iast:
iti sarvaṃ samutsṛjya dhṛtvā sarveśamacyutam ..
vāsudevetyavirataṃ nāma devasya kīrtayet .. 17 ..
meaning:
इति सर्वं समुत्सृज्य धृत्वा सर्वेशमच्युतम् ..
वासुदेवेत्यविरतं नाम देवस्य कीर्तयेत् .. 17 ..
text_mt: Having thus relinquished everything and grasped Acyuta, the Lord of all, / he should incessantly recite the deity's name: 'Vāsudeva'.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāgreṣu darbheṣu śete vai prākchirāstathā ..
udakchirā vā rājeṃdra ciṃtayañjagataḥ patim .. 18 ..
meaning:
दक्षिणाग्रेषु दर्भेषु शेते वै प्राक्छिरास्तथा ..
उदक्छिरा वा राजेंद्र चिंतयञ्जगतः पतिम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: He lies down on darbha grass pointing to the south, with his head to the east / or with his head to the north, O king of kings, contemplating the Lord of the world:

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuṃ jiṣṇuṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ keśavaṃ madhusūdanam ..
nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ śauriṃ vāsudevaṃ janārdanam .. 19 ..
meaning:
विष्णुं जिष्णुं हृषीकेशं केशवं मधुसूदनम् ..
नारायणं नरं शौरिं वासुदेवं जनार्दनम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: "Viṣṇu, the victorious, Hṛṣīkeśa, Keśava, slayer of Madhu, / Nārāyaṇa, Nara, Śauri, Vāsudeva, Janārdana,

sanskrit_iast:
vārāhaṃ yajñapuruṣaṃ puṃḍarīkākṣamacyutam ..
vāmanaṃ śrīdharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nṛsiṃhamaparājitam .. 4.126.20 ..
meaning:
वाराहं यज्ञपुरुषं पुंडरीकाक्षमच्युतम् ..
वामनं श्रीधरं कृष्णं नृसिंहमपराजितम् .. 4.126.20 ..
text_mt: The Boar, the sacrificial person, the lotus-eyed, Acyuta, / Vāmana, Śrīdhara, Kṛṣṇa, the invincible Narasiṃha,

sanskrit_iast:
padmanābhamajaṃ śrīśaṃ dāmodaramadhokṣajam ..
sarveśvareśvaraṃ śuddhamanaṃtaṃ viśvarūpiṇam .. 21 ..
meaning:
पद्मनाभमजं श्रीशं दामोदरमधोक्षजम् ..
सर्वेश्वरेश्वरं शुद्धमनंतं विश्वरूपिणम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: Padmanābha, the unborn, Lord of Śrī, Dāmodara, Adhokṣaja, / the Lord of the lords of all, the pure, the endless, whose form is the universe,

sanskrit_iast:
cakriṇaṃ gadinaṃ śāṃtaṃ śaṃkhinaṃ garuḍadhvajam ..
kirīṭakaustubhadharaṃ praṇamāmyahamavyayam .. 22 ..
meaning:
चक्रिणं गदिनं शांतं शंखिनं गरुडध्वजम् ..
किरीटकौस्तुभधरं प्रणमाम्यहमव्ययम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: Bearer of the discus, bearer of the mace, the tranquil, bearer of the conch, whose banner is Garuḍa, / wearing a diadem and the Kaustubha jewel—I bow to the imperishable Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
ahamasmi jagannātha mayi vāsaṃ kuru drutam ..
āvayoraṃtaraṃ māstu samīrākāśayoriva .. 23 ..
meaning:
अहमस्मि जगन्नाथ मयि वासं कुरु द्रुतम् ..
आवयोरंतरं मास्तु समीराकाशयोरिव .. 23 ..
text_mt: I am yours, O Lord of the world; quickly make your dwelling in me! / Let there be no interval between us, like that between wind and space.

sanskrit_iast:
ayaṃ viṣṇurayaṃ śaurirayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ puro mama ..
nīlotpaladalaśyāmaḥ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
अयं विष्णुरयं शौरिरयं कृष्णः पुरो मम ..
नीलोत्पलदलश्यामः पद्मपत्रायतेक्षणः .. 24 ..
text_mt: This is Viṣṇu, this is Śauri, this is Kṛṣṇa before me, / dark as the petal of a blue lotus, with long eyes like lotus petals.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa paśyatu māmīśaḥ paśyāmyahamadhokṣajam ..
itthaṃ japedekamanāḥ smaransarveśvaraṃ harim .. 25 ..
meaning:
एष पश्यतु मामीशः पश्याम्यहमधोक्षजम् ..
इत्थं जपेदेकमनाः स्मरन्सर्वेश्वरं हरिम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: May this Lord look upon me; I look upon Adhokṣaja." / Thus one should recite with a single mind, remembering Hari, the Lord of all.

sanskrit_iast:
āsīta sukhaduḥkheṣu samo mitrāhiteṣu ca ..
oṃ namo vāsudevāya ' ityetatsatataṃ japet .. 26 ..
meaning:
आसीत सुखदुःखेषु समो मित्राहितेषु च ..
ओं नमो वासुदेवाय ' इत्येतत्सततं जपेत् .. 26 ..
text_mt: He should remain equal in joy and sorrow, and toward friends and foes; / he should constantly recite this: 'Oṃ namo Vāsudevāya'.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāyathā bhavetkāmastathā tannāmakīrtayet ..
dhyāyecca devadeveśaṃ viṣṇo rūpaṃ manoramam .. 27 ..
meaning:
यथायथा भवेत्कामस्तथा तन्नामकीर्तयेत् ..
ध्यायेच्च देवदेवेशं विष्णो रूपं मनोरमम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: According as his wish may be, so he should recite His name; / and he should meditate on the enchanting form of Viṣṇu, the god of gods,

sanskrit_iast:
prasannanetrabhrūcakraśaṃkhacakragadādharam ..
śrīvakṣasaṃ sumanasaṃ caturvaktraṃ kirīṭinam .. 28 ..
meaning:
प्रसन्ननेत्रभ्रूचक्रशंखचक्रगदाधरम् ..
श्रीवक्षसं सुमनसं चतुर्वक्त्रं किरीटिनम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Bearing gracious eyes, eyebrows, and circular discus, and bearing the conch, discus, and mace, / with Śrī on his chest, benevolent-minded, four-faced, wearing a crown,

sanskrit_iast:
pītāṃbaradharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ cārukeyūradhāriṇam ..
ciṃtayettu sadārūpaṃ manaḥ kṛtvaikaniścayam..29..
meaning:
पीतांबरधरं कृष्णं चारुकेयूरधारिणम् ..
चिंतयेत्तु सदारूपं मनः कृत्वैकनिश्चयम्..29..
text_mt: Wearing yellow garments, dark, wearing lovely armlets— / he should always meditate on this form, having fixed his mind with single resolve.

sanskrit_iast:
yādṛśe vā manaḥ sthairyaṃ rūpe badhnāti cakriṇaḥ ..
tadeva ciṃtayedrūpaṃ vāsudeveti kīrtayet .. 4.126.30 ..
meaning:
यादृशे वा मनः स्थैर्यं रूपे बध्नाति चक्रिणः ..
तदेव चिंतयेद्रूपं वासुदेवेति कीर्तयेत् .. 4.126.30 ..
text_mt: Or on whatever form of the Discus-bearer his mind establishes steadiness, / on that very form he should meditate, and recite 'Vāsudeva'.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ japansmarannityaṃ svarūpaṃ paramātmanaḥ ..
aprāṇaparamodārastaccittastatparāyaṇaḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
इत्थं जपन्स्मरन्नित्यं स्वरूपं परमात्मनः ..
अप्राणपरमोदारस्तच्चित्तस्तत्परायणः .. 31 ..
text_mt: Thus constantly reciting and remembering the essential nature of the supreme Self, / until life's breath departs, exceedingly noble, with his mind fixed on Him, devoted to Him,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapātakayukto'pi puruṣaḥ puruṣarṣabha ..
prayāti devadeveśe layamīḍyatamecyute .. 32 ..
meaning:
सर्वपातकयुक्तोऽपि पुरुषः पुरुषर्षभ ..
प्रयाति देवदेवेशे लयमीड्यतमेच्युते .. 32 ..
text_mt: Even a person tainted with all sins, O bull among men, / attains dissolution into Acyuta, the most praiseworthy Lord of the gods of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāgnistṛṇa jātāni dahatyanilasaṃgataḥ ..
tathānaśanasaṃkalpaḥ puṃsāṃ pāpamasaṃśayam .. 33 ..
meaning:
यथाग्निस्तृण जातानि दहत्यनिलसंगतः ..
तथानशनसंकल्पः पुंसां पापमसंशयम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: Just as fire joined with the wind burns heaps of grass, / even so the resolve of fasting to death burns away men's sin, without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
utkrāṃtikāle bhūtānāṃ muhyaṃti cittavṛttayaḥ ..
jarāvyādhivihīnānāṃ kimuta vyādhidoṣiṇām .. 34 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
उत्क्रांतिकाले भूतानां मुह्यंति चित्तवृत्तयः ..
जराव्याधिविहीनानां किमुत व्याधिदोषिणाम् .. 34 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / At the time of departure, the mental faculties of living beings become bewildered / even for those free from old age and sickness, how much more so for those suffering from illness?

sanskrit_iast:
atyaṃtavayasā dagdho vyādhinā copapīḍitaḥ ..
yadi sthātuṃ na śaknoti kṣitistho darbhasaṃstare .. 35 ..
meaning:
अत्यंतवयसा दग्धो व्याधिना चोपपीडितः ..
यदि स्थातुं न शक्नोति क्षितिस्थो दर्भसंस्तरे .. 35 ..
text_mt: Consumed by extreme old age and afflicted by disease, / if one is unable to remain on the ground upon a bed of darbha,

sanskrit_iast:
kimapyanyopyupāyo'sti na vānaśanakarmaṇi ..
vaikalyaṃ yena nāpnoti tanme brūhi janārdana..36..
meaning:
किमप्यन्योप्युपायोऽस्ति न वानशनकर्मणि ..
वैकल्यं येन नाप्नोति तन्मे ब्रूहि जनार्दन..36..
text_mt: Is there or is there not any other means in the rite of fasting to death / by which one does not incur deficiency? Tell me that, O Janārdana.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayoktaṃ bhagavandhyānaṃ tadbrūhi mama tattvataḥ ..
dhyānasvarūpamakhilaṃ kathayasva janārdana ..37..
meaning:
त्वयोक्तं भगवन्ध्यानं तद्ब्रूहि मम तत्त्वतः ..
ध्यानस्वरूपमखिलं कथयस्व जनार्दन ..37..
text_mt: Meditation was spoken of by you, O Blessed One; speak of that to me as it truly is. / Relate the entire nature of meditation, O Janārdana.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca.. ..
nātra bhūmirna ca kuśāḥ svāstarāśca na kāraṇam..
cittasyālaṃ vanībhūto viṣṇurevātra kāraṇam .. 38 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच.. ..
नात्र भूमिर्न च कुशाः स्वास्तराश्च न कारणम्..
चित्तस्यालं वनीभूतो विष्णुरेवात्र कारणम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Here neither the ground, nor kuśa grass, nor comfortable beddings are the cause; / Viṣṇu alone, having become the support of the mind, is the cause here.

sanskrit_iast:
tiṣṭhanbhuñjansvapangacchaṃstathā dhāvannitastataḥ ..
utkrāṃtikāle govindaṃ saṃsmaraṃstanmayo bhavet .. 39 ..
meaning:
तिष्ठन्भुञ्जन्स्वपन्गच्छंस्तथा धावन्नितस्ततः ..
उत्क्रांतिकाले गोविन्दं संस्मरंस्तन्मयो भवेत् .. 39 ..
text_mt: Standing, eating, sleeping, walking, or running here and there, / remembering Govinda at the time of departure, one becomes absorbed in Him.

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃ yañcāpi smaranbhāvaṃ tyajanyante kalevaram ..
taṃ tamevaiti kaunteya sadā tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ ..4.126.40..
meaning:
यं यञ्चापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजन्यन्ते कलेवरम् ..
तं तमेवैति कौन्तेय सदा तद्भावभावितः ..4.126.40..
text_mt: Whatever state of being one remembers when abandoning the body at the end, / to that very one he goes, O Kaunteya, always shaped by that state of being.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātpradhānamaṃtroktaṃ vāsudevasya cintanam ..
yadyatpṛṣṭaṃ tvayā dhyānaṃ tadeva kathayāmi te ..41..
meaning:
तस्मात्प्रधानमंत्रोक्तं वासुदेवस्य चिन्तनम् ..
यद्यत्पृष्टं त्वया ध्यानं तदेव कथयामि ते ..41..
text_mt: Therefore, contemplation of Vāsudeva, taught by the principal mantra, [is prescribed]. / Whatever meditation was asked about by you, that very thing I shall tell you.

sanskrit_iast: purā me kathitaṃ pārtha mārkaṃḍeyena dhīmatā ..42..
meaning: पुरा मे कथितं पार्थ मार्कंडेयेन धीमता ..42..
text_mt: Formerly it was told to me, O Pārtha, by the wise Mārkaṇḍeya:

sanskrit_iast:
rājyopabhogaśayanāsanavāhaneṣu strīgaṃdhamālyamaṇivastravibhūṣaṇeṣu ..
icchābhilāṣamatimātramudeti mohāddhyānaṃ tadāttamiti saṃpravadaṃti tajjñāḥ ..43..
meaning:
राज्योपभोगशयनासनवाहनेषु स्त्रीगंधमाल्यमणिवस्त्रविभूषणेषु ..
इच्छाभिलाषमतिमात्रमुदेति मोहाद्ध्यानं तदात्तमिति संप्रवदंति तज्ज्ञाः ..43..
text_mt: When an excessive longing and desire arises out of delusion / for the enjoyment of royal power, beds, seats, and vehicles, for women, perfumes, garlands, gems, garments, and ornaments, / those who know it proclaim that meditation to be distressed (ārta).

sanskrit_iast:
saṃchedanairdahanatāḍanapīḍanaiśca gātraprahāradamanairvinikartanaiśca..
yasyeha cetasi hi yāti na cānukaṃpā dhyānaṃ tu raudramiti tatpravadaṃti tajjñāḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
संछेदनैर्दहनताडनपीडनैश्च गात्रप्रहारदमनैर्विनिकर्तनैश्च..
यस्येह चेतसि हि याति न चानुकंपा ध्यानं तु रौद्रमिति तत्प्रवदंति तज्ज्ञाः .. 44 ..
text_mt: In whose mind no compassion arises / at severe mutilations, burnings, strikings, and tortures, or at blows to the limbs, subduings, and dissections, / those who know it proclaim that meditation to be wrathful (raudra).

sanskrit_iast:
sūtrārthamārgaṇamahāvratabhāvanābhirbaṃdhapramokṣagatirāgatihetu cintā ..
pañcendriyādyupaśamaśca śamaśca bhūterdhyānaṃ tu dharmyamiti tatpravadaṃti saṃtaḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
सूत्रार्थमार्गणमहाव्रतभावनाभिर्बंधप्रमोक्षगतिरागतिहेतु चिन्ता ..
पञ्चेन्द्रियाद्युपशमश्च शमश्च भूतेर्ध्यानं तु धर्म्यमिति तत्प्रवदंति संतः .. 45 ..
text_mt: Inquiry into the meaning of the sūtras, reflection on the great vows, contemplation on the causes of bondage, liberation, going, and coming, / the calming of the five sense organs and the like, and the quietude of prosperity—that, the virtuous proclaim, is righteous (dharmya) meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyendriyāṇi viṣayairna vivarjitāni saṅkalpanātmaja vikalpavikārayogaiḥ ..
tatvekaniṣṭhahṛdayo nibhṛtāṃtarātmā dhyānaṃ tu śuklamiti tatpravadaṃti siddhāḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
यस्येन्द्रियाणि विषयैर्न विवर्जितानि सङ्कल्पनात्मज विकल्पविकारयोगैः ..
तत्वेकनिष्ठहृदयो निभृतांतरात्मा ध्यानं तु शुक्लमिति तत्प्रवदंति सिद्धाः .. 46 ..
text_mt: Whose senses are not left uncurbed by sense objects, yet through the association with modification and doubts born of mental constructions, / his heart is single-mindedly devoted to reality, with his inner self concealed—that, the perfected ones (siddhas) proclaim, is pure (śukla) meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
ādye tiryagadhogatiśca niyataṃ dhyāne tu raudre sadā dharmye devagatiḥ śubhaṃ phalamahośukle ca janmakṣayaḥ ..
tasmājjanmarujāpahe hitatare saṃsāranirvāhake dhyāne śuklatare rajaḥpramathane kuryātprayatnaṃ budhaḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
आद्ये तिर्यगधोगतिश्च नियतं ध्याने तु रौद्रे सदा धर्म्ये देवगतिः शुभं फलमहोशुक्ले च जन्मक्षयः ..
तस्माज्जन्मरुजापहे हिततरे संसारनिर्वाहके ध्याने शुक्लतरे रजःप्रमथने कुर्यात्प्रयत्नं बुधः .. 47 ..
text_mt: In the first [two], the destination is surely animal existence or a nether world; in the wrathful, always [the lowest]; in the righteous, divine status and an auspicious fruit; and in the pure, ah, the cessation of rebirth. / Therefore, regarding the purer meditation that removes the afflictions of rebirth, is most beneficial, carries one across saṃsāra, and destroys passion, the wise person should make an effort.

sanskrit_iast:
samāḥ sahasrāṇi tu sapta vai jale daśaikamagnau pavane ca ṣoḍaśa ..
gavāṃ gṛhe ṣaṣṭiraśītirāhave anāśane bhārata cākṣayā gatiḥ.. .. 48 .. ..
meaning:
समाः सहस्राणि तु सप्त वै जले दशैकमग्नौ पवने च षोडश ..
गवां गृहे षष्टिरशीतिराहवे अनाशने भारत चाक्षया गतिः.. .. 48 .. ..
text_mt: In water [the reward lasts] seven thousand years, in fire eleven, and in wind sixteen; / in a cow-shed sixty, in battle eighty, and in fasting [to death], O Bhārata, the destination is imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde sāṃbharāyaṇīvratavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 126 .. ..
vāpīkūpataḍāgotsargavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराण उत्तरपर्वणि श्रीकृष्णयुधिष्ठिरसंवादे सांभरायणीव्रतवर्णनं नाम षड्विंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 126 .. ..
वापीकूपतडागोत्सर्गविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Sāmbharāyaṇī Vow,' in the dialogue between Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Yudhiṣṭhira, in the Uttaraparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the procedure for dedicating reservoirs, wells, and ponds

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
taḍāgotsarjane deva vidhiṃ vidhividāṃ vara ..
kathayasva mahābhāga mama devakinaṃdana .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
तडागोत्सर्जने देव विधिं विधिविदां वर ..
कथयस्व महाभाग मम देवकिनंदन .. 1 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / O God, best of those who know ritual procedures, relate to me the procedure / for dedicating a pond, O illustrious one, O delight of Devakī.
title: Vāpīkūpataḍāgotsargavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
vāpīkūpodakānāñca ke maṃtrāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
ke ṛtvijotra ke yūpāḥ kartavyāḥ kuṇḍamaṇḍape .. 2 ..
meaning:
वापीकूपोदकानाञ्च के मंत्राः परिकीर्तिताः ..
के ऋत्विजोत्र के यूपाः कर्तव्याः कुण्डमण्डपे .. 2 ..
text_mt: And what mantras are declared for the waters of reservoirs and wells? / What officiating priests (ṛtvijs) are here, and what sacrificial posts (yūpas) are to be made in the sacrificial pit and the pavilion?

sanskrit_iast:
dānaṃ kimatra nirdiṣṭaṃ balayaḥ ke prakīrtitāḥ ..
kasminkāle kathaṃ kuryādityetatsakalaṃ vada .. 3 ..
meaning:
दानं किमत्र निर्दिष्टं बलयः के प्रकीर्तिताः ..
कस्मिन्काले कथं कुर्यादित्येतत्सकलं वद .. 3 ..
text_mt: What gift is prescribed here? What offerings (balis) are proclaimed? / At what time and in what manner should one perform it? Tell all this.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
sādhusādhu mahābāho yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ..
taḍāgavāpīkūpānāmutsargaṃ kathayāmi te .. .. 4 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
साधुसाधु महाबाहो यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ..
तडागवापीकूपानामुत्सर्गं कथयामि ते .. .. 4 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Excellent, excellent, O mighty-armed one, that you question me! / I shall tell you of the dedication of ponds, reservoirs, and wells.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣpanne baddhapālīke sarvodbhedavivarjite ..
sopānapaṃktisahite pāṣāṇaiḥ sarvataścite .. 5 ..
meaning:
निष्पन्ने बद्धपालीके सर्वोद्भेदविवर्जिते ..
सोपानपंक्तिसहिते पाषाणैः सर्वतश्चिते .. 5 ..
text_mt: When it is completed, with its embankments bound, free from all seepage, / provided with a flight of steps, and paved all around with stones,

sanskrit_iast:
tasminsalilasaṃpūrṇe kārtike vā viśeṣataḥ ..
taḍāgasya vidhiḥ kāryaḥ sthiranakṣatrayogataḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
तस्मिन्सलिलसंपूर्णे कार्तिके वा विशेषतः ..
तडागस्य विधिः कार्यः स्थिरनक्षत्रयोगतः .. 6 ..
text_mt: when it is filled with water, especially in [the month of] Kārtika, / the rite for the pond should be performed in conjunction with a fixed lunar mansion (sthiranakṣatra).

sanskrit_iast:
munayaḥ kecidicchaṃti vyatīte cottarāyaṇe ..
na kālaniyamo hyatra pramāṇaṃ salilaṃ yataḥ ..7 ..
meaning:
मुनयः केचिदिच्छंति व्यतीते चोत्तरायणे ..
न कालनियमो ह्यत्र प्रमाणं सलिलं यतः ..7 ..
text_mt: Some sages desire [it] when the northern course of the sun (uttarāyaṇa) has passed. / Indeed, there is no restriction of time here, because water is the determining factor.

sanskrit_iast:
taḍāgapālaśīrṣe tu maṃḍalaṃ kārayecchubham ..
daśadvādaśahastaṃ ca caturdvāraṃ suvistṛtam .. 8 ..
meaning:
तडागपालशीर्षे तु मंडलं कारयेच्छुभम् ..
दशद्वादशहस्तं च चतुर्द्वारं सुविस्तृतम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: One should cause an auspicious maṇḍala to be made on the crest of the pond's embankment, / ten or twelve cubits [in size], with four gates, and very spacious.

sanskrit_iast:
toraṇāni tu catvāri caturdikṣu vicakṣaṇaiḥ ..
aśvatthoduṃbaraplakṣavaṭaśākhāmayāni ca .. 9 ..
meaning:
तोरणानि तु चत्वारि चतुर्दिक्षु विचक्षणैः ..
अश्वत्थोदुंबरप्लक्षवटशाखामयानि च .. 9 ..
text_mt: Four archways (toraṇas) [should be made] in the four directions by skilled persons, / made of branches of aśvattha, udumbara, plakṣa, and vaṭa trees.

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvarṇāstu paritaḥ patākāḥ parikalpayet ..
madhye mahādhvajaḥ kāryaḥ pañcavarṇaḥ suśobhanaḥ .. 4.127.10 ..
meaning:
नानावर्णास्तु परितः पताकाः परिकल्पयेत् ..
मध्ये महाध्वजः कार्यः पञ्चवर्णः सुशोभनः .. 4.127.10 ..
text_mt: All around, one should arrange banners of various colours. / In the centre a great banner of five colours, exceedingly beautiful, should be made.

sanskrit_iast:
caturhastā bhavedvedī madhye pañcakarātha vā ..
yajamānapramāṇena madhye yūpena śobhitā ..11..
meaning:
चतुर्हस्ता भवेद्वेदी मध्ये पञ्चकराथ वा ..
यजमानप्रमाणेन मध्ये यूपेन शोभिता ..11..
text_mt: The altar should be four cubits [wide], or five cubits in the middle, / according to the measure of the patron of the sacrifice (yajamāna), adorned in the centre with a sacrificial post (yūpa).

sanskrit_iast:
kadaṃbāśvatthapālāśavaikaṃkatamayaḥ śubhaḥ ..
brāhmaṇasyāsya nirdiṣṭo yūpaḥ śrutivicakṣaṇaiḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
कदंबाश्वत्थपालाशवैकंकतमयः शुभः ..
ब्राह्मणस्यास्य निर्दिष्टो यूपः श्रुतिविचक्षणैः .. 12 ..
text_mt: Made of kadamba, aśvattha, palāśa, or vikankata, auspicious— / such a sacrificial post is prescribed for a brāhmaṇa by those skilled in the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
nyagrodhabilvajaḥ proktaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ ca khādiraḥ ..
vaiśyasyoduṃbaramayo madhvarjunasamudbhavaḥ .. 13..
meaning:
न्यग्रोधबिल्वजः प्रोक्तः क्षत्रियाणां च खादिरः ..
वैश्यस्योदुंबरमयो मध्वर्जुनसमुद्भवः .. 13..
text_mt: One born of nyagrodha or bilva is proclaimed [for a brāhmaṇa], and of khadira for kṣatriyas; / for a vaiśya, one made of udumbara, or produced from madhuka or arjuna;

sanskrit_iast:
bibhītakoduṃbarajaḥ śākaśālmalisaṃbhavaḥ ..
śūdrasya yūpo nirdiṣṭaḥ sāradārumayo'tha vā ..14..
meaning:
बिभीतकोदुंबरजः शाकशाल्मलिसंभवः ..
शूद्रस्य यूपो निर्दिष्टः सारदारुमयोऽथ वा ..14..
text_mt: produced from bibhītaka or udumbara, or originating from teak or śālmali— / such a sacrificial post is prescribed for a śūdra, or one made of heartwood.

sanskrit_iast:
lokapālāṣṭakaṃ tatra rajasā ca vilekhayet ..
brahmāviṣṇuśca rudraśca kamalā cāmbikā tathā .. 15 ..
meaning:
लोकपालाष्टकं तत्र रजसा च विलेखयेत् ..
ब्रह्माविष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च कमला चाम्बिका तथा .. 15 ..
text_mt: One should draw there the eight world protectors (lokapālas) with coloured powder, / and Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Rudra, Kamalā, and Ambikā;

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitrī sahitā kāryā puṣpadhūpairathārcayet ..
kuryātkuṃḍāni catvāri caturdikṣu vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
सावित्री सहिता कार्या पुष्पधूपैरथार्चयेत् ..
कुर्यात्कुंडानि चत्वारि चतुर्दिक्षु विचक्षणः .. 16 ..
text_mt: they should be accompanied by Sāvitrī, and then one should worship them with flowers and incense. / The skilled person should make four sacrificial pits in the four directions,

sanskrit_iast:
mekhalātrayayuktāni hastamātrāṇi sarvataḥ ..
hemālaṃkāriṇaḥ kāryā hotāraḥ ṣoḍaśāṣṭa vā .. 17 ..
meaning:
मेखलात्रययुक्तानि हस्तमात्राणि सर्वतः ..
हेमालंकारिणः कार्या होतारः षोडशाष्ट वा .. 17 ..
text_mt: provided with three tiers (mekhalās), measuring one cubit all around. / Sixteen or eight hotṛ priests, adorned with gold ornaments, should be appointed,

sanskrit_iast:
ahatāṃbarasaṃvītāḥ srakcandanavibhūṣitāḥ ..
sthāpakāścātra vihitā vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
अहतांबरसंवीताः स्रक्चन्दनविभूषिताः ..
स्थापकाश्चात्र विहिता वेदवेदाङ्गपारगाः .. 18 ..
text_mt: clothed in unwashed garments, adorned with garlands and sandalwood paste. / And master builders (sthāpakas) are ordained here, masters of the Vedas and auxiliary sciences,

sanskrit_iast:
itihāsapurāṇajñāḥ priyavāco'nasūyakāḥ ..
mṛnmayāni ca pātrāṇi tāmrāṇi sruksruvaṃ tathā .. 19 ..
meaning:
इतिहासपुराणज्ञाः प्रियवाचोऽनसूयकाः ..
मृन्मयानि च पात्राणि ताम्राणि स्रुक्स्रुवं तथा .. 19 ..
text_mt: knowers of the Itihāsas and Purāṇas, of pleasant speech and free from envy. / And earthenware vessels, copper ones, as well as the ladles sruc and sruva,

sanskrit_iast:
vyaṃjanāni ca kāryāṇi homārthaṃ samidhastilāḥ ..
grahayajñavidhānena homaḥ kāryo vijānatā .. 4.127.20 ..
meaning:
व्यंजनानि च कार्याणि होमार्थं समिधस्तिलाः ..
ग्रहयज्ञविधानेन होमः कार्यो विजानता .. 4.127.20 ..
text_mt: and condiments are to be prepared, and firewood and sesame seeds for the fire offering (homa). / The fire offering should be performed by the discerning one according to the rule of the planetary sacrifice (grahayajña).

sanskrit_iast:
vedyādhivāsitānāṃ ca surāṇāṃ homa iṣyate ..
vāruṇaistu tathā maṃtrairhotavyaṃ puṣṭivarddhanam .. 21 ..
meaning:
वेद्याधिवासितानां च सुराणां होम इष्यते ..
वारुणैस्तु तथा मंत्रैर्होतव्यं पुष्टिवर्द्धनम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: A fire offering is desired for the gods installed upon the altar; / and the offering that increases nourishment is to be poured with mantras addressed to Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
indrādilokapālānāṃ pūrvādikramayogataḥ ..
baliṃ dadyācca talliṅgairmantraissarvārthasiddhaye .. 22 ..
meaning:
इन्द्रादिलोकपालानां पूर्वादिक्रमयोगतः ..
बलिं दद्याच्च तल्लिङ्गैर्मन्त्रैस्सर्वार्थसिद्धये .. 22 ..
text_mt: To the world protectors beginning with Indra, in the order starting from the east, / one should offer an offering (bali) with the mantras possessing their marks, for the attainment of all aims.

sanskrit_iast:
dvāreṣu kalaśāndadyātsahiraṇyānsapallavān ..
aśvatthapallavaiḥ kāryāḥ śubhāścandanamālikāḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
द्वारेषु कलशान्दद्यात्सहिरण्यान्सपल्लवान् ..
अश्वत्थपल्लवैः कार्याः शुभाश्चन्दनमालिकाः .. 23 ..
text_mt: At the doorways one should place water jars containing gold and with fresh shoots; / auspicious garlands of sandalwood should be made with aśvattha shoots.

sanskrit_iast:
sauvarṇaṃ kārayetkūrmaṃ tāmreṇa makaraṃ tathā ..
rajatena tathā matsyaṃ trapuṇā darduraṃ tathā .. 24 ..
meaning:
सौवर्णं कारयेत्कूर्मं ताम्रेण मकरं तथा ..
रजतेन तथा मत्स्यं त्रपुणा दर्दुरं तथा .. 24 ..
text_mt: One should have a golden tortoise made, and a crocodile (makara) of copper, / and a fish of silver, and a frog of tin;

sanskrit_iast:
śiśumārajalaukāñca rajatenaiva kārayet ..
sarvānapi yathāsthānaṃ tāmrapātryāṃ nidhāpayet .. 25 ..
meaning:
शिशुमारजलौकाञ्च रजतेनैव कारयेत् ..
सर्वानपि यथास्थानं ताम्रपात्र्यां निधापयेत् .. 25 ..
text_mt: and one should have a dolphin (śiśumāra) and a leech made of silver alone. / One should place them all, each in its proper place, into a copper vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā pratiṣṭhā nāmeti mantreṇāmaṃtrayecca tān ..
yūpapratiṣṭhā kartavyā vedoktavidhinā tataḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
एषा प्रतिष्ठा नामेति मन्त्रेणामंत्रयेच्च तान् ..
यूपप्रतिष्ठा कर्तव्या वेदोक्तविधिना ततः .. 26 ..
text_mt: And one should address them with the mantra 'eṣā pratiṣṭhā nāma'. / Then the consecration of the sacrificial post (yūpa) is to be performed according to the rule declared in the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṃkumena samālabhya puṣpairdhūpaiḥ samarcayet ..
vastrayugmena saṃpūjya naivedyādi yathākramam .. 27 ..
meaning:
कुंकुमेन समालभ्य पुष्पैर्धूपैः समर्चयेत् ..
वस्त्रयुग्मेन संपूज्य नैवेद्यादि यथाक्रमम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: Having smeared it with saffron, one should worship it with flowers and incense; / having worshipped it with a pair of garments, with food offerings and the like in due order,

sanskrit_iast:
tato dvijātipravaraḥ śrapayitvā caruṃ navam ..
tataścāgnyāhutīrdadyādbhūrbhuvaḥsvariti kramāt .. 28 ..
meaning:
ततो द्विजातिप्रवरः श्रपयित्वा चरुं नवम् ..
ततश्चाग्न्याहुतीर्दद्याद्भूर्भुवःस्वरिति क्रमात् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Then the foremost among twice-born, having cooked fresh sacrificial porridge, / should offer oblations into the fire in order, uttering 'Bhūr, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ'.

sanskrit_iast:
tataścāvāhayeddevaṃ varuṇaṃ saritāṃ patim ..
vāditraghoṣaigītaiśca gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
ततश्चावाहयेद्देवं वरुणं सरितां पतिम् ..
वादित्रघोषैगीतैश्च गन्धमाल्यानुलेपनैः .. 29 ..
text_mt: Then he should invoke the god Varuṇa, the lord of rivers, / with the sounds of musical instruments, songs, fragrances, garlands, and ointments.

sanskrit_iast:
śvetenaiva tu vastreṇa śiroveṣṭaṃ tu kārayet ..
ādāya tāmrapātrīṃ tu brahmaghoṣapuraḥsaraḥ .. 4.127.30 ..
meaning:
श्वेतेनैव तु वस्त्रेण शिरोवेष्टं तु कारयेत् ..
आदाय ताम्रपात्रीं तु ब्रह्मघोषपुरःसरः .. 4.127.30 ..
text_mt: He should wrap his head with a white cloth, / and taking a copper vessel, preceded by the chanting of the Veda,

sanskrit_iast:
apramāṇaṃ jalaṃ gatvā varuṇāya nivedayet ..
tvaṃ varuṇa iti maṃtreṇa jala madhye pravāhayet .. 31 ..
meaning:
अप्रमाणं जलं गत्वा वरुणाय निवेदयेत् ..
त्वं वरुण इति मंत्रेण जल मध्ये प्रवाहयेत् .. 31 ..
text_mt: he should enter fathomless water and offer it to Varuṇa, / setting it afloat into the middle of the water with the mantra: 'Thou art Varuṇa.'

sanskrit_iast:
yaccānyadvastrabījāni tatsarvaṃ majjayejjale ..
tārayecca tato dhenuṃ dakṣiṇāyā udagvrajet .. 32 ..
meaning:
यच्चान्यद्वस्त्रबीजानि तत्सर्वं मज्जयेज्जले ..
तारयेच्च ततो धेनुं दक्षिणाया उदग्व्रजेत् .. 32 ..
text_mt: Whatever else [there is], clothes and seeds, he should immerse all that into the water. / Then he should guide a cow across [the water], and go north of the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast:
gośiroveṣṭanaṃ kuryātsati vastre tu buddhimān ..
lāṃgalasyāgramādāya avatīrya tato jalam .. 33 ..
meaning:
गोशिरोवेष्टनं कुर्यात्सति वस्त्रे तु बुद्धिमान् ..
लांगलस्याग्रमादाय अवतीर्य ततो जलम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: The wise man should wrap the cow's head if cloth is available; / then, taking the tip of a plough, having entered the water,

sanskrit_iast:
jñātibhiḥ sahitaḥ kartā sabhāryaścāvagāhayet ..
tato'vatīrya salilāddattvā gāṃ brāhmaṇāya tām ..
śaktyā ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādevaṃ viprānvisarjayet .. 34 ..
meaning:
ज्ञातिभिः सहितः कर्ता सभार्यश्चावगाहयेत् ..
ततोऽवतीर्य सलिलाद्दत्त्वा गां ब्राह्मणाय ताम् ..
शक्त्या च दक्षिणां दद्यादेवं विप्रान्विसर्जयेत् .. 34 ..
text_mt: the patron, accompanied by his kinsmen and with his wife, should bathe. / Then, coming out of the water, having given that cow to a brāhmaṇa / and presented a sacrificial fee according to his means, he should dismiss the brāhmaṇas in this manner.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmānyaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo mayā dattamidaṃ jalam ..
evaṃ jalāñjaliṃ kṣiptvā pūjayejjalamātaraḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
सामान्यं सर्वभूतेभ्यो मया दत्तमिदं जलम् ..
एवं जलाञ्जलिं क्षिप्त्वा पूजयेज्जलमातरः .. 35 ..
text_mt: 'Common to all beings is this water given by me'— / having thus poured out a handful of water, he should worship the water-mothers.

sanskrit_iast:
toṣyāḥ karmakarāḥ sarve kuddālāni ca pūjayet ..
avāritaṃ tu dātavyaṃ mantrapūrvaṃ dinatrayam .. 36 ..
meaning:
तोष्याः कर्मकराः सर्वे कुद्दालानि च पूजयेत् ..
अवारितं तु दातव्यं मन्त्रपूर्वं दिनत्रयम् .. 36 ..
text_mt: All the labourers should be gratified, and he should worship the spades. / For three days, [food] preceded by mantras must be given without restriction;

sanskrit_iast:
ekāhaṃ ca yathāśaktyā vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet ..
gosahasraṃ tadardhaṃ vā tasyārdhamathavāpi vā .. 37 ..
meaning:
एकाहं च यथाशक्त्या वित्तशाठ्यं न कारयेत् ..
गोसहस्रं तदर्धं वा तस्यार्धमथवापि वा .. 37 ..
text_mt: or for one day according to one's means; one must not be miserly with wealth. / A thousand cows, or half of that, or half of that again,

sanskrit_iast:
śatamardhaśataṃ vāpi pañcaviṃśatimeva ca ..
tāsāmabhāve gāṃ dadyātsavatsāṃ kāṃsyadohanām .. 38 ..
meaning:
शतमर्धशतं वापि पञ्चविंशतिमेव च ..
तासामभावे गां दद्यात्सवत्सां कांस्यदोहनाम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: or a hundred, or fifty, or indeed twenty-five; / in their absence, he should give a cow with a calf and a bronze milking pail.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa rājaṃstaḍāgasya vidhiste parikīrtitaḥ ..
vāpīkūpavidhānaṃ ca kathayāmi tathā param .. 39 ..
meaning:
एष राजंस्तडागस्य विधिस्ते परिकीर्तितः ..
वापीकूपविधानं च कथयामि तथा परम् .. 39 ..
text_mt: This, O king, is the rule for a pond proclaimed to you. / Now I will likewise tell the procedure for a stepwell and an ordinary well, which is supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇḍamaṇḍapasaṃbhārabhūṣaṇācchādanādikam ..
taḍāgavidhivatkuryādyūpagotaraṇādikam .. 4.127.40 ..
meaning:
कुण्डमण्डपसंभारभूषणाच्छादनादिकम् ..
तडागविधिवत्कुर्याद्यूपगोतरणादिकम् .. 4.127.40 ..
text_mt: The preparation of sacrificial pit and pavilion, the adornments, coverings, and so forth, / as well as the sacrificial post, crossing with the cow, and the rest, he should perform according to the rule for a pond.

sanskrit_iast:
akālamūlānkalaśānvāpīkoṇeṣu dāpayet ..
tīrthodakasamāyuktānsitacandanacarcitān .. 41 ..
meaning:
अकालमूलान्कलशान्वापीकोणेषु दापयेत् ..
तीर्थोदकसमायुक्तान्सितचन्दनचर्चितान् .. 41 ..
text_mt: He should place pitchers without unseasonal roots at the corners of the stepwell, / filled with water from sacred fords and smeared with white sandalwood,

sanskrit_iast:
sitavāsoyugacchannānsamālyānratnagarbhiṇaḥ ..
śrapayitvā caruṃ tatra yāvanmātro yathāvidhi .. 42 ..
meaning:
सितवासोयुगच्छन्नान्समाल्यान्रत्नगर्भिणः ..
श्रपयित्वा चरुं तत्र यावन्मात्रो यथाविधि .. 42 ..
text_mt: covered with a pair of white cloths, adorned with garlands, containing jewels. / Having cooked sacrificial porridge there, according to proper measure and rule,

sanskrit_iast:
catasra āhutīrdadyādbhūrbhuvaḥ svariti kramāt ..
grahahomaṃ prakurvīta śāṃtipuṣṭivivarddhanam .. 43 ..
meaning:
चतस्र आहुतीर्दद्याद्भूर्भुवः स्वरिति क्रमात् ..
ग्रहहोमं प्रकुर्वीत शांतिपुष्टिविवर्द्धनम् .. 43 ..
text_mt: he should offer four oblations in order, uttering 'Bhūr, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ'. / He should perform the planet-oblation, which increases peace and prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
varuṇāya baliṃ dadyāllokapālebhya eva ca ..
vāruṇāni ca sūktāni paṭheyurddhijasattamāḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
वरुणाय बलिं दद्याल्लोकपालेभ्य एव च ..
वारुणानि च सूक्तानि पठेयुर्द्धिजसत्तमाः .. 44 ..
text_mt: He should present an offering to Varuṇa and to the world protectors; / and the best among the twice-born should recite the hymns to Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vedīmadhye maṃḍalaṃ ca padmamatra praśasyate ..
tanmadhye pūjaye cchaṃbhuṃ brahmāṇaṃ keśavaṃ tathā .. 45 ..
meaning:
वेदीमध्ये मंडलं च पद्ममत्र प्रशस्यते ..
तन्मध्ये पूजये च्छंभुं ब्रह्माणं केशवं तथा .. 45 ..
text_mt: In the middle of the altar a maṇḍala—a lotus here is praised; / in its centre he should worship Śambhu, Brahmā, and Keśava.

sanskrit_iast:
matsyakamaṭhamaṇḍūkānvedyā madhye'dhivāsayet ..
mitramitro'si bhūtānāṃ dhanado dhanakāṃkṣiṇām .. 46 ..
meaning:
मत्स्यकमठमण्डूकान्वेद्या मध्येऽधिवासयेत् ..
मित्रमित्रोऽसि भूतानां धनदो धनकांक्षिणाम् .. 46 ..
text_mt: He should consecrate fish, turtles, and frogs in the middle of the altar: / 'Thou art the friend of friends to living beings, the giver of wealth to seekers of wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
vaidyo rogābhibhūtānāṃ śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇārthinām ..
anenaiva hi maṃtreṇa varuṇāya visarjayet .. 47 ..
meaning:
वैद्यो रोगाभिभूतानां शरण्यः शरणार्थिनाम् ..
अनेनैव हि मंत्रेण वरुणाय विसर्जयेत् .. 47 ..
text_mt: the physician to those overcome by disease, the refuge of those seeking refuge.' / With this very mantra he should bid farewell to Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ādau cāvāhayeddevamanenaiva viśeṣataḥ ..
namaste viśvaguptāya namo viṣṇo apāṃpate .. 48 ..
meaning:
आदौ चावाहयेद्देवमनेनैव विशेषतः ..
नमस्ते विश्वगुप्ताय नमो विष्णो अपांपते .. 48 ..
text_mt: And at the beginning he should invoke the god especially with this [mantra]: / 'Homage to you, protector of the universe! Homage, O Viṣṇu, lord of waters!

sanskrit_iast:
sānnidhyaṃ kuru deveśa samudre yadvadatra vai ..
tatastu dakṣiṇā deyā brāhmaṇānāṃ narādhipa .. 49 ..
meaning:
सान्निध्यं कुरु देवेश समुद्रे यद्वदत्र वै ..
ततस्तु दक्षिणा देया ब्राह्मणानां नराधिप .. 49 ..
text_mt: Be present, O lord of gods, just as in the ocean here.' / Then the sacrificial fee should be given to the brāhmaṇas, O ruler of men;

sanskrit_iast:
gauḥ sthāpakāya dātavyā bhojanaṃ cānivāritam ..
sarveṣāmeva dātavyameṣa paurāṇiko vidhiḥ .. 4.127.50 ..
meaning:
गौः स्थापकाय दातव्या भोजनं चानिवारितम् ..
सर्वेषामेव दातव्यमेष पौराणिको विधिः .. 4.127.50 ..
text_mt: a cow should be given to the ritual master, and unrestricted food / must be given to everyone: this is the Purāṇic rule.

sanskrit_iast:
śarāyā āgataṃ toyaṃ sāmudraṃ prathamaṃ smṛtam ..
nipāne vā taḍāge vā saṃsthitaṃ tadbhavecchuci .. 51 ..
meaning:
शराया आगतं तोयं सामुद्रं प्रथमं स्मृतम् ..
निपाने वा तडागे वा संस्थितं तद्भवेच्छुचि .. 51 ..
text_mt: Water that comes from the ground is traditionally regarded as the first sea-water; / when collected in a watering reservoir or pond, that becomes pure.

sanskrit_iast:
vāpīkūpataḍāge vā sthitaṃ tu prathamaṃ jalam ..
apeyaṃ tu bhavetsarvaṃ tajjalaṃ sūtikāsamam .. 52 ..
meaning:
वापीकूपतडागे वा स्थितं तु प्रथमं जलम् ..
अपेयं तु भवेत्सर्वं तज्जलं सूतिकासमम् .. 52 ..
text_mt: The first water standing in a stepwell, ordinary well, or pond / is entirely undrinkable; that water is like a woman in childbed [impurity].

sanskrit_iast:
samudro'pi hi kauṃteya devayonirapāṃpatiḥ ..
kuśāgreṇāpi rabhasā na spṛṣṭavyastvasaṃskṛtaḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
समुद्रोऽपि हि कौंतेय देवयोनिरपांपतिः ..
कुशाग्रेणापि रभसा न स्पृष्टव्यस्त्वसंस्कृतः .. 53 ..
text_mt: Even the ocean, O son of Kuntī, divine-born and lord of waters, / must not be touched rashly even with the tip of a kuśa grass blade when unconsecrated.

sanskrit_iast:
agniśca tejo mṛḍayātha dehe retodhā viṣṇuramṛtasya nābhiḥ ..
evaṃ bruvanpāṃḍava satyavākyaṃ tatovagāheta patiṃ nadīnām .. 54 ..
meaning:
अग्निश्च तेजो मृडयाथ देहे रेतोधा विष्णुरमृतस्य नाभिः ..
एवं ब्रुवन्पांडव सत्यवाक्यं ततोवगाहेत पतिं नदीनाम् .. 54 ..
text_mt: 'Agni and splendour, bestow joy now in my body; seed-bearing Viṣṇu is the navel of immortality'— / uttering this true verse, O Pāṇḍava, he should then enter the lord of rivers.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇave māsi saṃprāpte nakṣatre vāruṇe tathā ..
arghyaṃ pradadyādbhaktyā tu tasminkāle mahodadheḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
वैष्णवे मासि संप्राप्ते नक्षत्रे वारुणे तथा ..
अर्घ्यं प्रदद्याद्भक्त्या तु तस्मिन्काले महोदधेः .. 55 ..
text_mt: When the Vaiṣṇava month has arrived, and likewise the Varuṇa lunar mansion, / at that time he should offer an arghya water offering with devotion to the great ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā tu vidhivanmaṃtraiḥ sāgare tu samāhitaḥ ..
phalamūlākṣatairbhakṣyaistathārghyaṃ saṃprakalpayet .. 56 ..
meaning:
स्नात्वा तु विधिवन्मंत्रैः सागरे तु समाहितः ..
फलमूलाक्षतैर्भक्ष्यैस्तथार्घ्यं संप्रकल्पयेत् .. 56 ..
text_mt: Having bathed according to rule with mantras, composed in mind at the ocean, / he should prepare the arghya with fruits, roots, unbroken grains, and edible treats.

sanskrit_iast:
api janmasahasraṃ tu yatpāpaṃ kurute naraḥ ..
mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ snātvā tu lavaṇāṃbhasi .. 57 ..
meaning:
अपि जन्मसहस्रं तु यत्पापं कुरुते नरः ..
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यः स्नात्वा तु लवणांभसि .. 57 ..
text_mt: Even whatever sin a man commits over a thousand lifetimes, / he is freed from all sins upon bathing in the salty water.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhijñena tu kartavyaṃ brāhmaṇena yathāvidhi ..
kartā kārayitā caiva ubhau tu svargagāminau .. 58 ..
meaning:
विधिज्ञेन तु कर्तव्यं ब्राह्मणेन यथाविधि ..
कर्ता कारयिता चैव उभौ तु स्वर्गगामिनौ .. 58 ..
text_mt: It should be performed according to rule by a brāhmaṇa who knows the ritual; / both the patron and the officiating priest go to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhiṃ tvenamajānāno yaḥ kuryādarthamohitaḥ ..
kartā kārayitā caiva ubhau narakagāminau .. 59 ...
meaning:
विधिं त्वेनमजानानो यः कुर्यादर्थमोहितः ..
कर्ता कारयिता चैव उभौ नरकगामिनौ .. 59 ...
text_mt: However, he who, ignorant of this rule, performs it deluded by wealth— / both the patron and the officiating priest go to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
yo na kārayate śāṃtiṃ taḍāgādyeṣu karmasu ..
tasya tanniṣphalaṃ sarvamuptaṃ bījamivoṣare .. 4.127.60 ..
meaning:
यो न कारयते शांतिं तडागाद्येषु कर्मसु ..
तस्य तन्निष्फलं सर्वमुप्तं बीजमिवोषरे .. 4.127.60 ..
text_mt: He who does not have an appeasement rite performed in rituals such as [excavating] ponds, / for him it is all fruitless, like seed sown in barren soil.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaratnamayaṃ divyaṃ candrārkasadṛśaprabham ..
vimānaṃ tejasā yuktamārohetpuṇyakarmakṛt .. 61 ..
meaning:
सर्वरत्नमयं दिव्यं चन्द्रार्कसदृशप्रभम् ..
विमानं तेजसा युक्तमारोहेत्पुण्यकर्मकृत् .. 61 ..
text_mt: Made of all kinds of jewels, divine, possessing splendour like the moon and sun, / endowed with brilliance, a maker of meritorious deeds ascends a celestial chariot.

sanskrit_iast:
kaścitpibati tattoyaṃ nipānasthaṃ tato'ñjalim ..
brāhmaṇo vā yatirgaurvā yena kartā na sīdati ..62...
meaning:
कश्चित्पिबति तत्तोयं निपानस्थं ततोऽञ्जलिम् ..
ब्राह्मणो वा यतिर्गौर्वा येन कर्ता न सीदति ..62...
text_mt: If someone drinks that water standing in a watering reservoir with his hollowed hands— / whether a brāhmaṇa, an ascetic, or a cow—thereby the patron does not perish.

sanskrit_iast:
utsṛṣṭe kṛtakṛtyastu suhṛtkuryānmahotsavam ..
mahābhojyaṃ mahotsargaṃ yajamāno dināṣṭakam .. 63 ..
meaning:
उत्सृष्टे कृतकृत्यस्तु सुहृत्कुर्यान्महोत्सवम् ..
महाभोज्यं महोत्सर्गं यजमानो दिनाष्टकम् .. 63 ..
text_mt: When it has been consecrated, the patron, having accomplished his purpose, should hold a great festival for his friends, / [giving] lavish food and large gifts for eight days.

sanskrit_iast:
kārakāḥ karmaṇo vāpi sūtradhārādayo narāḥ ..
iṣṭāpūrtena dharmeṇa te'pi svargaṃ prayāṃti hi .. 64 ..
meaning:
कारकाः कर्मणो वापि सूत्रधारादयो नराः ..
इष्टापूर्तेन धर्मेण तेऽपि स्वर्गं प्रयांति हि .. 64 ..
text_mt: The workers on the project, too, artisans and other men, / through the virtue of public works also go to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
khanyamāne mahībhāge prāṇino ye kṣayaṃ gatāḥ ..
citre vā devakūṭārthe te sarve tridivaṃ gatāḥ .. .. 65 ..
meaning:
खन्यमाने महीभागे प्राणिनो ये क्षयं गताः ..
चित्रे वा देवकूटार्थे ते सर्वे त्रिदिवं गताः .. .. 65 ..
text_mt: The living beings that were destroyed while the plot of ground was being excavated / for a wonderful temple spire, all of them have gone to the third heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
dhenostu romakūpāṇi yāvantīha narottama ..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi varṣakoṭiśatāni ca .. 66 ..
meaning:
धेनोस्तु रोमकूपाणि यावन्तीह नरोत्तम ..
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि वर्षकोटिशतानि च .. 66 ..
text_mt: As many hair-follicles as a cow has here, O best of men, / for that many thousands of years, and hundreds of crores of years,

sanskrit_iast:
koṭiryugasahasrāṇāṃ svarge tiṣṭhettaḍāgakṛt ..
cettasyapitaraḥ kecinnarakaṃ samupāgatāḥ .. 67 ..
meaning:
कोटिर्युगसहस्राणां स्वर्गे तिष्ठेत्तडागकृत् ..
चेत्तस्यपितरः केचिन्नरकं समुपागताः .. 67 ..
text_mt: a crore of thousands of yugas, the maker of a pond dwells in heaven. / If any of his ancestors have gone to hell,

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃstu tārayate sarvānātmānaṃ ca mahīpate ..
āsphoṭayaṃti pitaro valgaṃti prapitāmahāḥ .. 68 ..
meaning:
तांस्तु तारयते सर्वानात्मानं च महीपते ..
आस्फोटयंति पितरो वल्गंति प्रपितामहाः .. 68 ..
text_mt: he delivers all of them and himself, O lord of the earth! / The ancestors clap their hands, the great-grandfathers leap with joy:

sanskrit_iast:
api naḥ sa kule jāto yastaḍāgaṃ kariṣyati ..
sarvasvenāpi kauṃteya bhūmiṣṭhamudakaṃ kuru ..69..
meaning:
अपि नः स कुले जातो यस्तडागं करिष्यति ..
सर्वस्वेनापि कौंतेय भूमिष्ठमुदकं कुरु ..69..
text_mt: 'Has he indeed been born in our family, who will construct a pond?' / Even with all your possessions, O son of Kuntī, establish water on the earth!

sanskrit_iast:
kulāni tārayetsapta yatra gaurvitṛṣī bhavet ..
evaṃ varṣaśatenāpi kṛttikā viharīvane..4.127.70..
meaning:
कुलानि तारयेत्सप्त यत्र गौर्वितृषी भवेत् ..
एवं वर्षशतेनापि कृत्तिका विहरीवने..4.127.70..
text_mt: He delivers seven generations [at any place] where a cow's thirst is quenched. / Thus, even for a hundred years Kṛttikā sports in the grove;

sanskrit_iast:
māsaṃ cetāgṛhe koṭikṣaṇadhvaṃsidhanasya hi..
taḍāgaṃ devabhavanaṃ vāpīvṛkṣoghanacchadaḥ..71..
meaning:
मासं चेतागृहे कोटिक्षणध्वंसिधनस्य हि..
तडागं देवभवनं वापीवृक्षोघनच्छदः..71..
text_mt: or for a month in the house of one with wealth that perishes in a moment—a crore [of blessings]. / A pond, a divine abode, a stepwell, and a dense-foliaged tree [bring lasting fruit].

sanskrit_iast:
caturthakaṃ phalaṃ prāptaṃ kārite'smiṃścatuṣṭaye..
yathā mātuḥ samācaṣṭe putraḥ śīlaṃ svakairguṇaiḥ..72..
meaning:
चतुर्थकं फलं प्राप्तं कारितेऽस्मिंश्चतुष्टये..
यथा मातुः समाचष्टे पुत्रः शीलं स्वकैर्गुणैः..72..
text_mt: A fourth part of the fruit is obtained when this group of four is caused to be made. / Just as a son reveals his mother's character by his own qualities,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā svādena ca jalaṃ kartuḥ sarvaṃ śubhāśubham..
ataḥ śubhāgataṃ dravyaṃ taḍāgādiṣu lāpayet ..73..
meaning:
तथा स्वादेन च जलं कर्तुः सर्वं शुभाशुभम्..
अतः शुभागतं द्रव्यं तडागादिषु लापयेत् ..73..
text_mt: So does the water, by its taste, reveal all the good and bad of its maker. / Therefore, one should apply wealth obtained through righteous means to ponds and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyasya pāṃthāḥ saṃprāpya taḍāgaṃ vṛkṣamaṃḍitam ..
pītvāpaḥ pādapatale viśramaṃti ramaṃti ca ..74 ..
meaning:
धन्यस्य पांथाः संप्राप्य तडागं वृक्षमंडितम् ..
पीत्वापः पादपतले विश्रमंति रमंति च ..74 ..
text_mt: Travellers, having reached the pond of a blessed man, adorned with trees, / Having drunk the water, rest and take delight beneath the foot of the trees.

sanskrit_iast:
mārutodbhūtavīcyagraiḥ karaiḥ kamalamaṃḍitam ..
abhyāgatāya sudhiyā taḍāgādyaṃ prakalpitam .. 75 ..
meaning:
मारुतोद्भूतवीच्यग्रैः करैः कमलमंडितम् ..
अभ्यागताय सुधिया तडागाद्यं प्रकल्पितम् .. 75 ..
text_mt: Adorned with lotuses by hands [in the form of] wind-raised tips of waves, / The pond and such were fashioned by the wise man for the guest who has arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmānyaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yena bhūmigataṃ jalam ..
tāritaṃ kāritaṃ tena suputreṇa kuladvayam .. 76 ..
meaning:
सामान्यं सर्वभूतेभ्यो येन भूमिगतं जलम् ..
तारितं कारितं तेन सुपुत्रेण कुलद्वयम् .. 76 ..
text_mt: By whom water residing in the earth has been made common to all living beings, / By that good son, having caused it to be made, both lineages are delivered.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtaṃ svabhāvataḥ siddhamiṣṭaṃ mantrapradarśitam ..
iṣṭāpūrte kṛte rājankṛtakṛtyaḥ pumānbhavet .. 77 ..
meaning:
मूर्तं स्वभावतः सिद्धमिष्टं मन्त्रप्रदर्शितम् ..
इष्टापूर्ते कृते राजन्कृतकृत्यः पुमान्भवेत् .. 77 ..
text_mt: Pūrta is physical, accomplished by its very nature; iṣṭa is taught by mantras. / When iṣṭa and pūrta are performed, O king, a man becomes one who has fulfilled his duties.

sanskrit_iast:
unnatā vātha nimnā vā kīrtiryena prakāśitā ..
tena trailokya candreṇa jananī pārtha putriṇī ..78..
meaning:
उन्नता वाथ निम्ना वा कीर्तिर्येन प्रकाशिता ..
तेन त्रैलोक्य चन्द्रेण जननी पार्थ पुत्रिणी ..78..
text_mt: Whether high or low, by whom fame is illuminated, / By him, a moon for the three worlds, O Pārtha, a mother has truly borne a son.

sanskrit_iast:
tritayaṃ nighnatāṃ neyaṃ tritayaṃ connatiṃ parām ..
taḍāgamatha yo bhūmau deva devālayaṃkṛtī ..79..
meaning:
त्रितयं निघ्नतां नेयं त्रितयं चोन्नतिं पराम् ..
तडागमथ यो भूमौ देव देवालयंकृती ..79..
text_mt: Three things should be brought to ruin, and three should be raised to supreme heights. / Now, he who makes a pond on earth, being a maker of temples of the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ kārayati loke'sminkīrtistasyāmalā bhavet ..
sa jīvati sa evaikaḥ sa bhavedajarāmaraḥ .. 4.127.80 ..
meaning:
यः कारयति लोकेऽस्मिन्कीर्तिस्तस्यामला भवेत् ..
स जीवति स एवैकः स भवेदजरामरः .. 4.127.80 ..
text_mt: He who causes one to be made in this world, his fame becomes spotless. / He lives, he alone, and he becomes free from old age and death.

sanskrit_iast:
upetānāmapi divaṃ sa nibandhavidhāyinām ..
āsta eva nirātaṃkaṃ tasya kīrtimayaṃ vapuḥ .. 81 ..
meaning:
उपेतानामपि दिवं स निबन्धविधायिनाम् ..
आस्त एव निरातंकं तस्य कीर्तिमयं वपुः .. 81 ..
text_mt: Even when they have gone to heaven, for those who institute such endowments, / His body, made of fame, remains indeed free from affliction.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvatsvarge sa ramate yāvatkīrtiranaśvarā ..
tāvattvilāyāmadhyāste sukṛtī vaibudhaṃ padam .. 82 ..
meaning:
तावत्स्वर्गे स रमते यावत्कीर्तिरनश्वरा ..
तावत्त्विलायामध्यास्ते सुकृती वैबुधं पदम् .. 82 ..
text_mt: So long does he rejoice in heaven as his fame remains imperishable; / So long, too, does the virtuous man dwell on earth in the divine station.

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsāsyakṣiptanīlyagraṃ padminīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitam ..
pīyamānaṃ mahāgrāmairdhanyāḥ paśyaṃti svaṃ saraḥ .. 83 ..
meaning:
हंसास्यक्षिप्तनील्यग्रं पद्मिनीखण्डमण्डितम् ..
पीयमानं महाग्रामैर्धन्याः पश्यंति स्वं सरः .. 83 ..
text_mt: Blessed men see their own lake being drunk from by great villages, / With tips of blue water-lilies cast into the beaks of swans, adorned with clusters of lotus plants.

sanskrit_iast:
ghaṭairañjalibhirvaktrairyasya vāṭīpuṭairjalam ..
pibaṃti jaṃtavaḥ sarve kimanyattasya varṇyate.. 84 ..
meaning:
घटैरञ्जलिभिर्वक्त्रैर्यस्य वाटीपुटैर्जलम् ..
पिबंति जंतवः सर्वे किमन्यत्तस्य वर्ण्यते.. 84 ..
text_mt: Whose water all creatures drink with jars, with folded hands, with their mouths, / And with leaf-cups from garden enclosures—what more can be said in praise of him?

sanskrit_iast:
taḍāgaṃ nagaropāṃte dhanyasya kila jāyate ..
ubhayorarthasaṃsiddhirdṛṣṭā karturjanasya ca .. 85 ..
meaning:
तडागं नगरोपांते धन्यस्य किल जायते ..
उभयोरर्थसंसिद्धिर्दृष्टा कर्तुर्जनस्य च .. 85 ..
text_mt: Truly, a pond on the outskirts of a city belongs to a blessed man; / The attainment of purpose of both is seen: of the maker and of the people.

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣāṃ devakulaṃ tattu niṣpadyeta sarastaṭe ..
abhīṣṭadevatāyuktaṃ teṣāṃ pārtha kimucyate .. 86 ..
meaning:
येषां देवकुलं तत्तु निष्पद्येत सरस्तटे ..
अभीष्टदेवतायुक्तं तेषां पार्थ किमुच्यते .. 86 ..
text_mt: Indeed, for those on the bank of whose lake a temple of the gods is constructed, / Endowed with their chosen deity, what can be said of them, O Pārtha?

sanskrit_iast:
na bhavaṃtīṣṭikā yāvaddroṇī vā bhūmisannibhā ..
svarge mahīyate tāvatkārako devaveśmanaḥ .. 87 ..
meaning:
न भवंतीष्टिका यावद्द्रोणी वा भूमिसन्निभा ..
स्वर्गे महीयते तावत्कारको देववेश्मनः .. 87 ..
text_mt: As long as the bricks or the trough do not become level with the earth, / So long is the maker of a house of God glorified in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
bhogyasthāne kṛtaḥ kūpaḥ susvādusalilastathā ..
dṛḍharajjusamāyuktaḥ punātyāsaptamaṃ kulam .. 88 ..
meaning:
भोग्यस्थाने कृतः कूपः सुस्वादुसलिलस्तथा ..
दृढरज्जुसमायुक्तः पुनात्यासप्तमं कुलम् .. 88 ..
text_mt: Likewise, a well constructed in a frequented place, having very sweet water / And equipped with a strong rope, purifies the family up to the seventh generation.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya svādujalaṃ kūpe pibaṃti satataṃ janāḥ ..
kiṃ tena na kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ savasattvopakāriṇā ..89..
meaning:
यस्य स्वादुजलं कूपे पिबंति सततं जनाः ..
किं तेन न कृतं पुण्यं सवसत्त्वोपकारिणा ..89..
text_mt: From whose well people constantly drink sweet water, / What merit has not been acquired by him, who benefits all living beings?

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ prāsādānracayati śubhāndevatānāṃ taḍāge kīrtistasya bhramati vipulā vaṃśamārgānuyātā ..
divyānbhogānbhajati ca sadā kārakaścāprameyānbhuktvā saukhyaṃ punarapi ca bhaveccakravartī pṛthivyām .. 4.127.90 ..
meaning:
यः प्रासादान्रचयति शुभान्देवतानां तडागे कीर्तिस्तस्य भ्रमति विपुला वंशमार्गानुयाता ..
दिव्यान्भोगान्भजति च सदा कारकश्चाप्रमेयान्भुक्त्वा सौख्यं पुनरपि च भवेच्चक्रवर्ती पृथिव्याम् .. 4.127.90 ..
text_mt: He who constructs auspicious temples of the deities at a pond, his vast fame roams about, following the course of his lineage; / And the maker constantly enjoys divine and immeasurable pleasures; having enjoyed happiness, he becomes an emperor again on earth.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ taḍāgāni bahūdakāni kūpāśca yūpāśca pratiśrayāśca ..
annapradānaṃ madhurā ca vāṇī yamasya te nirvacanī bhavaṃti .. 91 .. ..
meaning:
तेषां तडागानि बहूदकानि कूपाश्च यूपाश्च प्रतिश्रयाश्च ..
अन्नप्रदानं मधुरा च वाणी यमस्य ते निर्वचनी भवंति .. 91 .. ..
text_mt: Those whose ponds have abundant water, and who have wells, sacrificial posts, rest-houses, / Giving of food, and sweet speech—they become beyond the reproach of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde vāpīkūpataḍāgotsargavidhivarṇanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 127 .. ..
vṛkṣodyāpanavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराण उत्तरपर्वणि श्रीकृष्णयुधिष्ठिरसंवादे वापीकूपतडागोत्सर्गविधिवर्णनं नाम सप्तविंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 127 .. ..
वृक्षोद्यापनविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-seventh chapter, entitled “Description of the Rite of Dedication of Stepwells, Wells, and Ponds,” in the dialogue between Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Yudhiṣṭhira, in the Uttaraparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the rite of concluding the observance of [planting] trees.

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
vṛkṣāropaṇamāhātmyaṃ vada devakinandana ..
udyāpanavidhiṃ caiva sarahasyaṃ samāsataḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
वृक्षारोपणमाहात्म्यं वद देवकिनन्दन ..
उद्यापनविधिं चैव सरहस्यं समासतः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Speak of the greatness of planting trees, O son of Devakī, / And the rite of concluding the observance, together with its esoteric meaning, in brief.
title: adhyāyaḥ 128

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
varaṃ bhūmiruhāḥ pañca nagakāṣṭharuhā daśa ..
patraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalairmūlaiḥ kurvaṃti pitṛtarpaṇam .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
वरं भूमिरुहाः पञ्च नगकाष्ठरुहा दश ..
पत्रैः पुष्पैः फलैर्मूलैः कुर्वंति पितृतर्पणम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Better are five plants that grow from the earth, ten that grow from mountain wood; / With their leaves, flowers, fruits, and roots, they offer satisfaction to the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
bahubhirmṛtakiñjātaiḥ putrairdharmārthavarjitaiḥ ..
varameke pathitaruryatra viśramate janaḥ ..3..
meaning:
बहुभिर्मृतकिञ्जातैः पुत्रैर्धर्मार्थवर्जितैः ..
वरमेके पथितरुर्यत्र विश्रमते जनः ..3..
text_mt: Better than many sons who turn out to be like the dead, devoid of righteousness and wealth, / Is a single roadside tree where people take their rest.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇinaḥ prīṇayaṃti sma cchāyāvalkalapallavaiḥ ..
ghanacchadāḥ sutaravaḥ puṣpairdevānphalaiḥ pitṝn ..4..
meaning:
प्राणिनः प्रीणयंति स्म च्छायावल्कलपल्लवैः ..
घनच्छदाः सुतरवः पुष्पैर्देवान्फलैः पितॄन् ..4..
text_mt: Good trees of dense foliage gratify living creatures with their shade, bark, and shoots, / The gods with their flowers, and the ancestors with their fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpapatraphalacchāyāmūlavalkaladārubhiḥ ..
dhanyā mahīruhā yeṣāṃ viphalā yāṃti nārthinaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
पुष्पपत्रफलच्छायामूलवल्कलदारुभिः ..
धन्या महीरुहा येषां विफला यांति नार्थिनः .. 5 ..
text_mt: With flowers, leaves, fruits, shade, roots, bark, and timber, / Blessed are the trees of the earth, from which seekers do not depart disappointed.

sanskrit_iast:
putrāḥ saṃvatsarasyāṃte śrāddhaṃ kurvaṃti vā na vā ..
pratyahaṃ pādapāḥ puṣṭiṃ śreyo'rthaṃ janayaṃti hi .. 6 ..
meaning:
पुत्राः संवत्सरस्यांते श्राद्धं कुर्वंति वा न वा ..
प्रत्यहं पादपाः पुष्टिं श्रेयोऽर्थं जनयंति हि .. 6 ..
text_mt: Sons may or may not perform a śrāddha at the end of the year; / But trees produce nourishment every day for the sake of the highest good.

sanskrit_iast:
na tatkarotyagnihotraṃ sukhaṃ yadyoṣitaḥ sutaḥ ..
yatkaroti ghanacchāyaḥ pādapaḥ pathi ropitaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
न तत्करोत्यग्निहोत्रं सुखं यद्योषितः सुतः ..
यत्करोति घनच्छायः पादपः पथि रोपितः .. 7 ..
text_mt: The agnihotra does not bring that happiness, nor does a woman’s son, / Which a densely shaded tree planted on a road brings.

sanskrit_iast:
sacchāyā ca sapuṣpā ca saphalā vṛkṣavāṭikā ..
kulayoṣeva bhavati bhartṛlokadvayānugā .. 8 ..
meaning:
सच्छाया च सपुष्पा च सफला वृक्षवाटिका ..
कुलयोषेव भवति भर्तृलोकद्वयानुगा .. 8 ..
text_mt: An orchard of trees having shade, flowers, and fruit / Is like a high-born wife, following her husband to both worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
aśokaphalāvakarā tilakālaṃkṛtānanā ..
sarvopabhoga veśyeva vāṭikā rasikā sadā .. 9 ..
meaning:
अशोकफलावकरा तिलकालंकृतानना ..
सर्वोपभोग वेश्येव वाटिका रसिका सदा .. 9 ..
text_mt: With a shower of aśoka fruits, her face adorned with a tilaka mark, / An orchard is always delightful, like a courtesan of all enjoyments.

sanskrit_iast:
sadā sa tīrthī bhavati sadā dānaṃ prayacchati ..
sadā yajñaṃ sa yajate yo ropayati pādapam .. .. 4.128.10 ..
meaning:
सदा स तीर्थी भवति सदा दानं प्रयच्छति ..
सदा यज्ञं स यजते यो रोपयति पादपम् .. .. 4.128.10 ..
text_mt: He constantly visits sacred fords, he constantly gives gifts, / He constantly offers sacrifices—he who plants a tree.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvatthamekaṃ picumaṃdamekaṃ nyagrodhamekaṃ daśa ciñciṇīkān..
kapitthabilvāmalakītrayaṃ ca pañcāmravāpī narakaṃ na paśyet .. 11 ..
meaning:
अश्वत्थमेकं पिचुमंदमेकं न्यग्रोधमेकं दश चिञ्चिणीकान्..
कपित्थबिल्वामलकीत्रयं च पञ्चाम्रवापी नरकं न पश्येत् .. 11 ..
text_mt: One who plants one aśvattha, one picumarda, one nyagrodha, ten tamarinds, / Three kapitthas, bilvas, and āmalakīs, and five mangoes, shall not see hell.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpopagaṃdhāḍhyaphalopagandhaṃ yaḥ pādapaṃ sparśayate dvijāya ..
sa strīsamṛddhaṃ vahuratnapūrṇaṃ labhedvimānapratimaṃ gṛhaṃ vai .. 12 ..
meaning:
पुष्पोपगंधाढ्यफलोपगन्धं यः पादपं स्पर्शयते द्विजाय ..
स स्त्रीसमृद्धं वहुरत्नपूर्णं लभेद्विमानप्रतिमं गृहं वै .. 12 ..
text_mt: He who dedicates to a twice-born a tree rich in flowers, fragrance, and scented fruits / Attains indeed a house filled with women, brimming with many jewels, resembling a celestial chariot.

sanskrit_iast:
pratiśrayāśrānta samāśrayatvātsamīhitaṃ tatra phalaṃ bubhukṣoḥ ..
apatyamekaṃ paralokahetorvimṛśyatāṃ kiṃ taravo na ropitāḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
प्रतिश्रयाश्रान्त समाश्रयत्वात्समीहितं तत्र फलं बुभुक्षोः ..
अपत्यमेकं परलोकहेतोर्विमृश्यतां किं तरवो न रोपिताः .. 13 ..
text_mt: From being a haven for those who are weary, a desired fruit is attained there for one who wishes to enjoy; / Reflecting that a single child is for the sake of the other world, why are trees not planted?

sanskrit_iast:
na khānitāḥ puṣkariṇyo ropitā na mahīruhāḥ ..
māturyauvanacaureṇa tena jātena kiṃ kṛtam .. 14 ..
meaning:
न खानिताः पुष्करिण्यो रोपिता न महीरुहाः ..
मातुर्यौवनचौरेण तेन जातेन किं कृतम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Lotus-ponds were not excavated, trees of the earth were not planted— / What was accomplished by that son who was born merely as a thief of his mother’s youth?

sanskrit_iast:
chāyāmanyasya kurvaṃti tiṣṭhaṃti svayamātape ..
phalaṃti ca parārtheṣu na svārtheṣu mahādrumāḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
छायामन्यस्य कुर्वंति तिष्ठंति स्वयमातपे ..
फलंति च परार्थेषु न स्वार्थेषु महाद्रुमाः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Great trees provide shade for others while standing in the heat themselves; / And they bear fruit for the sake of others, not for their own sake.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi vṛkṣasyodyāpane vidhim ..
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvakīrtivivarddhanam .. 16 ..
meaning:
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि वृक्षस्योद्यापने विधिम् ..
सर्वपापप्रशमनं सर्वकीर्तिविवर्द्धनम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: Hereafter I shall proclaim the rite of concluding the observance of a tree, / Which pacifies all sins and increases all fame.

sanskrit_iast:
aputrayā purā pārtha pārvatyā mandarācale ..
aśokaḥ śokaśamanaḥ putratve parikalpitaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
अपुत्रया पुरा पार्थ पार्वत्या मन्दराचले ..
अशोकः शोकशमनः पुत्रत्वे परिकल्पितः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Formerly, O Pārtha, an aśoka tree, the remover of grief, was adopted as a son / On Mount Mandara by Pārvatī, who was childless.

sanskrit_iast:
jātakarmādikāstasya yāḥ kriyāḥ kila buddhiman ..
carakātripurāṇoktāstāḥ śṛṇuṣva yudhiṣṭhira .. 18 ..
meaning:
जातकर्मादिकास्तस्य याः क्रियाः किल बुद्धिमन् ..
चरकात्रिपुराणोक्तास्ताः शृणुष्व युधिष्ठिर .. 18 ..
text_mt: Listen, O wise Yudhiṣṭhira, to those rites of his beginning with the birth-ceremony / Which are stated in Caraka, Atri, and the Purāṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
tato mūle ghanadalo valgucchāyāṃgapallavaḥ ..
śītavātātapasahaḥ saṃskāryastaruṇastaruḥ .. 19..
meaning:
ततो मूले घनदलो वल्गुच्छायांगपल्लवः ..
शीतवातातपसहः संस्कार्यस्तरुणस्तरुः .. 19..
text_mt: Then, at its base, the young tree, dense with leaves, having charming shade, branches, and shoots, / Capable of enduring cold, wind, and heat, is to be consecrated.

sanskrit_iast:
strīnāmakaṃṭakīkubjakīṭavṛścikakoṭaraḥ ..
nodyāpyaḥ pādapaḥ pārtha śiṣṭānāṃ yo na saṃmataḥ .. 4.128.20 ..
meaning:
स्त्रीनामकंटकीकुब्जकीटवृश्चिककोटरः ..
नोद्याप्यः पादपः पार्थ शिष्टानां यो न संमतः .. 4.128.20 ..
text_mt: A tree with a feminine name, thorny, crooked, or with insects, scorpions, and hollows, / Which is not approved of by the virtuous, O Pārtha, should not be consecrated.

sanskrit_iast:
ālavāle suvihite śubhe baddhacatuṣkike ..
śodhayitvā tamuddeśaṃ suguptaṃ kārayettataḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
आलवाले सुविहिते शुभे बद्धचतुष्किके ..
शोधयित्वा तमुद्देशं सुगुप्तं कारयेत्ततः .. 21 ..
text_mt: When a basin has been well constructed, auspicious and framed with four sides, / he should cleanse that area and then have it well protected.

sanskrit_iast:
sadaivodyāpanaṃ pārtha pādapānāṃ praśasyate ..
śubhe'hni viprakathite grahanakṣatrasaṃyute .. 22 ..
meaning:
सदैवोद्यापनं पार्थ पादपानां प्रशस्यते ..
शुभेऽह्नि विप्रकथिते ग्रहनक्षत्रसंयुते .. 22 ..
text_mt: The consecration rite of trees is praised at all times, O Pārtha, / on an auspicious day declared by a brāhmaṇa, endowed with [favourable] planets and lunar asterisms.

sanskrit_iast:
patākālaṃkṛtaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pūrvedyuradhivāsayet ..
raktavastraiḥ samācchādya raktasūtreṇa veṣṭayet ..23..
meaning:
पताकालंकृतं वृक्षं पूर्वेद्युरधिवासयेत् ..
रक्तवस्त्रैः समाच्छाद्य रक्तसूत्रेण वेष्टयेत् ..23..
text_mt: On the previous day he should perform preliminary consecration upon the tree adorned with flags; / covering it with red garments, he should bind it with a red thread.

sanskrit_iast:
piṣṭātakenāvakiretsarvauṣadhyā ca pādapam ..
sthāpayetpūrṇakalaśāṃścaturdikṣu vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
पिष्टातकेनावकिरेत्सर्वौषध्या च पादपम् ..
स्थापयेत्पूर्णकलशांश्चतुर्दिक्षु विचक्षणः .. 24 ..
text_mt: He should sprinkle the tree with fragrant cosmetic powder and all herbs; / the wise man should set down full water-jars in the four directions,

sanskrit_iast:
pallavālaṃkṛtamukhānsitacandanacarcitān ..
sitavāsoyugacchannānsakalānratnagarbhiṇaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
पल्लवालंकृतमुखान्सितचन्दनचर्चितान् ..
सितवासोयुगच्छन्नान्सकलान्रत्नगर्भिणः .. 25 ..
text_mt: their mouths adorned with shoots, smeared with white sandalwood, / draped with a pair of white cloths, complete and containing jewels inside.

sanskrit_iast:
patākālaṃkṛtāḥ sarve kāryāstatsannidhau drumāḥ ..
mūlavinyastakalaśā raktasūtrāvaguṇṭhitāḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
पताकालंकृताः सर्वे कार्यास्तत्सन्निधौ द्रुमाः ..
मूलविन्यस्तकलशा रक्तसूत्रावगुण्ठिताः .. 26 ..
text_mt: All the trees near it must be adorned with flags, / jars placed at their roots, veiled with red threads,

sanskrit_iast:
raktapītasitācchādaiścarcitāḥ sumanoharaiḥ ..
kaladhautamayānyatra phalāni daśa paṃca vā .. 27 ..
meaning:
रक्तपीतसिताच्छादैश्चर्चिताः सुमनोहरैः ..
कलधौतमयान्यत्र फलानि दश पंच वा .. 27 ..
text_mt: anointed, [draped] with highly charming red, yellow, and white coverings; / there [he should prepare] ten or five fruits made of gold

sanskrit_iast:
tāmrapātryāṃ sabījāni saralānyadhivāsayet ..
tūryamaṅgalaghoṣeṇa caturdikṣu kṣipedbalim .. 28 ..
meaning:
ताम्रपात्र्यां सबीजानि सरलान्यधिवासयेत् ..
तूर्यमङ्गलघोषेण चतुर्दिक्षु क्षिपेद्बलिम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: and consecrate them, straight and containing seeds, in a copper vessel. / To the sound of musical instruments and auspicious chants he should cast the offering in the four directions

sanskrit_iast:
indrādilokapālebhyo bhūtebhyo maṃtravidguruḥ ..
tataḥ prabhāte vimale kuṃḍaṃ kṛtvā samekhalam .. 29 ..
meaning:
इन्द्रादिलोकपालेभ्यो भूतेभ्यो मंत्रविद्गुरुः ..
ततः प्रभाते विमले कुंडं कृत्वा समेखलम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: to the world protectors headed by Indra and to the ghosts, the guru knowing the mantras. / Then, at clear dawn, having constructed a sacrificial pit with girdles,

sanskrit_iast:
grahayajñavidhānena śāṃtikarma samārabhet ..
suvarṇālaṃkṛtānkṛtvā brāhmaṇānvedapāragān .. 4.128.30 ..
meaning:
ग्रहयज्ञविधानेन शांतिकर्म समारभेत् ..
सुवर्णालंकृतान्कृत्वा ब्राह्मणान्वेदपारगान् .. 4.128.30 ..
text_mt: he should commence the rite of pacification according to the rules of planetary sacrifice, / having adorned with gold brāhmaṇas who have mastered the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
caturo'ṣṭau yathāśaktyā vāsobhirabhipūjayet ..
tilājyena ca homaḥ syāttuṣṭipuṣṭikaraḥ sadā .. 31 ..
meaning:
चतुरोऽष्टौ यथाशक्त्या वासोभिरभिपूजयेत् ..
तिलाज्येन च होमः स्यात्तुष्टिपुष्टिकरः सदा .. 31 ..
text_mt: According to his capacity he should honour four or eight with garments, / and the oblation should be made with sesame and ghee, always bringing contentment and prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
mātaraṃ sthāpayitvāgre pūjayetkusumākṣataiḥ ..
śrapayitvā caruṃ samyakpāyasādyapariplutam .. 32 ..
meaning:
मातरं स्थापयित्वाग्रे पूजयेत्कुसुमाक्षतैः ..
श्रपयित्वा चरुं सम्यक्पायसाद्यपरिप्लुतम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: Having placed the Mother in front, he should worship her with flowers and unbroken grains, / having properly cooked the sacrificial porridge steeped in milk-rice and other delicacies.

sanskrit_iast:
homādau jātakarmādi godānaṃ yāvadeva tu ..
pādapaṃ snāpayitvā tu samaṃtraistīrthavāribhiḥ..33..
meaning:
होमादौ जातकर्मादि गोदानं यावदेव तु ..
पादपं स्नापयित्वा तु समंत्रैस्तीर्थवारिभिः..33..
text_mt: Beginning with the fire offering, the birth rites up through the gift of a cow [should be done]; / having bathed the tree with consecrated waters from sacred places,

sanskrit_iast:
jātakaṃ nāmakaraṇamannaprāśanameva ca ..
suvarṇasūcyā kurvīta karṇavedhaṃ vidhānavit .. 34 ..
meaning:
जातकं नामकरणमन्नप्राशनमेव च ..
सुवर्णसूच्या कुर्वीत कर्णवेधं विधानवित् .. 34 ..
text_mt: the birth rite, the naming ceremony, and the first feeding of solid food; / the one who knows the ritual should perform the ear-piercing with a golden needle.

sanskrit_iast:
jātarūpakṣureṇātra cūḍākāryā yathākramam ..
badhnīyānmekhalāṃ mauñjīṃ vāsaśca paridhāpayet .. 35 ..
meaning:
जातरूपक्षुरेणात्र चूडाकार्या यथाक्रमम् ..
बध्नीयान्मेखलां मौञ्जीं वासश्च परिधापयेत् .. 35 ..
text_mt: Here the tonsure is to be performed in proper order with a golden razor; / he should tie a girdle of muñja grass and clothe it in a garment.

sanskrit_iast:
yajamānastataḥ snātaḥ śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuciḥ ..
puṣpāñjaliḥ samabhyetya maṃtrametamudīrayet .. 36 ..
meaning:
यजमानस्ततः स्नातः शुक्लांबरधरः शुचिः ..
पुष्पाञ्जलिः समभ्येत्य मंत्रमेतमुदीरयेत् .. 36 ..
text_mt: Then the sacrificer, bathed, wearing white garments, pure, / with folded hands holding flowers, having approached, should utter this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
ye śākhinaḥ śikhariṇāṃ śirasā vibhūṣā ye nandanādiṣu vaneṣu kṛtapratiṣṭhāḥ ..
ye kāmadāḥ suranaroragakinnarāṇāṃ te me natasya duritārtiharā bhavaṃtu ... 37 ..
meaning:
ये शाखिनः शिखरिणां शिरसा विभूषा ये नन्दनादिषु वनेषु कृतप्रतिष्ठाः ..
ये कामदाः सुरनरोरगकिन्नराणां ते मे नतस्य दुरितार्तिहरा भवंतु ... 37 ..
