text_mt: "May those trees that are ornaments upon the crest of mountains, those established in forests such as Nandana, / those that grant wishes to gods, mortals, serpents, and kinnaras, remove sins and afflictions for me who bow down [to them].

sanskrit_iast:
etairdvijairvidhivaraprahuto hutāśaḥ paśyatyasāvahimadīdhitiraṃbarasthaḥ ..
tvaṃ vṛkṣa putraparikalpanayā vṛto'si kāryaṃ sadaiva bhavatā mama putrakāryam .. 38 ..
meaning:
एतैर्द्विजैर्विधिवरप्रहुतो हुताशः पश्यत्यसावहिमदीधितिरंबरस्थः ..
त्वं वृक्ष पुत्रपरिकल्पनया वृतोऽसि कार्यं सदैव भवता मम पुत्रकार्यम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: By these twice-born the fire is offered with excellent rites; the hot-rayed [sun] standing in the sky watches. / You, O tree, have been chosen in the conception of a son; you must always perform for me the duties of a son."

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā taṃ vṛkṣaṃ lālayitvā punaḥpunaḥ ..
ghṛtapātre svavadanaṃ dṛṣṭvāśiṣamudīrayet .. 39 ..
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा तं वृक्षं लालयित्वा पुनःपुनः ..
घृतपात्रे स्ववदनं दृष्ट्वाशिषमुदीरयेत् .. 39 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, cherishing that tree again and again, / looking at his own face in a vessel of ghee, he should utter the blessing:

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgādaṅgātsaṃbhavasi hṛdayādabhijāyase ..
ātmā vai putranāmāsi sa jīva śaradaḥ śatam .. 4.128.40 ..
meaning:
अङ्गादङ्गात्संभवसि हृदयादभिजायसे ..
आत्मा वै पुत्रनामासि स जीव शरदः शतम् .. 4.128.40 ..
text_mt: "You are produced from limb after limb; you are born from the heart. / You are indeed the self named 'son'; live for a hundred autumns!"

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānāṃ tato deyā dakṣiṇā hṛṣṭamānasaiḥ ..
sthāpakāya śubhāṃ dhenuṃ dattvā kuryānmahotsavam .. 41 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणानां ततो देया दक्षिणा हृष्टमानसैः ..
स्थापकाय शुभां धेनुं दत्त्वा कुर्यान्महोत्सवम् .. 41 ..
text_mt: Then a priestly fee should be given to the brāhmaṇas with joyful hearts; / having given an auspicious cow to the master of ceremonies, he should hold a great festival.

sanskrit_iast:
dīnānāthajanānāṃ ca bhojanaṃ cānivāritam ..
itareṣāṃ pradātavyaṃ saṃtuṣṭena surāsavam .. 42 ..
meaning:
दीनानाथजनानां च भोजनं चानिवारितम् ..
इतरेषां प्रदातव्यं संतुष्टेन सुरासवम् .. 42 ..
text_mt: Food is to be given without restriction to the poor and helpless people, / and spirituous liquor should be given by the contented man to the others.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātibandhujanaiḥ sārddhaṃ svayaṃ bhuñjīta kāmataḥ ..
preṣyāḥ karmakarāḥ sarve pūjanīyāḥ svaśaktitaḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
ज्ञातिबन्धुजनैः सार्द्धं स्वयं भुञ्जीत कामतः ..
प्रेष्याः कर्मकराः सर्वे पूजनीयाः स्वशक्तितः .. 43 ..
text_mt: Together with his kinsmen and relatives he should himself eat at will; / all attendants and servants should be honoured according to his capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
ya evaṃ kurute pārtha vṛkṣāṇāṃ mahadutsavam ..
sarvakāmānavāpnoti ihaloke paratra ca .. 44 ..
meaning:
य एवं कुरुते पार्थ वृक्षाणां महदुत्सवम् ..
सर्वकामानवाप्नोति इहलोके परत्र च .. 44 ..
text_mt: Whoever performs such a great festival of trees, O Pārtha, / obtains all desires in this world and in the next.

sanskrit_iast:
putrairvinā śubhagatirna bhavennarāṇāṃ duṣputrakairiti tathobhayalokanāśaḥ ..
etadvicārya sudhiyā paripālya vṛkṣānputrāḥ purāṇavidhinā parikalpanīyā .. 45 ..
devapūjāvidhivarṇanam
meaning:
पुत्रैर्विना शुभगतिर्न भवेन्नराणां दुष्पुत्रकैरिति तथोभयलोकनाशः ..
एतद्विचार्य सुधिया परिपाल्य वृक्षान्पुत्राः पुराणविधिना परिकल्पनीया .. 45 ..
देवपूजाविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Without sons there is no auspicious destiny for men; and through bad sons there is destruction in both worlds. / Considering this, having nurtured trees with a wise mind, they should be conceived as sons according to the ancient rule.
Description of the Rules for Worshipping Deities

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ye mānavāstridaśamūrtiniketanāni kurvaṃti sādhujanadṛṣṭimanoharāṇi ..
teṣāṃ mṛte'tha paramārthamaye śarīre loke paribhramati kīrtimayaṃ śarīram .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
ये मानवास्त्रिदशमूर्तिनिकेतनानि कुर्वंति साधुजनदृष्टिमनोहराणि ..
तेषां मृतेऽथ परमार्थमये शरीरे लोके परिभ्रमति कीर्तिमयं शरीरम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Those men who build dwellings for the forms of the gods, pleasing to the eyes of good people, / after their physical body dies, their body composed of renown wanders throughout the world.
title: Devapūjāvidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ kārayeddvārasitābhragauramuttuṃgasaudhadhavalāyatanaṃ surāṇām ..
caṃdrāvadātabhavane divi labdhasaukhyo rājyaśriyaṃ sa bhuvi bodhayutāmupaiti .. 2 ..
meaning:
यः कारयेद्द्वारसिताभ्रगौरमुत्तुंगसौधधवलायतनं सुराणाम् ..
चंद्रावदातभवने दिवि लब्धसौख्यो राज्यश्रियं स भुवि बोधयुतामुपैति .. 2 ..
text_mt: Whoever causes to be built an abode for the gods, lofty, white with mansions, and pale as white clouds at the gateway, / finding happiness in heaven in an abode pure as the moon, attains sovereign fortune endowed with wisdom on earth.

sanskrit_iast:
ye kārayaṃti surasadmasu devatānāmarcāḥ suvarṇarajatāyasaśailatāmrāḥ ..
sāmaṃtamaulimaṇiraśmisamamarcitāste siṃhāsane'ṅgadakirīṭabhṛto'vabhāṃti .. 3 ..
meaning:
ये कारयंति सुरसद्मसु देवतानामर्चाः सुवर्णरजतायसशैलताम्राः ..
सामंतमौलिमणिरश्मिसममर्चितास्ते सिंहासनेऽङ्गदकिरीटभृतोऽवभांति .. 3 ..
text_mt: Those who cause images of deities to be made in the houses of the gods, out of gold, silver, iron, stone, and copper, / honoured by the radiant gems of the diadems of feudatories, shine upon a throne, bearing armlets and crowns.

sanskrit_iast:
ye merumaulisurasaṃghakṛtābhiṣekāḥ pañcāmṛtaiḥ suravarānabhiṣecayaṃti ..
te divyakalpamabhidhārya sureśvaratvaṃ rājyābhiṣekamatulaṃ punarāpnuvaṃti .. 4 ..
meaning:
ये मेरुमौलिसुरसंघकृताभिषेकाः पञ्चामृतैः सुरवरानभिषेचयंति ..
ते दिव्यकल्पमभिधार्य सुरेश्वरत्वं राज्याभिषेकमतुलं पुनराप्नुवंति .. 4 ..
text_mt: Those who bathe the foremost gods with the five nectars, like the bathing performed by the host of gods upon the summit of Meru, / having assumed divine sovereignty over the gods for a divine cosmic age, attain matchless royal consecration again.

sanskrit_iast:
ye śailarājamalayodbhavacaṃdanena satkuṃkumena ca surānanulepayaṃti ..
te divyagandhapaṭavāsasugaṃdhidehā naṃdaṃti naṃdanavaneṣu sahāpsarobhiḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
ये शैलराजमलयोद्भवचंदनेन सत्कुंकुमेन च सुराननुलेपयंति ..
ते दिव्यगन्धपटवाससुगंधिदेहा नंदंति नंदनवनेषु सहाप्सरोभिः .. 5 ..
text_mt: Those who anoint the gods with sandalwood born from the king of mountains and Malaya, and with genuine saffron, / their bodies fragrant with divine perfumes and scented powders, rejoice in the Nandana groves together with apsarases.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃdhāḍhyajātikamalotpaladivyapuṣpairdevānnavairanudinaṃ nanu ye'rcayaṃti ..
puṣpottamairnarapatitvamavāpya te'pi yāsyaṃti kuṃdadhavalāmacireṇa siddhim .. 6 ..
meaning:
गंधाढ्यजातिकमलोत्पलदिव्यपुष्पैर्देवान्नवैरनुदिनं ननु येऽर्चयंति ..
पुष्पोत्तमैर्नरपतित्वमवाप्य तेऽपि यास्यंति कुंदधवलामचिरेण सिद्धिम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Those who surely worship the gods every day with fresh, excellent flowers, fragrant jasmine, lotuses, blue water-lilies, and divine blossoms, / having obtained kingship through the best of flowers, they too will soon attain success pure as the jasmine flower.

sanskrit_iast:
āmodibhirhimaturuṣkasugandhadhūpairye mānavāḥ suravarānapi dhūpayaṃti ..
karpūradhāranibhagandhavarā bhirāme svarge vimānavati te bhavane ramaṃte .. 7 ..
meaning:
आमोदिभिर्हिमतुरुष्कसुगन्धधूपैर्ये मानवाः सुरवरानपि धूपयंति ..
कर्पूरधारनिभगन्धवरा भिरामे स्वर्गे विमानवति ते भवने रमंते .. 7 ..
text_mt: Those men who incense even the best of gods with fragrant incenses of camphor and Turkish olibanum, / delightful with the finest scents resembling streams of camphor, rejoice in heaven in an abode possessing celestial chariots.

sanskrit_iast:
dodhūyate kanakadaṃḍavirājitaiśca saccāmarairdhavalakuṇḍalasundarībhiḥ ..
divyāṃbarasraganulepanabhūṣi tāṅgāṃ kṛtvā sureśabhavanāṃbaravastrapūjām ..8..
meaning:
दोधूयते कनकदंडविराजितैश्च सच्चामरैर्धवलकुण्डलसुन्दरीभिः ..
दिव्यांबरस्रगनुलेपनभूषि ताङ्गां कृत्वा सुरेशभवनांबरवस्त्रपूजाम् ..8..
text_mt: [Such a one] is fanned with excellent chowries shining with golden sceptres by beautiful women with white earrings, / his body adorned with divine garments, garlands, and ointments, having performed worship with vestments and clothes in the temple of the lord of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
dedīpyate dinakarojjvalapadmarāgaratnaprabhācchuritahemamaye vimāne ..
divyāṃganāparivṛto nayanābhirāmaḥ prajvālya dīpamamalaṃ bhavane surāṇām .. 9 ..
meaning:
देदीप्यते दिनकरोज्ज्वलपद्मरागरत्नप्रभाच्छुरितहेममये विमाने ..
दिव्यांगनापरिवृतो नयनाभिरामः प्रज्वाल्य दीपममलं भवने सुराणाम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Pleasing to the eye, surrounded by celestial women, he blazes in a golden celestial chariot overlaid with the radiance of rubies as dazzling as the sun, / having kindled a spotless lamp in the dwelling of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
yo jāgaraṃ suravarābhimato dadāti caitrotsavādidivaseṣvapi tūryanādaiḥ ..
vīṇāsuveṇumadhurasvarabhāṣi ṇībhiḥ saṃgīyate ca sa kṛśodarakinnarībhiḥ .. 4.129.10 ..
meaning:
यो जागरं सुरवराभिमतो ददाति चैत्रोत्सवादिदिवसेष्वपि तूर्यनादैः ..
वीणासुवेणुमधुरस्वरभाषि णीभिः संगीयते च स कृशोदरकिन्नरीभिः .. 4.129.10 ..
text_mt: He who, favoured by the best of gods, offers a vigil with the sounds of musical instruments on occasions such as the spring festival, / is sung of by slender-waisted kinnarīs speaking with the sweet voices of lutes and flutes.

sanskrit_iast:
kurvati ye sadupalenadhāturāgasaṃmārjanaṃ suravarāyatane'nuraktāḥ ..
muktākalāpamapi kāṃcanabhakti citrairvaiḍūryakṛṭṭimatale divi te vasaṃti .. 11 ..
meaning:
कुर्वति ये सदुपलेनधातुरागसंमार्जनं सुरवरायतनेऽनुरक्ताः ..
मुक्ताकलापमपि कांचनभक्ति चित्रैर्वैडूर्यकृट्टिमतले दिवि ते वसंति .. 11 ..
text_mt: Those who, devoted to the temple of the foremost of gods, clean it with excellent stones and mineral colours, / dwell in heaven upon a mosaic floor of lapis lazuli adorned with strings of pearls and varied gold tracery.

sanskrit_iast:
dadyācca yaḥ paramabhaktiyutaḥ surāṇāṃ ghaṇṭāvitānavaracāmaramātapatram ..
keyūrahāramaṇikuṇḍalabhūṣi tosau ratnādhipo vasati bhūtalacakravartī .. 12 ..
meaning:
दद्याच्च यः परमभक्तियुतः सुराणां घण्टावितानवरचामरमातपत्रम् ..
केयूरहारमणिकुण्डलभूषि तोसौ रत्नाधिपो वसति भूतलचक्रवर्ती .. 12 ..
text_mt: And whoever, full of supreme devotion, gives the gods a bell, a canopy, an excellent chowrie, [or] a parasol, / adorned with armlets, necklaces, and jewelled earrings, lives as a sovereign lord of jewels, an emperor of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
abhyarcayetprativacaḥ kusumairvicitrairdevādhidevaparisaṃstutapādapadmān ..
bhaktyā prahṛṣṭamanasaḥ praṇamaṃti devāṃste bhūrbhuvaḥ svarmahimāptaphalā bhavaṃti .. 13 ..
dīpadānavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
अभ्यर्चयेत्प्रतिवचः कुसुमैर्विचित्रैर्देवाधिदेवपरिसंस्तुतपादपद्मान् ..
भक्त्या प्रहृष्टमनसः प्रणमंति देवांस्ते भूर्भुवः स्वर्महिमाप्तफला भवंति .. 13 ..
दीपदानविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
One should worship the lotus feet, extolled by the god of gods, with varied flowers according to each word; / those who bow down to the gods with devotion and delighted minds attain the fruit of greatness over earth, the intermediate region, and heaven.
Description of the Rule for the Gift of Lamps

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
bhagavankena tapasā vratena niyamena vā ..
dānena kena vā loke projjvaltvaṃ prajāyate .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
भगवन्केन तपसा व्रतेन नियमेन वा ..
दानेन केन वा लोके प्रोज्ज्वल्त्वं प्रजायते .. 1 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / O Blessed One, by what austerity, by what vow, or by what observance, / or by what gift in this world does radiant splendour arise?
title: Dīpadānavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
atitejo mahaddīptaṃ dīptāṃśukiraṇojjvalam ..
śarīraṃ jāyate yena tanme vaktumathārhasi .. 2 ..
meaning:
अतितेजो महद्दीप्तं दीप्तांशुकिरणोज्ज्वलम् ..
शरीरं जायते येन तन्मे वक्तुमथार्हसि .. 2 ..
text_mt: A body endowed with immense, blazing brilliance, radiant like the rays of the sun— / you ought to tell me that by which it is produced.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
mathurāyāṃ purā pārtha piṅgalo nāma tāpasaḥ ..
āgataḥ sa ca me patnyā jāmbavatyā prapūjitaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
मथुरायां पुरा पार्थ पिङ्गलो नाम तापसः ..
आगतः स च मे पत्न्या जाम्बवत्या प्रपूजितः .. 3 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / In Mathurā formerly, O Pārtha, an ascetic named Piṅgala / arrived, and he was worshipped by my wife Jāmbavatī.

sanskrit_iast:
praṣṭaśca praśramevaitaṃ sa cāvocadyathātatham ..
tayāpi me samākhyātaṃ tatsarvaṃ te vadāmyaham .. 4 ..
meaning:
प्रष्टश्च प्रश्रमेवैतं स चावोचद्यथातथम् ..
तयापि मे समाख्यातं तत्सर्वं ते वदाम्यहम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: He was asked this very question, and he answered it truly; / she too related it all to me. I shall tell it to you.

sanskrit_iast:
yadāyadā nṛpaśreṣṭha puṇyakālaḥ prapadyate ..
saṃkrātau sūryagrahaṇe candraparvaṇi vaidhṛtau .. 5 ..
meaning:
यदायदा नृपश्रेष्ठ पुण्यकालः प्रपद्यते ..
संक्रातौ सूर्यग्रहणे चन्द्रपर्वणि वैधृतौ .. 5 ..
text_mt: Whenever, O best of kings, an auspicious time arrives: / at an equinox or solstice, a solar eclipse, a lunar junction, a Vaidhṛti yoga,

sanskrit_iast:
uttare tvayane prāpte dakṣiṇe viṣuve tathā ..
ekādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ dinakṣaye .. 6 ..
meaning:
उत्तरे त्वयने प्राप्ते दक्षिणे विषुवे तथा ..
एकादश्यां शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां दिनक्षये .. 6 ..
text_mt: when the northern solstice or the southern has arrived, at the equinox likewise, / on an eleventh day of the bright fortnight, on a fourteenth day, on an omission of a lunar day,

sanskrit_iast:
saptamyāmatha vāṣṭamyāṃ snātvā vrataparo naraḥ ..
nārī vā bhūmidevebhyaḥ prayacchetprayatāṃgaṇe ..
ghṛtakuṃbhena dīpena prajvalaṃtaṃ pradīpakam .. 7 ..
meaning:
सप्तम्यामथ वाष्टम्यां स्नात्वा व्रतपरो नरः ..
नारी वा भूमिदेवेभ्यः प्रयच्छेत्प्रयतांगणे ..
घृतकुंभेन दीपेन प्रज्वलंतं प्रदीपकम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: or on a seventh or eighth day, a man or woman dedicated to the vow, having bathed, / should give with self-restraint in a courtyard to the gods of the earth / a blazing lamp together with a pot of ghee.

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭir uvāca .. ..
bhūmidevā iti proktaṃ yattvayā madhusūdana ..
kimetatkautukaṃ me'sti saṃśayaṃ chettumarhasi .. 8 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्टिर् उवाच .. ..
भूमिदेवा इति प्रोक्तं यत्त्वया मधुसूदन ..
किमेतत्कौतुकं मेऽस्ति संशयं छेत्तुमर्हसि .. 8 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / As to what was spoken by you, O Madhusūdana, namely, "the gods of the earth"— / what is this? I am curious; you should dispel my doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
purā kṛtayugasyādau triśaṃkurnāma pārthivaḥ ..
sa svargaṃ gantukāmo'bhūccharīreṇa narottama ..
tataścaṇḍālatāṃ nīto vaśiṣṭhena mahātmanā .. 9 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
पुरा कृतयुगस्यादौ त्रिशंकुर्नाम पार्थिवः ..
स स्वर्गं गन्तुकामोऽभूच्छरीरेण नरोत्तम ..
ततश्चण्डालतां नीतो वशिष्ठेन महात्मना .. 9 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Formerly, in the beginning of the Kṛta age, there was a king named Triśaṅku; / he wished to go to heaven in his physical body, O best of men. / Then he was reduced to the state of an outcaste by the great-souled Vasiṣṭha.

sanskrit_iast:
triśaṃkuḥ sarvamācakhyau viśvāmitrāya dhīmate ..
so'pi manyuvaśādyajñaṃ cakārāhūya devatāḥ .. 4.130.10 ..
meaning:
त्रिशंकुः सर्वमाचख्यौ विश्वामित्राय धीमते ..
सोऽपि मन्युवशाद्यज्ञं चकाराहूय देवताः .. 4.130.10 ..
text_mt: Triśaṅku reported everything to the wise Viśvāmitra; / he too, under the sway of wrath, performed a sacrifice having summoned the deities.

sanskrit_iast:
na tā haviḥ pratyagṛhṇaṃstataḥ kruddhaḥ kuśātmajaḥ ..
viśvāmitrastu kopena cakārānyānsurottamān .. 11 ..
meaning:
न ता हविः प्रत्यगृह्णंस्ततः क्रुद्धः कुशात्मजः ..
विश्वामित्रस्तु कोपेन चकारान्यान्सुरोत्तमान् .. 11 ..
text_mt: They did not accept the oblation; therefore, the descendant of Kuśa was enraged. / But Viśvāmitra in anger created other foremost gods,

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṃgāṭakā nnālikerānpacanānānajauḍakān ..
medhārathadavārtākatārikūṣmaṇḍakodravān.. 12 ..
meaning:
शृंगाटका न्नालिकेरान्पचनानानजौडकान् ..
मेधारथदवार्ताकतारिकूष्मण्डकोद्रवान्.. 12 ..
text_mt: water caltrops, coconuts, [...], / [...], eggplants, [...], pumpkins, [and] kodo millets.

sanskrit_iast:
uṣṭrānmanujadevāṃśca krodhānmuniravāsṛjat ..
cakārānyānsapta ṛṣīnpratimāsaṃ surottamān .. 13 ..
meaning:
उष्ट्रान्मनुजदेवांश्च क्रोधान्मुनिरवासृजत् ..
चकारान्यान्सप्त ऋषीन्प्रतिमासं सुरोत्तमान् .. 13 ..
text_mt: In wrath the sage created camels and deities for men; / he created other seven sages, foremost gods for every month.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śakraḥ samāgamya viśvāmitraṃ prasādya vai ..
sṛṣṭiṃ nivārayāmāsa ye sṛṣṭāste tathāpi ca .. 14 ..
meaning:
ततः शक्रः समागम्य विश्वामित्रं प्रसाद्य वै ..
सृष्टिं निवारयामास ये सृष्टास्ते तथापि च .. 14 ..
text_mt: Then Śakra, having approached and conciliated Viśvāmitra, / put a stop to the creation; yet those who were created remained as they were.

sanskrit_iast:
martya loke ca te sarve devā devakuleṣvatha ..
maṃtrairnibaddhāḥ piṇḍīṣu sthitā mūrtibhṛto yathā ..15..
meaning:
मर्त्य लोके च ते सर्वे देवा देवकुलेष्वथ ..
मंत्रैर्निबद्धाः पिण्डीषु स्थिता मूर्तिभृतो यथा ..15..
text_mt: And in the mortal world all those gods, residing in temples, / bound to pedestals by mantras, stand like embodied forms.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā viṣṇustathā rudro ye cānye devatāgaṇāḥ ..
lokānāmupakārāya martyalokamupāgatāḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मा विष्णुस्तथा रुद्रो ये चान्ये देवतागणाः ..
लोकानामुपकाराय मर्त्यलोकमुपागताः .. 16 ..
text_mt: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, likewise Rudra, and whatever other hosts of deities there are, / have come to the mortal world for the benefit of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
pratimāsu sthitāḥ śaśvadbhogānbhuñjati śāśvatān ..
varapradāśca bhaktānāmiti te guhyamīritam .. 17 ...
meaning:
प्रतिमासु स्थिताः शश्वद्भोगान्भुञ्जति शाश्वतान् ..
वरप्रदाश्च भक्तानामिति ते गुह्यमीरितम् .. 17 ...
text_mt: Stationed in images, they perpetually enjoy perpetual offerings, / and they grant boons to devotees. Thus this secret has been declared to you.

sanskrit_iast:
tebhyaḥ purastāddātavyo dīpyamānaḥ pradīpakaḥ ..
sūryāya raktavastreṇa pūrṇavartiṃ ghṛtairyutām ..
catuḥprasthaiḥ prajvalantīṃ maṃtreṇānena dāpayet .. 18 ..
meaning:
तेभ्यः पुरस्ताद्दातव्यो दीप्यमानः प्रदीपकः ..
सूर्याय रक्तवस्त्रेण पूर्णवर्तिं घृतैर्युताम् ..
चतुःप्रस्थैः प्रज्वलन्तीं मंत्रेणानेन दापयेत् .. 18 ..
text_mt: Before them a blazing lamp should be given: / for Sūrya, one should cause to be offered with red cloth a full wick endowed with ghee, / blazing with four prasthas [of oil or ghee], with this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
tadvi ṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ sadā paśyaṃti sūrayaḥ ..
divīva cakṣurātatam .. 19 ..
meaning:
तद्वि ष्णोः परमं पदं सदा पश्यंति सूरयः ..
दिवीव चक्षुराततम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: "That supreme step of Viṣṇu the patrons of sacrifice see perpetually, / like an eye stretched across the sky."

sanskrit_iast:
pītavastreṇa kṛṣṇāya śvetavastreṇa śūline ..
kausuṃbhavastreṇāḍhyena gaurīmuddiśya dāpayet ..4.130.20 .. varti
meaning:
पीतवस्त्रेण कृष्णाय श्वेतवस्त्रेण शूलिने ..
कौसुंभवस्त्रेणाढ्येन गौरीमुद्दिश्य दापयेत् ..4.130.20 .. वर्ति
text_mt: With a yellow cloth for Kṛṣṇa, with a white cloth for the Trident-bearer, / [and] intending Gaurī, one should offer [a wick] enriched with safflower-dyed cloth;

sanskrit_iast:
lākṣāraktena durgāyai pūrṇavarti prabodhayet ..
nīlavastreṇa kāmāya gaṇanāthāya khādiraiḥ ..21..
meaning:
लाक्षारक्तेन दुर्गायै पूर्णवर्ति प्रबोधयेत् ..
नीलवस्त्रेण कामाय गणनाथाय खादिरैः ..21..
text_mt: with cloth red from lac one should ignite a full wick for Durgā; / with blue cloth for Kāma, [and] for Gaṇanātha with catechu-dyed cloth;

sanskrit_iast:
nāgebhyaḥ kṛṣṇavastreṇa grahebhya iṣikā yudhām ..
devāṃganā pitṛbhyastu pitṛvartiṃ prabodhayet ..22..
meaning:
नागेभ्यः कृष्णवस्त्रेण ग्रहेभ्य इषिका युधाम् ..
देवांगना पितृभ्यस्तु पितृवर्तिं प्रबोधयेत् ..22..
text_mt: with black cloth for the Nāgas, with reed stalks for the planets [and gods of] weapons; / for the divine women, and for the ancestors one should ignite an ancestral wick.

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu sūryāya pūrṇavartirnigadyate ..
śivāyeśvaravartīti bhogavartirjanārdane .. 23 ..
meaning:
विशेषं शृणु सूर्याय पूर्णवर्तिर्निगद्यते ..
शिवायेश्वरवर्तीति भोगवर्तिर्जनार्दने .. 23 ..
text_mt: Hear the distinction: for Sūrya it is called a full wick; / for Śiva it is the Lord's wick, [and] the wick of enjoyment for Janārdana;

sanskrit_iast:
padmavartirviriṃcāya gauryyai saubhāgyavartikā ..
nāgebhyo nāgavartīti grahavartiryudhiṣṭhira .. 24 ..
meaning:
पद्मवर्तिर्विरिंचाय गौर्य्यै सौभाग्यवर्तिका ..
नागेभ्यो नागवर्तीति ग्रहवर्तिर्युधिष्ठिर .. 24 ..
text_mt: the lotus-wick for Viriñci, the auspicious-fortune wick for Gaurī; / for the Nāgas it is the serpent-wick, [and] the planetary wick [for the planets], O Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit_iast:
netrapaṭṭena madhunā ghṛtena madhukuṃḍake ..
arcite carcite caiva lalitāyai prabodhayet .. 25 ..
meaning:
नेत्रपट्टेन मधुना घृतेन मधुकुंडके ..
अर्चिते चर्चिते चैव ललितायै प्रबोधयेत् .. 25 ..
text_mt: With fine silk, honey, and ghee, in a honey vessel, / worshipped and anointed, one should ignite [a wick] for Lalitā,

sanskrit_iast: maṃtreṇānena rājendra tanniśāmaya vaidikam .. 26 ..
meaning: मंत्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र तन्निशामय वैदिकम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: with this Vedic mantra, O king of kings; listen to it:

sanskrit_iast:
agre tvāṃ kāmyayā girā tubhyaṃ tā girasastu viśvāḥ ..
sukṣitayaḥ pṛthakpṛthak .. 27 ..
meaning:
अग्रे त्वां काम्यया गिरा तुभ्यं ता गिरसस्तु विश्वाः ..
सुक्षितयः पृथक्पृथक् .. 27 ..
text_mt: "Before thee, with longing speech; may all those words be for thee, / peaceful dwellings, separately and distinctly.

sanskrit_iast:
agne kāmāya jegire agnipriyeṣu dhāmasu ..
kāmo bhūtasya bhavyasya samrāḍeko virājati tābhyāṃ nāma svāhā .. .. 28 ..
meaning:
अग्ने कामाय जेगिरे अग्निप्रियेषु धामसु ..
कामो भूतस्य भव्यस्य सम्राडेको विराजति ताभ्यां नाम स्वाहा .. .. 28 ..
text_mt: O Agni, they have sung out for desire in the abodes dear to Agni. / Kāma shines as the sole sovereign of what has been and what is to be. Svāhā unto both of them, indeed!"

sanskrit_iast:
evametena vidhinā yaḥ prayacchati dīpakam ..
vistīrṇe vipule pātre ghṛtakumbhe niyojitam .. 29 ..
meaning:
एवमेतेन विधिना यः प्रयच्छति दीपकम् ..
विस्तीर्णे विपुले पात्रे घृतकुम्भे नियोजितम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: Whoever in this manner, according to this rule, gives a lamp / placed in a broad, vast vessel [or] in a jar of ghee,

sanskrit_iast:
yāṃti te brahmasadanaṃ vimānenārkavarcasā ..
tiṣṭhaṃti dyotamānāste yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 4.130.30 ..
meaning:
यांति ते ब्रह्मसदनं विमानेनार्कवर्चसा ..
तिष्ठंति द्योतमानास्ते यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् .. 4.130.30 ..
text_mt: they go to the abode of Brahmā in a celestial chariot radiant as the sun; / they remain shining there until the dissolution of all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
sadīpe tu yathā deśe cakṣūṃṣi balavanti hi ..
tathā dīpasya dātāro bhavaṃti saphalekṣaṇāḥ.. .. 31 ..
meaning:
सदीपे तु यथा देशे चक्षूंषि बलवन्ति हि ..
तथा दीपस्य दातारो भवंति सफलेक्षणाः.. .. 31 ..
text_mt: Just as in a place endowed with a lamp, eyes are indeed powerful, / so those who give a lamp come to have fruitful sight.

sanskrit_iast:
yathaivordhvaṃ gatirnityaṃ rājandīpaśikhāsu vai ..
dīpadātustathaivordhvaṃ gatirbhavati śobhanā .. 32 ..
meaning:
यथैवोर्ध्वं गतिर्नित्यं राजन्दीपशिखासु वै ..
दीपदातुस्तथैवोर्ध्वं गतिर्भवति शोभना .. 32 ..
text_mt: Just as the upward course of the flames of a lamp is constant, O king, / so the beautiful course of the giver of a lamp is upward.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtena dīpo dātavyo rājaṃstailena vā punaḥ ..
vasāmajjādibhirdeyo na tu dīpaḥ kathañcana .. 33 ..
meaning:
घृतेन दीपो दातव्यो राजंस्तैलेन वा पुनः ..
वसामज्जादिभिर्देयो न तु दीपः कथञ्चन .. 33 ..
text_mt: A lamp should be given with ghee, O king, or else with oil; / but a lamp should never at all be given with fat, marrow, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpastailena kartavyo na tu karma vijānatā ..
nirvāpaṇaṃ ca dīpasya hiṃsanaṃ ca vigarhitam .. 34 ..
meaning:
दीपस्तैलेन कर्तव्यो न तु कर्म विजानता ..
निर्वापणं च दीपस्य हिंसनं च विगर्हितम् .. 34 ..
text_mt: A lamp should not be made with [impure] oil by one who knows the ritual; / and extinguishing a lamp or harming it is condemned.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ kuryātkarmaṇā tena syādasau puṣpitekṣaṇaḥ ..
dīpahartā bhavatyaṃdhaḥ kāṇo nirvāpako bhavet .. 35 ..
meaning:
यः कुर्यात्कर्मणा तेन स्यादसौ पुष्पितेक्षणः ..
दीपहर्ता भवत्यंधः काणो निर्वापको भवेत् .. 35 ..
text_mt: One who does so would become cataract-eyed by that deed; / a stealer of a lamp becomes blind, [and] an extinguisher becomes one-eyed.

sanskrit_iast:
padmasūtrodbhavāṃ vartiṃ gaṃdhatailena dīpitām ..
virogaḥ subhagaścaiva dattvā bhavati mānavaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
पद्मसूत्रोद्भवां वर्तिं गंधतैलेन दीपिताम् ..
विरोगः सुभगश्चैव दत्त्वा भवति मानवः .. 36 ..
text_mt: A person who gives a wick made from lotus fibres, / illuminated with fragrant oil, becomes free from disease and endowed with good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
prajvālya devadevasya karpūreṇa tu dīpakam ..
aśvamedhamavāpnoti kulaṃ caiva samuddharet.. 37 ..
meaning:
प्रज्वाल्य देवदेवस्य कर्पूरेण तु दीपकम् ..
अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्.. 37 ..
text_mt: Having ignited a lamp with camphor for the god of gods, / one attains [the fruit of] an Aśvamedha and lifts up one's lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
etanmayoktaṃ tava dīpadānaphalaṃ samagraṃ kuruvaṃśacandra ..
śrutvā yathāvatsatataṃ hi deyā dīpāstvayā viprasurālayeṣu .. 38 ..
meaning:
एतन्मयोक्तं तव दीपदानफलं समग्रं कुरुवंशचन्द्र ..
श्रुत्वा यथावत्सततं हि देया दीपास्त्वया विप्रसुरालयेषु .. 38 ..
text_mt: This complete fruit of the gift of lamps has been spoken by me to you, O moon of the Kuru lineage; / having heard it properly, lamps should indeed constantly be given by you in the dwellings of brahmins and gods.

sanskrit_iast:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ..
dīpadānāllalitayā yadavāptaṃ purā'nagha .. 39 ..
meaning:
अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् ..
दीपदानाल्ललितया यदवाप्तं पुराऽनघ .. 39 ..
text_mt: In this regard also they cite this ancient narrative, / what was attained in ancient times by Lalitā through the gift of a lamp, O sinless one.

sanskrit_iast:
āsīccitrarathonāma vidarbheṣu mahīpatiḥ ..
tasya putraśataṃ rājño jajñe pañcadaśottaram .. 4.130.40 ..
meaning:
आसीच्चित्ररथोनाम विदर्भेषु महीपतिः ..
तस्य पुत्रशतं राज्ञो जज्ञे पञ्चदशोत्तरम् .. 4.130.40 ..
text_mt: There was a king named Citraratha among the Vidarbhas; / to that king were born one hundred and fifteen sons.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaiva kanyā tasyāsīllalitā nāma nāmataḥ ..
sarvalakṣaṇasampannā rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi .. 41 ..
meaning:
एकैव कन्या तस्यासील्ललिता नाम नामतः ..
सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्ना रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि .. 41 ..
text_mt: He had only one daughter, named Lalitā by name, / endowed with all auspicious marks, incomparable on earth in beauty.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ dadau kāśirājāya cārvaṃgīṃ cārudharmaṇe ..
śatānyanyāni bhāryāṇāṃ trīṇyāsaṃścārudharmaṇaḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: During the dark fortnight of Āśvayuja and the bright fortnight of Kārttika, / an auspicious lamp was lit by her, placed in an elevated spot.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminkāle tathā nityaṃ brāhmaṇāvasathe ca sā ..

व्यग्रा भवति सायाह्ने दीपप्रेषणतत्परा .. 46 ..
text_mt: At that time likewise, constantly in the dwelling of brahmins, she / became busied at dusk, intent on sending forth lamps,

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣpatheṣu rathyāsu devatāyataneṣu ca ..
caityavṛkṣeṣu goṣṭheṣu parvatānāṃ ca mūrddhasu .. 47 ..

चैत्यवृक्षेषु गोष्ठेषु पर्वतानां च मूर्द्धसु .. 47 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pulineṣu nadīnāṃ ca kūpamūleṣu pāṃḍava ..

तां सपत्न्योऽथ संगम्य पप्रच्छुरिदमादृताः .. 48..
text_mt: And on the sandbanks of rivers, at the bases of wells, O Pāṇḍava. / Then her co-wives, having assembled, respectfully asked her this:

na tathā balipuṣpeṣu na tathā dvijapūjane .. 49 ..

न तथा बलिपुष्पेषु न तथा द्विजपूजने .. 49 ..
text_mt: “Lalitā, speak charming words; may good fortune be yours! / Not so in offerings and flowers, not so in the worship of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:

tadetatkathayāsmākaṃ lalite kautukaṃ param .. 4.130.50 ..
meaning:
भवत्याः सुमहान्यत्नो दीपप्रज्वालने यथा ..
तदेतत्कथयास्माकं ललिते कौतुकं परम् .. 4.130.50 ..

.. ललितोवाच .. ..

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: For this reason, day and night, I offer / these lamps in the house of Hari; its great fruit has arisen.”

They declare the gift of a lamp to be exceedingly meritorious also in the single courtyard of a house of brahmins, fire, cows, or gods; / then, with his body illuminated by that gift, a man walking on a path in the darkness never falls or stumbles.

Whatever ground he scratches up with his horns and hooves when delighted, or whatever piece he breaks seeing rival bulls, / all of that brings complete satisfaction to the performer of his marriage when he has reached the assembly of Śakra.
Description of the Vow on the Full Moon of Phālguna

sanskrit_iast:
..yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..

utsavo jāyate loke grāmegrāme pure pure.. 1 ..
meaning:
..युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..

text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / For what purpose, Janārdana, at the end of Phālguna, on the full moon day, / is a festival celebrated in the world, in every village and in every town?
title: Tsavavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
kimarthaṃ śiśavastasyāṃ gehegehe'tivādinaḥ ..
holikā dīpyate kasmātphālgunāṃte kimucyate .. 2 ..
meaning:
किमर्थं शिशवस्तस्यां गेहेगेहेऽतिवादिनः ..
होलिका दीप्यते कस्मात्फाल्गुनांते किमुच्यते .. 2 ..
text_mt: Why do children on that day make great noise in house after house? / Why is the Holikā kindled, and why is it spoken of at the end of Phālguna?

sanskrit_iast:
aḍāḍeti ca kā saṃjñā śītoṣṇeti kimucyate ..
ko hyasyāṃ pūjyate devaḥ keneyamavatāritā ..
kimasyāṃ kriyate kṛṣṇa etadvistarato vada .. 3 .. ..
meaning:
अडाडेति च का संज्ञा शीतोष्णेति किमुच्यते ..
को ह्यस्यां पूज्यते देवः केनेयमवतारिता ..
किमस्यां क्रियते कृष्ण एतद्विस्तरतो वद .. 3 .. ..
text_mt: And what is the name "Aḍāḍā", and why is it called "Śītoṣṇā"? / What deity is worshipped on it, and by whom was this brought down? / What is done on this day, Kṛṣṇa? Tell this in full detail.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
āsītkṛtayuge pārtha raghurnāma narādhipaḥ ..
śūraḥ sarvaguṇopataḥ priyavādī bahuśrutaḥ .. 4 ..

.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
आसीत्कृतयुगे पार्थ रघुर्नाम नराधिपः ..
शूरः सर्वगुणोपतः प्रियवादी बहुश्रुतः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / In the Kṛtayuga, O son of Pṛthā, there was a king named Raghu, / heroic, endowed with all virtues, pleasant-spoken, and well-learned.

sanskrit_iast:
sa sarvāṃ pṛthivīṃ jitvā vaśīkṛtya narādhipān ..
dharmataḥ pālayāmāsa prajāḥ putrānivaurasān .. 5 ..
meaning:
स सर्वां पृथिवीं जित्वा वशीकृत्य नराधिपान् ..
धर्मतः पालयामास प्रजाः पुत्रानिवौरसान् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Having conquered the whole earth and brought kings under his control, / he protected his subjects in accordance with dharma, like his own born sons.

sanskrit_iast:
na durbhikṣaṃ na ca vyādhirnākālamaraṇaṃ tathā ..
nādharmarucayaḥ paurāstasmiñchāsati pārthiva .. 6 ..
meaning:
न दुर्भिक्षं न च व्याधिर्नाकालमरणं तथा ..
नाधर्मरुचयः पौरास्तस्मिञ्छासति पार्थिव .. 6 ..
text_mt: There was no famine, no disease, and likewise no untimely death, / nor did the citizens delight in unrighteousness while he ruled, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaivaṃ śāsato rājyaṃ kṣātradharmaratasya vai ..

तस्यैवं शासतो राज्यं क्षात्रधर्मरतस्य वै ..
पौराः सर्वे समागम्य पाहिपाहीत्यथाब्रुवन्.. 7 ..
text_mt: While he was thus ruling the kingdom, devoted to the duty of the warrior class, / all the citizens came together and said: "Protect us! Protect us!"

sanskrit_iast:
.. paurā ūcuḥ ..
asmākaṃ hi gṛhe kāciḍhḍhauṃḍhā nāmeti rākṣasī ..

दिवा रात्रौ समागम्य बालान्पीडयते बलात् ..8..
text_mt: The citizens said: / Indeed, in our homes, a certain rākṣasī named Ḍhoṇḍhā, / coming by day and by night, forcibly torments the children.

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣayā kaṃḍakenāpi bheṣajairvā narādhipa ..

text_mt: Neither by protective ash, nor by a thorn, nor by remedies, O king, / nor by supreme teachers skilled in mantras can she be restrained.

sanskrit_iast:
paurāṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā raghurvismayamāgataḥ ..
vismayāviṣṭahṛdayaḥ purohitamathābravīt..4.132.10.
meaning:
पौराणां वचनं श्रुत्वा रघुर्विस्मयमागतः ..
विस्मयाविष्टहृदयः पुरोहितमथाब्रवीत्..4.132.10.
text_mt: Hearing the speech of the citizens, Raghu was filled with astonishment. / His heart overcome with wonder, he then spoke to his family priest.

.. raghuruvāca .. ..
ḍhauṃḍheti rākṣasī keyaṃ kiṃprabhāvā dvijottama ..

meaning:
.. रघुरुवाच .. ..

कथमेषा नियंतव्या मया दुष्कृतकारिणी .. 11 ..
text_mt: Raghu said: / Who is this rākṣasī named Ḍhoṇḍhā? What is her power, O best of the twice-born? / How is this evil-doer to be subdued by me?

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣaṇātprocyate rājā pṛthivīpālanātpatiḥ ..
arakṣamāṇaḥ pṛthivīṃ rājā bhavati kilbiṣī .. 12 ..

रक्षणात्प्रोच्यते राजा पृथिवीपालनात्पतिः ..
अरक्षमाणः पृथिवीं राजा भवति किल्बिषी .. 12 ..
text_mt: A king is spoken of from protection, and a lord from guarding the earth. / A king who does not protect the earth becomes sinful.

sanskrit_iast:

ḍhauṃḍhā nāmeti vikhyātā rākṣasī mālinaḥ sutā .. 13 ..
meaning:
वशिष्ठ उवाच ..

ढौंढा नामेति विख्याता राक्षसी मालिनः सुता .. 13 ..
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Hear, O king, a supreme secret that has not been told by me anywhere. / Renowned by the name Ḍhoṇḍhā is a rākṣasī, the daughter of Mālin.

sanskrit_iast:
tayā cārādhitaḥ śaṃbhurugreṇa tapasā purā ..

प्रीतस्तामाह भगवान्वरं वरय सुव्रते .. 14 ..
text_mt: In ancient times, Śambhu was worshipped by her with fierce austerities. / Pleased, the Blessed Lord said to her: "Choose a boon, O lady of good vows!

sanskrit_iast:
yatte manobhilaṣitaṃ taddadāmyavicāritam ..
ḍhauṃḍhā prāha mahādevaṃ yadi tuṣṭaḥ svayaṃ mama .. 15 ..
meaning:
यत्ते मनोभिलषितं तद्ददाम्यविचारितम् ..
ढौंढा प्राह महादेवं यदि तुष्टः स्वयं मम .. 15 ..
text_mt: Whatever is desired by your mind, that I grant without hesitation." / Ḍhoṇḍhā said to Mahādeva: "If you yourself are pleased with me,

sanskrit_iast:
na ca vadhyāṃ surādīnāṃ manujānāṃ ca śaṃkara ..
māṃ kuru tvaṃ trilokeśa śastrāstrāṇāṃ tathaiva ca .. 16 ..
meaning:
न च वध्यां सुरादीनां मनुजानां च शंकर ..
मां कुरु त्वं त्रिलोकेश शस्त्रास्त्राणां तथैव च .. 16 ..
text_mt: make me not capable of being slain by gods and others, or by men, O Śaṅkara, / and likewise by weapons or missiles, O Lord of the three worlds!

sanskrit_iast:
śītoṣṇavarṣāsamaye divā rātrau bahirgṛhe ..
abhayaṃ sarvadā me syāttvatprasādānmaheśvara .. 17 ..
meaning:
शीतोष्णवर्षासमये दिवा रात्रौ बहिर्गृहे ..
अभयं सर्वदा मे स्यात्त्वत्प्रसादान्महेश्वर .. 17 ..
text_mt: In the cold, hot, and rainy seasons, by day, by night, outside, or in a house, / let there always be fearlessness for me by your grace, O Maheśvara!"

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkara uvāca ..
evamastvityathoktvā tāṃ punaḥ provāca śūlabhṛt ..
unmattebhyaḥ śiśubhyaśca bhayaṃ te saṃbhaviṣyati ..
ṛtāvṛtau mahābhāge mā vyathāṃ hṛdaye kṛthāḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
शंकर उवाच ..
एवमस्त्वित्यथोक्त्वा तां पुनः प्रोवाच शूलभृत् ..
उन्मत्तेभ्यः शिशुभ्यश्च भयं ते संभविष्यति ..
ऋतावृतौ महाभागे मा व्यथां हृदये कृथाः .. 18 ..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / Having said to her, "So be it," the bearer of the trident spoke again: / "Your fear shall arise from madmen and children / at every change of season, O highly fortunate lady; do not make anguish in your heart."

sanskrit_iast:

स्वप्ने लब्धो यथार्थार्थस्तत्रैवांतर्हितोऽभवत् .. 19 ..
text_mt: Having thus granted a boon to her, the Blessed Lord, the destroyer of the eyes of Bhaga, / vanished right there, like wealth obtained in a dream.

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:

text_mt: All this deed of Ḍhoṇḍhā has been told to you by me. / Now I shall tell the means by which she is slain.
