meaning:
अद्य पञ्चदशी शुक्ला फाल्गुनस्य नराधिप ..
शीतकालो विनिष्क्रांतः प्रातर्ग्रीष्मो भविष्यति .. 23 ..
text_mt: Today is the fifteenth day of the bright fortnight of Phālguna, O ruler of men. / The cold season has departed; tomorrow morning it will be summer.

sanskrit_iast:
abhayapradānaṃ lokānāṃ dīyatāṃ puruṣottama ..
yathādyāśaṃkitā lokā ramaṃti ca hasaṃti ca .. 24 ..
meaning:
अभयप्रदानं लोकानां दीयतां पुरुषोत्तम ..
यथाद्याशंकिता लोका रमंति च हसंति च .. 24 ..
text_mt: Let the gift of fearlessness be given to the people, O best of men, / so that today, freed from anxiety, the people may sport and laugh.

sanskrit_iast:
dārujāni ca khaṃḍāni gṛhītvā samarotsukāḥ ..
yodhā iva viniryāṃtu śiśavaḥ saṃpraharṣitāḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
दारुजानि च खंडानि गृहीत्वा समरोत्सुकाः ..
योधा इव विनिर्यांतु शिशवः संप्रहर्षिताः .. 25 ..
text_mt: Taking wooden sticks, eager for battle, / let the children march out greatly delighted, like warriors.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃcayaṃ śuṣkakāṣṭhānāmupalānāṃ ca kārayet ..
tatrāgniṃ vidhivaddhutvā rakṣoghnairmantravistaraiḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
संचयं शुष्ककाष्ठानामुपलानां च कारयेत् ..
तत्राग्निं विधिवद्धुत्वा रक्षोघ्नैर्मन्त्रविस्तरैः .. 26 ..
text_mt: One should cause a heap of dry wood and cow-dung cakes to be made. / Having offered fire there in accordance with rule, with extensive demon-slaying mantras,

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kilakilāśabdaistālaśabdairmanoharaiḥ ..
tamagniṃ triḥ parikramya gāyaṃtu ca hasaṃtu ca ..
jalpaṃtu svecchayā lokā niḥśaṃkā yasya yanmatam .. 27 ..
meaning:
ततः किलकिलाशब्दैस्तालशब्दैर्मनोहरैः ..
तमग्निं त्रिः परिक्रम्य गायंतु च हसंतु च ..
जल्पंतु स्वेच्छया लोका निःशंका यस्य यन्मतम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: then, with joyous shouts and charming hand-clappings, / let them circumambulate that fire three times, and let them sing and laugh, / and let people chatter freely, without fear, whatever is on anyone's mind.

sanskrit_iast:
tena śabdena sā pāpā homena ca nirā kṛtā ..
adṛṣṭaghātairḍiṃbhānāṃ rākṣasī kṣayameṣyati ..28..
meaning:
तेन शब्देन सा पापा होमेन च निरा कृता ..
अदृष्टघातैर्डिंभानां राक्षसी क्षयमेष्यति ..28..
text_mt: Repelled by that sound and by the oblation, / that wicked rākṣasī will perish from unseen blows upon children.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
tasyarṣervacanaṃ śrutvā sa nṛpaḥ pāṃḍunadana..
sarvaṃ cakāra vidhivaduktaṃ tena ca dhīmatā ..29..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ..
तस्यर्षेर्वचनं श्रुत्वा स नृपः पांडुनदन..
सर्वं चकार विधिवदुक्तं तेन च धीमता ..29..
text_mt: The Blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / Having heard the words of that ṛṣi, O son of Pāṇḍu, that king / performed everything properly as spoken by that wise one.

sanskrit_iast:
gatā sā rākṣasī nāśaṃ tena cogreṇa karmaṇā ..
tataḥ prabhṛti loke'sminnaḍāḍā khyātimāgatā..4.132.30.
meaning:
गता सा राक्षसी नाशं तेन चोग्रेण कर्मणा ..
ततः प्रभृति लोकेऽस्मिन्नडाडा ख्यातिमागता..4.132.30.
text_mt: That rākṣasī went to destruction by that fierce act; / from that time on in this world, she came to be known as Aḍāḍā.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaduṣṭāpaho homaḥ sarvarogopaśāṃtidaḥ ..
kriyate'syāṃ dvijaiḥ pārtha tena sā holikā matā .. 31 ..
meaning:
सर्वदुष्टापहो होमः सर्वरोगोपशांतिदः ..
क्रियतेऽस्यां द्विजैः पार्थ तेन सा होलिका मता .. 31 ..
text_mt: An oblation destroying all wicked beings and pacifying all diseases / is performed on this [day] by the twice-born, O Pārtha; therefore it is considered Holikā.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasārātiviśveyaṃ pūrvamāsīdyudhiṣṭhira ..
sāratvātphalgurityeṣā paramānaṃdadāyinī .. 32..
meaning:
सर्वसारातिविश्वेयं पूर्वमासीद्युधिष्ठिर ..
सारत्वात्फल्गुरित्येषा परमानंददायिनी .. 32..
text_mt: Formerly, O Yudhiṣṭhira, this [tithi] was the essence of everything and entirely universal; / because of its excellence, it is called Phalgu, granting supreme bliss.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāṃ niśāgame pārtha saṃrakṣyāḥ śiśavo gṛhe ..
gomayenopasaṃlipte sacatuṣke gṛhāṃgaṇe .. 33 ..
meaning:
अस्यां निशागमे पार्थ संरक्ष्याः शिशवो गृहे ..
गोमयेनोपसंलिप्ते सचतुष्के गृहांगणे .. 33 ..
text_mt: At the coming of night on this [day], O Pārtha, children are to be protected in the house, / in the courtyard of the house smeared with cow dung and marked with a square.

sanskrit_iast:
ākārayecchiśuprāyānkhaḍgavyagra karānnarān ..
te kāṣṭhakhaṇḍaiḥ saṃspṛśya gītairhāsyakaraiḥ śiśūn ..
rakṣaṃti teṣāṃ dātavyaṃ guḍaṃ pakvānnameva ca ..34..
meaning:
आकारयेच्छिशुप्रायान्खड्गव्यग्र करान्नरान् ..
ते काष्ठखण्डैः संस्पृश्य गीतैर्हास्यकरैः शिशून् ..
रक्षंति तेषां दातव्यं गुडं पक्वान्नमेव च ..34..
text_mt: One should summon men, mostly youngsters, with swords ready in hand; / touching the children with pieces of wood, they protect [them] with merry songs; / to them should be given jaggery and cooked food.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ ḍhauṃḍhitamātrasya sa doṣaḥ praśamaṃ vrajet ..
bālānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ tasyāttasminniśāgame .. 35 ..
meaning:
एवं ढौंढितमात्रस्य स दोषः प्रशमं व्रजेत् ..
बालानां रक्षणं कार्यं तस्यात्तस्मिन्निशागमे .. 35 ..
text_mt: In this way, as soon as it is searched, that misfortune goes to pacification; / therefore the protection of boys should be performed at the coming of night on that [day].

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
prabhāte kiñjanairdeva kartavyaṃ sukhamīpsubhiḥ ..
pravṛtte mādhave māsi pratipadbhāskarodaye .. 36 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
प्रभाते किञ्जनैर्देव कर्तव्यं सुखमीप्सुभिः ..
प्रवृत्ते माधवे मासि प्रतिपद्भास्करोदये .. 36 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / At dawn, O Lord, when the month of Mādhava has begun / and the sun rises on the first lunar day, what should people desiring happiness do?

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
kṛtvā cāvaśyakāryāṇi saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ ..
vaṃdayeddholikābhūtiṃ sarvaduṣṭopaśāṃtaye .. 37 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
कृत्वा चावश्यकार्याणि संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः ..
वंदयेद्धोलिकाभूतिं सर्वदुष्टोपशांतये .. 37 ..
text_mt: The Blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / Having performed obligatory duties and gratified the ancestors and deities, / one should revere the ashes of Holikā for the pacification of all wicked beings.

sanskrit_iast:
maṃḍite carcite caiva upalipte gṛhājire ..
catuṣkaṃ kārayecchreṣṭhaṃ varṇakaiścākṣataiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
मंडिते चर्चिते चैव उपलिप्ते गृहाजिरे ..
चतुष्कं कारयेच्छ्रेष्ठं वर्णकैश्चाक्षतैः शुभैः .. 38 ..
text_mt: In the courtyard of the house adorned, smeared, and smeared over [with cow dung], / one should make an excellent square with colored powders and auspicious unbroken grains of rice.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmadhye sthāpayetpīṭhaṃ śuklavastrottara cchadam ..
agrataḥ pūrṇakalaśaṃ sthāpayetpallavairyutam.. 39 ..
meaning:
तन्मध्ये स्थापयेत्पीठं शुक्लवस्त्रोत्तर च्छदम् ..
अग्रतः पूर्णकलशं स्थापयेत्पल्लवैर्युतम्.. 39 ..
text_mt: In its center one should place a seat covered with a white cloth; / in front of it one should place a full water pot endowed with sprouts,

sanskrit_iast:
sākṣataṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca sitacandanacarcitam..
kalaśasyāgrato deyā upānahavarāṃśukāḥ..4.132.40..
meaning:
साक्षतं सहिरण्यं च सितचन्दनचर्चितम्..
कलशस्याग्रतो देया उपानहवरांशुकाः..4.132.40..
text_mt: together with unbroken grains of rice and gold, smeared with white sandalwood; / in front of the water pot, shoes and fine garments should be presented.

sanskrit_iast:
āsane copaviṣṭasya brahmaghoṣeṇa bhārata ..
carcayeccandanaṃ nārī avyaṃgāṃgā sulakṣaṇā .. 41 ..
meaning:
आसने चोपविष्टस्य ब्रह्मघोषेण भारत ..
चर्चयेच्चन्दनं नारी अव्यंगांगा सुलक्षणा .. 41 ..
text_mt: To him who is seated upon the seat, amid the chanting of the Veda, O Bhārata, / an unblemished, auspicious woman should apply sandalwood [paste]—

sanskrit_iast:
padmarāgottarapaṭā śreṣṭhāṃśukavibhūṣitā ..
vasudhārāṃ śirogre ca dadhidūrvākṣatānvitām.. 42 ..
meaning:
पद्मरागोत्तरपटा श्रेष्ठांशुकविभूषिता ..
वसुधारां शिरोग्रे च दधिदूर्वाक्षतान्विताम्.. 42 ..
text_mt: she who has an upper cloth [red like] ruby and is adorned with excellent garments— / and on the top of his head a stream of wealth accompanied by curds, dūrvā grass, and unbroken grains of rice.

sanskrit_iast:
carcāpayitvā śrīkhaṃḍamāyurārogyavṛddhaye ..
paścācca prāśayedvidvāṃścūtapuṣpaṃ sacaṃdanam.. 43 ..
meaning:
चर्चापयित्वा श्रीखंडमायुरारोग्यवृद्धये ..
पश्चाच्च प्राशयेद्विद्वांश्चूतपुष्पं सचंदनम्.. 43 ..
text_mt: Having caused sandalwood paste to be smeared for the increase of longevity and health, / the wise man should afterwards consume mango blossom mixed with sandalwood.

sanskrit_iast:
manobhavasya sā pūjā ṛṣibhiḥ saṃpradarśitā ..
ye pibaṃti vasaṃtādau cūtapuṣpaṃ sacandanam .. 44 ..
meaning:
मनोभवस्य सा पूजा ऋषिभिः संप्रदर्शिता ..
ये पिबंति वसंतादौ चूतपुष्पं सचन्दनम् .. 44 ..
text_mt: That worship of the Mind-born One has been taught by the ṛṣis / for those who consume mango blossom mixed with sandalwood at the beginning of spring.

sanskrit_iast:
satyaṃ hṛdisthakāmasya tatpūrtirjāyateñjasā ..
anaṃtaraṃ dvijendrāṇāṃ sūtamāgadhabaṃdinām .. 45 ..
meaning:
सत्यं हृदिस्थकामस्य तत्पूर्तिर्जायतेञ्जसा ..
अनंतरं द्विजेन्द्राणां सूतमागधबंदिनाम् .. 45 ..
text_mt: Truly, the fulfillment of whatever desire resides in their heart quickly comes to pass. / Thereupon, to foremost Brahmins, sūtas, māgadhas, and bards,

sanskrit_iast:
dadyāddānaṃ yathāśaktyā kāmo me prīyatāmiti ..
tato bhojanavelāyāṃ śṛtaṃ yatprāktane'hani .. 46 ..
meaning:
दद्याद्दानं यथाशक्त्या कामो मे प्रीयतामिति ..
ततो भोजनवेलायां शृतं यत्प्राक्तनेऽहनि .. 46 ..
text_mt: he should make gifts according to his ability, saying: 'May the God of Love be pleased.' / Then at mealtime, having first eaten the food that was cooked

sanskrit_iast:
prāśnīyātprathamaṃ cānnaṃ tato bhuñjīta kāmataḥ ..
ya evaṃ kurute pārtha śāstroktaṃ phālgunotsavam .. 47 ..
meaning:
प्राश्नीयात्प्रथमं चान्नं ततो भुञ्जीत कामतः ..
य एवं कुरुते पार्थ शास्त्रोक्तं फाल्गुनोत्सवम् .. 47 ..
text_mt: on the previous day, he may eat at will. / The man who performs the Phālguna festival as taught in the scriptures in this way, O Pārtha,

sanskrit_iast:
anāyāsena sidhyaṃti tasya sarve manorathāḥ ..
ādhayo vyādhayaścaiva yāṃti nāśaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ..48..
meaning:
अनायासेन सिध्यंति तस्य सर्वे मनोरथाः ..
आधयो व्याधयश्चैव यांति नाशं न संशयः ..48..
text_mt: all his desires are accomplished without exertion; / mental agonies and physical diseases go to destruction, there is no doubt;

sanskrit_iast: putrapautrasamāyuktaḥ sukhaṃ tiṣṭhati mānavaḥ .. 49 ..
meaning: पुत्रपौत्रसमायुक्तः सुखं तिष्ठति मानवः .. 49 ..
text_mt: and endowed with sons and grandsons, the man dwells happily.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyā pavitrā jayadā sarvavighravināśinī ..
eṣā te kathitā pārtha tithīnāmuttamā tithiḥ .. 4.132.50 ..
meaning:
पुण्या पवित्रा जयदा सर्वविघ्रविनाशिनी ..
एषा ते कथिता पार्थ तिथीनामुत्तमा तिथिः .. 4.132.50 ..
text_mt: Meritorious, purifying, granting victory, destroying all obstacles: / this best lunar day among lunar days has been told to you, O Pārtha.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛtte tuṣārasamaye sitapañcadaśyāṃ prātarvasantasamaye samupasthite ca ..
saṃprāśya cūtakusumaṃ saha candanena satyaṃ hi pārtha puruṣaḥ sa sukhī samāste .. 51 .. ..
āndolakavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
वृत्ते तुषारसमये सितपञ्चदश्यां प्रातर्वसन्तसमये समुपस्थिते च ..
संप्राश्य चूतकुसुमं सह चन्दनेन सत्यं हि पार्थ पुरुषः स सुखी समास्ते .. 51 .. ..
आन्दोलकविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
When the cold season has passed, on the bright fifteenth [day], in the morning when the spring season has arrived, / having consumed mango blossom together with sandalwood, truly indeed, O Pārtha, that person dwells happily.
Description of the Swing Rite

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
saṃtyajyālikulālīḍhakusumāni mṛdūnyapi ..
damanena kathaṃ lokaiḥ pūjyaṃte nākanāyakāḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
संत्यज्यालिकुलालीढकुसुमानि मृदून्यपि ..
दमनेन कथं लोकैः पूज्यंते नाकनायकाः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Leaving aside soft flowers touched by swarms of bees, / why are the rulers of heaven worshipped by people with damanaka?
title: Āndolakavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
dolāṃdolanamāhātmyaṃ rathayātrāmahotsavam ..
kathayasvāmalaṃ prājña yādavāṃbhojabhāskara .. 2 ... ..
meaning:
दोलांदोलनमाहात्म्यं रथयात्रामहोत्सवम् ..
कथयस्वामलं प्राज्ञ यादवांभोजभास्कर .. 2 ... ..
text_mt: The greatness of the swinging on a swing and the great festival of the chariot procession— / tell [me] this flawlessly, O wise one, O sun to the lotus that is the Yādava race!

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
pārthārthijanasadvṛkṣa kṣāṃtidhāma dharāpate ..
yadetadbhavatā pṛṣṭaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva vadāmi te .. 34
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
पार्थार्थिजनसद्वृक्ष क्षांतिधाम धरापते ..
यदेतद्भवता पृष्टं तच्छृणुष्व वदामि ते .. 34
text_mt: The Blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / O Pārtha, O wishing tree to supplicants, O abode of patience, O lord of the earth! / That which was asked by you, listen to it; I will tell you.

sanskrit_iast:
purā surāṇāmāvāse maṃdare cārukaṃdare ..
gandhādhārī kulālīḍho jāto damanakastaruḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
पुरा सुराणामावासे मंदरे चारुकंदरे ..
गन्धाधारी कुलालीढो जातो दमनकस्तरुः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Formerly, in the abode of the gods on Mount Mandara with its lovely caves, / the damanaka plant was born, bearing fragrance and touched by bees.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya gaṃdhamanāghreyamāghrāya surayoṣitaḥ ..
madanonmādavaśagā gāyaṃti ca hasaṃti ca ..5..
meaning:
तस्य गंधमनाघ्रेयमाघ्राय सुरयोषितः ..
मदनोन्मादवशगा गायंति च हसंति च ..5..
text_mt: Smelling its fragrance which should not have been smelled, the celestial women, / falling under the power of the intoxication of passion, sang and laughed.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayo niyamāṃstyaktvā prādravaṃta gṛhānprati ..
na vedādhyayane dhyāne ratisteṣāṃ babhūva ha .6..
meaning:
ऋषयो नियमांस्त्यक्त्वा प्राद्रवंत गृहान्प्रति ..
न वेदाध्ययने ध्याने रतिस्तेषां बभूव ह .6..
text_mt: The ṛṣis, abandoning their vows, ran toward their houses; / there was no delight for them in Vedic study or meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
aparādhādvighaṭitaṃ yadbabhūva priye param..
mānasaṃ māninīnāṃ tu punargaṃdhena saṃdhitam .. 7 ..
meaning:
अपराधाद्विघटितं यद्बभूव प्रिये परम्..
मानसं मानिनीनां तु पुनर्गंधेन संधितम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: The heart of proud women, which had been deeply alienated / from their lover due to an offense, was reunited again by that fragrance.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃdhenākulitaṃ lokaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmā tamabravīt ..
śamanirmitayā vācā roṣātprasphuritādharaḥ .. 8 .. ..
meaning:
गंधेनाकुलितं लोकं दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मा तमब्रवीत् ..
शमनिर्मितया वाचा रोषात्प्रस्फुरिताधरः .. 8 .. ..
text_mt: Seeing the world agitated by the fragrance, Brahmā spoke to it / in words forged with restraint, his lower lip trembling with wrath.

sanskrit_iast:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
jātastvaṃ lokadamanānnūnaṃ damanako mayā ..
jagadvā ghūrṇase kasmātkarma naitattavocitam .. 9 ..
meaning:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
जातस्त्वं लोकदमनान्नूनं दमनको मया ..
जगद्वा घूर्णसे कस्मात्कर्म नैतत्तवोचितम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Brahmā said: / You were born surely from subduing the world, hence [named] Damanaka by me; / why do you agitate the universe? This action is not fitting for you.

sanskrit_iast:
yatsaṃtastvanumanyaṃte sarvā tiśayavarjitam ..
tatseveta naraḥ karma yatrodvego na dhīmatām .. 4.133.10 ..
meaning:
यत्संतस्त्वनुमन्यंते सर्वा तिशयवर्जितम् ..
तत्सेवेत नरः कर्म यत्रोद्वेगो न धीमताम् .. 4.133.10 ..
text_mt: That which the virtuous approve, free from every excess, / a man should pursue that action in which there is no distress for the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
ekasyāpyapakāraṃ yaḥ karoti sa narādhamaḥ ..
bahūnāmapakārāya sapravṛtaḥ kimucyate .. 11 ..
meaning:
एकस्याप्यपकारं यः करोति स नराधमः ..
बहूनामपकाराय सप्रवृतः किमुच्यते .. 11 ..
text_mt: He who causes harm even to one person is the lowest of men; / what can be said of him who is bent upon harm to many?

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭārthabādhakaṃ karma na kartavyaṃ kathaṃcana ..
adṛṣṭaṃ prati saṃdehaḥ sosmābhiranumīyate .. 12 ..
meaning:
दृष्टार्थबाधकं कर्म न कर्तव्यं कथंचन ..
अदृष्टं प्रति संदेहः सोस्माभिरनुमीयते .. 12 ..
text_mt: An action which obstructs visible purposes should never be done; / as for the unseen result, there is doubt; it is merely inferred by us.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ svayaṃ prabhajati daive pitrye ca karmaṇi ..
bhogārthe ca tribhuvananirādeyo bhaviṣyati .. 13 ..
meaning:
ततः स्वयं प्रभजति दैवे पित्र्ये च कर्मणि ..
भोगार्थे च त्रिभुवननिरादेयो भविष्यति .. 13 ..
text_mt: Therefore, when one engages oneself in rites for the gods and ancestors / and for enjoyment, you shall be unacceptable to the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
.. damanaka uvāca .. ..
puruṣādevamārabdhaṃ na krodhānnārthakāra ṇāt ..
svabhāva eṣa me brahmaṃstvayā sṛṣṭaḥ purā vibho .. 14 ..
meaning:
.. दमनक उवाच .. ..
पुरुषादेवमारब्धं न क्रोधान्नार्थकार णात् ..
स्वभाव एष मे ब्रह्मंस्त्वया सृष्टः पुरा विभो .. 14 ..
text_mt: Damanaka said: / This was begun solely from destiny, not from anger, nor for the sake of wealth; / this nature of mine, O Brahmā, was created formerly by you, O omnipresent Lord!

sanskrit_iast:
yā yasya jaṃtoḥ prakṛtiḥ śubhā vā yadi vetarā ..
sa tasyāmeva ramate duṣkṛte sukṛte tathā .. 15 ..
meaning:
या यस्य जंतोः प्रकृतिः शुभा वा यदि वेतरा ..
स तस्यामेव रमते दुष्कृते सुकृते तथा .. 15 ..
text_mt: Whatever nature belongs to a creature, whether auspicious or otherwise, / in that alone does he find delight, whether in evil deeds or in good deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsvabhāvapravṛttasya yadi śāpastvayā mama ..
pradattaḥ kiṃ karomyetanna kṛtyamaparādhyati .'. 16 ..
meaning:
तत्स्वभावप्रवृत्तस्य यदि शापस्त्वया मम ..
प्रदत्तः किं करोम्येतन्न कृत्यमपराध्यति .'. 16 ..
text_mt: Therefore, if a curse has been given by you to me who acted according to my nature, / what can I do about this? Action does not offend [against destiny].

sanskrit_iast:
yuktiyuktaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā damanena samī ritam ..
prītātmā padmajaḥ prāha karomi tava satpriyam .. 17 ..
meaning:
युक्तियुक्तं वचः श्रुत्वा दमनेन समी रितम् ..
प्रीतात्मा पद्मजः प्राह करोमि तव सत्प्रियम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: Hearing the reasoned statement uttered by Damana, / the Lotus-born One, pleased in his mind, said: 'I shall do what is truly pleasing to you.'

sanskrit_iast:
vasaṃte sahakārotthamaṃjarīpiṃjare jane ..
puṣpitāśokaśobhāḍhye vane puṃskokilā kule .. 18 ..
meaning:
वसंते सहकारोत्थमंजरीपिंजरे जने ..
पुष्पिताशोकशोभाढ्ये वने पुंस्कोकिला कुले .. 18 ..
text_mt: In spring, when the people are tawny with mango blossoms, / in the forest crowded with male cuckoos and rich in the beauty of flowering aśoka trees,

sanskrit_iast:
tasminkāle sureśānāṃ śirāṃsyākramya līlayā ..
sthāsyasi tvaṃ dinaṃ caikaṃ yadyasya vihitaṃ hitam .. 19 ..
meaning:
तस्मिन्काले सुरेशानां शिरांस्याक्रम्य लीलया ..
स्थास्यसि त्वं दिनं चैकं यद्यस्य विहितं हितम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: at that time, resting playfully upon the heads of the lords of the gods, / you will abide for one day, since this beneficial deed has been ordained for you.

sanskrit_iast:
ye tvāmāropayiṣyaṃti dānamānapurassarāḥ ..
surāṇāṃ te bhaviṣyaṃti sadaiva sukhino narāḥ .. 4.133.20 ..
meaning:
ये त्वामारोपयिष्यंति दानमानपुरस्सराः ..
सुराणां ते भविष्यंति सदैव सुखिनो नराः .. 4.133.20 ..
text_mt: Those men who will place you [there] after gifts and honors, / will always remain happy before the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadaiva śivasyeṣṭā puṇyā pāpabhayāpahā ..
prasiddhiṃ yāsyati madhau damanākhyā caturdaśī .. 21 ..
meaning:
सर्वदैव शिवस्येष्टा पुण्या पापभयापहा ..
प्रसिद्धिं यास्यति मधौ दमनाख्या चतुर्दशी .. 21 ..
text_mt: Always beloved of Śiva, sacred, removing the fear of sin, / the fourteenth [lunar day] named Damanā in the month of Madhu will attain renown.

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā yayau brahmā damano maṃdare girau ..
uvāsa vāsitāśeṣabhuvano gaṃdhasampadā .. 22 ..
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा ययौ ब्रह्मा दमनो मंदरे गिरौ ..
उवास वासिताशेषभुवनो गंधसम्पदा .. 22 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, Brahmā departed; and Damanaka dwelled on Mount Mandara, / perfuming all the worlds with his abundance of fragrance.

sanskrit_iast:
divye girau girisu tādayitādhivāse ratnāṃśukacchuritakāñcanabhūmibhāge ..
śāpaṃ varaṃ ca hṛdaye viniveśya śaṃbhostatrāsthito damanako damitāṃtarātmā .. 23 ..
meaning:
दिव्ये गिरौ गिरिसु तादयिताधिवासे रत्नांशुकच्छुरितकाञ्चनभूमिभागे ..
शापं वरं च हृदये विनिवेश्य शंभोस्तत्रास्थितो दमनको दमितांतरात्मा .. 23 ..
text_mt: Upon that divine mountain, the beloved abode of the Mountain's daughter, where the golden ground was inlayed with radiant gems, / having placed both Śambhu's curse and boon in his heart, Damanaka remained there, master of his inner self.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
dharmarāja nibodhedamāṃdolakamahotsavam ..
pravṛttanaranārīkaṃ pañcamoccārasundaram..24..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
धर्मराज निबोधेदमांदोलकमहोत्सवम् ..
प्रवृत्तनरनारीकं पञ्चमोच्चारसुन्दरम्..24..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / O King of Dharma, learn now of this great festival of the swing, / in which men and women engage, delightful with the sounding of the fifth note.

sanskrit_iast:
sānaṃdaṃ naṃdanavane ārdrayā sahito yathā ..
vismayasmeranayano babhrāmodvāṃtasaurabhaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
सानंदं नंदनवने आर्द्रया सहितो यथा ..
विस्मयस्मेरनयनो बभ्रामोद्वांतसौरभः .. 25 ..
text_mt: Joyfully in the Nandana grove, together with Ārdrā, / with eyes smiling in wonder, exuding fragrance, he wandered,

sanskrit_iast:
unmādayanvane puṇye vidyādharagaṇānbahūn ..
vasaṃtartau nṛtyamānānmurāsuraśatārcitaḥ .. .. 26 ..
meaning:
उन्मादयन्वने पुण्ये विद्याधरगणान्बहून् ..
वसंतर्तौ नृत्यमानान्मुरासुरशतार्चितः .. .. 26 ..
text_mt: intoxicating the many hosts of Vidyādharas in the sacred forest, / dancing in the spring season, worshipped by hundreds of foes of the demon Mura.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtānapārijātotthāṃ baddhvā sa mādhavīlatām ..
kaścidāṃdolanaṃ cakre samāliṃgya ghanastanīm .. 27 ..
meaning:
संतानपारिजातोत्थां बद्ध्वा स माधवीलताम् ..
कश्चिदांदोलनं चक्रे समालिंग्य घनस्तनीम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: Having fastened a mādhavī creeper born of the saṃtāna and pārijāta trees, / someone swung, embracing a woman with full breasts.

sanskrit_iast:
gītamāṃdolakārūḍhastadgāyaṃtyamara striyaḥ ..
yena cotpādayaṃti sma manmathasyāpi manmatham .. 28 ..
meaning:
गीतमांदोलकारूढस्तद्गायंत्यमर स्त्रियः ..
येन चोत्पादयंति स्म मन्मथस्यापि मन्मथम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Mounted on the swing, they sang; the wives of the immortals sang that song / by which they produced love even in the God of Love.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvāṣṭāpadanibhā bhavānī prāha śaṃkaram ..
kautukaṃ me samutpannaṃ paśyemāḥ śaṃkara prabho .. 29 ..
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वाष्टापदनिभा भवानी प्राह शंकरम् ..
कौतुकं मे समुत्पन्नं पश्येमाः शंकर प्रभो .. 29 ..
text_mt: Seeing him, Bhavānī, who shone like gold, spoke to Śaṅkara: / "Curiosity has arisen in me; behold them, O Lord Śaṅkara!

sanskrit_iast:
ādolakaṃ mama kṛte kārayasva svalaṃkṛtam ..
tvayā sahāṃdolayeyaṃ yathā caite trilocana..4.133.30..
meaning:
आदोलकं मम कृते कारयस्व स्वलंकृतम् ..
त्वया सहांदोलयेयं यथा चैते त्रिलोचन..4.133.30..
text_mt: Have a well-adorned swing made for my sake, / so that I may swing together with you, O three-eyed lord, just like these!"

sanskrit_iast:
tadgaurīvacanaṃ ramyaṃ śrutvā govṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ..
saddolāṃ kārayāmāsa samāhūya mahāsurān ..31..
meaning:
तद्गौरीवचनं रम्यं श्रुत्वा गोवृषभध्वजः ..
सद्दोलां कारयामास समाहूय महासुरान् ..31..
text_mt: Hearing those charming words of Gaurī, he whose banner is the bull / summoned the great asuras and had an excellent swing fashioned.

sanskrit_iast:
staṃbhadvayaṃ ropayitvā iṣṭāpūrtamayaṃ dṛḍham ..
satyaṃ caivoparitataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kāṣṭhamakalpayat .. ..32..
meaning:
स्तंभद्वयं रोपयित्वा इष्टापूर्तमयं दृढम् ..
सत्यं चैवोपरिततं श्रेष्ठं काष्ठमकल्पयत् .. ..32..
text_mt: Having erected two firm pillars consisting of sacrificial and pious works, / he fashioned the truth above it into a spread, excellent crossbeam.

sanskrit_iast:
vāsukiṃ daṃḍakasthāne baddhvā tāṃtavasaprabham ..
tatphaṇāmaṃtarāpīṭhaṃ kṛtavānmaṇimaṃḍitam .. 33 ..
meaning:
वासुकिं दंडकस्थाने बद्ध्वा तांतवसप्रभम् ..
तत्फणामंतरापीठं कृतवान्मणिमंडितम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: Having bound Vāsuki, lustrous as thread, in place of the pole, / he made a seat within his hoods adorned with jewels.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛmikārpāsakauśeyavastraiḥ saṃveṣṭitaṃ navaiḥ ..
sragdāmālaṃbitaprāṃtamaṇimauktikaśekharam..34..
meaning:
कृमिकार्पासकौशेयवस्त्रैः संवेष्टितं नवैः ..
स्रग्दामालंबितप्रांतमणिमौक्तिकशेखरम्..34..
text_mt: It was wrapped in new fabrics made of wild silk, cotton, and woven silk, / with its borders hung with wreaths of garlands, crowned with jewels and pearls.

sanskrit_iast:
racayitvā vicitrāṃ tāṃ dolāṃ cailājinottarām ..
sa siddhāṃ siddhagurave gauraveṇa nyavedayat ..35..
meaning:
रचयित्वा विचित्रां तां दोलां चैलाजिनोत्तराम् ..
स सिद्धां सिद्धगुरवे गौरवेण न्यवेदयत् ..35..
text_mt: Having fashioned that wondrous swing covered with clothes and deer-skins, / he, having completed it, respectfully offered it to the guru of the Siddhas.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrārūḍhastu yāvatsa saumyasomavibhūṣaṇaḥ ..
maṃdaraṃ dolayāmāsa pārśvasthaiḥ pārṣadaiḥ saha ..36..
meaning:
तत्रारूढस्तु यावत्स सौम्यसोमविभूषणः ..
मंदरं दोलयामास पार्श्वस्थैः पार्षदैः सह ..36..
text_mt: As soon as he, adorned with the gentle moon, mounted it, / he swung Mandara along with his attendants standing at his side.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmapārśve tu vijayā dakṣiṇena jayā bhavet ..
cāmarākrāṃtabāhū te tenāśliṣṭe nyavījatām .. 37 ..
meaning:
वामपार्श्वे तु विजया दक्षिणेन जया भवेत् ..
चामराक्रांतबाहू ते तेनाश्लिष्टे न्यवीजताम् .. 37 ..
text_mt: On the left side stood Vijayā, and on the right Jayā; / their arms occupied with chowries, embraced by him, they fanned him.

sanskrit_iast:
ādolayaṃtyā pārvatyā sahitaṃ sa gadākṣaram ..
yena devāsurastraiṇamāsīdānaṃdanirbharam .. 38 ..
meaning:
आदोलयंत्या पार्वत्या सहितं स गदाक्षरम् ..
येन देवासुरस्त्रैणमासीदानंदनिर्भरम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: Together with Pārvatī who was swinging [him], he spoke in a choked voice, / whereby the women of the gods and asuras became filled with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
jagurgaṃdharvapatayo nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ ..
ucchalattālavādyāni vādayaṃti sma cāraṇāḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
जगुर्गंधर्वपतयो ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः ..
उच्छलत्तालवाद्यानि वादयंति स्म चारणाः .. 39 ..
text_mt: The masters of the Gandharvas sang, and troops of apsarases danced; / the Cāraṇas played musical instruments that burst forth with rhythm.

sanskrit_iast:
celuḥ kulācalāḥ sarve cukṣubhuḥ sapta sāgarāḥ ..
vavurvātāḥ sanirghātā deve dolāṃ samāsthite .. 4.133.40 ..
meaning:
चेलुः कुलाचलाः सर्वे चुक्षुभुः सप्त सागराः ..
ववुर्वाताः सनिर्घाता देवे दोलां समास्थिते .. 4.133.40 ..
text_mt: All the principal mountain ranges shook, the seven oceans surged, / and winds blew with thunderbolts when the god mounted the swing.

sanskrit_iast:
ālokya vyākulaṃ lokaṃ devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ ..
upetya praṇipatyocuḥ sarvapāpaharaṃ param .. 41 ..
meaning:
आलोक्य व्याकुलं लोकं देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः ..
उपेत्य प्रणिपत्योचुः सर्वपापहरं परम् .. 41 ..
text_mt: Beholding the world perturbed, the gods, led by Śakra, / approached and, bowing down, spoke to the supreme remover of all sins:

sanskrit_iast:
upāramasva bhagavanbhavataḥ krīḍayānayā ..
jagadvyāpadyate deve calitaḥ sāgaraśca yat .. 42 ..
meaning:
उपारमस्व भगवन्भवतः क्रीडयानया ..
जगद्व्यापद्यते देवे चलितः सागरश्च यत् .. 42 ..
text_mt: "Desist, O Lord! By this play of yours / the universe is perishing, O God, and the ocean is agitated!"

sanskrit_iast:
gīrvāṇagīrbhiḥ saṃhṛṣṭaḥ śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ ..
samutpapāta dolātaḥ praharṣotphullalocanaḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
गीर्वाणगीर्भिः संहृष्टः शंकरो लोकशंकरः ..
समुत्पपात दोलातः प्रहर्षोत्फुल्ललोचनः .. 43 ..
text_mt: Gladdened by the words of the gods, Śaṅkara, the bringer of welfare to the world, / sprang down from the swing, his eyes wide open with delight.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca vacanaṃ pārtha surasārthasya paśyataḥ ..
sānukaṃpaṃ sulalitaṃ visphuṭārthapadākṣaram .. 44 ..
meaning:
उवाच वचनं पार्थ सुरसार्थस्य पश्यतः ..
सानुकंपं सुललितं विस्फुटार्थपदाक्षरम् .. 44 ..
text_mt: O Pārtha, while the assembly of gods watched, he spoke words / full of compassion, very charming, with clear words, syllables, and meaning.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmahādeva uvāca ..
adya prabhṛti ye dolākrīḍāṃ puṣkariṇītaṭe ..
vasaṃte kārayiṣyaṃti maṃḍite tridaśāṃgaṇe .. 45 ..
meaning:
श्रीमहादेव उवाच ..
अद्य प्रभृति ये दोलाक्रीडां पुष्करिणीतटे ..
वसंते कारयिष्यंति मंडिते त्रिदशांगणे .. 45 ..
text_mt: The venerable Mahādeva said: / "From this day forward, those who, on the bank of a lotus pond, / in the courtyard of the gods decorated in spring, will celebrate the swing festival—

sanskrit_iast:
netrapaṭṭāpaṭacchannāṃ padmarāgavibhūṣi tām ..
ātapatreṇa saṃyuktāṃ vinyastakanakāṃḍakām .. 46 ..
meaning:
नेत्रपट्टापटच्छन्नां पद्मरागविभूषि ताम् ..
आतपत्रेण संयुक्तां विन्यस्तकनकांडकाम् .. 46 ..
text_mt: covered with silk cloths, adorned with rubies, / furnished with an umbrella, having golden finials placed upon it,

sanskrit_iast:
vicitrābharaṇābhābhirābhāsitadigaṃtarām ..
tārakāśāṃtacitrāṃgapuṣpamālāmanora mām .. 47 ..
meaning:
विचित्राभरणाभाभिराभासितदिगंतराम् ..
तारकाशांतचित्रांगपुष्पमालामनोर माम् .. 47 ..
text_mt: illuminating the directions with the luster of manifold ornaments, / delightful with flower garlands of various kinds resembling stars,

sanskrit_iast:
mālāṃ vidyādharākrātāṃ prāṃtaropitadarpaṇām ..
chatracāmarasaṃchannāṃ yathā śaktyāpyalaṃkṛtām .. 48 ..
meaning:
मालां विद्याधराक्रातां प्रांतरोपितदर्पणाम् ..
छत्रचामरसंछन्नां यथा शक्त्याप्यलंकृताम् .. 48 ..
text_mt: with a garland surrounded by Vidyādharas, with mirrors set at its borders, / covered with royal parasols and chowries, and adorned according to one's ability—

sanskrit_iast:
agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kṣiptvā caiva diśāṃ balim ..
tasyāmāropayeddevamiṣṭahṛṣṭajanāvṛtaḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
अग्निकार्यं ततः कृत्वा क्षिप्त्वा चैव दिशां बलिम् ..
तस्यामारोपयेद्देवमिष्टहृष्टजनावृतः .. 49 ..
text_mt: having then performed the fire-rite and cast the offering to the directions, / one should place the god upon it, surrounded by dear and joyful people.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlamaṃtreṇa devānāṃ proktaṃ dolādhirohaṇam ..
pārśvastho brāhmaṇo vidvānpaṭhedvā maṃtramuttamam .. 4.133.50 ..
meaning:
मूलमंत्रेण देवानां प्रोक्तं दोलाधिरोहणम् ..
पार्श्वस्थो ब्राह्मणो विद्वान्पठेद्वा मंत्रमुत्तमम् .. 4.133.50 ..
text_mt: The ascending of the swing by the gods is prescribed with the root mantra, / or a learned brāhmaṇa standing nearby should recite the supreme mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃbhīrāṃtaranirghoṣairlalanānāṃ ca nisvanaiḥ ..
stutimaṃgalaśabdaiśca puṣpadhūpādhivāsitām .. 51 ..
meaning:
गंभीरांतरनिर्घोषैर्ललनानां च निस्वनैः ..
स्तुतिमंगलशब्दैश्च पुष्पधूपाधिवासिताम् .. 51 ..
text_mt: With the deep, inner rumblings and sounds of women, / and with the words of auspicious hymns, perfumed with flowers and incense—

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare nārīṃ dohanāya nikuṭṭakām ..
praveśayetkuṃkumāḍhyāṃ krīḍāvarṇapriyaiḥ saha .. 52 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे नारीं दोहनाय निकुट्टकाम् ..
प्रवेशयेत्कुंकुमाढ्यां क्रीडावर्णप्रियैः सह .. 52 ..
text_mt: meanwhile, one should bring in a woman adorned with saffron to sprinkle [water], / dancing the nikuṭṭaka step, together with those who love colored sports.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇaśṛṃgiṇā proktaṃ smitadaṃtāṃśukarburam ..
lagamānaṃ jalaṃ cāṃge kasya na syātsukhapradam .. 53 ..
meaning:
सुवर्णशृंगिणा प्रोक्तं स्मितदंतांशुकर्बुरम् ..
लगमानं जलं चांगे कस्य न स्यात्सुखप्रदम् .. 53 ..
text_mt: Sprayed from a golden horn, variegated with the rays of smiling teeth, / to whom would the water striking the body not bring delight?

sanskrit_iast:
jalasaṃklinnavasano raśanādāmamaṃḍitaḥ ..
kambugrīvollasansarvo babhūva gaṇikāgaṇaḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
जलसंक्लिन्नवसनो रशनादाममंडितः ..
कम्बुग्रीवोल्लसन्सर्वो बभूव गणिकागणः .. 54 ..
text_mt: Their garments drenched with water, adorned with girdle-strings, / the whole host of courtesans shone, their necks like conch shells.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṃkumakṣodatāṃbūlapuṣpa mālākulo janaḥ ..
tāṃ vihāya jalakrīḍāṃ nānyasyāṃ vidadhe manaḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
कुंकुमक्षोदतांबूलपुष्प मालाकुलो जनः ..
तां विहाय जलक्रीडां नान्यस्यां विदधे मनः .. 55 ..
text_mt: Covered in saffron powder, betel, and flower garlands, / the people, setting aside that water sport, fixed their minds on nothing else.

sanskrit_iast:
pītaśītajalāghāta tāḍito'pi janaḥ sukham ..
manyate niyataḥ kopi prabhāvo'yamanaṃgajaḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
पीतशीतजलाघात ताडितोऽपि जनः सुखम् ..
मन्यते नियतः कोपि प्रभावोऽयमनंगजः .. 56 ..
text_mt: Even when struck by the impact of yellow and cold water, the people considered it joy; / surely this was some power born of the Bodiless One.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ ye tu gamiṣyaṃti narā vartmatayā gatam ..
nīrujaste bhaviṣyaṃti sukhitāḥ śaradāṃ śatam .. 57 ..
meaning:
एवं ये तु गमिष्यंति नरा वर्त्मतया गतम् ..
नीरुजस्ते भविष्यंति सुखिताः शरदां शतम् .. 57 ..
text_mt: Those men who will thus proceed according to this path / will be free from disease and happy for a hundred autumns.

sanskrit_iast:
putrapautrasamā yuktā dhanadhānyasamāyutāḥ ..
vihṛtya sukhasaṃpattau tato yāsyaṃti matpuram .. 58 ..
meaning:
पुत्रपौत्रसमा युक्ता धनधान्यसमायुताः ..
विहृत्य सुखसंपत्तौ ततो यास्यंति मत्पुरम् .. 58 ..
text_mt: Endowed with sons and grandsons, accompanied by wealth and grain, / after sporting in prosperity and happiness, they will go to my city.

sanskrit_iast:
prāpte vasaṃtasamaye surasattamānāmāndolanaṃ suravarānanukurvate ye ..
te prāpnuvaṃti bhuvi janmataroḥ phalāni duḥkhārṇavātkulaśatānyapi tārayaṃti .. 59 ..
damanakāṃdolakarathayātrāmahotsavavarṇanam
meaning:
प्राप्ते वसंतसमये सुरसत्तमानामान्दोलनं सुरवराननुकुर्वते ये ..
ते प्राप्नुवंति भुवि जन्मतरोः फलानि दुःखार्णवात्कुलशतान्यपि तारयंति .. 59 ..
दमनकांदोलकरथयात्रामहोत्सववर्णनम्
text_mt:
When the spring season has arrived, those who imitate the gods' swinging / of the best of gods, obtain on earth the fruits of the tree of birth / and deliver even hundreds of families from the ocean of suffering."
Description of the great festival of Damanaka's swing and chariot procession.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
rathayātrāvidhānaṃ te katha yāmi yudhiṣṭhira ..
sthiro bhūtvā nibodhedaṃ tvaṃ hi mūrtavidāṃ varaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
रथयात्राविधानं ते कथ यामि युधिष्ठिर ..
स्थिरो भूत्वा निबोधेदं त्वं हि मूर्तविदां वरः .. 1 ..
text_mt:
The blessed Kṛṣṇa said:
I shall explain to you the rite of the chariot procession, O Yudhiṣṭhira.
Become calm and learn this, for you are the foremost of those who know forms.
title: Damanakāṃdolakarathayātrāmahotsavavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
caitre trinetrasaṃbhūtamalayākhyamahāgirau ..
pravahatpavanadhvānapreṃkholitalatācaye .. 2 ..
meaning:
चैत्रे त्रिनेत्रसंभूतमलयाख्यमहागिरौ ..
प्रवहत्पवनध्वानप्रेंखोलितलताचये .. 2 ..
text_mt:
In the month of Caitra, on the great mountain named Malaya, which arose from the Three-Eyed Lord,
where clumps of creepers were set rocking by the sound of blowing winds,

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu bhramamāṇo yadṛcchayā ..
nāradaḥ śāradākāṃtācchivaloke samāyayau .. 3 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु भ्रममाणो यदृच्छया ..
नारदः शारदाकांताच्छिवलोके समाययौ .. 3 ..
text_mt:
at that very time, wandering about at will,
Nārada arrived in the world of Śiva from [the presence of] his beloved Śāradā.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvāpūrvaṃ śivaṃ śāṃtaṃ sureśaiḥ sarvato vṛtam ..
praṇamyopāviśadvipraḥ purataḥ keśaveśayoḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वापूर्वं शिवं शांतं सुरेशैः सर्वतो वृतम् ..
प्रणम्योपाविशद्विप्रः पुरतः केशवेशयोः .. 4 ..
text_mt:
Seeing wondrous, tranquil Śiva surrounded on all sides by the lords of gods,
the Brahmin bowed and sat down before Keśava and the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tamupāsīnamālakṣya bhagavānbhaganetrahā ..
papracchācchāditamanāḥ kutaścāgamyate punaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
तमुपासीनमालक्ष्य भगवान्भगनेत्रहा ..
पप्रच्छाच्छादितमनाः कुतश्चागम्यते पुनः .. 5 ..
text_mt:
Observing him seated nearby, the blessed destroyer of Bhaga's eyes,
his mind veiled [in curiosity], asked: “Whence do you come now?”

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīnārada uvāca .. ..
śiva kāmaṃ ca taṃ viddhi dagdhaṃ mā vibudhottama ..
vasaṃto nāma ko'pyeṣa kāmasya dayitaḥ sakhā .. 6 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीनारद उवाच .. ..
शिव कामं च तं विद्धि दग्धं मा विबुधोत्तम ..
वसंतो नाम कोऽप्येष कामस्य दयितः सखा .. 6 ..
text_mt:
The blessed Nārada said:
O Śiva, do not think that Kāma has been burnt up, O best of the gods!
There is a certain beloved friend of Kāma named Spring.

sanskrit_iast:
malayānilayuktena tena viśvaṃ vaśīkṛtam ..
sahakārakarīndrasthaṃ kṛtvā kokilaḍiṃḍimam .. 7 ..
meaning:
मलयानिलयुक्तेन तेन विश्वं वशीकृतम् ..
सहकारकरीन्द्रस्थं कृत्वा कोकिलडिंडिमम् .. 7 ..
text_mt:
Joined with the Malaya breeze, by him the universe has been subdued.
Placing the cuckoo-drum atop the lordly elephant of a mango tree,

sanskrit_iast:
poṣayāmāsa vijayaṃ manmathasya purepure ..
śaśāṃkaśekharaḥ ko'yaṃ koyaṃ śaṃkhagadādharaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
पोषयामास विजयं मन्मथस्य पुरेपुरे ..
शशांकशेखरः कोऽयं कोयं शंखगदाधरः .. 8 ..
text_mt:
he fostered the victory of the Love-god in every single city:
“Who is this Moon-crested Lord? Who is this wielder of the conch and mace?

sanskrit_iast:
koyaṃ ca ḍimbo vā brahmā kāmastrijagatāṃ prabhuḥ ..
prāyaḥ krīḍāratirloko vasaṃtavacanātpunaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
कोयं च डिम्बो वा ब्रह्मा कामस्त्रिजगतां प्रभुः ..
प्रायः क्रीडारतिर्लोको वसंतवचनात्पुनः .. 9 ..
text_mt:
Who is this mere child, or Brahmā? Kāma is the master of the three worlds!”
People are almost entirely devoted to pleasure on account of Spring's command.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvabāhustu narnarti tāladattapadakramaḥ ..
vyavasāyaṃ na gacchaṃti ye saṃhṛtya vanāṃtaram .. 4.134.10 ..
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वबाहुस्तु नर्नर्ति तालदत्तपदक्रमः ..
व्यवसायं न गच्छंति ये संहृत्य वनांतरम् .. 4.134.10 ..
text_mt:
With upraised arms they dance, stepping in time to the rhythm.
Even those who had retired into the deep forest no longer engage in ascetic effort;

sanskrit_iast:
gāyaṃtaśca parīhṛṣṭāste cāpyāyāṃti yāṃti ca ..
gopyasīmāṃtaragatāḥ kṣetrasthānasya rakṣiṇaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
गायंतश्च परीहृष्टास्ते चाप्यायांति यांति च ..
गोप्यसीमांतरगताः क्षेत्रस्थानस्य रक्षिणः .. 11 ..
text_mt:
rejoicing and singing, they too come and go.
The guards of the fields, who have reached the boundary lands of the cowherdesses,

sanskrit_iast:
te'pi gāyaṃti nṛtyaṃti hasaṃti smaratārakāḥ ..
karasya tāḍane'tyarthaṃ murajo dhurdharāyate .. 12 ..
meaning:
तेऽपि गायंति नृत्यंति हसंति स्मरतारकाः ..
करस्य ताडनेऽत्यर्थं मुरजो धुर्धरायते .. 12 ..
text_mt:
they too sing, dance, and laugh, with eyes full of love.
Under the heavy beating of hands, the drum roars incessantly.

sanskrit_iast:
viṭaṃ paśyaṃti kulaṭāḥ prārabdhocitapaṇḍitāḥ ..
sumanāṃsi susaṃgītanṛtyavādyasuvāditam .. 13 ..
meaning:
विटं पश्यंति कुलटाः प्रारब्धोचितपण्डिताः ..
सुमनांसि सुसंगीतनृत्यवाद्यसुवादितम् .. 13 ..
text_mt:
Unchaste women gaze upon paramours, skilled in what is timely and initiated;
[their] minds delight in sweet singing, dancing, and the playing of musical instruments.

sanskrit_iast:
evametattriloke'sminniti vyavasito janaḥ ..
lalallambastanīṃ dṛṣṭvā jarā yoṣāpi nṛtyati .. 14 ..
meaning:
एवमेतत्त्रिलोकेऽस्मिन्निति व्यवसितो जनः ..
ललल्लम्बस्तनीं दृष्ट्वा जरा योषापि नृत्यति .. 14 ..
text_mt:
In this way, people in these three worlds are fully engaged in this.
Seeing her dangling, drooping breasts, even an old woman dances!

sanskrit_iast:
vasaṃtasya prabhāvo'yaṃ ko'pyapūrvo vijṛṃbhate ..
sarāṃsyadbhutapadmāni praphullā puṣpavāṭikāḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
वसंतस्य प्रभावोऽयं कोऽप्यपूर्वो विजृंभते ..
सरांस्यद्भुतपद्मानि प्रफुल्ला पुष्पवाटिकाः .. 15 ..
text_mt:
Such an extraordinary, unprecedented power of Spring manifests itself:
lakes with wondrous lotuses, flower gardens in full bloom,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkṣāḥ pakṣiśatākīrṇā vijighrāṇamukhāḥ surāḥ ..
vikaṃpavasanāvālaḥ pavanastriguṇātmakaḥ ..16..
meaning:
वृक्षाः पक्षिशताकीर्णा विजिघ्राणमुखाः सुराः ..
विकंपवसनावालः पवनस्त्रिगुणात्मकः ..16..
text_mt:
trees thronged with hundreds of birds, gods with smelling faces,
and the three-natured wind stirring the garments and hair.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaḥ pratyakṣasumahānvasaṃto na jagattraye ..
avajalpamukhā bālā vṛddhāstu vikaladvijāḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
कृतः प्रत्यक्षसुमहान्वसंतो न जगत्त्रये ..
अवजल्पमुखा बाला वृद्धास्तु विकलद्विजाः .. 17 ..
text_mt:
Has not an exceedingly great Spring been made visible in the three worlds?
Children with babbling mouths, and the aged with failing teeth,

sanskrit_iast:
ubhāvapi pratapyete paśyedaṃ kāmaceṣṭitam ..
pakṣiṇāṃ pakṣanikṣepairnadyastuṃgataraṃgakaiḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
उभावपि प्रतप्येते पश्येदं कामचेष्टितम् ..
पक्षिणां पक्षनिक्षेपैर्नद्यस्तुंगतरंगकैः .. 18 ..
text_mt:
both are tormented—behold this doing of Kāma!
With the flapping of the wings of birds, with the rivers' soaring waves,

sanskrit_iast:
pādapāḥ pallavaśatairnṛtyaṃte ca praharṣiṇaḥ ..
etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ nāradasyenduśekharaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
पादपाः पल्लवशतैर्नृत्यंते च प्रहर्षिणः ..
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं नारदस्येन्दुशेखरः .. 19 ..
text_mt:
and the trees with hundreds of sprouts, they dance in great joy.
Having heard these words of Nārada, the Moon-crested Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
kautukākulitaḥ śīghramāruroha rathaṃ svakam ..
rathena kāñcanāṃgena patatrivaraketanaḥ .. 4.134.20 ..
meaning:
कौतुकाकुलितः शीघ्रमारुरोह रथं स्वकम् ..
रथेन काञ्चनांगेन पतत्रिवरकेतनः .. 4.134.20 ..
text_mt:
filled with curiosity, swiftly mounted his own chariot.
Upon a chariot with golden limbs, he whose emblem is the best of birds,

sanskrit_iast:
prayayau puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ ..
pārāvatapratīkāśaṃ caturvedamayaṃ ratham .. 21 ..
meaning:
प्रययौ पुण्डरीकाक्षः शंखचक्रगदाधरः ..
पारावतप्रतीकाशं चतुर्वेदमयं रथम् .. 21 ..
text_mt:
the lotus-eyed wielder of the conch, discus, and mace, set forth;
mounting a chariot resembling a dove and consisting of the four Vedas,

sanskrit_iast:
āsthāya prayayau hṛṣṭo brahmā brāhmaṇasaṃstutaḥ ..
munibhiścāpsarobhiśca yakṣarakṣomahoragaiḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
आस्थाय प्रययौ हृष्टो ब्रह्मा ब्राह्मणसंस्तुतः ..
मुनिभिश्चाप्सरोभिश्च यक्षरक्षोमहोरगैः .. 22 ..
text_mt:
delighted Brahmā, praised by Brahmins, set forth,
surrounded by sages, apsarases, yakṣas, rakṣasas, and great serpents.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛto rathena prayayau bhāskaro vāritaskaraḥ ..
śailajorupatākena rathenādityavarcasā .. 23 ..
meaning:
वृतो रथेन प्रययौ भास्करो वारितस्करः ..
शैलजोरुपताकेन रथेनादित्यवर्चसा .. 23 ..
text_mt:
Mounted on a chariot, the Sun, who drives away thieves, set forth.
In a chariot with the splendour of the sun and with the large banner of the Mountain's Daughter,

sanskrit_iast:
kātyāyanī pracalitā pañcavaktreṇa ketunā ..
laṃbodaraḥ karaśatagṛhītakanakotpalaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
कात्यायनी प्रचलिता पञ्चवक्त्रेण केतुना ..
लंबोदरः करशतगृहीतकनकोत्पलः .. 24 ..
text_mt:
Kātyāyanī set out, with her five-faced emblem.
The pot-bellied god, holding golden lotuses in hundreds of hands,

sanskrit_iast:
prayātaḥ svarathārūḍhaḥ kṛtakarṇakulākulaḥ ..
evaṃ devaḥ parivṛto bhagavāngovṛṣadhvajaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
प्रयातः स्वरथारूढः कृतकर्णकुलाकुलः ..
एवं देवः परिवृतो भगवान्गोवृषध्वजः .. 25 ..
text_mt:
mounted upon his chariot, with ears flapping busily, departed.
Thus surrounded, the blessed god whose banner bears the bull,

sanskrit_iast:
rathārūḍhairamūḍhātmā martyalokamavātarat ..
yāvatpaśyati deveśastāvatsarvaṃ tadakṣaram .. 26 ..
meaning:
रथारूढैरमूढात्मा मर्त्यलोकमवातरत् ..
यावत्पश्यति देवेशस्तावत्सर्वं तदक्षरम् .. 26 ..
text_mt:
unbewildered in mind, descended to the mortal world accompanied by those mounted on chariots.
As soon as the lord of gods looked, everything was indeed indestructible;

sanskrit_iast:
nāradena yathaivoktastāvatsarvaṃ tadakṣaram ..
nāradena yathaivoktaṃ jagadānandanirbharam .. 27 ..
meaning:
नारदेन यथैवोक्तस्तावत्सर्वं तदक्षरम् ..
नारदेन यथैवोक्तं जगदानन्दनिर्भरम् .. 27 ..
text_mt:
just as was spoken by Nārada, so was everything without fail;
just as was spoken by Nārada, the world was filled with bliss.

sanskrit_iast:
devaiḥ sārddhaṃ paśupatiryāvatpaśyati vismitaḥ ..
tāvattasyaiva hi gaṇāḥ parabrahmasamaṃjasam .. 28 ..
meaning:
देवैः सार्द्धं पशुपतिर्यावत्पश्यति विस्मितः ..
तावत्तस्यैव हि गणाः परब्रह्मसमंजसम् .. 28 ..
text_mt:
While Paśupati, astonished, looked on together with the gods,
right then his very own gaṇas, properly attuned to the supreme Brahman,

sanskrit_iast:
gāyaṃti kecitsotkaṃṭhaṃ luṭhaṃtyanye praharṣitāḥ ..
vādayaṃtyapare tuṣṭā jahasuḥ kecidulbaṇam .. 29 ..
meaning:
गायंति केचित्सोत्कंठं लुठंत्यन्ये प्रहर्षिताः ..
वादयंत्यपरे तुष्टा जहसुः केचिदुल्बणम् .. 29 ..
text_mt:
some were singing with longing, others were rolling on the ground in joy,
others, contented, were playing instruments, and some laughed boisterously.

sanskrit_iast:
vādayaṃtyanyathā vādyaṃ gāyaṃtyanyenyathā gaṇāḥ ..
anyenyathā pranṛtyaṃti citraṃ caitrasya ceṣṭitam .. 4.134.30 ..
meaning:
वादयंत्यन्यथा वाद्यं गायंत्यन्येन्यथा गणाः ..
अन्येन्यथा प्रनृत्यंति चित्रं चैत्रस्य चेष्टितम् .. 4.134.30 ..
text_mt:
The gaṇas played instruments in unusual ways, others sang in strange fashions,
and others danced in varied styles—wondrous was the sport of Caitra!

sanskrit_iast:
nīlotpalābhanayanairvilasatprāṃtatārakaiḥ ..
krīḍāratibhirārabdhamālāpaiśca surairapi .. 31 ..
meaning:
नीलोत्पलाभनयनैर्विलसत्प्रांततारकैः ..
क्रीडारतिभिरारब्धमालापैश्च सुरैरपि .. 31 ..
text_mt:
With eyes like blue lotuses, their outer pupils sparkling,
even the gods began to converse, delighting in playful revelry.

sanskrit_iast:
surāṇāṃ kṣobhamālakṣya bhagavāngovṛṣadhvajaḥ ..
cintayāmāsa sumahānkāryayogo hyupasthitaḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
सुराणां क्षोभमालक्ष्य भगवान्गोवृषध्वजः ..
चिन्तयामास सुमहान्कार्ययोगो ह्युपस्थितः .. 32 ..
text_mt:
Observing the agitation of the gods, the blessed Lord whose banner bears the bull
thought: “A great confluence of duties is indeed present.”

sanskrit_iast:
anarthamutthitaṃ tadvattadvighātāya ye janāḥ ..
nayaṃte ye'timūrkhatvādāpado'bhibhavaṃti tān .. 33 ..
meaning:
अनर्थमुत्थितं तद्वत्तद्विघाताय ये जनाः ..
नयंते येऽतिमूर्खत्वादापदोऽभिभवंति तान् .. 33 ..
text_mt:
“Those people who bring about calamity that has arisen, or who out of extreme foolishness
do nothing to avert it, calamities overcome them.

sanskrit_iast:
vasaṃtaḥ svāmibhaktatvānmānyapuṣpākaraṃ yadā ..
unmādāḍhyajano rakṣyaḥ kāryaṃ kāryadvayaṃ mama .. 34 ..
meaning:
वसंतः स्वामिभक्तत्वान्मान्यपुष्पाकरं यदा ..
उन्मादाढ्यजनो रक्ष्यः कार्यं कार्यद्वयं मम .. 34 ..
text_mt:
Since Spring is devoted to his master, the spring season is to be honoured;
and people filled with madness must be protected: I have two tasks to perform.”

sanskrit_iast:
saṃciṃtyaivaṃ samānāyya vasaṃtaṃ prāha śaṃkaraḥ ..
samānīto māsamekaṃ sthātavyaṃ bhavatā tviha .. 35 ..
meaning:
संचिंत्यैवं समानाय्य वसंतं प्राह शंकरः ..
समानीतो मासमेकं स्थातव्यं भवता त्विह .. 35 ..
text_mt:
Having thus reflected and summoned Spring, Śaṅkara said to him:
“You have been brought here; you must remain in this place for one month.

sanskrit_iast:
sitapakṣaḥ sahāyo'yaṃ sarvabhūtasukhapradaḥ ..
bhavatyatimahānando viśeṣeṇa divaukasām .. 36 ..
meaning:
सितपक्षः सहायोऽयं सर्वभूतसुखप्रदः ..
भवत्यतिमहानन्दो विशेषेण दिवौकसाम् .. 36 ..
text_mt:
This companion, the bright fortnight, gives happiness to all beings;
and an exceedingly great joy arises, especially for the heaven-dwellers.

sanskrit_iast:
yo yathā rathamārūḍhaḥ samāyātaḥ samīkṣitum ..
varṣevarṣe sa tenaiva saṃsthānenāgamiṣyati .. 37 ..
meaning:
यो यथा रथमारूढः समायातः समीक्षितुम् ..
वर्षेवर्षे स तेनैव संस्थानेनागमिष्यति .. 37 ..
text_mt:
Whosoever came mounted on a chariot to observe [this spectacle],
he shall arrive year after year in that very same manner.

sanskrit_iast:
kārayiṣyanti ye martyā rathayātrāmahotsavam ..
te divyabhogabhoktāro bhaviṣyanti nirāmayāḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
कारयिष्यन्ति ये मर्त्या रथयात्रामहोत्सवम् ..
ते दिव्यभोगभोक्तारो भविष्यन्ति निरामयाः .. 38 ..
text_mt:
Those mortals who perform the great festival of the chariot procession
shall enjoy divine pleasures and be free from affliction.”

sanskrit_iast:
evamābhāṣya bhagavānvasaṃtaṃ ca tataḥ suraiḥ ..
saṃstuto'tha nataścāpi svasthānamagamattataḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
एवमाभाष्य भगवान्वसंतं च ततः सुरैः ..
संस्तुतोऽथ नतश्चापि स्वस्थानमगमत्ततः .. 39 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus to Spring, the blessed Lord, praised and bowed to
by the gods, then went to his own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
rathaḥ kimātmakaḥ kāryaḥ kāryā yātrā kathaṃ bhavet ..
āropayetkathaṃ devānrathe vada jagatpate .. 4.134.40 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
रथः किमात्मकः कार्यः कार्या यात्रा कथं भवेत् ..
आरोपयेत्कथं देवान्रथे वद जगत्पते .. 4.134.40 ..
text_mt:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Of what nature should the chariot be made? How should the procession be carried out?
How should one mount the gods upon the chariot? Speak, O Lord of the universe!

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
suvicitraṃ citratanuṃ śreṣṭhakāṣṭhamayaṃ ratham ..
sudṛḍhākṣaṃ dṛḍhābaṃdhaṃ sucakrarathakūbaram .. 41 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
सुविचित्रं चित्रतनुं श्रेष्ठकाष्ठमयं रथम् ..
सुदृढाक्षं दृढाबंधं सुचक्ररथकूबरम् .. 41 ..

sanskrit_iast:
atha vā vaṃśavihitaṃ netrapaṭṭapaṭāvṛtam ..
tārakāśatacitrāṃśaṃ puṣpamālāvibhūṣitam .. 42 ..
meaning:
अथ वा वंशविहितं नेत्रपट्टपटावृतम् ..
तारकाशतचित्रांशं पुष्पमालाविभूषितम् .. 42 ..
text_mt:
or else made of bamboo, covered with fine silk cloth,
patterned with hundreds of stars, and adorned with flower garlands;

sanskrit_iast:
sitagoyugasaṃyuktaṃ pañcabāṇapatākinam ..
chatracāmaraśobhāḍhyaṃ sthāpayedbhavanāṅgaṇe .. 43 ..
meaning:
सितगोयुगसंयुक्तं पञ्चबाणपताकिनम् ..
छत्रचामरशोभाढ्यं स्थापयेद्भवनाङ्गणे .. 43 ..
text_mt:
yoked with a pair of white cattle, bearing the banner of the Five-Arrowed One,
richly adorned with royal parasols and chowries, one should set it up in the courtyard of the house.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśvadevaṃ tataḥ kuryādgrahayajñavidhānataḥ ..
catuścaraṇakairmaṃtrairvipra śāntikapauṣṭikaiḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
वैश्वदेवं ततः कुर्याद्ग्रहयज्ञविधानतः ..
चतुश्चरणकैर्मंत्रैर्विप्र शान्तिकपौष्टिकैः .. 44 ..
text_mt:
Then, O Brahmin, one should perform the Vaiśvadeva rite according to the rule of the planetary sacrifice,
with four-footed mantras that bring peace and prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
āropayedrathe devaṃ mūlamaṃtreṇa maṃtravit ..
vedoktairathapaurāṇairgaṃdhadhūpādhivāsite .. 45 ..
meaning:
आरोपयेद्रथे देवं मूलमंत्रेण मंत्रवित् ..
वेदोक्तैरथपौराणैर्गंधधूपाधिवासिते .. 45 ..
text_mt: The knower of mantras should place the god onto the chariot with the root mantra, / [and] with Vedic and Purāṇic [mantras], when it has been fumigated with fragrant incenses.

sanskrit_iast:
rathe tiṣṭhannayati vājinaḥ puro yatrayatra kāmayate suṣārathiḥ ..
abhīṣūṇāṃ mahimānaṃ panāyata manuḥ paścādanuyacchanti raśmayaḥ..
śaṃkhaduṃdubhinirghoṣaiḥ kāhalānāṃ ca niḥsvanaiḥ..
hastadīpaiḥ prajvalitaistālakolāhā lena ca .. 47 ..
meaning:
रथे तिष्ठन्नयति वाजिनः पुरो यत्रयत्र कामयते सुषारथिः ..
अभीषूणां महिमानं पनायत मनुः पश्चादनुयच्छन्ति रश्मयः..
शंखदुंदुभिनिर्घोषैः काहलानां च निःस्वनैः..
हस्तदीपैः प्रज्वलितैस्तालकोलाहा लेन च .. 47 ..
text_mt: Standing in the chariot, the skilled charioteer leads the horses forward wherever he desires; / praise the greatness of the reins, the mantra [says], and the rays follow behind. / With the roaring sounds of conchs and war drums, with the blasts of trumpets, / with burning hand-held torches, and with the clamour of cymbals,

sanskrit_iast:
doṣāsukhena ramitaṃ preṣaṇīyapuraḥsaram ..
mahatotsavabhāreṇa bhrāmayetparito ratham..48..
meaning:
दोषासुखेन रमितं प्रेषणीयपुरःसरम् ..
महतोत्सवभारेण भ्रामयेत्परितो रथम्..48..
text_mt: delighted with nocturnal pleasure, preceded by theatrical troupes, / he should drive the chariot all around with the weight of a great festival.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃbūlāni rathe dadyātpuṣpamālāyutāni ca ..
rathavoḍhraṃ pradadyāttu prekṣakebhyo'pyavāritam .. 49 ..
meaning:
तांबूलानि रथे दद्यात्पुष्पमालायुतानि च ..
रथवोढ्रं प्रदद्यात्तु प्रेक्षकेभ्योऽप्यवारितम् .. 49 ..
text_mt: He should present betels in the chariot, together with garlands of flowers; / he should also give [them] without hindrance to the chariot-drawers and to the onlookers.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyayasya gṛhebhyeti prerito rathinā rathaḥ..
tasya tasya bhavetpūjyaḥ puṣpadhūpākṣatādibhiḥ ... .. 4.134.50 ..
meaning:
यस्ययस्य गृहेभ्येति प्रेरितो रथिना रथः..
तस्य तस्य भवेत्पूज्यः पुष्पधूपाक्षतादिभिः ... .. 4.134.50 ..
text_mt: To whichever house the chariot, impelled by the charioteer, approaches, / by him it must be worshipped with flowers, incenses, unbroken grains, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
itaro'pi bhavetpūjyaḥ saṃprāpte gṛhiṇāṃ gṛhe ..
kiṃ punarjagatāṃ bhartā sarvalokamaheśvaraḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
इतरोऽपि भवेत्पूज्यः संप्राप्ते गृहिणां गृहे ..
किं पुनर्जगतां भर्ता सर्वलोकमहेश्वरः .. 51 ..
text_mt: Even an ordinary person must be honoured when he arrives at the house of householders; / how much more so the lord of the worlds, the supreme lord of all the worlds?

sanskrit_iast:
kadācidakṣabhaṅgaḥ syāddhvajabhaṃgo'tha vā bhavet..
bhajyeta vā yugamadhye nahanaṃ truṭyate yadi .. 52 ..
meaning:
कदाचिदक्षभङ्गः स्याद्ध्वजभंगोऽथ वा भवेत्..
भज्येत वा युगमध्ये नहनं त्रुट्यते यदि .. 52 ..
text_mt: If at any time an axle should break, or the banner should break, / or if [the chariot] should break in the middle of the yoke, or the fastening tear,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāṃstatra saṃpūjya homaḥ kāryo vijānatā ..
tilairājyena payasā yena saṃpadyate sukham .. .. 53 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणांस्तत्र संपूज्य होमः कार्यो विजानता ..
तिलैराज्येन पयसा येन संपद्यते सुखम् .. .. 53 ..
text_mt: having worshipped the brāhmaṇas there, an oblation should be made by one who understands, / with sesamum, clarified butter, and milk, so that well-being may be attained.

sanskrit_iast:
preraṇīprekṣaṇīyaiśca bhrāmayitvā rathottamam ..
sthāpayennagarasyāṃtastatra kuryānmahotsavam .. 54 ..
meaning:
प्रेरणीप्रेक्षणीयैश्च भ्रामयित्वा रथोत्तमम् ..
स्थापयेन्नगरस्यांतस्तत्र कुर्यान्महोत्सवम् .. 54 ..
text_mt: Having driven the excellent chariot around with performers and spectacles, / he should station it inside the city, and perform a great festival there.

sanskrit_iast:
dolāgrāhaiścakradolābhramairḍamarakaistathā ..
vidyādharīṇāṃ caritamitarābhiḥ prakāśyate .. 55 ..
meaning:
दोलाग्राहैश्चक्रदोलाभ्रमैर्डमरकैस्तथा ..
विद्याधरीणां चरितमितराभिः प्रकाश्यते .. 55 ..
text_mt: With swing-seats, rotating Ferris wheels, and damarus, / the deeds of Vidyādharīs are displayed by other women.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha sukhadaṃ tu rathotsavam ..
tathaiva pūjayetpārtha upavāsaparo naraḥ .. 56 ...
meaning:
एवं यः कुरुते पार्थ सुखदं तु रथोत्सवम् ..
तथैव पूजयेत्पार्थ उपवासपरो नरः .. 56 ...
text_mt: Whoever performs in this way, O Pārtha, this chariot-festival that grants happiness, / and in that very way, O Pārtha, a man intent on fasting worships,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavyādhivihīnaśca sukhī syāccharadāṃ śatam ..
yaḥ kārayitvā sauvarṇaṃ raupyaṃ vā rathamuttamam .. 57 ..
meaning:
सर्वव्याधिविहीनश्च सुखी स्याच्छरदां शतम् ..
यः कारयित्वा सौवर्णं रौप्यं वा रथमुत्तमम् .. 57 ..
text_mt: he becomes free of all diseases and happy for a hundred autumns. / He who, having had an excellent chariot made of gold or silver,

sanskrit_iast:
varṇakaiścitritaṃ divyaṃ dārujaṃ vā suśobhanam..
svahastaracitaṃ yaśca bhāskarāya nivedayet .. 58 ..
meaning:
वर्णकैश्चित्रितं दिव्यं दारुजं वा सुशोभनम्..
स्वहस्तरचितं यश्च भास्कराय निवेदयेत् .. 58 ..
text_mt: or a divine one painted with pigments, or a very beautiful wooden one, / crafted with his own hands, presents it to the Sun,

sanskrit_iast:
sa martyaloke sucirātsukhāni ca samaśnute ..
pūrvoktavidhinā bhānuṃ bhrāmayitvā rathe sthitam .. .. 59 ..
meaning:
स मर्त्यलोके सुचिरात्सुखानि च समश्नुते ..
पूर्वोक्तविधिना भानुं भ्रामयित्वा रथे स्थितम् .. .. 59 ..
text_mt: enjoys pleasures for a very long time in the world of mortals. / Having driven the Sun stationed in the chariot in the manner stated before,

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpayetsarvabhāge tu geyaṃ vādyapuraḥsaram ..
dakṣiṇe tu diśo bhāge dvitīye'hni nayedratham .. 4.134.60 ..
meaning:
स्थापयेत्सर्वभागे तु गेयं वाद्यपुरःसरम् ..
दक्षिणे तु दिशो भागे द्वितीयेऽह्नि नयेद्रथम् .. 4.134.60 ..
text_mt: he should station it on every side, preceded by singing and instrumental music; / and on the second day he should take the chariot to the southern quarter.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpi jāgaraṃ kuryādvādyagītasumaṃ galaiḥ ..
aparāyāṃ tṛtīye'hni sthāpayedrathamuttamam .. 61 ..
meaning:
तत्रापि जागरं कुर्याद्वाद्यगीतसुमं गलैः ..
अपरायां तृतीयेऽह्नि स्थापयेद्रथमुत्तमम् .. 61 ..
text_mt: There too he should keep a vigil with auspicious instrumental music and songs; / on the third day he should station the excellent chariot in the western [quarter].

sanskrit_iast:
prekṣaṇīyavinodena tāṃ rātrimativāhayet ..
sthāpayeduttarasyāṃ tu caturthe divase ratham .. ..62 ..
meaning:
प्रेक्षणीयविनोदेन तां रात्रिमतिवाहयेत् ..
स्थापयेदुत्तरस्यां तु चतुर्थे दिवसे रथम् .. ..62 ..
text_mt: He should pass that night with the diversion of theatrical spectacles; / and on the fourth day he should station the chariot in the northern [quarter].

sanskrit_iast:
mahāyātrāṃ prakurvīta tatrāpyadbhutaceṣṭitam ..
paṃcame divase prāpte nagarāṃtasthitaṃ ravim .. 63
meaning:
महायात्रां प्रकुर्वीत तत्राप्यद्भुतचेष्टितम् ..
पंचमे दिवसे प्राप्ते नगरांतस्थितं रविम् .. 63
text_mt: He should perform a great procession, wonderful in its actions, there too; / when the fifth day has arrived, [for] the Sun stationed at the edge of the city,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā vidhānena ṣaṣṭhe'hni bhavanaṃ nayet ..
rathayātrāprasaṃgena kathitā rathasaptamī .. 64 ..
meaning:
पूजयित्वा विधानेन षष्ठेऽह्नि भवनं नयेत् ..
रथयात्राप्रसंगेन कथिता रथसप्तमी .. 64 ..
text_mt: having worshipped him according to the rules, he should bring him home on the sixth day. / In connection with the chariot procession, Rathasaptamī has been spoken of.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpaharā puṇyā kiñcidanyannibodha me ..
gaurī pūjyā tṛtīyāyāṃ caturthyāṃ vighnanāyakaḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
सर्वपापहरा पुण्या किञ्चिदन्यन्निबोध मे ..
गौरी पूज्या तृतीयायां चतुर्थ्यां विघ्ननायकः .. 65 ..
text_mt: It removes all sins and is holy. Learn something else from me: / Gaurī is to be worshipped on the third [lunar day], and the leader of obstacles on the fourth.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamyāṃ paṃkajakarāṃ pūjayedvā sarasvatīm ..
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śaktidharaṃ skandaṃ saptamyāṃ tu divākaram .. 66 ..
meaning:
पञ्चम्यां पंकजकरां पूजयेद्वा सरस्वतीम् ..
षष्ठ्यां शक्तिधरं स्कन्दं सप्तम्यां तु दिवाकरम् .. 66 ..
text_mt: On the fifth he should worship the lotus-handed Sarasvatī; / on the sixth, Skanda who bears the spear; and on the seventh, the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ sampūjyaḥ śaśiśekharaḥ ..
navamyāṃ pūjayeccaṇḍīṃ cāmuṇḍāṃ muṇḍamālinīm .. 67 ..
meaning:

नवम्यां पूजयेच्चण्डीं चामुण्डां मुण्डमालिनीम् .. 67 ..
text_mt: On the eighth and on the fourteenth, the Moon-crested Lord is to be worshipped; / on the ninth he should worship Caṇḍī, Cāmuṇḍā, garlanded with severed heads.

sanskrit_iast:
daśamyāmṛṣayaḥ śāṃtāḥ sarve vyāsapurassarāḥ ..
ekādaśyāṃ cakrapāṇiṃ dvādaśyāṃ vā samarcayet..68..
meaning:
दशम्यामृषयः शांताः सर्वे व्यासपुरस्सराः ..
एकादश्यां चक्रपाणिं द्वादश्यां वा समर्चयेत्..68..
text_mt: On the tenth, the tranquil sages, all headed by Vyāsa, [are to be worshipped]; / on the eleventh or on the twelfth he should worship the Discus-handed Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
trayodaśyāṃ trinetrotthavahninā śāṃtavigraham..
sādhāraṇī tu sarveṣāṃ paurṇamāsī tithiḥ smṛtā..69..
meaning:
त्रयोदश्यां त्रिनेत्रोत्थवह्निना शांतविग्रहम्..
साधारणी तु सर्वेषां पौर्णमासी तिथिः स्मृता..69..
text_mt: On the thirteenth, him whose form was pacified by the fire arising from the Three-Eyed Lord [is to be worshipped]; / and the full moon day is considered common to all.

sanskrit_iast:
āṃdolake madanake rathayātrāsu caiva hi..
vyutkrameṇāpi kartavyā tithīnāṃ kāryagauravāt..
yātrā vāsaṃtikī ceyaṃ cittasvāsthyakarī parā..4.134.70..
meaning:
आंदोलके मदनके रथयात्रासु चैव हि..
व्युत्क्रमेणापि कर्तव्या तिथीनां कार्यगौरवात्..
यात्रा वासंतिकी चेयं चित्तस्वास्थ्यकरी परा..4.134.70..
text_mt: In swing rites, Madana rites, and in chariot processions, / [the worship] may be performed even out of order, on account of the importance of the rite among the lunar days; / and this vernal procession is supreme, producing peace of mind.

sanskrit_iast:
samyaksudhādhavalite bhavane surāṇāmaṃtassuvastramaṇimauktikadānacitre ..
tāṃbūlakakramukavāravilāsinībhiryātrāṃ vidhāya bhavatīha sa bhārateśaḥ .. .. 71 .. ..

text_mt:
Having celebrated the procession in the temple of the gods, properly whitened with lime, decorated within by gifts of fine clothes, gems, and pearls, with betel, areca nuts, and courtesans, he becomes a lord of Bhārata in this world.
Description of the Great Festival of Madana

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..

title: Madanamahotsavavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādibhiḥ samāmaṃtrya vibudhaiḥ putralabdhaye ..
gauryā manobhilaṣitapūraṇāya praharṣitaiḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मादिभिः समामंत्र्य विबुधैः पुत्रलब्धये ..
गौर्या मनोभिलषितपूरणाय प्रहर्षितैः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Having deliberated, the gods headed by Brahmā, rejoiced, / in order to obtain a son and to fulfil Gaurī’s heart's desire,

sanskrit_iast:
prahitaḥ kṣobhaṇārthāya samartha iti manmathaḥ..
tato māraḥ smaraḥ kāmopyājagāma tamāśramam .. 3 ..
meaning:
प्रहितः क्षोभणार्थाय समर्थ इति मन्मथः..
ततो मारः स्मरः कामोप्याजगाम तमाश्रमम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: dispatched Manmatha, [thinking] he was capable, in order to agitate [him]; / then Māra, Smara, who is Kāma, went to that hermitage,

sanskrit_iast:
ratiprītimadonmādavasaṃtaśrīsahāyavān ..
nidhānavāruṇīdarpaśṛṃgāraiḥ parivāritaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
रतिप्रीतिमदोन्मादवसंतश्रीसहायवान् ..
निधानवारुणीदर्पशृंगारैः परिवारितः .. 4 ..
text_mt: accompanied by Rati, Prīti, Mada, Unmāda, Spring, and Śrī; / surrounded by treasures, Vāruṇī, pride, and erotic passion;

sanskrit_iast:
āmrāśokavanottaṃso mālatīkṛtaśekharaḥ ..
vīṇāmṛdaṃgasaṃgītakokilāśṛṃgadūtakaḥ ..5..
meaning:
आम्राशोकवनोत्तंसो मालतीकृतशेखरः ..
वीणामृदंगसंगीतकोकिलाशृंगदूतकः ..5..
text_mt: with an ear-ornament of mango and aśoka groves, wearing a crest of jasmine flowers, / with lutes, mṛdaṅga drums, music, cuckoos, and horn-[trumpets] as his messengers;

sanskrit_iast:
jhallarīvādyasaṃghuṣṭabhāṃḍāgārikalekhakaḥ ..
pānamattāṅganārūḍho hindolāścaryamaṃtrimān .. 6 ..
meaning:
झल्लरीवाद्यसंघुष्टभांडागारिकलेखकः ..
पानमत्ताङ्गनारूढो हिन्दोलाश्चर्यमंत्रिमान् .. 6 ..
text_mt: with a treasurer and a scribe proclaimed by the playing of jhallarī cymbals, / mounted on a woman intoxicated with drink, possessing marvellous ministers for the swing;

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇānilagaṃdhāḍhyaḥ kaṭākṣekṣitavarṣavān ..
mahārājādhirājo vā smaraḥ prāpto harāṃtikam .. 7 ..
meaning:
दक्षिणानिलगंधाढ्यः कटाक्षेक्षितवर्षवान् ..
महाराजाधिराजो वा स्मरः प्राप्तो हरांतिकम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: rich in the fragrance of the southern wind, showering side-glances, / like a great emperor of kings, Smara arrived near Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
sa puṣpacāpamākṛṣya madanonmādanaṃ śaram ..
cikṣepa tripuraghnāya samādherbhaṃgahetave .. 8 ..
meaning:
स पुष्पचापमाकृष्य मदनोन्मादनं शरम् ..
चिक्षेप त्रिपुरघ्नाय समाधेर्भंगहेतवे .. 8 ..
text_mt: Drawing his flower-bow, he shot the arrow that intoxicates with passion / at the destroyer of Tripura, for the sake of breaking his meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
buddhvā taṃ tasya saṃkalpaṃ rudraḥ krodhājjvalanruṣā ..
lalāṭādvahnimasṛjattṛtīya nayanāddharaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
बुद्ध्वा तं तस्य संकल्पं रुद्रः क्रोधाज्ज्वलन्रुषा ..
ललाटाद्वह्निमसृजत्तृतीय नयनाद्धरः .. 9 ..
text_mt: Perceiving that intention of his, Rudra, blazing in fury from anger, / released fire from his forehead, from his third eye, [did] Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmo vilokitastena bhasmībhūtaśca tatkṣaṇāt ..
dagdhaṃ dṛṣṭvā smaraṃ śokādratiprītī sthite sadā .. 4.135.10 ..
meaning:
कामो विलोकितस्तेन भस्मीभूतश्च तत्क्षणात् ..
दग्धं दृष्ट्वा स्मरं शोकाद्रतिप्रीती स्थिते सदा .. 4.135.10 ..
text_mt: Kāma was looked upon by him and was turned to ashes that very instant; / seeing Smara burned, Rati and Prīti stood constantly in grief,

sanskrit_iast:
karuṇaṃ vilapaṃtyau te sarvamanyaddiśaṃ gatam ..
tataḥ śokārtahṛdayā gaurī rudramuvāca ha .. 11 ..
meaning:
करुणं विलपंत्यौ ते सर्वमन्यद्दिशं गतम् ..
ततः शोकार्तहृदया गौरी रुद्रमुवाच ह .. 11 ..
text_mt: lamenting piteously, while everyone else fled in every direction. / Then, her heart afflicted with sorrow, Gaurī spoke to Rudra:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavannasmadarthe taṃ kāmaṃ nirdagdhavānasi ..
tenaite paśya nāryau te kāmasya ruditaḥ katham .. 12 ..
meaning:
भगवन्नस्मदर्थे तं कामं निर्दग्धवानसि ..
तेनैते पश्य नार्यौ ते कामस्य रुदितः कथम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: “O Blessed One, for our sake you burnt Kāma to ashes; / therefore, look at these two women of Kāma, how they weep!

sanskrit_iast:
kuru prasādaṃ deveśa ratiprītye vṛṣadhvaja ..
saṃjīvaya smaraṃ śaṃbho mūrtimaṃtaṃ punaḥ kuru .. 13 ..
meaning:
कुरु प्रसादं देवेश रतिप्रीत्ये वृषध्वज ..
संजीवय स्मरं शंभो मूर्तिमंतं पुनः कुरु .. 13 ..
text_mt: Grant your favour, O Lord of gods, O bull-bannered Lord, for the sake of Rati and Prīti; / revive Smara, O Śambhu, make him embodied once again!”

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā tu mahādevo hṛṣṭaḥ provāca pārvatīm ..
upaplutaṃ jagatsarvaṃ manmathena śarīriṇā .. 14 ..
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा तु महादेवो हृष्टः प्रोवाच पार्वतीम् ..
उपप्लुतं जगत्सर्वं मन्मथेन शरीरिणा .. 14 ..
text_mt: Having heard that, Mahādeva, delighted, said to Pārvatī: / “The entire world was harassed by Manmatha when he had a body.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā dagdhasya kāmasya punarāgamanaṃ kutaḥ ..
kiṃ tu te mānayanvākyaṃ karomi saphalaṃ priye..15 ..
meaning:
मया दग्धस्य कामस्य पुनरागमनं कुतः ..
किं तु ते मानयन्वाक्यं करोमि सफलं प्रिये..15 ..
text_mt: Whence can there be a return of Kāma who was burned by me? / Yet, respecting your words, I shall make them fruitful, my beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
asminvasaṃtasamaye śuklapakṣe trayodaśī ..
asyāṃ manobhavo devi bhaviṣyati śarīravān .. 16 ..
meaning:
अस्मिन्वसंतसमये शुक्लपक्षे त्रयोदशी ..
अस्यां मनोभवो देवि भविष्यति शरीरवान् .. 16 ..
text_mt: In this spring season, on the thirteenth [tithi] of the bright fortnight, / on this day, O goddess, the Mind-born one will become embodied.

sanskrit_iast:
etena bījabhūtena jagadvarṇiṣyate'khilam ..
evaṃ varamimaṃ dattvā manmathāya yudhiṣṭhira ..17..
meaning:
एतेन बीजभूतेन जगद्वर्णिष्यतेऽखिलम् ..
एवं वरमिमं दत्त्वा मन्मथाय युधिष्ठिर ..17..
text_mt: With him as the seed-source, the entire world will be populated.' / Having given this boon to Manmatha in this way, O Yudhiṣṭhira,

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma himavacchṛṃgaṃ kailāsaṃ pārvatīpriyaḥ ..
tadetatsarvamākhyātaṃ smarasya caritaṃ nṛpa .. 18 ..
meaning:
जगाम हिमवच्छृंगं कैलासं पार्वतीप्रियः ..
तदेतत्सर्वमाख्यातं स्मरस्य चरितं नृप .. 18 ..
text_mt: the lover of Pārvatī went to Kailāsa, a peak of the Himavat. / Thus all this deed of Smara has been told, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjāvidhānamaparaṃ kathayāmi śṛṇuṇva tat ..
asyāṃ snātvā trayodaśyāmaśokākhyaṃ nagaṃ likhet .. 19 ..
meaning:
पूजाविधानमपरं कथयामि शृणुण्व तत् ..
अस्यां स्नात्वा त्रयोदश्यामशोकाख्यं नगं लिखेत् .. 19 ..
text_mt: I shall tell you another rule of worship; listen to it. / Having bathed on this thirteenth [tithi], one should draw the tree named aśoka;

sanskrit_iast:
sindūrajanitairaṃgairatiprīti samanvitam .
kāmadevaṃ vasaṃtaṃ ca vājivaktraṃ jhaṣadhvajam .. 4.135.20 ..
meaning:
सिन्दूरजनितैरंगैरतिप्रीति समन्वितम् .
कामदेवं वसंतं च वाजिवक्त्रं झषध्वजम् .. 4.135.20 ..
text_mt: with limbs created from vermilion, full of great affection, / [and draw] Kāmadeva and spring, horse-faced and with a fish-banner,

sanskrit_iast:
sauvarṇaṃ vā mahārāja vārkṣaṃ citramathāpi vā ..
līlāvilāsagamanaṃ garvitaṃ sāpsa rogaṇam ..21..
meaning:
सौवर्णं वा महाराज वार्क्षं चित्रमथापि वा ..
लीलाविलासगमनं गर्वितं साप्स रोगणम् ..21..
text_mt: or golden, O great king, wooden, or even painted, / moving with playful grace, proud, accompanied by a host of apsarases,

gandharvagītavāditraprekṣaṇīyasamākulam ..
naṃdyāvartiratikrīḍāprītividyādharairyutam ..22..
meaning:
गन्धर्वगीतवादित्रप्रेक्षणीयसमाकुलम् ..
नंद्यावर्तिरतिक्रीडाप्रीतिविद्याधरैर्युतम् ..22..
text_mt: crowded with gandharva songs, instrumental music, and dramatic spectacles, / and joined by Vidyādharas delighted with joyful play [like] the nandyāvarta.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyāhne bhojayedbhaktyā bhakṣyairdhūpaiḥsragaṃbaraiḥ..
maṃtreṇānena kauṃteya naro nāryā samanvitaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
मध्याह्ने भोजयेद्भक्त्या भक्ष्यैर्धूपैःस्रगंबरैः..
मंत्रेणानेन कौंतेय नरो नार्या समन्वितः .. 23 ..
text_mt: At midday, a man accompanied by his wife should worship [him] with devotion, / with sweets, incenses, garlands, and garments, using this mantra, O son of Kuntī:

sanskrit_iast:
namo vāmāya kāmāya devadevāya mūrtaye ..
brahmaviṣṇuśivendrāṇāṃ manaḥkṣobhakarāya vai .. 24 ..
meaning:
नमो वामाय कामाय देवदेवाय मूर्तये ..
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवेन्द्राणां मनःक्षोभकराय वै .. 24 ..
text_mt: 'Obeisance to Vāma, to Kāma, to the god of gods, to the embodied form, / indeed to the one who agitates the minds of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and Indra.'

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvaivamarcayitvā tu devadevamanobhavam ..
tatastasyāgrato deyā modakā mukhamodakāḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
कृत्वैवमर्चयित्वा तु देवदेवमनोभवम् ..
ततस्तस्याग्रतो देया मोदका मुखमोदकाः .. 25 ..
text_mt: Having thus worshipped the Mind-born god of gods, / modakas that delight the mouth should then be offered before him,

tato visarjayedviprāndattvā yugmaṃ sadakṣiṇam .. 26 ..
meaning:
नानाप्रकारान्भक्ष्यांश्च कामो मे प्रीयतामिति ..
ततो विसर्जयेद्विप्रान्दत्त्वा युग्मं सदक्षिणम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: and various kinds of food, saying: 'May Kāma be pleased with me.' / Then he should dismiss the brāhmaṇas after giving [them] a pair [of garments] with a fee.

sanskrit_iast:
svapatiṃ pūjayennārī vastramālāvibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
kāmo'yamiti saṃciṃtya prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā ..27..
meaning:
स्वपतिं पूजयेन्नारी वस्त्रमालाविभूषणैः ..
कामोऽयमिति संचिंत्य प्रहृष्टेनांतरात्मना ..27..
text_mt: A woman should worship her own husband with garments, garlands, and ornaments, / with a delighted inner self, thinking: 'He is Kāma.'

sanskrit_iast:

rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātsukharātriryathā bhavet .. 28 ..
meaning:
मन्मथायतने तस्मिन्यजमानः सुहृद्वृतः ..
रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्यात्सुखरात्रिर्यथा भवेत् .. 28 ..
text_mt: In that temple of Manmatha, the sacrificer, surrounded by friends, / should keep vigil at night so that it becomes a night of happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
karpūrakuṃkumakṣodagaṃdhatāṃbūlasarjanaiḥ ..

meaning:
कर्पूरकुंकुमक्षोदगंधतांबूलसर्जनैः ..
नानाप्रकारैर्भक्ष्यैश्च कुर्याद्रात्रौ महोत्सवम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: With camphor, saffron powder, fragrances, and gifts of betel, / and with various kinds of foods, he should hold a great festival at night,

sanskrit_iast:
