the son of Kaśyapa, known as immortal, the enemy of serpents, the mount of Viṣṇu, / immeasurable, invincible, the slayer of the foes of the gods,
Garutmān, who moves like the wind, stands close at hand upon you. / Protect the weapons, armour, arms, and warriors, and burn our enemies! (Thus the banner mantra.)
Kumuda, Airāvaṇa, Padma, Puṣpadanta, Vāmana, / Supratīka, Añjana, and Nīla—these eight are of divine origin.
Their sons and grandsons resorted to the eight army divisions: / bhadra, mandra, mṛga, and saṃkīrṇa elephants. / Born in every forest, they are the great elephants born of elephant stock.
May the Vasus, the Rudras, and the Ādityas together with the Marut hosts protect you! / Protect your master, O lord of elephants, observing your commitment!

For they attained victory in battle; in marching out, proceed with welfare for us! / May your splendour be from Soma, strength from Viṣṇu, radiance from Sūrya, speed from the wind, / steadfastness from Meru, victory from Rudra, and glory from King Indra!
May the celestial serpents and the directions along with their deities protect you in battle! / May the two Aśvins along with the Gandharvas protect you on all sides always! (Thus the elephant mantra.)
The Fire, the Vasus, the Rudras, the Wind, Soma, the great sages, / the nāgas, kinnaras, gandharvas, yakṣas, bhūta hosts, and planets,
the pramathas together with the Ādityas, the Lord of Bhūtas with the Mothers, / Skanda the commander of Indra's army, and Varuṇa—all reside in you.
May they burn all enemies; may the king attain victory! / Whatever sorceries have been directed against us on all sides by the enemies,
these of the enemy adversaries are destroyed by your splendour! / In the battle for the slaying of Kālanemi, in the battle for the destruction of Tripura,
in the battle with Hiraṇyakaśipu, and likewise in the battle between the gods and asuras, / you shone forth; likewise today, shine forth for the king!

पूतना रेवती नाम्ना कालरात्रीति या स्मृता ..
दहंत्वाशु रिपून्सर्वान्पताके त्वामुपागताः .. 64 .. (इति पताकामन्त्रः ..)

श्रीगर्भो विजयश्चैव धर्मधारस्तथैव च .. 69 ..
इत्यष्टौ तव नामानि स्वयमुक्तानि वेधसा ..

रक्ष मां रक्षणीयोऽहं तव वर्मन्नमोऽस्तु ते .. 68 .. ( इति वर्ममन्त्रः ..) ..
text_mt:
Having seen this blue and white [banner], may the king's enemies perish today, / vanquished in battle by dreadful, diverse afflictions and by weapons.
They became well at once, swept over by your breeze. 63.
She who is known as Pūtanā, Revatī by name, and Kālarātrī, / having approached you, O banner, may they swiftly burn all enemies. (Thus the mantra for the banner.)
Asi, Ripuhā, Khaḍga, Tīkṣṇakarmā, Durāsada, / Śrīgarbha, Vijaya, and also Dharmadhāra—
thus these eight names of yours were spoken by the Creator himself. / Your constellation is Kṛttikā, and your guru is the god Maheśvara.
Your body is gold, and your creator is the god Janārdana; / the god [Brahma], the Grandfather, is your father. Protect me always! (Thus the mantra for the sword.)
You grant peace in battle, for you are armour made entirely of iron. / Protect me, for I am to be protected by you; O armour, homage to you! (Thus the mantra for the armour.)

शूलायुधाद्विनिष्कृष्य कृत्वा मुष्टिपरिग्रहम् .. 75 ..
text_mt:
O war drum, you who make the hearts of adversaries tremble by your roaring, / be the enhancer of victory for the armies of the king.
Just as excellent elephants rejoice at the roar of a raincloud, / so let our joy, bringing gladness, arise from your sound.
Just as terror arises in women at the sound of a raincloud, / even so let our enemies tremble in battle at your sound. (Thus the mantra for the war drum.)
O commander of all weapons, slayer of all the enemies of the gods, / O bow, protect me always together with the finest arrows! (Thus the mantra for the bow.)
You are holy, O conch, the flower of all auspicious things and the auspiciousness of auspicious things, / held perpetually by Viṣṇu: grant peace of mind! (Thus the mantra for the conch.)
Resembling the moon’s rays, white as snow and foam, / swiftly dispel misfortune, O chowrie, beloved of the immortals! (Thus the mantra for the chowrie.)
You were fashioned by Pinākin as the foremost of all weapons, / pulled forth from the trident-weapon and provided with a hilt.

text_mt:
You were given to Caṇḍikā, O destroyer of all evil ones, / and thus you were expanded and delivered to the gods.
You have become a part of the bodies of all beings, / O dispeller of all inauspiciousness! / O dagger, protect me perpetually and grant peace! Homage to you! 77. (Thus the dagger mantra.)
For driving away the wicked and for protecting the virtuous, / and for the accomplishment of statecraft, you were fashioned by Brahmā.
Give fame, give happiness, be the protector of the king; / strike down all enemies swiftly, O golden sceptre, homage to you! (Thus the mantra for the golden sceptre.)
Vijaya, Jayada, Jetā, Ripughātī, Priyaṃkara, / Duḥkhahā, Dharmada, Śānta, Sarvāriṣṭavināśana—
because these eight lions of great strength are present in you, / therefore you are celebrated as a throne by the brahmins in the Vedas.
In you Śiva himself is seated; in you is Śakra, lord of the gods; / in you the god Hari is seated; for your sake asceticism is performed.

Homage to you who are auspicious on every side! Be the bestower of auspiciousness upon the king; / O entire substance of victory over the three worlds, O throne, homage to you! (Thus the mantra for the throne.)
Having performed this iron-lustration rite accompanied by mantras, / with fruits, food offerings, flowers, incenses, lamps, and ointments,
and having cleansed oneself on the aṣṭamī, one should take a bath in the forenoon.

text_mt:
(Now the prose passage:)
Having had an image of Durgā fashioned according to his means—golden, silver, brass, wooden, painted, or copper—placed within an ornamental arch of wood in a beautiful spot, with eyes directed forward, set in the middle of an ornate pavilion, bathed and her limbs anointed with saffron, sandalwood, perfumes, the fourfold unguent, and silken garments, having worshipped the goddess with flowers, the king, accompanied by priests, his fame proclaimed by many and bringing satisfaction to the brahmins, should himself present worship to the goddess with a bilva leaf, [reciting] this mantra:
(Thus ends the prose passage.)
Jayaṃtī, Maṅgalā, Kālī, Bhadrakālī, Kapālinī, / Durgā, Śivā, Kṣamā, Dhātrī, Svāhā, Svadhā: homage to you!
Born of ambrosia, the sacred bilva tree is ever dear to the Great Goddess. / I offer you this pure bilva leaf, O ruler of the gods!
Durgā should also be worshipped from that day on with droṇapuṣpa flowers, / for she is beloved of the ruler of the gods […].

text_mt:
Then, having bowed to the sword that crushes the pride of enemies, / the king should desire his own victory, kingdom, and abundance of food.
Then, having bowed repeatedly, he should meditate in his heart upon Śivā, / slayer of the buffalo, many-armed, a maiden riding a lion,
terrifying the dānavas, her hand raised with a sword, auspicious, / holding a bell and a rosary, Durgā standing at the commencement of battle.
Then, with shouts of victory, he should next make this hymn of praise:
O auspiciousness of all auspicious things, O Śivā, accomplisher of all aims, / refuge, three-eyed one, Gaurī, Nārāyaṇī, homage to you!
Anointed with saffron, smeared with sandalwood, / garlanded with bilva leaves, O Durgā, I have taken refuge in you.
Having performed the worship thus, O descendant of Kuru, on the aṣṭamī night he should keep vigil, / and have a great festival celebrated with actors, dances, and songs.
Having spent the night with joyful people in this manner, at dawn, when the sun rises, / he should strike down buffaloes and rams before [her], their necks bowed low,

May my sin together with its obstacles, and those who oppose me, be pacified; / may the ghosts and pretas be gentle, satisfied, and bringers of happiness!"
Thus he should parade the goddess Durgā standing on her chariot through the kingdom, / or on a palanquin, O son of Pṛthā, and then bring it to a close without obstacles.
Now, should obstacles arise, he should perform an appeasement of the spirits, / by which obstacles do not arise and the procession reaches completion.
Kings and other men too who carry out the procession in this manner / on Mahānavamī, the Nandā tithi, [obtain] sons and have joyful minds;
freed from all sins, they go to the city of the Goddess.

text_mt:
Neither the fire from a child's corpse, nor thieves, nor vināyakas / cause an obstacle for those with whom the Great Goddess is pleased, O king of kings.
Free from disease, happy, enjoying pleasures, and devoid of fear / become the men devoted to the Goddess—what more need be said?
Thus this great festival of the goddess Durgā has been fully related to you; / for those who read it and listen to it, it destroys all inauspiciousness.
Having worshipped Durgā on the navamī—who stands on the back of Mahiṣāsura pierced by the tip of her trident, whose arm-staffs have splendid armlets and a brandished sword, and who is followed by the five-faced [Śiva]—mortals cross over the most impassable depths.
Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-eighth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Mahānavamī Vrata', in the dialogue between Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Yudhiṣṭhira, in the Uttaraparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa. 138

पञ्चमं चाष्टकोणं तु शुक्लं धातुविचित्रितम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: The fourth is round like a cochineal insect and surrounded by the mothers. / The fifth has eight corners, is white, and is decorated with mineral pigments.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇakarṇikayā ṣaṣṭhaṃ vṛttaṃ budbuda śobhitam ..
saptamaṃ cāṣṭakoṇaṃ tu śuddhaṃ vidyādharairyutam .. 19 ..
meaning:
कृष्णकर्णिकया षष्ठं वृत्तं बुद्बुद शोभितम् ..
सप्तमं चाष्टकोणं तु शुद्धं विद्याधरैर्युतम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: The sixth is round with a black pericarp and adorned with bubbles. / The seventh has eight corners, is pure, and is accompanied by vidyādharas.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭamaṃ piṭakaṃ vṛttaṃ varatrāsūtraveṣṭitam ..
navagrahayutaṃ dīptaṃ navamaṃ ca sacaṃḍikam .. .. 4.139.20 ..
meaning:
अष्टमं पिटकं वृत्तं वरत्रासूत्रवेष्टितम् ..
नवग्रहयुतं दीप्तं नवमं च सचंडिकम् .. .. 4.139.20 ..
text_mt: The eighth basket is round and bound with leathern straps and cords. / The ninth is radiant, endowed with the nine planets, and has Caṇḍikā.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaviṣṇvīśasahitaṃ daśamaṃ śivasaṃsthitam ..
kṛṣṇamekādaśaṃ vṛttaṃ yamayuktaṃ yudhiṣṭhira .. 21 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मविष्ण्वीशसहितं दशमं शिवसंस्थितम् ..
कृष्णमेकादशं वृत्तं यमयुक्तं युधिष्ठिर .. 21 ..
text_mt: The tenth contains Śiva together with Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Īśa. / The eleventh is black, round, and accompanied by Yama, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit_iast:
chātraṃ dvādaśamaṃ śuklaṃ dhvajadīrghaṃ trayodaśam ..
sakuśaṃ puṣpasragdāmaghaṃṭācāmaracarcitam .. 22 ..
meaning:
छात्रं द्वादशमं शुक्लं ध्वजदीर्घं त्रयोदशम् ..
सकुशं पुष्पस्रग्दामघंटाचामरचर्चितम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: The twelfth is a white parasol; the thirteenth is long as a banner, / equipped with kuśa grass, smeared and decorated with flower garlands, bells, and chowries.

sanskrit_iast:
bandhayitvā candrapādai rajjubhiḥ sthūṇikāṃ naraiḥ ..
śanairutthāpayetpārtha hutvā vaiśvānaraṃ dvijān .. 23 ..
meaning:
बन्धयित्वा चन्द्रपादै रज्जुभिः स्थूणिकां नरैः ..
शनैरुत्थापयेत्पार्थ हुत्वा वैश्वानरं द्विजान् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Having bound the post with ropes using men at the quarter-turns of the moon, / he should raise it slowly, O son of Pṛthā, after offering oblations to the fire and [feeding] the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇābhiśca saṃpūjya guḍapāyasapūpakaiḥ ..
kuryānmahotsavaṃ rājā dināni nava sapta vā .. 24 ..
meaning:
दक्षिणाभिश्च संपूज्य गुडपायसपूपकैः ..
कुर्यान्महोत्सवं राजा दिनानि नव सप्त वा .. 24 ..
text_mt: And after honouring [them] with priestly gifts, jaggery, milk-rice, and cakes, / the king should hold a great festival for nine or seven days,

sanskrit_iast:
prekṣaṇīyairmahādānairnaṭaigītaiḥ kathānakaiḥ ..
cakradolādharotsargaiḥ karkeṭairmallayodhanaiḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
प्रेक्षणीयैर्महादानैर्नटैगीतैः कथानकैः ..
चक्रदोलाधरोत्सर्गैः कर्केटैर्मल्लयोधनैः .. 25 ..
text_mt: with spectacles, great gifts, actors, songs, stories, / ferris wheels, swings, abandonment of lower garments, acrobatics, wrestling bouts,

sanskrit_iast:
veśyāṃganānarairhṛṣṭairdyūtakrīḍāmahotsavaiḥ ..
karpūravastradānaiśca saṃmānaiśca parasparam... 26 ..
meaning:
वेश्यांगनानरैर्हृष्टैर्द्यूतक्रीडामहोत्सवैः ..
कर्पूरवस्त्रदानैश्च संमानैश्च परस्परम्... 26 ..
text_mt: delighted courtesans and men, great festivals of gambling games, / gifts of camphor and garments, and mutual honours.

sanskrit_iast:
rātrau prajāgaraḥ kāryo rakṣaṇāya prayatnataḥ ..
kākolūkakapotānāṃ yena pāto na vidyate .. 27 ..
meaning:
रात्रौ प्रजागरः कार्यो रक्षणाय प्रयत्नतः ..
काकोलूककपोतानां येन पातो न विद्यते .. 27 ..
text_mt: A vigil should be kept at night with effort for protection, / so that there is no alighting of crows, owls, and pigeons.

sanskrit_iast:
kākādbhavati durbhikṣaṃ kauśikānmriyate nṛpaḥ ..
kapotācca prajānāśastato rakṣetsadodyataḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
काकाद्भवति दुर्भिक्षं कौशिकान्म्रियते नृपः ..
कपोताच्च प्रजानाशस्ततो रक्षेत्सदोद्यतः .. 28 ..
text_mt: From a crow comes famine; from an owl the king dies; / and from a pigeon comes the destruction of the subjects; therefore he should always be intent on protecting it.

sanskrit_iast:
śaithilyādgiribhicchakraḥ pramādānnīyate yadi ..
tasmindeśe samutthānamindraketorna kārayet .. .. 29 ..
meaning:
शैथिल्याद्गिरिभिच्छक्रः प्रमादान्नीयते यदि ..
तस्मिन्देशे समुत्थानमिन्द्रकेतोर्न कारयेत् .. .. 29 ..
text_mt: If due to slackness or negligence the mountain-cleaver's wheel is brought down, / he should not cause the raising of Indra's banner in that region

sanskrit_iast: yāvattu nīyate sthānādanyasmādaiṃdrato dhvajaḥ .. 4.139.30 ..
meaning: यावत्तु नीयते स्थानादन्यस्मादैंद्रतो ध्वजः .. 4.139.30 ..
text_mt: until the banner is brought from another site sacred to Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
iṃdradhvajasamutthānaṃ pramādānna kṛtaṃ yadi ..
tato dvādaśame varṣe kartavyaṃ nāṃtare punaḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
इंद्रध्वजसमुत्थानं प्रमादान्न कृतं यदि ..
ततो द्वादशमे वर्षे कर्तव्यं नांतरे पुनः .. 31 ..
text_mt: If the raising of Indra's banner is not performed due to negligence, / it must then be performed in the twelfth year, not in the interval between.

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃcidyadi vighnaḥ syādvipākaṃ me nibodha vai ..
chatrabhaṃge cchatrabhaṃgo dhvaje rāṣṭraṃ vinaśyati .. 32 ..
meaning:
कथंचिद्यदि विघ्नः स्याद्विपाकं मे निबोध वै ..
छत्रभंगे च्छत्रभंगो ध्वजे राष्ट्रं विनश्यति .. 32 ..
text_mt: If somehow an obstacle should occur, learn from me the fruition: / on the breaking of the royal parasol, the royal parasol breaks [for the king]; on [the breaking of] the banner, the kingdom perishes.

sanskrit_iast:
mastake mantravicchedo mukhe mukhyabalakṣayaḥ ..
bāhudaṃḍe vadetpīḍāṃ jaṭhare jāṭharaṃ bhayam .. 33 ..
meaning:
मस्तके मन्त्रविच्छेदो मुखे मुख्यबलक्षयः ..
बाहुदंडे वदेत्पीडां जठरे जाठरं भयम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: At the crest, [it causes] the severance of counsel; at the face, the loss of principal forces; / on the crossbar, one should declare affliction; in the belly, danger to the belly.

sanskrit_iast:
varatrāyāṃ mitranāśaḥ sthūṇikāsu padātayaḥ ..
kṣayaṃ gacchaṃti rājendra tasmādyatnātpuraṃdaram .. 34 ..
meaning:
वरत्रायां मित्रनाशः स्थूणिकासु पदातयः ..
क्षयं गच्छंति राजेन्द्र तस्माद्यत्नात्पुरंदरम् .. 34 ..
text_mt: On the rope, destruction of friends; on the small posts, the infantry / go to destruction, O king of kings. Therefore, with effort, Purandara

sanskrit_iast:
utthāpya pūjayedbhaktyā divārātramataṃdritaḥ ..
pramādātpatite bhagne gate cendradhvaje dvidhā .. 35 ..
meaning:
उत्थाप्य पूजयेद्भक्त्या दिवारात्रमतंद्रितः ..
प्रमादात्पतिते भग्ने गते चेन्द्रध्वजे द्विधा .. 35 ..
text_mt: having raised, one should worship with devotion day and night, free from sluggishness. / If through negligence Indra's banner falls, breaks, or goes in two,

sanskrit_iast:
sauvarṇaṃ raupyakaṃ kṛtvā pūrṇamutthāpayeddhvajam ..
śāṃtikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ kṛtvā dvijebhyonnaṃ pradāpayet .. 36 ..
meaning:
सौवर्णं रौप्यकं कृत्वा पूर्णमुत्थापयेद्ध्वजम् ..
शांतिकं पौष्टिकं कृत्वा द्विजेभ्योन्नं प्रदापयेत् .. 36 ..
text_mt: having made [a banner] of gold or silver, one should raise a complete banner. / Having performed peaceful and nourishing rites, he should have food given to the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
trapusaiḥ karkaṭībhiśca nālikeraiḥ kapitthakaiḥ ..
bījapūraiḥ sanāraṃgairbhakṣyānnairvividhaistathā .. 37 ..
meaning:
त्रपुसैः कर्कटीभिश्च नालिकेरैः कपित्थकैः ..
बीजपूरैः सनारंगैर्भक्ष्यान्नैर्विविधैस्तथा .. 37 ..
text_mt: with cucumbers, melon, coconuts, and wood-apples, / with citrons accompanied by oranges, and likewise with various edible foods.

sanskrit_iast:
naivedyādibhirabhyarcya maṃtreṇānena toṣayet ..
vajrahasta surārighna bahunetra puraṃdara ..
kṣemārthaṃ sarvalokasya pūjeyaṃ pratigṛhyatām .. 38 ..
meaning:
नैवेद्यादिभिरभ्यर्च्य मंत्रेणानेन तोषयेत् ..
वज्रहस्त सुरारिघ्न बहुनेत्र पुरंदर ..
क्षेमार्थं सर्वलोकस्य पूजेयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped with food-offerings and other gifts, he should propitiate [him] with this mantra: / 'O holder of the thunderbolt, slayer of the gods' enemies, many-eyed Purandara, / for the welfare of all the world, may this worship be accepted!'

sanskrit_iast:
śravaṇādbharaṇīṃ yāvatpūjāṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ ..
rātrau visarjayecchakraṃ maṃtreṇānena pāṃḍava .. 39 ..
meaning:
श्रवणाद्भरणीं यावत्पूजां कृत्वा विधानतः ..
रात्रौ विसर्जयेच्छक्रं मंत्रेणानेन पांडव .. 39 ..
text_mt: Having performed the worship according to rule from Śravaṇā until Bharaṇī, / one should dismiss Śakra at night with this mantra, O Pāṇḍava:

sanskrit_iast:
sārthaṃ surāsuragaṇaiḥ puraṃdaraśatakrato ..
upahāraṃ gṛhītvainaṃ mahendradhvaja gamyatām.. 4.139.40 ..
meaning:
सार्थं सुरासुरगणैः पुरंदरशतक्रतो ..
उपहारं गृहीत्वैनं महेन्द्रध्वज गम्यताम्.. 4.139.40 ..
text_mt: 'Together with the hosts of gods and asuras, O Purandara, O Śatakratu, / having accepted this offering, O banner of Mahendra, depart!'

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute yātrāmindraketoryudhiṣṭhira ..
parjanyaḥ kāmavarṣī syāttasminrāṣṭre na saṃśayaḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
एवं यः कुरुते यात्रामिन्द्रकेतोर्युधिष्ठिर ..
पर्जन्यः कामवर्षी स्यात्तस्मिन्राष्ट्रे न संशयः .. 41 ..
text_mt: He who thus conducts the procession of Indra's banner, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / rain will fall according to desire in his realm, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
ītayo na pravartaṃte tasmānmṛtyukṛtaṃ bhayam ..
vijitya śatrūnsamare vaśe kṛtvā mahītalam ..
bhuktvā rājyaṃ ciraṃkālamindraloke mahīyate ..42..
meaning:
ईतयो न प्रवर्तंते तस्मान्मृत्युकृतं भयम् ..
विजित्य शत्रून्समरे वशे कृत्वा महीतलम् ..
भुक्त्वा राज्यं चिरंकालमिन्द्रलोके महीयते ..42..
text_mt: Plagues do not occur, nor danger caused by death; / having conquered his enemies in battle and brought the surface of the earth under control, / having enjoyed the kingdom for a long time, he is honoured in the world of Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
rāṣṭre pure ca nagare surarājaketoryatrotsavo nṛpajanaiḥ kriyate sametya..
duṣṭopasargajanitaṃ paracakrajaṃ vā tasminbhayaṃ bhavati pārtha na kiñcideva .. 43 ..
meaning:
राष्ट्रे पुरे च नगरे सुरराजकेतोर्यत्रोत्सवो नृपजनैः क्रियते समेत्य..
दुष्टोपसर्गजनितं परचक्रजं वा तस्मिन्भयं भवति पार्थ न किञ्चिदेव .. 43 ..
text_mt: In the kingdom, castle, and city where the festival of the king of gods' banner is celebrated by the royal people together, / no danger whatsoever, O Pārtha, arises there from malicious afflictions or from an enemy army.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde mahendradhvajamahotsavavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonacatvāriṃśadutaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 139 .. ..
dīpālikotsavavarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराण उत्तरपर्वणि श्रीकृष्णयुधिष्ठिरसंवादे महेन्द्रध्वजमहोत्सववर्णनं नामैकोनचत्वारिंशदुतरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 139 .. ..
दीपालिकोत्सववर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-ninth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Great Festival of Mahendra's Banner', in the dialogue between Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Yudhiṣṭhira in the Uttaraparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Dīpālikā Festival

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
purā vāmanarūpeṇa yācayitvā dharāmimām ..
baliyajñe hariḥ sarvaṃ krāṃtavānvikramaistribhiḥ .. .. 1 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
पुरा वामनरूपेण याचयित्वा धरामिमाम् ..
बलियज्ञे हरिः सर्वं क्रांतवान्विक्रमैस्त्रिभिः .. .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Formerly, having begged for this earth in the form of a dwarf / at Bali's sacrifice, Hari strode across all with three strides.
title: Dīpālikotsavavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
indrāya dattavānrājyaṃ baliṃ pātālavāsinam ..
kṛtvā daityapatervāsamahorātraṃ punarnṛpa .. 2 ..
meaning:
इन्द्राय दत्तवान्राज्यं बलिं पातालवासिनम् ..
कृत्वा दैत्यपतेर्वासमहोरात्रं पुनर्नृप .. 2 ..
text_mt: He gave the kingdom to Indra, making Bali an inhabitant of the netherworld; / and again, O king, [he granted] a day and a night as the dwelling of the lord of the Daityas,

sanskrit_iast:
ekameva hi bhogārthaṃ balirājyeticihnitam ..
sarahasyaṃ tadetatte kathayāmi narottama .. 3 ..
meaning:
एकमेव हि भोगार्थं बलिराज्येतिचिह्नितम् ..
सरहस्यं तदेतत्ते कथयामि नरोत्तम .. 3 ..
text_mt: a single [day] indeed marked as 'Bali's kingdom' for the sake of enjoyment. / Together with its secret, I shall relate this to you, O best of men.

sanskrit_iast:
kārttike kṛṣṇapakṣasya pañcadaśyāṃ niśāgame ..
yatheṣṭaceṣṭā daityānāṃ rājyaṃ teṣāṃ mahītale .. 4 .. ..
meaning:
कार्त्तिके कृष्णपक्षस्य पञ्चदश्यां निशागमे ..
यथेष्टचेष्टा दैत्यानां राज्यं तेषां महीतले .. 4 .. ..
text_mt: In Kārttika, on the fifteenth [day] of the dark fortnight, at the arrival of night, / the actions of the Daityas are according to their desire, and the kingdom on the surface of the earth belongs to them.

sanskrit_iast:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
niśśeṣeṇa hṛṣīkeśa kaumudīṃ brūhi me prabho ..
kimarthaṃ dīyate dānaṃ tasyāṃ kā devatā bhavet .. 5 ..
meaning:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
निश्शेषेण हृषीकेश कौमुदीं ब्रूहि मे प्रभो ..
किमर्थं दीयते दानं तस्यां का देवता भवेत् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Speak to me completely of Kaumudī, O Hṛṣīkeśa, O lord. / For what purpose is a gift given, and who is the deity on it?

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃsvittasyai bhaveddeyaṃ kebhyo devaṃ janārdana ..
praharṣaḥ ko'tra nirdiṣṭaḥ krīḍā kātra prakīrtitā .. 6 ..
meaning:
किंस्वित्तस्यै भवेद्देयं केभ्यो देवं जनार्दन ..
प्रहर्षः कोऽत्र निर्दिष्टः क्रीडा कात्र प्रकीर्तिता .. 6 ..
text_mt: What indeed should be given to her? To whom [should gifts be given], O divine Janārdana? / What joy is prescribed here, and what sport is proclaimed here?

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
kārttike kṛṣṇapakṣe ca caturdaśyāṃ dinodaye ..
avaśyameva kartavyaṃ snānaṃ narakabhīrubhiḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
कार्त्तिके कृष्णपक्षे च चतुर्दश्यां दिनोदये ..
अवश्यमेव कर्तव्यं स्नानं नरकभीरुभिः .. 7 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / In Kārttika, in the dark fortnight, on the fourteenth [day] at daybreak, / a bath must certainly be taken by those who fear hell.

sanskrit_iast:
apāmārgapallavānvā bhrābhayenmastakopari ..
sītāloṣṭasamāyuktasakaṃṭakadalānvitān .. 8 ..
meaning:
अपामार्गपल्लवान्वा भ्राभयेन्मस्तकोपरि ..
सीतालोष्टसमायुक्तसकंटकदलान्वितान् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Or one should cause apāmārga shoots to be waved above the head, / joined with a clod from a furrow and possessing thorny leaves:

sanskrit_iast:
hara pāpamapāmārga bhrāmyamāṇaṃ punaḥpunaḥ ..
āpadaṃ kilbiṣaṃ cāpi mamāpahara sarvaśaḥ ..
apāmārga namastestu śarīraṃ mama śodhaya .. 9 .. ( ityapāmārga bhramaṇa mantraḥ)
meaning:
हर पापमपामार्ग भ्राम्यमाणं पुनःपुनः ..
आपदं किल्बिषं चापि ममापहर सर्वशः ..
अपामार्ग नमस्तेस्तु शरीरं मम शोधय .. 9 .. ( इत्यपामार्ग भ्रमण मन्त्रः)
text_mt: 'Remove sin, O apāmārga, being waved again and again! / Take away completely also my misfortune and guilt! / O apāmārga, homage be to you! Purify my body!' (Thus the mantra for the waving of the apāmārga)

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca tarpaṇaṃ kāryaṃ dharmarājasya nāmabhiḥ ..
yamāya dharmarājāya mṛtyave cāṃtakāya ca ..
vaivasvatāya kālāya sarvabhūtakṣayāya ca ..4.140.1 0..
meaning:
ततश्च तर्पणं कार्यं धर्मराजस्य नामभिः ..
यमाय धर्मराजाय मृत्यवे चांतकाय च ..
वैवस्वताय कालाय सर्वभूतक्षयाय च ..4.140.1 0..
text_mt: And then water-libation should be made with the names of the King of Dharma: / 'To Yama, to the King of Dharma, to Death, and to the Ender, / to Vaivasvata, to Time, and to the Destruction of All Beings.'

sanskrit_iast:
narakāya pradātavyo dīpaḥ saṃpūjya devatāḥ ..
tataḥ pradoṣasamaye dīpāndadyānmanoramān .. 11 ..
meaning:
नरकाय प्रदातव्यो दीपः संपूज्य देवताः ..
ततः प्रदोषसमये दीपान्दद्यान्मनोरमान् .. 11 ..
text_mt: A lamp should be offered to Naraka after worshipping the deities. / Then, at twilight, one should offer charming lamps,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ bhavaneṣu maṭheṣu ca ..
kūṭāgāreṣu caityeṣu sabhāsu ca nadīṣu ca .. 12 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादीनां भवनेषु मठेषु च ..
कूटागारेषु चैत्येषु सभासु च नदीषु च .. 12 ..
text_mt: in the dwellings and monasteries of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and others, / in upper storeys, shrines, halls, and rivers,

sanskrit_iast:
prākārodyānavāpīṣu pratolīniṣkuṭeṣu ca ..
siddhārhabuddhacāmuṃḍābhairavāyataneṣu ca ..
maṃdurāsu viviktāsu hastiśālāsu caiva hi .. 13 ..
meaning:
प्राकारोद्यानवापीषु प्रतोलीनिष्कुटेषु च ..
सिद्धार्हबुद्धचामुंडाभैरवायतनेषु च ..
मंदुरासु विविक्तासु हस्तिशालासु चैव हि .. 13 ..
text_mt: on ramparts, in pleasure-gardens and wells, in main streets and house-gardens, / in the sanctuaries of the Siddhas, the Arhats, the Buddhas, Cāmuṇḍā, and Bhairava, / and in secluded stables and elephant-stalls.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ prabhātasamaye'māvāsyāyāṃ narādhipa ..
snātvā devānpitṝnbhaktyā saṃpūjyātha praṇamya ca .. 14 ..
meaning:
एवं प्रभातसमयेऽमावास्यायां नराधिप ..
स्नात्वा देवान्पितॄन्भक्त्या संपूज्याथ प्रणम्य च .. 14 ..
text_mt: Thus at dawn on the new moon day, O ruler of men, / having bathed, and having worshipped the gods and ancestors with devotion and bowed,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā tu pārvaṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ dadhikṣīraghṛtādibhiḥ ..
bhojyairnānāvidhairviprānbhojayitvā kṣamāpya ca .. 15 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा तु पार्वणं श्राद्धं दधिक्षीरघृतादिभिः ..
भोज्यैर्नानाविधैर्विप्रान्भोजयित्वा क्षमाप्य च .. 15 ..
text_mt: having performed the pārvaṇa-śrāddha with curds, milk, clarified butter, and the like, / and having fed the Brahmins with various kinds of foods and asked their pardon,

sanskrit_iast:
tato'parāhṇasamaye ghoṣayennagare nṛpaḥ ..
adya rājyaṃ balerlokā yatheṣṭaṃ modyatāmiti .. 16 ..
meaning:
ततोऽपराह्णसमये घोषयेन्नगरे नृपः ..
अद्य राज्यं बलेर्लोका यथेष्टं मोद्यतामिति .. 16 ..
text_mt: then in the afternoon the king should proclaim in the city: / 'Today is Bali's kingdom; let the people rejoice as they please!'

sanskrit_iast:
lokaścāpi pare hṛṣyetsudhādhavalitājire ..
vṛkṣacandanamālāḍhyaiścarcite ca gṛhegṛhe .. 17 ..
meaning:
लोकश्चापि परे हृष्येत्सुधाधवलिताजिरे ..
वृक्षचन्दनमालाढ्यैश्चर्चिते च गृहेगृहे .. 17 ..
text_mt: And the people should greatly rejoice in courtyards whitened with plaster / and in house after house decorated and smeared with garlands of tree-flowers and sandalwood,

sanskrit_iast:
dyūtapānaratodṛptanaranārīmanohare ..
nṛtyavāditrasaṃghuṣṭe samprajvalitadīpake .. 18 ...
anyonyaprītisaṃhṛṣṭadattalābhena vai jane ..
tāṃbūlahṛṣṭa vadane kuṅkumakṣodacarcite .. 19 ..
meaning:
द्यूतपानरतोदृप्तनरनारीमनोहरे ..
नृत्यवादित्रसंघुष्टे सम्प्रज्वलितदीपके .. 18 ...
अन्योन्यप्रीतिसंहृष्टदत्तलाभेन वै जने ..
तांबूलहृष्ट वदने कुङ्कुमक्षोदचर्चिते .. 19 ..
text_mt: delightful with proud men and women engaged in gambling and drinking, / echoing with dance and musical instruments, with lamps blazing brightly, / with people rejoicing over profit given through mutual affection, / their faces delighting in betel, smeared with saffron powder,

sanskrit_iast:
dukūlapaṭṭanepathye svarṇamāṇikyabhūṣite ..
adbhutodbhaṭaśṛṃgārapradarśitakutūhale .. 4.140.20 ..
meaning:
दुकूलपट्टनेपथ्ये स्वर्णमाणिक्यभूषिते ..
अद्भुतोद्भटशृंगारप्रदर्शितकुतूहले .. 4.140.20 ..
text_mt: attired in fine cloth and silk, adorned with gold and rubies, / with curiosity displayed in wondrous and lofty amorous adornment,

sanskrit_iast:
yuvatījanasaṃkīrṇavastrojjvalavihāriṇi ..
dīpamālākule ramye vidhvastadhvāṃtasañcaye ..
pradoṣe doṣarahite śastadoṣāgame śubhe .. 21 ..
meaning:
युवतीजनसंकीर्णवस्त्रोज्ज्वलविहारिणि ..
दीपमालाकुले रम्ये विध्वस्तध्वांतसञ्चये ..
प्रदोषे दोषरहिते शस्तदोषागमे शुभे .. 21 ..
text_mt: walking about in clothes shining brightly amidst crowds of young women, / crowded with rows of lamps, delightful, with masses of darkness destroyed, / at twilight, free of fault, at the auspicious arrival of an excellent evening.

sanskrit_iast:
śaśipūrṇamukhābhiśca kanyābhiḥ kṣiptataṇḍulam ..
nīrājanaṃ prakartavyaṃ vṛkṣaśākhāsu dīpakaiḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
शशिपूर्णमुखाभिश्च कन्याभिः क्षिप्ततण्डुलम् ..
नीराजनं प्रकर्तव्यं वृक्षशाखासु दीपकैः .. 22 ..
text_mt: And the lustration with raw rice thrown by maidens with faces like the full moon / should be performed with lamps placed on the branches of trees.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrāmyamāṇo nato mūrghni manujānāṃ janādhipaḥ ..
vṛkṣaśākhāṃtadīpānāṃ nirastāddarśanādvrajet ..
nīrājanaṃ tu teneha procyate vijayapradam .. 23 ..
meaning:
भ्राम्यमाणो नतो मूर्घ्नि मनुजानां जनाधिपः ..
वृक्षशाखांतदीपानां निरस्ताद्दर्शनाद्व्रजेत् ..
नीराजनं तु तेनेह प्रोच्यते विजयप्रदम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Being circumambulated, bowed at the head, the ruler of men / should walk away from the sight of the lamps at the ends of the tree branches as they are cast off; / therefore lustration is proclaimed here to grant victory.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmājjanena kartavyaṃ rakṣodoṣabhayāpaham ..
yātrāvihārasañcāre jayajīveti vādinā .. 24 ..
meaning:
तस्माज्जनेन कर्तव्यं रक्षोदोषभयापहम् ..
यात्राविहारसञ्चारे जयजीवेति वादिना .. 24 ..
text_mt: Therefore it should be performed by the people to remove the danger of faults and demons, / as they utter 'Victory! Live long!' during processions, diversions, and promenades,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣudropasargarahite rājacaurabhayojjhite ..
mitrasvajanasambandhisuhatpremānuraṃjite .. 25 ..
meaning:
क्षुद्रोपसर्गरहिते राजचौरभयोज्झिते ..
मित्रस्वजनसम्बन्धिसुहत्प्रेमानुरंजिते .. 25 ..
text_mt: free from petty afflictions, rid of fear of kings and thieves, / delighted by the love of friends, kin, relatives, and well-wishers.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'rddharātrasamaye svayaṃ rājā vrajetpuram ..
avalokayituṃ ramyaṃ padbhyāmeva śanaiḥśanaiḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
ततोऽर्द्धरात्रसमये स्वयं राजा व्रजेत्पुरम् ..
अवलोकयितुं रम्यं पद्भ्यामेव शनैःशनैः .. 26 ..
text_mt: Then, at midnight, the king himself should walk through the city / on foot, very slowly, to view its beauty.

sanskrit_iast:
mahatā tūryaghoṣeṇa jvaladbhirhastadīpakaiḥ ..
kṛtaśobhāṃ purīṃ paśyetkṛtarakṣāṃ svakairnaraiḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
महता तूर्यघोषेण ज्वलद्भिर्हस्तदीपकैः ..
कृतशोभां पुरीं पश्येत्कृतरक्षां स्वकैर्नरैः .. 27 ..
text_mt: He should see the city adorned with the loud sound of musical instruments, / with blazing hand-held torches, and guarded by his own men.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryamṛddhiṃ caivātmanaḥ śubhām ..
balirājyapramodaṃ ca tataḥ svagṛhamāvrajet .. 28 ..
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा महदाश्चर्यमृद्धिं चैवात्मनः शुभाम् ..
बलिराज्यप्रमोदं च ततः स्वगृहमाव्रजेत् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Having beheld that great wonder, his own auspicious prosperity, / and the rejoicing under Bali's rule, he should then return to his palace.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ gate niśārdhe tu jane nidrārdralocane ..
tāvannagaranārībhiḥ śūrpaḍiṃḍimavādanaiḥ ..
niṣkrāmyate prahṛṣṭābhiralakṣmīḥ svagṛhāṃgaṇāt .. 29 ..
meaning:
एवं गते निशार्धे तु जने निद्रार्द्रलोचने ..
तावन्नगरनारीभिः शूर्पडिंडिमवादनैः ..
निष्क्राम्यते प्रहृष्टाभिरलक्ष्मीः स्वगृहांगणात् .. 29 ..
text_mt: When midnight has thus passed and people's eyes are heavy with sleep, / Alakṣmī is driven out from the courtyards of their homes / by the women of the city, beating winnowing baskets and drums in high delight.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabuddhe sakale jane jātamahotsave ..
mālyadīpakahaste ca snehanirbharalocane .. 4.140.30 ..
meaning:
ततः प्रबुद्धे सकले जने जातमहोत्सवे ..
माल्यदीपकहस्ते च स्नेहनिर्भरलोचने .. 4.140.30 ..
text_mt: Then, when everyone has awakened and a great festival has begun, / with garlands and lamps in hand, their eyes full of affection,

sanskrit_iast:
veśyā vilāsinī sārdhaṃ svasti maṃgalakāriṇī ..
gṛhādgṛhaṃ vrajantī ca pādābhyaṃgapradāyinī .. 31 ..
meaning:
वेश्या विलासिनी सार्धं स्वस्ति मंगलकारिणी ..
गृहाद्गृहं व्रजन्ती च पादाभ्यंगप्रदायिनी .. 31 ..
text_mt: a courtesan and a playful woman together, bringing good fortune and auspiciousness, / going from house to house and offering foot ointments,

sanskrit_iast:
piṣṭakodvartanapare guruśuśrūṣaṇākule ..
dvijābhivādanapare sukharājyābhivīkṣaṇe .. 32 ..
meaning:
पिष्टकोद्वर्तनपरे गुरुशुश्रूषणाकुले ..
द्विजाभिवादनपरे सुखराज्याभिवीक्षणे .. 32 ..
text_mt: devoted to massaging with paste, eager in serving elders, / devoted to greeting the twice-born, looking upon a happy realm,

sanskrit_iast:
suvāsinībhyo dāne ca dīyamāne yadṛcchayā ..
yathāprabhātasamaye rājārhamānayejjanam .. 33 ..
meaning:
सुवासिनीभ्यो दाने च दीयमाने यदृच्छया ..
यथाप्रभातसमये राजार्हमानयेज्जनम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: and with gifts being freely given to married women, / the king should assemble the worthy people at daybreak.

sanskrit_iast:
sadbhāvenaiva santoṣyā devāḥ satpuruṣā dvijāḥ ..
itare cānnapānena vākpradānena paṃḍitāḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
सद्भावेनैव सन्तोष्या देवाः सत्पुरुषा द्विजाः ..
इतरे चान्नपानेन वाक्प्रदानेन पंडिताः .. 34 ..
text_mt: The gods, virtuous men, and twice-born are to be satisfied with genuine goodwill, / the others with food and drink, and the learned with gifts of speech.

sanskrit_iast:
vastraistāṃbūladānaiśca puṣpakarpūrakuṃkumaiḥ ..
bhakṣyairuccāvacairbhojyairantaḥpuravilāsinīḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
वस्त्रैस्तांबूलदानैश्च पुष्पकर्पूरकुंकुमैः ..
भक्ष्यैरुच्चावचैर्भोज्यैरन्तःपुरविलासिनीः .. 35 ..
text_mt: With garments, gifts of betel, flowers, camphor, and saffron, / with varied cakes and foods [he should gratify] the women of the inner apartments;

sanskrit_iast:
grāmairviṣayadānaiśca sāmaṃtanṛpatīndhanaiḥ ..
padātīnaṅgasaṃlagnāngraiveyakaṭakaiḥ svakān .. 36 ..
meaning:
ग्रामैर्विषयदानैश्च सामंतनृपतीन्धनैः ..
पदातीनङ्गसंलग्नान्ग्रैवेयकटकैः स्वकान् .. 36 ..
text_mt: with villages and land grants [he should gratify] feudatory kings, with wealth [others], / and his own foot soldiers devoted to him with necklaces and bracelets.

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ rājā toṣayetsa janānbhṛtyānpṛthakpṛthak ..
yathārhaṃ toṣayitvā tu tato mallanaṭānbhaṭān ..37..
meaning:
स्वयं राजा तोषयेत्स जनान्भृत्यान्पृथक्पृथक् ..
यथार्हं तोषयित्वा तु ततो मल्लनटान्भटान् ..37..
text_mt: The king himself should satisfy the people and his servants one by one. / Then, having rewarded wrestlers, actors, and soldiers according to their merit,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣabhānmahiṣāṃścaiva yudhyamānānparaiḥ saha ..
gajānaśvāṃśca yodhāṃśca padātīnsamalaṃkṛtān ...38..
meaning:
वृषभान्महिषांश्चैव युध्यमानान्परैः सह ..
गजानश्वांश्च योधांश्च पदातीन्समलंकृतान् ...38..
text_mt: bulls and buffaloes fighting with each other, / elephants, horses, warriors, and well-adorned foot soldiers,

sanskrit_iast:
maṃcārūḍhaḥ svayaṃ paśyennaṭanartakacāraṇān ..
kruddhāpayedānayecca gomahiṣyādikaṃ tataḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
मंचारूढः स्वयं पश्येन्नटनर्तकचारणान् ..
क्रुद्धापयेदानयेच्च गोमहिष्यादिकं ततः .. 39 ..
text_mt: he should watch in person mounted on a dais, [and view] actors, dancers, and bards. / He should incite them to anger and then bring forward cows, buffaloes, and other animals.

sanskrit_iast:
diṣṭyā kāryaṃ payojyotiruktipratyuktikā vadet ..
tatoparāhnasamaye pūrvasyāṃ diśi bhārata .. 4.140.40 ..
meaning:
दिष्ट्या कार्यं पयोज्योतिरुक्तिप्रत्युक्तिका वदेत् ..
ततोपराह्नसमये पूर्वस्यां दिशि भारत .. 4.140.40 ..
text_mt: He should say congratulations, perform libations, and speak witty banter. / Then in the afternoon, O Bhārata, in the eastern direction,

sanskrit_iast:
mārgapālīṃ prabadhnīyāttuṃgastaṃbhe'tha pādape ..
kuśakāśamayīṃ divyāṃ saṃbhave bahubhirvṛtām .. 41 ..
meaning:
मार्गपालीं प्रबध्नीयात्तुंगस्तंभेऽथ पादपे ..
कुशकाशमयीं दिव्यां संभवे बहुभिर्वृताम् .. 41 ..
text_mt: he should fasten the mārgapālī to a tall pillar or a tree, / a splendid [festoon] made of kuśa and kāśa grass, surrounded by many if available.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā gajānvājīnsārdhe yāmatraye gate ..
gāvo vṛṣāḥ samahiṣā maṃḍitā ghaṭikotkaṭāḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
पूजयित्वा गजान्वाजीन्सार्धे यामत्रये गते ..
गावो वृषाः समहिषा मंडिता घटिकोत्कटाः .. 42 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped the elephants and horses when three and a half yāmas have passed, / cows, bulls, and buffaloes are adorned, eager for the moment.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛte home dvijendraistu gṛhṇīyānmārgapālikām ..
rāṣṭrabhojyena dhārābhiḥ sahasreṇa śatena vā ..43..
meaning:
कृते होमे द्विजेन्द्रैस्तु गृह्णीयान्मार्गपालिकाम् ..
राष्ट्रभोज्येन धाराभिः सहस्रेण शतेन वा ..43..
text_mt: When the homa has been performed by the foremost twice-born, one should take hold of the mārgapālikā, / with the food of the realm, in streams of a thousand or a hundred,

sanskrit_iast:
svaśaktyapekṣayā vāpi gṛhṇīyādvāmabhojanaiḥ ..
mātuḥ kulaṃ pitṛkulamātmānaṃ sahabaṃdhubhiḥ .. 44..
meaning:
स्वशक्त्यपेक्षया वापि गृह्णीयाद्वामभोजनैः ..
मातुः कुलं पितृकुलमात्मानं सहबंधुभिः .. 44..
text_mt: or according to one's own capacity, or take hold of it with offerings of food. / He who offers the mārgapālī delivers

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtārayetsa sakalaṃ mārgapālīṃ dadāti yaḥ ..
nīrājanaṃ ca tatraiva kāryaṃ rājñe jayapradam ..45..
meaning:
संतारयेत्स सकलं मार्गपालीं ददाति यः ..
नीराजनं च तत्रैव कार्यं राज्ञे जयप्रदम् ..45..
text_mt: the maternal family, the paternal family, and himself together with his kinsmen. / Right there, the wave-offering of lights bringing victory should be performed for the king.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgapālītalenetthaṃ hayā gāvo gajā vṛṣāḥ ..
rājāno rājaputrāśca brāhmaṇā śūdrajātayaḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
मार्गपालीतलेनेत्थं हया गावो गजा वृषाः ..
राजानो राजपुत्राश्च ब्राह्मणा शूद्रजातयः .. 46 ..
text_mt: Thus beneath the mārgapālī horses, cows, elephants, bulls, / kings, princes, brāhmaṇas, and śūdras,

sanskrit_iast:
mārgapālīṃ samullaṃghya nīrujaḥ syātsukhī sadā ..
kṛtvaitatsarvameveha rātrau daityapaterbaleḥ .. .. 47 ..
meaning:
मार्गपालीं समुल्लंघ्य नीरुजः स्यात्सुखी सदा ..
कृत्वैतत्सर्वमेवेह रात्रौ दैत्यपतेर्बलेः .. .. 47 ..
text_mt: passing under the mārgapālī, will be free from illness and always happy. / Having done all this here, at night a man should perform

sanskrit_iast:
pūjāṃ kuryānnaraḥ sākṣādbhūmau maṃḍalake kṛte ..
balimālikhya daityendraṃ varṇakaiḥ paṃcaraṃgakaiḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
पूजां कुर्यान्नरः साक्षाद्भूमौ मंडलके कृते ..
बलिमालिख्य दैत्येन्द्रं वर्णकैः पंचरंगकैः .. 48 ..
text_mt: the worship of Bali, king of the Daityas, directly upon the ground on a maṇḍala, / having drawn Bali, the Daitya lord, with five-coloured powders,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvābharaṇasaṃpūrṇaṃ viṃdhyāvalyā sahāsitam..
kūṣmāṃḍabāṇajaṃghorumuradānavasaṃvṛtam .. 49 ..
meaning:
सर्वाभरणसंपूर्णं विंध्यावल्या सहासितम्..
कूष्मांडबाणजंघोरुमुरदानवसंवृतम् .. 49 ..
text_mt: resplendent with all ornaments, seated with Vindhyāvalī, / surrounded by Kūṣmāṇḍa, Bāṇa, Jaṅgha, Uru, and Mura, the Dānavas,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūrṇahṛṣṭavadanaṃ kirīṭotkaṭakuṇḍalam ..
dvibhujaṃ daityarājānaṃ kārayitvā nṛpaḥ svayam..4.140.50..
meaning:
संपूर्णहृष्टवदनं किरीटोत्कटकुण्डलम् ..
द्विभुजं दैत्यराजानं कारयित्वा नृपः स्वयम्..4.140.50..
text_mt: his face filled with joy, wearing a diadem and prominent earrings. / Having had the two-armed king of the Daityas made, the king himself,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhasya madhye śālāyāṃ viśālāyāṃ tato'rcayet ..
bhrātṛmaṃtrijanaiḥ sārddhaṃ saṃtuṣṭo vaṃdibhiḥ stutaḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
गृहस्य मध्ये शालायां विशालायां ततोऽर्चयेत् ..
भ्रातृमंत्रिजनैः सार्द्धं संतुष्टो वंदिभिः स्तुतः .. 51 ..
text_mt: content and praised by bards, should then worship him in the middle of the house / inside a spacious hall, accompanied by his brothers and ministers,

sanskrit_iast:
kamalaiḥ kumudaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kahlārai raktakotpalaiḥ ..
gandhadhūpānnanaivedyairakṣatairguḍapūpakaiḥ ..52..
meaning:
कमलैः कुमुदैः पुष्पैः कह्लारै रक्तकोत्पलैः ..
गन्धधूपान्ननैवेद्यैरक्षतैर्गुडपूपकैः ..52..
text_mt: with lotuses, white water-lilies, kahlāra flowers, and red night-lotuses, / with perfumes, incense, food offerings, unbroken grain, and treacle cakes,

sanskrit_iast:
madyamāṃsasurālehyadīpavartyupahārakaiḥ ..
maṃtreṇānena rājendra samaṃtrī sapurohitaḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
मद्यमांससुरालेह्यदीपवर्त्युपहारकैः ..
मंत्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र समंत्री सपुरोहितः .. 53 ..
text_mt: with gifts of wine, meat, liquor, sweetmeats, lamps, and wicks, / with this mantra, O king of kings, together with his minister and chaplain:

sanskrit_iast:
balirāja namastubhyaṃ virocanasuta prabho ..
bhaviṣyendrasurārāte pūjeyaṃ pratigṛhyatām .. 54 ..
meaning:
बलिराज नमस्तुभ्यं विरोचनसुत प्रभो ..
भविष्येन्द्रसुराराते पूजेयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् .. 54 ..
text_mt: “O King Bali, homage to you, son of Virocana, O lord, / future Indra, enemy of the gods! Please accept this worship.”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pūjāṃ nṛpaḥ kṛtvā rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ tataḥ ..
kārayetprekṣaṇīyādi naṭakṣatrakathānakaiḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
एवं पूजां नृपः कृत्वा रात्रौ जागरणं ततः ..
कारयेत्प्रेक्षणीयादि नटक्षत्रकथानकैः .. 55 ..
text_mt: Having thus performed the worship, the king should then hold a vigil at night / with spectacles and tales of actors and kṣatriyas.

sanskrit_iast:
lokaścāpi gṛhasyāṃte śayyāyāṃ śuklataṃḍulaiḥ ..
saṃsthāpya balirājānaṃ phalaiḥ puṣpaiśca pūjayet .. 56 ..
meaning:
लोकश्चापि गृहस्यांते शय्यायां शुक्लतंडुलैः ..
संस्थाप्य बलिराजानं फलैः पुष्पैश्च पूजयेत् .. 56 ..
text_mt: The people too should install King Bali on a couch in the interior of their homes / with white rice, and worship him with fruits and flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
balimuddiśya dīyaṃte dānāni kurunandana ..
yāni tānyakṣayāṇyāhurmayaivaṃ saṃpradarśitam .. 57 ..
meaning:
बलिमुद्दिश्य दीयंते दानानि कुरुनन्दन ..
यानि तान्यक्षयाण्याहुर्मयैवं संप्रदर्शितम् .. 57 ..
text_mt: Gifts given dedicated to Bali, O joy of the Kurus, / are said to be imperishable; this has been demonstrated by me.

sanskrit_iast:
yadasyāṃ dīyate dānaṃ svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu ..
tadakṣayaṃ bhavetsarvaṃ viṣṇoḥ prītikaraṃ param .. 58 ..
meaning:
यदस्यां दीयते दानं स्वल्पं वा यदि वा बहु ..
तदक्षयं भवेत्सर्वं विष्णोः प्रीतिकरं परम् .. 58 ..
text_mt: Whatever gift is given on this day, whether little or much, / all that becomes imperishable and brings supreme delight to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇunā vasudhā labdhā prītena balaye punaḥ ..
upakārakaro dattaścāsurāṇāṃ mahotsavaḥ .. 59 ..
meaning:
विष्णुना वसुधा लब्धा प्रीतेन बलये पुनः ..
उपकारकरो दत्तश्चासुराणां महोत्सवः .. 59 ..
text_mt: When the earth was gained by Viṣṇu, he, being pleased, granted / to Bali once again this great festival of the Asuras, which confers benefits.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabhṛti rājendra pravṛttā kaumudī punaḥ ..
sarvopadravavidrāvi sarvavighnavināśinī ..4.140.60..
meaning:
ततः प्रभृति राजेन्द्र प्रवृत्ता कौमुदी पुनः ..
सर्वोपद्रवविद्रावि सर्वविघ्नविनाशिनी ..4.140.60..
text_mt: Ever since then, O king of kings, Kaumudī has been observed again, / driving away all afflictions and destroying all obstacles,

sanskrit_iast:
lokaśokaharī kāmyā dhanapuṣṭisukhāvahā ..
kuśabdena mahī jñeyā mudī harṣe tataḥ param .. 61 ..
meaning:
लोकशोकहरी काम्या धनपुष्टिसुखावहा ..
कुशब्देन मही ज्ञेया मुदी हर्षे ततः परम् .. 61 ..
text_mt: dispelling the sorrow of the people, desirable, bringing wealth, prosperity, and happiness. / By the word 'ku' the earth is to be understood, and thereafter 'mudī' signifies joy;

sanskrit_iast:
dhātujñairnaigamajñaiśca tenaiṣā kaumudī smṛtā ..
kau modante janā yasyāṃ nānābhāvaiḥ parasparā .. 62 ..
meaning:
धातुज्ञैर्नैगमज्ञैश्च तेनैषा कौमुदी स्मृता ..
कौ मोदन्ते जना यस्यां नानाभावैः परस्परा .. 62 ..
text_mt: therefore it is remembered as Kaumudī by knowers of roots and knowers of the Vedas. / On it people rejoice (modante) mutually on earth (kau) with various sentiments;

sanskrit_iast:
hṛṣṭāstuṣṭāḥ sukhāyattāstenaiṣā kaumudī smṛtā ..
kumudāni baleryasmāddīyante'syāṃ yudhiṣṭhira .. 63 ..
meaning:
हृष्टास्तुष्टाः सुखायत्तास्तेनैषा कौमुदी स्मृता ..
कुमुदानि बलेर्यस्माद्दीयन्तेऽस्यां युधिष्ठिर .. 63 ..
text_mt: delighted, contented, and possessing happiness, therefore it is remembered as Kaumudī. / Because white water-lilies (kumuda) are offered on it to Bali, O Yudhiṣṭhira,

sanskrit_iast:
arthārthe pārtha bhūmau ca tenaiṣā kaumudī smṛtā ..
ekamevamahorātraṃ varṣe varṣe viśāṃpate .. 64 ..
meaning:
अर्थार्थे पार्थ भूमौ च तेनैषा कौमुदी स्मृता ..
एकमेवमहोरात्रं वर्षे वर्षे विशांपते .. 64 ..
text_mt: and on earth (bhūmau) for the sake of wealth, O son of Pṛthā, therefore it is remembered as Kaumudī. / Thus for a single day and night each year, O ruler of the people,

sanskrit_iast:
dattaṃ dānavarājasya ādarśamiva bhūtale ..
yaḥ karoti nṛpo rāṣṭraṃ tasya vyādhibhayaṃ kutaḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
दत्तं दानवराजस्य आदर्शमिव भूतले ..
यः करोति नृपो राष्ट्रं तस्य व्याधिभयं कुतः .. 65 ..
text_mt: it was given to the Dānava king as a mirror upon the surface of the earth. / For the king who observes it in his realm, whence can fear of disease come?

sanskrit_iast:
kuta īti bhayaṃ tatra nāsti mṛtyukṛtaṃ bhayam ..
subhikṣaṃ kṣemamārogyaṃ sarvasampada uttamāḥ .. 66 ..
meaning:
कुत ईति भयं तत्र नास्ति मृत्युकृतं भयम् ..
सुभिक्षं क्षेममारोग्यं सर्वसम्पद उत्तमाः .. 66 ..
text_mt: Whence can fear of crop pestilence arise there? There is no fear caused by death. / There is abundance of food, safety, health, and all the highest forms of prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
nīrujaśca janāḥ sarve sarvopadravavarjitāḥ ..
kaumudīkaraṇādrājanbhavatīha mahītale .. 67 ..
meaning:
नीरुजश्च जनाः सर्वे सर्वोपद्रववर्जिताः ..
कौमुदीकरणाद्राजन्भवतीह महीतले .. 67 ..
text_mt: All the people are free from illness and rid of all afflictions, / O king, on the surface of the earth, from performing Kaumudī.

sanskrit_iast:
yo yādṛśena bhāvena tiṣṭhatyasyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ..
harṣadainyādirūpeṇa tasya varṣaṃ prayāti hi .. 68 ..
meaning:
यो यादृशेन भावेन तिष्ठत्यस्यां युधिष्ठिर ..
हर्षदैन्यादिरूपेण तस्य वर्षं प्रयाति हि .. 68 ..
text_mt: In whatever state of mind one remains on this day, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / in the form of joy, misery, or the like, indeed such does his whole year pass.

sanskrit_iast:
rudite roditi varṣaṃ hṛṣṭo varṣaṃ prahṛṣyati ..
bhuktau bhoktā bhavedvarṣaṃ svasthaḥ svastho bhavediti .. 69 ..
meaning:
रुदिते रोदिति वर्षं हृष्टो वर्षं प्रहृष्यति ..
भुक्तौ भोक्ता भवेद्वर्षं स्वस्थः स्वस्थो भवेदिति .. 69 ..
text_mt: If he weeps, he weeps for a year; if delighted, he rejoices for a year; / if feasting, he becomes a feaster for a year; if healthy, he remains healthy. So it is.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātprahṛṣṭaistuṣṭaiśca kartavyā kaumudī naraiḥ ..
vaiṣṇavī dānavī ceyaṃ tithiḥ paitrī yudhiṣṭhira .. 4.140.70 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्प्रहृष्टैस्तुष्टैश्च कर्तव्या कौमुदी नरैः ..
वैष्णवी दानवी चेयं तिथिः पैत्री युधिष्ठिर .. 4.140.70 ..
text_mt: Therefore, the Kaumudī festival should be observed by men full of joy and satisfaction. / This lunar day, O Yudhiṣṭhira, belongs to Viṣṇu, belongs to the Dānavas, and belongs to the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
upaśamitameghanādaṃ prajvalitadaśānanaṃ ramitarāmam ..
rāmāyaṇamiva subhagaṃ dīpadinaṃ haratu vo duritam .. 71 ..
meaning:
उपशमितमेघनादं प्रज्वलितदशाननं रमितरामम् ..
रामायणमिव सुभगं दीपदिनं हरतु वो दुरितम् .. 71 ..
text_mt: Having quelled the roar of clouds, with the ten quarters ablaze, delighting Rāma— / charming like the Rāmāyaṇa, which silenced Meghanāda, burned Daśānana, and delighted Rāma—may the day of lamps dispel your misfortune.

sanskrit_iast:
kūṣmāṇḍādānaramyaṃ kuvalayakhaṇḍaiśca dhātukābhadram ..
śaradiva harigatanidraṃ dīpadinaṃ haratu vo duritam ..72..
meaning:
कूष्माण्डादानरम्यं कुवलयखण्डैश्च धातुकाभद्रम् ..
शरदिव हरिगतनिद्रं दीपदिनं हरतु वो दुरितम् ..72..
text_mt: Delightful with the giving of winter melons, auspicious with mineral pigments and lotus blossoms, / as autumn awakens Hari from slumber, so may the day of lamps dispel your misfortune.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpotsave janitasarvajanapramodāṃ kurvaṃti ye sumanaso balirājapūjām ..
dānopabhogasukhavṛddhiśatākulānāṃ harṣeṇa varṣamiha pārthiva yāti teṣām ..73..
navagrahalakṣahomavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
दीपोत्सवे जनितसर्वजनप्रमोदां कुर्वंति ये सुमनसो बलिराजपूजाम् ..
दानोपभोगसुखवृद्धिशताकुलानां हर्षेण वर्षमिह पार्थिव याति तेषाम् ..73..
नवग्रहलक्षहोमविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Those who, with delighted minds, perform the worship of King Bali during the festival of lamps, bringing joy to all people, / spend their year here in joy, O king, filled with hundreds of increases in charity, enjoyment, and happiness.
Description of the procedure for the hundred-thousand fire oblation to the nine planets

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kathayasva mahābhāga sarvajño hyasi yādava ..
sarvakāmāptaye kṛtyaṃ kathaṃ śāṃtikapauṣṭikam ..1..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
कथयस्व महाभाग सर्वज्ञो ह्यसि यादव ..
सर्वकामाप्तये कृत्यं कथं शांतिकपौष्टिकम् ..1..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Speak, O exalted one, for you are omniscient, O Yādava! / What rite brings about pacification and nourishment for the attainment of all desires?
title: Navagrahalakṣahomavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca.. ..
śrīkāmaḥ śāntikāmo vā grahayajñaṃ samārabhet ..
dṛṣṭyāyuḥ puṣṭikāmo vā tathaivābhicaranpunaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच.. ..
श्रीकामः शान्तिकामो वा ग्रहयज्ञं समारभेत् ..
दृष्ट्यायुः पुष्टिकामो वा तथैवाभिचरन्पुनः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / One who desires prosperity, or one who desires pacification, should undertake a sacrifice to the planets, / or one who desires sight, longevity, or nourishment, or likewise one who performs sorcery.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaśāstrāṇyanukramya saṃkṣipya granthavistaram ..
grahaśāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi purāṇaśrutibhāṣitām ..3..
meaning:
सर्वशास्त्राण्यनुक्रम्य संक्षिप्य ग्रन्थविस्तरम् ..
ग्रहशांतिं प्रवक्ष्यामि पुराणश्रुतिभाषिताम् ..3..
text_mt: Having reviewed all the scriptures and condensed the vastness of the treatises, / I shall proclaim the pacification of the planets as taught in the Purāṇas and the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇye'hni viprakathite kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam ..
grahāngrahādhidevāṃśca sthāpya homaṃ samārabhet .. 4 ..
meaning:
पुण्येऽह्नि विप्रकथिते कृत्वा ब्राह्मणवाचनम् ..
ग्रहान्ग्रहाधिदेवांश्च स्थाप्य होमं समारभेत् .. 4 ..
text_mt: On an auspicious day declared by a Brahmin, having performed the blessing recitation by Brahmins, / and having installed the planets and their presiding deities, one should commence the fire oblation.

sanskrit_iast:
grahayajñastridhā proktaḥ purāṇaśrutikovidaiḥ ..
prathamo'yutahomaḥ syāllakṣahomastataḥ param .. 5 ..
meaning:
ग्रहयज्ञस्त्रिधा प्रोक्तः पुराणश्रुतिकोविदैः ..
प्रथमोऽयुतहोमः स्याल्लक्षहोमस्ततः परम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: The sacrifice to the planets is declared to be threefold by those skilled in the Purāṇas and the Vedas: / the first is an oblation of ten thousand, and beyond that is an oblation of a hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyaḥ koṭihomastu sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ ..
ayutenāhutīnāṃ ca navagrahamakhaḥ smṛtaḥ ..6..
meaning:
तृतीयः कोटिहोमस्तु सर्वकामफलप्रदः ..
अयुतेनाहुतीनां च नवग्रहमखः स्मृतः ..6..
text_mt: The third is an oblation of ten million, which bestows the fruit of all desires; / and a sacrifice to the nine planets is traditionally known to consist of ten thousand offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya tāvadvidhiṃ vakṣye purāṇaśrutibhāṣitam ..
gartasyottarapūrveṇa vitastidvayavistṛtām .. 7 ..
meaning:
तस्य तावद्विधिं वक्ष्ये पुराणश्रुतिभाषितम् ..
गर्तस्योत्तरपूर्वेण वितस्तिद्वयविस्तृताम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: I shall first explain its procedure as taught in the Purāṇas and the Vedas. / To the northeast of the pit, measuring two spans in width,

sanskrit_iast:
kuryādvidhānato vediṃ vitastyucchrayasaṃyutām ..
saṃsthāpanāya devānāṃ caturasrāmudakplavām .. 8 ..
meaning:
कुर्याद्विधानतो वेदिं वितस्त्युच्छ्रयसंयुताम् ..
संस्थापनाय देवानां चतुरस्रामुदक्प्लवाम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: one should construct an altar according to rule, with a height of one span, / four-cornered and sloping to the north, for the installation of the deities.

sanskrit_iast:
agnipraṇayanaṃ kṛtvā tasyāmāvāhayetsurān ..
devānāṃ tatra saṃsthāpyā viṃśatirdvādaśādhikā .. 9 ..
meaning:
अग्निप्रणयनं कृत्वा तस्यामावाहयेत्सुरान् ..
देवानां तत्र संस्थाप्या विंशतिर्द्वादशाधिका .. 9 ..
text_mt: Having brought forward the sacrificial fire, one should invoke the gods upon it. / Thirty-two deities are to be installed there:

sanskrit_iast:
sūryaḥ somo mahīputro budho jīvaḥ sitorkajaḥ ..
rāhuḥ keturiti proktā grahālokahitāvahāḥ .. 4.141.10 ..
meaning:
सूर्यः सोमो महीपुत्रो बुधो जीवः सितोर्कजः ..
राहुः केतुरिति प्रोक्ता ग्रहालोकहितावहाः .. 4.141.10 ..
text_mt: Sūrya, Soma, Mahīputra, Budha, Jīva, Sita, the son of Arka, / Rāhu, and Ketu are declared to be the planets that bring welfare to the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmrakātsphaṭikādraktacandanātsvarṇajāvubhau ..
rajatādāyasāccaiva grahāḥ kāryāḥ kramādamī .. 11 ..
meaning:
ताम्रकात्स्फटिकाद्रक्तचन्दनात्स्वर्णजावुभौ ..
रजतादायसाच्चैव ग्रहाः कार्याः क्रमादमी .. 11 ..
text_mt: From copper, from crystal, from red sandalwood, two from gold, / from silver, and from iron—these planets should be made respectively [from these materials].

sanskrit_iast:
madhye tu bhāskaraṃ vidyāllohitaṃ dakṣiṇena tu ..
uttareṇa guruṃ vidyādbudhaṃ pūrvottareṇa tu .. 12 ..
meaning:
मध्ये तु भास्करं विद्याल्लोहितं दक्षिणेन तु ..
उत्तरेण गुरुं विद्याद्बुधं पूर्वोत्तरेण तु .. 12 ..
text_mt: One should know the Sun to be in the center, Mars to the south, / Jupiter to the north, and Mercury to the northeast;

sanskrit_iast:
pūrveṇa bhārgavaṃ vidyātsomaṃ dakṣiṇapūrvake ..
paścimottarataḥ ketuṃ sthāpayecchuklataṃḍulaiḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
पूर्वेण भार्गवं विद्यात्सोमं दक्षिणपूर्वके ..
पश्चिमोत्तरतः केतुं स्थापयेच्छुक्लतंडुलैः .. 13 ..
text_mt: one should know Venus to the east, Soma to the southeast, / and one should install Ketu to the northwest with white rice grains.

sanskrit_iast:
rājāmātyānmahārāja taṃḍulaiḥ sthāpayedatha ..
bhāskarasyeśvaraṃ vidyādumāṃ ca śaśinastathā .. 14 ..
meaning:
राजामात्यान्महाराज तंडुलैः स्थापयेदथ ..
भास्करस्येश्वरं विद्यादुमां च शशिनस्तथा .. 14 ..
text_mt: Then, O great king, one should install the kings and ministers with rice grains. / One should know Īśvara as the deity of the Sun, and Umā as that of the Moon,

sanskrit_iast:
skandamaṅgārakasyāpi budhasya ca tathā harim ..
brahmāṇaṃ ca gurorvidyācchukrasyāpi śacīpatim .. .. 15 ..
meaning:
स्कन्दमङ्गारकस्यापि बुधस्य च तथा हरिम् ..
ब्रह्माणं च गुरोर्विद्याच्छुक्रस्यापि शचीपतिम् .. .. 15 ..
text_mt: Skanda as that of Mars, and likewise Hari as that of Mercury, / Brahmā as that of Jupiter, and Śacī's lord as that of Venus,

sanskrit_iast:
śanaiścarasya tu yamaṃ rāhoḥ kālaṃ tathaiva ca ..
ketostu citraguptaṃ tu sarveṣāmeva devatāḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
शनैश्चरस्य तु यमं राहोः कालं तथैव च ..
केतोस्तु चित्रगुप्तं तु सर्वेषामेव देवताः .. 16 ..
text_mt: Yama as that of Saturn, and likewise Kāla as that of Rāhu, / and Citragupta as that of Ketu: these are the deities of all [the planets].

sanskrit_iast:
agnirāpaḥ kṣitirviṣṇurindraḥ sauvarṇadevatāḥ ..
prajāpatiśca sūryaśca brahmā pratyadhidevatāḥ ..17..
meaning:
अग्निरापः क्षितिर्विष्णुरिन्द्रः सौवर्णदेवताः ..
प्रजापतिश्च सूर्यश्च ब्रह्मा प्रत्यधिदेवताः ..17..
text_mt: Agni, the Waters, Earth, Viṣṇu, and Indra are the golden deities. / Prajāpati, Sūrya, and Brahmā are the secondary presiding deities.

sanskrit_iast:
vināyakaṃ tathā durgāṃ vāyumākāśameva ca ..
sāvitrīṃ ca tathā lakṣmīmumāṃ ca sahabhartṛkām .. .. 18 ..
meaning:
विनायकं तथा दुर्गां वायुमाकाशमेव च ..
सावित्रीं च तथा लक्ष्मीमुमां च सहभर्तृकाम् .. .. 18 ..
text_mt: Vināyaka, likewise Durgā, Vāyu, and Space, / Sāvitrī, and likewise Lakṣmī, and Umā together with her consort,

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhayedvyāhṛtibhistathaivāśvikumārakau ..
saṃsmaredraktamādityamaṃgārakasamanvitam .. 19 ..
meaning:
आवाहयेद्व्याहृतिभिस्तथैवाश्विकुमारकौ ..
संस्मरेद्रक्तमादित्यमंगारकसमन्वितम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: and likewise the two Aśvins one should invoke with the sacred utterances. / One should meditate on the Sun as red, together with Mars;

sanskrit_iast:
somaśukrau yathāśvetau budhajīvau ca piṅga lau ..
maṃdarāhū tathā kṛṣṇau dhūmraṃ ketuguṇaṃ viduḥ .. 4.141.20 ..
meaning:
सोमशुक्रौ यथाश्वेतौ बुधजीवौ च पिङ्ग लौ ..
मंदराहू तथा कृष्णौ धूम्रं केतुगुणं विदुः .. 4.141.20 ..
text_mt: the Moon and Venus are white, Mercury and Jupiter are yellowish-brown, / Saturn and Rāhu are black, and they know the quality of Ketu to be smoky.

sanskrit_iast:
grahavarṇāni deyāni vāsāṃsi kusumāni ca ..
gaṃdhāśca balayaścaiva dhūpā guggulapūrvakāḥ .. .. 21 ..
meaning:
ग्रहवर्णानि देयानि वासांसि कुसुमानि च ..
गंधाश्च बलयश्चैव धूपा गुग्गुलपूर्वकाः .. .. 21 ..
text_mt: Garments and flowers corresponding to the colors of the planets should be offered, / as well as perfumes, offerings, and incenses headed by bdellium.

sanskrit_iast:
guḍaudanaṃ raverdadyātsomāya ghṛtapāyasam ..
aṃgārakāya saṃyāvaṃ budhāya kṣīraṣaṣṭikam .. 22 ..
meaning:
गुडौदनं रवेर्दद्यात्सोमाय घृतपायसम् ..
अंगारकाय संयावं बुधाय क्षीरषष्टिकम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: One should give jaggery-rice to the Sun, milk-rice with ghee to the Moon, / a sweet confection of wheat to Mars, and milk cooked with sixty-day rice to Mercury.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhyannaṃ gurave dadyācchakrāya tu ghṛtaudanam ..
śanaiścarāya kṛśaraṃ meṣamāṃsaṃ tu rāhave .. 23 ..
meaning:
दध्यन्नं गुरवे दद्याच्छक्राय तु घृतौदनम् ..
शनैश्चराय कृशरं मेषमांसं तु राहवे .. 23 ..
text_mt: One should give curd-rice to Jupiter, and rice with ghee to Venus, / a dish of rice and lentils to Saturn, and ram's meat to Rāhu,

sanskrit_iast:
citraudanaṃ ketave ca sarvānbhakṣyairathārcayet ..
prāguttareṇa tasmācca dadhyakṣatavibhūṣitam .. 24 ..
meaning:
चित्रौदनं केतवे च सर्वान्भक्ष्यैरथार्चयेत् ..
प्रागुत्तरेण तस्माच्च दध्यक्षतविभूषितम् .. 24 ..
text_mt: and variegated rice to Ketu; and then one should worship them all with eatables. / To the northeast of that, [one should place an unblemished jar] adorned with curd and unbroken rice,

sanskrit_iast:
cūta pallavasaṃpannaṃ phalavastrayugānvitam ..
pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ pañcabhaṃgayutaṃ tathā .. 25 ..
meaning:
चूत पल्लवसंपन्नं फलवस्त्रयुगान्वितम् ..
पञ्चरत्नसमायुक्तं पञ्चभंगयुतं तथा .. 25 ..
text_mt: provided with mango shoots, accompanied by fruit and a pair of cloths, / endowed with the five jewels, and likewise furnished with the five leaves;

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpayedavraṇaṃ kuṃbhaṃ varuṇaṃ tatra vinyaset ..
gaṃgāyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ samudrāśca sarāṃsi ca .. 26 ..
meaning:
स्थापयेदव्रणं कुंभं वरुणं तत्र विन्यसेत् ..
गंगायाः सरितः सर्वाः समुद्राश्च सरांसि च .. 26 ..
text_mt: one should place an unblemished water jar, and install Varuṇa in it. / All the rivers [beginning with] the Gaṅgā, the oceans, and the lakes,

sanskrit_iast:
gajāśvarathyāvalmīkātsaṃgamāddhṛdagokulāt ..
mṛdamānīya rājendra sarvauṣadhijalānvitām .. 27 ..
meaning:
गजाश्वरथ्यावल्मीकात्संगमाद्धृदगोकुलात् ..
मृदमानीय राजेन्द्र सर्वौषधिजलान्विताम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: having brought earth from an elephant-track, a horse-track, an anthill, a confluence, a lake, and a cowpen, O lord of kings, / combined with water containing all medicinal herbs,

sanskrit_iast:
snānārthaṃ vinyasettatra yajamānasya dharmavit ..
sarve samudrāḥ saritaḥ saraḥ prasravaṇāni ca .. 28 ..
meaning:
स्नानार्थं विन्यसेत्तत्र यजमानस्य धर्मवित् ..
सर्वे समुद्राः सरितः सरः प्रस्रवणानि च .. 28 ..
text_mt: the one who knows dharma should place it there for the bath of the patron of the sacrifice. / "May all the oceans, rivers, lakes, and waterfalls

sanskrit_iast:
āyāṃtu yajamānasya duritakṣayakārakāḥ ..
evamāvāhayitvā tānsarvānnṛpatisattama .. 29 ..
meaning:
आयांतु यजमानस्य दुरितक्षयकारकाः ..
एवमावाहयित्वा तान्सर्वान्नृपतिसत्तम .. 29 ..
text_mt: come to destroy the misfortunes of the patron of the sacrifice!" / Having thus invoked them all, O best of monarchs,

sanskrit_iast:
homaṃ samārabhetsarpiryavavrīhitilādinā ..
arkaḥ palāśakhadirau hyapāmārgo'tha pippalaḥ .. 4.141.30 ..
meaning:
होमं समारभेत्सर्पिर्यवव्रीहितिलादिना ..
अर्कः पलाशखदिरौ ह्यपामार्गोऽथ पिप्पलः .. 4.141.30 ..
text_mt: one should commence the oblation with ghee, barley, rice, sesame, and other substances. / Calotropis, palāśa, and khadira, then apāmārga, then pippala,

sanskrit_iast:
uduṃbara śamīdūrvākuśāśca samidhaḥ kramāt ..
ekaikasya cāṣṭaśatamaṣṭāviṃśati vā punaḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
उदुंबर शमीदूर्वाकुशाश्च समिधः क्रमात् ..
एकैकस्य चाष्टशतमष्टाविंशति वा पुनः .. 31 ..
text_mt: udumbara, śamī, dūrvā grass, and kuśa grass are the kindling sticks respectively. / For each one, one hundred and eight, or twenty-eight,

sanskrit_iast:
hotavyā madhusarpibhyāṃ dadhnā vā pāyasena vā ..
prādeśamātrā ṛjavo viśākhā viphalāḥ śubhāḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
होतव्या मधुसर्पिभ्यां दध्ना वा पायसेन वा ..
प्रादेशमात्रा ऋजवो विशाखा विफलाः शुभाः .. 32 ..
text_mt: kindling sticks should be offered with honey and ghee, or with curd, or with milk-rice. / Measuring a span in length, straight, unbranched, without fruit, and auspicious—

sanskrit_iast:
kalpyaṃte samidhaḥ prājñaiḥ sarvakarmasu sarvadā ..
devānāmapi sarveṣāmupāṃśu paramārthavit .. 33 ..'
meaning:
कल्प्यंते समिधः प्राज्ञैः सर्वकर्मसु सर्वदा ..
देवानामपि सर्वेषामुपांशु परमार्थवित् .. 33 ..'
text_mt: such kindling sticks are prepared by the wise in all rites at all times. / For all the deities as well, in a low voice, the knower of the supreme truth

sanskrit_iast:
svena svenaiva maṃtreṇa hotavyāḥ samidhaḥ pṛthak ..
ākṛṣṇena imaṃ devā agnirmūrddhā divaḥ kramāt .. 34 ..
meaning:
स्वेन स्वेनैव मंत्रेण होतव्याः समिधः पृथक् ..
आकृष्णेन इमं देवा अग्निर्मूर्द्धा दिवः क्रमात् .. 34 ..
text_mt: should offer the kindling sticks separately, each with its own mantra: / "By the dark [path]," "These, O gods," and "Agni is the head of heaven," in order,

sanskrit_iast:
udbudhyasveti bodhyaśca yathāsaṃkhyamudāhṛtāḥ ..
bṛhaspate atiyadastathaivānnātparisutaḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
उद्बुध्यस्वेति बोध्यश्च यथासंख्यमुदाहृताः ..
बृहस्पते अतियदस्तथैवान्नात्परिसुतः .. 35 ..
text_mt: and "Awaken"—these are recited in their respective order— / "O Bṛhaspati, that which is transcendent," and likewise "From food distilled,"

sanskrit_iast:
śannodevīti ca kayā ketuṃ kṛṇvannitīti ca ..
hotavyaṃ yadvadājyaṃ caruṃ bhakṣyāṇi vā punaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
शन्नोदेवीति च कया केतुं कृण्वन्नितीति च ..
होतव्यं यद्वदाज्यं चरुं भक्ष्याणि वा पुनः .. 36 ..
text_mt: "May the divine waters be propitious to us," and "With what [aid]," and "Making a banner." / Clarified butter, sacrificial porridge, or eatables should be offered in the same way.

sanskrit_iast:
maṃtrairdaśāhutīrdattvā homo vyāhṛtibhistataḥ ..
udaṅmukhāḥ prāṅmukhāśca kuryurbrāhmaṇapuṃgavāḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
मंत्रैर्दशाहुतीर्दत्त्वा होमो व्याहृतिभिस्ततः ..
उदङ्मुखाः प्राङ्मुखाश्च कुर्युर्ब्राह्मणपुंगवाः .. 37 ..
text_mt: Having offered ten oblations with these mantras, the oblation is then performed with the sacred utterances / by the foremost Brahmins facing either north or east.

sanskrit_iast:
maṃtravaṃtastu kartavyāścaravaḥ pratidaivatam ..
apo rājeti rudrasya balihomaṃ samārabhet .. 38 ..
meaning:
मंत्रवंतस्तु कर्तव्याश्चरवः प्रतिदैवतम् ..
अपो राजेति रुद्रस्य बलिहोमं समारभेत् .. 38 ..
text_mt: The sacrificial caru offerings, accompanied by mantras, are to be prepared for each deity. / With 'apo rājan,' one should begin the offering-oblation to Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
āpo hiṣṭetyumāyāstu śyeneti svāminastathā ..
viṣṇoridaṃ viṣṇuriti svamiccheti svayaṃbhuvaḥ .. .. 39 ..
meaning:
आपो हिष्टेत्युमायास्तु श्येनेति स्वामिनस्तथा ..
विष्णोरिदं विष्णुरिति स्वमिच्छेति स्वयंभुवः .. .. 39 ..
text_mt: With 'āpo hi ṣṭhā' for Umā, with 'śyena' for the Lord [Skanda], / with 'idaṃ viṣṇur' for Viṣṇu, and with 'svam iccha' for the Self-born [Brahmā];

sanskrit_iast:
indrādidevatānāṃ tu indrāya juhuyātpunaḥ ..
navā yamasyāyaṃ gauścetyevaṃ homaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 4.141.40 ..
meaning:
इन्द्रादिदेवतानां तु इन्द्राय जुहुयात्पुनः ..
नवा यमस्यायं गौश्चेत्येवं होमः प्रकीर्तितः .. 4.141.40 ..
text_mt: and for the deities beginning with Indra, one should offer [with the mantra] to Indra; / for Yama with 'navā' and 'ayaṃ gauḥ'—thus the oblation is proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
kālasya brahmajajñānamiti maṃtraḥ praśasyate ..
citraguptasya vā jāta paurāṇikā vidurbudhāḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
कालस्य ब्रह्मजज्ञानमिति मंत्रः प्रशस्यते ..
चित्रगुप्तस्य वा जात पौराणिका विदुर्बुधाः .. 41 ..
text_mt: For Kāla the mantra 'brahma jajñānam' is praised; / for Citragupta, or with 'jāta,' as the wise scholars of the Purāṇas know.

sanskrit_iast:
agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe iti vahnerudāhṛtaḥ ..
iṃdraṃ yamaṃ varuṇamityayaṃ maṃtraḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. .. 42 ..
meaning:
अग्निं दूतं वृणीमहे इति वह्नेरुदाहृतः ..
इंद्रं यमं वरुणमित्ययं मंत्रः प्रकीर्तितः .. .. 42 ..
text_mt: For Agni 'agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe' is declared; / 'indraṃ yamaṃ varuṇam' is the mantra proclaimed [for the guardians of the directions].

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmeḥ pṛthivyaṃtarikṣamiti vedeṣu paṭhyate ..
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣa iti viṣṇorudāhṛtaḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
भूमेः पृथिव्यंतरिक्षमिति वेदेषु पठ्यते ..
सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुष इति विष्णोरुदाहृतः .. 43 ..
text_mt: For the Earth, 'pṛthivy antarikṣam' is recited in the Vedas; / 'sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ' is declared for Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
varuṇaḥ pavanaścaiva dhanādhyakṣastathā śivaḥ ..
brahmaṇā sahitaḥ śeṣo dikpālāḥ pātu te sadā .. 44 ..
meaning:
वरुणः पवनश्चैव धनाध्यक्षस्तथा शिवः ..
ब्रह्मणा सहितः शेषो दिक्पालाः पातु ते सदा .. 44 ..
text_mt: May Varuṇa, Pavana, Dhanādhyakṣa [Kubera], and Śiva, / along with Brahmā, Śeṣa, and the guardians of the directions, protect you always.

sanskrit_iast:
kīrtirlakṣmīrdhṛtirmedhāḥ puṣṭiḥ śraddhā kriyā matiḥ ..
buddhirlajjā śāṃtipuṣṭī kāṃtistuṣṭiśca mātaraḥ ..45..
meaning:
कीर्तिर्लक्ष्मीर्धृतिर्मेधाः पुष्टिः श्रद्धा क्रिया मतिः ..
बुद्धिर्लज्जा शांतिपुष्टी कांतिस्तुष्टिश्च मातरः ..45..
text_mt: Kīrti, Lakṣmī, Dhṛti, Medhā, Puṣṭi, Śraddhā, Kriyā, Mati, / Buddhi, Lajjā, Śānti, Tuṣṭi, Kānti, and the Mothers—

sanskrit_iast:
etāstvāmabhiṣiṃcaṃtu dharmapatnyaḥ samāgatāḥ ..
ādityaścandramā bhaumo budhajīvasitārkajāḥ ..46..
meaning:
एतास्त्वामभिषिंचंतु धर्मपत्न्यः समागताः ..
आदित्यश्चन्द्रमा भौमो बुधजीवसितार्कजाः ..46..
text_mt: assembled as the wives of Dharma, may these consecrate you. / The Sun, the Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, and Saturn;

sanskrit_iast:
grahāstvāmabhiṣiṃcaṃtu rāhuḥ ketuśca tarpitāḥ ..
devadānavagaṃdharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
ग्रहास्त्वामभिषिंचंतु राहुः केतुश्च तर्पिताः ..
देवदानवगंधर्वा यक्षराक्षसपन्नगाः .. 47 ..
text_mt: may the planets consecrate you, as well as Rāhu and Ketu when satisfied; / gods, Dānavas, Gandharvas, yakṣas, rākṣasas, and serpents;

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayo manavo gāvo devamātara eva ca ..
devapatnyo drumā nāgā daityāścāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ .. .. 48 ..
meaning:
ऋषयो मनवो गावो देवमातर एव च ..
देवपत्न्यो द्रुमा नागा दैत्याश्चाप्सरसां गणाः .. .. 48 ..
text_mt: sages, Manus, cows, and the mothers of the gods; / the wives of the gods, trees, nāgas, Daityas, and the hosts of apsarases;

sanskrit_iast:
astrāṇi sarvaśastrāṇi rājāno vāhanāni ca ..
auṣadhāni ca ratnāni kālasyāvayavāśca ye .. 49 ..
meaning:
अस्त्राणि सर्वशस्त्राणि राजानो वाहनानि च ..
औषधानि च रत्नानि कालस्यावयवाश्च ये .. 49 ..
text_mt: missiles, all weapons, kings, and mounts; / herbs, jewels, and the divisions of Time;

sanskrit_iast:
saritaḥ sāgarāḥ śailāstīrthāni jaladā nadāḥ ..
ete tvāmabhiṣiṃcaṃtu sarvakāmārthasiddhaye .. 4.141.50 ..
meaning:
सरितः सागराः शैलास्तीर्थानि जलदा नदाः ..
एते त्वामभिषिंचंतु सर्वकामार्थसिद्धये .. 4.141.50 ..
text_mt: rivers, oceans, mountains, sacred fords, clouds, and streams— / may these consecrate you for the accomplishment of all desires and purposes.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuklagandhānulepanaḥ ..
sarvagandhasamāyuktaḥ snātaḥ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..51..
meaning:
ततः शुक्लांबरधरः शुक्लगन्धानुलेपनः ..
सर्वगन्धसमायुक्तः स्नातः श्रद्धासमन्वितः ..51..
text_mt: Then, clad in white garments, anointed with white unguents, / endowed with all perfumes, bathed, and filled with faith,

sanskrit_iast:
yajamānaḥ sapatnīkānsiddhidāṃstānsamāhitān ..
dakṣiṇābhiḥ prayatnena pūjayedgatavismayaḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
यजमानः सपत्नीकान्सिद्धिदांस्तान्समाहितान् ..
दक्षिणाभिः प्रयत्नेन पूजयेद्गतविस्मयः .. 52 ..
text_mt: the patron of the sacrifice, free from arrogance, should diligently honour / [the priests] who grant success, composed in mind, together with their wives, with priestly gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryāya kapilāṃ dhenuṃ dadyācchaṃkhaṃ tathendave ..
raktaṃ dhuraṃdharaṃ dadyādbhaumāya kakudādhikam .. 53 ..
meaning:
सूर्याय कपिलां धेनुं दद्याच्छंखं तथेन्दवे ..
रक्तं धुरंधरं दद्याद्भौमाय ककुदाधिकम् .. 53 ..
text_mt: To the Sun he should give a tawny cow; likewise a conch to the Moon; / to Mars he should give a red draught-ox with a large hump;

sanskrit_iast:
budhāya jātarūpaṃ ca gurave pītavāsasī ..
śvetāśvaṃ daityagurave kṛṣṇāṃgāmarkasūnave .. 54 ..
meaning:
बुधाय जातरूपं च गुरवे पीतवाससी ..
श्वेताश्वं दैत्यगुरवे कृष्णांगामर्कसूनवे .. 54 ..
text_mt: gold to Mercury; two yellow garments to Jupiter; / a white horse to the guru of the Daityas [Venus]; and black cows to the son of Arka [Saturn].

sanskrit_iast:
āyasaṃ rāhave dadyātketave cchāgamuttamam ..
suvarṇena samā kāryā yajamānena dakṣiṇā .. 55..
meaning:
आयसं राहवे दद्यात्केतवे च्छागमुत्तमम् ..
सुवर्णेन समा कार्या यजमानेन दक्षिणा .. 55..
text_mt: To Rāhu he should give iron; to Ketu an excellent he-goat; / the patron of the sacrifice should make the priestly gift equivalent in value to gold.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmathavā dadyādgururvā yena tuṣyati ..
sumaṃtreṇa pradātavyāḥ sarvāḥ sarvārthadakṣiṇāḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
सर्वेषामथवा दद्याद्गुरुर्वा येन तुष्यति ..
सुमंत्रेण प्रदातव्याः सर्वाः सर्वार्थदक्षिणाः .. 56 ..
text_mt: Or he may give to all whatever pleases the preceptor; / all priestly gifts for every purpose should be given with appropriate mantras:

sanskrit_iast:
kapile sarvadevānāṃ pūjanīyāsi rohiṇī ..
tīrthadevamayī yasmādataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayaccha me .. 57 ..
meaning:
कपिले सर्वदेवानां पूजनीयासि रोहिणी ..
तीर्थदेवमयी यस्मादतः शांतिं प्रयच्छ मे .. 57 ..
text_mt: 'O tawny cow, you are worthy of worship by all the gods, O Rohiṇī! / Since you are made of all sacred fords and deities, therefore grant me peace.'

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyastvaṃ śaṃkha puṇyānāṃ maṅgalānāṃ ca maṃgalam ..
viṣṇunā vidhṛto nityamataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayaccha me .. 58 ..
meaning:
पुण्यस्त्वं शंख पुण्यानां मङ्गलानां च मंगलम् ..
विष्णुना विधृतो नित्यमतः शांतिं प्रयच्छ मे .. 58 ..
text_mt: 'O conch, you are holy among holy things and the auspiciousness of all auspicious things; / you are eternally held by Viṣṇu, therefore grant me peace.'

sanskrit_iast:
dharma tvaṃ vṛṣarūpeṇa jagadānandakārakaḥ ..
aṣṭamūrteradhiṣṭhānamataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayaccha me .. 59 ..
meaning:
धर्म त्वं वृषरूपेण जगदानन्दकारकः ..
अष्टमूर्तेरधिष्ठानमतः शांतिं प्रयच्छ मे .. 59 ..
text_mt: 'O Dharma, in the form of a bull you bring joy to the world; / you are the mount of the Eight-formed Lord [Śiva], therefore grant me peace.'

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyagarbhagarbhasthaṃ hema bījaṃ vibhāvasoḥ ..
anantapuṇyaphaladamataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayaccha me .. 4.141.60 ..
meaning:
हिरण्यगर्भगर्भस्थं हेम बीजं विभावसोः ..
अनन्तपुण्यफलदमतः शांतिं प्रयच्छ मे .. 4.141.60 ..
text_mt: 'Gold, resting within the womb of Hiraṇyagarbha, is the seed of Fire; / it grants the fruit of endless merit, therefore grant me peace.'

sanskrit_iast:
pītavastrayugaṃ dadyādvāsudevasya vallabham ..
pradānāttasya me viṣṇurataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayacchatu .. 61 ..
meaning:
पीतवस्त्रयुगं दद्याद्वासुदेवस्य वल्लभम् ..
प्रदानात्तस्य मे विष्णुरतः शांतिं प्रयच्छतु .. 61 ..
text_mt: 'One should present a pair of yellow garments, dear to Vāsudeva; / from that gift, may Viṣṇu therefore grant me peace.'

sanskrit_iast:
kapilastvaśvarūpeṇa yasmādamṛtasambhavaḥ ..
candrārkavāhano nityamataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayaccha me .. 62 ..
meaning:
कपिलस्त्वश्वरूपेण यस्मादमृतसम्भवः ..
चन्द्रार्कवाहनो नित्यमतः शांतिं प्रयच्छ मे .. 62 ..
text_mt: 'O tawny horse, since in the form of a steed you were born from the nectar, / and are ever the mount of the Moon and the Sun, therefore grant me peace.'

sanskrit_iast:
yasmāttvaṃ pṛthivī sarvā dheno vai kṛṣṇasaṃjñitā ..
sarvapāpaharā nityamataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayaccha me .. 63 ..
meaning:
यस्मात्त्वं पृथिवी सर्वा धेनो वै कृष्णसंज्ञिता ..
सर्वपापहरा नित्यमतः शांतिं प्रयच्छ मे .. 63 ..
text_mt: 'O cow designated as black, since you are the entire earth / and ever the remover of all sins, therefore grant me peace.'

sanskrit_iast:
yasmādāyasa karmāṇi tavādhīnāni sarvadā ..
lāṃgalānyāyudhādīni tasmācchāṃtiṃ prayaccha me .. 64 ..
meaning:
यस्मादायस कर्माणि तवाधीनानि सर्वदा ..
लांगलान्यायुधादीनि तस्माच्छांतिं प्रयच्छ मे .. 64 ..
text_mt: 'Since iron implements such as plows and weapons / are forever subject to you, therefore grant me peace.'

sanskrit_iast:
yasmāttvaṃ chāga yajñānāmaṃgatvena vyavasthitaḥ ..
yonirvibhāvasornityamataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayaccha me .. 65 ..
meaning:
यस्मात्त्वं छाग यज्ञानामंगत्वेन व्यवस्थितः ..
योनिर्विभावसोर्नित्यमतः शांतिं प्रयच्छ मे .. 65 ..
text_mt: 'O he-goat, since you stand as an essential limb of sacrifices / and are ever the source of Fire, therefore grant me peace.'

sanskrit_iast:
gavāmaṃgeṣu tiṣṭhaṃti bhuvanāni caturdaśa ..
yasmāttasmācchivaṃ me syādiha loke paratra ca .. .. 66 ..
meaning:
गवामंगेषु तिष्ठंति भुवनानि चतुर्दश ..
यस्मात्तस्माच्छिवं मे स्यादिह लोके परत्र च .. .. 66 ..
text_mt: 'The fourteen worlds abide within the limbs of cows; / because of that, may there be auspiciousness for me in this world and in the next.'

sanskrit_iast:
yasmādaśūnyaṃ śayanaṃ keśavasya śivasya ca ..
śayyā mamāpyaśūnyāstu tathā janmani janmani .. 67 ..
meaning:
यस्मादशून्यं शयनं केशवस्य शिवस्य च ..
शय्या ममाप्यशून्यास्तु तथा जन्मनि जन्मनि .. 67 ..
text_mt: 'Just as the couch of Keśava and of Śiva is never empty, / so too may my bed never be empty, birth after birth.'

sanskrit_iast:
yathā ratneṣu sarveṣu sarve devā vyavasthitāḥ ..
tathā śāṃtiṃ prayacchaṃtu ratnadānena me surāḥ .. 68 ..
meaning:
यथा रत्नेषु सर्वेषु सर्वे देवा व्यवस्थिताः ..
तथा शांतिं प्रयच्छंतु रत्नदानेन मे सुराः .. 68 ..
text_mt: 'Just as all the gods abide in all precious stones, / so may the gods grant me peace through the gift of gems.'

sanskrit_iast:
yathā bhūmipradānasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm ..
dānānyanyāni me śāṃtiṃ bhūmi dānādbhavatyapi .. 69 ..
meaning:
यथा भूमिप्रदानस्य कलां नार्हंति षोडशीम् ..
दानान्यन्यानि मे शांतिं भूमि दानाद्भवत्यपि .. 69 ..
text_mt: 'Just as other gifts do not equal even a sixteenth part of a gift of land, / may peace come to me from the gift of land.'

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃpūjayedbhaktyā vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ..
vastrakāñcanaratnaughairmālyagaṃdhānulepanaiḥ .. 4.141.70 ..
meaning:
एवं संपूजयेद्भक्त्या वित्तशाठ्यविवर्जितः ..
वस्त्रकाञ्चनरत्नौघैर्माल्यगंधानुलेपनैः .. 4.141.70 ..
text_mt: Thus he should worship with devotion, free from deceit regarding his wealth, / with heaps of garments, gold, and jewels, and with garlands, perfumes, and unguents.

sanskrit_iast:
grahasvarūpamatulaṃ kathyamānaṃ nibodha me ..
bhaktibhāvaprapannasya kathyamānaṃ virājate ..
padmāsanaḥ padmakaraḥ padmagarbhasamadyutiḥ ..
saptāśvaḥ saptarajjuśca dvibhujaḥ syātsadā raviḥ .. .. 71 ..
meaning:
ग्रहस्वरूपमतुलं कथ्यमानं निबोध मे ..
भक्तिभावप्रपन्नस्य कथ्यमानं विराजते ..
पद्मासनः पद्मकरः पद्मगर्भसमद्युतिः ..
सप्ताश्वः सप्तरज्जुश्च द्विभुजः स्यात्सदा रविः .. .. 71 ..
text_mt: Hear from me the incomparable forms of the planets as they are described; / described to one endowed with devotion, they shine forth: / The Sun should always be seated on a lotus, holding a lotus in his hand, radiant like the interior of a lotus, / possessing seven horses, seven reins, and two arms.

sanskrit_iast:
śvetaḥ śvetāṃbaradharo daśāśvaḥ śvetabhūṣaṇaḥ ..
gadāpāṇirdvibāhuśca kartavyo varadaḥ śaśī .. 72 ..
meaning:
श्वेतः श्वेतांबरधरो दशाश्वः श्वेतभूषणः ..
गदापाणिर्द्विबाहुश्च कर्तव्यो वरदः शशी .. 72 ..
text_mt: White, wearing white garments, with ten horses and white ornaments, / holding a mace in hand, two-armed, and bestowing boons: such should the Moon be made.

sanskrit_iast:
raktamālyāṃbaradharaḥ karṇikārasamaṃdyutiḥ ..
khaḍgacarmagadāpāṇirvidheyo bhūminaṃdanaḥ .. 73 ..
meaning:
रक्तमाल्यांबरधरः कर्णिकारसमंद्युतिः ..
खड्गचर्मगदापाणिर्विधेयो भूमिनंदनः .. 73 ..
text_mt: Wearing red garlands and garments, with a splendour like the karṇikāra flower, / holding a sword, shield, and mace in hand, the Son of the Earth [Mars] should be made.

sanskrit_iast:
pītamālyāṃbaradharaḥ pītagaṃdhānulepanaḥ ..
kāṃcane ca rathe divye śobhamāno budhaḥ sadā .. 74 ..
meaning:
पीतमाल्यांबरधरः पीतगंधानुलेपनः ..
कांचने च रथे दिव्ये शोभमानो बुधः सदा .. 74 ..
text_mt: Wearing yellow garlands and garments, anointed with yellow fragrant unguents, / Mercury should ever be resplendent in a divine golden chariot.

sanskrit_iast:
devadaityagurū tadvatpītaśvetau caturbhujau ..
daṃḍinau varadau kāryau sākṣasūtrakamaḍalū .. 75 ..
meaning:
देवदैत्यगुरू तद्वत्पीतश्वेतौ चतुर्भुजौ ..
दंडिनौ वरदौ कार्यौ साक्षसूत्रकमडलू .. 75 ..
text_mt: Likewise, the preceptors of the gods and of the Daityas [Jupiter and Venus], yellow and white respectively, four-armed, / carrying staffs, bestowing boons, and holding rosaries and water pots, should be made.

sanskrit_iast:
indranīladyutiḥ śūlī varado gṛdhravāhanaḥ ..
bāṇabāṇāsanadharaḥ kartavyo'rkasutaḥ sadā .. 76 ..
meaning:
इन्द्रनीलद्युतिः शूली वरदो गृध्रवाहनः ..
बाणबाणासनधरः कर्तव्योऽर्कसुतः सदा .. 76 ..
text_mt: Radiant like a sapphire, holding a trident, bestowing boons, mounted on a vulture, / holding arrows and a bow: such should the son of Arka [Saturn] always be made.

sanskrit_iast:
śārdūlavadanaḥ khaḍgī varmī śūlī varapradaḥ ..
nīlasiṃhāsanasthaśca rāhuratra praśasyate .. 77 ..
meaning:
शार्दूलवदनः खड्गी वर्मी शूली वरप्रदः ..
नीलसिंहासनस्थश्च राहुरत्र प्रशस्यते .. 77 ..
text_mt: With the face of a tiger, holding a sword, armoured, bearing a trident, granting boons, / and seated upon a blue throne: Rāhu is praised here as such.

sanskrit_iast:
dhūmrā dvibāhavaḥ sarve gadino vikṛtānanāḥ ..
gṛdhrāsanaratā nityaṃ ketavaḥ syurvarapradāḥ .. 78 ..
meaning:
धूम्रा द्विबाहवः सर्वे गदिनो विकृताननाः ..
गृध्रासनरता नित्यं केतवः स्युर्वरप्रदाः .. 78 ..
text_mt: Smoke-coloured, all two-armed, holding maces, with deformed faces, / ever seated upon vultures, the Ketus should be granters of boons.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve kirīṭinaḥ kāryā grahā lokahitāvahāḥ ..
svāṃgulenocchritāḥ sarve śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tadā .. 79 ..
meaning:
सर्वे किरीटिनः कार्या ग्रहा लोकहितावहाः ..
स्वांगुलेनोच्छ्रिताः सर्वे शतमष्टोत्तरं तदा .. 79 ..
text_mt: All the planets, bringers of welfare to the world, should be made wearing diadems; / each should be one hundred and eight finger-breadths in height according to their own measure.

sanskrit_iast:
grahasvarūpametatte vyākhyātaṃ pāṃḍunandana ..
etajjñātvā prayatnena pūjā kāryā vicakṣaṇaiḥ .. 4.141.80 ..
meaning:
ग्रहस्वरूपमेतत्ते व्याख्यातं पांडुनन्दन ..
एतज्ज्ञात्वा प्रयत्नेन पूजा कार्या विचक्षणैः .. 4.141.80 ..
text_mt: This form of the planets has been expounded to you, O son of Pāṇḍu; / having understood this, worship should be performed diligently by the discerning.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhinā grahapūjāṃ yonena tvārabhate naraḥ ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti pretya svarge mahīyate .. 81 ..
meaning:
विधिना ग्रहपूजां योनेन त्वारभते नरः ..
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति प्रेत्य स्वर्गे महीयते .. 81 ..
text_mt: The man who undertakes worship of the planets according to rule with this [method] / attains all desires, and after death is glorified in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu pīḍākaro nityaṃ mālyavittasya vā grahaḥ ..
taṃ tu yatnena saṃpūjya śeṣānapyarcayedbudhaḥ .. 82 ..
meaning:
यस्तु पीडाकरो नित्यं माल्यवित्तस्य वा ग्रहः ..
तं तु यत्नेन संपूज्य शेषानप्यर्चयेद्बुधः .. 82 ..
text_mt: Whichever planet constantly causes affliction to wealth or garlands, / the wise man should worship that one with effort, and worship the remaining ones as well.

sanskrit_iast:
grahā gāvo narendrāśca brāhmaṇāśca viśeṣataḥ ..
