pūjitāḥ pūjayaṃtyete nirdahaṃtyavamānitāḥ .. 83 ..
meaning:
ग्रहा गावो नरेन्द्राश्च ब्राह्मणाश्च विशेषतः ..
पूजिताः पूजयंत्येते निर्दहंत्यवमानिताः .. 83 ..
text_mt: Planets, cows, kings, and especially brāhmaṇas— / when worshipped, these [all] honour [him]; when disrespected, they burn [him] down.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānna dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā ..
saṃpūrṇāyāṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ yasmādeko'pi tuṣyati .. 84 ..
meaning:
तस्मान्न दक्षिणाहीनं कर्तव्यं भूतिमिच्छता ..
संपूर्णायां दक्षिणायां यस्मादेकोऽपि तुष्यति .. 84 ..
text_mt: Therefore one who desires prosperity should not perform it devoid of a sacrificial fee, / because when the fee is complete, even a single one is satisfied.

sanskrit_iast: sadaivā'yutahomo'yaṃ navagrahamakhaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 85 ..
meaning: सदैवाऽयुतहोमोऽयं नवग्रहमखः स्मृतः .. 85 ..
text_mt: This sacrifice to the nine planets is always remembered as a sacrifice of ten thousand oblations.

sanskrit_iast:
vivāhotsavayajñeṣu pratiṣṭhādiṣu karmasu ..
nirvighnārthaṃ mahārāja tathodvegādbhuteṣu ca .. 86 ..
meaning:
विवाहोत्सवयज्ञेषु प्रतिष्ठादिषु कर्मसु ..
निर्विघ्नार्थं महाराज तथोद्वेगाद्भुतेषु च .. 86 ..
text_mt: In marriages, festivals, and sacrifices, in consecration and other rites, / for the removal of obstacles, O great king, and likewise in times of anxiety and portents,

sanskrit_iast:
kathito'yutahomo'yaṃ lakṣahomamataḥ śṛṇu ..
sarvakāmāptaye yasmāllakṣa homaṃ vidurbudhāḥ .. 87 ..
meaning:
कथितोऽयुतहोमोऽयं लक्षहोममतः शृणु ..
सर्वकामाप्तये यस्माल्लक्ष होमं विदुर्बुधाः .. 87 ..
text_mt: this sacrifice of ten thousand oblations has been declared. Now listen to the sacrifice of one hundred thousand oblations; / for the wise know the sacrifice of one hundred thousand oblations to bring attainment of all desires,

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝṇāṃ vallabho yasmādbhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ ..
grahatārābalaṃ labdhvā kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam .. 88 ..
meaning:
पितॄणां वल्लभो यस्माद्भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदः ..
ग्रहताराबलं लब्ध्वा कृत्वा ब्राह्मणवाचनम् .. 88 ..
text_mt: because it is dear to the ancestors and bestows the fruit of enjoyment and liberation. / Having obtained the strength of the planets and asterisms and having the brāhmaṇas recite blessings,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhasyottarapūrveṇa maṇḍapaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ ..
rudrāyatanabhūmau vā caturasramudaṅmukham .. 89 ..
meaning:
गृहस्योत्तरपूर्वेण मण्डपं कारयेद्बुधः ..
रुद्रायतनभूमौ वा चतुरस्रमुदङ्मुखम् .. 89 ..
text_mt: the wise man should have a pavilion built to the northeast of the house / or on the ground of a sanctuary of Rudra, four-sided and facing north.

sanskrit_iast:
daśahastamathāṣṭau vā hastānkuryādvidhānataḥ ..
prāgudakpravaṇāṃ bhūmiṃ kārayedyatnato naraḥ .. 4.141.90 ..
meaning:
दशहस्तमथाष्टौ वा हस्तान्कुर्याद्विधानतः ..
प्रागुदक्प्रवणां भूमिं कारयेद्यत्नतो नरः .. 4.141.90 ..
text_mt: He should make it ten cubits or eight cubits according to rule; / a man should carefully have the ground made sloping toward the northeast.

sanskrit_iast:
prāguttaraṃ samāsādya pradeśaṃ maṃḍapasya tu ..
śobhanaṃ kārayetkuṇḍaṃ yathāvallakṣaṇānvitam .. 91 ..
meaning:
प्रागुत्तरं समासाद्य प्रदेशं मंडपस्य तु ..
शोभनं कारयेत्कुण्डं यथावल्लक्षणान्वितम् .. 91 ..
text_mt: Reaching the northeastern region of the pavilion, / he should have a beautiful sacrificial pit made, properly furnished with the required characteristics.

sanskrit_iast:
mānahīnaṃ cāpraśastamanekabhayadaṃ bhavet ..
yasmāttasmātsusaṃpūrṇaṃ śāṃtikuṃḍaṃ vidhīyate .. 92 ..
meaning:
मानहीनं चाप्रशस्तमनेकभयदं भवेत् ..
यस्मात्तस्मात्सुसंपूर्णं शांतिकुंडं विधीयते .. 92 ..
text_mt: Lacking proper measurement and unpraiseworthy, it would cause many fears; / therefore, a sacrificial pit for pacification is prescribed as perfectly complete.

sanskrit_iast:
asmāddaśaguṇaḥ prokto lakṣahome svayaṃbhuvā ..
āhutibhiḥ prayatnena dakṣiṇābhistathaiva ca .. 93 ..
meaning:
अस्माद्दशगुणः प्रोक्तो लक्षहोमे स्वयंभुवा ..
आहुतिभिः प्रयत्नेन दक्षिणाभिस्तथैव च .. 93 ..
text_mt: In the sacrifice of one hundred thousand oblations, it is declared by the Self-born to be tenfold compared to this, / in its oblations with care, and likewise in its sacrificial fees.

sanskrit_iast:
dvihastavistṛtaṃ tadvaccaturhastāyataṃ punaḥ ..
lakṣahome bhavetkuṇḍaṃ yonivaktraṃ trimekhalam .. 94 ..
meaning:
द्विहस्तविस्तृतं तद्वच्चतुर्हस्तायतं पुनः ..
लक्षहोमे भवेत्कुण्डं योनिवक्त्रं त्रिमेखलम् .. 94 ..
text_mt: In the sacrifice of one hundred thousand oblations, the sacrificial pit should likewise be two cubits wide / and four cubits long, with a yoni-shaped opening and three girdles,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsthāpanāya devānāṃ vapratrayasamāvṛtam ..
dviraṃgulocchrito vapraḥ prathamaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ .. 95 ..
meaning:
संस्थापनाय देवानां वप्रत्रयसमावृतम् ..
द्विरंगुलोच्छ्रितो वप्रः प्रथमः समुदाहृतः .. 95 ..
text_mt: surrounded by three tiers for the establishment of the deities. / The first tier is stated to be two finger-breadths high;

sanskrit_iast:
aṃgulocchrayasaṃyuktaṃ vapradvayamathopari ..
dvyaṅgulastatra vistāraḥ sarveṣāṃ kathyate budhaiḥ .. 96 ..
meaning:
अंगुलोच्छ्रयसंयुक्तं वप्रद्वयमथोपरि ..
द्व्यङ्गुलस्तत्र विस्तारः सर्वेषां कथ्यते बुधैः .. 96 ..
text_mt: then above it are two tiers, each one finger-breadth high. / The width of all of them there is said by the wise to be two finger-breadths.

sanskrit_iast:
daśāṃgulocchritā bhittiḥ sthaṃḍilasya tathopari ..
tasminnāvāhayeddevānpūrvavatpuṣpataṇḍulaiḥ .. 97 ..
meaning:
दशांगुलोच्छ्रिता भित्तिः स्थंडिलस्य तथोपरि ..
तस्मिन्नावाहयेद्देवान्पूर्ववत्पुष्पतण्डुलैः .. 97 ..
text_mt: The wall of the raised altar above it is ten finger-breadths high. / Upon it he should invoke the deities with flowers and raw rice grains as before.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityābhimukhāḥ sarvāḥ sthāpyāḥ pratyadhidevatāḥ ..
sthāpanīyā muniśreṣṭhā nāṃtareṇa parāṅmukhāḥ .. 98 ..
meaning:
आदित्याभिमुखाः सर्वाः स्थाप्याः प्रत्यधिदेवताः ..
स्थापनीया मुनिश्रेष्ठा नांतरेण पराङ्मुखाः .. 98 ..
text_mt: All the secondary and primary presiding deities must be established facing Āditya; / they should be set up, O best of sages, without facing away [from him].

sanskrit_iast:
garutmānadhikastatra saṃpūjyaḥ śriyamicchatā ..
samapīnaśarīrastu vāhanaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ ..99..
meaning:
गरुत्मानधिकस्तत्र संपूज्यः श्रियमिच्छता ..
समपीनशरीरस्तु वाहनं परमेष्ठिनः ..99..
text_mt: Garutmān should be worshipped there additionally by one who desires fortune; / he has an evenly plump body and is the mount of Parameṣṭhin.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣapāpaharo nityamataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayaccha me ..
pūrvavatkuṃbhamāmaṃtrya tadvaddhomaṃ samācaret ..4.141.1 00..
meaning:
विषपापहरो नित्यमतः शांतिं प्रयच्छ मे ..
पूर्ववत्कुंभमामंत्र्य तद्वद्धोमं समाचरेत् ..4.141.1 00..
text_mt: He constantly removes poison and sin: “Therefore bestow peace upon me.” / Having consecrated the water pot as before, he should perform the oblation in that manner.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ hutvā samitsaṃkhyādikaṃ punaḥ ..
audumbarīmathārdrāṃ ca vakrakoṭaravarjitām .. 101 ..
meaning:
सहस्राणां शतं हुत्वा समित्संख्यादिकं पुनः ..
औदुम्बरीमथार्द्रां च वक्रकोटरवर्जिताम् .. 101 ..
text_mt: Having offered a hundred thousand [oblations] with the count of firewood sticks and the rest, / then [making] an unctuous udumbara [ladle] free from crookedness and hollows,

sanskrit_iast:
bāhumātrāṃ srucaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ staṃbhadvayopari ..
ghṛtadhārāṃ tathā samyagagnerupari pātayet ..1 02..
meaning:
बाहुमात्रां स्रुचं कृत्वा ततः स्तंभद्वयोपरि ..
घृतधारां तथा सम्यगग्नेरुपरि पातयेत् ..1 02..
text_mt: having fashioned a sruc ladle one arm-length [long], then resting on two posts / he should properly pour a stream of clarified butter upon the fire.

sanskrit_iast:
pāṭhayetsūktamāgneyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ raudramaiṃdavam ..
mahāvaiśvānaraṃ sāma jyeṣṭhasāma ca pāṭhayet ..103..
meaning:
पाठयेत्सूक्तमाग्नेयं वैष्णवं रौद्रमैंदवम् ..
महावैश्वानरं साम ज्येष्ठसाम च पाठयेत् ..103..
text_mt: He should have the hymn to Agni recited, the one to Viṣṇu, the one to Rudra, and the one to Soma; / he should also have the Mahāvaiśvānara Sāman and the Jyeṣṭha Sāman recited.

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ tu yajamānasya pūrvavanmantravācanam ..
dātavyā yajamānena pūrvavaddakṣiṇā pṛthak .. 104 ..
meaning:
स्नानं तु यजमानस्य पूर्ववन्मन्त्रवाचनम् ..
दातव्या यजमानेन पूर्ववद्दक्षिणा पृथक् .. 104 ..
text_mt: The bathing of the patron is as before, and the recitation of mantras. / The sacrificial fee must be given separately by the patron as before,

sanskrit_iast:
kāmakrodhavihīnena ṛtvigbhyaḥ śāṃtacetasaḥ ..
navagraha makhe viprāścatvāro vedavedinaḥ .. 105 ..
meaning:
कामक्रोधविहीनेन ऋत्विग्भ्यः शांतचेतसः ..
नवग्रह मखे विप्राश्चत्वारो वेदवेदिनः .. 105 ..
text_mt: free from desire and anger, with a calm mind, to the officiating priests. / In the sacrifice to the nine planets, there should be four brāhmaṇas who know the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
atha vā ṛtvijau śāṃtau dvāveva tvatikovidau ..
kāryāvayutahome tu na prasajyeta vistare .. 106 ..
meaning:
अथ वा ऋत्विजौ शांतौ द्वावेव त्वतिकोविदौ ..
कार्यावयुतहोमे तु न प्रसज्येत विस्तरे .. 106 ..
text_mt: Or, in the sacrifice of ten thousand oblations, just two calm and very skilled officiating priests / should be employed; he should not indulge in excessive elaboration.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvacca daśa cāṣṭau vā lakṣahome'pi ṛtvijaḥ..
kartavyāḥ śaktitastadvaccatvāro vā vimatsarāḥ ..1 07..
meaning:
तद्वच्च दश चाष्टौ वा लक्षहोमेऽपि ऋत्विजः..
कर्तव्याः शक्तितस्तद्वच्चत्वारो वा विमत्सराः ..1 07..
text_mt: Likewise, in the sacrifice of one hundred thousand oblations, ten or eight officiating priests / should be appointed according to capacity, or four free from envy.

sanskrit_iast:
navagrahamakhe sarvaṃ lakṣahome daśottaram..
dadyācca pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha bhūṣaṇānyapi śaktitaḥ .. 108 ..
meaning:
नवग्रहमखे सर्वं लक्षहोमे दशोत्तरम्..
दद्याच्च पांडवश्रेष्ठ भूषणान्यपि शक्तितः .. 108 ..
text_mt: Everything in the sacrifice to the nine planets should be tenfold in the sacrifice of one hundred thousand oblations; / and he should give ornaments according to capacity, O best of the Pāṇḍavas.

sanskrit_iast:
śayanāni ca vastrāṇi haimāni kaṭakāni ca ..
karṇāṃgulīpavitrāṇi bhaktimānpratipādayet ..1 09..
meaning:
शयनानि च वस्त्राणि हैमानि कटकानि च ..
कर्णांगुलीपवित्राणि भक्तिमान्प्रतिपादयेत् ..1 09..
text_mt: Beds, garments, golden bracelets, / and ear and finger rings the devout [patron] should bestow.

sanskrit_iast:
na kuryāddakṣiṇāhīnaṃ vittaśāṭhyena mānavaḥ ..
adadallobhamohābhyāṃ kulakṣayamavāpnuyāt .. 4.141.110 ..
meaning:
न कुर्याद्दक्षिणाहीनं वित्तशाठ्येन मानवः ..
अददल्लोभमोहाभ्यां कुलक्षयमवाप्नुयात् .. 4.141.110 ..
text_mt: A man should not perform it devoid of a sacrificial fee out of stinginess with his wealth; / by not giving out of greed and delusion, he would incur the destruction of his family.

sanskrit_iast:
annadānaṃ yathā śaktyā dātavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā ..
annahīnaṃ vrataṃ yasmāddurbhikṣaphaladaṃ bhavet .. 111 ..
meaning:
अन्नदानं यथा शक्त्या दातव्यं भूतिमिच्छता ..
अन्नहीनं व्रतं यस्माद्दुर्भिक्षफलदं भवेत् .. 111 ..
text_mt: The gift of food must be given according to capacity by one who desires prosperity, / because a votive observance devoid of food would yield the fruit of famine.

sanskrit_iast:
rāṣṭraṃ hanyādaṃgahīno maṃtrahīnastu ṛtvijaḥ ..
adakṣiṇo yajamānaṃ nāsti yajñasamo ripuḥ .. 112 ..
meaning:
राष्ट्रं हन्यादंगहीनो मंत्रहीनस्तु ऋत्विजः ..
अदक्षिणो यजमानं नास्ति यज्ञसमो रिपुः .. 112 ..
text_mt: A rite lacking limbs destroys the realm; one lacking mantras destroys the officiating priests; / one lacking a sacrificial fee destroys the patron: there is no enemy equal to [such] a sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
na cāpyalpadhanaḥ kuryāllakṣahomaṃ naraḥ kvacit ..
tasmātpīḍākaro nityaṃ ya eva bhavati grahaḥ .. 113 ..
meaning:
न चाप्यल्पधनः कुर्याल्लक्षहोमं नरः क्वचित् ..
तस्मात्पीडाकरो नित्यं य एव भवति ग्रहः .. 113 ..
text_mt: Nor should a man of little wealth ever perform the sacrifice of one hundred thousand oblations. / Therefore, whichever planet is constantly causing affliction,

sanskrit_iast:
tameva pūjayedbhaktyā dvau vā trīnvā yathāvidhi ..
ekamapyarcayedbhaktyā brāhmaṇaṃ veda pāragam ..114 ..
meaning:
तमेव पूजयेद्भक्त्या द्वौ वा त्रीन्वा यथाविधि ..
एकमप्यर्चयेद्भक्त्या ब्राह्मणं वेद पारगम् ..114 ..
text_mt: that very one he should worship with devotion, or two, or three, according to rule. / With devotion he should worship even a single brāhmaṇa who has mastered the Veda,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇābhiḥ prayatnena bahūnvā bahuvittavān ..
lakṣahomastu kartavyo yadi vittaṃ gṛhe gṛhe .. 115 ..
meaning:
दक्षिणाभिः प्रयत्नेन बहून्वा बहुवित्तवान् ..
लक्षहोमस्तु कर्तव्यो यदि वित्तं गृहे गृहे .. 115 ..
text_mt: with sacrificial fees, with care; or many, if he possesses much wealth. / The sacrifice of one hundred thousand oblations should be performed if there is wealth in every house,

sanskrit_iast:
yataḥ sarvānavāpnoti kurvankāmānvidhānataḥ ..
pūjyate śivaloke ca vasvādityamarudgaṇaiḥ .. 116 ..
meaning:
यतः सर्वानवाप्नोति कुर्वन्कामान्विधानतः ..
पूज्यते शिवलोके च वस्वादित्यमरुद्गणैः .. 116 ..
text_mt: since by performing it according to rule he attains all desires, / and he is worshipped in the world of Śiva by the Vasus, Ādityas, and the hosts of Maruts,

sanskrit_iast:
yāvatkalpaśatānyaṣṭāvatha mokṣamavāpnuyāt..
sakāmo yastvimaṃ kuryāllakṣahomaṃ yathāvidhi ..117..
meaning:
यावत्कल्पशतान्यष्टावथ मोक्षमवाप्नुयात्..
सकामो यस्त्विमं कुर्याल्लक्षहोमं यथाविधि ..117..
text_mt: for as long as eight hundred eons; and then he obtains liberation. / But whoever performs this sacrifice of one hundred thousand oblations according to rule with a specific desire,

sanskrit_iast:
sa taṃ kāmamavāpnoti padaṃ cānaṃtyamaśnute..
putrārthī labhate putraṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam ..118..
meaning:
स तं काममवाप्नोति पदं चानंत्यमश्नुते..
पुत्रार्थी लभते पुत्रं धनार्थी लभते धनम् ..118..
text_mt: he attains that desire and enjoys an endless station. / One who desires a son obtains a son; one who desires wealth obtains wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāryārthī śobhanāṃ bhāryāṃ kumārī ca śubhaṃ patim ..
bhraṣṭarājyastathā rājyaṃ śrīkāmaḥ śriyamāpnuyāt .. 119 ..
meaning:
भार्यार्थी शोभनां भार्यां कुमारी च शुभं पतिम् ..
भ्रष्टराज्यस्तथा राज्यं श्रीकामः श्रियमाप्नुयात् .. 119 ..
text_mt: One who desires a wife [obtains] a beautiful wife, and an unmarried girl obtains a good husband; / likewise, one fallen from his kingdom obtains a kingdom, and one who desires fortune obtains fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃ yaṃ prārthayate kāmaṃ taṃ tamāpnoti puṣkalam ..
niṣkāmaḥ kurute yastu paraṃ brahma sa gacchati .. 4.141.120 ..
meaning:
यं यं प्रार्थयते कामं तं तमाप्नोति पुष्कलम् ..
निष्कामः कुरुते यस्तु परं ब्रह्म स गच्छति .. 4.141.120 ..
text_mt: Whatever desire he asks for, that he abundantly obtains; / but he who performs it without desire goes to the supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
śāṃtiṃ navagrahamayīṃ duritopaśāṃtiṃ rājankaroti bahunā vidhivaddvijendraiḥ ..
kṣemaṃ subhikṣamatulaṃ kulavṛddhisaṃpattatrāsti yatra kurute bata lakṣahomam ..121..
koṭihomavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
शांतिं नवग्रहमयीं दुरितोपशांतिं राजन्करोति बहुना विधिवद्द्विजेन्द्रैः ..
क्षेमं सुभिक्षमतुलं कुलवृद्धिसंपत्तत्रास्ति यत्र कुरुते बत लक्षहोमम् ..121..
कोटिहोमविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
O king, when one performs the pacification consisting of the nine planets that allays misfortunes, through many foremost twice-born according to rule, / there is safety, matchless abundance of food, family growth, and prosperity, wherever one performs, indeed, the sacrifice of one hundred thousand oblations.
Description of the Rule for the Sacrifice of Ten Million Oblations

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
rājā saṃvaraṇaḥ pūrvaṃ pratiṣṭhāne purottame ..
babhūva sa mahābhāgaḥ śāstrārthakuśalo balī ..1..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
राजा संवरणः पूर्वं प्रतिष्ठाने पुरोत्तमे ..
बभूव स महाभागः शास्त्रार्थकुशलो बली ..1..
text_mt: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / Formerly there was King Saṃvaraṇa in the excellent city of Pratiṣṭhāna; / he was highly fortunate, skilled in the meaning of the treatises, and mighty.
title: Vidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇyaḥ pitṛbhaktaśca devabrāhmaṇapūjakaḥ ..
tasyātha kurvato rājyaṃ samyakpālayataḥ prajāḥ ..2..
meaning:
ब्रह्मण्यः पितृभक्तश्च देवब्राह्मणपूजकः ..
तस्याथ कुर्वतो राज्यं सम्यक्पालयतः प्रजाः ..2..
text_mt: pious toward Brahmins, devoted to the ancestors, and a worshipper of the gods and Brahmins. / As he was thus ruling his realm and properly protecting his subjects,

sanskrit_iast:
ājagāma mahāyogī sanako brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ..
dattvā tasyāsanaṃ rājā praṇamya śirasā tathā ..3..
meaning:
आजगाम महायोगी सनको ब्रह्मणः सुतः..
दत्त्वा तस्यासनं राजा प्रणम्य शिरसा तथा ..3..
text_mt: the great yogin Sanaka, the son of Brahmā, arrived. / The king offered him a seat, bowed with his head,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvārghyapādyādyairātmānaṃ vinivedya ca ..
itihāsapurāṇoktāścakāra vividhāḥ kathāḥ ..4..
meaning:
पूजयित्वार्घ्यपाद्याद्यैरात्मानं विनिवेद्य च ..
इतिहासपुराणोक्ताश्चकार विविधाः कथाः ..4..
text_mt: and worshipped him with arghya, water for washing the feet, and other offerings, placing himself at his disposal. / He related various tales told in the epics and Purāṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
rājarṣīṇāṃ purāṇāṃ ca caritāni yathārthavit ..
tataḥ kathāṃtare rājā kāryaṃ manasi saṃsthitam ..5..
meaning:
राजर्षीणां पुराणां च चरितानि यथार्थवित् ..
ततः कथांतरे राजा कार्यं मनसि संस्थितम् ..5..
text_mt: and the deeds of ancient royal sages, being one who knew their true meaning. / Then, in the midst of conversation, the king, [keeping] in mind a matter that preoccupied him,

sanskrit_iast:
hitāya pṛthivīśānāṃ jagataścātmanastathā ..
papraccha vinayopeto yogācāryaṃ mahāmatiḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
हिताय पृथिवीशानां जगतश्चात्मनस्तथा ..
पप्रच्छ विनयोपेतो योगाचार्यं महामतिः .. 6 ..
text_mt: for the benefit of the lords of the earth, of the world, and of himself, / asked the master of yoga with humility, being of great intellect:

sanskrit_iast:
.. saṃvaraṇa uvāca .. ..
bhagavanmahadutpātasaṃbhave bhūprakaṃpane ..
nirghāte pāṃśuvarṣe ca gṛhabhaṃge tathaiva ca .. 7 ..
meaning:
.. संवरण उवाच .. ..
भगवन्महदुत्पातसंभवे भूप्रकंपने ..
निर्घाते पांशुवर्षे च गृहभंगे तथैव च .. 7 ..
text_mt: Saṃvaraṇa said: / "O venerable one, when great portents occur, when the earth trembles, / when there is a thunderstroke, a shower of dust, or the destruction of homes,

sanskrit_iast:
janmanakṣatrapīḍāsu anāvṛṣṭibhayeṣu ca ..
jvareṣu grahapīḍāsu durbhikṣe rāṣṭravigrahe .. .. 8 ..
meaning:
जन्मनक्षत्रपीडासु अनावृष्टिभयेषु च ..
ज्वरेषु ग्रहपीडासु दुर्भिक्षे राष्ट्रविग्रहे .. .. 8 ..
text_mt: during afflictions caused by one's birth-star, when there is fear of drought, / during fevers, afflictions caused by the planets, famine, or warfare in the realm,

sanskrit_iast:
vyādhīnāṃ saṃbhave jāte śarīre cātipīḍite ..
kleśe mahati cotpanne kiṃ kartavyaṃ narottamaiḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
व्याधीनां संभवे जाते शरीरे चातिपीडिते ..
क्लेशे महति चोत्पन्ने किं कर्तव्यं नरोत्तमैः .. 9 ..
text_mt: when diseases break out, when the body is afflicted by severe pain, / and when great misery has arisen, what should be done by the best of men?

sanskrit_iast:
svargasya sādhanaṃ yacca kīrtidaṃ dhanadaṃ tathā ..
prabrūhi me dvijaśreṣṭha tathārogyapradaṃ nṛṇām .. 4.142.10 ..
meaning:
स्वर्गस्य साधनं यच्च कीर्तिदं धनदं तथा ..
प्रब्रूहि मे द्विजश्रेष्ठ तथारोग्यप्रदं नृणाम् .. 4.142.10 ..
text_mt: Tell me, O best of the twice-born, what brings about heaven, confers fame and wealth, / and likewise grants health to mankind?"

sanskrit_iast:
.. sanatkumāra uvāca .. ..
śṛṇurājanpravakṣyāmi śāṃtikarma hyanuttamam ..
koṭihomākhyamatulaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam .. 11 ..
meaning:
.. सनत्कुमार उवाच .. ..
शृणुराजन्प्रवक्ष्यामि शांतिकर्म ह्यनुत्तमम् ..
कोटिहोमाख्यमतुलं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / "Listen, O king! I shall declare the supreme rite of pacification, / known as the Koṭihoma, peerless and granting the fruit of all desires,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmahatyādipāpāni yena naśyaṃti tatkṣaṇāt ..
utpātā praśamaṃ yāṃti mahatsaṃpadyate sukham .. 12 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्महत्यादिपापानि येन नश्यंति तत्क्षणात् ..
उत्पाता प्रशमं यांति महत्संपद्यते सुखम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: by which sins such as killing a Brahmin are instantly destroyed, / portents are appeased, and great happiness is attained.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhānaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhava ..
devāgāre nadītīre vane vā bhavane'pi vā .. 13 ..
meaning:
विधानं तस्य वक्ष्यामि शृणुष्वैकमना भव ..
देवागारे नदीतीरे वने वा भवनेऽपि वा .. 13 ..
text_mt: I shall declare its procedure: listen and be single-minded! / In a temple, on a riverbank, in a forest, or even in a dwelling,

sanskrit_iast:
parvate vāpi kurvīta ya icchetkṣemamātmanaḥ ..
śubhanakṣatrayoge ca vāre pūrvaguṇānvite .. 14 ..
meaning:
पर्वते वापि कुर्वीत य इच्छेत्क्षेममात्मनः ..
शुभनक्षत्रयोगे च वारे पूर्वगुणान्विते .. 14 ..
text_mt: or on a mountain, one who desires one's own well-being should perform it / at an auspicious conjunction of constellations and on a day endowed with the aforesaid qualities,

sanskrit_iast:
yajamānasyānukūlye koṭihomaṃ samācaret ..
pūjayitvā prayatnena brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam .. 15 ..
meaning:
यजमानस्यानुकूल्ये कोटिहोमं समाचरेत् ..
पूजयित्वा प्रयत्नेन ब्राह्मणं वेदपारगम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: when favourable to the sacrificer, he should perform the Koṭihoma. / Having honoured with diligence a Brahmin who has crossed to the end of the Veda,

sanskrit_iast:
vastrairvibhūṣaṇaiścaiva gaṃdhamālyānulepanaiḥ ..
praṇamya vidhivattasmai ātmānaṃ vinivedayet .. 16 ..
meaning:
वस्त्रैर्विभूषणैश्चैव गंधमाल्यानुलेपनैः ..
प्रणम्य विधिवत्तस्मै आत्मानं विनिवेदयेत् .. 16 ..
text_mt: with garments and ornaments, and with perfumes, garlands, and unguents, / and bowing to him according to rule, he should surrender himself to him, [saying]:

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ no gatiḥ pitā mātā tvaṃ gatistvaṃ parāyaṇaḥ ..
tvatprasādena viprarṣe sarvaṃ me syānmanogatam .. 17 ..
meaning:
त्वं नो गतिः पिता माता त्वं गतिस्त्वं परायणः ..
त्वत्प्रसादेन विप्रर्षे सर्वं मे स्यान्मनोगतम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: 'You are our refuge, father, and mother; you are our recourse, you are our supreme stay. / By your grace, O Brahmin sage, may all the desires of my heart be fulfilled!

sanskrit_iast:
āpadvimokṣāya ca me kuru yajñamanuttamam..
koṭihomārthamatulaṃ śāṃtyarthaṃ sārvakāmikam .. 18 ..
meaning:
आपद्विमोक्षाय च मे कुरु यज्ञमनुत्तमम्..
कोटिहोमार्थमतुलं शांत्यर्थं सार्वकामिकम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: For my release from adversity, perform this peerless sacrifice, / this incomparable [rite] for the sake of the Koṭihoma, for pacification, fulfilling all desires!'

sanskrit_iast:
purohitastataḥ prājñaḥ śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuciḥ ..
brāhmaṇairvedasaṃvṛttaiḥ puṇyairyuktaḥ samāhitaiḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
पुरोहितस्ततः प्राज्ञः शुक्लांबरधरः शुचिः ..
ब्राह्मणैर्वेदसंवृत्तैः पुण्यैर्युक्तः समाहितैः .. 19 ..
text_mt: Then the wise family priest, clad in white garments and pure, / accompanied by virtuous, concentrated Brahmins endowed with Vedic learning,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmibhāge same śuddhe prāgudakpravaṇe tathā ..
puṇyāhaṃ vācayetpūrvaṃ kṛtvā viprānsupūjitān .. 4.142.20 ..
meaning:
भूमिभागे समे शुद्धे प्रागुदक्प्रवणे तथा ..
पुण्याहं वाचयेत्पूर्वं कृत्वा विप्रान्सुपूजितान् .. 4.142.20 ..
text_mt: on a level, clean piece of ground sloping toward the east or north, / should first have the 'auspicious day' proclaimed, after properly worshipping the Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu mahitairvipraḥ sūtrayenmaṇḍapaṃ śubham ..
uttamaṃ śatahastaṃ tu tadardhena tu madhyamam ..
jaghanyaṃ tu tadardhena śaktikālādyapekṣayā ..21..
meaning:
ततस्तु महितैर्विप्रः सूत्रयेन्मण्डपं शुभम् ..
उत्तमं शतहस्तं तु तदर्धेन तु मध्यमम् ..
जघन्यं तु तदर्धेन शक्तिकालाद्यपेक्षया ..21..
text_mt: Then, together with the honoured Brahmins, he should measure out an auspicious pavilion with cords: / the best is one hundred cubits; half of that is middling; / and half of that is the smallest, according to ability, time, and circumstance.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye tu maṇḍapasyāpi kuṃḍaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ..
aṣṭahastapramāṇena āyāmena tathaiva ca .. 22 ..
meaning:
मध्ये तु मण्डपस्यापि कुंडं कुर्याद्विचक्षणः ..
अष्टहस्तप्रमाणेन आयामेन तथैव च .. 22 ..
text_mt: In the middle of the pavilion, the discerning [priest] should make a sacrificial pit, / eight cubits in length and breadth.

sanskrit_iast:
mekhalātritayaṃ tasya dvādaśāṃgulavistatam ..
tatpramāṇāṃ tathā yoniṃ kurvīta susamāhitaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
मेखलात्रितयं तस्य द्वादशांगुलविस्ततम् ..
तत्प्रमाणां तथा योनिं कुर्वीत सुसमाहितः .. 23 ..
text_mt: Its three steps should be twelve finger-breadths wide; / and well-concentrated, he should fashion the vulva-shaped hearth of that same dimension.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṃḍasya pūrvabhāge tu vediṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ..
caturhastāṃ samāṃ caiva hastamātrocchritaḥ nṛpa .. 24 ..
meaning:
कुंडस्य पूर्वभागे तु वेदिं कुर्याद्विचक्षणः ..
चतुर्हस्तां समां चैव हस्तमात्रोच्छ्रितः नृप .. 24 ..
text_mt: To the east of the sacrificial pit, the discerning [priest] should make an altar, / four cubits [wide], level, and one cubit high, O king.

sanskrit_iast: sthānaṃ tatsarvabhūtānāṃ kuryādyatnena buddhimān .. 25 ..
meaning: स्थानं तत्सर्वभूतानां कुर्याद्यत्नेन बुद्धिमान् .. 25 ..
text_mt: The wise [priest] should diligently prepare that place for all the beings.

sanskrit_iast:
udalipya tato bhūmiṃ maṃḍapasya samīpataḥ ..
vinyasetkalaśāṃstatra jalapūrṇāṃścaturdaśa .. 26 ..
meaning:
उदलिप्य ततो भूमिं मंडपस्य समीपतः ..
विन्यसेत्कलशांस्तत्र जलपूर्णांश्चतुर्दश .. 26 ..
text_mt: Then, having smeared the ground in the vicinity of the pavilion, / he should place there fourteen water pots filled with water,

sanskrit_iast:
aśvatthaplakṣacūtādyaiḥ pallavairupaśobhitān..
vitānamupariṣṭācca maṃḍapasya prakalpayet .. 27 ..
meaning:
अश्वत्थप्लक्षचूताद्यैः पल्लवैरुपशोभितान्..
वितानमुपरिष्टाच्च मंडपस्य प्रकल्पयेत् .. 27 ..
text_mt: adorned with sprouts of aśvattha, plakṣa, mango, and other [trees]. / And he should arrange a canopy over the pavilion.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpayeddikṣu sarvāsu toraṇāni vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
evaṃ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāraiḥ purodhāḥ susamāhitaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
स्थापयेद्दिक्षु सर्वासु तोरणानि विचक्षणः ..
एवं संभृतसंभारैः पुरोधाः सुसमाहितः .. 28 ..
text_mt: In all the directions, the discerning [priest] should erect archways. / With the materials thus assembled, the family priest, well-concentrated,

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyāhajayaghoṣeṇa homakarma samārabhet ..
sthāpayitvā surānvedyāṃ vakṣyamāṇānariṃdama .. 29 ..
meaning:
पुण्याहजयघोषेण होमकर्म समारभेत् ..
स्थापयित्वा सुरान्वेद्यां वक्ष्यमाणानरिंदम .. 29 ..
text_mt: should begin the work of oblation with the proclamation of 'auspicious day' and cries of victory, / having established the gods on the altar, as will be mentioned, O crusher of foes:

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaṃ pūrvabhāge tu madhye devaṃ janārdanam..
paścime tu tathā rudraṃ vasūnuttaratastathā .. 4.142.30 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणं पूर्वभागे तु मध्ये देवं जनार्दनम्..
पश्चिमे तु तथा रुद्रं वसूनुत्तरतस्तथा .. 4.142.30 ..
text_mt: Brahmā in the eastern part, and in the middle Lord Janārdana; / Rudra in the west, and likewise the Vasus in the north;

sanskrit_iast:
aiśānyāṃ ca grahānsarvānāgneyyāṃ marutastathā ..
vāyuṃ saumyāṃ tathaiśānyāṃ lokapālānkrameṇa tu .. 31 ..
meaning:
ऐशान्यां च ग्रहान्सर्वानाग्नेय्यां मरुतस्तथा ..
वायुं सौम्यां तथैशान्यां लोकपालान्क्रमेण तु .. 31 ..
text_mt: and all the planets in the north-east, the Maruts in the south-east, / Vāyu in the north, and in the north-east the world protectors, in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃsthāpya vibudhānyathāsthānaṃ nṛpottama ..
pūjayedvidhivadvastragandhamālyānulepanaiḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
एवं संस्थाप्य विबुधान्यथास्थानं नृपोत्तम ..
पूजयेद्विधिवद्वस्त्रगन्धमाल्यानुलेपनैः .. 32 ..
text_mt: Having thus established the gods in their respective places, O best of kings, / he should worship them according to rule with garments, perfumes, garlands, and unguents,

sanskrit_iast:
vedoktamaṃtraistalliṅgaiḥ purāṇoktaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak .. ..
ādityā vasavo rudrā lokapālāstathā grahāḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
वेदोक्तमंत्रैस्तल्लिङ्गैः पुराणोक्तैः पृथक्पृथक् .. ..
आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा लोकपालास्तथा ग्रहाः .. 33 ..
text_mt: with the mantras mentioned in the Vedas bearing their characteristics, and with those spoken in the Purāṇas, individually: / 'The Ādityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the world protectors, and the planets,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā janārdanaścaiva śūlapāṇirbhagākṣihā ..
atra saṃnihitāḥ sarve bhavaṃtu sukhabhāginaḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मा जनार्दनश्चैव शूलपाणिर्भगाक्षिहा ..
अत्र संनिहिताः सर्वे भवंतु सुखभागिनः .. 34 ..
text_mt: Brahmā, Janārdana, and the spear-bearing destroyer of Bhaga's eyes— / may they all be present here and partake of joy!

sanskrit_iast:
pūjāṃ gṛhṇaṃtu sarvetra mayā bhaktyopapāditām ..
kurvaṃtu ca śubhaṃ sarve yajñakarma samāhitāḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
पूजां गृह्णंतु सर्वेत्र मया भक्त्योपपादिताम् ..
कुर्वंतु च शुभं सर्वे यज्ञकर्म समाहिताः .. 35 ..
text_mt: May all accept the worship offered here by me with devotion, / and, concentrated in mind, may all bring good fortune to the sacrificial rite!'

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃpūjayitvā tāndevānyatnena śuddhadhīḥ..
naivedyairvividhairbhakṣyaiḥ phalaiḥ patraistathaiva ca .. 36 ..
meaning:
एवं संपूजयित्वा तान्देवान्यत्नेन शुद्धधीः..
नैवेद्यैर्विविधैर्भक्ष्यैः फलैः पत्रैस्तथैव च .. 36 ..
text_mt: Having thus carefully worshipped those deities, with a pure mind, / with various food-offerings, eatables, fruits, and leaves,

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu tairdvijaiḥ sārddhaṃ kuṃḍasya vidhipūrvakam ..
kuryātsaṃskārakaraṇaṃ yathoktaṃ vedacintakaiḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
ततस्तु तैर्द्विजैः सार्द्धं कुंडस्य विधिपूर्वकम् ..
कुर्यात्संस्कारकरणं यथोक्तं वेदचिन्तकैः .. 37 ..
text_mt: then, along with those twice-born, he should duly perform / the consecration of the sacrificial pit, as stated by those who contemplate the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ samāhvayedvahniṃ nāmnā khyātaṃ ghṛtārciṣam ..
niyojayeddvijāṃstatra śatasaṃkhyānnṛpottama ..
alābhe tu bahūnā ca yathālābhaṃ niyojayet .. 38 ..
meaning:
ततः समाह्वयेद्वह्निं नाम्ना ख्यातं घृतार्चिषम् ..
नियोजयेद्द्विजांस्तत्र शतसंख्यान्नृपोत्तम ..
अलाभे तु बहूना च यथालाभं नियोजयेत् .. 38 ..
text_mt: Then he should invoke the fire known by name as Ghṛtārcis. / He should employ one hundred Brahmins there, O best of kings; / but if many are not to be found, he should employ as many as are available:

sanskrit_iast:
vidyāvṛddhānvayovṛddhāngṛhasthānsaṃyatendriyān..
svakarmaniyatāñjñānaśīlāñchāntāndvijottamān .. 39 ..
meaning:
विद्यावृद्धान्वयोवृद्धान्गृहस्थान्संयतेन्द्रियान्..
स्वकर्मनियताञ्ज्ञानशीलाञ्छान्तान्द्विजोत्तमान् .. 39 ..
text_mt: the best of the twice-born, advanced in learning, advanced in age, householders who have restrained their senses, / devoted to their own duties, possessing knowledge and good conduct, and tranquil.

sanskrit_iast:
ciṃtayettatra deveśaṃ paṃcāsyaṃ nṛpa pāvakam ..
mukhāni tasya catvāri sapta jihvāśca pārthiva .. 4.142.40 ..
meaning:
चिंतयेत्तत्र देवेशं पंचास्यं नृप पावकम् ..
मुखानि तस्य चत्वारि सप्त जिह्वाश्च पार्थिव .. 4.142.40 ..
text_mt: There he should meditate on the fire, the lord of gods, as having five faces, O king; / he has four faces and seven tongues, O ruler of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
ekajihvamathaikaṃ tu tatsmṛtaṃ sarvakāmadam ..
dhūmāyamāne mana vṛthā hotavyaṃ jvalite nale .. 41 ..
meaning:
एकजिह्वमथैकं तु तत्स्मृतं सर्वकामदम् ..
धूमायमाने मन वृथा होतव्यं ज्वलिते नले .. 41 ..
text_mt: Or else he is remembered as having a single tongue, granting all desires. / An oblation should not be offered in smoke; it should be offered into blazing fire.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛgbhiḥ pūrvāmukhairhomo yajurbhiścottarāmukhaiḥ.
sāmabhiḥ paścime kāryo'tharvabhirdakṣiṇāmukhaiḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
ऋग्भिः पूर्वामुखैर्होमो यजुर्भिश्चोत्तरामुखैः.
सामभिः पश्चिमे कार्योऽथर्वभिर्दक्षिणामुखैः .. 42 ..
text_mt: The oblation is to be performed with Ṛg[veda verses] facing east, with Yajur[veda verses] facing north, / with Sāma[veda verses] in the west, and with Atharva[veda verses] facing south.

sanskrit_iast:
āghārāvājya bhāgau tu pūrvaṃ hutvā vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
paritotha paristīrṇe kalpitai ca tathāsane .. 43 ..
meaning:
आघारावाज्य भागौ तु पूर्वं हुत्वा विचक्षणः ..
परितोथ परिस्तीर्णे कल्पितै च तथासने .. 43 ..
text_mt: Having first offered the two āghāra and the two portions of clarified butter, the discerning [priest], / all around the strewn grass and upon the prepared seat,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇaṃ pūrvamapyetatsarvaṃ paścātsamācaret ..
homo vyāhṛtibhiścaiva sarvastatra vidhīyate .. 44 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्माणं पूर्वमप्येतत्सर्वं पश्चात्समाचरेत् ..
होमो व्याहृतिभिश्चैव सर्वस्तत्र विधीयते .. 44 ..
text_mt: [having worshipped] Brahmā beforehand, should then perform all this. / And the entire oblation is prescribed to be made there with the vyāhṛtis.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavādibhistalliṃgaiḥ svāhākārāṃtayojitaiḥ..
juhuyātsarvadevānāṃ vedyāṃ ye copakalpitāḥ ..45..
meaning:
प्रणवादिभिस्तल्लिंगैः स्वाहाकारांतयोजितैः..
जुहुयात्सर्वदेवानां वेद्यां ये चोपकल्पिताः ..45..
text_mt: With [mantras] beginning with the syllable Oṃ, possessing their distinguishing marks, and joined with "svāhā" at the end, / one should offer oblations to all the gods who have been prepared on the altar.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ prakalpaye dyajñaṃ koṭihomākhyamuttamam ..
tilāḥ kṛṣṇā ghṛtābhyaktāḥ kiñcidyavasamanvitāḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
एवं प्रकल्पये द्यज्ञं कोटिहोमाख्यमुत्तमम् ..
तिलाः कृष्णा घृताभ्यक्ताः किञ्चिद्यवसमन्विताः .. 46 ..
text_mt: Thus one should perform the supreme sacrifice called the Koṭihoma. / Black sesame seeds smeared with ghee, mixed with a little barley,

sanskrit_iast:
hotavyāḥ koṭihome tu samidhaśca palāśajāḥ ..
pūrṇe pūrṇesahasre tu dadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ śubhām ..
pañcame tanmukhe rājansarvakāmārthasiddhaye .. 47..
meaning:
होतव्याः कोटिहोमे तु समिधश्च पलाशजाः ..
पूर्णे पूर्णेसहस्रे तु दद्यात्पूर्णाहुतिं शुभाम् ..
पञ्चमे तन्मुखे राजन्सर्वकामार्थसिद्धये .. 47..
text_mt: and firewood born of the palāśa tree should be offered in the Koṭihoma. / At the completion of each thousand, one should offer an auspicious final oblation / into that fifth mouth, O king, for the attainment of all desired objects.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇāhutyaḥ samākhyātāḥ koṭihome narādhipa ..
sahasrāṇi nṛpaśreṣṭha daśa śāstraviśāradaiḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
पूर्णाहुत्यः समाख्याताः कोटिहोमे नराधिप ..
सहस्राणि नृपश्रेष्ठ दश शास्त्रविशारदैः .. 48 ..
text_mt: Ten thousand final oblations in the Koṭihoma / are proclaimed by those learned in the scriptures, O best of kings, O ruler of men.

sanskrit_iast:
prāraṃbhadinamārabhya brāhmaṇairbrahmavādibhiḥ ..
bhāvyaṃ sayajamānaistu athavā sapurohitaiḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
प्रारंभदिनमारभ्य ब्राह्मणैर्ब्रह्मवादिभिः ..
भाव्यं सयजमानैस्तु अथवा सपुरोहितैः .. 49 ..
text_mt: From the day of commencement, the brāhmaṇas who expound the Veda / should abide [in purity] together with the sacrificers or with the family priests.

sanskrit_iast:
krodhalobhādayo doṣā varjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ ..
yajamānena rājendra savargakāmānabhīpsitā .. 4.142.50 ..
meaning:
क्रोधलोभादयो दोषा वर्जनीयाः प्रयत्नतः ..
यजमानेन राजेन्द्र सवर्गकामानभीप्सिता .. 4.142.50 ..
text_mt: Faults such as anger and greed must be diligently avoided / by the sacrificer, O king of kings, who desires all objects of wish.

sanskrit_iast:
.. saṃvaraṇa uvāca .. ..
bahutvātkarmaṇo brahmankoṭi homaḥ suduṣkaraḥ ..
kālena mahatā caiva śakyaḥ prāptuṃ kathaṃcana .. 51 ..
meaning:
.. संवरण उवाच .. ..
बहुत्वात्कर्मणो ब्रह्मन्कोटि होमः सुदुष्करः ..
कालेन महता चैव शक्यः प्राप्तुं कथंचन .. 51 ..
text_mt: Saṃvaraṇa said: / O brāhmaṇa, on account of the vastness of the ritual, the Koṭihoma is very difficult to perform; / and it can scarcely be accomplished, even in a great length of time.

sanskrit_iast:
niyamādbrahmacaryādvā duṣkaro hīti me matiḥ ..
nirodho'tra brāhmaṇānāṃ bhṛśayyādiṣu duṣkaraḥ ..52..
meaning:
नियमाद्ब्रह्मचर्याद्वा दुष्करो हीति मे मतिः ..
निरोधोऽत्र ब्राह्मणानां भृशय्यादिषु दुष्करः ..52..
text_mt: Because of the observances or celibacy, it is indeed difficult to perform—such is my opinion. / The restraint of the brāhmaṇas here in sleeping on the ground and the like is difficult.

sanskrit_iast:
kāryādgurutayā yasmātparvakālādyapekṣayā ..
etadvijñāyate brahmanyadi śāstreṣu kathyate ..
koṭihomasya saṃkṣepaṃ vada me brahma saṃbhava .. 53 ..
meaning:
कार्याद्गुरुतया यस्मात्पर्वकालाद्यपेक्षया ..
एतद्विज्ञायते ब्रह्मन्यदि शास्त्रेषु कथ्यते ..
कोटिहोमस्य संक्षेपं वद मे ब्रह्म संभव .. 53 ..
text_mt: Since, on account of the weight of the task, [it depends] on seasonal moments and the like, / if this is explained in the scriptures, O brāhmaṇa, and is understood, / tell me the abridgement of the Koṭihoma, O son of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sanatkumāra uvāca .. ..
śatānano daśamukho dvimukhaikamukhastathā ..
caturvidho mahārāja koṭihomo vidhīyate .. 54 ..
meaning:
.. सनत्कुमार उवाच .. ..
शताननो दशमुखो द्विमुखैकमुखस्तथा ..
चतुर्विधो महाराज कोटिहोमो विधीयते .. 54 ..
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / With a hundred faces, with ten faces, with two faces, and with one face— / fourfold, O great king, is the Koṭihoma prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
kāryasya gurutāṃ jñātvā naiva kuryādaparvaṇi ..
yathā saṃkṣepataḥ kāryaḥ koṭihomastathā śṛṇu .. 55 ..
meaning:
कार्यस्य गुरुतां ज्ञात्वा नैव कुर्यादपर्वणि ..
यथा संक्षेपतः कार्यः कोटिहोमस्तथा शृणु .. 55 ..
text_mt: Recognizing the gravity of the task, one must not perform it on an inauspicious lunar occasion. / Hear how the Koṭihoma is to be performed in brief:

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā kuṃḍaśataṃ divyaṃ yathoktaṃ hasta saṃmitam ..
ekaikasmiṃstataḥ kuṃḍe śataṃ viprānniyojayet .. 56 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा कुंडशतं दिव्यं यथोक्तं हस्त संमितम् ..
एकैकस्मिंस्ततः कुंडे शतं विप्रान्नियोजयेत् .. 56 ..
text_mt: Having made a hundred divine sacrificial pits according to instruction, measuring one cubit, / one should then assign a hundred vipras to each sacrificial pit.

sanskrit_iast:
sadyaḥ pakṣe tu viprāṇāṃ sahasraṃ parikīrtitam ..
ekasthānapraṇītegnau sarvataḥ paribhāvite .. 57 ..
meaning:
सद्यः पक्षे तु विप्राणां सहस्रं परिकीर्तितम् ..
एकस्थानप्रणीतेग्नौ सर्वतः परिभाविते .. 57 ..
text_mt: In the immediate procedure, a thousand vipras are proclaimed. / When the fire has been brought from one place and consecrated all around,

sanskrit_iast:
homaṃ kuryurdvijāḥ sarve kuṇḍe kuṇḍe yathoditam ..
yathā kuṃḍabahutve'pi rājasūye mahākratau .. 58 ..
meaning:
होमं कुर्युर्द्विजाः सर्वे कुण्डे कुण्डे यथोदितम् ..
यथा कुंडबहुत्वेऽपि राजसूये महाक्रतौ .. 58 ..
text_mt: all the twice-born should make offerings in pit after pit, as declared, / just as, even though there are many sacrificial pits in the great Rājasūya sacrifice,

sanskrit_iast:
na ca vahnibahutvaṃ syāttatra yajñe vidhīyate ..
tathā kuṃḍaśate'pyatra ghṛtārciṣi vitānite .. 59 ..
meaning:
न च वह्निबहुत्वं स्यात्तत्र यज्ञे विधीयते ..
तथा कुंडशतेऽप्यत्र घृतार्चिषि वितानिते .. 59 ..
text_mt: there is no multiplicity of fires prescribed in that sacrifice; / so here too, even though there are a hundred sacrificial pits when the fire fed by ghee is spread,

sanskrit_iast:
eka eva bhavedyajñaḥ koṭihomo na saṃśayaḥ ..
evaṃ yatkriyate kṣipraṃ vyākulaiḥ kāryagauravāt ..
śatānanaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ koṭihomo na saṃśayaḥ .. 4.142.60 ..
meaning:
एक एव भवेद्यज्ञः कोटिहोमो न संशयः ..
एवं यत्क्रियते क्षिप्रं व्याकुलैः कार्यगौरवात् ..
शताननः स विज्ञेयः कोटिहोमो न संशयः .. 4.142.60 ..
text_mt: the sacrifice, the Koṭihoma, remains only one, without doubt. / Thus, what is done swiftly by those anxious due to the gravity of the task, / is to be known as the hundred-faced Koṭihoma, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
svalpairahobhiḥ kāryaḥ syādvarṣākālādike'pi vā ..
tadā daśaguṇaḥ kāryaḥ koṭihomo vijānatā .. 61 ..
meaning:
स्वल्पैरहोभिः कार्यः स्याद्वर्षाकालादिकेऽपि वा ..
तदा दशगुणः कार्यः कोटिहोमो विजानता .. 61 ..
text_mt: If it must be done in a few days, or during the rainy season and the like, / then the tenfold Koṭihoma should be performed by the wise man.

sanskrit_iast:
viprāṇāṃ dve śate tatra suvibhajya niyojayet ..
te'pi vijñānaśīlāḥ syurvratavaṃto jitendriyāḥ .. 62 ..
meaning:
विप्राणां द्वे शते तत्र सुविभज्य नियोजयेत् ..
तेऽपि विज्ञानशीलाः स्युर्व्रतवंतो जितेन्द्रियाः .. 62 ..
text_mt: Two hundred vipras should be appointed there, well apportioned; / they too should be men of knowledge, keeping vows, with subdued senses.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūpa kuṃḍadvayaṃ kṛtvā vibhajya ca vibhāvasum ..
homaṃ kuryurdvijā bhūyaḥ saṃskṛtya vidhipūrvakam .. 63 ..
meaning:
भूप कुंडद्वयं कृत्वा विभज्य च विभावसुम् ..
होमं कुर्युर्द्विजा भूयः संस्कृत्य विधिपूर्वकम् .. 63 ..
text_mt: Having made two sacrificial pits, O king, and having divided the fire, / the twice-born should repeatedly offer oblations after sanctifying [it] according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
śataṃ tatra niyojyaṃ syādviprāṇāṃ pravibhajya vai ..
māse vātha dvimāse vā yathākāle hyupasthite .. 64 ..
meaning:
शतं तत्र नियोज्यं स्याद्विप्राणां प्रविभज्य वै ..
मासे वाथ द्विमासे वा यथाकाले ह्युपस्थिते .. 64 ..
text_mt: A hundred vipras are to be appointed there, properly distributed, / in one month or in two months, when the proper time has arrived.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ ca dvimukhaṃ kāryaḥ koṭihomo vicakṣaṇaiḥ .. 65 ..
meaning: एवं च द्विमुखं कार्यः कोटिहोमो विचक्षणैः .. 65 ..
text_mt: And in this way the two-faced Koṭihoma should be performed by the discerning.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā tu svecchayā yajñaṃ yajamānaḥ samāpayet ..
kālena bahudhā rājaṃstadā caikamukho bhavet .. 66 ..
meaning:
यदा तु स्वेच्छया यज्ञं यजमानः समापयेत् ..
कालेन बहुधा राजंस्तदा चैकमुखो भवेत् .. 66 ..
text_mt: When, however, the sacrificer concludes the sacrifice at his own will / over a long period of time in many ways, O king, it becomes one-faced.

sanskrit_iast:
ekakuṃḍasthito vahnirekacittaiḥ samāhitaiḥ ..
yathālābha sthitairviprairjñānaśīlairvicakṣaṇaiḥ ..67..
meaning:
एककुंडस्थितो वह्निरेकचित्तैः समाहितैः ..
यथालाभ स्थितैर्विप्रैर्ज्ञानशीलैर्विचक्षणैः ..67..
text_mt: The fire resides in a single sacrificial pit; [the offerings are made] with single-mindedness and concentration / by discerning vipras endowed with wisdom, present as available.

sanskrit_iast:
na saṃkhyāniyamaścātra brāhmaṇānāṃ narottama ..
na kālaniyamaścaiva svecchāyajñaḥ sa ucyate .. 68 ..
meaning:
न संख्यानियमश्चात्र ब्राह्मणानां नरोत्तम ..
न कालनियमश्चैव स्वेच्छायज्ञः स उच्यते .. 68 ..
text_mt: Here there is no fixed rule for the number of brāhmaṇas, O best of men, / nor is there a fixed rule for time; that is called a sacrifice at one's own will.

sanskrit_iast:
āvṛttyā sarvakāmasya cāturmāsyānukarmavat ..
tadaprasaktau kartavyo yajño'yaṃ sārvakālikaḥ .. 69 ..
meaning:
आवृत्त्या सर्वकामस्य चातुर्मास्यानुकर्मवत् ..
तदप्रसक्तौ कर्तव्यो यज्ञोऽयं सार्वकालिकः .. 69 ..
text_mt: Through repetition it yields all desires, like the rite following the Cāturmāsya. / When that [other method] is impracticable, this universal-time sacrifice should be performed.

sanskrit_iast:
ayamekamukho rājankālena bahunā bhavet ..
bahuvighnaśca kālena tasmātsaṃkṣepamācaret .. 4.142.70 ..
meaning:
अयमेकमुखो राजन्कालेन बहुना भवेत् ..
बहुविघ्नश्च कालेन तस्मात्संक्षेपमाचरेत् .. 4.142.70 ..
text_mt: This one-faced one, O king, takes a long time, / and with time there are many obstacles; therefore one should practice the abridged [form].

sanskrit_iast:
yato hi cittavittādyamāyuścaivāsthiraṃ sadā ..
ataḥ saṃkṣepataḥ kāryaṃ dharmakāryaṃ praśasyate .. 71 ..
meaning:
यतो हि चित्तवित्ताद्यमायुश्चैवास्थिरं सदा ..
अतः संक्षेपतः कार्यं धर्मकार्यं प्रशस्यते .. 71 ..
text_mt: For mind, wealth, and the like, as well as life itself, are always unstable; / therefore an auspicious religious duty is praised when performed in abridged form.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ samāpte yajñe tu kārayetsumahotsavam ..
śaṃkhatūryaninādena brahmaghoṣasvanena ca .. 72 ..
meaning:
ततः समाप्ते यज्ञे तु कारयेत्सुमहोत्सवम् ..
शंखतूर्यनिनादेन ब्रह्मघोषस्वनेन च .. 72 ..
text_mt: Then, when the sacrifice has concluded, he should cause a great festival to be held, / with the sounding of conches and trumpets, and with the sound of Vedic recitation.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu dīkṣayedvinprānhotṝṃśca śraddhayānvitaḥ ..
niṣkaiśca kaṃkaṇaiścaiva kuṇḍalairvividhairnṛpa .. 73 ..
meaning:
ततस्तु दीक्षयेद्विन्प्रान्होतॄंश्च श्रद्धयान्वितः ..
निष्कैश्च कंकणैश्चैव कुण्डलैर्विविधैर्नृप .. 73 ..
text_mt: Then, filled with faith, he should reward the vipras and the hotṛ priests, / O king, with gold coins, bracelets, and various earrings.

sanskrit_iast:
gośataṃ caiva dātavyamaśvānāṃ ca śataṃ tadā ..
sahasraṃ ca suvarṇasya sarveṣāmapi dāpayet .. 74 ..
meaning:
गोशतं चैव दातव्यमश्वानां च शतं तदा ..
सहस्रं च सुवर्णस्य सर्वेषामपि दापयेत् .. 74 ..
text_mt: A hundred cows and a hundred horses should then be given, / and he should have a thousand [measures] of gold given to all of them.

sanskrit_iast:
grāmairgajai rathairaśvaiḥ pūjayecca purohitam ..
dīnāndhakṛpaṇānsarvānvastrādyaiścāpi pūjayet .. 79 ..
meaning:
ग्रामैर्गजै रथैरश्वैः पूजयेच्च पुरोहितम् ..

यमायेति च सप्तान्याः स्वाहांता जुहुयात्ततः .. 31 ..
text_mt: Then one should offer four oblations with the hymn "taratsamandī..."; / and then one should offer seven others ending with svāhā with [the mantra] "yamāya...";

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ viṣṇustataḥ sapta juhuyādāhutīrnṛpa ..
nakṣatrebhyastataḥ svāhā saptaviṃśada thāhutīḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
इदं विष्णुस्ततः सप्त जुहुयादाहुतीर्नृप ..
नक्षत्रेभ्यस्ततः स्वाहा सप्तविंशद थाहुतीः .. 32 ..
text_mt: then one should offer seven oblations with "idaṃ viṣṇuḥ...", O king; / then twenty-seven oblations with "svāhā to the lunar mansions!";

sanskrit_iast:
yatkarmaṇaiti juhuyāttataḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ punaḥ ..
grahahomastataḥ kāryastilairājyapariplutaiḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
यत्कर्मणैति जुहुयात्ततः स्विष्टकृतं पुनः ..
ग्रहहोमस्ततः कार्यस्तिलैराज्यपरिप्लुतैः .. 33 ..
text_mt: then one should offer with "yatkarmaṇā...", and then again the sviṣṭakṛt oblation; / then the planetary oblation should be made with sesame seeds soaked in clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittaṃ tato hutvā homakarma samāpayet ..
tatastu tūryanirghoṣaiḥ kāhalāśaṃkhaniḥsvanaiḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तं ततो हुत्वा होमकर्म समापयेत् ..
ततस्तु तूर्यनिर्घोषैः काहलाशंखनिःस्वनैः .. 34 ..
text_mt: Then, having offered the expiation, one should conclude the ritual of oblations. / Then, amidst the sounds of musical instruments and the noises of horns and conches,

sanskrit_iast:
yajamānasya kartavyo hyabhiṣeko dvijottamaiḥ ..
kāśmaryavṛkṣasaṃbhūte bhadre bhadrāsane sthitam .. 35 ..
meaning:
यजमानस्य कर्तव्यो ह्यभिषेको द्विजोत्तमैः ..
काश्मर्यवृक्षसंभूते भद्रे भद्रासने स्थितम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: the consecration (abhiṣeka) of the patron of the sacrifice must indeed be performed by the best of the twice-born. / Seated upon the auspicious bhadrāsana chair made of kāśmarya wood,

sanskrit_iast:
vedimadhyagataṃ kṛtvā durnimittapraśāṃtaye ..
paṃcabhiḥ kalaśaiḥ pūrṇairmaṃtrairebhiryathākramam .. 36 ..
meaning:
वेदिमध्यगतं कृत्वा दुर्निमित्तप्रशांतये ..
पंचभिः कलशैः पूर्णैर्मंत्रैरेभिर्यथाक्रमम् .. 36 ..
text_mt: placed in the middle of the altar, for the pacification of evil portents, / with the five full jars, with these mantras in proper order:

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrākṣeṇa prathamaṃ tataścaiva śatā yuṣā ..
sajoṣasā ca indreti viśvānītyṛgbhireva ca .. 37 ..
meaning:
सहस्राक्षेण प्रथमं ततश्चैव शता युषा ..
सजोषसा च इन्द्रेति विश्वानीत्यृग्भिरेव च .. 37 ..
text_mt: concentrated, they should bathe [him], first with "sahasrākṣeṇa...", and then with "śatāyuṣā...", / and with the verses "sajoṣasā...", "indra...", "viśvāni...", / and then with "ṛtamastu...".

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtamastviti ca tataḥ snāpayeyuḥ samāhitāḥ ..
tato diśāṃ baliṃ dadyādvicitrānna samāyutam .. 38 ..
meaning:
ऋतमस्त्विति च ततः स्नापयेयुः समाहिताः ..
ततो दिशां बलिं दद्याद्विचित्रान्न समायुतम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: Then one should present the offering (bali) to the directions, accompanied by varied cooked food,

sanskrit_iast:
namostu sarvabhūtebhya iti mantramudāharan ..
snātasya brāhmaṇāḥ sarve paṭheyuḥ śāṃtimuttamām .. 39 ..
meaning:
नमोस्तु सर्वभूतेभ्य इति मन्त्रमुदाहरन् ..
स्नातस्य ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे पठेयुः शांतिमुत्तमाम् .. 39 ..
text_mt: uttering the mantra "namo 'stu sarvabhūtebhyaḥ...". / For him when he has bathed, all the brāhmaṇas should recite the supreme pacification formula;

sanskrit_iast:
śāṃtitoyena dhārāṃ ca pātayitvā saṃmatataḥ ..
puṇyāhavācanaṃ kṛtvā śāṃtikarma samāpayet .. 4.143.40 ..
meaning:
शांतितोयेन धारां च पातयित्वा संमततः ..
पुण्याहवाचनं कृत्वा शांतिकर्म समापयेत् .. 4.143.40 ..
text_mt: and having poured a continuous stream with water of pacification, / having performed the proclamation of an auspicious day (puṇyāhavācana), one should conclude the pacification rite.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣitiṃ hiraṇyaṃ vāsāṃsi śayanānyāsanāni ca ..
viprebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādyathā śaktyā vimatsaraḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
क्षितिं हिरण्यं वासांसि शयनान्यासनानि च ..
विप्रेभ्यो दक्षिणां दद्याद्यथा शक्त्या विमत्सरः .. 41 ..
text_mt: Land, gold, clothes, beds, and seats / one should give as a sacrificial fee to the brāhmaṇas according to one's ability, free from envy.

sanskrit_iast:
dīnānāthaviśiṣṭebhyaḥ śrotriyebhyaśca dāpayet ..
bhojanaṃ śobhanaṃ dattvā tataḥ sarvaṃ prasiddhyati .. 42 ..
meaning:
दीनानाथविशिष्टेभ्यः श्रोत्रियेभ्यश्च दापयेत् ..
भोजनं शोभनं दत्त्वा ततः सर्वं प्रसिद्ध्यति .. 42 ..
text_mt: One should cause gifts to be given to the poor, the helpless, the distinguished, and learned brāhmaṇas; / having given excellent food, then everything succeeds.

sanskrit_iast:
āyuśca labhate dīrghaṃ śatrūnvijayate kṣaṇāt ..
durgāṇi cāsya sidyanti putrāṃśca labhate śubhān .. 43 ..
meaning:
आयुश्च लभते दीर्घं शत्रून्विजयते क्षणात् ..
दुर्गाणि चास्य सिद्यन्ति पुत्रांश्च लभते शुभान् .. 43 ..
text_mt: And he attains a long life, conquers enemies in an instant, / his difficulties are resolved, and he obtains auspicious sons.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāśastraprahārāṇāṃ kavacaṃ vāraṇaṃ bhavet..
tathā daivopaghātānāṃ śāntirbhavati vāraṇam .. 44 ..
meaning:
यथाशस्त्रप्रहाराणां कवचं वारणं भवेत्..
तथा दैवोपघातानां शान्तिर्भवति वारणम् .. 44 ..
text_mt: Just as armor is a shield against blows from weapons, / so pacification is a shield against the afflictions of fate.

sanskrit_iast:
ahiṃsakasya dāṃtasya dharmārjitadhanasya ca ..
dayādākṣiṇyayuktasya sarve sānugrahā grahāḥ.. 45..
meaning:
अहिंसकस्य दांतस्य धर्मार्जितधनस्य च ..
दयादाक्षिण्ययुक्तस्य सर्वे सानुग्रहा ग्रहाः.. 45..
text_mt: For one who is non-violent, self-controlled, who has acquired wealth righteously, / and who is endowed with compassion and courtesy, all planets are gracious.

sanskrit_iast:
arthānsamarthayati varddhayate ca dharmaṃ kāmaṃ prasādhayati tasya pinaṣṭi pāpam ..
yaḥ kārayetsakaladoṣaharīṃ samarthāṃ śāṃtiṃ praśāṃtahṛdayaḥ puruṣaḥ sadaiva .. .. 46 ..
gaṇanāthaśāntivarṇanam
meaning:
अर्थान्समर्थयति वर्द्धयते च धर्मं कामं प्रसाधयति तस्य पिनष्टि पापम् ..
यः कारयेत्सकलदोषहरीं समर्थां शांतिं प्रशांतहृदयः पुरुषः सदैव .. .. 46 ..
गणनाथशान्तिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
For that man who, with a calm heart, always has this efficacious pacification performed / which removes all defects, it accomplishes goals, increases righteousness, / achieves desires, and crushes his sin.
Description of the pacification rite for Gaṇanātha

sanskrit_iast:
.. .. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
śāṃtiṃ kathaya deveśa gaṇanāthasya me vibho ..
yāṃ kṛtvā sarvadurgāṇi tarate mānavo'khilaḥ .. 1 .. .. ..
meaning:
.. .. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
शांतिं कथय देवेश गणनाथस्य मे विभो ..
यां कृत्वा सर्वदुर्गाणि तरते मानवोऽखिलः .. 1 .. .. ..
text_mt:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Tell me, O Lord of gods, O all-pervading one, the propitiatory rite of Gaṇanātha,
by performing which every mortal crosses over all difficulties.
title: Gaṇanāthaśāṃtivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śāṃtiṃ vakṣyāmi rājendra gaṇanāthapriyāṃ parām ..
yasyā ācaraṇenaiva sarvāriṣṭakṣayo bhavet .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
शांतिं वक्ष्यामि राजेन्द्र गणनाथप्रियां पराम् ..
यस्या आचरणेनैव सर्वारिष्टक्षयो भवेत् .. 2 ..
text_mt:
The venerable Kṛṣṇa said:
I shall proclaim to you, O king of kings, the supreme propitiatory rite dear to Gaṇanātha,
by the very practice of which all afflictions are destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
vināyakaṃ karmāvighnasiddhyarthaṃ vinibodhata ..
svapne'vagāhate'tyarthaṃ jalaṃ muṃḍāṃśca paśyati .. 3 ..
meaning:
विनायकं कर्माविघ्नसिद्ध्यर्थं विनिबोधत ..
स्वप्नेऽवगाहतेऽत्यर्थं जलं मुंडांश्च पश्यति .. 3 ..
text_mt:
Understand [the possession by] Vināyaka, for the sake of the unobstructed accomplishment of rituals:
In dreams one plunges deeply into water and sees shaven-headed men.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṣāyavāsasaścaiva kravyādānadhirohati ..
apamūrdhaiḥ śave rudraiḥ sahaikatra ca tiṣṭhati .. 4 ..
meaning:
काषायवाससश्चैव क्रव्यादानधिरोहति ..
अपमूर्धैः शवे रुद्रैः सहैकत्र च तिष्ठति .. 4 ..
text_mt:
And [one sees] men wearing ochre garments, and mounts carnivorous animals;
one remains in one place with headless corpses [and] terrifying beings.

sanskrit_iast:
vrajannapi tathātmānaṃ manyatenugataṃ paraiḥ ..
vimanā viphalāraṃbhaḥ saṃsīdatyanimittataḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
व्रजन्नपि तथात्मानं मन्यतेनुगतं परैः ..
विमना विफलारंभः संसीदत्यनिमित्ततः .. 5 ..
text_mt:
Even while walking, one considers oneself followed by others;
one is dejected, one's undertakings are futile, and one sinks into despondency without cause.

sanskrit_iast:
tenopasṛṣṭo labhate na rājyaṃ rājanaṃdanaḥ ..
kumārī na ca bhartāramapatyaṃ garbhiṇī tathā .. 6 ..
meaning:
तेनोपसृष्टो लभते न राज्यं राजनंदनः ..
कुमारी न च भर्तारमपत्यं गर्भिणी तथा .. 6 ..
text_mt:
Asslicted by him, a prince does not obtain a kingdom;
a maiden does not obtain a husband, nor does a pregnant woman obtain offspring.

sanskrit_iast:
ācāryatvaṃ śrotriyaśca na śiṣyo'dhyāpanaṃ tathā ..
vaṇiglābhaṃ na cāpnoti na kṛṣiṃ ca kṛṣīvalaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
आचार्यत्वं श्रोत्रियश्च न शिष्योऽध्यापनं तथा ..
वणिग्लाभं न चाप्नोति न कृषिं च कृषीवलः .. 7 ..
text_mt:
A learned Vedic scholar does not obtain teacherhood, nor does a pupil obtain instruction;
a merchant does not obtain profit, and a farmer does not obtain a harvest.

sanskrit_iast:
snapanaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ puṇye'hni vidhipūrvakam ..
gaurasarṣapakalkena sājyenotsāditasya tu .. 8 ..
meaning:
स्नपनं तस्य कर्तव्यं पुण्येऽह्नि विधिपूर्वकम् ..
गौरसर्षपकल्केन साज्येनोत्सादितस्य तु .. 8 ..
text_mt:
A bath should be performed for him on an auspicious day according to the rules,
when he has been anointed with a paste of white mustard seeds mixed with clarified butter,

sanskrit_iast:
sugandhakuṃkumāliptaśarīraśirasastathā ..
bhadrāsanopaviṣṭasya svasti vācya dvijāñchubhān .. 9 ..
meaning:
सुगन्धकुंकुमालिप्तशरीरशिरसस्तथा ..
भद्रासनोपविष्टस्य स्वस्ति वाच्य द्विजाञ्छुभान् .. 9 ..
text_mt:
and whose body and head are smeared with fragrant saffron,
seated upon an auspicious seat, having auspicious twice-born priests recite benedictions.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvasthānādgajasthānādvalmīkātsaṃgamāddhradāt ..
mṛttikāṃ rocanāṃ gaṃdhānguggulaṃ cāpsu nikṣipet .. 4.144.10 ..
meaning:
अश्वस्थानाद्गजस्थानाद्वल्मीकात्संगमाद्ध्रदात् ..
मृत्तिकां रोचनां गंधान्गुग्गुलं चाप्सु निक्षिपेत् .. 4.144.10 ..
text_mt:
From a horse stable, an elephant stable, an anthill, a confluence, and a deep pool,
one should cast soil, yellow orpiment, perfumes, and bdellium into the waters.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā hṛtā hyekavaṇairmanubhiḥ kalaśairhradāt ..
carmaṇyānaḍuhe rakte sthāpya bhadrāsanaṃ tathā .. ..1 1..
meaning:
यदा हृता ह्येकवणैर्मनुभिः कलशैर्ह्रदात् ..
चर्मण्यानडुहे रक्ते स्थाप्य भद्रासनं तथा .. ..1 1..
text_mt:
When [the waters] are brought from a deep pool in jars of uniform colour with mantras,
having placed the auspicious seat on a red bull's hide,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrākṣaṃ śatadhāramṛṣiṇā vacanaṃ kṛtam ..
tena tvāmabhiṣiṃcāmi pāvamānyaḥ punaṃtu te ..12..
meaning:
सहस्राक्षं शतधारमृषिणा वचनं कृतम् ..
तेन त्वामभिषिंचामि पावमान्यः पुनंतु ते ..12..
text_mt:
“The utterance made by the sage has a thousand eyes and a hundred streams;
with that I sprinkle you; may the purifying mantras purify you.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagaṃ te varuṇo rājā bhagaṃ sūryo bṛhaspatiḥ ..
bhagamindraśca vāyuśca bhagaṃ saptarṣayo daduḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
भगं ते वरुणो राजा भगं सूर्यो बृहस्पतिः ..
भगमिन्द्रश्च वायुश्च भगं सप्तर्षयो ददुः .. 13 ..
text_mt:
King Varuṇa has given you good fortune; Sūrya and Bṛhaspati have given good fortune;
Indra and Vāyu have given good fortune; the seven sages have given good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
yatte keśeṣu daurbhāgyaṃ sīmaṃte yacca mūrddhani ..
lalāṭe karṇayorakṣṇorāpastadghnantu te sadā .. 14 ..
meaning:
यत्ते केशेषु दौर्भाग्यं सीमंते यच्च मूर्द्धनि ..
ललाटे कर्णयोरक्ष्णोरापस्तद्घ्नन्तु ते सदा .. 14 ..
text_mt:
Whatever misfortune is in your hair, in the parting of your hair, and upon your head,
on your forehead, your ears, and your eyes—may the waters destroy that forever.”

sanskrit_iast:
snātasya sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ sruveṇaudumbareṇa ca ..
juhuyānmūrddhani kuśānsavyena parigṛhya ca .. 15 ..
meaning:
स्नातस्य सार्षपं तैलं स्रुवेणौदुम्बरेण च ..
जुहुयान्मूर्द्धनि कुशान्सव्येन परिगृह्य च .. 15 ..
text_mt:
For him who has bathed, one should offer mustard oil with an udumbara ladle
upon his head, holding kuśa grass with the left hand.

sanskrit_iast:
mitaśca samitaścaiva tathā sālakaṭaṃkaṭau ..
kūṣmāṃḍo rājaputraśca aṃte svāhāsamanvitaiḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
मितश्च समितश्चैव तथा सालकटंकटौ ..
कूष्मांडो राजपुत्रश्च अंते स्वाहासमन्वितैः .. 16 ..
text_mt:
[With the names] Mita, Samita, as well as Sālakaṭaṅkaṭa,
Kūṣmāṇḍa, and Rājaputra, accompanied at the end by “svāhā”,

sanskrit_iast:
nāmabhirbalimaṃtraiśca namaskārasamanvitaiḥ ..
dadyāccatuṣpathe śūrpe kuśānāstīrya sarvaśaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
नामभिर्बलिमंत्रैश्च नमस्कारसमन्वितैः ..
दद्याच्चतुष्पथे शूर्पे कुशानास्तीर्य सर्वशः .. 17 ..
text_mt:
with these names, mantras of offering, and accompanied by obeisance,
one should present [the offering] at a crossroads in a winnowing basket, having strewn kuśa grass all around:

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtā kṛtāṃstaṃḍulāṃśca palalaudanameva ca ..
matsyānpakvāṃstathaivāmānmāṃsametāvadeva tu .. 18 ..
meaning:
कृता कृतांस्तंडुलांश्च पललौदनमेव च ..
मत्स्यान्पक्वांस्तथैवामान्मांसमेतावदेव तु .. 18 ..
text_mt:
cooked and uncooked rice grains, and rice boiled with sesame paste,
cooked fish as well as raw, and just as much meat,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpaṃ citraṃ sugandhaṃ ca surāṃ ca trividhāmapi ..
mūlakaṃ pūri kāpūpaṃ tathaivoṃḍerakasrajam .. 19 ..
meaning:
पुष्पं चित्रं सुगन्धं च सुरां च त्रिविधामपि ..
मूलकं पूरि कापूपं तथैवोंडेरकस्रजम् .. 19 ..
text_mt:
variegated and fragrant flowers, and three kinds of spirituous liquor,
radishes, purīs, rice cakes, and garlands of uṇḍeraka cakes.

sanskrit_iast:
dūrvāṃ sarvaprapuṣpāṇāṃ dattvārghyaṃ pūrṇamaḍalām ..
vināyakasya jananīmupatiṣṭhettatoṃ'bikām .. 4.144.20 ..
meaning:
दूर्वां सर्वप्रपुष्पाणां दत्त्वार्घ्यं पूर्णमडलाम् ..
विनायकस्य जननीमुपतिष्ठेत्ततोंऽबिकाम् .. 4.144.20 ..
text_mt:
Having offered an arghya of dūrvā grass with all flowers [forming] a complete circle,
one should then attend upon Ambikā, the mother of Vināyaka:

sanskrit_iast:
rūpaṃ dehi yaśo dehi bhagaṃ bhavati dehi me ..
putrāndehi dhanaṃ dehi sarvakāmāṃśca dehi me .. 21 ..
meaning:
रूपं देहि यशो देहि भगं भवति देहि मे ..
पुत्रान्देहि धनं देहि सर्वकामांश्च देहि मे .. 21 ..
text_mt:
“Give me beauty, give me fame, give me good fortune, O goddess;
give me sons, give me wealth, and give me all desires.”

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuklamālyānulepanaḥ ..
bhojayedbrāhmaṇāndadyādvastrayugmaṃ gurorapi .. 22 ..
meaning:
ततः शुक्लांबरधरः शुक्लमाल्यानुलेपनः ..
भोजयेद्ब्राह्मणान्दद्याद्वस्त्रयुग्मं गुरोरपि .. 22 ..
text_mt:
Then, wearing white garments, adorned with white garlands and unguents,
he should feed brāhmaṇas and give a pair of garments to his guru as well.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vināyakaṃ pūjya grahāṃścaiva vidhānataḥ ..
karmaṇāṃ phalamāpnoti śriyamāpnoti cottamām .. 23 ..
meaning:
एवं विनायकं पूज्य ग्रहांश्चैव विधानतः ..
कर्मणां फलमाप्नोति श्रियमाप्नोति चोत्तमाम् .. 23 ..
text_mt:
Having thus worshipped Vināyaka and the planets according to the rules,
he obtains the fruit of his actions and obtains supreme prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityasya tathā pūjāṃ tilakaṃ svāminastathā ..
mahāgaṇapateścaiva kurvansiddhimavāpnuyāt .. 24 ..
meaning:
आदित्यस्य तथा पूजां तिलकं स्वामिनस्तथा ..
महागणपतेश्चैव कुर्वन्सिद्धिमवाप्नुयात् .. 24 ..
text_mt:
Performing likewise the worship of the Sun, the sectarian mark of the Lord,
and of Mahāgaṇapati, he will attain accomplishment.

sanskrit_iast:
śvetārkasya tu yo mūle mahāgaṇapatiḥ kṛtaḥ ..
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇaḥ so'pi siddhikaraḥ smṛtaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
श्वेतार्कस्य तु यो मूले महागणपतिः कृतः ..
सर्वलक्षणसंपूर्णः सोऽपि सिद्धिकरः स्मृतः .. 25 ..
text_mt:
A Mahāgaṇapati made at the root of a white arka plant,
endowed with all auspicious marks, is also considered to bring accomplishment.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃjapyate śucau deśe vighnaṃ nātra hi dehinaḥ ..
paramaṃ pūjayennityaṃ gandhamālyasragādibhiḥ .. 26 ..
kṣīṇabhāgyo'pi puruṣaḥ pūjitaśca nareśvaraḥ ..
sarvasiddhimavāpnoti jayī bhavati sarvadā .. .27 .. ..
nakṣatrahomavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
संजप्यते शुचौ देशे विघ्नं नात्र हि देहिनः ..
परमं पूजयेन्नित्यं गन्धमाल्यस्रगादिभिः .. 26 ..
क्षीणभाग्योऽपि पुरुषः पूजितश्च नरेश्वरः ..
सर्वसिद्धिमवाप्नोति जयी भवति सर्वदा .. .27 .. ..
नक्षत्रहोमविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
When he is chanted to in a pure place, no obstacle exists for the embodied soul here;
one should always worship the Supreme One with perfumes, garlands, wreaths, and the like.
Even a man whose fortune is depleted, and a king who has worshipped him,
attains all accomplishment and becomes victorious at all times.
Description of the rules for the constellation burnt-offering

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
agnihotre sukhāsīnaṃ gargaḥ pṛcchati kauśikam ..
baṃdhane saṃnirodheṅgā vyādhīnāṃ saṃprapīḍane .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
अग्निहोत्रे सुखासीनं गर्गः पृच्छति कौशिकम् ..
बंधने संनिरोधेङ्गा व्याधीनां संप्रपीडने .. 1 ..
text_mt:
The venerable Kṛṣṇa said:
Garga asks Kauśika, who is seated comfortably by the sacred fire:
“In bondage, confinement, and the affliction of the limbs by diseases,
title: Nakṣatrahomavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ mokṣo bhavettasya sādhyāsādhyaṃ bravīhi me ..
gargeṇa kauśikaḥ pṛṣṭa idaṃ vacanamabravīt ..2..
meaning:
कथं मोक्षो भवेत्तस्य साध्यासाध्यं ब्रवीहि मे ..
गर्गेण कौशिकः पृष्ट इदं वचनमब्रवीत् ..2..
text_mt:
how might there be release for him? Tell me what is curable and incurable.”
Being questioned by Garga, Kauśika spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāne janmanakṣatre naidhanapratyayeṣu ca ..
vyādhirutpadyate yasya kleśāya maraṇāya ca ..3..
meaning:
आधाने जन्मनक्षत्रे नैधनप्रत्ययेषु च ..
व्याधिरुत्पद्यते यस्य क्लेशाय मरणाय च ..3..
text_mt:
“When a disease arises under the constellation of conception, of birth, or in the destructive positions,
it leads to suffering and to death.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛttikāsu yadā kaścidvyādhiṃ saṃpratipadyate ..
navarātraṃ bhavetpīḍā trirātraṃ rohiṇīṣu ca ..4..
meaning:
कृत्तिकासु यदा कश्चिद्व्याधिं संप्रतिपद्यते ..
नवरात्रं भवेत्पीडा त्रिरात्रं रोहिणीषु च ..4..
text_mt:
When anyone contracts a disease under the Kṛttikās,
there will be affliction for nine nights, and for three nights under the Rohiṇīs.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgaśīrṣe pañcarātramārdrā prāṇaviyojinī ..
punarvasau ca puṣye ca saptarātraṃ vidhīyate .. .. 5 ..
meaning:
मृगशीर्षे पञ्चरात्रमार्द्रा प्राणवियोजिनी ..
पुनर्वसौ च पुष्ये च सप्तरात्रं विधीयते .. .. 5 ..
text_mt:
Under Mṛgaśīrṣa it lasts five nights; Ārdrā deprives one of life;
and under Punarvasu and Puṣya, seven nights are prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
navarātraṃ tathāśleṣā śmaśānāṃtaṃ maghāsu ca ..
dvau māsau phālgunī caiva uttarāsu tripakṣakam .. 6 ..
meaning:
नवरात्रं तथाश्लेषा श्मशानांतं मघासु च ..
द्वौ मासौ फाल्गुनी चैव उत्तरासु त्रिपक्षकम् .. 6 ..
text_mt:
Under Āśleṣā it lasts nine nights, and under the Maghās it ends at the cremation ground;
under [Pūrva-]Phālgunī two months, and under the Uttarās [Uttara-Phālgunī] three fortnights.

sanskrit_iast: haste ca tanu dṛśyeta citrāyāṃ tvarddhamāsa kam ..7..
meaning: हस्ते च तनु दृश्येत चित्रायां त्वर्द्धमास कम् ..7..
text_mt: Under Hasta it is seen to be slight; under Citrā, half a month.

sanskrit_iast:
māsadvayaṃ tathā svātau viśākhā viṃśatirdināḥ ..
maitre caiva daśāhaṃ tu jyeṣṭhā caivārddhamāsikā ..8..
meaning:
मासद्वयं तथा स्वातौ विशाखा विंशतिर्दिनाः ..
मैत्रे चैव दशाहं तु ज्येष्ठा चैवार्द्धमासिका ..8..
text_mt:
Likewise, two months under Svāti; Viśākhā lasts twenty days;
under Maitra [Anurādhā] ten days, and Jyeṣṭhā lasts half a month.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlena jāyate mokṣaścāṣāḍhāsu tripañcakam ..
uttarādinaviṃśatyā dvau māsau śravaṇena tu .. 9 ..
meaning:
मूलेन जायते मोक्षश्चाषाढासु त्रिपञ्चकम् ..
उत्तरादिनविंशत्या द्वौ मासौ श्रवणेन तु .. 9 ..
text_mt:
Under Mūla release occurs; under the Āṣāḍhās [Pūrvāṣāḍhā], fifteen [days];
under the Uttarā [Uttarāṣāḍhā] twenty days, and two months under Śravaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
dhaniṣṭhāyāmarddhamāsaṃ vāruṇe tu daśāhakaiḥ ..
nava bhādrapadāṛkṣa uttarāsu tripaṃcakam .. 4.145.10 ..
meaning:
धनिष्ठायामर्द्धमासं वारुणे तु दशाहकैः ..
नव भाद्रपदाऋक्ष उत्तरासु त्रिपंचकम् .. 4.145.10 ..
text_mt:
Under Dhaniṣṭhā half a month, but under Vāruṇa [Śatabhiṣaj] ten days;
nine under the Bhādrapadā constellation [Pūrvabhādrapadā], and fifteen under the Uttarās [Uttarabhādrapadā].

sanskrit_iast:
revatī daśarātraṃ tu ahorātraṃ tathāśvinī ..
prāṇairviyojayennityaṃ garga nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
रेवती दशरात्रं तु अहोरात्रं तथाश्विनी ..
प्राणैर्वियोजयेन्नित्यं गर्ग नास्त्यत्र संशयः .. 11 ..
text_mt:
Revatī lasts ten nights, and Aśvinī a day and night;
it always deprives one of life, O Garga, there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
kauśikena samādiṣṭo nakṣatravyādhisaṃbhavaḥ ..
daivajñenāpi jñātavyaṃ nakṣatramatha janmanā .. 12 ..
meaning:
कौशिकेन समादिष्टो नक्षत्रव्याधिसंभवः ..
दैवज्ञेनापि ज्ञातव्यं नक्षत्रमथ जन्मना .. 12 ..
text_mt:
The origin of disease according to constellations has been declared by Kauśika;
the astrologer should also know the constellation from birth.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīravṛkṣasya samidho juhuyādaśvadaivate ..
tilānmadhuplutānyāmye yavamevāgnidaivate .. 13 ..
meaning:
क्षीरवृक्षस्य समिधो जुहुयादश्वदैवते ..
तिलान्मधुप्लुतान्याम्ये यवमेवाग्निदैवते .. 13 ..
text_mt:
One should offer sacrificial sticks of a milky tree under the horse-deity [Aśvinī];
sesame flooded with honey under the Yamya [Bharaṇī]; barley indeed under the fire-deity [Kṛttikā].

sanskrit_iast:
prājāpatye tu juhuyādbhogyabījakaraṃ bakam ..
saumye priyaṃgavo raudre sarpirmāṃsasamanvitam .. 14 ..
meaning:
प्राजापत्ये तु जुहुयाद्भोग्यबीजकरं बकम् ..
सौम्ये प्रियंगवो रौद्रे सर्पिर्मांससमन्वितम् .. 14 ..
text_mt:
Under the Prājāpatya [Rohiṇī] one should offer a mixture of edible grains;
under the Saumya [Mṛgaśīrṣa] priyaṅgu grains; under the Raudra [Ārdrā] clarified butter accompanied by meat.

sanskrit_iast:
āditye ca prayatnena ghṛtāktāḥ sitataṃḍulāḥ ..
payasā sarpiṣā sākaṃ bṛhaspatyadhidaivate .. 15 ..
meaning:
आदित्ये च प्रयत्नेन घृताक्ताः सिततंडुलाः ..
पयसा सर्पिषा साकं बृहस्पत्यधिदैवते .. 15 ..
text_mt:
And under the Āditya [Punarvasu] carefully [offer] white rice grains smeared with clarified butter;
with milk and clarified butter under the deity presided over by Bṛhaspati [Puṣya].

sanskrit_iast:
grāmyoṣadhairvaṭapatraiḥ sarpiḥ sarpādhidaivate ..
homaḥ proktaḥ priyaṃgūnāṃ nakṣatre yāmadaivate .. 16 ..
meaning:
ग्राम्योषधैर्वटपत्रैः सर्पिः सर्पाधिदैवते ..
होमः प्रोक्तः प्रियंगूनां नक्षत्रे यामदैवते .. 16 ..
text_mt: In the [nakṣatra] presided over by the serpents, the oblation is of clarified butter with wild herbs and vaṭa leaves; / the oblation in the nakṣatra presided over by Yama is declared to be of priyaṅgu.

sanskrit_iast: sāvitre dadhihomotra tvāṣṭraṃ citraudanaṃ haviḥ .. 17 ..
meaning: सावित्रे दधिहोमोत्र त्वाष्ट्रं चित्रौदनं हविः .. 17 ..
text_mt: In the [nakṣatra] of Savitṛ, the oblation here is of curds; that of Tvaṣṭṛ is variegated boiled rice as the sacrificial offering.

sanskrit_iast:
yavānsahājyena hunedraudre'gnau tu payodanam ..
maitreṇātha tu maṃtreṇa maitre kaṭakamiśritam .. 18 ..
meaning:
यवान्सहाज्येन हुनेद्रौद्रेऽग्नौ तु पयोदनम् ..
मैत्रेणाथ तु मंत्रेण मैत्रे कटकमिश्रितम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: One should offer barley together with clarified butter, but in the Raudra [nakṣatra] one should offer rice cooked in milk into the fire; / then, with the Mitra mantra, [an oblation] mixed with lentils in the Maitra [nakṣatra].

sanskrit_iast:
nairṛtye tilahomaḥ syādavyakte ca hutāśane ..
abdaivatye śālibījairvaiśvadevaṃ tu kārayet .. 19 ..
meaning:
नैरृत्ये तिलहोमः स्यादव्यक्ते च हुताशने ..
अब्दैवत्ये शालिबीजैर्वैश्वदेवं तु कारयेत् .. 19 ..
text_mt: In the Nairṛta [nakṣatra], there should be an oblation of sesame seeds, and into the unmanifest fire; / in that presided over by the Waters, one should perform the Vaiśvadeva [offering] with grains of śāli rice.

sanskrit_iast:
raktāśca taṃḍulāścaiva hotavyā viṣṇudaivate ..
vāruṇe pārijātānāṃ puṣpāṇāṃ homa iṣyate .. 4.145.20 ..
meaning:
रक्ताश्च तंडुलाश्चैव होतव्या विष्णुदैवते ..
वारुणे पारिजातानां पुष्पाणां होम इष्यते .. 4.145.20 ..
text_mt: And red unhusked rice grains should be offered in the [nakṣatra] presided over by Viṣṇu; / in the Vāruṇa [nakṣatra], an oblation of pārijāta flowers is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
ajaikapāde nakṣatre prājāpatyena tatsamam ..
āhirbudhnye tu nakṣatre vaiśvadevaṃ tu kārayet .. 21 ..
meaning:
अजैकपादे नक्षत्रे प्राजापत्येन तत्समम् ..
आहिर्बुध्न्ये तु नक्षत्रे वैश्वदेवं तु कारयेत् .. 21 ..
text_mt: In the Ajaikapāda nakṣatra, it is equal to that of the Prājāpatya; / in the Āhirbudhnya nakṣatra, one should perform the Vaiśvadeva [offering].

sanskrit_iast:
raktāśca taṇḍulāścaiva hotavyā viṣṇudaivate ..
pauṣe phalānyakhaṃḍāni juhuyādaṣṭottaraṃ śatam .. 22 ..
meaning:
रक्ताश्च तण्डुलाश्चैव होतव्या विष्णुदैवते ..
पौषे फलान्यखंडानि जुहुयादष्टोत्तरं शतम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: And red unhusked rice grains should be offered in the [nakṣatra] presided over by Viṣṇu; / in Pauṣa, one should offer one hundred and eight unbroken fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitrī homamekaṃ tu brahmābhihitavānpurā ..
sarvajvarapraśamanaṃ sadyo jvaraharaṃ param .. 23 ..
aparādhaśatavratavarṇanam
meaning:
सावित्री होममेकं तु ब्रह्माभिहितवान्पुरा ..
सर्वज्वरप्रशमनं सद्यो ज्वरहरं परम् .. 23 ..
अपराधशतव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Brahmā formerly declared a single Sāvitrī oblation, / which pacifies all fevers and immediately removes fever, being supreme.
Description of the Hundred-Transgression Observance.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīvasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
athānyadapi te vacmi vrataṃ rājanmahāphalam ..
aparādhaśataṃ yena kṣayaṃ yāti śṛṇuṣva tat .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीवसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
अथान्यदपि ते वच्मि व्रतं राजन्महाफलम् ..
अपराधशतं येन क्षयं याति शृणुष्व तत् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Vasiṣṭha said: / Now I shall tell you another observance of great fruit, O king, / by which a hundred transgressions are destroyed; listen to it.
title: Aparādhaśatavratavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
.. ikṣvākuruvāca .. ..
kiṃ vrataṃ tanmamācakṣva ko'parādhastu taṃ vada ..
kaḥ pūjyate ca vai tasminkadā vā kriyate naraiḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. इक्ष्वाकुरुवाच .. ..
किं व्रतं तन्ममाचक्ष्व कोऽपराधस्तु तं वद ..
कः पूज्यते च वै तस्मिन्कदा वा क्रियते नरैः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Ikṣvāku said: / Tell me what that observance is, and state what the transgression is; / who is worshipped in it, and when is it performed by men?

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīvasiṣṭha uvāca ..
śṛṇu rājanmahābāho aparādhaśatavratam..
yenānuṣṭhitamātreṇa kāmamokṣau labheta nā .. 3 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीवसिष्ठ उवाच ..
शृणु राजन्महाबाहो अपराधशतव्रतम्..
येनानुष्ठितमात्रेण काममोक्षौ लभेत ना .. 3 ..
text_mt: Śrī Vasiṣṭha said: / Listen, O mighty-armed king, to the Hundred-Transgression observance, / merely by performing which a man obtains desire and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittānyaśeṣāṇi sarvapāpāpanuttaye ..
kṛtānyapyakṛtāni syuriti hovāca padmajaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तान्यशेषाणि सर्वपापापनुत्तये ..
कृतान्यप्यकृतानि स्युरिति होवाच पद्मजः .. 4 ..
text_mt: All expiations for the removal of all sins, / even when performed, become as if unperformed; so spoke the Lotus-born [Brahmā].

sanskrit_iast:
pāpaṃ gurutaraṃ cāpi dahyate tūlarāśivat ..
aparādhaśataṃ rājañśṛṇuṣva gadato mama .. 5 ..
meaning:
पापं गुरुतरं चापि दह्यते तूलराशिवत् ..
अपराधशतं राजञ्शृणुष्व गदतो मम .. 5 ..
text_mt: Even a very heavy sin is burnt away like a heap of cotton. / Listen, O king, as I recite the hundred transgressions:

sanskrit_iast:
na karoti naro mohādvratametaddinedine..
anāśramitvaṃ prathamo'nagnitā vratahīnatā .. 6 ..
meaning:
न करोति नरो मोहाद्व्रतमेतद्दिनेदिने..
अनाश्रमित्वं प्रथमोऽनग्निता व्रतहीनता .. 6 ..
text_mt: A man out of delusion does not perform this observance day by day. / Being without a life-stage is the first; being without sacred fire; lack of observances;

sanskrit_iast:
adātṛtvamaśaucaṃ ca nirdayatvaṃ spṛhālutā ..
akṣāṃtirjanapīḍā ca māyitvamapyamaṃgalam .. 7 ..
meaning:
अदातृत्वमशौचं च निर्दयत्वं स्पृहालुता ..
अक्षांतिर्जनपीडा च मायित्वमप्यमंगलम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: Uncharitableness and impurity, mercilessness, covetousness, / lack of patience, tormenting people, deceptiveness, and inauspiciousness;

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatavratatvaṃ nāstikyaṃ vedaniṃdā kaṭhoratā ..
asatyatā hiṃsakatvaṃ stainyami ndriyaviplavaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
क्षतव्रतत्वं नास्तिक्यं वेदनिंदा कठोरता ..
असत्यता हिंसकत्वं स्तैन्यमि न्द्रियविप्लवः .. 8 ..
text_mt: Broken vows, atheism, reviling the Vedas, harshness, / untruthfulness, injuriousness, theft, unrestraint of the senses;

sanskrit_iast:
manaso'nigrahaścaiva krodha īrṣyātha matsaraḥ ..
daṃbhaḥ śāṭhyaṃ ca dhaurtyaṃ ca kaṭukoktiḥ pramādatā .. 9 ..
meaning:
मनसोऽनिग्रहश्चैव क्रोध ईर्ष्याथ मत्सरः ..
दंभः शाठ्यं च धौर्त्यं च कटुकोक्तिः प्रमादता .. 9 ..
text_mt: Lack of control over the mind, anger, envy, and malice; / hypocrisy, deceit, knavery, bitter speech, negligence;

sanskrit_iast:
bhāryāmātṛsutādīnāṃ tyāgaścāpūjya pūjanam ..
śrāddhahānirjapatyāgaḥ paṃcayajñavivarjanam .. 4.146.10 ..
meaning:
भार्यामातृसुतादीनां त्यागश्चापूज्य पूजनम् ..
श्राद्धहानिर्जपत्यागः पंचयज्ञविवर्जनम् .. 4.146.10 ..
text_mt: Abandonment of wife, mother, son, and others, and worshipping the unworthy of worship; / omission of ancestral rites, abandoning silent prayer, neglect of the five daily sacrifices;

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyātarpaṇahomānāṃ hāniragneḥ praṇāśanam ..
anṛtau maithunaṃ pārtha parvaṇyapi ca maithunam .. 11 ..
meaning:
संध्यातर्पणहोमानां हानिरग्नेः प्रणाशनम् ..
अनृतौ मैथुनं पार्थ पर्वण्यपि च मैथुनम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Loss of twilight devotions, libations, and fire-oblations; extinction of the sacred fire; / sexual intercourse outside the fertile period, O king, and intercourse on sacred days;

sanskrit_iast:
paiśunyaṃ paradāreṣu dānaṃ veśyābhigāmitā ..
apātradānaṃ cālpaṃ ca mūlikākulibhakṣaṇam .. 12 ..
meaning:
पैशुन्यं परदारेषु दानं वेश्याभिगामिता ..
अपात्रदानं चाल्पं च मूलिकाकुलिभक्षणम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Malicious gossip, giving gifts for another's wife, consorting with courtesans, / giving gifts to the unworthy, and eating little or forbidden roots;

sanskrit_iast:
aṃtyajāgamanaṃ mātṛtyāgaḥ pitṛvivarjanam ..
pitrorabhaktirvādaśca purāṇasmṛtivarjanam .. 13 ..
meaning:
अंत्यजागमनं मातृत्यागः पितृविवर्जनम् ..
पित्रोरभक्तिर्वादश्च पुराणस्मृतिवर्जनम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Intercourse with outcaste women, abandoning the mother, forsaking the father, / lack of devotion to parents and arguing [with them], abandoning the Purāṇas and Smṛtis;

sanskrit_iast:
abhakṣyabhojanaṃ cāpi patidroho'vicāratā ..
kṛṣikarmakriyāvāhaṃ bhāryāsaṃgrahakāritā .. 14 ..
meaning:
अभक्ष्यभोजनं चापि पतिद्रोहोऽविचारता ..
कृषिकर्मक्रियावाहं भार्यासंग्रहकारिता .. 14 ..
text_mt: Eating forbidden food, betrayal of one's master, thoughtlessness, / [unauthorized] engagement in agriculture, procurement of wives;

sanskrit_iast:
iṃdriyājayamāyitvaṃ vidyāvismaraṇaṃ tathā ..
śāstratyāga ṛṇaṃ citrakarma cānaṃgadhāvanam .. 15 ..
meaning:
इंद्रियाजयमायित्वं विद्याविस्मरणं तथा ..
शास्त्रत्याग ऋणं चित्रकर्म चानंगधावनम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: Non-restraint of the senses, fraudulence, forgetting sacred knowledge, / abandoning the scriptures, incurring debt, strange acts, and pursuit of lust;

sanskrit_iast:
bhāryāputrasutādīnāṃ vikrayaḥ paśumaithunam..
indhanārthaṃ drumacchedo bile vāryādipūraṇam .. 16 ..
meaning:
भार्यापुत्रसुतादीनां विक्रयः पशुमैथुनम्..
इन्धनार्थं द्रुमच्छेदो बिले वार्यादिपूरणम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: Selling one's wife, son, daughter, and others; bestiality; / cutting trees for firewood; filling a hole with water and the like;

sanskrit_iast:
taḍāgāgamane vṛttaṃ vidyāvikrayakāritā ..
vṛttilopo mahīpāla yācakatvaṃ kumitratā .. 17 ..
meaning:
तडागागमने वृत्तं विद्याविक्रयकारिता ..
वृत्तिलोपो महीपाल याचकत्वं कुमित्रता .. 17 ..
text_mt: Conduct regarding approach to reservoirs; selling knowledge; / loss of livelihood, O protector of the earth; mendicancy; keeping bad company;

sanskrit_iast:
strīvadho govadhaścaiva paurohityaṃ suhṛdvadhaḥ ..
bhrūṇahatyā parānnaṃ ca śūdrānnasya niṣevaṇam .. 18 ..
meaning:
स्त्रीवधो गोवधश्चैव पौरोहित्यं सुहृद्वधः ..
भ्रूणहत्या परान्नं च शूद्रान्नस्य निषेवणम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: Killing a woman, killing a cow, officiating for the unworthy, killing a friend, / killing an embryo, eating another's food, and consumption of a Śūdra's food;

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrasya cāgnikarmatvamavidhitvaṃ kuputratā ..
vidvadbhyo yācakatvaṃ hi vācāṭatvaṃ pratigrahaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
शूद्रस्य चाग्निकर्मत्वमविधित्वं कुपुत्रता ..
विद्वद्भ्यो याचकत्वं हि वाचाटत्वं प्रतिग्रहः .. 19 ..
text_mt: A Śūdra performing fire-rituals, lack of proper ritual, being a bad son, / begging from the learned, loquacity, and accepting improper gifts;

sanskrit_iast:
śrautasaṃskāra dīnatvamārtatrāṇavivarjanam ..
brahmahatyāsurāpānarukmastainyamataḥ param .. 4.146.20 ..
meaning:
श्रौतसंस्कार दीनत्वमार्तत्राणविवर्जनम् ..
ब्रह्महत्यासुरापानरुक्मस्तैन्यमतः परम् .. 4.146.20 ..
text_mt: Deficiency in Vedic rites, abandonment of protecting the distressed, / killing a Brahmin, drinking spirituous liquor, theft of gold; beyond this,

sanskrit_iast:
gurudārābhigāmitvaṃ saṃyogaścāpi taiḥ saha ..
aparādhaśataṃ tvetatkathitaṃ te mayānagha .. 21 ..
meaning:
गुरुदाराभिगामित्वं संयोगश्चापि तैः सह ..
अपराधशतं त्वेतत्कथितं ते मयानघ .. 21 ..
text_mt: Sexual intercourse with the guru's wife, and association with such [sinners]— / this hundred of transgressions has been declared to you by me, O sinless one.

sanskrit_iast:
anye'pi vividhāḥ saṃti proktāḥ prādhānyatastvamī ..
yadi vaktrasahasrāṇi vaktre jihvāśatāni ca .. 22 ..
meaning:
अन्येऽपि विविधाः संति प्रोक्ताः प्राधान्यतस्त्वमी ..
यदि वक्त्रसहस्राणि वक्त्रे जिह्वाशतानि च .. 22 ..
text_mt: There are also other diverse kinds, but these have been spoken by way of prominence. / Even if one had a thousand mouths and a hundred tongues in each mouth,

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpyete na śakyaṃte vaktuṃ yasmādanaṃtakāḥ ..
aparādhasahasrāṇi lakṣakoṭiśatāni ca .. 23 ..
meaning:
तथाप्येते न शक्यंते वक्तुं यस्मादनंतकाः ..
अपराधसहस्राणि लक्षकोटिशतानि च .. 23 ..
text_mt: Even so, they cannot be spoken, because they are endless. / Thousands, hundreds of thousands, and hundreds of millions of transgressions

sanskrit_iast:
naśyaṃti tatkṣaṇānnūnaṃ satyeśasyānupūjanāt ..
pūjye bhagavānatra kṛtakṛtye parājite .. 24 ..
meaning:
नश्यंति तत्क्षणान्नूनं सत्येशस्यानुपूजनात् ..
पूज्ये भगवानत्र कृतकृत्ये पराजिते .. 24 ..
text_mt: Are surely destroyed in that very instant by worshipping Satyeśa. / The Lord is to be worshipped here as one whose purpose is accomplished, undefeated;

sanskrit_iast:
dhvaje satye sthitaścāyaṃ lakṣmyā saha jagatpatiḥ ..
vāmadevastataḥ pūrvaṃ nṛsiṃho dakṣiṇe sthitaḥ ..25 ..
meaning:
ध्वजे सत्ये स्थितश्चायं लक्ष्म्या सह जगत्पतिः ..
वामदेवस्ततः पूर्वं नृसिंहो दक्षिणे स्थितः ..25 ..
text_mt: And he, the Lord of the universe, abides on the banner of truth together with Lakṣmī. / Vāmadeva is in the east, Nṛsiṃha is situated in the south,

sanskrit_iast:
kapilaḥ paścimāsye tu vārāhaścottare sthitaḥ..
ūrdhvavaktro'cyuto jñeya etadvai brahmapaṃcakam .. 26 ..
meaning:
कपिलः पश्चिमास्ये तु वाराहश्चोत्तरे स्थितः..
ऊर्ध्ववक्त्रोऽच्युतो ज्ञेय एतद्वै ब्रह्मपंचकम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: Kapila is in the western face, and Vārāha is situated in the north; / Acyuta is to be known as the upward face: this indeed is the group of five Brahmans.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ satyeśaṃ sthitaṃ rājanpūjayecca sadaiva hi ..
kṣīrodayārdhacandrasthapadmakarṇikasaṃsthitam .. 27 ..
meaning:
तं सत्येशं स्थितं राजन्पूजयेच्च सदैव हि ..
