क्षीरोदयार्धचन्द्रस्थपद्मकर्णिकसंस्थितम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: One should always worship that Satyeśa abiding there, O king, / who is situated on the pericarp of a lotus resting on the crescent moon arising from the milk-ocean,

sanskrit_iast:
padmakaumodakīśaṃkhacakrāyudhavidhāraṇam ..
vāme cādhastathā dakṣe ūrdhve paścādadho nṛpa .. 28 ..
meaning:
पद्मकौमोदकीशंखचक्रायुधविधारणम् ..
वामे चाधस्तथा दक्षे ऊर्ध्वे पश्चादधो नृप .. 28 ..
text_mt: Holding the lotus, the Kaumodakī club, the conch, and the discus as weapons, / on the lower left, on the right, above, and then below, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
pādādhastādviniṣkrāṃtā gaṃgā pūtā sadā nṛbhiḥ ..
śaktyaṣṭakaṃ tathā cānyattannāmāni ca me śṛṇu .. 29 ..
meaning:
पादाधस्ताद्विनिष्क्रांता गंगा पूता सदा नृभिः ..
शक्त्यष्टकं तथा चान्यत्तन्नामानि च मे शृणु .. 29 ..
text_mt: From beneath his feet emerges the Gaṅgā, ever purified by men; / and there is another group of eight Śaktis; listen to their names from me:

sanskrit_iast:
jayā ca vijayā caiva jayaṃtī pāpanāśinī..
unmīlinī vaṃjulī ca trispṛśātha vivarddhanā ..4.146.30..
meaning:
जया च विजया चैव जयंती पापनाशिनी..
उन्मीलिनी वंजुली च त्रिस्पृशाथ विवर्द्धना ..4.146.30..
text_mt: Jayā, Vijayā, Jayantī, Pāpanāśinī, / Unmīlinī, Vañjulī, Trispṛśā, and Vivardhanā.

sanskrit_iast:
etābhiḥ śaktibhiryuktaṃ lokadikpālavarjitam ..
śuklāṃbaradharaṃ saumyaṃ prahṛṣṭavadanaṃ śivam .. .. 31 ..
meaning:
एताभिः शक्तिभिर्युक्तं लोकदिक्पालवर्जितम् ..
शुक्लांबरधरं सौम्यं प्रहृष्टवदनं शिवम् .. .. 31 ..
text_mt: Endowed with these Śaktis, devoid of the world guardians and guardians of the directions, / wearing white garments, gentle, with a delighted face, auspicious,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvābharaṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ harim ..
pūjayecca prayatnena vidhinā yena taṃ śṛṇu .. 32 ..
meaning:
सर्वाभरणशोभाढ्यं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं हरिम् ..
पूजयेच्च प्रयत्नेन विधिना येन तं शृणु .. 32 ..
text_mt: Abundantly adorned with all ornaments, bestowing enjoyment and liberation, Hari— / one should worship him with effort; hear the rite by which [it is done].

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśīrṣādimāseṣu dvādaśasvapi sarvadā ..
dvādaśyāmapyamāyāṃ vā aṣṭamyāṃ ca sitāsite .. 33 ..
meaning:
मार्गशीर्षादिमासेषु द्वादशस्वपि सर्वदा ..
द्वादश्यामप्यमायां वा अष्टम्यां च सितासिते .. 33 ..
text_mt: In the twelve months beginning with Mārgaśīrṣa, always / on the twelfth, on the new moon, or on the eighth, bright or dark,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtopavāsaḥ śuddhātmā kuryādvratamataṃdritaḥ ..
pakṣayorubhayorevaṃ pūjaye'haṃ janārdanam .. 34 ..
meaning:
कृतोपवासः शुद्धात्मा कुर्याद्व्रतमतंद्रितः ..
पक्षयोरुभयोरेवं पूजयेऽहं जनार्दनम् .. 34 ..
text_mt: Having observed a fast, pure in mind, unwearied, one should perform the observance: / 'In both fortnights, thus shall I worship Janārdana.'

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tu niyamaṃ kṛtvā daṃtadhāvanapūrvakam ..
gacchettatastaḍāge vā puṣkariṇyāṃ gṛhe'pi vā .. 35 ..
meaning:
एवं तु नियमं कृत्वा दंतधावनपूर्वकम् ..
गच्छेत्ततस्तडागे वा पुष्करिण्यां गृहेऽपि वा .. 35 ..
text_mt: Having made such a resolve preceded by cleaning the teeth, / he should then go to a pond, a lotus lake, or even in the house.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā tu naityakaṃ karma kṛtvā naimittikaṃ tataḥ ..
kuryātsarvaṃ prayatnena yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
स्नात्वा तु नैत्यकं कर्म कृत्वा नैमित्तिकं ततः ..
कुर्यात्सर्वं प्रयत्नेन यथावदनुपूर्वशः .. 36 ..
text_mt: Having bathed and performed the obligatory rites, and then the occasional rites, / one should carefully carry out everything in proper order according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
sauvarṇaṃ kārayeddevaṃ pūrvoktaṃ satyarūpiṇam ..
śaktyaṣṭakayutaṃ lakṣmyā yuktaṃ padmāsanasthayā .. 37 ..
meaning:
सौवर्णं कारयेद्देवं पूर्वोक्तं सत्यरूपिणम् ..
शक्त्यष्टकयुतं लक्ष्म्या युक्तं पद्मासनस्थया .. 37 ..
text_mt: One should cause to be made a golden image of the god, as previously described, whose nature is truth, / endowed with the eight powers, and joined with Lakṣmī seated upon a lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇapalamānena kāryametatsavistaram ..
dugdhakuṃbhopariṣṭāttu svarṇapadmaṃ prakalpayet .. 38 ..
meaning:
सुवर्णपलमानेन कार्यमेतत्सविस्तरम् ..
दुग्धकुंभोपरिष्टात्तु स्वर्णपद्मं प्रकल्पयेत् .. 38 ..
text_mt: This should be made fully with the weight of a pala of gold. / Then, upon a pot filled with milk, one should place a golden lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkarṇikāgataṃ devaṃ śaktivṛndasamanvitam ..
pūjayedvidhivatpaścādgurumaṃtrapracoditaḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
तत्कर्णिकागतं देवं शक्तिवृन्दसमन्वितम् ..
पूजयेद्विधिवत्पश्चाद्गुरुमंत्रप्रचोदितः .. 39 ..
text_mt: Upon the deity seated on its pericarp, accompanied by the host of śaktis, / one should afterward worship according to rule, inspired by the guru's mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhaśuklāṃbaradharo maṃtrasaṃbhārasaṃsthitaḥ ..
devakṣīrasamudre'sminvṛtte candre ca puṣkare ..
tatra tvaṃ satyayā sārddhaṃ satyeśa bhava sannidhau .. 4.146.40 ..
meaning:
शुद्धशुक्लांबरधरो मंत्रसंभारसंस्थितः ..
देवक्षीरसमुद्रेऽस्मिन्वृत्ते चन्द्रे च पुष्करे ..
तत्र त्वं सत्यया सार्द्धं सत्येश भव सन्निधौ .. 4.146.40 ..
text_mt: "Wearing pure white garments, present with all the materials of worship, / in this divine ocean of milk, in the circle, the moon, and the lotus, / there be present, O Lord of truth, together with Satyā!

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ kṣīrasāgarakallole snāhi pāpaniṣūdana ..
anena bhūtabhavyena dattena jalabindunā .. 41 ..
meaning:
ओं क्षीरसागरकल्लोले स्नाहि पापनिषूदन ..
अनेन भूतभव्येन दत्तेन जलबिन्दुना .. 41 ..
text_mt: Oṃ! Bathe in the waves of the milk ocean, O destroyer of sins! / By this drop of water, representing past and future, offered [to you],

sanskrit_iast:
harasva sarvaṃ duritaṃ mama nātha janārdana ..
vastradānena śubhreṇa satyeśa kuru me śubham .. 42 ..
meaning:
हरस्व सर्वं दुरितं मम नाथ जनार्दन ..
वस्त्रदानेन शुभ्रेण सत्येश कुरु मे शुभम् .. 42 ..
text_mt: take away all my misfortune, O Lord Janārdana! / By the gift of a white garment, O Lord of truth, grant me good fortune!

sanskrit_iast:
yajñe yoge tathā sāṃkhye pavitrastvaṃ sadocyase ..
yajñopavītadānena kuru māṃ sarvapāvanam .. 43 ..
meaning:
यज्ञे योगे तथा सांख्ये पवित्रस्त्वं सदोच्यसे ..
यज्ञोपवीतदानेन कुरु मां सर्वपावनम् .. 43 ..
text_mt: In sacrifice, in Yoga, and likewise in Sāṃkhya, you are always called the purifier; / by the gift of a sacred thread, make me completely pure!

sanskrit_iast:
viliptaṃ karmaṇā sarvaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ na kenacit ..
mama candanaliptāṃgaḥ sarvalepāpaho bhava .. 44 ..
meaning:
विलिप्तं कर्मणा सर्वं सत्यं सत्यं न केनचित् ..
मम चन्दनलिप्तांगः सर्वलेपापहो भव .. 44 ..
text_mt: Everything is smeared by action; truth, truth is smeared by nothing! / With limbs smeared with sandalwood paste for me, remove all defilements from me!

sanskrit_iast:
satyanātha namastubhyaṃ mūrtāmūrtasvarūpiṇe ..
vāsudeva nṛsiṃhākhya kapilādivyabhūdhara .. 45 ..
meaning:
सत्यनाथ नमस्तुभ्यं मूर्तामूर्तस्वरूपिणे ..
वासुदेव नृसिंहाख्य कपिलादिव्यभूधर .. 45 ..
text_mt: O Lord of truth, praise to you whose nature is both manifest and unmanifest! / O Vāsudeva, named Nṛsiṃha, O divine bearer of the earth beginning with Kapila,

sanskrit_iast:
vārāhācyuta yajñeśa lakṣmīkāṃta nṛpeśvara ..
paśuṃ putraṃ ca me dehi pāpaśatro niraṃjana .. 46 ..
meaning:
वाराहाच्युत यज्ञेश लक्ष्मीकांत नृपेश्वर ..
पशुं पुत्रं च मे देहि पापशत्रो निरंजन .. 46 ..
text_mt: O Boar, O Acyuta, O Lord of sacrifice, O beloved of Lakṣmī, O King of kings, / grant me cattle and a son, O enemy of sin, O stainless one!

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkarṣaṇa mahāvīrya sarveśāmitavikrama ..
aniruddhendra govinda dhṛtacakra namo'stu te .. 47 .. (iti pūjāmaṃtraḥ)
meaning:
संकर्षण महावीर्य सर्वेशामितविक्रम ..
अनिरुद्धेन्द्र गोविन्द धृतचक्र नमोऽस्तु ते .. 47 .. (इति पूजामंत्रः)
text_mt: O Saṃkarṣaṇa of great valour, O Lord of all, of boundless might, / O Aniruddha, O Indra, O Govinda, bearer of the discus, praise to you!" (Thus the worship mantra)

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa prabho rāmarāma kṛṣṇa vibho hare ..
trāhi māṃ sarvaduḥkhebhyo ramayā saha mādhava .. 48 ..
meaning:
कृष्णकृष्ण प्रभो रामराम कृष्ण विभो हरे ..
त्राहि मां सर्वदुःखेभ्यो रमया सह माधव .. 48 ..
text_mt: "O Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, O Lord! O Rāma, Rāma, Kṛṣṇa, O all-pervading Hari! / Protect me from all sufferings together with Ramā, O Mādhava!

sanskrit_iast:
pūjā ceyaṃ mayā dattā pitāmahajagadguro ..
gṛhāṇa jagadīśāna nārāyaṇa namo'stu te .. 49 ..
meaning:
पूजा चेयं मया दत्ता पितामहजगद्गुरो ..
गृहाण जगदीशान नारायण नमोऽस्तु ते .. 49 ..
text_mt: And this worship has been offered by me, O Grandfather, O Teacher of the world! / Accept it, O Ruler of the universe, O Nārāyaṇa, praise to you!"

sanskrit_iast:
dhanaṃ guptaṃ mahīpāla sarvapāpāpanuttaye ..
ekasyaiva tu viprasya yāvadvarṣaṃ samarpayet .. 4.146.50 ..
meaning:
धनं गुप्तं महीपाल सर्वपापापनुत्तये ..
एकस्यैव तु विप्रस्य यावद्वर्षं समर्पयेत् .. 4.146.50 ..
text_mt: For the removal of all sins, O protector of the earth, / one should bestow secret wealth on a single brāhmaṇa for as long as a year.

sanskrit_iast:
dānaṃ dadyānmahārāja hyaśaktau tadabhāvataḥ ..
pakṣepakṣe prakartavyaṃ vratametanmahattaram .. 51 ..
meaning:
दानं दद्यान्महाराज ह्यशक्तौ तदभावतः ..
पक्षेपक्षे प्रकर्तव्यं व्रतमेतन्महत्तरम् .. 51 ..
text_mt: One should give a gift, O great king, or in case of inability, in the absence of that, / this most eminent votive observance is to be performed fortnight after fortnight.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsare tataḥ pūrṇe kuryādudyāpanaṃ budhaḥ ..
pūrvavatpūjayedevaṃ bahusaṃbhāravi staraiḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
संवत्सरे ततः पूर्णे कुर्यादुद्यापनं बुधः ..
पूर्ववत्पूजयेदेवं बहुसंभारवि स्तरैः .. 52 ..
text_mt: Then, when a year has elapsed, the wise person should perform the concluding rite. / One should worship as before, with extensive and plentiful provisions.

sanskrit_iast:
anujñāṃ prārthayedviprānpāpaghvaṃso mamāstu vai ..
pāpadhvaṃso'stu satataṃ taveti ca dvijo vadet .. 53 ..
meaning:
अनुज्ञां प्रार्थयेद्विप्रान्पापघ्वंसो ममास्तु वै ..
पापध्वंसोऽस्तु सततं तवेति च द्विजो वदेत् .. 53 ..
text_mt: One should pray to the brāhmaṇas for permission: "May my sins indeed be destroyed!" / And the twice-born should say: "May your sins be destroyed forever!"

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sarvaṃ brāhmaṇāya samarpya ca kṣamāpayet ..
asminvrate kṛte rājanbhavedbahuphalodayaḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
ततः सर्वं ब्राह्मणाय समर्प्य च क्षमापयेत् ..
अस्मिन्व्रते कृते राजन्भवेद्बहुफलोदयः .. 54 ..
text_mt: Then, presenting everything to the brāhmaṇa, one should ask for his forgiveness. / When this votive observance is performed, O king, there arises an abundance of fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
yatphalaṃ sarvavedeṣu sarvatīrtheṣu yatphalam ..
tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ vratasyāsya niṣevaṇāt .. 55 ..
meaning:
यत्फलं सर्ववेदेषु सर्वतीर्थेषु यत्फलम् ..
तत्फलं कोटिगुणितं व्रतस्यास्य निषेवणात् .. 55 ..
text_mt: Whatever fruit is found in all the Vedas, whatever fruit is in all sacred bathing places, / that fruit is multiplied ten million times through the practice of this votive observance.

sanskrit_iast:
ihaloke dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ putramitrasukhādikam ..
prāpnoti puruṣaḥ samyagvidyārogyakalāyudham .. 56 ..
meaning:
इहलोके धनं धान्यं पुत्रमित्रसुखादिकम् ..
प्राप्नोति पुरुषः सम्यग्विद्यारोग्यकलायुधम् .. 56 ..
text_mt: In this world, a man attains wealth, grain, sons, friends, happiness, and other blessings, / along with learning, health, arts, and longevity.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmamatha ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca nṛpasattama ..
labhate nātra saṃdeho brahmaṇo vacanaṃ yathā .. 57 ..
meaning:
धर्ममथ च कामं च मोक्षं च नृपसत्तम ..
लभते नात्र संदेहो ब्रह्मणो वचनं यथा .. 57 ..
text_mt: Dharma, artha, kāma, and liberation, O best of kings, / he obtains without any doubt, in accordance with the word of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ..
yaḥ kuryātpunaretaddhi so'nantaphalabhāgbhavet .. 58 ..
meaning:
यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ..
यः कुर्यात्पुनरेतद्धि सोऽनन्तफलभाग्भवेत् .. 58 ..
text_mt: Whoever recites or even listens to it is freed from all sins; / and whoever actually performs it comes to share in an endless reward.

sanskrit_iast:
aśaktastu tathā śakto vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ..
vrataṃ kurvannaro bhaktyā labhate śāśvataṃ padam .. 59 ..
meaning:
अशक्तस्तु तथा शक्तो वित्तशाठ्यविवर्जितः ..
व्रतं कुर्वन्नरो भक्त्या लभते शाश्वतं पदम् .. 59 ..
text_mt: Whether unable or able, free from deceit regarding wealth, / a man performing this votive observance with devotion attains the eternal abode.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛte vai kriyamāṇe tu kartā phalamavāpnuyāt ..
aparādhaśatāghaughaṃ vratenānena nāśayet .. 4.146.60 ..
kāñcanavratavarṇanam
meaning:
कृते वै क्रियमाणे तु कर्ता फलमवाप्नुयात् ..
अपराधशताघौघं व्रतेनानेन नाशयेत् .. 4.146.60 ..
काञ्चनव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Whether it has been performed or is being performed, the doer attains the reward; / he destroys a multitude of sins consisting of hundreds of offences by means of this votive observance.
Description of the Golden Votive Observance

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śvetadvīpe sukhāsīnaṃ devadevaṃ jagatprabhum ..
vāsudevaṃ jagannāthaṃ sthitisaṃyamakārakam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
श्वेतद्वीपे सुखासीनं देवदेवं जगत्प्रभुम् ..
वासुदेवं जगन्नाथं स्थितिसंयमकारकम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / To the god of gods, the lord of the universe, comfortably seated in Śvetadvīpa, / Vāsudeva, master of the universe, who causes maintenance and dissolution,
title: Kāṃcanapurīvratavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
parāvarāṇāṃ sraṣṭāraṃ purāṇaṃ paramavyayam ..
ādidevaṃ jagannāthaṃ jagataḥ kāraṇātma kam.. 2 ..
meaning:
परावराणां स्रष्टारं पुराणं परमव्ययम् ..
आदिदेवं जगन्नाथं जगतः कारणात्म कम्.. 2 ..
text_mt: the creator of higher and lower beings, ancient, supreme, imperishable, / the primordial god, master of the universe, the material cause of the world,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇipatya mahādevaṃ carācaraguruṃ harim ..
lakṣmīḥ provāca rājendra pādasaṃvāhane sthitā .. 3 ..
meaning:
प्रणिपत्य महादेवं चराचरगुरुं हरिम् ..
लक्ष्मीः प्रोवाच राजेन्द्र पादसंवाहने स्थिता .. 3 ..
text_mt: having bowed down to the great god Hari, the teacher of the moving and unmoving, / Lakṣmī, engaged in massaging his feet, said, O lord of kings:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavandevadeveśa bhaktānāmanukampaka ..
praṣṭavyaṃ kiñcidicchāmi praṣṭuṃ praśnavidāṃ vara .. 4 ..
meaning:
भगवन्देवदेवेश भक्तानामनुकम्पक ..
प्रष्टव्यं किञ्चिदिच्छामि प्रष्टुं प्रश्नविदां वर .. 4 ..
text_mt: "O Lord, ruler of the gods, compassionate toward your devotees, / there is something I wish to ask, O best of those who know how to answer questions.

sanskrit_iast:
prakuruṣva mahābhāga dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari ..
vrataṃ kiñcitkathaya me rūpasaubhāgyadāyakam .. 5 ..
meaning:
प्रकुरुष्व महाभाग दयां कृत्वा ममोपरि ..
व्रतं किञ्चित्कथय मे रूपसौभाग्यदायकम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Show mercy upon me, O fortunate one, / and tell me of a votive observance that bestows beauty and good fortune,

sanskrit_iast:
uttamaṃ sarvavarṇānāṃ vratānāmapi cottamam..
kṛtena yena deveśa sarvatīrthaphalaṃ bhavet .. 6 ..
meaning:
उत्तमं सर्ववर्णानां व्रतानामपि चोत्तमम्..
कृतेन येन देवेश सर्वतीर्थफलं भवेत् .. 6 ..
text_mt: the highest among all castes, and also the highest among votive observances, / by the performance of which, O Lord of gods, the fruit of all sacred bathing places is attained."

sanskrit_iast:
.. viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
gṛhasthaścāśramāṇāṃ ca varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo yathā ..
yathā nadīṣu sarvāsu jāhnavī lokaviśrutā .. 7 ..
meaning:
.. विष्णुरुवाच .. ..
गृहस्थश्चाश्रमाणां च वर्णानां ब्राह्मणो यथा ..
यथा नदीषु सर्वासु जाह्नवी लोकविश्रुता .. 7 ..
text_mt: Viṣṇu said: / "Just as the householder is [highest] among the stages of life, and the brāhmaṇa among castes, / just as among all rivers the Ganges is renowned throughout the world,

sanskrit_iast:
hradānāmudadhiḥ śreṣṭho devānāṃ viṣṇuruttamaḥ ..
strīṇāṃ devā yathā lakṣmīstathedaṃ vratamuttamam.. 8 ..
meaning:
ह्रदानामुदधिः श्रेष्ठो देवानां विष्णुरुत्तमः ..
स्त्रीणां देवा यथा लक्ष्मीस्तथेदं व्रतमुत्तमम्.. 8 ..
text_mt: just as the ocean is best among reservoirs of water, and Viṣṇu is supreme among gods, / just as you, Lakṣmī, are divine among women, so this votive observance is supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
na gaṅgā na kurukṣetraṃ na kāśī na ca puṣkaram ..
pāvanāni mahābhāge yathedaṃ vratamuttamam .. 9 ..
meaning:
न गङ्गा न कुरुक्षेत्रं न काशी न च पुष्करम् ..
पावनानि महाभागे यथेदं व्रतमुत्तमम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Neither the Gaṅgā, nor Kurukṣetra, nor Kāśī, nor Puṣkara / are as purifying, O fortunate one, as this supreme votive observance.

sanskrit_iast:
gauryā devyā kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ śaṃkareṇa mahātmanā ..
rāmeṇa sītayā sārddhaṃ rājyaṃ prāpya kṛtaṃ purā .. 4.147.10 ..
meaning:
गौर्या देव्या कृतं पूर्वं शंकरेण महात्मना ..
रामेण सीतया सार्द्धं राज्यं प्राप्य कृतं पुरा .. 4.147.10 ..
text_mt: It was performed of old by Goddess Gaurī, and by the high-souled Śaṅkara; / it was performed formerly by Rāma together with Sītā when he attained kingship;

sanskrit_iast:
damayantīviyogena nalena tu tathā kṛtam ..
kṛṣṇayā sahitaiḥ pārtha pāṃḍavairvana vāsibhiḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
दमयन्तीवियोगेन नलेन तु तथा कृतम् ..
कृष्णया सहितैः पार्थ पांडवैर्वन वासिभिः .. 11 ..
text_mt: and it was likewise performed by Nala when separated from Damayantī; / by the Pāṇḍavas residing in the forest, accompanied by Draupadī, O Pārtha,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtametadvrataṃ bhadre svargamokṣapradāyakam ..
raṃbhayā menayā vāpi paulomyā satyabhāmayā .. 12 ..
meaning:
कृतमेतद्व्रतं भद्रे स्वर्गमोक्षप्रदायकम् ..
रंभया मेनया वापि पौलोम्या सत्यभामया .. 12 ..
text_mt: this auspicious votive observance, granting heaven and liberation, was performed; / by Rambhā and Menakā, by Paulomī and Satyabhāmā,

sanskrit_iast:
śāṃḍilyā cāpyarundhatyā urvaśyā devadattayā ..
kṛtaṃ vratamidaṃ bhadraṃ saubhāgyasukhakāmyayā .. 13 ..
meaning:
शांडिल्या चाप्यरुन्धत्या उर्वश्या देवदत्तया ..
कृतं व्रतमिदं भद्रं सौभाग्यसुखकाम्यया .. 13 ..
text_mt: by Śāṇḍilyā and Arundhatī, by Urvaśī and Devadattā, / this auspicious votive observance was performed with the desire for good fortune and happiness;

sanskrit_iast:
pātāle nāgakanyābhiḥ kṛtametatsuśobhanam ..
gāyatryā ca sarasvatyā sāvitryā brahmabhāryayā .. 14 ..
meaning:
पाताले नागकन्याभिः कृतमेतत्सुशोभनम् ..
गायत्र्या च सरस्वत्या सावित्र्या ब्रह्मभार्यया .. 14 ..
text_mt: it was performed in Pātāla by the serpent maidens, very beautifully; / by Gāyatrī, Sarasvatī, and Sāvitrī the wife of Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
anyābhiḥ sarvanārībhiḥ sarvakāmaphalepsubhiḥ ..
tasmātte'haṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 15 ..
meaning:
अन्याभिः सर्वनारीभिः सर्वकामफलेप्सुभिः ..
तस्मात्तेऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: and by other women, all desiring the fruit of all their wishes. / Therefore I shall declare it to you, destroying all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
vasuprītikaraṃ ramyaṃ vratānāṃ paramaṃ śṛṇu ..
brahmahā mucyate pāpātsurāpo vasuhārakaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
वसुप्रीतिकरं रम्यं व्रतानां परमं शृणु ..
ब्रह्महा मुच्यते पापात्सुरापो वसुहारकः .. 16 ..
text_mt: Pleasing to the Vasus, delightful, supreme among votive observances, listen: / the killer of a brāhmaṇa is freed from sin, the drinker of liquor, the stealer of wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
gurubhāryābhigāmī ca hyeteṣāṃ saṃgamī ca yaḥ ..
mānakūṭaṃ tulākūṭaṃ kanyāvṛttirgavāṃ vratī .. 17 ..
meaning:
गुरुभार्याभिगामी च ह्येतेषां संगमी च यः ..
मानकूटं तुलाकूटं कन्यावृत्तिर्गवां व्रती .. 17 ..
text_mt: he who violates the guru's wife, and whoever associates with these; / one who cheats with measures, cheats with balances, lives off a daughter, or has pledged vows to cattle,

sanskrit_iast:
agamyāgamano yastu māṃsāśī vṛṣalīpatiḥ ..
kuṇḍāgnibhojī yastu syādbhūbhihartā tathaiva ca .. 18 ..
meaning:
अगम्यागमनो यस्तु मांसाशी वृषलीपतिः ..
कुण्डाग्निभोजी यस्तु स्याद्भूभिहर्ता तथैव च .. 18 ..
text_mt: one who approaches women not to be approached, who eats meat, the husband of a low-caste woman, / one who eats food offered into a sacrificial pit, and likewise a stealer of land—

sanskrit_iast:
ebhiḥ sarvairmahāpāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
ebhiḥ syānnaranārībhiḥ kartavyaṃ vratamuttamam ..19..
meaning:
एभिः सर्वैर्महापापैर्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ..
एभिः स्यान्नरनारीभिः कर्तव्यं व्रतमुत्तमम् ..19..
text_mt: from all these great sins he is freed; there is no doubt of this. / Men and women should perform this excellent votive observance.

sanskrit_iast:
ataste'haṃ vidhiṃ vakṣye vidhānamavadhāraya ..
kāñcanākhyā purī nāma vrataṃ trailokyaviśrutam .. 4.147.20 ..
meaning:
अतस्तेऽहं विधिं वक्ष्ये विधानमवधारय ..
काञ्चनाख्या पुरी नाम व्रतं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् .. 4.147.20 ..
text_mt: Therefore I shall tell you the rule; listen to the injunction: / the votive observance named 'The Golden City' is famous throughout the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ karoti naro devi nārī vā bhaktisaṃyutā ..
tasya putrāśca pautrāśca jāyate vipulaṃ dhanam .. 21 ..
meaning:
यः करोति नरो देवि नारी वा भक्तिसंयुता ..
तस्य पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च जायते विपुलं धनम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: Whichever man, O goddess, or woman endowed with devotion performs it, / to him sons and grandsons are born, and vast wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminmāse ca kartavyaṃ vratametacca sundari ..
tasminmāse ca kartavyā kāñcanākhyā purī śubhā .. 22 ..
meaning:
तस्मिन्मासे च कर्तव्यं व्रतमेतच्च सुन्दरि ..
तस्मिन्मासे च कर्तव्या काञ्चनाख्या पुरी शुभा .. 22 ..
text_mt: In that month this votive observance is to be performed, O beautiful lady; / in that month the auspicious Golden City is to be prepared.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklakṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāmekādaśyāṃ ca pūrṇimā ..
saṃkrāṃtirvā mahābhāge kuhūrvā cāṣṭamī tithiḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
शुक्लकृष्णतृतीयायामेकादश्यां च पूर्णिमा ..
संक्रांतिर्वा महाभागे कुहूर्वा चाष्टमी तिथिः .. 23 ..
text_mt: On the third lunar day of the bright or dark fortnight, on the eleventh, on the full moon, / on a solar transition, O fortunate one, on the new moon, or on the aṣṭamī lunar day,

sanskrit_iast:
parvasvanyeṣu sarveṣu dātavyā kāñcanī purī ..
vratī snātvā tu pūrvāhṇe nadyādau vimale jale .. 24 ..
meaning:
पर्वस्वन्येषु सर्वेषु दातव्या काञ्चनी पुरी ..
व्रती स्नात्वा तु पूर्वाह्णे नद्यादौ विमले जले .. 24 ..
text_mt: on all other festive occasions, the Golden City should be given. / Having bathed in the morning in the clear water of a river or similar watercourse, the performer of the votive observance

sanskrit_iast:
mṛttikālaṃbhanaṃ kāryaṃ maṃtreṇānena suvrate ..
uddhṛtāsi yathāpūrvaṃ viṣṇunā kroḍarūpiṇā ..25..
meaning:
मृत्तिकालंभनं कार्यं मंत्रेणानेन सुव्रते ..
उद्धृतासि यथापूर्वं विष्णुना क्रोडरूपिणा ..25..
text_mt: should perform the touching of clay with this mantra, O lady of good vows: / 'As you were previously lifted up by Viṣṇu in the form of a boar,

sanskrit_iast:
lokānāmupakārārthaṃ vandanātsiddhikāmadā ..
tasmāttvaṃ vaṃditā pāpaṃ hara me'nekajanmajam .. 26 .. ( iti mṛttikāmaṃtraḥ ..) ..
meaning:
लोकानामुपकारार्थं वन्दनात्सिद्धिकामदा ..
तस्मात्त्वं वंदिता पापं हर मेऽनेकजन्मजम् .. 26 .. ( इति मृत्तिकामंत्रः ..) ..
text_mt: for the benefit of the worlds, granting desired success through reverence, / therefore, praised by me, remove my sin born of many births.' (Thus the mantra for the clay.)

sanskrit_iast:
āpastu viśvayonirhi viṣṇunā nirmitāḥ svayam ..
sānnidhyaṃ tīrthasahitaṃ kartavyaṃ mama sāṃpratam .. 27 .. ( ityammaṃtraḥ ..) ..
meaning:
आपस्तु विश्वयोनिर्हि विष्णुना निर्मिताः स्वयम् ..
सान्निध्यं तीर्थसहितं कर्तव्यं मम सांप्रतम् .. 27 .. ( इत्यम्मंत्रः ..) ..
text_mt: 'The waters are indeed the source of the universe, created by Viṣṇu himself; / their presence together with the sacred fords must now be brought about for me.' (Thus the mantra for the water.)

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā snātvā yajamānaḥ samāhitaḥ ..
gṛhamāgamya śuddhātmā nālapanpiśunāṃstva rāt .. 28 ..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना स्नात्वा यजमानः समाहितः ..
गृहमागम्य शुद्धात्मा नालपन्पिशुनांस्त्व रात् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Having bathed according to this rule, composed, / having returned home, pure-minded, not speaking in haste to malicious persons,

sanskrit_iast:
pākhaṃḍino vikarmasthāndhūrtāṃśca kitavācchaṭhān ..
prakṣālya pāṇivadanaṃ kuryāttvācamanaṃ tataḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
पाखंडिनो विकर्मस्थान्धूर्तांश्च कितवाच्छठान् ..
प्रक्षाल्य पाणिवदनं कुर्यात्त्वाचमनं ततः .. 29 ..
text_mt: heretics, those engaging in unlawful acts, rogues, gamblers, and cheats, / having washed his hands and face, he should then perform the sipping of water.

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsasya niyamaṃ kuryānnaktasya vā punaḥ ..
śaṃkhapravaramādāya hemayuktaṃ jalairbhṛtam .. 4.147.30 ..
meaning:
उपवासस्य नियमं कुर्यान्नक्तस्य वा पुनः ..
शंखप्रवरमादाय हेमयुक्तं जलैर्भृतम् .. 4.147.30 ..
text_mt: He should undertake the restriction of fasting, or else of a nocturnal meal. / Taking an excellent conch containing gold and filled with water,

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśākṣaramaṃtreṇa tajjalaṃ cābhimaṃtrayet ..
pibetto'yaṃ gṛhe gatvā harirityakṣaraṃ japet .. 31 ..
meaning:
द्वादशाक्षरमंत्रेण तज्जलं चाभिमंत्रयेत् ..
पिबेत्तोऽयं गृहे गत्वा हरिरित्यक्षरं जपेत् .. 31 ..
text_mt: he should consecrate that water with the twelve-syllable mantra. / Having gone into the house, he should drink the water and repeat the syllable 'Hari'.

sanskrit_iast:
śamīvṛkṣamayā vedī catuḥstaṃbhasamanvitā ..
caturhastapramāṇena kāryyā caiva suśobhanā .. 32 ..
meaning:
शमीवृक्षमया वेदी चतुःस्तंभसमन्विता ..
चतुर्हस्तप्रमाणेन कार्य्या चैव सुशोभना .. 32 ..
text_mt: An altar made of the wood of the śamī tree, equipped with four pillars, / measuring four cubits, very beautiful, should be made.

sanskrit_iast:
vastreṇāveṣṭitāḥ stambhā vitānavara maṇḍitāḥ ..
puṣpamālānvitāḥ kāryā divyadhūpādhivāsitāḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
वस्त्रेणावेष्टिताः स्तम्भा वितानवर मण्डिताः ..
पुष्पमालान्विताः कार्या दिव्यधूपाधिवासिताः .. 33 ..
text_mt: The pillars should be wrapped in cloth, adorned with an excellent canopy, / provided with flower garlands, and perfumed with divine incense.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye tu maṃḍalaṃ kāryaṃ padmākhyaṃ varṇakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
yena dṛṣṭena deveśi sarvapāpa kṣayo bhavet ..
maṃḍalasya tu madhye vai bhadrapīṭhaṃ suśobhanam .. 34 ..
meaning:
मध्ये तु मंडलं कार्यं पद्माख्यं वर्णकैः शुभैः ..
येन दृष्टेन देवेशि सर्वपाप क्षयो भवेत् ..
मंडलस्य तु मध्ये वै भद्रपीठं सुशोभनम् .. 34 ..
text_mt: In the middle, a maṇḍala called the lotus should be made with auspicious pigments, / upon seeing which, O ruler of gods, all sins are destroyed. / In the middle of the maṇḍala, an auspicious seat of honour,

sanskrit_iast:
āsanaṃ tatra vinyasya komalaṃ vastraveṣṭitam ..
tasyopari nyaseddevaṃ lakṣmyā yuktaṃ janārdanam .. 35 ..
meaning:
आसनं तत्र विन्यस्य कोमलं वस्त्रवेष्टितम् ..
तस्योपरि न्यसेद्देवं लक्ष्म्या युक्तं जनार्दनम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: a soft seat wrapped in cloth, should be placed there. / Upon it he should place the god Janārdana accompanied by Lakṣmī.

sanskrit_iast:
agre tu kalaśaḥ kāryo jalapūrṇaḥ suśobhanaḥ ..
kṣīrasāgaranāmā sa kalpitavyaḥ prayatnataḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
अग्रे तु कलशः कार्यो जलपूर्णः सुशोभनः ..
क्षीरसागरनामा स कल्पितव्यः प्रयत्नतः .. 36 ..
text_mt: In front, a very beautiful jar filled with water should be prepared; / it should be carefully conceived as bearing the name of the Ocean of Milk.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ vastreṇāve ṣṭayeddhanam ..
kumbhaṃ prapūrṇamudakaistasyopari nyasedbudhaḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
पञ्चरत्नसमायुक्तं वस्त्रेणावे ष्टयेद्धनम् ..
कुम्भं प्रपूर्णमुदकैस्तस्योपरि न्यसेद्बुधः .. 37 ..
text_mt: Equipped with the five gems, he should wrap the precious object with cloth; / the wise person should place a pot filled with water upon it.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyopariṣṭātsaṃsthāpya kāṃcanākhyāṃ purīṃ śubhām..
catuṣpalā hyuttamā syāddvipalā madhyamā smṛtā .. 38 ..
meaning:
तस्योपरिष्टात्संस्थाप्य कांचनाख्यां पुरीं शुभाम्..
चतुष्पला ह्युत्तमा स्याद्द्विपला मध्यमा स्मृता .. 38 ..
text_mt: Having established upon it the auspicious Golden City— / four palas in weight is excellent, two palas is considered middling,

sanskrit_iast:
sāmānyaikapalā kāryā kalaśaistu samanvitā ..
modakānsthāpayeddivyānsamaṃtātsuṃdarākṛtīn .. 39 ..
meaning:
सामान्यैकपला कार्या कलशैस्तु समन्विता ..
मोदकान्स्थापयेद्दिव्यान्समंतात्सुंदराकृतीन् .. 39 ..
text_mt: the ordinary one should be made of one pala—furnished with jars, / he should place divine modakas of beautiful shape all around.

sanskrit_iast:
tadagre kadalīstambhaistoraṇaṃ parikalpayet ..
cātuścaraṇikāṃstatra viprānāvāhya suṃdari .. 4.147.40 ..
meaning:
तदग्रे कदलीस्तम्भैस्तोरणं परिकल्पयेत् ..
चातुश्चरणिकांस्तत्र विप्रानावाह्य सुंदरि .. 4.147.40 ..
text_mt: In front of it, he should construct an archway with banana trunks. / Having invited there Brahmins learned in the four branches of the Veda, O beautiful lady,

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayettasya vedamantraiḥ suśobhanaiḥ ..
tasyā madhye nyasedviṣṇuṃ haimaṃ lakṣmyā samanvitam .. 41 ..
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठां कारयेत्तस्य वेदमन्त्रैः सुशोभनैः ..
तस्या मध्ये न्यसेद्विष्णुं हैमं लक्ष्म्या समन्वितम् .. 41 ..
text_mt: he should have its consecration performed with auspicious Vedic mantras. / In its centre he should place a golden Viṣṇu accompanied by Lakṣmī.

sanskrit_iast:
netre ratnamaye kārye daśanā vajrabhūṣitāḥ ..
muktāphalamayaṃ tasya bhūṣaṇaṃ parikalpayet .. 42 ..
meaning:
नेत्रे रत्नमये कार्ये दशना वज्रभूषिताः ..
मुक्ताफलमयं तस्य भूषणं परिकल्पयेत् .. 42 ..
text_mt: The two eyes should be made of jewels; the teeth adorned with diamonds; / his ornaments should be made of pearls.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃgaṃ svarṇamayaṃ kāryaṃ śaṃkhacakragadāyudham ..
pañcāmṛtena deveśaṃ snāpya nārāyaṇaṃ vibhum .. 43 ..
meaning:
अंगं स्वर्णमयं कार्यं शंखचक्रगदायुधम् ..
पञ्चामृतेन देवेशं स्नाप्य नारायणं विभुम् .. 43 ..
text_mt: The body should be made of gold, wielding the conch, discus, and mace. / Having bathed the all-pervading lord of gods, Nārāyaṇa, with the five nectars,

sanskrit_iast:
tameva gaṃdhapuṣpādyairmaṃtramuccārya pūjayet ..
brāhmaṇo vaidikairmantraiḥ pūjayenmadhusūdanam .. 44 ..
meaning:
तमेव गंधपुष्पाद्यैर्मंत्रमुच्चार्य पूजयेत् ..
ब्राह्मणो वैदिकैर्मन्त्रैः पूजयेन्मधुसूदनम् .. 44 ..
text_mt: he should worship him alone with scents, flowers, and the like, reciting the mantra. / A Brahmin should worship Madhusūdana with Vedic mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣā varṇāḥ purāṇoktaistāñchṛṇuṣva mama priye ..
vāsudevāya pādau tu gulphau saṃkarṣaṇāya ca .. 45 ..
meaning:
शेषा वर्णाः पुराणोक्तैस्ताञ्छृणुष्व मम प्रिये ..
वासुदेवाय पादौ तु गुल्फौ संकर्षणाय च .. 45 ..
text_mt: The remaining castes [should worship] with mantras spoken in the Purāṇas; hear them, my beloved: / 'To Vāsudeva' for the feet, and 'To Saṃkarṣaṇa' for the ankles;

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyajanakāyeti jānunī pūjayeddhareḥ ..
trailokyanāthāya guhye jñānamayāya vai kaṭim .. 46 ..
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यजनकायेति जानुनी पूजयेद्धरेः ..
त्रैलोक्यनाथाय गुह्ये ज्ञानमयाय वै कटिम् .. 46 ..
text_mt: saying 'To the Generator of the Three Worlds', he should worship Hari's two knees; / 'To the Lord of the Three Worlds' for the private parts; 'To the Embodiment of Knowledge' for the waist;

sanskrit_iast:
dāmodarāyetyudaraṃ hṛdayaṃ viśvarūpiṇe ..
nityaṃ hi pūjayeddevi uraḥ śrīvatsadhāriṇe .. 47 ..
meaning:
दामोदरायेत्युदरं हृदयं विश्वरूपिणे ..
नित्यं हि पूजयेद्देवि उरः श्रीवत्सधारिणे .. 47 ..
text_mt: 'To Dāmodara' for the belly; 'To the Universal-Formed' for the heart; / O goddess, he should always worship the chest saying 'To the Bearer of the Śrīvatsa';

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇṭhaṃ kaustubhanāthāya āsyaṃ yajñamukhāya ca ..
daityāṃtakāriṇe bāhū svairnāmairāyudhāni ca .. 48 ..
meaning:
कण्ठं कौस्तुभनाथाय आस्यं यज्ञमुखाय च ..
दैत्यांतकारिणे बाहू स्वैर्नामैरायुधानि च .. 48 ..
text_mt: the throat 'To the Lord of the Kaustubha'; the mouth 'To the Mouth of the Sacrifice'; / the arms 'To the Slayer of Daityas', and the weapons with their own names;

sanskrit_iast:
śiraḥ sarvātmane devi devadevasya pūjayet ..
śriyaṃ prapūjayeddevīṃ devyā maṃtraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
शिरः सर्वात्मने देवि देवदेवस्य पूजयेत् ..
श्रियं प्रपूजयेद्देवीं देव्या मंत्रैः पृथग्विधैः .. 49 ..
text_mt: the head 'To the Self of All', O goddess, of the god of gods he should worship. / He should worship the goddess Śrī with various mantras of the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
indrādilokapālānāṃ pūjā kāryā yathākramam ..
navagrahāṇāṃ homaśca kartavyo vighnanāśanaḥ ..4.147.50..
meaning:
इन्द्रादिलोकपालानां पूजा कार्या यथाक्रमम् ..
नवग्रहाणां होमश्च कर्तव्यो विघ्ननाशनः ..4.147.50..
text_mt: The worship of the world protectors, Indra and the rest, should be performed in due order, / and a fire offering to the nine planets should be performed to destroy obstacles.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjā gaṇapateḥ kāryā tathā homo vidhānataḥ ..
agre naivadyamatulaṃ dāpayeddhṛtapācitam .. 51 ..
meaning:
पूजा गणपतेः कार्या तथा होमो विधानतः ..
अग्रे नैवद्यमतुलं दापयेद्धृतपाचितम् .. 51 ..
text_mt: Worship of Gaṇapati should be performed, as well as a fire offering according to rule. / In front, he should present peerless food offerings cooked in clarified butter:

sanskrit_iast:
pāyasaṃ ghṛtapūrāṃśca modakānpūrikāstathā ..
sohālikādinaivedyaṃ pheṇikāḥ śarkarāstathā .. 52 ..
meaning:
पायसं घृतपूरांश्च मोदकान्पूरिकास्तथा ..
सोहालिकादिनैवेद्यं फेणिकाः शर्करास्तथा .. 52 ..
text_mt: rice pudding, cakes filled with clarified butter, modakas, and pūrikās, / food offerings such as sohālikās, pheṇikās, and sugars.

sanskrit_iast:
deśakālodbhavānyeva phalāni vinivedayet ..
dīpāndaśa diśo dadyātpārthivānraktavartikān..53..
meaning:
देशकालोद्भवान्येव फलानि विनिवेदयेत् ..
दीपान्दश दिशो दद्यात्पार्थिवान्रक्तवर्तिकान्..53..
text_mt: He should offer fruits produced according to season and place. / He should offer lamps to the ten directions, made of clay and with red wicks.

sanskrit_iast:
etena tu viśālākṣi mūlamantreṇa dāpayet ..
puṣpamālānvitānkṛtvā caṃdanena vibhūṣitān ..54..
meaning:
एतेन तु विशालाक्षि मूलमन्त्रेण दापयेत् ..
पुष्पमालान्वितान्कृत्वा चंदनेन विभूषितान् ..54..
text_mt: With this root mantra, O large-eyed lady, he should make the offering, / having provided them with flower garlands and adorned them with sandalwood paste.

sanskrit_iast:
abhimaṃtrya prayatnena viṣṇustabakavācakaiḥ ..
sahasraśīrṣādibhirmaṃtrairjapadbhirbrāhmaṇottamaiḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
अभिमंत्र्य प्रयत्नेन विष्णुस्तबकवाचकैः ..
सहस्रशीर्षादिभिर्मंत्रैर्जपद्भिर्ब्राह्मणोत्तमैः .. 55 ..
text_mt: Having carefully consecrated it through reciters of praise-clusters to Viṣṇu, / through excellent Brahmins chanting the mantras beginning with 'A Thousand Heads',

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśātha sapatnīkānpūjayecca yathāvidhi ..
bhūṣayecca śubhairvastraistathālaṃkāraṇādibhiḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
षोडशाथ सपत्नीकान्पूजयेच्च यथाविधि ..
भूषयेच्च शुभैर्वस्त्रैस्तथालंकारणादिभिः .. 56 ..
text_mt: he should then worship sixteen [Brahmins] with their wives according to the rule, / and adorn them with auspicious garments and ornaments and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuṃ matvā dvijaḥ pūjyo lakṣmīṃ matvā ca brāhmaṇīm ..
chatraṃ copānahau caiva aṃgulyābharaṇaṃ tathā ..57..
meaning:
विष्णुं मत्वा द्विजः पूज्यो लक्ष्मीं मत्वा च ब्राह्मणीम् ..
छत्रं चोपानहौ चैव अंगुल्याभरणं तथा ..57..
text_mt: Considering him Viṣṇu, the twice-born is to be worshipped, and considering her Lakṣmī, the Brahmin woman: / a royal parasol and shoes, and also a finger-ornament,

sanskrit_iast:
phalāni sapta dhānyāni bhojanaṃ ca yadīpsitam ..
dātavyaṃ ca sabhāryāya kṛṣṇo me prīyatāmiti .. 58 ..
meaning:
फलानि सप्त धान्यानि भोजनं च यदीप्सितम् ..
दातव्यं च सभार्याय कृष्णो मे प्रीयतामिति .. 58 ..
text_mt: fruits, the seven grains, and desired food, / are to be given to him together with his wife, saying: 'May Kṛṣṇa be pleased with me.'

sanskrit_iast:
śayyāṃ sopaskarāṃ caiva vastreṇācchādya yatnataḥ ..
tathā prakalpayedvittaśaktyā ca suṃdarī yathā .. 59 ..
meaning:
शय्यां सोपस्करां चैव वस्त्रेणाच्छाद्य यत्नतः ..
तथा प्रकल्पयेद्वित्तशक्त्या च सुंदरी यथा .. 59 ..
text_mt: A bed furnished with utensils, carefully covered with a cloth, / he should also prepare according to his financial capacity, O beautiful lady.

sanskrit_iast:
vrate pūrṇe ca gaurdeyā sarvopaskarasaṃyutā ..
purīṃ ghaṭāpayetpūrvaṃ vastreṇācchādyayastaḥ ..
yathā kuryātprayāsena yathā kartā na paśyati .. 4.147.60 ..
meaning:
व्रते पूर्णे च गौर्देया सर्वोपस्करसंयुता ..
पुरीं घटापयेत्पूर्वं वस्त्रेणाच्छाद्ययस्तः ..
यथा कुर्यात्प्रयासेन यथा कर्ता न पश्यति .. 4.147.60 ..
text_mt: When the votive observance is completed, a cow equipped with all utensils should be given. / He should previously have the city fashioned, carefully covered with a cloth, / taking care in such a way that the maker does not see it.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpāṃstu dīpitāṃstatra ānayedyajñamaṇḍapam ..
śvetavastreṇa netre tu yajamānasya ca priye..61..
meaning:
दीपांस्तु दीपितांस्तत्र आनयेद्यज्ञमण्डपम् ..
श्वेतवस्त्रेण नेत्रे तु यजमानस्य च प्रिये..61..
text_mt:
He should bring lighted lamps there into the sacrificial pavilion,
and [cover] the eyes of the sacrificer with a white cloth, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutavāñchāstravitprājñaḥ kṛtasarvāghasaṃkṣayaḥ ..
ābadhya netre suprājña ācāryastamidaṃ vadet ..62..
meaning:
श्रुतवाञ्छास्त्रवित्प्राज्ञः कृतसर्वाघसंक्षयः ..
आबध्य नेत्रे सुप्राज्ञ आचार्यस्तमिदं वदेत् ..62..
text_mt:
Learned, versed in scripture, wise, having destroyed all his sins,
the very wise ācārya, having bound his eyes, should say this to him:

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmapradāṃ paśya kāṃcanākhyāṃ purīmimām..
varavastrayutāṃ ramyāṃ duḥkhadaurbhāgyanāśinīm.. 63 ..
meaning:
सर्वकामप्रदां पश्य कांचनाख्यां पुरीमिमाम्..
वरवस्त्रयुतां रम्यां दुःखदौर्भाग्यनाशिनीम्.. 63 ..
text_mt:
"Behold this city named Kāñcanā, which grants all desires,
adorned with excellent clothes, delightful, the destroyer of sorrow and misfortune!"

sanskrit_iast:
evamukto mahābhāga paṭamunmucya netrayoḥ ..
puṣpāñjaliṃ gurau kṣiptvā sa paśyettāṃ purīṃ śubhām..64..
meaning:
एवमुक्तो महाभाग पटमुन्मुच्य नेत्रयोः ..
पुष्पाञ्जलिं गुरौ क्षिप्त्वा स पश्येत्तां पुरीं शुभाम्..64..
text_mt:
Thus addressed, O fortunate one, removing the cloth from his eyes
and casting a handful of flowers to his guru, he should behold that auspicious city.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ nagarīṃ devi yajamānaḥ samāhitaḥ ..
sauvarṇaṃ pātramādāya raupyaṃ tāmramathāpi vā .. 65 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तां नगरीं देवि यजमानः समाहितः ..
सौवर्णं पात्रमादाय रौप्यं ताम्रमथापि वा .. 65 ..
text_mt:
Having beheld that city, O goddess, the sacrificer, composed in mind,
taking a golden vessel, or a silver or copper one,

sanskrit_iast:
atha vā śaṃkhamādāya pātrālābhe tu sundari ..
pañcaratnaṃ kṣipetpātre jalaṃ gāṅgaṃ tathā phalam .. 66 ..
meaning:
अथ वा शंखमादाय पात्रालाभे तु सुन्दरि ..
पञ्चरत्नं क्षिपेत्पात्रे जलं गाङ्गं तथा फलम् .. 66 ..
text_mt:
or taking a conch, O lovely woman, if a vessel cannot be obtained,
should cast into the vessel the five jewels, water of the Gaṅgā, and fruit,

sanskrit_iast:
siddhārthamakṣatāḥ pūrvaṃ rocanā dadhi vā punaḥ ..
tataścārdhyaṃ pradātavyaṃ kṛṣṇāya prabhaviṣṇave .. 67 ..
meaning:
सिद्धार्थमक्षताः पूर्वं रोचना दधि वा पुनः ..
ततश्चार्ध्यं प्रदातव्यं कृष्णाय प्रभविष्णवे .. 67 ..
text_mt:
white mustard seeds, unhusked barley beforehand, yellow pigment, or curd.
Then arghya should be offered to the all-powerful Kṛṣṇa:

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīnārāyaṇau devau sarvakāmaphalapradau ..
rukmapuryāḥ pradānena yacchaitāṃ vāṃchitaṃ mama .. 68 ..
meaning:
लक्ष्मीनारायणौ देवौ सर्वकामफलप्रदौ ..
रुक्मपुर्याः प्रदानेन यच्छैतां वांछितं मम .. 68 ..
text_mt:
"O deities Lakṣmī and Nārāyaṇa, givers of the fruit of all desires!
By the gift of this city of gold, grant my wish.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa hṛṣīkeśa jñānajñeya niraṃjana..
lakṣmīkāṃta jagannātha gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namostu te..69.. ( ityarghamaṃtraḥ) ..
meaning:
नारायण हृषीकेश ज्ञानज्ञेय निरंजन..
लक्ष्मीकांत जगन्नाथ गृहाणार्घ्यं नमोस्तु ते..69.. ( इत्यर्घमंत्रः) ..
text_mt:
O Nārāyaṇa, Hṛṣīkeśa, known through knowledge, stainless one,
beloved of Lakṣmī, lord of the world, accept this arghya; praise be to you!" (Thus the arghya mantra.)

sanskrit_iast:
evamarghyaṃ tato dattvā viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave..
devyāstvarghyaṃ pradātavyaṃ bhaktiyukte na cetasā..4.147.70..
meaning:
एवमर्घ्यं ततो दत्त्वा विष्णवे प्रभविष्णवे..
देव्यास्त्वर्घ्यं प्रदातव्यं भक्तियुक्ते न चेतसा..4.147.70..
text_mt:
Having thus offered arghya to the all-powerful Viṣṇu,
arghya should then be given to the goddess with a mind full of devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā maṃtrametamudīrayet ..
brahmaṇā pūjitā devī viṣṇunā śaṃkareṇa ca ..71..
meaning:
जानुभ्यामवनिं गत्वा मंत्रमेतमुदीरयेत् ..
ब्रह्मणा पूजिता देवी विष्णुना शंकरेण च ..71..
text_mt:
Going down on his knees to the earth, he should utter this mantra:
"The goddess worshipped by Brahmā, by Viṣṇu, and by Śaṅkara,

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyā pūjitā lakṣmīḥ skaṃdavaiśravaṇena ca..
mayā ca pūjitā devi dharmasya vijigīṣayā ..72..
meaning:
पार्वत्या पूजिता लक्ष्मीः स्कंदवैश्रवणेन च..
मया च पूजिता देवि धर्मस्य विजिगीषया ..72..
text_mt:
Lakṣmī worshipped by Pārvatī, by Skanda and by Vaiśravaṇa,
and worshipped by me, O goddess, through the desire to conquer for dharma:

sanskrit_iast:
saubhāgyaṃ dehi me putrāndhanaṃ pautrāṃśca pūjitān ..
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ devi saukhyaṃ prayaccha me ..73..
meaning:
सौभाग्यं देहि मे पुत्रान्धनं पौत्रांश्च पूजितान् ..
गृहाणार्घ्यं मया दत्तं देवि सौख्यं प्रयच्छ मे ..73..
text_mt:
Grant me good fortune, grant me sons, wealth, and revered grandsons!
Accept the arghya given by me, O goddess, and grant me happiness!"

sanskrit_iast:
ya evaṃ purato dattvā pūrvoktavidhinā tava ..
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādbhaktiyuktena cetasā ..74..
meaning:
य एवं पुरतो दत्त्वा पूर्वोक्तविधिना तव ..
रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्याद्भक्तियुक्तेन चेतसा ..74..
text_mt:
He who, having thus made the gift before you according to the aforesaid rule,
keeps vigil at night with a mind filled with devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
gītanṛtyavinodena upākhyānaiśca vaiṣṇavaiḥ..
yena kena vinodena nidrā naiva prajāyate ..75..
meaning:
गीतनृत्यविनोदेन उपाख्यानैश्च वैष्णवैः..
येन केन विनोदेन निद्रा नैव प्रजायते ..75..
text_mt:
with the delight of songs and dances, and with tales of Viṣṇu,
with whatever entertainment so that sleep does not arise at all,

sanskrit_iast:
unnidro jāgṛyādyastu śatayajñaphalaṃ labhet ..
prabhāte vimale snātvā saṃpūjya pitṛdevatāḥ ..76..
meaning:
उन्निद्रो जागृयाद्यस्तु शतयज्ञफलं लभेत् ..
प्रभाते विमले स्नात्वा संपूज्य पितृदेवताः ..76..
text_mt:
whoever, remaining sleepless, keeps vigil, obtains the fruit of a hundred sacrifices.
At clean daybreak, having bathed and worshipped the ancestors and gods,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāṃśca sapatnīkānparidhāpyānubhojayet ..
dakṣiṇāśca yathāśaktyā pradāya ca kṣamāpayet .. 77 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणांश्च सपत्नीकान्परिधाप्यानुभोजयेत् ..
दक्षिणाश्च यथाशक्त्या प्रदाय च क्षमापयेत् .. 77 ..
text_mt:
he should clothe and feed brāhmaṇas together with their wives,
and having given priestly gifts according to his means, he should ask their forgiveness.

sanskrit_iast:
dīnāṃdhabadhirānpaṃgūnsarvāṃstānparitoṣayet ..
paścātpāraṇakaṃ kāryamupavāsī bhavedyadi .. 78 ..
meaning:
दीनांधबधिरान्पंगून्सर्वांस्तान्परितोषयेत् ..
पश्चात्पारणकं कार्यमुपवासी भवेद्यदि .. 78 ..
text_mt:
He should satisfy all the poor, the blind, the deaf, and the lame.
Afterward, if he is fasting, the breaking of the fast must be performed,

sanskrit_iast:
madhuraṃ payasā yuktaṃ suhṛdbhirbāṃdhavaiḥ saha ..
evametadvrataṃ kāryamekādaśyāṃ śucismite .. 79 ..
meaning:
मधुरं पयसा युक्तं सुहृद्भिर्बांधवैः सह ..
एवमेतद्व्रतं कार्यमेकादश्यां शुचिस्मिते .. 79 ..
text_mt:
sweet and accompanied by milk, together with friends and kinsmen.
Thus this vrata should be performed on the ekādaśī, O fair-smiling one,

sanskrit_iast:
śuklāyāmatha kṛṣṇāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ tathā tithau..
saṃkrāṃtivāsare vāpi vyatīpāte ca vaidhṛtau ..4.147.80..
meaning:
शुक्लायामथ कृष्णायां तृतीयायां तथा तिथौ..
संक्रांतिवासरे वापि व्यतीपाते च वैधृतौ ..4.147.80..
text_mt:
in the bright or in the dark [fortnight], or on the tṛtīyā tithi,
or on the day of a saṃkrānti, and at a vyatīpāta or a vaidhṛta,

sanskrit_iast:
yadā vā jāyate vittaṃ cittaṃ ca varavarṇini ..
gaurānīya pradātavyā kṛṣṇo me prīyatāmiti .. 81 ..
meaning:
यदा वा जायते वित्तं चित्तं च वरवर्णिनि ..
गौरानीय प्रदातव्या कृष्णो मे प्रीयतामिति .. 81 ..
text_mt:
or whenever wealth and the intention arise, O fair-complexioned one.
Having brought a cow, it should be given, [saying,] 'May Kṛṣṇa be pleased with me.'

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛte ca yatpuṇyaṃ tanna śakyaṃ niveditum ..
api varṣasahasreṇa kulalakṣaśatairapi .. 82 ..
meaning:
एवं कृते च यत्पुण्यं तन्न शक्यं निवेदितुम् ..
अपि वर्षसहस्रेण कुललक्षशतैरपि .. 82 ..
text_mt:
When this is done, the merit that [accrues] cannot be fully told
even in a thousand years by hundreds of thousands of lineages.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatāni ca..
brahmalokaṃ samāsādya brahmaṇā pratimodyate .. 83 ..
meaning:
कल्पकोटिसहस्राणि कल्पकोटिशतानि च..
ब्रह्मलोकं समासाद्य ब्रह्मणा प्रतिमोद्यते .. 83 ..
text_mt:
For thousands of ten millions of kalpas and hundreds of ten millions of kalpas,
having reached the world of Brahmā, he rejoices with Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmakādrudralokaṃ tatparaṃ viṣṇusaṃnidhau ..
indrādilokapālānāṃ vratī lokamavāpnuyāt .. 84 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मकाद्रुद्रलोकं तत्परं विष्णुसंनिधौ ..
इन्द्रादिलोकपालानां व्रती लोकमवाप्नुयात् .. 84 ..
text_mt:
From Brahmā's [world] to the world of Rudra, and beyond that to the presence of Viṣṇu,
the keeper of the vrata attains the world of the world protectors, Indra and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhuktvā śuciḥ śrīmānbhogāṃstrailokyasuṃdari ..
cakravartī bhavedbhūmau brahmaṇyo vaiṣṇavastathā ..85..
meaning:
ततो भुक्त्वा शुचिः श्रीमान्भोगांस्त्रैलोक्यसुंदरि ..
चक्रवर्ती भवेद्भूमौ ब्रह्मण्यो वैष्णवस्तथा ..85..
text_mt:
Then, having enjoyed pleasures, pure and prosperous, O beauty of the three worlds,
he becomes an emperor on earth, devoted to brāhmaṇas and a devotee of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ vācayamānaṃ samaṃtataḥ ..
kulasaptakamuddhṛtya vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamāpnuyāt ..86..
meaning:
य इदं शृणुयान्नित्यं वाचयमानं समंततः ..
कुलसप्तकमुद्धृत्य वैष्णवं लोकमाप्नुयात् ..86..
text_mt:
Whoever constantly hears this being recited on all sides,
having delivered seven generations of his family, attains the realm of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā kāṃcanapuryākhyaṃ vratametatkṛtaṃ purā ..
tena puṇyena labdho'haṃ bhartā trailokyapūjitaḥ .. 87 ..
kanyāpradānavarṇanam ( atha kanyādānam)
meaning:
त्वया कांचनपुर्याख्यं व्रतमेतत्कृतं पुरा ..
तेन पुण्येन लब्धोऽहं भर्ता त्रैलोक्यपूजितः .. 87 ..
कन्याप्रदानवर्णनम् ( अथ कन्यादानम्)

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
brahmadeyāṃ tu yaḥ kanyāmalaṃkṛtya prayacchati ..
saptapūrvānbhaviṣyāṃśca svakule sapta mānavān..1..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
ब्रह्मदेयां तु यः कन्यामलंकृत्य प्रयच्छति ..
सप्तपूर्वान्भविष्यांश्च स्वकुले सप्त मानवान्..1..
text_mt:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
He who gives away a maiden adorned [in marriage] according to the rite of Brahmā,
seven men before and seven to come in his own family—
title: adhyāyaḥ 148

sanskrit_iast:
tena kanyāpradānena sa tārayatyasaṃśayam ..
lokānāpnoti ca tathā dakṣasyaiva prajāpateḥ..2..
meaning:
तेन कन्याप्रदानेन स तारयत्यसंशयम् ..
लोकानाप्नोति च तथा दक्षस्यैव प्रजापतेः..2..
text_mt:
by that gift of a maiden, he undoubtedly redeems them,
and likewise he attains the worlds of Dakṣa Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast:
prājāpatyena vidhinā ātmānaṃ ca samuddharet..
mahatpuṇyamavāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati ..3..
meaning:
प्राजापत्येन विधिना आत्मानं च समुद्धरेत्..
महत्पुण्यमवाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति ..3..
text_mt:
By the rite of Prajāpati, he redeems himself also;
he attains great merit and goes to the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūgavāśvapradānāni gajadānaṃ tathaiva ca ..
dattvā tu varṇahīnāya ghore tamasi majjati ..4..
meaning:
भूगवाश्वप्रदानानि गजदानं तथैव च ..
दत्त्वा तु वर्णहीनाय घोरे तमसि मज्जति ..4..
text_mt:
Gifts of land, cows, and horses, and likewise the gift of an elephant,
if given to one devoid of caste, he sinks into terrible darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi purīṣaṃ kākamaśnute..
śulkena dattvā kanyāṃ ca ghoraṃ narakamāpnuyāt ..5..
meaning:
बहुवर्षसहस्राणि पुरीषं काकमश्नुते..
शुल्केन दत्त्वा कन्यां च घोरं नरकमाप्नुयात् ..5..
text_mt:
For many thousands of years he eats feces and crows.
And having given a maiden for a bride-price, he attains a terrible hell.

sanskrit_iast:
bahūnyabdasahasrāṇi tathā aśucibhuṅnaraḥ..
savarṇāṃ ca savarṇebhyo dadyātkanyāṃ yathāvidhi ..6..
meaning:
बहून्यब्दसहस्राणि तथा अशुचिभुङ्नरः..
सवर्णां च सवर्णेभ्यो दद्यात्कन्यां यथाविधि ..6..
text_mt:
For many thousands of years the man thus feeds on impurity.
One should give a maiden of the same caste to those of the same caste according to the rule;

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā cādhikavarṇāya dviguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ tathā ..
dvijaputramanāthaṃ vā saṃskuryādyaśca karmabhiḥ ..7..
meaning:
दत्त्वा चाधिकवर्णाय द्विगुणं निर्गुणं तथा ..
द्विजपुत्रमनाथं वा संस्कुर्याद्यश्च कर्मभिः ..7..
text_mt:
and having given [her] to one of higher caste, [he obtains] double [the fruit], but if to one devoid of virtues, [none].
Or he who consecrates a fatherless son of a twice-born with the sacred rites,

sanskrit_iast:
cūḍopanayādyaiśca so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ..
anāthāṃ kanyakāṃ dattvā nākaloke mahīyate .. 8 ..
meaning:
चूडोपनयाद्यैश्च सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् ..
अनाथां कन्यकां दत्त्वा नाकलोके महीयते .. 8 ..
text_mt:
beginning with the tonsure and the sacred thread investiture, obtains the fruit of an aśvamedha.
Having given an orphaned maiden [in marriage], he is honoured in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyayā saha dattaṃ ca suvarṇaṃ vahnimūlakam ..
sakalaṃ dviguṇaṃ tasya phalamuktaṃ purātanaiḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
कन्यया सह दत्तं च सुवर्णं वह्निमूलकम् ..
सकलं द्विगुणं तस्य फलमुक्तं पुरातनैः .. 9 ..
text_mt:
Gold, which has fire for its source, given along with the maiden—
the entire fruit of that is said by the ancients to be twofold.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyādānādavāpnoti dakṣalokaṃ narottama ..
viṣṇupūjāsamaṃ puṇyaṃ tatkanyāpūjayā bhavet .. 4.148.10 ..
meaning:
कन्यादानादवाप्नोति दक्षलोकं नरोत्तम ..
विष्णुपूजासमं पुण्यं तत्कन्यापूजया भवेत् .. 4.148.10 ..
text_mt:
From the gift of a maiden, O best of men, one attains the world of Dakṣa;
merit equal to the worship of Viṣṇu arises from the worship of that maiden.

sanskrit_iast:
vimānamāhṛtya manobhirāmaṃ surāṅganāgītavilāsahṛdyam ..
prāpnoti lokaṃ tridaśottamānāṃ kanyāpradānānna vicāraṇeti .. 11 .. ..
brāhmaṇaśuśrūṣāvidhivarṇanam
meaning:
विमानमाहृत्य मनोभिरामं सुराङ्गनागीतविलासहृद्यम् ..
प्राप्नोति लोकं त्रिदशोत्तमानां कन्याप्रदानान्न विचारणेति .. 11 .. ..
ब्राह्मणशुश्रूषाविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Having obtained a celestial chariot pleasing to the mind, delightful with the songs and play of divine women,
he reaches the world of the foremost among the thirty [gods] through the gift of a maiden; there is no doubt of this.
Description of the Rule for Serving Brāhmaṇas

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca.. ..
brāhmaṇā daivataṃ bhūmau brāhmaṇā divi daivatam ..
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ paraṃ nāsti nāsti bhūtaṃ jagattraye .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच.. ..
ब्राह्मणा दैवतं भूमौ ब्राह्मणा दिवि दैवतम् ..
ब्राह्मणेभ्यः परं नास्ति नास्ति भूतं जगत्त्रये .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Brāhmaṇas are the divinity on earth; brāhmaṇas are the divinity in heaven.
There is nothing higher than brāhmaṇas, no [greater] being in the three worlds.
title: Brāhmaṇaśuśrūṣāvidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
adevaṃ daivataṃ kuryuḥ kuryurdevamadaivatam ..
brāhmaṇā hi mahābhāgāḥ pūjyaṃte satataṃ dvijāḥ ..2..
meaning:
अदेवं दैवतं कुर्युः कुर्युर्देवमदैवतम् ..
ब्राह्मणा हि महाभागाः पूज्यंते सततं द्विजाः ..2..
text_mt:
They can make a non-god into a god; they can make a god into a non-god.
For brāhmaṇas are very fortunate; the twice-born are constantly to be worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samutpannā devāḥ pūrvamiti smṛtiḥ ..
brāhmaṇebhyo jagatsarvaṃ tasmātpūjyatamā dvijāḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणेभ्यः समुत्पन्ना देवाः पूर्वमिति स्मृतिः ..
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो जगत्सर्वं तस्मात्पूज्यतमा द्विजाः .. 3 ..
text_mt: From brāhmaṇas the gods were born in the beginning—so says tradition; / from brāhmaṇas came the entire universe, therefore the twice-born are most worthy of worship.

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣāmaśnaṃti vaktreṇa devatāḥ pitarastathā ..
ṛṣayaśca tathā nāgāḥ kiṃ bhūtamadhikaṃ tataḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
येषामश्नंति वक्त्रेण देवताः पितरस्तथा ..
ऋषयश्च तथा नागाः किं भूतमधिकं ततः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Through whose mouth the deities eat, and likewise the ancestors, / the sages, and likewise the nāgas—what being is greater than them?

sanskrit_iast:
yadaiva manujo bhaktyā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati ..
tadaivāpnoti dharmajña bahujanmani janmani .. 5 ..
meaning:
यदैव मनुजो भक्त्या ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रयच्छति ..
तदैवाप्नोति धर्मज्ञ बहुजन्मनि जन्मनि .. 5 ..
text_mt: Whenever a man gives with devotion to brāhmaṇas, / just then he obtains [his reward], O knower of dharma, in birth after birth across many births.

sanskrit_iast:
tālavṛṃtānilenaiva śrāṃtasaṃvāhanena ca ..
utsādanena gātrāṇāṃ tathā vyaṃjanakarmaṇā .. 6 ..
meaning:
तालवृंतानिलेनैव श्रांतसंवाहनेन च ..
उत्सादनेन गात्राणां तथा व्यंजनकर्मणा .. 6 ..
text_mt: Merely by the breeze of a palm-leaf fan, and by massaging the weary, / by rubbing down the limbs, and likewise by the act of fanning,

sanskrit_iast:
pādaśaucapradānena pādayoḥ secanena ca ..
paricarya yathā kāmamekenaiva dvijottama .. 7 ..
meaning:
पादशौचप्रदानेन पादयोः सेचनेन च ..
परिचर्य यथा काममेकेनैव द्विजोत्तम .. 7 ..
text_mt: by offering foot-washing water, and by pouring water on their feet, / by waiting upon a single excellent twice-born according to his desire,

sanskrit_iast:
aniṣṭvāpi samāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca śāśvatam ..
brāhmaṇānāṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā nākaloke mahīyate .. 8 ..
meaning:
अनिष्ट्वापि समाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च शाश्वतम् ..
ब्राह्मणानां शुभं कृत्वा नाकलोके महीयते .. 8 ..
text_mt: even without performing sacrifices, one attains the eternal heavenly realm; / having brought about the welfare of brāhmaṇas, one is glorified in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
yadbrāhmaṇāstuṣṭimanto vadaṃti pratyakṣadeveṣu parokṣadevāḥ ..
tadvai śubhaṃ tasya narasya nūnaṃ bhavedatastānsatataṃ niṣevet .. 9 ..
vṛṣadānavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
यद्ब्राह्मणास्तुष्टिमन्तो वदंति प्रत्यक्षदेवेषु परोक्षदेवाः ..
तद्वै शुभं तस्य नरस्य नूनं भवेदतस्तान्सततं निषेवेत् .. 9 ..
वृषदानविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Whatever the contented brāhmaṇas—the invisible deities manifested as visible deities—say, / that indeed will surely become auspicious for that person; therefore, one should serve them constantly.
Description of the Rule for the Gift of a Bull

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
yuṣmadvākyāmṛtamidaṃ hyahaṃ śṛṇvañjanārdana..
na tṛptimadhigacchāmi jātaṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
युष्मद्वाक्यामृतमिदं ह्यहं शृण्वञ्जनार्दन..
न तृप्तिमधिगच्छामि जातं कौतूहलं हि मे .. 1 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Listening to this nectar of your words, O Janārdana, / I do not find satisfaction; indeed, curiosity has arisen in me.
title: Vṛṣadānavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
gopatiḥ kila govindastriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ ..
govṛṣasya pradānena trailokyamabhinaṃdati .. 2 ..
meaning:
गोपतिः किल गोविन्दस्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः ..
गोवृषस्य प्रदानेन त्रैलोक्यमभिनंदति .. 2 ..
text_mt: Govinda is renowned throughout the three worlds as the Lord of Cattle; / through the gift of a bull, the three worlds rejoice.

sanskrit_iast: tasmādgovṛṣakalpasya vidhānaṃ kathayācyuta .. 3 ..
meaning: तस्माद्गोवृषकल्पस्य विधानं कथयाच्युत .. 3 ..
text_mt: Therefore, O Acyuta, declare the procedure for the rite of gifting a bull.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
vṛṣadānaphalaṃ puṇyaṃ śṛṇuṣva kathayāmi te ..
pavitraṃ pāvanaṃ caiva sarvadānottamaṃ tathā .. 4 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
वृषदानफलं पुण्यं शृणुष्व कथयामि ते ..
पवित्रं पावनं चैव सर्वदानोत्तमं तथा .. 4 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Listen to the meritorious fruit of gifting a bull; I shall tell it to you; / it is pure, purifying, and indeed the best among all gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
daśadhenusamo'naḍvānekaścaiva dhuraṃdharaḥ ..
daśadhenupradānāddhi sa evaiko viśiṣyate .. 5 ..
meaning:
दशधेनुसमोऽनड्वानेकश्चैव धुरंधरः ..
दशधेनुप्रदानाद्धि स एवैको विशिष्यते .. 5 ..
text_mt: A single draught bull is equal to ten cows; / indeed, he alone surpasses the gift of ten cows.

sanskrit_iast:
voḍhā ca cārupṛṣṭhāṃgo hyarogaḥ pāṃḍunaṃdana ..
yuvā bhadraḥ suśī laśca sarvadoṣavivarjitaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
वोढा च चारुपृष्ठांगो ह्यरोगः पांडुनंदन ..
युवा भद्रः सुशी लश्च सर्वदोषविवर्जितः .. 6 ..
text_mt: He should be a beast of burden, having a handsome back and limbs, free from disease, O son of Pāṇḍu, / young, auspicious, well-tempered, and devoid of all defects.

sanskrit_iast:
dhuraṃdharaḥ sthāpayate eka eva kulaṃ mahat ..
trātā bhavati saṃsārānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 7 ..
meaning:
धुरंधरः स्थापयते एक एव कुलं महत् ..
त्राता भवति संसारान्नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 7 ..
text_mt: A single draught bull uplifts a great lineage; / he becomes a saviour from worldly existence—no doubt should be entertained on this point.

sanskrit_iast:
alaṃkṛtya vṛṣaṃ śāṃtaṃ puṇyehni samupasthite ..
raupyalāḍgūlasaṃyuktaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet .. 8 ..
meaning:
अलंकृत्य वृषं शांतं पुण्येह्नि समुपस्थिते ..
रौप्यलाड्गूलसंयुक्तं ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Having adorned the docile bull when an auspicious day has arrived, / furnished with silver on his tail, one should present him to a brāhmaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
maṃtreṇānena rājendra taṃ śṛṇuṣva vadāmi te ..
dharmastvaṃ vṛṣarūpeṇa jaga dānaṃdakāraka .. 9 ..
meaning:
मंत्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र तं शृणुष्व वदामि ते ..
धर्मस्त्वं वृषरूपेण जग दानंदकारक .. 9 ..
text_mt: with this mantra, O king of kings; listen to it, I tell you: / "You are Dharma in the form of a bull, the creator of joy for the universe;

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭamūrteradhiṣṭhānamataḥ pāhi sanātana ..
datvaivaṃ dakṣiṇāyuktaṃ praṇipatya visarjayet .. 4.150.10 ..
meaning:
अष्टमूर्तेरधिष्ठानमतः पाहि सनातन ..
दत्वैवं दक्षिणायुक्तं प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् .. 4.150.10 ..
text_mt: the abode of the Eight-formed [Śiva], therefore protect [me], O eternal one!" / Having thus given [him] along with a priestly gift, one should bow down and dismiss [him].

sanskrit_iast:
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vāṅmanaḥ kāyakarmajam ..
tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti godānasukṛtena ca .. 11 ..
meaning:
सप्तजन्मकृतं पापं वाङ्मनः कायकर्मजम् ..
तत्सर्वं विलयं याति गोदानसुकृतेन च .. 11 ..
text_mt: Sin committed through speech, mind, and bodily actions across seven births, / all that dissolves away by the merit of gifting cattle.

sanskrit_iast:
yānaṃ vṛṣabhasaṃyuktaṃ dīpyamānaṃ suśobhitam ..
āruhya kāmagaṃ divyaṃ svarlokamadhirohati .. 12 ..
meaning:
यानं वृषभसंयुक्तं दीप्यमानं सुशोभितम् ..
आरुह्य कामगं दिव्यं स्वर्लोकमधिरोहति .. 12 ..
text_mt: Mounting a vehicle yoked with bulls, blazing, exceedingly beautiful, / moving at will, celestial, he ascends to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvaṃti tasya romāṇi govṛṣasya mahīpate ..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi gavāṃ loke mahīyate .. 13 ..
meaning:
यावंति तस्य रोमाणि गोवृषस्य महीपते ..
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि गवां लोके महीयते .. 13 ..
text_mt: As many hairs as there are on that bull, O king, / for that many thousands of years he is glorified in the world of cows.

sanskrit_iast:
golokādavatīrṇastu ihaloke dvijottamaḥ ..
yajñayājī mahātejāḥ sarvabrāhmaṇapūjitaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
गोलोकादवतीर्णस्तु इहलोके द्विजोत्तमः ..
यज्ञयाजी महातेजाः सर्वब्राह्मणपूजितः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Descending from Goloka, he becomes the best of twice-born in this world, / a performer of Vedic sacrifices, of great splendour, honoured by all brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
tavoktaṃ vai mahārāja kasya deyo vṛṣottamaḥ ..
tadapyahaṃ te vakṣyāmi pātraṃ trāṇapradaṃ nṛṇām .. 15 ..
meaning:
तवोक्तं वै महाराज कस्य देयो वृषोत्तमः ..
तदप्यहं ते वक्ष्यामि पात्रं त्राणप्रदं नृणाम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: It has been told to you, O great king, to whom the excellent bull should be given; / I shall also describe to you that worthy recipient who grants protection to men.

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣāṃ sadā vai śrutipūrṇakarṇā jitendriyāḥ prāṇivadhe nivṛttāḥ ..
pratigrahe saṃkucitā gṛhasthāste brāhmaṇāstārayituṃ samarthāḥ ..16 ..
meaning:
येषां सदा वै श्रुतिपूर्णकर्णा जितेन्द्रियाः प्राणिवधे निवृत्ताः ..
प्रतिग्रहे संकुचिता गृहस्थास्ते ब्राह्मणास्तारयितुं समर्थाः ..16 ..
text_mt: Those whose ears are ever filled with Vedic revelation, whose senses are mastered, who have desisted from slaughtering living beings, / who hesitate to accept gifts, householders—those brāhmaṇas are capable of delivering [the donor].

sanskrit_iast:
gātre dṛḍhaṃ bhārasahaṃ supuṣṭaṃ suśṛṅgiṇaṃ sarvaguṇopapannam ..
dattvarṣabhaṃ godaśakena tulyaṃ satyaṃ bhavaṃti bhuvi tatphalabhāginaste .. 17 ..
pratyakṣadhenudānavratavidhivarṇanam( atha vividhadānāni)
meaning:
गात्रे दृढं भारसहं सुपुष्टं सुशृङ्गिणं सर्वगुणोपपन्नम् ..
दत्त्वर्षभं गोदशकेन तुल्यं सत्यं भवंति भुवि तत्फलभागिनस्ते .. 17 ..
प्रत्यक्षधेनुदानव्रतविधिवर्णनम्( अथ विविधदानानि)
text_mt:
Having gifted a bull strong in body, capable of bearing burdens, well-nourished, having handsome horns, endowed with all good qualities, / which is equal to ten cows, they truly become sharers in that fruit in the world.
Description of the Rule for the Observance of the Gift of an Actual Cow (Now, Various Gifts)

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
śrutaḥ purāṇaviṣayastvatprasādānmayācyuta ..
saṃsārāsāratāṃ jñātvā śrutaśca vratavistaraḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
श्रुतः पुराणविषयस्त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत ..
संसारासारतां ज्ञात्वा श्रुतश्च व्रतविस्तरः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / By your grace, O Acyuta, the subjects of the Purāṇa have been heard by me; / knowing the vanity of worldly existence, the details of observances have also been heard.
title: Vidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyaśca śrotumicchāmi dānamāhātmyamuttamam ..
kiṃ dīyate kadā kṛṣṇa kenopāyena śaṃsa me .. 2 ..
meaning:
भूयश्च श्रोतुमिच्छामि दानमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् ..
किं दीयते कदा कृष्ण केनोपायेन शंस मे .. 2 ..
text_mt: I wish to hear further the supreme majesty of giving: / What is to be given, when, O Kṛṣṇa, and by what means? Tell me.

sanskrit_iast:
nahi dānātparataramanyadastīti me matiḥ ..
dhanaṃ dhanavatāṃ kiñcidahāryaṃ rājataskaraiḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
नहि दानात्परतरमन्यदस्तीति मे मतिः ..
धनं धनवतां किञ्चिदहार्यं राजतस्करैः .. 3 ..
text_mt: For in my view, there is nothing higher than giving; / it is a wealth belonging to the wealthy that cannot be taken away by kings or thieves.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
aniścitaṃ nidhānaṃ yadaprayuktaṃ ca varddhate ..
anītaṃ yāti cādhvānaṃ dhanaṃ viprakarārpitam .. 4 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
अनिश्चितं निधानं यदप्रयुक्तं च वर्द्धते ..
अनीतं याति चाध्वानं धनं विप्रकरार्पितम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Wealth placed into the hands of a brāhmaṇa is an imperishable treasure that increases without being invested, / and travels along the road [to the afterlife] without being carried.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ kāyena supuṣṭena balinā cirajīvinā ..
yannasattvopakārāya tajjīvitamanarthakam .. 5 ..
meaning:
किं कायेन सुपुष्टेन बलिना चिरजीविना ..
यन्नसत्त्वोपकाराय तज्जीवितमनर्थकम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: What is the use of a body well-nourished, strong, and long-lived? / That life which is not for the benefit of living beings is useless.

sanskrit_iast:
grāsādarddhamapi grāsa marthibhyaḥ kiṃ na dīyate ..
icchānurūpo vibhavaḥ kadā kasya bhaviṣyati .. 6 ..
meaning:
ग्रासादर्द्धमपि ग्रास मर्थिभ्यः किं न दीयते ..
इच्छानुरूपो विभवः कदा कस्य भविष्यति .. 6 ..
text_mt: Why is even half a morsel not given from a morsel to seekers? / When will anyone ever possess wealth according to his desires?

sanskrit_iast:
ekasminnapyatikrāṃte dine dānavivarjite ..
dasyubhirmuṣitaścaiva divārātrau ca śocati .. 7 ..
meaning:
एकस्मिन्नप्यतिक्रांते दिने दानविवर्जिते ..
दस्युभिर्मुषितश्चैव दिवारात्रौ च शोचति .. 7 ..
text_mt: Even when a single day passes devoid of giving, / one should grieve day and night as if plundered by bandits.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya trivargaśūnyāni dinānyāyāṃti yāṃti ca ..
salohakārabhastreva śvasannapi na jīvati .. 8 ..
meaning:
यस्य त्रिवर्गशून्यानि दिनान्यायांति यांति च ..
सलोहकारभस्त्रेव श्वसन्नपि न जीवति .. 8 ..
text_mt: He whose days come and go devoid of the three aims of life, / even though breathing like a blacksmith's bellows, does not truly live.

sanskrit_iast:
yairna dattaṃ na ca hutaṃ na tīrthe maraṇaṃ kṛtam ..
hiraṇyamannamudakaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo na cārpitam .. 9 ..
meaning:
यैर्न दत्तं न च हुतं न तीर्थे मरणं कृतम् ..
हिरण्यमन्नमुदकं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो न चार्पितम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: By whom nothing was given, no oblations offered, no death met at a sacred place, / and gold, food, and water were not offered to brāhmaṇas—

sanskrit_iast:
dīnā niraśanā rūkṣāḥ kapālāṅkitapāṇayaḥ ..
te dṛśyaṃte mahārāja jāyamānā punaḥ .. 4.151.10 ..
meaning:
दीना निरशना रूक्षाः कपालाङ्कितपाणयः ..
ते दृश्यंते महाराज जायमाना पुनः .. 4.151.10 ..
text_mt: wretched, starving, withered, with begging-bowls marked upon their hands, / they are seen being born again, O great king.

sanskrit_iast:
āyāsaśatalabdhasya prāṇebhyopi garīyasaḥ ..
gatirekaiva vittasya dānamanyā vipattayaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
आयासशतलब्धस्य प्राणेभ्योपि गरीयसः ..
गतिरेकैव वित्तस्य दानमन्या विपत्तयः .. 11 ..
text_mt: For wealth acquired through a hundred exertions, dearer even than life itself, / there is only one true path, namely giving; the others are calamities.

sanskrit_iast:
nopabhogaiḥ kṣayaṃ yāṃti na pradānaiḥ samṛddhayaḥ ..
pūrvārjitānāmanyatra sukṛtānāṃ parikṣayāt .. 12 ..
meaning:
नोपभोगैः क्षयं यांति न प्रदानैः समृद्धयः ..
पूर्वार्जितानामन्यत्र सुकृतानां परिक्षयात् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Prosperities do not waste away through enjoyments, nor through gifts, / except through the exhaustion of good deeds accumulated in the past.

sanskrit_iast:
adṛṣṭaparatattvopi pātrebhyo visṛjeddhanam ..
yasmānmṛtasya tannāsti tasmātsāṃśayikaṃ varam .. 13 ..
meaning:
अदृष्टपरतत्त्वोपि पात्रेभ्यो विसृजेद्धनम् ..
यस्मान्मृतस्य तन्नास्ति तस्मात्सांशयिकं वरम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Even one who has not perceived the highest truth should bestow wealth upon worthy recipients; / since it does not remain with a dead man, even a doubtful venture is better.

sanskrit_iast:
dānāni bahurūpāṇi kathayāmi tavānagha ..
vyāsavālmīkimanvādyaiḥ kathitāni purā mama .. 14 ..
meaning:
दानानि बहुरूपाणि कथयामि तवानघ ..
व्यासवाल्मीकिमन्वाद्यैः कथितानि पुरा मम .. 14 ..
text_mt: I shall describe to you various forms of gifts, O sinless one, / which were related to me long ago by Vyāsa, Vālmīki, Manu, and others.

sanskrit_iast:
kiñcidvrataṃ yatkriyate pūjyate ca trilocanaḥ ..
dīyate yacca viprebhya etajjanmataroḥ phalam .. 15 ..
meaning:
किञ्चिद्व्रतं यत्क्रियते पूज्यते च त्रिलोचनः ..
दीयते यच्च विप्रेभ्य एतज्जन्मतरोः फलम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: Whatever observance is performed, and Three-Eyed [Śiva] is worshipped, / and whatever is given to brāhmaṇas—this is the fruit of the tree of birth.

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
brāhmaṇaprīṇanārthāya keśavasya śivasya ca ..
yāni dānāni deyāni tānyācakṣya yadūttama ..16..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
ब्राह्मणप्रीणनार्थाय केशवस्य शिवस्य च ..
यानि दानानि देयानि तान्याचक्ष्य यदूत्तम ..16..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / For the sake of pleasing the brāhmaṇas, Keśava, and Śiva, / declare those gifts that should be given, O best of the Yadus!

sanskrit_iast:
yena caiva vidhānena dānaṃ puṇyasukhāvaham ..
ehikāmuṣmikāvāptiṃ karoti nahi hanyate .. 17 ..
meaning:
येन चैव विधानेन दानं पुण्यसुखावहम् ..
एहिकामुष्मिकावाप्तिं करोति नहि हन्यते .. 17 ..
text_mt: And by what procedure a gift brings merit and happiness, / accomplishes attainment in this world and the next, and is never thwarted.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
trīṇyāhuratidānāni gāvaḥ pṛthvī sarasvatī ..
āsaptamaṃ punaṃtyete dohavāhanavedanaiḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
त्रीण्याहुरतिदानानि गावः पृथ्वी सरस्वती ..
आसप्तमं पुनंत्येते दोहवाहनवेदनैः .. 18 ..
text_mt: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / They say there are three supreme gifts: cows, land, and Sarasvatī. / These purify up to the seventh generation through their milking, carriage, and instruction.

sanskrit_iast:
godānamādau vakṣyāmi pratyakṣakramayogataḥ ..
yena caiva vidhānena anyūnādhikavistaram .. 19 ..
meaning:
गोदानमादौ वक्ष्यामि प्रत्यक्षक्रमयोगतः ..
येन चैव विधानेन अन्यूनाधिकविस्तरम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: First I shall explain the gift of an actual cow according to its proper sequence, / and by what ritual procedure, in detail, neither deficient nor redundant.

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ..
deyāḥ kiṃlakṣaṇā gāvaḥ kāśca rājanvivarjitāḥ ..
kīdṛśāya pradātavyā na deyāḥ kīdṛśāya vai ..4.151.20..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच ..
देयाः किंलक्षणा गावः काश्च राजन्विवर्जिताः ..
कीदृशाय प्रदातव्या न देयाः कीदृशाय वै ..4.151.20..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / What are the marks of cows that should be given, and which ones are to be avoided, O King? / To what sort [of person] should they be given, and to what sort should they indeed not be given?

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
taruṇī rūpasaṃpannā suśīlā ca payasvinī ..
nyāyārjitā savatsā ca pradeyā śrotriyāya gauḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
तरुणी रूपसंपन्ना सुशीला च पयस्विनी ..
न्यायार्जिता सवत्सा च प्रदेया श्रोत्रियाय गौः .. 21 ..
text_mt: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / A cow that is young, endowed with beauty, good-tempered, abundant in milk, / righteously acquired, and with her calf should be given to a śrotriya.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛddhā sarogā hīnāṃgī vaṃdhyā duṣṭā mṛtaprajā ..
dūrasthā'nyāyalabdhā ca deyā gaurna kathaṃcana .. 22 ..
meaning:
वृद्धा सरोगा हीनांगी वंध्या दुष्टा मृतप्रजा ..
दूरस्थाऽन्यायलब्धा च देया गौर्न कथंचन .. 22 ..
text_mt: An old, diseased, mutilated, barren, vicious, or stillborn-bearing cow, / or one living far away, or acquired unjustly, should never be given.

sanskrit_iast:
sā dattaiva haretpāpaṃ śrotriyāyāhitāgnaye ..
atithipriyāya dāṃtāya dhenuṃ dadyādguṇādhike ..23..
meaning:
सा दत्तैव हरेत्पापं श्रोत्रियायाहिताग्नये ..
अतिथिप्रियाय दांताय धेनुं दद्याद्गुणाधिके ..23..
text_mt: Given thus, she removes sin: one should give the cow to a śrotriya who maintains the sacred fires, / who is hospitable to guests, self-restrained, and distinguished by virtues.

sanskrit_iast:
akulīnāya mūrkhāya lubdhāya piśunāya ca ..
havyakavyavyapetāya na deyā gauḥ kathaṃcana .. 24 ..
meaning:
अकुलीनाय मूर्खाय लुब्धाय पिशुनाय च ..
हव्यकव्यव्यपेताय न देया गौः कथंचन .. 24 ..
text_mt: To a low-born man, a fool, a greedy man, or a slanderer, / or one devoid of offerings to gods and ancestors, a cow should never be given.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
puṇyaṃ dinamathāsādya snātvātarpya pitṝṃstathā ..
ghṛtakṣīrābhiṣekaṃ ca kṛtvā viṣṇoḥ śivasya ca .. 25 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
पुण्यं दिनमथासाद्य स्नात्वातर्प्य पितॄंस्तथा ..
घृतक्षीराभिषेकं च कृत्वा विष्णोः शिवस्य च .. 25 ..
text_mt: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / Then, having arrived at an auspicious day, having bathed and gratified the ancestors, / and having performed an ablution of Viṣṇu and Śiva with ghee and milk,

sanskrit_iast:
samabhyarcya yathānyāyaṃ puṣpādibhiranukramāt ..
udaṅmukhīṃ prāṅmukhīṃ vā gṛṣṭiṃ kṛtvā payasvinīm .. 26 ..
meaning:
समभ्यर्च्य यथान्यायं पुष्पादिभिरनुक्रमात् ..
उदङ्मुखीं प्राङ्मुखीं वा गृष्टिं कृत्वा पयस्विनीम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: having worshipped them properly in succession with flowers and other offerings, / having placed facing north or facing east a cow that has calved once and yields abundant milk,

sanskrit_iast:
savatsāṃ vastrasaṃvītāṃ sitayajñopavītinīm ..
svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ kāṃsyadohanakānvitām .. 27 ..
meaning:
सवत्सां वस्त्रसंवीतां सितयज्ञोपवीतिनीम् ..
स्वर्णशृङ्गीं रौप्यखुरां कांस्यदोहनकान्विताम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: accompanied by her calf, draped in cloth, wearing a white sacred thread, / with golden horns, silver hooves, and accompanied by a bronze milking pail,

sanskrit_iast:
śaktito dakṣiṇāyuktāṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ..
pucche kṛṣṇājinaṃ deyaṃ gāṃ pucche kariṇaṃ kare .. 28 ..
meaning:
शक्तितो दक्षिणायुक्तां ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ..
पुच्छे कृष्णाजिनं देयं गां पुच्छे करिणं करे .. 28 ..
text_mt: endowed with a sacrificial fee according to one's means, he should present her to the brāhmaṇa. / A black antelope skin should be placed on the tail—the cow by the tail, an elephant by the trunk,

sanskrit_iast:
aśvaṃ sadā sukarṇe vā dāsīṃ śirasi dāpayet ..
gāvo mamāgrataḥ saṃtu gāvo me saṃtu pṛṣṭhataḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
अश्वं सदा सुकर्णे वा दासीं शिरसि दापयेत् ..
गावो ममाग्रतः संतु गावो मे संतु पृष्ठतः .. 29 ..
text_mt: a horse always by the ears, or a female slave should be given by the head. / 'May cows be before me; may cows be behind me;

sanskrit_iast:
gāvo me hṛdaye saṃtu gavāṃ madhye vasāmyaham ..
pradakṣiṇāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dhenuṃ dvijavarāya tām .. 4.151.30 ..
meaning:
गावो मे हृदये संतु गवां मध्ये वसाम्यहम् ..
प्रदक्षिणां ततः कृत्वा धेनुं द्विजवराय ताम् .. 4.151.30 ..
text_mt: may cows be in my heart; may I dwell in the midst of cows.' / Then, having circumambulated that cow, to the foremost of the twice-born [he says]:

sanskrit_iast:
imāṃ ca pratigṛhṇīṣva dhenurdattā mayā tava ..
evamuccārya taṃ vipraṃ deveśaṃ parikalpayet .. 31 ..
meaning:
इमां च प्रतिगृह्णीष्व धेनुर्दत्ता मया तव ..
एवमुच्चार्य तं विप्रं देवेशं परिकल्पयेत् .. 31 ..
text_mt: 'Receive this cow given by me to you.' / Having uttered this, he should regard that brāhmaṇa as the Lord of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
anuvrajecca gacchaṃtaṃ padānyaṣṭau narādhipa ..
anena vidhinā dhenuṃ yo viprāya prayacchati .. 32 ..
meaning:
अनुव्रजेच्च गच्छंतं पदान्यष्टौ नराधिप ..
अनेन विधिना धेनुं यो विप्राय प्रयच्छति .. 32 ..
text_mt: And he should accompany him as he walks away for eight steps, O ruler of men. / Whoever gives a cow to a brāhmaṇa according to this rite,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā svargalokaṃ sa gacchati ..
sapta pūrvānsapta parānātmānaṃ caiva mānavaḥ ..33..
meaning:
सर्वकामसमृद्धात्मा स्वर्गलोकं स गच्छति ..
सप्त पूर्वान्सप्त परानात्मानं चैव मानवः ..33..
text_mt: his desires completely fulfilled, goes to the heavenly realm. / A mortal liberates seven ancestors, seven descendants, and himself,

sanskrit_iast:
sapta janmakṛtātpāpānmocayatyavanīpate..
pade pade'śvamedhasya gośatasya ca mānavaḥ ..34..
meaning:
सप्त जन्मकृतात्पापान्मोचयत्यवनीपते..
पदे पदेऽश्वमेधस्य गोशतस्य च मानवः ..34..
text_mt: from sin committed in seven births, O lord of the earth. / At every step a mortal obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice

sanskrit_iast:
phalamāpnoti rājendra dakṣāyaivaṃ jagau hariḥ ..
sarvakāmapradā sā syātsarvakāleṣu pārthiva ..35..
meaning:
फलमाप्नोति राजेन्द्र दक्षायैवं जगौ हरिः ..
सर्वकामप्रदा सा स्यात्सर्वकालेषु पार्थिव ..35..
text_mt: and of a hundred cows, O king of kings; thus Hari proclaimed to Dakṣa. / She grants all desires at all times, O king;

sanskrit_iast:
bhavatyasau pāpaharā yāvadiṃdrāścaturdaśa ..
sarveṣāmeva pāpānāṃ kṛtānāmapi jānatā ..36..
meaning:
भवत्यसौ पापहरा यावदिंद्राश्चतुर्दश ..
सर्वेषामेव पापानां कृतानामपि जानता ..36..
text_mt: she removes sin as long as the fourteen Indras endure. / Even for all sins committed knowingly,

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittamidaṃ proktamanutāpopabṛṃhitam ..
sarveṣāmeva dānānāmekajanmānugaṃ phalam .. 37 ..
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तमिदं प्रोक्तमनुतापोपबृंहितम् ..
सर्वेषामेव दानानामेकजन्मानुगं फलम् .. 37 ..
text_mt: this expiation is proclaimed, accompanied by remorse. / The fruit of all other gifts lasts for a single birth;

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ śūdraiścānyaiśca mānavaiḥ ..
lokāḥ kāmagamā prāptā dattvaitadvidhinā nṛpa .. 38 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणैः क्षत्रियैर्वैश्यैः शूद्रैश्चान्यैश्च मानवैः ..
लोकाः कामगमा प्राप्ता दत्त्वैतद्विधिना नृप .. 38 ..
text_mt: by brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, śūdras, and other men, / realms conforming to every wish are attained by giving it according to this rite, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
gobhyodhikaṃ jagati nāparamastikiñciddānaṃ pavitramiti śāstravido vadaṃti ..
tatsaṃpadaḥ surasadaśca samīhamānairdeyāḥ sadaiva vidhinā dvijapuṃgavāya .. 39 ..
dhenudānavratavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
गोभ्योधिकं जगति नापरमस्तिकिञ्चिद्दानं पवित्रमिति शास्त्रविदो वदंति ..
तत्संपदः सुरसदश्च समीहमानैर्देयाः सदैव विधिना द्विजपुंगवाय .. 39 ..
धेनुदानव्रतविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Those who know the scriptures declare that there is no other sacred gift in the world greater than cows; / therefore, by those desiring prosperity and the realm of the gods, [a cow] should always be given by this rite to an eminent twice-born.
Description of the ritual procedure for the votive gift of cows

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dhenūnāṃ kalpanā nṛpa ..
viśeṣavidhinā yāśca deyāḥ kāmānabhīpsubhiḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि धेनूनां कल्पना नृप ..
विशेषविधिना याश्च देयाः कामानभीप्सुभिः .. 1 ..
text_mt: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / Now I shall fully explain the fashioned models of cows, O king, / which should be given by special rite by those desiring the objects of their wishes.
title: Dhenudānavratavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
kāmaṃ yaddīyate dānaṃ samagraṃ tatsukhāvaham ..
asamagraṃ tu doṣāya bhavatīha paratra ca .. 2 ..
meaning:
कामं यद्दीयते दानं समग्रं तत्सुखावहम् ..
असमग्रं तु दोषाय भवतीह परत्र च .. 2 ..
text_mt: Any gift given willingly in its entirety brings happiness; / but an incomplete one leads to misfortune here and in the hereafter.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānna dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ vidhānavikalaṃ tathā ..
deyaṃ dānaṃ mahārāja samagraphalakāmyayā .. 3 ..
meaning:
तस्मान्न दक्षिणाहीनं विधानविकलं तथा ..
देयं दानं महाराज समग्रफलकाम्यया .. 3 ..
text_mt: Therefore, a gift should not be given lacking a sacrificial fee or defective in ritual procedure, O great king, / if one desires the complete fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
anyathā dīyamānaṃ tadahaṃkārāya kevalam ..
pratyakṣaṃ cārthahāniḥ syānna vā tatphaladaṃ bhavet .. 4 ..
meaning:
अन्यथा दीयमानं तदहंकाराय केवलम् ..
प्रत्यक्षं चार्थहानिः स्यान्न वा तत्फलदं भवेत् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Given otherwise, it serves merely for egoism; / there is a perceptible loss of wealth, and it would bear no fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
tiladhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu pārthivasattama ..
vārāheṇa purā proktāṃ mahāpātakanāśinīm .. 5 ..
meaning:
तिलधेनुं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु पार्थिवसत्तम ..
वाराहेण पुरा प्रोक्तां महापातकनाशिनीम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: I shall explain the sesame cow, listen, O best of kings, / as previously proclaimed by the Boar Incarnation, which destroys major sins.

sanskrit_iast:
yāṃ dattvā brahmahā goghnaḥ pitṛhā gurutalpagaḥ ..
agāradāhī garadaḥ sarvapāparatopi vā .. 6 ..
meaning:
यां दत्त्वा ब्रह्महा गोघ्नः पितृहा गुरुतल्पगः ..
अगारदाही गरदः सर्वपापरतोपि वा .. 6 ..
text_mt: By giving which, the killer of a brāhmaṇa, the killer of a cow, the killer of a father, one who violates the teacher's bed, / an arsonist, a poisoner, or even one devoted to all sins,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpātakayuktaśca saṃyuktaścopapātakaiḥ ..
mucyate hyakhilaiḥ pāpaiḥ svargalokaṃ ca gacchati .. 7 ..
meaning:
महापातकयुक्तश्च संयुक्तश्चोपपातकैः ..
मुच्यते ह्यखिलैः पापैः स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति .. 7 ..
text_mt: one burdened with major sins and joined with minor sins, / is freed from all sins and goes to the heavenly realm.

sanskrit_iast:
anulipte mahīpṛṣṭhe kṛṣṇājinasamāvṛte ..
dhenuṃ tilamayīṃ kṛtvā darbhānāstīrya sarvataḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
अनुलिप्ते महीपृष्ठे कृष्णाजिनसमावृते ..
धेनुं तिलमयीं कृत्वा दर्भानास्तीर्य सर्वतः .. 8 ..
text_mt: On ground that has been smeared [with cow dung] and covered with a black antelope skin, / having fashioned a cow made of sesame seeds, after strewing darbha grass all around,

sanskrit_iast:
tilāḥ śvetāstilāḥ kṛṣṇāstilā gomūtravarṇakāḥ ..
tilānāṃ ca vicitrāṇāṃ dhenuṃ sarvāṃ ca kārayet ..9 ..
meaning:
तिलाः श्वेतास्तिलाः कृष्णास्तिला गोमूत्रवर्णकाः ..
तिलानां च विचित्राणां धेनुं सर्वां च कारयेत् ..9 ..
text_mt: with white sesame seeds, black sesame seeds, and sesame seeds of the colour of cow's urine, / he should have the entire cow made of variegated sesame seeds.

sanskrit_iast:
droṇasya vatsakaṃ kuryāccaturāḍhakikāṃ ca gām ..
svarṇaśṛṃgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ gandhavarṇavatīṃ tathā .. 4.152.10 ..
meaning:
द्रोणस्य वत्सकं कुर्याच्चतुराढकिकां च गाम् ..
स्वर्णशृंगीं रौप्यखुरां गन्धवर्णवतीं तथा .. 4.152.10 ..
text_mt: He should make the calf from a droṇa [of sesame] and the cow from four āḍhakas, / with golden horns, silver hooves, and endowed with fragrance and colour.

sanskrit_iast:
kāryā śarkarayā jihvā guḍenāsyaṃ ca kambalaḥ ..
ikṣupādāṃ tāmrapṛṣṭhīṃ śuktimuktāphalekṣaṇām .. 11 ..
meaning:
कार्या शर्करया जिह्वा गुडेनास्यं च कम्बलः ..
इक्षुपादां ताम्रपृष्ठीं शुक्तिमुक्ताफलेक्षणाम् .. 11 ..
