text_mt: Her tongue should be made of sugar, her mouth and dewlap of jaggery, / her legs of sugarcane, her back of copper, and her eyes of pearls from mother-of-pearl.

sanskrit_iast:
praśastapatraśravaṇāṃ phaladaṃtavatīṃ śubhām ..
sragdāmapucchāṃ kurvīta nava nītastanānvitām .. 12 ..
meaning:
प्रशस्तपत्रश्रवणां फलदंतवतीं शुभाम् ..
स्रग्दामपुच्छां कुर्वीत नव नीतस्तनान्विताम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Her ears should be made of auspicious leaves, her teeth of fruit, auspicious; / he should make her tail of a garland and cord, and her udder endowed with fresh butter.

sanskrit_iast:
sitavastraśirālambāṃ sitasarṣaparomikām ..
phalairmanoharairannairmaṇimuktāphalānvitām .. 13 ..
meaning:
सितवस्त्रशिरालम्बां सितसर्षपरोमिकाम् ..
फलैर्मनोहरैरन्नैर्मणिमुक्ताफलान्विताम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Covered on her head with a white cloth, with body hair of white mustard seeds, / endowed with charming fruits, grains, jewels, and pearls,

sanskrit_iast:
īdṛksaṃsthānasampannāṃ kṛtvā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
kāṃsyopadohanāṃ dadyātparvakāle samāgate .. 14 ..
meaning:
ईदृक्संस्थानसम्पन्नां कृत्वा श्रद्धासमन्वितः ..
कांस्योपदोहनां दद्यात्पर्वकाले समागते .. 14 ..
text_mt: having fashioned her endowed with such a form, full of faith, / he should give her with a bronze milking pail when an auspicious occasion has arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
yā lakṣmīḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yā vai deveṣvavasthitā ..
dhenurūpeṇa sā devī mama pāpaṃ vyapohatu .. 15 ..
meaning:
या लक्ष्मीः सर्वभूतानां या वै देवेष्ववस्थिता ..
धेनुरूपेण सा देवी मम पापं व्यपोहतु .. 15 ..
text_mt: 'May that goddess Lakṣmī, who belongs to all beings and who resides among the gods, / remove my sin in the form of a cow.'

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā praṇamya ca ..
sadakṣiṇā mayā tubhyaṃ dattetyuktvā visarjayet .. 16 ..
meaning:
ततः प्रदक्षिणां कृत्वा पूजयित्वा प्रणम्य च ..
सदक्षिणा मया तुभ्यं दत्तेत्युक्त्वा विसर्जयेत् .. 16 ..
text_mt: Then, having circumambulated, worshipped, and bowed to her, / he should dismiss her, saying: 'Accompanied by a sacrificial fee, she is given by me to you.'

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā dattvā tiladhenuṃ narādhipa ..
sarvapāpavinirmukto paraṃ brahmādhigacchati .. 17 ..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना दत्त्वा तिलधेनुं नराधिप ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति .. 17 ..
text_mt: Having given the sesame cow according to this procedure, O ruler of men, / freed from all sins, he attains the supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
yaśca gṛhṇāti vidhivaddīyamānāṃ pramodate ..
dīyamānāṃ praśaṃsaṃti ye ca saṃhṛṣṭamānasāḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
यश्च गृह्णाति विधिवद्दीयमानां प्रमोदते ..
दीयमानां प्रशंसंति ये च संहृष्टमानसाः .. 18 ..
text_mt: And he who receives it according to the rule as it is being given rejoices; / and those who, with delighted minds, praise it as it is being given [also attain merit].

sanskrit_iast:
tepi doṣavinirmuktā brahmalokaṃ vrajaṃti te ..
praśāṃtāya suśīlāya vedavrataratāya ca .. 19 ..
meaning:
तेपि दोषविनिर्मुक्ता ब्रह्मलोकं व्रजंति ते ..
प्रशांताय सुशीलाय वेदव्रतरताय च .. 19 ..
text_mt: they too are freed from fault and go to the world of Brahmā. / Having given a cow made of sesame to [a brāhmaṇa who is] tranquil, of good character, and devoted to the vows of the Veda,

sanskrit_iast:
dhenuṃ tilamayīṃ dattvā na śocati kṛtākṛte ..
trirātraṃ yastilāhārastiladhenuprado bhavet .. 4.152.20 ..
meaning:
धेनुं तिलमयीं दत्त्वा न शोचति कृताकृते ..
त्रिरात्रं यस्तिलाहारस्तिलधेनुप्रदो भवेत् .. 4.152.20 ..
text_mt: he does not grieve over what was done or undone. / Whoever subsists on sesame for three nights and gives a sesame cow,

sanskrit_iast:
ekāhamatha vā rājanna yucchedantarātmanā ..
dānādviśuddhiḥ pāpasya tasya puṇyavato nṛpa .. 21 ..
meaning:
एकाहमथ वा राजन्न युच्छेदन्तरात्मना ..
दानाद्विशुद्धिः पापस्य तस्य पुण्यवतो नृप .. 21 ..
text_mt: or for even one day, O king, with an attentive inner self, / from that gift, O ruler of men, comes purification from sin for that meritorious person.

sanskrit_iast:
cāndrāyaṇādabhyadhikaṃ kathitaṃ tilabhakṣaṇam ..
bālatve caiva yatpāpaṃ yauvane vārddhake tathā .. 22 ..
meaning:
चान्द्रायणादभ्यधिकं कथितं तिलभक्षणम् ..
बालत्वे चैव यत्पापं यौवने वार्द्धके तथा .. 22 ..
text_mt: Eating sesame is declared to be superior to the cāndrāyaṇa penance. / Whatever sin was committed in childhood, in youth, or in old age,

sanskrit_iast:
vācā kṛtaṃ tu manasā karmaṇā yacca saṃcitam ..
udakaṣṭhīvane caiva nagnasnānena yadbhavet .. 23 ..
meaning:
वाचा कृतं तु मनसा कर्मणा यच्च संचितम् ..
उदकष्ठीवने चैव नग्नस्नानेन यद्भवेत् .. 23 ..
text_mt: committed by speech, by mind, or accumulated through bodily action, / whatever arises from spitting into water or bathing naked,

sanskrit_iast:
muśalenodyate nāpi laṃbite brāhmaṇe tathā ..
vṛṣalīgamane caiva gurudārābhigāmini .. 24 ..
meaning:
मुशलेनोद्यते नापि लंबिते ब्राह्मणे तथा ..
वृषलीगमने चैव गुरुदाराभिगामिनि .. 24 ..
text_mt: by raising a pestle [against another], or by humiliating a brāhmaṇa, / in approaching a śūdra woman, or in violating the wife of a guru,

sanskrit_iast:
surāpānena yatpāpamabhakṣyasya ca bhakṣaṇāt ..
tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti tiladhenupradāyinām .. 25 ..
meaning:
सुरापानेन यत्पापमभक्ष्यस्य च भक्षणात् ..
तत्सर्वं विलयं याति तिलधेनुप्रदायिनाम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: whatever sin comes from drinking spirituous liquor or eating what is inedible, / all of that dissolves for those who bestow a sesame cow.

sanskrit_iast:
yamamārge mahāghore nadī vaitaraṇī smṛtā ..
vālukāyāḥ sthalaṃ caiva pacyate yatra pāpinaḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
यममार्गे महाघोरे नदी वैतरणी स्मृता ..
वालुकायाः स्थलं चैव पच्यते यत्र पापिनः .. 26 ..
text_mt: On the terrifying path of Yama, the river Vaitaraṇī is traditionally known, / as well as the stretch of hot sand where sinners are cooked,

sanskrit_iast:
yatra lohamukhāḥ kākā yatra śvāno bhayāvahāḥ ..
nikṛtya pāpināṃ māṃsaṃ bhakṣayaṃti bubhukṣitāḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
यत्र लोहमुखाः काका यत्र श्वानो भयावहाः ..
निकृत्य पापिनां मांसं भक्षयंति बुभुक्षिताः .. 27 ..
text_mt: where there are iron-beaked crows and terrifying dogs / that, ravenous, tear off and eat the flesh of sinners,

sanskrit_iast:
asipatravanaṃ caiva lohakaṃṭakaśālmalīm ..
etānsarvānatikramya tato yamapuraṃ vrajet .. 28 ..
meaning:
असिपत्रवनं चैव लोहकंटकशाल्मलीम् ..
एतान्सर्वानतिक्रम्य ततो यमपुरं व्रजेत् .. 28 ..
text_mt: and the forest of sword-like leaves, and the silk-cotton tree with iron thorns. / Transcending all these, he then goes to Yama’s city.

sanskrit_iast:
vimāne kāṃcane divye maṇiratnavibhūṣite ..
tatrāruhya naraśreṣṭho gacchate paramāṅgatim .. 29 ..
meaning:
विमाने कांचने दिव्ये मणिरत्नविभूषिते ..
तत्रारुह्य नरश्रेष्ठो गच्छते परमाङ्गतिम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: Mounting a divine, golden celestial chariot / adorned with gems and jewels, that best of men attains the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
guṇahīne na dātavyā na dātavyā dhaneśvare ..
kuṇḍe gole ca lubdhe ca na ca deyā kadāpi sā .. 4.152.30 ..
meaning:
गुणहीने न दातव्या न दातव्या धनेश्वरे ..
कुण्डे गोले च लुब्धे च न च देया कदापि सा .. 4.152.30 ..
text_mt: It must not be given to one devoid of virtues, nor to a lord of wealth; / it must never be given to an adulterine son, an incestuous son, or a greedy man.

sanskrit_iast:
ekā ekasya dātavyā munibhiḥ kathitaṃ purā ..
araṇye naimiṣe pārtha nāradena niveditam .. 31 ..
meaning:
एका एकस्य दातव्या मुनिभिः कथितं पुरा ..
अरण्ये नैमिषे पार्थ नारदेन निवेदितम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: One [cow] must be given to one [recipient]; this was stated by sages of old. / It was related by Nārada in the Naimiṣa forest, O Pārtha.

sanskrit_iast:
tattehaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi samyakphalasahasradam ..
idaṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ ca māṅgalyaṃ kīrtivardhanam .. 32 ..
meaning:
तत्तेहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि सम्यक्फलसहस्रदम् ..
इदं पुण्यं पवित्रं च माङ्गल्यं कीर्तिवर्धनम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: I shall proclaim that to you, which properly bestows a thousandfold fruit. / This [account] is meritorious, purifying, auspicious, and increases fame.

sanskrit_iast:
viprāṇāṃ śrāvayecchrāddhe anantaphalamaśnute ..
bahubhyo na pradeyāni gaurgṛhaṃ śayanaṃ striyaḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
विप्राणां श्रावयेच्छ्राद्धे अनन्तफलमश्नुते ..
बहुभ्यो न प्रदेयानि गौर्गृहं शयनं स्त्रियः .. 33 ..
text_mt: If one recites it to brāhmaṇas at a śrāddha, one attains endless fruit. / A cow, a house, a bed, and women must not be given to many [recipients].

sanskrit_iast:
vibhajyamānānyetāni dātāraṃ pātayaṃtyadhaḥ ..
sā tu vikrayamāpannā dahatyāsaptamaṃ kulam .. 34 ..
meaning:
विभज्यमानान्येतानि दातारं पातयंत्यधः ..
सा तु विक्रयमापन्ना दहत्यासप्तमं कुलम् .. 34 ..
text_mt: These, when divided, bring down the giver into hell. / But if it is sold, it burns his lineage up to the seventh generation.

sanskrit_iast:
asyā dānaprabhāvena vimānaṃ sarvakāmikam ..
samāruhya naro yāti yatra devo hariḥ svayam .. 39 ..
meaning:
अस्या दानप्रभावेन विमानं सर्वकामिकम् ..
समारुह्य नरो याति यत्र देवो हरिः स्वयम् .. 39 ..
text_mt: By the power of giving it, a man mounts / a celestial chariot yielding all desires and goes to where Lord Hari himself dwells.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā caiva pradātavyā prayatenāntarātmanā ..
paurṇamāsyāṃ ca māghasya kārtikyāṃ caiva bhārata .. 36 ..
meaning:
एषा चैव प्रदातव्या प्रयतेनान्तरात्मना ..
पौर्णमास्यां च माघस्य कार्तिक्यां चैव भारत .. 36 ..
text_mt: And this must be given with a restrained inner self / on the full moon of Māgha and on the Kārtikī full moon, O descendant of Bharata,

sanskrit_iast:
candrasūryoparāge tu viṣuve ayane tathā ..
ṣaḍaśītimukhe caiva vyatīpāte tu sarvadā .. 37 ..
meaning:
चन्द्रसूर्योपरागे तु विषुवे अयने तथा ..
षडशीतिमुखे चैव व्यतीपाते तु सर्वदा .. 37 ..
text_mt: at an eclipse of the moon or sun, at the equinox, at a solstice, / at a ṣaḍaśītimukha transition, and always on a vyatīpāta,

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśākhyāṃ mārgaśīrṣyāṃ vā gajacchāyāsu caiva hi ..
eṣā te kathitā pārtha tiladhenurmayānagha .. 38 ..
meaning:
वैशाख्यां मार्गशीर्ष्यां वा गजच्छायासु चैव हि ..
एषा ते कथिता पार्थ तिलधेनुर्मयानघ .. 38 ..
text_mt: on the full moon of Vaiśākha or of Mārgaśīrṣa, or during gajacchāyā conjunctions. / Thus, O sinless Pārtha, this sesame cow has been described by me to you.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvaṃti dheno romaṇi gātreṣu nṛpapuṅgava ..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi tadā svarge mahīyate .. 39 ..
meaning:
यावंति धेनो रोमणि गात्रेषु नृपपुङ्गव ..
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि तदा स्वर्गे महीयते .. 39 ..
text_mt: As many hairs as there are on the limbs of the cow, O bull among kings, / for that many thousands of years he is glorified in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
yaśca gṛhṇāti vidhivaddīyamānāṃ ca paśyati ..
anumodayate caiva te sarve svargagāminaḥ .. 4.152.40 ..
meaning:
यश्च गृह्णाति विधिवद्दीयमानां च पश्यति ..
अनुमोदयते चैव ते सर्वे स्वर्गगामिनः .. 4.152.40 ..
text_mt: And he who receives it according to rule, or sees it being given, / or approves of it—all of them go to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
dhenuṃ dhanādhipatayo magadhodbhavena mānena ye tilamayīṃ caturāḍhakena ..
kṛtvā yathoktaracanāṃ kṛtacāruvatsāṃ yacchaṃti te bhuvi bhavaṃti vimuktapāpāḥ ..41..
meaning:
धेनुं धनाधिपतयो मगधोद्भवेन मानेन ये तिलमयीं चतुराढकेन ..
कृत्वा यथोक्तरचनां कृतचारुवत्सां यच्छंति ते भुवि भवंति विमुक्तपापाः ..41..
text_mt: Wealthy lords who, having fashioned a sesame cow with four āḍhakas by the Magadha measure / according to the prescribed design, provided with a beautiful calf, bestow it, become freed from sin on earth.

sanskrit_iast:
pratigṛhṇāmi devi tvāṃ kuṭuṃbabharaṇāya ca ..
kāmaṃ deyā dayāsmabhyaṃ dheno tvaṃ sarvadā hyasi .. 42 .. ..
jaladhenudānavratavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
प्रतिगृह्णामि देवि त्वां कुटुंबभरणाय च ..
कामं देया दयास्मभ्यं धेनो त्वं सर्वदा ह्यसि .. 42 .. ..
जलधेनुदानव्रतविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
"I accept you, O goddess, for the maintenance of my family. / Compassion must be granted to us according to your will, for you are ever a cow to us!"
Description of the Procedure for the Votive Observance of Bestowing a Water Cow

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
jaladhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi prīyate dattayā yayā ..
devadevo hṛṣīkeśaḥ pūjitaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
जलधेनुं प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रीयते दत्तया यया ..
देवदेवो हृषीकेशः पूजितः सर्वभावनः .. 1 ..
text_mt: The Blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / I shall describe the water cow, through the gift of which / Hṛṣīkeśa, the god of gods, the source of all beings, is pleased and worshipped.
title: adhyāyaḥ 153

sanskrit_iast:
jalakuṃbhaṃ naravyāghra sthāpayitvā supūjitam ..
ratnagarbhaṃ tu taṃ kṛtvā grāmyairdhānyai samanvitam .. 2 ..
meaning:
जलकुंभं नरव्याघ्र स्थापयित्वा सुपूजितम् ..
रत्नगर्भं तु तं कृत्वा ग्राम्यैर्धान्यै समन्वितम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: Having set up a well-worshipped water jar, O tiger among men, / filled with jewels, and provided with cultivated grains,

sanskrit_iast:
sitavastrayugacchannaṃ dūrvāpallavaśobhitam ..
kuṣṭhamāṃsīpurośīravālakāmalakīyutam .. 3 ..
meaning:
सितवस्त्रयुगच्छन्नं दूर्वापल्लवशोभितम् ..
कुष्ठमांसीपुरोशीरवालकामलकीयुतम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: covered with a pair of white garments, adorned with sprouts of dūrvā grass, / furnished with costus, spikenard, bdellium, vetiver, vālaka, and myrobalan,

sanskrit_iast:
priyaṅgupatrasahitaṃ sitayajñopavītinam ..
sopānaktaṃ ca sacchatraṃ darbhaviṣṭarasaṃsthitam .. 4 ..
meaning:
प्रियङ्गुपत्रसहितं सितयज्ञोपवीतिनम् ..
सोपानक्तं च सच्छत्रं दर्भविष्टरसंस्थितम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: accompanied by priyaṅgu leaves, having a white sacred thread, / with sandals and a royal parasol, placed upon a seat of darbha grass,

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhiḥ saṃyutaṃ raupyaṃ tilapātraiścaturdiśam ..
sthagitaṃ dadhipātreṇa ghṛtakṣaudravatā mukhama. .. 5 ..
meaning:
चतुर्भिः संयुतं रौप्यं तिलपात्रैश्चतुर्दिशम् ..
स्थगितं दधिपात्रेण घृतक्षौद्रवता मुखम. .. 5 ..
text_mt: furnished with four silver vessels of sesame in the four directions, / its mouth covered with a vessel of curd containing clarified butter and honey,

sanskrit_iast:
savatsāṃ ca pratiṣṭhāpya gomayenopaśobhitām ..
sragdāmapucchīṃ kurvīta tāmradohanakānvitām .. 6 ..
meaning:
सवत्सां च प्रतिष्ठाप्य गोमयेनोपशोभिताम् ..
स्रग्दामपुच्छीं कुर्वीत ताम्रदोहनकान्विताम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: having installed it with a calf and adorned it with cow dung, / one should make its tail of flower-garlands and provide it with a copper milking vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ samabhyarcya vibhuṃ vāsudevaṃ sanātanam ..
puṣpadhūpopahāraiśca yathāvibhavamātmanaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
ततः समभ्यर्च्य विभुं वासुदेवं सनातनम् ..
पुष्पधूपोपहारैश्च यथाविभवमात्मनः .. 7 ..
text_mt: Then, having worshipped the all-pervading, eternal Vāsudeva / with flowers, incense, and food offerings according to one’s means,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkalpya jaladhenuṃ ca kuṃbhaṃ tamabhimaṃtrya ca ..
viṣṇorvakṣasi yā lakṣmīḥ svāhā yā ca vibhāvasoḥ ..
somaśakrārkaśaktiryā dhenurūpeṇa sāstu me .. 8 ..
meaning:
संकल्प्य जलधेनुं च कुंभं तमभिमंत्र्य च ..
विष्णोर्वक्षसि या लक्ष्मीः स्वाहा या च विभावसोः ..
सोमशक्रार्कशक्तिर्या धेनुरूपेण सास्तु मे .. 8 ..
text_mt: having resolved it as a water cow and consecrated that jar with the mantra: / "May Lakṣmī who is on Viṣṇu’s chest, Svāhā who belongs to the Fire-god, / and the power belonging to Soma, Indra, and the Sun, be mine in the form of a cow!"

sanskrit_iast:
evamāmaṃtrya vidhivatsaphalāṃ vatsakānvitām ..
bhaktyā saṃpūjya goviṃdaṃ jalaśāyinamacyutam .. 9 ..
meaning:
एवमामंत्र्य विधिवत्सफलां वत्सकान्विताम् ..
भक्त्या संपूज्य गोविंदं जलशायिनमच्युतम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Having thus invited it according to rule, furnished with fruits and a calf, / having worshipped with devotion Govinda who reclines upon the waters, the infallible,

sanskrit_iast:
sitavastradharaḥ śāṃto vītarāgo vimatsaraḥ ..
dadyādviprāya rājendra prītyarthaṃ jalaśāyinaḥ .. 4.153.10 ..
meaning:
सितवस्त्रधरः शांतो वीतरागो विमत्सरः ..
दद्याद्विप्राय राजेन्द्र प्रीत्यर्थं जलशायिनः .. 4.153.10 ..
text_mt: wearing white garments, tranquil, free from passion and envy, / one should give it to a brāhmaṇa, O best of kings, for the pleasure of the one who reclines upon the waters:

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣaparyaṃkaśayanaḥ śrīmāñchārṅgavibhūṣitaḥ ..
jalaśāyī jagadyoniḥ prīyatāṃ mama keśavaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
शेषपर्यंकशयनः श्रीमाञ्छार्ङ्गविभूषितः ..
जलशायी जगद्योनिः प्रीयतां मम केशवः .. 11 ..
text_mt: "May Keśava be pleased with me—he who sleeps upon the couch of Śeṣa, the glorious one, adorned with the Śārṅga bow, / who reclines upon the waters, the womb of the universe!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuccārya jagannāthaṃ viprāya prati pādya tām ..
taddinaṃ govratastiṣṭhecchraddhayā parayā yutaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
इत्युच्चार्य जगन्नाथं विप्राय प्रति पाद्य ताम् ..
तद्दिनं गोव्रतस्तिष्ठेच्छ्रद्धया परया युतः .. 12 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus to the Lord of the World and delivered it to a brāhmaṇa, / he should observe the vow of the cow on that day, endowed with supreme faith.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā dattvā jaladhenuṃ janādhipa ..
sarvabhogānavāpnoti ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना दत्त्वा जलधेनुं जनाधिप ..
सर्वभोगानवाप्नोति ये दिव्या ये च मानुषाः .. 13 ..
text_mt: Having given a water cow according to this procedure, O ruler of people, / he attains all enjoyments, both celestial and human.

sanskrit_iast:
śarīrārogyamatulaṃ praśamaḥ sarvakālikaḥ ..
nṛṇāṃ bhavaṃti dattāyāṃ sarve kāmā na saṃśayaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
शरीरारोग्यमतुलं प्रशमः सर्वकालिकः ..
नृणां भवंति दत्तायां सर्वे कामा न संशयः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Incomparable bodily health and perpetual tranquility / and all desires come to men when it is given; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
atrāpi śrūyate bhūpa mudgale na mahātmanā ..
jātismareṇa yadgītamihābhyetya purā kila .. 15 ..
meaning:
अत्रापि श्रूयते भूप मुद्गले न महात्मना ..
जातिस्मरेण यद्गीतमिहाभ्येत्य पुरा किल .. 15 ..
text_mt: In this matter also is heard, O king, what was sung of old / by the great-souled Mudgala who remembered his former births, when he came here.

sanskrit_iast:
sa mudgalaḥ purā vipro yamalokagato muniḥ ..
dadarśa yātanānekāḥ pāpakarmakṛtāṃ nṛṇām .. 16 ..
meaning:
स मुद्गलः पुरा विप्रो यमलोकगतो मुनिः ..
ददर्श यातनानेकाः पापकर्मकृतां नृणाम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: That Mudgala, a brāhmaṇa sage of old, having gone to Yama’s realm, / beheld the numerous torments of men who had performed sinful acts:

sanskrit_iast:
dīptāgnitīkṣṇayantrasthāḥ kvāthatailamayāstathā ..
uṣṇakṣāranadīpātā bhairavāḥ puruṣarṣabha .. 17 ..
meaning:
दीप्ताग्नितीक्ष्णयन्त्रस्थाः क्वाथतैलमयास्तथा ..
उष्णक्षारनदीपाता भैरवाः पुरुषर्षभ .. 17 ..
text_mt: those placed in blazes of fire and sharp torture-engines, immersed in boiling oil, / thrown into rivers of boiling caustic, [all] terrifying, O bull among men,

sanskrit_iast:
vraṇakṣāranipātotha kumbhīpākamahālayāḥ ..
tā dṛṣṭvā yātanā vipraścakāra paramāṃ kṛpām .. 18 ..
meaning:
व्रणक्षारनिपातोथ कुम्भीपाकमहालयाः ..
ता दृष्ट्वा यातना विप्रश्चकार परमां कृपाम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: and the application of caustic to wounds, and the vast hell of Kumbhīpāka. / Having seen those torments, the brāhmaṇa was filled with supreme compassion.

sanskrit_iast:
āhlādaṃ te tadā jagmuḥ pāpāstadanukaṃpayā ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā nārakāḥ kecitsthitvā tadavalokinaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
आह्लादं ते तदा जग्मुः पापास्तदनुकंपया ..
तं दृष्ट्वा नारकाः केचित्स्थित्वा तदवलोकिनः .. 19 ..
text_mt: Those sinners then experienced delight through his compassion; / seeing him, some denizens of hell stood gazing at him.

sanskrit_iast:
tadavasthaṃ vilokyātha munirnārakamaṇḍalam ..
dharmarājaṃ sa papraccha teṣāṃ praśamakāraṇam .. 4.153.20 ..
meaning:
तदवस्थं विलोक्याथ मुनिर्नारकमण्डलम् ..
धर्मराजं स पप्रच्छ तेषां प्रशमकारणम् .. 4.153.20 ..
text_mt: Beholding the assembly of hell-dwellers in that state, the sage / asked the King of Dharma the cause of their relief.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmai cācaṣṭa rājendra tadā vaivasvato yamaḥ ..
āhlādahetumadhikaṃ nārakāṇāṃ narottama .. 21 ..
meaning:
तस्मै चाचष्ट राजेन्द्र तदा वैवस्वतो यमः ..
आह्लादहेतुमधिकं नारकाणां नरोत्तम .. 21 ..
text_mt: Then Yama, son of Vivasvat, told him, O king of kings, / O best of men, the supreme cause of the hell-dwellers' delight:

sanskrit_iast:
dānānubhāvātsarveṣāṃ nārakāṇāṃ dvijottama ..
saṃpravṛto'yamāhlādaḥ kāraṇaṃ tacchṛṇu ṣva me .. 22 ..
meaning:
दानानुभावात्सर्वेषां नारकाणां द्विजोत्तम ..
संप्रवृतोऽयमाह्लादः कारणं तच्छृणु ष्व मे .. 22 ..
text_mt: “Through the power of a gift, O best of the twice-born, for all the hell-dwellers / this delight has begun; hear from me the reason for that.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayābhyarcya jagannāthaṃ sarveśaṃ jalaśāyinam ..
jaladhenuḥ purā dattā vidhivadvijapuṅgava .. 23 ..
meaning:
त्वयाभ्यर्च्य जगन्नाथं सर्वेशं जलशायिनम् ..
जलधेनुः पुरा दत्ता विधिवद्विजपुङ्गव .. 23 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped the Lord of the World, the Lord of All who reclines on the waters, / a water-cow was formerly given by you according to the rules, O bull among the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātvajjanmano'tīte tṛtīye dvija janmani ..
tasya dānasya te vyuṣṭiriyamāhlādadāyinī .. 24 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्वज्जन्मनोऽतीते तृतीये द्विज जन्मनि ..
तस्य दानस्य ते व्युष्टिरियमाह्लाददायिनी .. 24 ..
text_mt: Now that three births have passed since that birth of yours, O twice-born, / this is the reward of that gift of yours, bestowing delight.

sanskrit_iast:
ye tvāṃ paśyaṃti śṛṇvaṃti ye ca dhyāyaṃti mānavāḥ ..
śṛṇoṣi yāṃśca viprendra yāṃśca dhyāyasi paśyasi ..25..
meaning:
ये त्वां पश्यंति शृण्वंति ये च ध्यायंति मानवाः ..
शृणोषि यांश्च विप्रेन्द्र यांश्च ध्यायसि पश्यसि ..25..
text_mt: Those men who see you, who hear [you], and who meditate upon you, / and those whom you hear, O chief of brahmins, and whom you meditate upon and see—

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛttiḥ paramā teṣāṃ sarvāhlādapradāyinī ..
sadyo bhavati mā'tra tvaṃ dvijāte kuru vismayam .. 26 ..
meaning:
निवृत्तिः परमा तेषां सर्वाह्लादप्रदायिनी ..
सद्यो भवति माऽत्र त्वं द्विजाते कुरु विस्मयम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: for them supreme relief immediately arises, granting all delight. / Do not feel astonishment at this, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
āhlādahetujananaṃ nāsti viprendra tādṛśam ..
jaladhenuryathā nṛṇāṃ janmānyekonaviṃśatim ..27..
meaning:
आह्लादहेतुजननं नास्ति विप्रेन्द्र तादृशम् ..
जलधेनुर्यथा नृणां जन्मान्येकोनविंशतिम् ..27..
text_mt: There is nothing that produces a cause of delight like that, O chief of brahmins, / as a water-cow [does] for men for nineteen births.

sanskrit_iast:
na doṣo na jvaro nārtirna klamo dvija jāyate ..
api janmasahasre'pi jaladhenupradāyinām .. 28 ..
meaning:
न दोषो न ज्वरो नार्तिर्न क्लमो द्विज जायते ..
अपि जन्मसहस्रेऽपि जलधेनुप्रदायिनाम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Neither affliction, nor fever, nor distress, nor exhaustion arises, O twice-born, / even across a thousand births, for givers of a water-cow.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tvaṃ gaccha gṛhītvārdhamasmato dvijasattama ..
yeṣāṃ samāśrayaḥ kṛṣṇe na niyamyā hi te mayā .. 29 ..
meaning:
स त्वं गच्छ गृहीत्वार्धमस्मतो द्विजसत्तम ..
येषां समाश्रयः कृष्णे न नियम्या हि ते मया .. 29 ..
text_mt: Therefore, depart, having received half from us, O best of the twice-born; / for those who have taken refuge in Kṛṣṇa are not to be punished by me.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇastu pūjito yaistu ye kṛṣṇārthamupoṣitāḥ ..
yaiśca nityaṃ smṛtaḥ kṛṣṇo na te madviṣayopagāḥ .. 4.153.30 ..
meaning:
कृष्णस्तु पूजितो यैस्तु ये कृष्णार्थमुपोषिताः ..
यैश्च नित्यं स्मृतः कृष्णो न ते मद्विषयोपगाः .. 4.153.30 ..
text_mt: Those by whom Kṛṣṇa has been worshipped, who have fasted for the sake of Kṛṣṇa, / and by whom Kṛṣṇa is constantly remembered, do not come into my realm.

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ kṛṣṇācyutānaṃta vāsudevetyudīritam ..
yairbhā vabhāvitairvipra na te madviṣayopagāḥ ..31..
meaning:
नमः कृष्णाच्युतानंत वासुदेवेत्युदीरितम् ..
यैर्भा वभावितैर्विप्र न ते मद्विषयोपगाः ..31..
text_mt: Those by whom, filled with devotion, O brahmin, it is uttered: / ‘Homage to Kṛṣṇa, Acyuta, Ananta, Vāsudeva!’, do not come into my realm.

sanskrit_iast:
dānaṃ dadadbhiryairuktamacyutaḥ prīyatāmiti ..
śraddhāpuraḥsarairvipra na te madviṣayopagāḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
दानं ददद्भिर्यैरुक्तमच्युतः प्रीयतामिति ..
श्रद्धापुरःसरैर्विप्र न ते मद्विषयोपगाः .. 32 ..
text_mt: Those who, accompanied by faith, say while giving a gift: / ‘May Acyuta be pleased!’, O brahmin, do not come into my realm.

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva nāthaḥ sarvasya tanniyogakarā vayam ..
janasaṃyamanaścāhamasmatsaṃyamano hariḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
स एव नाथः सर्वस्य तन्नियोगकरा वयम् ..
जनसंयमनश्चाहमस्मत्संयमनो हरिः .. 33 ..
text_mt: He alone is the lord of all; we are the executors of his commands. / I am the restrainer of people, but Hari is our restrainer.”

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ niśamya vacanaṃ yamasya vadato'khilam ..
ūcuste nārakāḥ sarve vahniśastrārkabhīravaḥ ..34..
meaning:
इत्थं निशम्य वचनं यमस्य वदतोऽखिलम् ..
ऊचुस्ते नारकाः सर्वे वह्निशस्त्रार्कभीरवः ..34..
text_mt: Hearing this entire speech uttered by Yama, / all those hell-dwellers, terrified of fire, weapons, and the sun, said:

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ kṛṣṇāya haraye viṣṇave jiṣṇave namaḥ ..
hṛṣīkeśāya keśāya jagaddhātre'cyutāya ca .. 35 ..
meaning:
नमः कृष्णाय हरये विष्णवे जिष्णवे नमः ..
हृषीकेशाय केशाय जगद्धात्रेऽच्युताय च .. 35 ..
text_mt: “Homage to Kṛṣṇa, to Hari, to Viṣṇu, homage to the victorious one! / To Hṛṣīkeśa, to Keśa, to the Supporter of the World, and to Acyuta!

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ paṅkajanetrāya namaḥ paṅkajanābhaye ..
janārdanāya śrīśāya śrībhartre pītavāsase .. 36 ..
meaning:
नमः पङ्कजनेत्राय नमः पङ्कजनाभये ..
जनार्दनाय श्रीशाय श्रीभर्त्रे पीतवाससे .. 36 ..
text_mt: Homage to the lotus-eyed one! Homage to the lotus-naveled one! / To Janārdana, the Lord of Śrī, the Consort of Śrī, the yellow-robed one!

sanskrit_iast:
goviṃdāya namo nityaṃ namaścodadhiśāyine ..
namaḥ kamalanetrāya nṛsiṃhāya ninādine .. 37 ..
meaning:
गोविंदाय नमो नित्यं नमश्चोदधिशायिने ..
नमः कमलनेत्राय नृसिंहाय निनादिने .. 37 ..
text_mt: Perpetual homage to Govinda! And homage to the one who reclines upon the ocean! / Homage to the lotus-eyed one, to the roaring Nṛsiṃha!

sanskrit_iast:
śārṅgiṇe śitakhaḍgāya śaṃkhacakragadābhṛte ..
namo vāmanarūpāya krāṃtalokatrayāya ca .. 38 ..
meaning:
शार्ङ्गिणे शितखड्गाय शंखचक्रगदाभृते ..
नमो वामनरूपाय क्रांतलोकत्रयाय च .. 38 ..
text_mt: To the bearer of the Śārṅga bow, the sharp sword, the conch, discus, and mace! / Homage to the one whose form is the Dwarf, who strode through the three worlds!

sanskrit_iast:
varāharūpāya tathā namo yajñāṅgadhāriṇe ..
vyāptāśeṣadigaṃtāyānaṃtāya paramātmane ..39..
meaning:
वराहरूपाय तथा नमो यज्ञाङ्गधारिणे ..
व्याप्ताशेषदिगंतायानंताय परमात्मने ..39..
text_mt: Likewise, homage to the one whose form is the Boar, who embodies the limbs of the sacrifice! / To the Infinite One, the Supreme Self, who pervades all ends of the directions!

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudeva namastubhyaṃ namaḥ kaiṭabhasūdine ..
keśavāya namo rāma namastestu mahīdhara ..4.153.40..
meaning:
वासुदेव नमस्तुभ्यं नमः कैटभसूदिने ..
केशवाय नमो राम नमस्तेस्तु महीधर ..4.153.40..
text_mt: O Vāsudeva, homage to you! Homage to the slayer of Kaiṭabha! / Homage to Keśava! O Rāma, homage be to you, O Upholder of the Earth!”

sanskrit_iast:
namo'stu vāsudevāya hyevamuccārite ca taiḥ ..
śastrāṇi kuṃṭhatāṃ jagmuranalaścāpi śītatām .. 41 ..
meaning:
नमोऽस्तु वासुदेवाय ह्येवमुच्चारिते च तैः ..
शस्त्राणि कुंठतां जग्मुरनलश्चापि शीतताम् .. 41 ..
text_mt: When ‘Homage be to Vāsudeva!’ was thus uttered by them, / the weapons became blunt, and the fire turned cool.

sanskrit_iast:
samabhajyaṃta vastrāṇi samutpeturayomukhāḥ ..
saṃśuṣkā kṣārasaritaḥ patitaḥ śālmalidrumaḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
समभज्यंत वस्त्राणि समुत्पेतुरयोमुखाः ..
संशुष्का क्षारसरितः पतितः शाल्मलिद्रुमः .. 42 ..
text_mt: The bonds shattered; the iron-beaked birds flew away; / the rivers of alkali dried up; the silk-cotton tree fell.

sanskrit_iast:
prakāśastamaso jajñe narakādbhānubhiḥ saha ..
vavau ca yuṃjanpavano'pyasipatravane tataḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
प्रकाशस्तमसो जज्ञे नरकाद्भानुभिः सह ..
ववौ च युंजन्पवनोऽप्यसिपत्रवने ततः .. 43 ..
text_mt: Light arose from the darkness of hell together with rays of the sun, / and a gentle wind blew across the grove of sword-leaved trees.

sanskrit_iast:
nirutsāhā jaḍadhiyo babhūvuryamakiṃkarāḥ ..
jātā gaṅgāmbuvāhinyaḥ pūyaśauṇitanimnagāḥ ..44..
meaning:
निरुत्साहा जडधियो बभूवुर्यमकिंकराः ..
जाता गङ्गाम्बुवाहिन्यः पूयशौणितनिम्नगाः ..44..
text_mt: Yama's servants became powerless and paralyzed in mind; / the rivers of pus and blood became streams flowing with Gaṅgā water.

sanskrit_iast:
divyaḥ sugaṃdhi pavano manaḥprītikarastathā ..
veṇuvīṇāsvanayutāḥ śabdāścāsanmanoramāḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
दिव्यः सुगंधि पवनो मनःप्रीतिकरस्तथा ..
वेणुवीणास्वनयुताः शब्दाश्चासन्मनोरमाः .. 45 ..
text_mt: A divine, fragrant wind blew, bringing delight to the mind, / and delightful sounds mingled with the music of flutes and lutes arose.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ tādṛśamathālakṣya tadā vaivasvato yamaḥ ..
kṣīṇapāpatrayāṃstāṃstu pādyārghyaiḥ samapūjayat .. 46 ..
meaning:
तं तादृशमथालक्ष्य तदा वैवस्वतो यमः ..
क्षीणपापत्रयांस्तांस्तु पाद्यार्घ्यैः समपूजयत् .. 46 ..
text_mt: Then, observing it to be so, Yama, the son of Vivasvat, / honoured those whose three kinds of sins were eradicated with water for the feet and guest-offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā ca tānāha kṛṣṇāya sa kṛtāṃjaliḥ ..
samāhitamatirbhūtvā dharmarājo nareśvara .. 47 ..
meaning:
पूजयित्वा च तानाह कृष्णाय स कृतांजलिः ..
समाहितमतिर्भूत्वा धर्मराजो नरेश्वर .. 47 ..
text_mt: And having honoured them, the King of Dharma, with folded hands / and a concentrated mind, addressed Kṛṣṇa, O lord of men:

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇo deva jagaddhātarjanārdana jagatpate ..
praṇāmaṃ ye'pi kurvanti teṣāmapi namonamaḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
विष्णो देव जगद्धातर्जनार्दन जगत्पते ..
प्रणामं येऽपि कुर्वन्ति तेषामपि नमोनमः .. 48 ..
text_mt: “O Viṣṇu, O God, O Supporter of the World, O Janārdana, O Lord of the Universe! / Homage, homage even to those who make obeisance [to you]!

sanskrit_iast:
acyutāyāprameyāya māyāvāmanarūpiṇe ..
praṇāmaṃ ye'pi kurvanti teṣāmapi namo namaḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
अच्युतायाप्रमेयाय मायावामनरूपिणे ..
प्रणामं येऽपि कुर्वन्ति तेषामपि नमो नमः .. 49 ..
text_mt: To Acyuta, the immeasurable, whose form is the illusory Dwarf! / Homage, homage even to those who make obeisance [to you]!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste vāsudevāya dhīmate puṇyakīrtaye ..
praṇāmaṃ ye ca kurvaṃti teṣāmapi namo namaḥ .. 4.153.50 ..
meaning:
नमस्ते वासुदेवाय धीमते पुण्यकीर्तये ..
प्रणामं ये च कुर्वंति तेषामपि नमो नमः .. 4.153.50 ..
text_mt: Homage to you, O Vāsudeva, wise one of sacred renown! / And homage, homage even to those who make obeisance [to you]!”

sanskrit_iast: tasya yajñavarāhasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ .. 51 ..
meaning: तस्य यज्ञवराहस्य विष्णोरमिततेजसः .. 51 ..
text_mt: […] of that Viṣṇu of boundless splendour, the sacrificial Boar.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ stutvā hṛṣīkeśaṃ dharmarājasya paśyataḥ ..
vimānavaramāruhya nārakāstridivaṃ yayuḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
एवं स्तुत्वा हृषीकेशं धर्मराजस्य पश्यतः ..
विमानवरमारुह्य नारकास्त्रिदिवं ययुः .. 52 ..
text_mt: Having thus praised Hṛṣīkeśa, while the King of Dharma looked on, / the hell-dwellers mounted an excellent celestial chariot and went to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
mudgalo'pi mahābuddhirdṛṣṭvaitadakhilaṃ nṛpa ..
jātismaro bhavadvipraḥ kaṇvagotre mahāmuniḥ ..53..
meaning:
मुद्गलोऽपि महाबुद्धिर्दृष्ट्वैतदखिलं नृप ..
जातिस्मरो भवद्विप्रः कण्वगोत्रे महामुनिः ..53..
text_mt: Mudgala too, of great intelligence, having seen all this, O king, / remembered his past lives—the brahmin, a great sage in the lineage of Kaṇva.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsmṛtya yamavākyāni viṣṇormāhātmyameva ca..
jaladhenostu māhātmyaṃ saṃsmṛtyedamagāyata..54..
meaning:
संस्मृत्य यमवाक्यानि विष्णोर्माहात्म्यमेव च..
जलधेनोस्तु माहात्म्यं संस्मृत्येदमगायत..54..
text_mt: Remembering the words of Yama and the greatness of Viṣṇu, / and remembering the greatness of the water-cow, he sang this:

sanskrit_iast:
aho sudustarā viṣṇormāyeyamatigahvarī ..
yayā mohitacittastu na vetti parameśvaram ..55..
meaning:
अहो सुदुस्तरा विष्णोर्मायेयमतिगह्वरी ..
यया मोहितचित्तस्तु न वेत्ति परमेश्वरम् ..55..
text_mt: “Ah, this Māyā of Viṣṇu is hard to cross, exceedingly deep, / bewildered by which the mind does not know the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
jīvo gacchati kīṭatvaṃ yūkāmatkuṇayonitām..
tasmāddrumalatādīnāṃ yoniṃ tasmācca pakṣiṇām .. 56 ..
meaning:
जीवो गच्छति कीटत्वं यूकामत्कुणयोनिताम्..
तस्माद्द्रुमलतादीनां योनिं तस्माच्च पक्षिणाम् .. 56 ..
text_mt: The soul enters the state of an insect, the womb of a louse or a bug; / from that, the womb of trees, creepers, and the like; from that, of birds;

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca paśutāṃ prāpya naratvamabhivāṃchati ..
tato manuṣyatāṃ prāpya naro yoniṃ kṛtātmanām ..
tāṃ prāpya ca śriyaṃ parāṃ naro māyāvimohitaḥ ..57..
meaning:
ततश्च पशुतां प्राप्य नरत्वमभिवांछति ..
ततो मनुष्यतां प्राप्य नरो योनिं कृतात्मनाम् ..
तां प्राप्य च श्रियं परां नरो मायाविमोहितः ..57..
text_mt: and then, having attained the state of a beast, it longs for the state of a human; / having attained humanity, a person enters the womb of the perfected; / and having attained that and supreme glory, a man is bewildered by Māyā.

sanskrit_iast:
dustarāpi susādhyā sā māyā kṛṣṇasya mohinī ..
vidyate sā manonyastā mudhaiva madhusūdane ..58..
meaning:
दुस्तरापि सुसाध्या सा माया कृष्णस्य मोहिनी ..
विद्यते सा मनोन्यस्ता मुधैव मधुसूदने ..58..
text_mt: Though hard to cross, that bewitching Māyā of Kṛṣṇa is easily mastered; / it is found [vanquished] in Madhusūdana with the mind effortlessly fixed on him.

sanskrit_iast:
avāpyaivaṃ ca gārhasthyamavāpyaivaṃ ca tatparam ..
chinatti vaiṣṇavīṃ māyāṃ keśavārpitamānasaḥ .. 59 ..
meaning:
अवाप्यैवं च गार्हस्थ्यमवाप्यैवं च तत्परम् ..
छिनत्ति वैष्णवीं मायां केशवार्पितमानसः .. 59 ..
text_mt: Having attained householdership in this way, and having attained that supreme [state] in this way, / one whose mind is surrendered to Keśava cuts through the Vaiṣṇava Māyā.

sanskrit_iast:
avirodhena viṣayānbhuñjanviṣṇuṃ samāśrayet ...
bhuktvā narastaratyenāṃ viṣṇormāyāṃ sudustarām .. 4.153.60 ..
meaning:
अविरोधेन विषयान्भुञ्जन्विष्णुं समाश्रयेत् ...
भुक्त्वा नरस्तरत्येनां विष्णोर्मायां सुदुस्तराम् .. 4.153.60 ..
text_mt: Enjoying sense-objects without contradiction [to dharma], one should take refuge in Viṣṇu; / having enjoyed them, a man crosses over this Māyā of Viṣṇu, which is very hard to cross.

sanskrit_iast:
īdṛgbahuphalā bhaktiḥ sarvadhātari keśave ..
māyayā tasya devasya tāṃ na kurvaṃti mohitāḥ .. .. 61 ..
meaning:
ईदृग्बहुफला भक्तिः सर्वधातरि केशवे ..
मायया तस्य देवस्य तां न कुर्वंति मोहिताः .. .. 61 ..
text_mt: Such is devotion yielding manifold fruits toward Keśava, the creator of all; / deluded by that god’s Māyā, they do not practice it.

sanskrit_iast:
mudhaivoktaṃ sudhāpānaṃ mudhā taddhi viceṣṭitam ..
mudhaiva janma tannaṣṭaṃ yatra nārādhito hariḥ .. 62 ..
meaning:
मुधैवोक्तं सुधापानं मुधा तद्धि विचेष्टितम् ..
मुधैव जन्म तन्नष्टं यत्र नाराधितो हरिः .. 62 ..
text_mt: In vain is the drinking of nectar spoken of; in vain indeed is that effort; / in vain indeed is that birth lost in which Hari is not worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhito hi yaḥ puṃsāmaihikāmuṣmikaṃ phalam ..
dadāti bhagavāndevaḥ kastaṃ na pratipūjayet .. 63 ..
meaning:
आराधितो हि यः पुंसामैहिकामुष्मिकं फलम् ..
ददाति भगवान्देवः कस्तं न प्रतिपूजयेत् .. 63 ..
text_mt: For when worshipped, the Lord God bestows the fruit / of this world and the next—who would not worship him?

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsarāstathā māsā viphalā divasāśca te ..
narāṇāṃ viṣayāṃdhānāṃ yaistu nārādhito hariḥ .. 64 ..
meaning:
संवत्सरास्तथा मासा विफला दिवसाश्च ते ..
नराणां विषयांधानां यैस्तु नाराधितो हरिः .. 64 ..
text_mt: The years, the months, and the days are completely wasted / for men blinded by sense-objects, by whom Hari is not worshipped.”

sanskrit_iast:
yo na vittarddhivibhavairna vāsobhirna bhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
tuṣyate hṛdayenaiva kastamīśaṃ na pūjayet .. 65 ..
meaning:
यो न वित्तर्द्धिविभवैर्न वासोभिर्न भूषणैः ..
तुष्यते हृदयेनैव कस्तमीशं न पूजयेत् .. 65 ..
text_mt: He who is pleased not by the abundance of wealth and power, not by garments, not by ornaments, / but by the heart alone—who would not worship that Lord?

sanskrit_iast:
jaladhenostu māhātmyaṃ niśamyedṛgvidhaṃ narāḥ..
nātra yacchaṃti teṣāṃ vai vivekaḥ kutra tiṣṭhati .. 66 ..
meaning:
जलधेनोस्तु माहात्म्यं निशम्येदृग्विधं नराः..
नात्र यच्छंति तेषां वै विवेकः कुत्र तिष्ठति .. 66 ..
text_mt: Having heard of such greatness of the water-cow, / if men do not offer it here, where indeed does their discernment abide?

sanskrit_iast:
karmabhūmau hi mānuṣyaṃ janmanāmayutairapi ..
svargāpavargaphaladaṃ kadācitprāpyate naraiḥ .. 67 ..
meaning:
कर्मभूमौ हि मानुष्यं जन्मनामयुतैरपि ..
स्वर्गापवर्गफलदं कदाचित्प्राप्यते नरैः .. 67 ..
text_mt: For human birth in this realm of action, which yields the fruits of heaven and liberation, / is obtained by men only occasionally, even after ten thousand births.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāpya ca na yairviṣṇustoṣito jaladhenunā ..
te janā bhraṣṭajanmāno vaṃcitāstasya māyayā .. 68 ..
meaning:
संप्राप्य च न यैर्विष्णुस्तोषितो जलधेनुना ..
ते जना भ्रष्टजन्मानो वंचितास्तस्य मायया .. 68 ..
text_mt: And having attained it, those by whom Viṣṇu is not gratified with a water-cow— / those people have wasted their lives, deceived by his Māyā.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvabāhurviraumyeṣa dṛṣṭalokadvayo'smi bhoḥ ..
ārādhayadhvaṃ govindaṃ jaladhenuṃ prayacchata .. 69 ..
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वबाहुर्विरौम्येष दृष्टलोकद्वयोऽस्मि भोः ..
आराधयध्वं गोविन्दं जलधेनुं प्रयच्छत .. 69 ..
text_mt: With upraised arms I cry aloud, O men, having witnessed both worlds: / Worship Govinda! Give a water-cow!

sanskrit_iast:
duḥsaho nārako vahniraviṣahyā ca yātanā ..
jñātaṃ mayaitadālaṃbya kṛṣṇaṃ bhavati niścalaḥ .. 4.153.70 ..
meaning:
दुःसहो नारको वह्निरविषह्या च यातना ..
ज्ञातं मयैतदालंब्य कृष्णं भवति निश्चलः .. 4.153.70 ..
text_mt: Unbearable is the fire of hell, and insufferable is its torment. / I have known this: relying upon Kṛṣṇa, one becomes unshaken.

sanskrit_iast:
ādeśiko deśiko hi yamamārge sudustare ..
vicintya tatsatyametanmanaḥ kṛṣṇe niveśyatām .. 71 ..
meaning:
आदेशिको देशिको हि यममार्गे सुदुस्तरे ..
विचिन्त्य तत्सत्यमेतन्मनः कृष्णे निवेश्यताम् .. 71 ..
text_mt: He is indeed the teacher and guide on the path of Yama, so hard to traverse. / Reflecting on this truth, let the mind be fixed on Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭena kiṃ kratuśatena suduṣkareṇa kleśādhikena sukṛtairniyamairvrataiśca ..
dattā dvijāya pitṛrājagṛhaṃ gatasya hyekā'pi gaurjalamayī sukhamātanoti ..72... ..
ghṛtadhenudānavratavarṇanam
meaning:
इष्टेन किं क्रतुशतेन सुदुष्करेण क्लेशाधिकेन सुकृतैर्नियमैर्व्रतैश्च ..
दत्ता द्विजाय पितृराजगृहं गतस्य ह्येकाऽपि गौर्जलमयी सुखमातनोति ..72... ..
घृतधेनुदानव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
What is the use of a hundred sacrifices, so hard to perform, accompanied by much hardship, or of well-done restraints and votive observances? / Even a single cow made of water, given to a twice-born, extends happiness to one who has gone to the abode of the King of the Ancestors.
Description of the Votive Observance of the Gift of a Ghee-Cow

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ghṛtadhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi tāṃ śṛṇuṣva narottama ..
dīyate yena vidhinā yādṛgrūpāṃ ca kārayet .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
घृतधेनुं प्रवक्ष्यामि तां शृणुष्व नरोत्तम ..
दीयते येन विधिना यादृग्रूपां च कारयेत् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / I shall describe the ghee-cow; listen to it, best of men, / according to which rite it is given and in what form one should fashion it.
title: Ghṛtadhenudānavratavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
gavyasya sarpiṣaḥ kumbhāngaṃdhamālyavibhūṣitān ..
kāṃsyopadohasaṃyuktānsitavastrāvaguṇṭhitān.. 2 ..
meaning:
गव्यस्य सर्पिषः कुम्भान्गंधमाल्यविभूषितान् ..
कांस्योपदोहसंयुक्तान्सितवस्त्रावगुण्ठितान्.. 2 ..
text_mt: Pots of cow's ghee, adorned with fragrant scents and garlands, / provided with bronze milking vessels, veiled with white cloth,

sanskrit_iast:
ikṣuyaṣṭimayāḥ pādāḥ khurā raupyamayāstathā ..
sauvarṇe cākṣiṇī kārye śṛṃge cāgurukāṣṭhake .. 3 ..
meaning:
इक्षुयष्टिमयाः पादाः खुरा रौप्यमयास्तथा ..
सौवर्णे चाक्षिणी कार्ये शृंगे चागुरुकाष्ठके .. 3 ..
text_mt: the legs made of sugar-cane stalks, and the hooves made of silver; / the eyes should be made of gold, and the horns of agallochum wood;

sanskrit_iast:
saptadhānyamaye pārśve paṭorṇena ca kambalam ..
kuryātturuṣkakarpūrairghrāṇaṃ phalamayānstanān .. 4 ..
meaning:
सप्तधान्यमये पार्श्वे पटोर्णेन च कम्बलम् ..
कुर्यात्तुरुष्ककर्पूरैर्घ्राणं फलमयान्स्तनान् .. 4 ..
text_mt: the flanks made of seven grains, and the dewlap of silk; / one should fashion the snout of Turkish incense and camphor, and the udders made of fruits;

sanskrit_iast:
tadvaccharkarayā jihvāṃ guḍakṣīramayaṃ mukham ..
kṣaumasūtreṇa lāṃgūlaṃ romāṇi sitasarṣapaiḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
तद्वच्छर्करया जिह्वां गुडक्षीरमयं मुखम् ..
क्षौमसूत्रेण लांगूलं रोमाणि सितसर्षपैः .. 5 ..
text_mt: likewise the tongue of sugar, the face made of molasses and milk, / the tail of flaxen thread, and the hair of white mustard seeds.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmrapātramayaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ kuryācchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
īdṛgrūpāṃ tu saṃkalpya ghṛtadhenuṃ narādhipa .. 6 ..
meaning:
ताम्रपात्रमयं पृष्ठं कुर्याच्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः ..
ईदृग्रूपां तु संकल्प्य घृतधेनुं नराधिप .. 6 ..
text_mt: One endowed with faith should make the back of a copper vessel. / Having thus fashioned the ghee-cow, O king of men,

sanskrit_iast:
tadvatkalpanayā dhenorvatsaṃ ca parikalpayet ..
maṃtreṇānena rājendra tāṃ samabhyarcya buddhimān .. 7 ..
meaning:
तद्वत्कल्पनया धेनोर्वत्सं च परिकल्पयेत् ..
मंत्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र तां समभ्यर्च्य बुद्धिमान् .. 7 ..
text_mt: by a similar design, one should also fashion the cow's calf. / Having worshipped her with this mantra, O king of kings, the wise man [recites]:

sanskrit_iast:
ājyaṃ tejaḥ samuddiṣṭamājyaṃ pāpaharaṃ param ..
ājyaṃ surāṇāmāhāraḥ sarvamājye pratiṣṭhitam.. 8 ..
meaning:
आज्यं तेजः समुद्दिष्टमाज्यं पापहरं परम् ..
आज्यं सुराणामाहारः सर्वमाज्ये प्रतिष्ठितम्.. 8 ..
text_mt: "Clarified butter is declared to be fiery energy; clarified butter is the supreme destroyer of sin; / clarified butter is the food of the gods; everything is established in clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ caivājyamayī devi kalpitāsi mayā kila ..
sarvapāpāpanodāya sukhāya bhava bhāmini .. 9 ..
meaning:
त्वं चैवाज्यमयी देवि कल्पितासि मया किल ..
सर्वपापापनोदाय सुखाय भव भामिनि .. 9 ..
text_mt: And you, O goddess, are indeed fashioned by me out of clarified butter. / For the removal of all sins, bring happiness, O radiant one!"

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ ca vipraṃ mahābhāga manaseva ghṛtārciṣā ..
kalpayitvā tatastasmai prayataḥ pratipādayet .. 4.154.10 ..
meaning:
तं च विप्रं महाभाग मनसेव घृतार्चिषा ..
कल्पयित्वा ततस्तस्मै प्रयतः प्रतिपादयेत् .. 4.154.10 ..
text_mt: And conceiving that Brahmin in one's mind as the deity of fire, O fortunate one, / one who is purified should then present it to him:

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāsahitā dhenuḥ kalpitājyamayī śubhā ..
etāṃ mamopakārāya gṛhāṇa tvaṃ dvijottama ..11..
meaning:
दक्षिणासहिता धेनुः कल्पिताज्यमयी शुभा ..
एतां ममोपकाराय गृहाण त्वं द्विजोत्तम ..11..
text_mt: "This auspicious cow fashioned of clarified butter, accompanied by a priestly gift— / accept this, O best of the twice-born, for my spiritual benefit."

sanskrit_iast:
ityudāhṛtya viprāya tāṃ gāṃ tu pratipādayet ..
dattvaikarātraṃ sthitvā ca ghṛtāhāro yatavrataḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
इत्युदाहृत्य विप्राय तां गां तु प्रतिपादयेत् ..
दत्त्वैकरात्रं स्थित्वा च घृताहारो यतव्रतः .. 12 ..
text_mt: Having said this, he should present that cow to the Brahmin. / Having given it, he should remain for one night eating only ghee, restraining his vows.

sanskrit_iast:
anena ca vidhānena navanītamayī śubhā ..
dātavyā nṛpate dhenurnyūnādhikavivarjitā .. 13 ..
meaning:
अनेन च विधानेन नवनीतमयी शुभा ..
दातव्या नृपते धेनुर्न्यूनाधिकविवर्जिता .. 13 ..
text_mt: And by this same procedure, O king, an auspicious cow / made of fresh butter should be given, without omitting or adding [anything].

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu pārtha mahābāho pradānaphalamuttamam..
ghṛtakṣīramahānadyo yatra pāyasakardamāḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
शृणु पार्थ महाबाहो प्रदानफलमुत्तमम्..
घृतक्षीरमहानद्यो यत्र पायसकर्दमाः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Hear, O long-armed son of Pṛthā, the supreme fruit of this gift: / Where there are great rivers of ghee and milk, with mud of milk-rice,

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtadhenupradā yāṃti tatra kāmaiḥ supūritāḥ ..
piturūrdhvaṃ ca ye sapta puruṣāstasya ye'pyadhaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
घृतधेनुप्रदा यांति तत्र कामैः सुपूरिताः ..
पितुरूर्ध्वं च ये सप्त पुरुषास्तस्य येऽप्यधः .. 15 ..
text_mt: there the givers of a ghee-cow go, fully satisfied in their desires. / And whichever seven generations are above his father, and whichever are below,

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃsteṣu nṛpa lokeṣu sa nayatyastakalmaṣān..
sakāmānāmiyaṃ vyuṣṭiḥ kathitā nṛpasattama .. 16 ..
meaning:
तांस्तेषु नृप लोकेषु स नयत्यस्तकल्मषान्..
सकामानामियं व्युष्टिः कथिता नृपसत्तम .. 16 ..
text_mt: those he leads to those worlds, their sins removed, O king. / This reward has been declared for those who have desires, O best of kings;

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkilviṣaṃ padaṃ yāṃti niṣkāmā ghṛtadhenudāḥ ..
ghṛtamagnirghṛtaṃ somastanmayāḥ sarvadevatāḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
निष्किल्विषं पदं यांति निष्कामा घृतधेनुदाः ..
घृतमग्निर्घृतं सोमस्तन्मयाः सर्वदेवताः .. 17 ..
text_mt: the desireless givers of a ghee-cow go to a stainless station. / Ghee is Agni, ghee is Soma; all the deities are made of it;

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtaṃ prayacchatāṃ bhītā bhavaṃtyakhiladevatāḥ .. 18 ..
meaning: घृतं प्रयच्छतां भीता भवंत्यखिलदेवताः .. 18 ..
text_mt: to those who offer ghee, all the gods become benevolent.

sanskrit_iast:
māyājalaṃ sutakalatramahormimālaṃ lobhogranakraviṣamaṃ bahupuṇyabhājaḥ ..
lagnā nimagnavapuṣo ghṛtadhenupucche saṃsārasāgaramapāramaho taraṃti .. 19 .. ..
lavaṇadhenudānavratavarṇanam
meaning:
मायाजलं सुतकलत्रमहोर्मिमालं लोभोग्रनक्रविषमं बहुपुण्यभाजः ..
लग्ना निमग्नवपुषो घृतधेनुपुच्छे संसारसागरमपारमहो तरंति .. 19 .. ..
लवणधेनुदानव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Having clinged to the tail of the ghee-cow when their bodies are submerged, those possessing great merit / cross over this boundless ocean of worldly existence, whose waters are Māyā, whose mass of great waves are sons and wives, and which is perilous with the fierce crocodiles of greed—ah!
Description of the Votive Observance of the Gift of a Salt-Cow

sanskrit_iast:
.. .. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa mahābāho sarvaśāstraviśārada ..
kathayasveha dānānāmuttamaṃ yatprakīrtitam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. .. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
कृष्णकृष्ण महाबाहो सर्वशास्त्रविशारद ..
कथयस्वेह दानानामुत्तमं यत्प्रकीर्तितम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / O Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, O mighty-armed one, skilled in all scriptures, / tell me here what is proclaimed as the best of gifts,
title: Lavaṇadhenudānavratavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
yena dattena dānāni sarvāṇyeva bhavaṃtyuta ..
sarvakāmasamṛddhiśca sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet .. 2 ..
meaning:
येन दत्तेन दानानि सर्वाण्येव भवंत्युत ..
सर्वकामसमृद्धिश्च सर्वपापक्षयो भवेत् .. 2 ..
text_mt: by the giving of which all gifts indeed become accomplished, / and there comes about the fulfillment of all desires and the destruction of all sins,

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittaviśuddhiśca tanme kathaya suvrata ..
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi dānānāmuttamottamam .. 3 ..
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तविशुद्धिश्च तन्मे कथय सुव्रत ..
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ..
शृणु राजन्प्रवक्ष्यामि दानानामुत्तमोत्तमम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: and purification through expiation; tell me that, O you of noble vows! / Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Hear, O king, I shall declare the highest of gifts,

sanskrit_iast:
khyātaṃ lavaṇadhenvākhyaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām ..
yāṃ dattvā brahmahā goghnaḥ pitṛhā gurutalpagaḥ .. .. 4 ..
meaning:
ख्यातं लवणधेन्वाख्यं सर्वकामप्रदं नृणाम् ..
यां दत्त्वा ब्रह्महा गोघ्नः पितृहा गुरुतल्पगः .. .. 4 ..
text_mt: known as the salt-cow, which grants all desires to mortals. / Giving which, the slayer of a Brahmin, the slayer of a cow, the slayer of a father, one who violates his guru's bed,

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāsaghātī krūrātmā sarvapāparato'pi vā..
mucyate nātra saṃdehaḥ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati .. 5 ..
meaning:
विश्वासघाती क्रूरात्मा सर्वपापरतोऽपि वा..
मुच्यते नात्र संदेहः शिवलोकं स गच्छति .. 5 ..
text_mt: a betrayer of trust, one of cruel nature, or even one devoted to all sins, / is freed—there is no doubt here—and goes to the world of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
subhago dhanasaṃpanno dīrghāyuraparājitaḥ ..
jāyate puruṣo loke sarvakāmasamanvitaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
सुभगो धनसंपन्नो दीर्घायुरपराजितः ..
जायते पुरुषो लोके सर्वकामसमन्वितः .. 6 ..
text_mt: He is born in the world fortunate, rich in wealth, long-lived, undefeated, / and endowed with all desired things.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhiṃ vakṣyāmi rājendra lavaṇasyeha kalpanam ..
gomayenopaliptena darbhasaṃstarasaṃsthitam .. 7 ..
meaning:
विधिं वक्ष्यामि राजेन्द्र लवणस्येह कल्पनम् ..
गोमयेनोपलिप्तेन दर्भसंस्तरसंस्थितम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: I shall state the procedure here, O king of kings, for the fashioning out of salt: / Upon [ground] smeared with cow-dung and spread with a layer of darbha grass,

sanskrit_iast:
āvikaṃ carma vinyasya pūrvāśābhimukhaṃ sthitam ..
vastreṇācchāditaṃ kṛtvā dhenuṃ kurvīta buddhimān .. 8 ..
meaning:
आविकं चर्म विन्यस्य पूर्वाशाभिमुखं स्थितम् ..
वस्त्रेणाच्छादितं कृत्वा धेनुं कुर्वीत बुद्धिमान् .. 8 ..
text_mt: having laid down a sheepskin facing the eastern quarter / and covered it with cloth, the wise man should fashion the cow.

sanskrit_iast:
āḍhakenaiva kurvīta vahuvitto'lpavittavān ..
svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāmikṣupādāṃ phalastanīm .. 9 ..
meaning:
आढकेनैव कुर्वीत वहुवित्तोऽल्पवित्तवान् ..
स्वर्णशृङ्गीं रौप्यखुरामिक्षुपादां फलस्तनीम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: One of great wealth or one of little wealth should fashion it with [four or fewer] āḍhakas; / with golden horns, silver hooves, sugarcane legs, and fruit udders,

sanskrit_iast:
kāryā śarkarayā jihvā gandhaprāṇavatī tathā ..
samudrodaraje śuktī karṇau tasyāḥ prakalpayet.. 4.155.10 ..
meaning:
कार्या शर्करया जिह्वा गन्धप्राणवती तथा ..
समुद्रोदरजे शुक्ती कर्णौ तस्याः प्रकल्पयेत्.. 4.155.10 ..
text_mt: the tongue should be made of sugar, possessing a fragrant breath; / one should fashion its ears from two oyster shells produced in the belly of the sea;

sanskrit_iast:
kaṃbalaṃ paṭṭasūtreṇa grīvāyāṃ ghaṇṭikāṃ tathā ..
śṛṃge candanakāṣṭhābhyāṃ mauktike cākṣiṇī ubhe .. 11 ..
meaning:
कंबलं पट्टसूत्रेण ग्रीवायां घण्टिकां तथा ..
शृंगे चन्दनकाष्ठाभ्यां मौक्तिके चाक्षिणी उभे .. 11 ..
text_mt: the dewlap with silk thread, and a little bell on the neck; / the horns with two pieces of sandalwood, and both eyes with pearls;

sanskrit_iast:
kapolau saktupiṇḍābhyāṃ yavānāsye pradāpayet ..
tilānpārśve prakurvīta godhūmāścaiva bhaktitaḥ ..12..
meaning:
कपोलौ सक्तुपिण्डाभ्यां यवानास्ये प्रदापयेत् ..
तिलान्पार्श्वे प्रकुर्वीत गोधूमाश्चैव भक्तितः ..12..
text_mt: the cheeks with two balls of roasted grain flour, and one should place barley in the mouth; / one should fashion the flanks with sesame seeds, and wheat also, with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vai saptadhānyāni yathālābhaṃ prakalpayet ..
pṛṣṭhe vai tāmrapātraṃ tu apāne guḍa piṃḍikām ..13..
meaning:
एवं वै सप्तधान्यानि यथालाभं प्रकल्पयेत् ..
पृष्ठे वै ताम्रपात्रं तु अपाने गुड पिंडिकाम् ..13..
text_mt: Thus indeed one should arrange the seven grains as they are obtained, / a copper vessel upon the back, and a lump of molasses at the anus.

sanskrit_iast:
lāṃgūle kaṃbalaṃ dadyāddrākṣāṃ kṣīrapradeśataḥ ..
yonipradeśe ca madhu sarvavastuphalānvitam ..14..
meaning:
लांगूले कंबलं दद्याद्द्राक्षां क्षीरप्रदेशतः ..
योनिप्रदेशे च मधु सर्ववस्तुफलान्वितम् ..14..
text_mt: One should place a blanket on the tail, grapes at the region of the milk, / and honey at the vulva region, along with all kinds of substances and fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ samyakparisthāpya rasarasyamayīṃ ca gām ..
sthāpayedvatsamekaṃ ca caturbhāgena mānavaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
एवं सम्यक्परिस्थाप्य रसरस्यमयीं च गाम् ..
स्थापयेद्वत्समेकं च चतुर्भागेन मानवः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Having thus completely set up the cow composed of the relish of saps, / a man should place a calf using one fourth [of the materials].

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dhenuṃ samabhyarcya mālyavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
snātvā devārcanaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇānabhipūjya ca ..
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇāṃ gāṃ tu putrabhāryāsamanvitaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
एवं धेनुं समभ्यर्च्य माल्यवस्त्रविभूषणैः ..
स्नात्वा देवार्चनं कृत्वा ब्राह्मणानभिपूज्य च ..
कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणां गां तु पुत्रभार्यासमन्वितः .. 16 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped the cow in this way with garlands, garments, and ornaments, / having bathed, performed the worship of the gods, and honoured the brāhmaṇas, / and having circumambulated the cow together with his son and wife,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāya suśīlāya vṛttayuktāya vai nṛpa ..
dadyātparvasu sarveṣu mantrapūrvaṃ subhaktitaḥ..17..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाय सुशीलाय वृत्तयुक्ताय वै नृप ..
दद्यात्पर्वसु सर्वेषु मन्त्रपूर्वं सुभक्तितः..17..
text_mt: O king, one should give it to a well-behaved brāhmaṇa endowed with good conduct / on all festival days with devotion, preceded by the mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
lavaṇe vai rasāḥ sarve lavaṇe sarvadevatāḥ ..
sarvadevamaye devi lavaṇākhye namo'stu te .. 18 ..
meaning:
लवणे वै रसाः सर्वे लवणे सर्वदेवताः ..
सर्वदेवमये देवि लवणाख्ये नमोऽस्तु ते .. 18 ..
text_mt: “All tastes indeed dwell in salt; all deities dwell in salt. / O goddess composed of all deities, named Salt, reverence be to you!”

sanskrit_iast:
evamuccārya maṃtrāṃ te viprāya pratipādayet ..
samyakpradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇāsahitāṃ nṛpa .. 19 ..
meaning:
एवमुच्चार्य मंत्रां ते विप्राय प्रतिपादयेत् ..
सम्यक्प्रदक्षिणां कृत्वा दक्षिणासहितां नृप .. 19 ..
text_mt: Having uttered these mantras, he should present it to the brāhmaṇa, / having duly circumambulated it together with a sacrificial fee, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
pradakṣiṇā mahī tena kṛtā bhavati bhārata ..
sarvadānāni dattāni sarvakratuphalāni ca .. 4.155.20 ..
meaning:
प्रदक्षिणा मही तेन कृता भवति भारत ..
सर्वदानानि दत्तानि सर्वक्रतुफलानि च .. 4.155.20 ..
text_mt: By him, O descendant of Bharata, the earth has been circumambulated; / all gifts have been given, and the fruits of all sacrifices attained.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve rasāḥ sarvamannaṃ sarvaṃ ca sacarācaram ..
saubhāgyaṃ paramā buddhirārogyaṃ sarvasaṃpadaḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
सर्वे रसाः सर्वमन्नं सर्वं च सचराचरम् ..
सौभाग्यं परमा बुद्धिरारोग्यं सर्वसंपदः .. 21 ..
text_mt: All essences, all food, and all that moves and is still, / good fortune, supreme intellect, health, and all prosperities

sanskrit_iast:
bhavati dattvā nṛṇāṃ tu rasadhenuṃ na saṃśayaḥ ..
svarge ca niyatā vāso yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 22 ..
meaning:
भवति दत्त्वा नृणां तु रसधेनुं न संशयः ..
स्वर्गे च नियता वासो यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: are gained by men who give a sap-cow, without doubt; / and their dwelling in heaven is certain until the universal deluge.

sanskrit_iast:
parṇaurṇakaṃbalagalāṃ lavaṇāḍhakena kṛtvā phalastanavatīmapi lāvaṇākhyām ..
dattvā dvijāya vidhivadrasadhenumenāṃ lokaṃ gavāṃ sakalasaukhyayuto viśetsaḥ .. 23 ..
suvarṇadhenudānavratavarṇanam
meaning:
पर्णौर्णकंबलगलां लवणाढकेन कृत्वा फलस्तनवतीमपि लावणाख्याम् ..
दत्त्वा द्विजाय विधिवद्रसधेनुमेनां लोकं गवां सकलसौख्ययुतो विशेत्सः .. 23 ..
सुवर्णधेनुदानव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Having made [her] with betel leaves for a dewlap, a woolen blanket, an āḍhaka of salt, and fruit-udders, named Salt, / and having given this sap-cow according to rule to a twice-born, he would enter the world of cows, endowed with all happiness.
Description of the vow of the gift of the golden cow.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi rājankāñcanadhenukām ..
yāṃ dattvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि राजन्काञ्चनधेनुकाम् ..
यां दत्त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Hereafter I shall speak, O king, of the golden cow, / having given which one is released from all sins; of this there is no doubt.
title: Suvarṇadhenudānavratavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
surāpo brahmahā goghno bhīrurbhagnavrato'pi vā ..
gurughātī svasṛgāmī paradārarataśca yaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
सुरापो ब्रह्महा गोघ्नो भीरुर्भग्नव्रतोऽपि वा ..
गुरुघाती स्वसृगामी परदाररतश्च यः .. 2 ..
text_mt: A drinker of liquor, a killer of a brāhmaṇa, a cow-killer, a coward, or one who has broken vows, / a slayer of a guru, one who has incest with his sister, and one who delights in another's wife—

sanskrit_iast:
mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvairdattvā kāñcanadhenukām ..
saṃśuddhasya suvarṇasya paṃcāśatpalikāṃ śubhām .. 3 ..
meaning:
मुच्यते पातकैः सर्वैर्दत्त्वा काञ्चनधेनुकाम् ..
संशुद्धस्य सुवर्णस्य पंचाशत्पलिकां शुभाम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: is freed from all sins by giving the golden cow, / an auspicious one made of fifty palas of purified gold.

sanskrit_iast:
arddhena vā prakurvīta śaktyā vā nṛpasattama ..
ukhāṃ paścimabhāge tu dṛṣṭakukṣipayodharām .. 4 ..
meaning:
अर्द्धेन वा प्रकुर्वीत शक्त्या वा नृपसत्तम ..
उखां पश्चिमभागे तु दृष्टकुक्षिपयोधराम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Or, O best of kings, one may make it with half that, or according to one's capacity, / with a vessel in the western part, having belly and udders made visible,

sanskrit_iast:
vibhaktāṅgīṃ sujaghanāṃ sumanoharakarṇikām ..
sarvaratnavicitrāṅgīṃ kārayetkapilāṃ śubhām .. 5 ..
meaning:
विभक्ताङ्गीं सुजघनां सुमनोहरकर्णिकाम् ..
सर्वरत्नविचित्राङ्गीं कारयेत्कपिलां शुभाम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: with well-proportioned limbs, beautiful hips, and charming ears; / one should cause an auspicious brown cow to be fashioned, variegated in all its limbs with all kinds of gems.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthena tu bhāgena vatsaṃ tasyāḥ prakalpayet ..
raupyaghaṭāṃ ca dattvā tu kauśeyaparivāritām .. 6 ..
meaning:
चतुर्थेन तु भागेन वत्सं तस्याः प्रकल्पयेत् ..
रौप्यघटां च दत्त्वा तु कौशेयपरिवारिताम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: One should fashion her calf with a fourth of the [weight of the] portion, / and having provided a silver milk-pail, surrounded by silk,

sanskrit_iast:
tāmraśṛṃgīṃ tathā kuryādvaiḍūryamayakaṃbalām ..
muktāphalamaye netre vaidrumī rasanā tathā .. 7 ..
meaning:
ताम्रशृंगीं तथा कुर्याद्वैडूर्यमयकंबलाम् ..
मुक्ताफलमये नेत्रे वैद्रुमी रसना तथा .. 7 ..
text_mt: one should likewise make her with copper horns and a cat's-eye blanket; / the two eyes made of pearls, and the tongue made of coral.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇājine guḍaprasthaṃ tatrasthāṃ kārayecchubhām..
kuṃbhāṣṭakasamopetāṃ nānā phalasamanvitām .. 8 ..
meaning:
कृष्णाजिने गुडप्रस्थं तत्रस्थां कारयेच्छुभाम्..
कुंभाष्टकसमोपेतां नाना फलसमन्विताम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: He should cause that auspicious cow to be placed upon a black antelope skin with a prastha of raw sugar, / accompanied by eight jars and endowed with various fruits,

sanskrit_iast:
tathāṣṭādaśa dhānyātapatropānadyugānvitām ..
bhājanaṃ vasanaṃ caiva tāmradohanakaṃ tathā .. 9 ..
meaning:
तथाष्टादश धान्यातपत्रोपानद्युगान्विताम् ..
भाजनं वसनं चैव ताम्रदोहनकं तथा .. 9 ..
text_mt: equipped with the eighteen grains, an umbrella, and a pair of sandals, / a vessel, clothing, and a copper milking vessel,

sanskrit_iast:
dīpakānnādilavaṇaśarkarādhānyakānvitām ..
pradadyādbrāhmaṇaṃ pūjya vastrairābharaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 4.156.10 ..
meaning:
दीपकान्नादिलवणशर्कराधान्यकान्विताम् ..
प्रदद्याद्ब्राह्मणं पूज्य वस्त्रैराभरणैः शुभैः .. 4.156.10 ..
text_mt: provided with lamps, cooked food, salt, sugar, and coriander; / having worshipped the brāhmaṇa with auspicious garments and ornaments, he should give it.

sanskrit_iast:
snātaḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya dhenuṃ sarvāṅgasaṃyutām ..
guḍadhenūktamaṃtraiśca āvāhya pratipūjya ca .. 11 ..
meaning:
स्नातः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य धेनुं सर्वाङ्गसंयुताम् ..
गुडधेनूक्तमंत्रैश्च आवाह्य प्रतिपूज्य च .. 11 ..
text_mt: Having bathed, having circumambulated the cow equipped with all limbs, / and having invoked and worshipped it with the mantras spoken for the sugar-cow,

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ sarvadevagaṇamandirabhūṣaṇāsi viśveśvaratripathagodadhiparvatānām ..
śraddhāmbutīkṣṇaśakalīkṛtapātakaughaḥ prāpnoti nirvṛtimatīva parāṃ namāmi ..12..
meaning:
त्वं सर्वदेवगणमन्दिरभूषणासि विश्वेश्वरत्रिपथगोदधिपर्वतानाम् ..
श्रद्धाम्बुतीक्ष्णशकलीकृतपातकौघः प्राप्नोति निर्वृतिमतीव परां नमामि ..12..
text_mt: “You are the ornament of the abode of all hosts of gods, of Viśveśvara, the Ganges, the ocean, and the mountains; / he whose heap of sins is sharply shattered by the water of faith attains the highest bliss; I bow to you!

sanskrit_iast:
loke yathepsitaphalārthavidhāyinī tvāmāsādya ko hi bhayabhāgbhavatīha martyaḥ .. (pāṭhā. bhayabhāgyavatīha)
saṃsāraduḥkhaśamanāya yatastvakāmāstvāṃ kāmadhenumiti vedavido vadaṃti .. 13 ..
meaning:
लोके यथेप्सितफलार्थविधायिनी त्वामासाद्य को हि भयभाग्भवतीह मर्त्यः .. (पाठा. भयभाग्यवतीह)
संसारदुःखशमनाय यतस्त्वकामास्त्वां कामधेनुमिति वेदविदो वदंति .. 13 ..
text_mt: Bestowing the desired fruit and wealth in the world, having approached you, what mortal here has fear? / Because you fulfill desires for the calming of worldly sorrow, those who know the Vedas call you the wish-fulfilling cow.”

sanskrit_iast:
evamāmantrya tāṃ dhenuṃ viprāya pratipādayet ..
sadakṣiṇopaskarāṃ ca praṇipatya kṣamāpayet .. 14 ..
meaning:
एवमामन्त्र्य तां धेनुं विप्राय प्रतिपादयेत् ..
सदक्षिणोपस्करां च प्रणिपत्य क्षमापयेत् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Having addressed that cow thus, he should hand it over to the brāhmaṇa / along with the sacrificial fee and accessories, and, having prostrated, ask for pardon.

sanskrit_iast:
dānakāle tu ye devāstīrthāni manavastathā ..
śarīre nivasaṃtyasyāstāñchṛṇuṣva narādhipa .. 15 ..
meaning:
दानकाले तु ये देवास्तीर्थानि मनवस्तथा ..
शरीरे निवसंत्यस्यास्ताञ्छृणुष्व नराधिप .. 15 ..
text_mt: Hear, O king, which gods, sacred fords, and Manus / reside in her body at the time of giving:

sanskrit_iast:
netrayoḥ sūryaśaśinau jihvāyāṃ tu sarasvatī ..
daṃteṣu maruto devāḥ karṇayośca tathāśvinau .. 16 ..
meaning:
नेत्रयोः सूर्यशशिनौ जिह्वायां तु सरस्वती ..
दंतेषु मरुतो देवाः कर्णयोश्च तथाश्विनौ .. 16 ..
text_mt: The sun and moon are in her eyes, and Sarasvatī is upon her tongue; / the Maruts are in her teeth, and the two Aśvins in her ears.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṃgāgragau sadā cāsyā devau rudrapitāmahau ..
gaṃdharvāpsarasaścaiva kakuddeśaṃ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ..
kukṣau samudrāścatvāro yonau tripathagāminī .. 17 ..
meaning:
शृंगाग्रगौ सदा चास्या देवौ रुद्रपितामहौ ..
गंधर्वाप्सरसश्चैव ककुद्देशं प्रतिष्ठिताः ..
कुक्षौ समुद्राश्चत्वारो योनौ त्रिपथगामिनी .. 17 ..
text_mt: Rudra and the Grandfather [Brahmā] are always on the tips of her horns; / Gandharvas and Apsarases reside in the region of the hump; / the four oceans are in her belly, and the triple-coursed river [Gaṅgā] is in her vulva.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayo romakūpeṣu apāne vasudhā sthitā ..
antreṣu nāgā vijñeyāḥ parvatāścāsthiṣu sthitāḥ .. .. 18 ..
meaning:
ऋषयो रोमकूपेषु अपाने वसुधा स्थिता ..
अन्त्रेषु नागा विज्ञेयाः पर्वताश्चास्थिषु स्थिताः .. .. 18 ..
text_mt: The sages reside in the hair follicles, and the earth in her anus; / the Nāgas are to be known in her entrails, and mountains in her bones.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmakāmārthamokṣāstu pādeṣu parisaṃsthitāḥ ..
huṃkāre ca caturvedāḥ kaṃṭhe rudrāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
धर्मकामार्थमोक्षास्तु पादेषु परिसंस्थिताः ..
हुंकारे च चतुर्वेदाः कंठे रुद्राः प्रतिष्ठिताः .. 19 ..
text_mt: Righteousness, pleasure, wealth, and liberation are established in her feet; / the four Vedas are in her bellow, and the Rudras are established in her neck.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛṣṭhabhāge sthito merurviṣṇuḥ sarvaśarīragaḥ ..
evaṃ sarvamayī devī pāvanī viśvarūpiṇī .. 4.156.20 ..
meaning:
पृष्ठभागे स्थितो मेरुर्विष्णुः सर्वशरीरगः ..
एवं सर्वमयी देवी पावनी विश्वरूपिणी .. 4.156.20 ..
text_mt: Meru is situated on the dorsal part, and Viṣṇu permeates her entire body; / thus she is the all-embodying, purifying goddess whose form is the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
kāñcanena kṛtā dhenuḥ sarvadevamayī smṛtā ..
yo dadyāttādṛśīṃ dhenuṃ sarvadānaprado hi saḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
काञ्चनेन कृता धेनुः सर्वदेवमयी स्मृता ..
यो दद्यात्तादृशीं धेनुं सर्वदानप्रदो हि सः .. 21 ..
text_mt: The cow made of gold is declared to be composed of all gods; / he who gives such a cow is indeed a giver of all gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
karmabhūmau hi martyānāṃ dānametatsudurlabham ..
tasmāddeyamidaṃ śaktyā sarvakalmaṣanāśanam ..22..
meaning:
कर्मभूमौ हि मर्त्यानां दानमेतत्सुदुर्लभम् ..
तस्माद्देयमिदं शक्त्या सर्वकल्मषनाशनम् ..22..
text_mt: For mortals on the earth of action, this gift is exceedingly difficult to obtain; / therefore, this should be given according to one's capacity, destroying all sins,

sanskrit_iast:
pāvanaṃ tāraṇaṃ caiva kīrtidaṃ śāṃtidaṃ tathā ..
varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ svargaloke gato naraḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
पावनं तारणं चैव कीर्तिदं शांतिदं तथा ..
वर्षकोटिशतं साग्रं स्वर्गलोके गतो नरः .. 23 ..
text_mt: purifying, carrying across [the ocean of existence], granting fame, and giving peace. / Having gone to the heavenly world for more than a hundred crore years,

sanskrit_iast:
nārī vā pūjyate devairvimānavaramāsthitā ..
gaṃdharvaigīyamānastu puṣpairmālāvibhūṣitaiḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
नारी वा पूज्यते देवैर्विमानवरमास्थिता ..
गंधर्वैगीयमानस्तु पुष्पैर्मालाविभूषितैः .. 24 ..
text_mt: a man or a woman, seated upon an excellent celestial chariot, is honoured by the gods, / sung to by Gandharvas, adorned with wreaths of flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvābharaṇasaṃpannaḥ sarvadvaṃdvavivarjitaḥ ..
svarge sthitvā ciraṃ kālaṃ tato martye'bhijāyate .. 25 ..
meaning:
सर्वाभरणसंपन्नः सर्वद्वंद्वविवर्जितः ..
स्वर्गे स्थित्वा चिरं कालं ततो मर्त्येऽभिजायते .. 25 ..
text_mt: endowed with all ornaments, freed from all dualities; / having dwelt in heaven for a long time, he is then born among mortals

sanskrit_iast:
ādhi vyādhi vinirmukto rūpavānpriyadarśanaḥ ..
evaṃ naro vā nārī vā dattvā dānamidaṃ bhuvi ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti jāyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
आधि व्याधि विनिर्मुक्तो रूपवान्प्रियदर्शनः ..
एवं नरो वा नारी वा दत्त्वा दानमिदं भुवि ..
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति जायमानः पुनः पुनः .. 26 ..
text_mt: freed from mental agony and physical disease, handsome, and pleasant to behold. / Thus a man or a woman, having given this gift on earth, / attains all desires, being born again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
āmantrya sādhukulaśīlaguṇānvitāya viprāya yaḥ kanakadhenumimāṃ pradadyāt ..
prāpnoti siddhamunikinnaradevajuṣṭaṃ kanyāśataiḥ parivṛtaṃ padamindumauleḥ..27..
ratnadhenudānavratavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
आमन्त्र्य साधुकुलशीलगुणान्विताय विप्राय यः कनकधेनुमिमां प्रदद्यात् ..
प्राप्नोति सिद्धमुनिकिन्नरदेवजुष्टं कन्याशतैः परिवृतं पदमिन्दुमौलेः..27..
रत्नधेनुदानव्रतविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
He who, having addressed [her], presents this golden cow to a brāhmaṇa endowed with a noble lineage, good character, and virtues, / attains the abode of the moon-crested god [Śiva], attended by Siddhas, sages, Kinnaras, and gods, and surrounded by hundreds of celestial maidens.
Description of the rule of the vow of the gift of the gem-cow.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dānamanyatsudurllabham ..
ratnadhenviti vikhyātaṃ golokaphaladaṃ nṛṇām .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि दानमन्यत्सुदुर्ल्लभम् ..
रत्नधेन्विति विख्यातं गोलोकफलदं नृणाम् .. 1 ..
text_mt:
The venerable Kṛṣṇa said:
Now, therefore, I shall fully declare another gift that is exceedingly hard to obtain,
known as the jewel-cow, which grants men the fruit of Goloka.
title: Ratnadhenudānavratavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyaṃ dinamathāsādya gomayenopalepanam ..
kṛtvā bhūmau mahārāja tatra dhenuṃ prakalpayet .. 2 ..
meaning:
पुण्यं दिनमथासाद्य गोमयेनोपलेपनम् ..
कृत्वा भूमौ महाराज तत्र धेनुं प्रकल्पयेत् .. 2 ..
text_mt:
Having found an auspicious day, and having smeared
the ground with cow-dung, O great king, one should construct the cow there.

sanskrit_iast:
dhenuṃ ratnamayīṃ kuryāttattatsaṃkalpapūrvikām ..
sthāpayetpadmarāgāṇāmekāśītiṃ mukhe budhaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
धेनुं रत्नमयीं कुर्यात्तत्तत्संकल्पपूर्विकाम् ..
स्थापयेत्पद्मरागाणामेकाशीतिं मुखे बुधः .. 3 ..
text_mt:
One should make a cow consisting of jewels, preceded by the respective solemn resolves.
A wise man should place eighty-one rubies upon her mouth,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣparāgaśataṃ dhenoḥ pādayoḥ parikalpayet ..
lalāṭe hematilakaṃ muktāphalaśataṃ dṛśoḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
पुष्परागशतं धेनोः पादयोः परिकल्पयेत् ..
ललाटे हेमतिलकं मुक्ताफलशतं दृशोः .. 4 ..
text_mt:
One should arrange one hundred topazes upon the feet of the cow,
a gold tilaka on her forehead, and a hundred pearls for her eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrūyuge vidrumaśataṃ śuktī karṇadvaye smṛte ..
kāñcanāni ca śṛṅgāṇi śirovajraśatātmakam .. 5 ..
meaning:
भ्रूयुगे विद्रुमशतं शुक्ती कर्णद्वये स्मृते ..
काञ्चनानि च शृङ्गाणि शिरोवज्रशतात्मकम् .. 5 ..
text_mt:
One hundred corals on her pair of brows, two pearl-oysters are prescribed for her two ears,
her horns of gold, and her head consisting of a hundred diamonds.

sanskrit_iast:
grīvāyāṃ netrapuṭake gomedakaśataṃ tathā ..
indranīlaśataṃ pṛṣṭhe vaidūryaśata pārśvake .. 6 ..
meaning:
ग्रीवायां नेत्रपुटके गोमेदकशतं तथा ..
इन्द्रनीलशतं पृष्ठे वैदूर्यशत पार्श्वके .. 6 ..
text_mt:
A hundred hessonites on her neck and in the eye-sockets likewise,
a hundred sapphires on her back, and a hundred chrysoberyls on her flank.

sanskrit_iast:
sphāṭikairudaraṃ kāryaṃ saugandhikaśataṃ kaṭau ..
khurā hemamayā kāryāḥ pucchaṃ muktāvalīmayam .. 7 ..
meaning:
स्फाटिकैरुदरं कार्यं सौगन्धिकशतं कटौ ..
खुरा हेममया कार्याः पुच्छं मुक्तावलीमयम् .. 7 ..
text_mt:
Her belly should be made of crystals, and a hundred carnelians upon her hips.
Her hooves should be made of gold, and her tail consisting of a string of pearls.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryakāntendukāntau ca ghrāṇe karpūracandanaiḥ ..
kuṃkumena ca romāṇi raupyaṃ nābhiṃ ca kārayet .. 8 ..
meaning:
सूर्यकान्तेन्दुकान्तौ च घ्राणे कर्पूरचन्दनैः ..
कुंकुमेन च रोमाणि रौप्यं नाभिं च कारयेत् .. 8 ..
text_mt:
A sunstone and a moonstone on her nose; with camphor, sandalwood,
and saffron her hair; and one should make her navel of silver.

sanskrit_iast:
gārutmataśataṃ tadvadapāne parikalpayet ..
tathānyāni ca ratnāni sthāpayetsarvasaṃdhiṣu .. 9 ..
meaning:
गारुत्मतशतं तद्वदपाने परिकल्पयेत् ..
तथान्यानि च रत्नानि स्थापयेत्सर्वसंधिषु .. 9 ..
text_mt:
Likewise, one should arrange a hundred emeralds at her anus;
and similarly, one should place other jewels at all her joints.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryāccharkarayā jihvāṃ gomayaṃ ca guḍātmakam ..
gomūtramājyena tathā dadhidugdhasvarūpataḥ .. 4.157.10 ..
meaning:
कुर्याच्छर्करया जिह्वां गोमयं च गुडात्मकम् ..
गोमूत्रमाज्येन तथा दधिदुग्धस्वरूपतः .. 4.157.10 ..
text_mt:
One should make her tongue of sugar, her dung of jaggery,
her urine of ghee, and likewise with the nature of curd and milk.

sanskrit_iast:
pucchāgre cāmaraṃ dadyātstanayostāmradohanam ..
kārayedevamevaṃ tu caturthāṃśena vatsakam .. 11 ..
meaning:
पुच्छाग्रे चामरं दद्यात्स्तनयोस्ताम्रदोहनम् ..
कारयेदेवमेवं तु चतुर्थांशेन वत्सकम् .. 11 ..
text_mt:
One should place a chowrie at the tip of her tail, and a copper milking-vessel at her udders;
and in this very manner one should have a calf made with a fourth part [of the jewels].

sanskrit_iast:
nānāphalāni pārśveṣu kṛtvā pūjāṃ prayatnataḥ ..
guḍadhenuvadāvāhya idaṃ codāharettataḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
नानाफलानि पार्श्वेषु कृत्वा पूजां प्रयत्नतः ..
गुडधेनुवदावाह्य इदं चोदाहरेत्ततः .. 12 ..
text_mt:
Having placed various fruits at the flanks and worshipped her with diligence,
and having invoked her as in the rite of the jaggery-cow, one should then recite this:

sanskrit_iast:
tvāṃ sarvadevagaṇavāsamiti stuvaṃti rudrendracandrakamalāsanavāsudevāḥ ..
tasmātsamastabhuvanatrayadehayuktā māṃ pāhi devi bhavasāgara magnamāsu .. 13 ..
meaning:
त्वां सर्वदेवगणवासमिति स्तुवंति रुद्रेन्द्रचन्द्रकमलासनवासुदेवाः ..
तस्मात्समस्तभुवनत्रयदेहयुक्ता मां पाहि देवि भवसागर मग्नमासु .. 13 ..
text_mt:
“Rudra, Indra, the Moon, the Lotus-Seated One [Brahmā], and Vāsudeva praise you as the dwelling place of the hosts of all the gods.
Therefore, endowed with a body [comprising] all the three worlds, protect me quickly, O goddess, submerged in the ocean of worldly existence!”

sanskrit_iast:
evamāmantrya tāṃ dhenuṃ viprāya pratipādayet ..
saṃpūjya vastrābharaṇairvidhijñaṃ vedapāragam .. 14 ..
meaning:
एवमामन्त्र्य तां धेनुं विप्राय प्रतिपादयेत् ..
संपूज्य वस्त्राभरणैर्विधिज्ञं वेदपारगम् .. 14 ..
text_mt:
Having thus addressed that cow, one should present her to a Brahmin,
having worshipped him with garments and ornaments, one who knows the ritual and has mastered the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā praṇipatya kṣamāpayet ..
evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 15 ..
meaning:
ततश्च दक्षिणां दत्त्वा प्रणिपत्य क्षमापयेत् ..
एवं यः कुरुते पार्थ तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु .. 15 ..
text_mt:
And then, having given the priestly fee, bowed down, and asked for forgiveness—
hear the meritorious fruit of him who performs this thus, O son of Pṛthā:

sanskrit_iast:
kalpakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ śivaloke sukhaṃ vaset ..
tataḥ kāle bahutithe rājarājo bhavediha .. 16 ..
meaning:
कल्पकोटिशतं साग्रं शिवलोके सुखं वसेत् ..
ततः काले बहुतिथे राजराजो भवेदिह .. 16 ..
text_mt:
He shall dwell happily in the world of Śiva for a full hundred crores of kalpas.
Then, after a long time, he would become a king of kings in this world,

sanskrit_iast: sarvakāmasamṛddhaśca śatrupakṣakṣayaṃkaraḥ .. 17 ..
meaning: सर्वकामसमृद्धश्च शत्रुपक्षक्षयंकरः .. 17 ..
text_mt: flourishing with all desires and bringing destruction to the faction of his enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
iti sakalavidhijño ratnadhenupradānaṃ vitarati sa vimānaṃ prāpya dedīpyamānam ..
sakala kaluṣamukto baṃdhubhiḥ putrapautraiḥ sa hi madanasarūpaḥ sthānamabhyeti śaṃbhoḥ .. 18 ..
ubhayamukhīgodānavratavarṇanam
meaning:
इति सकलविधिज्ञो रत्नधेनुप्रदानं वितरति स विमानं प्राप्य देदीप्यमानम् ..
सकल कलुषमुक्तो बंधुभिः पुत्रपौत्रैः स हि मदनसरूपः स्थानमभ्येति शंभोः .. 18 ..
उभयमुखीगोदानव्रतवर्णनम्

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
prasūyamānā dātavyā dhenurbrāhmaṇapuṅgave ..
vidhinā kena dharmajñaṃ dāne tasyāśca kiṃ phalam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
प्रसूयमाना दातव्या धेनुर्ब्राह्मणपुङ्गवे ..
विधिना केन धर्मज्ञं दाने तस्याश्च किं फलम् .. 1 ..
title: adhyāyaḥ 158

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
prasūyamānātipuṇyaiḥ prāpyate gaurnṛpottama ..
prāpnuvaṃti narāḥ kecitpuṇyasaṃbhāravistarāḥ ..2 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
प्रसूयमानातिपुण्यैः प्राप्यते गौर्नृपोत्तम ..
प्राप्नुवंति नराः केचित्पुण्यसंभारविस्तराः ..2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yāvatpādau yonigatau śiraścaiva pradṛśyate ..
tāvadgauḥ pṛthivī jñeyā yāvadgarbhaṃ na muṃcati .. 3 ..
meaning:
यावत्पादौ योनिगतौ शिरश्चैव प्रदृश्यते ..
तावद्गौः पृथिवी ज्ञेया यावद्गर्भं न मुंचति .. 3 ..
text_mt:
As long as the two feet are in the vulva and the head also is seen,
so long is the cow to be known as the earth, until she discharges the fetus.

sanskrit_iast:
gauryāvaddvimukhī caiva yadā bhavati bhārata ..
tadāsau pṛthivī jñeyā saśailavanakānanā .. 4 ..
meaning:
गौर्यावद्द्विमुखी चैव यदा भवति भारत ..
तदासौ पृथिवी ज्ञेया सशैलवनकानना .. 4 ..
text_mt:
As long as the cow has two faces, when [this] occurs, O descendant of Bharata,
then she is to be known as the earth together with its mountains, woods, and forests.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvobhayamukhīṃ rājanyatpuṇyaṃ prāpyate nṛbhiḥ ..
na tadvarṇayituṃ yāti mukhenaikena kenacit .. 5 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वोभयमुखीं राजन्यत्पुण्यं प्राप्यते नृभिः ..
न तद्वर्णयितुं याति मुखेनैकेन केनचित् .. 5 ..
text_mt:
The merit that is attained by men upon giving a two-faced cow, O king—
that cannot be described with a single mouth by anyone.

sanskrit_iast:
kimiṣṭairbahubhiryajñairdānairdattaiśca sattama ..
prasūyamānāṃ gāmekāṃ dehi kiṃ bahunā tava .. 6 ..
meaning:
किमिष्टैर्बहुभिर्यज्ञैर्दानैर्दत्तैश्च सत्तम ..
प्रसूयमानां गामेकां देहि किं बहुना तव .. 6 ..
text_mt:
What need is there of many sacrifices offered, or gifts bestowed, O best of beings?
Give a single cow in the process of giving birth! What need have you of much?

sanskrit_iast:
ekaiva pāti narakātsukhamekaiva kārayet..
ekāpi dvimukhī dattā gaurgaurbhavati bhārata .. 7 ..
meaning:
एकैव पाति नरकात्सुखमेकैव कारयेत्..
एकापि द्विमुखी दत्ता गौर्गौर्भवति भारत .. 7 ..
text_mt:
One alone protects from hell; one alone creates happiness;
even a single two-faced cow, when given, becomes the earth, O descendant of Bharata.

sanskrit_iast:
svarṇaśṛṃgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ muktālāṅgūlabhūṣitām ..
kāṃsyopadohanāṃ rājannalaṃkṛtya dvijottame ..
prasūyamānāṃ gāṃ dattvā mahatpuṇyaphalaṃ labhet .. 8 ..
meaning:
स्वर्णशृंगीं रौप्यखुरां मुक्तालाङ्गूलभूषिताम् ..
कांस्योपदोहनां राजन्नलंकृत्य द्विजोत्तमे ..
प्रसूयमानां गां दत्त्वा महत्पुण्यफलं लभेत् .. 8 ..
text_mt:
With horns of gold, hooves of silver, adorned with a pearl tail,
with a bronze milking vessel, O king, having adorned her, upon [presenting her to] a best of Brahmins,
having given a cow in the process of giving birth, one obtains great meritorious fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvaṃti dhenuromāṇi vatsasyāpi narādhipa ..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate .. 9 ..
meaning:
यावंति धेनुरोमाणि वत्सस्यापि नराधिप ..
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते .. 9 ..
text_mt:
As many hairs as there are on the cow, and on the calf as well, O lord of men,
for that many thousands of years he is glorified in the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝnpitāmahāṃścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahān ..
samuddharatyasaṃdigdhaṃ narakādbhūridakṣiṇaḥ .. 4.158.10 ..
meaning:
पितॄन्पितामहांश्चैव तथैव प्रपितामहान् ..
समुद्धरत्यसंदिग्धं नरकाद्भूरिदक्षिणः .. 4.158.10 ..
text_mt:
He delivers his fathers, his grandfathers, and likewise his great-grandfathers
from hell without doubt, he who gives an abundant priestly fee.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtakṣīravahā nadyo dadhipāyasakardamāḥ ..
tatra te yāṃti yatrāsti drumaścepsitakāmadaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
घृतक्षीरवहा नद्यो दधिपायसकर्दमाः ..
तत्र ते यांति यत्रास्ति द्रुमश्चेप्सितकामदः .. 11 ..
text_mt:
Rivers flowing with ghee and milk, having mud of curd and milk-rice—
there they go, where there is the tree that grants desired wishes.

sanskrit_iast:
yo dadāti suvarṇena bahunā saha bhāvinīm ..
golokaḥ sulabhastasya brahmalokaśca pārthiva .. 12 ..
meaning:
यो ददाति सुवर्णेन बहुना सह भाविनीम् ..
गोलोकः सुलभस्तस्य ब्रह्मलोकश्च पार्थिव .. 12 ..
text_mt:
He who gives the noble cow together with abundant gold—
Goloka is easily accessible to him, and Brahmaloka, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
na deyā durbalā rājandhenurnaivālpadakṣiṇā ..
kāmyo'yaṃ vidhiruddiṣṭaḥ phalado vidhinā kṛtaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
न देया दुर्बला राजन्धेनुर्नैवाल्पदक्षिणा ..
काम्योऽयं विधिरुद्दिष्टः फलदो विधिना कृतः .. 13 ..
text_mt:
A weak cow must not be given, O king, nor indeed one with a small priestly fee;
this optional rite has been declared, granting fruit when performed according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
striyaśca ta caṃdrasamānavaktrāḥ prataptajāṃbūnadatulyavarṇāḥ ..
mahānitaṃbāstanuvṛttamadhyāḥ sevaṃtyajasraṃ nalinābhanetrāḥ .. 14 ...
gosahasrapradānavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
स्त्रियश्च त चंद्रसमानवक्त्राः प्रतप्तजांबूनदतुल्यवर्णाः ..
महानितंबास्तनुवृत्तमध्याः सेवंत्यजस्रं नलिनाभनेत्राः .. 14 ...
गोसहस्रप्रदानविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
And women whose faces resemble the moon, whose complexion equals refined gold,
with large hips, slender and rounded waists, and eyes resembling lotuses, serve him perpetually.
Description of the Rite of Bestowing a Thousand Cows

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
gosahasravidhānaṃ ca kathayasva janārdana ..
kasminkāle pradātavyaṃ kathaṃ deyaṃ ca tadbhavet .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
गोसहस्रविधानं च कथयस्व जनार्दन ..
कस्मिन्काले प्रदातव्यं कथं देयं च तद्भवेत् .. 1 ..
title: Gosahasrapradānavidhivratavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
gāvaḥ pavitrā lokānāṃ gāva eva parāyaṇam ..
brahmaṇā sṛjatā lokānvṛttihetoḥ prajeśvara ..
gāvaḥ prathamataḥ sṛṣṭāstrailokya hitakāmyayā .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
गावः पवित्रा लोकानां गाव एव परायणम् ..
ब्रह्मणा सृजता लोकान्वृत्तिहेतोः प्रजेश्वर ..
गावः प्रथमतः सृष्टास्त्रैलोक्य हितकाम्यया .. 2 ..
text_mt:
The venerable Kṛṣṇa said:
Cows are the purifiers of the worlds; cows alone are the supreme refuge.
By Brahmā, when creating the worlds for the purpose of livelihood, O lord of creatures,
cows were created first of all, out of a desire for the welfare of the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
yāsāṃ mūtrapurīṣeṇa devatāyatanānyapi ..
śucīni samajāyaṃta kiṃbhūtamadhikaṃ tataḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
यासां मूत्रपुरीषेण देवतायतनान्यपि ..
शुचीनि समजायंत किंभूतमधिकं ततः .. 3 ..
text_mt:
Through whose urine and dung even the temples of the deities
became pure—what being could be greater than that?

sanskrit_iast:
mūlaṃ yajñasya kāmyasya sarvadevamayāḥ śubhāḥ ..
gomaye vasate lakṣmīḥ paryāptaṃ tannidarśanam .. 4 ..
meaning:
मूलं यज्ञस्य काम्यस्य सर्वदेवमयाः शुभाः ..
