गोमये वसते लक्ष्मीः पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम् .. 4 ..
text_mt:
The auspicious [cows] are the root of the sacrificial rite undertaken for desires, embodying all the gods;
Lakṣmī resides in cow-dung—that is an adequate illustration.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāścaiva gāvaśca kulamekaṃ dvidhā kṛtam ..
ekatra maṃtrāstiṣṭhanti haviranyatra tiṣṭhati .. 5 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाश्चैव गावश्च कुलमेकं द्विधा कृतम् ..
एकत्र मंत्रास्तिष्ठन्ति हविरन्यत्र तिष्ठति .. 5 ..
text_mt:
Brahmins and cows are a single family made into two;
in the one place mantras abide, in the other oblation abides.

sanskrit_iast:
yāsāṃ putrairdhṛtā lokā dhāritāḥ sarvadevatāḥ ..
tāsāṃ dānavidhānaṃ ca śṛṇu tatpṛthivīpate .. 6 ..
meaning:
यासां पुत्रैर्धृता लोका धारिताः सर्वदेवताः ..
तासां दानविधानं च शृणु तत्पृथिवीपते .. 6 ..
text_mt:
By whose sons the worlds are supported and all the deities are sustained—
hear the ordinance of the gift of those [cows], O lord of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
ekā'pi gaurguṇopetā kṛtsnaṃ tārayate kulam ..
surūpā śīlasaṃpannā yuvatiḥ supayasvinī .. 7 ..
meaning:
एकाऽपि गौर्गुणोपेता कृत्स्नं तारयते कुलम् ..
सुरूपा शीलसंपन्ना युवतिः सुपयस्विनी .. 7 ..
text_mt:
Even a single cow endowed with good qualities delivers the entire family—
comely, possessed of good nature, young, and yielding abundant milk,

sanskrit_iast:
suvatsā suduhā caiva pāparogavivarjitā ..
vidhivattādṛśā dattā kṛtsnaṃ tārayate kulam .. 8 ..
meaning:
सुवत्सा सुदुहा चैव पापरोगविवर्जिता ..
विधिवत्तादृशा दत्ता कृत्स्नं तारयते कुलम् .. 8 ..
text_mt:
having a good calf, easy to milk, and free from diseases caused by sin;
given according to the rules, such a cow delivers the entire family.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ punardaśa yo dadyācchataṃ vā vidhipūrvakam ..
sahasraṃ tu punardadyāttasya vai kimihocyate .. 9 ..
meaning:
किं पुनर्दश यो दद्याच्छतं वा विधिपूर्वकम् ..
सहस्रं तु पुनर्दद्यात्तस्य वै किमिहोच्यते .. 9 ..
text_mt:
What then of one who gives ten, or a hundred, according to the rules?
And if one should give a thousand, indeed, what is to be said in this world of his [merit]?

sanskrit_iast:
gosahasraṃ purā dattaṃ nahuṣeṇa mahībhṛtā ..
sa gato brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ yayātiśca mahāmatiḥ .. 4.159.10 ..
meaning:
गोसहस्रं पुरा दत्तं नहुषेण महीभृता ..
स गतो ब्रह्मणः स्थानं ययातिश्च महामतिः .. 4.159.10 ..
text_mt:
In ancient times, a thousand cows were given by King Nahuṣa;
he went to the realm of Brahmā, as did the high-minded Yayāti.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃgātīre mahaddattamadityā putrakāmyayā ..
lebhe putraṃ trilokeśaṃ nārāyaṇamakalmaṣam .. 11 ..
meaning:
गंगातीरे महद्दत्तमदित्या पुत्रकाम्यया ..
लेभे पुत्रं त्रिलोकेशं नारायणमकल्मषम् .. 11 ..
text_mt:
On the bank of the Gaṅgā, a great [gift] was given by Aditi desiring a son;
she obtained as her son Nārāyaṇa, the spotless lord of the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast: śrūyate pitṛbhirgītā gāthāstāḥ śṛṇu bhūpate .. 12 ..
meaning: श्रूयते पितृभिर्गीता गाथास्ताः शृणु भूपते .. 12 ..
text_mt: Verses sung by the ancestors are heard; listen to them, O king:

sanskrit_iast:
yadi kaścitkule'smākaṃ gosahasraṃ pradāpayet ..
yāsyāmaḥ paramāṃ siddhiṃ kāritāṃ puṇyakarmaṇā .. 13 ..
meaning:
यदि कश्चित्कुलेऽस्माकं गोसहस्रं प्रदापयेत् ..
यास्यामः परमां सिद्धिं कारितां पुण्यकर्मणा .. 13 ..
text_mt:
"If someone in our family would give a thousand cows,
we will attain the highest perfection brought about by that meritorious act.

sanskrit_iast:
duhitā vā kule kācidgosahasrapradāyinī ..
sopānaḥ sugatirdatto bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
दुहिता वा कुले काचिद्गोसहस्रप्रदायिनी ..
सोपानः सुगतिर्दत्तो भविष्यति न संशयः .. 14 ..
text_mt:
Or if any daughter in the family becomes a giver of a thousand cows,
a stairway providing a good destination will come to be; of this there is no doubt."

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi yajñaṃ vai sarvakāmikam ..
gosahasraṃ tadā dadyācchāstroktavidhivannaraḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ञं वै सर्वकामिकम् ..
गोसहस्रं तदा दद्याच्छास्त्रोक्तविधिवन्नरः .. 15 ..
text_mt:
Hereafter, I shall proclaim the sacrifice that fulfills all desires.
A man should then give a thousand cows according to the rules stated in the scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthe goṣṭhe gṛhe vāpi maṃḍapaṃ kārayecchubham ..
daśadvādaśahastaṃ vā caturvaktraṃ satoraṇam .. 16 ..
meaning:
तीर्थे गोष्ठे गृहे वापि मंडपं कारयेच्छुभम् ..
दशद्वादशहस्तं वा चतुर्वक्त्रं सतोरणम् .. 16 ..
text_mt:
At a sacred ford, in a cowshed, or in a house, he should have an auspicious pavilion constructed,
ten or twelve cubits in size, with four entrances and archways.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmadhye kārayedvediṃ caturhastāmanūpamām ..
hastamātrapramāṇena hastena samalaṃkṛtām ..17..
meaning:
तन्मध्ये कारयेद्वेदिं चतुर्हस्तामनूपमाम् ..
हस्तमात्रप्रमाणेन हस्तेन समलंकृताम् ..17..
text_mt:
In its middle he should have an altar made, four cubits [wide] and peerless,
adorned with a hand[-design] of the measure of one cubit.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvottare'thadigbhāge grahavediṃ prakalpayet ..
grahayajñavidhānena grahāṃstatra kramādyajet .. 18 ..
meaning:
पूर्वोत्तरेऽथदिग्भागे ग्रहवेदिं प्रकल्पयेत् ..
ग्रहयज्ञविधानेन ग्रहांस्तत्र क्रमाद्यजेत् .. 18 ..
text_mt:
Then, in the north-eastern direction, he should arrange an altar for the planets;
there he should worship the planets in due order according to the rules of the planet-sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca pūjyāḥ prathamameva hi ..
ṛtvijaḥ parikartavyā ṣoḍaśāṣṭau ca śobhanāḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च पूज्याः प्रथममेव हि ..
ऋत्विजः परिकर्तव्या षोडशाष्टौ च शोभनाः .. 19 ..
text_mt:
Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra must indeed be worshipped first of all.
Sixteen or eight excellent officiating priests should be appointed,

sanskrit_iast:
catvāro vā mahārāja upādhyāyaśca paṃcamaḥ ..
sarvābharaṇasaṃpannāḥ karṇaveṣṭāṃgulīyakaiḥ .. 4.159.20 ..
meaning:
चत्वारो वा महाराज उपाध्यायश्च पंचमः ..
सर्वाभरणसंपन्नाः कर्णवेष्टांगुलीयकैः .. 4.159.20 ..
text_mt:
or four, O great king, and an instructor as the fifth,
endowed with all ornaments, with earrings and finger-rings,

sanskrit_iast:
śobhitāśchatrasaṃpannāstāmrapātradvayānvitāḥ ..
grahayajñoktavidhinā homaṃ havyaṃ samācaret .. 21 ..
meaning:
शोभिताश्छत्रसंपन्नास्ताम्रपात्रद्वयान्विताः ..
ग्रहयज्ञोक्तविधिना होमं हव्यं समाचरेत् .. 21 ..
text_mt:
adorned, equipped with royal parasols, and provided with two copper vessels.
Following the rules prescribed for the planet-sacrifice, he should perform the fire oblation and sacrificial offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
vedyāḥ pūrvottare bhāge śivakuṃḍaṃ niyojayet ..
kuṃbhadvayaṃ ca dvāreṣu paṃcaratnaṃ sapallavam .. 22 ..
meaning:
वेद्याः पूर्वोत्तरे भागे शिवकुंडं नियोजयेत् ..
कुंभद्वयं च द्वारेषु पंचरत्नं सपल्लवम् .. 22 ..
text_mt:
In the north-eastern portion of the altar, he should arrange an auspicious sacrificial pit;
and at the doorways, two jars with five jewels and leafy twigs.

sanskrit_iast:
kāryaṃ kurukulaśreṣṭha tato homaṃ samārabhet ..
lokapālabaliṃ dadyāttulāpuruṣadānavat .. 23 ..
meaning:
कार्यं कुरुकुलश्रेष्ठ ततो होमं समारभेत् ..
लोकपालबलिं दद्यात्तुलापुरुषदानवत् .. 23 ..
text_mt:
This is to be done, O best of Kuru's line; then he should begin the fire oblation.
He should present the offering to the world protectors just as in the gift of a man weighed against gold.

sanskrit_iast:
gosahasrādviniṣkṛṣya savatsaṃ daśakaṃ gavām ..
gosahasrādbahiṣkuryādvastramālyavibhūṣaṇam ..
ataḥ praveśya daśakaṃ vastrairmālyaiśca pūjayet .. 24 ..
meaning:
गोसहस्राद्विनिष्कृष्य सवत्सं दशकं गवाम् ..
गोसहस्राद्बहिष्कुर्याद्वस्त्रमाल्यविभूषणम् ..
अतः प्रवेश्य दशकं वस्त्रैर्माल्यैश्च पूजयेत् .. 24 ..
text_mt:
Drawing out from the thousand cows a group of ten cows with their calves,
he should place them outside the thousand cows, adorned with garments and garlands.
Then, bringing in the group of ten, he should worship them with clothes and garlands,

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇaghaṃṭikāyuktaṃ tāmradohanakānvitam ..
suvarṇatilakopetaṃ khurai raupyairalaṃkṛtaiḥ ..
hemaratnamayaiḥ śṛṃgaiścāmaraiścopaśobhitam .. 25 ..
meaning:
सुवर्णघंटिकायुक्तं ताम्रदोहनकान्वितम् ..
सुवर्णतिलकोपेतं खुरै रौप्यैरलंकृतैः ..
हेमरत्नमयैः शृंगैश्चामरैश्चोपशोभितम् .. 25 ..
text_mt:
fitted with golden bells, accompanied by copper milking vessels,
provided with golden fore-head marks, with hooves adorned with silver,
with horns of gold and jewels, and beautified with chowries.

sanskrit_iast:
munayaḥ kecidicchanti kāṃcanaṃ naṃdikeśvaram ..
lavaṇadroṇaśikhare bhaktyā tamapi kārayet .. 26 ..
meaning:
मुनयः केचिदिच्छन्ति कांचनं नंदिकेश्वरम् ..
लवणद्रोणशिखरे भक्त्या तमपि कारयेत् .. 26 ..
text_mt:
Some sages desire a golden Nandikeśvara;
with devotion, one should also have him fashioned on top of a droṇa measure of salt.

sanskrit_iast:
ekā pratyakṣaṛṣabhe keṣāṃciddānamiṣyate ..
grahānsurāṃśca saṃpūjya mālyavastraphalākṣataiḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
एका प्रत्यक्षऋषभे केषांचिद्दानमिष्यते ..
ग्रहान्सुरांश्च संपूज्य माल्यवस्त्रफलाक्षतैः .. 27 ..
text_mt:
For some, the gift is desired with an actual bull.
Having worshipped the planets and the gods with garlands, garments, fruits, and unbroken grains,

sanskrit_iast:
patākābhiralaṃkṛtya devatāyatanāni ca ..
gośate'pi daśāṃśena sarvametatprakalpayet .. 28 ..
meaning:
पताकाभिरलंकृत्य देवतायतनानि च ..
गोशतेऽपि दशांशेन सर्वमेतत्प्रकल्पयेत् .. 28 ..
text_mt:
and having adorned the shrines of the deities with flags—
even in the case of a hundred cows, he should arrange all this in a one-tenth proportion.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi sarvā na vidyante gāvaḥ sarvaguṇottamāḥ..
daśakaṃ pūjya yatnena itaraḥ parikalpayet .. 29 ..
meaning:
यदि सर्वा न विद्यन्ते गावः सर्वगुणोत्तमाः..
दशकं पूज्य यत्नेन इतरः परिकल्पयेत् .. 29 ..
text_mt:
If all the cows are not found to be highest in all good qualities,
having worshipped the ten with care, he should arrange the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpakālamatho vādyagītamaṃgalanisvanaiḥ ..
sarvauṣadhyudakasnātaḥ snapito dvijapuṃga vaiḥ ..
imamuccārayenmaṃtraṃ gṛhītakusumāṃjaliḥ .. 4.159.30 ..
meaning:
पुष्पकालमथो वाद्यगीतमंगलनिस्वनैः ..
सर्वौषध्युदकस्नातः स्नपितो द्विजपुंग वैः ..
इममुच्चारयेन्मंत्रं गृहीतकुसुमांजलिः .. 4.159.30 ..
text_mt:
Then, at the time for flowers, amid the sounds of instruments, singing, and auspicious music,
bathed in water containing all medicinal herbs, sprinkled by eminent twice-born men,
he should utter this mantra, holding an offering of flowers in his folded hands:

sanskrit_iast:
namo vo viśvamūrtibhyo viśvamātṛbhya eva ca ..
lokādhivāsinībhyastu rohiṇībhyo namo namaḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
नमो वो विश्वमूर्तिभ्यो विश्वमातृभ्य एव च ..
लोकाधिवासिनीभ्यस्तु रोहिणीभ्यो नमो नमः .. 31 ..
text_mt:
"Homage to you whose form is the universe, and mothers of the universe!
To the dwellers of the worlds, to the Rohiṇīs, homage, homage!

sanskrit_iast:
gavāmaṃgeṣu tiṣṭhanti bhuvanānyekaviṃśatiḥ ..
brahmādayastathā devā rohiṇyaḥ pāṃtu mātaraḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
गवामंगेषु तिष्ठन्ति भुवनान्येकविंशतिः ..
ब्रह्मादयस्तथा देवा रोहिण्यः पांतु मातरः .. 32 ..
text_mt:
In the limbs of the cows reside the twenty-one worlds,
as well as the gods beginning with Brahmā; may the mothers, the Rohiṇīs, protect us!

sanskrit_iast:
gāvo mamāgrataḥ saṃtu gāvo me saṃtu pṛṣṭhataḥ ..
gāvo me sarvataḥ saṃtu gavāṃ madhye vasāmyaham .. 33 ..
meaning:
गावो ममाग्रतः संतु गावो मे संतु पृष्ठतः ..
गावो मे सर्वतः संतु गवां मध्ये वसाम्यहम् .. 33 ..
text_mt:
May cows be in front of me; may cows be behind me;
may cows be on all sides of me; may I dwell in the midst of cows!"

sanskrit_iast:
yasmāttvaṃ vṛṣarūpeṇa dharmaścaiva sanātanaḥ .. (pāṭhā. sanānataḥ)
aṣṭamūrtteradhiṣṭhānamataḥ pāhi sanātanaḥ .. ..34..
meaning:
यस्मात्त्वं वृषरूपेण धर्मश्चैव सनातनः .. (पाठा. सनानतः)
अष्टमूर्त्तेरधिष्ठानमतः पाहि सनातनः .. ..34..
text_mt:
"Since you, in the form of a bull, are eternal dharma itself,
and the abode of the eight-formed [Śiva], therefore, O eternal one, protect [me]!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityāmantrya tato dayādgurave naṃdikeśvaram ..
sarvopaskaraṇopetaṃ goyutaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
इत्यामन्त्र्य ततो दयाद्गुरवे नंदिकेश्वरम् ..
सर्वोपस्करणोपेतं गोयुतं च विशेषतः .. 35 ..
text_mt:
Having thus addressed [him], he should then give Nandikeśvara to the preceptor,
endowed with all utensils, and especially accompanied by a cow.

sanskrit_iast:
gavāṃ śatamathaikaikaṃ tadardhaṃ cāpi viṃśatiḥ ..
daśa pañcaśataṃ dadyādbahubhyastadanujñayā .. 36 ..
meaning:
गवां शतमथैकैकं तदर्धं चापि विंशतिः ..
दश पञ्चशतं दद्याद्बहुभ्यस्तदनुज्ञया .. 36 ..
text_mt:
With his permission, he should give a hundred cows to each one, or half of that, or twenty,
ten, or fifty, to many [priests].

sanskrit_iast:
naikā bahubhyo dātavyā dātā doṣakaro bhavet ..
bahvyastvekasya dātavyāḥ śrīmadārogyavṛddhaye .. 37 ..
meaning:
नैका बहुभ्यो दातव्या दाता दोषकरो भवेत् ..
बह्व्यस्त्वेकस्य दातव्याः श्रीमदारोग्यवृद्धये .. 37 ..
text_mt:
One [cow] should not be given to many; the giver would incur fault.
Rather, many should be given to one, for the increase of fortune and health.

sanskrit_iast:
payovratastatastiṣṭhedekāhaṃ gosahasradaḥ ..
tathaiva brahmacārī syādya icchedvipulāṃ śriyam .. 38 ..
meaning:
पयोव्रतस्ततस्तिष्ठेदेकाहं गोसहस्रदः ..
तथैव ब्रह्मचारी स्याद्य इच्छेद्विपुलां श्रियम् .. 38 ..
text_mt:
Then the giver of a thousand cows should remain on a diet of milk for one day;
likewise, he who desires vast fortune should be celibate.

sanskrit_iast:
na deyā durbalā dhenurnālpakṣīrā na rogiṇī ..
na jīrṇā jīrṇavastrā vā nāpatyagatacetanā .. 39 ..
meaning:
न देया दुर्बला धेनुर्नाल्पक्षीरा न रोगिणी ..
न जीर्णा जीर्णवस्त्रा वा नापत्यगतचेतना .. 39 ..
text_mt:
A weak cow must not be given, nor one yielding little milk, nor a diseased one,
nor a decrepit one, nor one with tattered clothes, nor one distraught over the loss of her offspring.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā yastu gosahasraprado bhavet ..
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ siddhacāraṇasevitaḥ .. .. 4.159.40 ..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु गोसहस्रप्रदो भवेत् ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः सिद्धचारणसेवितः .. .. 4.159.40 ..
text_mt:
He who becomes a giver of a thousand cows according to this rule,
freed from all sins, attended upon by Siddhas and Cāraṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
vimānenārkavarṇena kiṃkiṇījālamālinā ..
sarveṣāṃ lokapālānāṃ loke saṃpūjyate suraiḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
विमानेनार्कवर्णेन किंकिणीजालमालिना ..
सर्वेषां लोकपालानां लोके संपूज्यते सुरैः .. 41 ..
text_mt:
in a celestial chariot shining like the sun and garlanded with a network of small bells,
is worshipped by the gods in the worlds of all the world protectors.

sanskrit_iast:
saptāvarānsapta parānsapta caiva parāvarān ..
puruṣānuddhareddattvā gosahasraṃ vidhānataḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
सप्तावरान्सप्त परान्सप्त चैव परावरान् ..
पुरुषानुद्धरेद्दत्त्वा गोसहस्रं विधानतः .. 42 ..
text_mt:
Seven below, seven above, and indeed seven intermediate [ancestors]—
a man delivers these persons after giving a thousand cows according to the ordinance.

sanskrit_iast:
svargalokāccyuto vātha nārī vā satparāyaṇā ..
sapta janmāni rājñī syātstūyamānā punaḥpunaḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
स्वर्गलोकाच्च्युतो वाथ नारी वा सत्परायणा ..
सप्त जन्मानि राज्ञी स्यात्स्तूयमाना पुनःपुनः .. 43 ..
text_mt:
Having fallen from the heavenly world, or if a woman devoted to truth,
she becomes a queen for seven births, praised again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
na tvevedaṃ dānamātraṃ praśastaṃ pātraṃ kālo goviśeṣo vighiśca ..
tasmādetāḥ sarvabhūṣāsametāḥ pātre kāle kṣīravatyo vidhānāt ..44 ..
meaning:
न त्वेवेदं दानमात्रं प्रशस्तं पात्रं कालो गोविशेषो विघिश्च ..
तस्मादेताः सर्वभूषासमेताः पात्रे काले क्षीरवत्यो विधानात् ..44 ..
text_mt:
Yet the mere gift is not praised: the recipient, the time, the quality of the cows, and the rite [must be right];
therefore, according to the rule, these milk-yielding [cows], equipped with all ornaments, [should be given] to a worthy recipient at an auspicious time.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāpi gaurbahuguṇā guṇine pradattā dātuḥ kulaṃ tripuruṣaṃ vidhivatpunāti ..
yaḥ śraddhayā vitaratīha gavāṃ sahasraṃ śakyaṃ phalaṃ na nṛpate'sya mayābhidhātum .. 45 .. ..
vṛṣabhadānavratavarṇanam
meaning:
एकापि गौर्बहुगुणा गुणिने प्रदत्ता दातुः कुलं त्रिपुरुषं विधिवत्पुनाति ..
यः श्रद्धया वितरतीह गवां सहस्रं शक्यं फलं न नृपतेऽस्य मयाभिधातुम् .. 45 .. ..
वृषभदानव्रतवर्णनम्

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca.. ..
yuṣmadvākyāmṛtamidaṃ śṛṇvānāha janārdana ..
na tṛptimadhigacchāmi jātaṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच.. ..
युष्मद्वाक्यामृतमिदं शृण्वानाह जनार्दन ..
न तृप्तिमधिगच्छामि जातं कौतूहलं हि मे .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Listening to this nectar of your words, O Janārdana,
I do not reach satisfaction; indeed, curiosity has arisen in me.
title: Vṛṣabhadānavratavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
gopatiḥ kila govindastriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ ..
govṛṣasya pradānena trailokyamabhinaṃdati .. 2 ..
meaning:
गोपतिः किल गोविन्दस्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः ..
गोवृषस्य प्रदानेन त्रैलोक्यमभिनंदति .. 2 ..
text_mt:
Govinda is renowned in the three worlds as the lord of cows;
by the gift of a breeding bull, the three worlds rejoice.

sanskrit_iast:
tadgovṛṣabhadānasya phalaṃ me kathāyācyuta ..
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
vṛṣadānaphalaṃ puṇyaṃ śṛṇuṣva kathayāmi te .. 3 ..
meaning:
तद्गोवृषभदानस्य फलं मे कथायाच्युत ..
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
वृषदानफलं पुण्यं शृणुष्व कथयामि ते .. 3 ..
text_mt:
Tell me, O Acyuta, the fruit of that gift of a bull.
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Listen, I shall tell you the meritorious fruit of the gift of a bull.

sanskrit_iast:
pavitraṃ pāvanaṃ caiva sarvadānottamottamam ..
daśadhenusamo'naḍvānekaścaikadhuraṃdharaḥ ..
daśadhenupradānāddhi sa evaiko viśiṣyate .. 4 ..
meaning:
पवित्रं पावनं चैव सर्वदानोत्तमोत्तमम् ..
दशधेनुसमोऽनड्वानेकश्चैकधुरंधरः ..
दशधेनुप्रदानाद्धि स एवैको विशिष्यते .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yo hṛṣṭaścātipuṣṭāṃgo hyarogaḥ pāṃḍunandana ..
yuvā bhadraḥ suśīlaśca sarvadoṣavivarjitaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
यो हृष्टश्चातिपुष्टांगो ह्यरोगः पांडुनन्दन ..
युवा भद्रः सुशीलश्च सर्वदोषविवर्जितः .. 5 ..
text_mt: One who is spirited, with very well-nourished limbs, free from disease, O son of Pāṇḍu, / young, auspicious, of good nature, and free of all defects,

sanskrit_iast:
dhuraṃdharaḥ sthāpayate eka eva kulaṃ mahat ..
trātā bhavati saṃsāre nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ..6..
meaning:
धुरंधरः स्थापयते एक एव कुलं महत् ..
त्राता भवति संसारे नात्र कार्या विचारणा ..6..
text_mt: bearing the yoke, alone sustains a great lineage; / he becomes a saviour in saṃsāra; there should be no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
alaṃkṛtya vṛṣaṃ śāṃtaṃ puṇyakāla upasthite ..
raupyalāṃgūlasaṃyuktaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet .. 7 ..
meaning:
अलंकृत्य वृषं शांतं पुण्यकाल उपस्थिते ..
रौप्यलांगूलसंयुक्तं ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् .. 7 ..
text_mt: Having adorned a gentle bull when an auspicious time arrives, / endowed with a silver tail, one should present him to a brāhmaṇa,

sanskrit_iast: maṃtreṇānena rājendra taṃ śṛṇuṣva vadāmi te .. 8 ..
meaning: मंत्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र तं शृणुष्व वदामि ते .. 8 ..
text_mt: with this mantra, O king of kings; listen to it, I tell you:

sanskrit_iast:
dharmastvaṃ vṛṣarūpeṇa jagadānandakārakaḥ ..
aṣṭamūrteradhiṣṭhānamataḥ pāhi sanātana .. 9 ..
meaning:
धर्मस्त्वं वृषरूपेण जगदानन्दकारकः ..
अष्टमूर्तेरधिष्ठानमतः पाहि सनातन .. 9 ..
text_mt: “You are Dharma in the form of a bull, bringing joy to the world, / the abode of the Eightfold Form; therefore protect [me], O Eternal One.”

sanskrit_iast:
dattvaivaṃ dakṣiṇāyuktaṃ praṇipatya visarjayet ..
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vāṅmanaḥ kāyakarmaṇām ..
tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti godānasukṛtena ca .. 4.160.10 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वैवं दक्षिणायुक्तं प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् ..
सप्तजन्मकृतं पापं वाङ्मनः कायकर्मणाम् ..
तत्सर्वं विलयं याति गोदानसुकृतेन च .. 4.160.10 ..
text_mt: Having thus given [the bull] together with a dakṣiṇā, one should bow down and dismiss [it]; / the sin of actions of speech, mind, and body committed across seven births, / all that dissolves through the merit of the gift of cattle.

sanskrit_iast:
yānaṃ vṛṣabhasaṃyuktaṃ dīpyamānaṃ suśobhanam ..
āruhya kāmagaṃ divyaṃ svalokamadhirohati ... 11 ..
meaning:
यानं वृषभसंयुक्तं दीप्यमानं सुशोभनम् ..
आरुह्य कामगं दिव्यं स्वलोकमधिरोहति ... 11 ..
text_mt: Mounting a vehicle yoked to bulls, shining, very beautiful, / moving at will and celestial, he ascends to his own world.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvaṃti tasya romāṇi govṛṣasya mahīpate ..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi gavāṃ loke mahīyate ..12..
meaning:
यावंति तस्य रोमाणि गोवृषस्य महीपते ..
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि गवां लोके महीयते ..12..
text_mt: As many hairs as that bull has, O protector of the earth, / for so many thousands of years he is glorified in the world of cattle.

sanskrit_iast:
golokādavatīrṇastu iha loke dvijo bhavet ..
yajñayājī mahātejāḥ sarvabrāhmaṇapūjitaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
गोलोकादवतीर्णस्तु इह लोके द्विजो भवेत् ..
यज्ञयाजी महातेजाः सर्वब्राह्मणपूजितः .. 13 ..
text_mt: And descending from Goloka, he becomes a twice-born in this world, / performing sacrifices, of great splendour, and honoured by all brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
yathoktaṃ te mahārāja kasya deyo vṛṣottamaḥ ..
tadahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi pātraṃ trāṇapadaṃ nṛṇām .. 14 ..
meaning:
यथोक्तं ते महाराज कस्य देयो वृषोत्तमः ..
तदहं ते प्रवक्ष्यामि पात्रं त्राणपदं नृणाम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: As you asked, O great king, to whom the best of bulls should be given, / I shall tell you that vessel of salvation for men:

sanskrit_iast:
ye kṣāṃtadāṃtāḥ śrutipūrṇakarṇā jiteṃdriyāḥ prāṇivadhānnivṛttāḥ ..
pratigrahe saṃkucitā gṛhasthāste brāhmaṇāstārayituṃ samarthāḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
ये क्षांतदांताः श्रुतिपूर्णकर्णा जितेंद्रियाः प्राणिवधान्निवृत्ताः ..
प्रतिग्रहे संकुचिता गृहस्थास्ते ब्राह्मणास्तारयितुं समर्थाः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Those householders who are patient, self-restrained, whose ears are filled with Vedic knowledge, whose senses are mastered, who abstain from killing living beings, / and who are hesitant to accept gifts—those brāhmaṇas are capable of rescuing [the donor].

sanskrit_iast:
ūrjasvinaṃ bharasahaṃ dṛḍhakaṃdharaṃ ca yacchaṃti ye vṛṣamaśeṣaguṇopapannam ..
dattena yadbhavati godaśakena puṇyaṃ satyaṃ bhavaṃti bhuvi tatphalabhāginaste .. 16 ..
kapilādānamāhātmyavarṇanam
meaning:
ऊर्जस्विनं भरसहं दृढकंधरं च यच्छंति ये वृषमशेषगुणोपपन्नम् ..
दत्तेन यद्भवति गोदशकेन पुण्यं सत्यं भवंति भुवि तत्फलभागिनस्ते .. 16 ..
कपिलादानमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Those who give a bull that is vigorous, enduring burdens, firm-necked, and endowed with all virtues / truly become partakers on earth of that fruit which is the merit gained by giving ten cows.
Description of the Greatness of the Gift of a Kapilā Cow

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kapilādānamāhātmyaṃ kathayasva jagatpate ..
puṇyaṃ yatsarvadānānāṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
कपिलादानमाहात्म्यं कथयस्व जगत्पते ..
पुण्यं यत्सर्वदानानां सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Tell, O Lord of the universe, the greatness of the gift of a kapilā cow, / which is the merit of all gifts, destroying all wicked deeds.
title: Kapilādānamāhātmyavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
tatte'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi vinatāśvena yatpurā ..
kathitaṃ kapilādānaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva mahāmate .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
तत्तेऽहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि विनताश्वेन यत्पुरा ..
कथितं कपिलादानं तच्छृणुष्व महामते .. 2 ..
text_mt:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
I shall explain that to you which Vinatāśva in ancient times / told concerning the gift of a kapilā cow; listen to that, O noble-minded one.

sanskrit_iast:
.. vinatāśva uvāca .. ..
ataḥ paraṃ mahārājobhayamukhyāḥ samāsataḥ ..
vidhānaṃ yadvarāheṇa dharaṇyai kathitaṃ purā .. 3 ..
meaning:
.. विनताश्व उवाच .. ..
अतः परं महाराजोभयमुख्याः समासतः ..
विधानं यद्वराहेण धरण्यै कथितं पुरा .. 3 ..
text_mt:
Vinatāśva said:
Hereafter, O great king, [I shall speak] briefly of the two-faced [cow], / the procedure that was told of old by Varāha to Dharaṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi navapuṇyaphalaṃ ca yat ..
.. dharaṇyuvāca .. ..
yattvayā kapilā nāma pūrvamutpāvitā prabho .. 4 ..
meaning:
तदहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि नवपुण्यफलं च यत् ..
.. धरण्युवाच .. ..
यत्त्वया कपिला नाम पूर्वमुत्पाविता प्रभो .. 4 ..
text_mt:
That I shall declare, and what the fruit of the nine merits is.
Dharaṇī said:
The one named kapilā who was produced by you of old, O Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
homadhenuḥ sadā puṇyā dhenuryajñāvatārabhūḥ ..
sā kathaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo hi deyā kasmindine'pi ca .. .. 5 ..
meaning:
होमधेनुः सदा पुण्या धेनुर्यज्ञावतारभूः ..
सा कथं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो हि देया कस्मिन्दिनेऽपि च .. .. 5 ..
text_mt: the cow for the fire-sacrifice, ever auspicious, the cow that is the birthplace of the sacrifice’s descent— / how should she be given to brāhmaṇas, and on which day?

sanskrit_iast:
kīdṛśāya ca viprāya dātavyā puṇyalakṣaṇā ..
kati vā kapilāḥ proktāḥ svayameva svayaṃbhuvā .. 6 ..
meaning:
कीदृशाय च विप्राय दातव्या पुण्यलक्षणा ..
कति वा कपिलाः प्रोक्ताः स्वयमेव स्वयंभुवा .. 6 ..
text_mt: And to what kind of vipra should she, possessing auspicious marks, be given? / How many kapilās indeed were proclaimed by the Self-born One himself?

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāṃ prayatnāddānena kiṃ puṇyaṃ syācca mādhava ..
etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ vistarānmadhusūdana .. 7 ..
meaning:
तासां प्रयत्नाद्दानेन किं पुण्यं स्याच्च माधव ..
एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं विस्तरान्मधुसूदन .. 7 ..
text_mt: And what merit would there be from their gift made with effort, O Mādhava? / I wish to hear this in detail, O Madhusūdana.

sanskrit_iast:
.. varāha uvāca .. ..
śṛṇuṣva bhadre tattvena pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam ..
kṛtvā yatsarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
.. वराह उवाच .. ..
शृणुष्व भद्रे तत्त्वेन पवित्रं पापनाशनम् ..
कृत्वा यत्सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः .. 8 ..
text_mt:
Varāha said:
Listen in truth, O auspicious one, to that which is pure and destroys sins, / by doing which one is freed from all sins; there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
kapilā agnihotrārthaṃ yajñārthe ca varānane ..
uddhṛtya sarvatejāṃsi brahmaṇā nirmitā purā .. 9 ..
meaning:
कपिला अग्निहोत्रार्थं यज्ञार्थे च वरानने ..
उद्धृत्य सर्वतेजांसि ब्रह्मणा निर्मिता पुरा .. 9 ..
text_mt: The kapilā cow, for the agnihotra and for sacrifice, O fair-faced one, / was fashioned of old by Brahmā, extracting all splendours.

sanskrit_iast:
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca maṅgalānāṃ ca maṃgalam ..
puṇyānāṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ kapilā ca varānane .. 4.161.10 ..
meaning:
पवित्राणां पवित्रं च मङ्गलानां च मंगलम् ..
पुण्यानां परमं पुण्यं कपिला च वरानने .. 4.161.10 ..
text_mt: The purest of the pure, the most auspicious of the auspicious, / the supreme merit among merits, O fair-faced one, is the kapilā cow.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasastapa evāgryaṃ vratānāmuttamaṃ vrataṃ ..
dānānāmuttamaṃ dānaṃ vidhinā hyetadakṣayam .. 11 ..
meaning:
तपसस्तप एवाग्र्यं व्रतानामुत्तमं व्रतं ..
दानानामुत्तमं दानं विधिना ह्येतदक्षयम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: The foremost austerity among austerities, the highest vow among vows, / the supreme gift among gifts, this [offering performed] according to rule is imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni guhyānyāyatanāni ca ..
pavitrāṇi ca puṇyāni sarvaloke vasundhare .. 12 ..
meaning:
पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि गुह्यान्यायतनानि च ..
पवित्राणि च पुण्यानि सर्वलोके वसुन्धरे .. 12 ..
text_mt: Whatever sacred fords and secret sanctuaries are on the earth, / pure and holy in all the world, O Vasundharā,

sanskrit_iast:
hotavyānyagnihotrāṇi sāyaṃ prātardvijātibhiḥ ..
kapilāyā ghṛteneha daśa kṣīreṇa vā punaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
होतव्यान्यग्निहोत्राणि सायं प्रातर्द्विजातिभिः ..
कपिलाया घृतेनेह दश क्षीरेण वा पुनः .. 13 ..
text_mt: the agnihotras are to be offered evening and morning by the twice-born / with ghee of the kapilā cow in this world, or with ten parts of milk.

sanskrit_iast:
yajaṃte ye'gnihotrāṇi annaiśca vividhaiḥ sadā ..
pūjayantyatithīṃścaiva parāṃ bhaktimupāgatāḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
यजंते येऽग्निहोत्राणि अन्नैश्च विविधैः सदा ..
पूजयन्त्यतिथींश्चैव परां भक्तिमुपागताः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Those who ever worship the agnihotras with diverse foods, / and honour guests, having attained supreme devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ tvādityavarṇaiśca vimānairjāyate gatiḥ ..
sūryamaṇḍalamadhye ca brahmaṇā nirmitā purā .. 15 ..
meaning:
तेषां त्वादित्यवर्णैश्च विमानैर्जायते गतिः ..
सूर्यमण्डलमध्ये च ब्रह्मणा निर्मिता पुरा .. 15 ..
text_mt: their departure takes place by means of celestial chariots having the colour of the sun; / and within the orb of the sun [the kapilā] was fashioned of old by Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
kapilāyāḥ śiro grīvāṃ sarva tīrthāni bhāmini ..
pitāmahaniyogācca nivasaṃti hi nityaśaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
कपिलायाः शिरो ग्रीवां सर्व तीर्थानि भामिनि ..
पितामहनियोगाच्च निवसंति हि नित्यशः .. 16 ..
text_mt: In the head and neck of the kapilā cow, O lovely one, / all sacred fords dwell perpetually by command of the Grandfather.

sanskrit_iast:
prātarutthāya yo martyaḥ kapilā galamastakāt ..
cyutaṃ tu bhaktyā pānīyaṃ śirasā dhārayennaraḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
प्रातरुत्थाय यो मर्त्यः कपिला गलमस्तकात् ..
च्युतं तु भक्त्या पानीयं शिरसा धारयेन्नरः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Having risen in the morning, whichever mortal man with devotion / bears upon his head water dripping from the throat and head of a kapilā cow,

sanskrit_iast:
sa tena puṇyenopetastatkṣaṇādgatakilviṣaḥ ..
viṃśadvarṣakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ dahatyagnirivendhanam .. 18 ..
meaning:
स तेन पुण्येनोपेतस्तत्क्षणाद्गतकिल्विषः ..
विंशद्वर्षकृतं पापं दहत्यग्निरिवेन्धनम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: endowed with that merit, his sins are gone that very moment; / it burns away the sin committed across twenty years, as fire burns fuel.

sanskrit_iast:
kalya utthāya yo martyaḥ kuryāttāsāṃ pradakṣiṇam ..
pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena pṛthivī syādvasundhare .. 19 ..
meaning:
कल्य उत्थाय यो मर्त्यः कुर्यात्तासां प्रदक्षिणम् ..
प्रदक्षिणीकृता तेन पृथिवी स्याद्वसुन्धरे .. 19 ..
text_mt: Having risen at dawn, whichever mortal performs circumambulation of them, / by him the earth has been circumambulated, O Vasundharā.

sanskrit_iast:
pradakṣiṇāyāṃ caikāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ ca vasundhare ..
daśavarṣakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ naśyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 4.161.20 ..
meaning:
प्रदक्षिणायां चैकायां कृतायां च वसुन्धरे ..
दशवर्षकृतं पापं नश्यते नात्र संशयः .. 4.161.20 ..
text_mt: And when a single circumambulation is performed, O Vasundharā, / the sin committed across ten years is destroyed; there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
kapilāyāstu mūtreṇa snāyādvai yaḥ śucivrataḥ ..
sa gaṅgādyeṣu tīrtheṣu snāto bhavati mānavaḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
कपिलायास्तु मूत्रेण स्नायाद्वै यः शुचिव्रतः ..
स गङ्गाद्येषु तीर्थेषु स्नातो भवति मानवः .. 21 ..
text_mt: He who, observing a pure vow, bathes with the urine of a kapilā cow, / that man becomes one who has bathed in the Gaṅgā and other sacred fords.

sanskrit_iast:
yena snānena caikena bhavamukto bhavennaraḥ ..
yāvajjīvakṛtātpāpāttatkṣaṇādeva mucyate .. 22 ..
meaning:
येन स्नानेन चैकेन भवमुक्तो भवेन्नरः ..
यावज्जीवकृतात्पापात्तत्क्षणादेव मुच्यते .. 22 ..
text_mt: By which single bath a man becomes liberated from worldly existence; / he is freed that very moment from the sin committed throughout his life.

sanskrit_iast:
gosahasraṃ ca yo dadyādekāṃ vā kapilāṃ naraḥ ..
samametatpurā prāha brahmaloke pitāmahaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
गोसहस्रं च यो दद्यादेकां वा कपिलां नरः ..
सममेतत्पुरा प्राह ब्रह्मलोके पितामहः .. 23 ..
text_mt: Whether a man gives a thousand cows or a single kapilā cow, / the Grandfather declared of old in the world of Brahmā that these are equal.

sanskrit_iast:
yaścaikāṃ kapilāṃ hanyānnaro rajjukaro yadi ..
gosahasraṃ hataṃ tena bhavatīha na saṃśayaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
यश्चैकां कपिलां हन्यान्नरो रज्जुकरो यदि ..
गोसहस्रं हतं तेन भवतीह न संशयः .. 24 ..
text_mt: And if a man should kill a single kapilā cow, even if making a halter, / a thousand cows have been killed by him in this world; there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
gavāṃ sthitiṃ kalpayeta ghṛtaṃ gavyaṃ na dūṣayet ..
yāvaddhi varddhate gavyaṃ tāvatpāpaistu pūyate .. 25 ...
meaning:
गवां स्थितिं कल्पयेत घृतं गव्यं न दूषयेत् ..
यावद्धि वर्द्धते गव्यं तावत्पापैस्तु पूयते .. 25 ...
text_mt: One should arrange shelter for cattle and not spoil cow’s ghee; / for as long as the products of the cow increase, so long is one purified of sins.

sanskrit_iast:
gavāṃ kaṃḍūyanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tathā ca pratipālanam ..
tulyaṃ goghṛtadānasya bhayarogādipālanam .. 26 ..
meaning:
गवां कंडूयनं श्रेष्ठं तथा च प्रतिपालनम् ..
तुल्यं गोघृतदानस्य भयरोगादिपालनम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: Scratching cows is excellent, as is tending to them; / protecting [them] from fear, disease, and the like is equal to the gift of cow’s ghee.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛṇādibhakṣaṇārthaṃ ca gavāṃ dadyāddharādikam ..
svargavāsaphalaṃ divyaṃ labhate mānavottamaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
तृणादिभक्षणार्थं च गवां दद्याद्धरादिकम् ..
स्वर्गवासफलं दिव्यं लभते मानवोत्तमः .. 27 ..
text_mt: And for cows to feed on grass and the like, one should give land and other [possessions]; / the best of men obtains the celestial reward of dwelling in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
daśeha kapilāḥ proktāḥ svayameva svayaṃbhuvā ..
yo dadyācchrotriyasyaiva svargaṃ gatvā sa mānavaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
दशेह कपिलाः प्रोक्ताः स्वयमेव स्वयंभुवा ..
यो दद्याच्छ्रोत्रियस्यैव स्वर्गं गत्वा स मानवः .. 28 ..
text_mt: Ten kinds of tawny cows are proclaimed here by the Self-born One himself. / The man who gives [one] to a learned Brāhmaṇa alone, having gone to heaven,

sanskrit_iast:
vimānairvividhairdivyairdivyakanyābhirarcitaḥ ..
sevyamānastu gaṃdharvairdīpyamānā yathāgnayaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
विमानैर्विविधैर्दिव्यैर्दिव्यकन्याभिरर्चितः ..
सेव्यमानस्तु गंधर्वैर्दीप्यमाना यथाग्नयः .. 29 ..
text_mt: Honoured by celestial maidens in various divine aerial chariots, / and served by Gandharvas, blazes like fires.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇakapilā pūrvā dvitīyā gaurapiṅgalā ..
āśā caiva tṛtīyā syādagnijvālā caturthikā .. 4.161.30 ..
meaning:
सुवर्णकपिला पूर्वा द्वितीया गौरपिङ्गला ..
आशा चैव तृतीया स्यादग्निज्वाला चतुर्थिका .. 4.161.30 ..
text_mt: The first is the golden-tawny; the second is the yellowish-red; / the third is the Āśā; and the fourth is the Agnijvālā.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcamī juhuvarṇā syātṣaṣṭhī tu ghṛtapiṅgalā ..
saptamī śvetapiṅgā syādaṣṭamī kṣīrapiṅgalā .. 31 ..
meaning:
पंचमी जुहुवर्णा स्यात्षष्ठी तु घृतपिङ्गला ..
सप्तमी श्वेतपिङ्गा स्यादष्टमी क्षीरपिङ्गला .. 31 ..
text_mt: The fifth is of sacrificial ladle colour, and the sixth is ghee-reddish; / the seventh is white-reddish, and the eighth is milk-reddish.

sanskrit_iast:
navamī pāṭalā jñeyā daśamī puṣpapiṅgalā ..
etā daśa samākhyātāḥ kapilāśca vasuṃdhare .. 32 ..
meaning:
नवमी पाटला ज्ञेया दशमी पुष्पपिङ्गला ..
एता दश समाख्याताः कपिलाश्च वसुंधरे .. 32 ..
text_mt: The ninth is to be known as Pāṭalā, and the tenth as flower-reddish. / These ten tawny cows are described, O Earth!

sanskrit_iast:
sarvā hyetā mahābhāgāstārayaṃti na saṃśayaḥ ..
saṃgameṣu praśastāśca sarvapāpapraṇāśanāḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
सर्वा ह्येता महाभागास्तारयंति न संशयः ..
संगमेषु प्रशस्ताश्च सर्वपापप्रणाशनाः .. 33 ..
text_mt: For all these highly fortunate ones cause [one] to cross over, without doubt; / they are praised at confluences and destroy all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
evametāstu kapilāḥ pāpaghnyaśca vasundhare ..
āśā caiva tu yā proktā agnigarbhānalaprabhā ..34..
meaning:
एवमेतास्तु कपिलाः पापघ्न्यश्च वसुन्धरे ..
आशा चैव तु या प्रोक्ता अग्निगर्भानलप्रभा ..34..
text_mt: Thus these tawny cows destroy sins, O Earth! / And that which is called Āśā has the womb of fire and the radiance of fire,

sanskrit_iast:
agnijvālojjvalaiḥ śṛṃgaiḥ pradīptāṃgāralocanā ..
agnipuṣpā agnilomā tathānyā cānalaprabhā ..35..
meaning:
अग्निज्वालोज्ज्वलैः शृंगैः प्रदीप्तांगारलोचना ..
अग्निपुष्पा अग्निलोमा तथान्या चानलप्रभा ..35..
text_mt: With horns blazing like flames of fire, with eyes like glowing coals, / with fire-like spots, with fire-coloured hair, and another with the radiance of fire.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmāgneyyāṃ sadā dadyādbrāhmaṇāyetaraiḥ sadā ..
gṛhītvā kapilāṃ śūdraḥ kāmatastatpayaḥ pibet ..36..
meaning:
तामाग्नेय्यां सदा दद्याद्ब्राह्मणायेतरैः सदा ..
गृहीत्वा कपिलां शूद्रः कामतस्तत्पयः पिबेत् ..36..
text_mt: One should always give her in the south-east to a Brāhmaṇa, always by others. / If a Śūdra, taking a tawny cow, should drink her milk out of desire,

sanskrit_iast:
patitaśca bhavennityaṃ caṃḍālasadṛśaḥ pumān..
tasmānna pratigṛhṇīyācchabalāṃ gāṃ kathaṃcana ..37..
meaning:
पतितश्च भवेन्नित्यं चंडालसदृशः पुमान्..
तस्मान्न प्रतिगृह्णीयाच्छबलां गां कथंचन ..37..
text_mt: That man would constantly become fallen, equal to a Caṇḍāla. / Therefore one should never accept a spotted cow.

sanskrit_iast:
dvārāṃte parihartavyā kapilā gaurdvijetaraiḥ ..
lokeṣu te mṛḍhatamāḥ kapilākṣīrabhojanāḥ ..38..
meaning:
द्वारांते परिहर्तव्या कपिला गौर्द्विजेतरैः ..
लोकेषु ते मृढतमाः कपिलाक्षीरभोजनाः ..38..
text_mt: A tawny cow should be avoided at the house's threshold by those other than the twice-born. / Those who consume the milk of a tawny cow are the most foolish in the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃbhāṣyāśca patitāḥ śūdrāste pāpakarmiṇaḥ ..
pibaṃti yāvatkapilāṃ tāvatteṣāṃ pitāmahāḥ ..
amedhyaṃ bhuñjate'tastāṃ nopajīveddvijetaraḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
असंभाष्याश्च पतिताः शूद्रास्ते पापकर्मिणः ..
पिबंति यावत्कपिलां तावत्तेषां पितामहाः ..
अमेध्यं भुञ्जतेऽतस्तां नोपजीवेद्द्विजेतरः .. 39 ..
text_mt: Those sinful Śūdras are unfit to be spoken to and are fallen. / As long as they drink [from] a tawny cow, so long their ancestors / eat impure matter; therefore, one other than a twice-born must not subsist on her.

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāṃ ghṛtaṃ ca kṣīraṃ vā navanītamathāpi vā ..
upajīvaṃti ye śūdrāste prayāṃti yamālayam ..4.161.40..
meaning:
तासां घृतं च क्षीरं वा नवनीतमथापि वा ..
उपजीवंति ये शूद्रास्ते प्रयांति यमालयम् ..4.161.40..
text_mt: Those Śūdras who subsist on their ghee, milk, or butter, / go to the abode of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
kapilājīvinaḥ śūdrāḥ sarve gacchaṃti rauravam ..
raurave bhuñjate duḥkhaṃ varṣakoṭi śatoṣitāḥ ..41..
meaning:
कपिलाजीविनः शूद्राः सर्वे गच्छंति रौरवम् ..
रौरवे भुञ्जते दुःखं वर्षकोटि शतोषिताः ..41..
text_mt: All Śūdras who subsist on a tawny cow go to Raurava; / dwelling for hundreds of millions of years in Raurava, they experience suffering.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vimuktāḥ kālena jāyaṃte śvānayoniṣu ..
śvānayonervimuktāste viṣṭhāyāṃ kṛmiyonigāḥ ..42..
meaning:
ततो विमुक्ताः कालेन जायंते श्वानयोनिषु ..
श्वानयोनेर्विमुक्तास्ते विष्ठायां कृमियोनिगाः ..42..
text_mt: Then, released in the course of time, they are born in the wombs of dogs; / released from the womb of a dog, they enter the wombs of worms in feces.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṭhāsveva ca pāpiṣṭhā durgaṃdheṣu ca nityaśaḥ..
bhūyo'pi jāyamānāste tatrottāro na vidyate ..43..
meaning:
विष्ठास्वेव च पापिष्ठा दुर्गंधेषु च नित्यशः..
भूयोऽपि जायमानास्ते तत्रोत्तारो न विद्यते ..43..
text_mt: Constantly being born again in feces and foul odors, / those most sinful ones find no rescue there.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaścaiva yo devi kuryātteṣāṃ pratigraham ..
tataḥ prabhṛtyamedhyāyāṃ pitarastasya śerate .. 44 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणश्चैव यो देवि कुर्यात्तेषां प्रतिग्रहम् ..
ततः प्रभृत्यमेध्यायां पितरस्तस्य शेरते .. 44 ..
text_mt: And whatever Brāhmaṇa, O goddess, should accept [a gift] from them, / from then on his ancestors lie in impurity.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ vipraṃ nānubhāṣeta na cāpyekāsane viśet ..
sa nityaṃ varjanīyo vai dūrāttu brāhmaṇādhamaḥ ..45..
meaning:
तं विप्रं नानुभाषेत न चाप्येकासने विशेत् ..
स नित्यं वर्जनीयो वै दूरात्तु ब्राह्मणाधमः ..45..
text_mt: One should not converse with that Vipra, nor sit on the same seat [with him]; / that lowest of Brāhmaṇas is indeed always to be avoided from afar.

sanskrit_iast:
yastena saha bhāṣeta prāyaścittī bhave ddvijaḥ ..
ekasya gopradānasya sahasrāṃśo na pūryate ..46..
meaning:
यस्तेन सह भाषेत प्रायश्चित्ती भवे द्द्विजः ..
एकस्य गोप्रदानस्य सहस्रांशो न पूर्यते ..46..
text_mt: A twice-born who speaks with him must perform an expiation. / A thousandth part of [the merit of] giving a single cow is not equalled [by other gifts].

sanskrit_iast: kimanyairbahubhirdānaiḥ koṭisaṃkhyātavistaraiḥ..47..
meaning: किमन्यैर्बहुभिर्दानैः कोटिसंख्यातविस्तरैः..47..
text_mt: What need of other numerous gifts, extensive by the tens of millions?

sanskrit_iast:
śrotriyāya daridrāya suvṛttāyāhitāgnaye ..
dattvaikāṃ kapilāṃ dhenuṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ..48..
meaning:
श्रोत्रियाय दरिद्राय सुवृत्तायाहिताग्नये ..
दत्त्वैकां कपिलां धेनुं सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ..48..
text_mt: By giving a single tawny milch cow to a poor learned Brāhmaṇa of good conduct / who maintains the sacred fire, one is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
māse prasavinīṃ dhenuṃ dānārthī pratipālayet ..
ātmārthe na prapālyā hi sadā narakabhīrubhiḥ ..49...
meaning:
मासे प्रसविनीं धेनुं दानार्थी प्रतिपालयेत् ..
आत्मार्थे न प्रपाल्या हि सदा नरकभीरुभिः ..49...
text_mt: One desirous of giving should tend a cow about to calve within a month; / she should never be kept for oneself by those afraid of hell.

sanskrit_iast:
kapilā'rdhaprasūtā ca dātavyā hi dvijanmane ..
jāyamānasya vatsasya mukhaṃ yonyāṃ pradṛśyate .. 4.161.50 ..
meaning:
कपिलाऽर्धप्रसूता च दातव्या हि द्विजन्मने ..
जायमानस्य वत्सस्य मुखं योन्यां प्रदृश्यते .. 4.161.50 ..
text_mt: A tawny cow half-delivered should indeed be given to a twice-born. / When the face of the calf being born is seen in the vulva,

sanskrit_iast: tāvatsā pṛthivī jñeyā yāvadgarbhaṃ na muṃcati .. .. 51 ..
meaning: तावत्सा पृथिवी ज्ञेया यावद्गर्भं न मुंचति .. .. 51 ..
text_mt: She is to be considered the earth so long as she does not discharge the fetus.

sanskrit_iast:
dhenoryāvaṃti romāṇi savatsāyā vasundhare ..
bhūmyāṃ tu pāṃsavo yāvadyāvannakṣatratārakāḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
धेनोर्यावंति रोमाणि सवत्साया वसुन्धरे ..
भूम्यां तु पांसवो यावद्यावन्नक्षत्रतारकाः .. 52 ..
text_mt: As many hairs as there are on the milch cow with her calf, O Earth, / and as many specks of dust as there are on the ground, and as many as the stars and asterisms,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi brahmeśādibhirarcitaḥ ..
brahmaloke nivasati yaścaikakapilāpradaḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि ब्रह्मेशादिभिरर्चितः ..
ब्रह्मलोके निवसति यश्चैककपिलाप्रदः .. 53 ..
text_mt: For that many thousands of years does the giver of a single tawny cow / dwell in the world of Brahmā, worshipped by Brahmā, Īśa, and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇaśṛṅgīṃ yaḥ kṛtvā khurai raupyaiḥ samarcitām ..
brāhmaṇasya kare dattvā suvarṇaṃ raupyameva ca .. 54 ..
meaning:
सुवर्णशृङ्गीं यः कृत्वा खुरै रौप्यैः समर्चिताम् ..
ब्राह्मणस्य करे दत्त्वा सुवर्णं रौप्यमेव च .. 54 ..
text_mt: One who makes [her] golden-horned, adorned with silver hooves, / placing gold and silver in the hand of the Brāhmaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
kapilāyāstadā putraṃ brāhmaṇasya kare nyaset ..
udakaṃ ca kare dattvā vācayeta svaśaktitaḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
कपिलायास्तदा पुत्रं ब्राह्मणस्य करे न्यसेत् ..
उदकं च करे दत्त्वा वाचयेत स्वशक्तितः .. 55 ..
text_mt: Should then place the son of the tawny cow in the hand of the Brāhmaṇa. / And having given water in his hand, he should recite [the formula] according to his ability.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇaistu caturbhiśca tribhirdvābhyāmathāpi vā ..
ekahīnā na dātavyā yadīcchecchubhamātmanaḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
सुवर्णैस्तु चतुर्भिश्च त्रिभिर्द्वाभ्यामथापि वा ..
एकहीना न दातव्या यदीच्छेच्छुभमात्मनः .. 56 ..
text_mt: With four suvarṇas [of gold], or three, or even two; / it should not be given deficient by one, if one desires his own welfare.

sanskrit_iast:
sa samudravanopetā saśailavanakānanā ..
ratnapūrṇā bhaveddattā pṛthivī nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
स समुद्रवनोपेता सशैलवनकानना ..
रत्नपूर्णा भवेद्दत्ता पृथिवी नात्र संशयः .. 57 ..
text_mt: The earth with its oceans and forests, with its mountains and woodlands, / full of jewels, is given; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivīdānatulyena dānenaitena vai naraḥ ..
tārito yāti pitṛbhirvaiṣṇavaṃ yatpadaṃ param .. 58 ..
meaning:
पृथिवीदानतुल्येन दानेनैतेन वै नरः ..
तारितो याति पितृभिर्वैष्णवं यत्पदं परम् .. 58 ..
text_mt: By this gift, equal to the gift of the earth, a man indeed, / rescued together with his ancestors, goes to the supreme abode of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmasvaharaṇo goghno bhrūṇahā brahmaghātakaḥ ..
pāpakṛccobhayamukhīṃ dadyātsatkanakānvitām ..
taddinaṃ ca payobhojī saṃyataścātivāhayet .. 59 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मस्वहरणो गोघ्नो भ्रूणहा ब्रह्मघातकः ..
पापकृच्चोभयमुखीं दद्यात्सत्कनकान्विताम् ..
तद्दिनं च पयोभोजी संयतश्चातिवाहयेत् .. 59 ..
text_mt: A thief of Brāhmaṇa's property, a cow-killer, a destroyer of an embryo, a killer of a Brāhmaṇa, / or an evildoer should give a cow with faces on both ends, adorned with fine gold; / and on that day, subsisting on milk and restrained, he should pass the time.

sanskrit_iast:
gomayenopalipyātha maṇḍalaṃ vidhipūrvakam ..
svaśākhoktena maṃtreṇa homayettu vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 4.161.60 ..
meaning:
गोमयेनोपलिप्याथ मण्डलं विधिपूर्वकम् ..
स्वशाखोक्तेन मंत्रेण होमयेत्तु विचक्षणः .. 4.161.60 ..
text_mt: Then, having smeared a circle with cow dung according to rule, / the wise one should perform an oblation with the mantra taught in his own school.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāhṛtyā homayetpūrvaṃ paṃcavāruṇakaṃ tathā ..
irāvatī dhenumatī devasya tveti vā punaḥ .. 61 ..
meaning:
व्याहृत्या होमयेत्पूर्वं पंचवारुणकं तथा ..
इरावती धेनुमती देवस्य त्वेति वा पुनः .. 61 ..
text_mt: He should first offer oblations with the vyāhṛtis, and likewise the five Vāruṇa [mantras], / or again with 'Irāvatī dhenumatī...' and 'Devasya tvā...'.

sanskrit_iast:
syonā pṛthivi maṃtreṇa gaurvatsasahitā navā ..
nikāmaphaladā dhenuḥ sā syātsurabhinaṃdinī .. 62 ..
meaning:
स्योना पृथिवि मंत्रेण गौर्वत्ससहिता नवा ..
निकामफलदा धेनुः सा स्यात्सुरभिनंदिनी .. 62 ..
text_mt: With the mantra 'Syonā pṛthivi...', a new cow together with her calf, / yielding all desired fruits, becomes a daughter of Surabhi.

sanskrit_iast:
yā te sarasvatī devī viṣṇunā ca tathā mahī ..
gaurī viṣṇupadaṃ coktvā śāṃtikarmaṇi vācayet .. 63 ..
meaning:
या ते सरस्वती देवी विष्णुना च तथा मही ..
गौरी विष्णुपदं चोक्त्वा शांतिकर्मणि वाचयेत् .. 63 ..
text_mt: Having recited 'Yā te sarasvatī devī...' and likewise the Earth with Viṣṇu, / 'Gaurī', and the abode of Viṣṇu, he should cause [them] to be recited in the rite of pacification.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvadvatsasyadvau pādau śiraścaiva pradṛśyate ..
tāvadvai pṛthivī jñeyā yāvadgarbhaṃ na muñcati ..
tasminkāle pradātavyā brāhmaṇāya vasuṃdhare .. 64 ..
meaning:
यावद्वत्सस्यद्वौ पादौ शिरश्चैव प्रदृश्यते ..
तावद्वै पृथिवी ज्ञेया यावद्गर्भं न मुञ्चति ..
तस्मिन्काले प्रदातव्या ब्राह्मणाय वसुंधरे .. 64 ..
text_mt: As long as the two feet and the head of the calf are seen, / so long she is indeed to be considered the earth, as long as she does not discharge the fetus; / at that time she should be given to a Brāhmaṇa, O Earth!

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇaśṛṃgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ kāsyadohāṃ satāmrakām ..
savastraghaṃṭābharaṇāṃ gaṃdhapuṣpairalaṃkṛtām ..
vastrākṣataiḥ samabhyarcya brāhmaṇāya samarpayet 65 ..
meaning:
सुवर्णशृंगीं रौप्यखुरां कास्यदोहां सताम्रकाम् ..
सवस्त्रघंटाभरणां गंधपुष्पैरलंकृताम् ..
वस्त्राक्षतैः समभ्यर्च्य ब्राह्मणाय समर्पयेत् 65 ..
text_mt: With golden horns, silver hooves, a bronze milking vessel, accompanied by copper, / equipped with garments, bells, and ornaments, adorned with perfumes and flowers, / having worshipped her with cloths and unbroken rice grains, he should present her to a Brāhmaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇasya sahasreṇa tadardhenāpi bhāmini ..
tasyāpyardhena śaktyā'tha tasyāpyarddhena vā punaḥ .. .. 66 ..
meaning:
सुवर्णस्य सहस्रेण तदर्धेनापि भामिनि ..
तस्याप्यर्धेन शक्त्याऽथ तस्याप्यर्द्धेन वा पुनः .. .. 66 ..
text_mt: With a thousand [measures] of gold, or even half of that, O spirited lady, / or half of that according to ability, or again half of that,

sanskrit_iast:
yathā śaktyā pradātavyā vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaiḥ ..
kare dattvā suvarṇaṃ ca athavā rūpyameva ca ..
gṛhāṇemāṃ mahādhenuṃ bhava bhrātā mamāśu vai ..
sarvapāpakṣayaṃ kṛtvā sadā svastikaro bhava ..68..
meaning:
यथा शक्त्या प्रदातव्या वित्तशाठ्यविवर्जितैः ..
करे दत्त्वा सुवर्णं च अथवा रूप्यमेव च ..
गृहाणेमां महाधेनुं भव भ्राता ममाशु वै ..
सर्वपापक्षयं कृत्वा सदा स्वस्तिकरो भव ..68..
text_mt: It should be given according to capacity by those free from dishonesty regarding wealth. / Placing gold or silver in his hand, [one should say:] / 'Accept this great milch cow; become at once my brother indeed! / Having destroyed all sins, always bring welfare!'

sanskrit_iast:
irāvatī dhenumatī jāhnavī tadanantaram ..
pratidāsyāmi te dhenuṃ kuṭumbārthe viśeṣataḥ ..69..
meaning:
इरावती धेनुमती जाह्नवी तदनन्तरम् ..
प्रतिदास्यामि ते धेनुं कुटुम्बार्थे विशेषतः ..69..
text_mt: 'Irāvatī, Dhenumatī, and then Jāhnavī— / I will give the cow back to you, especially for the sake of your family.'

sanskrit_iast:
bhavatātsvasti me nityaṃ sukhaṃ cānuttamaṃ tathā ..
dattā tu pṛthivī devī tvayeyaṃ pratigṛhyatām ..4.161.70..
meaning:
भवतात्स्वस्ति मे नित्यं सुखं चानुत्तमं तथा ..
दत्ता तु पृथिवी देवी त्वयेयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् ..4.161.70..
text_mt: 'May there always be welfare for me, and likewise unsurpassed happiness! / This goddess Earth has been given; let her be accepted by you.'

sanskrit_iast:
ko'dāditi ca vai maṃtro japitavyo dvijena ca ...
visṛjya brāhmaṇaṃ so'pi tāṃ dhenuṃ svagṛhaṃ nayet .. 71 ..
meaning:
कोऽदादिति च वै मंत्रो जपितव्यो द्विजेन च ...
विसृज्य ब्राह्मणं सोऽपि तां धेनुं स्वगृहं नयेत् .. 71 ..
text_mt: And the mantra 'Who gave?' should indeed be recited by the twice-born; / having taken leave of the brāhmaṇa, he too should lead that cow to his home.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ prasūyamānāṃ gāṃ yo dadāti vasundhare ..
sā samudravanopetā saśailavanakānanā ..
ratnapūrṇā bhaveddattā pṛthivī nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 72 ..
meaning:
एवं प्रसूयमानां गां यो ददाति वसुन्धरे ..
सा समुद्रवनोपेता सशैलवनकानना ..
रत्नपूर्णा भवेद्दत्ता पृथिवी नात्र संशयः .. 72 ..
text_mt: Whoever gives a cow while it is giving birth in this manner, O Earth, / by him the earth, with its oceans and groves, with its mountains, forests, and woods, / filled with jewels, has been given—there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
prataptajāṃbūnadatulyavarṇāṃ mahānitaṃbāṃ tanuvṛttamadhyām ..
arddhaprasūtāṃ dvimukhīṃ suśīlāṃ sevantyajasraṃ kapilāṃ hi devāḥ .. 73 ..
meaning:
प्रतप्तजांबूनदतुल्यवर्णां महानितंबां तनुवृत्तमध्याम् ..
अर्द्धप्रसूतां द्विमुखीं सुशीलां सेवन्त्यजस्रं कपिलां हि देवाः .. 73 ..
text_mt: With a complexion resembling molten gold, broad hips, and a slender, rounded waist, / half-calved, two-faced, and gentle-natured—the gods ever attend upon such a Kapila cow.

sanskrit_iast:
prātarutthāya yo bhaktyā dhenukalpaṃ naro bhuvi ..
jitendriyaḥ śucirbhūtvā paṭhedbhaktyā samanvitaḥ .. 74 ..
meaning:
प्रातरुत्थाय यो भक्त्या धेनुकल्पं नरो भुवि ..
जितेन्द्रियः शुचिर्भूत्वा पठेद्भक्त्या समन्वितः .. 74 ..
text_mt: Having risen in the morning, whichever man on earth with devotion, / self-controlled and purified, recites the ritual manual of the cow endowed with devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
trikālaṃ paṭhate yastu pāpaṃ varṣaśatodbhavam ..
naśyatyekakṣaṇādeva vāyunā pāṃsavo yathā .. 75 ..
meaning:
त्रिकालं पठते यस्तु पापं वर्षशतोद्भवम् ..
नश्यत्येकक्षणादेव वायुना पांसवो यथा .. 75 ..
text_mt: Whoever recites it at the three junctures of the day, his sin arising from a hundred years / is destroyed in an instant, just as dust by the wind.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhakāle paṭhedyastu idaṃ pāvanamuttamam ..
tasyānnaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ tadvai pitaro'śnaṃti dhīmataḥ .. 76 ..
meaning:
श्राद्धकाले पठेद्यस्तु इदं पावनमुत्तमम् ..
तस्यान्नं संस्कृतं तद्वै पितरोऽश्नंति धीमतः .. 76 ..
text_mt: Whoever recites this supreme purifying [text] at the time of an ancestral rite, / his ancestors indeed consume that food of the wise man properly consecrated.

sanskrit_iast:
amāvāsyāṃ ca yo vidvāndvijānāmagrataḥ paṭhet ..
pitarastasya tuṣyaṃti varṣāṇāṃ śatameva ca .. 77 ..
meaning:
अमावास्यां च यो विद्वान्द्विजानामग्रतः पठेत् ..
पितरस्तस्य तुष्यंति वर्षाणां शतमेव च .. 77 ..
text_mt: And whichever learned man recites it on the new-moon day before twice-born men, / his ancestors are pleased for a full hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
yaścaitatchṛṇuyātpuṇyaṃ tadgatenāṃtarātmanā ..
saṃvatsarakṛtātpāpāttatkṣaṇādeva mucyate .. 78..
meaning:
यश्चैतत्छृणुयात्पुण्यं तद्गतेनांतरात्मना ..
संवत्सरकृतात्पापात्तत्क्षणादेव मुच्यते .. 78..
text_mt: And whoever listens to this sacred [manual] with a concentrated inner self / is freed instantly from the sin committed throughout a year.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ rahasyaṃ rājendra varāhamukhanirgatam..
dharaṇyai kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 79 ..
mahiṣīdānavratavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
इदं रहस्यं राजेन्द्र वराहमुखनिर्गतम्..
धरण्यै कथितं पूर्वं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .. 79 ..
महिषीदानव्रतविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
This secret, O king of kings, issued from the mouth of the Boar, / was told to the Earth of old, destroying all sins.
Description of the procedure for the observance of the gift of a female buffalo.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
mahiṣīdānamāhātmyaṃ kathayāmi yudhiṣṭhira ..
puṇyaṃ pāpavināśaṃ ca āyuṣyaṃ sarvakāmadam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
महिषीदानमाहात्म्यं कथयामि युधिष्ठिर ..
पुण्यं पापविनाशं च आयुष्यं सर्वकामदम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / I shall describe the greatness of the gift of a female buffalo, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / which is meritorious, destroys sins, bestows longevity, and grants all desires.
title: Mahiṣīdānavratavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
candrasūryagrahe puṇye kārttikyāmayane tathā ..
śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ sūryasaṃkrāntivāsare .. 2 ..
meaning:
चन्द्रसूर्यग्रहे पुण्ये कार्त्तिक्यामयने तथा ..
शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां सूर्यसंक्रान्तिवासरे .. 2 ..
text_mt: At an eclipse of the moon or the sun, on the holy full moon of Kārttika, on a solstice, / on the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight, on the day of the sun's transit,

sanskrit_iast:
yadā vā jāyate cittaṃ vittaṃ ca kurunandana ..
tadaiva deyā mahiṣī saṃsārabhayabhīruṇā .. 3 ..
meaning:
यदा वा जायते चित्तं वित्तं च कुरुनन्दन ..
तदैव देया महिषी संसारभयभीरुणा .. 3 ..
text_mt: Or whenever the inclination arises and wealth is present, O descendant of Kuru, / then indeed should a female buffalo be given by one fearful of the terrors of worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
supayodharaśobhāḍhyā suśṛṃgī sukhurā tathā ..
prathamaprasūtā taruṇī suśīlā doṣavarjitā .. 4 ..
meaning:
सुपयोधरशोभाढ्या सुशृंगी सुखुरा तथा ..
प्रथमप्रसूता तरुणी सुशीला दोषवर्जिता .. 4 ..
text_mt: Possessing the beauty of good udders, having fine horns and fine hooves, / having given birth for the first time, young, gentle-natured, and free from defects;

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇaśṛṅgatilakā ghaṃṭābharaṇabhūṣitā ..
raktavastrāvṛtā ramyā kāṃsyadohanakānvitā .. 5 ..
meaning:
सुवर्णशृङ्गतिलका घंटाभरणभूषिता ..
रक्तवस्त्रावृता रम्या कांस्यदोहनकान्विता .. 5 ..
text_mt: Marked with a golden mark on her forehead between the horns, adorned with bells as ornaments, / covered with red cloth, beautiful, accompanied by a bell-metal milking pail;

sanskrit_iast:
piṇyākapiṭikopetā sahiraṇyā ca śaktitaḥ ..
saptadhānyayutā deyā brāhmaṇe vedapārage .. 6 ..
meaning:
पिण्याकपिटिकोपेता सहिरण्या च शक्तितः ..
सप्तधान्ययुता देया ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे .. 6 ..
text_mt: Provided with a small basket of oil-cake, together with gold according to one's means, / accompanied by the seven grains, she should be given to a brāhmaṇa who has mastered the Vedas,

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇapāṭhake tadvajjyotiḥśāstravide tathā ..
deyā na vedarahite na ca kuvratine kvacit .. 7 ..
meaning:
पुराणपाठके तद्वज्ज्योतिःशास्त्रविदे तथा ..
देया न वेदरहिते न च कुव्रतिने क्वचित् .. 7 ..
text_mt: Or likewise to a reciter of the Purāṇas, or to one knowledgeable in astrology; / she should never be given to one devoid of Vedic knowledge, nor ever to one following bad observances.

sanskrit_iast:
dravyairebhiḥ samāyuktāṃ puṇye'hni vidhipūrvakam ..
dadyānmaṃtreṇa rājendra purāṇapaṭhitena tu .. 8 ..
meaning:
द्रव्यैरेभिः समायुक्तां पुण्येऽह्नि विधिपूर्वकम् ..
दद्यान्मंत्रेण राजेन्द्र पुराणपठितेन तु .. 8 ..
text_mt: Endowed with these articles, on an auspicious day according to the prescribed rules, / one should present her, O king of kings, with the mantra recited in the Purāṇa:

sanskrit_iast:
indrādilokapālānāṃ yā rājamahiṣī śubhā ..
mahiṣī dānamāhātmyātsāstu me sarvakāmadā .. 9 ..
meaning:
इन्द्रादिलोकपालानां या राजमहिषी शुभा ..
महिषी दानमाहात्म्यात्सास्तु मे सर्वकामदा .. 9 ..
text_mt: 'She who is the auspicious chief queen among the world protectors beginning with Indra, / may she, through the greatness of the gift of a buffalo cow, grant all my desires.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmarājasya sāhāyye yasyāḥ putraḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ..
mahiṣāsurasya jananī yā sāstu varadā mama ..4.162.10.. (iti dānamaṃtraḥ)
meaning:
धर्मराजस्य साहाय्ये यस्याः पुत्रः प्रतिष्ठितः ..
महिषासुरस्य जननी या सास्तु वरदा मम ..4.162.10.. (इति दानमंत्रः)
text_mt: Whose son is established to aid the King of Dharma, / she who is the mother of Mahiṣāsura, may she grant me boons.' (Thus the formula of donation.)

sanskrit_iast:
dadyātpradakṣiṇīkṛtya brāhmaṇe tāṃ payasvinīm..
pratigrahaḥ smṛtastasyāḥ pṛṣṭhadeśe svayaṃbhuvā..11..
meaning:
दद्यात्प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य ब्राह्मणे तां पयस्विनीम्..
प्रतिग्रहः स्मृतस्तस्याः पृष्ठदेशे स्वयंभुवा..11..
text_mt: Having circumambulated her, one should give that milch cow to the brāhmaṇa; / her acceptance was decreed by the Self-born to be on her back.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dattvā vidhānena brāhmaṇasya gṛhaṃ nayet ..
vastrairābharaṇaiḥ pūjya bhaktyā ca kurunandana .. 12 ..
meaning:
एवं दत्त्वा विधानेन ब्राह्मणस्य गृहं नयेत् ..
वस्त्रैराभरणैः पूज्य भक्त्या च कुरुनन्दन .. 12 ..
text_mt: Having thus given [her] according to the ritual, he should lead her to the brāhmaṇa's house, / having honoured him with garments and ornaments, and with devotion, O descendant of Kuru, [saying:]

sanskrit_iast: saṃpāditā mayā tubhyaṃ saṃtuṣṭo me bhava dvija .. 13 ..
meaning: संपादिता मया तुभ्यं संतुष्टो मे भव द्विज .. 13 ..
text_mt: 'She has been procured by me for you; be pleased with me, O twice-born!'

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā dattvā mahiṣīṃ dvijapuṅgave ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti iha loke paratra ca .. 14 ..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना दत्त्वा महिषीं द्विजपुङ्गवे ..
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति इह लोके परत्र च .. 14 ..
text_mt: Having given a female buffalo to an eminent twice-born man by this procedure, / he attains all desires in this world and in the next.

sanskrit_iast:
yā sā dadāti mahiṣīṃ sā rājamahiṣī bhavet ..
mahārājaḥ pumānrājanvyāsasya vacanaṃ yathā .. 15 ..
meaning:
या सा ददाति महिषीं सा राजमहिषी भवेत् ..
महाराजः पुमान्राजन्व्यासस्य वचनं यथा .. 15 ..
text_mt: Whichever woman gives a female buffalo, she becomes a king's chief queen; / a man becomes an emperor, O king, according to the word of Vyāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñayājī bhavedvipraḥ kṣatriyo vijayī bhavet ..
bhavedvaiśyastu dhanavāñchūdraḥ sarvārthasaṃyutaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
यज्ञयाजी भवेद्विप्रः क्षत्रियो विजयी भवेत् ..
भवेद्वैश्यस्तु धनवाञ्छूद्रः सर्वार्थसंयुतः .. 16 ..
text_mt: A vipra becomes a performer of Vedic sacrifices; a kṣatriya becomes victorious; / a vaiśya becomes wealthy; and a śūdra becomes endowed with all riches.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānnareṇa dātavyā mahiṣī vibhave sati ..
putrapautraprapautrārthamātmanaḥ śubhamicchatā .. 17 ..
meaning:
तस्मान्नरेण दातव्या महिषी विभवे सति ..
पुत्रपौत्रप्रपौत्रार्थमात्मनः शुभमिच्छता .. 17 ..
text_mt: Therefore, when wealth is available, a female buffalo should be given by a man / who desires good fortune for himself and for his sons, grandsons, and great-grandsons.

sanskrit_iast:
daśadhenusamāṃ rājanmahiṣīṃ nārado'bravīt ..
viṃśatigosamāṃ vyāsaḥ sarvadānottamaṃ raviḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
दशधेनुसमां राजन्महिषीं नारदोऽब्रवीत् ..
विंशतिगोसमां व्यासः सर्वदानोत्तमं रविः .. 18 ..
text_mt: Nārada declared a female buffalo to be equal to ten cows, O king; / Vyāsa [declared her] equal to twenty cows; the Sun declared it the highest of all gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
sagareṇa kakutsthena dhuṃdhumāreṇa gādhinā ..
dattāḥ saṃpūjya viprebhyo mahiṣyaḥ sarvakāmadāḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
सगरेण ककुत्स्थेन धुंधुमारेण गाधिना ..
दत्ताः संपूज्य विप्रेभ्यो महिष्यः सर्वकामदाः .. 19 ..
text_mt: By Sagara, by Kakutstha, by Dhundhumāra, by Gādhi, / female buffaloes fulfilling all desires were given to vipras after honouring them.

sanskrit_iast:
mahiṣī dānamāhātmyaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti sadā naraḥ ..
sa sarvapāpanirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate .. 4.162.20 ..
meaning:
महिषी दानमाहात्म्यं यः शृणोति सदा नरः ..
स सर्वपापनिर्मुक्तः शिवलोके महीयते .. 4.162.20 ..
text_mt: Whichever man constantly hears the greatness of the gift of a female buffalo, / freed from all sins, he is glorified in the world of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
dugdhādhikāṃ hi mahiṣīṃ jalameghavarṇāṃ sapuṣṭapaṭṭakavatīṃ jaghanābhirāmām ..
dattvā suvarṇatilakāṃ dvijapuṃgavāya lokadvayaṃ vijayate kimu tatra citram .. 21 ..
avidānavratavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
दुग्धाधिकां हि महिषीं जलमेघवर्णां सपुष्टपट्टकवतीं जघनाभिरामाम् ..
दत्त्वा सुवर्णतिलकां द्विजपुंगवाय लोकद्वयं विजयते किमु तत्र चित्रम् .. 21 ..
अविदानव्रतविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Having given an abundant producer of milk, having the colour of a raincloud, / possessed of robust flanks and pleasing hips, bearing a golden forehead mark, to an eminent twice-born man, / he conquers both worlds; what wonder is there in that?
Description of the procedure for the observance of the gift of a female sheep.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu pārtha paraṃ dānaṃ sarvakilbiṣanāśanam ..
yaddattvā trividhaṃ pāpaṃ sadyo vilayamṛcchati .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
शृणु पार्थ परं दानं सर्वकिल्बिषनाशनम् ..
यद्दत्त्वा त्रिविधं पापं सद्यो विलयमृच्छति .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Listen, O son of Pṛthā, to the supreme gift that destroys all sins, / having given which, threefold sin instantly undergoes destruction.
title: adhyāyaḥ 163

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇaromāṃ sauvarṇīṃ pratyakṣaṃ vā suśobhanām ..
suvarṇatilakopetāṃ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitām .. 2 ..
meaning:
सुवर्णरोमां सौवर्णीं प्रत्यक्षं वा सुशोभनाम् ..
सुवर्णतिलकोपेतां सर्वालंकारभूषिताम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: [A ewe] with golden fleece, made of gold, or an actual, beautiful one, / bearing a golden forehead mark, adorned with all ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
kauśeyaparidhānāṃ ca divyacaṃdanabhūṣitām ..
divyapuṣpopahārāṃ ca sarvadhāturasairyutām ..
saptadhānyasamāyuktāṃ phalapuṣpavatīṃ tathā .. 3 ..
meaning:
कौशेयपरिधानां च दिव्यचंदनभूषिताम् ..
दिव्यपुष्पोपहारां च सर्वधातुरसैर्युताम् ..
सप्तधान्यसमायुक्तां फलपुष्पवतीं तथा .. 3 ..
text_mt: Clothed in silk attire and adorned with divine sandalwood paste, / with divine flowers as offerings and endowed with all metallic minerals and liquids, / accompanied by the seven grains, as well as with fruits and flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
śatena kārayettāṃ ca suvarṇasya prayatnataḥ ..
yathā śaktyātha vā kuryādvittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayeta .. 4 ..
meaning:
शतेन कारयेत्तां च सुवर्णस्य प्रयत्नतः ..
यथा शक्त्याथ वा कुर्याद्वित्तशाठ्यं न कारयेत .. 4 ..
text_mt: One should diligently have her made with a hundred [measures] of gold, / or one should make it according to one's means; one must not practice deceit regarding wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
ayane viṣuve caiva grahaṇe śaśisūryayoḥ ..
duḥsvapnadarśane caiva janmarkṣe pitṛsaṃkṣaye .. 5 ..
meaning:
अयने विषुवे चैव ग्रहणे शशिसूर्ययोः ..
दुःस्वप्नदर्शने चैव जन्मर्क्षे पितृसंक्षये .. 5 ..
text_mt: At a solstice, at an equinox, and at an eclipse of the moon or the sun, / when having a bad dream, at one's birth constellation, or on the death anniversary of an ancestor,

sanskrit_iast:
yadā vā jāyate vittaṃ cittaṃ śraddhāsamanvitam ..
tadaiva dānakālaḥ syādyato'nityaṃ hi jīvitam .. 6 ..
meaning:
यदा वा जायते वित्तं चित्तं श्रद्धासमन्वितम् ..
तदैव दानकालः स्याद्यतोऽनित्यं हि जीवितम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Or whenever wealth is present and the mind is endowed with faith, / right then is the time for giving, since life is indeed impermanent.

sanskrit_iast: dadyāttīrthe gṛhe vāpi yatra vā ramate manaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning: दद्यात्तीर्थे गृहे वापि यत्र वा रमते मनः .. 7 ..
text_mt: One should give it at a sacred place or even at home, or wherever the mind takes delight.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra saṃsthāpya deveśamumayā saha śaṃkaram ..
brahmāṇaṃ saha gāyatryā saśrīkaṃ śrīdharaṃ tathā .. 8 ..
meaning:
तत्र संस्थाप्य देवेशमुमया सह शंकरम् ..
ब्रह्माणं सह गायत्र्या सश्रीकं श्रीधरं तथा .. 8 ..
text_mt: Having established there Śaṅkara, the lord of gods, together with Umā, / Brahmā together with Gāyatrī, and Śrīdhara together with Śrī,

sanskrit_iast:
ratyā saha tathānaṃgaṃ lokapālāngrahānapi ..
saṃpūjya ca vidhānena gaṃdhapuṣpanivedanaiḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
रत्या सह तथानंगं लोकपालान्ग्रहानपि ..
संपूज्य च विधानेन गंधपुष्पनिवेदनैः .. 9 ..
text_mt: And Anaṅga together with Rati, as well as the world protectors and planets, / and having worshipped them according to the rules with offerings of perfumes and flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
tadagre kārayeddhomaṃ tilājyena mahīpate ..
alaṃkṛtya dvijaṃ śāṃtaṃ vāsobhiḥ pratipūjya ca .. 4.163.10 ..
meaning:
तदग्रे कारयेद्धोमं तिलाज्येन महीपते ..
अलंकृत्य द्विजं शांतं वासोभिः प्रतिपूज्य च .. 4.163.10 ..
text_mt: One should perform an oblation in the fire in front of them with sesame seeds and clarified butter, O protector of the earth, / having adorned a peaceful twice-born man and honoured him with garments.

sanskrit_iast:
talliṅgamaṃtrairhomaśca kartavyo jvalite'nale ..
tatastāṃ tilakuṃbhasthāṃ lavaṇāntamupasthitām .. 11 ..
meaning:
तल्लिङ्गमंत्रैर्होमश्च कर्तव्यो ज्वलितेऽनले ..
ततस्तां तिलकुंभस्थां लवणान्तमुपस्थिताम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: And the burnt offering should be made in the kindled fire with the mantras dedicated to her. / Then, worshipping her who is placed on a jar of sesame seeds and has salt alongside,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā vidhānena mantrametamudīrayet ..
romatvaṅmāṃsamajjādyaiḥ sarvopakaraṇaiḥ sadā..
jagataḥ saṃpravṛddhāsi tvāmataḥ prārthaye sthitām .. 12 ..
meaning:
पूजयित्वा विधानेन मन्त्रमेतमुदीरयेत् ..
रोमत्वङ्मांसमज्जाद्यैः सर्वोपकरणैः सदा..
जगतः संप्रवृद्धासि त्वामतः प्रार्थये स्थिताम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: in accordance with the rules, he should utter this mantra: / 'With hair, hide, flesh, marrow, and all [other] materials, you have ever / flourished for the sake of the world; therefore, present here, I pray to you:

sanskrit_iast:
vāṅmanaḥkāyajanitaṃ yatkiñcinmama duṣkṛtam..
tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yātu tava dānātprasevitam .. 13 ..
meaning:
वाङ्मनःकायजनितं यत्किञ्चिन्मम दुष्कृतम्..
तत्सर्वं विलयं यातु तव दानात्प्रसेवितम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Whatever misdeed of mine has been produced by speech, mind, and body, / may all that completely vanish through your gift, when carefully served.'

sanskrit_iast:
evamuccārya tāṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine ..
nābhibhāṣeta taṃ dattvā mukhaṃ ca nāvalokayet .. 14 ..
meaning:
एवमुच्चार्य तां दद्याद्ब्राह्मणाय कुटुम्बिने ..
नाभिभाषेत तं दत्त्वा मुखं च नावलोकयेत् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, he should give her to a Brahmin householder. / Having given her, he should not converse with him, nor should he look upon his face.

sanskrit_iast: duṣṭapratigrahahato vipro bhavati pātakī .. 15 ..
meaning: दुष्टप्रतिग्रहहतो विप्रो भवति पातकी .. 15 ..
text_mt: Struck by an unworthy gift, a Brahmin becomes a sinner.

sanskrit_iast:
no dadyāddakṣiṇāhīnāṃ dātavyā sā vidhānataḥ ..
dakṣiṇāvidhinā hīnā duḥkhaśokāvahā bhavet .. 16 ..
meaning:
नो दद्याद्दक्षिणाहीनां दातव्या सा विधानतः ..
दक्षिणाविधिना हीना दुःखशोकावहा भवेत् .. 16 ..
text_mt: He should not give [her] devoid of a priestly fee; it must be given according to rule. / Void of the rule of a priestly fee, it would bring pain and grief.

sanskrit_iast:
purā dattamidaṃ dānaṃ gauryā śaṃkarakāmyayā ..
tena śaṃbhuḥ patirlabdhaḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
पुरा दत्तमिदं दानं गौर्या शंकरकाम्यया ..
तेन शंभुः पतिर्लब्धः सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः .. 17 ..
text_mt: In ancient times this gift was given by Gaurī, desiring Śaṅkara; / through that, Śambhu was obtained as her husband, bowed to by all the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
indrāṇyā svarṇaromāṇāṃ śataṃ dattaṃ vidhānataḥ ..
sarvadevapatiṃ prāpya patiṃ sādyāpi modate .. 15 ..
meaning:
इन्द्राण्या स्वर्णरोमाणां शतं दत्तं विधानतः ..
सर्वदेवपतिं प्राप्य पतिं साद्यापि मोदते .. 15 ..
text_mt: A hundred golden-fleeced [ewes] were given by Indrāṇī in accordance with the rule; / having attained the lord of all the gods as her husband, she rejoices even today.

sanskrit_iast:
nalena dattametaddhi rājyaṃ kṛtvā divaṃ gataḥ ..
rukmiṇyāhaṃ patirlabdhaḥ saubhāgyamatulaṃ tathā .. 19 ..
meaning:
नलेन दत्तमेतद्धि राज्यं कृत्वा दिवं गतः ..
रुक्मिण्याहं पतिर्लब्धः सौभाग्यमतुलं तथा .. 19 ..
text_mt: Given by Nala, indeed, having ruled a kingdom he went to heaven. / By Rukmiṇī I was obtained as husband, as well as peerless good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
dānasyāsya prabhāveṇa putrā bahubalānvitāḥ ..
aputro labhate putramadhano labhate dhanam..4.163.20..
meaning:
दानस्यास्य प्रभावेण पुत्रा बहुबलान्विताः ..
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रमधनो लभते धनम्..4.163.20..
text_mt: By the power of this gift, sons endowed with great strength [are born]; / a sonless man obtains a son, a poor man obtains wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā dānaṃ śubhāṃ kāṃtiṃ vipulāṃ ca tathā śriyam ..
ya imaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ dānakalpamanuttamam..
ahorātrakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ..21 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वा दानं शुभां कांतिं विपुलां च तथा श्रियम् ..
य इमं शृणुयान्नित्यं दानकल्पमनुत्तमम्..
अहोरात्रकृतात्पापान्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ..21 ..
text_mt: Having given this gift, [one gains] auspicious beauty and abundant fortune. / Whoever constantly hears this unsurpassed procedure of giving / is freed from sin committed day and night; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
meṣī viśeṣakaluṣāpaharātiśastā dāne sadaiva rasadhātuyutā sadhānyā ..
tāmādareṇa kurunandana dehi dattvā yenāstapāpatimiraḥ saviteva bhāsi .. 22 .. ..
bhūmidānavarṇanam
meaning:
मेषी विशेषकलुषापहरातिशस्ता दाने सदैव रसधातुयुता सधान्या ..
तामादरेण कुरुनन्दन देहि दत्त्वा येनास्तपापतिमिरः सवितेव भासि .. 22 .. ..
भूमिदानवर्णनम्
text_mt:
The ewe is highly praised as an exceptional remover of defilement; in giving she is ever accompanied by minerals and fluids, accompanied by grains. / Give her with reverence, O delight of the Kurus, having given which, your darkness of sin having set, you will shine like the sun.
Description of the Gift of Land

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca.. ..
bhūmidānamato vakṣye sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ..
ye prayacchaṃti viprebhyo bhūmidānaṃ sadakṣiṇam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच.. ..
भूमिदानमतो वक्ष्ये सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ..
ये प्रयच्छंति विप्रेभ्यो भूमिदानं सदक्षिणम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / 'Now I shall declare the gift of land, the destroyer of all sins. / Those who bestow the gift of land upon Brahmins accompanied by a sacrificial fee,
title: adhyāyaḥ 164

sanskrit_iast:
śrotriyāya daridrāya agnihotraratāya ca ..
sa sarvakāmatṛptātmā sarvaratnairvibhūṣitaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
श्रोत्रियाय दरिद्राय अग्निहोत्ररताय च ..
स सर्वकामतृप्तात्मा सर्वरत्नैर्विभूषितः .. 2 ..
text_mt: to one learned in the Vedas, poor, and devoted to the fire-sacrifice, / his self fulfilled in all desires, adorned with all jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpavinirmukto dīpyamāno raviryathā ..
bālasūryaprabhābhāsairvāditradhvajaśobhitaiḥ ..3..
meaning:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो दीप्यमानो रविर्यथा ..
बालसूर्यप्रभाभासैर्वादित्रध्वजशोभितैः ..3..
text_mt: completely freed from all sins, blazing like the sun, / on celestial chariots gleaming with the radiance of the morning sun, adorned with musical instruments and banners,

sanskrit_iast: vimānairbhāsvarairdivyairviṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati .. 4 ..
meaning: विमानैर्भास्वरैर्दिव्यैर्विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति .. 4 ..
text_mt: radiant and divine, he goes to the realm of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra divyāṃganābhiśca sevyamāno yathāsukham ..
kāmagaḥ kāmarūpī ca krīḍatyānaṃdamakṣayam .. 5 ..
meaning:
तत्र दिव्यांगनाभिश्च सेव्यमानो यथासुखम् ..
कामगः कामरूपी च क्रीडत्यानंदमक्षयम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: There, waited upon at his pleasure by celestial women, / moving at will and assuming shapes at will, he sports in imperishable bliss.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvaddhārayate lokānbhūraṃkurasamudbhavā ..
tāvadbhūmipradaḥ kāmaṃ viṣṇuloke mahīyate .. 6 ..
meaning:
यावद्धारयते लोकान्भूरंकुरसमुद्भवा ..
तावद्भूमिप्रदः कामं विष्णुलोके महीयते .. 6 ..
text_mt: As long as the earth, origin of sprouts, sustains the worlds, / so long does the giver of land rightly rejoice in the realm of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
nahi bhūmipradānādvai dānamanyadviśiṣyate ..
diśo daśānugṛhṇāti hartā tā daśa haṃti ca .. 7 ..
meaning:
नहि भूमिप्रदानाद्वै दानमन्यद्विशिष्यते ..
दिशो दशानुगृह्णाति हर्ता ता दश हंति च .. 7 ..
text_mt: Indeed, no other gift is superior to the gift of land. / [The giver] favors ten directions, and the usurper destroys those ten.

sanskrit_iast:
dānānyanyāni kṣīyaṃte kālena puruṣarṣabha ..
bhūmipradānapuṇyasya kṣayo naivopapadyate .. 8 ..
meaning:
दानान्यन्यानि क्षीयंते कालेन पुरुषर्षभ ..
भूमिप्रदानपुण्यस्य क्षयो नैवोपपद्यते .. 8 ..
text_mt: Other gifts diminish in time, O bull among men; / no diminution ever befalls the merit of giving land.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpāni kṣīyaṃte kālayogakrameṇa tu ..
bhūmihartuśca rājeṃdra duḥkhasyāṃto na vidyate .. 9 ..
meaning:
सर्वपापानि क्षीयंते कालयोगक्रमेण तु ..
भूमिहर्तुश्च राजेंद्र दुःखस्यांतो न विद्यते .. 9 ..
text_mt: All sins dwindle away in the course of time's conjunction, / but for the thief of land, O king of kings, there is no end to suffering.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāya suśīlāya bhūmiṃ dattvā tu yo naraḥ ..
na hi tāmupajīvedyaḥ sa mahatpuṇyamāpnuyāt .. 4.164.10 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाय सुशीलाय भूमिं दत्त्वा तु यो नरः ..
न हि तामुपजीवेद्यः स महत्पुण्यमाप्नुयात् .. 4.164.10 ..
text_mt: The man who, having given land to a virtuous Brahmin, / does not live off it, attains great merit.

sanskrit_iast:
halakṛṣṭāṃ mahīṃ kṛtvā sabījāṃ sasyamālinīm..
yāvatsūryakṛtā lokastāvatsvarge mahīyate .. 11 ..
meaning:
हलकृष्टां महीं कृत्वा सबीजां सस्यमालिनीम्..
यावत्सूर्यकृता लोकस्तावत्स्वर्गे महीयते .. 11 ..
text_mt: Having made the earth furrowed by the plough, provided with seeds, and garlanded with crops, / as long as the worlds are illuminated by the sun, so long is he glorified in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca ratnānyābharaṇāni ca ..
sarvadānāni rājeṃdra dadāti vasudhāṃ dadat .. 12 ..
meaning:
धनं धान्यं हिरण्यं च रत्नान्याभरणानि च ..
सर्वदानानि राजेंद्र ददाति वसुधां ददत् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Wealth, grain, gold, gems, and ornaments— / all gifts he gives, O king of kings, when giving the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
sāgarānsaritaḥ śailānsamāni viṣamāṇi ca ..
sarvagaṃdharasānsnehāndadāti vasudhāṃ dadat .. 13 ..
meaning:
सागरान्सरितः शैलान्समानि विषमाणि च ..
सर्वगंधरसान्स्नेहान्ददाति वसुधां ददत् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Oceans, rivers, mountains, level lands and rough, / all scents, tastes, and saps he gives when giving the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
oṣadhīḥ kṣīrasaṃpannā nānāpuṣpaphalopagāḥ ..
kamalotpalakhaṃḍāṃśca dadāti vasudhāṃ dadat .. 14 ..
meaning:
ओषधीः क्षीरसंपन्ना नानापुष्पफलोपगाः ..
कमलोत्पलखंडांश्च ददाति वसुधां ददत् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Medicinal herbs full of sap, laden with diverse flowers and fruits, / and beds of lotuses and water lilies he gives when giving the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
agniṣṭomādibhiryajñairye yajaṃti sadakṣiṇaiḥ ..
prāpnuvaṃti ca tatpuṇyaṃ bhūmidānādyadāpyate .. 15 ..
meaning:
अग्निष्टोमादिभिर्यज्ञैर्ये यजंति सदक्षिणैः ..
प्राप्नुवंति च तत्पुण्यं भूमिदानाद्यदाप्यते .. 15 ..
text_mt: The merit that those who sacrifice with the Agniṣṭoma and other rites along with priestly fees obtain, / that same merit is attained from the gift of land.

sanskrit_iast:
śrotriyāya mahīṃ dattvā ye haraṃti na mānavāḥ ..
tāvatteṣāṃ bhavetsvargo yāvallokā pratiṣṭhitāḥ .. 16..
meaning:
श्रोत्रियाय महीं दत्त्वा ये हरंति न मानवाः ..
तावत्तेषां भवेत्स्वर्गो यावल्लोका प्रतिष्ठिताः .. 16..
text_mt: Those men who, having given land to a Vedic scholar, do not seize it back, / heaven shall be theirs as long as the worlds remain established.

sanskrit_iast:
sasyapūrṇāṃ mahīṃ yastu śrotriyāya prayacchati ..
pitarastasya tuṣyaṃti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 17 ..
meaning:
सस्यपूर्णां महीं यस्तु श्रोत्रियाय प्रयच्छति ..
पितरस्तस्य तुष्यंति यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: He who bestows land full of crops upon a Vedic scholar, / his ancestors are gratified until the universal dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
yatkiṃcitkurute pāpaṃ puruṣo vṛttikarśitaḥ ..
api gocarmamātreṇa bhūmidānena śudhyati .. 18 ..
meaning:
यत्किंचित्कुरुते पापं पुरुषो वृत्तिकर्शितः ..
अपि गोचर्ममात्रेण भूमिदानेन शुध्यति .. 18 ..
text_mt: Whatever sin a man commits when reduced by [lack of] livelihood, / he is purified even by a gift of land measuring only a cow's hide.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇānāṃ sahasreṇa yatpuṇyaṃ samudāhṛtam..
bhūmi gocarmamātreṇa tatphalaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
सुवर्णानां सहस्रेण यत्पुण्यं समुदाहृतम्..
भूमि गोचर्ममात्रेण तत्फलं प्राप्नुयान्नरः .. 19 ..
text_mt: The merit that is declared to come from a thousand gold pieces, / that fruit a man obtains from land measuring only a cow's hide.

sanskrit_iast:
kapilānāṃ sahasrebhyo yaddatte'nnaṃ narottama ..
bhūmigocarmamātreṇa tatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ .. 4.164.20 ..
meaning:
कपिलानां सहस्रेभ्यो यद्दत्तेऽन्नं नरोत्तम ..
भूमिगोचर्ममात्रेण तत्फलं लभते नरः .. 4.164.20 ..
text_mt: Whatever food is given to thousands of brown cows, O best of men, / that fruit a man attains from land measuring only a cow's hide.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyamasya manuṣyasya vyāsena parisaṃkhyayā..
triṃśaddaṃḍāṃśca gocarma dattvā svarge mahīyate .. 21 ..
meaning:
मध्यमस्य मनुष्यस्य व्यासेन परिसंख्यया..
त्रिंशद्दंडांश्च गोचर्म दत्त्वा स्वर्गे महीयते .. 21 ..
text_mt: According to the calculation of Vyāsa for an average man, / having given a cow's hide measuring thirty rods, he is glorified in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
bahubhirvasudhā bhuktā rājabhiḥ sagarādibhiḥ ..
yasya yasya yadā bhūmistasyatasya tadā phalam .. 22 ..
meaning:
बहुभिर्वसुधा भुक्ता राजभिः सगरादिभिः ..
यस्य यस्य यदा भूमिस्तस्यतस्य तदा फलम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: The earth has been enjoyed by many kings, beginning with Sagara; / whoever possesses the land at any time, his is the fruit then.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃkarā mṛtyudaṃḍāśca asipatravanādayaḥ ..
ghorāśca vāruṇāḥ pāśā nopasarpaṃti bhūmidam.. 23 ..
meaning:
किंकरा मृत्युदंडाश्च असिपत्रवनादयः ..
घोराश्च वारुणाः पाशा नोपसर्पंति भूमिदम्.. 23 ..
text_mt: The servants [of Yama], the rods of death, the forest of sword-like leaves and the like, / and the terrible snares of Varuṇa do not approach the giver of land.

sanskrit_iast:
nirayā rauravādyāśca kuṃbhīpākaḥ suduḥsahaḥ ..
tathā ca yātanāḥ kaṣṭā nopasarpaṃti bhūmidam .. 24 ..
meaning:
निरया रौरवाद्याश्च कुंभीपाकः सुदुःसहः ..
तथा च यातनाः कष्टा नोपसर्पंति भूमिदम् .. 24 ..
text_mt: The hells, Raurava and others, the unbearable Kumbhīpāka, / and dreadful torments do not approach the giver of land.

sanskrit_iast:
citraguptaśca kālaśca kṛtāṃto mṛtyureva ca ..
yamaścāpi svayaṃ rājā saṃpūjayati bhūmidam .. 25 ..
meaning:
चित्रगुप्तश्च कालश्च कृतांतो मृत्युरेव च ..
यमश्चापि स्वयं राजा संपूजयति भूमिदम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Citragupta, Time, the End-Maker, and Death himself, / and King Yama himself honours the giver of land.

sanskrit_iast:
rudraḥ prajāpatiḥ śakro devāsuragaṇāstathā ..
ahaṃ ca paramaprītyā pūjayāmīha bhūmidam.. 26 ..
meaning:
रुद्रः प्रजापतिः शक्रो देवासुरगणास्तथा ..
अहं च परमप्रीत्या पूजयामीह भूमिदम्.. 26 ..
text_mt: Rudra, Prajāpati, Śakra, the hosts of gods and demons, / and I too, honour the giver of land here with supreme love.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭkarmakṛtsuvṛttāya kṛśāya ca priyārthine ..
bhūmirdeyā naravyāghra sannidhiścākṣayo bhavet .. 27 ..
meaning:
षट्कर्मकृत्सुवृत्ताय कृशाय च प्रियार्थिने ..
भूमिर्देया नरव्याघ्र सन्निधिश्चाक्षयो भवेत् .. 27 ..
text_mt: To one who performs the six rites, of good conduct, emaciated, and desiring his welfare, / land should be given, O tiger among men, and an inexhaustible store shall be his.

sanskrit_iast:
sīdamānakuṭuṃbāya śrotriyāyāhitāgnaye ..
vṛttasthāya daridrāya bhūmirdeyā nareśvara .. 28 ..
meaning:
सीदमानकुटुंबाय श्रोत्रियायाहिताग्नये ..
वृत्तस्थाय दरिद्राय भूमिर्देया नरेश्वर .. 28 ..
text_mt: To one whose family is in distress, a Vedic scholar who maintains the sacred fire, / established in good conduct and poor, land should be given, O lord of men.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā janitrī kṣīreṇa putraṃ saṃvarddhayetsadā ..
tathā bhūmipradaṃ bhūmiḥ sarvakāmaistu tarpati .. 29 ..
meaning:
यथा जनित्री क्षीरेण पुत्रं संवर्द्धयेत्सदा ..
तथा भूमिप्रदं भूमिः सर्वकामैस्तु तर्पति .. 29 ..
text_mt: Just as a mother ever nurtures her son with milk, / so the earth gratifies the giver of land with all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā gaurbharate vatsa kṣīreṇa kṣīramutsṛjet ..
tathā sarvarasopetā bhūmirbharati bhūmidam .. 4.164.30 ..
meaning:
यथा गौर्भरते वत्स क्षीरेण क्षीरमुत्सृजेत् ..
