'O Blessed One, how might the removal of my thirst come about, O supreme lord?
You ought to show favor by imparting instruction.'

sanskrit_iast:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
bhūyo gatvā mahīṃ rājanbrahmāṃḍaṃ sārvakāmikam ..
prayaccha dvijamukhyānāṃ tena tṛptimavāpsyasi .. 38 ..
meaning:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
भूयो गत्वा महीं राजन्ब्रह्मांडं सार्वकामिकम् ..
प्रयच्छ द्विजमुख्यानां तेन तृप्तिमवाप्स्यसि .. 38 ..
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
'Going again to the earth, O king, bestow the Cosmic Egg that grants all desires
upon the foremost of the twice-born; through that you will attain satisfaction.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktaḥ samyagāgatya martyalokaṃ mahīpatiḥ ..
brahmāṃḍaṃ tu vidhānena brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradattavān .. 39 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तः सम्यगागत्य मर्त्यलोकं महीपतिः ..
ब्रह्मांडं तु विधानेन ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रदत्तवान् .. 39 ..
text_mt:
Having been spoken to thus, the ruler of the earth duly came to the mortal world,
and gave the Cosmic Egg to the brāhmaṇas according to the ritual.

sanskrit_iast:
sa jagāma punaḥ svargaṃ lebhe tṛptiṃ ca śāśvatīm..
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ mahādānasya yatphalam .. 4.177.40 ..
meaning:
स जगाम पुनः स्वर्गं लेभे तृप्तिं च शाश्वतीम्..
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं महादानस्य यत्फलम् .. 4.177.40 ..
text_mt:
He went to heaven again and obtained eternal satisfaction.
All this has been related to you: the fruit of this great gift.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṃḍaṃ yaḥ prayaccheta tena dattaṃ carācaram ..
saptāvarānsapta parānsapta caiva parāvarān.. 41 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मांडं यः प्रयच्छेत तेन दत्तं चराचरम् ..
सप्तावरान्सप्त परान्सप्त चैव परावरान्.. 41 ..
text_mt:
Whoever gives the Cosmic Egg, by him all that is moving and unmoving has been given.
Seven descendants, seven ancestors, and seven higher and lower descendants,

sanskrit_iast:
tārayetkulajāndattvā bhaviṣyāṃśca na saṃśayaḥ ..
manvaṃtarāṇi ṣaṭtriśadbrahmaloke mahīyate .. 42 ..
meaning:
तारयेत्कुलजान्दत्त्वा भविष्यांश्च न संशयः ..
मन्वंतराणि षट्त्रिशद्ब्रह्मलोके महीयते .. 42 ..
text_mt:
and future ones born in his family, he redeems by giving it, without a doubt.
For thirty-six manvantaras he is exalted in the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
punarmānuṣyamabhyetya dhārmiko jāyate kule ..
na dāridyaṃ na ca vyādhiṃ viyogaṃ naiva paśyati .. 43 ..
meaning:
पुनर्मानुष्यमभ्येत्य धार्मिको जायते कुले ..
न दारिद्यं न च व्याधिं वियोगं नैव पश्यति .. 43 ..
text_mt:
Entering the human state again, he is born righteous in an [honorable] family;
he sees neither poverty nor disease, nor separation.

sanskrit_iast:
nārī vā puruṣo vāpi dānasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ..
yaścaitacchṛṇuyādbhaktyā bhaktānāṃ śrāvayecca yaḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
नारी वा पुरुषो वापि दानस्यास्य प्रभावतः ..
यश्चैतच्छृणुयाद्भक्त्या भक्तानां श्रावयेच्च यः .. 44 ..
text_mt:
A woman or a man, through the power of this gift,
and whoever hears this with devotion, and whoever causes the devoted to hear it,

sanskrit_iast: so'pi sadgatimāpnoti kiṃ punaryaḥ prayacchati .. 45 ..
meaning: सोऽपि सद्गतिमाप्नोति किं पुनर्यः प्रयच्छति .. 45 ..
text_mt: he too attains a good state, how much more so the one who gives it!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṃḍakhaṃḍayugalaṃ sakulācalaṃ ca digbhāgasāgarasarovarasiddhajuṣṭam ..
diksaṃkhyayā guṇavatāṃ dvijasattamānāṃ dattvā pumānpadamupaiti pitāmahasya .. 46 ..
kalpavṛkṣadānavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
ब्रह्मांडखंडयुगलं सकुलाचलं च दिग्भागसागरसरोवरसिद्धजुष्टम् ..
दिक्संख्यया गुणवतां द्विजसत्तमानां दत्त्वा पुमान्पदमुपैति पितामहस्य .. 46 ..
कल्पवृक्षदानविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Having given the pair of hemispheres of the Cosmic Egg, along with the principal mountains, / frequented by the directions, oceans, lakes, and siddhas, / to the number of the directions of virtuous twice-born men, / a man attains the realm of the Grandfather.
Description of the Rite of Giving the Wish-Granting Tree

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
bhagavāñchaṃkaraḥ pūrvaṃ kṛtodvāho mayā saha ..
ramamāṇastayā sārddhaṃ bahuvarṣagaṇānsthitaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
भगवाञ्छंकरः पूर्वं कृतोद्वाहो मया सह ..
रममाणस्तया सार्द्धं बहुवर्षगणान्स्थितः .. 1 ..
title: adhyāyaḥ 178

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve paraṃ trāsamupāgatāḥ ..
tayorapatyasya bhayāttameva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
ततः सुरगणाः सर्वे परं त्रासमुपागताः ..
तयोरपत्यस्य भयात्तमेव शरणं गताः .. 2 ..
text_mt:
Then all the hosts of gods were seized with great dread;
out of fear of their offspring, they sought refuge in him alone—

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśvānaramukhā devā mahādevaṃ trilocanam ..
prasannaścābhavatteṣāṃ vibudhānāṃ trilocanaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
वैश्वानरमुखा देवा महादेवं त्रिलोचनम् ..
प्रसन्नश्चाभवत्तेषां विबुधानां त्रिलोचनः .. 3 ..
text_mt:
the gods headed by Agni, [sought refuge in] Mahādeva, the three-eyed one;
and the three-eyed one was pleased with those deities.

sanskrit_iast:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
kiṃ bhītāstridaśāḥ sarve kaṃ varaṃ ca dadāmi vaḥ ..
mayi prasanne vibudhā durlabhaṃ hi na kiṃcana .. 4 ..
meaning:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
किं भीतास्त्रिदशाः सर्वे कं वरं च ददामि वः ..
मयि प्रसन्ने विबुधा दुर्लभं हि न किंचन .. 4 ..
text_mt:
The Lord said:
'Why are all the gods frightened, and what boon shall I grant you?
When I am pleased, O gods, nothing indeed is difficult to attain.'

sanskrit_iast:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
bhagavaṃstava saṃyogātpārvatyā saha śaṃkara ..
mogho bhavatu deveśa bhītāḥ sma tanayasya te ..5 ..
meaning:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
भगवंस्तव संयोगात्पार्वत्या सह शंकर ..
मोघो भवतु देवेश भीताः स्म तनयस्य ते ..5 ..
text_mt:
The gods said:
'O Blessed One, may your union with Pārvatī
be fruitless, O Śaṅkara, O lord of the gods! We are terrified of your son.

sanskrit_iast:
anapatyaśca deveśa bhava bhūtapate sadā ..
aśaktāḥ sma vayaṃ sarve bhavadojo vidhāraṇe .. 6 ..
meaning:
अनपत्यश्च देवेश भव भूतपते सदा ..
अशक्ताः स्म वयं सर्वे भवदोजो विधारणे .. 6 ..
text_mt:
And remain childless forever, O lord of the gods, O lord of beings!
We are all powerless to bear your splendor.'

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
ataḥ prabhṛtyahaṃ devā ūrdhvaretā vyavasthitaḥ ..
sthāṇuvacca sthitaścāsmi nāma caitadbhaviṣyati .. 7 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
अतः प्रभृत्यहं देवा ऊर्ध्वरेता व्यवस्थितः ..
स्थाणुवच्च स्थितश्चास्मि नाम चैतद्भविष्यति .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kruddhā umā teṣāṃ devānāṃ vākyamabravīt ..
vitathaṃ putrajaṃ saukhyaṃ bhavadbhirme kṛtaṃ surāḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
ततः क्रुद्धा उमा तेषां देवानां वाक्यमब्रवीत् ..
वितथं पुत्रजं सौख्यं भवद्भिर्मे कृतं सुराः .. 8 ..
text_mt:
Then Umā, angered, spoke a word to those gods:
'The happiness born of a son has been rendered futile for me by you, O gods!

sanskrit_iast:
yasmāttasmādbhavaṃto'pi na putrāñjanayiṣyatha ..
tataḥ prabhṛti vai devāḥ prasūyaṃte na bhūpate .. 9 ..
meaning:
यस्मात्तस्माद्भवंतोऽपि न पुत्राञ्जनयिष्यथ ..
ततः प्रभृति वै देवाः प्रसूयंते न भूपते .. 9 ..
text_mt:
Therefore, you also will not beget sons.'
From then on, O ruler of the earth, the gods indeed do not procreate.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā śāpaṃ tato devī devānāmāha śaṃkaram ..
putrajanma mayā prāptaṃ na tāvajjagataḥ pate .. 4.178.10 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वा शापं ततो देवी देवानामाह शंकरम् ..
पुत्रजन्म मया प्राप्तं न तावज्जगतः पते .. 4.178.10 ..
text_mt:
Having then pronounced the curse on the gods, the goddess said to Śaṅkara:
'The birth of a son has not been attained by me, O lord of the world!'

sanskrit_iast:
aputrasya gatirnāsti itīyaṃ śrūyate śrutiḥ ..
tadādiśa mahābhāga lokadvayahitaṃ prabho .. 11 ..
meaning:
अपुत्रस्य गतिर्नास्ति इतीयं श्रूयते श्रुतिः ..
तदादिश महाभाग लोकद्वयहितं प्रभो .. 11 ..
text_mt:
"There is no destination for the sonless"—so runs this Vedic text.
Therefore instruct me, fortunate one, in what benefits both worlds, O Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
.. bhagavānuvāca .. ..
aputraḥ puruṣo yaśca nārī vā parvatātmaje ..
sauvarṇastena dātavyaḥ kalpavṛkṣo guṇānvitaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
.. भगवानुवाच .. ..
अपुत्रः पुरुषो यश्च नारी वा पर्वतात्मजे ..
सौवर्णस्तेन दातव्यः कल्पवृक्षो गुणान्वितः .. 12 ..
text_mt:
The Blessed Lord said:
A sonless man, or a woman, O daughter of the mountain,
should give a golden wishing-tree endowed with [all] qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtrimaṃ vāpi gṛhṇīyādvṛkṣaṃ vā sthāvarādikam ..
jātaputro'tha vā putraḥ putratve parikalpayet..13..
meaning:
कृत्रिमं वापि गृह्णीयाद्वृक्षं वा स्थावरादिकम् ..
जातपुत्रोऽथ वा पुत्रः पुत्रत्वे परिकल्पयेत्..13..
text_mt:
Or one may take an artificial [image] or an actual tree, immovable and so forth,
and whether one has sons or not, adopt it as a son.

sanskrit_iast:
tena putravatāṃ lokā devi tasya na saṃśayaḥ ..
kalpavṛkṣastu kartavyaḥ śuddhakāṃcanasaṃbhavaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
तेन पुत्रवतां लोका देवि तस्य न संशयः ..
कल्पवृक्षस्तु कर्तव्यः शुद्धकांचनसंभवः .. 14 ..
text_mt:
Through that, O goddess, the worlds of those possessing sons are attained by him, without doubt.
The wishing-tree, however, should be fashioned out of pure gold,

sanskrit_iast:
bahuśākhaḥ suvarṇāṃgopyanekakusumānvitaḥ ..
mahāskaṃdhasvarūpaśca ratnālaṃkṛtavigrahaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
बहुशाखः सुवर्णांगोप्यनेककुसुमान्वितः ..
महास्कंधस्वरूपश्च रत्नालंकृतविग्रहः .. 15 ..
text_mt:
having many branches, its body of gold, endowed with numerous blossoms,
having the form of a great trunk, its frame adorned with jewels.

sanskrit_iast:
phalāni tasya divyāni sauvarṇāni prakalpayet ..
kuryāviṃśatpalādūrddhvaṃ śaktyā vā nṛpasattama .. 16 ..
meaning:
फलानि तस्य दिव्यानि सौवर्णानि प्रकल्पयेत् ..
कुर्याविंशत्पलादूर्द्ध्वं शक्त्या वा नृपसत्तम .. 16 ..
text_mt:
One should fashion divine fruits for it out of gold.
One should make it of twenty palas or more, or according to one's capacity, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
dānametatpradātavyaṃ rājataṃ caivamuttamam ..
pravālāṃkurasaṃchannaṃ muktādāmāvalaṃbitam .. 17 ..
meaning:
दानमेतत्प्रदातव्यं राजतं चैवमुत्तमम् ..
प्रवालांकुरसंछन्नं मुक्तादामावलंबितम् .. 17 ..
text_mt:
This excellent gift should also be provided with silver,
covered with sprouts of coral, and hanging with strings of pearls.

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣkoṇeṣu kurvīta caturaḥ kāṃcanadrumān ..
suvarṇasya pramāṇaṃ ca kathayāmi varānane .. 18 ..
meaning:
चतुष्कोणेषु कुर्वीत चतुरः कांचनद्रुमान् ..
सुवर्णस्य प्रमाणं च कथयामि वरानने .. 18 ..
text_mt:
At the four corners one should place four golden trees.
And I shall tell the weight of the gold, O fair-faced lady:

sanskrit_iast:
sahasreṇa tadarddhena tasyāpyarddhena vā punaḥ ..
nadyāstīre gṛhe vāpi devatāyatane tathā..19..
meaning:
सहस्रेण तदर्द्धेन तस्याप्यर्द्धेन वा पुनः ..
नद्यास्तीरे गृहे वापि देवतायतने तथा..19..
text_mt:
by a thousand [palas], or half of that, or again half of that.
On the bank of a river, or in a house, or in a temple of the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
prāgudakpravaṇe deśe maṃḍapaṃ tatra kārayet ..
daśahastapramāṇena daśahastāśca vedikāḥ .. 4.178.20 ..
meaning:
प्रागुदक्प्रवणे देशे मंडपं तत्र कारयेत् ..
दशहस्तप्रमाणेन दशहस्ताश्च वेदिकाः .. 4.178.20 ..
text_mt:
in a place sloping towards the north-east, one should erect a pavilion there,
measuring ten cubits, and platforms of ten cubits.

sanskrit_iast:
hastamātrapramāṇena kuṃḍamekaṃ suśobhanam ..
āgneyyāṃ kārayedrājanmekhalāmupalepanam .. 21 ..
meaning:
हस्तमात्रप्रमाणेन कुंडमेकं सुशोभनम् ..
आग्नेय्यां कारयेद्राजन्मेखलामुपलेपनम् .. 21 ..
text_mt:
Measuring just a single cubit, one very beautiful sacrificial pit
one should have made in the south-east, O king, with rims and smeared [with cowdung].

sanskrit_iast:
tatra vai brāhmaṇā yojyā ṛgyajuḥsāmapāṭhakāḥ ..
upadeṣṭā ca tatraiva tṛtīyaḥ paṃcamo'tha vā .. .. 22 ..
meaning:
तत्र वै ब्राह्मणा योज्या ऋग्यजुःसामपाठकाः ..
उपदेष्टा च तत्रैव तृतीयः पंचमोऽथ वा .. .. 22 ..
text_mt:
There, indeed, Brahmins who recite the Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma Vedas must be employed,
and an instructor right there as the third, or as the fifth.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvābharaṇasaṃpannāstāmrapatradvayānvitāḥ ..
anuliptāścaṃdanena vastramālyādibhūṣitāḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
सर्वाभरणसंपन्नास्ताम्रपत्रद्वयान्विताः ..
अनुलिप्ताश्चंदनेन वस्त्रमाल्यादिभूषिताः .. 23 ..
text_mt:
Endowed with all ornaments, provided with two copper vessels,
anointed with sandalwood paste, adorned with garments, garlands, and so forth,

sanskrit_iast:
guḍaprasthopariṣṭācca sthāpayetkalpapādapam ..
brahmaviṣṇuśivopetaṃ paṃcaśākhaṃ sabhāskaram .. 24 ..
meaning:
गुडप्रस्थोपरिष्टाच्च स्थापयेत्कल्पपादपम् ..
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवोपेतं पंचशाखं सभास्करम् .. 24 ..
text_mt:
upon a prastha of molasses one should set the wishing-tree,
endowed with Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva, having five branches, accompanied by the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmadevamadhastācca sakalatra prayojayet ..
saṃtānaṃ saha gāyatryā pūrvato lavaṇopari .. 25 ..
meaning:
कामदेवमधस्ताच्च सकलत्र प्रयोजयेत् ..
संतानं सह गायत्र्या पूर्वतो लवणोपरि .. 25 ..
text_mt:
And underneath one should place Kāmadeva together with his wife;
the Saṃtāna tree together with Gāyatrī to the east, upon salt;

sanskrit_iast:
maṃdāraṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve śriyā saha tathā ghṛte ..
paścime pārijātaṃ tu umayā saha pādapam .. 26 ..
meaning:
मंदारं दक्षिणे पार्श्वे श्रिया सह तथा घृते ..
पश्चिमे पारिजातं तु उमया सह पादपम् .. 26 ..
text_mt:
the Mandāra on the southern side together with Śrī, likewise upon ghee;
to the west the Pārijāta tree together with Umā;

sanskrit_iast:
surabhīsaṃyutaṃ tadvattileṣu haricaṃdanam ..
kauśeyavastrasaṃyuktānikṣumālyaphalānvitān.. 27 ..
meaning:
सुरभीसंयुतं तद्वत्तिलेषु हरिचंदनम् ..
कौशेयवस्त्रसंयुक्तानिक्षुमाल्यफलान्वितान्.. 27 ..
text_mt:
likewise the Haricandana joined with Surabhi upon sesame seeds;
clothed in silk garments, provided with sugarcane, garlands, and fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
tathāṣṭau pūrṇakalaśānsamaṃtātparikalpayet ..
agnipraṇayanaṃ kṛtvā adhivāsya ca pādapān .. 28 ..
meaning:
तथाष्टौ पूर्णकलशान्समंतात्परिकल्पयेत् ..
अग्निप्रणयनं कृत्वा अधिवास्य च पादपान् .. 28 ..
text_mt:
Likewise, one should arrange eight full water-pots on all sides.
Having brought forward the fire, and having consecrated the trees,

sanskrit_iast:
dhānyāni caiva sarvāṇi samaṃtātparikalpayet ..
nānā bhakṣyāṇi naivedyaṃ sarvaṃ tatra niyojayet .. 29 ..
meaning:
धान्यानि चैव सर्वाणि समंतात्परिकल्पयेत् ..
नाना भक्ष्याणि नैवेद्यं सर्वं तत्र नियोजयेत् .. 29 ..
text_mt:
one should also arrange all grains completely around.
Various eatables and food offerings—one should present all that there.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpamālā vicitrāśca jvālayeta samaṃtataḥ ..
maṃtreṇa yojayitvā tā mayoktena varānane .. 4.178.30 ..
meaning:
दीपमाला विचित्राश्च ज्वालयेत समंततः ..
मंत्रेण योजयित्वा ता मयोक्तेन वरानने .. 4.178.30 ..
text_mt:
And one should kindle variegated rows of lamps on every side.
Having joined them with the mantra spoken by me, O fair-faced lady:

sanskrit_iast:
kāmadastvaṃ hi devānāṃ kāmavṛkṣastataḥ smṛtaḥ ..
mayā saṃpūjito bhaktyā pūrayasva manorathān .. .. 31 ..
meaning:
कामदस्त्वं हि देवानां कामवृक्षस्ततः स्मृतः ..
मया संपूजितो भक्त्या पूरयस्व मनोरथान् .. .. 31 ..
text_mt:
"You grant the wishes of the gods; therefore you are remembered as the wishing-tree.
Worshipped by me with devotion, fulfill my desires!"

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhinā jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet ..
śaṃkhavāditranirghoṣairvedadhvanivimiśritaiḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
एवं संपूज्य विधिना जागरं तत्र कारयेत् ..
शंखवादित्रनिर्घोषैर्वेदध्वनिविमिश्रितैः .. 32 ..
text_mt:
Having worshipped thus according to the rules, one should hold a night-vigil there,
with the sounds of conches and musical instruments mingled with Vedic chants.

sanskrit_iast:
homaṃ ca brāhmaṇāḥ kuryurmadgatenāṃtarātmanā ..
āghārāvājyabhāgau tu pūrvaṃ hutvā vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
होमं च ब्राह्मणाः कुर्युर्मद्गतेनांतरात्मना ..
आघारावाज्यभागौ तु पूर्वं हुत्वा विचक्षणः .. 33 ..
text_mt:
And the Brahmins should perform the fire sacrifice, their inner self fixed on me.
The wise one, having first offered the two libations and the two portions of clarified butter,

sanskrit_iast:
talliṃgaiḥ sthāpitāndevānhomenāpyāyayettataḥ ..
mahāvyāhṛtibhiścaiva homaṃ kuryustataḥ param .. .. 34 ..
meaning:
तल्लिंगैः स्थापितान्देवान्होमेनाप्याययेत्ततः ..
महाव्याहृतिभिश्चैव होमं कुर्युस्ततः परम् .. .. 34 ..
text_mt:
should then gratify the installed gods with the fire sacrifice using their characteristic mantras.
After that, they should perform the fire sacrifice with the great sacred utterances.

sanskrit_iast:
ayutena bhavetsiddhiryajñasya varavarṇini ..
tataḥ prabhāte cotthāya snātvā śuklāṃbaraḥ śuciḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
अयुतेन भवेत्सिद्धिर्यज्ञस्य वरवर्णिनि ..
ततः प्रभाते चोत्थाय स्नात्वा शुक्लांबरः शुचिः .. 35 ..
text_mt:
With ten thousand [oblations], perfection of the sacrifice is attained, O fair-complexioned lady.
Then, rising at dawn, having bathed, wearing white garments, pure,

sanskrit_iast:
dadyātparvasamīpe tu kalpavṛkṣaṃ sada kṣiṇam ..
triḥpradakṣiṇamāvṛtya maṃtrametamudīrayet .. 36 ..
meaning:
दद्यात्पर्वसमीपे तु कल्पवृक्षं सद क्षिणम् ..
त्रिःप्रदक्षिणमावृत्य मंत्रमेतमुदीरयेत् .. 36 ..
text_mt:
near the festival time one should give the wishing-tree together with a sacrificial fee.
Circumambulating three times clockwise, one should recite this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
namaste kalpavṛkṣāya vitatārthapradāya ca ..
viśvaṃbharāya devāya namaste viśvamūrtaye .. .. 37 ..
meaning:
नमस्ते कल्पवृक्षाय विततार्थप्रदाय च ..
विश्वंभराय देवाय नमस्ते विश्वमूर्तये .. .. 37 ..
text_mt:
"Homage to you, the wishing-tree, the giver of boundless desires,
the god who sustains all, homage to you whose form is the universe!

sanskrit_iast:
yasmāttvameva viśvātmā brahmasthāṇudivākarāḥ ..
mūrtāmūrtaparaṃ bījamataḥ pāhi sanātana ..38..
meaning:
यस्मात्त्वमेव विश्वात्मा ब्रह्मस्थाणुदिवाकराः ..
मूर्तामूर्तपरं बीजमतः पाहि सनातन ..38..
text_mt:
Because you yourself are the universal Self, Brahmā, Sthāṇu, and the Sun,
the highest seed of the manifest and the unmanifest—therefore protect me, O eternal one!"

sanskrit_iast:
evamāmantrya taṃ dṛṣṭvā gurave kalpapādapam ..
caturbhyaścāpi ṛtvigbhyaḥ sāmaṃtādīnprakalpayet .. 39 ..
meaning:
एवमामन्त्र्य तं दृष्ट्वा गुरवे कल्पपादपम् ..
चतुर्भ्यश्चापि ऋत्विग्भ्यः सामंतादीन्प्रकल्पयेत् .. 39 ..
text_mt:
Having addressed it thus and beheld the wishing-tree, [he gives it] to the guru,
and should assign the surrounding [trees] to the four priests.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā yastu dānametatprayacchati ..
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ devi śṛṇuṣva gadato mama.. .. 4.178.40 ..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु दानमेतत्प्रयच्छति ..
तस्य पुण्यफलं देवि शृणुष्व गदतो मम.. .. 4.178.40 ..
text_mt:
He who bestows this gift according to this rule—
hear from me as I proclaim the fruit of his merit, O goddess:

sanskrit_iast:
vimānavaramāruhya sūryatejaḥsamaprabham ..
apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ kiṃkiṇījālamālitam .. 41 ..
meaning:
विमानवरमारुह्य सूर्यतेजःसमप्रभम् ..
अप्सरोगणसंकीर्णं किंकिणीजालमालितम् .. 41 ..
text_mt:
Mounting an excellent celestial chariot shining like the radiance of the sun,
crowded with hosts of apsarases, garlanded with nets of tinkling bells,

sanskrit_iast:
yāti lokaṃ sureśasya sarvabādhāvivarji tam..
punaḥ karmakṣitāvetya jāyate śrotriye kule .. 42 ..
meaning:
याति लोकं सुरेशस्य सर्वबाधाविवर्जि तम्..
पुनः कर्मक्षितावेत्य जायते श्रोत्रिये कुले .. 42 ..
text_mt:
he goes to the world of the lord of gods, free from all afflictions.
Returning again to the earth of action, he is born in a family learned in the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
yajvā śūro'pi vidvāṃśca naro bhavati dhārmikaḥ ..
punaraṃte prāpnuyādvai lokaṃ devasya śārṅgiṇaḥ .. 43 .. ..
meaning:
यज्वा शूरोऽपि विद्वांश्च नरो भवति धार्मिकः ..
पुनरंते प्राप्नुयाद्वै लोकं देवस्य शार्ङ्गिणः .. 43 .. ..
text_mt:
A sacrificer, a hero, and a learned man, he becomes a righteous person.
At the end, he surely attains the world of the god who bears the Śārṅga bow.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde kalpavṛkṣadānavidhivarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭasaptatyuttaraśatata mo'dhyāyaḥ ... 178 ..
kalpalatādānavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराण उत्तरपर्वणि श्रीकृष्णयुधिष्ठिरसंवादे कल्पवृक्षदानविधिवर्णनं नामाष्टसप्तत्युत्तरशतत मोऽध्यायः ... 178 ..
कल्पलतादानविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus, in the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa, in the Uttaraparvan, in the dialogue between Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Yudhiṣṭhira, the one hundred and seventy-eighth chapter, named "Description of the Rite of Giving the Wishing-Tree."
Description of the Rite of Giving the Wishing-Creeper

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
bhagavansarvabhūteśa sarvalokanamaskṛta ..
anugrahāya lokānāṃ kathayasva mamāparam .. 1 ...
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
भगवन्सर्वभूतेश सर्वलोकनमस्कृत ..
अनुग्रहाय लोकानां कथयस्व ममापरम् .. 1 ...
title: Kalpalatādānavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
niṣpāpo jāyate yena āyuṣā yaśasā śriyā ..
tanme kathaya deveśa dānaṃ vratamathāpi vā .. 2 ..
meaning:
निष्पापो जायते येन आयुषा यशसा श्रिया ..
तन्मे कथय देवेश दानं व्रतमथापि वा .. 2 ..
text_mt:
by which one becomes free from sin, endowed with longevity, fame, and fortune;
tell me that, O Lord of gods, whether a gift or a votive observance.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi tava lokahitepsayā ..
yenopāyena jāyaṃte sabhāgyā mānavā bhuvi .. 3 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
शृणु राजन्प्रवक्ष्यामि तव लोकहितेप्सया ..
येनोपायेन जायंते सभाग्या मानवा भुवि .. 3 ..
text_mt:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Listen, O king, I shall tell you out of a desire for the welfare of the world,
by which means mortals become fortunate on earth.

sanskrit_iast:
na vratairnopavāsaiśca na tīrthagamanairapi ..
mahāpathādimaraṇairna yajñairna śrutena ca .. 4 ..
meaning:
न व्रतैर्नोपवासैश्च न तीर्थगमनैरपि ..
महापथादिमरणैर्न यज्ञैर्न श्रुतेन च .. 4 ..
text_mt:
Not by votive observances, nor by fasts, nor even by visits to sacred sites,
not by dying on the great journey and the like, not by sacrifices, nor by sacred learning,

sanskrit_iast:
prāpyate mama loko'yaṃ duṣprāpyastridaśairapi ..
pārtha snehānmahābhāga pravakṣyāmi hitaṃ tava .. 5 ..
meaning:
प्राप्यते मम लोकोऽयं दुष्प्राप्यस्त्रिदशैरपि ..
पार्थ स्नेहान्महाभाग प्रवक्ष्यामि हितं तव .. 5 ..
text_mt:
is this world of mine attained, which is hard to reach even by the thirty [gods].
O son of Pṛthā, out of affection, fortunate one, I shall tell what is beneficial for you.

sanskrit_iast:
vakṣye kalpalatādānaṃ śobhanaṃ vidhipūrvakam ..
sarvaṃ pūrvavidhānaṃ ca tatra tantre prakalpayet .. 6 ..
meaning:
वक्ष्ये कल्पलतादानं शोभनं विधिपूर्वकम् ..
सर्वं पूर्वविधानं च तत्र तन्त्रे प्रकल्पयेत् .. 6 ..
text_mt:
I shall describe the auspicious gift of the wishing-creeper according to the rules.
And all the previous procedure one should arrange in that rite.

sanskrit_iast:
dikpālebhyo baliṃ tatra kṣipedvai vidhipūrvakam ..
āghārāvājyabhāgau tu pūrvaṃ hutvā vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
दिक्पालेभ्यो बलिं तत्र क्षिपेद्वै विधिपूर्वकम् ..
आघारावाज्यभागौ तु पूर्वं हुत्वा विचक्षणः .. 7 ..
text_mt:
One should throw the offering to the guardians of the directions there according to rule.
The wise one, having first offered the two libations and the two portions of clarified butter,

sanskrit_iast:
tato grahamakhaṃ kuryāddhomaṃ vyāhṛtibhistataḥ ..
ayutenaiva homasya samāptiriha kathyate .. 8 ..
meaning:
ततो ग्रहमखं कुर्याद्धोमं व्याहृतिभिस्ततः ..
अयुतेनैव होमस्य समाप्तिरिह कथ्यते .. 8 ..
text_mt:
should then perform the planetary sacrifice, and then the fire sacrifice with the sacred utterances.
The completion of the fire sacrifice is declared to be with ten thousand [oblations].

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sarvasamīpe tu snātaḥ śuklāṃbaraḥ śuciḥ ..
puṣpadhūpairathābhyarcya vāsobhiḥ saphalākṣataiḥ ..
tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya maṃtrānetānudīrayet .. 9 ..
meaning:
ततः सर्वसमीपे तु स्नातः शुक्लांबरः शुचिः ..
पुष्पधूपैरथाभ्यर्च्य वासोभिः सफलाक्षतैः ..
ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य मंत्रानेतानुदीरयेत् .. 9 ..
text_mt:
Then near everything, bathed, wearing white garments, pure,
having worshipped with flowers and incense, with garments, along with fruits and unbroken grains,

khaḍgadhenukayā naddhaṃ hārālaṃkṛtavigraham .. 27 ..
meaning:
बद्धतूणिं धनुष्पाणिं बहुचर्मविभूषितम् ..
खड्गधेनुकया नद्धं हारालंकृतविग्रहम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: with a quiver fastened, holding a bow in hand, adorned with many shields, / girt with a dagger, his body adorned with a necklace.

sanskrit_iast:
yajamānastataḥ prājñaḥ śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuciḥ ..
rathaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya gṛhītakusumāṃjaliḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
यजमानस्ततः प्राज्ञः शुक्लांबरधरः शुचिः ..
रथं प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य गृहीतकुसुमांजलिः .. 28 ..
text_mt: Then the wise patron of the sacrifice, wearing white garments, pure, / having circumambulated the chariot, with anjali of flowers taken up,

sanskrit_iast:
imamuccārayenmantraṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ..
kumudairāvaṇau padmaḥ puṣpadaṃto'tha vāmanaḥ ..
supratīkoṃjanaḥ sārvabhaumo'ṣṭau devayonayaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
इममुच्चारयेन्मन्त्रं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ..
कुमुदैरावणौ पद्मः पुष्पदंतोऽथ वामनः ..
सुप्रतीकोंजनः सार्वभौमोऽष्टौ देवयोनयः .. 29 ..
text_mt: should utter this mantra that destroys all sins: / “Kumuda, Airāvaṇa, Padma, Puṣpadanta, then Vāmana, / Supratīka, Añjana, Sārvabhauma—the eight born of divine origin—

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ vaṃśaprasūtau tu balarūpasamanvitau ..
tadyuktarathadānena mama syātāṃ varapradau ..4.180.30....
meaning:
तेषां वंशप्रसूतौ तु बलरूपसमन्वितौ ..
तद्युक्तरथदानेन मम स्यातां वरप्रदौ ..4.180.30....
text_mt: born in their lineages, endowed with strength and beauty, / by the gift of this chariot equipped with them, may they bestow boons upon me!

sanskrit_iast:
ratho'yaṃ yajñapuruṣo brāhmaṇotra śivaḥ svayam ..
mamebharathadānena prīyetāṃ śivakeśavau ..31..
meaning:
रथोऽयं यज्ञपुरुषो ब्राह्मणोत्र शिवः स्वयम् ..
ममेभरथदानेन प्रीयेतां शिवकेशवौ ..31..
text_mt: This chariot is the Spirit of Sacrifice; the brāhmaṇa here is Śiva himself. / Through my gift of this elephant chariot, may Śiva and Keśava be pleased!”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuccārya mahābhāge pūjayitvā punaḥpunaḥ ..
āropayettatastasminbrāhmaṇaṃ śaṃsitavratam ..32..
meaning:
इत्युच्चार्य महाभागे पूजयित्वा पुनःपुनः ..
आरोपयेत्ततस्तस्मिन्ब्राह्मणं शंसितव्रतम् ..32..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, O highly fortunate one, and having worshipped him again and again, / he should then seat upon it a brāhmaṇa of praised vows,

sanskrit_iast:
svadāranirataṃ śāṃtaṃ vedavedāṃgapāragam ..
pañcāgnyabhimataṃ caiva avyaṃgaṃ vyādhivarjitam .. 33 ..
meaning:
स्वदारनिरतं शांतं वेदवेदांगपारगम् ..
पञ्चाग्न्यभिमतं चैव अव्यंगं व्याधिवर्जितम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: one devoted to his own wife, calm, fully versed in the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, / respected by the keepers of the five fires, unmaimed, and free from disease.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya rathasthaṃ dvijasattamam ..
ādvāramanugacchecca praṇipatya gṛhaṃ viśet .. 34 ..
meaning:
पुनः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य रथस्थं द्विजसत्तमम् ..
आद्वारमनुगच्छेच्च प्रणिपत्य गृहं विशेत् .. 34 ..
text_mt: Having circumambulated the best of the twice-born seated on the chariot, / he should follow him to the doorway, and having prostrated, enter his house.

sanskrit_iast:
tato yajñāvasāne tu dīnāṃdhādīñjaḍānkṛśān ..
pūjayedvividhairdānairvastragodānabhojanaiḥ ..35..
meaning:
ततो यज्ञावसाने तु दीनांधादीञ्जडान्कृशान् ..
पूजयेद्विविधैर्दानैर्वस्त्रगोदानभोजनैः ..35..
text_mt: Then, at the conclusion of the sacrifice, the poor, the blind, the dull-witted, and the emaciated / he should honour with diverse gifts: clothes, gifts of cows, and meals.

sanskrit_iast:
anenaiva vidhānena saṃkalpya rathamuttamam..
kuṇḍamaṃḍapasaṃbhārabhūṣaṇācchādanādikam ..36..
meaning:
अनेनैव विधानेन संकल्प्य रथमुत्तमम्..
कुण्डमंडपसंभारभूषणाच्छादनादिकम् ..36..
text_mt: Following this very rule, having prepared an excellent chariot / with the sacrificial pit, pavilion, provisions, ornaments, coverings, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva homadravyaṃ ca homamaṃtrāsta eva hi ..
viśeṣo'śvarathe rājankathyamāno nibodhyatām ..37..
meaning:
तदेव होमद्रव्यं च होममंत्रास्त एव हि ..
विशेषोऽश्वरथे राजन्कथ्यमानो निबोध्यताम् ..37..
text_mt: the offering substance is the same, and the offering mantras are indeed the very same. / Hear now, O king, the specific rule for the horse-chariot being described.

sanskrit_iast:
hayau lakṣaṇasaṃyuktau khalīnālaṃkṛtānanau..
vicitravastusaṃvītau kaṇṭhābharaṇabhūṣitau.. .. 38 ..
meaning:
हयौ लक्षणसंयुक्तौ खलीनालंकृताननौ..
विचित्रवस्तुसंवीतौ कण्ठाभरणभूषितौ.. .. 38 ..
text_mt: Two horses possessing auspicious marks, their muzzles adorned with bits, / covered in variegated garments, adorned with neck-ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
supragrahayutau yojyau dātā tasminnathottame ..
taṃ pradakṣiṇamāvṛttya maṃtrametamudīrayet .. 39 ..
meaning:
सुप्रग्रहयुतौ योज्यौ दाता तस्मिन्नथोत्तमे ..
तं प्रदक्षिणमावृत्त्य मंत्रमेतमुदीरयेत् .. 39 ..
text_mt: and fitted with good reins, the giver should harness to that excellent chariot. / Having circumambulated it, he should utter this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
namostu te vedaturaṃgamāya trayīmayāya triguṇātmakāya ..
sudurgamārge sukhapānapātre namo'stu te vājidharāya nityam .. 4.180.40 ..
meaning:
नमोस्तु ते वेदतुरंगमाय त्रयीमयाय त्रिगुणात्मकाय ..
सुदुर्गमार्गे सुखपानपात्रे नमोऽस्तु ते वाजिधराय नित्यम् .. 4.180.40 ..
text_mt: "Homage to you whose steed is the Veda, who consist of the three Vedas, whose nature is of the three guṇas! / On the very difficult path, you are a vessel of pleasant drink; homage be to you who constantly bear the steeds!

sanskrit_iast:
ratho'yaṃ savitā sākṣādvedāścāmī turaṃgamāḥ ..
aruṇo brāhmaṇaścāyaṃ prayacchaṃtu sukhaṃ mama .. 41 ..
meaning:
रथोऽयं सविता साक्षाद्वेदाश्चामी तुरंगमाः ..
अरुणो ब्राह्मणश्चायं प्रयच्छंतु सुखं मम .. 41 ..
text_mt: This chariot is Savitṛ visibly, and these steeds are the Vedas; / and this brāhmaṇa is Aruṇa. May they bestow happiness upon me!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuccārya tatastasminrathe brāhmaṇasattamam ..
āropayedgṛhāddvāraṃ yāvadetamanuvrajet .. 42 ..
meaning:
इत्युच्चार्य ततस्तस्मिन्रथे ब्राह्मणसत्तमम् ..
आरोपयेद्गृहाद्द्वारं यावदेतमनुव्रजेत् .. 42 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, he should then seat the best of brāhmaṇas upon that chariot, / and follow him from the house as far as the doorway.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā yastu dadyādvājirathaṃ budhaḥ ..
tasmādvāharathaṃ rājyaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 43 ..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु दद्याद्वाजिरथं बुधः ..
तस्माद्वाहरथं राज्यं तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु .. 43 ..
text_mt: The wise man who gives a horse-chariot according to this rule— / from that chariot-mount he attains kingship; hear its meritorious reward:

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvāmayavivarjitaḥ ..
manvaṃtaraśataṃ yāvatsarvabhogasamanvitaḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः सर्वामयविवर्जितः ..
मन्वंतरशतं यावत्सर्वभोगसमन्वितः .. 44 ..
text_mt: Freed from all sins, released from all sickness, / endowed with all enjoyments for a hundred manvantaras,

sanskrit_iast:
apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇe vimāne sūryavarcase ..
divyabhogānvitaḥ śrīmānkāmacārī vaseddivi .. 45 ..
meaning:
अप्सरोगणसंकीर्णे विमाने सूर्यवर्चसे ..
दिव्यभोगान्वितः श्रीमान्कामचारी वसेद्दिवि .. 45 ..
text_mt: in a celestial chariot filled with hosts of apsarases and possessing the splendour of the sun, / endowed with heavenly enjoyments, glorious, moving wherever he desires, he dwells in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ..
putrapautrānvitaścaiva ciraṃjīvī priyātithiḥ ..46..
meaning:
पुण्यक्षयादिहाभ्येत्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः ..
पुत्रपौत्रान्वितश्चैव चिरंजीवी प्रियातिथिः ..46..
text_mt: When his merit is exhausted, returning here, he becomes a righteous king, / endowed with sons and grandsons, long-lived, and affectionate to guests.

sanskrit_iast:
gajenaikena nirdiṣṭaḥ kaścidgajaratho nṛpa ..
ekenāśvenāśvarathaḥ kathyate vedavādibhiḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
गजेनैकेन निर्दिष्टः कश्चिद्गजरथो नृप ..
एकेनाश्वेनाश्वरथः कथ्यते वेदवादिभिः .. 47 ..
text_mt: Some describe an elephant-chariot with one elephant, O king; / a horse-chariot is declared with one horse by the expounders of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast: dānamaṃtrāsta evoktāḥ phalaṃ tatra nigadyate .. 48 ..
meaning: दानमंत्रास्त एवोक्ताः फलं तत्र निगद्यते .. 48 ..
text_mt: The gift-mantras are said to be the same; the fruit thereof is declared [now]:

sanskrit_iast:
yacchaṃti ye rathavaraṃ sudhurākṣacakraṃ vikrāṃtavāraṇayutaṃ turagānvitaṃ vā ..
sopaskaraṃ kanakapaṭṭavicitritāgaṃ te syaṃdanena surarājapuraṃ prayāṃti .. 49 ..
kālapuruṣadānavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
यच्छंति ये रथवरं सुधुराक्षचक्रं विक्रांतवारणयुतं तुरगान्वितं वा ..
सोपस्करं कनकपट्टविचित्रितागं ते स्यंदनेन सुरराजपुरं प्रयांति .. 49 ..
कालपुरुषदानविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Those who give an excellent chariot with sturdy poles, axles, and wheels, harnessed with a valiant elephant or equipped with horses, / complete with furnishings, its body adorned with golden plates, go to the city of the king of gods in a chariot.
Description of the Rule for the Gift of the Kālapuruṣa

sanskrit_iast:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
dānānyanyāni me kṛṣṇa kathayasva yadūttama ..
maṃgalyāni pavitrāṇi sarvapāpaharāṇi ca .. 1 ..
meaning:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
दानान्यन्यानि मे कृष्ण कथयस्व यदूत्तम ..
मंगल्यानि पवित्राणि सर्वपापहराणि च .. 1 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Tell me of other gifts, O Kṛṣṇa, O best of the Yadus, / that are auspicious, purifying, and take away all sins.
title: Kālapuruṣadānavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsārasāgarottārahetubhūto'si mādhava ..
dharmādharmaparijñāne tvadanyo neha kaścana ..2..
meaning:
संसारसागरोत्तारहेतुभूतोऽसि माधव ..
धर्माधर्मपरिज्ञाने त्वदन्यो नेह कश्चन ..2..
text_mt: You are the cause of crossing over the ocean of worldly existence, O Mādhava; / there is none other here than you in discerning dharma and adharma.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
dānāni bahurūpāṇi kathitāni mayā tava ..
punareva pravakṣyāmi yadyasti tava kautukam .. 3 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
दानानि बहुरूपाणि कथितानि मया तव ..
पुनरेव प्रवक्ष्यामि यद्यस्ति तव कौतुकम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Many kinds of gifts have been described by me to you. / I shall speak again if there is curiosity in you.

sanskrit_iast:
kathitāni mayā tubhyaṃ kathayiṣyāmi yāni ca ..
mahatārthena sidhyaṃti prayacchaṃti mahatphalam .. 4 ..
meaning:
कथितानि मया तुभ्यं कथयिष्यामि यानि च ..
महतार्थेन सिध्यंति प्रयच्छंति महत्फलम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Those that have been described by me to you, and those that I shall describe, / are accomplished at great cost and bestow a great reward.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmyo dānavidhiḥ pārtha kriyamāṇaḥ prayatnataḥ ..
phalāya munibhiḥ prokto viparīto bhayāya ca .. 5 ..
meaning:
काम्यो दानविधिः पार्थ क्रियमाणः प्रयत्नतः ..
फलाय मुनिभिः प्रोक्तो विपरीतो भयाय च .. 5 ..
text_mt: A voluntary rule of donation, O son of Pṛthā, performed with effort, / is declared by the sages to bring reward; if performed improperly, it brings fear.

sanskrit_iast:
jñeyaṃ niṣkaśataṃ sarvadāneṣu vidhiruttamaḥ ..
madhyamastu tadardhena tadarddhenāvaraḥ smṛtaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
ज्ञेयं निष्कशतं सर्वदानेषु विधिरुत्तमः ..
मध्यमस्तु तदर्धेन तदर्द्धेनावरः स्मृतः .. 6 ..
text_mt: One should know that one hundred niṣkas is the highest rule in all gifts; / the middling is with half of that, and the lowest is regarded as with half of that.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vṛkṣaratheṃdrāṇāṃ dhenoḥ kṛṣṇājinasya ca ..
aśaktasyāpi kṛṣṭo'yaṃ paṃcasauvarṇiko vidhiḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
एवं वृक्षरथेंद्राणां धेनोः कृष्णाजिनस्य च ..
अशक्तस्यापि कृष्टोऽयं पंचसौवर्णिको विधिः .. 7 ..
text_mt: Thus for trees, lordly chariots, a cow, and a black antelope skin; / even for one unable, this rule of five sauvarṇikas has been drawn up.

sanskrit_iast:
ato'nyūnena yo dadyānmahādānaṃ narādhipa ..
pratigṛhṇāti vā tasya duḥkhaśokāvahaṃ bhavet .. 8 ..
meaning:
अतोऽन्यूनेन यो दद्यान्महादानं नराधिप ..
प्रतिगृह्णाति वा तस्य दुःखशोकावहं भवेत् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Whoever gives a great gift of less than this, O lord of men, / or receives it, it will bring him pain and grief.

sanskrit_iast:
ādau tāvatpravakṣyāmi kālākhyaṃ puruṣaṃ tava ..
saptasāgaradānaṃ ca mahābhūtaghaṭantathā .. 9 ..
meaning:
आदौ तावत्प्रवक्ष्यामि कालाख्यं पुरुषं तव ..
सप्तसागरदानं च महाभूतघटन्तथा .. 9 ..
text_mt: First I will tell you of the man called Kāla, / and the gift of the seven oceans, and the jar of the great elements,

sanskrit_iast:
ardhyapradānamaṃtrokta mātmapratikṛtistathā ..
suvarṇāśvaḥ smṛtaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ suvarṇāśvaratho'paraḥ .. 4.181.10 ..
meaning:
अर्ध्यप्रदानमंत्रोक्त मात्मप्रतिकृतिस्तथा ..
सुवर्णाश्वः स्मृतः षष्ठः सुवर्णाश्वरथोऽपरः .. 4.181.10 ..
text_mt: a personal likeness accompanied by the mantra for offering arghya, / a golden horse is regarded as the sixth, and a golden horse-chariot as the other,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadānottamaṃ rājankṛṣṇājinamathāṣṭamam ..
viśvacakraṃ ca navamaṃ haimo gajarathastathā .. 11 ..
meaning:
सर्वदानोत्तमं राजन्कृष्णाजिनमथाष्टमम् ..
विश्वचक्रं च नवमं हैमो गजरथस्तथा .. 11 ..
text_mt: and the black antelope skin as the eighth, the highest of all gifts, O king, / and the universal wheel as the ninth, and likewise a golden elephant-chariot.

sanskrit_iast:
etatte dānadaśakaṃ vedmi pārthivasattama ..
dehi dāpaya sadbudiṃ dāne nṛpanarottama .. 12 ..
meaning:
एतत्ते दानदशकं वेद्मि पार्थिवसत्तम ..
देहि दापय सद्बुदिं दाने नृपनरोत्तम .. 12 ..
text_mt: I know this set of ten gifts for you, O best of rulers; / give, and inspire a good mind toward giving, O best of kings, best of men.

sanskrit_iast:
dānādṛte nopakāro vidyate dhanino'paraḥ ..
dīyamāno hi nāpaiti bhūya evābhivardhate .. 13 .
meaning:
दानादृते नोपकारो विद्यते धनिनोऽपरः ..
दीयमानो हि नापैति भूय एवाभिवर्धते .. 13 .
text_mt: Other than giving, there is no benefit for a wealthy man; / for what is given does not depart, but indeed increases all the more.

sanskrit_iast:
kūpa ullikhyamāno'pi bhavatyeva bahūdakaḥ ..
puṇyaṃ dinamathāsādya bhūmibhāge same śubhe .. 14 ..
meaning:
कूप उल्लिख्यमानोऽपि भवत्येव बहूदकः ..
पुण्यं दिनमथासाद्य भूमिभागे समे शुभे .. 14 ..
text_mt: A well, even when being dug out, becomes full of water. / Then, having found an auspicious day on an even, pure plot of ground,

sanskrit_iast:
caturthyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ viṣṭyāṃ vā pāṃḍunaṃdana ..
pumānkṛṣṇatilaiḥ kāryo raupyadaṃtaḥ suvarṇadṛk .. 15 ..
meaning:
चतुर्थ्यां वा चतुर्दश्यां विष्ट्यां वा पांडुनंदन ..
पुमान्कृष्णतिलैः कार्यो रौप्यदंतः सुवर्णदृक् .. 15 ..
text_mt: either on the fourth or the fourteenth [lunar day], or in Viṣṭi, O son of Pāṇḍu, / an effigy of a man should be made of black sesame, with silver teeth and gold eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
khaḍgodyatakaro dīrṇo japā kusumakuṃḍalaḥ ..
raktāṃbaradharaḥ sragvī śaṃkhamālāvibhūṣitaḥ .. 16 ..

खड्गोद्यतकरो दीर्णो जपा कुसुमकुंडलः ..
रक्तांबरधरः स्रग्वी शंखमालाविभूषितः .. 16 ..
text_mt: his hand raised with a sword, terrible, with earrings of hibiscus flowers, / wearing red garments, garlanded, adorned with a necklace of conches,

sanskrit_iast:
tīkṣṇāsipatradhanuṣā visphāritakaṭītaṭaḥ ..
upānadyugayukto hi kṛṣṇakaṃbala pārśvagaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
तीक्ष्णासिपत्रधनुषा विस्फारितकटीतटः ..
उपानद्युगयुक्तो हि कृष्णकंबल पार्श्वगः .. 17 ..
text_mt: his waist expanded with a sharp sword-leaf bow, / equipped with a pair of shoes, with a black blanket at his side,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītamāṃsapiṃḍaśca vāme karatale tathā ..
evaṃ vidhaṃ naraṃ kṛtvā gṛhītakusumāṃjaliḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
गृहीतमांसपिंडश्च वामे करतले तथा ..
एवं विधं नरं कृत्वा गृहीतकुसुमांजलिः .. 18 ..
text_mt: and with a lump of flesh held in the palm of his left hand. / Having made such an effigy of a man, taking a handful of flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya gaṃdhakusumairnaivedyaṃ vinivedya ca ..
tilājyaṃ juhuyāttatra tryaṃbaketi ca maṃtrataḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
संपूज्य गंधकुसुमैर्नैवेद्यं विनिवेद्य च ..
तिलाज्यं जुहुयात्तत्र त्र्यंबकेति च मंत्रतः .. 19 ..
text_mt: having worshipped it with perfumes and flowers and presented an offering of food, / he should offer an oblation of sesame and ghee there with the mantra "Tryambaka..."

sanskrit_iast:
svagṛhyoktavidhānena śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet ..
yajamānaḥ prasannātmā imaṃ maṃtramudīrayet ..4.181.20...
meaning:
स्वगृह्योक्तविधानेन शतमष्टोत्तरं यजेत् ..
यजमानः प्रसन्नात्मा इमं मंत्रमुदीरयेत् ..4.181.20...
text_mt: He should sacrifice one hundred and eight times according to the rule declared in his own Gṛhyasūtra. / With a joyful mind, the patron of the sacrifice should utter this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ kalayase yasmātkālastvaṃ tena bhaṇyase ..
brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ tvamasādhyo'si suvrata .. 21 ..
meaning:
सर्वं कलयसे यस्मात्कालस्त्वं तेन भण्यसे ..
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादीनां त्वमसाध्योऽसि सुव्रत .. 21 ..
text_mt: "Because you reckon everything, you are therefore called Time. / You cannot be mastered even by Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and the others, O you of noble vows!

sanskrit_iast:
pūjitastvaṃ mayā bhaktyā prārthitaśca tathā sukham ..
yaducyate tava vibho tatkuruṣva namonamaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
पूजितस्त्वं मया भक्त्या प्रार्थितश्च तथा सुखम् ..
यदुच्यते तव विभो तत्कुरुष्व नमोनमः .. 22 ..
text_mt: You have been worshipped by me with devotion and prayed to for happiness; / fulfill what has been spoken to you, O all-pervading one! Homage, homage!"

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃpūjayitvā taṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ..
brahmāṇaṃ prathamaṃ pūjya vāsobhirbhūṣaṇaistathā .. 23 ..
meaning:
एवं संपूजयित्वा तं ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ..
ब्रह्माणं प्रथमं पूज्य वासोभिर्भूषणैस्तथा .. 23 ..
text_mt: Having thus worshipped him, he should present him to a brāhmaṇa, / having first worshipped the brāhmaṇa with garments and ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāṃ śaktito dadyātpraṇipatya visarjayet..
anena vidhinā yastu dānametatprayacchati .. 24 ..
meaning:
दक्षिणां शक्तितो दद्यात्प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत्..
अनेन विधिना यस्तु दानमेतत्प्रयच्छति .. 24 ..
text_mt: He should give a sacrificial fee according to his capacity, and having prostrated, dismiss him. / Whoever offers this gift according to this rule,

sanskrit_iast:
nāpamṛtyubhayaṃ tasya na ca vyādhikṛtaṃ bhayam ..
bhavatyavyāhataiśvaryaḥ sarvabādhāvivarjitaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
नापमृत्युभयं तस्य न च व्याधिकृतं भयम् ..
भवत्यव्याहतैश्वर्यः सर्वबाधाविवर्जितः .. 25 ..
text_mt: has no fear of untimely death, nor fear caused by disease; / his sovereignty becomes unobstructed, and he is free from all afflictions.

sanskrit_iast:
dehāṃte sūryabhavanaṃ bhittvā yāti paraṃ padam ..
puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ..
saṃtatyā ca śriyā yuktaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
देहांते सूर्यभवनं भित्त्वा याति परं पदम् ..
पुण्यक्षयादिहाभ्येत्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः ..
संतत्या च श्रिया युक्तः पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितः .. 26 ..
text_mt: At the end of his body, piercing the solar realm, he goes to the supreme abode. / When his merit is exhausted, he comes here and becomes a righteous king, / endowed with lineage and fortune, accompanied by sons and grandsons.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya kālapuruṣaṃ vidhivaddvijāya dattvā śubhāśubhaphalodayahetubhūtaḥ ..
rogāṃtare sakaladoṣamaye ca dehī no vadhyabhāvamupagacchati tatprabhāvāt .. 27 .. ..
saptasāgaradānavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
संपूज्य कालपुरुषं विधिवद्द्विजाय दत्त्वा शुभाशुभफलोदयहेतुभूतः ..
रोगांतरे सकलदोषमये च देही नो वध्यभावमुपगच्छति तत्प्रभावात् .. 27 .. ..
सप्तसागरदानविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Having duly worshipped the Time-Person and given it to a brāhmaṇa, he who is the source of the rise of auspicious and inauspicious results, / the embodied soul does not meet death amidst diseases and full of all afflictions, by that power.
Description of the procedure for the gift of the seven oceans

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi pārthadānamanuttamam ..
saptasāgarakaṃ nāma sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि पार्थदानमनुत्तमम् ..
सप्तसागरकं नाम सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Now, therefore, O son of Pṛthā, I shall describe an unsurpassed gift / named the Seven Oceans, which destroys all sins.
title: Saptasāgaradānavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyaṃ dinamathāsādya yugādigrahaṇādikam ..
kārayetsaptakuṇḍāni kāṃcanāni vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
पुण्यं दिनमथासाद्य युगादिग्रहणादिकम् ..
कारयेत्सप्तकुण्डानि कांचनानि विचक्षणः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Having reached an auspicious day, such as an eclipse, the start of a yuga, or similar occasions, / the wise person should cause seven sacrificial pits to be made of gold,

sanskrit_iast:
prādeśamātrāṇi tathā ratnimātrāṇi vā punaḥ ..
kuryātsaptaśatādūrdhvamāsahasrācca śaktitaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
प्रादेशमात्राणि तथा रत्निमात्राणि वा पुनः ..
कुर्यात्सप्तशतादूर्ध्वमासहस्राच्च शक्तितः .. 3 ..
text_mt: measuring a span, or else measuring a cubit. / According to one's capacity, one should make them from seven hundred [palas] up to a thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsthāpyāni ca sarvāṇi kṛṣṇājinatilopari ..
prathamaṃ pūrayetkuṃḍaṃ lavaṇena vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
संस्थाप्यानि च सर्वाणि कृष्णाजिनतिलोपरि ..
प्रथमं पूरयेत्कुंडं लवणेन विचक्षणः .. 4 ..
text_mt: And all of them are to be set upon black antelope skin and sesame seeds. / The wise person should fill the first sacrificial pit with salt;

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyaṃ payasā tadvattṛtīyaṃ sarpiṣā punaḥ ..
caturthaṃ tu guḍenaiva dadhnā paṃcamameva ca .. 5 ..
meaning:
द्वितीयं पयसा तद्वत्तृतीयं सर्पिषा पुनः ..
चतुर्थं तु गुडेनैव दध्ना पंचममेव च .. 5 ..
text_mt: the second likewise with milk; again, the third with clarified butter; / the fourth indeed with molasses; and the fifth with curds;

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhaṃ śarkarayā tadvatsaptamaṃ tīrthavāriṇā ..
sthāpayellavaṇasyāṃte brahmāṇaṃ kāṃcanaṃ śubham .. 6 ..
meaning:
षष्ठं शर्करया तद्वत्सप्तमं तीर्थवारिणा ..
स्थापयेल्लवणस्यांते ब्रह्माणं कांचनं शुभम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: the sixth likewise with sugar; the seventh with sacred water. / At the end of the salt one should place an auspicious golden Brahmā;

sanskrit_iast:
keśavaṃ kṣīramadhye tu ghṛtamadhye maheśvaram ..
bhāskaraṃ guḍamadhye tu dadhimadhye surādhipam .. 7 ..
meaning:
केशवं क्षीरमध्ये तु घृतमध्ये महेश्वरम् ..
भास्करं गुडमध्ये तु दधिमध्ये सुराधिपम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: Keśava in the middle of the milk; Maheśvara in the middle of the clarified butter; / Bhāskara in the middle of the molasses; the lord of the gods in the middle of the curds;

sanskrit_iast:
śarkarāyāṃ nyasellakṣmīṃ jalamadhye tu pārvatīm ..
sarveṣu sarvaratnāni dhānyāni ca samaṃtataḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
शर्करायां न्यसेल्लक्ष्मीं जलमध्ये तु पार्वतीम् ..
सर्वेषु सर्वरत्नानि धान्यानि च समंततः .. 8 ..
text_mt: upon the sugar one should place Lakṣmī; and Pārvatī in the middle of the water. / In all of them, all jewels and grains all around,

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpayetpuruṣaśreṣṭha yathālābhaṃ yathāsukham ..
tataḥ parvasamīpe tu snātaḥ śuklāṃbaro gṛhī .. 9 ..
meaning:
स्थापयेत्पुरुषश्रेष्ठ यथालाभं यथासुखम् ..
ततः पर्वसमीपे तु स्नातः शुक्लांबरो गृही .. 9 ..
text_mt: O best of men, one should place according to what is available and comfortably. / Then, near the sacred festival time, bathed and wearing white garments, the householder,

sanskrit_iast:
triḥpradakṣiṇamāvṛtya maṃtrānetānudīrayet ..
namo vaḥ sarvasiṃdhūnāmādhārebhyaḥ sanātanāḥ .. 4.182.10 ..
meaning:
त्रिःप्रदक्षिणमावृत्य मंत्रानेतानुदीरयेत् ..
नमो वः सर्वसिंधूनामाधारेभ्यः सनातनाः .. 4.182.10 ..
text_mt: having circled three times clockwise, should utter these mantras: / 'Homage to you, eternal foundations of all rivers!

sanskrit_iast:
jaṃtūnāṃ prāṇadebhyaśca samudrebhya namonamaḥ ..
pūrṇāḥ sarve bhavaṃto vai kṣāra kṣīraghṛtaikṣavaiḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
जंतूनां प्राणदेभ्यश्च समुद्रेभ्य नमोनमः ..
पूर्णाः सर्वे भवंतो वै क्षार क्षीरघृतैक्षवैः .. 11 ..
text_mt: To the oceans, givers of life to living creatures, homage, homage! / May all of you indeed become full with salt water, milk, clarified butter, and sugarcane juice,

sanskrit_iast:
dadhnā śarkarayā tadvattīrthavāribhireva ca ..
tasmādaghaughavidhvaṃsaṃ kurudhvaṃ mama mānadāḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
दध्ना शर्करया तद्वत्तीर्थवारिभिरेव च ..
तस्मादघौघविध्वंसं कुरुध्वं मम मानदाः .. 12 ..
text_mt: with curds, with sugar, and with sacred waters! / Therefore, O honorers, destroy the mass of my sins!

sanskrit_iast:
alakṣmīḥ praśamaṃ yātu lakṣmīścāstu gṛhe mama ..
evamuccārya tāndadyādbrāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhira.. 13 ..
meaning:
अलक्ष्मीः प्रशमं यातु लक्ष्मीश्चास्तु गृहे मम ..
एवमुच्चार्य तान्दद्याद्ब्राह्मणेभ्यो युधिष्ठिर.. 13 ..
text_mt: May misfortune be calmed, and may fortune reside in my home!' / Having uttered this, he should give them to brāhmaṇas, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit_iast:
ekamevamathābhyarcya puṣpavastravilepanaiḥ ..
bahūnāmetaduddiṣṭaṃ dānamekasya vā punaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
एकमेवमथाभ्यर्च्य पुष्पवस्त्रविलेपनैः ..
बहूनामेतदुद्दिष्टं दानमेकस्य वा पुनः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped [them] thus one by one with flowers, garments, and ointments, / this gift is prescribed for many or else for one [brāhmaṇa];

sanskrit_iast:
deyaṃ vā sarvasāmānyaṃ kriyāviprānurūpataḥ ..
dānaṃ saptasamudrākhyaṃ yaḥ prayacchati pārthiva .. 15 ..
meaning:
देयं वा सर्वसामान्यं क्रियाविप्रानुरूपतः ..
दानं सप्तसमुद्राख्यं यः प्रयच्छति पार्थिव .. 15 ..
text_mt: or it may be given equally to all, in accordance with the deeds and the brāhmaṇas. / The king who offers the gift called the Seven Oceans,

sanskrit_iast:
tasya gṛhānna calati lakṣmīryāvatkulāṣṭakam ..
pūjyamānaḥ suragaṇaiḥ siddhavidyādharoragaiḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
तस्य गृहान्न चलति लक्ष्मीर्यावत्कुलाष्टकम् ..
पूज्यमानः सुरगणैः सिद्धविद्याधरोरगैः .. 16 ..
text_mt: from his house fortune does not depart for eight generations. / Being worshipped by hosts of gods, siddhas, vidyādharas, and uragas,

sanskrit_iast:
devalokānna cyavate saptamanvatarāṇyasau ..
tataśca vedasaṃskārātparaṃ brahmādhigacchati .. 17 ..
meaning:
देवलोकान्न च्यवते सप्तमन्वतराण्यसौ ..
ततश्च वेदसंस्कारात्परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति .. 17 ..
text_mt: he does not fall from the world of the gods for seven Manvantaras; / and then, through the consecration of the Veda, he attains the supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
iti dadāti rasāmarasaṃyutāñchuciravismayadāniha sāgarān ..
analakāṃcanaratnamayānasau padamupaiti hare ramayā vṛtam .. .. 16 ..
meaning:
इति ददाति रसामरसंयुताञ्छुचिरविस्मयदानिह सागरान् ..
अनलकांचनरत्नमयानसौ पदमुपैति हरे रमया वृतम् .. .. 16 ..
text_mt: He who, pure and offering wondrous things here, gives the oceans containing the nectar of the earth / and consisting of pure gold and jewels, reaches the abode of Hari, accompanied by Ramā.

sanskrit_iast:
dānaṃ pradhānatarametadatīva vipre proktaṃ yudhiṣṭhira samādhidhiyā viciṃtya ..
haimānvidhāya jaladhīnvitarasva śaktyā prāpnoṣi yena sarasāni samīhitāni .. 19 ..
mahābhūtaghaṭadānavarṇanam
meaning:
दानं प्रधानतरमेतदतीव विप्रे प्रोक्तं युधिष्ठिर समाधिधिया विचिंत्य ..
हैमान्विधाय जलधीन्वितरस्व शक्त्या प्राप्नोषि येन सरसानि समीहितानि .. 19 ..
महाभूतघटदानवर्णनम्
text_mt:
This gift is proclaimed as exceedingly preeminent when given to a brāhmaṇa, O Yudhiṣṭhira; having considered this with a focused mind, / having fashioned the golden oceans, give them according to your means, by which you will obtain your desired charming things.
Description of the gift of the jar of the great elements

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dānamanyattavottamam ..
mahābhūtaghaṭaṃ nāma mahāpātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि दानमन्यत्तवोत्तमम् ..
महाभूतघटं नाम महापातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Now, therefore, I shall describe another excellent gift for you, / named the Jar of the Great Elements, which destroys great sins.
title: Vidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyāṃ tithiṃ samāsādya svanulipte gṛhāṃgaṇe ..
kārayetkāṃcanaṃ kuṃbhaṃ mahāratnānvitaṃ punaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
पुण्यां तिथिं समासाद्य स्वनुलिप्ते गृहांगणे ..
कारयेत्कांचनं कुंभं महारत्नान्वितं पुनः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Having reached an auspicious lunar day, in a well-smeared courtyard of the house, / one should cause a golden jar to be made, further adorned with great jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
prādeśādaṃgulaśataṃ yāvatkuryātpramāṇataḥ ..
śaktyā paṃcapalādūrdhvamāśatācca narottama .. 3 ..
meaning:
प्रादेशादंगुलशतं यावत्कुर्यात्प्रमाणतः ..
शक्त्या पंचपलादूर्ध्वमाशताच्च नरोत्तम .. 3 ..
text_mt: from a span up to a hundred fingers in measure; / according to one's capacity, from five palas up to a hundred, O best of men.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrājyapūritaṃ kṛtvā kalpavṛkṣasamanvitam ..
padmāsanagatāstatra brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
क्षीराज्यपूरितं कृत्वा कल्पवृक्षसमन्वितम् ..
पद्मासनगतास्तत्र ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Having made it filled with milk and clarified butter, accompanied by a wish-fulfilling tree, / seated on lotus postures there are Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara;

sanskrit_iast:
lokapālā mahendrāśca svavāhanasamāsthitāḥ ..
ṛgvedaḥ sākṣasūtraśca yajurvedaḥ sapaṃkajaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
लोकपाला महेन्द्राश्च स्ववाहनसमास्थिताः ..
ऋग्वेदः साक्षसूत्रश्च यजुर्वेदः सपंकजः .. 5 ..
text_mt: the world protectors and great Indras mounted on their respective vehicles; / the Ṛgveda with a rosary; the Yajurveda with a lotus;

sanskrit_iast:
vīṇādhārī sāmavedo hyatharvā srakchubhānvitaḥ ..
purāṇavedo varadaḥ sākṣasūtrakamaṃḍaluḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
वीणाधारी सामवेदो ह्यथर्वा स्रक्छुभान्वितः ..
पुराणवेदो वरदः साक्षसूत्रकमंडलुः .. 6 ..
text_mt: the Sāmaveda holding a lute; and indeed the Atharvaveda endowed with an auspicious ladle; / the Purāṇa-Veda, granting boons, with a rosary and a water pot.

sanskrit_iast:
saptadhānyāni purataḥ sthāpayecchaktito budhaḥ ..
pādukopānahacchatraṃ cāmarāgryāsanāyudhān .. 7 ..
meaning:
सप्तधान्यानि पुरतः स्थापयेच्छक्तितो बुधः ..
पादुकोपानहच्छत्रं चामराग्र्यासनायुधान् .. 7 ..
text_mt: In front, the wise man should place the seven grains according to his means, / sandals, shoes, royal parasol, chowrie, supreme seat, and weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ prakalpya vidhivanmahābhūtaghaṭaṃ naraḥ ..
guḍasāroparigataṃ mālyavastrairathārcayet .. 8 ..
meaning:
एवं प्रकल्प्य विधिवन्महाभूतघटं नरः ..
गुडसारोपरिगतं माल्यवस्त्रैरथार्चयेत् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Having thus prepared according to rule the jar of the great elements, / placed on top of molasses, a man should then worship it with garlands and garments.

sanskrit_iast:
atha parvasamīpe tu snātvā niyatamānasaḥ ..
triḥ pradakṣiṇamāvṛtya maṃtrametamudīrayet .. 9 ..
meaning:
अथ पर्वसमीपे तु स्नात्वा नियतमानसः ..
त्रिः प्रदक्षिणमावृत्य मंत्रमेतमुदीरयेत् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Then, near the festival time, having bathed with a restrained mind, / having circled three times clockwise, he should utter this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
yasmānna kiṃcidapyasti mahābhūtairvinā kṛtam ..
mahābhūtamayaścāyaṃ tasmācchāṃtiṃ dadātu me .. 4.183.10 ..
meaning:
यस्मान्न किंचिदप्यस्ति महाभूतैर्विना कृतम् ..
महाभूतमयश्चायं तस्माच्छांतिं ददातु मे .. 4.183.10 ..
text_mt: 'Since nothing at all is made without the great elements, / and this consists of the great elements, therefore may it grant me peace!

sanskrit_iast:
atra sannihitā devāḥ sthāpitā viśvakarmaṇā ..
te me śāṃtiṃ prayacchaṃtu bhaktibhāvena pūjitāḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
अत्र सन्निहिता देवाः स्थापिता विश्वकर्मणा ..
ते मे शांतिं प्रयच्छंतु भक्तिभावेन पूजिताः .. 11 ..
text_mt: The gods present here were established by Viśvakarman; / worshipped with devotion, may they grant peace to me!'

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ pūjayitvā tu mahābhūtaghaṭaṃ naraḥ ..
brāhmaṇaṃ pūjayitvā tu bhūṣaṇācchādanādibhiḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
इत्येवं पूजयित्वा तु महाभूतघटं नरः ..
ब्राह्मणं पूजयित्वा तु भूषणाच्छादनादिभिः .. 12 ..
text_mt: Having thus worshipped the jar of the great elements, a man, / having worshipped a brāhmaṇa with ornaments, clothing, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
mahābhūtaghaṭaṃ dadyātparvakāle yatavrataḥ ..
punaḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ kṣamāpayet.. 13 ..
meaning:
महाभूतघटं दद्यात्पर्वकाले यतव्रतः ..
पुनः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य ब्राह्मणं तं क्षमापयेत्.. 13 ..
text_mt: should give the jar of the great elements at the festival time, observing his vow. / Having circled the brāhmaṇa clockwise again, he should ask his pardon.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā yaśca dānametatprayacchati ..
ekaviṃśatkulopetaḥ śivaloke prayātyasau .. 14 ..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना यश्च दानमेतत्प्रयच्छति ..
एकविंशत्कुलोपेतः शिवलोके प्रयात्यसौ .. 14 ..
text_mt: And he who presents this gift by this procedure, / accompanied by twenty-one generations of his family, goes to the world of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ..
ajeyaḥ śatrusaṃghātairmahābala parākramaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
पुण्यक्षयादिहाभ्येत्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः ..
अजेयः शत्रुसंघातैर्महाबल पराक्रमः .. 15 ..
text_mt: When his merit is exhausted, he comes here and becomes a righteous king, / invincible to hosts of enemies, possessed of great strength and prowess,

sanskrit_iast: kṣatradharmarato vidvāndevabrāhmaṇapūjakaḥ ..16..
meaning: क्षत्रधर्मरतो विद्वान्देवब्राह्मणपूजकः ..16..
text_mt: devoted to the duty of the kṣatriya, learned, worshipping gods and brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāpadottamaghaṭaṃ vimalaṃ vidhāya brahmeśakeśavayutaṃ sahalokapālaiḥ ..
kṣīrājyapūrṇavivaraṃ praṇipatya bhaktyā viprāya dehi tava dānaśataiḥ kimanyaiḥ ...17..
śayyādānavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
अष्टापदोत्तमघटं विमलं विधाय ब्रह्मेशकेशवयुतं सहलोकपालैः ..
क्षीराज्यपूर्णविवरं प्रणिपत्य भक्त्या विप्राय देहि तव दानशतैः किमन्यैः ...17..
शय्यादानविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Having made a spotless jar of the best gold, joined with Brahmā, Īśa, and Keśava along with the world protectors, / its cavity filled with milk and clarified butter, give it with devotion, having bowed down, to a brāhmaṇa; what need have you of hundreds of other gifts?
Description of the Rules for the Gift of a Bed

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śayyādānaṃ pravakṣyāmi tava pāṃḍukulodvaha ..
yaddattvā sukhabhāgī syādiha loke paratra ca .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
शय्यादानं प्रवक्ष्यामि तव पांडुकुलोद्वह ..
यद्दत्त्वा सुखभागी स्यादिह लोके परत्र च .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
I shall explain to you the gift of a bed, O uplifter of the Pāṇḍu line, / by giving which one attains happiness in this world and in the next.
title: Śayyādānavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
śayyādānaṃ prayacchaṃti sarvadaiva dvijottamāḥ ..
anityaṃ jīvitaṃ yasmātkonyaḥ paścātpradāsyati .. 2 ..
meaning:
शय्यादानं प्रयच्छंति सर्वदैव द्विजोत्तमाः ..
अनित्यं जीवितं यस्मात्कोन्यः पश्चात्प्रदास्यति .. 2 ..
text_mt: The best of the twice-born always give the gift of a bed, / because life is transient; who else will give it afterwards?

sanskrit_iast:
tāvatsa baṃdhuḥ sa pitā yāvajjīvati bhārata ..
mṛto mṛta iti jñātvā kṣaṇātsneho nivartate .. 3 ..
meaning:
तावत्स बंधुः स पिता यावज्जीवति भारत ..
मृतो मृत इति ज्ञात्वा क्षणात्स्नेहो निवर्तते .. 3 ..
text_mt: He is a kinsman, he is a father, only so long as he lives, O descendant of Bharata; / knowing that the dead is dead, affection ceases in an instant.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsvayaṃ pradātavyaṃ śayyābhojyajalādikam ..
ātmaiva hyātmano bandhuriti saṃciṃtya cetasi .. 4 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्स्वयं प्रदातव्यं शय्याभोज्यजलादिकम् ..
आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरिति संचिंत्य चेतसि .. 4 ..
text_mt: Therefore, one should give a bed, food, water, and so forth oneself, / reflecting in one's heart: “The self indeed is the friend of the self.”

sanskrit_iast:
ātmaiva yo hi nātmānaṃ dānabhogaiḥ samarcayet ..
ko'nyo hitatarastasmātkaḥ paścātpūjayiṣyati .. 5 ..
meaning:
आत्मैव यो हि नात्मानं दानभोगैः समर्चयेत् ..
कोऽन्यो हिततरस्तस्मात्कः पश्चात्पूजयिष्यति .. 5 ..
text_mt: For whoever does not worship his own self with gifts and enjoyments— / who else is more beneficial than he himself? Who will worship him afterwards?

sanskrit_iast:
tasmācchayyāṃ samāsādya sāradārumayīṃ dṛḍhām ..
daṃtapatracitāṃ ramyāṃ himapaṭṭairalaṃkṛtām .. 6 ..
meaning:
तस्माच्छय्यां समासाद्य सारदारुमयीं दृढाम् ..
दंतपत्रचितां रम्यां हिमपट्टैरलंकृताम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Therefore, having obtained a bed made of solid wood, sturdy, / charming, inlaid with ivory plaques, adorned with fine white silks,

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsatūlīpraticchannāṃ subhagāṃ sopadhānikām ..
pracchādanapaṭīyuktāṃ gaṃdhadhūpādhivāsitām .. 7 ..
meaning:
हंसतूलीप्रतिच्छन्नां सुभगां सोपधानिकाम् ..
प्रच्छादनपटीयुक्तां गंधधूपाधिवासिताम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: covered with swansdown, beautiful, provided with pillows, / furnished with a bedspread, perfumed with fragrant incense,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ saṃsthāpayeddhaimaṃ hariṃ lakṣmīsamanvitam ..
ucchīrṣake dhṛtaṃ caiva kalaśaṃ parikalpayet .. 8 ..
meaning:
तस्यां संस्थापयेद्धैमं हरिं लक्ष्मीसमन्वितम् ..
उच्छीर्षके धृतं चैव कलशं परिकल्पयेत् .. 8 ..
text_mt: upon it one should place a golden Hari accompanied by Lakṣmī, / and at the head of the bed one should arrange a pot placed [there].

sanskrit_iast:
vijñeyaṃ pāṃḍava sadā sanidrākalpakaṃ budhaiḥ ..
tāṃbūlaṃ kuṃkumakṣodakarpūrāgaru caṃdanam .. 9 ..
meaning:
विज्ञेयं पांडव सदा सनिद्राकल्पकं बुधैः ..
तांबूलं कुंकुमक्षोदकर्पूरागरु चंदनम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: It should always be understood by the wise, O Pāṇḍava, as equipped for sleep: / betel, saffron powder, camphor, agallochum, sandalwood,

sanskrit_iast:
dīpakopānahacchatracāmarāsanabhojanam ..
pārśveṣu sthāpayecchaktyā saptadhānyāni caiva hi .. 4.184.10 ..
meaning:
दीपकोपानहच्छत्रचामरासनभोजनम् ..
पार्श्वेषु स्थापयेच्छक्त्या सप्तधान्यानि चैव हि .. 4.184.10 ..
text_mt: a lamp, sandals, a royal parasol, a chowrie, a seat, and food; / and on the sides, according to one's means, one should place the seven grains,

sanskrit_iast:
śayanasthasya bhavati yadanyadupakārakam ..
bhṛṃgārakādyapuṣpāṇi paṃcavarṇavitānakam .. 11 ..
meaning:
शयनस्थस्य भवति यदन्यदुपकारकम् ..
भृंगारकाद्यपुष्पाणि पंचवर्णवितानकम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: and whatever else is useful to one lying on a bed: / ewers and other vessels, flowers, and a canopy of five colours.

sanskrit_iast:
śayyāmevaṃvidhāṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇāyopadāpayet ..
sapatnīkāya saṃpūjya puṇye'hni vidhipūrvakam .. 12 ..
meaning:
शय्यामेवंविधां कृत्वा ब्राह्मणायोपदापयेत् ..
सपत्नीकाय संपूज्य पुण्येऽह्नि विधिपूर्वकम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Having prepared such a bed, on an auspicious day, / having worshipped [it] according to rule, one should present it to a brāhmaṇa together with his wife.

sanskrit_iast:
namaste sarvadeveśa śayyādānaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā ..
dehi tasmācchāṃtiphalaṃ namaste puruṣottama .. 13 ..
meaning:
नमस्ते सर्वदेवेश शय्यादानं कृतं मया ..
देहि तस्माच्छांतिफलं नमस्ते पुरुषोत्तम .. 13 ..
text_mt: “Homage to you, O Lord of all the gods! The gift of a bed has been made by me; / therefore grant me the fruit of peace. Homage to you, O Supreme Person!

sanskrit_iast:
yathā na kṛṣṇa śayanaṃ śūnyaṃ sāgarajātayā ..
śayyā mamāpyaśūnyāstu tathā janmanijanmani .. 14 ..
meaning:
यथा न कृष्ण शयनं शून्यं सागरजातया ..
शय्या ममाप्यशून्यास्तु तथा जन्मनिजन्मनि .. 14 ..
text_mt: Just as your couch, O Kṛṣṇa, is never bereft of her who was born from the ocean, / likewise may my bed also not be bereft [of a spouse] birth after birth.”

sanskrit_iast:
dattvaivaṃ talpamamalaṃ praṇipatya visarjayet ..
ekādaśāhe'pi tathā vidhireṣa prakīrtitaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वैवं तल्पममलं प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् ..
एकादशाहेऽपि तथा विधिरेष प्रकीर्तितः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Having thus given the spotless bed, bowing down, he should dismiss [the brāhmaṇa]. / This rite is also proclaimed for the eleventh day [after death].

sanskrit_iast:
dadāti yadi dharmārthaṃ mānavo bāṃdhave mṛte ..
viśeṣaṃ cātra rājeṃdra kathyamānaṃ nibodha me .. 16 ..
meaning:
ददाति यदि धर्मार्थं मानवो बांधवे मृते ..
विशेषं चात्र राजेंद्र कथ्यमानं निबोध मे .. 16 ..
text_mt: If a man gives it for the sake of religious merit when a kinsman has died, / understand from me the special rule mentioned here, O lord of kings:

sanskrit_iast:
tenopabhuktaṃ yadvastu kiṃcitpūrvaṃ gṛhe satā ..
tadgātralagnaṃ ca tathā vastravāhanabhājanam .. 17 ..
meaning:
तेनोपभुक्तं यद्वस्तु किंचित्पूर्वं गृहे सता ..
तद्गात्रलग्नं च तथा वस्त्रवाहनभाजनम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: Whatever article was previously enjoyed in the house by that good person, / and likewise whatever was worn on his body—garments, conveyances, vessels—

sanskrit_iast:
yadiṣṭaṃ ca tathāsyāsīttatsarvaṃ parikalpayet ..
sa eva puruṣo haimastasyāṃtaṃ sthāpayettathā .. 18 ..
meaning:
यदिष्टं च तथास्यासीत्तत्सर्वं परिकल्पयेत् ..
स एव पुरुषो हैमस्तस्यांतं स्थापयेत्तथा .. 18 ..
text_mt: and whatever was dear to him, all that one should arrange. / Likewise, that same golden figure of a man one should place near it.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā pradātavyo mṛtaśayyā yathoditā ..
svarge puraṃdaragṛhe sūryaputrālayetha vā .. 19 ..
meaning:
पूजयित्वा प्रदातव्यो मृतशय्या यथोदिता ..
स्वर्गे पुरंदरगृहे सूर्यपुत्रालयेथ वा .. 19 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped [it], the bed of the deceased should be given as prescribed. / In heaven, in the house of Purandara or in the abode of the son of Sūrya,

sanskrit_iast:
sukhaṃ vasatyasau jaṃtuḥ śayyādānaprabhāvataḥ ..
pīḍayaṃti na taṃ yāmyāḥ puruṣā bhīṣaṇānanāḥ .. 4.184.20 ..
meaning:
सुखं वसत्यसौ जंतुः शय्यादानप्रभावतः ..
पीडयंति न तं याम्याः पुरुषा भीषणाननाः .. 4.184.20 ..
text_mt: that creature dwells happily by the power of the gift of a bed. / The attendants of Yama with terrifying faces do not afflict him.

sanskrit_iast:
na dharmeṇa na śītena bādhyate sa naraḥ kvacit ..
api pāpasamāyuktaḥ svargaloke mahīyate .. 21 ..
meaning:
न धर्मेण न शीतेन बाध्यते स नरः क्वचित् ..
अपि पापसमायुक्तः स्वर्गलोके महीयते .. 21 ..
text_mt: That man is never troubled by heat or by cold; / even if burdened with sin, he is honoured in the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast:
vimānavaramārūḍhaḥ sevyamānopsarogaṇaiḥ ..
ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ yāvattiṣṭhetpātakavarjitaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
विमानवरमारूढः सेव्यमानोप्सरोगणैः ..
आभूतसंप्लवं यावत्तिष्ठेत्पातकवर्जितः .. 22 ..
text_mt: Mounted upon an excellent celestial chariot, attended by hosts of apsarases, / freed from sins, he shall remain [there] until the dissolution of all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
śayyāpradānamamalaṃ tava pāṃḍuputrasaṃkīrtitaṃ sakalasaukhyānidhānametat ..
tayo dadāti vidhivatsvayameva nāke talpe vikalparahitaḥ sa vibhāti satyam .. 23 ..
ātmapratidānavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
शय्याप्रदानममलं तव पांडुपुत्रसंकीर्तितं सकलसौख्यानिधानमेतत् ..
तयो ददाति विधिवत्स्वयमेव नाके तल्पे विकल्परहितः स विभाति सत्यम् .. 23 ..
आत्मप्रतिदानविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
This spotless gift of a bed, the repository of all happiness, has been proclaimed to you, O son of Pāṇḍu; / he who gives it according to rule himself shines free from doubt on a couch in heaven—this is the truth.
Description of the Rules for the Gift of an Effigy of Oneself

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ātmapratikṛtirnāma yathoktaṃ kasyacitpurā ..
tatte'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi dānaṃ mānavivardhanam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
आत्मप्रतिकृतिर्नाम यथोक्तं कस्यचित्पुरा ..
तत्तेऽहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि दानं मानविवर्धनम् .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
I shall explain to you that gift known as the effigy of oneself, / which enhances honour, as it was declared to someone in the past.
title: Ātmapratikṛtidānavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
dānakālaḥ sadā tasya munibhiḥ parikīrtitaḥ ..
puṇyaiḥ puṇyadinaṃ pārtha prāpyate jīvitairna ca .. 2 ..
meaning:
दानकालः सदा तस्य मुनिभिः परिकीर्तितः ..
पुण्यैः पुण्यदिनं पार्थ प्राप्यते जीवितैर्न च .. 2 ..
text_mt: The proper time for giving it has always been declared by the sages; / an auspicious day, O son of Pṛthā, is obtained by merits, not merely by being alive.

sanskrit_iast:
lohajāṃ prakṛtiṃ bhavyāṃ kārayitvātmano nṛpa ..
abhīṣṭavāhanagatāmiṣṭālaṃkārasaṃyutām .. 3 ..
meaning:
लोहजां प्रकृतिं भव्यां कारयित्वात्मनो नृप ..
अभीष्टवाहनगतामिष्टालंकारसंयुताम् .. 3 ..

text_mt:
Or the man who hears it, or remembers it, or rejoices in the gift of a golden horse being given, / he too, his sins destroyed and his body purified, goes to the place frequented by the worlds of Purandara and Maheśvara.
The holy Kṛṣṇa said: / The holy Mahānavamī is the most excellent lunar day among lunar days; / it should be observed by all gods, and especially by rulers of subjects.
You should celebrate it, O Pārtha, for the happiness of the year, / and for the pleasure of ghosts, pretas, and piśācas, or as a festival.
Yudhiṣṭhira said: / From what time did this navamī bearing the word 'mahā' begin? / O Blessed One, was the rule of navamī introduced at the beginning?
Did this procession begin from the birth from Yaśodā's womb, / or did it already exist in the Kṛta, Tretā, and other yugas?
Since on this [day] some revere living beings and slaughter them, / what is the otherworldly destiny of those slaughtered creatures?
And what of those who kill them themselves, those who have them killed, and those who approve? / You ought first to resolve this doubt of mine, O Keśava.
