माया कात्यायनी दुर्गा चामुंडा शंकरप्रिया .. 8 ..
ध्यायंति यां योगरतां सा देवी परमेश्वरी ..
रूपभेदैर्नामभेदैर्भवानी पूज्यते शिवा..9..
अष्टम्यां तु नवम्यां तु देवदानवराक्षसैः..
गंधर्वैरुरगैर्यज्ञैः पूज्यते किन्नरैर्नरैः..10..
अन्येष्वपि युगेष्वादौ सृष्टेः पूर्वं प्रदर्शिता..
पूज्यतेयं पुरा देवी तेभ्यः पूर्वतरैः शुभैः..11..
आश्वयुक्शुक्लपक्षे च याष्टमी मूल संयुता ..
सा महानवमी नाम त्रैलोक्येऽपि सुदुर्लभा .. 12 ..
कन्यागते सवितरि शुक्लपक्षेऽष्टमी तु या ..
मूलनक्षत्रसंयुक्ता सा महानवमी स्मृता .. 13 ..
text_mt:
The holy Kṛṣṇa said: / O Pārtha, that supreme power which is endless, famed throughout the world, / primeval, all-pervading, pure, accessible through devotion, and enchanting,
is the first aṣṭamī, the digit, Kālī; the second is Sarvamaṅgalā, / Māyā, Kātyāyanī, Durgā, Cāmuṇḍā, beloved of Śaṅkara.
She whom those devoted to yoga meditate upon is the goddess Parameśvarī; / through different forms and different names, Bhavānī, Śivā, is worshipped.
On the aṣṭamī and on the navamī, she is worshipped by gods, dānavas, and rākṣasas, / by gandharvas, serpents, yakṣas, kinnaras, and men.
In other yugas as well, revealed at the beginning before creation, / this goddess was worshipped of old by the auspicious ones who came before them.
And in the bright fortnight of Āśvayuja, that aṣṭamī which is conjoined with Mūla / is called Mahānavamī, very difficult to obtain even in the three worlds.
When the sun has entered Virgo, that aṣṭamī in the bright fortnight / which is conjoined with the lunar mansion Mūla is known as Mahānavamī.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭamyāṃ ca navamyāṃ ca jaganmātaramambikām ..
pūjayitvā''śvine māsi viśoko jayati dviṣaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
अष्टम्यां च नवम्यां च जगन्मातरमम्बिकाम् ..
पूजयित्वा'ऽश्विने मासि विशोको जयति द्विषः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped the mother of the universe, Ambikā, on the aṣṭamī and on the navamī / in the month of Āśvina, one becomes free of sorrow and conquers one's enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtarjayaṃtī huṃkāraiḥ khaḍgādibhiraharniśam ..
navamyāṃ pūjitā devī dadāti navamaṃ phalam .. 15 ..
meaning:
संतर्जयंती हुंकारैः खड्गादिभिरहर्निशम् ..
नवम्यां पूजिता देवी ददाति नवमं फलम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: Terrifying [enemies] day and night with hum-cries and swords and other weapons, / the goddess, worshipped on the navamī, grants a fresh fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
sā puṇyā sā pavitrā ca sā dharmasukhadāyinī ..
tasmātsadā pūjanīyā cāmuṃḍā muṃḍamālinī .. 16 ..
meaning:
सा पुण्या सा पवित्रा च सा धर्मसुखदायिनी ..
तस्मात्सदा पूजनीया चामुंडा मुंडमालिनी .. 16 ..
text_mt: She is meritorious, she is purifying, she is the giver of virtue and happiness; / therefore, Cāmuṇḍā, garlanded with severed heads, should always be worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ yadyupayujyaṃte prāṇino mahiṣādayaḥ ..
sarve te svargatiṃ yāṃti ghnatāṃ pāpaṃ na vidyate .. 17 ..
meaning:
तस्यां यद्युपयुज्यंते प्राणिनो महिषादयः ..
सर्वे ते स्वर्गतिं यांति घ्नतां पापं न विद्यते .. 17 ..
text_mt: If on that [day] creatures such as buffaloes are employed [in sacrifice], / they all go to heaven, and no sin accrues to those who slaughter them.

sanskrit_iast:
na tathā balidānena puṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ ..
yathā saṃtuṣyate loke mahiṣairviṃdhyavāsinī .. 18 ..
meaning:
न तथा बलिदानेन पुष्पधूपविलेपनैः ..
यथा संतुष्यते लोके महिषैर्विंध्यवासिनी .. 18 ..
text_mt: Not by animal sacrifice, flowers, incense, or unguents / is Vindhyavāsinī so pleased in the world as she is with buffaloes.

sanskrit_iast:
uddiśya durgāṃ hanyaṃte vidhānādye'tra jaṃtavaḥ ..
svargaṃ te yāṃti kauṃteya ghātayaṃto'pi bhaktiḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
उद्दिश्य दुर्गां हन्यंते विधानाद्येऽत्र जंतवः ..
स्वर्गं ते यांति कौंतेय घातयंतोऽपि भक्तिः .. 19 ..
text_mt: Those creatures that are slain here in accordance with the rule in dedication to Durgā / go to heaven, O son of Kuntī, as do those who have them slain with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavānīprāṅgaṇe prāṇā yeṣāṃ yātā yudhiṣṭhira ..
teṣāṃ svarge dhruvaṃ vāso varāste'pyarasāṃ priyāḥ .. 20 ..
meaning:
भवानीप्राङ्गणे प्राणा येषां याता युधिष्ठिर ..
तेषां स्वर्गे ध्रुवं वासो वरास्तेऽप्यरसां प्रियाः .. 20 ..
text_mt: Those whose lives depart in the courtyard of Bhavānī, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / have their dwelling assured in heaven, and they become the beloved husbands of apsarases.

sanskrit_iast:
manvantareṣu sarveṣu kalpeṣu kurunadana ..
teṣu sarveṣu caivāsannavamīyaṃ purārcitā .. 21 ..
meaning:
मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु कल्पेषु कुरुनदन ..
तेषु सर्वेषु चैवासन्नवमीयं पुरार्चिता .. 21 ..
text_mt: In all the manvantaras and kalpas, O delight of the Kurus, / in all of them this navamī was worshipped of old.

sanskrit_iast:
prasiddhānādinidhanā varṣevarṣe yudhiṣṭhira ..
bhūyobhūyo'vatāraiśca bhavānīpūjya tesuraiḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
प्रसिद्धानादिनिधना वर्षेवर्षे युधिष्ठिर ..
भूयोभूयोऽवतारैश्च भवानीपूज्य तेसुरैः .. 22 ..
text_mt: Renowned, without beginning or end, year after year, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / through repeated incarnations, Bhavānī is worshipped by the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
avatīrṇā bhuvi sadā nityaṃ daityanibarhiṇī ..
svargapātālamartyeṣu karoti sthitipālanam .. 23 ..
meaning:
अवतीर्णा भुवि सदा नित्यं दैत्यनिबर्हिणी ..
स्वर्गपातालमर्त्येषु करोति स्थितिपालनम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Ever descended to the earth, constantly destroying the Daityas, / she maintains the preservation of the worlds in heaven, the netherworld, and the mortal realm.

sanskrit_iast:
punaścaiṣā mahādevī yaśodā garbhasaṃbhavā ..
kaṃsāsurasyottamāṅge pādaṃ dattvā gatāyuṣaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
पुनश्चैषा महादेवी यशोदा गर्भसंभवा ..
कंसासुरस्योत्तमाङ्गे पादं दत्त्वा गतायुषः .. 24 ..
text_mt: And once again this great goddess was born from the womb of Yaśodā, / placing her foot on the head of the asura Kaṃsa whose lifespan had expired.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabhṛti lokeṣu yaśodānaṃdadāyinīm ..
viṃdhyācale sthāpayitvā punaḥ pūjā pravartitā .. 25 ..
meaning:
ततः प्रभृति लोकेषु यशोदानंददायिनीम् ..
विंध्याचले स्थापयित्वा पुनः पूजा प्रवर्तिता .. 25 ..
text_mt: From then on, having established on the Vindhya mountain her who gives joy to Yaśodā, / her worship was once again set in motion throughout the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvapravṛddho'pi punarbhaginyā mahimā kṛtaḥ ..
bhuvi sarvopakārāya sarvopadravaśāṃtaye .. 26 ..
meaning:
पूर्वप्रवृद्धोऽपि पुनर्भगिन्या महिमा कृतः ..
भुवि सर्वोपकाराय सर्वोपद्रवशांतये .. 26 ..
text_mt: Though already flourishing from of old, the greatness of the sister was established once more / on earth for the benefit of all and for the pacification of all afflictions.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ viṃdhyopavāsinyā navarātropavāsinaḥ ..
ekarātreṇa naktena svaśaktyā'yācitena vā .. 27 ..
meaning:
एवं विंध्योपवासिन्या नवरात्रोपवासिनः ..
एकरात्रेण नक्तेन स्वशक्त्याऽयाचितेन वा .. 27 ..
text_mt: In this manner, by fasting during the Navarātra for Vindhyavāsinī, / or by a single night's fast, by a nocturnal meal, or by unasked-for food according to one's capacity,

sanskrit_iast:
yajanairyājanairdevāḥ sthānesthāne purepure ..
gṛhegṛhe bhaktipare rgrāmegrāme vanevane .. 28 ..
meaning:
यजनैर्याजनैर्देवाः स्थानेस्थाने पुरेपुरे ..
गृहेगृहे भक्तिपरे र्ग्रामेग्रामे वनेवने .. 28 ..
text_mt: with sacrifices and officiations, the gods [are worshipped] in every place, every city, / every house, devoted to piety, in every village, and in every forest,

sanskrit_iast:
snātaiḥ pramuditairhṛṣṭairbrāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairnṛpaiḥ ..
vaiśyaiḥ śūdrairbhakticitrairmlecchairanyaiśca mānavaiḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
स्नातैः प्रमुदितैर्हृष्टैर्ब्राह्मणैः क्षत्रियैर्नृपैः ..
वैश्यैः शूद्रैर्भक्तिचित्रैर्म्लेच्छैरन्यैश्च मानवैः .. 29 ..
text_mt: by Brahmins, Kṣatriyas, and kings, bathed, delighted, and joyful, / by Vaiśyas, Śūdras filled with devotion, Mlecchas, and other men,

sanskrit_iast:
strībhiśca kuruśārdūla tadvidhānamidaṃ śṛṇu ..
jayābhilāṣī nṛpatiḥ pratipatprabhṛtikramāt .. 30 ..
meaning:
स्त्रीभिश्च कुरुशार्दूल तद्विधानमिदं शृणु ..
जयाभिलाषी नृपतिः प्रतिपत्प्रभृतिक्रमात् .. 30 ..
text_mt: and by women, O tiger among the Kurus! Listen to this procedure for it: / A king desirous of victory, starting in sequence from the first lunar day,

sanskrit_iast:
lohābhihārikaṃ karma kārayedyāvadaṣṭami ..
prāgudakpravaṇe deśe patākābhiralaṃkṛtam .. 31 ..
meaning:
लोहाभिहारिकं कर्म कारयेद्यावदष्टमि ..
प्रागुदक्प्रवणे देशे पताकाभिरलंकृतम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: should have the iron-lustration rite performed up until the aṣṭamī. / In an area sloping towards the northeast, decorated with banners,

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍapaṃ kārayeddivyaṃ navasaptakaraṃ varam ..
āgneyyāṃ kārayetkuṇḍaṃ hastamātraṃ suśobhanam .. 32 ..
meaning:
मण्डपं कारयेद्दिव्यं नवसप्तकरं वरम् ..
आग्नेय्यां कारयेत्कुण्डं हस्तमात्रं सुशोभनम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: he should have an excellent, splendid pavilion constructed, nine cubits by seven. / In the south-east he should have a sacrificial pit made, measuring a cubit, very beautiful,

sanskrit_iast:
mekhalātrayasaṃ yuktaṃ yonyaśvatthadalābhayā ..
rājacihnāni sarvāṇi śastrāṇyastrāṇi yāni ca .. 33 ..
meaning:
मेखलात्रयसं युक्तं योन्यश्वत्थदलाभया ..
राजचिह्नानि सर्वाणि शस्त्राण्यस्त्राणि यानि च .. 33 ..
text_mt: furnished with three step-tiers, having a vulva-spout shaped like a leaf of the sacred fig tree. / All the insignia of royalty, and whatever weapons and missiles there are,

sanskrit_iast:
ānīya maṇḍape tāni sarvāṇyevādhivāsayet ..
tatastu brāhmaṇaḥ snātaḥ śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuciḥ.. 34 ..
meaning:
आनीय मण्डपे तानि सर्वाण्येवाधिवासयेत् ..
ततस्तु ब्राह्मणः स्नातः शुक्लांबरधरः शुचिः.. 34 ..
text_mt: having brought them into the pavilion, he should consecratedly seat them all. / Then a Brahmin, bathed, wearing white garments, pure,

sanskrit_iast:
oṃkārapūrvakairmantraistalliṃgairjuhuyādghṛtam..
lohanāmābhavatpūrvaṃ dānavastu mahābalaḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
ओंकारपूर्वकैर्मन्त्रैस्तल्लिंगैर्जुहुयाद्घृतम्..
लोहनामाभवत्पूर्वं दानवस्तु महाबलः .. 35 ..
text_mt: should offer clarified butter with mantras preceded by Om and bearing their respective marks. / Formerly there was a Danava named Loha of great strength;

sanskrit_iast:
sa devaiḥ samare kruddhairbahudhā śakalīkṛtaḥ ..
tadaṃgasambhavaṃ lohaṃ yatsarvaṃdṛśyate kṣitau .. 36 ..
meaning:
स देवैः समरे क्रुद्धैर्बहुधा शकलीकृतः ..
तदंगसम्भवं लोहं यत्सर्वंदृश्यते क्षितौ .. 36 ..
text_mt: he was hacked into many pieces by the enraged gods in battle. / From his body arose all the iron that is seen upon the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
śastrāstramantrairhotavyaṃ pāyasaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutam ..
hutaśeṣaṃ turaṃgāṇāṃ gajānāmupahārayet .. 37 ..
meaning:
शस्त्रास्त्रमन्त्रैर्होतव्यं पायसं घृतसंयुतम् ..
हुतशेषं तुरंगाणां गजानामुपहारयेत् .. 37 ..
text_mt: One should offer into the fire milk-rice mixed with clarified butter, accompanied by mantras for weapons and missiles; / the remainder of the offering he should present to the horses and elephants.

sanskrit_iast:
lohābhihārikaṃ karma tenaitadṛṣibhiḥ smṛtam ..
baddhapratiśaravyaṃ ca gajāśvasamalaṃkṛtam .. 38 ..
meaning:
लोहाभिहारिकं कर्म तेनैतदृषिभिः स्मृतम् ..
बद्धप्रतिशरव्यं च गजाश्वसमलंकृतम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: Therefore this has been declared by the sages as the iron-lustration rite. / Having mounted a dummy target, adorned with elephants and horses,

sanskrit_iast:
bhrāmayennagare nityaṃ naṃdi ghoṣapurassaram..
pratyahaṃ nṛpatiḥ snātvā saṃpūjya pitṛdevatāḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
भ्रामयेन्नगरे नित्यं नंदि घोषपुरस्सरम्..
प्रत्यहं नृपतिः स्नात्वा संपूज्य पितृदेवताः .. 39 ..
text_mt: he should process through the city daily, preceded by joyful sounding. / Daily the king, having bathed and worshipped the ancestors and deities,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedrājacihnāni phalamālyānulepanaiḥ ..
hutaśeṣaṃ pradātavyamaupanāyanike dvije .. 40 ..
meaning:
पूजयेद्राजचिह्नानि फलमाल्यानुलेपनैः ..
हुतशेषं प्रदातव्यमौपनायनिके द्विजे .. 40 ..
text_mt: should worship the insignia of royalty with fruits, garlands, and ointments. / The remainder of the offering should be given to an initiated twice-born Brahmin;

sanskrit_iast:
tasyābhiharaṇādrājño vijayaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ ..
pūjāmaṃtrānpravakṣyāmi purāṇoktānahaṃ tava .. 41 ..
meaning:
तस्याभिहरणाद्राज्ञो विजयः समुदाहृतः ..
पूजामंत्रान्प्रवक्ष्यामि पुराणोक्तानहं तव .. 41 ..
text_mt: by its presentation, victory for the king is proclaimed. / I shall declare to you the mantras for worship proclaimed in the Purāṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
yaiḥ pūjitāḥ prayacchanti kīrtimāyu ryaśobalama..
yathāṃbudaśchādayati śivāyemāṃ vasundharām .. 42 ..
meaning:
यैः पूजिताः प्रयच्छन्ति कीर्तिमायु र्यशोबलम..
यथांबुदश्छादयति शिवायेमां वसुन्धराम् .. 42 ..
text_mt: worshipped with which they bestow renown, long life, fame, and strength: / 'Just as the cloud covers this earth for its welfare,

sanskrit_iast:
tathācchādaya rājānaṃ vijayārogyavṛddhaye .. ( iti chatramantraḥ) ..
gandharva kulajātastvaṃ mābhūyāḥ kuladūṣakaḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
तथाच्छादय राजानं विजयारोग्यवृद्धये .. ( इति छत्रमन्त्रः) ..
गन्धर्व कुलजातस्त्वं माभूयाः कुलदूषकः .. 43 ..
text_mt: so cover the king for the increase of victory and health.' (Thus the royal parasol mantra.) / 'You are born from the lineage of the Gandharvas; do not become a disgrace to your race!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇaḥ satyavākyena somasya varuṇasya ca ..
prabhāvāñca hutāśasya varddhasva tvaṃ turaṃgama .. 44 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मणः सत्यवाक्येन सोमस्य वरुणस्य च ..
प्रभावाञ्च हुताशस्य वर्द्धस्व त्वं तुरंगम .. 44 ..
text_mt: By the truthful word of Brahmā, of Soma, and of Varuṇa, / and by the power of the Fire-god, may you thrive, O horse!

sanskrit_iast:
tejasā caiva sūryasya munīnāṃ tapasā yathā ..
rudrasya brahmacaryeṇa pavanasya valena ca.. smṛ ..
smara tvaṃ rājaputro'si kaustubhaṃ ca maṇiṃ smara ..
yāṃ gatiṃ brahmahā gacchetpitṛhā mātṛhā tathā .. 46 ..
meaning:
तेजसा चैव सूर्यस्य मुनीनां तपसा यथा ..
रुद्रस्य ब्रह्मचर्येण पवनस्य वलेन च.. स्मृ ..
स्मर त्वं राजपुत्रोऽसि कौस्तुभं च मणिं स्मर ..
यां गतिं ब्रह्महा गच्छेत्पितृहा मातृहा तथा .. 46 ..
text_mt: Just as by the splendour of the Sun, the asceticism of the sages, / the celibacy of Rudra, and the strength of the Wind— / remember: you are a prince! Remember the Kaustubha jewel! / Whatever destination a killer of a Brahmin reaches, or a killer of a father or mother,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmyarthenṛtavādī ca kṣatriyaśca parāṅmukhaḥ ..
sūryācandramasau vāyuḥ pāvakaśca na yatra vai .. 47..
meaning:
भूम्यर्थेनृतवादी च क्षत्रियश्च पराङ्मुखः ..
सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ वायुः पावकश्च न यत्र वै .. 47..
text_mt: or a liar for the sake of land, or a Kṣatriya who turns his back in flight— / where there is neither sun nor moon, neither wind nor fire—

sanskrit_iast:
vrajecca tāṃ gatiṃ kṣipraṃ tacca pāpaṃ bhavetkila ..
vikṛtiṃ yadi gacchestvaṃ yuddhedhvani turaṃgama ..
ripūnvijitya samare saha bhartrā sukhī bhava .. 48 .... .. ( ityaśvamaṃtraḥ) .. ..
meaning:
व्रजेच्च तां गतिं क्षिप्रं तच्च पापं भवेत्किल ..
विकृतिं यदि गच्छेस्त्वं युद्धेध्वनि तुरंगम ..
रिपून्विजित्य समरे सह भर्त्रा सुखी भव .. 48 .... .. ( इत्यश्वमंत्रः) .. ..
text_mt: may you swiftly go to that destination, and indeed may that sin be yours, / if you should falter in battle or on the march, O horse! / Having conquered your enemies in battle, be happy together with your master!' (Thus the horse mantra.)

sanskrit_iast:
śakraketo mahāvīrya suparṇastvayyupasthitaḥ ..
patatrirāḍvainateyastathā nārāyaṇadhvajaḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
शक्रकेतो महावीर्य सुपर्णस्त्वय्युपस्थितः ..
पतत्रिराड्वैनतेयस्तथा नारायणध्वजः .. 49 ..
text_mt: 'O banner of Indra of great heroism! The fair-winged Garuḍa is present upon you, / the king of birds, son of Vinatā, and the emblem of Nārāyaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
kāśyapeyo'mṛto jñeyo nāgārirviṣṇuvāhanaḥ ..
aprameyo durādharṣo devaśatruniṣūdanaḥ .. 50 ..
meaning:
काश्यपेयोऽमृतो ज्ञेयो नागारिर्विष्णुवाहनः ..
अप्रमेयो दुराधर्षो देवशत्रुनिषूदनः .. 50 ..
text_mt: son of Kaśyapa, known as immortal, enemy of serpents, vehicle of Viṣṇu, / immeasurable, invincible, slayer of the gods' enemies,

sanskrit_iast:
garutmānmārutagatistvayi sannihitaḥ sthitaḥ ..
śastravarmāyudhānyodhānrakṣāsmāṃśca ripūndaha .. 51 .. .. (iti dhvajamaṃtraḥ) .. ..
meaning:
गरुत्मान्मारुतगतिस्त्वयि सन्निहितः स्थितः ..
शस्त्रवर्मायुधान्योधान्रक्षास्मांश्च रिपून्दह .. 51 .. .. (इति ध्वजमंत्रः) .. ..
text_mt: Garuḍa, swift as the wind, stands close at hand within you. / Protect our weapons, armour, arms, and warriors, and burn our enemies!' (Thus the banner mantra.)

sanskrit_iast:
kumudairāvaṇau padmaḥ puṣpadaṃto'tha vāmanaḥ ..
supratīkoñjano nīla ete'ṣṭau devayonayaḥ .... 52 ..
meaning:
कुमुदैरावणौ पद्मः पुष्पदंतोऽथ वामनः ..
सुप्रतीकोञ्जनो नील एतेऽष्टौ देवयोनयः .... 52 ..
text_mt: 'Kumuda, Airāvaṇa, Padma, Puṣpadanta, then Vāmana, / Supratīka, Añjana, and Nīla—these eight are of divine origin;

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣāṃ putrapautrāśca balānyaṣṭau samāśritāḥ ..
bhadro mandro mṛgaścaiva gajaḥ saṃkīrṇa eva ca ..
vanevane prasūtāste kariyoniṃ mahāgajāḥ..53..
meaning:
एतेषां पुत्रपौत्राश्च बलान्यष्टौ समाश्रिताः ..
भद्रो मन्द्रो मृगश्चैव गजः संकीर्ण एव च ..
वनेवने प्रसूतास्ते करियोनिं महागजाः..53..
text_mt: and their sons and grandsons have resorted to eight armies. / Bhadra, Mandra, Mṛga, and Saṃkīrṇa elephants— / those great elephants born in every forest have attained the elephant species.

sanskrit_iast:
pātu tvāṃ vasavo rudrā ādityāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ ..
bhartāraṃ rakṣa nāgendra samayaṃ pratipālayan .. 54 ..
meaning:
पातु त्वां वसवो रुद्रा आदित्याः समरुद्गणाः ..
भर्तारं रक्ष नागेन्द्र समयं प्रतिपालयन् .. 54 ..
text_mt: May the Vasus, Rudras, and Ādityas along with the hosts of Maruts protect you! / Protect your master, O lord of elephants, keeping your covenant!

sanskrit_iast:
avāpurhi jayaṃ yuddhe gamane svasti no vraja ..
śrīste somādbalaṃ viṣṇostejaḥ sūryājjavonilāt ..
sthairyaṃ merorjayaṃ rudrādyaśo devātpuraṃdarāt .. 55 ..
meaning:
अवापुर्हि जयं युद्धे गमने स्वस्ति नो व्रज ..
श्रीस्ते सोमाद्बलं विष्णोस्तेजः सूर्याज्जवोनिलात् ..
स्थैर्यं मेरोर्जयं रुद्राद्यशो देवात्पुरंदरात् .. 55 ..
text_mt: They indeed attained victory in battle; advance for our well-being on the march! / May your splendour come from Soma, strength from Viṣṇu, radiance from the Sun, speed from the Wind,

sanskrit_iast:
yuddhe rakṣaṃtu nāgāstvāṃ diśaśca saha daivataiḥ ..
aśvinau saha gaṃdharvaiḥ pāṃtu tvāṃ sarvataḥ sadā .. 56 .. ( iti hastimaṃtraḥ ..)
meaning:
युद्धे रक्षंतु नागास्त्वां दिशश्च सह दैवतैः ..
अश्विनौ सह गंधर्वैः पांतु त्वां सर्वतः सदा .. 56 .. ( इति हस्तिमंत्रः ..)
text_mt: steadfastness from Meru, victory from Rudra, and glory from the god Indra! / In battle may the serpents protect you, and the directions along with the deities; / may the Aśvins along with the Gandharvas protect you everywhere, always!' (Thus the elephant mantra.)

sanskrit_iast:
hutabhugvasavo rudrā vāyuḥ somo maharṣayaḥ ..
nāgakinnaragandharvayakṣa bhūtagaṇāgrahāḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
हुतभुग्वसवो रुद्रा वायुः सोमो महर्षयः ..
नागकिन्नरगन्धर्वयक्ष भूतगणाग्रहाः .. 57 ..
text_mt: 'The Fire-god, Vasus, Rudras, Wind, Soma, and the great sages, / the hosts of serpents, Kinnaras, Gandharvas, Yakṣas, and ghosts, and the planets,

sanskrit_iast:
pramathāśca sahādityairbhūteśo mātṛbhiḥ saha ..
śakrasenāpatiḥ skando varuṇaścāśritāstvayi .. 58 ..
meaning:
प्रमथाश्च सहादित्यैर्भूतेशो मातृभिः सह ..
शक्रसेनापतिः स्कन्दो वरुणश्चाश्रितास्त्वयि .. 58 ..
text_mt: the Pramathas along with the Ādityas, the Lord of ghosts along with the Mothers, / Skanda the commander of Indra's army, and Varuṇa are situated in you.

sanskrit_iast:
pradahaṃtu ripūnsarvānrājā vijayamṛcchatu ..
yāni prayuktānyaribhirdūṣaṇāni samaṃtataḥ .. 59 ..
meaning:
प्रदहंतु रिपून्सर्वान्राजा विजयमृच्छतु ..
यानि प्रयुक्तान्यरिभिर्दूषणानि समंततः .. 59 ..
text_mt: May they burn all enemies; may the king attain victory! / Whatever harms have been employed on every side by the foes,

sanskrit_iast:
etāni paraśatrūṇāṃ hatāni tava tejasā ..
kālanemivadhe yuddhe yuddhe tripuraghātane .. 60 ..
meaning:
एतानि परशत्रूणां हतानि तव तेजसा ..
कालनेमिवधे युद्धे युद्धे त्रिपुरघातने .. 60 ..
text_mt: may these of the external enemies be destroyed by your splendour! / In the battle for the slaying of Kālanemi, in the battle for the destruction of Tripura,

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyakaśiporyuddhe yuddhe devāsure tathā ..
śobhitāsi tathaivādya śobhamānāstu bhūpateḥ .. 61 ..
meaning:
हिरण्यकशिपोर्युद्धे युद्धे देवासुरे तथा ..
शोभितासि तथैवाद्य शोभमानास्तु भूपतेः .. 61 ..
text_mt: in the battle with Hiraṇyakaśipu, and likewise in the war between the gods and asuras, / you shone; even so, today, shine for the king!

sanskrit_iast:
nīlāṃ śvetāmimāṃ dṛṣṭvā naśyaṃtvadya nṛpārayaḥ ..
vyādhibhirvividhairghoraiḥ śastraiśca yudhi nirjitāḥ .. 62 ..
meaning:
नीलां श्वेतामिमां दृष्ट्वा नश्यंत्वद्य नृपारयः ..
व्याधिभिर्विविधैर्घोरैः शस्त्रैश्च युधि निर्जिताः .. 62 ..
text_mt: Having seen this dark and white [standard], may the king's enemies perish today, / vanquished in battle by terrible, manifold diseases and by weapons!

sanskrit_iast: sadyaḥ svasthā bhavaṃti sma tvadvātenāpamārjitāḥ .. 63 ..
meaning: सद्यः स्वस्था भवंति स्म त्वद्वातेनापमार्जिताः .. 63 ..
text_mt: They became well at once, swept over by your breeze. 63.

sanskrit_iast:
pūtanā revatī nāmnā kālarātrīti yā smṛtā ..
dahaṃtvāśu ripūnsarvānpatāke tvāmupāgatāḥ .. 64 .. (iti patākāmantraḥ ..)
meaning:
पूतना रेवती नाम्ना कालरात्रीति या स्मृता ..
दहंत्वाशु रिपून्सर्वान्पताके त्वामुपागताः .. 64 .. (इति पताकामन्त्रः ..)
text_mt: Pūtanā, Revatī by name, and she who is remembered as Kālarātrī— / having approached you, O standard, may they swiftly burn all enemies!' (Thus the standard mantra.)

sanskrit_iast:
asiśca ripuhā khaḍgastīkṣṇakarmā durāsadaḥ ..
śrīgarbho vijayaścaiva dharmadhārastathaiva ca .. 69 ..
meaning:
असिश्च रिपुहा खड्गस्तीक्ष्णकर्मा दुरासदः ..
श्रीगर्भो विजयश्चैव धर्मधारस्तथैव च .. 69 ..
text_mt: 'You are the blade, the slayer of enemies, the sword, sharp in deed, hard to approach, / the womb of fortune, victory, and the bearer of righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
ityaṣṭau tava nāmāni svayamuktāni vedhasā ..
nakṣatraṃ kṛttikā tubhyaṃ gururdevo maheśvaraḥ .. 66 ..
meaning:
इत्यष्टौ तव नामानि स्वयमुक्तानि वेधसा ..
नक्षत्रं कृत्तिका तुभ्यं गुरुर्देवो महेश्वरः .. 66 ..
text_mt: Thus these eight names of yours were spoken by the Creator Himself. / Your constellation is Kṛttikā, your preceptor the god Maheśvara;

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyaṃ ca śarīraṃte dhātā devojanārdanaḥ ..
pitā pitāmaho devastvaṃ māṃ pālaya sarvadā .. 67 .. (iti khaḍgamantraḥ ..)
meaning:
हिरण्यं च शरीरंते धाता देवोजनार्दनः ..
पिता पितामहो देवस्त्वं मां पालय सर्वदा .. 67 .. (इति खड्गमन्त्रः ..)
text_mt: gold is your body, and your ordainer is the god Janārdana; / you are father and grandfather, a deity; protect me always!' (Thus the sword mantra.)

sanskrit_iast:
śarmapradastvaṃ samare varma sarvāyaso hyasi ..
rakṣa māṃ rakṣaṇīyo'haṃ tava varmannamo'stu te .. 68 .. ( iti varmamantraḥ ..) ..
meaning:
शर्मप्रदस्त्वं समरे वर्म सर्वायसो ह्यसि ..
रक्ष मां रक्षणीयोऽहं तव वर्मन्नमोऽस्तु ते .. 68 .. ( इति वर्ममन्त्रः ..) ..
text_mt: 'You are the granter of well-being in battle, armour entirely made of iron; / protect me, for I am to be protected by you; O armour, salutations to you!' (Thus the armour mantra.)

sanskrit_iast:
dundubhe tvaṃ sapatnānāṃ .ghoṣāddhṛdayakampan ..
bhava bhūmipa sainyānāṃ tathā vijayavarddhanaḥ .. 69 ..
meaning:
दुन्दुभे त्वं सपत्नानां .घोषाद्धृदयकम्पन् ..
भव भूमिप सैन्यानां तथा विजयवर्द्धनः .. 69 ..
text_mt: O war drum, by your sound you make the hearts of adversaries tremble; / likewise, be the enhancer of victory for the armies of the king.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā jīmūtaghoṣeṇa hṛṣyaṃti varavāraṇāḥ ..
tathāstu tava śabdena harṣo'smākaṃ mudāvahaḥ ..70..
meaning:
यथा जीमूतघोषेण हृष्यंति वरवारणाः ..
तथास्तु तव शब्देन हर्षोऽस्माकं मुदावहः ..70..
text_mt: Just as the best of elephants rejoice at the roar of rainclouds, / so may your sound bring us joy that carries delight.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā jīmūtaśabdena strīṇāṃ trāso'bhijāyate ..
tathā ca tava śabdena trasyaṃtvasmaddviṣo raṇe..71..( iti duṃdubhimaṃtraḥ ..)
meaning:
यथा जीमूतशब्देन स्त्रीणां त्रासोऽभिजायते ..
तथा च तव शब्देन त्रस्यंत्वस्मद्द्विषो रणे..71..( इति दुंदुभिमंत्रः ..)
text_mt: Just as terror arises in women at the sound of rainclouds, / even so may our enemies tremble in battle at your sound. (Thus the mantra for the war drum.)

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāyudha mahāmātra sarvadevārisūdana ..
cāpa māṃ sarvadā rakṣa sākaṃ sāyakasattamaiḥ .. 72.. ( iti cāpamantraḥ..)
meaning:
सर्वायुध महामात्र सर्वदेवारिसूदन ..
चाप मां सर्वदा रक्ष साकं सायकसत्तमैः .. 72.. ( इति चापमन्त्रः..)
text_mt: O commander of all weapons, slayer of all enemies of the gods, / O bow, protect me at all times along with the best of arrows. (Thus the mantra for the bow.)

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyastvaṃ śaṅkha puṣpāṇāṃ maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam ..
viṣṇunā vidhṛto nityaṃ manaḥśāṃtiprado bhava .. 73 .. ( iti śaṅkhamantraḥ ..)
meaning:
पुण्यस्त्वं शङ्ख पुष्पाणां मङ्गलानां च मङ्गलम् ..
विष्णुना विधृतो नित्यं मनःशांतिप्रदो भव .. 73 .. ( इति शङ्खमन्त्रः ..)
text_mt: You are holy, O conch, among flowers, and the most auspicious of auspicious things; / constantly held by Viṣṇu, be the bestower of peace of mind. (Thus the mantra for the conch.)

sanskrit_iast:
śaśāṃkakarasaṃkāśa hima ḍiṃḍīrapāṃḍura ..
protsārayāśu duritaṃ cāmarāmaravallabha .. 74 .. ( iti cāmaramaṃtraḥ ..)
meaning:
शशांककरसंकाश हिम डिंडीरपांडुर ..
प्रोत्सारयाशु दुरितं चामरामरवल्लभ .. 74 .. ( इति चामरमंत्रः ..)
text_mt: Resembling moonbeams, white as snow and foam, / quickly drive away misfortune, O chowrie, beloved of the immortals. (Thus the mantra for the chowrie.)

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāyudhānāṃ prathamā nirmitā'si pinākinā ..
śūlāyudhādviniṣkṛṣya kṛtvā muṣṭiparigraham .. 75 ..
meaning:
सर्वायुधानां प्रथमा निर्मिताऽसि पिनाकिना ..
शूलायुधाद्विनिष्कृष्य कृत्वा मुष्टिपरिग्रहम् .. 75 ..
text_mt: You were created as the foremost of all weapons by Pinākin, / drawing [you] out from the spear weapon and forming a hilt for the fist.

sanskrit_iast:
caṃḍikāyāḥ pradattāsi sarvaduṣṭanibarhiṇi ..
tathā vistāritā cāsi devānāṃ pratipāditā .. 76 ..
meaning:
चंडिकायाः प्रदत्तासि सर्वदुष्टनिबर्हिणि ..
तथा विस्तारिता चासि देवानां प्रतिपादिता .. 76 ..
text_mt: You were given to Caṇḍikā, O slayer of all the wicked; / likewise you were multiplied and presented to the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
sarva sattvāṃgabhūtāsi sarvāśubhanivāriṇi ..
churike rakṣa māṃ nityaṃ śāntiṃ yaccha namo'stu te .. 77 .. ( iticchūrikāmaṃtraḥ ..)
meaning:
सर्व सत्त्वांगभूतासि सर्वाशुभनिवारिणि ..
छुरिके रक्ष मां नित्यं शान्तिं यच्छ नमोऽस्तु ते .. 77 .. ( इतिच्छूरिकामंत्रः ..)
text_mt: You have become a part of the bodies of all beings, / O dispeller of all inauspiciousness! / O dagger, protect me perpetually and grant peace! Homage to you! 77. (Thus the dagger mantra.)

sanskrit_iast:
protsāraṇāya duṣṭānāṃ sādhusaṃgrahaṇāya ca ..
brahmaṇā nirmitaścāsi vyavahāraprasiddhaye ..78..
meaning:
प्रोत्सारणाय दुष्टानां साधुसंग्रहणाय च ..
ब्रह्मणा निर्मितश्चासि व्यवहारप्रसिद्धये ..78..
text_mt: For driving away the wicked and gathering the virtuous, / you were created by Brahmā for the accomplishment of lawful governance.

sanskrit_iast:
yaśo dehi sukhaṃ dehi jagado bhava bhūpateḥ ..
tāḍayāśu ripūnsarvānhemadaṃḍa namostu te .. 79 .. ( iti kanakadaṇḍamantraḥ ..)
meaning:
यशो देहि सुखं देहि जगदो भव भूपतेः ..
ताडयाशु रिपून्सर्वान्हेमदंड नमोस्तु ते .. 79 .. ( इति कनकदण्डमन्त्रः ..)
text_mt: Grant fame, grant happiness, be the protector of the king; / strike down all foes quickly, O golden sceptre, homage to you. (Thus the mantra for the golden sceptre.)

sanskrit_iast:
vijayo jayado jetā ripughātī priyaṃkaraḥ ..
duḥkhahā dharmadaḥ śāṃtaḥ sarvāriṣṭavināśanaḥ ..80..
meaning:
विजयो जयदो जेता रिपुघाती प्रियंकरः ..
दुःखहा धर्मदः शांतः सर्वारिष्टविनाशनः ..80..
text_mt: Vijaya, Jayada, Jetṛ, Ripughātin, Priyaṃkara, / Duḥkhahan, Dharmada, Śānta, and the destroyer of all calamities—

sanskrit_iast:
ete'ṣṭausaṃnidhau yasmāttava siṃhā mahābalāḥ...
tena siṃhāsaneti tvaṃ viprairvedeṣu gīyase ..81..
meaning:
एतेऽष्टौसंनिधौ यस्मात्तव सिंहा महाबलाः...
तेन सिंहासनेति त्वं विप्रैर्वेदेषु गीयसे ..81..
text_mt: Because these eight mighty lions reside in your presence, / therefore you are praised as 'throne' by the brahmins in the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayi sthitaḥ śivaḥ sākṣāttvayi śakraḥ sureśvaraḥ..
tvayi sthito harirdevastvadarthaṃ tapyate tapaḥ .. 82 ..
meaning:
त्वयि स्थितः शिवः साक्षात्त्वयि शक्रः सुरेश्वरः..
त्वयि स्थितो हरिर्देवस्त्वदर्थं तप्यते तपः .. 82 ..
text_mt: In you dwells Śiva visibly; in you dwells Śakra, lord of the gods; / in you dwells Lord Hari; for your sake asceticism is performed.

sanskrit_iast:
namaste sarvato bhadra bhadrado bhava bhūpateḥ ..
trailokyajayasarvasva siṃhāsana namo'stu te .. 83 .. ( iti siṃhāsanamaṃtraḥ ..)
meaning:
नमस्ते सर्वतो भद्र भद्रदो भव भूपतेः ..

text_mt:
(Now the prose passage:)
Having made an image of Durgā—golden, silver, brass, wooden, painted, or copper—according to his means, placed beneath a wondrous wooden arch in a beautiful spot, with her gaze directed forward, stationed in the middle of a splendid house, bathed, her limbs smeared with saffron, sandalwood paste, fragrant mixtures of four scents, and fine silken cloth, the king, accompanied by many twice-born men whose fame is flourishing and who are brought satisfaction, should himself, along with the royal priests, present worship to the Goddess with bilva leaves and flowers by day with this mantra: (End of the prose passage)
Jayantī, Maṅgalā, Kālī, Bhadrakālī, Kapālinī, / Durgā, Śivā, Kṣamā, Dhātrī, Svāhā, Svadhā, homage to you.

text_mt: Then, having bowed to the sword, the crusher of the pride of enemies, / the king should desire his own victory, kingdom, and abundance of food.

महिषघ्रीं बहुभुजां कुमारीं सिंहवाहिनीम् .. 90 ..
text_mt: Having bowed again and again, he should then meditate in his heart on Śivā, / the slayer of Mahiṣa, many-armed, a maiden, riding a lion,

meaning:

text_mt:
May my sins along with obstacles be pacified; may my adversaries be quieted; / may the ghosts and pretas be gentle, satisfied, and bringers of happiness.'
In this manner he should process Goddess Durgā through the realm, standing on a chariot / or in a palanquin, O son of Pṛthā, and then bring it to a close without obstacles.
Now, if obstacles arise, one should perform the pacification of ghosts, / whereby obstacles do not arise, and the procession attains completion.
Thus, the kings and other men who perform the procession / on Mahānavamī, the joyful day, with cheerful minds, [having obtained] sons,
all of them, freed from sin, go to the city of the Lord.

bhavānutthāpayetpārtha saṃvatsarasukhāya vai ..

.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..

text_mt:
Having worshipped on the navamī Durgā, who stands upon the back of Mahiṣāsura pierced by the tip of her trident, / whose arm-staffs bear armlets gleaming with unsheathed swords, and who is attended by the five-faced [Śiva], mortals cross over impassable difficulties.
The Blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / The holy Mahānavamī is the foremost lunar day among lunar days; / it should be observed by all gods, and especially by rulers of people.
O son of Pṛthā, you should celebrate it indeed for happiness throughout the year, / or for the delight of ghosts, pretas, and piśācas, and as a festival.
Yudhiṣṭhira said: / From what time did this navamī, joined with the word "mahā", begin? / O Blessed One, was the rite of the navamī established at the very beginning?
Does this procession proceed from her birth in the womb of Yaśodā, / or was it already present formerly, in the Kṛta, Tretā, and other yugas?
Since on this [day] some people intend [offerings] and slay living beings, / what is the fate in the next world for those slain beings,
and for those who themselves kill, who cause [others] to kill, and who approve [of it]? / You ought first to explain this doubt of mine, O Keśava.

text_mt:
The Blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / O son of Pṛthā, she who is the supreme Power, infinite, world-renowned, / the primordial, all-pervading, pure, accessible through devotion, and captivating;
the primordial eighth, the digit Kālī, the second, Sarvamaṅgalā, / Māyā, Kātyāyanī, Durgā, Cāmuṇḍā, beloved of Śaṅkara;
that Goddess, Parameśvarī, upon whom those devoted to yoga meditate— / as Bhavānī, Śivā, she is worshipped through various forms and various names.
On the aṣṭamī and on the navamī, by gods, dānavas, and rākṣasas, / by gandharvas, serpents, yajñas, kinnaras, and men she is worshipped.
Even in other yugas, shown at the beginning before creation, / this Goddess was worshipped in ancient times by auspicious beings even earlier than they.
And in the bright fortnight of Āśvayuja, the aṣṭamī that is conjoined with Mūla / is called Mahānavamī, very difficult to attain even in the three worlds.
When the sun has entered Virgo, the aṣṭamī in the bright fortnight / that is conjoined with the asterism Mūla is traditionally regarded as Mahānavamī.

text_mt:
Having worshipped the Mother of the World, Ambikā, on the aṣṭamī and navamī / in the month of Āśvina, one conquers enemies, free from sorrow.
Menacing day and night with hum-cries and swords and other [weapons], / the Goddess, worshipped on the navamī, grants a fresh reward.
She is meritorious, she is pure, she is the giver of virtue and happiness; / therefore, Cāmuṇḍā, adorned with a garland of heads, should always be worshipped.
If on that [day] creatures such as buffaloes are sacrificed, / they all attain heaven, and no sin accrues to those who kill them.
Vindhyavāsinī is not so pleased in the world by animal sacrifice, / nor by flowers, incense, and ointments, as she is by buffaloes.
The creatures that are slain here according to the prescribed rule, dedicated to Durgā, / go to heaven, O son of Kuntī, and those who cause them to be slain with devotion [reap merit].
Those whose lives depart in the courtyard of Bhavānī, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / have a permanent dwelling in heaven; they become best among men, dear to the apsarases.

text_mt:
In all the manvantaras and kalpas, O delight of the Kurus, / in all of them, this navamī was worshipped in ancient times.
Celebrated, without beginning or end, year after year, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / through repeated incarnations Bhavānī is worshipped by the gods.
Always descended to the earth, the perpetual slayer of daityas, / she maintains order in heaven, the netherworld, and the mortal realm.
And again, this Great Goddess, born from the womb of Yaśodā, / placed her foot on the head of the demon Kaṃsa, whose life had run out.
From that time forward, having established on Mount Vindhya / her who brought joy to Yaśodā, her worship was initiated anew in the worlds.
Though already flourishing earlier, the majesty of my sister was manifested once more / on earth for the welfare of all and for the pacification of all afflictions.
Thus, fasting for the Navarātra of Vindhyavāsinī, / or with a one-night fast, or a nocturnal meal, according to one's capability, or with unsolicited food,
the gods [are worshipped] with sacrifices and priestly services in every place, in every city, / in every house, by those intent on devotion, in every village, in every forest,

by bathed, cheerful, and glad brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, kings, / vaiśyas, and śūdras, with varied devotions, by mlecchas and other men,
and by women, O bull of the Kurus; hear now this procedure for it: / A king desirous of victory, starting from the first day [of the fortnight] in regular succession,
should cause the iron-lustration rite to be performed up to the aṣṭamī. / In a place sloping to the north-east, decorated with flags,
he should cause an excellent celestial pavilion to be built, measuring nine by seven cubits; / in the south-east he should cause a sacrificial pit to be made, measuring a cubit, very beautiful,
endowed with three girdles, having a yoni shaped like an aśvattha leaf. / All the insignia of royalty, and whatever weapons and missiles there are,
having brought them to the pavilion, he should consecrate them all. / Then a brāhmaṇa, bathed, wearing white garments, pure,
should offer clarified butter with mantras preceded by the syllable Oṃ and bearing their characteristic marks. (35cd)
Formerly there was an exceedingly powerful dānava named Loha. (36ab)

he was hacked to pieces in various ways by the enraged gods in battle; / all the iron that is seen on earth originated from his body.
An oblation of milk-rice mixed with ghee should be offered with the mantras for weapons and missiles; / the remainder of the oblation should be presented to the horses and elephants.
Therefore, this is remembered by the sages as the iron-lustration rite; / targets are set up, and it is adorned with elephants and horses.
he should parade [them] daily around the city, preceded by joyful cries.
Every day, having bathed and worshipped the ancestors and deities,
the king should worship the insignia of royalty with fruits, garlands, and ointments.
The remainder of the offering should be given to an initiated twice-born [brahmin].
Victory is proclaimed for the king from its presentation.
I will tell you the worship mantras taught in the Purāṇas,
worshipped with which, they bestow fame, long life, renown, and strength.
Just as a cloud covers this earth for its welfare,

By the true word of Brahmā, of Soma, and of Varuṇa,

by the celibacy of Rudra, and by the strength of the Wind,

if you should become recalcitrant in battle on the march, O horse!
Conquering the enemies in battle, be happy together with your master! (Thus the horse mantra.)

O flag of Indra, of mighty valor, the fair-winged [Garuḍa] is present in you,
the king of birds, the son of Vinatā, and the banner of Nārāyaṇa.
He should be known as the son of Kaśyapa, immortal, enemy of the serpents, the mount of Viṣṇu,
immeasurable, invincible, slayer of the enemies of the gods.
Winged Garuḍa, moving with the swiftness of the wind, is placed and abides in you.
Protect the weapons, armour, and warriors, and protect us, and burn the enemies! (Thus the banner mantra.)
Kumuda, Airāvaṇa, Padma, Puṣpadanta, then Vāmana,
Supratīka, Añjana, and Nīla: these are the eight of divine origin.
Their sons and grandsons, resorted to by the eight armies—
Bhadra, Mandra, and Mṛga, and the Mixed elephant—
those great elephants born in forest after forest, of the elephant species:
may the Vasus, the Rudras, and the Ādityas, along with the Marut hosts, protect you.
Protect your master, O lord of elephants, keeping your compact.

For they attained victory in battle; advance for our welfare on the march!
May your beauty be from Soma, strength from Viṣṇu, splendour from the Sun, speed from the Wind,
stability from Meru, victory from Rudra, and fame from the divine Indra.
May the serpents protect you in battle, and the directions together with their deities;
may the two Aśvins together with the Gandharvas protect you on all sides always. (Thus the elephant mantra.)
The Fire-god, the Vasus, the Rudras, the Wind, Soma, the great sages,
serpents, kinnaras, gandharvas, yakṣas, hosts of ghosts, and the planets,
and the Pramathas along with the Ādityas, the Lord of Ghosts with the Mothers,
Indra’s army commander Skanda, and Varuṇa are lodged in you.
May they burn all enemies; may the king attain victory!
Whatever corruptions have been employed all around by enemies,
these of the enemy’s forces are destroyed by your splendour!
In the battle of the slaying of Kālanemi, in the battle of the destruction of Tripura,
in the battle against Hiraṇyakaśipu, and likewise in the battle between the gods and the asuras,
you shone; in that very way, shine today for the king!

Having seen this dark-blue and white [flag], may the enemies of the king perish today,
vanquished in battle by diverse terrible diseases and by weapons!
They became well at once, swept over by your breeze. 63.
Pūtanā, she who is named Revatī, and she who is remembered as Kālarātrī—
resorting to you, O standard, let them quickly consume all enemies! (Thus the standard mantra.)
Asi, the slayer of foes, the sword, fierce in action, hard to approach,
the womb of fortune, victory, and the supporter of righteousness:
these eight names of yours were spoken by the Creator himself.
Your asterism is Kṛttikā, and your venerable deity is Maheśvara.
Gold is your body; your creator is the god Janārdana;
you are the father, the grandfather, the god; protect me always! (Thus the sword mantra.)
You are the giver of comfort in battle, an armour made entirely of iron.
Protect me, for I am to be protected by you, O armour! Reverence to you! (Thus the armour mantra.)

O war drum, you cause the hearts of rivals to tremble at your sound!
Become likewise the increaser of victory for the armies of the king!
Just as excellent elephants rejoice at the rumble of a cloud,
so let there be joy bringing delight to us at your sound.
Just as terror arises in women at the sound of a cloud,
so at your sound may our enemies tremble in battle! (Thus the war drum mantra.)
O highest among all weapons, slayer of all enemies of the gods,
O bow, protect me always together with the finest of arrows! (Thus the bow mantra.)
You are holy, O conch, the most auspicious of all auspicious things,
borne constantly by Viṣṇu; become the granter of peace of mind! (Thus the conch mantra.)
Resembling the rays of the moon, white as snow and foam,
quickly drive away misfortune, O chowrie dear to the immortals! (Thus the chowrie mantra.)
First of all weapons you were fashioned by the wielder of Pināka,
drawn forth from the spear-weapon and furnished with a handle.

You were given to Caṇḍikā, O destroyer of all evil-doers!
Likewise you were multiplied and presented to the gods.
You have become a part of the bodies of all beings, / O dispeller of all inauspiciousness! / O dagger, protect me perpetually and grant peace! Homage to you! 77. (Thus the dagger mantra.)
For driving away evil-doers and for gathering the righteous,
you were also fashioned by Brahmā for the accomplishment of justice.
Give fame, give happiness, be the protector of the king's world;
strike quickly all enemies, O golden sceptre, reverence to you! (Thus the golden sceptre mantra.)
Conquering, granting victory, victorious, slayer of foes, bringing delight,
remover of sorrow, giver of righteousness, tranquil, destroyer of all misfortunes:
because these eight exceedingly strong lions are in your presence,
therefore you are sung by the brahmins in the Vedas as 'throne' [siṃhāsana]!
In you sits Śiva manifest; in you sits Śakra, lord of the gods; / in you sits god Hari; for your sake ascetic penance is performed.

(Now the prose passage)
Having made according to his means an image of Durgā—golden, silver, brass, wooden, painted, or copper—placed beneath an archway adorned with wood, in a beautiful location, her gaze cast straight ahead, situated in the middle of a decorated chamber, bathed, her limbs anointed with saffron, sandalwood paste, fragrant fourfold unguents, and fine silken garments, having worshipped that goddess with flowers, the king, accompanied by daylight, his fame nurtured by many twice-born folk whose satisfaction has been secured, should himself, along with the family priests, offer worship to the goddess with a bilva leaf and with this mantra:
(Thus the prose is complete)
"Jayaṃtī, Maṅgalā, Kālī, Bhadrakālī, Kapālinī, / Durgā, Śivā, Kṣamā, Dhātrī, Svāhā, Svadhā, homage be to you!
Born of nectar, the bilva tree is ever dear to the Great Goddess. / I offer a pure bilva leaf to you, O sovereign of the gods!"
And Durgā is to be worshipped from that day with droṇapuṣpī flowers; / and she, the sovereign of the gods, is pleased by that, and the one beset with deep-seated sores [is healed].

text_mt:
Then, having bowed to the sword that crushes the pride of enemies, / he should desire his own victory, sovereignty, and abundance of food for himself, O king.
Having bowed again and again, he should then meditate in his heart on Śivā, / the slayer of the buffalo, many-armed, the maiden who rides a lion,
threatening the demons, with an upraised sword in her hand, auspicious, / bearing a bell and a rosary, Durgā stationed at the beginning of battle.
Then, with cries of "Victory! Victory!", he should next recite this hymn of praise:
"O you who are the auspiciousness of all that is auspicious, O Śivā, accomplisher of all aims, / O refuge, three-eyed Gauri, Nārāyaṇī, homage be to you!
Smeared with saffron, anointed with sandalwood paste, / garlanded with bilva leaves, O Durgā, I have come to you for refuge."
Having performed the worship thus, O descendant of Kuru, on the aṣṭamī night [he should keep] a vigil, / and he should have a great festival celebrated with actors, dances, and songs.
Having passed the night thus with joyful folk, at dawn, when the day begins to break, / he should fell buffaloes and sheep before [her], their necks bowed down.

text_mt:
Neither childlessness nor fire, neither thieves nor vināyakas / cause obstacles for those with whom the Great Goddess is pleased, O lord of kings.
Free from disease, happy, enjoyers of pleasures, free from fear / do men who are devoted to the Goddess become; what more need be said?
Thus this great festival of goddess Durgā has been told to you, / destroying all misfortune for those who recite and listen to it.
Having worshipped on the navamī Durgā, who stands upon the back of Mahiṣāsura pierced by the tip of her trident, whose arm-staffs bear bright armlets and a drawn sword, and who is attended by the five-faced [lion], mortals cross over difficult and dense perils.

तेजोमयमिदं यस्मात्सदा पश्यंति सूरयः..
हृदि तत्र गुणातीतं विश्वचक्रं नमाम्यहम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: Because the wise ever see this luminous [wheel] / in their heart, beyond the qualities, I bow to that Viśvacakra.

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudeve sthitaṃ cakraṃ tasya madhye tu mādhavaḥ ..
anyonyādhārarūpeṇa praṇamāmi sthitāviha .. .. 4.190.20 ..
meaning:
वासुदेवे स्थितं चक्रं तस्य मध्ये तु माधवः ..
अन्योन्याधाररूपेण प्रणमामि स्थिताविह .. .. 4.190.20 ..
text_mt: The wheel is situated in Vāsudeva, and in its center is Mādhava; / I bow to the two situated here, mutually serving as each other's support.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvacakramidaṃ yasmātsarvapāpaharaṃ hareḥ ..
āyudhaṃ cādhivāsaśca tasmācchāntiṃ dadātu me .. 21 ..
meaning:
विश्वचक्रमिदं यस्मात्सर्वपापहरं हरेः ..
आयुधं चाधिवासश्च तस्माच्छान्तिं ददातु मे .. 21 ..
text_mt: Since this Viśvacakra of Hari, which takes away all sins, / is both his weapon and his abode, therefore may it grant me peace.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityāmaṃtrya ca yo dadyādviśvacakraṃ vimatsaraḥ ..
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇuloke mahīyate .. 22 ..
meaning:
इत्यामंत्र्य च यो दद्याद्विश्वचक्रं विमत्सरः ..
विमुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यो विष्णुलोके महीयते .. 22 ..
text_mt: Having thus addressed it, he who gives the Viśvacakra without envy, / freed from all sins, is glorified in the world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
vaikuṇṭhalokamāsādya caturbāhunarāvṛtam ..
sevyate'psarasāṃ saṃghaistiṣṭhetkalpaśatatrayam .. 23 ..
meaning:
वैकुण्ठलोकमासाद्य चतुर्बाहुनरावृतम् ..
सेव्यतेऽप्सरसां संघैस्तिष्ठेत्कल्पशतत्रयम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Having attained the world of Vaikuṇṭha, surrounded by four-armed men, / he is attended by hosts of apsarases and remains there for three hundred kalpas.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamedvātha yaḥ kṛtvā viśvacakraṃ dinedine ..
tasyāyurvarddhate dīrghaṃ lakṣmīstu vipulā bhavet .. 24 ..
meaning:
प्रणमेद्वाथ यः कृत्वा विश्वचक्रं दिनेदिने ..
तस्यायुर्वर्द्धते दीर्घं लक्ष्मीस्तु विपुला भवेत् .. 24 ..
text_mt: Or he who, having fashioned the Viśvacakra, bows to it day by day, / his life-span increases long and his fortune becomes vast.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāccakraṃ sadā kāryaṃ dhāryaṃ ca svagṛhe naraiḥ ..
kāṃcanaṃ vātha raupyaṃ vā tadabhāve'tha tāmrajam .. 25 ..
meaning:
तस्माच्चक्रं सदा कार्यं धार्यं च स्वगृहे नरैः ..
कांचनं वाथ रौप्यं वा तदभावेऽथ ताम्रजम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Therefore, men should always fashion the wheel and keep it in their house, / either of gold or of silver, or in the absence of that, made of copper.

sanskrit_iast:
iti sakalajagatsurādhivāsaṃ vitarati yastapanīyaṣoḍaśāram ..
haribhuvanagataḥ sa siddhasaṃghaiściramadhigamya namasyate'psarobhiḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
इति सकलजगत्सुराधिवासं वितरति यस्तपनीयषोडशारम् ..
हरिभुवनगतः स सिद्धसंघैश्चिरमधिगम्य नमस्यतेऽप्सरोभिः .. 26 ..
text_mt: He who thus presents the golden sixteen-spoked [wheel], the abode of all gods of the universe, / having gone to the world of Hari and met with hosts of siddhas, is bowed to for a long time by apsarases.

sanskrit_iast:
atha sudarśanatāṃ prayāti śatrormadanasudarśanatāṃ ca kāminībhyaḥ ..
sa sudarśanakeśavānurūpaḥ kanakasudarśanadānadagdhapāpaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
अथ सुदर्शनतां प्रयाति शत्रोर्मदनसुदर्शनतां च कामिनीभ्यः ..
स सुदर्शनकेशवानुरूपः कनकसुदर्शनदानदग्धपापः .. 27 ..
text_mt: Then he becomes a fair sight for his enemy and a handsome sight like Love for longing women; / he becomes like Kesava of fair sight, his sins burned away by the gift of the golden Sudarśana.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtagurudurito'pi ṣoḍaśārapravitaraṇātpravarākṛtirmurāreḥ..
abhibhavati bhavodbhavāni bhittvā bhavamabhito bhavane bhavāni bhūyaḥ .. 28 .. ..
bhuvanapratiṣṭhāvarṇanam
meaning:
कृतगुरुदुरितोऽपि षोडशारप्रवितरणात्प्रवराकृतिर्मुरारेः..
अभिभवति भवोद्भवानि भित्त्वा भवमभितो भवने भवानि भूयः .. 28 .. ..
भुवनप्रतिष्ठावर्णनम्
text_mt:
Even if he has committed grave sins, having attained the excellent form of Murāri through the gift of the sixteen-spoked [wheel], / he breaks through the worldly conditions born of existence and repeatedly overcomes them everywhere in the world.
Description of the Consecration of the Worlds

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
pratiṣṭhā śāśvatī kena dānena madhusūdana ..
iha loke pare caiva kīrtiratyadbhutā tathā ..1..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
प्रतिष्ठा शाश्वती केन दानेन मधुसूदन ..
इह लोके परे चैव कीर्तिरत्यद्भुता तथा ..1..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / By what gift, O Madhusūdana, is there eternal establishment / and most wondrous fame in this world and the next,
title: Bhuvanapratiṣṭhāvarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
sadgatiṃ ca tathā yāṃti sarve pitṛpitāmahāḥ ..
saṃtatiścākṣayā loke vibhavaścāpi puṣkalaḥ ..2..
meaning:
सद्गतिं च तथा यांति सर्वे पितृपितामहाः ..
संततिश्चाक्षया लोके विभवश्चापि पुष्कलः ..2..
text_mt: and all fathers and grandfathers go to a good destination, / and there is imperishable lineage and abundant prosperity in the world?

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpanātsarvadevānāṃ kathaṃ syādyadunaṃdana ..
tadācakṣva mahābhāga dānena niyamena vā .. 3 ..
meaning:
स्थापनात्सर्वदेवानां कथं स्याद्यदुनंदन ..
तदाचक्ष्व महाभाग दानेन नियमेन वा .. 3 ..
text_mt: How can it be through the establishment of all the gods, O Delighter of the Yadus? / Declare that, O fortunate one, whether through a gift or a restriction.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā rājam̐llokānāmupakārakam ..
śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā guhyaṃ paramamuttamam.. ..4..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
साधु पृष्टं त्वया राजम्̐ल्लोकानामुपकारकम् ..
शृणुष्वैकमना भूत्वा गुह्यं परममुत्तमम्.. ..4..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Well asked by you, O King, for the benefit of the worlds! / Listen with an attentive mind to this supreme, most excellent secret.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuvanānāṃ samāsena pratiṣṭhāṃ kathayāmi te ..
devāsurāstathā nāgā gaṃdharvā yakṣarākṣasāḥ ..5..
meaning:
भुवनानां समासेन प्रतिष्ठां कथयामि ते ..
देवासुरास्तथा नागा गंधर्वा यक्षराक्षसाः ..5..
text_mt: I shall tell you in brief of the establishment of the worlds, / of gods and asuras, and likewise nāgas, gandharvas, yakṣas, and rākṣasas.

sanskrit_iast:
pretāḥ piśācā bhūtāśca sthāpitāḥ syurna saṃśayaḥ..
kārakasyānukūle tu muhūrte vijaye śubhe ..6..
meaning:
प्रेताः पिशाचा भूताश्च स्थापिताः स्युर्न संशयः..
कारकस्यानुकूले तु मुहूर्ते विजये शुभे ..6..
text_mt:
pretas, piśācas, and ghosts are undoubtedly installed.
At a victorious, auspicious moment favourable to the patron,

sanskrit_iast:
puṇye tithau śivakṣetre dine saumyagrahānvite ..
sapta hastaṃ paṭaṃ kṛtvā caturasraṃ susaṃhatam ..7..
meaning:
पुण्ये तिथौ शिवक्षेत्रे दिने सौम्यग्रहान्विते ..
सप्त हस्तं पटं कृत्वा चतुरस्रं सुसंहतम् ..7..
text_mt:
on an auspicious lunar day, in a sacred field of Śiva, on a day accompanied by auspicious planets,
having made a canvas seven cubits [in size], square and very compact,

sanskrit_iast:
abhinnāṃgaṃ dṛḍhaṃ śuddhaṃ śuddhasphaṭikavarcasam ..
tasminsarvāṇi rājeṃdra bhuvanāni ca lekhayet .. 8 ..
meaning:
अभिन्नांगं दृढं शुद्धं शुद्धस्फटिकवर्चसम् ..
तस्मिन्सर्वाणि राजेंद्र भुवनानि च लेखयेत् .. 8 ..
text_mt:
with unbroken fabric, firm, clean, and radiant like pure crystal,
upon it, O king of kings, he should cause all the worlds to be painted.

sanskrit_iast:
cāturvarṇyakamānīya vicitraṃ citrakarmaṇi ..
yuvānaṃ vyādhirahitaṃ bhavyaṃ citrakaraṃ śubham .. 9 ..
meaning:
चातुर्वर्ण्यकमानीय विचित्रं चित्रकर्मणि ..
युवानं व्याधिरहितं भव्यं चित्रकरं शुभम् .. 9 ..
text_mt:
Having brought four-coloured pigments and an expert painter,
young, free from disease, handsome, skilled, and auspicious,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjayitvā yatnena divyavāsovibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
tasminkarmaṇi yuṃjīta paṭhyamānairdvijottamaiḥ .. 4.191.10 ..
meaning:
संपूजयित्वा यत्नेन दिव्यवासोविभूषणैः ..
तस्मिन्कर्मणि युंजीत पठ्यमानैर्द्विजोत्तमैः .. 4.191.10 ..
text_mt:
having worshipped him carefully with divine garments and ornaments,
he should employ him in that task, while the best of twice-born [priests] recite.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkhabherīninādaiśca gītamaṃgalanisvanaiḥ ..
puṇyāhajayaghoṣaiśca brāhmaṇānpūjyettataḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
शंखभेरीनिनादैश्च गीतमंगलनिस्वनैः ..
पुण्याहजयघोषैश्च ब्राह्मणान्पूज्येत्ततः .. 11 ..
text_mt:
With the sounds of conches and kettle-drums, with the auspicious sounds of songs,
and with the proclamation of an auspicious day and cries of victory, he should then worship the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
ācāryamapi saṃpūjya vāsobhirbhūṣaṇaistathā ..
prāraṃbhaṃ kārayedrājanpaṭe tasminyathoditam .. 12 ..
meaning:
आचार्यमपि संपूज्य वासोभिर्भूषणैस्तथा ..
प्रारंभं कारयेद्राजन्पटे तस्मिन्यथोदितम् .. 12 ..
text_mt:
Having also worshipped the preceptor with garments and ornaments,
he should cause the beginning [of the work] on that canvas to be made as prescribed, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye ca lekhayedrājañjaṃbūdvīpaṃ savistaram ..
tasya madhye sthito merurmerorupari devatāḥ ..13..
meaning:
मध्ये च लेखयेद्राजञ्जंबूद्वीपं सविस्तरम् ..
तस्य मध्ये स्थितो मेरुर्मेरोरुपरि देवताः ..13..
text_mt:
In the centre, O king, he should cause Jambūdvīpa to be painted in full detail;
in its centre stands Meru, and above Meru the deities.

sanskrit_iast:
diśāsu lokapālānāṃ puro'ṣṭau surasaṃyutāḥ ..
saptadvīpavatī pṛthvī sapta caiva kulācalāḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
दिशासु लोकपालानां पुरोऽष्टौ सुरसंयुताः ..
सप्तद्वीपवती पृथ्वी सप्त चैव कुलाचलाः .. 14 ..
text_mt:
In the directions [are] the eight cities of the world protectors, accompanied by gods.
The earth has seven continents, and there are seven mountain ranges.

sanskrit_iast:
sāgarāḥ sapta cātraiva nadyo hradāḥ sarāṃsi ca ..
pātālāḥ sapta cātraiva sapta svargavibhūtayaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
सागराः सप्त चात्रैव नद्यो ह्रदाः सरांसि च ..
पातालाः सप्त चात्रैव सप्त स्वर्गविभूतयः .. 15 ..
text_mt:
Here too are the seven oceans, the rivers, lakes, and pools.
Here too are the seven underworlds and the seven heavenly splendours,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ bhuvanāni yathākramam ..
dhruvamārgastathādityo grahatārāgaṇairyutaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादीनां भुवनानि यथाक्रमम् ..
ध्रुवमार्गस्तथादित्यो ग्रहतारागणैर्युतः .. 16 ..
text_mt:
the worlds of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and others in due order,
the path of Dhruva, and the sun accompanied by the host of planets and stars,

sanskrit_iast:
devadānavagandharvā yakṣa rākṣasapannagāḥ ..
ṛṣayo munayo gāvo devamātara eva ca ..17..
meaning:
देवदानवगन्धर्वा यक्ष राक्षसपन्नगाः ..
ऋषयो मुनयो गावो देवमातर एव च ..17..
text_mt:
gods, dānavas, gandharvas, yakṣas, rākṣasas, serpents,
ṛṣis, sages, cows, and the divine mothers,

sanskrit_iast:
suparṇādyāśca vihagā nāgāścairāvatādayaḥ ..
diggajāṣṭakamatraiva lekhayenmadamaṃḍitam .. .. 18 ..
meaning:
सुपर्णाद्याश्च विहगा नागाश्चैरावतादयः ..
दिग्गजाष्टकमत्रैव लेखयेन्मदमंडितम् .. .. 18 ..
text_mt:
birds such as eagles, and elephants such as Airāvata;
here too he should cause the group of eight directional elephants to be painted, adorned with temporal rut.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃvidhaṃ paṭaṃ rājankārayitvā suśobhanam ..
daśottareṇa payasā etatsarvasamāvṛtam .. 19 ..
meaning:
एवंविधं पटं राजन्कारयित्वा सुशोभनम् ..
दशोत्तरेण पयसा एतत्सर्वसमावृतम् .. 19 ..
text_mt:
Having caused such a most splendid canvas to be made, O king,
all this is surrounded by water, tenfold [greater].

sanskrit_iast:
tattejasā vṛtaṃ bhūyo mahatogreṇa sarvataḥ ..
tejastadvāyunā vāyurākāśena samāvṛtaḥ .. 4.191.20 ..
meaning:
तत्तेजसा वृतं भूयो महतोग्रेण सर्वतः ..
तेजस्तद्वायुना वायुराकाशेन समावृतः .. 4.191.20 ..
text_mt:
That [water] is further surrounded on all sides by fierce, vast fire;
that fire is surrounded by wind, and the wind is surrounded by space.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtādinā tathākāśaṃ bhūtādirmahatā tathā ..
avyaktena mahāṃścaiva vyāpto vai śuddhilakṣaṇaḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
भूतादिना तथाकाशं भूतादिर्महता तथा ..
अव्यक्तेन महांश्चैव व्याप्तो वै शुद्धिलक्षणः .. 21 ..
text_mt:
Space is likewise surrounded by the origin of elements (ego), and the origin of elements by the great principle;
and the great principle, characterised by purity, is pervaded by the unmanifest.

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktaṃ tamasā vyāptaṃ tamaśca rajasā tathā ..
rajaḥ sattvena saṃvyāptaṃ tridhā prakṛtirucyate .. 22 ..
meaning:
अव्यक्तं तमसा व्याप्तं तमश्च रजसा तथा ..
रजः सत्त्वेन संव्याप्तं त्रिधा प्रकृतिरुच्यते .. 22 ..
text_mt:
The unmanifest is pervaded by darkness, and darkness likewise by passion;
passion is thoroughly pervaded by goodness; nature is said to be threefold.

sanskrit_iast:
evamāvaraṇopetaṃ brahmāṃḍamakhilaṃ nṛpa ..
puruṣeṇāvṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sabāhyābhyaṃtaraṃ tathā .. 23 ..
meaning:
एवमावरणोपेतं ब्रह्मांडमखिलं नृप ..
पुरुषेणावृतं सर्वं सबाह्याभ्यंतरं तथा .. 23 ..
text_mt:
Thus the entire cosmic egg is provided with coverings, O king;
all is pervaded by the Supreme Person, both externally and internally.

sanskrit_iast:
etatsarvaṃ paṭasthaṃ tu kṛtvā citramayaṃ sudhīḥ ..
kārtikyāmayane caiva viṣuve grahaṇe'pi vā .. 24 ..
meaning:
एतत्सर्वं पटस्थं तु कृत्वा चित्रमयं सुधीः ..
कार्तिक्यामयने चैव विषुवे ग्रहणेऽपि वा .. 24 ..
text_mt:
Having depicted all of this upon the canvas, full of paintings, the wise man,
on the full moon of Kārttika, at an equinox, a solstice, or during an eclipse,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedyena vidhinā tatsamāsena me śṛṇu ..
purato maṃḍapaṃ tasya vicitraṃ kārayedbudhaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
पूजयेद्येन विधिना तत्समासेन मे शृणु ..
पुरतो मंडपं तस्य विचित्रं कारयेद्बुधः .. 25 ..
text_mt:
should worship it according to the rite; listen to that in brief from me.
In front of it, the wise man should cause a splendid pavilion to be built.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra kuṇḍāni catvāri caturasrāṇi kārayet ..
dvaudvau niyojayetteṣu brāhmaṇau vedapāragau .. 26 ..
meaning:
तत्र कुण्डानि चत्वारि चतुरस्राणि कारयेत् ..
द्वौद्वौ नियोजयेत्तेषु ब्राह्मणौ वेदपारगौ .. 26 ..
text_mt:
There he should cause four square sacrificial pits to be made;
at each of them he should appoint two brāhmaṇas who have mastered the Vedas,

sanskrit_iast:
yajñopakaraṇopetau vastrābharaṇabhūṣitau ..
homaṃ kuryurjitātmāno mauninaḥ sarva eva te .. 27 ..
meaning:
यज्ञोपकरणोपेतौ वस्त्राभरणभूषितौ ..
होमं कुर्युर्जितात्मानो मौनिनः सर्व एव ते .. 27 ..
text_mt:
equipped with the implements of sacrifice, adorned with garments and ornaments.
Self-controlled and observant of silence, they all should perform the fire oblation

sanskrit_iast:
paṭe sthitānāṃ devānāṃ maṃtrairoṃkārapūrvakaiḥ ..
yajamānastataḥ snātaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
पटे स्थितानां देवानां मंत्रैरोंकारपूर्वकैः ..
यजमानस्ततः स्नातः सर्वालंकारभूषितः .. 28 ..
text_mt:
to the deities present on the canvas with mantras preceded by the syllable Om.
Then the patron, having bathed and adorned with all ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
ācāryeṇasamaṃ kuryātpūjāmagre paṭasya tu ..
puṣpairvastraiḥ samabhyarcya maṃtrametamudīrayet .. 29 ..
meaning:
आचार्येणसमं कुर्यात्पूजामग्रे पटस्य तु ..
पुष्पैर्वस्त्रैः समभ्यर्च्य मंत्रमेतमुदीरयेत् .. 29 ..
text_mt:
should perform the worship together with the preceptor in front of the canvas.
Having worshipped with flowers and garments, he should utter this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṃḍodaravartīni bhuvanāni caturdaśa ..
tāni saṃnihitānyatra pūjitāni bhavaṃtu me .. 4.191.30 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मांडोदरवर्तीनि भुवनानि चतुर्दश ..
तानि संनिहितान्यत्र पूजितानि भवंतु मे .. 4.191.30 ..
text_mt:
“May the fourteen worlds residing within the womb of the cosmic egg,
present here, be worshipped by me!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā viṣṇustathā rudro hyādityā vasavastathā ..
pūjitāḥ supratiṣṭhāśca bhavaṃtu satataṃ mama .. 31 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मा विष्णुस्तथा रुद्रो ह्यादित्या वसवस्तथा ..
पूजिताः सुप्रतिष्ठाश्च भवंतु सततं मम .. 31 ..
text_mt:
May Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Rudra, the Ādityas, and the Vasus
be worshipped and well established for me always!”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ paṭaṃ taṃ saṃpūjya kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇam ..
bhakṣyānnānāvidhāṃścaiva naivedyaṃ tatra dāpayet .. 32 ..
meaning:
एवं पटं तं संपूज्य कृत्वा चैव प्रदक्षिणम् ..
भक्ष्यान्नानाविधांश्चैव नैवेद्यं तत्र दापयेत् .. 32 ..
text_mt:
Having thus worshipped that canvas and circumambulated it,
he should offer various kinds of edible foods as an oblation there.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkhatūryaninādaiśca jāgaraṃ kārayettataḥ..
brahmaghoṣaivicitraiśca gītamaṃgalanisvanaiḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
शंखतूर्यनिनादैश्च जागरं कारयेत्ततः..
ब्रह्मघोषैविचित्रैश्च गीतमंगलनिस्वनैः .. 33 ..
text_mt:
Then he should keep a night vigil with the sounds of conches and musical instruments,
with diverse recitations of the Veda, and with auspicious sounds of singing.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ prabhāte vimale snātvā śuciralaṃkṛtaḥ ..
pūrvoktavidhinānena punaḥ saṃpūjya taṃ paṭam .. 34 ..
meaning:
पुनः प्रभाते विमले स्नात्वा शुचिरलंकृतः ..
पूर्वोक्तविधिनानेन पुनः संपूज्य तं पटम् .. 34 ..
text_mt:
Again at the clear daybreak, having bathed, pure and adorned,
having worshipped that canvas once more according to this aforementioned rule,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtvikpūjāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā gośatena vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
athavā goyugaṃ dadyādekaika syātyalaṃkṛtam .. 35 ..
meaning:
ऋत्विक्पूजां ततः कृत्वा गोशतेन विचक्षणः ..
अथवा गोयुगं दद्यादेकैक स्यात्यलंकृतम् .. 35 ..
text_mt:
and then having performed the worship of the officiating priests with a hundred cows, the discerning man
may alternatively give a pair of cows, each one well adorned,

sanskrit_iast:
upānahau tathā chatraṃ gṛhopakaraṇāni ca ..
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ kiṃcitsarvaṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
उपानहौ तथा छत्रं गृहोपकरणानि च ..
यद्यदिष्टतमं किंचित्सर्वं दद्याद्विचक्षणः .. 36 ..
text_mt:
shoes, a royal parasol, household utensils,
and whatever is most dear; the discerning man should give all of it.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prakalpayedyānaṃ nāgayuktamalaṃkṛtam ..
alābhe vājisaṃyuktaṃ patākādhvajaśālinam ..37..
meaning:
ततः प्रकल्पयेद्यानं नागयुक्तमलंकृतम् ..
अलाभे वाजिसंयुक्तं पताकाध्वजशालिनम् ..37..
text_mt:
Then he should prepare a chariot harnessed to elephants, adorned,
or, in its absence, harnessed to horses, splendid with banners and flags.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā tatastvāropayetpaṭam ..
brāhmaṇaṃ vā rathenātha nayeddevālayaṃ budhaḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
सहस्रं दक्षिणां दत्त्वा ततस्त्वारोपयेत्पटम् ..
ब्राह्मणं वा रथेनाथ नयेद्देवालयं बुधः .. 38 ..
text_mt:
Having given a thousand [coins] as priestly fee, the wise man should then mount the canvas
or a brāhmaṇa upon the chariot and convey it to the temple.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrasthaṃ sthāpayennītvā gandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpayet ..
tatrāpi dadayānnaivedyaṃ kuryāccāpi mahotsavam .. 39 ..
meaning:
तत्रस्थं स्थापयेन्नीत्वा गन्धैः पुष्पैश्च धूपयेत् ..
तत्रापि ददयान्नैवेद्यं कुर्याच्चापि महोत्सवम् .. 39 ..
text_mt:
Bringing it there, he should install it, and perfume it with fragrant scents and flowers;
there too he should present food offerings and also celebrate a great festival.

sanskrit_iast:
yasminnāyatane tasya pratiṣṭhā kriyate nṛpa ..
pūjā tatrāpi mahatī kartavyā bhūtimicchatā .. 4.191.40 ...
meaning:
यस्मिन्नायतने तस्य प्रतिष्ठा क्रियते नृप ..
पूजा तत्रापि महती कर्तव्या भूतिमिच्छता .. 4.191.40 ...
text_mt:
In whatever temple its installation is performed, O king,
a great worship should also be performed there by one who desires prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
caṃdrātapatraṃ ghaṇṭāṃ ca dhvajādyaṃ dāpayetsudhīḥ ..
yathāśaktyā ca rājendra guruṃ gauravayaṃtritaḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
चंद्रातपत्रं घण्टां च ध्वजाद्यं दापयेत्सुधीः ..
यथाशक्त्या च राजेन्द्र गुरुं गौरवयंत्रितः .. 41 ..
text_mt:
The wise man should present a moon-awning, a bell, flags, and so forth,
and according to his ability, O king of kings, constrained by respect for his guru,

sanskrit_iast:
abhyarcya dakṣiṇābhiśca brāhmaṇāṃśca visarjayet ..'
dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca bhojanaṃ cāpyavāritam .. 42 ..
meaning:
अभ्यर्च्य दक्षिणाभिश्च ब्राह्मणांश्च विसर्जयेत् ..'
दीनांधकृपणानां च भोजनं चाप्यवारितम् .. 42 ..
text_mt:
having honoured the brāhmaṇas with priestly fees, he should dismiss them.
And unrestricted food for the poor, the blind, and the wretched

sanskrit_iast:
tasminnahani dātavyaṃ mitrasvajanabaṃdhuṣu ..
anena vidhinā yastu śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ .... .. 43 ..
meaning:
तस्मिन्नहनि दातव्यं मित्रस्वजनबंधुषु ..
अनेन विधिना यस्तु श्रद्दधानो जितेन्द्रियः .... .. 43 ..
text_mt:
should be given on that day, as well as to friends, his own people, and relatives.
Whoever, full of faith and with senses subdued, according to this rule,

sanskrit_iast:
kuryānnaro vā nārī vā pratiṣṭhāṃ sārvalaukikīm ..
sthāpitaṃ tu bhavettena trailokyaṃ sacarācaram .. 44 ..
meaning:
कुर्यान्नरो वा नारी वा प्रतिष्ठां सार्वलौकिकीम् ..
स्थापितं तु भवेत्तेन त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् .. 44 ..
text_mt:
man or woman, performs this installation of all the worlds,
by that person the three worlds, moving and unmoving, will have been established.

sanskrit_iast:
kulaṃ ca tāritaṃ tena satputreṇa yudhiṣṭhira ..
yāvacca devatāgāre paṭastiṣṭhati pūjitaḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
कुलं च तारितं तेन सत्पुत्रेण युधिष्ठिर ..
यावच्च देवतागारे पटस्तिष्ठति पूजितः .. 45 ..
text_mt:
And his lineage is redeemed by him as a true son, O Yudhiṣṭhira.
And for as long as the canvas remains worshipped in the temple,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadasyākṣayā kīrtistrailokye saṃprasarpati ..
dānena kīrtiryāvaṃti martyalokeṣu gīyate .. 46 ..
meaning:
तावदस्याक्षया कीर्तिस्त्रैलोक्ये संप्रसर्पति ..
दानेन कीर्तिर्यावंति मर्त्यलोकेषु गीयते .. 46 ..
text_mt:
for so long does his imperishable fame spread through the three worlds.
For as many [years] as the fame of his gift is sung in the mortal world,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ..
gandharvairgīyamānastu apsarogaṇasevitaḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते ..
गन्धर्वैर्गीयमानस्तु अप्सरोगणसेवितः .. 47 ..
text_mt:
for that many thousands of years he is exalted in the heavenly world.
Being praised in song by gandharvas and attended by hosts of apsarases,

sanskrit_iast:
vaseddhṛṣṭamanāḥ svarge yāvadiṃdrāścatu rdaśa ..
puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
वसेद्धृष्टमनाः स्वर्गे यावदिंद्राश्चतु र्दश ..
पुण्यक्षयादिहाभ्येत्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः .. 48 ..
text_mt:
he would reside joyful in heaven for as long as fourteen Indras [endure].
Upon the exhaustion of his merit, returning here, he becomes a righteous king,

sanskrit_iast:
putrapautrānvitaḥ śrīmāndīrghāyuratidhārmikaḥ ..
daśa janmāni rājendra jāyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
पुत्रपौत्रान्वितः श्रीमान्दीर्घायुरतिधार्मिकः ..
दश जन्मानि राजेन्द्र जायमानः पुनः पुनः .. 49 ..
text_mt:
endowed with sons and grandsons, prosperous, long-lived, and exceedingly righteous,
being born again and again for ten lifetimes, O king of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
śrūyate ca purā rājā rajirnāma mahābalaḥ ..
cakravartī dṛḍhamatirjitārirvijiteṃdriyaḥ .. 4.191.50 ..
meaning:
श्रूयते च पुरा राजा रजिर्नाम महाबलः ..
चक्रवर्ती दृढमतिर्जितारिर्विजितेंद्रियः .. 4.191.50 ..
text_mt:
And it is heard that formerly there was a mighty king named Raji,
an emperor of firm resolve, who conquered his enemies and subdued his senses.

sanskrit_iast:
mahī yena purā dattā devarājasya saṃgare ..
jitvā daityabalaṃ sarvaṃ dattavāṃstridivaṃ punaḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
मही येन पुरा दत्ता देवराजस्य संगरे ..
जित्वा दैत्यबलं सर्वं दत्तवांस्त्रिदिवं पुनः .. 51 ..
text_mt: by whom the earth was formerly given to the king of the gods in battle, / and who, having defeated the entire army of the Daityas, gave heaven back again

sanskrit_iast:
mahendrāya mahābhāga sarvaṃ nihatakaṃṭakam ..
sa kadācitsabhāmadhye yāvadāste mahī patiḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
महेन्द्राय महाभाग सर्वं निहतकंटकम् ..
स कदाचित्सभामध्ये यावदास्ते मही पतिः .. 52 ..
text_mt: to Mahendra, O fortunate one, entirely freed from thorns. / Once, while that lord of the earth was seated in the assembly,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvattatrājagāmātha pulastyo brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ..
śiṣyaiḥ parivṛtaḥ śrīmānvedavedāṃgapāragaiḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
तावत्तत्राजगामाथ पुलस्त्यो ब्रह्मणः सुतः..
शिष्यैः परिवृतः श्रीमान्वेदवेदांगपारगैः .. 53 ..
text_mt: Pulastya, the son of Brahmā, arrived there, / glorious, surrounded by disciples who had mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas.

sanskrit_iast:
dattārghastu tadā tena upaviṣṭo varāsane .. (pāṭhā. dattārdhastu)
śuśubhe parayā lakṣmyā pitāmaha ivāparaḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
दत्तार्घस्तु तदा तेन उपविष्टो वरासने .. (पाठा. दत्तार्धस्तु)
शुशुभे परया लक्ष्म्या पितामह इवापरः .. 54 ..
text_mt: Offered the water of hospitality by him, seated on an excellent seat, / he shone with supreme splendor like a second Grandfather.

sanskrit_iast:
atha taṃ pūjayitvāgre madhuparkeṇa pārthivaḥ ..
papraccha vinayopetaḥ kathāmātmodbhavāṃ nṛpaḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
अथ तं पूजयित्वाग्रे मधुपर्केण पार्थिवः ..
पप्रच्छ विनयोपेतः कथामात्मोद्भवां नृपः .. 55 ..
text_mt: Then, having first honored him with the madhuparka offering, the king, / full of humility, asked about the story of his own past:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavankena dānena tapasā niyamena vā ..
śrīriyaṃ mama dharmajña tejaścāvyāhataṃ bhuvi .. 56 ..
meaning:
भगवन्केन दानेन तपसा नियमेन वा ..
श्रीरियं मम धर्मज्ञ तेजश्चाव्याहतं भुवि .. 56 ..
text_mt: "O Lord, by what gift, austerity, or observance, / O knower of righteousness, have I attained this fortune and unhindered power on earth,

sanskrit_iast:
balaṃ puṣṭiṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ putrapautraṃ tathottamam ..
etanme sarvamācakṣva sarvajño'si dvijottama .. 57 ..
meaning:
बलं पुष्टिं धनं धान्यं पुत्रपौत्रं तथोत्तमम् ..
एतन्मे सर्वमाचक्ष्व सर्वज्ञोऽसि द्विजोत्तम .. 57 ..
text_mt: strength, nourishment, wealth, grain, and excellent sons and grandsons? / Tell me all this, O best of the twice-born, for you are omniscient."

sanskrit_iast:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu rājankathāmetāmātmīyāṃ sumanoharām ..
kathyamānāṃ mayā samyaksaptame tava janmani .. 58 ..
meaning:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
शृणु राजन्कथामेतामात्मीयां सुमनोहराम् ..
कथ्यमानां मया सम्यक्सप्तमे तव जन्मनि .. 58 ..
text_mt: Pulastya said: / "Listen, O king, to this charming story of your own, / related accurately by me regarding your seventh birth.

sanskrit_iast:
katheyamabhinirvṛttā śṛṇuṣvaiśvaryavarddhinīm ..
āsīstvaṃ vaiśyajātīyo vārāṇasyāṃ narottama .. .. 59 ..
meaning:
कथेयमभिनिर्वृत्ता शृणुष्वैश्वर्यवर्द्धिनीम् ..
आसीस्त्वं वैश्यजातीयो वाराणस्यां नरोत्तम .. .. 59 ..
text_mt: Listen to this narrative that took place, which enhances sovereignty: / You were born into the Vaiśya caste in Vārāṇasī, O best of men,

sanskrit_iast:
bahubhṛtyaparīvāro dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ ..
dhārmikaḥ satyanirato vaṇigdharmarataḥ sadā .. 4.191.60 ..
meaning:
बहुभृत्यपरीवारो धनधान्यसमन्वितः ..
धार्मिकः सत्यनिरतो वणिग्धर्मरतः सदा .. 4.191.60 ..
text_mt: surrounded by many servants and attendants, endowed with wealth and grain, / righteous, devoted to truth, and always dedicated to the duties of a merchant.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tvayā śrutā dharmā dharmākhyānagatena vai..
dānāśrayā bahuvidhā vratāni vividhāni ca .. 61 ..
meaning:
तत्र त्वया श्रुता धर्मा धर्माख्यानगतेन वै..
दानाश्रया बहुविधा व्रतानि विविधानि च .. 61 ..
text_mt: There, having gone to an exposition of dharma, you heard of religious duties / of many kinds based on gifts, and diverse votive observances.

sanskrit_iast:
prasaṃgena kadācicca pratiṣṭhā bhauvanī tvayā ..
śrutā rājendra vidhivatkṛtā ca bahupuṇyadā .. .. 62 ..
meaning:
प्रसंगेन कदाचिच्च प्रतिष्ठा भौवनी त्वया ..
श्रुता राजेन्द्र विधिवत्कृता च बहुपुण्यदा .. .. 62 ..
text_mt: In that context, O king of kings, you heard of the dedication of a world-model, / and performed it according to rule, yielding great religious merit.

sanskrit_iast:
phalena tena jāto'si sapta janmāni bhūpatiḥ ..
kīrtiste prathitā loke valaṃ cāpi mahattava .. 63 ..
meaning:
फलेन तेन जातोऽसि सप्त जन्मानि भूपतिः ..
कीर्तिस्ते प्रथिता लोके वलं चापि महत्तव .. 63 ..
text_mt: By that fruit you have been born as a lord of the earth for seven births; / your fame is celebrated in the world, and your strength is vast.

sanskrit_iast:
aparāṇyapi janmāni sapta rājā bhaviṣyasi ..
paścādyogikule bhūtvā nirvāṇaṃ samavāpsyasi .. 64 ..
meaning:
अपराण्यपि जन्मानि सप्त राजा भविष्यसि ..
पश्चाद्योगिकुले भूत्वा निर्वाणं समवाप्स्यसि .. 64 ..
text_mt: For seven other births as well you will be a king; / afterwards, being born into a family of yogins, you will attain nirvāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yanmāṃ paripṛcchasi ..
nārī vā puruṣo vāpi pratiṣṭhāṃ bhauvanīṃ tu yaḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यन्मां परिपृच्छसि ..
नारी वा पुरुषो वापि प्रतिष्ठां भौवनीं तु यः .. 65 ..
text_mt: All this has been related to you, which you asked me. / Whatever woman or man, however, performs the dedication of a world-model

sanskrit_iast:
prakaroti vidhānena kṛtakṛtyo bhavedbudhaḥ ..
ityuktvā sa munistatra rājānaṃ śaṃsitavrataḥ ..66..
meaning:
प्रकरोति विधानेन कृतकृत्यो भवेद्बुधः ..
इत्युक्त्वा स मुनिस्तत्र राजानं शंसितव्रतः ..66..
text_mt: according to the rules, that wise person will have fulfilled all duties." / Having spoken thus to the king there, the sage of honored vows

sanskrit_iast: yayāvadarśanaṃ tatra sūrye vaiśvānaropamaḥ .. 67 ..
meaning: ययावदर्शनं तत्र सूर्ये वैश्वानरोपमः .. 67 ..
text_mt: disappeared from sight right there like the sun, resembling the fire of Agni.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaṃ vivarddhayati kīrtiṃ śatāni dhatte kāmaṃ prasādhayati pāpamapākaroti ..
khyātā mayeyamadhunā tava dānaniṣṭhā tannāsti yanna kurute bhuvanapratiṣṭhā ..68..
meaning:
धर्मं विवर्द्धयति कीर्तिं शतानि धत्ते कामं प्रसाधयति पापमपाकरोति ..
ख्याता मयेयमधुना तव दाननिष्ठा तन्नास्ति यन्न कुरुते भुवनप्रतिष्ठा ..68..
text_mt: It increases righteousness, secures hundreds of fames, accomplishes desire, and dispels sin; / this devotion to giving of yours has now been declared by me: there is nothing that the dedication of a world-model does not effect.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde bhuvanapratiṣṭhāvarṇanaṃ nāmaikanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 191 .. ..
nakṣatradānavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराण उत्तरपर्वणि श्रीकृष्णयुधिष्ठिरसंवादे भुवनप्रतिष्ठावर्णनं नामैकनवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 191 .. ..

text_mt:
Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Dedication of a World-Model,' in the dialogue between Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Yudhiṣṭhira, in the Uttaraparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Rite of Giving According to Asterisms

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
śruto dānavidhiḥ sarvaḥ prasādātte ramādhava ..
nakṣatradānasyedānī dānakalpaṃ pracakṣva me .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
श्रुतो दानविधिः सर्वः प्रसादात्ते रमाधव ..
नक्षत्रदानस्येदानी दानकल्पं प्रचक्ष्व मे .. 1 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / "All the rites of gift have been heard by me through your grace, O Lord of Ramā; / now tell me the rule of giving for the asterism gift."
title: adhyāyaḥ 192

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
atrāpyudāharaṃtīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ..
devakyāścaiva saṃvādaṃ devarṣernāradasya ca .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ..
अत्राप्युदाहरंतीममितिहासं पुरातनम् ..
देवक्याश्चैव संवादं देवर्षेर्नारदस्य च .. 2 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / "In this connection they also cite this ancient history, / the conversation between Devakī and the divine sage Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
dvārakāmanusaṃjātaṃ nāradaṃ devadarśanam ..
papracchedaṃ tathā praśnaṃ devakī dharmadarśinī .. 3 ..
meaning:
द्वारकामनुसंजातं नारदं देवदर्शनम् ..
पप्रच्छेदं तथा प्रश्नं देवकी धर्मदर्शिनी .. 3 ..
text_mt: To Nārada of divine sight, who had arrived at Dvārakā, / Devakī, perceiver of righteousness, addressed this question:

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ saṃpṛcchamānāyā devarṣirnāradastataḥ ..
ācaṣṭa vidhivatsarvaṃ yattacchṛṇu viśāṃpate .. 4 ..
meaning:
तस्याः संपृच्छमानाया देवर्षिर्नारदस्ततः ..
आचष्ट विधिवत्सर्वं यत्तच्छृणु विशांपते .. 4 ..
text_mt: To her, as she was inquiring, the divine sage Nārada / then related everything according to rule; listen to that, O ruler of the people:

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatrayogaṃ vakṣyāmi sarvapātakanāśanam ..
kṛttikāsu mahābhāga pāyasena sasarpiṣā .. 5 ..
meaning:
नक्षत्रयोगं वक्ष्यामि सर्वपातकनाशनम् ..
कृत्तिकासु महाभाग पायसेन ससर्पिषा .. 5 ..
text_mt: "I shall declare the conjunction of the asterisms, which destroys all sins. / Under Kṛttikā, O fortunate one, with milk-rice mixed with clarified butter,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtarpya brāhmaṇānsādhūm̐llokānprāpnotyanuttamān ..
rohiṇyāṃ pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha māṃsairannena sarpiṣā .. 6 ..
meaning:
संतर्प्य ब्राह्मणान्साधूम्̐ल्लोकान्प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमान् ..
रोहिण्यां पांडवश्रेष्ठ मांसैरन्नेन सर्पिषा .. 6 ..
text_mt: having gratified virtuous brāhmaṇas, one attains unsurpassed worlds. / Under Rohiṇī, O best of Pāṇḍavas, with meat, boiled rice, and clarified butter,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtarpya brāhmaṇānsādhūm̐llokānprāpnotyanuttamān ..
payo''nnadānaṃ dātavyamānṛṇyārthaṃ dvijātaye .. 7 ..
meaning:
संतर्प्य ब्राह्मणान्साधूम्̐ल्लोकान्प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमान् ..
पयो'ऽन्नदानं दातव्यमानृण्यार्थं द्विजातये .. 7 ..
text_mt: having gratified virtuous brāhmaṇas, one attains unsurpassed worlds; / a gift of milk and food should be given to a twice-born man to free oneself from debt.

sanskrit_iast:
dogdhnīṃ savatsāṃ tu naro nakṣatre somadaivate ..
dattvā divyavimānasthaḥ svargaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam .. 8 ..
meaning:
दोग्ध्नीं सवत्सां तु नरो नक्षत्रे सोमदैवते ..
दत्त्वा दिव्यविमानस्थः स्वर्गं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Giving a milch cow along with her calf under the asterism whose deity is Soma, / a person, seated in a celestial chariot, attains unsurpassed heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
ārdrāyāṃ kṛśarāṃ dattvā tilamiśrā samāhitaḥ ..
narastarati durgāṇi sarvāṇyeva narottama .. 9 ..
meaning:
आर्द्रायां कृशरां दत्त्वा तिलमिश्रा समाहितः ..
नरस्तरति दुर्गाणि सर्वाण्येव नरोत्तम .. 9 ..
text_mt: Having given kṛśarā mixed with sesame under Ārdrā with a collected mind, / a man crosses over all difficulties, O best of men.

sanskrit_iast:
pūṣānpunarvasau dattvā ghṛtapūrṇānsupācitān ..
yaśasvī rūpasaṃpannaḥ sajjano jāyate kule .. 4.192.10 ..
meaning:
पूषान्पुनर्वसौ दत्त्वा घृतपूर्णान्सुपाचितान् ..
यशस्वी रूपसंपन्नः सज्जनो जायते कुले .. 4.192.10 ..
text_mt: Having given cakes filled with clarified butter and well-cooked under Punarvasu, / one is born in a noble family, renowned, endowed with handsome form, and virtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣye tu kāṃcanaṃ dattvā kṛtaṃ vākṛtameva vā ..
anālokeṣu lokeṣu somavatsa virājate ..11..
meaning:
पुष्ये तु कांचनं दत्त्वा कृतं वाकृतमेव वा ..
अनालोकेषु लोकेषु सोमवत्स विराजते ..11..
text_mt: Giving gold, whether worked or unworked, under Puṣya, / one shines like the moon even in unlit worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
āśleṣāsu tathā raupyaṃ yaḥ surūpaṃ prayacchati ..
sarvabhayavinirmuktaḥ śāstravānabhijāyate .. 12 ..
meaning:
आश्लेषासु तथा रौप्यं यः सुरूपं प्रयच्छति ..
सर्वभयविनिर्मुक्तः शास्त्रवानभिजायते .. 12 ..
text_mt: Likewise, he who gives handsome silver under Āśleṣā / is born free of all fears and learned in the treatises.

sanskrit_iast:
maghāsu tilapūrṇāni vardhamānāni mānavaḥ ..
pradāya paśumāṃścaiva putravāṃśca prajāyate ..13..
meaning:
मघासु तिलपूर्णानि वर्धमानानि मानवः ..
प्रदाय पशुमांश्चैव पुत्रवांश्च प्रजायते ..13..
text_mt: A person, having given vessels filled with sesame under Maghā, / is born possessing cattle and possessing sons.

sanskrit_iast:
phālgunīpūrvasamaye vaḍavāṃ dvijapuṃgave ..
