dattvā puṇyakṛtāṃllokānprāpnoti surasevitān .. 14 ..
meaning:
फाल्गुनीपूर्वसमये वडवां द्विजपुंगवे ..
दत्त्वा पुण्यकृतांल्लोकान्प्राप्नोति सुरसेवितान् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Having given a mare to an eminent twice-born man at the time of Pūrva-phālgunī, / one attains the worlds of the meritorious, frequented by the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
uttarāphālgunīyoge dattvā sauvarṇapaṃkajam ..
sūryalokamavāpnoti sarvabādhāvivarjitaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
उत्तराफाल्गुनीयोगे दत्त्वा सौवर्णपंकजम् ..
सूर्यलोकमवाप्नोति सर्वबाधाविवर्जितः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Having given a golden lotus under the conjunction of Uttara-phālgunī, / free of all afflictions, one attains the realm of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
haste tu hastinaṃ dattvā kāṃcanaṃ śaktitaḥ kṛtam ..
yātyasau śakrasadanaṃ varavāraṇadhūrgataḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
हस्ते तु हस्तिनं दत्त्वा कांचनं शक्तितः कृतम् ..
यात्यसौ शक्रसदनं वरवारणधूर्गतः .. 16 ..
text_mt: Having given an elephant made of gold according to one's capacity under Hasta, / one goes to Śakra's abode, seated on the pole of an excellent elephant.

sanskrit_iast:
citrāsu vṛṣabhaṃ dattvā puṇyānāṃ puṇyamuttamam ..
caratyapsarasāṃ loke modate naṃdanevane .. 17 ..
meaning:
चित्रासु वृषभं दत्त्वा पुण्यानां पुण्यमुत्तमम् ..
चरत्यप्सरसां लोके मोदते नंदनेवने .. 17 ..
text_mt: Having given a bull under Citrā, the highest merit among merits, / one wanders in the world of the apsarases and rejoices in the Nandana grove.

sanskrit_iast:
svātīṣu ca dhanaṃ dattvā yadabhīṣṭamihātmanaḥ ..
prāpnoti ca śubhāṃllokāniha loke mahadyaśaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
स्वातीषु च धनं दत्त्वा यदभीष्टमिहात्मनः ..
प्राप्नोति च शुभांल्लोकानिह लोके महद्यशः .. 18 ..
text_mt: And having given wealth under Svātī, whatever is cherished by oneself here, / one attains auspicious worlds and great fame in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
viśākhāsu mahārāja dhuraṃdharavibhūṣitam ..
sopaskaraṃ ca śakaṭaṃ sadhānyaṃ vastrasaṃvṛtam .. 19 ..
meaning:
विशाखासु महाराज धुरंधरविभूषितम् ..
सोपस्करं च शकटं सधान्यं वस्त्रसंवृतम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: Under Viśākhā, O great king, having given a cart equipped with accessories, / adorned with a yoke-bearer, with grain, and covered with cloth,

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā prīṇāti sa pituḥ pretya cānantyamaśnute ..
na ca durgāṇyavāpnoti rauravādīni mānavaḥ .. 4.192.20 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वा प्रीणाति स पितुः प्रेत्य चानन्त्यमश्नुते ..
न च दुर्गाण्यवाप्नोति रौरवादीनि मानवः .. 4.192.20 ..
text_mt: he pleases his ancestors, and after death attains infinity, / nor does the man encounter terrible hells such as Raurava.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā yatheṣṭaṃ viprebhyo gatimiṣṭāṃ sa gacchati ..
kambalānyanurādhakṣeṃ dattvā prāvaraṇāni ca .. 21 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वा यथेष्टं विप्रेभ्यो गतिमिष्टां स गच्छति ..
कम्बलान्यनुराधक्षें दत्त्वा प्रावरणानि च .. 21 ..
text_mt: Having given as much as desired to the vipras, he goes to his desired state; / having given blankets and outer garments under the asterism Anurādhā,

sanskrit_iast:
svarge varṣaśataṃ sāgramāste suragaṇairvṛtaḥ ..
kālaśākaṃ ca viprebhyo dattvā martyaḥ samūlakam .. 22 ..
meaning:
स्वर्गे वर्षशतं साग्रमास्ते सुरगणैर्वृतः ..
कालशाकं च विप्रेभ्यो दत्त्वा मर्त्यः समूलकम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: he resides in heaven for a full hundred years, surrounded by hosts of gods; / having given kālaśāka greens along with roots to the vipras,

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhānujyeṣṭhatāmeti gatimiṣṭāṃ ca gacchati ..
mūle mūlaphalaṃ dattvā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samāhitaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
ज्येष्ठानुज्येष्ठतामेति गतिमिष्टां च गच्छति ..
मूले मूलफलं दत्त्वा ब्राह्मणेभ्यः समाहितः .. 23 ..
text_mt: under Jyeṣṭhā, a mortal attains supremacy and goes to his desired state; / having given roots and fruit to brāhmaṇas under Mūla with a collected mind,

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝnprīṇayate sarvāngatiṃ prāpnotyanuttamām ..
atha pūrvāsvaṣāḍhāsu dadhipātrāṇi mānavaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
पितॄन्प्रीणयते सर्वान्गतिं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमाम् ..
अथ पूर्वास्वषाढासु दधिपात्राणि मानवः .. 24 ..
text_mt: he pleases all the ancestors and attains an unsurpassed destination; / then under Pūrvāṣāḍhā, a man [giving] vessels of curd

sanskrit_iast:
kulavṛttopasampanne brāhmaṇe vedapārage ..
pradāya jāyate pretya kule ca bahubhogavān .. 25 ..
meaning:
कुलवृत्तोपसम्पन्ने ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे ..
प्रदाय जायते प्रेत्य कुले च बहुभोगवान् .. 25 ..
text_mt: having given [them] to a brāhmaṇa endowed with good family and conduct, who has mastered the Veda, / he is reborn after death in a [noble] family, possessing manifold enjoyments,

sanskrit_iast:
putrapautraiḥ parivṛtaḥ paśumāndhanavāṃstathā ..
udamaṃthaṃ sasarpiṣkaṃ prabhūtamadhuphāṇitam .. 26 ..
meaning:
पुत्रपौत्रैः परिवृतः पशुमान्धनवांस्तथा ..
उदमंथं ससर्पिष्कं प्रभूतमधुफाणितम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: surrounded by sons and grandsons, possessing cattle and wealth. / Having given a barley-groat beverage with ghee and abundant honey and molasses

sanskrit_iast:
dattvottarāsvaṣāḍhāsu sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt..
dugdhaṃ tvabhijito bhāge
dattvā ghṛtamadhuplutam .. 27 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वोत्तरास्वषाढासु सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात्..
दुग्धं त्वभिजितो भागे
दत्त्वा घृतमधुप्लुतम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: under Uttarāṣāḍhā, he obtains all desires. / But having given milk filled with ghee and honey under the portion of Abhijit,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmanityo manīṣibhyaḥ svarge vasati puṇyabhāk ..
śravaṇe pustakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pradadātīha yo naraḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
धर्मनित्यो मनीषिभ्यः स्वर्गे वसति पुण्यभाक् ..
श्रवणे पुस्तकं श्रेष्ठं प्रददातीह यो नरः .. 28 ..
text_mt: always devoted to dharma, [giving it] to wise men, he dwells in heaven sharing in merit. / The man who gives an excellent book here under Śravaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
svecchayā yāti yānena sarvāṃllokānna saṃśayaḥ ..
goyugaṃ ca dhaniṣṭhāsu dattvā viprāya mānavaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
स्वेच्छया याति यानेन सर्वांल्लोकान्न संशयः ..
गोयुगं च धनिष्ठासु दत्त्वा विप्राय मानवः .. 29 ..
text_mt: goes at will in a vehicle to all the worlds; there is no doubt. / And a man, having given a pair of oxen to a vipra under Dhaniṣṭhā,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatra mānamāpnoti yatra yatreha jāyate ..
tathā śatabhiṣāyoge dattvā sāgaru caṃdanam .. 4.192.30 ..
meaning:
सर्वत्र मानमाप्नोति यत्र यत्रेह जायते ..
तथा शतभिषायोगे दत्त्वा सागरु चंदनम् .. 4.192.30 ..
text_mt: receives honour everywhere, wherever he is born in this world. / Likewise, having given sandalwood along with aloe under the conjunction of Śatabhiṣaj,

sanskrit_iast:
prāpnotyapsarasāṃ loke pretya gaṃdhāṃśca śobhanān ..
pūrvabhādrapadāyoge rājamāṣānpradāpayet .. 31 ..
meaning:
प्राप्नोत्यप्सरसां लोके प्रेत्य गंधांश्च शोभनान् ..
पूर्वभाद्रपदायोगे राजमाषान्प्रदापयेत् .. 31 ..
text_mt: after death he reaches the world of the apsarases and lovely perfumes. / Under the conjunction of Pūrvabhādrapadā, he should give royal beans;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhakṣaphalopetaḥ sa vai pretya sukhī bhavet ..
ratnamuttarayoge tu suvastraṃ yaḥ prayacchati ..32..
meaning:
सर्वभक्षफलोपेतः स वै प्रेत्य सुखी भवेत् ..
रत्नमुत्तरयोगे तु सुवस्त्रं यः प्रयच्छति ..32..
text_mt: endowed with every edible food and fruit, he becomes happy after death. / But he who gives a gem and fine cloth under the northern conjunction (Uttarabhādrapadā),

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝnprīṇāti sakalānpretya cānaṃtyamaśnute ..
kāṃsyopadohanāṃ dhenuṃ revatyāṃ yaḥ prayacchati .. 33 ..
meaning:
पितॄन्प्रीणाति सकलान्प्रेत्य चानंत्यमश्नुते ..
कांस्योपदोहनां धेनुं रेवत्यां यः प्रयच्छति .. 33 ..
text_mt: gratifies all the ancestors and enjoys eternity after death. / He who gives a cow with a bronze milking pail under Revatī,

sanskrit_iast:
sa pretya kāmānādāya dātāramupagacchati ..
rathamaśvasamāyuktaṃ dattvāśvinyāṃ narottama .. 34 ..
meaning:
स प्रेत्य कामानादाय दातारमुपगच्छति ..
रथमश्वसमायुक्तं दत्त्वाश्विन्यां नरोत्तम .. 34 ..
text_mt: after death, having taken his desires, she comes to the giver. / Having given a chariot harnessed with horses under Aśvinī, O best of men,

sanskrit_iast:
hastyaśvarathasaṃpūrṇe varcasvī jāyate kule ..
bharaṇīṣu dvijātibhyastiladhenuṃ pradāya vai .. 35 ..
meaning:
हस्त्यश्वरथसंपूर्णे वर्चस्वी जायते कुले ..
भरणीषु द्विजातिभ्यस्तिलधेनुं प्रदाय वै .. 35 ..
text_mt: he is born radiant in a family filled with elephants, horses, and chariots. / Indeed, having given a cow made of sesame seeds to the twice-born under Bharaṇī,

sanskrit_iast:
gāvaḥ prabhūtāḥ prāpnoti naraḥ pretya yaśastathā ..
ityeṣa dakṣiṇoddeśaḥ prokto nakṣatrayogataḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
गावः प्रभूताः प्राप्नोति नरः प्रेत्य यशस्तथा ..
इत्येष दक्षिणोद्देशः प्रोक्तो नक्षत्रयोगतः .. 36 ..
text_mt: a man obtains abundant cattle and fame after death. / Thus this teaching on donations according to the conjunctions of constellations has been declared,

sanskrit_iast:
devakyai nāradenaiva mayā ca kathitastava ..
sarvapāpapraśamanaḥ sarvopadravanāśanaḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
देवक्यै नारदेनैव मया च कथितस्तव ..
सर्वपापप्रशमनः सर्वोपद्रवनाशनः .. 37 ..
text_mt: which was told to Devakī by Nārada and by me to you, / which allays all sins and destroys all afflictions.

sanskrit_iast:
na cātra kālaniyamo nakṣatraprakamastathā ..
vittaṃ śraddhā ca rājendra kāraṇaṃ cātra kathyate .. 38 ..
yadyacca te bhagavatā kamalodbhavasya putreṇa dānamuditaṃ prasamīkṣya vedān..
meaning:
न चात्र कालनियमो नक्षत्रप्रकमस्तथा ..
वित्तं श्रद्धा च राजेन्द्र कारणं चात्र कथ्यते .. 38 ..
यद्यच्च ते भगवता कमलोद्भवस्य पुत्रेण दानमुदितं प्रसमीक्ष्य वेदान्..
text_mt:
And here there is no restriction of time, nor the sequence of the constellations; / wealth and faith, O best of kings, are declared to be the cause here.
Whatever gift has been declared to you by the venerable son of the lotus-born (Nārada) having examined the Vedas,

sanskrit_iast:
tadyo dadāti vibhave sati sādhuvṛtte kiṃ tena pārtha na kṛtaṃ bhavatīha loke .. 39 ..
tithidānavarṇanam
meaning:
तद्यो ददाति विभवे सति साधुवृत्ते किं तेन पार्थ न कृतं भवतीह लोके .. 39 ..
तिथिदानवर्णनम्
text_mt:
whoever gives that when wealth is available, being of righteous conduct—what has not been accomplished by him here in this world, O son of Pṛthā?
Description of Gifts on Lunar Days

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
tithidānamidānīṃ te kathayāmi yudhiṣṭhira ..
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvavighnavināśanam ..1..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
तिथिदानमिदानीं ते कथयामि युधिष्ठिर ..
सर्वपापप्रशमनं सर्वविघ्नविनाशनम् ..1..
text_mt: The venerable Kṛṣṇa said: / I shall now tell you the gift on lunar days, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / which allays all sins and destroys all obstacles.
title: Tithidānavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
mānasaṃ vācikaṃ cāpi karmajaṃ yadaghaṃ bhavet ..
sarvaṃ praśamamāyāti dānenānena pāṃḍava ..2..
meaning:
मानसं वाचिकं चापि कर्मजं यदघं भवेत् ..
सर्वं प्रशममायाति दानेनानेन पांडव ..2..
text_mt: Whatever sin there may be, whether mental, vocal, or born of action, / it all comes to cessation by this gift, O Pāṇḍava.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvaṇe kārtike caitre vaiśākhe phālgune tathā ..
sitapakṣātprabhṛtyeva dātavyaṃ puṇyavarddhanam .. 3 ..
meaning:
श्रावणे कार्तिके चैत्रे वैशाखे फाल्गुने तथा ..
सितपक्षात्प्रभृत्येव दातव्यं पुण्यवर्द्धनम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: In Śrāvaṇa, Kārtika, Caitra, Vaiśākha, and Phālguna, / beginning indeed from the bright fortnight, that which increases merit should be given.

sanskrit_iast:
vittaṃ śraddhāsahāyaśca pātraprāptistathaiva ca ..
dānakālaḥ sadaiveha kathitastattvadarśibhiḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
वित्तं श्रद्धासहायश्च पात्रप्राप्तिस्तथैव च ..
दानकालः सदैवेह कथितस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Wealth, the assistance of faith, and likewise the obtaining of a worthy recipient: / this is ever declared by the seers of truth to be the time for giving here.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthe devālaye goṣṭhe gṛhe vā niyatātmavān ..
yaddadāti naraśreṣṭhastadānaṃtyāya kalpate ..5..
meaning:
तीर्थे देवालये गोष्ठे गृहे वा नियतात्मवान् ..
यद्ददाति नरश्रेष्ठस्तदानंत्याय कल्पते ..5..
text_mt: In a holy bath, a temple of the gods, a cowshed, or at home, self-restrained, / whatever the best of men gives leads to eternity.

sanskrit_iast:
pratipatsu dvijānpūjyapta pūjayitvā prajāpatim..
sauvarṇamaravindaṃ ca kārayitvāṣṭapatrakam .. 6 ..
meaning:
प्रतिपत्सु द्विजान्पूज्यप्त पूजयित्वा प्रजापतिम्..
सौवर्णमरविन्दं च कारयित्वाष्टपत्रकम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Having honoured the twice-born on the first lunar days and worshipped Prajāpati, / and having caused a golden eight-petalled lotus to be made,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā caudumbare pātre sugandhavṛtapūrite ..
puṣpairdhūpaiḥ pūjayitvā viprāya pratipāda yet ..7..
meaning:
कृत्वा चौदुम्बरे पात्रे सुगन्धवृतपूरिते ..
पुष्पैर्धूपैः पूजयित्वा विप्राय प्रतिपाद येत् ..7..
text_mt: and having placed it in an udumbara vessel filled with fragrant ghee, / having worshipped it with flowers and incenses, one should offer it to a vipra.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā dattvā kamalaṃ kamalālayam ..
īpsitāṃllabhate kāmānniṣkāmo brahmasātmyatām ..8..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना दत्त्वा कमलं कमलालयम् ..
ईप्सितांल्लभते कामान्निष्कामो ब्रह्मसात्म्यताम् ..8..
text_mt: Having given the lotus, the abode of Kamalā, according to this rule, / he obtains his sought-after desires, or free from desire, attains unity with Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
vahniṃ pūjya dvitīyāyāṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvariti kramāt ..
tilājyena śataṃ hutvā dattvā pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ ..9..
vaiśvānaraṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ sthāpayettāmrabhājane ..
guḍājyapūrite rājaṃstoyapūrṇaghaṭopari ..4.193.1 0..
pūjayitvā vastramālyairbhakṣyabhojyairanekadhā ..
tatastaṃ brāhmaṇe dadyādvahnirme prīyatāmiti ..1 1..
meaning:
वह्निं पूज्य द्वितीयायां भूर्भुवःस्वरिति क्रमात् ..
तिलाज्येन शतं हुत्वा दत्त्वा पूर्णाहुतिं ततः ..9..
वैश्वानरं तु सौवर्णं स्थापयेत्ताम्रभाजने ..
गुडाज्यपूरिते राजंस्तोयपूर्णघटोपरि ..4.193.1 0..
पूजयित्वा वस्त्रमाल्यैर्भक्ष्यभोज्यैरनेकधा ..
ततस्तं ब्राह्मणे दद्याद्वह्निर्मे प्रीयतामिति ..1 1..
text_mt:
Having worshipped the sacred fire on the second lunar day with 'bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ' in due order, / having made a hundred oblations of sesame and ghee, and then having given the full oblation,
one should place a golden fire in a copper vessel / filled with jaggery and ghee upon a pot filled with water, O king.
Having worshipped it with garments and garlands, and with varied eatables and foodstuffs, / one should then give it to a brāhmaṇa, [saying,] 'May the sacred fire be pleased with me.'

sanskrit_iast:
yāvajjīvakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
mṛto vahni puraṃ yāti prāhedaṃ nārado muniḥ ..12..
meaning:
यावज्जीवकृतात्पापान्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ..
मृतो वह्नि पुरं याति प्राहेदं नारदो मुनिः ..12..
text_mt: He is released from sin committed throughout his life; there is no doubt here. / When dead, he goes to the realm of fire; the sage Nārada declared this.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyāyāṃ mahārāja rādhāṃ svarṇamayīṃ śubhām ..
sthāpayitvā tāmrapātre lavaṇopari vinyaset ..13..
meaning:
तृतीयायां महाराज राधां स्वर्णमयीं शुभाम् ..
स्थापयित्वा ताम्रपात्रे लवणोपरि विन्यसेत् ..13..
text_mt: On the third lunar day, O great king, having set up an auspicious golden Rādhā / in a copper vessel, one should place it upon salt.

sanskrit_iast:
jīrakaṃ kaṭukaṃ caiva guḍaṃ pārtheṣu dāpayet ..
raktavastrayugacchannāṃ kuṃkumena vibhūṣitām .. 14 ..
meaning:
जीरकं कटुकं चैव गुडं पार्थेषु दापयेत् ..
रक्तवस्त्रयुगच्छन्नां कुंकुमेन विभूषिताम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: One should give cumin, pungent spices, and jaggery on earthen dishes, O son of Pṛthā; / covered with a pair of red garments, adorned with saffron,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpadhūpaiḥ sanaivedyaiḥ pūjayitvā dvijātaye ..
dattvā yatphalamāpnoti pārtha tatkena varṇyate .. 15 ..
meaning:
पुष्पधूपैः सनैवेद्यैः पूजयित्वा द्विजातये ..
दत्त्वा यत्फलमाप्नोति पार्थ तत्केन वर्ण्यते .. 15 ..
text_mt: having worshipped it with flowers, incenses, and food offerings, / what fruit one obtains by giving it to a twice-born, by whom can that be described, O son of Pṛthā?

sanskrit_iast:
prāsādā yatra sauvarṇā nadyaḥ pāyasakardamāḥ..
gandharvāpsaraso yatra tatra te yāṃti mānavāḥ ..16..
meaning:
प्रासादा यत्र सौवर्णा नद्यः पायसकर्दमाः..
गन्धर्वाप्सरसो यत्र तत्र ते यांति मानवाः ..16..
text_mt: Where there are golden palaces and rivers of rice-milk mud, / where there are gandharvas and apsarases, thither those people go.

sanskrit_iast:
svargādihaitya saṃsāre surūpaḥ subhago bhavet ..
dātā bhoktā bahudhanaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
स्वर्गादिहैत्य संसारे सुरूपः सुभगो भवेत् ..
दाता भोक्ता बहुधनः पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Returning here to the world of transmigration from heaven, he becomes handsome and fortunate, / a giver, an enjoyer, possessing much wealth, endowed with sons and grandsons;

sanskrit_iast:
nārī vā tadguṇairyuktā bhavatīha na saṃśayaḥ ..
caturthyāṃ vāraṇaṃ haimaṃ palādūrddhvaṃ suśobhanam .. 18 ..
meaning:
नारी वा तद्गुणैर्युक्ता भवतीह न संशयः ..
चतुर्थ्यां वारणं हैमं पलादूर्द्ध्वं सुशोभनम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: or a woman endowed with those virtues comes to be here, without doubt. / On the fourth lunar day, having caused a golden elephant to be made,

sanskrit_iast:
kāmayitvāṃkuśayutaṃ tiladroṇopari nyaset ..
vastraiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayitvā naiveyaṃ vinivedya ca .. 19 ..
meaning:
कामयित्वांकुशयुतं तिलद्रोणोपरि न्यसेत् ..
वस्त्रैः पुष्पैः पूजयित्वा नैवेयं विनिवेद्य च .. 19 ..
text_mt: weighing more than a pala, very beautiful, accompanied by a goad, one should place it on a droṇa of sesame; / having worshipped it with garments and flowers, and having offered a food offering,

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu brāhmaṇe dadyādgaṇeśaḥ prīyatāmiti ..
kāryāraṃbheṣu sarveṣu tasya vighnaṃ na jāyate .. 4.193.20 ..
meaning:
ततस्तु ब्राह्मणे दद्याद्गणेशः प्रीयतामिति ..
कार्यारंभेषु सर्वेषु तस्य विघ्नं न जायते .. 4.193.20 ..
text_mt: one should then give it to a brāhmaṇa, [saying,] 'May Gaṇeśa be pleased.' / At the beginning of all undertakings, no obstacle arises for him.

sanskrit_iast:
vāraṇāḥ sapta janmāni bhavaṃti madavihvalāḥ ..
vāraṇendrasamārūḍhastrailokyavijayī bhavet .. 21 ..
meaning:
वारणाः सप्त जन्मानि भवंति मदविह्वलाः ..
वारणेन्द्रसमारूढस्त्रैलोक्यविजयी भवेत् .. 21 ..
text_mt: For seven lifetimes there are elephants frantic with rut [in his possession]; / mounted on an elephant-lord, he becomes a conqueror of the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcamyāṃ pannagaṃ caiva svarṇenaikena kārayet ..
kṣīrājyapatramadhyasthaṃ pūjayitvā pradāpayet .. 22 ..
meaning:
पंचम्यां पन्नगं चैव स्वर्णेनैकेन कारयेत् ..
क्षीराज्यपत्रमध्यस्थं पूजयित्वा प्रदापयेत् .. 22 ..
text_mt: And on the fifth lunar day, one should cause a serpent to be made of one [measure of] gold; / resting in the middle of a leaf with milk and ghee, having worshipped it, one should give it.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijaṃ saṃpūjya vāsobhiḥ praṇipatya kṣamāpayet ..
iha loke pare caiva dānametatsukhāvaham .. 23 ..
meaning:
द्विजं संपूज्य वासोभिः प्रणिपत्य क्षमापयेत् ..
इह लोके परे चैव दानमेतत्सुखावहम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Having honoured the twice-born with garments, having bowed down, one should ask for forbearance; / this gift brings happiness in this world and in the next world.

sanskrit_iast:
nāgopadravavidrāvi sarvaduṣṭanibarhaṇam ..
prāyaścittaṃ tathā proktaṃ nāgadaṣṭasya śaṃbhunā .. 24 ..
meaning:
नागोपद्रवविद्रावि सर्वदुष्टनिबर्हणम् ..
प्रायश्चित्तं तथा प्रोक्तं नागदष्टस्य शंभुना .. 24 ..
text_mt: It drives away afflictions caused by serpents and destroys all evils; / likewise it has been declared by Śambhu as an expiation for one bitten by a snake.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śaktisamopetaṃ kumāraṃ śikhivāhanam ..
kārayitvā yathāśaktyā hemamālāvibhūṣitam .. 25 ..
meaning:
षष्ठ्यां शक्तिसमोपेतं कुमारं शिखिवाहनम् ..
कारयित्वा यथाशक्त्या हेममालाविभूषितम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: On the sixth lunar day, having caused Kumāra, who rides the peacock, / to be made according to one's ability, endowed with his spear, adorned with a golden garland,

sanskrit_iast:
taṃḍulenātha śikhare vāsobhiḥ pūjya bhaktitaḥ ..
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ skaṃdaṃ yathāśakti kṛtvā skaṃdaṃ hiraṇmayam .. 26 ..
meaning:
तंडुलेनाथ शिखरे वासोभिः पूज्य भक्तितः ..
षष्ठ्यां स्कंदं यथाशक्ति कृत्वा स्कंदं हिरण्मयम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: upon a heap of husked grains, having worshipped him with cloths in devotion, / having made Skanda of gold according to one's ability on the sixth lunar day,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā gaṃdhapuṣpadhūpainaivedyatastathā ..
namaskṛtya tato dadyādbrāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine .. 27 ..
meaning:
पूजयित्वा गंधपुष्पधूपैनैवेद्यतस्तथा ..
नमस्कृत्य ततो दद्याद्ब्राह्मणाय कुटुंबिने .. 27 ..
text_mt: having worshipped him with perfumes, flowers, incenses, and food offerings, / and having bowed down, one should then give it to a householder brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
iha bhūtiṃ parāṃ prāpya pretya svarge mahīyate ..
śūdro brāhmaṇatāmeti brāhmaṇo brahmalokatām .. 28 ..
meaning:
इह भूतिं परां प्राप्य प्रेत्य स्वर्गे महीयते ..
शूद्रो ब्राह्मणतामेति ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मलोकताम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Attaining supreme prosperity here, upon death he is magnified in heaven; / a śūdra attains the state of a brāhmaṇa, and a brāhmaṇa attains the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
saptamyāṃ bhāskaraṃ pūjya brāhmaṇānaśvamuttamam ..
dadyādalaṃkṛtagrīvaṃ saparyāṇaṃ sadakṣiṇam .. 29 ..
meaning:
सप्तम्यां भास्करं पूज्य ब्राह्मणानश्वमुत्तमम् ..
दद्यादलंकृतग्रीवं सपर्याणं सदक्षिणम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: On the seventh [tithi], having worshipped the Sun, he should give to a brāhmaṇa an excellent horse, / its neck adorned, fitted with a saddle, along with a sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryalokamavāpnoti sūryeṇa saha modate ..
gaṃdharvāstuṣṭimāyāṃti datte'śve samalaṃkṛte .. 4.193.30 ..
meaning:
सूर्यलोकमवाप्नोति सूर्येण सह मोदते ..
गंधर्वास्तुष्टिमायांति दत्तेऽश्वे समलंकृते .. 4.193.30 ..
text_mt: He attains the world of Sūrya and rejoices together with Sūrya; / the gandharvas attain satisfaction when an adorned horse is given.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭamyāṃ vṛṣabhaṃ śvetamavyaṃgāṃgaṃ dhuraṃdharam ..
sitavastrayugacchannaṃ ghaṃṭābharaṇabhūṣitam .. 31 ..
meaning:
अष्टम्यां वृषभं श्वेतमव्यंगांगं धुरंधरम् ..
सितवस्त्रयुगच्छन्नं घंटाभरणभूषितम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: On the eighth [tithi], [he should give] a white bull, unblemished in its limbs, capable of bearing the yoke, / covered with a pair of white garments and adorned with bell-ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
dadyātpraṇamya viprāya prīyatāṃ vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ..
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā ādvārāṃtamanuvrajet .. 32 ..
meaning:
दद्यात्प्रणम्य विप्राय प्रीयतां वृषभध्वजः ..
प्रदक्षिणं ततः कृत्वा आद्वारांतमनुव्रजेत् .. 32 ..
text_mt: Bowing, he should give it to a vipra, [saying,] 'May the Bull-bannered [Śiva] be pleased.' / Then, having circumambulated it, he should follow it as far as the doorway.

sanskrit_iast:
dānenānena nṛpate śivaloko na durlabhaḥ ..
vṛṣaskaṃdhe pratiṣṭhaṃti bhuvanāni caturdaśa .. 33 ..
meaning:
दानेनानेन नृपते शिवलोको न दुर्लभः ..
वृषस्कंधे प्रतिष्ठंति भुवनानि चतुर्दश .. 33 ..
text_mt: By this gift, O king, the world of Śiva is not difficult to attain; / the fourteen worlds abide upon the shoulder of the bull.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādvṛṣabhadānena dattā bhavati bhāratī ..
navamyāṃ kāṃcanaṃ siṃhaṃ kārayitvā svaśaktitaḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
तस्माद्वृषभदानेन दत्ता भवति भारती ..
नवम्यां कांचनं सिंहं कारयित्वा स्वशक्तितः .. 34 ..
text_mt: Therefore, through the gift of a bull, the earth has been given. / On the ninth [tithi], having a golden lion made according to one's capacity,

sanskrit_iast:
muktāphalāṣṭakayutaṃ nīlavastrāvaguṇṭhitam ..
dadyāddevīmanusmṛtya duṣṭadaityanibarhaṇīm .. 35 ..
meaning:
मुक्ताफलाष्टकयुतं नीलवस्त्रावगुण्ठितम् ..
दद्याद्देवीमनुस्मृत्य दुष्टदैत्यनिबर्हणीम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: endowed with eight pearls and veiled with a blue cloth, / one should give it, remembering the Goddess who destroys wicked demons,

sanskrit_iast:
dvijātipravarāyetthaṃ sarvānkāmānsamaśnute ..
kāṃtāravanadurgeṣu cauravyālā kule pathi .. 36 ..
meaning:
द्विजातिप्रवरायेत्थं सर्वान्कामान्समश्नुते ..
कांतारवनदुर्गेषु चौरव्याला कुले पथि .. 36 ..
text_mt: to an eminent twice-born man. In this way he attains all desires. / In dense forests, difficult terrain, and on roads infested with thieves and beasts of prey,

sanskrit_iast:
hiṃsakāstaṃ na hiṃsaṃti dānasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ..
mṛto devīpuraṃ yāti pūjyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
हिंसकास्तं न हिंसंति दानस्यास्य प्रभावतः ..
मृतो देवीपुरं याति पूज्यमानः सुरासुरैः .. 37 ..
text_mt: violent beings do not harm him by the power of this gift. / When he dies, he goes to the city of the Goddess, worshipped by gods and asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ..
daśamyāṃ nṛpaśārdūla daśāśāḥ svarṇanirmitāḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
पुण्यक्षयादिहाभ्येत्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः ..
दशम्यां नृपशार्दूल दशाशाः स्वर्णनिर्मिताः .. 38 ..
text_mt: When his merit is exhausted, he returns here and becomes a righteous king. / On the tenth [tithi], O tiger among kings, [he should make images of] the ten directions fashioned of gold,

sanskrit_iast:
lavaṇe ca guḍe kṣīre niṣpāveṣu tileṣu ca ..
gavyatraye taṃduleṣu māṣāṇā supari sthitāḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
लवणे च गुडे क्षीरे निष्पावेषु तिलेषु च ..
गव्यत्रये तंदुलेषु माषाणा सुपरि स्थिताः .. 39 ..
text_mt: placed upon salt, jaggery, milk, kidney beans, sesame seeds, / the three products of the cow, rice grains, and black gram.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya vastrapuṣpādyairdvijāya pratipādayet ..
anena vidhinā yastu pumānstrī vātha vā punaḥ .. 4.193.40 ..
meaning:
संपूज्य वस्त्रपुष्पाद्यैर्द्विजाय प्रतिपादयेत् ..
अनेन विधिना यस्तु पुमान्स्त्री वाथ वा पुनः .. 4.193.40 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped them with garments, flowers, and the like, he should present them to a twice-born man. / Whichever man, or even woman, who according to this rite

sanskrit_iast:
nirvāpayati rājeṃdra tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ..
iha loke bhūpatiḥ syātpretya svarge mahīyate ..41..
meaning:
निर्वापयति राजेंद्र तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु ..
इह लोके भूपतिः स्यात्प्रेत्य स्वर्गे महीयते ..41..
text_mt: accomplishes [it], O lord of kings, hear the fruit of that merit: / in this world he becomes a lord of the earth, and upon death he is magnified in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
sakalāstasya sarvāśā yāḥ kāścinmanasecchitāḥ ..
tataḥ svargādihābhyetya kule mahati jāyate .. 42 ..
meaning:
सकलास्तस्य सर्वाशा याः काश्चिन्मनसेच्छिताः ..
ततः स्वर्गादिहाभ्येत्य कुले महति जायते .. 42 ..
text_mt: All his hopes whatsoever, desired in his heart, are fulfilled; / then, returning here from heaven, he is born into a great family.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyāṃ garutmaṃtaṃ kārayitvā hiraṇmayam ..
yathāśaktyā tāmrapātre ghṛtasyopari pūjitam .. 43 ..
meaning:
एकादश्यां गरुत्मंतं कारयित्वा हिरण्मयम् ..
यथाशक्त्या ताम्रपात्रे घृतस्योपरि पूजितम् .. 43 ..
text_mt: On the eleventh [tithi], having a golden Garuda made / according to one's capacity, worshipped upon ghee in a copper vessel,

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcāgnyabhirate vipre purāṇajñe viśeṣataḥ ..
dattvā kiṃ bahunoktena viṣṇuloke mahīyate .. 44 ..
meaning:
पंचाग्न्यभिरते विप्रे पुराणज्ञे विशेषतः ..
दत्त्वा किं बहुनोक्तेन विष्णुलोके महीयते .. 44 ..
text_mt: and giving it to a vipra devoted to the five sacred fires, especially one knowledgeable in the Purāṇas— / what need of saying more?—he is magnified in the world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
gāṃ vṛṣaṃ mahiṣīṃ hemaṃ saptadhānyānyajāvikam ..
vaḍavāṃ guraḍarasānsa rvāṃstathā bahuphaladrumān .. 45 ..
meaning:
गां वृषं महिषीं हेमं सप्तधान्यान्यजाविकम् ..
वडवां गुरडरसान्स र्वांस्तथा बहुफलद्रुमान् .. 45 ..
text_mt: A cow, a bull, a female buffalo, gold, the seven grains, goats and sheep, / a mare, sugar-cane juice, all types of fruit trees,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpāṇi ca vicitrāṇi gaṃdhāṃścoccāvacānbahūn ..
yathāśaktyā melayitvā vastrairācchādayennavaiḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
पुष्पाणि च विचित्राणि गंधांश्चोच्चावचान्बहून् ..
यथाशक्त्या मेलयित्वा वस्त्रैराच्छादयेन्नवैः .. 46 ..
text_mt: variegated flowers, and many varied perfumes— / having assembled these according to capacity, he should cover them with fresh garments.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāṃ dvādaśaitāni brāhmaṇebhyo nivedayet ..
ekasya vā mahārāja yatphalaṃ tanniśāmaya .. 47 ..
meaning:
द्वादश्यां द्वादशैतानि ब्राह्मणेभ्यो निवेदयेत् ..
एकस्य वा महाराज यत्फलं तन्निशामय .. 47 ..
text_mt: On the twelfth [tithi], he should offer these twelve to brāhmaṇas, / or [all of them] to one alone, O great king. Hear what the fruit is:

sanskrit_iast:
iha kīrtiṃ parāṃ prāpya bhuktvā bhogānyathepsitān ..
tato viṣṇupuraṃ yāti sevyamāno'psaroṇaṇaiḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
इह कीर्तिं परां प्राप्य भुक्त्वा भोगान्यथेप्सितान् ..
ततो विष्णुपुरं याति सेव्यमानोऽप्सरोणणैः .. 48 ..
text_mt: having attained supreme renown here and enjoyed desires as he wishes, / he then goes to the city of Viṣṇu, attended by hosts of apsarases.

sanskrit_iast:
karmakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ..
yajñayājī dānapatirjīvecca śaradāṃ śatam .. 49 ..
meaning:
कर्मक्षयादिहाभ्येत्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः ..
यज्ञयाजी दानपतिर्जीवेच्च शरदां शतम् .. 49 ..
text_mt: When his karma is exhausted, he returns here and becomes a righteous king; / he performs sacrifices, becomes a lord of generosity, and lives for a hundred autumns.

sanskrit_iast:
snāpayedbrāhmaṇāṃścātra trayodaśyāṃ trayodaśa ..
tānācchādya navairvastrairgaṃdhapuṣpairathārcayet .. .. 4.193.50 ..
meaning:
स्नापयेद्ब्राह्मणांश्चात्र त्रयोदश्यां त्रयोदश ..
तानाच्छाद्य नवैर्वस्त्रैर्गंधपुष्पैरथार्चयेत् .. .. 4.193.50 ..
text_mt: And on the thirteenth [tithi] here, he should bathe thirteen brāhmaṇas; / having covered them with fresh garments, he should then worship them with perfumes and flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
bhojayīta sumiṣṭānnaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ vinivedayet ..
yathāśaktyā hemakhaṇḍāndharmātmā prīyatāmiti .. 51 ..
meaning:
भोजयीत सुमिष्टान्नं दक्षिणां विनिवेदयेत् ..
यथाशक्त्या हेमखण्डान्धर्मात्मा प्रीयतामिति .. 51 ..
text_mt: He should feed them very sweet food and present a sacrificial fee / of gold pieces according to his capacity, [saying,] 'May the righteous-souled [Yama] be pleased.'

sanskrit_iast:
dharmarājāya kālāya citraguptāya daṃḍine ..
mṛtyave kṣayarūpāya aṃtakāya yamāya ca .. 52 ..
meaning:
धर्मराजाय कालाय चित्रगुप्ताय दंडिने ..
मृत्यवे क्षयरूपाय अंतकाय यमाय च .. 52 ..
text_mt: To Dharmarāja, to Kāla, to Citragupta, to Daṇḍin, / to Mṛtyu, to Kṣayarūpa, to Antaka, and to Yama,

sanskrit_iast:
pretanāthāya raudrāya tathā vaivasvatāya ca ..
mahiṣasthāya devāya nāmānīha trayodaśa .. 53 ..
meaning:
प्रेतनाथाय रौद्राय तथा वैवस्वताय च ..
महिषस्थाय देवाय नामानीह त्रयोदश .. 53 ..
text_mt: to the Lord of the Pretas, to Raudra, and likewise to Vaivasvata, / to the god mounted on a buffalo—the thirteen names here—

sanskrit_iast:
uccārya śraddhayā yuktaḥ praṇipatya visarjayet ..
yaḥ karoti mahārāja pūjāmetāṃ manoramām ..54..
meaning:
उच्चार्य श्रद्धया युक्तः प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् ..
यः करोति महाराज पूजामेतां मनोरमाम् ..54..
text_mt: pronouncing [them], endowed with faith, he should bow down and bid them farewell. / The man who performs this delightful worship for Yama, O great king,

sanskrit_iast:
yamāya sa sukhaṃ martye sthitvā vyādhivivarjitaḥ ..
yamamārgagataḥ paścādduḥkhaṃ nāpnotyasau pumān .. 95 ..
meaning:
यमाय स सुखं मर्त्ये स्थित्वा व्याधिविवर्जितः ..
यममार्गगतः पश्चाद्दुःखं नाप्नोत्यसौ पुमान् .. 95 ..
text_mt: having dwelt happily among mortals free from disease, / does not subsequently incur suffering when proceeding on the path of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
na paśyati pretamukhaṃ pitṛlokaṃ sa gacchati ..
puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya sa sukhī nīrujo bhavet .. 56 ..
meaning:
न पश्यति प्रेतमुखं पितृलोकं स गच्छति ..
पुण्यक्षयादिहाभ्येत्य स सुखी नीरुजो भवेत् .. 56 ..
text_mt: He does not look upon the face of a preta; he goes to the world of the ancestors. / When his merit is exhausted, he returns here, becoming happy and free from illness.

sanskrit_iast:
mahiṣaṃ suśubhaṃ kuṃbhaṃ caturdaśyāṃ payobhṛtam ..
taṃ karṣakeṇa saṃyuktaṃ hemnaḥ sadvastrasaṃyutam .. 57 ..
meaning:
महिषं सुशुभं कुंभं चतुर्दश्यां पयोभृतम् ..
तं कर्षकेण संयुक्तं हेम्नः सद्वस्त्रसंयुतम् .. 57 ..
text_mt: On the fourteenth [tithi], [he should prepare] an auspicious jar filled with milk [symbolising] a buffalo, / together with a ploughman fashioned of gold, accompanied by fine cloth,

sanskrit_iast:
ghaṃṭābharaṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ vṛṣabheṇa samanvitam ..
yo dadyācchivabhaktāya brāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine .. 58 ..
meaning:
घंटाभरणशोभाढ्यं वृषभेण समन्वितम् ..
यो दद्याच्छिवभक्ताय ब्राह्मणाय कुटुंबिने .. 58 ..
text_mt: richly adorned with bell-ornaments, and together with a bull. / Whoever gives it to a brāhmaṇa householder devoted to Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣaṃ dattvā naraśreṣṭha śivaloke mahīyate ..
tatra sthitvā ciraṃ kālaṃ kramādetya mahītalam .. 59 ..
meaning:
वृषं दत्त्वा नरश्रेष्ठ शिवलोके महीयते ..
तत्र स्थित्वा चिरं कालं क्रमादेत्य महीतलम् .. 59 ..
text_mt: having given a bull, O best of men, is magnified in the world of Śiva. / Having dwelt there for a long time, he gradually returns to the surface of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
ārogyadhanasaṃyukte kule mahati jāyate ..
sarvakāmasamṛddhyarthaṃ yāvajanmaśatatrayam .. .. 4.193.60 ..
meaning:
आरोग्यधनसंयुक्ते कुले महति जायते ..
सर्वकामसमृद्ध्यर्थं यावजन्मशतत्रयम् .. .. 4.193.60 ..
text_mt: and is born into a great family endowed with health and wealth / for three hundred lives, in order to fulfill all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
paurṇamāsyāṃ vṛṣotsargaṃ kārayitvā vidhānataḥ ..
caṃdrarajataniṣpannaṃ phalenaikena śobhanam .. 61 ..
meaning:
पौर्णमास्यां वृषोत्सर्गं कारयित्वा विधानतः ..
चंद्ररजतनिष्पन्नं फलेनैकेन शोभनम् .. 61 ..
text_mt: On the full moon day, having performed the release of a bull according to the ordinance, / [an image of] the moon made of silver, adorned with a fruit,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedgaṃdhakusumairnaivedyaṃ vinivedya ca ..
dadyādviprāya saṃkalpya vāsolaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 62 ..
meaning:
पूजयेद्गंधकुसुमैर्नैवेद्यं विनिवेद्य च ..
दद्याद्विप्राय संकल्प्य वासोलंकारभूषणैः .. 62 ..
text_mt: he should worship with fragrant flowers and, having presented food offerings, / he should resolve and give it to a vipra along with garments and ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
maṃtreṇānena rājendra tannibodha yathoditam ..
kṣīrodārṇavasaṃbhūta trailokyāṃgaṇadīpaka .. 63 ..
meaning:
मंत्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र तन्निबोध यथोदितम् ..
क्षीरोदार्णवसंभूत त्रैलोक्यांगणदीपक .. 63 ..
text_mt: with this mantra, O lord of kings; understand it as proclaimed: / 'O you who arose from the Ocean of Milk, O lamp in the courtyard of the three worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
umā pateḥ śiroratnaśivaṃ yaccha namonamaḥ ..
dānenānena nṛpate bhrājate caṃdravaddivi .. 64 ..
meaning:
उमा पतेः शिरोरत्नशिवं यच्छ नमोनमः ..
दानेनानेन नृपते भ्राजते चंद्रवद्दिवि .. 64 ..
text_mt: O crest-jewel of the lord of Umā, bestow well-being! Homage, homage to you!' / By this gift, O king, he shines like the moon in heaven,

sanskrit_iast: apsarobhiḥ parivṛto yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam ..65..
meaning: अप्सरोभिः परिवृतो यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् ..65..
text_mt: surrounded by apsarases until the dissolution of all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
dānānyamūni vidhivatprayatikrameṇa yacchaṃti ye dvijavarāya viśuddhasattvāḥ ..
te brahmaviṣṇubhuvaneṣu sukhaṃ vihṛtya yāṃtyekatāṃ saha śivena na saṃśayo me .. 66 ..
varāhadānavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
दानान्यमूनि विधिवत्प्रयतिक्रमेण यच्छंति ये द्विजवराय विशुद्धसत्त्वाः ..
ते ब्रह्मविष्णुभुवनेषु सुखं विहृत्य यांत्येकतां सह शिवेन न संशयो मे .. 66 ..
वराहदानविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Those whose being is pure, who duly offer these gifts in order of effort to the best of the twice-born, / having sported happily in the realms of Brahmā and Viṣṇu, go to oneness with Śiva; of this I have no doubt.
Description of the Rite of the Gift of the Boar.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ādivārāhadānaṃ ta kathayāmi yudhiṣṭhira ..
dharaṇyai yatpurā proktaṃ varāhavapuṣā mayā .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
आदिवाराहदानं त कथयामि युधिष्ठिर ..
धरण्यै यत्पुरा प्रोक्तं वराहवपुषा मया .. 1 ..
text_mt: The holy Kṛṣṇa said: / I will declare to you the gift of the primordial Boar, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / which was proclaimed long ago by me to the Earth in the form of a boar.
title: Varāhadānavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyaṃ pavitramāyuṣyaṃ sarva dānottamottamam ..
mahāpāpādidoṣaghnaṃ pūjitaṃ dharmasattamaiḥ.. 2..
meaning:
पुण्यं पवित्रमायुष्यं सर्व दानोत्तमोत्तमम् ..
महापापादिदोषघ्नं पूजितं धर्मसत्तमैः.. 2..
text_mt: It is meritorious, purifying, prolonging life, the best among all gifts, / destroying the defects of great sins and the like, revered by the best among the righteous.

sanskrit_iast:
deyaṃ saṃkramaṇe bhānorgrahaṇe dvādaśīṣvatha..
yajñotsavavivāheṣu duḥsvapnādbhutadarśane ..3..
meaning:
देयं संक्रमणे भानोर्ग्रहणे द्वादशीष्वथ..
यज्ञोत्सवविवाहेषु दुःस्वप्नाद्भुतदर्शने ..3..
text_mt: It is to be given at the sun's ingress into a zodiac sign, at an eclipse, on twelfth [tithi]s, / at sacrifices, festivals, weddings, and upon seeing an ominous dream or a portent.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā ca jāyate vittaṃ cittaṃ śraddhāsamanvitam ..
tadaiva dānakālaḥ syādadhruvaṃ jīvitaṃ yataḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
यदा च जायते वित्तं चित्तं श्रद्धासमन्वितम् ..
तदैव दानकालः स्यादध्रुवं जीवितं यतः .. 4 ..
text_mt: And whenever wealth is acquired and the mind is endowed with faith, / that very time is the occasion for giving, since life is fleeting.

sanskrit_iast:
kurukṣetrāditīrtheṣu gaṃgādyāsu nadīṣu ca ..
pureṣu ca pavitreṣu araṇyeṣu vaneṣu ca .. 5 ..
meaning:
कुरुक्षेत्रादितीर्थेषु गंगाद्यासु नदीषु च ..
पुरेषु च पवित्रेषु अरण्येषु वनेषु च .. 5 ..
text_mt: In holy sites such as Kurukṣetra, and in rivers such as the Gaṅgā, / and in holy cities, in forests, and in groves,

sanskrit_iast:
goṣṭhe devālaye vāpi rathe vā svagṛhāṃgaṇe ..
deyaṃ purāṇavidhinā brāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine.. 6 ..
meaning:
गोष्ठे देवालये वापि रथे वा स्वगृहांगणे ..
देयं पुराणविधिना ब्राह्मणाय कुटुंबिने.. 6 ..
text_mt: or in a cowshed, in a temple, in a chariot, or in one’s own house courtyard, / it should be given according to the Purāṇic rite to a householder brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśairāstīrya tāṃ pārtha praṇavākṣaramaṃtritaiḥ ..
upariṣṭāttilaisteṣāṃ varāhaṃ parikalpayet .. 7 ..
meaning:
कुशैरास्तीर्य तां पार्थ प्रणवाक्षरमंत्रितैः ..
उपरिष्टात्तिलैस्तेषां वराहं परिकल्पयेत् .. 7 ..
text_mt: Having spread kuśa grass consecrated with the syllable Oṃ, O Pārtha, / on top of it, one should fashion a boar out of sesame seeds.

sanskrit_iast:
drauṇaiścaturbhiḥ saṃpūrṇaṃ tadardhenātha vā punaḥ ..
āḍhakenātha kurvīta vitta śāṭhyaṃ na kārayet .. 8 ..
meaning:
द्रौणैश्चतुर्भिः संपूर्णं तदर्धेनाथ वा पुनः ..
आढकेनाथ कुर्वीत वित्त शाठ्यं न कारयेत् .. 8 ..
text_mt: It should be fully made with four droṇas, or else with half of that; / or one may make it with an āḍhaka; one should not practice deceit regarding wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇena mukhaṃ kāryaṃ bhujau cakragadānvitau ..
rājatīṃ kārayeddaṃṣṭāṃ padmarāgavibhūṣitām .. 9 ..
meaning:
सुवर्णेन मुखं कार्यं भुजौ चक्रगदान्वितौ ..
राजतीं कारयेद्दंष्टां पद्मरागविभूषिताम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Its face should be made of gold, and its arms equipped with the discus and mace; / one should have its tusk made of silver and adorned with rubies.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkhaṃ ca sthāpayetpārśve vanamālāṃ hiraṇmayīm ..
puṣpairvā kārayedvidvānpādau rūpyamayau tathā .. 4.194.10 ..
meaning:
शंखं च स्थापयेत्पार्श्वे वनमालां हिरण्मयीम् ..
पुष्पैर्वा कारयेद्विद्वान्पादौ रूप्यमयौ तथा .. 4.194.10 ..
text_mt: And the wise man should place a conch at its side, and a golden forest garland, / or make it with flowers, and likewise feet of silver.

sanskrit_iast:
daṃṣṭrāgralagnavasudhāṃ sauvarṇīṃ kārayecchubhām ..
sarvadhānyarasopetāṃ vastrālaṃkṛtavigrahām .. 11 ..
meaning:
दंष्ट्राग्रलग्नवसुधां सौवर्णीं कारयेच्छुभाम् ..
सर्वधान्यरसोपेतां वस्त्रालंकृतविग्रहाम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: One should fashion an auspicious golden earth resting on the tip of its tusk, / furnished with all grains and flavours, its body adorned with garments.

sanskrit_iast:
pracchādya vastrairdeveśaṃ varāhaṃ sarvakāmadam ..
romarājiṃ kuśaiḥ kṛtvā gaṃdhapuṣpairathārcayet .. 12 ..
meaning:
प्रच्छाद्य वस्त्रैर्देवेशं वराहं सर्वकामदम् ..
रोमराजिं कुशैः कृत्वा गंधपुष्पैरथार्चयेत् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Having covered the Lord of Gods, the boar who grants all desires, with garments, / and having formed his bristles with kuśa grass, one should then worship him with fragrances and flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
navagrahamakhaḥ kāryo homa ścātra tilaiḥ smṛtaḥ ..
evaṃ saṃsthāpya vidhivattataḥ stotramudīrayet .. 13 ..
meaning:
नवग्रहमखः कार्यो होम श्चात्र तिलैः स्मृतः ..
एवं संस्थाप्य विधिवत्ततः स्तोत्रमुदीरयेत् .. 13 ..
text_mt: A sacrifice to the nine planets should be performed, and the oblation here is taught to be made with sesame seeds. / Having thus installed him according to rule, one should then utter this hymn of praise:

sanskrit_iast:
varāheśa praduṣṭāni sarvapāpaphalāni ca ..
marddamardda mahādaṃṣṭra bhāsvatkana kakuṃḍala .. 14 ..
meaning:
वराहेश प्रदुष्टानि सर्वपापफलानि च ..
मर्द्दमर्द्द महादंष्ट्र भास्वत्कन ककुंडल .. 14 ..
text_mt: “O Boar Lord, crush, crush the wicked fruits / of all my sins, O great-tusked one, wearing radiant golden earrings!

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkhacakrāsihastāya hiraṇyākṣāṃtakāya ca ..
daṃṣṭroddhṛtadharābhṛte trayīmūrtimate namaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
शंखचक्रासिहस्ताय हिरण्याक्षांतकाय च ..
दंष्ट्रोद्धृतधराभृते त्रयीमूर्तिमते नमः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Homage to the one whose hands bear the conch, discus, and sword, who slew Hiraṇyākṣa, / who lifted up the mountain-bearing earth with his tusk, whose form is the three Vedas!”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuccārya namaskṛtya pradakṣiṇamanu vrajet ..
tatastaṃ brāhmaṇe dadyādvastrālaṃkārabhūṣitam .. .. 16..
meaning:
इत्युच्चार्य नमस्कृत्य प्रदक्षिणमनु व्रजेत् ..
ततस्तं ब्राह्मणे दद्याद्वस्त्रालंकारभूषितम् .. .. 16..
text_mt: Having spoken thus and bowed down, he should walk in circumambulation. / Then he should give it to a brāhmaṇa, adorned with garments and ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
prarigrahastu tasyoktaḥ pādayoḥ paramarṣibhiḥ ..
anena vidhinā dattvā praṇipatya kṣamā payet .. 17 ..
meaning:
प्ररिग्रहस्तु तस्योक्तः पादयोः परमर्षिभिः ..
अनेन विधिना दत्त्वा प्रणिपत्य क्षमा पयेत् .. 17 ..
text_mt: The highest sages say that the reception of it [must be taken] by the feet. / Having given it according to this rite, one should bow down and ask for forgiveness.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dattvā mahīnātha varāhaṃ sarvakāmadam ..
yatphalaṃ samavāpnoti pārtha tatkena varṇyate .. 18 ..
meaning:
एवं दत्त्वा महीनाथ वराहं सर्वकामदम् ..
यत्फलं समवाप्नोति पार्थ तत्केन वर्ण्यते .. 18 ..
text_mt: Having given the boar that fulfills all desires in this manner, O lord of the earth, / what reward one attains, O Pārtha, by whom can that be described?

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadāneṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvakratuṣu yatphalam..
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti dattvā devaṃ janārdanam.. 19 ..
meaning:
सर्वदानेषु यत्पुण्यं सर्वक्रतुषु यत्फलम्..
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति दत्त्वा देवं जनार्दनम्.. 19 ..
text_mt: Whatever merit is found in all donations, whatever reward in all sacrifices, / that reward one attains by giving the divine Janārdana.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāśaktyā samuddhṛtā varāheṇa vasuṃdharā..
yathākulaṃ samuddhatya viṣṇuloke mahīyate. ... 4.194.20 ..
meaning:
यथाशक्त्या समुद्धृता वराहेण वसुंधरा..
यथाकुलं समुद्धत्य विष्णुलोके महीयते. ... 4.194.20 ..
text_mt: Just as the earth was lifted up according to power by the Boar, / so having lifted up his family, he is glorified in the world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ strīṇāṃ śūdrajanasya ca ..
etatsādhāraṇaṃ dānaṃ śaivavaiṣṇavayoginām .. 21 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां स्त्रीणां शूद्रजनस्य च ..
एतत्साधारणं दानं शैववैष्णवयोगिनाम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: For brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, women, and śūdras, / and for Śaiva, Vaiṣṇava, and yogin practitioners, this gift is common to all.

sanskrit_iast:
viprāya vedaviduṣe nṛvarāharūpaṃ dattvā tilāmalasuvarṇamayaṃ savastram ..
uddhṛtya pūrvapuruṣānsakalatramitraḥ prāpnoti siddhabhuvanaṃ surasiddhajuṣṭam .. 22 .. ..
dhānyaparvatadānavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
विप्राय वेदविदुषे नृवराहरूपं दत्त्वा तिलामलसुवर्णमयं सवस्त्रम् ..
उद्धृत्य पूर्वपुरुषान्सकलत्रमित्रः प्राप्नोति सिद्धभुवनं सुरसिद्धजुष्टम् .. 22 .. ..
धान्यपर्वतदानविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Having given to a brāhmaṇa who knows the Vedas this form of the Man-Boar, made of flawless sesame seeds and gold, together with garments, / one lifts up one's ancestors and, along with wife and friends, attains the realm of the perfected ones, frequented by gods and siddhas.
Description of the rite of donating the grain mountain

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ..
bhagavañchrotumicchāmi dānamāhātmyamuttamam ..
yadakṣayaṃ pare loke devarṣigaṇapūjitam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच ..
भगवञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि दानमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् ..
यदक्षयं परे लोके देवर्षिगणपूजितम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / O Lord, I wish to hear about the supreme majesty of donating, / which is imperishable in the next world and revered by the hosts of divine sages.
title: Dhānyaparvatadānavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
rudreṇa yatpurā proktaṃ nāradāya mahātmane ..
matsyena manave tadvattacchuṇuṣva kurūdvaha .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
रुद्रेण यत्पुरा प्रोक्तं नारदाय महात्मने ..
मत्स्येन मनवे तद्वत्तच्छुणुष्व कुरूद्वह .. 2 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / What was declared in ancient times by Rudra to the great-souled Nārada, / and likewise by the Fish [Avatāra] to Manu, hear that, O bull of the Kurus!

sanskrit_iast:
meroḥ pradānaṃ vakṣyāmi daśadhā punareva te ..
yatpradātottarām̐llokānprāpnoti surapūjitān.. 3 ..
meaning:
मेरोः प्रदानं वक्ष्यामि दशधा पुनरेव ते ..
यत्प्रदातोत्तराम्̐ल्लोकान्प्राप्नोति सुरपूजितान्.. 3 ..
text_mt: I shall tell you once again of the ten gifts of Mount Meru, / by giving which one attains the higher worlds revered by the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇeṣu ca vedeṣu yajñeṣvadhyayaneṣu ca ..
na tatphalamadhīteṣu kṛteṣviha yadaśnute .. 4 ..
meaning:
पुराणेषु च वेदेषु यज्ञेष्वध्ययनेषु च ..
न तत्फलमधीतेषु कृतेष्विह यदश्नुते .. 4 ..
text_mt: Not in the Purāṇas, nor in the Vedas, nor in sacrifices, nor in studies / is that reward obtained, which one enjoys here when these are performed.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādvidhānaṃ vakṣyāmi parvatānāmanukramāt ..
prathamo dhānyaśailaḥ syaddvitīyo lavaṇācalaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
तस्माद्विधानं वक्ष्यामि पर्वतानामनुक्रमात् ..
प्रथमो धान्यशैलः स्यद्द्वितीयो लवणाचलः .. 5 ..
text_mt: Therefore I will explain the procedure for the mountains in order: / the first is the grain mountain; the second, the salt mountain;

sanskrit_iast:
guḍācalastṛtīyastu caturtho hemaparvataḥ ..
pañcamastilaśailaḥ syātṣaṣṭhaḥ kārpāsaparvataḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
गुडाचलस्तृतीयस्तु चतुर्थो हेमपर्वतः ..
पञ्चमस्तिलशैलः स्यात्षष्ठः कार्पासपर्वतः .. 6 ..
text_mt: the third is the mountain of molasses; and the fourth is the gold mountain; / the fifth is the sesame mountain; the sixth, the cotton mountain;

sanskrit_iast:
saptamo ghṛtaśailaśca rasaśailastathāṣṭamaḥ ..
rājato navamastadvaddaśamaḥ śarkarācalaḥ .. .. 7 ..
meaning:
सप्तमो घृतशैलश्च रसशैलस्तथाष्टमः ..
राजतो नवमस्तद्वद्दशमः शर्कराचलः .. .. 7 ..
text_mt: the seventh is the clarified butter mountain; and likewise the eighth is the mountain of liquids; / the ninth is the silver [mountain]; and similarly the tenth is the sugar mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
vakṣye vidhānameteṣāṃ yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ ..
ayane viṣuve puṇye vyatīpāte dinakṣaye .. 8 ..
meaning:
वक्ष्ये विधानमेतेषां यथावदनुपूर्वशः ..
अयने विषुवे पुण्ये व्यतीपाते दिनक्षये .. 8 ..
text_mt: I shall explain their procedure properly in due succession: / at an equinox, a holy solstice, a vyatīpāta, on a day of moon loss,

sanskrit_iast:
śuklapakṣe tṛtīyāyāmuparāge śaśikṣaye ..
vivāhotsavayajñe vā dvādaśyāmatha vā punaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
शुक्लपक्षे तृतीयायामुपरागे शशिक्षये ..
विवाहोत्सवयज्ञे वा द्वादश्यामथ वा पुनः .. 9 ..
text_mt: on the third [tithi] of the bright fortnight, during an eclipse, on a new moon, / at a marriage, a festival, a sacrifice, or on the twelfth [tithi],

sanskrit_iast:
śuklāyāṃ pañcadaśyāṃ vā puṇyarkṣe vā pradhānataḥ ..
dhānyaśailādayo deyā yathāśāstraṃ vijānatā .. 4.195.10 ..
meaning:
शुक्लायां पञ्चदश्यां वा पुण्यर्क्षे वा प्रधानतः ..
धान्यशैलादयो देया यथाशास्त्रं विजानता .. 4.195.10 ..
text_mt: or on the fifteenth [tithi] of the bright fortnight, or especially under an auspicious lunar mansion, / the grain mountain and the others should be given according to the treatise by one who understands.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthe vāyatane vāpi goṣṭhe vā saṃgame'pi vā ..
maṃḍapaṃ kārayedbhaktyā caturasramudaṅmukham .. 11 ..
meaning:
तीर्थे वायतने वापि गोष्ठे वा संगमेऽपि वा ..
मंडपं कारयेद्भक्त्या चतुरस्रमुदङ्मुखम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: In a holy site, or in a temple, or in a cowshed, or at a confluence, / one should build with devotion a four-sided pavilion facing north,

sanskrit_iast:
prāgudakpravaṇaṃ tatra prāṅmukhaṃ vā vidhānataḥ ..
gomayenānuliptāyāṃ bhūmāvāstīrya vā kuśān .. 12 ..
meaning:
प्रागुदक्प्रवणं तत्र प्राङ्मुखं वा विधानतः ..
गोमयेनानुलिप्तायां भूमावास्तीर्य वा कुशान् .. 12 ..
text_mt: sloping towards the north-east, or facing east, according to the rule. / Having smeared the ground with cow-dung or having spread kuśa grass,

sanskrit_iast:
tanmadhye parvataṃ kuryādviṣkambhaparvatānvitam ..
dhānyadroṇasahasreṇa bhavedgiririhottamaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
तन्मध्ये पर्वतं कुर्याद्विष्कम्भपर्वतान्वितम् ..
धान्यद्रोणसहस्रेण भवेद्गिरिरिहोत्तमः .. 13 ..
text_mt: in its middle one should make the mountain, accompanied by the supporting mountains. / With a thousand droṇas of grain, the mountain here is the best;

sanskrit_iast: madhyamaḥ paṃcaśatikaḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ syāttribhiḥ śataiḥ .. 14 ..
meaning: मध्यमः पंचशतिकः कनिष्ठः स्यात्त्रिभिः शतैः .. 14 ..
text_mt: the middling is of five hundred, and the lowest consists of three hundred.

sanskrit_iast:
merurmahāvrīhimayastu madhyasuvarṇavṛkṣatrayasaṃyutaḥ syāt ..
saṃpūrṇamuktāphalavajrayukto yāmye nu gomedakapuṣparāgaiḥ ..15..
meaning:
मेरुर्महाव्रीहिमयस्तु मध्यसुवर्णवृक्षत्रयसंयुतः स्यात् ..
संपूर्णमुक्ताफलवज्रयुक्तो याम्ये नु गोमेदकपुष्परागैः ..15..
text_mt: Meru made of great rice should be equipped in its centre with three golden trees, / fully set with pearls and diamonds, and on the south side with hessonite and topaz;

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ syācca gārutmatanīlaratnaiḥ saumyena vaiḍūryasarojarāgaiḥ ..
śrīkhaṃḍakhaṇḍairabhitaḥ pravāla latānvitaḥ śuddhaśilātalaḥ syāt ..16..
meaning:
यः स्याच्च गारुत्मतनीलरत्नैः सौम्येन वैडूर्यसरोजरागैः ..
श्रीखंडखण्डैरभितः प्रवाल लतान्वितः शुद्धशिलातलः स्यात् ..16..
text_mt: to the west with emerald and sapphire gems, to the north with cat’s eye and rubies; / it should have pieces of sandalwood, be surrounded by coral creepers, and have pure stone ledges.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmātha viṣṇurbhagavānpurārirdivākaro'pyatra hiraṇmayaḥ syāt ..
tathaikadeśoddhatakandharastu ghṛtodakaprasravaṇāśca dikṣu .. 17 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्माथ विष्णुर्भगवान्पुरारिर्दिवाकरोऽप्यत्र हिरण्मयः स्यात् ..
तथैकदेशोद्धतकन्धरस्तु घृतोदकप्रस्रवणाश्च दिक्षु .. 17 ..
text_mt: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Lord Śiva, and the Sun here should also be made of gold; / likewise, its summits should rise in one part, with waterfalls of clarified butter in the directions.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklāṃbaro'nyaśca surācalaḥ syātpūrveṇa kṛṣṇāni ca dakṣiṇena ..
vāsāṃsi paścādatha kesarāṇi raktāni caivottarato dalāni .. 18 ..
meaning:
शुक्लांबरोऽन्यश्च सुराचलः स्यात्पूर्वेण कृष्णानि च दक्षिणेन ..
वासांसि पश्चादथ केसराणि रक्तानि चैवोत्तरतो दलानि .. 18 ..
text_mt: And the mountain of the gods should have white garments [to the south], black garments to the east, / garments of saffron to the west, and red leaves to the north.

sanskrit_iast:
raupyā maheṃdrapramukhāstathāṣṭau saṃsthāpayellokapatīnkrameṇa ..
nānāphalālī ca samaṃtataḥ syānmanoramāmālyavilepanādyā .. 19 ..
meaning:
रौप्या महेंद्रप्रमुखास्तथाष्टौ संस्थापयेल्लोकपतीन्क्रमेण ..
नानाफलाली च समंततः स्यान्मनोरमामाल्यविलेपनाद्या .. 19 ..
text_mt: One should install in order the eight silver world protectors beginning with Mahendra; / and all around there should be a variety of fruits, delightful garlands, unguents, and the like;

sanskrit_iast:
vitānakañcopari pañcavarṇamamlānapuṣpābharaṇaṃ sitaṃ vā ..
itthaṃ niveśyāmaraśailamapyunmanāstu viṣkambhagaṇānkrameṇa .. 4.195.20 ..
meaning:
वितानकञ्चोपरि पञ्चवर्णमम्लानपुष्पाभरणं सितं वा ..
इत्थं निवेश्यामरशैलमप्युन्मनास्तु विष्कम्भगणान्क्रमेण .. 4.195.20 ..
text_mt: and above it, a five-coloured canopy, or a white one, adorned with unfading flowers. / Having thus installed the mountain of the immortals, with intent mind [one should install] the supporting ranges in order.

sanskrit_iast:
turīyabhāgena caturdiśaṃ ca saṃsthāpayetpuṣpavilepanādyān ..
pūrveṇa mandaramanekaphalopayuktaṃ yatrollasatkanakabhadrakadaṃbacihnam .. 21 ..
meaning:
तुरीयभागेन चतुर्दिशं च संस्थापयेत्पुष्पविलेपनाद्यान् ..
पूर्वेण मन्दरमनेकफलोपयुक्तं यत्रोल्लसत्कनकभद्रकदंबचिह्नम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: With a fourth part [of the grain] in the four directions, one should set them up with flowers, ointments, and so forth: / to the east Mandara, supplied with various fruits, where shines the mark of a golden bhadrakadamba tree,

sanskrit_iast:
kāmena kāṃcanamayena virājamānamākārayetkusumavastravilepanāḍhyam ..
kṣīrāruṇodasarasātha tathā vanena raupyeṇa śaktighaṭitena virājamānam ..22..
meaning:
कामेन कांचनमयेन विराजमानमाकारयेत्कुसुमवस्त्रविलेपनाढ्यम् ..
क्षीरारुणोदसरसाथ तथा वनेन रौप्येण शक्तिघटितेन विराजमानम् ..22..
text_mt: shining with a golden Kāmadeva, one should fashion it rich with flowers, garments, and unguents, / and shining with a lake of milk and red water, and with a silver forest fashioned with strength.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmyena gaṃdhamadanotra niveśanīyo godhūmasaṃcayamayaḥ kaladhautajo vā ..
haimena pakṣipatinā dhṛtamānasena tenādyameva sakalaṃ kilasaṃyutaḥ syāt .. 23 ..
meaning:
याम्येन गंधमदनोत्र निवेशनीयो गोधूमसंचयमयः कलधौतजो वा ..
हैमेन पक्षिपतिना धृतमानसेन तेनाद्यमेव सकलं किलसंयुतः स्यात् .. 23 ..
text_mt: To the south should be placed Gandhamādana, made of a heap of wheat or fashioned of silver, / with a golden lord of birds who holds [Mount] Mānasa; with that, indeed, the entire [mountain] becomes complete. 23

sanskrit_iast:
paścāttilācalamanekasugandha puṣpasauvarṇapippalahiraṇyayahaṃsayuktam ..
ākārayedrajatapuṣpavanena tadvadvastrānvitaṃ dadhiśatodasarastathāgre .. 24 ..
meaning:
पश्चात्तिलाचलमनेकसुगन्ध पुष्पसौवर्णपिप्पलहिरण्ययहंसयुक्तम् ..
आकारयेद्रजतपुष्पवनेन तद्वद्वस्त्रान्वितं दधिशतोदसरस्तथाग्रे .. 24 ..
text_mt: To the west [one should place] the mountain of sesame seeds, endowed with various fragrant flowers, a golden pippala tree, and a golden goose; / one should fashion it likewise with a silver flower-grove, clothed in garments, with the lake of Dadhiśatoda before it. 24

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsthāpya taṃ vipulaśailamathottareṇa śailaṃ supārśvamapi māṣamayaṃ suvapram ..
puṣpaiśca hemavaṭapādapaśeṣaratnamākārayetkanakadhenuvirājamānam .. 25 ..
meaning:
संस्थाप्य तं विपुलशैलमथोत्तरेण शैलं सुपार्श्वमपि माषमयं सुवप्रम् ..
पुष्पैश्च हेमवटपादपशेषरत्नमाकारयेत्कनकधेनुविराजमानम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Having set up that great mountain, then to the north Mount Supārśva, made of māṣa beans, with fair ramparts, / with flowers, a golden banyan tree, the remainder of jewels, and adorned with a golden cow; 25

sanskrit_iast:
mākṣīkabhadrakarasāvacayena tadvadrau pyeṇa bhāsvararasaiśca yutaṃ vidhāya ..
homaścaturbhiratha vedapurāṇavidbhirhyetairaniṃdya varitākṛtibhirdvijendraiḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
माक्षीकभद्रकरसावचयेन तद्वद्रौ प्येण भास्वररसैश्च युतं विधाय ..
होमश्चतुर्भिरथ वेदपुराणविद्भिर्ह्येतैरनिंद्य वरिताकृतिभिर्द्विजेन्द्रैः .. 26 ..
text_mt: furnished likewise with a collection of honey and good fluids, and with silver and gleaming essences, / a homa should then be performed by four eminent Brahmins who know the Vedas and Purāṇas, irreproachable and chosen for their form. 26

sanskrit_iast:
pūrveṇa hastamukhamatra vidhāya kuṃḍaṃ kāryastilairatha ghṛtena samitkuśaiśca ..
rātrau ca jāgaramanuddhatagītatūryairāvāhanaṃ ca kathayāmi śiloccayānām .. 27 ..
meaning:
पूर्वेण हस्तमुखमत्र विधाय कुंडं कार्यस्तिलैरथ घृतेन समित्कुशैश्च ..
रात्रौ च जागरमनुद्धतगीततूर्यैरावाहनं च कथयामि शिलोच्चयानाम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: Having made here a sacrificial pit of one cubit's extent in the east, [the offering] should be made with sesame seeds, ghee, kindling sticks, and kuśa grass; / and at night [one should keep] vigil with restrained singing and musical instruments. Now I shall tell the invocation of the mountains: 27

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ sarvadevagaṇadhāmanidhe ca vighnamasmadgṛheṣvamaraparvata nāśayāśu ..
kṣemaṃ vidhatsva kuru śāṃtimanuttamāṃ naḥ saṃpūjitaḥ paramabhaktimataḥ pradehi .. 28 ..
meaning:
त्वं सर्वदेवगणधामनिधे च विघ्नमस्मद्गृहेष्वमरपर्वत नाशयाशु ..
क्षेमं विधत्स्व कुरु शांतिमनुत्तमां नः संपूजितः परमभक्तिमतः प्रदेहि .. 28 ..
text_mt: "O treasure-house of the dwellings of all the host of gods! Mountain of the immortals, destroy swiftly the misfortune in our homes! / Grant security, make our peace supreme! Worshipped, grant [it] to this devotee of supreme devotion! 28

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva bhagavānīśo brahmā viṣṇurdivākaraḥ ..
mūrtāmūrtaparaṃ bījamataḥ pāhi sanātana .. 29 ..
meaning:
त्वमेव भगवानीशो ब्रह्मा विष्णुर्दिवाकरः ..
मूर्तामूर्तपरं बीजमतः पाहि सनातन .. 29 ..
text_mt: You alone are the Lord God, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, the Sun, / the supreme seed of both form and formlessness; therefore protect [us], O eternal one! 29

sanskrit_iast:
yasmāttvaṃ lokapālānāṃ viśvamūrteśca maṃdiram ..
keśavārkavasūnāṃ ca tasmā cchāṃtiṃ prayaccha me .. 4.195.30 ..
meaning:
यस्मात्त्वं लोकपालानां विश्वमूर्तेश्च मंदिरम् ..
केशवार्कवसूनां च तस्मा च्छांतिं प्रयच्छ मे .. 4.195.30 ..
text_mt: Because you are the dwelling of the world protectors, of the universal form, / and of Keśava, the Sun, and the Vasus, therefore grant me peace! 30

sanskrit_iast:
yasmādaśūnyamamarairgaṃdharvaiśca śirastava ..
tasmānmāmuddharāśeṣa duḥkhasaṃsārasāgarāt .. 31 ..
meaning:
यस्मादशून्यममरैर्गंधर्वैश्च शिरस्तव ..
तस्मान्मामुद्धराशेष दुःखसंसारसागरात् .. 31 ..
text_mt: Because your summit is never devoid of gods and Gandharvas, / therefore deliver me from the ocean of worldly existence filled with all sorrows! 31

sanskrit_iast:
evamabhyarcya taṃ meruṃ mandaraṃ cāpi pūjayet ..
yasmāccaitrarathenātha bhadrāśvavariṣeṇa ca .. 32 ..
meaning:
एवमभ्यर्च्य तं मेरुं मन्दरं चापि पूजयेत् ..
यस्माच्चैत्ररथेनाथ भद्राश्ववरिषेण च .. 32 ..
text_mt: Having thus worshipped Meru, one should also worship Mandara: / 'Because [you shine] with the Caitraratha [forest] and with the Bhadrāśva realm, 32

sanskrit_iast:
śobhase mandarakṣipramatastuṣṭikaro bhava ..
yasmāccūḍāmaṇirjaṃbūdvīpe tvaṃ gandhamādanaḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
शोभसे मन्दरक्षिप्रमतस्तुष्टिकरो भव ..
यस्माच्चूडामणिर्जंबूद्वीपे त्वं गन्धमादनः .. 33 ..
text_mt: O Mandara, you shine brightly, therefore bring satisfaction!' / 'Because you, O Gandhamādana, are the crest-jewel of Jambūdvīpa, 33

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvairapsarobhiśca gīyamānaṃ yaśo'stu me ..
yasmāttvaṃ ketumālena vaibhrājena vanena ca .. 34 ..
meaning:
गन्धर्वैरप्सरोभिश्च गीयमानं यशोऽस्तु मे ..
यस्मात्त्वं केतुमालेन वैभ्राजेन वनेन च .. 34 ..
text_mt: may my fame be sung by the Gandharvas and Apsarases!' / 'Because you [shine] with the Ketumāla [realm] and with the Vaibhrāja forest, 34

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyamayapāṣāṇastasmācchāṃtiṃ prayaccha me ..
uttaraiḥ kurubhiryasmātsāvitreṇa vanena ca .. 35 ..
meaning:
हिरण्यमयपाषाणस्तस्माच्छांतिं प्रयच्छ मे ..
उत्तरैः कुरुभिर्यस्मात्सावित्रेण वनेन च .. 35 ..
text_mt: having golden boulders, therefore grant me peace!' / 'Because with the Northern Kurus and with the Sāvitra forest, 35

sanskrit_iast:
supārśva rājase nityamataḥ śrīrakṣayāstu me ..
evamāmaṃtrya tānsarvānprabhāte vimale punaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
सुपार्श्व राजसे नित्यमतः श्रीरक्षयास्तु मे ..
एवमामंत्र्य तान्सर्वान्प्रभाते विमले पुनः .. 36 ..
text_mt: O Supārśva, you shine eternally, therefore let my prosperity be imperishable!' / Having thus invoked them all, again at clear dawn, 36

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā tu gurave dadyānmadhyamaṃ parvatottamam ..
śeṣāṃśca paṃca tāndadyādṛtvigbhyaḥ kramaśo nṛpa .. 37 ..
meaning:
स्नात्वा तु गुरवे दद्यान्मध्यमं पर्वतोत्तमम् ..
शेषांश्च पंच तान्दद्यादृत्विग्भ्यः क्रमशो नृप .. 37 ..
text_mt: having bathed, one should give the best central mountain to the preceptor, / and the remaining five [mountains] one should give to the officiating priests in due order, O king. 37

sanskrit_iast:
gāvo deyāścatustriṃśadathavā daśa bhārata..
śaktitaḥ sapta vāṣṭau vā evaṃ dadyādaśaktimān .. 38 ..
meaning:
गावो देयाश्चतुस्त्रिंशदथवा दश भारत..
शक्तितः सप्त वाष्टौ वा एवं दद्यादशक्तिमान् .. 38 ..
text_mt: Thirty-four cows should be given, or ten, O descendant of Bharata, / or seven or eight according to one's capacity; thus should one give if lacking capacity. 38

sanskrit_iast:
ekāpi gurave deyā kapilā supayasvinī ..
parvatānāmaśeṣāṇāmeṣa eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
एकापि गुरवे देया कपिला सुपयस्विनी ..
पर्वतानामशेषाणामेष एव विधिः स्मृतः .. 39 ..
text_mt: Even a single brown cow yielding abundant milk should be given to the preceptor. / This alone is remembered as the rule for all the mountains. 39

sanskrit_iast:
ya eva pūjane maṃtrāsta evopaskare tathā ..
grahāṇāṃ lokapālānāṃ brahmādīnāmagaiḥ saha .. 4.195.40 ..
meaning:
य एव पूजने मंत्रास्त एवोपस्करे तथा ..
ग्रहाणां लोकपालानां ब्रह्मादीनामगैः सह .. 4.195.40 ..
text_mt: The very mantras for the worship, the same are for the furnishings, / for the planets, the world protectors, and for Brahmā and the rest along with the mountains. 40

sanskrit_iast:
svamaṃtreṇaiva sarveṣu homaḥ śaileṣu śasyate ..
upavāsī bhavennityamaśaktau naktamiṣyate .. 41 ..
meaning:
स्वमंत्रेणैव सर्वेषु होमः शैलेषु शस्यते ..
उपवासी भवेन्नित्यमशक्तौ नक्तमिष्यते .. 41 ..
text_mt: A homa with its own mantra is commended for all the mountains; / one should always remain fasting; if incapable, a nocturnal meal is approved. 41

sanskrit_iast:
vidhānaṃ sarvaśailānāṃ kramaśaḥ śṛṇu bhārata ..
dānakāleṣu ye mantrāḥ parvateṣu ca yatphalam .. 42 ..
meaning:
विधानं सर्वशैलानां क्रमशः शृणु भारत ..
दानकालेषु ये मन्त्राः पर्वतेषु च यत्फलम् .. 42 ..
text_mt: Listen, O descendant of Bharata, in due order to the rule of all the mountains, / to the mantras at the times of donation, and to the fruit regarding the mountains. 42

sanskrit_iast:
annaṃ brahma yataḥ proktamanne prāṇāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ..
annādbhavaṃti bhūtāni jagadannena varddhate .. 43 ..
meaning:
अन्नं ब्रह्म यतः प्रोक्तमन्ने प्राणाः प्रतिष्ठिताः ..
अन्नाद्भवंति भूतानि जगदन्नेन वर्द्धते .. 43 ..
text_mt: Because food is declared to be Brahman, in food the vital breaths are established; / from food beings come to be, the world prospers through food. 43

sanskrit_iast:
annameva yato lakṣmīrannameva janārdanaḥ ..
dhānyaparvatarūpeṇa pāhi tasmānnagottama .. 44 ..
meaning:
अन्नमेव यतो लक्ष्मीरन्नमेव जनार्दनः ..
धान्यपर्वतरूपेण पाहि तस्मान्नगोत्तम .. 44 ..
text_mt: Because food alone is Lakṣmī, food alone is Janārdana; / therefore protect [us] in the form of the mountain of grain, O best of mountains!' 44

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā yastu dadyāddhānyamayaṃ girim ..
manvantaraśataṃ sāgraṃ devaloke mahīyate .. 45 ..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु दद्याद्धान्यमयं गिरिम् ..
मन्वन्तरशतं साग्रं देवलोके महीयते .. 45 ..
text_mt: He who gives a mountain of grain according to this rule / is honoured in the world of the gods for fully one hundred manvantaras. 45

sanskrit_iast:
apsarogaṇagaṃdharvairākīrṇena virājatā ..
vimānena divaḥ pṛṣṭhe sa yāti ṛṣisevitaḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
अप्सरोगणगंधर्वैराकीर्णेन विराजता ..
विमानेन दिवः पृष्ठे स याति ऋषिसेवितः .. 46 ..
text_mt: In a radiant celestial chariot thronged with hosts of Apsarases and Gandharvas, / attended by sages, he travels upon the back of heaven. 46

sanskrit_iast: puṇyakṣaye rājarājyamāpnotīha na saṃśayaḥ .. 47 ..
meaning: पुण्यक्षये राजराज्यमाप्नोतीह न संशयः .. 47 ..
text_mt: Upon the exhaustion of merit, he obtains royal sovereignty here [on earth]; of this there is no doubt. 47

sanskrit_iast:
dhānyācalaṃ kanakavṛkṣavirājamānaṃ viṣkaṃbhaparvatayutaṃ surasiddhajuṣṭam ..
yacchaṃti ye sumatayaḥ praṇipatya viprāṃste prāpnuvaṃti parameṣṭhipadābjayugmam .. 48 .. ..
meaning:
धान्याचलं कनकवृक्षविराजमानं विष्कंभपर्वतयुतं सुरसिद्धजुष्टम् ..
यच्छंति ये सुमतयः प्रणिपत्य विप्रांस्ते प्राप्नुवंति परमेष्ठिपदाब्जयुग्मम् .. 48 .. ..
text_mt: Those wise persons who, having bowed down to the Brahmins, give a mountain of grain / resplendent with golden trees, endowed with flanking mountains, and frequented by gods and Siddhas, reach the pair of lotus feet of the Supreme Lord. 48

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībhaviṣye purāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde dhānyaparvatadānavidhivarṇanaṃ nāma paṃcanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ.. .. 195 ..
lavaṇaparvatadānavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
इति श्रीभविष्ये पुराण उत्तरपर्वणि श्रीकृष्णयुधिष्ठिरसंवादे धान्यपर्वतदानविधिवर्णनं नाम पंचनवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः.. .. 195 ..
लवणपर्वतदानविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-fifth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Rule for the Gift of a Mountain of Grain', in the conversation between Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Yudhiṣṭhira, in the Uttaraparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣyapurāṇa. 195
Description of the rule for the gift of a mountain of salt.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi lavaṇācalamuttamam ..
yatpradānānnaro lokamāpnoti śivasaṃyutam ..1..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि लवणाचलमुत्तमम् ..
यत्प्रदानान्नरो लोकमाप्नोति शिवसंयुतम् ..1..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Now therefore I shall fully describe the excellent mountain of salt, / by the giving of which a man attains the world united with Śiva. 1
title: Lavaṇaparvatadānavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
uttamaḥ ṣoḍaśadroṇaḥ kartabyo lavaṇācalaḥ ..
madhyamaḥ syāttadardhena tadarddhenādhamaḥ smṛtaḥ ..2..
meaning:
उत्तमः षोडशद्रोणः कर्तब्यो लवणाचलः ..
मध्यमः स्यात्तदर्धेन तदर्द्धेनाधमः स्मृतः ..2..
text_mt: The best mountain of salt should be made of sixteen droṇas; / the middling should be of half that, and the lowest is remembered as half of that. 2

sanskrit_iast:
vittahīno yathāśaktyā droṇādardhaṃ tu kārayet ..
caturthāṃśena viṣayānparvatānkārayetpṛthak ..3..
meaning:
वित्तहीनो यथाशक्त्या द्रोणादर्धं तु कारयेत् ..
चतुर्थांशेन विषयान्पर्वतान्कारयेत्पृथक् ..3..
text_mt: A man without wealth should make it according to his capacity, down to half a droṇa; / with a fourth portion he should fashion the subsidiary flanking mountains separately. 3

sanskrit_iast:
vidhānaṃ pūrvavatkuryādbrahmādīnāṃ ca sarvadā ..
tadvaddhematarūnsarvāṃllokapālaniveśanam ..4..
meaning:
विधानं पूर्ववत्कुर्याद्ब्रह्मादीनां च सर्वदा ..
तद्वद्धेमतरून्सर्वांल्लोकपालनिवेशनम् ..4..
text_mt: One should always perform the ritual for Brahmā and the others as before; / likewise all the golden trees and the placing of the world protectors. 4

sanskrit_iast:
śirāṃsi kāmadevādīṃstadvattatra niveśayet ..
kuryājjāgaramatrāpi dānamaṃtrānnibodha me ..5..
meaning:
शिरांसि कामदेवादींस्तद्वत्तत्र निवेशयेत् ..
कुर्याज्जागरमत्रापि दानमंत्रान्निबोध मे ..5..
text_mt: One should place the peaks, Kāmadeva and the others, there likewise; / one should keep vigil here too. Hear from me the donation mantras: 5

sanskrit_iast:
saubhāgyarasasaṃbhūto yato'yaṃ lavaṇorasaḥ ..
dānātmakatvena ca māṃ pāhi pāpānnagottama .. 6 ..
meaning:
सौभाग्यरससंभूतो यतोऽयं लवणोरसः ..
दानात्मकत्वेन च मां पाहि पापान्नगोत्तम .. 6 ..
text_mt: "Because this saline essence is born from the essence of auspicious fortune, / and because you are in the form of a gift, protect me from sin, O best of mountains! 6

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādannarasāḥ sarve notkṛṣṭā lavaṇaṃ vinā ..
priyaṃ ca śivayornityaṃ tasmākchāṃtiprado bhava ..7..
meaning:
तस्मादन्नरसाः सर्वे नोत्कृष्टा लवणं विना ..
प्रियं च शिवयोर्नित्यं तस्माक्छांतिप्रदो भव ..7..
text_mt: Therefore, all the flavours of food are not superior without salt, / and it is eternally dear to Śiva and Śivā; therefore be a granter of peace! 7

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇudeha samudbhūtaṃ yasmādārogyavardhanam ..
yasmātparvatarūpeṇa pāhi saṃsārasāgarāt .. 8 ..
meaning:
विष्णुदेह समुद्भूतं यस्मादारोग्यवर्धनम् ..
यस्मात्पर्वतरूपेण पाहि संसारसागरात् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Because [salt] arose from the body of Viṣṇu, promoting health, / and because [you stand] in the form of a mountain, protect [me] from the ocean of worldly existence!" 8

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā yastu dadyāllavaṇaparvatam ..
umāloke vasetkalpaṃ tato yāti parāṃ gatim .. 9 ..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु दद्याल्लवणपर्वतम् ..
उमालोके वसेत्कल्पं ततो याति परां गतिम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: He who gives a mountain of salt according to this rule / dwells in the world of Umā for an aeon; thence he goes to the supreme state. 9

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ..
putrapautraiḥ parivṛto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam .. 4.196.10 ..
meaning:
पुण्यक्षयादिहाभ्येत्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः ..
पुत्रपौत्रैः परिवृतो जीवेच्च शरदां शतम् .. 4.196.10 ..
text_mt: Coming here upon the exhaustion of merit, he becomes a righteous king; / surrounded by sons and grandsons, he shall live for a hundred autumns. 10

sanskrit_iast:
kurvaṃti ye lavaṇa parvatasaṃpradānaṃ saṃprāpnuvaṃti divi te sumahadvimānam ..
tatrāpsarogaṇasurāsurasevyamānāstiṣṭhaṃti hṛṣṭamanaso divi vṛddhamānāḥ .. 11 .. ..
guḍācaladānavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
कुर्वंति ये लवण पर्वतसंप्रदानं संप्राप्नुवंति दिवि ते सुमहद्विमानम् ..
तत्राप्सरोगणसुरासुरसेव्यमानास्तिष्ठंति हृष्टमनसो दिवि वृद्धमानाः .. 11 .. ..
गुडाचलदानविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Those who perform the gift of a mountain of salt obtain a magnificent celestial chariot in heaven; / served there by hosts of Apsarases, gods, and Asuras, they remain joyful in mind, exalted in heaven. 11
Description of the rule for the gift of a mountain of molasses.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi guḍaparvatamuttamam ..
yatpradānānnaraḥ svargaṃ prāpnoti surapūjitam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि गुडपर्वतमुत्तमम् ..
यत्प्रदानान्नरः स्वर्गं प्राप्नोति सुरपूजितम् .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
After this I shall explain the highest mountain of molasses,
by giving which a man attains heaven honoured by the gods.
title: Guḍācaladānavidhivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
uttamo daśabhirbhāraiḥ madhyamaḥ paṃcabhistathā ..
tribhirbhāraiḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ syāttadarddhenālpako mataḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
उत्तमो दशभिर्भारैः मध्यमः पंचभिस्तथा ..
त्रिभिर्भारैः कनिष्ठः स्यात्तदर्द्धेनाल्पको मतः .. 2 ..
text_mt:
The highest is made of ten bhāras, the intermediate of five,
the lowest consists of three bhāras, and half of that is considered small.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvadāmaṃtraṇaṃ pūjāṃ hemavṛkṣasurārcanam ..
viṣkaṃbhaparvatāstatra sarāṃsi vanadevatāḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
तद्वदामंत्रणं पूजां हेमवृक्षसुरार्चनम् ..
विष्कंभपर्वतास्तत्र सरांसि वनदेवताः .. 3 ..
text_mt:
Likewise, the invitation, the worship, the adoration of the golden trees and the gods,
the auxiliary mountains there, the lakes, the forest deities,

sanskrit_iast:
homaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ tadvallokapālādhivāsanam ..
dhānyaparvatavatkuryādimaṃ maṃtramudīrayet .. 4 ..
meaning:
होमं जागरणं तद्वल्लोकपालाधिवासनम् ..
धान्यपर्वतवत्कुर्यादिमं मंत्रमुदीरयेत् .. 4 ..
text_mt:
the fire-offering, the night-vigil, and similarly the preliminary consecration of the world protectors,
one should perform as for the mountain of grain, and recite this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
yathā deveṣu viśvātmā pravaroyaṃ janārdanaḥ ..
sāmavedastu vedānāṃ mahādevastu yoginām .. 5 ..
meaning:
यथा देवेषु विश्वात्मा प्रवरोयं जनार्दनः ..
सामवेदस्तु वेदानां महादेवस्तु योगिनाम् .. 5 ..
text_mt:
"Just as among the gods this Janārdana, the soul of the universe, is supreme,
as the Sāmaveda is among the Vedas, and Mahādeva among yogins,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavaḥ sarvamaṃtrāṇāṃ nārīṇāṃ pārvatī yathā ..
tathā rasānāṃ pravaraḥ sadā cekṣuraso mataḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
प्रणवः सर्वमंत्राणां नारीणां पार्वती यथा ..
तथा रसानां प्रवरः सदा चेक्षुरसो मतः .. 6 ..
text_mt:
as the praṇava is among all mantras, and Pārvatī among women,
even so sugarcane juice is always considered supreme among essences.

sanskrit_iast:
mama tasmātparāṃ lakṣmīṃ prayaccha guḍaparvata ..
surāsurāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ nāgayakṣarkṣayaṃtriṇām .. 7 ..
meaning:
मम तस्मात्परां लक्ष्मीं प्रयच्छ गुडपर्वत ..
सुरासुराणां सर्वेषां नागयक्षर्क्षयंत्रिणाम् .. 7 ..
text_mt:
Therefore, O mountain of molasses, grant me supreme fortune!
From all the gods and asuras, serpents, yakṣas, bears, and sorcerers,

sanskrit_iast:
vināśaścāpi pārvatyāstasmānmāṃ pāhi sarvadā ..
anena vidhinā yastu dadyādguḍamayaṃ girim .. 8 ..
meaning:
विनाशश्चापि पार्वत्यास्तस्मान्मां पाहि सर्वदा ..
अनेन विधिना यस्तु दद्याद्गुडमयं गिरिम् .. 8 ..
text_mt:
and from destruction, O mountain [dear to] Pārvatī, protect me always!"
One who gives a mountain made of molasses according to this rule,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjyamāno gaṃdharvairgauṃrīloke mahīyate ..
punaḥ kalpaśatāṃte tu saptadvīpādhipo bhavet .. 9 ..
meaning:
संपूज्यमानो गंधर्वैर्गौंरीलोके महीयते ..
पुनः कल्पशतांते तु सप्तद्वीपाधिपो भवेत् .. 9 ..
text_mt:
being honoured by the gandharvas, is exalted in the realm of Gaurī;
then, at the end of a hundred kalpas, he becomes ruler of the seven continents,

sanskrit_iast:
āyurārogyasaṃpannaḥ śatrubhiścāparājitaḥ ..
āsīdrājñī mahābhāgā sulabhā nāma suvratā .. 4.197.10 ..
meaning:
आयुरारोग्यसंपन्नः शत्रुभिश्चापराजितः ..
आसीद्राज्ञी महाभागा सुलभा नाम सुव्रता .. 4.197.10 ..
text_mt:
endowed with long life and good health, and undefeated by enemies.
There was a highly fortunate queen named Sulabhā, faithful to her vows,

sanskrit_iast:
maruttasya priyā bhāryā rūpa yauvanaśālinī ..
tasya bhāryā śatānyāsansapta rājño mahātmanaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
मरुत्तस्य प्रिया भार्या रूप यौवनशालिनी ..
तस्य भार्या शतान्यासन्सप्त राज्ञो महात्मनः .. 11 ..
text_mt:
the beloved wife of Marutta, endowed with beauty and youth.
That noble king had seven hundred wives;

sanskrit_iast:
tā dāsya iva vākyāni kuryustasyāḥ sadaiva hi ..
mukhāvalokanakaro rājā tasya ca sā priyā .. 12 ..
meaning:
ता दास्य इव वाक्यानि कुर्युस्तस्याः सदैव हि ..
मुखावलोकनकरो राजा तस्य च सा प्रिया .. 12 ..
text_mt:
they always obeyed her commands like handmaids;
the king constantly gazed upon her face, and she was dear to him.

sanskrit_iast:
atha kālena mahatā durvāsā ṛṣisattamaḥ ..
ājagāma tadabhyāśaṃ bhramamāṇo yadṛcchayā .. 13 ..
meaning:
अथ कालेन महता दुर्वासा ऋषिसत्तमः ..
आजगाम तदभ्याशं भ्रममाणो यदृच्छया .. 13 ..
text_mt:
Then, after a long time, the best of sages, Durvāsas,
came near her, wandering of his own free will.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyātha satkriyāṃ kṛttvā dattvā cārghaṃ yathāvidhi ..
papraccha sulabhā vipraṃ durvāsasamakalmaṣam .. 14 ..
meaning:
तस्याथ सत्क्रियां कृत्त्वा दत्त्वा चार्घं यथाविधि ..
पप्रच्छ सुलभा विप्रं दुर्वाससमकल्मषम् .. 14 ..
text_mt:
Having rendered hospitality to him and offered arghya according to the rule,
Sulabhā questioned the stainless brāhmaṇa Durvāsas.

sanskrit_iast:
.. sulabhovāca .. ..
kena puṇyena bhagavanmama rājā priyaṃkaraḥ ..
mukhāvalokanaparo vaśe tiṣṭhati sarvadā .. 15 .. ..
meaning:
.. सुलभोवाच .. ..
केन पुण्येन भगवन्मम राजा प्रियंकरः ..
मुखावलोकनपरो वशे तिष्ठति सर्वदा .. 15 .. ..
text_mt:
Sulabhā said:
"By what merit, O lord, is the king affectionate to me,
always intent on gazing at my face, and continually in my power?

sanskrit_iast:
sapatnyaśca mama brahmansadā priyahite ratāḥ ..
etadācakṣva bhagavanparaṃ kautūhalaṃ mama ..16..
meaning:
सपत्न्यश्च मम ब्रह्मन्सदा प्रियहिते रताः ..
एतदाचक्ष्व भगवन्परं कौतूहलं मम ..16..
text_mt:
And why, O brāhmaṇa, are my co-wives always devoted to doing what is pleasing and beneficial to me?
Tell me this, O lord; great is my curiosity."

sanskrit_iast:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
śṛṇuṣvāvahitā subhrūrātmavṛttaṃ purātanam ..
jānāmi sarvaṃ subhage tava vṛttamaśeṣataḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच .. ..
शृणुष्वावहिता सुभ्रूरात्मवृत्तं पुरातनम् ..
जानामि सर्वं सुभगे तव वृत्तमशेषतः .. 17 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tvamāsīrvaiśya mahiṣī girivrajapure purā ..
dhārmikā satyaśīlā ca pativrataparāyaṇā .. 18 ..
meaning:
त्वमासीर्वैश्य महिषी गिरिव्रजपुरे पुरा ..
धार्मिका सत्यशीला च पतिव्रतपरायणा .. 18 ..
text_mt:
In the past, you were the chief wife of a vaiśya in the city of Girivraja,
virtuous, truthful in character, and devoted to your husband.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra śrutastvayā vatse brāhmaṇānāṃ samīpataḥ ..
purā dānavidhiḥ kṛtsnaḥ sthitayā patisaṃnidhau .. 19 ..
meaning:
तत्र श्रुतस्त्वया वत्से ब्राह्मणानां समीपतः ..
पुरा दानविधिः कृत्स्नः स्थितया पतिसंनिधौ .. 19 ..
text_mt:
There, O child, while staying by your husband's side, you heard
the whole rule for gifts in the presence of brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣatastatra vipraiḥ kathito guḍaparvataḥ ..
dattaścāpi tvayā putri saṃbhṛtya vidhivattadā .. 4.197.20 ..
meaning:
विशेषतस्तत्र विप्रैः कथितो गुडपर्वतः ..
दत्तश्चापि त्वया पुत्रि संभृत्य विधिवत्तदा .. 4.197.20 ..
text_mt:
In particular, the mountain of molasses was described there by the brāhmaṇas;
and having assembled [the materials] properly at that time, O daughter, you gave it.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya dānasya māhātmyāttvayā bhuktaṃ varānane ..
rājyaṃ janmāni catvāri niḥsapatnamanākulam .. 21 ..
meaning:
तस्य दानस्य माहात्म्यात्त्वया भुक्तं वरानने ..
राज्यं जन्मानि चत्वारि निःसपत्नमनाकुलम् .. 21 ..
text_mt:
Through the majesty of that gift, O fair-faced lady,
you enjoyed sovereignty for four births, free from rivals and untroubled.

sanskrit_iast:
anyāni sapta janmāni tava rājyaṃ bhaviṣyati ..
saubhāgyamatulaṃ caiva rūpamārogyameva ca .. 22 ..
meaning:
अन्यानि सप्त जन्मानि तव राज्यं भविष्यति ..
सौभाग्यमतुलं चैव रूपमारोग्यमेव च .. 22 ..
text_mt:
For another seven births you will possess sovereignty,
unrivalled good fortune, beauty, and good health.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtaṃ caivamavaśyaṃ ca guḍaparvatadānajam ..
kathā tava varārohe yāsye tvaṃ bhava pu triṇī .. 23 ..
meaning:
भूतं चैवमवश्यं च गुडपर्वतदानजम् ..
कथा तव वरारोहे यास्ये त्वं भव पु त्रिणी .. 23 ..
text_mt:
Such is the inescapable result born of giving the mountain of molasses.
Such is your story, O fair-hipped lady; I shall depart; may you have sons!"

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāddeyamidaṃ dānaṃ phalamuttamamicchatā ..
gatiṃ ca śāśvatīṃ lebhe saubhāgyaṃ rūpameva ca .. 24 ..
meaning:
तस्माद्देयमिदं दानं फलमुत्तममिच्छता ..
गतिं च शाश्वतीं लेभे सौभाग्यं रूपमेव च .. 24 ..
text_mt:
Therefore, this gift should be given by one who desires the highest reward;
and she attained the eternal path, good fortune, and beauty.

sanskrit_iast:
dānametatpraśaṃsaṃti strīṇāṃ rāja nviśeṣataḥ ..
pūrvoktaṃ ca phalaṃ prāpya kṛtakṛtyo'bhijāyate .. 25 ..
meaning:
दानमेतत्प्रशंसंति स्त्रीणां राज न्विशेषतः ..
पूर्वोक्तं च फलं प्राप्य कृतकृत्योऽभिजायते .. 25 ..
text_mt:
They praise this gift especially for women, O king;
and having obtained the previously mentioned fruit, one becomes fulfilled.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇeṣṭasuṃdaradarīsravaṇākulena gaṃdharvasiddhavanitāśatasevitena ..
dattena bhārata vidhānavatā sadaiva gaurī prasādamupayāti guḍācalena .. 26 .. ..
hemācaladānavidhivarṇanam
meaning:
कृष्णेष्टसुंदरदरीस्रवणाकुलेन गंधर्वसिद्धवनिताशतसेवितेन ..
दत्तेन भारत विधानवता सदैव गौरी प्रसादमुपयाति गुडाचलेन .. 26 .. ..
हेमाचलदानविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
When given properly according to rule, O descendant of Bharata, by means of that mountain of molasses,
filled with charming caves and flowing streams pleasing to Kṛṣṇa, and attended by hundreds of women of the gandharvas and siddhas, Gaurī is always pleased.
Description of the Rule for the Gift of the Mountain of Gold

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
atha pāpaharaṃ vakṣye suvarṇācalamuttamam ..
yasya prasādādbhavanaṃ vairicyaṃ yāti mānavaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
अथ पापहरं वक्ष्ये सुवर्णाचलमुत्तमम् ..
यस्य प्रसादाद्भवनं वैरिच्यं याति मानवः .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Now I shall explain the highest mountain of gold, which removes sins,
by the grace of which a human being goes to the abode of Brahmā.
title: adhyāyaḥ 198

sanskrit_iast:
uttamaḥ palasāhasro madhyamaḥ pañcabhiḥ śataiḥ ..
tadarddhenāvarastadvadalpavitto'pi śaktitaḥ .. .. 2..
meaning:
उत्तमः पलसाहस्रो मध्यमः पञ्चभिः शतैः ..
तदर्द्धेनावरस्तद्वदल्पवित्तोऽपि शक्तितः .. .. 2..
text_mt:
The highest is made of a thousand palas, the intermediate of five hundred,
the lowest of half that; and one of small means [may give] according to his ability.

sanskrit_iast:
dadyādekapalādūrdhvaṃ yathāśaktyā vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
dhānyaparvatavatsarvaṃ vidadhyānnṛpasattama .. 3 ..
meaning:
दद्यादेकपलादूर्ध्वं यथाशक्त्या विचक्षणः ..
धान्यपर्वतवत्सर्वं विदध्यान्नृपसत्तम .. 3 ..
text_mt:
The wise man should give upwards of one pala, according to his capacity;
one should perform everything just like the mountain of grain, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣkaṃbhaśailāṃstadvacca kṛtvā maṃtramudīrayet ..
namaste brahmabījāya brahmagarbhāya vai namaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
विष्कंभशैलांस्तद्वच्च कृत्वा मंत्रमुदीरयेत् ..
नमस्ते ब्रह्मबीजाय ब्रह्मगर्भाय वै नमः .. 4 ..
text_mt:
