text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Now I shall fully explain the excellent mountain of sugar, / from the gift of which Viṣṇu, Sūrya, and Rudra are always pleased.
title: Varṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭabhiḥ śarkarābhārairuttamaḥ syānmahācalaḥ ..
caturbhirmadhyamaḥ prokto bhārābhyāmadhamaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
अष्टभिः शर्कराभारैरुत्तमः स्यान्महाचलः ..
चतुर्भिर्मध्यमः प्रोक्तो भाराभ्यामधमः स्मृतः .. 2 ..
text_mt: The highest great mountain should be made of eight bhāras of sugar; / the middling is declared to be four, and the lowest is remembered as two bhāras.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāreṇaivārddhabhāreṇa kuryādyaścālpavittavān ..
viṣkaṃbhaparvatānkuryātturīyāṃśena mānavaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
भारेणैवार्द्धभारेण कुर्याद्यश्चाल्पवित्तवान् ..
विष्कंभपर्वतान्कुर्यात्तुरीयांशेन मानवः .. 3 ..
text_mt: A man of small wealth may make it with one bhāra or half a bhāra; / a man should make the peripheral mountains with a fourth part [each].

sanskrit_iast:
dhānyaparvatavatsarvamāsādya rasasaṃyutam ..
meroruparitastadvatsthāpya hematarutrayam .. 4 ..
meaning:
धान्यपर्वतवत्सर्वमासाद्य रससंयुतम् ..
मेरोरुपरितस्तद्वत्स्थाप्य हेमतरुत्रयम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Preparing everything together with the liquids just as with the mountain of grain, / having likewise placed three golden trees on top of Meru:

sanskrit_iast:
maṃdāraḥ pārijātaśca tṛtīyaḥ kalpapādapaḥ..
etadvṛkṣatrayaṃ mūrdhni sarveṣvapi nidhāpayet ..5..
meaning:
मंदारः पारिजातश्च तृतीयः कल्पपादपः..
एतद्वृक्षत्रयं मूर्ध्नि सर्वेष्वपि निधापयेत् ..5..
text_mt: the mandāra, the pārijāta, and thirdly the wish-granting tree; / one should have these three trees placed on the summit on all [the mountains] as well.

sanskrit_iast:
haricaṃdanasaṃtānau pūrvapaścimabhāgayoḥ ..
niveśyau sarvaśaileṣu viśeṣāccharkarācale .. 6 ..
meaning:
हरिचंदनसंतानौ पूर्वपश्चिमभागयोः ..
निवेश्यौ सर्वशैलेषु विशेषाच्छर्कराचले .. 6 ..
text_mt: The haricandana and saṃtāna trees should be placed on the eastern and western parts / on all mountains, especially on the mountain of sugar.

sanskrit_iast:
maṃdare kāmadevaṃ tu kaṃdabasya tale nyaset ..
jaṃbūvṛkṣatale kāryo garunmāngaṃdhamādane ..7..
meaning:
मंदरे कामदेवं तु कंदबस्य तले न्यसेत् ..
जंबूवृक्षतले कार्यो गरुन्मान्गंधमादने ..7..
text_mt: On Mount Mandara one should place Kāmadeva beneath a kadamba tree; / on Gandhamādana, Garuḍa should be fashioned beneath a jambū tree.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṅmukho hemamūrtiśca haṃsaḥ syādvipulācale ..
haimī śreyorthibhiḥ kāryā surabhirdakṣiṇāmukhī .. 8 ..
meaning:
प्राङ्मुखो हेममूर्तिश्च हंसः स्याद्विपुलाचले ..
हैमी श्रेयोर्थिभिः कार्या सुरभिर्दक्षिणामुखी .. 8 ..
text_mt: On Mount Vipula there should be an east-facing golden form of a swan; / those seeking welfare should make a golden Surabhi facing south.

sanskrit_iast:
dhānyaparvatavatsarvamāvāhanamakhādikam ..
kṛtvātha gurave dadyānmadhyamaṃ parvatottamam .. 9 ..
meaning:
धान्यपर्वतवत्सर्वमावाहनमखादिकम् ..
कृत्वाथ गुरवे दद्यान्मध्यमं पर्वतोत्तमम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Having performed everything—the invocation, sacrificial ritual, and the rest—as with the mountain of grain, / one should then give the central, excellent mountain to the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtvigbhyaścaturaḥ śailānimānmaṃtrānudīrayet ..
saubhāgyāmṛtasāro'yaṃ paramaḥ śarkarāyutaḥ .. 4.204.10 ..
meaning:
ऋत्विग्भ्यश्चतुरः शैलानिमान्मंत्रानुदीरयेत् ..
सौभाग्यामृतसारोऽयं परमः शर्करायुतः .. 4.204.10 ..
text_mt: He should give the four mountains to the priests, reciting these mantras: / “This supreme essence of the nectar of auspiciousness, accompanied by sugar...

sanskrit_iast:
yasmādānaṃdakārī tvaṃ bhava śaileṃdra sarvadā ..
amṛtaṃ pibatāṃ ye tu niṣpeturbhuvi śīkarāḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
यस्मादानंदकारी त्वं भव शैलेंद्र सर्वदा ..
अमृतं पिबतां ये तु निष्पेतुर्भुवि शीकराः .. 11 ..
text_mt: Because you bring joy, O lord of mountains, be ever [joyful]! / Those drops that fell to the earth as the gods were drinking nectar—

sanskrit_iast:
devānāṃ tatsamuttho'si pāhi naḥ śarkarācala ..
manobhavadhanurmadhyādudbhūtā śarkarā yataḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
देवानां तत्समुत्थोऽसि पाहि नः शर्कराचल ..
मनोभवधनुर्मध्यादुद्भूता शर्करा यतः .. 12 ..
text_mt: From those you arose; protect us, O mountain of sugar! / Since sugar was born from the middle of the bow of the Mind-born god [Kāmadeva],

sanskrit_iast:
tanmayo'si mahāśaila pāhi saṃsārasāgarāt ..
yo dadyāccharkarāśailamanena vidhinā naraḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
तन्मयोऽसि महाशैल पाहि संसारसागरात् ..
यो दद्याच्छर्कराशैलमनेन विधिना नरः .. 13 ..
text_mt: You consist of that, O great mountain; protect [us] from the ocean of worldly existence!' / The man who gives a mountain of sugar according to this rule

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sa yāti śivamaṃdiram ..
caṃdrādisārcisaṃkāśamadhiruhyānujīvibhiḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः स याति शिवमंदिरम् ..
चंद्रादिसार्चिसंकाशमधिरुह्यानुजीविभिः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Is freed from all sins and goes to the abode of Śiva. / Ascending a vehicle resembling the rays of the moon and [the sun], together with his dependents,

sanskrit_iast:
sahaiva yānamātiṣṭhetsa tu viṣṇupade divi ..
tataḥ kalpa śatāṃte tu saptadvīpādhipo bhavet .. 15 ..
meaning:
सहैव यानमातिष्ठेत्स तु विष्णुपदे दिवि ..
ततः कल्प शतांते तु सप्तद्वीपाधिपो भवेत् .. 15 ..
text_mt: He indeed abides in heaven, in the abode of Viṣṇu. / Then, at the end of a hundred kalpas, he becomes the ruler of the seven continents,

sanskrit_iast:
āyurārogyasaṃpanno yāvajjanmāyutatrayam ..
bhojanaṃ śaktito dadyātsarvaśaileṣvamatsaraḥ ..
svayaṃ vā kṣāra lavaṇamaśnīyāttadanujñayā .. 16 ..
meaning:
आयुरारोग्यसंपन्नो यावज्जन्मायुतत्रयम् ..
भोजनं शक्तितो दद्यात्सर्वशैलेष्वमत्सरः ..
स्वयं वा क्षार लवणमश्नीयात्तदनुज्ञया .. 16 ..
text_mt: Endowed with long life and health for thirty thousand births. / Free from jealousy, one should give food according to one's capacity at all the mountains; / or oneself, with his [the guru's] permission, one should eat alkaline salt.

sanskrit_iast:
parvatopaskaraṃ sarvaṃ prāpayedbrāhmaṇālayam ..
āsītpurā brahmakalpe dharmamūrtirnarādhipaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
पर्वतोपस्करं सर्वं प्रापयेद्ब्राह्मणालयम् ..
आसीत्पुरा ब्रह्मकल्पे धर्ममूर्तिर्नराधिपः .. 17 ..
text_mt: One should convey all the equipment of the mountain to the home of the brāhmaṇa. / In ancient times, in the Kalpa of Brahmā, there was a king who was the embodiment of righteousness,

sanskrit_iast:
suhṛcchakrasya nihatā yena daityāḥ sahasraśaḥ ..
somasūryādayo yasya tejasā vigataprabhāḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
सुहृच्छक्रस्य निहता येन दैत्याः सहस्रशः ..
सोमसूर्यादयो यस्य तेजसा विगतप्रभाः .. 18 ..
text_mt: A friend of Indra, by whom thousands of daityas were slain; / by whose radiance Soma, Sūrya, and the others became devoid of luster;

sanskrit_iast:
bhavaṃti śataśo yena rājāno'pi parājitāḥ ..
yathecchārūpadhārī ca manuṣyo'pyapavāritaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
भवंति शतशो येन राजानोऽपि पराजिताः ..
यथेच्छारूपधारी च मनुष्योऽप्यपवारितः .. 19 ..
text_mt: By whom kings by the hundreds were defeated; / who assumed forms at will, yet was an unhindered mortal.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya bhānumatīnāma bhāryā trailokyasuṃdarī ..
lakṣmīriva ca rūpeṇa nirjitāmarasuṃdarī .. 4.204.20 ..
meaning:
तस्य भानुमतीनाम भार्या त्रैलोक्यसुंदरी ..
लक्ष्मीरिव च रूपेण निर्जितामरसुंदरी .. 4.204.20 ..
text_mt: His wife, named Bhānumatī, was the most beautiful woman in the three worlds, / resembling Lakṣmī in beauty, who surpassed heavenly beauties.

sanskrit_iast:
rājñastasyāgramahiṣī prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī ..
daśanārīsahasrāṇāṃ madhye śrīriva rājate .. 21 ..
meaning:
राज्ञस्तस्याग्रमहिषी प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसी ..
दशनारीसहस्राणां मध्ये श्रीरिव राजते .. 21 ..
text_mt: She was the chief queen of that king, dearer even than his life's breath; / among ten thousand women, she shone like Śrī.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpakoṭisahasreṇa na kadācitpramucyate ..
sa kadācitsthānagataṃ papraccha svaṃ purohitam .. 22 ..
meaning:
नृपकोटिसहस्रेण न कदाचित्प्रमुच्यते ..
स कदाचित्स्थानगतं पप्रच्छ स्वं पुरोहितम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: He was never abandoned by tens of millions of kings. / Once, he asked his family priest who had arrived at his seat,

sanskrit_iast:
vismayāviṣṭahṛdayo vasiṣṭhamṛṣisattamam ..
bhagavankena dharmeṇa mama lakṣmīranuttamā .. 23 ..
meaning:
विस्मयाविष्टहृदयो वसिष्ठमृषिसत्तमम् ..
भगवन्केन धर्मेण मम लक्ष्मीरनुत्तमा .. 23 ..
text_mt: His heart filled with wonder, [addressing] Vasiṣṭha, the best of sages: / 'O venerable one, by what righteous act is my fortune unsurpassed?

sanskrit_iast: kasmācca vipulaṃ tejo maccharīre sadottamam .. 24 ..
meaning: कस्माच्च विपुलं तेजो मच्छरीरे सदोत्तमम् .. 24 ..
text_mt: And why is there always immense, supreme splendor in my body?'

sanskrit_iast:
.. vaśiṣṭha uvāca ..
purā līlāvatī nāma veśyā śivaparāyaṇā ..
tayā dattaścaturdaśyāṃ gurave lavaṇācalaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
.. वशिष्ठ उवाच ..
पुरा लीलावती नाम वेश्या शिवपरायणा ..
तया दत्तश्चतुर्दश्यां गुरवे लवणाचलः .. 25 ..
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / 'In ancient times there was a courtesan named Līlāvatī, devoted to Śiva; / on the fourteenth day, she gave a mountain of salt to her guru,

sanskrit_iast:
hemavṛkṣāmaraiḥ sārddhaṃ yathāvadvidhipūrvakaḥ ..
śūdraḥ suvarṇakārastu nāmnā śauṃḍobhavattadā .. 26 ..
meaning:
हेमवृक्षामरैः सार्द्धं यथावद्विधिपूर्वकः ..
शूद्रः सुवर्णकारस्तु नाम्ना शौंडोभवत्तदा .. 26 ..
text_mt: Together with golden trees and gods, properly in accordance with rule. / At that time there was a śūdra goldsmith named Śauṇḍa,

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛtyo līlāvatīgehe tena haimā vinirmitāḥ ..
taravo'maramukhyāśca śraddhāyuktena pārthiva .. 27 ..
meaning:
भृत्यो लीलावतीगेहे तेन हैमा विनिर्मिताः ..
तरवोऽमरमुख्याश्च श्रद्धायुक्तेन पार्थिव .. 27 ..
text_mt: A servant in Līlāvatī's house; by him, endowed with faith, / golden trees and chief deities were fashioned, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
atirūpeṇa saṃpannānghaṭayitvā tato hṛdi ..
dharmakāryamatiṃ jñātvā nāgṛhīta kathaṃcana .. 28 ..
meaning:
अतिरूपेण संपन्नान्घटयित्वा ततो हृदि ..
धर्मकार्यमतिं ज्ञात्वा नागृहीत कथंचन .. 28 ..
text_mt: Having fashioned them endowed with extreme beauty, then in his heart / recognizing her mind was set on a pious act, he took nothing whatever.

sanskrit_iast:
ujjvālitāstu tatpatnyā sauvarṇāmarapādapāḥ ..
līlāvatī gṛhe pārśve paricaryā ca pārthiva .. 29 ..
meaning:
उज्ज्वालितास्तु तत्पत्न्या सौवर्णामरपादपाः ..
लीलावती गृहे पार्श्वे परिचर्या च पार्थिव .. 29 ..
text_mt: The golden divine trees were polished by his wife, / and service was rendered beside Līlāvatī's house, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaṃ tābhyāṃ praharṣeṇa dvijaśuśrūṣaṇādikam ..
sā tu līlāvatī veśyā kālena mahatā nṛpa .. 4.204.30 ..
meaning:
कृतं ताभ्यां प्रहर्षेण द्विजशुश्रूषणादिकम् ..
सा तु लीलावती वेश्या कालेन महता नृप .. 4.204.30 ..
text_mt: Attending upon the brāhmaṇas and other [services] were performed by both of them with great joy. / In course of time, O king, that courtesan Līlāvatī,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpavinirmuktā jagāma śivamaṃdiram ..
yo'sau suvarṇakāraśca daridro'pyati sattvavān .. 31 ..
meaning:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्ता जगाम शिवमंदिरम् ..
योऽसौ सुवर्णकारश्च दरिद्रोऽप्यति सत्त्ववान् .. 31 ..
text_mt: Freed from all sins, went to the abode of Śiva. / And that goldsmith who, though poor, possessed great noble resolution,

sanskrit_iast:
na mūlyamādādveśyātaḥ sa bhavāniha sāṃpratam ..
saptadvīpapatirjātaḥ sūryāyutasamaprabhaḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
न मूल्यमादाद्वेश्यातः स भवानिह सांप्रतम् ..
सप्तद्वीपपतिर्जातः सूर्यायुतसमप्रभः .. 32 ..
text_mt: And took no payment from the courtesan, is now you yourself in this world; / you have become the lord of the seven continents, radiant as ten thousand suns.

sanskrit_iast:
yayā suvarṇa racitāstaravo hemadevatāḥ ..
samyagujjvalitāḥ patnī seyaṃ bhānumatī tava .. 30 ..
meaning:
यया सुवर्ण रचितास्तरवो हेमदेवताः ..
सम्यगुज्ज्वलिताः पत्नी सेयं भानुमती तव .. 30 ..
text_mt: She by whom the golden trees and golden deities / were thoroughly polished is this Bhānumatī, your wife.

sanskrit_iast:
ujjvālanādujjvalarūpamasyāḥ sujātamasminbhuvanādhipatyam ..
tasmātkṛtaṃ tatparikarma rātrāvanuddhatābhyāṃ lavaṇācalasya .. 34 ..
meaning:
उज्ज्वालनादुज्ज्वलरूपमस्याः सुजातमस्मिन्भुवनाधिपत्यम् ..
तस्मात्कृतं तत्परिकर्म रात्रावनुद्धताभ्यां लवणाचलस्य .. 34 ..
text_mt: From the polishing, her brilliant form was born, as was this sovereignty over the world; / therefore, that service for the salt-mountain was performed at night by the two of you without arrogance.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmācca lokeṣvaparājitastvamārogyasaubhāgyayutā ca lakṣmīḥ ..
tasmāttvamapyatra vidhānapūrvaṃ dhānyācalādīndaśadhā kuruṣva .. 35 ..
meaning:
तस्माच्च लोकेष्वपराजितस्त्वमारोग्यसौभाग्ययुता च लक्ष्मीः ..
तस्मात्त्वमप्यत्र विधानपूर्वं धान्याचलादीन्दशधा कुरुष्व .. 35 ..
text_mt: Therefore you are undefeated in the worlds, and your fortune is endowed with health and good luck; / therefore, you too here must offer the ten [mountains], beginning with the grain-mountain, according to rule.'

sanskrit_iast:
tatheti sampūjya ca dharmamūrti vaco vaśiṣṭhasya dadau sa sarvān ..
dhānyācalādīnkramaśaḥ purārerlokaṃ jagāmāmarapūjyamānaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
तथेति सम्पूज्य च धर्ममूर्ति वचो वशिष्ठस्य ददौ स सर्वान् ..
धान्याचलादीन्क्रमशः पुरारेर्लोकं जगामामरपूज्यमानः .. 36 ..
text_mt: Saying 'So be it,' that embodiment of righteousness honored the word of Vasiṣṭha and gave all / [mountains] beginning with the grain-mountain in order, and, honored by the gods, went to the realm of the enemy of Pura [Śiva].

sanskrit_iast:
yaścādhanaḥ paśyati dīyamānaṃ meroḥ pradānamiha dharmaparo manuṣyaḥ ..
śṛṇoti bhaktyā parayā'pramādī vikalmaṣaḥ so'pi divaṃ prayāti .. 37 ..
meaning:
यश्चाधनः पश्यति दीयमानं मेरोः प्रदानमिह धर्मपरो मनुष्यः ..
शृणोति भक्त्या परयाऽप्रमादी विकल्मषः सोऽपि दिवं प्रयाति .. 37 ..
text_mt: And whatever man without wealth, intent on righteousness, sees being given here / the gift of Meru, or hears of it with supreme devotion and vigilance, he too, freed from taint, goes to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
duḥsvapnaṃ praśabhamupaiti paṭhyamāne śailendre bhavabhayabhedane narāṇām ..
yaḥ kuryātkimu nṛpapuṃgaveha samyakchāṃtātmā hariharapurameti jaṃtuḥ .. 38 ..
sadācāradharmavarṇanam
meaning:
दुःस्वप्नं प्रशभमुपैति पठ्यमाने शैलेन्द्रे भवभयभेदने नराणाम् ..
यः कुर्यात्किमु नृपपुंगवेह सम्यक्छांतात्मा हरिहरपुरमेति जंतुः .. 38 ..
सदाचारधर्मवर्णनम्
text_mt:
When this lord of mountains that breaks the fear of worldly existence is recited, a bad dream is immediately subdued for men; / what need be said of a person who fully performs it here with a tranquil soul, O best of kings? He goes to the city of Hari and Hara.
Description of the Practice of Proper Conduct

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
pratipankramayogena tithīnāṃ vistaraḥ śrutaḥ ..
sarahasyaḥ samaṃtraśca prāraṃbhodyāpanaiḥ saha .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
प्रतिपन्क्रमयोगेन तिथीनां विस्तरः श्रुतः ..
सरहस्यः समंत्रश्च प्रारंभोद्यापनैः सह .. 1 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / 'Starting from the first lunar day, in proper order, the extensive account of lunar days has been heard / along with the secret doctrine, with mantras, and with beginnings and concluding rites.
title: Sadācāradharmavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
navagrahamakhātsarvaṃ homakarmāvadhāritam ..
snānakramaśca vidito vijñātāścotsavā mayā .. 2 ..
meaning:
नवग्रहमखात्सर्वं होमकर्मावधारितम् ..
स्नानक्रमश्च विदितो विज्ञाताश्चोत्सवा मया .. 2 ..
text_mt: Beginning with the sacrifice to the nine planets, all the homa ritual has been understood; / and the sequence of bathings has been learned, and festivals have been comprehended by me.

sanskrit_iast:
dānadharmastvaśeṣeṇa śrutaḥ sarvārthadarśitaḥ ..
taḍāgotsarjanavidhirviditaḥ pādapotsavaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
दानधर्मस्त्वशेषेण श्रुतः सर्वार्थदर्शितः ..
तडागोत्सर्जनविधिर्विदितः पादपोत्सवः .. 3 ..
text_mt: The duty of gifting has been heard completely, revealing all ends of life; / the rule for the dedication of ponds has been learned, and the festival of trees.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ gataṃ mama mano muhyate madhusūdana ..
vrataṃ kathayatā kṛṣṇa tāstāḥ saṃśritya devatāḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
एवं गतं मम मनो मुह्यते मधुसूदन ..
व्रतं कथयता कृष्ण तास्ताः संश्रित्य देवताः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Yet, turning thus, my mind is bewildered, O Madhusūdana! / While you described votive observances, O Kṛṣṇa, taking refuge in various deities,

sanskrit_iast:
devānāṃ devakīputra nānātvaṃ saṃpradarśitam ..
tithikramānkathayatā pūjāmantrodhivāsanam .. 5 ..
meaning:
देवानां देवकीपुत्र नानात्वं संप्रदर्शितम् ..
तिथिक्रमान्कथयता पूजामन्त्रोधिवासनम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Multiplicity of gods has been demonstrated, O son of Devakī, / while narrating the sequence of lunar days, worship, mantras, and preliminary consecration.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsādyairmunibhiḥ sarvairdhyānayogaparāyaṇaiḥ ..
eka evātra nirdiṣṭo devaḥ sarvagato'vyayaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
व्यासाद्यैर्मुनिभिः सर्वैर्ध्यानयोगपरायणैः ..
एक एवात्र निर्दिष्टो देवः सर्वगतोऽव्ययः .. 6 ..
text_mt: By all the sages beginning with Vyāsa, devoted to the yoga of meditation, / only one all-pervading, imperishable God has been pointed out here.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāśramācāradharmaḥ kasmānnātra pradarśitaḥ ..
ete maharṣayastuṣṭāḥ śrotukāmā bhavadvacaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
वर्णाश्रमाचारधर्मः कस्मान्नात्र प्रदर्शितः ..
एते महर्षयस्तुष्टाः श्रोतुकामा भवद्वचः .. 7 ..
text_mt: Why has the righteous conduct of the classes and life-stages not been expounded here? / These great sages are satisfied and wish to hear your word.'

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
vratadānaikaleśoyaṃ kathitastava pārthiva ..
viśeṣataśca śaknoti vaktuṃ yadi sarasvatī .. 8 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
व्रतदानैकलेशोयं कथितस्तव पार्थिव ..
विशेषतश्च शक्नोति वक्तुं यदि सरस्वती .. 8 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / 'Only a single fraction of votive observances and gifts has been spoken to you, O king; / and even Sarasvatī could speak of them in detail [only with difficulty].

sanskrit_iast:
sarvastarati durgāṇi sarvo bhadrāṇi paśyati ..
varṇāśramāṇāṃ sāmānya iti dharmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
सर्वस्तरति दुर्गाणि सर्वो भद्राणि पश्यति ..
वर्णाश्रमाणां सामान्य इति धर्मः प्रकीर्तितः .. 9 ..
text_mt: Everyone crosses over difficulties; everyone sees good things: / this is declared as the common duty for the classes and life-stages.

sanskrit_iast:
kathito'yaṃ vratatvoho devānuddiśya yo mayā ..
paramārthaḥ sa evokto devastamupadhāraya .. 4.205.10 ..
meaning:
कथितोऽयं व्रतत्वोहो देवानुद्दिश्य यो मया ..
परमार्थः स एवोक्तो देवस्तमुपधारय .. 4.205.10 ..
text_mt: This collection of votive observances that has been described by me with reference to the deities / is declared as the supreme reality itself; understand that God!

sanskrit_iast:
yo brahmā sa hariḥ prokto yo hariḥ sa maheśvaraḥ ..
maheśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ sūryaḥ sūryaḥ pāvaka ucyate .. .. 11 ..
meaning:
यो ब्रह्मा स हरिः प्रोक्तो यो हरिः स महेश्वरः ..
महेश्वरः स्मृतः सूर्यः सूर्यः पावक उच्यते .. .. 11 ..
text_mt: He who is Brahmā is said to be Hari; he who is Hari is Maheśvara; / Maheśvara is remembered as Sūrya; Sūrya is said to be the Fire.

sanskrit_iast:
pāvakaḥ kārtikeyosau kārtikeyo vināyakaḥ ..
gaurī lakṣmīśca sāvitrī śaktibhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
पावकः कार्तिकेयोसौ कार्तिकेयो विनायकः ..
गौरी लक्ष्मीश्च सावित्री शक्तिभेदाः प्रकीर्तिताः .. 12 ..
text_mt: That Fire is Kārttikeya; Kārttikeya is Vināyaka; / Gaurī, Lakṣmī, and Sāvitrī are declared to be differentiations of Śakti.

sanskrit_iast:
devaṃ devīṃ samuddiśya yaḥ karoti vrataṃ naraḥ ..
na bhedastatra maṃtavyaḥ śivaśaktimayaṃ jagat .. 13 ..
meaning:
देवं देवीं समुद्दिश्य यः करोति व्रतं नरः ..
न भेदस्तत्र मंतव्यः शिवशक्तिमयं जगत् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Whatever votive observance a man performs dedicated to a god or a goddess, / no distinction is to be considered there; the world is made of Śiva and Śakti.'

sanskrit_iast:
bahuprakārā vasudhā bhedāḥ sāgnyanilāṃbhasām ..
paramārthataściṃtyamāno na bhedaḥ pratibhāsate .. 14 ..
meaning:
बहुप्रकारा वसुधा भेदाः साग्न्यनिलांभसाम् ..
परमार्थतश्चिंत्यमानो न भेदः प्रतिभासते .. 14 ..
text_mt: The earth has many forms, and there are varieties of fire, wind, and water; / when considered in the highest sense, no division is perceived.

sanskrit_iast:
kañciddevaṃ samāśritya karoti kimapi vratam ..
trayīdharmānugaṃ pārtha ekaṃ tatrāpi kāraṇam .. 15 ..
meaning:
कञ्चिद्देवं समाश्रित्य करोति किमपि व्रतम् ..
त्रयीधर्मानुगं पार्थ एकं तत्रापि कारणम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: Taking refuge in whichever deity, one performs whatever votive observance / in accordance with the duty prescribed by the triple Veda, O son of Pṛthā, yet even there the cause is one.

sanskrit_iast:
yaścaiva te mayā khyāto vratadānavidhiḥ paraḥ ..
saphalaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ sadācāravatāṃ satām .. 16 ..
meaning:
यश्चैव ते मया ख्यातो व्रतदानविधिः परः ..
सफलः स तु विज्ञेयः सदाचारवतां सताम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: And whatever supreme rule of votive observances and gifts has been spoken of by me to you, / that should be understood as fruitful for virtuous men endowed with good conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
ācārahīnaṃ na punaṃti vedā yadyapyadhītāḥ saha ṣaḍbhiraṅgaiḥ ..
chaṃdāṃsyenaṃ mṛtyukāle tyajaṃti nīḍaṃ śakuntā iva jātapakṣāḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
आचारहीनं न पुनंति वेदा यद्यप्यधीताः सह षड्भिरङ्गैः ..
छंदांस्येनं मृत्युकाले त्यजंति नीडं शकुन्ता इव जातपक्षाः .. 17 ..
text_mt: The Vedas do not purify one who is devoid of good conduct, even if studied along with the six limbs; / at the time of death, the Vedic meters abandon him, just as fledglings with grown wings abandon their nest.

sanskrit_iast:
kapālasthaṃ yathā toyaṃ śvadṛtau vā yathā payaḥ ..
duṣṭaṃ syātsthānadoṣeṇa vṛttahīne tathā śubham .. 18 ..
meaning:
कपालस्थं यथा तोयं श्वदृतौ वा यथा पयः ..
दुष्टं स्यात्स्थानदोषेण वृत्तहीने तथा शुभम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: Just as water kept in a skull, or milk kept in a dog's leather bag, / becomes defiled due to the fault of its vessel, so auspicious deeds [become defiled] in one devoid of good conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛttaṃ yatnena saṃrakṣedvittameti prayāti ca ..
ahīno vittato hīno vṛttatastu hato hataḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
वृत्तं यत्नेन संरक्षेद्वित्तमेति प्रयाति च ..
अहीनो वित्ततो हीनो वृत्ततस्तु हतो हतः .. 19 ..
text_mt: One should preserve one's character with effort; wealth comes and goes. / One who is deficient in wealth is not ruined, but one who is ruined in character is utterly ruined.

sanskrit_iast:
evamācāradharmasya mūlaṃ rājankulasya ca ..
ācārāddhi cyuto jaṃturna kulīno na dhārmikaḥ .. 4.205.20..
meaning:
एवमाचारधर्मस्य मूलं राजन्कुलस्य च ..
आचाराद्धि च्युतो जंतुर्न कुलीनो न धार्मिकः .. 4.205.20..
text_mt: Thus good conduct is the root of dharma and of family, O king; / for a creature fallen from good conduct is neither of noble family nor righteous.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ kulenopadiṣṭen vipulena durātmanām ..
kṛmayaḥ kiṃ na jāyaṃte kusumeṣu sugaṃdhiṣu .. 21 ..
meaning:
किं कुलेनोपदिष्टेन् विपुलेन दुरात्मनाम् ..
कृमयः किं न जायंते कुसुमेषु सुगंधिषु .. 21 ..
text_mt: What is the use of an extensive lineage declared for the wicked? / Do worms not arise in fragrant flowers?

sanskrit_iast:
hīnajātiprasūtopi śaucācārasamanvitaḥ ..
sarvadharmārthakuśalaḥ sakulīnaḥ satāṃ varaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
हीनजातिप्रसूतोपि शौचाचारसमन्वितः ..
सर्वधर्मार्थकुशलः सकुलीनः सतां वरः .. 22 ..
text_mt: Even one born in a low caste, if endowed with purity and good conduct, / skilled in the meaning of all dharma, is noble-born and the best among the virtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
na kulaṃ kulamityāhurācāraḥ kulamucyate ..
ācārakuśalo rājanniha cāmutra naṃdate .. 23 ..
meaning:
न कुलं कुलमित्याहुराचारः कुलमुच्यते ..
आचारकुशलो राजन्निह चामुत्र नंदते .. 23 ..
text_mt: They do not say that family is family; conduct is called family. / O king, one skilled in conduct rejoices here and in the hereafter.

sanskrit_iast:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
sadācāramahaṃ kṛṣṇa śrotumicchāmi śāśvatam ..
sarvaṃ dharmamayaḥ ko'tra sadācāraḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
सदाचारमहं कृष्ण श्रोतुमिच्छामि शाश्वतम् ..
सर्वं धर्ममयः कोऽत्र सदाचारः प्रकीर्तितः .. 24 ..
text_mt: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / O Kṛṣṇa, I wish to hear of eternal good conduct. / What is proclaimed here as good conduct, full of all dharma?

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ācāraprabhavo dharmaḥ saṃtaścācāralakṣaṇāḥ ..
sādhūnāṃ ca yathā vṛttaṃ sa sadācāra ucyate .. 29 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
आचारप्रभवो धर्मः संतश्चाचारलक्षणाः ..
साधूनां च यथा वृत्तं स सदाचार उच्यते .. 29 ..
text_mt: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / Dharma arises from conduct, and the virtuous are characterized by conduct; / and that which is the behavior of the good, that is called good conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātkuryādihācāraṃ ya icchedgatimātmanaḥ ..
api pāpaśarīrasya ācāro haṃtyalakṣaṇam .. 26 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्कुर्यादिहाचारं य इच्छेद्गतिमात्मनः ..
अपि पापशरीरस्य आचारो हंत्यलक्षणम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: Therefore, one who desires his own high destination should practice good conduct here. / Even of one with a sinful body, conduct destroys inauspicious marks.

sanskrit_iast:
adṛṣṭamaśrutaṃ vedaṃ puruṣaṃ dharmacāriṇam ..
svāni karmāṇi kurvāṇaṃ taṃ janaṃ kurute priyam .. 27 ..
meaning:
अदृष्टमश्रुतं वेदं पुरुषं धर्मचारिणम् ..
स्वानि कर्माणि कुर्वाणं तं जनं कुरुते प्रियम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: A man unseen and unheard of, who practices dharma according to the Veda, / performing his own duties—people hold him dear.

sanskrit_iast:
ye nāstikā naiṣṭhikāśca guruśāstrātilaṃghinaḥ ..
adharmajñā durācārāste bhavaṃti gatāyuṣaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
ये नास्तिका नैष्ठिकाश्च गुरुशास्त्रातिलंघिनः ..
अधर्मज्ञा दुराचारास्ते भवंति गतायुषः .. 28 ..
text_mt: Those who are nihilists, [hypocritical] perpetual students, and transgressors of the guru and scriptures, / ignorant of dharma and wicked in conduct—they become short-lived.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalakṣaṇahīnopi yaḥ sadācāravānnaraḥ ..
śraddadhānonasūyaśca sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 29 ..
meaning:
सर्वलक्षणहीनोपि यः सदाचारवान्नरः ..
श्रद्दधानोनसूयश्च सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् .. 29 ..
text_mt: Even a man devoid of all auspicious marks, if endowed with good conduct, / trusting and ungrudging, obtains all desired objects.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhme muhūrte budhyeta dharmārthāvanucintayet ..
brāhmaṇānalago sūryānna meheta kadācana .. 4.205.30 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मे मुहूर्ते बुध्येत धर्मार्थावनुचिन्तयेत् ..
ब्राह्मणानलगो सूर्यान्न मेहेत कदाचन .. 4.205.30 ..
text_mt: He should wake in the hour of Brahman and reflect on dharma and wealth; / he should never urinate facing a brāhmaṇa, fire, a cow, or the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
udaṅmukho divārātrāvutsargaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ..
utthāyācamya tiṣṭheta pūrvāṃ saṃdhyāṃ samāhitaḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
उदङ्मुखो दिवारात्रावुत्सर्गं दक्षिणामुखः ..
उत्थायाचम्य तिष्ठेत पूर्वां संध्यां समाहितः .. 31 ..
text_mt: Facing north by day and facing south by night for excretion; / having arisen and sipped water, he should stand composed for the morning twilight devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
evamevottarāṃ saṃdhyāṃ samupāsīta vāgyataḥ ..
nekṣetādityamudyantaṃ nāstaṃ yāṃtaṃ kadācana .. 32 ..
meaning:
एवमेवोत्तरां संध्यां समुपासीत वाग्यतः ..
नेक्षेतादित्यमुद्यन्तं नास्तं यांतं कदाचन .. 32 ..
text_mt: In the very same way, restraining his speech, he should worship the evening twilight devotion; / he should never look at the rising sun, nor at the setting sun.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayo dīrghatapasā dīrghamāyuravāpnuyuḥ ..
upāsate yena pūrvāṃ dvijāḥ saṃdhyāṃ na paścimām .. 33 ..
meaning:
ऋषयो दीर्घतपसा दीर्घमायुरवाप्नुयुः ..
उपासते येन पूर्वां द्विजाः संध्यां न पश्चिमाम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: Through long asceticism, the sages attain a long lifespan; / therefore, twice-born men attend the morning twilight devotion, not neglecting the evening one.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāṃstāndhārmiko rājā śūdrakarmaṇi yojayet ..
ābādhāsu yathākāmaṃ kuryānmūtrapurīṣayoḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
सर्वांस्तान्धार्मिको राजा शूद्रकर्मणि योजयेत् ..
आबाधासु यथाकामं कुर्यान्मूत्रपुरीषयोः .. 34 ..
text_mt: A righteous king should assign all of those [who neglect it] to the work of a śūdra. / In case of distress, one may pass urine and feces as one pleases,

sanskrit_iast:
śirasā prāvṛtenaiva samāstīrya tṛṇairmahīm ..
grāmāvasathatīrthānāṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ caiva vartmani .. 35 ..
meaning:
शिरसा प्रावृतेनैव समास्तीर्य तृणैर्महीम् ..
ग्रामावसथतीर्थानां क्षेत्राणां चैव वर्त्मनि .. 35 ..
text_mt: only with the head covered, having strewn the ground with grass. / On the path of villages, dwellings, sacred fords, and fields,

sanskrit_iast:
na mūtramadhitiṣṭheta na kṛṣṭe na ca govraje ..
antarjalādāvasathādvalmīkānmūṣakasthalāt .. 36 ..
meaning:
न मूत्रमधितिष्ठेत न कृष्टे न च गोव्रजे ..
अन्तर्जलादावसथाद्वल्मीकान्मूषकस्थलात् .. 36 ..
text_mt: he should not discharge urine, nor on plowed ground, nor in a cowpen. / From within water, from a dwelling, from an anthill, from a mouse-hole,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaśaucāvaśiṣṭāśca varjayetpañca vai mṛdaḥ ..
devārcanādikāryāṇi tathā gurvabhivādanam .. 37 ..
meaning:
कृतशौचावशिष्टाश्च वर्जयेत्पञ्च वै मृदः ..
देवार्चनादिकार्याणि तथा गुर्वभिवादनम् .. 37 ..
text_mt: and the remnants of earth used for purification—one must avoid these five kinds of earth. / Actions such as the worship of deities, and likewise saluting the guru,

sanskrit_iast:
kurvīta samyagācamya tadvadannabhuji kriyām ..
aphenaśabdagaṃdhābhiradbhiracchābhirādarāt .. .. 38 ..
meaning:
कुर्वीत सम्यगाचम्य तद्वदन्नभुजि क्रियाम् ..
अफेनशब्दगंधाभिरद्भिरच्छाभिरादरात् .. .. 38 ..
text_mt: he should perform having properly sipped water, and likewise the act of eating food, / with water that is free of foam, sound, and smell, and is clear, with due care.

sanskrit_iast:
ācāmetprayataḥ samyakprāṅmukhodaṅmukho'pi vā ..
trivargasādhane yacca sadā kāryaṃ vipaścitā .. 39 ..
meaning:
आचामेत्प्रयतः सम्यक्प्राङ्मुखोदङ्मुखोऽपि वा ..
त्रिवर्गसाधने यच्च सदा कार्यं विपश्चिता .. 39 ..
text_mt: Pure, he should sip water properly, facing east or facing north. / And what is always to be done by a wise man in accomplishing the three aims of life,

sanskrit_iast:
tatsāṃnidhye gṛhasthasya siddhiratra paratra ca ..
pādena kāryaṃ pāratryaṃ pādaṃ kuryācca saṃcaye .. 4.205.40 ..
meaning:
तत्सांनिध्ये गृहस्थस्य सिद्धिरत्र परत्र च ..
पादेन कार्यं पारत्र्यं पादं कुर्याच्च संचये .. 4.205.40 ..
text_mt: in its presence lies the householder's success here and hereafter. / With one quarter he should perform what belongs to the next world, and one quarter he should put into savings;

sanskrit_iast:
ardhenāhāracaraṇanityanaimittikāṃtakam ..
arthasyopārjane yatnaḥ sadā kāryo vipaścitaiḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
अर्धेनाहारचरणनित्यनैमित्तिकांतकम् ..
अर्थस्योपार्जने यत्नः सदा कार्यो विपश्चितैः .. 41 ..
text_mt: with half, [he should provide for] food, conduct, and obligatory and occasional rites. / Effort should always be made by the wise in acquiring wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
tatsaṃsiddhau hi siddhyanti dharmakāmādayo nṛpa ..
keśaprasādhanādarśadarśanaṃ daṃtadhāvanam .. 42 ..
meaning:
तत्संसिद्धौ हि सिद्ध्यन्ति धर्मकामादयो नृप ..
केशप्रसाधनादर्शदर्शनं दंतधावनम् .. 42 ..
text_mt: for upon its achievement, dharma, pleasure, and the rest are indeed achieved, O king. / Dressing the hair, looking into a mirror, cleaning the teeth,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvāhna eva kāryāṇi devatānāṃ ca pūjanam ..
dūrādāvasathānmūtraṃ dūrātpādāvasecanam .. 43 ..
meaning:
पूर्वाह्न एव कार्याणि देवतानां च पूजनम् ..
दूरादावसथान्मूत्रं दूरात्पादावसेचनम् .. 43 ..
text_mt: and the worship of the deities are to be performed in the forenoon. / Far from the dwelling should be urination, far away the washing of feet,

sanskrit_iast:
ucchiṣṭotsarjanaṃ dūrātsadā kāryaṃ hitaiṣiṇā ..
loṣṭamardī tṛṇacchedī nakhakhādī ca yo naraḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
उच्छिष्टोत्सर्जनं दूरात्सदा कार्यं हितैषिणा ..
लोष्टमर्दी तृणच्छेदी नखखादी च यो नरः .. 44 ..
text_mt: and far away the disposal of food remnants should always be done by one seeking his own welfare. / A man who breaks clods, cuts grass, and bites his nails,

sanskrit_iast:
nityocchiṣṭaḥ saṃkarakṛnnehāyurviṃdate mahat ..
nagnāṃ parastriyaṃ nekṣenna paśyedātmanaḥ śakṛt .. 45 ..
meaning:
नित्योच्छिष्टः संकरकृन्नेहायुर्विंदते महत् ..
नग्नां परस्त्रियं नेक्षेन्न पश्येदात्मनः शकृत् .. 45 ..
text_mt: who is perpetually defiled by food remnants and causes confusion of purity, does not attain a long life here. / He should not look at a naked woman belonging to another, nor should he look at his own feces.

sanskrit_iast:
udakyādarśanasparśaṃ kuryātsaṃbhāṣaṇaṃ na ca ..
nāpsu mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā maithunaṃ vā samācaret .. 46 ..
meaning:
उदक्यादर्शनस्पर्शं कुर्यात्संभाषणं न च ..
नाप्सु मूत्रं पुरीषं वा मैथुनं वा समाचरेत् .. 46 ..
text_mt: He should not look at, touch, or converse with a menstruating woman; / he should not discharge urine or feces in water, nor engage in sexual intercourse [there].

sanskrit_iast:
nādhitiṣṭhecchakṛnmūtre keśabhasmakapālikān ..
tuṣāṃgārāsthiśīrṇāni rañjuvastrādikāni ca .. 47 ..
meaning:
नाधितिष्ठेच्छकृन्मूत्रे केशभस्मकपालिकान् ..
तुषांगारास्थिशीर्णानि रञ्जुवस्त्रादिकानि च .. 47 ..
text_mt: He should not step upon feces, urine, hair, ashes, pot-sherds, / chaff, charcoal, broken bones, or cords, garments, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
dhāriṇo na namedvidvānnāsanaṃ cāpi dāpayet ..
brāhmaṇānpraṇamedvidvānāsanaṃ cāpi dāpayet .. 48 ..
meaning:
धारिणो न नमेद्विद्वान्नासनं चापि दापयेत् ..
ब्राह्मणान्प्रणमेद्विद्वानासनं चापि दापयेत् .. 48 ..
text_mt: A wise man should not bow to debtors, nor should he offer them a seat. / A wise man should bow to brāhmaṇas and also offer them a seat.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtāṃjalirupāsīta gacchaṃtaṃ pṛṣṭhatonviyāt ..
na cāsītāsane bhinne bhinnaṃ kāṃsyaṃ ca varjayet .. 49 ..
meaning:
कृतांजलिरुपासीत गच्छंतं पृष्ठतोन्वियात् ..
न चासीतासने भिन्ने भिन्नं कांस्यं च वर्जयेत् .. 49 ..
text_mt: With palms joined he should wait upon them, and when they depart, follow behind them; / he should not sit upon a broken seat, and he should avoid broken bell-metal.

sanskrit_iast:
nāmuktakeśairbhoktavyaṃ na nagnaḥ snānamācaret ..
svaptavyaṃ naiva nagnena na cocchiṣṭastu saṃviśet .. 4.205.50 ..
meaning:
नामुक्तकेशैर्भोक्तव्यं न नग्नः स्नानमाचरेत् ..
स्वप्तव्यं नैव नग्नेन न चोच्छिष्टस्तु संविशेत् .. 4.205.50 ..
text_mt: Food should not be eaten with unloosed hair; he should not bathe naked; / he should not sleep naked, nor should he lie down when defiled with food remnants.

sanskrit_iast:
ucchiṣṭo na spṛśecchīrṣaṃ sarve prāṇāstadāśrayāḥ ..
keśagrahānprahārāṃśca śirasyetāni varjayet .. 51 ..
meaning:
उच्छिष्टो न स्पृशेच्छीर्षं सर्वे प्राणास्तदाश्रयाः ..
केशग्रहान्प्रहारांश्च शिरस्येतानि वर्जयेत् .. 51 ..
text_mt: When defiled with food remnants, he should not touch his head; all the vital breaths reside there. / Pulling of the hair and blows to the head—these he must avoid.

sanskrit_iast:
nānyatra putra śiṣyābhyāṃ śiphayā tāḍanaṃ smṛtam ..
na pāṇibhyāṃ saṃhatābhyāṃ kaṃḍūyedātmanaḥ śiraḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
नान्यत्र पुत्र शिष्याभ्यां शिफया ताडनं स्मृतम् ..
न पाणिभ्यां संहताभ्यां कंडूयेदात्मनः शिरः .. 52 ..
text_mt: Except in the case of a son and a student, striking with a reed is not prescribed by tradition. / He should not scratch his head with both hands joined together.

sanskrit_iast:
na cābhīkṣṇaṃ śiraḥsnānaṃ kāryaṃ niṣkāraṇaṃ naraiḥ ..
apraśastaṃ niśi snānaṃ rāhoranyatra darśanāt .. 53 ..
meaning:
न चाभीक्ष्णं शिरःस्नानं कार्यं निष्कारणं नरैः ..
अप्रशस्तं निशि स्नानं राहोरन्यत्र दर्शनात् .. 53 ..
text_mt: Nor should washing of the head be done constantly by men without cause; / bathing at night is uncommended, except upon the sighting of Rāhu [during an eclipse].

sanskrit_iast:
na bhuktottarakālaṃ ca na gambhīrajalāśaye ..
śiraḥsnānaṃ tu tailena nāṃgaṃ kiṃcidupaspṛśet.. .. 54 ..
meaning:
न भुक्तोत्तरकालं च न गम्भीरजलाशये ..
शिरःस्नानं तु तैलेन नांगं किंचिदुपस्पृशेत्.. .. 54 ..
text_mt: Nor [should he bathe] immediately after eating, nor in a deep body of water. / In washing the head with oil, he should not touch any other limb.

sanskrit_iast:
tilapiṣṭaṃ ca nāśnīyāttathāsyāyurna hīyate ..
duṣkṛtaṃ na gurorbhūyātkruddhaṃ cainaṃ prasādayet ..55..
meaning:
तिलपिष्टं च नाश्नीयात्तथास्यायुर्न हीयते ..
दुष्कृतं न गुरोर्भूयात्क्रुद्धं चैनं प्रसादयेत् ..55..
text_mt: And he should not eat ground sesame; thus his life does not diminish. / No misdeed should be done toward the guru, and when he is angry, one should appease him.

sanskrit_iast:
parīvādaṃ na śṛṇuyādanyeṣāmapi jalpatām..
sadānupahatastiṣṭhetpraśastāśca tathauṣadhīḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
परीवादं न शृणुयादन्येषामपि जल्पताम्..
सदानुपहतस्तिष्ठेत्प्रशस्ताश्च तथौषधीः .. 56 ..
text_mt: He should not listen to censure even when others are chattering. / He should always remain unhurt, and likewise [wear] auspicious herbs

sanskrit_iast:
gāruḍāni ca ratnāni bibhṛyātprayato naraḥ ..
susnigdhāmalakeśaśca sugandhiścāruveṣadhṛk ..57..
meaning:
गारुडानि च रत्नानि बिभृयात्प्रयतो नरः ..
सुस्निग्धामलकेशश्च सुगन्धिश्चारुवेषधृक् ..57..
text_mt: and gems sacred to Garuḍa, a man should carry with care; / with hair well-oiled and clean, fragrant, and wearing handsome attire.

sanskrit_iast:
sitāḥ sumanaso hṛdyā bibhṛyācca naraḥ sadā..
kiṃcitparasvaṃ na harennālpamapyapriyaṃ vadet..58..
meaning:
सिताः सुमनसो हृद्या बिभृयाच्च नरः सदा..
किंचित्परस्वं न हरेन्नाल्पमप्यप्रियं वदेत्..58..
text_mt: A man should always wear white, charming, agreeable flowers; / he must not take anything of another's property, nor speak even a little unpleasantness.

sanskrit_iast:
priyaṃ ca nānṛtaṃ brūyānnānyadoṣānudīrayet ..
nānyāśritaṃ tathā vairaṃ rocayetpuruṣeśvaraḥ..59..
meaning:
प्रियं च नानृतं ब्रूयान्नान्यदोषानुदीरयेत् ..
नान्याश्रितं तथा वैरं रोचयेत्पुरुषेश्वरः..59..
text_mt: He should not speak pleasant falsehood, nor mention the faults of others; / likewise, the lord of men should not take pleasure in hostility directed toward another.

sanskrit_iast:
na duṣṭayānamārohetkūlacchāyā na saṃśrayet ..
vidviṣṭapatitonmattabahuvairādisaṃkaraiḥ ..4.205.60..
meaning:
न दुष्टयानमारोहेत्कूलच्छाया न संश्रयेत् ..
विद्विष्टपतितोन्मत्तबहुवैरादिसंकरैः ..4.205.60..
text_mt: He must not mount a dangerous vehicle; he should not seek shade under a riverbank. / With those who are hated, fallen, mad, having many enemies, and cross-bred,

sanskrit_iast:
baṃdhakībaṃdhakībhartṛkṣudrānṛta kathaiḥ saha ..
tathātivyayaśīlaiśca parivādarataiḥ śaṭhaiḥ ..61..
meaning:
बंधकीबंधकीभर्तृक्षुद्रानृत कथैः सह ..
तथातिव्ययशीलैश्च परिवादरतैः शठैः ..61..
text_mt: with unchaste women, husbands of unchaste women, petty liars in conversation, / likewise with squanderers, those devoted to slander, and rogues,

sanskrit_iast:
budho maitrīṃ na kurvīta naikaḥ paṃthānamāśrayet ..
nāvagāhejjalaughasya vegamagre nareśvarā.62..
meaning:
बुधो मैत्रीं न कुर्वीत नैकः पंथानमाश्रयेत् ..
नावगाहेज्जलौघस्य वेगमग्रे नरेश्वरा.62..
text_mt: a wise man should not form a friendship; he should not take a road alone; / he should not plunge into the force of a flood of water ahead, O kings.

sanskrit_iast:
pradīptaṃ veśma na viśennārohecchikharaṃ taroḥ ..
na huṃkuryācchavaṃ caiva śavagandho hi somajaḥ .. 63 ..
meaning:
प्रदीप्तं वेश्म न विशेन्नारोहेच्छिखरं तरोः ..
न हुंकुर्याच्छवं चैव शवगन्धो हि सोमजः .. 63 ..
text_mt: He must not enter a burning house; he must not climb the top of a tree; / he must not snort with disgust at a corpse, for the smell of a corpse is born of Soma.

sanskrit_iast:
na kuryāddantasaṃvarṣaṃ na kuryāccalanāsikām ..
nāsaṃspṛṣṭamukho brūyācchvāsakāsau ca varjayet .. 64 ..
meaning:
न कुर्याद्दन्तसंवर्षं न कुर्याच्चलनासिकाम् ..
नासंस्पृष्टमुखो ब्रूयाच्छ्वासकासौ च वर्जयेत् .. 64 ..
text_mt: He should not grind his teeth; he should not wiggle his nose; / he should not speak without touching his mouth, and he should avoid panting and coughing [while speaking].

sanskrit_iast:
noccairhasetsaśabdaṃ ca na muñcetpavanaṃ budhaḥ ..
nakhānna vādayecchiṃdyānna nakhaiśca mahīṃ likhet .. .. 65 ..
meaning:
नोच्चैर्हसेत्सशब्दं च न मुञ्चेत्पवनं बुधः ..
नखान्न वादयेच्छिंद्यान्न नखैश्च महीं लिखेत् .. .. 65 ..
text_mt: A wise man should not laugh loudly with a roar, nor release flatulence audibly; / he should not snap his nails or bite them, nor scratch the earth with his nails.

sanskrit_iast:
na śmaśru bhakṣayeccaiva na loṣṭhāni ca mardayet ..
pādena nākrametpādaṃ na pūjyābhimukhaṃ nayeta ..66..
meaning:
न श्मश्रु भक्षयेच्चैव न लोष्ठानि च मर्दयेत् ..
पादेन नाक्रमेत्पादं न पूज्याभिमुखं नयेत ..66..
text_mt: He should not chew his beard, nor crush clods of earth; / he should not cross foot over foot, nor stretch out his feet toward a venerable person.

sanskrit_iast:
noccāsane samāsīta guroragre kadācana ..
tasmātsadācāraparo bhavetkāmacaro na hi .. 67 ..
meaning:
नोच्चासने समासीत गुरोरग्रे कदाचन ..
तस्मात्सदाचारपरो भवेत्कामचरो न हि .. 67 ..
text_mt: He should never sit on a high seat in front of his guru; / therefore he should be devoted to right conduct and never act at his own whim.

sanskrit_iast:
lokadvaye śubhaṃ prepsuḥ pretya svarge mahīyate ..
catuṣpathaṃ caityataruṃ śmaśānopavanāni ca .. 68 ..
meaning:
लोकद्वये शुभं प्रेप्सुः प्रेत्य स्वर्गे महीयते ..
चतुष्पथं चैत्यतरुं श्मशानोपवनानि च .. 68 ..
text_mt: Desiring good fortune in both worlds, he is honoured in heaven after dying. / A crossroads, a caitya tree, cremation grounds, and pleasure gardens,

sanskrit_iast:
duṣṭastrīsaṃnikarṣaṃ ca varjayenniśi sarvadā ..
grīṣmavarṣāsu cacchatrī maunī rātrau vaneṣu ca .. 69 ..
meaning:
दुष्टस्त्रीसंनिकर्षं च वर्जयेन्निशि सर्वदा ..
ग्रीष्मवर्षासु चच्छत्री मौनी रात्रौ वनेषु च .. 69 ..
text_mt: and contact with wicked women—he should always avoid these at night. / In summer and the rains [he should walk] holding a parasol, and in silence at night and in forests.

sanskrit_iast:
keśāsthikaṇṭakāmedhyabalibhasmatuṣāṃstathā ..
snānārdrāṃ dharaṇīṃ caiva dūrataḥ parivarjayet..4.205.70..
meaning:
केशास्थिकण्टकामेध्यबलिभस्मतुषांस्तथा ..
स्नानार्द्रां धरणीं चैव दूरतः परिवर्जयेत्..4.205.70..
text_mt: Hair, bones, thorns, impure things, offerings, ashes, and chaff, / as well as ground wet from bathing, he should avoid from a distance.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃthā deyo brāhmaṇebhyo rājabhyaḥ strībhya eva ca ..
vidyādhikasya gurviṇyā bhārārtasya mahīyasaḥ..71..
meaning:
पंथा देयो ब्राह्मणेभ्यो राजभ्यः स्त्रीभ्य एव च ..
विद्याधिकस्य गुर्विण्या भारार्तस्य महीयसः..71..
text_mt: The path must be yielded to Brāhmaṇas, kings, and women, / to one superior in learning, to a pregnant woman, to one oppressed by a burden, to an elder,

sanskrit_iast:
mūkāṃdhabadhirāṇāṃ ca mattasyonmattakasya ca ..
upānadvastramālyaṃ ca dhṛtamanyairna dhārayet .. 72 ..
meaning:
मूकांधबधिराणां च मत्तस्योन्मत्तकस्य च ..
उपानद्वस्त्रमाल्यं च धृतमन्यैर्न धारयेत् .. 72 ..
text_mt: and to the mute, the blind, the deaf, the intoxicated, and the mad. / One should not wear shoes, clothes, or a garland worn by others.

sanskrit_iast:
na hīdṛśamanāyuṣyaṃ loke kiñcana vidyate ..
yādṛśaṃ puruṣasyeha paradāropasevanam ..73..
meaning:
न हीदृशमनायुष्यं लोके किञ्चन विद्यते ..
यादृशं पुरुषस्येह परदारोपसेवनम् ..73..
text_mt: For there is nothing in this world that destroys longevity / so much as a man's pursuit of another's wife.

sanskrit_iast:
na cerṣyā strīṣu kartavyā dārā rakṣyāḥ prayatnataḥ ..
anāyuṣyā bhavedīrṣyā tasmāttāṃ parivarjayet .. 74 ..
meaning:
न चेर्ष्या स्त्रीषु कर्तव्या दारा रक्ष्याः प्रयत्नतः ..
अनायुष्या भवेदीर्ष्या तस्मात्तां परिवर्जयेत् .. 74 ..
text_mt: Jealousy should not be directed toward women; one's wives must be guarded with effort. / Jealousy is destructive of longevity; therefore one should abandon it.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrkhonmattavyasanino virūpānmāninastathā ..
hīnāṃgānadhikāṃgāṃśca vidyāhīnāṃśca nākṣipet .. 75 ..
meaning:
मूर्खोन्मत्तव्यसनिनो विरूपान्मानिनस्तथा ..
हीनांगानधिकांगांश्च विद्याहीनांश्च नाक्षिपेत् .. 75 ..
text_mt: The foolish, the mad, the addicted, the deformed, the proud, / those deficient in limbs, those with extra limbs, and the uneducated—he should not revile them.

sanskrit_iast:
pānīyasya kriyā naktaṃ tathaiva dadhisaktavaḥ ..
varjanīyā mahārāja niśīthe bhojanakriyāḥ .. 76 ..
meaning:
पानीयस्य क्रिया नक्तं तथैव दधिसक्तवः ..
वर्जनीया महाराज निशीथे भोजनक्रियाः .. 76 ..
text_mt: Drinking water at night, and likewise curd-meal, / and eating meals at midnight are to be avoided, O great king.

sanskrit_iast:
nordhvajānuściraṃ tiṣṭhenna rahasyaparo bhavet ..
tadvannopaviśetprājñaḥ pādenākramya vāsanam ..77..
meaning:
नोर्ध्वजानुश्चिरं तिष्ठेन्न रहस्यपरो भवेत् ..
तद्वन्नोपविशेत्प्राज्ञः पादेनाक्रम्य वासनम् ..77..
text_mt: He should not remain long with raised knees; he should not be excessively secretive; / likewise, a wise man should not sit stepping upon the seat with his foot.

sanskrit_iast:
na cātiraktavāsāḥ syāccitrāsitadharo'pi vā ..
na ca kuryādviparyāsaṃ vāsaso na vibhūṣaṇe .. 78 ..
meaning:
न चातिरक्तवासाः स्याच्चित्रासितधरोऽपि वा ..
न च कुर्याद्विपर्यासं वाससो न विभूषणे .. 78 ..
text_mt: He should not wear garments that are excessively red, variegated, or black; / nor should he invert his garment, nor do so with ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
strīṃ kṛśāṃ nāvajānīyāddīrghamāyurjijīviṣuḥ ..
brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyaṃ sarvaṃ sarve hyāśīviṣopamāḥ ..79..
meaning:
स्त्रीं कृशां नावजानीयाद्दीर्घमायुर्जिजीविषुः ..
ब्राह्मणं क्षत्रियं सर्वं सर्वे ह्याशीविषोपमाः ..79..
text_mt: One who desires to live a long life should not despise a weak woman, / a Brāhmaṇa, or any Kṣatriya, for all are like venomous serpents.

sanskrit_iast:
hanyādāśīviṣaḥ kruddho yāvatspṛśati daṃṣṭrayā ..
kṣatriyo'pi dahetkruddho yāvatpaśyati tejasā..4.205.80..
meaning:
हन्यादाशीविषः क्रुद्धो यावत्स्पृशति दंष्ट्रया ..
क्षत्रियोऽपि दहेत्क्रुद्धो यावत्पश्यति तेजसा..4.205.80..
text_mt: An enraged venomous serpent strikes only so far as it touches with its fang; / an enraged Kṣatriya burns only so far as he sees with his splendour;

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaḥ sakulaṃ hanyāddhyāne nāvekṣitena ca ..
nātikalyaṃ nātisāyaṃ na ca madhyaṃ dine tathā..81..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणः सकुलं हन्याद्ध्याने नावेक्षितेन च ..
नातिकल्यं नातिसायं न च मध्यं दिने तथा..81..
text_mt: a Brāhmaṇa destroys one along with one's family through contemplation and a glance. / Neither too early in the morning, nor too late in the evening, nor at midday

sanskrit_iast:
nājñātaiḥ saha gaṃtavyaṃ naikena bahubhiḥ saha ..
nāruṃtudaḥ syānna parokṣavādī na sahī nataḥ .. 82 ..
meaning:
नाज्ञातैः सह गंतव्यं नैकेन बहुभिः सह ..
नारुंतुदः स्यान्न परोक्षवादी न सही नतः .. 82 ..
text_mt: should one travel with strangers, nor alone, nor with many people. / He should not utter biting words, nor slander behind backs, nor [...]

sanskrit_iast:
rohate cāgninā dagdhaṃ vanaṃ paraśunā hatam ..
vaco duruktabībhatsaṃ na saṃrohati cāśatam .. 83 ..
meaning:
रोहते चाग्निना दग्धं वनं परशुना हतम् ..
वचो दुरुक्तबीभत्सं न संरोहति चाशतम् .. 83 ..
text_mt: A forest burnt by fire or struck down by an axe grows back; / but a repulsive, ill-spoken word never heals, even after a hundred [years].

sanskrit_iast:
nāstikyaṃ vedaniṃdā ca devatānāṃ ca kutsanam ..
dveṣastaṃbhādimānasya klaibyaṃ ca parivarjayet .. 84 ..
meaning:
नास्तिक्यं वेदनिंदा च देवतानां च कुत्सनम् ..
द्वेषस्तंभादिमानस्य क्लैब्यं च परिवर्जयेत् .. 84 ..
text_mt: Atheism, reviling the Vedas, abuse of the deities, / malice, haughtiness born of conceit, and unmanliness he should avoid.

sanskrit_iast:
na brāhmaṇaṃ parivadenna nakṣatrāṇi darśayet ..
tithiṃ pakṣasya na brūyādyayāsyāyurna riṣyate .. 85 ..
meaning:
न ब्राह्मणं परिवदेन्न नक्षत्राणि दर्शयेत् ..
तिथिं पक्षस्य न ब्रूयाद्ययास्यायुर्न रिष्यते .. 85 ..
text_mt: He should not slander a Brāhmaṇa; he should not point out the stars; / he should not announce the tithi of the fortnight, so that his lifespan is not harmed.

sanskrit_iast:
tejo niṣṭhīvya vāsaśca paridhāyācamedbudhaḥ ..
jitāmitro nṛpo yaśca balavānkarmatatparaḥ ..86 ..
meaning:
तेजो निष्ठीव्य वासश्च परिधायाचमेद्बुधः ..
जितामित्रो नृपो यश्च बलवान्कर्मतत्परः ..86 ..
text_mt: Having spat out semen, and having put on a garment, a wise man should sip water. / Where the king has conquered his enemies, is powerful, and is devoted to duty,

sanskrit_iast:
tatra nityaṃ vasetprājñaḥ kṛtakṛtyaḥ patau sukham ..
paurāḥ susaṃhatā yatra satatanyāyavartinaḥ .. 87 ..
meaning:
तत्र नित्यं वसेत्प्राज्ञः कृतकृत्यः पतौ सुखम् ..
पौराः सुसंहता यत्र सततन्यायवर्तिनः .. 87 ..
text_mt: there a wise man, fulfilled in purpose, should dwell happily under that lord. / Where the citizens are well united and constantly conduct themselves with justice,

sanskrit_iast:
yatra striyo'matsariṇyastatra vāsaḥ sukhodayaḥ ..
yasminkṛṣīvalā rāṣṭre prāyaśo nātibhāṣiṇaḥ .. 88 ..
meaning:
यत्र स्त्रियोऽमत्सरिण्यस्तत्र वासः सुखोदयः ..
यस्मिन्कृषीवला राष्ट्रे प्रायशो नातिभाषिणः .. 88 ..
text_mt: where women are without jealousy, dwelling there brings about happiness. / In whatever realm the farmers generally do not talk excessively,

sanskrit_iast:
yatrauṣadhānyaśeṣāṇi vasettatra vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
tatra rājanna vastavyaṃ yatraitattritayaṃ sadā .. 89 ..
meaning:
यत्रौषधान्यशेषाणि वसेत्तत्र विचक्षणः ..
तत्र राजन्न वस्तव्यं यत्रैतत्त्रितयं सदा .. 89 ..
text_mt: and where all medicinal herbs are present, there a discerning person should dwell. / O king, one must never reside where this triad exists:

sanskrit_iast:
jigīṣuḥ pūrvavairaṃ ca janaśca viratotsavaḥ ..
tatra rājanna vastavyaṃ yatra nāsti catuṣṭayam .. 4.205.90 ..
meaning:
जिगीषुः पूर्ववैरं च जनश्च विरतोत्सवः ..
तत्र राजन्न वस्तव्यं यत्र नास्ति चतुष्टयम् .. 4.205.90 ..
text_mt: an ambitious rival, ancestral enmity, and people devoid of festivals. / O king, one must not reside where four things are absent:

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṇapradātā vaidyaśca śrotriyaḥ sajalā nadī ..
avalokyo na cādarśo malino buddhimattaraiḥ .. 91 ..
meaning:
ऋणप्रदाता वैद्यश्च श्रोत्रियः सजला नदी ..
अवलोक्यो न चादर्शो मलिनो बुद्धिमत्तरैः .. 91 ..
text_mt: a moneylender, a physician, a Vedic scholar, and a river filled with water. / A dirty mirror must not be looked into by the exceedingly intelligent,

sanskrit_iast:
na ca rātrau mahārāja dīrgharājyamabhīpsatā ..
hemakāragṛhe cānnamaśnīyānna ca viśvaset.. 92 ..
meaning:
न च रात्रौ महाराज दीर्घराज्यमभीप्सता ..
हेमकारगृहे चान्नमश्नीयान्न च विश्वसेत्.. 92 ..
text_mt: nor [should a mirror be looked into] at night, O great king, by one desiring a long reign. / One should not eat food in a goldsmith's house, nor trust him,

sanskrit_iast:
na ca mitraṃ prakurvīta hemakāraṃ kadācana ..
bhinnabhāṃḍaṃ ca khaṭvāṃ ca kukkuraṃ kukkuṭaṃ tathā ..93..
meaning:
न च मित्रं प्रकुर्वीत हेमकारं कदाचन ..
भिन्नभांडं च खट्वां च कुक्कुरं कुक्कुटं तथा ..93..
text_mt: and one should never make a goldsmith a friend. / A broken pot, a [broken] cot, a dog, and a rooster—

sanskrit_iast:
apraśastāni catvāri ye ca vṛkṣāḥ sakaṃṭakāḥ ..
bhinna bhāṃḍe baliḥ prāyaḥ khadvāyāṃ ceha niścayaḥ .. 94 ..
meaning:
अप्रशस्तानि चत्वारि ये च वृक्षाः सकंटकाः ..
भिन्न भांडे बलिः प्रायः खद्वायां चेह निश्चयः .. 94 ..
text_mt: these four are inauspicious, as are trees that are thorny. / An offering [given] in a broken pot is generally considered wasted, and in a cot it is likewise certain;

sanskrit_iast:
nāśnaṃti pitarastasya yatra kukkurakukkaṭau ..
vṛkṣamūle piśācānāṃ sarveṣāmeva saṃsthitiḥ .. 95 ..
meaning:
नाश्नंति पितरस्तस्य यत्र कुक्कुरकुक्कटौ ..
वृक्षमूले पिशाचानां सर्वेषामेव संस्थितिः .. 95 ..
text_mt: his ancestors do not eat where there are dogs and roosters. / At the root of a tree is the abode of all piśācas;

sanskrit_iast:
atasteṣāṃ tale bhujannaśnute pūyaśoṇitam ..
asaṃskṛtānnabhuṅmūtraṃ bālādiprabhavaṃ svayam .. 96 ..
meaning:
अतस्तेषां तले भुजन्नश्नुते पूयशोणितम् ..
असंस्कृतान्नभुङ्मूत्रं बालादिप्रभवं स्वयम् .. 96 ..
text_mt: therefore, eating beneath them, one partakes of pus and blood. / One who eats unconsecrated food eats urine produced by children and others.

sanskrit_iast:
suvāsinīṃ gurviṇīṃ ca vṛddhāṃ bālāturāṃstathā ..
bhojayetsaṃskṛtānnena prathamaṃ caramaṃ gṛhī .. 97 ..
meaning:
सुवासिनीं गुर्विणीं च वृद्धां बालातुरांस्तथा ..
भोजयेत्संस्कृतान्नेन प्रथमं चरमं गृही .. 97 ..
text_mt: A woman whose husband is alive, a pregnant woman, an elderly woman, children, and the sick / the householder should feed with consecrated food first, and himself last.

sanskrit_iast:
aghaṃ sa kevalaṃ bhuṃkte baddhagovāhanādikam ..
yo bhuṃkte ca bahirjyeṣṭhaprekṣatāmapradāya ca .. 98 ..
meaning:
अघं स केवलं भुंक्ते बद्धगोवाहनादिकम् ..
यो भुंक्ते च बहिर्ज्येष्ठप्रेक्षतामप्रदाय च .. 98 ..
text_mt: He eats mere sin, like one binding oxen and draught animals, / who eats without having given to elders watching outside.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśvadevaṃ tataḥ kuryādyāvadāhutayaḥ kramāt ..
prathamāṃ brahmaṇe dadyātprajānāṃ pataye tataḥ .. 99 ..
meaning:
वैश्वदेवं ततः कुर्याद्यावदाहुतयः क्रमात् ..
प्रथमां ब्रह्मणे दद्यात्प्रजानां पतये ततः .. 99 ..
text_mt: Then he should perform the Vaiśvadeva rite, offering oblations in succession: / he should offer the first to Brahmā, then to the Lord of Creatures,

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyāṃ caiva guhyebhyaḥ kaśyapāya tathā parām ..
tataścānumate dadyāddattvā gṛhabaliṃ tataḥ .. 4.205.100 ..
meaning:
तृतीयां चैव गुह्येभ्यः कश्यपाय तथा पराम् ..
ततश्चानुमते दद्याद्दत्त्वा गृहबलिं ततः .. 4.205.100 ..
text_mt: and the third to the Guhyas, and the next to Kaśyapa; / then he should offer to Anumati, and having then offered the domestic bali,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvākhyātaṃ mayā yatte nityakarmakriyāvidhau ..
dadyādatha dharitrīṇāṃ dadyāttu maṇikatrayam .. 101 ..
meaning:
पूर्वाख्यातं मया यत्ते नित्यकर्मक्रियाविधौ ..
दद्यादथ धरित्रीणां दद्यात्तु मणिकत्रयम् .. 101 ..
text_mt: as was declared by me to you before in the rule for daily rites, / he should then make offerings to the Earths, and present three water jars.

sanskrit_iast:
prācyādikramayogena iṃdrādīnāṃ baliṃ kṣipet ..
brahmaṇe cāntarikṣāya sūryāya ca yathākramam ..102..
meaning:
प्राच्यादिक्रमयोगेन इंद्रादीनां बलिं क्षिपेत् ..
ब्रह्मणे चान्तरिक्षाय सूर्याय च यथाक्रमम् ..102..
text_mt: In order starting from the east, he should cast the offering for Indra and the others, / and in proper sequence for Brahmā, the atmosphere, and the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvebhyaścaiva devebhyo viśvabhūtebhya eva ca ..
kṛtvāpasavyaṃ vāyavyaṃ yakṣmaitatte nivedayet ..103..
meaning:
विश्वेभ्यश्चैव देवेभ्यो विश्वभूतेभ्य एव च ..
कृत्वापसव्यं वायव्यं यक्ष्मैतत्ते निवेदयेत् ..103..
text_mt: And for the Viśvedevas, and indeed for all beings; / having placed [the sacred thread] over the right shoulder toward the northwest, he should offer: 'O consumption, this is yours!'

sanskrit_iast:
tataścāgraṃ samuddhṛtya haṃtakāropakalpitam ..
yathāvidhi yathānyāyaṃ brāhmaṇāyopapādayet ..104..
meaning:
ततश्चाग्रं समुद्धृत्य हंतकारोपकल्पितम् ..
यथाविधि यथान्यायं ब्राह्मणायोपपादयेत् ..104..
text_mt: Then, having set aside the first portion prepared as a haṃtakāra offering, / he should present it to a brāhmaṇa according to rule and right order.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā vidhibhyo devebhyo gurubhyaḥ suśrutāya ca ..
puṇyagaṃdhāṃbaradharo mālyadhārī nareśvara .. 105 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वा विधिभ्यो देवेभ्यो गुरुभ्यः सुश्रुताय च ..
पुण्यगंधांबरधरो माल्यधारी नरेश्वर .. 105 ..
text_mt: Having given [offerings] according to rule to the gods, the elders, and an educated [guest], / wearing pure scents and garments, and bearing garlands, O ruler of men,

sanskrit_iast:
naikavastradharo'śnīyānnārdrapādo mahīpate ..
viśuddhavadanaḥ prīto bhuṃjīta na vidiḍmukhaḥ .. 106 ..
meaning:
नैकवस्त्रधरोऽश्नीयान्नार्द्रपादो महीपते ..
विशुद्धवदनः प्रीतो भुंजीत न विदिड्मुखः .. 106 ..
text_mt: he should not eat wearing a single garment, nor with wet feet, O king; / with a purified face, cheerful, he should eat, not facing an intermediate direction.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṅmukhodaṅmukho vāpi na caivānyamanā naraḥ ..
kutsitena hataṃ caiva jugupsāvadasaṃskṛtam ..107..
meaning:
प्राङ्मुखोदङ्मुखो वापि न चैवान्यमना नरः ..
कुत्सितेन हतं चैव जुगुप्सावदसंस्कृतम् ..107..
text_mt: A man should face east or face north, and not have his mind elsewhere; / [he should not eat food] struck by a despicable person, or prepared with disgust,

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā tu bhuṃkte śiṣṭebhyaḥ kṣudhitebhyastathā gṛhī ..
praśastaśuddhapātreṣu bhuñjītākupito nṛpa .. 108 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वा तु भुंक्ते शिष्टेभ्यः क्षुधितेभ्यस्तथा गृही ..
प्रशस्तशुद्धपात्रेषु भुञ्जीताकुपितो नृप .. 108 ..
text_mt: but the householder eats after having given to the worthy and to the hungry; / he should eat from praised, clean vessels, unangered, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsaṃdīsaṃsthite pātre nādeśe ca nareśvara ..
nā kāle nātisaṃkīrṇe dattvāgraṃ ca naro mahī .. 109 ..
meaning:
नासंदीसंस्थिते पात्रे नादेशे च नरेश्वर ..
ना काले नातिसंकीर्णे दत्त्वाग्रं च नरो मही .. 109 ..
text_mt: Nor [should he eat from] a vessel placed on a stool, nor in an improper place, O ruler of men, / nor at an unseasonable time, nor in an excessively crowded space, having given the first portion, a man [on] earth.

sanskrit_iast:
aśnīyāttanmayo bhūtvā pūrvaṃ tu madhuraṃ rasam ..
lavaṇograu tataḥ paścātkaṭutīkṣṇādikaṃ tataḥ .. .. 4.205.110 ..
meaning:
अश्नीयात्तन्मयो भूत्वा पूर्वं तु मधुरं रसम् ..
लवणोग्रौ ततः पश्चात्कटुतीक्ष्णादिकं ततः .. .. 4.205.110 ..
text_mt: He should eat, absorbed in it: first the sweet flavour, / then the salty and pungent, and afterwards the bitter, sharp, and others.

sanskrit_iast:
mārdavaṃ puruṣośnanvai madhye ca kaṭhināśanam ..
aṃte punardravāśī ca naro rogeṇa mucyate ..111..
meaning:
मार्दवं पुरुषोश्नन्वै मध्ये च कठिनाशनम् ..
अंते पुनर्द्रवाशी च नरो रोगेण मुच्यते ..111..
text_mt: A man eating soft food [at first], hard food in the middle, / and eating liquid at the end, is freed from disease.

sanskrit_iast:
divādhānāsu vasati rātrau ca dadhisaktuṣu ..
alakṣmīḥ kovidāreṣu sarvadaiva kṛtālayā .. 112 ..
meaning:
दिवाधानासु वसति रात्रौ च दधिसक्तुषु ..
अलक्ष्मीः कोविदारेषु सर्वदैव कृतालया .. 112 ..
text_mt: Alakṣmī dwells in fried grains by day and in curds with roasted barley meal at night; / in kovidāra trees she has made her abode at all times.

sanskrit_iast:
aniṃdyaṃ bhakṣayennityaṃ vāgyato'nnamakutsayan ..
bhuktvā samyagyathācamya prāṅmukhodaṅ mukho'pi vā .. 113 ..
meaning:
अनिंद्यं भक्षयेन्नित्यं वाग्यतोऽन्नमकुत्सयन् ..
भुक्त्वा सम्यग्यथाचम्य प्राङ्मुखोदङ् मुखोऽपि वा .. 113 ..
text_mt: He should always eat blameless food with restrained speech, not finding fault with the food; / having eaten and properly sipped water, facing east or facing north,

sanskrit_iast:
yathāvatpunarācāmetpāṇī prakṣālya yatnataḥ ..
abhīṣṭadevatānāṃ ca kurvīta smaraṇaṃ naraḥ .. 114 ..
meaning:
यथावत्पुनराचामेत्पाणी प्रक्षाल्य यत्नतः ..
अभीष्टदेवतानां च कुर्वीत स्मरणं नरः .. 114 ..
text_mt: he should carefully wash both hands and sip water again according to rule; / and a man should practice remembrance of his beloved deities:

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāpānasamānānāmudānavyānayostathā ..
annapuṣṭikaraṃ cāstu mamādyāvyāhataṃ sukham .. 115 ..
meaning:
प्राणापानसमानानामुदानव्यानयोस्तथा ..
अन्नपुष्टिकरं चास्तु ममाद्याव्याहतं सुखम् .. 115 ..
text_mt: 'May the food bring nourishment to prāṇa, apāna, samāna, / udāna, and vyāna, and unhindered happiness to me today!

sanskrit_iast:
agastiragnirvaḍavānalaśca bhuktaṃ prapātraṃ jarayatvaśeṣam ..
sukhaṃ ca me tatpariṇāmasaṃbhava yacchatvarogaṃ khalu vāsudevaḥ .. 116 ..
meaning:
अगस्तिरग्निर्वडवानलश्च भुक्तं प्रपात्रं जरयत्वशेषम् ..
सुखं च मे तत्परिणामसंभव यच्छत्वरोगं खलु वासुदेवः .. 116 ..
text_mt: May Agastya, Agni, and the submarine fire completely digest the meal that has been eaten; / and may Vāsudeva truly bestow on me health and the happiness born of its digestion!'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuccārya svahastena pīramārjya tathodaram ..
anāyāsapradāyīti kuryātkarmāṇyataṃdritaḥ..117..
meaning:
इत्युच्चार्य स्वहस्तेन पीरमार्ज्य तथोदरम् ..
अनायासप्रदायीति कुर्यात्कर्माण्यतंद्रितः..117..
text_mt: Having spoken thus and stroked his belly with his own hand, / [saying] 'giver of ease', he should perform his duties unwearied.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyāyāṃ pathikaḥ kaścitsamāgacchati bhārata ..
pādaśaucāsanaiḥ prahvaḥ svāgatoktyā ca pūjayet .. 118 ..
meaning:
संध्यायां पथिकः कश्चित्समागच्छति भारत ..
पादशौचासनैः प्रह्वः स्वागतोक्त्या च पूजयेत् .. 118 ..
text_mt: If a traveller arrives at twilight, O descendant of Bharata, / he should honour him humbly with washing of the feet, a seat, and words of welcome.

sanskrit_iast:
tataścānnapradānena śayanena ca pārthiva ..
divā tithau ca vimukho yadaikaṃ pātakaṃ bhavet ..119..
meaning:
ततश्चान्नप्रदानेन शयनेन च पार्थिव ..
दिवा तिथौ च विमुखो यदैकं पातकं भवेत् ..119..
text_mt: And then with the gift of food and a bed, O king; / if a guest turns away [unfed] by day, there would be a single sin,

sanskrit_iast:
tadevāṣṭaguṇaṃ puṃsāṃ sūrye haṃsamukhe gate ..
gacchecchayyāmasphuṭitāmapi dārumayīṃ nṛpa .. 4.205.120 ..
meaning:
तदेवाष्टगुणं पुंसां सूर्ये हंसमुखे गते ..
गच्छेच्छय्यामस्फुटितामपि दारुमयीं नृप .. 4.205.120 ..
text_mt: and that same [sin] becomes eightfold for men when the sun has gone to set. / He should go to a bed made of wood that is not split, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
nāviśālāṃ na vā bhagnāṃ nāsamāṃ malināṃ na ca ..
na ca jaṃtumayīṃ śayyāṃ samātiṣṭhedanāpadi .. 121 ..
meaning:
नाविशालां न वा भग्नां नासमां मलिनां न च ..
न च जंतुमयीं शय्यां समातिष्ठेदनापदि .. 121 ..
text_mt: nor narrow, nor broken, nor uneven, nor dirty; / nor should he resort to a bed infested with vermin, unless in an emergency.

sanskrit_iast:
prācyāṃ diśi śiraḥ śastaṃ yāmyāyāmapi bhūpate ..
sadaiva svapatāṃ puṃsāṃ viparītaṃ tu rogadam .. 122 ..
meaning:
प्राच्यां दिशि शिरः शस्तं याम्यायामपि भूपते ..
सदैव स्वपतां पुंसां विपरीतं तु रोगदम् .. 122 ..
text_mt: Sleeping with the head toward the east or toward the south is praised, O king, / for men at all times; but the reverse brings disease.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtāvupagamaḥ śastaḥ sapatnyāṃ hyavanīpate ..
puṇyarkṣe ca śubhe kāle putrā yugmāsu rātriṣu .. 123 ..
meaning:
ऋतावुपगमः शस्तः सपत्न्यां ह्यवनीपते ..
पुण्यर्क्षे च शुभे काले पुत्रा युग्मासु रात्रिषु .. 123 ..
text_mt: Approaching one's wife during her season is praised, O king, / under an auspicious constellation and at an auspicious time, [producing] sons on even nights.

sanskrit_iast:
na cāsnātāṃ striyaṃ gacchedgarbhiṇīṃ na rajasvalām ..
nāniṣṭāṃ vai na kupitāṃ nāśastāṃ na ca rogiṇīm .. 124 ..
meaning:
न चास्नातां स्त्रियं गच्छेद्गर्भिणीं न रजस्वलाम् ..
नानिष्टां वै न कुपितां नाशस्तां न च रोगिणीम् .. 124 ..
text_mt: He should not approach a woman who has not bathed, nor one who is pregnant, nor one who is menstruating, / nor one who is unloved, nor angry, nor inauspicious, nor ill,

sanskrit_iast:
nādakṣiṇāṃ nānyakāmāṃ nākāmāṃ nānyayoṣitam ..
sukṣāmāmatyabhuktāṃ ca svayaṃ caibhirguṇairyutaḥ ..125..
meaning:
नादक्षिणां नान्यकामां नाकामां नान्ययोषितम् ..
सुक्षामामत्यभुक्तां च स्वयं चैभिर्गुणैर्युतः ..125..
text_mt: nor one who is ungracious, nor one desiring another, nor one without desire, nor another's wife, / nor one who is emaciated, nor one who has overeaten; and he himself should possess these [corresponding] qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
snātaḥ sugandhadhṛgdhṛṣṭo na śrāṃtaḥ kṣudhito'pi vā ..
sakāmaḥ sānurāgaśca vyavāyaṃ puruṣo vrajet .. 126 ..
meaning:
स्नातः सुगन्धधृग्धृष्टो न श्रांतः क्षुधितोऽपि वा ..
सकामः सानुरागश्च व्यवायं पुरुषो व्रजेत् .. 126 ..
text_mt: Bathed, wearing scents, cheerful, not fatigued nor hungry, / desiring and affectionate, a man should engage in sexual union.

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaśyāṃ tathāṣṭamyāṃ paṃcadaśyāṃ ca parvasu ..
tailābhyaṃgaṃ tathā bhogānyoṣitaśca vivarjayet .. 127 ..
meaning:
चतुर्दश्यां तथाष्टम्यां पंचदश्यां च पर्वसु ..
तैलाभ्यंगं तथा भोगान्योषितश्च विवर्जयेत् .. 127 ..
text_mt: On the fourteenth, likewise on the eighth, and on the fifteenth, and on the parvan days, / he should avoid oil massage, sensual pleasures, and women.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣura karmaṇi cāṃte ca strīsaṃbhoge ca bhārata ..
snāyīta cailavānprātaḥ kaṭabhūmimupetya ca .. 128 ..
meaning:
क्षुर कर्मणि चांते च स्त्रीसंभोगे च भारत ..
स्नायीत चैलवान्प्रातः कटभूमिमुपेत्य च .. 128 ..
text_mt: After shaving, at the end [of an illness], after intercourse with a woman, O descendant of Bharata, / and after visiting a cemetery ground, he should bathe with his clothes on in the morning.

sanskrit_iast:
guroḥ pativratānāṃ ca tathā yajñatapasvinām ..
parivādaṃ na kurvīta parihāse'pi bhārata .. 129 ..
meaning:
गुरोः पतिव्रतानां च तथा यज्ञतपस्विनाम् ..
परिवादं न कुर्वीत परिहासेऽपि भारत .. 129 ..
text_mt: He should not speak ill of a guru, of devoted wives, / or of sacrificers and ascetics, even in jest, O descendant of Bharata.

sanskrit_iast:
yugapajjalamagniṃ ca bibhṛyānna vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
guruṃ devānprati tathā na ca pādau prasārayet .. 4.205.130 ..
meaning:
युगपज्जलमग्निं च बिभृयान्न विचक्षणः ..
गुरुं देवान्प्रति तथा न च पादौ प्रसारयेत् .. 4.205.130 ..
text_mt: A wise man should not carry water and fire simultaneously; / nor should he stretch out his feet toward a guru or toward the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
nācakṣīta dhayaṃtīṃ gāṃ jalaṃ nāṃjalinā pibet ..
vātātapau na seveta anutāpaṃ ca varjayet ..131..
meaning:
नाचक्षीत धयंतीं गां जलं नांजलिना पिबेत् ..
वातातपौ न सेवेत अनुतापं च वर्जयेत् ..131..
text_mt: He should not point out a cow suckling a calf; he should not drink water with cupped hands; / he should not expose himself to wind and blazing sun; and he should avoid remorse.

sanskrit_iast:
dāsaṃ śapenna vai kruddhaḥ sarvabandhūnamatsarī ..
bhītāśvāsanakṛtsādhuḥ svargastasyāvyayaṃ phalam .. 132 ..
meaning:
दासं शपेन्न वै क्रुद्धः सर्वबन्धूनमत्सरी ..
भीताश्वासनकृत्साधुः स्वर्गस्तस्याव्ययं फलम् .. 132 ..
text_mt: He should not curse a servant when angry, free of malice toward all kinsmen; / he who comforts the frightened is virtuous: heaven is his imperishable fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
nordhvaṃ tu pattanadvāraṃ nirīkṣya paryaṭennaraḥ..
yugamātraṃ mahīpṛṣṭhe naro gacchedvilokayan .. 133 ..
meaning:
नोर्ध्वं तु पत्तनद्वारं निरीक्ष्य पर्यटेन्नरः..
युगमात्रं महीपृष्ठे नरो गच्छेद्विलोकयन् .. 133 ..
text_mt: A man should not wander looking upward at the city gate; / a man should walk gazing only a yoke's length upon the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣāhe tvapi śeṣāṃśca vaśyātmā yo nirasyati ..
tasya dharmārthakāmānāṃ hānirnālpāpi jāyate .. 134 ..
meaning:
शेषाहे त्वपि शेषांश्च वश्यात्मा यो निरस्यति ..
तस्य धर्मार्थकामानां हानिर्नाल्पापि जायते .. 134 ..
text_mt: He who, having mastered himself, discards remainder on remaining days, / suffers not even the slightest loss of virtue, wealth, and desire.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛthā māṃsaṃ na khādeta pṛṣṭhamāṃsaṃ tathaiva ca ..
ākrośaṃ ca vivādaṃ ca paiśunyaṃ ca vivarjayet .. 135 ..
meaning:
वृथा मांसं न खादेत पृष्ठमांसं तथैव च ..
आक्रोशं च विवादं च पैशुन्यं च विवर्जयेत् .. 135 ..
text_mt: He should not eat meat needlessly, nor back-meat; / he should avoid reviling, dispute, and calumny.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃyāvaṃ kṛśaraṃ māṃsaṃ śaṣkulīpāyasaṃ tathā ..
ātmārthe na prakartavyaṃ devatānāṃ prakalpayet .. .. 136 ..
meaning:
संयावं कृशरं मांसं शष्कुलीपायसं तथा ..
आत्मार्थे न प्रकर्तव्यं देवतानां प्रकल्पयेत् .. .. 136 ..
text_mt: Sweet fried dough, kṛśara, meat, cakes, and milk-rice / should not be made for oneself; he should prepare them for the deities.

sanskrit_iast:
ajāśca nāvakarṣeta tā bahirdhārayaṃti ca ..
raktamālyaṃ na dhāryaṃ syācchuklaṃ dhāryaṃ tu paṃḍitaiḥ .. 137 ..
meaning:
अजाश्च नावकर्षेत ता बहिर्धारयंति च ..
रक्तमाल्यं न धार्यं स्याच्छुक्लं धार्यं तु पंडितैः .. 137 ..
text_mt: He should not drag goats, for they carry outside; / a red garland should not be worn, but white should be worn by the wise,

sanskrit_iast:
varjayitvātra kamalaṃ tathā kuvalayaṃ vibho ..
raktaṃ śirasi dhāryaṃ ca tathā pāneyamityapi .. 138 ..
meaning:
वर्जयित्वात्र कमलं तथा कुवलयं विभो ..
रक्तं शिरसि धार्यं च तथा पानेयमित्यपि .. 138 ..
text_mt: excepting here the lotus and the blue water-lily, O lord; / red [flowers] may be worn on the head, as well as aquatic ones.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṃcanīyāpi yā mālā sā na duṣyati karhicit ..
anyadeva bhavedvāsaḥ śayanīye narottama .. 139 ..
meaning:
कांचनीयापि या माला सा न दुष्यति कर्हिचित् ..
अन्यदेव भवेद्वासः शयनीये नरोत्तम .. 139 ..
text_mt: Even a garland made of gold is never defiled; / there should be one garment for the bed, O best of men,

sanskrit_iast:
anyadarcāsu devānāmanyaddhāryaṃ sabhāsu ca ..
pippalaṃ ca vaṭaṃ caiva śīrṇaśleṣmāṃtakaṃ tathā .. 4.205.140 ..
meaning:
अन्यदर्चासु देवानामन्यद्धार्यं सभासु च ..
पिप्पलं च वटं चैव शीर्णश्लेष्मांतकं तथा .. 4.205.140 ..
text_mt: another for the worship of the gods, and another to be worn in assemblies. / The pippala, the banyan, and the withered śleṣmātaka,

sanskrit_iast:
udubaraṃ na khādeta bhavārthī puruṣottamaḥ ..
patitaiśca kathāṃte ca cchedanaṃ ca vivarjayet .. 141 ..
meaning:
उदुबरं न खादेत भवार्थी पुरुषोत्तमः ..
पतितैश्च कथांते च च्छेदनं च विवर्जयेत् .. 141 ..
text_mt: and the udumbara he should not eat, if he desires prosperity, O best of men; / he should avoid conversation with fallen persons and causing injury.

sanskrit_iast:
patitaḥ syānnaro rājanpatitaistu sahācaran ..
vṛddho jñātistathā mitraṃ daridro yo bhavediha .. 142 ..
meaning:
पतितः स्यान्नरो राजन्पतितैस्तु सहाचरन् ..
वृद्धो ज्ञातिस्तथा मित्रं दरिद्रो यो भवेदिह .. 142 ..
text_mt: A man becomes fallen, O king, by associating with the fallen. / An elderly kinsman, a friend, or anyone here who is poor,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhe vā saṃsthāpitāste gṛhavṛddhimabhīpsatā ..
gṛhe pārāvatā dhanyāḥ śukāśca sahasārikāḥ.. 143 ..
meaning:
गृहे वा संस्थापितास्ते गृहवृद्धिमभीप्सता ..
गृहे पारावता धन्याः शुकाश्च सहसारिकाः.. 143 ..
text_mt: should be settled in the house by one desiring the house's prosperity. / Pigeons in the house bring fortune, as do parrots along with mynas;

sanskrit_iast:
bhavaṃtyete tathā pāpāstathā vai tilapāyikāḥ ..
ājokṣā caṃdanaṃ vīṇā ādarśo madhusarpiṣī .. 144 ..
meaning:
भवंत्येते तथा पापास्तथा वै तिलपायिकाः ..
आजोक्षा चंदनं वीणा आदर्शो मधुसर्पिषी .. 144 ..
text_mt: these, however, are inauspicious: cockroaches; / a goat-bull, sandalwood, a lute, a mirror, honey, and clarified butter [are auspicious].

sanskrit_iast:
jalāgnī caiva bibhṛyādgṛhe nityamiti sthitiḥ..
dhanurvede ca satataṃ yatnaḥ kāryo narādhipa .. 145 ..
meaning:
जलाग्नी चैव बिभृयाद्गृहे नित्यमिति स्थितिः..
धनुर्वेदे च सततं यत्नः कार्यो नराधिप .. 145 ..
text_mt: And water and fire one should maintain continually in the home; such is the rule. / And, O ruler of men, constant effort must be made in the science of archery.

sanskrit_iast:
hastipṛṣṭhe'śvapṛṣṭhe ca rathacaryāsu caiva hi..
yatnavānbhava rājendra nayavānsukhamedhate .. 146 ..
meaning:
हस्तिपृष्ठेऽश्वपृष्ठे च रथचर्यासु चैव हि..
यत्नवान्भव राजेन्द्र नयवान्सुखमेधते .. 146 ..
text_mt: On the back of an elephant, on the back of a horse, and in chariot maneuvers, / be diligent, O king of kings; one who possesses statecraft prospers in happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpālana yuktaśca na kṣāṃtiṃ labhate nṛpa ..
yajñaśāstraṃ ca vijñāya śabdaśāstraṃ ca bhārata .. 147 ..
meaning:
प्रजापालन युक्तश्च न क्षांतिं लभते नृप ..
यज्ञशास्त्रं च विज्ञाय शब्दशास्त्रं च भारत .. 147 ..
text_mt: And dedicated to protecting his subjects, a king finds no rest. / Having understood the science of sacrifice and the science of grammar, O Bhārata,

sanskrit_iast:
gāṃdharvaśāstraṃ vijñeyaṃ kalā jñeyāśca bhārata ..
purāṇamitihāsaṃ ca tathākhyānāni yāni ca .. 148 ..
meaning:
गांधर्वशास्त्रं विज्ञेयं कला ज्ञेयाश्च भारत ..
पुराणमितिहासं च तथाख्यानानि यानि च .. 148 ..
text_mt: the science of music must be understood, and the arts must be understood, O Bhārata, / as well as the Purāṇa, the epic, and whatever narratives there are.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa te lakṣaṇoddeśa ācārasya prakīrtitaḥ ..
śeṣāśca vedyā vṛddhebhyaḥ pratyāhāryā narādhipa.. 149 ..
meaning:
एष ते लक्षणोद्देश आचारस्य प्रकीर्तितः ..
शेषाश्च वेद्या वृद्धेभ्यः प्रत्याहार्या नराधिप.. 149 ..
text_mt: This brief indication of the characteristics of conduct has been proclaimed to you; / the rest should be learned from the elders and adopted, O ruler of men.

sanskrit_iast:
ācāro bhūtijanana ācāraḥ kīrtivardhanaḥ ..

text_mt: Conduct indeed is spoken of as best among all sacred scriptures; / conduct is the highest dharma; from conduct wealth increases.

sanskrit_iast:

सर्ववर्णानुकंपार्थं मयैतत्समुदाहृतम् .. .. 152 ..
text_mt: Meritorious, bringing fame and longevity, leading to heaven, a great blessing— / this has been proclaimed by me out of compassion for all castes.

meaning:

रोहिणीचन्द्रशयनव्रतविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Conduct alone, when practiced, O bull among men, grants men the fruits of dharma, wealth, and pleasure in this world; / therefore, O king, it must always be carefully maintained day by day by the wise man as proclaimed in the scriptures.
Description of the procedure for the Rohiṇīcandraśayana observance.

sanskrit_iast:

tasminnārāyaṇasyārccāmarccayediṃdunāmabhiḥ .. 3 ..

तस्मिन्नारायणस्यार्च्चामर्च्चयेदिंदुनामभिः .. 3 ..
text_mt: The observance here named Rohiṇīcandraśayana is supreme; / in it one should worship the image of Nārāyaṇa with the names of the moon.

sanskrit_iast:

अथ वा ब्रह्मनक्षत्रं पौर्णमास्यां प्रजायते .. 4 ..
text_mt: When the fifteenth lunar day is joined with Monday, / or else the asterism of Brahmā falls on a full moon day,

sanskrit_iast:

āpyāyasveti ca japedvidvānaṣṭaśataṃ punaḥ .. .. 5 ..

आप्यायस्वेति च जपेद्विद्वानष्टशतं पुनः .. .. 5 ..
text_mt: then a man should bathe with the five products of the cow and with mustard seeds; / and the learned man should recite [the mantra] "Āpyāyasva..." one hundred and eight times.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdro'pi parayā bhaktyā pākhaṃḍālāpavarjitaḥ ..
somāya varadāyātha viṣṇave ca namonamaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
शूद्रोऽपि परया भक्त्या पाखंडालापवर्जितः ..
सोमाय वरदायाथ विष्णवे च नमोनमः .. 6 ..
text_mt: Even a śūdra, endowed with supreme devotion and avoiding speech with heretics, [should recite:] / "Obeisance, obeisance to Soma, the giver of boons, and to Viṣṇu."

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtajapyaḥ svabhavanamāgatya madhusūdanam ..
pūjayetphalapuṣpaiśca somanāmāni kīrtayet .. 7 ..
meaning:
कृतजप्यः स्वभवनमागत्य मधुसूदनम् ..
पूजयेत्फलपुष्पैश्च सोमनामानि कीर्तयेत् .. 7 ..
text_mt: Having performed his recitation and returned to his home, / he should worship Madhusūdana with fruits and flowers, and chant the names of the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
somāya śāṃtāya namo'stu pādāvanaṃtanāmne hyanujānu jaṃghe ..

meaning:

ऊरुद्वयं चापि वृकोदराय संपूजयेन्मेढ्रमनंगबाहवे .. 8 ..
text_mt: With "Obeisance to Soma, the peaceful," the two feet; with "To him named Ananta," the shanks below the knees; / and the two thighs with "To Vṛkodara"; he should worship the penis with "To Anaṅgabāhu";

sanskrit_iast:

tathodaraṃ cāpyamṛtodarāya nābhiḥ supūjyā vidhilocanāya .. 9 ..
meaning:
नमोनमः कामसुखप्रदाय कटिः शशांकस्य समर्चनीया ..
तथोदरं चाप्यमृतोदराय नाभिः सुपूज्या विधिलोचनाय .. 9 ..
text_mt: with "Obeisance, obeisance to the giver of the pleasure of desire," the hips of the moon are to be worshipped; / likewise the belly with "To him of nectar-belly"; the navel is to be well worshipped with "To Vidhilocana";

sanskrit_iast:
namo'stu candrāya mukhaṃ prapūjya hanurdvijānāmadhipāya pūjyā ..
āsyaṃ namaścaṃdramasebhipūjyamoṣṭhau kumutkhaṃḍavanapriyāya .. 4.206.10 ..
meaning:
नमोऽस्तु चन्द्राय मुखं प्रपूज्य हनुर्द्विजानामधिपाय पूज्या ..
आस्यं नमश्चंद्रमसेभिपूज्यमोष्ठौ कुमुत्खंडवनप्रियाय .. 4.206.10 ..
text_mt: having worshipped the face with "Obeisance to the moon," the chin is to be worshipped with "To the lord of the twice-born"; / having worshipped the mouth with "Obeisance to the moon," the two lips with "To him who loves clusters of night-blooming water lilies";

sanskrit_iast:

netradvayaṃ nīlakumutpriyāya ceṃdīvaraśyāmakarāya coraḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
नासा च नाथाय वनौषधीनां ह्यानंन्ददायाथ पुनर्भ्रुवोश्च ..
नेत्रद्वयं नीलकुमुत्प्रियाय चेंदीवरश्यामकराय चोरः .. 11 ..
text_mt: and the nose with "To the master of forest herbs," and both eyebrows with "To the giver of bliss"; / the two eyes with "To him who loves blue water lilies," and the chest with "To him whose hands are dark like blue lotuses";

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ samastādhvaravaṃditāya karṇadvayaṃ daityaniṣūdanāya ..
lalāṭamiṃdorudadhipriyāya keśā suṣumṇādhipateḥ prapūjyāḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:

text_mt: the two ears with "Obeisance to him praised in all sacrifices," with "To the slayer of daityas"; / the forehead of the moon with "To the beloved of the ocean"; the hair is to be worshipped with "To the lord of Suṣumṇā";

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: the head with "To the moon, obeisance to the enemy of the asuras"; the diadem with "Obeisance to the lord of the universe"; / with "To Lakṣmī named Rohiṇī, who loves the lotus, the star of good fortune, happiness, and nectar..."

text_mt: And having worshipped the goddess, the wife of the moon, with fragrant incense, food offerings, flowers, and the like, / having paid homage on the ground and risen again, having bathed, he, taking sacrificial food,

sanskrit_iast:

संप्राश्य गोमूत्रममांसमन्नमक्षारमष्टावथ विंशतिं च .. 15 ..
text_mt: should give in the morning that pot of water containing gold to a brāhmaṇa, for the destruction of mental sins. / Having consumed cow's urine, and twenty-eight mouthfuls of meatless,

कदंबनीलोत्पलकेतकानि जाती सरोजं शतपत्रिका च ..16..

श्रावणादिषु मासेषु क्रमादेतानि सर्वदा ..

vratāṃte śayanaṃ dadyāddarpaṇopaskarānvitam .. 19 ..

एकसंवत्सरं यावदुपोष्य विधिवन्नरः ..

क्षीरकुंभोपरि पुन. कांस्यपात्राक्षतान्वितम् .. 21 ..

meaning:
दद्यान्मंत्रेणे पूर्वाह्ने शालीक्षुफलसंयुतम् ..
श्वेतामथ सुवर्णास्यां रौप्यखुरसमन्विताम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: He should give it with a mantra in the forenoon, together with rice, sugarcane, and fruit, / and a white cow with a golden face, equipped with silver hooves,

sanskrit_iast:

bhūṣaṇairdvijadāṃpatyamalaṃkṛtya guṇānvitam .. 23 ..
meaning:

भूषणैर्द्विजदांपत्यमलंकृत्य गुणान्वितम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: together with garments and vessels, and an auspicious conch. / Having adorned a virtuous brāhmaṇa couple with ornaments,

yathā na rohiṇī kṛṣṇa śayanaṃ tyajya gacchati .. 24 ..
meaning:
चंद्रोऽयं द्विजरूपेण सभार्य इति कल्पयेत् ..

text_mt: he should conceptualize: "This is the moon with his wife in the form of a brāhmaṇa. / Just as Rohiṇī, O Kṛṣṇa, does not abandon the bed and go away,

text_mt: so may there be non-difference for me from your forms, O you who have the form of the moon. / Just as you alone are the giver of supreme bliss and liberation to all,

इति संसारभीतस्य मुक्तिकामस्य चानघ .. 26 ..
text_mt: so may my enjoyment, liberation, and devotion be steadfast in you, the Sacrifice." / Thus, for one afraid of transmigration and desiring liberation, O sinless one,

meaning:
रूपारोग्यायुषामेतद्विधायकमनुत्तमम् ..
इदमेव पितॄणां च सर्वदा वल्लभं मुने .. 27 ..

चंद्रलोकमवाप्नोति पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् .. 28 ..
